Wa tawwaali Abiimalik naada Ishaakh wa gaal leyah-:-Akiid hi di martak-!Maala gult leena hi akhtak-? Wa Ishaakh gaal leyah-:-Ana gult al-kalaam da achaan ana khaayif yaktuluuni be sababha.
Wa Abiimalik radda leyah wa gaal-:-Da chunu al-sawweetah leena da-?Wa hassa' kan naadum waahid min cha'abi ragad ma'a martak da,ma khalaas aniina kullina ke bigiina khaatiyiin walla-?
Wa Abiimalik amar kulla l-cha'ab wa gaal-:-Ma tilammusu al-raajil da wa la martah-!Al-yilammishum,waajib yaktuluuh-!
Wa Ishaakh harat fi l-balad di wa fi l-sana di,ligi miya marra ziyaada achaan Allah baarakah.
Wa hu bigi khani wa maalah gaa'id yiziid lahaddi bigi khani marra waahid.
Wa indah khanam wa bagar wa khaddaamiin katiiriin.Wa achaan da bas,al-Filistiyiin hasadooh le Ishaakh.
Wa humman gammo dafano kulla l-biyaar al-awwal khaddaamiin abuuh Ibraahiim hafaroohum.
Khalaas Abiimalik gamma gaal le Ishaakh-:-Hassa' inta bigiit chadiid bilheen minnina.Yalla gumm fuut-!
Wa khalaas,Ishaakh gamma min al-bakaan da wa macha waadi Garaar wa sakan hinaak.
Wa hafar min jadiid al-biyaar al-hafaroohum fi wakit abuuh Ibraahiim.Dool al-biyaar al-dafanoohum al-Filistiyiin ba'ad moot Ibraahiim.Wa Ishaakh sammaahum be nafs al-asaame al-abuuh Ibraahiim sammaahum beehum awwal.
Wa yoom waahid,khaddaamiin Ishaakh hafaro biir fi l-waadi wa ligo almi nadiif.
Wa ru'yaan balad Garaar harajoohum le ru'yaan Ishaakh wa gaalo leehum-:-Al-almi da hanaana. Wa khalaas,Ishaakh samma al-biir di Isig (ma'anaatah al-muchkila) achaan humman harajo ma'aayah foogha.
Wa ba'ad da,khaddaamiin Ishaakh hafaro biir aakhara wa battaan macho harajoohum foogha wa khalaas,Ishaakh sammaaha Sitna (ma'anaatah al-khilaaf).
Wa Ishaakh hawwal min al-bakaan da wa hafar biir aakhara wa fi l-marra di,ma harajooh foogha.Wa samma al-biir di Rahubuut (ma'anaatah al-wasa'a).Wa gaal-:-Hassa' da,Allah jammaana wa nagdaro niziidu fi l-ard.
Wa hawwal min al-bakaan da wa macha Biir Sab'a.
Wa be l-leel,Allah baan leyah wa gaal-:-Ana Rabb abuuk Ibraahiim.Ma takhaaf,ana ma'aak-!Wa nibaarikak wa nisawwi zurriiytak tabga katiire fi chaan abdi Ibraahiim.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Ishaakh bana madbah wa sa'al be usum Allah.Wa bana fariigah wa khaddaamiinah hafaro biir.
Wa Abiimalik gamma min Garaar ma'a rafiigah Ahuzzat wa Fikuul mas'uul askarah.Wa macha gaabal Ishaakh.
Wa Ishaakh gaal leehum-:-Maala jiitu leyi-?Ma intu bas al-kirihtuuni wa taradtuuni ba'iid minku-?
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Aniina chifna kadar Allah gaa'id ma'aak.Khalli aniina nahalfu wa nisawwu ma'aak mu'aahada.
Wa inta kula tahlif ma tisawwi leena cheyy fasil achaan aniina sawweena leek al-kheer wa khalleenaak macheet be l-salaama.Achaan inta bigiit naadum al-Allah baarakah.
Wa khalaas,Ishaakh sawwa leehum aazuuma wa humman akalo wa chirbo.
Wa ambaakir fajur,gammo sawwo haliife ambeenaathum.Wa ba'ad da,Ishaakh addaahum wa humman macho be l-salaama.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom,khaddaamiin Ishaakh jo khabbarooh be l-biir al-gaa'idiin yahfuruuha wa gaalo leyah-:-Aniina ligiina almi.
Wa Ishaakh samma al-biir di Sab'a (ma'anaatah al-haliife).Wa bakaan al-biir di bigi hille wa lahaddi l-yoom binaaduuha Biir Sab'a.
Wa Isuu indah 40 sana wakit akhad awiin itneen,al-waahide Yahuudiit bineeyit Biiri al-Hitti wa l-aakhara Baasmat bineeyit Iluun wa hu kula Hitti.
Wa l-awiin dool marraro marra waahid al-haya le Ishaakh wa Rifga.
Wa Ishaakh bigi chaayib wa uyuunah ma bichiifu.Wa khalaas,gamma naada wileedah al-bikir Isuu wa gaal-:-Ya wileedi-! Wa hu gaal-:-Na'am-!
Wa Ishaakh gaal leyah-:-Chiif ana bigiit chaayib wa ma na'arif yoom mooti.
Hassa' da chiil silaahak wa nubbaalak wa nuchchaabak wa amchi al-ganiis wa jiib leyi seede.
Wa sawwi leyi beeha akil al-niriidah wa jiibah leyi naakul achaan nibaarikak gubbaal ma numuut.
Wa wakit Ishaakh gaa'id yihajji le wileedah Isuu da,Rifga gaa'ide tasma' fi kalaamah.Khalaas Isuu marag macha fi l-khala le yaktul seede wa yijiibha.
Wa ba'ad da,Rifga gaalat le wileedha Yaakhuub-:-Asma'-!Ana simi't abuuk hajja le akhuuk Isuu wa gaal-:
--Jiib leyi seede wa sawwi leyi akil al-niriidah achaan nibaarikak giddaam Allah gubbaal ma numuut.--
Hassa' da,ya wileedi,asma' kalaami wa sawwi al-cheyy al-naamurak beyah.
Amchi fi l-zariibe wa jiib leyi sukhlaan itneen sumaan wa ana nisawwi le abuuk al-akil al-halu al-hu yiriidah.
Wa inta tiwaddi al-akil da le abuuk wa hu yaakulah achaan yibaarikak gubbaal ma yumuut.
Laakin Yaakhuub gaal le ammah Rifga-:-Akhuuyi Isuu jildah kulla suuf wa ana jildi amlas.
Wa akuun abuuyi yalmasni wa ya'arifni wa yuguul ana khachcheetah wa yugumm yal'anni wa ma yibaarikni.
Wa ammah gaalat leyah-:-Khalli al-la'ana di talhagni ana,ya wileedi.Asma' kalaami-!Amchi-!Jiib leyi al-sukhlaan.
Wa khalaas,Yaakhuub macha jaab al-sukhlaan le ammah wa hi gammat sawwat al-akil al-abuuh yiriidah.
Wa ba'ad da,Rifga chaalat khulgaan al-samhiin hana Isuu wileedha al-kabiir,al-gaa'idiin fi bakaanha fi l-beet wa labbasathum le Yaakhuub wileedha al-sakhayyar.
Wa be l-farwa hana l-sukhlaan,hi labbasat iideenah wa ragabatah bakaan al-amlas.
Wa Rifga antat le wileedha Yaakhuub al-akil al-halu wa l-khubza al-hi sawwatha.
Wa khalaas,Yaakhuub gamma macha le abuuh wa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi. Wa Ishaakh gaal-:-Na'am-!Inta yaatu,ya wileedi-?
Wa Yaakhuub gaal-:-Ana Isuu wileedak al-bikir.Ana sawweet al-cheyy al-inta talabtah minni.Min iznak,gumm wa aakul laham al-seede achaan inta be nafsak tibaarikni.
Wa Ishaakh gaal leyah-:-Ya wileedi,da kikkeef inta ligiitha ajala ke-? Wa Yaakhuub gaal-:-Achaan Allah Ilaahak bas jaab leyi al-seede.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,khalaas Ishaakh gaal le Yaakhuub-:-Ta'aal gariib,ya wileedi,achaan nilammisak wa na'arif kadar inta bas wileedi Isuu walla la.
Wa Yaakhuub garrab le abuuh Ishaakh wa hu limsah wa gaal-:-Al-hiss,hiss hana Yaakhuub laakin al-iideen,iideen hana Isuu.
Wa be misil da,Ishaakh ma irif Yaakhuub achaan iideenah induhum suuf misil akhuuh Isuu.Wa khalaas,hu baarakah.
Wa gubbaal ma yibaarikah,hu sa'alah battaan wa gaal-:-Sahiih ke inta wileedi Isuu-? Wa Yaakhuub gaal-:-Aywa.
Wa khalaas,Ishaakh gaal leyah-:-Ya wileedi,antiini naakul al-laham al-jibtah achaan ana be nafsi nibaarikak. Wa Yaakhuub anta al-akil le abuuh.Wa hu akalah wa jaab leyah khamar wa hu chiribah.
Wa ba'ad da,Ishaakh abuuh gaal leyah-:-Ya wileedi,ta'aal gariib wa hibbini.
Wa Yaakhuub garrab leyah wa habbaah.Wa Ishaakh chamma al-riihe hint khulgaanah wa gamma baarakah wa gaal-:-Aywa-!Al-riihe di hint wileedi-!Hi misil riihe hint zere'al-Allah baarakah.
Khalli al-Rabb yantiikkarany al-yanzil min al-samawa intaaj al-ard.Wa yantiik gamehwa khamar jadiid be katara.
Khalli al-chu'uub yakhdumu leekwa l-umam yasjudu giddaamak.Wa abga siid akhwaanakwa iyaal ammak yasjudu giddaamak-!Al-yal'anak mal'uunwa l-yibaarikak mubaarak.
Wa wakit Ishaakh kammal min mubaarakat Yaakhuub wa Yaakhuub marag min bakaan abuuh da,khalaas tawwaali ke akhuuh Isuu ja min al-ganiis.
Wa hu kula sawwa akil halu wa jaabah le abuuh wa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi,gumm wa aakul laham al-seede al-ana wileedak jibtah achaan inta be nafsak tibaarikni.
Wa abuuh Ishaakh gaal leyah-:-Inta yaatu-? Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana wileedak al-bikir Isuu.
Wa min simi' al-kalaam da,Ishaakh gamma yarjif chadiid wa gaal-:-Yaatu al-macha al-ganiis wa jaab leyi laham-?Wa ana akalt minnah hassa' gubbaal inta ma taji wa ana baaraktah.Wa akiid hu yabga mubaarak-!
Wa wakit Isuu simi' kalaam abuuh,gamma yikoorik korooraak chadiid hana waja' galib wa gaal le abuuh-:-Baarikni ana kula,ya abuuyi-!
Wa Ishaakh gaal leyah-:-Akhuuk ja khachchaani wa ana baaraktah fi badalak.
Wa Isuu gaal-:-Achaan usmah Yaakhuub (ma'anaatah al-najiid),da bas khachchaani marrateen-!Awwal chaal bukuuriiyti wa hassa' daahu chaal barakati-!-Wa gaal battaan-:-Inta ma faddalt leyi baraka waahide kula-?
Wa Ishaakh radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana sawweetah siidak wa sawweet kulla akhwaanah yabgo khaddaamiin leyah.Wa anteetah gameh wa khamar be katara.Wa battaan ana nagdar nisawwi leek chunu,ya wileedi-?
Wa Isuu gaal le abuuh-:-Ya abuuyi,indak baraka waahide bas-?Baarikni ana kula,ya abuuyi-! Wa Isuu gamma yabki baki chadiid.
Wa Ishaakh abuuh gaal leyah-:-Inta taskun fi ard al-ma indaha intaajwa ma indaha karanyal-yanzil min al-sama.
Wa inta ti'iich be seefakwa takhdim le akhuuk.Laakin fi ruwaakhtak al-jaay wa jaay,tidalli tagalatah min kataafeek.
Wa Isuu bigi khasiim le Yaakhuub achaan al-baraka al-abuuh Ishaakh baarakah beeha.Wa Isuu gaal fi galbah-:-Abuuyi gariib yumuut.Ba'ad ayyaam al-hizin,naktul akhuuyi Yaakhuub.
Wa khabbaro Rifga be kalaam Isuu wileedha al-kabiir.Khalaas hi rassalat naadat Yaakhuub wileedha al-sakhayyar wa gaalat leyah-:-Daahu akhuuk Isuu yidoor yilkaffa foogak wa yaktulak.
Hassa' da,ya wileedi,asma' kalaami.Gumm arrid amchi bakaan akhuuyi Laabaan fi Haaraan.
Wa agood ma'aayah ayyaam hinaak,lahaddi akhuuk za'alah yufuut.
Wa kan za'alah faat wa nisi al-cheyy al-inta sawweetah leyah da,khalaas ana nirassil leek,taji.Maala ana niwaddirku intu al-itneen fi nafs al-yoom-?
Wa ba'ad da,Rifga gaalat le Ishaakh-:-Al-haya bakhkhadat leyi fi chaan banaat al-Hittiyiin dool.Wa kan Yaakhuub kula yaakhud waahide min banaat al-Hittiyiin al-fi l-balad di,ana hayaati ma indaha faayde.
Wa khalaas,Ishaakh naada Yaakhuub wa baarakah wa wassaah wa gaal leyah-:-Ma taakhud mara min banaat al-Kan'aaniyiin
laakin gumm amchi Faddaan Araam bakaan Batuwiil abu ammak.Wa aakhud mara min hinaak,min banaat Laabaan akhu ammak.
Wa khalli Allah al-Gaadir yibaarikak wa talda iyaal wa yabgo katiiriin achaan inta tabga jidd hana umam katiiriin.
Wa khalli al-Rabb yantiik inta wa zurriiytak al-ma'aak al-baraka al-antaaha le Ibraahiim.Wa intu tawrusu al-balad al-hu antaaha le Ibraahiim wa inta saakin foogha misil ajnabi.
Wa khalaas,Ishaakh rassal Yaakhuub wa hu macha Faddaan Araam,bakaan Laabaan wileed Batuwiil al-Araami.Wa Laabaan hu akhu Rifga amm Yaakhuub wa Isuu.
Wa Isuu irif kadar abuuh Ishaakh baarak Yaakhuub wa rassalah macha Faddaan Araam achaan yaakhud mara min hinaak.Wa irif kadar wakit abuuh baarakah,wassaah wa gaal leyah-:-Ma taakhud mara min banaat al-Kan'aaniyiin.
Wa Yaakhuub simi' kalaam ammah wa abuuh wa gamma macha Faddaan Araam.
Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,Isuu irif kadar abuuh Ishaakh ma yidoor banaat al-Kan'aaniyiin.
Wa khalaas,hu gamma macha le Ismaa'iil wileed Ibraahiim.Wa akhad bineeytah Mahla akhut Nabayuut.Wa hu akhadaaha min foog le awiinah al-aakhariin.
Wa Yaakhuub gamma min Biir Sab'a wa maachi le balad Haaraan.
Wa wassal fi bakaan waahid wa dawwar yunuum foogah achaan al-harraay waga'at.Wa chaal hajar alwassadah wa naam fi l-bakaan da.
Wa hu ri'i.Wa fi l-ru'ya di hu chaaf tallaa'a khattooha fi l-ard wa raasha fi l-sama.Wa malaa'ikat Allah yatla'o wa yanzulu beeha.
Wa Allah waagif jambah wa gaal leyah-:-Ana Allah Ilaah abuuk Ibraahiim wa Ilaah Ishaakh.Al-ard al-inta raagid foogha di,nantiiha leek wa le zurriiytak.
Wa zurriiytak tabga katiire misil turaab al-ard wa tiziid min al-sabaah le l-kharib wa min al-munchaakh le l-wati.Wa kulla gabaayil al-ard yalgo baraka beek inta wa be zurriiytak.
Chiif-!Ni'akkid leek-!Ana zaati gaa'id ma'aak.Nahfadak fi ayyi bakaan al-tamchi foogah wa nigabbilak fi l-balad di.Ana ma nikhalliik wa lahaddi nitimm kulla l-cheyy al-gultah leek.
Wa Yaakhuub gamma min noomah wa gaal-:-Akiid-!Allah gaa'id fi l-bakaan da wa ana ma iriftah.
Wa khoof chadiid dakhal leyah wa gaal-:-Al-bakaan da bikhawwif-!Akiid hu da beet al-Rabb-!Wa l-bakaan da baab al-sama-!
Wa be fajur badri,Yaakhuub gamma chaal al-hajar al-hu alwassadah,khazzaah wa sabba foogah dihin achaan yabga alaama yizzakkar beeha al-bakaan da.
Wa samma al-bakaan da Beet Iil (ma'anaatah beet Allah).Wa laakin zamaan,al-hille di usumha Luuz.
Wa ba'ad da,Yaakhuub sawwa nazir wa gaal-:-Kan al-Rabb gaa'id ma'aayi wa hafadni fi makhatari al-ana maachi foogah wa antaani akil wa lubaas
wa kan gabbalaani fi beet abuuyi be sihha wa salaama,khalaas Allah hu bas yabga Ilaahi.
Wa l-hajar al-khazzeetah leek,ya Rabbi,yabga beetak.Wa nantiik al-uchur min kulla cheyy al-tantiini.
Wa khalaas,Yaakhuub gamma macha ale balad al-sabaah.
Wa wakit maachi,ligi biir fi l-khala.Wa fi l-bakaan da,fi talaata door hana khanam raagdiin jamb al-biir achaan di bas al-biir al-yazguuhum foogha.Wa khachum al-biir di masduud be hajar kabiir.
Wa wakit kulla l-khanam yilimmu khalaas,al-ru'yaan yilizzu al-hajar min khachum al-biir wa yazgu al-khanam.Wa ba'ad da,yigabbulu al-hajar fi khachum al-biir.
Wa Yaakhuub gaal le l-ru'yaan-:-Ya akhwaani,intu min ween-? Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Aniina min Haaraan.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Ta'arfu Laabaan wileed wileedah le Naahuur-? Wa gaalo-:-Aywa na'arfuuh.
Wa hu gaal-:-Hu gaa'id aafe walla-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aafe.Wa diik bittah Raahiil jaaye be l-khanam.
Wa Yaakhuub gaal leehum-:-Al-harraay lissaa' foog,da ma al-wakit al-tilimmu foogah al-khanam.Azguuhum wa asraho beehum.
Wa l-ru'yaan gaalo leyah-:-Aniina ma nagdaro nazguuhum illa kan al-khanam kulluhum lammo,khalaas nilizzu al-hajar min khachum al-biir wa nazgu al-khanam.
Wa wakit Yaakhuub lissaa' gaa'id yihajji ma'aahum ke bas,Raahiil wassalat be khanam abuuha achaan hi kula raa'iye.
Wakit Yaakhuub chaaf Raahiil bineeyit Laabaan akhu ammah wa khanam Laabaan akhu ammah,tawwaali macha lazza al-hajar min khachum al-biir wa zaga khanam Laabaan akhu ammah.
Wa ba'adeen,habbaaha le Raahiil wa gamma yabki.
Wa Yaakhuub ooraaha le Raahiil kadar hu min ahal abuuha wa hu wileed Rifga.Wa tawwaali,hi jarat khabbarat abuuha.
Wa wakit Laabaan simi' be l-khabar hana Yaakhuub wileed akhtah,khalaas jara laagaah hadanah wa habbaah wa waddaah beetah.Wa Yaakhuub hajja le Laabaan be kulla cheyy al-kaan leyah.
Wa Laabaan gaal-:-Akiid inta da,wileed bitt ammi-!Inta min dammi wa lahami-!-Wa Yaakhuub ga'ad ma'a Laabaan muddit chahar.
Wa ba'ad da,Laabaan gaal leyah-:-Achaan inta min ahali bas,takhdim leyi saakit walla-?Ooriini maahiiytak kam.
Wa Laabaan indah banaat itneen wa l-kabiire usumha Leeya wa l-sakhayre usumha Raahiil.
Wa Leeya di choofha da'iif laakin Raahiil daggaha sameh wa jamiile marra waahid.
Wa Yaakhuub yiriidha le Raahiil wa gamma gaal-:-Ana nakhdim leek sab'a sana achaan naakhud Raahiil,bineeytak al-sakhayre.
Wa Laabaan gaal leyah-:-Nantiiha leek inta,akheer min nantiiha le naadum aakhar.Khalaas agood ma'aayi.
Wa be misil da,Yaakhuub khadam sab'a sana achaan yaakhud Raahiil.Wa l-siniin dool faato leyah ajala ke bas min hubbah leeha al-katiir.
Wa ba'ad da,Yaakhuub gaal le Laabaan-:-Antiini marti-!Al-wakit tamma le nichiilha aruus.
Khalaas Laabaan azam kulla naas al-hille wa sawwo al-aruus.
Laakin be l-leel,Laabaan chaal bineeytah Leeya wa waddaaha le Yaakhuub wa hu dakhal beeha.
Wa Laabaan antaaha le bineeytah Leeya khaddaamtah al-usumha Zilfa achaan takhdim leeha.
Wa be fajur,Yaakhuub chaaf wa irif kadar di Leeya-!Khalaas gamma gaal le Laabaan-:-Da chunu al-sawweetah leyi da-?Ma le Raahiil bas ana khadamt leek-?Maala khachcheetni-?
Wa Laabaan gaal leyah-:-Da ma fi aaditna kadar nantu al-sakhayre gubbaal al-kabiire.
Wa hassa' da,kammil al-usbuu' da ma'a l-kabiire di wa ba'adeen nantuuk al-sakhayre kula.Wa takhdim leyi battaan sab'a siniin aakhariin.
Wa Yaakhuub khassad wa tamma al-usbuu' hana l-iris ma'a Leeya wa ba'ad da,Laabaan antaah bineeytah Raahiil kula,le yichiilha aruus.
Wa Laabaan antaaha le bineeytah Raahiil khaddaamtah al-usumha Bilha achaan takhdim leeha.
Wa Yaakhuub dakhal be Raahiil kula wa laakin hu habbaaha le Raahiil ziyaada min Leeya.Wa khadam sab'a siniin battaan le Laabaan.
Wa wakit Allah chaaf kadar Leeya ma maryuuda,antaaha iyaal wa laakin Raahiil aagre.
Wa Leeya bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed wa sammatah Ra'uubiin (ma'anaatah Allah chaaf ta'abi).Wa gaalat-:-Akiid hassa' da,raajli yiriidni.
Wa Leeya khilbat battaan wa wildat wileed wa gaalat-:-Allah simi' kadar ana ma maryuuda wa antaani battaan leyah hu da. Wa be da,sammatah Chim'uun (ma'anaatah hu simi').
Wa battaan bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed wa gaalat-:-Hassa' da khalaas,raajli yinlawi foogi achaan jibt leyah talaata awlaad. Achaan da bas,al-wileed sammooh Laawi (ma'anaatah anlawa).
Wa battaan kula bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed wa gaalat-:-Fi l-marra di,nachkur Allah. Wa sammatah Yahuuza (ma'anaatah chukur).Wa ba'ad da,wagafat min al-waaluuda.
Wa wakit Raahiil chaafat kadar hi ma wildat le Yaakhuub,gammat nandalat fi akhutha wa gaalat le Yaakhuub-:-Antiini iyaal-!Kan ma ke da,ana numuut-!
Wa Yaakhuub gamma zi'il foogha wa gaal leeha-:-Ana wa la Allah,nadharki al-waaluuda.
Wa Raahiil gaalat leyah-:-Di hi khaddaamti Bilha.Adkhul beeha wa hi talda wa ana nirabbiihum.Wa beeha hi bas,ana kula nalga iyaal.
Wa hi dafa'at le Yaakhuub khaddaamitha Bilha wa hu dakhal beeha wa hi bigat martah.
Wa bigat khalbaane wa jaabat wileed le Yaakhuub.
Wa Raahiil gaalat-:-Al-Rabb hakam leyi-!Khibil su'aali wa antaani wileed. Achaan da,hi sammatah Daan (ma'anaatah hu hakam leyi).
Wa Bilha khaddaamit Raahiil jaabat battaan wileed le Yaakhuub.
Wa Raahiil gaalat-:-Ana haarabt akhti wa annasart. Wa sammatah Naftaali (ma'anaatah al-harib).
Wa wakit Leeya chaafat kadar hi wagafat min al-waaluuda,hi kula chaalat khaddaamitha Zilfa wa dafa'atha le Yaakhuub achaan tabga leyah mara.
Wa Zilfa khaddaamit Leeya jaabat wileed le Yaakhuub.
Wa Leeya gaalat-:-Al-sa'aada jaatni-! Wa l-wileed sammatah Gaad (ma'anaatah al-sa'aada).
Wa Zilfa khaddaamit Leeya jaabat battaan wileed le Yaakhuub.
Wa Leeya gaalat-:-Aywa-!Ana farhaane-!Wa l-banaat yinaadanni al-Farhaane. Wa hi sammatah Achiir (ma'anaatah al-farah).
Wa fi wakt al-gati' hana l-gameh,Ra'uubiin macha fi l-zere' wa ligi chadarat al-waaluuda wa jaabaaha le ammah Leeya.Wa Raahiil gaalat le Leeya-:-Min fadulki,antiini min chadarat al-waaluuda al-wileedki jaabaaha leeki di.
Wa laakin Leeya raddat leeha wa gaalat-:-Inti chilti raajli,da kula ma tammaaki-?Wa battaan tidoori tichiili chadarat al-waaluuda al-wileedi jaabaaha leyi-! Khalaas Raahiil gaalat leeha-:-Yo,sameh-!Kan ke da,khalli al-yoom Yaakhuub yamchi yargud fi bakaanki,fi badal chadarat al-waaluuda hana wileedki.
Wa be achiiye,wakit Yaakhuub jaayi min al-zere',Leeya maragat laagatah wa gaalat leyah-:-Al-yoom taji fi bakaani achaan ana ajjartak be chadarat al-waaluuda hana wileedi. Wa l-leele di,hu macha ragad fi bakaanha.
Wa l-Rabb simi' kalaam Leeya.Wa hi bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileedha al-khaamis le Yaakhuub.
Wa gaalat-:-Al-Rabb antaani ajur,ana al-anteet khaddaamti le raajli. Wa hi sammatah Yassaakar (ma'anaatah ajur).
Wa Leeya bigat battaan khalbaane wa wildat wileedha al-saadis le Yaakhuub.
Wa gaalat-:-Al-Rabb antaani hadiiye samha-!Wa fi l-marra di raajli yaskun ma'aayi achaan ana jibt leyah sitte awlaad. Wa hi sammatah Zabuluun (ma'anaatah yaskun).
Wa fi l-akhiir,jaabat bineeye wa sammatha Diina.
Wa ba'ad da,al-Rabb fakkar le Raahiil wa khibil su'aalha wa razakhaaha be l-waaluuda.
Wa hi bigat khalbaane wa jaabat wileed wa gaalat-:-Al-Rabb sallaani min al-ihaana.
Wa hi sammatah Yuusuf (ma'anaatah yiziid).Wa gaalat-:-Allah yiziidni wileed aakhar.
Wa ba'ad Raahiil wildat Yuusuf,Yaakhuub gaal le Laabaan-:-Khalliini nigabbil baladi.
Hassa' da,antiini awiini wa iyaali al-fi chaanhum ana khadamt leek.Nichiilhum wa namchi.Wa inta zaatak ta'arif adiil kulla l-khidme al-ana sawweetha leek.
Wa Laabaan gaal leyah-:-Ya wileedi,kan inta radyaan leyi,ana chawwaft wa irift kadar Allah baarakaani be sababak inta.
Ooriini maahiiytak wa nikaffiik.
Wa Yaakhuub gaal leyah-:-Inta zaatak ta'arif kikkeef ana khadamt leek wa chift kikkeef maalak bigi beyi ana.
Achaan al-maal al-chiyya al-awwal indak gubbaali,hassa' zaad wa bigi katiir.Wa Allah baarakak min ana jiit fi beetak.Wa hassa' da,nakhdim le nafsi mata-?
Wa Laabaan gaal-:-Waajib nantiik chunu-? Wa Yaakhuub radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ma tantiini cheyy.Laakin kan tikhassid be l-kalaam al-nuguulah leek da,ana nasrah leek battaan be khanamak wa nahfadhum.
Al-yoom namchi fi lubb maalak wa ni'azzil kulla l-khanam al-rugut wa l-duro' wa kulla l-dawaayin al-zurug min khanamak.Wa ni'azzil min inzeek kulla l-rugut wa l-duro'.Wa dool bas yabgo maahiiyti.
Wa ambaakir,kan inta macheet chift khanami wa ligiit fooghum loon aakhar,da illa ana saragtah.Wa be da,ta'arif kan ana saalih walla la.
Wa Laabaan gaal-:-Sameh.Ana khassadt be kalaamak da.
Wa laakin fi nafs al-yoom,Laabaan gamma azzal al-tuyuus al-rugut wa l-induhum siihaan wa l-inze al-duro' wa l-rugut wa kulla l-khanam al-induhum bayaad wa l-dawaayin al-zurug.Wa antaahum le iyaalah.
Wa Laabaan ba''ad min Yaakhuub be talaata yoom hana ruwaakha.Wa Yaakhuub gaa'id yasrah be l-khanam al-faddalo.
Wa Yaakhuub chaal mataarig khudur min talaata chadar chig chig wa le l-mataarig dool,nagga girifhum wa sawwa fooghum siihaan.Wa bakaan waahid yikhalliihum be girifhum achaan yabgo rugut.
Wa wakit al-anaati yihiilan wa l-dukuur yihiiju wa yaju yacharbo almi,hu yukhutt al-mataarig al-rugut fi l-hiitaan,bakaan al-khanam yaju yacharbo foogah.
Wa khalaas,al-khanam yi'achchuru jamb al-mataarig al-rugut wa yijiibu iyaal rugut wa duro' wa induhum siihaan.
Wa kan le l-dawaayin,Yaakhuub yukhuttuhum taraf wa yiwajjihhum ale l-kubchaan al-rugut wa ale kulla l-kubchaan al-zurug hana Laabaan.Wa be misil da,Yaakhuub sawwa leyah maal wa ma khallaahum khalbato ma'a khanam Laabaan.
Wa ayyi wakit al-khanam al-kubaar kan haalo,Yaakhuub yukhutt al-mataarig giddaamhum fi l-hiitaan achaan yi'achchuru giddaam al-mataarig.
Laakin kan le l-khanam al-da'iifiin,hu ma yukhutt giddaamhum abadan al-mataarig.Be misil da,al-khanam al-da'iifiin bigo hana Laabaan wa l-chudaad hana Yaakhuub.
Wa be misil da,Yaakhuub ligi maal ziyaada.Indah bahaayim katiiriin wa khaddaamiin wa khaddaamaat wa indah jumaal wa hamiir.
Wa ba'ad da,Yaakhuub simi' kalaam awlaad Laabaan al-buguul-:-Yaakhuub chaal kulla maal abuuna wa be maal abuuna bas,hu bigi khani.
Wa Yaakhuub chaaf haal Laabaan alkhayyarat leyah,ma misil awwal.
Wa khalaas,Allah gaal le Yaakhuub-:-Gabbil balad abbahaatak,bakaan ahalak.Wa ana nukuun daayman ma'aak.
Wa Yaakhuub rassal le awiinah Raahiil wa Leeya yamchan yalgannah fi l-kadaade,bakaan khanamah.
Wa gaal leehin-:-Ana chift haal abuukan khayyarat leyi,ma misil awwal.Laakin Allah Rabb abuuyi kaan ma'aayi.
Wa intan zaatkan ta'arfan kadar ana khadamt le abuukan be niiye waahide.
Wa be da kula,abuukan khachchaani wa khayyar maahiiyti achara marraat.Wa laakin al-Rabb daharah ma yisawwi leyi cheyy fasil.
Wa kan abuukan gaal-:--Al-duro' yabgo maahiiytak,kulla l-khanam yaldo iyaal duro'.- Wa kan gaal-:--Al-rugut yabgo maahiiytak,kulla l-khanam yaldo iyaal rugut.--
Wa be da bas,al-Rabb chaal bahaayim abuukan wa antaahum leyi ana.
Wa fi wakit al-khanam gaa'idiin yi'achchuru foogah da,ana ri'iit wa fi l-ru'ya di,rafa't raasi wa chift tuyuus gaa'idiin yi'achchuru al-khanam al-rugut al-induhum daraa' wa siihaan.
Wa malak Allah gaal leyi fi l-ru'ya-:--Yaakhuub-!- Wa ana gult-:--Na'am-!--
Wa gaal leyi-:--Arfa' raasak wa chiif adiil,kulla l-tuyuus al-gaa'idiin yi'achchuru al-khanam,humman rugut wa induhum daraa' wa siihaan.Achaan ana chift kulla l-cheyy al-Laabaan gaa'id yisawwi leek.
Wa ana Ilaah Beet Iil,bakaan al-inta khazzeet leyi foogah hajar wa sabbeet foogah dihin wa sawweet leyi nazir.Hassa' da,gumm-!Amrug min al-balad di wa amchi balad abbahaatak.-
Wa Raahiil wa Leeya gaalan leyah-:-Hal faddal leena gisim wa warasa min maal abuuna walla-?
Aywa,maala hu ja'alaana misil ajnabiiyaat wa baa'aana wa akal kulla tamanna-?
Wa fi chaan da,kulla l-maal al-chaalah al-Rabb min abuuna da,bigi leena wa le iyaalna.Wa inta,ya Yaakhuub,sawwi kulla cheyy al-Rabb amarak beyah.
Wa khalaas,Yaakhuub gamma chaal iyaalah wa awiinah wa rakkabaahum fi jumaal.
Wa chaal kulla l-bahaayim wa kulla l-maal al-ligaah fi Faddaan Araam wa gamma maachi le abuuh Ishaakh fi balad Kan'aan.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,Laabaan ma fiih,macha yagta' suuf khanamah.Wa wakit humman maachiin,Raahiil sirgat asnaam abuuha.
Wa Yaakhuub khachchaah le Laabaan al-Araami,jara minnah ma khabbarah.
Wa jara be kulla cheyy al-indah wa chagga bahar al-Furaat wa wajjah ale jibaal Gil'aad.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,gaalo le Laabaan-:-Yaakhuub arrad-!
Wa khalaas,Laabaan chaal akhwaanah wa jara wara Yaakhuub.Wa ba'ad sab'a yoom hana ruwaakha,lihigah fi jibaal Gil'aad.
Laakin be l-leel,al-Rabb baan le Laabaan al-Araami fi ru'ya wa gaal leyah-:-Angari'-!Ma tikallim le Yaakhuub wa la be kheer wa la be charr-!
Wa Laabaan lihig Yaakhuub fi l-bakaan al-bana foogah kheemtah fi raas al-jabal.Wa Laabaan wa akhwaanah kula bano kheemithum fi jibaal Gil'aad.
Wa Laabaan gaal le Yaakhuub-:-Da chunu al-sawweetah leyi da-?Maala khachcheetni-?Inta khataft banaati misil masjuunaat al-harib-!
Maala arradt minni-?Wa allabbadt minni wa ma ooreetni-?Kan awwal ooreetni,ana ni'addiik be farha wa be khine wa nagaagiir wa jigindiiye.
Wa inta ma khalleetni habbeet iyaal banaati wa ammahaathum.Inta sawweet al-cheyy da bala fikir.
Ana nagdar nisawwi leeku cheyy fasil laakin Allah Rabb abuuk gaal leyi fi l-leele al-faatat-:--Angari'-!Ma tikallim le Yaakhuub wa la be kheer wa la be charr.--
Wa hassa' inta maachi achaan inta girimt le beet abuuk.Wa laakin maala sirigt asnaami-?
Wa Yaakhuub radda le Laabaan wa gaal-:-Ana arradt minnak da achaan ana khaayif inta tagla' banaatak minni.
Wa l-naadum al-inta ligiit fi bakaanah asnaamak,khalli yaktuluuh-!Inta zaatak fattich kulla khumaami giddaam kulla akhwaanna-!Wa kan ligiit cheyy hanaak,chiilah-! Laakin Yaakhuub ma irif kadar Raahiil bas sirgat al-asnaam.
Wa khalaas,Laabaan dakhal fi kheemat Yaakhuub wa kheemat Leeya wa kheemat al-khaddaamaat al-itneen wa ma ligi cheyy.Wa ba'adeen,marag min kheemat Leeya wa dakhal fi kheemat Raahiil.
Wa gabul da,Raahiil chaalat al-asnaam wa khattathum tihit al-baasuur hana l-jamal wa ga'adat foogah.Wa Laabaan fattach al-kheema kullaha ke wa ma ligi cheyy.
Wa Raahiil gaalat le abuuha-:-Khalli siidi ma yaz'al,kan ana ma gidirt gammeet giddaamah achaan indi aade. Wa hu fattach battaan wa ma ligi al-asnaam.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Yaakhuub zi'il wa haraj le Laabaan wa gaal-:-Ana ke jariimti chunu-?Wa chunu zanbi,lahaddi tajri waraayi be za'al misil da-?
Wakit inta fattacht kulla khumaami,ligiit chunu min khumaam beetak-?Hassa' da,wassif leyi ayyi cheyy al-inta ligiitah hini giddaam akhwaani wa akhwaanak.Wa khalli humman yahkumu ambeenaatna.
Wa fi l-ichriin sana al-ana ichtuhum ma'aak,dawaaynak wa inzeek abadan ma taraho.Wa ana ma akalt min kubchaanak.
Wa kan haywaanaat al-kadaade katalo khanamaay kula,ana ma jibtaha leek.Ana bas chilt mas'uuliiyitha wa kaffeetha leek.Wa kan khanamaay sirgooha be l-leel walla be l-nahaar kula,inta talabt tamanha minni.
Wa be l-nahaar,ana ta'baan min al-sakhaana wa be l-leel,min al-bardaay.Wa l-noom aba eeni.
Wa be da kula,ana ga'adt ma'aak 20 sana.Wa ana khadamt leek 14 sana achaan banaatak al-itneen.Wa sitte sana battaan achaan nalga minnak bahaayim.Wa be da kula,inta khayyart maahiiyti achara marraat.
Wa Allah Rabb abuuyi Ishaakh wa Rabb jiddi Ibraahiim wa hu al-Rabb al-Ishaakh khaayif minnah,kaan ma'aayi.Laakin kan hu ma kaan ma'aayi,inta tikhalliini namchi iideeni yaabsiin.Laakin al-Rabb chaaf ta'abi wa khidmit iideeni wa fi l-leele al-faatat,hu hakam ambeenaatna.
Wa tawwaali Laabaan radda le Yaakhuub wa gaal leyah-:-Al-banaat banaati,al-awlaad awlaadi,al-khanam khanami wa kulla l-achya al-inta gaa'id tichiifhum dool hineeyi.Wa laakin ana nagdar nisawwi chunu al-yoom le banaati wa le iyaalhin al-wildanhum-?
Hassa' da,ta'aal.Ana wa inta nisawwu mu'aahada ambeenaatna.Wa nukhuttu alaama al-tachhad beeni wa beenak.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Yaakhuub chaal hajar wa khazzaah.
Wa gaal le akhwaanah-:-Laggutu hujaar wa limmuuhum leena hini. Wa humman laggato hujaar wa lammoohum koom waahid.Wa akalo jamb al-koom da.
Wa Laabaan sammaah al-bakaan da Yagar Sahduusa (ma'anaatah al-koom al-yachhad).Wa Yaakhuub sammaah Gal'iid (wa da kula ma'anaatah al-koom al-yachhad).
Wa Laabaan gaal-:-Al-koom da yukuun chahaadat al-mu'aahada beeni wa beenak al-yoom. Achaan da,sammooh al-koom Gal'iid (ma'anaatah al-koom al-yifakkirna fi l-mu'aahada).
Wa sammooh battaan Misfa (ma'anaatah yiraakhib) achaan Laabaan gaal-:-Allah yiraakhibna wakit nilfaarago.
Wa kan inta ti'azzib banaati walla taakhud awiin aakhariin fooghum wa kan naadum al-yachhad ambeenaatna ma fiih,khalaas al-Rabb bas yachhad beeni wa beenak.
Wa Laabaan gaal battaan le Yaakhuub-:-Daahu al-koom wa daahu al-hajar al-ana khazzeetah beeni wa beenak.
Al-koom hana l-hajar da chaahid wa l-hajar al-inta khazzeetah da,kula chaahid.Achaan ana ma nazhaf aleek khaadi min al-koom da wa inta kula ma tazhaf aleyi jaayi min al-hajar da,le ma nisawwu ambeenaatna cheyy fasil.
Wa Allah Rabb jiddak Ibraahiim wa jiddi Naahuur,hu bas al-yahkim ambeenaatna.-Wa Yaakhuub halaf be Allah al-Ishaakh khaayif minnah.
Wa khalaas,dabah dahiiye le l-Rabb fi raas al-jabal.Wa azam akhwaanah le l-acha wa humman akalo sawa wa naamo fi raas al-jabal.
Wa Laabaan gamma be fajur badri ja salaam banaatah wa iyaalhum wa baarakaahum wa gabbal baladah.
Wa Yaakhuub taaba' safarah wa malaa'ikat Allah baano leyah.
Wa wakit Yaakhuub chaafaahum gaal-:-Da bakaan al-gaa'idiin foogah askar al-Rabb. Wa samma al-bakaan da Mahanaayim (ma'anaatah mu'askaraat itneen).
Wa Yaakhuub rassal naas giddaamah achaan yamchu le akhuuh Isuu fi turaab Sa'iir fi balad Adoom.
Wa wassaahum wa gaal leehum-:-Guulu le siidi Isuu-:--Daahu kalaam abdak Yaakhuub-:"Ana sakant fi bakaan Laabaan wa ga'adt ma'aayah lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa hassa' indi bagar wa hamiir wa khanam wa abiid wa khaddaamaat.Wa ana rassalt naas leek le yikhabburuuk inta siidi Isuu le tarda leyi."-
Wa ba'ad da,wakit al-naas al-Yaakhuub rassalaahum gabbalo,humman gaalo leyah-:-Aniina lammeena ma'a akhuuk Isuu wa hu zaatah jaayi le yigaabilak.Wa laakin indah ma'aayah 400 raajil-!
Wa Yaakhuub khaaf khoof chadiid wa gamma gassam al-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah wa l-khanam wa l-bagar wa l-jumaal ale majmuu'teen.
Wa gaal fi galbah-:-Kan Isuu lamma ma'a l-majmuu'a al-waahide wa darabaaha kula,al-majmuu'a al-aakhara tanja.
Wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Rabb jiddi Ibraahiim wa abuuyi Ishaakh-!Ya Allah-!Inta al-gult leyi-:--Gabbil baladak fi bakaan ahalak wa nisawwi leek al-kheer.--
Wa ana sakhayyar giddaam al-rahma wa l-amaan al-inta anteetah leyi ana abdak.Achaan wakit ana chaggeet bahar al-Urdun ma indi cheyy illa asaati.Wa hassa' daahu indi furgaan itneen.
Nachhadak tinajjiini min akhuuyi Isuu achaan ana khaayif hu yaji yaktulna ana wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal.
Wa awwal inta gult leyi-:--Nisawwi leek al-kheer wa nisawwi zurriiytak katiire misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar al-naadum ma yagdar yahsibha min al-katara.-
Wa fi l-leele di,Yaakhuub ga'ad fi l-bakaan da.Wa chaal min al-maal al-ja beyah le yigaddimah hadiiye le akhuuh Isuu.
Wa l-maal da 200 anzaay wa 20 tees wa 200 na'aje wa 20 kabich
wa 30 naaga be iyaalhum wa 40 bagara wa 10 toor wa 20 humaara wa 10 humaar.
Wa amman al-bahaayim dool le khaddaamiinah wa gassamaahum ambeenaathum.Wa ayyi waahid kallafah be door hana bahaayim wa gaal leehum-:-Gaddumu giddaami wa khallu faraga ambeenaatku.
Wa anta amur le khaddaamah al-maachi awwal wa gaal leyah-:-Kan akhuuyi Isuu laagaak wa sa'alak gaal leek-:--Inta yaatu wa maachi ween wa l-bahaayim al-maachi beehum dool hana yaatu-?--
Guul leyah-:--Al-bahaayim dool hana abdak Yaakhuub wa hu rassalaahum hadiiye le siidah Isuu.Wa hu zaatah jaayi waraana.-
Wa anta nafs al-amur le khaddaamah al-taani wa l-taalit wa le kulla l-naas al-maachiin ma'a l-bahaayim wa gaal leehum-:-Kan lammeetu ma'a Isuu,guulu leyah al-kalaam da.
Wa battaan guulu leyah-:--Daahu abdak Yaakhuub zaatah jaayi waraana.--Achaan hu fakkar wa gaal-:-Khalli nidalli galbah be l-hadiiye al-machat giddaami di.Wa ba'ad da,kan gaabalna ma'aayah wijih be wijih kula,akuun yigaabilni be farah.
Wa l-hadiiye machat giddaamah.Wa Yaakhuub kamaan,ga'ad fi fariigah.
Wa be l-leel,Yaakhuub gamma chaal awiinah al-itneen wa khaddaamaatah al-itneen wa awlaadah al-ihdaachar wa gatta'aahum waadi Yabbuukh.
Wa ba'ad chaalaahum wa gatta'aahum al-bahar wa gatta' kulla cheyy al-indah,
hu faddal hinaak wiheedah.Wa raajil waahid ja saara'ah lahaddi gariib sabaah.
Wa wakit al-raajil irif kadar hu ma yagdar yakhalbah fi l-siraa' da,gamma darab Yaakhuub fi wirkah wa wirkah marag.
Wa l-raajil gaal le Yaakhuub-:-Khalliini namchi achaan al-wata gariib tasbih. Wa Yaakhuub gaal leyah-:-Ana ma nikhalliik tamchi kan ma baaraktini-!
Wa l-raajil sa'al Yaakhuub wa gaal leyah-:-Usmak yaatu-? Wa hu gaal-:-Usmi Yaakhuub.
Wa l-raajil gaal-:-Ba'ad al-yoom,ma yinaaduuk Yaakhuub,khalli yinaaduuk Israa'iil (ma'anaatah saara' ma'a l-Rabb).Achaan inta saara't ma'a l-Rabb wa ma'a l-naas wa inta annasart.
Wa Yaakhuub sa'al al-raajil wa gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak,ooriini usmak. Wa l-raajil gaal-:-Maala tas'alni min usmi-? Wa fi l-bakaan da,hu baarak Yaakhuub.
Wa Yaakhuub samma al-bakaan da Faniyiil (ma'anaatah wijih al-Rabb) achaan hu gaal-:-Ana chift al-Rabb wijih be wijih wa laakin ana nijiit min al-moot-!
Wa l-harraay tala'at leyah wakit hu faat min Fanuwiil.Wa gaa'id yadla' achaan wirkah marag.
Wa fi chaan da lahaddi l-yoom,Bani Israa'iil ma yaakulu laham al-wirk achaan Yaakhuub wirkah marag.
Wa Yaakhuub rafa' raasah wa chaaf akhuuh Isuu jaayi be 400 raajil ma'aayah.Wa Yaakhuub gassam iyaalah ambeen Leeya wa Raahiil wa khaddaamaatah al-itneen.
Wa gaddam al-khaddaamaat giddaam ma'a iyaalhum wa waraahum Leeya ma'a iyaalha wa fi l-akhiir Raahiil ma'a Yuusuf.
Wa Yaakhuub kamaan gaddam giddaamhum wa sajad sab'a marraat lahaddi garrab le akhuuh.
Wa Isuu jara laaga akhuuh,hadanah wa habbaah wa humman al-tineen gammo bako.
Wa ba'ad da,Isuu rafa' raasah wa chaaf al-awiin wa l-iyaal wa gaal-:-Dool yaatumman al-ma'aak-? Wa Yaakhuub gaal-:-Di l-rahma al-antaaha al-Rabb leyi ana abdak.
Wa l-khaddaamaat garrabo ma'a iyaalhum wa sajado.
Wa Leeya kula garrabat ma'a iyaalha wa sajado.Wa ba'ad da,garrab Yuusuf ma'a Raahiil kula sajado.
Wa Isuu gaal-:-Tidoor tisawwi chunu be kulla l-maal al-ana laageetah-? Wa Yaakhuub gaal leyah-:-Nidoor tarda leyi,ya siidi.
Wa Isuu gaal-:-Ana indi maal katiir.Khalli maalak yagood leek,ya akhuuyi.
Wa Yaakhuub gaal-:-La.Kan inta radyaan beyi,akhbal hadiiyti al-gaddamtaha leek.Ana min chift wijhak da,misil chift wijih al-Rabb achaan inta ridiit leyi.
Wa hassa' da akhbal minni hadiiyti al-gaddamtaha leek achaan al-Rabb antaani ni'ma wa indi kulla cheyy. Wa Yaakhuub hannasah wa khalaas Isuu khibil.
Wa Isuu gaal leyah-:-Gumm namchu wa ana namchi ma'aak fi machiik.
Wa Yaakhuub radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya siidi,inta ta'arif kadar al-iyaal da'iifiin wa indi ma'aayi al-khanam wa l-bagar al-biraddu'u.Wa kan asartuhum fi yoom waahid,kulla l-bahaayim yumuutu.
Min fadlak,ya siidi,hassa' da inta gaddim giddaami.Wa ana abdak kamaan nuruukh bicheech fi ruwaakha hana l-bahaayim wa fi ruwaakha hana l-iyaal lahaddi nawsalo bakaanak inta siidi fi Sa'iir.
Wa Isuu gaal leyah-:-Wa kan ke da,nikhalli ma'aak min naasi al-jiina sawa. Wa Yaakhuub gaal-:-Wa maala-?Ana min ligiit ridaak da,khalaas ya siidi-!
Wa khalaas fi nafs al-yoom Isuu gabbal Sa'iir.
Wa Yaakhuub gamma macha Sukkuut wa bana leyah beet wa kuuzi le bahaaymah.Achaan da bas,sammo al-bakaan da Sukkuut (ma'anaatah ligdaabe).
Wa Yaakhuub taaba' safarah min Faddaan Araam lahaddi wassal be sihha wa salaama fi hillit Chakiim al-gaa'ide fi balad Kan'aan.Wa hu gaabal al-hille di wa sakan.
Wa chara min iyaal Hamuur abu Chakiim bakaan al-bana foogah kheemtah be miya hajar fudda.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,bana leyah madbah le yigaddim foogah dahiiye le l-Rabb wa sammaah El Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Yoom waahid,Diina bineeyit Yaakhuub al-Leeya wildatha leyah maragat machat tuzuur banaat al-balad.
Wa Chakiim wileed Hamuur cheekh balad al-Hiwwiyiin chaafaaha.Wa hu khatafha wa li'ib ma'aaha wa tallaf charafha.
Wa galbah allag foog Diina bineeyit Yaakhuub.Wa hu habbaaha wa fattach tariiga al-hi takhbal beeha kalaamah.
Wa Chakiim gaal le abuuh Hamuur-:-Aakhud leyi al-bineeye di achaan tabga marti.
Wa Yaakhuub simi' kadar Chakiim tallaf charaf Diina bineeytah.Wa laakin awlaadah gaa'idiin fi l-khala yasraho be bahaaymah.Achaan da,Yaakhuub sakat saakit lahaddi yaju.
Wa Hamuur abu Chakiim macha le Yaakhuub achaan yihajji leyah.
Wa wakit awlaad Yaakhuub sim'o be l-cheyy al-kaan da,jo min al-khala wa za'laaniin za'al chadiid.Achaan Chakiim sawwa fi'il cheen fi gabiilat Israa'iil wakit khatafha wa tallaf charafha le bineeyit Yaakhuub.Wa l-cheyy da,ma waajib yukuun abadan.
Wa Hamuur hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Wileedi Chakiim,galbah allag fi bittuku.Min fadulku,antuuha leyah le tabga martah.
Wa intu tagdaro tinaasubuuna,naakhudu min banaatku wa taakhudu min banaatna.
Wa taskunu ma'aana.Wa l-balad gaa'ide maftuuha leeku.Taajuru wa aksabo foogha ard le nufuusku.
Wa Chakiim zaatah gaal le Yaakhuub abu Diina wa akhwaanha-:-Ardo leyi wa ana nantiiku ayyi cheyy al-tatulbuuh minni.
Wa khuttu foogi al-maal al-tidooruuh wa hadiiye katiire wa ana nantiiku kulla cheyy al-tidooruuh.Laakin nidoor al-bineeye di tabga marti.
Wa awlaad Yaakhuub raddo be najaada le Chakiim wa Hamuur abuuh achaan Chakiim tallaf charaf akhuthum Diina
Wa gaalo leehum-:-Al-cheyy da,ma mumkin leena.Ma nagdaro nantu akhutna le raajil ma mutahhar achaan da eeb leena.
Aniina nikhassudu leeku illa fi haala waahide bas.Tabgo misilna,tahhuru ayyi dakar minku.
Wa be da khalaas,intu tagdaro taakhudu min banaatna wa aniina kula naakhudu min banaatku.Wa kullina nabgo cha'ab waahid.
Wa laakin kan abeetu ma titahhuru,aniina nichiilu akhutna wa namchu.
Wa Chakiim wa abuuh Hamuur khassado be l-kalaam da.
Wa Chakiim tabbag ajala ke bas al-kalaam al-humman dawwarooh achaan biriidha marra waahid le Diina bineeyit Yaakhuub.Wa Chakiim hu muhtaram min kulla naas beet abuuh.
Wa Hamuur ma'a wileedah Chakiim macho fi khachum baab hillithum,al-bakaan al-naas yilimmu foogah.Wa hajjo le naas al-hille
wa gaalo leehum-:-Al-naas dool ma induhum ayyi kalaam ma'aana.Khalli yagoodu fi l-balad wa yitaajuru wa di hi al-balad wasii'e leehum.Wa aniina naakhudu banaathum wa humman kula yaakhudu banaatna.
Wa laakin humman yikhassudu yagoodu ma'aana wa nabgo gabiila waahide,illa kan aniina nitahhuru kulla dakar minnina misil humman zaathum mutahhariin.
Wa kan aniina khassadna be l-cheyy al-humman talabooh minnina,humman yaju yaskunu ma'aana.Wa be da,bahaayimhum wa maalhum wa kulla cheyy al-induhum ma yabgo hanaana walla-?
Wa kulla l-naas al-macho fi khachum baab al-hille,khassado be kalaam Hamuur wa wileedah Chakiim.Wa khalaas,kulla l-dukuur al-macho fi khachum baab al-hille tahharoohum.
Wa ba'ad talaata yoom,wakit al-rujaal lissaa' ma biro min al-tahuura di,awlaad Yaakhuub Chim'uun wa Laawi akhwaan Diina chaalo suyuufhum.Wa dakhalo al-hille bala khoof wa katalo kulla l-dukuur.
Wa katalo Hamuur wa wileedah Chakiim kula be seef wa dakhalo fi beet Chakiim wa chaalo akhuthum wa macho.
Wa awlaad Yaakhuub al-aakhariin katalo al-majruuhiin wa kasabo al-hille achaan charaf akhuthum Diina tilif.
Wa chaalo kulla khanam al-Hiwwiyiin wa bagarhum wa hamiirhum wa kulla maalhum al-fi lubb al-hille wa l-fi l-khala.
Wa kasabo kulla maalhum wa kulla iyaalhum wa kulla awiinhum wa chaalo kulla cheyy al-fi buyuuthum.
Wa ba'ad da,Yaakhuub gaal le iyaalah Chim'uun wa Laawi-:-Intu zara'tu leyi machaakil-!Wa be sababku intu,al-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Firizziyiin naas al-balad yakrahooni-!Indi rujaal chiyya bas.Wa kan humman lammo foogi wa hajamooni,yidammuruuni ana wa naas beeti.
Laakin humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Hu ma ja'al akhutna zannaaya walla-?
Wa l-Rabb gaal le Yaakhuub-:-Gumm amchi Beet Iil.Askun hinaak wa abni madbah leyi,ana al-Rabb al-bayyant nafsi leek wakit inta mu'arrid min akhuuk Isuu.
Wa Yaakhuub gaal le aayiltah wa le kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah-:-Ba''udu minku al-asnaam al-ajnabiyiin wa tahhuru guluubku wa khayyuru khulgaanku.
Gummu-!Namchu Beet Iil.Wa ana nabni madbah le l-Rabb.Hu hallaani wakit ana fi l-diige wa kaan ma'aayi fi derbi al-ana macheet foogah.
Wa humman anto le Yaakhuub kulla l-asnaam al-ajnabiyiin al-fi iideehum wa l-khuruus al-fi udneehum.Wa Yaakhuub dafanaahum fi tihit al-chadara al-kabiire al-gariibe le hillit Chakiim.
Wa wakit gammo maachiin,al-Rabb nazzal khoof chadiid fi naas al-hillaal al-mujaawiriinhum wa ma fi naadum gidir macha wara awlaad Yaakhuub.
Wa Yaakhuub ma'a l-naas al-ma'aayah wassalo fi hillit Luuz al-hassa' usumha Beet Iil,fi balad Kan'aan.
Wa bana madbah wa samma al-bakaan da El Beet Iil (ma'anaatah Rabb Beet Iil).Achaan fi l-bakaan da bas,al-Rabb baan leyah wakit hu mu'arrid min akhuuh Isuu.
Wa da l-bakaan al-maatat foogah Dabuura al-rabbatha le Rifga wakit hi sakhayre.Wa dafanooha gariib le Beet Iil tihit chadarat al-balluut al-sammooha Balluut al-Baki.
Wa ba'ad Yaakhuub gamma min balad Faddaan Araam wa wassal fi Beet Iil,al-Rabb baan leyah battaan wa baarakah.
Wa gaal leyah-:-Usmak Yaakhuub wa laakin ba'ad al-yoom ma yinaaduuk Yaakhuub.Khalli usmak yabga Israa'iil. Wa be misil da,le Yaakhuub al-Rabb sammaah Israa'iil.
Wa l-Rabb gaal leyah-:-Ana Allah al-Gaadir.Alda wa iyaalak yabgo katiiriin.Umma wa umam katiiriin yamurgu minnak wa min sulbak yamurgu muluuk.
Wa l-balad al-ana anteetha le Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh,nantiiha leek inta wa le zurriiytak al-taji min ba'adak.
Wa khalaas,al-Rabb macha min al-bakaan al-hajja leyah foogah.
Wa Yaakhuub khazza hajar fi l-bakaan al-Rabb hajja leyah wa sabba foogah hadiiyat charaab wa dihin le yikhassisah.
Wa Yaakhuub samma al-bakaan al-Rabb hajja leyah foogah da,Beet Iil (ma'anaatah beet Allah).
Wa khalaas,Yaakhuub wa aayiltah gammo min Beet Iil.Wa wakit humman lissaa'hum ba'iid min hillit Afraata,Raahiil taalagat.Wa waaluuditha bigat gaasiye.
Wa wakit al-talaga assaratha,al-wallaada gaalat leeha-:-Ma takhaafe,daahu battaan wilidti wileed-!
Wa laakin Raahiil garrabat tumuut.Gabul mootha,sammat al-wileed da Banuuni (ma'anaatah wileed hizni).Wa laakin abuuh sammaah Banyaamiin (ma'anaatah wileed zeenaayti).
Wa Raahiil maatat wa dafanooha fi derib hillit Afraata al-ma'ruufa al-yoom be Beet Laham.
Wa Yaakhuub khazza hajar fi raas khaburha.Wa l-hajar al-fi khabur Raahiil gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Yaakhuub al-binaaduuh Israa'iil hawwal min al-bakaan da wa macha bana kheemtah giddaam min Migdal Idar.
Wa wakit Israa'iil sakan fi l-balad di,wileedah al-bikir Ra'uubiin macha ragad ma'a Bilha sirriiyit abuuh wa Israa'iil simi' be l-cheyy da.Wa awlaad Yaakhuub humman atnaachar.
Leeya jaabat leyah Ra'uubiin al-bikir wa Chim'uun wa Laawi wa Yahuuza wa Yassaakar wa Zabuluun.
Wa Raahiil jaabat leyah Yuusuf wa Banyaamiin.
Wa Bilha khaddaamit Raahiil jaabat leyah Daan wa Naftaali.
Wa Zilfa khaddaamit Leeya jaabat leyah Gaad wa Achiir.Dool awlaad Yaakhuub al-wildoohum leyah fi Faddaan Araam.
Wa khalaas,Yaakhuub wassal bakaan abuuh Ishaakh fi hillit Mamra,gariib le Kharyat Arba'a al-ma'ruufa al-yoom be Hibruun.Wa da l-bakaan al-awwal Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh sakano foogah.
Wa Ishaakh aach 180 sana.
Wa maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa da wakit chayyab wa chibi' min al-dunya.Wa khalaas,awlaadah Isuu wa Yaakhuub dafanooh.
Daahu zurriiyit Isuu al-ma'ruuf be Adoom.
Isuu akhad min banaat al-Kan'aaniyiin Aada bineeyit Iluun al-Hitti wa Uhulibaama bineeyit Anaa.Wa Anaa da,hu wileed Sib'uun al-Hiwwi.
Wa fi raas awiinah al-aakhariin,Isuu akhad Baasmat bineeyit Ismaa'iil akhut Nabayuut.
Wa Aada wildat Alifaaz le Isuu.Wa Baasmat wildat leyah Ra'uwiil.
Wa Uhulibaama wildat leyah Ya'uuch wa Ya'laam wa Khuurah.Wa dool awlaad Isuu al-wildoohum leyah fi balad Kan'aan.
Wa Isuu chaal awiinah wa awlaadah wa banaatah wa kulla l-naas al-fi beetah wa bahaaymah wa maalah wa kulla cheyy al-ligaah fi Kan'aan.Wa hawwal macha balad aakhara ba'iid min akhuuh Yaakhuub.
Achaan al-balad al-humman saakniin foogha bigat leehum dayge.Wa ma yagdaro yi'iichu sawa achaan maalhum bigi katiir.
Wa Isuu,al-ma'ruuf be Adoom,macha sakan fi jibaal balad Sa'iir.
Daahu zurriiyit Isuu abu al-Adoomiyiin fi jibaal balad Sa'iir.
Awlaad Isuu humman Alifaaz wileed Aada wa Ra'uwiil wileed Baasmat.
Wa awlaad Alifaaz humman Teemaan wa Umaar wa Saafi wa Ga'taam wa Khinaaz.
Wa Alifaaz wileed Isuu indah sirriiye usumha Timnaa'a hi jaabat leyah wileed usmah Amaalikh.Wa dool awlaad Aada marit Isuu.
Wa awlaad Ra'uwiil humman Nahat wa Zaarah wa Chamma wa Mizza.Wa dool awlaad Baasmat marit Isuu.
Wa Uhulibaama marit Isuu,hi bineeyit Anaa wa jiddaha Sib'uun.Wa hi wildat leyah Ya'uuch wa Ya'laam wa Khuurah.
Wa daahu chuyuukh zurriiyit Isuu.Awlaad Alifaaz bikir Isuu,humman Teemaan wa Umaar wa Saafi wa Khinaaz
wa Khuurah wa Ga'taam wa Amaalikh.Wa dool chuyuukh zurriiyit Alifaaz fi balad Adoom al-marago min Aada marit Isuu.
Wa l-chuyuukh al-maargiin min Ra'uwiil wileed Isuu,humman Nahat wa Zaarah wa Chamma wa Mizza.Wa dool chuyuukh zurriiyit Ra'uwiil al-marago min Baasmat marit Isuu wa saakniin fi balad Adoom.
Wa l-chuyuukh al-maargiin min Uhulibaama bineeyit Anaa marit Isuu,humman Ya'uuch wa Ya'laam wa Khuurah.
Wa dool bas chuyuukh al-Adoomiyiin zurriiyit Isuu.
Wa daahu awlaad Sa'iir al-Huuri al-awwal saakin fi balad Adoom,humman Luutaan wa Chuubaal wa Sib'uun wa Aana
wa Diichuun wa Isar wa Diichaan.Wa daahu chuyuukh al-Huuriyiin min zurriiyit Sa'iir al-saakniin fi balad Adoom.
Awlaad Luutaan humman Huuri wa Heemaam.Wa akhut Luutaan usumha Timnaa'a.
Wa awlaad Chuubaal humman Alwaan wa Manaahat wa Ibaal wa Chafu wa Unaam.
Wa awlaad Sib'uun humman Ayya wa Aana.Wa Aana da bas al-ligi een almi al-haami fi l-sahara wakit gaa'id yasrah be hamiir hana abuuh Sib'uun.
Wa iyaal Aana humman Diichuun wa bineeytah Uhulibaama.
Wa awlaad Diichuun humman Hamdaan wa Achbaan wa Yitraan wa Karaan.
Wa awlaad Isar humman Bilhaan wa Za'waan wa Akhaan.
Wa awlaad Diichaan humman Uus wa Araan.
Wa chuyuukh al-Huuriyiin humman Luutaan wa Chuubaal wa Sib'uun wa Aana
wa Diichuun wa Isar wa Diichaan.Dool chuyuukh al-Huuriyiin al-saakniin fi balad Sa'iir.
Wa daahu asaame al-muluuk al-hakamo fi balad Adoom gubbaal ayyi malik ma yahkim fi Bani Israa'iil.
Baala' wileed Ba'uur hakam fi balad Adoom wa usum hillitah Dinhaaba.
Wa Baala' maat wa Yubaab wileed Zaarah min hillit Busra hakam fi badalah.
Wa Yubaab maat wa Huchaam min balad Teemaan hakam fi badalah.
Wa Huchaam maat wa Haddaad wileed Badaad hakam fi badalah.Wa hu bas al-annasar fi gabiilat Midyaan fi balad Muwaab wa hillitah usumha Awiit.
Wa Haddaad maat wa Samla min Masriikha hakam fi badalah.
Wa Samla maat wa Chaawuul min hillit Rahubuut al-Bahar hakam fi badalah.
Wa Chaawuul maat wa Ba'al Hanaan wileed Akbuur hakam fi badalah.
Wa Ba'al Hanaan wileed Akbuur maat wa Hadaar hakam fi badalah wa usum hillitah Faa'u.Wa usum martah Mahiitabiil bineeyit Matrid wa hi di bineeyit Meedahab.
Wa daahu asaame hana chuyuukh Bani Isuu ale hasab gabaayilhum wa asaame buldaanhum.HummanTimnaa' wa Alwa wa Yatiit
wa Uhulibaama wa Iila wa Finuun
wa Khinaaz wa Teemaan wa Mibsaar
wa Magdiyiil wa Iraam.Wa dool humman chuyuukh balad Adoom ale hasab maskanhum fi l-balad al-hakamooha.Wa kulluhum min zurriiyit Isuu jidd al-Adoomiyiin.
Yaakhuub gaa'id fi balad Kan'aan,al-abuuh Ishaakh ja sakan foogha.
Wa daahu taariikh Yaakhuub.Wa wileedah Yuusuf sabi wa umrah saba'taachar sana wa gaa'id yasrah be l-khanam ma'a akhwaanah iyaal abuuh.Humman iyaal Bilha wa Zilfa awiin Yaakhuub.Wa Yuusuf gaa'id yikhabbir abuuhum be amalhum al-cheen.
Wa Yaakhuub al-sammooh Israa'iil habba Yuusuf ziyaada min kulla akhwaanah achaan hu wildaah wakit hu chaayib.Wa antaah khalag khaali.
Wa wakit akhwaanah chaafo kadar abuuhum yiriid Yuusuf ziyaada minhum,humman kirhooh wa ma dawwaro kalaamah.
Wa yoom waahid,Yuusuf ri'i wa khabbar akhwaanah be l-ru'ya wa gaal leehum-:
Asma'o ya akhwaani,ana hilimt.
Aniina gaa'idiin fi l-zere' wa nagta'o gameh.Wa ayyi waahid minnina rabat rubta waahide hana gameh.Wa ba'adeen,rubtiti gammat wagafat be tuulha wa rubatku jo hawwagooha wa sajado leeha.
Wa min sim'o kalaamah da,humman gaalo leyah-:-Inta tidoor tabga foogna sultaan wa tahkimna walla-? Wa humman kirhooh be ziyaada achaan ru'yitah di wa achaan kalaamah da.
Wa Yuusuf ri'i battaan wa kallam le akhwaanah wa gaal leehum-:-Ana battaan hilimt.Al-harraay wa l-gamar wa ihdaachar nujuum sajado leyi.
Wa hajja beyah le abuuh kula.Wa abuuh kachchar leyah wa gaal-:-Da kalaam chunu-?Hu da hilim hana chunu-?Tahsib ana wa ammak wa akhwaanak kullina nasjudu leek walla-?
Wa akhwaanah anhasado wa laakin abuuhum kamaan karab al-kalaam da fi galbah.
Yoom waahid,akhwaan Yuusuf macho fi l-kadaade yasraho be khanam abuuhum,gariib le hillit Chakiim.
Wa Yaakhuub al-sammooh Israa'iil gaal le Yuusuf-:-Asma',akhwaanak gaa'idiin yasraho be l-khanam gariib le Chakiim.Amchi alhaghum. Wa Yuusuf gaal-:-Tamaam,namchi.
Wa Israa'iil gaal leyah-:-Amchi algaahum wa chiif kikkeef mug'adhum ma'a l-khanam.Wa jiib leyi khabar aafiyithum.-Wa khalaas,Israa'iil rassal Yuusuf min waadi Hibruun wa Yuusuf macha ale hillit Chakiim.
Wakit raayikh fi l-kadaade,lamma ma'a raajil waahid.Wa l-raajil da sa'alah wa gaal leyah-:-Inta gaa'id tifattich chunu-?
Wa Yuusuf radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana gaa'id nifattich akhwaani.Wassifni al-bakaan al-macho yasraho foogah.
Wa l-raajil gaal-:-Humman faato minni hini wa ana simi'tuhum gaa'idiin yihajju wa fi l-akhiir,gaalo-:--Namchu Dutaan.--Wa khalaas,Yuusuf chaal derib hana akhwaanah wa macha ligaahum fi Dutaan.
Wa wakit humman chaafooh jaayi min ba'iid gubbaal ma yalhaghum ke bas,humman gammo achchaawaro foogah le yaktuluuh
wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Daahu siid al-hilim jaayi-!
Ta'aalu naktuluuh wa nazguluuh fi biir.Wa nuguulu haywaan fasil bas akalah.Wa ba'adeen,nichiifu hilmah da,yisawwi leyah chunu-?
Wa laakin wakit Ra'uubiin simi' kalaamhum da,dawwar yinajjiih minhum wa gaal-:-Ma naktuluuh-!
Azguluuh fi l-biir al-fi l-khala di achaan ma tichiilu leeku dimme.Wa iideeku kula ma tukhuttuuhum foogah. Wa hu kallam leehum misil da achaan dawwar yinajjiih wa yiwaddiih le abuuh.
Wa khalaas min Yuusuf wassal bakaan akhwaanah,humman gammo karabooh wa sallo minnah khalagah al-khaali
wa zagalooh fi l-biir.Wa l-biir di yaabse,ma indaha almi.
Wa khalaas,macho ga'ado tihit le yaakulu.Wakit gaa'idiin yaakulu,rafa'o ruuseehum wa chaafo tujjaar Ismaa'iiliyiin jaayiin be jumaalhum min turaab Gil'aad maachiin ale Masir.Wa jumaalhum chaayliin samukh hana kitir wa talha wa dukhkhaan.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,khalaas Yahuuza gaal le akhwaanah-:-Chunu al-faayde al-nalgooha kan katalna akhuuna wa labbadnaah-?
Khalli ma naktuluuh wa laakin nibii'uuh le l-tujjaar dool achaan hu akhuuna min dammina wa lahamna. Wa khalaas khassado.
Wa ba'ad chiyya ke,tujjaar Midyaaniyiin jaayiin faaytiin.Wa akhwaanah le Yuusuf gammo sallooh min al-biir wa baa'ooh le l-Ismaa'iiliyiin be taman al-yibii'u beyah al-abiid.Wa waddooh Masir.
Wa ba'adeen,Ra'uubiin ja taawag Yuusuf fi l-biir wa ma ligaah.Wa min al-hizin gamma charrat khalagah.
Wa gabbal le akhwaanah wa gaal leehum-:-Al-wileed ma fiih-!Hassa' da,nisawwi chunu-?
Wa khalaas,humman dabaho tees wa chaalo al-khalag al-khaali hana Yuusuf wa dassooh fi l-damm.
Wa rassalo al-khalag al-khaali da le abuuhum wa wassooh le l-mursaal yuguul le abuuhum-:-Chiifah-!Aniina ligiina al-khalag da.Ma hana wileedak walla-?
Wa Yaakhuub,min chaaf al-khalag da,hu irif kadar da hana wileedah.Wa gamma sarakh wa gaal-:-Sahiih al-khalag da hana wileedi-!Haywaan waahid katalah wa gatta'ah wa akalah-!
Wa Yaakhuub charrat khalagah wa libis khalag hana hizin.Wa mudda tawiile hu gaa'id yabki le wileedah.
Awlaadah wa banaatah kulluhum yaju yihannusuuh laakin hu aba ma yilhannas leehum wa gaal-:-Ana nagood haznaan lahaddi namchi nilimmu ma'aayah fi l-khabur. Wa gaa'id yabki le wileedah bas.
Wa l-tujjaar waddo Yuusuf fi Masir wa baa'ooh le Fuutifaar.Wa Fuutifaar da,hu kabiir hurraas al-malik.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Yahuuza farag min akhwaanah wa macha bakaan raajil waahid usmah Hiira min hillit Adullaam.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Yahuuza chaaf bineeye waahide wa abuuha min Kan'aan usmah Chuu'.Wa Yahuuza akhad al-bineeye di wa dakhal beeha.
Wa hi bigat khalbaane wa wildat leyah wileed wa Yahuuza sammaah Iir.
Wa battaan bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed wa sammatah Unaan.
Wa battaan kula wildat wileed wa sammatah Chiila.Wa fi l-wakit al-hi wildat foogah da,humman gaa'idiin fi hillit Kaziib.
Wa Yahuuza akhad le Iir,wileedah al-bikir,mara usumha Taamaar.
Wa laakin Iir,bikir Yahuuza,hu naadum fasil giddaam Allah wa be sabab fasaaltah di,Allah ja'al leyah al-moot.
Wa ba'ad da,Yahuuza gaal le wileedah Unaan-:-Aakhud marit akhuuk wa jiib leyah zurriiye.Da cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih le akhuuk al-marhuum.
Wa laakin Unaan irif kadar al-zurriiye di ma tabga leyah hu.Wa wakit yargud ma'a marit akhuuh,yikhalli al-mani yidaffig barra achaan hi ma tabga khalbaane wa tijiib zurriiye le akhuuh.
Wa l-cheyy al-Unaan sawwaah da,fasil giddaam Allah.Wa Allah ja'al al-moot leyah hu kula.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Yahuuza gaal le Taamaar marit wileedah-:-Hassa' da,amchi beet abuuki wa agoodi armala lahaddi wileedi Chiila yabga kabiir. Achaan Yahuuza khaayif Chiila kula yumuut misil akhwaanah.Wa khalaas,Taamaar machat ga'adat fi beet abuuha.
Wa ba'ad mudda tawiile,bineeyit Chuu' marit Yahuuza maatat.Wa wakit hiznah faat,Yahuuza macha hillit Timna achaan yagta' suuf khanamah.Wa macha ma'aayah rafiigah Hiira min hillit Adullaam.
Wa naas gaalo le Taamaar-:-Daahu nasiibki jaayi Timna le yagta' suuf khanamah.
Wa khalaas,hi sallat khulgaan al-khabiibe wa allaffahat be laffaaha wa assarramat wa ga'adat fi khachum baab hillit Inaayim fi derib hillit Timna.Achaan hi irfat kadar Chiila bigi kabiir wa ma antooha leyah achaan tabga martah.
Wa Yahuuza chaafha wa hasabha mara charmuuta achaan hi assarramat.
Wa hu wajjah aleeha,wa macha leeha wa gaal-:-Ana nidoor nargud ma'aaki. Wa laakin hu ma irif kadar hi marit wileedah.Wa Taamaar gaalat leyah-:-Kan ragadt ma'aayi da,tantiini chunu-?
Wa hu radda leeha wa gaal-:-Nirassil leeki sakhal min inzeeyi. Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Illa tantiini damaan nakurbah lahaddi tirassil leyi al-sakhal.
Wa hu gaal-:-Chunu al-cheyy al-nantiiki takurbiih-? Wa hi raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Antiini khitmak be hablah wa asaatak.-Wa hu antaahum leeha wa ragad ma'aaha wa hi khilbat minnah.
Wa ba'ad da,Taamaar gammat machat beetha sallat laffaahitha wa libsat khulgaanha hana l-khabiibe.
Wa Yahuuza anta al-sakhal le rafiigah al-min hillit Adullaam le yiwaddiih le l-mara di wa yichiil leyah khumaamah minha.Laakin hu ma ligiiha.
Wa sa'al naas al-hille wa gaal-:-Ween al-mara al-charmuuta al-gaa'ide fi khachum derib hillit Inaayim-? Wa humman raddo leyah-:-Ma fi mara charmuuta fi l-bakaan da.
Wa l-raajil gabbal le Yahuuza wa gaal-:-Ana ma ligiitha wa naas al-hille zaathum gaalo leyi ma fi mara charmuuta fi l-bakaan da.
Khalaas Yahuuza gaal-:-Khalli al-khumaam da yagood fi iideenha achaan al-naas ma yichchammato leena.Achaan ana rassalt leeha al-sakhal wa laakin inta ma ligiitha.
Wa ba'ad talaata chahar,gaalo le Yahuuza-:-Daahu Taamaar marit wileedak zanat wa bigat khalbaane. Wa Yahuuza gaal-:-Amurguuha barra wa harruguuha-!
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yamurguuha,hi rassalat le nasiibha Yahuuza wa gaalat-:-Guulu leyah-:--Ana khalbaane min al-raajil siid al-khumaam da.-- Wa gaalat battaan-:-Akkid wa chiif al-khitim be hablah da wa l-asa di,hana yaatu-?
Wa Yahuuza akkad al-achya dool wa gaal-:-Hi indaha hagg ziyaada minni achaan ana ma jawwaztaha le wileedi Chiila. Wa khalaas,battaan ma garrab leeha.
Wa wakit wakitha hana l-waaluuda tamma,hi irfat kadar indaha tiimaan.
Wa wakit gaa'ide talda,waahid minhum salla iidah waahide.Wa l-wallaada massakat iidah wa rabatat leyah kheet ahmar wa gaalat-:-Hu da al-yamrug awwal.
Laakin hu jabad iidah wa akhuuh marag gubbaalah.Wa l-wallaada gaalat-:-Ligiit derib min ween maragt-? Achaan da,sammooh Faaris (ma'anaatah derib hana marigiin).
Wa ba'ad da,akhuuh al-aakhar marag be habil ahmar fi iidah wa sammooh Zaarah (ma'anaatah ahmar tchu).
Wa l-Ismaa'iiliyiin waddooh le Yuusuf fi Masir wa Fuutifaar al-Masri charaah.Wa Fuutifaar da,hu kabiir al-hurraas wa siid al-amaan hana Fir'oon malik Masir.
Wa Allah gaa'id ma'a Yuusuf wa achaan da bas,kulla cheyy al-yisawwiih da,yanjah.Wa sakan fi beet siidah al-Masri.
Wa Fuutifaar irif kadar Allah gaa'id ma'a Yuusuf wa Allah yanti al-najaah le Yuusuf fi kulla cheyy al-tisawwiih iidah.
Wa Fuutifaar radyaan beyah wa khaddamah.Wa antaah le Yuusuf mas'uuliiyit beetah wa kulla maalah antaah leyah fi iideenah.
Min wakit al-Fuutifaar wakkal Yuusuf,Allah baarak beetah wa maalah wa ziraa'tah fi chaan Yuusuf.
Achaan da bas,Fuutifaar anta kulla cheyy al-indah fi iideen Yuusuf.Wa Fuutifaar ma yisawwi cheyy fi beetah,illa yaji yaakul bas.Wa Yuusuf sabi jamiil wa tuulah kula sameh.
Wa ba'ad ayyaam,marit siidah chaafatah wa gaalat leyah-:-Ta'aal,argud ma'aayi.
Wa Yuusuf gaal leeha-:-La-!Abadan-!Siidi ma yihimm be cheyy fi beetah.Antaani mas'uuliiye hana kulla maalah fi iideeni.
Wa ma fi naadum fi l-beet da mas'uul ziyaada minni ana,illa siidi.Wa siidi zaatah ma yadharni cheyy,illa inti bas achaan inti martah.Wa da kikkeef nisawwi cheyy haraam misil ke-?Wa kikkeef nisawwi zanib misil da giddaam Allah-?
Wa laakin daayman hi ma tikhalliih wa Yuusuf kula ma khassad abadan wa la yi'aanis ma'aaha wa la yargud ma'aaha.
Yoom waahid,Yuusuf dakhal fi l-beet le yakhdim.Wa l-khaddaamiin al-aakhariin ma fiihum.
Wa marit Fuutifaar jaat karabat Yuusuf min khalagah wa gaalat leyah-:-Ta'aal,argud ma'aayi-! Laakin Yuusuf talag leeha khalagah fi iideenha wa jara marag barra.
Min chaafat talag leeha khalagah fi iideenha wa jara marag barra da,
hi gammat sarakhat wa naadat khaddaamiinha wa gaalat-:-Ta'aalu,chiifu-!Al-Ibraani al-siid beeti jaabah leena da,yidoor yal'ab ma'aana-!Gamma ja hini le yargud ma'aayi wa ana gammeet sarakht.
Wa min simi' ana sarakht da,hu gamma jara barra wa khalla leyi khalagah.
Wa ba'ad da,hi dammat khalag Yuusuf lahaddi siid beetha ja.
Min hu ja,hi gammat ooratah nafs al-kalaam al-ooratah le l-khaddaamiin wa gaalat-:-Ha-!Daahu abdak al-Ibraani al-jibtah leena da,ja leyi le yal'ab ma'aayi-!
Laakin ana gammeet sarakht,hu gamma jara barra wa khalla leyi khalagah-!
Wakit siid beetha simi' al-kalaam al-gaalatah fi Yuusuf da,hu gamma zi'il.
Wa karab Yuusuf fi l-sijin fi l-bakaan al-yidissu foogah masaajiin hana l-malik.Wa Yuusuf ga'ad fi l-sijin da.
Wa fi l-sijin kula,Allah gaa'id ma'a Yuusuf wa antaah rahma.Wa ligi rida min mas'uul al-sijin.
Wa anta Yuusuf mas'uuliiyit kulla l-masaajiin fi iideenah wa kulla cheyy al-humman yisawwuuh illa be izin Yuusuf.
Wa mas'uul al-sijin ma yihimm be khidimtah al-ammanaaha le Yuusuf achaan Allah gaa'id ma'aayah.Wa Allah yanti al-najaah le Yuusuf fi kulla cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Wa ba'ad da,yoom waahid mas'uuliin itneen hana Fir'oon malik Masir sawwo zanib.Al-waahid mas'uul al-naas al-yantu charaab le l-malik.Wa l-aakhar mas'uul al-naas al-yisawwu khubza le l-malik.
Wa l-malik zi'il minhum wa sajanaahum.Wa l-sijin da gaa'id fi beet kabiir al-hurraas hana l-malik.Wa fi l-sijin da Yuusuf kula makruub foogah.
Wa kabiir al-hurraas hana l-malik wakkal Yuusuf achaan yakhdim leehum.Wa sawwo ayyaam fi l-sijin.
Yoom waahid,al-mas'uuliin al-itneen hana l-malik hilmo fi l-sijin be l-leel.Wa hilim hana ayyi waahid indah ma'ana.
Be fajur wakit Yuusuf ja leehum,chaafaahum gaa'idiin mubarjaliin.
Wa hu sa'alaahum-:-Maalku al-yoom intu mubarjaliin-?
Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aniina hilimna wa ma fi naadum hini al-yifassir leena hilimna da. Wa Yuusuf radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-Rabb bas yagdar yifassirah leeku.Hajjuuni be hilimku.
Wa mas'uul al-naas al-yantu charaab le l-malik hajja le Yuusuf be hilmah wa gaal-:-Fi hilmi ana chift chadarat inab waahide.
Wa l-chadara di indaha talaata furuu' wa tidoor tinawwir wa ba'adeen nawwarat wa sawwat anguud hana inab najiid.
Wa indi fi iideeni kaas hana l-malik.Ana gata't min al-inab wa assart almiih fi l-kaas da wa maddeetah le l-malik.
Wa Yuusuf gaal leyah-:-Daahu tafsiir hilmak.Al-talaata furuu' humman yiwassufu talaata yoom.
Ba'ad talaata yoom,al-malik yamurgak min al-sijin wa yigabbilak fi khidimtak al-awwal wa battaan timidd leyah al-kaas.
Wa wakit gabbalt fi khidimtak,ma tansaani sawwi leyi al-kheer wa hajji beyi le l-malik achaan yamrugni min al-sijin.
Achaan ana jaabooni be gu min balad al-Ibraaniyiin.Wa hini ana ma sawweet cheyy al-waajib yasjunuuni be sababah.
Wa wakit mas'uul al-naas al-yisawwu khubza le l-malik simi' Yuusuf anta tafsiir adiil,gaal leyah-:-Ana kula hilimt.Fi hilmi ana chaayil fi raasi talaata gufaf hana khubza.
Wa l-guffa al-foogaaniiye malaane be ayyi nafar hana khubza al-malik yiriidha wa l-tuyuur jo akalo al-khubza al-fi raasi.
Wa Yuusuf radda leyah wa gaal-:-Daahu tafsiir hilmak.Al-talaata gufaf yiwassufu talaata yoom.
Ba'ad talaata yoom,al-malik yamurgak min al-sijin wa yachunguuk fi chadara.Wa l-tuyuur yaju yaakulu jildak.
Wa khalaas ba'ad talaata yoom,al-malik ayyad hool hana waaluudtah wa sawwa hafla le kulla masaa'iilah wa marag al-mas'uuliin al-itneen min al-sijin,giddaam masaa'iilah.
Wa gabbal mas'uul al-naas al-yantu charaab le l-malik fi khidimtah le yimidd leyah battaan al-kaas.
Wa le mas'uul al-naas al-yisawwu khubza le l-malik,chanagooh.Wa khalaas be misil da,tafsiir hana Yuusuf ja fi derbah.
Wa laakin mas'uul al-naas al-yantu charaab le l-malik ma fakkarah le Yuusuf,hu nisiih.
Ba'ad santeen,al-malik Fir'oon hilim.Fi hilmah hu gaa'id fi khachum bahar al-Niil.
Wa chaaf sab'a bagar sumaan wa samhiin marago min al-bahar wa gaa'idiin yaakulu gechch fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa ba'ad chiyya,chaaf sab'a bagar aakhariin baatliin wa cheeniin marago min al-bahar wa macho jambuhum.
Wa tawwaali,gammo akalo al-bagar al-sumaan wa samhiin dool.Wa khalaas,al-malik gamma min al-noom.
Wa gabbal naam wa hilim battaan.Hu chaaf sab'a ganaadiil hana gameh marago min ageegaay waahide.Wa humman tukhaan wa malaaniin iyaal.
Wa hu chaaf battaan sab'a ganaadiil rugaag wa hargaaniin min al-hamu marago jambuhum.
Wa zarato al-ganaadiil al-tukhaan wa malaaniin iyaal.Wa khalaas,Fir'oon gamma wa irif kadar hu hilim.
Wa be fajur,Fir'oon barjal marra waahid min hilmah da wa naada kulla l-chaddaara wa ulama Masir.Hu hajja leehum be l-hilim wa laakin naadum waahid kula ma gidir fassar leyah al-hilim da.
Khalaas,mas'uul hana l-naas al-bantu charaab le l-malik gaal-:-Ya siidi-!Al-yoom ana azzakkart khataayi.
Yoom waahid,inta zi'ilt minni ana wa min mas'uul al-naas al-yisawwu khubza.Wa gammeet sajantina fi sijin hana kabiir al-hurraas.
Wa yoom waahid,hilimna wa hilim hana ayyi waahid minnina indah ma'ana.
Wa fi l-sijin fiyah sabi waahid,hu abid Ibraani hana kabiir al-hurraas.Wa aniina hajjeena leyah be hilimna wa hu antaana al-ma'ana.Wa fassar le ayyi waahid hilmah.
Wa l-kalaam al-kallamah leena da,ja fi derbah misil hu gaalah.Wa khalaas,leyi ana gabbaltini fi khidimti wa laakin le mas'uul al-naas al-bisawwu khubza,inta chanagtah.
Wa tawwaali Fir'oon rassal yijiibu Yuusuf.Wa macho maragooh min al-sijin.Wa hu zayyan raasah wa khayyar khalagah.Wa waddooh giddaam Fir'oon.
Wa l-malik gaal le Yuusuf-:-Ana hilimt wa naadum waahid kula ma gidir fassar leyi hilmi da.Wa ana simi't kadar inta tagdar tifassir al-hilim kan naadum hajjaah leek.
Wa Yuusuf radda leyah-:-Ma ana bas nantiik tafsiir laakin al-Rabb bas yantiik tafsiir adiil.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Fi hilmi ana gaa'id fi khachum bahar al-Niil.
Wa daahu chift sab'a bagar sumaan wa samhiin marago min al-bahar wa gaa'idiin baakulu gechch fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa ba'ad da,sab'a bagar aakhariin kula marago waraahum wa humman baatliin wa cheeniin wa hargaaniin.Wa ana ma chift abadan fi Masir bagar cheeniin misil dool-!
Khalaas al-bagar dool akalo al-sab'a bagar al-sumaan al-marago awwal.
Ba'ad akaloohum,be da kula humman gaa'idiin baatliin misil awwal.Wa kan chiftuhum,ma tuguul akalo al-bagar dool.Khalaas ana wi'iit.
Wa battaan ana hilimt wa daahu chift sab'a ganaadiil tukhaan wa malaaniin iyaal marago min ageegaay waahide.
Wa ba'ad da,sab'a ganaadiil aakhariin marago jambuhum wa humman rugaag wa yaabsiin wa hargaaniin min al-hamu.
Wa l-sab'a ganaadiil al-rugaag zarato al-ganaadiil al-malaaniin iyaal.Wa misil da,ana hajjeetah le l-chaddaara wa laakin ma fi naadum al-gidir fassarah leyi.
Wa Yuusuf gaal le Fir'oon-:-Hilmak al-itneen dool yiwassufu cheyy waahid bas.Al-Rabb wassafaak al-cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Al-sab'a bagar al-samhiin wa l-sab'a ganaadiil al-malaaniin iyaal humman sab'a sana.Wa da,hilim waahid bas.
Wa l-sab'a bagar baatliin wa cheeniin al-marago waraahum wa l-sab'a ganaadiil yaabsiin wa hargaaniin min al-hamu,humman dool yiwassufu sab'a sana hana juu'.
Misil ana ooreetak,ya l-sayyid al-malik,al-Rabb wassafaak al-cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Daahu al-sab'a siniin al-jaayiin,yukuunu siniin hana ma'aach katiir fi kulla balad Masir.
Wa ba'adeen,yaju sab'a siniin hana juu'.Wa l-naas yanso al-ma'aach al-awwal ligooh fi l-balad.Wa l-juu' yidammir kulla balad Masir.
Wa l-naas yanso kadar awwal ligo ma'aach katiir.Wa da achaan al-juu' yabga chadiid marra waahid.
Wa hilmak bigi itneen da achaan al-Rabb chaal kharaar kadar al-cheyy da gariib yukuun.
Ya sayyid al-malik,hassa' da fattich naadum faahim wa hakiim wa antiih mas'uuliiyit kulla balad Masir.
Wa khutt muraakhibiin fi l-balad.Wa humman yichiilu al-khumus min al-intaaj fi l-sab'a siniin hana l-ma'aach al-katiir al-yalgooh fi balad Masir.
Wa khalli yilimmu al-akil al-yalgooh fi l-sab'a siniin hana l-ma'aach al-katiir.Wa antiihum amur le yusubbuuh wa yudummuuh fi l-makhaazin al-fi l-hillaal.
Be misil da,yudummu al-ma'aach le naas al-balad le sab'a siniin hana l-juu' al-yaju fi balad Masir.Wa be da,al-juu' ma yidammir al-balad.
Wakit al-malik Fir'oon wa l-mas'uuliin sim'o al-kalaam al-Yuusuf gaalah da,humman firho.
Wa l-malik gaal le mas'uuliinah-:-Al-raajil da,Ruuh Allah gaa'id foogah.Ma nagdaro nalgo naadum al-indah baraka ziyaada minnah.
Wa gaal le Yuusuf-:-Al-Rabb wassaf leek kulla l-cheyy da.Achaan da bas,ma fi naadum faahim wa hakiim ziyaada minnak inta.
Khalaas inta bas tahkim fi baladi.Wa kulla l-cha'ab hana Masir yitaabu'u kalaamak.Wa illa ana bas nabga aali minnak achaan ana al-malik.
Wa battaan gaal le Yuusuf-:-Khalaas,ana anteetak al-hukum hana kulla balad Masir.
Wa l-malik salla al-khaatim min iidah wa dassaah fi iid Yuusuf wa labbasah khalag hana gumaach sameh wa dassa leyah fi ragabatah hafiide hana dahab.
Wa rakkabah fi arabatah al-malakiiye al-taaniye wa l-naas maachiin giddaamah yuguulu-:-Kissu min al-derib-! Wa be misil da,Fir'oon anta le Yuusuf al-hukum hana kulla balad Masir.
Wa gaal battaan le Yuusuf-:-Ana bas al-malik wa nuguul leek naadum ma yarfa' iidah wa la rijlah bala iznak inta,fi kulla balad Masir-!
Wa l-malik samma Yuusuf Safnat Fa'niih wa jawwazah bineeyit Fuuti Faara' al-usumha Asnaat.Wa Fuuti Faara' hu raajil diin hana l-hille al-usumha Uun.Min da khalaas,Yuusuf bada yahkim fi balad Masir.
Wakit Yuusuf gaabal Fir'oon malik Masir,umrah 30 sana.Wa khalaas,hu marag min bakaan al-malik wa macha yuruukh fi kulla balad Masir.
Fi sab'a siniin,al-ziraa'a wildat katiir.
Wa fi kulla balad Masir,Yuusuf lamma kulla l-ma'aach hana l-sab'a siniin dool wa dammaah fi l-makhaazin hana l-hillaal.Wa fi ayyi hille,damma al-ma'aach al-naas haratooh fi l-ziraa'a al-hawaaleeha.
Wa Yuusuf lamma gameh katiir misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar.Wa naadum ma yagdar yigaawisah min al-katara.
Gubbaal sant al-juu',Asnaat marit Yuusuf jaabat leyah awlaad itneen,wa hi bineeyit Fuuti Faara' raajil diin hana l-hille al-usumha Uun.
Al-bikir,Yuusuf sammaah Manassa (ma'anaatah nassaani) achaan hu gaal-:-Al-Rabb nassaani kulla ta'abi wa l-furga ma'a ahali.
Wa l-sakhayyar sammaah Afraayim (ma'anaatah intaaj) achaan hu gaal-:-Al-Rabb antaani iyaal fi l-balad al-ana ti'ibt foogha.
Khalaas fi Masir,al-sab'a siniin hana l-ma'aach al-katiir kammalo.
Wa l-sab'a siniin hana l-juu' bado misil Yuusuf gaalah.Wa fi kulla l-buldaan,al-juu' dakhal leehum,illa fi Masir bas fiyah ma'aach.
Wa ba'adeen,al-juu' dakhal fi Masir kula.Wa l-cha'ab macho bako le Fir'oon wa gaalo-:-Antiina ma'aach-! Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Amchu le Yuusuf wa sawwu al-cheyy al-yuguulah leeku.
Wa l-juu' bigi chadiid fi kulla l-balad.Wa Yuusuf fatah kulla l-makhaazin wa gamma yibii' al-gameh le cha'ab Masir.Wa battaan al-juu' gaa'id yiziid be ziyaada fi Masir.
Wa l-naas jaayiin min kulla l-buldaan le yachru gameh min Yuusuf fi Masir achaan al-juu' bigi chadiid marra waahid fi kulla l-buldaan.
Khalaas yoom waahid,Yaakhuub simi' kadar fi Masir fiyah ma'aach wa hu gaal le awlaadah-:-Maalku gaa'idiin saakit ke-?
Ana simi't gaalo fi Masir fiyah ma'aach.Amchu achru leena gameh achaan ni'iichu wa ma numuutu min al-juu'.
Khalaas akhwaan Yuusuf al-achara macho fi Masir le yachru gameh.
Wa laakin kan le Banyaamiin,wald amm Yuusuf,Yaakhuub aba ma yikhalliih yamchi ma'aahum achaan hu khaayif cheyy waahid yisawwiih fi l-derib.
Wa khalaas,awlaad Yaakhuub wislo fi Masir le yachru gameh misil naas aakhariin kula achaan al-juu' bigi chadiid fi balad Kan'aan.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Yuusuf gaa'id yahkim fi Masir.Wa hu bas gaa'id yibii' al-gameh le kulla l-naas.Wa khalaas,yoom waahid akhwaanah jo sajado giddaamah.
Wakit hu chaafaahum,irifaahum laakin hu sawwa nafsah misil ma ya'arifhum abadan.Wa kachchar leehum wa gaal-:-Intu dool da,jaayiin min ween-? Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Aniina jaayiin min balad Kan'aan le nachru ma'aach.
Wa Yuusuf irifaahum laakin humman ma irfooh.
Wa Yuusuf fakkar fi l-hilim al-awwal hilmah fi akhwaanah wa gaal leehum-:-Kalaamku da ma sahiih-!Intu jawaasiis jiitu ti'akkudu min al-balad.
Wa humman gaalo-:-La la,ya l-sayyid al-haakim.Abiidak jo le yachru ma'aach.
Aniina kullina ke abuuna waahid bas.Aniina amiiniin-!Abiidak ma jawaasiis.
Wa Yuusuf gaal-:-La-!Intu jiitu ti'akkudu min al-balad-!
Wa humman gaalo-:-Aniina abiidak atnaachar akhwaan wa abuuna waahid wa saakniin fi balad Kan'aan.Wa akhuuna al-sakhayyar gaa'id ma'a abuuna.Wa l-waahid kamaan waddar.
Wa Yuusuf gaal leehum-:-La,akiid intu dool jawaasiis misil ana gultah-!
Laakin nijarribku kan kalaamku da sahiih.Wa be hayaat Fir'oon,kan akhuuku al-sakhayyar da ma jibtuuh leyi,intu ma tamurgu min hini.
Asma'o,khalli waahid minku yamchi yijiibah wa intu al-aakhariin tagoodu fi l-sijin.Be misil da,nijarribku wa nagdar na'arif kan kalaamku da sahiih.Wa kan ma sahiih,akkid intu jawaasiis-!
Wa Yuusuf sabbaahum kulluhum fi l-sijin wa ga'ado talaata yoom.
Wa ba'ad talaata yoom,Yuusuf gaal leehum-:-Ana khaayif min Allah.Achaan da,sawwu al-cheyy al-nuguulah leeku wa ma tumuutu.
Kan intu amiiniin,khalli waahid minku yagood fi l-sijin.Wa intu al-aakhariin kamaan,tamchu tiwaddu al-gameh le aayilaatku al-jii'aaniin.
Wa tijiibu leyi akhuuku al-sakhayyar.Be misil da,na'arif kadar kalaamku da sahiih.Wa be misil da,ma tumuutu. Wa humman khassado be l-kalaam da.
Wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Aniina khitiina fi akhuuna-!Achaan aniina chifna diigtah wakit gaa'id yachhadna wa aniina ma simi'na kalaamah.Wa fi chaan da bas,aniina kula al-diige di nazalat foogna.
Wa Ra'uubiin gaal-:-Ana ma gult leeku ma tisawwu khata fi l-walad da walla-?Wa intu ma simi'tuuni.Wa hassa',nil'aakhabo be sabab dimmitah-!
Wa humman ma irfo kadar Yuusuf yasma' kalaamhum achaan hu gaa'id yihajji ma'aahum be turjumaan.
Wa Yuusuf kaskas minhum wa gamma yabki.Wa ba'adeen,gabbal wa hajja leehum.Wa khalaas,karab Chim'uun giddaamhum wa dassaah fi l-sijin.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuusuf anta amur yamlo leehum chuwaalaathum be gameh wa yidissu gurus hana ayyi waahid fi chuwaalah wa yantuuhum zaad.Wa sawwo misil Yuusuf gaalah.
Wa akhwaanah gammo chaddo chuwaalaathum fi hamiirhum wa faato.
Wa wakit dallo be leel,waahid minhum fakka chuwaalah le yanti assaar le humaarah.Wa wakit fakkaah,daahu ligi gursah fi khachum chuwaalah.
Hu gaal le akhwaanah-:-Daahu gabbalo leyi gursi-!Ligiitah fi khachum chuwaali. Wakit chaafo al-cheyy da,galibhum angata' wa rajafo wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Chunu al-sawwaah leena al-Rabb da-?
Wa wakit wassalo fi bakaan abuuhum fi balad Kan'aan,gammo hajjo leyah be kulla cheyy al-bigi.Gaalo leyah-:
Al-haakim hana Masir kachchar leena wa gaal aniina jawaasiis.
Wa aniina gulna leyah-:--La,aniina ma jawaasiis.Aniina amiiniin.
Aniina atnaachar akhwaan,iyaal abu waahid.Al-wileed al-waahid waddar wa l-sakhayyar gaa'id ma'a abuuna fi balad Kan'aan.--
Wa l-haakim da gaal-:--Nidoor na'arif kan intu naas amiiniin.Khallu waahid minku yagood hini wa amchu waddu al-ma'aach le aayilaatku al-jii'aaniin.
Wa jiibu leyi akhuuku al-sakhayyar.Be misil da,nagdar na'arif kadar intu ma jawaasiis laakin intu naas amiiniin.Wa namrug leeku akhuuku wa nantiiku izin turuukhu fi l-balad.-
Wa ba'adeen,faddo chuwaalaathum.Wa ayyi waahid ligi gursah gaa'id fi juzlaanah.Khalaas,min chaafo gurushum,humman wa abuuhum khaafo khoof chadiid.
Wa Yaakhuub gaal leehum-:-Intu waddartu iyaali.Yuusuf ma fiih wa Chim'uun kula ma fiih wa battaan kula tidooru tichiilu Banyaamiin.Kulla l-ta'ab da ja leyi ana bas fi raasi.
Wa Ra'uubiin gaal le abuuh-:-Ammin leyi Banyaamiin fi iideeni.Wa kan ana ma jibt leek Banyaamiin,aktul iyaali al-itneen dool fi gaddah.
Wa Yaakhuub gaal-:-La,wileedi ke ma yamchi ma'aaku abadan achaan akhuuh maat wa hu wiheedah bas fi ammah al-faddal leyi.Kan cheyy waahid kaan leyah fi safarku,be cheebi da,numuut min al-hizin.
Al-juu' bigi chadiid bilheen fi balad Kan'aan.
Ba'ad humman kammalo al-ma'aach al-jaabooh min Masir,Yaakhuub gaal le iyaalah-:-Gabbulu amchu Masir achru leena ma'aach chiyya.
Laakin Yahuuza gaal le abuuh-:-Aniina ma gulna leek-?Al-haakim gaal leena be kalaam waadih kan ma jibna akhuuna da,hu ma yigaabilna.
Laakin kan inta tikhassid akhuuna yamchi ma'aana da,khalaas aniina namchu nachru leek ma'aach.
Wa kan abeet kamaan,aniina ma nagdaro namchu.Achaan al-haakim gaal leena kan ma jibna akhuuna da,hu ma yigaabilna.
Wa Yaakhuub al-binaaduuh Israa'iil gaal leehum-:-Maala gultu leyah induku akhu aakhar-?Intu dool ta''abtuuni.
Humman gaalo-:-Ma ke-!Hu bas sa'alaana su'aal katiir achaan ya'arifna wa ya'arif aayilitna.Hu gaal leena-:--Abuuku gaa'id hayy walla-?Induku akhu aakhar walla-?- Wa aniina raddeena leyah fi su'aalah.Laakin ma na'arfu kadar yuguul leena-:--Amchu jiibu leyi akhuuku.-
Wa Yahuuza gaal battaan le abuuh Israa'iil-:-Khalli al-wileed yamchi ma'aayi.Wa khalli nugummu namchu kan ma nidooru numuutu kullina ke,aniina wa iyaalna wa inta.
Wa ana bas nadmanah wa tagdar tatulbah minni.Kan ana ma gabbaltah leek,aj'alni misil naadum khaati fi muddit hayaati.
Hassa' da,awwal kan ma akhkharna da,wakit da macheena marrateen.
Khalaas,abuuhum Israa'iil gaal leehum-:-Hiya,kan ke da,asma'o kalaami.Chiilu ma'aaku hadiiye wa wadduuha le l-haakim.Chiilu fi mawaa'iinku min ahsan intaaj ardina misil asal chiyya wa samukh hana kitir wa talha wa dukhkhaan wa iyaal al-chadar al-samhiin.
Wa waddu al-gurus al-tachru beyah gameh wa l-gurus al-ligiituuh fi chuwaalaatku kula.Akuun humman sawwo khalat.
Khalaas,amchu waddu akhuuku bakaan al-haakim.
Wa Allah al-Gaadir yikhalli al-haakim da yihinn foogku wa yikhalli Banyaamiin wa yatlig akhuuku al-aakhar kula.Kan leyi ana kamaan,khalli nagood bala iyaal.
Wa khalaas,humman jahhazo al-hadiiye misil abuuhum gaalah wa chaalo al-gurus marrateen.Wa waddo Banyaamiin ma'aahum le Masir.Wa gaabalo Yuusuf.
Wa Yuusuf chaaf Banyaamiin ma'aahum.Wa wakit chaafah,gamma gaal le mas'uul beetah-:-Waddi al-naas dool fi beeti wa adbah leehum kabich wa sawwu akil achaan yikhaddu ma'aayi.
Wa l-mas'uul waddaahum fi beet Yuusuf misil hu gaalah leyah.
Wa wakit waddoohum fi beet Yuusuf,humman khaafo bilheen wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Fi chaan al-gurus al-gabbalo leena fi chuwaalaatna wakit awwal jiina,akuun humman yakurbuuna le yichiilu hamiirna wa yi'abbuduuna-!
Wa fi madkhal al-beet,garrabo le l-mas'uul hana beet Yuusuf wa gaalo leyah-:
Min fadlak,ya l-sayyid,awwal aniina jiina hini chareena ma'aach.
Wa wakit mugabbiliin,wassalna bakaan al-nunuumu foogah wa gammeena fakkeena chuwaalaatna.Wa ayyi waahid ligi gursah fi khachum chuwaalah.Wa daahu al-gurus da,jibnaah leek battaan.
Wa jibna gurus aakhar le nachru beyah ma'aach.Wa ma na'arfu yaatu dassa leena al-gurus da fi chuwaalaatna.
Wa l-mas'uul gaal leehum-:-Asburu,ma takhaafo cheyy.Allah Rabbuku wa Rabb abuuku bas rahamaaku be kanz fi chuwaalaatku.Kan le gurusku kamaan,ana ligiitah.-Wa khalaas,al-mas'uul marag leehum Chim'uun min al-sijin.
Wa waddaahum fi beet Yuusuf.Wa antaahum almi le yikhassulu rijleehum wa jaab akil le hamiirhum.
Min sim'o kadar humman yikhaddu ma'a Yuusuf,marago al-hadiiye al-daayriin yantuuha leyah fi wakt al-khada.
Wa khalaas,wakit Yuusuf ja dakhal fi beetah,humman gaddamo leyah al-hadiiye wa sajado leyah.
Hu sallamaahum wa gaal-:-Chaayibku al-hajjeetuuni beyah lissaa' gaa'id hayy wa gaa'id aafe walla-?
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Aywa,abuuna gaa'id hayy wa gaa'id aafe. Wa battaan dangaro wa sajado leyah.
Wa Yuusuf rafa' raasah wa chaafaahum kulluhum wa irif wald ammah Banyaamiin wa gaal-:-Hu da bas akhuuku al-sakhayyar al-yoom daak hajjeetuuni beyah da walla-? Wa gaal le Banyaamiin-:-Ya wileedi,al-Rabb yantiik rahma.
Wa wakit chaaf akhuuh,galbah ri'if wa yidoor yabki wa tawwaali marag wa macha fattach bakaan al-yabki foogah.Wa macha dakhal fi khurfitah wa baka.
Wa ba'ad baka,khassal wijhah wa asar galbah wa marag leehum.Wa gaal le khaddaamiinah-:-Amchu jiibu al-akil.
Wa khalaas,jaabo al-akil wa antooh le Yuusuf wiheedah wa le akhwaanah wiheedhum wa le l-Masriyiin kula wiheedhum achaan haraam le l-Masriyiin yaakulu ma'a l-Ibraaniyiin.
Wa akhwaan Yuusuf rassoohum giddaamah min al-bikir lahaddi l-sakhayyar.Wa be da,humman al'ajjabo wa bichchaawafo ambeenaathum.
Wa be izin Yuusuf,chaalo al-akil al-gaa'id giddaamah wa antooh le akhwaanah.Wa l-akil al-antooh le Banyaamiin yisaawi khamsa marraat akil hana akhwaanah.Wa humman chirbo khamar sawa lahaddi firho.
Wa ba'adeen,Yuusuf anta amur le mas'uul hana beetah wa gaal leyah-:-Amla chuwaalaat hana l-naas dool be ma'aach katiir al-yagdaro yiwadduuh wa diss gurus hana ayyi waahid fi chuwaalah.
Wa laakin khutt fi khachum chuwaal hana l-sakhayyar da,gursah wa kaasi hana l-fudda kula. Wa l-mas'uul sawwa misil Yuusuf gaalah leyah.
Be fajur badri,khalloohum le iyaal Yaakhuub faato be hamiirhum.
Wa khalaas,marago min al-hille wa laakin ma macho ba'iid ke bas,Yuusuf gaal le mas'uul hana beetah-:-Gumm,alhaghum le l-naas dool-!Wa kan wassaltuhum,guul leehum-:--Maala al-kheer baddaltuuh be l-charr-?
Maala sirigtu al-kaas hana sayyidi al-yachrab wa yichawwif beyah-?Al-cheyy al-sawweetuuh da,fasil-!-
Wa khalaas,mas'uul hana l-beet macha,lihighum wa gaal leehum al-kalaam da.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Kikkeef tathamna misil da,ya l-sayyid al-mas'uul-?Abadan cheyy haraam misil da ma nisawwuuh.
Ya l-sayyid al-mas'uul,aniina gabbalna min balad Kan'aan al-gurus al-ligiinaah fi khachum chuwaalaatna kula.Wa kikkeef nagdaro nasurgu fudda walla dahab hana sayyidak-?
Kan waahid min abiidak ligo fi bakaanah al-kaas,khalli yumuut-!Wa aniina al-aakhariin kamaan nabgo abiid le siidak-!
Wa l-mas'uul gaal-:-Tamaam.Laakin hu al-ligiina al-kaas fi khumaamah da,hu bas yabga abdi wa intu al-aakhariin kamaan tabgo bariyiin.
Wa tawwaali,ayyi waahid dalla chuwaalah tihit wa fatahah.
Wa l-mas'uul gamma yifattich chuwaalaathum,bada be chuwaal hana l-bikir wa kammal be chuwaal hana l-sakhayyar.Wa ligi al-kaas fi chuwaal hana Banyaamiin.
Fi l-bakaan da,gammo charrato khulgaanhum min al-hizin.Wa ayyi waahid gamma chadda humaarah wa gabbalo fi l-hille.
Khalaas,Yahuuza ma'a akhwaanah wassalo bakaan Yuusuf.Wa hu kula lissaa' gaa'id fi beetah wa humman waga'o saajidiin giddaamah.
Wa Yuusuf gaal leehum-:-Maala sawweetu al-cheyy da-?Ma ta'arfu kadar naadum misli ana da,yagdar yichawwif walla-?
Yahuuza gaal-:-Hu da,nuguulu chunu,ya l-sayyid al-haakim-?Wa be da,kikkeef nuguulu aniina bariyiin-?Al-Rabb bayyan khata abiidak.Khalaas,aniina nabgo leeku abiid ma'a l-ligiitu al-kaas fi bakaanah.
Wa Yuusuf gaal-:-La,haraam leyi nisawwi misil ke-!Illa l-naadum al-ligiina fi bakaanah al-kaas bas,yabga abdi.Wa kan leeku intu al-aakhariin kamaan,amchu be l-aafe le abuuku.
Wa tawwaali,Yahuuza ja gariib le Yuusuf wa gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid al-haakim.Min fadlak,khalli nihajji leek wa ma taz'al foogi ana abdak achaan inta misil al-malik.
Fi wakit awwal aniina jiina,inta sa'altina gult leena-:--Abuuku gaa'id hayy walla-?Wa induku akhu aakhar walla-?--
Wa aniina raddeena leek-:--Abuuna chaayib wa gaa'id.Wa indina akhu sakhayyar al-wildaah wakit hu chaayib.Wa hu wiheedah bas faddal leyah min martah al-biriidha bilheen achaan akhuuh al-aakhar da maat.Wa abuuna biriidah ziyaada.--
Wa inta gult leena khalli namchu nijiibuuh leek achaan tichiifah be eenak.
Wa aniina gulna leek al-wileed ma yagdar yaji yikhalli abuuh.Kan marag khallaah,abuuh yumuut.
