Wakit kheel Fir'oon malik Masir wa arabaatah wa siyaadhum dakhalo fi l-bahar,Allah galab fooghum al-almi.Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil gata'o al-bahar fi l-turaab al-yaabis.
Wa khalaas,Mariyam al-nabiiye akhut Haaruun chaalat nuggaara sakhayre wa kulla l-awiin taaba'anha wa gamman yal'aban wa yuduggan nagaagiirhin.
Wa Mariyam khannat wa gaalat-:-Khannu le Allahachaan hu wassaf gudurtah al-majiide.Wa hu rama fi l-baharal-juwaad wa siidah-!
Wa ba'ad da,Muusa chaal Bani Israa'iil min al-bahar al-Ahmar wa waddaahum le saharat Chuur.Wa fi muddit talaata yoom,humman saayriin fi l-sahara wa ma ligo almi yacharbooh.
Wa wakit wassalo fi Murra,ligo almi wa laakin al-almi da murr,ma gidro yacharbooh.Wa fi chaan da bas,al-bakaan da sammooh Murra.
Fi l-bakaan da,laamooh le Muusa wa gaalo-:-Nacharbo chunu-?
Wa Muusa sa'al Allah wa Allah wassaf leyah chadara waahide.Wa Muusa gata' minha firi' wa zagalah fi l-almi da wa l-almi bigi halu.Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,Allah anta le Bani Israa'iil gawaaniin wa churuut.Wa jarrabaahum
wa gaal-:-Kan tasma'o kalaami ana Allah Ilaahku wa tisawwu al-adiil giddaami wa titaabu'u wasiiyaati wa titabbugu kulla l-churuut,ana ma ninazzil foogku waba misil al-nazzaltah fi l-Masriyiin.Achaan ana Allah al-yachfiiku.
Wa ba'ad da,humman jo fi Iliim wa ligo foogha 12 een hana almi wa 70 nakhal.Wa nazalo jamb al-almi da.
Wa kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil rahalo min Iliim fi yoom 15 hana l-chahar al-taani min marigiinhum min Masir.Wa macho ale saharat Siin al-gaa'ide ambeen Iliim wa jabal Siinaa'.
Wa fi l-sahara di,kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil laamo Muusa wa Haaruun
wa gaalo leehum-:-Akheer leena kan Allah katalaana fi balad Masir wakit aniina chab'aaniin jamb al-buraam hana l-laham.Wa laakin intu maragtuuna fi l-sahara di le numuutu kullina min al-juu'-!
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Hassa' ana ninazzil leeku akil min al-sama.Wa l-cha'ab yamchu yilaggutu akil al-yitimmuhum hana kulla yoom.Wa be da,nijarribku le na'arif kan intu titaabu'u wasiiyaati walla la.
Fi l-yoom al-saadis,laggutu wa jahhuzu al-akil wa hu yabga marrateen ziyaada min al-ayyaam al-aakhariin.
Wa khalaas,Muusa wa Haaruun gaalo le kulla Bani Israa'iil-:-Al-yoom achiiye,ta'arfu kadar Allah hu bas maragaaku min balad Masir.
Wa ambaakir fajur,tichiifu majd Allah yibiin leeku achaan hu simi' luwaamitku.Kan leena aniina,aniina ke chunu al-intu tuluumuuna-?
Wa Muusa gaal battaan-:-Allah hu bas al-yantiiku be achiiye laham taakuluuh.Wa be fajur,tachba'o be akil min al-sama achaan hu simi' luwaamitku.Wa kan tuluumuuna aniina da,intu lumtu Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,Muusa gaal le Haaruun-:-Guul le kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil-:--Ta'aalu giddaam Allah achaan hu simi' luwaamitku.-
Wa wakit Haaruun bada yikallim leehum be l-kalaam da,humman kulluhum anlafato ale l-sahara wa chaafo majd Allah baan leehum fi l-sahaab.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal-:
Ana simi't luwaamit Bani Israa'iil.Guul leehum-:--Al-yoom achiiye,taakulu laham wa ambaakir fajur,tachba'o be l-akil al-yanzil min al-sama.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahku.-
Wa khalaas be achiiye,al-teer al-usmah salwa ja sadda al-bakaan al-humman naazliin foogah.Wa be fajur,al-karany nazal wa khatta hawaale al-fariig.
Wakit al-karany chirib,khalla cheyy khafiif misil al-talaj laasig fi l-ard.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil chaafooh,assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Da chunu-? Achaan humman abadan ma ya'arfuuh.Laakin Muusa gaal leehum-:-Da bas al-akil al-antaaku Allah le taakuluuh.
Wa Allah amaraaku le tilaggutu minnah kulla yoom wa ayyi naadum yilaggit hasab al-yitimm leyah.Wa tichiilu kooro le ayyi naadum min al-aayila.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sawwo misil ooroohum.Waahidiin laggato katiir wa waahidiin laggato chiyya.
Laakin wakit macho gaawasooh,al-laggato katiir ma faddal leehum wa l-laggato chiyya kula ma gassar leehum.Wa be da,ayyi waahid laggat hasab al-yitimm leyah.
Wa khalaas,Muusa gaal leehum-:-Khalli naadum ma yudumm al-akil da lahaddi fajur.
Wa laakin waahidiin minhum ma sim'o kalaam Muusa wa dammo min al-akil da lahaddi fajur.Wa l-akil al-dammooh da affan wa dawwad.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Muusa zi'il fooghum.
Wa kulli fajur,humman yilaggutu al-akil da wa ayyi naadum yilaggit hasab al-yitimm leyah.Wakit al-harraay tidaahi,al-akil da yumuu'.
Wa fi l-yoom al-saadis,yilaggutu akil ziyaada ya'ni koorteen le ayyi naadum.Wa chuyuukh al-mujtama' jo kallamo Muusa be l-cheyy da.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Allah yuguul ke-:--Ambaakir da yoom al-sabt wa da yoom Allah wa hu mukhaddas wa tinjammo foogah.Wa l-cheyy al-tidooru tidissuuh fi l-furun,dissuuh al-yoom.Wa l-tidooru tirakkubuuh fi l-naar kula,rakkubuuh al-yoom.Wa l-faddal min al-akil da,dummuuh lahaddi fajur.-
Khalaas,dammo al-akil da lahaddi fajur misil Muusa amaraahum.Wa l-akil da wa la affan wa la dawwad.
Wa Muusa gaal-:-Aakuluuh fi l-yoom da achaan hu yoom al-sabt le Allah.Wa fi yoom al-sabt,ma talgo akil al-tilaggutuuh.
Fi muddit sitte yoom,laggutu al-akil al-yanzil min al-sama.Wa l-yoom al-saabi' da yabga yoom al-sabt.Fi l-yoom da,al-akil ma yanzil.
Wa wakit al-yoom al-saabi' ja,waahidiin min al-cha'ab macho le yilaggutu al-akil al-yanzil min al-sama wa laakin ma ligooh.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Le mata taabo ma titabbugu gawaaniini wa wasiiyaati-?
Ma ta'arfu kadar ana Allah azalt leeku yoom al-sabt le tinjammo-?Wa fi chaan da,fi l-yoom al-saadis anteetku akil hana yoomeen.Wa khalli ayyi naadum yagood fi beetah ma yamrug fi l-yoom al-saabi'.
Wa be sabab da,kulla l-cha'ab anjammo fi buyuuthum fi l-yoom al-saabi'.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sammo al-akil al-yanzil min al-sama da manna.Hi misil iyaal al-kussubarra wa loonha abyad wa ta'amha misil ka'ak be asal.
Wa Muusa gaal-:-Daahu amur Allah.Chiilu kooro malaan manna wa ahfadooh le zurriiyitku achaan humman yichiifu al-akil al-ana anteetah leeku fi l-sahara wakit maragtuku min balad Masir.
Wa Muusa gaal le Haaruun-:-Chiil jarr wa subb foogah kooro hana manna wa khuttah giddaam Allah.Wa yukuun mahfuud adiil wa yagood min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Wa Haaruun chaalah wa ba'adeen khattaah fi sanduug ma'a liihaan al-mu'aahada achaan yukuun mahfuud adiil misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yaakulu al-manna di le muddit 40 sana lahaddi wassalo fi huduud balad Kan'aan al-indaha sukkaan.
Al-wazin hana l-yoom daak usmah omar wa hu yisaawi uchur al-eefa.
Kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil rahalo min saharat Siin misil Allah amaraahum beyah wa zahafo chiyya chiyya lahaddi nazalo fi Rafidiim bakaan al-ma indah almi yacharbooh.
Fi l-bakaan da,humman gammo yaharju le Muusa wa gaalo-:-Antiina almi nacharbooh-! Wa Muusa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Maala taharjuuni-?Wa maala tijarrubu Allah-?
Wa l-cha'ab al-atach sawwaahum be ziyaada wa gammo yuluumu Muusa wa gaalo-:-Maala maragtina min Masir le taktulna aniina wa iyaalna wa bahaayimna be l-atach-?
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Muusa chaka le Allah wa gaal-:-Chunu nisawwi le l-cha'ab dool-?Faddal chiyya bas yarjumuuni.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi giddaam al-cha'ab wa chiil ma'aak waahidiin min chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil.Wa chiil fi iidak asaatak al-darabt beeha bahar al-Niil wa amchi
talgaani giddaamak fi l-hajar al-gaa'id fi jabal Huuriib.Adrub al-hajar da wa yamrug minnah almi le l-cha'ab yacharbo. Wa Muusa sawwa al-cheyy da giddaam chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil.
Wa samma al-bakaan da Massa wa Mariiba (ma'anaatah al-tajriba wa l-huraaj) achaan Bani Israa'iil harajooh le Muusa wa jarrabo Allah wa gaalo-:-Allah gaa'id ma'aana walla la-?
Askar al-Amaalikh jo wa haarabo Bani Israa'iil fi Rafidiim.
Wa Muusa gaal le raajil waahid min Bani Israa'iil al-usmah Yachuu'-:-Yalla-!Chiil rujaal wa amrug haarib leena al-Amaalikh-!Wa ambaakir,ana nagiif fi raas al-hajar wa asaat Allah fi iidi.
Wa Yachuu' macha le yihaarib al-Amaalikh misil Muusa gaalah leyah.Wa laakin Muusa wa Haaruun wa Huur tala'o foog fi raas al-hajar.
Wa wakit Muusa yarfa' iidah foog,Bani Israa'iil yakhalbu.Wa laakin wakit Muusa yidalli iidah,al-Amaalikh yakhalbu.
Wa wakit iideen Muusa bigo tugaal min al-aya,Haaruun wa Huur chaalo hajar wa khattooh tihtah wa hu ga'ad foogah.Wa ayyi waahid minhum lazam iid waahide hana Muusa.Wa khalaas,iideenah bigo saabtiin lahaddi l-harraay waga'at.
Wa be darb al-seef,Yachuu' annasar nasur kaamil fi askar al-Amaalikh.
Wa khalaas,Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Aktib kulla l-cheyy da fi kitaab achaan ma yinnasi.Wa khalli Yachuu' kula yasma'ah achaan ana nuguchch kulla l-Amaalikh min al-ard wa battaan naadum ma yihajji beehum.
Wa Muusa bana madbah wa sammaah Allah hu Raayti al-Marfuu'a.
Wa gaal-:-Al-Amaalikh rafa'o iideehum didd Allah.Wa hu yihaaribhum min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Yasruun raajil al-diin hana balad Midyaan wa hu nasiib Muusa.Wa simi' be kulla cheyy al-Rabb sawwaah le Muusa wa le cha'abah Bani Israa'iil wa kikkeef Allah maragaahum min balad Masir.
Awwal Muusa wadda martah Siffuura le nasiibah Yasruun wa hu khibilaaha.
Wa wadda ma'aaha iyaalha al-itneen.Al-bikir Muusa sammaah Girchuum (ma'anaatah ajnabi) achaan Muusa ajnabi fi l-balad.
Wa l-aakhar sammaah Ali'aazar (ma'anaatah Allah yafza') achaan Allah Rabb abuuh faza'ah wa najjaah min seef Fir'oon malik Masir.
Wa Yasruun nasiib Muusa chaal al-iyaal wa ammuhum wa maachi yiwaddiihum le Muusa fi l-sahara gariib le jabal Allah al-bakaan al-Muusa nazal foogah.
Wa Yasruun rassal khabar le nasiibah Muusa wa gaal-:-Daahuuni ana jaayi leek wa jaayib ma'aayi martak Siffuura wa iyaalha.
Wakit Yasruun wassal,Muusa marag laagaah wa barak giddaamah wa habbaah.Wa assaa'alo khabar aafiyithum wa ba'ad da,dakhalo al-kheema.
Wa Muusa hajja le nasiibah be kulla cheyy al-Allah sawwa didd Fir'oon malik Masir wa l-Masriyiin fi chaan Bani Israa'iil.Wa hajja leyah be kulla l-ta'ab al-ligooh fi l-derib wa kikkeef Allah najjaahum.
Wa Yasruun firih be kulla l-kheer al-Allah sawwaah le Bani Israa'iil wakit najjaahum min al-Masriyiin.
Wa hu gaal-:-Baarak Allah al-najjaaku min ubuudiiyit Fir'oon wa l-Masriyiin.
Wa hassa' ana irift kadar Allah akbar min kulla l-ilaahaat achaan hu wassaf gudurtah le l-naas al-zalamo Bani Israa'iil.
Khalaas,Yasruun nasiib Muusa gaddam dahiiye muharraga wa dahaaya aakhariin le l-Rabb.Wa Haaruun wa kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil jo le yaakulu ma'a nasiib Muusa giddaam al-Rabb.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taani,Muusa gaa'id yichaari' al-cha'ab wa humman waagfiin giddaamah min al-fajur lahaddi l-achiiye.
Wakit nasiibah Yasruun chaaf kulla cheyy al-Muusa gaa'id yisawwiih le l-cha'ab,gaal leyah-:-Chunu al-gaa'id tisawwiih le l-cha'ab da-?Maala inta wiheedak bas tagood tichaari'hum-?Wa maala humman kulluhum waagfiin giddaamak min al-fajur lahaddi l-achiiye-?
Wa Muusa radda le nasiibah wa gaal-:-Achaan al-cha'ab yaju leyi le nas'al leehum al-Rabb.
Wa kan induhum muchkila kula,humman yaju leyi le nisawwi leehum charii'a been al-waahid wa l-aakhar.Wa ni'arrifhum be gawaaniin al-Rabb wa wasiiyaatah.
Wa nasiib Muusa gaal leyah-:-Al-cheyy al-inta gaa'id tisawwiih da ma adiil-!
Inta gaa'id tita''ib nafsak wa tita''ib al-cha'ab kula ma'aak achaan al-cheyy da faat gudurtak.Wa inta wiheedak ma tagdar tisawwiih.
Wa hassa' da,asma' kalaami wa wasiiyti wa khalli al-Rabb yukuun ma'aak-!Gaddim su'aal al-cha'ab le l-Rabb achaan inta mumassil al-cha'ab giddaam Allah.
Wa allimhum al-gawaaniin wa l-wasaaya wa arrifhum al-derib al-waajib yichiiluuh wa l-cheyy al-waajib yisawwuuh.
Wa ba'ad da,a'azil min kulla l-cha'ab rujaal gaadriin wa khaayfiin min al-Rabb wa amiiniin wa ma yakhbalo al-rachwa.Wa khuttuhum mas'uuliin fi l-cha'ab.Waahidiin minhum yisawwu charii'a le alif naadum wa le miya wa le khamsiin wa la achara.
Wa khalliihum yichaaru'u al-cha'ab fi kulla wakit.Humman yichaaru'uuhum fi machaakilhum al-dugaag wa laakin machaakilhum al-kubaar kamaan yiwadduuhum leek inta.Wa da yikhaffif leek inta achaan humman kula yichiilu al-tagala ma'aak.
Wa kan tisawwi al-cheyy al-amarak beyah al-Rabb,misil da tagdar tilhammal mas'uuliiytak.Wa kulla l-cha'ab yigabbulu buyuuthum be l-salaam.
Wa Muusa simi' kalaam nasiibah wa sawwa kulla cheyy al-hu gaalah leyah.
Wa azal rujaal gaadriin min kulla Bani Israa'iil wa khattaahum mas'uuliin fi l-cha'ab.Wa waahidiin minhum yisawwu charii'a le alif naadum wa le miya wa le khamsiin wa la achara.
Wa gaa'idiin yichaaru'u al-cha'ab fi kulla wakit.Machaakilhum al-kubaar yigaddumuuhum le Muusa wa l-dugaag kamaan,humman bas yihilluuhum.
Wa khalaas,Muusa adda nasiibah Yasruun wa hu gabbal baladah.
Fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-taalit min marigiinhum min Masir,Bani Israa'iil saaro min Rafidiim wa wassalo fi saharat Siinaa'.Wa hinaak humman nazalo mugaabiliin al-jabal.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Muusa tala' fi l-jabal le yigaabil al-Rabb.Wa hu naadaah min raas al-jabal wa gaal leyah-:-Guul al-kalaam da le zurriiyit Yaakhuub.Khabbir Bani Israa'iil wa guul leehum-:
--Intu zaatku chiftu al-cheyy al-ana sawweetah fi Masir wa kikkeef ana chiltuku misil fi janaahe al-suguura wa jibtuku aleyi ana Allah.
Fi chaan da,kan intu tasma'o kalaami wa tikarrumu mu'aahadati,intu tabgo cha'abi halaali min kulla l-chu'uub hatta kan al-ard kullaha ke hinti kula.
Wa intu tabgo leyi mamlakat rujaal al-diin wa umma mukhassasa.- Da l-kalaam al-waajib tuguulah le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Muusa gabbal al-fariig wa tawwaali naadaahum le chuyuukh al-cha'ab wa kallamaahum be kulla l-kalaam al-Allah amarah beyah.
Fi l-bakaan da,kulla l-cha'ab raayhum bigi waahid wa gaalo-:-Kulla l-kalaam al-gaalah Allah,aniina nitabbuguuh-! Wa Muusa chaal radduhum le yiwaddiih le Allah.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Daahu ana nigaabilak fi sahaabaay mudallime achaan kulla l-cha'ab yasma'ooni wakit ana nikallim ma'aak.Wa be misil da,humman yi'aamunu beek daayman. Wa fi l-wakit da,Muusa hajja kalaam al-cha'ab le Allah.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Gabbil le l-cha'ab wa khassishum al-yoom wa ambaakir.Wa khalli yikhassulu khulgaanhum.
Wa yukuunu jaahiziin le l-yoom al-taalit achaan fi l-yoom da,ana Allah nanzil fi jabal Siinaa' giddaam kulla l-cha'ab.
Khutt huduud been al-cha'ab wa l-jabal wa guul leehum-:--Angar'u ma tatla'o fi l-jabal wa la tilammusuuh.Ayyi naadum al-yilammis al-jabal da,yaktuluuh.
Wa l-naadum da,naadum aakhar battaan ma yilammisah illa yarjumuuh walla yizarruguuh be nuchchaab.Kan bahiime walla naadum kula,ma yikhalluuh hayy.Wa laakin wakit sim'o daribiin al-buug,waahidiin minhum yagdaro yarkabo fi l-jabal.-
Wa Muusa nazal min al-jabal wa khassas al-cha'ab wa humman khassalo khulgaanhum.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Jahhuzu nufuusku le l-yoom al-taalit.Ma tarugdu ma'a awiinku fi l-mudda di.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit be fajur,al-cha'ab chaafo barraaga wa sim'o hiss hana ra'ad wa chaafo sahaabaay kabiire fi l-jabal wa sim'o daribiin chadiid hana buug.Fi l-bakaan da,kulla l-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi l-fariig rajafo.
Wa Muusa marag al-cha'ab barra min al-fariig le yigaabulu al-Rabb.Wa humman wagafo fi ga'ar al-jabal.
Wa kulla jabal Siinaa' mukhatta be dukhkhaan achaan Allah nazal foogah be naar.Al-dukhkhaan yatla' min al-jabal misil dukhkhaan al-furun wa kulla l-jabal rajaf be chidde.
Wa daribiin al-buug gaa'id yiziid.Wakit Muusa gaa'id yikallim ma'a l-Rabb,hu yurudd leyah be hiss misil hiss al-ra'ad.
Wa Allah nazal fi raas jabal Siinaa' wa naada Muusa le yarkab fi raas al-jabal.Wa Muusa rikib.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Anzil wa hazzir al-cha'ab achaan ma yufuutu al-huduud le yaju yichiifuuni.Kan humman faato al-huduud,katiir minhum yumuutu.
Wa hatta kan rujaal al-diin dawwaro yigarrubu leyi kula,khalli yikhassusu nufuushum achaan ana Allah ma nadrubhum.
Wa Muusa gaal le Allah-:-Al-cha'ab ma yagdaro yatla'o fi jabal Siinaa' achaan inta zaatak bas hazzartina wa gult nukhuttu huduud ambeenna aniina wa l-jabal wa naj'alooh mukhaddas.
Wa Allah radda leyah wa gaal-:-Anzil wa battaan atla' leyi inta wa Haaruun.Wa laakin rujaal al-diin wa l-cha'ab,khalli ma yufuutu al-huduud wa yigarrubu leyi wa be da,ana ma nadrubhum.
Wa Muusa nazal le l-cha'ab wa khabbaraahum.
Wa l-Rabb kallam kulla l-kalaam da wa gaal-:
Ana Allah Ilaahak bas maragtak min Masir balad al-ubuudiiye.
Ma ta'abud ilaahaat aakhariin illa ana.
Ma tasna' sanam fi ayyi hajim min al-achya al-gaa'idiin foog fi l-sama aw tihit fi l-ard aw fi lubb al-almi al-fi l-ard.
Wa ma tasjud giddaam al-asnaam dool wa la ta'abudhum achaan ana bas Allah Ilaahak.Ana Allah khayyuur ya'ni ma nidoor ta'abud ilaah aakhar.Wa ana ni'aakhib al-iyaal wa iyaal al-iyaal be zunuub abbahaathum lahaddi l-zurriiye al-taalta wa l-raab'e kan humman yakrahooni.
Wa laakin ana nisawwi al-kheer le aalaaf al-zurriiyaat al-yihibbuuni wa yitabbugu wasiiyaati.
Ma tahlif be usmi ana Allah Ilaahak be kidib achaan al-yahlif be usmi be kidib,ana Allah ma naj'alah bari.
Azzakkar yoom al-sabt wa aj'alah yoom mukhaddas.
Inta takhdim le muddit sitte yoom wa tikammil kulla khidimtak.
Wa laakin al-yoom al-saabi' hu sabt leyi ana Allah Ilaahak.Fi l-yoom da,ma takhdim ayyi cheyy wa la inta wa la awlaadak wa la banaatak wa la abiidak wa la khadiimak wa la bahaaymak wa la l-ajaanib al-gaa'idiin ma'aak fi hillitak.
Achaan fi sitte yoom,Allah khalag al-samaawaat wa l-ard wa l-buhuur wa kulla cheyy al-fiihum.Wa laakin hu ma khadam fi l-yoom al-saabi'.Achaan da,hu baarak al-yoom al-saabi' wa ja'alah mukhaddas leyah.
Karrim ammak wa abuuk achaan umrak yabga tawiil fi l-ard al-nantiiha leek ana Allah Ilaahak.
Ma taktul dimme.
Ma tazna.
Ma tasrig.
Ma tachhad be kidib fi ayyi waahid min jiiraanak.
Ma titmanna beet jaarak wa la martah wa la abdah wa la khaadmah wa la toorah wa la humaarah wa la ayyi cheyy hanaayah.
Wakit kulla l-cha'ab sim'o hiss al-ra'ad wa chaafo al-barraaga wa sim'o hiss al-buug wa chaafo al-jabal gaa'id yidakhkhin,humman rajafo min al-khoof wa wagafo ba'iid.
Wa gaalo le Muusa-:-Hassa' da,inta bas kallim leena wa aniina nasma'ook.Achaan kan al-Rabb yikallim leena da,aniina numuutu-!
Wa Muusa gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Ma takhaafo-!Al-Rabb ja le yijarribku wa le takhaafo minnah wa ma tisawwu zanib.
Wa l-cha'ab wagafo ba'iid wa laakin Muusa garrab wa dakhal fi l-dalaam al-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah al-Rabb.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Intu be nufuusku chiftu kadar ana kallamt leeku min al-sama.
Ma tisawwu leeku ilaah aakhar ma'aayi wa la min fudda wa la min dahab.Abadan ma tisawwuuh.
Abnu leyi madbah min turaab le tigaddumu leyi foogah dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama min khanamku wa bagarku.Wa ana naji nibaarikku fi kulla bakaan al-tinaadu foogah usmi.
Kan tabnu leyi madbah hana hajar,ma tabnuuh be l-hajar al-magtuu' achaan al-hadiid al-tagta'ooh beyah ma yikhalliih yabga mukhaddas.
Ma tatla'o fi l-madbah be ataba achaan kan tala'tu,ooritku tigaabil al-madbah.-
Wa dool al-churuut al-tantiihum le Bani Israa'iil.
Kan chareetu abid Ibraani,khalli yakhdim leeku sitte sana wa fi l-sana al-saab'e,yukuun hurr wa da bala ma yikaffi leeku cheyy.
Wa kan jibtuuh wiheedah,tikhalluuh yamchi wiheedah.Wa kan jibtuuh be mara,tikhalluuh yamchi ma'aaha sawa.
Wa kan jibtuuh wa intu bas anteetuuh mara wa wildat leyah awlaad aw banaat,al-iyaal wa ammuhum yifaddulu leeku wa abuuhum kamaan yamchi wiheedah.
Wa laakin kan al-abid gaal-:--Ana niriid siidi wa marti wa iyaali wa ma nidoor nabga hurr--,
fi l-bakaan da siidah yichiil al-abid wa yiwaddiih giddaam al-Rabb wa yigarribah le l-baab aw le uud al-baab wa yigidd adaanah be mukhras.Wa yagood yakhdim leyah ila l-abad.
Wa kan raajil baa' bineeytah misil khaadim hi ma yatulguuha hurra misil al-raajil al-abid.
Wa kan al-bineeye di ma ajabat siidha al-charaaha le tabga leyah mara,hu ma yibii'ha le l-ajaanib achaan da misil hu khaanha.Khalli ahalha yafdooha.
Wa kan charaaha le yijawwizha le wileedah,da khalli yi'aamilha misil bineeytah.
Wa kan siidha akhad mara aakhara,khalli ma yangus akilha wa la lubaasha wa la leelitha.
Wa kan waahid min al-achya al-talaata dool nagas,hi tamchi hurra min duun tikaffi cheyy.
Wa kan naadum darab insaan wa katalah,waajib hu kula yaktuluuh.
Wa laakin kan katalah bala raayah wa l-cheyy da l-Rabb bas ja'alah leyah,khalli yamchi fi l-bakaan al-ana Allah nihaddidah le yalja' foogah.
Wa kan naadum yugumm be niiytah didd jaarah wa yaktulah be najaada,hu da yichiiluuh wa yaktuluuh hatta kan laja' fi madbahi kula.
Wa kan naadum darab ammah aw abuuh,waajib yaktuluuh.
Wa kan naadum khataf insaan wa baa'ah aw ligooh makruub fi beetah,al-khaatif da waajib yaktuluuh.
Wa kan naadum ayyar ammah aw abuuh,waajib yaktuluuh.
Kan rujaal itneen alhaarajo wa l-waahid darab al-aakhar be hajar aw be iidah wa ma katalah laakin hu ragad mardaan wa ma yagdar yugumm barra illa be asa,fi l-bakaan da al-naadum al-darab da,ma yi'aakhubuuh.Laakin waajib yikaffi le l-mardaan muddit al-ayyaam al-hu ragadaahum wa yikaffi al-ilaaj kula.
Wa kan naadum darab abdah aw khaadmah be asa wa katalah,waajib yi'aakhubuuh.
Laakin kan ga'ad yoom aw yoomeen hatta maat,al-siid ma yi'aakhubuuh achaan al-abid aw al-khaadim da hu charaah be gursah.
Wa kan naaseen addaawaso wa waga'o foog mara khalbaane wa hi ramat sakhiirha laakin hi aafe,fi l-bakaan da al-naadum al-waga' foogha yikaffi al-diiye al-raajilha yatulbah minnah be muwaafagat al-gaadi.
Wa laakin kan al-mara di maatat aw hassat,sawwi hasab al-gaanuun al-buguul al-nafis be l-nafis
wa l-een be l-een wa l-sinn be l-sinn wa l-iid be l-iid wa l-rijil be l-rijil
wa l-haraag be l-haraag wa l-jiraah be l-jiraah wa l-darbe be l-darbe.
Wa kan naadum salla een abdah aw khaadmah,waajib yikhalliih yamchi hurr achaan hu salla eenah.
Wa kan kasar sinn abdah aw khaadmah,waajib yikhalliih yamchi hurr achaan hu kasar sinnah.
Wa kan toor ta'an raajil aw mara wa katalah,al-toor da waajib yarjumuuh.Wa lahamah kula ma yaakuluuh.Wa siid al-toor da yukuun bari.
Wa laakin kan al-toor da awwal kula ma'ruuf yat'an al-naas wa l-naas hazzaro siidah wa siidah ma hafadah wa hu ta'an raajil aw mara wa katalah,fi l-bakaan da al-toor yarjumuuh wa siidah kula waajib yaktuluuh.
Wa kan talabo minnah diiye le yafda beeha nafsah,waajib yanti al-diiye al-talabooha minnah.
Wa nafs al-hukum da yahkumu beyah le l-toor al-ta'an bineeye aw wileed.
Wa kan al-toor ta'an abid aw khaadim,siidah yikaffi le siid al-abid aw al-khaadim 30 hajar fudda wa l-toor da,yarjumuuh.
Wa kan naadum fakka biir aw nakat biir wa khallaaha faathe wa waga' foogha toor aw humaar,
siid al-biir da yikaffi taman al-toor aw al-humaar le siidah.Wa siid al-biir kamaan yichiil al-bahiime al-mayte.
Kan toor ta'an toor hana naadum aakhar wa katalah,siyaad al-tiiraan al-itneen dool yibii'u al-toor al-hayy wa yilgaasamo tamanah wa l-toor al-mayyit kula yilgaasamooh.
Wa laakin kan al-toor da awwal ma'ruuf yat'an wa siidah ma hafadah adiil,fi l-bakaan da siid al-toor al-ta'an yikaffi al-toor.Wa hu yichiil al-toor al-mayyit.
Wa kan naadum sarag toor aw kharuuf wa dabahah aw baa'ah,hu yikaffi al-toor khamsa tiiraan wa l-kharuuf arba'a khurfaan.
Wa kan be leel sarraag ja yasrig wa naadum darabah wa katalah,da ma yinhasib jariimit katil.
Illa kan al-sirge wa l-katil kaano ba'ad taluu' al-harraay,da yinhasib jariimit katil.Wa ayyi sarraag kan karabooh,yikaffi hukum le l-naadum al-hu sarag minnah.Wa kan ma indah cheyy yikaffi beyah,yibii'uuh.
Wa kan ligo fi bakaan al-sarraag bahiime hayye al-hu sirigaaha,misil toor aw humaar aw khanamaay,hu yikaffiiha marrateen.
Wa kan naadum sarrah bahaaymah fi zere' aw jineenit inab hana jaarah wa khalla bahaaymah akaloohum,hu waajib yikaffi siidhum min ahsan intaaj hana zer'ah aw jineentah.
Wa kan naadum harrag hariige wa l-naar di lihgat al-zariibe wa akalat kiimaan al-gameh aw ganaadiil al-lissaa' ma gata'oohum min al-zere',al-naadum da yikaffi kulla l-khasaara di le siid al-zere'.
Wa kan naadum khatta amaana hint fudda aw achya aakhariin bakaan jaarah wa l-amaana di sirgooha,al-sarraag da kan ligooh yikaffiiha marrateen.
Wa kan al-sarraag ma ligooh,al-naadum al-dammo fi bakaanah al-amaana yiwadduuh giddaam al-Rabb le yichiifu kan hu bas akal al-amaana di.
Wa kan naaseen alkhaalato fi cheyy misil toor aw humaar aw khanamaay aw khalag aw ayyi cheyy aakhar al-humman alkhaalato foogah,al-naaseen dool waajib yamchu giddaam al-Rabb.Wa l-naadum al-ramatah al-charii'a da yikaffi marrateen le l-aakhar.
Wa kan naadum wadda toor aw khanamaay aw humaar aw bahiime aakhara misil amaana le jaarah wa l-bahiime di maatat aw an'adarat aw sirgooha wa naadum ma chaafha,
khalaas al-naadum al-khatto fi bakaanah al-bahiime yahlif be usum Allah kadar hu ma sabbab al-khasaara al-bigat fi l-bahiime di.Fi l-haala di,hu ma yikaffi cheyy le siid al-bahiime.Wa siid al-bahiime waajib yikhassid be l-haliife di.
Wa kan al-bahiime di sirgooha be sabab hu ma fakkar leeha,fi l-haala di hu yikaffi siidha.
Wa kan al-bahiime akalaaha haywaan,hu waajib yijiib danabha aw adaanha.Fi l-haala di,hu ma yikaffi cheyy.
Wa kan naadum attal bahiime min jaarah wa ba'adeen al-bahiime di an'adarat aw maatat wa siidha ma fiih,al-naadum al-attalaaha da yikaffiiha.
Wa laakin kan siidha haadir,al-naadum al-attalaaha ma yikaffi cheyy.Wa kan al-bahiime di mu'ajjara,al-ujra tikhatti al-khasaara di.
Wa kan raajil garrab le bineeye udriiye al-lissaa' ma karabo raasha wa hu lamma ma'aaha wa tallafha,hu waajib yikaffi jeebha wa yaakhudha.
Wa kan abu al-bitt aba kula,al-raajil waajib yikaffi jeeb al-banaat al-udriiyaat.
Ma tikhallu al-saahira ti'iich.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yargud ma'a bahiime,waajib yaktuluuh.
Wa kan naadum khalla Allah wa gaddam dahiiye le ilaah aakhar,waajib yidammuruuh.
Ma tazulmu al-khariib wa la tidaayuguuh achaan awwal intu kula khariibiin fi Masir.
Ma tazulmu al-araamil aw al-ataama.
Wa kan intu zalamtuuhum,ana nasma' siraakhhum wakit humman yasrakho leyi.
Wa nakhdab leeku chadiid wa naktulku be l-seef.Wa awiinku kula yabgo araamil wa iyaalku kula yabgo ataama.
Kan naadum waahid min cha'abi miskiin wa gaa'id ma'aak wa dayyantah maal,ma tarbah foogah ya'ni ma tidayyinah be riba.
Wa kan chilt khalag hana naadum fi deen,waajib tigabbilah leyah gubbaal al-harraay ma taga'.
Achaan da bas al-khalag al-waahid al-hu yilkhatta beyah.Wa kan ma gabbaltah leyah,hu yunuum be chunu-?Wa kan sarakh leyi,ana nasma'ah achaan ana hanuun.
Ma ti'ayyirni ana al-Rabb wa ma tal'an kabiir cha'abak.
Ma ti'akhkhir leyi gaddimiin awwal asiir al-inab wa dihin al-zaytuun.Wa gaddim leyi wileedak al-bikir kula.
Wa battaan kula,gaddim leyi wald al-bikir min bagarak wa khanamak.Khalli ayyi wald bikir yagood sab'a yoom ma'a ammah wa fi l-yoom al-taamin,gaddimah leyi.
Waajib intu tabgo naas mukhassasiin leyi.Wa be da,ma taakulu fadle hana bahiime al-katalaaha haywaan.Laakin antuuha le l-kulaab.
Ma tangul al-guwaale been al-naas.Ma tachhad be kidib achaan tansur al-khaati.
Ma ti'aawin al-katiiriin kan humman yidooru yisawwu cheyy fasil.Wa fi l-charii'a,ma titallif chahaadtak le tistafig ma'a l-katiiriin.
Wa ma ti'aawin al-miskiin kula fi l-charii'a achaan hu miskiin bas.
Wa kan ligiit toor hana aduuk aw humaarah muwaddir,waddiih leyah.
Wa kan chift humaar hana naadum al-yakrahak waagi' tihit himlah,ma tikhalliih wa tamchi.Wa laakin arfa'ah ma'aayah.
Ma tazlum al-miskiin wa tidangis al-charii'a.
Ma tatham insaan be kidib.Wa ma tahkim be l-moot le l-insaan al-bari aw al-saalih.Al-naadum al-fasil al-sawwa misil da,ana Allah ma naj'alah saalih.
Ma takhbal rachwa achaan hi ta'ami uyuun al-masaa'iil wa ti'awwij kalaam al-saalihiin.
Ma tazlum al-khariib.Intu ta'arfu iichit al-khariib achaan intu kula awwal ichtu khariibiin fi Masir.
Fi sitte sana,ahrit zer'ak wa agta' intaajah.
Wa fi l-sana al-saab'e,khalli yubuur wa yugumm bandar.Wa min al-bandar da,yaakulu masaakiin cha'abak.Wa l-faddal kamaan,yaakuluuh haywaanaat al-kadaade.Wa tisawwi nafs al-cheyy fi zer'ak hana l-inab wa l-zaytuun.
Akhdim muddit sitte yoom.Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' kamaan,anjamma achaan toorak wa humaarak kula yinjammo wa l-khariib al-gaa'id ma'aak wa abdak kula yinjammo.
Sawwu kulla cheyy al-gultah leeku.Wa ma tihajju be usum ilaah aakhar wa la yinsami' fi khuchuumku.
Ayyudu leyi talaata marraat fi l-sana.
Ayyudu iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara.Fi sab'a yoom,taakulu khubza bala tawwaara misil ana amartuku.Wa da fi wakit al-muhaddad fi chahar al-Ganaadiil al-chahar al-intu maragtu beyah min balad Masir.Ma taju giddaami iideeku yaabsiin.
Wa ba'ad da,ayyudu iid al-Gati' wa gaddumu leyi awwal intaaj al-gata'tuuh min ziraa'itku al-teerabtuuhum.Wa ba'ad da,ayyudu iid al-Lammiin fi kumaalit al-sana wakit intu tilimmu foogah intaaj ziraa'itku.
Wa talaata marraat fi l-sana,ayyi dakar minku yaji giddaami ana Allah al-Rabb le ya'abudni.
Ma tigaddumu leyi damm al-dahiiye ma'a ayyi cheyy al-indah tawwaara.Wa ma tikhallu chaham dahiiyat al-iid yargud lahaddi fajur.
Wa gaddumu awwal intaaj ziraa'itku le beet Allah Ilaahku.-Wa ma tirakkubu laham al-sakhal fi laban ammah.
Chiifu,ana nirassil malak yamchi giddaamku fi l-derib wa yahfadku.Wa yiwaddiiku fi l-bakaan al-ana jahhaztah leeku.
Fakkuru foogah wa taabu'u kalaamah wa ma ta'asooh achaan hu ma yisaamih isyaanku achaan hu yimassilni.
Wa laakin kan titii'uuh wa tisawwu kulla cheyy hasab kalaami,ana nabga adu le udwaanku wa nidaayig al-yidaayuguuku.
Wa malaki yamchi giddaamku wa yiwaddiiku fi balad al-Amuuriyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin wa nidammirhum.
Ma tasjudu le ilaahaathum wa la ta'abuduuhum wa la tisawwu al-cheyy al-humman gaa'idiin yisawwuuh.Laakin armu wa dammuru al-hujaar al-khazzoohum le l-ibaada.
A'abuduuni ana Allah Ilaahku wa nibaarik akilku wa charaabku wa namrug al-marad min usutku.
Wa fi baladku,ma fi ayyi mara al-tabga aagre wa la tarmi sakhiirha.Wa nantiiku umur tawiil.
Wa nirassil al-khoof le kulli umma al-tagiif giddaamku achaan tibarjil wa tajri minku.
Wa nirassil al-nahale giddaamku le tatrudhum le l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hittiyiin.
Laakin ana ma natrudhum marra waahid fi sana waahide achaan al-balad ma tabga kharaab wa haywaanaat al-kadaade yabgo katiiriin wa yugummu didduku.
Ana natrudhum chiyya chiyya lahaddi intu tabgo katiiriin wa tawrusu al-balad.
Wa nisawwi huduudku min al-bahar al-Ahmar lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad wa min al-sahara lahaddi bahar al-Furaat.Nidiss fi iideeku sukkaan al-balad wa taturduuhum giddaamku.
Ma tisawwu alaakha ma'aahum wa la ma'a ilaahaathum.
Ma tikhalluuhum yaskunu fi baladku ma'aaku achaan yilizzuuku tisawwu zanib giddaami.Achaan kan intu abadtu ilaahaathum,da yabga leeku charak.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Atla'o leyi fi l-jabal,inta wa Haaruun wa awlaadah Nadaab wa Abiihu wa 70 chuyuukh min Bani Israa'iil.Wa asjudu min ba'iid.
Wa khalli inta Muusa wiheedak bas taji leyi ana Allah.Wa kan le l-aakhariin kamaan,ma yaju gariib.Wa khalli al-cha'ab ma yatla'o ma'aak.
Khalaas,Muusa gabbal kallam al-cha'ab be kulla kalaam Allah wa gawaaniinah.Wa kulla l-cha'ab raddo leyah be hiss waahid wa gaalo-:-Aniina nisawwu kulla cheyy hasab kalaam Allah.
Muusa katab kulla kalaam Allah.Wa ambaakir fajur,Muusa bakkar wa bana madbah fi ga'ar al-jabal.Wa battaan khazza 12 hajar ale hasab adad gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Muusa rassal subyaan min Bani Israa'iil wa humman gaddamo le Allah dahiiye muharraga wa dabaho tiiraan dahaaya salaama.
Wa Muusa sabba nuss al-damm fi mawaa'iin.Wa nussah al-aakhar kamaan,rachcha beyah al-madbah.
Wa chaal kitaab al-mu'aahada al-hu katabah wa garaah le l-cha'ab.Wa humman gaalo-:-Aniina nisawwu kulla cheyy hasab kalaam Allah wa nitii'uuh.
Wa Muusa chaal al-faddal min al-damm wa rachcha beyah al-cha'ab wa gaal-:-Daahu damm al-mu'aahada al-Allah sawwaaha ma'aaku hasab kulla kalaamah al-gaalah leeku.
Muusa wa Haaruun wa awlaadah Nadaab wa Abiihu wa 70 chuyuukh min Bani Israa'iil tala'o al-jabal.
Wa chaafo Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa tihtah cheyy misil ard min al-yaakhuut al-akhdar wa da chaffaaf misil al-sama.
Wa laakin al-Rabb ma madda iidah le yahlik kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil.Humman chaafo al-Rabb wa ba'ad da,akalo wa chirbo giddaamah.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Atla' leyi fi raas al-jabal wa agood fi l-bakaan da.Wa nantiik liihaan itneen hana hajar al-ana katabt fooghum al-wasaaya wa l-gawaaniin le l-naas yil'allamoohum.
Wa Muusa chaal ma'aayah musaa'idah Yachuu' wa tala'o fi jabal Allah.
Wa gabul ma yatla'o,Muusa gaal le chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil-:-Arjoona hini lahaddi nigabbulu leeku.Daahu Haaruun wa Huur gaa'idiin ma'aaku.Kan induku muchkila,amchu leehum.
Wa khalaas,Muusa tala' al-jabal wa l-sahaabaay saddat al-jabal marra waahid.
Wa majd Allah ga'ad fi jabal Siinaa'.Fi muddit sitte yoom,al-sahaabaay saddat al-jabal.Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi',Allah naada Muusa min ust al-sahaabaay.
Wa fi uyuun Bani Israa'iil,majd Allah anchaaf misil al-naar al-gaa'ide taakul fi raas al-jabal.
Wa Muusa dakhal fi ust al-sahaabaay wa tala' battaan foog fi l-jabal.Wa ga'ad fi raas al-jabal 40 nahaar wa 40 leele.
Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Ayyi naadum minku al-galbah kariim khalli yijiib leyi hadiiye.
Wa dool al-hadaaya al-intu takhbaloohum min Bani Israa'iil.Humman dahab wa fudda wa nahaas
wa gumaach zahri wa garadi wa ahmarwa gumaach kattaan wa suuf inze
wa firaaw kubaach madbuukhiin wa mulawwaniin be loon ahmarwa farwa hint ijil al-baharwa hatab hana chadar al-sunt
wa dihin le l-faanuuswa itir le dihin al-masahaanwa itir le l-bakhuur al-mu'attar
wa hajar al-usmah agiigwa hujaar aakhariin khaaliyiin le yijammulu beehum al-farmala wa l-sideeriiye hana kabiir rujaal al-diin.
--Abnu leyi bakaan mukhaddas le nagood fi usutku.
Wa asna'o al-kheema di wa mu'iddaatha sawa sawa min al-nizaam al-ana niwassifah leek.
--Asna' sanduug min khachab al-sunt tuulah duraa'een wa nuss wa urdah duraa' wa nuss wa tuulah foog kula duraa' wa nuss.
Wa amsahah be dahab saafi min daakhal lahaddi barra.Wa darris khachmah kula be dahab.
Wa asna' arba'a khawaatim hana dahab wa lassighum fi l-koonyaat al-arba'a hana l-sanduug.Wa da itneen fi l-nuss al-waahid wa itneen fi l-nuss al-aakhar.
Wa addil iidaan itneen min hatab al-sunt wa amsahhum be dahab.
Wa dakhkhilhum fi l-khawaatim al-arba'a al-mulassagiin fi l-sanduug achaan yichiiluuh beehum.
Wa l-iidaan dool khalliihum yagoodu fi l-khawaatim,ma yisilluuhum minhum abadan.
Wa khutt fi lubb al-sanduug al-liihaan al-fooghum kalimaat al-mu'aahada al-ana nantiihum leek.
--Wa asna' sidaade le l-sanduug min dahab saafi.Tuul al-sidaade di yukuun duraa'een wa nuss wa urdaha duraa' wa nuss.
Asna' min al-dahab makhluugiin samaawiyiin itneen wa khuttuhum ayyi waahid fi taraf al-sidaade mulgaabiliin.
Khutt ayyi waahid fi taraf al-sidaade ya'ni al-waahid be hini wa l-aakhar be hinaak mulassagiin fi l-sidaade.
Wa l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool mumattitiin janaaheehum giddaam wa mukhattiyiin beehum al-sidaade.Ayyi waahid mugaabil al-aakhar wa mudangiriin ale l-sidaade.
--Wa khutt al-sidaade fi khachum al-sanduug.Wa fi daakhal al-sanduug,khutt al-liihaan al-fooghum kalimaat al-mu'aahada al-ana nantiihum leek.
Wa hinaak foog le sidaadit al-sanduug ambeen al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin al-itneen,ana nigaabilak.Wa nikallim leek be kulla l-awaamir al-nantiihum le Bani Israa'iil.
--Asna' tarabeeza be khachab al-sunt.Tuulha duraa'een wa urdaha duraa' wa tuulha foog duraa' wa nuss.
Wa amsahha be dahab saafi.Wa darris khachumha be dahab.
Wa hawwig khachum al-tarabeeza be hatab urdah yukuun arba'a usba' wa darrisah be dahab.
Wa asna' arba'a khawaatim min dahab wa lassighum fi l-koonyaat al-arba'a hana l-tarabeeza.Kulla khaatim yagood muwaafig le rijil waahide min al-tarabeeza.
Wa l-khawaatim yabgo gariibiin le khachum al-tarabeeza.Wa be da,yagdaro yidissu fooghum iidaan itneen wa yichiilu beehum al-tarabeeza.
Wa l-iidaan dool sawwiihum be hatab al-sunt wa amsahhum be dahab le yichiilu beehum al-tarabeeza.
Wa l-tarabeeza di sawwi leeha sufar wa kharaariif wa abaariig wa kiisaan min dahab saafi al-yista'maloohum wakit yigaddumu hadaaya charaab.
Wa khutt fi l-tarabeeza al-khubza al-yigaddumuuha leyi.Wa hi tukuun giddaami daayman.
--Wa asna' leyi faanuus min dahab saafi.Al-faanuus da wa ga'arah wa saagah wa kiyeesaatah wa dakaarmah wa zuhuurah kulla ke sun'a waahide bas.
Wa yilfarra' min saag al-faanuus da sitte furuu',talaata furuu' min nuss waahid wa talaata min nuss aakhar.
Wa fi ayyi firi',sawwi talaata kiyeesaat yichaabuhu zahrat al-looz be dukrumitha wa waragha.Wa da fi kulla firi' min al-furuu' al-sitte.
Wa fi saag al-faanuus kula,sawwi arba'a kiyeesaat yichaabuhu zahrat al-looz be dukrumitha wa waragha.
Wa tihit ayyi machbak hana furuu' itneen,sawwi dukrume.
Wa kulla l-dakaarim wa l-furuu' yukuunu madguugiin sun'a waahide bas min dahab saafi.
Wa sawwi sab'a tiyeesaat le l-naar wa khuttuhum fi l-faanuus da achaan wakit yiwallu'uuhum,niiraanhum yidawwu kulla l-bakaan al-giddaamhum.
Sawwi kalaaliib wa taffaayaat min dahab saafi.
Wa l-dahab al-saafi al-tasna' beyah al-faanuus wa kulla mu'iddaatah,waznah yabga 34 kiilo.
Wa khalaas,chiif wa asna' kulla cheyy hasab al-nizaam al-ana wassaftah leek fi l-jabal da.
--Wa sawwi al-kheema be achara git'e min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa khayyit fi l-gita' dool suwar makhluugiin samaawiyiin be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa tuul al-gita' dool yukuun sawa sawa.Ayyi waahide tukuun indaha 28 duraa' wa urdaha 4 duraa'.
Wa l-gita' dool,khamsa yilimmuuhum sawa fi majmuu'a waahide wa l-khamsa al-aakhariin kula yilimmuuhum sawa.
Wa kachkich taraf al-khamsa be gumaach zahri wa taraf al-khamsa al-aakhariin kula kachkichah be nafs al-gumaach.
Sawwi 50 manaakhir fi l-majmuu'a al-awwal wa 50 manaakhir fi l-majmuu'a al-taaniye.Wa l-manaakhir dool yukuunu mulgaabiliin.
Wa sawwi 50 fangar hana dahab wa achbik beyah al-manaakhir kulli waahide ma'a l-aakhara.Wa be da,al-majmuu'teen yabgo kheema waahide.
--Wa sawwi al-khita al-awwal min 11 git'e matruuriin be suuf inze.Wa khuttah be foog le l-kheema.
Wa tuul al-gita' dool yukuunu sawa sawa.Wa tuul al-waahide 30 duraa' wa urdaha 4 duraa'.
Wa l-gita' dool,khamsa yilimmuuhum sawa wa l-sitte al-aakhariin kula yilimmuuhum sawa.Wa l-git'e al-saadse di tatbugha foog khachum al-kheema.
Wa sawwi 50 manaakhir fi nuss kulli waahide min al-majmuu'teen.
Wa sawwi 50 fangar min nahaas wa achbik beyah al-manaakhir kulli waahide ma'a l-aakhara.Wa be da,al-majmuu'teen yabgo khita waahid.
Wa l-khita da,nussah al-faayit fi l-tuul,dalliih be wara le l-kheema.
Wa nussah al-faayit fi l-urd,dalliih fi nuss al-kheema be duraa'.Wa be l-nuss al-aakhar hana l-kheema kula,dalliih be duraa'.Wa be da,al-khita yikhatti al-kheema marra waahid.
--Wa sawwi al-khita al-taani be firaaw kubaach madbuukhiin wa mulawwaniin be loon ahmar.Wa l-khita al-taalit da,sawwiih be firaaw ijil al-bahar.
--Khuzz khachab al-sunt wa russah le tabni beyah kheemat al-ibaada.
Ayyi waahid min al-khachab da tuulah yukuun 10 duraa' wa urdah yukuun duraa' wa nuss.
Le ayyi khachaba sawwi rijle itneen al-yagdaro yisabbutuuha ma'a l-aakhariin.Kulla l-khachab da sawwiih misil da.
Wa addil 20 khachab fi l-nuss al-junuubi hana l-kheema.
Wa sawwi 40 asaas hana fudda min tihit le l-ichriin khachab.Le kulli khachaba waahide,sawwi asaas itneen tihit rijileenha al-itneen.
Wa 20 khachab yukuunu fi l-nuss al-munchaakhi hana l-kheema.
Wa dool kula,sawwi leehum 40 asaas hana fudda min tihit.Le kulli khachaba waahide sawwi asaas itneen tihit rijileenha al-itneen.
Wa 6 khachab yukuunu fi l-nuss al-warraani hana l-kheema al-mugaabil al-kharib.
Wa sawwi khachab itneen le l-koonyaat al-wara.
Wa l-khachab al-itneen dool mulassagiin min tihit lahaddi foog.Wa be foog,yisabbutuuhum be khaatim.Wa da yabga fi l-koonyaat al-itneen al-gaa'idiin be wara.
Wa be da,yukuun 8 khachab wa induhum 16 asaas hana fudda.Wa tihit kulli khachaba,fi asaas itneen.
--Wa sawwi 5 maraadiis min khachab al-sunt le l-nuss al-junuubi.
Wa sawwi 5 aakhariin le l-nuss al-munchaakhi hana l-kheema.Wa battaan sawwi 5 le nussaha al-warraani al-mugaabil al-kharib.
Wa l-murdaas al-ustaani al-tawiil al-gaa'id fi gismit al-khachab yamchi min tarafha le tarafha.
Wa amsah kulla l-khachab da be dahab wa asna' khawaatim hana dahab al-tidiss fooghum al-maraadiis.Wa amsah al-maraadiis kula be dahab.
--Wa sawwi al-kheema di hasab al-nizaam al-ana wassaftah leek fi l-jabal da.
--Wa sawwi sitaar min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa khayyit foogah suwar makhluugiin samaawiyiin be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa ti'alligah fi manaakhir hana dahab al-gaa'idiin fi arba'a amuud min hatab al-sunt al-mamsuuhiin be dahab.Wa l-amad dool musabbatiin fi arba'a asaas hana fudda.
Wa allig al-sitaar da be fangar wa khutt al-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada khaadi le l-sitaar.Wa be da,al-sitaar yafsul been al-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.
--Wa sidd al-sanduug da be sidaadtah wa khuttah fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa barra min al-sitaar fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas,khutt al-tarabeeza fi l-nuss al-munchaakhi hana l-kheema wa khutt al-faanuus mugaabilha fi l-nuss al-junuubi.
--Wa sawwi sitaar le baab al-kheema min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa le l-sitaar sawwi leyah khamsa amuud hana hatab al-sunt al-mamsuuhiin be dahab.Wa sawwi leehum manaakhir hana dahab wa le l-amad dool sawwi leehum khamsa asaas min nahaas.
--Wa sawwi madbah murabba' min khachab al-sunt.Tuulah 5 duraa' wa urdah 5 duraa' wa tuulah foog kula 3 duraa'.
Wa sawwi arba'a guruun fi koonyaatah al-arba'a.Wa l-madbah wa l-guruun yukuunu sun'a waahide bas.Wa amsahah be nahaas.
Wa asna' kulla mu'iddaatah min nahaas.Humman al-mawaa'iin al-yarfa'o beehum al-rumaad al-mudahhan wa l-feelaat wa l-kiisaan al-yuruchchu beehum al-damm wa l-hadiidaay al-yisillu beeha al-laham wa khammaamaat al-naar.
--Wa asna' le l-madbah tachaacha min nahaas indaha arba'a khawaatim kula min nahaas fi chawaaribha al-arba'a.
Wa khutt al-tachaacha di fi lubb al-madbah wa be da,tukuun fi gismit al-madbah.
Wa sawwi le l-madbah iidaan itneen min hatab al-sunt wa amsahhum be nahaas.
Wa l-iidaan dool dissuhum fi l-khawaatim al-gaa'idiin fi jawaanib al-madbah le yichiiluuh beehum.
Wa l-madbah yukuun mujawwaf ya'ni indah lubb.Wa asna'ah be khachab misil ana wassaftah leek fi l-jabal da.
--Wa sawwi fadaay le l-kheema.Wa be l-nuss al-junuubi,tuulha yukuun 100 duraa' wa indaha sataayir min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil.
Wa indaha 20 amuud wa 20 asaas min nahaas.Wa l-manaakhir wa l-rubaat al-gaa'idiin fi l-amad dool min fudda.
Wa l-nuss al-munchaakhi kula tuulah 100 duraa' wa indah sataayir wa 20 amuud wa 20 asaas min nahaas.Wa l-manaakhir wa l-rubaat al-gaa'idiin fi l-amad dool min fudda.
Laakin al-nuss al-kharbaani min al-fadaay tuulah 50 duraa' wa indah sataayir wa 10 amuud wa 10 asaas.
Wa l-nuss al-sabhaani ale l-bakaan al-harraay tatla',hu kula tuulah 50 duraa'.
--Wa fi l-nuss al-zeenaay hana l-baab,fiyah sataayir tuulhum 15 duraa' wa indah 3 amuud wa 3 asaas.
Wa fi l-nuss al-israay hana l-baab,fiyah sataayir tuulhum 15 duraa' wa indah 3 amuud wa 3 asaas.
Wa be da,al-baab al-yadkhulu beyah al-fadaay indah sitaar tuulah 20 duraa' min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.Wa indah 4 amuud wa 4 asaas.
Kulla l-amad al-muhawwigiin al-fadaay yukuunu fooghum rubaat wa manaakhir min fudda.Wa induhum asaas min nahaas.
Wa tuul al-fadaay yabga 100 duraa' wa urdaha 50 duraa' wa tuulha foog 5 duraa'.Wa sataayirha min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil wa asaasha min nahaas.
Wa kulla l-mu'iddaat al-yista'maloohum fi l-kheema wa kulla l-wutaad hana l-kheema wa l-wutaad hana l-fadaay yabgo min nahaas.
--Wa aamur Bani Israa'iil yijiibu leek dihin hana zaytuun ma'suur wa musaffa le l-faanuus achaan deyyah yukuun muwalli' daayman.
Haaruun wa iyaalah yahfadooh muwalli' giddaam Allah fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' giddaam al-sitaar al-yidaarig al-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada.Wa deyy al-faanuus yukuun muwalli' min makhrib lahaddi fajur.Wa da yabga chart daayim le Bani Israa'iil min zurriiye le zurriiye.
--Chiil min Bani Israa'iil akhuuk Haaruun wa awlaadah Nadaab wa Abiihu wa Ali'aazar wa Itamaar le yabgo leyi rujaal diin.
Wa addil le akhuuk Haaruun khulgaan khaassiin al-yantuuh charaf wa ihtiraam.
Wa guul le kulla l-khayyaatiin al-ana anteethum khibra fi l-khidme di khalli yisawwu khulgaan le Haaruun.Wa hu yalbashum wakit yikhassusuuh le yabga leyi raajil diin.
Al-khulgaan al-yisawwuuhum humman al-sideeriiye wa l-farmala wa l-jallaabiiye wa l-jawwaaniiye wa l-kadmuul wa l-hizaam.Yisawwu khulgaan khaassiin le Haaruun akhuuk wa le iyaalah le yabgo leyi rujaal diin.
Wa l-khulgaan dool yisawwuuhum be gumaach hana kattaan al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa mujammaliin be dahab.
--Al-farmala yisawwuuha be gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa mujammala be dahab.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa tukuun indaha hubaal al-yisabbutuuha beehum fi l-kataafe.
Wa l-hizaam al-yarbutuuh kula yukuun min nafs al-sun'a min dahab wa gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.
--Chiil hujaar itneen min agiig wa anguch fooghum asaame awlaad Israa'iil al-atnaachar.
Hasab nizaam miilaadhum,aktib asaame al-sitte fi l-hajar al-waahid wa asaame al-sitte fi l-hajar al-taani.
Wa sayyaakhi ma'ruuf fi nagich al-khawaatim yanguch asaame awlaad Israa'iil fi l-hajareen dool.Wa tisabbithum fi halagateen min dahab.
Wa tukhuttuhum fi kataafe al-farmala le yabgo zikra le Bani Israa'iil.Wa Haaruun yichiil al-asaame dool fi kataafeeh misil zikra giddaam Allah.
Wa sawwi al-halagateen min dahab
wa silsilateen hana dahab saafi maftuuliin misil al-habil.Wa allighum fi l-halagateen.
--Sawwi sideeriiyit al-kharaar misil al-farmala min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa mujammala be dahab.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa tukuun murabba'a tuulha chibir wa urdaha kula chibir.Wa matbuuga marrateen misil jeeb.
Wa tijammilha be arba'a roog min al-hujaar al-khaaliyiin.Al-roog al-awwal indah agiig ahmar wa yaakhuut asfar wa zumurrud akhdar.
Wa l-roog al-taani indah marajaan ahmar wa yaakhuut akhdar wa maass.
Wa l-roog al-taalit indah fayruuz wa yaakhuut ahmar wa zaytuun.
Wa l-roog al-raabi' indah zabarjad wa agiig wa kharaz.---Wa kulla l-hujaar dool yukuunu murassasiin fi l-riigaan hana l-dahab.
Wa l-hujaar al-khaaliyiin dool fi adad gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-atnaachar.Ayyi usum gabiila manguuch fi hajar waahid misil nagich al-khawaatim.
--Wa sawwi le l-sideeriiye silsilateen min dahab saafi maftuuliin misil al-habil.
Wa sawwi battaan khawaatim itneen min dahab wa sabbithum fi koonyaat al-sideeriiye be foog.
Wa dakhkhil fi l-khawaatim dool al-silsilateen hana l-dahab.
Wa khachum al-aakhar hana l-silsilateen,dakhkhilah fi l-halagateen al-gaa'idiin fi kataafe al-farmala be giddaam.
Wa battaan sawwi khawaatim itneen min dahab fi koonyaat al-sideeriiye be tihit.Wa khuttuhum be daakhal ambeen al-sideeriiye wa l-farmala.
Wa battaan sawwi khawaatim itneen min dahab wa khuttuuhum fi kataafe al-farmala be tihit min giddaam gariib le hizaam al-farmala.
Wa arbut al-khawaatim al-itneen hana l-sideeriiye be l-khawaatim al-itneen hana l-farmala be habil zahri.Wa be da,al-sideeriiye tabga foog min al-hizaam wa gaa'ide saabte foog al-farmala ma tilharrak.
Wa be da,wakit Haaruun yadkhul fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas,yichiil asaame gabaayil Bani Israa'iil fi sadrah fi sideeriiyit al-kharaar achaan yabgo zikra daayme giddaam Allah.
Wa khutt al-Uriim wa l-Tummiim fi sideeriiyit al-kharaar achaan yukuunu fi sadur Haaruun wakit yadkhul giddaam Allah.Wa be da,Haaruun yichiilhum daayman fi sadrah giddaam Allah le ya'arif kharaaraat Allah le Bani Israa'iil.
--Wa khayyit jallaabiiye le l-farmala kullaha min gumaach zahri.
Wa l-jallaabiiye indaha gabbe makfuufa wa mudarrasa achaan al-gabbe ma tincharit.Wa yikhayyutuuha be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa khayyit fi daayir al-jallaabiiye rummaanaat masnuu'iin min gumaach zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa arbut jursaan min dahab ambeen al-rummaanaat.
Wa be da,yukuun rummaana wa jaras,rummaana wa jaras fi kulla daayir al-jallaabiiye.
Wa Haaruun yalbas al-jallaabiiye di wakit yakhdim giddaam Allah.Wa harakat al-jursaan tinsami' wakit hu yadkhul fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas giddaam Allah wa wakit yamrug.Wa be da,hu ma yumuut.
--Wa sawwi hafiide min dahab saafi wa anguch foogha al-kalaam al-buguul Khaass le Allah.
Wa arbutha be habil zahri fi raas al-kadmuul be giddaam.
Wa tagood fi jabhit Haaruun.Wa be da,hu yukuun al-mas'uul min al-khata al-yisawwuuh Bani Israa'iil wakit yigaddumu hadaayaahum al-mukhaddasiin.Al-hafiide di tagood daayman fi jabhit Haaruun achaan Allah yarda beehum.
--Wa khayyit jawwaaniiye min gumaach hana kattaan.Wa kadmuul kula min kattaan.Wa sawwi hizaam be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
--Wa khayyit jawwaaniiye wa hizaam wa kadmuul le ayyi wileed min awlaad Haaruun le tantiihum charaf wa ihtiraam.
Wa ba'ad tilabbis akhuuk Haaruun wa awlaadah al-khulgaan dool,amsahhumwa darrijhum wa khassishum le yabgo leyi rujaal diin.
Wa khayyit leehum saraawiil min gumaach hana kattaan le yasturu beehum oorithum.Al-saraawiil dool yikhattu al-sulub wa l-dawaarij.
Haaruun wa awlaadah yalbasoohum wakit yadkhulu fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa wakit yigarrubu le l-madbah le yakhdumu.Wa be da,ma yaznubu wa yumuutu.Wa da chart daayim le Haaruun wa zurriiytah al-taji min ba'adah.
--Daahu kikkeef tisawwi le tikhassis Haaruun wa awlaadah le yabgo leyi rujaal diin.Chiil toor wa kubchaan itneen al-ma induhum ayyi eeb.
Wa chiil dagiig hana gameh wa sawwi beyah khubza bala tawwaara wa ka'ak bala tawwaara al-tisawwiih be dihin wa kisaar mamsuuh be dihin.
Wa kulla l-khumaam da,subbah fi soosal wa gaddimah be l-soosal da ma'a l-toor wa l-kubchaan al-itneen.
Wa naadi Haaruun wa awlaadah yaju fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa barridhum.
Wa chiil al-khulgaan wa labbis Haaruun al-jawwaaniiye wa l-jallaabiiye wa l-farmala wa l-sideeriiye.Wa arbut al-farmala be l-hizaam.
Wa khutt al-kadmuul fi raasah wa sabbit foogah al-hafiide al-mukhassasa.
Wa chiil dihin al-masahaan wa subbah fi raasah wa amsahah.
Wa ba'ad da,jiib awlaadah wa labbishum jawwaaniiyaat.
Wa ayyi waahid,arbut sulbah be hizaam wa khutt leyah kadmuul.Wa misil da,darrij leyi Haaruun wa awlaadah.Wa khidmit rujaal al-diin tukuun leehum misil chart daayim.
--Wa battaan jiib al-toor giddaam kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa khalli Haaruun wa awlaadah yukhuttu iideehum fi raas al-toor da.
Wa adbah al-toor giddaam Allah fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa chiil min damm al-toor be usba'ak wa khuttah fi guruun al-madbah.Wa l-baagi min al-damm kamaan subbah fi ga'ar al-madbah.
Wa chiil kulla l-chaham al-mukhatti al-butuun wa nuss al-kibde wa l-kalaawe be chahamhum wa harrighum fi l-madbah.
Wa laakin laham al-toor wa farwitah wa ba'arah,harrighum barra min al-fariig achaan di dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib.
--Wa chiil waahid min al-kubchaan al-itneen wa khalli Haaruun wa awlaadah yukhuttu iideehum fi raasah.
Adbah al-kabich wa chiil dammah wa ruchchah fi kulla nawaayit al-madbah.
Wa gatti' laham al-kabich da dugaag dugaag wa khassil butuunah wa dalaafeeh wa khuttuhum ma'a l-raas wa l-gita' al-aakhariin.
Wa harrig kulla l-kabich da fi l-madbah achaan di dahiiye muharraga le Allah al-hu yarda be riihitha achaan hi hadiiye le Allah.
--Wa chiil al-kabich al-taani wa khalli Haaruun wa awlaadah yukhuttu iideehum fi raasah.
Adbah al-kabich wa chiil min dammah wa khuttah fi halamat al-adaan al-zeene hana Haaruun wa awlaadah.Wa khuttah fi asaabi'hum al-kubaar hana iideehum wa rijleehum al-zeenaayaat.Wa ruchch baagi al-damm fi nawaayit al-madbah.
Wa chiil min al-damm al-sabbeetah fi l-madbah wa dihin al-masahaan wa ruchchah fi Haaruun wa lubaasah wa fi awlaadah wa lubaashum.Wa be da,Haaruun wa awlaadah wa khulgaanhum yabgo mukhassasiin le Allah.
--Wa chiil min al-kabich da chaham al-danab wa l-chaham al-mukhatti al-butuun wa nuss al-kibde wa l-kalaawe be chahamhum wa l-gaayme al-zeene.Wa da kabich hana darrijiin.
Wa chiil min al-soosal al-gaa'id giddaam Allah khubza waahide wa ka'akaay al-sawwooha be dihin wa kisaaraay.
Wa khuttuhum fi iideen Haaruun wa awlaadah le yigaddumuuhum hadaaya marfuu'iin le Allah.
Wa battaan chiil al-hadaaya dool min iideehum wa harrighum fi l-madbah ma'a l-dahiiye al-muharraga le Allah al-hu yarda be riihitha achaan hi hadiiye le Allah.
Wa chiil zoor al-kabich hana darrijiin Haaruun wa gaddimah hadiiye marfuu'a le Allah.Wa da yabga hanaak inta.
--Wa min kabich al-darrijiin hana Haaruun wa awlaadah,khassis al-zoor wa l-gaayme al-gaddamtuhum hadiiye marfuu'a.Dool yukuunu le Haaruun wa awlaadah.
Al-laham da yabga hagg daayim le Haaruun wa awlaadah min kulla dahaaya al-salaama al-yadbahoohum Bani Israa'iil wa yigaddumuuhum hadiiye le Allah.
--Wa ahfado al-khulgaan al-khaassiin hana Haaruun achaan ayyi waahid min awlaadah al-yaji ba'adah yalbashum wakit yamsahooh wa yidarrujuuh.
Wa l-wileed al-yabga kabiir rujaal al-diin ba'ad Haaruun yalbashum sab'a ayyaam gabul ma yadkhul fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa yakhdim fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.
--Wa laakin al-laham al-yifaddil min kabich al-darrijiin,tichiilah wa tirakkibah fi bakaan mukhaddas.
Haaruun wa awlaadah yaakulu laham al-kabich da wa l-khubza al-gaa'ide fi l-soosal fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Humman yaakulu hadaaya al-kaffaara dool wakit yidarrujuuhum wa yikhassusuuhum.Naadum aakhar ke ma yaakul minhum achaan al-hadaaya dool mukhaddasiin.
Wa kan yifaddil cheyy min laham kabich al-darrijiin aw min al-khubza lahaddi ambaakir,ma yaakuluuh achaan da mukhaddas.Khalli yiharruguuh fi l-naar.
--Sawwi le Haaruun wa awlaadah misil ana amartak beyah.Wa muddit darrijiinhum tukuun sab'a yoom.
Wa gaddim kulla yoom toor dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib.Wa khassis al-madbah kula be dahiiyat al-kaffaara wa amsahah le yukuun mukhaddas.
Fi muddit sab'a yoom,tadbah dahiiyat al-kaffaara fi l-madbah wa tikhassisah.Wa be da,yukuun mukhaddas marra waahid.Wa kulla cheyy al-yilammis al-madbah yukuun mukhaddas.
--Daayman wa kulla yoom,gaddim fi l-madbah khurfaan itneen awlaad sana.
Al-kharuuf al-waahid,gaddimah be fajur wa l-aakhar be achiiye.
Wa ma'a l-kharuuf al-awwal,gaddim kooro hana dagiig mukhalbat be liitir hana dihin zaytuun ma'suur.Wa gaddim ma'aayah liitir hana khamar al-inab hadiiyat charaab.
Wa l-kharuuf al-taani,gaddimah be achiiye.Wa gaddim ma'aayah hadiiye hana dagiig wa hadiiyat charaab misil inta sawweetah be fajur.Wa hi hadiiye muharraga le Allah al-hu yarda be riihitha.
Min zurriiye le zurriiye,gaddumu daayman al-dahaaya al-muharragiin dool fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa' giddaam Allah.Wa da l-bakaan al-ana nigaabilak foogah le nikallimak.
Wa hinaak nigaabil Bani Israa'iil wa be gudrat majdi,al-bakaan da yabga mukhaddas.
Wa be da,nikhaddis kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa l-madbah.Wa nikhassis Haaruun wa awlaadah le yabgo leyi rujaal diin.
Wa naskun ma'a Bani Israa'iil wa nabga Ilaahhum.
Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahhum al-maragtuhum min balad Masir le naskun ma'aahum.Ana Allah Ilaahhum.
--Wa sawwi mukhbar min khachab al-sunt le tiharrig foogah al-bakhuur.
Wa l-mukhbar da yukuun murabba' tuulah duraa' wa urdah kula duraa'.Wa tuulah foog kamaan duraa'een.Wa l-mukhbar da yukuun hu wa guruunah sun'a waahide bas.
Wa amsah daharah wa kulla jawaanibah wa guruunah be dahab saafi.Wa darris khachmah kula be dahab.
Wa sawwi leyah khawaatim itneen tihit min al-diraasa be l-jaanib al-waahid wa be l-jaanib al-aakhar kula.Wa be da,yagdaro yidakhkhulu le l-mukhbar iidaan itneen le yichiiluuh beehum.
Wa sawwi al-iidaan al-itneen dool be hatab al-sunt wa amsahhum be dahab.
Wa khutt al-mukhbar da barra min al-sitaar al-gaa'id giddaam al-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada.Al-sanduug wa sidaadtah gaa'idiin wara l-sitaar.Wa da l-bakaan al-ana nigaabilak foogah.
--Haaruun yiharrig al-bakhuur al-mu'attar da kulli fajur wakit yaji yinaddif al-faanuus.
Wa battaan yiharrigah achiiye wakit yaji yigabbid al-faanuus.Al-bakhuur yiharruguuh daayman fajur wa achiiye giddaam Allah min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Ma tiharrig fi l-mukhbar da bakhuur al-Allah ma azan beyah wa la dahiiye muharraga wa la hadiiye hana dagiig.Wa ma tusubbu foogah hadiiyat charaab.
Wa marra fi l-sana,Haaruun waajib yichiil min damm hana l-bahiime al-dabahooha le kaffaarat al-zanib wa yamsahah fi guruun al-mukhbar da.Wa be da,hu yikhassis al-mukhbar marra waahide fi l-sana,min zurriiye le zurriiye.Wa l-mukhbar da yabga mukhaddas marra waahid le Allah.-
Wakit tahsib Bani Israa'iil le talga adadhum,khalli kulla raajil yafda nafsah wa yigaddim fidya le Allah achaan ma yaga' fooghum waba wakit inta gaa'id tahsibhum.
Ayyi waahid kan hasabooh khalaas,yanti nuss hajar hana fudda hadiiye le Allah.Wa hasab al-wazin al-rasmi hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas,ayyi hajar fudda yawzin 12 giraam.
Wa ayyi waahid al-umrah tamma 20 sana wa ziyaada kan hasabooh khalaas,waajib yanti hadiiye le Allah.
Al-khani ma yanti aktar min nuss hajar wa l-fagri kula ma yanti angas achaan di hadiiye le Allah al-tabga kaffaara le nufuushum.
Chiil al-fudda hana l-kaffaara di min Bani Israa'iil wa asta'malha le khidmit kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa tabga kaffaara le Bani Israa'iil wa zikra giddaam Allah.
Asna' hoot min nahaas le l-wadu.Wa sawwi leyah ga'ar min nahaas wa khuttah been kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa l-madbah.Wa subb foogah almi.
Wa Haaruun wa awlaadah yilwaddo be l-almi da.
Gubbaal ma yadkhulu fi kheemat al-ijtimaa',yilwaddo achaan ma yumuutu.Wa gubbaal ma yaju gariib le l-madbah le yigaddumu le Allah hadiiye muharraga,
yilwaddo achaan ma yumuutu.Wa da yabga chart daayim le Haaruun wa awlaadah min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Chiil min ahsan al-riihe.Chiil min al-khumra 6 kiilo wa min al-sandal 3 kiilo wa min al-itir 3 kiilo
wa min al-girfa 3 kiilo.Wa da kula hasab al-wazin al-rasmi hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa chiil battaan 4 liitir min dihin al-zaytuun.
Wa da kulla khalbitah sawa wa sawwi beyah dihin mu'attar khaass le l-masahaan.Wa l-yisawwi al-dihin da,naadum ma'ruuf fi khalbitiin al-itir.Wa da yabga dihin khaass le l-masahaan.
Wa be l-dihin al-khaass da,amsah kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa l-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada
wa l-tarabeeza wa kulla mu'iddaatha wa l-faanuus wa mu'iddaatah wa mukhbar al-bakhuur.
Wa battaan amsah al-madbah hana l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa mu'iddaatah wa l-hoot wa ga'arah kula.
Wa khassishum le yukuunu mukhaddasiin marra waahid.Wa l-cheyy al-yilammishum kula yabga mukhaddas.
Wa ba'ad da,amsah Haaruun wa awlaadah wa khassishum achaan yabgo leyi rujaal diin.
Wa guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Dihin al-masahaan da yabga leyi khaass min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Ma tamsaho beyah ayyi naadum wa la tikhalbutu dihin aakhar mislah.Hu khaass wa waajib intu kula ta'arfu kadar hu khaass.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yikhalbit dihin mislah aw yamsahah le naadum ma min rujaal al-diin,al-naadum da waajib yafsuluuh min ahalah.-
Wa battaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Chiil fi wazin mutasaawi al-aryaah dool wa humman al-samukh wa l-dufur wa l-lubaan wa l-samukh al-mu'attar.
Wa khalbit minhum bakhuur mu'attar.Wa l-yisawwi al-bakhuur da,naadum ma'ruuf fi khalbitiin al-itir.Wa yukuun sameh wa saafi wa khaass.
Wa chiil minnah wa arhakah maarin wa khuttah giddaam al-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa da l-bakaan al-ana nigaabilak foogah.Wa da khalli yabga leeku mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa ma tisawwu le nufuusku bakhuur misil al-bakhuur da wa laakin aj'alooh khaass le Allah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yisawwi bakhuur mislah le yuchummah,waajib yafsuluuh min ahalah.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa battaan wa gaal-:
Asma'.Ana azalt Basaliil wileed Uuri wileed Huur min gabiilat Yahuuza.
Ana nazzalt Ruuhi foogah wa anteetah khibra wa fihim wa ma'rafa le yasna' kulli cheyy.
Wa da,ya'arif yasna' achya be dahab wa fudda wa nahaas
wa yagta' al-hujaar al-khaaliyiin wa yanguchhum wa yanjur al-khachab wa yasna' kulla cheyy.
Wa be da,ana kallaft Uhuliyaab wileed Akhisamaak min gabiilat Daan le yisaa'idah.Wa battaan,ana anteet khibra le kulla l-sinaa'iyiin le yisawwu kulla l-achya al-ana amartak beehum.Wa humman
kheemat al-ijtimaa'wa l-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahadawa sidaadtah al-yisidduuh beehawa kulla mu'iddaat al-kheema
wa l-tarabeeza wa kulla mu'iddaathawa l-faanuus hana l-dahab al-saafi wa kulla mu'iddaatahwa mukhbar al-bakhuur
wa l-madbah hana l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa kulla mu'iddaatahwa l-hoot wa ga'arah
wa l-khulgaan al-khaaliyiin al-khaassiin le Haaruun raajil al-diinwa khulgaan iyaalah wakit yakhdumu misil rujaal diin
wa dihin al-masahaanwa l-bakhuur al-mu'attar al-yiharruguuh fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.-Wa humman yisawwu kulla l-achya dool misil ana amartak beyah.
Wa battaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:
Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Ahfado yoomi hana l-sabt achaan ana ja'altah alaama beeni wa beenku min zurriiye le zurriiye.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana Allah bas nikhassisku.
Wa ahfado yoom al-sabt achaan hu yoom mukhaddas leeku.Kan naadum ma yihtarim yoom al-sabt,waajib yaktuluuh.Wa kan naadum yisawwi ayyi khidme fi l-yoom da,waajib yafsuluuh min ahalah.
Fi sitte yoom,sawwu khidmitku wa laakin al-yoom al-saabi' da,hu sabt.Hu yoom hana raaha,mukhaddas le Allah.Wa kan naadum sawwa ayyi amal fi yoom al-sabt da,waajib yaktuluuh.
Khalli Bani Israa'iil yahfado yoom al-sabt wa yi'ayyuduuh min zurriiye le zurriiye misil mu'aahada daayme.
Wa hu yabga alaama daayme beeni wa been Bani Israa'iil achaan ana Allah khalagt al-samaawaat wa l-ard fi sitte yoom.Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' kamaan,ana ma khalagt cheyy.Wa be da,ana ja'altah yoom hana raaha.-
Wa wakit Allah kammal kalaamah ma'a Muusa fi jabal Siinaa',antaah liihaan al-mu'aahada.Wa humman liihaan itneen hana hajar al-Allah zaatah katab fooghum kalaamah.
Wa wakit al-cha'ab chaafo Muusa ma nazal leehum ajala min al-jabal,humman jo le Haaruun wa gaalo leyah-:-Gumm sawwi leena sanam na'abuduuh.Wa yuguudna fi machiina achaan al-naadum al-yuguulu leyah Muusa da,hu bas al-maragaana min balad Masir wa laakin hassa' da,ma na'arfu chunu al-bigi leyah.
Wa Haaruun radda leehum wa gaal-:-Sillu al-khuruus hana l-dahab al-fi udne awiinku wa awlaadku wa banaatku wa jiibuuhum leyi.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab sallo al-khuruus hana l-dahab al-fi udneehum wa antoohum le Haaruun.
Wa hu chaal minhum al-dahab da wa gata'ah wa sabbaah fi gaalib wa sana' beyah sanam hana ijil.Wa humman gaalo-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil,al-sanam da bas ilaahku al-maragaaku min balad Masir-!
Wa wakit Haaruun chaaf al-cheyy da,bana madbah giddaam al-ijil.Wa hajja le l-naas wa gaal-:-Ambaakir iid le ilaahna-!
Wa ambaakir be fajur,humman gaddamo dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa ba'ad da,akalo wa chirbo wa gammo yal'abo.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Gumm anzil achaan cha'abak al-inta maragtuhum min balad Masir tallafo khalaas.
Wa ajala ke bas talago al-derib al-ana amartuhum beyah wa sana'o leehum sanam hana ijil wa sajado giddaamah.Wa gaddamo leyah dahaaya wa gaalo-:--Ya Bani Israa'iil,al-sanam da bas ilaahku al-maragaaku min balad Masir-!-
Wa Allah gaal battaan le Muusa-:-Ana chift cha'abak da,humman raashum gawi.
Wa hassa' da,khalli khadabi yanzil fooghum wa nidammirhum marra waahid.Wa laakin minnak inta kamaan,namrug umma kabiire.
Wa Muusa chahad Allah Ilaahah fi chaan cha'abah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah,maala khadabak yanzil fi cha'abak al-inta maragtuhum min balad Masir be gudra kabiire wa iid chadiide-?
Wa maala tikhalli al-Masriyiin yichchammato foogna wa yuguulu-:--Achaan Allah ma yidoorhum bas hu maragaahum min hini wa waddaahum le yaktulhum fi lubb al-jibaal.Wa be da,hu yuguchchuhum marra waahid min al-ard.- Ya Rabb,ma takhdab le cha'abak wa khalli khadabak al-awwal kharrart tinazzilah fooghum.
Wa fakkir fi abiidak Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub al-inta zaatak halaft leehum wa gult-:--Nisawwi zurriiyitku katiire misil nujuum al-sama.Wa nantiihum kulla l-balad al-ana waa'adtuhum beeha.Wa hi tabga warasathum le l-abad.-
Wa khalaas,Allah khalla khadabah al-awwal kharrar yinazzilah fi cha'abah.
Wa ba'ad da,Muusa nazal min al-jabal wa fi iidah al-liihaan al-itneen hana l-mu'aahada.Wa l-liihaan dool maktuubiin jaay wa jaay.
Wa l-Rabb bas sawwaahum wa katab fooghum.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yanzulu,Yachuu'simi' harakat al-cha'ab wa gaal le Muusa-:-Ana gaa'id nasma' haraka hint harib fi l-fariig.
Wa Muusa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-haraka di wa la hint nasurwa la hint haziime.Al-haraka al-ana gaa'id nasma'ha di,hint khine.
Wa wakit Muusa ja gariib le l-fariig wa chaaf al-ijil wa l-naas gaa'idiin yal'abo,hu zi'il za'al chadiid.Wa l-liihaan al-fi iidah zagalaahum fi ga'ar al-jabal wa kassaraahum.
Wa hu chaal al-ijil al-humman sana'ooh wa harragah fi l-naar wa rihikah lahaddi bigi dagiig wa sabbaah fi almi wa zagaah le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Muusa gaal le Haaruun-:-Al-cha'ab dool sawwo leek chunu lahaddi tijiibhum le zanib kabiir misil da-?
Wa Haaruun radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ma taz'al,ya siidi-!Inta zaatak ta'arfah al-cha'ab dool yiriidu illa l-fasaala.
Wa humman gaalo leyi-:--Sawwi leena sanam na'abuduuh.Wa yuguudna fi machiina achaan al-naadum al-yuguulu leyah Muusa da,hu bas al-maragaana min balad Masir wa laakin hassa' ma na'arfu chunu al-bigi leyah.--
Wa ana gult leehum-:--Al-naadum al-indah dahab khalli yisillah wa yantiih leyi.- Wa ana zagaltah fi l-naar wa tawwaali ke,marag al-ijil da-!
Wa khalaas,Muusa irif kadar al-cha'ab gaa'idiin yisawwu ayyi cheyy bala huduud.Wa Haaruun kula ma gidir leehum.Wa be da,udwaanhum gaa'idiin yichchammato leehum.
Wa Muusa wagaf fi madkhal al-fariig wa gaal-:-Ayyi naadum minku al-yitaabi' Allah,khalli yaji leyi. Wa khalaas,kulla rujaal al-Laawiyiin jo leyah wa wagafo ma'aayah.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Khalli ayyi waahid minku yichiil seefah wa yuchugg kulla l-fariig wa yaktul akhuuh wa rafiigah wa jaarah.-
Wa khalaas,al-Laawiyiin tabbago kalaam Muusa.Wa fi l-yoom da,katalo hawaale 3-000 raajil.
Wa Muusa gaal le l-Laawiyiin-:-Min al-yoom,khassastu nufuusku le Allah achaan intu gammeetu ayyi waahid didd wileedah wa didd akhuuh.Wa be da,Allah antaaku baraka.
Wa ambaakir be fajur,Muusa gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Intu sawweetu zanib kabiir.Hassa' da,ana narkab al-jabal wa nisawwi leeku kaffaara.Akuun Allah yakhfir leeku zanibku.
Wa Muusa gabbal le Allah wa chahadah wa gaal-:-Ya Rabb,cha'abak dool sawwo zanib kabiir.Sawwo leehum ilaah min dahab le ya'abuduuh.
Ya Rabb,akhfir leehum zanibhum-!Aw guchch usmi min kitaabak al-inta katabtah.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Illa l-naadum al-aznab giddaami,ana nuguchch usmah min kitaabi.
Wa hassa' da,amchi guud al-cha'ab wa waddiihum fi l-bakaan al-ana gultah leek.Wa malaki yuguudku fi machiiku.Wa laakin yoom nugumm,ni'aakhib al-cha'ab da be sabab zanibhum.
Wa khalaas,Allah nazzal waba fi l-cha'ab achaan abado al-ijil al-Haaruun sana'ah leehum.
Wa ba'ad da,battaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Amchi min hini inta wa l-cha'ab al-inta maragtuhum min balad Masir.Wa gummu amchu le l-balad al-ana halaft le Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub wa gult nantiiha le zurriiyithum.
Wa ana nirassil giddaamak malak wa natrud al-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.
Wa ba'ad da,intu tamchu le l-balad al-malaane be l-laban wa l-asal.Wa laakin ana ma namchi ma'aaku achaan ma naktulku fi l-derib be sabab intu cha'ab raasku gawi.
Wa wakit al-cha'ab sim'o al-kalaam da,bigi leehum gaasi wa gammo yabku wa naadum minhum libis ziintah kula ma fiih.
Wa da achaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Intu cha'ab raasku gawi.Kan ana macheet ma'aaku le wakit chiyya kula,naktulku.Hassa' da,sillu minku ziinitku.Wa ana nichiif kikkeef nisawwi leeku.-
Wa khalaas min al-yoom da fi jabal Huuriib,Bani Israa'iil sallo ziinithum wa ma libsooha battaan.
Wa ayyi wakit kan al-cha'ab nazalo fi bakaan,Muusa yichiil al-kheema wa yabniiha barra ba'iid min al-fariig.Wa Muusa sammaaha kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa ayyi naadum kan dawwar yas'al Allah,yamchi leeha barra min al-fariig.
Wa fi ayyi wakit kan Muusa marag maachi le l-kheema di,kulla l-cha'ab yagiifu ayyi waahid fi khachum baab kheemtah wa yichiif Muusa lahaddi yadkhul fi kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa wakit Muusa yadkhul fi l-kheema di,amuud al-sahaab yanzil wa yagiif fi khachum baab al-kheema.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Allah yikallim ma'a Muusa.
Wa wakit kulla l-cha'ab yichiifu amuud al-sahaab waagif fi baab al-kheema,kulluhum yasjudu ayyi waahid fi khachum baab kheemtah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Allah yikallim ma'a Muusa khachum be khachum misil naadum yikallim ma'a rafiigah.Wa kan Muusa gabbal le l-fariig kula,musaa'idah al-sabi al-usmah Yachuu' wileed Nuun yagood daayman fi l-kheema.
Wa Muusa gaal le Allah-:-Inta dawwart minni ana nuguud al-cha'ab da.Wa laakin ma arraftini yaatu al-tirassilah ma'aayi.Wa battaan inta gult leyi-:--Ana bas azaltak wa ridiit leek.--
Wa kan sahiih ke inta ridiit leyi,arrifni derbak achaan na'arfak wa inta tarda leyi daayman.Wa fakkir fi l-umma di achaan hi cha'abak.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana zaati namchi giddaamak wa be da,inta ma tihimm.
Wa Muusa gaal-:-Kan inta be nafsak ma tamchi ma'aana,ma tamrugna min hini.
Wa kan inta ma tamchi ma'aana,kikkeef naadum yagdar ya'arif kadar inta ridiit leyi wa le cha'abak-?Wa kikkeef yagdaro yifannuduuna ana wa cha'abak min kulla chu'uub al-ard al-aakhariin-?
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Al-cheyy al-inta talabtah da,ana nisawwiih achaan ana ridiit leek wa ana bas azaltak.
Wa Muusa gaal-:-Khalliini nichiif azamatak.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Niwassifak kulla kheeri wa ni'aalin leek usmi hu Allah.Wa ana nihinn ayyi naadum al-nidoor nihinnah wa narham ayyi naadum al-nidoor narhamah.
Wa laakin ma tagdar tichiif wijhi achaan kan insaan chaaf wijhi,battaan ma yi'iich.
Wa Allah gaal battaan-:-Daahu fi bakaan gariib leyi fi l-hajar.Agiif foogah.
Wa wakit azamati tufuut giddaamak,nukhuttak fi faragat al-hajar wa nikhattiik be iidi.Wa ba'ad azamati tufuut khalaas,
ana narfa' iidi wa tichiif azamati be wara.Achaan wijhi,naadum ma yagdar yichiifah.
Wa battaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Sawwi liihaan itneen hana hajar misil al-liihaan al-awwal.Wa ana naktib fooghum al-wasaaya al-awwal katabtuhum fi l-liihaan al-itneen al-inta kassartuhum.
Wa jahhiz nafsak.Ambaakir fajur,atla' fi jabal Siinaa' wa ta'aal leyi fi raas al-jabal.
Khalli naadum ma yatla' ma'aak wa la yinchaaf fi ayyi bakaan fi l-jabal.Wa l-khanam wa l-bagar kula ma yasraho ale l-jabal da.
Wa Muusa sawwa liihaan itneen hana hajar misil al-liihaan al-awwal.Wa ambaakir fajur,rikib fi jabal Siinaa'.Wa chaal al-liihaan dool fi iidah misil Allah amarah beyah.
Wa khalaas,Allah nazal fi amuud al-sahaab fi l-bakaan al-Muusa waagif foogah.Wa aalan usmah hu Allah.
Wa faat giddaam Muusa wa aalan wa gaal-:-Ana Allah-!Ana Allah al-Rahmaan al-Rahiim wa l-Sabuur wa l-Muhibb wa l-Amiin.
Niwassif kheeri al-daayim le aalaaf al-zurriiyaat wa nakhfir al-khata wa l-isyaan wa l-zunuub.Wa laakin al-muznib ma naj'alah bari.Ni'aakhib al-iyaal wa iyaal al-iyaal be zunuub abbahaathum lahaddi l-zurriiye al-taalta wa l-raab'e.
Wa tawwaali,Muusa dangar fi l-ard wa sajad le Allah
wa gaal-:-Ya Rabb,kan inta ridiit leyi,amchi ma'aana.Ya Rabb,hatta kan aniina cha'abak raasna gawi kula,akhfir leena khataayaana wa zunuubna.Wa aj'alna cha'abak al-halaalak.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Daahu ana nisawwi ma'aaku mu'aahada.Nisawwi ajaayib giddaam kulla cha'abak al-abadan ma bigo fi umam al-ard.Wa l-cha'ab al-inta gaa'id fi usuthum yichiifu kulla l-fi'il al-ajiib al-bikhawwif al-ana Allah nisawwiih beek inta.
Khalli yitabbugu daayman kalaami al-nuguulah leek al-yoom.Wa be da,ana natrud min giddaamku al-Amuuriyiin wa l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.
Angar'u ma tisawwu alaakha ma'a sukkaan al-balad al-intu maachiin leeha achaan humman ma yabgo leeku charak.
Wa laakin haddumu madaabihhum wa armu hujaarhum al-khazzoohum wa kassuru iidaanhum al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira.
Ma ta'abudu ilaah aakhar balaayi ana Allah achaan ana khayyuur ya'ni ma nidoor ya'abudu ilaah aakhar.
Angar'u ma tisawwu alaakha ma'a sukkaan al-balad di achaan wakit yichcharmato ma'a ilaahaathum wa ya'abuduuhum wa yigaddumu leehum dahaaya,ya'azumuuku le taakulu ma'aahum dahaayaahum.
Wa akuun taakhudu banaathum le awlaadku.Wa kan banaathum yichcharmato ma'a asnaamhum wa ya'abuduuhum,awlaadku kula yisawwu nafs al-cheyy.
Ma tasna'o leeku asnaam hana hadiid.
Ayyudu iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara.Fi sab'a yoom,aakulu khubza bala tawwaara misil ana amartuku beyah.Wa da fi l-wakit al-muhaddad fi chahar al-Ganaadiil.Wa da bas al-chahar al-intu maragtu beyah min balad Masir.
Kulla awlaad al-bikir yabgo hineeyi ana Allah hatta awlaad al-bikir min al-bahaayim kan min al-bagar walla min al-khanam kula.
Wa ayyi wald bikir hana hamiir,chiilu fi badalah kharuuf.Wa kan ma baddaltuuh kamaan,aksuru ragabatah.Wa laakin ayyi wald bikir min iyaalku intu al-insaan,afdooh.-Ma taju giddaami iideeku yaabsiin.
Akhdumu le muddit sitte yoom wa l-yoom al-saabi' kamaan,anjammo.Hatta fi l-hiraate aw fi l-gati' kula,fi l-yoom al-saabi' da,waajib tinjammo.
Ayyudu iid al-Gati' wa gaddumu leyi awwal intaaj al-gameh al-intu gata'tuuh min al-zere'.Wa ba'ad da,ayyudu iid al-Lammiin wa da yabga fi aakhir khidmit al-ziraa'a.
Talaata marraat fi l-sana,ayyi dakar minku yaji giddaami le ya'abudni ana Allah al-Rabb Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana natrud al-umam min giddaamku wa niwassi' baladku.Wa naadum waahid kula ma yatma' fi arduku wakit taju giddaami ana Allah Ilaahku talaata marraat fi l-sana.
Ma tigaddumu leyi damm al-dahiiye ma'a ayyi cheyy al-indah tawwaara.Wa ma tikhallu chaham dahiiyat iid al-Fisha yargud lahaddi fajur.
Wa gaddumu awwal intaaj ziraa'itku le beet Allah Ilaahku.-Wa ma tirakkubu laham al-sakhal fi laban ammah.
Wa battaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Aktib al-kalaam da wa da yabga asaas al-mu'aahada al-sawweetha ma'aak inta wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Muusa ga'ad ma'a Allah 40 nahaar wa 40 leele.Wa la akal khubza wa la chirib almi.Wa katab fi l-liihaan kalaam al-mu'aahada wa hu al-wasaaya al-achara.
Wa khalaas wakit Muusa nazal min jabal Siinaa' wa liihaan al-mu'aahada fi iideenah,hu ma irif kadar wijhah gaa'id yiraari be sabab hu kallam ma'a Allah.
Wa wakit Haaruun wa kulla Bani Israa'iil chaafo wijih Muusa gaa'id yiraari,khaafo ma garrabo leyah.
Wa laakin hu naadaahum wa fi l-bakaan da,Haaruun wa kulla chuyuukh al-mujtama' jo leyah.Wa hu kallam ma'aahum.
Wa ba'ad da,kulla Bani Israa'iil jo leyah gariib.Wa hu wassaahum be kulla l-wasaaya al-Allah gaalaahum leyah fi jabal Siinaa'.
Wakit Muusa kammal kalaamah ma'aahum,khatta minhum wijhah be mindiil.
Wa ayyi wakit kan Muusa yidoor yagiif giddaam Allah le yikallim ma'aayah,yarfa' al-mindiil min wijhah lahaddi yamrug min hadarat Allah.Wa hu yikallim le Bani Israa'iil be l-wasaaya al-Allah amarah beehum.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Bani Israa'iil yichiifu wijhah al-gaa'id yiraari.Wa ba'ad da,hu yukhutt al-mindiil fi wijhah lahaddi yaji yikallim ma'a Allah battaan.
Wa Muusa lamma kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa gaal leehum-:-Dool humman al-churuut al-Allah amaraaku le takhdumu beehum.
Fi sitte yoom sawwu khidmitku.Wa laakin fi l-yoom al-saabi',da sabt hana raaha wa hu mukhassas le Allah.Wa kan naadum sawwa ayyi amal fi l-yoom al-saabi' da,waajib yaktuluuh.
Wa fi yoom al-sabt,naar kula ma ti'ooguduuha fi buyuutku.
Wa Muusa gaal le kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil-:-Da bas al-cheyy al-Allah amaraaku beyah.
Gaddumu hadiiye le Allah.Wa ayyi naadum minku al-galbah kariim khalli yijiib hadiiye le Allah.-Al-hadaaya dool hummandahab wa fudda wa nahaas
Wa khalli kulla l-sinaa'iyiin minku yaju le yasna'o al-cheyy al-amar beyah Allah.
Wa dool al-achya al-yasna'oohum.Al-achya al-yabnu beehum al-kheema min daakhal wa min barrawa khita al-kheema wa fangarhawa khachabha wa maraadiisha wa amadha wa asaasha
wa l-sanduug wa iidaanah wa sidaadtah wa l-sitaar al-yidaarig al-sanduug
wa l-tarabeeza wa iidaanha wa kulla mu'iddaathawa l-khubza al-yigaddumuuha le Allah
wa l-faanuus wa mu'iddaatah wa niiraanah wa dihnah
wa mukhbar al-bakhuur wa iidaanahwa dihin al-masahaan wa l-bakhuur al-mu'attarwa l-sitaar le baab al-kheema
wa l-madbah hana l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa tachaachtah min nahaas wa iidaanah wa kulla mu'iddaatahwa hoot le l-wadu wa ga'arah
wa l-sataayir al-muhawwigiin beehum al-fadaay wa amadhum wa asaashumwa sitaar hana baab al-fadaay
wa wutaad al-kheemawa wutaad sataayir al-fadaay wa hubaalhum
wa khulgaan le l-khidme fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa dool khulgaan al-khaassiin le Haaruun raajil al-diin wa khulgaan le awlaadah wakit yakhdumu misil rujaal diin.
Wa ba'ad Muusa kammal kalaamah khalaas,kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil gammo macho minnah
wa kulla insaan indah niiye wa galbah kariim jaab hadiiye le Allah achaan yisawwu beeha kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa kulla mu'iddaatha wa khulgaan khaassiin.
Wa kulla l-naas jo awiin wa rujaal anto hadiiye be juud wa karam.Wa ayyi naadum indah galib kariim anta khuruus aw chinif aw khaatim aw hafiide aw ayyi cheyy aakhar hana dahab.Ayyi naadum minhum gaddam dahab hadiiye marfuu'a le Allah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-indah gumaach zahri aw garadi aw ahmar aw gumaach hana kattaan aw suuf inze aw firaaw kubaach madbuukhiin wa mulawwaniin be loon ahmar aw farwa hana ijil al-bahar kula jaabah hadiiye.
Wa naas waahidiin jaabo hadiiye hana fudda aw nahaas wa antooha le Allah.Wa ayyi naadum al-indah khachab al-sunt al-yanfa' le ayyi khidme jaabah hadiiye.
Wa ayyi mara al-indaha khibra fi khiyaatit al-gumaach khayyatat be iidha wa jaabatah hadiiye.Wa l-gumaach da hana kattaan wa loonah zahri aw garadi aw ahmar.
Wa ayyi mara al-indaha niiye wa indaha khibra tarrat suuf inze.
Wa chuyuukh al-cha'ab jaabo hujaar agiig wa hujaar aakhariin khaaliyiin le yurussuuhum fi l-farmala hana raajil al-diin wa fi l-sideeriiye.
Wa anto battaan aryaah wa dihin le l-faanuus wa dihin le l-masahaan wa itir le l-bakhuur al-mu'attar.
Wa kulla insaan min Bani Israa'iil al-indah niiye,kan raajil walla mara kula,jaab cheyy le l-khidme al-amaraahum beeha Allah be waasitat Muusa.
Wa Muusa gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Asma'o.Daahu Allah azal Basaliil wileed Uuri wileed Huur min gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa hu nazzal Ruuhah foogah wa antaah khibra wa fihim wa ma'rafa le yasna' kulla cheyy
wa da,le yasna' achya be dahab wa fudda wa nahaas
wa le yagta' al-hujaar al-khaaliyiin wa yanguchhum wa yanjur al-khachab wa yasna' kulla cheyy.
Wa be da,Allah anta ilim le Basaliil wa Uhuliyaab wileed Akhisamaak min gabiilat Daan le yi'allumu naas aakhariin.
Wa hu antaahum khibra achaan yanguchu wa yarsumu wa yikhayyutu gumaach kattaan al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa yitirru gabag wa yikhayyutu wa yasna'o kulli cheyy.
Wa misil Allah amaraahum beyah,Basaliil wa Uhuliyaab wa sinaa'iyiin aakhariin al-Allah antaahum khibra wa fihim le yisawwu khidimtah gammo be buna kheemat al-ibaada.
Wa Muusa naada Basaliil wa Uhuliyaab wa l-sinaa'iyiin al-aakhariin al-Allah antaahum khibra wa ayyi naadum al-indah niiye achaan yaju leyah wa yugummu be l-khidme.
Wa humman ligo min Muusa kulla l-hadaaya al-Bani Israa'iil jaaboohum le buna al-kheema.Wa kulla yoom al-naas gaa'idiin yijiibu be niiyithum hadaaya aakhariin.
Wa khalaas kulla l-sinaa'iyiin al-gammo be buna al-kheema ayyi waahid waggaf khidimtah wa ja.
Wa gaalo le Muusa-:-Bani Israa'iil jaabo hadaaya aktar min al-yakfi le l-amal al-Allah amar beyah.
Wa Muusa kallam fi l-fariig wa gaal-:-Khalli kulla l-naas yiwaggufu al-hadaaya al-yijiibuuhum le kheemat al-ibaada. Wa khalaas kulla l-naas ma jaabo hadaaya battaan.
Achaan al-hadaaya al-jaaboohum yakfu le buna al-kheema wa yifaddulu kula.
Wa kulla l-sinaa'iyiin gammo le buna al-kheema.Wa sawwooha be achara git'e min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al-loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa khayyato fi l-gita' dool suwar makhluugiin samaawiyiin be khiyaatit khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa tuul al-gita' dool sawa sawa.Ayyi waahide tuulha 28 duraa' wa urdaha 4 duraa'.
Wa l-gita' dool,khamsa lammoohum sawa fi majmuu'a waahide wa l-khamsa al-aakhariin kula lammoohum sawa.
Wa kachkacho taraf al-khamsa be gumaach zahri wa taraf al-khamsa al-aakhariin kula kachkachoohum be nafs al-gumaach.
Sawwo 50 manaakhir fi l-majmuu'a al-awwal wa 50 manaakhir fi l-majmuu'a al-taaniye.Wa khalaas al-manaakhir dool bigo mulgaabiliin.
Wa sawwo 50 fangar hana dahab wa chabako beyah al-manaakhir kulli waahide ma'a l-aakhara.Wa be da,al-majmuu'teen bigo kheema waahide.
Wa sawwo al-khita al-awwal le l-kheema min 11 git'e matruuriin be suuf inze.Wa khattooh be foog le l-kheema.
Wa tuul al-gita' dool sawa sawa.Wa tuul al-waahide 30 duraa' wa urdaha 4 duraa'.
Wa l-gita' dool,khamsa lammoohum sawa wa l-sitte al-aakhariin kula lammoohum sawa.
Wa sawwo 50 manaakhir fi nuss kulli waahide min al-majmuu'teen.
