Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Nataniil wileed Suu'ar.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,Aliyaab wileed Hiiluun cheekh gabiilat Zabuluun ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa fi l-hadiiye di fi sufra hana fudda wazinha 50 hajar wa kaas hana fudda al-yawzin 30 hajar wa da hasab al-wazin al-rasmi hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa l-mawaa'iin al-itneen dool maloohum dagiig mukhalbat be dihin wa gaddamoohum hadiiye.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Aliyaab wileed Hiiluun.
Wa fi l-yoom al-raabi',Alisuur wileed Chadayuur cheekh gabiilat Ra'uubiin ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Alisuur wileed Chadayuur.
Wa fi l-yoom al-khaamis,Chalumiyiil wileed Surichadaay cheekh gabiilat Chim'uun ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Chalumiyiil wileed Surichadaay.

Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Aliyaasaf wileed Da'uwiil.

Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Alichama' wileed Amihuud.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taamin,Gamaliyiil wileed Fadahsuur cheekh gabiilat Manassa ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Gamaliyiil wileed Fadahsuur.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taasi',Abidaan wileed Gid'uuni cheekh gabiilat Banyaamiin ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Abidaan wileed Gid'uuni.
Wa fi l-yoom al-aachir,Akhi'aazar wileed Amichadaay cheekh gabiilat Daan ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Akhi'aazar wileed Amichadaay.
Wa fi yoom 11,Fag'iyiil wileed Ukran cheekh gabiilat Achiir ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Fag'iyiil wileed Ukran.
Wa fi yoom 12,Akhiira' wileed Inaan cheekh gabiilat Naftaali ja gaddam hadiiytah.
Wa fi l-hadiiye di fi sufra hana fudda wazinha 50 hajar wa kaas hana fudda al-yawzin 30 hajar wa da hasab al-wazin al-rasmi hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa l-mawaa'iin al-itneen dool maloohum dagiig mukhalbat be dihin wa gaddamoohum hadiiye.
Wa le dahiiyat al-salaama kamaan fi tiiraan itneen wa khamsa kabich wa khamsa tees wa khamsa kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa di l-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha Akhiira' wileed Inaan.
Wa dool al-hadaaya al-jaaboohum chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil wakit masaho al-madbah wa fatahooh.Humman jaabo 12 sufra hana fudda wa 12 kaas hana fudda wa 12 taasa sakhayre hana dahab.
Wa ayyi sufra hana fudda wazinha 50 hajar wa ayyi kaas hana fudda waznah 30 hajar wa kulla mawaa'iin al-fudda dool wazinhum 985 hajar wa da hasab al-wazin al-rasmi hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.
Wa l-atnaachar taasa sakhayre hana dahab malaane bakhuur ayyi waahide tawzin 14 jineeh wa siisi.Wa l-taasaat al-sukhaar hana l-dahab dool kulluhum ke yawzunu 174 jineeh wa da hasab al-wazin al-rasmi hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.
Wa be l-jumla jaabo le l-dahaaya al-muharragiin 12 toor wa 12 kabich wa 12 kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana wa jaabo ma'aahum hadiiye hana dagiig.Wa jaabo 12 tees dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib.
Wa be l-jumla jaabo le dahaaya al-salaama 24 toor wa 60 kabich wa 60 tees wa 60 kharuuf ayyi waahid wald sana.Wa dool al-hadaaya al-gaddamoohum le fatihiin al-madbah ba'ad masahooh.
Wa wakit Muusa yadkhul fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' le yikallim ma'a Allah,hu yasma' hissah yaji leyah min foog le sidaadit sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada ambeen al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin al-itneen al-masnuu'iin fi dahar al-sidaade.Wa yikallim ma'aayah.
Guul le Haaruun wakit yirakkib al-sab'a tiyeesaat le l-naar,khalli yiwajjih al-niiraan le yidawwu al-bakaan al-gaa'id giddaam al-faanuus.
Wa Haaruun sawwa misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.Rakkab kulla tiyeesaat al-naar wa wajjah niiraanhum achaan gaa'idiin yidawwu al-bakaan al-gaa'id giddaam al-faanuus.
Wa l-faanuus da madguug be dahab min ga'arah lahaddi raasah al-gaa'idiin foogah al-zuhuur hana l-dahab.Wa daggooh hasab wasif al-wassafah Allah le Muusa.
Chiil al-Laawiyiin min Bani Israa'iil wa sawwiihum taahiriin.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-tisawwiih le yabgo taahiriin.Ruchchuhum be almi al-tathiir wa khalli yizayyunu kulla jilidhum wa yikhassulu khulgaanhum wa be da,khalaas yabgo taahiriin.
Wa yichiilu toor wa ma'aayah hadiiye hana dagiig mukhalbat be dihin wa inta tichiil toor aakhar dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib.
Wa jiib al-Laawiyiin giddaam kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa limm kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil.
Wa gaddim al-Laawiyiin giddaam Allah.Wa khalli Bani Israa'iil yukhuttu iideehum foog al-Laawiyiin.
Wa Haaruun yigaddim al-Laawiyiin misil hadiiye marfuu'a al-yigaddumuuha Bani Israa'iil le Allah.Wa be da,al-Laawiyiin yagdaro yakhdumu le Allah.
Wa l-Laawiyiin yukhuttu iideehum fi ruuse al-tiiraan dool wa inta gaddimhum le Allah.Al-toor al-waahid dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib wa l-waahid dahiiye muharraga wa da yabga kaffaara le zunuub al-Laawiyiin.
Wa jiib al-Laawiyiin giddaam Haaruun wa awlaadah wa gaddimhum misil hadiiye marfuu'a le Allah.
Wa be da,a'azil al-Laawiyiin min Bani Israa'iil wa humman yabgo hineeyi ana Allah.
Wa ba'ad titahhir al-Laawiyiin wa tigaddimhum leyi misil hadiiye marfuu'a,khalli yamchu yakhdumu fi kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Achaan min kulla Bani Israa'iil,humman bas hineeyi halaali.Wa ana chiltuhum fi badal kulla awlaad al-bikir min Bani Israa'iil le yabgo hineeyi ana Allah.
Achaan kulla awlaad al-bikir hineeyi.Min yoom ana katalt kulla awlaad al-bikir fi balad Masir,kulla awlaad al-bikir fi Israa'iil kan min al-naas walla min al-bahaayim kula,ana khassastuhum le yabgo hineeyi ana.
Wa laakin hassa' ana chilt al-Laawiyiin fi badal kulla awlaad al-bikir min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana chilt al-Laawiyiin wa anteethum le Haaruun wa awlaadah achaan yakhdumu le Bani Israa'iil fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa yisawwu leehum al-kaffaara.Wa be da,al-waba ma yanzil fi Bani Israa'iil wakit yaju gariib le l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.
Wa Muusa wa Haaruun wa kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil sawwo kulla cheyy al-bukhuss al-Laawiyiin misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa l-Laawiyiin tahharo nufuushum wa khassalo khulgaanhum wa Haaruun gaddamaahum misil hadiiye marfuu'a le Allah.Wa sawwa leehum al-kaffaara achaan yabgo taahiriin.
Wa ba'ad da,al-Laawiyiin gidro khadamo fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' tihit muraakhabat Haaruun wa awlaadah.Wa sawwo kulla cheyy al-bukhuss al-Laawiyiin misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Daahu khidmit al-Laawiyiin.Ayyi waahid al-umrah min 25 sana wa foog,waajib yugumm wa yakhdim fi kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa kan umrah lihig 50 sana,khalaas khalli yagiif battaan ma yakhdim.
Hu yisaa'id akhwaanah al-gaa'idiin yahfado wa yakhdumu fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' laakin ma yantuuh khidme khaassa leyah.Wa da l-cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih fi l-khidme al-tukhuss al-Laawiyiin.
Wa fi l-chahar al-awwal hana l-sana al-taaniye ba'ad Bani Israa'iil marago min balad Masir,Allah hajja le Muusa fi saharat Siinaa' wa gaal-:
Guul le Bani Israa'iil yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha fi l-wakit al-muhaddad leyah.
Wa fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar da,fi l-makhrib,intu ti'ayyudu al-iid da fi l-wakit al-muhaddad leyah hasab kulla gawaaniinah wa churuutah.
Wa Muusa gaal le Bani Israa'iil yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha.
Wa fi saharat Siinaa',Bani Israa'iil ayyado al-iid da fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar al-awwal fi l-makhrib.Wa humman sawwo kulla cheyy misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa laakin fi l-yoom da,fi naas waahidiin limso janaaza wa najjaso nufuushum.Wa fi chaan da,humman ma yagdaro yi'ayyudu al-iid fi l-yoom da.Wa khalaas al-naas dool jo giddaam Muusa wa Haaruun fi nafs al-yoom
wa gaalo-:-Sahiih aniina ma taahiriin be sabab limisna janaaza.Laakin maala ma nagdaro nigaddumu hadiiye le Allah fi l-wakit al-muhaddad misil Bani Israa'iil al-aakhariin-?
Wa Muusa gaal leehum-:-Arjooni lahaddi Allah yantiini amur fi chaanku.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal-:
Guul le Bani Israa'iil,humman wa kulla zurriiyaathum kan naas minhum ma taahiriin be sabab limso janaaza aw musaafiriin ba'iid kula,khalli yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha le Allah.
Wa laakin humman dool waajib yi'ayyudu al-iid da be ta'khiir ya'ni fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar al-taani fi l-makhrib.Wa yaakulu al-hamal wa l-khubza bala tawwaara wa l-khadaar al-murr.
Wa ma yifaddulu cheyy min al-akil da yagood lahaddi fajur.Wa ma yaksuru adum min laham al-hamal.Wa yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha hasab gaanuunah sawa sawa.
Wa laakin kan naadum taahir wa ma musaafir wa aba ma yi'ayyid iid al-Fisha,al-naadum da waajib yafsuluuh min ahalah be sabab hu ma gaddam hadiiye le Allah fi l-yoom al-muhaddad.Wa l-naadum da waajib yilhammal mas'uuliiyit al-zanib al-hu sawwaah.
Wa kan naadum ajnabi gaa'id ma'aaku kula,khalli yi'ayyid iid al-Fisha le Allah hasab kulla l-gawaaniin wa l-churuut hana iid al-Fisha.Leeku intu al-muwaatiniin wa le l-ajnabi al-ma'aaku kula,al-gaanuun waahid bas.
Wa wakit bano kheemat al-ibaada,al-sahaabaay nazalat wa khattat al-kheema wa di l-kheema al-foogha al-sanduug al-indah liihaan al-mu'aahada.Wa be l-leel,al-sahaabaay tidawwi misil al-naar fi raas al-kheema lahaddi fajur.
Wa l-sahaabaay gaa'ide daayman mukhattiye al-kheema wa be l-leel tidawwi misil al-naar.
Wa wakit al-sahaabaay tugumm min al-kheema,Bani Israa'iil yisiiru.Wa wakit tanzil fi ayyi bakaan,Bani Israa'iil yanzulu fi l-bakaan da.
Bani Israa'iil yisiiru be amur Allah wa yanzulu be amur Allah.Wa wakit al-sahaabaay gaa'ide mukhattiye al-kheema,humman yagoodu fi bakaanhum.
Wa kan al-sahaabaay tagood titawwil mukhattiye kheemat al-ibaada kula,Bani Israa'iil yitii'u Allah wa ma yisiiru.
Hatta kan al-sahaabaay tagood fi kheemat al-ibaada le muddit ayyaam chiyya kula,Bani Israa'iil yagoodu be amur Allah wa yisiiru be amur Allah.
Wa kan al-sahaabaay tagood min achiiye lahaddi fajur wa tugumm tamchi kula,humman yisiiru.Wa kan tagood yoom wa leele wa tugumm tamchi kula,humman yisiiru.
Wa kan al-sahaabaay tagood ti'akhkhir mukhattiye al-kheema misil yoomeen aw chahar aw ziyaada kula,Bani Israa'iil yagoodu ma yisiiru abadan.Wa laakin wakit al-sahaabaay tugumm tamchi,khalaas Bani Israa'iil kula yisiiru.
Bani Israa'iil yanzulu be amur Allah wa yisiiru be amur Allah.Wa humman yitii'u amur Allah al-hu antaah be waasitat Muusa.
Sawwi leek burunji itneen madguugiin min fudda le tinaadi beehum mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wakit yilimmu aw wakit yisiiru hasab mu'askaraathum.
Wakit yasma'o daribiin al-burunji al-itneen,kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil yilimmu giddaamak fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa laakin wakit yasma'o daribiin al-burunji al-waahid,al-chuyuukh wa l-kubaaraat hana khuchuum buyuut Bani Israa'iil bas yilimmu giddaamak.
Wa kan tadurbu al-burunji iddat marraat,khalaas al-mu'askar al-naazil sabaah yugumm yisiir.
Wa kan tadurbu al-burunji iddat marraat darbe taaniye,al-mu'askar al-naazil wati yugumm yisiir.Wa daribiin al-burunji iddat marraat da yiwassif al-masaar.
Wa laakin wakit tinaadu mujtama' al-cha'ab le yilimmu,adurbu al-burunji marra waahide bas.
Wa l-burunji al-itneen dool yadurbuuhum rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Haaruun.Wa da yabga leeku chart daayim min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Wa wakit tamchu le l-harib didd udwaanku al-gaa'idiin yahjumuuku fi baladku,adurbu al-burunji al-itneen iddat marraat.Wa be da,ana Allah Ilaahku nifakkir foogku wa ninajjiiku min udwaanku.
Adurbu al-burunji fi farahku wa iidku wa fi l-yoom al-awwal hana kulli chahar.Wa adurbu al-burunji wakit tigaddumu dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya al-salaama.Wa be da,ana Ilaahku nifakkir foogku.Wa ana Allah Ilaahku.
Wa fi yoom 20 hana l-chahar al-taani fi l-sana al-taaniye ba'ad Bani Israa'iil marago min balad Masir,al-sahaabaay gammat min kheemat al-ibaada al-foogha al-sanduug al-indah liihaan al-mu'aahada wa machat.
Wa Bani Israa'iil kula khalaas saaro min saharat Siinaa' lahaddi bakaan al-sahaabaay nazalat foogah fi kadaadit Faaraan.
Wa da awwal masaar al-amaraahum beyah Allah be waasitat Muusa.
Wa l-maachi awwal,mu'askar Yahuuza tihit raaytah hasab majmuu'tah al-askariiye.Wa khaaydah Nahchuun wileed Aminadaab.
Wa ma'aayah gabiilat Yassaakar wa khaayidha Nataniil wileed Suu'ar.
Wa ma'aayah battaan gabiilat Zabuluun wa khaayidha Aliyaab wileed Hiiluun.
Wa ba'ad da,fartago kheemat al-ibaada.Wa zurriiyit Girchuun wa zurriiyit Maraari chaalooha wa saaro beeha.
Wa ba'ad al-kheema,mu'askar Ra'uubiin saar tihit raaytah hasab majmuu'tah al-askariiye.Wa khaaydah Alisuur wileed Chadayuur.
Wa ma'aayah gabiilat Chim'uun wa khaayidha Chalumiyiil wileed Surichadaay.
Wa ma'aayah battaan gabiilat Gaad wa khaayidha Aliyaasaf wileed Da'uwiil.
Wa ba'ad da,zurriiyit Gahaat saaro chaayliin al-mu'iddaat al-mukhaddasiin.Wa gabul zurriiyit Gahaat ma yiwassulu,al-Laawiyiin al-aakhariin yabnu kheemat al-ibaada wa yijahhuzuuha leehum.
Wa ba'ad da,mu'askar Afraayim saar tihit raaytah hasab majmuu'tah al-askariiye.Wa khaaydah Alichama' wileed Amihuud.
Wa ma'aayah gabiilat Manassa wa khaayidha Gamaliyiil wileed Fadahsuur.
Wa ma'aayah battaan gabiilat Banyaamiin wa khaayidha Abidaan wileed Gid'uuni.
Wa fi l-akhiir,mu'askar Daan hu macha wara kulla l-mu'askaraat le yahfadoohum min wara.Wa hu saar tihit raaytah hasab majmuu'tah al-askariiye.Wa khaaydah Akhi'aazar wileed Amichadaay.
Wa ma'aayah gabiilat Achiir wa khaayidha Fag'iyiil wileed Ukran.
Wa ma'aayah battaan gabiilat Naftaali wa khaayidha Akhiira' wileed Inaan.
Wa da bas al-nizaam al-saayriin beyah Bani Israa'iil.Humman saayriin hasab majmuu'aathum al-askariiye.
Wa Muusa gaal le Hubaab wileed nasiibah Ra'uwiil al-Midyaani-:-Aniina saayriin le l-bakaan al-Allah gaal yantiih leena.Ta'aal namchu sawa wa nisawwu leek al-kheer achaan Allah gaal yisawwi le Bani Israa'iil al-kheer.
Wa hu gaal-:-La-!Ana ma namchi ma'aaku.Ana namchi le baladi wa ahali.
Wa Muusa gaal leyah-:-La-!Ma tikhalliina wiheedna achaan inta ta'arif al-bakaan al-adiil fi l-kadaade al-aniina nanzulu foogha.Ta'aal abga leena giid.
Wa kan macheet ma'aana nantuuk min al-kheer al-Allah yantiina.
Wa gammo min jabal Allah wa macho masaafit talaata yoom.Wa sanduug mu'aahadat Allah waddooh giddaamhum achaan ya'arfu al-bakaan al-yanzulu foogah.
Wa sahaabaayit Allah mukhattiyeehum be nahaar wakit yisiiru min fariighum.
Wa wakit sanduug mu'aahadat Allah yugumm le l-masaar,Muusa yuguul-:-Gumm,ya Allah-!Udwaanak yichittu wa khusmaanak yajru giddaamak-!
Wa wakit al-sanduug yanzil,Muusa yuguul-:-Gabbil,ya Allah,le cha'abak Bani Israa'iil al-adadhum katiiriin.
Wa yoom waahid,Bani Israa'iil gammo yachku be za'al le Allah.Wa wakit hu simi' chakwaahum,khidib khadab chadiid wa nazzal fooghum naar wa l-naar di haragat taraf fariighum.
Wa Bani Israa'iil koorako le Muusa wa hu chahad Allah wa l-naar di maatat.
Wa khalaas,humman sammo al-bakaan da Tab'iira (ma'anaatah bakaan al-hariige) achaan naar Allah nazalat fooghum wa haragat min al-fariig.
Wa yoom aakhar,al-ajaanib al-gaa'idiin ma'a Bani Israa'iil girmo wa dawwaro leehum laham.Wa Bani Israa'iil zaathum gammo yabku wa yuguulu-:-Al-jaham katalna.Nidooru laham naakulu-!
Al-yoom aniina alfakkarna al-huut al-gaa'idiin naakuluuh fi Masir saakit bala gurus wa l-fagguus wa l-chammaam wa l-basal al-akhdar wa l-tuum wa l-basal.
Wa hassa' da,niiyitna gafalat min al-akil achaan akil aakhar binchaaf ke ma fiih,illa l-manna di.
Wa l-manna hi misil al-kussubarra wa tinchaaf misil al-samukh.
Wa Bani Israa'iil yamchu yukhummuuha wa yarhakooha fi l-murhaaka aw yudugguuha fi l-fundug.Wa yirakkubuuha fi l-buraam wa yisalluluuha kisaar kula.Wa tu'mitha misil al-ka'ak al-sawwooh be dihin.
Wa be l-leel wakit al-karany yanzil fi l-fariig,al-manna kula tanzil ma'aayah.
Wa Muusa simi' kulla khuchuum buyuut Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yabku,ayyi waahid fi khachum baab kheemtah.Wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid wa achaan da,Muusa kula zi'il.
Wa gaal le Allah-:-Maala sawweet cheyy fasil misil da leyi ana abdak-?Wa maala ma ridiit leyi-?Wa maala tukhutt mas'uuliiyit kulla l-cha'ab da fi raasi ana-?
Kulla l-naas dool,ana bas wilidtuhum walla-?Wa maala taamurni wa tuguul leyi-:--Ahdinhum fi sadrak misil al-amm tahdin sakhiirha,lahaddi tiwaddiihum fi l-ard al-ana waa'adt beeha juduudhum.--
Wa min ween ana nalga laham nantiih le kulla l-cha'ab da-?Achaan humman gaa'idiin yabku wa yuguulu leyi-:--Antiina laham naakulu-!--
Ana wiheedi ma nagdar nichiil mas'uuliiyithum achaan humman tugaal leyi.
Ya Rabb,kan di bas mu'aamalatak leyi,aktulni hassa'.Wa kan ana nalga minnak rida,battaan ma nichiif bala misil da.
Wa Allah radda le Muusa wa gaal-:-Jiib leyi 70 raajil min chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil al-inta ta'arifhum kadar humman chuyuukh wa mukallafiin min Bani Israa'iil.Chiilhum wa jiibhum giddaam kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa hinaak humman yagiifu ma'aak.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,ana nanzil wa nikallim ma'aak wa nichiil min al-ruuh al-gaa'id foogak wa nukhuttah fooghum.Wa be da,humman yichiilu ma'aak mas'uuliiyit al-cha'ab wa battaan inta ma tichiilha wiheedak.
Wa guul le l-cha'ab-:--Khassusu nufuusku wa ambaakir taakulu laham achaan Allah simi' bakiiku wakit gultu-:"Al-jaham katalna nidooru laham naakulu-!Aywa,akheer leena kan ga'adna fi Masir."Wa fi chaan da,Allah yantiiku laham wa intu taakuluuh.
Wa l-laham da,ma taakuluuh le muddit yoom aw yoomeen aw khamsa aw achara aw 20 yoom.
Laakin taakuluuh le muddit chahar tamaam lahaddi yamrug leeku min manaakhirku wa yitiir leeku.Wa da achaan abeetu Allah al-gaa'id fi usutku wa bakeetu giddaamah wa gultu-:"Maala maragna min Masir-?"-
Wa Muusa radda le Allah wa gaal-:-Al-cha'ab al-ana gaa'id fi usuthum adad al-askar 600-000.Wa be da kula,inta gult tantiihum laham yaakulu le muddit chahar kaamil-!
Wa laakin kan nadbaho kulla l-khanam wa l-bagar kula yitimmu leehum walla-?Wa kan nakurbu kulla huut al-bahar kula yitimm leehum walla-?
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Iidi ana Allah gisayre walla-?Wa hassa' tichiif kan kalaami yilhaggag leek walla la.
Wa Muusa marag min al-kheema wa macha khabbaraahum le l-cha'ab be kalaam Allah.Wa lamma al-sab'iin rujaal min chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil wa khattaahum hawaale al-kheema.
Wa Allah nazal fi lubb al-sahaabaay wa kallam leyah.Wa chaal min al-ruuh al-gaa'id foog Muusa wa khattaah foog al-sab'iin chuyuukh.Wa wakit al-ruuh ga'ad fooghum,tawwaali gammo yitnabba'o wa battaan yoom aakhar ma sawwooh.
Wa laakin rujaal itneen,al-waahid usmah Alidaad wa l-aakhar usmah Midaad,humman kula min al-sab'iin kubaaraat wa ma macho ma'a l-aakhariin le l-kheema.Wa laakin humman kula al-ruuh nazal fooghum wa gammo yitnabba'o fi l-fariig.
Wa wileed waahid jara khabbar Muusa wa gaal-:-Alidaad wa Midaad gaa'idiin yitnabba'o fi l-fariig.
Wa Yachuu' wileed Nuun musaa'id Muusa min chabaabah,gaal-:-Ya sayyidi Muusa-!Adharhum.
Wa Muusa gaal leyah-:-Inta hasuud leyi walla chunu-?Aywa,khalli Allah yinazzil ruuhah fi kulla l-cha'ab wa yisawwiihum kulluhum anbiya.
Wa ba'ad da,khalaas Muusa wa kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil gabbalo fi l-fariig.
Wa khalaas,Allah jaab riih min ale l-bahar wa jaabat ma'aaha tuyuur al-salwa wa sabbathum fi l-fariig fi ayyi jiihe lahaddi machi yoom.Munsabbiin fi l-ard wa gaaymiin minha lahaddi duraa'een.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gammo yukhummu al-salwa tuul al-leel wa tuul al-nahaar lahaddi l-yoom al-taani.Wa lammo al-salwa wa l-ligi chiyya kula ligi 25 chuwaal wa charrooha hawaale al-fariig le tijiff.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yaakulu al-laham wa lissaa' ma kammalo min aklah ke bas,Allah khidib khadab chadiid wa darabaahum be waba chadiid.
Wa sammo al-bakaan da Khibruut Hattaawa (ma'anaatah khubuur al-garam).Achaan da bas al-bakaan al-dafano foogah al-naas al-garmaaniin le akil al-laham.
Wa min Khibruut Hattaawa,Bani Israa'iil saaro wa macho le Hasiruut wa ga'ado hinaak.
Wa yoom waahid,Mariyam wa Haaruun gammo didd Muusa be sabab al-mara al-hu akhadaaha min balad al-Habacha.
Wa humman gaalo-:-Allah wa la kallam le Muusa wiheedah-?Hu ma kallam leena aniina kula walla-? Wa Allah simi' kalaamhum.
Wa Muusa kamaan,hu raajil miskiin wa ma yichiif nafsah ziyaada min kula naas al-ard.
Wa tawwaali,Allah kallam le Muusa wa Haaruun wa Mariyam wa gaal leehum-:-Intu al-talaata ta'aalu fi kheemat al-ijtimaa'. Wa khalaas humman al-talaata macho.
Wa tawwaali,Allah nazal fi amuud hana sahaab wa wagaf fi khachum baab al-kheema wa naada Haaruun wa Mariyam wa humman zahafo giddaam.
Wa gaal-:-Asma'o kalaami.Kan fi nabi fi usutku ana Allah ni'arrif nafsi leyah be ru'ya wa nikallim leyah wakit hu naayim.
Wa laakin da ma misil ana gaa'id nisawwiih ma'a Muusa abdi achaan hu raajil amiin fi kulla cha'abi.
Wa nikallim ma'aayah khachum be khachum be kalaam waadih ma mulabbad.Wa ana nibayyin nafsi leyah wa hu yichiifni ana Allah.Wa be da,maala ma khuftu wa gammeetu didd Muusa abdi-?
Wa Allah khidib leehum khadab chadiid wa khalaas khallaahum.
Wa min al-sahaabaay gammat min al-kheema bas,khalaas Mariyam karabaaha al-jidaamwa hi bigat beeda karr misil al-laban.Wa Haaruun kula wakit anlafat hu chaaf hi mujaddime.
Wa Haaruun gaal le Muusa-:-Ya siidi,Allah yikhalliik-!Ma tinazzil foogna ikhaab be sabab al-zanib al-sawweenaah misil ma indina raas.
Wa khalli Mariyam ma tabga misil sakhiir al-rumaaye al-marag min batun ammah nuss laham jildah ma'kuul.
Wa fi chaan da,Muusa chahad Allah wa gaal-:-Ya Ilaahi,achfiiha-!
Wa laakin Allah radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan abuuha bazakh leeha fi wijihha,al-khajla ma takrubha le muddit sab'a yoom walla-?Wa achaan da,aturduuha barra min al-fariig le muddit sab'a yoom wa ba'ad da,khalli tigabbil.
Wa be misil da,taradooha le Mariyam barra min al-fariig le muddit sab'a yoom.Wa l-cha'ab ma saaro min bakaanhum lahaddi hi gabbalat.
Wa khalaas ba'ad da,humman saaro min Hasiruut wa nazalo fi kadaadit Faaraan.
Rassil naas le yuruukhu leek balad Kan'aan al-ana nantiiha le Bani Israa'iil.Chiil min ayyi gabiila naadum aagil le yimassil gabiilat abbahaatah wa rassilhum.
Wa khalaas Muusa rassalaahum min kadaadit Faaraan hasab kalaam Allah.Wa l-rujaal dool kulluhum min kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil.
Wa dool asaameehum.Min gabiilat Ra'uubiin,Chammuu' wileed Zakkuur.
Wa min gabiilat Chim'uun,Chaafaat wileed Huuri.
Wa min gabiilat Yahuuza,Kaalib wileed Yafuuna.
Wa min gabiilat Yassaakar,Yigaal wileed Yuusuf.
Wa min gabiilat Afraayim,Huucha' wileed Nuun.
Wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin,Falti wileed Raafu.
Wa min gabiilat Zabuluun,Gaddiyiil wileed Suudi.
Wa min gabiilat Yuusuf wa da min gabiilat Manassa,Gaddi wileed Suusi.
Wa min gabiilat Daan,Amiyiil wileed Gamaali.
Wa min gabiilat Achiir,Satuur wileed Mikaayiil.
Wa min gabiilat Naftaali,Nahbi wileed Wafsi.
Wa min gabiilat Gaad,Gawiil wileed Maaki.
Wa dool asaame al-naas al-rassalaahum Muusa le yuruukhu balad Kan'aan.Wa Muusa samma Huucha' wileed Nuun be usum Yachuu'.
Wa Muusa rassalaahum le yuruukhu balad Kan'aan wa gaal leehum-:-Amurgu min hini.Addu be saharat al-Nagab wa amchu giddaam ale l-jibaal.
Wa chiifu kikkeef al-balad di wa akkudu min naasha kan gawiyiin walla da'iifiin wa kan katiiriin walla chiyya.
Wa battaan akkudu adiil kan al-balad di zeene walla fasle wa akkudu min buyuutha kan khiyam saakit walla mudun gawiyiin.
Wa chiifu kan ard al-balad di tigawwim ma'aach walla la wa kan indaha chadar walla ma indaha.Wa ma takhaafo,jiibu ma'aaku chiyya min fawaakihha.-Wa da,wakit awwal intaaj al-inab.
Wa khalaas macho raakho kulla l-balad min saharat Siin lahaddi Rahuub gariib le Labu Hamaat.
Wa humman macho be saharat Nagab lahaddi wassalo hillit Hibruun,bakaan al-aaychiin foogah khuchuum buyuut Akhimaan wa Chiichaay wa Talmaay min zurriiyit Bani Anakh.Wa hillit Hibruun di banooha be sab'a sana gubbaal hillit Su'aan al-gaa'ide fi Masir.
Wa humman wassalo fi waadi Achkuul wa hinaak gata'o firi' al-indah anguud hana inab wa dara'ooh fi uud wa chaalooh ambeenaathum fi kataafeehum.Wa chaalo rummaan wa tiin.
Wa l-bakaan da,sammooh waadi Achkuul (ma'anaatah waadi al-anguud) achaan Bani Israa'iil gata'o minnah anguud al-inab.
Wa humman raakho al-balad fi muddit 40 yoom wa gabbalo.
Wa jo ligo Muusa wa Haaruun wa kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil fi Khaadich al-gaa'ide fi kadaadit Faaraan.Wa kallamo leehum wa le kulla Bani Israa'iil be khabar al-balad di wa wassafo leehum al-fawaakih al-jaaboohum minha.
Wa humman gaalo le Muusa-:-Aniina macheena fi l-balad al-inta rassaltina leeha wa sahiih al-balad di samhe wa malaane be l-laban wa l-asal wa daahu fawaakihha.
Wa laakin naasha chudaad wa mudunhum kubaar wa gawiyiin wa chifna naas kubaar min zurriiyit Bani Anakh.
Wa l-Amaalikh saakniin fi saharat Nagab wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin saakniin fi balad al-jibaal.Wa l-Kan'aaniyiin saakniin jamb al-bahar al-Abyad wa fi khachum bahar al-Urdun.
Wa Kaalib sakkat al-naas al-gammo didd Muusa wa gaal-:-Gummu namchu nichiilu al-balad achaan aniina nagdaro ninnasru fooghum-!
Wa laakin al-rujaal al-raakho ma'aayah al-balad gaalo-:-Ma nagdaro namchu nahjumu al-naas dool achaan humman gawiyiin minnina.
Wa khalaas,gammo ayyaro le Bani Israa'iil al-balad al-humman macho raakhooha wa chaafooha.Wa gaalo-:-Al-balad al-rukhnaaha wa chifnaaha di ma adiile.Hi tikattil siyaadha wa kulla l-naas al-ligiinaahum hinaak foogha kula naas kubaar.
Wa aniina chifna naas min zurriiyit Bani Anakh wa humman naas tuwaal wa chudaad.Wa jambuhum aniina nichiifu nufuusna misil angurraasa.Wa humman kula yichiifuuna misil da.
Wa kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yikooruku wa yabku tuul al-leele di.
Wa kulla l-mujtama' gammo yuluumu Muusa wa Haaruun wa gaalo leehum-:-Akheer leena kan mutna fi balad Masir aw numuutu fi l-sahara di.
Maala Allah yiwaddiina fi l-balad di achaan yaktuluuna be l-seef-?Wa iyaalna wa awiinna yabgo kasiibe.Wa da akheer leena kan nigabbulu fi balad Masir.
Wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Yalla nukhuttu leena cheekh aakhar wa nigabbulu fi balad Masir.
Fi l-bakaan da,Muusa wa Haaruun waga'o fi l-turaab be wujuuhhum giddaam kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil al-laammiin.
Wa min al-naas al-raakho al-balad,Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa Kaalib wileed Yafuuna humman dool gammo charrato khulgaanhum min al-za'al.
Wa gaalo le kulla l-mujtama'-:-Al-balad al-aniina rukhnaaha wa chifnaaha samhe marra waahid.
Kan Allah biriidna,yiwaddiina fi l-balad di wa yantiiha leena hi al-malaane be l-laban wa l-asal.
Wa hassa' da,ma ta'aso Allah wa ma takhaafo min sukkaan al-balad di.Humman lugma kula ma tammo leena-!Wa ilaahaathum al-yahmuuhum kula aboohum wa laakin aniina Allah ma'aana.Wa fi chaan da,ma takhaafo minhum.
Wa be sabab da,kulla l-mujtama' dawwaro yarjumuuhum.Wa tawwaali,majd Allah baan fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' giddaam kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Lahaddi mata al-cha'ab da yahgirni-?Be kulla l-ajaayib al-ana sawweethum fi usuthum kula humman ma aamano beyi.Yi'aamunu beyi mata-?
Achaan da,ana ninazzil fooghum waba wa ma nantiihum warasathum.Wa minnak inta ana namrug umma kabiire wa chadiide minhum.
Wa laakin Muusa gaal le Allah-:-Al-Masriyiin ya'arfu kadar inta bas maragt al-cha'ab da be gudurtak min usuthum
wa hajjo beyah le sukkaan al-balad di.Wa be da,sukkaan al-balad di kula sim'o kadar inta Allah gaa'id fi usut cha'abak da.Wa bayyant nafsak leehum wa humman chaafo majdak be uyuunhum.Wa sahaabaaytak gaa'ide min foog leehum wa inta bas maachi giddaamhum be nahaar fi amuud hana sahaab wa be l-leel fi amuud hana naar.
Wa kan inta katalt al-cha'ab da khachum waahid,al-umam al-yasma'o be l-khabar hana l-cheyy al-inta sawweetah da,yuguulu-:
--Daahu Allah ma gidir yiwaddi al-cha'ab fi l-balad al-hu halaf wa gaal yantiiha leehum.Achaan da,hu dammaraahum fi l-sahara.--
Wa hassa' wassif azamat gudurtak,ya Rabb,achaan inta gult-:
--Ana Allah al-Sabuur wa l-Muhibb,nakhfir le l-khaati wa l-aasi.Wa laakin al-muznib ma naj'alah bari.Wa ni'aakhib al-iyaal be zunuub abbahaathum lahaddi l-zurriiye al-taalta wa l-raab'e.--
Ya Rabb,be rahmatak al-wasii'e akhfir le l-cha'ab dool khataayaahum misil inta khafart leehum min maragtuhum min balad Masir lahaddi jibtuhum hini.
Wa Allah radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana khafart leehum be sabab su'aalak.
Sahiih,ana hayy wa majdi yamla kulla l-ard.
Wa l-naas dool kulluhum chaafo majdi wa l-ajaayib al-ana sawweethum fi Masir wa fi l-sahara di wa be da kula,jarrabooni achara marraat wa ma sim'o kalaami.
Wa fi chaan da,waahid minhum ma yichiif al-balad al-ana halaft nantiiha le juduudhum.Wa l-yahguruuni kula,waahid minhum ma yichiifha.
Wa laakin abdi Kaalib galbah bigi minhum chig.Hu taaba' kalaami bala chakk.Hu da,ana niwaddiih fi l-ard al-hu raakh foogha wa zurriiytah yichiiluuha wa yaskunu foogha.
Wa hassa',al-Amaalikh wa l-Kan'aaniyiin saakniin fi l-wudyaan.Wa intu kamaan,ambaakir gabbulu wa amchu battaan fi l-sahara be l-derib al-yamchi beyah al-bahar al-Ahmar.
Le mata mujtama' Bani Israa'iil al-fasliin dool yuluumuuni-?Wa ana simi't al-chakwa wa l-luwaama al-Bani Israa'iil gaaymiin beeha diddi.
Guul leehum-:--Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,ni'aamilku hasab kalaamku al-intu gultuuh leyi.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Intu al-hasabooku min umur 20 sana wa foog,kulluku tumuutu fi l-sahara di achaan gammeetu tuluumuuni.
Abadan intu ma tadkhulu fi l-balad al-halaft wa gult nantiiha leeku le taskunu foogha.Illa Kaalib wileed Yafuuna wa Yachuu' wileed Nuun bas yadkhuluuha.
Wa iyaalku al-gultu yabgo kasiibe,niwaddiihum wa humman yadkhulu fi l-balad al-intu abeetuuha.
Wa laakin intu dool kamaan,tumuutu fi l-sahara di.
Wa iyaalku yabgo ruhhal wa yarhalo fi l-sahara le muddit 40 sana wa yat'abo be sabab khiyaanitku.Wa ta'abhum da,ma yikammil illa kan intu kulluku muttu fi l-sahara.
Wa l-arba'iin sana dool fi adad al-arba'iin yoom al-intu rukhtu wa chiftu fooghum al-balad.Wa tilhammalo ikhaab khataayaaku le muddit 40 sana wa da ayyi yoom yisaawi sana.Wa be da,ta'arfu adaawti.--
Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah-:--Da bas al-cheyy al-ana nisawwiih le kulla l-mujtama' al-fasliin al-gammo diddi.Humman dool yikammulu wa yumuutu fi l-sahara di.-
Wa l-naas al-Muusa rassalaahum macho raakho wa chaafo al-balad gabbalo wa ayyaro al-balad.Wa battaan gammo harracho kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil didd Muusa.
Wa l-naas dool maato be waba giddaam Allah achaan humman gammo ayyaro al-balad al-humman chaafooha.
Wa min al-naas al-macho raakho wa chaafo al-balad illa Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa Kaalib wileed Yafuuna bas ma maato.
Wa wakit Muusa kallamaahum le Bani Israa'iil be l-kalaam da,humman hizno hizin chadiid.
Wa ambaakir be fajur badri,Bani Israa'iil gammo macho ale balad al-jibaal wa gaalo-:-Sahiih,aniina aznabna wa laakin hassa' khassadna namchu fi l-balad al-wassafaaha leena Allah.
Wa laakin Muusa gaal-:-Maala tikhaalufu kalaam Allah-?Chokholku da,battaan ma yanjah.
Wa hassa' da,ma tamchu-!Achaan Allah ma gaa'id fi usutku wa kan tamchu,kula udwaanku yaktuluuku.
Wa l-Amaalikh wa l-Kan'aaniyiin gaa'idiin giddaamku wa yaktuluuku achaan intu abeetu ma titaabu'u Allah.Wa hu kula ma yukuun ma'aaku.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gawwo ruuseehum wa macho ale balad al-jibaal wa laakin wa la sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wa la Muusa ma harrako min al-mu'askar.
Wa l-Amaalikh wa l-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi l-jibaal nazalo fooghum wa haaraboohum wa taradoohum lahaddi hillit Hurma.
Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Kan dakhaltu fi l-balad al-nantiiha leeku wa sakantu foogha,
waajib tigaddumu le Allah min bagarku aw khanamku hadiiye muharraga aw dahiiye muharraga aw dahiiye aakhara.Wa da achaan tihaggugu wa'adku aw tigaddumu hadiiye be niiyitku aw wakit tilimmu le l-iid wa hu yarda be riihitha.
--Wa l-yigaddim al-hadiiye di le Allah,yigaddim ma'aaha hadiiye hana dagiig kooro mukhalbat be liitir hana dihin.
Wa battaan yigaddim liitir hana khamar hadiiyat charaab ma'a ayyi kharuuf dahiiye muharraga aw dahiiye aakhara.
--Wa kan le l-kabich kamaan,yichiil ma'aayah hadiiye hana dagiig koorteen mukhalbat be liitir wa nuss hana dihin.
Wa yichiil liitir wa nuss hana khamar hadiiyat charaab wa yigaddimha le Allah wa hu yarda be riihitha.
--Wa kan yigaddim le Allah toor dahiiye muharraga aw dahiiye aakhara le yihaggig wa'adah aw le dahiiyat al-salaama,
yigaddim ma'aayah hadiiye talaata kooro hana dagiig mukhalbat be liitreen hana dihin.
Wa yichiil liitreen hana khamar hadiiyat charaab wa yigaddimha hadiiye muharraga le Allah wa hu yarda be riihitha.
--Wa yisawwi misil da ma'a ayyi hadiiye hana toor wa kabich wa kharuuf wa anzaay.
Wa kan al-bahaayim al-yigaddimhum dool katiiriin kula,yisawwi ma'a ayyi waahid misil da.
Wa kan ayyi muwaatin yigaddim al-hadaaya al-muharragiin le Allah,khalli yisawwi misil da wa Allah yarda be riihithum.
--Wa kan naadum ajnabi gaa'id ma'aaku mudda tawiile wa yidoor yigaddim hadiiye muharraga le Allah wa hu yarda be riihitha,khalli yisawwi misil intu gaa'idiin tisawwuuh.
Wa da yabga leeku chart daayim min zurriiye le zurriiye le intu kulluku wa le l-ajnabi al-gaa'id ma'aaku kula.Wa tisawwu misil da sawa sawa giddaam Allah.
Wa da yabga gaanuun waahid wa chart waahid leeku intu wa le l-ajnabi al-gaa'id ma'aaku.-
Hajji le Bani Israa'iil wa guul leehum-:--Kan dakhaltu fi l-balad al-niwaddiiku foogha
wa kan taakulu min khubzitha,gaddumu minha hadiiye le Allah.
Wa min awwal dagiigku,sawwu khubza wa gaddumuuha leyi hadiiye misil al-hadiiye al-intu tigaddumuuha leyi wakt al-gati' hana ziraa'itku.
Wa min zurriiye le zurriiye,gaddumu leyi hadiiye min awwal dagiigku.
--Wa kan intu kulluku bala raayku bas ma tabbagtu waahid min wasaaya Allah al-gaalaahum le Muusa,
ya'ni kulla l-wasaaya al-amaraaku beehum Allah be waasitat Muusa min awwal yoom wa ba'ad da min zurriiye le zurriiye,
wa kan mujtama' Bani Israa'iil sawwo zanib bala raayhum wa kulluhum ma irfooh,khalaas kulluhum yigaddumu toor dahiiye muharraga le Allah wa hu yarda be riihitha.Wa yigaddumu hadiiye hana dagiig wa hadiiyat charaab misil fi l-gaanuun wa tees dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib.
Wa raajil al-diin yisawwi kaffaara le zunuub kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa humman yalgo al-khufraan.Achaan al-zanib da sawwooh bala raayhum wa humman jaabo dahiiye muharraga le Allah wa gaddamo dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib.
Wa l-khufraan da le kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa le l-ajnabi al-saakin ma'aahum achaan al-zanib al-sawwooh bala raayhum da bukhuss kulla l-cha'ab.
--Wa kan al-zanib da sawwaah naadum waahid bas,hu yigaddim anzaay bitt sana dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib.
Wa raajil al-diin yisawwi kaffaara le l-zanib hana l-naadum al-sawwaah bala raayah giddaam Allah.Wa wakit raajil al-diin yisawwi kaffaara,al-naadum da yalga al-khufraan.
Kan al-naadum min Bani Israa'iil aw kan naadum ajnabi saakin ma'aahum kula,al-gaanuun hana l-zanib al-yisawwuuh bala raayhum da waahid bas.
--Wa kan naadum min Bani Israa'iil aw ajnabi gaa'id ma'aahum kula kan sawwa zanib be niiytah,al-naadum da sawwa jariime didd Allah.Wa be sabab da,waajib yafsuluuh min ahalah.
Achaan hu aba kalaam Allah wa khaalaf wasiiyaatah.Wa be da,waajib yafsuluuh wa yilhammal ikhaabah.-
Wa yoom waahid fi l-sahara,Bani Israa'iil ligo naadum waahid gaa'id yilaggit hatab fi yoom al-sabt.
Wa humman karabooh le l-naadum da wa waddooh giddaam Muusa wa Haaruun wa kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil.
Al-naadum da khattooh fi l-sijin achaan fi l-wakit daak,gaanuun al-yihaakumuuh beyah ke ma fiih.
Wa khalaas ba'ad da,Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Khalli kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil yilimmu barra min al-fariig wa yarjumu al-naadum da lahaddi l-moot.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-mujtama' waddooh le l-naadum da barra min al-fariig wa rajamooh lahaddi maat.Wa da misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa battaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:
Hajji le Bani Israa'iil wa guul leehum-:--Min zurriiye le zurriiye tisawwu chanchali fi daayir khulgaanku wa khayyutuuh be kheet zahri.
Wa wakit tichiifu al-chanchali da,tizzakkaro kulla wasaaya Allah wa titabbuguuhum.Wa be da,ma titaabu'u chahwaat guluubku wa uyuunku al-yiwadduuku fi l-isyaan.
Wa misil da,tizzakkaro kulla wasiiyaatah wa titabbuguuhum wa tukuunu ummat Allah al-saalhe.
Wa ta'arfu ana bas Allah Ilaahku al-maragtuku min balad Masir le nabga Ilaahku.Wa ana bas Allah Ilaahku.-
Wa Khuurah wileed Yishaar min khachum beet Gahaat min gabiilat Laawi chaal min gabiilat Ra'uubiin talaata naas wa humman Dataan wa Abiraam iyaal Aliyaab wa Uun wileed Faalat
wa gammo didd Muusa.Wa ma'aahum 250 raajil min chuyuukh wa mas'uuliin fi l-mujtama' wa naas ma'ruufiin fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa humman kulluhum gammo didd Muusa wa Haaruun wa gaalo-:-Chokholku da bigi leena katiir-!Kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil kulluhum mukhassasiin le Allah wa Allah gaa'id ma'aahum.Wa maala intu tichiifu nufuusku ziyaada min jamaa'at Allah-?
Wa wakit Muusa simi' al-kalaam da,waga' be wijhah fi l-turaab.
Wa ba'ad da,gaal le Khuurah wa le naas Bani Israa'iil al-ma'aayah-:-Ambaakir fajur,Allah yiwassif leena al-naadum al-taab'ah wa l-hu khassasah wa ridi beyah le yaji giddaamah.Wa l-naadum al-hu ya'azilah da,hu bas yaji giddaamah.
Daahu al-cheyy al-tisawwuuh,inta Khuurah wa naas Bani Israa'iil al-ma'aak.Ayyi waahid yichiil mukhbar.
Wa ambaakir,subbu fooghum naar wa bakhuur wa gaddumuuh le Allah.Wa l-naadum al-Allah ya'azilah da,hu bas al-mukhassas.Wa chokholku da bigi leena katiir,ya iyaal Laawi.
Wa Muusa gaal battaan le Khuurah-:-Asma'o,ya iyaal Laawi.
Kan Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil azalaaku min mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa ridi beeku le taju giddaamah wa takhdumu fi kheemat Allah wa tagiifu giddaam Bani Israa'iil wa tisaa'uduuhum,da chiyya leeku walla-?
Hu ridi beeku le taju giddaamah,inta wa kulla akhwaanak al-Laawiyiin.Wa battaan tidooru khidmit rujaal al-diin walla-?
Achaan da bas,inta wa kulla naasak gammeetu didd Allah.Wa Haaruun ke,hu yaatu intu tuluumuuh-?
Wa Muusa naadaahum le Dataan wa Abiraam iyaal Aliyaab.Wa laakin humman gaalo leyah-:-Aniina abadan ma naju leek-!
Inta maragtina min balad al-malaane be l-laban wa l-asal wa jibtina numuutu fi l-sahara di.Da ma tammaak walla-?Wa be da kula,battaan tidoor tahkim foogna-?
Be l-sahiih inta ma waddeetna fi balad al-malaane be l-laban wa l-asal.Wa ma anteetna warasa hana ziraa'a wa la jineenaat inab.Inta tahsib aniina matmuusiin walla-?Khalaas,aniina abadan ma naju giddaamak.
Wa min simi' al-kalaam da,Muusa zi'il za'al chadiid wa gaal-:-Ya Allah,ma takhbal hadaayaahum-!Wa abadan ana ma chilt humaar hana naadum wa la sawweet leehum cheyy.
Wa Muusa gaal battaan le Khuurah-:-Inta wa Bani Israa'iil al-ma'aak ambaakir ta'aalu giddaam Allah,inta wa humman wa Haaruun kula.
Wa ayyi waahid min naasak al-miiteen wa khamsiin yichiil mukhbar wa yusubb foogah bakhuur wa ayyi waahid yigaddim mukhbarah giddaam Allah.Wa inta wa Haaruun kula tisawwu nafs al-cheyy,tigaddumu makhaabirku.
Wa khalaas ayyi waahid chaal mukhbarah wa sabba foogah naar wa bakhuur wa wagafo fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa' ma'a Muusa wa Haaruun.
Wa Khuurah lamma kulla naasah giddaam Muusa wa Haaruun fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa tawwaali,majd Allah baan le kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa wa Haaruun-:
Amurgu min usut mujtama' Bani Israa'iil dool achaan ana nidammirhum hassa'.
Wa laakin fi l-bakaan da,Muusa wa Haaruun waga'o be wujuuhhum fi l-turaab wa gaalo-:-Ya Rabb,inta al-Ilaah al-tamluk fi kulla makhluug hayy.Takhdab le kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil be sabab naadum waahid sawwa zanib walla-?
Wa Allah radda le Muusa wa gaal-:
Guul le mujtama' Bani Israa'iil yikissu ba'iid min khiyam Khuurah wa Dataan wa Abiraam.
Wa Muusa gamma macha bakaan Dataan wa Abiraam wa kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil taaba'ooh.
Wa Muusa hajja le mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa gaal-:-Kissu ba'iid min khiyam al-naas al-aasiyiin dool.Wa ma tilammusu khumaamhum achaan ma tumuutu intu kula be sabab zunuubhum.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-cha'ab kasso ba'iid min al-khiyam al-saakniin fooghum Khuurah wa Dataan wa Abiraam.Wa laakin Dataan wa Abiraam marago waagfiin fi khuchuum biibaan khiyamhum ma'a awiinhum wa iyaalhum wa iyaal iyaalhum.
Wa Muusa gaal-:-Be misil da,ta'arfu kadar Allah bas rassalaani achaan nisawwi kulla cheyy be amrah.Wa ta'arfu ana ma sawweet cheyy be niiyti ana.
Kan al-naas dool yumuutu moot tabii'i walla yabga leehum misil bigi fi l-naas,Allah ma rassalaani.
Laakin kan Allah yisawwi cheyy al-abadan ma bigi,misil kan al-ard tinfatih wa tazruthum humman wa kulla cheyy al-induhum wa hayyiin bas yindafnu ma'a l-maytiin,be da intu ta'arfu kadar al-naas dool hagaro Allah.
Wa min Muusa kammal kalaamah da,tawwaali al-ard anchaggat tihit rijleehum.
Wa zaratathum humman wa aayilaathum wa zaratat kulla naas Khuurah wa khumaamhum kula.
Humman wa khumaamhum hayyiin bas andafano ma'a l-maytiin.Wa l-ard ansaddat fooghum wa khalaas,bigo ma fiihum fi ust al-mujtama'.
Wa min chiddit siraakhhum,kulla naas Israa'iil al-sim'oohum arrado wa gaalo-:-Yalla najru achaan al-ard ma tazrutna aniina kula-!
Wa Allah nazzal naar akalat al-miiteen wa khamsiin raajil al-gaa'idiin yigaddumu bakhuur le Allah.
Guul le raajil al-diin Ali'aazar wileed Haaruun yisill al-makhaabir min ust al-naar achaan humman mukhaddasiin wa khalli yichattit al-jamur da ba'iid.
Wa be l-makhaabir hana l-naas al-kaffo zunuubhum be ruuhhum dool,dugguuhum misil al-birich wa aksu beehum al-madbah.Wa l-makhaabir al-gaddamoohum le Allah dool mukhaddasiin.Wa l-makhaabir al-daggoohum dool yabgo alaamat tahziir le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,raajil al-diin Ali'aazar chaal al-makhaabir hana l-nahaas al-gaddamoohum al-naas al-hirgo.Wa daggoohum misil al-birich wa kaso beehum al-madbah.
Wa da yanti fikir le Bani Israa'iil achaan ayyi naadum al-ma min zurriiyit Haaruun ma yigaddim bakhuur le Allah wa yahrag misil Khuurah wa Bani Israa'iil al-ma'aayah.Wa da misil Allah gaalah be waasitat Muusa.
Wa ambaakir fajur,kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil gammo didd Muusa wa Haaruun wa gaalo-:-Intu bas kataltu cha'ab Allah-!
Wa laakin wakit kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil lammo wa gammo didd Muusa wa Haaruun wa humman muwajjihiin ale kheemat al-ijtimaa',tawwaali chaafo al-sahaabaay khattat al-kheema wa majd Allah baan.
Wa Muusa wa Haaruun jo giddaam kheemat al-ijtimaa'
wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal-:
Amurgu min usut mujtama' Bani Israa'iil dool achaan ana nidammirhum hassa'.-Fi l-bakaan da,Muusa wa Haaruun waga'o be wujuuhhum fi l-turaab.
Wa Muusa gaal le Haaruun-:-Chiil al-mukhbar wa subb foogah jamur min al-madbah wa subb foogah bakhuur wa amchi ajala le mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa sawwi leehum al-kaffaara achaan khadab Allah nazal fooghum wa l-waba bada khalaas.
Wa Haaruun chaal al-mukhbar misil Muusa gaalah leyah wa jara le l-cha'ab wa ligi al-waba bada fi usuthum khalaas.Hu sabba al-bakhuur fi l-mukhbar wa sawwa leehum al-kaffaara.
Wa hu wagaf ambeen al-hayyiin wa l-maytiin wa khalaas al-waba wagaf.
Wa l-naas al-katalhum al-waba adadhum 14-700.Wa da bala l-naas al-maato fi muchkilat Khuurah.
Wa Haaruun gabbal le Muusa fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa' achaan al-waba wagaf khalaas.
Guul le Bani Israa'iil ayyi cheekh gabiila yijiib asa wa da fi adad gabaayilhum al-atnaachar.Wa aktib usum ayyi cheekh fi asaatah.
Wa fi asaat gabiilat Laawi aktib usum Haaruun achaan ayyi cheekh gabiila indah asa waahide.
Wa khutt al-isay dool fi lubb kheemat al-ijtimaa' giddaam al-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada fi l-bakaan al-ana nigaabilku foogah.
Wa l-naadum al-asaatah tikhaddir wa tisawwi nuwwaar,hu da bas al-ana azaltah.Wa be da,ana niwaggif al-luwaama al-gaaymiin beeha Bani Israa'iil didduku.
Wa khalaas,Muusa kallam le Bani Israa'iil wa kulla chuyuukhhum ayyi waahid jaab asaatah.Wa l-chuyuukh al-atnaachar ayyi cheekh gabiila jaab asaatah.Wa asaat Haaruun kula gaa'ide fi ust al-isay dool.
Wa Muusa khatta al-isay dool giddaam Allah fi lubb al-kheema al-foogha al-sanduug al-indah liihaan al-mu'aahada.
Wa ambaakir fajur,Muusa dakhal fi l-kheemat di wa chaaf asaat Haaruun al-min gabiilat Laawi khaddarat wa sawwat nuwwaar wa indaha iyaal naajdiin.
Wa Muusa marag kulla l-isay min giddaam Allah wa khattaahum giddaam Bani Israa'iil wa ayyi cheekh chaaf asaatah wa chaalha.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Gabbil asaat Haaruun wa khuttaha giddaam al-sanduug da wa ahfadha misil alaama le l-mu'aaridiin.Wa tiwaggif kalaamhum diddi wa be da,ma yumuutu.
Wa Muusa tabbag kalaam Allah sawa sawa misil hu amarah beyah.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gaalo le Muusa-:-Chiif daahu aniina kullina ke nahlako wa numuutu-!
Wa ayyi naadum al-yigarrib le kheemat Allah da yumuut-!Wa da,ma numuutu kullina lahaddi aakhirna walla-?
Wa Allah gaal le Haaruun-:-Inta wa iyaalak wa naas min ahalak tilhammalo al-ikhaab hana ayyi khata al-yukuun fi l-mu'iddaat hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa inta wa iyaalak bas tilhammalo al-ikhaab hana ayyi khata al-yukuun fi khidmit rujaal al-diin.
Wa akhwaanak naas gabiiltak al-Laawiyiin,khalli humman kula yigarrubu ma'aak le l-beet al-mukhaddas wa yakhdumu ma'aak wa yisaa'uduuk.Wa laakin inta wa iyaalak bas tagiifu giddaam al-kheema al-foogha al-sanduug.
Al-Laawiyiin yakhdumu tihit amrak wa yahfado kulla kheemat al-ibaada wa laakin ma yigarrubu le l-mu'iddaat al-mukhassasiin wa la le l-madbah achaan ma yijiibu al-moot le nufuushum wa la leeku intu.
Wa humman bas yisaa'uduuku wa yakhdumu ma'aaku fi kulla l-khidme al-tukuun fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa yahfadooha.Naadum aakhar ke ma yaji yakhdim ma'aaku.
Wa intu bas tahfado al-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa l-madbah wa be da,battaan khadab Allah ma yanzil fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa daahu ana azalt akhwaanku al-Laawiyiin min Bani Israa'iil wa anteethum leeku misil hadiiye achaan yakhdumu fi kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa inta Haaruun wa awlaadak ahfado khidmit rujaal al-diin wa akhdumu fi ayyi cheyy al-bukhuss al-madbah wa l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid al-gaa'id khaadi le l-sitaar.Wa khidmit rujaal al-diin di,ana anteetha leeku intu bas.Wa ayyi naadum aakhar kan yigarrib le l-khidme di yumuut.
Wa battaan Allah gaal le Haaruun-:-Daahu ana nantiik mas'uuliiye fi kulla l-hadaaya al-mukhaddasiin al-yigaddumuuhum leyi Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-hadaaya dool,ana anteethum leek wa le awlaadak wa da yabga leeku hagg daayim.
Wa daahu haggak al-talgaah min al-hadaaya al-mukhaddasiin al-ma muharragiin misil kulla l-hadaaya hana l-dagiig wa kulla dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib wa l-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-khata al-yigaddumuuhum leyi ana.Kulla l-hadaaya al-mukhaddasiin dool,ana nantiihum leek inta wa awlaadak.
Wa min al-hadaaya al-mukhaddasiin dool inta taakul wa kulla l-dukuur min iyaalak yaakuluuhum wa aj'alhum mukhaddasiin leek.
Wa daahu cheyy aakhar kula yabga haggak.Wa humman al-hadaaya al-yarfa'oohum Bani Israa'iil wa yigaddumuuhum,dool kula ana nantiihum leek inta wa le awlaadak wa le banaatak al-gaa'idaat ma'aak.Kulli insaan taahir min ahal beetak yagdar yaakul minhum wa da yabga leeku hagg daayim.
Wa nantiik al-zaka al-yigaddumuuha le Allah min ahsan al-dihin wa ahsan al-khamar wa l-gameh.
Wa ana nantiik inta kula awwal intaaj al-yigaddumuuh le Allah min ziraa'ithum wa kulli insaan taahir min ahal beetak yagdar yaakul minnah.
Wa kulla cheyy al-yikhassusuuh leyi Bani Israa'iil,ana nantiih leek inta.
Wa battaan nantiik kulla awlaad al-bikir al-yigaddumuuhum leyi ana Allah kan min al-naas walla min al-bahaayim kula.Wa laakin kulla awlaad al-bikir min al-naas wa l-bahaayim al-ma taahiriin,chiil tamanhum al-yafdoohum beyah.
Wa wakit umur al-wileed yitimm chahar,afdooh be 5 hajar fudda.Wa hasab al-wazin al-rasmi hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas,ayyi hajar fudda yawzin 12 giraam.
Wa laakin ma tafda wileed al-bikir hana l-bagar wa l-khanam wa l-inze achaan dool mukhassasiin le Allah.Adbahhum wa ruchch dammuhum fi l-madbah wa harrig chahamhum hadiiye muharraga al-Allah yarda be riihitha.
Wa l-laham hana l-hadaaya dool yabga hanaak ma'a l-zoor al-yarfa'ooh wa yigaddumuuh hadiiye wa l-gaayme al-zeene.
Kulla l-hadaaya al-mukhaddasiin al-yigaddumuuhum Bani Israa'iil le Allah yabgo hagg daayim leek inta wa awlaadak wa banaatak al-gaa'idaat ma'aak.Wa da yabga leek wa le zurriiytak mu'aahada daayme ma'a Allah al-abadan ma tingati'.
Wa battaan Allah gaal le Haaruun-:-Inta ma indak warasa fi arduhum wa la indak hagg ma'aahum.Ana bas nabga leek misil hagg wa warasa fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Le zurriiyit Laawi ana nantiihum kulla l-uchuur fi Israa'iil warasa.Wa da fi badal al-khidme al-humman gaa'idiin yakhdumuuha fi kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa be da,Bani Israa'iil ma yigarrubu battaan le kheemat al-ijtimaa' achaan da zanib al-yijiib leehum al-moot.
Wa l-Laawiyiin humman bas yakhdumu fi kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa humman yilhammalo natiijat khataahum.Wa da yabga leehum chart daayim min zurriiye le zurriiye.Wa laakin ma induhum warasa al-yawrusuuha misil Bani Israa'iil.
Al-uchuur al-yigaddumuuhum Bani Israa'iil hadiiye le Allah dool,ana anteethum le l-Laawiyiin misil warasa.Achaan ana gult humman ma induhum warasa al-yawrusuuha misil Bani Israa'iil.
Guul le l-Laawiyiin-:--Kan ligo min Bani Israa'iil al-uchuur al-ana anteethum leehum misil warasa,khalli humman kula yamurgu uchur al-uchuur hadiiye le Allah.
Wa da yabga leeku misil hadaaya al-yigaddumuuhum al-naas al-aakhariin min al-gameh fi l-madagg aw min asiir al-inab.
Wa misil da,intu kula tigaddumu hadaaya le Allah min kulla l-uchuur al-intu talgoohum min Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-hadaaya dool hana Allah,antuuhum le Haaruun raajil al-diin.
Wa min kulla cheyy al-yantuuku,gaddumu minnah hadiiye le Allah wa l-hadiiye al-ahsan khassusuuha leyah.--
Wa guul leehum battaan-:--Kan gaddamtu min kulla cheyy al-ahsan,al-faddal yagood leeku intu al-Laawiyiin misil al-faddal le l-naas min al-gameh fi l-madagg wa asiir al-inab.
Wa intu wa aayilaatku tagdaro taakulu minnah fi ayyi bakaan achaan di bas ujrat khidmitku al-gaa'idiin tisawwuuha fi kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa be misil da,wakit gaddamtu al-ahsan min al-achya dool,ma tilhammalo ayyi zanib.Wa ahtarumu al-hadaaya al-mukhaddasiin hana Bani Israa'iil wa be da,ma tijiibu al-moot le nufuusku.-
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa wa Haaruun-:
Dool humman gawaaniin al-charii'a al-Allah amar beehum.Guul le Bani Israa'iil yijiibu leek bagara chagra ma mukhalgana wa ma indaha ayyi eeb wa yoom waahid kula ma harato beeha.
Wa l-bagara di sallumuuha le raajil al-diin Ali'aazar wa yiwaddiiha barra min al-fariig wa yadbahooha giddaamah.
Hu yichiil min dammaha be usba'ah wa yuruchchah sab'a marraat ale jiihat khachum kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa fi giddaam raajil al-diin Ali'aazar,yiharrugu al-bagara di kullaha ke,farwitha wa lahamha wa dammaha wa ba'arha kula.
Wa raajil al-diin yichiil uud hana arz wa firi' hana zuufa wa kheet ahmar wa yazgulhum fi l-naar al-gaa'ide tahrag foogha al-bagara.
Wa raajil al-diin yikhassil khulgaanah wa yilbarrad wa ba'ad da,yigabbil fi l-fariig wa laakin yagood nijis lahaddi achiiye.
Wa l-harrag al-bagara kula yikhassil khulgaanah wa yilbarrad be almi wa laakin yagood nijis lahaddi achiiye.
Wa naadum waahid taahir yukhumm al-rumaad hana l-bagara wa yukhuttah barra min al-fariig fi bakaan taahir.Wa mujtama' Bani Israa'iil yahfado al-rumaad le yisawwu beyah almi al-tathiir al-yista'malooh le mahiyiin al-khata.
Wa l-naadum al-yukhumm al-rumaad hana l-bagara,hu kula yikhassil khulgaanah wa laakin yagood nijis lahaddi achiiye.Wa da yabga chart daayim le Bani Israa'iil wa le l-ajnabi al-saakin ma'aahum.
Kan naadum limis janaaza,hu yabga nijis le muddit sab'a yoom.
Wa l-naadum da,khalli yitahhir nafsah be almi al-tathiir al-sawwooh be rumaad al-bagara fi l-yoom al-taalit wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' wa be da,hu yukuun taahir.Wa laakin kan ma yitahhir nafsah fi l-yoom al-taalit wa l-yoom al-saabi',hu ma yabga taahir.
Kan naadum limis janaaza wa ma tahhar nafsah,yinajjis kheemat Allah.Wa l-naadum da waajib yafsuluuh min Bani Israa'iil achaan hu ma rachchooh be almi al-tathiir wa hu nijis wa gaa'id be najaastah.
Wa daahu gaanuun al-bukhuss al-naadum al-yumuut fi l-kheema.Wa fi l-haala di,ayyi naadum al-yadkhul fi l-kheema di aw gaa'id foogha yabga nijis le muddit sab'a yoom.
Wa ayyi maa'uun maftuuh al-ma indah sidaade masduuda foogah kula yukuun nijis.
Ayyi naadum kan maachi fi l-kadaade wa limis naadum maktuul be l-seef aw limis naadum mayyit moot saakit aw limis udaam hana naadum aw limis khabur,al-naadum da yabga nijis le muddit sab'a yoom.
Wa le l-naadum al-ma taahir da,yichiilu min rumaad al-bagara al-harragooha le kaffaarat al-zanib wa yusubbuuh fi maa'uun wa yusubbu foogah almi nadiif.
Wa raajil waahid taahir yichiil firi' hana zuufa wa yidissah fi l-almi da wa yuruchch beyah al-kheema wa kulla l-mawaa'iin wa kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi lubbaha.Wa yuruchch al-naadum al-limis udaam hana naadum mayyit aw limis naadum maktuul be l-seef aw limis naadum mayyit moot saakit aw limis khabur.
Wa l-raajil al-taahir yuruchch al-naadum al-nijis fi l-yoom al-taalit wa l-yoom al-saabi'.Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' da,khataayah yinmahi.Wa ba'ad da,yikhassil khulgaanah wa yilbarrad wa be achiiye hu yabga taahir.
Wa laakin al-naadum al-najjas nafsah wa ma tahharha,waajib yafsuluuh min al-cha'ab achaan hu najjas al-beet al-mukhaddas hana Allah.Wa l-naadum da gaa'id be najaastah achaan ma rachchooh be almi al-tathiir.
Wa da yabga leehum chart daayim.Wa l-naadum al-yuruchch almi al-tathiir da,waajib yikhassil khulgaanah.Wa kan naadum limis almi al-tathiir da,yukuun nijis lahaddi achiiye.
Ayyi cheyy al-yilammisah al-naadum al-nijis da,yukuun nijis wa l-naadum limis naadum nijis,hu kula yukuun nijis lahaddi achiiye.
Wa fi l-chahar al-awwal,kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wassalo fi saharat Siin wa ga'ado fi hillit Khaadich wa da bakaan Mariyam maatat foogah wa dafanooha.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,almi ma fiih wa Bani Israa'iil lammo wa gammo didd Muusa wa Haaruun.
Wa humman harajo Muusa wa gaalo-:-Akheer leena kan mutna ma'a akhwaanna al-maato min khadab Allah.
Maala jibtu jamaa'at Allah fi l-sahara di-?Achaan numuutu aniina wa bahaayimna walla-?
Maala maragtuuna min Masir wa jibtuuna fi l-bakaan al-fasil da-?Wa l-bakaan da ma indah ma'aach wa la indah tiin wa la indah inab wa la indah rummaan.Wa almi hana charaab kula ma fiih.
Wa Muusa wa Haaruun khallo al-cha'ab wa macho fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa waga'o be wujuuhhum fi l-turaab.Wa khalaas majd Allah baan leehum.
Chiil asaatak.Inta wa akhuuk Haaruun limmu mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa giddaamhum kulluhum guulu le l-hajar-:--Amrug almi-!- Wa khalaas al-hajar yamrug almi wa be l-almi al-yamrug min al-hajar da,azgi kulla Bani Israa'iil wa bahaayimhum.
Wa misil Allah amarah beyah,Muusa chaal al-asa min giddaam Allah min kheemat al-ibaada.
Wa Muusa wa Haaruun lammo kulla Bani Israa'iil giddaam al-hajar.Wa Muusa gaal leehum-:-Asma'o,ya aasiyiin-!Aniina namurgu leeku almi min al-hajar da walla-?
Wa Muusa rafa' iidah wa darab al-hajar marrateen be asaatah.Wa khalaas almi jara be katara min al-hajar.Wa mujtama' Bani Israa'iil chirbo wa zago kulla bahaayimhum.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa wa Haaruun-:-Intu ma aamantu beyi wa giddaam Bani Israa'iil ma ahtaramtuuni ana al-Khudduus.Wa fi chaan da,intu abadan ma tiwaddu al-cha'ab da fi l-ard al-ana anteetha leehum.
Wa l-bakaan da sammooh almi Mariiba (ma'anaatah almi al-huraaj) achaan Bani Israa'iil gammo didd Allah.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Allah wassaf leehum khadaastah.
Wa min Khaadich,Muusa rassal naas le malik Adoom.Wa l-naas dool gaalo le l-malik-:-Akhwaanak Bani Israa'iil yuguulu leek ke-:--Inta ta'arif kulla l-machaakil al-bigo foogna.
Wa juduudna macho fi balad Masir wa aniina sakanna foogha mudda tawiile.Wa hinaak al-Masriyiin sawwo al-fasaala foog juduudna wa foogna aniina kula.
Wa aniina sarakhna wa chahadna Allah wa hu simi'na wa rassal leena malak le yamrugna min Masir.Wa daahu aniina fi Khaadich al-hille al-gariib le huduud baladak.
Wa hassa' nidooru nuchuggu ardak wa ma nitallufu al-ziraa'a wa la chadar al-inab wa ma nacharbo almi biyaarak.Aniina nichiilu al-derib al-usmah Derib al-Malik wa la nimayyulu minnah isra wa la zeene lahaddi nagta'o ardak.-
Wa laakin malik Adoom gaal-:-Ma tuchuggu ardi.Wa kan abeetu,namrug leeku wa nihaaribku.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gaalo leyah-:-Aniina nichiilu al-derib wa kan nidooru almi leena walla le bahaayimna kula,nachruuh minnak chari.Wa laakin nidooru minnak tikhalliina nuchuggu ardak bas.
Wa laakin malik Adoom gaal leehum-:-Ma tuchuggu ardi-!-Wa hu marag laagaahum be deech kabiir wa gawi.
Wa be misil da,malik Adoom aba ma yikhalliihum le Bani Israa'iil yuchuggu ardah.Wa humman gabbalo wa macho be derib aakhar.
Wa kulla l-mujtama' saaro min Khaadich wa nazalo fi jabal Hoor
al-gaa'id fi huduud balad Adoom.Wa hinaak Allah hajja le Muusa wa Haaruun wa gaal-:
Haaruun yumuut wa yalhag abbahaatah.Wa hu ma yadkhul fi l-balad al-ana anteetha le Bani Israa'iil achaan intu isiitu kalaami fi almi Mariiba.
Wa inta,ya Muusa,chiil Haaruun wa wileedah Ali'aazar wa atla' beehum fi jabal Hoor.
Wa sill khulgaan raajil al-diin min Haaruun wa labbishum le wileedah Ali'aazar wa khalaas Haaruun yumuut fi l-bakaan daak.
Wa Muusa sawwa kulla cheyy misil Allah amarah beyah.Giddaam kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil,humman tala'o fi jabal Hoor.
Wa Muusa salla khulgaan Haaruun minnah wa labbasaahum le wileedah Ali'aazar.Wa khalaas Haaruun maat fi raas jabal Hoor.Wa ba'ad da,Muusa wa Ali'aazar nazalo min al-jabal.
Wa wakit kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil irfo kadar Haaruun maat khalaas,humman bako wa hizno leyah le muddit 30 yoom.
Wa wakit al-malik Araad al-Kan'aani al-gaa'id yaskun fi saharat Nagab simi' kadar Bani Israa'iil jaayiin be derib Ataariim,hu laagaahum wa haarabaahum wa karab minhum masaajiin.
Wa ba'ad da,Bani Israa'iil aahado Allah wa gaalo-:-Kan dasseet leena al-cha'ab da fi iideenna,aniina kula nidammuru kulla hillaalhum ma nikhallu minhum cheyy.
Wa Allah khibil kalaamhum wa nasaraahum fi l-Kan'aaniyiin dool.Wa Bani Israa'iil dammaro kulla l-Kan'aaniyiin dool wa hillaalhum ma khallo minhum cheyy.Wa sammo al-bakaan da Hurma (ma'anaatah al-damaar).
Wa Bani Israa'iil saaro min jabal Hoor wa macho be l-derib al-yufuut be l-bahar al-Ahmar achaan humman yidooru yihawwugu ba'iid min balad Adoom.Wa laakin fi l-derib,humman ma sabaro.
Wa gammo didd al-Rabb wa didd Muusa wa gaalo-:-Maala maragtuuna min balad Masir wa jibtuuna le numuutu fi l-sahara di-?Achaan hini ma fi khubza wa la almi wa akilna da,akil ma yanfa'.Taar leena khalaas.
Wa khalaas Allah rassal leehum dabiib amchideegaat wa addo katiir min Bani Israa'iil wa katalaahum.
Wa Bani Israa'iil jo le Muusa wa gaalo leyah-:-Aniina aznabna wakit gammeena didd Allah wa diddak inta.Hassa' da,achhad leena Allah achaan yiba''id minnina al-dabiib da.-Wa Muusa chahad leehum Allah.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Asna' daabi amchideegaat wa arfa'ah foog fi uud.Wa ayyi naadum al-addaah daabi kan chaafah,battaan ma yumuut.
Wa khalaas,Muusa sana' daabi hana nahaas wa rafa'ah foog fi uud.Wa wakit daabi yi'addi naadum,kan al-naadum da chaaf al-daabi hana l-nahaas da battaan ma yumuut.
Wa Bani Israa'iil saaro wa nazalo fi Ubuut.
Wa battaan saaro min Ubuut wa nazalo fi Iyy Abaariim fi l-sahara sabaah min balad Muwaab.
Wa min al-bakaan da,saaro wa nazalo fi khachum waadi Zarad.
Wa minnah saaro wa nazalo khaadi le waadi Arnuun wa da l-waadi al-yuchugg al-sahara wa jaayi min turaab al-Amuuriyiin.Wa hu gaa'id huduud ambeen balad Muwaab wa balad al-Amuuriyiin.
Wa fi chaan da,fi kalaam maktuub fi kitaab al-Huruub hana Allah wa l-kalaam da bukhuss madiinat Waahib fi Suufa be wudyaanha wa waadi Arnuun
wa rujuulah al-yusubbu ale madiinat Aar yabgo huduud Muwaab.
Wa min al-bakaan da,saaro wa nazalo fi hillit Biir.Wa da l-bakaan al-Allah amar Muusa wa gaal leyah-:-Limm al-cha'ab wa ana nantiihum almi.
Wa Bani Israa'iil khanno be l-khine da-:-Atmi,ya biir,wa ya naas,khannu leeha katiir.
Wa l-biir di hafarooha al-kubaaraatwa gaddooha al-hukkaambe isay mulukhumwa isay kheezaraanhum.-Wa min al-sahara,saaro lahaddi Mattaana
wa min Mattaana lahaddi Nahliyiil wa min Nahliyiil lahaddi Baamoot.
Wa min Baamoot saaro lahaddi l-waadi al-fi balad Muwaab wa da ale raas jabal al-Fisga al-minnah tinchaaf kulla l-sahara.
Wa Bani Israa'iil rassalo naas le Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin wa gaalo leyah-:
Nidooru nuchuggu ardak wa ma nitallufu al-ziraa'a wa la chadar al-inab wa ma nacharbo almi biyaarak.Aniina nichiilu al-derib al-usmah Derib al-Malik lahaddi nagta'o ardak.
Wa laakin al-malik Siihuun aba ma yanti izin le Bani Israa'iil yuchuggu ardah.Hu lamma deechah wa marag laaga Bani Israa'iil fi l-sahara.Wa hu ja fi Yahaas wa haarabaahum le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil haarabooh wa katalooh be l-seef wa chaalo ardah min waadi Arnuun lahaddi waadi Yabbuukh.Wa laakin wagafo fi l-huduud al-gawiiye hana Bani Ammuun.
Wa Bani Israa'iil chaalo kulla mudun al-Amuuriyiin wa sakano fooghum.Humman sakano fi Hachbuun wa kulla l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha.
Wa Hachbuun hi madiinat Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin al-haarab malik Muwaab al-awwal wa chaal minnah kulla ardah lahaddi waadi Arnuun.
Wa be sabab da,al-khannaayiin gaalo-:-Ta'aalu le madiinat al-malik Siihuunnabnu Hachbuun wa nigawwuuha.
Achaan min Hachbuun maragat naarwa min hillit Siihuun maragat ambalbaalawa akalat hillit Aar fi balad Muwaabwa siyaad al-bakaan al-aalijamb waadi Arnuun.
Ya khasaaritki,ya balad Muwaab-!Ya cha'ab al-ilaahku Kamuuch,intu addammartu khalaas.Intu ja'altu awlaadku matruudiinmin malik al-Amuuriyiinwa hasabtu banaatku masjuunaatfi iideen Siihuun.
Wa laakin hassa' aniina Bani Israa'iilta''anna al-Amuuriyiin be l-huraabwa dammarnaahummin Hachbuun lahaddi Diibuunwa kharabnaahummin Nuufah lahaddi Miidba.
Wa be misil da,Bani Israa'iil sakano fi balad al-Amuuriyiin.
Wa Muusa rassal naas le yuruukhu madiinat Ya'ziir.Wa Bani Israa'iil chaalo kulla l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha.Wa nahabo al-Amuuriyiin al-saakniin fooghum.
Wa ba'ad da,Bani Israa'iil chaalo derib aakhar wa macho ale Baachaan.Wa Oog malik Baachaan marag laagaahum hu wa kulla cha'abah le yihaaribhum fi Idra'i.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Ma takhaaf minnah,ana nisallimah leek fi iidak,hu wa kulla cha'abah wa baladah.Wa inta tisawwi foogah misil inta sawweet foog Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin al-hakam fi Hachbuun.
Wa khalaas Bani Israa'iil annasaro foog Oog malik Baachaan wa katalooh hu wa iyaalah wa kulla cha'abah lahaddi naadum waahid kula minhum ma faddal.Wa chaalo baladah.
Bani Israa'iil saaro wa nazalo fi kadaadit Muwaab sabaah le bahar al-Urdun mugaabiliin Ariiha.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Balaakh wileed Siffuur hu bas malik Muwaab.Wa wakit hu chaaf kulla cheyy al-sawwooh Bani Israa'iil fi l-Amuuriyiin,hu wa cha'abah al-Muwaabiyiin khaafo min katarat Bani Israa'iil.Wa wakit chaafoohum,barjalo marra waahid.Wa l-Muwaabiyiin gaalo le kubaaraat Midyaan-:-Al-naas dool katiiriin.Humman yidammuru kulla cheyy al-gaa'id hawaaleena misil al-bagar al-yaakulu al-gechch.
Wa hu rassal naas le Bal'aam wileed Ba'uur fi hillit Fatuur jamb bahar al-Furaat fi usut cha'abah.Hu rassal le yikhabbirah wa yuguul leyah-:-Daahu fi cha'ab marago min balad Masir wa min al-katara saddo al-ard marra waahid.Wa jo gaabaloona wa nazalo.
Wa hassa',ta'aal al'anhum achaan humman gawiyiin minnina.Wa be da,akuun ana ninnasir fooghum wa natrudhum min al-balad.Achaan ana na'arif kadar al-naadum al-inta baaraktah yabga mubaarak wa l-la'antah yabga mal'uun.
Wa kubaaraat Muwaab wa kubaaraat Midyaan chaalo ma'aahum bayaad wa macho le Bal'aam.Wa wakit humman wassalo,khabbarooh be kalaam Balaakh.
Wa Bal'aam gaal leehum-:-Al-leele arugdu ma'aayi hini wa ambaakir,ana nikhabbirku be kalaam Allah al-yuguulah leyi.-Wa khalaas,kubaaraat al-Muwaabiyiin ga'ado ma'a Bal'aam.
Wa be l-leel,al-Rabb sa'al Bal'aam wa gaal leyah-:-Al-rujaal al-ma'aak dool yaatumman-?
Wa Bal'aam gaal le l-Rabb-:-Balaakh wileed Siffuur malik Muwaab rassalaahum leyi wa gaal-:
--Daahu fiyah cha'ab katiiriin marra waahid marago min balad Masir.Ta'aal al'anhum leyi wa be da,akuun ana ninnasir fooghum wa natrudhum.-
Wa l-Rabb gaal le Bal'aam-:-Inta wa la tamchi ma'aahum wa la tal'an al-cha'ab da achaan al-cha'ab da mubaarak.
Wa ambaakir fajur,Bal'aam gamma wa gaal le kubaaraat Balaakh-:-Gabbulu baladku.Allah aba ma yikhalliini namchi ma'aaku.
Wa kubaaraat Muwaab gabbalo le Balaakh wa gaalo leyah-:-Bal'aam aba ma yaji ma'aana.
Wa laakin Balaakh battaan rassal kubaaraat aakhariin katiiriin wa muhimmiin min al-awwal.
Wa l-kubaaraat jo le Bal'aam wa gaalo leyah-:-Balaakh wileed Siffuur buguul leek ke-:--Min fadlak,ta'aal leyi ma taaba.
Wa ana nicharrifak wa nisawwi leek ayyi cheyy al-tidoorah minni.Min fadlak,ta'aal-!Al'an leyi al-cha'ab da.-
Wa Bal'aam radda le l-naas al-rassalaahum Balaakh wa gaal-:-Kan Balaakh yantiini kulla l-fudda wa l-dahab al-fi beetah kula,ana ma nagdar nisawwi leyah cheyy wa la kabiir wa la sakhayyar didd amur Allah Ilaahi.
Wa hassa' da,intu kula al-leele agoodu hini lahaddi ana na'arif al-cheyy al-yuguulah leyi Allah battaan.
Wa be l-leel,al-Rabb hajja le Bal'aam wa gaal leyah-:-Kan al-naas dool jo battaan le yinaaduuk,khalaas amchi ma'aahum.Wa laakin sawwi al-cheyy al-ana nuguulah leek bas.
Wa ambaakir fajur,Bal'aam gamma chadda humaartah wa macha ma'a kubaaraat Muwaab.
Wa be da kula,Allah khidib le Bal'aam wakit gamma maachi wa khalaas malak Allah wagaf leyah fi l-derib achaan yadharah.Wa Bal'aam raakib fi humaartah wa ma'aayah itneen min khaddaamiinah.
Wa wakit al-humaara chaafat malak Allah waagif fi l-derib wa seefah masluul fi iidah,talagat al-derib wa dagachat al-khala.Wa Bal'aam gamma yudugg al-humaara le yijiibha fi l-derib.
Wa battaan malak Allah macha wagaf fi l-derib fi bakaan chiyya dayyig al-yufuut ambeen daraadir itneen hana jineenaat inab.
Wa wakit al-humaara chaafat malak Allah,lammat fi l-durdur wa asarat rijil Bal'aam fi l-durdur.Wa hu gamma battaan yuduggaha.
Wa battaan malak Allah macha giddaam wagaf fi bakaan dayyig marra waahid ma indah faraga al-yufuutu beeha wa la isra wa la zeene.
Wa wakit al-humaara chaafat malak Allah,ragadat be Bal'aam.Wa hu zi'il wa gamma yuduggaha be asaatah.
Wa Allah anta khachum le l-humaara achaan tihajji wa gaalat le Bal'aam-:-Ana sawweet leek chunu lahaddi tuduggini talaata marraat-?
Wa Bal'aam gaal leeha-:-Inti gaa'ide tal'abe beyi wa kan awwal ana indi seef,wakit da ana gata't raaski khalaas.
Wa l-humaara gaalat le Bal'aam-:-Ana ma humaartak al-gaa'id tarkab foogi min zamaan lahaddi l-yoom-?Wa yoom waahid kula,ana sawweet cheyy misil da walla-? Wa Bal'aam gaal-:-La,abadan.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Allah kachaf le Bal'aam wa hu chaaf malak Allah waagif fi ust al-derib wa seefah masluul fi iidah.Wa tawwaali,Bal'aam dangar fi l-ard wa sajad.
Wa malak Allah gaal leyah-:-Maala daggeet humaartak talaata marraat-?Wa daahu ana jiit le nadharak achaan makhatarak da ma ajabni.
Al-humaara chaafatni wa talaata marraat hi baarat minni.Wa kan awwal hi ma baarat minni,wakit da ana kataltak khalaas wa khalleetha hi hayye.
Wa Bal'aam gaal le malak Allah-:-Ana aznabt wa ma irift kadar inta bas gaa'id fi derbi.Wa kan makhatari da ma ajabaak,ana nigabbil.
Wa laakin malak Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi ma'a l-rujaal dool.Wa laakin guul al-kalaam al-ana nuguulah leek bas. Wa khalaas Bal'aam macha ma'a l-kubaaraat al-rassalaahum Balaakh.
Wa wakit Balaakh simi' kadar Bal'aam jaayi leyah,hu marag laagaah fi madiinat Iir fi huduud Muwaab jamb waadi Arnuun.
Wa Balaakh gaal le Bal'aam-:-Maala ma jiit wakit ana rassalt leek awwal marra wa azamtak-?Inta tahsib ana ma nagdar nantiik charaf walla-?
Wa Bal'aam radda leyah wa gaal-:-Hassa' daahu ana jiit leek-!Wa ana ma nagdar nuguul ayyi cheyy illa l-kalaam al-yuguulah leyi al-Rabb.
Wa Bal'aam macha ma'a Balaakh wa dakhalo fi hillit Kharyat Husuut.
Wa Balaakh gaddam dahaaya hana bagar wa khanam wa anta minhum le Bal'aam wa l-kubaaraat al-jo ma'aayah.
Wa ambaakir fajur,Balaakh chaal Bal'aam wa tala'o fi raas hajar al-binaaduuh Baamoot Ba'al wa min hinaak,humman chaafo nuss min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Bal'aam gaal le Balaakh-:-Abni leyi hini sab'a madbah wa jiib leyi sab'a tiiraan wa sab'a kubchaan.
Wa Balaakh sawwa misil Bal'aam gaalah leyah.Wa humman al-itneen gaddamo dahiiye hana toor wa kabich fi ayyi madbah.
Wa Bal'aam gaal le Balaakh-:-Agiif jamb dahiiytak al-muharraga wa ana kamaan namchi hinaak.Akuun Allah yaji wa yihajji leyi wa ayyi kalaam al-yuguulah leyi ana nuguulah leek.-Wa macha fi raas al-jabal.
Wa l-Rabb baan wa Bal'aam gaal leyah-:-Ana baneet sab'a madbah wa gaddamt dahiiye fi ayyi waahid toor wa kabich.
Wa Allah kallam le Bal'aam wa gaal leyah-:-Gabbil amchi le Balaakh wa guul leyah al-kalaam da.
Wa Bal'aam gabbal le Balaakh wa ligiih waagif jamb dahiiytah al-muharraga wa kulla kubaaraat Muwaab waagfiin ma'aayah.
Wa khalaas,bada be l-chi'ir wa gaal-:-Min Araam,Balaakh malik Muwaab jaabaaniwa min jibaal al-sabaah,naadaani wa gaal-:--Ta'aal le Yaakhuub al'anah leyiwa ta'aal ayyir Israa'iil aduuyi.--
Wa kikkeef nal'an naadumal-Ilaah ma la'anah-?Wa kikkeef nihaddid naadumal-Allah ma haddadah-?
Wa wakit nichiifhummin raas al-hajarwa wakit niraakhibhummin raas al-jabal,ana nichiifhum cha'ab yaskun ma'zuulwa ma mahsuubiin ma'a baagi al-umam.
Zurriiyit Yaakhuub misil al-turaab.Yaatu yagdar yahsibhum-?Wa Bani Israa'iil misil al-ramla.Yaatu yalga adadhum-?Khalli ana numuut fi moot al-saalihiinwa nintahi misil humman antaho.
Wa Balaakh gaal le Bal'aam-:-Chunu al-sawweetah leyi da-?Ana naadeetak le tal'an leyi aduuyi wa daahu inta baaraktuhum khalaas-!
Wa Bal'aam radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana ma nikallim al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah leyi walla-?
Wa Balaakh gaal battaan-:-Ta'aal ma'aayi fi bakaan aakhar wa min hinaak,tichiif al-cha'ab da.Wa inta tichiif nussuhum bas ma kulluhum ke.Wa min al-bakaan da,al'anhum leyi.
Wa wadda Bal'aam foog fi raas jabal al-Fisga wa da l-bakaan al-yiraakhubu minnah.Wa bana sab'a madbah wa gaddam dahiiye hana toor wa kabich fi ayyi madbah.
Wa Bal'aam gaal le Balaakh-:-Agiif jamb dahiiytak al-muharraga wa ana kamaan namchi hinaak narja Allah yaji leyi.
Wa khalaas,Allah ja le Bal'aam wa kallamah.Wa gaal leyah-:-Gabbil amchi le Balaakh wa guul leyah al-kalaam da.
Wa Bal'aam gabbal le Balaakh wa ligiih waagif jamb dahiiytah al-muharraga wa kulla kubaaraat Muwaab waagfiin ma'aayah.Wa Balaakh sa'alah wa gaal leyah-:-Allah gaal leek chunu-?
Wa khalaas,Bal'aam bada be l-chi'ir wa gaal-:-Gumm,ya Balaakh,wa asma'wa khutt adaanak leyi,ya wileed Siffuur.
Al-Ilaah ma misil al-insaan yakdibwa la misil Bani Adam yandam.Kulla cheyy al-yuguulah,hu yisawwiihwa yihaggig kalaamah al-yihajjiih.
Ana ligiit amur nibaarikachaan hu baarakaahum khalaas.Wa battaan ana ma nagdar nisawwicheyy aakhar.
Ma fi zanib fi zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa la zulum fi Bani Israa'iil.Allah Ilaahhum yukuun ma'aahumwa humman yahmudu Allah malikhum.
Allah maragaahum min balad Masirwa induhum gudramisil gudrat al-jaamuus.
Ma fi al-yikallim be ilim al-kheebfi zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa ma fi al-yichawwiffi Bani Israa'iil.Wa fi wakit muwaafig,zurriiyit Yaakhuub wa Bani Israa'iilya'arfu kulla cheyy al-Allah yisawwiih.
Daahu al-cha'abgamma misil al-nimirwa wagaf misil al-duud.Ma yunuum kan ma akalseede al-hu saadaahawa la yargud kan ma chiribdamm al-seede al-hu katalaaha.
Wa Balaakh gaal le Bal'aam-:-Kan ma tal'anhum da,ma tibaarikhum kula-!
Wa Bal'aam radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana ma gult leek-?Ana nihajji kulla l-kalaam al-Allah yuguulah leyi.
Wa Balaakh gaal le Bal'aam-:-Ta'aal niwaddiik bakaan aakhar.Akuun min al-bakaan daak al-Rabb yarda inta tal'an leyi al-cha'ab da.
Wa Balaakh wadda Bal'aam fi raas jabal Fa'uur wa min al-bakaan da,tinchaaf al-sahara.
Wa Balaakh sawwa misil Bal'aam gaalah leyah wa gaddam dahiiye hana toor wa kabich fi ayyi madbah.
Wa wakit Bal'aam irif kadar Allah yidoor yibaarik Bani Israa'iil,hu ma sawwa misil al-marraat al-awwal le ya'arif al-kheeb wa laakin wajjah ale l-sahara.
Wa wakit Bal'aam rafa' raasah,chaaf kulla Bani Israa'iil naazliin hasab gabaayilhum.Wa khalaas Ruuh Allah nazal foogah.
Wa bada be l-chi'ir wa gaal-:-Da kalaam Bal'aam wileed Ba'uur.Da kalaam al-raajil al-yichiif adiil.
Da kalaam al-naadumal-yasma' kalaam al-Ilaahwa wakit yasjud,uyuunah yinfathuyichiif al-ru'yaal-yiwassifha leyah Allah al-Gaadir.
Khiyamku samhiin,ya zurriiyit Yaakhuub,wa masaakinku al-taskunu fooghum,ya Bani Israa'iil.
Khiyamku marsuusiin misil waadiwa misil jineenaat fi khachum al-baharwa misil chadar al-kitir al-Allah gawwamahwa misil chadar al-arz fi khachum al-almi.
Almi yisiil min eenahwa bizirtah yazguuha be almi katiir.Wa malikhum yabga ziyaada min al-malik Agaagwa mamlakatah tabga gawiiye.
Wa l-Ilaah maragaahummin balad Masirwa induhum gudratmisil gudrat al-jaamuus.Wa yidammuru al-umamal-humman udwaanhumwa yita''unuuhum be nuchchaabhumwa yikassuru udaamhum.
Humman misil al-duud al-yabrukwa l-duudaay al-targud.Yaatu al-yagdar yigawwimhum-?Mabruuk al-yibaarikkuwa mal'uun al-yal'anku.
Wa khalaas Balaakh zi'il didd Bal'aam wa darab ambeenaat iideenah wa gaal-:-Ana naadeetak le tal'an leyi udwaani.Wa daahu le taalit marra inta baaraktuhum-!
Yalla-!Amchi baladak-!Awwal ana gult nicharrifak wa laakin daahu Allah daharak min al-charaf da.
Wa Bal'aam radda le Balaakh wa gaal-:-Ana kallamtuhum le naasak al-inta rassaltuhum wa gult-:
--Kan Balaakh yantiini kulla l-fudda wa l-dahab al-fi beetah kula,ana ma nagdar nisawwi cheyy didd amur Allah wa ana be nafsi ma nagdar nisawwi kheer wa la charr.Ana nuguul illa l-kalaam al-Allah gaalah bas.-
Wa battaan Bal'aam gaal-:-Hassa',gubbaal ma nigabbil le cha'abi,ta'aal ni'ooriik be l-cheyy al-yisawwiih al-cha'ab da ba'adeen fi cha'abak.
Wa khalaas,bada be l-chi'ir wa gaal-:-Da kalaam Bal'aam wileed Ba'uur.Da kalaam al-raajil al-yichiif adiil.
Da kalaam al-naadumal-yasma' kalaam al-Ilaahwa indah ilim min al-Aaliwa wakit yasjud,uyuunah yinfathuyichiif al-ru'yaal-yiwassifha leyah Allah al-Gaadir.
Ana nichiif al-jaayiwa laakin ma yaji hassa'.Ana gaa'id nichiifahwa laakin ma min gariib.Min zurriiyit Yaakhuub tatla' najmawa min Bani Israa'iil yaji malik.Be asaat mulkah yaksir jabhat Muwaabwa yaktul kulla zurriiyit Chiit.
Wa balad Adoom yichiilhawa yichiil Sa'iir balad udwaanhumwa Bani Israa'iil gudrithum tiziid.
Wa yaji malik gawimin zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa yidammir al-naasal-faddalo fi l-madiina.
Wa Bal'aam chaaf balad al-Amaalikh wa bada be l-chi'ir wa gaal-:-Amaalikh hu al-awwal fi l-umamwa laakin fi l-akhiir yiddammar.
Wa Bal'aam chaaf balad al-Khiiniyiin wa bada be l-chi'ir wa gaal-:-Buyuutku gaa'idiin be amaanmisil uchuuch fi raas al-hajar.
Laakin balad al-Khiiniyiin tahrag be naarwakit Achuur yakrubku masaajiin.
Wa battaan Bal'aam bada be l-chi'ir wa gaal-:-Ya khasaaritna-!Yaatu yagdar yi'iichkan al-Ilaah bas ja'alah misil da-?
Fi sufun yaju min Khubrus.Yazulmu Achuur wa yazulmu Ibaarwa humman kula yiddammaro.
Wa khalaas,Bal'aam gabbal baladah wa Balaakh kula chaal derbah.
Wakit Bani Israa'iil ga'ado fi Chittiim,gammo yafsudu ma'a banaat al-Muwaabiyiin.
Banaat al-Muwaabiyiin ya'aziman Bani Israa'iil fi gaddimiin al-dahaaya le ilaahaathin.Wa humman yaakulu ma'aahin laham dahaayaahin wa yasjudu le ilaahaathin.
Wa be misil da,Bani Israa'iil chaarako fi ibaadat ilaah Ba'al hana jabal Fa'uur wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid didduhum.
Wa Allah gaal le Muusa-:-Akrub kulla kubaaraat al-cha'ab al-fasado wa jiibhum giddaami ana Allah wa gaabilhum le l-harraay wa achnighum.Wa be da,khadabi al-muhrig battaan ma yalhaghum le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Muusa gaal le l-gudiya hana Bani Israa'iil-:-Ayyi waahid minku yaktul rujaalah al-chaarako fi ibaadat ilaah Ba'al hana jabal Fa'uur.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yabku fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa',fi raajil min Bani Israa'iil jaayi le akhwaanah ma'a mara Midyaaniiye.Wa Muusa wa kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil chaafooh.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Fiinhaas wileed Ali'aazar wileed Haaruun raajil al-diin,gamma min usut mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa chaal harba fi iidah.
Wa taaba' al-raajil lahaddi fi lubb al-kheema wa ta'anaahum humman al-itneen ta'ne waahide bas.Al-raajil wa l-mara ta'anaahum fi butuunhum.Wa khalaas al-waba wagaf min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-maato min al-waba da,adadhum 24-000 naas.
Fiinhaas wileed Ali'aazar wileed Haaruun raajil al-diin waggaf khadabi min Bani Israa'iil wakit wassaf khiirti ana Allah fi usuthum.Wa be sabab al-cheyy al-sawwaah Fiinhaas,ana battaan ma niwassif khiirti wa nikammil Bani Israa'iil.
Achaan da,guul leyah ana nantiih mu'aahadati hana l-salaam.
Wa l-mu'aahada di tabga ma'aayah hu wa zurriiytah al-yaju min ba'adah.Wa hi tadman leehum khidmit rujaal al-diin le l-abad achaan hu wassaf khiirtah fi chaani ana Ilaahah wa sawwa kaffaara le zunuub Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-raajil al-min Bani Israa'iil al-katalooh ma'a l-Midyaaniiye usmah Zimri wileed Saalu cheekh hana aayila min gabiilat Chim'uun.
Wa l-mara al-Midyaaniiye al-katalooha usumha Kuzbi bineeyit Suur kabiir hana khachum beet min khuchuum buyuut Midyaan.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal-:
Ahjumu al-Midyaaniyiin wa aktuluuhum.
Achaan humman khachchooku fi muchkilat Fa'uur wa fi muchkilat akhuthum Kuzbi bitt kabiir Midyaan al-katalooha fi yoom al-waba al-nazal fi muchkilat Fa'uur.
Wa ba'ad al-waba da,Allah gaal le Muusa wa le Ali'aazar wileed Haaruun raajil al-diin-:
Min kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil,ahsubu kulla l-rujaal al-umurhum min 20 sana wa foog al-yagdaro le khidmit al-askariiye hasab aayilaathum.
Wa fi kadaadit Muwaab fi khachum bahar al-Urdun al-mugaabil hillit Ariiha,Muusa wa raajil al-diin Ali'aazar gaalo le l-cha'ab-:
Aniina nahsubuuku intu al-rujaal al-umurku min 20 sana wa foog misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.-Wa daahu gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-marago min balad Masir.
Wa Ra'uubiin hu bikir Israa'iil wa dool zurriiytah hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Hanuuk jaab al-Hanuukiyiinwa Fallu jaab al-Falluwiyiin
wa Hasruun jaab al-Hasruuniyiinwa Karmi jaab al-Karmiyiin.
Wa khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Ra'uubiin adadhum 43-730 naas.
Wa Fallu jaab Aliyaab
wa Aliyaab jaab Namuwiil wa Dataan wa Abiraam.Wa Dataan wa Abiraam dool kubaaraat mujtama' Bani Israa'iil al-gammo didd Muusa wa Haaruun.Humman ma'a naas Khuurah wakit gammo didd Allah.
Wa l-ard anfatahat wa zaratathum humman wa Khuurah wa l-naas al-ma'aahum wa l-naar haragat 250 naadum wa bigo masal le l-aakhariin.
Wa laakin iyaal Khuurah ma maato fi l-yoom daak.
Wa dool zurriiyit Chim'uun hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Namuwiil jaab al-Namuwiiliyiinwa Yaamiin jaab al-Yaamiiniyiinwa Yaakiin jaab al-Yaakiiniyiin
wa Zaarah jaab al-Zaarahiyiinwa Chaawuul jaab al-Chaawuuliyiin.
Wa khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Chim'uun adadhum 22-200 naas.
Wa dool zurriiyit Gaad hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Safuun jaab al-Safuuniyiinwa Haggi jaab al-Haggiyiinwa Chuuni jaab al-Chuuniyiin
wa Uzni jaab al-Uzniyiinwa Iiri jaab al-Iriyiin
wa Aruudi jaab al-Aruudiyiinwa Ariili jaab al-Ariiliyiin.
Wa khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Gaad adadhum 40-500 naas.
Wa iyaal Yahuuza humman Iir wa Unaanwa humman dool maato fi balad Kan'aan.
Wa dool zurriiyit Yahuuza hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Chiila jaab al-Chiiliyiinwa Faaris jaab al-Faarisiyiinwa Zaarah jaab al-Zaarahiyiin.
Wa min al-Faarisiyiin marago Hasruun wa Haamul.Wa Hasruun jaab al-Hasruuniyiinwa Haamul jaab al-Haamuliyiin.
Wa khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Yahuuza adadhum 76-500 naas.
Wa dool zurriiyit Yassaakar hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Tuula' jaab al-Tuula'iyiinwa Fuwwa jaab al-Fuwwiyiin.
Wa Yachuub jaab al-Yachuubiyiinwa Chimruun jaab al-Chimruuniyiin.
Wa khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Yassaakar adadhum 64-300 naas.
Wa dool zurriiyit gabiilat Zabuluun hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Saarad jaab al-Saaradiyiinwa Iluun jaab al-Iluuniyiinwa Yahaliil jaab al-Yahaliiliyiin.
Wa khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Zabuluun adadhum 60-500 naas.
Wa dool zurriiyit Yuusuf,gabaayil Manassa wa Afraayim hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Manassa jaab Makiirwa Makiir jaab al-Makiiriyiinwa min al-Makiiriyiin marag Gil'aadwa Gil'aad jaab al-Gil'aadiyiin.
Wa min al-Gil'aadiyiin marago Iya'zar al-jaab al-Iya'zariyiinwa Hilakh al-jaab al-Hilakhiyiin.
Wa Asriyiil al-jaab al-Asriyiiliyiinwa Chakiim al-jaab al-Chakiimiyiin.
Wa Chamiida' al-jaab al-Chamiida'iyiinwa Hiifar al-jaab al-Hiifariyiin.
Wa Saluufhad wileed Hiifar ma jaab awlaad wa laakin jaab banaat bas.Wa banaatah asaameehum Mahla wa Nuu'a wa Hugla wa Milka wa Tirsa.
Wa khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Manassa adadhum 52-700 naas.
