Wa waddaahumfi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin fi l-baladwa akkalaahummin ma'aach al-kadaadewa akkalaahum asalal-saayil min al-jibaalwa antaahum dihin al-zaytuunmin al-hajar al-gawi.
Wa akkalaahum raayib min laban al-bagarwa haliib min al-khanamwa antaahum laham samiin min humlaanwa kubchaan hana Baachaanwa tuyuuswa akkalaahum dagiig al-gamehwa charrabaahum min asiir al-inab al-hu khamar.
Wa Bani Israa'iil simno wa iso.Aywa,humman simnowa gargato wa tikhno.Wa khalaas abo Allah al-khalagaahumwa hagaro malja'hum wa munajjiihum.
Wa gawwamo khiirtahbe l-ilaahaat al-ajnabiyiinwa khaddabooh be l-haraam.
Wa l-cha'ab dabaho le l-chawaatiinal-humman ma al-Rabb.Aywa,dabaho le l-ilaahaatal-humman ma irfoohum.Wa l-ilaahaat dool jo dahaabhumwa abbahaathum ma irfoohum.
Wa intu ma fakkartu fi Allahal-hu malja'ku al-antaaku al-haya.Aywa,nisiitu Ilaahkual-jaabaaku fi l-dunya.
Wa Allah chaafaahum wa rafadaahumachaan iyaalah khaddabooh.
Wa gaal-:-Battaan ma niwajjih aleehumwa nichiif chunu yukuun leehum fi l-akhiirachaan humman zurriiye mufsidewa iyaal al-ma induhum amaan.
Wa ana bas Allahwa humman gawwamo khiirti be ilaahhumwa khaddabooni be asnaamhum al-zaayliin.Wa laakin ana kamaan nigawwim khiirithumbe l-cha'ab al-ma tammo ummawa niza''ilhum be umma matmuusa.
Achaan naar khadabi oogadatwa akalat lahaddi l-makhaabirwa akalat al-ard wa nabaathalahaddi asaas al-jibaal.
Wa ninazzil fooghum kulla l-masaayibwa nikammil fooghum kulla nachaachiibi.
Wa juu' yibattilhumwa wirde wa waba chadiid yaga'o fooghumwa nirassil didduhum haywaanaat fasliinwa dabiib al-indah samm al-yaktul.
Barra,al-seef yaktul iyaalhumwa daakhal,al-khoof yakrubhum.Wa kulluhum yumuutu,al-subyaan wa l-banaatwa l-atfaal wa l-chiyyaab.
Wa ana nuguchchuhum be nafkha waahidewa niwaddir zikirhum min ust al-naas.
Wa ana gult udwaanhumyichchammato wa yuguulu-:--Al-cheyy da,Allah ma sawwaahlaakin aniina bas gidirna fooghum.-
Achaan dool al-umam al-khittithum addammaratwa ma induhum ayyi fihim.
Wa kan humman hakiimiin,yafhamo al-cheyy dawa ya'arfu mustakhbalhum.
Kikkeef raajil waahid yatrud alif naaswa rujaal itneen yaturdu achara alifkan Allah bas ma sallamaahumwa malja'hum ma baa'aahum-?
Achaan malja'hum ma misil malja'nawa udwaanna ya'arfuuh.
Humman misil chadar al-inabhana Saduum wa Amuuraal-yalda inab murr wa musammam.
Wa khamarah misil samm abundaragwa misil al-samm al-khatiir hana amchideegaat.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Da kulla mulabbad fi bakaaniwa makhtuum wa gaa'id fi makhazani.
Wa ana bas al-nichiil al-taarwa nanti al-ajur wakit rijleehum yittarta'oachaan yoom kharaabhum garrabwa yajiihum be sur'a.
Aywa,Allah yihaakim cha'abah be l-adilwa yihinn fi abiidahwakit yichiif ma induhum gudrawa ma faddal waahid kula,wa la abid wa la hurr.
Wa Allah yuguul-:-Ween ilaahaathumwa ween malja'hum al-yalja'o leyah-?
Wa ween ilaahaathumal-akalo chaham dahaayaahumwa chirbo hadaaya charaabhum-?Khalli yugummu yafza'oohumwa yahmuuhum.
Wa hassa',a'arfu ana bas al-Rabb.La Ilaah illa ana-!Ana bas al-nahayi wa naktulwa najrah wa nachfiwa ma fi al-yagdar yikhallis min iidi.
Wa nahlif be nafsi wa nuguul-:--Ana hayy ila l-abad.--
Wa wakit nitarrig seefiwa nugumm be l-adaala,nichiil al-taar fi udwaaniwa nilkaffa fi l-yakrahooni.
Wa seefi yaakul lahamwa nachaachiibi yarwo be l-dammwa da,damm al-maytiinwa masaajiin al-haribwa nagta' ruuse al-adube cha'arhum al-tuwaal.
Ya l-umam,afraho ma'a cha'abahachaan Allah yilkaffa damm abiidahwa yichiil al-taar fi udwaanahwa yikaffir le cha'abah fi ardah.
Wa Muusa ja ma'a Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa raddad kulla kalaam al-khine da giddaam al-cha'ab.
Wa wakit Muusa kammal al-kalaam da giddaam kulla Bani Israa'iil,
hu gaal leehum-:Fakkuru fi kulla l-kalaam al-ana hazzartuku beyah al-yoom.Wa allumuuh le awlaadku achaan yahfado wa yitabbugu kulla kalaam al-wasaaya dool.
Achaan al-kalaam da,muhimm leeku.Wa l-kalaam da,hu hayaatku wa yiziid umurku fi l-balad al-tamchu leeha wa tichiiluuha warasa ba'ad tagta'o bahar al-Urdun.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom da,Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal-:
Atla' fi ruuse jibaal Abaariim wa lahaddi jabal Nabu al-fi ard Muwaab mugaabil Ariiha.Wa chiif ard Kan'aan al-ana nantiiha warasa le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa inta tumuut fi raas al-jabal al-tatla' foogah wa talhag abbahaatak misil Haaruun akhuuk maat fi jabal Hoor wa lihig abbahaatah.
Achaan intu bigiitu khaayniin leyi ana fi lubb Bani Israa'iil fi een almi Mariibagariib le hillit Khaadich fi saharat Siin wakit intu ma khaddastuuni fi lubb Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas inta tichiif al-balad min ba'iid giddaamak wa laakin ma tadkhul fi l-balad al-nantiiha le Bani Israa'iil di.
Wa di hi al-baraka al-nabi Allah Muusa baarak beeha Bani Israa'iil gabul mootah.
Hu gaal-:Allah ja leehum min Siinaa'wa misil al-harraay,tala' min Sa'iirwa min jabal Faaraan,nawwar.Wa ja be aalaafmin al-malaa'ika ma'aayahwa min iidah al-zeenetamrug naar.
Akiid hu yihibb al-cha'abwa kulla saalihiinah fi iideenah.Wa humman gaa'idiin tihtahwa yasma'o ta'liimah.
Wa Muusa amaraana be l-wasaayawa humman warasat gabiilat Yaakhuub.
Wa l-Rabb bigi malik fi Israa'iilwakit lammo kubaaraat al-cha'abwa gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Khalli gabiilat Ra'uubiinyahyo ma yumuutuwa rujaalha yabgo katiiriin.
Wa fi gabiilat Yahuuza,hu gaal-:Ya Allah asma' hiss Yahuuzawa gabbilah le cha'abahwa gawwi duraa'ahwa saa'idah didd udwaanah.
Wa fi gabiilat Laawi,hu gaal-:Ya Allah,al-Uriim wa l-Tummiimal-beehum yas'alookantoohum le l-naas al-amiiniin ma'aakal-inta jarrabtuhum fi Massawa haarajtuhum fi almi Mariiba.
Wa humman gaalo le waaldeenhum-:-Aniina ma chifnaaku.-Wa gaalo le akhwaanhum-:-Aniina ma na'arfuuku.-Wa gaalo le iyaalhum-:-Aniina ma na'arfu intu yaatumman.-Wa humman hafado kalaamak,ya Allah,wa ahtaramo mu'aahadatak.
Wa humman gaa'idiin yigarruchuruutak le iyaal Yaakhuubwa wasiiyaatak le Bani Israa'iil.Wa fi l-mukhbar,yigaddumu leek al-bakhuurwa fi l-madbah,yigaddumu dahiiye kaamile.
Ya Allah,baarik khidmithumwa arda be amalhum al-yisawwuuh be iideehum.Aksir salaba al-naasal-yugummu didduhumwa kan le l-yakrahoohum,ma tikhalliihum battaan yugummu.
Wa fi gabiilat Banyaamiin,hu gaal-:Allah yihibb iyaal Banyaamiinwa yaskunu be amaanjamb al-yahmiihum daaymanwa yaskunu fi jibaalah.
Wa fi zurriiyit Yuusuf,hu gaal-:Allah yibaarik baladhumwa yalgo al-rahmabe l-matara al-tanzil min al-samawa l-karanywa uyuun almi al-yatla'o min al-ard.
Wa yarhamhum be l-nabaataatal-tigawwimhum al-harraaywa iyaalhum yanjado fi ayyi chahar.
Wa yarhamhum be awwal intaajal-jibaal al-gadiimiinwa ahsan intaaj al-hujaar ila l-abad.
Wa yarhamhum be ahsan intaajal-malaan fi l-ard.Allah al-baanfi l-chideere al-gammat foogha naar,khalli ni'matah tabga misil taajfi raas Yuusufwa fi jabhat al-khassasooh wa darrajooh fi akhwaanah.
Hu indah charafmisil toor wald al-bikirwa guruunahmisil guruun al-jaamuus.Be darbe waahide,hu yadrub beehumkulla l-cha'ab lahaddi aakhir al-ard.Wa humman acharaat al-aalaaf min iyaal Afraayimwa aalaaf min iyaal Manassa.
Wa fi gabiilat Zabuluun,hu gaal-:Ya iyaal Zabuluun,afrahowakit tamurgu.Ya iyaal Yassaakar,afrahowakit gaa'idiin fi khiyamku.
Humman ya'azumu al-cha'ab fi l-jibaal,fi l-bakaan al-yigaddumu foogah al-dahaaya al-muwaafgiinachaan humman yalgo khunaahummin khazaayin al-ramla hana khachum al-bahar.
Wa fi gabiilat Gaad,hu gaal-:Mubaarakal-anta gabiilat Gaad bakaan wasii'.Humman ragado misil al-duudal-yagta' gaayme aw raas rimmitah.
Wa hu khatta eenah fi l-ard al-ahsanwa fi bakaan al-foogah gisim al-malik.Wa hu gaddam le l-cha'abwa tabbag adaalit Allahwa churuutah fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi gabiilat Daan,hu gaal-:Iyaal Daan humman misil wileed al-duudal-marag min Baachaan.
Wa fi gabiilat Naftaali,hu gaal-:Iyaal Naftaali,humman chab'aaniinbe l-ni'ma wa barakat Allahwa yichiilu al-kharib wa l-junuub.
Wa fi gabiilat Achiir,hu gaal-:Allah yibaarik Achiirmin iyaal Yaakhuubwa akhwaanah yardo beyahwa yidiss rijlah fi l-dihin.
Khalli gafala madiintahyabgo hana hadiid wa nahaaswa khalli yantiih al-gudrafi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Wa ma fi chabiih le l-Rabb,hu al-yaji yafza'ku ya Israa'iil.Hu raakib fi l-samaawaatwa be azamatah,fi l-sahaab.
Wa l-Rabb min zamaanhu al-malja'wa gudurtah hi al-sawwatkulla cheyy fi l-ard.Hu tarad udwaanak giddaamakwa gaal-:-Dammirhum-!
Bani Israa'iil yaskunu be amaanwa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yagoodu wiheedhumfi balad al-gamehwa l-khamar al-jadiidwa l-sama yinazzil al-karany.
Afraho,ya Bani Israa'iil-!Yaatu al-misilku-?Intu cha'ab al-najjaaku Allah.Hu al-daraga al-tahmiikuwa l-seef al-yiwassif gudritku.Wa udwaanku yilmaskanowa intu tifajjukhu bakaanaathum al-aaliyiin.
Wa min kadaadit Muwaab,Muusa tala' fi jabal Nabu fi raas al-Fisga al-mugaabile hillit Ariiha.Wa min al-bakaan da,Allah wassafah kulla balad Gil'aad lahaddi Daan
wa kulla ard Naftaali wa balad Afraayim wa Manassa wa kulla balad Yahuuza lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad
wa saharat Nagab wa waadi Ariiha madiinat al-nakhal lahaddi Suukhar.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Di l-balad al-ana halaft le Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub wa gult-:--Nantiiha le zurriiytak.- Wa ana chawwaftak al-ard di wa laakin inta ma tadkhul foogha.
Wa Muusa abd Allah maat fi l-bakaan da,fi balad Muwaab wa da hasab amur Allah.
Wa Allah satarah fi l-waadi fi balad Muwaab mugaabil Beet Fa'uur.Wa lahaddi l-yoom da,naadum ma ya'arif bakaan khaburah.
Wa wakit Muusa maat,umrah 120 sana wa laakin choofah ma nagas wa gudurtah kula ma kammalat.
Wa Bani Israa'iil hizno le Muusa le muddit 30 yoom fi kadaadit Muwaab wa ba'ad da,ayyaam hizinhum kammalo.
Wa Yachuu' wileed Nuun malaan be ruuh al-hikma achaan Muusa khatta foogah iidah.Wa Bani Israa'iil yasma'o kalaamah wa yisawwu kulla cheyy misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa abadan ma marag nabi fi Bani Israa'iil misil Muusa,hu al-kallam ma'a Allah khachum be khachum.
Wa hu bas Allah rassalah yisawwi alaamaat wa ajaayib fi balad Masir giddaam Fir'oon wa khaddaamiinah wa kulla baladah.
Wa be iidah,Muusa bas al-sawwa amal chadiid wa mukhiif giddaam kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad moot Muusa abd Allah,Allah gaal le Yachuu' wileed Nuun musaa'id Muusa-:
Abdi Muusa maat.Hassa' gumm,inta wa kulla l-cha'ab.Agta'o bahar al-Urdun wa amchu le l-balad al-ana nantiiha leeku intu Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ayyi bakaan al-rijlak tafjakhah,ana nantiih leeku misil ana waa'adt beyah Muusa.
Wa min al-wati le l-munchaakh,arduku tamchi min al-sahara le jibaal Lubnaan.Wa min al-sabaah le l-kharib,tamchi min bahar al-Furaat,al-bahar al-kabiir,lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad wa kulla balad al-Hittiyiin.
Fi kulla muddit hayaatak,ma fi naadum al-yagdar yagiif giddaamak.Wa ana nukuun ma'aak misil kunt ma'a Muusa wa la naabaak wa la nikhalliik.
Abga chadiid wa fahal-!Achaan inta bas al-tiwaddi al-cha'ab da fi l-balad al-ana halaft le juduudhum wa gult nantiiha leehum.
Aywa,abga chadiid wa fahal be ziyaada.Wa sawwi ayyi cheyy hasab al-Tawraat al-amarak beyah abdi Muusa.Ma tibaari minnah wa la isra wa la zeene.Wa be da,tanjah fi ayyi bakaan al-tamchi foogah.
Wa kitaab al-Tawraat hana Muusa da,ma tiba''idah minnak.Agriih fajur wa achiiye achaan tisawwi ayyi cheyy hasab al-kalaam al-maktuub foogah.Wa be da,kulla cheyy al-tisawwiih yabga adiil wa tanjah.
Wa azzakkar kadar ana amartak abga chadiid wa fahal.Ma tarjif wa la takhaaf achaan ana Allah Ilaahak nukuun ma'aak fi ayyi bakaan al-inta tamchi foogah.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' amar chuyuukh al-cha'ab wa gaal-:
Adkhulu al-fariig wa aamuruuhum le l-cha'ab wa guulu leehum-:--Kulluku jahhuzu zaadku.Achaan fi talaata yoom tagta'o bahar al-Urdun wa tadkhulu fi l-balad al-yantiiha leeku Allah Ilaahku wa tichiiluuha.-
Wa Yachuu' kallam le gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa wa gaal-:
Azzakkaro al-amur al-antaaku Muusa abd Allah,wakit gaal-:--Allah Ilaahku antaaku al-balad di wa raaha.--
Hassa' da,awiinku wa iyaalku wa bahaayimku yagoodu hini fi l-balad al-antaaha leeku Muusa,sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.Wa laakin intu kulluku al-rujaal al-furraas,jahhuzu le l-harib wa amchu giddaam akhwaanku wa saa'uduuhum.
Saa'udu akhwaanku lahaddi Allah yantiihum al-raaha misilku wa humman kula yichiilu al-ard al-antaaha leehum Allah Ilaahku.Wa ba'ad da,tigabbulu fi ard warasatku,sabaah le bahar al-Urdun,al-antaaha leeku Muusa abd Allah.
Wa humman raddo le Yachuu' wa gaalo leyah-:-Kulla cheyy al-inta amartina beyah,aniina nisawwuuh.Wa ayyi bakaan al-tirassilna foogah,namchu.
Wa misil simi'na kalaam Muusa fi ayyi cheyy,nasma'o kalaamak inta kula.Wa khalli Allah Ilaahak yukuun ma'aak misil kaan ma'a Muusa.
Wa ayyi naadum al-isi amrak wa ma yasma' kalaamak al-tuguulah fi ayyi cheyy,naktuluuh.Aywa,abga chadiid wa fahal-!
Wa min fariighum fi Chittiim,Yachuu' wileed Nuun rassal jawaasiis itneen be sirr wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu akkudu al-balad wa hillit Ariiha. Wa humman macho.Wakit wassalo fi hillit Ariiha,dakhalo fi beet hana mara waahide charmuuta usumha Raahaab wa naamo fi l-bakaan da.
Wa naas waahidiin macho khabbaro malik Ariiha wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu fi rujaal dakhalo hini albaareh wa humman min Bani Israa'iil wa jo le yuruukhu kulla l-balad.
Wa l-malik rassal le Raahaab wa gaal leeha-:-Amurgi al-rujaal al-jo wa dakhalo fi beetki,achaan humman jo le yuruukhu kulla l-balad.
Wa laakin al-mara chaalat al-rujaal al-itneen wa labbadathum.Wa khalaas,raddat le l-malik wa gaalat-:-Sahiih,al-rujaal dool jo fi bakaani wa laakin ana ma na'arif humman jo min ween.
Wa l-rujaal dool marago min al-hille be l-leel wakit yisiddu baab al-hille wa ana ma na'arif bakaan macho.Amchu waraahum ajala,akuun talhagoohum-!
Wa taari,hi talla'athum fi raas beetha wa labbadathum tihit ganaadiil al-kattaan al-marsuus fi raas al-beet.
Wa rujaal al-malik macho yifattuchuuhum be l-derib al-maachi ale bahar al-Urdun,gariib le l-ma'add.Wa ba'ad marago yifattuchuuhum,saddo baab al-hille waraahum.
Wa gabul al-rujaal al-itneen dool ma yunuumu,hi tala'at leehum fi raas al-beet
wa gaalat leehum-:-Ana na'arif kadar al-balad di Allah antaaha leeku.Wa aniina khufna khoof chadiid minku lahaddi kulla sukkaan al-balad gaa'idiin yarjufu giddaamku.
Simi'na kadar Allah yabbas leeku al-bahar al-Ahmarwakit maragtu min balad Masir.Wa simi'na kikkeef dammartu Siihuun wa Oogal-muluuk al-itneen hana l-Amuuriyiin al-ga'ado sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa wakit simi'na al-khabar da,khalaas galibna angata' wa ma indina gudra le nigaabuluuku.Achaan Allah Ilaahku,hu al-Ilaah al-gaa'id foog fi l-sama wa tihit fi l-ard.
Wa daahu ana sawweet leeku al-kheer.Wa be da,ahalfu leyi be Allah kadar intu kula tisawwu al-kheer le aayilti.Wassufuuni al-alaama al-ti'akkid haliifitku
kadar ma taktulu abuuyi wa la ammi wa la akhwaani wa la akhwaati wa la aayilaathum wa tinajjuuna min al-moot.
Wa l-rujaal al-itneen gaalo leeha-:-Kan inti ma maragti achiirna da le l-naas,nahalfu leeki be ruuhna.Wa kan Allah antaana al-balad,nisawwu leeki al-kheer wa l-amaan.
Wa khalaas,hi dallathum be habil min al-chubbaak hana beetha achaan beetha mulassag ma'a l-durdur al-muhawwig al-hille.
Wa gaalat leehum-:-Amchu ale l-jibaal achaan al-naas al-macho waraaku ma yalgooku.Wa allabbado hinaak talaata yoom,lahaddi al-naas al-macho waraaku yigabbulu.Wa ba'ad da,amurgu wa chiilu deribku.
Wa l-rujaal al-itneen gaalo leeha-:-Aniina nitimmu al-haliife al-hallaftiina beeha.
Wa wakit nahjumu baladki,arbuti al-jango al-ahmar da fi l-chubbaak al-maragtiina beyah.Wa limmi fi beetki abuuki wa ammiki wa akhwaanki wa kulla aayilitki.
Wa kan naadum minhum marag min beetki,aniina bariyiin minnah wa hu yilhammal mas'uuliiyit mootah.Wa kan naadum min naaski al-ma'aaki katalooh fi beetki,aniina nilhammalo mas'uuliiyit mootah.
Wa laakin kan maragti achiirna da,aniina nukuunu bariyiin min al-haliife al-hallaftiina beeha.
Wa hi gaalat-:-Khalli yabga misil intu gultuuh. Wa khalaas,khallathum macho wa rabatat al-jango al-ahmar fi l-chubbaak.
Wa humman macho ale l-jibaal wa allabbado hinaak talaata yoom lahaddi al-naas al-macho waraahum gabbalo.Wa l-naas al-taradoohum fattachoohum fi tuul al-derib wa ma ligoohum.Wa gabbalo Ariiha.
Wa khalaas,al-rujaal al-itneen dool addallo min al-jibaal wa gata'o bahar al-Urdun.Wa ba'ad da,jo le Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa kallamooh be kulla l-cheyy al-kaan leehum.
Wa gaalo le Yachuu'-:-Sahiih ke,Allah antaana kulla l-balad fi iideenna wa sukkaan al-balad gaa'idiin yarjufu giddaamna.
Wa be fajur badri,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gammo min fariighum fi Chittiim wa nazalo fi khachum bahar al-Urdun.Wa humman ga'ado fi l-bakaan da gubbaal ma yagta'o.
Wa fi muddit talaata yoom,chuyuukh al-cha'ab gaa'idiin yuruukhu fi l-fariig
wa anto amur wa gaalo-:-Wakit tichiifu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah Ilaahku wa rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin al-yichiiluuh,khalaas gummu min bakaanku al-gaa'idiin foogah wa taabu'uuh.
Wa be da,ta'arfu al-derib al-tichiiluuh achaan awwal intu ma addeetu be l-derib da.Wa waajib tikhallu beenku wa been al-sanduug faraga tisaawi waahid kiilomitir wa abadan ma tigarrubu leyah.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Khassusu nufuusku achaan ambaakir Allah yisawwi ajaayib fi usutku.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le rujaal al-diin-:-Chiilu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wa amchu giddaam al-cha'ab. Wa khalaas humman chaalo sanduug al-mu'aahada wa macho giddaam al-cha'ab.
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Al-yoom,ana nisawwiik kabiir fi uyuun kulla Bani Israa'iil achaan ya'arfu kadar ana nukuun ma'aak misil kunt ma'a Muusa.
Wa anti al-amur da le rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin sanduug al-mu'aahada wa guul leehum-:--Kan wassaltu khachum bahar al-Urdun wa dasseetu rijleeku fi almiih,agiifu.-
Wa Yachuu' gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Ta'aalu gariib hini wa asma'o kalaam Allah Ilaahku.
Wa battaan Yachuu' gaal-:-Wakit tichiifu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah Rabb kulla l-ard yagta' bahar al-Urdun,khalaas fi l-wakit da,ta'arfu kadar Allah al-Hayy gaa'id fi usutku.Wa ta'arfu kadar hu yagla' giddaamku ard al-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Girgaachiyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.
Wa hassa',a'azulu raajil waahid min ayyi gabiila min gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-atnaachar.
Wa rujaal al-diin yichiilu sanduug Allah Rabb kulla l-ard yadkhulu fi l-bahar.Wa wakit butuun rijleehum yadkhulu fi almi bahar al-Urdun,khalaas almi al-bahar da yinhajiz min almi al-jaari min al-een wa yagiif misil al-durdur.
Wa wakit al-cha'ab gammo min khiyamhum le yagta'o bahar al-Urdun,rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin sanduug al-mu'aahada macho giddaamhum.
Wa da fi wakt al-gati' al-foogah bahar al-Urdun malaan marra waahid lahaddi faat huduudah.Wa laakin wakit rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wassalo fi khachum bahar al-Urdun wa dasso rijleehum fi l-almi,
tawwaali al-almi al-jaari min al-een wagaf wa bigi misil durdur fi masaafa tawiile fi hillit Adam al-gaa'ide jamb Sartaan.Wa l-almi al-naazil ale l-bahar al-Mayyit wagaf marra waahid.Wa l-cha'ab gata'o al-bahar mugaabil hillit Ariiha.
Wa rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wagafo saabtiin fi l-turaab al-yaabis fi usut bahar al-Urdun.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yagta'o fi l-turaab al-yaabis da,lahaddi kulla l-umma gata'at bahar al-Urdun.
Wa wakit kulla l-umma gata'at bahar al-Urdun khalaas,Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:
Chiilu 12 raajil min al-cha'ab.Wa da yabga raajil waahid min ayyi gabiila.
Wa aamuruuhum wa guulu leehum-:--Chiilu 12 hajar min usut bahar al-Urdun,min al-bakaan al-wagafo foogah rujaal al-diin.Wa wadduuhum ma'aaku wa khuttuuhum fi l-bakaan al-tidallu wa tunuumu foogah.-
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' naada al-atnaachar rujaal al-azalaahum min Bani Israa'iil wa l-rujaal dool ayyi waahid min gabiila.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu giddaam sanduug Allah Ilaahku fi usut bahar al-Urdun wa ayyi waahid minku yichiil hajar waahid fi kitfah ale hasab adad gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Achaan yabga alaama ambeenaatku.Akuun fi l-mustakhbal,iyaalku yas'alooku wa yuguulu-:--Al-hujaar dool yimassulu chunu-?--
Wa intu tuguulu leehum-:--Da achaan almi hana bahar al-Urdun wagaf wakit sanduug mu'aahadat Allah gaa'id yagta' al-bahar.Wa l-hujaar dool humman zikra le Bani Israa'iil ila l-abad kadar almi bahar al-Urdun wagaf.-
Wa khalaas,Bani Israa'iil sawwo misil Yachuu' amaraahum beyah.Humman chaalo 12 hajar min usut bahar al-Urdun fi adad gabaayil Bani Israa'iil,misil Allah gaalah le Yachuu'.Wa humman chaalo al-hujaar dool wa waddoohum ma'aahum lahaddi l-bakaan al-naamo foogah wa khattoohum hinaak.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' amar yichiilu 12 hujaar aakhariin wa yurussuuhum fi usut bahar al-Urdun fi bakaan rijle rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin sanduug al-mu'aahada.Wa l-hujaar dool gaa'idiin lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wagafo fi usut bahar al-Urdun lahaddi tamma kulla l-kalaam al-Allah amar beyah Yachuu' le yuguulah le l-cha'ab.Wa da hasab al-kalaam al-Muusa amar beyah Yachuu'.Wa l-cha'ab macho ajala le yagta'o al-bahar.
Wa wakit kulla l-cha'ab gata'ooh khalaas,rujaal al-diin chaalo sanduug Allah wa macho giddaam al-cha'ab.
Wa l-macho awwal min Bani Israa'iil humman gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa.Wa humman macho be nizaam hana harib giddaam Bani Israa'iil misil awwal Muusa gaalah leehum.
Wa hawaale 40-000 rujaal musallahiin gata'o al-bahar jaahiziin le l-harib wa Allah ma'aahum.Wa humman mutawajjihiin ale kadaadit Ariiha.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Allah kabbar Yachuu' fi uyuun kulla Bani Israa'iil wa humman karramooh misil awwal karramo min Muusa fi hayaatah.
Wa khalaas,Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:
Aamur rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin al-sanduug al-foogah liihaan al-mu'aahada,yamurgu min lubb bahar al-Urdun.
Wa Yachuu' amar rujaal al-diin wa gaal leehum-:-Amurgu min lubb bahar al-Urdun.
Wa rujaal al-diin al-chaayliin sanduug mu'aahadat Allah marago min lubb bahar al-Urdun.Wa wakit khatto rijleehum fi l-turaab al-yaabis,khalaas almi al-bahar gabbal fi bakaanah wa gaa'id yajri wa saal misil awwal.
Wa fi l-yoom al-aachir hana l-chahar al-awwal,al-cha'ab gata'o bahar al-Urdun.Wa sakano fi Gilgaal,sabaah min hillit Ariiha.
Wa kan le l-hujaar al-chaaloohum ma'aahum min bahar al-Urdun,Yachuu' rassaahum fi Gilgaal.
Wa gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Akuun fi l-mustakhbal,iyaalku yas'alooku wa yuguulu leeku-:--Al-hujaar dool yimassulu chunu-?--
Khalaas,fassuru leehum wa guulu-:--Bani Israa'iil gata'o bahar al-Urdun da fi l-turaab al-yaabis.
Wa da achaan Allah Ilaahku yabbas almi bahar al-Urdun giddaamku lahaddi intu gidirtu gata'tuuh.Wa da misil Allah Ilaahku sawwaah leena zamaan wakit hu yabbas al-bahar al-Ahmar giddaamna wa aniina gata'naah.
Wa be da,kulla chu'uub al-ard ya'arfu kadar iid Allah chadiide wa intu iyaalna kula takhaafo min Allah Ilaahku daayman.-
Wa kulla muluuk al-Amuuriyiin al-gaa'idiin fi l-nuss al-kharbaani le bahar al-Urdun wa kulla muluuk al-Kan'aaniyiin al-fi khachum al-bahar al-Abyad sim'o kadar Allah yabbas almi bahar al-Urdun giddaam Bani Israa'iil lahaddi gidro gata'o.Wa wakit sim'ooh khalaas,guluub al-muluuk dool angata'o wa ma gidro yagoodu giddaam Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Tarrig leek hujaar wa tahhir al-ma mutahhariin min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' tarrag hujaar wa tahhar Bani Israa'iil fi jabal al-Tahuura.
Wa daahu al-sabab al-tahharaahum foogah Yachuu'.Awwal,kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin al-marago min Masir maato fi l-sahara fi deribhum wakit jaayiin min Masir.
Wa l-cha'ab al-marago min Masir kulluhum mutahhariin.Laakin iyaalhum al-wildoohum fi l-sahara fi l-derib wakit jaayiin min Masir,waahid kula minhum ma mutahhar.
Bani Israa'iil raakho le muddit 40 sana fi l-sahara lahaddi kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin al-marago min Masir maato achaan humman ma sim'o kalaam Allah.Wa fi chaan isyaanhum,Allah kharrar kadar ma yichawwifhum al-balad al-awwal hu halaf le juduudhum wa gaal yantiiha leehum.Wa di l-balad al-malaane be l-laban wa l-asal.
Wa Allah wadda iyaalhum fi badalhum.Wa awlaadhum dool bas al-naas al-tahharaahum Yachuu' achaan humman ma tahharoohum fi l-derib.
Wa wakit tahharo kulla rujaal al-umma,humman ga'ado fi l-fariig lahaddi biro.
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Al-yoom ana maragt minku al-eeb al-jibtuuh min Masir. Wa achaan da,sammo al-bakaan da Gilgaal (ma'anaatah marag minku).Wa l-usum da gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom kula.
Wa Bani Israa'iil nazalo fi Gilgaal wa ayyado iid al-Fisha fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar al-awwal be achiiye fi kadaadit Ariiha.
Wa ambaakir,humman akalo min intaaj al-balad wa khubza bala tawwaara wa fariiki.
Wa fi l-yoom al-akalo min intaaj al-balad,khalaas al-manna wagafat.Al-manna wagafat min Bani Israa'iil wa humman akalo min intaaj balad Kan'aan fi l-sana di.
Wa wakit Yachuu' gaa'id jamb Ariiha,hu rafa' raasah wa chaaf naadum waagif giddaamah wa seefah masluul fi iidah.Wa Yachuu' macha leyah wa gaal-:-Inta leena aniina walla le aduuna-?
Wa hu gaal-:-La-!Ana khaayid deech Allah.Wa hassa' jiit. Wa khalaas,Yachuu' waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaamah wa gaal leyah-:-Ya sayyidi-!Chunu kalaamak leyi ana abdak-?
Wa khaayid deech Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Sill na'aalak achaan al-bakaan al-inta gaa'id foogah da mukhaddas. Wa khalaas,Yachuu' salla na'aalah misil amarah beyah.
Wa Ariiha masduuda gawi min Bani Israa'iil wa naadum ma marag wa la dakhal.
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Chiif,ana nisallim leek Ariiha wa malikha wa rujaalha al-furraas.
Wa chiil kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin wa ruukhu hawwugu al-hille di.Wa hawwugu al-hille di marra waahide ayyi yoom lahaddi sitte yoom.
Wa sab'a rujaal diin yuruukhu giddaam sanduug Allah wa ayyi waahid minhum yichiil buug hana garin kabich.Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi',ruukhu wa hawwugu al-hille sab'a marraat wa rujaal al-diin yadurbu al-buug.
Wa wakit tasma'o rujaal al-diin yadurbu hiss tawiil fi l-buug,khalli kulla l-cha'ab yi'iitu.Wa l-durdur al-muhawwig al-hille yaga' wa khalaas,kulluku tahjumu al-hille,ayyi waahid be l-faraga al-giddaamah.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' wileed Nuun naada rujaal al-diin wa gaal leehum-:-Chiilu sanduug al-mu'aahada wa khalli sab'a rujaal diin yamchu giddaam sanduug Allah wa ayyi waahid minhum yichiil buug hana garin kabich.
Wa hu gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Amchu wa hawwugu al-hille wa l-rujaal al-musallahiin khalli yamchu giddaam sanduug Allah.
Wa kulla cheyy bigi misil Yachuu' gaalah le l-cha'ab.Wa rujaal al-diin al-sab'a macho giddaam sanduug Allah wa ayyi waahid minhum chaal buug wa yadurbah.Wa sanduug mu'aahadat Allah kamaan maachi waraahum.
Wa l-rujaal al-musallahiin maachiin giddaam rujaal al-diin al-yadurbu al-buug wa rujaal musallahiin aakhariin maachiin wara l-sanduug.Wakit humman maachiin rujaal al-diin gaa'idiin yadurbu al-buug.
Wa Yachuu' amaraahum le l-cha'ab wa gaal leehum-:-Abadan ma ti'iitu wa hissuku ma yinsami' wa khuchuumku ma yuguul ayyi kalaam lahaddi yoom ana nuguul leeku iitu.
Wa humman hawwago al-hille marra waahide be sanduug Allah wa gabbalo naamo fi l-fariig.
Wa Yachuu' gamma be fajur badri wa rujaal al-diin chaalo sanduug Allah.
Wa rujaal al-diin al-sab'a macho giddaam sanduug Allah wa ayyi waahid chaal buug wa yadurbah.Wa l-rujaal al-musallahiin maachiin giddaamhum wa rujaal musallahiin aakhariin maachiin wara sanduug Allah.Wakit humman maachiin,rujaal al-diin gaa'idiin yadurbu al-buug.
Wa humman hawwago al-hille marra waahide fi l-yoom al-taani wa ba'ad da,gabbalo fi l-fariig.Wa humman sawwo misil da lahaddi sitte yoom.
Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi',humman gammo be fajur badri hawwago al-hille misil fi l-aade.Wa laakin fi l-yoom da bas,humman hawwago al-hille sab'a marraat.
Wa fi l-marra al-saab'e,rujaal al-diin darabo al-buug wa Yachuu' gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Iitu achaan Allah antaaku al-hille-!
Dammuru al-hille wa kulla l-khumaam al-haraam.Dammuruuha achaan hi hint Allah.Wa illa Raahaab al-charmuuta wa kulla l-naas al-ma'aaha fi beetha,ma taktuluuhum achaan hi labbadat al-naas al-rassalnaahum yuruukhu al-balad.
Wa kan leeku intu,angar'u min al-haraam.Ma tatma'o wa tichiilu al-khumaam al-haraam achaan tinajjusu beyah fariig Bani Israa'iil wa tijiibu foogah al-masiibe.
Al-fudda wa l-dahab wa kulla l-mu'iddaat hana l-nahaas wa l-hadiid,humman dool mukhassasiin le Allah.Khuttuuhum fi makhaazin Allah.
Wa darabo al-buug wa wakit al-cha'ab sim'o daribiin al-buug,aato be chidde.Wa tawwaali,durdur al-hille waga' wa Bani Israa'iil hajamo al-hille ayyi waahid be l-faraga al-giddaamah wa chaalo al-hille.
Wa humman dammaro kulla cheyy fi l-hille.Katalo be l-seef kulla l-rujaal wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal wa l-chiyyaab wa l-bagar wa l-khanam wa l-hamiir.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le l-jawaasiis al-itneen al-rassaloohum yi'akkudu al-balad-:-Amchu fi beet al-mara al-charmuuta wa amurguuha wa amurgu kulla aayilitha misil intu halaftu leeha.
Wa l-jawaasiis dool dakhalo fi l-beet wa marago Raahaab wa abuuha wa ammaha wa akhwaanha wa kulla aayilitha.Wa humman marago kulla naas beetha wa khattoohum barra min fariig Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-hille kamaan haragooha be kulla cheyy al-fiiha wa illa l-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-mu'iddaat hana l-nahaas wa l-hadiid khattoohum fi makhaazin hana beet Allah.
Wa Yachuu' khalla Raahaab al-charmuuta wa aayilitha wa kulla naasha hayyiin achaan hi labbadat al-jawaasiis al-rassalaahum Yachuu' yi'akkudu Ariiha.Wa hi wa zurriiyitha saakniin fi usut Bani Israa'iil lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Yachuu' halaf wa gaal-:-Allah yal'an al-naadum al-yugumm wa yabni battaan hillit Ariiha.Khalli iyaalah yumuutu-!Al-bikir yumuut wakit yukhutt asaasha wa tariidah yumuut wakit yirakkib biibaanha.
Wa Allah kaan ma'a Yachuu' wa kulla naas al-balad sim'o beyah.
Wa Bani Israa'iil iso Allah fi l-khumaam al-hu harramah leehum.Akaan wileed Karmi wileed Zabdi wileed Zaarah min gabiilat Yahuuza chaal min al-khumaam al-haraam wa khalaas,Allah khidib le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa min Ariiha,Yachuu' rassal jawaasiis le hillit Aay al-gariibe le hillit Beet Awan sabaah le hillit Beet Iil.Wa gaal-:-Amchu akkudu al-balad. Wa l-jawaasiis dool macho akkado hillit Aay.
Wa wakit gabbalo,gaalo le Yachuu'-:-Khalli al-cha'ab kulluhum ma yamchu.Khalli naas misil 2-000 aw 3-000 bas yamchu yahjumu hillit Aay achaan sukkaanha chiyya wa fi chaan da,ma tita''ib al-cha'ab kulluhum ke.
Wa khalaas,hawaale 3-000 rujaal macho hajamo al-hille.Wa laakin ma gidro yichiiluuha wa arrado giddaam sukkaan hillit Aay.
Wa rujaal hillit Aay taradoohum min madkhal al-hille lahaddi Chabaariim wa katalo hawaale 36 raajil fi l-dilleeye.Wa khalaas,al-cha'ab khaafo wa galibhum angata'.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Yachuu' wa chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil charrato khulgaanhum min al-hizin wa sabbo turaab fi ruuseehum.Wa waga'o be wujuuhhum fi l-turaab wa sajado giddaam sanduug Allah lahaddi l-achiiye.
Wa Yachuu' gaal-:-Ya Allah Rabbi,maala inta jibt al-cha'ab lahaddi gata'o bahar al-Urdun-?Wa da achaan tisallimna le l-Amuuriyiin wa yidammuruuna walla-?Wa hassa' da,aniina nidimna.Maala ma sakanna sabaah le bahar al-Urdun-?
Ya Rabb,saamihni.Hassa' ana nuguul chunu ba'ad Bani Israa'iil arrado min udwaanhum-?
Wakit al-Kan'aaniyiin wa kulla sukkaan al-balad yasma'o,humman kula yugummu diddina wa yuguchchu usumna min al-ard.Wa be da,chunu yabga le charaf usmak al-aziim-?
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Gumm-!Maala waga't be wijhak fi l-turaab-?
Bani Israa'iil aznabo-!Aywa,humman nagado mu'aahadati al-ana amartuhum beeha wa chaalo min al-khumaam al-haraam,sirgooh wa labbadooh fi khumaamhum.
Wa fi chaan da,Bani Israa'iil ma yagdaro yiwaajuhu udwaanhum.Humman yi'arrudu min giddaamhum achaan humman zaathum bigo misil al-khumaam al-haraam.Wa be da,ana ma nukuun ma'aaku,ya Bani Israa'iil,kan ma dammartu kulla l-khumaam al-haraam al-gaa'id fi usutku.
Gumm amchi khassis al-cha'ab wa guul leehum-:--Khassusu nufuusku le ambaakir achaan daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Fi khumaam haraam gaa'id fi usutku,ya Bani Israa'iil.Wa intu ma tagdaro tiwaajuhu udwaanku kan ma maragtu al-khumaam al-haraam da min usutku.
Wa ambaakir fajur,ta'aalu hasab gabaayilku.Wa l-gabiila al-ya'azilha Allah taji hasab khuchuum buyuutha.Wa khachum al-beet al-ya'azilah Allah yaji hasab aayilaatah.Wa l-aayila al-ya'azilha Allah taji hasab rujaalha.
Wa l-raajil al-ya'azilah Allah be sabab hu chaal khumaam haraam,al-raajil da yiharruguuh fi l-naar hu wa kulla cheyy al-indah achaan hu nagad mu'aahadat Allah wa sawwa fi'il cheen fi Bani Israa'iil."-
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' gamma be fajur badri wa gaddam Bani Israa'iil hasab gabaayilhum wa khalaas,gabiilat Yahuuza azalooha.
Wa gaddam gabiilat Yahuuza hasab khuchuum buyuutha wa khachum beet Zaarah azalooh.Wa gaddam khachum beet Zaarah hasab aayilaatah wa aayilat Zabdi azalooha.
Wa wakit gaddam rujaal aayiltah,azalooh le Akaan wileed Karmi wileed Zabdi wileed Zaarah al-min gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le Akaan-:-Ya wileedi,Allah aleek-!Majjid Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil wa achkurah.Kallimni-!Inta sawweet chunu-?Ma tilabbid leyi cheyy.
Wa Akaan radda le Yachuu' wa gaal-:-Be sahiih,ana sawweet zanib didd Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa daahu al-cheyy al-ana sawweetah.
Ana chift fi l-khaniime al-ligiinaaha fi l-harib,khalag jamiil min Chin'aar wa 200 hajar fudda wa hafiide hana dahab wazinha 72 jineeh.Wa l-khumaam da ajabaani wa ana chiltah wa daahu madfuun fi l-turaab fi lubb kheemti wa l-fudda tihtah.
Wa Yachuu' rassal naas fi kheemtah wa daahu ligo al-khumaam al-madfuun fi lubb kheemtah wa l-fudda tihtah.
Humman marago al-khumaam min al-kheema wa waddooh le Yachuu' wa le kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa khattooh giddaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil chaalo Akaan wileed Zaarah wa l-fudda wa l-khalag wa l-hafiide hana l-dahab wa awlaadah wa banaatah wa toorah wa humaarah wa khanamah wa kheemtah wa kulla cheyy al-indah wa waddoohum fi waadi Akuur.
Wa Yachuu' gaal-:-Maala jibt leena masiibe misil di-?Allah yijiib foogak inta masiibe al-yoom-! Wa khalaas,kulla Bani Israa'iil gammo rajamooh.Wa rajamo aayiltah wa harragoohum.
Wa humman sawwo fooghum koom kabiir hana hujaar al-gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.Wa khalaas,Allah ma khidib aleehum battaan.Wa fi chaan da,sammo al-bakaan da waadi Akuur (ma'anaatah waadi al-masiibe) lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Ma takhaaf wa la tinbahit.Chiil ma'aak kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin wa gumm didd hillit Aay.Daahu ana sallamt leek malik hillit Aay wa cha'abah wa hillitah wa baladah.
Wa inta tisawwi fi hillit Aay wa malikha misil sawweet fi Ariiha wa malikha.Wa laakin hassa' tagdaro tichiilu khaniime hana l-khumaam wa l-bahaayim.Wa arbut kamiin wara l-hille.
Wa Yachuu' wa kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin gammo jahhazo le yahjumu hillit Aay.Wa hu azal 30-000 raajil min al-rujaal al-furraas wa rassalaahum be l-leel.
Wa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Arbutu kamiin wara l-hille wa ma tagoodu minha ba'iid laakin agoodu jaahiziin.
Wa ana wa kulla l-deech al-ma'aayi nigarrubu le l-hille.Wa wakit humman yamurgu le yihaarubuuna,aniina ni'arrudu minhum misil awwal.
Wa yamurgu waraana wa aniina niwadduuhum ba'iid min al-hille lahaddi yuguulu-:--Al-naas dool arrado giddaamna misil awwal.- Wa wakit aniina najru giddaamhum,
khalaas intu tamurgu min kamiinku wa tichiilu al-hille achaan Allah Ilaahku yisallimha leeku fi iideeku.
Wa min tichiiluuha,harruguuha misil Allah hajja leeku.Wa dool bas awaamiri ana.
Wa Yachuu' rassalaahum fi bakaan al-kamiin wa humman ga'ado ambeen Beet Iil wa hillit Aay fi l-nuss al-kharbaani hana hillit Aay.Wa fi l-leele di,Yachuu' naam ma'a l-cha'ab fi l-fariig.
Wa be fajur badri,Yachuu' gamma alfaggad al-deech.Wa ba'ad da,hu wa chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil gammo fi raas al-deech wa macho le yahjumu hillit Aay.
Wa kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin al-ma'aayah macho wa garrabo le l-hille be nussaha al-munchaakhi wa nazalo hinaak.Wa l-waadi gaa'id ambeenaathum humman wa hillit Aay.
Wa Yachuu' chaal hawaale 5-000 raajil wa khattaahum kamiin ambeen Beet Iil wa hillit Aay fi l-nuss al-kharbaani hana l-hille.
Wa l-deech khatta mu'askarah be l-nuss al-munchaakhi hana l-hille wa l-kamiin khattooh kharib le l-hille.Wa fi l-leele di,Yachuu' macha fi lubb al-waadi.
Wakit malik hillit Aay chaaf deech Bani Israa'iil,hu wa kulla rujaal al-hille gammo le yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil ale waadi al-Urdun.Wa laakin humman ma irfo kadar khatto kamiin wara l-hille.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' wa deech Bani Israa'iil sawwo nufuushum misil anhazamo wa gammo arrado ale l-sahara.
Wa kulla rujaal hillit Aay lammo sawwa le yaturduuhum.Wa taarado Yachuu' wa deechah lahaddi macho ba'iid min al-hille.
Wa fi hillit Aay wa Beet Iil,ma fi raajil al-ma marag taarad Bani Israa'iil.Wa humman khallo al-hille maftuuha wa macho yitaarudu Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Midd al-harba al-fi iidak ale hillit Aay achaan nisallimha leek. Wa khalaas,Yachuu' madda al-harba al-fi iidah ale l-hille.
Wa min madda iidah,tawwaali al-rujaal al-fi l-kamiin gammo wa jaro dakhalo al-hille wa chaalooha wa harragooha.
Wa rujaal hillit Aay anlafato wa chaafo al-dukhkhaan gaa'id yatla' min al-hille.Wa khalaas,humman ma induhum bakaan al-yajru aleyah achaan Bani Israa'iil al-mu'arridiin gabbalo fi l-naas al-gaa'idiin yitaaruduuhum.
Wa khalaas,wakit Yachuu' wa deech Bani Israa'iil chaafo al-rujaal al-fi l-kamiin chaalo al-hille wa l-dukhkhaan gaa'id yatla' minha,humman hajamo rujaal hillit Aay wa kataloohum.
Wa l-rujaal al-sawwo al-kamiin marago min hillit Aay le yihaarubuuhum humman kula.Wa khalaas,rujaal hillit Aay bigo fi usut Bani Israa'iil,dool giddaamhum wa dool waraahum.Wa Bani Israa'iil kataloohum lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy wa la arrad.
Wa kan le malik hillit Aay kamaan,karabooh hayy wa waddooh le Yachuu'.
Wa ba'ad Bani Israa'iil katalo be l-seef kulla sukkaan hillit Aay fi l-kadaade wa fi l-sahara wa fi ayyi bakaan al-taradoohum foogah,humman gabbalo fi l-hille wa katalo kulla naasha be l-seef.
Wa fi l-yoom da,kulla sukkaan hillit Aay maato wa adadhum 12-000 rujaal wa awiin.
Achaan Yachuu' ma dalla iidah al-madda beeha al-harba lahaddi dammaro kulla sukkaan Aay.
Wa Bani Israa'iil chaalo khaniime hana l-bahaayim wa l-khumaam min al-hille di hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah le Yachuu'.
Wa Yachuu' harrag hillit Aay wa bigat koom hana turaab daayim wa kharaab lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Yachuu' chanag malik hillit Aay fi chadara wa khallaah mu'allag foogha lahaddi l-achiiye.Wa wakit al-harraay waga'at,Yachuu' amar yidallu janaaztah.Wa wakit dallooha,zagalooha fi khachum baab al-hille wa sawwo foogha koom kabiir hana hujaar al-gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' bana madbah le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil fi jabal Ibaal
misil Muusa abd Allah amar Bani Israa'iil wa misil maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa.Gaal waajib yabnu madbah be hujaar kaamiliin al-abadan ma gata'oohum be hadiid.Wa fi l-madbah da,gaddamo dahaaya muharragiin le Allah wa dahaaya salaama.
Wa fi l-hujaar dool,Yachuu' katab Tawraat Muusa al-awwal hu katabha le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa cha'ab Bani Israa'iil wa chuyuukhhum wa masaa'iilhum wa gudiyaahum wagafo jaay wa jaay le sanduug mu'aahadat Allah giddaam rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin al-chaalo al-sanduug da.Al-ajaanib wa l-muwaatiniin kulluhum gaa'idiin.Nussuhum wagafo giddaam jabal Gariziim wa nussuhum wagafo giddaam jabal Ibaal misil Muusa abd Allah amaraahumle yibaaruku awwalan ke Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' gara be hiss aali kulla kalaam kitaab al-Tawraat hana Muusa hana l-baraka wa l-la'ana hasab kulla cheyy al-maktuub fi l-kitaab da.
Wa min kulla l-kalaam al-katabah Muusa,ma fi kalaam al-Yachuu' ma garaah giddaam kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal wa l-ajaanib al-gaa'idiin ma'aahum.
Wa kulla muluuk al-balad sim'o be nasur Bani Israa'iil wa humman saakniin kharib le bahar al-Urdun fi l-jibaal wa fi l-sahale wa fi khachum al-bahar al-Abyad lahaddi Lubnaan.Wa humman muluuk al-Hittiyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.
Wa kulla l-muluuk dool astafago achaan yihaarubu sawa didd Yachuu' wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa sukkaan Gib'uun min Hiwwiyiin sim'o be l-cheyy al-sawwaah Yachuu' fi hillaal Ariiha wa hillit Aay.
Wa humman kula gammo annaajado.Chaddo fi hamiirhum chuwaalaat gadiimiin wa girab hana khamar mucharratiin wa mukhayyatiin.
Wa libso ni'le gadiimiin wa mukhayyatiin wa libso khulgaan mucharratiin wa chaalo khubza yaabse wa mukassara.
Wa macho ligo Yachuu' fi l-fariig fi Gilgaal wa gaalo leyah wa le Bani Israa'iil-:-Aniina jiina min ba'iid.Wa hassa',sawwu ma'aana alaakha.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil gaalo le l-Hiwwiyiin dool-:-Mumkin intu saakniin fi usutna-!Wa be da,ma nagdaro nisawwu ma'aaku alaakha.
Wa laakin humman gaalo le Yachuu'-:-Aniina abiidak.-Wa Yachuu' sa'alaahum wa gaal leehum-:-Intu yaatumman wa jaayiin min ween-?
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Aniina abiidak jaayiin min balad ba'iide marra waahid fi chaan usum Allah Ilaahak achaan simi'na be usmah wa be kulla cheyy al-sawwaah fi Masir.
Wa simi'na battaan be kulla cheyy al-sawwaah fi l-muluuk al-itneen hana l-Amuuriyiin al-gaa'idiin khaadi le bahar al-Urdun wa humman Siihuun malik Hachbuun wa Oog malik Baachaan al-saakin fi Achtaruut.
Wa kubaaraatna wa kulla sukkaan baladna gaalo leena-:--Chiilu ma'aaku zaad le l-derib wa amchu gaabuluuhum wa guulu leehum-:"Aniina abiidku wa hassa' sawwu ma'aana alaakha."--
Wa chiifu al-khubza hint zaadna-!Wakit maragna le naju leeku,chilnaaha haamiye wa laakin hassa',di hi yaabse wa mukassara.
Wa l-girab dool kula,wakit maleenaahum khamar humman judaad.Wa laakin hassa' chiifu kikkeef humman achcharrato.Wa khulgaanna wa ni'leena kula gidmo achaan saafarna wa jiina leeku min ba'iid.
Wa Bani Israa'iil khassado be alaakhithum wa akalo min zaadhum wa laakin ma sa'alo Allah le ya'arfu al-hu yidoorah.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' sawwa ma'aahum salaam wa alaakha al-tadman leehum hayaathum.Wa chuyuukh al-mujtama' kula halafo leehum.
Wa laakin talaata yoom ba'ad sawwo ma'aahum al-alaakha,Bani Israa'iil sim'o kadar al-naas dool jiiraanhum wa saakniin fi usuthum.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gammo saafaro.Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,wassalo fi hillaalhum wa humman hillaal Gib'uun wa Kafiira wa Biiruut wa Kharyat Ya'ariim.
Wa Bani Israa'iil ma daraboohum achaan chuyuukh al-mujtama' halafo leehum be Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa laakin kulla l-mujtama' gaa'idiin yihajju tihit tihit didd al-chuyuukh.
Wa kulla l-chuyuukh gaalo le kulla l-mujtama'-:-Aniina halafna leehum be usum Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Battaan ma nagdaro nisawwu leehum cheyy fasil.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-nisawwuuh leehum.Nikhalluuhum hayyiin achaan khadab Allah ma yanzil foogna be sabab al-haliife al-halafnaaha leehum.
Wa l-chuyuukh gaalo battaan le cha'abhum-:-Nikhalluuhum hayyiin achaan yichaggugu al-hatab wa yawurdu almi le kulla l-mujtama'. Wa da bas kalaam al-chuyuukh.
Wa Yachuu' naadaahum le sukkaan Gib'uun wa gaal leehum-:-Maala khachcheetuuna wa gultu intu jaayiin min ba'iid wa taari intu saakniin fi usutna-?
Wa be da,intu khalaas mal'uuniin wa tabgo daayman abiid.Wa tichaggugu al-hatab wa tawurdu almi le beet Allah.
Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aniina abiidak.Simi'na kadar Allah Ilaahku amar abdah Muusa yantiiku al-balad di wa yaktul sukkaanha giddaamku.Wa aniina khufna ziyaada minku wa achaan da bas,sawweena al-cheyy da.
Wa hassa',daahu aniina fi iidak.Sawwi foogna ayyi cheyy al-tidoorah.
Wa be misil da,Yachuu' najjaahum min Bani Israa'iil ma kataloohum.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Yachuu' khaddamaahum wa humman chaggago al-hatab wa warado al-almi le kulla l-mujtama' wa le madbah Allah.Wa zurriiyithum yisawwu al-khidme di lahaddi l-yoom,fi bakaan al-ibaada al-Allah azalah le cha'abah.
Wa Aduuni Saadikh malik Uruchaliim simi' kadar Yachuu' chaal hillit Aay wa dammaraaha wa sawwa fi hillit Aay wa malikha misil hu sawwa fi Ariiha wa malikha.Wa simi' kadar sukkaan Gib'uun sawwo salaam ma'a Bani Israa'iil wa sakano fi usuthum.
Wa khalaas,hu khaaf marra waahid achaan Gib'uun hi hille kabiire misil hillaal al-muluuk wa hi kabiire min hillit Aay wa rujaalha kula fahaliin.
Wa khalaas,Aduuni Saadikh malik Uruchaliim rassal le Huhaam malik Hibruun wa Firaam malik Yarmuut wa Yafii'a malik Lakiich wa Dabiir malik Agluun.Wa gaal leehum-:
Yalla ta'aalu leyi-!Afza'ooni wa nihaarubu Gib'uun achaan hi sawwat salaam ma'a Yachuu' wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-muluuk al-khamsa hana l-Amuuriyiin dool wa kulla duyuuchhum macho hajamo Gib'uun wa haarabooha.Wa humman malik Uruchaliim wa malik Hibruun wa malik Yarmuut wa malik Lakiich wa malik Agluun.
Wa tawwaali,naas Gib'uun rassalo le Yachuu' fi mu'askar Gilgaal wa gaalo leyah-:-Ma taaba musaa'adatak le abiidak.Ta'aalu leena ajala-!Afza'oona wa najjuuna achaan kulla muluuk al-Amuuriyiin al-saakniin fi l-jibaal lammo wa gammo diddina.
Wa Yachuu' gamma min Gilgaal wa ma'aayah kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin wa kulla l-rujaal al-furraas.
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Ma takhaaf minhum achaan ana sallamtuhum leek fi iideenak wa waahid minhum ma yagdar yagiif giddaamak.
Wa Yachuu' gamma min Gilgaal wa raakh tuul al-leel wa be khafla ja le malik al-Amuuriyiin.
Wa Allah hazamaahum haziime kabiire giddaam Bani Israa'iil fi Gib'uun.Wa taradoohum ale giizaan Beet Huruun wa kataloohum lahaddi hillaal Aziikha wa Makhiida.
Wa wakit humman mu'arridiin giddaam Bani Israa'iil wa wassalo fi l-dilleeye hana Beet Huruun,Allah rassal fooghum barad kubaar min al-sama wa maato.Wa l-barad al-kubaar da darabaahum fi deribhum lahaddi Aziikha wa katal naas ziyaada min al-naas al-kataloohum Bani Israa'iil be l-seef.
Wa fi l-yoom al-foogah Allah sallam al-Amuuriyiin le Bani Israa'iil,Yachuu' sa'al Allah giddaam Bani Israa'iil wa gaal-:-Ya l-harraay,agiifi saabte fi Gib'uun-!Wa inta al-gamar,agiif saabit fi waadi Ayyaluun-!
Wa l-harraay wagafat wa l-gamar kula wagaf lahaddi al-umma chaalat taarha fi udwaanha.Wa daahu al-maktuub fi Kitaab al-Saalih-:-Al-harraay wagafat fi bakaanha fi l-sama,ma waga'at muddit yoom kaamil.
Wa l-yoom da,yoom mislah ke ma fiih wa la gablah wa la ba'adah.Wa fi l-yoom da,al-insaan sa'al wa Allah khibil su'aalah achaan Allah gaa'id yihaarib udwaan Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gabbalo fi l-fariig fi Gilgaal.
Wa l-muluuk al-khamsa al-arrado macho allabbado fi karkuur Makhiida.
Wa naas jo gaalo le Yachuu'-:-Al-muluuk al-khamsa anlago mullabbidiin fi karkuur hajar Makhiida.
Wa Yachuu' gaal-:-Dargusu hujaar kubaar wa siddu beehum khachum al-karkuur wa khuttu naas yaharsu al-muluuk dool.
Wa intu kamaan ma tagiifu.Aturdu udwaanku wa agta'o leehum al-derib.Ma tikhalluuhum yadkhulu mudunhum achaan Allah Ilaahku sallamaahum leeku fi iideeku.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' wa Bani Israa'iil annasaro nasur kabiir wa dammaro al-Amuuriyiin.Wa naas chiyya bas min al-Amuuriyiin gidro arrado wa nijo wa dakhalo fi mudunhum al-gawiyiin.
Wa ba'ad da,kulla l-cha'ab gabbalo le Yachuu' fi l-mu'askar al-fi Makhiida be salaam.Wa naadum waahid kula min al-balad ma gidir yuguul cheyy didd Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' gaal-:-Fukku khachum al-karkuur wa amurgu leyi al-muluuk al-khamsa.
Wa be misil da,humman maragoohum le l-muluuk al-khamsa min al-karkuur wa jaaboohum giddaam Yachuu'.Wa humman muluuk Uruchaliim wa Hibruun wa Yarmuut wa Lakiich wa Agluun.
Wa wakit maragoohum le l-muluuk al-khamsa wa jaaboohum giddaamah,Yachuu' naadaahum le kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil wa gaal le khuyyaad askarah al-macho ma'aayah-:-Khuttu rijleeku fi rigaab al-muluuk dool. Wa humman garrabo wa khatto rijleehum fi rigaab al-muluuk.
Wa Yachuu' gaal-:-Ma takhaafo wa la tinbahtu wa laakin abgo chudaad wa fahaliin.Achaan Allah yisawwi nafs al-cheyy fi kulla udwaanku al-tihaarubuuhum.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' katalaahum le l-muluuk al-khamsa wa allaghum fi chadar khamsa,ayyi waahid fi chadara.Wa humman ga'ado mu'allagiin lahaddi l-achiiye.
Wa ba'ad al-harraay waga'at,Yachuu' amar yinazzulu janaazaathum min al-chadar wa yazguluuhum fi l-karkuur al-awwal humman allabbado foogah.Wa saddo khachmah be hujaar kubaar wa l-hujaar dool gaa'idiin lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Yachuu' chaal hillit Makhiida wa katal malikha be l-seef wa dammar kulla naasha lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy.Wa Yachuu' sawwa fi malik Makhiida misil sawwa fi malik Ariiha.
Wa min Makhiida,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil macho hillit Libna wa haarabooha.
Wa Libna kula Allah sallamaaha hi wa malikha fi iid Bani Israa'iil wa humman katalo malikha be l-seef wa dammaro kulla naasha lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy.Wa Yachuu' sawwa fi malik Libna misil sawwa fi malik Ariiha.
Wa min Libna,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil macho haasaro hillit Lakiich wa haarabooha.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taani,Lakiich kula Allah sallamaaha fi iid Bani Israa'iil wa humman katalo kulla naasha be l-seef.Wa Yachuu' sawwa foogha misil sawwa fi Libna.
Wa Huraam malik Gaazar ja faza' le hillit Lakiich.Wa laakin Yachuu' gidir fooghum hu wa naasah wa katalaahum lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy.
Wa min Lakiich,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil macho haasaro hillit Agluun wa haarabooha.
Wa fi l-yoom da,humman chaalooha be l-seef wa dammaro kulla naasha.Wa Yachuu' sawwa foogha misil sawwa fi Lakiich.
Wa min Agluun,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil macho hillit Hibruun wa haarabooha.
Wa humman chaalooha wa katalo malikha be l-seef wa dammaro kulla naasha wa naas al-hillaal al-taab'iinha lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy.Wa Yachuu' sawwa foogha misil sawwa fi Agluun.Dammar kulla naasha.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gabbalo fi hillit Dabiir wa haarabooha.
Wa humman chaalooha wa kulla l-hillaal al-taab'iinha wa katalo malikha be l-seef wa dammaro kulla naasha lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy.Wa Yachuu' sawwa fi Dabiir wa malikha misil sawwa fi Hibruun wa misil sawwa fi Libna wa malikha.
Wa be misil da,Yachuu' chaal kulla l-balad ya'ni jibaalha wa junuubha wa sahalitha wa giizaanha.Hu katal muluukha lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy.Wa dammar kulla makhluug hayy misil Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil amarah beyah.
Wa Yachuu' chaal kulla l-balad min Khaadich Barnii'a wa Khazza fi l-wati lahaddi mantagat Goochan wa Gib'uun fi l-munchaakh.
Wa Yachuu' khalab kulla l-muluuk dool wa chaal buldaanhum fi wakit waahid achaan Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaa'id yihaarib leehum.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gabbalo fi l-fariig fi Gilgaal.
Wa wakit Yaabiin malik Haasuur simi' be l-khabar da,rassal naas le yikhabburu muluuk aakhariin wa hummanYubaab malik Maduunwa l-malik hana Chimruunwa l-malik hana Akchaaf
wa muluuk jibaal al-munchaakhwa muluuk waadi al-Urdunjunuub bahar al-Jaliilwa muluuk sahalat Chafiilawa muluuk giizaan Duur fi l-kharib
wa l-Kan'aaniyiinal-gaa'idiin sabaah wa kharibwa l-Amuuriyiinwa l-Hittiyiinwa l-Firizziyiinwa l-Yabuusiyiinal-gaa'idiin fi l-jibaalwa l-Hiwwiyiinal-gaa'idiin fi ga'ar jabal Harmuun fi ard Misfa.
Wa kulluhum marago be duyuuchhum.Wa humman katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar be kheel katiiriin wa arabaat hana harib.
Wa kulla l-muluuk dool lammo wa jo nazalo sawa jamb een Miruum le yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal le Yachuu'-:-Ma takhaaf minhum achaan ambaakir fi nafs al-wakit,ana nisallim al-muluuk dool wa askarhum kulluhum maytiin le Bani Israa'iil.Wa inta tigatti' araagiib kheelhum wa titichch arabaathum hana l-harib.
Wa Yachuu' wa kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin macho hajamoohum be khafla jamb een Miruum.
Wa Allah sallamaahum le Bani Israa'iil.Wa humman hajamoohum wa taaradoohum lahaddi Seeda al-kabiire wa lahaddi Misrafuut Maayim wa lahaddi waadi Misfa ale l-sabaah.Wa humman kataloohum lahaddi naadum waahid minhum kula ma faddal hayy.
Wa Yachuu' sawwa fooghum misil Allah amarah beyah.Hu gatta' araagiib kheelhum wa tachcha arabaathum hana l-harib.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit,Yachuu' gabbal wa chaal madiinat Haasuur wa katal malikha be l-seef.Wa Haasuur di,hi bas zamaan aasima hana kulla l-mamaalik dool.
Wa Yachuu' katal kulla naas Haasuur be l-seef wa dammaraahum lahaddi ma faddal minhum makhluug hayy.Wa ba'ad da,harrag al-madiina di.
Wa Yachuu' chaal kulla l-mudun dool wa katal muluukhum be l-seef.Wa hu dammaraahum misil Muusa abd Allah amarah beyah.
Wa laakin kulla l-mudun al-gaa'idiin fi l-jibaal,Bani Israa'iil ma harragoohum.Illa madiinat Haasuur bas Yachuu' harragaaha.
Wa kulla l-khumaam hana l-mudun dool wa l-bahaayim,Bani Israa'iil kasaboohum misil khaniime.Wa laakin katalo kulla naashum be l-seef lahaddi ma faddal minhum makhluug hayy.
Wa da misil Allah gaalah le abdah Muusa wa Muusa kamaan amar beyah Yachuu' wa da bas al-cheyy al-sawwaah Yachuu'.Hu tabbag kulla kalaam al-Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa be misil da,Yachuu' chaal kulla l-balad di ya'ni jibaalha wa saharat Nagab wa kulla turaab Goochan wa sahalat Chafiila wa waadi al-Urdun wa jibaal Israa'iil wa sahale hana khachum al-bahar.
Wa min al-jabal al-amlas al-gaa'id jamb Sa'iir fi l-wati lahaddi Ba'al Gaad fi waadi Lubnaan fi ga'ar jabal Harmuun fi l-munchaakh,hu karab kulla muluukhum wa katalaahum.
Wa muddit ayyaam katiiriin,Yachuu' gaa'id yihaarib fi l-muluuk dool.
Wa hille waahide kula ma sawwat salaam ma'a Bani Israa'iil illa l-Hiwwiyiin al-gaa'idiin fi Gib'uun.Wa kulla l-hillaal al-aakhariin,humman chaaloohum fi l-harib.
Wa Allah bas gawwa guluubhum le yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil.Wa be da,waajib Bani Israa'iil yidammuruuhum wa ma yihinnu minhum naadum.Wa yikammuluuhum kulluhum misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Yachuu' macha marag Bani Anakh min al-jibaal wa min Hibruun wa min Dabiir wa min Anaab wa min kulla jibaal Yahuuza wa min kulla jibaal Israa'iil.Hu katalaahum kulluhum wa dammar hillaalhum.
Wa min Bani Anakh waahid kula ma faddal fi balad Bani Israa'iil.Wa laakin waahidiin minhum faddalo fi Khazza wa Gaat wa Achduud.
Wa Yachuu' chaal kulla l-balad wa da hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah le Muusa.Wa l-balad di,Yachuu' antaaha le Bani Israa'iil warasa le yigassumuuha ambeenaat gabaayilhum.Wa khalaas,al-harib wagaf wa l-balad ligat al-raaha.
Wa awwal,Bani Israa'iil annasaro fi muluuk itneen sabaah min bahar al-Urdun wa chaalo arduhum min waadi Arnuun fi l-wati lahaddi jabal Harmuun fi l-munchaakh wa kulla arduhum ale l-sabaah min waadi al-Urdun.
Wa l-awwal hu Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin al-saakin fi madiinat Hachbuun.Hu yamluk fi nuss waadi Arnuun min Aruu'ir wa fi nuss turaab Gil'aad lahaddi waadi Yabbuukh al-hu huduud Bani Ammuun.
Wa yamluk fi waadi al-Urdun min bahar al-Jaliil fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Beet Yachiimut gariib al-bahar al-Mayyit wa battaan lahaddi l-turaab fi ga'ar jabal al-Fisga fi l-wati.
Wa l-malik al-taani,hu Oog malik Baachaan al-saakin fi Achtaruut wa Idra'i wa hu aakhir waahid min al-Rafaayiin.
Wa hu malak fi jabal Harmuun wa Salka wa fi kulla turaab Baachaan lahaddi huduud al-Gachuuriyiin wa l-Ma'aakiyiin.Wa hu malak fi nuss turaab Gil'aad lahaddi huduud turaab Siihuun malik Hachbuun.
Wa Muusa abd Allah wa Bani Israa'iil dammaro al-muluuk al-itneen dool wa Muusa anta arduhum warasa le gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa.
Wa Yachuu' wa Bani Israa'iil dammaro muluuk al-balad al-kharib le bahar al-Urdun.Wa arduhum min Ba'al Gaad al-fi waadi Lubnaan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi l-jabal al-amlas al-gaa'id jamb Sa'iir fi l-wati.Wa Yachuu' anta al-ard di warasa le Bani Israa'iil hasab gabaayilhum.
Wa dool al-jibaal wa sahalat Chafiila wa waadi al-Urdun wa l-giizaan wa l-sahara wa saharat Nagab.Wa dool buldaan al-Hittiyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.
Wa l-muluuk al-dammaroohum hummanmalik Ariihawa malik hillit Aayal-gaa'ide jamb Beet Iil
wa malik Uruchaliimwa malik Hibruun
wa malik Yarmuutwa malik Lakiich
wa malik Agluunwa malik Gaazar
wa malik Dabiirwa malik Gadiir
wa malik Hurmawa malik Araad
wa malik Libnawa malik Adullaam
wa malik Makhiidawa malik Beet Iil
wa malik Tafuuhwa malik Hiifar
wa malik Afiikhwa malik Chaaruun
wa malik Maduunwa malik Haasuur
wa malik Chimruun Maruumwa malik Akchaaf
wa malik Ta'nakwa malik Magiddu
wa malik Khadachwa malik Yakhna'aam fi Karmal
wa malik Duur fi giizaan hana Duurwa malik Guuyim fi Jaliil
wa malik Tirsa.Kulluhum ke 31 malik.
Wa Yachuu' bigi chaayib marra waahid wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Inta bigiit chaayib marra waahid wa l-ard al-waajib tichiiluuha kula kabiire.
Wa di hi al-ard al-faddalat.Chiilu kulla mudiiriiyaat al-Filistiyiin wa l-Gachuuriyiin
min waadi Chiihuur fi huduud Masir lahaddi huduud Akhruun fi l-munchaakh.Wa da turaab al-Kan'aaniyiin al-gaa'idiin foogah khamsa kubaaraat hana l-Filistiyiin.Wa humman kabiir Khazza wa kabiir Achduud wa kabiir Achgaluun wa kabiir Gaat wa kabiir Akhruun wa kabiir al-Awwiyiin
fi l-junuub.Wa chiilu kulla ard al-Kan'aaniyiin min Aara hana l-Seeduuniyiin lahaddi Afiikh fi huduud al-Amuuriyiin.
Wa chiilu balad al-Gibaaliyiin wa kulla Lubnaan fi l-sabaah min Ba'al Gaad ga'ar jabal Harmuun lahaddi Labu Hamaat.
Wa chiilu kulla l-jabal min Lubnaan lahaddi Misrafuut Maayim al-yaskun foogah al-Seeduuniyiin.Wa kulla l-sukkaan dool,ana natrudhum giddaam Bani Israa'iil.Wa inta chiil al-balad di wa gassimha warasa le Bani Israa'iil be am'iyeedaat misil ana amartak beyah.
Wa hassa' da,gassim al-balad di le Bani Israa'iil le tabga warasathum.Tis'a gabaayil wa nuss gabiilat Manassa yalgo ard warasathum kharib le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa l-nuss al-aakhar hana gabiilat Manassa wa gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad ligo ard warasathum sabaah le bahar al-Urdun wa da bas al-antaah leehum Muusa abd Allah.
Wa huduudhum min hillit Aruu'ir al-gaa'ide fi khachum waadi Arnuun fi l-junuub wa l-hille al-gaa'ide fi ust al-waadi wa kulla l-sahale hana Miidba lahaddi Diibuun.
Wa gisimhum indah kulla l-mudun al-hakam fooghum Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin min Hachbuun lahaddi huduud Bani Ammuun.
Wa gisimhum indah turaab Gil'aad wa turaab Gachuuriyiin wa l-Ma'aakiyiin wa jabal Harmuun wa kulla turaab Baachaan lahaddi Salka.
Wa turaab Baachaan,awwal da mamlakat Oog al-hakam fi Achtaruut wa Idra'i wa hu aakhir waahid faddal min al-Rafaayiin.Muusa katalaahum wa chaal arduhum.
Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil ma chaalo ard al-Gachuuriyiin wa la l-Ma'aakiyiin wa be da,humman saakniin fi ust Bani Israa'iil lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa le gabiilat Laawi,Muusa ma antaahum ard warasa.Humman waraso al-hadaaya al-muharragiin al-yigaddumuuhum le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Da bas bigi warasathum misil Muusa gaalah leehum.
Wa Muusa anta gisim le gabiilat Ra'uubiin hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa gisimhum min hillit Aruu'ir al-gaa'ide fi khachum waadi Arnuun wa l-hille al-gaa'ide fi ust al-waadi wa kulla l-sahale hana Miidba
lahaddi Hachbuun wa kulla hillaalha al-fi l-sahale.Wa l-hillaal dool Diibuun wa Baamoot Ba'al wa Beet Ba'al Maa'oon
wa Yahaas wa Khadimuut wa Mifa'at
wa Khiryataayim wa Sibma wa Saarat Chahar al-fi jabal al-waadi
wa Beet Fa'uur wa jabal al-Fisga wa Beet Yachiimut.
Wa gisim gabiilat Ra'uubiin,hu kulla l-hillaal hana l-sahale dool wa kulla mamlakat Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin al-hakam fi Hachbuun.Muusa katalah wa katal chuyuukh Midyaan wa humman Awiya wa Raakhim wa Suur wa Huur wa Raabi'.Dool kubaaraat al-malik Siihuun al-sakano fi l-balad di.
Wa ambeen al-naas al-Bani Israa'iil kataloohum be l-seef,fiyah al-chawwaafi Bal'aam wileed Ba'uur.
Wa huduud gabiilat Ra'uubiin fi l-kharib bahar al-Urdun wa l-ard al-jambah.Wa dool al-mudun wa l-hillaal al-ligoohum gabiilat Ra'uubiin warasa hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa Muusa anta gisim le gabiilat Gaad hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa gisimhum ard Ya'ziir wa kulla mudun Gil'aad wa nuss hana ard Bani Ammuun lahaddi hillit Aruu'ir al-mugaabile madiinat Rabba.
Wa gisimhum min madiinat Hachbuun lahaddi Raamat al-Misfa wa Batuniim wa min Mahanaayim lahaddi huduud Luudabaar.
Wa jamb waadi al-Urdun,antaahum Beet Haaraam wa Beet Nimra wa Sukkuut wa Safuun.Wa dool al-hillaal al-faddalo min mamlakat Siihuun malik Hachbuun.Wa huduudhum fi l-kharib,humman bahar al-Urdun wa hawaaleeyah lahaddi bahar al-Jaliil fi l-munchaakh.Kulla arduhum sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa dool al-mudun wa l-hillaal al-ligoohum gabiilat Gaad warasa hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa Muusa anta gisim le nuss gabiilat Manassa hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa gisimhum min Mahanaayim lahaddi kulla turaab Baachaan wa da kulla ard mamlakat Oog malik Baachaan wa kulla furgaan Yayiir al-gaa'idiin fi Baachaan,adadhum 60 fariig.
Wa gisimhum nuss hana mantaga Gil'aad wa Achtaruut wa Idra'i wa dool hillaal mamlakat Oog fi Baachaan.Kulla l-turaab da antooh le nuss khuchuum buyuut Makiir wileed Manassa.
Wa wakit Muusa fi kadaadit Muwaab,gassam al-warasa di wa hi al-ard fi sabaah le bahar al-Urdun mugaabil hillit Ariiha.
Wa laakin le gabiilat Laawi,Muusa ma antaahum ard warasa achaan warasathum di yakhdumu le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil misil hu gaalah leehum.
Wa daahu al-ard al-ligooha Bani Israa'iil misil warasa fi balad Kan'aan.Wa l-naas al-gassamooha leehum humman raajil al-diin Ali'aazar wa Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa chuyuukh aayilaat gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-warasa di bigat le tis'a gabaayil wa nuss gabiilat Manassa be am'iyeedaat misil Allah amar beyah be waasitat Muusa.
Awwal,Muusa anta le itneen gabiila wa nuss gabiilat Manassa warasa sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.Wa laakin le l-Laawiyiin ma antaahum warasa ma'a l-gabaayil al-aakhariin.
Achaan Iyaal Yuusuf bigo itneen gabiila wa humman gabiilat Manassa wa gabiilat Afraayim.Wa ma anto ard warasa le gabiilat Laawi fi l-balad illa antoohum hillaal al-yaskunu fooghum wa ard hana sarha le bahaayimhum wa maalhum.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sawwo misil Allah amar beyah Muusa wa humman algaasamo al-balad.
Wa yoom waahid,naas min gabiilat Yahuuza jo le Yachuu' fi Gilgaal.Wa Kaalib wileed Yafuuna al-Khinaazi gaal leyah-:-Inta ta'arif tamaam kalaam Allah al-gaalah le l-nabi Muusa fi sababi anawa fi sababak inta wakit aniina fi Khaadich Barnii'a.
Ana umri 40 sana wakit Muusa abd Allah rassalaani min Khaadich Barnii'a le nuruukh al-baladwa ana kallamt leyah be kulla cheyy al-chiftah hasab ma'rafati.
Wa akhwaani al-macho ma'aayi jo wa be kalaamhum khawwafo al-cha'ab.Wa laakin ana taaba't Allah Ilaahi be kulla niiyti.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Muusa halaf leyi wa gaal-:--Al-balad al-inta rukht foogha tabga daayman warasa leek inta wa le zurriiytak achaan inta taaba't Allah Ilaahi be kulla niiytak.--
Wa hassa',daahu Allah antaani umur tawiil hasab kalaamah wa min Allah gaal al-kalaam da le Muusa,indah 45 sana.Wa fi kulla l-wakit da,Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin fi l-sahara.Wa l-yoom,daahu indi 85 sana.
Wa l-yoom,indi nafs al-gudra wakit Muusa rassalaani namchi nuruukh al-balad.Wa l-gudra al-hassa' indi,hi misil al-gudra al-indi wakit nihaarib aw wakit namchi wa naji min al-harib.
Wa khalaas,antiini ard fi l-jibaal misil Allah gaalah fi l-yoom da.Achaan fi l-yoom da,inta irift kadar Bani Anakh gaa'idiin fi l-ard di fi mudun gawiyiin.Wa laakin kan Allah yukuun ma'aayi,ana nichiil minhum al-ard di misil Allah gaalah.
Wa Yachuu' baarak Kaalib wileed Yafuuna wa antaah hillit Hibruun misil warasa.
Wa be sabab da,Kaalib wileed Yafuuna al-Khinaazi ligi Hibruun misil warasa lahaddi l-yoom achaan hu taaba' Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil be kulla niiytah.
Wa gabul da,Hibruun usumha Kharyat Arba'a.Wa Arba'a da hu raajil ma'ruuf fi Bani Anakh.Wa khalaas,al-harib wagaf wa l-balad ligat al-raaha.
Wa daahu gisim al-ard hana gabiilat Yahuuza hasab khuchuum buyuuthum min huduud Adoom le saharat Siin wa lahaddi saharat Nagab fi aakhir al-junuub.
Wa huduudhum fi l-junuub min khachum al-bahar al-Mayyit al-mugaabil al-junuub.
Wa min hinaak,al-huduud yihawwugu junuub le giizaan al-Agaarib wa yi'addu be saharat Siin.Wa l-huduud dool yatla'o junuub le Khaadich Barnii'a wa yamchu le turaab Hasruun wa yatla'o ale Addaar wa yigabbulu ale turaab Garga'.
Wa min al-bakaan da,yi'addu be Asmuun lahaddi waadi Masir wa minnah lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad.Wa dool bas huduudhum min jiihat al-junuub.
Wa huduudhum fi l-sabaah yamchu min al-bahar al-Mayyit lahaddi khachum bahar al-Urdun.Wa min al-munchaakh,al-huduud yabdo min nafs al-bakaan fi khachum bahar al-Urdun
wa yatla'o lahaddi Beet Hugla wa yi'addu munchaakh le Beet Araba wa yatla'o lahaddi l-hajar al-binaaduuh Buuhan usum hana wileed Ra'uubiin.
Wa l-huduud yamchu ale Dabiir be waadi Akuur wa yigabbulu munchaakh ale Gilgaal al-mugaabile al-gooz hana Aduumiim al-gaa'id wati le l-waadi.Al-huduud dool yi'addu gariib le almi hana Een Chams wa yamchu lahaddi Een Ruugil.
Wa l-huduud yi'addu be waadi Bani Hinnuum wa l-dilleeye al-wati le jabal al-Yabuusiyiin ya'ni Uruchaliim.Wa minha yatla'o lahaddi raas al-jabal al-mugaabil waadi Bani Hinnuum fi l-kharib fi khachum waadi Rafaayiin fi l-munchaakh.
Wa l-huduud yigabbulu min raas al-jabal lahaddi Een Niftuuh wa yamchu ale l-hillaal al-fi jabal Afruun wa yigabbulu ale Ba'la ya'ni Kharyat Ya'ariim.
Wa min Ba'la,al-huduud yigabbulu kharib ale jabal Sa'iir wa yatla'o fi l-dilleeye hana jabal al-Khaabaat fi l-munchaakh ya'ni jabal Kasaaluun.Wa yiddallo be Beet Chams wa yi'addu be Timna.
Wa l-huduud yamchu lahaddi l-dilleeye hana hillit Akhruun fi l-munchaakh wa yigabbulu ale Chikaaruun wa yi'addu be jabal Ba'la wa yamchu lahaddi Yabniyiil wa yagiifu fi l-bahar al-Abyad.
Wa khalaas al-bahar al-Abyad yabga huduudhum fi l-khariib.Wa dool bas al-huduud min kulli jiihe hana ard gabiilat Yahuuza hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa Kaalib wileed Yafuuna ligi gismah min gabiilat Yahuuza wa da hasab kalaam Allah le Yachuu'.Wa antooh Kharyat Arba'a ya'ni Hibruun.Wa Arba'a da hu jidd hana Bani Anakh.
Wa Kaalib tarad talaata khuchuum buyuut min Bani Anakh wa chaal minhum arduhum wa humman Chiichaay wa Akhimaan wa Talmaay.
Wa min al-bakaan da,hu gamma didd sukkaan Dabiir al-awwal usumha Kharyat Siifar.
Wa Kaalib gaal-:-Al-naadum al-hajam Kharyat Siifar wa chaalha,ana nantiih bineeyti Aksa yaakhudha.
Wa Utniyiil wileed Khinaaz akhu Kaalib hajam Kharyat Siifar wa chaalha.Wa Kaalib antaah bineeytah Aksa le yaakhudha.
Wa laakin min jaat leyah,hi harrachatah wa gaalat-:-As'al abuuyi yantiik zere'. Wa ba'ad hi addallat min humaarha,Kaalib gaal leeha-:-Tidoori chunu-?
Wa hi raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Hassa' da,baarikni.Inta anteetni turaab fi saharat Nagab wa hassa' da,antiini uyuun almi kula. Wa hu antaaha uyuun almi al-foog wa l-tihit kula.
Wa di bas al-ard al-antooha warasa le gabiilat Yahuuza hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa l-mudun hana gabiilat Yahuuza al-fi huduud Adoom fi l-junuub,humman Khabsiil wa Idar wa Yaguur
wa Khiina wa Diimuuna wa Ad'aada
wa Khadach wa Haasuur wa Yitnaan
wa Ziif wa Talam wa Ba'aluut
wa Haasuur Hadatta wa Kharyuut Hasruun al-binaaduuha Haasuur
wa Amaam wa Chama' wa Mulaada
wa Hasar Gadda wa Hachmuun wa Beet Faalat
wa Hasar Chuu'al wa Biir Sab'a wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha
wa Ba'la wa Iyyiim wa Asam
wa Alituulad wa Kasiil wa Hurma
wa Sikhlaag wa Madmanna wa Sansanna
wa Labawuut wa Chilhiim wa Een Rimmuun.Wa be l-jumla 29 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa mudunhum al-fi sahalat Chafiila humman Achtawuul wa Saar'a wa Achna
wa Zanuuh wa Een Ganniim wa Tafuuh wa Inaam
wa Yarmuut wa Adullaam wa Suuku wa Aziikha
wa Cha'araayim wa Aditaayim wa Gadiira wa Gadiiruutaayim.Wa be l-jumla 14 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa waraso battaan Sinaan wa Hadaacha wa Migdal Gaad
wa Dil'aan wa Misfa wa Yakhtiil
wa Lakiich wa Buskhat wa Agluun
wa Kabbuun wa Lahmaas wa Kitliich
wa Gadiiruut wa Beet Daguun wa Na'ama wa Makhiida.Wa be l-jumla 16 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa waraso battaan Libna wa Atar wa Achan
wa Yiftaah wa Achna wa Nasiib
wa Kha'iila wa Akziib wa Mariicha.Wa be l-jumla 9 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa waraso Akhruun wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha.
Wa min Akhruun huduudhum yamchu kharib le Achduud wa hillaalha.
Waraso Achduud wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha wa Khazza wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha wa lahaddi waadi Masir fi khachum al-bahar al-Abyad.
Wa waraso battaan mudun al-gaa'idiin fi l-jibaal wa humman Chamiir wa Yattiir wa Suuku
wa Danna wa Kharyat Sanna ya'ni Dabiir
wa Anaab wa Achtimu wa Aniim
wa Goochan wa Huluun wa Giilu.Wa be l-jumla 11 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa waraso battaan fi Araab wa Ruuma wa Ich'aan
wa Yaanuum wa Beet Tafuuh wa Afiikha
wa Humta wa Kharyat Arba'a ya'ni Hibruun wa Sii'uur.Wa be l-jumla 9 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa waraso battaan fi Maa'oon wa Karmal wa Ziif wa Yutta
wa Yazra'iil wa Yakhda'aam wa Zanuuh
wa Khayiin wa Gibee'a wa Timna.Wa be l-jumla 10 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa waraso battaan ligo Halhuul wa Beet Suur wa Gaduur
wa Ma'aarat wa Beet Anuut wa Alitakhuun.Wa be l-jumla 6 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa waraso battaan Kharyat Ba'al ya'ni Kharyat Ya'ariim wa Rabba.Be l-jumla 2 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa fi l-sahara,waraso Beet Araba wa Middiin wa Sikaaka
wa Nibchaan wa madiinat al-Mileh wa Een Jidi.Be l-jumla 6 madiina wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa laakin gabiilat Yahuuza ma gidro chaalo ard al-Yabuusiyiin al-saakniin fi Uruchaliim.Wa l-Yabuusiyiin gaa'idiin yaskunu fi Uruchaliim fi usut gabiilat Yahuuza lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa gisim al-ard hana zurriiyit Yuusuf yamchi min bahar al-Urdun gariib le Ariiha lahaddi sabaah le Een Ariiha wa yatla' ale l-sahara min Ariiha lahaddi jibaal Beet Iil.
Wa min Beet Iil,al-huduud yamchu ale Luuz wa yufuutu be huduud al-Arkiyiin fi Ataruut.
Wa yamchu ale huduud al-Yaflitiyiin fi l-kharib wa lahaddi huduud Beet Huruun al-tihit wa lahaddi Gaazar wa lahaddi khachum al-bahar al-Abyad.
Wa zurriiyit Yuusuf al-humman gabaayil Manassa wa Afraayim kula ligo warasathum.
Wa daahu huduud al-ard hana gabiilat Afraayim hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Min Ataruut Addaar fi l-sabaah,huduud warasathum yi'addu be Beet Huruun al-foog
wa yamchu lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad.Wa fi l-munchaakh,al-huduud yamchu ale Mikmata wa yigabbulu sabaah ale Taanat Chiilooh wa yamchu sabaah ale Yanuuh.
Wa l-huduud dool yamchu min Yanuuh lahaddi Ataruut wa Na'ara wa yalhago Ariiha wa minha lahaddi bahar al-Urdun.
Wa min Tafuuh,al-huduud yamchu kharib lahaddi waadi Khaana wa yagiifu fi l-bahar al-Abyad.Wa da l-ard al-ligo warasa gabiilat Afraayim hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa fi mudun aakhariin al-antoohum warasa le gabiilat Afraayim fi usut ard gabiilat Manassa wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin le l-mudun dool.
Wa laakin ma chaalo ard al-Kan'aaniyiin al-gaa'idiin fi Gaazar.Wa l-Kan'aaniyiin dool gaa'idiin yaskunu fi usut gabiilat Afraayim lahaddi l-yoom wa bigo abiid yakhdumu leehum.
Wa gabiilat Manassa bikir Yuusuf kula ligo gisim al-ard.Wa Makiir hu bikir Manassa wa abu Gil'aad.Wa hu ligi turaab Gil'aad wa Baachaan sabaah bahar al-Urdun achaan hu muhaarib kabiir.
Wa khuchuum buyuut al-aakhariin hana gabiilat Manassa kula ligo gisim al-ard.Wa humman khuchuum buyuut hana Abi'aazar wa iyaal Hilakh wa iyaal Asriyiil wa iyaal Chakiim wa iyaal Hiifar wa iyaal Chamiida'.Wa dool kulluhum dukuur hana gabiilat Manassa wileed Yuusuf hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa Saluufhad wileed Hiifar wileed Gil'aad wileed Makiir wileed Manassa ma jaab wulaad wa laakin jaab banaat bas.Wa banaatah asaameehin Mahla wa Nuu'a wa Hugla wa Milka wa Tirsa.
Wa l-banaat deel jin giddaam raajil al-diin Ali'aazar wa giddaam Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa giddaam al-chuyuukh wa gaalan-:-Allah amar Muusa yantiina warasa fi usut akhwaanna. Wa khalaas hasab kalaam Allah,antoohin warasa fi lubb akhwaanhin awlaad abuuhin.
Wa gabiilat Manassa ligat achara gisim.Wa da bala turaab Gil'aad wa Baachaan sabaah le bahar al-Urdun
achaan banaat Manassa ligan warasathin ambeen akhwaanhin.Wa laakin turaab Gil'aad le zurriiyit Manassa al-aakhariin.
Wa huduud Manassa yamchu min Achiir lahaddi Mikmata mugaabil Chakiim wa yamchu ale l-junuub lahaddi bakaan sukkaan Een Tafuuh.
Wa ard Tafuuh hi hana Manassa wa laakin hillit Tafuuh al-fi huduud Manassa,hi hana gabiilat Afraayim.
Wa l-huduud yamchu le waadi Khaana fi l-wati.Wa l-hillaal hana l-bakaan da,antoohum le gabiilat Afraayim kan gaa'idiin fi ard gabiilat Manassa kula.Wa huduud gabiilat Manassa yamchu munchaakh le l-waadi wa yagiifu fi l-bahar al-Abyad.
Wa be da,gabiilat Afraayim ale l-wati wa gabiilat Manassa ale l-munchaakh wa huduudhum fi l-kharib al-bahar al-Abyad.Wa munchaakh le ard gabiilat Manassa fi ard gabiilat Achiir wa ard gabiilat Yassaakar fi l-sabaah.
Wa gabiilat Manassa ligo mudun fi ard Yassaakar wa ard Achiir.Wa l-mudun dool humman Beet Chaan wa Yibla'aam wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum wa Duur wa Een Duur wa Ta'nak wa Magiddu wa sukkaanhum wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum.Wa da,talaata manaatig.
Wa laakin gabiilat Manassa ma gidrat tichiilu al-mudun dool wa l-Kan'aaniyiin ga'ado fi l-balad di.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil bigo gawiyiin,gidro abbado al-Kan'aaniyiin.Wa laakin ma gidro chaalo minhum arduhum.
Wa zurriiyit Yuusuf gaalo le Yachuu'-:-Maala tantiina warasa gisim waahid bas kan aniina naas katiiriin achaan Allah baarakaana-?
Wa Yachuu' gaal leehum-:-Kan intu naas katiiriin wa jibaal Afraayim dayyig leeku,amchu fi l-khaaba wa chiilu le nufuusku bakaan fi balad al-Firizziyiin wa l-Rafaayiin.
Wa zurriiyit Yuusuf gaalo leyah-:-Sahiih al-jibaal wiheedhum ma yitimmuuna wa laakin al-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi l-sahale hana l-balad di induhum arabaat hana hadiid wa naas al-gaa'idiin fi Beet Chaan wa hillaalha al-taab'iin leeha wa l-fi waadi Yazra'iil kula.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le zurriiyit Yuusuf ya'ni gabiilat Afraayim wa gabiilat Manassa-:-Intu naas katiiriin wa induku gudra ziyaada.Ma waajib gisimku yabga waahid.
Wa hassa' da,chiilu balad al-jibaal hatta kan hi khaaba kula agta'o chadarha wa agoodu foogha.Wa aturdu al-Kan'aaniyiin hatta kan humman induhum arabaat hana hadiid wa gudra kula.
Wa ba'ad khatto kulla l-balad tihit hukumhum,kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil lammo fi Chiilooh wa bano kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa min Bani Israa'iil,fi sab'a gabaayil al-lissaa' ma ligo warasathum.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Le mata taabo ma tamchu tichiilu al-balad al-antaaha leeku Allah Rabb juduudku-?
A'azulu talaata rujaal min ayyi gabiila wa ana nirassilhum yamchu yuruukhu al-balad.Wa yaktubu rasim huduud ard al-warasa al-muwaafge le ayyi gabiila wa yigabbulu leyi.
Wa humman yigassumu al-balad al-faddalat ale sab'a gisim.Wa gabiilat Yahuuza yagoodu fi turaabhum fi l-wati wa zurriiyit Yuusuf yagoodu fi turaabhum fi l-munchaakh.
Amchu wa aktubu rasim huduud al-balad hasab al-sab'a gisim wa jiibuuh leyi hini giddaami.Wa ana nisawwi am'iyeedaat giddaam Allah Ilaahna achaan na'arfu al-gisim le ayyi gabiila.
Wa laakin ma fi gisim ambeenaatku le l-Laawiyiin achaan humman warasathum khidmit rujaal al-diin.Wa gabiilat Gaad wa gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa nuss gabiilat Manassa humman ligo gisimhum sabaah khaadi le bahar al-Urdun.Wa da l-gisim al-antaah leehum Muusa abd Allah.
Wa l-rujaal al-azaloohum jahhazo le l-machi.Wa gubbaal ma yamchu,Yachuu' gaal leehum-:-Amchu ruukhu al-balad wa aktubu rasimha wa gabbulu leyi hini.Wa ana nisawwi am'iyeedaat giddaam Allah hini fi Chiilooh achaan na'arfu al-gisim le ayyi gabiila.
Wa l-rujaal dool macho chaggo al-balad wa katabo rasim al-hillaal hasab al-sab'a gisim.Wa gabbalo le Yachuu' fi l-fariig fi Chiilooh.
Wa Yachuu' sawwa leehum am'iyeedaat giddaam Allah fi Chiilooh.Wa be da,Yachuu' gassam al-balad le Bani Israa'iil hasab al-gisim al-waga' le ayyi gabiila.
Wa l-gisim al-awwal antooh le gabiilat Banyaamiin hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Wa l-turaab al-ligooh gaa'id ambeen turaab gabiilat Yahuuza wa turaab zurriiyit Yuusuf.
Wa min jiihat al-munchaakh,huduudhum yamchu min bahar al-Urdun lahaddi l-dilleeye hana Ariiha fi l-munchaakh wa lahaddi balad al-jibaal al-fi l-kharib wa yagiifu fi saharat Beet Awan.
Wa min al-bakaan da,al-huduud yamchu lahaddi Luuz wa yi'addi jamb al-dilleeye al-fi junuub Luuz ya'ni Beet Iil.Wa l-huduud yiddallo ale Ataruut Addaar wa yamchu ale l-jabal al-gaa'id junuub min Beet Huruun al-tihit.
Wa l-huduud yigabbulu ale l-kharib wa yamchu ale l-junuub min al-jabal al-mugaabil Beet Huruun.Wa yamchu le Kharyat Ba'al ya'ni Kharyat Ya'ariim al-hi hille hint gabiilat Yahuuza.Wa dool al-huduud min jiihat al-kharib.
Wa min jiihat al-junuub huduudhum yabdo min Kharyat Ya'ariim wa yamchu ale l-kharib lahaddi Een Niftuuh.
Wa l-huduud yamchu taraf al-jabal al-mugaabil waadi Bani Hinnuum al-gaa'id munchaakh le waadi Rafaayiin.Wa l-huduud yamchu min waadi Bani Hinnuum be l-dilleeye al-junuubiiye hana jabal al-Yabuusiyiin wa yiddallo ale Een Ruugil.
Wa l-huduud yigabbulu munchaakh lahaddi Een Chams wa lahaddi Galiiluut al-mugaabile al-gooz hana l-Aduumiim.Wa l-huduud yamchu ale l-hajar hana Buuhan wileed Ra'uubiin.
Wa l-huduud yi'addu be l-dilleeye al-tidalli fi waadi al-Urdun wa yamchu ale l-junuub fi waadi al-Urdun.
Wa l-huduud yi'addu ale munchaakh le l-dilleeye hana Beet Hugla wa yamchu lahaddi munchaakh le l-bahar al-Mayyit bakaan al-yusubb foogah bahar al-Urdun.Wa dool al-huduud min al-junuub.
Wa l-huduud min sabaah hu bahar al-Urdun.Wa da bas ard warasa hana gabiilat Banyaamiin hasab khuchuum buyuuthum be huduudhum min kulli jiihe.
Wa l-mudun hana gabiilat Banyaamiin hasab khuchuum buyuuthum humman Ariiha wa Beet Hugla wa Imakh Khasiis
wa Beet Araba wa Samaraayim wa Beet Iil
wa Awiim wa Faara wa Ufra
wa Kafar Ammuuna wa Ufni wa Gaba'.Wa be l-jumla 12 mudun wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa battaan Gib'uun wa l-Raama wa Biiruut
wa Misfa wa Kafiira wa Mussa
wa Raakhim wa Yirfiil wa Taraala
wa Siila' wa Alif wa madiinat al-Yabuusiyiin ya'ni Uruchaliim wa Gibee'a wa Kharyat Ya'ariim.Wa be l-jumla 14 mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.Wa da kulla ard warasa hint gabiilat Banyaamiin hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa l-gisim al-taani antooh le gabiilat Chim'uun hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Wa ard warasathum gaa'ide fi usut ard warasat gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa l-turaab al-ligooh warasa indah mudun Biir Sab'a wa Chaba' wa Mulaada
wa Hasar Chuu'al wa Baala wa Asam
wa Alituulad wa Batuul wa Hurma
wa Sikhlaag wa Beet Markabuut wa Hasar Suusa
wa Beet Labawuut wa Charuuheen.Wa be l-jumla 13 mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa Een wa Rimmuun wa Atar wa Achan.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum
wa battaan kulla l-hillaal al-muhawwigiin al-mudun dool lahaddi Ba'alat Biir ya'ni Raamat al-junuub.Wa di bas ard warasa hint gabiilat Chim'uun hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa gisim hana gabiilat Chim'uun chaalooh min ard warasa hint gabiilat Yahuuza.Achaan gisim hana gabiilat Yahuuza kabiir leehum ziyaada wa be misil da bas,gabiilat Chim'uun ligo arduhum fi usut ard warasat gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa l-gisim al-taalit antooh le gabiilat Zabuluun hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Wa huduud ard warasathum yamchu lahaddi Saariid.
Min hinaak,huduudhum yatla'o ale l-kharib lahaddi Mar'ala wa yalhago Dabbaacha wa l-waadi al-mugaabil Yakhna'aam.
Wa min Saariid,al-huduud yigabbulu ale l-sabaah lahaddi turaab Kisluut Taabuur wa yamchu ale Dabra wa yatla'o lahaddi Yafii'a.
Wa min al-bakaan da,al-huduud yamchu sabaah lahaddi Gaat Hiifar wa Itta Khaasiin.Wa minha yamchu ale Rimmuun wa yigabbulu ale Nii'a.
Wa min al-munchaakh,al-huduud yihawwugu Hannatuun wa yamchu lahaddi waadi Yiftahiil.
Wa humman ligo al-mudun Khattaat wa Nahlaal wa Chimruun wa Yidaala wa Beet Laham.Wa be l-jumla 12 mudun wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa dool bas al-mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum al-ligoohum warasa gabiilat Zabuluun hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa l-gisim al-raabi' antooh le gabiilat Yassaakar hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa huduudhum yamchu ale Yazra'iil wa Kasuluut wa Chuunam
wa Hafaraayim wa Chiyuun wa Anaharat
wa Rabbiit wa Khichyuun wa Abiis
wa Raamat wa Een Ganniim wa Een Hadda wa Beet Fasiis.
Wa l-huduud yiwassulu ale Taabuur wa Chahsiima wa Beet Chams wa yamchu lahaddi bahar al-Urdun.Wa be l-jumla 16 mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa dool bas al-mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum al-ligoohum warasa gabiilat Yassaakar hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa l-gisim al-khaamis antooh le gabiilat Achiir hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa huduudhum fi Halkha wa Hali wa Baatan wa Akchaaf
wa Allamalik wa Am'aad wa Michaal.Fi l-kharib,yamchu min jabal al-Karmal lahaddi Chiihuur Libna
wa yigabbulu sabaah ale Beet Daguun wa yamchu ale huduud gabiilat Zabuluun wa waadi Yiftahiil munchaakh le Beet Imakh wa Na'iil.Wa yamchu ale jiihat Kaabuul
wa ale Abduun wa Rahuub wa Hammuun wa Khaana lahaddi Seeda al-kabiire.
Wa l-huduud yigabbulu ale l-Raama wa lahaddi madiinat Suur al-gawiiye.Wa l-huduud yigabbulu lahaddi Huusa wa l-bahar al-Abyad wa yufuutu be Mahlab wa Akziib
wa Umma wa Afiikh wa Rahuub.Wa be l-jumla 22 mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa dool bas al-mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum al-ligoohum ard warasa gabiilat Achiir hasab khuchuum buyuuthum kulla.
Wa l-gisim al-saadis antooh le gabiilat Naftaali hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa huduudhum yamchu min Hiilaf wa l-chadar al-kubaar hana Sa'naniim wa Adaami Nakhab wa Yabniyiil lahaddi Lakhuum wa yagiifu fi bahar al-Urdun.
