Wa min al-kharib,al-huduud yigabbulu lahaddi Aznuut Taabuur wa minha yamchu lahaddi Huugug wa lahaddi turaab gabiilat Zabuluun fi l-junuub wa lahaddi turaab gabiilat Achiir fi l-kharib wa Yahuuza gariib le bahar al-Urdun ale sabaah.
Wa l-mudun al-gawiyiin humman Siddiim wa Siir wa Hammat wa Rakhat wa Kinaarat
wa Adama wa l-Raama wa Haasuur
wa Khadach wa Idra'i wa Een Haasuur
wa Yirwuun wa Migdaliil wa Huuriim wa Beet Anaat wa Beet Chams.Wa be l-jumla 19 mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa dool bas al-mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum al-ligoohum warasa gabiilat Naftaali hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa l-gisim al-saabi' antooh le gabiilat Daan hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa huduud ard warasathum Saar'a wa Achtawuul wa Iir Chams
wa Cha'albiin wa Ayyaluun wa Yitla
wa Iluun wa Timna wa Akhruun
wa Alitakha wa Gibbatuun wa Ba'ala
wa Yihuud wa Bani Barakh wa Gaat Rimmuun
wa Almi Yarguun wa Rakhuun wa l-turaab al-mugaabil Yaafa.
Wa laakin gabiilat Daan ma gidro yalgo turaabhum.Wa fi chaan da,humman gammo didd sukkaan Lacham haaraboohum wa kataloohum be l-seef wa chaalo hillithum minhum.Wa ga'ado foogha wa sammooha Daan be usum jidduhum.
Wa dool bas al-mudun wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum al-ligoohum warasa gabiilat Daan hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa ba'ad gassamo ard warasathum be kulla huduudha,Bani Israa'iil anto ard le Yachuu' wileed Nuun fi usuthum.
Wa hasab kalaam Allah,humman antooh al-madiina al-hu dawwaraaha ya'ni Timna Saarah fi jibaal Afraayim.Wa hu banaaha wa sakan foogha.
Wa da bas gisim al-ard al-sawwooh raajil al-diin Ali'aazar wa Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa chuyuukh aayilaat gabaayil Bani Israa'iil be am'iyeedaat.Sawwooh be am'iyeedaat giddaam Allah fi Chiilooh fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa be misil da,humman gassamo al-balad.
Wa Allah hajja le Yachuu' wa gaal-:
Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Khassusu leeku mudun hana luju hasab al-kalaam al-ana gultah leeku be waasitat Muusa.
Wa naadum al-katal dimme bala raayah yagdar yajri le waahide minhum.Wa l-mudun dool yagdaro yahfado al-kaatil min siid al-taar.
Wa l-kaatil yajri le waahide min al-mudun dool wa wakit yiwassil fi khachum baab al-madiina,hu yigaabil kubaaraat al-madiina wa yihajji leehum muchkiltah.Ba'ad da,humman yantu izin yadkhul fi madiinithum wa yantuuh bakaan yagood fi usuthum.
Wa kan siid al-taar macha waraayah kula,humman ma yisallumuuh leyah achaan hu katal dimme bala raayah wa ma indah leyah ayyi karaahiiye min awwal.
Wa yagood fi l-madiina di lahaddi yagiif giddaam al-mujtama' le yihaakumuuh wa lahaddi moot kabiir rujaal al-diin hana l-zaman da.Wa ba'ad da,al-kaatil yagdar yigabbil fi madiintah wa fi beetah ya'ni fi l-madiina al-hu jara minha.-
Wa khalaas,Bani Israa'iil khassaso Khadach al-Jaliil al-fi jibaal Naftaali wa Chakiim al-fi jibaal Afraayim wa Kharyat Arba'a ya'ni Hibruun al-fi jibaal Yahuuza.
Wa khaadi le bahar al-Urdun wa sabaah le Ariiha,humman khassaso Baasar al-fi l-sahara fi sahalat gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa Raamuut al-fi turaab Gil'aad hana gabiilat Gaad wa Joolaan fi turaab Baachaan hana gabiilat Manassa.
Wa dool bas al-mudun hana l-luju al-khassasoohum Bani Israa'iil le nufuushum wa le l-ajnabi al-saakin ma'aahum.Wa ayyi naadum al-katal dimme bala raayah yagdar yajri leehum achaan siid al-taar ma yaktulah gabul ma yagiif giddaam al-mujtama' le yihaakumuuh.
Wa ba'ad da,kubaaraat aayilaat al-Laawiyiin jo giddaam raajil al-diin Ali'aazar wa Yachuu' wileed Nuun wa kubaaraat aayilaat gabaayil Bani Israa'iil
fi Chiilooh fi balad Kan'aan.Wa gaalo leehum-:-Allah gaal be waasitat Muusa tantuuna mudunal-naskunu fooghum wa induhum bakaan le bahaayimna yasraho foogah.
Wa khalaas min ard warasathum,Bani Israa'iil antoohum le l-Laawiyiin mudun be bakaanaathum hana sarha hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa gassamo be am'iyeedaat wa l-gisim al-awwal,antooh le khachum beet Gahaat.Wa minhum zurriiyit Haaruun raajil al-diin ligo 13 mudun min gabiilat Yahuuza wa gabiilat Chim'uun wa gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa l-Laawiyiin al-aakhariin hana khachum beet Gahaat ligo be am'iyeedaat 10 mudun min gabiilat Afraayim wa gabiilat Daan wa nuss gabiilat Manassa.
Wa khachum beet Girchuun ligi be am'iyeedaat 13 mudun min gabiilat Yassaakar wa gabiilat Achiir wa gabiilat Naftaali wa nuss gabiilat Manassa al-fi turaab Baachaan.
Wa khachum beet Maraari ligi 12 mudun min gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa gabiilat Zabuluun.
Wa Bani Israa'iil anto kulla l-mudun dool be bakaanaathum hana l-sarha be am'iyeedaat le l-Laawiyiin misil Allah amar beyah be waasitat Muusa.
Wa daahu asaame al-mudun al-antoohum gabiilat Yahuuza wa gabiilat Chim'uun
le zurriiyit Haaruun min khachum beet Gahaat min gabiilat Laawi gisimhum antooh leehum be am'iyeedaat fi l-awwal.
Wa anto Kharyat Arba'a ya'ni Hibruun al-gaa'ide fi jibaal Yahuuza be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha al-muhawwigiinha.Wa sammo al-madiina di Kharyat Arba'a be usum hana Arba'a abu Anuukh.
Wa laakin al-ziraa'a wa l-hillaal hana l-madiina di antoohum warasa le Kaalib wileed Yafuuna.
Wa ziyaada min Hibruun madiinat al-luju be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha,zurriiyit Haaruun raajil al-diin ligo Libna be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Yattiir be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Achtamuu'a be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Huluun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Dabiir be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Achan be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Yutta be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Beet Chams be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 9 mudun al-antoohum gabiilat Yahuuza wa gabiilat Chim'uun.
Wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin ligo Gib'uun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Gaba' be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Anatuut be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Almuun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa adad al-mudun hana rujaal al-diin zurriiyit Haaruun 13 mudun be bakaanaathum hana l-sarha.
Wa l-Laawiyiin al-aakhariin min khachum beet Gahaat ligo mudun be am'iyeedaat min gabiilat Afraayim.
Wa humman antoohum Chakiim madiinat al-luju le l-kaatil al-gaa'ide fi jibaal Afraayim be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Gaazar be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Khibsiim be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Beet Huruun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa min gabiilat Daan ligo hillit Alitakha be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Gibbatuun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa Ayyaluun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Gaat Rimmuun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa min nuss gabiilat Manassa ligo Ta'nak be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Yibla'aam be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 2 mudun.
Wa be l-jumla al-Laawiyiin al-aakhariin min khachum beet Gahaat ligo 10 mudun be bakaanaathum hana l-sarha.
Wa l-Laawiyiin min khachum beet Girchuun ligo min nuss gabiilat Manassa,Joolaan madiinat al-luju le l-kaatil fi Baachaan be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Ba'achtara be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 2 mudun.
Wa min gabiilat Yassaakar,ligo Khichyuun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Dabra be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Yarmuut be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Een Ganniim be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa min gabiilat Achiir ligo Michaal be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Abduun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Halkha be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Rahuub be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa min gabiilat Naftaali ligo Khadach fi l-Jaliil madiinat al-luju be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Hammuut Duur be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Khartaan be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 3 mudun.
Wa khachum beet Girchuun be l-jumla ligo 13 mudun be bakaanaathum hana l-sarha.
Wa l-Laawiyiin min khachum beet Maraari ligo min gabiilat Zabuluun Yakhna'aam be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Kharta be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Rimuuna be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Nahlaal be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa min gabiilat Ra'uubiin sabaah khaadi le bahar al-Urdun mugaabil Ariiha ligo Baasar madiina le luju al-kaatil al-gaa'ide fi l-sahara fi l-kadaade be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha,wa Yahaas be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Khadimuut be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Mifa'at be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa min gabiilat Gaad anto Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad madiinat al-luju le l-kaatil be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Mahanaayim be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha
wa Hachbuun be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha wa Ya'ziir be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa be l-jumla 4 mudun.
Wa be l-jumla adad al-mudun al-antoohum be am'iyeedaat le l-Laawiyiin min khachum beet Maraari 12 mudun.
Wa be l-jumla adad al-mudun al-antoohum le l-Laawiyiin fi lubb Bani Israa'iil 48 mudun be bakaanaathum hana l-sarha.
Wa ayyi waahide min al-mudun dool indaha bakaanaat hana sarha.
Wa Allah anta Bani Israa'iil kulla l-balad al-hu halaf le juduudhum wa gaal yantiiha leehum.Wa humman chaalooha wa ga'ado foogha.
Wa Allah antaahum al-raaha min kulli jiihe hasab al-haliife al-halaf beeha le juduudhum.Wa min kulla udwaanhum,waahid kula ma gidir yihaaribhum wa be da,Allah sallam leehum kulla udwaanhum.
Wa min kulla kalaam al-kheer al-Allah gaalah le Bani Israa'iil,ma fi kilme al-ma alhaggagat.Kulla l-kalaam da alhaggag leehum.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' naada gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa
wa gaal leehum-:-Intu tabbagtu kulla l-kalaam al-amaraaku beyah Muusa abd Allah wa simi'tu kulla kalaami al-ana amartuku beyah.
Wa min wakit tawiil lahaddi l-yoom,intu ma abeetu akhwaanku wa hafadtu wasaaya Allah Ilaahku.
Wa hassa' Allah Ilaahku anta al-raaha le akhwaanku misil hu waa'adaahum beeha.Wa hassa' tagdaro tamchu le khiyamku fi baladku al-antaaha leeku Muusa abd Allah sabaah khaadi le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa laakin fakkuru chadiid wa tabbugu al-wasiiye wa l-gaanuun al-amaraaku beyah Muusa abd Allah.Hibbu Allah Ilaahku wa amchu adiil fi derbah wa tabbugu wasiiyaatah wa atmassako be Allah wa a'abuduuh be kulla guluubku wa be kulla fikirku.
Wa Yachuu' baarakaahum wa gaal leehum yamchu le khiyamhum wa humman macho.
Wa le nuss waahid min gabiilat Manassa,Muusa antaahum ard fi Baachaan sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.Wa l-nuss al-aakhar,Yachuu' antaahum ard ma'a akhwaanhum kharib le bahar al-Urdun.Wa wakit Yachuu' gaal leehum yamchu le khiyamhum,hu baarakaahum
wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu le khiyamku be l-khuna al-ligiituuha hana l-bahaayim wa l-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-nahaas wa l-hadiid wa l-lubaas al-katiir.Gassumu ma'a akhwaanku al-khaniime al-ligiituuha min udwaanku.
Wa be misil da,gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa gammo min bakaan Bani Israa'iil fi Chiilooh fi balad Kan'aan wa macho le balad Gil'aad ard warasathum al-Allah antaaha leehum be waasitat Muusa.
Wa wakit jo fi khachum bahar al-Urdun fi balad Kan'aan,gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa bano madbah jamb al-bahar.Wa l-madbah da binchaaf kabiir.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sim'o be l-khabar al-buguul-:-Daahu gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa bano madbah fi balad Kan'aan fi khachum bahar al-Urdun wa da fi ard Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil sim'o al-khabar da,tawwaali kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil lammo fi Chiilooh achaan yamchu yahjumuuhum.
Wa Laakin gubbaal ma yamchu,Bani Israa'iil rassalo Fiinhaas wileed raajil al-diin Ali'aazar le turaab Gil'aad achaan yamchi yihajji le gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa.
Wa macho ma'aayah achara rujaal min kubaaraat aayilaat Bani Israa'iil,ayyi waahid mas'uul fi aayiltah ambeen aayilaat Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-naas dool jo le gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa fi turaab Gil'aad wa gaalo leehum-:
Daahu kulla mujtama' Allah buguulu leeku-:--Maala sawweetu khiyaana misil di didd Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil-?Wa maala al-yoom khalleetu derib Allah wa baneetu leeku madbah wa isiitu Allah-?
Wa l-khata al-sawweena fi Fa'uurma tamma leena walla-?Lahaddi al-yoom ma tahharna nufuusna min al-khata da,kan Allah nazal fi cha'abah waba kula.
Wa chiifu-!Al-yoom,intu khalleetu derib Allah wa isiituuh.Wa ambaakir,hu yaz'al didd kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil-!
Wa kan ard warasatku ma taahire,ta'aalu agoodu ma'aana fi ard warasatna al-foogha kheemat Allah wa awrusuuha ma'aana sawa.Wa laakin ma tugummu didd Allah wa la diddina aniina wa tabnu leeku madbah aakhar bala madbah Allah Ilaahna-!
Wakit Akaan wileed Zaarah isi wa chaal al-khumaam al-haraam,hu ma hilik wiheedah be sabab khataayah laakin khadab Allah waga' fi kulla mujtama' Bani Israa'iil-!-
Wa gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa raddo le kubaaraat aayilaat Bani Israa'iil wa gaalo-:
Allah hu bas Ilaah al-Ilaahaat-!Allah hu al-Rabb-!Allah ya'arif al-sahiih wa waajib Bani Israa'iil kula ya'arfuuh-!Kan aniina gammeena didd Allah wa isiinaah,khalli ma tinajjuuna al-yoom.
Wa kan baneena leena madbah le nikhallu derib Allah wa le nigaddumu foogah dahaaya muharragiin aw hadaaya hana dagiig aw dahaaya salaama,khalli Allah yi'aakhibna-!
La,aniina sawweena al-cheyy da achaan nakhaafo yoom waahid iyaalku yuguulu le iyaalna-:--Chunu alaakhitku intu be Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil-?
Allah khatta bahar al-Urdun huduud ambeenna aniina wa intu gabaayil Ra'uubiin wa Gaad.Wa intu ma induku ayyi hagg fi Allah.- Wa be da,iyaalku yilizzu iyaalna achaan ma yakhaafo Allah.
Wa be sabab da bas,aniina chilna niiye nabnu madbah wa laakin wa la le dahaaya muharragiin wa la le dahaaya aakhariin.
Wa da yukuun chahaada ambeenna aniina wa intu wa zurriiyitna al-yaju waraana kadar indina hagg na'abudu Allah be gaddimiin dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa be da,ambaakir iyaalku ma yuguulu le iyaalna-:--Intu ma induku hagg ta'abudu Allah.--
Wa aniina gulna ambeenaatna-:--Kan ambaakir al-kalaam da gaalooh leena walla le zurriiyitna,aniina nuguulu-:"Chiifu hajim madbah Allah al-banooh abbahaatna.Hu ma hana dahaaya muharragiin wa la hana dahaaya aakhariin wa laakin le yabga chahaada beenna aniina wa intu."--
Istakhfar Allah-!Abadan ma nugummu didd Allah wa la khalleena derbah al-yoom.Wa ma nabnu madbah hana dahaaya muharragiin wa hadaaya hana dagiig wa dahaaya aakhariin bala madbah Allah Ilaahna al-gaa'id giddaam kheemtah.
Wa wakit raajil al-diin Fiinhaas wa chuyuukh al-mujtama' wa kubaaraat aayilaat Bani Israa'iil al-macho ma'aayah sim'o al-kalaam al-gaalooh gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa,humman khassado beyah.
Wa Fiinhaas wileed raajil al-diin Ali'aazar gaal leehum-:-Al-yoom aniina na'arfu kadar Allah gaa'id fi usutna achaan intu ma isiitu Allah.Wa be da,intu najjeetu Bani Israa'iil min khadab Allah.
Wa Fiinhaas wileed raajil al-diin Ali'aazar wa l-kubaaraat gammo min gabaayil Ra'uubiin wa Gaad wa jo min turaab Gil'aad le Bani Israa'iil fi balad Kan'aan.Wa kallamoohum be kulla cheyy al-hasal.
Wa Bani Israa'iil kula khassado wa chakaro al-Rabb.Wa khallo minhum al-harib wa l-kharaab al-awwal dawwaro yijiibu didd gabaayil Ra'uubiin wa Gaad.
Wa gabaayil Ra'uubiin wa Gaad gaalo-:-Al-madbah da yachhad kadar Allah hu Ilaahna kullina-! Wa sammo al-madbah da Chaahid.
Wa ba'ad mudda tawiile,Allah anta al-raaha le Bani Israa'iil min kulla udwaanhum al-mujaawiriinhum.Wa Yachuu' chayyab wa umrah bigi tawiil.
Wa hu naada kulla Bani Israa'iil wa chuyuukhhum wa kubaaraathum wa gudiyaahum wa masaa'iilhum wa gaal-:-Ana chayyabt wa umri bigi tawiil.
Wa intu zaatku chiftu kulla cheyy al-sawwaah Allah Ilaahku didd al-umam dool fi sababku.Achaan Allah Ilaahku,hu bas al-haarab leeku.
Wa chiifu,ana anteetku ard warasatku be am'iyeedaat hasab gabaayilku.Wa di ard al-umam al-ana dammartuhum wa ard al-umam al-lissaa'hum gaa'idiin.Wa l-ard di tamchi min bahar al-Urdun fi l-sabaah lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad fi l-kharib.
Wa Allah Ilaahku,hu bas yatrud giddaamku al-umam al-lissaa'hum gaa'idiin achaan intu tichiilu baladhum misil hu waa'adaaku beyah.
Wa be da,abgo chudaad wa fakkuru achaan tisawwu ayyi cheyy hasab al-wasaaya al-maktuubiin fi Tawraat Muusa.Ma tibaaru minhum wa la isra wa la zeene.
Wa ma tilkhalbato ma'a l-umam al-lissaa'hum jambuku wa la tifakkuru fi asaame ilaahaathum wa la tahalfu beehum wa la ta'abuduuhum wa la tasjudu leehum.
Wa waajib intu titmassako be Allah Ilaahku misil intu sawweetuuh min awwal lahaddi l-yoom.
Chiifu-!Allah gala' giddaamku ard al-umam al-kubaar wa chudaad.Wa waahid minhum ma gidir yagiif giddaamku lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa naadum waahid minku yatrud alif naadum achaan Allah Ilaahku gaa'id yihaarib leeku misil hu gaalah leeku.
Wa chiilu niiye achaan tihibbu Allah Ilaahku.
Wa laakin kan khalleetu derib Allah wa atmassaktu be l-umam al-lissaa'hum jambuku wa kan akhadtu minhum wa alkhalbattu ma'aahum,
khalaas,a'arfu kadar Allah Ilaahku battaan ma yagla' ard al-umam dool giddaamku.Wa humman yabgo leeku misil amkajjaama wa charak wa soot al-yafruchku wa chook fi uyuunku,lahaddi kulluku tikammulu fi l-ard al-samhe di al-antaaha leeku Allah Ilaahku.
Wa daahu gariib numuut misil kulla makhluug fi l-ard.Wa laakin waajib ta'arfu be kulla guluubku wa be kulla fikirku kadar kulla l-kalaam al-kheer al-gaalah Allah Ilaahku fi chaanku,alhaggag.Kulla l-kalaam da alhaggag leeku,ma fi kilme waahide kula al-ma alhaggagat.
Wa laakin angar'u-!Al-kalaam al-kheer al-gaalah Allah Ilaahku alhaggag.Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-cheen al-gaalah didduku kula yilhaggag lahaddi kulluku tikammulu fi l-ard al-samhe di,al-antaaha leeku Allah Ilaahku.
Wa kan nagadtu mu'aahadat Allah Ilaahku al-hu amaraaku beeha wa kan abadtu ilaahaat aakhariin wa sajadtu giddaamhum,khalaas khadab Allah yanzil foogku wa tawwaali tikammulu fi l-balad al-adiile al-hu antaaha leeku.
Wa Yachuu' lamma kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil fi Chakiim wa naada chuyuukhhum wa kubaaraathum wa gudiyaahum wa masaa'iilhum wa humman jo giddaam al-Rabb.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le kulla l-cha'ab-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Zamaan,juduudku sakano khaadi le bahar al-Furaat wa abado ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa Taarah abu Ibraahiim wa Naahuur kula ambeenaathum.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,ana chilt abuuku Ibraahiim min khaadi le bahar al-Furaat wa jibtah fi balad Kan'aan.Wa ana kattart zurriiytah wa anteetah wileedah Ishaakh.
Wa le Ishaakh,ana anteetah awlaadah Yaakhuub wa Isuu.Wa anteetah le Isuu balad jibaal Sa'iir le yichiilha wa Yaakhuub wa iyaalah kamaan macho ale balad Masir.
--Wa ba'ad da,ana rassalt Muusa wa Haaruun wa darabt balad Masir be l-waba al-nazzaltah fooghawa khalaas,maragtuku minha.
Wa ana maragt juduudku min Masir wa jo lahaddi l-bahar al-Ahmar.Wa laakin al-Masriyiin tarado juduudku be arabaat harib wa siyaad kheel lahaddi l-bahar da.
Wa wakit juduudku sarakho leyi,ana Allah khatteet dalaam beenhum wa been al-Masriyiin.Wa ba'ad da,chilt al-bahar wa khatteet beyah al-Masriyiin.Wa intu chiftuuh be uyuunku al-cheyy al-ana sawweetah le l-Masriyiin.---Wa ba'ad da,intu ga'adtu fi l-sahara le mudda tawiile.
Wa ana waddeetku le balad al-Amuuriyiin al-saakniin sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.Wa humman haarabooku wa laakin ana hazamtuhum wa dammartuhum giddaamku wa intu chiltu baladhum.
Wa Balaakh wileed Siffuur malik Muwaab gamma le yihaarib Bani Israa'iil wa rassal le Bal'aam wileed Ba'uur achaan yaji yal'anku.
Wa laakin ana ma simi't kalaam Bal'aam wa fi l-akhiir,hu baarakaaku be baraka kabiire.Wa ana najjeetku min iid Balaakh malik Muwaab.
--Wa gata'tu bahar al-Urdun wa wassaltu Ariiha.Wa sukkaanha gammo haarabooku wa ma'aahum al-Amuuriyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Girgaachiyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.Wa laakin ana sallamtuhum leeku fi iideeku.
Wa rassalt ru'ub chadiid le natrud min giddaamku al-muluuk al-itneen hana l-Amuuriyiin wa da ma be suyuufku wa la be nachaachiibku-!
Wa ana anteetku balad al-ma ti'ibtu foogha wa anteetku mudun al-intu ma baneetuuhum wa hassa' gaa'idiin taskunu fooghum.Wa anteetku ziraa'a hana inab wa zaytuun al-ma teerabtuuh wa hassa' gaa'idiin taakulu minnah.-
Wa Yachuu' gaal battaan-:-Hassa',akhaafo Allah wa a'abuduuh be sahiih wa amaan.Wa ba''udu minku kulla l-asnaam al-juduudku abadoohum khaadi le bahar al-Furaat wa fi Masir wa a'abudu Allah.
Wa laakin kan ma tidooru ta'abudu Allah,a'azulu al-yoom al-ilaah al-tidooru ta'abuduuh.Mumkin tichiilu ilaahaat al-abadoohum juduudku khaadi le bahar al-Furaat,walla tichiilu ilaahaat al-Amuuriyiin min al-balad al-intu saakniin foogha.Wa laakin ana wa aayilti kamaan,aniina na'abudu Allah-!
Wa l-cha'ab raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-La,abadan-!Ma naabo Allah le na'abudu ilaahaat aakhariin-!
Achaan Allah Ilaahna,hu bas al-maragaana aniina wa abbahaatna min Masir balad al-ubuudiiye wa sawwa al-ajaayib al-kubaar dool giddaamna.Wa hafadaana fi tuul al-derib al-macheena foogah wa fi ust kulla l-chu'uub al-chaggeenaahum.
Wa Allah tarad giddaamna al-Amuuriyiin wa kulla l-chu'uub al-aakhariin al-sakano fi l-balad di.Wa fi chaan da,aniina kula na'abudu Allah achaan hu bas Ilaahna.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Intu ma tagdaro ta'abudu Allah achaan hu al-Ilaah al-Khudduus wa hu al-Ilaah al-Khayyuur,ma yahmal isyaanku wa zunuubku.
Wa wakit taabo Allah wa ta'abudu ilaahaat aakhariin,hu yugumm didduku wa yi'aakhibku wa yikammilku ba'ad hu sawwa leeku kulla l-kheer da.
Wa l-cha'ab gaalo le Yachuu'-:-La,na'abudu Allah bas.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Intu zaatku chuhuud fi nufuusku kadar azaltu Allah wa ta'abuduuh. Wa humman gaalo-:-Aywa,aniina chuhuud.
Wa Yachuu' gaal-:-Kan ke da khalaas,ba''udu al-ilaahaat al-ajnabiyiin min usutku wa khuttu guluubku fi Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-cha'ab gaalo le Yachuu'-:-Aniina na'abudu Allah Ilaahna bas wa nasma'o kalaamah.
Wa khalaas fi l-yoom da fi Chakiim,Yachuu' sawwa mu'aahada been al-cha'ab wa Allah wa sawwa leehum gawaaniin wa churuut.
Wa Yachuu' katab al-kalaam da fi kitaab Tawraat Allah.Wa chaal hajar kabiir wa khazzaah fi l-bakaan da,tihit al-chadara al-kabiire al-gaa'ide jamb al-bakaan al-mukhaddas hana Allah.
Wa gaal le kulla l-cha'ab-:-Daahu al-hajar yukuun chaahid foogna achaan hu simi' kulla kalaam Allah wakit kallam ma'aana.Wa l-hajar da yachhad foogku achaan ma tankuru Ilaahku.
Wa khalaas,Yachuu' gaal le l-cha'ab khalli ayyi waahid yamchi le ard warasatah.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' wileed Nuun abd Allah maat fi umur hana 110 sana.
Wa dafanooh fi ard warasatah fi Timna Saarah fi jibaal Afraayim munchaakh le jabal Ga'ach.
Wa Bani Israa'iil abado Allah fi kulla muddit ayyaam Yachuu'.Wa ba'ad mootah,abado Allah fi kulla muddit ayyaam al-chuyuukh al-chaafo kulla l-a'maal al-sawwaahum Allah fi chaan Bani Israa'iil.
Wa kan le udaam Yuusuf al-chaaloohum Bani Israa'iil min balad Masir,humman dafanoohum fi Chakiim fi l-zere' al-charaah Yaakhuub be 100 hajar fudda min awlaad Hamuur abu Chakiim.Wa da kula bigi warasa le zurriiyit Yuusuf.
Wa Ali'aazar wileed Haaruun kula maat wa dafanooh fi l-jabal al-anto le wileedah Fiinhaas fi jibaal Afraayim.
Wa ba'ad moot Yachuu',Bani Israa'iil sa'alo Allah wa gaalo-:-Yaatu minnina yugumm awwal yahjim al-Kan'aaniyiin wa yihaaribhum-?
Wa Allah gaal-:-Gabiilat Yahuuza bas yahjumuuhum achaan ana khalaas anteethum al-balad di fi iideehum.
Wa gabiilat Yahuuza gaalo le akhwaanhum gabiilat Chim'uun-:-Yalla-!Ta'aalu ma'aana le ardina al-gassamooha leena wa nihaarubu al-Kan'aaniyiin sawa.Wa ba'adeen,aniina kula namchu ma'aaku le nichiilu arduku. Wa khalaas,gabiilat Chim'uun macho ma'aahum.
Wa gabiilat Yahuuza hajamo udwaanhum wa Allah sallam leehum fi iideehum al-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Firizziyiin.Wa fi hillit Baazakh,humman katalo minhum 10-000 raajil.
Wa hinaak humman ligo al-malik Aduuni Baazakh wa haarabooh wa annasaro fi l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Firizziyiin.
Wa Aduuni Baazakh arrad wa laakin humman taaba'ooh wa karabooh wa gatta'o asaab'ah al-kubaar hana iideenah wa rijileenah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Aduuni Baazakh gaal-:-70 malik ana gatta't asaabi'hum al-kubaar hana iideehum wa rijleehum wa humman laggato al-akil al-mudaffig fi bakaan dabalaayti.Al-cheyy al-ana sawweetah bas,al-Rabb gabbalah leyi. Wa humman chaalooh wa waddooh fi madiinat Uruchaliim wa maat hinaak.
Wa gabiilat Yahuuza hajamo madiinat Uruchaliim wa chaalooha wa katalo kulla sukkaanha be l-seef wa harragooha.
Wa ba'ad da,gabiilat Yahuuza macho achaan yihaarubu al-Kan'aaniyiin al-gaa'idiin fi l-jibaal wa fi saharat Nagab wa fi sahalat Chafiila.
Gabiilat Yahuuza gammo didd al-Kan'aaniyiin al-gaa'idiin fi Hibruun al-awwal usumha Kharyat Arba'a.Wa hinaak,humman hazamo khuchuum buyuut Chiichaay wa Akhimaan wa Talmaay.
Wa min al-bakaan da,gabiilat Yahuuza gammo didd sukkaan Dabiir al-awwal usumha Kharyat Siifar.
Wa Utniyiil wileed Khinaaz tariidah le Kaalib,hajam Kharyat Siifar wa chaalha.Wa Kaalib antaah bineeytah Aksa le yaakhudha.
Wa laakin min jaat leyah,hi harrachatah wa gaalat-:-As'al abuuyi yantiik zere'. Wa ba'ad hi addallat min humaarha,Kaalib gaal leeha-:-Tidoori chunu-?
Wa hi raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Hassa' da,baarikni.Inta anteetni turaab fi saharat Nagab wa hassa' antiini uyuun almi kula. Wa hu antaaha uyuun almi al-foog wa l-tihit kula.
Wa zurriiyit Khiini nasiib Muusa marago min madiinat al-Nakhal wa macho ma'a gabiilat Yahuuza fi kadaadit Yahuuza ale junuub Araad.Wa humman sakano ma'a l-cha'ab hinaak.
Wa ba'ad da,gabiilat Yahuuza gammo macho ma'a akhwaanhum gabiilat Chim'uun le yichiilu arduhum.Wa haarabo al-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi Safat wa dammaro al-hille di wa sammooha Hurma (ma'anaatah al-damaar).
Wa gabiilat Yahuuza chaalo mudun Khazza wa Achgaluun wa Akhruun be kula turaabhum.
Wa Allah saa'ad gabiilat Yahuuza wa humman chaalo manaatig hana l-jibaal.Wa laakin ma gidro yichiilu balad sukkaan al-sahale achaan al-sukkaan dool induhum arabaat hana hadiid le l-harib.
Wa hasab kalaam Muusa,hillit Hibruun antooha le Kaalib wa hu bas chaalha min al-talaata khuchuum buyuut hana Bani Anakh.
Wa kan le l-Yabuusiyiin al-saakniin fi Uruchaliim,gabiilat Banyaamiin ma chaalo minhum arduhum.Wa l-Yabuusiyiin saakniin ma'a gabiilat Banyaamiin fi Uruchaliim lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa zurriiyit Yuusuf gammo didd hillit Beet Iil wa Allah kaan ma'aahum.
Wa zurriiyit Yuusuf rassalo naas achaan yuruukhu Beet Iil al-awwal usumha Luuz.
Wa l-rawwaakhiin dool wakit jo fi l-hille,ligo raajil maarig minha.Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Wassif leena madkhal al-hille wa aniina nisawwu leek al-kheer.
Wa hu wassaf leehum min ween yadkhulu al-hille.Wa humman dakhalo wa katalo kulla sukkaanha be l-seef.Wa laakin le l-raajil al-wassaf leehum al-derib,khallooh hu wa kulla aayiltah yamchu be salaam.
Wa l-raajil da macha fi balad al-Hittiyiin wa bana leyah hille wa sammaaha Luuz.Wa da usumha lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa gabiilat Manassa ma chaalo ard sukkaan Beet Chaan wa Ta'nak wa Duur wa Yibla'aam wa Magiddu wa hillaalhum al-taab'iin leehum.Wa be da,al-Kan'aaniyiin gaa'idiin yaskunu fi l-balad di.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil ligo gudra,gammo abbadoohum le l-Kan'aaniyiin wa laakin ma chaalo minhum arduhum.
Wa gabiilat Afraayim ma chaalo ard al-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi Gaazar.Wa be da,al-Kan'aaniyiin sakano fi usut gabiilat Afraayim.
Wa gabiilat Zabuluun ma chaalo ard al-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi Khitruun wa fi Nahlaal.Wa be da,al-Kan'aaniyiin sakano fi usut gabiilat Zabuluun laakin gabiilat Zabuluun gammo abbadoohum.
Wa gabiilat Achiir ma chaalo ard sukkaan Akku wa Seeda wa Ahlab wa Akziib wa Halba wa Afiikh wa Rahuub.
Wa gabiilat Achiir sakano fi ust al-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi l-balad achaan ma chaalo minhum arduhum.
Wa gabiilat Naftaali ma chaalo ard al-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi Beet Chams wa Beet Anaat.Wa be da,humman sakano fi ust al-Kan'aaniyiin wa laakin gabiilat Naftaali gammo abbadoohum le sukkaan al-hillaal al-tineen dool.
Wa l-Amuuriyiin gammo haasaroohum le gabiilat Daan fi l-jibaal wa daharoohum ma yanzulu fi l-wudyaan.
Wa be da,al-Amuuriyiin gaa'idiin saakniin fi jabal Haaras wa Ayyaluun wa Cha'albiim wa laakin wakit zurriiyit Yuusuf ligo gudra,abbadoohum.
Wa huduud balad al-Amuuriyiin yamchu min giizaan al-Agaarib wa lahaddi khaadi le Saala'.
Wa malak Allah gamma min Gilgaal wa macha le Bukiim.Wa gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Ana maragtuku min balad Masir wa waddeetku fi l-balad al-ana halaft le juduudku wa gult nantiiha leehum.Wa ana gult-:--Abadan ma nangud mu'aahadati ma'aaku.
Wa intu kula ma tisawwu mu'aahada ma'a sukkaan al-balad di.Wa haddumu madaabihhum.- Wa laakin intu ma simi'tu kalaami.Wa maala sawweetu misil da-?
Wa khalaas,ana nuguul-:--Ma natrud sukkaan al-balad di min giddaamku.Wa humman yabgo leeku misil amkajjaama wa ilaahaathum yabgo leeku charak.-
Wa laakin wakit malak Allah gaal al-kalaam da le kulla Bani Israa'iil,tawwaali al-cha'ab gammo yikooruku wa yabku.
Wa humman sammo al-bakaan da Bukiim (ma'anaatah al-bakkaayiin) wa gaddamo dahaaya le Allah.
Wa Yachuu' gaal le l-cha'ab yamchu.Wa ayyi waahid min Bani Israa'iil macha le yichiil ard warasatah.Wa be da,chaalo al-balad.
Wa Bani Israa'iil abado Allah fi kulla muddit ayyaam Yachuu'.Wa ba'ad mootah,abado Allah fi kulla muddit ayyaam al-chuyuukh al-chaafo kulla l-a'maal al-sawwaahum Allah fi chaan Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yachuu' wileed Nuun abd Allah,maat fi umur hana 110 sana.
Wa dafanooh fi ard warasatah fi Timna Haaras fi jibaal Afraayim munchaakh le jabal Ga'ach.
Wa ba'ad kulla l-zurriiye di maatat wa lihgat abbahaatha,zurriiye aakhara gammat ba'adha wa laakin al-zurriiye di ma irfat Allah wa la l-a'maal al-sawwaahum le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sawwo al-fasaala giddaam Allah wa abado asnaam Ba'al.
Wa humman abo Allah Rabb juduudhum al-maragaahum min balad Masir.Wa taaba'o leehum ilaahaat aakhariin min ilaahaat al-chu'uub al-mujaawiriinhum wa sajado giddaamhum.Wa be da,khaddabo Allah.
Wa humman abo Allah wa abado asnaam Ba'al wa Achtaruut.
Wa khadab Allah nazal fi Bani Israa'iil wa hu sallamaahum le l-nahhaabiin wa nahaboohum.Hu sallamaahum le udwaanhum al-mujaawiriinhum wa ma gidro yagiifu giddaamhum.
Wa fi kulli wakit kan yamurgu le l-harib,Allah yijiib fooghum al-fasaala wa da misil Allah gaalah wa misil hu halaf leehum beyah.Wa be da,al-mudaayaga bigat chadiide.
Wa khalaas,Allah khatta leehum hukkaam achaan yinajjuuhum min al-naas al-yanhaboohum.
Wa laakin al-cha'ab abo ma yasma'o kalaam hukkaamhum wa achcharmato ma'a ilaahaat aakhariin wa abadoohum.Wa ajala ke bas,humman abo derib juduudhum al-sim'o wasaaya Allah wa ma sawwo misilhum.
Wa wakit Allah khatta leehum al-hukkaam,hu kaan ma'a ayyi haakim.Wa fi kulla muddit hayaatah,Allah yinajjiihum le Bani Israa'iil min udwaanhum.Wakit gaa'idiin yaguntu min al-naas al-yazulmuuhum wa yita''ubuuhum,Allah hanna fooghum.
Wa laakin ba'ad moot al-haakim,al-cha'ab yigabbulu fi zunuubhum wa yitallufu ziyaada min juduudhum achaan humman yitaabu'u ilaahaat aakhariin wa ya'abuduuhum wa yasjudu giddaamhum.Wa humman gawwo raashum wa abadan ma khayyaro amalhum.
Wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Bani Israa'iil wa gaal-:-Al-umma di nagadat al-mu'aahada al-ana sawweetha ma'a juduudhum wa ma sim'o kalaami.
Wa ana kula battaan ma nagla' giddaamhum ard hana ayyi naadum min al-umam al-Yachuu' khallaahum fi l-balad gabul ma yumuut.
Wa be l-umam dool,nijarrib Bani Israa'iil wa nichiif kan yakurbu derbi ana Allah al-macho foogah juduudhum.
Wa achaan da,Allah khalla fi l-balad di kulla l-umam al-ma sallamaahum le Yachuu'.Wa ma gala' minhum arduhum ajala.
Wa dool al-umam al-khallaahum Allah yagoodu wa beehum yijarrib kulla naas Bani Israa'iil al-ma hidro wakit haarabo le yichiilu balad Kan'aan.
Wa hu sawwa misil ke le yi'allim al-harib le l-zurriiyit al-jadiide hana Bani Israa'iil achaan awwal humman ma haarabo.
Daahu al-umam al-Allah khallaahum fi l-balad.Humman khamsa kubaaraat hana l-Filistiyiin wa kulla l-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Seeduuniyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin al-saakniin fi jibaal Lubnaan min jabal Ba'al Harmuun lahaddi Labu Hamaat.
Wa be l-umam dool,Allah yijarrib Bani Israa'iil le ya'arif kan humman yasma'o wasiiyaatah al-amar beehum juduudhum be waasitat Muusa.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sakano fi ust al-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.
Bani Israa'iil akhado banaat al-umam dool wa anto banaathum al-halaalhum le awlaadhum.Wa abado ilaahaathum kula.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sawwo al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Humman niso Allah ilaahhum wa abado asnaam Ba'al wa Achiira.
Wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Bani Israa'iil wa sallamaahum le Kuuchan Richa'taayim malik Araam been al-Nahreen.Wa Bani Israa'iil khadamo abiid le Kuuchan Richa'taayim le muddit tamaane sana.
Wa Bani Israa'iil koorako le Allah wa dawwaro al-faza' wa Allah rassal leehum munajji.Wa hu Utniyiil wileed Khinaaz tariidah le Kaalib.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal fi Utniyiil wa hu hakam fi Bani Israa'iil.Wa hu macha haarab Kuuchan Richa'taayim malik balad Araam wa Allah nasarah.
Wa l-balad gaa'ide fi raaha le muddit 40 sana wa ba'ad da,Utniyiil wileed Khinaaz maat.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gammo battaan sawwo al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa fi chaan da,Allah anta gudra le Agluun malik Muwaab le yugumm didduhum.
Wa Agluun lamma ma'a Bani Ammuun wa l-Amaalikh wa haarab Bani Israa'iil.Wa annasar fooghum wa chaal minhum Ariiha madiinat al-Nakhal.
Wa Bani Israa'iil khadamo abiid le Agluun malik Muwaab le muddit 18 sana.
Wa Bani Israa'iil koorako le Allah wa Allah rassal leehum munajji.Wa hu Ihuud al-israay,wileed Giira min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa Bani Israa'iil rassalo Ihuud yiwaddi hadaaya le Agluun malik Muwaab.
Wa Ihuud sawwa le nafsah seef tuulah duraa' wa tarragah jaay wa jaay wa rabatah fi daarijtah al-zeene be daakhal le khalagah.
Wa wadda al-hadaaya dool le Agluun malik Muwaab.Wa Agluun hu samiin marra waahid.
Wa wakit anta al-hadaaya khalaas,Ihuud faat ma'a naasah al-jaabo al-hadaaya.
Wa wakit wassalo bakaan al-asnaam gariib le hillit Gilgaal,Ihuud gabbal le l-malik wa gaal-:-Ya l-malik,indi leek kalaam sirr. Wa l-malik amar kulla khaddaamiinah yamchu wa humman marago min giddaamah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-malik gaa'id fi khurfitah al-baarde al-jahhazooha leyah foog.Wa Ihuud macha gariib leyah wa gaal-:-Indi kalaam min al-Rabb nidoor nuguulah leek. Wa khalaas,al-malik gamma min kursiih.
Wa tawwaali be iidah al-isra,Ihuud salla al-seef min daarijtah al-zeene wa ta'anah le l-malik fi batnah.
Sala'at al-seef kula dakhalat fi batnah wa khalaas al-chaham sadda foogah achaan Ihuud ma salla al-seef min batun al-malik.Wa khalaas,Ihuud marag min wara.
Wa gubbaal ma yufuut,hu sadda biibaan al-khurfa wa gaffalaahum.
Wa ba'ad hu marag,khaddaamiin al-malik jo wa ligo biibaan al-khurfa al-foog mugaffaliin wa gaalo-:-Akiid al-malik gaa'id yagdi haajtah fi l-khurfa al-baarde.
Wa humman arrajjooh wakit tawiil wa laakin hu ma fatah leehum biibaan khurfitah.Wa ba'ad da,humman chaalo al-muftaah wa fataho al-baab wa ligo siidhum waagi' fi l-turaab wa mayyit.
Wa wakit humman gaa'idiin yarjo da,Ihuud anbalas wa faat khaadi le bakaan al-asnaam wa arrad ale Sa'iira.
Wa wakit wisil hinaak,darab al-buug fi jibaal Afraayim.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil nazalo ma'aayah min al-jibaal wa hu maachi giddaamhum.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Taabu'uuni achaan Allah sallam leeku udwaanku al-Muwaabiyiin fi iideeku. Wa humman nazalo waraayah wa chaalo al-ma'add hana bahar al-Urdun min al-Muwaabiyiin wa ma khallo naadum waahid kula yuchugg al-bahar da.
Wa fi l-wakit da,katalo min al-Muwaabiyiin gariib 10-000 raajil,kulluhum induhum gudra wa fahaliin.Wa naadum waahid kula minhum ma niji.
Wa min al-yoom da,al-Muwaabiyiin ga'ado tihit hukum Bani Israa'iil wa l-balad gaa'ide fi raaha le muddit 80 sana.
Wa ba'ad Ihuud,hakam Chamgar wileed Anaat.Wa Chamgar da katal 600 raajil min al-Filistiyiin be kookaab hana garin toor wa hu kula najja Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad Ihuud maat,Bani Israa'iil gammo battaan sawwo al-fasaala giddaam Allah.
Wa Allah sallamaahum le Yaabiin malik Kan'aan al-haakim fi madiinat Haasuur.Wa khaayid deechah usmah Siisra wa Siisra da saakin fi Haruuchat Guuyim.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sarakho le Allah achaan Siisra indah 900 araba hint hadiid wa hu zalamhum le Bani Israa'iil zulum chadiid le muddit 20 sana.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,Dabuura al-nabiiye gaa'ide tahkim fi Bani Israa'iil.Wa raajilha usmah Lafiiduut.
Wa hi sakanat tihit nakhal al-binaaduuh Dabuura ambeen hillit al-Raama wa hillit Beet Iil fi jibaal Afraayim.Wa Bani Israa'iil yamchu leeha wa hi tisawwi leehum charii'a ambeenaathum.
Wa yoom waahid,hi rassalat naadat Baaraakh wileed Abinuu'am min Khadach turaab Naftaali wa gaalat leyah-:-Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil amarak be l-kalaam da-:--Yalla gumm amchi le jabal Taabuur wa chiil ma'aak 10-000 raajil min gabaayil Naftaali wa Zabuluun.
Wa ana nilizz Siisra khaayid deech Yaabiin le yihaaribku hu wa kulla askarah wa arabaatah hana l-harib wa nijiibhum fi waadi Khiichuun.Wa nisallimhum leek fi iideenak.-
Wa Baaraakh gaal le Dabuura-:-Kan tamchi ma'aayi,namchi.Wa laakin kan ma tamchi ma'aayi,ana ma namchi.
Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Khalaas ana namchi ma'aak.Wa laakin fi l-tariig al-tamchi foogah,al-charaf ma yukuun leek inta achaan Allah yisallim Siisra fi iideen hana mara bas. Wa khalaas,Dabuura gammat machat le Baaraakh fi Khadach.
Wa fi Khadach,Baaraakh naada rujaal gabaayil Zabuluun wa Naftaali wa humman macho ma'aayah wa adadhum 10-000 raajil.Wa Dabuura kula machat ma'aahum.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Haabar al-Khiini anfarag min al-Khiiniyiin al-aakhariin al-min iyaal Hubaab nasiib Muusa.Wa bana kheemtah jamb al-chadara al-kabiire hana Sa'naniim gariib le Khadach.
Wa jo khabbarooh le Siisra kadar Baaraakh wileed Abinuu'am wa deechah tala'o fi jabal Taabuur.
Wa khalaas Siisra lamma kulla arabaatah hana l-hadiid al-adadhum 900 wa kulla deechah.Wa gamma min Haruuchat Guuyim wa macha le waadi Khiichuun.
Wa Dabuura gaalat le Baaraakh-:-Yalla gumm-!Al-yoom bas Allah yisallim leek Siisra fi iideenak.Aywa,Allah macha giddaamak.-Wa khalaas,Baaraakh nazal min jabal Taabuur wa ma'aayah 10-000 raajil.
Wa Allah hazam Siisra be arabaatah wa askarah giddaam Baaraakh wa deechah.Wa Siisra addalla min arabatah wa arrad be rijileenah.
Wa Baaraakh taaba' al-arabaat wa l-askar lahaddi Haruuchat Guuyim.Wa kulla askar Siisra kataloohum be l-seef wa waahid kula minhum ma faddal.
Wa laakin Siisra arrad be rijileenah lahaddi kheemat Yaa'il marit Haabar al-Khiini achaan fi salaam ambeen Yaabiin malik Haasuur wa aayilat Haabar al-Khiini.
Wa Yaa'il maragat laagat Siisra wa gaalat leyah-:-Ta'aal adkhul hini fi bakaani,ya sayyidi.Wa ma takhaaf. Wa hu dakhal fi kheemitha wa hi khattatah be khattaay wa labbadatah.
Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Ana atchaan.Min fadulki,antiini almi chiyya nachrab. Wa Yaa'il chaalat bukhsa malaane laban wa antatah chirib minha.Wa ba'ad da,khattatah battaan be l-khattaay.
Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Agoodi fi madkhal al-kheema.Akuun naadum yas'alki wa yuguul-:--Fi naadum hini walla-?- Khalaas,guuli leyah-:--La-!Ma fiih.-
Wa laakin wakit Siisra naayim min al-aya,Yaa'il marit Haabar chaalat witid min wutaad al-kheema wa mitraga wa dakhalat bicheech jambah.Wa hi ta'anatah be l-witid fi raasah lahaddi al-witid andafan fi l-turaab.Wa be da,Siisra maat.
Wa wakit Baaraakh chaayil derib Siisra ja,Yaa'il maragat leyah laagatah wa gaalat-:-Ta'aal,niwassifak al-raajil al-inta gaa'id tifattichah. Wa wakit dakhal fi beetha,hu ligi Siisra waagi' mayyit wa l-witid fi raasah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-Rabb hazam Yaabiin malik Kan'aan giddaam Bani Israa'iil.
Wa gudrat Bani Israa'iil gaa'ide tiziid didd Yaabiin malik Kan'aan lahaddi katalooh.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Dabuura wa Baaraakh wileed Abinuu'am khanno wa gaalo-:
Fi Israa'iil,ayyi raajil jaahiz le l-haribwa l-cha'ab yamchu le l-harib be niiye waahide.Baarak Allah-!
Asma'o,ya l-muluuk,wa aftaho adaanku,ya l-salaatiin.Ana nikhanni le Allahwa le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil ana nahmudah.
Ya Allah,wakit inta maragt min Sa'iirwa wakit inta jiit min balad Adoom,al-ard rajafatwa min al-sama,almi sabba chadiidwa l-sahaab nazzal matar.
Al-jibaal maa'o misil al-almigiddaam Allahaywa,jabal Siinaa' maa'giddaam Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Fi ayyaam Chamgar wileed Anaatwa fi ayyaam Yaa'il,naas katiir khallo al-duruubwa l-musaafiriin yamchu be dabaali uwuj.
Sukkaan al-hillaal khallo hillaalhumaywa,khallo hillaalhumlahaddi ana Dabuura jiitwa bigiit misil amm le Bani Israa'iil.
Humman chaalo leehum ilaahaat aakhariin,wakit al-harib garrab le madaakhil al-hillaal.Fi l-wakit da,bigi leena gaasile nalgo daraga aw harbale deech Israa'iilal-adadhum 40-000 raajil.
Wa galbi ma'a khuyyaad Israa'iilwa ma'a l-cha'abal-yihaarubu be niiye waahide.Baarak Allah-!
Intu al-raakbiin fi hamiir buyudwa intu al-jaalsiin fi busaataatwa intu al-maachiin fi l-duruub,fakkuru adiil-!
Wa l-yusubbu almi fi l-hiitaankhanno be amal adaalit Allah.Wa da l-nasur al-antaah Allahle khuyyaad Israa'iilwakit cha'ab Allah nazalofi biibaan al-madiina.
Yalla gummi-!Yalla gummi,ya Dabuura.Yalla gummi-!Yalla gummi wa khanni.Yalla gumm,ya Baaraakh wileed Abinuu'am-!Wa jiib masaajiinak.
Khalaas al-faddalo hayyiinnazalo ale l-kubaaraatwa cha'ab Allah gammo fi chaanimisil al-furraas.
Al-dammaro al-Amaalikhmarago min gabiilat Afraayimwa ma'aahum gabiilat Banyaamiin ma'a askarhum.Wa min khachum beet Makiirmarago al-khuyyaadwa min gabiilat Zabuluunmarago kubaaraat al-askar.
Wa kubaaraat gabiilat Yassaakarandammo le Dabuurawa rujaal Yassaakar taaba'o Baaraakhwa macho waraayah fi l-waadi.Wa laakin ambeenaat khuchuum buyuut Ra'uubiingammo machaakil bala hadd.
Wa maala intu ga'adtu jamb al-zaraayible tasma'o baki al-bahaayimwa tasma' baki al-maal-?Wa ambeenaat khuchuum buyuut Ra'uubiingammo machaakil bala hadd.
Wa naas Gil'aadga'ado fi arduhum sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.Wa maala gabiilat Daanga'adat jamb sufunha-?Wa gabiilat Achiirga'adat fi khachum al-baharwa ma gammat min bakaanha foogah.
Wa laakin gabiilat Zabuluundasso nufuushum fi l-khutuurawa gabiilat Naftaalikhaataro be hayaathum fi bakaan al-harib.
Wa jo muluuk wa haarabo.Khalaas,muluuk Kan'aan kula haarabo.Fi Ta'nak gariib le almi Magiddu,ma ligo khaniime hana fudda.
Wa min al-sama,al-nujuum chaarako fi l-haribwa min bakaanhum al-ba'iid,haarabo Siisra.
Wa waadi Khiichuun chaalaahum,hu al-waadi al-gadiim,waadi Khiichuun.Amchi,ya nafsi,be gudra-!
Harakat rijle al-kheel ansama'atwakit gaa'idiin yajru,yajru misil kheel al-sabag.
Wa malak Allah gaal-:--Al'ano hillit Miruuzwa al'ano sukkaanha la'ana chadiide.Achaan humman ma jo haarabo le Allahwa ma jo faza'o al-furraas.--
Ya Yaa'il,marit Haabar al-Khiini,Allah yibaarikki min kulla l-awiin.Aywa,khalli Allah yibaarikki,min kulla l-awiin al-saaknaat fi l-khiyam.
Wakit Siisra sa'alha almi,hi antatah labanwa antatah zibde fi kaas al-furraas.
Wa hi chaalat witid al-kheemabe iidha al-israwa be iidha al-zeene,chaalat mitragat al-khaddaam.Wa hi darabat Siisrawa rihkat raasahwa ta'anatah fi raasah.
Giddaamha,hu barakwa waga' giddaamha wa ragad.Wa l-bakaan al-waga' foogah,da bas maat foogah.
Min al-chubbaak,amm Siisra gaa'ide tichiifwa min al-chubbaak,hi tuguul-:--Maala arabaatah hana l-harib ma jo-?Maala arabat wileedi hana l-harib akhkharat-?--
Wa l-indihin hikma min awiin al-kubaaraatyikalliman leehawa hi tiraddid fi nafisha kalaamhinwa tuguul-:
--Akiid ligo khaniimewa gaa'idiin yigassumuuha.Bitt waahide aw banaat itneenle kulli muhaarib.Toob mulawwan wa mukallaf le Siisrawa kadmuul mukallaf al-yarbutuuh fi ragabat al-munnasir.--
Ya Allah,khalli kulla udwaanakyiddammaro misil Siisrawa l-yihibbuukyabgo misil deyy al-harraay wakit tatla'.-Wa ba'ad da,al-balad gaa'ide fi raaha le muddit 40 sana.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gammo battaan sawwo al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa Allah sallamaahum le balad Midyaan le muddit sab'a siniin.
Wa hukum Midyaan bigi chadiid fi Bani Israa'iil wa be sabab da,Bani Israa'iil sawwo bakaanaat hana malja' fi karaakiir al-jibaal wa fi wa'ar al-hajar.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil teerabo ziraa'ithum,al-Midyaaniyiin wa l-Amaalikh wa gabaayil aakhariin min al-sabaah gammo hajamoohum.
Wa humman nazalo jamb Bani Israa'iil wa dammaro intaaj al-ziraa'a hana l-balad lahaddi Khazza.Wa ma khallo cheyy le Bani Israa'iil yi'iichu beyah wa la khanamaay wa la bagara wa la humaar.
Wakit jo,jo katiiriin misil saar al-leel,humman be khiyamhum wa maalhum.Jo be jumaalhum bala adad wa be da,dammaro al-balad.
Wa Bani Israa'iil ti'ibo ziyaada be sabab al-Midyaaniyiin wa koorako le Allah.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil koorako le Allah wa dawwaro al-faza' min al-Midyaaniyiin,
khalaas Allah rassal nabi le Bani Israa'iil.Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ana Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,al-maragtuku min Masir balad al-ubuudiiye.
Ana najjeetku min iid al-Masriyiin wa min kulla l-naas al-zalamooku wa taradtuhum giddaamku wa anteetku baladhum.
Wa gult leeku-:"Ana Allah Ilaahku.Ma takhaafo min ilaahaat al-Amuuriyiin al-intu saakniin fi baladhum."Wa laakin intu ma simi'tu kalaami.--
Wa ba'ad da,malak Allah ja wa ga'ad tihit al-chadarat al-kabiire fi hillit Ufra,hint Yuwaach al-min khachum beet Abi'aazar.Wa wileedah Gid'uun gaa'id yudugg gameh fi assaarat al-inab achaan al-Midyaaniyiin ma yichiifuuh.
Wa malak Allah baan leyah wa gaal-:-Allah gaa'id ma'aak,ya l-raajil al-faaris.
Wa Gid'uun gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak ya siidi,kan Allah gaa'id ma'aana,maala kulla l-ta'ab da ja foogna-?Wa ween al-ajaayib al-hajjo beehum juduudna wakit ooroona kikkeef Allah maragaahum min Masir-?Wa hassa' da,Allah abaana wa sallamna le l-Midyaaniyiin.
Wa khalaas,Allah wajjah aleyah wa gaal-:-Amchi be l-gudra al-indak wa najji Bani Israa'iil min al-Midyaaniyiin.Ana bas rassaltak-!
Wa laakin Gid'uun gaal leyah-:-Ya siidi,saamihni-!Kikkeef ana nagdar ninajji Bani Israa'iil-?Khachum beeti aakhir khachum beet fi gabiilat Manassa wa ana kula aakhar naadum fi aayilat abuuyi.
Wa Allah radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana nukuun ma'aak wa be da,taktul kulla l-Midyaaniyiin misil naadum waahid.
Wa Gid'uun gaal-:-Kan inta ridiit leyi,wassif leyi alaama kadar da inta bas al-gaa'id tihajji leyi.
Min fadlak,ma tamchi min hini lahaddi nigabbil leek wa nukhutt giddaamak hadiiyti. Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana nagood lahaddi inta tigabbil.
Wa Gid'uun macha wa jahhaz sakhal ma'a 10 kooro hana dagiig wa sawwa khubza bala tawwaara.Wa khatta al-laham fi guffa wa l-mulaah fi burma.Wa waddaah wa gaddamah leyah tihit al-chadarat al-kabiire.
Wa malak Allah gaal leyah-:-Chiil al-laham wa l-khubza bala tawwaara wa khuttuhum fi l-hajar da wa ruchch al-mulaah. Wa Gid'uun tabbag kulla l-kalaam da.
Wa malak Allah matta al-asa al-fi iideenah wa limis beeha al-laham wa l-khubza bala tawwaara.Wa l-naar gammat min al-hajar wa akalat al-laham wa l-khubza bala tawwaara.Wa khalaas,malak Allah bigi ma fiih.
Wa wakit Gid'uun irif kadar da malak Allah,hu gaal-:-Ya Allah Rabbi,ana gaabalt malak Allah wijih be wijih-!
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Al-salaam ma'aak-!Ma takhaaf,inta ma tumuut.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Gid'uun bana madbah le Allah wa sammaah Allah Hu al-Salaam.Wa lahaddi l-yoom,al-madbah da gaa'id fi hillit Ufra fi ard khachum beet Abi'aazar.
Wa fi l-leele di,Allah gaal le Gid'uun-:-Chiil al-toor al-taani hana abuuk al-hu wald sab'a sana.Wa ahdim madbah Ba'al hana abuuk wa agta' al-uud al-khazzooh le ibaadat Achiira al-gaa'id jambah.
Wa abni madbah be nizaam le Allah Ilaahak fi raas al-bakaan al-gawi da.Wa chiil al-toor da wa gaddimah dahiiye muharraga be l-uud hana ibaadat Achiira al-inta gata'tah.
Wa Gid'uun chaal achara raajil min abiidah wa tabbag amur Allah al-gaalah leyah.Wa laakin hu sawwa al-khidme di be l-leel achaan be l-nahaar,hu khaayif min aayiltah wa min naas al-hille.
Wa be fajur badri,naas al-hille gammo chaafo madbah Ba'al muhaddam wa l-uud al-khazzooh le ibaadat Achiira al-gaa'id jambah magtuu' wa l-toor al-taani gaddamooh dahiiye muharraga fi l-madbah al-banooh.
Wa humman gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Yaatu sawwa al-cheyy da-? Wa sa'alo wa fattacho wa gaalo-:-Da Gid'uun wileed Yuwaach.Hu bas sawwa al-cheyy da.
Wa naas al-hille gaalo le Yuwaach-:-Jiib leena wileedak naktuluuh achaan hu bas al-haddam madbah Ba'al wa kassar al-uud hana ibaadat Achiira al-gaa'id jambah.
Wa Yuwaach gaal le kulla l-naas al-waagfiin jambah-:-Hal intu bas al-tidaafu'u le Ba'al walla-?Wa intu bas al-tafza'ooh walla-?Ayyi naadum al-yidaafi' le Ba'al,waajib yumuut gabul al-harraay ma tatla'.Wa kan Ba'al hu ilaah,khalli yidaafi' le nafsah kan naadum haddam madbahah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,sammo Gid'uun Yarba'al wa gaalo-:-Khalli Ba'al yidaafi' le nafsah minnah achaan hu haddam madbahah.
Wa ba'ad da,kulla l-Midyaaniyiin wa l-Amaalikh wa gabaayil al-sabaah lammo kalaamhum sawa wa gata'o bahar al-Urdun wa nazalo fi waadi Yazra'iil.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal fi Gid'uun wa hu darab al-buug wa khachum beet Abi'aazar macho waraayah.
Wa hu rassal naas yi'ooru kulla gabiilat Manassa achaan yitaabu'uuh.Wa battaan rassal naas le gabaayil Achiir wa Zabuluun wa Naftaali achaan humman kula yindammo leyah.
Wa Gid'uun gaal le l-Rabb-:-Kan tidoor tinajji Bani Israa'iil beyi ana misil inta gultah,
daahu ana nukhutt farwa be suufha fi l-madagg.Wa kan al-karany yanzil fi l-suuf da wa ma yibill al-naga'a,khalaas ana na'arif kadar inta tinajji Bani Israa'iil be iidi ana.
Wa bigi misil da.Wa wakit ambaakir Gid'uun gamma,macha asar al-suuf wa almi marag minnah malyit kooro.
Wa khalaas,Gid'uun gaal le l-Rabb-:-Ya Ilaahi,ma takhdab leyi kan nikallim battaan.Khalliini nijarrib al-suuf da battaan.Wa fi l-marra di,khalli al-suuf yagood yaabis wa l-naga'a kamaan tinballa be l-karany.
Wa l-Rabb sawwa misil da fi l-leele di.Al-suuf ga'ad yaabis wa l-naga'a anballat.
Wa be fajur badri,Yarba'al wa hu Gid'uun gamma,hu wa kulla l-cha'ab al-ma'aayah wa nazalo gariib le Een Haruud.Wa mu'askar al-Midyaaniyiin kamaan gaa'id munchaakh fi l-waadi ale jabal Muura.
Wa Allah gaal le Gid'uun-:-Al-cha'ab al-ma'aak dool katiiriin marra waahid.Wa kan ana nisallim leehum al-Midyaaniyiin fi iideehum,Bani Israa'iil yafchuru be nufuushum wa yuguulu-:--Be duraa'na bas najjeena nufuusna.--
Wa hassa',guul le cha'abak-:--Ayyi naadum al-khaaf wa gaa'id yarjif,khalli yigabbil min jibaal Gil'aad.-- Wa khalaas,22-000 raajil min al-cha'ab gabbalo wa faddalo 10-000 raajil.
Wa Allah gaal le Gid'uun-:-Ya hassa' kula,al-cha'ab dool katiiriin ziyaada.Dalliihum fi khachum al-almi wa hinaak,ana nijarribhum leek.Wa ayyi naadum al-nuguul leek-:--Khalli yamchi ma'aak--,hu da yamchi ma'aak.Wa l-naadum al-nuguul leek-:--Ma yamchi ma'aak--,hu da khalli ma yamchi ma'aak.
Wa khalaas,Gid'uun wadda al-cha'ab fi khachum al-almi.Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Ayyi naadum al-yakhrif almi be iideenah wa yuluggah misil kalib,khuttah chig.Wa l-yabruk wa yachrab kula,khuttah chig.
Wa l-naas al-kharafo almi be iideehum wa laggooh misil kulaab,adadhum bigi tultumiya.Wa laakin al-baagi min al-cha'ab,kulluhum barako wa chirbo almi.
Wa Allah gaal le Gid'uun-:-Be l-tultumiya rujaal al-laggo almi misil kulaab dool bas,ana ninajjiiku wa nisallim leeku al-Midyaaniyiin fi iideeku.Wa khalaas,khalli kulla l-baagi min al-cha'ab yamchu buyuuthum.
Wa khalaas,al-rujaal al-tultumiya chaalo zaad al-baagi min al-cha'ab wa bawagaahum.Wa Gid'uun gaal le l-baagi min cha'ab Bani Israa'iil khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah.Wa hu khatta al-tultumiya naas dool ma'aayah.Wa mu'askar al-Midyaaniyiin gaa'id tihithum fi l-waadi.
Wa fi l-leele di,Allah gaal le Gid'uun-:-Gumm anzil wa ahjim mu'askar al-Midyaaniyiin.Ana sallamtah leek-!
Wa laakin kan khuft ma tanzil wa tahjim,dalli chiif ale l-mu'askar ma'a khaddaamak Fuura.
Wa tasma' kalaamhum wa khalaas,talga gudra wa tahjim al-mu'askar. Wa hu dalla ma'a Fuura khaddaamah lahaddi gariib le khachum al-mu'askar.
Wa l-Midyaaniyiin wa l-Amaalikh wa kulla gabaayil al-sabaah muchattatiin fi l-waadi misil saar al-leel wa jumaalhum katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar.
Wa wakit Gid'uun dalla,hu simi' waahid min al-askar gaa'id yihajji le rafiigah be ru'ya.Wa gaal-:-Ana ri'iit wa di hi al-ru'ya al-ana chiftaha.Ana chift khubza waahide hint gameh abyad gaa'id yiddargas fi mu'askarna.Wa l-khubza di jaat lahaddi kheema waahide wa darabaaha wa l-kheema di achchaglabat wa waga'at marra waahid.
Wa rafiigah gaal leyah-:-Da bas yabga seef Gid'uun wileed Yuwaach al-min Israa'iil.Al-Rabb sallam leyah Midyaan wa kulla mu'askarna.
Wa min Gid'uun simi' al-ru'ya wa tafsiirha,gamma sajad.Wa gabbal le mu'askar Bani Israa'iil wa gaal-:-Gummu achaan Allah sallam mu'askar Midyaan fi iideeku-!
Wa Gid'uun gassam al-tultumiya rujaal ale talaata majmuu'aat wa anta ayyi raajil buug wa jarr faadi wa fi ayyi jarr fi deyy.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Chiifu aleyi wa sawwu misli.Wa wakit niwassil fi khachum al-mu'askar,al-cheyy al-ana nisawwiih,intu kula sawwuuh.
Wakit ana wa l-naas al-ma'aayi nadurbu al-buug,intu kula hawwugu al-mu'askar wa adurbu bawagaaku wa guulu-:--Le Allah wa le Gid'uun-!-
Wa gubbaal al-leel ma yingasim Gid'uun wa l-miya naas al-ma'aayah jo fi khachum al-mu'askar wa da wakit baddalo al-haraasa.Humman darabo al-buug wa kassaro al-jiraar al-fi iideehum.
Wa l-talaata majmuu'aat kulluhum darabo al-buug wa kassaro jiraarhum.Ayyi raajil be iidah al-isra,kaarib al-deyy wa be iidah al-zeene,kaarib al-buug al-gaa'id yadurbah.Wa gaalo-:-Al-seef le Allah wa le Gid'uun-!
Wa humman hawwago al-mu'askar ayyi waahid waagif fi bakaanah.Wa khalaas,kulla rujaal fi mu'askar al-Midyaaniyiin gammo barjalo wa koorako wa arrado.
Wa wakit al-tultumiya naas darabo al-bawaga,Allah sawwa fi lubb al-mu'askar kadar ayyi raajil yaktul rafiigah be seefah.Wa kulla l-askar arrado lahaddi Beet Chitta ale Sariira wa lahaddi khachum Abil Mahuula gariib le Tabbat.
Wa Bani Israa'iil lammo rujaal gabaayil Naftaali wa Achiir wa kulla gabiilat Manassa wa taarado al-Midyaaniyiin.
Wa Gid'uun rassal naas le kulla jibaal Afraayim le yuguulu-:-Anzulu wa ahjumu al-Midyaaniyiin.Akurbu giddaamhum ayyi ma'add fi bahar al-Urdun lahaddi Beet Bara. Wa be da,kulla rujaal Afraayim karabo ayyi ma'add fi bahar al-Urdun lahaddi Beet Bara.
Wa karabo itneen min khuyyaad al-Midyaaniyiin wa humman Uriib wa Ziib.Wa katalo Uriib fi hajar hana Uriib wa Ziib fi assaarat Ziib.Wa humman taarado al-Midyaaniyiin lahaddi turaab Midyaan.Wa ba'ad da,jaabo ruuse Uriib wa Ziib le Gid'uun khaadi le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa rujaal Afraayim gaalo le Gid'uun-:-Maala ma hajjeetna wakit maachi tihaarib al-Midyaaniyiin-? Wa humman harajo ma'aayah huraaj chadiid.
Wa Gid'uun gaal leehum-:-Ana ma sawweet cheyy yisaawi al-cheyy al-intu sawweetuuh-!Wa l-kichcheeb gabiilitku Afraayim ma akheer min kulla l-gati' hana khachum beeti Abi'aazar walla-?
Wa leeku intu bas,al-Rabb sallam Uriib wa Ziib khuyyaad al-Midyaaniyiin.Ana ma sawweet cheyy yisaawi al-cheyy al-intu sawweetuuh-! Wa min hu gaal al-kalaam da,khalaas za'alhum da bigi ma fiih.
Wa Gid'uun wa l-rujaal al-tultumiya al-ma'aayah wassalo bahar al-Urdun wa gata'ooh.Hatta kan ayyaaniin kula,humman gaa'idiin yitaarudu udwaanhum.
Wa wakit wassalo hillit Sukkuut,Gid'uun gaal le sukkaanha-:-Min fadulku,antu khubza le l-rujaal al-ma'aayi achaan humman ayyaaniin.Ana gaa'id natrud Zabah wa Salmuuna' muluuk Midyaan.
Wa laakin kubaaraat Sukkuut gaalo leyah-:-Inta lissaa' ma gidirt tukhutt Zabah wa Salmuuna' tihit sultitak.Maala nantu akil le deechak-?
Wa Gid'uun radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan Allah sallam leyi Zabah wa Salmuuna',ana nafruchku be chook al-sahara wa l-haskaniit.
Wa min al-bakaan da,hu macha hillit Fanuwiil wa hajja le sukkaanha be nafs al-kalaam wa naas Fanuwiil kula raddo leyah be nafs al-kalaam misil hana naas Sukkuut.
Wa hu gaal le naas Fanuwiil-:-Kan jiit be sihha wa salaama,nihaddim gasirku da.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Zabah wa Salmuuna' gaa'idiin fi Garguur ma'a askarhum al-adadhum yisaawi 15-000 raajil.Wa dool bas al-faddalo min kulla deech gabaayil al-sabaah achaan 120-000 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf maato.
Wa Gid'uun macha be murhaal al-sayyaara sabaah le Nuubah wa Yugbaha wa katal al-askar al-yahsubu humman gaa'idiin be amaan.
Wa Zabah wa Salmuuna' muluuk Midyaan arrado wa Gid'uun taradaahum wa karabaahum.Wa khalaas be da,barjal kulla askarhum.
Wa Gid'uun wileed Yuwaach gabbal min al-harib be gooz Haaras.
Wa hu karab sabi min naas Sukkuut wa sa'alah.Wa hu katab leyah kulla asaame al-kubaaraat wa l-chuyuukh hana Sukkuut wa adadhum 77 raajil.
Wa Gid'uun macha le naas Sukkuut wa gaal leehum-:-Chiifu-!Daahu Zabah wa Salmuuna' al-be sababhum intu gultu leyi-:--Inta lissaa' ma gidirt tukhutt Zabah wa Salmuuna' tihit sultitak.Maala nantu akil le deechak-?-
Wa hu chaal chuyuukh al-hille wa chaal chook al-sahara wa haskaniit wa farach beehum naas Sukkuut.
Wa hu haddam al-gasir al-fi Fanuwiil wa katal rujaal al-hille.
Wa ba'ad da,Gid'uun gaal le Zabah wa Salmuuna'-:-Al-naas al-kataltuuhum fi Taabuur yichaabuhu yaatu-? Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Al-naas dool mislak.Wa ayyi waahid minhum misil wileed malik.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Humman dool akhwaani iyaal ammi.Nahlif leeku be Allah al-Hayy,kan awwal ma kataltuuhum,ana abadan ma naktulku.
Wa Gid'uun gaal le Yatar wileedah al-bikir-:-Gumm wa aktulhum-! Wa laakin al-wileed ma salla seefah.Hu khaaf achaan hu wileed sabi.
Wa Zabah wa Salmuuna' gaalo-:-Gumm,inta zaatak bas aktulna achaan di khidmit al-raajil al-fahal. Wa khalaas,Gid'uun gamma katalaahum le Zabah wa Salmuuna' wa chaal al-ziina min rigaab jumaalhum.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil gaalo le Gid'uun-:-Inta bas abga malikna.Wa ba'adak inta,wileedak wa wileed wileedak yabgo muluukna achaan inta najjeetna min al-Midyaaniyiin.
Wa laakin Gid'uun gaal leehum-:-Ana ma nabga malik foogku wa la wileedi.Khalli Allah bas yamluk foogku.
Wa battaan gaal leehum-:-Nidoor nas'alku cheyy waahid.Khalli ayyi waahid minku yijiib leyi khaatim waahid min al-khaniime al-ligiituuha fi l-harib. Udwaanhum al-Ismaa'iiliyiin induhum khatam.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Tamaam,nantuuhum leek. Wa humman faracho khalag wa ayyi waahid zagal foogah khaatim waahid min khaniimtah.
Wa l-khatam al-talabaahum Gid'uun wazinhum yisaawi 2-500 jineeh hana dahab.Wa da bala l-suure wa l-khuruus wa l-khulgaan al-loonhum garadi al-yalbasoohum muluuk Midyaan wa l-ribig al-yarbutuuh fi rigaab jumaalhum.
Wa Gid'uun chaal al-dahab da wa daggah farmala wa khattaah fi hillitah Ufra.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil yaju ya'abudu al-farmala di wa da bigi charak le Gid'uun wa le kulla aayiltah.
Wa khalaas,al-Midyaaniyiin ga'ado tihit hukum Bani Israa'iil wa ma gidro battaan yarfa'o ruuseehum.Wa fi muddit hayaat Gid'uun,al-balad gaa'ide fi raaha le muddit 40 sana.
Wa Yarba'al wa hu Gid'uun wileed Yuwaach gabbal sakan fi beetah.
Wa Gid'uun jaab 70 awlaad achaan hu indah awiin katiiraat.
Wa indah sirriiye fi Chakiim.Hi kula jaabat leyah wileed wa hu sammaah Abiimalik.
Wa Gid'uun wileed Yuwaach chayyab marra waahid wa aach fi halu.Wa ba'ad da,maat wa dafanooh fi khabur abuuh Yuwaach fi Ufra hint khachum beet Abi'aazar.
Wa ba'ad moot Gid'uun,Bani Israa'iil gammo battaan achcharmato ma'a asnaam Ba'al wa abadoohum wa sawwo Ba'al Bariit ilaahhum.
Wa Bani Israa'iil abadan ma fakkaro fi Allah ilaahhum al-najjaahum min udwaanhum al-muhawwigiinhum.
Wa be kulla l-kheer al-sawwaah leehum Yarba'al wa hu Gid'uun,Bani Israa'iil ma sawwo kheer le aayiltah.
Wa Abiimalik wileed Yarba'al macha Chakiim le yalga akhwaan ammah wa kulla aayilat abu ammah.Wa gaal leehum-:
Guulu le kulla sukkaan Chakiim-:--Akheer yahkumuuku 70 hukkaam kulluhum min awlaad Yarba'al aw yahkimku raajil waahid bas-?Wa a'arfu kadar ana da min dammuku wa lahamku.-
Wa akhwaan ammah kallamo kulla kalaam Abiimalik le sukkaan Chakiim wa humman dawwarooh achaan gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Hu da akhuuna.
Wa humman antooh 70 hajar fudda min beet ilaahhum Ba'al Bariit le Abiimalik.Wa be l-fudda di,hu ajjar naas ma naaf'iin wa rabbaatiin duruub le yitaabu'uuh.
Wa hu gabbal le beet abuuh fi Ufra wa katal kulla akhwaanah iyaal abuuh Yarba'al,humman al-sab'iin,kulluhum fi hajar waahid.Wa illa Yuutaam al-sakhayyar wileed Yarba'al faddal minhum achaan hu da allabbad.
Wa kulla sukkaan Chakiim wa kulla cha'ab Beet Millu macho le l-chadara al-kabiire al-gaa'ide jamb al-hajar al-khazzooh fi Chakiim.Wa hinaak darrajo Abiimalik malik.
Wa wakit khabbaro Yuutaam,hu macha tala' fi raas jabal Gariziim wa sarakh be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Asma'ooni,ya sukkaan Chakiim,wa l-Rabb kula yasma'ku.
Yoom min al-ayyaam,kulla chadar al-khaaba gammo le yamsaho wa yidarruju leehum malik wa gaalo le chadar al-zaytuun-:--Abga foogna malik.--
Wa chadar al-zaytuun gaal-:--Hal nikhalli dihni al-be sababah al-Rabb wa l-naas kula chakarooni wa namchi nabga kabiir fi l-chadar walla-?--
Wa chadar al-khaaba gaalo le chadar al-tiin-:--Ta'aal wa abga foogna malik.--
Wa chadar al-tiin gaal-:--Hal nikhalli tu'umti al-haluuwe wa ma nalda fawaakihi al-haluwiin wa namchi nabga kabiir fi l-chadar walla-?--
Wa chadar al-khaaba gaalo le chadar al-inab-:--Ta'aal wa abga foogna malik.--
Wa chadar al-inab gaal-:--Hal nikhalli asiiri al-yafrah beyah al-Rabb wa l-naas wa namchi nabga kabiir fi l-chadar walla-?--
Wa khalaas,kulla chadar al-khaaba gaalo le l-chadar al-indah chook-:--Ta'aal wa abga foogna malik.--
Wa l-chadar al-indah chook gaal leehum-:--Kan sahiih ke intu tidooru tamsahooni wa tidarrujuuni malik foogku da,ta'aalu agoodu tihti fi dulli.Wa laakin kan abeetu kamaan,tamrug naar minni wa taakul arz Lubnaan.-
Wa Yuutaam gaal battaan-:-Hassa',ya sukkaan Chakiim,wakit darrajtu Abiimalik malik,hal darrajtuuh be l-hagg wa l-adaala-?Wa hal sawweetu al-kheer ma'a Yarba'al wa aayiltah walla-?Wa hal fakkartu fi l-cheyy al-hu sawwaah leeku-?
Abuuyi haarab fi chaanku wa dassa nafsah fi l-khutuura wa najjaaku min al-Midyaaniyiin.
Wa l-yoom,intu gammeetu didd aayiltah wa kataltu awlaadah al-sab'iin fi hajar waahid.Wa Abiimalik wileed sirriiytah bas darrajtuuh malik fi sukkaan Chakiim achaan hu akhuuku.
Wa kan al-yoom intu gammeetu ma'a Yarba'al wa ma'a aayiltah be l-hagg wa l-adaala,khalaas afraho be Abiimalik wa khalli Abiimalik kula yafrah beeku.
Wa kan abeetu kamaan,khalli naar tamrug min Abiimalik wa taakul sukkaan Chakiim wa cha'ab Beet Millu.Wa khalli naar tamrug min sukkaan Chakiim wa cha'ab Beet Millu wa taakul Abiimalik.
Wa khalaas,Yuutaam jara wa macha le hillit Biir wa sakan hinaak ba'iid min akhuuh Abiimalik.
Wa Abiimalik hakam fi Israa'iil muddit talaata sana.
Wa ba'ad da,al-Rabb rassal ruuh fasle jaabat khilaaf ambeen Abiimalik wa sukkaan Chakiim wa humman gammo khaanooh.
Wa be sabab dimmit awlaad Yarba'al al-sab'iin,al-ikhaab waga' fi raas akhuuhum Abiimalik al-katalhum wa fi raas sukkaan Chakiim al-lazzooh fi l-katil.
Wa sukkaan Chakiim gammo yarbutu leyah kamiin fi ruuse al-jibaal wa yagla'o khumaam kulla l-naas al-yi'addu beyah.Wa khalaas,jo khabbaro Abiimalik.
Wa yoom waahid,raajil waahid al-binaaduuh Ga'al wileed Aabad ja ma'a akhwaanah fi Chakiim wa sukkaan Chakiim aamanooh.
Wa l-sukkaan marago fi l-kadaade wa gata'o jineenaathum hana l-inab wa asarooh wa sawwo aazuuma.Wa macho le beet ilaahhum wa akalo wa chirbo wa la'ano Abiimalik.
Wa Ga'al wileed Aabad gaal-:-Abiimalik hu yaatu lahaddi aniina naas Chakiim nagoodu tihtah-?Hu wileed Yarba'al bas wa l-mas'uul fi l-hille di,hu Zabuul.Nagoodu tihit zurriiyit Hamuur abu Chakiim.Maala nidooru nagoodu tihit hukum Abiimalik-?
Kan kulla l-naas aamano beyi,ana nitarrif Abiimalik.Wa nuguul le Abiimalik-:--Limm askarak wa amrug le l-harib-!-
Wa Zabuul haakim al-hille zi'il za'al chadiid wakit simi' kalaam Ga'al wileed Aabad.
Wa hu rassal naas be sirr le yikhabburu Abiimalik wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu Ga'al wileed Aabad wa akhwaanah jo fi Chakiim wa gawwamo kulla naas al-hille diddak.
Wa hassa' da,gumm be l-leel,inta wa askarak wa amchi arbut leehum kamiin fi l-kadaade.
Wa be fajur wakit al-harraay tatla',amchi wa ahjim al-hille.Wa wakit Ga'al wa l-naas al-ma'aayah yamurgu le yihaarubuuk,khalaas sawwi foogah ayyi cheyy al-tidoorah.
Wa Abiimalik wa kulla askarah gammo be l-leel wa angasamo ale arba'a majmuu'aat wa rabato kamiin gariib le hillit Chakiim.
Wa Ga'al wileed Aabad marag wa wagaf fi khachum baab al-hille.Wa khalaas,Abiimalik wa askarah marago min bakaanaathum al-rabato fooghum kamiin.
Wa wakit chaafhum,Ga'al gaal le Zabuul-:-Daahu rujaal gaa'idiin yiddallo min al-jibaal. Wa laakin Zabuul gaal leyah-:-Da dull hana l-jibaal bas wa inta tahsibah naas.
Wa Ga'al gaal battaan-:-Daahu naas gaa'idiin yiddallo min al-jabal al-fi usut wa fi aakhariin kula jaayiin be derib chadarat al-Chawwaafiin.
Wa Zabuul gaal leyah-:-Ween kalaamak al-inta awwal hajjeetah-?Awwal inta ma gult-:--Abiimalik hu yaatu lahaddi aniina nagoodu tihtah-?- Wa daahu al-naas al-inta hagartuhum.Hassa' da,amrug wa haaribhum-!
Wa khalaas,Ga'al marag fi raas sukkaan Chakiim wa haarab Abiimalik.
Wa laakin Abiimalik annasar fi Ga'al wa taradah giddaamah lahaddi khachum baab al-hille wa naas katiir maato.
Wa ba'ad da,Abiimalik macha ga'ad fi Aruuma.Wa Zabuul tarad Ga'al wa akhwaanah wa ma yikhalliihum yaskunu fi Chakiim.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taani,cha'ab Chakiim macho fi ziraa'ithum wa Abiimalik simi' be l-khabar da.
Wa Abiimalik chaal askarah wa gassamaahum ale talaata majmuu'aat wa rabat kamiin fi l-kadaade.Wa wakit chaafo al-cha'ab marago min al-hille,al-askar gammo didduhum wa kataloohum.
Wa Abiimalik wa l-majmuu'a al-ma'aayah macho karabo khachum baab al-hille wa ga'ado foogah.Wa l-majmuu'teen al-aakhariin hajamo kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi l-ziraa'a wa kataloohum.
Wa tuul al-nahaar da,Abiimalik gaa'id yihaarib fi l-hille wa ba'ad da,chaalha.Wa katal kulla l-cha'ab wa dammar al-hille wa sabba fi bakaanha mileh.
Wa wakit kulla rujaal Migdal Chakiim sim'o al-khabar da,humman macho allabbado fi l-nugra al-gaa'ide tihit beet al-ibaada hana Iil Bariit.
Wa jo khabbaro Abiimalik kadar kulla rujaal Migdal Chakiim lammo bakaan waahid.
Wa khalaas,Abiimalik wa kulla askarah tala'o fi jabal Salmuun.Wa Abiimalik chaal faas wa gata' firi' yaabis wa khattaah fi kitfah wa gaal le askarah-:-Ajala,sawwu misil ana sawweetah.
Wa ayyi waahid min askarah gata' firi' yaabis wa taaba'o Abiimalik.Wa humman khatto al-furuu' dool fi khachum al-nugra di wa tachchooha.Wa kulla naas Migdal Chakiim al-gaa'idiin fi lubb al-nugra di maato,awiin wa rujaal adadhum gariib 1-000.
Wa ba'ad da,Abiimalik chaal derib hillit Tiibis wa haasarha wa chaalha.
Wa fiyah gasir gawi fi ust al-hille wa kulla l-sukkaan,awiin wa rujaal,dakhalo foogah.Wa ba'ad saddo al-baab,tala'o fi raas al-gasir.
Wa Abiimalik ja hajam al-gasir al-gawi da.Hu ja gariib le baabah achaan yitichchah.
Wa khalaas,mara waahide zaragat Abiimalik be murhaaka wa kassarat raasah.
Wa tawwaali,Abiimalik naada al-sabi al-chaayil leyah silaahah wa gaal leyah-:-Sill seefak wa aktulni achaan ma yuguulu-:--Mara bas katalatah.-- Wa l-sabi ta'anah wa hu maat.
Wa wakit rujaal Bani Israa'iil chaafo Abiimalik maat,ayyi waahid macha beetah.
Wa l-Rabb gabbal fi raas Abiimalik al-fasaala al-hu sawwaaha le abuuh wakit katal akhwaanah al-sab'iin.
Wa l-Rabb gabbal fi raas sukkaan Chakiim kulla l-fasaala al-humman sawwooha.Wa be misil da,al-la'ana al-la'anaahum beeha Yuutaam wileed Yarba'al kula lihgathum.
Wa ba'ad moot Abiimalik,Tuula' wileed Fuwwa wileed Duudu al-min gabiilat Yassaakar gamma le yinajji Bani Israa'iil.Wa hu saakin fi Chamiir fi jibaal Afraayim.
Hu hakam fi Bani Israa'iil 23 sana.Wa ba'ad da,maat wa dafanooh fi Chamiir.
Wa ba'adah gamma Yayiir al-min turaab Gil'aad wa hakam fi Bani Israa'iil 22 sana.
Wa hu indah 30 awlaad raakbiin fi 30 duhuuch wa induhum 30 hillaal al-bisammuuhum lahaddi l-yoom furgaan Yayiir fi turaab Gil'aad.
Wa Yayiir maat wa dafanooh fi Khaamuun.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gammo battaan yisawwu al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa abado asnaam Ba'al wa Achtaruut wa ilaahaat hana buldaan aakhariin,misil Araam wa Seeda wa Muwaab wa Bani Ammuun wa l-Filistiyiin.Wa humman abo Allah wa battaan ma abadooh.
Wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Bani Israa'iil wa sallamaahum le l-Filistiyiin wa Bani Ammuun.
Wa min al-wakit da,humman rihko Bani Israa'iil wa zalamoohum fi muddit 18 sana lahaddi kulla Bani Israa'iil al-gaa'idiin sabaah le bahar al-Urdun fi balad al-Amuuriyiin fi turaab Gil'aad.
Wa Bani Ammuun gata'o bahar al-Urdun achaan yihaarubu gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa Afraayim.Wa Bani Israa'iil addaayago mudaayaga chadiide.
Wa khalaas,Bani Israa'iil sarakho le Allah wa gaalo-:-Sahiih,aniina aznabna achaan abeenaak inta Ilaahna wa abadna asnaam Ba'al.
Wa Allah gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Wakit al-Masriyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa Bani Ammuun wa l-Filistiyiin
wa l-Seeduuniyiin wa l-Amaalikh wa l-Maa'ooniyiin zalamooku wa wakit sarakhtu leyi,ana ma najjeetku minhum walla-?
Wa laakin intu abeetuuni wa abadtu leeku ilaahaat aakhariin wa fi chaan da,ana ma ninajjiiku battaan.
Yalla-!Amchu asrakho le ilaahaatku al-intu azaltuuhum.Khalli humman bas yafza'ooku wakit tat'abo-!
Wa Bani Israa'iil gaalo le Allah-:-Sahiih,aniina aznabna.Sawwi foogna kulla cheyy al-tidoorah wa laakin najjiina al-yoom.
Wa humman ba''ado minhum al-ilaahaat al-ajnabiyiin wa abado Allah.Wa hu hanna fooghum fi chaan ta'abhum.
Wa deech Bani Ammuun lammo wa khatto mu'askarhum fi Gil'aad.Wa Bani Israa'iil lammo wa khatto mu'askarhum fi Misfa.
Al-cha'ab wa kulla kubaaraat Gil'aad gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Al-raajil al-yabda al-harib ma'a Bani Ammuun,hu da bas yabga kabiir fi kulla sukkaan Gil'aad.
Wa Yiftaah al-min turaab Gil'aad hu raajil faaris.Wa ammah mara charmuuta wa abuuh usmah Gil'aad.
Wa l-mara al-aakhara hint Gil'aad jaabat leyah iyaal aakhariin.Wakit al-iyaal dool kibro,humman taradooh le Yiftaah wa gaalo leyah-:-Inta ma talga warasa ma'a aayilitna achaan ammak aakhara.
Wa Yiftaah arrad ba'iid min akhwaanah wa macha sakan fi balad Toob.Wa naas waahidiin ma naaf'iin andammo ma'a Yiftaah wa gaa'idiin yihaarubu ma'aayah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Bani Ammuun gammo yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit gammo didduhum,kubaaraat Gil'aad macho fattacho Yiftaah fi balad Toob.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Ta'aal abga foogna khaayid le nihaarubu Bani Ammuun.
Wa Yiftaah gaal le kubaaraat Gil'aad-:-Intu bas ma kirihtuuni wa taradtuuni min aayilat abuuyi-?Wa maala al-yoom wakit addaayagtu,jiitu leyi-?
Wa kubaaraat Gil'aad gaalo le Yiftaah-:-Hassa' aniina jiina leek achaan tamchi ma'aana wa nihaarubu Bani Ammuun.Wa tabga kabiir foogna wa fi kulla sukkaan Gil'aad.
Wa Yiftaah gaal le kubaaraat Gil'aad-:-Kan tigabbuluuni le nihaarib Bani Ammuun wa kan Allah sallamaahum leyi fi iidi,ana nabga kabiir foogku.
Wa kubaaraat Gil'aad gaalo le Yiftaah-:-Allah yachhad ambeenaatna kan ma sawweena misil inta gultah.
Wa khalaas,Yiftaah macha ma'a kubaaraat Gil'aad wa l-cha'ab khattooh fooghum kabiir wa khaayid.Wa fi hillit Misfa giddaam Allah,Yiftaah sabbat al-alaakha al-sawwaaha ma'a kubaaraat Gil'aad.
Wa ba'ad da,Yiftaah rassal naas le malik Bani Ammuun wa gaal leyah-:-Chunu al-beeni wa beenak le taji tihaaribni fi baladi-?
Wa malik Bani Ammuun gaal le l-naas al-rassalhum Yiftaah-:-Wakit Bani Israa'iil marago min balad Masir chaalo kulla ardi min waadi Arnuun le waadi Yabbuukh wa lahaddi bahar al-Urdun.Wa hassa' da,gabbulu leyi ardi be l-salaama.
Wa battaan Yiftaah rassal naas le malik Bani Ammuun
le yuguulu leyah-:-Daahu Yiftaah gaal leek-:--Bani Israa'iil ma chaalo balad Muwaab wa la balad Bani Ammuun.
Wakit marago min balad Masir,Bani Israa'iil chaggo al-sahara lahaddi l-bahar al-Ahmar wa jo fi Khaadich.
Wa rassalo naas le malik Adoom wa gaalo leyah-:"Min fadlak,khalliina nuchuggu baladak."Wa laakin malik Adoom aba ma simi' kalaamhum.Wa le malik Muwaab kula,gaddamo leyah nafs al-talab wa laakin hu kula aba.Wa khalaas,Bani Israa'iil ga'ado fi Khaadich.
Wa ba'ad da,Bani Israa'iil gammo maachiin fi l-sahara wa baaro balad Adoom wa balad Muwaab.Wa wassalo sabaah le Muwaab wa nazalo khaadi le waadi Arnuun wa laakin ma dakhalo balad Muwaab achaan waadi Arnuun da huduud Muwaab.
--Wa Bani Israa'iil rassalo naas le Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin al-gaa'id fi Hachbuun wa gaalo leyah-:"Min fadlak,khalliina nuchuggu baladak lahaddi nawsalo bakaanna."
Wa laakin Siihuun ma aamanaahum le Bani Israa'iil wa aba ma khallaahum yuchuggu baladah.Wa hu lamma kulla askarah wa khatto mu'askarhum fi Yahaas wa haarabo Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil sallam Siihuun wa kulla cha'abah le Bani Israa'iilwa humman annasaro fooghum.Wa Bani Israa'iil chaalo kulla ard al-Amuuriyiin al-saakniin fi l-balad di.
Wa chaalo kulla ard al-Amuuriyiin min waadi Arnuun lahaddi waadi Yabbuukh wa min al-sahara lahaddi bahar al-Urdun.
--Wa hassa',Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gala' ard al-Amuuriyiin wa antaaha le cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.Wa inta tidoor tagla'ha minhum walla-?
Wa inta ma warast al-ard al-antaaha leek ilaahak Kamuuch walla-?Wa aniina kula indina hagg nawrusu al-ard al-antaaha leena Allah Ilaahna.
Walla inta chadiid min Balaakh wileed Siffuur malik Muwaabwalla-?Laakin hu ma haraj ma'a Bani Israa'iil lahaddi haarabaahum.
--Min muddit 300 sana Bani Israa'iil sakano fi Hachbuun wa hillaalha al-taab'iin leeha wa fi Aruu'ir wa hillaalha al-taab'iin leeha wa fi kulla l-mudun al-fi khachum waadi Arnuun.Wa maala intu ma gala'tu al-balad di fi kulla l-mudda di-?
Wa kan leyi ana,ma khitiit foogak.Wa laakin inta bas khitiit foogi wa gaa'id tihaaribni.Wa khalli Allah yahkim al-yoom been Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Ammuun-!-
Wa laakin malik Bani Ammuun ma simi' al-kalaam al-Yiftaah rassal wa gaalah leyah.
Wa ba'ad da,Ruuh Allah nazal fi Yiftaah.Wa Yiftaah gamma chagga turaab Gil'aad wa turaab Manassa.Wa ba'ad da,macha fi Misfa Gil'aad wa minha wassal huduud Bani Ammuun.
Wa Yiftaah aahad Allah wa gaal-:-Kan inta sallamt leyi Bani Ammuun,
wakit nigabbil be sihha wa salaama min al-harib ma'a Bani Ammuun,awwal makhluug al-yamrug min beeti le yilaagiini ana nikhassisah le Allah wa nigaddimah dahiiye muharraga.
Wa Yiftaah gata' huduud Bani Ammuun wa haarabaahum.Wa Allah sallamaahum leyah fi iidah.
Wa hu annasar fooghum min hillit Aruu'ir lahaddi gariib le Minniit wa da 20 mudun wa lahaddi Abil Karaamiim.Wa l-haziime bigat kabiire lahaddi Bani Ammuun ga'ado tihit Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit Yiftaah jaayi le beetah fi Misfa,hu chaaf bittah maragat le tilaagiih gaa'ide tudugg tambal wa tal'ab.Wa di bineeytah al-waahide wa balaaha,ma indah wa la bitt wa la walad.
Wa min hu chaaf bittah,tawwaali gamma charrat khulgaanah wa gaal-:-Ya khasaarti-!Ya bineeyti,rameetiini fi l-hizin-!Inti bas jibti leyi al-ta'ab-!Ana aahadt Allah wa battaan ma nagdar nangud al-ahad.
Wa laakin hi gaalat leyah-:-Ya abuuyi,kan inta aahadt Allah,sawwi foogi misil inta gultah achaan Allah chaal leek al-taar fi udwaanak Bani Ammuun.
Wa battaan gaalat le abuuha-:-Natlub minnak bas muddit chahareen namchi fi l-jibaal ana wa rafiigaati achaan nabki le banaatiiyti.
Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Amchi. Wa hu khallaaha machat le muddit chahareen ma'a rafiigaatha le tabki le banaatiiyitha fi l-jibaal.
Wa ba'ad chahareen,hi gabbalat le abuuha wa hu tabbag ahadah al-gaalah.Wa hi ma chaafat raajil.Wa da bigi aade fi Bani Israa'iil,
kadar ayyi sana,banaat Bani Israa'iil yamchan yahzanan le muddit arba'a yoom le bitt Yiftaah al-min turaab Gil'aad.
Wa rujaal Afraayim lammo wa macho ale Safuun.Wa humman gaalo le Yiftaah-:-Maala gata't huduud Bani Ammuun le tihaaribhum wa ma khabbartina achaan namchu ma'aak-?Fi chaan da,aniina niharrugu beetak fi raasak.
Wa Yiftaah radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ana wa cha'abi indina muchkila kabiire ma'a Bani Ammuun.Wa wakit ana naadeetku,intu ma jiitu faza'tuuni.
Wa wakit ana irift kadar intu ma taju tafza'ooni,ana dasseet nafsi fi l-khutuura wa gata't huduud Bani Ammuun wa Allah sallamaahum leyi fi iidi.Wa maala al-yoom jiitu le tihaarubuuni-?
Wa khalaas,Yiftaah lamma kulla rujaal Gil'aad wa haarab gabiilat Afraayim.Wa rujaal Gil'aad annasaro fi gabiilat Afraayim achaan awwal naas Afraayim gaalo-:-Intu ya rujaal Gil'aad,intu arradtu min gabiilat Afraayim.Wa khalleetu gabiilitna le tamchu tabgo fi gabiilat Manassa.
Wa rujaal Gil'aad karabo ayyi derib hana bahar al-Urdun al-maachi ale ard Afraayim.Wa wakit raajil min Afraayim mu'arrid yuguul-:-Khalluuni nagta' -,rujaal Gil'aad yuguulu leyah-:-Inta min gabiilat Afraayim walla-? Wa kan hu yuguul-:-La-,
humman yuguulu leyah-:-Min fadlak,guul-:--Chibuuleet-!-- Wa kan hu yuguul-:-Sibuuleet- achaan ma natagah adiil,khalaas humman yakurbuuh wa yadbahooh fi l-derib hana bahar al-Urdun.Wa fi l-wakit daak,katalo 42-000 raajil min Afraayim.
Wa Yiftaah hakam fi Bani Israa'iil sitte sana.Wa ba'ad da,maat wa dafanooh fi waahide min mudun Gil'aad.
Wa ba'ad Yiftaah,Ibsaan al-min Beet Laham hakam fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Ibsaan indah 30 awlaad wa 30 banaat.Hu chaal banaatah al-talaatiin wa jawwazaahum barra min al-gabiila wa jaab le awlaadah 30 banaat min barra.Wa hakam fi Bani Israa'iil sab'a sana.
Wa ba'ad da,Ibsaan maat wa dafanooh fi Beet Laham.
Wa ba'ad Ibsaan,Iluun al-min gabiilat Zabuluun hakam fi Bani Israa'iil le muddit achara sana.
Wa ba'ad da,Iluun maat wa dafanooh fi Ayyaluun fi ard gabiilat Zabuluun.
Wa ba'ad Iluun,Abduun wileed Hilliil al-min hillit Fir'atuun hakam fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Abduun da iyaalah 40 wa iyaal iyaalah 30 wa kulluhum raakbiin fi 70 duhuuch.Wa hu hakam fi Bani Israa'iil muddit tamaane sana.
Wa ba'ad da,Abduun maat wa dafanooh fi hillit Fir'atuun fi ard gabiilat Afraayim,fi jibaal Amaalikh.
Wa battaan Bani Israa'iil gammo yisawwu al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa be da,Allah sallamaahum le l-Filistiyiin le muddit 40 sana.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,fiyah raajil waahid min gabiilat Daan al-yaskun fi hillit Saar'a wa usmah Manuuh.Wa l-raajil da,martah aagre ma jaabat iyaal.
Wa yoom waahid,malak Allah baan le martah wa gaal leeha-:-Ana na'arif kadar inti aagre ma indiki iyaal.Wa laakin hassa',inti tabge khalbaane wa tijiibi wileed.
Min hini le giddaam,fakkiri ma tacharbe khamar wa la ayyi charaab al-bisakkir wa ma taakuli akil nijis,
achaan inti tabge khalbaane wa talde wileed.Wa kan wilidtiih,ma tizayyini raasah achaan al-wileed da mukhassas le l-Rabb min hu fi batunki.Wa hu bas al-yabda yinajji Bani Israa'iil min al-Filistiyiin.
Wa khalaas,al-mara gabbalat fi l-beet wa gaalat le raajilha-:-Fiyah raajil saalih hana Allah ja leyi wa l-raajil da chooftah tikhawwif ziyaada.Akuun hu da malak Allah.Wa ana ma sa'altah hu min ween wa hu kula ma ooraani usmah.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:--Inti tabge khalbaane wa talde wileed.Wa min hini le giddaam,ma tacharbe khamar wa la ayyi charaab al-bisakkir wa ma taakuli akil nijis achaan al-wileed da mukhassas le l-Rabb min hu fi batunki lahaddi yumuut.-
Wa Manuuh sa'al Allah wa gaal-:-Ya Rabb,khalli al-raajil al-saalih al-inta rassaltah da,yajiina battaan wa khalli yiwassifna al-cheyy al-nisawwuuh wakit al-wileed da yaldooh.
Wa khalaas,Allah khibil su'aal Manuuh wa malak Allah ja battaan le martah wakit hi gaa'ide tihit fi l-zere'.Wa raajilha Manuuh ma ma'aaha.
Wa tawwaali,al-mara jarat le raajilha khabbaratah wa gaalat leyah-:-Daahu al-raajil al-jaani al-yoom daak,battaan baan leyi-!
Wa Manuuh gamma taaba' martah wa jo le l-raajil.Wa hu gaal leyah-:-Inta bas al-raajil al-awwal kallamt le marti walla-? Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa,ana bas.
Wa Manuuh gaal leyah-:-Wakit kalaamak da yilhaggag,chunu al-churuut al-waajib leyah-?Wa aniina nisawwu chunu le l-wileed da-?
Wa malak Allah gaal le Manuuh-:-Kulla cheyy al-ana gultah le martak di,khalli hi tifakkir foogah.
Ma taakul ayyi cheyy al-jaayi min al-inab wa la tachrab khamar wa la ayyi charaab al-bisakkir wa ma taakul akil nijis.Waajib hi titabbig kulla l-kalaam al-ana gultah leeha.
Wa Manuuh gaal le malak Allah-:-Min fadlak,khalli nidayyufuuk wa nigaddumu leek sakhal.
Wa malak Allah gaal le Manuuh-:-Hatta kan tidayyifni kula,ana ma naakul aklak.Wa laakin kan tidoor tigaddim dahiiye muharraga,gaddimha le Allah. Wa Manuuh ma irif kadar al-raajil hu malak Allah.
Wa Manuuh gaal le malak Allah-:-Usmak yaatu-?Achaan wakit kalaamak da yilhaggag,nicharrufuuk ziyaada.
Wa malak Allah gaal leyah-:-Maala tas'alni min usmi-?Usmi hu ajiib bilheen.
Wa Manuuh chaal sakhal wa hadiiye hana dagiig wa gaddamaahum dahiiye muharraga fi raas hajar waahid le Allah.Wa tawwaali,cheyy ajiib bigi giddaam Manuuh wa martah.
Wa wakit lahiib al-naar gaa'id yatla' min al-madbah le l-sama,malak Allah kula tala' fi l-lahiib.Wa wakit chaafo al-cheyy da,Manuuh wa martah waga'o be wujuuhhum fi l-ard.
Wa khalaas,Manuuh irif kadar da malak Allah.Wa malak Allah ma baan leyah hu wa la le martah battaan.
Wa Manuuh gaal le martah-:-Akiid aniina numuutu achaan chifna al-Rabb-!
Wa laakin martah gaalat leyah-:-Kan Allah dawwar yaktulna,ma khibil minnina al-dahiiye al-muharraga wa l-hadiiye wa la wassafna kulla l-achya dool wa la ooraana kulla l-kalaam da.
Wa l-mara wildat wileed wa sammatah Chamchuun.Wa l-wileed kibir wa Allah baarakah.
Wa fi mantagat Daan ambeen Saar'a wa Achtawuul,Ruuh Allah nazal fi Chamchuun wa bada yichajji'ah.
Wa yoom waahid,Chamchuun macha fi Timna wa hinaak hu chaaf mara waahide min banaat al-Filistiyiin.
Wa hu macha le abuuh wa ammah wa gaal leehum-:-Fi Timna,ana chift mara waahide min banaat al-Filistiyiin.Wa hassa',amchu aakhuduuha leyi.
