Wa abuuh wa ammah gaalo leyah-:-Ma ligiit mara min banaat akhwaanak wa la min cha'abna walla-?Maala tamchi tichiil mara min al-Filistiyiin al-ma mutahhariin dool-? Wa laakin Chamchuun gaal le abuuh-:-Al-bineeye di bas ajabatni.Amchi aakhudha leyi-!
Wa abuuh wa ammah ma irfo kadar be l-cheyy da Allah yijiib fursa le muhaarabat al-Filistiyiin.Wa hu gaa'id yifattich tariiga le yihaarib al-Filistiyiin.Achaan fi l-wakit da,Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin tihit hukum al-Filistiyiin.
Wa khalaas,Chamchuun macha Timna ma'a abuuh wa ammah.Wa wakit wassalo fi jineenaat al-inab hana Timna,Chamchuun chaaf farkh hana duud gaa'id yikirr jaari jaayi leyah.
Fi l-bakaan da,Ruuh Allah nazal fi Chamchuun.Hu ma indah silaah fi iidah wa laakin be iideenah bas,karab al-duud wa chaggah tineen misil sakhal.Wa hu ma kallam abuuh wa la ammah be l-cheyy al-sawwaah.
Wa hu macha Timna wa kallam ma'a l-mara wa hi ajabatah.
Wa ba'ad ayyaam,hu gabbal le yaakhudha.Wa hu baara min derbah achaan yichiif al-rimme hana l-duud.Wa fi lubb al-rimme di,hu ligi beet hana nahale malaan asal.
Hu chaal min al-asal da fi lubb iidah wa maachi wa gaa'id yaakul.Wa wakit wassal bakaan abuuh wa ammah,hu antaahum wa akalo humman kula.Wa laakin ma khabbaraahum kadar chaal al-asal da min lubb al-rimme hana l-duud.
Wa khalaas,abuuh gamma macha bakaan al-mara.Chamchuun sawwa aazuuma hinaak wa da misil aadit al-subyaan fi l-wakit da.
Wa wakit al-Filistiyiin chaafooh,humman azalo 30 subyaan le yagoodu ma'aayah.
Wa Chamchuun gaal leehum-:-Min fadulku,khalli nihajji leeku hijjeeye.Kan gidirtu iriftu ma'anaatha wa halleetuuha fi l-sab'a yoom hana l-aazuuma,ana nantiiku 30 jawwaaniiye wa 30 khulgaan tikhayyuru beehum.
Wa laakin kan ma gidirtu halleetu al-hijjeeye kamaan,intu tantuuni 30 jawwaaniiye wa 30 khulgaan nikhayyir beehum. Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Guul hijjeeytak wa aniina nasma'ooha.
Wa Chamchuun gaal leehum-:-Min al-biyaakul marag al-akilwa min al-gawi marag al-halu.-Wa muddit talaata yoom,al-subyaan ma gidro yifassuru ma'ana al-hijjeeye di.
Wa laakin fi l-yoom al-saabi',humman gaalo le marit Chamchuun-:-Khuchchi raajilki le yi'ooriina ma'ana al-hijjeeye di.Kan ma khachcheetiih,aniina niharruguuki inti wa aayilat abuuki.Walla intu azamtuuna le tanhaboona-?
Wa be da,marit Chamchuun bakat katiir wa gaalat leyah-:-Inta kirihtini wa abadan ma tihibbini.Al-hijjeeye al-inta gultaha le subyaan cha'abi kula inta ma ooreetni ma'anaatha. Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Ana le abuuyi wa ammi kula ma ooreethum wa leeki inti bas ni'ooriiki walla-?
Wa fi muddit sab'a yoom hana l-aazuuma,hi daayman tabki.Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi',hu gaal leeha al-ma'ana achaan hi ta''abatah.Wa khalaas,hi machat kallamat ma'ana al-hijjeeye di le subyaan cha'abha.
Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' gubbaal al-harraay ma taga',naas al-madiina gaalo leyah-:-Chunu al-halu min al-asalwa chunu al-gawi min al-duud-?-Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan ma harattu ma'a ijilti,ma tihillu hijjeeyti.
Wa khalaas,Ruuh Allah nazal foogah.Wa Chamchuun macha madiinat Achgaluun wa katal min sukkaanha 30 raajil wa chaal khulgaanhum wa antaahum le l-naas al-hallo al-hijjeeye.Wa zi'il chadiid wa gabbal le beet abuuh.
Wa marit Chamchuun kamaan,antooha le sabi al-bigi waziirah.
Wa ba'ad ayyaam fi wakit gati'iin al-gameh,Chamchuun saafar macha bakaan martah.Wa wadda ma'aayah sakhal wa gaal-:-Nidoor nadkhul fi khurfit marti. Wa laakin abu martah ma antaah izin le yadkhul.
Wa gaal le Chamchuun-:-Ana hasabt inta abeetha wa ana anteetha le waziirak.Wa akhutha tariiditha ma samhe minha walla-?Khalaas chiilha fi badalha.
Wa Chamchuun gaal-:-Hassa' da,kan nisawwi cheyy fasil fi l-Filistiyiin kula,ma yagdaro yuluumuuni-!
Wa macha karab 300 ba'aachiim wa kulli ba'aachiim itneen rabat dunubbaahum sawa.Wa khatta ambeenaat al-dunubba al-itneen dool kaniite.
Wa ba'ad da,hu gabbad al-kaniite wa talag al-ba'aachiim fi ziraa'at al-Filistiyiin.Wa be da,hu harrag ganaadiil al-gameh al-waagif foog wa rubat al-gameh al-magtuu'.Wa hatta jineenaat al-inab wa l-zaytuun kula hirgo.
Wa l-Filistiyiin gaalo-:-Yaatu al-sawwa al-cheyy da-? Wa gaalo leehum-:-Da Chamchuun nasiib al-raajil al-min hillit Timna achaan hu da,chaal martah wa antaaha le waziirah. Wa khalaas,al-Filistiyiin macho harrago al-mara di wa abuuha.
Wa Chamchuun gaal leehum-:-Hatta kan sawweetu al-cheyy da kula,ana ma nagiif lahaddi nichiil taari foogku.
Khalaas,hu hajamaahum wa hazamaahum haziime kabiire.Wa ba'ad da,macha dakhal fi karkuur hajar Itaam wa ga'ad foogah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-Filistiyiin gammo khatto mu'askarhum fi turaab Yahuuza wa hajamo Laahi.
Wa rujaal Yahuuza gaalo leehum-:-Maala gammeetu diddina-? Wa l-Filistiyiin gaalo-:-Aniina gammeena achaan nakurbu Chamchuun wa nisawwu foogah misil hu sawwa foogna.
Wa khalaas,3-000 raajil min Yahuuza gammo macho le l-karkuur hana hajar Itaam.Wa gaalo le Chamchuun-:-Inta ma ta'arif kadar aniina gaa'idiin tihit hukum al-Filistiyiin walla-?Wa chunu al-inta sawweetah da-? Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Ana sawweet fooghum misil humman sawwo foogi.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Aniina jiina le nakurbuuk wa nisallumuuk le l-Filistiyiin. Wa Chamchuun gaal leehum-:-Ahalfu leyi kadar intu ke ma taktuluuni.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-La,aniina nidooru nakurbuuk wa nisallumuuk leehum bas laakin ma naktuluuk. Khalaas,humman rabbatooh be hubaal judaad itneen wa maragooh min al-karkuur.
Wa wakit ja gariib le Laahi,al-Filistiyiin marago laagooh be korooraak hana harib.Laakin Ruuh Allah nazal foogah wa l-hubaal al-raabtiin beehum iideenah bigo misil al-janaago al-haragathum al-naar wa daffago min iideenah.
Wa tawwaali,hu ligi saalfe hint humaar maat gariib waag'e wa chaalha wa katal beeha 1-000 raajil.
Wa Chamchuun gaal-:-Be saalfit humaar,ana hazamtuhum-!Be saalfit humaar bas,ana katalt 1-000 raajil.
Wa min kammal kalaamah bas,hu zagal minnah al-saalfe.Wa sammo al-bakaan da Raamat Laahi (ma'anaatah jabal al-Saalfe).
Wa hu atchaan ziyaada wa sa'al Allah wa gaal-:-Inta bas al-jibt al-nasur al-kabiir da be iid ana abdak.Wa hassa',hal ana numuut min al-atach wa naga' fi iideen al-naas al-ma mutahhariin walla-?
Wa l-Rabb chagga al-jabal al-fi Laahi wa almi jara minnah.Wa Chamchuun chirib wa battaan bigi chadiid wa hiyi.Wa be sabab da,een almi al-gaa'ide lahaddi l-yoom fi Laahi sammooha Een Khuuri (ma'anaatah een hana l-naadum al-yas'al Allah).
Wa fi wakit al-Filistiyiin,Chamchuun hakam fi balad Israa'iil 20 sana.
Yoom waahid,Chamchuun macha madiinat Khazza wa hinaak hu chaaf mara charmuuta wa macha ragad fi beetha.
Wa gaalo le sukkaan Khazza-:-Chamchuun ja hini. Khalaas humman hawwago al-madiina wa karaso jamb baab al-madiina tuul al-leel.Wa ma harrako min bakaanhum tuul al-leel achaan gaalo-:-Khalli narjo nuur al-fajur wa naktuluuh.
Wa laakin Chamchuun ragad lahaddi ust al-leel.Wa fi ust al-leel,gamma macha marrag biibaan al-madiina wa maraadiishum wa chaalaahum fi kataafeeh wa waddaahum lahaddi raas al-hajar al-mugaabil Hibruun.
Wa ba'ad da,Chamchuun dawwar mara waahide usumha Daliila al-gaa'ide ale waadi Suurikh.
Wa kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin macho le l-mara di wa gaalo leeha-:-Khuchchiih wa as'aleeh min ween yaji sirr gudurtah al-kabiire di.Fattichi kikkeef nagdaro foogah wa nirabbutuuh.Wa ayyi waahid minnina yantiiki 1-100 hajar fudda.
Wa Daliila gaalat le Chamchuun-:-Ooriini min ween ligiit sirr gudurtak al-kabiire di wa be chunu yarbutuuk wa gudurtak al-kabiire di tabga ma fiiha.
Wa Chamchuun gaal leeha-:-Kan rabbatooni be sab'a hubaal hana nubbaal neyyiin ma muyabbasiin,khalaas gudurti tabga ma fiiha wa nabga misil kulla l-naas.
Wa kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin jaabo le Daliila sab'a hubaal hana nubbaal neyyiin ma muyabbasiin wa hi rabbatatah be l-hubaal dool.
Wa naas waahidiin allabbado fi khurfitha wa l-mara koorakat wa gaalat-:-Chamchuun,al-Filistiyiin hajamook-! Wa khalaas,Chamchuun gata' al-hubaal dool misil gata'oohum be naar.Wa laakin ma ligo al-sirr hana gudurtah.
Wa Daliila gaalat le Chamchuun-:-Inta khachcheetni wa gult leyi kalaam kidib.Wa hassa',ooriini be chunu yirabbutuuk-?
Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Kan rabbatooni gawi be hubaal judaad al-yoom waahid ma sawwo beehum khidme,khalaas gudurti tabga ma fiiha wa nabga misil kulla l-naas.
Wa khalaas,Daliila chaalat hubaal judaad wa rabbatatah wa gaalat-:-Chamchuun,al-Filistiyiin hajamook-! Wa fi l-wakit daak,naas waahidiin mullabbidiin fi l-khurfa wa laakin Chamchuun gata' al-hubaal al-marbuut beehum misil al-kheet.
Wa Daliila gaalat le Chamchuun-:-Hassa' kula inta khachcheetni wa gult leyi kalaam kidib.Ooriini be chunu yirabbutuuk-? Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Kan machatti sab'a cha'ar fi raasi be khuyuut hana gabag wa rabattiihum fi mutraara,khalaas gudurti tabga ma fiiha wa nabga misil kulla l-naas.
Wa khalaas,hi nawwamatah wa machatat sab'a cha'ar fi raasah be khuyuut hana gabag wa rabatatah fi witid wa gaalat-:-Chamchuun,al-Filistiyiin hajamook-! Fi l-bakaan da,Chamchuun wi'i min noomah wa marag al-mutraara al-marbuut foogha al-cha'ar al-madfuur be khuyuut al-gabag.
Wa Daliila gaalat-:-Kikkeef tagdar tuguul leyi-:--Ana nihibbiki-!- Galbak ma ma'aayi-!Wa daahu talaata marraat,inta khachcheetni wa abeet ma ooreetni sirr gudurtak al-kabiire di.
Wa hi gaa'ide tibachtinah kulla yoom le Chamchuun lahaddi hu iyi min bachtanatha.
Wa khalaas,ooraaha sirrah min daakhal galbah wa gaal-:-Ana raasi yoom waahid ma zayyanooh achaan ana mukhassas le l-Rabb min ana fi batun ammi.Kan zayyanooni,gudurti tabga ma fiiha marra waahid wa nabga misil kulla l-naas.
Wa wakit Daliila irfat kadar hu ooraaha sirrah min daakhal galbah,hi rassalat le kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin wa gaalat leehum-:-Al-yoom kula ta'aalu achaan hu ooraani sirrah min daakhal galbah. Wa kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin jo fi bakaanha chaayliin ma'aahum al-fudda al-hajjooha leeha.
Hi nawwamat Chamchuun fi rijilha wa naadat naadum waahid zayyan al-sab'a cha'ar al-mamchuut fi raasah.Khalaas fi l-bakaan da,hi gidrat foogah wa gudurtah kula bigat ma fiiha.
Wa Daliila gaalat leyah-:-Chamchuun,al-Filistiyiin hajamook-! Tawwaali,hu wi'i min noomah wa fakkar wa gaal-:-Namrug minhum misil awwal wa ninbalis. Wa laakin hu ma irif kadar Allah ba''adah minnah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-Filistiyiin karabooh wa gaddado uyuunah.Wa humman chaalooh wa waddooh fi Khazza.Wa rabbatooh be guyuud hana nahaas wa jabarooh yarhak gameh fi lubb al-sijin.
Wa laakin ba'ad zayyanooh,battaan suuf raasah bada yugumm.
Yoom waahid,kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin lammo wa gaddamo dahiiye kabiire le ilaahhum Daguun.Wa gaa'idiin yafraho wa yuguulu-:-Ilaahna sallam leena aduuna Chamchuun fi iideenna-!
Wa wakit al-cha'ab chaafo Chamchuun,chakaro ilaahhum wa gaalo-:-Ilaahna sallam leena aduuna fi iideenna-!Hu bas al-kharab baladna wa kattar maytiinna.
Wa laakin wakit firho ziyaada,gaalo-:-Naadu leena Chamchuun le yidahhikna. Wa humman jaabooh min al-sijin wa jabarooh yal'ab giddaamhum.Wa humman waggafooh ambeen amad beet al-ibaada da.
Wa Chamchuun gaal le l-sabi al-karabah min iidah-:-Guudni wa khalliini nalmas al-amad hana beet al-ibaada achaan nirrakkaz fooghum.
Wa beet al-ibaada da malaan be rujaal wa awiin wa kulla kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin kula gaa'idiin.Wa battaan fi raas al-beet,hawaale 3-000 rujaal wa awiin gaa'idiin yichiifu Chamchuun al-gaa'id yal'ab.
Wa Chamchuun naada Allah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Rabbi,fakkir foogi wa gaddirni aakhir marra le nichiil al-taar fi l-Filistiyiin fi chaan gaddado uyuuni.
Wa Chamchuun karab al-amad al-itneen al-ust al-bano fooghum beet al-ibaada wa arrakkaz fooghum iidah al-zeene fi amuud wa l-isra kula fi l-amuud al-aakhar.
Wa gaal-:-Khalli numuut ma'a l-Filistiyiin-! Wa be gudra lazza al-amad al-itneen wa khalaas beet al-ibaada waga' fi l-kubaaraat wa kulla l-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin foogah.Wa l-naas al-katalaahum ma'aayah fi wakit mootah aktar min al-naas al-katalaahum wakit hu hayy.
Wa khalaas akhwaanah wa kulla aayilat abuuh jo chaalo janaaztah wa waddooh dafanooh ambeen hillaal Saar'a wa Achtawuul fi khabur abuuh Manuuh.Wa Chamchuun hakam fi Israa'iil 20 sana.
Fiyah raajil waahid min jibaal Afraayim usmah Miika.
Wa l-raajil da gaal le ammah-:-Ana simi'tiki tal'ane al-naadum al-sirig minki 1-100 hajar fudda.Al-fudda di fi bakaani.Ana bas chiltaha. Wa ammah gaalat leyah-:-Allah yibaarikak,ya wileedi.
Wa hu gabbal al-alif wa miya hajar fudda le ammah wa laakin hi gaalat leyah-:-Ana khassast al-fudda di le Allah wa nantiiha leek inta wileedi achaan tasna' beeha sanam wa timsaal hana hadiid.Wa daahu ana nigabbilha leek.
Wa misil da,wakit hu gabbal al-fudda le ammah,hi chaalat 200 hajar fudda wa antathum le l-haddaadi.Wa hu sana' beeha sanam wa timsaal hana hadiid wa khattoohum fi beet Miika.
Wa Miika indah beet hana ilaahah.Hu sana' farmala hana raajil al-diin wa tamaasiil wa darraj waahid min awlaadah le yabga leyah raajil diin.
Wa fi l-wakit da,ma fi malik fi Israa'iil wa ayyi naadum bisawwi cheyy al-hu bidoorah.
Wa fiyah sabi waahid Laawi al-saakin fi Beet Laham fi turaab gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa yoom waahid,al-naadum da gamma macha min Beet Laham fi turaab Yahuuza le yifattich bakaan aakhar yaskun foogah.Wa wakit ja fi jibaal Afraayim,sudfa fi derbah hu ligi beet Miika.
Wa Miika gaal leyah-:-Inta jaayi min ween-? Wa hu gaal leyah-:-Ana Laawi min Beet Laham fi turaab Yahuuza wa maachi nifattich bakaan naskun foogah.
Wa khalaas,Miika gaal leyah-:-Agood ma'aayi wa abga leyi abu wa raajil diin.Wa ana nantiik achara hajar fudda fi ayyi sana wa khulgaan wa akil. Wa l-Laawi dakhal beetah.
Wa hu khassad yagood ma'a Miika wa hu ja'alah misil waahid min awlaadah.
Wa Miika darraj al-Laawi da raajil diin wa ga''adah ma'aayah fi beetah.
Wa Miika gaal-:-Hassa' da,ana na'arif kadar Allah yisawwi leyi al-kheer achaan al-Laawi da bigi leyi raajil diin.
Wa fi l-wakit da,ma fi malik fi Israa'iil.Wa gabiilat Daan gaa'ide tifattich turaab al-taskun foogah achaan hi lissaa' ma ligat ard warasa ambeen gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa min hillaalhum Saar'a wa Achtawuul,naas gabiilat Daan rassalo rujaal khamsa fahaliin min gabiilithum achaan yamchu yuruukhu wa yichiifu al-balad.Wa gaalo leehum-:-Amchu chiifu al-balad. Wa l-rujaal al-khamsa wassalo fi jibaal Afraayim wa ligo beet Miika wa naamo foogah.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin jamb beet Miika,humman irfo al-lahja al-hajja beeha al-sabi al-Laawi.Wa garrabo leyah wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Yaatu al-jaabak hini-?Gaa'id tisawwi chunu fi l-bakaan da-?Wa chunu al-ga''adaak hini-?
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Miika sawwa leyi misil da wa hu ajjaraani wa ana bigiit leyah raajil diin.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-As'al leena al-Rabb achaan na'arfu kan makhatarna da yanjah walla la.
Wa raajil al-diin gaal leehum-:-Amchu be l-salaam fi makhatarku.Allah ma'aaku.
Wa l-rujaal al-khamsa macho giddaam wa wassalo hillit Layich.Wa chaafo kadar sukkaanha haadiyiin wa aaychiin fi raaha wa amaan hasab aadit al-Seeduuniyiin.Wa fi l-balad di,ma fi naadum yibarjilhum walla yazlumhum.Wa sukkaan Layich ba'iidiin min al-Seeduuniyiin wa ma induhum naas al-yahfadoohum.
Wakit al-rujaal al-khamsa gabbalo le akhwaanhum fi Saar'a wa Achtawuul,akhwaanhum gaalo leehum-:-Chunu al-khabar-?
Wa humman raddo leehum wa gaalo-:-Yalla-!Nugummu didduhum achaan aniina chifna al-balad wa hi samha marra waahid.Ma tagoodu saakit-!Yalla-!Gummu amchu le l-balad di le tichiiluuha.
Wa wakit tiwassulu fi l-balad di,talgo cha'ab gaa'idiin be amaan wa kulla l-balad wasii'e giddaamku achaan al-Rabb sallamaaha leeku fi iideeku.Wa cheyy mugassir fi l-balad di ke ma fiih.
Wa khalaas min gabiilat Daan,600 rujaal musallahiin gammo min Saar'a wa Achtawuul wa macho.
Wa humman macho nazalo fi Kharyat Ya'ariim fi turaab Yahuuza.Achaan da,lahaddi l-yoom yinaadu al-bakaan da Mahana Daan (ma'anaatah fariig Daan).Wa l-bakaan da gaa'id kharib le Kharyat Ya'ariim.
Wa min al-bakaan da,macho le jibaal Afraayim wa ligo beet Miika.
Wa l-rujaal al-khamsa al-macho raakho hillit Layich gaalo le akhwaanhum-:-Hal ta'arfu kadar fi l-buyuut dool fi farmala hana raajil al-diin wa tamaasiil wa sanam wa timsaal hana hadiid walla-?Wa hassa' da,fakkuru fi l-cheyy al-waajib tisawwuuh.
Wa jo dakhalo fi beet al-sabi al-Laawi al-gaa'id ma'a Miika wa sallamooh.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-suttumiya rujaal musallahiin al-min naas gabiilat Daan waagfiin fi khachum al-baab.
Wa l-rujaal al-khamsa al-macho raakho al-balad dakhalo wa chaalo al-sanam wa l-farmala wa l-tamaasiil wa timsaal hana l-hadiid.Wa fi l-wakit da,raajil al-diin wa l-suttumiya rujaal musallahiin waagfiin fi khachum al-baab.
Wa wakit al-rujaal dool dakhalo fi beet Miika wa chaalo al-sanam wa l-farmala wa l-tamaasiil wa l-timsaal hana l-hadiid,raajil al-diin gaal leehum-:-Tisawwuuh chunu-?
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Askut wa khutt iidak fi khachmak-!Ta'aal ma'aana wa abga leena abu wa raajil diin.Da akheer leek tabga raajil diin le aayila hana raajil waahid bas aw le gabiila tamaama fi Israa'iil-?
Wa khalaas,raajil al-diin galbah firih wa chaal al-farmala wa l-tamaasiil wa l-sanam wa macha ma'a l-rujaal al-musallahiin.
Wa khalaas,gammo maachiin wa khatto giddaamhum al-iyaal wa l-bahaayim wa l-khumaam.
Wa wakit ba''ado min beet Miika,al-rujaal al-saakniin jamb beet Miika lammo wa gammo didd naas gabiilat Daan wa macho waraahum.
Wa l-rujaal dool gaa'idiin yi'iitu foog naas gabiilat Daan.Wa naas gabiilat Daan gabbalo le Miika wa gaalo leyah-:-Maala gawwamt al-rujaal dool diddina-?
Wa Miika gaal-:-Al-ilaahaat al-ana sawweethum,intu chiltuuhum-!Wa raajil al-diin kula chiltuuh wa macheetu beyah.Battaan faddal leyi chunu-?Wa kikkeef tuguulu leyi-:--Inta maalak-?-
Wa naas gabiilat Daan raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ma ti'ayyiina be kalaamak.Wa kan abeet kamaan,rujaal galibhum murr yahjumuuk wa inta tijiib al-moot fi nafsak wa fi aayiltak-!
Wa khalaas,naas gabiilat Daan chaalo deribhum wa macho.Wa wakit Miika chaaf humman induhum gudra ziyaada minnah,hu gabbal beetah.
Wa naas gabiilat Daan chaalo al-khumaam al-Miika sana'aahum wa raajil al-diin al-khadam leyah wa macho fi Layich.Wa sukkaanha al-gaa'idiin fi raaha wa amaan,kataloohum be l-seef wa harrago al-madiina.
Wa ma fi naadum al-yinajjiihum achaan al-hille ba'iide min Seeda wa ma induhum alaakha ma'a naas aakhariin kula.Hi gaa'ide fi l-waadi hana Beet Rahuub.Wa naas gabiilat Daan bano al-hille di battaan wa ga'ado foogha.
Wa sammo al-hille be usum jidduhum Daan wileed Yaakhuub wa laakin al-hille di zamaan binaaduuha Layich.
Wa naas gabiilat Daan khatto leehum sanam Miika.Wa Yuunataan wileed Girchuum wileed Muusa wa iyaalah bigo rujaal diin le naas gabiilat Daan lahaddi chaaloohum wa waddoohum fi l-khurba.
Wa l-sanam al-sana'ah Miika gaa'id fi bakaanah fi kulla l-mudda al-gaa'id foogha beet Allah fi Chiilooh.
Wa fi l-wakit da,ma fi malik fi Israa'iil.Wa fiyah raajil waahid Laawi saakin fi jibaal Afraayim wa akhad leyah mara sirriiye min Beet Laham fi turaab Yahuuza.
Wa l-sirriiye di alkhabbanat minnah wa machat beet abuuha fi Beet Laham fi turaab Yahuuza wa ga'adat hinaak le muddit arba'a chahar.
Wa l-raajil macha waraaha achaan yiraddiiha wa yijiibha.Wa hu chaal ma'aayah khaddaamah wa hamiir itneen.Wa l-sirriiye di faddalat raajilha fi beet abuuha wa wakit abuuha chaafah,gamma laagaah be farah.
Wa abu al-mara di dayyaf nasiibah wa fi muddit talaata yoom,al-Laawi wa khaddaamah yaakulu wa yacharbo wa yunuumu fi l-bakaan da.
Wa fi l-yoom al-raabi',al-Laawi gamma be fajur badri wa jahhaz khumaamah le l-safar.Wa abu martah gaal leyah-:-Agiif,aakul leek akil chiyya wa ba'ad da,amchu.
Khalaas,humman al-itneen ga'ado wa akalo wa chirbo sawa.Wa abu al-mara gaal le nasiibah-:-Min fadlak,khassid al-leele kula,nuum ma'aana wa anjamma.
Al-Laawi gamma yidoor yamchi wa laakin fi chaan talab nasiibah,hu naam al-leele di.
Wa fi l-yoom al-khaamis,al-Laawi gamma be fajur badri le yisaafir.Wa laakin abu martah gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak,anjamma wa akhkhir safarak da lahaddi ba'ad al-duhur. Wa humman al-itneen akalo sawa.
Wa ba'ad da,al-raajil gamma yidoor yamchi hu wa sirriiytah wa khaddaamah.Wa laakin abu martah gaal leyah-:-Ana nichiif al-wata di bigat achiiye wa l-harraay kula gariib taga',khalaas al-leele di kula nuum hini wa anjamma.Wa ambaakir fajur kamaan,saafuru gabbulu beetku.
Wa laakin fi l-marra di,al-Laawi aba ma yunuum.Wa gamma macha ma'a hamiirah al-itneen machduudiin wa sirriiytah lahaddi wassal mugaabil Yabuus ya'ni Uruchaliim.
Wa wakit wassalo gariib le Yabuus,al-makhrib garrabat.Wa l-khaddaam gaal le siidah-:-Khalli nidallu fi madiinat al-Yabuusiyiin di wa nunuumu foogha.
Wa siidah gaal leyah-:-Ma nidallu fi madiina ajnabiiye al-sukkaanha ma min Bani Israa'iil.Khalli namchu giddaam lahaddi Gibee'a.
Wa gaal battaan le khaddaamah-:-Yalla namchu ale hillaal Gibee'a aw al-Raama wa nunuumu fi waahide minhum.
Wa macho giddaam wa fi wakit al-makhrib,wassalo gariib le hillit Gibee'a fi turaab Banyaamiin.
Wa dallo fi Gibee'a le yunuumu foogha.Wa dakhalo al-hille wa ga'ado fi naga'a fi usutha wa laakin naadum waahid kula ma faddalaahum fi beetah le yunuumu ma'aayah.
Wa khalaas,humman chaafo chaayib waahid jaayi min al-ziraa'a be makhrib.Wa l-chaayib da min jibaal Afraayim wa aayich fi Gibee'a fi turaab Banyaamiin.
Wa wakit al-chaayib rafa' raasah,chaaf al-raajil al-musaafir fi naga'at al-hille wa gaal-:-Jaayi min ween wa maachi ween-?
Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aniina jaayiin min Beet Laham fi turaab Yahuuza wa maachiin lahaddi lubb jibaal Afraayim achaan ana naskun hinaak.Ana macheet Beet Laham wa hassa',mugabbil le beet Allah fi bakaani.Wa laakin naadum faddalaani fi beetah ke ma fiih.
Indina gechch wa alfa le hamiirna wa khubza wa khamar leyi ana wa sirriiyti wa l-khaddaam al-ma'aana.Wa cheyy gassar leena ke ma fiih.
Wa l-chaayib radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-salaam aleekum-!Akiid kulla cheyy al-tidoorah ana nichiil mas'uuliiytah wa laakin ma tunuum fi l-naga'a di.
Wa hu waddaahum beetah wa anta al-hamiir alfa.Wa l-diifaan khassalo rijleehum wa akalo wa chirbo.
Wa wakit humman gaa'idiin yinjammo,tawwaali rujaal waahidiin ma naaf'iin min al-hille jo hawwago al-beet.Wa taggo al-baab be chidde wa gaalo le l-chaayib siid al-beet-:-Amrug leena al-naadum al-dakhal fi beetak da achaan narugdu ma'aayah.
Wa siid al-beet marag wa gaal leehum-:-La,ya akhwaani,ma tisawwu al-fasil da-!Al-raajil da deef fi beeti wa khalaas ma tisawwu leyah al-fi'il al-cheen da-!
Wa di hi bineeyti udriiye wa sirriiyit al-raajil da.Namrughin leeku le tisawwu fooghin kulla cheyy al-tidooruuh.Wa laakin le l-raajil da,ma tisawwu leyah fi'il cheen misil da.
Wa l-rujaal dool abo ma yasma'o kalaam al-chaayib.Wa khalaas,al-Laawi karab sirriiytah wa maragaaha leehum barra.Wa humman chaalooha wa ragado ma'aaha be gu tuul al-leel lahaddi fajur.Wa gariib sabaah bas,humman khallooha.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-mara jaat waga'at fi khachum baab al-chaayib al-raajilha gaa'id fi bakaanah wa ragadat fi bakaanha da lahaddi al-harraay tala'at.
Wa be fajur badri,wakit raajilha fatah al-baab le yisaafir,hu ligi sirriiytah waag'e fi khachum al-baab be iideenha fi l-ataba.
Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Yalla gummi namchu. Wa laakin hi ma raddat leyah.Khalaas,hu chadda janaazitha fi l-humaar wa macha lahaddi wassal bakaanah.
Wakit wassal beetah,chaal sakkiin wa gatta' janaazit sirriiytah ale 12 koom wa rassalhum le ayyi gabiila fi balad Israa'iil.
Wa l-Laawi gaal le murassaliinah-:-Guulu le kulla Bani Israa'iil-:--Min maragna min balad Masir lahaddi l-yoom,hal cheyy misil da bigi walla-?Fakkuru wa achchaawaro ambeenaatku wa kallumu be raayku-!-- Wa ayyi naadum al-chaaf al-cheyy da gaal-:-Min Bani Israa'iil marago min balad Masir lahaddi l-yoom da,cheyy misil da ma bigi.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil marago min Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati wa lahaddi turaab Gil'aad wa lammo be galib waahid giddaam Allah fi hillit Misfa.
Wa kubaaraat al-cha'ab hana kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil hidro fi malammat cha'ab al-Rabb.Wa adadhum 400-000 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf.
Wa naas gabiilat Banyaamiin sim'o kadar Bani Israa'iil jo fi Misfa.Wa Bani Israa'iil gaalo-:-Ooruuna kikkeef al-fasaala di bigat.
Wa l-Laawi raajil al-mara al-katalooha gaal-:-Ana wa sirriiyti wassalna fi Gibee'a fi turaab Banyaamiin le nunuumu foogha.
Wa sukkaan Gibee'a gammo diddi wa be l-leel,hawwago al-beet al-ana dalleet foogah wa dawwaro yaktuluuni.Wa chaalo sirriiyti wa ragado ma'aaha be gu lahaddi maatat.
Wa ana chilt janaazit sirriiyti wa gatta'taha wa rassaltaha fi kulla ard warasa hana Bani Israa'iil achaan al-naas dool sawwo fasaala wa fi'il cheen fi Bani Israa'iil.
Daahu intu kulluku,ya Bani Israa'iil,hajju wa achchaawaro ambeenaatku hini bas wa antuuna raayku.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab gammo be galib waahid wa gaalo-:-Naadum minnina waahid kula ma yigabbil le kheemtah wa la le beetah.
Wa hassa' daahu al-cheyy al-nisawwuuh le Gibee'a.Nisawwu am'iyeedaat wa nugummu diddaha.
Wa nichiilu rujaal min kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.Min al-miya,nichiilu 10 wa min al-alif,nichiilu 100 wa min al-achara alif nichiilu 1-000.Wa l-naas dool yijiibu akil le l-rujaal al-yamchu yahjumu Gibee'a hana Banyaamiin le yisawwu fooghum hasab fi'ilhum al-cheen al-sawwooh fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil gammo be galib waahid didd al-hille di.
Wa gabaayil Bani Israa'iil rassalo rujaal le gabiilat Banyaamiin le yas'aloohum wa yuguulu leehum-:-Chunu al-fasaala al-bigat fi bakaanku di-?
Wa hassa' da,sallumuuna al-naas al-ma naaf'iin hana Gibee'a le naktuluuhum wa namurgu al-fasaala min Israa'iil-!-Wa laakin naas gabiilat Banyaamiin abo ma yasma'o kalaam akhwaanhum Bani Israa'iil.
Wa naas gabiilat Banyaamiin jo min hillaalhum wa lammo fi Gibee'a achaan yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-yoom da,naas gabiilat Banyaamiin al-jo min al-hillaal,hasaboohum wa adadhum bigi 26-000 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf.Wa da,bala sukkaan Gibee'a al-adadhum 700 raajil min ahsan al-muhaaribiin.
Wa min kulla l-rujaal dool fiyah 700 rujaal israayiin min ahsan al-muhaaribiin.Al-waahid minhum be hajar miglaa'ah yagdar yagta' al-kheet.
Wa Bani Israa'iil kula hasabo nufuushum bala naas gabiilat Banyaamiin wa adadhum bigi 400-000 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf wa kulluhum muhaaribiin.
Wa Bani Israa'iil macho Beet Iil wa sa'alo al-Rabb wa gaalo-:-Yaatu minnina yamchi awwal le muhaarabat naas gabiilat Banyaamiin-? Wa Allah gaal leehum-:-Naas gabiilat Yahuuza bas yamchu awwal.
Wa khalaas,Bani Israa'iil gammo be fajur badri wa macho nazalo jamb Gibee'a.
Wa gammo le yihaarubu Banyaamiin wa rasso le l-harib mugaabiliin Gibee'a.
Wa naas gabiilat Banyaamiin marago min Gibee'a le yihaarubuuhum.Wa fi l-yoom da,katalo 22-000 raajil min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa rujaal Israa'iil chaddo heelhum wa battaan rasso le l-harib fi bakaanhum al-awwal yoom rasso foogah.
Wa Bani Israa'iil macho bako giddaam Allah lahaddi l-achiiye wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Battaan namchu nihaarubu didd akhwaanna naas gabiilat Banyaamiin walla-? Wa Allah radda leehum wa gaal-:-Gummu didduhum.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taani,Bani Israa'iil garrabo le naas gabiilat Banyaamiin
wa naas gabiilat Banyaamiin marago min Gibee'a le yigaabuluuhum.Wa fi l-yoom da,katalo 18-000 raajil min Bani Israa'iil,kulluhum askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf.
Wa khalaas,kulla cha'ab Bani Israa'iil macho Beet Iil wa ga'ado tihit wa bako le Allah.Wa l-yoom da,saamo lahaddi l-achiiye wa gaddamo dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama le Allah.
Bani Israa'iil sa'alo Allah achaan fi l-wakit daak,sanduug mu'aahadat al-Rabb gaa'id fi Beet Iil.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,Fiinhaas wileed Ali'aazar wileed Haaruun gaa'id giddaam al-sanduug da.Wa hu gaal-:-Battaan namchu nihaarubu didd akhwaanna naas gabiilat Banyaamiin walla la-? Wa Allah radda leehum wa gaal-:-Amchu,achaan ambaakir ana nisallimhum leeku.
Wa khalaas,Bani Israa'iil hawwago Gibee'a wa rabato kamiin.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,Bani Israa'iil gammo didd Banyaamiin wa rasso mugaabiliin Gibee'a misil fi l-marraat al-faato.
Wa iyaal Banyaamiin marago le yigaabulu rujaalhum wa macho ba'iid min al-hille.Wa gammo yaktulu rujaalhum misil fi l-marraat al-faato.Wa katalo min Bani Israa'iil hawaale 30 raajil fi l-derib al-maachi le Beet Iil wa fi l-derib hana l-kadaade al-maachi le Gibee'a.
Wa iyaal Banyaamiin gaalo-:-Daahu battaan hazamnaahum misil awwal-! Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil gaalo-:-Khalli ni'arrudu minhum wa namurguuhum ba'iid min al-hille fi l-duruub.
Wa kulluhum arrado lahaddi wislo Ba'al Taamaar wa hinaak,laffo wa rasso battaan le l-harib.Wa laakin rujaal Bani Israa'iil fi l-kamiin marago be sur'a min bakaanhum gariib le hillit Gaba'.
Wa 10-000 raajil min ahsan al-muhaaribiin hana Bani Israa'iil jo gaabalo Gibee'a wa l-harib da bigi chadiid.Wa laakin iyaal Banyaamiin ma irfo kadar al-masiibe taji fooghum.
Wa Allah hazam iyaal Banyaamiin giddaam Bani Israa'iil.Fi l-yoom da,Bani Israa'iil katalo 25-100 raajil,kulluhum askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf.
Wa ba'ad da,iyaal Banyaamiin irfo kadar humman anhazamo.Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil arrado giddaam naas Banyaamiin achaan humman antakalo ale l-kamiin al-humman rabatooh hawaale Gibee'a.
Wa be sur'a,naas al-kamiin gammo hajamo Gibee'a wa katalo kulla naas al-hille be l-seef.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil astafago ma'a naas al-kamiin achaan humman yisawwu alaama hana dukhkhaan fi l-hille.
Wa be da,Bani Israa'iil gabbalo battaan le l-harib wa iyaal Banyaamiin bado yaktulu minhum hawaale 30 raajil.Wa gaalo-:-Daahu battaan hazamnaahum misil awwal-!
Wa tawwaali,al-alaama hint al-dukhkhaan badat tatla' min al-hille.Wa wakit iyaal Banyaamiin anlafato,chaafo al-hille kullaha ke gammat naar wa dukhkhaanha tala' fi l-sama.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil gabbalo le l-harib.Wa rujaal Banyaamiin anbahato achaan humman irfo kadar al-masiibe khalaas jaat fooghum.
Wa humman arrado giddaam Bani Israa'iil wa jaro ale l-sahara.Wa laakin dakhalo ambeen al-rujaal al-gaa'idiin yitaaruduuhum wa l-rujaal al-marago min al-hille.Wa humman kataloohum marra waahid.
Wa Bani Israa'iil hajamoohum le iyaal Banyaamiin min kulli jiihe.Wa taaradoohum lahaddi sabaah min Gibee'a wa ma khalloohum yinjammo wa kataloohum hinaak.
Wa min iyaal Banyaamiin,18-000 rujaal fahaliin maato.
Wa aakhariin arrado ale l-sahara le hajar Rimmuun.Wa Bani Israa'iil katalo minhum 5-000 raajil fi l-duruub wa taaradoohum lahaddi Gid'uum wa katalo battaan minhum 2-000 raajil.
Wa be l-jumla,adad iyaal Banyaamiin al-maato fi l-yoom da 25-000 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf.
Wa 600 rujaal kamaan arrado ale l-sahara le hajar Rimmuun wa ga'ado fi l-hajar da arba'a chahar.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gabbalo didd iyaal Banyaamiin wa katalo kulla sukkaan hillaalhum be l-seef lahaddi bahaayimhum wa dammaro kulla cheyy al-ligooh.Wa ziyaada min da,tachcho kulla l-hillaal al-fi deribhum.
Wakit Bani Israa'iil lammo fi Misfa,humman halafo wa gaalo-:-Khalli ayyi naadum minnina ma yijawwiz bittah le raajil min gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa ba'ad al-harib da,al-cha'ab jo fi Beet Iil wa ga'ado giddaam al-Rabb lahaddi l-achiiye.Wa humman bako ziyaada wa dumuu'hum kula daffago katiir.
Wa gaalo-:-Ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,maala al-yoom waahide min gabaayil Bani Israa'iil bigat ma fiiha-?
Wa ambaakir,al-cha'ab bakkaro wa bano madbah fi l-bakaan da wa gaddamo foogah dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gaalo-:-Yaatu min kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil ma hidir fi l-malamma fi Misfa giddaam Allah-? Achaan fi l-yoom da fi Misfa,humman halafo le yaktulu ayyi naadum al-ma hidir fi l-malamma giddaam Allah.
Wa hassa' Bani Israa'iil nidmo fi chaan akhwaanhum naas gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa gaalo-:-Al-yoom gabiila waahide anfasalat min Israa'iil.
Wa kikkeef nisawwu le nijawwuzu awiin le l-faddalo minhum achaan awwal aniina halafna be Allah wa gulna ma nijawwuzuuhum banaatna-?
Wa battaan gaalo-:-Hal fiyah naas min gabaayil Israa'iil al-ma hidro giddaam Allah fi Misfa walla-? Wa khalaas,humman azzakkaro kadar naas Yaabiich fi turaab Gil'aad ma jo fi l-mu'askar le l-malamma al-yoom daak.
Achaan wakit al-cha'ab lammo le l-hasaaba,naadum waahid kula min sukkaan Yaabiich Gil'aad ma hidir.
Wa khalaas,humman rassalo 12-000 raajil min al-muhaaribiin wa gaalo leehum-:-Amchu wa aktulu kulla sukkaan Yaabiich Gil'aad be l-seef hatta awiinhum wa iyaalhum kula aktuluuhum.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-tisawwuuh.Dammuru kulla l-dakar wa ayyi mara al-daakhle beet.
Wa min sukkaan Yaabiich Gil'aad,ligo 400 banaat udriiyaat al-ma dakhalan beet wa humman chaaloohin wa jaaboohin fi l-mu'askar fi Chiilooh fi turaab Kan'aan.
Wa kulla l-mujtama' rassalo naas le gabiilat Banyaamiin fi hajar Rimmuun achaan yisawwu salaam.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-rujaal al-faddalo min gabiilat Banyaamiin gabbalo fi bakaanaathum.Wa Bani Israa'iil antoohum al-banaat al-jaaboohin hayyaat min Yaabiich Gil'aad.Wa laakin adad al-banaat ma tamma wa rujaal waahidiin ma ligo awiin.
Wa l-cha'ab nidmo fi chaan naas gabiilat Banyaamiin achaan Allah khalla faraga hana gabiila waahide min gabaayil Israa'iil.
Wa kubaaraat al-mujtama' gaalo-:-Awiin Banyaamiin kammalo.Nisawwu chunu achaan al-rujaal al-faddalo kula yalgo awiin-?
Wa gaalo battaan-:-Khalli gabiilat Banyaamiin kula talga zurriiye achaan gabiila waahide ma tiwaddir min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa aniina zaatna ma nagdaro nantuuhum banaatna le yaakhuduuhin achaan aniina halafna wa gulna-:--Mal'uun al-yanti mara le iyaal Banyaamiin.-
Wa ba'ad da,gaalo-:-Kulli sana fiyah iid le Allah fi Chiilooh al-gaa'ide munchaakh le Beet Iil wa wati le Labuuna wa sabaah le l-derib al-yamchi min Beet Iil le Chakiim.
Wa amaro iyaal Banyaamiin wa gaalo leehum-:-Amchu allabbado fi jineenaat al-inab.
Wa kan chiftu banaat min Chiilooh maragan yal'aban sawa,khalaas intu amurgu fooghin min jineenaat al-inab.Wa khalli ayyi waahid minku yakrub leyah mara min banaat Chiilooh.Chiiluuhin wa amchu beehin fi turaab Banyaamiin.
Wa kan abbahaathin aw akhwaanhin yaju yachku leena,nuguulu leehum-:--Hinnu foogah akhwaanna min Banyaamiin achaan aniina ma ligiina leehum kulluhum awiin wakit haarabna Yaabiich Gil'aad.Wa intu kula ma anteetu leehum banaatku be raayku wa be da,haliifitku ma talhagku.-
Wa da bas al-cheyy al-iyaal Banyaamiin sawwooh.Humman chaalo min al-banaat al-la''aabaat hasab adadhum.Wa macho beehin fi ard warasathum wa bano hillaalhum battaan wa sakano fooghum.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Bani Israa'iil chatto.Ayyi waahid macha le gabiiltah wa le khachum beetah wa ga'ad fi ard warasatah.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,ma fi malik fi Israa'iil wa ayyi naadum bisawwi cheyy al-hu bidoorah.
Fi wakit al-hukkaam gubbaal Bani Israa'iil ma induhum malik,juu' chadiid ja fi balad Yahuuza wa fi chaan da,raajil waahid min hillit Beet Laham macha le balad Muwaab le yaskun hinaak.Wa l-raajil da macha ma'a martah wa awlaadah al-itneen.
Wa hu usmah Aliimalik wa martah usumha Na'iima wa awlaadah asaameehum Mahluun wa Kilyuun.Wa humman min khachum beet Afraata min hillit Beet Laham fi turaab Yahuuza.Wa humman macho le balad Muwaab wa sakano hinaak.
Wa Aliimalik maat wa martah Na'iima ga'adat wiheedha ma'a awlaadha al-itneen.
Wa awlaadha al-itneen akhado awiin min al-Muwaabiyiin,al-waahide usumha Urfa wa l-aakhara usumha Ra'uus.Wa humman sakano gariib achara sana min jayyithum min Beet Laham.
Wa ba'ad da,Mahluun wa Kilyuun maato wa khalaas ammuhum fagadat raajilha wa iyaalha.
Wa wakit Na'iima gaa'ide fi balad Muwaab,sim'at kadar Allah raham cha'abah wa antaahum intaaj sameh min ziraa'ithum.Wa khalaas,gammat jahhazat hi wa awiin awlaadha al-itneen le yamurgan min al-balad di.
Wa gamman min al-bakaan al-hinna sakanan foogah wa chaalan derib hana turaab Yahuuza.
Wa wakit maachaat fi l-derib,Na'iima gaalat le awiin awlaadha-:-Hassa' da,khalli ayyi waahide minkan tigabbil le beet ammaha.Wa khalli Allah yisawwi leekan al-kheer misil intan sawweetannah le l-maato wa leyi ana.
Wa khalli Allah yantiikan le ayyi waahide beet baarid bakaan raajilha-! Wa hi habbat kulli waahide minhin.Wa khalaas hinna bakan chadiid
wa gaalan le Na'iima-:-La,aniina namchu ma'aaki bakaan ahalki.
Laakin Na'iima gaalat-:-Gabbilan,ya banaati-!Maala tidooran tamchan ma'aayi-?Hal nalda awlaad al-battaan yabgo leekan rujaal walla-?
Gabbilan amchan,ya banaati,achaan ana bigiit ajuuz wa battaan ma naakhud raajil.Wa kan nuguul indi acham naakhud raajil fi l-leele di wa nalda awlaad kula
hal tagdaran tarjanhum lahaddi yakburu-?Taaban ma taakhudan rujaal aakhariin walla-?La,ya banaati-!Al-murr al-foogi ana da chadiid min hanaakan intan.Wa Allah bas nazzal al-ta'ab foogi.
Wa min sim'an al-kalaam da,gamman battaan bakan.Wa ba'ad da,Urfa habbat nasiibitha wa faatat.Laakin Ra'uus anrabatat ma'aaha.
Wa khalaas,Na'iima gaalat le Ra'uus-:-Chiifi,hamaatki gabbalat le ahalha wa le ilaahaatha.Inti kula gabbili ma'aaha.
Wa Ra'uus raddat le nasiibitha wa gaalat-:-Ma tajburiini le nikhalliikiwa nigabbil minki-!Fi ayyi bakaan al-tamchi,namchi ma'aakiwa fi ayyi bakaan al-taskuni,naskun ma'aaki.Ahalki yabgo ahaliwa Ilaahki yabga Ilaahi.
Al-bakaan al-tumuuti,ana kula numuut wa yadfunuuni.Kan cheyy aakhar bala l-moot bas faragaani minki da,khalli Allah yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid-!
Wakit Na'iima chaafat kadar Ra'uus indaha niiye le tamchi ma'aaha,sakatat khallatha battaan ma jabaratha le tigabbil.
Wa khalaas,machan tineenithin lahaddi Beet Laham.Wa wakit wassalan hinaak,kulla awiin al-hille ajjaban fooghin wa assaa'alan ambeenaathin wa gaalan-:-Di Na'iima walla-?
Wa Na'iima raddat leehin wa gaalat-:-Battaan ma tinaadanni Na'iima laakin naadanni Murra achaan Allah al-Gaadir marrar leyi hayaati.
Ana macheet min hini malaane wa Allah gabbalaani yaabse.Battaan maala tinaadanni Na'iima achaan Allah al-Gaadir ta''abaani wa nazzal foogi al-hizin.
Wa be misil da,Na'iima wa marit waladha Ra'uus al-Muwaabiiye gabbalan min balad Muwaab.Wa wassalan fi Beet Laham fi bidaayit gati' al-gameh al-abyad.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid usmah taali' wa hu min ahal Aliimalik,raajilha le Na'iima.Wa l-raajil da usmah Bu'aaz.
Wa Ra'uus al-Muwaabiiye gaalat le Na'iima-:-Khalliini namchi fi l-ziraa'a nikachchib kan siyaad al-ziraa'a yardo leyi. Wa Na'iima gaalat leeha-:-Amchi,ya bineeyti.
Wa khalaas,Ra'uus machat tilaggit wara l-lammaamiin wa be sudfa hi machat fi zere' hana Bu'aaz min ahal Aliimalik.
Wa ba'ad chiyya,Bu'aaz kula ja min Beet Laham wa gaal le l-lammaamiin-:-Allah ma'aaku-! Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Allah yibaarikak-!
Wa Bu'aaz gaal le khaddaamah al-wakkalah kabiir al-lammaamiin-:-Al-bitt di min ween-?
Wa kabiir al-lammaamiin gaal leyah-:-Di al-bineeye al-Muwaabiiye al-jaat ma'a Na'iima min balad Muwaab.
Hi jaat leyi wa sa'alat wa gaalat-:--Antuuni izin nikachchib wa nilimm kulla l-ganaadiil al-khalloohum al-lammaamiin waraahum.- Wa min al-fajur hi jaat wa gaa'ide takhdim lahaddi hassa' wa ma anjammat fi l-dull illa chiyya bas.
Wa ba'ad da,Bu'aaz gaal le Ra'uus-:-Asma'e,ya bineeyti.Ma tikhalli al-zere' da wa tamchi tilaggiti fi zere' aakhar.Akhdimi hini ma'a khaddaamaati.
Wa fakkiri fi l-bakaan al-gaa'idiin yagta'ooh wa amchi waraahin.Wa ana kallamt le l-khaddaamiin ma yilammusuuki.Wa kan atchaane kula,amchi acharbe min al-mawaa'iin al-humman maloohum.
Wa min sim'at kalaamah da,hi barakat giddaamah wa gaalat-:-Kikkeef ridiit beyi be ziyaada,ana al-khariibe,lahaddi tifakkir foogi misil da-?
Wa Bu'aaz radda leeha wa gaal-:-Ana simi't be kulla l-kheer al-inti sawweetiih le nasiibitki amm raajilki ba'ad hu maat.Wa na'arif inti khalleeti abuuki wa ammiki wa ardiki al-wildooki foogha wa jiiti le naas al-ma ta'arfiihum min awwal.
Wa Allah yantiiki ajur hana l-kheer al-inti sawweetiih.Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,al-jiiti le laja'ti tihit janaaheeh,hu bas yantiiki ajur kaamil-!
Wa Ra'uus gaalat-:-Inta ridiit leyi,ya sayyidi,wa chajja'tini be kalaamak al-halu.Wa laakin ana ma nisaawi waahide min khaddaamaatak.
Wa wakit jahhazo al-akil,Bu'aaz gaal le Ra'uus-:-Ta'aali hini aakuli.Chiili al-khubza di wa mallihiiha fi l-asiir al-haamud. Wa hi ga'adat jamb al-lammaamiin wa Bu'aaz antaaha fariiki wa akalat wa chib'at lahaddi faddalatah.
Wa ba'ad hi gammat tilaggit,Bu'aaz amar khaddaamiinah wa gaal-:-Khalluuha tilaggit al-ganaadiil al-mudaffigiin ambeenaat al-juruun.Ma ti'aazuuha.
Wa laakin daffugu leeha be niiyitku ganaadiil min al-juruun wa khalluuha tilaggithum,ma tikhawwufuuha.
Wa Ra'uus laggatat fi l-zere' da lahaddi l-achiiye.Wa chakkat al-gameh al-abyad al-lammatah wa bigi gariib 10 kooro.
Wa khalaas,Ra'uus chaalat al-gameh al-abyad al-laggatatah wa gabbalat al-hille antatah kulla le nasiibitha amm raajilha.Wa jaabat ma'aaha kula al-akil al-hi chib'at wa faddalatah wa antatah le nasiibitha.
Wa nasiibitha gaalat leeha-:-Al-yoom macheeti laggatti ween-?Wa khadamti ween-?Allah yibaarik al-naadum al-fakkar foogki-! Wa Ra'uus khabbarat nasiibitha be l-naadum al-hi khadamat fi bakaanah wa gaalat-:-Al-raajil al-ana khadamt fi bakaanah al-yoom usmah Bu'aaz.
Wa Na'iima gaalat le marit waladha-:-Baarak Allah fi Bu'aaz-!Wa ya hassa' kula na'arif Allah gaa'id yarham al-hayyiin wa l-maytiin. Wa Na'iima gaalat battaan-:-Al-raajil da gariibna wa hu wariis raajli.
Wa Ra'uus al-Muwaabiiye gaalat-:-Wa hu gaal leyi battaan-:--Akhdimi hini ma'a khaddaamaati lahaddi kulla l-lammiin yikammil.-
Wa Na'iima gaalat le Ra'uus marit waladha-:-Akheer leeki ya bitti,takhdimi ma'a khaddaamaatah achaan kan macheeti fi zere' aakhar mumkin yi'aazuuki.
Wa khalaas,Ra'uus khadamat ma'a khaddaamaat Bu'aaz fi laggitiin al-ganaadiil lahaddi lammiin al-gameh al-abyad wa l-ahmar kulla kammal.Wa hi sakanat ma'a nasiibitha amm raajilha.
Wa yoom waahid,Na'iima gaalat le Ra'uus-:-Ya bineeyti,kan nifattich leeki al-raaha da,ma akheer-?
Wa hassa' ta'arfi kadar Bu'aaz al-inti khadamti ma'a khaddaamaatah da,hu gariibna.Wa l-leele di,hu yaji fi l-madagg le yidarri gamhah.
Yalla gummi albarrade wa al'attare wa albase khulgaanki al-samhiin wa amchi al-madagg.Wa laakin ma tiwassifi nafiski kadar inti jiiti lahaddi Bu'aaz yaakul wa yachrab.
Wa wakit yargud,fakkiri adiil fi bakaan furaachah.Wa kan naam khalaas,fukki al-khita min adal rijileenah wa arugdi.Wa hu yi'ooriiki al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih.
Wa Ra'uus gaalat-:-Aywa,nisawwi kulla cheyy al-gultiih leyi.
Wa khalaas,Ra'uus machat al-madagg wa sawwat ayyi cheyy misil nasiibitha gaalatah leeha.
Wa wakit Bu'aaz akal wa chirib wa galbah firih,gamma macha naam fi taraf al-juruun hana l-gameh.Wa Ra'uus gammat be bicheech wa machat fakkat al-khita min adal rijileenah wa ragadat.
Wa fi ust al-leel,Bu'aaz jafal wa achchaglab wa irif kadar fiyah mara raagde fi adal rijileenah.
Wa gaal-:-Inti yaati-? Wa hi gaalat-:-Ana Ra'uus khaddaamtak.Aakhudni achaan inta bas wariis indak hagg ta'agilni-!
Wa Bu'aaz gaal-:-Allah yibaarikki,ya bineeyti-!Al-amaan al-indiki al-yoom le l-aayila di,hu ziyaada min amaanki al-awwal.Achaan inti ma talabti raajil min al-subyaan,kan fagri walla khani kula.
Wa hassa' da,ma takhaafe,ya bineeyti-!Ana nisawwi kulla cheyy al-inti talabtiih minni achaan naas hilliti ya'arfu tamaam kadar inti mara indiki khiima.
Sahiih,ana wariis le raajilki laakin wariis aakhar gariib leyah ziyaada minni ana kula fi.
Hassa' da,nuumi wa ambaakir fajur kamaan nichiifu.Kan hu yidoor yugumm be waajbah hana l-wariis,al-hamdulillah.Wa kan aba ma yugumm be waajbah kamaan,nahlif be Allah al-Hayy,ana bas nugumm beyah.Hassa' da,nuumi lahaddi fajur.
Wa Ra'uus naamat adal rijileenah lahaddi l-fajur.Laakin hi gammat fajur badri gubbaal al-chagaag achaan naadum ma yichiifha.Wa Bu'aaz kula ma yidoor al-naas ya'arfu kadar al-mara di jaat fi l-madagg.
Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Jiibi nuss farditki wa akurbiih adiil. Wa hu sabba leeha foogah sitte kayyaal hana gameh wa chayyalah leeha.Wa hu gabbal al-hille.
Wa wakit Ra'uus gabbalat le nasiibitha,hi sa'alatha wa gaalat-:-Chunu al-khabar,ya bineeyti-? Wa Ra'uus kallamatha be kulla cheyy al-sawwaah leeha Bu'aaz.
Wa gaalat battaan-:-Hu antaani al-sitte kayyaal hana l-gameh da.Wa hu gaal leyi-:--Ma tamchi iidki yaabse le nasiibitki.-
Wa Na'iima raddat wa gaalat-:-Arje,ya bineeyti,wa nichiifu al-cheyy al-yabga.Achaan al-raajil da ma yinjamma al-yoom lahaddi yikammil al-cheyy da.
Wa wakit Bu'aaz gabbal,macha ga'ad fi khachum baab al-hille wa da bakaan al-malamma.Wa l-raajil al-wariis al-hu kallam beyah le Ra'uus kula ja faayit.Wa Bu'aaz gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal,ya gariibi,wa agood hini. Wa khalaas al-raajil da ja ga'ad jambah.
Wa Bu'aaz naada achara rujaal min chuyuukh al-hille wa gaal leehum-:-Min fadulku agoodu ma'aana. Wa humman ga'ado.
Wa khalaas,hajja le l-raajil al-wariis al-hu min ahal Aliimalik wa gaal-:-Na'iima al-gabbalat min balad Muwaab tidoor tibii' al-zere' hana akhuuna Aliimalik.
Ana naadeetak achaan nikallimak be l-cheyy da.Hassa' da,achri al-ard di,giddaam al-naas al-gaa'idiin dool wa giddaam chuyuukh cha'abi.Kan chareetha,khalaas.Wa kan abeet ma tachriiha kamaan,ooriini achaan na'arif.Achaan ma fi naadum aakhar wariis ziyaada minnak inta wa ana min ba'adak. Wa l-raajil gaal-:-Aywa,nachriiha.
Wa Bu'aaz gaal-:-Kan chareet al-ard min Na'iima da,a'agil Ra'uus al-Muwaabiiye marit al-mayyit kula.Wa misil da,al-ard tagood warasa le ahal al-mayyit.
Wa l-raajil gaal-:-Kan ana wariis kula ma nagdar nachri al-ard achaan ma nitallif warasati.Inta achriiha fi badali achaan ana ma nagdar nachriiha.
Wa fi aadit Bani Israa'iil fi l-wakit daak,kan yibaddulu hagg al-wariis aw yibii'u ard,al-naadum al-yibii' yisill na'aalah wa yantiiha le l-naadum al-yachri.Wa l-cheyy da yabga leehum chahaada le l-bee'.
Wa fi chaan da,al-raajil al-wariis salla na'aalah antaaha le Bu'aaz wa gaal-:-Achriiha inta.
Wa khalaas,Bu'aaz gaal le kulla l-chuyuukh wa kulla l-cha'ab-:-Intu chaahidiin.Ana al-yoom chareet min Na'iima kulla l-khumaam hana Aliimalik wa awlaadah Kilyuun wa Mahluun.
Wa ana chilt Ra'uus al-Muwaabiiye marit Mahluun le tabga marti achaan al-ard tagood warasa le ahal al-mayyit.Wa usmah ma yingachcha min al-aayila wa yagood musajjal fi daftar al-madiina.Intu al-yoom chaahidiin-!
Al-chuyuukh wa kulla l-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi khachum baab al-hille gaalo-:-Aniina chaahidiin-!Allah yibaarik al-mara al-tadkhul fi beetak wa yisawwiiha misil Raahiil wa Leeya,hinna al-itneen ammahaat zurriiyit Yaakhuub jiddina.Wa inta tabga khani fi khachum beet Afraata wa machhuur ziyaada fi Beet Laham.
Wa be l-zurriiye al-Allah yantiiha leek min al-mara di,beetak yabga misil beet Faaris,hu al-Taamaar wildatah le jiddina Yahuuza.
Wa khalaas,Bu'aaz chaal martah Ra'uus wa Allah antaaha bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed.
Wa awiin hana Beet Laham gaalan le Na'iima-:-Al-hamdulillah-!Allah ma khallaaki wa antaaki wileed al-yabga leeki wariis wa yisawwiih machhuur fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-wileed da yikhayyir hayaatki wa yisaa'idki fi wakit tabge ajuuz achaan wildatah leeki marit wileedki al-tiriidki.Wa hi akheer leeki min sab'a awlaad-!
Wa khalaas,Na'iima chaalat al-wileed hadanatah wa ga'adat tirabbiih.
Wa jaaraat Na'iima gaalan-:-Allah razakhaaha be wileed. Wa sammanah Ubeed.Wa hu bigi abu Yassa,abu malik Dawuud.
Wa di hi zurriiyit Faaris.Faaris wilid Hasruun
wa Hasruun wilid Raamwa Raam wilid Aminadaab.
Wa Aminadaab wilid Nahchuunwa Nahchuun wilid Salmuun.
Wa Salmuun wilid Bu'aazwa Bu'aaz wilid Ubeed.
Wa Ubeed wilid Yassawa Yassa wilid Dawuud.
Fiyah raajil waahid min hillit al-Raama fi jibaal Afraayim min khachum beet Suuf.Usmah Alikhaana wileed Yaruuhaam wileed Aliihu wileed Tuuhu wileed Suuf.Wa hu min gabiilat Afraayim.
Hu indah awiin itneen,al-kabiire usumha Hinna wa l-sakhayre usumha Fininna.Wa Fininna wildat leyah iyaal wa laakin Hinna kamaan aagre.
Wa kulli sana Alikhaana yamrug min hillitah yatla' wa yamchi le hillit Chiilooh achaan yasjud wa yigaddim dahiiye le Allah al-Gaadir.Wa da l-bakaan al-gaa'idiin foogah rujaal al-diin al-itneen Hufni wa Fiinhaas awlaad Ali.Wa humman mas'uuliin min al-dahiiye al-yigaddumuuha le Allah.
Wa kulli wakit kan ja wakit al-dahiiye,Alikhaana yadbah wa yanti Fininna gisim al-laham ale adadhum hi wa awlaadha wa banaatha.
Wa laakin le Hinna,yantiiha gisim khaass hana l-laham achaan hu biriidha,hi al-Allah ja'alaaha aagre.
Wa darritha daayman tiza''ilha le tahrig galibha be sabab Allah ja'alaaha aagre.
Wa l-cheyy da gaa'id yabga kulli sana.Wa wakit Hinna tatla' le beet Allah,Fininna tiwaaji'ha lahaddi tabki wa taaba al-akil.
Wa raajilha Alikhaana yuguul leeha-:-Ya Hinna,maalki tabki wa taabe al-akil-?Maalki haznaane-?Ana raajilki ma akheer leeki min achara awlaad walla-?
Wa yoom waahid ba'ad ma akalo wa chirbo fi Chiilooh,Hinna gammat.Wa fi l-wakit da,raajil al-diin al-usmah Ali gaa'id fi kursiih jamb baab beet Allah.
Wa hi gaa'ide tas'al Allah wa tabki be hurga.
Wa sawwat nazir wa gaalat-:-Ya Allah al-Gaadir,chiifni ana khaadmak-!Fakkir foogi wa ma tansaani-!Antiini wileed.Kan anteetni wileed,ana nantiih leek muddit hayaatah.Wa ma nizayyin raasah abadan wa da yiwassif kadar ana anteetah leek.
Wa wakit Hinna gaa'ide tas'al Allah mudda tawiile,Ali gaa'id yichiif khachumha.
Hi gaa'ide tas'al Allah fi galibha wa chalaaliifha gaa'idiin bilharrako laakin hissaha ma binsami'.Khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Ali yahsib hi sakraane.
Wa gaal leeha-:-Maala macheeti sikirti-?Amchi farrigi al-khamar minki-!
Wa Hinna raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-La,ya sayyidi-!Ana mara haznaane.Wa la chiribt khamar wa la cheyy al-bisakkir.Laakin ana gult kulla hamm galbi giddaam Allah.
Ma tahsib khaadmak mara sitt charr.Be sabab hizni wa za'ali bas,ana tawwalt fi su'aali le Allah.
Wa Ali radda leeha wa gaal-:-Amchi be l-salaama.Wa khalli Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil yantiiki al-cheyy al-sa'altiih minnah.
Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Khalaas,ya sayyidi,kan inta ridiit leyi.-Wa khalaas,machat akalat wa hizinha faat.
Wa ambaakir be fajur badri,gammo sajado le Allah wa gabbalo le beethum fi hillit al-Raama.Wa ba'ad da,Alikhaana lamma ma'a martah Hinna wa Allah fakkar leeha wa khibil su'aalha
wa hi bigat khalbaane.Wa fi nafs al-sana di,hi wildat wileed wa sammatah Samuwiil,ma'anaatah ana sa'altah min Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,Alikhaana wa kulla aayiltah dawwaro yamchu fi Chiilooh achaan yigaddim al-dahiiye hana l-sana di le Allah wa yigaddim al-dahiiye al-hu waa'ad beeha fi nazrah.
Wa laakin Hinna ma machat ma'aahum wa gaalat le raajilha-:-Ana kan faradt al-wileed hatta namchi niwaddiih yagood hinaak fi beet Allah daayman.
Wa raajilha gaal-:-Sawwi al-cheyy al-tidoorah.Wa agoodi lahaddi tafurdiih.Wa Allah bas yihaggig kalaamah.-Wa khalaas,Hinna ga'adat fi l-beet wa karabat wileedha lahaddi faradatah.
Wa wakit faradatah,chaalat ma'aaha toor wald talaata sana wa 10 kooro hana dagiig wa girbe hana khamar.Wa machat fi hillit Chiilooh wa chaalat al-wileed wa dakhalat beyah fi beet Allah.Wa fi l-wakit da,al-wileed lissaa'ah sakhayyar.
Wa dabaho al-toor wa waddo al-wileed le Ali raajil al-diin.
Wa Hinna gaalat leyah-:-Ya sayyidi,iriftini walla-?Ana al-mara al-jaat leek yoom daak hini sa'alat Allah.
Ana sa'alt Allah achaan yantiini al-wileed da.Wa daahu antaani al-cheyy al-ana talabtah minnah.
Wa hassa',ana nantiih le Allah muddit hayaatah.-Khalaas fi l-bakaan da,kulluhum sajado le Allah.
Wa Hinna sallat wa gaalat-:-Ni'mat Allah malat galbi be l-farah,Allah rafa' raasi wa antaani gudra.Giddaam udwaani,dihikt be hiss aaliwa be najaatak ana firiht,ya Rabbi.
Ma fi cheyy khudduus misil Allah.Ma fi ilaah illa intawa ma fi malja' misil Ilaahna.
Ma tikallumu be istikbaar ziyaadawa ma tamurgu kalaam bala adab.Achaan Allah hu al-ilaah al-aalim be kulla cheyywa yawzin a'maal al-naas fi l-miizaan.
Silaah al-furraas addammarwa khalaas al-da'iifiin bigo gawiyiin.
Naas al-awwal chab'aaniin,khalaas fi chaan al-akil bigo khaddaamiinwa l-awwal jii'aaniin,khalaas bigo chab'aaniin.Wa l-mara al-aagre wildat sab'a iyaalwa l-awwal indaha iyaal,galibha haznaan.
Allah yimowwit al-insaanwa yihayyiihwa yinazzilah fi l-khaburwa yigawwimah minnah.
Allah yufgir wa yukhniwa yizill wa yi'izz.
Wa yigawwim al-miskiin min al-turaabwa yarfa' al-fagraan min al-rumaad.Ma'a l-muluuk,yiga''idhumwa izz wa charaf yantiihum misil warasa.Le Allah bas asaas al-ardwa foogah,khatta al-dunya.
Allah yahfad al-naas al-saalihiinwa fi l-dalaam,yumuutu al-fasliin.Achaan al-insaanbe gudurtah ma yinnasir.
Udwaan Allah yiddammarowa hu yahrighum be ra'ad min al-sama.Wa Allah yahkim lahaddi aakhir al-dunyawa yanti gudra le l-malik al-hu darrajah.Aywa,yarfa' raas al-naadum al-hu masahah.
Wa ba'ad da,Alikhaana wa aayiltah gabbalo beethum fi hillit al-Raama.Wa l-wileed Samuwiil gaa'id yakhdim le Allah tihit muraakhabat Ali raajil al-diin.
Wa laakin awlaad Ali ma naaf'iin wa ma khaayfiin min Allah.
Wa di hi al-tariiga al-humman gaa'idiin yi'aamulu beeha al-naas.Kan ayyi naadum gaddam dahiiye,khaddaam awlaad Ali yaji leyah wakit gaa'idiin yirakkubu al-laham wa indah fi iidah hadiidaay al-indaha talaata sunuun.
Wa yidiss al-hadiidaay di fi l-gidir aw al-tahwa aw al-kalool aw al-burma al-murakkibiin fiiha al-laham.Wa l-laham al-yamrug fi raas al-hadiidaay da,al-khaddaam yichiilah wa yiwaddiih le raajil al-diin.Wa di bas al-tariiga al-beeha awlaad Ali gaa'idiin yi'aamulu kulla Bani Israa'iil al-yaju le beet Allah fi hillit Chiilooh.
Wa bakaan waahid kamaan,khaddaam rujaal al-diin yaji le l-raajil mugaddim al-dahiiye gubbaal ma yiharrig al-chaham le l-Rabb.Wa l-khaddaam yuguul leyah-:-Antiini laham nutuchchah le raajil al-diin achaan al-laham al-murakkab hu ma yakhbalah minnak,illa kan neyy-!
Wa kan al-raajil gaal-:-Khalliini niharrig al-chaham hatta ta'aal chiil al-ya'ajibak-,al-khaddaam yuguul-:-La-!Ma fiih-!Hassa' da,antiini.Kan abeet nichiilah be gu-!
Wa be da,khutuurat al-zanib hana awlaad Ali bigat ziyaada giddaam Allah.Achaan humman ma yihtarumu al-dahaaya al-yigaddumuuhum le Allah.
Wa laakin fi l-wakit da,Samuwiil gaa'id yakhdim le Allah.Wa hu lissaa' sakhayyar wa laabis khalag hana rujaal al-diin.
Wa ammah tisawwi leyah jallaabiiye sakhayre wa tiwaddiiha leyah kulli sana wakit hi tamchi ma'a raajilha le yigaddim dahiiyat al-sana.
Wa Ali yibaarik Alikhaana wa martah wa yuguul-:-Allah yantiik zurriiye min al-mara di fi gadd al-wileed al-hi antatah le Allah. Wa ba'ad da,yigabbulu fi bakaanhum.
Wa Allah razakhaaha le Hinna wa wildat jaabat awlaad talaata wa banaat itneen.Wa l-wileed Samuwiil gaa'id yakbur giddaam Allah.
Wa Ali bigi chaayib kabiir wa gaa'id yasma' be l-cheyy al-fasil al-awlaadah gaa'idiin yisawwuuh fi jamii' Bani Israa'iil.Wa hu simi' kadar humman yarugdu ma'a l-awiin al-yakhdumu fi madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Maala tisawwu fi'il cheen misil da-?Wa ana simi'tah min kulla cha'ab Bani Israa'iil.
La,ya iyaali.Al-cheyy al-ana simi'tah da hawaan-!Ana simi't kadar intu bas al-gaa'idiin tilizzu kulla naas Allah achaan ya'asooh.
Haay tara-!Angar'u-!Kan naadum aznab fi naadum aakhar,Allah yahkim ambeenaathum.Wa laakin kan naadum aznab fi Allah,yaatu yagdar yilwassat leyah-?-Wa be da kula,awlaad Ali ma sim'o kalaam abuuhum achaan Allah hakam leehum be l-moot.
Wa laakin al-wileed Samuwiil gaa'id yakbur wa ligi rida Allah wa rida al-naas.
Wa yoom waahid,nabi waahid ja le Ali wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ana bayyant nafsi le aayilat jiddak Haaruun wakit humman zamaan gaa'idiin abiid tihit Fir'oon malik Masir.
Wa ana azaltuhum min kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil achaan yabgo rujaal al-diin.Wa yiharrugu al-bakhuur fi madbahi wa yalbaso giddaami khalag hana rujaal al-diin.Wa battaan ana anteethum aayilat Haaruun gisim min kulla l-dahaaya muharragiin al-yiharruguuhum Bani Israa'iil.
Wa laakin maala tahguru al-dahaaya wa l-hadaaya al-ana amart beehum le yigaddumuuhum fi beeti-?Wa maala tikarrim awlaadak ziyaada minni ana Allah Rabbak-?Wa maala intu tisammunu nufuusku be ahsan laham al-ti'azzuluuh min al-dahaaya al-yigaddumuuhum leyi cha'abi Bani Israa'iil-?Da kikkeef-!--
Achaan da,daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal leek-:--Akiid ana awwal gult beetak wa beet abuuk yagoodu fi khidimti daayman.- Laakin hassa' da,daahu kalaam Allah-:--Abadan-!Battaan ma nisawwiih-!Nicharrif al-yicharrufuuni wa laakin al-yahguruuni yabgo mahguuriin.
Wa daahu yaji yoom waahid al-foogah yumuutu kulla l-rujaal min zurriiytak wa naadum waahid ma yakbur wa yabga chaayib fi beetak.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil yi'iichu fi l-raaha,inta tukuun ta'baan.Wa naadum min zurriiytak ke ma yi'iich lahaddi yabga chaayib.
Wa ana nikhalli naadum waahid minku le yakhdim fi madbahi wa da yabga leek inta sabab maliyiin uyuunak be dumuu' wa galbak yahzan chadiid min al-daliime.Wa zurriiytak yumuutu fi chabaabhum.
Wa nantiik alaama wa l-alaama di tabga moot iyaalak Hufni wa Fiinhaas fi yoom waahid.
Wa na'azil le nafsi raajil diin amiin achaan yisawwi al-cheyy al-galbi wa nafsi yidooruuh.Wa nisabbit aayiltah le takhdim daayman ma'a l-malik al-ana masahtah wa darrajtah.
Wa l-faddal min zurriiytak yaji yabruk giddaam raajil al-diin da,achaan yalga sile aw khubzaay.Wa yuguul battaan leyah-:"Min fadlak,antiini amal ma'a rujaal al-diin le nalga khubzaay naakul-!"-
Wa l-wileed Samuwiil gaa'id yakhdim le Allah tihit muraakhabat Ali.Wa fi l-wakit daak,kalaam Allah al-yihajjiih le l-naas ma katiir wa l-ru'ya kula chiyya.
Wa yoom waahid,Ali naayim fi bakaanah al-yunuum foogah.Wa da wakit al-hu chayyab khalaas wa choofah kula bigi da'iif wa uyuunah ma bichiifu.
Wa Samuwiil kamaan naayim fi beet Allah fi l-bakaan al-foogah sanduug al-Rabb.Wa da be l-leel gabul faanuus al-Rabb ma yumuut.
Wa Allah naada Samuwiil wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Na'am-!
Wa gamma jara macha le Ali wa gaal leyah-:-Daahuuni.Inta naadeetni wa ana jiit-! Wa Ali gaal leyah-:-Ana ma naadeetak,ya wileedi.Gabbil nuum-!-Wa hu macha naam.
Wa battaan Allah naadaah le Samuwiil.Wa Samuwiil gamma jara le Ali wa gaal-:-Daahuuni.Inta naadeetni wa ana jiit-! Wa Ali gaal leyah-:-La-!Ana ma naadeetak,ya wileedi.Gabbil nuum-!
Wa fi l-wakit da,Samuwiil ma irif Allah wa la Allah hajja leyah yoom waahid.
Wa Allah naadaah le Samuwiil le taalit marra.Wa Samuwiil gamma jara macha le Ali wa gaal-:-Daahuuni.Inta naadeetni wa ana jiit-! Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Ali irif kadar Allah gaa'id yinaadi al-wileed.
Wa Ali gaal le Samuwiil-:-Gabbil nuum.Wa kan naadaak battaan,guul leyah-:--Kallim,ya Allah.Abdak gaa'id yasma'ak-!--Wa Samuwiil gabbal fi bakaanah wa ragad.
Wa Allah ja wa naadaah le Samuwiil misil awwal-:-Ya Samuwiil-!Ya Samuwiil-! Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Kallim,ana abdak gaa'id nasma'ak-!
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Nisawwi cheyy fi Bani Israa'iil al-yabhat kulla l-naas al-yasma'ooh-!
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana nitimm kulla kalaami al-gult nisawwiih fi zurriiyit Ali,min al-bidaaya lahaddi l-nihaaya.
Wa ana gult leyah ni'aakhib zurriiytah ikhaab daayim.Wa da,be sabab al-hugra al-awlaadah gaa'idiin yisawwuuha wa hu ma aakhabaahum.
Wa be da,ana nahlif kadar zanib hana zurriiyit Ali abadan ma indah kaffaara wa la be dahiiye wa la be hadiiye aakhara.
Wa ba'ad da,Samuwiil gabbal ragad.Wa be fajur,gamma fatah biibaan beet Allah.Wa hu khaaf ma gidir yi'ooriih le Ali be l-ru'ya di.
Laakin Ali naadaah wa gaal-:-Ya Samuwiil wileedi-! Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Na'am.
Wa Ali gaal-:-Chunu al-kalaam al-gaalah leek Allah-?Ma tilabbid minni cheyy.Khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibak ikhaab chadiid kan labbadt kilme waahide kula-!
Khalaas,Samuwiil kallamah le Ali be kulla l-kalaam da wa ma labbad minnah cheyy.Wa Ali gaal-:-Hu Allah.Wa hu yisawwi al-cheyy al-yidoorah.
Wa Samuwiil bigi kabiir wa Allah kaan ma'aayah wa kulla l-kalaam al-gaalah leyah Allah da,tamma.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil min Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati irfo kadar Allah sabbat Samuwiil nabi.
Wa daayman Allah gaa'id yibayyin nafsah fi Chiilooh be kalaamah al-hu gaa'id yuguulah le Samuwiil.
Wa Samuwiil ballakh kalaam Allah le kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa achaan da,Bani Israa'iil marago le yihaarubu al-Filistiyiin.Wa lammo askarhum fi bakaan al-usmah Aban Aazar (ma'anaatah hajar al-Musaa'ada).Wa l-Filistiyiin kamaan lammo askarhum fi hillit Afiikh.
Wa l-Filistiyiin rasso rujaalhum le l-harib giddaam Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-harib bada wa alwassa' wa Bani Israa'iil anhazamo giddaam al-Filistiyiin.Wa l-Filistiyiin katalo min Bani Israa'iil gariib 4-000 raajil fi l-duwaas da.
Wa wakit al-naas al-arrado min al-harib wassalo fi l-mu'askar da,chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil gaalo-:-Maala Allah hazamna al-yoom giddaam al-Filistiyiin-?Yalla-!Namchu nijiibu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah min hillit Chiilooh wa nichiiluuh ma'aana achaan yinajjiina min aduuna.
Wa khalaas,rassalo naas fi hillit Chiilooh wa jaabo sanduug mu'aahadat Allah al-Gaadir,hu al-gaa'id fi l-archah ambeen al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.Wa awlaad Ali al-itneen Hufni wa Fiinhaas,humman kula macho ma'a sanduug mu'aahadat al-Rabb.
Wa wakit sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wassal fi l-mu'askar da,Bani Israa'iil sarakho min al-farha wa min siraakhhum,al-ard rajafat.
Wa l-Filistiyiin sim'o al-siraakh da wa gaalo-:-Chunu al-haraka al-chadiide al-bigat fi mu'askar al-Ibraaniyiin-? Wa be da,al-Filistiyiin irfo kadar sanduug Allah wassal fi mu'askar Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khaafo khoof chadiid wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Al-ilaah ja fi mu'askar Bani Israa'iil.Ya khasaaritna-!Da cheyy al-awwal ke ma bigi abadan-!
Ya khasaaritna-!Yaatu yinajjiina min al-ilaah al-aziim da-?Wa da bas al-ilaah al-darab al-Masriyiin be kulla l-waba fi l-sahara-!
Chiddu heelku,ya l-Filistiyiin,wa abgo rujaal-!Kan ma ke da,aniina nabgo abiid le l-Ibraaniyiin misil awwal humman bigo leena abiid.Abgo rujaal wa haarubuuhum be gudra-!
Wa fi l-bakaan da khalaas,al-Filistiyiin hajamoohum le Bani Israa'iil wa annasaro fooghum.Wa ayyi waahid min Bani Israa'iil jara gabbal beetah.Wa l-khasaara bigat kabiire fi ust Bani Israa'iil wa waddaro fiiha 30-000 raajil.
Wa kan le sanduug al-Rabb,al-Filistiyiin chaalooh.Wa awlaad Ali al-itneen Hufni wa Fiinhaas kula maato.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom,raajil waahid min gabiilat Banyaamiin arrad min bakaan al-harib wa jara lahaddi wisil Chiilooh.Wa l-raajil da charrat khulgaanah wa sabba turaab fi raasah le yiwassif hiznah wa ja fi Chiilooh.
Wa wakit al-raajil da wassal,Ali gaa'id fi kursiih jamb al-derib gaa'id yarja al-khabar achaan galbah khaayif le sanduug al-Rabb.Wa l-raajil da ja anta al-khabar le naas al-hille wa kulluhum gammo yikooruku.
Wakit Ali simi' korooraak hana naas al-hille,hu sa'al wa gaal-:-Chunu al-haraka al-gaa'id nasma'ha di-?-Wa l-raajil ja ajala khabbarah le Ali be l-khabar da.
Wa Ali indah 98 sana wa uyuunah faathiin wa ma bichiifu.
Wa l-raajil gaal le Ali-:-Ana jaayi min bakaan al-harib wa arradt min hinaak wa di bas jayti-! Wa Ali sa'alah wa gaal-:-Chunu al-kaan hinaak,ya wileedi-?
Wa l-raajil al-jaab al-khabar gaal-:-Bani Israa'iil arrado min al-Filistiyiin wa maato katiiriin be ziyaada-!Wa awlaadak Hufni wa Fiinhaas kula maato.Wa sanduug al-Rabb,al-Filistiyiin chaalooh-!
Wa min simi' be khabar cheeliin sanduug al-Rabb da,tawwaali Ali waga' be gafaayah min kursiih jamb khachum baab al-hille wa anfahag wa maat.Achaan hu bigi chaayib wa jismah kula tagiil.Wa gabul da,hu hakam 40 sana fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa marit wileedah Fiinhaas khalbaane gariib talda.Wa wakit sim'at khabar cheeliin sanduug al-Rabb wa moot raajilha Fiinhaas wa abuuh,tawwaali talaga chadiide karabatha wa hi gangasat wa wildat.
Wa hilkat gariib tumuut wa l-awiin al-muhawwigiinha gaalan leeha-:-Ma takhaafe,wilidti wileed-! Laakin da ma lammaaha wa ma raddat leehin cheyy.
Wa sammat al-wileed da Ikabuud (ma'anaatah majd Allah bigi ma fiih).Wa gaalat-:-Majd Allah rafa'ooh min Israa'iil-! Wa da be sabab cheeliin sanduug al-Rabb wa moot raajilha wa abuuh.
Wa be misil da,hi gaalat-:-Majd Allah rafa'ooh min Israa'iil-!Achaan sanduug al-Rabb chaalooh.
Wa ba'ad chaalo sanduug al-Rabb,al-Filistiyiin nagalooh min hajar al-Musaa'ada wa waddooh madiinat Achduud.
Wa jaabooh fi beet al-ibaada hana sanamhum Daguun wa khatto sanduug al-Rabb jamb al-sanam da.
Wa ambaakir be fajur badri,sukkaan Achduud gammo wa daahu ligo Daguun waagi' be wijhah giddaam sanduug Allah-!Wa humman chaalooh wa battaan khattooh fi bakaanah.
Wa ambaakir kula be fajur badri,gammo wa daahu ligo Daguun waagi' be wijhah giddaam sanduug Allah-!Wa raasah wa iideenah mugatta'iin wa waagi'iin fi atabat al-beet.Wa faddalat illa jittitah bas.
Wa fi chaan da bas fi Achduud,rujaal al-diin hana Daguun wa kulla l-naas al-yadkhulu fi beet al-ibaada hana Daguun ma yukhuttu rijleehum fi l-ataba lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Allah darab naas madiinat Achduud chadiid wa barjalaahum be ziyaada.Wa darab naas Achduud wa l-hillaal al-taab'iinha be waba hana hubuun.
Wa wakit chaafo al-cheyy al-kaan fooghum,sukkaan Achduud gaalo-:-Sanduug ilaah Bani Israa'iil ke ma yagood fi baladna achaan hu nazzal waba chadiid foogna aniina wa fi ilaahna Daguun.
Wa naadoohum le l-kubaaraat hana l-Filistiyiin,lammoohum kulluhum ke wa gaalo-:-Hassa' da,nisawwu chunu be sanduug ilaah Bani Israa'iil-? Wa humman raddo wa gaalo-:-Khalli yiwadduuh fi hillit Gaat. Wa khalaas,humman chaalo sanduug ilaah Bani Israa'iil wa waddooh fi hillit Gaat.
Wa wakit waddooh hinaak,Allah darab al-hille di darbe chadiide bilheen.Wa kulla sukkaanha barjalo marra waahid.Wa nazzal fooghum waba hana hubuun min dugaaghum lahaddi kubaarhum.
Wa khalaas,waddo sanduug al-Rabb le madiinat Akhruun.Wa wakit dakhkhalooh fi Akhruun,kulla l-sukkaan sarakho wa gaalo-:-Daahu jaabo leena sanduug ilaah Bani Israa'iil achaan yikattuluuna kullina ke,aniina wa cha'abna-!
Wa humman rassalo le kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin wa lammoohum wa gaalo leehum-:-Gabbulu sanduug ilaah Bani Israa'iil fi bakaanah achaan ma yaktulna aniina wa kulla cha'abna. Achaan fi kulla l-madiina di,barjaal chadiid min al-moot nazal fooghum achaan Allah darabaahum be ru'ub chadiid.
Wa kulla l-naas al-ma maato,marad al-hubuun karabaahum wa baki naas al-madiina lihig lahaddi l-sama.
Wa sanduug Allah ga'ad fi balad al-Filistiyiin muddit sab'a chahar.
Wa l-Filistiyiin naado rujaal al-diin wa l-chawwaafiin wa sa'aloohum wa gaalo-:-Kikkeef nisawwu be sanduug Allah-?Wassufuuna kikkeef nisawwu le nigabbuluuh fi baladah.
Wa humman gaalo-:-Kan tigabbulu sanduug ilaah Bani Israa'iil fi baladah,ma tigabbuluuh saakit.Laakin gaddumu leyah hadiiye le kaffaarat al-khata.Wa be da,intu tachfo min al-marad wa ta'arfu maala Allah ma rafa' minku al-waba da.
Wa l-Filistiyiin gaalo-:-Chunu al-hadiiye le kaffaarat al-khata al-niwadduuha ma'aayah-? Wa humman raddo leehum wa gaalo-:-Gaddumu khamsa daraadim hana dahab misil al-hubuun dool wa khamsa faar hana dahab ale adad kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin.Achaan al-waba da lihigku intu kulluku wa kubaaraatku kula.
Adduluuhum misil al-hubuun al-karabooku wa l-faar al-kharab baladku.Wa timajjudu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa be da,akuun yiwaggif nazziliin al-waba minku intu wa min ilaahku wa min baladku.
Ma tigawwu ruuseeku misil zamaan al-Masriyiin wa Fir'oon malik Masir sawwooh-!Achaan Allah ta''abaahum hatta humman khallo Bani Israa'iil faato.
Wa hassa' da,sawwu kaarro jadiid wa chiilu bagar itneen chawaayil al-yoom waahid kula ma rabato fooghum uud hana kaarro.Wa arbutuuhum fi l-kaarro da.Wa gabbulu iyaalhum wa dissuuhum fi l-zariibe.
Chiilu sanduug Allah wa khuttuuh fi l-kaarro.Wa l-khumaam hana l-dahab al-tigaddumuuhum misil hadiiye le kaffaarat al-khata da,dissuhum fi sanduug aakhar wa khuttuuh jamb sanduug Allah.Wa khalaas,khallu al-kaarro yamchi
wa chiifu.Kan al-bagar macho ale huduud balad Israa'iil ale hillit Beet Chams,ta'arfu kadar Allah bas darabaaku be kulla l-waba da.Wa kan faato be derib aakhar kamaan,ta'arfu kadar al-cheyy al-jaaku,da ma min Allah laakin sudfa bas.
Wa l-Filistiyiin sawwo al-cheyy al-gaalo leehum da.Chaalo bagar itneen chawaayil wa rabatoohum fi l-kaarro.Wa iyaalhum kamaan dassoohum fi l-zariibe.
Wa khalaas,khatto sanduug Allah fi l-kaarro ma'a l-sanduug al-indah foogah faar wa daraadim hana dahab.
Wa l-bagar macho adiil ale hillit Beet Chams.Humman maachiin fi deribhum wa yabku wa ma mayyalo isra walla zeene.Wa kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin taaba'oohum le l-bagar lahaddi huduud Beet Chams.
Wa fi l-yoom da,sukkaan Beet Chams gaa'idiin fi l-waadi yagta'o al-gameh.Wa tawwaali wakit chaafo sanduug Allah da,firho farha chadiide.
Wa wakit al-kaarro wassal fi zere' Yachuu' fi hillit Beet Chams,wagaf.Wa fi l-bakaan da,fiyah hajar kabiir.Wa l-naas chaggago hatab al-kaarro wa dabaho al-bagar al-itneen wa harragoohum dahiiye muharraga le Allah.
Wa gubbaal da,al-Laawiyiin rafa'o sanduug Allah wa l-sanduug al-ma'aayah al-foogah al-achya hana l-dahab wa nazzaloohum fi l-hajar al-kabiir da.Wa fi nafs al-yoom,sukkaan Beet Chams gaddamo dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya aakhariin le Allah.
Wa ba'ad chaafo kulla cheyy al-bigi,kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin al-khamsa gabbalo madiinat Akhruun fi nafs al-yoom.
Wa daahu adad daraadim al-dahab al-Filistiyiin gaddamoohum misil hadiiye le kaffaarat al-khata le Allah.Waahid le Achduud wa waahid le Khazza wa waahid le Achgaluun wa waahid le Gaat wa waahid le Akhruun.
Wa l-faar hana l-dahab kamaan,adadhum yimassil kulla l-hillaal al-taab'iin le l-kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin al-khamsa.Wa l-hillaal dool,humman al-mudun al-gawiyiin wa l-furgaan lahaddi l-huduud gariib le l-hajar al-kabiir al-khatto foogah sanduug Allah.Wa l-hajar da gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom,fi zere' Yachuu' al-fi hillit Beet Chams.
Wa Allah darab sukkaan hillit Beet Chams achaan humman chaafo lubb sanduug Allah.Wa maato minhum 70 raajil.Wa l-cha'ab bigo haznaaniin achaan Allah darabaahum darbe chadiide.
Wa sukkaan hillit Beet Chams gaalo-:-Yaatu al-yagdar yagood giddaam Allah al-Rabb al-Khudduus-?Wa sanduug Allah da,hassa' niwadduuh ween-?
Wa humman rassalo le sukkaan Kharyat Ya'ariim wa gaalo leehum-:-Al-Filistiyiin gabbalo sanduug Allah.Hassa' da,ta'aalu wadduuh bakaanku-!
Wa sukkaan hillit Kharyat Ya'ariim jo chaalo sanduug Allah wa khattooh fi beet Abinadaab fi raas al-hajar.Wa khassaso wileedah Ali'aazar le yahfadah.
Wa l-sanduug da ga'ad ayyaam katiiriin fi Kharyat Ya'ariim,muddit 20 sana.Wa Bani Israa'iil dawwaro yigabbulu battaan le Allah.
Wa Samuwiil kallamaahum wa gaal-:-Tamaam-!Kan be kulla guluubku tidooru tigabbulu le Allah,ba''udu min kulla l-ilaahaat al-ajnabiyiin wa l-ilaaha Achtaruut wa sabbutu guluubku fi Allah wa a'abuduuh hu wiheedah bas.Be da,hu yinajjiiku min udwaanku al-Filistiyiin.
Wa khalaas,Bani Israa'iil tarrafo minhum asnaam Ba'al wa Achtaruut wa abado Allah wiheedah.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Limmu kulluku fi hillit Misfa achaan nas'al leeku Allah.
Khalaas,Bani Israa'iil lammo fi Misfa wa chaalo almi wa sabbooh giddaam Allah.Wa di alaamit al-tooba.Wa fi l-yoom da,humman saamo wa gaalo-:-Nachhado fi nufuusna kadar aniina aznabna giddaam Allah. Wa fi l-wakit da fi Misfa,Samuwiil bigi haakim fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wakit al-Filistiyiin sim'o kadar Bani Israa'iil lammo fi Misfa,kulla askar kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin gammo le yihaarubuuhum.Wa Bani Israa'iil sim'o al-khabar da wa khaafo khoof chadiid min al-Filistiyiin.
Wa gaalo le Samuwiil-:-As'al Allah Ilaahna daayman achaan yinajjiina min al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Samuwiil chaal hamal radii' wa gaddamah kulla ke dahiiye muharraga le Allah wa sa'al Allah fi chaan Bani Israa'iil.Wa khalaas,Allah khibil su'aalah.
Wa wakit Samuwiil gaa'id yigaddim al-dahiiye al-muharraga da,al-Filistiyiin garrabo le yahjumu Bani Israa'iil.Wa laakin fi l-yoom da,Allah darabaahum le l-Filistiyiin be ra'ad chadiid.Wa humman barjalo marra waahid wa anhazamo giddaam Bani Israa'iil.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil gammo min Misfa wa taarado al-Filistiyiin wa kataloohum lahaddi be khaadi le hillit Beet Kaar.
Wa Samuwiil chaal hajar wa khazzaah been Misfa wa l-hajar al-usmah Sinn wa samma al-hajar da hajar al-Musaa'ada.Wa gaal-:-Lahaddi hini,Allah saa'adna.
Wa l-haziime di bigat chadiide le l-Filistiyiin wa battaan ke ma gabbalo fi turaab Bani Israa'iil.Achaan Allah daharaahum min turaab Bani Israa'iil fi kulla wakit Samuwiil.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gala'o kulla l-turaab wa l-mudun al-chaaloohum minhum al-Filistiyiin min huduud madiinat Akhruun lahaddi hillit Gaat.Wa kaan salaam ambeen al-Amuuriyiin wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Samuwiil hakam fi Bani Israa'iil muddit hayaatah.
Wa hu yamchi kulla sana le Beet Iil wa Gilgaal wa Misfa wa yisawwi charii'a le Bani Israa'iil fi kulla l-hillaal al-talaata dool.
Wa ba'ad da,yigabbil fi hillit al-Raama wa da l-bakaan al-hu saakin foogah.Wa hinaak kula hu yisawwi charii'a le Bani Israa'iil.Wa bana madbah le ibaadat Allah.
Wa wakit Samuwiil bigi chaayib khalaas,darraj awlaadah hukkaam fi Israa'iil.
Wa wileedah al-bikir usmah Yuwiil wa l-taani Abiiya.Wa humman gaa'idiin yahkumu min hillit Biir Sab'a.
Laakin al-awlaad dool ma taaba'o derib abuuhum.Dawwaro maslahat nafishum wa yakhbalo al-rachwa wa yidangusu al-charii'a.
Wa kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil lammo wa macho le Samuwiil fi hillit al-Raama.
Wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu inta bigiit chaayib wa awlaadak ma gaa'idiin yitaabu'u derbak.Hassa' da,darrij leena malik yahkimna,misil al-umam al-aakhariin.
Wa Samuwiil zi'il fi l-kalaam al-buguul-:-Darrij leena malik yahkimna. Wa gamma sa'al Allah.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Asma' kalaam al-cha'ab fi kulla cheyy al-buguuluuh leek.Humman ma rafadook inta laakin rafadooni ana.Wa ma yidooru nahkimhum.
A'arif-!Min yoom al-ana maragtuhum min balad Masir lahaddi hassa',humman khallooni wa abado ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa l-cheyy al-daayman sawwooh leyi ana da,hassa' gaa'idiin yisawwuuh leek inta kula-!
Wa hassa' da khalaas,akhbal talabhum.Laakin hazzirhum wa arrifhum huguug al-malik al-yahkimhum.
Wa Samuwiil hajja le Bani Israa'iil al-talabo minnah malik be kulla l-kalaam al-gaalah leyah Allah.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Daahu huguug al-malik al-yahkimku.Hu yichiil awlaadku le yusuugu leyah arabaatah hana l-harib wa yarkabo fi kheelah wa yajru giddaam arabatah.
Wa yichiil waahidiin minhum wa yisawwiihum khuyyaad fi aalaaf wa khuyyaad fi khamsiinaat.Wa yahartu zer'ah wa yagta'o intaajah wa yasna'o leyah silaah hana l-harib wa aalaat arabaatah hana l-harib.
Wa yichiil banaatku achaan yisawwan leyah riihe fi beetah wa yisawwan leyah akil wa yidissan leyah khubza fi l-furun.
Wa yichiil al-adiil min ziraa'itku wa jineenaatku hana l-inab wa l-zaytuun wa yantiihum le khaddaamiinah.
Wa yichiil al-uchur min intaaj ziraa'itku wa inabku wa yantiihum le khaddaamiinah wa kubaaraatah.
Wa yichiil khaddaamiinku wa khaddaamaatku wa subyaanku wa hamiirku al-induhum gudra le yakhdumu leyah.
Wa yichiil al-uchur min khanamku.Wa fi l-akhiir,intu zaatku tabgo leyah abiid-!
Wa fi l-wakit da,intu tabku le Allah achaan al-malik al-intu azaltuuh.Wa laakin fi l-yoom da,Allah ma yasma'ku abadan.
Wa be da kula,al-cha'ab abo ma sim'o kalaam Samuwiil wa gaalo-:-La-!Ma lammaana-!Darrij leena malik bas
achaan aniina kula nabgo misil al-umam al-aakhariin.Malikna yahkim foogna wa yamchi giddaam askarna wa yihaarib ma'aana.
Wa Samuwiil simi' kulla kalaamhum wa kallamah le Allah.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Kan ke da,asma' kalaamhum wa darrij leehum malik. Wa khalaas,Samuwiil gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil hillitah.
Wa fiyah naadum waahid min balad Banyaamiin usmah Khiich.Wa aayich fi l-balad di wa hu siid al-maal.Wa hu wileed Abiyiil wileed Saruur wileed Bakuurat wileed Afiyah.
Wa Khiich indah wileed usmah Chaawuul.Hu sabi jamiil wa naadum min Bani Israa'iil al-yufuutah da,ma fiih.Hu faataahum kulluhum be tuul,raasah wa kataafeeh maargiin foog minhum.
Wa yoom waahid,hamiir hana Khiich abuuh Chaawuul waddaro.Wa Khiich gaal le wileedah Chaawuul-:-Chiil waahid min al-khaddaamiin wa amchi fattich al-hamiir.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul wa l-khaddaam macho yifattuchu al-hamiir fi kulla jibaal Afraayim wa fi kulla balad Chaliicha wa ma ligoohum.Wa fattachoohum battaan fi kulla balad Cha'aliim wa balad Banyaamiin wa laakin ma ligoohum.
Wa wakit wassalo fi balad Suuf,Chaawuul gaal le khaddaamah al-ma'aayah-:-Khalli nigabbulu-!Ana nakhaaf abuuyi hassa' ma yihimm le l-hamiir laakin yihimm leena aniina.
Wa l-khaddaam gaal leyah-:-Fi l-hille di,fiyah nabi Allah.Wa l-naadum da hu ma'ruuf wa kulla cheyy al-buguulah yaji fi bakaanah.Khalli namchu leyah.Akuun yiwassif leena al-derib al-waajib nichiiluuh.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul gaal le khaddaamah-:-Yalla namchu-!Wa laakin niwaddu chunu le l-nabi da-?Ma indina khubza fi mukhlaatna wa ma indina hadiiye al-nigaddumuuha leyah.Ma indina cheyy-!
Wa l-khaddaam radda le Chaawuul wa gaal-:-Indi fi jeebi rubu' hana hajar fudda nantiih le nabi Allah.Wa hu yiwassif leena al-derib.
Wa fi aadit Bani Israa'iil zamaan,kan yidooru yamchu yas'alo al-Rabb,humman yuguulu-:-Namchu le l-chawwaafi. Achaan fi wakithum daak,humman le l-nabi yinaaduuh chawwaafi.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le khaddaamah-:-Kalaamak adiil-!Ta'aal namchu-! Wa khalaas,humman macho fi l-hille al-gaa'id foogha nabi Allah.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yatla'o le yadkhulu fi l-hille,laago banaat maargaat maachaat yichiilan almi.Wa humman sa'aloohin wa gaalo-:-Al-chawwaafi da hini walla-?
Wa l-banaat raddan leehum wa gaalan-:-Aywa-!Hu giddaamku-!Amchu ajala talgooh.Hu ja fi l-hille al-yoom achaan al-yoom fiyah dahiiye le l-cha'ab fi l-bakaan al-aali hana l-ibaada.
Amchu ajala talgooh gubbaal ma yatla' fi bakaan al-ibaada.Achaan al-cha'ab ma yaakulu gubbaal hu ma yawsal wa yibaarik al-dahiiye di.Wa ba'ad da,al-ma'zuumiin yaakuluuha.Hassa' da,amchu talgooh.
Humman tala'o ale l-hille.Wa wakit daakhliin fi lubb al-hille,chaafo daahu Samuwiil kulla jaayi mulaagiihum taali' ale bakaan al-ibaada.
Laakin gubbaal al-lumma ma'a Chaawuul be yoom,Allah khabbarah le Samuwiil wa gaal leyah-:
Ambaakir fi nafs al-wakit,nirassil leek naadum waahid min balad Banyaamiin.Amsahah wa darrijah le yabga kabiir le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa yinajjiihum min al-Filistiyiin.Achaan ana chift ta'ab cha'abi wa siraakhhum wassalaani.
Wa wakit Samuwiil chaaf Chaawuul,tawwaali Allah hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Da al-raajil al-kallamtak beyah wa hu bas al-yakrub cha'abi-!
Wa Chaawuul lamma ma'a Samuwiil fi khachum baab al-hille wa sa'alah wa gaal leyah-:-Al-salaam aleek-!Min fadlak,wassifni beet al-chawwaafi.
Wa Samuwiil radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana bas al-chawwaafi.Atla' giddaami fi bakaan al-ibaada.Al-yoom,intu taakulu ma'aayi.Wa ambaakir fajur kamaan,nihajjiik be kulla cheyy al-yihimmak wa ni'addiik tamchi.
Wa kan le l-hamiir al-waddaro induhum talaata yoom,ma tihimm leehum.Humman anlago.Wa l-muna hana cha'ab Bani Israa'iil da,fi yaatu-?Ma fiik inta wa aayilat abuuk walla-?
Wa Chaawuul radda wa gaal-:-Ana ma min gabiilat Banyaamiin walla-?Wa aniina min al-gabaayil al-dugaag hana Bani Israa'iil-!Wa khachum beeti kulla l-sakhayyar fi khuchuum buyuut Banyaamiin.Wa maala tihajji leyi misil da-?
Wa Samuwiil macha ma'a Chaawuul wa khaddaamah wa waddaahum fi l-beet al-baakulu foogah.Wa khattaahum fi l-bakaan al-indah charaf fi usut 30 ma'zuumiin aakhariin.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le l-khaddaam al-gaa'id yisawwi al-akil-:-Jiib al-laham al-anteetak wa gult leek ahfadah.
Wa l-khaddaam jaab al-gaayme wa kulla l-laham al-foogha wa khattaaha giddaam Chaawuul.Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Alfaddal.Daahu al-cheyy al-dammeena leek fi l-munaasaba di wakit ana azamt al-naas.Khuttah giddaamak wa aakul. Wa fi l-yoom da,Chaawuul akal ma'a Samuwiil.
Wa ba'ad da,nazalo min bakaan al-ibaada wa macho al-hille.Wa Samuwiil hajja ma'a Chaawuul fi raas beetah.
Wa humman bakkaro.Wa wakit al-chagaag chagga,Samuwiil naadaah le Chaawuul al-gaa'id fi raas al-beet wa gaal leyah-:-Ni'addiik. Wa khalaas,Chaawuul gamma wa Samuwiil macha ma'aayah le yi'addiih.
Wa wakit garrabo yamurgu min al-hille,Samuwiil gaal le Chaawuul-:-Guul le khaddaamak khalli yigaddim. Wa hu gaddam.Wa Samuwiil gaal le Chaawuul-:-Hassa' da,inta agiif-!Ni'ooriik kalaam al-Rabb.
Wa Samuwiil chaal dihin wa sabbaah fi raas Chaawuul.Wa hadanah wa gaal-:-Be da,Allah darrajak le tabga kabiir le cha'abah Bani Israa'iil al-misil warasatah.
Wa wakit al-yoom tamchi min bakaani hini,tilimm ma'a rujaal itneen jamb khabur Raahiil al-gaa'id fi turaab Salsah fi huduud Banyaamiin.Wa humman yuguulu leek-:--Al-hamiir al-inta macheet tifattichhum,khalaas anlago.Wa hassa',abuuk khalla kalaam al-hamiir wa gaa'id yihimm leeku intu.Wa yas'al nafsah kikkeef yalga wileedah.--
Min al-bakaan da,amchi lahaddi tiwassil fi ga'ar al-chadara al-kabiire al-fi jabal Taabuur.Wa fi l-bakaan da,yalgook rujaal talaata al-taali'iin le ya'abudu al-Rabb fi hillit Beet Iil.Wa waahid min al-rujaal dool chaayil talaata sakhal wa l-taani chaayil talaata khubza wa l-taalit kamaan chaayil girbe hint asiir al-inab.
Wa humman yisallumuuk wa yantuuk itneen khubza wa inta tichiilhum minhum.
Wa ba'ad da,tamchi fi hillit Gibee'at Allah,al-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah mu'askar al-Filistiyiin.Wa wakit tadkhul fi l-hille di,tilimm ma'a majmuu'a min al-anbiya naazliin min bakaan al-ibaada.Wa giddaamhum,fiyah naas al-yadurbu jigindiiye wa nuggaara wa suffaara wa amsibeybe.Wa l-anbiya dool yitnabba'o.
Wa tawwaali,Ruuh Allah yanzil foogak inta be chidde wa titnabba' ma'aahum wa tikhayyir wa tabga raajil aakhar.
Wa wakit kulla l-alaamaat dool yitimmu leek,khalaas sawwi kulla cheyy al-inta tidoor tisawwiih achaan al-Rabb ma'aak.
