Wa anzil giddaami wa amchi fi hillit Gilgaal.Wa ba'ad da,ana nalhagak le nigaddim dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa arjaani muddit sab'a yoom lahaddi ana najiik wa ni'ooriik al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih.
Wa min Chaawuul gabbal min Samuwiil wa macha,al-Rabb khayyar galbah.Wa kulla l-alaamaat dool tammo fi nafs al-yoom.
Wa wakit Chaawuul wa khaddaamah wassalo fi hillit Gibee'a,laagoohum majmuu'a min al-anbiya.Wa tawwaali,Ruuh Allah nazal be chidde fi Chaawuul wa hu kula dakhal fi usuthum wa gamma yitnabba' ma'aahum.
Wa wakit chaafooh yitnabba' ma'a l-anbiya,kulla l-naas al-awwal irfo Chaawuul assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Chunu al-bigi le wileed Khiich-?Chaawuul kula bigi nabi ma'aahum walla-?
Wa naadum waahid min naas al-bakaan da gaal-:-Yaatu sayyidhum-? Wa min al-bakaan da bas,marag al-masal al-buguul-:-Chaawuul kula bigi nabi ma'aahum walla-?
Wa wakit Chaawuul kammal min al-tanabbu,tala' fi bakaan al-ibaada.
Wa immah le Chaawuul sa'alah hu wa khaddaamah wa gaal leehum-:-Intu macheetu ween-? Wa Chaawuul radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aniina macheena nifattuchu al-hamiir.Wa wakit ma ligiinaahum kamaan,macheena gaabalna Samuwiil.
Wa immah le Chaawuul gaal-:-Khalaas,ooriini Samuwiil gaal leeku chunu-?
Wa Chaawuul radda le immah wa gaal-:-Samuwiil khabbaraana kadar al-hamiir anlago. Wa laakin labbad le immah al-cheyy al-bukhuss al-muluk,al-khabbarah beyah Samuwiil.
Wa Samuwiil naada al-cha'ab le yilimmu giddaam Allah fi hillit Misfa.
Wa hu gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Ana bas al-maragtuku intu Bani Israa'iil min Masir.Wa ana bas al-najjeetku min malik Masir wa min kulla l-muluuk al-gaa'idiin yista'marooku.--
Wa laakin al-yoom intu abeetu Ilaahku al-najjaaku min kulla l-masaayib wa min kulla l-ta'ab.Wa gultu leyah-:--Aywa-!Darrij leena malik-!- Hassa' da,ta'aalu giddaam Allah be gabaayilku wa khuchuum buyuutku.
Wa Samuwiil gaddam kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil wa sawwa leehum am'iyeedaat wa l-ikhtiyaar waga' fi gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa battaan gaddam gabiilat Banyaamiin be kulla khuchuum buyuutha wa l-ikhtiyaar waga' fi khachum beet Matri.Wa fi l-akhiir,al-ikhtiyaar waga' fi Chaawuul wileed Khiich.Wa humman fattachooh wa laakin ma ligooh.
Wa humman sa'alo Allah battaan wa gaalo-:-Al-raajil da gaa'id ma'aana hini walla-? Wa Allah gaal-:-Aywa-!Chiifuuh-!Mullabbid jamb al-khumaam.
Wa humman macho jaabooh.Wa wakit wagaf fi ust al-cha'ab,hu bas faataahum be tuul,raasah wa kataafeeh maargiin foog minhum.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le kulla l-cha'ab-:-Hal chiftu al-naadum al-Allah azalah walla-?Ma fi naadum mislah fi kulla l-cha'ab-! Wa kulla l-cha'ab aato be hiss waahid wa gaalo-:-Yi'iich al-malik-!
Wa Samuwiil kallam le l-cha'ab be kulla huguug al-malik wa katabaahum fi kitaab wa khattaah giddaam Allah.Wa ba'ad da,Samuwiil gaal le kulla l-cha'ab khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah.
Wa Chaawuul kula gabbal beetah fi hillit Gibee'a wa macho ma'aayah mujtama' min al-rujaal al-chudaad al-hadaahum al-Rabb.
Wa laakin naas waahidiin al-ma naaf'iin gaalo-:-Hu da yinajjiina walla-? Humman kirhooh wa ma gaddamo leyah hadaaya.Wa Chaawuul ma gaal cheyy.
Wa ba'ad da,Nahaach malik Bani Ammuun macha fi hillit Yaabiich fi turaab Gil'aad wa haasarha.Wa kulla sukkaan Yaabiich Gil'aad gaalo leyah-:-Sawwi ma'aana mu'aahada wa nagoodu tihtak.
Wa Nahaach gaal leehum-:-Tamaam-!Kan nisawwi ma'aaku mu'aahada da,illa nisill kulla uyuunku al-zeenaayaat.Wa be da,nijiib al-ihaana fi kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa chuyuukh Yaabiich gaalo-:-Arjaana sab'a ayyaam.Nirassulu fi kulla balad Bani Israa'iil wa kan ma ligiina naadum yafza'na,khalaas namurgu wa nagoodu tihtak.
Wa wakit al-murassaliin wassalo fi hillit Chaawuul al-usumha Gibee'a,hajjo be l-kalaam da le kulla l-cha'ab wa l-cha'ab gammo yabku be hiss aali.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Chaawuul jaayi min al-zere' wara bagarah wa gaal-:-Chunu al-bigi le l-cha'ab wa gaa'idiin yabku-? Wa humman oorooh be l-khabar hana naas Yaabiich.
Wa wakit Chaawuul simi' al-kalaam da,tawwaali Ruuh Allah nazal foogah wa hu zi'il za'al chadiid.
Wa chaal bagar itneen dabahaahum wa gatta'aahum wa rassal lahamhum fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa gaal-:-Guulu le Bani Israa'iil-:--Ayyi naadum al-ma marag le l-harib wara Chaawuul wa Samuwiil,bagarah nigatti'hum misil da-!-- Wa khalaas,khoof chadiid min Allah dakhal fi guluubhum wa marago kulluhum misil raajil waahid.
Wa fi hillit Baazakh,Chaawuul hasab askarah.Wa adad rujaal Bani Israa'iil 300-000 wa rujaal gabiilat Yahuuza 30-000.
Wa l-naas al-lammo gaalo le l-murassaliin al-jo min hillit Yaabiich Gil'aad-:-Guulu le naasku ambaakir gaayle yalgo al-faza'. Wa l-murassaliin macho wa khabbaro naas hillit Yaabiich wa humman firho bilheen be l-khabar da.
Wa gaalo le Bani Ammuun-:-Ambaakir aniina nisallumu nufuusna leeku wa tisawwu foogna kulla cheyy al-tidooruuh.
Wa ambaakir be fajur badri,Chaawuul gassam askarah ale talaata bakaan wa hajamo mu'askar Bani Ammuun wa kataloohum lahaddi al-harraay bigat gaayle.Wa l-askar al-faddalo chattato marra waahid,itneen maachiin sawa kula ma fiih-!
Wa kulla l-naas gaalo le Samuwiil-:-Yaatumman al-gaalo-:--Chaawuul ma yamluk foogna-?- Jiibuuhum hini naktuluuhum-!
Wa laakin Chaawuul gaal-:-Fi l-yoom da,ma yaktulu naadum waahid kula-!Achaan Allah najja Bani Israa'iil fi l-yoom da.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Ta'aalu namchu hillit Gilgaal le nijaddudu sabbitiin al-malik.
Wa khalaas,kulla Bani Israa'iil macho le hillit Gilgaal wa sabbato al-malik Chaawuul giddaam Allah.Wa gaddamo dahaaya salaama le Allah.Wa ba'ad da,Chaawuul wa kulla Bani Israa'iil firho farha chadiide.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Daahu ana simi't kulla kalaamku wa darrajt leeku malik.
Wa hassa' da,daahu induku malik gaa'id yuguudku.Wa kan leyi ana kamaan,ana bigiit chaayib wa raasi kula bigi abyad.Wa daahu iyaali kula gaa'idiin ma'aaku wa ta'arfu kadar ana gudtuku min subaayi lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa daahu ana waagif giddaamku.Awurdu foogi chahaada giddaam Allah wa giddaam al-malik al-hu masahah wa darrajah.Kan ana chilt toor aw humaar min naadum aw zalamt naadum aw sawweet fasil le naadum,ooruuni-!Kan chilt rachwa min naadum achaan nakhjal minnah wa ma ni'ooriih al-sahiih,ooruuni-!Ooruuni achaan ana nikaffiiku al-cheyy al-zalamtuku beyah.
Wa humman gaalo-:-La-!Inta ma zalamtina wa la sawweet cheyy fasil le naadum wa la chilt cheyy min naadum.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Al-yoom Allah chaahid wa l-malik al-hu darrajah kula chaahid kadar intu ma ligiitu foogi eeb waahid kula. Wa humman gaalo-:-Aywa,hu chaahid-!
Wa khalaas,Samuwiil gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Aywa-!Allah hu bas al-azal Muusa wa Haaruun wa marag juduudku min balad Masir.
Wa hassa' da,ta'aalu.Ana madluum foogku giddaam Allah.Wa nifakkirku be kulla cheyy al-aadil al-Allah sawwaah leeku intu wa le juduudku.
Wa wakit juduudku iyaal Yaakhuub gaa'idiin fi balad Masir,sarakho le Allah.Wa hu rassal Muusa wa Haaruun maragoohum min balad Masir wa jaaboohum hini.
Wa laakin humman niso Allah Ilaahhum wa Allah sallamaahum le Siisra khaayid hana madiinat Haasuur wa le l-Filistiyiin wa le malik Muwaab wa humman haaraboohum.
Wa juduudku sarakho le Allah wa gaalo-:--Aniina aznabna achaan abeena Allah wa abadna asnaam Ba'al wa Achtaruut.Wa laakin hassa' da,najjiina min udwaanna wa aniina na'abuduuk battaan.--
Wa khalaas,Allah rassal Yarba'al wa Baaraakh wa Yiftaahwa ana Samuwiil.Wa najjaaku min udwaanku al-muhawwigiinku wa be da,sakantu be amaan.
Wa wakit chiftu Nahaach malik Bani Ammuun gamma didduku,gultu-:--Aniina kula nidooru malik yamluk foogna.- Wa be da kula,abeetu Allah Ilaahku wa hu bas malikku.
Wa hassa' da,daahu al-malik al-intu dawwartuuh wa talabtuuh.Wa hu bas al-malik al-Allah darrajah foogku.
Wa kan intu khuftu min Allah wa abadtuuh wa simi'tu kalaamah wa ma isiitu amur Allah Ilaahku wa taaba'tuuh,intu wa l-malik al-gaa'id yamluk foogku,da yabga leeku adiil.
Laakin kan ma simi'tu kalaam Allah wa isiitu amrah,Allah yadrubku misil awwal darab juduudku.
Wa hassa' da,ta'aalu wa chiifu al-cheyy al-ajiib al-yisawwiih Allah giddaamku-!
Da darat,wakit gati'iin al-gameh.Wa hassa' bas,ana nas'al Allah wa hu yinazzil matara wa ra'ad.Wa be da,intu tichiifu wa ta'arfu kadar intu sawweetu khata kabiir giddaam Allah wakit intu talabtu minnah malik-!
Wa khalaas,Samuwiil sa'al Allah wa Allah nazzal matara wa ra'ad fi l-yoom da.Wa kulla l-cha'ab khaafo khoof chadiid min Allah wa min Samuwiil.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab gaalo le Samuwiil-:-Achhad leena Allah ilaahak le ma numuutu-!Achaan aniina zidna zanib kabiir fi zunuubna be sabab talabna malik.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Ma takhaafo.Sahiih,intu sawweetu al-khata da.Wa laakin ma tikhallu derib Allah wa a'abuduuh be kulla guluubku.
Ma titaabu'u al-asnaam achaan humman ma yagdaro yafza'ooku wa la yinajjuuku.Achaan humman ma naaf'iin.
Wa fi chaan usmah al-aziim,Allah ma yikhalli cha'abah.Achaan dawwar yisawwiiku intu cha'abah halaalah.
Wa kan leyi ana,ma niwaggif al-du'a fi chaanku achaan kan ana waggaftah,da zanib didd Allah.Wa waajib niwassifku al-derib al-sameh wa l-adiil.
Wa laakin akhaafo min Allah wa a'abuduuh be sahiih wa be kulla guluubku.Wa fakkuru fi l-ajaayib al-kubaar al-hu sawwaahum leeku.
Wa kan sawweetu al-fasaala,tahlako intu wa malikku kula-!
Wa Chaawuul indah 30 sana wakit bigi malik fi Bani Israa'iil wa hu hakam 42 sana lahaddi maat.
Wa yoom waahid,Chaawuul azal 3-000 raajil min Bani Israa'iil.Wa 2-000 khattaahum ma'aayah fi Mikmaach wa fi jabal Beet Iil.Wa 1-000 kamaan khattaahum ma'a Yuunataan wileedah fi hillit Gibee'a Banyaamiin.Wa l-faddalo min al-rujaal,Chaawuul gaal khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah.
Wa yoom waahid,Yuunataan katal khaayid al-Filistiyiin al-gaa'id fi Gaba'.Wa l-Filistiyiin kula sim'o be l-khabar da.Wa Chaawuul amar le yadurbu al-buug fi kulla l-balad wa gaal-:-Khalli kulla l-Ibraaniyiin yasma'o al-khabar da-!
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil sim'o kadar Chaawuul katal khaayid al-Filistiyiin wa humman irfo kadar al-Filistiyiin gaa'idiin yakrahoohum.Wa khalaas,kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil wagafo misil raajil waahid wara Chaawuul fi hillit Gilgaal.
Wa l-Filistiyiin kula lammo le yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil wa humman induhum 30-000 arabaat al-harib wa 6-000 siyaad al-kheel wa rujaal katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar.Wa jo wa dallo fi hillit Mikmaach sabaah le hillit Beet Awan.
Wa wakit rujaal Bani Israa'iil chaafo kadar aduuhum ja leehum gariib,humman barjalo wa jaro allabbado fi l-karaakiir wa l-nugaar wa l-hujaar wa l-khaaba wa l-biyaar.
Wa waahidiin min al-Ibraaniyiin gata'o bahar al-Urdun wa wassalo balad Gaad wa Gil'aad.Wa laakin Chaawuul kamaan ga'ad fi Gilgaal.Wa kulla l-rujaal al-ma'aayah gaa'idiin yarjufu min al-khoof.
Wa Chaawuul ga'ad sab'a yoom hasab al-wa'ad al-antaah leyah Samuwiil.Wa laakin Samuwiil ma ja leyah fi Gilgaal.Wa l-rujaal bado yichattutu minnah.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul gaal-:-Jiibu leyi bahaayim le l-dahiiye al-muharraga wa dahaaya al-salaama. Wa hu gaddam al-dahiiye al-muharraga.
Wa wakit Chaawuul kammal min gaddimiin al-dahiiye al-muharraga,tawwaali chaaf Samuwiil wassal.Wa hu marag laagaah.
Wa Samuwiil gaal leyah-:-Chunu al-sawweetah da-? Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Wakit ana chift al-rujaal gaa'idiin yichattutu minni wa inta zaatak ma jiit fi l-wa'ad wa l-Filistiyiin lammo fi Mikmaach,
ana gult akuun al-Filistiyiin yahjumuuni fi Gilgaal gubbaal ma nachhad Allah.Wa khalaas,ana anjabart wa gaddamt al-dahiiye al-muharraga.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Chaawuul-:-Inta sawweet cheyy bala fikir wa ma taaba't wasiiyat Allah Ilaahak al-hu amarak beeha.Wa kan awwal inta taaba't wasiiyat Allah,hu yisabbit mulkak daayman fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa hassa' da,mulkak ma yitawwil.Achaan Allah azal naadum aakhar al-hu radyaan beyah wa darrajah le yahkim cha'abah.Wa laakin inta ma taaba't wasiiyat Allah al-amarak beeha.
Wa ba'ad da,Samuwiil gamma min Gilgaal wa macha le Gibee'a fi ard Banyaamiin.Wa Chaawuul hasab al-rujaal al-ma'aayah wa adadhum bigi hawaale 600 raajil.
Wa Chaawuul wa wileedah Yuunataan wa l-rujaal al-ma'aahum ga'ado fi Gaba' ard Banyaamiin.Wa l-Filistiyiin kamaan khatto mu'askarhum fi Mikmaach.
Wa l-mukharribiin min al-Filistiyiin marago min mu'askarhum wa angasamo ale talaata majmuu'aat.Al-majmuu'a al-awwalaaniiye chaalat derib Ufra ale balad Chuu'al.
Wa l-majmuu'a al-taaniye machat ale derib Beet Huruun.Wa l-majmuu'a al-taalta kamaan chaalat derib al-maachi le l-huduud ale waadi al-Maraaf'iin fi l-sahara.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,ma fi haddaadi fi kulla balad Israa'iil achaan al-Filistiyiin khaafo wa gaalo-:-Akuun al-Ibraaniyiin yasna'o suyuuf walla huraab.
Wa ayyi naadum min Bani Israa'iil waajib yamchi le haddaad al-Filistiyiin hatta yitarrugu leyah jarraaytah aw haffaarah aw faasah aw kadankitah.
Wa tarrigiin al-jarraay aw al-kadanka tamanah itneen tilit hana hajar fudda.Wa tarrigiin al-faas aw addiliin raas al-kookaab tamanah tilit hana hajar fudda.
Wa achaan da fi yoom al-harib,ma fi seef walla harba fi iideen kulla l-rujaal al-gaa'idiin ma'a Chaawuul wa Yuunataan.Illa Chaawuul wa wileedah Yuunataan bas musallahiin.
Wa l-Filistiyiin marago min al-mu'askar wa ga'ado fi derib Mikmaach.
Wa yoom waahid,Yuunataan wileed Chaawuul gaal le l-sabi al-chaayil leyah silaahah-:-Ta'aal,namchu le l-mu'askar hana l-Filistiyiin al-gaa'id fi l-nuss al-hinaak. Wa laakin Yuunataan ma khabbar abuuh.
Wa Chaawuul gaa'id fi taraf hillit Gibee'a fi ga'ar chadarat al-rummaan fi turaab Migruun wa ma'aayah hawaale 600 raajil.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid usmah Akhiiya wileed Akhituub akhu Ikabuud wileed Fiinhaas wileed Ali al-hu raajil al-diin hana Allah fi hillit Chiilooh.Wa Akhiiya da,hu bas kabiir rujaal al-diin wa laabis al-farmala.Wa kulla l-askar ma irfo kadar Yuunataan ma fiih.
Wa l-derib al-Yuunataan yidoor yamchi beyah wa yahjim mu'askar al-Filistiyiin indah hujaar itneen.Al-waahid be hini usmah Busiis wa l-aakhar be hinaak usmah Sanna.
Wa l-hajar al-waahid gaa'id be munchaakh mugaabil Mikmaach wa l-hajar al-aakhar kamaan gaa'id wati mugaabil Gaba'.
Wa Yuunataan gaal le l-sabi al-chaayil leyah silaahah-:-Ta'aal-!Namchu le l-mu'askar hana l-naas al-ma mutahhariin dool.Akuun Allah yisaa'idna wa ninnasru fooghum achaan Allah gaadir,yanti al-nasur le naas katiiriin aw le naas chiyya kula.
Wa khaddaamah gaal leyah-:-Sawwi kulla cheyy al-tidoorah-!Amchi wa ana waraak-!
Wa Yuunataan gaal-:-Yalla-!Khalli namchu leehum lahaddi yichiifuuna.
Wa kan yuguulu leena-:--Agiifu fi bakaanku lahaddi najuuku--,khalaas nagiifu wa ma natla'o leehum.
Wa laakin kan yuguulu leena-:--Atla'o--,natla'o leehum.Achaan di bas alaamat al-nasur wa Allah yansurna fooghum.
Wa khalaas,al-Filistiyiin chaafoohum tineenithum wa gaalo-:-Chiifu-!Al-Ibraaniyiin maargiin min al-nugaar al-humman allabbado fooghum-!
Wa l-hurraas gaalo le Yuunataan wa khaddaamah-:-Atla'o leena jaay-!Ni'ooruuku kalaam waahid-! Wa Yuunataan gaal le khaddaamah-:-Atla' waraayi achaan al-yoom Allah dassaahum fi iideen Bani Israa'iil-!
Wa Yuunataan tala' fi l-hajar wa khaddaamah tala' waraayah.Wa hu katal al-Filistiyiin.Wa khalaas,al-Filistiyiin anhazamo giddaam Yuunataan.Wa khaddaamah kula gaa'id yaktulhum waraayah.
Wa fi l-duwaas al-awwal da,Yuunataan wa khaddaamah katalo hawaale 20 raajil fi masaafa gariibe bas.
Wa khalaas,khoof chadiid waga' fi kulla deech al-Filistiyiin wa fi kulla sukkaan al-mantaga wa l-gaa'idiin fi l-mu'askar.Wa l-hurraas wa l-mukharribiin kulluhum barjalo.Wa l-ard kula rajafat achaan al-Rabb bas nazzal fooghum al-barjaal da.
Wa hurraas Chaawuul al-gaa'idiin fi Gibee'a ard Banyaamiin gaa'idiin bichiifu al-Filistiyiin barjalo wa jaariyiin fi ayyi bakaan.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le l-rujaal al-ma'aayah-:-Ajala ahsubu al-naas al-gaa'idiin wa chiifu yaatu al-ma fiih-! Wa humman hasabo al-naas wa ligo Yuunataan wa khaddaamah ma fiihum.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le Akhiiya-:-Jiib sanduug Allah-! Achaan fi l-wakit daak,sanduug al-Rabb gaa'id fi bakaan Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit Chaawuul gaa'id yikallim ma'a Akhiiya raajil al-diin,al-korooraak gaa'id yiziid fi mu'askar al-Filistiyiin wa tawwaali Chaawuul gaal le raajil al-diin-:-Agiif-!Khalaas khalliih-!
Wa Chaawuul lamma kulla l-rujaal al-ma'aayah wa dakhalo fi l-harib.Wa humman ligo al-Filistiyiin gaa'idiin yilkaatalo ambeenaathum.Wa l-barjala di bigat chadiide.
Wa fi Ibraaniyiin waahidiin tawwalo ma'a l-Filistiyiin wa gaa'idiin yihaarubu ma'aahum.Wa fi l-yoom da,humman lammo ma'a akhwaanhum Bani Israa'iil al-taab'iin le Chaawuul wa Yuunataan.
Wa wakit sim'o al-Filistiyiin arrado,kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil al-mullabbidiin fi jibaal Afraayim,humman kula dakhalo fi l-harib le yitaarudu al-Filistiyiin.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Allah najja Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-harib lihig lahaddi khaadi le hillit Beet Awan.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil ti'ibo fi l-yoom da achaan Chaawuul hallafaahum wa gaal-:-Mal'uun al-naadum al-yaakul gubbaal al-achiiye,gabul ma ninnasir fi aduuyi-! Wa fi l-yoom da,kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil ma akalo cheyy.
Wa kulla l-deech dakhal fi l-khaaba wa hinaak fiyah asal gaa'id yisiil fi l-ard.
Wa wakit dakhalo fi l-khaaba,chaafo al-asal al-gaa'id yisiil fi l-ard laakin naadum ma akal minnah achaan khaafo min al-haliife.
Wa Yuunataan ma simi' kadar abuuh hallaf al-askar wa gamma madda asaatah al-fi iidah wa chakka raasha fi l-asal wa akalah.Wa tawwaali ke,jildah bigi nachiit.
Wa waahid min al-askar gaal leyah-:-Abuuk hallaf al-askar wa gaal-:--Mal'uun al-naadum al-yaakul fi l-yoom da.- Wa achaan da bas,kulla l-deech bigi ayyaan.
Wa Yuunataan gaal-:-Abuuyi sabbab barjaal le kulla l-askar.Chiifuuni ana,kikkeef bigiit nachiit wakit dukht al-asal da.
Wa kan al-yoom al-askar akalo min al-khaniime al-chaalooha min aduuhum di,akiid haziimat al-Filistiyiin tabga akbar min da.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Bani Israa'iil annasaro fi l-Filistiyiin wa kataloohum min Mikmaach lahaddi hillit Ayyaluun.Wa askar Bani Israa'iil iyo marra waahid.
Wa waga'o fi l-khaniime wa chaalo al-khanam wa l-bagar wa l-ajjaal wa kataloohum wa akalo al-laham be dammah fi nafs al-bakaan.
Wa naas waahidiin jo khabbaro Chaawuul kadar al-askar aznabo wa iso Allah achaan akalo al-laham be dammah.Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Intu khaayniin.Hassa' da,dargusu hajar kabiir wa jiibuuh leyi hini.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Amchu ambeen al-askar wa guulu leehum-:--Khalli ayyi waahid yijiib leyi khanamaaytah aw toorah wa yadbahoohum hini wa yaakuluuhum.Achaan ma taakulu laham be dammah wa tisawwu zanib wa ta'aso Allah.--Wa khalaas fi l-leele di,ayyi waahid min al-askar jaab toorah wa dabahah fi l-bakaan da.
Wa Chaawuul bana madbah le Allah wa da awwal madbah al-hu bana le Allah.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Khalli al-leele di namchu wara l-Filistiyiin wa nagla'o khumaamhum lahaddi l-fajur.Wa ma nikhallu waahid kula minhum yifaddil. Wa l-askar raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Sawwi kulla cheyy al-tidoorah.-Wa laakin raajil al-diin gaal-:-Khalli hini bas nas'alo al-Rabb.
Wa Chaawuul sa'al al-Rabb wa gaal-:-Namchi wara l-Filistiyiin walla-?Tisallimhum fi iideen Bani Israa'iil walla-? Wa laakin al-Rabb ma radda leyah fi l-yoom da.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le kulla kubaaraat al-deech-:-Limmu wa ta'aalu.Khalli al-yoom nichiifu wa na'arfu chunu al-sabab hana l-zanib da.
Wa nahlif be Allah al-Hayy al-najja Bani Israa'iil,al-naadum al-sawwa al-khata da kan wileedi Yuunataan kula,al-yoom yumuut. Wa naadum min al-deech radda leyah ma fiih.
Wa hu gaal le kulla Bani Israa'iil-:-Agiifu intu be hinaak wa ana wa wileedi Yuunataan nagiifu be hini. Wa l-askar gaalo le Chaawuul-:-Sawwi kulla cheyy al-tidoorah.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil-:-Wassifna al-hagg-! Wa sawwo am'iyeedaat.Wa khalaas,waga'at fi raas Yuunataan wa Chaawuul wa l-askar bigo bariyiin.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Sawwu am'iyeedaat beeni wa been wileedi Yuunataan-! Wa khalaas,waga'at fi Yuunataan.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le Yuunataan-:-Ooriini al-cheyy al-inta sawweetah. Wa Yuunataan hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Ana dukht al-asal be raas al-asa al-fi iidi.Wa daahuuni le l-moot.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid kan inta ma mutt,ya Yuunataan-!
Wa l-askar gaalo le Chaawuul-:-Yuunataan al-jaab al-nasur al-kabiir le Israa'iil da,yumuut-?Da ma sahiih-!Nahalfu be Allah al-Hayy,suufaay waahide kula min raasah ma taga' fi l-ard-!Achaan fi l-yoom da,hu najja Bani Israa'iil be gudrat Allah.La-!Yuunataan ma yumuut.-Wa be da,al-askar najjo Yuunataan min al-moot.
Wa ba'ad Chaawuul khalla mutaaradathum,al-Filistiyiin gabbalo fi baladhum.
Wa wakit Chaawuul chaal al-muluk fi Israa'iil,hu haarab kulla udwaanah al-mujaawiriinah misil naas Muwaab wa Bani Ammuun wa naas Adoom wa muluk Suuba wa l-Filistiyiin.Wa fi ayyi bakaan yiwajjih,hu yinnasir.
Wa hu wassaf faraasiiytah wakit hazam al-Amaalikh wa najja Bani Israa'iil min al-naas al-yanhaboohum.
Wa awlaad Chaawuul humman Yuunataan wa Yichwi wa Malkichuu'.Wa banaatah kamaan itneen al-kabiire usumha Miirab wa l-sakhayre usumha Mikaal.
Wa marit Chaawuul usumha Akhinuu'am bineeyit Akhimaa'as.Wa khaayid askarah usmah Abniir wileed Niir.Wa Niir da,hu immah le Chaawuul.
Niir abu Abniir wa Khiich abu Chaawuul,humman kulluhum iyaal Abiyiil.
Fi wakit Chaawuul,al-harib didd al-Filistiyiin bigi chadiid bilheen.Wa Chaawuul gaa'id yijannid kulla l-rujaal al-fahaliin wa l-gaadriin.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Chaawuul-:-Ana bas,Allah rassalaani masahtak wa darrajtak malik fi cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.Hassa' da,asma' kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:--Ana ni'aakhib cha'ab Amaalikh fi amalhum al-sawwooh kan daharo al-derib le Bani Israa'iilwakit humman maargiin min balad Masir.
Hassa' da,amchi wa haarib cha'ab Amaalikh wa dammir kulla cheyy al-induhum.Wa ma tihinn fooghum-!Aktul al-rujaal wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal wa l-atfaal wa l-bagar wa l-khanam wa l-jumaal wa l-hamiir.-
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul lamma al-deech fi hillit Talaayim wa ligi adadhum 200-000 askari wa 10-000 min gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa Chaawuul macha ma'a askarah le madiinat al-Amaalikh wa karaso fi l-waadi.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le l-Khiiniyiin-:-Amurgu min ust al-Amaalikh wa amchu-!Ma nidammirku ma'aahum achaan intu sawweetu al-kheer le Bani Israa'iil wakit humman maargiin min balad Masir.-Wa khalaas,al-Khiiniyiin anfarago min al-Amaalikh.
Wa Chaawuul haarab al-Amaalikh wa annasar fooghum min hillit Hawiila lahaddi gariib le hillit Chuur al-mugaabile balad Masir.
Wa dammar kulla cha'ab Amaalikh be l-seef wa karab malikhum Agaag.
Wa Chaawuul wa askarah khallo ma dammaro al-malik Agaag wa kulla l-bahaayim al-samhiin wa sumaan misil al-khanam wa l-bagar wa l-humlaan.Wa kulla cheyy sameh wa indah faayde ma dammarooh wa laakin dammaro kulla cheyy al-da'iif wa l-ma indah faayde.
Wa Allah hajja le Samuwiil wa gaal-:
Awwal ana darrajt Chaawuul malik.Wa laakin hassa',ana nidimt achaan hu abaani wa ma taaba' kalaami. Wa l-kalaam da bigi le Samuwiil gaasi bilheen wa tuul al-leel hu gaa'id yas'al Allah.
Wa be fajur badri,Samuwiil gamma macha le yigaabil Chaawuul.Wa oorooh kadar Chaawuul macha fi hillit Karmal sawwa leyah timsaal wa gabbal fi hillit Gilgaal.
Wa wakit Samuwiil wassal fi bakaan Chaawuul,Chaawuul gaal leyah-:-Allah yibaarikak-!Ana sawweet al-cheyy al-Allah gaalah-!
Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Chunu al-baki hana l-bagar wa l-khanam al-gaa'id nasma' da-?
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Dool al-bagar wa l-khanam al-samhiin wa sumaan al-aniina gala'naahum min al-Amaalikh wa l-askar khalloohum ma dammaroohum achaan yigaddumuuhum dahiiye le Allah Ilaahak.Wa laakin al-faddalo kamaan,aniina dammarnaahum.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Chaawuul-:-Askut-!Khalli nikallimak be l-kalaam al-Allah gaalah leyi albaareh. Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Kallim-!
Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Inta ta'arif nafsak kadar inta ma tisaawi cheyy wa laakin hassa' bigiit kabiir fi gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.Wa Allah bas masahak wa darrajak fooghum malik.
Wa Allah kallafaak wa gaal leek-:--Amchi wa dammir kulla l-Amaalikh al-muznibiin wa haaribhum lahaddi tikammilhum marra waahid.--
Wa laakin maala inta ma simi't kalaam Allah-?Waga'at fi l-khaniime wa sawweet al-fasaala giddaam Allah.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le Samuwiil-:-Ana simi't kalaam Allah.Wa sawweet al-cheyy al-hu kallafaani beyah.Dammart kulla l-Amaalikh wa karabt malikhum Agaag wa jibtah-!
Wa l-askar chaalo al-khaniime hana l-khanam wa l-bagar al-samhiin al-waajib nidammuruuhum wa khalloohum le yigaddumuuhum dahiiye le Allah Ilaahak fi Gilgaal-!
Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Allah yafrah be dahaaya muharragiin wa be dahaaya aakhariin walla-?Walla yafrah kan titii' kalaamah-?Achaan kan titii'ah,da afdal min al-dahaaya wa kan tasma' kalaamah,da afdal min chaham al-kubaach.
Al-isyaan,hu khata misil al-hije be ilim al-kheeb.Wa gu al-raas,hu charr misil ibaadat al-asnaam-!Wa be sabab inta abeet kalaam Allah,hu kula abaak wa maragaak min al-muluk-!
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul gaal le Samuwiil-:-Ana aznabt-!Achaan khaalaft awaamir Allah wa wasiiytak inta.Ana khuft min al-rujaal al-ma'aayi wa taaba't kalaamhum.
Wa hassa' da,min fadlak saamihni min zanbi.Wa ta'aal,nigabbulu sawa achaan ana nasjud le Allah.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Chaawuul-:-La,ana ma nigabbil ma'aak achaan inta abeet kalaam Allah wa Allah kula abaak.Wa battaan ma tabga malik fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit Samuwiil anlafat yidoor yamchi,Chaawuul karabah min chaarib khalagah wa l-khalag ancharat.
Wa Samuwiil gaal leyah-:-Al-yoom Allah yagla' muluk Israa'iil minnak wa yantiih le naadum aakhar al-akheer minnak.
Wa Allah al-Daayim Ilaah Bani Israa'iil ma yakdib wa ma yandam.Achaan hu ma misil al-insaan yandam.
Wa Chaawuul gaal battaan-:-Ana aznabt.Hassa' da,Allah aleek ma ti'ayyibni giddaam cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa kubaaraathum.Ta'aal nigabbulu sawa wa nasjud le Allah Ilaahak.
Wa Samuwiil gabbal ma'a Chaawuul wa Chaawuul sajad le Allah.
Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Jiib leyi Agaag malik al-Amaalikh. Wa Agaag jaayi leyah farhaan wa buguul fi galbah-:-Akiid-!Ana ma'a l-moot da,fakka fakka.
Wa Samuwiil gaal leyah-:-Misil seefak bakka awiin katiiriin,ammak inta kula al-yoom tabki-! Wa Samuwiil katalah le l-malik Agaag giddaam Allah fi Gilgaal.
Wa Samuwiil gabbal fi hillit al-Raama wa Chaawuul kamaan gabbal beetah fi Gibee'a.
Wa Samuwiil hizin bilheen min Chaawuul wa ma macha chaafah lahaddi maat.Wa Allah nidim achaan darraj Chaawuul malik fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal le Samuwiil-:-Le mata inta tahzan le Chaawuul,al-ana abeetah battaan ma yamluk fi Israa'iil-?Hassa' da,chiil garnak wa amla dihin wa ta'aal nirassilak le Yassa al-min hillit Beet Laham achaan ana azalt waahid min iyaalah le yabga malik.
Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Kikkeef ana namchi-?Kan Chaawuul simi',ma yaktulni walla-? Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Chiil ma'aak ijle wa guul-:--Ana jiit nigaddim dahiiye le Allah.--
Wa ta'azim Yassa kula fi l-dahiiye di.Wa ana ni'ooriik be l-cheyy al-tisawwiih.Wa tamsah wa tidarrijah leyi al-naadum al-niwassifah leek.
Wa Samuwiil sawwa kulla cheyy al-gaalah leyah Allah.Wa wakit wassal fi hillit Beet Laham,kulla kubaaraat al-hille barjalo wa marago le yigaabuluuh wa gaalo-:-Jaytak di aafe bas-?
Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Aafe bas-!Jiit le nigaddim dahiiye le Allah.Khassusu nufuusku wa ta'aalu ma'aayi fi l-dahiiye di. Wa hu khassas Yassa wa iyaalah wa azamaahum fi l-dahiiye.
Wa wakit Yassa wa iyaalah jo,Samuwiil chaaf Aliyaab wa gaal fi nafsah-:-Akiid-!Hu da bas al-Allah darrajah.Wa daahu gaa'id giddaamah-!
Wa laakin Allah gaal le Samuwiil-:-Ana rafadtah.Wa khalli jamaalah wa tuulah ma ya'ajubuuk-!Achaan ana ma nichiif al-achya misil al-insaan yichiifhum.Al-insaan yichiif al-zaahir bas wa laakin ana Allah nichiif al-fi l-galib.
Wa ba'ad da,Yassa naada Abinadaab wa jaabah giddaam Samuwiil.Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Hu da kula,Allah ma azalah.
Wa Yassa jaab wileedah Chamma giddaam Samuwiil wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Hu da kula,Allah ma azalah.
Wa Yassa jaab sab'a min iyaalah giddaam Samuwiil.Wa Samuwiil gaal le Yassa-:-Dool Allah ma azalaahum.
Wa Samuwiil sa'alah le Yassa wa gaal-:-Dool bas iyaalak walla-? Wa Yassa radda leyah wa gaal-:-La.Faddal waahid wa laakin sakhayyar.Wa gaa'id yasrah be l-khanam. Wa Samuwiil gaal-:-Rassil leyah yaji-!Aniina ma naakulu lahaddi hu yiwassil.
Wa Yassa rassal leyah wa jaabah.Wa hu jamiil wa loonah sameh wa uyuunah kula samhiin.Wa Allah gaal-:-Da bas hu.Gumm amsahah wa darrijah-!
Wa khalaas,Samuwiil chaal dihin min garnah wa masah Dawuud wa darrajah giddaam akhwaanah.Wa tawwaali,Ruuh Allah nazal fi Dawuud wa min al-yoom da,hu gaa'id foogah.Wa Samuwiil gabbal fi hillit al-Raama.
Wa Ruuh Allah khalla Chaawuul.Wa ruuh fasle jaat min Allah wa gaa'ide ti'azzibah.
Wa khaddaamiin Chaawuul gaalo leyah-:-Daahu fi ruuh fasle hana l-ilaahaat gaa'ide ti'azzibak.
Wa hassa' da,khalli inta siidna al-malik tanti izin le khaddaamiinak wa aniina namchu nifattuchu naadum al-ya'arif yadrub jigindiiye.Achaan kan al-ruuh al-fasle hana l-ilaahaat nazalat foogak,hu yadrub al-jigindiiye.Wa da yabga leek chiyya akheer.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le khaddaamiinah-:-Fattuchu leyi raajil al-ya'arif yadrub al-jigindiiye wa jiibuuh leyi.
Wa waahid min al-khaddaamiin gaal leyah-:-Daahu ana na'arif waahid min iyaal Yassa al-min hillit Beet Laham.Hu ya'arif daribiin al-jigindiiye wa hu raajil faaris wa muhaarib wa ya'arif yikallim wa hu jamiil.Wa Allah ma'aayah.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul rassal naas le Yassa wa gaal-:-Rassil leyi wileedak Dawuud al-gaa'id yasrah be l-khanam.
Wa Yassa chaal humaar wa chadda foogah khubza wa girbe hana khamar wa sakhal wa antaah le Dawuud wileedah wa rassalah le Chaawuul.
Wa Dawuud macha le Chaawuul wa gaa'id yakhdim leyah.Wa Chaawuul habbaah marra waahid wa sawwaah khaddaam al-yichiil leyah silaahah.
Wa battaan Chaawuul rassal le Yassa wa gaal-:-Khalli Dawuud yagood ma'aayi achaan ana ridiit beyah marra waahid.
Wa wakit ruuh al-ilaahaat taji fi Chaawuul,Dawuud yichiil al-jigindiiye wa yadrubha.Wa fi l-bakaan da khalaas,Chaawuul haalah tabga leyah akheer wa yirtaah wa l-ruuh al-fasle kula tikiss minnah.
Wa yoom waahid,al-Filistiyiin lammo deechhum le l-harib fi hillit Suuku al-gaa'ide fi balad Yahuuza wa ga'ado been Suuku wa hillit Aziikha,fi hillit Afas Dammiim.
Wa Chaawuul kamaan lamma Bani Israa'iil wa ga'ado fi waadi al-Butum wa jahhazo le muhaarabat al-Filistiyiin.
Wa l-Filistiyiin ga'ado fi l-hajar al-be hini wa Bani Israa'iil fi l-hajar al-aakhar be hinaak.Wa l-waadi ambeenaathum.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid faaris marag min ust al-Filistiyiin.Wa usmah Jaaluut,min hillit Gaat.Wa tuulah ziyaada min 6 duraa'.
Wa fi raasah taagiiye min nahaas wa jildah kula mukhatta be dire' hana nahaas madfuur al-yawzin hawaale 60 kiilo.
Wa siigaanah kula khattaahum be safaayih hana nahaas.Wa mu'allag fi kitfah tabiig hana nahaas.
Wa uud haribtah misil uud murdaas al-ligdaabe wa sinnaha kamaan tawzin hawaale 7 kiilo.Wa l-khaddaam al-yichiil leyah daragatah maachi giddaamah.
Wa Jaaluut wagaf wa naada Bani Israa'iil wa gaal leehum-:-Maalku rasseetu le l-harib-?Ana ma Filisti walla-?Wa intu abiid Chaawuul.A'azulu raajil minku wa khalli yanzil leyi.
Wa kan haarabaani wa gidir katalaani,aniina nabgo leeku abiid.Wa laakin kan ana bas annasart foogah wa kataltah kamaan,intu tabgo leena abiid wa takhdumu leena.
Wa battaan al-Filisti gaal-:-Wa daahu ana-!Nichammit foogku intu,ya Bani Israa'iil-!Amurgu leyi raajil wa ma'aayah nilhaarabo-!
Wa wakit Chaawuul wa kulla Bani Israa'iil sim'o kalaam al-Filisti da,khaafo khoof chadiid wa anbahato.
Wa Dawuud da,hu wileed raajil waahid min gabiilat Afraayim al-usmah Yassa wa hu min hillit Beet Laham fi turaab Yahuuza.Wa Yassa da indah tamaane awlaad.Wa fi wakit hukum Chaawuul,hu chayyab wa bigi kabiir ziyaada.
Awlaad Yassa al-talaata al-kubaar,al-bikir usmah Aliyaab wa l-taani usmah Abinadaab wa l-taalit usmah Chamma,wa kulluhum taaba'o Chaawuul fi bakaan al-harib.
Wa Dawuud hu al-sakhayyar minhum.Wa l-talaata al-kubaar gaa'idiin ma'a Chaawuul
wa laakin Dawuud gaa'id yamchi le Chaawuul wa yigabbil bakaan abuuh le yasrah be l-khanam fi Beet Laham.
Wa Jaaluut al-Filisti gaa'id yamrug wa yinaadi Bani Israa'iil fajur wa achiiye lahaddi 40 yoom.
Wa yoom waahid,Yassa gaal le wileedah Dawuud-:-Chiil al-achara kooro hana l-gameh al-fariik da wa l-khubza al-achara dool wa waddiihum ajala le akhwaanak fi l-mu'askar.
Wa haak al-jibna al-achara dool wa waddiihum le khaayid al-alif.Wa al'akkad min aafiyit akhwaanak wa jiib leyi minhum cheyy al-yiwassif kadar humman aafe.
Talgaahum humman wa kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil ma'a Chaawuul fi waadi al-Butum gaa'idiin yihaarubu al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Dawuud gamma be fajur badri wa khalla al-khanam ma'a l-haras wa chaal khumaamah wa macha misil abuuh Yassa amarah beyah.Wa wisil fi l-mu'askar wakit al-askar kulluhum marago wa rasso le l-duwaas wa gaa'idiin yichajju'u nufuushum be hiss aali.
Wa Bani Israa'iil ma'a l-Filistiyiin algaabalo le l-duwaas.
Wa Dawuud khalla khumaamah le l-haras hana l-khumaam wa jara bakaan al-harib wa sallam akhwaanah.
Wa wakit Dawuud gaa'id yikallim ma'a akhwaanah,tawwaali al-raajil al-Filisti al-faaris al-usmah Jaaluut min hillit Gaat marag min ust al-Filistiyiin wa gaal kalaamah al-awwal gaa'id yuguulah.Wa Dawuud simi' kalaamah da.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil chaafo al-raajil da,kaskaso minnah wa khaafo khoof chadiid.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil gaalo-:-Chiifu al-raajil al-gaa'id yamrug da-!Hu yichchammat le Bani Israa'iil-!Al-raajil al-yamrug leyah wa yaktulah,al-malik yisawwiih khani marra waahid.Wa yizawwijah bittah kula-!Wa le ahalah kula,ma yichiil minhum al-miiri.
Wa Dawuud sa'al al-rujaal al-gaa'idiin jambah wa gaal-:-Yantu chunu le l-naadum al-yaktul al-Filisti da wa yarfa' al-eeb min Bani Israa'iil-?Al-Filisti al-ma mutahhar da,hu yaatu achaan yichchammat fi deech Allah al-Hayy-?
Wa humman hajjo leyah al-kalaam battaan wa gaalo-:-Aywa-!Al-naadum al-yaktulah yalga kulla l-cheyy da-!
Wa wakit Aliyaab akhuuh al-kabiir simi' kalaam Dawuud al-gaa'id yikallim ma'a l-rujaal dool,hu zi'il za'al chadiid wa gaal leyah-:-Chunu jaabak hini-?Wa l-khanam khalleethum ma'a yaatu fi l-kadaade-?Ana na'arfak-!Inta mutakabbir wa galbak murr wa jiit le tichiif al-harib bas-!
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Ana sawweet chunu-?Mamnuu' leyi ma nikallim walla-?
Wa Dawuud anlafat min akhuuh wa sa'al naadum aakhar min al-kalaam da.Wa hu radda leyah nafs al-kalaam al-gaalah al-malik.
Wa naas waahidiin sim'o kalaam Dawuud wa kallamooh le Chaawuul.Wa tawwaali,hu rassal leyah wa naadaah.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Chaawuul-:-Khalli naadum waahid kula galbah ma yakhaaf min al-Filisti da-!Ana abdak namchi leyah wa nihaaribah.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le Dawuud-:-La-!Inta ma tagdar tihaarib al-Filisti da achaan inta wileed sakhayyar wa hu raajil kabiir wa muhaarib min hu sakhayyar.
Wa Dawuud radda le Chaawuul wa gaal-:-Ya siidi-!Wakit ana gaa'id nasrah be khanam abuuyi,kan duud aw dubb ja khataf waahide min khanami,
ana najri waraayah nadurbah wa nagla'ha minnah.Wa kan natta foogi,nakurbah min dignah wa nuduggah lahaddi naktulah.
Wa misil al-duud wa l-dubb al-abdak katalaahum,al-Filisti al-ma mutahhar da,hu kula ma yufuuthum.Achaan hu achchammat fi deech Allah al-Hayy-!
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Allah al-najjaani min al-duud wa l-dubb,hu yagdar yinajjiini min al-Filisti da. Wa Chaawuul gaal le Dawuud-:-Amchi-!Allah ma'aak.
Wa Chaawuul labbasah le Dawuud khulgaanah wa dassa leyah taagiiye hana nahaas fi raasah wa labbasah dir'ah.
Wa Dawuud rabat seefah fi sulbah min foog le khulgaanah wa dawwar yamchi.Wa laakin ma gidir yamchi achaan hu ma muwaalif beyah.Wa gaal le Chaawuul-:-Ana ma nagdar namchi be kulla l-khumaam da achaan ana ma muwaalif beyah. Wa khalaas,hu salla kulla l-khumaam da minnah.
Wa chaal asaatah fi iidah wa azzal khamsa hajar amlas min al-waadi wa dassaahum fi mukhlaatah hint al-raa'i.Wa chaal miglaa'ah fi iidah wa macha le l-Filisti.
Wa l-Filisti zahaf lahaddi ja gariib le Dawuud wa l-khaddaam al-yichiil leyah daragatah maachi giddaamah.
Wa l-Filisti chaafah le Dawuud wa hagarah achaan hu sakhayyar wa jamiil wa indah loon sameh.
Wa l-Filisti gaal le Dawuud-:-Ana kalib walla,inta taji leyi be asa-? Wa la'anah le Dawuud be ilaahaatah.
Wa gaal battaan-:-Ta'aal giddaam-!Khalli nanti lahamak le tuyuur al-sama wa le wuhuuch al-kadaade.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l-Filisti-:-Inta jiit leyi be seef wa harba wa tabiig.Wa laakin ana jiit leek be usum Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah askar Bani Israa'iil al-inta gaa'id tichammit fooghum.
Al-yoom Allah yarmiik fi iidi wa ana naktulak wa nagta' raasak.Wa nanti jisas al-Filistiyiin le tuyuur al-sama wa haywaanaat al-ard.Wa be da,kulla l-dunya ta'arif kadar Bani Israa'iil induhum Ilaah al-yihaarib leehum.
Wa kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin hini ya'arfu kadar Allah ma yansur be seef wa la be harba achaan Allah hu bas siid al-harib wa l-yoom yisallimku fi iideenna.
Wa wakit al-Filisti gamma macha le yilaagi Dawuud,Dawuud kula tawwaali jara macha leyah le yilaagiih.
Wa Dawuud dassa iidah fi mukhlaatah wa chaal hajar wa zaragah be l-miglaa' wa darab al-Filisti fi buguchtah.Wa l-hajar da dakhal fi raasah.Wa l-Filisti waga' be wijhah fi l-ard.
Wa be da,Dawuud annasar fi l-Filisti be l-miglaa' wa l-hajar bas.Hu darabah le l-Filisti wa katalah bala seef.
Wa Dawuud jara le l-Filisti wa salla seefah minnah wa tammamah.Wa beyah gata' raasah.Wa wakit al-Filistiyiin chaafo naadumhum al-faaris maat,humman arrado.
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil wa gabiilat Yahuuza aato wa taarado al-Filistiyiin lahaddi gariib le khachum al-waadi wa lahaddi khachum baab madiinat Akhruun.Wa jisas al-Filistiyiin muchattatiin fi derib hillit Cha'araayim lahaddi hillaal Gaat wa Akhruun.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gabbalo min mutaaradat al-Filistiyiin wa nahabo mu'askarhum.
Wa Dawuud chaal raas Jaaluut wa waddaah fi madiinat Uruchaliim.Wa silaahah kamaan,khattaahum fi kheemtah.
Wa wakit Dawuud macha le yilaagi al-Filisti,Chaawuul chaafah wa sa'al Abniir khaayid al-deech wa gaal-:-Ya Abniir,al-wileed da hana yaatu-? Wa Abniir gaal-:-Allah yansurak,ya l-malik-!Ana ma na'arfah.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Amchi as'al-!Al-sabi da wileed yaatu-?
Wa ba'ad Dawuud katal al-Filisti wa gabbal,Abniir chaalah wa waddaah giddaam Chaawuul.Wa raas Jaaluut fi iidah.
Wa Chaawuul sa'alah le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Inta wileed yaatu-? Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Ana wileed abdak Yassa al-min hillit Beet Laham.
Wa wakit Dawuud kammal kalaamah ma'a Chaawuul,Yuunataan galbah allag foog Dawuud wa hu habbaah misil nafsah.
Wa min al-yoom da,Chaawuul khatta Dawuud ma'aayah wa ma khallaah yigabbil bakaan abuuh.
Wa Yuunataan sawwa alaakha ma'a Dawuud achaan hu habbaah misil nafsah.
Wa Yuunataan salla jallaabiiytah wa antaaha le Dawuud.Wa antaah khulgaanah hana l-askar wa seefah wa nubbaalah wa hizaamah kula.
Wa fi ayyi muhimma al-Chaawuul yirassilah foogha,Dawuud yanjah.Wa Chaawuul khattaah khaayid fi l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin.Wa kulla l-cha'ab wa rujaal Chaawuul raadooh le Dawuud.
Wa ba'ad Dawuud katal Jaaluut al-Filisti,humman gabbalo min bakaan al-harib wa l-awiin al-min kulla hillaal balad Israa'iil maragan le yilaagan al-malik Chaawuul be khine wa li'ib wa nagaagiir wa jigindiiye wa zakhraat.
Wa hinna kullihin ke gaa'idaat yal'aban wa yikhannan wa yuguulan-:-Chaawuul katal aalaaf wa Dawuud katal acharaat al-aalaaf-!
Wa l-khine da harrag galib Chaawuul wa hu zi'il za'al chadiid wa fakkar wa gaal-:-Kan hinna yuguulan Dawuud katal acharaat al-aalaaf wa ana katalt aalaaf bas,faddal leyah illa l-muluk-!
Wa min al-yoom da,Chaawuul kirihah le Dawuud.
Wa ambaakir,ruuh fasle min al-ilaahaat jaat fi Chaawuul.Wa hu gaa'id yitnabba' fi beetah wa Dawuud kamaan gaa'id yudugg fi jigindiiytah misil awwal.Wa Chaawuul indah harba fi iidah.
Wa tawwaali,zaragah le Dawuud wa gaal fi nafsah-:-Khalli nilassigah fi l-durdur-! Laakin Dawuud khanas minnah marrateen.
Wa Chaawuul khaaf min Dawuud achaan Allah kaan ma'aayah wa khallaah leyah hu.
Wa fi chaan da,Chaawuul ba'adah minnah wa khattaah khaayid fi alif askar wa hu yamchi wa yaji fi raashum.
Wa Dawuud gaa'id yanjah fi l-harib achaan Allah ma'aayah.
Wa wakit Chaawuul chaaf Dawuud gaa'id yanjah be ziyaada fi l-harib,hu khaaf minnah bilheen.
Wa laakin kulla Bani Israa'iil wa naas gabiilat Yahuuza yiriiduuh le Dawuud achaan hu bas khaayid al-deech wa gaa'id yamchi wa yaji fi raashum.
Wa yoom waahid,Chaawuul gaal le Dawuud-:-Di hi bineeyti al-kabiire Miirab,nantiiha leek mara-!Wa laakin be chart tabga raajil fahal wa tihaarib fi huruub Allah. Wa fi galbah,Chaawuul gaal-:-Khalli ana ma naktulah laakin narmiih fi iid al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Dawuud radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana ke yaatu-?Wa khachum beet abuuyi fi Bani Israa'iil ke chunu-?Wa kikkeef nabga nasiib al-malik-?
Wa fi wakit al-Dawuud yichiil foogah martah Miirab bineeyit Chaawuul,tawwaali abuuha gamma antaaha le Adriyiil min hillit Mahuula.
Wa laakin Mikaal bineeyit Chaawuul al-sakhayre habbatah le Dawuud.Wa wakit Chaawuul sim'ah,hu firih
wa gaal fi galbah-:-Khalli nantiiha leyah achaan tabga leyah charak-!Wa l-Filistiyiin yaktuluuh-! Wa Chaawuul gaal le Dawuud-:-Hassa' da,di fursa aakhara al-beeha inta tabga nasiibi-!
Wa Chaawuul gaal le khaddaamiinah-:-Guulu le Dawuud be achiir-:--Al-malik farhaan beek wa kulla khaddaamiinah yihibbuuk.Ma taaba-!Abga nasiib al-malik-!-
Wa khaddaamiin Chaawuul gaalo al-kalaam da le Dawuud wa Dawuud gaal-:-Intu tichiifu al-cheyy da hayyiin,le nabga nasiib al-malik-?Ana miskiin wa ma nisaawi cheyy-!
Wa l-khaddaamiin jaabo al-radd hana Dawuud le l-malik.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Guulu le Dawuud-:--Al-malik ma bidoor minnak maal fi bineeytah.Laakin hu yidoor miya khulaf hana l-Filistiyiin al-taktulhum.Achaan Chaawuul yichiil al-taar fi udwaanah.-- Wa be da,Chaawuul yahsib yarmi Dawuud fi iid al-Filistiyiin.
Wa khaddaamiin Chaawuul hajjo be l-kalaam da le Dawuud.Wa hu khassad le yabga nasiib al-malik.Wa gubbaal al-wa'ad ma yitimm,
Dawuud chaal rujaalah wa macha katal miiteen rujaal min al-Filistiyiin.Wa jaab adad al-khulaf wa antaahum le l-malik achaan yabga nasiibah.Wa khalaas,Chaawuul antaah bineeytah Mikaal.
Wa Chaawuul irif tamaam kadar Allah gaa'id ma'a Dawuud wa bineeytah Mikaal kula habbatah.
Wa be da,Chaawuul khaaf min Dawuud be ziyaada.Wa min al-yoom da,hu chaafah misil aduuh.
Wa fi ayyi wakit kan kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin yahjumu,Dawuud yinnasir fooghum.Wa nasrah bigi ziyaada min nasur kulla l-khuyyaad al-aakhariin hana Chaawuul.Wa be da,usmah tala'.
Wa Chaawuul kallam le wileedah Yuunataan wa kulla khaddaamiinah kadar hu yidoor yaktul Dawuud.Wa laakin Yuunataan wileed Chaawuul indah mahabba chadiide le Dawuud.
Wa Yuunataan ja khabbarah le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:-Abuuyi Chaawuul yidoor yaktulak-!Abga hadiir ambaakir fajur.Fattich leek bakaan wa allabbadt foogah.
Wa ana namrug wa namchi ma'a abuuyi fi l-zere' al-inta mullabbid foogah.Wa ana nihajji leyah beek wa nasma' hu yuguul chunu.Wa ba'adeen nikhabbirak.
Wa Yuunataan hajja le Chaawuul abuuh be kulla l-kheer al-Dawuud sawwaah wa gaal-:-Ya l-malik-!Ma takhta fi khaddaamak Dawuud achaan hu ma khiti foogak.Wa hu sawwa leek daayman al-kheer.
Wa dassa nafsah fi l-khutuura wakit hu katal al-Filisti.Wa be da,Allah nasar kulla Bani Israa'iil nasur kabiir.Wa inta zaatak chiftah wa firiht beyah.Wa maala takhta wa tidaffig damm hana insaan bari misil Dawuud wa taktulah bala janiiye-?
Wa Chaawuul simi' kalaam Yuunataan wileedah wa halaf wa gaal-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy,battaan le Dawuud ma naktulah-!
Wa khalaas,Yuunataan naadaah le Dawuud wa khabbarah be kulla l-kalaam da.Wa battaan jaab Dawuud le abuuh Chaawuul.Wa Dawuud gaa'id yakhdim leyah misil awwal.
Wa l-harib ma'a l-Filistiyiin bada battaan wa Dawuud macha hajamaahum wa khassaraahum khasaara kabiire.Wa humman arrado minnah.
Wa ruuh fasle min Allah nazalat fi Chaawuul.Wa hu gaa'id fi beetah wa haribtah fi iidah.Wa Dawuud kamaan gaa'id yudugg fi jigindiiytah.
Wa Chaawuul dawwar yilassigah le Dawuud fi l-durdur be haribtah.Wa laakin Dawuud khanas wa l-harba lisgat fi l-durdur.Wa be da,Dawuud jara faat fi l-leele di.
Wa Chaawuul rassal naas fi beet Dawuud le yiraakhubuuh wa ambaakir fajur kamaan,yaktuluuh.Laakin Mikaal marit Dawuud khabbarat raajilha wa gaalat-:-Kan ma arradt fi l-leele di,ambaakir fajur yaktuluuk-!
Wa khalaas,Mikaal saa'adat raajilha Dawuud wa maragatah min al-chubbaak.Wa be misil da,Dawuud arrad wa niji.
Wa ba'ad da,Mikaal chaalat sanam wa raggadatah fi l-sariir wa khattat farwa hana khanam fi raasah wa khattatah be khalag.
Wa wakit Chaawuul rassal naas le yakurbu Dawuud,Mikaal gaalat leehum-:-Hu mardaan.
Wa Chaawuul gabbalaahum le l-naas dool wa gaal-:-Jiibuuh leyi fi lubb sariirah le nitammimah marra waahid-!
Wa wakit al-rujaal dakhalo fi beet Dawuud,ma ligooh.Laakin ligo al-sanam fi l-sariir wa farwit al-khanam fi raasah.
Wa Chaawuul naadaaha le Mikaal wa gaal leeha-:-Maala khachcheetiini wa khalleeti aduuyi jara wa niji-? Wa Mikaal raddat le Chaawuul wa gaalat-:-Hu gaal leyi-:--Khalliini namchi-!Walla tidoori naktulki-?-
Wa be misil da,Dawuud arrad wa niji.Wa macha le Samuwiil fi hillit al-Raama wa hajja leyah be kulla cheyy al-Chaawuul sawwaah leyah.Wa humman gammo macho sakano fi hillit Nayuut.
Wa naas jo khabbaro Chaawuul wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu Dawuud macha Nayuut,gariib le hillit al-Raama.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul rassal naas le yakurbu Dawuud.Wa laakin wakit wassalo,chaafo majmuu'a min al-anbiya gaa'idiin yitnabba'o wa fi raashum Samuwiil waagif be tuulah.Wa Ruuh Allah nazal fi l-naas al-rassaloohum wa humman kula bado yitnabba'o.
Wa jo khabbaro Chaawuul be l-cheyy da wa hu gamma rassal naas aakhariin.Laakin humman kula bado yitnabba'o.Wa rassal naas aakhariin le taalit marra wa humman dool kula bado yitnabba'o.
Wa fi l-akhiir,Chaawuul zaatah gamma macha le hillit al-Raama.Wa wakit wisil fi l-biir al-kabiire al-gaa'ide fi hillit Siiku,hu sa'al wa gaal-:-Ween Samuwiil wa Dawuud-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Humman gaa'idiin fi Nayuut gariib le hillit al-Raama.
Wa wakit hu maachi le Nayuut gariib le hillit al-Raama,Ruuh Allah nazal foogah hu kula wa maachi wa gaa'id yitnabba' lahaddi wisil fi Nayuut.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul salla khalagah wa hu kula gaa'id yitnabba' giddaam Samuwiil.Wa waga' aryaan wa gaa'id waagi' tuul al-yoom da wa tuul al-leele di.Wa be sabab da bas,al-naas yuguulu-:-Chaawuul kula bigi nabi ma'aahum walla-?
Wa Dawuud arrad min hillit Nayuut al-gariibe le hillit al-Raama wa ja ligaah le Yuunataan wa gaal leyah-:-Chunu al-ana sawweetah le abuuk-?Chunu al-khata wa l-zanib al-ana sawweetah le abuuk achaan hu yidoor yaktulni-?
Wa Yuunataan radda leyah wa gaal-:-Abadan ma yaktulak-!Abuuyi ma yisawwi cheyy wa la kabiir wa la sakhayyar kan ma khabbaraani.Maala hu yilabbid leyi cheyy misil da-?Da ma sahiih-!
Wa Dawuud halaf le Yuunataan wa gaal-:-Abuuk ya'arif adiil kadar inta radyaan beyi.Wa gaal fi nafsah-:--Khalli Yuunataan ma yasma' be l-cheyy da achaan da ma yabga leyah gaasi-!- Wa laakin ana nahlif leek be Allah al-Hayy wa be hayaatak inta,ma faddal beeni wa been al-moot illa chibir bas-!
Wa Yuunataan gaal le Dawuud-:-Ana nisawwi leek al-cheyy al-inta tidoorah.
Wa Dawuud radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ambaakir da iid hana awwal yoom fi l-chahar.Waajib ana nil'achcha ma'a l-malik.Laakin khalliini namchi nillabbad fi l-kadaade lahaddi l-achiiye.
Wa kan abuuk fagadaani,guul leyah-:--Dawuud chaal minni izin le yamchi hillitah Beet Laham achaan yahdar fi gaddimiin al-dahiiye al-sanawiiye ma'a ahalah.--
Wa kan abuuk gaal-:--Sameh--,khalaas ana abdak nagood be salaam.Laakin kan hu zi'il kamaan,inta ta'arif kadar hu chaal niiye le yiwaddirni.
Wa inta,sawwi leyi al-kheer achaan ana wa inta sawweena alaakha giddaam Allah.Wa kan ana khitiit fi ayyi cheyy,aktulni inta bas wa laakin ma tisallimni le abuuk-!
Wa Yuunataan radda leyah wa gaal-:-Abadan da ma nisawwiih-!Kan ana irift abuuyi yidoor yiwaddirak,akiid ana nikhabbirak tawwaali-!
Wa Dawuud gaal le Yuunataan-:-Kikkeef tagdar tikhabbirni kan radd abuuk ma ajabaak-?
Wa Yuunataan gaal le Dawuud-:-Ta'aal namchu fi l-kadaade. Wa khalaas,humman al-itneen macho fi l-kadaade.
Wa Yuunataan gaal le Dawuud-:-Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil yachhad,ambaakir aw ambukra fi nafs al-wakit,ana nas'al abuuyi wa nichiif fikrah.Kan hu ma indah leek cheyy fi galbah,ana nirassil leek wa nufukk adaanak.
Wa laakin khalli Allah yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid kan ana ma khabbartak kadar abuuyi yidoor yisawwi leek cheyy fasil wa ma khalleetak macheet be l-salaama-!Khalli Allah yukuun ma'aak misil hu kaan ma'a abuuyi awwal.
Wa fi wakit al-ana lissaa' gaa'id hayy,sawwi leyi al-kheer hasab alaakhitna al-sawweenaaha giddaam Allah.Wa kan ana mutt kula,
sawwi al-kheer le zurriiyti hatta wakit Allah yuguchch kulla udwaanak min wijh al-ard.
Wa Yuunataan sawwa alaakha ma'a Dawuud wa zurriiytah wa gaal-:-Khalli Allah yi'aakhib udwaan Dawuud-!
Wa Yuunataan hallaf Dawuud battaan be mahabbitah leyah achaan hu yihibbah misil nafsah.
Wa Yuunataan gaal leyah-:-Ambaakir iid hana awwal yoom fi l-chahar.Bakaanak fi l-akil yukuun faadi wa nafguduuk.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,inta anzil wa amchi allabbad fi l-bakaan al-inta allabbadt foogah yoom al-muchkila.Wa agood jamb al-hajar al-usmah al-Furga.
Wa ana nazrug talaata nuchchaab ale l-jiihe al-inta mullabbid foogha misil gaa'id nusuub cheyy.
Wa ana nirassil wileed wa nuguul leyah-:--Amchi jiib leyi al-nuchchaab-!- Wa kan gult leyah-:--Ta'aal,al-nuchchaab jaaye minnak--,khalaas inta tagdar taji be salaam achaan cheyy ma fiih.Wa da,ana nahlif leek be Allah al-Hayy.
Wa laakin kan ana gult le l-wileed-:--Daahu al-nuchchaab khaadi minnak--,khalaas amchi achaan Allah yidoor inta tufuut.
Wa Allah yachhad fi l-alaakha al-beeni wa beenak ila l-abad.
Wa Dawuud macha allabbad fi l-kadaade.Wa awwal yoom hana l-chahar ja wa l-malik ga'ad le l-akil.
Wa misil fi aadtah,al-malik ga'ad fi bakaanah jamb al-durdur wa Abniir ga'ad jambah.Wa Yuunataan kamaan gaabalah wa ga'ad.Wa laakin bakaan Dawuud gaa'id faadi.
Wa Chaawuul ma gaal cheyy fi l-yoom da achaan hu gaal fi nafsah-:-Akuun hasal leyah cheyy wa hu bigi ma taahir.
Wa ambaakir fi l-yoom al-taani hana l-chahar,Chaawuul fagadah le Dawuud.Wa hu sa'alah le wileedah Yuunataan wa gaal-:-Maala wileed Yassa ma ja wa la amis wa la l-yoom-?
Wa Yuunataan gaal le abuuh-:-Dawuud chahadaani dawwar yamchi fi hillit Beet Laham
wa gaal leyi-:--Min iznak,khalliini namchi achaan ahali induhum dahiiye fi hillitna.Wa akhuuyi gaal leyi nahdar.Wa hassa' kan inta ridiit leyi,khalliini namchi nichiif akhwaani.- Wa be sabab da,hu ma gidir yahdar ma'a l-malik fi l-akil.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Chaawuul zi'il za'al chadiid didd Yuunataan wa gaal leyah-:-Wald al-azaba-!Al-mukhaalif-!Inta tahsib ana ma na'arfah kadar inta indak rafag ma'a wileed Yassa walla-?Wa be da,inta tijiib al-eeb fi raasak inta wa fi raas ammak al-charmuuta-!
Asma',wileed Yassa kan gaa'id hayy,inta ma indak amin wa mamlakatak kula ma tabga gawiiye.Hassa' da,amchi jiibah leyi-!Hu da,waajib leyah al-moot-!
Wa Yuunataan gaal le abuuh Chaawuul-:-Maala yaktuluuh-?Hu sawwa chunu-?
Wa Chaawuul chaal haribtah wa zarag beeha Yuunataan wa yidoor yat'anah.Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Yuunataan irif kadar abuuh chaal niiye le yaktul Dawuud.
Wa Yuunataan zi'il za'al chadiid wa gamma.Wa min al-za'al fi l-yoom al-taani hana l-chahar da,hu ma gidir akal achaan abuuh ayyar Dawuud.
Wa ambaakir be fajur,Yuunataan gamma macha fi l-kadaade fi l-wa'ad al-sawwaah ma'a Dawuud.Wa chaal ma'aayah wileed sakhayyar.
Wa Yuunataan gaal le l-wileed-:-Ajri amchi jiib al-nuchchaab al-ana nazurgah. Wa l-wileed jara giddaam wa Yuunataan zarag al-nuchchaab ba'iid minnah.
Wa wakit al-wileed wassal fi l-bakaan al-Yuunataan zarag foogah al-nuchchaab,Yuunataan gaal leyah-:-Al-nuchchaab lissaa' khaadi minnak-!
Wa Yuunataan gaal leyah battaan-:-Ajala be sur'a-!Ma tagiif-! Wa l-wileed chaal al-nuchchaab wa jaabah le sayyidah.
Wa l-wileed ma irif cheyy wa laakin Yuunataan wa Dawuud bas ya'arfuuh.
Wa Yuunataan anta kulla silaahah le l-wileed wa gaal leyah-:-Waddiih al-beet.
Wa ba'ad al-wileed faat,Dawuud marag min al-bakaan al-mullabbid foogah fi nuss al-wati hana l-hajar wa waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaam Yuunataan talaata marraat.Wa l-rufgaan al-itneen alhaadano wa bako wa laakin Dawuud baka ziyaada.
Wa khalaas,Yuunataan gaal le Dawuud-:-Amchi be l-salaama-!Achaan aniina al-itneen halafna be usum Allah wa gulna Allah yachhad beeni wa beenak wa been zurriiyti wa zurriiytak ila l-abad. Wa khalaas,Dawuud gamma faat wa Yuunataan kamaan gabbal al-madiina.
Wa Dawuud macha fi hillit Nuub al-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah Akhiimalik raajil al-diin.Wa wakit Akhiimalik chaaf Dawuud,gaa'id yarjif.Wa gamma laagaah wa gaal-:-Maala naadum ma'aak ma fiih-?
Wa Dawuud gaal le Akhiimalik raajil al-diin-:-Al-malik amaraani wa gaal leyi ma nuguul cheyy le naadum be l-muhimma al-rassalaani foogha.Achaan da bas,ana waa'adt naasi yarjooni fi bakaan ma'ruuf.
Wa hassa' da,indak chunu-?Antiini khamsa khubza walla kan cheyy aakhar kula.
Wa Akhiimalik gaal le Dawuud-:-Ana ma indi khubza aadiiye illa l-khubza al-mukhaddasa.Wa nantiiha leek illa kan naasak ma limso awiin.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Akhiimalik raajil al-diin-:-Aywa,akiid al-awiin mamnuu'aat leena min amis wa min awwal kula.Wa da misil fi aadti wakit namrug le l-harib.Hatta fi l-muhimma al-aadiiye kula,naasi jisimhum taahir.Maala jisimhum ma yukuun taahir fi muhimma mukhaddasa misil di-?
Wa khalaas,raajil al-diin anta al-khubza al-mukhaddasa le Dawuud.Achaan ma fi khubza aakhara illa l-khubza al-gaddamooha le Allah.Wa l-khubza di,hi al-khayyarooha be khubza jadiide wa haamiye.
Wa fi l-yoom da,fiyah khaddaam hana Chaawuul gaa'id fi bakaan ibaadat Allah.Wa hu naadum min balad Adoom usmah Duwaag kabiir al-ru'yaan hana Chaawuul.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Akhiimalik-:-Daahu be khafla al-malik dawwaraani le l-muhimma di wa ana ma jiit be seef wa la be silaah aakhar.Hal indak harba walla seef tantiini-?
Wa raajil al-diin gaal-:-Illa l-seef hana Jaaluut al-Filisti al-inta kataltah fi waadi al-Butum.Da gaa'id mulawlaw be git'e wara l-farmala.Chiilah kan tidoorah achaan ma fi seef aakhar hini. Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Seef misil hu da ma fiih.Jiibah leyi-!
Wa fi l-yoom da,Dawuud arrad ba'iid min Chaawuul wa macha bakaan Akiich malik hana hillit Gaat.
Wa khaddaamiin Akiich gaalo leyah-:-Da ma Dawuud malik balad Israa'iil walla-?Da ma hu al-bikhannu beyah wa buguulu-:--Chaawuul katal aalaaf wa Dawuud katal acharaat al-aalaaf-?-
Wa l-kalaam da barjalah le Dawuud wa hu khaaf ziyaada min Akiich malik Gaat.
Wa khalaas,hu sawwa nafsah misil muchootin fi usuthum wa gaa'id yichakhkhit fi l-biibaan wa riyaaltah tisiil fi dignah.
Wa Akiich gaal le khaddaamiinah-:-Al-raajil da muchootin-!Maala jibtuuh leyi-?
Ana mugassir leyi muchootiniin walla-?Maala tijiibu leyi muchootin yisawwi chawaatiinah giddaami hini-?Maala hu yadkhul fi beeti-?
Wa min al-bakaan da,Dawuud macha allabbad fi karkuur Adullaam.Wa wakit akhwaanah wa ahalah sim'o khabarah,gammo andammo leyah hinaak.
Wa kulla l-naas al-ta'baaniin wa l-naas al-taradoohum al-duyuun wa l-naas al-za'laaniin min al-hukum macho lammo ma'aayah wa hu bigi fooghum khaayid.Wa be da,adad al-naas al-ma'aayah bigi hawaale 400 raajil.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud macha fi hillit Misfa fi balad Muwaab.Wa gaal le malik Muwaab-:-Min fadlak,anti izin le abuuyi wa ammi yaju yagoodu fi bakaanak lahaddi nichiif al-cheyy al-yisawwiih leyi al-Rabb.
Wa hu chaalaahum wa waddaahum giddaam al-malik wa humman ga'ado ma'aayah kulla l-mudda al-Dawuud gaa'id foogha fi l-bakaan al-gawi.
Wa yoom waahid,al-nabi Gaad gaal le Dawuud-:-Ma tagood fi l-bakaan al-gawi hini,amchi fi balad Yahuuza. Wa Dawuud gamma wa macha fi l-khaaba al-usumha Haarit.
Wa Chaawuul simi' be l-bakaan al-gaa'idiin foogah Dawuud wa l-rujaal al-ma'aayah.Wa da wakit Chaawuul gaa'id fi hillit Gibee'a tihit al-ardeebaay al-gaa'ide foog fi l-hajar wa haribtah fi iidah wa khaddaamiinah kulluhum gaa'idiin ma'aayah.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le khaddaamiinah al-gaa'idiin jambah-:-Min fadulku asma'o,ya naas Banyaamiin-!Hal wileed Yassa yantiiku kulluku ziraa'a wa jineenaat inab walla-?Wa yidarrijku khuyyaad fi aalaaf wa fi miyaat walla-?
Wa kan ma fiih,maala kulluku wagaftu diddi-?Naadum waahid minku ma kallamaani kadar wileedi sawwa alaakha ma'a wileed Yassa.Wa naadum waahid minku ma hanna foogi walla ja kallamaani kadar wileedi gaa'id yilizz abdi diddi wa yukujj leyi charak misil al-yoom hu gaa'id yisawwiih.
Wa Duwaag al-Adoomi gaa'id ma'a khaddaamiin Chaawuul wa gaal-:-Yoom waahid,ana chift wileed Yassa macha fi hillit Nuub bakaan Akhiimalik wileed Akhituub.
Wa Akhiimalik sa'al Allah fi chaanah wa antaah akil wa antaah seef hana Jaaluut al-Filisti kula.
Wa ba'ad da,Chaawuul rassal naadaah le raajil al-diin Akhiimalik wileed Akhituub wa kulla ahalah al-humman kula rujaal al-diin al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Nuub.Wa kulluhum jo giddaam al-malik.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le Akhiimalik-:-Asma',ya wileed Akhituub-! Wa hu gaal-:-Na'am,ya siidi.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Maala inta wa wileed Yassa atmarradtu diddi-?Wa inta anteetah khubza wa seef.Wa battaan sa'alt al-Rabb fi chaanah le yugumm diddi wa yukujj leyi charak misil al-yoom hu gaa'id yisawwiih.
Wa Akhiimalik radda leyah wa gaal-:-Yaatu min kulla khaddaamiinak amiin misil Dawuud-?Wa hu nasiib al-malik wa bigi harasak wa mukarram ziyaada fi beetak inta al-malik-!
Hal di awwal marra ana sa'alt al-Rabb fi chaanah walla-?La,di ma awwal marra-!Wa laakin khalli al-malik ma yukhutt al-tuhma di foogi ana wa la fi ahali achaan ana abdak ma na'arif foogah cheyy.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-La,ya Akhiimalik,akiid inta tumuut-!Inta wa ahalak kulluku tumuutu-!
Wa l-malik amar al-hurraas al-gaa'idiin jambah wa gaal-:-Yalla-!Aktulu kulla rujaal al-diin hana Allah achaan humman saa'ado Dawuud.Humman irfo kadar hu mu'arrid wa ma jo kallamooni-! Wa laakin kulla rujaal al-haras abo ma yaktulu rujaal al-diin hana Allah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-malik gaal le Duwaag-:-Yalla-!Inta bas aktul rujaal al-diin dool-! Wa Duwaag al-Adoomi gamma katalaahum.Wa fi l-yoom da,katal 85 rujaal al-diin kulluhum laabsiin khulgaan rujaal al-diin.
Wa battaan hu katal be l-seef kulla naas Nuub hillit rujaal al-diin wa ma khalla wa la awiin wa la rujaal wa la iyaal wa la atfaal wa la bagar wa la hamiir wa la khanam.Kulluhum katalaahum be l-seef.
Wa naadum waahid bas niji.Wa hu Abiyaatar wileed Akhiimalik wileed Akhituub.Wa hu arrad wa lihig Dawuud.
Wa Abiyaatar khabbarah le Dawuud kadar Chaawuul katal rujaal al-diin hana Allah.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Abiyaatar-:-Al-yoom daak,ana irift kadar Duwaag al-Adoomi yikhabbirah le Chaawuul be kulla cheyy.Wa ana bas bigiit sabab fi moot ahalak.
Wa hassa' da,agood ma'aayi,ma takhaaf-!Achaan al-yaktulak inta,ma yikhalliini ana kula.Laakin fi jambi ana da,inta fi amaan.
Wa yoom waahid,jo khabbaro Dawuud wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu al-Filistiyiin hajamo hillit Kha'iila wa nahabo al-makhaazin hana l-gameh.
Wa Dawuud sa'al Allah wa gaal-:-Ya Rabb,namchi nihaarib al-Filistiyiin walla-? Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi haaribhum wa inta tinajji Kha'iila.
Laakin al-rujaal al-ma'a Dawuud gaalo leyah-:-Wakit aniina hini fi balad Yahuuza kula,aniina khaayfiin-!Wa kan macheena fi Kha'iila le nihaarubu deech al-Filistiyiin,da ma yabga leena gaasi walla-?
Wa battaan Dawuud sa'al Allah.Wa Allah radda leyah wa gaal-:-Gumm-!Amchi wa anzil fi Kha'iila wa ana nisallim al-Filistiyiin leek fi iidak.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud chaal naasah wa gamma macha Kha'iila wa haarab al-Filistiyiin.Wa annasar fooghum nasur kabiir wa chaal bahaayimhum wa najja sukkaan Kha'iila.
Wa gabul da,wakit Abiyaatar wileed Akhiimalik arrad wa macha lihig Dawuud fi hillit Kha'iila,chaal sideeriiyit al-kharaar wa waddaaha ma'aayah.
Wa wakit Chaawuul simi' kadar Dawuud gaa'id fi hillit Kha'iila,hu gaal-:-Al-yoom,al-Rabb sallamah leyi fi iidi-!Achaan hu ja dakhal fi hille al-indaha biibaan yilgaffalo.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul lamma kulla askarah le yamchu Kha'iila yihaasuru Dawuud wa naasah.
Wa Dawuud simi' kadar Chaawuul khattat al-fasaala diddah wa gaal le raajil al-diin Abiyaatar-:-Jiib al-sideeriiye achaan nas'alo Allah.
Wa Dawuud sa'al wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,ana abdak simi't kadar Chaawuul indah niiye yaji fi Kha'iila wa yidammir al-hille di fi chaani ana.
Wa kubaaraat Kha'iila yisallumuuni leyah walla-?Wa hu yaji misil ana abdak simi'tah walla-?Ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,khabbirni ana abdak-! Wa Allah gaal-:-Aywa,Chaawuul yaji.
Wa Dawuud gaal battaan-:-Wa kubaaraat Kha'iila yisallumuuni le Chaawuul,ana wa naasi walla-? Wa Allah gaal-:-Aywa,humman yisallumuuku leyah kulluku.
Wa tawwaali,Dawuud wa naasah al-adadhum hawaale 600 marago min hillit Kha'iila wa faato bakaan aakhar.Wa Chaawuul simi' khabar Dawuud arrad min hillit Kha'iila wa khalaas,khalla mutaaradatah.
Wa Dawuud macha fi kadaadit Ziif wa sakan fi jibaalha fi l-wa'ar.Wa fi tuul al-wakit,Chaawuul gaa'id yifattichah wa laakin al-Rabb ma sallamah leyah fi iidah.
Wa Dawuud gaa'id fi l-khaaba fi kadaadit Ziif wa simi' kadar Chaawuul gaa'id yifattichah wa yidoor yaktulah.
Wa Yuunataan wileed Chaawuul macha le Dawuud fi l-khaaba le yichajji'ah fi iimaanah be l-Rabb.
Wa gaal leyah-:-Ma takhaaf achaan abuuyi Chaawuul ma yalgaak le yaktulak.Wa inta tahkim fi Israa'iil wa ana nabga naaybak.Wa da abuuyi zaatah ya'arfah-!
Wa khalaas,humman al-itneen jaddado alaakhithum giddaam Allah.Wa ba'ad da,Yuunataan gabbal beetah wa Dawuud ga'ad fi l-khaaba.
Wa l-naas al-saakniin fi kadaadit Ziif macho le Chaawuul fi hillit Gibee'a wa gaalo leyah-:-Dawuud mullabbid fi baladna fi l-khaaba fi raas hajar Hakiila,wati le Yachiimuun.
Hassa' da,ya l-malik,kan tidoor taji leena,ta'aal-!Wa aniina nisallumuuh leek fi iidak.
Wa Chaawuul gaal leehum-:-Allah yibaarikku achaan intu hanneetu foogi-!
Hassa' da,amchu akkudu adiil min al-bakaan al-hu gaa'id foogah wa min al-naadum al-chaafah achaan ana simi't hu najiid bilheen.
Chiifu wa a'arfu kulla l-bakaan al-yillabbad foogah.Akkudu minnah wa ta'aalu leyi wa ana namchi ma'aaku.Wa khalaas,kan hu gaa'id fi lubb al-balad di,ana nalgaah kan nifattichah fi lubb kulla khuchuum buyuut Yahuuza kula-!
Wa l-naas al-saakniin fi kadaadit Ziif gaddamo le Chaawuul.Wa Dawuud wa naasah kamaan gaa'idiin fi saharat Maa'oon,wati le Yachiimuun.
Wa Chaawuul chaal askarah wa macha yifattich Dawuud wa jo khabbaro Dawuud.Wa hu dalla min raas al-hajar wa ga'ad fi saharat Maa'oon.Wa Chaawuul simi' wa bada yitaaridah le Dawuud fi saharat Maa'oon.
Wa Chaawuul maachi be l-nuss al-waahid hana l-hajar wa Dawuud wa naasah maachiin be l-nuss al-aakhar.Wa Dawuud maachi ajala le yi'arrid min Chaawuul wa Chaawuul wa naasah kamaan yidooru yihawwuguuhum le Dawuud wa naasah le yikarrubuuhum.
Wa laakin mursaal waahid ja wa gaal le Chaawuul-:-Ta'aal ajala-!Al-Filistiyiin hajamo al-balad-!
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul gabbal wa khalla mutaaradat Dawuud wa macha le yihaarib al-Filistiyiin.Wa achaan da,sammo al-bakaan da hajar al-Mufaaraga.
Wa Dawuud marag min al-mantaga di wa macha sakan fi l-wa'ar hana Een Jidi.
Wa wakit Chaawuul gabbal min muhaarabat al-Filistiyiin,khabbarooh kadar Dawuud gaa'id fi kadaadit Een Jidi.
Wa Chaawuul lamma 3-000 raajil min ahsan al-muhaaribiin min kulla Bani Israa'iil wa macha yifattich Dawuud wa naasah jamb al-hajar al-binaaduuh hajar al-Khazaal.
Wa wakit wassalo fi zaraayib al-khanam al-gariib le l-derib,Chaawuul chaaf karkuur wa dakhal foogah wa gangas le yistariih.Wa Dawuud wa naasah kamaan gaa'idiin fi lubb al-karkuur da.
Wa khalaas,naasah le Dawuud waswaso leyah wa gaalo-:-Daahu al-yoom al-Allah hajja leek foogah wa gaal-:--Ana nisallim leek aduuk.Wa be da,sawwi leyah kulla cheyy al-tidoorah.-- Wa Dawuud gamma addabba wa gata' khachum khalag Chaawuul min wara.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud galbah ma bigi leyah halu achaan hu gata' khachum khalag Chaawuul.
Wa gaal le naasah-:-Allah yi'aakhibni kan ana sawweet cheyy fasil le siidi Chaawuul al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik-!Ana ma nukhutt iidi foogah achaan Allah bas azalah.
Wa be misil da,Dawuud kallam le naasah wa daharaahum ma yahjumu Chaawuul.Wa Chaawuul marag min al-karkuur wa faat.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud kula marag waraayah min al-karkuur wa naadaah wa gaal-:-Ya siidi al-malik-! Wa Chaawuul chaglab wa chaaf waraayah.Wa Dawuud dangar fi l-ard wa sajad.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Chaawuul-:-Maala tasma' kalaam al-naas al-buguulu-:--Dawuud yidoor yisawwi leek cheyy fasil-?--
Daahu al-yoom inta chift be eenak Allah sallamaak leyi fi iidi fi lubb al-karkuur-!Wa naasi gaalo leyi naktulak.Wa laakin ana hanneet foogak wa ma maddeet iidi aleek inta,ya siidi,achaan inta bas al-Allah masahak wa darrajak malik-!
Chiif,ya abuuyi-!Al-fi iidi,da ma khachum khalagak walla-?Kan ana gidirt gata'at khachum khalagak wa ma kataltak da,a'arif kadar ana ma mu'aarid wa la khaayin wa ma sawweet khata diddak inta.Laakin inta bas gaa'id titaaridni wa tidoor taktulni-!
Wa khalli Allah yahkim beeni wa beenak wa yikaffiini kulla l-fasaala al-inta gaa'id tisawwiiha leyi.Laakin ana ke ma nukhutt iidi foogak-!
Misil al-masal al-gadiim buguul-:--Min naas al-fasliin bas taji al-fasaala.- Wa laakin ana ke,ma nukhutt iidi foogak-!
Wa Dawuud gaal battaan-:-Didd yaatu marag malik Israa'iil-?Inta maragt wara kalib mayyit walla wara gamulaay bas-?
Wa Allah hu al-haakim wa yahkim beeni wa beenak wa yichiif muchkilti wa yidaafi' leyi wa yibarriini wa yinajjiini min iidak inta.
Wa ba'ad Dawuud kammal kalaamah le Chaawuul,Chaawuul gaal-:-Ya wileedi Dawuud,kalaamak sahiih-! Wa Chaawuul gamma baka baki chadiid
wa gaal battaan le Dawuud-:-Inta saalih ziyaada minni ana achaan inta sawweet leyi al-kheer wa laakin ana sawweet leek al-charr.
Wa l-yoom,inta sawweet leyi al-kheer wakit Allah sallamaani leek fi iidak wa inta ma kataltini.
Yaatu al-ligi aduuh wa khallaah macha be l-salaama-?Allah yi'aajirak fi l-kheer al-inta sawweetah leyi al-yoom-!
Wa hassa',ana akkadt inta tabga malik wa mamlakat Israa'iil tagood saabte fi iideenak.
Wa hassa' da,ahlif leyi be Allah wa akkid leyi ma taktul zurriiyti ba'ad mooti wa ma tuguchch usmi min lubb ahali.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud halaf le Chaawuul.Wa ba'ad da,Chaawuul gabbal beetah wa Dawuud ma'a naasah kamaan gabbalo fi bakaanhum al-gawi.
Wa Samuwiil maat wa dafanooh fi beetah fi hillit al-Raama.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil lammo wa bako leyah.Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud macha fi kadaadit Faaraan.
Wa fi hillit Maa'oon,fiyah raajil waahid indah maal katiir wa maalah da gaa'id fi hillit Karmal.Hu indah 3-000 khanam dawaayin wa 1-000 inze.Wa macha fi hillit Karmal le yagta' suuf khanamah.
Wa l-raajil da usmah Naabaal wa martah usumha Abigaayil.Hi mara aagle wa samha bilheen wa laakin raajilha iideenah gawi wa hawaan.Wa hu min khachum beet Kaalib.
Wa fi l-kadaade,Dawuud simi' kadar Naabaal macha yagta' suuf khanamah.
Wa Dawuud rassal achara subyaan wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu hillit Karmal wa talgo Naabaal.Wa waddu leyah salaami wa guulu leyah-:
--Ti'iich daayman-!Wa l-salaam aleek wa le ahalak wa le kulla maalak-!
Wa hassa' da,ana simi't kadar inta jiit ma'a naasak le tagta' suuf khanamak.Wa wakit ru'yaanak ga'ado ma'aana,aniina ma sawweena leehum cheyy fasil.Wa cheyy waahid kula ma waddar leehum wakit humman ga'ado fi Karmal.
As'al naasak wa humman yi'ooruuk-!Wa khalli naasi yalgo minnak rida achaan aniina jiina fi yoom al-iid.Wa min fadlak,anti al-cheyy al-tagdar tantiih le abiidak wa le wileedak Dawuud.-
Wa wakit subyaan Dawuud wassalo bakaan Naabaal,hajjo leyah be kulla l-kalaam al-Dawuud rassalaahum beyah.Wa ga'ado yarjo.
Wa Naabaal gaal le naas Dawuud-:-Dawuud da,hu yaatu-?Wileed Yassa da,hu yaatu-?Fi wakitna da,fiyah abiid katiiriin al-yi'arrudu min siyaadhum-!
Wa ana kamaan,kikkeef nichiil khubziti wa almiiyi wa lahami al-jahhaztah le naasi wa nantiih le naas al-ma na'arifhum jaayiin min ween kula-?
Wa khalaas,subyaan Dawuud gammo gabbalo.Wa wakit wassalo,hajjo le Dawuud be kulla l-kalaam da.
Wa Dawuud gaal le naasah-:-Khalli ayyi waahid minku yichiil seefah-! Wa khalaas,ayyi waahid chaal seefah wa rabatah fi sulbah.Wa Dawuud kula chaal hanaayah wa macho.Wa l-macho,adadhum 400 raajil wa 200 kamaan ga'ado ma'a l-khumaam.
Wa waahid min khaddaamiin Naabaal ja khabbar Abigaayil marit Naabaal be kulla cheyy al-hasal wa gaal leeha-:-Daahu Dawuud rassal naasah jo min al-kadaade le yisallumu siidna.Laakin hu ma rahhab beehum.
Wa l-naas dool zeeniin leena marra waahid wakit aniina ga'adna ma'aahum fi l-kadaade wa ma sawwo leena cheyy fasil.Wa min maalna kula,cheyy ma waddar.
Leel wa nahaar,humman bigo leena misil al-zariibe fi kulla l-wakit al-aniina ga'adna ma'aahum wa saarhiin be l-khanam.
Wa hassa' da,a'arfi wa chiifi al-cheyy al-tagdare tisawwiih achaan masiibe kabiire jaaye le siidna wa ahalah.Achaan sayyidna ma naafi' wa naadum yahdiih kula ma fiih-!
Wa tawwaali,Abigaayil chaalat 200 khubza wa 2 girbe hana khamar wa 5 khanam munajjadiin wa 15 kooro hana gameh fariiki wa 100 dukrume hana inab yaabis mu'abbak wa 200 dukrume hana tiin yaabis mu'abbak.Wa kulla l-achya dool,hi chaddathum fi hamiir.
Wa gaalat le khaddaamiinha-:-Intu gaddumu wa ana namchi waraaku. Wa laakin hi ma gaalat cheyy le raajilha Naabaal.
Wa hi rikbat fi humaarha wa machat ale l-hajar.Wa Dawuud kula be naasah jaayiin be nuss al-hajar be hinaak.Wa jo wa be khafla,lammo.
Wa gubbaal ma yilimmu,Dawuud gaal-:-Ana sawweet khata.Al-naadum da,ana hafadt kulla maalah fi l-kadaade achaan cheyy ma yiwaddir leyah.Wa l-kheer al-sawweetah leyah da,hu gabbalah leyi be charr-!
Kadar le ambaakir fajur,kan ana khalleet naadum waahid min rujaal Naabaal aach kula,khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid-!
Wa wakit Abigaayil chaafat Dawuud,dallat ajala min humaarha.Wa barakat wa sajadat giddaamah,
wa karabat rijileenah wa gaalat-:-Ya sayyidi,aj'al al-khata da minni ana-!Wa daahu ana khaadmak nihajji leek wa asma' kalaami.
Min fadlak,ya sayyidi,Naabaal hu siid charr,ma taj'alah-!Al-usum bitaabi' siidah wa usmah Naabaal ma'anaatah matmuus.Wa ana khaadmak ma chift al-naas al-inta rassaltuhum,ya sayyidi.
Wa hassa',ya sayyidi,nahlif leek be Allah al-Hayy wa be hayaatak inta kadar Allah daharak min daffigiin al-damm wa kaffiin al-taar.Khalli udwaanak wa kulla l-naas al-yidooru leek al-fasaala yabgo misil Naabaal,ya sayyidi-!
Wa khalaas,ya sayyidi,akhbal al-hadaaya al-ana khaadmak jibtuhum leek wa gassimhum le l-subyaan al-ma'aak.
Wa saamih ana khaadmak fi l-khata al-sawweetah,ya sayyidi.Akiid Allah yisabbit zurriiytak fi l-muluk achaan inta gaa'id tihaarib fi chaan Allah.Wa abadan fi muddit hayaatak,ma yalgo foogak ayyi eeb.
Wa kan naadum gaa'id yitaaridak wa yidoor yaktulak,ya sayyidi,Allah Ilaahak yinajjiik wa yahfadak misil naadum al-gaa'id yahfad maalah.Wa laakin udwaanak,Allah yiwaddiihum ba'iid minnak misil hajar al-zaragooh be miglaa'.
Wa wakit Allah yitimm kulla cheyy al-waa'adak beyah inta sayyidi,hu yidarrijak malik fi Israa'iil.
Ya sayyidi,kan inta kaffeet al-taar,da yagood leek fi fikrak wa tandam le l-cheyy al-sawweetah achaan fi za'alak bas inta katalt naas.Wa wakit Allah yisawwi leek al-kheer,ma tansaani.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Abigaayil-:-Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-jaabaaki al-yoom le tilaagiini-!
Allah yibaarik foogki wa fi fikirki achaan inti dahartiini ma naktul naas wa ma nilkaffa al-taar.
Wa nahlif be Allah al-Hayy Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,hu bas daharaani ma nisawwi leeki cheyy fasil.Wa kan inti ma jiiti ajala laageetiini,ambaakir fajur da,naadum waahid kula ma yifaddil fi beet Naabaal-!
Wa Dawuud khibil al-hadaaya al-Abigaayil jaabathum wa gaal leeha-:-Amchi beetki be l-salaama.Ana simi't kalaamki wa nisawwi kulla cheyy al-talabtiih minni.
Wa Abigaayil gabbalat bakaan Naabaal raajilha wa ligatah sawwa aazuuma kabiire fi beetah misil aazuuma hana malik.Wa hu sakraan marra waahid wa farhaan.Wa hi ma gaalat leyah cheyy lahaddi l-fajur.
Wa be fajur,wakit sakarah chatta minnah,Abigaayil hajjat leyah be kulla cheyy al-hasal.Wa wakit Naabaal simi' al-kalaam da,taggaah waja' galib wa jildah maat.
Wa ga'ad hawaale achara yoom wa ba'ad da,Allah hakam leyah be l-moot.
Wa wakit Dawuud simi' be moot Naabaal,gaal-:-Al-hamdulillah.Allah daafa' leyi min mu'yaar Naabaal wa daharaani ma nisawwi cheyy fasil diddah.Wa hu gabbal leyah fasaaltah fi raasah. Wa Dawuud rassal naas le Abigaayil wa dawwar yaakhudha.
Wa wakit naas Dawuud wassalo fi hillit Karmal bakaan Abigaayil,gaalo leeha-:-Dawuud rassalaana leeki achaan yidoor yaakhudki.
Wa tawwaali,Abigaayil waga'at fi l-ard wa barakat giddaam Dawuud wa gaalat-:-Ana khaadmah jaahize le nabga khaadim le nijiib almi le nikhassil rijileen khaddaamiin sayyidi.
Wa Abigaayil gammat ajala wa rikbat fi humaarha.Wa machan ma'aaha khamsa banaat wa taaba'an khaddaamiin Dawuud.Wa khalaas,hi bigat marit Dawuud.
Wa gubbaal da kula,Dawuud indah mara usumha Akhinuu'am.Hi min hillit Yazra'iil.Wa be da,Akhinuu'am wa Abigaayil kullihin ke awiinah le Dawuud.
Wa kan le Mikaal marit Dawuud al-awwalaaniiye,Chaawuul abuuha chaalaaha wa antaaha le raajil aakhar usmah Falti wileed Layich min hillit Galliim.
Wa battaan al-naas al-saakniin fi kadaadit Ziif jo ligooh le Chaawuul fi hillit Gibee'a wa gaalo leyah-:-Inta ma ta'arfah kadar Dawuud mullabbid fi raas hajar Hakiila mugaabil naga'at Yachiimuun-?
Wa Chaawuul chaal 3-000 raajil min ahsan al-muhaaribiin hana Bani Israa'iil wa gamma macha le kadaadit Ziif le yifattich Dawuud.
Wa Chaawuul khatta mu'askarah fi raas hajar Hakiila mugaabil Yachiimuun gariib le l-derib.Wa Dawuud kamaan gaa'id fi l-kadaade.Wa wakit hu irif kadar Chaawuul ja wa gaa'id yifattich foogah fi l-kadaade,
hu rassal naas le yi'akkudu min jayyit Chaawuul.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud gamma macha chaaf al-mu'askar hana Chaawuul wa akkad min al-bakaan al-Chaawuul wa Abniir wileed Niir khaayid deechah naaymiin foogah.Wa Chaawuul ragad fi ust al-mu'askar wa askarah hawwagooh.
Wa Dawuud naadaah le Akhiimalik al-Hitti wa le Abichaay akhu Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya wa gaal-:-Yaatu yamchi ma'aayi fi mu'askar Chaawuul-? Wa Abichaay gaal leyah-:-Ana namchi ma'aak.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud wa Abichaay macho dakhalo be l-leel fi l-mu'askar.Wa chaafo Chaawuul raagid wa naayim fi ust al-mu'askar wa haribtah ale raasah.Wa Abniir wa askarah hawwagooh wa raagdiin.
Wa Abichaay gaal le Dawuud-:-Al-yoom,al-Rabb sallam leek aduuk-!Khalliini nat'anah be haribti marra waahide bas wa nilassigah fi l-turaab-!Wa ma nitanniih leyah-!
Wa Dawuud gaal le Abichaay-:-La,ma taktulah-!Achaan Allah ma yaj'al bari al-naadum al-yaktul al-malik al-hu masahah wa darrajah.
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Nahlif leek be Allah al-Hayy.Allah bas yigassir ajalah wa yumuut moot aadi walla yaktuluuh fi l-harib.
Allah yasturni ma nukhutt iidi foogah,hu al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik-!Hassa' da,khalli nichiilu haribtah al-gaa'ide ale raasah wa girbitah hint al-almi wa namchu.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud chaal al-harba wa l-girbe hint al-almi al-gaa'idiin ale raas Chaawuul wa faato.Wa naadum waahid kula ma chaafaahum wa la hassa beehum wa la gamma.Kulluhum naaymiin achaan Allah nazzal fooghum noom chadiid.
Wa Dawuud dalla min mu'askar Chaawuul wa tala' fi raas hajar aakhar al-chiyya ba'iid minhum.
Wa gamma yinaadi ale l-mu'askar wa le Abniir wa gaal-:-Ya Abniir wileed Niir-!Ya Abniir-!Ma turudd leyi walla-? Wa Abniir gaal-:-Inta ke yaatu al-ti'iit le l-malik-?
Wa Dawuud gaal le Abniir-:-Inta ma raajil al-mislak ma fiih fi Bani Israa'iil walla-?Wa maala ma harast siidak al-malik-?Achaan naadum waahid min al-cha'ab ja wa yidoor yaktul siidak al-malik-!
Al-cheyy al-hassa' inta sawweetah,da ma adiil-!Wa nahlif leek be Allah al-Hayy,intu dool waajib leeku al-katil achaan intu ma harastu siidku,hu al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik.Chiif-!Ween al-harba wa l-girbe hana l-malik al-ga'ado ale raasah-?
Wa Chaawuul irif hiss Dawuud.Wa gaal-:-Ya wileedi Dawuud,da hissak inta walla-? Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Aywa,da hissi ana,ya siidi al-malik.
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Maala siidi yitaarid abdah-?Ana sawweet leek chunu-?Wa chunu al-fasaala al-ana sawweetha-?
Wa hassa' da,min fadlak ya siidi,asma' kalaami ana abdak.Kan Allah bas lazzaak achaan titaaridni,waajib ana nigaddim leyah dahiiye.Laakin kan min naas bas,khalli Allah yal'anhum-!Achaan al-yoom humman taradooni min al-balad al-antaaha Allah warasa le cha'abah wa da misil humman gaalo leyi-:--Amchi wa a'abud ilaahaat aakhariin.--
Wa hassa' da,khalli dammi ma yidaffig ba'iid min giddaam Allah.Achaan malik Israa'iil gamma yitaaridni misil gaa'id yitaarid gamulaay walla jidaadit khala fi raas al-hajar.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Ana aznabt.Gabbil,ya wileedi Dawuud-!Ana battaan ma nisawwi leek cheyy fasil.Achaan fi l-yoom da,inta chift hayaati indaha khiima giddaamak.Wa ana khitiit ziyaada wakit gammeet diddak misil naadum ma indah fikir.
Wa Dawuud radda wa gaal-:-Di hi harbit al-malik-!Khalli waahid min subyaanak yaji yichiilha.
Wa Allah yikaafi ayyi naadum saalih wa amiin.Achaan al-yoom,Allah sallamaak leyi wa laakin ana ma dawwart nimidd iidi didd al-raajil al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik.
Wa misil al-yoom ana ja'alt hayaatak muhimme,Allah kula yaj'al hayaati muhimme wa yinajjiini min ayyi masiibe.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul gaal le Dawuud-:-Allah yibaarikak,ya wileedi Dawuud-!Akiid inta tisawwi achya katiiriin wa tanjah-!-Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud chaal derbah wa faat.Wa Chaawuul gabbal beetah.
Wa Dawuud gaal fi nafsah-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,Chaawuul yaji yaktulni.Wa cheyy aakhar nisawwiih ma fiih illa ni'arrid wa namchi balad al-Filistiyiin.Wa be da,hu yikhalli mutaaradati fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa ana nanja minnah.
Wa Dawuud wa l-rujaal al-suttumiya al-ma'aayah macho le Akiich wileed Ma'uuk malik hillit Gaat.
Wa Dawuud macha sakan bakaan Akiich malik Gaat,hu wa l-naas al-ma'aayah,ayyi waahid be aayiltah.Wa Dawuud kula chaal awiinah al-itneen Akhinuu'am al-min hillit Yazra'iil wa Abigaayil al-awwal marit Naabaal al-min hillit Karmal.
Wa wakit Chaawuul simi' kadar Dawuud arrad macha hillit Gaat,hu khalla mutaaradatah.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Akiich-:-Kan ridiit leyi,antiini hille waahide min al-hillaal dool nagood foogha.Wa maala ana abdak nagood ma'aak fi hillit al-malik-?
Wa khalaas fi l-yoom da,Akiich antaah le Dawuud hillit Sikhlaag.Wa achaan da bas,hillit Sikhlaag gaa'ide fi iideen muluuk Yahuuza lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Dawuud ga'ad fi balad al-Filistiyiin muddit sana wa arba'a chahar.
Wa Dawuud wa naasah gaa'idiin yamchu yahjumu al-Gachuuriyiin wa l-Girziyiin wa l-Amaalikh.Wa dool al-naas al-saakniin min zamaan fi l-ard min Chuur lahaddi balad Masir.
Wa Dawuud yidammir al-balad wa yaktul kulla l-rujaal wa l-awiin wa yichiil al-khanam wa l-bagar wa l-hamiir wa l-jumaal wa l-khulgaan.Wa yigabbil yaji le l-malik Akiich.
Wa l-malik Akiich yuguul leyah-:-Al-yoom hajamtu ween-? Wa Dawuud yakdib wa yuguul-:-Hajamna be nuss al-wati hana balad Yahuuza wa ard al-Yarhamiiliyiin wa ard al-Khiiniyiin.
Wa fi l-bakaanaat al-macha hajamhum,Dawuud yaktul kulla l-naas.Ma yikhalli wa la mara wa la raajil achaan kan yijiibuuhum fi hillit Gaat,yihajju wa yi'ooru be l-buldaan al-hu hajamaahum be l-sahiih.Wa da l-cheyy al-Dawuud gaa'id yisawwiih wakit hu gaa'id fi balad al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Akiich aamanah le Dawuud wa gaal fi nafsah-:-Hassa' da,Dawuud bigi makruuh le ahalah Bani Israa'iil.Achaan da,khalli yabga leyi khaddaam daayman.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-Filistiyiin lammo askarhum le yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil.Wa Akiich gaal le Dawuud-:-Waajib ta'arif kadar inta wa naasak tamchu ma'aayi le l-harib.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Akiich-:-Sameh.Inta zaatak tichiif al-cheyy al-abdak yisawwiih-! Wa l-malik gaal le Dawuud-:-Tamaam.Min hini le giddaam,inta tabga mas'uul harasi.
Wa Samuwiil maat wa dafanooh fi hillitah al-Raama wa kulla Bani Israa'iil hizno leyah.Wa ba'ad da,Chaawuul gamma tarad kulla l-naas al-yikallumu ma'a l-maytiin wa l-naas al-yihajju ma'a l-junuun min balad Israa'iil.
Wa l-Filistiyiin lammo naashum wa jo khatto mu'askarhum fi hillit Chuunam.Wa Chaawuul kula lamma kulla Bani Israa'iil wa khatto mu'askarhum fi jabal Gilbuu'a.
Wa laakin wakit Chaawuul chaaf mu'askar al-Filistiyiin,khaaf khoof chadiid wa bada yarjif.
Wa Chaawuul sa'al Allah laakin Allah ma radda leyah wa la be ru'ya wa la be Uriim wa la be l-anbiya.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le khaddaamiinah-:-Fattuchu leyi mara al-tagdar tikallim ma'a l-maytiin wa ana namchi le tichiif leyi. Wa khaddaamiinah gaalo leyah-:-Daahu mara waahide al-gaa'ide fi hillit Een Duur tikallim ma'a l-maytiin.
Wa Chaawuul baddal khulgaanah hana l-muluk wa libis khulgaan aakhariin wa macha bakaan al-mara ma'a itneen min khaddaamiinah.Wa humman wassalo be l-leel wa Chaawuul gaal leeha-:-Chiifi leyi wa naadi al-mayyit al-ni'ooriiki beyah.
Wa l-mara gaalat leyah-:-Inta ta'arif adiil kadar Chaawuul tarad min al-balad kulla l-naas al-bikallumu ma'a l-maytiin wa l-junuun.Wa maala inta tukujj leyi charak wa tidoor taktulni-?
Wa Chaawuul halaf leeha be Allah wa gaal-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy,akiid al-ikhaab ma yaji leeki be l-sabab da-!
Wa l-mara gaalat-:-Tidoor ninaadi leek yaatu-? Wa hu gaal-:-Naadi leyi Samuwiil.
Wa wakit al-mara chaafat Samuwiil,sarakhat wa gaalat le Chaawuul-:-Maala khachcheetni-?Inta Chaawuul-!
