Wa l-malik Chaawuul gaal leeha-:-Ma takhaafe-!Laakin chifti chunu-? Wa l-mara gaalat leyah-:-Ana chift naadum bikhawwif taali' min tihit al-ard.
Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Chabahah kikkeef-? Wa hi gaalat-:-Raajil chaayib taali' min tihit al-ard wa mukhatti be khalag al-anbiya. Wa Chaawuul irif kadar da Samuwiil.Wa khalaas,Chaawuul dangar fi l-ard wa sajad.
Wa Samuwiil gaal le Chaawuul-:-Maala tibarjil margadi wa tigawwimni-? Wa Chaawuul gaal-:-Ana addaayagt marra waahid.Al-Filistiyiin jo le yihaarubuuni wa l-Rabb abaani wa ma radda leyi wa la be l-anbiya wa la be ru'ya.Achaan da bas,ana naadeetak le ti'arrifni al-cheyy al-waajib nisawwiih.
Wa Samuwiil gaal leyah-:-Kan Allah abaak wa bigi leek misil adu,maala tinaadiini-?
Achaan Allah tamma al-kalaam al-gaalah leek be waasitati ana.Chaal minnak al-muluk wa antaah le naadum aakhar gariibak wa hu Dawuud.
Wa da achaan inta ma simi't kalaam Allah wa ma aakhabt al-Amaalikh hasab khadab Allah.Wa be da,al-yoom Allah gabbal leek al-cheyy da fi raasak.
Wa yisallimak inta wa Bani Israa'iil fi iid al-Filistiyiin.Wa ambaakir,inta wa iyaalak kulluku tumuutu wa tukuunu ma'aayi hini.Wa Allah yisallim mu'askar Bani Israa'iil kula fi iid al-Filistiyiin.
Wa wakit Chaawuul simi' kalaam Samuwiil,tawwaali anbahat wa waga' tihit wa almattat.Wa hu ma indah gudra achaan ma akal cheyy tuul al-leel wa l-nahaar.
Wa l-mara garrabat le Chaawuul wa chaafat hu anbahat be ziyaada wa gaalat leyah-:-Chiif,ana khaadmak simi't kalaamak wa dasseet nafsi fi l-khutuura wa sawweet kulla cheyy al-inta talabtah minni.
Hassa' da,min fadlak asma' kalaam khaadmak.Khalliini nijiib leek khubza chiyya.Aakul achaan talga gudra wa tamchi.
Wa Chaawuul aba wa gaal-:-Ana ma naakul.-Wa laakin khaddaamiinah wa l-mara assarooh wa hu simi' kalaamhum.Wa gamma min al-turaab wa ga'ad fi l-sariir.
Wa tawwaali,al-mara machat chaalat ijilha al-samiin wa dabahatah wa chaalat dagiig ajjanatah wa sawwatah khubza bala tawwaara.
Wa hi gaddamatah le Chaawuul wa khaddaamiinah wa humman akalo.Wa ba'ad da,gammo faato fi nafs al-leele di.
Wa l-Filistiyiin lammo askarhum fi hillit Afiikh.Wa Bani Israa'iil kamaan lammo askarhum jamb een al-almi al-gaa'ide fi hillit Yazra'iil.
Wa kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin jarsaso ayyi waahid fi raas miya askar aw fi alif.Wa Dawuud wa naasah jarsaso fi l-akhiir ma'a l-malik Akiich.
Wa kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin gaalo-:-Al-Ibraaniyiin dool jo yisawwu chunu-? Wa Akiich gaal leehum-:-Da Dawuud mas'uul hana Chaawuul malik Israa'iil.Hu gaa'id ma'aayi muddit sana aw santeen.Wa ana ma ligiit foogah cheyy fasil min arrad min sayyidah lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin zi'ilo didd Akiich wa gaalo-:-Atrud al-raajil da-!Khalli yigabbil fi l-bakaan al-inta sakkantah foogah-!Ma yamchi ma'aana fi l-harib achaan ba'adeen ma yigabbil diddina.Wa kan yidoor yidalli galib sayyidah,ma yiwaddi leyah ruuseena walla-?
Da ma Dawuud al-bikhannu beyah wa buguulu-:--Chaawuul katal aalaaf wa Dawuud katal acharaat al-aalaaf-?-
Wa khalaas,al-malik Akiich naadaah le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy,inta adiil-!Da bigi leyi sameh wakit tamchi wa taji ma'aayi fi l-mu'askar.Wa ana ma ligiit foogak cheyy fasil min jiit leyi lahaddi l-yoom.Wa laakin kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin al-aakhariin ma yidooruuk.
Hassa' da,gabbil wa amchi be l-salaama achaan ma tisawwi cheyy al-yiza''il kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Akiich-:-Laakin ana sawweet chunu-?Wa chunu al-cheyy al-inta simi'tah minni ana abdak min ana jiitak lahaddi l-yoom achaan tadharni ma namchi nihaarib udwaan sayyidi al-malik-?
Wa Akiich radda le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Ana na'arif kadar inta adiil ma'aayi misil malak al-Rabb.Wa laakin kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin bas gaalo leyi,inta ma tamchi ma'aana fi l-harib.
Hassa' da,gumm be fajur badri,inta wa l-rujaal al-jo ma'aak.Gabbulu fi l-bakaan al-ana anteetak.Ma tifakkir fi l-kalaam da achaan ana radyaan beek.Wa kan al-wata asbahat,khalaas amchu-!
Wa ambaakir fajur badri,Dawuud wa naasah gabbalo fi balad al-Filistiyiin.Wa l-Filistiyiin kamaan faato ale Yazra'iil.
Wa ba'ad talaata yoom,Dawuud wa naasah wassalo fi hillit Sikhlaag wa ligo al-Amaalikh hajamo wati balad Yahuuza wa hajamo Sikhlaag kula wa tachchooha.
Wa humman chaalo al-awiin wa ma khallo naadum,wa la kubaar wa la dugaag.Wa ma katalo naadum waahid kula laakin chaaloohum wa gabbalo beehum.
Wa wakit Dawuud wa naasah wassalo fi Sikhlaag,ligo al-hille khalaas al-Amaalikh tachchooha.Wa awiinhum wa awlaadhum wa banaathum kamaan,waddoohum masaajiin.
Wa Dawuud wa naasah bako baki chadiid lahaddi iyo min al-baki.
Wa awiin Dawuud al-itneen Akhinuu'am al-min Yazra'iil wa Abigaayil al-awwal marit Naabaal al-min Karmal kula waddoohin masjuunaat.
Wa Dawuud addaayag marra waahid achaan kulla l-naas al-ma'aayah gaalo yarjumuuh.Humman hizno katiir le awlaadhum wa banaathum.Wa laakin hu ligi chajaa'a be ni'mat Allah Ilaahah.
Wa Dawuud gaal le raajil al-diin Abiyaatar wileed Akhiimalik-:-Min fadlak,jiib leyi sideeriiyit al-kharaar. Wa Abiyaatar jaabah leyah.
Wa Dawuud sa'al Allah wa gaal-:-Kan namchi wara l-adu da,nagdar nalhagah walla-? Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi waraahum-!Talhaghum wa tagla' naasak.
Wa Dawuud wa naasah al-suttumiya macho wara l-adu wa wassalo fi l-rijil al-usumha Basuur.
Wa wakit wassalo fi l-rijil di,miiteen min naasah bigo ayyaaniin marra waahid wa ma gidro yagta'o al-rijil.Wa ga'ado fi l-bakaan da.Laakin Dawuud taaba' al-adu be naasah al-urbu'miya.
Wa fi l-khala,naasah le Dawuud ligo sabi Masri waahid wa karabooh wa waddooh le Dawuud.Wa antooh akil akal wa almi chirib.
Wa antooh dukrume hana tiin yaabis mu'abbak wa dakaarim itneen hana inab yaabis mu'abbak.Wa ba'ad akalaahum,aglah ja achaan hu ma akal wa la chirib min muddit talaata yoom wa talaata leele.
Wa Dawuud sa'alah-:-Siidak yaatu-?Wa inta min ween-? Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana Masri.Wa siidi Amaalikhi wa hu khallaani achaan ana miridt le muddit talaata yoom.
Wa aniina bas al-jiina hajamna wati le balad al-Kiritiyiin wa wati le balad Yahuuza wa wati le balad Kaalib.Wa tachcheena hillit Sikhlaag kula.
Wa Dawuud gaal leyah-:-Tagdar tiwaddiini bakaan al-adu da walla-? Wa l-Masri gaal-:-Ahlif leyi be l-Rabb kadar ma taktulni wa la tisallimni le siidi.Wa ana niwaddiik bakaan al-adu.
Wa khalaas,al-Masri waddaah le Dawuud.Wa ligoohum le l-Amaalikh muchattatiin fi kulla l-balad,yaakulu wa yacharbo wa farhaaniin be l-khaniime al-kabiire al-ligooha min balad al-Filistiyiin wa min balad Yahuuza.
Wa Dawuud hajamaahum min fajur badri wa daawasaahum lahaddi ambaakir achiiye.Wa naadum waahid kula minhum ma faddal,illa 400 subyaan al-rikbo fi jumaal wa arrado.
Wa Dawuud gala' kulla cheyy al-Amaalikh chaalooh wa najja awiinah al-itneen kula.
Wa naadum waahid kula ma fagadooh wa la min al-dugaag wa la min al-kubaar wa la min al-awlaad wa la min al-banaat wa la min al-khaniime al-chaalooha minhum.Kulla ke,Dawuud gala'ah.
Wa Dawuud jaab kulla l-khanam wa l-bagar hana l-Amaalikh.Wa l-naas al-yusuugu al-bahaayim gaa'idiin yuguulu-:-Di al-khaniime al-gala'aaha Dawuud-!
Wa Dawuud wisil bakaan naasah al-miiteen al-awwal ayyaaniin bilheen wa ma taaba'ooh wa ga'ado fi l-rijil Basuur.Wa gammo laagooh le Dawuud wa naasah.Wa Dawuud wa naasah garrabo leehum wa sallamoohum.
Wa min al-naas al-macho ma'a Dawuud,fiyah naas fasliin wa siyaad charr al-gaalo-:-Al-naas al-ma macho ma'aana,ma nantuuhum cheyy min al-khaniime al-jibnaaha.Illa ayyi waahid yichiil martah wa iyaalah wa yamchi-!
Wa laakin Dawuud gaal-:-Ma tisawwu misil da,ya akhwaani,fi l-cheyy al-antaana Allah.Hu bas al-hafadaana wa sallam leena fi iideenna aduuna al-ja hajamaana.
Kalaamku da ma yabga,achaanal-macha fi l-haribwa l-gaa'id fi l-khumaamyigassumu sawa sawa.
Wa min al-yoom da,al-gisim hana l-kasiibe bigi chart wa gaanuun fi Bani Israa'iil lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa wakit Dawuud gabbal fi Sikhlaag,rassal min al-khaniime le rufgaanah kubaaraat balad Yahuuza.Wa gaal leehum-:-Daahu hadiiye leeku min al-khaniime al-chilnaaha min udwaan Allah.
Wa Dawuud rassalha le kubaaraat hana hillaal Beet Iil wa Raamuut fi l-wati wa Yattiir
wa Aruu'ir wa Sifmuut wa Achtamuu'a
wa Raakaal wa le hillaal Yarhamiiliyiin wa le hillaal al-Khiiniyiin
wa Hurma wa Buur Achan wa Ataak
wa Hibruun.Wa da fi kulla l-bakaanaat al-awwal macha fooghum Dawuud wa naasah.
Wa yoom waahid,al-Filistiyiin hajamo Bani Israa'iil wa humman jaro giddaam al-Filistiyiin wa katiiriin minhum maato fi jabal Gilbuu'a.
Wa l-Filistiyiin haasaroohum le Chaawuul wa awlaadah.Wa humman katalo Yuunataan wa Abinadaab wa Malkichuu',awlaad Chaawuul.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-harib bigi chadiid le Chaawuul.Wa siyaad al-nuchchaab chaafooh wa wakit hu chaafaahum,gamma yarjif chadiid giddaamhum.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le l-sabi al-chaayil leyah silaahah-:-Sill seefak wa aktulni.Achaan ma nidoor al-ma mutahhariin dool yi'azzubuuni wa yaktuluuni. Laakin al-sabi aba achaan hu khaaf marra waahid.Wa khalaas,Chaawuul chaal seefah wa waga' foogah wa maat.
Wa wakit al-sabi chaaf Chaawuul maat,hu kula waga' fi seefah wa maat ma'aayah.
Wa be misil da,Chaawuul wa awlaadah al-talaata wa l-sabi al-chaayil leyah silaahah wa kulla askarah al-ma'aayah da maato sawa fi l-yoom da.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil al-saakniin khaadi le waadi Yazra'iil wa l-saakniin khaadi le l-Urdun sim'o be haziimat Bani Israa'iil wa moot Chaawuul wa awlaadah,humman kula arrado wa khallo hillaalhum.Wa l-Filistiyiin jo wa sakano fi l-hillaal dool.
Wa ambaakir wakit al-Filistiyiin jo fi bakaan al-duwaas le yichiilu khumaam al-maytiin,ligo Chaawuul wa awlaadah al-talaata maytiin fi raas jabal Gilbuu'a.
Wa gata'o raas Chaawuul wa chaalo silaahah.Wa rassalo al-khabar da fi kulla balad al-Filistiyiin wa khabbaro beyah cha'abhum wa fi buyuut asnaamhum.
Wa humman khatto silaah Chaawuul fi beet al-ibaada hana ilaahithum Achtaruut.Wa allago janaaztah fi durdur hillit Beet Chaan.
Wa sukkaan hillit Yaabiich fi turaab Gil'aad sim'o be l-cheyy al-Filistiyiin sawwooh fi Chaawuul.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-rujaal al-fahaliin gammo wa raakho tuul al-leel.Wa jo sallo janaazaat Chaawuul wa awlaadah min durdur Beet Chaan wa jaaboohum fi Yaabiich wa tachchoohum.
Wa ba'ad da,khammo udaamhum wa dafanoohum fi ga'ar al-ardeebaay al-gaa'ide fi Yaabiich.Wa saamo sab'a yoom.
Wa Dawuud haarab al-Amaalikh wa annasar fooghum wa gabbal ga'ad fi hillit Sikhlaag yoomeen.Wa da ba'ad Chaawuul maat khalaas.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,ja sabi waahid min mu'askar Chaawuul,khulgaanah mucharratiin wa indah turaab fi raasah le yiwassif hiznah.Wa wakit garrab le Dawuud,waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaamah.
Wa Dawuud sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta jaayi min ween-? Hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana min mu'askar Bani Israa'iil wa arradt min al-harib.
Wa Dawuud gaal leyah-:-Chunu al-kaan hinaak-?Min fadlak,hajjiini beyah. Wa l-sabi radda leyah wa gaal-:-Askar Bani Israa'iil arrado min al-harib wa katiiriin minhum maato.Wa Chaawuul wa wileedah Yuunataan kula maato.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l-sabi al-jaab leyah al-khabar da-:-Kikkeef inta irift kadar Chaawuul wa wileedah Yuunataan maato-?
Wa l-sabi gaal-:-Wakit ana gaa'id fi raas jabal Gilbuu'a,chift Chaawuul gaa'id yirrakkaz fi haribtah wa l-adu haasarah be kheel wa be arabaat al-harib.
Wa wakit Chaawuul anlafat,chaafaani wa naadaani wa ana gult-:--Na'am,ya siidi.--
Wa hu sa'alaani gaal-:--Inta yaatu-?- Wa ana gult-:--Ana Amaalikhi.--
Wa hu gaal leyi-:--Ta'aal gariib leyi wa aktulni kan ruuhi ma maragat kula achaan ana gariib numuut.--
Wa khalaas,ana garrabt leyah wa kataltah achaan irift kadar min waga' da,hu ma yi'iich.Wa be da,daahu chilt al-taaj al-fi raasah wa dimlij al-muluk al-fi iidah wa jibtuhum leek,inta siidi.
Wa tawwaali,min al-hizin Dawuud gamma charrat khalagah wa l-naas al-ma'aayah kula charrato khulgaanhum.
Wa humman bako wa naaho wa saamo lahaddi l-achiiye fi chaan Chaawuul wa wileedah Yuunataan wa cha'ab Allah wa kulla Bani Israa'iil al-maato fi l-harib.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l-sabi al-jaab leyah al-khabar-:-Inta min ween-? Wa hu radda wa gaal-:-Ana wileed ajnabi waahid Amaalikhi.
Wa Dawuud gaal leyah-:-Kikkeef inta ma khuft wa rafa't iidak wa katalt al-raajil al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik-?
Wa khalaas,Dawuud naada waahid min askarah wa gaal leyah-:-Aktulah-!-Wa l-askari darab al-Amaalikhi wa katalah.
Wa wakit ruuhah gaa'ide tamrug,Dawuud gaal leyah-:-Khalli dimmitak taga' fi raasak achaan inta gult be khachmak kadar inta bas katalt al-raajil al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud khanna khine hana hizin le Chaawuul wa wileedah Yuunataan.
Wa amar yi'allumuuh le Bani Yahuuza.Wa l-khine da sammooh Khine al-Nubbaal.Wa hu maktuub fi Kitaab al-Saalih.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,majduku dabahooh fi raas al-hajar.Maala al-furraas dabahoohum-?
Ma tikhabburu naas hillit Gaatwa ma tiballukhuuh fi chawaari' hillit Achgaluunachaan banaat al-Filistiyiin ma yafrahanwa la banaat al-ma mutahhariin yifaachiran.
Ya jabal Gilbuu'a,ma yanzil foogak matarwa la yibillak karanywa ziraa'tak abadan ma tugumm.Achaan hinaak wassakhodaragat al-furraaswa daragat Chaawuul,be dihin ma yamsahooha battaan
illa be damm al-dabahoohumwa be chaham furraashum.Nuchchaab Yuunataan ma khiti abadanwa seef Chaawuul abadan ma raham.
Chaawuul wa Yuunataanmaryuudiin wa mahbuubiin fi hayaathumwa humman ma anfarago fi moothum.Humman ajiiliin min al-suguurawa chudaad min al-diidaan.
Ya banaat Bani Israa'iil,abkan le Chaawuulachaan hu labbasaakan khulgaan samhiin wa khaaliyiinwa mujammaliin be dahab.
Maala al-furraas dabahoohum fi l-harib-?Wa maala Yuunataan dabahooh fi raas al-hajar-?
Ana haznaan leek,ya akhuuyi Yuunataan-!Ridtak min kulla galbiwa rafagak ajabni ziyaada min hubb al-awiin.
Maala al-furraas dabahoohum-?Wa maala silaahhum daffag-?
Wa ba'ad al-hizin da,Dawuud sa'al Allah wa gaal-:-Hal namchi nagood fi hille waahide min hillaal balad Yahuuza walla-? Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi. Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Namchi ween-? Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi hillit Hibruun.
Wa Dawuud gamma macha Hibruun ma'a awiinah al-itneen Akhinuu'am al-min hillit Yazra'iil wa Abigaayil marit Naabaal al-min hillit Karmal.
Wa Dawuud wadda ma'aayah naasah wa aayilaathum wa sakano fi Hibruun wa hawaaleeha.
Wa naas gabiilat Yahuuza jo le Dawuud masahooh wa darrajooh malik fooghum.Wa wakit khabbarooh kadar naas hillit Yaabiich fi turaab Gil'aad sataro janaazit Chaawuul,
khalaas Dawuud rassal le naas Yaabiich Gil'aad wa gaal-:-Allah yibaarikku achaan intu induku amaan le siidku Chaawuul wa satartu janaaztah.
Wa hassa' da,khalli Allah yiwassif leeku al-rahma wa l-amaan.Wa ana kula nisawwi leeku al-kheer misil intu sawweetuuh.
Sahiih,kan siidku Chaawuul maat kula,chiddu heelku wa abgo rujaal fahaliin.Achaan naas gabiilat Yahuuza masahooni wa darrajooni malik fooghum.
Wa Abniir wileed Niir khaayid deech Chaawuul jaab Ichbuuchat wileed Chaawuul fi hillit Mahanaayim.
Wa darrajah malik fi turaab Gil'aad wa Achuuriin wa Yazra'iil wa Afraayim wa Banyaamiin wa fi kulla turaab Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Ichbuuchat wileed Chaawuul indah 40 sana wakit bigi malik fi Israa'iil wa hakam santeen.Wa laakin naas gabiilat Yahuuza taaba'o Dawuud.
Wa l-malik Dawuud hakam fi Hibruun sab'a sana wa sitte chahar foog naas gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa Abniir wileed Niir wa naas Ichbuuchat wileed Chaawuul marago min Mahanaayim wa macho ale hillit Gib'uun.
Wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya wa naas Dawuud kula marago.Wa l-majmuu'teen dool lammo fi rahad Gib'uun.Wa dool wagafo be hini wa dool wagafo be hinaak le l-rahad.
Wa Abniir gaal le Yuwaab-:-Khalli subyaanna wa subyaanku yamurgu yijarrubu gudrithum giddaamna. Wa Yuwaab gaal-:-Sameh.Khalli yamurgu.
Wa khalaas,hasabo 12 raajil min gabiilat Banyaamiin naas Ichbuuchat wileed Chaawuul wa 12 raajil min naas Dawuud.
Wa ayyi waahid gamma wa karab gabiilah min raasah wa attaa'ano be l-suyuuf fi nawaayithum wa maato kulluhum fi l-bakaan da.Wa sammooh Khilgat Hasuuriim (ma'anaatah zere' al-hujaar) wa l-bakaan da fi Gib'uun.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-harib bigi chadiid bilheen wa naas Dawuud hazamoohum le Abniir wa naas Bani Israa'iil.
Wa awlaadha le Saruuya al-talaata Yuwaab wa Abichaay wa Asaahiil,humman kula haadiriin fi l-harib da.Wa Asaahiil hu jarraay misil khazaal al-naga'a.
Wa Asaahiil jara wara Abniir wa ma baara min derbah wa la isra wa la zeene.
Wa Abniir anlafat chaafah wa gaal-:-Da inta,ya Asaahiil-? Wa Asaahiil gaal-:-Aywa,da ana.
Wa Abniir gaal-:-Amchi ale israaytak aw zeenaaytak wa talga waahid min al-subyaan,aktulah wa chiil silaahah. Wa laakin Asaahiil aba ma yigabbil min wara Abniir.
Wa Abniir gaal battaan le Asaahiil-:-Gabbil min derbi walla tidoor naktulak-?Wa kan kataltak,nuguul chunu le akhuuk Yuwaab-?
Wa laakin Asaahiil aba ma yigabbil min wara Abniir.Wa khalaas,Abniir ta'anah fi batnah be ga'ar haribtah lahaddi maragat leyah min wara.Wa hu waga' wa maat fi l-bakaan da.Wa kulla l-naas yagiifu wakit wassalo fi l-bakaan al-maat foogah Asaahiil.
Wa laakin Yuwaab wa Abichaay chaalo derib Abniir.Wa wakit wassalo jabal Amma,al-harraay waga'at khalaas.Wa l-jabal da gaa'id sabaah le hillit Giiyah fi l-derib al-maachi ale saharat Gib'uun.
Wa gabiilat Banyaamiin lammo kulluhum wara Abniir misil raajil waahid fi raas jabal waahid.
Wa Abniir naadaah le Yuwaab be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Le mata nikhallu minnina al-duwaas-?Inta ma ta'arfah kadar al-cheyy da yikammil be hizin-?Wa le mata tuguul le naasak yikhallu minhum mutaaradat akhwaanhum-?
Wa Yuwaab gaal le Abniir-:-Nahlif leek be Allah al-Hayy,awwal kan inta ma hajjeet da,naasi yitaaruduuku lahaddi ambaakir fajur.
Wa khalaas,Yuwaab darab al-buug wa kulla naasah wagafo min mutaaradat akhwaanhum Bani Israa'iil wa battaan ma alhaarabo.
Wa Abniir wa naasah raakho tuul al-leel fi waadi al-Urdun wa chaggo al-bahar wa raakho lahaddi hillit Bitruun wa wassalo Mahanaayim.
Wa ba'ad Yuwaab khalla mutaaradat Abniir,lamma kulla naasah.Wa fagad Asaahiil wa 19 naas min naas Dawuud.
Wa laakin naas Dawuud katalo 360 naas min rujaal hana Banyaamiin wa Abniir.
Wa chaalo janaazit Asaahiil wa dafanooha fi khabur abuuh al-fi Beet Laham.Wa ba'ad da,Yuwaab wa naasah raakho tuul al-leel wa wassalo fi Hibruun be fajur badri.
Wa l-harba ambeen aayilat Dawuud wa aayilat Chaawuul tawwalat.Wa gudrat Dawuud gaa'ide tiziid wa aayilat Chaawuul kamaan darajathum gaa'ide tangus.
Wa daahu awlaad Dawuud al-wildoohum leyah fi Hibruun.Al-bikir usmah Amnuun wa ammah usumha Akhinuu'am min hillit Yazra'iil.
Wa l-taani Kilaab wa ammah usumha Abigaayil al-awwal marit Naabaal min hillit Karmal.Wa l-taalit Abchaluum wa ammah usumha Ma'aaka bineeyit Talmaay malik balad Gachuur.
Wa l-raabi' Aduniiya wa ammah usumha Haggiit.Wa l-khaamis Chafatya wa ammah usumha Abitaal.
Wa l-saadis Yitra'aam wa ammah usumha Agla marit Dawuud.Wa dool awlaad Dawuud al-wildoohum leyah fi Hibruun.
Wa wakit al-harib gaa'id ambeen aayilat Chaawuul wa aayilat Dawuud,Abniir gaa'id yilmakkan fi lubb aayilat Chaawuul.
Wa Chaawuul indah sirriiye waahide usumha Risfa wa abuuha usmah Ayya.Wa yoom waahid,Ichbuuchat taham Abniir wa gaal-:-Maala dakhalt fi sirriiyit abuuyi-?
Wa wakit Abniir simi' al-kalaam da,zi'il za'al chadiid wa gaal-:-Ana jaasuus hana Bani Yahuuza walla-?Ya hassa' kula,ana gaa'id fi amaani le aayilat Chaawuul abuuk wa akhwaanah wa rufgaanah.Wa inta zaatak,ana ma sallamtak le Dawuud-!Wa laakin al-yoom,inta tahamtini be l-mara di.
Khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid kan ana ma haggagt al-cheyy al-halaf beyah Allah le Dawuud.
Achaan Allah gaal yichiil al-muluk min aayilat Chaawuul wa yantiih le Dawuud.Wa hu yahkim fi Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza min Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati.
Wa Ichbuuchat ma yagdar yuguul kilme waahide kula le Abniir achaan hu khaayif minnah.
Wa khalaas,Abniir rassal naas le Dawuud wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu guulu le Dawuud-:--Yaatu yahkim al-balad di-?- Wa guulu leyah battaan-:--Khalli yisawwi ma'aayi mu'aahada wa ana nisaa'idah wa kulla Bani Israa'iil yindammo leyah.-
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Sameh-!Nisawwi ma'aak mu'aahada.Wa laakin natlub minnak cheyy waahid.Gubbaal ma taji tigaabilni,jiib leyi marti Mikaal bineeyit Chaawuul.Wa ba'ad da,ta'aal gaabilni.
Wa Dawuud rassal naas le Ichbuuchat wileed Chaawuul wa gaal-:-Gabbil leyi marti Mikaal al-ana akhadtaha be miya khulaf hana l-Filistiyiinal-ana kataltuhum.
Wa khalaas,Ichbuuchat rassal maragooha le Mikaal min beet raajilha Faltiyiil wileed Layich.
Wa raajilha taaba'ha be baki lahaddi hillit Bahuriim.Wa laakin Abniir gaal leyah-:-Yalla gabbil amchi beetak-! Wa khalaas,hu gabbal macha beetah.
Wa Abniir lamma chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil wa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Min zamaan,intu dawwartu Dawuud yabga malikku.
Wa hassa' da,darrujuuh-!Achaan fi sabab Dawuud,Allah gaal-:--Be waasitat abdi Dawuud,ana ninajji cha'abi Bani Israa'iil min iid al-Filistiyiin wa min kulla udwaanhum.-
Wa Abniir hajja be nafs al-kalaam da le kubaaraat gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa ba'ad da,gamma wa macha le Dawuud fi Hibruun kallam leyah be niiyit Bani Israa'iil wa kulla gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa wakit Abniir macha bakaan Dawuud fi Hibruun,chaal ma'aayah 20 raajil.Wa Dawuud sawwa leehum aazuuma.
Wa Abniir gaal le Dawuud-:-Khalli namchi nilimm kulla Bani Israa'iil le yindammo leek inta,ya siidi al-malik.Wa humman yisawwu ma'aak mu'aahada wa inta tahkim fi ayyi bakaan al-galbak yidoorah. Wa khalaas,Dawuud khallaah macha.Wa Abniir faat be l-salaama.
Wa ba'ad chiyya,Yuwaab wa naas Dawuud gabbalo min al-harib wa jaabo ma'aahum khaniime katiire.Wa fi l-wakit da,Abniir khalaas ma fiih fi Hibruun achaan Dawuud khallaah macha be l-salaama.
Wa wakit Yuwaab wa kulla l-askar al-ma'aayah wassalo,khabbaroohum kadar Abniir wileed Niir ja bakaan al-malik wa hu khallaah macha be l-salaama.
Wa Yuwaab gaabal al-malik wa gaal-:-Da chunu al-sawweetah da-?Maala Abniir ja leek hini wa inta khalleetah macha-?
Wa Yuwaab gaal battaan-:-Abniir wileed Niir da,inta ta'arfah tamaam kadar hu ja leek le yukhuchchak wa ya'arif marigiinak wa jaytak wa yichiif kulla cheyy al-inta gaa'id tisawwiih.
Wa tawwaali,Yuwaab marag min bakaan Dawuud wa rassal naas wara Abniir wa humman gabbalooh min Biir Siira.Wa laakin Dawuud ma indah khabar.
Wa wakit Abniir gabbal ja fi Hibruun,Yuwaab laagaah fi khachum baab al-hille wa tarrafah misil yidoor yihajji leyah be achiir.Wa tawwaali,ta'anah fi batnah wa katalah.Wa be da,hu alkaffa al-taar hana akhuuh Asaahiil.
Wa wakit Dawuud simi' be cheyy al-kaan da,gaal-:-Ana wa mamlakati bariyiin giddaam Allah min dimmit Abniir wileed Niir ila l-abad.
Wa khalli al-dimme di taga' fi raas Yuwaab wa zurriiytah.Wa khalli daayman waahidiin minhum yakrubhum marad al-bajal aw marad al-jismi aw yisawwu khidmit al-awiin aw yumuutu fi l-harib aw yat'abo min al-juu'.
Wa be misil da,Yuwaab wa akhuuh Abichaay katalo Abniir achaan hu katal akhuuhum Asaahiil fi l-harib al-kaan fi hillit Gib'uun.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Dawuud gaal le Yuwaab wa le kulla l-naas al-ma'aayah-:-Charrutu khulgaanku wa albaso khulgaan hana chuwaalaat le tiwassufu hizinku le Abniir. Wa Dawuud macha wara l-janaaza.
Wa dafano janaazit Abniir fi Hibruun.Wa Dawuud baka chadiid fi l-khabur wa kulla l-naas al-ma'aayah bako.
Wa Dawuud wassaf hiznah le Abniir be khine wa gaal-:-Ya Abniir,maalak tumuut misil al-mukhaffal-?
Iideenak ma marbuutiinwa rijileenak kula ma mujanzariin.Wa mootak misil al-naadumal-katalooh mujrimiin.-Wa kulla l-naas al-haadiriin gaa'idiin yabku fi chaan Abniir.
Wa ba'ad da,naasah le Dawuud jo le yantuuh akil wa da gubbaal al-harraay ma taga'.Wa laakin Dawuud halaf wa gaal-:-Khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid kan ana akalt khubza walla cheyy aakhar gubbaal al-harraay ma taga'.
Wa kulla l-naas chaafo siyaamah wa rido beyah.Wa be misil da,kulla l-naas radyaaniin be kulla cheyy al-malik gaa'id yisawwiih.
Wa fi l-yoom da,kulla naas Bani Yahuuza wa kulla Bani Israa'iil irfo kadar katil Abniir wileed Niir da,ma be amur min al-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal le masaa'iilah-:-A'arfu kadar al-yoom khaayid kabiir maat fi Israa'iil.
Wa l-yoom kan masahooni wa darrajooni malik kula,ana na'arif kadar ma indi gudra.Laakin Yuwaab wa Abichaay awlaadha le Saruuya,humman dool gawiyiin.Wa khalli Allah yi'aakhibhum fi l-fasaala al-sawwooha.
Wa wakit Ichbuuchat wileed Chaawuul simi' kadar Abniir maat fi Hibruun,hu anbahat marra waahid.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil anbahato.
Wa Ichbuuchat indah kubaaraat askar itneen.Al-waahid usmah Ba'ana wa l-taani usmah Rikaab.Wa humman iyaal Rimmuun al-min hillit Biiruut min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa hillit Biiruut mahsuuba le turaab Banyaamiin.
Wa zamaan,naas hillit Biiruut arrado wa macho hillit Gitaayim wa ga'ado hinaak lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Yuunataan wileed Chaawuul indah wileed rijileenah maato.Wa da hasal wakit jaabo khabar moot Chaawuul wa Yuunataan min hillit Yazra'iil.Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-wileed indah khamsa sana.Wa l-mara al-takurbah chaalatah wa mu'arride beyah wa min al-sa'jaal,hu waga' minha.Wa be sabab da,rijileenah maato.Wa l-wileed da usmah Mafiibuchat.
Wa Rikaab wa Ba'ana iyaal Rimmuun al-min hillit Biiruut macho bakaan Ichbuuchat wakit al-harraay haamiye.Wa hu raagid yinjamma.
Wa humman dakhalo fi l-beet misil yidooru yichiilu gameh wa ta'anooh fi batnah wa katalooh.Wa ba'ad da,Rikaab wa akhuuh Ba'ana arrado.
Wa wakit dakhalo fi l-beet,ligooh raagid fi sariirah fi lubb beetah gaa'id yinjamma.Wa khalaas,ta'anooh katalooh wa gata'o raasah wa arrado beyah.Wa humman raakho tuul al-leel fi l-derib al-maachi waadi al-Urdun.
Wa jaabo raas Ichbuuchat le Dawuud fi Hibruun wa gaalo leyah-:-Ya siidna al-malik,fi chaanak inta al-yoom Allah aakhab Chaawuul wa zurriiytah.Wa hassa' da,daahu raas Ichbuuchat wileed Chaawuul,aduuk al-dawwar yaktulak.
Wa Dawuud radda le Rikaab wa akhu Ba'ana iyaal Rimmuun al-min hillit Biiruut wa gaal leehum-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy al-fadaani min kulla cheyy fasil-!
Ana nuguul leeku,zamaan naadum waahid khabbaraani be moot Chaawuul wa hu yahsib jaab leyi khabar halu.Laakin ana karabtah wa kataltah fi Sikhlaag.Wa di natiijat al-khabar al-hu jaabah.
Wa laakin intu dool fasliin marra waahid.Kataltu leeku naadum saalih fi lubb beetah fi sariirah-!Wa be sabab al-dimme di,ana ni'aakhibku wa nuguchchuku min al-ard.
Wa Dawuud amar naasah yaktulu Rikaab wa Ba'ana.Wa humman kataloohum wa gata'o iideehum wa rijleehum wa allago jisassuhum jamb al-rahad al-fi Hibruun.Wa laakin raas Ichbuuchat kamaan,chaalooh wa dafanooh fi khabur Abniir fi Hibruun.
Wa kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil jo le Dawuud fi Hibruun wa gaalo leyah-:-Chiif-!Aniina min dammak wa lahamak.
Wa zamaan wakit Chaawuul malikna,inta gaa'id tuguud deech Bani Israa'iil.Wa fi l-wakit daak bas,Allah gaal leek-:--Inta tabga raa'i le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa tahkim fooghum.-
Wa kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil jo le Dawuud fi Hibruun wa hu sawwa ma'aahum mu'aahada giddaam Allah.Wa humman masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Dawuud indah 30 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 40 sana.
Wa hu hakam fi Bani Yahuuza 7 sana wa nuss fi Hibruun.Wa ba'ad da,hakam fi kulla Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza 33 sana fi Uruchaliim.
Wa yoom waahid,Dawuud wa naasah gammo min Hibruun wa macho Uruchaliim le yihaarubu al-Yabuusiyiin al-saakniin fiiha.Wa l-Yabuusiyiin gaalo le Dawuud-:-Inta ma tagdar tadkhul fi l-hille di-!Hatta al-amyaaniin wa l-mukarsahiin kula yagdaro yadharook. Wa be l-kalaam da,humman yahsubu Dawuud ma yagdar yichiil al-hille.
Wa be da kula,Dawuud chaal bakaanhum al-gawi al-usmah Sahyuun.Wa l-bakaan da,sammooh madiinat Dawuud.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Dawuud gaal le naasah-:-Kan ayyi naadum yidoor yahjim al-Yabuusiyiin,khalli yadkhul leehum be l-majra al-yadkhul beyah al-almi al-fi tihit al-ard wa yalhaghum.Wa kan le l-mukarsahiin wa l-amyaaniin dool,ana nakrahhum. Wa fi chaan da,al-masal buguul-:-Al-amyaaniin wa l-mukarsahiin ma yadkhulu beet Allah.
Wa Dawuud sakan fi l-bakaan al-gawi da wa sammaah madiinat Dawuud.Wa ba'ad da,bana durdur al-difaa' al-sammooh Millu al-gaa'id ambeen al-ziraa'a wa maskanah.
Wa gudrat Dawuud gaa'ide tiziid be ziyaada achaan Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir gaa'id ma'aayah.
Wa Hiiraam malik balad Suur rassal naas le Dawuud wa waddo leyah hatab al-arz.Wa rassal najjaariin al-hatab wa naas al-yagta'o al-hajar le yabnu beet le Dawuud.
Wa be da,Dawuud irif kadar Allah sabbatah malik fi Bani Israa'iil.Wa Allah zaad darajat mulkah fi chaan cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit Dawuud gamma min Hibruun wa ja fi Uruchaliim,akhad awiin aakharaat wa chaal sirriiyaat.Wa hinna wildan leyah awlaad wa banaat.
Wa daahu asaame awlaad Dawuud al-wildoohum leyah fi Uruchaliim.Humman Chammuu' wa Chuubaab wa Naataan wa Suleymaan
wa Yibhaar wa Alichuu' wa Nafag wa Yafii'a
wa Alichama' wa Aliyaada' wa Alifaalat.
Wa wakit al-Filistiyiin sim'o kadar Dawuud masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi Bani Israa'iil,kulluhum gammo macho le yifattuchuuh.Wa laakin Dawuud simi' beehum wa macha ga'ad fi bakaanah al-gawi.
Wa l-Filistiyiin jo le l-harib wa rasso fi waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa Dawuud sa'al Allah wa gaal-:-Namchi nihaarib al-Filistiyiin walla-?Inta tisallimhum fi iidi walla-? Wa Allah radda le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Amchi haaribhum wa akiid ana nisallimhum leek fi iidak.
Wa Dawuud macha hillit Ba'al Faraasiim wa haarabaahum le l-Filistiyiin hinaak wa annasar fooghum.Wa gaal-:-Allah fatah leyi derib wa darabt udwaani misil al-seel. Wa be sabab da bas,al-bakaan da sammooh Ba'al Faraasiim (ma'anaatah al-Rabb al-darab).
Wa l-Filistiyiin khallo asnaamhum fi l-bakaan da wa Dawuud wa naasah chaaloohum.
Wa battaan al-Filistiyiin jo le l-harib wa rasso fi waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa Dawuud sa'al Allah.Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Ma tamchi tahjimhum be giddaam laakin hawwig leehum be wara min jiihat al-chadar wa garrib leehum.
Wa wakit simi't haraka misil khatwaat al-rijil fi raas al-chadar,tawwaali amchi ahjimhum-!Achaan Allah macha giddaamak le yadrub askar al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Dawuud sawwa kulla cheyy misil Allah amarah beyah.Wa khalaas,haarab al-Filistiyiin wa taradaahum min hillit Gaba' lahaddi madkhal hillit Gaazar.
Wa Dawuud lamma battaan 30-000 raajil min ahsan al-muhaaribiin hana Bani Israa'iil.
Wa gamma ma'a kulla l-naas dool wa macho hillit Ba'la Yahuuza achaan yijiibu min hinaak sanduug al-Rabb.Wa da l-sanduug al-foogah usum Allah al-Gaadir,hu al-archah gaa'id been al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin al-masnuu'iin fi sidaadit al-sanduug.
Wa humman chaalo sanduug al-Rabb min beet Abinadaab al-gaa'id fi raas al-hajar wa khattooh fi kaarro jadiid.Wa awlaad Abinadaab,Uzza wa Akhyu,gaado al-kaarro
al-gaa'id foogah sanduug al-Rabb wa Akhyu maachi giddaamah.
Wa Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yal'abo giddaam sanduug Allah fi hiss aalaat al-sawwoohum be hatab al-sarwi misil al-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l-tambal wa l-bukhsa wa l-nuggaara.
Wa wakit wassalo fi l-madagg hana Naakuun,al-bagar attarta'o wa Uzza madda iidah wa karab sanduug al-Rabb.
Wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Uzza wa tawwaali darabah achaan khataayah.Wa Uzza waga' maat hinaak jamb sanduug al-Rabb.
Wa Dawuud zi'il za'al chadiid achaan Allah khidib didd Uzza wa darabah.Wa samma al-bakaan da Faaris Uzza (ma'anaatah darab Uzza) wa l-usum da gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Dawuud khaaf khoof chadiid min Allah wa gaal-:-Kan ke da,kikkeef nagdar nijiib sanduug Allah fi beeti-?
Wa Dawuud aba ma yiwaddi sanduug Allah fi beetah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa laakin waddaah fi beet Ubeed Adoom al-min hillit Gaat.
Wa sanduug Allah ga'ad talaata chahar fi beet Ubeed Adoom.Wa Allah baarak Ubeed Adoom wa kulla aayiltah.
Wa jo khabbarooh le l-malik Dawuud kadar Allah baarak Ubeed Adoom wa kulla aayiltah wa ayyi cheyy al-indah achaan sanduug al-Rabb gaa'id fi beetah.Wa khalaas,Dawuud gamma macha chaal sanduug al-Rabb min beet Ubeed Adoom wa waddaah fi madiinat Dawuud be farah.
Wa wakit al-naas al-chaalo sanduug Allah yisawwu sitte khatwa,Dawuud yadbah toor wa ijil samiin.
Wa Dawuud gaa'id yal'ab be kulla gudurtah giddaam Allah wa laabis khalag gisayyir misil rujaal al-diin.
Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israa'iil waddo sanduug Allah fi Uruchaliim be zakhraat wa daribiin buug.
Wa wakit jaabo sanduug Allah fi madiinat Dawuud,Mikaal bineeyit Chaawuul gaa'ide tichiif min al-chubbaak wa hi chaafat al-malik Dawuud gaa'id yal'ab wa yinattit giddaam Allah.Wa khalaas,hi abatah min daakhil galibha.
Wa humman jaabo sanduug Allah wa khattooh fi bakaanah fi lubb al-kheema al-Dawuud jahhazaaha leyah.Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud gaddam le Allah dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.
Wa wakit Dawuud gaddam al-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa dahaaya al-salaama dool khalaas,hu baarak Bani Israa'iil be usum Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud gassam akil le kulla cha'ab Bani Israa'iil,mara wa raajil.Le ayyi waahid,antaah khubza wa abbuud hana tamur wa abbuud hana inab.Wa khalaas,kulla l-cha'ab chatto wa ayyi waahid gabbal beetah.
Wa Dawuud gabbal beetah le yibaarik aayiltah.Wa Mikaal bineeyit Chaawuul maragat tilaagiih wa gaalat-:-Da ma eeb leek inta malik Bani Israa'iil-?Al-yoom khalleet jildak aryaan giddaam khaddaamaat naasak misil naadum al-ma yanfa' yisawwiih-!
Wa Dawuud gaal le Mikaal-:-Ana sawweet al-cheyy da giddaam Allah al-azalaani ana akheer min abuuki wa aayiltah.Wa sawwaani kabiir hana cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.Wa ana nafrah battaan ziyaada giddaam Allah.
Aywa-!Kan ti'ayyiriini wa ti'ayyibiini kula,nafrah.Wa laakin al-khaddaamaat deel yicharrifanni.
Wa Mikaal bineeyit Chaawuul ma ligat sakhiir lahaddi maatat.
Wa ba'ad Allah nasarah le l-malik Dawuud fi kulla udwaanah al-mujaawiriinah,khalaas hu sakan fi beetah be l-salaama.
Wa yoom waahid,al-malik gaal le l-nabi Naataan-:-Chiif,ana saakin fi beet jamiil hana hatab al-arz.Wa laakin sanduug al-Rabb gaa'id fi kheema bas.
Wa Naataan radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Amchi sawwi kulla cheyy al-fi galbak achaan Allah ma'aak.
Wa laakin fi l-leele di,Allah hajja le Naataan wa gaal-:
Amchi guul le abdi Dawuud-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Da ma inta al-tabni leyi beet al-ana naskun foogah.
Achaan ana abadan ma sakant fi beet min yoom al-ana maragt Bani Israa'iil min Masir lahaddi l-yoom.Wa laakin ana sirt ma'aahum wa sakant fi kheema.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan,ana sirt ma'a kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa ana abadan ma kallamt le waahid min kubaaraat gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-ana amartuhum le yahkumu foog cha'abi wa la sa'altah maala ma bana leyi beet hana hatab al-arz."--
Wa hassa' da,amchi guul le abdi Dawuud-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:"Ana jibtak min sarhit al-khanam achaan tabga kabiir hana cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana kunt ma'aak fi ayyi bakaan al-inta macheet foogah wa gachcheet kulla udwaanak min giddaamak.Wa nisawwi usmak aali misil al-asaame hana l-naas al-kubaar fi l-ard.
Wa ana nanti bakaan le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa nimakkinhum.Wa humman yaskunu fi l-bakaan da bala khoof.Wa naas fasliin ma yazulmuuhum battaan misil awwal.
Wa min wakit al-ana kallaft hukkaam fi cha'abi Bani Israa'iil,ana najjeetak min kulla udwaanak.Wa nikhabbirak kadar ana Allah nisabbit beet aayiltak.
Wa wakit ayyaamak yikammulu,tumuut wa talhag abbahaatak.Wa ana na'azil waahid min zurriiytak,hu al-yamrug min sulbak,wa ana nisabbit mulkah.
Wa hu bas al-yabni beet le yimajjudu foogah usmi wa ana nisabbit aayiltah fi l-muluk ila l-abad.
Wa ana nabga leyah abuuh wa hu yabga leyi ibni.Wa kan ma maachi adiil,ana ni'addibah misil al-insaan yi'addib iyaalah.
Wa laakin ma nichiil minnah rahmati misil chiltaha min Chaawuul al-ana tarraftah achaan inta tabga malik.
Wa aayilat beetak tahkim daayman ba'adak wa mulkak yasbit ila l-abad."-
Wa Naataan hajja le Dawuud be kulla l-kalaam al-gaalah leyah Allah fi l-ru'ya di.
Wa l-malik Dawuud dakhal fi l-kheema fi hadarat Allah wa gaal-:-Ana yaatu,ya Allah Rabbi-?Wa aayilti tisaawi chunu lahaddi tantiini daraja misil di-?
Wa da cheyy hayyin saakit leek inta,ya Allah Rabbi,wa inta aahadt aayilat beeti ana abdak fi l-mustakhbal.Wa ya Allah Rabbi,cheyy misil da yichaabih leyi ana al-insaani walla-?
Ya Allah Rabbi,inta ta'arifni tamaam ana abdak.Wa nagdar nuguul chunu battaan-?
Wa be sabab kalaamak wa niiytak,inta sawweet leyi al-achya al-kubaar dool wa arraftuhum leyi ana abdak.
Ya Allah al-Rabb,inta al-akbar.Inta ma indak chabiih wa abadan ma fi ilaah illa inta.Wa da hasab kulla l-kalaam al-simi'naah.
Fiyah umma fi kulla l-ard misil cha'abak Bani Israa'iil walla-?Ya Rabb,inta fadeethum wa sawweethum cha'abak achaan usmak yabga aali.Wa inta sawweet ajaayib kubaar al-bikhawwufu le baladak wa giddaam cha'abak al-inta fadeethum le nafsak min balad Masir.Wa taradt al-umam al-aakhariin wa ilaahaathum giddaam cha'abak.
Wa inta sabbatt cha'abak Bani Israa'iil le yabgo daayman cha'abak halaalak.Ya Allah,inta bigiit leehum Ilaahhum.
Wa hassa' da,ya Allah Ilaahi,al-kalaam al-gultah foogi ana abdak wa foog aayilti da,khalli yilhaggag ila l-abad.Wa tammim kulla cheyy al-gultah.
Wa khalli yimajjudu usmak ila l-abad wa yuguulu-:--Allah al-Gaadir,hu bas Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.- Wa khalli beeti ana abdak Dawuud yagood saabit giddaamak.
Achaan inta zaatak,ya Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,khabbartini ana abdak wa gult leyi-:--Nisabbit beet aayiltak fi l-muluk.---Wa fi chaan da,ana abdak ligiit al-chajaa'a wa gaddamt leek al-sala di.
Wa hassa' da,ya Allah Rabbi,inta bas al-Ilaah wa kalaamak hagg.Wa inta aahadtini ana abdak be kulla l-kheer da.
Wa khalaas hassa' da,akhbal su'aali wa baarik aayilti ana abdak le yamulku giddaamak ila l-abad.Ya Allah Rabbi,achaan inta bas gult be barakatak,aayilat beeti talga baraka daayme.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud haarab al-Filistiyiin wa annasar fooghum.Wa gala' sultit hukumhum.
Hu annasar fi naas Muwaab wa raggadaahum fi l-ard wa gaawasaahum be habil.Wa khattaahum be majmuu'aat wa fi ayyi talaata majmuu'a,yaktul majmuu'teen.Wa naas balad Muwaab ga'ado tihit hukum Dawuud wa yikaffu miiri.
Wa Dawuud annasar fi Hadad'aazar wileed Rahuub malik Suuba.Wa da fi l-wakit al-Hadad'aazar dawwar yichiil battaan mantagat bahar al-Furaat.
Wa Dawuud karab min Hadad'aazar 1-700 masaajiin min siyaad al-kheel wa 20-000 askar maachiin be rijleehum.Wa hu gatta' araagiib hana l-kheel al-yukurru arabaat al-harib wa khalla minhum illa 100 kheel.
Wa naas balad Araam jo min Dimachkh le yafza'o le Hadad'aazar malik Suuba.Wa laakin Dawuud katal min naas Araam 22-000 raajil.
Wa Dawuud khatta muhaafiziin fi l-Araamiyiin al-gaa'idiin tihit hukum madiinat Dimachkh.Wa l-Araamiyiin ga'ado tihit hukum Dawuud wa gaa'idiin yikaffu miiri.Wa Allah anta al-nasur le Dawuud fi ayyi bakaan al-yamchi foogah.
Wa Dawuud gala' darag hana dahab min hurraas Hadad'aazar wa waddaahum Uruchaliim.
Wa min Baatah wa Biiruutaay hillaal Hadad'aazar,al-malik Dawuud gala' nahaas katiir.
Wa Tuu'i malik balad Hamaat simi' kadar Dawuud annasar fi kulla askar Hadad'aazar.
Khalaas,rassal wileedah Yuuraam le yisallimah wa yachkurah achaan Dawuud haarab Hadad'aazar wa annasar foogah.Wa gubbaal da,Tuu'i wa Hadad'aazar humman udwaan.Wa Yuuraam wileed Tuu'i jaab le Dawuud mu'iddaat katiiriin hana fudda wa dahab wa nahaas.
Wa l-mu'iddaat al-jaabaahum leyah dool,Dawuud khassasaahum le Allah.Wa da misil awwal kula,hu khassas le Allah al-fudda wa l-dahab al-chaalaahum min al-umam al-annasar fooghum.
Wa l-umam dool humman al-Adoomiyiin wa l-Muwaabiyiin wa Bani Ammuun wa l-Filistiyiin wa l-Amaalikh.Wa kulla l-khaniime al-chaalaaha min Hadad'aazar wileed Rahuub malik hillit Suuba,di kula hu khassasaaha le Allah.
Wa Dawuud annasar fi l-Araamiyiin fi waadi al-Mileh wa katal minhum 18-000 raajil wa usmah bigi taali' be ziyaada.
Wa Dawuud khatta muhaafiziin fi ayyi bakaan fi balad Adoom wa kulla l-Adoomiyiin ga'ado tihit hukmah.Wa Allah anta al-nasur le Dawuud fi ayyi bakaan al-yamchi foogah.
Wa Dawuud malak fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa hakam fi kulla cha'abah be l-hagg wa l-adaala.
Wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya,hu khaayid al-deech wa Yahuuchafat wileed Akhiluud,hu kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik
wa Saduukh wileed Akhituub wa Akhiimalik wileed Abiyaatar,humman dool rujaal diin wa Saraaya,hu kaatib hana l-malik.
Wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada',hu mas'uul fi l-Kiritiyiin wa fi l-Filtiyiin wa humman dool hurraas al-malik.Wa awlaad Dawuud,humman rujaal diin.
Wa yoom waahid,Dawuud sa'al wa gaal-:-Hal faddal naadum waahid min aayilat Chaawuul al-nagdar nisawwi leyah kheer fi chaan Yuunataan walla-?
Wa fi beet Chaawuul,fiyah khaddaam waahid usmah Siiba wa jaabooh bakaan Dawuud.Wa l-malik sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta bas Siiba walla-? Wa hu radda wa gaal-:-Aywa,ana abdak.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Hal ma faddal naadum waahid min aayilat Chaawuul al-nagdar nisawwi leyah kheer al-Rabb walla-? Wa Siiba radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Faddal wileed waahid hana Yuunataan al-rijileenah maytiin.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Gaa'id ween-? Wa Siiba radda leyah wa gaal-:-Hu gaa'id fi hillit Luudabaar fi beet Makiir wileed Amiyiil.
Wa l-malik Dawuud rassal jaabooh min beet Makiir wileed Amiyiil fi hillit Luudabaar.
Wa wakit Mafiibuchat wileed Yuunataan wileed Chaawuul wassal bakaan Dawuud,waga' be wijhah wa sajad giddaamah.Wa Dawuud sa'alah wa gaal-:-Da inta Mafiibuchat walla-? Wa hu radda wa gaal-:-Aywa,ana abdak.
Wa Dawuud gaal leyah-:-Ma takhaaf.Ana nisawwi leek kheer fi chaan al-amaan al-indi le abuuk Yuunataan.Wa nantiik kulla ziraa'a hana jiddak Chaawuul.Wa inta taakul ma'aayi daayman fi beeti.
Wa Mafiibuchat sajad wa gaal-:-Ana abdak misil kalib mayyit.Maala tihimm beyi-?
Wa l-malik naadaah le Siiba khaddaam Chaawuul wa gaal leyah-:-Kulla cheyy al-hana siidak Chaawuul wa aayiltah,ana nantiih le wileed wileedah Mafiibuchat.
Inta wa iyaalak wa khaddaamiinak tahartu leyah.Wa l-intaaj,tijiibuuha le wileed Yuunataan wileed siidak achaan yi'iich beeha.Wa Mafiibuchat wileed siidak yaakul daayman ma'aayi fi beeti. Wa Siiba da indah 15 awlaad wa 20 khaddaam.
Wa Siiba radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Ana abdak nisawwi kulla cheyy al-siidi al-malik amaraani beyah.-Wa be misil da,khalaas Mafiibuchat gaa'id yaakul daayman fi gasir al-malik misil waahid min awlaadah.
Wa Mafiibuchat indah wileed waahid sakhayyar usmah Miika.Wa kulla l-naas al-saakniin fi beet Siiba gaa'idiin yakhdumu le Mafiibuchat.
Wa Mafiibuchat sakan fi Uruchaliim achaan yamchi yaakul daayman fi beet al-malik.Wa Mafiibuchat da,rijileenah maytiin.
Wa ba'ad da,Nahaach malik Bani Ammuun maat wa wileedah Hanuun hakam fi badalah.
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Nisawwi al-kheer le Hanuun wileed Nahaach misil al-kheer al-abuuh sawwaah leyi.-Wa Dawuud rassal masaa'iilah le Hanuun achaan yikalwudu leyah fi moot abuuh.Wa wakit humman wassalo fi balad Bani Ammuun,
kubaaraat al-balad gaalo le Hanuun siidhum-:-Hal le yicharrif abuuk bas Dawuud rassal naasah achaan yikalwudu leek walla-?La,hu rassal naasah misil jawaasiis achaan yi'akkudu min al-hille di wa ba'adeen yaju yichiiluuha.
Wa khalaas,Hanuun karab masaa'iil Dawuud wa zayyan nuss duguunhum wa gatta' khulgaanhum min ale ja'abaathum.Wa ba'ad da,taradaahum.
Wa khabbaro Dawuud be l-ihaana al-ziyaada al-bigat fi naasah.Wa hu rassal leehum naadum le yuguul leehum-:-Agoodu fi hillit Ariiha lahaddi duguunku yugummu wa ba'ad da,ta'aalu.
Wa naas Bani Ammuun irfo kadar humman bigo makruuhiin le Dawuud.Wa khalaas,jannado murtazakha 20-000 askar min al-Araamiyiin al-min hillit Beet Rahuub wa min al-Araamiyiin al-min hillit Suuba wa 1-000 raajil min balad al-malik Ma'aaka wa 12-000 min balad Toob.
Wa wakit Dawuud simi' be l-cheyy da,rassal Yuwaab ma'a kulla l-askar al-fahaliin didduhum.
Wa Bani Ammuun kamaan marago wa rasso le l-harib fi khachum baab al-hille.Wa l-Araamiyiin al-min hillit Suuba wa l-min hillit Rahuub wa naas Ma'aaka al-min balad Toob,humman dool ga'ado taraf fi l-khala.
Wa Yuwaab chaaf kadar hu wa naasah waajib yihaarubu majmuu'teen,al-waahide waraahum wa l-aakhara giddaamhum.Wa khalaas,hu azzal naasah al-chudaad min Bani Israa'iil wa gaabalaahum le l-Araamiyiin.
Wa naasah al-faddalo kamaan,kallaf beehum akhuuh Abichaay wa humman gaabalo Bani Ammuun.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuwaab gaal le Abichaay-:-Kan al-Araamiyiin khalabooni,inta taji tafza'ni.Wa kan Bani Ammuun khalabook,ana naji nafza'ak.
Chidd heelak,khalli nabgo rujaal-!Nidaafu'u le cha'abna wa le l-hillaal al-Ilaahna antaahum leena.Wa khalli Allah yisawwi al-cheyy al-yidoorah.
Wa khalaas,Yuwaab wa l-askar al-ma'aayah macho le yihaarubu al-Araamiyiin al-gaa'idiin taraf fi l-khala.Wa l-Araamiyiin dool arrado minhum.
Wa wakit Bani Ammuun chaafo al-Araamiyiin arrado,humman kula arrado min Abichaay wa gabbalo hillithum.Wa khalaas,Yuwaab khalla minnah al-duwaas didd Bani Ammuun wa gabbal Uruchaliim.
Wa laakin wakit al-Araamiyiin chaafo kadar Bani Israa'iil annasaro fooghum,humman macho wa lammo kulla naashum.
Wa l-malik Hadad'aazar rassal naas le yilimmu kulla l-Araamiyiin al-gaa'idiin khaadi le bahar al-Furaat.Wa humman lammo fi hillit Hilaam.Wa fi raashum Chubak khaayid deech Hadad'aazar.
Wa wakit khabbarooh le Dawuud,hu kula lamma kulla askar Bani Israa'iil wa gata' bahar al-Urdun wa macha Hilaam.Wa l-Araamiyiin rasso gaabalooh le Dawuud wa haarabooh.
Laakin askar al-Araamiyiin arrado min Bani Israa'iil.Wa wakit humman mu'arridiin,Dawuud wa askarah katalo 700 naas min siyaad arabaat al-harib wa katalo 40-000 min siyaad al-kheel.Wa darabo Chubak khaayid deech al-Araamiyiin wa hu maat fi l-bakaan da.
Wa wakit kulla l-muluuk al-gaa'idiin tihit Hadad'aazar irfo kadar Bani Israa'iil annasaro fooghum khalaas,humman sawwo ma'aahum salaam wa ga'ado tihit hukumhum.Wa l-Araamiyiin khaafo wa battaan ma jo faza'o le Bani Ammuun.
Wa fi l-sana al-jadiide,fi wakit al-muluuk yamchu al-harib,Dawuud rassal Yuwaab khaayid deechah wa naasah wa kulla Bani Israa'iil fi l-harib.Wa humman dammaro Bani Ammuun wa haasaro madiinat Rabba aasimathum.Wa laakin Dawuud ga'ad fi Uruchaliim.
Wa yoom waahid be achiiye,Dawuud gamma min furaachah wa gaa'id yihawwig fi raas gasrah wa min foog,chaaf mara gaa'ide tilbarrad.Wa hi jamiile marra waahid.
Wa Dawuud rassal le yi'akkudu min al-mara di.Wa oorooh gaalo leyah-:-Di Batchaaba' bineeyit Ali'aam.Wa hi marit Uriiya al-min gabiilat al-Hittiyiin.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud rassal naas le yijiibuuha.Wa l-mara di dahaabha khassalat wa hi jaat fi gasrah wa hu ragad ma'aaha.Wa ba'ad da,hi gabbalat beetha.
Wa l-mara di bigat khalbaane.Wa hi rassalat le Dawuud wa ooratah wa gaalat kadar hi khalbaane.
Wa tawwaali,Dawuud rassal le Yuwaab wa gaal-:-Rassil leyi Uriiya al-Hitti. Wa khalaas,Yuwaab rassalah leyah.
Wa wakit Uriiya ja le Dawuud,hu sa'alah min aafiyit Yuwaab wa l-askar wa khabar al-harib.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud gaal le Uriiya-:-Amchi beetak wa khassil rijileenak.-Wa Uriiya marag min gasir al-malik wa waraayah al-malik rassal leyah hadiiye.
Wa laakin Uriiya ragad fi madkhal gasir al-malik ma'a khaddaamiin siidah wa ma macha beetah.
Wa khabbarooh le Dawuud wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu Uriiya ma macha beetah. Wa Dawuud sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta ma dahaabak jiit min al-safar-?Wa maala ma macheet beetak-?
Wa Uriiya radda le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Sanduug Allah wa askar Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza saakniin fi khiyam wa siidi Yuwaab wa naasak al-aakhariin gaa'idiin barra fi l-kadaade.Wa be da,kikkeef namchi beeti wa naakul wa nachrab wa nargud ma'a marti-?Da ma mumkin-!Nahlif leek be hayaatak inta kadar cheyy misil da,abadan ma nisawwiih.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Uriiya-:-Khalaas,al-yoom kula agood hini.Wa ambaakir kamaan,nikhalliik tamchi.-Wa Uriiya ga'ad fi Uruchaliim fi l-yoom da wa ambaakir kula.
Wa Dawuud azamah fi gasrah le yaakul wa yachrab wa sakkarah.Wa be l-leel,Uriiya marag wa macha ragad fi furaachah ma'a khaddaamiin al-malik.Laakin ma macha beetah.
Wa be fajur,Dawuud katab jawaab le Yuwaab wa rassalah leyah be waasitat Uriiya.
Wa fi l-jawaab da,Dawuud katab wa gaal-:-Gaddim Uriiya wa khuttah fi l-bakaan al-khatari marra waahid hana l-harib al-chadiid.Wa intu ba''udu minnah.Wa be da,al-adu yadurbah wa hu yumuut.
Wa Yuwaab gaa'id yiraakhib fi l-hille al-haasarha.Khalaas,khatta Uriiya fi l-bakaan al-ya'arfah gaa'idiin foogah udwaanhum al-fahaliin.
Wa askar al-hille di marago wa hajamo Yuwaab wa katalo waahidiin min askarah wa naas Dawuud.Wa Uriiya al-Hitti kula maat.
Wa Yuwaab rassal khabbarah le Dawuud be kulla cheyy al-kaan fi l-duwaas.
Wa anta amur le l-mursaal da wa gaal-:-Ba'ad kammalt hijeek le l-malik be kulla cheyy al-kaan fi l-duwaas da,
akuun al-malik yaz'al wa yuguul leek-:--Maala intu garrabtu le l-hille hatta daawastu-?Ma ta'arfu kadar humman yadurbuuku min al-durdur walla-?
Wa ma fakkartu zamaan yaatu al-katal Abiimalik wileed Yarbuuchat fi hillit Tiibis-?Ma mara bas zagalat foogah murhaaka min al-durdur wa katalatah.Wa be da,maala intu garrabtu le l-durdur-?- Wa kan al-malik hajja leek misil da,inta rudd leyah wa guul-:--Khaddaamak Uriiya al-Hitti kula maat.-
Wa l-mursaal macha.Wa wakit wassal bakaan Dawuud,kallamah be kulla cheyy al-Yuwaab kallafah beyah.
Wa gaal le Dawuud-:-Bani Ammuun dool bigo chudaad minnina wa marago barra min al-hille wa hajamoona.Wa laakin aniina daawasnaahum lahaddi khachum baab al-hille.
Wa fi l-wakit da,siyaad al-nuchchaab zarrago fi askarak min foog le l-durdur.Wa waahidiin min askarak maato wa khaddaamak Uriiya al-Hitti kula maat.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l-mursaal-:-Amchi chajji'ah le Yuwaab wa guul leyah ma yihimm fi l-cheyy da achaan fi l-harba,daayman fi moot min hini wa min hinaak kula.Khalli yihaaribhum be chidde wa yidammir al-hille di.
Wa wakit Batchaaba' marit Uriiya sim'at be moot raajilha,hi hiznat le zoojha.
Wa ba'ad wakt al-hizin kammal khalaas,Dawuud rassal jaabooha leyah wa hu khattaaha fi beetah.Wa hi bigat leyah martah wa wildat leyah wileed.Wa laakin Allah khidib le Dawuud be sabab al-cheyy al-hu sawwaah.
Wa Allah rassal Naataan le Dawuud.Wa l-nabi macha le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:-Fiyah naaseen gaa'idiin fi hille waahide.Al-raajil al-waahid khani wa l-aakhar fagri.
Wa l-khani da indah khanam wa bagar katiiriin.
Wa l-fagri da ma indah cheyy,illa sakhala waahide bas al-hu charaaha wa gaa'id yirabbiiha.Wa hi gaa'ide takbur ma'aayah fi lubb iyaalah wa taakul min aklah wa tachrab min charaabah wa tunuum jambah.Wa hi bigat leyah misil bineeytah.
Wa yoom waahid,deef ja le l-raajil al-khani fi beetah.Wa laakin al-khani hanna fi bahaaymah wa ma dawwar yichiil bahiime waahide min khanamah aw bagarah le yidayyif beeha deefah.Hu gamma macha chaal al-sakhala hint al-fagri da wa dayyaf beeha deefah.
Wa wakit Dawuud simi' al-kalaam da,zi'il za'al chadiid didd al-raajil al-khani wa gaal le Naataan-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy,al-raajil da waajib leyah al-moot.
Wa waajib yikaffi arba'a khanam fi badal al-sakhala di achaan hu sawwa fi'il cheen wa ma hanna foogha.
Wa khalaas,Naataan gaal le Dawuud-:-Al-raajil da,inta zaatak-!Wa daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Ana masahtak wa darrajtak malik fi Bani Israa'iil wa najjeetak min iid Chaawuul.
Wa anteetak mas'uuliiye hana aayilat siidak Chaawuul wa anteetak awiinah kula.Wa anteetak mas'uuliiye hana Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.Wa da kulla ke,kan chiyya leek,ana niziidak battaan ziyaada min da.
Wa maala ma karramt kalaami ana Allah-?Maala sawweet al-cheyy al-fasil da giddaami-?Inta katalt Uriiya al-Hitti be l-seef wa chilt martah wa sawweetha martak.Aywa,inta sallamtah le Bani Ammuun wa katalooh.
Wa min al-yoom le giddaam,aayiltak yaktuluuhum be l-seef.Achaan inta ma simi't kalaami ana Allah wa chilt marit Uriiya al-Hitti wa sawweetha martak.--
Wa hassa' da,daahu Allah gaal-:--Ana ni'assis leek masiibe min lubb ahalak.Nagla' minnak awiinak wa nantiihin le waahid min ahalak wa hu yargud ma'aahin be l-nahaar.
Aywa,inta sawweet al-cheyy da be achiir laakin ana niwassifah giddaam kulla Bani Israa'iil be l-nahaar.-
Wa Dawuud gaal le Naataan-:-Ana a'taraft be zanbi giddaam Allah. Wa Naataan gaal le Dawuud-:-Allah khafar leek zunuubak,inta ma tumuut.
Wa laakin inta hagart Allah wa isiitah wa be l-sabab da,al-wileed al-wildooh leek da yumuut.
Wa ba'ad da,Naataan gabbal beetah.Wa Allah darab wileed marit Uriiya al-wildatah le Dawuud wa hu bigi mardaan.
Wa Dawuud chahad al-Rabb fi chaan al-wileed wa gaa'id yusuum.Wa wakit yamchi beetah be l-leel,yargud fi l-turaab.
Wa kubaaraat khaddaamiinah jo le yigawwumuuh min al-turaab laakin hu aba ma yugumm wa ma dawwar yaakul ma'aahum.
Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi',al-wileed maat.Wa l-masaa'iil khaafo wa abo ma yikhabburu Dawuud be mootah.Wa gaalo-:-Wakit al-wileed lissaa' hayy,aniina hajjeena leyah wa hu aba ma yasma' kalaamna.Wa kikkeef nagdaro ni'ooruuh moot al-wileed da-?Akuun yisawwi al-fasaala le nafsah.
Wa wakit Dawuud chaaf masaa'iilah gaa'idiin yiwaswusu ambeenaathum,hu irif kadar al-wileed da maat.Wa hu sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Al-wileed da maat walla-? Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aywa siidna,hu maat.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud gamma min al-turaab albarrad wa al'attar wa khayyar khulgaanah wa macha fi beet Allah wa sajad.Wa ba'ad gabbal beetah,hu sa'al yantuuh akil.Wa hu akal.
Wa masaa'iilah gaalo leyah-:-Da chunu al-gaa'id tisawwiih da-?Wakit al-wileed lissaa' hayy,inta sumt wa bakeet.Wa hassa' wakit al-wileed maat,inta tugumm wa taakul.
Wa Dawuud radda leehum wa gaal-:-Wakit al-wileed lissaa' hayy,ana sumt wa bakeet achaan gult akuun Allah yihinn foogi wa l-wileed yi'iich.
Wa laakin hassa' hu maat.Wa maala battaan nusuum-?Ana ma nagdar nigawwimah.Ana bas namchi nalhagah laakin hu abadan ma yaji leyi.
Wa Dawuud sabbar martah Batchaaba'.Wa ragad ma'aaha wa hi bigat khalbaane wa ba'ad da,wildat wileed wa hi sammatah Suleymaan.Wa Allah habbaah
wa gaalah le Dawuud be waasitat al-nabi Naataan.Wa fi chaan da,al-wileed sammooh Yadiidya (ma'anaatah mahbuub Allah).Wa da misil Allah gaalah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Yuwaab khaayid al-deech macha hajam Rabba aasimat Bani Ammuun wa chaal aasimat al-mamlaka.
Wa Yuwaab rassal naas le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Guulu le Dawuud ke-:--Ana hajamt aasimat Rabba wa chilt minha al-bakaan al-indah almi.
Hassa' da,ajala limm al-naas al-faddalo wa ta'aal hawwig al-madiina di wa chiilha inta zaatak.Achaan kan ana bas nichiilha,yinaaduuha be usmi.-
Wa khalaas,Dawuud lamma kulla naasah wa gamma macha Rabba wa hajamha wa chaalha.
Wa chaal al-taaj min raas Muulak sanam Bani Ammuun.Wa l-taaj da hana dahab wa yawzin gariib 34 kiilo wa mujammal be hajar khaali.Wa khattooh fi raas Dawuud.Wa chaalo khaniime katiire min al-madiina di.
Wa Dawuud chaal naas al-madiina di wa khaddamaahum be gu khidme al-yisawwuuha be munchaar wa khaazuug hana hadiid wa faas.Wa asaraahum fi salliliin al-diringeel kula.Wa hu sawwa misil da fi kulla hillaal Bani Ammuun.Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud wa kulla l-naas gabbalo fi Uruchaliim.
Wa ba'ad da,daahu al-cheyy al-kaan.Abchaluum wileed Dawuud indah akhut waahide jamiile usumha Taamaar.Wa Amnuun wileed Dawuud al-aakhar habbaaha le Taamaar.
Wa l-chahwa karabat Amnuun lahaddi mirid wa dawwar yargud ma'a akhtah Taamaar al-hi lissaa' ma chaafat raajil.Wa hu ma ligi fursa wa da bigi leyah gaasi bilheen.
Wa Amnuun indah rafiig waahid usmah Yunadaab wileed Chim'a akhu Dawuud.Wa Yunadaab da,hu najiid.
Wa yoom waahid,Yunadaab sa'alah le Amnuun wa gaal leyah-:-Ya wileed al-malik,maalak ayyi ma sabaah inta kaslaan-?Ma ti'ooriini al-sabab walla-? Wa Amnuun gaal leyah-:-Nihibb Taamaar akhut Abchaluum akhuuyi.
Wa Yunadaab gaal leyah-:-Argud fi sariir wa sawwi nafsak mardaan.Wa wakit abuuk yaji leek fi beetak le yichiifak,guul leyah-:--Min fadlak,anti izin le akhti Taamaar taji tantiini akil.Wa l-akil da,khalli tisawwi giddaami nichiifah be eeni.Wa hi zaatha tijiibah leyi wa ana naakulah.-
Wa khalaas,Amnuun ragad wa sawwa nafsah mardaan.Wa wakit al-malik abuuh ja le yichiifah,hu gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak,anti izin le akhti Taamaar taji tisawwi leyi itneen ka'ak fi giddaami.Wa hi zaatha tantiini wa ana naakulah.
Wa Dawuud rassal le Taamaar fi beetha wa gaal-:-Min fadulki,amchi bakaan akhuuki Amnuun wa sawwi leyah akil.
Wa Taamaar machat beet akhuuha Amnuun wa ligatah raagid.Wa khalaas,hi chaalat dagiig wa ajjanatah wa sawwatah ka'ak fi giddaamah.
Wa ba'ad da,chaalat al-ka'ak da min al-tahwa wa gaddamatah leyah achaan yaakul.Laakin hu aba ma yaakul wa gaal-:-Amurgu kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayi. Wa khalaas,kulla l-naas marago.
Wa Amnuun gaal le Taamaar-:-Waddi al-ka'ak da fi l-khurfa wa antiini naakulah.-Wa khalaas,Taamaar chaalat al-ka'ak al-sawwatah wa waddatah le akhuuha Amnuun fi l-khurfa.
Wa wakit hi gaddamatah leyah le yaakul,hu karabha wa gaal leeha-:-Ta'aali arugdi ma'aayi,ya akhti.
Wa Taamaar gaalat leyah-:-La,ya akhuuyi,ma titallifni achaan cheyy misil da ma bisawwuuh fi Israa'iil.Ma tisawwi al-fasaala di-!
Fakkir foogi,ana namchi ween be eebi da-?Wa fakkir fi nafsak,inta tabga misil matmuus fi Israa'iil.Hassa' da,nachhadak hajji le abuuna al-malik.Hu ma yaaba,yantiini leek.
Wa laakin Amnuun aba ma yasma' kalaamha.Hu gidir foogha wa ragad ma'aaha wa tallafha.
Wa ba'ad da,Amnuun gamma kirihha ziyaada min al-hubb al-awwal indah leeha.Wa gaal leeha-:-Yalla-!Gummi amchi.
Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Taridiinak leyi da,masiibe kabiire ziyaada min al-cheyy al-inta sawweetah. Laakin hu aba ma yasma' kalaamha.
Wa naada khaddaamah wa gaal leyah-:-Hi di,atrudha min hini wa agfil al-baab.
Wa khalaas,khaddaam Amnuun taradaaha wa gafal al-baab.Wa Taamaar laabse khalag khaali wa da lubaas hana banaat al-muluuk al-lissaa'hin ma chaafan raajil.
Wa charratat khalagha min al-hizin wa sabbat rumaad fi raasha wa khattat iideenha fi raasha wa maache wa tabki.
Wa akhuuha Abchaluum gaal leeha-:-Hal akhuuki Amnuun tallafki-?Hassa' da,ya akhti askuti,da akhuuki.Ma tifakkiri battaan fi l-cheyy da. Wa Taamaar ga'adat fi beet akhuuha Abchaluum misil mara baayre.
Wa wakit al-malik Dawuud simi' be l-cheyy al-kaan da,hu zi'il za'al chadiid.Wa laakin ma sawwa leyah cheyy achaan Amnuun da,hu wileedah al-bikir wa hu yiriidah ziyaada.
Wa kan le Abchaluum kamaan,ma gaa'id yihajji le Amnuun wa la be kheer wa la be charr.Hu kirihah achaan Amnuun tallaf akhtah Taamaar.
Wa ba'ad santeen,Abchaluum wa l-naas al-yagta'o suuf khanamah gaa'idiin fi hillit Ba'al Haasuur gariib le hillit Afraayim.Wa hu azam kulla akhwaanah awlaad al-malik.
Abchaluum ja bakaan abuuh wa gaal leyah-:-Ya l-malik,daahu al-naas al-yagta'o suuf al-khanam gaa'idiin bakaan ana abdak.Min fadlak,khalli al-malik wa kulla masaa'iilah yahdaro fi l-hafla.
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-La,ya wileedi,aniina ma namchu kullina achaan da yabga leek tagiil. Wa laakin Abchaluum asarah le abuuh yamchi.Wa abuuh aba ma yamchi wa baarakah.
Wa Abchaluum gaal-:-Kan ke da,min fadlak khalli akhuuyi Amnuun yamchi ma'aana. Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Maala tidoor hu yamchi ma'aak-?
Wa battaan hu asarah le abuuh.Wa khalaas,al-malik khalla Amnuun wa kulla awlaadah al-aakhariin macho ma'a Abchaluum.Wa khalaas,hu sawwa aazuuma kabiire misil aazuumit al-malik.
Wa Abchaluum antaah amur le khaddaamiinah wa gaal-:-Fakkuru adiil fi Amnuun.Wakit chiftuuh sikir wa ana gult leeku adurbuuh,gummu aktuluuh.Ma takhaafo achaan ana bas anteetku al-amur da.Chiddu heelku wa abgo fahaliin-!
Wa khalaas,al-khaddaamiin katalo Amnuun be amur min Abchaluum.Wa tawwaali,awlaad al-malik al-aakhariin gammo jaro,ayyi waahid rikib fi bakhalah wa arrad.
Wa wakit humman lissaa'hum fi l-derib bas,khabbarooh le Dawuud wa gaalo leyah-:-Abchaluum katal kulla awlaad al-malik-!Waahid minhum kula ma faddal.
Wa tawwaali,al-malik gamma charrat khalagah wa waga' fi l-turaab min al-hizin.Wa kulla masaa'iilah waagfiin jambah,khulgaanhum mucharratiin min al-hizin.
Wa Yunadaab wileed Chim'a akhu Dawuud chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:-Khalli siidi al-malik ma yifakkir kadar katalo kulla awlaadah.Amnuun wiheedah bas maat.Achaan Abchaluum chaal al-niiye di min al-yoom al-Amnuun tallaf akhtah Taamaar.
Wa hassa' da,khalli siidi al-malik ma yifakkir kadar kulla awlaadah maato.La,Amnuun wiheedah bas maat.
Wa Abchaluum kula arrad.Wa wakit al-haras hana gasir al-malik rafa' raasah,chaaf naas katiiriin jaayiin be waraayah ale l-hajar.
Wa Yunadaab gaal le l-malik-:-Dool awlaad al-malik bas jaayiin.Wa kulla l-cheyy da kaan misil ana abdak gultah leek.
Wa min Yunadaab kammal kalaamah ke bas,awlaad al-malik wassalo.Wa gammo yabku wa l-malik wa kulla masaa'iilah al-ma'aayah bako baki chadiid.
Wakit Abchaluum arrad,hu macha bakaan Talmaay wileed Amihuud malik hillit Gachuur.Wa fi kulla l-wakit da,Dawuud gaa'id fi hizin hana wileedah Amnuun.
Wa Abchaluum al-arrad wa macha hillit Gachuur da,ga'ad talaata sana hinaak.
Wa l-malik Dawuud khalla minnah mutaaradat Abchaluum achaan sabbarooh fi moot wileedah Amnuun.
Wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya irif kadar Dawuud galbah dawwar Abchaluum.
Wa gamma rassal fi hillit Takhuu'a le mara waahide al-indaha hikma.Wa wakit al-mara di jaat,hu gaal leeha-:-Min fadulki,sawwi nafiski haznaane wa albase khulgaan al-hizin wa ma tilmassahe.Abge misil mara al-haznaane min zamaan.
Wa amchi bakaan al-malik wa guuli leyah al-kalaam al-ana ni'ooriiki da. Wa Yuwaab gaal leeha al-kalaam al-waajib hi tuguulah.
Wa khalaas,al-mara al-min hillit Takhuu'a machat le l-malik Dawuud wa waga'at fi l-ard wa sajadat giddaamah wa gaalat-:-Ya l-malik,afza'ni-!
Wa l-malik gaal leeha-:-Maalki-? Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Leyi al-asaf,ana armala wa raajli mayyit.
Wa ana khaadmak indi awlaad itneen al-addaawaso fi l-kadaade wa naadum al-yihaajizhum kula ma fiih.Wa l-waahid katal al-aakhar.
Wa hassa' daahu kulla naas gabiilti gammo diddi wa gaalo leyi khalli nisallim leehum wileedi al-katal akhuuh wa humman yaktuluuh fi gaddah,hu al-ba'adeen yabga wariis.Wa be misil da,humman yidooru yiwadduru al-acham al-waahid al-indi wa ma yikhallu le raajli wa la wariis wa la usum fi l-ard.
Wa l-malik gaal leeha-:-Gabbili amchi beeti.Wa ana zaati nanti amur fi sababki.
Wa l-mara al-min hillit Takhuu'a gaalat leyah-:-Ya siidi al-malik,khalli al-khata da yaga' fi raasi wa fi raas ahali.Al-malik wa aayiltah yukuunu bariyiin.
Wa l-malik gaal leeha-:-Kan naadum yihajji foogki,jiibiih leyi ana.Wa battaan ma yisawwiih.
Wa l-mara gaalat battaan-:-Khalli al-malik yi'aahidni be usum Allah Ilaahah achaan siid al-taar ma yiziid al-damaar wa yaktul leyi wileedi. Wa l-malik gaal leeha-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy,suufaay waahide kula hana wileedki ma taga' fi l-ard.
Wa ba'ad da,al-mara gaalat leyah-:-Min iznak,ya siidi al-malik,khalli nuguul leek kilme waahide. Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Hajji.
Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Maala inta ma fakkart misil da fi cha'ab al-Rabb-?Wa be kalaamak al-inta kallamtah hassa',ya l-malik,inta bigiit khaati achaan inta ma gabbalt wileedak al-mu'arrid.
Aywa,yoom waahid kullina numuutu wa hayaatna tabga misil almi al-daffag fi l-turaab wa battaan ma yinchaal.Wa laakin al-Rabb ma yaktul al-mu'arrid.Da ma fikir al-Rabb kadar al-mu'arrid yagood ba'iid minnah.
Wa hassa',ana jiit hajjeet al-kalaam da leek inta siidi al-malik achaan al-naas khawwafooni.Wa ana khaadmak gult namchi nihajji leek inta al-malik wa akuun tisawwi al-cheyy al-ana khaadmak nuguulah leek.
Wa be da,inta tasma' kalaami wa tinajjiini ana khaadmak min iid al-naadum al-yidoor yiwaddirni ana wa wileedi min usut cha'ab al-Rabb al-misil warasatah.
Wa ana fakkart kadar kalaamak inta al-malik yisabbirni min al-muchkila di.Wa siidi al-malik,hu misil malak Allah al-yasma' al-zeen wa l-fasil.Khalli Allah Ilaahak yukuun ma'aak.
Wa l-malik gaal le l-mara-:-Nas'alki su'aal waahid wa ma tilabbidi leyi cheyy. Wa l-mara gaalat leyah-:-Kallim,ya siidi al-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal leeha-:-Hal kulla l-kalaam da ma jaayi min Yuwaab walla-? Wa l-mara gaalat-:-Nahlif be hayaatak inta,ya siidi al-malik.Ana ma nagdar nakdib leek,ya siidi al-malik.Be akiid,abdak Yuwaab bas kallafaani be l-kalaam da.
Wa abdak Yuwaab sawwa al-cheyy da achaan yibaddil al-haala di.Wa laakin siidi al-malik,hu hakiim misil malak Allah al-ya'arif kulla cheyy fi l-ard.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-malik gaal le Yuwaab-:-Khalaas al-kalaam kammal.Amchi gabbilah le Abchaluum hini.
Wa tawwaali,Yuwaab waga' fi l-ard wa sajad wa baarak al-malik wa gaal-:-Al-yoom ana abdak irift kadar inta siidi al-malik ridiit leyi achaan inta sawweet al-cheyy al-ana abdak gultah leek.
Wa Yuwaab gamma wa macha Gachuur gabbalah le Abchaluum fi Uruchaliim.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Khalli Abchaluum yamchi beetah ma yigaabilni. Wa khalaas,Abchaluum macha beetah wa ma gaabalah le l-malik.
Wa fi Israa'iil,ma fi naadum jamiil wa machkuur misil Abchaluum wa min rijileenah lahaddi raasah foog ma fi ayyi eeb.
Wa fi ayyi akhiir al-sana,yizayyin suuf raasah achaan tagiil leyah.Wa hu yawzin suuf raasah wa waznah yisaawi ziyaada min itneen kiilo hasab wazin al-muluuk.
Wa Abchaluum indah awlaad talaata wa bineeye waahide usumha Taamaar.Wa hi mara jamiile marra waahid.
Wa Abchaluum ga'ad santeen fi Uruchaliim wa laakin ma gaabal al-malik.
Wa yoom waahid,Abchaluum naadaah le Yuwaab achaan yirassilah bakaan al-malik wa laakin Yuwaab aba ma yaji leyah.Wa le taani marra battaan rassal le Yuwaab wa hu aba ma yaji.
Wa Abchaluum gaal le khaddaamiinah-:-Chiifu al-zere' hana gameh abyad al-jamb zer'i,da hana Yuwaab.Amchu tuchchuuh. Wa khalaas,khaddaamiin Abchaluum tachcho al-zere' da.
Wa tawwaali,Yuwaab gamma macha le Abchaluum fi beetah wa gaal leyah-:-Maala khaddaamiinak tachcho zer'i-?
Wa Abchaluum gaal le Yuwaab-:-Achaan ana rassalt leek taji leyi wa inta abeet.Ana dawwart nirassilak bakaan al-malik tuguul leyah-:--Maala ana jiit min Gachuur-?Akheer leyi nigabbil battaan hinaak.- Wa hassa',nidoor nigaabil al-malik.Wa kan ana khaati kamaan,khalli yaktulni.
Wa Yuwaab macha hajja le l-malik be l-kalaam da.Wa khalaas,al-malik naadaah le Abchaluum wa hu gamma macha wa waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaam al-malik.Wa l-malik habbaah.
Wa ba'ad kulla l-cheyy da,Abchaluum ligi araba hint harib wa kheel wa 50 rujaal al-maachiin giddaam arabatah.
Wa be fajur badri,Abchaluum yugumm wa yagiif fi khachum al-derib hana madkhal al-hille.Wa kulli wakit kan naadum indah muchkila wa jaayi bakaan al-malik achaan yisawwi leyah charii'a,Abchaluum yiwaggifah wa yuguul leyah-:-Inta min hille al-weeni-? Wa akuun al-naadum da yuguul-:-Ana abdak jaayi min gabiila waahide hana Bani Israa'iil.
Khalaas,Abchaluum yuguul leyah-:-Chiif-!Kalaamak adiil wa hagg.Wa laakin ma fi naadum mas'uul bakaan al-malik al-yasma' kalaamak.
Wa yuguul battaan-:-Kan awwal ana bigiit haakim fi l-balad di wa ayyi naadum yaji leyi be daliimtah aw muchkiltah,ana nisawwi leyah al-charii'a.
Wa kan naadum yigarrib leyah le yasjud giddaamah,Abchaluum yimidd iidah yakurbah wa yihibbah.
Wa hu yisawwi misil da le kulla Bani Israa'iil al-yaju bakaan al-malik le yisawwi leehum al-charii'a.Wa be misil da,hu yilimm kulla Bani Israa'iil waraayah be najaada.
Wa ba'ad arba'a sana,Abchaluum gaal le l-malik-:-Min fadlak,khalliini namchi hillit Hibruun le nihaggig al-nazir al-sawweetah le Allah.
Achaan wakit ana abdak saakin fi Gachuur fi balad Araam,sawweet nazir wa gult-:--Kan gabbalt be aafe fi Uruchaliim,na'abud Allah.-
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Amchi be l-salaama. Wa khalaas,Abchaluum gamma macha hillit Hibruun.
Wa wakit wassal hinaak,rassal naas be talbiid fi kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil wa gaal leehum-:-Wakit tasma'o hiss al-buug,guulu-:--Abchaluum bigi malik fi Hibruun.-
Wa 200 naas al-azamaahum Abchaluum macho ma'aayah min Uruchaliim.Wa humman macho ma'aayah wa laakin ma induhum khabbar be l-mu'aamara di.
Wa wakit Abchaluum gaa'id yigaddim al-dahiiye,rassal le Akhituufal al-Giiluuni mustachaar Dawuud al-saakin fi hillit Giilu.Wa l-mu'aamara gaa'ide tabga chadiide bilheen.Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yiziidu be ziyaada wara Abchaluum.
Wa naadum waahid ja khabbarah le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Bani Israa'iil lammo wara Abchaluum.
Khalaas,Dawuud gaal le kulla masaa'iilah al-ma'aayah fi Uruchaliim-:-Yalla ni'arrudu-!Kan ma ke da,ma nanjo min Abchaluum.Khalli namchu ajala gubbaal ma yalhagna wa yijiib foogna al-masiibe wa yaktul kulla naas al-hille be l-seef.
Wa masaa'iilah gaalo leyah-:-Ya siidna al-malik,kulla cheyy al-inta tikharrirah,aniina nisawwuuh.
Wa l-malik marag be rijileenah wa kulla aayiltah taaba'ooh.Wa laakin khalla waraayah achara sirriiyaat le yahfadan al-beet.
Wa wakit al-malik maarig,kulla l-cha'ab taaba'ooh wa humman wagafo fi aakhir beet hana l-hille.
Wa kulla naas Dawuud wa kulla l-Kiritiyiin wa l-Filtiyiin hurraas al-malik gammo yijarsusu giddaamah.Wa 600 naas al-taaba'o Dawuud min hillit Gaat,humman kula jarsaso.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Ittaay al-min hillit Gaat-:-Maala inta kula tamchi ma'aana-?Gabbil amchi agood ma'a l-malik Abchaluum achaan inta ajnabi wa laaji'.
Wa inta jiit hini ma tawwalt.Wa l-yoom,nichiilak wa niwaddiik ma'aayi fi bakaan al-ana zaati ma na'arfah da walla-?La-!Hassa' da,chiil akhwaanak wa gabbil fi l-hille fi kheer wa amaan Allah.
Wa laakin Ittaay radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy wa be hayaatak inta al-malik,fi ayyi bakaan al-siidi al-malik yamchi le yi'iich aw yumuut,ana abdak kula namchi.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Ittaay-:-Sameh-!Gaddim. Wa Ittaay gaddam ma'a naasah wa kulla aayilaathum.
Wa kulla naas al-balad gaa'idiin yabku chadiid wakit chaafo Dawuud wa naasah maachiin.Wa l-malik chagga waadi Khidruun ma'a kulla naasah wa chaalo al-derib al-maachi le l-sahara.
Wa macha ma'aahum Saduukh raajil al-diin wa ma'aayah kulla l-Laawiyiin al-chaayliin sanduug mu'aahadat al-Rabb.Wa humman khatto al-sanduug da tihit wa Abiyaatar raajil al-diin gaa'id jambah lahaddi kulla l-naas al-maargiin min al-hille kammalo.
Wa l-malik gaal le Saduukh raajil al-diin-:-Gabbil sanduug al-Rabb fi l-hille.Achaan kan Allah yarda beyi,yisawwi leyi al-kheer wa yigabbilni wa yichawwifni battaan sanduugah wa maskanah.
Wa laakin kan hu gaal ma yidoorni,khalaas khalli yisawwi foogi al-cheyy al-hu yidoorah.
Wa l-malik gaal battaan le Saduukh raajil al-diin-:-Hassa' da,inta chift al-haala.Gabbil amchi be l-salaama fi l-hille ma'a Akhimaa'as wileedak wa Yuunataan wileed Abiyaatar.Wa be da,iyaalku al-itneen yamchu ma'aaku.
Wa kan leyi ana,ni'akhkhir fi waadi al-Urdun lahaddi nalga khabar minku.
Wa khalaas,Saduukh wa Abiyaatar gabbalo sanduug al-Rabb fi Uruchaliim wa ga'ado hinaak.
Wa Dawuud gaa'id yatla' jabal al-Zaytuun be baki wa sadda raasah wa maachi bala na'aal.Wa kulla l-naas al-taali'iin ma'aayah,humman kula saddo ruuseehum wa gaa'idiin yabku.
Wa jo khabbaro Dawuud wa gaalo-:-Daahu Akhituufal kula min al-khaayniin al-ma'a Abchaluum. Khalaas Dawuud gaal-:-Ya Allah,khalli wasiiyat Akhituufal tabga ma naaf'e.
Wa wakit Dawuud wassal fi raas al-jabal fi bakaan ibaadat al-Rabb,Huuchaay al-min hillit Arki ja laagaah le Dawuud wa khalagah mucharrat min al-hizin wa indah turaab fi raasah.
Wa Dawuud gaal leyah-:-Inta ma tamchi ma'aayi achaan da tagiil leyi.
Wa laakin kan gabbalt al-hille,guul le Abchaluum-:--Ya l-malik,nidoor nabga khaddaamak.Awwal,ana khaddaam abuuk wa laakin hassa',nabga khaddaamak.- Wa be misil da,tafchul wasiiyat Akhituufal.
Wa hinaak talga musaa'ada min rujaal al-diin Saduukh wa Abiyaatar.Wa kulla cheyy al-tasma'ah min gasir al-malik,guulah le Saduukh wa Abiyaatar.
Wa iyaalhum Akhimaa'as wileed Saduukh wa Yuunataan wileed Abiyaatar,humman kula gaa'idiin ma'aahum.Wa be waasitathum humman,tikhabburuuni be kulla cheyy al-tasma'o.
Wa khalaas,Huuchaay rafiig Dawuud gabbal al-hille fi wakit al-Abchaluum daakhil Uruchaliim.
Wa wakit Dawuud gaa'id yanzil min raas al-jabal be khaadi,laaga Siiba khaddaam Mafiibuchat saayig hamiir itneen al-chadda fooghum 200 khubza wa 100 abbuud hana inab yaabis mu'abbak wa 100 abbuud hana tiin yaabis mu'abbak wa girbe hana khamar.
Wa l-malik gaal le Siiba-:-Hu da kulla,tisawwi beyah chunu-? Wa Siiba gaal-:-Al-hamiir le aayilat al-malik yarkabo fooghum wa l-khubza wa l-tiin le naasak yaakulu wa l-khamar kamaan yichajji' naasak al-ayyaaniin min ta'ab al-safar fi l-sahara.
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Ween wileed siidak-? Wa Siiba gaal leyah-:-Hu gaa'id fi Uruchaliim wa gaal-:--Al-yoom Bani Israa'iil yigabbulu leyi muluk abuuyi Chaawuul.-
Wa l-malik gaal le Siiba-:-Kan ke da,min hini le giddaam kulla l-maal hana Mafiibuchat da hanaak inta. Wa Siiba sajad giddaamah wa gaal-:-Ana abdak,ya siidi al-malik,kan inta ridiit leyi.
Wa wakit Dawuud garrab le hillit Bahuriim,raajil waahid marag leyah.Wa l-raajil da,hu min khachum beet Chaawuul wa usmah Chim'i wileed Giira.Wa hu marag min al-hille wa gaa'id yal'an foogah.
Wa be katarat al-cha'ab wa rujaalah al-fahaliin al-maachiin ma'aayah be zeene wa isra kula,Chim'i gaa'id yizarrig fi l-malik Dawuud wa masaa'iilah be hujaar.
Wa daahu kalaam Chim'i al-gaa'id yuguulah-:-Yalla amchi-!Yalla amchi-!Ya kattaal al-dimam al-ma naafi'-!
Allah gabbal leek fi raasak al-damm al-inta daffagtah min aayilat Chaawuul al-inta bigiit malik fi badalah.Hassa' Allah sallam al-muluk le wileedak Abchaluum wa di bas al-masiibe al-waajbe leek achaan inta kattaal al-dimam.
Wa Abichaay wileedha le Saruuya gaal le l-malik-:-Maala al-kalib al-mayyit da gaa'id yal'an siidi al-malik-?Khalliini namchi nagta' raasah-!
Wa laakin al-malik gaal-:-Chunu al-beeni ana wa intu,ya awlaad Saruuya-?Kan al-raajil da gaa'id yal'an,akuun Allah bas gaalah leyah-:--Amchi al'an Dawuud-!- Wa be da,yaatu yagdar yuguul leyah-:--Maala inta tuguul al-kalaam da-?-
Wa Dawuud gaal le Abichaay wa le kulla masaa'iilah-:-Chiifu wileedi,hu al-marag min sulbi.Hu kula yidoor yaktulni wa da maala yabga ajiib kan al-naadum min gabiilat Banyaamiin da gaa'id yal'an foogi-?Khalli yuguul al-la'ana di kan Allah bas amarah beeha.
Wa be da,akuun Allah yichiif ta'abi wa yisawwi leyi al-kheer fi badal al-la'ana al-hu gaa'id yuguulha foogi al-yoom.
Wa Dawuud wa rujaalah taab'iin fi deribhum wa maachiin wa Chim'i kula maachi jambuhum fi raas al-hajar yal'an wa yizarrig fi Dawuud wa yigawwim ajaaj kula.
Wa l-malik wa kulla l-cha'ab al-ma'aayah wassalo fi khachum bahar al-Urdun.Wa humman wassalo ayyaaniin wa ga'ado yinjammo fi l-bakaan da.
Wa Abchaluum wa kulla l-cha'ab wa askar Bani Israa'iil wassalo fi Uruchaliim.Wa Akhituufal mustachaar Dawuud,hu kula ma'aahum.
Wa wakit Huuchaay al-min hillit Arki rafiigah le Dawuud wassal bakaan Abchaluum,hu gaal-:-Yi'iich al-malik-!Yi'iich al-malik-!
Wa Abchaluum gaal le Huuchaay-:-Da bas al-amaan al-indak le rafiigak Dawuud walla-?Maala inta ma macheet ma'aayah-?
Wa Huuchaay gaal le Abchaluum-:-La-!Ana nabga ma'a l-naadum al-azalooh Allah wa kulla l-cha'ab wa kulla askar Bani Israa'iil.Hu da bas,ana nagood ma'aayah.
Wa fi cheyy taani,ana nakhdim le yaatu-?Ma leek inta wileedah walla-?Misil ana khadamt le abuuk,be misil da nakhdim leek inta kula.
Wa Abchaluum gaal le Akhituufal-:-Chaawuru ambeenaatku fi l-cheyy al-waajib nisawwuuh.
Wa Akhituufal gaal le Abchaluum-:-Amchi argud ma'a sirriiyaat abuuk al-khallaahin yahfadan al-beet.Wa be misil da,kulla Bani Israa'iil yasma'ooh wa inta tabga makruuh le abuuk.Wa l-naas al-ma'aak yalgo chajaa'a.
Wa khalaas,sawwo kheema fi raas gasir al-malik wa Abchaluum macha ragad ma'a sirriiyaat abuuh giddaam kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-wasaaya al-yantiihum Akhituufal induhum ahammiiye ziyaada misil kalaam jaayi min al-Rabb.Wa kan Dawuud walla Abchaluum kula,ma yagdaro yikhaalufu wasiiyat Akhituufal.
Wa ba'ad da,Akhituufal gaal le Abchaluum-:-Min fadlak,khalliini na'azil 12-000 raajil wa namchi wara Dawuud fi l-leele di bas.
Ana nikhaffilah wakit hu ayyaan wa ma indah gudra.Wa ana nibarjilah wa kulla l-cha'ab al-ma'aayah yi'arrudu.Wa khalaas,ana naktulah hu wiheedah.
Wa be misil da,nilimm kulla cha'abah leek misil awwal al-cha'ab lammo wara l-naadum al-inta gaa'id tifattichah.Wa be da,kulla l-cha'ab yukuunu fi l-salaama.
Wa Abchaluum wa kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil muwaafgiin fi l-kalaam da.
Wa Abchaluum gaal-:-Naaduuh le Huuchaay al-min hillit Arki achaan hu kula yantiina fikrah.
Wa Huuchaay ja le Abchaluum.Wa Abchaluum hajja leyah be l-kalaam al-Akhituufal gaalah leyah.Wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Hal nitabbugu kalaamah walla-?Kan la kamaan,antiina fikrak.
Wa Huuchaay gaal le Abchaluum-:-Fi l-marra di,wasiiyat Akhituufal ma adiile.
Wa Huuchaay gaal battaan-:-Inta ta'arif abuuk wa rujaalah,humman furraas wa khatiiriin misil mart al-duud al-waddarat iyaalha fi l-khala.Wa abuuk raajil muhaarib,ma yunuum ma'a l-cha'ab.
Wa akiid,hassa' hu gaa'id mullabbid fi karkuur aw bakaan aakhar.Wa kan al-harib bada wa katalo minnina,naas aakhariin yasma'ooh wa yuguulu-:--Al-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'a Abchaluum anhazamo.--
Wa be da,naadum fahal al-galbah misil galib al-duud kula yabga kaslaan.Achaan kulla Bani Israa'iil ya'arfu kadar abuuk faaris wa indah ma'aayah rujaal fahaliin.
Wa di hi wasiiyti ana.Limm kulla Bani Israa'iil ma'aak min Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati.Wa humman yilimmu katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar.Wa be da,inta zaatak tamchi ma'aahum fi l-harib.
Wa aniina nalhagooh le Dawuud fi ayyi bakaan al-hu mullabbid foogah.Wa nanzulu foogah misil al-matar al-yanzil fi l-ard.Wa be da,naadum waahid kula minhum ma yifaddil wa la hu wa la rujaalah al-ma'aayah.
Wa kan hu arrad wa dakhal fi hille waahide,kulla Bani Israa'iil yichiilu hubaal yarbutu daraadirha wa yukurruuha wa yarmuuha fi l-waadi lahaddi ma yifaddil minha cheyy.
Wa khalaas,Abchaluum wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gaalo-:-Wasiiyat Huuchaay al-min hillit Arki akheer min wasiiyat Akhituufal. Wa be da,Allah fachchal al-wasiiye al-adiile hint Akhituufal achaan Allah yidoor yinazzil masiibe fi raas Abchaluum.
Wa khalaas,Huuchaay macha le Saduukh wa Abiyaatar rujaal al-diin wa gaal leehum-:-Akhituufal anta wasiiye le Abchaluum wa le chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil.Wa ana kula anteet wasiiyti misil di misil di.
Wa hassa' da,rassulu ajala le Dawuud khabburuuh wa guulu leyah khalli ma yargud fi waadi al-Urdun.Waajib yagta' al-bahar achaan ma yaktuluuh,hu wa kulla naasah al-ma'aayah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Akhimaa'as wa Yuunataan ga'ado fi hillit Een Ruugil.Wa waajib khaddaama waahide tamchi tikhabbirhum wa humman kamaan yamchu yikallumuuh le Dawuud achaan humman ma yagdaro yadkhulu fi Uruchaliim le yichiifuuhum.
Wa laakin sabi waahid chaafaahum wa macha khabbar Abchaluum.Wa Akhimaa'as wa Yuunataan macho ajala ajala wa wassalo bakaan raajil waahid fi hillit Bahuriim.Wa fi l-hooch da,fiyah biir wa humman dakhalo allabbado foogha.
Wa sitt al-beet chaalat birich wa saddat khachum al-biir wa sabbat foog al-birich da khalla achaan ma yichiifu cheyy.
Wa khaddaamiin Abchaluum macho bakaan al-mara di wa sa'alooha wa gaalo-:-Ween Akhimaa'as wa Yuunataan-? Wa l-mara gaalat leehum-:-Humman gata'o al-rijil. Wa khalaas,khaddaamiin Abchaluum fattachoohum ke wa ma ligoohum.Wa ba'ad da,gabbalo fi Uruchaliim.
Wa ba'ad humman faato,Akhimaa'as wa Yuunataan marago min al-biir wa macho khabbarooh le Dawuud be wasiiyat Akhituufal.Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Ajala agta'o al-bahar.
Wa tawwaali,Dawuud wa kulla l-naas al-ma'aayah gammo wa gata'o bahar al-Urdun.Wa be fajur badri,kulluhum gata'o al-bahar wa naadum waahid kula minhum ma faddal.
Wa wakit Akhituufal irif kadar Abchaluum ma tabbag wasiiytah,gamma chadda humaarah wa gabbal hillitah wa macha beetah.Wa wassa aayiltah wa chanag nafsah wa maat.Wa dafanooh fi khabur abuuh.
Wa Dawuud wassal hillit Mahanaayim wakit Abchaluum gaa'id yagta' bahar al-Urdun ma'a kulla askar Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Abchaluum khatta Amaasa khaayid al-deech fi badal Yuwaab.Wa Amaasa da,abuuh Yatar al-min Bani Israa'iil wa ammah Abigaayil bineeyit Nahaach akhutha le Saruuya amm Yuwaab.
Wa Abchaluum wa askar Bani Israa'iil khatto mu'askarhum fi balad Gil'aad.
Wa wakit Dawuud wassal Mahanaayim,laagooh Chuubi wileed Nahaach al-min madiinat Rabba aasimat balad Bani Ammuun wa Makiir wileed Amiyiil al-min hillit Luudabaar wa Barzillaay al-min hillit Rugliim fi turaab Gil'aad.
Wa l-naas dool jaabo le Dawuud wa naasah furaach wa mawaa'iin wa buraam hana tiine wa akil misil gameh ahmar wa gameh abyad wa dagiig wa fariiki wa lubya wa adas
wa asal wa zibde hana khanam wa jibna min laban al-bagar.Wa humman jaabo kulla l-achya dool le Dawuud achaan al-naas al-ma'aayah yaakulu.Wa gaalo-:-Al-naas dool yukuunu maytiin min al-aya wa l-juu' wa l-atach hana l-sahara.
Wa Dawuud hasab askarah al-ma'aayah wa khatta leehum khuyyaad fi aalaaf wa khuyyaad fi miyaat.
Wa Dawuud anta amur le l-askar yamchu.Wa l-tilit min al-askar da,hu kallaf beyah Yuwaab wa l-tilit kallaf beyah Abichaay wileed Saruuya al-hu akhu Yuwaab wa l-tilit kallaf beyah Ittaay al-min hillit Gaat.Wa l-malik gaal le askarah-:-Ana zaati namchi ma'aaku.
Wa laakin askarah gaalo leyah-:-La-!Ya siidna al-malik,inta ma tamchi ma'aana.Achaan kan aniina arradna kula,naadum yaj'alna ma fiih wa kan nussina maat kula,ma yijiibu khabarna.Wa inta wiheedak muhimm min 10-000 minnina wa da akheer leena kan tagood fi l-madiina wa tijiib leena minha al-faza'.
Wa l-malik gaal leehum-:-Ana nisawwi al-cheyy al-tidooruuh.-Wa khalaas,al-malik wagaf fi khachum baab al-hille wakit kulla askarah maargiin be miyaat wa aalaaf.
