Wa hu amar Yuwaab wa Abichaay wa Ittaay wa gaal leehum-:-Assahhalo ma'a l-sabi Abchaluum fi chaan reedti leyah. Wa kulla askarah sim'o be l-amur al-malik antaah le l-khuyyaad fi sabab Abchaluum.
Wa khalaas,askar Dawuud marago fi l-kadaade le yihaarubu Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-harib bada fi l-khaaba hana balad Afraayim.
Wa askar Bani Israa'iil anhazamo giddaam naas Dawuud.Wa fi l-yoom da,al-haziime bigat kabiire wa maato foogha 20-000 raajil.
Wa l-harib alwassa' fi kulla l-balad.Wa fi l-yoom da,al-naas al-katalathum al-khaaba katiiriin ziyaada min al-naas al-katalaahum al-harib.
Wa Abchaluum be khafla anlaga wijih be wijih ma'a naas Dawuud.Wa hu raakib fi bakhal wa l-bakhal da dakhal tihit firi' hana chadarat balluut.Wa raas Abchaluum dakhal fi mafaarig al-firi' wa hu ga'ad mu'allag ambeen al-sama wa l-ard wa l-bakhal faat khallaah.
Wa askari waahid chaafah wa macha khabbarah le Yuwaab wa gaal-:-Daahu ana chift Abchaluum mu'allag fi firi' hana chadara.
Wa Yuwaab gaal le l-raajil al-jaab leyah al-khabar-:-Sahiih ke,inta chiftah walla-?Wa maala ma darabtah wa kataltah fi bakaanah da-?Kan awwal inta kataltah,ana nantiik 10 hajar fudda wa hizaam.
Wa l-raajil gaal le Yuwaab-:-Kan inta tantiini 1-000 hajar fudda kula,ana ma narfa' iidi wa nadurbah le wileed al-malik.Achaan aniina kullina simi'na be amur al-malik al-antaah leek inta wa Abichaay wa Ittaay wa gaal-:--Fakkuru fi l-sabi Abchaluum.--
Wa kan ana sawweet nafsi misil ma simi't kalaamah wa gammeet kataltah kula,al-malik ya'arif kulla cheyy wa yi'aakhibni wa inta zaatak ma tahmiini.
Wa Yuwaab gaal-:-Ana ma ni'akhkhir wakti ma'aak.-Wa khalaas,Yuwaab chaal talaata kookaab wa khazzaahum fi galib Abchaluum wakit hu lissaa' hayy wa mu'allag fi l-chadara.
Wa ba'ad da,achara subyaan al-chaayliin silaahah le Yuwaab jo hawwagooh wa tammamooh.
Wa khalaas,Yuwaab darab al-buug wa askarah wagafo min mutaaradat Bani Israa'iil achaan hu waggafaahum.
Wa chaalo janaazit Abchaluum wa zagalooha fi nugra fi l-khaaba wa radamo foogah hujaar.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil arrado wa ayyi waahid gabbal beetah.
Wa fi hayaatah,Abchaluum khazza hajar al-yizzakkaro beyah fi waadi al-Malik wa gaal-:-Ana ma indi wileed al-yichiil usmi. Wa samma al-hajar da be usmah.Wa lahaddi l-yoom,binaaduuh hajar Abchaluum.
Wa Akhimaa'as wileed Saduukh gaal-:-Min fadlak,khalliini najri nikhabbir al-malik be l-khabar al-halu da achaan Allah najjaah min iid udwaanah.
Wa Yuwaab gaal leyah-:-La-!Al-yoom inta ma tiwaddi khabar halu,tiwaddiih yoom aakhar.Wa l-khabar hana l-yoom da,khabar cheen achaan wileed al-malik maat.
Wa Yuwaab rassal waahid Habachi min khaddaamiinah wa gaal leyah-:-Amchi khabbir al-malik be l-cheyy al-chiftah. Wa khalaas,al-Habachi sajad giddaam Yuwaab wa gamma macha be jari.
Wa battaan Akhimaa'as wileed Saduukh gaal le Yuwaab-:-Kan chunu yukuun leyi kula,khalliini namchi wara l-Habachi da. Wa Yuwaab gaal leyah-:-Maala inta kula tamchi,ya wileedi-?Achaan da ma al-khabar al-inta talga foogah faayde.
Wa Akhimaa'as gaal-:-Kan chunu yukuun leyi kula,namchi. Wa Yuwaab gaal leyah-:-Amchi.-Wa khalaas,Akhimaa'as jara be l-derib al-saahil wa sabagah le l-Habachi.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Dawuud gaa'id ambeenaat al-biibaan al-itneen hana l-hille.Wa l-haras kamaan gaa'id fi bakaan waahid be foog le l-baab wa da bakaan al-yagood foogah al-haras.Wa l-haras chaaf raajil jaari jaayi wiheedah.
Wa l-haras naada le yikhabbir al-malik.Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Kan hu jaayi wiheedah da,yiwassif kadar yijiib khabar halu. Wa l-raajil gaa'id yigarrib leehum.
Wa l-haras chaaf naadum aakhar jaari jaayi wiheedah wa naada haaris al-biibaan wa gaal-:-Daahu naadum aakhar jaari jaayi wiheedah. Wa l-malik gaal-:-Hu da kula jaayib khabar halu.
Wa l-haras gaal battaan-:-Ana irift al-raajil al-awwal da min jariih wa hu Akhimaa'as wileed Saduukh. Wa l-malik gaal-:-Hu da raajil hana kheer jaayi yijiib khabar halu bilheen.
Wa wakit Akhimaa'as wassal bakaan al-malik,hu gaal-:-Al-salaam aleek-! Wa waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaam al-malik wa gaal-:-Ya siidi al-malik,nibaarik Allah Ilaahak al-sallam leek al-naas al-atmarrado diddak.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Wa kikkeef haalit al-sabi Abchaluum-? Wa Akhimaa'as gaal le l-malik-:-Ana chift al-naas barjalo be ziyaada wakit Yuwaab rassal ana abdak.Wa laakin ana ma na'arfah chunu kaan.
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Kiss wa agood hini. Wa Akhimaa'as kassa wa ga'ad yarja.
Wa khalaas,al-Habachi ja wa gaal le l-malik-:-Ana jibt le siidi al-malik khabar halu,al-yoom Allah sallamaak min iid udwaanak al-gammo diddak.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Wa kikkeef haalit al-sabi Abchaluum-? Wa l-Habachi gaal-:-Ya siidi al-malik,kulla udwaanak wa kulla l-naas al-gammo diddak le yisawwu leek al-fasaala,khalli yabgo misil al-sabi da.
Wa khalaas,al-malik barjal wa tala' fi l-gasir al-gaa'id fi khachum baab al-hille wa dakhal fi khurfa wa gamma yabki.Wa yuruukh wa yuguul-:-Ya wileedi Abchaluum-!Haay wileedi-!Ya wileedi Abchaluum,maala ana ma mutt fi badalak-!Haay wileedi Abchaluum,ya wileedi-!
Wa macho kallamooh le Yuwaab wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu al-malik gaa'id yabki wa yunuuh le Abchaluum.
Wa l-nasur hana l-yoom da albaddal be hizin le kulla l-askar achaan fi l-yoom da,sim'o kadar al-malik haznaan be sabab moot wileedah.
Wa fi l-yoom da min al-khajla,al-askar dakhalo fi l-madiina be sirr misil al-deech al-anhazam fi l-harib.
Wa l-malik sadda wijhah wa gaa'id yabki be tuul hissah wa yuguul-:-Haay wileedi Abchaluum-!Abchaluum,ya wileedi-!Ya wileedi-!
Wa khalaas,Yuwaab ja le l-malik fi l-khurfa wa gaal leyah-:-Al-yoom inta dasseet kulla naasak fi l-eeb.Wa humman bas al-yoom najjo hayaatak inta wa awlaadak wa banaatak wa hayaat awiinak wa sirriiyaatak.
Inta tihibb al-yakrahook wa takrah al-yihibbuuk-!Wa l-yoom wassaftina kadar wa la khaayid wa la khaddaam ma yisaawu cheyy giddaamak.Wa ana irift kadar al-yoom kan Abchaluum gaa'id hayy wa aniina dool kullina mutna kula,inta halu leek.
Wa hassa' da,gumm amchi raggid galib naasak.Achaan kan ma macheet,ana nahlif leek be Allah kadar le fajur da,naadum waahid kula ma yifaddil ma'aak.Wa di tabga akbar masiibe min kulla l-masaayib al-waga'o foogak min inta sabi lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa khalaas,al-malik gamma macha ga'ad fi khachum baab al-hille wa ooroohum le l-askar wa gaalo leehum-:-Daahu al-malik macha ga'ad fi khachum baab al-hille. Wa kulla l-askar jo giddaam al-malik.Wa askar Abchaluum kamaan arrado wa ayyi waahid gabbal beetah.
Wa kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yinaakhuchu wa yuguulu-:-Al-malik najjaana min iid udwaanna wa min iid al-Filistiyiin wa hassa' arrad min al-balad le yanja min Abchaluum.
Wa Abchaluum al-masahnaah wa darrajnaah malik maat fi l-duwaas.Wa hassa',gaa'idiin narjo chunu le nigabbulu al-malik Dawuud-?
Wa kulla l-kalaam al-hajjooh Bani Israa'iil wassalooh le l-malik Dawuud.Wa khalaas,al-malik rassal le Saduukh wa Abiyaatar rujaal al-diin wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu hajju le kubaaraat Bani Yahuuza wa guulu leehum-:--Maala tabgo aakhir naas al-yigabbulu al-malik fi beetah-?
Intu akhwaani min dammi wa lahami.Wa maala tabgo aakhir naas al-yigabbulu al-malik fi beetah-?--
Wa guulu le Amaasa-:--Inta ma min dammi wa lahami walla-?Khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid kan ana ma darrajtak khaayid deechi fi badal Yuwaab.-
Wa be kalaamah da,Dawuud radda guluub Bani Yahuuza.Wa misil raajil waahid,humman rassalo gaalo le l-malik-:-Gabbil inta wa kulla naasak.
Wa l-malik gabbal lahaddi bahar al-Urdun wa kulla Bani Yahuuza macho laagooh le l-malik fi hillit Gilgaal achaan yigattu'uuh al-bahar.
Wa Chim'i wileed Giira al-min gabiilat Banyaamiin wa min hillit Bahuriim,hu macha ajala ma'a naas Bani Yahuuza le yilaagu al-malik Dawuud.
Wa macho ma'a Chim'i 1-000 raajil min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa Siiba khaddaam aayilat Chaawuul,hu kula macha ma'aahum wa ma'aayah awlaadah al-khamistaachar wa khaddaamiinah al-ichriin.Wa humman assa'jalo wa lihgo bahar al-Urdun gubbaal al-malik.
Wa humman gata'o al-bahar le yigattu'u al-malik wa aayiltah wa le yisawwu kulla cheyy al-hu yidoorah.Wa wakit al-malik gata' al-bahar,Chim'i wileed Giira waga' giddaamah
wa gaal-:-Ma ti'aakhibni be khataayi wa la tifakkir fi l-khata al-ana abdak sawweetah wakit inta maarig min Uruchaliim.Wa ya siidi al-malik,ma takrub leyi fi galbak.
Achaan ana abdak a'taraft be zanbi wa l-yoom,ana bas awwal naadum min kulla gabaayil al-munchaakh jiit le nigaabil siidi al-malik.
Wa Abichaay wileedha le Saruuya chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:-Hal da sabab al-yikhalli Chim'i ma yaktuluuh walla-?Achaan hu la'an al-raajil al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik-!
Wa laakin Dawuud gaal-:-Chunu al-beeni ana wa intu,ya awlaad Saruuya-?Maala al-yoom gammeetu diddi misil adu-?Hal al-yoom,da yoom al-yaktulu foogah naadum fi balad Israa'iil walla-?Hal ana ma na'arif kadar al-yoom,ana bas malik fi balad Israa'iil walla-?
Wa l-malik halaf le Chim'i wa gaal-:-Inta ma tumuut-!
Wa Mafiibuchat wileed wileedah le Chaawuul,hu kula macha yigaabil al-malik.Wa hu ma khassal rijileenah wa la khulgaanah wa la addal dignah min yoom al-malik marag lahaddi yoom gabbal be l-salaama fi Uruchaliim.
Wa wakit Mafiibuchat wassal bakaan al-malik,al-malik gaal leyah-:-Ya Mafiibuchat,maalak ma macheet ma'aayi-?
Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya siidi al-malik,khaddaami khaanni.Ana abdak a'raj wa be da,gult nichidd humaari wa namchi ma'a l-malik.
Wa khaddaami kadab foogi ana abdak giddaamak inta siidi al-malik.Wa siidi al-malik,hu misil malak Allah wa be da,sawwi kulla cheyy al-tidoorah.
Achaan aayilat abuuyi ma tisaawi cheyy fi giddaamak inta siidi al-malik,illa l-moot.Wa be da kula,inta khibiltini ana abdak ma'a l-naas al-yaakulu fi beetak.Wa ana ma indi ayyi cheyy al-natulbah battaan min al-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Maala nihajju battaan fi l-kalaam da-?Ana kharrart,inta wa Siiba tigassumu ziraa'at Chaawuul.
Wa Mafiibuchat gaal le l-malik-:-Khalli yichiilah kulla ke,al-muhimm leyi da siidi al-malik ja beetah be l-salaama.
Wa Barzillaay al-min balad Gil'aad,hu kula ja min Rugliim gata' ma'a l-malik bahar al-Urdun.Wa ba'ad da,macha le yisallim al-malik gubbaal ma yufuut.
Wa Barzillaay chaayib marra waahid,umrah 80 sana.Wa wakit al-malik gaa'id fi Mahanaayim,hu bas wagaf ma'aayah wa rayyasah achaan hu khani marra waahid.
Wa l-malik gaal le Barzillaay-:-Ta'aal ma'aayi fi Uruchaliim wa ana nirayyisak.
Wa Barzillaay gaal le l-malik-:-Ma faddal leyi min umri cheyy achaan namchi nagood ma'aak fi Uruchaliim.
Hassa' indi 80 sana.Hal nagdar nafsul been al-fasil wa l-zeen walla-?Wa hal ana abdak nagdar nafsul ta'am al-akil wa l-charaab walla-?Wa nagdar battaan nasma' hiss al-hakkaamaat wa l-dawaka walla-?Wa maala battaan siidi al-malik yilkallaf beyi ana abdah-?
Wa ana abdak macheet ma'aak chiyya lahaddi gata'na bahar al-Urdun bas.Wa maala al-malik yidoor yantiini mukaafa misil di-?
Min fadlak,ya l-malik,khalliini nigabbil hilliti wa numuut jamb khabur abuuyi wa ammi.Wa laakin daahu abdak Kimhaam wileedi.Khalli hu yamchi ma'aak inta siidi al-malik wa sawwi leyah kulla cheyy al-tidoorah.
Wa khalaas,al-malik gaal-:-Tamaam,Kimhaam yamchi ma'aayi wa nisawwi leyah kulla cheyy al-inta tidoorah.Wa kulla cheyy al-tatulbah minni,ana nisawwi leek.
Al-malik Dawuud gata' al-bahar gubbaal kulla l-cha'ab.Wa ba'ad da,hu habbaah wa baarakah le Barzillaay wa Barzillaay gabbal beetah.
Wa l-malik taaba' derbah ale hillit Gilgaal wa Kimhaam kula macha ma'aayah.Wa kulla cha'ab Bani Yahuuza wa nuss cha'ab Bani Israa'iil chaalo al-malik wa gatta'o bahar al-Urdun.
Wa laakin wakit garrabo le l-malik,kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil gaalo leyah-:-Maala akhwaanna Bani Yahuuza chaalook wa gatta'ook al-bahar inta wa aayiltak wa kulla naasak al-ma'aak-?
Wa rujaal Bani Yahuuza raddo le rujaal Bani Israa'iil wa gaalo leehum-:-Sahiih aniina ahal al-malik wa maalku zi'iltu-?Hal al-malik gaa'id yikallifna walla-?Wa hal aniina chilna miiri le nufuusna walla-?
Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil gaalo le Bani Yahuuza-:-Wa laakin aniina indina hagg fi l-muluk achara marra ziyaada minku wa foog Dawuud kula.Wa maala tahguruuna,ma aniina bas al-awwalaaniyiin talabna gabbiliin al-malik walla-? Wa laakin rujaal Bani Yahuuza hajjo kalaam murr ziyaada min kalaam rujaal Bani Israa'iil.
Wa hinaak fi Gilgaal,fiyah raajil waahid ma naafi' usmah Chaba' wileed Bikri min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa hu darab al-buug wa gaal-:-Chunu al-yilimmina ma'a zurriiyit Dawuud-?Aniina ma indina warasa ma'a iyaal Yassa.Yalla,ya Bani Israa'iil,khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah-!
Wa khalaas,kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil tarrafo min Dawuud wa taaba'o Chaba' wileed Bikri.Wa laakin rujaal Bani Yahuuza anrabato fi malikhum wa macho ma'aayah min al-Urdun lahaddi Uruchaliim.
Wa wakit Dawuud wassal beetah fi Uruchaliim,chaal sirriiyaatah al-achara al-khallaahin yahfadan al-beet wa gamma habasaahin.Wa antaahin kilfithin wa laakin ma garrabaahin.Wa hinna ga'adan mahbuusaat tuul muddit hayaathin lahaddi l-moot.Wa hinna aachan misil awiin al-raajilhin mayyit.
Wa l-malik gaal le Amaasa-:-Fi talaata yoom da,limm leyi kulla rujaal Bani Yahuuza.Wa inta kula ta'aal ma'aahum.
Wa khalaas,Amaasa macha yilimm rujaal Bani Yahuuza wa laakin hu fawwat al-wakit al-haddadah leyah al-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal le Abichaay-:-Chaba' wileed Bikri da yisawwi leena cheyy fasil ziyaada min al-sawwaah Abchaluum.Hassa' da,chiil askari hanaayi ana siidak wa amchi waraayah gubbaal ma yalhag al-mudun al-gawiyiin wa yanja minnina.
Wa ma'a Abichaay macho askar Yuwaab wa l-Kiritiyiin wa l-Filtiyiin hurraas al-malik wa kulla l-rujaal al-fahaliin.Wa humman marago min Uruchaliim wa macho wara Chaba' wileed Bikri.
Wa wakit wassalo jamb al-hajar al-kabiir al-fi hillit Gib'uun,Amaasa laagaahum.Wa Yuwaab laabis khulgaanah hana l-askar wa raabit seefah be beetah fi sulbah.Wa wakit maachi,al-seef waga'.
Wa Yuwaab gaal le Amaasa-:-Keef haalak,ya akhuuyi-? Wa be iidah al-zeene,karabah le Amaasa min dignah le yihibbah.
Wa Amaasa ma fakkar fi l-seef al-fi iid Yuwaab al-isra.Wa khalaas,Yuwaab ta'anah le Amaasa fi batnah wa daffag musraanah wa tawwaali,hu maat fi l-bakaan da wa battaan Yuwaab ma tanna leyah kula.Wa Yuwaab wa akhuuh Abichaay faato wara Chaba' wileed Bikri.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,sabi askari waahid hana Yuwaab waagif jamb janaazit Amaasa wa yuguul-:-Al-naas al-ma'a Yuwaab wa Dawuud,khalli yitaabu'u Yuwaab.
Wa Amaasa waagi' fi lubb dammah fi ust al-derib.Wa l-sabi karra janaazit Amaasa wa tarrafha fi zere' wa khattaaha be khalag achaan hu chaaf kadar kulla l-naas al-wassalo jambah yagiifu.
Wa ba'ad tarraf al-janaaza min al-derib,kulla l-naas taaba'o Yuwaab wa macho wara Chaba' wileed Bikri.
Wa Chaba' wa naasah al-fahaliin chaggo ard kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil wa wajjaho ale hillit Abil Beet Ma'aaka.Wa kulla naas lammo wa macho ma'aayah.
Wa Yuwaab wa naasah macho hillit Abil Beet Ma'aaka wa hawwago al-hille be radmiiye lahaddi gismit al-durdur wa haasarooha.Wa kulla l-naas al-macho ma'a Yuwaab gammo yankutu ga'ar al-durdur achaan yarmuuh.
Wa min al-hille,mara waahide al-indaha hikma sarakhat wa gaalat-:-Asma'o-!Asma'o-!Min fadulku,guulu le Yuwaab yigarrib leyi nidoor nihajji leyah.
Wa hu garrab leeha.Wa l-mara sa'alatah wa gaalat-:-Inta Yuwaab walla-? Wa hu gaal-:-Aywa,da ana. Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Asma' kalaam khaadmak. Wa hu gaal-:-Nasma'.
Wa l-mara gaalat-:-Zamaan fi aaditna,yuguulu-:--Chaawuru naas hillit Abil Beet Ma'aaka.- Wa be da khalaas,al-kalaam yikammil.
Wa ana min al-naas al-haadiyiin wa amiiniin fi balad Israa'iil.Wa inta gaa'id tifattich derib al-tahlik hillitna al-muhimme fi Israa'iil.Maala tidoor tidammir al-warasa al-antaaha leena Allah-?
Wa Yuwaab gaal-:-Haraam,haraam leyi nahlik wa nidammir-!
Al-kalaam da ma ke.Laakin fiyah naadum waahid min jibaal Afraayim usmah Chaba' wileed Bikri wa hu atmarrad didd al-malik Dawuud.Hassa' da,sallumuuh leyi hu wiheedah bas wa ana niba''id min al-hille. Wa l-mara gaalat le Yuwaab-:-Khalaas,nazgulu leek raasah min al-durdur.
Wa l-mara machat khabbarat kulla naas al-hille be fikirha al-hakiim da.Wa khalaas,humman gata'o raas Chaba' wileed Bikri wa zagalooh le Yuwaab.Wa Yuwaab darab al-buug wa askarah tarrafo min al-hille wa ayyi waahid gabbal beetah.Wa Yuwaab kula macha bakaan al-malik fi Uruchaliim.
Wa Yuwaab,hu khaayid deech Bani Israa'iil wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada',hu mas'uul fi l-Kiritiyiin wa fi l-Filtiyiin hurraas al-malik.
Wa Aduraam,hu mas'uul fi l-khidme al-ijbaariiye wa Yahuuchafat wileed Akhiluud,hu kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik.
Wa Cheewa,hu al-kaatib wa Saduukh wa Abiyaatar,humman rujaal diin.
Wa Iira al-min hillit Yayiiri,hu kula raajil diin yakhdim le Dawuud.
Wa fi wakit hukum Dawuud,bigi juu' wa l-juu' da ga'ad talaata sana mutataabi'iin.Wa Dawuud sa'al Allah wa Allah radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-juu' da ja be sabab al-dimam al-Chaawuul wa aayiltah kataloohum.Humman katalo min sukkaan Gib'uun.
Wa l-malik naadaahum le sukkaan Gib'uun wa hajja leehum.Wa l-Gib'uuniyiin,humman ma min Bani Israa'iil laakin min al-Amuuriyiin al-faddalo fi l-balad.Wa zamaan,Bani Israa'iil halafo le l-Gib'uuniyiin wa gaalo ma yaktuluuhum.Wa laakin min chiddit hamiistah le Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza,Chaawuul dawwar yidammirhum.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l-Gib'uuniyiin-:-Nisawwi leeku chunu-?Wa be chunu niraddiiku min al-fasaala al-sawwooha leeku achaan tibaaruku cha'ab Allah al-misil warasatah-?
Wa l-Gib'uuniyiin gaalo le l-malik-:-Muchkilitna ma'a Chaawuul wa aayiltah ma tinhalla wa la be gurus wa la be dahab wa la be katil naadum fi Bani Israa'iil. Wa l-malik gaal leehum-:-Ayyi cheyy al-tidooruuh,ana nisawwi leeku.
Wa humman gaalo le l-malik-:-Chaawuul dawwar yidammirna wa yiwaddirna marra waahid min balad Israa'iil.
Wa be da,khalli yisallumu leena sab'a rujaal min iyaalah wa aniina nachunguuhum giddaam Allah fi Gibee'a hillit Chaawuul hu al-Allah azalah. Wa l-malik gaal leehum-:-Nisallimhum leeku.
Wa laakin al-malik hanna fi Mafiibuchat wileed Yuunataan wileed Chaawuul achaan al-haliife al-sawwaaha Dawuud wa Yuunataangiddaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,al-malik chaal Armuuni wa Mafiibuchat iyaal Risfa al-wildathum le Chaawuul.Wa Risfa di hi bineeyit Ayya.Wa chaal battaan al-iyaal al-khamsa hana Miirabbineeyit Chaawuul al-wildathum le Adriyiil wileed Barzillaay al-min hillit Mahuula.
Wa l-malik sallamaahum le l-Gib'uuniyiin.Wa khalaas,al-Gib'uuniyiin chanagoohum fi raas al-hajar giddaam Allah.Wa humman al-sab'a dool,kulluhum maato sawa.Wa moothum da bigi fi bidaayit al-gati' hana l-gameh al-abyad.
Wa Risfa bineeyit Ayya chaalat chuwaal wa farachatah fi raas al-hajar wa ga'adat hinaak min bidaayit gati' al-gameh al-abyad lahaddi almi al-khariif sabba fi l-janaazaat dool.Wa be nahaar,hi tadhar al-suguura ma yanzulu fooghum wa be leel,tadhar minhum haywaanaat al-kadaade.
Wa khabbarooh le Dawuud be l-cheyy al-sawwatah Risfa bineeyit Ayya sirriiyit Chaawuul.
Wa Dawuud gamma macha chaal udaam Chaawuul wa Yuunataan wileedah min sukkaan hillit Yaabiich fi turaab Gil'aad.Achaan wakit al-Filistiyiin hajamo Chaawuul wa askarah fi jabal Gilbuu'a,humman kataloohum wa allago janaazaathum fi naga'at hillit Beet Chaan.Wa sukkaan Yaabiich chaaloohum.
Wa Dawuud wadda ma'aayah udaam Chaawuul wa Yuunataan.Wa naasah kula khammo udaam al-rujaal al-sab'a al-chanagoohum.
Wa dafano udaam Chaawuul wa Yuunataan wa l-rujaal al-sab'a dool fi balad Banyaamiin fi hillit Siila' fi khabur Khiich abu Chaawuul.Wa l-naas sawwo kulla cheyy al-malik amaraahum beyah.Wa ba'ad da,al-Rabb raham al-balad di.
Wa kaan harib ambeen al-Filistiyiin wa Bani Israa'iil.Wa Dawuud wa naasah macho haaraboohum le l-Filistiyiin wa Dawuud bigi ayyaan.
Wa Yichbi Binuub waahid min zurriiyit Raafa chaal niiye achaan yaktul al-malik Dawuud.Wa haribtah hint nahaas tawzin talaata kiilo wa raabit fi sulbah seef jadiid.
Wa laakin Abichaay wileedha le Saruuya ja faza' le Dawuud wa darab al-Filisti wa katalah.Wa fi l-bakaan da,askar Dawuud halafo wa gaalo leyah-:-Battaan inta ma tamrug ma'aana fi l-harib.Achaan inta nuur Bani Israa'iil ma tumuut.
Wa ba'ad da,gamma battaan harib ma'a l-Filistiyiin fi Guub.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Sibbakaay min hillit Huucha katal Saaf min zurriiyit Raafa.
Wa battaan al-harib bada ma'a l-Filistiyiin fi Guub.Wa Alihanaan wileed Ya'ri min Beet Laham katal Jaaluut min hillit Gaat.Wa Jaaluut da,uud haribtah takhiin misil murdaas al-ligdaabe.
Wa battaan kula al-harib bada fi hillit Gaat.Wa fiyah raajil waahid tawiil wa asaabi' rijileenah wa iideenah sitte sitte wa kulluhum ke adadhum 24.Wa hu kula min zurriiyit Raafa.
Wa l-raajil da ayyar Bani Israa'iil.Wa khalaas,Yuunataan wileed Chim'a akhu Dawuud katalah.
Wa kulla l-rujaal al-arba'a dool,humman min zurriiyit Raafa min hillit Gaat.Wa humman maato be iid Dawuud wa naasah.
Wa Dawuud gaddam khine al-chukur le Allah wakit hu najjaah min iid kulla udwaanah wa min iid Chaawuul.
Wa hu gaal-:-Allah hu malja'iyahmiini wa yinajjiini.
Ilaahi hu malja'iwa l-bakaan al-nillabbad foogah.Hu daragati wa l-gudra al-tinajjiini.Hu maskani al-gawi wa malja'iwa min siyaad al-unuf,yinajjiini.
Ana sarakht wa gult-:--Al-hamdulillah-!Allah najjaani min udwaani.--
Achaan mooj al-moot khattaaniwa seel al-halaak bahatni.
Guyuud al-haawiye hawwagooniwa churukka al-moot gaa'idiin giddaami.
Fi l-diige,naadeet Allahaywa,naadeet Ilaahiwa min beetah al-mukhaddas hu simi'ni,hu simi' hiss siraakhi.
Al-ard anhazzat wa rajafatwa asaas al-sama anhazza wa barjalachaan ma himlo khadab Allah al-chadiid.
Wa min manaakhirah yatla' dukhkhaanwa min khachmah tamrug naar al-taakulal-indaha jamur al-yahrig.
Allah falla al-samaawaatwa dalla ma'a sahaabaay dalma tihit rijileenah.
Hu rikib fi makhluug samaawi wa taarwa be janaahe al-riih,haam.
Wa allabbad fi dalaam al-muhawwigmisil kheemtahwa da katarat almiwa l-sahaab al-azrag al-chaayil.
Giddaamah nuur chadiidal-yamrug minnah jamur al-yahrig.
Wa Allah dagdag min al-sama.Hu al-Aali,wa hissah ansama'.
Hu zarrag nachaachiible udwaani wa chattataahumbe barraaga al-chadiidewa hazamaahum.
Wa min chiddit za'al Allahwa min hamu riih al-jaayi minnah,ga'ar al-bahar baanwa asaas al-dunya ankachaf.
Wa min foog,madda iidah rafa'niwa min al-almi al-katiir,maragaani.
Wa najjaani min udwaani al-chudaadwa min khusmaani al-gawiyiin minni.
Wa yoom al-masiibe waga'at foogi,humman hajamoonilaakin Allah faza'ni.
Wa hu maragaani min al-khutuura wa harraraani,hu najjaani achaan yiriidni.
Wa Allah yi'aamilni hasab adaaltiwa yikaafiini hasab salaamat iideeni.
Achaan ana taaba't derib Allahwa ma isiit Ilaahi.
Aywa,ana tabbagt kulla churuutahwa abadan ma tarraft min gawaaniinah.
Wa bigiit naadum tamaam giddaamahwa hafadt nafsi min al-khata.
Wa khalaas,Allah antaani ajurhasab adaaltiwa hasab salaamti al-hu chaafha giddaamah.
Ya Allah-!Inta saadikh ma'a l-saadikhiinwa ma tuluum al-naas al-tamaamiin.
Ma'a l-taahiriin,tukuun taahirwa ma'a l-uwuj,tukuun a'waj.
Wa tinajji al-mazluumiinwa tidalli raas al-mustakbiriin.
Ya Allah-!Inta bas faanuusiwa Allah al-yidawwi leyi fi l-dalaam.
Ya Ilaahi-!Beek inta,nahjim duyuuchwa beek inta,nunutt daraadir al-hille.
Al-Rabb,derbah adiil,kalaam Allah daayman kaamil.Hu daraga le l-naadumal-yalja' leyah.
Achaan la ilaah illa Allahwa la malja' illa Ilaahna.
Ilaahi hu malja'i al-gawiwa yuguudni fi l-derib al-adiil.
Wa antaani rijle khafiifiinnajri misil al-khazaalwa rafa'ni fi l-bakaan al-aali.
Hu bas allamaani kikkeef nihaaribwa kikkeef iideeni yajbudu nubbaal al-nahaas.
Ya Allah-!Anteetni daragat najaatakwa be musaa'adatak,gawweetni.
Wa sahhalt leyi derbiwa sabbat rijileeni.
Nitaarid udwaani wa nidammirhumwa ma nigabbil lahaddi nikammilhum.
Nikammilhum wa nidammirhumwa yaga'o fi l-ard wa nifajjikhhum.
Wa gudra le l-harib,inta anteetniwa dangart udwaani giddaami.
Wa fi iideeni,sallamtuhumwa le khusmaani,ana dammartuhum.
Yi'iitu le l-faza' wa ma fi munajji,yas'alo Allah wa ma yurudd leehum.
Ana rihiktuhum misil ajaaj al-ard,misil tiinat al-chawaari' daggeethum wa fajjakhtuhum.
Wa inta najjeetnimin mu'aaradat cha'abiwa sabbattini kabiir fi umamwa cha'ab al-ma na'arifhum yakhdumu leyi.
Al-ajaanib yimaskunu nufuushum leyiwa yukhuttu udneehum le yasma'ooni.
Al-ajaanib kislowa marago min malja'hum be rajifiin.
Al-Hayy hu Allahwa baarak Allah malja'i-!Al-Aali hu Ilaah malja'i al-yinajjiini.
Ilaahi hu al-yichiil leyi al-taarwa yisallim leyi al-chu'uub tihit sultiti.
Wa yamrugni min iid udwaaniwa yansurni fooghumwa yinajjiini min al-naasal-yisawwu al-unuf.
Wa be sabab da,ya Allah,fi ust al-umam,nachkurakwa be khine,namdah usmak.
Allah anta al-nasurle l-malik al-hu darrajah.Aywa,wassaf kheerahle l-naadum al-hu masahah,le Dawuud wa zurriiytah ila l-abad.
Daahu aakhir kalaam Dawuud.Da kalaam Dawuud wileed Yassa,kalaam al-raajil al-aziim.Hu al-Allah Ilaah Yaakhuub masahah wa darrajah malikwa hu chaa'ir al-kulla Bani Israa'iil yihibbuuh wa yikarrumuuh.
Wa hu gaal-:-Ruuh Allah hajja be waasitatiwa kallam be khachmi.
Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil hajja,aywa,malja' Bani Israa'iil gaal leyi-:--Al-malik al-yahkim be l-adaalawa yuguud al-naas be khoof Allah,
hu bas misil deyy al-sabaahfi taluu' al-harraay bala sahaabwa misil nuur al-yigawwim al-khadaarba'ad al-matara.--
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-Rabb sawwaahma'aayi ana wa ma'a zurriiyti,hu sawwa ma'aayi mu'aahada daaymewa kaamile wa madmuuna.Wa fi ayyi cheyy,hu yinajjiiniwa yihaggig muna galbi.
Wa laakin kulla l-naas al-ma naaf'iin,humman misil firi' indah chook al-yazguluuh ba'iidwa ma yinkarib be iid saakit.
Wa l-naadum al-yidoor yilammisah,waajib yichiil faas aw uud harbahatta yukurrah wa yazgulah fi l-naarwa yutuchchah.
Daahu asaame furraas Dawuud.Al-awwalaani Yichbaal min hillit Hakmuun wa hu khaayid hana l-furraas dool.Wa usmah al-aakhar Adiinu min hillit Asnu.Wa hu bas al-katal 800 raajil fi l-duwaas fi yoom waahid.
Wa l-taani Ali'aazar wileed Duudu min hillit Akhuukh.Hu kula faaris min al-furraas al-talaata al-macho ma'a Dawuud wa wagafo didd al-Filistiyiin al-lammo le l-harib.Kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil ansahabo
wa laakin Ali'aazar ga'ad saabit wa katal al-Filistiyiin lahaddi iidah khidrat wa bigat gawiiye fi seefah.Wa fi l-yoom da,Allah anta nasur kabiir le Bani Israa'iil.Wa Bani Israa'iil gabbalo le Ali'aazar achaan yichiilu al-kasiibe bas.
Wa l-taalit Chamma wileed Aagi min hillit Haraar.Al-Filistiyiin lammo askarhum fi hillit Laahi wa fi l-bakaan da,fiyah zere' hana adas.Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil arrado min al-Filistiyiin
wa laakin Chamma waagif fi lubb al-zere' da wa min hinaak,marag wa haarabaahum le l-Filistiyiin.Wa Allah anta nasur kabiir le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa yoom waahid fi wakt al-gati',talaata min al-furraas al-talaatiin hana Dawuud jo ligooh le Dawuud fi karkuur Adullaam.Wa fi l-wakit da,al-Filistiyiin lammo askarhum wa ga'ado fi waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa Dawuud macha laja' fi bakaanah al-gawi.Wa fi l-wakit da,Filistiyiin waahidiin gaa'idiin fi mu'askarhum fi Beet Laham.
Wa tawwaali,Dawuud atmanna wa gaal-:-Yaatu yijiib leyi almi nachrab min al-biir al-gaa'ide fi madkhal Beet Laham-?
Wa khalaas,al-furraas al-talaata macho dakhalo fi mu'askar al-Filistiyiin wa chaalo almi min al-biir al-gaa'ide fi madkhal Beet Laham wa jaabooh wa antooh le Dawuud.Wa hu aba ma yacharbah wa laakin gaddamah hadiiyat charaab le Allah.
Wa gaal-:-Istakhfar Allah-!Abadan ma nisawwi cheyy misil da-!Ma nachrab min al-almi da achaan hu misil damm al-rujaal al-macho jaabooh be taman hayaathum. Wa Dawuud aba ma yachrab al-almi da.Wa da l-cheyy al-sawwooh al-furraas al-talaata dool.
Wa Abichaay akhu Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya,hu khaayid al-talaata.Wa yoom waahid,hu bas be haribtah katal 300 raajil.Wa usmah bigi taali' ambeen al-furraas al-talaata dool.
Wa hu ligi charaf ziyaada min al-talaata wa bigi khaayidhum.Wa ma fi al-yufuutah ambeen al-furraas al-talaata.
Wa Banaaya al-min hillit Khabsiil,hu wileed Yahuuyada' raajil waahid fahal.Wa Banaaya da,hu zaatah fahal wa chadiid.Da hu bas al-katal rujaal itneen fahaliin hana balad Muwaab.Wa yoom waahid wakit al-talaj nazal,hu dakhal fi nugra wa katal duud.
Wa battaan hu bas katal Masri al-chooftah tikhawwif.Wa l-Masri da gaa'id be haribtah fi iidah wa Banaaya macha leyah hajamah be asa wa gala' minnah haribtah wa katalah beeha.
Wa dool al-a'maal al-sawwaahum Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' wa usmah bigi taali' misil al-furraas al-talaata.
Wa hu ligi charaf ziyaada min al-talaatiin wa laakin ma lihig al-talaata.Wa Dawuud khattaah mas'uul harasah.
Wa l-rujaal al-talaatiin hana Dawuud hummanAsaahiil akhu Yuwaabwa Alihanaan wileed Duudu min Beet Laham
wa Chamma wa Aliikha,humman dool min hillit Haruud
wa Haalas min hillit Falitwa Iira wileed Ikheech min hillit Takhuu'a
wa Abi'aazar min hillit Anatuutwa Mabunnaay min hillit Huucha
wa Salmuun min hillit Akhuukhwa Mahraay min hillit Natuufa
wa Khaalib wileed Ba'ana min hillit Natuufawa Ittaay wileed Riibaay min hillit Gibee'a fi ard gabiilat Banyaamiin
wa Banaaya min hillit Fir'atuunwa Hiddaay min waadi Ga'ach
wa Abi'albuun min hillit Arabawa Azmaawat min hillit Barhum
wa Aliyahba min hillit Cha'albuunwa waahid min awlaad Yaachinwa Yuunataan
wa Chamma min hillit Haraarwa Akhiyaam wileed Charaar min hillit Haraar
wa Alifaalat wileed Ahasbaay wileed raajil waahid min hillit Ma'aakawa Ali'aam wileed Akhituufal min hillit Giilu
wa Hasraay min hillit Karmalwa Fa'araay min hillit Arab
wa Yigaal wileed Naataan min hillit Suubawa Baani min gabiilat Gaad
wa Salakh min Bani Ammuunwa Nahraay min hillit Biiruut,hu al-chaayil silaah Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya
wa Iira wa Gaarib kulluhum min aayilat Yitri
wa Uriiya al-Hitti.Dool kulluhum ke furraas Dawuud wa adadhum 37.
Wa yoom waahid,Allah khidib battaan le Bani Israa'iil wa lazza Dawuud yisawwi cheyy al-ma biwaafig wa gaal leyah-:-Gumm ahsib Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.
Wa khalaas,al-malik Dawuud gaal le Yuwaab khaayid deechah-:-Amchi fi kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil min Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati wa ahsib kulla l-cha'ab le na'arif adadhum.
Wa Yuwaab gaal le l-malik-:-Khalli Allah Ilaahak yiziid adad al-cha'ab miya marra wa khalli inta siidi al-malik tichiifah be eenak.Wa laakin maala,ya siidi al-malik,tidoor tisawwi al-cheyy da-?
Wa laakin amur al-malik bigi chadiid bilheen fi Yuwaab wa l-khuyyaad al-aakhariin hana l-deech.Wa khalaas,humman marago min bakaan al-malik le yamchu yahsubu cha'ab Bani Israa'iil.
Humman chaggo bahar al-Urdun wa macho fi hillit Aruu'ir wa l-hille di gaa'ide fi ust al-waadi.Wa macho le gabiilat Gaad wa wajjaho ale hillit Ya'ziir.
Wa wassalo hillit Gil'aad fi mantagat Tahtiim Khaadich wa macho lahaddi Daan Ya'an wa ale hawaale Seeda.
Wa dakhalo fi Suur al-madiina al-gawiiye wa fi kulla mudun al-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Kan'aaniyiin.Wa fi l-aakhir,macho wati balad Yahuuza fi hillit Biir Sab'a.
Wa ba'ad raakho fi kulla l-balad fi muddit 9 chahar wa 20 yoom,gabbalo fi Uruchaliim.
Wa khalaas,Yuwaab anta adad hisaab al-cha'ab le l-malik.Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil adadhum 800-000 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf wa min Bani Yahuuza kamaan 500-000.
Wa ba'ad hasab al-cha'ab,tawwaali Dawuud hassa' galbah gaa'id yadrub.Wa gaal-:-Ana sawweet zanib kabiir achaan hasabt al-cha'ab.Hassa' da,ya Allah,akhfir leyi khataayi ana abdak.Achaan ana sawweet al-cheyy da misil naadum matmuus.
Wa wakit Dawuud gamma be fajur,Allah hajja le l-nabi Gaad al-yichiif ru'ya le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:
Amchi guul le Dawuud-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ana ninazzil leek talaata nafar hana masaayib.Wa a'azil minhum waahid wa ana ninazzilah."-
Wa khalaas,Gaad macha le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:-Tidoor sab'a sana hana juu' fi baladak-?Aw tidoor tajri giddaam udwaanak wa humman yaturduuk le muddit talaata chahar-?Aw tidoor waba yanzil le muddit talaata yoom fi baladak-?Hassa' da,fakkir wa ooriini al-radd al-nuguulah le Allah al-rassalaani.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Gaad-:-Ana addaayagt marra waahid-!Khalli naga' fi iid Allah achaan rahmatah wasii'e.Wa khalli ma naga' fi iid insaan.
Wa khalaas,Allah nazzal waba fi balad Israa'iil.Wa min al-fajur lahaddi l-wakit al-muhaddad,maato 70-000 naas min Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati.
Wa l-malak al-mudammir madda iidah ale Uruchaliim le yidammirha.Laakin Allah ma dawwar al-damaar da wa gaal le l-malak-:-Khalaas,kafa-!Arfa' iidak. Wa l-malak da gaa'id fi l-madagg hana Arawna al-Yabuusi.
Wa wakit Dawuud chaaf al-malak al-katal al-cha'ab da,gaal le Allah-:-Ana bas aznabt wa sawweet al-khata da.Laakin al-cha'ab dool al-misil al-khanam sawwo chunu-?Aakhibni ana wa aayilti.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom da,al-nabi Gaad macha le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:-Amchi abni madbah le Allah fi l-madagg hana Arawna al-Yabuusi.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud macha misil Allah amarah beyah be waasitat al-nabi Gaad.
Wa wakit Arawna rafa' raasah wa chaaf al-malik wa khaddaamiinah jaayiin aleyah,hu ja wa waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaam al-malik.
Wa gaal-:-Maala siidi al-malik jaayi bakaan abdah-? Wa Dawuud radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana jiit le nachri minnak al-madagg wa nabni foogah madbah le Allah achaan al-waba da yagiif min al-cha'ab.
Wa Arawna gaal battaan le Dawuud-:-Khalli siidi al-malik yichiil al-madagg wa yisawwi beyah ayyi cheyy al-yidoorah.Chiif-!Daahu bagar le l-dahiiye al-muharraga.Wa l-kaarro al-yifajjukhu beyah al-gameh wa aalaatah kamaan yabgo leek hatab.
Ya l-malik,ana Arawna anteetak kulla l-achya dool.Khalli Allah Ilaahak yakhbal dahiiytak.
Wa laakin al-malik gaal le Arawna-:-La-!Ana nachriih minnak wa nikaffi tamanah.Achaan ma nidoor nigaddim dahiiye le Allah Ilaahi al-ma tikallifni cheyy. Wa khalaas,Dawuud chara al-madagg wa l-bagar be 50 hajar fudda.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Dawuud bana madbah le Allah wa gaddam foogah dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa be da,Allah raham al-balad wa l-waba wagaf min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-malik Dawuud bigi chaayib marra waahid wa kan yikhattuuh be khattaay kula hu ma yihiss be l-dafu.
Wa khaddaamiinah gaalo leyah-:-Khalli nifattuchu le siidna al-malik bineeye udriiye tirayyisah wa tabga leyah mara targud jambah.Wa be misil da,siidna al-malik yiddaffa.
Wa khalaas,gammo yifattuchu bitt jamiile fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa ligo Abichaag al-min hillit Chuunam wa jaabooha le l-malik.
Wa l-bitt di jamiile marra waahid.Wa gaa'ide tirayyis al-malik wa takhdim leyah.Wa laakin al-malik ma limisha.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit da,Aduniiya wileed Dawuud wileedha le Haggiit gamma yuguul-:-Ana bas namluk. Wa hu ligi araba hint harib wa siyaad kheel wa 50 rujaal al-yamchu giddaam arabatah.
Wa Aduniiya hu jamiil marra waahid wa wildooh ba'ad Abchaluum.Wa abadan abuuh fi kulla hayaatah ma kachchar leyah wa gaal-:-Maala tisawwi cheyy misil da-?
Wa Aduniiya hajja ma'a Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya wa ma'a Abiyaatar raajil al-diin.Wa humman andammo leyah.
Wa laakin wa la Saduukh raajil al-diin wa la Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' wa la l-nabi Naataan wa la Chim'i wa la Rii'i wa la furraas Dawuud humman dool ma andammo ma'a Aduniiya.
Wa yoom waahid,Aduniiya gaddam dahaaya hana khanam wa bagar wa tiiraan sumaan gariib le l-hajar al-amlas al-fi hillit Een Ruugil.Wa hu azam kulla akhwaanah iyaal al-malik wa kulla Bani Yahuuza masaa'iil al-malik.
Wa laakin ma azam al-nabi Naataan wa la Banaaya wa la l-furraas wa la Suleymaan akhuuh.
Wa khalaas,Naataan macha le Batchaaba' amm Suleymaan wa gaal leeha-:-Inti ma simi'ti kadar Aduniiya wileedha le Haggiit sawwa nafsah malik-?Wa siidna al-malik Dawuud kula ma indah khabar.
Wa hassa' da,ta'aali nantiiki wasiiye wa beeha tagdare tinajji hayaatki wa hayaat wileedki Suleymaan.
Amchi tawwaali algeeh le l-malik Dawuud.Wa guuli leyah-:--Ya siidi al-malik,ma inta bas halaft leyi ana khaadmak wa gult-:"Wileedki Suleymaan yahkim ba'adi wa hu bas yagood fi kursi al-muluk."Wa hassa',maala Aduniiya bigi malik-?--
Wa wakit inti gaa'ide tihajji ma'a l-malik,ana zaati nadkhul waraaki wa nitammim fi kalaamki.
Khalaas,Batchaaba' machat le l-malik fi khurfitah.Wa fi l-wakit da,hu bigi chaayib marra waahid wa Abichaag al-min hillit Chuunam gaa'ide tirayyisah.
Wa Batchaaba' barakat wa sajadat giddaam al-malik.Wa l-malik sa'alha wa gaal-:-Tidoori chunu-?
Wa hi raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Ya siidi,inta halaft leyi ana khaadmak be usum Allah Ilaahak wa gult-:--Wileedki Suleymaan yahkim ba'adi wa hu bas yagood fi kursi al-muluk.--
Wa hassa',ana simi't kadar Aduniiya bigi malik.Wa laakin,ya siidi,inta ma simi't cheyy.
Wa Aduniiya gaddam dahaaya hana tiiraan wa ajjaal sumaan wa khanam katiiriin.Wa azam kulla iyaalak inta al-malik wa Abiyaatar raajil al-diin wa Yuwaab khaayid al-deech.Wa laakin ma azam abdak Suleymaan.
Wa kan leek inta,ya siidi al-malik,kulla Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yarjook be sabur le yasma'o kharaarak wa ya'arfu yaatu al-yagood fi kursi al-muluk ba'adak.
Wa wakit inta siidi al-malik tumuut wa talhag abbahaatak,ana wa wileedi Suleymaan al-naas yaj'aloona muznibiin.
Wa wakit Batchaaba' lissaa'ha tihajji ma'a l-malik ke bas,al-nabi Naataan wassal.
Wa jo khabbaro al-malik wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu al-nabi Naataan ja. Wa l-nabi Naataan dakhal le l-malik wa waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaamah.
Wa gaal le l-malik-:-Ya siidi al-malik,hal inta bas kharrart wa gult Aduniiya yahkim ba'adak wa hu bas yagood fi kursi al-muluk walla-?
Achaan al-yoom hu macha Een Ruugil wa gaddam dahaaya hana tiiraan wa ajjaal sumaan wa khanam katiiriin.Wa hu azam kulla iyaal al-malik wa khuyyaad al-askar wa Abiyaatar raajil al-diin.Wa humman gaa'idiin yaakulu wa yacharbo giddaamah wa yuguulu-:--Yi'iich al-malik Aduniiya-!--
Wa laakin hu ma azamaani ana abdak wa la Saduukh raajil al-diin wa la Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' wa la abdak Suleymaan.
Ya siidi al-malik,al-amur da jaayi minnak inta walla-?Ya siidi al-malik,ma khabbartini ana abdak be l-naadum al-yagood fi kursi al-muluk min ba'adak.
Wa be sabab kalaam Naataan,al-malik Dawuud gaal-:-Naadu leyi Batchaaba'. Wa hi jaat dakhalat bakaan al-malik wa wagafat giddaamah.
Wa l-malik halaf wa gaal-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy al-najjaani min kulla diige
misil awwal kula ana halaft leeki be Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,wileedki Suleymaan bas yahkim ba'adi wa yagood fi l-kursi fi gaddi.Wa l-yoom bas,nihaggig al-kalaam da.
Wa Batchaaba' waga'at fi l-ard wa sajadat giddaam al-malik wa gaalat-:-Allah yansur siidi al-malik Dawuud ila l-abad.
Wa l-malik Dawuud gaal-:-Naadu leyi Saduukh raajil al-diin wa l-nabi Naataan wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada'. Wa humman jo wa dakhalo le l-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal battaan-:-Limmu kulla masaa'iili wa rakkubu wileedi Suleymaan fi bakhali wa wadduuh fi rijil al-almi hana Gihuun.
Wa fi l-bakaan daak,Saduukh raajil al-diin wa l-nabi Naataan yamsahooh wa yidarrujuuh malik fi Israa'iil.Wa khalaas,tadurbu al-buug wa tuguulu-:--Yi'iich al-malik Suleymaan.--
Wa ba'ad da,tusuuguuh giddaamku wa taju fi l-hille.Wa hu yaji yagood fi kursiiyi wa hu bas yahkim fi gaddi.Wa hu bas al-ana azaltah le yabga haakim fi Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.
Wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' gaal le l-malik-:-Aamiin,khalli Allah Ilaah siidi al-malik yihaggig kalaamah.
Wa misil Allah kaan ma'a siidi al-malik,khalli yukuun ma'a Suleymaan kula.Wa yi'alli darajat hukmah ziyaada min darajat siidi al-malik Dawuud.
Wa khalaas,Saduukh raajil al-diin macha ma'a l-nabi Naataan wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' wa l-Kiritiyiin wa l-Filtiyiin hurraas al-malik wa kulluhum rakkabooh le Suleymaan fi bakhal hana l-malik Dawuud wa waddooh Gihuun.
Wa Saduukh raajil al-diin chaal al-garin malaan dihin min lubb kheemat Allah wa masahah le Suleymaan wa darrajah malik.Wa darab al-buug wa kulla l-naas al-haadiriin gaalo-:-Yi'iich al-malik Suleymaan.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-naas gabbalo al-hille wara Suleymaan.Wa humman gaa'idiin yal'abo fi hiss al-suffaara be farha chadiide lahaddi al-ard rajafat min harakathum.
Wa Aduniiya wa naasah sim'o al-haraka di fi wakit al-dahaabhum kammalo akilhum.Wa Yuwaab irif hiss al-buug wa gaal-:-Chunu al-haraka al-chadiide di al-fi lubb al-hille-?
Wa lissaa' ma kammal kalaamah ke bas,ja Yuunataan wileed Abiyaatar raajil al-diin.Wa Aduniiya gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal,inta naadum indah charaf wa akiid indak khabar halu le ti'ooriina.
Wa Yuunataan radda le Aduniiya wa gaal-:-La abadan-!Siidna al-malik Dawuud darrajah le Suleymaan wa khattaah malik.
Wa l-malik Dawuud rassal ma'a Suleymaan Saduukh raajil al-diin wa l-nabi Naataan wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' wa l-Kiritiyiin wa l-Filtiyiin hurraas al-malik.Wa humman rakkabooh fi l-bakhal hana l-malik.
Wa Saduukh raajil al-diin wa l-nabi Naataan masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi Gihuun.Wa be da khalaas,humman gabbalo fi l-hille farhaaniin wa kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yasrakho.Wa di bas al-haraka al-intu gaa'idiin tasma'ooha.
Wa Suleymaan zaatah ga'ad khalaas fi l-kursi hana l-muluk
wa ziyaada min da,masaa'iil al-malik jo baarako le siidna al-malik Dawuud wa gaalo leyah-:--Khalli al-Rabb yisawwi usum Suleymaan yabga machhuur min usmak inta wa mulkah kula yabga ziyaada min mulkak inta.- Wa l-malik sajad fi furaachah.
Wa gaal al-kalaam da-:--Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil hu al-khatta fi kursi al-muluk naadum fi badali.Wa ana gidirt chiftah be uyuuni.-
Wa wakit sim'o al-kalaam da,kulla ma'zuumiin Aduniiya gaa'idiin yarjufu min al-khoof wa ayyi waahid gamma wa macha.
Wa Aduniiya zaatah khaaf min Suleymaan wa gamma macha karab guruun al-madbah.
Wa jo khabbaro Suleymaan wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu Aduniiya khaaf minnak inta,ya l-malik Suleymaan.Wa karab guruun al-madbah wa gaal-:--Khalli al-yoom al-malik Suleymaan yahlif leyi kadar ma yaktulni be l-seef.-
Wa Suleymaan radda wa gaal-:-Kan hu maachi adiil,suufaay waahide kula min raasah ma taga' fi l-turaab.Laakin kan yisawwi al-fasaala kamaan,yumuut.
Wa khalaas,Suleymaan rassal naas dallooh le Aduniiya min al-madbah.Wa hu ja wa sajad giddaam al-malik Suleymaan.Wa Suleymaan gaal leyah-:-Amchi beetak.
Wa wakit Dawuud irif kadar hu gariib yumuut,anta wasiiye le wileedah Suleymaan.Wa gaal-:
Ana gariib nikhalli al-dunya.Chidd heelak wa abga raajil-!
Taabi' kalaam Allah Ilaahak wa amchi fi derbah.Ahfad gawaaniinah wa wasiiyaatah wa churuutah wa mu'aahadatah wa kulla cheyy al-maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa.Wa be da,inta tanjah fi kulla cheyy al-tisawwiih wa fi ayyi bakaan al-tamchi.
Achaan Allah gaal yihaggig kalaamah al-gaalah leyi.Hu gaal-:--Kan naas zurriiytak yamchu adiil wa yisawwu al-hagg be kulla guluubhum wa kulla fikirhum,khalaas daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiytak fi kursi al-muluk hana Bani Israa'iil.-
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Inta ta'arif tamaam al-cheyy al-sawwaah leyi Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya.Hu bas al-katalaahum le kubaaraat al-askar al-itneen hana Bani Israa'iil ya'ni Abniir wileed Niir wa Amaasa wileed Yatar.Wa daffag dammuhum fi wakit al-salaama wa chaal mas'uuliiyit katilhum.
Wa al'aamal ma'aayah be hikma achaan ma tikhalli yabga chaayib wa la yumuut be salaam.
Wa fakkir fi iyaal Barzillaay al-min turaab Gil'aad wa sawwi leehum al-kheer.Wa khalliihum yabgo min al-naas al-yaakulu ma'aak inta al-malik achaan humman faza'ooniwakit ana mu'arrid min akhuuk Abchaluum.
Wa fakkir fi Chim'i wileed Giira min gabiilat Banyaamiin min hillit Bahuriim al-gaa'id jambak.Hu la'anniziyaada wakit ana mu'arrid maachi Mahanaayim.Wa laakin wakit ana mugabbil,hu ligaani ale bahar al-Urdun wa ana halaft leyah be Allah wa gult ma naktulah be l-seef.
Wa hassa',ma taj'alah naadum bari.Achaan inta raajil hakiim wa ta'arif al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih leyah.Wa be suuf raasah al-abyad da kula,aktulah.
Wa Dawuud maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud fi Uruchaliim.
Wa muddit hukum Dawuud fi kulla balad Israa'iil 40 sana.Hu hakam 7 sana fi Hibruun wa 33 sana fi Uruchaliim.
Wa Suleymaan chaal kursi al-muluk hana abuuh Dawuud.Wa mulkah bigi saabit.
Wa Aduniiya wileedha le Haggiit ja le Batchaaba' amm Suleymaan.Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Jaytak di aafe bas-? Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Aafe.
Wa gaal battaan-:-Indi kilme nuguulha leeki. Wa hi gaalat-:-Guulha.
Wa hu gaal-:-Inti ta'arfi kadar al-muluk da hanaayi ana wa kulla Bani Israa'iil yidooru ana nabga malik.Wa laakin al-muluk marag minni wa waga' le akhuuyi Suleymaan achaan Allah bas dawwar kadar hu yabga malik.
Wa hassa' da,indi talab waahid nigaddimah leeki.Ma taabe leyi. Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Kallim-!
Wa hu gaal-:-Min fadulki guuli le l-malik Suleymaan yantiini Abichaag al-min hillit Chuunam le tabga marti.Hu ma yaaba leeki.
Wa Batchaaba' gaalat-:-Da adiil.Ana zaati namchi nikallim al-malik be l-cheyy al-bukhussak.
Wa khalaas,Batchaaba' machat bakaan al-malik Suleymaan le tihajji leyah be l-cheyy al-bukhuss Aduniiya.Wa wakit dakhalat,al-malik gamma laagaaha le ammah wa sajad leeha.Wa ba'ad da,gamma ga'ad fi kursiih wa khatta kursi aakhar le ammah be nussah al-zeenaay.
Wa Batchaaba' gaalat leyah-:-Indi talab sakhayyar ke nigaddimah leek wa laakin ma taaba leyi. Wa l-malik gaal leeha-:-Gaddimi talabki,ya ammi.Ana ma naaba leeki.
Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Hal ma nagdaro nantu Abichaag al-min hillit Chuunam le akhuuk Aduniiya le tabga martah walla-?
Wa l-malik Suleymaan radda le ammah wa gaal-:-Maala tatulbi Abichaag al-min hillit Chuunam le Aduniiya-?Hu akhuuyi al-kabiir.Wa misil da,atulbi al-muluk leyah hu wa le Abiyaatar raajil al-diin wa le Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya kula-!
Wa khalaas,al-malik Suleymaan halaf be Allah wa gaal-:-Khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid kan Aduniiya ma kaffa be hayaatah taman al-talab al-hu gaddamah da.
Wa Allah al-Hayy bas sabbataani fi kursi al-muluk hana abuuyi Dawuud wa anta al-muluk da leyi ana wa le zurriiyti misil hu gaalah.Wa l-yoom bas,Aduniiya yumuut.
Wa khalaas,al-malik Suleymaan rassalah le Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada'.Wa hu macha darabah le Aduniiya wa katalah.
Wa kan le Abiyaatar raajil al-diin kamaan,al-malik gaal-:-Amchi le ziraa'tak fi Anatuut achaan al-moot waajib leek.Wa laakin ana ma naktulak al-yoom achaan inta chilt sanduug Allah al-Rabb giddaam abuuyi Dawuud wa inta ti'ibt ma'aayah fi kulla diigtah.
Wa be misil da,Suleymaan tarad Abiyaatar min khidimtah hana rujaal al-diin achaan yihaggig al-kalaam al-gaalah Allah fi zurriiyit Ali fi Chiilooh.
Wa wakit Yuwaab simi' be l-khabar da,gamma arrad wa macha fi kheemat Allah wa karab guruun al-madbah.Wa da achaan hu aba ma andamma ma'a Abchaluum wa laakin andamma ma'a Aduniiya.
Wa jo khabbaro al-malik Suleymaan kadar Yuwaab arrad wa allabbad fi lubb kheemat Allah wa gaa'id jamb al-madbah.Wa khalaas,Suleymaan rassal Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' wa gaal leyah-:-Amchi aktulah.
Wa Banaaya dakhal fi kheemat Allah wa gaal le Yuwaab-:-Al-malik buguul-:--Amrug min al-bakaan da.-- Wa Yuwaab gaal-:-La-!Ana numuut hini.-Wa khalaas,Banaaya gabbal bakaan al-malik wa ooraah be l-kalaam al-Yuwaab raddaah leyah.
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Sawwi misil hu gaalah-!Aktulah wa adfinah fi bakaanah da bas.Wa be misil da,ana wa aayilat abuuyi nukuunu bariyiin min al-dimam al-katalaahum Yuwaab bala sabab.
Wa khalli Allah yigabbil leyah al-dimam dool fi raasah achaan hu katal be l-seef naaseen al-adiiliin wa akheer minnah wa abuuyi Dawuud ma indah khabar.Hu katal Abniir wileed Niir khaayid deech Bani Israa'iil wa Amaasa wileed Yatar khaayid deech Bani Yahuuza.
Khalli Allah yigabbil al-dimam dool fi raas Yuwaab wa fi zurriiytah ila l-abad.Wa laakin le Dawuud kamaan,khalli Allah yijiib al-salaam al-daayim fi zurriiytah wa fi beetah wa fi mulkah.
Wa khalaas,Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' macha le Yuwaab dakhal leyah wa katalah.Wa dafanooh fi beetah fi l-kadaade.
Wa l-malik khattaah le Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' khaayid al-deech fi badal Yuwaab.Wa le Saduukh,khattaah raajil al-diin fi badal Abiyaatar.
Wa l-malik naadaah le Chim'i wa gaal leyah-:-Abni leek beet fi Uruchaliim wa askun fi lubb al-madiina wa ma tamchi ayyi bakaan.
Wa a'arif tamaam kan yoom inta maragt min al-madiina di wa gata't waadi Khidruun da,tumuut.Wa inta bas tabga mas'uul min mootak.
Wa Chim'i radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Kalaamak adiil-!Ana khaddaamak nisawwi kula cheyy al-inta siidi al-malik gultah. Wa Chim'i sakan tawwal fi Uruchaliim.
Wa laakin ba'ad talaata sana,abiid itneen hana Chim'i arrado wa macho bakaan Akiich wileed Ma'aaka malik hillit Gaat.Wa jo khabbarooh le Chim'i wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu abiidak macho hillit Gaat.
Wa tawwaali,Chim'i gamma chadda humaara wa macha hillit Gaat bakaan Akiich le yichiil abiidah.Wa khalaas,Chim'i chaal wa jaab abiidah min hillit Gaat.
Wa jo khabbarooh le Suleymaan kadar Chim'i marag min Uruchaliim wa macha hillit Gaat wa gabbal.
Wa khalaas,al-malik rassal naadaah le Chim'i wa gaal leyah-:-Ana ma hallaftak be Allah wa hazzartak wa gult leek-:--A'arif tamaam kan yoom maragt min al-madiina di wa macheet fi ayyi bakaan,tumuut.- Wa inta gult-:--Tamaam-!Simi't kalaamak.--
Wa maala ma khuft min al-haliife al-sawweetha giddaam Allah-?Wa maala ma tabbagt amri al-amartak beyah-?
Wa l-malik gaal battaan le Chim'i-:-Inta ta'arif kulla l-fasaala al-sawweetha be niiytak le abuuyi Dawuud.Allah yigabbil leek fasaaltak di fi raasak.
Wa laakin Allah yibaarikni ana al-malik Suleymaan wa yisabbit kursi al-muluk hana abuuyi Dawuud wa yagood ila l-abad giddaam Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik anta amur le Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' wa hu macha darabah le Chim'i lahaddi maat.Wa be misil da,al-muluk hana malik Suleymaan bigi saabit.
Wa Suleymaan naasab Fir'oon malik Masir.Hu akhad bineeyit Fir'oon wa khattaaha fi madiinat Dawuud lahaddi hu kammal buna beetah al-halaalah wa beet Allah wa durdur al-muhawwig Uruchaliim.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-cha'ab gaa'idiin yigaddumu dahaayaahum le Allah fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin achaan lissaa' ma bano beet Allah.
Wa Suleymaan indah hubb le Allah wa gaa'id yitabbig al-churuut al-antaahum leyah abuuh Dawuud.Wa laakin hu kula gaa'id yigaddim dahaaya wa yiharrig bakhuur fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin.
Wa yoom waahid,al-malik macha hillit Gib'uun le yigaddim dahaaya fi bakaan al-ibaada hinaak.Wa da bakaan al-ibaada al-muhimm ziyaada.Wa Suleymaan gaddam 1-000 dahaaya muharragiin fi l-madbah da.
Wa fi Gib'uun,Allah baan le Suleymaan be l-leel fi ru'ya wa gaal leyah-:-Atlub minni al-cheyy al-inta tidoorah wa ana nantiih leek.
Wa Suleymaan radda wa gaal-:-Inta sawweet kheer katiir le abuuyi Dawuud abdak achaan hu taaba' derbak be amaan wa adaala wa galib abyad.Wa inta hafadt leyah al-kheer al-katiir da wa anteetah wileed al-chaal mulkah al-yoom.
Wa hassa' da,ya Allah Ilaahi,inta bas al-darrajtini ana abdak malik fi gadd abuuyi Dawuud.Wa ana lissaa'ni sabi wa ma na'arif kikkeef nahkim.
Wa ana abdak gaa'id fi ust al-cha'ab al-inta azaltuhum.Wa l-cha'ab dool min katarathum wa la yinhasbu wa la yin'addo.
Arzukhni ana abdak be galib al-indah hikma le nahkim fi cha'abak wa na'arif al-zeen wa l-fasil.Achaan yaatu yagdar yahkim fi cha'abak al-katiiriin dool-?
Wa l-Rabb khibil talab Suleymaan al-gaddamah leyah da.
Wa l-Rabb radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta talabt al-hikma bas wa la talabt umur tawiil wa la talabt maal wa la talabt moot udwaanak laakin inta talabt al-fihim le tahkim be l-adaala.
Daahu ana nihaggig talabak wa nantiik hikma wa fihim al-abadan ma anteetah le naadum min gablak wa la min ba'adak.
Wa ana nantiik al-cheyy al-inta ma talabtah kula.Nantiik al-khuna wa l-azama wa fi kulla muddit hayaatak ma fi malik min al-muluuk al-yabga mislak.
Wa kan titaabi' derbi wa tahfad churuuti wa wasiiyaati misil Dawuud abuuk,ana nitawwil umrak.
Wa wakit Suleymaan wi'i,hu irif kadar hu ri'i.Wa khalaas,gamma macha Uruchaliim wa wagaf giddaam sanduug mu'aahadat al-Rabb.Wa hu gaddam dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa ba'ad da,hu sawwa aazuuma le masaa'iilah.
Wa yoom waahid,awiin itneen charaamiit jin giddaam al-malik.
Wa l-waahide min al-awiin deel gaalat-:-Ya siidi al-malik-!Ana wa l-mara di saaknaat fi nafs al-beet.Wa wakit ana wilidt,hi kula gaa'ide.
Wa ba'ad talaata yoom,hi kula wildat.Wa aniina gaa'idaat sawa,naadum aakhar ma'aana fi l-beet ke ma fiih illa aniina al-itneen.
Wa wald al-mara di maat be l-leel achaan hi ragadat foogah.
Wa hi gammat ust al-leel wa chaalat wileedi al-raagid jambi.Wa da wakit ana khaadmak naayme.Wa hi hadanatah giddaamha wa wileedha al-mayyit kamaan raggadatah giddaami.
Wa be fajur wakit gammeet niraddi' wileedi,ligiitah mayyit.Wa wakit al-sabaah asbah,ana akkadt al-wileed da adiil wa irift kadar da ma wileedi al-ana wilidtah.
Wa l-mara al-aakhara gaalat-:-La,ma ke-!Al-wileed al-hayy da bas hanaayi wa l-mayyit da hanaaki. Wa l-mara al-awwalaaniiye gaalat-:-Abadan-!Wileedki inti bas al-mayyit wa wileedi ana bas al-hayy. Wa be misil da,hinna gamman yilkhaalatan giddaam al-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal leehin-:-Al-waahide minkan gaalat-:--Al-wileed al-hayy hanaayi wa l-mayyit hanaaki.- Wa l-aakhara tuguul-:--La-!Wileedki inti bas al-mayyit wa hanaayi ana bas al-hayy.-
Wa khalaas,al-malik gaal-:-Jiibu leyi seef. Wa jaabo seef le l-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Agta'o al-sakhiir al-hayy da bakaanteen wa antu nuss le l-waahide wa nuss le l-aakhara.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,amm al-sakhiir al-hayy hannat le sakhiirha wa gaalat le l-malik-:-Ya siidi al-malik,antiiha al-sakhiir da.Ma taktuluuh-! Wa laakin al-mara al-aakhara tuguul-:-Agta'o al-sakhiir-!Wa be misil da,wa la ana nalgaah wa la hi talgaah.
Wa khalaas,al-malik gaal-:-Antu al-sakhiir al-hayy da le l-mara al-awwalaaniiye.Ma taktuluuh achaan hi bas ammah.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil sim'o be l-charii'a al-sawwaaha Suleymaan.Wa humman khaafo minnah achaan irfo kadar al-Rabb antaah hikma le yahkim be l-adaala.
Wa Suleymaan bigi malik fi kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa masaa'iilah humman Azarya wileed Saduukh hu raajil al-diin
wa Alihuuraf wa Akhiiya wileed Chiicha humman kuttaabah wa Yahuuchafat wileed Akhiluud hu kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik.
Wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' hu khaayid al-deech wa Saduukh wa Abiyaatar humman rujaal diin
wa Azarya wileed Naataan hu mas'uul fi l-hukkaam wa Zabuud wileed Naataan hu raajil diin wa mustachaar al-khaass hana l-malik.
Wa Akhichaar hu mas'uul fi gasir al-malik wa Aduniraam wileed Abda hu mas'uul fi l-khidme al-ijbaariiye.
Suleymaan khatta 12 hukkaam fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa humman bas mas'uuliin min iichit al-malik wa aayiltah.Wa fi l-sana,ayyi waahid minhum yijiib ma'aach hana chahar waahid.
Wa daahu asaame al-hukkaam dool.Wileed Huur haakim fi mantagat jibaal Afraayim.
Wa wileed Dakhar haakim fi Maakhas wa fi Cha'albiim wa fi Beet Chams wa fi Iluun Beet Hanaan.
Wa wileed Hasad haakim fi Arubuut ya'ni mantagat Suuku wa kulla balad Hiifar.
Wa wileed Abinadaab haakim fi kulla mantagat jibaal Duur.Wa hu bas raajilha le Taafat bineeyit Suleymaan.
Wa Ba'ana wileed Akhiluud haakim fi Ta'nak wa Magiddu wa kulla mantagat Beet Chaan al-gariibe le Sartaan giddaam le Yazra'iil ya'ni min Beet Chaan lahaddi Abil Mahuula wa lahaddi khaadi le Yakhma'aam.
Wa wileed Giibar haakim fi Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad.Wa hu mas'uul fi hillaal hana Yayiir wileed Manassa fi Gil'aad.Wa battaan hu haakim fi Arguub fi turaab Baachaan wa 60 mudun kubaar wa muhawwagiin be daraadir gawiyiin wa mugaffaliin be hawaadir hana nahaas.
Wa Akhinadaab wileed Iddu haakim fi mantagat Mahanaayim.
Wa Akhimaa'as haakim fi mantagat Naftaali.Wa hu kula akhad bitt waahide min banaat Suleymaan al-usumha Baasmat.
Wa Ba'ana wileed Huuchaay haakim fi mantagat Achiir wa Ba'aluut.
Wa Yahuuchafat wileed Faaruuh haakim fi mantagat Yassaakar.
Wa Chim'i wileed Iila haakim fi mantagat Banyaamiin.
Wa Giibar wileed Uuri haakim fi turaab Gil'aad.Wa l-turaab di zamaan hi hint Siihuun malik al-Amuuriyiin wa Oog malik Baachaan.Wa ziyaada min al-hukkaam al-atnaachar dool,fiyah haakim fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil humman katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar.Wa humman induhum akil wa charaab wa aaychiin fi raaha.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan hakam fi kulla l-mamaalik min bahar al-Furaat wa balad al-Filistiyiin lahaddi huduud balad Masir.Wa humman dool yikaffu al-miiri wa yakhdumu le l-malik Suleymaan fi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Wa l-ma'aach al-yijiibuuh le Suleymaan wa naasah fi l-yoom yisaawi 75 chuwaal hana ahsan dagiig wa 150 chuwaal hana dagiig gameh
wa 10 tiiraan sumaan murabbayiin wa 20 tiiraan hana sarha wa 100 khanam.Wa da bala l-teetal wa l-khuzlaan wa l-wuhuuch wa l-tuyuur al-murabbayiin.
Al-malik Suleymaan gaa'id yahkim fi kulla l-balad al-gaa'ide kharib le bahar al-Furaat wa da min hillit Tifsah lahaddi hillit Khazza.Wa hu aayich be l-salaama ma'a kulla l-buldaan al-mujaawiriinah.
Wa min Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati,Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil yagoodu be amaan ayyi waahid fi lubb jineentah hana l-inab wa l-tiin fi kulla muddit hayaat Suleymaan.
Wa Suleymaan indah 40-000 chaaye le l-kheel al-yukurru leyah arabaatah hana l-harib wa 12-000 rujaal siyaad kheel.
Wa l-malik kallaf atnaachar hukkaam,wa humman al-mas'uuliin be ma'aach al-malik wa l-naas al-yaakulu fi dabalaaytah.Wa ayyi waahid yijiib ma'aach hana chahar waahid wa ma yikhalli cheyy yigassir leyah.
Wa l-hukkaam dool ayyi waahid hasab al-talabooh minnah yijiib gameh abyad wa gechch le l-kheel al-yarkabo fooghum wa l-kheel al-yukurru beehum.Wa l-khumaam da,kulla ke yijiibuuh fi l-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah al-malik.
Wa l-Rabb antaah le Suleymaan hikma wa fihim ziyaada wa ma'rafa katiire misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar.
Wa hikmat Suleymaan bigat ziyaada min hikmat kulla naas al-sabaah wa hikmat naas Masir.
Wa Suleymaan bigi hakiim min kulla naas al-dunya wa hakiim min Itaan al-min khachum beet Azraahi wa Heemaan wa Kalkuul wa Darda' iyaal Mahuul.Wa usmah bigi ma'ruuf fi kulla l-umam al-mujaawiriinah.
Wa Suleymaan katab 3-000 masal wa 1-005 khine.
Wa hu hajja be l-nabaat min chadar al-arz al-aziim hana Lubnaan lahaddi nabaat al-zuufa al-sakhayyar al-yugumm fi l-durdur.Wa hajja be l-bahaayim wa l-tuyuur wa l-zawaahif wa l-huut.
Wa kulla l-chu'uub wa muluuk al-ard al-sim'o be hikmat al-malik Suleymaan rassalo naashum jo le yasma'o hikmatah.
Wa wakit Hiiraam malik balad Suur simi' kadar Suleymaan masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi gadd abuuh,rassal masaa'iilah le Suleymaan achaan Hiiraam kaan rafiigah le Dawuud fi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Wa Suleymaan rassal le Hiiraam wa gaal-:
Inta ta'arif kadar abuuyi Dawuud ma gidir bana beet le Allah Ilaahah achaan udwaanah haarabooh min ayyi jiihe lahaddi Allah khattaahum tihit rijileenah.
Wa laakin hassa',Allah Ilaahi jaab leyi al-salaama min ayyi jiihe wa ma fi adu wa la diige.
Wa daahu ana indi niiye le nabni beet le Allah Ilaahi.Wa da misil Allah gaalah le abuuyi Dawuud,hu gaal-:--Ana nidarrij wileedak malik fi gaddak wa hu bas al-yabni beet le usmi.--
Wa hassa' da,anti amur le naasak yagta'o leyi hatab al-arz hana Lubnaan.Wa khaddaamiinak yakhdumu ma'a khaddaamiini wa ana nikaffiik ujrat khaddaamiinak hasab inta tuguulah.Achaan inta ta'arif tamaam kadar ma fi naadum minnina al-ya'arif yagta' al-chadar misil naasak min balad Seeda.
Wa wakit Hiiraam simi' kalaam Suleymaan da,firih farha chadiide wa gaal-:-Baarak Allah al-antaah al-yoom le Dawuud wileed hakiim le yahkim fi l-cha'ab al-katiiriin dool.
Wa Hiiraam rassal le Suleymaan wa gaal-:-Ana simi't kalaam mursaalak wa khalaas nantiik kulla l-dawwartah min hatab al-arz wa hatab al-sarwi.
Wa khaddaamiini yangulu hatab al-arz min Lubnaan lahaddi khachum al-bahar al-Abyad.Wa hinaak,yilimmu al-hatab da wa yarbutuuh wa yi'awwumuuh fi l-bahar lahaddi fi l-bakaan al-inta tiwassifah leyi.Wa fi l-bakaan da,naasi yifartugu al-hubaal wa inta tichiilah.Wa inta kamaan sawwi leyi al-cheyy al-nidoorah wa anti akil le naas beeti.
Wa be misil da,Hiiraam anta Suleymaan hatab al-arz wa hatab al-sarwi misil hu dawwarah.
Wa kulli sana,Suleymaan yanti akil le Hiiraam misil 50-000 chuwaal hana gameh wa itneen birmiil hana dihin zaytuun saafi.
Wa Allah antaah hikma le Suleymaan misil hu gaalah leyah.Wa l-alaakha bigat samha been Hiiraam wa Suleymaan.Wa be da,humman sawwo mu'aahada ambeenaathum.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan nazzam khidme ijbaariiye wa chaal foogha 30-000 raajil min kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-rujaal dool yakhdumu amkaaba.Wa fi ayyi chahar,yirassil 10-000 raajil yamchu Lubnaan le yakhdumu chahar.Wa ba'ad da,yigabbulu yinjammo chahareen fi buyuuthum.Wa l-muraakhib fi l-khidme di,hu Aduniraam.
Wa Suleymaan indah battaan 70-000 naggaaliin wa 80-000 naas gaa'idiin fi l-jibaal achaan yagta'o hujaar hana buna.
Wa bala l-masaa'iil al-Suleymaan kallafaahum fi l-khidme,fiyah naas aakhariin kula muraakhibiin fi l-khidme di.Wa adadhum 3-300 raajil.
Wa l-malik anta amur le yagta'o hujaar kubaar wa samhiin le yabgo asaas le beet Allah.
Wa khalaas,kulla khaddaamiin Suleymaan wa khaddaamiin Hiiraam wa naas hillit Gibaal gammo yagta'o wa yijahhuzu al-hatab wa l-hujaar le buna al-beet da.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan bada buna beet Allah be 480 sana ba'ad marigiin Bani Israa'iil min balad Masir.Wa da fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukmah fi Bani Israa'iil wa fi l-chahar al-usmah Ziyu wa hu al-chahar al-taani hana l-sana.
Wa l-beet al-Suleymaan banaah le Allah da tuulah 60 duraa' wa urdah 20 duraa' wa tuulah foog kamaan 30 duraa'.
Wa giddaam beet Allah,fiyah khurfa hana madkhal al-urdaha 20 duraa' ma'a urd al-beet sawa wa tuulha 10 duraa' giddaam al-beet.
Wa l-beet da rakkabo leyah chabaabiik wa saddoohum be hadiid madfuur.
Wa bano buyuut barra fi tuul al-durdur hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa l-gasir al-tihtaani urdah 5 duraa' wa l-ustaani urdah 6 duraa' wa l-taalit urdah 7 duraa' achaan durdur hana beet Allah ma indah nafs al-tukhun fi kulla tuulah foog.Wa tukhnah ma mutasaawi fi ayyi gasir.Wa be da,al-maraadiis al-yisabbutu al-beet ma yadkhulu fi l-durdur hana beet Allah.
Wa l-buna hana beet Allah da sawwooh be hujaar mujahhaziin al-gata'oohum gubbaal.Wa be da,ma binsami' daribiin hana mitraga wa la faas wa la aala aakhara hana hadiid fi lubb beet Allah wakit gaa'idiin yabnuuh.
Wa l-baab al-yadkhulu beyah al-gasir al-ustaani gaa'id be nuss al-zeene hana beet Allah.Wa yarkabo fi l-gasir al-ustaani da be ataba wa min hinaak,yarkabo battaan fi l-gasir al-foogaani.
Wa ba'ad Suleymaan kammal buna beet Allah,khatta leyah maraadiis hana arz wa sadda raasah be khachab.
Wa bana al-buyuut barra fi tuul al-durdur hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa ayyi beet tuulah 5 duraa' wa lammaahum ma'a durdur al-beet al-mukhaddas be hatab al-arz.
Wa Allah hajja le Suleymaan wa gaal-:
Daahu inta gaa'id tabni leyi al-beet da.Wa kan tamchi hasab gawaaniini wa titaabi' churuuti wa tahfad wasiiyaati wa titabbighum,khalaas ana nihaggig al-kalaam al-gultah fi chaanak wa da l-kalaam al-gultah le abuuk Dawuud.
Wa ana naskun fi lubb cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa abadan ma nikhalliihum.
Wa ba'ad kammal buna beet Allah,Suleymaan
sadda kulla daakhal al-beet min tihit lahaddi foog be khachab al-arz.Wa turaabah kula saddaah be khachab al-sarwi.
Wa fi lubb al-beet daakhal,bana khurfa khaassa wa da l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.Tuulah yisaawi 20 duraa' wa saddaah be khachab al-arz min tihit lahaddi foog.
Wa l-bakaan al-faddal min al-khurfa al-kabiire hana beet Allah gaa'id giddaam al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid wa tuulah yisaawi 40 duraa'.
Wa khachab al-arz al-saddo beyah al-bakaan al-mukhaddas min daakhal,nagacho foogah suwar hana bukhas wa zuhuur mufattahiin.Wa saddo kulla l-bakaan al-mukhaddas da be khachab al-arz.Wa be da,hajar waahid kula ma binchaaf.
Wa daakhal beet Allah,Suleymaan bana al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid da le yukhuttu foogah sanduug mu'aahadat Allah.
Wa l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid tuulah 20 duraa' wa urdah 20 duraa' wa tuulah foog kula 20 duraa'.Wa Suleymaan masah lubbah be dahab saafi.Wa sawwa mukhbar kula min hatab al-arz wa masahah be dahab.
Wa Suleymaan masah lubb al-beet da be dahab saafi wa allag salaasil hana dahab giddaam al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid al-mamsuuh be dahab.
Wa khalaas be da,hu masah be dahab saafi kulla l-beet wa l-mukhbar al-khattaah giddaam al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa fi lubb al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid,sana' tamaasiil hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin itneen be hatab al-zaytuun.Wa ayyi waahid tuulah foog 10 duraa'.
Wa ayyi makhluug samaawi indah janaahe itneen.Wa tuul al-jinh al-waahid 5 duraa' wa l-jinh al-aakhar kula tuulah 5 duraa'.Wa min taraf jinhah al-waahid le jinhah al-aakhar,tuulah 10 duraa'.
Wa tuul al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin al-itneen dool sawa sawa ya'ni 10 duraa' ayyi waahid.Wa chakilhum kula waahid.
Wa ayyi waahid min al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool tuulah foog 10 duraa'.
Wa Suleymaan khatta al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool daakhal fi lubb al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.Wa l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool mumattitiin janaaheehum wa jinh hana l-makhluug al-samaawi al-waahid yilammis al-durdur be hini wa jinh hana l-makhluug al-samaawi al-aakhar yilammis al-durdur be hinaak.Wa misil da,janaaheehum al-aakhariin kamaan laammiin sawa fi ust al-beet,jinh ma'a jinh.
Wa l-tamaasiil hana l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin al-itneen dool,masahaahum be dahab.
Wa fi kulla l-daraadir al-daakhal hana l-khuraf al-itneen hana beet Allah,nagach suwar hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin wa chadar nakhal wa zuhuur mufattahiin.
Wa hu masah ard al-khuraf al-itneen dool be dahab.
Wa fi madkhal al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid,sawwa baab abdalfiteen be hatab al-zaytuun.Wa l-hatab al-yirakkubu foogah al-baab da,tuulah yisaawi al-khumus hana l-durdur.
Wa l-biibaan al-itneen hana l-baab abdalfiteen dool,sawwaahum be hatab al-zaytuun.Wa nagach fooghum suwar hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin wa chadar nakhal wa zuhuur mufattahiin wa masahaahum be dahab.Al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin wa l-nakhal kulluhum ke masahaahum be dahab.
Wa sawwa nafs al-cheyy le l-baab hana madkhal beet Allah.Wa l-hatab al-yirakkubu foogah al-baab da sawwaah be hatab al-zaytuun wa tuulah yisaawi al-rubu' hana l-durdur.
Wa sawwa biibaan itneen be hatab al-sarwi al-induhum rubaat ambeenaathum wa l-waahid yintabig fi l-aakhar.
Wa fi l-biibaan dool,nagach suwar hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin wa chadar nakhal wa zuhuur mufattahiin wa masahaahum be dahab.
Wa l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye,hawwagha be talaata roog hana hajar manguuch.Wa fi raas al-talaata roog hana hajar,khatta roog waahid hana hatab al-arz.
Wa asaas beet Allah,khattooh fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Suleymaan fi l-chahar al-usmah Ziyu.
Wa fi sanit 11 hana hukmah fi l-chahar al-usmah Buul ya'ni fi l-chahar al-taamin,buna hana l-beet da kammal marra waahid hasab al-waajib leyah.Wa Suleymaan bana al-beet da fi muddit sab'a sana.
Wa Suleymaan bana gasrah wa kammalah fi muddit 13 sana.
Wa hu bana beet al-sammooh Khaabat Lubnaan wa tuulah 100 duraa' wa urdah 50 duraa' wa tuulah foog kamaan 30 duraa'.Wa fi lubbah,hu sawwa arba'a roog hana amad min hatab al-arz wa fi raashum,khatta maraadiis kula min hatab al-arz.
Wa l-maraadiis dool adadhum 45 wa gaa'idiin fi talaata roog wa ayyi roog indah 15 maraadiis al-gaa'idiin fi raas al-amad.Wa hu sadda al-maraadiis dool be khachab al-arz.
Wa fi ayyi jiihe hana l-beet,sawwo talaata roog hana chabaabiik be hatabhum.Wa rakkabo al-chabaabiik dool mulgaabiliin al-waahid le l-aakhar.
Wa kulla l-biibaan wa l-chabaabiik wa hatabhum al-yirakkubuuhum foogah,chakilhum murabba'.Wa l-chabaabiik dool mulgaabiliin ambeenaathum ale talaata roog.
Wa Suleymaan sawwa baranda al-tuulha 50 duraa' wa urdaha 30 duraa' wa banaaha be amad.Wa bana khurfit al-madkhal wa sabbatha be amad wa sawwa baabha be giddaam.
Wa battaan bana baranda aakhara al-yukhuttu foogha kursi al-muluk wa da l-bakaan al-yisawwi foogah al-charii'a.Wa l-bakaan da,hu saddaah be khachab al-arz min tihit lahaddi foog.
Wa l-beet al-yaskun foogah,banooh fi fadaay aakhara wa hu bichaabih beet Khaabat Lubnaan.Wa le martah bineeyit Fir'oon malik Masir,Suleymaan bana beet al-hu kula bichaabih beet Khaabat Lubnaan.
Wa kulla l-buyuut dool wa l-daraadir wa l-fadaay al-kabiire min al-asaas lahaddi l-maraadiis,banoohum be hujaar samhiin wa magtuu'iin.Wa humman gata'oohum be munchaar be giddaam wa be wara.
Wa le l-asaas,asta'malo hujaar kubaar wa samhiin al-tuulhum ma sawa.Waahidiin 10 duraa' wa waahidiin 8 duraa'.
Wa fi raas al-asaas da,khatto hujaar samhiin magtuu'iin hasab al-magaas al-waajib wa hatab al-arz.
Wa l-fadaay al-kabiire,hawwagooha be durdur al-indah talaata roog hana hujaar magtuu'iin wa fi raashum,indah roog waahid hana hatab al-arz.Wa da misil al-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye wa khurfit al-madkhal hana beet Allah.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan rassal jaabah le Huuraam min balad Suur.
Wa Huuraam da,hu wileed hana mara armala wa hi min gabiilat Naftaali wa abuuh min balad Suur.Wa hu indah khibra wa fihim wa ma'rafa fi khidmit al-nahaas.Hu ja bakaan al-malik Suleymaan wa sawwa leyah kulla khidimtah.
Wa Huuraam sana' amad itneen hana nahaas wa tuul hana ayyi waahid 18 duraa' wa l-daayira hana ayyi waahid indaha 12 duraa'.
Wa sana' ruuse hana nahaas al-yukhuttuuhum foog fi l-amad dool wa ayyi waahid min al-ruuse dool tuulah 5 duraa'.
Wa jammal al-amad dool be salaasil hana nahaas madfuuriin wa khattaahum foog fi raas al-amad dool.Wa ayyi amuud indah sab'a salaasil.
Wa battaan sana' be nahaas roogeen hana rummaan wa allaghum fi l-salaasil wa sadda beehum raas al-amuud al-waahid.Wa sawwa nafs al-cheyy be l-amuud al-taani.
Wa le l-amad hana l-madkhal dool,sana' leehum ruuse aakhariin wa ayyi raas tuulah 4 duraa'.Wa l-ruuse dool bichaabuhu nuwwaar al-sitteeb.
Wa foog min ruuse al-amad,fiyah bakaan takhiin ziyaada.Wa l-bakaan da faayit al-salaasil al-mu'allagiin fooghum 200 rummaan al-muhawwigiin ruuse al-amad.
Wa Huuraam khatta al-amad dool giddaam khurfit al-madkhal hana beet Allah.Al-amuud al-waahid,khattaah be l-zeene wa sammaah Yaakiin (ma'anaatah Allah yisabbit).Wa l-amuud al-taani,khattaah be l-isra wa sammaah Bu'aaz (ma'anaatah al-gudra min Allah).
Wa l-ruuse hana l-amad dool bichaabuhu nuwwaar al-sitteeb.Wa be misil da,Huuraam kammal khidmit al-amad.
Wa Huuraam sana' hoot kabiir mudawwar hana nahaas.Wa khachmah yisaawi 10 duraa' min tarafah le tarafah.Wa tuulah foog yisaawi 5 duraa' wa daayirah kamaan 30 duraa'.
Wa jammal al-hoot be bukhas al-sana'aahum be nahaas.Fi ayyi duraa',sawwa 10 bukhas wa da,fi kulla daayira al-hoot.Wa l-bukhas dool sana'aahum ale roogeen.Wa humman wa l-hoot kulluhum ke sun'a waahide bas.
Wa l-hoot da khattooh fi 12 tiiraan hana nahaas.Wa l-tiiraan dool muwajjihiin ale l-arba'a jiihaat.Talaata muwajjihiin ale jiihat al-munchaakh wa talaata ale jiihat al-kharib wa talaata ale jiihat al-wati wa talaata ale jiihat al-sabaah.Wa duhuurhum daakhal tihit al-hoot.
Wa khachum al-hoot da tukhnah yisaawi arba'a usba' wa khachmah misil nuwwaar al-sitteeb.Wa l-hoot da yichiil 200 birmiil hana almi.
Wa Huuraam sana' achara hiitaan mutaharrikiin min nahaas wa ayyi waahid tuulah 4 duraa' wa urdah 4 duraa' wa tuulah foog kamaan 3 duraa'.
Wa daahu kikkeef sana' al-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin dool.Sana'aahum be safaayih hana nahaas al-bigi misil asaas wa khatta leehum hawaadir.
Wa sana' fi l-safaayih ambeen al-hawaadir dool suwar hana diidaan wa tiiraan wa makhluugiin samaawiyiin.Wa be foog wa be tihit le l-diidaan wa l-tiiraan,jammalaahum be zuhuur muddoodaliin.
Wa ayyi asaas indah arba'a ajalaat hana nahaas murakkabiin fi arba'a hawaadir hana nahaas al-musabbatiin fi l-arba'a arkaan hana l-asaas.Wa l-hawaadir ma'a l-asaas,kulluhum ke sun'a waahide bas wa l-ajalaat ma lihgo al-bakaan al-mujammal be zuhuur.
Wa fi raas ayyi asaas,fiyah fatha mudawwara tuulha foog duraa' wa urdaha duraa' wa nuss wa da l-bakaan al-yukhuttu foogah al-hoot.Wa khachum al-fatha al-mudawwara da,nagacho foogah suwar.Wa laakin safaayih al-asaas da murabba'iin ma mudawwariin.
Wa l-arba'a ajalaat dool gaa'idiin be tihit marbuutiin fi safaayih al-asaas wa l-hawaadir al-murabbatiin fooghum al-ajalaat maargiin jaay wa jaay le l-asaas wa tuul al-ajalaat foog duraa' wa nuss.
Wa l-ajalaat dool misil ajalaat hana arabaat al-harib.Al-hawaadir wa kulla cheyy al-fooghum,sana'aahum min nahaas.
Wa fi arba'a amad masnuu'iin fi l-arba'a arkaan wa kulluhum ke sun'a waahide ma'a l-asaas.
Wa l-bakaan al-foog hana ayyi asaas mujammal be taaj mudawwar tuulah nuss duraa'.Wa l-bakaan da,indah massaaka wa safaayih hana nahaas wa humman kulluhum ke sun'a waahide ma'a l-asaas.
Wa ayyi bakaan faadi fi l-massaaka wa l-safaayih,hu jammalaahum be suwar hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin wa diidaan wa chadar nakhal wa zuhuur fi kulla daayir al-asaas.
Wa be misil da,hu sawwa al-asaas dool be nahaas wa kulluhum induhum nafs al-sun'a wa nafs al-tuul wa nafs al-hajim.
Wa sawwa achara hiitaan hana nahaas.Wa ayyi hoot tuulah foog yisaawi 4 duraa' wa yichiil 4 birmiil almi.Wa ayyi hoot yukhuttuuh fi raas asaas waahid.
Wa l-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin al-khamsa khattaahum be nuss al-zeene hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa l-hiitaan al-khamsa al-aakhariin kamaan khattaahum be nuss al-isra.Wa laakin al-hoot al-kabiir kamaan khattaah be nuss al-zeene hana l-beet fi ruknah mugaabil wati sabaah.
Wa Huuraam sana' hiitaan wa feelaat wa kiisaan.Wa hu kammal kulla l-khidme hana beet Allah al-kallafah beeha al-malik Suleymaan.
Wa hu sana'al-amad al-itneenwa ruuseehum al-khattaahum fi raas al-amadwa l-silsilateen hana nahaas al-madfuuriin al-khattaahum fi ruuse al-amad dool
wa l-urbu'miya rummaan al-mu'allagiin roogeen fi l-silsilateen hana nahaas al-madfuuriin al-khattaahum fi ruuse al-amad dool
wa l-achara asaaswa l-achara hiitaan al-khattaahum fooghum
wa l-hoot al-kabiir al-wahiidwa l-atnaachar tiiraan al-tihtah
wa l-hiitaan wa l-feelaat wa l-kiisaan.Kulla l-mu'iddaat dool,Huuraam sana'aahum min nahaas nagi le beet Allah be amur al-malik Suleymaan.
Wa l-malik amar yasna'o kulla l-mu'iddaat dool fi gawaalib hana tiine fi turaab bahar al-Urdun ambeen Sukkuut wa Sartaan.
Wa Suleymaan sawwa mu'iddaat katiiriin marra waahid lahaddi naadum ma yagdar ya'arif wazin al-nahaas al-sawwoohum beyah.
Wa battaan kula Suleymaan sawwa mu'iddaat aakhariin le beet Allah.Wa hummanmukhbar al-bakhuur hana l-dahabwa l-tarabeeza hana l-dahab al-yigaddumu foogha al-khubza le Allah
wa l-achara faanuus min dahab saafi al-khattaahum giddaam al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid,al-khamsa be nuss al-zeene wa l-khamsa al-aakhariin be nuss al-israwa l-zuhuur wa l-tiyeesaat le l-naar wa l-kalaaliib kulluhum ke min dahab
wa l-mawaa'iin wa l-sakaakiin wa l-kiisaan wa l-sufar wa khammaamaat al-naar kulluhum ke min dahab saafiwa l-hadiid al-musabbit al-biibaan hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid wa l-hadiid al-musabbit al-biibaan hana beet Allah kulluhum ke min dahab.
Wa wakit kulla l-khidme hana beet Allah kammalat khalaas,al-malik Suleymaan jaab kulla cheyy al-abuuh Dawuud khassasah misil al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-mawaa'iin wa khattaahum fi l-makhaazin hana beet Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Suleymaan naada kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil wa kulla kubaaraat al-gabaayil wa kubaaraat al-aayilaat hana Bani Israa'iil yilimmu fi Uruchaliim.Wa da achaan yichiilu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah min madiinat Dawuud al-sammooha Sahyuun wa yiwadduuh beet Allah.
Wa kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil lammo wara l-malik Suleymaan fi l-chahar al-saabi' al-usmah Itaaniim wa da fi wakt al-iid.
Wakit kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil jo,rujaal al-diin chaalo al-sanduug.
Wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin chaalo sanduug Allah wa kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa kulla l-mu'iddaat al-mukhassasiin al-fi lubb al-kheema.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan wa kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil lammo wa wagafo giddaam al-sanduug.Wa gaddamo dahaaya hana khanam wa bagar katiir marra waahid lahaddi naadum ma yagdar yahsibhum wa la yalga adadhum.
Wa ba'ad da,rujaal al-diin jaabo sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wa dakhkhalooh fi lubb beet Allah fi l-bakaan al-khassasooh leyah fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid tihit janaahe hana l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.
Wa l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool mumattitiin janaaheehum be foog le l-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah al-sanduug.Wa be misil da,yikhattu al-sanduug wa l-iidaan al-yichiiluuh beehum.
Wa l-iidaan al-yichiiluuh beehum tuwaal.Wa khachum al-iidaan dool yinchaaf le l-naadum al-gaa'id ambeen al-sanduug wa l-madkhal hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid wa laakin naadum min barra ma yichiifah.Wa kulla l-achya dool gaa'idiin lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa l-sanduug da ma indah cheyy daakhal illa l-liihaan al-itneen hana l-hajar al-Muusa khattaahum fi lubbah wakit hu gaa'id fi jabal Huuriib.Wa da,wakit Allah sawwa mu'aahada ma'a Bani Israa'iil ba'ad marigiinhum min balad Masir.
Wa wakit rujaal al-diin marago min al-bakaan al-mukhaddas da,sahaabaay jaat saddat beet Allah.
Wa rujaal al-diin ma gidro yisawwu khidmithum be sabab al-sahaabaay di achaan majd Allah mala beet Allah.
Wa khalaas,Suleymaan gaal-:-Ya Allah-!Inta gult taskun fi l-dalaam.
Wa daahu ana baneet leek beet aziim al-taskun foogah.Wa da l-bakaan al-inta taskun foogah ila l-abad.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik wajjah le kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil al-waagfiin foog wa baarakaahum.
Wa gaal-:-Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-hajja le abuuyi Dawuud.Aywa,be iidah hu haggag kulla l-kalaam al-gaalah leyah.Hu gaal-:
--Min yoom al-ana maragt cha'abi Bani Israa'iil min balad Masir,ana ma azalt hille waahide min kulla hillaal gabaayil Bani Israa'iil le yabnu beet al-nukhutt foogah usmi.Wa laakin ana azalt Dawuud le yahkim fi cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.-
Wa Suleymaan gaal battaan-:-Dawuud abuuyi indah niiye le yabni beet le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa laakin Allah gaal le abuuyi Dawuud-:--Inta chilt niiye le tabni beet le usmi wa niiytak di adiile.
Wa da ma inta al-tabni leyi al-beet da laakin wileedak al-marag min sulbak,hu bas yabni al-beet da le usmi.--
Wa hassa',Allah haggag kalaamah al-gaalah.Ana baddalt abuuyi Dawuud wa ga'adt fi kursi al-muluk fi Bani Israa'iil misil Allah gaalah.Wa daahu ana baneet beet le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa addalt bakaan le l-sanduug al-indah al-liihaan al-fooghum al-mu'aahada al-sawwaaha Allah ma'a juduudna wakit hu maragaahum min balad Masir.
Wa Suleymaan wagaf giddaam madbah Allah wa gaabal kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil.Wa rafa' iideenah ale l-sama
wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,ma fi Ilaah mislak inta wa la foog fi l-sama wa la tihit fi l-ard.Inta tahfad mu'aahadatak wa kheerak le khaddaamiinak al-yitaabu'uuk be kulla guluubhum.
Wa l-yoom,inta hafadt le abdak Dawuud abuuyi mu'aahadatak wa be iidak,inta haggagt kulla kalaamak al-gultah leyah.
Wa hassa',ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,ahfad mu'aahadatak al-sawweetha ma'a abdak Dawuud abuuyi wakit gult leyah-:--Daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiytak giddaami fi kursi al-muluk hana Bani Israa'iil.Wa da illa kan zurriiytak tukuunu ma'aayi wa titaabi' derbi misil inta zaatak taaba'tah.--
Wa hassa',ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,min fadlak khalli kalaamak da yilhaggag misil inta gultah le abdak Dawuud abuuyi.
Wa hal sahiih ke al-Rabb yaskun fi l-ard walla-?Al-sama wa kulla l-samaawaat al-wasii'iin dool ma yagdaro yichiiluuk,ya Allah.Wa kikkeef al-beet al-sakhayyar al-ana baneetah yichiilak-?
Ya Allah Ilaahi,akhbal salaati wa du'aayi ana abdak.Asma' al-munaada wa l-sala al-niwajjihhum leek ana abdak al-yoom.
Wa fakkir fi l-beet da leel wa nahaar achaan da al-bakaan al-inta gult-:--Da bas al-bakaan al-nukhutt foogah usmi.- Asma' salaati ana abdak al-niwajjihha ale l-bakaan da.
Ya Allah,asma' du'aayi ana abdak wa du'a cha'abak Bani Israa'iil wakit yisallu ale l-bakaan da.Wa min al-sama,al-bakaan al-inta saakin foogah,asma'na wa akhfir leena zunuubna.
Wa kan yuluumu naadum wa yuguulu hu sawwa khata didd naadum aakhar wa yajburuuh le yahlif be haliife al-tijiib foogah al-la'ana,khalli al-naadum da yaji yahlif giddaam madbahak al-gaa'id fi lubb al-beet da.
Wa khalaas min al-sama,asma' wa ahkim ambeen abiidak.Aakhib al-fasil wa gabbil leyah fasaaltah fi raasah.Wa barri al-saalih wa ahkim leyah hasab adaaltah.
Wa akuun al-adu yinnasir fi cha'abak Bani Israa'iil be sabab humman aznabo diddak.Wa kan humman yi'tarufu be zunuubhum wa yimajjudu usmak wa yiwajjuhu leek salaawaathum wa yachhadook fi lubb al-beet da,
khalaas min al-sama asma' wa akhfir le cha'abak Bani Israa'iil zunuubhum wa gabbilhum fi l-ard al-inta anteetha le juduudhum.
Wa akuun al-sama yinsadda wa l-matar yabga ma fiih achaan cha'abak aznabo diddak.Wa kan humman yiwajjuhu leek ale l-bakaan da le yisallu wa yimajjudu usmak wa yi'tarufu be zunuubhum achaan inta ta''abtuhum,
khalaas min al-sama asma'hum wa akhfir le abiidak wa le cha'abak Bani Israa'iil zunuubhum.Wa wassif leehum al-derib al-adiil al-waajib yichiiluuh.Wa nazzil leehum matar fi l-ard al-inta anteetha warasa le cha'abak.
Wa akuun juu' walla waba yaji fi l-balad di wa l-ziraa'a yaybaso wa l-teeraab yi'affin wa saar al-leel wa l-jaraad yaju be katara.Wa l-adu yaji yihaasir al-mudun al-gawiyiin hana cha'abak hatta kan fooghum waba aw amraad kula.
Wa kan kulla cha'abak Bani Israa'iil irfo kadar al-waba da jaayi minhum humman zaathum,humman yachhadook wa yiwajjuhu ale beetak wa yarfa'o iideehum aleek le yas'alook,
