khalaas min al-sama,al-bakaan al-inta saakin foogah,asma' wa akhfir leehum zunuubhum wa ahkim wa sawwi foog ayyi waahid hasab amalah achaan inta ta'arif galbah.Wa inta bas al-ta'arif galib hana ayyi naadum.
Wa be misil da,Bani Israa'iil yakhaafo minnak fi kulla muddit hayaathum al-yi'iichuuha fi l-ard al-inta anteetha le juduudna.
Wa akuun ajnabi al-ma min cha'abak Bani Israa'iil yaji min balad ba'iide fi chaan usmak
achaan simi' yihajju be usmak al-majiid wa gudurtak al-aziime wa iidak al-mamduuda.Wa kan al-ajnabi da yaji yigaddim salaawaatah ale l-beet da,
khalaas min al-sama,al-bakaan al-inta saakin foogah,asma' wa akhbal kulla cheyy al-yatulbah minnak al-ajnabi.Wa be da,kulla chu'uub al-ard yi'tarufu be usmak wa yakhaafo minnak misil cha'abak Bani Israa'iil.Wa ya'arfu kadar usmak yinaaduuh fi l-beet al-ana baneetah leek da.
Wa akuun cha'abak yamurgu yamchu yihaarubu udwaanhum be l-derib al-inta tirassilhum foogah.Wa kan humman yisallu leek inta Allah wa yiwajjuhu ale l-madiina al-inta azaltaha wa ale l-beet al-ana baneetah le usmak,
khalaas min al-sama asma' salaawaathum wa du'aahum al-yiwajjuhuuhum leek wa daafi' le huguughum.
Wa akuun Bani Israa'iil yaznubu diddak,achaan ma fi naadum al-ma yisawwi zanib,wa inta takhdab leehum wa tisallimhum le udwaanhum wa humman yakurbuuhum masaajiin harib wa yiwadduuhum fi balad ba'iide aw gariibe.
Wa akuun min balad al-adu,al-bakaan al-humman gaa'idiin foogah masaajiin,yutuubu min zunuubhum wa yachhadook wa yuguulu-:--Aniina aznabna wa sawweena khata wa fasaala.--
Wa kan yi'tarufu be zunuubhum be kulla guluubhum wa be kulla fikirhum min balad udwaanhum,al-balad al-waddoohum foogha masaajiin,wa kan humman yisallu leek wa yiwajjuhu ale baladhum al-inta anteetha le juduudhum wa ale l-madiina al-inta azaltaha wa ale l-beet al-ana baneetah le usmak,
khalaas min al-sama,al-bakaan al-inta saakin foogah,asma' salaawaathum wa du'aahum wa daafi' le huguughum.
Akhfir le cha'abak al-aznabo diddak wa isook.Wa khalli yalgo rahma min al-naas al-karaboohum wa waddoohum masaajiin wa yihinnu fooghum
achaan Bani Israa'iil humman cha'abak al-misil warasatak min inta maragtuhum min balad Masir al-misil jahannam al-tagta' al-hadiid.
Wa asma' daayman du'a hanaayi ana abdak wa hana cha'abak Bani Israa'iil.Asma'na fi ayyi wakit al-nachhadook.
Ya Allah Rabbina,inta bas azaltina min usut kulla chu'uub al-ard le nabgo warasatak.Wa da misil inta gultah be waasitat abdak Muusa wakit maragt juduudna min balad Masir.
Wa wakit Suleymaan gaa'id yisalli wa yachhad Allah,kammal kulla salaatah wa du'aayah da le Allah,hu barak giddaam madbah Allah wa rafa' iideenah ale l-sama.Wa wakit kammal salaatah gamma
wa wagaf be tuulah wa baarak kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil be hiss aali wa gaal-:
Baarak Allah al-anta bakaan hana raaha le cha'abah Bani Israa'iil misil hu gaalah.Wa min kulla l-kalaam al-adiil al-hu gaalah be waasitat abdah Muusa,kilme waahide al-lissaa'ha ma alhaggagat ke ma fi.
Wa khalli Allah Ilaahna yukuun ma'aana misil kaan ma'a juduudna.Wa khalli ma yaabaana wa la yikhalliina.
Wa laakin khalli yiwajjih fikirna aleyah achaan nitaabu'u derbah wa nahfado wasiiyaatah wa gawaaniinah wa churuutah al-antaahum le juduudna.
Ya Allah,leel wa nahaar fakkir fi du'aayi al-wajjahtah leek achaan inta Allah Ilaahna tidaafi' daayman huguugi ana abdak wa huguug cha'abak Bani Israa'iil.
Wa be misil da,kulla chu'uub al-ard ya'arfu kadar Allah hu bas al-Ilaah wa ma fi ilaah illa hu.
Wa khalli guluubku yukuunu mukhlisiin le Allah Ilaahna misil hu yidoorah wa tahfado churuutah wa titabbugu gawaaniinah misil al-yoom.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Suleymaan wa kulla Bani Israa'iil al-ma'aayah gaddamo dahaaya le Allah.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan gaddam dahaaya katiiriin.Dahaaya al-salaama al-gaddamaahum le Allah humman 22-000 bagar wa 120-000 khanam.Wa be misil da,al-malik wa kulla Bani Israa'iil sawwo hafla wa fataho beet Allah.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom da,al-malik khassas ust al-fadaay al-gaa'ide giddaam beet Allah achaan yigaddim foogah al-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa hadaaya al-dagiig wa yiharrig foogah al-chaham hana dahaaya al-salaama.Wa da achaan al-madbah hana l-nahaas al-gaa'id fi beet Allah sakhayyar ma yichiil kulla l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa hadaaya al-dagiig wa l-chaham hana dahaaya al-salaama.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-malik Suleymaan ayyad iid ma'a kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa jamaa'a katiiriin jo min kulla l-balad,min hillit Labu Hamaat fi l-munchaakh lahaddi waadi Masir fi l-wati.Wa humman ayyado giddaam Allah al-Rabb 7 yoom wa battaan 7 yoom wa kulla ke yisaawi 14 yoom.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taamin hana l-subuu' al-taani,Suleymaan gaal le Bani Israa'iil khalli ayyi waahid yamchi beetah.Wa humman jo baarako le l-malik wa macho buyuuthum mabsuutiin wa farhaaniin achaan Allah sawwa al-kheer le abdah Dawuud wa le cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.
Wakit Suleymaan kammal buna hana beet Allah wa gasir al-malik wa kulla cheyy al-dawwar yisawwiih hasab niiytah,
Allah baan leyah battaan misil awwal baan leyah fi Gib'uun.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Ana khibilt salaatak wa du'aak al-wajjahtuhum leyi.Wa l-beet al-inta baneetah leyi da,ana khaddastah achaan khatteet foogah usmi ila l-abad.Wa niraakhibah wa nifakkir foogah daayman.
Wa inta,ya Suleymaan,kan tichiil derbi misil Dawuud abuuk chaalah be niiye mukhlisa wa l-takhwa wa kan tisawwi kulla cheyy al-ana amartak beyah wa tahfad gawaaniini wa churuuti,
khalaas ana daayman nisabbit mulkak fi Israa'iil misil gultah le Dawuud abuuk.Ana gult leyah-:--Daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiytak al-yamluk fi kursi Bani Israa'iil.--
Wa laakin kan inta wa zurriiyitku abeetu ma tahfado wasiiyaati wa la titabbugu gawaaniini al-ana amartuku beehum wa kan tamchu ta'abudu ilaahaat aakhariin wa tasjudu leehum,
khalaas ana natrudku,ya Bani Israa'iil,min al-ard al-ana anteetha leeku wa niba''id minni al-beet al-ana khaddastah le usmi.Wa be da,kulla l-chu'uub al-aakhariin yichchammato foogku wa yi'ayyuruuku.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yufuut jamb al-beet al-awwal aali da yil'ajjab wa yisaffir wa yuguul-:--Maala Allah sawwa misil da le l-balad di wa l-beet da-?--
Wa yuruddu wa yuguulu leyah-:--Achaan humman abo ma yitaabu'u Allah Ilaahhum al-marag juduudhum min balad Masir.Wa humman taaba'o leehum ilaahaat aakhariin wa sajado leehum wa abadoohum.Wa be sabab da bas,Allah nazzal fooghum kulla l-charr da.-
Wa fi muddit 20 sana,Suleymaan bana al-buyuut al-itneen ya'ni beet Allah wa gasir al-malik.
Wa Hiiraam malik Suur jaab le Suleymaan hatab al-arz wa hatab al-sarwi wa dahab be katara misil hu dawwarah.Wa Suleymaan antaah le Hiiraam 20 hille fi balad al-Jaliil.
Wa Hiiraam gamma min Suur wa macha le yichiif al-hillaal al-Suleymaan antaahum leyah.Wa laakin al-hillaal dool ma ajabooh le Hiiraam.
Wa hu gaal-:-Ya akhuuyi,dool bas al-hillaal al-anteethum leyi walla-? Wa hu sammaahum balad Kaabuul (ma'anaatah ma yanfa').Wa l-usum da gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa laakin gabul da,Hiiraam rassal gariib 4-000 kiilo hana dahab le Suleymaan.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-bukhuss al-khidme al-ijbaariiye al-asaasha al-malik Suleymaan fi wakit buna beet Allah wa gasir al-malik wa durdur al-difaa' al-sammooh Millu wa daraadir hana Madiinat al-Khuduswa hillaal Haasuur wa Magiddu wa Gaazar.
Wa Fir'oon malik Masir macha hajam hillit Gaazar chaalha wa tachchaaha.Wa ba'ad katal al-Kan'aaniyiin al-saakniin fi l-hille di,hu anta al-hille di hadiiye le bittah marit Suleymaan.
Wa be misil da,Suleymaan banaaha battaan le hillit Gaazar.Wa bana kula hillaal Beet Huruun al-tihit
wa Ba'alat wa Tadmuur fi l-kadaade hana l-balad.
Wa bana kulla l-hillaal al-yakhzin fooghum wa l-hillaal al-yukhutt fooghum arabaatah hana l-harib wa kheelah.Wa Suleymaan bana kulla cheyy al-yidoorah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi jibaal Lubnaan wa fi kulla mamlakatah al-hu gaa'id yahkim foogha.
Wa fi l-balad,yifaddil naas min al-Amuuriyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.Wa kulla l-naas dool,humman ma min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Bani Israa'iil ma gidro dammaroohum kulluhum wa fi chaan da,waahidiin min zurriiyithum faddalo fi l-balad.Wa humman dool,Suleymaan asta'malhum misil abiid fi l-khidme al-ijbaariiye lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Suleymaan ma anta khidmit al-ubuudiiye di le naadum waahid min Bani Israa'iil.Wa laakin hu sawwaahum askarah wa masaa'iilah wa khuyyaadah wa kubaaraat arabaatah hana l-harib wa siyaad kheelah.
Wa daahu adad kubaaraat al-hukkaam al-yiraakhubu fi khidmit Suleymaan.Humman 550 rujaal al-yiraakhubu fi l-khaddaamiin al-yisawwu al-khidme di.
Wa bineeyit Fir'oon hawwalat min madiinat Dawuud wa machat fi l-beet al-Suleymaan bana leeha.Wa ba'ad da kamaan,Suleymaan bana durdur al-difaa' al-sammooh Millu.
Wa talaata marraat fi l-sana,Suleymaan yigaddim dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama fi l-madbah al-bana le Allah wa yiharrig al-bakhuur al-halu giddaam Allah.Wa be misil da,asta'malo al-beet misil waajib leyah.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan addal sufun wa khattaahum fi hillit Asyuun Giibar gariib le hillit Ilaat.Wa l-bakaan da fi khachum al-bahar al-Ahmar hana balad Adoom.
Wa Hiiraam malik Suur rassal leyah khaddaamiinah al-ya'arfu al-bahar adiil wa l-sufun kula.Wa l-khaddaamiin dool saafaro sawa ma'a khaddaamiin Suleymaan
wa macho le balad Ufiir.Wa jaabo min hinaak dahab ziyaada min 14-000 kiilo le l-malik Suleymaan.
Wa malikat balad Saba sim'at be l-kalaam al-gaa'idiin yihajjuuh fi Suleymaan wa fi l-cheyy al-sawwaah leyah Allah.Wa hi jaat le tijarribah be gaddimiin su'aalaat gaasiyiin.
Wa l-malika wassalat fi Madiinat al-Khudus be naas katiiriin wa jumaal chaayliin itir wa dahab katiir wa hujaar khaaliyiin.Wa wakit wassalat bakaan Suleymaan,hi hajjat leyah be kulla cheyy al-indaha fi galibha.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan radda leeha fi kulla l-su'aalaat al-gaddamathum leyah.Wa ma fi su'aal waahid al-bigi leyah gaasi al-ma gidir radda foogah.
Wa malikat balad Saba chaafat hikmat Suleymaan wa l-gasir al-hu banaah
wa l-akil al-fi raas tarabeeztah wa l-maskan hana masaa'iilah wa nizaam khidmithum wa l-lubaas hana l-naas al-yantu al-akil wa l-charaab wa l-dahaaya al-gaa'idiin yigaddumuuhum fi beet Allah.Wa hi al'ajjabat bilheen wa ma gidrat tuguul cheyy.
Wa khalaas,gaalat le l-malik-:-Al-cheyy al-simi'tah min baladi al-bukhuss kalaamak wa hikmatak da sahiih.
Wa ana ma saddagt be l-kalaam al-gaalooh foogak illa ba'ad jiit wa chiftah be eeni.Wa daahu nuss hikmatak kula ma khabbarooni beyah-!Hikmatak wa kheerak ziyaada min kulla cheyy al-ana simi'tah.
Mabruuk le naasak wa le masaa'iilak al-daayman gaa'idiin ma'aak wa yasma'o hikmatak.
Baarak Allah Ilaahak al-ridi beek wa khattaak fi kursi al-muluk le tamluk fi Bani Israa'iil achaan Allah gaa'id yihibb Bani Israa'iil ila l-abad.Wa fi chaan da bas,hu khattaak malik fooghum le tahkim be l-hagg wa l-adaala.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malika hana balad Saba antat le l-malik ziyaada min 4-000 kiilo hana dahab wa itir katiir wa hujaar khaaliyiin kula.Wa abadan ma fi itir ziyaada min al-itir al-jaabatah al-malika hana Saba le l-malik Suleymaan.
Wa l-sufun hana malik Hiiraam al-gaa'idiin yijiibu dahab min Ufiir jaabo hatab al-sandal be katara wa hujaar khaaliyiin kula.
Wa be hatab al-sandal da,al-malik sawwa maraadiis le beet Allah wa le gasrah hu kula.Wa sawwa beyah jigindiiye wa amsibeybe le l-khannaayiin.Wa min al-wakit daak lahaddi l-yoom da,ma chaafo hatab al-sandal katiir misil da.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan antaaha le malikat balad Saba kulla cheyy al-dawwaratah wa talabatah minnah.Wa ziyaada min da,al-malik Suleymaan antaaha hadaaya be juud wa karam.Wa ba'ad da,al-malika gabbalat baladha ma'a masaa'iilha.
Wa wazin al-dahab al-yijiibuuh le Suleymaan fi kulli sana yisaawi ziyaada min 22-000 kiilo.
Wa da bala l-maal al-yalgaah min al-daraayib al-yichiilah min al-tujjaar wa l-miiri al-yalgaah min muluuk al-Arab wa hukkaam al-balad.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan dagga 200 darag kubaar hana dahab wa ayyi waahide wazinha yisaawi 850 jineeh.
Wa dagga battaan 300 darag dugaag wa ayyi waahide wazinha yisaawi 200 jineeh hana dahab.Wa l-malik khattaahum fi beetah al-sammooh Khaabat Lubnaan.
Wa l-malik sana' kursi kabiir hana aaj wa masahah be dahab saafi.
Wa l-kursi da indah sitte ataba al-yatla'o beehum.Wa be wara fi l-bakaan al-yintaku foogah mudawwar wa l-kursi da sawwo leyah iideen be jaay wa jaay.Wa sana'o timsaal hana diidaan itneen wa khattoohum be nuss al-zeene wa l-isra le l-kursi.
Wa 12 diidaan aakhariin waagfiin be jaay wa jaay le l-atabaat al-sitte dool.Wa abadan ma sawwo cheyy misil da fi ayyi mamlaka.
Wa kulla l-kiisaan al-yachrab beehum al-malik Suleymaan humman hana dahab wa kulla l-mu'iddaat al-fi beet Khaabat Lubnaan sawwoohum min dahab saafi.Wa cheyy al-sawwooh be fudda ke ma fiih achaan fi wakit Suleymaan,al-fudda ma indaha khiima.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan indah sufun kubaar hana l-tijaara al-yamchu ma'a sufun hana l-malik Hiiraam.Wa fi ayyi talaata sana,al-sufun dool yigabbulu machhuuniin be dahab wa fudda wa aaj wa tuguula wa taawuus.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan faat kulla muluuk al-ard be maal wa hikma.
Wa kulla l-naas al-ard yidooru yigaabulu Suleymaan achaan yasma'o min hikmatah al-antaaha leyah al-Rabb fi galbah.
Wa ayyi sana,al-naas dool yijiibu leyah hadaaya.Yijiibu leyah mu'iddaat hana fudda wa dahab wa khulgaan wa silaah wa itir wa kheel wa bikhaal.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan lamma arabaat hana harib wa siyaad kheel.Hu indah 1-400 arabaat harib wa 12-000 siyaad kheel.Wa hu wadda waahidiin minhum fi l-hillaal al-yukhutt fooghum arabaatah wa waahidiin kamaan khallaahum ma'aayah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-malik jaab fi Madiinat al-Khudus fudda katiire ziyaada misil al-hashas.Wa hatab al-arz kula bigi katiir ziyaada misil chadar al-jimmeez al-yugumm fi sahalat Chafiila.
Wa kheel al-malik Suleymaan,gaa'idiin yijiibuuhum leyah min Masir wa min Kuwi.Wa da tujjaar al-malik bas yamchu wa yachruuhum leyah min hinaak.
Wa ayyi araba al-yijiibuuha min Masir tamanha 600 hajar fudda wa ayyi juwaad tamanah 150 hajar fudda.Wa be nafs al-taman da bas,al-tujjaar gaa'idiin yijiibu arabaat wa kheel le muluuk al-Hittiyiin wa le muluuk balad Araam kula.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan habba awiin katiiraat ajnabiiyaat bala bineeyit Fir'oon.Hu habba awiin min balad Muwaab wa Ammuun wa Adoom wa Seeda wa min balad al-Hittiyiin.
Wa l-awiin deel min al-umam al-Allah gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Angar'u ma taakhudu min al-umam dool wa humman kula ma yaakhudu minku achaan yamurguuku min al-derib wa ta'abudu ilaahaathum. Wa laakin al-malik Suleymaan habba awiin min al-umam dool wa anrabat ma'aahum.
Wa hu akhad 700 awiin mayaarim wa chaal 300 sirriiyaat kula.Wa l-awiin deel maragannah min al-derib.
Wa wakit Suleymaan chayyab marra waahid,al-awiin deel maragannah min al-derib wa hu abad ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa be sabab da,hu ma abad Allah Ilaahah be galib mukhlis misil abuuh Dawuud.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan abad Achtaruut ilaahat naas balad Seeda wa Milkuum al-sanam al-muharram hana Bani Ammuun.
Wa Suleymaan sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah wa hu ma taaba' Allah misil abuuh Dawuud.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Suleymaan addal bakaan aali fi raas al-jabal al-mugaabil Madiinat al-Khudus le Kamuuch al-sanam al-muharram hana naas Muwaab wa le Muulak al-sanam al-muharram hana Bani Ammuun.
Wa hu sawwa misil da le ilaahaat hana kulla awiinah al-ajnabiiyaat.Wa hinna yiharrigan bakhuur wa yigaddiman dahaaya muharragiin le ilaahaathin.
Wa Allah khidib didd Suleymaan achaan hu aba ma taaba' al-derib hana Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-baan leyah marrateen.
Wa amarah ma yitaabi' ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa laakin Suleymaan ma tabbag amur Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah gaal le Suleymaan-:-Inta ma hafadt mu'aahadati wa churuuti al-ana amartak beehum.Khalaas,ana nagla' minnak mulkak wa nanti le waahid min khaddaamiinak.
Wa ana ma nagla'ah fi hayaatak fi chaan abuuk Dawuud.Laakin nagla' al-muluk da min iid wileedak.
Wa ana ma nagla' kulla l-mamlaka di min wileedak.Laakin nikhalliih yahkim fi gabiila waahide bas.Wa da fi chaan Dawuud abdi wa fi chaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-madiina al-ana azaltaha.
Wa khalaas,Allah gawwam adu le Suleymaan.Wa hu Haddaad al-Adoomi min zurriiyit malik al-Adoomiyiin.
Zamaan,Dawuud haarab mamlakat Adoom.Wa wakit Yuwaab khaayid deechah macha dafan kulla janaazaat al-naas al-maato fi l-harib,hu katal kulla naas balad Adoom al-dukuura.
Wa Yuwaab wa kulla Bani Israa'iil ga'ado hinaak sitte chahar lahaddi kammalo kulla l-dukuura min balad Adoom.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Haddaad lissaa' sabi.Wa hu arrad macha Masir ma'a waahidiin min naas balad Adoom min khaddaamiin abuuh.
Wa humman gammo min Midyaan wa macho Faaraan wa chaalo ma'aahum naas min Faaraan.Wa ba'ad da,macho Masir bakaan Fir'oon malik Masir.Wa hu antaah le Haddaad beet wa ma'aach wa ard.
Wa Haddaad ligi rida min Fir'oon wa jawwazah hamaatah akhut martah Tahfaniis al-meeram.
Wa akhut Tahfaniis wildat wa jaabat wileed le Haddaad wa sammaah Ganuubat.Wa Tahfaniis faradatah wa chaalatah fi beet Fir'oon wa Ganuubat kibir hinaak ma'a awlaad Fir'oon.
Wa wakit Haddaad fi Masir simi' kadar Dawuud maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa Yuwaab khaayid al-deech kula maat,khalaas Haddaad gaal le Fir'oon-:-Khalliini namchi baladi.
Wa Fir'oon gaal leyah-:-Min inta gaa'id ma'aayi da,chunu gassar leek-?Maala tidoor tamchi baladak-? Wa Haddaad radda leyah wa gaal-:-Cheyy ma gassar leyi laakin khalliini namchi bas.
Wa l-Rabb gawwam adu aakhar le Suleymaan,usmah Rizuun wileed Aliyaada' al-arrad min beet siidah Hadad'aazar malik Suuba.
Wa Rizuun lamma majmuu'a hana rujaal haraamiyiin wa bigi kabiirhum.Wa wakit Dawuud gamma katal naas Hadad'aazar,Rizuun wa naasah macho madiinat Dimachkh wa ga'ado hinaak wa hakamo foogha.
Wa Rizuun bigi adu le Bani Israa'iil fi kulla muddit hayaat Suleymaan.Wa hu kirih Bani Israa'iil ziyaada min al-fasaala al-sawwaah Haddaad.Wa Rizuun hakam fi balad Araam.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid usmah Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat min gabiilat Afraayim wa hu min hillit Sariida.Wa ammah usumha Saruu'a wa hi armala.Wa Yaruba'aam da hu awwal waahid min khaddaamiin Suleymaan wa ba'adeen,gamma atmarrad diddah.
Wa daahu al-sabab al-gawwam Yaruba'aam le yitmarrad.Da fi wakit al-Suleymaan gaa'id yabni durdur al-difaa' al-sammooh Millu wa yikaddik al-khurma al-fi durdur madiinat Dawuud abuuh.
Wa Yaruba'aam da hu raajil faaris.Wa Suleymaan chaaf al-sabi da wakit gaa'id yakhdim wa hu kallafah le yiraakhib al-khidme al-ijbaariiye hana zurriiyit Yuusuf.
Wa yoom waahid,Yaruba'aam marag min Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi l-derib lamma ma'a l-nabi Akhiiya hana hillit Chiilooh.Wa Akhiiya da laabis jard jadiid wa humman lammo itneen bas fi l-kadaade.
Wa Akhiiya chaal al-jard al-jadiid al-laabsah da wa charratah atnaachar git'e.
Wa gaal le Yaruba'aam-:-Chiil al-achara git'e dool le nafsak achaan daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Ana nagla' al-muluk min iid Suleymaan wa nantiik inta al-achara gabaayil dool.
Wa gabiila waahide bas tifaddil leyah wa da fi chaan abdi Dawuud wa fi chaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-ana azaltaha min kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa nisawwi misil da achaan humman abooni wa sajado le Achtaruut ilaahat naas balad Seeda wa le Kamuuch sanam naas balad Muwaab wa le Milkuum sanam Bani Ammuun.Wa humman ma taaba'o derbi wa la sawwo al-adiil giddaami wa la tabbago churuuti wa gawaaniini misil Dawuud abu Suleymaan.
Wa abdi Dawuud al-ana azaltah,hu hafad wasiiyaati wa churuuti.Wa be sabab da,ana ma nagla' al-muluk min iid Suleymaan.Nikhalli yamluk fi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Laakin ana nagla' al-muluk min iid wileed Suleymaan wa l-achara gabaayil dool nantiihum leek inta.
Wa ana nikhalli gabiila waahide le wileed Suleymaan fi chaan abdi Dawuud.Waajib daayman yukuun naadum waahid min zurriiytah fi l-muluk fi Madiinat al-Khudus al-ana azaltaha le nukhutt foogha usmi.
--Wa kan leek inta kamaan,ana bas azaltak wa tagdar tamluk misil galbak yidoorah.Wa tabga malik fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa kan inta tasma' kulla cheyy al-amartak wa titaabi' derbi adiil wa tisawwi al-adiil giddaami wa titabbig churuuti wa wasiiyaati misil Dawuud abdi tabbagaahum,ana nukuun ma'aak wa nisabbit mulkak misil sabbatt muluk Dawuud.Wa nantiik al-achara gabaayil hana Bani Israa'iil.
Wa be misil da,ana nijiib al-ihaana fi zurriiyit Dawuud wa laakin al-ihaana di ma tagood fooghum daayman.-
Wa ba'ad da,Suleymaan fattachah le Yaruba'aam achaan yaktulah.Wa laakin Yaruba'aam arrad macha bakaan Chiichakh malik Masir wa hu ga'ad hinaak lahaddi Suleymaan maat.
Wa l-baagi min amal Suleymaan wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa hikmatah maktuubiin fi kitaab a'maal Suleymaan.
Wa Suleymaan hakam fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi kulla balad Israa'iil muddit 40 sana.
Wa ba'ad da,Suleymaan maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud abuuh.Wa wileedah Rahab'aam hakam fi badalah.
Wa Rahab'aam gamma macha hillit Chakiim achaan kulla Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yarjooh hinaak le yidarrujuuh malik.
Wa wakit Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat simi' al-khabar da,hu lissaa' gaa'id fi Masir.Achaan awwal hu arrad min al-malik Suleymaan wa macha Masir wa sakan hinaak.
Wa rassalo naadooh le Yaruba'aam wa hu ja.Wa hu ma'a kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil gammo hajjo le Rahab'aam wa gaalo leyah-:
Abuuk sawwaana misil abiid wa khatta foogna khidme gaasiye misil daami tagiil fi ragabatna.Wa hassa',nidooru minnak inta tikhaffif leena tagalat al-daami al-abuuk khattaah foogna wa aniina nakhdumu tihtak.
Wa Rahab'aam gaal leehum-:-Gabbulu wa ba'ad talaata yoom ta'aalu leyi. Wa khalaas,al-cha'ab gabbalo buyuuthum.
Wa l-malik Rahab'aam chaawar al-chuyuukh al-awwal gaa'idiin ma'a abuuh Suleymaan wakit hu hayy.Wa gaal leehum-:-Chunu wasiiyitku leyi fi kalaam al-cha'ab da-?
Wa l-chuyuukh raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Kan al-yoom inta takhdim le l-cha'ab wa tisawwi leehum al-kheer wa turudd leehum be kalaam halu,khalaas humman yakhdumu daayman tihtak.
Wa laakin Rahab'aam aba wasiiyat al-chuyuukh al-antooha leyah.Wa hu chaawar wasiiyat al-subyaan al-kibro ma'aayah sawa wa gaa'idiin yakhdumu leyah.
Wa hu sa'alaahum le l-subyaan dool wa gaal-:-Chunu wasiiyitku fi l-cha'ab al-bidooru nikhaffif leehum tagalat al-daami al-abuuyi khattaah fooghum-?
Wa l-subyaan al-kibro ma'aayah gaalo-:-Daahu al-kalaam al-tuguulah le l-cha'ab al-yachku kadar abuuk khatta fooghum daami tagiil wa yidooru inta tikhaffifah leehum.Wa daahu al-kalaam al-tuguulah leehum-:--Usba'i al-sakhayyar da kabiir min sulub abuuyi.
Sahiih,abuuyi khatta foogku daami tagiil wa hassa' da,ana niziid foogku tagala aakhara-!Abuuyi jaladaaku be soot hana farwa wa laakin ana najlidku be soot al-indah hadiid misil danab al-agrab.-
Wa ba'ad talaata yoom,Yaruba'aam wa kulla l-cha'ab gabbalo jo le Rahab'aam misil hu gaalah leehum-:-Gabbulu wa ba'ad talaata yoom,ta'aalu leyi.
Wa l-malik Rahab'aam aba wasiiyat al-chuyuukh al-antooha leyah wa hajja le l-cha'ab be kalaam gawi.
Wa radda leehum hasab wasiiyat al-subyaan wa gaal leehum-:-Abuuyi khatta foogku daami tagiil wa hassa' ana niziid foogku tagala aakhara.Abuuyi jaladaaku be soot hana farwa laakin ana najlidku be soot al-indah hadiid misil danab al-agrab.
Wa l-malik ma simi' kalaam al-cha'ab.Wa da jaayi min Allah,achaan Allah dawwar yihaggig kalaamah al-gaalah le Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat be waasitat al-nabi Akhiiya al-min hillit Chiilooh.
Wa wakit kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil chaafo kadar al-malik ma simi' kalaamhum da,gaalo leyah-:-Chunu al-yilimmina ma'a zurriiyit Dawuud-?Aniina ma indina warasa ma'a iyaal Yassa-!Yalla,ya gabaayil Israa'iil,khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah-!Wa hassa' da,ya zurriiyit Dawuud,himmu be nufuusku. Wa Bani Israa'iil chatto wa gabbalo buyuuthum.
Wa be da,Rahab'aam gaa'id yahkim fi gabaayil Israa'iil al-saakniin fi hillaal balad Yahuuza bas.
Wa l-malik Rahab'aam rassal Aduraam muraakhib hana l-khidme al-ijbaariiye le gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-saakniin fi munchaakh al-balad.Laakin kulluhum lammo foogah wa rajamooh wa maat.Wa l-malik Rahab'aam zaatah yalla yalla rikib fi arabatah wa arrad macha Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa be misil da,gabaayil Israa'iil al-saakniin fi l-munchaakh atmarrado didd zurriiyit Dawuud lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil sim'o kadar Yaruba'aam gabbal min Masir,naadooh giddaam al-mujtama' wa darrajooh malik fi waahidiin min gabaayil Israa'iil.Wa illa gabiilat Yahuuza wiheedha bas taaba'at zurriiyit Dawuud.
Wa wakit Rahab'aam wassal Madiinat al-Khudus,lamma kulla gabiilat Yahuuza wa gabiilat Banyaamiin wa azal minhum 180-000 rujaal muhaaribiin le yamchu yihaarubu gabaayil Israa'iil fi l-munchaakh wa yigabbulu al-muluk battaan le Rahab'aam wileed Suleymaan.
Wa laakin al-Rabb hajja le l-nabi Chama'ya wa gaal leyah-:
Hajji le Rahab'aam wileed Suleymaan malik Bani Yahuuza wa le kulla gabiilat Yahuuza wa gabiilat Banyaamiin wa le kulla l-cha'ab al-aakhariin wa guul leehum-:
--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ma tamchu tihaarubu akhwaanku gabaayil Israa'iil.Khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah achaan ana bas assast al-barjala di."-- Wa be da,khalaas humman sim'o kalaam Allah wa gabbalo buyuuthum hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa Yaruba'aam bana hillit Chakiim fi jibaal Afraayim wa sakan hinaak.Wa ba'ad da,macha bana hillit Fanuwiil.
Wa Yaruba'aam gaal fi nafsah-:-Fi l-haala di,mumkin al-muluk da yigabbil le zurriiyit Dawuud.
Kan al-cha'ab yamchu daayman yigaddumu dahaaya fi beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus,yoom waahid guluubhum yigabbulu wa yitaabu'u siidhum Rahab'aam malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa ana da yaktuluuni wa yigabbulu le Rahab'aam malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa khalaas,al-malik Yaruba'aam ligi fikra wa sana' ajjaal itneen hana dahab wa gaal le l-cha'ab-:-Intu macheetu iddat marraat fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hassa' da,ya Bani Israa'iil,dool bas ilaahaatku al-maragooku min balad Masir.
Wa khatta al-asnaam dool waahid fi hillit Beet Iil wa l-aakhar fi hillit Daan.
Wa lazza al-cha'ab fi l-zanib.Humman macho ma'a l-sanam al-waahid da lahaddi hillit Daan.
Wa Yaruba'aam bana bakaanaat aaliyiin hana ibaada.Wa min al-cha'ab,hu darraj rujaal diin al-ma min gabiilat Laawi.
Wa Yaruba'aam assas iid fi yoom 15 hana l-chahar al-taamin misil al-iid al-gaa'idiin yi'ayyuduuh fi mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa l-malik zaatah macha wa gaddam dahaaya fi l-madbah.Wa fi Beet Iil kula,hu gaddam dahaaya le l-ajjaal al-sana'aahum.Wa fi Beet Iil,khatta rujaal diin fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin al-banaahum le l-ibaada.
Wa da fi yoom 15 hana l-chahar al-taamin,al-yoom al-hu bas gata'ah,hu macha Beet Iil fi bakaan al-madbah al-banaah.Wa assas iid le Bani Israa'iil wa hu zaatah gaddam dahaaya fi l-madbah da.
Wa daahu nabi Allah waahid gamma min balad Yahuuza be amur Allah wa ja fi Beet Iil.Wa da fi wakit al-Yaruba'aam gaa'id yiharrig al-bakhuur fi l-madbah al-hu banaah.
Wa l-nabi da hajja be hiss aali didd al-madbah hasab kalaam Allah wa gaal-:-Ya l-madbah-!Ya l-madbah-!Daahu Allah gaal-:--Daahu yaldo wileed le zurriiyit Dawuud wa yisammuuh Yuuchiiya.Wa rujaal al-diin hana l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin al-yiharrugu foogak al-bakhuur,hu yigaddimhum foogak dahaaya.Wa yiharrugu foogak udaam al-naas kula.-
Wa fi nafs al-yoom da,al-nabi anta alaama wa gaal-:-Di hi al-alaama al-tiwassif kadar kalaam Allah yihaggig.Al-madbah da yinchagga wa l-rumaad al-fi lubbah yidaffig.
Wa wakit al-malik Yaruba'aam simi' kalaam nabi Allah al-gaalah didd al-madbah hana Beet Iil da,hu madda iidah min al-madbah wa gaal be hiss aali-:-Akurbu al-raajil da-! Wa fi l-bakaan da,iidah al-maddaaha ale l-nabi di yibsat wa ma yagdar yijiibha aleyah.
Wa tawwaali,al-madbah anchagga wa l-rumaad al-fi lubbah daffag.Wa da bigi misil al-alaama al-kallam beeha al-nabi al-tiwassif kadar kalaam Allah yihaggig.
Wa l-malik gaal le l-nabi-:-Min fadlak,achhad Allah Ilaahak wa as'alah leyi achaan nagdar nijiib iidi aleyi. Wa l-nabi chahad Allah wa l-malik gidir jaab iidah aleyah wa hi bigat misil awwal.
Wa l-malik gaal le l-nabi-:-Ta'aal namchu al-beet taakul wa tachrab wa ana nantiik hadiiye.
Wa l-nabi radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Kan inta tantiini nuss beetak kula,ana ma namchi ma'aak.Wa ana wa la naakul akil wa la nachrab almi fi l-bakaan da
achaan da bas Allah amaraani wa gaal-:--Wa la taakul akil wa la tachrab almi wa la tigabbil be nafs al-derib al-macheet beyah.-
Wa khalaas,al-nabi gabbal be derib aakhar ma be l-derib al-awwal macha beyah Beet Iil.
Wa fiyah nabi waahid chaayib saakin fi Beet Iil.Wa iyaalah jo wa hajjo leyah be l-amal al-sawwaah nabi Allah fi l-yoom da fi Beet Iil.Wa hajjo le abuuhum be l-kalaam al-gaalah le l-malik.
Wa abuuhum gaal leehum-:-Be l-derib al-weenu al-nabi da faat-? Wa iyaalah wassafooh al-derib al-gabbal beyah al-nabi al-ja min balad Yahuuza.
Wa khalaas,gaal le iyaalah-:-Chiddu leyi al-humaar. Wa humman chaddooh leyah wa hu rikib foogah.
Wa l-chaayib chaal derib al-nabi wa ligaah gaa'id fi ga'ar chadara kabiire.Wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta bas al-nabi al-ja min balad Yahuuza walla-? Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa,ana bas.
Wa l-chaayib gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal ma'aayi fi l-beet wa aakul leek akil.
Wa l-nabi radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana wa la nagdar nigabbil wa la nagdar namchi ma'aak fi beetak wa la naakul akil wa la nachrab almi ma'aak fi l-bakaan da.
Wa da achaan Allah amaraani wa gaal leyi-:--Wa la taakul akil wa la tachrab almi fi l-bakaan da wa la tigabbil be nafs al-derib al-macheet beyah.-
Wa l-chaayib gaal leyah-:-Ana kula nabi mislak.Wa malak waahid kallam leyi be kalaam min Allah wa gaal-:--Amchi gabbil al-nabi da fi beetak wa khalli yaakul akil wa yachrab almi.-- Wa laakin al-chaayib gaa'id yakdib leyah.
Wa khalaas,al-nabi gabbal ma'aayah fi beetah wa akal akil wa chirib almi.
Wa wakit humman al-itneen gaa'idiin yaakulu,Allah hajja le l-nabi al-chaayib al-gabbal al-nabi al-ja min balad Yahuuza.
Wa l-nabi al-chaayib hajja be hiss foog le l-nabi al-ja min balad Yahuuza wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Inta isiit kalaami wa ma hafadt al-amur al-amartak beyah ana Allah Ilaahak.
Wa gabbalt akalt akil wa chiribt almi fi l-bakaan al-ana gult leek-:"Ma taakul akil wa ma tachrab almi."Wa be sabab da,ma yadfunu janaaztak fi khabur juduudak.-
Wa ba'ad akal akil wa chirib almi,al-nabi al-chaayib chadda humaar al-nabi al-hu gabbalah.
Wa khalaas,al-nabi da rikib wa faat.Wa wakit maachi fi l-derib,duud waahid marag wa katalah.Wa janaaztah waag'e fi l-derib wa l-humaar waagif jambaha be nussaha al-waahid wa l-duud kula waagif jambaha be nussah al-aakhar.
Wa naas waahidiin faaytiin be l-derib da chaafo janaaza waag'e fi l-derib wa l-duud waagif jambaha.Wa humman macho wa hajjo beeha fi l-hille al-saakin foogha al-nabi al-chaayib.
Wa wakit al-nabi al-chaayib al-gabbalah simi' be l-khabar da,hu gaal-:-Da nabi Allah,da l-nabi al-isi amur Allah.Wa Allah sallamah le l-duud darabah wa katalah wa da bigi hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah leyah.
Wa khalaas,al-nabi al-chaayib gaal le iyaalah-:-Chiddu leyi al-humaar. Wa humman chaddooh leyah.
Wa hu macha ligi al-janaaza waag'e fi l-derib wa l-humaar wa l-duud waagfiin jamb al-janaaza.Wa l-duud ma akal al-janaaza wa ma darab al-humaar.
Wa l-nabi al-chaayib rafa' janaazit nabi Allah wa khattaaha fi l-humaar wa gabbal beeha.Wa l-nabi al-chaayib ja fi l-hille le yadfinah wa yisawwi leyah furaach.
Wa hu dafan al-janaaza fi khabur hana juduudah halaalah wa hizin leyah wa gaal-:-Ya khasaaritna-!Ya akhuuyi.
Wa ba'ad dafanah,al-chaayib gaal le iyaalah-:-Kan ana mutt,adfunuuni fi khabur juduudi ma'a l-nabi da.Wa khuttu udaami jamb udaamah.
Achaan al-kalaam al-gaalah Allah didd al-madbah hana Beet Iil wa didd kulla buyuut al-ibaada fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin fi hillaal al-Saamira,akiid yilhaggag.
Wa ba'ad kulla cheyy al-kaan da,Yaruba'aam ma khalla derbah al-fasil al-maachi foogah da.Wa min al-cha'ab hu darraj rujaal diin le l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin.Wa ayyi naadum al-yidoor yabga raajil diin,hu yidarrijah raajil diin fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin.
Wa da bas sabab zanib aayilat Yaruba'aam.Wa achaan da bas,aayiltah addammarat wa waddarat min wijh al-ard.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Abiiya wileed Yaruba'aam mirid.
Wa Yaruba'aam gaal le martah-:-Gummi wa khayyiri khulgaanki achaan al-naas ma ya'arfuuki kadar inti marti ana Yaruba'aam.Wa ba'ad da,amchi hillit Chiilooh wa hinaak talge al-nabi Akhiiya.Wa hu bas al-awwal khabbaraani kadar nabga malik fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa chiili ma'aaki achara khubza wa ka'ak wa girbe hana asal wa amchi algeeh.Wa hu yikhabbirki be l-cheyy al-yukuun le l-wileed.
Wa marit Yaruba'aam sawwat al-cheyy al-raajilha gaalah leeha wa hi gammat wa machat le hillit Chiilooh fi beet al-nabi Akhiiya.Wa Akhiiya da ma bichiif achaan hu chayyab marra waahid wa uyuunah faathiin wa ma bichiifu.
Wa Allah gaal le Akhiiya-:-Di hi marit Yaruba'aam jaaye leek le tichawwif leeha achaan wileedha mardaan.Wa wakit hi tawsal hini,hi tisawwi nafisha misil mara aakhara.Wa inta kamaan hajji leeha be misil da wa misil da.
Wa tawwaali wakit Akhiiya simi' harakat rijileenha wakit daakhle,hu gaal leeha-:-Alfaddale,ya marit Yaruba'aam-!Maala sawweeti nafiski misil mara aakhara-?Ana indi leeki khabar cheen.
Gabbili le Yaruba'aam wa guuli leyah-:--Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Min ust al-cha'ab,ana rafa'tak wa sawweetak kabiir fi cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana gala't al-muluk min zurriiyit Dawuud wa anteetah leek.Wa laakin inta ma bigiit misil abdi Dawuud al-hafad wasiiyaati wa taaba' kalaami be kulla galbah wa illa yisawwi al-adiil bas giddaami.
Wa inta gaa'id tisawwi al-fasaala ziyaada min al-naas al-gablak.Wa le tiza''ilni,inta sana't leek asnaam min hadiid al-yimassulu ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa leyi ana kamaan,rafadtini.
Wa be sabab da,ana ninazzil charr foog aayilat Yaruba'aam.Wa nidammir kulla l-rujaal min aayiltah kan abiid walla hurriin kula fi lubb Bani Israa'iil.Wa nuguchch aayiltah misil yuguchchu al-ba'ar min wijh al-ard.
Wa ayyi naadum min aayilat Yaruba'aam al-yumuut fi lubb al-hille,al-kulaab yaakuluuh.Wa l-yumuut fi l-kadaade,tuyuur al-sama yaakuluuh."- Wa da kalaam Allah al-hu gaalah.
Wa kan leeki inti,gummi amchi beetki.Wa laakin wakit tidissi rijilki fi l-hille bas,al-wileed yumuut.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil yahzano leyah wa yadfunuuh.Wa min aayilat Yaruba'aam,hu wiheedah bas al-yadfunuuh fi khabur achaan hu wiheedah bas min aayilat Yaruba'aam,Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil ligi foogah cheyy adiil.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah yidarrij leyah malik fi Bani Israa'iil al-yidammir aayilat Yaruba'aam.Wa da l-cheyy al-gaa'id yahsal al-yoom fi l-wakit da bas.
Wa Allah yadrub Bani Israa'iil wa yabgo misil ageeg al-chaaylah al-almi.Wa hu yamrughum min al-balad al-samha al-antaaha le juduudhum wa yichattithum khaadi le bahar al-Furaat achaan humman khaddabo Allah wakit khazzo iidaan le ibaadat ilaaha Achiira.
Wa Allah yaabaahum le Bani Israa'iil be sabab al-zanib al-Yaruba'aam sawwaah,hu al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa marit Yaruba'aam gammat wa gabbalat hillit Tirsa.Wa wakit wassalat khachum baab beetha,khalaas al-wileed maat.
Wa dafanooh wa kulla Bani Israa'iil hizno leyah.Wa da bigi hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah be waasitat abdah al-nabi Akhiiya.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yaruba'aam al-sawwaah min al-huruub wa l-hukum,kulla ke maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa muddit hukum Yaruba'aam 22 sana wa ba'ad da,maat wa lihig abbahaatah.Wa wileedah Nadaab hakam fi badalah.
Wa Rahab'aam wileed Suleymaan bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa hu indah 41 sana wakit bigi malik.Wa hakam 17 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa di l-madiina al-azalaaha Allah min kulla mudun gabaayil Bani Israa'iil le yukhutt foogha usmah.Wa amm Rahab'aam usumha Na'ama wa hi min balad Bani Ammuun.
Wa naas gabiilat Yahuuza gaa'idiin yisawwu al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa be l-zanib da,khaddabo Allah ziyaada min al-khadab al-awwal juduudhum sabbabooh be zunuubhum al-sawwoohum.
Wa humman kula bano bakaanaat aaliyiin wa khazzo hujaar le l-ibaada wa khazzo iidaan le ibaadat Achiira fi raas ayyi jabal aali wa tihit ayyi chadara khadra.
Wa naas waahidiin yisawwu al-charmata fi bakaan al-ibaada fi l-balad.Wa da nafs al-muharramaat al-sawwoohum al-umam al-Allah gala' minhum arduhum wa antaaha le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-sana al-khaamse hana hukum Rahab'aam,Chiichakh malik Masir gamma ja haarab Madiinat al-Khudus.
Hu chaal kulla l-khuna al-fi beet Allah wa gasir al-malik.Hu chaal kulla cheyy,khaassatan al-darag hana l-dahab al-Suleymaan sawwaahum.
Wa fi badal al-darag dool,al-malik Rahab'aam sawwa darag aakhariin hana nahaas wa ammanaahum le kabiir al-hurraas al-gaa'id yahris khachum baab gasir al-malik.
Wa kan al-malik yamchi beet Allah,al-hurraas yichiilu al-darag dool wa ba'adeen yigabbuluuhum fi beet al-hurraas.
Wa l-baagi min amal Rahab'aam wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa daayman bigi harib ambeen Rahab'aam wa Yaruba'aam.
Wa Rahab'aam maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa ammah usumha Na'ama wa hi min balad Bani Ammuun.Wa wileedah Abiiya hakam fi badalah.
Fi sanit 18 hana hukum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat,Abiiya bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa hu hakam talaata sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Ma'aaka bineeyit Abichaluum.
Wa Abiiya sawwa kulla l-zunuub al-awwal abuuh sawwaahum wa galbah ma mukhlis le Allah Ilaahah misil galib jiddah Dawuud.
Wa laakin fi chaan Dawuud,Allah Ilaahah khatta naadum waahid min zurriiytah fi l-muluk fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa da achaan Madiinat al-Khudus kula tagood
wa achaan Dawuud sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah.Wa fi kulla muddit hayaatah,hu ma khaalaf amur Allah illa fi muchkilat Uriiya al-Hitti.
Wa kaan harib ambeen aayilat Rahab'aam wa aayilat Yaruba'aam.Wa l-harba di gaa'ide daayman fi kulla muddit hayaat Abiiya.
Wa l-baagi min amal Abiiya wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.Wa kaan harib ambeen Abiiya wa Yaruba'aam.
Wa Abiiya maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Aasa hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 20 hana hukum Yaruba'aam malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Aasa kula bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Aasa hakam 41 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa jidditah usumha Ma'aaka bineeyit Abichaluum.
Wa Aasa sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah misil jiddah Dawuud.
Wa tarad min al-balad al-naas al-yichcharmato fi bakaan al-ibaada wa dammar kulla l-asnaam al-abbahaatah sana'oohum.
Wa l-malik Aasa marag hatta jidditah Ma'aaka min darajatha hana l-meeram achaan hi sana'at sanam muharram le l-ilaaha Achiira.Wa Aasa kassar al-sanam al-muharram da wa harragah fi waadi Khidruun.
Wa laakin be da kula,al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam gaa'idiin.Wa fi kulla muddit hayaatah,Aasa gaa'id yitaabi' Allah be galib mukhlis.
Wa hu jaab fi beet Allah al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-mu'iddaat al-abuuh wa hu zaatah khassasoohum.
Wa kaan harib ambeen Aasa wa Ba'aacha malik mamlakat Israa'iil fi kulla muddit hayaathum.
Wa Ba'aacha malik mamlakat Israa'iil gamma yihaarib mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa gawwa hillit al-Raama le yadhar al-derib le Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa naasah ma yamurgu wa la yadkhulu be l-derib da.
Wa khalaas,Aasa chaal kulla l-fudda wa l-dahab al-gaa'idiin fi makhaazin hana beet Allah wa kulla l-maal hana gasir al-malik wa antaah le masaa'iilah.Wa rassalaahum le Banhadaad wileed Tabrimuun wileed Hazyuun malik balad Araam al-gaa'id fi madiinat Dimachkh.Wa rassal leyah wa gaal-:
Khalli nisawwu alaakha beeni wa beenak misil al-alaakha al-bigat ambeen abuuyi wa abuuk.Daahu nirassil leek hadiiye hana fudda wa dahab wa natlub minnak tagta' alaakhtak ma'a Ba'aacha malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa be da,yiwaggif al-harba al-gamma beeha diddi.
Wa Banhadaad khassad be kalaam al-malik Aasa.Wa khalaas,hu rassal khuyyaad askarah wa hajamo hillaal mamlakat Israa'iil wa chaalo Iyuun wa Daan wa Abil Beet Ma'aaka wa kulla mantagat al-Jaliil wa kulla ard gabiilat Naftaali.
Wa min Ba'aacha simi' be l-khabar da,khalla minnah gawiyiin hillit al-Raama wa sakan fi hillit Tirsa.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,al-malik Aasa lamma kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza,wa ma khalla naadum waahid kula,le yangulu al-hajar wa l-hatab al-Ba'aacha lammaahum le yigawwi beehum hillit al-Raama.Wa hu asta'mal al-hajar wa l-hatab dool le yigawwi hillit Gaba' Banyaamiin wa hillit Misfa.
Wa l-baagi min amal Aasa wa kulla faraasiiytah wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa l-hillaal al-banaahum,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kutub taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.Wa laakin wakit Aasa chayyab,waja' rijle karabah.
Wa Aasa maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud jiddah.Wa wileedah Yahuuchafat hakam fi badalah.
Wa Nadaab wileed Yaruba'aam bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum Aasa.Wa hu hakam santeen fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Nadaab sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Hu taaba' derib abuuh al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa Ba'aacha wileed Akhiiya al-min gabiilat Yassaakar atmarrad didd al-malik.Al-malik Nadaab ma'a kulla askar mamlakat Israa'iil macho haasaro hillit Gibbatuun al-fi iid al-Filistiyiin,fi l-wakit da bas Ba'aacha katalah le Nadaab.
Ba'aacha katalah le Nadaab fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa Ba'aacha hakam fi badal Nadaab.
Wa min hu bigi malik,dammar kulla aayilat Yaruba'aam.Ma khalla naadum waahid kula min aayiltah.Wa da bigi misil kalaam Allah al-gaalah be waasitat abdah Akhiiya al-min hillit Chiilooh.
Wa kulla l-cheyy da bigi achaan al-zunuub al-Yaruba'aam sawwaahum.Wa lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub wa khaddabo Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-baagi min amal Nadaab wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Ba'aacha wileed Akhiiya bigi malik fi kulla mamlakat Israa'iil fi hillit Tirsa.Wa hu hakam 24 sana.
Wa Ba'aacha sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Hu taaba' derib Yaruba'aam al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa Allah hajja le l-nabi Yaahu wileed Hanaani kalaam bukhuss al-malik Ba'aacha wa gaal-:
Inta al-ma tisaawi cheyy kula,ana darrajtak wa sawweetak kabiir hana cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.Wa laakin inta taaba't derib Yaruba'aam wa lazzeet cha'abi Bani Israa'iil fi l-zunuub wa be zunuubhum da,humman khaddabooni.
Wa hassa' da,ana nuguchchak inta wa aayiltak.Wa aayiltak tabga misil aayilat Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat.
Wa ayyi naadum min aayilat Ba'aacha al-yumuut fi lubb al-hille,al-kulaab yaakuluuh.Wa l-yumuut fi l-kadaade,tuyuur al-sama yaakuluuh.
Wa l-baagi min amal Ba'aacha wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa faraasiiytah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Ba'aacha maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi hillit Tirsa.Wa wileedah Iila hakam fi badalah.
Wa Allah hajja be waasitat al-nabi Yaahu wileed Hanaani le Ba'aacha wa aayiltah be sabab kulla l-fasaala al-khaddabo beeha Allah wa l-achya al-sawwoohum be iidhum le yabgo sawa sawa misil Yaruba'aam wa aayiltah.Wa achaan Ba'aacha dammar aayilat Yaruba'aam.
Wa fi sanit 26 hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Iila wileed Ba'aacha bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi hillit Tirsa.Wa hakam santeen.
Wa waahid min masaa'iilah al-usmah Zimri atmarrad diddah.Wa hu da khaayid deech Iila al-indah mas'uuliiye fi nuss min arabaat al-harib.Wa wakit Iila gaa'id yachrab wa yaskar fi Tirsa fi beet Arsa al-hu mas'uul fi gasir al-malik,
Zimri dakhal leyah wa darabah wa katalah.Wa da fi sanit 27 hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa Zimri hakam fi badal Iila.
Wa min ga'ad fi kursi al-muluk,katal kulla aayilat Ba'aacha.Ma khalla naadum waahid kula min al-dukuura wa la min aayiltah wa la min rufgaanah.
Wa hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah didd Ba'aacha be waasitat al-nabi Yaahu,Zimri dammar kulla aayilat Ba'aacha.
Wa da be sabab kulla zunuub Ba'aacha wa wileedah Iila.Humman aznabo wa lazzo naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.Wa be da,khaddabo Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil be ibaadat al-asnaam.
Wa l-baagi min amal Iila wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi sanit 27 hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Zimri bigi malik wa hakam sab'a yoom fi hillit Tirsa.Wa fi l-wakit da,askar mamlakat Israa'iil ga'ado mugaabil hillit Gibbatuun al-fi iid al-Filistiyiin.
Wa l-askar ligo khabar kadar Zimri atmarrad didd al-malik wa katalah.Wa fi l-yoom da,tawwaali humman darrajooh le Umri khaayid al-deech malik fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,Umri wa kulla askar Bani Israa'iil gammo min hillit Gibbatuun wa jo haasaro hillit Tirsa.
Wa wakit Zimri irif kadar al-hille di chaalooha,khalaas dakhal fi gasir hana l-malik.Wa tachcha gasir al-malik wa nafsah kula wa maat.
Wa da bigi achaan zunuubah wakit sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa hu taaba' kulla l-fasaala al-sawwaaha Yaruba'aam al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa l-baagi min amal Zimri wa mu'aamaratah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad moot Zimri,cha'ab mamlakat Israa'iil angasamo bakaanteen.Waahidiin taaba'o Tibni wileed Giinat le yidarrujuuh malik.Wa waahidiin taaba'o Umri.
Wa l-naas al-taaba'o Umri khilbo naas Tibni wileed Giinat.Wa Tibni maat wa Umri bigi malik.
Wa fi sanit 31 hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Umri bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil wa hakam 12 sana.Wa gabul da,hu hakam 6 sana fi hillit Tirsa.
Wa hu chara min Saamar jabal be 70 kiilo fudda.Wa bana madiina fi raas al-jabal da wa gawwaaha wa sammaaha madiinat al-Saamira.Wa da l-usum al-awwal hana Saamar siid al-jabal.
Wa Umri sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah ziyaada min kulla l-muluuk al-hakamo gablah.
Hu taaba' kulla duruub Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.Wa be da,khaddabo Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil be ibaadat al-asnaam.
Wa l-baagi min amal Umri wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa faraasiiytah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Umri maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa wileedah Akhaab hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 38 hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Akhaab wileed Umri bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa Akhaab wileed Umri hakam 22 sana fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa Akhaab wileed Umri sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah ziyaada min kulla l-muluuk al-hakamo gablah.
Wa hu taaba' al-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat.Wa da kula,hu chaafah chiyya wa sawwa ziyaada minnah-!Akhaab macha akhadaaha le Izabiil bineeyit Atba'al malik balad Seeda wa sajad le ilaah al-usmah Ba'al wa abadah.
Wa fi l-Saamira,bana madbah wa beet le ya'abudu foogah ilaah Ba'al.
Wa Akhaab khazza iidaan le ibaadat Achiira le yikhaddib Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil ziyaada min kulla muluuk Israa'iil al-hakamo gablah.
Wa fi waktah,Hiyiil al-min hillit Beet Iil gamma yabni hillit Ariiha battaan.Wa wakit bada yukhutt asaasha,wileedah al-bikir Abiraam maat.Wa battaan wakit gaa'id yidiss biibaan al-durdur,wileedah al-taani al-usmah Saguub kula maat.Wa da hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah zamaan be waasitat al-nabi Yachuu' wileed Nuun.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid usmah Iliyaas saakin fi hillit Tichbi fi turaab Gil'aad.Wa hu gaal le l-malik Akhaab-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy,Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-ana gaa'id na'abudah,fi l-siniin al-jaayiin ma fi karany wa la matara illa kan ana chahadtah.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah hajja le Iliyaas wa gaal-:
Gumm min hini wa amchi ale sabaah wa allabbad fi waadi Kariit sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa hinaak tachrab min al-waadi wa ana amart khurbaat yijiibu leek akil.
Wa khalaas,Iliyaas sawwa hasab amur Allah.Hu macha sakan fi waadi Kariit sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa fi l-bakaan da fajur wa achiiye,al-khurbaat gaa'idiin yijiibu leyah khubza wa laham.Wa hu gaa'id yachrab min almi al-waadi.
Wa ba'ad Iliyaas ga'ad wakit chiyya fi l-bakaan da,al-waadi yibis achaan al-matara ma sabbat fi l-balad.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja leyah wa gaal-:
Gumm amchi hillit Sarafa al-gaa'ide fi turaab Seeda wa askun hinaak.Achaan ana amart le mara waahide armala tantiik akil.
Wa khalaas,Iliyaas gamma macha fi Sarafa.Wa wakit wisil fi madkhal al-hille,hu chaaf al-mara al-armala gaa'ide tilaggit hatab.Hu naadaaha wa gaal leeha-:-Min fadulki,jiibi leyi almi chiyya fi maa'uun nachrab.
Wa wakit maache tijiib leyah al-almi da,hu naadaaha battaan wa gaal leeha-:-Jiibi leyi ma'aaki khubza sakhayre kula.
Wa hi raddat leyah-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy Ilaahak,ana ma indi cheyy jaahiz.Ma faddal leyi illa dagiig fi umra yisaawi malyit iid wa dihin chiyya fi karyo.Wa hassa' jiit nilaggit hatab achaan nisawwi akil leyi ana wa le wileedi naakulu.Wa ba'ad da,numuutu.
Wa khalaas Iliyaas gaal leeha-:-Ma takhaafe,amchi wa sawwi misil inti gultiih.Wa be l-cheyy al-indiki da bas,sawwi leyi ana khubza sakhayre wa jiibiiha leyi.Wa ba'ad da,sawwiih leeki inti wa le wileedki.
Achaan daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Al-dagiig ma yikammil min al-umra wa l-dihin ma yikammil min al-karyo lahaddi l-yoom al-Allah yijiib al-matara fi l-ard.-
Wa khalaas,al-mara machat wa sawwat misil Iliyaas gaalah leeha.Wa humman akalo,hi wa Iliyaas wa aayilitha le muddit ayyaam.
Wa l-dagiig al-fi l-umra ma kammal wa l-dihin al-fi l-karyo kula ma kammal wa da bigi hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah be waasitat Iliyaas.
Wa ba'ad da,wileed al-mara al-armala sitt al-beet di bigi mardaan.Wa maradah bigi chadiid bilheen lahaddi maat.
Wa hi gaalat le Iliyaas-:-Chunu al-beeni wa beenak,ya nabi Allah-?Inta jiit achaan tizakkirni be khataayi wa taktul wileedi walla-?
Wa hu radda leeha wa gaal-:-Antiini wileedki.-Wa khalaas,chaal al-wileed min iideenha wa macha beyah foog fi l-gasir,fi l-beet al-hu saakin foogah wa raggadah fi l-sariir.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,sa'al Allah be chidde wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Ilaahi,le l-mara al-ana gaa'id deef fi bakaanha di kula tisawwi leeha cheyy fasil wa taktul wileedha walla-?
Wa Iliyaas almattat talaata marraat min foog le l-wileed wa sa'al Allah be chidde wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Ilaahi,nachhadak tigabbil ruuh al-wileed da.
Wa Allah khibil su'aalah wa ruuh al-wileed gabbalat wa hu hiyi.
Wa Iliyaas chaal al-wileed wa dalla beyah min al-gasir wa antaah le ammah wa gaal-:-Chiifi-!Daahu wileedki hiyi.
Wa l-mara gaalat le Iliyaas-:-Aywa,hassa' ana irift kadar inta nabi Allah wa akiid al-kalaam al-gaa'id tuguulah da jaayi min Allah.
Wa ba'ad muddit ayyaam katiiriin,Allah hajja le Iliyaas fi l-sana al-taalta hana jafaaf wa gaal-:-Amchi gaddim nafsak le l-malik Akhaab wa ana ninazzil matara fi wijh al-ard.
Wa khalaas,Iliyaas gamma macha le yigaabil Akhaab.Wa fi l-wakit da,al-juu' bigi chadiid marra waahid fi madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa Akhaab naada khaddaamah Ubadya hu al-mas'uul fi gasrah.Wa Ubadya da khaayif ziyaada min Allah.
Wa wakit Izabiil marit al-malik Akhaab dammarat anbiya Allah,Ubadya chaal minhum 100 wa labbadaahum fi karaakiir.Wa gassamaahum khamsiin khamsiin wa ayyachaahum be khubza wa almi.
Wa Akhaab gaal le khaddaamah Ubadya-:-Amchi ruukh wa chiif kulla l-uyuun al-almi wa kulla l-wudyaan al-fi l-balad.Akuun talga gechch al-ni'ayyuchu beyah al-kheel wa l-bikhaal.Wa be da,maalna ma yumuut.
Wa humman gassamooha le l-balad di achaan yuruukhuuha kullaha ke.Wa Akhaab macha wiheedah be derib waahid wa Ubadya kula macha wiheedah be derib aakhar.
Wa wakit Ubadya maachi,lamma ma'a Iliyaas fi l-derib.Wa Ubadya irifah wa waga' be wijhah fi l-ard wa gaal-:-Akiid inta bas sayyidi Iliyaas walla-?
Wa Iliyaas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa,da ana.Amchi guul le siidak Akhaab-:--Daahu Iliyaas jaayi.-
Wa Ubadya gaal-:-Chunu al-zanib al-ana sawweetah achaan tisallimni fi iid Akhaab le yaktulni-?
Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy Ilaahak wa ni'akkid leek kadar ma fi umma wa la mamlaka al-siidi ma rassal naas le yifattuchuuk foogha.Wa kan naas al-umma di wa l-mamlaka gaalo ma chaafook,yihallufuuhum lahaddi yuguulu ma ligook.
Wa hassa',inta tuguul leyi-:--Amchi guul le siidak-:"Daahu Iliyaas jaayi."--
Wa wakit ana nufuut minnak,Ruuh Allah yiwaddiik fi bakaan al-ana ma na'arfah.Wa kan ana macheet wa khabbartah le Akhaab beek wa ma ligaak,khalaas yaktulni.Wa laakin ana abdak khaayif min Allah min ana sabi.
Ya sayyidi,inta ma khabbarook be l-cheyy al-ana sawweetah wakit Izabiil gaa'ide taktul fi anbiya Allah da walla-?Ana labbadt 100 min al-anbiya dool wa gassamtuhum khamsiin khamsiin fi l-karaakiir wa ayyachtuhum be khubza wa almi.
Wa hassa',inta tuguul leyi --Amchi guul le siidak-:"Daahu Iliyaas jaayi."- Kan ke da,hu ma yaktulni walla-?
Wa khalaas,Iliyaas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy al-Gaadir al-ana gaa'id na'abudah wa ni'akkid leek kadar al-yoom bas namchi nigaabil Akhaab.
Wa Ubadya macha lihigah le Akhaab wa khabbarah.Wa Akhaab macha achaan yigaabil Iliyaas.
Wa wakit Akhaab chaafah le Iliyaas,gaal leyah-:-Da bas inta,inta al-jibt al-barjaal le Bani Israa'iil walla-?
Wa Iliyaas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana ma jibt barjaal le Bani Israa'iil.Laakin inta wa aayilat abuuk bas jibtuuh achaan khalleetu wasaaya Allah wa taaba'tu ilaahaat Ba'al.
Wa hassa' da,rassil le kulla Bani Israa'iil yaju yilimmu leyi fi jabal al-Karmal.Wa limm al-urbu'miya wa khamsiin anbiya hana l-ilaah Ba'al wa l-urbu'miya anbiya hana l-ilaaha Achiira al-gaa'idiin yaakulu min tarabeezit Izabiil marit al-malik.
Wa khalaas,Akhaab rassal naadaahum le kulla Bani Israa'iil wa lamma al-anbiya fi raas jabal al-Karmal.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Iliyaas garrab le kulla l-cha'ab wa gaal-:-Le mata tamchu jaay wa jaay misil ja'abaat al-rahhaak-?Kan Allah bas al-Ilaah,taabu'uuh-!Kan Ba'al bas al-ilaah,taabu'uuh-! Wa laakin humman ma gidro raddo leyah kilme waahide kula.
Wa Iliyaas gaal leehum-:-Ana wiheedi bas faddalt min anbiya Allah laakin anbiya Ba'al humman 450.
Khalli yijiibu leena tiiraan itneen.Wa anbiya Ba'al yi'azzulu leehum toor waahid yadbahooh wa yigattu'uuh wa yukhuttuuh fi raas al-hatab laakin ma yi'oogudu foogah naar.Wa ana kula nisawwi nafs al-cheyy be l-toor al-aakhar da.Nukhuttah fi l-madbah fi raas al-hatab wa laakin ma ni'oogid foogah naar.
Wa intu as'alo ilaahku wa ana kula nas'al be usum Allah.Wa l-ilaah al-yurudd fi l-su'aal da wa yi'oogid al-naar,hu da bas al-Ilaah al-sahiih. Wa kulla l-cha'ab gaalo-:-Kalaamak adiil.
Wa khalaas,Iliyaas gaal le anbiya Ba'al-:-A'azulu leeku waahid min al-tiiraan dool wa jahhuzuuh intu bas al-awwal achaan intu katiiriin.Wa as'alo ilaahku laakin ma ti'oogudu foogah naar.
Wa humman chaalo al-toor al-antooh leehum wa jahhazooh wa gammo yas'alo be usum Ba'al min fajur lahaddi gaayle wa yuguulu-:-Ya Ba'al,rudd leena-! Laakin ma fi hiss wa la radd.Wa humman gaa'idiin yinattutu giddaam al-madbah al-addalooh.
Wa fi wakit al-gaayle,Iliyaas bada yichchammat fooghum wa gaal-:-Kooruku be hiss foog,hu ilaah-!Akuun anchakhal walla khaayib walla saafar.Akuun hu naayim,khalli yugumm-!
Wa humman gammo yikooruku ziyaada.Wa misil fi aadithum,bado yijarruhu jilidhum be suyuuf wa be huraab lahaddi damm yidaffig minhum.
Wa wakit al-gaayle faatat,humman gammo yitnabba'o be usum Ba'al lahaddi l-wakit al-yigaddumu foogah hadaaya hana achiiye.Laakin humman ma ligo wa la radd wa la kilme wa la alaama.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Iliyaas gaal le kulla l-cha'ab-:-Garrubu leyi. Wa kulla l-cha'ab garrabo leyah.Wa hu addal madbah Allah al-awwal haddamooh.
Wa Iliyaas chaal 12 hajar ale hasab adad gabaayil iyaal Yaakhuub hu al-Allah hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Min al-yoom,yinaaduuk Israa'iil.
Wa be l-hujaar dool,addal madbah le Allah.Wa hawwag al-madbah be nugra al-tagdar tichiil 12 kooro almi.
Wa khalaas,hu rassa al-hatab wa dabah al-toor wa gatta'ah wa khattaah fi raas al-hatab.Wa ba'ad da,hu gaal-:-Amlo arba'a jiraar hana almi wa subbuuh fi l-dahiiye al-muharraga wa fi l-hatab.
Wa gaal battaan-:-Subbuuh marra taaniye. Wa humman sabbooh marra taaniye.Wa gaal battaan-:-Subbuuh marra taalta. Wa humman sabbooh marra taalta.
Wa l-almi jara wa mala al-nugra al-muhawwige al-madbah.
Wa fi l-wakit al-yigaddumu foogah hadaaya al-achiiye,al-nabi Iliyaas gaal-:-Ya Allah,inta Allah Rabb juduudna Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub.Wa l-yoom,wassif le l-naas kadar inta bas Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa hasab kalaamak,ana abdak sawweet kulla l-cheyy da.
Ya Allah,rudd leyi.Rudd leyi achaan al-cha'ab da ya'arif kadar inta bas al-Rabb Allah.Wa inta bas al-tigabbil al-cha'ab da aleek.
Wa tawwaali,Allah nazzal naar min al-sama.Wa l-naar akalat al-dahiiye al-muharraga wa l-hatab wa l-hujaar wa l-ajaaj wa chirbat al-almi al-gaa'id fi l-nugra.
Wa wakit kulla l-cha'ab chaafo al-cheyy da,waga'o kulluhum be wujuuhhum fi l-ard wa gaalo-:-La Ilaah illa Allah-!La Ilaah illa Allah-!
Wa Iliyaas gaal leehum-:-Karrubu kulla anbiya Ba'al wa khalli waahid minhum kula ma yinbalis. Wa khalaas,karaboohum.Wa Iliyaas nazal beehum fi waadi Khiichuun wa dabahaahum.
Wa ba'ad al-cheyy al-kaan da,Iliyaas gaal le Akhaab-:-Amchi aakul wa achrab achaan ana gaa'id nasma' dagdaag hana matara.
Wa Akhaab macha le yaakul wa yachrab.Wa laakin Iliyaas macha tala' fi raas jabal al-Karmal wa sajad wa dassa raasah ambeenaat rikabbah.
Wa ba'ad da,Iliyaas gaal le khaddaamah-:-Atla' foog wa chiif ale l-bahar al-Abyad. Wa khaddaamah tala' wa chaaf wa gaal leyah-:-Ma chift cheyy. Wa sab'a marraat Iliyaas gaal leyah-:-Amchi chiif battaan.
Wa fi l-marra al-saab'e al-khaddaam gaal-:-Daahu chift sahaabaay sakhayre gadur al-kaff gaa'ide tatla' min al-bahar. Wa khalaas,Iliyaas gaal le khaddaamah-:-Amchi guul le Akhaab-:--Chidd kheelak wa amchi gubbaal al-matara ma tiwaggifak.-
Wa tawwaali,al-sama bigi adlam be ziyaada min al-sahaab wa l-riih wa matara chadiide sabbat.Wa Akhaab rikib fi arabatah wa macha le hillit Yazra'iil.
Wa iid Allah kaanat ma'a Iliyaas wa hu rabat sulbah wa gaa'id yajri giddaam Akhaab lahaddi madkhal hillit Yazra'iil.
Wa l-malik Akhaab khabbar martah Izabiil be kulla cheyy al-Iliyaas sawwaah wa kikkeef katal kulla anbiya Ba'al be l-seef.
Wa khalaas,Izabiil rassalat le Iliyaas wa gaalat-:-Khalli al-ilaahaat yi'aakhubuuni kadar le ambaakir fi nafs al-saa'a di kan ma sawweet fi hayaatak misil inta sawweet fi hayaat al-anbiya dool.
Wa min simi' al-kalaam da,Iliyaas arrad le yinajji nafsah.Wa gamma macha Biir Sab'a fi balad Yahuuza wa khalla khaddaamah hinaak.
Wa Iliyaas macha fi l-sahara wa raakh ruwaakha hana yoom kaamil.Wa macha ga'ad fi ga'ar chideerit ratam.Wa talab al-moot le nafsah wa gaal-:-Hassa' da,tammaani.Ya Allah,chiil ruuhi achaan ana ma akheer min juduudi.
Wa hu ragad wa naam fi tihit al-chideere di.Wa tawwaali fi l-bakaan da,malak ja limsah wa gaal leyah-:-Gumm wa aakul.
Wa khalaas,Iliyaas gamma wa chaaf ale raasah khubza haamiye wa jarr hana almi.Wa hu akal wa chirib wa gabbal ragad.
Wa malak Allah ja leyah le taani marra limsah wa gaal leyah-:-Gumm wa aakul achaan al-safar yabga leek tawiil ziyaada.
Wa Iliyaas gamma akal wa chirib.Wa ba'ad ligi gudra min al-akil da,raakh muddit 40 leele wa 40 nahaar lahaddi wisil fi jabal Allah al-usmah Huuriib.
Wa wakit Iliyaas wisil hinaak,dakhal fi karkuur wa ragad fi l-bakaan da leele waahide.Wa laakin Allah hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Iliyaas,inta gaa'id tisawwi chunu hini-?
Wa Iliyaas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir,indi mahabba chadiide leek.Wa Bani Israa'iil nagado mu'aahadatak wa kassaro kulla madaabhak wa katalo anbiyaak be l-seef.Wa ana faddalt wiheedi wa humman gaa'idiin yifattuchuuni le yaktuluuni.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Amrug wa agiif fi l-hajar fi giddaami ana Allah.Wa ana nufuut giddaamak.-Wa riih chadiide gammat giddaam Allah wa chaggagat al-jibaal wa kassarat al-hujaar.Wa laakin Allah ma gaa'id fi l-riih di.Wa ba'ad al-riih,ja zilzaal.Wa laakin Allah ma gaa'id fi l-zilzaal da.
Wa ba'ad al-zilzaal,jaat naar.Wa laakin Allah ma gaa'id fi l-naar di.Wa ba'ad al-naar,jaat haraka hana hiss baarid.
Wa wakit Iliyaas simi' al-hiss al-baarid da,khatta wijhah be khalagah wa marag wagaf fi khachum al-karkuur.Wa simi' hiss buguul leyah-:-Ya Iliyaas,inta gaa'id tisawwi chunu hini-?
Wa Iliyaas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir,indi mahabba chadiide leek.Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil nagado mu'aahadatak wa kassaro kulla madaabhak wa katalo anbiyaak be l-seef.Wa ana faddalt wiheedi wa humman gaa'idiin yifattuchuuni le yaktuluuni.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Gabbil be derib al-sahara wa amchi lahaddi madiinat Dimachkh.Wa hinaak,amsahah le Hazayiil wa darrijah malik fi balad Araam.
Wa amsahah le Yaahu wileed Nimchi wa darrijah malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa amsah Alyasa' wileed Chaafaat al-min hillit Abil Mahuula achaan yabga nabi fi badalak.
Wa ayyi naadum al-niji min seef Hazayiil,Yaahu yaktulah.Wa ayyi naadum al-niji min seef Yaahu,Alyasa' yaktulah.
Wa laakin nikhalli 7-000 naas min Bani Israa'iil humman al-ma sajado wa la habbo ilaah Ba'al.
Wa khalaas,Iliyaas gamma min al-bakaan da wa macha ligi Alyasa' wileed Chaafaat.Hu gaa'id yahrit fi zer'ah be 12 harraata wa ayyi harraata yukurruuha tiiraan itneen.Wa Alyasa' zaatah gaa'id yusuug tiiraan al-harraata al-akhiire.Wa Iliyaas garrab leyah wa khatta khalagah foogah.
Wa Alyasa' khalla al-tiiraan wa jara wara Iliyaas wa gaal leyah-:-Khalliini namchi nihibb abuuyi wa ammi wa ba'ad da,nitaabi'ak. Wa Iliyaas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Amchi wa gabbil ta'aal achaan inta ta'arif al-cheyy al-ana sawweetah leek.
Wa khalaas,Alyasa' gabbal min wara Iliyaas wa chaal tiiraanah al-itneen wa dabahaahum wa gaddamaahum dahiiye.Wa be hatab al-harraata di,oogad naar wa rakkab al-laham wa antaah le l-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah wa humman akalooh.Wa ba'ad da,hu taaba'ah le Iliyaas wa bigi khaddaamah.
Wa Banhadaad malik Araam lamma kulla askarah wa ma'aayah 32 muluuk wa siyaad kheel wa arabaat harib.Wa humman macho haasaro madiinat al-Saamira le yihaarubuuha.
Wa Banhadaad rassal naas fi l-madiina le Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil
wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu kalaam Banhadaad,hu buguul-:--Fudditak wa dahabak humman hineeyi wa awiinak wa iyaalak al-samhiin kula hineeyi.-
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil radda leyah wa gaal-:-Misil inta gultah,ya siidi al-malik,ana wa kulla cheyy al-indi hanaak inta.
Wa l-naas dool gabbalo taani marra le Akhaab wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu kalaam Banhadaad,hu buguul-:--Ana rassalt leek wa gult kadar fudditak wa dahabak hineeyi wa awiinak wa iyaalak kula tantiihum leyi.
Wa ziyaada min da,a'arif kadar le ambaakir fajur fi nafs al-wakit,nirassil leek masaa'iili wa humman yifattuchu beetak wa buyuut masaa'iilak.Wa kulla cheyy al-tichiifah khaali leek,humman yichiiluuh.-
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil lamma kulla chuyuukh al-balad wa gaal leehum-:-Chiifu al-raajil da yidoor yisawwi leyi cheyy fasil.Wakit dawwar minni awiini wa iyaali wa fudditi wa dahabi,ana ma abeet leyah.
Wa kulla l-chuyuukh wa kulla l-cha'ab gaalo leyah-:-Ma tasma' kalaamah wa la tarda beyah.
Wa be da,Akhaab gaal le naas Banhadaad-:-Amchu guulu le siidi al-malik-:--Kulla cheyy al-talabah minni fi l-marra al-awwal,ana khassadt beyah nisawwiih.Laakin talabah al-taani da,ana ma nagdar nitabbigah.-- Wa khalaas,al-naas dool gabbalo wa waddo al-radd da le siidhum.
Wa Banhadaad rassal le taalit marra wa gaal-:-Khalli al-ilaahaat yi'aakhubuuni ikhaab chadiid kan ard al-Saamira tammat malyit iid le kulla askari al-maachiin ma'aayi.
Wa laakin malik mamlakat Israa'iil radda leyah wa gaal-:-Amchu guulu leyah al-masal da-:--Ma tachkur nafsak gabul al-harib-!-
Wa wakit Banhadaad simi' al-kalaam da,hu gaa'id yachrab ma'a muluuk aakhariin fi lubb al-kheema wa gaal le askarah-:-Yalla jahhuzu-! Wa khalaas,humman jahhazo le yihaarubu al-madiina.
Wa laakin nabi waahid ja le Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Hal chift al-deech al-kabiir da walla-?Daahu ana nisallimhum leek fi iidak.Wa fi l-yoom da,inta ta'arif kadar ana bas Allah.-
Wa Akhaab sa'al al-nabi wa gaal-:-Be musaa'adat yaatu inta tisallimhum leyi-? Wa l-nabi gaal-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Be musaa'adat askar masaa'iil al-wulaayaat.-- Wa Akhaab gaal-:-Yaatu al-yamchi yigawwim al-harib-? Wa l-nabi radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta bas.
Wa khalaas,Akhaab lamma kulla askar masaa'iil al-wulaayaat wa adadhum 232.Wa lamma battaan kulla naas mamlakat Israa'iil wa ligi adadhum 7-000 askari.
Wa humman macho hajamo be gaayle.Wa Banhadaad wa l-muluuk al-talaatiin wa tineen al-jo leyah faza' gaa'idiin yaskaro fi lubb al-kheema.
Wa awwalan ke,askar masaa'iil al-wulaayaat marago.Wa Banhadaad rassal wa akkad wa gaalo leyah-:-Rujaal marago min al-Saamira.
Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Kan humman jaayiin yidooru al-salaama,karrubuuhum hayyiin.Wa kan jaayiin le l-harib kula,karrubuuhum hayyiin.
Wa askar masaa'iil al-wulaayaat wa l-askar al-aakhariin al-maachiin waraahum marago min al-madiina.
Wa ayyi waahid darab gabiilah.Wa l-Araamiyiin arrado wa askar mamlakat Israa'iil taaradoohum.Wa Banhadaad malik Araam rikib fi juwaad wa arrad ma'a siyaad kheel waahidiin.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil macha ma'a askarah al-ma'aayah wa katal al-kheel wa dammar arabaat al-harib.Wa be misil da,hu annasar fi l-Araamiyiin nasur kabiir.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-nabi ja le malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa gaal leyah-:-Chidd heelak wa fakkir fi l-cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih.Achaan fi l-sana al-jadiide,malik Araam yaji yahjimak battaan.
Wa masaa'iil malik Araam gaalo leyah-:-Ilaah Bani Israa'iil hu ilaah hana jibaal wa fi chaan da bas,humman bigo gawiyiin minnina.Laakin khalli nihaarubuuhum fi l-sahale wa akiid aniina nabgo gawiyiin minhum.
Wa hassa',daahu al-cheyy al-tisawwiih.Nazzil kulla l-muluuk dool wa baddilhum be hukkaam.
Wa inta zaatak chiil leek askar gawiyiin misil al-askar al-awwal inta waddartuhum wa chiil nafs al-adad hana l-kheel wa arabaat al-harib.Wa ba'ad da,aniina nihaarubu askar Bani Israa'iil fi l-sahale.Wa akiid aniina nabgo gawiyiin minhum. Wa l-malik simi' kalaamhum wa sawwa al-cheyy al-gaalooh leyah.
Wa fi l-sana al-jadiide,Banhadaad wa kulla askar al-Araamiyiin macho wa lammo fi hillit Afiikh le yihaarubu mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa naas mamlakat Israa'iil kula lammo askarhum wa antoohum ma'aach wa macho le yiwaajuhu al-Araamiyiin.Wa askar mamlakat Israa'iil khatto mu'askarhum mugaabil al-Araamiyiin.Wa laakin humman chiyya,bichchaabaho misil door itneen hana khanam jamb al-Araamiyiin al-malo kulla l-balad.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-nabi ja le malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Al-Araamiyiin gaalo-:"Allah hu ilaah hana jibaal wa ma ilaah hana wudyaan."Wa fi chaan da,ana nisallim leek kulla l-deech al-kabiir da fi iidak.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.-
Wa l-duyuuch al-itneen dool ga'ado mulgaabiliin muddit sab'a yoom.Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi',al-duwaas bada.Wa fi yoom waahid,askar mamlakat Israa'iil katalo min al-Araamiyiin 100-000 askar al-maachiin be rijleehum.
Wa 27-000 askar al-faddalo arrado wa dakhalo fi hillit Afiikh wa laakin al-durdur waga' fooghum kulluhum.Wa Banhadaad kula arrad wa macha dakhal fi l-hille wa gaa'id yillabbad min khurfa le khurfa.
Wa masaa'iil Banhadaad jo wa gaalo leyah-:-Aniina simi'na kadar muluuk Bani Israa'iil induhum rahma.Hassa' da,khalli narbutu chuwaalaat fi salabaana wa hubaal fi ruuseena wa namchu le malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa be da,akuun yikhalliik ma yaktulak.
Wa khalaas,humman rabato chuwaalaat fi salabaahum wa hubaal fi ruuseehum wa macho le malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa gaalo leyah-:-Abdak Banhadaad buguul-:--Min fadlak,khalliini ni'iich-!-- Wa Akhaab gaal-:-Hu gaa'id hayy walla-?Hu akhuuyi-!
Wa l-kalaam da bigi leehum halu le l-naas dool wa tawwaali gaalo leyah-:-Banhadaad da akhuuk-! Wa Akhaab gaal leehum-:-Aywa,jiibuuh leyi-! Wa khalaas,Banhadaad marag ja le Akhaab wa hu rakkabah fi arabatah hu zaatah.
Wa Banhadaad gaal le Akhaab-:-Ana nigabbil leek al-mudun al-abuuyi chaalaahum min abuuk.Wa inta tagdar tamchi tisaawig khumaamak fi madiinat Dimachkh misil awwal abuuyi saawag fi l-Saamira. Wa Akhaab gaal le Banhadaad-:-Ana nisawwi alaakha ma'aak wa nikhalliik tamchi. Wa khalaas,hu sawwa ma'aayah alaakha wa khallaah macha.
Wa nabi waahid min majmuu'at al-anbiya gaal le rafiigah be amur Allah-:-Min fadlak,adrubni-! Wa laakin rafiigah da aba.
Wa l-nabi gaal leyah-:-Inta abeet ma tabbagt amur Allah.Wa fi chaan da,wakit tugumm min hini wa tamchi,duud yadurbak. Wa khalaas,wakit rafiigah gamma minnah wa maachi,duud waahid ligaah wa darabah wa katalah.
Wa l-nabi da ligi naadum aakhar wa gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak,adrubni-! Wa khalaas,al-naadum da darabah wa jarahah.
Wa khalaas,al-nabi macha ga'ad fi derib al-yufuut beyah al-malik wa khatta wijhah be khita achaan ma ya'arfuuh.
Wa wakit al-malik ja faayit be l-derib da,al-nabi gamma naadaah wa gaal-:-Ya l-malik,wakit ana abdak gaa'id fi l-duwaas,naadum waahid jaab leyi masjuun waahid wa gaal-:--Ahfad al-naadum da.Kan khalleetah arrad kamaan,hayaatak inta tukuun fi badalah aw tikaffi 34 kiilo fudda.--
Wa wakit ana abdak anchakhalt be cheyy aakhar,al-masjuun da arrad. Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal leyah-:-Wa da inta be nafsak bas gata't al-charii'a.
Wa tawwaali,al-nabi fatah al-khita min wijhah wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil irifah kadar hu waahid min al-anbiya.
Wa hu gaal le l-malik-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Achaan inta khalleet al-raajil al-waajib tidammirah arrad min iideenak,hassa' hayaatak inta tukuun fi badal hayaatah wa hayaat cha'abak fi badal hayaat cha'abah.-
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gabbal beetah fi l-Saamira za'laan wa indah hamm.
Wa ba'ad da,fi cheyy aakhar kula hasal.Fiyah naadum waahid usmah Naabuut.Hu min hillit Yazra'iil wa indah jineenit inab fi Yazra'iil jamb gasir Akhaab malik al-Saamira.
Wa yoom waahid,Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Naabuut-:-Antiini jineentak wa nahrit foogha khadaar achaan hi gariibe le beeti.Wa ana nantiik jineene aakhara al-ahsan min di.Wa laakin kan inta tidoor tamanha,nantiik fudda.
Wa Naabuut radda le Akhaab wa gaal-:-Istakhfar Allah-!Abadan ma nantiik al-jineene al-ana ligiitha warasa min juduudi.
Wa Akhaab gabbal beetah za'laan wa indah hamm achaan al-kalaam al-Naabuut al-min hillit Yazra'iil gaalah leyah-:-Ana ma nantiik al-jineene al-ligiitha warasa min juduudi. Hu macha ragad fi sariirah wa wajjah ale l-durdur wa aba ma yaakul cheyy.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,martah Izabiil jaat ligatah wa sa'alatah-:-Maalak inta za'laan ke wa ma tidoor taakul-?
Wa Akhaab radda leeha wa gaal-:-Ana hajjeet le Naabuut al-min hillit Yazra'iil wa gult leyah-:--Bii' leyi jineentak hana l-inab wa kan ma fi kamaan,nibaddilha leek be jineene aakhara.- Wa laakin hu gaal leyi-:--Ana ma nantiik jineenti.-
Wa khalaas,Izabiil martah gaalat leyah-:-Hal da ma inta bas al-gaa'id tahkim fi mamlakat Israa'iil walla-?Gumm aakul wa afrah.Wa ana nantiik jineenit Naabuut al-min hillit Yazra'iil.
Wa hi gammat katabat jawaabaat be usum Akhaab wa khatamathum be khitmah.Wa rassalat al-jawaabaat dool le l-kubaaraat wa l-chuyuukh al-saakniin ma'a Naabuut fi hillitah.
Wa fi l-jawaabaat dool,hi katabat gaalat-:-Kharruru yoom hana siyaam wa khuttuuh le Naabuut giddaam al-cha'ab.
Wa khuttu naaseen al-ma naaf'iin mugaabiliinah wa khalli yachhado foogah wa yuguulu-:--Hu ayyar al-Rabb wa l-malik.- Wa ba'ad da,amurguuh barra min al-hille wa arjumuuh lahaddi yumuut.
Wa l-kubaaraat wa l-chuyuukh al-saakniin fi hillit Yazra'iil sawwo kulla cheyy al-Izabiil amarat beyah fi jawaabaatha al-rassalathum leehum.
Wa khalaas,humman kharraro yoom hana siyaam wa khattooh le Naabuut giddaam al-cha'ab
wa l-naaseen al-ma naaf'iin jo gaabalooh.Wa humman gammo yachhado fi Naabuut giddaam al-cha'ab wa gaalo-:-Naabuut ayyar al-Rabb wa l-malik. Wa khalaas,gammo maragooh barra min al-hille wa rajamooh lahaddi hu maat.
Wa rassalo le Izabiil wa gaalo leeha-:-Naabuut rajamooh wa maat khalaas.
Wa wakit Izabiil sim'at kadar Naabuut rajamooh wa maat,khalaas hi gaalat le Akhaab-:-Gumm wa chiil jineenit Naabuut al-min hillit Yazra'iil hu al-aba ma yantiiha leek be fudditak achaan hu faarag al-haya wa maat khalaas.
Wa wakit Akhaab simi' kadar Naabuut maat,gamma wa macha fi jineenit Naabuut al-min hillit Yazra'iil le yichiilha.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Iliyaas al-min hillit Tichbi wa gaal-:
Gumm amchi algaah le Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil al-gaa'id fi l-Saamira.Hassa' hu gaa'id fi jineenit Naabuut,macha achaan yichiil al-jineene di.
Amchi wa guul leyah-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ba'ad katalt Naabuut,battaan tidoor tichiil jineentah walla-?"- Wa guul leyah battaan-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Fi nafs al-bakaan al-foogah al-kulaab lihso damm Naabuut,inta kula al-kulaab yalhaso dammak."-
Wa Akhaab gaal le Iliyaas-:-Inta jiit ligiitni walla,ya aduuyi-? Wa Iliyaas gaal leyah-:-Aywa-!Ana jiit ligiitak achaan inta chilt niiye tisawwi al-fasaala giddaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:--Ana ninazzil foogak charr wa nuguchchak inta wa kulla aayiltak min wijh al-ard.Wa nidammir kulla l-rujaal min aayiltak kan abiid walla hurriin kula fi lubb Bani Israa'iil.
Wa nisawwi aayiltak tabga misil aayilat Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat wa misil aayilat Ba'aacha wileed Akhiiya fi chaan al-khadab al-khaddabtini wa lazzeet naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.--
Wa Allah hajja battaan fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss Izabiil wa gaal-:--Al-kulaab yaakuluuha le Izabiil fi ga'ar al-durdur hana hillit Yazra'iil.
Wa ayyi naadum min aayilat Akhaab al-yumuut fi lubb al-hille,al-kulaab yaakuluuh.Wa l-yumuut fi l-kadaade,tuyuur al-sama yaakuluuh.-
Wa abadan ma fi naadum misil Akhaab al-chaal niiye wa sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa martah Izabiil kula gaa'ide tilizzah.
Hu sawwa cheyy muharram,taaba' al-asnaam misil sawwooh al-Amuuriyiin humman al-Allah gala' minhum arduhum wa antaaha le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit Akhaab simi' al-kalaam da,charrat khulgaanah wa libis khalag hana tooba wa saam.Wa hu yunuum wa yugumm be khalag al-tooba da wa yuruukh bicheech bicheech.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Iliyaas al-min hillit Tichbi wa gaal-:
Hal chift kikkeef Akhaab almaskan giddaami-?Wa achaan da,ana ma ninazzil al-charr da fi wakit hukmah.Laakin ninazzil al-charr da fi aayiltah fi wakit hukum wileedah.
Wa fi muddit talaata sana,ma fi harib ambeen al-Araamiyiin wa mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta,Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza ja le malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le masaa'iilah-:-Intu ta'arfu kadar hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad di hintina.Wa maala ma namchu nichiiluuha min iid malik al-Araamiyiin-?
Wa l-malik gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Hal inta kula tamchi ma'aayi le nahjumu hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad walla-? Wa Yahuuchafat radda le malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa gaal leyah-:-Aywa,ana wa inta kullina sawa wa cha'abi misil cha'abak wa kheeli misil kheelak.
Wa laakin Yahuuchafat gaal battaan le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-:-Hassa' da min fadlak,amchi as'al Allah gabul.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil lamma al-anbiya wa adadhum 400 raajil wa gaal leehum-:-Hal namchi nahjim hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad walla ma namchi-? Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Amchi-!Al-Rabb yisallimha leek fi iidak,ya l-malik-!
Wa laakin Yahuuchafat gaal-:-Hal ma fi hini nabi Allah al-nagdaro nas'alo beyah Allah walla-?
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Fiyah naadum waahid al-yagdar yas'al leena Allah.Wa laakin ana nakrahah achaan hu ma yitnabba' beyi be l-kheer laakin daayman yitnabba' beyi be l-fasaala.Wa l-naadum da,hu Miika wileed Yimla. Wa Yahuuchafat gaal-:-Khalli al-malik ma yihajji kalaam misil da-!
Wa khalaas,al-malik naada waahid min khaddaamiinah wa gaal leyah-:-Amchi ajala naadiih le Miika wileed Yimla.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza ayyi waahid laabis khalagah hana l-muluk wa ga'ado fi karaasiihum fi l-madagg jamb khachum baab madiinat al-Saamira.Wa kulla l-anbiya gaa'idiin yitnabba'o giddaamhum.
Wa waahid min al-anbiya dool usmah Sidkhiiya wileed Kan'aana.Hu sawwa leyah guruun hana hadiid wa gaal-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Be l-guruun dool tadrub al-Araamiyiin lahaddi tidammirhum.-
Wa kulla l-anbiya yitnabba'o be nafs al-kalaam wa gaalo-:-Amchi ahjim hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad wa inta tanjah wa Allah yisallimha leek fi iidak,ya l-malik.
Wa l-mursaal al-macha yinaadiih le Miika gaal leyah-:-Daahu kulla l-anbiya kalaamhum waahid wa yihajju be l-kheer le l-malik.Hassa' da,khalli kalaamak inta yabga sawa ma'a kalaamhum.Inta kula hajji be l-kheer.
Wa laakin Miika gaal leyah-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy kadar illa l-kalaam al-gaalah leyi Allah,da bas nuguulah.
Wa wakit wassal bakaan al-malik,al-malik gaal leyah-:-Ya Miika,hal namchu nahjumu hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad walla ma namchu-? Wa Miika radda leyah wa gaal-:-Amchi-!Inta tanjah wa Allah yisallimha leek fi iidak,ya l-malik-!
Wa laakin al-malik gaal leyah-:-Nihallifak kam marra le ti'ooriini illa l-hagg be usum Allah-?
Wa Miika radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana chift kulla Bani Israa'iil muchattatiin fi l-jibaal misil khanam bala raa'i.Wa Allah gaal-:--Al-naas dool battaan ma induhum siid.Khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah be l-salaama.-
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Ana ma gult leek kadar al-naadum da ma yitnabba' leyi be l-kheer laakin yitnabba' leyi be l-charr bas.
Wa khalaas,Miika gaal leyah-:-Hassa' da,asma' kalaam Allah-!Ana chift Allah gaa'id fi archah wa kulla khuwwaat al-sama waagfiin jambah be nussah al-zeenaay wa l-israay.
Wa Allah sa'alaahum wa gaal-:--Yaatu yagdar yukhuchch al-malik Akhaab le yamchi yahjim hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad wa yumuut hinaak-?- Wa ayyi waahid yihajji kalaam chig.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,ruuh waahid ja giddaam Allah wa gaal-:--Ana bas nukhuchchah.- Wa Allah gaal leyah-:--Be tariiga al-weeni-?--
Wa l-ruuh gaal-:--Ana namchi wa nabga ruuh al-kaddaab fi khuchuum kulla anbiya al-malik.- Wa Allah gaal leyah-:--Akiid,misil ke tagdar tukhuchchah wa tanjah.Amchi wa sawwi misil inta gultah.-
Wa Miika gaal-:-Daahu Allah bas rassal ruuh al-kaddaab fi khuchuum anbiyaak wa hu bas kharrar yirassil leek al-charr da.
Wa tawwaali fi l-bakaan da,Sidkhiiya wileed Kan'aana garrab le Miika wa chaddagah wa gaal leyah-:-Kikkeef Ruuh Allah marag minni wa hajja leek-?
Wa Miika gaal leyah-:-Tichiifah yoom tamchi tillabbad min khurfa le khurfa fi beetak.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal-:-Akurbuuh le Miika wa gabbuluuh bakaan Aamuun haakim al-madiina wa Yuwaach wileed al-malik.
Wa guulu leehum-:--Daahu kalaam al-malik hu gaal-:"Dissu al-naadum da fi l-sijin wa antuuh khubza wa almi chiyya chiyya bas lahaddi ana nigabbil be l-sihha wa l-salaama."-
Wa Miika gaal le l-malik-:-Kan sahiih ke inta bas gabbalt be sihha wa salaama da,Allah ma hajja kalaamah leyi ana. Wa gaal battaan-:-Asma'o,ya kulla l-cha'ab.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza macho le yahjumu hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Ana nikhayyir khulgaani hana l-muluk wa namchi al-duwaas.Wa inta kamaan,agood be khulgaanak hana l-muluk. Wa khalaas,malik mamlakat Israa'iil khayyar khulgaanah wa macha al-duwaas.
Wa malik balad Araam anta amur le 32 min kubaaraat arabaatah hana l-harib wa gaal leehum-:-Ma tahjumu al-askar wa la kubaaraathum laakin ahjumu malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa wakit kubaaraat arabaatah chaafooh le Yahuuchafat,gaalo-:-Akiid,hu da bas malik mamlakat Israa'iil. Wa humman wajjaho aleyah le yihaarubuuh wa laakin Yahuuchafat koorak.
Wa wakit kubaaraat al-arabaat irfo kadar da ma malik mamlakat Israa'iil,humman gabbalo min waraayah.
Wa laakin naadum waahid zarag nuchchaabah bala hadaf wa l-nuchchaab da lihig malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa darabah ambeen faragaat al-dire'.Wa tawwaali,malik mamlakat Israa'iil sarakh le sawwaag arabatah wa gaal-:-Gabbil-!Amrugni min bakaan al-harib achaan ana anjaraht.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-harib bigi chadiid marra waahid wa l-malik ga'ad fi lubb arabatah giddaam al-Araamiyiin.Wa damm jiraahah da jara fi ga'ar al-araba.Wa kadar le l-achiiye da hu maat.
Wa ma'a waguu' al-harraay,al-askar koorako fi l-mu'askar wa gaalo-:-Khalli ayyi waahid yamchi le hillitah wa le baladah.
Wa be misil da,al-malik maat wa jaabooh fi l-Saamira wa dafanooh foogha.
Wa wakit khassalo al-araba fi l-rijil hana l-Saamira fi l-bakaan al-yilbarradan foogah al-charaamiit,al-kulaab lihso damm Akhaab da hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Akhaab wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa l-beet hana l-aaj wa l-hillaal al-banaahum,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Akhaab maat wa lihig abbahaatah.Wa wileedah Akhazya hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Yahuuchafat wileed Aasa bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa hu indah 35 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 25 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Azuuba bineeyit Chilhi.
Wa Yahuuchafat taaba' derib abuuh Aasa wa ma baara minnah.Wa sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah.Wa laakin be da kula,al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam gaa'idiin wa fooghum,al-cha'ab yigaddumu dahaaya wa yiharrugu bakhuur.
Wa Yahuuchafat sawwa salaam ma'a malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahuuchafat wa faraasiiytah wa l-huruub al-sawwaahum maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa hu gachcha al-naas al-bisawwu al-charmata fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam al-faddalo fi l-balad min wakit abuuh Aasa.
