Wa fi l-wakit da,ma fi malik fi balad Adoom wa laakin mumassil hana l-malik bas gaa'id.
Wa Yahuuchafat addal sufun kubaar hana l-tijaara al-yamchu le Ufiir yangulu dahab.Wa laakin al-sufun dool ma gidro macho achaan humman alkassaro fi hillit Asyuun Giibar.
Wa khalaas,Akhazya wileed Akhaab gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Khalli khaddaamiini yamchu ma'a khaddaamiinak fi l-sufun. Wa laakin Yahuuchafat aba.
Wa Yahuuchafat maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud jiddah.Wa wileedah Yahuuraam hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 17 hana hukum Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Akhazya wileed Akhaab bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hu hakam santeen fi mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah wa taaba' derib ammah wa abuuh wa derib Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa hu abad al-ilaah Ba'al wa sajad leyah.Wa be da,hu khaddab Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil misil abuuh sawwaah.
Wa ba'ad moot Akhaab,balad Muwaab atmarradat didd Bani Israa'iil.
Wa yoom waahid fi madiinat al-Saamira,al-malik Akhazya waga' min chubbaak gasrah wa ti'ib ziyaada.Wa khalaas,rassal naas wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu as'alo leyi Ba'al Zabuub ilaah madiinat Akhruun fi balad al-Filistiyiin le na'arif kan nalga al-aafe walla la.
Wa laakin malak Allah ja le l-nabi Iliyaas al-min al-Tichbi wa gaal leyah-:-Gumm amchi gaabil naas malik mamlakat Israa'iil al-rassalaahum min madiinat al-Saamira wa guul leehum-:--Ma fi Ilaah fi balad Israa'iil walla-?Maala intu maachiin tas'alo Ba'al Zabuub ilaah madiinat Akhruun-?
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:"Al-sariir al-hu raagid foogah da ma yugumm minnah achaan akiid hu yumuut."--Wa ba'ad da,Iliyaas macha wa hajja leehum.
Wa tawwaali,al-naas al-rassalaahum al-malik gabbalo jo leyah.Wa l-malik sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Maalku gabbaltu ajala-?
Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Raajil waahid jara lihigna wa gaal leena-:--Ajala gabbulu le malikku al-rassalaaku wa guulu leyah-:Daahu Allah gaal-:"Hal ma fi Ilaah fi balad Israa'iil lahaddi tirassil naas yamchu yas'alo Ba'al Zabuub ilaah madiinat Akhruun walla-?Wa be sabab da,al-sariir al-inta raagid foogah da ma tugumm minnah achaan akiid inta tumuut."-
Wa l-malik sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Al-raajil al-macha lihigku wa gaal leeku al-kalaam da,chabahah kikkeef-?
Wa humman raddo wa gaalo leyah-:-Al-raajil da laabis khalag hana suuf wa mulhazzim be farwa. Wa tawwaali,al-malik gaal-:-Da Iliyaas al-min hillit Tichbi.
Wa khalaas,al-malik rassal khaayid be khamsiin askar le yakurbu Iliyaas.Wa Iliyaas gaa'id fi raas al-jabal foog wa l-khaayid gaal leyah-:-Ya nabi Allah-!Al-malik buguul anzil-!
Wa laakin Iliyaas gaal le khaayid al-khamsiin-:-Kan ana nabi Allah,khalli naar tanzil min al-sama wa taakulak inta wa askarak al-khamsiin. Wa tawwaali,naar nazalat min al-sama wa akalathum hu wa askarah al-khamsiin.
Wa battaan kula,al-malik rassal khaayid aakhar be khamsiin askar le yakurbu Iliyaas.Wa l-khaayid gaal le Iliyaas-:-Ya nabi Allah-!Al-malik buguul anzil ajala-!
Wa Iliyaas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan ana nabi Allah,khalli naar tanzil min al-sama wa taakulak inta wa askarak al-khamsiin. Wa tawwaali,naar Allah nazalat min al-sama wa akalathum hu wa askarah al-khamsiin.
Wa le taalit marra battaan,al-malik rassal khaayid be khamsiin askar le yakurbu Iliyaas.Wa l-khaayid al-taalit da gamma macha wa barak giddaam Iliyaas wa chahadah wa gaal-:-Ya nabi Allah-!Khalli hayaati wa hayaat khaddaamiinak al-khamsiin dool tabga leek muhimme.
Wa daahu naar nazalat min al-sama wa akalat khuyyaad al-itneen al-awwalaaniyiin wa askarhum.Wa laakin hassa',khalli hayaati tabga leek muhimme.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,malak Allah hajja le Iliyaas wa gaal leyah-:-Anzil wa amchi ma'aayah,ma takhaaf minnah. Wa khalaas,Iliyaas nazal wa macha ma'a l-khaayid da bakaan al-malik.
Wa Iliyaas gaal le l-malik-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Hal ma fi Ilaah fi balad Bani Israa'iil al-inta tagdar tas'alah walla-?Achaan inta rassalt naas yas'alo leek Ba'al Zabuub ilaah madiinat Akhruun.Wa be sabab da,al-sariir al-inta raagid foogah da ma tugumm minnah achaan akiid inta tumuut.-
Wa l-malik Akhazya maat hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah al-nabi Iliyaas.Wa Akhazya ma indah wileed.Wa be da,akhuuh Yuuraam hakam fi badalah fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum Yahuuraam wileed Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa l-baagi min amal Akhazya wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Daahu kikkeef Allah rafa' Iliyaas fi l-sama,hu rafa'ah be riih amzooba'aane.Wa da yoom,Iliyaas wa Alyasa' gammo min Gilgaal.
Wa wakit maachiin fi l-derib,Iliyaas gaal le Alyasa'-:-Agood hini achaan Allah rassalaani namchi Beet Iil. Wa laakin Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi,nahlif be Allah al-Hayy wa be hayaatak inta kadar ana abadan ma nikhalliik wiheedak. Wa khalaas,humman macho sawa le Beet Iil.
Wa naas majmuu'at al-anbiya al-saakniin fi Beet Iil marago laagooh le Alyasa' wa gaalo leyah-:-Hal inta ta'arif kadar al-yoom Allah yarfa' sayyidak fi l-sama-? Wa Alyasa' radda wa gaal-:-Ana kula na'arfah.Askutu-!
Wa Iliyaas gaal le Alyasa'-:-Hassa' da,ya wileedi,agood hini achaan Allah rassalaani namchi Ariiha. Wa Alyasa' gaal-:-Ya abuuyi,nahlif be Allah al-Hayy wa be hayaatak inta kadar ana abadan ma nikhalliik tamchi wiheedak. Wa khalaas,humman macho sawa le Ariiha.
Wa naas majmuu'at al-anbiya al-saakniin fi Ariiha garrabo le Alyasa' wa gaalo leyah-:-Hal inta ta'arif kadar al-yoom Allah yarfa' sayyidak fi l-sama-? Wa Alyasa' radda wa gaal-:-Ana kula na'arfah.Askutu-!
Wa Iliyaas gaal le Alyasa'-:-Hassa' da,ya wileedi,agood hini achaan Allah rassalaani namchi bahar al-Urdun. Wa Alyasa' radda wa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi,nahlif be Allah al-Hayy wa be hayaatak inta kadar ana abadan ma nikhalliik wiheedak. Wa khalaas,attaaba'o tineenithum wa macho.
Wa 50 naas min majmuu'at al-anbiya macho ga'ado mugaabil al-Urdun chiyya ba'iid min Iliyaas wa Alyasa'.Wa humman al-itneen wagafo fi khachum bahar al-Urdun.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Iliyaas salla khalagah wa tabbagah wa darab beyah al-almi wa l-almi da angasam itneen jaay wa jaay.Wa humman chaggo al-bahar da fi l-turaab al-yaabis.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yuchuggu al-bahar da,Iliyaas gaal le Alyasa'-:-Atlub minni al-cheyy al-waajib nisawwi leek gubbaal ma yarfa'ooni min jambak. Wa Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Khalli yanzil foogi ruuh misil al-ruuh al-indak marrateen.
Wa Iliyaas gaal leyah-:-Inta talabt minni cheyy gaasi.Wa laakin wakit yarfa'ooni min jambak,kan gaa'id tichiifni,khalaas talga talabak da.Wa kan ma tichiifni kamaan,talabak da ma talgaah.
Wa wakit humman maachiin wa gaa'idiin yihajju,tawwaali maragat fooghum araba hint naar al-karrooha kheel hana naar.Wa l-araba di faragat Iliyaas min Alyasa'.Wa khalaas,Iliyaas tala' fi l-sama fi riih amzooba'aane.
Wa Alyasa' gaa'id yichiifah wa yabki chadiid wa yuguul-:-Ya abuuyi-!Ya abuuyi-!Inta muhimm le Bani Israa'iil misil kulla arabaathum wa kulla kheelhum-!-Wa ba'ad da,battaan Alyasa' ma chaafah le Iliyaas.Wa gamma charrat khulgaanah min usut min al-hizin.
Wa chaal khalag Iliyaas al-waga' min kitfah wa gabbal wa wagaf fi khachum bahar al-Urdun.
Wa chaal khalag Iliyaas al-waga' min kitfah wa darab beyah al-almi wa gaal-:-Hal Allah Ilaah Iliyaas gaa'id ma'aayi walla-? Wa wakit hu kula darab al-almi,al-almi angasam itneen jaay wa jaay wa Alyasa' adda.
Wa naas majmuu'at al-anbiya al-gaa'idiin mugaabiliin Ariiha chaafooh wa gaalo-:-Ruuh Iliyaas gaa'id fi Alyasa'-! Wa humman macho laagooh wa waga'o be wujuuhhum wa sajado giddaamah.
Wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu min khaddaamiinak fi 50 rujaal fahaliin.Khalli yamchu yifattuchuuh le sayyidak.Akuun Ruuh Allah waddaah khattaah fi raas jabal waahid aw fi waadi. Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Ma tirassuluuhum.
Wa laakin humman ma khallooh,asarooh be ziyaada.Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Khalaas,rassuluuhum.-Wa humman rassalo 50 raajil le yifattuchu Iliyaas.Wa humman fattachooh le muddit talaata yoom wa ma ligooh.
Wa gabbalo jo le Alyasa' al-gaa'id fi Ariiha wa hu gaal leehum-:-Hal ana ma gult leeku ma tamchu-?
Wa naas hillit Ariiha gaalo le Alyasa'-:-Ya sayyidna,misil gaa'id tichiifah al-mug'ad fi l-hille di hu adiil laakin al-almi waskhaan wa l-ard kula ma tantij.
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Jiibu leyi maa'uun jadiid wa subbu foogah mileh. Wa humman jaabooh leyah.
Wa Alyasa' marag wa macha le een al-almi wa sabba foogha al-mileh wa gaal-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ana tahhart al-almi da wa battaan ma yisabbib moot wa ma yadhar al-ard ma tantij.-
Wa be da,al-almi bigi nadiif lahaddi l-yoom da,hasab kalaam Alyasa'.
Wa Alyasa' gamma min Ariiha wa macha Beet Iil.Wa wakit maachi fi l-derib,iyaal waahidiin marago min al-hille wa achchammato leyah wa gaalo-:-Amchi,ya abu sala'a-!Amchi,ya abu sala'a-!
Wa Alyasa' chaglab chaafhum wa la'anhum be usum Allah.Wa tawwaali,dubaba itneen khatiiraat maragan leehum min al-khaaba wa katalan 42 min al-iyaal dool.
Wa min al-bakaan da,Alyasa' gamma macha jabal al-Karmal wa min hinaak,gabbal madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa Yuuraam wileed Akhaab bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira fi sanit 18 hana hukum Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa hu hakam 12 sana.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah wa laakin ma misil fasaalit ammah wa abuuh.Hu salla al-hajar al-abuuh khazzaah le ibaadat al-ilaah Ba'al.
Wa hu anrabat fi l-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.Yuuraam kula ma khalla minnah al-zunuub dool.
Wa Miicha' malik balad Muwaab indah bahaayim katiiriin wa gaa'id yikaffi 100-000 humlaan wa 100-000 kubchaan al-induhum suuf tuwaal misil miiri le malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa laakin wakit Akhaab maat,malik balad Muwaab atmarrad didd al-malik al-jadiid hana mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas fi l-yoom da,al-malik Yuuraam marag min madiinat al-Saamira wa lamma kulla mamlakat Israa'iil le l-harib.
Wa gamma rassal le Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu malik balad Muwaab atmarrad diddi.Tagdar taji ma'aayi le nihaarubu balad Muwaab walla-? Wa Yahuuchafat radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa,najiik-!Ana wa inta kullina sawa,naasi misil naasak wa kheeli misil kheelak.
Wa gaal battaan-:-Be l-derib al-weenu namchu-? Wa Yuuraam gaal leyah-:-Be derib al-maachi be saharat Adoom.
Wa khalaas,malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa malik balad Adoom gammo wa macho sawa.Wa hawwago muddit sab'a yoom wa almi bigi ma fiih le l-askar wa le l-bahaayim al-maachiin ma'aahum.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal-:-Akiid Allah jaabaana aniina al-muluuk al-talaata dool hini achaan yisallimna fi iid malik balad Muwaab.
Wa laakin Yahuuchafat gaal-:-Hini ma fi nabi Allah al-beyah hu nagdaro nas'alo Allah walla-? Wa waahid min masaa'iil malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal leyah-:-Fiyah Alyasa' wileed Chaafaat hu al-awwal tilmiiz hana l-nabi Iliyaas wa gaa'id yusubb almi fi iideenah.
Wa Yahuuchafat gaal battaan-:-Al-raajil da indah kalaam Allah. Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa Yahuuchafat wa malik balad Adoom macho le Alyasa'.
Wa Alyasa' gaal le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-:-Chunu beeni wa beenak,ya malik mamlakat Israa'iil-?Amchi le anbiya ammak wa abuuk. Wa khalaas,malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal-:-La-!Achaan akiid Allah jaabaana aniina al-muluuk al-talaata dool hini le yisallimna fi iid malik balad Muwaab.
Wa Alyasa' gaal-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy al-Gaadir al-ana gaa'id na'abudah,kan awwal ma indi karaama le Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza da,ana ma naj'alak wa la nichiifak kula.
Hassa' da,jiibu leyi naadum al-ya'arif yadrub jigindiiye.-Wa wakit al-naadum da bada yadrub al-jigindiiye,Ruuh Allah nazal fi Alyasa'.
Wa Alyasa' gaal-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ankutu nugaar katiiriin fi l-waadi da.--
Wa daahu Allah gaal battaan-:--Ma tichiifu riih wa la tichiifu matara laakin al-waadi da yinmali almi.Wa intu wa maalku wa bahaayimku tacharbo minnah.
Wa da cheyy hayyin leyi ana Allah-!Wa nisallim leeku balad Muwaab fi iideeku kula.
Wa tidammuru kulla l-mudun al-gawiyiin wa kulla mudun al-muhimmiin wa tagta'o kulla l-chadar al-adiil wa tadfunu kulla uyuun al-almi wa titallufu al-ziraa'a achaan tamloohum be hujaar.-
Wa be fajur fi wakit gaddimiin al-hadaaya,chaafo almi jaari jaayi min ale nuss balad Adoom wa l-ard anmalat be almi.
Wa l-Muwaabiyiin sim'o kadar al-muluuk al-talaata dool jaayiin le yihaarubuuhum.Khalaas,lammo kulla naashum min al-subyaan lahaddi l-chiyyaab al-yagdaro yichiilu silaah wa khattoohum fi l-huduud.
Wa be fajur badri wakit naas balad Muwaab gammo,al-almi gaa'id yiraari fi taluu' al-harraay wa humman chaafo al-almi da ahmar misil damm.
Wa khalaas,gaalo-:-Akiid al-muluuk dool yiddaawaso ambeenaathum be l-seef.Hassa' da,ya l-Muwaabiyiin,gummu le l-kasiibe-!
Wa humman garrabo le mu'askar Bani Israa'iil.Wa tawwaali,Bani Israa'iil gammo wa hajamoohum le l-Muwaabiyiin wa humman arrado min Bani Israa'iil.Wa humman macho waraahum lahaddi dakhalo fi baladhum wa dammaroohum marra waahid.
Wa Bani Israa'iil dammaro mudunhum wa ayyi waahid daffag hajar wa malo kulla l-ziraa'a wa dafano kulla uyuun al-almi wa gata'o al-chadar al-adiil.Wa fi akhiir faddalat illa hillit Khiir Haaras.Wa laakin al-naas al-induhum miglaa' hawwagooha wa hajamooha hi kula.
Wa wakit malik balad Muwaab chaaf kadar al-harib da bigi leyah chadiid bilheen,chaal 700 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf wa yidooru yuchuggu min jiihat malik balad Adoom.Wa laakin ma gidro.
Wa malik balad Muwaab chaal wileedah al-bikir al-waajib yahkim ba'adah wa rafa' fi raas durdur al-hille wa gaddamah dahiiye muharraga.Wa khadab chadiid nazal fi Bani Israa'iil wa humman kasso min malik balad Muwaab wa gabbalo baladhum.
Wa fi mara armala al-raajilha awwal hu min majmuu'at al-anbiya.Hi jaat chahadat Alyasa' wa gaalat leyah-:-Abdak raajli maat wa inta ta'arfah kadar abdak khaayif min Allah.Wa daahu siid deen waahid ja wa gaal yichiil iyaali al-itneen wa yisawwiihum abiid.
Wa Alyasa' gaal leeha-:-Tidoori nisawwi leeki chunu-?Ooriini indiki chunu fi l-beet-? Wa hi raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Khaadmak indaha illa gazzaaza hint dihin.
Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Amchi as'ale min jiiraanki mawaa'iin yaabsiin wa katiiriin,ma chiyya.
Wa wakit tijiibiihum,adkhuli fi beetki wa siddi al-baab foogki wa foog iyaalki.Wa subbi al-dihin fi kulla l-mawaa'iin dool wa ayyi maa'uun kan malaan khalaas,khuttiih taraf.
Wa khalaas,hi gammat machat wa saddat al-baab foogha wa foog iyaalha.Wa humman gaa'idiin yantuuha al-mawaa'iin wa hi tamlaahum.
Wa wakit al-mawaa'iin anmalo khalaas,gaalat le wileedha-:-Antiini maa'uun aakhar battaan. Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Ma fi maa'uun aakhar. Wa tawwaali,al-dihin wagaf ma gaa'id yusubb.
Wa khalaas,al-mara gammat machat bakaan nabi Allah wa khabbaratah be l-cheyy al-kaan.Wa hu gaal leeha-:-Amchi bii'i al-dihin da wa kaffi beyah deenki.Wa l-faddal kamaan,iichu beyah inti wa iyaalki.
Yoom waahid,Alyasa' ja faayit be hillit Chuunam.Wa fi l-hille di,fiyah mara khaniiye talabat minnah achaan yaji yaakul fi beetha.Wa min al-yoom da,ayyi wakit kan Alyasa' faayit,yakhchaaha achaan yaakul fi bakaanha.
Wa l-mara di gaalat le raajilha-:-Al-raajil al-daayman gaa'id yaji leena da,ana na'arfah hu nabi mukhassas le Allah.
Hassa' da,khalli nabnu leyah kuuzi sakhayyar fi l-gasir foog.Wa nukhuttu fi lubbah sariir wa tarabeeza wa ga''aada wa faanuus achaan kan yoom ja leena,yargud fi l-kuuzi da.
Wa yoom waahid,Alyasa' ja fi bakaanhum wa anjamma fi l-kuuzi al-fi l-gasir da wa ragad.
Wa gaal le khaddaamah Gihaazi-:-Naadi leyi al-Chuunamiiye di. Wa Gihaazi naadaaha wa hi jaat wa wagafat giddaamah.
Wa Alyasa' gaal le khaddaamah-:-Guul leeha-:--Inti ti'ibti katiir fi chaanna.Tidoori nisawwu leeki chunu-?Tidoori nihajju le l-malik wa le khaayid al-deech fi chaanki walla-?-- Wa hi raddat wa gaalat-:-La-!Ana aayche be l-salaama fi usut ahali.
Wa Alyasa' gaal le khaddaamah-:-Kan ke da,nisawwi leeha chunu-? Wa khaddaamah Gihaazi radda leyah wa gaal-:-Hi ma indaha iyaal wa raajilha kula chaayib.
Wa Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Naadiiha battaan-! Wa hu naadaaha.Wa hi jaat wa wagafat fi khachum al-baab.
Wa Alyasa' gaal leeha-:-Fi nafs al-wakit fi l-sana al-jaaye,takurbi wileed fi hudunki. Wa laakin al-mara gaalat-:-La-!Ya siidi nabi Allah,ma takdib le khaadmak.
Wa khalaas,fi nafs al-wakit hana l-sana al-aakhara,al-mara di bigat khalbaane.Wa hi wildat wileed hasab al-kalaam al-Alyasa' gaalah leeha.
Wa l-wileed kibir.Wa yoom waahid,al-wileed macha wara abuuh al-gaa'id yakhdim ma'a l-naas al-yagta'o al-khalla fi l-zere'.
Wa khalaas,al-wileed gamma yabki le abuuh wa gaal-:-Raasi-!Raasi booja'ni-! Wa abuuh gaal le khaddaamah-:-Chiilah wa waddiih le ammah.
Wa l-khaddaam chaalah wa waddaah le ammah.Wa l-wileed ragad fi rijileen ammah lahaddi l-gaayle wa ba'ad da,maat.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,ammah tala'at beyah fi l-kuuzi hana nabi Allah wa raggadatah fi l-sariir wa saddat foogah al-baab wa maragat.
Wa hi naadat raajilha wa gaalat leyah-:-Min fadlak,rassil leyi waahid min al-khaddaamiin wa humaara min al-hamiir achaan namchi ajala bakaan nabi Allah wa nigabbil.
Wa raajilha sa'alha wa gaal-:-Maala tidoori tamchi leyah al-yoom-?Al-yoom wa la iid hana awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa la yoom al-sabt. Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Aafe bas.
Wa hi chaddat al-humaara wa gaalat le khaddaamha-:-Waddiini ajala-!Ma tagiif fi l-derib kan ana ma gult leek cheyy.
Wa hi machat wara nabi Allah fi jabal al-Karmal.Wa wakit nabi Allah chaafha min ba'iid gaal le khaddaamah Gihaazi-:-Di hi al-mara al-min hillit Chuunam.
Hassa' da,gumm ajri laagiiha wa as'alha guul leeha-:--Keef haalki-?Raajilki aafe walla-?Wa wileedki kula aafe walla-?-- Wa hi gaalat-:-Aafe-!
Wa wakit wassalat fi raas al-jabal bakaan nabi Allah kamaan,karabat rijileenah.Wa Gihaazi garrab leeha achaan yitarrifha wa laakin nabi Allah gaal leyah-:-Khalliiha-!Hi haznaane wa Allah labbadah minni ma khabbaraani beyah.
Wa khalaas,hi gaalat leyah-:-Hal ana sa'alt sakhiir min siidi-?Gabul da kula,ana ma gult leek ma takdib leyi walla-?
Wa Alyasa' gaal le Gihaazi-:-Gumm arbut sulbak wa chiil asaati di fi iidak wa amchi-!Wa kan lammeet ma'a naadum fi l-derib,ma tisallimah wa kan naadum sallamaak kula,ma turudd leyah.Wa khutt asaati di fi wijh al-wileed.
Wa amm al-wileed gaalat-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy wa be hayaatak inta kadar ana ma namchi balaak inta min al-bakaan da. Wa khalaas,Alyasa' gamma macha ma'aaha.
Wa Gihaazi gaddam leehum wa khatta al-asa fi wijih al-wileed.Wa laakin ma fi haraka wa la alaama hint haya.Wa hu gabbal bakaan al-nabi wa khabbarah wa gaal leyah-:-Al-wileed ma gamma.
Wa wakit Alyasa' wassal fi l-beet,ligi al-wileed mayyit wa raagid fi sariirah.
Wa Alyasa' dakhal wa sadda al-baab foogah ma'a l-wileed wa chahad Allah.
Wa hu rikib fi l-sariir wa anbatah min foog le l-wileed wa lamma khachmah ma'a khachum al-wileed wa uyuunah ma'a uyuun al-wileed wa iideenah ma'a iideen al-wileed.Wa hu almattat min foog leyah lahaddi jisim al-wileed himi.
Wa Alyasa' dalla min al-sariir wa raayikh jaay wa jaay fi lubb al-kuuzi wa ba'adeen,gabbal almattat battaan min foog le l-wileed.Wa khalaas,al-wileed attach sab'a marra wa fatah uyuunah.
Wa Alyasa' naadaah le Gihaazi wa gaal leyah-:-Naadi al-mara di. Wa hu naadaaha.Wa hi jaat le Alyasa' wa hu gaal leeha-:-Chiili wileedki.
Wa hi jaat wa waga'at fi rijileenah wa sajadat.Wa ba'ad da,chaalat wileedha wa machat.
Wa Alyasa' gabbal hillit Gilgaal.Wa fi l-wakit da,juu' chadiid gaa'id fi l-balad.Wa naas majmuu'at al-anbiya lammo wa gaa'idiin giddaamah.Wa Alyasa' gaal le khaddaamah-:-Jahhiz al-burma al-kabiire di wa sawwi churba le l-anbiya.
Wa waahid min al-anbiya macha al-kadaade achaan yifattich khadaar.Wa hu ligi fagguus al-kadaade wa mala khalagah be fawaakihah.Wa wakit gabbal,gatta'aahum wa sabbaahum fi l-burma al-jahhazooha.Wa ma fi naadum minhum ya'arif al-nabaat da hu chunu.
Wa anto al-akil le l-naas le yaakuluuh.Wa laakin wakit humman daakhooh,gammo yikooruku wa buguulu-:-Al-moot gaa'id fi lubb al-burma,ya nabi Allah-! Wa humman ma gidro yaakuluuh.
Wa nabi Allah gaal-:-Jiibu leyi dagiig. Wa hu sabba al-dagiig da fi l-burma wa gaal-:-Antuuhum yaakuluuh. Achaan al-churba battaan ma fasle.
Wa yoom waahid,naadum ja min Ba'al Chaliicha.Jaab le nabi Allah khubza min al-intaaj al-awwal wa da 20 khubza min dagiig al-gameh al-abyad wa gameh jadiid kula fi mukhlaatah.Wa Alyasa' gaal le khaddaamah-:-Antiihum le l-naas yaakulu.
Wa khaddaamah gaal leyah-:-Kikkeef tidoor nigassimah le 100 naadum-? Wa Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Antiihum le l-naas yaakulu achaan daahu Allah gaal-:--Ayyi waahid yaakul wa yifaddilah.-
Wa khalaas,al-khaddaam gassam al-akil da le l-naas.Wa kulluhum akalo lahaddi faddalooh kula.Wa da bigi hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa fiyah khaayid deech hana malik balad Araam al-usmah Na'amaan.Wa hu naadum muhimm le siidah al-malik wa hu radyaan beyah achaan beyah hu bas Allah anta al-nasur le balad Araam.Wa hu raajil faaris marra waahid wa laakin mujaddim.
Wa naas balad Araam macho nahabo mamlakat Israa'iil wa chaalo kasiibe wa fi l-kasiibe di,karabo leehum bineeye.Wa l-bineeye di jaabooha khaddaama le marit Na'amaan.
Wa yoom waahid,al-bineeye gaalat le sittaha-:-Kan siidi yagdar yamchi le l-nabi al-gaa'id fi madiinat al-Saamira,hu yachfiih min al-jidaam da.
Wa Na'amaan ja hajja be l-kalaam da le siidah al-malik wa gaal-:-Al-bineeye al-min mamlakat Israa'iil hajjat kalaam misil da misil da.
Wa malik Araam gaal leyah-:-Gumm amchi-!Wa ana nirassil ma'aak jawaab le malik mamlakat Israa'iil.-Wa Na'amaan gamma macha wa chaal ma'aayah 340 kiilo hana fudda wa 70 kiilo hana dahab wa 10 khulgaan hana khiyaar.
Wa wakit wassal fi madiinat al-Saamira,gaddam al-jawaab da le malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa fi l-jawaab da maktuub-:-Hassa' nirassil leek al-jawaab da ma'a abdi Na'amaan achaan tachfiih min al-jidaam da.
Wa ba'ad gara al-jawaab da,malik mamlakat Israa'iil charrat khulgaanah min al-hizin wa gaal-:-Ana Allah walla-?Naktul wa nahayi al-naas walla-?Kikkeef malik balad Araam yirassil leyi naadum wa yuguul nachfiih min al-jidaam da-?Be da,chiifu wa a'arfu kadar hu yidoor yisawwi ma'aayi muchkila bas-!
Wa wakit Alyasa' nabi Allah simi' kadar malik mamlakat Israa'iil charrat khulgaanah da,rassal leyah wa gaal-:-Maala inta charratt khulgaanak-?Khalli al-raajil da yaji leyi wa be da,hu ya'arif kadar fi nabi fi mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,Na'amaan ja be kheelah wa arabatah wa wagaf fi madkhal beet Alyasa'.
Wa Alyasa' rassal khaddaamah achaan yuguul leyah-:-Amchi albarrad sab'a marraat fi bahar al-Urdun.Wa talga al-aafe wa jismak yabga taahir.
Wa Na'amaan gamma macha za'laan wa gaal-:-Fi fikri,nahsib al-nabi zaatah yaji yagiif giddaami wa yas'al be usum Allah Ilaahah wa yukhutt iidah fi l-bakaan al-mardaan wa yachfiini min al-jidaam.
Hal buhuur hana madiinat Dimachkh misil bahar Abaana wa bahar Farfar,humman dool ma akheer min almi hana mamlakat Israa'iil walla-?Hal ma nilbarrad fi lubbuhum wa nabga taahir walla-? Wa gamma mugabbil za'laan.
Wa laakin khaddaamiinah garrabo wa hajjo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ya abuuna-!Kan al-nabi talab minnak cheyy gaasi kula,ma tisawwiih walla-?Wa maala taaba kan hu yuguul leek tamchi tilbarrad wa tabga taahir-?
Wa khalaas,Na'amaan nazal fi bahar al-Urdun wa albarrad sab'a marra hasab kalaam nabi Allah.Wa jismah bigi misil jisim al-wileed al-sakhayyar wa hu bigi taahir.
Wa tawwaali,hu wa naasah gabbalo bakaan nabi Allah.Wa wakit wassalo hinaak,Na'amaan gaal-:-Hassa' da,ana na'arif kadar fi kulla l-ard,ma fi Ilaah illa fi balad Israa'iil.Min fadlak,akhbal minni ana abdak al-hadiiye al-nigaddimha leek.
Wa Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy al-ana gaa'id na'abudah,ana ma nakhbal al-hadiiye di. Wa Na'amaan asarah achaan yichiilha wa laakin hu aba.
Wa Na'amaan gaal leyah-:-Kan inta abeet ma tichiil minni al-hadiiye di,hassa' da khalliini nichidd bikhaal itneen be turaab hana baladak achaan ana abdak ma nidoor battaan nigaddim wa la dahiiye muharraga wa la dahiiye aakhara le ilaahaat aakhariin bala Allah.
Wa laakin ana natlub min Allah yakhfir leyi ana abdak fi cheyy waahid.Wakit siidi al-malik yadkhul fi beet al-ibaada hana ilaahah Rimmuun le yasjud giddaam ilaahah Rimmuun,hu yintaki fi iidi.Wa waajib ana kula nasjud.Wa be da,khalli Allah yakhfir leyi ana abdak fi l-cheyy da.
Wa Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Amchi be l-salaama. Wa hu gamma macha ba'iid minnah.
Wa Gihaazi khaddaam Alyasa' nabi Allah gaal fi nafsah-:-Siidi aba ma yichiil al-hadiiye al-gaddamaaha leyah Na'amaan al-min balad Araam.Wa laakin nahlif be Allah al-Hayy kadar najri waraayah wa akiid nalga minnah cheyy.
Wa khalaas,Gihaazi jara wara Na'amaan.Wa wakit Na'amaan chaafah jaari waraayah,dalla ajala min arabatah wa macha laaga wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Maalak,ma aafe walla-?
Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aafe-!Siidi bas rassalaani leek wa gaal-:--Fiyah subyaan tineen min majmuu'at al-anbiya jo leyi hassa' min jibaal Afraayim.Wa hu yatlub minnak tanti leehum 35 kiilo hana fudda wa khulgaan itneen hana khiyaar.-
Wa Na'amaan gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak,chiil 70 kiilo hana fudda-! Wa hu asarah le Gihaazi wa sabba leyah 70 kiilo hana fudda fi itneen makhaali wa l-khulgaan hana l-khiyaar kula.Wa antaahum le itneen min khaddaamiinah wa humman chaaloohum wa macho giddaam Gihaazi.
Wa wakit wassalo fi l-jabal jamb madkhal al-hille,Gihaazi chaal al-khumaam min iideehum wa khattaah fi beetah wa gaal le l-khaddaamiin dool khalli yigabbulu.Wa khalaas humman faato.
Wa Gihaazi macha bakaan siidah.Wa Alyasa' sa'alah wa gaal leyah-:-Inta jaayi min ween,Gihaazi-? Wa hu radda wa gaal-:-Abdak ma macha ayyi bakaan.
Wa laakin Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Inta ma ta'arif kadar kan ana ma ma'aak kula,galbi yichiifak-?Wakit al-raajil da dalla be ajala min arabatah wa ja laagaak ana chiftak.Hal da l-wakit al-waajib inta tichiil gurus walla khulgaan walla zaytuun walla inab walla bagar walla khanam walla abiid walla khadiim-?
Wa be sabab da,jidaam Na'amaan yakurbak inta wa zurriiytak ila l-abad.-Wa khalaas,Gihaazi marag min bakaan Alyasa' wa jildah abyad karr misil al-gutun min jidaam.
Wa yoom waahid,naas majmuu'at al-anbiya gaalo le Alyasa'-:-Chiif,al-bakaan al-gaa'idiin nilimmu ma'aak foogah da bigi leena dayyig.
Hassa' da,khalliina namchu al-Urdun wa ayyi waahid minnina yagta' murdaas waahid achaan nabnu leena bakaan al-nagoodu foogah. Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Amchu-!
Wa waahid min al-majmuu'a gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak,nidoor taji ma'a khaddaamiinak. Wa Alyasa' gaal-:-Sameh-!Naji.
Wa hu macha ma'aahum.Wa humman wassalo al-Urdun wa gata'o chadar.
Wa wakit waahid minhum gaa'id yagta' leyah murdaas,al-faas nasalat wa waga'at fi lubb al-almi.Wa l-raajil sarakh wa gaal-:-Haay,ya siidi-!Al-faas di ana al'attaltaha atiile.
Wa nabi Allah sa'alah wa gaal-:-Waga'at ween-? Wa hu wassaf leyah al-bakaan.Wa Alyasa' gata' uud wa zagalah fi nafs al-bakaan al-waga'at foogah al-faas.Wa khalaas,al-faas taahat foog fi raas al-almi.
Wa ba'ad da,Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Amrug al-faas-! Wa l-raajil madda iidah wa chaalha.
Wa fi l-wakit al-malik balad Araam gaa'id yihaarib foogah mamlakat Israa'iil da,hu lamma masaa'iilah wa wassaf leehum al-bakaan al-yidoor yukhutt foogah mu'askarah.
Wa tawwaali,al-nabi Alyasa' rassal wa gaal le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-:-Angari' ma tufuut be l-bakaan da achaan askar balad Araam nazalo foogah.
Wa khalaas,malik mamlakat Israa'iil rassal naas le yiraakhubu al-bakaan al-wassafaahum leyah nabi Allah.Wa l-cheyy da,kaan iddat marraat wa nabi Allah yikhabbir al-malik achaan yibaari al-bakaan da.
Wa khalaas,malik Araam galbah khaaf marra waahid.Wa lamma kulla masaa'iilah wa gaal leehum-:-Wassufuuni yaatu al-naadum al-minnina al-andamma le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-?
Wa waahid min masaa'iilah gaal leyah-:-Ma fi naadum,ya siidi al-malik-!Laakin Alyasa' al-nabi al-gaa'id fi mamlakat Israa'iil,hu bas yagdar yihajji le malik mamlakat Israa'iil be kulla l-kalaam al-inta tuguulah hatta fi khurfitak al-tunuum foogah kula.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Yalla amchu wa chiifu al-bakaan al-hu gaa'id foogah wa nirassil naas le yakurbuuh. Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Hu gaa'id fi Dutaan.
Wa tawwaali,al-malik rassal askar katiiriin be kheel wa arabaat.Wa humman wassalo be leel wa hawwago al-hille.
Wa khaddaam nabi Allah gamma be fajur badri wa marag.Wa daahu chaaf askar katiiriin hawwago al-hille be kheel wa arabaat.Wa l-khaddaam gaal le siidah-:-Haay,ya siidi-!Nisawwu kikkeef-?
Wa siidah radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ma takhaaf-!Achaan humman al-gaa'idiin ma'aana katiiriin ziyaada min al-gaa'idiin ma'aahum.
Wa Alyasa' chahad Allah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah,aftah uyuunah achaan yichiif-! Wa Allah fatah uyuun al-khaddaam wa chaaf al-jabal malaan be kheel wa arabaat hana naar muhawwigiin Alyasa'.
Wa askar al-Araamiyiin wajjaho ale Alyasa'.Wa hu chahad Allah wa gaal-:-Min fadlak,adrub al-naas dool yabgo amyaaniin-! Wa tawwaali,Allah darabaahum wa bigo amyaaniin hasab kalaam Alyasa'.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Alyasa' gaal le l-askar dool-:-Al-derib da ma be hini wa l-hille kula ma be hini.Taabu'uuni wa niwaddiiku bakaan al-raajil al-intu gaa'idiin tifattuchuuh. Wa khalaas,hu waddaahum fi madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa wakit dakhalo al-Saamira,Alyasa' chahad Allah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah,aftah uyuun al-naas dool wa khalli yichiifu. Wa khalaas,Allah fatah uyuunhum wa humman chaafo wa irfo kadar gaa'idiin daakhal fi l-Saamira.
Wa wakit malik mamlakat Israa'iil chaafaahum,gaal le Alyasa'-:-Ya abuuyi-!Waajib leyi naktulhum walla-?
Wa laakin Alyasa' gaal le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-:-Ma taktulhum-!Fi l-waajib inta taktul al-masaajiin hana l-harib be seefak wa nuchchaabak walla-?Hassa' da,antiihum khubza yaakulu wa almi yacharbo.Wa ba'ad da,khalliihum yamchu le siidhum.
Wa khalaas,al-malik sawwa aazuuma kabiire.Wa humman akalo wa chirbo wa ba'ad da,khallaahum macho le siidhum.Wa min al-yoom da,battaan naas balad Araam ma jo nahabo mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad al-cheyy al-kaan da,Banhadaad malik Araam lamma kulla askarah wa macha yahjim madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa fi l-wakit da,fi juu' chadiid fi l-Saamira.Wa l-juu' da bigi chadiid ziyaada lahaddi akil hawaan kula bigi khaali.Raas humaar tamanah bigi 80 hajar fudda wa nuss kooro hana huraar al-hamaam kula bigi 5 hajar fudda.
Wa yoom waahid,malik mamlakat Israa'iil faayit fi raas al-durdur hana l-madiina.Wa mara waahide chaafatah wa koorakat leyah wa gaalat-:-Ya siidi al-malik,afza'ni-!
Wa l-malik radda leeha wa gaal-:-Kan Allah ma faza'ki,ana nagdar nafza'ki be chunu-?Wa la fi gameh wa la fi khamar.
Wa l-malik gaal leeha battaan-:-Inti tidoori chunu-? Wa hi raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Al-mara di gaalat leyi-:--Jiibi wileedki naakuluuh al-yoom wa ambaakir kamaan,naakulu wileedi.--
Wa aniina rakkabna wileedi wa akalnaah.Wa ambaakir,ana gult leeha-:--Jiibi wileedki naakuluuh.- Wa taari hi labbadatah.
Wa wakit al-malik simi' kalaam al-mara di,charrat khulgaanah min al-hizin.Wa wakit hu faayit fi durdur al-madiina battaan,al-naas gidro chaafo kadar al-malik laabis khulgaan hana chuwaal be tihit le khulgaanah hana l-muluk.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Khalli al-Rabb yi'aakhibni ikhaab chadiid kan al-yoom ma gata't raas Alyasa' wileed Chaafaat.
Wa Alyasa' gaa'id fi beetah ma'a chuyuukh al-madiina wa l-malik rassal leyah naadum.Wa laakin gubbaal al-mursaal da ma yawsal ke,Alyasa' gaal le l-chuyuukh-:-Chiifu wald kattaal al-dimam da rassal naadum le yagta' raasi.Khuttu baalku-!Kan chiftu al-mursaal da wassal,siddu al-baab wa adharooh ma yadkhul.Wa hassa',ma gaa'idiin tasma'o harakat rijle sayyidah waraayah walla-?
Wa lissaa' Alyasa' ma kammal kalaamah ke bas,al-malik wassal.Wa gaal le Alyasa'-:-Kulla l-masiibe di jaayi min Allah-!Wa hal indi acham foogah battaan walla-?
Wa Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Asma'o kalaam Allah-!Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ambaakir fi nafs al-saa'a fi khachum baab madiinat al-Saamira,yachru 3 kooro hana dagiig gameh ahmar aw 6 kooro hana gameh abyad be hajar waahid bas hana fudda.-
Wa l-khaayid al-muraafig al-malik hajja le nabi Allah wa gaal-:-Kan Allah yaftah biibaan al-sama kula,hal kalaamak al-gultah da yilhaggag-? Wa Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Tichiifah be eenak wa laakin ma taakul minnah-!
Wa fiyah arba'a rujaal mujaddimiin gaa'idiin fi khachum baab al-madiina.Wa humman gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Maala nagoodu hini wa narjo al-moot-?
Hassa' da,kan nuguulu nadkhulu fi lubb al-madiina,numuutu min al-juu' wa kan nagoodu hini kula,numuutu.Wa be da,khalli namchu nisallumu nufuusna fi mu'askar al-Araamiyiin.Kan khalloona,ni'iichu wa kan kataloona kamaan,numuutu.
Wa khalaas fi wakt al-makhrib,al-mujaddimiin gammo macho fi mu'askar al-Araamiyiin.Wa wakit wassalo fi taraf al-mu'askar,ma ligo naadum waahid kula
achaan al-Rabb khalla al-Araamiyiin yasma'o haraka chadiide hana arabaat al-harib wa hana kheel wa hana askar.Wa humman gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Daahu malik mamlakat Israa'iil ajjar muluuk al-Hittiyiin wa l-Masriyiin le yugummu diddina.
Wa khalaas,askar al-Araamiyiin gammo wa arrado be makhrib wa khallo khiyamhum wa kheelhum wa hamiirhum.Wa khallo mu'askarhum fi haalah misil awwal le yinajju nufuushum.
Wa wakit al-rujaal al-mujaddimiin dool wassalo fi taraf al-mu'askar,dakhalo fi kheema waahide akalo wa chirbo.Wa chaalo min hinaak fudda wa dahab wa khulgaan wa macho labbadoohum.Wa gabbalo battaan wa dakhalo fi kheema aakhara wa chaalo khumaam min hinaak kula wa macho labbadooh.
Wa ba'ad da,gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Al-cheyy al-aniina gaa'idiin nisawwuuh da ma adiil.Al-yoom da,yoom hana khabar halu-!Wa kan sakatna ma ballakhnaah lahaddi l-sabaah da,aniina khaatiyiin.Hassa' da,ta'aalu niwaddu al-khabar fi gasir al-malik.
Wa humman macho wa naado al-haaris hana baab al-madiina wa gaalo leyah-:-Aniina macheena fi mu'askar al-Araamiyiin wa ma ligiina naadum wa la simi'na hiss insaan.Wa illa faddalo bas al-kheel wa l-hamiir marbuutiin wa l-khiyam kula khalloohum.
Wa l-haaris naada naadum waahid min daakhal wa hu macha wadda al-khabar fi gasir al-malik.
Wa l-malik gamma be l-leel wa gaal le masaa'iilah-:-Asma'o-!Ni'ooriiku be l-cheyy al-Araamiyiin yidooru yisawwuuh leena.Humman ya'arfu kadar aniina jii'aaniin.Wa gammo marago min mu'askarhum achaan yillabbado leena fi l-kadaade wa yuguulu-:--Al-muhaasariin dool yamurgu min al-madiina wa khalaas,nikarrubuuhum hayyiin wa nadkhulu fi l-madiina.-
Wa waahid min masaa'iil al-malik radda leyah wa gaal-:-Hassa' da,khalli nichiilu khamsa min al-kheel al-faddalo fi l-madiina.Be l-aks kan yagoodu kula,al-kheel dool yumuutu ma'a sukkaan al-madiina.Wa khalli naas yarkabo fooghum wa yamchu yichiifu al-cheyy al-hasal hinaak.
Wa jahhazo arabaat itneen be kheelhum wa l-malik rassal naas wara askar al-Araamiyiin.Wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu akkudu min al-cheyy al-hasal.
Wa khalaas,al-naas dool gammo wa macho wara l-askar lahaddi bahar al-Urdun.Wa chaafo al-derib malaan be khulgaan wa khumaam al-Araamiyiin al-daffagooh wakit mu'arridiin.Wa khalaas,al-naas dool gabbalo wa khabbaro al-malik.
Wa tawwaali,naas madiinat al-Saamira marago wa macho kasabo mu'askar al-Araamiyiin.Wa be misil da,humman charo 3 kooro hana dagiig gameh ahmar aw 6 kooro hana gameh abyad be hajar waahid bas hana fudda.Wa da bigi hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa l-malik kallaf al-khaayid al-muraafgah le yiraakhib khachum baab al-madiina.Wa laakin al-cha'ab fajjakhooh wa hu maat misil nabi Allah gaalah wakit al-malik macha leyah.
Achaan awwal al-nabi gaal-:-Ambaakir fi nafs al-saa'a fi khachum baab madiinat al-Saamira,yachru 6 kooro hana gameh abyad aw 3 kooro hana dagiig gameh ahmar be hajar waahid bas hana fudda.
Wa l-khaayid al-muraafig al-malik radda le nabi Allah wa gaal-:-Kan Allah yaftah biibaan al-sama kula,hal kalaamak al-gultah da yilhaggag-? Wa fi l-wakit da,Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Tichiifah be eenak wa laakin ma taakul minnah-!
Wa da l-cheyy al-hasal le l-khaayid da.Al-cha'ab fajjakhooh wa hu maat fi khachum baab madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa yoom waahid,Alyasa' hajja le l-mara al-awwal hayya leeha wileedha wa gaal-:-Gummi inti wa aayilitki wa amchi alja'e fi l-bakaan al-tagdaro ti'iichu foogah.Achaan Allah kharrar yijiib al-juu' fi l-balad di wa yagood muddit sab'a sana.
Wa khalaas,al-mara sawwat misil nabi Allah gaalah leeha.Hi gammat ma'a aayilitha wa machat sakanat sab'a sana fi balad al-Filistiyiin.
Wa ba'ad sab'a sana,al-mara gabbalat min balad al-Filistiyiin.Wa machat bakaan al-malik le tatlub minnah faza' fi cheyy al-bukhuss beetha wa zere'ha.
Wa l-malik gaa'id yihajji ma'a Gihaazi khaddaam nabi Allah wa hu gaa'id yas'alah wa yuguul leyah-:-Ooriini kulla l-ajaayib al-kubaar al-sawwaahum Alyasa'.
Wa wakit Gihaazi gaa'id yihajji le l-malik be kikkeef Alyasa' hayya al-wileed al-maat,tawwaali amm al-wileed al-hiyi jaat le tatlub min al-malik faza' fi cheyy al-bukhuss beetha wa zere'ha.Wa Gihaazi gaal le l-malik-:-Ya siidi al-malik-!Di bas al-mara al-Alyasa' hayya leeha wileedha.
Wa l-malik wajjah su'aalaat le l-mara wa hi hajjat leyah be kulla cheyy al-kaan.Wa khalaas,al-malik naada waahid min masaa'iilah wa gaal leyah-:-Amchi gabbil kulla khumaam al-mara di.Wa antiiha kulla intaaj zere'ha min yoom al-hi maragat min al-balad lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa yoom waahid,Alyasa' macha madiinat Dimachkh wa fi l-wakit da,Banhadaad malik balad Araam mardaan.Wa wakit al-malik simi' kadar nabi Allah ja fi l-madiina,
gaal le Hazayiil-:-Chiil ma'aak hadiiye wa waddiiha le nabi Allah.Wa atlub minnah yas'al Allah achaan na'arif kan nalga al-aafe min maradi da walla la.
Wa khalaas,Hazayiil chaal hadiiye min al-khumaam al-ahsan hana Dimachkh wa chaddaah fi 40 jumaal wa macha le Alyasa'.Wa wakit wassal bakaanah,wagaf giddaamah wa gaal-:-Wileedak Banhadaad malik Araam rassalaani leek wa gaal-:--Ana nalga al-aafe min maradi da walla la-?-
Wa Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Amchi guul leyah hu yalga al-aafe-!Wa laakin akiid Allah bayyan leyi kadar hu yumuut.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Alyasa' gamma yihammirah le Hazayiil daakhal fi eenah lahaddi al-eeb sawwaah.Wa ba'ad da,nabi Allah baka.
Wa Hazayiil gaal-:-Maala sayyidi gaa'id yabki-? Wa Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Achaan ana na'arif al-fasaala al-ba'adeen inta tisawwiiha le Bani Israa'iil.Titichch mudunhum al-gawiyiin wa taktul subyaanhum be l-seef wa tidammir iyaalhum al-dugaag wa tuchugg butuun awiinhum al-khalbaanaat.
Wa Hazayiil gaal leyah-:-Wa laakin kikkeef ana abdak al-misil al-kalib nagdar nisawwi cheyy misil da-? Wa Alyasa' radda leyah wa gaal-:-Allah bayyan leyi kadar inta tabga malik fi balad Araam.
Wa khalaas,Hazayiil khallaah le Alyasa' wa gabbal bakaan siidah.Wa siidah sa'alah wa gaal-:-Alyasa' gaal leek chunu-? Wa hu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Hu gaal leyi akiid inta talga al-aafe.
Wa ambaakir,Hazayiil balla khattaay wa khatta beeha wijh al-malik wa l-malik maat.Wa Hazayiil hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi l-sana al-khaamse hana hukum Yuuraam wileed Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Yahuuraam wileed Yahuuchafat bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Yahuuraam indah 32 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 8 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu taaba' derib muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil misil aayilat Akhaab sawwatah achaan hu akhad bineeyit Akhaab.Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.
Wa be da kula,Allah ma dawwar yidammir mamlakat Yahuuza fi chaan abdah Dawuud.Achaan hu waa'adah wa gaal leyah daayman naadum waahid min zurriiytah yagood fi l-muluk.
Wa fi hukum Yahuuraam malik mamlakat Yahuuza,naas balad Adoom atmarrado didd hukmah wa darrajo leehum malik aakhar.
Wa Yahuuraam gamma wa macha Sa'iir wa chaal ma'aayah kulla arabaatah hana l-harib le yihaarubu al-Adoomiyiin.Wa be l-leel,al-Adoomiyiin hawwagoohum wa laakin Yahuuraam wa kubaaraat arabaatah hana l-harib gammo haaraboohum.Wa laakin askarah arrado macho buyuuthum.
Wa l-tamarrud hana balad Adoom didd hukum Yahuuraam gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.Wa fi l-wakit da,hillit Libna kula atmarradat didd hukmah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahuuraam wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa Yahuuraam maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Akhazya hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 12 hana hukum Yuuraam wileed Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Akhazya wileed Yahuuraam bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Akhazya indah 22 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam sana waahide fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Atalya min aayilat Umri malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa Akhazya taaba' derib aayilat Akhaab wa sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil aayilat Akhaab sawwatah achaan hu akhad min aayilat Akhaab.
Wa Akhazya macha ma'a Yuuraam wileed Akhaab wa haarabooh Hazayiil malik Araam fi hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad.Wa l-Araamiyiin jarahooh le Yuuraam.
Wa l-malik Yuuraam gabbal fi hillit Yazra'iil le yi'aalij al-jiraah al-jarahooh al-Araamiyiin wakit gaa'id yihaarib didd Hazayiil malik Araam.Wa Akhazya wileed Yahuuraam malik mamlakat Yahuuza macha yichiif Yuuraam wileed Akhaab achaan hu ta'baan.
Wa l-nabi Alyasa' naada sabi waahid min majmuu'at al-anbiya wa gaal leyah-:-Arbut sulbak wa chiil al-gazzaaza hint al-dihin di fi iidak wa amchi hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad.
Wa hinaak,algaah le Yaahu wileed Yahuuchafat wileed Nimchi.Wa gawwimah wa tarrifah min rufgaanah wa waddiih fi khurfa chiyya taraf.
Wa chiil al-dihin da wa subbah leyah fi raasah wa guul leyah-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Be da,ana darrajtak malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil-!"- Wa ba'ad da,khalaas aftah al-baab wa arrid ma ti'akhkhir.
Wa l-nabi al-sabi gamma wa macha hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad.
Wa wakit al-nabi da wassal,ligi kubaaraat al-askar gaa'idiin sawa.Wa hu gaal-:-Ya kabiir al-askar,indi kalaam nidoor ni'ooriik. Wa Yaahu sa'alah wa gaal leyah-:-Le yaatu minnina-? Wa hu radda wa gaal-:-Leek inta,ya kabiir al-askar.
Wa Yaahu gamma wa dakhal fi lubb al-beet.Wa l-nabi al-sabi sabba al-dihin fi raasah wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Be da,ana darrajtak malik fi cha'ab Allah,fi mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa tidammir aayilat siidak Akhaab.Wa ana nichiil al-taar hana abiidi al-anbiya wa hana khaddaamiini al-aakhariin al-katalathum Izabiil marit Akhaab.
Aywa,kulla aayilat Akhaab yumuutu.Nidammir kulla l-rujaal min aayiltah kan abiid walla hurriin kula fi lubb Bani Israa'iil.
Wa nisawwi aayilat Akhaab tabga misil aayilat Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat wa misil aayilat Ba'aacha wileed Akhiiya.
Wa kan le Izabiil kamaan,al-kulaab yaakuluuha fi ard Yazra'iil wa naadum al-yasturha kula ma fiih.-- Wa khalaas,al-nabi fatah al-baab wa arrad.
Wa Yaahu marag ja le masaa'iil siidah al-malik wa humman sa'alooh wa gaalo leyah-:-Hal aafe bas-?Maala al-muchootin da ja leek-? Wa Yaahu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Intu ta'arfu al-naas al-misil dool wa kalaamhum al-saakit bas.
Wa laakin humman gaalo leyah-:-Kalaamak da ma sahiih-!Ooriina al-kalaam al-hu gaalah leek. Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Daahu al-kalaam al-kallamaani.Hu gaal-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Be sabbiin dihin fi raasak da,ana darrajtak malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil."-
Wa tawwaali,ayyi waahid chaal khalagah wa khattaah fi l-ataba tihit rijileen Yaahu.Wa darabo al-buug wa gaalo-:-Yi'iich al-malik Yaahu-!
Wa be da,Yaahu wileed Yahuuchafat wileed Nimchi atmarrad didd malikah Yuuraam.Wa Yuuraam wa kulla mamlakat Israa'iil gaa'idiin yahfado hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad min hujuum Hazayiil malik balad Araam.
Wa l-malik Yuuraam ja le yi'aalij nafsah fi hillit Yazra'iil min al-jiraah al-jarahooh leyah al-Araamiyiin.Wa khalaas,Yaahu gaal le kubaaraat al-askar al-ma'aayah-:-Kan intu mukhassidiin ma'aayi,khalli naadum ma yamrug min hini le yamchi yi'ooruuhum fi hillit Yazra'iil kadar masahooni malik.
Wa Yaahu rikib fi arabatah wa macha hillit Yazra'iil.Wa hinaak,Yuuraam raagid fi sariirah wa Akhazya malik mamlakat Yahuuza ja le yichiifah.
Wa l-haras al-gaa'id fi beet al-muraakhaba hana hillit Yazra'iil chaaf Yaahu wa naasah jaayiin wa gamma gaal-:-Gaa'id nichiif naas jaayiin. Wa Yuuraam gaal leyah-:-Rassil siid juwaad wa khalli yilaagiihum wa yas'alhum kan jayyithum di aafe bas.
Wa siid al-juwaad wassalaahum le Yaahu wa naasah wa gaal leehum-:-Daahu siidi al-malik gaal-:--Jayyitku di aafe bas-?-- Wa Yaahu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Lammaak chunu be l-aafe-?Ta'aal gabbil ma'aayi.-Wa khalaas,al-haras gaal le l-malik Yuuraam-:-Gaa'id nichiif al-mursaal wassalaahum wa laakin ma gabbal hini.
Wa l-malik rassal siid juwaad aakhar.Wa hu wassalaahum wa gaal leehum-:-Daahu siidi al-malik gaal-:--Jayyitku di aafe bas-?-- Wa Yaahu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Lammaak chunu be l-aafe-?Ta'aal gabbil ma'aayi.
Wa l-haras gaal-:-Gaa'id nichiif al-mursaal wassalaahum wa laakin ma gabbal hini.Wa ana irift al-suwaage hint al-araba,di suwaage hint Yaahu wileed Nimchi achaan hu yusuug misil majnuun.
Wa khalaas,malik Yuuraam gaal yijahhuzu leyah arabatah.Wa humman jahhazo leyah arabatah wa Yuuraam malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa Akhazya malik mamlakat Yahuuza ayyi waahid rikib fi arabatah wa macho le yilaagu Yaahu.Wa humman lihgooh fi zere' hana Naabuut al-min hillit Yazra'iil.
Wa min Yuuraam chaaf Yaahu,gaal leyah-:-Jaytak di aafe bas,ya Yaahu-? Wa Yaahu radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aafe hint chunu-?Achaan ammak Izabiil gaa'ide tichcharmat ma'a l-asnaam wa tisawwi sihir katiir kula.
Wa tawwaali,Yuuraam laffa arabatah wa arrad wa gaal le Akhazya-:-Di l-khiyaana,ya Akhazya-!
Wa laakin Yaahu chaal nubbaalah wa zarag nuchchaab wa ta'anah le Yuuraam ambeen kataafeeh.Wa l-nuchchaab chagga galbah wa marag.Wa hu maat fi lubb arabatah.
Wa Yaahu gaal le Bidkhar khaayid deechah-:-Arfa' janaaztah wa azgulha fi zere' hana Naabuut al-min hillit Yazra'iil.Wa fakkir fi kalaam Allah al-gaalah didd abuuh al-malik Akhaab wakit ana wa inta maachiin be araba waraayah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:--Amis,ana chift moot Naabuut wa iyaalah.Wa hassa',ana nilkaffa foogak nafs al-cheyy fi l-zere' da.-- Wa Yaahu gaal-:-Hassa' da,chiilha le janaazit Yuuraam wa azgulha fi l-zere' da hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah.
Wa wakit Akhazya malik mamlakat Yahuuza chaaf al-cheyy da,gamma arrad wa chaal derib hana hillit Beet Haggaan.Wa Yaahu taradah wa gaal-:-Aktuluuh hu kula-! Wa wakit Akhazya taali' ale giizaan Guur al-gariib le hillit Yibla'aam da,darabooh fi lubb arabatah.Wa hu arrad lahaddi wisil madiinat Magiddu wa maat foogha.
Wa masaa'iilah chaalooh fi araba wa waddooh Madiinat al-Khudus wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.
Akhazya bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza fi sanit 11 hana hukum Yuuraam wileed Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa wakit Yaahu jaayi daakhil fi hillit Yazra'iil,Izabiil sim'at beyah.Wa hi kahhalat uyuunha wa jammalat raasha wa gaa'ide tichiif min chubbaak al-gasir.
Wa wakit hu wassal baab al-hille,hi gaalat leyah-:-Jaytak di aafe bas,ya Zimri kattaal siidak-?
Wa hu rafa' uyuunah ale l-chubbaak wa gaal-:-Yaatu al-ma'aayi-?Yaatu-? Wa naaseen aw talaata min khaddaamiin al-meeram dangaro leyah min al-chubbaak.
Wa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Azguluuha tihit-! Wa khalaas,zagalooha min al-chubbaak wa dammaha rachcha fi l-durdur wa fi l-kheel.Wa Yaahu rikib fi janaazitha be arabatah.
Wa Yaahu dakhal fi gasir al-malik akal wa chirib.Wa ba'ad da,gaal-:-Fakkuru foog al-mal'uuna di wa asturuuha achaan hi bineeyit malik.
Wa wakit al-rujaal macho le yasturuuha,ma ligo illa adum al-raas wa l-iideenha wa l-rijileenha.
Wa humman gabbalo wa oorooh le Yaahu.Wa hu gaal-:-Da bigi hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah be waasitat abdah Iliyaas al-min hillit Tichbi.Hu gaal-:--Al-kulaab yaakulu janaazit Izabiilfi ard Yazra'iil
wa l-fadle hana jisimha kamaan tabga misil al-ba'ar al-dayyaro beyah zere' fi ard Yazra'iil.Wa naadum ma yagdar ya'arifha wa yuguul-:"Di Izabiil."-
Wa l-malik Akhaab indah 70 naas min aayiltah al-saakniin fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa Yaahu rassal jawaabaat fi l-Saamira le chuyuukh hillit Yazra'iil wa le kubaaraat al-cha'ab wa le l-naas al-mukallafiin be tarbiyat iyaal Akhaab.Wa gaal leehum-:
Intu mukallafiin be iyaal siidku wa arabaat al-harib wa l-kheel wa l-mudun al-gawiyiin wa l-silaah.Wa min talgo al-jawaab da,
fattuchu naadum zeen wa adiil min iyaal siidku wa khuttuuh fi kursi al-muluk fi gadd abuuh.Wa ba'ad da,agoodu jaahiziin le tihaarubu le tahfado aayilat siidku.
Wa wakit al-naas dool ligo al-jawaabaat,khaafo khoof chadiid wa gaalo-:-Muluuk itneen kula ma gidro foog Yaahu wa aniina kamaan nagdaro nisawwu chunu diddah-?
Wa khalaas,al-mas'uul fi gasir al-malik wa cheekh al-hille wa kubaaraat al-cha'ab wa l-naas al-mukallafiin be tarbiyat iyaal al-malik,kulluhum rassalo le Yaahu wa gaalo leyah-:-Aniina abiidak wa nisawwu kulla cheyy al-taamurna beyah.Wa naadum waahid kula,aniina ma nidarrujuuh malik.Inta sawwi kulla cheyy al-tidoorah.
Wa Yaahu katab jawaab taani wa gaal-:-Kan intu ma'aayi wa tasma'o kalaami,agta'o ruuse awlaad siidku wa jiibuuhum leyi ambaakir fajur fi nafs al-saa'a fi Yazra'iil.-Wa awlaad al-malik al-sab'iin saakniin bakaan kubaaraat al-hillaal al-mukallafiin be tarbiyithum.
Wa min al-kubaaraat dool ligo al-jawaab,khalaas gammo karaboohum le iyaal al-malik al-sab'iin wa dabahoohum wa gata'o ruuseehum.Wa ba'ad da,sabbo al-ruuse dool fi gufaf wa rassaloohum le Yaahu fi Yazra'iil.
Wa tawwaali,naadum waahid ja khabbarah le Yaahu wa gaal-:-Daahu jaabo ruuse awlaad al-malik. Wa Yaahu gaal leyah-:-Khutt al-ruuse dool fi koom itneen fi khachum baab al-hille wa khalliihum yagoodu fi bakaanhum da lahaddi fajur.
Wa be fajur,Yaahu marag wa wagaf giddaam al-cha'ab wa gaal-:-Intu bariyiin-!Ana bas atmarradt didd siidi al-malik wa kataltah.Wa laakin kulla l-naas dool,yaatu katalaahum-?
Hassa' da,a'arfu tamaam kadar ma fi kilme waahide kula min kalaam Allah al-ma tilhaggag.Allah haggag kulla kalaamah al-gaalah didd aayilat Akhaab be waasitat abdah al-nabi Iliyaas.
Wa Yaahu katal kulla l-naas al-faddalo min aayilat Akhaab al-gaa'idiin fi Yazra'iil.Wa katal kulla kubaaraatah wa rufgaanah wa rujaal al-diin al-yakhdumu leyah.Wa naadum waahid kula minhum ma faddal.
Wa ba'ad da,Yaahu macha madiinat al-Saamira.Wa fi derib hana hillit Beet Ikheed hana l-Ru'yaan,
hu lamma ma'a akhwaan Akhazya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa hu gaal leehum-:-Intu dool yaatumman-? Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aniina akhwaan Akhazya maachiin nisallumu awlaad al-malik wa awlaad al-meeram.
Wa tawwaali,Yaahu amar wa gaal-:-Yalla-!Karrubuuhum hayyiin. Khalaas,karaboohum wa ba'ad da,dabahoohum wa daffagoohum fi biir hana Beet Ikheed.Wa l-naas dool adadhum 42 raajil wa Yaahu ma khalla waahid minhum kula hayy.
Wa Yaahu gamma min al-bakaan da wa macha laagaah le Yunadaab wileed Rikaab al-hu kula jaayi leyah.Yaahu sallamah wa gaal-:-Hal niiytak mukhlisa misil niiyti ana-? Wa Yunadaab gaal-:-Aywa-! Wa Yaahu gaal leyah-:-Antiini iidak. Wa Yunadaab madda iidah wa Yaahu karabah wa rakkabah ma'aayah fi arabatah.
Wa gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal ma'aayi wa tichiif za'ali al-chadiid didd udwaan Allah. Wa Yaahu waddaah ma'aayah fi arabatah.
Wa wakit wassal fi l-Saamira,Yaahu katal kulla l-naas al-faddalo min aayilat Akhaab al-saakniin fi l-hille.Hu dammaraahum kulluhum hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah le l-nabi Iliyaas.
Wa Yaahu lamma kulla l-cha'ab wa gaal leehum-:-Akhaab abad ilaah Ba'al chiyya bas wa ana na'abudah ziyaada minnah.
Wa hassa' da,limmu kulla anbiya Ba'al wa kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin ya'abuduuh wa kulla rujaal al-diin hana Ba'al.Khalli naadum waahid kula ma yifaddil laakin kulluhum yaju leyi achaan nidoor nigaddim dahaaya le ilaah Ba'al.Wa ayyi naadum al-ma ja da,ma yi'iich. Wa laakin Yaahu hajja al-kalaam da be najaada achaan hu yidoor yidammir al-naas al-gaa'idiin ya'abudu Ba'al.
Wa Yaahu amar yikhassusu iid le Ba'al.Wa sawwo misil ke.
Wa Yaahu rassal naas fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin ya'abudu Ba'al jo wa naadum aba ma yaji da,ma fiih.Wa humman dakhalo fi beet al-ibaada hana Ba'al wa l-beet da anmala tak.
Wa Yaahu amar mas'uul khulgaan al-ibaada hana Ba'al wa gaal leyah-:-Anti khulgaan le kulla l-naas al-ya'abudu Ba'al. Wa l-mas'uul antaahum al-khulgaan.
Wa khalaas,Yaahu wa Yunadaab wileed Rikaab macho fi beet al-ibaada hana Ba'al.Wa Yaahu gaal le l-naas al-gaa'idiin ya'abudu Ba'al-:-Akkudu wa chiifu kadar fi lubbuku ma fi naadum waahid al-ya'abud Allah laakin illa l-naas al-ya'abudu ilaah Ba'al bas.
Wa Yaahu khatta 80 askar be barra wa gaal leehum-:-Kan naadum anbalas min al-naas al-ana sallamtuhum leeku dool,al-naadum al-khallaah anbalas da yumuut. Wa ba'ad da,Yaahu wa Yunadaab dakhalo fi beet al-ibaada le yigaddumu dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya aakhariin.
Wa wakit gaddamo dahaayaahum khalaas,Yaahu gaal le l-askar wa khuyyaadhum-:-Adkhulu wa aktuluuhum-!Khalli naadum waahid kula ma yi'arrid. Wa l-askar dakhalo wa kataloohum be l-seef wa khammo al-janaazaat wa daffagoohum barra min al-hille.Wa ba'ad da,al-askar macho daakhal lahaddi l-bakaan al-khaass al-gaa'id fi lubb beet al-ibaada hana Ba'al.
Wa l-hajar al-khazzooh le l-ibaada,humman ramooh wa waddooh barra wa tachchooh fi l-naar.
Wa ba'ad marago al-hajar da min beet al-ibaada,haddamo al-beet zaatah wa l-bakaan da,sawwooh wara beet aamm al-gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa be misil da bas,Yaahu gachcha ilaah Ba'al min balad Israa'iil.
Wa laakin Yaahu anrabat fi zanib Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub wa da ibaadat al-ajjaal hana l-dahab al-fi Beet Iil wa hillit Daan.
Wa yoom waahid,Allah gaal le Yaahu-:-Achaan inta sawweet al-adiil giddaami wa dammart aayilat Akhaab sawa sawa misil ana dawwartah,awlaadak yagoodu fi kursi al-muluk fi mamlakat Israa'iil lahaddi l-zurriiye al-raab'e.
Wa laakin Yaahu ma tabbag wasaaya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil be kulla galbah.Wa ma khalla minnah nafs al-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit da bas,Allah bada yangus min turaab mamlakat Israa'iil.Hazayiil malik balad Araam haarabaahum le naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi kulla huduud baladhum.
Wa hu chaal minhum al-manaatig al-sabaah le bahar al-Urdun wa da turaab Gil'aad wa ard gabaayil Gaad wa Ra'uubiin wa Manassa.Wa da min hillit Aruu'ir al-gaa'ide fi waadi Arnuun fi l-wati lahaddi turaab Gil'aad wa Baachaan fi l-munchaakh.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yaahu wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa faraasiiytah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yaahu maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa wileedah Yahuuhaaz hakam fi badalah.
Wa Yaahu hakam 28 sana fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa wakit Atalya amm Akhazya chaafat kadar wileedha maat,hi gammat tidammir kulla zurriiyit al-malik.
Wa laakin Yuuchab'a al-hi bineeyit malik Yahuuraam wa akhut Akhazya chaalat Yuwaach wileed Akhazya wa maragatah be sirr min lubb iyaal al-malik al-yidooru yaktuluuhum.Wa hi khattatah ma'a l-mara al-takurbah fi lubb makhazan al-saraayir.Wa hinna labbadannah min Atalya wa be da,hu niji min al-moot.
Wa Yuwaach ga'ad ma'aaha mulabbad fi beet Allah le muddit sitte sana.Wa fi l-wakit da,Atalya gaa'ide tahkim fi l-balad.
Wa fi l-sana al-saab'e,raajil al-diin Yahuuyada' rassal le khuyyaad al-miyaat hana l-Kariyiin wa le hurraas gasir al-malik wa jaabaahum jambah fi beet Allah.Wa hu sawwa ma'aahum mu'aahada wa hallafaahum fi beet Allah wa wassafaahum wileed al-malik.
Wa ba'ad da,hu antaahum al-amur wa gaal-:-Daahu al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwuuh.Al-tilit minku al-yichiilu al-khidme fi yoom al-sabt yaharsu gasir al-malik
wa l-tilit minku yagoodu fi khachum baab Suur wa l-tilit al-aakhar kamaan yaharsu al-baab al-gaa'id wara l-hurraas.Wa l-majmuu'aat al-talaata dool,waajib yaharsu gasir al-malik al-waahid ba'ad al-aakhar.
Wa le l-majmuu'teen al-ma yakhdumu fi yoom al-sabt,waajib yaharsu beet Allah al-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah al-malik.
Wa intu tihawwuguuh al-malik min kulli jiihe wa ayyi waahid minku be silaahah fi iidah.Wa ayyi naadum al-yidoor yadkhul fi sufuufku,aktuluuh.Wa intu tukuunu ma'a l-malik fi marigiinah wa jaytah.
Wa khalaas,khuyyaad al-miyaat sawwo kulla cheyy al-amaraahum beyah raajil al-diin Yahuuyada'.Wa ayyi khaayid minhum lamma naasah,al-naas al-kammalo khidmithum fi yoom al-sabt wa l-naas al-yichiilu khidmithum fi yoom al-sabt kula.Wa macho bakaan raajil al-diin Yahuuyada'.
Wa raajil al-diin anta le khuyyaad al-miyaat al-huraab wa l-darag hana l-malik Dawuud al-gaa'idiin fi beet Allah.
Wa l-hurraas gaa'idiin fi bakaanhum,ayyi waahid be silaahah fi iidah.Wa rasso min nuss al-zeene hana beet Allah lahaddi nuss al-isra giddaam al-beet wa l-madbah le yihawwugu al-malik.
Wa khalaas,Yahuuyada' marag wileed al-malik wa khatta taaj fi raasah wa antaah kitaab al-mu'aahada wa masahah wa darrajah malik.Wa ba'ad da,saffago leyah wa gaalo-:-Yi'iich al-malik-!
Wa wakit al-malika Atalya sim'at harakat al-hurraas wa l-cha'ab,jarat machat leehum fi beet Allah.
Wa hi chaafat al-malik waagif jamb al-amuud fi madkhal beet Allah hasab al-aade hana l-muluuk.Wa l-khuyyaad wa l-naas al-yadurbu burunji gaa'idiin ma'a l-malik.Wa kulla cha'ab al-balad farhaaniin marra waahid wa naas gaa'idiin yadurbu burunji.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Atalya charratat khulgaanha min al-za'al wa gaalat-:-Di mu'aamara-!Di mu'aamara-!
Wa raajil al-diin Yahuuyada' anta amur le khuyyaad al-miyaat al-mukallafiin be l-askar wa gaal-:-Amurguuha barra min sufuufku.Wa ayyi naadum al-yitaabi'ha,aktuluuh be l-seef. Achaan hu ma dawwar yaktuluuha fi beet Allah.
Wa humman karabooha le Atalya wa maragooha.Wa wakit wassalo ale gasir al-malik fi l-derib hana madkhal al-kheel,khalaas katalooha fi l-bakaan da.
Wa Yahuuyada' sawwa mu'aahada been Allah wa been al-malik wa cha'abah le yabgo cha'ab Allah.Wa battaan sawwa mu'aahada ambeen al-malik wa l-cha'ab.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab macho beet al-ibaada hana Ba'al wa haddamooh wa dammaro madaabhah wa asnaamah kula.Wa giddaam al-madaabih,katalo Mattaan raajil al-diin hana Ba'al.Wa ba'ad da,raajil al-diin Yahuuyada' khatta muraakhibiin fi beet Allah.
Wa hu lamma khuyyaad al-miyaat wa l-Kariyiin wa l-hurraas wa kulla cha'ab al-balad.Wa humman marago al-malik min beet Allah wa waddooh le gasir al-malik be derib madkhal al-hurraas.Wa khalaas,Yuwaach ga'ad fi kursi al-muluk.
Wa kulla cha'ab al-balad firho.Wa ba'ad katalooha le Atalya jamb gasir al-malik,al-madiina gaa'ide fi l-salaama.
Wa Yuwaach indah sab'a sana wakit bigi malik.
Wa da fi l-sana al-saab'e hana hukum Yaahu malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa Yuwaach hakam 40 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Sibya wa hi min hillit Biir Sab'a.
Wa fi kulla muddit hayaatah,Yuwaach sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah achaan Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin anta wasaaya adiiliin.
Wa laakin be da kula,al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam gaa'idiin wa fooghum,al-cha'ab yigaddumu dahaaya wa yiharrugu bakhuur.
Wa Yuwaach gaal le rujaal al-diin-:-Limmu kulla l-fudda al-khassastuuha le beet Allah wa l-fudda hana l-fadayaan aw al-fudda al-antooha hasab gudurtah wa l-fudda al-antooha be juud hasab al-niiye hana ayyi waahid.Wa kulla l-fudda di,jiibuuha le beet Allah.
Wa khalli ayyi raajil diin yichiil al-fudda di min al-naas al-ya'arifhum wa beeha yi'addulu kulla l-chuguug al-gaa'idiin fi beet Allah.
Wa laakin fi sanit 23 hana hukum Yuwaach,rujaal al-diin lissaa' ma addalo al-chuguug hana beet Allah.
Wa Yuwaach naadaah le Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin wa le rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin wa gaal leehum-:-Maala ma addaltu al-chuguug hana beet Allah-?Hassa' da,battaan ma tichiilu fudda min al-naas al-ta'arfuuhum laakin khalluuha kullaha le yi'addulu beeha beet Allah.
Wa rujaal al-diin khassado battaan ma yichiilu al-fudda min al-cha'ab wa la yichiilu al-mas'uuliiye le yi'addulu al-chuguug hana beet Allah.
Wa Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin chaal sanduug wa gadda sidaadtah wa khattaah jamb al-madbah be nuss al-zeene hana madkhal beet Allah.Wa rujaal al-diin al-humman hurraas al-madkhal yukhuttu foogah kulla l-fudda al-yijiibuuha le beet Allah.
Wa kan al-fudda di bigat katiire fi l-sanduug,khalaas al-kaatib hana l-malik wa kabiir rujaal al-diin yaju wa yichiilu al-fudda al-jaabooha fi beet Allah wa yihaasubuuha.
Wa ba'ad hasabo al-fudda di,yantuuha fi iid al-naas al-mukallafiin be khidmit beet Allah.Wa humman yista'malooha le yikaffu beeha al-khachchaabiin wa l-bannaayiin al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu fi beet Allah
wa l-addaaliin wa naggaachiin al-hajar wa yachru beeha maraadiis wa hujaar magtuu'iin le yi'addulu beeha chuguug beet Allah.Wa yikaffu beeha kulla cheyy al-waajib le addiliin al-beet.
Wa laakin be l-fudda al-jaabooha le beet Allah di,ma sawwo beeha wa la mawaa'iin hana fudda wa la sakaakiin wa la kiisaan wa la buug wa la ayyi aala hana dahab aw fudda.
Humman anto al-fudda di le l-mukallafiin be l-khidme achaan yista'malooha le addiliin beet Allah.
Wa ma yas'aloohum le l-mukallafiin dool min al-fudda al-gaa'idiin yikaffu beeha al-khaddaamiin achaan humman naas al-induhum amaan.
Wa kan le l-fudda al-yijiibuuha hadiiye le kaffaarat al-khata walla hadiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib di,ma yusubbuuha fi beet Allah wa laakin yantuuha le rujaal al-diin.
Wa yoom waahid,Hazayiil malik balad Araam ja hajam hillit Gaat wa chaalha.Wa Hazayiil chaal niiye le yamchi yahjim Madiinat al-Khudus kula.
Wa Yuwaach malik mamlakat Yahuuza chaal al-mawaa'iin al-khassasoohum abbahaatah Yahuuchafat wa Yahuuraam wa Akhazya muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza wa l-mawaa'iin al-hu zaatah khassasaahum wa kulla l-dahab al-gaa'id fi l-makhaazin hana beet Allah wa fi gasir al-malik.Wa rassal kulla l-achya dool le Hazayiil malik Araam wa hu khalla jaytah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yuwaach wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa masaa'iil Yuwaach atmarrado diddah wa darabooh fi hillit Beet Millu fi l-derib al-maachi ale hillit Silla.
Wa l-masaa'iil dool humman Yuzaakaar wileed Chim'aat wa Yahuzabaad wileed Chumiir.Wa humman darabo Yuwaach wa katalooh.Wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Amasya hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 23 hana hukum Yuwaach wileed Akhazya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Yahuuhaaz wileed Yaahu bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hu hakam 17 sana.
Wa Yahuuhaaz sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Hu sawwa nafs al-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.Wa Yahuuhaaz kula ma khalla minnah al-zunuub dool.
Wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid le naas mamlakat Israa'iil wa sallamaahum le Hazayiil malik balad Araam wa le Banhadaad wileed Hazayiil fi kulla wakithum.
Wa laakin Yahuuhaaz chahad Allah wa Allah khibil su'aalah achaan hu chaaf al-zulum al-gaa'id yisawwiih malik Araam le mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa Allah jaab le mamlakat Israa'iil munajji.Wa hu najjaahum min iid malik balad Araam.Wa naas mamlakat Israa'iil gidro aacho be l-salaama fi buyuuthum misil awwal.
Wa laakin be da kula,naas mamlakat Israa'iil ma khallo minhum al-zunuub al-lazzaahum fooghum Yaruba'aam wa aayiltah.Wa humman ga'ado fi zunuubhum hatta khallo fi l-Saamira al-uud al-khazzooh le ibaadat ilaaha Achiira.
Wa fi l-akhiir,min askar Yahuuhaaz ma faddal leyah illa 50 rujaal siyaad kheel wa 10 arabaat hana harib wa 10-000 askar maachiin be rijleehum.Wa da achaan malik Araam dammar al-aakhariin wa rihikaahum marra waahid misil al-ajaaj tihit rijileenah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahuuhaaz wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa faraasiiytah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yahuuhaaz maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa wileedah Yahu'aach hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 37 hana hukum Yuwaach malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Yahu'aach wileed Yahuuhaaz bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hakam 16 sana.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa hu ma khalla minnah kulla l-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahu'aach wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa faraasiiytah wa l-huruub al-sawwaahum didd Amasya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yahu'aach maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat al-Saamira ma'a muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa wileedah Yaruba'aam hakam fi badalah.
Wakit Alyasa' mirid marad al-yaktulah,Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil macha giddaamah wa baka leyah wa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi-!Ya abuuyi-!Inta muhimm le Bani Israa'iil ziyaada min kulla arabaathum wa kulla siyaad kheelhum.
Wa Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Chiil leek nubbaal wa nuchchaab. Wa Yahu'aach chaal nubbaal wa nuchchaab.
Wa Alyasa' gaal le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-:-Ajbid al-nubbaal. Wa wakit Yahu'aach jabad al-nubbaal,Alyasa' khatta iideenah fi iideen al-malik wa gaal-:
Aftah al-chubbaak al-be l-nuss al-sabhaani. Wa Yahu'aach fatahah.Wa Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Azurgah-! Wa Yahu'aach zaragah.Wa Alyasa' gaal leyah-:-Da nuchchaab al-nasur al-jaayi min Allah,nuchchaab al-nasur didd al-Araamiyiin.Inta tihaaribhum le l-Araamiyiin fi hillit Afiikh wa tidammirhum marra waahid.
Wa Alyasa' gaal battaan-:-Chiil al-nuchchaab-! Wa Yahu'aach chaal al-nuchchaab.Wa Alyasa' gaal le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-:-Adrub beyah al-ard-! Wa hu darab al-ard talaata marraat wa wagaf.
Wa nabi Allah zi'il minnah wa gaal leyah-:-Waajib tadrub al-ard khamsa aw sitte marra wa be da,tagdar tinnasir fi l-Araamiyiin lahaddi tidammirhum.Wa laakin hassa' da,inta tinnasir fooghum talaata marraat bas.
Wa Alyasa' maat wa dafanooh.Wa ayyi bidaayit al-sana,nahhaabiin min balad Muwaab yadkhulu fi balad Israa'iil.
Wa yoom waahid,fiyah naas waahidiin gaa'idiin yadfunu naadum mayyit wa chaafo al-nahhaabiin dool.Wa tawwaali,al-naas dool zagalo al-janaaza fi khabur Alyasa' wa faato.Wa wakit al-janaaza waga'at fi raas udaam Alyasa',al-mayyit da hiyi wa gamma be tuulah.
Wa Hazayiil malik balad Araam gaa'id yazlum mamlakat Israa'iil fi kulla wakit hukum Yahuuhaaz.
Wa laakin Allah hanna foog naas mamlakat Israa'iil wa wassaf leehum rahmatah be sabab al-mu'aahada al-sawwaaha ma'a Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub wa ma dawwar yidammirhum.Wa misil da,ma ba''adaahum min giddaamah lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Hazayiil malik Araam maat wa wileedah Banhadaad hakam fi badalah.
Wa Yahu'aach wileed Yahuuhaaz chaal min Banhadaad kulla l-hillaal al-chaalaahum abuuh Hazayiil fi wakt al-duwaas.Wa Yahu'aach haarabah le Banhadaad talaata marraat wa chaal minnah hillaal mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum Yahu'aach wileed Yahuuhaaz malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Amasya wileed Yuwaach bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Amasya indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 29 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Yuu'addaan wa hi min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah.Ma sawwa misil jiddah Dawuud sawwaah laakin misil abuuh Yuwaach.
Wa laakin be da kula,al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam gaa'idiin wa fooghum,al-cha'ab yigaddumu dahaaya wa yiharrugu bakhuur.
Wa wakit Amasya sabbat al-muluk,hu katal kulla l-masaa'iil al-katalo abuuh al-malik Yuwaach.
Wa laakin hu ma katal iyaalhum.Wa da hasab maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa al-foogah Allah amaraahum wa gaal-:-Al-abbahaat ma yaktuluuhum be sabab zanib al-iyaal wa l-iyaal ma yaktuluuhum be sabab zanib al-abbahaat.Ayyi waahid yumuut be sabab zanbah bas.
Wa l-malik Amasya katal 10-000 naas min al-Adoomiyiin fi waadi al-Mileh.Wa fi l-harib da,hu chaal hillit Saala' wa sammaaha Yakhtiil wa usumha da gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa khalaas ba'ad al-harib da,Amasya rassal naas le Yahu'aach wileed Yahuuhaaz wileed Yaahu malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa Amasya gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal nilgaabalo wa nilhaarabo-!
Wa Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil rassal le Amasya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa hajja leyah be l-masal da-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam fi jibaal Lubnaan,chookaay waahide rassalat le chadar al-arz wa gaalat leyah-:--Akhkhid bineeytak le wileedi-!- Wa laakin teetal waahid hana Lubnaan fajjakh al-chookaay di wa rihikha marra waahid.
Wa Yahu'aach gaal battaan-:-Akiid inta annasart fi l-Adoomiyiin wa fi chaan da,firiht be nasrak wa gaa'id tilfachchar.Wa nuguul leek ke-:--Agood saakit fi beetak.Maala tidoor tigawwim harib cheen al-yidammirak inta wa mamlakat Yahuuza kula-?-
Wa laakin Amasya ma simi' kalaamah.Wa khalaas,Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil marag gaabalah.Wa askar Yahu'aach wa askar Amasya malik mamlakat Yahuuza alhaarabo fi hillit Beet Chams fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa askar mamlakat Yahuuza anhazamo giddaam askar mamlakat Israa'iil wa ayyi askari arrad gabbal beetah.
Wa fi hillit Beet Chams,Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil karabah le Amasya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wileed Yuwaach wileed Akhazya.Wa hu bigi masjuun al-harib wa Yahu'aach waddaah Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hinaak,hu kassar durdur al-madiina fi tuul hana 400 duraa' min baab Afraayim lahaddi baab al-Rukun.
Wa Yahu'aach chaal kulla l-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-mu'iddaat hana beet Allah.Wa chaal al-kanz min gasir al-malik wa khataf naas kula.Wa ba'ad da,gabbal madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahu'aach wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa faraasiiytah wa l-huruub al-sawwaahum didd Amasya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yahu'aach maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat al-Saamira ma'a muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa ba'ad da,wileedah Yaruba'aam hakam fi badalah.
Wa Amasya wileed Yuwaach malik mamlakat Yahuuza aach 15 sana ba'ad moot Yahu'aach wileed Yahuuhaaz malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa l-baagi min amal Amasya maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus,naas waahidiin atmarrado didd Amasya.Wa hu arrad wa macha hillit Lakiich laakin humman rassalo naas waraayah wa katalooh fi l-hille di.
Wa humman jaabo janaaztah fi Madiinat al-Khudus be kheel wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.
Wa kulla cha'ab mamlakat Yahuuza chaalooh le Uzziiya al-indah 16 sana wa darrajooh malik fi badal abuuh Amasya.
Wa ba'ad al-malik Amasya maat wa lihig abbahaatah,Uzziiya chaal hillit Ilaat wa banaaha battaan wa gabbalha le mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa fi sanit 15 hana hukum Amasya wileed Yuwaach malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Yaruba'aam wileed Yahu'aach bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hu hakam 41 sana.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Hu ma khalla minnah kulla l-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa Yaruba'aam wileed Yahu'aach,hu bas al-gala' battaan kulla l-manaatig al-awwal hana mamlakat Israa'iil min Labu Hamaat fi l-munchaakh lahaddi l-bahar al-Mayyit fi l-junuub.Wa da bigi hasab kalaam Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-gaalah be waasitat abdah al-nabi Yuunus wileed Amittaayal-min hillit Gaat Hiifar.
Allah chaaf al-ta'ab al-chadiid hana Bani Israa'iil.Wa ma fi naadum wa la min al-abiid wa la min al-hurriin al-yaji yafza'hum.
Wa laakin abadan Allah ma kharrar yuguchch usum Bani Israa'iil min tihit al-sama.Wa be da,hu najjaahum be iid Yaruba'aam wileed Yahu'aach.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yaruba'aam wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa faraasiiytah wa huruubah wa kikkeef hu gabbal mudun Dimachkh wa Hamaat tihit hukum mamlakat Israa'iil wa dool mudun al-awwal hana mamlakat Yahuuza,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yaruba'aam maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh ma'a muluuk Bani Israa'iil.Wa wileedah Zakariiya hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 27 hana hukum Yaruba'aam malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Uzziiya wileed Amasya bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Uzziiya indah 16 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 52 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Yakulya wa hi min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Uzziiya sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah misil abuuh Amasya sawwaah.
Wa Allah nazzal marad al-jidaam fi l-malik wa hu ga'ad mujaddim lahaddi mootah.Wa hu sakan fi beet wiheedah taraf.Wa Yuutaam wileed al-malik bigi mas'uul fi l-gasir wa hakam fi cha'ab al-balad.
Wa l-baagi min amal Uzziiya wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa Uzziiya maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Yuutaam hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 38 hana hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Zakariiya wileed Yaruba'aam bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hu hakam sitte chahar.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil al-zanib al-juduudah sawwooh.Wa hu ma khalla minnah al-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa Challuum wileed Yaabiich atmarrad didd al-malik wa gamma darabah wa katalah giddaam al-cha'ab wa hakam fi badalah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Zakariiya maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa hukum Zakariiya bigi hasab kalaam Allah le Yaahu.Wa hu gaal-:-Iyaalak yahkumu fi mamlakat Israa'iil lahaddi l-zurriiye al-raab'e. Wa bigi misil hu gaalah.
Fi sanit 39 hana hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Challuum wileed Yaabiich bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa hu hakam chahar waahid fi madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa Manahiim wileed Gaadi gamma min hillit Tirsa wa macha al-Saamira wa darabah le Challuum wileed Yaabiich wa katalah hinaak.Wa hu hakam fi badalah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Challuum wa mu'aamaratah al-sawwaaha maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Manahiim hajam hillit Tifsah wa kulla manaatigha wa katal kulla l-sukkaan lahaddi Tirsa achaan humman abo ma yaftaho leyah baab al-madiina.Wa hu chagga butuun al-awiin al-khalbaanaat.
Wa fi sanit 39 hana hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Manahiim wileed Gaadi bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa hu hakam 10 sana fi madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Wa fi muddit kulla hayaatah,hu ma khalla minnah al-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa Takhlat Falaasarmalik balad Achuur dakhal be gu fi balad Israa'iil.Wa Manahiim antaah le Takhlat Falaasar ziyaada min 30-000 kiilo hana fudda achaan yisaa'idah le yisabbit mulkah.
Wa le yalga al-fudda di,Manahiim talab min al-khaniyiin hana mamlakat Israa'iil yikaffu al-miiri,ayyi waahid yikaffi 50 hajar fudda.Wa hu antaah le malik Achuur wa ba'ad da,al-malik gamma wa gabbal ma ga'ad fi balad Israa'iil.
Wa l-baagi min amal Manahiim wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Manahiim maat wa lihig abbahaatah.Wa wileedah Fakhahya hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 50 hana hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Fakhahya wileed Manahiim bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hu hakam santeen.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Hu ma khalla minnah al-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.
Wa waahid khaayid deechah le Fakhahya al-usmah Fagah wileed Ramalya atmarrad didd al-malik wa katalah hu wa Arguub wa Aryi fi lubb al-gasir fi l-Saamira.Wa saa'adooh 50 naas min Gil'aad.Wa ba'ad katal al-malik,Fagah hakam fi badalah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Fakhahya wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi sanit 52 hana hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Fagah wileed Ramalya bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hu hakam 20 sana.
Wa wakit al-Fagah gaa'id yamluk fi mamlakat Israa'iil,Takhlat Falaasar malik balad Achuur ja wa chaal hillaal Iyuun wa Abil Beet Ma'aaka wa Yanuuh wa Khadach wa Haasuur wa turaab Gil'aad wa balad al-Jaliil wa kulla ard Naftaali.Wa wadda sukkaanhum fi l-khurba fi balad Achuur.
Wa Huucha' wileed Iila atmarrad didd Fagah wileed Ramalya.Wa hu darabah wa katalah wa hakam fi badalah wa da fi sanit 20 hana hukum Yuutaam wileed Uzziiya.
Wa l-baagi min amal Fagah wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum Fagah wileed Ramalya malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Yuutaam wileed Uzziiya bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Yuutaam indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 16 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Yaruucha bineeyit Saduukh.
Wa Yuutaam sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah misil abuuh Uzziiya sawwaah.
Wa laakin be da kula,al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam gaa'idiin wa fooghum,al-cha'ab yigaddumu dahaaya wa yiharrugu bakhuur.Wa Yuutaam addal al-baab al-foogaani hana madkhal beet Allah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yuutaam wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa fi wakit Yuutaam bas,Allah rassal Rasiin malik balad Araam wa Fagah wileed Ramalya didd mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Yuutaam maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud jiddah.Wa wileedah Ahaaz hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 17 hana hukum Fagah wileed Ramalya,Ahaaz wileed Yuutaam bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Ahaaz indah 20 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 16 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hu ma sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah Ilaahah misil jiddah Dawuud.
Wa laakin hu taaba' derib muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil lahaddi gaddam wileedah wa harragah fi l-naar.Wa da nafs al-muharramaat al-sawwoohum al-umam al-Allah gala' minhum arduhum wa antaaha le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Ahaaz gaddam dahaaya wa harrag bakhuur fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam wa fi ruuse al-jibaal wa tihit ayyi chadara khadra.
Wa yoom waahid,Rasiin malik balad Araam wa Fagah wileed Ramalya malik mamlakat Israa'iil jo le yihaarubu Ahaaz malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa haasaro Madiinat al-Khudus wa laakin ma annasaro foogah.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit da,Rasiin malik Araam chaal battaan hillit Ilaat wa gabbalha le l-Araamiyiin.Wa tarad Bani Yahuuza al-gaa'idiin fi lubbaha wa l-Adoomiyiin jo wa sakano foogha lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Ahaaz rassal naas le Takhlat Falaasar malik balad Achuur le yuguulu leyah al-kalaam da-:-Ana abdak wa wileedak.Ta'aal najjiini min iid malik Araam wa min iid malik Israa'iil humman al-gammo diddi.
Wa Ahaaz chaal al-fudda wa l-dahab min beet Allah wa makhaazin hana gasir al-malik wa rassalaahum le malik Achuur misil hadiiye.
Wa malik Achuur radda fi talab Ahaaz.Hu gamma wa macha hajam madiinat Dimachkhwa chaalha wa wadda sukkaanha fi l-khurba fi hillit Khiir.Wa katal Rasiin malik Araam.
Wa l-malik Ahaaz hana mamlakat Yahuuza macha Dimachkh le yilimm ma'a Takhlat Falaasar malik Achuur.Wa wakit al-malik Ahaaz chaaf madbah hana madiinat Dimachkh,rassal le Uriiya raajil al-diin al-suura wa l-rasim hana l-madbah hana Dimachkh achaan yabnu madbah sawa sawa mislah.
Wa Uriiya raajil al-diin bana al-madbah hasab al-suura wa l-rasim al-rassalah leyah al-malik Ahaaz min Dimachkh.Wa Uriiya raajil al-diin bana al-madbah da gubbaal al-malik Ahaaz ma yigabbil min Dimachkh.
Wa wakit al-malik gabbal min Dimachkh,chaaf al-madbah wa garrab leyah
wa gaddam dahaaya muharragiin wa hadaaya hana dagiig wa hadaaya charaab wa rachcha al-madbah be damm dahaaya al-salaama.
Wa kan le l-madbah hana l-nahaas al-gaa'id giddaam beet Allah,hu hawwalah min bakaanah al-been al-madbah al-jadiid wa beet Allah.Wa hu khattaah be l-nuss al-munchaakhi hana l-madbah al-jadiid.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Ahaaz amar Uriiya raajil al-diin wa gaal leyah-:-Min al-yoom da,asta'mal al-madbah al-kabiir.Wa fi l-madbah al-kabiir da bas,tigaddim al-dahaaya al-muharragiin hana l-fajur wa hadaaya al-dagiig hana l-achiiye.Wa tigaddim kula al-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa hadaaya al-dagiig hana l-malik wa l-dahaaya al-muharragiin hana kulla cha'ab ma'a hadaayaahum hana l-dagiig wa hana l-charaab.Wa ba'ad da,turuchch al-madbah be damm hana l-bahaayim al-gaddamtuuhum dahaaya.Wa kan le l-madbah hana l-nahaas kamaan,ana bas nista'malah.
Wa Uriiya raajil al-diin sawwa kulla cheyy al-amarah beyah al-malik Ahaaz.
Wa l-malik Ahaaz marag al-safaayih min al-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin wa marag al-hiitaan hana nahaas al-foogah.Wa marag al-hoot al-kabiir al-mudawwar al-gaa'id fi l-tiiraan hana nahaas wa khattaah fi raas hajar al-gaa'id fi l-turaab.
Wa achaan yidoor yiraddi malik balad Achuur,hu khayyar baab al-sabt al-banooh daakhal fi beet Allah wa l-baab al-barraani hana madkhal al-malik.
Wa l-baagi min amal Ahaaz wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa Ahaaz maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Hizkhiiya hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi sanit 12 hana hukum Ahaaz malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Huucha' wileed Iila bigi malik fi mamlakat Israa'iil fi madiinat al-Saamira.Wa hu hakam 9 sana.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah wa laakin ma misil al-fasaala hana muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil al-gablah.
Wa Chalmanaasar malik balad Achuur ja haarabah le Huucha' malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa gidir foogah.Wa Huucha' kaffa leyah al-miiri.
Wa laakin malik Achuur irif kadar Huucha' atmarrad wa aba ma yikaffi battaan al-miiri al-waajib yikaffiih ayyi sana.Wa battaan kula,Huucha' rassal naas le Suu malik balad Masir.Wa be da khalaas,malik Achuur karab Huucha' wa dassaah fi l-sijin wa janzarah.
Wa ba'ad da,malik Achuur ja hajam kulla mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa hu haasar madiinat al-Saamira le muddit talaata sana.
