Wa fi l-sana al-taas'e hana hukum Huucha',malik Achuur chaal madiinat al-Saamira wa wadda naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-khurba fi balad Achuur.Wa hu sakkanaahum fi hillit Halah fi khachum bahar Haabur fi mantagat Guzaan wa fi hillaal al-Maadiyiin.
Wa kulla l-cheyy da kaan achaan naas mamlakat Israa'iil aznabo didd Allah Ilaahhum,hu al-najjaahum min hukum Fir'oon malik balad Masir wa maragaahum min baladah wa be da kula,humman abado ilaahaat aakhariin.
Wa humman taaba'o aadaat hana l-umam al-Allah gala' minhum arduhum wa antaaha le Bani Israa'iil.Wa humman taaba'o al-aadaat al-sabbato muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa naas mamlakat Israa'iil sawwo achya waahidiin be sirr didd Allah Ilaahhum al-ma waajib yisawwuuhum.Bano bakaanaat aaliyiin le ibaadat al-asnaam fi kulla hillaalhum kan di hille sakhayre al-ma kabiire min beet tawiil hana muraakhaba walla kan di madiina gawiiye kula.
Wa khazzo hujaar wa iidaan le ibaadat Achiira fi raas ayyi jabal aali wa tihit ayyi chadara khadra.
Wa fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin dool,harrago al-bakhuur misil al-umam al-aakhariin al-Allah taradaahum giddaamhum le yantiihum al-balad.Wa misil ke,humman sawwo al-fasaala lahaddi Allah khidib leehum.
Wa humman abado al-asnaam al-awwal Allah gaal leehum-:-Ma ta'abuduuhum.
Wa Allah hazzarhum le naas mamlakat Israa'iil wa mamlakat Yahuuza be waasitat kulla l-anbiya al-yichiifu ru'ya wa gaal leehum-:-Khallu deribku al-fasil wa ahfado wasiiyaati wa tabbugu churuuti hasab Tawraat Muusa al-amart beeha juduudku wa rassaltaha leeku be waasitat abiidi al-anbiya.
Wa laakin humman ma sim'o kalaamah.Gawwo ruuseehum misil juduudhum al-ma aamano be Allah Ilaahhum.
Wa Allah antaahum gawaaniin wa sawwa ma'a juduudhum mu'aahada wa antaahum ta'liim.Wa laakin humman rafado kulla l-achya dool wa taaba'o leehum asnaam ma naaf'iin wa humman zaathum bigo naas ma naaf'iin be cheyy.Wa humman taaba'o derib al-umam al-mujaawiriinhum al-daharaahum Allah achaan ma yichiilu deribhum.
Wa humman khallo minhum wasaaya Allah Ilaahhum wa sana'o leehum ajjaal itneen min hadiid wa khazzo iidaan le ibaadat Achiira wa sajado le kulla khuwwaat al-sama wa abado ilaah Ba'al.
Wa harrago awlaadhum wa banaathum fi l-naar le l-asnaam wa gammo yisawwu al-sihir wa yichawwufu.Wa chaalo niiye le yisawwu al-fasaala giddaam Allah lahaddi yikhaddubuuh.
Wa Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Bani Israa'iil wa ba''adaahum minnah wa illa gabiilat Yahuuza bas faddalat.
Wa laakin gabiilat Yahuuza kula ma hafadat wasaaya Allah Ilaahha wa hi taaba'at aadaat Bani Israa'iil.
Wa be sabab da,Allah abaahum le kulla zurriiyit Bani Israa'iil wa ayyabaahum wa sallamaahum fi iid al-nahhaabiin wa fi l-akhiir,ba''adaahum minnah.
Wa wakit Allah farag mamlakat Israa'iil min zurriiyit Dawuud,humman darrajo fooghum malik al-hu Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat.Wa Yaruba'aam ba''ad naas mamlakat Israa'iil min Allah wa lazzaahum le yisawwu zunuub kubaar.
Wa min al-wakit daak,kulla naas mamlakat Israa'iil gaa'idiin yisawwu nafs al-zunuub al-sawwaahum Yaruba'aam wa humman ma khallo minhum
lahaddi Allah taradaahum ba'iid minnah hasab al-kalaam al-hu gaalah be waasitat abiidah al-anbiya.Wa be da naas mamlakat Israa'iil,karaboohum wa waddoohum fi l-khurba fi balad Achuur ba'iid min baladhum wa gaa'idiin hinaak lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa malik balad Achuur jaab naas min madiinat Baabil wa min hillaal Kuuta wa Awwa wa Hamaat wa Safarwaayim wa sakkanaahum fi l-hillaal hana madiinat al-Saamira fi badal naas mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa l-naas dool chaalo madiinat al-Saamira wa sakano fi hillaalha.
Wa wakit al-naas dool jo sakano fi l-bakaan da,humman ma gaa'idiin ya'abudu Allah.Wa Allah rassal leehum diidaan al-katalo katiir minhum.
Wa jo khabbaro malik Achuur wa gaalo leyah-:-Al-umam al-inta waddeethum fi l-khurba wa sakkantuhum fi hillaal al-Saamira dool ma ya'arfu kikkeef ya'abudu al-ilaah hana l-balad di.Wa hassa',al-ilaah da rassal leehum diidaan al-gaa'idiin yaktuluuhum achaan humman ma ya'arfu kikkeef ya'abuduuh,hu al-ilaah hana l-balad di.
Wa khalaas,malik Achuur anta al-amur da wa gaal-:-Gabbulu raajil diin waahid min al-naas al-awwal karabnaahum wa maragnaahum min hinaak wa waddeenaahum fi l-khurba.Khalli yigabbil yaskun ma'aahum fi l-Saamira wa yiwassifhum kikkeef ya'abudu al-ilaah hana l-balad di.
Wa be misil da,waahid min rujaal al-diin al-karaboohum wa maragoohum min al-Saamira wa waddoohum fi l-khurba gabbal ja wa sakan fi Beet Iil wa gaa'id yi'allimhum kikkeef yakhaafo min Allah.
Wa laakin be da kula,ayyi umma sawwat leeha sanam wa khattatah fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin al-banoohum naas al-Saamira le l-ibaada.Wa ayyi umma sawwat misil da fi l-hillaal al-saakniin fooghum.
Wa l-naas al-jo min Baabil sana'o sanam Sukkuut Banuut wa l-naas al-jo min Kuuta sana'o sanam Nirgal wa l-naas al-jo min Hamaat sana'o sanam Achiima
wa l-naas al-jo min Awwa sana'o asnaam Nibhaz wa Tartaakh wa l-naas al-jo min Safarwaayim kamaan gaa'idiin yiharrugu iyaalhum fi l-naar le ilaahaathum Adramalik wa Anamalik.
Wa be da kula,humman khaayfiin min Allah.Wa azalo leehum naas min usuthum le yabgo rujaal diin wa yakhdumu leehum fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada.
Wa be khoofhum min Allah da kula,humman gaa'idiin ya'abudu ilaahaathum hasab aadaat al-umam al-jo minhum.
Wa lahaddi l-yoom kula,humman gaa'idiin yitaabu'u al-aadaat al-gadiimiin.Humman ma khaayfiin min Allah wa ma gaa'idiin yitabbugu al-churuut wa l-gawaaniin wa kitaab al-Tawraat wa l-wasaaya al-antaahum Allah le zurriiyit Yaakhuub.Wa da Yaakhuub al-Allah sammaah Israa'iil.
Wa Allah sawwa mu'aahada ma'a zurriiyit Yaakhuub wa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Ma takhaafo min al-ilaahaat al-aakhariin wa ma tasjudu leehum wa la ta'abuduuhum wa la tigaddumu leehum dahaaya.
Laakin akhaafo minni ana Allah al-maragtuku min balad Masir be gudra kabiire wa duraa' gawi.Wa waajib tasjudu leyi ana bas wa tigaddumu leyi dahaaya.
Wa waajib titabbugu al-churuut wa l-gawaaniin wa kitaab al-Tawraat wa l-wasaaya al-katabtuhum leeku wa tahfadoohum daayman.Wa ma takhaafo min al-ilaahaat al-aakhariin.
Wa ma tanso al-mu'aahada al-ana sawweetha ma'aaku wa la takhaafo min al-ilaahaat al-aakhariin.
Wa laakin waajib takhaafo min Allah Ilaahku bas,hu al-yinajjiiku min iid kulla udwaanku.
Wa laakin al-naas dool abo ma yasma'o al-kalaam da wa humman munkaribiin fi aadaathum al-gadiimiin.
Wa be misil da,al-umam dool khaayfiin min Allah wa laakin taaba'o ibaadat al-asnaam kula.Wa lahaddi l-yoom kula,iyaalhum wa iyaal iyaalhum gaa'idiin yisawwu nafs al-cheyy misil juduudhum.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukum Huucha' wileed Iila malik mamlakat Israa'iil,Hizkhiiya wileed Ahaaz bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Hizkhiiya indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 29 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Abi bineeyit Zakariiya.
Wa Hizkhiiya sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah misil jiddah Dawuud sawwaah.
Hu haddam al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa rama al-hujaar al-khazzoohum le l-ibaada wa kassar al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira.Wa kassar al-daabi hana l-nahaas al-Muusa sana'ahachaan lahaddi l-wakit daak,Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yiharrugu bakhuur le l-daabi al-sammooh Nahuuchtaan.
Wa Hizkhiiya atwakkal ale Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa min kulla muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza al-hakamo gablah aw al-hakamo ba'adah,ma fi malik mislah hu.
Wa hu mutamassik be Allah wa abadan ma tarraf minnah.Wa hu hafad al-wasaaya al-Allah amar beehum Muusa.
Wa Allah kaan ma'aayah wa Hizkhiiya gaa'id yanjah fi kulla cheyy al-yisawwiih.Wa hu atmarrad didd malik balad Achuur wa aba ma yagood tihit hukmah.
Wa Hizkhiiya annasar fi l-Filistiyiin wa chaal arduhum lahaddi hillit Khazza,min hillaal dugaag al-ma ziyaada min beet tawiil hana muraakhaba lahaddi l-mudun al-gawiyiin.
Wa l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Hizkhiiya,di hi al-sana al-saab'e hana hukum Huucha' wileed Iila malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa fi l-sana di,Chalmanaasar malik balad Achuur ja le madiinat al-Saamira wa haasarha.
Wa ba'ad muddit talaata sana,hu chaal al-madiina di.Wa da fi l-sana al-saadse hana hukum Hizkhiiya wa l-sana al-taas'e hana hukum Huucha' malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa malik Achuur wadda naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-khurba fi balad Achuur.Wa hu sakkanaahum fi hillit Halah wa fi khachum bahar Haabur fi mantagat Guzaan wa fi hillaal al-Maadiyiin.
Wa da achaan naas mamlakat Israa'iil ma sim'o kalaam Allah Ilaahhum wa ma karramo al-mu'aahada.Wa ma sim'o kalaamah wa la tabbago awaamirah al-antaahum leehum be waasitat abdah Muusa.
Wa fi sanit 14 hana hukum Hizkhiiya,Sanhariib malik balad Achuur hajam al-mudun al-gawiyiin hana mamlakat Yahuuza wa gala'aahum.
Wa Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza rassal le malik Achuur fi hillit Lakiich wa gaal leyah-:-Ana muznib-!Hassa' da,kiss minni.Wa kulla cheyy al-tukhuttah foogi da nahmalah. Wa khalaas,malik Achuur dawwar min Hizkhiiya malik Yahuuza 10-000 kiilo hana fudda wa 1-000 kiilo hana dahab.
Wa Hizkhiiya antaah kulla l-fudda al-gaa'ide fi beet Allah wa fi l-makhaazin hana gasir al-malik.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,Hizkhiiya mallat al-dahab min al-biibaan wa iidaanhum hana beet Allah al-mumassahiin be dahab wa antaah le malik Achuur.
Wa min hillit Lakiich,malik balad Achuur rassal waziirah hana l-difaa' wa kabiir al-masaa'iil wa khaayid al-deech wa ma'aahum deech kabiir le l-malik Hizkhiiya fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit wassalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus,ga'ado jamb majra al-birke al-aali fi l-derib al-maachi ale zere' al-khassaaliin.
Wa humman talabo achaan yihajju le l-malik.Wa laakin Aliyaakhim wileed Hilkhiiya mas'uul fi gasir al-malik marag min al-madiina le yilaagiihum wa macho ma'aayah Chabna al-kaatib wa Yuwaakh wileed Asaaf al-kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik.
Wa khaayid al-deech gaal leehum-:-Guulu le Hizkhiiya al-kalaam da al-jaayi min al-malik al-kabiir hana balad Achuur-:--Ween al-amaan al-inta mutawakkil aleyah-?
Inta tahsib al-kalaam al-faadi yanti raay wa gudra fi l-harib walla-?Wa hassa' da,ale yaatu inta atwakkalt le titmarrad diddi-?
Daahu inta atwakkalt ale balad Masir wa hi misil mu'aawana hana ageegaay al-mafjuukha al-tat'an ayyi naadum al-yirrakkaz foogah.Wa Fir'oon malik Masir hu misil da le kulla l-naas al-yitwakkalo aleyah.--
Wa tuguulu leyi-:--Ale Allah Ilaahna bas atwakkalna.- Laakin da Hizkhiiya bas al-haddam al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa l-madaabih hana ibaadat Allah-!Wa hu gaal le naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus-:--Amchu asjudu giddaam al-madbah al-hini fi Madiinat al-Khudus.--
Wa hassa' da,ta'aal astafig ma'a siidi malik balad Achuur.Ana nantiik 2-000 kheel kan talga leehum rakkaabiin.
Wa kikkeef inta tagdar tinnasir fi mas'uul waahid sakhayyar min khaddaamiin siidi-?Inta titwakkal ale Masir le talga arabaat harib wa siyaad kheel walla-?
Wa hassa' be izin Allah,ana gammeet didd al-bakaan da le nidammirah.Aywa-!Allah bas gaal leyi-:--Gumm didd al-balad di wa dammirha.-
Wa khalaas,Aliyaakhim wileed Hilkhiiya wa Chabna wa Yuwaakh raddo le khaayid al-deech wa gaalo leyah-:-Min fadlak,kallim leena aniina khaddaamiinak be l-araamiiye achaan aniina nafhamo al-lukhkha di.Laakin ma tikallim leena be l-ibraaniiye wa la tisammi' al-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi raas al-durdur.
Wa khaayid al-deech gaal leehum-:-Hal kalaam siidi al-rassalaani da bukhussuku intu wa malikku bas walla-?La-!Al-kalaam da bukhuss kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi durdur al-madiina.Humman kula misilku yinjabru yaakulu huraarhum wa yacharbo boolhum.
Wa ba'ad da,khaayid al-deech gamma be tuulah wa aat be hiss aali be kalaam ibraani wa gaal-:-Asma'o kalaam al-malik al-kabiir wa hu malik balad Achuur.
Daahu al-malik gaal-:--Khalli Hizkhiiya ma yukhuchchuku achaan hu ma yagdar yinajjiiku minni.
Wa khalli Hizkhiiya ma yiwaddiiku lahaddi titwakkalo ale Allah wa yuguul leeku-:"Akiid Allah yinajjiina wa l-madiina di kula ma taga' fi iideen malik Achuur-!"--
Ma tasma'o kalaam Hizkhiiya achaan daahu malik Achuur gaal-:--Sawwu ma'aayi suluh wa sallumu nufuusku leyi.Wa khalaas,ayyi waahid minku yaakul min intaaj inabah wa tiinah wa yachrab min almi biirah.
Wa da lahaddi ana nigabbil wa niwaddiiku fi balad misil baladku.Wa l-balad di indaha gameh wa khamar jadiid wa ma'aach wa inab wa zaytuun le l-dihin wa asal wa be misil da,intu ti'iichu wa ma tumuutu.Ma tasma'o kalaam Hizkhiiya al-gaa'id yukhuchchuku wa yuguul-:"Allah yinajjiina."
Hal ilaahaat al-umam gidro najjo buldaanhum min iid malik Achuur walla-?
Ween ilaahaat Hamaat wa Arfad-?Wa ween ilaahaat Safarwaayim wa Hiina' wa Awwa-?Hal humman gidro najjo madiinat al-Saamira min iidi walla-?
Wa min kulla ilaahaat al-buldaan dool,yaatu al-gidir najja baladah minni-?Wa be da,hal Allah yagdar yinajji Madiinat al-Khudus minni walla-?-
Wa laakin al-cha'ab sakato ma raddo leyah be ayyi kilme achaan al-malik Hizkhiiya amaraahum wa gaal-:-Ma turuddu leyah.
Wa khalaas,Aliyaakhim wileed Hilkhiiya mas'uul fi gasir al-malik wa Chabna al-kaatib wa Yuwaakh wileed Asaaf al-kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik,kulluhum jo le Hizkhiiya wa khulgaanhum mucharratiin min al-hizin wa jaabo leyah kalaam khaayid al-deech.
Wa wakit al-malik Hizkhiiya simi' kalaamhum,hu kula gamma charrat khulgaanah wa libis khalag al-hizin wa macha beet Allah.
Wa hu rassal Aliyaakhim mas'uul fi gasir al-malik wa Chabna al-kaatib wa rujaal al-diin al-chiyyaab.Wa kulluhum ke laabsiin khulgaan al-hizin wa macho le l-nabi Icha'ya wileed Ammuus.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Daahu kalaam al-malik Hizkhiiya-:--Al-yoom da,yoom hana diige wa ikhaab wa fadiihe.Wa da misil al-iyaal jaahiziin le yamurgu min batun ammuhum wa laakin hi ma indaha gudra le taldaahum.
Wa akuun Allah Ilaahak yasma' kulla kalaam khaayid al-deech al-siidah malik balad Achuur rassalah le yi'ayyir Allah al-Hayy.Wa akuun Allah Ilaahak yasma' kalaamah wa yi'aakhibah.Hassa' da,as'al Allah fi chaan al-cha'ab al-faddalo.-
Wa wakit masaa'iil al-malik Hizkhiiya jo giddaam Icha'ya,
hu gaal leehum-:-Amchu guulu le siidku al-malik Hizkhiiya-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ma takhaaf min al-mu'yaar al-simi'tah al-ayyarooni beyah khaddaamiin malik Achuur.
Wa daahu ana nantiih khabar wa be sabab al-khabar da,hu yigabbil baladah.Wa hinaak ana naktulah be l-seef."-
Wa khaayid al-deech simi' kadar malik balad Achuur gamma min hillit Lakiich wa macha le yihaarib hillit Libna.Khalaas,hu kula gabbal lihigah hinaak.
Wa khalaas,malik balad Achuur simi' khabar.Wa l-khabar da buguul-:-Tirhaakha malik balad al-Habacha gamma jaayi le yihaaribak. Wa khalaas,malik Achuur rassal murassaliin le Hizkhiiya wa gaal leehum-:
Amchu le Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa guulu leyah-:--Khalli ilaahak al-inta gaa'id titwakkal aleyah da ma yukhuchchak wa yuguul leek-:"Madiinat al-Khudus ma taga' fi iideen malik Achuur-!"
Inta zaatak simi't be kulla cheyy al-sawwooh muluuk balad Achuur fi kulla l-buldaan wa dammaroohum marra waahid.Wa tahsib inta wiheedak bas tanja walla-?
Wa ilaahaat al-umam al-dammaroohum juduudi,hal gidro najjo hillaal Guzaan wa Haaraan wa Rasaf wa zurriiyit Adan al-saakniin fi Talassaar walla-?
Wa ween muluuk mudun Hamaat wa Arfad wa La'iir wa Safarwaayim wa Hiina' wa Awwa-?-
Wa Hizkhiiya chaal al-jawaab min iide al-murassaliin wa garaah.Wa macha le beet Allah wa fatah al-jawaab da giddaam Allah.
Wa giddaam Allah,Hizkhiiya sa'al wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil-!Inta al-gaa'id fi archak foog al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.Wa inta wiheedak bas Ilaah kulla mamaalik al-ard-!Wa inta bas al-khalagt al-samaawaat wa l-ard-!
Ya Allah,khutt adaanak wa asma'ni-!Ya Allah,aftah uyuunak wa chiif-!Wa asma' kalaam Sanhariib malik Achuur al-rassalah le yi'ayyirak inta,al-Ilaah al-Hayy.
Ya Allah,akiid muluuk Achuur dammaro kulla l-umam wa buldaanhum.
Wa zagalo ilaahaathum fi l-naar achaan humman asnaam bas al-sawwoohum al-naas be iideehum min hatab wa hajar.Wa muluuk Achuur dammaroohum.
Wa hassa',ya Allah Ilaahna,najjiina min iid Sanhariib wa be da,kulla mamaalik al-ard ya'arfu kadar inta ya Allah,inta wiheedak bas al-Rabb.
Wa Icha'ya wileed Ammuus rassal le Hizkhiiya wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Aywa,ana simi't salaatak al-inta wajjahtaha leyi fi chaan Sanhariib malik balad Achuur.-
Wa Icha'ya gaal battaan-:-Daahu kalaam Allah al-gaalah didd Sanhariib-:--Sahyuun al-misil bineeye udriiyetahgirak wa tichchammat foogak-!Aywa-!Madiinat al-Khudus al-misil bineeyetihizz raasha waraak.
Le yaatu inta ayyartahwa achchammat foogah-?Wa didd yaatu inta kallamtwa chift be istikbaar-?Da diddi ana,Khudduus Israa'iil-!
Be waasitat naasak al-rassaltuhum,inta ayyart al-Rabb wa gult-:"Be katarat arabaati,ana tala't fi ruuse al-jibaallahaddi dakhalt fi Lubnaan daakhalle nagta' chadarha hana l-arz al-tuwaalwa chadarha hana l-sarwi al-sameh.Wa namchi lahaddi nalhagal-malja' al-aakhirwa khaabaatha al-dulum.
Wa ana nakat biyaar fi buldaan hana naas aakhariinwa chiribt almiihumwa be fajkhat rijli,yabbast kulla rujuul Niil Masir."
--Wa laakin,ya Sanhariib,inta ma fihimtkadar min wakit tawiil,ana kharrart al-cheyy da.Wa min zamaan ana kawwantahwa hassa',nihaggigah.Wa inta kamaan,gaa'id tidammir al-mudun al-gawiyiinwa yabgo koom hana turaab.
Wa sukkaanhum ma induhum gudrawa khaafo wa khijlo.Wa humman yibso misilgechch al-kadaadewa nabaat al-akhdarwa l-gechch fi ruuse al-buyuutwa yibso misil al-gameh al-yibisgubbaal ma yanjad.
Wa laakin ana na'arifwakit inta tagoodwa wakit tamrug wa tigabbilwa wakit tarjif min al-za'al diddi.
Wa ana simi't inta rajaft min al-za'al diddiwa astakbart.Wa be sabab da,ana nidiss leekzumaam fi munkharakwa lijaam fi khachmakwa nigabbilak be l-deribal-inta jiit beyah.-
Wa di hi al-alaama,ya Hizkhiiya.Fi l-sana di,taakulu min al-kichcheebwa fi l-sana al-taaniye,taakulu min al-bandar.Wa laakin fi l-sana al-taalta,titeerubu wa tagta'owa timaggunu jineenaatku hana l-inabwa taakulu min fawaakihhum.
Wa l-nijo min Bani Yahuuzawa faddaloyabgo misil chadaraal-tidiss uruugha min jadiid fi l-ardwa furuu'ha yinmalu be fawaakih.
Achaan min Madiinat al-Khudusyamurgu al-naas al-faddaloaywa,min jabal Sahyuunyamurgu humman al-nijo.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir yisawwiihhasab mahabbitah al-chadiide.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal fi malik balad Achuur-:-Hu ma yadkhul fi l-madiina diwa la yizarrig foogha nuchchaab.Wa la yigarrib leeha be daragwa la yigawwim radmiiye wara durdurha.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Hu yigabbil be l-derib al-ja beyahwa fi l-madiina di,ma yadkhul.
Ana nahmi al-madiina diwa ninajjiiha.Wa da fi chaani ana Allahwa fi chaan abdi Dawuud.
Wa khalaas fi l-leele di,malak Allah ja darab mu'askar al-Achuuriyiin wa katal 185-000 raajil.Wa be fajur wakit gammo,al-faddalo minhum chaafo kulla l-janaazaat dool.
Wa khalaas,Sanhariib malik balad Achuur gabbal wa macha ga'ad fi madiinat Niinawa.
Wa yoom waahid,Sanhariib macha fi beet Nisruuk ilaahah le ya'abudah.Wa iyaalah al-itneen Adramalik wa Charaasar dakhalo darabooh wa katalooh be l-seef wa arrado macho le balad Araraat.Wa wileedah Isar Hadduun hakam fi badalah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Hizkhiiya mirid marad chadiid lahaddi gariib yumuut.Wa l-nabi Icha'ya wileed Ammuus ja leyah wa gaal-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Wassi aayiltak achaan inta tumuut.Ma talga al-aafe.-
Wa Hizkhiiya wajjah ale l-durdur wa sa'al Allah wa gaal-:
Ya Allah,fakkir foogi ana al-taaba't derbak be sidikh wa be galib mukhlis wa sawweet kulla cheyy adiil giddaamak-! Wa Hizkhiiya baka baki chadiid.
Wa wakit al-nabi Icha'ya lissaa' ma marag min al-fadaay hana gasir al-malik,Allah hajja leyah wa gaal-:
Gabbil amchi le Hizkhiiya kabiir cha'abi wa guul leyah-:--Daahu Allah Ilaah jiddak Dawuud gaal-:"Ana simi't su'aalak wa chift dumuu'ak al-daffago.Hassa' da,ana nachfiik wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,inta tagdar tamchi le beet Allah.
Wa daahu ana niziid leek 15 sana fi umrak.Wa ninajjiik inta wa l-madiina di min iid malik balad Achuur.Aywa,nahmi al-madiina di fi chaani ana wa fi chaan abdi Dawuud."-
Wa ba'ad da,Icha'ya gaal-:-Chiilu abbuud hana tiin. Wa humman chaalo al-abbuud wa ajjanooh wa masahooh fi hubuun al-malik wa hu ligi al-aafe.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Hizkhiiya gaal le Icha'ya-:-Chunu al-alaama al-tiwassif leyi kadar Allah yantiini al-aafe wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,namchi battaan le beet Allah-?
Wa Icha'ya radda leyah wa gaal-:-Di hi al-alaama al-beeha tagdar ta'arif kadar Allah yihaggig al-kalaam al-gaalah.Inta tidoor al-dull yiziid be achara darajaat walla yangus be achara darajaat-?
Wa Hizkhiiya gaal leyah-:-Hayyin le l-dull yiziid be achara darajaat.Angusah be achara darajaat.
Wa khalaas,al-nabi Icha'ya sa'al Allah wa Allah kaskas al-dull wara be achara darajaat min al-bakaan al-awwal nazal foogah fi darajaat atabat Ahaaz.
Wa fi l-wakit da,malik balad Baabil al-usmah Maruudak Baladaan wileed Baladaan rassal jawaabaat wa hadiiye le Hizkhiiya achaan hu simi' kadar Hizkhiiya mirid.
Wa Hizkhiiya simi' kalaam murassaliinah.Wa wassafaahum al-makhaazin al-khazano fooghum al-achya al-khaaliyiin misil al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-itir wa l-dihin al-mu'attar.Wa wassafaahum makhaazin al-silaah wa ayyi cheyy al-gaa'id fi makhaazinah.Wa ma fi cheyy al-Hizkhiiya ma wassafah leehum kan fi gasrah walla fi kulla mamlakatah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-nabi Icha'ya ja le l-malik Hizkhiiya wa gaal leyah-:-Al-naas dool jo gaalo leek chunu-?Wa humman jaayiin min ween-? Wa Hizkhiiya gaal-:-Humman jaayiin min ba'iid,min balad Baabil-!
Wa Icha'ya gaal-:-Chaafo chunu fi gasrak-? Wa Hizkhiiya gaal-:-Chaafo kulla cheyy fi gasri.Ma fi cheyy fi makhaazini al-ana ma wassaftah leehum-!
Wa khalaas,Icha'ya gaal leyah-:-Asma' kalaam Allah-!Hu gaal-:
--Daahu yaji yoom waahid,kulla l-khumaam al-fi gasrak wa kulla cheyy al-juduudak dammooh min zamaan lahaddi l-yoom da,yiwadduuh fi Baabil.Wa cheyy waahid kula ma yifaddil.Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa yichiilu min iyaalak al-marago min sulbak,al-inta wilidtuhum.Wa yikhassuuhum wa yabgo abiid fi gasir malik Baabil.-
Wa Hizkhiiya radda le Icha'ya wa gaal-:-Kalaam Allah al-inta gultah leyi da,adiil. Achaan hu gaal fi nafsah-:-Ana ni'iich be salaam wa amaan fi kulla muddit hayaati.
Wa l-baagi min amal Hizkhiiya wa faraasiiytah wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa buna khazzaan almi wa nakitiin al-majra al-yijiib al-almi fi lubb al-hille,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa Hizkhiiya maat wa lihig abbahaatah.Wa wileedah Manassa hakam fi badalah.
Wa Manassa indah 12 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 55 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Hafsiiba.
Wa Manassa sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Hu sawwa nafs al-muharramaat al-sawwoohum al-umam al-Allah gala' minhum arduhum wa antaaha le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa hu bana battaan al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada al-abuuh Hizkhiiya haddamaahum.Wa bana madaabih le ilaah Ba'al wa khazza iidaan le ibaadat Achiira misil Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil sawwaah.Wa Manassa sajad giddaam kulla khuwwaat al-sama wa abadhum.
Wa bana leehum madaabih fi lubb beet Allah wa da l-bakaan al-Allah gaal foogah-:-Fi Madiinat al-Khudus bas,nukhutt usmi.
Wa battaan kula bana madaabih le kulla khuwwaat al-sama fi l-fadaayaat al-itneen hana beet Allah.
Wa hu harrag wileedah fi l-naar le l-asnaam.Wa macha le l-chaddaara wa l-chawwaafiin wa le l-naas al-yikallumu ma'a l-maytiin wa l-jannaaniyiin.Wa gaa'id yikhaddib Allah ziyaada be l-fasaala al-hu sawwaaha.
Wa hu khatta fi beet Allah sanam Achiira al-sana'ah.Wa da fi lubb al-beet al-hajja foogah Allah le Dawuud wa le wileedah Suleymaan wa gaal-:-Ana nukhutt usmi ila l-abad foog al-beet da wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus al-madiina al-ana azaltaha min kulla mudun gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa battaan ma natrud Bani Israa'iil min al-ard al-anteetha le juduudhum kan humman yahfado wa yitabbugu kulla cheyy al-ana amartuhum beyah hasab kulla l-wasaaya al-amar beehum abdi Muusa.
Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil ma sim'o kalaam Allah.Wa Manassa lazzaahum le yisawwu al-fasaala ziyaada min al-umam al-dammaraahum Allah giddaam Bani Israa'iil.
Wa be sabab da,Allah kallam leehum be waasitat abiidah al-anbiya wa gaal-:
Manassa malik mamlakat Yahuuza sawwa al-muharramaat wa l-fasaala ziyaada min kulla cheyy al-sawwooh al-Amuuriyiin gablah.Wa be ibaadat asnaamah,hu lazza naas mamlakat Yahuuza kula fi l-zunuub.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Ana ninazzil fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi balad Yahuuza masiibe al-tabhat kulla l-naas al-yasma'o beeha.
Wa nidammir Madiinat al-Khudus misil awwal dammart madiinat al-Saamira wa aayilat Akhaab.Wa ana nuguchch Madiinat al-Khudus wa sukkaanha misil al-maa'uun al-yikhassuluuh wa ba'ad da,yakfooh.
Wa naabaahum le l-faddalo min cha'abi al-misil warasati wa nisallimhum fi iid udwaanhum.Wa humman yabgo khaniime wa kasiibe le kulla udwaanhum
achaan cha'abi gaa'idiin yisawwu daayman al-fasaala giddaami.Wa humman gaa'idiin daayman yikhaddubuuni min yoom al-juduudhum marago min Masir lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Manassa kula daffag damm hana naas bariyiin lahaddi dammuhum mala kulla Madiinat al-Khudus min tarafha le tarafha.Wa da bala l-zanib al-hu lazza foogah naas mamlakat Yahuuza wa humman sawwo al-fasaala giddaam Allah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Manassa wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah wa kulla zunuubah al-sawwaahum maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa Manassa maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi jineenit gasrah al-binaaduuh jineenit Uzza.Wa wileedah Aamuun hakam fi badalah.
Wa Aamuun indah 22 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam santeen fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Machullama bineeyit Haarus min hillit Yatba.
Wa Aamuun kula sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil abuuh Manassa.
Hu chaal nafs al-derib al-abuuh chaalah wa abad al-asnaam al-abuuh abadhum wa sajad giddaamhum.
Wa aba minnah Allah Rabb juduudah wa ma chaal al-derib al-Allah yidoorah.
Wa masaa'iil Aamuun atmarrado diddah wa katalooh fi lubb beetah.
Wa laakin cha'ab al-balad katalo kulla l-naas al-atmarrado didd al-malik Aamuun.Wa darrajo wileedah Yuuchiiya malik fi badalah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Aamuun wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa dafanooh le Aamuun fi khaburah fi jineenit Uzza.Wa wileedah Yuuchiiya hakam fi badalah.
Wa Yuuchiiya indah 8 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 31 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Yadiida bineeyit Adaaya min hillit Buskhat.
Wa Yuuchiiya sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah.Hu taaba' al-derib al-adiil hana jiddah Dawuud wa ma baara minnah wa la ale l-zeene wa la ale l-isra.
Wa fi sanit 18 hana hukmah,al-malik Yuuchiiya rassal al-kaatib Chaafaan wileed Asalya wileed Machullam le beet Allah wa gaal leyah-:
Amchi bakaan Hilkhiiya kabiir rujaal al-diin wa guul leyah khalli yahsib jumlit al-fudda al-lammooha hurraas madkhal beet Allah min al-cha'ab wa jaabooha fi beet Allah.
Wa l-fudda di,yantuuha le l-naas al-mukallafiin be khidmit adiiliin beet Allah.Wa yikaffu beeha al-khaddaamiin al-yi'addulu al-chuguug hana beet Allah
wa yikaffu beeha al-khachchaabiin wa l-bannaayiin wa l-addaaliin.Wa yachru beeha maraadiis wa hujaar magtuu'iin le yi'addulu beehum al-beet.
Wa ma yas'aloohum min al-fudda al-antooha leehum di achaan humman naas al-induhum amaan.
Wa Hilkhiiya kabiir rujaal al-diin gaal le Chaafaan al-kaatib-:-Ana ligiit kitaab al-Tawraat fi beet Allah. Wa Hilkhiiya anta al-kitaab da le Chaafaan wa hu garaah.
Wa Chaafaan al-kaatib ja le l-malik wa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Masaa'iilak sallamo al-fudda al-ligooha fi makhazan beet Allah le l-mukallafiin be khidmit adiiliin beet Allah.
Wa Chaafaan al-kaatib gaal battaan le l-malik-:-Hilkhiiya raajil al-diin antaani kitaab waahid. Wa Chaafaan gara al-kitaab da giddaam al-malik.
Wa wakit al-malik simi' kalaam kitaab al-Tawraat da,gamma charrat khulgaanah min al-hizin.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik amar Hilkhiiya raajil al-diin wa Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan wa Akbuur wileed Miika wa Chaafaan al-kaatib wa Asaaya waahid min masaa'iil al-malik wa gaal leehum-:
Amchu as'alo Allah leyi wa le l-cha'ab wa le kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza be sabab al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-ligooh.Khadab Allah chadiid bilheen foogna achaan juduudna ma sim'o al-kalaam al-fi l-kitaab da wa ma tabbago kulla cheyy al-maktuub foogah.
Wa khalaas,Hilkhiiya raajil al-diin wa Akhigaam wa Akbuur wa Chaafaan wa Asaaya macho bakaan Hulda al-nabiiye marit al-haaris hana khulgaan rujaal al-diin al-usmah Challuum wileed Tigwa wileed Harhas.Wa hi saakne fi l-haara al-jadiide hana Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit humman wassalo,hajjo leeha be l-kalaam da.
Wa Hulda al-nabiiye gaalat leehum-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal tamchu tuguulu le l-raajil al-rassalaaku leyi-:
--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Akiid ana nijiib masiibe fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi sukkaanha.Wa da yihaggig kulla l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-garaah malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa da be sabab humman abooni wa harrago bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin wa khaddabooni be kulla amalhum al-sawwooh.Wa khadabi yanzil fi l-madiina di wa ana ma niwaggifah."--
Wa hassa' da,amchu guulu al-kalaam da le malik mamlakat Yahuuza al-rassalaaku tas'alo leyah Allah.Wa guulu leyah daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Inta simi't kalaam al-kitaab da
wa galbak khaaf wa inta almaskant giddaami ana Allah wakit inta simi't al-kalaam al-ana gultah didd Madiinat al-Khudus wa sukkaanha.Wa l-kalaam da buguul-:"Al-bakaan da yabga kharaab wa mal'uun."Wa inta charratt khulgaanak min al-hizin wa bakeet giddaami wa ana kula simi'tak.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa be sabab da,nikhalliik talhag abbahaatak be l-salaama wa yadfunuuk fi khaburak wa ma tichiif al-masiibe al-ana ninazzilha fi Madiinat al-Khudus.--Wa khalaas al-murassaliin macho wa kallamo al-kalaam da le l-malik.
Wa tawwaali,malik Yuuchiiya naada kulla chuyuukh Bani Yahuuza wa chuyuukh Madiinat al-Khudus le yilimmu.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik macha beet Allah ma'a kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza wa kulla sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa rujaal al-diin wa l-anbiya wa kulla l-cha'ab min al-kubaar lahaddi l-dugaag.Wa hu gara leehum kulla l-kalaam al-fi kitaab al-mu'aahada al-ligooh fi beet Allah.
Wa l-malik wagaf jamb amuud beet Allah wa jaddad al-mu'aahada ma'a Allah.Waajib ayyi waahid yitaabi' Allah wa yahfad wasiiyaatah wa ta'liimah wa churuutah be kulla galbah wa be kulla fikrah wa yitabbig kalaam al-mu'aahada al-maktuub fi l-kitaab da.Wa kulla l-cha'ab khassado be l-mu'aahada di.
Wa l-malik amar Hilkhiiya kabiir rujaal al-diin wa rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin wa hurraas madkhal beet Allah wa gaal khalli yamurgu min beet Allah kulla l-mu'iddaat al-sana'oohum le ibaadat asnaam Ba'al wa Achiira wa le kulla khuwwaat al-sama.Wa khalaas,humman maragoohum barra min Madiinat al-Khudus wa harragoohum fi waadi Khidruun wa waddo al-rumaad fi Beet Iil.
Wa hu tarad rujaal al-diin al-khattoohum muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza le yiharrugu bakhuur fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada al-fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa hawaaleeha le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa tarad al-naas al-yiharrugu al-bakhuur le Ba'al wa le l-harraay wa l-gamar wa l-nujuum wa le kulla khuwwaat al-sama.
Wa marag min beet Allah al-uud al-khazzooh le ibaadat Achiira wa waddaah barra min Madiinat al-Khudus fi waadi Khidruun wa hinaak harragah wa rihkah wa l-rumaad kamaan chattatah fi khubuur al-cha'ab.
Wa l-malik dammar buyuut al-naas al-bisawwu al-charmata al-gaa'idiin fi fadaayit beet Allah.Wa fi l-bakaan da,awiin gaa'idaat yitirran gabag le ibaadat al-ilaaha Achiira.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuuchiiya jaab kulla rujaal al-diin al-gaa'idiin fi hillaal balad Yahuuza.Wa hu najjas kulla l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada al-rujaal al-diin gaa'idiin yiharrugu fooghum al-bakhuur min Gaba' lahaddi Biir Sab'a.Wa hu dammar al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada al-fi khachum baab al-madiina wa khaassatan al-baab hana haakim al-madiina Yachuu' al-gaa'id be nuss al-isra le madkhal al-madiina.
Wa rujaal al-diin hana l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada ma induhum izin yigaddumu dahaaya fi madbah Allah al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus laakin induhum izin yaakulu khubza bala tawwaara ma'a rujaal al-diin akhwaanhum.
Wa battaan al-malik najjas al-mahrag hana Tuufa al-gaa'id fi waadi Bani Hinnuum achaan battaan naadum ma yiharrig wileedah wa la bineeytah fi l-naar le ilaah Muulak.
Wa ba''ad tamaasiil al-kheel al-khassasoohum muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza le ibaadat al-harraay.Wa tamaasiil al-kheel dool awwal khattoohum jamb madkhal beet Allah wa jamb beet al-mas'uul Natanmalik.Wa Yuuchiiya harrag al-arabaat hana ibaadat al-harraay kula.
Wa l-malik haddam al-madaabih al-banoohum muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza fi raas gasir malik Ahaaz wa l-madaabih al-Manassa banaahum fi l-fadaayaat al-itneen hana beet Allah.Wa ba'ad haddamaahum,hu chaal al-turaab wa daffagah fi waadi Khidruun.
Wa hu najjas kulla l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada al-mugaabiliin Madiinat al-Khudus be nuss al-zeene hana hajar al-Damaar.Wa l-bakaanaat dool,zamaan Suleymaan malik Bani Israa'iil banaahumle Achtaruut al-ilaahat al-muharrama hint naas balad Seeda wa le Kamuuch al-ilaah al-muharram hana naas balad Muwaab wa le Milkuum al-sanam al-makruuh hana Bani Ammuun.
Wa hu rama al-hujaar al-khazzoohum wa kassar al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira wa mala al-bakaan da be udaam al-naas.
Wa battaan al-malik haddam al-madbah al-fi Beet Iil wa da l-bakaan al-aali al-banaah Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat al-lazza naas mamlakat Israa'iil fi l-zunuub.Wa Yuuchiiya haddam al-madbah da wa l-bakaan al-aali hana l-ibaada.Wa harrag al-bakaan al-aali wa rihikah bigi rumaad wa tachcha al-uud al-khazzooh le ibaadat Achiira.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuuchiiya chaglab wa chaaf al-khubuur al-gaa'idiin fi raas al-hajar fi l-bakaan da.Wa rassal naas yijiibu al-udaam min al-khubuur wa hu gamma tachcha al-udaam fi l-madbah da achaan yinajjisah.Wa l-cheyy da bigi hasab kalaam nabi Allah al-awwal gaalah.
Wa l-malik sa'al wa gaal-:-Al-hajar al-gaa'id nichiifah,da chunu-? Wa naas al-hille raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Da khabur hana nabi Allah al-ja min balad Yahuuza wa hajja be l-achya al-hassa' inta sawweethum fi l-madbah hana Beet Iil.
Wa khalaas,al-malik gaal-:-Khallu al-khabur da-!Naadum ma yilammis udaam al-nabi. Wa be misil da,ma limso udaam al-nabi da walla udaam al-nabi al-chaayib al-ja min al-Saamira kula.
Wa l-malik Yuuchiiya haddam kulla l-buyuut al-gaa'idiin fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada al-fi hillaal al-Saamira al-banoohum muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil achaan yikhaddubu Allah.Wa hu dammar kulla l-buyuut dool misil sawwaah fi Beet Iil.
Wa fi raas madaabih hana l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin dool,hu dabah kulla rujaal al-diin al-gaa'idiin fi l-bakaan da wa harrag udaam al-naas.Wa ba'ad da,gabbal Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-malik Yuuchiiya amar kulla l-cha'ab wa gaal leehum-:-Ayyudu iid al-Fisha le Allah Ilaahku hasab al-kalaam al-maktuub fi kitaab al-mu'aahada.
Wa l-cha'ab abadan ma ayyado iid misil da min al-wakit al-hakamo foogah al-hukkaam al-binaaduuhum al-gudiya lahaddi kulla l-wakit al-hakamo foogah muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil wa muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa laakin fi sanit 18 hana hukum al-malik Yuuchiiya,ayyado iid al-Fisha le Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Yuuchiiya katal al-yikallumu ma'a l-maytiin wa l-jannaaniyiin wa dammar al-asnaam wa l-tamaasiil wa kulla l-muharramaat al-gaa'idiin fi balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa da achaan yihaggig kalaam al-Tawraat al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-ligaah Hilkhiiya kabiir rujaal al-diin fi beet Allah.
Wa ma fi malik misil Yuuchiiya al-taaba' le Allah be kulla galbah wa kulla fikrah wa kulla gudurtah hasab Tawraat Muusa.Wa ba'adah ma fi malik mislah.
Wa be da kula,Allah ma khalla minnah khadabah al-muhrig didd mamlakat Yahuuza be sabab kulla l-fasaala al-sawwaaha Manassa diddah.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Niba''id min giddaami mamlakat Yahuuza misil ba''adt mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa nikhalli minni Madiinat al-Khudus al-madiina al-ana azaltaha wa l-beet al-ana gult foogah-:--Da bas al-bakaan al-nukhutt foogah usmi.-
Wa l-baagi min amal Yuuchiiya wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa fi wakit hukum Yuuchiiya,Fir'oon Naku malik balad Masir gamma le yahjim malik balad Achuur be jiihat bahar al-Furaat.Wa l-malik Yuuchiiya macha gaabalah fi l-derib wa laakin wakit malik Masir chaafah,katalah le Yuuchiiya fi hillit Magiddu.
Wa masaa'iilah chaalooh fi araba wa waddooh min Magiddu lahaddi Madiinat al-Khudus wa dafanooh fi khaburah.Wa cha'ab al-balad chaalooh le Yahaaz wileed Yuuchiiya masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi badal abuuh.
Wa Yahaaz indah 23 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam talaata chahar fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Hamuutal bineeyit Irmiya min hillit Libna.
Wa Yahaaz sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil juduudah sawwooh.
Wa Fir'oon Naku malik balad Masir karabah wa sajanah fi Ribla balad Hamaat wa battaan ma hakam fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ziyaada min da,al-malik Naku jabaraahum le naas mamlakat Yahuuza yikaffu miiri hana 3-400 kiilo hana fudda wa 34 kiilo hana dahab.
Wa Fir'oon Naku darraj Aliyaakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik fi badal abuuh Yuuchiiya wa khayyar usmah wa sammaah Yahuuyakhim.Wa kan le Yahaaz al-masjuun kamaan,waddaah Masir wa maat hinaak.
Wa Yahuuyakhim chaal al-miiri min naas mamlakat Yahuuza achaan yanti le Fir'oon Naku al-fudda wa l-dahab al-hu talabaahum.Wa ayyi waahid kaffa al-miiri al-khattooh foogah hasab gudurtah wa Yahuuyakhim antaah le malik Masir.
Wa Yahuuyakhim indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 11 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Zabuuda bineeyit Fadaaya min hillit al-Ruuma.
Wa Yahuuyakhim sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil juduudah sawwooh.
Wa wakit Yahuuyakhim gaa'id yahkim,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil chaal mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa Yahuuyakhim ga'ad tihit hukmah muddit talaata sana wa ba'ad da,atmarrad diddah.
Wa Allah rassal didd Yahuuyakhim nahhaabiin min balad Baabil wa balad Araam wa balad Muwaab wa Bani Ammuun achaan yidammuru balad Yahuuza.Wa da hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah be waasitat abiidah al-anbiya.
Wa kulla l-achya dool bigo be amur Allah al-dawwar yiba''id minnah mamlakat Yahuuza be sabab zunuub Manassa wa kulla cheyy al-hu sawwaah
wa be sabab damm al-naas al-bariyiin al-Manassa katalaahum lahaddi dammuhum mala kulla Madiinat al-Khudus da.Wa Allah aba ma yakhfir leehum.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahuuyakhim wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah maktuubiin fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Yahuuza.
Wa Yahuuyakhim maat wa lihig abbahaatah.Wa wileedah Yuyakiin hakam fi badalah.
Wa min al-wakit da,malik Masir ma marag battaan min baladah achaan malik Baabil chaal minnah kulla l-manaatig al-awwal fi iideenah min waadi Masir fi l-wati lahaddi bahar al-Furaat fi l-munchaakh.
Wa Yuyakiin indah 18 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam talaata chahar fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Nahuuchta bineeyit Alnaataan min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Yuyakiin sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil abuuh sawwaah.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,rujaal Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil jo wa haasaro Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil hu zaatah ja hajam al-hille al-rujaalah haasarooha.
Wa khalaas,Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza marag didd malik Baabil wa chaal ma'a ammah wa masaa'iilah wa kubaaraatah wa khaddaamiinah.Wa malik Baabil karabah wa waddaah masjuun wa da fi l-sana al-taamne hana hukmah.
Misil Allah gaalah,Nabuukhadnasar chaal kulla l-achya al-fi makhaazin beet Allah wa gasir al-malik.Wa kulla l-mawaa'iin hana l-dahab al-Suleymaan malik Bani Israa'iil sana'aahum wa khataahum fi beet Allah,Nabuukhadnasar dammaraahum.
Wa hu wadda fi l-khurba kulla cha'ab Madiinat al-Khudus wa kulla l-kubaaraat wa kulla l-rujaal al-furraas wa adadhum yisaawi 10-000.Wa wadda ma'aahum kulla l-sayyaakhiin wa l-haddaad.Wa fi l-balad,faddalo illa masaakiin al-balad.
Wa hu wadda fi Baabil al-malik Yuyakiin wa ammah wa awiinah wa khaddaamiinah wa furraas al-balad.Hu chaalaahum min Madiinat al-Khudus wa waddaahum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar wadda kulla askar adadhum 7-000 wa l-sayyaakhiin wa l-haddaad adadhum 1-000 wa kulla l-naas al-fahaliin al-ya'arfu al-duwaas.Wa hu wadda kulla l-naas dool fi l-khurba fi Baabil.
Wa malik Baabil darraj Mattanya immah le Yuyakiin malik fi badalah wa khayyar usmah wa sammaah Sidkhiiya.
Wa Sidkhiiya indah 21 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 11 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Hamuutal bineeyit Irmiya min hillit Libna.
Wa Sidkhiiya sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil al-malik Yahuuyakhim sawwaah.
Wa l-fasaala al-humman sawwooha fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi balad Yahuuza jaabat khadab Allah.Wa fi chaan da,Allah taradaahum ba'iid minnah.Wa Sidkhiiya atmarrad didd malik Baabil.
Fi l-yoom al-aachir hana l-chahar al-aachir fi l-sana al-taas'e hana hukum Sidkhiiya,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja be kulla askarah le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa humman nazalo wa hawwagooha be radmiiye.
Wa l-madiina di ga'adat muhaasara lahaddi sanit 11 hana hukum al-malik Sidkhiiya.
Wa l-juu' bigi chadiid fi l-madiina wa l-naas ma induhum cheyy yaakuluuh.Wa fi l-yoom al-taasi' hana l-chahar al-raabi',
gaddo khurma fi durdur al-madiina.Wa khalaas be l-leel,malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa kulla askarah marago wa arrado.Humman marago be l-derib al-gaa'id ambeenaat al-daraadir al-itneen hana l-difaa' al-gariib le jineenit al-malik hatta kan al-Baabiliyiin muhawwigiin al-madiina kula.Wa l-malik Sidkhiiya chaal al-derib al-maachi ale waadi al-Urdun.
Wa laakin askar Baabil taradooh le l-malik wa lihgooh wa karabooh fi kadaadit Ariiha.Wa kulla askarah arrado khallooh.
Wa askar Baabil karabooh le l-malik Sidkhiiya wa waddooh fi hillit Ribla giddaam malik Baabil.Wa fi l-bakaan da,haakamooh.
Wa humman dabaho awlaad Sidkhiiya fi giddaamah.Wa ba'ad da,malik Baabil gaddad uyuun Sidkhiiya wa janzarah be jinziir hana nahaas matbuug wa waddaah fi Baabil.
Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' hana l-chahar al-khaamis fi sanit 19 hana hukum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas wa mas'uul le malik Baabil dakhal fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu tachcha beet Allah wa gasir al-malik wa kulla buyuut Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa kulla buyuut al-masaa'iil,hu harragaahum be naar.
Wa kulla askar Baabil al-macho ma'a kabiir al-hurraas kassaro al-durdur al-muhawwig Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas chaal ma'aayah al-cha'ab al-faddalo fi l-madiina wa l-sallamo nufuushum le malik Baabil.Wa hu chaal naas aakhariin kula wa waddaahum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.
Wa laakin kabiir al-hurraas khalla waahidiin min masaakiin al-balad le yahartu al-inab wa l-ziraa'a.
Wa askar Baabil kassaro amad al-nahaas al-giddaam beet Allah wa l-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin wa l-hoot al-kabiir hana nahaas al-gaa'id giddaam beet Allah.Wa waddo kulla l-nahaas da fi Baabil.
Wa humman chaalo al-buraam wa l-feelaat wa l-sakaakiin wa l-kiisaan wa kulla l-mawaa'iin al-sana'oohum min nahaas wa asta'maloohum le l-ibaada.
Wa khammaamaat al-naar wa l-kiisaan al-kulluhum min dahab wa fudda,chaalaahum kabiir al-hurraas.
Wa kan le l-amad al-itneen wa l-hoot al-kabiir wa l-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin al-sana'aahum al-malik Suleymaan le beet Allah,wazin nahaashum ma ma'ruuf min al-katara.
Wa l-amuud al-awwalaani,tuulah 18 duraa' wa l-amuud da khatto foogah raas hana nahaas al-tuulah 3 duraa' wa muhawwag be salaasil al-murassas fooghum rummaan wa kulluhum ke min nahaas.Wa l-amuud al-taani,sun'itah sawa sawa misil al-amuud al-awwalaani be salaasilah.
Wa battaan kabiir al-hurraas karab Saraaya kabiir rujaal al-diin wa Safanya raajil al-diin al-naayib wa l-hurraas al-talaata hana madkhal beet Allah.
Wa min al-madiina,karab kabiir waahid al-mukallaf be l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin wa khamsa naas min khaddaamiin al-malik al-ligoohum fi lubb al-madiina.Wa karab battaan al-kaatib hana khaayid al-deech,hu al-mukallaf be jannidiin al-cha'ab fi l-askariiye wa 60 raajil min al-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi l-madiina.
Wa Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas karabaahum masaajiin wa waddaahum le malik Baabil fi Ribla.
Wa malik Baabil katalaahum hinaak fi Ribla fi balad Hamaat.Wa be misil da,kulla naas balad Yahuuza waddoohum fi l-khurba ba'iid min arduhum.
Wa kan le l-naas al-faddalo fi balad Yahuuza,humman al-Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil khallaahum,hu darraj Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan haakim fooghum.
Wa wakit kulla khuyyaad al-askar hana mamlakat Yahuuza wa kulla naashum sim'o kadar malik Baabil darrajah le Gadaalya haakim,gammo macho leyah fi Misfa.Wa l-naas dool humman Ismaa'iil wileed Natanya wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa Saraaya wileed Tanhuumat min hillit Natuufa wa Yazanya min hillit Ma'aaka.
Wa Gadaalya halaf leehum wa le naashum wa gaal-:-Ma takhaafo min masaa'iil al-Baabiliyiin.Agoodu fi l-balad wa akhdumu tihit sultit malik Baabil wa akiid da yabga leeku adiil.
Wa laakin fi l-chahar al-saabi',Ismaa'iil wileed Natanya wileed Alichama' min zurriiyit al-mamlaka ja ma'a achara rujaal wa darabooh le Gadaalya wa katalooh,hu wa naas min balad Yahuuza wa l-Baabiliyiin al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah fi hillit Misfa.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,kulla cha'ab mamlakat Yahuuza,kan kabiir walla sakhiir walla kubaaraat al-askar kula,gammo wa macho balad Masir achaan khaafo min al-Baabiliyiin.
Wa fi sanit 37 min waddo Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza fi l-khurba fi Baabil,darrajo Awiil Maruudak malik fi Baabil.Wa fi yoom 27 hana chahri 12 hana l-sana di,Awiil Maruudak afa Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa talagah min al-sijin.
Wa l-malik hajja leyah be kalaam halu wa darrajah fi bakaan aali ziyaada min al-muluuk al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah fi Baabil.
Wa malik Baabil khayyar khulgaan Yuyakiin hana l-sijin wa khallaah yaakul ma'aayah daayman fi dabalaaytah fi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Wa be misil da fi kulla muddit hayaatah,Yuyakiin ligi riise samhe min malik Baabil.
Adam wilid Chiitwa Chiit wilid Anuuch.
Wa Anuuch wilid Khinaanwa Khinaan wilid Mahlaliilwa Mahlaliil wilid Yaarad.
Wa Yaarad wilid Akhnuukhwa Akhnuukh wilid Matuuchalahwa Matuuchalah wilid Laamak.
Wa Laamak wilid Noohwa Nooh wilid awlaad talaata wa humman Saam wa Haam wa Yaafas.
Wa awlaad Yaafas humman Guumar wa Maajuuj wa Maadaay wa Yawaan wa Tuubal wa Maachak wa Tiraas.
Wa awlaad Guumar humman Achkanaaz wa Diifat wa Tugarma.
Wa awlaad Yawaan humman Aliicha wa Tarchiich wa Kittiim wa Rudaaniim.
Wa awlaad Haam humman Kuuch wa Misraayim wa Fuut wa Kan'aan.
Wa awlaad Kuuch humman Saba wa Hawiila wa Sabta wa Ra'ma wa Sabtaka.Wa awlaad Ra'ma humman Chaba wa Dadaan.
Wa Kuuch wilid Nimruud.Wa Nimruud hu awwal raajil faaris fi l-ard.
Wa Misraayim jaab gabaayil Luud wa Anaam wa Lahaab wa Naftuuh
wa Fatruus wa Kasluuh wa Kaftuur.Wa min gabiilat Kasluuh bas marago al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Kan'aan wilid Siduun wileedah al-bikir wa ba'adah wilid Hitta.

Wa daahu asaame chuyuukh khuchuum buyuut gabiilat Chim'uun.Wa humman Machuubaab wa Yamliik wa Yuucha wileed Amasya wa Yuwiil wa Yaahu wileed Yuchibya wileed Saraaya wileed Asiyiil wa Aliyu'naay wa Ya'khuuba wa Yuchuhaaya wa Asaaya wa Adiyiil wa Yasimiil wa Banaaya wa Ziiza wileed Chif'i wileed Alluun wileed Yadaaya wileed Chimri wileed Chama'ya.Wa aayilaathum bigo kubaar marra waahid.

Wa waahidiin min zurriiyit Chim'uun macho fi jibaal Sa'iir.Wa adadhum 500 raajil wa fi raashum Falatya wa Na'arya wa Rafaaya wa Uzziyiil kulluhum awlaad Yich'i.

Wa Ra'uubiin hu bikir Israa'iil.Wa achaan hu dakhal fi marit abuuh,hagg bukuuriiytah antooh le iyaal Yuusuf al-hu kula wileed Israa'iil.Wa be da,Ra'uubiin ma ligi hagg al-bukuuriiye.

Wa fi l-sabaah kamaan,humman sakano fi khachum al-sahara al-maachi lahaddi bahar al-Furaat achaan humman induhum bahaayim katiiriin fi balad Gil'aad.
Wa fi wakit al-malik Chaawuul,naas zurriiyit Ra'uubiin haarabo Bani Haajar wa annasaro fooghum.Wa sakano fi furgaanhum fi kulla l-mantaga al-sabaah le balad Gil'aad.

Wa l-aayila al-awwalaaniiye hi hint Yuwiil wa waraayah aayilat Chaafaam wa Ya'naay wa Chaafaat kulluhum fi Baachaan.
Wa ma'aahum sab'a aayilaat aakhariin wa humman Mikaayiil wa Machullam wa Chaba' wa Yuraay wa Ya'akaan wa Zii' wa Ibaar.
Wa di l-zurriiye al-maragat min Abihaayil.Wa Abihaayil hu wileed Huuriwa Huuri wileed Yaaruuhwa Yaaruuh wileed Gil'aadwa Gil'aad wileed Mikaayiilwa Mikaayiil wileed Yachiichaaywa Yachiichaay wileed Yahduwa Yahdu wileed Buuz.

Wa kulla aayilaat Gaad sakano fi Gil'aad wa fi Baachaan wa fi l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum wa fi bakaanaat al-mar'a hana Chaaruun lahaddi huduudhum.
Wa kulla l-naas al-gabiila di sajjalo usumhum fi wakit Yuutaam malik Bani Yahuuza wa Yaruba'aam malik Bani Israa'iil.
Wa gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa,humman kulla induhum 44-760 rujaal fahaliin al-ya'arfu yista'malo al-daraga wa l-seef wa l-nuchchaab wa jaahiziin le l-harib.
Wa humman haarabo Bani Haajar wa zurriiyit Yatuur wa Nafiich wa Nudaab.
Wa fi wakt al-harba di,humman koorako le l-Rabb le yafza'hum achaan humman mutawakkiliin aleyah.Wa hu khibil su'aalhum wa nasaraahum fi Bani Haajar wa l-naas al-ma'aahum.
Wa humman nahabo bahaayim katiiriin,50-000 ibil wa 250-000 khanam wa 2-000 hamiir.Wa karabo 100-000 naas masaajiin
wa katalo naas katiiriin achaan al-harib da,al-Rabb bas amar beyah.Wa humman sakano fi badalhum lahaddi l-wakit al-waddoohum fi l-khurba.
Wa zurriiyit nuss gabiilat Manassa sakano fi l-balad min Baachaan lahaddi Ba'al Harmuun wa Saniir wa jabal Harmuun.Humman katiiriin marra waahid.
Wa daahu asaame kubaaraat aayilaathum.Humman Ifir wa Yich'i wa Aliyiil wa Azriyiil wa Irmiya wa Hudawya wa Yahdiyiil.Humman dool rujaal furraas wa gaadriin wa kubaaraat aayilaathum.
Wa laakin fi l-akhiir naas gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa iso Allah Rabb juduudhum.Wa humman achcharmato ma'a ilaahaat aakhariin wa abadoohum.Wa dool ilaahaat al-chu'uub al-dammaraahum al-Rabb min giddaamhum.
Wa khalaas,Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil lazza Fuul malik balad Achuur wa hu al-usmah Takhlat Falaasar.Wa Takhlat Falaasar ja chaal gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa gabiilat Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa.Wa waddaahum fi l-khurba fi balad Achuurfi hillaal Halah wa Haabur wa Haara wa gariib le bahar Guzaan.Wa humman saakniin hinaak lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa awlaad Laawi humman Girchuun wa Gahaat wa Maraari.
Wa awlaad Gahaat humman Amraam wa Yishaar wa Habruun wa Uzziyiil.
Wa awlaad Amraam humman Haaruun wa Muusa wa Mariyam.Wa awlaad Haaruun humman Nadaab wa Abiihu wa Ali'aazar wa Itamaar.
Wa Ali'aazar wilid Fiinhaaswa Fiinhaas wilid Abichuu'
wa Abichuu' wilid Bukhiwa Bukhi wilid Uzzi
wa Uzzi wilid Zarahyawa Zarahya wilid Marayuut
wa Marayuut wilid Amaryawa Amarya wilid Akhituub
wa Akhituub wilid Saduukhwa Saduukh wilid Akhimaa'as
wa Akhimaa'as wilid Azaryawa Azarya wilid Yuuhanaan
wa Yuuhanaan wilid Azarya.Wa Azarya hu bas al-bigi raajil diin fi beet Allah al-banaah Suleymaan fi Uruchaliim.
Wa Azarya wilid Amaryawa Amarya wilid Akhituub
wa Akhituub wilid Saduukhwa Saduukh wilid Challuum
wa Challuum wilid Hilkhiiyawa Hilkhiiya wilid Azarya
wa Azarya wilid Saraayawa Saraaya wilid Yuusaadikh.
Wa Yuusaadikh kula waddooh wakit Allah wadda naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus fi l-khurba be iid Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.
Wa daahu asaame awlaad Girchuun,humman Libni wa Chim'i.
Wa awlaad Maraari humman Mahli wa Muuchi.Wa dool bas al-juduud al-anto asaameehum le khuchuum buyuut al-Laawiyiin.
Wa Girchuun wilid Libniwa Libni wilid Yahatwa Yahat wilid Zimma
wa Zimma wilid Yuwaakhwa Yuwaakh wilid Idduwa Iddu wilid Zaarahwa Zaarah wilid Yaatraay.
Wa Gahaat wilid Aminadaabwa Aminadaab wilid Khuurahwa Khuurah wilid Assiir
wa Assiir wilid Alikhaanawa Alikhaana wilid Abiyaasafwa Abiyaasaf wilid Assiir
wa Assiir wilid Tahatwa Tahat wilid Uriyiilwa Uriyiil wilid Uzziiyawa Uzziiya wilid Chaawuul.
Wa awlaad Alikhaana humman Amaasaay wa Akhimuut.
Wa Akhimuut wilid Alikhaanawa Alikhaana wilid Suufaaywa Suufaay wilid Nahat
wa Nahat wilid Aliyaabwa Aliyaab wilid Yaruuhaamwa Yaruuhaam wilid Alikhaana.
Wa awlaad Samuwiil humman Yuwiil al-bikir wa Abiiya al-taani.
Wa Maraari wilid Mahliwa Mahli wilid Libniwa Libni wilid Chim'iwa Chim'i wilid Uzza
wa Uzza wilid Chim'awa Chim'a wilid Haggiiyawa Haggiiya wilid Asaaya.
Wa ba'ad khatto al-sanduug fi kheemat Allah,Dawuud anta al-mas'uuliiye hint al-khine le naas zurriiyit Laawi.
Gubbaal Suleymaan ma bana beet Allah fi Uruchaliim,al-naas dool gaa'idiin yisawwu khidmithum hana l-khine giddaam al-kheema wa hi kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa humman sawwo khidmithum hasab al-churuut.
Wa l-naas dool ma'a iyaalhum gaa'idiin yisawwu al-khidme di.Wa min zurriiyit Gahaat,Heemaan kabiir al-khannaayiin.Wa Heemaan da wileed Yuwiilwa Yuwiil wileed Samuwiil
wa Samuwiil wileed Alikhaanawa Alikhaana wileed Yaruuhaamwa Yaruuhaam wileed Aliyiilwa Aliyiil wileed Tuuh
wa Tuuh wileed Suufwa Suuf wileed Alikhaanawa Alikhaana wileed Mahatwa Mahat wileed Amaasaay
wa Amaasaay wileed Alikhaanawa Alikhaana wileed Yuwiilwa Yuwiil wileed Azaryawa Azarya wileed Safanya
wa Safanya wileed Tahatwa Tahat wileed Assiirwa Assiir wileed Abiyaasafwa Abiyaasaf wileed Khuurah
wa Khuurah wileed Yishaarwa Yishaar wileed Gahaatwa Gahaat wileed Laawiwa Laawi wileed Israa'iil.
Wa be l-nuss al-zeenaay hana Heemaan,waagif rafiigah Asaaf.Wa Asaaf da wileed Barakyawa Barakya wileed Chim'a
wa Chim'a wileed Mikaayiilwa Mikaayiil wileed Ba'asiiyawa Ba'asiiya wileed Malkiiya
wa Malkiiya wileed Atniwa Atni wileed Zaarahwa Zaarah wileed Adaaya
wa Adaaya wileed Itaanwa Itaan wileed Zimmawa Zimma wileed Chim'i
wa Chim'i wileed Yahatwa Yahat wileed Girchuunwa Girchuun wileed Laawi.
Wa be l-nuss al-israay hana Heemaan,waagif Itaan min zurriiyit Maraari.Wa Itaan da wileed Khiichiwa Khiichi wileed Abdiwa Abdi wileed Malluuk
wa Malluuk wileed Hachabyawa Hachabya wileed Amasyawa Amasya wileed Hilkhiiya
wa Hilkhiiya wileed Amsiwa Amsi wileed Baaniwa Baani wileed Chaamar
wa Chaamar wileed Mahliwa Mahli wileed Muuchiwa Muuchi wileed Maraariwa Maraari wileed Laawi.
Wa akhwaanhum min gabiilat Laawi,humman bas al-gaa'idiin yisawwu kulla l-khidme al-tukhuss kheemat beet Allah.
Haaruun wa awlaadah,humman yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin fi l-madbah wa l-bakhuur fi l-mukhbar wa yisawwu kulla l-khidme al-tukhuss al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.Wa yisawwu kaffaara le Bani Israa'iil hasab amur Muusa abd al-Rabb.
Wa daahu asaame zurriiyit Haaruun.Haaruun wilid Ali'aazarwa Ali'aazar wilid Fiinhaaswa Fiinhaas wilid Abichuu'
wa Abichuu' wilid Bukhiwa Bukhi wilid Uzziwa Uzzi wilid Zarahya
wa Zarahya wilid Marayuutwa Marayuut wilid Amaryawa Amarya wilid Akhituub
wa Akhituub wilid Saduukhwa Saduukh wilid Akhimaa'as.
Wa daahu al-mudun wa l-furgaan al-sakano fiihum zurriiyit Haaruun al-min khachum beet Gahaat.Wa humman bas al-awwalaaniyiin al-ligo arduhum be am'iyeedaat.
Wa antoohum madiina Hibruun fi ard gabiilat Yahuuza ma'a kulla bakaanaatha hana l-sarha al-mujaawiriinha.
Wa laakin al-ziraa'a hana l-madiina di wa l-hillaal dool antoohum le Kaalib wileed Yafuuna.
Wa le zurriiyit Haaruun antoohum mudun hana luju.Wa l-mudun dool humman Hibruun wa Libna wa Yattiir wa Achtamuu'a wa Hiliin wa Dabiir wa Achan wa Beet Chams wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa min ard gabiilat Banyaamiin kamaan,chaalo Gaba' wa Alamaat wa Anatuut wa antoohum le zurriiyit Haaruun.Wa kulla adad mudunhum 13 madiina be bakaanaathum hana l-sarha wa mugassam ale hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.
Wa zurriiyit Gahaat al-aakhariin ligo 10 mudun ale hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Wa humman ligoohum be am'iyeedaat min ard gabiilat Afraayim wa Daan wa min ard nuss gabiilat Manassa.
Wa zurriiyit Girchuun ligo 13 mudun ale hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Wa humman ligoohum be am'iyeedaat min ard gabiilat Yassaakar wa Achiir wa Naftaali wa min ard nuss gabiilat Manassa al-fi Baachaan.
Wa zurriiyit Maraari ligo 12 mudun ale hasab khuchuum buyuuthum.Wa humman ligoohum be am'iyeedaat min ard gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa Gaad wa Zabuluun.
Wa Bani Israa'iil anto kulla l-mudun dool wa l-bakaanaat al-sarha le l-Laawiyiin.
Wa antoohum al-mudun dool be am'iyeedaat min ard gabiilat Yahuuza wa Chim'uun wa Banyaamiin.
Wa khuchuum buyuut zurriiyit Gahaat al-aakhariin ligo mudunhum be am'iyeedaat min ard gabiilat Afraayim.Wa antoohum mudun hana luju wa l-mudun dool Chakiim al-gaa'ide fi jibaal Afraayim wa Gaazar wa Yakhma'aam wa Beet Huruun wa Ayyaluun wa Gaat Rimmuun wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa min ard nuss gabiilat Manassa ligo mudun Aniir wa Bil'aam wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa da kulla ke le khuchuum buyuut zurriiyit Gahaat al-aakhariin.
Wa zurriiyit Girchuun ale hasab khuchuum buyuuthum ligo mudun hana luju min ard nuss gabiilat Manassa.Wa l-mudun dool humman Joolaan fi Baachaan wa Achtaruut wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa min ard gabiilat Yassaakar ligo mudun.Wa l-mudun dool humman Khadach wa Dabra wa Raamuut wa Aniim wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa min ard gabiilat Achiir ligo mudun.Wa l-mudun dool humman Machaal wa Abduun wa Huguug wa Rahuub wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa min ard gabiilat Naftaali ligo mudun.Wa l-mudun dool humman Khadach fi l-Jaliil wa Hammuun wa Khiryataayim wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa gabiilat Maraari al-aakhariin ligo mudun min ard gabiilat Zabuluun.Wa l-mudun dool humman Rimmuun wa Taabuur wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa min ard gabiilat Ra'uubiin sabaah le bahar al-Urdun mugaabil hillit Ariiha ligo mudun.Wa l-mudun dool humman Baasar al-fi l-kadaade wa Yahaas wa Khadimuut wa Mifa'at wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa min ard gabiilat Gaad ligo mudun.Wa l-mudun dool humman Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad wa Mahanaayim wa Hachbuun wa Ya'ziir wa ayyi madiina be bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.
Wa awlaad Tuula' humman Uzzi wa Rafaaya wa Yariyiil wa Yahmaay wa Yibsaam wa Samuwiil.Wa humman dool kubaaraat aayilat Tuula' hasab zurriiyithum.Wa fi wakit Dawuud,zurriiyithum di adadhum 22-600 raajil faaris.
Wa wileed Uzzi hu Yizrahya.Wa awlaad Yizrahya humman Mikaayiil wa Ubadya wa Yuwiil wa Yichiiya.Hu wa awlaadah adadhum khamsa wa kulluhum kubaaraat.
Wa hasab zurriiyithum aayilaathum induhum 36-000 askar muhaaribiin achaan induhum awiin wa iyaal katiiriin marra waahid.
Wa akhwaanhum al-aakhariin al-min gabiilat Yassaakar al-sajjaloohum,adadhum 87-000 raajil faaris.
Wa Banyaamiin jaab awlaad talaata wa humman Baala' wa Baakar wa Yadiya'iil.
Wa Baala' jaab khamsa awlaad wa humman Asbuun wa Uzzi wa Uzziyiil wa Yarimuut wa Iiri,kulluhum ke kubaaraat fi aayilaathum.Wa naashum dool sajjaloohum wa adadhum 22-034 raajil faaris.
Wa awlaad Baakar humman Zamiira wa Yuwaach wa Ali'aazar wa Aliyu'naay wa Umri wa Yarimuut wa Abiiya wa Anatuut wa Alamaat dool kulluhum ke min zurriiyit Baakar
wa humman kubaaraat fi aayilaathum.Wa naashum dool sajjaloohum hasab zurriiyithum wa adadhum 20-200 raajil faaris.
Wa wileed Yadiya'iil hu Bilhaan.Wa awlaad Bilhaan humman Ya'uuch wa Banyaamiin wa Ihuud wa Kan'aana wa Ziitaan wa Tarchiich wa Akhichaahar.
Wa dool kulluhum ke min zurriiyit Yadiya'iil wa humman kubaaraat fi aayilaathum.Wa naashum dool sajjaloohum wa adadhum 17-200 rujaal furraas wa jaahiziin le l-harib.
Wa Chuffim wa Huffiim humman dool iyaal Iirwa Huchiim hu wileed Ahiir.
Wa awlaad Naftaali humman Yahsiyiil wa Guuni wa Yisar wa Challuum.Wa amm Naftaali usumha Bilha.
Wa awlaad Manassa humman Asriyiil wa Makiir al-wildathum leyah sirriiytah al-Araamiiye.Wa Makiir da hu abu Gil'aad.
Wa Makiir akhad awiin le iyaalah Huffiim wa Chuffim.Wa akhut Makiir usumha Ma'aaka.Wa wileedah al-taani usmah Saluufhad.Wa Saluufhad da jaab illa banaat bas.
Wa marit Makiir al-usumha Ma'aaka jaabat wileed wa sammatah Faraach wa akhuuh usmah Charaach.Wa iyaal Charaach humman Ulaam wa Raakhim.
Wa wileed Ulaam usmah Badaan.Wa dool zurriiyit Gil'aad wileed Makiir wileed Manassa.
Wa Hamuulaka akhut Gil'aad jaabat Ichhuud wa Abi'aazar wa Mahla.
Wa awlaad Chamiida' humman Akhyaan wa Chakiim wa Lighi wa Ani'aam.
Wa Afraayim wilid Chutaalahwa Chutaalah wilid Baradwa Barad wilid Tahatwa Tahat wilid Ali'aadawa Ali'aada wilid Tahat
wa Tahat wilid Zabaadwa Zabaad wilid Chutaalah.Wa iyaal Afraayim al-itneen Izaar wa Ali'aad da,sukkaan hillit Gaat kataloohum achaan humman macho le yagla'o bahaayimhum.
Wa abuuhum Afraayim tawwal fi l-hizin.Wa akhwaanah jo le bihannusuuh.
Wa ba'ad da,Afraayim lamma ma'a martah wa hi bigat khalbaane wa jaabat wileed.Wa sammaah Barii'a (ma'anaatah fi l-charr) achaan al-charr ja le aayiltah.
Wa Afraayim battaan indah bineeye waahide usumha Chiira wa hi bas al-banat hillit Beet Huruun al-tihit wa Beet Huruun al-foog wa hillit Uziin Chiira.
Wa Barii'a wilid Raafahwa Raafah wilid Raachafwa Raachaf wilid Taalahwa Taalah wilid Taahan
wa Taahan wilid La'daanwa La'daan wilid Amihuudwa Amihuud wilid Alichama'
wa Alichama' wilid Nuunwa Nuun wilid Yachuu'.
Wa zurriiyit Afraayim sakano fi mudun warasathum wa humman Beet Iil wa Na'araan be sabaah wa Gaazar be kharib wa Chakiim wa Ayya wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa zurriiyit Manassa kula sakano fi mudun wa humman Beet Chaan wa Ta'nak wa Magiddu wa Duur wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum.Wa fi l-hillaal dool bas sakano zurriiyit Yuusuf wileed Israa'iil.
Wa awlaad Achiir humman Yimna wa Yichwa wa Yichwi wa Barii'a wa akhuthum Saarah.
Wa awlaad Barii'a humman Haabar wa Malkiyiilwa Malkiyiil da abu Birzayit.
Wa Haabar wilid Yaflit wa Chumiir wa Huutaam wa akhuthum Chuu'a.
Wa awlaad Yaflit humman Faasak wa Bimhaal wa Achwaat.
Wa awlaad Chaamar humman Ruhga wa Yahubba wa Araam.
Wa awlaad Hiilaam akhuuh humman Suufah wa Yimna' wa Chiilach wa Amaal.
Wa awlaad Suufah humman Suuh wa Harnafar wa Chuu'al wa Biiri wa Yimra
wa Baasar wa Huud wa Chamma wa Chilcha wa Yitraan wa Biira.
Wa awlaad Yatar humman Yafuuna wa Fisfa wa Ara.
Wa awlaad Ulla humman Aarah wa Hanniyiil wa Risya.
Wa kulla l-naas dool humman min zurriiyit Achiir wa kubaaraat fi aayilaathum wa rujaal furraas wa khuyyaad.Wa kulla l-naas dool sajjaloohum fi l-deech wa adadhum 26-000 rujaal gaadriin fi l-harba.
Wa Banyaamiin wilid Baala' al-bikir wa Achbiil al-taani wa Akhrakh al-taalit
wa Nuuha al-raabi' wa Raafa al-khaamis.
Wa awlaad Baala' humman Addaar wa Giira wa Abihuud
wa Abichuu' wa Na'amaan wa Akhuukh
wa Giira wa Chafuufan wa Huuraam.
Wa daahu awlaad Ihuud al-bigo kubaaraat al-aayilaat al-saakniin fi Gaba' wa waddo naashum fi l-khurba fi Manaahat.
Humman Na'amaan wa Akhiiya wa Giira.Wa Giira hu bas kabiirhum al-waddaahum fi l-khurba.Wa hu wilid Uzza wa Akhihuud.
Wa Chaharaayim tarad awiinah al-itneen Huchiim wa Ba'ara,wa ba'ad da,wilid awlaad fi balad Muwaab
min martah Hudach.Wa iyaalah humman Yubaab wa Sibya wa Miicha wa Malkaam
wa Ya'uus wa Saakya wa Mirma.Wa dool awlaad Chaharaayim al-bigo kubaaraat al-aayilaat.
Wa gubbaal da,Chaharaayim indah awlaad itneen wa humman Abituub wa Alifaa'al min martah Huchiim.
Wa awlaad Alifaa'al humman Ibaar wa Mich'aam wa Chaamid.Wa Chaamid bana hillit Uunu wa hillit Luud wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha.
Barii'a wa Chama' humman kubaaraat al-aayilaat al-saakniin fi Ayyaluun.Wa humman bas al-tarado sukkaan Gaat.
Wa awlaad Yaruuhaam humman Chamachraay wa Chaharya wa Atalya wa Ya'rachya wa Iliiya wa Zikri.
Wa kulluhum kubaaraat al-aayilaat wa ayyi waahid bigi kabiir hasab zurriiytah.Wa humman saakniin fi Uruchaliim.
Wa abu Gib'uun sakan fi hillit Gib'uun ma'a martah al-usumha Ma'aaka.
Wa wileedah al-bikir usmah Abduun wa awlaadah al-aakhariin humman Suur wa Khiich wa Ba'al wa Niir wa Nadaab
wa Gaduur wa Akhyu wa Zaakar.
Wa Mikhluut wilid Chima.Wa humman kula sakano fi Uruchaliim ma'a akhwaanhum al-min khachum beethum.
Wa Niir wilid Khiichwa Khiich wilid Chaawuulwa Chaawuul wilid Yuunataan wa Malkichuu' wa Abinadaab wa Ichba'al.
Wa Yuunataan wilid Mariiba'alwa Mariiba'al wilid Miika.
Wa awlaad Miika humman Fiituun wa Maalik wa Taara' wa Ahaaz.
Wa Ahaaz wilid Yahu'aadawa Yahu'aada wilid Alamaat wa Azmaawat wa Zimri.Wa Zimri wilid Mussa.
Wa Mussa wilid Bin'awa Bin'a wilid Raafawa Raafa wilid Al'aasawa Al'aasa wilid Asiil.
Wa Asiil wilid sitte awlaad wa humman Azrikhaam wa Bukru wa Ismaa'iil wa Cha'arya wa Ubadya wa Hanaan.Wa dool kulluhum awlaad Asiil.
Wa awlaad Ichakh akhu Asiil humman Ulaam al-bikir wa Ya'uuch al-taani wa Alifaalat al-taalit.
Wa awlaad Ulaam humman rujaal furraas wa ya'arfu yazurgu al-nuchchaab.Wa humman induhum iyaal wa iyaal al-iyaal katiir,fi l-jumla 150.Wa humman dool kulluhum ke min zurriiyit Banyaamiin.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil hasaboohum wa sajjalo usumhum fi kitaab muluuk Bani Israa'iil.Wa naas Bani Yahuuza waddoohum fi l-khurba fi balad Baabil achaan iso Allah.
Wa awwal naas al-gabbalo min al-khurba wa jo fi hillaalhum ard warasathum,humman naas min Bani Israa'iil rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah.
Wa l-naas al-jo wa sakano fi Madiinat al-Khudus,humman min gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa Afraayim wa Manassa.
Wa min gabiilat Yahuuza,ja Utaay wileed Amihuud wileed Umri wileed Imri wileed Baani min khachum beet Faaris wileed Yahuuza.
Wa min khachum beet Chiilooh,ja Asaaya wileed al-bikir hana aayiltah wa iyaalah.
Wa min khachum beet Zaarah,ja Ya'uwiil.Wa kulla l-naas al-min gabiilat Yahuuza al-sakano fi Madiinat al-Khudus,adadhum 690.
Wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin fiyahSallu wileed Machullam wileed Hudawya wileed Hasnu
wa Yibniya wileed Yaruuhaamwa Iila wileed Uzzi wileed Mikriwa Machullam wileed Chafatya wileed Ra'uwiil wileed Yibniiya.
Wa kulla l-naas al-min gabiilat Banyaamiin al-sakano fi Madiinat al-Khudus,adadhum 956.Wa kulla l-naas dool,ayyi waahid kabiir fi aayiltah.
Wa min rujaal al-diin fiyahYada'yawa Yuyaaribwa Yaakiin
wa Azarya wileed Hilkhiiya wileed Machullam wileed Saduukh wileed Marayuut wileed Akhituub wa hu mas'uul fi beet Allah
wa Adaaya wileed Yaruuhaam wileed Fachhuur wileed Malkiiyawa Ma'asaay wileed Adiyiil wileed Yahziira wileed Machullam wileed Machillimuut wileed Immiir.
Wa ma'a akhwaanhum rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin,al-naas dool kubaaraat fi aayilaathum wa adadhum 1-760 rujaal gaadriin fi khidmit beet Allah.
Wa min al-Laawiyiin fiyahChama'ya wileed Hachuub wileed Azrikhaam wileed Hachabya min zurriiyit Maraari
wa Bagbagarwa Haraachwa Galaalwa Mattanya wileed Miika wileed Zikri wileed Asaaf
wa Ubadya wileed Chama'ya wileed Galaal wileed Yaduutuunwa Barakya wileed Aasa wileed Alikhaana.Wa Alikhaana sakan fi l-hillaal al-taab'iin madiinat Natuufa.
Wa min hurraas al-biibaan fiyah Challuum al-mas'uul wa Akhuub wa Talmuun wa Akhimaan wa akhwaanhum.
Wa lahaddi l-yoom kula,zurriiyithum bas gaa'ide tahris al-baab al-sabhaani hana beet Allah al-binaaduuh baab al-Malik.Wa juduudhum bas al-zamaan hurraas hana furgaan al-Laawiyiin.
Wa Challuum hu wileed Khuuri wileed Abiyaasaf wileed Khuurah.Wa hu ma'a akhwaanah al-min zurriiyit Khuurah mas'uuliin fi khidmit hurraas madkhal kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa da misil juduudhum awwal kula hurraas fariig cha'ab Allah.
Wa zamaan Fiinhaas wileed Ali'aazar,hu bas kabiirhum wa Allah ma'aayah.
Wa Zakariiya wileed Machalaamya,hu bas al-gaa'id yahris baab kheemat al-ijtimaa'.
Wa l-rujaal al-azaloohum hurraas hana l-biibaan adadhum 212.Humman sajjaloohum min hillaalhum al-wildoohum fooghum.Wa Dawuud wa l-nabi Samuwiil humman bas al-kallafoohum be l-khidme di daayman.
Wa humman wa iyaalhum hafado khidmit hafidiin kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa haraasat biibaan beet Allah.
Wa l-hurraas dool gaa'idiin fi l-biibaan hana l-arba'a jiihe,sabaah wa kharib wa wati wa munchaakh.
Wa akhwaanhum al-gaa'idiin fi hillaalhum yaju leehum fi kulla wakit achaan yisaa'uduuhum fi l-haraasa le muddit sab'a yoom.
Wa laakin al-kubaaraat al-arba'a hana l-hurraas yagoodu daayman.Wa l-Laawiyiin dool mas'uuliin fi l-buyuut wa l-makhaazin hana beet Allah.
Humman yunuumu hawaale beet Allah achaan yahfadooh wa yaftaho al-biibaan kulli sabaah.
Wa waahidiin min al-Laawiyiin mas'uuliin fi hisaab mu'iddaat al-ibaada wakit yichiiluuhum wa yijiibuuhum.
Wa waahidiin minhum mas'uuliin fi kulla l-mu'iddaat al-mukhassasiin wa fi l-dagiig wa l-khamar wa l-dihin wa l-samukh al-mu'attar wa l-itir.
Wa laakin rujaal al-diin bas yikhalbutu al-itir.
Wa Mattitya,hu waahid min al-Laawiyiin wa hu bikir Challuum min zurriiyit Khuurah.Hu daayman mas'uul be sawwiyiin al-ka'ak.
Wa waahidiin min al-Laawiyiin al-aakhariin al-humman min zurriiyit Gahaat,humman dool mas'uuliin be sawwiyiin al-khubza al-yigaddumuuha le Allah kulli yoom sabt.
Wa kubaaraat aayilat al-Laawiyiin al-mukallafiin be khine,khattoohum fi buyuut taraf wa ma antoohum khidme aakhara achaan humman gaa'idiin yakhdumu leel wa nahaar.
Wa dool bas kubaaraat aayilat al-Laawiyiin ayyi waahid hasab zurriiytah.Wa humman saakniin fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Ya'iyiil abu Gib'uun sakan fi hillit Gib'uun ma'a martah al-usumha Ma'aaka.
Wa wileedah al-bikir usmah Abduun wa awlaadah al-aakhariin humman Suur wa Khiich wa Ba'al wa Niir wa Nadaab
wa Gaduur wa Akhyu wa Zakariiya wa Mikhluut.
Wa Mikhluut wilid Chimaam.Wa humman kula sakano fi Uruchaliim ma'a akhwaanhum al-min khachum beethum.
Wa awlaad Miika humman Fiituun wa Maalik wa Taahri'.
Wa Ahaaz wilid Ya'arawa Ya'ara wilid Alamaat wa Azmaawat wa Zimri.Wa Zimri wilid Mussa.
Wa Mussa wilid Bin'awa Bin'a wilid Rafaayawa Rafaaya wilid Al'aasawa Al'aasa wilid Asiil.
Wa Asiil wilid sitte awlaad wa humman Azrikhaam wa Bukru wa Ismaa'iil wa Cha'arya wa Ubadya wa Hanaan.Wa dool kulluhum awlaad Asiil.
Wa yoom waahid,al-Filistiyiin hajamo Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Israa'iil jaro giddaam al-Filistiyiin wa katiiriin minhum maato fi jabal Gilbuu'a.
Wa l-Filistiyiin zarroohum le Chaawuul wa iyaalah.Wa humman katalo Yuunataan wa Abinadaab wa Malkichuu',iyaal Chaawuul.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-harib bigi chadiid le Chaawuul.Wa siyaad al-nuchchaab chaafooh wa wakit hu chaafaahum,gamma yarjif giddaamhum.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le l-sabi al-chaayil leyah silaahah-:-Sill seefak wa aktulni.Achaan ma nidoor al-ma mutahhariin dool yi'azzubuuni. Laakin al-sabi aba achaan hu khaaf marra waahid.Wa khalaas Chaawuul chaal seefah wa waga' foogah wa maat.
Wa wakit al-sabi da chaaf Chaawuul maat,hu kula waga' fi seefah wa maat.
Wa be misil da,Chaawuul wa awlaadah al-talaata wa kulla aayiltah maato sawa.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil al-saakniin jamb al-waadi sim'o be haziimat Bani Israa'iil wa moot Chaawuul wa awlaadah,humman kula arrado wa khallo hillaalhum.Wa l-Filistiyiin jo wa sakano fi l-hillaal dool.
Wa ambaakir,wakit al-Filistiyiin jo fi bakaan al-duwaas le yichiilu khumaam al-maytiin,ligo Chaawuul wa awlaadah maytiin fi raas jabal Gilbuu'a.
Wa humman chaalo silaah Chaawuul wa gata'o raasah.Wa rassalo al-khabar da fi kulla balad al-Filistiyiin wa khabbaro beyah cha'abhum wa fi buyuut asnaamhum.
Wa humman khatto silaah Chaawuul fi beet ilaahaathum.Wa allago raasah fi beet ilaahhum Daguun.
Wa kulla sukkaan hillit Yaabiich fi turaab Gil'aad sim'o be kulla cheyy al-Filistiyiin sawwooh fi Chaawuul.
Khalaas kulla l-rujaal al-fahaliin gammo wa macho chaalo janaazaat Chaawuul wa awlaadah wa jaaboohum fi Yaabiich.Wa humman dafano udaamhum fi ga'ar al-chadara al-kabiire al-gaa'ide fi Yaabiich.Wa saamo sab'a yoom.
Wa Chaawuul maat achaan isi Allah wa ma taaba' kalaamah.Wa battaan hu macha sa'al naadum al-yikallim ma'a l-maytiin
wa aba ma yas'al Allah.Wa be sabab da,Allah ja'al leyah al-moot wa sallam al-muluk le Dawuud wileed Yassa.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil jo le Dawuud fi Hibruun wa gaalo leyah-:-Chiif-!Aniina min dammak wa lahamak.
Zamaan wakit Chaawuul malik,inta gaa'id tuguud deech Bani Israa'iil.Wa fi l-wakit daak bas,Allah Ilaahak gaal leek-:--Inta tabga raa'i le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa tahkim fooghum.-
Wa fi chaan da,kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil jo le Dawuud fi Hibruun wa hu sawwa ma'aahum mu'aahada giddaam Allah.Wa humman masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi Bani Israa'iil hasab kalaam Allah al-gaalah zamaan be waasitat Samuwiil.
Wa yoom waahid,Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israa'iil macho Uruchaliim.Wa fi l-wakit da,al-hille di usumha Yabuus wa l-Yabuusiyiin bas saakniin fiiha.
Wa l-Yabuusiyiin gaalo le Dawuud-:-Inta ma tagdar tadkhul fi l-hille di. Wa laakin Dawuud chaal bakaanhum al-gawi al-usmah Sahyuun.Wa be da,sammo al-bakaan da madiinat Dawuud.
Wa gubbaal ma yichiil al-bakaan da,Dawuud gaal-:-Al-naadum al-yugumm awwal wa yahjim al-Yabuusiyiin,ana nidarrijah khaayid al-deech. Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya hajamaahum awwal wa hu bigi khaayid al-deech.
Wa Dawuud sakan fi l-bakaan al-gawi da.Wa achaan da bas,sammo al-bakaan da madiinat Dawuud.
Wa hu wassa' al-hille min ayyi jiihe wa da min durdur al-difaa' al-sammooh Millu lahaddi hawaaleeha.Wa Yuwaab kamaan jaddad al-baagi hana l-hille.
Wa gudrat Dawuud gaa'ide tiziid be ziyaada achaan Allah al-Gaadir gaa'id ma'aayah.
Daahu kubaaraat furraas Dawuud al-saa'adooh marra waahid fi kulla wakit mulkah.Wa humman ma'a kulla Bani Israa'iil darrajooh malik hasab kalaam Allah fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa daahu asaame furraas Dawuud.Al-awwalaani Yachab'aam wileed naadum waahid min hillit Hakmuun wa hu khaayid majmuu'at al-talaatiin.Wa hu bas al-be haribtah katal 300 raajil fi l-duwaas fi yoom waahid.
Wa l-taani Ali'aazar wileed Duudu min hillit Akhuukh.Hu kula faaris min al-furraas al-talaata.
Wa hu bas al-macha ma'a Dawuud fi Faas Dammiim wakit al-Filistiyiin lammo le l-harib.Wa fi l-bakaan da,fiyah zere' hana gameh abyad wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil arrado min al-Filistiyiin.
Wa karaso fi lubb al-zere' wa ba'ad da,marago wa haaraboohum le l-Filistiyiin.Wa Allah anta nasur kabiir le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa yoom waahid,talaata min al-furraas al-talaatiin hana Dawuud jo ligooh le Dawuud fi karkuur Adullaam.Wa fi l-wakit da,mu'askar al-Filistiyiin gaa'id fi waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa Dawuud gaa'id fi bakaanah al-gawi.Wa l-Filistiyiin kamaan gaa'idiin fi mu'askarhum fi Beet Laham.
Wa tawwaali Dawuud atmanna wa gaal-:-Yaatu yijiib leyi almi nachrab min al-biir al-gaa'ide fi madkhal Beet Laham-?
Wa khalaas al-furraas al-talaata dool macho dakhalo fi mu'askar al-Filistiyiin,chaalo almi min al-biir al-gaa'ide fi madkhal Beet Laham,jaabooh wa antooh le Dawuud.Wa laakin hu aba ma yacharbah wa gaddamah hadiiyat charaab le Allah.
Wa gaal-:-Istakhfar Allah-!Abadan ma nisawwi cheyy misil da-!Ma nagdar nachrab min al-almi da achaan hu misil damm al-rujaal al-macho jaabooh be taman hayaathum.Aywa-!Be taman hayaathum bas humman jaabo al-almi da. Wa Dawuud aba ma yachrab al-almi da.Wa da l-cheyy al-sawwooh al-furraas al-talaata dool.
Wa Abichaay akhu Yuwaab hu bas khaayid al-talaata.Wa yoom waahid,hu bas be haribtah katal 300 raajil.Wa usmah bigi taali' ambeen al-furraas al-talaata dool.
Wa hu ligi charaf ziyaada min al-tineen wa hu bigi khaayidhum.Wa ma fi al-yufuutah ambeen al-furraas al-talaata.
Wa Banaaya al-min hillit Khabsiil,hu wileed Yahuuyada' raajil waahid fahal.Wa Banaaya da,hu zaatah fahal wa chadiid.Da hu al-katal rujaal itneen fahaliin hana balad Muwaab.Wa yoom waahid wakit al-talaj nazal,hu dakhal fi nugra wa katal duud.
Wa battaan hu bas katal Masri al-tuulah yisaawi 5 duraa' wa uud haribtah gadur murdaas al-ligdaabe.Wa Banaaya macha leyah hajamah be asa wa gala' minnah haribtah wa katalah beeha.
Wa daahu rujaal furraas aakhariin hana Dawuud.Asaahiil akhu Yuwaabwa Alihanaan wileed Duudu min Beet Laham
wa Chammuut min hillit Haruurwa Haalas min hillit Faluun
wa Iira wileed Ikheech min hillit Takhuu'awa Abi'aazar min hillit Anatuut
wa Sibbakaay min hillit Huuchawa Ilaay min hillit Akhuukh
wa Mahraay min hillit Natuufawa Khaalid wileed Ba'ana min hillit Natuufa
wa Ittaay wileed Riibaay min hillit Gibee'a min gabiilat Banyaamiinwa Banaaya min hillit Fir'atuun
wa Huuraay min waadi Ga'achwa Abiyiil min hillit Araba
wa Azmaawat min hillit Baharuumwa Aliyahba min hillit Cha'albuun
wa awlaad Haachim min hillit Gizuunwa Yuunataan wileed Chaagi min hillit Haraar
wa Akhiyaam wileed Saakar min hillit Haraarwa Alifaal wileed Uur
wa Hiifar min hillit Makiirawa Akhiiya min hillit Faluun
wa Hasru min hillit Karmalwa Na'araay wileed Azbaay.
Wa Yuwiil akhu Naataanwa Mibhaar wileed Haagri
wa Salakh al-Ammuuniwa Nahraay min hillit Biiruut hu al-chaayil silaah Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya
wa Uriiya al-Hittiwa Zabaad wileed Ahlaay
wa Adiina wileed Chiiza cheekh khachum beet Ra'uubiin wa ma'aayah 30 askar
wa Hanaan wileed Ma'aakawa Yuchaafaat min hillit Mitan
wa Uzziiya min hillit Achtaruutwa Chama' wa Ya'iyiil awlaad Huutaam min hillit Aruu'ir
wa Yadiya'iil wileed Chimri wa akhu Yuuha min hillit Tiisi
wa Aliyiil min hillit Mahawawa Yaribaay wa Yuchawya awlaad Alinaa'amwa Yitma min balad Muwaab
wa Aliyiil wa Ubeed wa Ya'siyiil min hillit Suuba.
Wa wakit Dawuud gaa'id yillabbad min Chaawuul wileed Khiich,fiyah rujaal fahaliin jo andammo leyah fi Sikhlaag.Wa humman jo saa'adooh fi l-duwaas.
Wa humman musallahiin be nubbaal wa miglaa'.Wa yizarrugu al-nuchchaab wa l-hajar be iidhum al-zeene aw al-isra kula.Wa humman min akhwaan Chaawuul min gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa l-rujaal dool hummanAkhi'aazar kabiirhum wa akhuuh Yuwaach humman awlaad Chamaa'a al-min hillit Gibee'awa Yaziyiil wa Faalat awlaad Azmaawatwa Barakawa Yaahu al-min hillit Anatuut
wa Yichma'ya al-min hillit Gib'uun hu waahid min al-furraas al-talaatiin wa hu bas khaayidhumwa Irmiya wa Yahaziyiil wa Yuuhanaan wa Yuuzabaad al-min hillit Gadiira
wa Ali'uuzaay wa Yarimuut wa Ba'alya wa Chamarya wa Chafatya al-min hillit Haruuf
wa Alikhaana wa Yichiiya wa Azariil wa Yu'aazar wa Yachab'aam humman dool min zurriiyit Khuurah
wa Yu'iila wa Zabadya awlaad Yaruuhaam al-min hillit Gaduur.
Wa fi rujaal waahidiin min gabiilat Gaad ansahabo wa macho ligooh le Dawuud fi bakaanah al-gawi fi l-kadaade.Wa l-naas dool rujaal furraas wa gaadriin fi l-harib.Wa musallahiin be darag wa huraab.Wa humman chudaad misil al-diidaan wa ajiiliin misil khazaal fi raas al-jibaal.
Wa Izaar kabiirhumwa l-taani Ubadyawa l-taalit Aliyaab
wa l-raabi' Michmannawa l-khaamis Irmiya
wa l-saadis Attaaywa l-saabi' Aliyiil
wa l-taamin Yuuhanaanwa l-taasi' Alzabad
wa l-aachir Irmiyawa l-ihdaachar Makbannaay.
Wa l-naas dool min gabiilat Gaad wa humman khuyyaad al-askar.Al-sakhayyar kula khaayid fi 100 askar wa l-kabiir kamaan khaayid fi 1-000 askar.
Wa humman bas al-gata'o bahar al-Urdun fi l-chahar al-awwal fi wakit al-seel yisiil.Wa tarado al-naas al-saakniin jamb al-waadi be nuss al-sabaah wa l-kharib.
Wa rujaal waahidiin min gabaayil Banyaamiin wa Yahuuza kula macho ligooh le Dawuud fi bakaanah al-gawi.
Wa Dawuud marag leehum wa gaal-:-Kan jiitu leyi be l-salaam le tisaa'uduuni,nifaddilku be niiye mukhlisa.Wa laakin kan intu jiitu le tukhuchchuuni le faaydit udwaani wa ana ma sawweet cheyy fasil,khalli Allah Rabb juduudna yichiif wa yihaakim ambeenaatna.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal fi Amaasaay kabiir al-furraas al-talaatiin wa hu gaal-:-Aniina ma'aak-!Aywa aniina ma'aak,ya Dawuud wileed Yassa-!Khalli al-salaam yukuun ma'aak wa ma'a l-naas al-gaa'idiin yisaa'uduuk achaan Rabbak gaa'id yisaa'idak. Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Dawuud laagaahum wa sawwaahum kubaaraat askarah.
Wa fiyah rujaal min gabiilat Manassa dawwaro yindammo le Dawuud fi wakit al-hu maachi ma'a l-Filistiyiin yihaarubu Chaawuul.Laakin Dawuud wa askarah ma gidro saa'ado al-Filistiyiin fi l-harib achaan wakit kubaaraat al-Filistiyiin lammo wa achchaawaro,taradooh le Dawuud wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Ba'adeen yigabbil diddina wa yisallimna le sayyidah Chaawuul.
Wa wakit Dawuud gabbal le hillit Sikhlaag,al-rujaal al-min gabiilat Manassa jo wa andammo leyah.Wa humman Adnaah wa Yuuzabaad wa Yadiya'iil wa Mikaayiil wa Yuuzabaad wa Aliihu wa Siltaay.Wa ayyi waahid minhum khaayid fi 1-000 raajil min gabiilat Manassa.
Wa humman saa'ado Dawuud wa askarah achaan humman rujaal furraas wa bigo khuyyaad askarah.
Wa ayyi yoom,fiyah naas al-yaju yindammo le Dawuud le yisaa'uduuh.Wa be misil da,askarah bigo katiiriin misil askar al-Rabb.
Wa daahu adad al-askar al-musallahiin al-macho wa andammo le Dawuud fi Hibruun.Wa humman macho le yisallumu muluk Chaawuul le Dawuud hasab amur Allah.
Min gabiilat Yahuuza 6-800 askar musallahiin chaayliin darag wa huraab.
Wa min gabiilat Chim'uun 7-100 askar furraas.
Wa min gabiilat Laawi 4-600 raajil
wa ma'aahum Yahuuyada' al-mas'uul fi khachum beet Haaruun wa ma'aayah 3-700 raajil.
Wa ma'aahum al-sabi Saduukh wa hu kula raajil faaris wa indah ma'aayah 22 kubaaraat min aayiltah.
Wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin gabiila hint Chaawuul 3-000 raajil.Wa gubbaal da,katiir min al-rujaal dool khadamo le aayilat Chaawuul.
Wa min gabiilat Afraayim 20-800 rujaal furraas wa usumhum taali' fi lubb aayilaathum.
Wa min nuss gabiilat Manassa 18-000 rujaal al-azaloohum le yaju yidarruju Dawuud malik.
Wa min gabiilat Yassaakar 200 khaayid ma'a l-naas al-gaa'idiin tihit amurhum.Al-khuyyaad dool ya'arfu yimayyuzu al-wakit wa ya'arfu al-cheyy al-waajib Bani Israa'iil yisawwu.
Wa min gabiilat Zabuluun 50-000 rujaal musallahiin wa jaahiziin le l-harib be niiye waahide.
Wa min gabiilat Naftaali 1-000 khaayid wa ma'aahum 37-000 rujaal musallahiin chaayliin darag wa huraab.
