Wa min gabiilat Daan 28-600 rujaal jaahiziin le l-harib.
Wa min gabiilat Achiir 40-000 rujaal jaahiziin le l-harib.
Wa min gabaayil Ra'uubiin wa Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa al-gaa'idiin khaadi le bahar al-Urdun,adadhum 120-000 rujaal musallahiin le l-harib.
Wa kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin dool,jo fi Hibruun be niiye waahide le yidarruju Dawuud malik fi Israa'iil.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil al-faddalo,humman kula be galib waahid jo le yidarruju Dawuud malik.
Wa humman ga'ado talaata yoom ma'a Dawuud wa akalo wa chirbo achaan akhwaanhum jahhazo leehum akil.
Wa kulla l-naas al-saakniin fi l-mantaga di wa zurriiyit Yassaakar wa Zabuluun wa Naftaali kula,jaabo akil be hamiir wa jumaal wa bikhaal wa tiiraan.Jaabo dagiig wa abbuud hana tiin wa inab yaabis wa khamar wa dihin wa khanam wa bagar be katara achaan induhum farha kabiire fi balad Israa'iil.
Wa Dawuud chaawar ma'a khuyyaad al-aalaaf wa ma'a khuyyaad al-miyaat wa ma'a kulla l-chuyuukh.
Wa ba'ad da,hu gaal le kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil-:-Kan tikhassudu wa kan Allah Ilaahna yarda beyah,khalli nirassulu le akhwaanna al-gaa'idiin fi kulla balad Israa'iil wa le rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-fi mudunhum wa l-fi hillaalhum al-saakniin foogah achaan yaju yilimmu ma'aana.
Wa khalaas nigabbulu sanduug al-Rabb wa nijiibuuh fi bakaanna achaan aniina ma ja'alnaah fi wakit Chaawuul.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab khassado achaan al-cheyy da ajabaahum.
Wa Dawuud lamma kulla Bani Israa'iil min waadi Masir fi l-junuub lahaddi Labu Hamaat fi l-munchaakh le yijiibu sanduug al-Rabb min hillit Kharyat Ya'ariim.
Wa Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israa'iil macho le Ba'la ya'ni Kharyat Ya'ariim hille waahide fi balad Yahuuza achaan yijiibu min hinaak sanduug al-Rabb.Wa da l-sanduug al-foogah usum Allah,hu al-archah gaa'id been al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin al-masnuu'iin fi sidaadit al-sanduug.
Wa humman chaalo sanduug al-Rabb min beet Abinadaab wa khattooh fi kaarro jadiid.Wa awlaad Abinadaab,Uzza wa Akhyu gaadooh wa macho beyah.
Wa Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yal'abo giddaam sanduug al-Rabb be kulla gudrithum wa yikhannu fi hiss aalaat al-musiikha misil jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa tambal wa nuggaara wa burunji.
Wa wakit wassalo fi l-madagg hana Kiiduun,al-bagar attarta'o wa Uzza madda iidah le yakrub al-sanduug.
Wa tawwaali Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Uzza wa tawwaali darabah achaan hu madda iidah wa karab al-sanduug.Wa Uzza waga' maat hinaak giddaam al-Rabb.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Dawuud khaaf khoof chadiid min al-Rabb wa gaal-:-Ana ma nagdar nijiib sanduug al-Rabb fi beeti.
Wa fi chaan da,Dawuud ma wadda al-sanduug fi beetah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa laakin waddaah fi beet Ubeed Adoom al-min hillit Gaat.
Wa sanduug al-Rabb ga'ad talaata chahar fi beet Ubeed Adoom.Wa Allah baarak beet Ubeed Adoom wa kulla cheyy al-indah.
Wa Hiiraam malik balad Suur rassal naas le Dawuud wa waddo leyah hatab al-arz.Wa rassal bannaayiin wa najjaariin al-hatab le yabnu beet le l-malik Dawuud.
Wa be da,Dawuud irif kadar Allah sabbatah malik fi Bani Israa'iil.Wa Allah rafa' darajat mulkah fi chaan cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Dawuud akhad awiin aakharaat fi Uruchaliim wa hinna wildan leyah awlaad wa banaat.
Wa daahu asaame hana iyaal Dawuud al-wildoohum leyah fi Uruchaliim.Humman Chammuu' wa Chuubaab wa Naataan wa Suleymaan
wa Yibhaar wa Alichuu' wa Alfalat
wa Nuga wa Nafag wa Yafii'a
wa Alichama' wa Ba'liyaada' wa Alifaalat.
Wa wakit al-Filistiyiin sim'o kadar Dawuud masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi kulla Bani Israa'iil,kulluhum gammo macho le yifattuchuuh.Wa laakin Dawuud simi' beehum wa macha le yiwajjihhum.
Wa l-Filistiyiin macho wa hajamo sukkaan fi waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa Dawuud sa'al al-Rabb wa gaal-:-Namchi nihaarib al-Filistiyiin walla-?Inta tisallimhum fi iidi walla-? Wa Allah radda le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Amchi haaribhum wa ana nisallimhum fi iidak.
Wa l-Filistiyiin macho hillit Ba'al Faraasiim wa Dawuud haarabaahum hinaak wa annasar fooghum.Wa gaal-:-Be iidi ana,al-Rabb fatah al-derib wa darabt udwaani misil al-seel. Wa be sabab da bas,al-bakaan da sammooh Ba'al Faraasiim (ma'anaatah al-Rabb al-darab).
Wa l-Filistiyiin khallo asnaamhum fi l-bakaan da wa Dawuud anta amur achaan yutuchchuuhum.
Wa battaan al-Filistiyiin macho wa hajamo sukkaan waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa battaan Dawuud sa'al al-Rabb.Wa l-Rabb gaal leyah-:-Ma tamchi tahjimhum tawwaali laakin hawwig leehum be wara min jiihat al-chadar wa garrib leehum.
Wa wakit inta simi't haraka misil khatwaat al-rijil fi raas al-chadar,tawwaali amrug wa ahjimhum.Achaan al-Rabb macha giddaamak le yadrub askar al-Filistiyiin.
Wa Dawuud sawwa kulla cheyy al-amarah beyah al-Rabb.Wa khalaas,humman haarabo askar al-Filistiyiin wa taradoohum min hillit Gib'uun lahaddi hillit Gaazar.
Wa min al-yoom da,Dawuud usmah bigi taali' fi kulla l-buldaan.Wa Allah sawwa kulla l-umam yakhaafo min Dawuud.
Wa Dawuud bana buyuut le nafsah fi hillitah al-usumha madiinat Dawuud.Wa jahhaz bakaan le sanduug al-Rabb wa bana leyah kheema.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud gaal-:-Sanduug al-Rabb naadum ma yichiilah illa l-Laawiyiin bas yichiiluuh achaan humman bas Allah azalaahum le yichiilu sanduug Allah wa yakhdumu leyah ila l-abad.
Wa Dawuud lamma kulla Bani Israa'iil fi Uruchaliim le yiwaddu sanduug Allah fi l-bakaan al-hu jahhazah leyah.
Wa hu lamma rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Haaruun wa l-Laawiyiin.
Min zurriiyit Gahaat cheekhhum Uriyiil wa ma'aayah naasah adadhum 120.
Wa min zurriiyit Maraari cheekhhum Asaaya wa ma'aayah naasah adadhum 220.
Wa min zurriiyit Girchuun cheekhhum Yuwiil wa ma'aayah naasah adadhum 130.
Wa min zurriiyit Alisaafan cheekhhum Chama'ya wa ma'aayah naasah adadhum 200.
Wa min zurriiyit Habruun cheekhhum Aliyiil wa ma'aayah naasah adadhum 80.
Wa min zurriiyit Uzziyiil cheekhhum Aminadaab wa ma'aayah naasah adadhum 112.
Wa Dawuud naada rujaal al-diin Saduukh wa Abiyaatar wa naada al-Laawiyiin Uriyiil wa Asaaya wa Yuwiil wa Chama'ya wa Aliyiil wa Aminadaab.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Intu,ya kubaaraat aayilaat al-Laawiyiin,khassusu nufuusku intu wa akhwaanku.Wa chiilu sanduug Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil wa wadduuh fi l-bakaan al-ana jahhaztah leyah.
Achaan awwal wakit intu ma fiiku,Allah Ilaahna darabaana be sabab aniina ma tabbagna al-churuut al-bukhussu sanduug al-mu'aahada.
Wa khalaas rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin khassaso nufuushum achaan yichiilu wa yiwaddu sanduug Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-Laawiyiin chaalo sanduug al-Rabb be l-iidaan fi kataafeehum misil Muusa amar beyah hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa Dawuud amar kubaaraat al-Laawiyiin yikallufu akhwaanhum al-khannaayiin be aalaat al-musiikha misil al-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l-nuggaara.Wa yista'malo al-aalaat dool be chidde achaan yiwassufu farahhum.
Wa khalaas kubaaraat al-Laawiyiin kallafo Heemaan wileed Yuwiil wa gariibah Asaaf wileed Barakya wa Itaan wileed Khuchaaya al-hu min zurriiyit Maraari.
Wa ma'aahum akhwaanhum Laawiyiin aakhariin hurraas biibaan beet Allah.Wa humman Zakariiya wa Been wa Ya'aziyiil wa Chamiiramuut wa Yahiyiil wa Unni wa Aliyaab wa Banaaya wa Ma'asiiya wa Mattitya wa Alifaliihu wa Mikhniya wa Ubeed Adoom wa Ya'iyiil.
Wa l-khannaayiin Heemaan wa Asaaf wa Itaan induhum nagaagiir hana nahaas al-yadurbuuhum.
Wa Zakariiya wa Aziyiil wa Chamiiramuut wa Yahiyiil wa Unni wa Aliyaab wa Ma'asiiya wa Banaaya humman dool yadurbu al-jigindiiye be soot aali.
Wa Mattitya wa Alifaliihu wa Mikhniya wa Ubeed Adoom wa Ya'iyiil wa Azazya humman dool yadurbu al-jigindiiye al-indaha tamaane habil le yuguudu al-khine.
Wa Kananya kabiir al-Laawiyiin,hu bas mas'uul be cheeliin al-sanduug.Wa hu yiraakhib al-cheeliin achaan hu ya'arif kikkeef yisawwiih.
Wa Barakya wa Alikhaana humman hurraas al-sanduug.
Wa Ubeed Adoom wa Yahiya humman kula hurraas al-sanduug.Wa rujaal al-diin Chabanya wa Yuchaafaat wa Nataniil wa Amaasaay wa Zakariiya wa Banaaya wa Ali'aazar,humman yadurbu al-burunji giddaam sanduug al-Rabb.
Wa khalaas,be farha chadiide Dawuud wa chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil wa khuyyaad al-aalaaf macho achaan yijiibu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah min beet Ubeed Adoom.
Wa be musaa'adat al-Rabb,al-Laawiyiin chaalo al-sanduug.Wa gaddamo dahaaya le Allah hana sab'a toor wa sab'a kabich.
Wa Dawuud ma'a kulla l-Laawiyiin al-chaayliin al-sanduug wa l-khannaayiin wa Kananya al-mas'uul hana l-cheeliin,humman kulluhum laabsiin jalaaliib hana gumaach sameh.Wa Dawuud kamaan laabis khalag gisayyir misil hana rujaal al-diin.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil waddo sanduug mu'aahadat Allah fi Uruchaliim be zakhraat wa daribiin buug wa burunji wa nuggaara wa be daribiin amsibeybe wa jigindiiye.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yijiibu al-sanduug fi madiinat Dawuud,Mikaal bineeyit Chaawuul gaa'ide tichiif min al-chubbaak.Wa chaafat al-malik Dawuud gaa'id yal'ab wa yinattit.Wa khalaas hi abatah min galibha.
Wa humman jaabo sanduug al-Rabb wa khattooh fi lubb al-kheema al-Dawuud jahhazaaha leyah.Wa ba'ad da,gaddamo le l-Rabb dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.
Wa wakit Dawuud gaddam al-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa dahaaya al-salaama dool khalaas,hu baarak al-cha'ab be usum Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud gassam akil le kulla Bani Israa'iil,mara wa raajil.Le ayyi waahid antaah khubza wa abbuud hana tamur wa abbuud hana inab.
Wa Dawuud kallaf waahidiin min al-Laawiyiin yagoodu giddaam sanduug Allah le yachkuru wa yahmudu wa yimajjudu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-Laawiyiin dool kabiirhum Asaaf wa naaybah Zakariiya wa ma'aahum Ya'iyiil wa Chamiiramuut wa Yahiyiil wa Mattitya wa Aliyaab wa Banaaya wa Ubeed Adoom wa Ya'iyiil.Humman dool gaa'idiin yadurbu aalaat al-musiikha misil al-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa Asaaf kamaan gaa'id yadrub al-nuggaara.
Wa rujaal al-diin Banaaya wa Yahaziyiil gaa'idiin yadurbu daayman al-burunji giddaam sanduug mu'aahadat al-Rabb.
Wa l-yoom da,awwal marra Dawuud kallaf Asaaf wa l-Laawiyiin al-aakhariin le yachkuru Allah.
Wa daahu khineehum.Achkuru Allah wa atru usmah-!Wa arrufu al-chu'uub al-aakhariin be a'maalah.
Khannu leyah wa amdahoohwa fakkuru fi kulla ajaaybah.
Anbastu achaan usmah al-mukhaddaswa khalli guluubku yinmalu be farahintu al-gaa'idiin titaabu'u Allah.
Fattuchu Allah wa gudurtahwa wajjuhu aleyah daayman
Azzakkaro ajaaybah al-sawwaahum,aywa,ajaaybah wa gawaaniinah al-amar beehum.
Intu,ya zurriiyit Israa'iil,intu abiidah.Intu,ya iyaal Yaakhuub,intu al-Allah azalaaku.
Allah hu bas Ilaahnaal-yahkim fi kulla l-ard.
Azzakkaro daayman mu'aahadatahwa kalaamah al-amar beyah le alif zurriiye.
Wa di mu'aahadatah al-sawwaaha ma'a Ibraahiimwa akkadha be haliife le Ishaakh.
Hu sabbat chart le zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa sawwa mu'aahada daayme ma'a Bani Israa'iil.
Wa gaal-:-Ana nantiiku balad Kan'aanwa da gisim al-talgooh misil warasa.
Wa fi l-zaman da,adadku chiyya,intu chiyya marra waahidwa saakniin fi l-balad di misil ajaanib.
Intu raaykhiin min umma le ummawa min mamlaka le cha'ab aakhar.
Laakin Allah ma khalla naadum yazlumkuwa aakhab muluuk fi chaanku.
Wa gaal-:-Ma tilammusu al-naasal-ana masahtuhum wa darrajtuhumwa ma tisawwu al-fasaala le anbiyaayi.
Ya sukkaan al-ard,achkuru Allah be khinewa kulla yoom bachchuru be najaatah.
Hajju be majdah le kulla l-umamwa be ajaaybah le kulla l-chu'uub.
Achaan Allah aziimwa waajib leyah al-hamd al-katiir.Hu mukhiif ziyaadawa faayit kulla l-ilaahaat.
Achaan kulla ilaahaat al-chu'uub ma naaf'iinwa laakin Allah hu bas khalag al-samaawaat.
Al-majd wa l-azama hineeyahwa fi bakaanah tinlagi al-gudra wa l-farha.
Majjudu Allah,ya gabaayil al-ard-!Majjudu Allahachaan hu al-Majiid wa l-Gaadir.
Majjudu Allahachaan usmah al-Majiid-!Gaddumu hadaayaaku giddaamahwa asjudu leyah achaan hu al-Khudduus.
Arjufu giddaamah,ya kulla sukkaan al-ard.Al-aalam yagood saabit,ma yinhazza.
Khalli al-sama tinbasit wa l-ard tafrahwa yuguulu fi ust al-umam-:-Allah hu al-malik.
Khalli al-bahar yidagdigbe kulla cheyy al-fi lubbah.Wa khalli al-kadaade tafrahbe kulla cheyy al-foogha.
Wa khalli chadar al-khaaba yizakhrutugiddaam Allahachaan Allah yajiyahkim al-ard.
Achkuru Allah achaan hu rahiimwa rahmatah daayme ila l-abad.
Wa guulu leyah-:-Ya Ilaah al-naja,najjiina-!Ajma'na wa najjiina min ust al-umam.Wa be da,nahmudu usmak al-mukhaddaswa nimajjuduuk wa nachkuruuk.
Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iilmin zamaan wa ila l-abad.Wa kulla l-cha'ab gaalo-:-Aamiin-! Wa chakaro Allah.
Wa Dawuud amar Asaaf wa akhwaanah yagoodu giddaam sanduug mu'aahadat Allah achaan yisawwu khidmithum al-waajib hasab al-churuut al-yoomi.
Wa Ubeed Adoom wileed Yaduutuun wa Huusa wa 68 min akhwaanhum humman hurraas biibaan beet Allah.
Wa Dawuud wakkal Saduukh raajil al-diin wa rujaal diin aakhariin al-min aayiltah be khidmit kheemat Allah al-gaa'ide fi bakaan al-ibaada fi Gib'uun.
Wa yigaddumu dahiiye muharraga le Allah ayyi yoom,fajur wa achiiye,fi l-madbah hana l-dahaaya.Wa da le yitabbugu kulla cheyy al-maktuub fi kitaab al-Tawraat al-Allah amar beyah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ma'aahum Heemaan wa Yaduutuun wa l-naas al-aakhariin al-azaloohum khaassatan le yachkuru Allah achaan rahmatah daayme ila l-abad.
Wa Heemaan wa Yaduutuun humman dool yadurbu al-burunji wa l-nuggaara wa aalaat al-musiikha le yachkuru al-Rabb be khine.Wa awlaad Yaduutuun kamaan yaharsu al-baab.
Wa ba'ad da,khalaas kulla l-cha'ab chatto wa ayyi waahid macha beetah.Wa Dawuud gabbal beetah le yibaarik aayiltah.
Wa wakit Dawuud saakin fi beetah,yoom waahid gaal le l-nabi Naataan-:-Chiif,ana saakin fi beet jamiil hana hatab al-arz.Wa laakin sanduug mu'aahadat Allah gaa'id fi kheema bas.
Wa Naataan radda le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Sawwi kulla cheyy al-fi galbak achaan al-Rabb ma'aak.
Wa laakin fi l-leele di,al-Rabb kallam le Naataan wa gaal-:
Amchi guul le abdi Dawuud-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Da ma inta al-tabni leyi beet al-ana naskun foogah.
Achaan ana abadan ma sakant fi beet min yoom al-ana maragt Bani Israa'iil min Masir lahaddi l-yoom.Wa laakin ana sirt ma'aahum wa sakant fi kheema.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan,ana sirt ma'a kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa ana abadan ma kallamt le waahid min hukkaam Bani Israa'iil al-ana amartuhum le yahkumu foog cha'abi walla sa'altah maala ma banaah leyi beet hana hatab al-arz"-?--
Wa hassa' da,amchi guul le abdi Dawuud-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:"Ana jibtak min sarhit al-khanam achaan tabga kabiir hana cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana kunt ma'aak fi ayyi bakaan al-inta macheet foogah wa gachcheet kulla udwaanak min giddaamak.Wa ana nisawwi usmak aali misil asaame hana l-naas al-kubaar al-fi l-ard.
Wa ana nanti bakaan le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa nimakkinhum.Wa humman yaskunu fi l-bakaan da bala khoof.Wa naas fasliin ma yazulmuuhum battaan misil awwal.
Wa min wakit al-ana kallaft hukkaam fi cha'abi Bani Israa'iil,ana najjeetak min kulla udwaanak.Wa nikhabbirak kadar ana Allah nisabbit beet aayiltak.
Wa wakit ayyaamak yikammulu,tumuut wa talhag abbahaatak.Wa ana na'azil waahid min zurriiytak wa hu yabga waahid min awlaadak wa ana nisabbit mulkah.
Wa hu bas al-yabni leyi beet wa ana nisabbit mulkah ila l-abad.
Wa ana nabga leyah abu wa hu yabga leyi ibn.Wa ma nichiil minnah rahmati misil chiltaha min Chaawuul al-hakam gablak.
Wa ana nisabbitah fi beeti wa fi mamlakati ila l-abad wa mulkah kula yasbit ila l-abad."-
Wa l-malik Dawuud dakhal fi l-kheema fi hadarat Allah wa gaal-:-Ana yaatu,ya Allah Ilaahi-?Wa aayilti tisaawi chunu lahaddi tantiini daraja misil di-?
Wa da cheyy hayyiin saakit leek inta,ya Ilaahi,wa inta aahadt aayilat beeti ana abdak fi l-mustakhbal.Wa sawweetni naadum muhimm,ya Allah Ilaahi.
Wa inta ta'arifni tamaam ana abdak.Wa nagdar nuguul chunu battaan fi l-daraja al-anteetni-?
Ya Allah-!Be sababi ana abdak wa hasab niiytak,inta sawweet leyi al-achya al-kubaar dool le ti'arrif kulla azamatak.
Ya Allah-!Inta ma indak chabiih wa abadan ma fi ilaah illa inta.Wa da hasab kulla l-kalaam al-simi'naah.
Fiyah umma fi kulla l-ard misil cha'abak Bani Israa'iil walla-?Ya Rabb,inta fadeethum wa sawweethum cha'abak achaan usmak yabga aali.Wa inta sawweet ajaayib kubaar al-bikhawwufu.Wa taradt al-umam al-aakhariin giddaam cha'abak al-inta fadeethum min balad Masir.
Wa sawweet cha'abak Bani Israa'iil le yabgo cha'abak daayman.Ya Allah,inta bigiit leehum Ilaahhum.
Wa hassa' da,ya Allah,al-kalaam al-gultah foogi ana abdak wa foog aayilti da,khalli yilhaggag ila l-abad.Wa tammim kulla cheyy al-gultah.
Wa khalli kalaamak yilhaggag wa be da,yimajjudu usmak ila l-abad wa yuguulu-:--Allah al-Gaadir,hu bas Ilaah Bani Israa'iil-!- Wa khalli beeti ana abdak Dawuud yagood saabit giddaamak.
Achaan inta zaatak,ya Ilaahi,khabbartini ana abdak wa gult leyi-:--Nisabbit beet aayiltak fi l-muluk.- Wa fi chaan da,ana abdak ligiit al-chajaa'a wa gaddamt leek al-sala di.
Wa hassa' da,ya Allah,inta bas al-Rabb wa aahadtini ana abdak be kulla l-kheer da.
Wa khalaas hassa' da,inta chilt niiye tibaarik aayilti ana abdak le yamulku giddaamak ila l-abad.Ya Allah,al-naadum inta bas baaraktah,hu yalga baraka ila l-abad.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud haarab al-Filistiyiin wa annasar fooghum.Wa gala' minhum hillit Gaat wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha.
Wa hu annasar fi naas Muwaab.Wa ba'ad da,naas balad Muwaab ga'ado tihit hukum Dawuud wa yikaffu miiri.
Wa Dawuud annasar fi Hadad'aazar malik Suuba al-fi Hamaat.Wa da,fi l-wakit al-Hadad'aazar dawwar yiwassi' hukmah lahaddi mantagat bahar al-Furaat.
Wa Dawuud gala' min Hadad'aazar 1-000 arabaat harib wa karab 7-000 masaajiin min siyaad al-kheel wa 20-000 askar maachiin be rijleehum.Wa hu gatta' araagiib hana l-kheel al-yukurru al-arabaat wa khalla minhum illa 100 kheel.
Wa naas balad Araam al-min Dimachkh jo faza' le Hadad'aazar malik Suuba.Wa laakin Dawuud katal min naas Araam 22-000 raajil.
Wa Dawuud gala' darag hana dahab min hurraas Hadad'aazar wa waddaahum Uruchaliim.
Wa min Tibha wa Kuun hillaal Hadad'aazar,Dawuud gala' nahaas katiir.Wa ba'adeen,wileedah Suleymaan sana' be l-nahaas da hoot kabiir wa amad wa mu'iddaat hana beet Allah.
Wa Tuu'i malik balad Hamaat simi' kadar Dawuud annasar fi kulla askar Hadad'aazar malik Suuba.
Khalaas rassal wileedah Haduraam le yisallimah wa yachkurah achaan Dawuud haarab Hadad'aazar wa annasar foogah.Wa gubbaal da,Tuu'i wa Hadad'aazar humman udwaan.Wa Haduraam wileed Tuu'i jaab le Dawuud mu'iddaat katiiriin hana dahab wa fudda wa nahaas.
Wa l-mu'iddaat al-jaabaahum leyah dool,Dawuud khassasaahum le Allah.Wa da misil awwal kula,hu khassas le Allah al-fudda wa l-dahab al-chaalaahum min al-umam,min al-Adoomiyiin wa l-Muwaabiyiin wa Bani Ammuun wa l-Filistiyiin wa l-Amaalikh.
Wa Abichaay wileedha le Saruuya annasar fi l-Adoomiyiin wa katal minhum 18-000 raajil fi waadi al-Mileh.
Wa Dawuud khatta muhaafiziin fi balad Adoom wa kulla l-Adoomiyiin ga'ado tihit hukmah.Wa Allah yanti al-nasur le Dawuud fi ayyi bakaan al-yamchi foogah.
Wa Dawuud malak fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa hakam fi kulla cha'abah be l-hagg wa l-adaala.
Wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya,hu khaayid al-deech wa Yahuuchafat wileed Akhiluud,hu kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik.
Wa Saduukh wileed Akhituub wa Abiimalik wileed Abiyaatar,humman dool rujaal diin wa Chawcha,hu kaatib hana l-malik.
Wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada',hu mas'uul fi l-Kiritiyiin wa l-Filtiyiin wa humman dool hurraas al-malik.Wa awlaad Dawuud,humman mumassiliin al-malik.
Wa ba'ad da,Nahaach malik Bani Ammuun maat.Wa wileedah Hanuun hakam fi badalah.
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Nisawwi al-kheer le Hanuun wileed Nahaach misil al-kheer al-abuuh sawwaah leyi. Wa Dawuud rassal masaa'iilah le Hanuun achaan yikalwudu leyah fi moot abuuh.Wa humman wassalo fi balad Bani Ammuun le yikalwudu le Hanuun.
Wa laakin kubaaraat Bani Ammuun gaalo le Hanuun-:-Hal le yicharrif abuuk bas Dawuud rassal naasah achaan yikalwudu leek walla-?La,hu rassal naasah misil jawaasiis achaan yi'akkudu min al-balad wa ba'adeen yaju yichiiluuha.
Wa khalaas,Hanuun karab masaa'iil Dawuud wa zayyan duguunhum wa gatta' khulgaanhum min ale ja'abaathum.Wa ba'ad da,taradaahum.
Wa macho khabbaro Dawuud be l-ihaana al-ziyaada al-bigat fi naasah.Wa hu rassal leehum naadum le yuguul leehum-:-Agoodu fi hillit Ariiha lahaddi duguunku yugummu wa ba'ad da,ta'aalu.
Wa naas Bani Ammuun irfo kadar humman bigo makruuhiin le Dawuud.Khalaas,Hanuun wa Bani Ammuun rassalo ziyaada min 30-000 kiilo hana fudda le yijannudu leehum murtazakha min Araam been al-Nahreen wa min al-Araamiyiin al-min hillit Ma'aaka wa l-min hillit Suuba wa arabaat harib wa siyaad kheel.
Wa humman ajjaro leehum 32-000 arabaat hana harib.Wa malik Ma'aaka wa naasah kula jo wa nazalo mugaabil hillit Miidba.Wa ba'ad da,Bani Ammuun lammo wa marago min hillaalhum le l-harib.
Wa Bani Ammuun marago wa rasso le l-harib fi khachum baab hillithum.Wa laakin al-muluuk al-jo leehum faza' kamaan,ga'ado taraf fi l-khala.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuwaab gaal le Abichaay-:-Kan al-Araamiyiin khalabooni,inta taji tafza'ni.Wa kan Bani Ammuun khalabook,ana naji nafza'ak.
Wa wakit Bani Ammuun chaafo al-Araamiyiin arrado,humman kula arrado min Abichaay akhu Yuwaab wa gabbalo hillithum.Wa khalaas,Yuwaab kula gabbal Uruchaliim.
Wa laakin wakit al-Araamiyiin chaafo kadar Bani Israa'iil annasaro fooghum,gammo rassalo naas achaan yilimmu kulla l-Araamiyiin al-gaa'idiin khaadi le bahar al-Furaat.Wa fi raashum Chufak khaayid deech Hadad'aazar.
Wa wakit khabbarooh le Dawuud,hu kula lamma kulla askar Bani Israa'iil wa gata' bahar al-Urdun wa macha le yihaaribhum.Wa l-Araamiyiin kula rasso gaabalooh le Dawuud wa haarabooh.
Laakin askar al-Araamiyiin arrado min Bani Israa'iil.Wa wakit humman mu'arridiin,Dawuud wa askarah katalo 7-000 naas min siyaad arabaat al-harib wa katalo 40-000 askar.Wa katalo Chufak khaayid deech al-Araamiyiin kula.
Wa wakit kulla l-muluuk al-gaa'idiin tihit Hadad'aazar irfo kadar Bani Israa'iil annasaro fooghum,khalaas humman sawwo salaam ma'a Dawuud wa ga'ado tihit hukmah.Wa l-Araamiyiin ma dawwaro yaju yafza'o Bani Ammuun battaan.
Wa fi l-sana al-jadiide,fi l-wakit al-muluuk yamchu al-harib,Yuwaab khaayid al-deech macha dammar balad Bani Ammuun wa haasar madiinat Rabba aasimathum.Wa laakin Dawuud ga'ad fi Uruchaliim.Wa Yuwaab chaal Rabba wa dammaraaha.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud chaal al-taaj min raas Milkuum sanam Bani Ammuun.Wa l-taaj da hana dahab wa yawzin gariib 34 kiilo wa mujammal be hajar khaali.Wa khattooh fi raas Dawuud.Wa chaalo khaniime katiire min al-madiina di.
Wa Dawuud chaal naas al-madiina di wa khaddamaahum be gu khidme al-yisawwuuha be munchaar wa khaazuug hana hadiid wa faas.Wa hu sawwa misil da fi kulla hillaal Bani Ammuun.Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud wa kulla l-cha'ab gabbalo fi Uruchaliim.
Wa ba'ad da,gamma harib ma'a l-Filistiyiin fi hillit Gaazar.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Sibbakaay min hillit Huucha katal Siffaay min zurriiyit Raafa.Wa be misil da,al-Filistiyiin anhazamo.
Wa battaan al-harib bada ma'a l-Filistiyiin.Wa Alihanaan wileed Ya'iir katal Lahmi akhu Jaaluut min hillit Gaat wa uud haribtah takhiin misil murdaas al-ligdaabe.
Wa battaan kula al-harba bigat fi hillit Gaat.Wa fiyah raajil waahid tawiil wa asaabi' rijileenah wa iideenah sitte sitte wa kulluhum ke 24.Wa hu kula min zurriiyit Raafa.
Wa kulla l-rujaal dool min zurriiyit Raafa min hillit Gaat.Wa humman maato be iid Dawuud wa naasah.
Wa yoom waahid,Ibliis gamma didd Bani Israa'iil wa lazza Dawuud le yahsibhum.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud gaal le Yuwaab wa le kubaaraat al-cha'ab-:-Amchu ahsubu kulla Bani Israa'iil min turaab Daan fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sab'a fi l-wati.Wa gabbulu jiibu leyi adadhum achaan na'arfah.
Wa Yuwaab gaal-:-Khalli Allah yiziid adad al-cha'ab miya marra,ya siidi al-malik-!Al-naas dool ma kulluhum ke khaddaamiinak walla-?Wa maala inta ya siidi tidoor tisawwi al-cheyy da-?Wa maala tilizz Bani Israa'iil fi l-khata da-?
Wa laakin amur al-malik bigi chadiid bilheen fi Yuwaab.Wa khalaas,Yuwaab gamma raakh fi kulla balad Israa'iil le yahsib al-cha'ab.Wa ba'ad da,gabbal fi Uruchaliim.
Wa Yuwaab anta adad hisaab al-cha'ab le l-malik.Wa rujaal Bani Israa'iil adadhum 1-100-000 askar al-ya'arfu harb al-suyuuf wa min Bani Yahuuza kamaan 470-000.
Wa Yuwaab ma hasab al-Laawiyiin wa la gabiilat Banyaamiin achaan hu ja'al amur al-malik muharram.
Wa l-cheyy da,fasil giddaam al-Rabb wa hu aakhab Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l-Rabb-:-Ana sawweet zanib kabiir achaan hasabt al-cha'ab.Wa laakin hassa' da,akhfir leyi khataayi ana abdak.Achaan ana sawweet al-cheyy da misil naadum matmuus.
Wa Allah hajja le l-nabi Gaad al-yichiif ru'ya le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:
Amchi guul le Dawuud-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ana nigaddim leek talaata nafar hana masaayib.Wa a'azil minhum waahid wa ana ninazzilah."-
Wa khalaas,Gaad macha le Dawuud wa gaal leyah-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Hassa' a'azil al-waba al-tahmalah.
Inta tidoor talaata sana hana juu' fi baladak-?Aw tidoor tajri giddaam udwaanak wa humman yaturduuk le muddit talaata chahar-?Aw tidoor Allah yinazzil waba le muddit talaata yoom fi baladak wa malak Allah yijiib al-kharaab fi kulla balad Israa'iil-?- Hassa' da,fakkir wa ooriini al-radd al-nuguulah le Allah al-rassalaani.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Gaad-:-Ana addaayagt marra waahid.Khalli naga' fi iid Allah achaan rahmatah wasii'e.Wa khalli ma naga' fi iid insaan.
Wa khalaas,Allah nazzal waba fi Israa'iil.Wa maato 70-000 naas fi kulla balad Israa'iil.
Wa l-Rabb rassal malak fi Uruchaliim le yidammirha.Wa wakit al-malak gaa'id yidammir,Allah khalla al-fasaala al-awwal kharrar yisawwiiha.Wa gaal le l-malak al-mudammir-:-Khalaas kafa.Arfa' iidak-! Wa fi l-wakit da,malak Allah gaa'id fi madagg hana Urnaan al-Yabuusi.
Wa Dawuud rafa' raasah wa chaaf malak Allah waagif ambeen al-sama wa l-ard wa seefah masluul fi iidah wa maddaah ale Uruchaliim.Khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Dawuud wa l-chuyuukh libso khulgaan al-tooba wa waga'o be wujuuhhum fi l-ard.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l-Rabb-:-Ma ana bas amart yahsubu al-cha'ab walla-?Wa ana bas aznabt wa sawweet al-khata da.Laakin al-cha'ab dool misil khanam bas,ma sawwo cheyy-!Ya Allah Ilaahi-!Aakhibni ana wa aayilti wa laakin ma tinazzil al-waba da fi cha'abak.
Wa malak Allah gaal le Gaad-:-Amchi guul le Dawuud khalli yamchi yabni madbah le Allah fi l-madagg hana Urnaan al-Yabuusi.
Wa khalaas Dawuud macha misil gaalah leyah Gaad be usum Allah.
Wa Urnaan gaa'id yudugg al-gameh fi l-madagg.Wa wakit anlafat,chaaf al-malak.Wa awlaadah al-arba'a al-ma'aayah arrado wa allabbado.
Wa Dawuud macha le Urnaan wa wakit Urnaan chaafah,hu marag min al-madagg wa waga' fi l-ard wa sajad giddaam al-malik.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Urnaan-:-Antiini bakaan al-madagg da.Nidoor nabni foogah madbah le Allah achaan al-waba da yagiif min al-cha'ab.Antiini wa nikaffiik tamanah kaamil.
Wa Urnaan radda le Dawuud wa gaal-:-Ya siidi al-malik,chiil al-madagg wa sawwi beyah ayyi cheyy al-tidoorah.Chiif,ana nantiik al-bagar le l-dahiiye al-muharraga wa l-kaarro al-yifajjukhu beyah al-gameh yabga leek hatab wa l-gameh kamaan yabga hadiiye hana dagiig.Ana nantiik kulla l-achya dool.
Wa laakin al-malik Dawuud gaal le Urnaan-:-La,abadan-!Ana nachriih minnak wa nikaffiik tamanah kaamil.Ma nidoor nichiil khumaamak wa nigaddimah le Allah wa be da,nigaddim dahiiye al-ma nakhsar foogha.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud chara min Urnaan al-madagg be 600 jineeh hana dahab.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Dawuud bana madbah le Allah wa gaddam foogah dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa hu sa'al Allah wa Allah khibil su'aalah wa nazzal naar min al-sama le yiharrig al-dahaaya al-fi l-madbah.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah amar al-malak yidakhkhil seefah fi beetah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Dawuud irif kadar Allah radda leyah fi su'aalah fi l-madagg hana Urnaan al-Yabuusi.Wa min al-yoom da,Dawuud gaa'id yigaddim dahaaya fi l-bakaan da.
Fi l-wakit da,kheemat Allah al-Muusa banaaha fi l-sahara wa l-madbah hana l-dahaaya gaa'idiin fi bakaan al-ibaada fi Gib'uun.
Wa laakin Dawuud ma gidir macha yas'al al-Rabb hinaak achaan hu khaaf min seef malak Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud gaal-:-Al-bakaan da yabga beet Allah al-Rabb.Wa l-madbah al-Bani Israa'iil yigaddumu foogah dahaaya muharragiin.
Wa Dawuud amar yilimmu kulla l-ajaanib al-gaa'idiin fi balad Israa'iil.Wa hu kallafaahum yanguchu hujaar le yabnu beehum beet Allah.
Wa Dawuud jahhaz hadiid katiir al-yisawwu beyah masaamiir al-biibaan wa hadiid al-yirakkubu beyah al-biibaan.Wa lamma nahaas katiir al-ma yinwazin.
Wa lamma hatab al-arz kula katiir ma yinhasib achaan naas min balad Seeda wa Suur jaabo hatab al-arz le Dawuud be katara.
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Wileedi Suleymaan lissaa' sabi wa ma indah irfe.Wa laakin al-beet al-nabnuuh le Allah waajib yihajju be kubrah wa jamaalah fi kulla l-ard.Wa fi chaan da,ana zaati nijahhiz le buna al-beet da. Wa be misil da,Dawuud jahhaz khumaam katiir gabul ma yumuut.
Wa Dawuud naadaah le wileedah Suleymaan wa amarah yabni beet le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Suleymaan-:-Ya wileedi-!Zamaan ana zaati indi niiye nabni beet le Allah Ilaahi.
Wa laakin Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:--Inta daffagt damm katiir wakit al-huruub al-katiir.Inta ma tabni leyi beet achaan inta daffagt damm katiir fi l-ard giddaami.
Wa laakin tijiib wileed wa hu yabga siid al-raaha wa ana nanti leyah raaha min kulla udwaanah al-mujaawiriinah.Wa l-wileed da,yinaadu Suleymaan (ma'anaatah al-salaam).Achaan nijiib al-salaam wa l-amaan fi balad Israa'iil fi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Wa hu bas al-yabni leyi beet.Wa ana nabga leyah abu wa hu yabga leyi ibn.Wa ana nisabbit mulkah fi Israa'iil ila l-abad.-
Wa Dawuud gaal battaan-:-Hassa' da,ya wileedi,khalli Allah yukuun ma'aak.Wa be da,tanjah wa tagdar tabni beet Allah Ilaahak hasab al-kalaam al-hu gaalah foogak.
Wa khalli Allah yantiik agul wa fihim wakit yidarrijak malik fi Israa'iil.Wa be da,tagdar tahfad wasaaya Allah Ilaahak.
Aywa,inta tanjah kan tahfad al-gawaaniin wa l-churuut al-Allah amar beehum Muusa le Bani Israa'iil.Abga chadiid wa fahal,ma takhaaf wa la tinbahit.
Chiif be ta'ab ana jahhazt le buna beet Allah ziyaada min 3 malyuun kiilo hana dahab wa ziyaada min 30 malyuun kiilo hana fudda.Wa lammeet nahaas wa hadiid katiir ma yinwazin.Wa ana jahhazt al-khachab wa l-hajar wa inta tiziid foogah battaan.
Wa inta talga khaddaamiin katiiriin wa naggaachiin al-hajar wa najjaariin al-hatab.Wa talga battaan naas al-induhum khibra fi ayyi khidme.
Wa hassa' indak al-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-nahaas wa l-hadiid bala adad.Gumm wa akhdim-!Allah ma'aak.
Wa Dawuud amar kulla masaa'iil Bani Israa'iil yisaa'udu wileedah Suleymaan.
Wa gaal le l-masaa'iil-:-Allah Ilaahku ma yukuun ma'aaku walla-?Wa ma antaaku al-raaha min kulli jiihe-?Achaan Allah sallam leyi kulla sukkaan al-balad di fi iideeni.Wa hassa' hi gaa'ide tihit Allah wa cha'abah.
Hassa' da,gummu be kulla guluubku wa gudritku le titaabu'u Allah Ilaahku.Gummu wa abnu beet mukhaddas le Allah Ilaahku le tijiibu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wa l-mu'iddaat al-mukhassasiin le Allah fi l-beet al-tabnuuh leyah.
Wa wakit Dawuud bigi chaayib marra waahid wa chibi' min al-dunya,darraj wileedah Suleymaan malik fi Israa'iil.
Wa lamma kulla kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin.
Wa hasabo al-Laawiyiin al-umurhum 30 sana wa foog wa adadhum bigi 38-000 raajil.
Wa Dawuud khatta minhum 24-000 le yuguudu al-khidme hana beet Allah wa 6-000 kamaan muraakhibiin wa hukkaam.
Wa khatta 4-000 haraasa al-yaharsu al-biibaan wa 4-000 le yachkuru Allah be aalaat al-musiikha al-hu sawwaahum le yachkuru beehum.
Wa Dawuud gassam al-Laawiyiin be majmuu'aat ale hasab iyaal Laawi wa humman Girchuun wa Gahaat wa Maraari.
Wa awlaad Girchuun humman La'daan wa Chim'i.
Wa awlaad La'daan humman talaata,al-kabiir Yahiyiil wa Zitaam wa Yuwiil.
Wa Chim'i kula indah talaata awlaad wa humman Chaluumit wa Haziyiil wa Harraan.Humman dool kubaaraat aayilat La'daan.
Wa Chim'i indah arba'a awlaad aakhariin wa humman Yahat wa Ziina wa Ya'uuch wa Barii'a.
Wa Yahat hu bas al-kabiir wa Ziiza al-taani.Wa laakin Ya'uuch wa Barii'a ma jaabo awlaad katiir wa be da,humman lammo wa bigo aayila waahide achaan yisawwu khidme waahide.
Wa Gahaat indah arba'a awlaad wa humman Amraam wa Yishaar wa Habruun wa Uzziyiil.
Wa awlaad Amraam humman Haaruun wa Muusa.Wa Haaruun azalooh hu wa iyaalah le yabgo mukhassasiin wa yisawwi khidmit Allah fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid,ila l-abad.Wa yiharrugu bakhuur giddaam Allah wa yisawwu khidmit Allah wa yibaaruku al-naas be usum Allah ila l-abad.
Wa Muusa hu abd Allah,iyaalah hasaboohum ma'a gabiilat Laawi.
Wa awlaad Muusa humman Girchuum wa Ali'aazar.
Wa min awlaad Girchuum,Chabuwiil al-kabiir.
Wa Ali'aazar wilid wileed waahid bas wa hu Rahabya wa hu mas'uul.Wa Rahabya wilid iyaal katiiriin marra waahid.
Wa min awlaad Yishaar,Chaluumit al-kabiir.
Wa awlaad Habruun humman Yariiya al-kabiir wa Amarya al-taani wa Yahaziyiil al-taalit wa Yakhma'aam al-raabi'.
Wa awlaad Uzziyiil humman Miika al-kabiir wa Yichiiya al-taani.
Wa awlaad Maraari humman Mahli wa Muuchi.Wa awlaad Mahli humman Ali'aazar wa Khiich.
Wa Ali'aazar maat ma indah wileed.Wa laakin indah banaat wa akhwaanhum iyaal immuhum Khiich akhadoohum.
Wa Muuchi wilid awlaad talaata wa humman Mahli wa Idar wa Yarimuut.
Wa kulla l-naas dool min gabiilat Laawi wa ayyi waahid kabiir fi aayiltah.Wa hasaboohum waahid be waahid wa asaameehum maktuubiin fi l-daftar.Wa min umur hana 20 sana wa foog,humman mukallafiin be khidmit beet Allah.
Achaan Dawuud gaal-:-Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil anta al-raaha le cha'abah.Wa hassa',hu yaskun ila l-abad fi Uruchaliim.
Wa be misil da,al-Laawiyiin ma yangulu battaan kheemat al-ibaada wa kulla mu'iddaat al-khidme.
Wa hasab al-kalaam al-aakhir hana Dawuud,al-Laawiyiin hasaboohum min umur 20 sana wa foog.
Wa l-Laawiyiin gaa'idiin tihit zurriiyit Haaruun fi khidmit beet Allah.Wa l-Laawiyiin humman mukallafiin be l-fadaay wa l-khuraf wa tihaarat kulla achya al-mukhaddasiin.Wa yakhdumu fi khidmit beet Allah.
Wa yijahhuzu al-khubza al-yigaddumuuha le Allah wa l-hadaaya hana l-dagiig wa l-khubza bala tawwaara wa l-ka'ak al-sallalo be dihin wa ka'ak aakhar.Wa battaan yifakkuru fi l-miizaan al-yikiilu wa l-yigaawusu beyah.
Wa l-mukallafiin dool yahdaro kulli sabaah wa kulli achiiye le yahmudu wa yachkuru Allah.
Wa yigaddumu le Allah kulla l-dahaaya al-muharragiin hana kulli yoom al-sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa kulli iid.Wa da hasab al-adad al-muhaddad leehum fi l-charii'a al-humman taab'iin leeha daayman giddaam Allah.
Wa yahfado kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa l-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa yisaa'udu akhwaanhum zurriiyit Haaruun fi khidmit beet Allah.
Wa gassamo zurriiyit Haaruun fi majmuu'aat.Wa awlaad Haaruun humman Nadaab wa Abiihu wa Ali'aazar wa Itamaar.
Wa Nadaab wa Abiihu maato gubbaal abuuhum wa ma jaabo awlaad.Wa fi chaan da,khidmit rujaal al-diin kallafo beeha Ali'aazar wa Itamaar.
Wa be musaa'adat Saduukh al-min zurriiyit Ali'aazar wa Akhiimalik al-min zurriiyit Itamaar,Dawuud gassam zurriiyit Haaruun fi majmuu'aat hasab khidmithum al-kallafoohum beeha.
Wa laakin zurriiyit Ali'aazar indaha rujaal ziyaada min zurriiyit Itamaar.Wa achaan da bas,gassamo zurriiyit Ali'aazar ale 16 majmuu'a wa zurriiyit Itamaar ale 8 majmuu'a.Wa ayyi majmuu'a indaha kabiir aayilitha.
Wa l-gassimiin da bigi be am'iyeedaat.Wa da,achaan kubaaraat hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa kubaaraat al-Rabb binlagu fi zurriiyit Ali'aazar wa zurriiyit Itamaar kula.
Wa Chama'ya wileed Nataniil hu al-kaatib min al-Laawiyiin.Wa hu katab asaameehum giddaam al-malik wa giddaam al-kubaaraat wa giddaam Saduukh raajil al-diin wa giddaam Akhiimalik wileed Abiyaatar wa giddaam kubaaraat aayilaat rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin.Wa kan le gabiilat Ali'aazar,yisawwu am'iyeedaat marrateen wa ba'ad da,le gabiilat Itamaar,yisawwuuha marra waahide bas.
Wa daahu asaame kubaaraat al-majmuu'aat al-azaloohum be am'iyeedaat.Wa l-am'iyeedaat al-awwal waga'at le Yuyaaribwa l-taani le Yada'ya
wa l-taalit le Hariimwa l-raabi' le Sa'uriim
wa l-khaamis le Malkiiyawa l-saadis le Miyaamiin
wa l-saabi' le Hagguuswa l-taamin le Abiiya
wa l-taasi' le Yachuu'wa l-aachir le Chakanya
wa l-ihdaachar le Alyaachibwa l-atnaachar le Yakhiim
wa l-talaataachar le Huffawa l-arba'taachar le Yachbaab
wa l-khamistaachar le Bilgawa l-sittaachar le Immiir
wa l-saba'taachar le Hiziirwa l-tamaantaachar le Hafisiis
wa l-tisa'taachar le Fatahyawa l-ichriin le Hizgiyaal
wa l-waahid wa ichriin le Yaakiinwa l-itneen wa ichriin le Gaamuul
wa l-talaata wa ichriin le Dalaayawa l-arba'a wa ichriin le Ma'azya.
Wa be misil da,al-majmuu'aat dool kallafoohum be khidmithum fi beet Allah.Wa da,hasab al-churuut al-antaahum leehum jidduhum Haaruun misil Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil amarah beyah.
Wa daahu kubaaraat min zurriiyit al-Laawiyiin al-faddalo.Min awlaad Amraam,Chubayiilwa min awlaad Chubayiil,Yahadya.
Wa min zurriiyit Rahabya,Yichiiya hu al-kabiir fi aayiltah.
Wa min zurriiyit Yishaar,Chalumuutwa min awlaad Chalumuut,Yahat.
Wa awlaad Hibruun,humman Yariiya al-awwal wa Amarya al-taani wa Yahaziyiil al-taalit wa Yakhma'aam al-raabi'.
Wa wileed Uzziyiil hu Miika wa min awlaad Miika,Chamiir.
Wa akhu Miika hu Yichiiya wa min awlaad Yichiiya,Zakariiya.
Wa awlaad Maraari humman Mahli wa Muuchi wa Ya'aziiya.
Wa iyaal iyaalah le Maraari al-min wileedah Ya'aziiya humman Chuham wa Zakkuur wa Ibri.
Wa min Mahli,Ali'aazar al-ma jaab awlaad.
Wa min Khiich,Yarhamiil.
Wa awlaad Muuchi humman Mahli wa Idar wa Yarimuut.Wa kulla l-naas dool min zurriiyit Laawi wa ayyi waahid kabiir fi aayiltah.
Wa misil akhwaanhum min zurriiyit Haaruun,humman kula sawwo am'iyeedaat giddaam al-malik Dawuud wa Saduukh wa Akhiimalik wa kubaaraat aayilaat rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin.Wa humman sawwo misil da,sawa sawa le kulla l-aayilaat kan hana akhu kabiir walla akhu sakhayyar kula.
Wa be musaa'adat kubaaraat beet al-ibaada,Dawuud azal zurriiyit Asaaf wa Heemaan wa Yaduutuun al-yikhannu be kalaam Allah be aalaat al-musiikha misil amsibeybe wa l-jigindiiye wa l-nuggaara.Wa daahu al-naas al-sajjaloohum wa kallafoohum be l-khidme di.
Min awlaad Asaaf,Zakkuur wa Yuusuf wa Natanya wa Asariila.Wa humman gaa'idiin tihit muraakhabat abuuhum Asaaf al-yikhanni be kalaam Allah hasab amur al-malik.
Min iyaal Yaduutuun,Gadaalya wa Saari wa Yacha'ya wa Chim'i wa Hachabya wa Mattitya kulluhum ke sitte.Wa humman gaa'idiin tihit muraakhabat abuuhum Yaduutuun al-yikhanni be kalaam Allah wa yachkurah wa yahmudah be daribiin al-jigindiiye.
Min iyaal Heemaan,Bukhiiya wa Mattanya wa Uzziyiil wa Chabuwiil wa Yarimuut wa Hananya wa Hanaani wa Aliyaata wa Giddaalti wa Rumaamti Azar wa Yuchbakhaacha wa Malluuti wa Hutiir wa Mahaziyuut.
Wa kulla l-naas dool,humman min zurriiyit Heemaan al-nabi al-yichiif ru'ya le l-malik.Hu yihajji le l-malik be kulla cheyy al-Rabb yibayyinah leyah le yiwassif gudurtah.Wa l-Rabb antaah le Heemaan arba'taachar awlaad wa talaata banaat.
Wa tihit muraakhabat abuuhum,humman yikhannu fi beet Allah be aalaat al-musiikha misil al-nuggaara wa l-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe.Wa Asaaf wa Yaduutuun wa Heemaan humman yisawwu al-khidme di tihit muraakhabat al-malik.
Wa l-Laawiyiin wa akhwaanhum al-mudarrabiin fi l-khine le Allah adadhum 288 kulluhum mutakhassisiin.
Wa le yantuuhum khidmithum,humman sawwo am'iyeedaat le l-kubaar wa l-dugaag wa le l-mu'allimiin wa l-talaamiiz.
Wa l-am'iyeedaat al-awwal sawwooha waga'at le Yuusuf wileed Asaaf.Wa l-taani le Gadaalya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-taalit le Zakkuur wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-raabi' le Yisar wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-khaamis le Natanya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-saadis le Bukhiiya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-saabi' le Yasariila wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-taamin le Yacha'ya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-taasi' le Mattanya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-aachir le Chim'i wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-ihdaachar le Azariil wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-atnaachar le Hachabya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-talaataachar le Chubayiil wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-arba'taachar le Mattitya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-khamistaachar le Yarimuut wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-sittaachar le Hananya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-saba'taachar le Yuchbakhaacha wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-tamaantaachar le Hanaani wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-tisa'taachar le Malluuti wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-ichriin le Aliyaata wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-waahid wa ichriin le Hutiir wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-itneen wa ichriin le Giddaalti wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-talaata wa ichriin le Mahaziyuut wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l-arba'a wa ichriin le Rumaamti Azar wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa majmuu'aat al-hurraas hana l-biibaan,chaaloohum min zurriiyit Khuurah wa fi raashum Machalaamya wileed Khuuri min zurriiyit Asaaf.
Wa awlaad Machalaamya humman Zakariiya al-bikir wa Yadiya'iil al-taani wa Zabadya al-taalit wa Yatniyiil al-raabi'
wa Ilaam al-khaamis wa Yuuhanaan al-saadis wa Aliyu'naay al-saabi'.
Wa awlaad Ubeed Adoom humman Chama'ya al-bikir wa Yahuzabaad al-taani wa Yuwaakh al-taalit wa Saakar al-raabi' wa Nataniil al-khaamis
wa Amiyiil al-saadis wa Yassaakar al-saabi' wa Fa'ullataay al-taamin,achaan al-Rabb baarak Ubeed Adoom.
Wa Chama'ya al-bikir jaab iyaal al-bigo mumassiliin aayilaathum achaan humman rujaal furraas wa gaadriin.
Wa awlaad Chama'ya humman Utni wa Rafayiil wa Ubeed wa Alzabad wa akhwaanhum al-fahaliin Aliihu wa Samakya.
Wa kulla l-naas dool min zurriiyit Ubeed Adoom ma'a awlaadhum wa aayilaathum,kulluhum ke rujaal fahaliin wa gaadriin fi khidmithum wa adadhum 62.
Wa majmuu'at Machalaamya be iyaalah wa akhwaanah adadhum 18 kulluhum rujaal fahaliin.
Wa Huusa al-min zurriiyit Maraari indah awlaad.Wa wileedah Chimri ma bikir abuuh wa laakin khattaah kabiir al-aayila.
Wa Hilkhiiya wileedah al-taani wa Tabalya al-taalit wa Zakariiya al-raabi'.Wa kulla awlaad Huusa wa akhwaan adadhum 13.
Wa kulla rujaal hana majmuu'aat al-hurraas wa kubaaraathum gaa'idiin yakhdumu sawa fi beet Allah.
Wa humman gassamo haraasat al-biibaan be am'iyeedaat,min al-kubaar le l-dugaag hasab aayilaathum.
Wa l-am'iyeedaat le haraasat al-baab al-sabhaani waga'at fi Chalamya.Wa l-am'iyeedaat le haraasat al-baab al-munchaakhi waga' le wileedah Zakariiya al-mustachaar al-indah agul.
Wa Ubeed Adoom hafad al-baab al-watiyaani wa iyaalah kamaan hafado al-makhaazin.
Wa Chuffim wa Huusa humman hafado al-baab al-kharbaani wa l-baab al-binaaduuh Challaka hu al-faatih ale derib al-taali' foog.Wa daahu kikkeef nazzamo al-haraasa.
Fi l-baab al-sabhaani,sitte Laawiyiin fi l-yoom wa fi l-baab al-munchaakhi arba'a Laawiyiin fi l-yoom wa fi l-baab al-watiyaani arba'a Laawiyiin fi l-yoom wa le l-makhaazin kamaan itneen itneen fi bakaanaat chig chig.
Wa le l-beet al-kharbaani arba'a rujaal hafado al-derib wa itneen kamaan hafado al-beet zaatah.
Wa dool majmuu'aat al-haraasa al-chaaloohum min zurriiyit Khuurah wa Maraari.
Wa min al-Laawiyiin kallafo Akhiiya be l-makhaazin hana beet Allah wa be l-makhaazin hana l-mu'iddaat al-mukhassasiin le Allah.
Wa awlaad La'daan min zurriiyit Girchuun kabiir aayilaathum Yahiyiil
wa awlaad Yahiyiil humman Zitaam wa akhuuh Yuwiil.Wa humman dool kallafoohum be makhaazin beet Allah.
Wa kan le zurriiyit Amraam wa Yishaar wa Habruun wa Uzziyiil,
Chabuwiil min zurriiyit Girchuum wileed Muusa,hu bas al-muraakhib al-aamm fi l-makhaazin dool.
Wa min aayiltah fi naas min zurriiyit Ali'aazar.Wa Ali'aazar da hu akhu Girchuum wileed Rahabyawa Rahabya wileed Ali'aazarwa Yacha'ya wileed Rahabyawa Yuuraam wileed Yacha'yawa Zikri wileed Yuuraamwa Chaluumit wileed Zikri.
Wa Chaluumit wa akhwaanah kallafoohum be l-makhaazin hana l-mu'iddaat al-khassasoohum al-malik Dawuud wa kubaaraat al-aayilaat wa khuyyaad al-aalaaf wa khuyyaad al-miyaat wa kubaaraat al-askar al-aakhariin.
Wa l-kubaaraat dool khassaso min al-khaniime al-chaalooha fi l-harib le yi'addulu beeha beet Allah.
Wa Chaluumit wa akhwaanah mas'uuliin min kulla l-mu'iddaat al-mukhaddasiin al-khassasoohum Samuwiil al-nabi wa Chaawuul wileed Khiich wa Abniir wileed Niir wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya.Wa kulla achya al-khassasoohum.
Min zurriiyit Yishaar,Kananya wa awlaadah kallafoohum muraakhibiin wa gudiya be khidmit chu'uun al-khaarijiiye hana Bani Israa'iil.
Wa min zurriiyit Habruun,Hachabya wa 1-700 rujaal fahaliin kallafoohum be muraakhabat kulla balad Israa'iil min jiihat al-kharib ale Urdun.Wa kallafoohum be kulla l-khidme al-tukhuss Allah wa l-malik.
Wa Yariiya hu bas kabiirhum le naas zurriiyit Habruun.Wa fi sanit 40 hana hukum al-malik Dawuud,fattacho gurmit aayilaathum.Wa ligo minhum rujaal furraas fi hillit Ya'ziir min balad Gil'aad.
Wa l-malik Dawuud chaal 2-700 rujaal fahaliin min zurriiyit Yariiya wa kulluhum kubaaraat al-aayilaat.Wa kallaf beehum gabiilat Ra'uubiin wa Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa fi kulla l-khidme al-tukhuss al-Rabb wa l-malik.
Wa daahu naas min Bani Israa'iil al-yakhdumu le l-malik.Wa humman kubaaraat al-aayilaat wa khuyyaad al-aalaaf wa khuyyaad al-miyaat wa l-muraakhibiin.Wa kulla khidmithum tukhuss al-majmuu'aat al-askariiye al-yakhdumu be amkaaba ayyi chahar fi tuul al-sana.Wa ayyi majmuu'a indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-awwalaaniiye hana l-chahar al-awwal,hu Yachab'aam wileed Zabdiyiil.Majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa hu min zurriiyit Faaris wa khaayid kulla l-askar hana l-chahar al-awwal.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-taaniye hana l-chahar al-taani,hu Duudaay min hillit Akhuukh.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil wa l-yuguudhum hu Mikhluut.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-taalta hana l-chahar al-taalit,hu Banaaya wileed Yahuuyada' raajil diin al-kabiir.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa Banaaya hu raajil faaris been al-khuyyaad al-talaatiin wa hu bas kabiirhum.Wa wileedah Amizabaad,hu kula fi l-majmuu'a di.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-raab'e hana l-chahar al-raabi',hu Asaahiil akhu Yuwaab wa ba'adah kamaan,wileedah Zabadya.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-khaamse hana l-chahar al-khaamis,hu Chamhuut al-min hillit Yizra.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-saadse hana l-chahar al-saadis,hu Iira wileed Ikheech min hillit Takhuu'a.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-saab'e hana l-chahar al-saabi',hu Haalas min hillit Faluun wa hu min gabiilat Afraayim.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-taamne hana l-chahar al-taamin,hu Sibbakaay min hillit Huucha wa hu min zurriiyit Zaarah.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-taas'e hana l-chahar al-taasi',hu Abi'aazar min hillit Anatuut wa hu min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-aachre hana l-chahar al-aachir,hu Mahraay min hillit Natuufa wa hu min zurriiyit Zaarah.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-ihdaachar hana chahri ihdaachar,hu Banaaya min hillit Fir'atuun wa hu min gabiilat Afraayim.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al-majmuu'a al-atnaachar hana chahri atnaachar,hu Haldaay min hillit Natuufa wa hu min khachum beet Utniyiil.Wa majmuu'tah indaha 24-000 raajil.
Daahu kubaaraat gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.Min gabiilat Ra'uubiin,kabiirhum Ali'aazar wileed Zikriwa min gabiilat Chim'uun,kabiirhum Chafatya wileed Ma'aaka
wa min gabiilat Laawi,kabiirhum Hachabya wileed Khamuwiilwa min zurriiyit Haaruun,kabiirhum Saduukh
wa min gabiilat Yahuuza,kabiirhum Aliihu min akhwaan Dawuudwa min gabiilat Yassaakar,kabiirhum Umri wileed Mikaayiil
wa min gabiilat Zabuluun,kabiirhum Yichma'ya wileed Ubadyawa min gabiilat Naftaali,kabiirhum Yarimuut wileed Azriyiil
wa min gabiilat Afraayim kabiirhum,Huucha' wileed Azazyawa min nuss gabiilat Manassa al-fi l-kharib,kabiirhum Yuwiil wileed Fadaaya
wa min nuss gabiilat Manassa al-fi Gil'aad fi l-sabaah,kabiirhum Yiddu wileed Zakariiyawa min gabiilat Banyaamiin,Ya'siyiil wileed Abniir
wa min gabiilat Daan,kabiirhum Azariil wileed Yaruuhaam.Wa dool kubaaraat gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Dawuud ma hasab al-subyaan al-umurhum angas min 20 sana achaan Allah gaal yisawwi Bani Israa'iil yabgo katiiriin misil nujuum al-sama.
Wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya bada al-hisaab wa laakin ma kammalah achaan Allah khidib le Bani Israa'iil.Wa be sabab da,adad al-cha'ab ma maktuub fi kitaab taariikh al-malik Dawuud.
Wa Azmaawat wileed Adiyiil mas'uul fi makhaazin al-malik.Wa Yuunataan wileed Uzziiya mas'uul fi l-makhaazin al-fi l-kadaade wa l-mudun wa l-hillaal wa fi buyuut al-tuwaal hana l-muraakhaba kula.
Wa Azri wileed Kaluub mas'uul fi kulla l-khaddaamiin al-yahartu fi l-ziraa'a.
Wa Chim'i al-min hillit al-Raama mas'uul fi jineenaat al-inab.Wa Zabdi al-min hillit Chafaam mas'uul fi l-makhaazin hana l-khamar al-yamrug min al-inab da.
Wa Ba'al Hanaan al-min hillit Gadiira mas'uul fi l-jineenaat al-zaytuun wa l-tiin al-fi l-sahale.Wa Yuwaach mas'uul fi l-makhaazin hana dihin.
Wa Chirtaay al-min hillit Chaaruun mas'uul fi l-bagar al-yasraho fi l-mar'a al-fi kadaadit Chaaruun.Wa Chaafaat wileed Adlaay mas'uul fi l-bagar al-yasraho fi l-wudyaan.
Wa Ubiil al-min zurriiyit Ismaa'iil mas'uul fi l-jumaal.Wa Yahadya al-min hillit Miruunuut mas'uul fi l-hamiir.
Wa Yaziiz al-min Bani Haajar mas'uul fi door al-khanam.Wa kulla l-naas dool masaa'iil fi maal al-malik Dawuud.
Wa Yuunataan immah le Dawuud,hu mustachaar wa raajil faahim wa kaatib al-malik.Wa Yahiyiil wileed Hakmuuni,hu mukallaf be tarbiyat awlaad al-malik.
Wa Akhituufal,hu kula mustachaar al-malik.Wa Huuchaay al-min hillit Arki,hu rafiig al-malik.
Wa ba'ad Akhituufal,jo Yahuuyada' wileed Banaaya wa Abiyaatar.Wa Yuwaab,hu khaayid hana deech al-malik.
Wa Dawuud lamma kulla kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil fi Uruchaliim.Wa dool kulla kubaaraat al-gabaayil wa kubaaraat al-majmuu'aat al-yakhdumu le l-malik wa khuyyaad al-aalaaf wa khuyyaad al-miyaat wa l-masaa'iil fi kulla l-khumaam wa l-bahaayim hana l-malik wa awlaadah.Wa lamma kulla l-khaddaamiin wa kulla l-fahaliin wa l-rujaal al-furraas.
Wa l-malik Dawuud gamma foog be tuulah wa gaal-:-Asma'ooni,ya akhwaani wa cha'abi.Ana indi niiye le nabni beet al-raaha le sanduug mu'aahadat Allah.Wa da l-bakaan al-Ilaahna yukhutt foogah rijileenah.Wa ana jaahiz le l-buna da.
Wa laakin al-Rabb gaal leyi-:--Inta ma tabni leyi beet achaan inta raajil muhaarib wa daffagt damm katiir.--
Wa laakin Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil azalaani min kulla aayilat abuuyi achaan nahkim fi Israa'iil.Achaan hu azal gabiilat Yahuuza tahkim wa min gabiilat Yahuuza hu azal aayilat abuuyi wa min kulla akhwaani iyaal abuuyi hu azalni ana le nabga malik fi kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah antaani iyaal katiiriin wa minhum azal wileedi Suleymaan wa khattaah fi kursi al-malik hana mamlakat Allah fi Israa'iil.
Wa gaal leyi-:--Wileedak Suleymaan bas yabni leyi beet be fadaay.Achaan ana azaltah le yabga leyi ibni wa ana nabga leyah abuuh.
Wa nisabbit mulkah ila l-abad kan hu yahfad wa yitabbig wasiiyaati wa churuuti misil al-yoom.--
Wa hassa' da,ya akhwaani-!Giddaam kulla Bani Israa'iil jamaa'at Allah wa giddaam Ilaahna Allah al-gaa'id yasma'ku,ana nuguul leeku-:--Ahfado wa taabu'u wasaaya Allah Ilaahku wa intu tawrusu al-balad al-adiile di wa tikhalluuha warasa le iyaalku ba'adku ila l-abad.--
Wa inta,ya wileedi Suleymaan,a'arif Allah Rabb abuuk wa a'abudah be kulla galbak wa be niiye mukhlisa.Achaan Allah yakchif galib al-insaan wa ya'arif al-fikir hana ayyi naadum.Wa kan inta tifattichah,hu yikhalliik talgaah.Wa laakin kan abeetah kamaan,hu kula yaabaak ila l-abad.
Wa hassa',chiif-!Daahu Allah azalak le tabni leyah beet wa l-beet da,yabga leyah bakaan mukhaddas.Chidd heelak wa abda al-khidme.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud antaah le wileedah Suleymaan al-rasim hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa da khurfit al-madkhal wa l-buyuut wa l-makhaazin wa l-khuraf al-foog wa l-khuraf al-daakhal wa beet sanduug al-mu'aahada.
Wa antaah rasim hana kulla cheyy al-indah fi fikrah al-yidoor yabniih,misil al-fadaay hana beet Allah wa kulla l-buyuut al-yihawwugu al-fadaay wa l-makhaazin hana beet al-Rabb wa l-makhaazin hana l-mu'iddaat al-mukhassasiin.
Wa antaah asaame hana majmuu'aat rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa kulla l-khidme al-tukhuss beet Allah wa kulla mu'iddaat al-khidme hana beet Allah.
Wa wassafah wazin al-dahab al-waajib le l-mu'iddaat al-yasna'oohum be dahab wa wazin al-fudda al-waajib le l-mu'iddaat al-yasna'oohum be fudda.Wa da hasab al-isti'maal hana ayyi cheyy.
Wa wassafah wazin hana l-faanuus wa niiraanah al-yasna'oohum be dahab wa wazin hana l-faanuus wa niiraanah al-yasna'oohum be fudda wa da hasab al-isti'maal hana ayyi faanuus.
Wa wassafah wazin al-dahab al-yisawwu beyah taraabiiz al-yigaddumu fooghum al-khubza le Allah wa wazin al-fudda al-yisawwu beeha taraabiiz aakhariin.
Wa wassafah wazin hana l-hadaayid al-yisillu beehum al-laham wa l-kiisaan al-yuruchchu beehum wa l-abaariig al-be dahab saafi.Wa wassafah wazin al-dahab hana l-kiisaan al-be dahab wa wazin al-fudda hana l-kiisaan al-be fudda.
Wa wassafah kula,al-wazin hana l-dahab al-saafi al-yisawwu beyah al-mukhbar al-yiharrugu foogah al-bakhuur.Wa wassafah al-rasim hana l-araba al-mukhassasa ya'ni sidaadit sanduug mu'aahadat Allah al-gaa'idiin foogha suurat makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin hana dahab al-mumattitiin janaaheehum wa mukhattiyiin beehum al-sanduug.
Wa Dawuud gaal-:-Wa da kulla maktuub hasab al-rasim al-Allah zaatah wassafaani le kulla l-khidme di.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud gaal le wileedah Suleymaan-:-Abga chadiid wa fahal wa abda al-khidme.Ma takhaaf wa la tinbahit achaan al-Rabb Allah Ilaahi gaa'id ma'aak.Hu ma yikhalliik wa ma yaabaak lahaddi kumaalit kulla l-khidme hana beet Allah.
Wa daahu,a'arif majmuu'aat rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-yakhdumu fi kulla khidmit beet Allah.Wa ma'aak fi l-khidme di,fi naas al-induhum niiye mukhlisa wa malaaniin be khibra fi kulla l-khidme.Wa l-kubaaraat wa kulla l-cha'ab yisawwu kulla cheyy al-taamurhum.
Wa l-malik Dawuud gaal le kulla l-cha'ab al-lammiin-:-Al-Rabb azal wileedi Suleymaan bas wa laakin hu lissaa' sabi wa ma indah irfe.Wa l-khidme di,hi kabiire achaan al-beet al-mukhaddas da,ma yabnuuh le insaani bas laakin le Allah al-Rabb.
Wa ana gammeet be kulla gudurti wa jahhazt le buna beet Ilaahi dahab le ayyi cheyy al-yasna'ooh be dahab wa fudda le ayyi cheyy al-yasna'ooh be fudda wa nahaas le ayyi cheyy al-yasna'ooh be nahaas wa hadiid le ayyi cheyy al-yasna'ooh be hadiid wa hatab le ayyi cheyy al-yisawwuuh be hatab.Wa ana jahhazt hajar khaali al-usmah agiig wa nafar aakhariin min al-hujaar al-khaaliyiin le yijammulu beehum.Wa hujaar khaaliyiin al-loonhum zurug wa khudur wa battaan jahhazt rukhaam be katara.
Wa da achaan ana nihibb beet Ilaahi,nanti min al-dahab wa l-fudda al-haggi halaali le beet Ilaahi.Wa da ziyaada fi l-cheyy al-jahhaztah le l-beet al-mukhaddas.
Ana nanti 100-000 kiilo hana dahab saafi wa 240-000 kiilo hana fudda saafi le yikhattu beyah daraadir al-beet.
Wa kulla l-dahab da le l-achya al-be dahab wa l-fudda le l-achya al-be fudda al-yisawwuuhum al-sinaa'iyiin le beet Allah.Wa yaatu minku al-yoom be niiytah yijiib hadiiye le Allah-?
Wa khalaas,kubaaraat al-aayilaat wa kubaaraat gabaayil Bani Israa'iil wa khuyyaad al-aalaaf wa khuyyaad al-miyaat wa masaa'iil al-malik jaabo hadaayaahum.
Wa humman anto le khidmit beet Allah 170-000 kiilo hana dahab wa 10-000 jineeh hana dahab wa 340-000 kiilo hana fudda wa gariib 600-000 kiilo hana nahaas wa ziyaada min 3 malyuun kiilo hana hadiid.
Wa humman al-induhum fi buyuuthum hujaar khaaliyiin jaaboohum le makhazan hana beet Allah wa ammanoohum fi iid Yahiyiil al-min gabiilat Girchuun.
Wa l-cha'ab firho be l-hadaaya dool achaan humman gaddamoohum be galib mukhlis le Allah.Wa l-malik Dawuud kula firih farha chadiide.
Wa Dawuud chakar Allah giddaam kulla l-cha'ab wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Ilaah jiddina Israa'iil khalli yibaaruku daayman wa ila l-abad.
Wa leek inta,ya Allah,al-azama wa l-gudra wa l-jalaal wa l-majd wa l-nuur achaan kulla cheyy al-fi l-sama wa fi l-ard,hanaak inta.Wa ya Allah,inta bas maalik fi kulla l-makhluugiin.
Al-khuna wa l-majd yaju minnak wa inta bas al-maalik fi kulla cheyy.Wa indak gudra wa izz wa inta bas al-tikabbir wa tigawwi.
Wa hassa',ya Ilaahna,nachkuruuk wa nahmudu usmak al-Jaliil.
Laakin ana ke yaatu-?Wa cha'abi yisaawi chunu-?Wa kikkeef ligiina gudra le nigaddumu hadaaya misil dool-?Ayyi cheyy al-indina jaayi minnak inta wa kulla cheyy al-gaddamnaah leek,inta bas anteetna.
Wa aniina ni'iichu misil ajaanib wa diifaan giddaamak misil kulla juduudna.Wa hayaatna fi l-dunya di misil dull al-daha al-zawwaal.Hal al-dull indah acham yagood walla-?
Ya Allah Ilaahna-!Kulla l-achya dool lammeenaahum be katara wa jahhaznaahum le nabnu leek beet le usmak al-mukhaddas.Wa laakin kulla l-achya dool jaayiin minnak wa hineeyak.
Wa ana na'arif,ya Ilaahi,kadar inta takchif al-fi l-galib wa tihibb al-adaala.Wa be niiye waahide,ana gaddamt leek kulla l-achya dool.Wa hassa',daahu cha'abak lammo be farha wa gaa'idiin yigaddumu leek be niiye waahide al-hadaaya dool.
Ya Allah Rabb juduudna Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub-!Ahfad daayman al-fikra hana gaddimiin al-hadaaya di fi guluub cha'abak.Wa sabbit guluubhum foogak.
Wa le wileedi Suleymaan da,antiih galib mukhlis le yahfad wasiiyaatak wa ta'liimak wa churuutak wa yitabbighum wa yabni al-beet al-mukhaddas al-ana jahhazt leyah.
Wa ba'ad da,Dawuud gaal le kulla l-cha'ab-:-Baaruku Allah Ilaahku. Wa kulla l-cha'ab baarako Allah Rabb juduudhum.Wa dangaro wa sajado le Allah wa le l-malik.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taani min al-yoom da,humman dabaho dahaaya wa gaddamo dahaaya muharragiin le Allah.Wa humman gaddamo 1-000 toor wa 1-000 kabich wa 1-000 hamal be hadaayaahum hana l-charaab.Wa l-dahaaya al-gaddamoohum katiiriin lihgo le kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-yoom da,humman akalo wa chirbo giddaam Allah be farha kabiire.Wa le taani marra,humman chaalo Suleymaan wileed Dawuud wa masahooh wa darrajooh malik wa khassaso le Allah.Wa masaho Saduukh raajil diin kabiir.
Wa Suleymaan ga'ad fi kursi al-muluk hana Allah wa bigi malik fi badal abuuh Dawuud.Wa hu gaa'id yanjah wa kulla Bani Israa'iil yikarrumuuh.
Wa kulla l-kubaaraat wa l-rujaal al-fahaliin wa kulla l-iyaal al-aakhariin hana l-malik Dawuud ga'ado tihit hukum Suleymaan.
Wa Allah sawwaah le Suleymaan aali marra waahid fi uyuun kulla Bani Israa'iil wa anta azama le mamlakatah al-abadan ma antaaha le ayyi malik al-gablah fi balad Israa'iil.
Wa Dawuud wileed Yassa hakam fi kulla balad Israa'iil.
Wa muddit hukmah fi kulla balad Israa'iil 40 sana.Hu hakam 7 sana fi Hibruun wa 33 sana fi Uruchaliim.
Wa maat wakit chayyab marra waahid wa chibi' min al-dunya.Wa gabul mootah,hu aach fi khuna wa charaf.Wa khalaas,wileedah Suleymaan hakam fi badalah.
Wa kulla amal al-malik Dawuud min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya maktuub fi kutub al-binaaduuhum A'maal al-nabi Samuwiil wa A'maal al-nabi Naataan wa A'maal al-nabi Gaad.
Wa l-kutub dool,maktuub fooghum kulla taariikh mulkah wa faraasiiytah wa kulla cheyy al-kaan foogah hu wa foog Bani Israa'iil wa foog kulla mamaalik hana buldaan aakhariin.
Suleymaan wileed Dawuud sabbat mulkah wa Allah Ilaahah gaa'id ma'aayah wa sawwaah aali.
Wa Suleymaan naada kulla Bani Israa'iil khaassatan khuyyaad al-aalaaf wa khuyyaad al-miyaat wa l-gudiya wa kulla kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil wa dool kubaaraat al-aayilaat.
Wa Suleymaan wa kulla l-cha'ab macho fi bakaan al-ibaada al-fi hillit Gib'uun achaan fi l-bakaan da bas gaa'ide kheemat al-ijtimaa' hana l-Rabb.Wa di bas al-kheema al-sawwaaha Muusa abd Allah fi l-sahara.
Wa sanduug al-Rabb kamaan,Dawuud jaabah min hillit Kharyat Ya'ariim wa khattaah fi l-bakaan al-hu jahhazah leyah wa di kheema fi Uruchaliim.
Wa l-madbah hana l-nahaas al-sana'ah Basaliil wileed Uuri wileed wileedah le Huur gaa'id giddaam kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,Suleymaan wa kulla l-cha'ab yas'alo Allah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da giddaam Allah,Suleymaan rikib fi l-madbah hana l-nahaas gariib le kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa gaddam foogah 1-000 dahaaya muharragiin.
Wa fi l-leel di,al-Rabb baan le Suleymaan wa gaal leyah-:-Atlub minni al-cheyy al-inta tidoorah wa ana nantiih leek.
Wa Suleymaan radda le l-Rabb wa gaal-:-Inta sawweet kheer katiir le Dawuud abuuyi wa darrajtini malik fi badalah.
Wa hassa' da,ya Allah Ilaahi,khalli kalaamak al-gultah le abuuyi Dawuud da yilhaggag achaan inta bas darrajtini malik fi raas al-cha'ab al-katiiriin misil turaab al-ard.
Wa antiini al-hikma wa l-ilim le na'arif kikkeef nuguud al-cha'ab da.Achaan yaatu yagdar yahkim fi cha'abak al-katiiriin dool-?
Wa l-Rabb gaal le Suleymaan-:-Da bas al-cheyy al-galbak dawwarah-!Inta ma talabt minni khuna wa la maal wa la azama.Wa ma talabt moot udwaanak wa la tuul al-umur laakin inta talabt al-hikma wa l-ilim le tahkim fi cha'abi al-ana darrajtak fooghum malik.
Wa fi chaan da,al-hikma wa l-ilim anteethum leek wa niziidak battaan wa nantiik al-khuna wa l-maal wa l-azama al-abadan muluuk al-gablak ma ligooh.Wa ba'adak kula,naadum ma yalgaah.
Wa ba'ad da,Suleymaan gabbal fi Uruchaliim min bakaan al-ibaada al-fi Gib'uun al-gaa'ide foogah kheemat al-ijtimaa'.Wa hakam fi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan lamma arabaat hana harib wa siyaad kheel.Hu indah 1-400 arabaat harib wa 12-000 siyaad kheel.Wa hu wadda waahidiin minhum fi l-hillaal al-yukhutt fooghum arabaatah wa waahidiin kamaan khallaahum ma'aayah fi Uruchaliim.
Wa l-malik jaab fi Uruchaliim fudda wa dahab katiir ziyaada misil al-hashas.Wa hatab al-arz kula bigi katiir ziyaada misil chadar al-jimmeez al-yugumm fi sahalat Chafiila.
Wa kheel al-malik Suleymaan,gaa'idiin yijiibuuhum leyah min Masir wa min Kuwi.Wa da tujjaar al-malik bas yamchu wa yachruuhum leyah min hinaak.
Wa ayyi araba al-yijiibuuha min Masir tamanha 600 hajar fudda wa ayyi juwaad tamanah 150 hajar fudda.Wa be nafs al-taman da bas,al-tujjaar gaa'idiin yijiibu arabaat wa kheel le muluuk al-Hittiyiin wa le muluuk Araam kula.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan amar yabnu beet le Allah wa gasir leyah hu.
Wa Suleymaan chaal 70-000 naggaaliin wa 80-000 naas gaa'idiin fi l-jibaal achaan yagta'o al-hajar wa 3-600 muraakhibiin.
Wa Suleymaan rassal le Hiiraam malik balad Suur wa gaal leyah-:-Min fadlak,rassil leyi ana kula misil inta rassalt le abuuyi Dawuud hatab al-arz le yabnu leyah beet al-yaskun foogah.
Chiif,ana nidoor nabni beet le Allah Ilaahi wa nikhassisah achaan yiharrugu giddaamah al-bakhuur al-mu'attar wa yigaddumu daayman al-khubza wa l-dahaaya al-muharragiin hana l-fajur wa l-achiiye wa kulli yoom sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa kulli iid hana Allah Ilaahna.Wa da bukhuss Bani Israa'iil daayman.
Wa l-beet al-ana nidoor nabniih hu kabiir achaan Ilaahna hu kabiir min kulla l-ilaahaat.
Wa yaatu yagdar yabni leyah beet-?Achaan al-sama wa kulla l-samaawaat al-wasii'iin dool ma yagdaro yichiiluuh.Wa ana nisaawi cheyy le nabni leyah beet-?Nidoor bas nabni bakaan yiharrugu foogah bakhuur giddaamah.
Wa hassa' da,rassil leyi naadum al-indah khibra fi khidmit al-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-nahaas wa l-hadiid wa l-gumaach al-garadi wa l-ahmar wa l-zahri wa ya'arif al-nagichiin.Wa hu yakhdim ma'a l-khaddaamiin al-induhum khibra al-abuuyi Dawuud jahhazaahum wa gaa'idiin ma'aayi fi balad Yahuuza wa fi Uruchaliim.
Wa rassil leyi min Lubnaan hatab al-arz wa hatab al-sarwi wa hatab al-sandal achaan ana na'arif kadar khaddaamiinak ya'arfu yagta'o chadar Lubnaan.Wa khaddaamiini yakhdumu ma'a khaddaamiinak
le yijahhuzu leyi hatab be katara achaan al-beet al-nidoor nabniih da kabiir wa ajiib.
Wa daahu nikaffi khaddaamiinak al-yagta'o al-hatab 50-000 chuwaal hana gameh ahmar wa 50-000 chuwaal hana gameh abyad wa 2-000 birmiil hana khamar wa 2-000 birmiil hana dihin.
Wa Hiiraam malik balad Suur katab maktuub wa radda le Suleymaan wa gaal-:-Achaan Allah yihibb cha'abah da bas,hu khattaak fooghum malik.
Wa battaan Hiiraam gaal-:-Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-khalag al-samaawaat wa l-ard wa anta le l-malik Dawuud wileed hakiim indah agul wa fihim.Wa yabni beet le Allah wa gasir leyah hu kula.
Wa hassa' da,nirassil leek raajil al-indah khibra wa ma'rafa wa hu Huuraam Abi
wileed hana mara waahide al-min gabiilat Daan wa abuuh min balad Suur.Hu da ya'arif yakhdim al-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-nahaas wa l-hadiid wa l-hajar wa l-hatab wa l-gumaach al-garadi wa l-zahri wa l-ahmar wa kattaan.Wa indah khibra fi nagichiin al-achya al-yanguchuuhum wa yi'addil kulla cheyy al-yantuuh le yakhdimah.Wa hu yakhdim ma'a naasak al-induhum khibra wa ma'a l-khubara hana siidi Dawuud abuuk.
Wa hassa' da,ya siidi,rassil leena al-gameh al-ahmar wa l-gameh al-abyad wa l-dihin wa l-khamar misil inta gultah.
Wa aniina kamaan nagta'o hatab Lubnaan al-waajib leek.Wa nilimmuuh wa narbutuuh wa ni'awwumuuh fi l-bahar lahaddi hillit Yaafa wa inta kamaan tangulah min hinaak wa tiwaddiih Uruchaliim.
Wa khalaas,al-malik Suleymaan hasab kulla l-ajaanib al-gaa'idiin fi balad Israa'iil wa da ba'ad al-hisaab al-sawwaah Dawuud abuuh.Wa ligi adadhum 153-600.
Wa hu chaal minhum 70-000 naggaaliin wa 80-000 naas gaa'idiin fi l-jibaal achaan yagta'o al-hajar wa 3-600 muraakhibiin al-yikhaddumu al-cha'ab.
Wa Suleymaan bada buna beet Allah fi Uruchaliim fi raas hajar Muriiya.Wa da l-bakaan al-Allah baan foogah le Dawuud abuuh wa da l-bakaan al-Dawuud jahhazah fi madagg hana Urnaan al-Yabuusi.
Wa Suleymaan bada al-buna fi l-chahar al-taani fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukmah.
Wa Suleymaan assas buna beet Allah be asaas tuulah 60 duraa' wa urdah 20 duraa' hasab al-magaas al-gadiim.
Wa khurfit al-madkhal urdaha 20 duraa' wa tuulha foog 20 duraa'.Wa masahooha min daakhal kullaha ke be dahab saafi.
Wa l-khurfa al-kabiire di saddooha be khachab al-sarwi al-mamsuuh be dahab saafi wa nagacho foogah suwar hana salaasil wa chadar nakhal.
Wa battaan jammalo al-khurfa di be hujaar khaaliyiin wa be dahab al-jaabooh min balad Farwaayim.
Wa kulla l-khurfa di,masahooha be dahab wa da l-maraadiis wa l-madkhal wa l-daraadir wa biibaan al-beet.Wa nagacho suwar hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin fi l-daraadir.
Wa fi lubb al-beet da,bano al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid tuulah 20 duraa' wa urdah kula 20 duraa'.Wa masahooh be dahab saafi al-waznah yisaawi 20-000 kiilo.
Wa l-wazin hana l-masaamiir yisaawi 72 jineeh hana dahab.Wa l-khachab hana l-beet be foog kula masahooh be dahab.
Wa fi lubb al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid,be hatab sana'o tamaasiil hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin itneen wa masahoohum be dahab.
Wa l-janaahe hana l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool tuulhum 20 duraa'.Jinh waahid hana l-makhluug al-awwalaani,tuulah 5 duraa' wa yilimm fi l-durdur hana l-beet.Wa jinhah al-aakhar kula tuulah 5 duraa' wa yilimm ma'a l-jinh hana l-makhluug al-taani.
Wa l-jinh hana l-makhluug al-taani kula tuulah 5 duraa' wa yilimm fi l-durdur hana l-beet.Wa jinhah al-aakhar kula tuulah 5 duraa' wa yilimm ma'a l-jinh hana l-makhluug al-awwalaani.
Wa l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin al-itneen dool waagfiin be tuulhum wa wijihhum mugaabil al-beet wa mumattitiin janaaheehum al-tuulhum 20 duraa'.
Wa sawwo sitaar min gumaach loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa kattaan.Wa khayyato foogah suwar hana l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.
Wa sana'o amad itneen hana nahaas giddaam beet Allah wa tuul hana ayyi amuud 35 duraa'.Wa sana'o leehum ruuse hana nahaas wa khattoohum foog fi l-amad dool wa ayyi waahid min al-ruuse dool tuulah 5 duraa'.
Wa jammalo al-amad dool be salaasil misil al-fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa allagoohum foog fi ruuse al-amad.Wa battaan sana'o 100 rummaan min nahaas wa rassoohum fi l-salaasil.
Wa khatto al-amad dool giddaam beet Allah.Al-amuud al-waahid,khattaah be l-zeene wa sammaah Yaakiin (ma'anaatah Allah yisabbit).Wa l-amuud al-taani,khattaah be l-isra wa sammaah Bu'aaz (ma'anaatah al-gudra min Allah).
Wa sana'o madbah hana nahaas al-tuulah 20 duraa' wa urdah kula 20 duraa' wa tuulah foog kamaan 10 duraa'.
Wa sana'o hoot kabiir mudawwar.Wa khachmah yisaawi 10 duraa' min tarafah le tarafah.Wa tuulah foog yisaawi 5 duraa' wa daayirah kamaan 30 duraa'.
Wa jammalo al-hoot be suwar hana tiiraan wa fi ayyi duraa',rasamo 10 toor wa da,fi kulla daayira al-hoot.Wa l-tiiraan dool rassoohum ale roogeen.Wa humman wa l-hoot kulluhum ke sun'a waahide bas.
Wa khachum al-hoot da tukhnah yisaawi arba'a usba' wa khachmah misil nuwwaar al-sitteeb.Wa l-hoot da yichiil 300 birmiil hana almi.
Wa sana'o achara hiitaan aakhariin hana nahaas.Al-khamsa khattoohum be nuss al-zeene hana beet Allah wa l-khamsa al-aakhariin kamaan khattoohum be nuss al-isra achaan yikhassulu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin al-yigaddumuuhum.Wa laakin rujaal al-diin yilwaddo be almi hana l-hoot al-kabiir.
Wa sana'o achara faanuus min dahab hasab al-churuut wa khattoohum fi lubb beet Allah,al-khamsa be nuss al-zeene wa l-khamsa al-aakhariin be nuss al-isra.
Wa sawwo achara tarabeeza wa khattoohum fi lubb beet Allah,al-khamsa be nuss al-zeene wa l-khamsa al-aakhariin be nuss al-isra.Wa sana'o miya kaas hana dahab.
Wa sawwo fadaay le rujaal al-diin.Wa battaan sawwo fadaay aakhara kabiire wa biibaanha masahoohum be nahaas.
Wa kan le l-hoot al-kabiir kamaan,khattooh be nuss al-zeene hana l-beet fi ruknah mugaabil wati sabaah.
Wa Huuraam sana' al-buraam wa l-feelaat wa l-kiisaan.Wa hu kammal kulla l-khidme hana beet Allah al-kallafah beeha al-malik Suleymaan.
wa l-hoot al-kabiir al-wahiidwa l-atnaachar tiiraan al-tihtah
wa l-buraam wa l-feelaat wa l-hadaayid al-yisillu beehum al-laham.Kulla l-mu'iddaat dool,Huuraam Abi sana'aahum be nahaas nagi le beet Allah be amur al-malik Suleymaan.
Wa l-malik amar yasna'o kulla l-mu'iddaat dool fi gawaalib hana tiine fi turaab bahar al-Urdun ambeen Sukkuut wa Sariida.
Wa Suleymaan sawwa mu'iddaat katiiriin marra waahid lahaddi naadum ma yagdar ya'arif wazin al-nahaas al-sawwoohum beyah.
Wa battaan kula Suleymaan sawwa mu'iddaat aakhariin le beet Allah.Wa hummanmukhbar al-bakhuur hana l-dahabwa l-taraabiiz hana l-dahab al-yigaddumu fooghum al-khubza le Allah
wa l-fawaaniis wa tiyeesaathum kulluhum ke min dahab saafi wa dool al-yi'ooguduuhum giddaam al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid hasab al-churuut
wa l-zuhuur wa l-tiyeesaat le l-naar wa l-kalaaliib kulluhum ke min dahab saafi
wa l-sakaakiin wa l-kiisaan wa l-sufar wa khammaamaat al-naar kulluhum ke min dahab saafiwa l-biibaan hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid wa l-biibaan hana beet Allah kulluhum ke min dahab.
Wa wakit kulla l-khidme hana beet Allah kammalat khalaas,al-malik Suleymaan jaab kulla cheyy al-abuuh Dawuud khassasah misil al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-mawaa'iin wa khattaahum fi l-makhaazin hana beet Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Suleymaan naada kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil wa kulla kubaaraat al-gabaayil wa kubaaraat al-aayilaat hana Bani Israa'iil yilimmu fi Uruchaliim.Wa da achaan yichiilu sanduug mu'aahadat Allah min madiinat Dawuud wa hi Sahyuun wa yiwadduuh beet Allah.
Wa kulla rujaal Bani Israa'iil lammo wara l-malik fi wakt al-iid hana l-chahar al-saabi'.
Wakit kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil jo,al-Laawiyiin chaalo al-sanduug.
Wa rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin chaalo al-sanduug wa kheemat al-ijtimaa' wa kulla l-mu'iddaat al-mukhassasiin al-fi lubb al-kheema.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan wa kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil lammo wa wagafo giddaam al-sanduug.Wa gaddamo dahaaya hana khanam wa bagar katiir marra waahid wa lahaddi naadum ma yagdar yahsibhum wa la yalga adadhum.
Wa l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool mumattitiin janaaheehum be foog le l-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah al-sanduug.Wa be misil da,yikhattu al-sanduug wa l-iidaan al-yichiiluuh beehum.
Wa l-iidaan al-yichiiluuh beehum tuwaal.Wa khachum al-iidaan dool yinchaaf le l-naadum al-gaa'id ambeen al-sanduug wa l-madkhal hana l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.Wa laakin naadum min barra ma yichiifah.Wa l-sanduug da gaa'id fi l-bakaan lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa l-sanduug da ma indah cheyy daakhal illa l-liihaan al-itneen al-Muusa khattaahum fi lubbah wakit hu gaa'id fi jabal Huuriib.Wa da,wakit Allah sawwa mu'aahada ma'a Bani Israa'iil ba'ad marigiinhum min balad Masir.
Wa rujaal al-diin marago min al-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa awwal kulluhum ke khassaso nufuushum wa ma hammo be l-nizaam hana majmuu'aathum.
Wa kulla l-Laawiyiin al-khannaayiin,humman Asaaf wa Heemaan wa Yaduutuun wa iyaalhum wa akhwaanhum laabsiin khulgaan min gumaach hana kattaan wa waagfiin be l-nuss al-sabhaani hana l-madbah be aalaat al-musiikha misil nagaagiir wa amsibeybe wa jigindiiye.Wa ma'aahum 120 rujaal diin al-gaa'idiin yadurbu al-burunji.
Wa l-naas al-yadurbu al-burunji wa l-khannaayiin kulluhum lammo hissuhum sawa le yahmudu Allah wa yachkuruuh.Wakit darabo al-burunji wa l-nagaagiir wa l-aalaat al-aakhariin hana l-musiikha,gaalo-:-Allah hu rahiim wa rahmatah daayme ila l-abad. Wa tawwaali ke,beet Allah anmala be sahaabaay.
Wa rujaal al-diin ma gidro yisawwu khidmithum be sabab al-sahaabaay di achaan majd Allah mala beetah.
Wa khalaas Suleymaan gaal-:-Ya Allah-!Inta gult taskun fi l-dalaam.
Wa daahu ana baneet leek beet aziim al-taskun foogah.Wa da l-bakaan al-inta taskun foogah ila l-abad.
Wa l-malik wajjah le kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil al-waagfiin foog wa baarakaahum.
Wa battaan gaal-:-Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-hajja le abuuyi Dawuud.Aywa,be iidah hu haggag kulla l-kalaam al-gaalah leyah.Hu gaal-:
--Min yoom al-ana maragt cha'abi Bani Israa'iil min balad Masir,ana ma azalt hille waahide min kulla hillaal gabaayil Bani Israa'iil le yabnu leyi beet al-nukhutt foogah usmi.Wa ma azalt raajil waahid le yahkim fi cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa laakin hassa' ana azalt Madiinat al-Khudus le yagood foogha usmi wa azalt Dawuud le yahkim fi cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.-
Wa laakin Allah gaal le abuuyi Dawuud-:--Inta chilt niiye le tabni beet le usmi.Wa niiytak di adiile.
Wa ana khatteet fi lubb al-beet da al-sanduug al-indah al-liihaan al-fooghum al-mu'aahada al-sawwaaha Allah ma'a Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Suleymaan wagaf giddaam madbah Allah wa gaabal kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil.Wa rafa' iideenah le yas'al Allah.
Achaan awwal,al-malik Suleymaan sawwa bakaan aali hana nahaas fi ust al-fadaay,tuulah 5 duraa' wa urdah 5 duraa' wa tuulah al-foog kula 3 duraa'.Wa rikib foog fi l-bakaan da wa barak giddaam kulla jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil wa rafa' iideenah ale l-sama.
Wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,ma fi ilaah mislak inta wa la foog fi l-sama wa la tihit fi l-ard.Inta tahfad mu'aahadatak wa kheerak le khaddaamiinak al-yitaabu'uuk be kulla guluubhum.
Wa hassa',ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,ahfad mu'aahadatak al-sawweetha ma'a abdak Dawuud abuuyi wakit gult leyah-:--Daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiytak giddaami fi kursi al-muluk hana Bani Israa'iil.Wa da illa kan zurriiytak titabbig wasiiyaati wa titaabi' derbi misil inta zaatak taaba'tah.--
Wa hassa',ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,khalli kalaamak da yilhaggag misil inta gultah le abdak Dawuud.
Wa hal sahiih ke al-Rabb yaskun ma'a l-insaan fi l-ard walla-?Al-sama wa kulla l-samaawaat al-wasii'iin dool ma yagdaro yichiiluuk,ya Allah.Wa kikkeef al-beet al-sakhayyar al-ana baneetah yichiiluuk-?
Ya Allah Ilaahi,akhbal salaati wa du'aayi ana abdak.Asma' al-munaada wa l-sala al-niwajjihhum leek ana abdak.
Wa fakkir fi l-beet da leel wa nahaar achaan da l-bakaan al-inta gult-:--Da bas al-bakaan al-nukhutt foogah usmi.- Asma' salaati ana abdak al-niwajjihha ale l-bakaan da.
Ya Allah-!Asma' du'aayi ana abdak wa du'a cha'abak Bani Israa'iil wakit yisallu ale l-bakaan da.Wa min al-sama,al-bakaan al-inta saakin foogah,asma'na wa akhfir leena zunuubna.
Wa kan yuluumu naadum wa yuguulu hu sawwa khata didd naadum aakhar wa yajburuuh le yahlif be haliife al-tijiib foogah al-la'ana,khalli al-naadum da yaji yahlif giddaam madbahak al-gaa'id fi lubb al-beet da.
Wa inta kamaan min al-sama,asma' wa ahkim ambeen abiidak.Aakhib al-fasil wa gabbil leyah fasaaltah fi raasah.Wa barri al-saalih wa ahkim leyah hasab adaaltah.
Wa akuun al-adu yinnasir fi cha'abak Bani Israa'iil be sabab humman aznabo diddak.Wa kan humman yi'tarufu be zunuubhum wa yimajjudu usmak wa yiwajjuhu leek salaawaathum wa yachhadook fi lubb al-beet da,
khalaas min al-sama asma' wa akhfir le cha'abak Bani Israa'iil zunuubhum wa gabbilhum fi l-ard al-inta anteetha le juduudhum.
Wa akuun al-sama yinsadda wa l-matar yabga ma fi achaan cha'abak aznabo diddak.Wa kan humman yiwajjuhu leek ale l-bakaan da le yisallu wa yimajjudu usmak wa yi'tarufu be zunuubhum achaan inta ta''abtuhum,
khalaas min al-sama asma'hum wa akhfir le abiidak wa le cha'abak Bani Israa'iil zunuubhum.Wa wassif leehum al-derib al-adiil al-waajib yichiiluuh.Wa nazzil leehum matar fi l-ard al-inta anteetha warasa le cha'abak.
Wa akuun juu' walla waba yaji fi l-balad di wa l-ziraa'a yaybaso wa l-teeraab yi'affin wa l-saar al-leel wa l-jaraad yaju be katara.Wa l-adu yaji yihaasir al-mudun al-gawiyiin hana cha'abak hatta kan fooghum waba aw amraad kula.
Wa kan kulla cha'abak Bani Israa'iil irfo kadar al-waba wa l-ta'ab da jaayiin minhum humman zaathum,wa kan humman yachhadook wa yiwajjuhu ale beetak wa yarfa'o iideehum aleek le yas'alook,
khalaas min al-sama,al-bakaan al-inta saakin foogah,asma' wa akhfir leehum zunuubhum wa ahkim le ayyi waahid hasab amalah achaan inta ta'arif galbah.Wa inta bas al-ta'arif galib hana ayyi naadum.
Wa be misil da,Bani Israa'iil yakhaafo minnak wa yitaabu'u derbak fi kulla muddit hayaathum al-yi'iichuuha fi l-ard al-inta anteetha le juduudna.
Wa akuun ajnabi al-ma min cha'abak Bani Israa'iil yaji min balad ba'iide fi chaan usmak al-majiid wa gudurtak al-aziime wa iidak al-mamduuda.Wa kan al-ajnabi da yaji yigaddim salaawaatah ale l-beet da,
Wa akuun cha'abak yamurgu yamchu yihaarubu udwaanhum be l-derib al-inta tirassilhum foogah.Wa kan humman yisallu leek wa yiwajjuhu ale l-madiina al-inta azaltaha wa ale l-beet al-ana baneetah le usmak,
Wa akuun Bani Israa'iil yaznubu diddak,achaan ma fi naadum al-ma yisawwi zanib,wa inta takhdab leehum wa tisallimhum le udwaanhum wa humman yakurbuuhum masaajiin harib wa yiwadduuhum fi balad ba'iide aw gariibe.
Wa akuun min balad al-adu,al-bakaan al-humman gaa'idiin foogah masaajiin,yutuubu min zunuubhum wa yachhadook wa yuguulu-:--Aniina aznabna wa sawweena khata wa fasaala.--
Wa kan yi'tarufu be zunuubhum be kulla guluubhum wa be kulla fikirhum,min balad al-ubuudiiye al-balad al-waddoohum foogha masaajiin,wa kan humman yisallu leek wa yiwajjuhu ale baladhum al-inta anteetha le juduudhum wa ale l-madiina al-inta azaltaha wa ale l-beet al-ana baneetah le usmak,
khalaas min al-sama,al-bakaan al-inta saakin foogah,asma' salaawaathum wa du'aahum wa daafi' le huguughum wa akhfir le cha'abak al-aznabo diddak.
Wa hassa',ya Rabbi,fakkir foogi wa asma' salaati al-gaa'id niwajjihha leek min al-bakaan da.
Wa hassa' da,ya Allah al-Rabb,gumm wa ta'aal le maskanak,inta wa sanduug al-mu'aahada al-hu alaamat gudurtak.Khalli naasak rujaal al-diin yalbaso al-naja misil yalbaso khulgaanhum.Wa khalli naasak al-saalihiin yafraho be kheerhum.
Ya Allah al-Rabb,ma tikhalli al-malik al-inta masahtah wa darrajtah.Fakkir fi kulla rahmatak le abdak Dawuud.
Wa wakit Suleymaan kammal min al-sala,naar nazalat min al-sama wa akalat kulla l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa l-dahaaya al-aakhariin al-gaddamoohum.Wa majd Allah mala al-beet.
Wa rujaal al-diin ma gidro yadkhulu fi beet Allah achaan majd Allah mala al-beet.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil chaafo al-naar wa l-majd al-nazal fi l-beet wa kulluhum waga'o fi l-ard wa sajado.Wa chakaro Allah wa gaalo-:-Allah hu rahiim wa rahmatah daayme ila l-abad.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan wa kulla l-cha'ab gaddamo dahaaya le Allah.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan gaddam dahaaya katiiriin.Dabah 22-000 bagar wa 120-000 khanam.Wa be misil da,al-malik wa kulla l-cha'ab sawwo hafla wa fataho beet Allah.
Wa rujaal al-diin waagfiin fi bakaanhum wa l-Laawiyiin kamaan be aalaathum hana l-musiikha al-Dawuud sawwaahum leehum le yachkuru beehum Allah.Wa humman yachkuru be kalimaat Dawuud wa buguulu-:-Achkuru Allah achaan rahmatah daayme ila l-abad. Wa wakit chakaro Allah,rujaal al-diin yadurbu al-burunji wa kulla Bani Israa'iil waagfiin.
Wa Suleymaan khassas ust al-fadaay al-gaa'ide giddaam beet Allah achaan yigaddim foogah al-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa yiharrig foogah al-chaham hana dahaaya al-salaama.Wa da achaan al-madbah hana l-nahaas al-sawwaah Suleymaan ma gidir yichiil kulla l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa hadaaya al-dagiig wa l-chaham hana dahaaya al-salaama.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-malik Suleymaan ayyad iid muddit sab'a yoom ma'a kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa jamaa'a katiiriin jo min kulla l-balad,min hillit Labu Hamaat fi l-munchaakh lahaddi waadi Masir fi l-wati.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taamin,sawwo hafla hana kumaalit al-iid.Achaan humman fataho al-madbah le muddit sab'a yoom wa ayyado iid battaan le muddit sab'a yoom aakhariin.
