Wa fi yoom 23 hana l-chahar al-saabi',Suleymaan gaal le Bani Israa'iil khalli ayyi waahid yamchi beetah.Wa humman mabsuutiin wa farhaaniin achaan Allah sawwa al-kheer le Dawuud wa le Suleymaan wa le cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Suleymaan kammal buna hana beet Allah wa gasir al-malik wa kulla cheyy al-dawwar yisawwiih fi beet Allah wa fi gasrah halaalah.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah baan leyah be l-leel wa gaal leyah-:-Ana khibilt salaatak wa azalt al-bakaan da le yabga leyi beet al-yigaddumu leyi foogah dahaaya.
Wa akuun nisidd al-sama wa l-matara ma tusubb aw naamur al-jaraad yidammir al-balad aw ninazzil waba fi cha'abi.
Wa kan cha'abi al-yinaaduuhum be usmi yimaskunu nufuushum wa yisallu wa yiwajjuhu aleyi wa yigabbulu min deribhum al-fasil,khalaas ana Allah min al-sama nasma'hum wa nakhfir leehum zunuubhum wa na'amir baladhum.
Wa min hassa',ana gaa'id nifakkir fooghum wa nukhutt adaani wa nasma' al-sala al-yisawwuuha fi l-bakaan da.
Wa ana azalt al-beet da wa khaddastah achaan usmi yagood foogah ila l-abad.Wa nifakkir foogah daayman.
Wa inta,ya Suleymaan,kan tichiil derbi misil Dawuud abuuk chaalah wa tisawwi kulla cheyy al-ana amartak beyah wa tahfad gawaaniini wa churuuti,
khalaas ana nisabbit mulkak misil gultah le Dawuud abuuk.Ana gult leyah-:--Daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiytak al-yamluk fi Bani Israa'iil.--
Wa laakin kan inta wa cha'abak abeetu ma titabbugu gawaaniini wa la tahfado wasiiyaati al-ana amartuku beehum wa kan tamchu ta'abudu ilaahaat aakhariin wa tasjudu leehum,
khalaas ana natrudku min al-ard al-ana anteetha leeku wa niba''id minni al-beet da al-ana khaddastah le usmi.Wa be da,kulla l-chu'uub al-aakhariin yichchammato foogku wa yi'ayyuruuku.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yufuut jamb al-beet al-awwal aali da,yil'ajjab wa yuguul-:--Maala Allah sawwa misil da le l-balad di wa le l-beet da-?--
Wa yuruddu wa yuguulu leyah-:--Achaan humman abo ma yitaabu'u Allah Rabb juduudhum al-maragaahum min balad Masir.Wa humman taaba'o ilaahaat aakhariin wa sajado leehum wa abadoohum.Wa be sabab da bas,Allah nazzal fooghum kulla l-charr da.-
Fi muddit 20 sana,Suleymaan bana beet Allah wa gasir le nafsah.
Wa hu bana battaan al-hillaal al-Hiiraam antaahum leyah wa antaahum le Bani Israa'iil le yaskunu fiihum.
Wa Suleymaan macha hajam hillit Hamaat Suuba wa chaalha.
Wa battaan kula bana hillit Tadmuur al-fi l-sahara wa bana hillaal fi balad Hamaat le yabgo makhaazin.
Wa Suleymaan bana hillit Beet Huruun al-foog wa hillit Beet Huruun al-tihit wa humman dool mudun gawiyiin induhum daraadir wa biibaan wa gafala.
Wa bana hillit Ba'alat wa kulla l-hillaal al-yakhzin fooghum wa l-hillaal al-yukhutt fooghum arabaatah hana l-harib wa kheelah.Wa Suleymaan bana kulla cheyy al-yidoorah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi jibaal Lubnaan wa fi kulla mamlakatah al-hu gaa'id yahkim foogha.
Wa fi l-balad,yifaddil naas min al-Hittiyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Hiwwiyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin.Wa l-naas dool humman ma min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Bani Israa'iil ma dammaro al-naas dool kulluhum wa fi chaan da,waahidiin min zurriiyithum faddalo fi l-balad.Wa Suleymaan asta'malhum fi l-khidme al-ijbaariiye lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa Suleymaan ma anta khidmit al-ijbaariiye di le naadum waahid min Bani Israa'iil.Wa laakin hu sawwaahum askarah wa masaa'iilah wa kubaaraat arabaatah hana l-harib wa siyaad kheelah.
Wa daahu adad kubaaraat al-hukkaam hana l-malik Suleymaan.Humman 250 rujaal al-yiraakhubu al-khaddaamiin.
Wa Suleymaan hawwalaaha le bineeyit Fir'oon min madiinat Dawuud le l-beet al-hu bana leeha.Wa Suleymaan gaal-:-Marti ma tagood fi gasir Dawuud abuuyi malik Bani Israa'iil.Achaan ayyi bakaan al-sanduug Allah ga'ad foogah,al-bakaan da mukhaddas.
Wa Suleymaan gaddam dahaaya muharragiin fi l-madbah al-banaah giddaam khurfit madkhal hana beet Allah.
Wa hasab wasaaya Muusa,Suleymaan yigaddim dahaaya kulla yoom wa fi kulli yoom al-sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar.Wa battaan yigaddim dahaaya fi wakit al-a'yaad al-talaata al-kubaar fi l-sana misil iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara wa iid al-Gati' wa iid al-Lagaadiib.
Wa Suleymaan tabbag al-kharaar al-Dawuud abuuh chaalah wa hu khatta majmuu'aat rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin fi khidmithum.Al-Laawiyiin yachkuru Allah wa yisaa'udu rujaal al-diin fi khidmithum hana kulla yoom.Wa l-hurraas mugassamiin fi ayyi baab hasab majmuu'aathum.Achaan da bas al-amur hana Dawuud abd Allah.
Wa humman ma tarrafo min amur Dawuud,al-bukhuss rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa fi ayyi cheyy al-bukhuss al-maal.
Wa be misil da,Suleymaan haggag kulla l-khidme al-badaaha min yoom khatto asaas beet Allah,lahaddi yoom kammalooh.Wa beet Allah kammal tamaam.
Wa khalaas,al-malik Suleymaan macha hillit Asyuun Giibar wa hillit Ilaat wa l-hillaal dool fi khachum al-bahar hana balad Adoom.
Wa Hiiraam malik Suur rassal leyah khaddaamiinah al-ya'arfu al-bahar adiil wa l-sufun kula.Wa l-khaddaamiin dool saafaro sawa ma'a khaddaamiin Suleymaan le balad Ufiir.Wa jaabo min hinaak dahab ziyaada min 15-000 kiilo le l-malik Suleymaan.
Wa malikat balad Saba sim'at be l-kalaam al-gaa'idiin yihajjuuh fi Suleymaan.Wa hi jaat fi Madiinat al-Khudusbe naas katiiriin wa jumaal chaayliin itir wa dahab katiir wa hujaar khaaliyiin.Jaat le tijarribah le Suleymaan be gaddimiin su'aalaat gaasiyiin.Wa wakit wassalat bakaan Suleymaan,hi hajjat leyah be kulla cheyy al-indaha fi galibha.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan radda leeha fi kulla l-su'aalaat al-gaddamathum leyah.Wa ma fi su'aal waahid al-bigi leyah gaasi al-ma gidir radda foogah.
Wa malikat balad Saba chaafat hikmat Suleymaan wa l-gasir al-hu banaah
wa l-akil al-fi raas tarabeeztah wa l-maskan hana masaa'iilah wa nizaam khidmithum wa l-lubaas hana l-naas al-yantu al-akil wa l-charaab wa l-ataba al-yatla'o beeha le beet Allah.Wa hi al'ajjabat bilheen wa ma gidrat tuguul cheyy.
Wa khalaas,gaalat le l-malik-:-Al-cheyy al-simi'tah min baladi al-bukhuss kalaamak wa hikmatak da sahiih.
Wa ana ma saddagt be l-kalaam al-gaalooh foogak illa ba'ad jiit wa chiftah be eeni.Wa daahu nuss hikmatak kula ma khabbarooni beyah-!Hikmatak ziyaada min kulla cheyy al-ana simi'tah.
Mabruuk le naasak wa le masaa'iilak al-daayman gaa'idiin ma'aak wa yasma'o hikmatak.
Baarak Allah Ilaahak al-ridi beek wa khattaak malik fi kursiih le takhdim le Allah Ilaahak.Wa Ilaahak sawwa misil da achaan hu yihibb Bani Israa'iil wa yidoor humman yagoodu ila l-abad.Wa fi chaan da bas,hu khattaak malik fooghum le tahkim be l-hagg wa l-adaala.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malika hana balad Saba antat le l-malik ziyaada min 4-000 kiilo hana dahab wa itir katiir wa hujaar khaaliyiin kula.Wa abadan ma fi itir ziyaada min al-itir al-jaabatah al-malika hana Saba le l-malik Suleymaan.
Wa ziyaada min da,khaddaamiin Hiiraam wa khaddaamiin Suleymaan al-gaa'idiin yijiibu dahab min Ufiir jaabo hatab al-sandal wa hujaar khaaliyiin kula.
Wa be hatab al-sandal da,al-malik sawwa khachab le beet Allah wa le gasrah hu kula.Wa sawwa beyah jigindiiye wa amsibeybe le l-khannaayiin.Wa gubbaal da,abadan ma chaafo cheyy misil da fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan antaaha le malikat balad Saba kulla cheyy al-hi dawwaratah wa talabatah minnah.Wa da,ziyaada min al-cheyy al-hi jaabatah le l-malik.Wa ba'ad da,al-malika gabbalat baladha ma'a masaa'iilha.
Wa wazin al-dahab al-yijiibuuh le Suleymaan fi kulli sana yisaawi ziyaada min 22-000 kiilo.
Wa da bala l-maal al-yalgaah min al-naggaaliin wa l-tujjaar.Wa kulla muluuk al-Arab wa hukkaam al-balad yijiibu dahab wa fudda le Suleymaan.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan dagga 200 darag kubaar hana dahab wa ayyi waahide wazinha yisaawi 850 jineeh.
Wa dagga battaan 300 darag dugaag hana dahab wa ayyi waahide wazinha yisaawi 400 jineeh.Wa l-malik khattaahum fi beetah al-sammooh Khaabat Lubnaan.
Wa l-kursi da,indah sitte ataba hana dahab al-yatla'o beehum wa ga''aada hana dahab giddaam al-kursi.Wa l-kursi zaatah,sawwo leyah iideen be jaay wa jaay.Wa sana'o timsaal hana diidaan itneen wa khattoohum be nuss al-zeene wa nuss al-isra le l-kursi.
Wa kulla l-kiisaan al-yachrab beehum al-malik Suleymaan,humman hana dahab wa kulla l-mu'iddaat al-fi beet Khaabat Lubnaan sawwoohum min dahab saafi.Wa cheyy al-sawwooh be fudda ke ma fi achaan fi wakit Suleymaan,al-fudda ma indaha khiima.
Wa l-malik Suleymaan indah sufun kubaar al-yamchu ba'iid le l-tijaara ma'a khaddaamiin hana l-malik Hiiraam.Wa fi ayyi talaata sana,al-sufun dool yigabbulu machhuuniin be dahab wa fudda wa aaj wa tuguula wa taawuus.
Wa kulla muluuk al-ard yidooru yigaabulu Suleymaan achaan yasma'o min hikmatah al-antaaha leyah al-Rabb fi galbah.
Wa ayyi sana,al-naas dool yijiibu leyah hadaaya.Yijiibu leyah mu'iddaat hana fudda wa dahab wa khulgaan wa silaah wa itir wa kheel wa bikhaal.
Wa Suleymaan indah 4-000 chaaye le l-kheel wa 4-000 arabaat wa 12-000 siyaad kheel.Wa hu khatta waahidiin fi l-hillaal al-yukhutt fooghum arabaatah wa l-aakhariin kamaan khallaahum ma'aayah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Suleymaan hakam fi kulla l-muluuk min bahar al-Furaat lahaddi balad al-Filistiyiin lahaddi huduud balad Masir.
Wa kheel al-malik Suleymaan gaa'idiin yijiibuuhum leyah min Masir wa min kulla l-buldaan al-aakhariin.
Wa l-baagi min amal Suleymaan min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya maktuub fi l-kutub al-binaaduuhum A'maal al-nabi Naataan wa Kalaam al-nabi Akhiiya al-min hillit Chiilooh wa Ru'yat al-nabi Ya'du,al-yihajji be Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat.
Wa ba'ad da,Suleymaan maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud abuuh.Wa wileedah Rahab'aam hakam fi badalah.
Wa wakit Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat simi' al-khabar da,hu lissaa' gaa'id fi Masir al-bakaan al-awwal hu arrad min al-malik Suleymaan.Wa gabbal min Masir.
Wa rassalo naadooh le Yaruba'aam wa hu ja.Wa hu ma'a kulla Bani Israa'iil gammo hajjo le Rahab'aam wa gaalo leyah-:
Abuuk sawwaana misil abiid wa khatta foogna khidme gaasiye misil daami tagiil fi ragabatna.Wa hassa',nidooru minnak inta tikhaffif leena tagalat al-daami al-abuuk khattaah foogna wa aniina nakhdumu tihtak.
Wa Rahab'aam gaal leehum-:-Gabbulu wa ba'ad talaata yoom ta'aalu leyi. Wa khalaas,al-cha'ab gabbalo buyuuthum.
Wa l-chuyuukh raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Kan inta tabga zeen ma'a l-cha'ab wa tarda be kalaamhum wa turudd leehum be kalaam halu,khalaas humman yakhdumu daayman tihtak.
Wa laakin Rahab'aam aba wasiiyat al-chuyuukh al-antooha leyah.Wa hu chaawar al-subyaan al-kibro ma'aayah sawa wa gaa'idiin yakhdumu leyah.
Wa l-subyaan al-kibro ma'aayah gaalo-:-Al-cha'ab yachku kadar abuuk khatta fooghum daami tagiil wa yidooru inta tikhaffifah leehum.Wa daahu al-kalaam al-tuguulah leehum-:--Usba'i al-sakhayyar da kabiir min sulub abuuyi.
Sahiih abuuyi khatta foogku daami tagiil wa laakin hassa' da,ana niziid foogku tagala aakhara-!Abuuyi jaladaaku be soot hana farwa wa laakin ana najlidku be soot al-indah hadiid misil danab al-agrab.-
Wa l-malik Rahab'aam aba wasiiyat al-chuyuukh wa hajja le l-cha'ab be kalaam gawi.
Wa radda leehum hasab wasiiyat al-subyaan wa gaal leehum-:-Abuuyi khatta foogku daami tagiil wa hassa' ana niziid foogku tagala aakhara.Abuuyi jaladaaku be soot hana farwa laakin ana najlidku be soot al-indah hadiid misil danab al-agrab.
Wa l-malik ma simi' kalaam al-cha'ab.Wa da jaayi min al-Rabb achaan Allah dawwar yihaggig kalaamah al-gaalah le Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat be waasitat al-nabi Akhiiya al-min hillit Chiilooh.
Wa wakit kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil chaafo kadar al-malik ma simi' kalaamhum da,gaalo leyah-:-Chunu al-yilimmina ma'a zurriiyit Dawuud-?Aniina ma indina warasa ma'a iyaal Yassa-!Yalla,ya gabaayil Israa'iil,khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah-!Wa hassa' da,ya zurriiyit Dawuud,himmu be nufuusku. Wa khalaas,kulla Bani Israa'iil chatto wa gabbalo buyuuthum.
Wa l-malik Rahab'aam rassal Aduraam muraakhib hana l-khidme al-ijbaariiye le gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-saakniin fi munchaakh al-balad.Laakin humman dool lammo foogah wa rajamooh wa maat.Wa l-malik Rahab'aam zaatah yalla yalla rikib fi arabatah wa arrad macha Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa wakit Rahab'aam wassal Madiinat al-Khudus,lamma gabiilat Yahuuza wa gabiilat Banyaamiin wa azal minhum 180-000 rujaal muhaaribiin le yamchu yihaarubu gabaayil Israa'iil fi l-munchaakh wa yigabbulu al-muluk battaan le Rahab'aam.
Wa laakin Allah hajja le l-nabi Chama'ya wa gaal leyah-:
Hajji le Rahab'aam wileed Suleymaan malik Bani Yahuuza wa le kulla Bani Israa'iil al-gaa'idiin fi hillaal Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin.Wa guul leehum-:
--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ma tamchu tihaarubu akhwaanku-!Khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil beetah achaan ana bas assast al-barjala di."-- Wa be da,khalaas humman sim'o kalaam Allah wa gabbalo ma macho le yihaarubu Yaruba'aam.
Wa Rahab'aam sakan fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa gawwa mudun katiiriin fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa humman mudun Beet Laham wa Itaam wa Takhuu'a
wa Beet Suur wa Suuku wa Adullaam
wa Gaat wa Mariicha wa Ziif
wa Aduraayim wa Lakiich wa Aziikha
wa Saar'a wa Ayyaluun wa Hibruun.Dool al-mudun al-gawiyiin hana manaatig Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin.
Wa Rahab'aam hawwagaahum le l-mudun dool be daraadir gawiyiin.Wa khatta fooghum hukkaam wa sawwa makhaazin hana ma'aach wa dihin wa khamar.
Wa fi ayyi waahide min al-mudun dool,fi darag kubaar wa huraab.Wa gawwaahum le l-mudun dool be ziyaada achaan manaatig Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin gaa'idiin tihit hukmah.
Wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin jo min ayyi mantaga fi kulla balad Israa'iil wa andammo le Rahab'aam.
Wa l-Laawiyiin khallo kulla bakaanhum hana l-sarha wa ard warasathum fi l-munchaakh wa macho le balad Yahuuza wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan Yaruba'aam wa iyaalah daharoohum ma yisawwu khidmit rujaal al-diin le Allah.
Wa laakin Yaruba'aam darraj leyah rujaal diin aakhariin al-yakhdumu fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam hana l-tuyuus wa l-ajjaal al-hu sawwaahum.
Wa naas min kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-induhum galib waahid le yitaabu'u Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,jo fi Madiinat al-Khudus le yigaddumu dahaaya le Allah Rabb juduudhum.
Wa be misil da,humman gawwo mamlakat Yahuuza wa saa'ado Rahab'aam wileed Suleymaan.Wa humman gaa'id yitaabu'u derib Dawuud wa Suleymaan muddit talaata sana.
Wa Rahab'aam akhad Mahla bineeyit Yarimuut wileed Dawuud.Wa ammaha Abihaayil bineeyit Aliyaab wileed Yassa.
Wa Mahla jaabat leyah awlaad wa humman Ya'uuch wa Chamarya wa Zaham.
Wa ba'adha,akhad Ma'aaka bineeyit Abchaluum.Wa hi jaabat leyah Abiiya wa Attaay wa Ziiza wa Chaluumit.
Wa Rahab'aam indah 18 awiin wa 60 sirriiyaat wa wilid 28 wulaad wa 60 banaat wa laakin habbaaha le Ma'aaka bineeyit Abchaluum ziyaada min kulla awiinah wa sirriiyaatah.
Wa Rahab'aam kabbar Abiiya wileedha le Ma'aaka fi kulla akhwaanah achaan hu yidoor yisawwiih malik ba'adah.
Wa Rahab'aam bigi faahim wa chattat awlaadah fi kulla l-mudun al-gawiyiin fi balad Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin.Wa antaahum ma'aach katiir wa akhad leehum awiin katiiraat.
Wa wakit mamlakat Rahab'aam sabatat wa bigat gawiiye,hu wa kulla Bani Israa'iil khallo minhum Tawraat Allah.
Wa fi l-sana al-khaamse hana hukum Rahab'aam,Chiichakh malik Masir gamma ja haarab Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa da,achaan humman iso Allah.
Wa Chiichakh ja ma'a 1-200 arabaat hana harib wa 60-000 siyaad kheel wa askar katiiriin marra waahid min Masir,humman al-Liibiyiin wa l-Sukkiyiin wa l-Habachiyiin.
Wa hu chaal al-mudun al-gawiyiin hana mamlakat Yahuuza wa wassal lahaddi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa wakit Chiichakh garrab le Madiinat al-Khudus,al-nabi Chama'ya ja le Rahab'aam wa le kubaaraat mamlakat Yahuuza al-lammo fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa gaal leehum-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Intu abeetuuni wa hassa' ana kula naabaaku wa nisallimku fi iid Chiichakh.-
Wa kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil wa l-malik almaskano wa gaalo-:-Allah saadikh wa l-cheyy al-gaa'id yisawwi da adiil.
Wa wakit Allah chaaf kadar humman almaskano,hu hajja le Chama'ya wa gaal-:-Min humman maskano nufuushum giddaami da khalaas,ana ma nidammirhum.Wa laakin fi wakit gariib,ana ninajjiihum wa khadabi ma yanzil fi Madiinat al-Khudus be iid Chiichakh.
Wa be da kula,humman yabgo abiidah wa ya'arfu al-faraga ambeen khidimti ana wa khidmit muluuk al-ard.
Wa Chiichakh malik balad Masir hajam Madiinat al-Khudus wa chaal kulla l-khuna al-fi beet Allah wa gasir al-malik.Hu chaal kulla cheyy,khaassatan al-darag hana l-dahab al-Suleymaan sawwaahum.
Wa kan al-malik yamchi beet Allah,al-hurraas yichiilu al-darag dool wa ba'adeen yigabbuluuhum fi beet al-hurraas.
Wakit al-malik maskan nafsah,Allah ma nazzal foogah khadabah le yidammirah marra waahid.Achaan fi achya adiiliin fi lubb mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Rahab'aam indah 41 sana wakit bigi malik.Wa l-malik Rahab'aam sabbat mulkah wa hakam 17 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus al-madiina al-azalaaha Allah min kulla mudun gabaayil Bani Israa'iil achaan yukhutt foogha usmah.Wa amm Rahab'aam usumha Na'ama min gabiilat Bani Ammuun.
Wa Rahab'aam sawwa al-fasaala achaan hu ma sabbat galbah le yitaabi' Allah.
Wa kulla amal Rahab'aam min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya maktuub wa musajjal fi kutub al-anbiya Chama'ya wa Iddu.Wa daayman bigi harib ambeen Rahab'aam wa Yaruba'aam.
Wa Rahab'aam maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur hana madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Abiiya hakam fi badalah.
Fi sanit 18 hana hukum Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat fi mamlakat Israa'iil,Abiiya bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa hu hakam talaata sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Mikaaya bineeyit Uriyiil min hillit Gibee'a.Wa kaan harib ambeen Abiiya wa Yaruba'aam.
Wa Abiiya bada al-harba be deech adadah 400-000 askar furraas min ahsan al-muhaaribiin.Wa Yaruba'aam kamaan gaabalah be rujaal furraas min ahsan muhaaribiinah wa adadhum 800-000.
Wa Abiiya tala' fi raas jabal Samaraayim al-fi jibaal Afraayim wa gaal-:-Asma'ni,ya Yaruba'aam-!Wa asma'ooni,ya kulla naas mamlakat Israa'iil-!
Intu ma ta'arfu kadar Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil anta muluk Bani Israa'iil le Dawuud wa iyaalah ila l-abad walla-?Wa di ma mu'aahada daayme al-ma tingati' walla-?
Wa laakin Yaruba'aam wileed Nabaat hu awwal abid Suleymaan wileed Dawuud wa gamma atmarrad didd siidah.
Wa ba'ad da,lammo ma'aayah naas al-kaslaaniin wa l-ma naaf'iin wa humman gammo didd Rahab'aam wileed Suleymaan.Wa fi l-wakit da,Rahab'aam lissaa' sabi ma indah gudra.Wa be da,hu ma gidir yasbit giddaamhum.
Wa Abiiya gaal battaan-:-Hassa' da,intu tuguulu intu gawiyiin wa tichiilu muluk Allah al-fi iid zurriiyit Dawuud.Wa intu naas katiiriin marra waahid wa induku ma'aaku ajjaal hana dahab al-sawwaahum leeku Yaruba'aam misil ilaahaatku.
Wa ma intu bas al-taradtu rujaal al-diin hana Allah wa dool min zurriiyit Haaruun wa l-Laawiyiin-?Wa darrajtu leeku rujaal diin aakhariin misil naas gaa'idiin yisawwu fi buldaan aakhariin-?Wa ayyi naadum al-yaji be toor wa sab'a kubchaan,khalaas hu yabga raajil diin hana asnaam dool wa humman ma ilaahaat.
Wa kan leena aniina kamaan,ma abeena Allah Ilaahna.Wa rujaal al-diin al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu le Allah,humman min zurriiyit Haaruun.Wa l-Laawiyiin kula gaa'idiin yisawwu khidmithum.
Fi kulli fajur wa achiiye,yiharrugu dahaaya wa bakhuur mu'attar le Allah wa yigaddumu al-khubza fi l-tarabeeza al-taahire.Wa kulli achiiye yi'oogudu niiraan al-faanuus al-min dahab.Achaan aniina gaa'idiin nahfado khidmit Allah Ilaahna al-intu abeetuuh.
Chiifu-!Allah wa rujaal al-diin hineeyah gaa'idiin ma'aana wa indina al-burunji al-nadurbuuh le harakat al-harib didduku.Ya naas mamlakat Israa'iil,ma tihaarubu Allah Rabb juduudku achaan intu ma tanjaho-!
Wa wakit Abiiya gaa'id yihajji,Yaruba'aam rassal askarah wa hawwagoohum wa karaso le askar mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa khalaas,askar mamlakat Israa'iil hajamo askar mamlakat Yahuuza be giddaam wa l-askar al-karaso leehum kamaan be wara.
Wa wakit askar mamlakat Yahuuza anlafato waraahum,chaafo kadar hajamoohum min giddaam wa min wara.Wa khalaas,humman koorako le Allah.Wa wakit rujaal al-diin darabo al-burunji,
askar mamlakat Yahuuza koorako wa wakit humman koorako,al-Rabb haarab Yaruba'aam wa kulla askar mamlakat Israa'iil giddaam Abiiya wa askar mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa askar mamlakat Israa'iil arrado giddaam askar mamlakat Yahuuza wa l-Rabb sallamaahum fi iid askar mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Abiiya wa naasah annasaro fooghum nasur kabiir wa 500-000 raajil min ahsan al-muhaaribiin hana mamlakat Israa'iil maato.
Wa fi l-wakit da,askar mamlakat Israa'iil anhazamo.Wa askar mamlakat Yahuuza kamaan annasaro achaan humman atwakkalo ale Allah Rabb juduudhum.
Wa Abiiya tarad Yaruba'aam lahaddi gala' minnah madiinat Beet Iil wa madiinat Yachaana wa madiinat Afruun wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum.
Wa fi kulla wakit hukum Abiiya,Yaruba'aam ma ligi battaan gudra misil awwal.Wa Allah darab Yaruba'aam wa hu maat.
Wa Abiiya kamaan bigi chadiid.Hu akhad 14 awiin wa wilid 22 wulaad wa 16 banaat.
Wa l-baagi min amal Abiiya wa l-cheyy al-sawwaah wa kalaamah maktuubiin fi kitaab al-taariikh al-katabah al-nabi Iddu.
Wa Abiiya maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Aasa hakam fi badalah.Wa fi wakit hukmah,al-balad gaa'ide fi raaha le muddit achara sana.
Wa Aasa sawwa al-zeen wa l-adiil giddaam Allah Ilaahah.
Hu haddam al-madaabih hana l-ilaahaat al-aakhariin wa l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa rama al-hujaar al-khazzoohum wa kassar al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira.
Wa Aasa amar naas mamlakat Yahuuza le yitaabu'u Allah Rabb juduudhum wa yitabbugu wasaaya Allah wa gawaaniinah.
Wa hu haddam al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa l-bakaanaat al-yiharrugu fooghum al-bakhuur fi kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza.Wa fi wakit hukmah,al-mamlaka gaa'ide be l-salaama.
Wa hu bana mudun gawiyiin fi balad Yahuuza achaan fi l-wakit da,al-balad gaa'ide fi raaha.Wa fi l-siniin dool,ma kaan harib diddah achaan Allah antaah al-raaha.
Wa Aasa gaal le naas mamlakat Yahuuza-:-Khalli nabnu al-mudun dool wa nihawwuguuhum be durdur wa buyuut tuwaal hana muraakhaba wa biibaan be hawaadirhum,al-balad gaa'ide fi l-raaha fi iideenah da,achaan aniina taaba'na Allah Ilaahna.Aywa,aniina taaba'naah wa hu antaana al-raaha min kulli jiihe. Wa humman najaho fi bunaahum.
Wa Aasa indah 300-000 askar min gabiilat Yahuuza chaayliin darag kubaar wa huraab wa 280-000 askar min gabiilat Banyaamiin chaayliin darag dugaag wa nachaachiib.Wa kulluhum rujaal furraas.
Wa yoom waahid,Zaarah al-min balad al-Habacha ja be malyuun askar wa 300 arabaat harib wa hajamhum.Wa wassal lahaddi madiinat Mariicha.
Wa Aasa marag leyah wa rasso le l-harib fi waadi Safaata gariib le madiinat Mariicha.
Wa Aasa sa'al Allah Ilaahah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah,balaak inta ma fi naadum al-yagdar yafza' al-gaadir wa l-da'iif.Afza'na,ya Allah Ilaahna,achaan aniina mutawakkiliin aleek inta-!Wa be usmak inta bas,aniina jiina nigaabulu al-malaayiin dool.Ya Allah,inta Ilaahna.Ma tikhalli al-insaan yinnasir foogak-!
Wa Allah haarab al-Habachiyiin wa humman arrado giddaam Aasa wa askar mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Aasa wa askarah taradoohum lahaddi hillit Garaar wa kataloohum wa waahid kula min al-Habachiyiin ma faddal.Achaan askarhum addammaro giddaam Allah wa giddaam cha'abah.Wa askar mamlakat Yahuuza chaalo khaniime katiire.
Wa humman chaalo kulla l-hillaal al-hawaale Garaar achaan khoof Allah karabaahum.Wa askar mamlakat Yahuuza nahabo al-hillaal dool wa chaalo minhum khaniime katiire.
Wa humman hajamo zaraayib al-bahaayim wa chaalo khanam wa jumaal katiiriin.Wa ba'ad da,gabbalo Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal fi Azarya wileed Udeed.
Wa macha bakaan Aasa wa gaal leyah-:-Asma'ooni,ya Aasa wa naas gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin.Allah ma'aaku kan intu ma'aayah.Wa kan intu tifattuchuuh,hu yikhalliiku talgooh.Wa laakin kan intu taabooh,hu kula yaabaaku.
Wa fi mudda tawiile,Bani Israa'iil aacho bala l-Ilaah al-sahiih wa bala rujaal diin al-yi'allumuuhum wa bala wasaaya Allah.
Wa laakin fi diigithum,humman gabbalo le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Humman fattachooh wa hu khallaahum yalgooh.
Wa fi l-wakit da,ma fi amin le l-naas al-maachiin wa l-jaayiin achaan fi l-wakit da,fi barjaal kabiir ambeen sukkaan kulla l-buldaan dool.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan,gaa'idiin yiddammaro ambeenaathum.Umma tugumm didd umma aakhara wa hille tugumm didd hille aakhara achaan al-Rabb nazzal fooghum kulla nafar hana ta'ab.
Wa laakin intu,abgo chudaad wa ma taksalo achaan amalku da,indah ajur.
Wa wakit Aasa simi' kalaam al-tanabbu hana l-nabi Udeed,hu gamma be chidde wa dammar al-muharramaat min kulla balad Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa kulla l-hillaal al-chaaloohum fi jibaal Afraayim.Wa hu jaddad madbah Allah al-gaa'id giddaam beet Allah.
Wa lamma kulla naas gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa kulla l-naas al-min gabiilat Afraayim wa Manassa wa Chim'uun al-jo ga'ado ma'aahum.Wa katiiriin min mamlakat Israa'iil andammo le Aasa achaan humman chaafo kadar Allah Ilaahah gaa'id ma'aayah.
Wa humman lammo fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi l-chahar al-taalit fi sanit 15 hana hukum Aasa.
Wa fi l-yoom da,humman gaddamo 700 bagar wa 7-000 khanam dahaaya le Allah min al-khaniime al-chaalooha.
Wa humman sawwo mu'aahada le yitaabu'u Allah Rabb juduudhum be kulla guluubhum wa be kulla fikirhum.
Wa chart al-mu'aahada da yuguul kadar ayyi naadum al-ma yitaabi' Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,yaktuluuh kan sakhiir walla kabiir,kan mara walla raajil.
Wa humman sawwo al-mu'aahada di be haliife.Halafo be Allah be zakhraat wa hiss al-burunji wa daribiin al-buug.
Wa kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza firho be l-haliife al-sawwooha be kulla guluubhum wa be niiyithum al-waahide le yifattuchu Allah.Wa hu khallaahum yalgooh.Wa hu antaahum al-raaha min kulli jiihe.
Wa l-malik Aasa marag hatta jidditah Ma'aaka min darajatha hana l-meeram achaan hi sana'at sanam muharram le l-ilaaha Achiira.Wa Aasa kassar al-sanam al-muharram da wa rihikah wa harragah fi waadi Khidruun.
Wa laakin be da kula,al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam gaa'idiin fi balad Israa'iil.Wa fi kulla muddit hayaatah,Aasa gaa'id yitaabi' Allah be galib mukhlis.
Wa hu jaab fi beet Allah al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-mu'iddaat al-abuuh wa hu zaatah khassasoohum.
Wa battaan harib ke ma bigi lahaddi sanit 35 hana hukum Aasa.
Wa fi sanit 36 hana hukum Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Ba'aacha malik mamlakat Israa'iil gamma yihaarib mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa gawwa hillit al-Raama le yadhar al-derib le Aasa wa naasah ma yamurgu wa la yadkhulu be l-derib da.
Wa khalaas Aasa chaal min al-fudda wa l-dahab al-gaa'idiin fi makhaazin hana beet Allah wa gasir al-malik wa rassalaahum le Banhadaad malik balad Araam al-gaa'id fi madiinat Dimachkh.Wa rassal leyah wa gaal-:
Khalli nisawwu alaakha beeni wa beenak misil al-alaakha al-bigat ambeen abuuyi wa abuuk.Daahu nirassil leek fudda wa dahab wa natlub minnak tagta' alaakhtak ma'a Ba'aacha malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa be da,yiwaggif al-harba al-gamma beeha diddi.
Wa Banhadaad khassad be kalaam al-malik Aasa.Wa khalaas,hu rassal khuyyaad askarah wa hajamo hillaal mamlakat Israa'iil wa chaalo Iyuun wa Daan wa Abil Maayim wa kulla l-makhaazin hana hillaal gabiilat Naftaali.
Wa min Ba'aacha simi' be l-khabar da,khalla minnah gawiyiin hillit al-Raama.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,al-malik Aasa lamma kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza le yangulu al-hajar wa l-hatab al-Ba'aacha lammaahum le yigawwi beehum hillit al-Raama.Wa hu asta'mal al-hajar wa l-hatab dool le yigawwi beehum hillit Gaba' wa hillit Misfa.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-nabi Hanaani ja le Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa gaal leyah-:-Inta atwakkal ale malik Araam wa ma atwakkal ale Allah Ilaahak wa be l-sabab da,askar balad Araam marago min iidak.
Al-Liibiyiin wa l-Habachiyiin humman askar chudaad wa jo be arabaat al-harib wa siyaad kheel katiiriin marra waahid.Wa be da kula,Allah sallamaahum leek fi iidak wakit inta atwakkalt aleyah.
Achaan Allah gaa'id yiraakhib fi l-ard le yisaa'id al-naas al-yitaabu'uuh be galib mukhlis.Wa inta sawweet amal ma yanfa' wa be sabab da,min al-yoom inta tiwaajih al-harib.
Wa Aasa zi'il fi l-nabi wa gayyadah fi l-sijin wa hu khidib ziyaada be sabab al-kalaam da.Wa fi l-wakit da,hu gamma yita''ib waahidiin min al-cha'ab kula.
Wa daahu kulla amal Aasa min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya maktuub fi kitaab muluuk Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi sanit 39 hana hukmah,Aasa mirid wa karabah marad chadiid fi rijileenah.Wa wakit hu mardaan,ma fattach al-chifa min Allah laakin hu fattach al-dakaatiir le yi'aalujuuh.
Wa Aasa maat wa lihig abbahaatah fi sanit 41 hana hukmah.
Wa dafanooh fi l-khabur al-nakatah le nafsah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa khatto janaaztah fi sariir al-sabbo foogah riihe wa itir al-khalbatooh naas al-mutakhassisiin.Wa humman harrago leyah riihe katiire le yicharrufuuh.
Wa Yahuuchafat wileed Aasa hakam fi badal abuuh.Wa hu gawwa mamlakatah didd mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa Yahuuchafat khatta askar fi kulla l-mudun al-gawiyiin hana mamlakat Yahuuza wa mu'askaraat fi kulla balad Yahuuza wa fi hillaal Afraayim al-chaalaahum abuuh Aasa.
Wa Allah kaan ma'a Yahuuchafat achaan hu chaal al-derib al-adiil hana jiddah Dawuud.Hu ma taaba' derib hana ilaah Ba'al.
Wa laakin hu taaba' derib Allah Rabb juduudah wa tabbag wasiiyaatah wa ma sawwa misil Bani Israa'iil sawwooh.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah sabbat muluk Yahuuchafat wa kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza gaa'idiin yigaddumu leyah hadaaya le l-malik.Wa bigi khani marra waahid wa indah charaf katiir.
Wa hu gaa'id yichiil derib Allah be kulla galbah lahaddi haddam al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa l-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira al-fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukmah,Yahuuchafat rassal kubaaraatah Banhaayil wa Ubadya wa Zakariiya wa Nataniil wa Mikaaya le yi'allumu sukkaan hillaal balad Yahuuza.
Wa macho ma'aahum Laawiyiin wa humman Chama'ya wa Natanya wa Zabadya wa Asaahiil wa Chamiiramuut wa Yuunataan wa Aduniiya wa Tuubiiya wa Toob Aduniiya.Wa macho ma'aahum rujaal diin Alichama' wa Yahuuraam.
Wa chaalo ma'aahum kitaab Tawraat Allah wa macho fi kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza le yi'allumu al-cha'ab.
Wa khoof Allah karab kulla mamaalik al-buldaan al-muhawwigiin balad Yahuuza wa waahid minhum kula ma gidir yihaarib Yahuuchafat.
Wa l-Filistiyiin jaabo le Yahuuchafat hadaaya hana fudda.Wa l-Arab kula jaabo leyah 7-700 kubchaan wa 7-700 tuyuus.
Wa Yahuuchafat bigi chadiid ziyaada.Hu bana mudun gawiyiin fi balad Yahuuza wa hillaal al-yabgo leyah makhaazin.
Wa damma ma'aach katiir fi hillaal balad Yahuuza.Wa rujaal muhaaribiin wa furraas gaa'idiin fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa daahu al-rujaal mugassamiin ale majmuu'aat aayilaathum.Min gabiilat Yahuuza,khaayid fi aalaaf hu Adnawa hu khaayid fi 300-000 raajil faaris
wa ma'aayah Yuuhanaanwa hu khaayid fi 280-000 askar
wa ma'aayah Amasya wileed Zikrihu al-be niiytah dawwar yakhdim le Allahwa hu khaayid fi 200-000 raajil faaris.
Min gabiilat Banyaamiin,Aliyaada' raajil faariswa hu khaayid fi 200-000 askarmusallahiin be nuchchaab wa darag
wa ma'aayah Yahuzabaadwa hu khaayid fi 180-000 askar musallahiin.
Wa kulla l-askar dool gaa'idiin yakhdumu le l-malik fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa da bala l-askar al-aakhariin al-khattaahum al-malik fi l-mudun al-gawiyiin hana kulla balad Yahuuza.
Wa Yahuuchafat bigi khani marra waahid wa indah charaf.Wa macha anrabat be waasitat al-akhiide ma'a Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad siniin,Yahuuchafat macha le Akhaab fi l-Saamira.Wa Akhaab dabah leyah hu wa naasah al-ma'aayah khanam wa bagar be katara.Wa harrachah achaan yamchu yahjumu hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad.
Wa Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza-:-Hal inta kula tamchi ma'aayi le nahjumu hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad walla-? Wa Yahuuchafat radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa,ana wa inta kullina sawa wa cha'abi misil cha'abak.Kullina namchu nidaawusu sawa.
Wa laakin Yahuuchafat gaal battaan le malik mamlakat Israa'iil-:-Hassa' da,min fadlak amchi as'al Allah gabul.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil lamma anbiya hineeyah wa adadhum 400 raajil wa gaal leehum-:-Hal namchu nahjumu hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad walla ma namchu-? Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Amchi-!Al-Rabb yisallimha leek fi iidak,ya l-malik-!
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Fiyah naadum waahid al-yagdar yas'al leena Allah.Wa laakin ana nakrahah achaan hu ma yitnabba' beyi be l-kheer laakin daayman yitnabba' beyi be l-fasaala.Wa l-naadum da,hu Miika wileed Yimla. Wa Yahuuchafat gaal-:-Khalli al-malik ma yihajji kalaam misil da-!
Wa khalaas,al-malik naada waahid min khaddaamiinah wa gaal leyah-:-Amchi ajala naadiih le Miika wileed Yimla.
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza ayyi waahid laabis khalagah hana l-muluk wa ga'ado fi karaasiihum fi l-madagg jamb khachum baab madiinat al-Saamira.Wa kulla l-anbiya gaa'idiin yitnabba'o giddaamhum.
Wa waahid min al-anbiya dool usmah Sidkhiiya wileed Kan'aana.Hu sawwa leyah guruun hana hadiid wa gaal-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Be l-guruun dool tadrub al-Araamiyiin lahaddi tidammirhum.-
Wa kulla l-anbiya yitnabba'o be nafs al-kalaam wa gaalo-:-Amchi ahjim hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad wa inta tanjah wa Allah yisallimha leek fi iidak,ya l-malik-!
Wa l-mursaal al-macha yinaadiih le Miika gaal leyah-:-Daahu kulla l-anbiya kalaamhum waahid wa yihajju be l-kheer le l-malik.Hassa' da,khalli kalaamak inta kula yabga sawa ma'a kalaamhum.Inta kula hajji be l-kheer.
Wa laakin Miika gaal leyah-:-Nahlif be Allah al-Hayy kadar illa l-kalaam al-gaalah leyi Ilaahi,da bas nuguulah.
Wa wakit wassal bakaan al-malik Akhaab,hu gaal leyah-:-Ya Miika,hal namchu nahjumu hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad walla ma namchu-? Wa Miika radda leyah wa gaal-:-Amchu-!Intu tanjaho wa Allah yisallimhum leeku fi iideeku-!
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Ana ma gult leek kadar al-naadum da ma yitnabba' leyi be l-kheer laakin yitnabba' leyi be l-charr bas-!
Wa khalaas,Miika gaal leyah-:-Hassa' da,asma'o kalaam Allah-!Ana chift Allah gaa'id fi archah wa kulla khuwwaat al-sama waagfiin jambah be nussah al-zeenaay wa l-israay.
Wa Allah sa'alaahum wa gaal-:--Yaatu yagdar yukhuchch Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil le yamchi yahjim hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad wa yumuut hinaak-?- Wa ayyi waahid yihajji kalaam chig.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,ruuh waahid ja giddaam Allah wa gaal-:--Ana bas nukhuchchah.- Wa Allah gaal leyah-:--Be tariiga al-weeni-?--
Wa l-ruuh gaal-:--Ana namchi wa nabga ruuh al-kaddaab fi khuchuum kulla anbiya al-malik.- Wa Allah gaal leyah-:--Akiid,misil ke tagdar tukhuchchah wa tanjah.Amchi wa sawwi misil inta gultah.-
Wa Miika gaal-:-Daahu Allah bas rassal ruuh al-kaddaab fi khuchuum anbiyaak wa hu bas kharrar yirassil leek al-charr da.
Wa tawwaali fi l-bakaan da,Sidkhiiya wileed Kan'aana garrab le Miika wa chaddagah wa gaal leyah-:-Kikkeef Ruuh Allah marag minni wa hajja leek-?
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal-:-Akurbuuh le Miika wa gabbuluuh bakaan Aamuun haakim al-madiina wa Yuwaach wileed al-malik.
Wa guulu leehum-:--Daahu kalaam al-malik hu gaal-:"Dissu al-naadum da fi l-sijin wa antuuh khubza wa almi chiyya chiyya bas lahaddi ana nigabbil be l-sihha wa l-salaama."-
Wa malik mamlakat Israa'iil gaal le Yahuuchafat-:-Ana nikhayyir khulgaani hana l-muluk achaan ma ya'arfuuni wa namchi al-harib.Wa inta kamaan,agood be khulgaanak hana l-muluk. Wa khalaas,malik mamlakat Israa'iil khayyar khulgaanah wa macha al-duwaas.
Wa malik balad Araam anta amur le kubaaraat arabaatah hana l-harib wa gaal leehum-:-Ma tahjumu al-askar wa la kubaaraathum laakin ahjumu malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa wakit kubaaraat arabaatah chaafooh le Yahuuchafat,gaalo-:-Akiid hu da bas malik mamlakat Israa'iil-! Wa humman hawwagooh le yihaarubuuh wa laakin Yahuuchafat koorak le l-faza' wa Allah saa'adah wa ba''adaahum minnah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-harib bigi chadiid marra waahid wa l-malik ga'ad fi lubb arabatah giddaam al-Araamiyiin lahaddi l-achiiye.Wa ma'a waguu' al-harraay da,hu maat.
Wa Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza gabbal be l-salaama fi beetah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Yaahu al-nabi al-yichiif ru'ya wileed Hanaani laagaah le l-malik Yahuuchafat wa gaal leyah-:-Waajib leek tafza' le naas al-fasliin walla-?Wa tihibb al-naas al-yakraho Allah walla-?Be l-sabab da,khadab Allah yanzil foogak.
Wa laakin inta sawweet a'maal adiiliin achaan mallat al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira fi kulla l-balad wa sabbatt galbak le titaabi' al-Rabb.
Wa Yahuuchafat sakan fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa bakaan waahid yamrug wa yamchi min Biir Sab'a lahaddi jibaal Afraayim wa chajja' al-cha'ab le yigabbulu le Allah Rabb juduudhum.
Wa khatta gudiya fi l-balad wa fi kulla mudun al-gawiyiin hana mamlakat Yahuuza,madiina ba'ad madiina.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Fakkuru fi khidmitku al-tisawwuuha achaan ma waajib tichaaru'u hasab al-naas laakin hasab charii'at Allah.Wa hu yukuun ma'aaku wakit tagta'o al-charii'a.
Wa hassa' da,akhaafo min Allah.Wa fakkuru fi l-cheyy al-tisawwuuh achaan Allah Ilaahna ma yidoor al-zulum wa la l-tafrikha wa la l-rachwa.
Wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus kula,Yahuuchafat khatta waahidiin min al-Laawiyiin wa rujaal al-diin wa kubaaraat aayilaat Bani Israa'iil le yisawwu al-charii'a hasab charii'at Allah wa yihillu khilaaf al-cha'ab.
Wa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Sawwu khidmitku be khoof min Allah wa be amaan wa be galib waahid.
Wa kan akhwaanku jo leeku min hillaalhum al-saakniin fooghum wa induhum muchkila be sabab dimme aw machaakil fi wasaaya aw fi gawaaniin aw churuut aw muhaakama,hazzuruuhum beehum.Wa be da,humman ma yabgo khaatiyiin giddaam Allah wa khadabah ma yanzil foogku wa la foog akhwaanku.Wa sawwu misil da achaan ma tabgo khaatiyiin.
Wa fi kulla cheyy al-bukhuss kalaam Allah,raajil al-diin Amarya hu bas kabiir.Wa fi kulla cheyy al-bukhuss malik mamlakat Yahuuza,Zabadya wileed Ismaa'iil hu bas mas'uul foogah.Wa l-Laawiyiin yabgo leeku muraakhibiin.Abgo chudaad wa akhdumu wa Allah yukuun ma'a ayyi naadum al-yisawwi al-kheer.
Wa ba'ad da,al-Muwaabiyiin wa Bani Ammuun wa ma'aahum al-Ma'uuniyiin jo le yihaarubu al-malik Yahuuchafat.
Wa naas jo khabbaro Yahuuchafat wa gaalo leyah-:-Askar katiiriin jo le yihaarubuuk wa humman jaayiin min khaadi le l-bahar al-Mayyit min balad Adoom.Wa hassa',gaa'idiin fi hillit Hassuun Taamaar al-binaaduuha Een Jidi.
Wa Yahuuchafat khaaf bilheen wa dawwar yas'al Allah wa kharrar siyaam le cha'abah fi kulla balad Yahuuza.
Wa naas mamlakat Yahuuza jo min kulla hillaal al-balad wa lammo le yachhado Allah.
Wa Yahuuchafat wagaf giddaam kulla l-cha'ab hana balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus giddaam al-fadaay al-jadiide fi beet Allah.
Wa sa'al al-Rabb wa gaal-:-Ya Allah Rabb juduudna-!Inta bas al-Rabb al-gaa'id fi l-sama wa siid kulla mamaalik al-umam.Wa inta bas indak al-gudra wa l-izz wa ma fi naadum al-yagdar yagiif giddaamak.
Da ma inta Ilaahna bas al-gala't ard sukkaan al-balad di giddaam cha'abak Bani Israa'iil wa anteetha le zurriiyit Ibraahiim khaliilak al-yihibbak ila l-abad-?
Wa humman sakano fi l-balad di wa bano leek beet mukhaddas.Wa gaalo-:
--Kan masiibe jaat foogna misil harib walla ikhaab walla waba walla juu',aniina naju giddaam al-beet da wa giddaamak inta achaan usmak gaa'id foog al-beet da.Wa aniina nikooruku wa natulbu minnak al-faza' min al-diige wa inta tasma' korooraakna wa tinajjiina.--
Wa hassa',daahu Bani Ammuun wa l-Muwaabiyiin wa naas jabal Sa'iir jaayiin le yahjumuuna.Wa inta ma khalleet Bani Israa'iil yuchuggu buldaanhum wakit marago min Masir.Fi chaan da,juduudna chaalo derib aakhar wa ma dammaroohum.
Wa daahu al-mukaafa al-yantuuha leena al-naas dool-!Humman jaayiin yagla'o minnina ard warasatna al-inta anteetha leena.
Ya Rabbina,ma ti'aakhibhum walla-?Aniina ma indina gudra giddaam al-askar al-katiiriin al-jaayiin diddina wa ma na'arfu nisawwu chunu.Wa achaan da,atwakkalna aleek inta.
Wa kulla naas balad Yahuuza waagfiin giddaam Allah ma'a aayilaathum wa awiinhum wa iyaalhum.
Wa khalaas,Ruuh Allah nazal fi naadum waahid fi ust al-cha'ab da.Wa hu Yahaziyiil wileed Zakariiya wileed Banaaya wileed Ya'iyiil wileed Mattanya.Hu min gabiilat Laawi min aayilat Asaaf.
Wa Yahaziyiil gaal leehum-:-Asma'o,ya naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-malik Yahuuchafat.Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ma takhaafo wa la tinbahtu min al-askar al-katiiriin dool achaan al-harba di ma hintuku laakin hint al-Rabb.
Wa ambaakir fajur,anzulu didd udwaanku.Humman yaju taali'iin min gooz al-Zuhuur.Wa talgoohum fi khachum al-waadi al-mugaabil saharat Yaruwiil.
Ma waajib leeku tihaarubuuhum.Amchu wa agiifu bas wa chiifu al-naja al-nijiibha leeku ana Allah.Ya naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus,ma takhaafo wa la tinbahtu-!Ambaakir,amchu waajuhuuhum wa ana Allah nukuun ma'aaku.-
Wa Yahuuchafat sajad wa kulla naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus dangaro fi l-ard wa sajado le Allah.
Wa l-Laawiyiin al-min zurriiyit Gahaat wa l-min zurriiyit Khuurah gammo yahmudu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil be hiss aali.
Wa l-cha'ab gammo be fajur badri marago wa maachiin ale saharat Takhuu'a.Wa wakit humman maachiin,Yahuuchafat wagaf be tuulah wa gaal-:-Asma'ooni,ya naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.Aamunu be Allah Ilaahku wa tagoodu saabtiin.Wa aamunu be anbiya Allah wa tanjaho.
Wa Yahuuchafat ma'a l-cha'ab achchaawaro wa khatta kubaaraat hana khine al-chukur achaan yamchu giddaam al-deech le yachkuru Allah al-Khudduus.Wa yuguulu-:-Achkuru Allah achaan rahmatah daayme ila l-abad-!
Wa wakit humman bado yiragrugu wa yachkuru Allah be hiss aali,Allah jaab barjaal ambeen Bani Ammuun wa l-Muwaabiyiin wa naas jabal Sa'iir al-jo le yahjumu balad Yahuuza wa humman gammo yiddaawaso ambeenaathum.
Wa Bani Ammuun wa l-Muwaabiyiin katalo naas jabal Sa'iir lahaddi dammaroohum marra waahid.Wa wakit kammalo naas Sa'iir,humman alkaatalo ambeenaathum.
Wa wakit askar mamlakat Yahuuza wassalo fi l-bakaan al-minnah yichiifu kulla l-sahara,wajjaho ale l-askar al-katiiriin.Wa khalaas,chaafo janaazaathum mudaffigiin fi l-ard wa naadum waahid kula ma faddal-!
Wa wakit Yahuuchafat wa naasah dallo le yichiilu khaniime,ligo khumaam katiir marra waahid.Ligo bahaayim wa lubaas wa mu'iddaat khaaliyiin.Khammo khumaam katiir lahaddi ma gidro yichiiluuh.Wa min al-katara,humman gaa'idiin yangulu al-khumaam da lahaddi talaata yoom.
Wa fi l-yoom al-raabi',lammo fi waadi al-Baraka achaan yibaaruku Allah.Wa be sabab da,sammo al-bakaan da waadi al-Baraka wa l-usum da gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa kulla rujaal balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus ma'a Yahuuchafat fi raashum gabbalo Madiinat al-Khudus be farha achaan Allah najjaahum min udwaanhum.
Wa humman wassalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus be hiss al-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l-burunji wa macho lahaddi beet Allah.
Wa khoof al-Rabb karab kulla l-mamaalik hana l-buldaan al-aakhariin achaan humman sim'o kadar Allah haarab udwaan Bani Israa'iil.
Wa mamlakat Yahuuchafat ga'adat fi raaha achaan Ilaahha antaaha al-salaama min kulli jiihe.
Wa Yahuuchafat wileed Aasa hakam fi mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa hu indah 35 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 25 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Azuuba bineeyit Chilhi.
Wa Yahuuchafat taaba' derib abuuh Aasa wa ma baara minnah.Wa sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah.
Wa laakin be da kula,al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam gaa'idiin wa l-cha'ab ma sabbato guluubhum fi Allah Rabb juduudhum.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahuuchafat min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya maktuub fi kitaab al-nabi Yaahu wileed Hanaani al-sajjalooh fi kitaab muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yahuuchafat malik mamlakat Yahuuza sawwa alaakha ma'a Akhazya malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa l-malik Akhazya yisawwi illa l-fasaala.
Wa Yahuuchafat sawwa alaakha ma'a l-malik da wa addalo sufun kubaar al-yamchu ba'iid le l-tijaara.Wa l-sufun dool addaloohum fi hillit Asyuun Giibar fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa laakin al-nabi Ali'aazar wileed Dudaawa al-min hillit Mariicha atnabba' didd Yahuuchafat wa gaal-:-Achaan inta sawweet alaakha ma'a Akhazya,Allah yikassir khidimtak. Wa l-sufun hana l-tijaara dool alkassaro gubbaal ma yawsalo.
Wa Yahuuchafat maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Yahuuraam hakam fi badalah.
Wa Yahuuraam indah akhwaan katiiriin wa humman Azarya wa Yahiyiil wa Zakariiya wa Azaryaahu wa Mikaayiil wa Chafatya dool kulluhum ke iyaal malik Yahuuchafat.
Wa abuuhum Yahuuchafat antaahum hadaaya katiiriin misil fudda wa dahab wa khumaam khaali.Wa antaahum mas'uuliiye fi l-mudun al-gawiyiin hana balad Yahuuza.Wa laakin hu anta al-muluk le wileedah Yahuuraam achaan hu bas al-bikir.
Wa wakit Yahuuraam chaal muluk abuuh,hu bigi chadiid wa katal kulla akhwaanah wa waahidiin min kubaaraat al-mamlaka kula.
Wa Yahuuraam indah 32 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 8 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa be da kula,Allah ma dawwar yidammir zurriiyit Dawuud achaan al-mu'aahada al-hu sawwaaha ma'a Dawuud wakit gaal leyah daayman naadum waahid min zurriiytah yagood fi l-muluk.
Wa Yahuuraam macha ma'a khuyyaad wa kulla arabaatah hana l-harib le yihaarubu al-Adoomiyiin.Wa be l-leel,al-Adoomiyiin hawwagoohum wa laakin Yahuuraam wa kubaaraat arabaatah hana l-harib gammo haaraboohum.
Wa l-tamarrud hana balad Adoom didd hukum Yahuuraam gaa'id lahaddi l-yoom.Wa fi l-wakit da,hillit Libna kula atmarradat didd hukum Yahuuraam achaan hu aba Allah Rabb juduudah.
Yahuuraam bana bakaanaat aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam fi ruuse jibaal Yahuuza.Wa lazza sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus yichcharmato ma'a l-asnaam wa le naas balad Yahuuza,ba''adaahum min Allah.
Yoom waahid,jawaab ja le Yahuuraam min al-nabi Iliyaas wa gaal-:Daahu Allah Ilaah jiddak Dawuud gaal-:-Inta ma taaba't derib abuuk Yahuuchafat wa la derib jiddak Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Laakin inta taaba't derib muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil wa lazzeet naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus le yichcharmato ma'a l-asnaam misil aayilat Akhaab sawwooh.Wa battaan inta katalt kulla akhwaanak iyaal abuuk al-humman akheer minnak.
Wa be sabab da,daahu Allah yinazzil waba chadiid fi cha'abak wa fi iyaalak wa fi awiinak wa fi kulla maalak.
Wa inta kula yakurbuuk amraad khaassatan marad al-batun al-yiziid leek min yoom le yoom lahaddi masaariinak yamurgu min batnak min chiddit al-marad.
Wa khalaas,Allah lazza al-Filistiyiin wa l-Arab al-gaa'idiin jamb al-Habachiyiin le yugummu didd al-malik Yahuuraam.
Wa humman hajamo mamlakat Yahuuza wa chaggo al-balad wa kasabo kulla l-maal al-fi gasir al-malik wa chaalo iyaalah wa awiinah kula.Wa ma faddal leyah waahid min iyaalah illa wileedah al-sakhayyar Akhazya.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah nazzal leyah marad al-batun al-ma biddaawa.
Wa l-marad da gaa'id yiziid min yoom le yoom.Wa fi l-sana al-taaniye,masaariinah marago min batnah min chiddit al-marad wa maat fi ta'ab chadiid.Wa cha'abah ma harrago leyah riihe katiire misil sawwooh le juduudah le yicharrufuuhum.
Wa Yahuuraam indah 32 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 8 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit maat,naadum waahid al-baka leyah kula ma fiih.Wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud laakin ma fi khabur al-muluuk.
Wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus darrajo Akhazya al-wileed al-sakhayyar hana Yahuuraam fi badalah achaan awwal al-Arab al-nahhaabiin jo fi l-mu'askar wa katalo kulla akhwaanah al-kubaar.Wa be misil da,Akhazya wileed Yahuuraam bigi malik fi mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Akhazya indah 42 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam sana waahide fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Atalya min aayilat Umri.
Wa hu kula taaba' derib aayilat Akhaab achaan ammah gaa'ide tiwassiih le yisawwi al-fasaala.
Wa Akhazya sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil aayilat Akhaab sawwatah achaan ba'ad moot abuuh,al-mustachaariin gaa'idiin yiwassuuh be l-cheyy al-yijiib damaarah.
Wa be wasiiyithum,Akhazya macha ma'a Yuuraam wileed Akhaab malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa haarabo Hazayiil malik balad Araam fi hillit Raamuut al-fi Gil'aad.Wa l-Araamiyiin jarahooh le Yuuraam.
Wa Yuuraam gabbal fi hillit Yazra'iil le yi'aalij jiraahah al-jarahooh wakit gaa'id yihaarib didd Hazayiil malik Araam.Wa Akhazya wileed Yahuuraam malik mamlakat Yahuuza macha hillit Yazra'iil le yichiif Yuuraam wileed Akhaab achaan hu ta'baan.
Wa be ziyaarat Akhazya le Yuuraam bas,al-Rabb kharrar damaarah.Wakit Akhazya gaa'id hinaak,hu gamma ma'a Yuuraam wa macho le yigaabulu Yaahu wileed Nimchi.Wa Yaahu da,hu bas al-Allah masahah wa darrajah malik le yidammir aayilat Akhaab.
Wa wakit Yaahu gaa'id yi'aakhib aayilat Akhaab,hu ligi kubaaraat mamlakat Yahuuza wa iyaal akhwaan Akhazya al-khadamo le l-malik wa katalaahum kulluhum.
Wa ba'ad da,gamma yifattich Akhazya.Wa Yaahu rassal naas yifattuchu Akhazya wa ligooh fi madiinat al-Saamira fi l-bakaan al-mullabbid foogah wa jaabooh le Yaahu wa katalooh.Wa dafanooh adiil achaan gaalo-:-Da wileed Yahuuchafat al-taaba' Allah be kulla galbah. Wa ma faddal naadum min aayilat Akhazya al-yagdar yichiil al-muluk.
Wa wakit Atalya amm Akhazya chaafat kadar wileedha maat,hi gammat tidammir kulla zurriiyit muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa laakin Yuuchab'a bineeyit malik Yahuuraam chaalat Yuwaach wileed Akhazya wa maragatah be sirr min lubb iyaal al-malik al-yidooru yaktuluuhum.Wa hi labbadatah ma'a l-mara al-takurbah,fi lubb makhazan al-saraayir.Wa Yuuchab'a di,hi bineeyit malik Yahuuraam wa marit Yahuuyada' kabiir rujaal al-diin wa akhut Akhazya.Wa be misil da,hi labbadat Yuwaach wileed Akhazya min Atalya wa hu niji min al-moot.
Wa Yuwaach ga'ad mulabbad fi beet Allah ma'a l-naas al-najjooh le muddit sitte sana.Wa fi l-mudda di,Atalya gaa'ide tahkim fi l-balad.
Wa fi l-sana al-saab'e hana hukum Atalya,Yahuuyada' chaal niiye wa lamma khuyyaad al-miyaat wa sawwa ma'aahum mu'aahada.Wa humman Azarya wileed Yaruuhaam wa Ismaa'iil wileed Yuuhanaan wa Azarya wileed Ubeed wa Ma'asiiya wileed Adaaya wa Alichaafaat wileed Zikri.
Wa humman raakho fi kulla mamlakat Yahuuza wa lammo al-Laawiyiin min kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza wa chuyuukh khuchuum buyuut Bani Israa'iil.Wa kulluhum jo Madiinat al-Khudus sawa.
Wa kulla l-mujtama' lammo wa sawwo mu'aahada ma'a l-malik fi beet Allah.Wa Yahuuyada' gaal leehum-:-Daahu Yuwaach wileed al-malik-!Waajib hu bas yabga malik wa da yihaggig al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah al-bukhuss zurriiyit Dawuud.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwu.Intu rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-tichiilu khidmitku fi yoom al-sabt,al-tilit minku yaharsu madkhal beet Allah
wa l-tilit minku yaharsu gasir al-malik wa l-tilit al-aakhar kamaan yaharsu baab al-Asaas.Wa kulla l-cha'ab yagoodu fi fadaayit beet Allah.
Wa ma tikhallu naadum yadkhul fi beet Allah illa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu.Humman bas yadkhulu achaan humman mukhassasiin.Wa kulla l-cha'ab yabgo haraasa le yahfado beet Allah.
Wa l-Laawiyiin yihawwugu al-malik min kulli jiihe wa ayyi waahid be silaahah fi iidah.Wa ayyi naadum al-yidoor yadkhul fi lubb beet Allah da,yaktuluuh.Wa l-Laawiyiin yamchu ma'a l-malik fi ayyi bakaan al-yamchi foogah.
Wa khalaas,al-Laawiyiin wa kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza sawwo kulla cheyy al-amaraahum beyah raajil al-diin Yahuuyada'.Wa ayyi kabiir lamma naasah,al-naas al-kammalo khidmithum fi yoom al-sabt wa l-naas al-yichiilu khidmithum fi yoom al-sabt kula.Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin ma anta yoom hana jumma le ayyi naadum min al-majmuu'aat dool.
Wa Yahuuyada' anta le khuyyaad al-miyaat al-huraab wa l-darag dugaag wa kubaar hana l-malik Dawuud al-gaa'idiin fi beet Allah.
Wa khatta kulla l-cha'ab fi bakaanhum,ayyi waahid be silaahah fi iidah.Wa rassaahum min nuss al-zeene hana beet Allah lahaddi nuss al-isra,giddaam al-beet wa l-madbah,le yihawwugu al-malik.
Wa khalaas,marago Yuwaach wileed al-malik wa khatto taaj fi raasah wa antooh kitaab al-mu'aahada.Wa ba'ad da,Yahuuyada' wa awlaadah masahooh wa darrajooh malik.Wa kulla l-naas aato wa gaalo-:-Yi'iich al-malik-!
Wa wakit al-malika Atalya sim'at harakat al-cha'ab al-jaariyiin wa yachkuru al-malik,hi jarat machat leehum fi beet Allah.
Wa hi chaafat al-malik waagif jamb al-amuud fi madkhal beet Allah.Wa l-khuyyaad wa l-naas al-yadurbu burunji gaa'idiin ma'a l-malik.Wa kulla cha'ab al-balad farhaaniin marra waahid.Naas gaa'idiin yadurbu burunji wa khannaayiin gaa'idiin bikhannu khine al-chukur be aalaat al-musiikha.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Atalya charratat khulgaanha min al-za'al wa gaalat-:-Di mu'aamara-!Di mu'aamara-!
Wa raajil al-diin Yahuuyada' naada khuyyaad al-miyaat al-mukallafiin be l-askar wa gaal leehum-:-Amurguuha barra min sufuufku.Wa ayyi naadum al-yitaabi'ha,aktuluuh be l-seef. Achaan hu ma dawwar yaktuluuha fi beet Allah.
Wa humman karabooha wa maragooha.Wa wakit wassalo ale gasir al-malik be baab Dakhuul al-Kheel,khalaas katalooha fi l-bakaan da.
Wa Yahuuyada' sawwa mu'aahada ma'a kulla l-cha'ab wa ma'a l-malik.Wa be l-mu'aahada di,al-cha'ab yabgo cha'ab Allah.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab macho beet al-ibaada hana ilaah Ba'al wa haddamooh wa dammaro madaabhah wa asnaamah kula.Wa giddaam al-madaabih,katalo Mattaan raajil al-diin hana Ba'al.
Wa ba'ad da,Yahuuyada' kallaf rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin be muraakhabat beet Allah.Wa l-naas dool,awwal Dawuud gassamaahum be majmuu'aat fi beet Allah le yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin misil maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa.Wa Dawuud amaraahum yisawwu al-khidme di be khine wa farha.
Wa Yahuuyada' khatta hurraas fi madkhal beet Allah achaan ayyi naadum nijis ma yadkhul.
Wa Yahuuyada' lamma khuyyaad al-miyaat wa l-kubaaraat wa masaa'iil al-cha'ab wa kulla cha'ab al-balad wa marag al-malik min beet Allah.Wa waddooh le gasir al-malik be baab al-foogaani.Wa ba'ad da,ga''adooh le Yuwaach fi kursi al-muluk.
Wa kulla cha'ab al-balad firho.Wa ba'ad katalooha le Atalya,al-madiina gaa'ide fi l-salaama.
Wa Yuwaach indah 7 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 40 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Sibya wa hi min hillit Biir Sab'a.
Wa Yuwaach sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah fi kulla muddit hayaat Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin.
Wa Yahuuyada' jawwaz Yuwaach awiin itneen wa hu jaab awlaad wa banaat.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuwaach chaal niiye le yi'addil beet Allah.
Wa hu lamma rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa atulbu min kulla Bani Israa'iil yilimmu fudda le ni'addulu beeha beet Ilaahku ayyi sana.Wa sawwu al-khidme di ajala. Wa laakin al-Laawiyiin ma sawwo al-khidme di ajala.
Wa khalaas,al-malik naadaah le Yahuuyada' kabiir rujaal al-diin wa gaal leyah-:-Maala ma jabart al-Laawiyiin yichiilu min naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-hadaaya.Wa dool misil al-hadaaya al-zamaan kharrarhum Muusa abd Allah wa mujtama' Bani Israa'iil wa gaalo yijiibuuhum le l-kheema al-indaha liihaan al-mu'aahada.
Achaan Atalya al-fasle wa naasha tallafo beet Allah wa asta'malo al-mu'iddaat al-mukhaddasiin hana beet Allah le ibaadat al-ilaah Ba'al.
Wa l-malik amar yisawwu sanduug waahid wa yukhuttuuh giddaam madkhal beet Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,marago kharaar fi kulla balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus wa gaalo waajib yijiibu le Allah al-hadaaya al-kharrarhum Muusa abd Allah zamaan fi l-sahara.
Wa kulla l-kubaaraat wa kulla l-cha'ab firho wa jaabo al-hadaaya wa sabboohum fi l-sanduug lahaddi anmala.
Wa wakit jaabo al-sanduug le l-Laawiyiin,muraakhibiin hana l-malik chaafo kadar al-fudda katiire marra waahid.Wa khalaas,al-kaatib hana l-malik wa l-muraakhib hana kabiir rujaal al-diin jo wa faddo al-sanduug wa gabbalooh fi bakaanah.Wa sawwo misil da kulla yoom wa ligo fudda katiire.
Wa l-malik wa Yahuuyada' anto al-fudda di le l-mukallafiin be khidmit addiliin beet Allah.Wa be l-fudda di,humman kaffo naggaachiin al-hajar wa najjaariin al-hatab wa kaffo al-haddaad al-yakhdumu be hadiid wa nahaas le yi'addulu beet Allah.
Wa kulla l-mukallafiin be l-khidme di naffazo al-khidme wa addalo beet Allah.Wa l-beet da bigi gawi wa adiil misil awwal.
Wakit al-khaddaamiin kammalo al-khidme khalaas,jaabo al-fadle hana l-fudda le l-malik wa Yahuuyada'.Wa sana'o beeha mawaa'iin le beet Allah wa humman mawaa'iin le l-ibaada wa le l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa kharaariif wa mu'iddaat aakhariin hana dahab wa fudda.Wa gaa'idiin yigaddumu dahaaya fi beet Allah daayman fi kulla muddit hayaat Yahuuyada' kabiir rujaal al-diin.
Wa Yahuuyada' bigi chaayib marra waahid wa chibi' min al-dunya wa maat fi umur hana 130 sana.
Wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud ma'a l-muluuk achaan hu sawwa al-adiil le Bani Israa'iil wa le Allah wa le beet Allah.
Wa ba'ad moot Yahuuyada',kubaaraat mamlakat Yahuuza jo wa sajado giddaam al-malik.Wa l-malik khatta baalah wa gaa'id yasma'hum.
Wa fi chaan wasiiyithum,naas mamlakat Yahuuza khallo beet Allah Rabb juduudhum wa khazzo iidaan le ibaadat Achiira wa le ilaahaat aakhariin wa abadoohum.Wa khalaas,Allah nazzal khadabah fi balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus be sabab khataahum da.
Wa Allah rassal leehum anbiya le yigabbuluuhum fi derbah.Wa l-anbiya hazzaroohum wa laakin humman abo ma yasma'oohum.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal fi Zakariiya wileed Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin.Wa hu wagaf giddaam al-cha'ab wa gaal-:-Daahu al-Rabb gaal-:--Maala isiitu wasiiyaati-?Intu ma tanjaho achaan abeetuuni ana Allah wa hassa' ana kula naabaaku.-
Wa l-cha'ab gammo didd Zakariiya wa rajamooh fi fadaayit beet Allah hasab amur al-malik.
Wa l-malik Yuwaach nisi kulla l-kheer al-sawwaah leyah Yahuuyada' abu le Zakariiya wa gamma katalah le wileedah Zakariiya.Wa wakit Zakariiya gaa'id yumuut,hu gaal-:-Khalli Allah yichiif khidimtak wa yi'aakhibak-!
Wa fi kumaalit al-sana,askar balad Araam jo hajamooh le l-malik Yuwaach.Dakhalo fi balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus wa katalo kulla kubaaraat al-cha'ab wa rassalo al-khaniime le malikhum fi madiinat Dimachkh.
Wa l-askar dool ma katiiriin wa laakin Allah sallam leehum al-deech al-kabiir hana mamlakat Yahuuza achaan humman abo Allah Rabb juduudhum.Wa be da,al-ikhaab alhaggag fi Yuwaach.
Wa wakit al-Araamiyiin faato,khallo Yuwaach majruuh ziyaada.Wa khalaas,masaa'iilah gammo diddah wa katalooh fi sariirah wa da be sabab al-dimme hana wileed Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin.Wa ba'ad Yuwaach maat,dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud wa laakin ma fi khubuur al-muluuk.
Wa daahu al-naas al-gammo diddah.Humman Zabaad al-ammah usumha Chim'aat wa hi min Ammuun wa Yahuzabaad al-ammah usumha Chimriit wa hi min Muwaab.
Wa asaame iyaal Yuwaach wa l-kalaam al-hajjooh diddah al-anbiya wa taariikh addiliin beet Allah,kulla ke maktuub fi kitaab taariikh al-muluuk.Wa wileedah Amasya hakam fi badalah.
Wa Amasya indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 29 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Yuu'addaan wa hi min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah wa laakin ma be niiye mukhlisa.
Wa wakit Amasya sabbat mulkah,hu katal kulla masaa'iilah al-katalo abuuh al-malik Yuwaach.
Wa laakin hu ma katal iyaalhum.Wa da hasab maktuub fi kitaab Tawraat Muusa al-foogah Allah amaraahum wa gaal-:-Al-abbahaat ma yaktuluuhum be sabab zanib al-iyaal wa l-iyaal ma yaktuluuhum be sabab zanib al-abbahaat.Ayyi waahid yumuut be sabab zanbah bas.
Wa Amasya lamma rujaal mamlakat Yahuuza wa nazzamaahum ale hasab aayilaathum.Wa darraj khuyyaad al-aalaaf wa khuyyaad al-miyaat le kulla gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin.Wa hu sajjal kulla l-rujaal al-umurhum min 20 sana wa foog wa ligi adadhum 300-000 rujaal jaahiziin le l-harib wa chaayliin huraab wa darag.
Wa jannad min mamlakat Israa'iil 100-000 rujaal furraas murtazakha be taman hana 3-400 kiilo hana fudda.
Wa laakin nabi Allah ja le Amasya wa gaal-:-Ya l-malik-!Khalli askar mamlakat Israa'iil ma yamchu ma'aak fi l-harib achaan Allah ma yukuun ma'a Bani Israa'iil,ma'a kulla naas gabiilat Afraayim dool.
Wa kan humman maachiin ma'aak,kan inta bigiit chadiid fi l-harib kula,al-Rabb yarmiik giddaam udwaanak.Achaan al-Rabb bas indah gudra yafza' aw yarmi.
Wa Amasya gaal le nabi Allah-:-Nisawwi kikkeef le l-fudda al-wazinha 3-400 kiilo al-anteetha le askar mamlakat Israa'iil-? Wa nabi Allah gaal-:-Allah indah-!Yagdar yantiik ziyaada min da.
Wa be da,Amasya tarad al-askar al-jo min gabiilat Afraayim achaan yigabbulu buyuuthum.Wa laakin humman zi'ilo didd mamlakat Yahuuza wa gabbalo buyuuthum be za'al chadiid.
Wa Amasya chadda heelah wa wadda cha'abah fi waadi al-Mileh wa katal 10-000 askar Adoomiyiin min Sa'iir.
Wa cha'ab Yahuuza karabo 10-000 askar aakhariin wa waddoohum fi raas hajar.Wa ramoohum min raas al-hajar da wa kulluhum alkassaro.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-askar al-Amasya taradaahum achaan ma yihaarubu ma'aayah da gammo hajamo hillaal balad Yahuuza min al-Saamira lahaddi Beet Huruun.Wa katalo 3-000 naas wa chaalo khaniime katiire.
Wa wakit Amasya mugabbil min nasrah fi l-Adoomiyiin,hu jaab ma'aayah ilaahaathum min Sa'iir.Hu sawwaahum ilaahaatah wa gaa'id ya'abudhum wa yiharrig leehum al-bakhuur.
Wa khalaas,Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Amasya wa rassal leyah nabi achaan yihajji leyah.Wa l-nabi gaal-:-Maala inta taaba't al-ilaahaat al-ma gidro najjo cha'abhum min iidak-?
Wa laakin wakit al-nabi gaa'id yihajji leyah,Amasya gata' kalaamah wa gaal-:-Yaatu khattaak mustachaar hanaayi ana al-malik-?Askut kan ma tidoor yuduggak-! Wa l-nabi gaal-:-Ana na'arif kadar al-Rabb kharrar le yidammirak achaan inta sawweet al-cheyy da wa abeet ma tasma' wasiiyti. Wa ba'ad da,sakat.
Wa Amasya malik mamlakat Yahuuza ligi wasiiye min mustachaariin aakhariin wa rassal le Yahu'aach wileed Yahuuhaaz wileed Yaahu malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal nilgaabalo wa nilhaarabo-!
Wa Yahu'aach gaal battaan-:-Akiid inta annasart fi l-Adoomiyiin wa fi chaan da,firiht be nasrak wa gaa'id tilfachchar.Wa hassa',nuguul leek agood saakit fi beetak.Maala tidoor tigawwim harib cheen al-yidammirak inta wa mamlakat Yahuuza kula-?
Wa laakin Amasya ma simi' kalaamah achaan Allah dawwar yisallimah fi iid udwaanah wa da fi chaan hu taaba' ilaahaat al-Adoomiyiin.
Wa khalaas,Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil marag gaabalah.Wa askar Yahu'aach wa askar Amasya malik mamlakat Yahuuza alhaarabo fi hillit Beet Chams fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa fi hillit Beet Chams,Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil karabah le Amasya wileed Yuwaach wileed Akhazya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa hu bigi masjuun al-harib wa Yahu'aach waddaah Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hinaak,hu kassar durdur Madiinat al-Khudus fi tuul hana 400 duraa' min baab Afraayim lahaddi baab al-Rukun.
Wa Yahu'aach chaal kulla l-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-mu'iddaat hana beet Allah al-hafadaahum Ubeed Adoom.Wa chaal al-kanz min gasir al-malik wa khataf naas kula.Wa ba'ad da,gabbal madiinat al-Saamira.
Wa l-baagi min amal Amasya min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya maktuub fi kitaab muluuk Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa min wakit Amasya khalla derib Allah,naas waahidiin atmarrado diddah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hu arrad wa macha hillit Lakiich laakin humman rassalo naas waraayah wa katalooh fi l-hille di.
Wa humman jaabo janaaztah be kheel wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah fi aasimat balad Yahuuza.
Wa kulla cha'ab mamlakat Yahuuza chaalo Uzziiya wakit indah 16 sana wa darrajooh malik fi badal abuuh Amasya.
Wa ba'ad abuuh maat wa lihig abbahaatah,Uzziiya chaal hillit Ilaat wa gawwaaha wa gabbalha le mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Uzziiya indah 16 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 52 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Yakulya wa hi min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu gaa'id yitaabi' al-Rabb fi kulla muddit hayaat Zakariiya al-gaa'id yi'allimah makhaafat Allah.Wa wakit Uzziiya gaa'id yitaabi' Allah,hu antaah al-najaah.
Wa Uzziiya macha haarab al-Filistiyiin wa kassar daraadir mudunhum Gaat wa Yabni wa Achduud.Wa ba'ad da,gawwa mudun al-fi mantagat Achduud wa fi bakaanaat aakhariin hana balad al-Filistiyiin.
Wa l-Rabb faza'ah wakit haarab al-Filistiyiin wa l-Arab al-saakniin fi hillit Guur Ba'al wa l-Ma'uuniyiin.
Wa l-Ma'uuniyiin anto hadaaya le Uzziiya.Wa usmah bigi taali' wa sim'o beyah lahaddi huduud Masir achaan hu bigi chadiid marra waahid.
Wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus be foog le baab al-Rukun wa be foog le baab al-Waadi wa fi l-bakaan al-durdur yilimm fi l-rukun,Uzziiya bana buyuut al-muraakhaba wa gawwaahum
Wa bana buyuut al-muraakhaba fi l-sahara wa nakat biyaar katiiriin achaan hu indah bahaayim katiiriin al-gaa'idiin fi sahalat Chafiila wa fi suhuul aakhariin.Wa hu indah harraatiin al-inab fi raas jabal al-Karmal achaan hu yihibb al-hiraate.
Wa Uzziiya indah deech chadiid wa jaahiz le l-harib.Wa l-deech da mugassam ale majmuu'aat hasab al-hisaab al-sawwaah al-kaatib Ya'iyiil wa l-mukallaf Ma'asiiya wa da fi tihit muraakhabat Hananya waahid min masaa'iil al-malik.
Wa kulla chuyuukh al-aayilat wa l-rujaal al-furraas adadhum 2-600.
Wa tihit amurhum induhum deech hana 307-500 askar chudaad al-yihaarubu be gudra wa chajaa'a achaan yidaafu'u le l-malik min udwaanah.
Wa wakit yamurgu le l-duwaas,Uzziiya yijahhiz leehum darag wa huraab wa tawaagi min nahaas wa dire' wa nachaachiib wa hujaar le l-miglaa'.
Wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus,Uzziiya sawwa makanaat hana harib wa da be fikir hana sinaa'i ma'ruuf.Wa yukhuttu al-makanaat dool fi buyuut al-muraakhaba wa fi arkaan al-durdur achaan be l-makanaat dool yizarrugu nachaachiib wa hujaar kubaar.Wa usum Uzziiya bigi taali' achaan ligi musaa'ada ajiibe lahaddi bigi chadiid fi hukmah.
Wa laakin wakit Uzziiya bigi chadiid,hu bada yistakbar lahaddi isi Allah Ilaahah wa jaab al-damaar le nafsah.Hu dakhal fi beet Allah wa harrag bakhuur fi mukhbar al-bakhuur.
Wa Azarya kabiir rujaal al-diin dakhal waraayah ma'a 80 rujaal diin hana Allah fahaliin.
Wa humman gammo didd al-malik Uzziiya wa gaalo leyah-:-Ya Uzziiya,ma indak hagg tahrig al-bakhuur fi beet Allah.Di khidmit rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Haaruun al-khassasoohum le yiharrugu al-bakhuur.Yalla amrug min al-beet al-mukhaddas da achaan inta isiit Allah-!Wa khidimtak di ma tijiib leek charaf giddaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa Uzziiya indah fi iidah al-mukhbar al-yiharrugu foogah al-bakhuur.Wa hu zi'il min rujaal al-diin.Wa tawwaali wakit hu gaa'id giddaam rujaal al-diin fi beet Allah jamb mukhbar al-bakhuur,al-jidaam marag fi jabhitah.
Wakit Azarya kabiir rujaal al-diin wa kulla rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin anlafato aleyah wa chaafo al-jidaam fi jabhitah,tawwaali maragooh min al-bakaan da.Hu zaatah assa'jal le yamrug achaan Allah nazzal foogah al-marad da.
Wa Uzziiya ga'ad mujaddim lahaddi mootah.Wa hu sakan fi beet wiheedah taraf wa ma waajib leyah yadkhul fi beet Allah.Wa Yuutaam wileedah bigi mas'uul fi l-gasir wa hakam fi cha'ab al-balad.
Wa l-baagi min amal Uzziiya min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya katabah al-nabi Icha'ya wileed Ammuus.
Wa Uzziiya maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh jamb khabur juduudah fi ard hana khabur al-muluuk achaan hu mujaddim.Wa wileedah Yuutaam hakam fi badalah.
Wa Yuutaam indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 16 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Yaruucha bineeyit Saduukh.
Yuutaam sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah misil abuuh Uzziiya sawwaah laakin Yuutaam ma khiti be dakhiliin fi beet Allah.Wa laakin be adaaltah di kula,al-cha'ab gaa'idiin yitallufu.
Wa hu addal al-baab al-foogaani hana madkhal beet Allah wa bana al-durdur hana haarat Ufal.
Wa bana hillaal fi jibaal Yahuuza wa mudun gawiyiin wa buyuut tuwaal hana l-muraakhaba fi l-khaaba.
Yuutaam haarab Bani Ammuun wa annasar fooghum.Wa fi l-sana di,Bani Ammuun antooh ziyaada min 3-400 kiilo hana fudda wa 25-000 chuwaal hana gameh ahmar wa 25-000 chuwaal hana gameh abyad.Wa antooh nafs al-hadaaya fi l-sana al-taaniye wa l-taalta kula.
Wa Yuutaam bigi chadiid misil ke achaan sabbat derbah giddaam Allah Ilaahah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yuutaam wa kulla l-huruub al-sawwaahum wa khidimtah maktuubiin fi kitaab muluuk Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.
Yuutaam indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 16 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Yuutaam maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa wileedah Ahaaz hakam fi badalah.
Wa Ahaaz indah 20 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 16 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hu ma sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah misil jiddah Dawuud.
Wa laakin hu taaba' derib muluuk mamlakat Israa'iil wa hu kula sawwa asnaam le ibaadat al-ilaah Ba'al.
Wa hu gaddam bakhuur fi waadi Bani Hinnuum wa gaddam iyaalah wa harragaahum fi l-naar.Wa da nafs al-muharramaat al-sawwoohum al-umam al-Allah gala' minhum arduhum wa antaaha le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,Allah Ilaahah sallamah fi iid malik balad Araam.Hu haarabah wa karab minnah naas katiiriin wa sawwaahum masaajiin wa waddaahum madiinat Dimachkh.Wa battaan,Allah sallamah fi iid Fagah wileed Ramalya malik mamlakat Israa'iil wa hu kula annasar foogah nasur kabiir.
Wa fi yoom waahid,Fagah katal 120-000 raajil min mamlakat Yahuuza kulluhum rujaal fahaliin.Wa da achaan humman abo Allah Rabb juduudhum.
Wa Zikri raajil faaris hana gabiilat Afraayim katal Ma'asiiya wileed al-malik wa Azrikhaam muraakhib gasir al-malik wa Alikhaana naayib al-malik.
Wa askar mamlakat Israa'iil karabo min akhwaanhum Bani Yahuuza 200-000 awiin wa awlaad wa banaat.Wa nahabo khaniime katiire wa waddooha fi madiinithum al-Saamira.
Wa hinaak fi l-Saamira,fiyah nabi Allah usmah Udeed.Hu marag laagaahum le l-askar al-gabbalo al-Saamira wa gaal leehum-:-Daahu khadab Allah Rabb juduudku nazal fi Bani Yahuuza wa hu sallamaahum leeku.Wa intu kamaan kataltuuhum bala mahanna lahaddi khabar moothum da tala' fi l-sama.
Wa hassa',intu tidooru tisawwuuhum le naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus dool abiid wa khadiim.Wa be misil da,tabga khaatiyiin giddaam Allah Ilaahku.
Hassa' da,asma'o kalaami.Atulgu al-masaajiin al-karabtuuhum min akhwaanku achaan khadab Allah al-muhrig jaayi foogku.
Wa kubaaraat waahidiin min gabiilat Afraayim kula gammo didd al-rujaal al-gabbalo min al-harib.Wa l-kubaaraat dool humman Azarya wileed Yuuhanaan wa Barakya wileed Machillimuut wa Yahizkhiiya wileed Challuum wa Amaasa wileed Hadlaay.
Wa gaalo leehum-:-Ma waajib tijiibu al-masaajiin dool hini.Aniina hassa' kula khaatiyiin giddaam Allah wa tidooru tiziidu fi zunuubna wa khataayaana walla-?Khataayaana katiiriin wa daahu khadab Allah jaayi foogna,ya Bani Israa'iil-!
Wa khalaas,al-askar talago al-masaajiin wa l-khaniime giddaam al-kubaaraat wa kulla l-cha'ab.
Wa naas al-kallafoohum gammo wa chajja'o al-masaajiin wa chaalo min al-khaniime wa labbasoohum le kulla l-aryaaniin.Wa antoohum khulgaan wa ni'le wa akil wa charaab wa sabbo leehum dihin fi awaawiirhum.Wa rakkabo fi hamiir al-naas al-ma yagdaro yuruukhu wa waddoohum le akhwaanhum fi Ariiha al-binaaduuha madiinat al-nakhal.Wa ba'ad da,gabbalo al-Saamira.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Ahaaz malik mamlakat Yahuuza rassal le malik balad Achuur achaan yaji yafza'ah.
Wa da,achaan al-Adoomiyiin battaan jo wa haarabo mamlakat Yahuuza wa karabo naashum wa waddoohum masaajiin.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit,al-Filistiyiin kula jo hajamo sahalat Chafiila wa mantagat al-junuub hana balad Yahuuza.Wa humman chaalo hillaal Beet Chams wa Ayyaluun wa Gadiiruut.Wa battaan chaalo hillaal Suuku wa Timna wa Gimzu wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum.Wa sakano fi kulla l-hillaal dool.
Allah gaa'id yimaskin mamlakat Yahuuza be sabab Ahaaz malikhum,hu al-lazza Bani Yahuuza yisawwu al-zanib wa be nafsah kula isi Allah.
Wa Takhlat Falaasar malik balad Achuur ja le Ahaaz laakin ma faza'ah,ja daayagah.
Wa Ahaaz chaal al-kanz al-fi beet Allah wa fi gasir al-malik wa fi buyuut al-masaa'iil wa antaah le malik balad Achuur misil hadiiye.Wa laakin be da kula,ma ligi minnah ayyi faza'.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id fi l-diige kula,al-malik Ahaaz gaa'id ya'asa Allah.
Hu gaa'id yigaddim dahaaya le ilaahaat madiinat Dimachkh al-hazamooh wa gaal fi nafsah-:-Ilaahaat malik balad Araam faza'o naashum.Kan misil da,ana kula nigaddim leehum dahaaya achaan yafza'ooni. Wa laakin da sabbab damaar leyah hu wa le kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Ahaaz lamma kulla l-mu'iddaat hana beet Allah wa kassaraahum wa ba'ad da,gaffal biibaan beet Allah.Wa sawwa le nafsah madaabih fi ayyi bakaan fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa bana bakaanaat aaliyiin fi kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza le yiharrugu fooghum al-bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa be misil da,hu khaddab Allah Rabb juduudah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Ahaaz wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya maktuubiin fi kitaab muluuk Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Ahaaz maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa laakin ma satarooh fi khubuur muluuk Bani Israa'iil.Wa wileedah Hizkhiiya hakam fi badalah.
Wa Hizkhiiya indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 29 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Abiiya bineeyit Zakariiya.
Fi awwal sana hana hukmah fi l-chahar al-awwal,hu fatah battaan biibaan beet Allah wa addalaahum.
Wa naadaahum le rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa lammaahum fi l-fadaay al-sabhaaniiye hana beet Allah.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Asma'o,ya l-Laawiyiin.Hassa' da,khassusu nufuusku wa tahhuru beet Allah Rabb juduudku wa amurgu al-najaasa min al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Achaan abbahaatna iso wa sawwo al-fasaala giddaam Allah Ilaahna.Humman nakarooh wa abo ma yamchu fi beet Allah wa antooh daharhum.
Wa humman gaffalo biibaan beet Allah wa katalo al-fawaaniis wa ma harrago bakhuur wa la gaddamo dahaaya le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.
Wa be da,khadab Allah nazal fi balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hu sawwaahum masal al-bikhawwif wa kharaab wa bahiite misil intu gaa'idiin tichiifuuh.
Wa be sabab da,abbahaatna maato fi l-harib wa awlaadna wa banaatna wa awiinna karaboohum wa waddoohum masaajiin.
Wa hassa' da,ana chilt niiye nisawwu mu'aahada ma'a Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil achaan yarfa' minnina khadabah al-muhrig.
Ya akhwaani-!Hassa' da,khallu al-kasal achaan Allah azalaaku le tagiifu giddaamah wa takhdumu leyah.Wa tabgo khaddaamiinah al-yiharrugu leyah al-bakhuur.
Wa khalaas,al-Laawiyiin gammo yakhdumu fi beet Allah wa hummanMahat wileed Amaasaay wa Yuwiil wileed Azaryamin khachum beet Gahaatwa Khiich wileed Abdi wa Azarya wileed Yahalaaliilmin khachum beet Maraariwa Yuwaakh wileed Zimma wa Idaan wileed Yuwaakhmin khachum beet Girchuun
wa Chimri wa Ya'iyiilmin khachum beet Alisaafanwa Zakariiya wa Mattanyamin khachum beet Asaaf
wa Yahiyiil wa Chim'imin khachum beet Heemaanwa Chama'ya wa Uzziyiilmin khachum beet Yaduutuun.
Wa ba'ad da,lammo kulla akhwaanhum wa khassaso nufuushum wa macho le yitahhuru beet Allah hasab amur al-malik wa hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,rujaal al-diin dakhalo fi lubb beet Allah le yitahhuruuh.Wa marago kulla l-achya al-nijsiin min beet Allah wa jaaboohum barra fi l-fadaay.Wa l-Laawiyiin chaalo al-achya dool wa waddoohum zagaloohum barra fi waadi Khidruun.
Wa humman bado yikhassusu beet Allah fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-awwal.Wa fi l-yoom al-taamin hana l-chahar da,wassalo fi khurfit madkhal beet Allah.Wa khassaso beet Allah muddit tamaane yoom battaan wa kammalo fi yoom 16 hana l-chahar al-awwal.
Wa ba'ad da,macho le l-malik Hizkhiiya wa gaalo leyah-:-Aniina tahharna kulla beet Allah wa l-madbah hana l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa kulla mu'iddaatah wa l-tarabeeza al-yigaddumu foogha al-khubza wa kulla mu'iddaatha.
Wa tahharna kulla l-mu'iddaat al-najjasaahum al-malik Ahaaz wakit hu isi Allah fi wakit hukmah.Wa daahu khatteenaahum giddaam madbah Allah.
Wa l-malik Hizkhiiya gamma be fajur badri wa lamma kulla hukkaam al-madiina wa macha ma'aahum le beet Allah.
Wa jaabo sab'a toor wa sab'a kabich wa sab'a hamal wa sab'a tees le yigaddumuuhum dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib le l-mamlaka wa le l-beet al-mukhaddas wa le kulla naas balad Yahuuza.Wa l-malik gaal le rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Haaruun yigaddumu al-dahaaya dool fi madbah Allah.
Wa humman dabaho al-tiiraan wa chaalo al-damm wa rachchooh fi l-madbah.Wa dabaho al-kubchaan wa rachcho al-damm fi l-madbah.Wa dabaho al-humlaan wa rachcho al-damm fi l-madbah.
Wa ba'ad da,jaabo kulla l-tuyuus al-humman dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib giddaam al-malik wa l-mujtama'.Wa kulluhum khatto iideehum fooghum.
Wa rujaal al-diin dabaho al-tuyuus dool dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib wa rachcho al-damm fi l-madbah achaan yisawwu kaffaara le kulla Bani Israa'iil.Achaan al-malik gaal yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin dool le kaffaarat al-zanib hana kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,al-malik khatta rujaal al-diin fi beet Allah be aalaathum hana l-musiikha misil al-nagaagiir wa l-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe.Wa da hasab amur al-malik Dawuud wa Gaad al-nabi al-yichiif ru'ya le l-malik wa Naataan al-nabi achaan al-amur da ja min Allah be waasitat al-anbiya dool.
Wa l-Laawiyiin wagafo fi bakaanhum be aalaathum hana l-musiikha al-sawwaahum Dawuud wa rujaal al-diin kamaan be burunji.
Wa Hizkhiiya amar yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin fi l-madbah.Wa wakit bado yigaddumu al-dahaaya dool,al-cha'ab gammo yimajjudu Allah be khine wa daribiin al-burunji wa be aalaat al-musiikha al-sawwaahum Dawuud malik Bani Israa'iil.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab ga'ado saajidiin wa l-khannaayiin gaa'idiin yikhannu wa yadurbu al-burunji lahaddi gaddamo kulla l-dahaaya dool.
Wa wakit gaddamo kulla l-dahaaya dool khalaas,al-malik wa kulla l-naas al-ma'aayah dangaro wa sajado.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Hizkhiiya wa masaa'iilah gaalo le l-Laawiyiin waajib yachkuru Allah be kalimaat Dawuud wa Asaaf al-nabi al-yichiif ru'ya.Wa humman chakaro Allah be farha wa dangaro wa sajado.
Wa Hizkhiiya hajja battaan wa gaal-:-Hassa' da,intu al-jibtu dahaaya le Allah,garrubu wa jiibu dahaayaaku hana l-chukur wa dahaayaaku al-aakhariin wa gaddumuuhum fi beet Allah. Wa khalaas,kulla l-cha'ab jaabo dahaayaahum hana l-chukur wa dahaayaahum al-aakhariin.Wa kulla l-naas al-guluubhum kariimiin gaddamo dahaayaahum al-muharragiin kula.
Wa l-adad hana l-dahaaya al-muharragiin al-jaaboohum al-cha'ab bigi 70 toor wa 100 kabich wa 200 hamal wa kulluhum ke gaddamoohum dahaaya muharragiin le Allah.
Wa kan le l-dahaaya al-aakhariin,jaabo 600 bagar wa 3-000 khanam.
Wa laakin rujaal al-diin humman chiyya,ma gidro yaslakho kulla l-dahaaya dool.Wa akhwaanhum al-Laawiyiin jo wa saa'adoohum lahaddi kammalo al-khidme di wa lahaddi rujaal al-diin khassaso nufuushum.Achaan al-Laawiyiin induhum niiye mukhlisa wa khassaso nufuushum le khidmit Allah ziyaada min rujaal al-diin.
Wa battaan be l-dahaaya al-muharragiin al-katiiriin dool,gaddamo chaham dahaaya al-salaama wa hadaaya charaab.Wa khalaas be misil da,khidmit al-ibaada badat battaan fi beet Allah.
Wa Hizkhiiya wa kulla l-cha'ab firho be l-cheyy al-sawwaah al-Rabb le l-cha'ab.Achaan kulla l-khidme di kammalat ajala.
Wa Hizkhiiya naada kulla Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza wa rassal jawaabaat le gabaayil Afraayim wa Manassa kula le yaju le beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yi'ayyudu iid al-Fishale Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Al-malik wa kulla masaa'iilah wa kulla l-mujtama' achchaawaro fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa waafago yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha fi l-chahar al-taani be ta'khiir.
Humman ma gidro ayyadooh fi waktah achaan rujaal al-diin al-khassaso nufuushum chiyya bas wa l-cha'ab kula lissaa'hum ma lammo fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-kalaam da ajabah le l-malik wa le kulla l-mujtama'.
Wa humman chaalo niiye yikhabburu kulla Bani Israa'iil min Biir Sab'a fi l-wati lahaddi Daan fi l-munchaakh le yaju fi Madiinat al-Khudus yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Achaan chiyya minhum bas gaa'idiin yi'ayyudu al-iid da hasab maktuub fi l-Tawraat.
Wa l-murassaliin jaro be l-jawaabaat al-kataboohum al-malik wa masaa'iilah.Wa waddoohum le kulla Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza wa yihajju leehum.Wa hasab amur al-malik,buguulu-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil,intu al-nijiitu min iid malik balad Achuur-!Wajjuhu ale Allah Rabb juduudku Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub wa be da,hu yiwajjih leeku.
Ma tabgo misil abbahaatku wa akhwaanku al-iso Allah Rabb juduudhum-!Allah dammaraahum misil intu gaa'idiin tichiifuuh.
Wa hassa' da,ma tigawwu ruuseeku misil abbahaatku.Laakin middu iideeku le Allah wa ta'aalu le beetah al-mukhaddas al-hu khaddasah ila l-abad.A'abudu Allah Ilaahku wa hu yarfa' minku khadabah.
Achaan kan wajjahtu ale Allah,akhwaanku wa akhwaatku yalgo al-rahma min al-naas al-karaboohum wa waddoohum masaajiin wa yikhalluuhum yigabbulu fi l-balad di.Achaan Allah Ilaahku hu al-Rahmaan al-Rahiim wa ma yikhalliiku abadan kan intu wajjahtu aleyah.
Wa khalaas,al-murassaliin macho min hille le hille fi ard gabaayil Afraayim wa Manassa wa Zabuluun.Wa naas waahidiin gaa'idiin yadhako wa yichchammato fooghum.
Wa laakin waahidiin min gabaayil Achiir wa Manassa wa Zabuluun maskano nufuushum wa macho Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi balad Yahuuza kula,al-Rabb antaahum galib waahid le yitabbugu amur al-malik wa masaa'iilah hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa l-cha'ab lammo katiiriin fi Madiinat al-Khudus le yi'ayyudu iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara fi l-chahar al-taani.Wa lammo mujtama' kabiir marra waahid.
Wa humman gammo haddamo madaabih al-asnaam al-fi lubb al-madiina.Wa chaalo al-makhaabir hana l-bakhuur kula wa daffagoohum fi waadi Khidruun.
Wa ba'ad da,humman dabaho le iid al-Fisha fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar al-taani.Wa l-eeb karabaahum le rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-lissaa'hum ma mukhassasiin.Wa ajala ke,gammo khassaso nufuushum achaan yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin fi beet Allah.
