Wa humman wagafo fi bakaanhum misil fi l-aade wa da muwaafig le Tawraat Muusa abd Allah.Wa l-Laawiyiin yijiibu damm al-dahaaya wa rujaal al-diin yuruchchuuh fi l-madbah.
Wa katiiriin min al-cha'ab ma khassaso nufuushum.Wa fi chaan da,al-Laawiyiin gaddamo dahaaya iid al-Fisha fi gadd al-cha'ab al-ma taahiriin achaan lissaa'hum ma khassaso nufuushum le Allah.
Wa katiir min al-cha'ab min gabaayil Afraayim wa Manassa wa Yassaakar wa Zabuluun lissaa'hum ma taahiriin.Wa wakit akalo akil hana iid al-Fisha,humman ma karramo al-chart al-maktuub.Wa laakin Hizkhiiya chahad Allah fi chaanhum wa gaal-:-Ya Allah al-Rahiim-!Akhfir
le kulla l-naas al-chaalo niiye le yitaabu'uuk inta al-Rabb,Allah Rabb juduudhum,kan ma tahharo wa la khassaso nufuushum kula.
Wa Allah khibil su'aal Hizkhiiya wa raham al-cha'ab.
Wa Bani Israa'iil ga'ado fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa ayyado be farha kabiire iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara le muddit sab'a yoom.Wa kulla yoom,al-Laawiyiin wa rujaal al-diin yachkuru Allah be aalaat al-musiikha al-chadiid.
Wa Hizkhiiya chajja' kulla l-Laawiyiin al-induhum ikraam adiil le Allah.Wa fi muddit sab'a yoom,humman akalo akil al-iid wa gaddamo dahaaya salaama wa dahaaya aakhariin wa chakaro Allah Rabb juduudhum.
Wa l-mujtama' achchaawaro le yiziidu sab'a yoom ale ayyaam al-iid da.Wa ayyado battaan sab'a yoom be farha.
Wa Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza anta al-mujtama' 1-000 toor wa 7-000 khanam.Wa masaa'iilah kula antoohum 1-000 toor wa 10-000 khanam.Wa katiir min rujaal al-diin kula khassaso nufuushum.
Wa kulluhum firho,kulla mujtama' balad Yahuuza wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa kulla l-cha'ab wa l-ajaanib al-jo min Bani Israa'iil wa kulluhum al-saakniin fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa l-farha di bigat chadiide fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan min wakit Suleymaan wileed Dawuud malik Bani Israa'iil,ma fi iid misil da bigi fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa ba'ad da,rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin gammo wa baarako al-cha'ab.Wa hissuhum ansama' wa du'aahum wassal lahaddi l-sama fi l-maskan al-mukhaddas al-saakin foogah Allah.
Wa wakit ayyado al-iid da khalaas,kulla Bani Israa'iil al-haadiriin macho fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa ramo al-hujaar al-khazzoohum le l-ibaada wa kassaro al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira wa haddamo al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa l-madaabih al-fi kulla ard gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa Afraayim wa Manassa.Wa ba'ad da,kulla Bani Israa'iil gabbalo fi hillaalhum,ayyi waahid fi ard warasatah.
Wa Hizkhiiya nazzam rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin be majmuu'aathum wa anta le ayyi waahid khidimtah fi majmuu'tah.Wa khattaahum fi fadaayit beet Allah achaan rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa dahaaya al-salaama wa yakhdumu le Allah wa yachkuruuh wa yahmuduuh.
Wa l-malik yanti min maalah le l-dahaaya al-muharragiin.Wa dool al-dahaaya al-muharragiin hana l-fajur wa l-achiiye wa kulli yoom al-sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa kulli iid.Wa da misil maktuub fi Tawraat Allah.
Wa amar al-cha'ab al-saakniin fi Madiinat al-Khudus le yantu al-gisim al-waajib le rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin achaan yikhassusu nufuushum le khidmit Allah hasab Tawraat Allah.
Wa wakit sim'o al-kalaam da,Bani Israa'iil jaabo awwal intaajhum be katara min al-gameh wa l-khamar wa l-dihin wa l-asal wa min kulla cheyy al-harato fi ziraa'ithum.Wa jaabo al-uchur hana kulla intaajhum be katara.
Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza al-saakniin fi hillaal balad Yahuuza,humman kula jaabo al-uchur hana bagarhum wa khanamhum.Wa jaabo al-uchuur hana l-dahaaya al-mukhassasiin le Allah Ilaahhum.Wa jaabo achya katiiriin wa khattoohum koom koom.
Wa fi l-chahar al-taalit,bado yilimmu al-achya dool be kiimaan wa kammalo al-lammiin fi l-chahar al-saabi'.
Wa wakit Hizkhiiya wa masaa'iilah jo wa chaafo al-kiimaan dool,baarako Allah wa chakaro cha'abah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Hizkhiiya sa'alaahum le rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin min al-kiimaan dool.
Wa khalaas,Azarya kabiir rujaal al-diin,hu al-min gabiilat Saduukh,radda wa gaal-:-Min al-cha'ab bado yijiibu al-hadaaya dool fi beet Allah,aniina gaa'idiin naakulu wa nachba'o lahaddi yifaddil.Achaan Allah baarak cha'abah wa daahu al-fadle gaa'ide be katara.
Wa Hizkhiiya amar yabnu makhaazin fi beet Allah.Wa wakit banoohum khalaas,
jaabo be amaan al-hadaaya wa l-uchuur wa l-dahaaya al-mukhassasiin.Wa Kananya al-Laawi,hu bas mas'uul fi l-hadaaya dool wa akhuuh Chim'i naaybah.
Wa Yahiyiil wa Azazya wa Nahat wa Asaahiil wa Yarimuut wa Yuuzabaad wa Aliyiil wa Yismakya wa Mahat wa Banaaya,humman dool muraakhibiin tihit mas'uuliiyit Kananya wa akhuuh Chim'i.Wa da hasab al-amur hana l-malik Hizkhiiya wa Azarya mas'uul beet Allah.
Wa Khuuri al-Laawi wileed Yimna,hu haaris hana l-baab al-sabhaani.Wa battaan hu mas'uul fi l-hadaaya al-yigaddumuuhum be niiye le l-Rabb wa yigassim al-hadaaya al-jaaboohum le Allah wa l-dahaaya al-mukhaddasiin.
Wa l-Laawiyiin al-gaa'idiin tihit mas'uuliiytah,humman Idaan wa Minyaamiin wa Yachuu' wa Chama'ya wa Amarya wa Chakanya.Wa fi hillaal rujaal al-diin,humman bas yigassumu al-akil be amaan le akhwaanhum hasab majmuu'aathum,le ayyi raajil diin,kabiir walla sakhayyar.
Wa gassamo akil le ayyi raajil al-sajjalooh,min umur 3 sana wa foog,wa le kulla l-naas al-yaju fi beet Allah kulla yoom le yisawwu khidmithum hasab majmuu'aathum.
Sajjalo rujaal al-diin hasab aayilaathum.Wa l-Laawiyiin kamaan,sajjaloohum min umur 20 sana wa foog hasab khidmithum wa majmuu'aathum.
Wa sajjalo kulla naas beethum,awiin wa awlaad wa banaat,wa kulla aayilaathum achaan humman khassaso nufuushum be amaan le khidmit al-bakaan al-mukhaddas.
Wa waahidiin min rujaal al-diin al-min zurriiyit Haaruun aaychiin fi bakaanaat al-sarha hawaale hillaal rujaal al-diin.Wa fi ayyi hille,azalo rujaal be usumhum le yantu al-gisim al-magtuu' le ayyi dakar min kulla rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-sajjaloohum fi l-tasjiil.
Wa Hizkhiiya sawwa misil ke fi kulla balad Yahuuza.Hu sawwa al-kheer wa l-adil wa l-hagg giddaam Allah Ilaahah.
Wa fi kulla khidme al-gamma sawwaaha le beet Allah,hu tabbag al-wasaaya wa l-gawaaniin.Hu taaba' al-Rabb be kulla galbah wa be da,hu ligi al-najaah.
Wa ba'ad Hizkhiiya kammal kulla l-khidme di be amaan,Sanhariib malik balad Achuur hajam al-mudun al-gawiyiin hana mamlakat Yahuuza le yichiilhum.
Wakit Hizkhiiya irif kadar Sanhariib indah niiye le yihaarib Madiinat al-Khudus,
hu achchaawaro ma'a masaa'iilah wa furraasah le yadfunu kulla uyuun al-almi al-gaa'idiin barra min al-madiina.Wa humman saa'adooh.
Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid lammo wa dafano uyuun almi wa l-majra al-yijiib almi al-balad achaan gaalo-:-Maala muluuk balad Achuur yaju wa yalgo almi be ziyaada-?
Wa Hizkhiiya chadda heelah wa addal kulla durdur al-hille al-mukassar wa gawwam buyuut tuwaal hana muraakhaba.Wa bana durdur jadiid barra min durdur al-madiina wa gawwa durdur al-difaa' al-sammooh Millu al-fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa sana' silaah wa darag be katara.
Wa Hizkhiiya khatta kubaaraat al-askar fi raas al-cha'ab wa lamma ma'aahum fi l-naga'a jamb khachum baab al-madiina.Wa chajja'aahum wa gaal-:
Abgo chudaad wa fahaliin-!Ma takhaafo wa la tinbahtu giddaam malik balad Achuur wa giddaam al-askar al-katiiriin al-ma'aayah.Achaan al-ma'aana akbar min al-ma'aayah-!
Al-malik da indah ma'aayah naas bas wa laakin aniina indina ma'aana Allah Ilaahna al-yafza'na wa yihaarib leena. Wa kalaam Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza da chajja' kulla l-cha'ab.
Wa ba'ad da,wakit Sanhariib malik balad Achuur wa kulla askarah gaa'idiin fi hillit Lakiich,hu gamma rassal murassaliin le Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa le kulla l-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa kubaaraathum gaalo leehum-:
Daahu kalaam Sanhariib malik balad Achuur.Hu gaal-:--Intu atwakkaltu ale yaatu wa ga'adtu fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi wakit al-hisaar-?
Hizkhiiya gaa'id yukhuchchuku wa yaktulku be l-juu' wa l-atach.Wa hu gaa'id yuguul leeku-:"Allah Ilaahna yinajjiina min iid malik balad Achuur-!"
Laakin da Hizkhiiya bas al-haddam al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa l-madaabih hana ibaadat Allah-!Wa hu sawwa misil da achaan yidoor naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus yasjudu wa yiharrugu bakhuur fi madbah waahid bas.
--Ma simi'tu be l-cheyy al-sawweenaah ana wa juduudi muluuk balad Achuur le kulla chu'uub al-ard-?Hal ilaahaat umam al-buldaan dool gidro najjo buldaanhum min iidi ana walla-?
Min kulla ilaahaat al-umam al-juduudi dammaroohum,yaatu al-gidir najja cha'abah min iidi-?Wa be da,hal ilaahku intu yagdar yinajjiiku min iidi ana walla-?
Wa hassa' da,khalli Hizkhiiya ma yakdib leeku wa la yukhuchchuku.Ma tisaddugu kalaamah achaan ma fi ilaah hana ayyi umma walla mamlaka al-gidir yinajji cha'abah min iidi ana walla min iid juduudi.Wa be da,ilaahaatku kula ma yagdaro yinajjuuku min iidi ana-!-
Wa murassaliin malik Sanhariib taaba'o fi kalaamhum didd Allah al-Rabb wa didd Hizkhiiya abdah.
Wa l-malik Sanhariib kula katab jawaabaat al-ayyar fooghum Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil wa gaal-:-Misil kulla ilaahaat umam al-buldaan ma gidro najjo cha'abhum min iidi,ilaah Hizkhiiya kula ma yagdar yinajji cha'abah min iidi.
Wa murassaliin Sanhariib yihajju be hiss aali be lukhkha hana Bani Yahuuza le cha'ab Madiinat al-Khudus al-gaa'idiin fi l-durdur achaan yikhawwufuuhum wa yirajjufuuhum le yagdaro yichiilu al-madiina.
Wa humman gaa'idiin yihajju be Ilaah Madiinat al-Khudus misil hu waahid min al-ilaahaat hana chu'uub al-ard,al-sana'aahum al-insaan.
Wa l-malik Hizkhiiya wa l-nabi Icha'ya wileed Ammuus gammo chahado Allah fi chaan kalaam al-murassaliin dool.Wa sarakho le l-Rabb achaan yafza'hum.
Wa khalaas,Allah rassal malak wa dammar kulla l-rujaal al-furraas wa l-kubaaraat wa l-khuyyaad al-fi l-mu'askar hana malik balad Achuur.Wa khalaas,malik balad Achuur gamma gabbal baladah be eeb.Wakit wisil hinaak,macha le beet ilaahah wa waahidiin min iyaalah halaalah macho waraayah wa katalooh be l-seef.
Wa be misil da,Allah najja Hizkhiiya wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus min iid Sanhariib malik balad Achuur wa min kulla udwaanhum al-aakhariin.Wa antaahum al-raaha min kulli jiihe.
Wa naas katiiriin yijiibu hadaaya le Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa hadaaya khaaliyiin le Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa min al-wakit da,usum Hizkhiiya bigi aali wa mukarram giddaam kulla l-umam.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Hizkhiiya mirid marad chadiid lahaddi gariib yumuut.Wa chahad Allah wa hu anta alaama al-tadman leyah al-chifa.
Wa laakin Hizkhiiya ma chakar Allah le l-kheer al-hu sawwaah leyah achaan hu astakbar.Wa be sabab da,Allah khidib leyah hu wa le balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa ba'ad da,Hizkhiiya wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus maskano nufuushum min al-istikbaar.Wa be da,Allah ma nazal khadabah fooghum fi muddit hayaat Hizkhiiya.
Hizkhiiya indah maal wa charaf katiir marra waahid.Wa bana makhaazin le l-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-hujaar al-khaaliyiin wa l-dukhkhaan wa l-darag wa l-khumaam al-khaali.
Wa battaan bana makhaazin al-yusubbu foogah intaaj al-gameh wa khamar wa dihin.Wa bana door le l-bahaayim wa zaraayib le l-khanam.
Wa bana leyah hillaal wa indah khanam wa bagar katiir achaan al-Rabb antaah maal katiir marra waahid.
Wa da Hizkhiiya bas al-dafan uyuun almi Gihuun wa nakat hafiir le yiwaddi almiihum kharib daakhil madiinat Dawuud.Wa Hizkhiiya najah fi kulla cheyy al-gaa'id yisawwiih.
Wa yoom waahid,kubaaraat balad Baabil rassalo naas le yi'akkudu min al-ajaayib al-bigo fi l-balad di.Wa laakin wakit ziyaarithum,al-Rabb khallaah le Hizkhiiya wiheedah achaan yijarribah wa ya'arif kulla cheyy al-fi galbah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Hizkhiiya wa amaanah le l-Rabb maktuubiin fi kitaab muluuk Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil wa battaan fi kitaab Ru'yat al-nabi Icha'ya wileed Ammuus.
Wa Hizkhiiya maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh gariib le l-derib al-taali' ale khubuur zurriiyit Dawuud.Wa fi mootah,kulla naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus charrafooh.Wa wileedah Manassa hakam fi badalah.
Wa Manassa indah 12 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 55 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.Hu sawwa nafs al-muharramaat al-sawwoohum al-umam al-Allah gala' minhum arduhum wa antaaha le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa hu bana battaan al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada al-abuuh Hizkhiiya haddamaahum.Wa bana madaabih le ilaah Ba'al wa khazza iidaan le ibaadat Achiira wa sajad giddaam kulla khuwwaat al-sama wa abadhum.
Wa bana leehum madaabih fi lubb beet Allah wa da l-bakaan al-Allah gaal foogah-:-Fi Madiinat al-Khudus bas,nukhutt usmi ila l-abad.
Wa Manassa zaatah harrag awlaadah fi l-naar le l-asnaam fi waadi Bani Hinnuum.Wa macha le l-chaddaara wa l-chawwaafiin wa l-sahhaariin wa l-naas al-yikallumu ma'a l-maytiin wa l-jannaaniyiin.Wa gaa'id yikhaddib Allah ziyaada be l-fasaala al-hu sawwaaha.
Wa hu khatta fi beet Allah sanam al-hu najarah.Wa da fi lubb al-beet al-hajja foogah al-Rabb le Dawuud wa le wileedah Suleymaan wa gaal-:-Ana nukhutt usmi ila l-abad foog al-beet da wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus al-madiina al-ana azaltaha min kulla mudun gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa battaan ma natrud Bani Israa'iil min al-ard al-ana anteetha le juduudhum kan humman yahfado wa yitabbugu kulla wasiiyaati wa churuuti wa gawaaniini al-amartuhum beehum be waasitat Muusa.
Wa laakin Manassa lazzaahum le naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus le yisawwu al-fasaala ziyaada min al-umam al-dammaraahum Allah giddaam Bani Israa'iil.
Allah hajja le Manassa wa cha'abah wa laakin humman ma khatto baalhum.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah gawwam didduhum khuyyaad askar malik balad Achuur.Wa karabooh le Manassa wa dasso leyah hadiid mukanjar wa rabatooh be jinziir hana nahaas matbuug wa waddooh Baabil.
Wa wakit gaa'id fi l-diige,Manassa baka le Allah Ilaahah wa maskan nafsah giddaam Allah Rabb juduudah.
Wa Manassa sa'al Allah wa hu rahamah wa khibil du'aayah wa gabbalah fi Madiinat al-Khudus le yahkim battaan.Wa be misil da,Manassa irif kadar Allah hu bas al-Ilaah.
Wa ba'ad da,hu bana durdur tawiil be barra le madiinat Dawuud.Wa l-durdur da gamma min al-nuss al-kharbaani le rijil Gihuun wa maachi fi l-waadi lahaddi baab al-Huut wa muhawwig haarat Ufal.Wa Manassa khatta khuyyaad al-askar fi kulla l-mudun al-gawiyiin hana balad Yahuuza.
Wa hu marag min beet Allah kulla l-ilaahaat al-ajnabiyiin wa l-sanam al-awwal najarah wa khattaah daakhal.Wa haddam kulla l-madaabih al-banaahum fi jabal beet Allah wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa daffagaahum barra min al-madiina.
Wa hu addal madbah Allah wa gaddam foogah dahaaya salaama wa dahaaya chukur.Wa amar naas balad Yahuuza khalli ya'abudu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-cha'ab lissaa'hum gaa'idiin yigaddumu dahaayaahum fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin laakin da,le Allah Ilaahhum bas.
Wa l-baagi min amal Manassa wa salaatah le Ilaahah wa l-kalaam al-kallamooh leyah al-anbiya al-yichiifu ru'ya be usum Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa salaatah al-khibilha Allah wa zunuubah wa isyaanah wa l-buna hana l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin al-khazza fooghum iidaan le ibaadat Achiira wa l-asnaam,dool kulla maktuubiin fi kitaab al-anbiya al-yichiifu be ru'ya.
Wa Manassa maat wa lihig abbahaatah wa dafanooh fi ard warasatah.Wa wileedah Aamuun hakam fi badalah.
Aamuun indah 22 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam santeen fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Aamuun kula sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah misil abuuh Manassa.Hu gaddam dahaaya wa abad kulla l-asnaam al-sawwaahum abuuh Manassa.
Wa laakin Aamuun ma maskan nafsah giddaam Allah misil abuuh Manassa sawwaah wa hu khata ziyaada min abuuh.
Wa masaa'iilah atmarrado diddah wa katalooh fi lubb beetah.
Wa Yuuchiiya indah 8 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 31 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu sawwa al-adiil giddaam Allah.Hu taaba' al-derib al-adiil hana jiddah Dawuud wa ma baara minnah wa la ale l-zeene wa la ale l-isra.
Wa fi l-sana al-taamne hana hukmah wakit hu lissaa' sabi,bada yitaabi' Allah Rabb jiddah Dawuud.Wa fi l-sana 12 hana hukmah,gamma yitahhir balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus min al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada wa min al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira wa l-asnaam wa l-tamaasiil hana hadiid.
Wa fi giddaamah bas,haddamo al-madaabih hana ilaah Ba'al wa l-makhaabir al-yiharrugu fooghum al-bakhuur al-gaa'idiin be foog al-madaabih.Wa gata' al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira wa kassar al-asnaam wa l-tamaasiil hana hadiid wa rihikaahum dagiig wa chattat al-dagiig da fi l-khubuur hana l-naas al-gaddamo leehum dahaaya.
Wa hu harrag udaam rujaal al-diin hana l-asnaam fi raas madaabihhum le yinajjishum.Wa be misil da,hu tahhar balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa ba'ad da,hu macha fi l-munchaakh fi hillaal gabaayil Manassa wa Afraayim wa Chim'uun wa lahaddi hillaal gabiilat Naftaali wa l-manaatig al-mujaawiriinhum.
Wa hu haddam al-madaabih wa gata' al-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira wa kassar al-sanam wa rihikaahum dagiig wa kassar kulla l-makhaabir al-fi kulla balad Israa'iil.Wa ba'ad da,gabbal Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi sanit 18 hana hukmah ba'ad tahhar al-balad wa beet Allah,al-malik Yuuchiiya rassal talaata naas le yi'addulu beet Allah Ilaahah.Wa humman Chaafaan wileed Asalya wa Ma'asiiya haakim al-madiina wa Yuwaakh wileed Yuwaahaz al-kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik.
Wa humman macho le Hilkhiiya kabiir rujaal al-diin.Wa jaabo fi beet Allah al-fudda al-lammooha al-Laawiyiin hurraas madkhal beet Allah min naas gabaayil Manassa wa Afraayim wa min kulla naas mamlakat Israa'iil al-faddalo wa min kulla naas gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa kulla sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-fudda di,antooha le l-naas al-mukallafiin be khidmit adiiliin beet Allah.Wa kaffo beeha al-khaddaamiin al-yakhdumu fi beet Allah le yi'addulu wa yigawwu al-beet da.
Wa anto min al-fudda di le l-khachchaabiin wa l-bannaayiin achaan yachru beeha al-hujaar al-magtuu'iin wa l-maraadiis al-yisabbutu beehum al-buyuut achaan awwal muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza khalloohum yilhaddamo.
Wa l-naas dool khadamo be amaan.Wa kallafo fooghum muraakhibiin min al-Laawiyiin wa humman Yahat wa Ubadya min zurriiyit Maraari wa Zakariiya wa Machullam min zurriiyit Gahaat.Wa l-Laawiyiin al-ya'arfu daribiin aalaat al-musiikha
mukallafiin foog al-naggaaliin wa yiraakhubu fi kulla l-khaddaamiin al-yisawwu ayyi khidme.Wa waahidiin min al-Laawiyiin kuttaab wa waahidiin muraakhibiin wa waahidiin hurraas biibaan.
Wa wakit marago al-fudda al-jaabooha fi beet Allah,Hilkhiiya raajil al-diin ligi kitaab al-Tawraat al-Allah amaraahum be waasitat Muusa.
Wa Hilkhiiya gaal le Chaafaan al-kaatib-:-Ana ligiit kitaab al-Tawraat fi beet Allah. Wa Hilkhiiya anta al-kitaab da le Chaafaan.
Wa Chaafaan jaab al-kitaab da le l-malik wa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Masaa'iilak sawwo kulla cheyy al-amaroohum beyah.
Humman sallamo al-fudda al-ligooha fi beet Allah le l-mukallafiin wa l-khaddaamiin.
Wa Chaafaan al-kaatib gaal battaan le l-malik-:-Wa Hilkhiiya raajil al-diin antaani kitaab waahid. Wa hu gara al-kitaab da le l-malik.
Wa wakit al-malik simi' kalaam al-Tawraat da,charrat khulgaanah min al-hizin.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik amar Hilkhiiya wa Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan wa Abduun wileed Miika wa Chaafaan al-kaatib wa Asaaya waahid min masaa'iil al-malik wa gaal leehum-:
Amchu as'alo Allah leyi ana wa le naas mamlakat Israa'iil al-faddalo wa le naas mamlakat Yahuuza be sabab al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-ligooh.Achaan khadab Allah chadiid bilheen diddina achaan juduudna ma karramo kalaam Allah wa ma tabbago al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-kitaab da.
Wa khalaas,Hilkhiiya wa murassaliin al-malik macho bakaan Hulda al-nabiiye marit al-haaris hana khulgaan rujaal al-diin al-usmah Challuum wileed Tugahaat wileed Hasra.Wa hi saakne fi l-haara al-jadiide hana Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit humman wassalo,hajjo leeha be l-kalaam da.
Wa Hulda al-nabiiye gaalat leehum-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal tamchu tuguulu le l-raajil al-rassalaaku leyi-:
--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Akiid ana nijiib masiibe fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi sukkaanha.Wa da yihaggig kulla kalaam al-la'ana al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-garooh le malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa da fi chaan cha'abi abooni wa harrago bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin wa khaddabooni be kulla amalhum al-sawwooh.Wa khadabi yanzil fi l-madiina di wa ana ma niwaggifah."--
Wa hassa' da,amchu guulu al-kalaam da le malik mamlakat Yahuuza al-rassalaaku tas'alo leyah Allah.Wa guulu leyah-:--Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Inta simi't kalaam al-kitaab da
wa galbak khaaf wa inta almaskant giddaami ana al-Rabb wakit inta simi't al-kalaam al-ana gultah didd Madiinat al-Khudus wa sukkaanha.Wa inta maskant nafsak giddaami wa charratt khulgaanak min al-hizin wa bakeet giddaami.Wa ana kula simi'tak.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa be sabab da,nikhalliik talhag abbahaatak be l-salaama wa yadfunuuk fi khaburak wa inta ma tichiif al-masiibe al-ana ninazzilha fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa sukkaanha."--Wa khalaas,al-murassaliin macho wa kallamo al-kalaam da le l-malik.
Wa tawwaali,malik Yuuchiiya naada kulla chuyuukh balad Yahuuza wa chuyuukh Madiinat al-Khudus le yilimmu.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik macha beet Allah ma'a kulla naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa kulla l-cha'ab min al-kubaar lahaddi l-dugaag.Wa hu gara leehum kulla l-kalaam al-fi kitaab al-mu'aahada al-ligooh fi beet Allah.
Wa l-malik wagaf fi bakaanah wa jaddad al-mu'aahada ma'a Allah.Waajib ayyi waahid yitaabi' Allah wa yahfad wasiiyaatah wa ta'liimah wa churuutah be kulla galbah wa be kulla fikrah wa yitabbig kalaam al-mu'aahada al-maktuub fi l-kitaab da.
Wa l-malik sawwa al-mu'aahada di le kulla sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa cha'ab Banyaamiin.Wa kulla sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus tabbago al-mu'aahada al-sawwaaha Allah Rabb juduudhum.
Wa Yuuchiiya marag kulla l-muharramaat al-fi kulla balad Bani Israa'iil wa amar kulla l-naas al-saakniin fi balad Israa'iil ya'abudu Allah Ilaahhum.Wa be misil da,humman ma tarrafo min derib Allah Rabb juduudhum fi kulla muddit hayaat Yuuchiiya.
Wa Yuuchiiya ayyad iid al-Fisha hana Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar al-awwal,dabaho bahaayim le l-iid da.
Wa hu sabbat rujaal al-diin fi khidmithum wa chajja'aahum fi khidmit beet Allah.
Wa hu hajja le l-Laawiyiin al-mukallafiin le yi'allumu kulla cha'ab Bani Israa'iil wa mukhassasiin fi khidmit Allah.Wa gaal leehum-:-Khuttu al-sanduug al-mukhaddas hana Allah fi l-beet al-banaah Suleymaan wileed Dawuud malik Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-sanduug da ma tihawwuluuh battaan.Wa hassa' da,akhdumu le Allah Ilaahku wa le Bani Israa'iil cha'abah.
Nazzumu nufuusku ale hasab aayilaatku wa majmuu'aatku hasab al-chart al-katabah Dawuud malik Bani Israa'iil wa wileedah Suleymaan.
Wa agiifu be majmuu'aat aayilaatku fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas achaan tisaa'udu akhwaanku naas al-cha'ab.Agiifu hasab al-nizaam hana aayilaat al-Laawiyiin.
Waajib tadbaho bahaayim le iid al-Fisha wa tikhassusu nufuusku le tisaa'udu akhwaanku wa titabbugu al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah be waasitat Muusa.
Wa min khanamah,Yuuchiiya antaahum le cha'abah 30-000 humlaan wa sukhlaan le dahaaya hana iid al-Fisha wa 3-000 bagar kula.Wa kulla l-bahaayim dool min maalah halaalah.
Wa masaa'iil al-malik kula anto be niiyithum bahaayim le l-cha'ab wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin.Wa Hilkhiiya wa Zakariiya wa Yahiyiil masaa'iil beet Allah kula antoohum le rujaal al-diin 2-600 khanam wa 300 bagar le iid al-Fisha.
Wa kubaaraat al-Laawiyiin,humman Kunanya wa Chama'ya wa Nataniil wa akhwaanah Hachabya wa Ya'iyiil wa Yuuzabaad,anto le l-Laawiyiin 5-000 khanam wa 500 bagar le iid al-Fisha.
Wa l-khidme di nazzamooha misil da.Rujaal al-diin ga'ado fi bakaanaathum wa l-Laawiyiin fi majmuu'aathum hasab amur al-malik.
Wa dabaho al-bahaayim hana iid al-Fisha wa anto al-damm le rujaal al-diin wa humman rachcho al-damm da fi l-madbah.Wa l-Laawiyiin kamaan salakho al-bahaayim.
Wa khatto taraf gisim al-bagar al-waajib yigaddumuuhum dahaaya muharragiin le Allah hana ayyi aayila min ayyi khachum beet misil maktuub fi kitaab Muusa.
Wa rakkabo khanam le iid al-Fisha fi l-naar hasab al-churuut.Wa rakkabo al-dahaaya al-mukhaddasiin fi l-buraam wa l-kalaayil wa l-guduur.Wa tawwaali,gassamo al-laham da le kulla l-cha'ab.
Wa ba'ad da,al-Laawiyiin jahhazo gisim hanaahum humman wa hana rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Haaruun achaan rujaal al-diin dool machkhuuliin be gaddimiin al-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa l-chaham lahaddi l-leel.Wa fi chaan da bas,al-Laawiyiin jahhazo le nufuushum wa le rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Haaruun.
Wa l-khannaayiin al-min zurriiyit Asaaf ga'ado fi bakaanhum hasab amur Dawuud wa Asaaf wa Heemaan wa Yaduutuun mustachaariin al-malik.Al-hurraas kula ga'ado fi bakaanaathum fi ayyi baab.Wa ma waajib humman yikhallu khidmithum wa be sabab da,akhwaanhum al-Laawiyiin gaa'idiin yijahhuzu leehum akilhum.
Wa da l-nizaam hana kulla l-khidme hana beet Allah fi l-yoom da achaan yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha wa yigaddumu dahaaya muharragiin fi madbah Allah.Wa da kulla hasab amur al-malik Yuuchiiya.
Wa Bani Israa'iil al-haadiriin ayyado iid al-Fisha fi l-wakit da wa ayyado iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara le muddit sab'a yoom.
Wa abadan ma ayyado iid al-Fisha misil da fi balad Israa'iil min wakit al-nabi Samuwiil.Wa ma fi malik fi kulla balad Israa'iil al-ayyad iid al-Fisha misil Yuuchiiya ayyadah.Yuuchiiya ayyadah ma'a rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa kulla naas mamlakat Yahuuza wa naas mamlakat Israa'iil al-hidro wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa da fi sanit 18 hana hukum Yuuchiiya bas al-ayyado foogah iid al-Fisha da.
Wa yoom waahid ba'ad Yuuchiiya addal beet Allah,Naku malik balad Masir gamma le yihaarib fi hillit Karkamiich fi bahar al-Furaat.Wa Yuuchiiya macha le yiwajjihah fi l-derib.
Wa l-malik Naku rassal leyah murassaliin wa gaal-:-Chunu fi ambeenaatna,ya malik mamlakat Yahuuza-?Da ma diddak inta ya ana jaayi al-yoom laakin ana jaayi nihaarib aduuyi wa l-sama gaal leyi namchi ajala.Wa inta kamaan,ma tagiif didd gudrat al-sama al-ma'aayi kan ma tidoor yaktulak.
Wa laakin Yuuchiiya ma khalla minnah fikrah hana l-harib wa aba ma yasma' kalaam Naku al-jaayi min al-Rabb.Wa khalaas,hu khayyar khulgaanah hana l-muluk achaan ma ya'arfuuh wa macha fi kadaadit Magiddu le yihaarib Naku.
Wa fi wakt al-harib,siyaad al-nuchchaab zarago nuchchaab wa darabooh le l-malik Yuuchiiya.Wa hu gaal le masaa'iilah-:-Amurguuni min al-harib achaan ana anjaraht katiir-!
Wa masaa'iilah maragooh min arabatah hint al-harib wa khattooh fi araba aakhara wa waddooh Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa Yuuchiiya maat wa dafanooh fi khabur juduudah.Wa kulla naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus hizno leyah.
Wa l-nabi Irmiya katab khine hana hizin le Yuuchiiya.Wa min al-wakit da,al-khannaayiin wa l-khannaayaat yikhannu be Yuuchiiya fi khineehum lahaddi l-yoom.Wa l-khine da bigi aade fi Israa'iil wa maktuub fi kitaab al-nuwaah.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yuuchiiya min al-bidaaya le l-nihaaya wa amalah hana l-kheer hasab al-maktuub fi Tawraat Allah,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab muluuk Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.
Wa cha'ab al-balad chaalooh le Yahaaz wileed Yuuchiiya wa darrajooh malik fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi badal abuuh.
Wa Yahaaz indah 23 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam talaata chahar fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Naku malik Masir nazzalah min hukmah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ziyaada min da,hu jabaraahum le naas mamlakat Yahuuza yikaffu leyah miiri hana 3-400 kiilo hana fudda wa 3-400 kiilo hana dahab.
Wa l-malik Naku darraj Aliyaakhim akhu Yahaaz malik fi balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus wa khayyar usmah wa sammaah Yahuuyakhim.Wa kan le Yahaaz al-masjuun kamaan,al-malik Naku chaalah wa waddaah Masir.
Wa Yahuuyakhim indah 25 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 11 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah Ilaahah.
Wa fi wakit hukmah,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja hajamah le Yahuuyakhim wa karabah wa janzarah be jinziir hana nahaas matbuug wa waddaah Baabil.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar wadda fi Baabil mu'iddaat waahidiin min beet Allah wa khattaahum fi gasrah fi Baabil.
Wa l-baagi min amal Yahuuyakhim wa kulla l-muharramaat al-sawwaahum wa kulla l-cheyy al-kaan leyah,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab muluuk Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.Wa wileedah Yuyakiin hakam fi badalah.
Wa Yuyakiin indah 8 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam talaata chahar wa achara yoom fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah.
Wa fi l-sana al-jadiide,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar rassal naas wa chaalo Yuyakiin wa khumaam khaaliyiin min beet Allah wa waddoohum Baabil.Wa darraj Sidkhiiya gariibah le Yuyakiin malik fi balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Sidkhiiya indah 21 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 11 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa hu sawwa al-fasaala giddaam Allah Ilaahah.Wa aba ma yimaskin nafsah giddaam al-nabi Irmiya wakit hu gaa'id yihajji leyah be kalaam jaayi min Allah.
Wa l-malik Nabuukhadnasar hallafah be sama wa be da kula,Sidkhiiya gamma atmarrad diddah.Wa gawwa raasah wa aba ma yasma' wa la yigabbil le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ziyaada min da,kulla kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa kubaaraat al-cha'ab iso marra waahid.Sawwo nafs al-muharramaat al-sawwoohum al-umam al-aakhariin wa najjaso beet Allah al-hu khaddasah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Allah Rabb juduudhum rassal leehum tahziir daayman be khuchuum al-murassaliin achaan hu hanna fi cha'abah wa fi maskanah.
Wa laakin cha'abah gaa'idiin yichchammato le murassaliin al-Rabb wa yankuru kalaamah wa yadhako fi l-anbiya dool lahaddi khadab Allah nazal fooghum wa lihigaahum wa ma nijo minnah.
Wa khalaas,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja wa katal subyaanhum fi lubb al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa ma hanna fi naadum wa la fi sabi wa la fi sabiiye wa la fi kabiir wa la chaayib.Kulluhum ke Allah sallamaahum leyah.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar chaal kulla l-mu'iddaat hana beet Allah,kubaar wa dugaag,wa kulla l-kanz min beet Allah wa min gasir al-malik wa min buyuut kubaaraatah.Wa wadda kulla l-khumaam da fi Baabil.
Wa harrago beet Allah wa haddamo durdur Madiinat al-Khudus wa tachcho kulla gusuurha wa dammaro kulla l-khumaam al-khaaliyiin.
Wa ba'ad da,wadda fi l-khurba fi Baabil kulla l-naas al-faddalo min al-katil.Wa hu sawwaahum abiid leyah hu wa le iyaalah lahaddi muluuk balad Faaris jo chaalo minhum al-hukum.
Wa be misil da,kalaam Allah alhaggag misil gaalah be khachum al-nabi Irmiya.Hu gaal-:-Al-balad yikhalluuha le muddit 70 sana lahaddi yitimmu al-ayyaam al-hi tinjamma fooghum.Wa be da,yikaffu kulla ayyaam al-sabt al-humman ma ahtaramoohum.
Wa fi l-sana al-awwal hana hukum Kuurach malik balad Faaris,Allah gamma le yihaggig kalaamah al-awwal gaalah be khachum al-nabi Irmiya.Wa Allah anta fikir le Kuurach malik balad Faaris.Wa be da,Kuurach kharrar fi kulla mamlakatah wa katab maktuub wa gaal-:
Daahu kalaami ana Kuurach malik balad Faaris.Nuguul leeku-:--Allah Rabb al-samaawaat antaani kulla mamaalik al-ard wa kallafaani achaan nabni leyah beet fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi balad Yahuuza.Khalli ayyi naadum min cha'abah yigabbil baladah.Wa Allah Ilaahah yukuun ma'aayah.-
Fi l-sana al-awwal hana hukum Kuurach malik balad Faaris,Allah gamma yihaggig kalaamah al-awwal gaalah be khachum al-nabi Irmiya.Wa Allah anta fikir le Kuurach malik balad Faaris wa be da,Kuurach kharrar fi kulla mamlakatah wa katab maktuub wa gaal-:
Daahu kalaami ana Kuurach malik balad Faaris.Allah Rabb al-samaawaat antaani kulla mamaalik al-ard wa kallafaani achaan nabni leyah beet fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi balad Yahuuza.
Khalli ayyi waahid min cha'abah yamchi fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi balad Yahuuza wa Ilaahah yukuun ma'aayah wa hinaak yabni beet Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa hu al-Ilaah al-ya'abuduuh fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan al-saakniin foogah cha'ab Bani Israa'iil fi l-khurba,khalli al-naas yisaa'uduuhum wa yantuuhum fudda wa dahab wa maal wa bahaayim wa hadaaya wa da yantuuh be niiyithum le beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa khalaas,kubaaraat gabaayil Yahuuza wa gabaayil Banyaamiin wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa ayyi naadum al-antaah al-Rabb fikir le yigabbil le Madiinat al-Khudus wa yabni beet Allah,dool kulluhum gaa'idiin yijahhuzu achaan yamchu.
Wa kulla jiiraanhum saa'adoohum wa antoohum mu'iddaat hana fudda wa dahab wa maal wa khumaam aakhar khaali wa bahaayim.Wa da bala l-musaa'ada al-antooha be niiyithum le beet Allah.
Wa mu'iddaat beet Allah al-awwal chaalaahum al-malik Nabuukhadnasar min Madiinat al-Khudus wa jaabaahum,dool gaa'idiin fi beet ilaahaatah.Wa l-mu'iddaat dool Kuurach malik balad Faaris anta izin le Mitradaat mas'uul al-makhaazin achaan yamrughum wa yahsibhum wa yantiihum le Chichbasar haakim balad Yahuuza.
Wa daahu adad al-mu'iddaat dool,humman 30 taasa hana dahab wa 1-000 taasa hana fudda wa 29 sakkiin
wa 30 kaas hana dahab wa 410 kiisaan aakhariin hana fudda wa 1-000 mu'iddaat aakhariin.
Wa mu'iddaat al-dahab wa l-fudda dool kulluhum ke adadhum 5-400.Chichbasar chaalaahum wa waddaahum ma'aayah wakit humman gabbalo min Baabil balad al-khurba wa macho le Madiinat al-Khudus.
Awwal Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil karab naas min balad Yahuuza wa waddaahum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.Wa ba'ad amur al-malik Kuurach,humman gabbalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi balad Yahuuza,ayyi waahid fi madiintah.
Wa l-naas dool jo ma'a Zarubaabil wa Yachuu' wa Nahamya wa Saraaya wa Ra'alaaya wa Mardakaay wa Bilchaan wa Misfaar wa Bigwaay wa Rahuum wa Ba'ana.Daahu adad rujaal Bani Israa'iil.

Daahu al-khannaayiin hana beet Allah.Humman min zurriiyit Asaaf wa adadhum 128 raajil.
Daahu hurraas al-biibaan hana beet Allah.Humman min zurriiyit Challuum wa Atiir wa Talmuun wa Akhuub wa Hatiit wa Chubaay wa kulluhum adadhum 139 raajil.
Daahu khaddaamiin beet Allah.Humman min zurriiyit Siiha wa Hasuuf wa Tabba'uut
wa Khiirus wa Sii'aha wa Faduun
