Daahu zurriiyit abiid al-malik Suleymaan.Humman min zurriiyit Sutaay wa Sufarat wa Fariid
wa Yaa'la wa Darkhuun wa Giddiil
wa Chafatya wa Hattiil wa Fukarat Hassabaayim wa Aami.
Wa zurriiyit khaddaamiin beet Allah wa zurriiyit abiid al-malik Suleymaan,kulluhum adadhum 392 raajil.
Wa laakin al-naas al-jo min hillit Hajar Mileh wa min hillit Hajar Harcha wa min hillit Karuub wa min hillit Addaan wa min hillit Immiir,humman ma gidro nasabo juduudhum wa la gidro jaabo daliil kadar humman maargiin min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa humman dool min zurriiyit Dalaaya wa zurriiyit Tuubiiya wa zurriiyit Naguuda wa kulluhum adadhum 652 raajil.
Wa waahidiin min rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Habaaya wa zurriiyit Hagguus wa zurriiyit Barzillaay kula ma gidro nasabo juduudhum.Al-naadum al-ma'ruuf be usum Barzillaay kamaan,hu akhad min banaat Barzillaay al-min turaab Gil'aad wa achaan da bas,sammooh be usum nasiibah.
Rujaal al-diin dool fattacho asaame juduudhum fi kutub al-tasjiil wa ma ligoohum.Achaan da,al-naas ja'aloohum nijsiin wa daharoohum ma yakhdumu khidmit rujaal al-diin.
Wa l-waali zaatah daharaahum ma yaakulu min al-akil al-mukhaddas lahaddi waahid min rujaal al-diin yaji yas'al leehum Allah be l-Uriim wa l-Tummiim wa yalga leehum halal.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-cha'ab al-gabbalo min al-khurba adadhum 42-360 raajil.
Wa da bala abiidhum wa khadiimhum al-adadhum 7-337 naas.Wa fi awiin wa rujaal al-yikhannu le Allah wa adadhum 200 naas.
Wa induhum 736 kheel wa 245 bikhaal
wa 435 jumaal wa 6-720 hamiir.
Wa misil ke,wakit wassalo fi beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus,waahidiin min kubaaraat al-aayilaat gammo anto hadaaya be niiyithum achaan yabnu beet Allah min jadiid fi bakaanah.
Ayyi waahid anta hasab gudurtah wa l-hadaaya al-antoohum be niiyithum le l-buna bigo 61-000 jineeh hana dahab wa ziyaada min 100-000 hajar fudda wa 100 khalag hana rujaal diin.
Wa be misil da,rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa waahidiin min al-cha'ab misil al-khannaayiin wa hurraas al-biibaan hana beet Allah wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah,dool kulluhum gabbalo wa jo sakano fi mudunhum.Wa misil da,kulla Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin fi mudunhum.
Wa wakit al-chahar al-saabi' ja,kulla Bani Israa'iil jo min mudunhum wa lammo fi Madiinat al-Khudus be galib waahid.
Wa Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh ma'a akhwaanah rujaal al-diin wa Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil ma'a akhwaanah,humman bano madbah le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil achaan yigaddumu foogah dahaaya muharragiin misil maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa abd Allah.
Wa humman khaayfiin min al-gabaayil al-muhawwigiinhum wa laakin be khoofhum da kula,bano al-madbah fi asaasah al-awwal.Wa gaddamo foogah dahaaya muharragiin le Allah.Wa dool dahaaya hana l-fajur wa hana l-achiiye.
Wa ayyado iid al-Lagaadiib misil maktuub fi kitaab al-Tawraat.Wa fi tuul ayyaam al-iid,kulla yoom yigaddumu dahaaya adad al-waajib hasab al-churuut.
Wa ba'ad al-iid,gaddamo dahiiye muharraga daayme wa dahiiye hana awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa dahiiye hana kulli yoom iid mukhaddas le Allah wa dahaaya hana l-naas al-antoohum be niiyithum.
Wa gabul asaas beet Allah ma khattooh,humman bado yigaddumu dahaaya muharragiin le Allah min al-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-saabi'.
Wa anto fudda le l-naas al-gata'o hujaar al-buna wa le l-khachchaabiin.Wa rassalo ma'aach wa charaab wa dihin le naas mudun Seeda wa Suur achaan yijiibu leehum khachab hana chadar al-arz min balad Lubnaan wa yiwadduuh be l-bahar lahaddi hillit Yaafa.Wa da kulla sawwooh be izin Kuurach malik balad Faaris.
Wa fi l-chahar al-taani hana l-sana al-taaniye ba'ad gabbalo min al-khurba,Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil wa Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh wa akhwaanhum rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin wa l-Laawiyiin wa kulla l-naas al-gabbalo min al-khurba,kulluhum jo fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa bado al-khidme.Wa wakkalo al-Laawiyiin al-umurhum min 20 sana wa foog achaan yiraakhubu buna beet Allah.
Wa Yachuu' al-min al-Laawiyiin ma'a iyaalah wa akhwaanah wa Khadmiyiil ma'a iyaalah al-min gabiilat Yahuuza,humman kulluhum yiraakhubu bannaayiin beet Allah.Wa Hinadaad al-min al-Laawiyiin ma'a iyaalah wa akhwaanah kula ma'aahum.
Wa wakit al-bannaayiin khatto asaas beet Allah,rujaal al-diin ga'ado ayyi waahid fi bakaanah be khulgaanah al-khaassiin wa be burunji fi iidah.Wa l-Laawiyiin min zurriiyit Asaaf ga'ado be nagaagiir achaan yahmudu Allah misil Dawuud malik Israa'iil zamaan amaraahum beyah.
Wa majmuu'a waahide minhum hamadat wa chakarat Allah be khine wa l-aakhariin rafa'o wa gaalo-:-Inta rahiim wa rahmatak daayme fi Israa'iil ila l-abad-! Wa kulla l-cha'ab gammo firho be ziyaada wa hamado Allah achaan khatto asaas beet Allah.
Wa laakin katiiriin min al-chiyyaab wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa kubaaraat al-aayilaat,wakit khatto asaas beet Allah giddaamhum,bako be hiss aali achaan humman chaafo beet Allah al-zamaani.Wa naas aakhariin kamaan aato be farha.
Wa l-naas ma gidro mayyazo min aayit al-farha wa min al-baki achaan kulla l-cha'ab gaa'idiin yi'iitu bilheen wa harakathum gaa'ide tinsami' min ba'iid.
Wa udwaan gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin sim'o kadar al-naas al-gabbalo min al-khurba gaa'idiin yabnu beet le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-udwaan dool macho le Zarubaabil wa kubaaraat aayilaat Bani Israa'iil wa gaabaloohum wa gaalo-:-Khalluuna nabnu ma'aaku achaan aniina kula misilku gaa'idiin na'abudu Ilaahku wa nigaddumu leyah dahaaya.Wa da min wakit Isar Hadduun malik balad Achuur jaabaana hini.
Wa laakin Zarubaabil wa Yachuu' wa kubaaraat aakhariin hana aayilaat Bani Israa'iil raddo leehum wa gaalo-:-Abadan ma tichaaruku ma'aana fi buna beet Ilaahna.Aniina wiheedna bas nabnu beet le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil misil Kuurach malik balad Faaris amaraana.
Wa misil da,naas al-balad gaa'idiin yikassuluuhum le cha'ab Bani Yahuuza wa yikhawwufuuhum le yadharoohum min al-buna.
Wa battaan ajjaro mustachaariin didduhum achaan yifachchulu barnaamijhum hana l-buna.Wa da min wakit hukum Kuurach malik balad Faaris lahaddi wakit hukum Daariyuus malik balad Faaris.
Wa fi bidaayit hukum al-malik Achawiruuch,udwaan al-Yahuud katabo leyah jawaab chakwa didd naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa battaan fi ayyaam Artahachta malik balad Faaris,Bichlaam wa Mitradaat wa Tabiil wa rufgaanhum al-aakhariin kula katabo le l-malik jawaab be l-lukhkha al-araamiiye wa tarjamooh leyah.
Wa battaan kula,Rahuum al-waali wa Chimchaay kaatib al-waali katabo jawaab le l-malik Artahachta didd sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa gaalo-:
Daahu jawaab hana Rahuum al-waali wa Chimchaay kaatib al-waali wa rufgaanhum al-aakhariin al-humman kubaaraat madiinat Diin wa madiinat Afarsitka wa madiinat Tarfil wa madiinat Afarsa wa madiinat Arak wa madiinat Baabil wa madiinat Chuucha wa madiinat Diiha wa madiinat Ilaam
wa chu'uub aakhariin al-waddaahum al-malik Asnaffar al-machhuur wa aziim fi hillaal balad Saamira wa fi l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat.
Wa daahu al-kalaam al-nuguulu le l-malik Artahachta.Aniina abiidak al-gaa'idiin fi l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat nikhabburuuk be l-kalaam da.
Al-Yahuud al-gabbalo minnak wa jo leena fi Madiinat al-Khudus dool gaa'idiin yabnu battaan madiinithum al-awwal ma'ruufa be sukkaanha al-mu'aaridiin wa fasliin.Humman gaa'idiin yi'addulu asaas al-durdur al-muhawwig al-madiina wa yikammuluuh.Al-khabar da,khalli al-malik yasma'ah.
Khalli al-malik yukhutt fi aglah kadar al-madiina di kan anbanat wa durdurha kammalooh,sukkaan al-madiina di battaan ma yikaffu miiri wa la zaka wa la ayyi cheyy al-waajib yikaffuuh le l-malik.Wa da yijiib darar fi sanduug al-malik.
Min akalna wa chiribna ma'a l-malik,aniina ma nardo leyah darar wa be da,ma nikhassudu cheyy fasil yaji le l-malik.Wa fi chaan da bas,aniina nantuuk al-khabar da
achaan tifattich kutub al-muluuk al-gubbaalak.Wa fi l-kutub dool,talga wa ta'arif kadar al-madiina di mu'aaride wa indaha darar le l-malik wa le manaatigah wa min zamaan kula sukkaanha mu'aaridiin bas.Wa achaan da bas,madiinithum alhaddamat.
Ya l-malik,aniina nikhabburuuk-!Kan al-Yahuud bano madiinithum di wa durdurha kula kammalooh,inta battaan ma indak hagg fi l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat.
Wa be misil da,al-malik radda fi jawaabhum wa gaal-:Le Rahuum al-waali wa le Chimchaay kaatib al-waali wa le rufgaanhum al-aakhariin al-saakniin fi balad Saamira wa fi l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat.
Al-jawaab al-rassaltuuh leena da garooh wa tarjamooh leyi.
Amarna naas le yifattuchu fi kutub al-muluuk wa humman ligo kadar sahiih ke,al-madiina di min zamaan kula mu'aaride didd al-muluuk wa sukkaanha mu'aaridiin.
Wa l-madiina di zamaan indaha muluuk gawiyiin al-hakamo kulla l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat wa l-naas kaffo leehum al-miiri wa l-zaka wa ayyi cheyy al-waajib yikaffuuh le l-malik.
Wa misil da,ooruuhum le l-naas al-gaa'idiin yabnu achaan yikhallu al-buna wa l-madiina di ma tinbani illa be izni.
Angar'u-!Ma tal'abo be amri da wa la tikhallu al-fasaala di tiziid wa tisabbib darar fi sanduug al-malik.
Wa min garo leehum kalaam al-jawaab hana l-malik Artahachta,Rahuum wa Chimchaay al-kaatib wa rufgaanhum macho ajala ke le l-Yahuud fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa be gu,waggafoohum min al-buna.
Wa misil da,khidmit buna beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wagafat wa gaa'ide waagfe lahaddi fi l-sana al-taaniye hana Daariyuus malik balad Faaris.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-anbiya Zakariiya al-min zurriiyit Iddu wa Haggaay atnabba'ole l-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi balad Yahuuza wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus be usum Allah Rabb Bani Israa'iil wa hu Ilaahhum.
Wa khalaas,Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil wa Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh gammo yabnu battaan beet Allah al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa anbiya Allah gaa'idiin ma'aahum sawa wa yisaa'uduuhum.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Tattanaay al-waali hana l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat wa Chatar Buuznaay wa rufgaanhum jo leehum wa gaalo-:-Yaatu antaaku izin tabnu al-beet da wa ti'addulu daraadirah-?
Wa sa'aloohum battaan-:-Yaatumman al-naas al-yichaaruku fi buna al-beet da-?
Wa laakin Allah kaan ma'a chuyuukh al-Yahuud wa misil da,al-waali wa rufgaanah ma gidro daharoohum min al-buna lahaddi rassalo jawaab le l-malik Daariyuus le yalgo minnah radd.
Daahu kalaam al-jawaab al-katabooh le l-malik Daariyuus Tattanaay al-waali hana l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat wa Chatar Buuznaay wa rufgaanhum al-humman kubaaraat al-mantaga di.
Wa daahu al-kalaam al-katabooh fi l-jawaab-:Ya l-malik Daariyuus,Allah yansurak-!
Nidooru ni'ooruuk kadar macheena fi balad Yahuuza wa lihigna beet al-Rabb al-aziim al-gaa'idiin yabnuuh be hujaar kubaar wa fi durdurah gaa'idiin yukhuttu khachab.Wa l-naas dool gaa'idiin yakhdumu be nizaam wa khidmithum maache adiil.
Wa sa'alna chuyuukhhum wa gulna leehum-:-Yaatu antaaku izin tabnu al-beet da wa ti'addulu daraadirah-?
Wa battaan sa'alnaahum min asaame al-naas al-yuguuduuhum fi buna al-beet da kula achaan naktubuuhum fi l-maktuub da wa ni'ooruuk.
Wa humman raddo leena wa gaalo-:-Aniina abiid Rabb al-samaawaat wa l-ard wa gaa'idiin nabnu battaan beet Allah al-banaah al-malik al-kabiir hana Bani Israa'iil wa kammalah min zamaan.
Wa laakin juduudna sawwo zunuub giddaam Rabb al-samaawaat wa hu khidib leehum wa sallamaahum fi iid Nabuukhadnasar al-Kaldaani malik balad Baabil.Wa hu haddam beet Allah wa le l-cha'ab kamaan waddaahum fi l-khurba fi balad Baabil.
Wa laakin fi awwal sana hana hukmah,Kuurach malik Baabil amar achaan yabnu beet Allah da battaan.
Wa l-malik Kuurach marag min beet al-ilaahaat fi Baabil al-mu'iddaat hana l-dahab wa l-fudda al-awwal al-malik Nabuukhadnasar chaalaahum min beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa waddaahum fi beet ilaahaatah fi Baabil.Wa l-malik Kuurach anta al-mu'iddaat dool le naadum waahid usmah Chichbasar.Wa Chichbasar da,al-malik sawwaah waali.
Wa gaal leyah-:--Chiil al-mu'iddaat dool wa amchi gabbilhum fi beet Allah al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa khalli yabnu al-beet da fi bakaanah.--
Wa misil da,Chichbasar ja fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa khatta asaas beet Allah.Wa min al-wakit daak,gaa'idiin yabnuuh wa laakin al-buna da lissaa' ma kammal.
Wa hassa' da,ya l-malik,kalaamna da kan ajabaak,anti amur le yifattuchu fi maktabatak fi madiinat Baabil wa nichiifu kan sahiih ke al-malik Kuurach anta izin yabnu beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus walla la.Wa ba'ad da,ya l-malik,rassil leena jawaab be kharaarak al-tichiilah.
Wa misil da,al-malik Daariyuus anta amur yifattuchu maktuub kharaar al-malik Kuurach fi maktabat al-malik al-fi madiinat Baabil.
Wa ma ligooh hinaak wa laakin ligo kitaab maktuub fi waraga malfuufa fi l-gasir hana madiinat Ahmata al-fi balad Maadi.Wa l-kalaam al-fi l-maktuub da buguul-:
Fi l-sana al-awwal hana mulkah,al-malik Kuurach marag kharaar wa gaal-:Beet Allah al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus waajib yinbani fi asaasah al-awwal achaan yigaddumu foogah dahaaya.Wa tuulah al-foog yabga 60 duraa' wa urdah kula 60 duraa'.
Wa l-buna yabga misil da.Ba'ad talaata roog hana hajar,yukhuttu roog waahid hana khachab.Wa kilfit al-buna kamaan yamurguuha min sanduug al-malik.
Wa be ziyaada,al-mu'iddaat hana l-dahab wa l-fudda al-awwal chaalaahum al-malik Nabuukhadnasar min beet Allah min Madiinat al-Khudus wa waddaahum fi Baabil,al-mu'iddaat dool khalli yigabbuluuhum fi beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa yukhuttuuhum fi bakaanaathum fi beet Allah.
Wa misil da,al-malik Daariyuus katab jawaab le Tattanaay al-waali hana l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat wa le Chatar Buuznaay wa le rufgaanhum al-humman kubaaraat al-mantaga di.Wa l-jawaab gaal-:Ma tiddakhkhalo fi l-kalaam da-!
Khallu khidmit buna beet Allah tamchi giddaam.Wa waali al-Yahuud be chuyuukhhum kula,khalluuhum yabnu beet Allah fi bakaanah al-awwal.
Wa daahu al-amur al-nantiih fi l-cheyy al-tisawwuuh ma'a chuyuukh al-Yahuud achaan yabnu beet Allah.Min maal al-malik hana l-miiri al-yaji min al-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat,antuuhum kilfit al-buna ajala achaan khidmit al-buna ma tagiif.
Waajib tantu al-cheyy al-yidooruuh kulla yoom bala ta'khiir le rujaal al-diin hana l-Yahuud achaan yigaddumu dahaaya muharragiin le Rabb al-samaawaat.Wa l-dahaaya dool humman tiiraan wa kubchaan wa humlaan wa gameh wa mileh wa khamar wa dihin.
Wa rujaal al-diin yigaddumu al-dahaaya dool le Rabb al-samaawaat achaan hu yarda be riihit al-dahaaya.Wa misil da,humman yas'alo Allah le l-malik wa le awlaadah achaan Allah yibaarikhum.
Wa daahu al-amur al-nantiih fi l-cheyy al-tisawwuuh fi ayyi naadum al-yikhaalif kharaari.Yichiilu min beetah uud tariin wa yat'anooh beyah wa yi'alluguuh.Wa yidammuru beetah wa yabga misil dungus.
Wa kan ayyi cha'ab aw ayyi malik yidoor yikhayyir kharaari wa yidoor yidammir beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus al-khatta foogah usmah,khalli Allah yidammirah.Ana Daariyuus maragt al-kharaar da wa khalli yitabbuguuh tawwaali.
Wa misil da,Tattanaay waali al-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat wa Chatar Buuznaay wa rufgaanhum tabbago tawwaali kalaam al-malik Daariyuus al-rassalah leehum.
Wa l-anbiya Zakariiya al-min zurriiyit Iddu wa Haggaay gaa'idiin yichajju'u chuyuukh al-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin yabnu beet Allah.Wa khidmithum maache adiil.Wa kammalo buna al-beet hasab kharaar Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil wa hasab kharaar muluuk balad Faaris al-humman Kuurach wa Daariyuus wa Artahachta.
Wa kammalo buna beet Allah fi l-yoom al-taalit hana l-chahar al-usmah Adaar fi l-sana al-saadse hana hukum al-malik Daariyuus.
Wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa l-faddalo min Bani Israa'iil al-gabbalo min al-khurba,kulluhum fataho beet Allah be farha.
Wa wakit fataho al-beet da,gaddamo 100 toor wa 200 kabich wa 400 hamal.Wa gaddamo 12 tees dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib le kulla Bani Israa'iil hasab adad gabaayilhum.
Wa misil maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa,Bani Israa'iil gammo darrajo rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin hasab majmuu'aathum achaan yakhdumu le Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Al-naas al-gabbalo min al-khurba ayyado iid al-Fisha fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar al-awwal.
Rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin kula chaalo niiye wa tahharo nufuushum wa kulluhum bigo taahiriin khalaas.Wa l-Laawiyiin dabaho bahaayim le iid al-Fisha le kulla l-naas al-gabbalo min al-khurba wa le akhwaanhum rujaal al-diin wa le nufuushum kula.
Wa Bani Israa'iil al-gabbalo min al-khurba akalo ma'a kulla l-naas al-khallo najaasit naas al-balad di wa taaba'o Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil ma'aahum sawa.
Wa ba'ad da,ayyado iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara be farha le muddit sab'a yoom.Wa firho achaan Allah khayyar galib malik balad Achuur le yiwajjih aleehum wa yisaa'idhum fi buna beet Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ba'ad da,fi wakit hukum Artahachta malik balad Faaris,fiyah raajil waahid usmah Azra.Wa Azra da,hu wileed Saraaya wileed Azarya wileed Hilkhiiya
wileed Challuum wileed Saduukh wileed Akhituub
wileed Amarya wileed Azarya wileed Marayuut
wileed Zarahya wileed Uzzi wileed Bukhi
wileed Abichuu' wileed Fiinhaas wileed Ali'aazar wileed Haaruun.Wa Haaruun da,hu raajil al-diin al-awwal.
Wa Azra kaatib wa aalim kabiir fi Tawraat Muusa al-antaaha Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.Wa achaan gudrat Allah gaa'ide fi Azra,al-malik antaah kulla cheyy al-hu talabah.Wa Azra gamma min madiinat Baabil
ma'a naas waahidiin min Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-naas dool humman rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa l-khannaayiin wa l-hurraas hana biibaan beet Allah wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah.Wa kulluhum macho fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi l-sana al-saab'e hana hukum al-malik Artahachta.
Wa Azra dawwar yugumm min madiinat Baabil fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-awwal.Wa ba'ad ayyaam,gamma wa wisil fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-khaamis achaan gudrat al-Rabb gaa'ide foogah.
Wa Azra chaal niiye mukhlisa achaan yagri Tawraat Allah wa yitabbigah fi nafsah wa yi'allim gawaaniinah wa churuutah le Bani Israa'iil.
Daahu kalaam al-jawaab al-katabah al-malik Artahachta le Azra raajil al-diin al-kaatib wa aalim fi wasaaya Allah wa l-churuut al-antaahum le Bani Israa'iil-:
Daahu amur minni ana Artahachta malik al-muluuk le Azra raajil al-diin wa kaatib hana Tawraat Rabb al-samaawaat.
Ana anteet izin le Bani Israa'iil wa le rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-gaa'idiin hini fi mamlakati wa gult ayyi waahid al-indah niiye le yigabbil fi Madiinat al-Khudus,khalli yigabbil ma'aak.
Ana al-malik wa mustachaariini al-sab'a nirassuluuk fi balad Yahuuza wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan tichiif al-naas,kan gaa'idiin yakhdumu hasab Tawraat Ilaahak al-fi iideenak walla la.
Wa nirassuluuk achaan tiwaddi ma'aak al-fudda wa l-dahab al-ana al-malik wa mustachaariini anteenaahum be niiyitna le Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-saakin fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa battaan tiwaddi ma'aak al-fudda wa l-dahab al-talgaah min kulla balad Baabil wa l-hadaaya al-antoohum al-cha'ab wa rujaal al-diin be niiyithum le khidmit beet Ilaahhum fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Abga naadum amiin achaan be l-maal da,tachri tiiraan wa kubchaan wa humlaan wa hadiiyat dagiig wa hadiiyat charaab achaan tigaddimhum fi l-madbah hana beet Ilaahku fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa kan le l-dahab wa l-fudda al-yifaddulu kamaan,inta wa akhwaanak sawwu beehum al-cheyy al-tichiifuuh adiil hasab al-yidoorah Ilaahku.
Wa kan le l-mu'iddaat al-antook achaan takhdim beehum khidmit beet Ilaahak,dool kamaan khuttuhum fi beetah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa kan tidoor ayyi cheyy aakhar le beet Ilaahak kula,chiilah min makhaazni ana al-malik.
Wa intu kulluku amiiniin al-makhaazin hana l-malik al-fi l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat,ana al-malik Artahachta anteetku izin achaan tantu ajala le Azra raajil al-diin wa kaatib hana Tawraat Rabb al-samaawaat kulla cheyy al-hu yas'alku.
Wa tantuuh lahaddi 3-000 kiilo hana fudda wa 300 chuwaal hana gameh wa 20 birmiil hana khamar wa 20 birmiil hana dihin wa mileh kamaan bala adad.
Wa kulla cheyy al-amaraaku Rabb al-samaawaat le tisawwuuh le beetah,sawwuuh adiil achaan Allah ma yakhdab le mamlakati wa le zurriiyti.
Wa ziyaada min da,nikhabburuuku kadar ma waajib tichiilu miiri aw zaka aw ayyi cheyy al-waajib yikaffuuh le l-malik min rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa l-khannaayiin wa l-hurraas hana biibaan beet Allah wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah wa l-abiid al-aakhariin hana beet Allah.
Wa inta,ya Azra,ale hasab al-hikma al-Rabbak antaak,khutt gudiya wa hukkaam fi l-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat.Wa humman yahkumu be l-adil fi kulla l-cha'ab al-ya'arfu Tawraat Ilaahku.Wa le l-naas al-ma ya'arfuuha kamaan,allimhum.
Wa ayyi naadum al-ma yitabbig Tawraat Ilaahak wa gawaaniin al-malik sawa sawa,khalli yahkumu leyah be l-moot aw yaturduuh min ust al-cha'ab aw yahkumuuh aw yasjunuuh.
Wa ana Azra gult-:Baarak Allah Rabb juduudna al-dassa niiye fi galib al-malik achaan yi'azzim beet Allah al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus-!
Wa leyi ana Azra,Allah antaani rahma giddaam al-malik wa mustachaariinah wa kulla kubaaraatah al-furraas.Wa Allah Ilaahi antaani gudra gidirt lammeet waahidiin min kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil achaan yigabbulu ma'aayi fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Daahu kubaaraat khuchuum al-buyuut al-sajjalo asaameehum wa gabbalo ma'aayi,ana Azra,min balad Baabil fi wakit al-malik Artahachta.
Min zurriiyit Fiinhaas,Girchuum.Min zurriiyit Itamaar,Danyaal.Min zurriiyit Dawuud,Hattuuch.
Wa waahidiin min zurriiyit Chakanya.Min zurriiyit Far'uuch,Zakariiya wa ma'aayah 150 rujaal al-sajjalo asaameehum.
Min zurriiyit Fahat Muwaab,Aliyu'naay wileed Zarahya wa ma'aayah 200 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Zattu,Chakanya wileed Yahaziyiil wa ma'aayah 300 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Adiin,Aabad wileed Yuunataan wa ma'aayah 50 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Ilaam,Yacha'ya wileed Atalya wa ma'aayah 70 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Chafatya,Zabadya wileed Mikaayiil wa ma'aayah 80 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Yuwaab,Ubadya wileed Yahiyiil wa ma'aayah 218 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Baani,Chaluumit wileed Yuuchifya wa ma'aayah 160 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Babaay,Zakariiya wileed Babaay wa ma'aayah 28 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Azgad,Yuuhanaan wileed Hagataan wa ma'aayah 110 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Adunikhaam,al-jo fi l-akhiir humman Alifaalat wa Ya'iyiil wa Chama'ya wa ma'aahum 60 raajil.
Min zurriiyit Bigwaay,Utaay wa Zakkuur wa ma'aahum 70 raajil.
Wa ana Azra lammeet al-naas dool jamb al-bahar al-maachi ale hillit Ahawa wa fi l-bakaan da,dalleena ga'adna talaata yoom.Wa ana alfaggadt al-cha'ab wa rujaal al-diin wa laakin ma ligiit Laawiyiin fi usuthum.
Wa khalaas,ana naadeet waahidiin min al-kubaaraat wa humman Ali'aazar wa Ariyiil wa Chama'ya wa Alnaataan wa Yariib wa Alinaataan wa Naataan wa Zakariiya wa Machullam.Wa naadeet itneen min al-ulama wa humman Yuyaarib wa Alnaataan.
Wa rassaltuhum le Iddu,kabiir hillit Kasifya.Wa ooreethum al-kalaam al-yuguuluuh le Iddu ma'a akhwaanah fi Kasifya,al-humman khaddaamiin hana beet Allah.Wa gaalo leehum-:-Rassulu leena naas al-yakhdumu fi beet Ilaahna.
Wa achaan gudrat Ilaahna gaa'ide ma'aana,humman jaabo leena naadum aagil usmah Charabya min iyaal Mahli wileed wileedah le Laawi wa Laawi kamaan hu wileed Israa'iil.Wa Charabya da jaabooh ma'a iyaalah wa akhwaanah wa adadhum 18.
Wa jaabo Hachabya wa ma'aayah Yacha'ya min iyaal Maraari.Wa humman jaabo ma'aahum iyaalhum wa akhwaanhum wa adadhum 20.
Wa battaan jaabo khaddaamiin beet Allah min zurriiyit al-naas al-zamaan al-malik Dawuud ma'a kubaaraatah azzaloohum achaan yisaa'udu al-Laawiyiin.Wa humman adadhum 220 wa asaameehum kulla musajjaliin.
Wa hinaak fi bahar Ahawa,ana khabbart al-naas le nusuumu wa nimaskunu nufuusna giddaam Ilaahna wa natulbu minnah yahfadna fi safarna,aniina wa iyaalna wa kulla maalna.
Achaan eeb sawwaani,ma gidirt sa'alt min al-malik askar be kheelhum le yahmuuna min udwaanna fi l-derib.Achaan awwal gulna leyah-:-Gudrat Ilaahna ma'a kulla l-naas al-yas'alooh wa Allah yakhdab ziyaada le kulla l-naas al-khallooh.
Achaan da,sumna wa sa'alna Ilaahna wa hu radda leena fi talabna.
Wa ba'ad da,ana azalt 12 min kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa ma'aahum Charabya wa Hachabya wa 10 min akhwaanhum.
Wa wazant leehum al-hadaaya hana l-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-mu'iddaat wa kulla cheyy hana beet Allah al-antooh al-malik wa mustachaariinah wa kubaaraatah wa kulla Bani Israa'iil al-gaa'idiin hinaak.
Wa anteethum fi iideehum 22-000 kiilo hana fudda wa mu'iddaat hana fudda wazinhum yisaawi 3-400 kiilo wa 3-400 kiilo hana dahab
wa 20 kaas hana dahab al-khiimithum tabga 1-000 jineeh wa mawaa'iin itneen hana nahaas sameh al-biraari wa khaali misil al-dahab.
Wa ana gult leehum-:-Intu naas mukhassasiin le Allah wa l-mu'iddaat wa l-fudda wa l-dahab kula mukhassasiin.Wa antoohum hadiiye be niiyithum le Allah Rabb juduudku.
Achaan da,abgo hadiiriin wa ahfadoohum adiil lahaddi tiwadduuhum fi beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hinaak,tawzunuuhum giddaam kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa kubaaraat aayilaat Bani Israa'iil fi makhaazin beet Allah.
Wa misil da,rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin chaalo al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-mu'iddaat al-wazanoohum achaan yiwadduuhum fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi beet Allah.
Wa yoom 12 hana l-chahar al-awwal,gammeena min bahar Ahawa le namchu Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa fi safarna,gudrat Ilaahna kaanat ma'aana wa hu hafadaana min udwaanna wa min rabbaatiin al-duruub.
Wa khalaas,jiina fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa ga'adna talaata yoom.
Wa fi l-yoom al-raabi',macheena fi beet Allah wa wazanna al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-mu'iddaat.Wa anteenaahum le Marimuut wileed Uriiya raajil al-diin wa ma'aayah Ali'aazar wileed Fiinhaas wa ma'aahum al-Laawiyiin Yuuzabaad wileed Yachuu' wa Nuu'adya wileed Binuuwi.
Wazanna wa hasabna kulla l-khumaam dool wa haadir bas sajjalna adadhum wa wazinhum.
Wa misil da,Bani Israa'iil al-awwal chaaloohum wa waddoohum fi l-khurba gabbalo wa gaddamo dahaaya muharragiin le Allah Ilaahhum.Gaddamo 12 toor wa 96 kabich wa 77 hamal le kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa battaan dabaho 12 tees le kaffaarat al-zanib.
Wa khabbaro al-muhaafiziin wa hukkaam al-mantaga al-kharib le bahar al-Furaat be awaamir al-malik.Wa humman saa'ado al-cha'ab wa beet Allah kula.
Wa ba'ad kammalna al-khidme,al-kubaaraat jo wa gaalo leyi-:-Cha'ab Bani Israa'iil wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin ma anfarago min chu'uub al-buldaan dool.Wa ma khallo muharramaat al-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin wa Bani Ammuun wa l-Muwaabiyiin wa l-Masriyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin.
Achaan Bani Israa'iil akhado min banaat al-chu'uub dool wa jawwazo awlaadhum kula.Wa misil da,khalbato al-zurriiye al-mukhassasa di ma'a chu'uub al-buldaan dool.Wa l-bado al-khiyaana di,humman al-kubaaraat wa l-masaa'iil zaathum.
Wa wakit ana simi't al-kalaam da,charratt jawwaaniiyti wa jallaabiiyti wa mallatt suuf raasi wa digni wa ga'adt tihit mutahayyir.
Wa l-naas al-bakhaafo min Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil lammo ma'aayi achaan al-khiyaana al-sawwooha al-naas al-gabbalo min al-khurba.Wa ana gaa'id tihit mutahayyir lahaddi achiiye fi l-wakit al-yigaddumu foogah hadiiye hana dagiig.
Wa wakit gaddimiin al-hadiiye hana l-dagiig be achiiye,ana gammeet min hiirti di be khulgaani al-mucharratiin wa barakt wa rafa't iideeni le Allah Ilaahi
wa gult-:-Ya Ilaahi,ana khajlaan wa aayib wa ma nagdar narfa' raasi aleek inta achaan zunuubna kitro faato raasna wa khataayaana bigo katiiriin lahaddi lihgo al-sama.
Wa min wakit juduudna lahaddi l-yoom,khataayaana bigo ziyaada.Wa fi chaan zunuubna,aniina wa muluukna wa rujaal diinna,sallamoona fi iideen muluuk hana chu'uub aakhariin.Wa humman kataloona be l-seef wa karaboona wa bigiina khaniime wa ayyaboona misil al-yoom.
Wa laakin hassa',ya Allah Ilaahna,inta hanneet foogna le wakit gisayyir wa khalleet waahidiin minnina nijo wa gabbalo jo almakkano fi l-bakaanak al-mukhaddas.Wa misil da,ya Ilaahna,inta fataht uyuunna wa anteetna raaha chiyya min al-ubuudiiye.
Aniina kan abiid kula,Ilaahna ma khallaana fi ubuudiiyitna.Sawwa leena al-kheer wa antaana haya jadiide.Wa anta amur le muluuk balad Faaris achaan yikhalluuna ni'addulu beet Ilaahna wa ni'addulu daraadir Madiinat al-Khudus fi balad Yahuuza.
Ya Rabbina-!Hassa' da,nuguulu chunu-?Abeena ma nasma'o wasiiyaatak
al-amartina beehum be abiidak al-anbiya wa gult leena-:--Al-balad al-intu maachiin leeha wa tichiiluuha wa tabga leeku warasa di,hi nijse wa l-gabaayil al-gaa'idiin foogha najjasooha wa malooha be haraamhum wa be najaasithum.
Wa achaan da,ma tizawwuju banaatku le awlaadhum wa la awlaadku le banaathum.Wa ma tilmanno leehum al-salaam wa la l-kheer ila l-abad.Wa misil da,tabgo gawiyiin wa taakulu min kheer al-balad di.Wa l-balad di tabga warasa le iyaalku ila l-abad.--
Wa kulla l-cheyy al-bigi foogna,da ja be sabab zunuubna wa fi'ilna al-cheen.Wa be da kula,inta Ilaahna ma aakhabtina hasab zunuubna al-waajib nil'aakhabo be sababhum.Wa laakin inta khalleet al-faddalo minnina aaychiin.
Wa hal battaan nigabbulu nikhaalufu wasiiyaatak wa nil'aakhado ma'a l-gabaayil al-bisawwu al-haraam giddaamak walla-?Kan nisawwu misil da,inta ma taz'al foogna ziyaada wa tidammirna marra waahid lahaddi waahid kula ma yifaddil walla-?
Ya Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,inta saadikh wa khalleet al-faddalo minnina aaychiin lahaddi l-yoom.Wa daahu aniina jiina giddaamak muznibiin.Wa fi chaan al-charr al-sawweenaah da,ma waajib nagiifu giddaamak.
Wa Azra gaa'id giddaam beet Allah wa wakit yisalli wa yasjud wa yabki wa yi'tarif,cha'ab Bani Israa'iil jo leyah katiiriin marra waahid,rujaal wa awiin wa iyaal.Wa humman kulla bako be ziyaada.
Wa Chakanya wileed Yahiyiil min zurriiyit Ilaam gaal le Azra-:-Aniina Bani Israa'iil khunna Ilaahna wakit akhadna awiin ajnabiiyaat min chu'uub al-balad.Wa laakin hassa' kula,indina acham.
Hassa' da,ta'aalu nisawwu mu'aahada ma'a Ilaahna le namurgu kulla l-awiin dool wa iyaalhum min usutna misil kalaamak inta,ya Azra,wa l-naas al-yakhaafo min wasaaya Ilaahna.Wa khalli nitaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat.
Hassa',ya Azra,gumm wa chidd heelak-!Akhdim khidimtak achaan di mas'uuliiytak wa aniina kula ma'aak.
Wa misil da khalaas,Azra gamma foogah wa hallafaahum le kubaaraat rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin wa le kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa humman halafo kadar yisawwu hasab kalaamhum al-gaalooh.
Wa Azra gamma min giddaam beet Allah wa andassa fi beet Yuuhanaan wileed Alyaachib.Wakit dakhal,ma akal wa la chirib min chiddit al-hizin achaan al-khiyaana al-sawwooha al-naas al-gabbalo min al-khurba.
Wa naado kulla l-naas al-jo min al-khurba al-gaa'idiin fi balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yilimmu fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-kubaaraat wa chuyuukh al-cha'ab chaalo niiye wa gaalo-:-Ayyi naadum al-simi' al-khabar da wa fi talaata yoom ma ja fi Madiinat al-Khudus,yichiilu minnah maalah kulla ke wa yaturduuh min al-jamaa'a al-jo min al-khurba.
Wa gabiilat Yahuuza wa gabiilat Banyaamiin kulluhum lammo fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi l-yoom al-taalit.Wa l-yoom al-lammo foogah da,yoom 20 hana l-chahar al-taasi'.Wa kulla l-cha'ab al-lammo ga'ado fi fadaayit beet Allah wa gaa'idiin yarjufu min al-kalaam al-gaasi da wa min al-matar al-gaa'id yusubb.
Wa Azra raajil al-diin gamma be heelah wa gaal-:-Intu akhadtu awiin min chu'uub al-balad wa be da,khuntu Rabbina wa zidtu al-zunuub fi Bani Israa'iil.
Hassa' da,tuubu le Allah Rabb juduudku wa sawwu al-hu yidoorah-!Anfargu min chu'uub al-balad wa min al-awiin al-ajnabiiyaat.
Wa l-jamaa'a kulluhum raddo leyah be hiss aali wa gaalo-:-Aywa,nisawwu misil inta gultah-!
Wa laakin humman katiiriin al-sawwo al-khata da wa misil da,al-kalaam da kabiir ma nagdaro nikammuluuh fi yoom walla yoomeen.Wa battaan wakitna da wakit hana khariif,ma nagdaro nagiifu barra.
Wa khalli kubaaraatna bas yagoodu fi badalna aniina al-cha'ab.Wa ayyi naadum al-gaa'id fi hillaalna wa akhad mara ajnabiiye,khalli yaji fi l-wa'ad al-yagta'ooh.Wa khalli yilimm ma'a chuyuukh wa hukkaam hillitah.Wa be misil da,nisawwu al-yidoorah Ilaahna fi l-kalaam da lahaddi khadabah al-muhrig yiba''id minnina.
Wa laakin Yuunataan wileed Asaahiil wa Yahazya wileed Tigwa wa Machullam wa Chabtaay al-Laawi,humman bas al-abo,ma waafago.
Wa Bani Israa'iil al-aakhariin al-gabbalo min al-khurba kamaan waafago fi l-kalaam da.Wa Azra raajil al-diin azal kubaaraat al-aayilaat wa min ayyi aayila chaal kabiir wa naadaahum be usumhum.Humman ga'ado naakhacho min al-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-aachir.
Wa fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-awwal hana l-sana al-jadiide,kammalo tasjiil al-rujaal al-akhado min awiin al-ajnabiiyaat deel.
Daahu asaame rujaal al-diin al-akhado awiin ajnabiiyaat min chu'uub al-balad,al-ligoohum fi wakt al-tasjiil.Wa kulluhum chaalo niiye achaan yaturdu awiinhum wa yijiibu kubchaan le kaffaarat khataahum.Min zurriiyit Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh wa akhwaanah,Ma'asiiya wa Ali'aazar wa Yariib wa Gadaalya.
Wa min zurriiyit Immiir,Hanaani wa Zabadya.
Wa min zurriiyit Hariim,Ma'asiiya wa Iliyaas wa Chama'ya wa Yahiyiil wa Uzziiya.
Wa min zurriiyit Fachhuur,Aliyu'naay wa Ma'asiiya wa Ismaa'iil wa Nataniil wa Yuuzabaad wa Al'aasa.
Wa min zurriiyit al-Laawiyiin,Yuuzabaad wa Chim'i wa Khilaaya al-binaaduuh Khaliita wa Fatahya wa Yahuuza wa Ali'aazar.
Wa min al-khannaayiin,Alyaachib.Wa min hurraas al-biibaan,Challuum wa Talam wa Uuri.
Wa daahu asaame naas aakhariin min cha'ab Bani Israa'iil.Min zurriiyit Far'uuch,Ramya wa Yizziiya wa Malkiiya wa Miyaamiin wa Ali'aazar wa Malkiiya wa Banaaya.
Wa min zurriiyit Ilaam,Mattanya wa Zakariiya wa Yahiyiil wa Abdi wa Yarimuut wa Iliyaas.
Wa min zurriiyit Zattu,Aliyu'naay wa Alyaachib wa Mattanya wa Yarimuut wa Zabaad wa Aziiz.
Wa min zurriiyit Babaay,Yuuhanaan wa Hananya wa Zabbaay wa Atlaay.
Wa min zurriiyit Baani,Machullam wa Malluuk wa Adaaya wa Yachuub wa Chaal wa Yarimuut.
Wa min zurriiyit Fahat Muwaab,Adna wa Kalaal wa Banaaya wa Ma'asiiya wa Mattanya wa Basaliil wa Binuuwi wa Manassa.
Wa min zurriiyit Hariim,Ali'aazar wa Yichiiya wa Malkiiya wa Chama'ya wa Chim'uun
wa Banyaamiin wa Malluuk wa Chamarya.
Wa min zurriiyit Hachum,Mattinaay wa Mattaata wa Zabaad wa Alifaalat wa Yarimaay wa Manassa wa Chim'i.
Wa min zurriiyit Baani,Maadaay wa Amraam wa Uyiil
wa Banaaya wa Beedya wa Kaluuhi
wa Wanya wa Marimuut wa Alyaachib
wa Mattanya wa Mattinaay wa Ya'asaay
wa Baani wa Binuuwi wa Chim'i
wa Chalamya wa Naataan wa Adaaya
wa Maknadabaay wa Chaachaay wa Charaay
wa Azariil wa Chalamya wa Chamarya
wa Challuum wa Amarya wa Yuusuf.
Wa min zurriiyit Nabu,Ya'iyiil wa Mattitya wa Zabaad wa Zabiina wa Yaddaay wa Yuwiil wa Banaaya.
Al-naas dool kulluhum ke akhado awiin ajnabiiyaat min chu'uub al-balad wa katiiraat minhin wildan iyaal.
Daahu kalaami ana Nahamya wileed Hakalya.Fi l-chahar al-taasi' al-usmah Kislu fi sanit 20 hana hukum Artahachta,wakit ana Nahamya gaa'id fi gasir al-malik fi madiinat Chuucha,
waahid min akhwaani usmah Hanaani ja wa ma'aayah rujaal waahidiin min balad Yahuuza.Wa ana sa'altuhum min khabar Madiinat al-Khudus wa min al-naas al-nijo min al-hujuum wa faddalo wa saakniin fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa humman gaalo leyi-:-Al-nijo min al-hujuum wa faddalo fi l-balad hinaak,humman gaa'idiin be diige chadiide wa da eeb leehum.Wa l-durdur al-muhawwig Madiinat al-Khudus mukassar wa biibaanah antachcho.
Wakit ana simi't al-kalaam da,bigiit haznaan wa ga'adt tihit wa bakeet.Wa gaa'id nusuum wa nisalli muddit ayyaam le Allah Rabb al-samaawaat
wa gult-:-Ya Allah Rabb al-samaawaat-!Ya Rabb,inta aziim wa mukhiif wa inta tahfad al-mu'aahada wa tiwassif rahmatak le l-naas al-biriiduuk wa l-bahfado wasiiyaatak.
Chiifni wa fakkir foogi wa asma' salaati al-ana abdak nisalliiha leek leel wa nahaar fi chaan abiidak Bani Israa'iil.Wa ni'tarif be l-zunuub al-aniina Bani Israa'iil sawweenaahum.Aywa,ana wa kulla aayilti aznabna.
Aniina abeena ma tabbagna wasiiyaatak wa churuutak wa l-gawaaniin al-inta amart beehum le abdak Muusa.Wa sawweena al-charr giddaamak.
Ya Rabb,fakkir fi kalaamak al-inta amart beyah abdak Muusa wa gult-:--Kan nagadtu mu'aahadati,nichattitku fi l-umam.
Laakin kan gabbaltu leyi wa hafadtu wasiiyaati wa tabbagtuuhum,khalaas kan taradooku fi aakhir al-dunya kula,ana nilimmuku wa nijiibku fi l-bakaan al-ana azaltah achaan usmi yagood foogah.--
Aniina cha'abak wa abiidak al-inta fadeetna be gudurtak al-kabiire wa iidak al-chadiide.
Ya Rabb,fakkir foogi wa asma' salaati wa salaat al-naas al-yakhaafo min usmak.Wa l-yoom da,antiini al-najaah fi l-cheyy al-ana abdak nidoorah min al-malik Artahachta.Khalli nalga minnah rahma-!-Fi l-wakit daak,mas'uuliiyti nanti charaab le l-malik.
Fi l-chahar al-awwal al-usmah Niisaan fi sanit 20 hana hukum Artahachta,wakit al-malik gaa'id baakul,ana chilt khamar al-inab al-gaa'id giddaamah wa anteetah leyah.Wa yoom waahid kula,ma wassaft hizni giddaam al-malik.
Wa l-malik irif hizni wa gaal leyi-:-Maala inta al-yoom haznaan-?Inta mardaan walla-?Walla galbak ma raagid-?-Wakit ana simi't al-kalaam da,khuft khoof chadiid
wa gult le l-malik-:-Allah yitawwil umrak ila l-abad-!Ya l-malik,al-madiina al-khubuur juduudi gaa'idiin foogha khirbat wa biibaanha kula tachchoohum.Achaan da bas,ana haznaan.
Wa battaan al-malik sa'alaani wa gaal-:-Tidoor nisawwi leek chunu-?-Wakit gaal leyi al-kalaam da,ana salleet le Allah Rabb al-samaawaat.
Wa ba'ad da,gult le l-malik-:-Kan inta tikhassid wa kan tarda leyi ana abdak,rassilni fi balad Yahuuza fi l-madiina al-khubuur juduudi gaa'idiin foogha achaan nabniiha battaan.
Fi l-wakit da,al-malika gaa'ide jamb al-malik.Wa l-malik sa'alaani wa gaal-:-Tagood kam wakit hinaak-?Wa mata tigabbil-? Wa ana ooreetah al-wakit al-nigabbil foogah wa khalaas,al-malik khassad yirassilni.
Wa battaan ana gult le l-malik-:-Kan inta tikhassid kadar ana namchi,khalli yaktubu leyi jawaabaat le l-hukkaam al-gaa'idiin kharib le bahar al-Furaat achaan yantuuni izin nuchugg baladhum lahaddi namchi fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa battaan antiini jawaab aakhar le Asaaf al-mas'uul fi khaabat al-malik achaan yantiini hatab al-nagdar ni'addil beyah biibaan al-gasir al-jamb beet Allah wa biibaan durdur al-madiina wa l-beet al-ana nagood foogah.-Wa khalaas,al-malik antaani al-jawaabaat dool achaan barakat Ilaahi gaa'ide foogi.
Wa be misil da,al-malik rassal ma'aayi khuyyaad al-askar wa siyaad al-kheel achaan yi'adduuni.Wa ana gammeet wa macheet le l-hukkaam al-gaa'idiin kharib le bahar al-Furaat wa anteethum jawaabaat al-malik.
Wa hinaak,fiyah naaseen al-usumhum Sanbalat min hillit Huruun wa Tuubiiya mas'uul fi Bani Ammuun.Wakit al-naaseen dool sim'o be jayti,bigi leehum gaasi marra waahid achaan ma bidooru naadum yisawwi al-kheer le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana wisilt Madiinat al-Khudus wa ga'adt foogha talaata yoom
wa ma ooreet ayyi naadum be l-cheyy al-Ilaahi kallamaani nisawwiih fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa gammeet be l-leel wa chilt rujaal waahidiin ma'aayi laakin ma chilt zaamile aakhara illa l-zaamile al-ana raakib foogha.
Wa maragt be l-leel min Madiinat al-Khudus be khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh baab al-Waadi wa maachi ale een al-almi al-binaaduuha een al-Khuul wa ale khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh baab al-Zibaala.Wa gaa'id nichiif al-durdur al-muhawwig Madiinat al-Khudus al-kassar wa biibaanah al-tachchoohum.
Wa battaan macheet ale khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh baab Een Almi wa ale birkit al-malik wa laakin hinaak al-derib bigi dayyig wa zaamilti ma ligat bakaan al-ti'addi beyah.
Wa fi nafs al-leele di,macheet be l-rijil al-tidalli min al-hajar wa gaa'id nichiif al-durdur.Wa battaan gabbalt dakhalt be baab al-Waadi wa jiit.
Wa kubaaraat al-cha'ab ma irfo ana macheet ween wa sawweet chunu achaan fi l-wakit da,lissaa' ma ooreet cheyy le l-Yahuud wa la le rujaal al-diin wa la le kubaaraat al-cha'ab wa la le l-mas'uuliin wa la le l-naas al-yakhdumu.
Laakin hassa',ooreethum wa gult leehum-:-Chiifu-!Aniina daahu gaa'idiin fi diige chadiide.Madiinat al-Khudus addammarat wa biibaanha kula antachcho.Hassa' da,khalli ni'addulu durdur Madiinat al-Khudus achaan namurgu min al-eeb-!
Wa ooreethum be barakat Ilaahi al-gaa'ide foogi wa kalaam al-malik al-hajjaah leyi.Wa khalaas,humman chaalo niiye achaan yakhdumu al-khidme al-adiile di wa gaalo-:-Yalla nugummu nabnu-!
Wa Sanbalat al-min hillit Huruun wa Tuubiiya al-mas'uul fi Bani Ammuun wa Gachaam al-Arabi,wakit sim'o al-khabar da,gammo yahguruuna wa yichchammato foogna wa yuguulu-:-Al-tisawwuuh da chunu-?Tidooru tugummu didd al-malik walla-?
Wa ana raddeet wa gult leehum-:-Allah Rabb al-samaawaat,hu bas yantiina al-najaah wa aniina abiidah nugummu nabnu bas.Wa intu kamaan ma induku gisim fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa la induku hagg foogha wa la na'arfu leeku cheyy hini-!
Alyaachib kabiir rujaal al-diin gamma be khidmit al-buna ma'a naasah rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin.Humman bano khachum baab al-durdur al-binaaduuh baab al-Khanam wa khassasooh wa rakkabo baabah.Wa gaa'idiin yabnu fi l-durdur lahaddi jo lihgo al-beet al-muraakhaba al-binaaduuh Miya wa khassasooh.Wa battaan gaa'idiin yabnu lahaddi lihgo beet al-muraakhaba hana Hananiil.
Wa jamb rujaal al-diin,rujaal hillit Ariiha kula gaa'idiin yabnu fi l-durdur da wa Zakkuur wileed Imri gaa'id yabni jambuhum.
Wa naas hillit Saana bano khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh baab al-Huut wa rakkabo al-baab be tarbaazah wa gufulah.
Wa Marimuut wileed Uriiya wileed wileedah le Hagguus gaa'id yabni jambuhum.Wa jambah,Machullam wileed Barakya wileed wileedah le Machizabiil gaa'id yabni.Wa jambah,Saduukh wileed Ba'ana gaa'id yabni.
Wa jambah,naas hillit Takhuu'a gaa'idiin yabnu wa laakin kubaaraathum abo ma yichaaruku fi l-khidme achaan ma yihtarumu al-naas al-mas'uuliin fi l-buna.
Wa Yuyaadaa' wileed Faasih wa Machullam wileed Basuudya,humman bas addalo al-baab al-Gadiim wa rakkabo al-baab be tarbaazah wa gufulah.
Wa jambuhum Malatya al-min hillit Gib'uun wa Yaduun al-min hillit Miruunuut wa ma'aahum naas hillit Gib'uun wa hillit Misfa wa humman gaa'idiin yabnu be izin haakim al-mantaga al-gaa'ide kharib le bahar al-Furaat.
Wa jambuhum,Uzziyiil wileed Harhaaya al-sayyaakhi gaa'id yabni al-durdur wa jambah Hananya siid al-itir.Wa be misil da,humman gaa'idiin yabnu durdur Madiinat al-Khudus lahaddi lihgo bakaan al-binaaduuh al-durdur al-Wasii'.
Wa jambuhum Rafaaya wileed Huur al-hu kabiir fi nuss al-turaab hana Madiinat al-Khudus wa hu kula gaa'id yabni.
Wa jambah,Yadaaya wileed Harumaaf gaa'id yabni al-durdur al-mugaabil ma'a beetah.Wa jambah,Hattuuch wileed Hachabniya kula gaa'id yabni.
Wa Malkiiya wileed Hariim wa Hachuub wileed Fahat Muwaab kamaan gaa'idiin yi'addulu al-nuss al-aakhar hana l-durdur wa beet al-muraakhaba al-binaaduuh al-Furun.
Wa jambuhum,Challuum kula gaa'id yi'addil ma'a banaatah.Wa hu da wileed Haluuhiich wa kabiir fi l-nuss al-aakhar hana turaab Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Hanuun ma'a naas hillit Zanuuh addalo baab al-Waadi wa rakkabo al-baab be tarbaazah wa gufulah.Wa gaa'idiin yabnu al-durdur lahaddi tuulah tamma nuss kiilomitir wa lihgo baab al-Zibaala.
Wa kan le baab al-Zibaala kamaan,Malkiiya wileed Rikaab al-hu kabiir fi turaab hillit Beet Karam,hu bas addalah wa rakkab al-baab be tarbaazah wa gufulah.
Wa le khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh Een Almi kamaan,al-addalah Challuun wileed Kulhuuza kabiir fi turaab hillit Misfa.Wa Challuun bana khachum al-baab da wa sawwa leyah raas wa rakkab al-baab be tarbaazah wa gufulah.Wa battaan addal al-durdur al-maachi min al-rahad al-binaaduuh Silwaam lahaddi jineenit al-malik wa lahaddi l-derib al-bidalli be atabaat min madiinat Dawuud.
Wa jambah,Nahamya wileed Azbuukh al-hu kabiir fi nuss al-turaab hana hillit Beet Suur gaa'id yabni al-durdur lahaddi mugaabil le makhaabir aayilat al-malik Dawuud wa lahaddi l-rahad al-nakatooh al-naas wa lahaddi beet furraas al-malik.
Wa jambah,al-Laawiyiin gaa'idiin yabnu al-durdur.Rahuum wileed Baani gaa'id yabni wa jambah Hachabya al-hu kabiir fi nuss al-turaab hana hillit Kha'iila wa hu gaa'id yabni be usum naas hillitah.
Wa jambah,akhwaanah gaa'idiin yabnu wa ma'aahum Binuuwi wileed Hinadaad al-hu kabiir fi l-nuss al-aakhar hana turaab hillit Kha'iila.
Wa jambah Izaar wileed Yachuu' al-hu kabiir hillit Misfa wa hu gaa'id yi'addil al-nuss al-aakhar hana l-durdur min al-bakaan al-mugaabil al-derib al-batla' le beet al-silaah lahaddi ale l-bakaan al-mukhawwas hana l-durdur.
Wa jambah kamaan Baruuk wileed Zabbaay wa hu kula gaa'id yi'addil al-nuss al-aakhar be niiye waahide min al-bakaan al-mukhawwas da lahaddi khachum al-baab hana beet Alyaachib kabiir rujaal al-diin.
Wa jambah Marimuut wileed Uriiya wileed wileedah le Hagguus wa hu gaa'id yi'addil al-nuss al-aakhar hana l-durdur min khachum derib beet Alyaachib lahaddi fi aakhir al-beet.
Wa jambah rujaal al-diin al-jo min hillaal al-hawaale Madiinat al-Khudus wa humman kula gaa'idiin yi'addulu.
Wa jambuhum Banyaamiin ma'a Hachuub wa humman gaa'idiin yabnu al-durdur al-mugaabil beethum.Wa jambuhum Azarya wileed Ma'asiiya wileed wileedah le Ananya wa hu gaa'id yabni jamb beetah.
Wa jambah Binuuwi wileed Hinadaad wa hu gaa'id yi'addil al-nuss al-aakhar hana l-durdur min beet Azarya lahaddi l-rukun al-mukhawwas.
Wa Falaal wileed Uzaay gaa'id yabni al-durdur min al-bakaan al-mukhawwas da wa min beet al-muraakhaba al-mukhawwas hana fadaayit al-hurraas hana gasir al-malik.Wa jambah Fadaaya wileed Far'uuch.
Wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah al-saakniin fi haarat Ufal gaa'idiin yabnu al-durdur lahaddi baab al-Almi al-gaa'id be l-nuss al-sabhaani wa lahaddi beet al-muraakhaba al-mukhawwas.
Wa jambuhum,naas hillit Takhuu'a gaa'idiin yi'addulu al-nuss al-aakhar hana l-durdur min al-bakaan al-mugaabil beet al-muraakhaba al-mukhawwas lahaddi wassalo fi l-durdur hana haarat Ufal.
Wa min baab al-Kheel,rujaal al-diin gaa'idiin yabnu al-durdur,ayyi waahid mugaabil beetah.
Wa jambuhum,Saduukh wileed Immiir gaa'id yabni al-durdur al-mugaabil beetah.Wa jambah Chama'ya wileed Chakanya al-hu haaris khachum al-baab al-sabhaani.
Wa jambah Hananya wileed Chalamya wa Hanuun wileed al-saadis hana Salaaf wa humman dool gaa'idiin yi'addulu al-nuss al-aakhar hana l-durdur.Wa jambuhum,Machullam wileed Barakya gaa'id yi'addil al-durdur al-mugaabil khurfitah.
Wa jambah,Malkiiya al-sayyaakhi gaa'id yabni al-durdur min al-bakaan al-mugaabil khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh Mifkhad lahaddi l-beet al-gaa'id foog fi l-rukun wa lahaddi beet al-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah wa l-tujjaar.
Wa l-sayyaakhiin wa l-tujjaar gaa'idiin yi'addulu min al-beet al-gaa'id foog fi l-rukun da lahaddi baab al-Khanam.
Wakit Sanbalat simi' kadar aniina al-Yahuud gaa'idiin nabnu al-durdur,hu zi'il za'al chadiid wa gaa'id bichammit leena.
Wa gaal giddaam akhwaanah wa giddaam askarah fi balad al-Saamira-:-Al-Yahuud al-da'iifiin dool gaa'idiin bisawwu chunu-?Sahiih ke yagdaro yihaggugu hadafhum wa yigaddumu dahaaya walla-?Sahiih ke al-yoom bas yagdaro yikammulu al-khidme walla-?Wa min al-kiimaan hana l-hajar al-mukassar wa muharrag hana l-buna al-gadiim da,yagdaro yichiilu wa yabnu beyah battaan walla-?
Wa Tuubiiya al-min Bani Ammuun gaa'id jamb Sanbalat wa gaal-:-Al-durdur al-gaa'idiin yabnuuh be hajar da,ba'achoom kan rikib foogah kula baga'.
Wakit ana simi't kalaamhum da,salleet wa gult le l-Rabb-:-Ya Ilaahna,chiif kikkeef gaa'idiin yahguruuna.Al-mu'yaar al-gaa'idiin yi'ayyuruuna da,gabbilah leehum fi raashum.Wa khalli khusmaanhum yaksubuuhum wa yiwadduuhum abiid.
Ma tisaamih al-khata al-sawwooh da wa ma tuguchch zunuubhum achaan humman achchammato leena,aniina al-gaa'idiin nabnu.
Wa be misil da,taaba'na fi buna al-durdur da wa tuulah foog anbana lahaddi nuss achaan ayyi waahid min al-cha'ab khadam be niiye.
Wa wakit Sanbalat wa Tuubiiya wa naas min al-Arab wa min Bani Ammuun wa min sukkaan Achduud sim'o kadar buna durdur Madiinat al-Khudus maachi giddaam wa khuramah kula gaa'idiin yinsaddo khalaas,humman zi'ilo za'al chadiid marra waahid.
Wa humman kulluhum ke waafago be khachum waahid achaan yahjumu Madiinat al-Khudus wa yibarjuluuha.
Wa khalaas,aniina salleena le Ilaahna wa khatteena hurraas achaan yahfadoona minhum leel wa nahaar.
Wa laakin naas Yahuuza gaalo-:-Gudrat al-khaddaamiin bigat chiyya wa be da,ma nagdaro nabnu al-durdur achaan al-hajar al-mukassar katiir.
Wa khusmaanna gaalo-:-Khalli namchu nahjumuuhum-!Wakit humman ma yichiifuuna,nindasso fi usuthum wa khalaas naktuluuhum wa niwaggufu al-khidme.
Wa l-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin jamb khusmaanna jo leena achara marraat wa gaalo leena-:-Al-naas dool yaju yahjumuuku min ayyi jiihe-!
Wa fi chaan da,ana nazzamt al-cha'ab hasab khuchuum buyuuthum wa khatteethum be suyuufhum wa nachaachiibhum wa huraabhum wara l-durdur fi bakaanaat al-chiyya tihit.
Wa chift kulla bakaanaat mug'adhum wa gult le l-kubaaraat wa l-masaa'iil wa l-cha'ab-:-Ma takhaafo minhum-!Fakkuru fi Rabbina al-kabiir wa l-aziim wa daawusuuhum achaan tahmu akhwaanku wa awlaadku wa banaatku wa awiinku wa buyuutku.
Wa wakit udwaanna sim'o kadar aniina ligiina khabar hana l-cheyy al-humman yidooru yisawwuuh wa l-Rabb kula waggaf niiyithum al-chaalooha,khalaas aniina kullina ke gabbalna fi khidmit al-durdur,ayyi waahid fi bakaanah.
Wa laakin min al-yoom daak,nuss al-naas gaa'idiin yakhdumu wa nussuhum kamaan gaa'idiin be huraab wa darag wa nachaachiib wa duruu'.Wa l-kubaaraat gaa'idiin wara naas balad Yahuuza wa yiraakhubuuhum.
Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin yabnu al-durdur wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin yijiibu khumaam al-buna,kulluhum ke gaa'idiin yakhdumu be iid waahide wa fi iidhum al-aakhara kamaan kaarbiin al-silaah.
Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin yabnu al-durdur,ayyi waahid seefah fi naaytah.Wa l-naadum al-yadrub al-buug kamaan gaa'id jambi.
Wa ana gult le l-kubaaraat wa l-mas'uuliin wa l-cha'ab-:-Al-khidme di,hi kabiire wa wasii'e wa aniina muchattatiin fi l-durdur,ayyi waahid ba'iid min al-aakhar.
Wa wakit tasma'o hiss al-buug da,ta'aalu limmu leena fi l-bakaan da wa Ilaahna kamaan yidaawis leena.
Wa be misil da,aniina gaa'idiin nitaabu'u fi l-khidme,nussina al-waahid gaa'idiin nakhdumu wa nussina al-aakhar kamaan kaarbiin al-huraab,min waradde lahaddi al-nujuum yinchaafo.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit da,ana gult le l-cha'ab khalli ayyi waahid ma'a l-naadum al-yisaa'idah fi l-buna yunuumu daakhal fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa nukhuttu hurraas yahfadoona be l-leel wa fi l-nahaar kamaan,nakhdumu.
Wa la ana wa la akhwaani wa la l-jamaa'a al-ma'aayi wa la l-hurraas al-gaa'idiin yitaabu'uuni,abadan ma nisillu khulgaanna wa ayyi waahid be silaahah fi iidah.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,naas waahidiin wa awiinhum gaddamo chakwa didd akhwaanhum al-Yahuud.
Wa waahidiin minhum gaalo-:-Aniina wa awlaadna wa banaatna katiiriin.Nidooru gameh achaan ni'iichu.
Wa waahidiin gaalo-:-Ziraa'itna wa jineenaatna hana l-inab wa buyuutna bigo damaana le l-gameh al-chilnaah achaan ni'iichu beyah fi wakt al-juu' da.
Wa aakhariin kamaan gaalo-:-Aniina chilna deen achaan nantu le l-malik al-miiri al-waajib nikaffuuh le ziraa'itna wa jineenaatna hana l-inab.
Laakin aniina kula misil akhwaanna al-aakhariin,iyaalna kula misil iyaalhum.Al-gu bas khallaana nibii'u awlaadna wa banaatna achaan yisawwuuhum abiid.Wa waahidaat min banaatna hassa' kula gaa'idaat khadiim wa ma nagdaro nisawwu cheyy achaan ziraa'itna wa jineenaatna bi'naahum khalaas.
Wa wakit ana simi't chakwithum di,zi'ilt marra waahid.
Ana fakkart fi kalaamhum da be ziyaada wa harajt al-kubaaraat wa l-mas'uuliin wa gult leehum-:-Intu gaa'idiin tazulmu akhwaanku wa tichiilu minhum riba be ziyaada-!-Wa ba'ad da,ana naadeethum fi malamma kabiire
wa gult leehum-:-Aniina be gudritna gidirna fadeena akhwaanna al-Yahuud al-baa'oohum abiid le l-umam al-aakhariin.Wa hassa',intu zaatku gaa'idiin tibii'u akhwaanku abiid le gabiilitna-! Wa humman sakato wa ma gidro gaalo cheyy waahid kula.
Wa ana battaan gult leehum-:-Al-sawweetuuh da ma adiil marra waahid.Ma akheer turuukhu be khoof hana Ilaahna fi guluubku walla-?Be da,udwaanna al-min umam aakhariin ma yichchammato leena.
Ana wa akhwaani wa l-rujaal al-gaa'idiin ma'aayi,aniina kula dayyannaahum gurus wa gameh.Hassa' da,al-deen khalli nikhalluuh leehum.
Al-yoom bas,intu kula gabbulu leehum ziraa'ithum wa jineenaathum hana l-inab wa l-zaytuun wa buyuuthum kula.Wa battaan kan dayyantuuhum gurus aw gameh aw khamar hana inab aw dihin,kan al-ribih al-tichiiluuh minhum waahid fi l-miya da kula,saamuhuuh leehum.
Wa humman gaalo-:-Tamaam,nigabbuluuh leehum wa ma nichiilu minhum cheyy waahid kula battaan wa nisawwu misil inta gultah.-Wa misil da,ana naadeet kubaaraat rujaal al-diin le nihallif giddaamhum al-naas al-anto deen achaan yitabbugu kalaamhum al-gaalooh.
Wa hatteet khalagi wa gult-:-Misil ana hatteet khalagi,khalli al-Rabb kula yatrud al-naadum al-ma yitabbig kalaamah.Hu yaturdah min beetah wa min maalah wa l-naadum da yabga matruud marra waahid wa yagood ta'baan. Wa kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin gaalo aamiin wa hamado Allah.Wa khalaas,tabbago kalaamhum al-gaalooh.
Wa min yoom al-malik Artahachta khattaani haakim fi balad Yahuuza,indi 12 sana.Wa da min sanit 20 hana mulkah lahaddi sanit 32.Wa fi l-wakit da,wa la ana wa la akhwaani,al-cheyy al-waajib le l-haakim kula,aniina ma chilnaah.
Laakin al-hukkaam al-hakamo gubbaali,humman sawwo hukumhum tagiil le l-cha'ab.Chaalo min ayyi waahid akil wa khamar hana inab wa 40 hajar fudda.Wa l-musaa'idiin hana l-hukkaam dool kula daayago al-cha'ab.Ana kamaan ma sawweet misil da achaan nakhaaf al-Rabb.
Wa be da,ma chareet turaab le nafsi wa sawweet khidimti hana buna al-durdur wa naasi kulluhum gaa'idiin yakhdumu ma'aayi.
Kubaaraat al-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin yaakulu fi bakaani,humman 150 wa battaan min al-umam al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin jambina kula,fi naas bajuuna.
Kulla yoom,badbaho leena toor wa sitte kubchaan sumaan wa jidaad.Wa kulla ma achara yoom,bijiibu khamar hana inab katiir.Laakin be da kula,ana ma dawwart al-waajib le l-haakim min al-cha'ab achaan bala da kula,ta'ab al-khidme bigi leehum tagiil.
Hassa' da,ya Ilaahi,fakkir fi kulla cheyy sameh al-ana sawweetah le l-cha'ab wa sawwi leyi al-kheer.
Wa misil da,ana baneet al-durdur wa kammaltah lahaddi khurma sakhayre kula ma faddalat.Wa laakin fi l-wakit da,al-biibaan lissaa' ma rakkabtuhum.Wa wakit Sanbalat wa Tuubiiya wa Gachaam al-Arabi wa udwaanna al-aakhariin kula sim'o al-khabar da,
Sanbalat wa Gachaam rassalo leyi wa gaalo-:-Ta'aal wa khalli nilimmu fi hillit Kafiriim jamb al-waadi hana Uunu. Wa laakin ana irift kadar humman yidooru yisawwu leyi cheyy fasil.
Wa rassalt leehum naas achaan nurudd leehum fi kalaamhum wa gult leehum-:-Ana gaa'id nisawwi khidme kabiire marra waahid,ma nagdar nikhalliiha.Maala nikhalli al-amal yagiif le namchi leeku-?
Wa humman rassalo leyi be nafs al-kalaam arba'a marraat wa ana kula raddeet leehum be nafs al-radd.
Wa fi l-marra al-khaamse kamaan,Sanbalat rassal leyi nafs al-kalaam be waasitat khaddaamah wa l-khaddaam da indah fi iidah jawaab faatih al-ayyi naadum al-ligaah yagdar yagriih.
Wa l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-jawaab da buguul-:Fi l-umam al-jambuku,al-naas buguulu wa Gachaam kula akkad kadar inta ma'a l-Yahuud al-aakhariin tidooru tugummu didd malikna al-kabiir.Wa achaan da bas,intu gaa'idiin tabnu al-durdur.Wa inta tidoor tabga malik.
Wa buguulu battaan inta khatteet anbiya fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yihajju beek wa yuguulu-:-Fi malik gaa'id fi balad Yahuuza-!-Hassa' da ta'aal,nilimmu wa nichchaawaro fi l-kalaam da.Wa kan abeet kamaan,ni'ooru al-malik al-kabiir wa nuguulu leyah inta tidoor tabga malik fi badalah.
Wa ana raddeet fi jawaab Sanbalat wa gult leyah-:-Al-kalaam al-inta gaa'id tuguulah da ma sahiih.Inta bas fakkartah fi nafsak wa gultah.
Wa misil da,kulla l-naas dool bidooru bikhawwufuuna wa fi fikirhum buguulu-:-Iideenhum yinrakhu,ma yagdaro yikammulu al-khidme di. Wa ana kamaan sa'alt Allah wa gult-:-Ya Rabb,ziid gudurti-!
Wa fiyah naadum usmah Chama'ya wileed Dalaaya wileed wileedah le Mahiitabiil.Wa yoom waahid,Chama'ya ma gidir marag min beetah wa naadaani.Wa ana macheet leyah wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ta'aal nindasso fi beet Allah daakhal wa nisiddu al-biibaan achaan naas waahidiin yidooru yaju be l-leel wa yaktuluuk.
Wa ana kamaan gult leyah-:-Kabiir al-cha'ab misli ana da yagdar yi'arrid walla-?Wa ana ma min zurriiyit rujaal al-diin.Kan nadkhul daakhal fi beet Allah,ma numuut walla-?La,ma nadkhul-!
Wa ana irift kadar Chama'ya da,al-Rabb ma rassalah leyi laakin Tuubiiya wa Sanbalat ajjarooh achaan yihajji leyi misil nabi.
Humman ajjarooh achaan nakhaaf min al-kalaam da wa nisawwi al-chokhol al-hu gaalah wa yabga leyi zanib wa usmi yatlaf wa be da,yagdaro yi'ayyubuuni.
Wa ana sa'alt Allah wa gult-:-Ya Ilaahi,fakkir fi Tuubiiya wa Sanbalat wa khidmithum al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuha.Wa fakkir fi Nuu'adya al-nabiiye wa l-anbiya al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin yikhawwufuuni.
Wa misil da,buna al-durdur kammal fi yoom 25 hana l-chahar al-saadis ya'ni fi muddit 52 yoom.
Wa kulla udwaanna wa kulla l-umam al-mujaawiriinna sim'o al-khabar da wa chaafo be eenhum al-cheyy al-bigi.Wa al'ajjabo bilheen wa eeb sawwaahum achaan irfo kadar khidmitna al-sawweenaaha di,be gudrat Ilaahna.
Wa fi l-wakit da,katiiriin min kubaaraat al-Yahuud gaa'idiin yirassulu jawaabaat le Tuubiiya al-min Bani Ammuun wa Tuubiiya kula gaa'id yirassil.
Wa l-Yahuud dool gaa'idiin yachkuru Tuubiiya giddaami wa l-kalaam al-ana gaa'id nihajjiih kula gaa'idiin yanguluuh leyah.Achaan awwal Tuubiiya akhad bineeyit Chakanya al-min al-Yahuud wa Chakanya,hu wileed Aarah.Wa wileed Tuubiiya al-usmah Yuuhanaan,hu kula akhad bineeyit Machullam al-hu kula min al-Yahuud.Wa Machullam da wileed Barakya.Achaan da bas,katiiriin min al-Yahuud halafo achaan alaakhithum ma'a Tuubiiya wa nusbaanhum al-aakhariin tagood adiil.Laakin ana fihimt kadar Tuubiiya rassal leyi al-jawaabaatah dool achaan yikhawwifni bas.
Wakit buna al-durdur kammal khalaas wa rakkabna biibaanah,khatteena hurraas al-biibaan.Wa l-khannaayiin wa l-Laawiyiin kula,khatteenaahum fi bakaanaathum.
Wa ana kallaft akhuuyi Hanaani kabiir fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa ma'aayah Hananya mas'uul fi l-gasir.Wa hu raajil amiin wa bakhaaf al-Rabb ziyaada min al-naas al-aakhariin.
Wa gult leehum-:-Ma taftaho al-biibaan hana Madiinat al-Khudus illa kan al-harraay tatla' foog.Wa waajib le l-hurraas hana l-nahaar yi'akkudu kadar ayyi baab saddooh be guful gubbaal ma yufuutu be makhrib.Wa waajib tukhuttu hurraas min sukkaan al-madiina,waahidiin fi l-bakaanaat al-waajib yaharsuuhum wa waahidiin kamaan yaharsu jamb buyuuthum.
Al-madiina kabiire wa wasii'e wa laakin al-sukkaan al-gaa'idiin foogha chiyya wa buyuutha kula lissaa' ma kammalo bunaahum.
Wa Ilaahi ooraani kadar nilimm al-kubaaraat wa l-mas'uuliin wa l-cha'ab wa nisajjilhum.Wa ana ligiit kitaab al-sajjalo foogah asaame al-naas al-waddoohum fi l-khurba wa gabbalo gubbaalna wa daahu al-asaame al-musajjaliin foogah min awwal.
Awwal Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil karab naas min balad Yahuuza wa waddaahum fi l-khurba.Wa ba'ad amur al-malik Kuurach,humman gabbalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi balad Yahuuza,ayyi waahid fi madiintah.
Wa l-naas dool jo ma'a Zarubaabil wa Yachuu' wa Nahamya wa Azarya wa Ra'amya wa Nahamaani wa Mardakaay wa Bilchaan wa Misfaarat wa Bigwaay wa Nahuum wa Ba'ana.Daahu adad rujaal Bani Israa'iil.

Wa rujaal hillit Beet Azmaawat adadhum 42 raajil.
Wa rujaal hillit Kharyat Ya'ariim wa hillit Kafiira wa hillit Biiruut adadhum 743 raajil.
Wa rujaal hillit al-Raama wa hillit Gaba' adadhum 621 raajil.

Daahu hurraas al-biibaan hana beet Allah.Humman min zurriiyit Challuum wa Atiir wa Talmuun wa Akhuub wa Hatiit wa Chubaay wa kulluhum adadhum 138 raajil.

wa Bisaay wa Ma'uuniim wa Nafuusiim
wa Basluut wa Mahiid wa Harcha
Daahu zurriiyit abiid al-malik Suleymaan.Humman min zurriiyit Sutaay wa Sufarat wa Fariid
wa Chafatya wa Hattiil wa Fukarat Hassabaayim wa Aamuun.
Wa laakin al-naas al-jo min hillit Hajar Mileh wa min hillit Hajar Harcha wa min hillit Karuub Adduun wa min hillit Immiir,humman ma gidro nasabo juduudhum wa la gidro jaabo daliil kadar humman maargiin min Bani Israa'iil.
Wa humman dool min zurriiyit Dalaaya wa zurriiyit Tuubiiya wa zurriiyit Naguuda wa kulluhum adadhum 642 raajil.
Wa waahidiin min rujaal al-diin min zurriiyit Habaaya wa zurriiyit Hagguus wa zurriiyit Barzillaay kula ma gidro nasabo juduudhum.Al-naadum al-ma'ruuf be usum Barzillaay kamaan,hu akhad min banaat Barzillaay al-min turaab Gil'aad wa achaan da bas,sammooh be usum nasiibah.
Wa l-waali zaatah daharaahum ma yaakulu min al-akil al-mukhaddas lahaddi waahid min rujaal al-diin yaji yas'al leehum Allah be l-Uriim wa l-Tummiim.
Wa da bala abiidhum wa khadiimhum al-adadhum 7-337 naas.Wa fi awiin wa rujaal al-yikhannu le Allah wa adadhum 245 naas.
Wa waahidiin min kubaaraat hana khuchuum al-buyuut gammo anto atiiye le l-buna hana beet Allah.Al-waali anta 1-000 jineeh hana dahab wa 50 kaas al-yakhdumu beehum fi beet Allah wa 530 khalag hana rujaal diin wa khattaahum fi l-makhaazin hana beet Allah.
Wa kubaaraat hana khuchuum buyuut aakhariin kula jaabo 20-000 jineeh hana dahab wa 45-000 hajar fudda wa antoohum le l-khidme.
Wa waahidiin min al-cha'ab kula lammo 20-000 jineeh hana dahab wa 41-000 hajar fudda wa 67 khalag hana rujaal diin.
Wa be misil da,rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa hurraas al-biibaan hana beet Allah wa l-khannaayiin wa waahidiin min al-cha'ab misil al-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah wa kulla Bani Israa'iil al-baagyiin,dool kulluhum gabbalo wa jo sakano fi mudunhum.Wa misil da wakit al-chahar al-saabi' ja,kulla Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin fi mudunhum.
Wa fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-saabi',kulla Bani Israa'iil lammo be galib waahid fi l-naga'a al-giddaam khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh baab al-Almi.Wa gaalo le Azra al-kaatib-:-Jiib leena kitaab Tawraat Muusa al-Allah nazzalah le Bani Israa'iil. Wa khalaas,Azra jaab kitaab al-Tawraat giddaam al-rujaal wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal al-yagdaro yafhamo.
Wa hu gara leehum minnah fi l-naga'a di.Wa min fajur lahaddi gaayle,hu gaa'id yagri giddaam al-rujaal wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal al-yagdaro yafhamo.Wa humman kulluhum gaa'idiin yasma'o adiil kalaam al-Tawraat.
Wa Azra al-kaatib raakib foog fi bakaan aali al-addalooh be khachab le l-malamma hana l-yoom da.Wa jambah be nussah al-zeenaay gaa'idiin Mattitya wa Chama' wa Anaaya wa Uriiya wa Hilkhiiya wa Ma'asiiya.Wa be nussah al-israay kamaan gaa'idiin Fadaaya wa Michayiil wa Malkiiya wa Hachum wa Hachbadaana wa Zakariiya wa Machullam.Dool al-naas al-gaa'idiin jamb Azra.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id fi l-bakaan al-aali wa l-naas chaafooh fatah al-kitaab,kulluhum gammo foog.
Wa Azra hamad Allah al-Rabb al-aziim be hiss aali wa l-naas kulluhum rafa'o iideehum wa gaalo-:-Aamiin,aamiin. Wa ba'ad da,dangaro fi l-ard wa sajado le Allah.
Wa battaan gammo wagafo be tuulhum fi bakaanaathum.Wa naas waahidiin min al-Laawiyiin fassaro ma'ana kalaam Azra wa humman Yachuu' wa Baani wa Charabya wa Yaamiin wa Akhuub wa Chabtaay wa Huudiiya wa Ma'asiiya wa Khaliita wa Azarya wa Yuuzabaad wa Hanaan wa Falaaya.Wa misil da,garo kitaab Tawraat Allah le l-cha'ab wa tarjamooh leehum be lukhkhithum wa fassarooh leehum achaan yafhamooh.
Wa wakit al-naas sim'o kalaam al-Tawraat,kulluhum bako.Wa Nahamya al-waali wa Azra al-kaatib wa raajil al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-gaa'idiin yifassuru al-kalaam gaalo-:-Al-yoom da yoom khaass le Allah al-Rabb-!Ma tahzano wa ma tabku-!
Wa battaan gaalo leehum-:-Amchu wa jahhuzu akil halu wa aakuluuh wa acharbo charaab halu wa gassumu minnah le l-naas al-ma gidro jahhazo cheyy.Achaan al-yoom da yoom khaass le Rabbina.Ma tahzano,achchaaja'o ambeenaatku achaan al-farah al-yaji min Allah,hu gudritku-!
Wa l-Laawiyiin kula gaa'idiin yisabburu kulla l-naas wa buguulu-:-Askutu,al-yoom da yoom khaass.Ma tahzano-!
Wa khalaas,kulla l-naas macho achaan yaakulu wa yacharbo wa yigassumu al-akil wa yafraho farha kabiire achaan fihmo al-kalaam al-ooroohum.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taani,kubaaraat hana khuchuum al-buyuut wa rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin jo le Azra al-kaatib achaan yafhamo be ziyaada ma'ana kalaam al-Tawraat.
Wa ligo maktuub fi kitaab al-Tawraat al-Allah nazzalah leehum be waasitat Muusa kadar Bani Israa'iil yagoodu fi lagaadiibfi wakt al-iid al-bi'ayyuduuh fi l-chahar al-saabi'.
Wa l-iid da waajib yiballukhuuh le Bani Israa'iil fi kulla mudunhum al-gaa'idiin fooghum wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa yuguulu leehum-:-Amurgu fi l-jibaal wa jiibu furuu' be warchaalhum min chadar al-zaytuun wa zaytuun al-kadaade wa chadar al-waadi wa chadar al-tamur wa ayyi nafar hana chadar al-warchaalah katiir.Wa be l-furuu' dool,sawwu lagaadiib misil maktuub fi l-kitaab.
Wa khalaas,al-naas marago wa jaabo kulla nafar hana furuu' wa sawwo lagaadiib,ayyi waahid fi raas dangaaytah aw fi fadaaytah.Wa waahidiin kamaan sawwo lagaadiibhum fi fadaayit beet Allah wa fi l-naga'a al-giddaam baab al-Almi wa fi l-naga'a al-giddaam baab Afraayim.
Wa be misil da,kulla l-jamaa'a al-gabbalo min al-khurba sawwo lagaadiib wa ga'ado fooghum.Wa min wakit Yachuu' wileed Nuun lahaddi l-yoom da,Bani Israa'iil ma ayyado iid al-Lagaadiib.Wa fi l-yoom da,ayyado iid al-Lagaadiib wa firho farha chadiide.
Wa min awwal yoom hana l-iid lahaddi kumaaltah,gaa'idiin yagru min kitaab Tawraat Allah kulla yoom.Wa l-iid da ga'ado foogah sab'a yoom wa fi l-yoom al-taamin kamaan,kammalo al-iid be hafla kabiire hasab al-gaanuun.
Fi nafs al-chahar fi yoom 24,Bani Israa'iil lammo achaan yusuumu wa sabbo turaab fi ruuseehum wa libso khulgaan hana tooba.
Wa Bani Israa'iil an'azalo min kulla l-ajaanib al-gaa'idiin ma'aahum wa wagafo be tuulhum wa gaa'idiin yi'tarufu be zunuubhum wa be l-fasaala al-juduudhum sawwooha.
Wa waagfiin be tuulhum,ayyi naadum fi bakaanah wa garo leehum muddit talaata saa'aat min kitaab al-Tawraat hana Allah Ilaahhum.Wa battaan fi muddit talaata saa'aat aakhar,gaa'idiin yi'tarufu be zunuubhum wa gaa'idiin yasjudu le Allah Ilaahhum.
Wa l-Laawiyiin gammo tala'o fi l-bakaan al-aali al-addalooh be khachab wa humman Yachuu' wa Baani wa Khadmiyiil wa Chabanya wa Bunni wa Charabya wa Baani wa Kanaani.Wa gammo sallo be hiss aali le Allah Ilaahhum.
Wa l-Laawiyiin Yachuu' wa Khadmiyiil wa Baani wa Hachabniya wa Charabya wa Huudiiya wa Chabanya wa Fatahya gaalo-:-Gummu wa ahmudu Allah Ilaahku fi kulla wakit ila l-abad-!--Ya Allah,mabruuk usmak al-majiid al-faayit kulla chukur wa kulla hamd al-aniina nigaddumuuh leek.
Inta bas Allah.Wa inta bas al-sawweet kulla l-samaawaat wa khuwwaathum.Wa inta bas khalagt al-ard wa kulla cheyy al-gaa'id foogha wa l-buhuur wa kulla cheyy al-fiihum.Inta bas al-tanti al-haya le kulla cheyy wa kulla khuwwaat al-samaawaat yasjudu leek.
Inta Allah al-Rabb al-azalt Abraam wa maragtah min madiinat Uur al-Kaldaaniyiin wa sammeetah Ibraahiim.
Wa inta chift galbah wa irift kadar hu amiin leek wa misil da,inta sawweet ma'aayah mu'aahadaachaan tanti le zurriiytah balad al-Kan'aaniyiin wa l-Hittiyiin wa l-Amuuriyiin wa l-Firizziyiin wa l-Yabuusiyiin wa l-Girgaachiyiin.Wa inta haggagt wa'adak achaan inta saadikh.
Wa inta chift ta'ab juduudna wakit humman gaa'idiin fi Masir wa simi't korooraakhum wakit gaa'idiin yikooruku fi khachum al-bahar al-Ahmar.
Wa sawweet le Fir'oon wa abiidah wa naasah al-fi Masir alaamaat wa ajaayib achaan inta irift kikkeef humman astakbaro didd juduudna.Wa wassaft leehum gudurtak wa sawweet usmak aali lahaddi al-yoom.
Wa chaggeet al-bahar min usut giddaam juduudna wa humman gata'o al-bahar fi l-turaab al-yaabis.Wa le l-naas al-gaa'idiin yitaarudu juduudna kamaan,inta zagaltuhum fi l-bahar misil hajar tagiil fi almi khariig.
Wa gudt cha'abak be l-nahaar fi amuud hana sahaab wa be l-leel fi amuud hana naar achaan tidawwi leehum al-derib al-yamchu foogah.
Wa inta nazalt leehum fi raas jabal Siinaa' wa hajjeet leehum min al-samawa anteethum gawaaniin adiiliin wa l-Tawraat al-mukarram wa churuut wa wasaaya zeeniin.
Wa allamtuhum kadar yoom al-sabt da yoom khaass leek inta.Wa anteethum wasaaya wa gawaaniin wa churuut al-Tawraat be waasitat abdak Muusa.
Wa anteethum akil min al-sama wakit jii'aaniin wa maragt leehum almi min al-hajar wakit atchaaniin.Wa anteethum izin achaan yamchu wa yichiilu al-balad al-halaft wa gult tantiihum.
Laakin abbahaatna astakbaro wa gawwo ruuseehum wa abo ma yitabbugu wasiiyaatak.
Wa khaalafook wa abo ma yitabbugu kalaamak wa ma gaa'idiin yizakkuru al-ajaayib al-inta sawweethum leehum.Wa gawwo ruuseehum wa fi mu'aaradathum,fattacho leehum derib achaan yigabbulu fi Masir fi l-bakaan al-ga'ado foogah abiid.Wa misil da,hagarook bilheen.Laakin inta al-Rabb al-Khafuur wa l-Rahmaan al-Rahiim wa l-Sabuur wa inta al-Muhibb ziyaada.Humman abook wa sana'o leehum sanam hana ijil be dahabwa gaalo-:--Da bas al-ilaah al-maragaana min Masir-!- Wa be da kula,inta ma khalleethum.
Wa battaan fi wakit humman gaa'idiin fi l-sahara kula,be rahmatak al-kabiire inta ma khalleethum.Amuud al-sahaab ma kassa minhum be l-nahaar wa amuud al-naar kula ma kassa minhum be l-leel achaan yidawwi leehum al-derib al-yamchu foogah.
Wa nazzalt leehum ruuhak al-zeen achaan yantiihum al-fihim.Wa anteethum al-manna wakit jii'aaniin wa wakit atchaaniin,anteethum almi.
Fi muddit 40 sana fi l-sahara,karabtuhum adiil wa cheyy ke ma gassar leehum wa la khulgaanhum achcharrato wa la rijleehum wirmo.
Wa inta anteethum turaab hana muluuk wa umam aakhariin lahaddi l-huduud.Wa khalaas,humman chaalo balad hana malik Siihuun al-fi madiinat Hachbuun wa balad hana Oog malik turaab Baachaan.
Wa inta sawweet zurriiyithum katiiriin misil nujuum al-sama wa jibtuhum fi l-balad al-waa'adt beeha juduudhum wa gult yichiiluuha wa yagoodu foogha.
Wa zurriiyithum dakhalo fi balad Kan'aan wa chaalooha.Wa inta hazamt al-Kan'aaniyiin siyaad al-balad wa muluukhum wa sallamtuhum le Bani Israa'iil achaan yisawwu fooghum misil yidooruuh.
Wa humman chaalo mudun gawiyiin al-muhawwagiin be daraadir wa chaalo ard al-tigawwim ma'aach adiil wa buyuut be kulla khumaamhum al-sameh wa ga'ado fooghum.Wa chaalo biyaar wa jineenaat hana inab wa chadar hana zaytuun wa chadar katiir al-yanti akil.Wa akalo wa chib'o wa bigo sumaan wa aacho fi l-raaha.Wa da kulla ke be ni'matak al-kabiire.
Wa laakin humman iso wa gammo diddak wa khaalafo churuut al-Tawraat wa katalo al-anbiya al-inta rassaltuhum le yihazzuruuhum achaan yigabbulu leek.Wa be misil da,hagarook bilheen.
Wa achaan da,inta sallamtuhum fi iideen udwaanhum wa humman ta''aboohum lahaddi sarakho leek.Wa wakit sarakho min al-ta'ab da,inta simi't siraakhhum min al-sama wa be rahmatak al-kabiire,gawwamt min usuthum naas al-yinajjuuhum min udwaanhum.
Wa laakin wakit humman ligo al-raaha,battaan kula gammo yisawwu al-charr giddaamak.Wa inta battaan sallamtuhum fi iideen udwaanhum wa malako fooghum.Wa wakit sarakho leek battaan,inta simi't siraakhhum min al-sama wa be rahmatak najjeethum marraat katiire.
Wa inta hazzartuhum achaan yigabbulu le churuut al-Tawraat wa laakin humman astakbaro wa abo wasiiyaatak wa aznabo ma tabbago gawaaniinak.Wa gawaaniinak dool kamaan,al-naadum kan simi'hum,yalga fooghum al-haya.Laakin humman gammo gawwo ruuseehum wa antook duhuurhum wa abo ma yasma'o kalaamak.
Wa be da kula,inta sabart leehum muddit siniin wa nazzalt ruuhak fi anbiyaak achaan yihazzuruuhum.Laakin humman abo ma yasma'o wa inta sallamtuhum le l-chu'uub.
Wa laakin be rahmatak al-kabiire,inta ma dammartuhum wa ma khalleethum achaan inta al-Ilaah al-Rahmaan al-Rahiim.
Hassa',ya Rabbina,inta al-Ilaah al-kabiir wa l-gaadir wa l-aziim wa inta tahfad al-mu'aahada al-sawweetha be amaan.Ya Rabbina,al-diige al-jaat fi muluukna wa kubaaraatna wa rujaal al-diin hanaana wa anbiyaana wa juduudna wa kulla cha'abak da min zaman al-muluuk hana balad Achuur lahaddi l-yoom,al-diige di ma tichiifha hayne.
Inta aadil wa fi kulla cheyy al-bigi leena,inta aamaltina be l-sidikh laakin aniina sawweena al-charr.
Wa muluukna wa kubaaraatna wa rujaal al-diin hanaana wa abbahaatna kulluhum ma tabbago churuut al-Tawraat wa ma khatto baalhum fi wasiiyaatak wa la fi l-tahziir al-inta hazzartuhum.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin fi mamlakathum,fi l-turaab al-inta anteethum al-hu wasii' wa bigawwim ma'aach adiil,humman ma abadook wa ma taabo min haalhum al-cheene.
Wa chiif,ya Rabb-!Al-balad al-inta anteetha le juduudna achaan naakulu minha intaaj sameh,al-yoom aniina bigiina foogha abiid.
Wa l-intaaj al-katiire hana turaabna kula bigi le l-muluuk al-aakhariin al-inta khatteethum foogna achaan aniina aznabna.Wa humman dool gaa'idiin yahkumu foogna wa fi bahaayimna misil bidooruuh.Wa be da,aniina gaa'idiin fi diige chadiide.
Wa be sabab da,aniina Bani Israa'iil chilna niiye astafagna wa katabna al-istifaag da.Wa kubaaraatna wa l-Laawiyiin wa rujaal al-diin hanaana,ayyi waahid khatta khitmah be usmah fi waragat al-istifaag.
Wa l-naas al-khatto khitimhum fi waragat al-istifaag di,humman al-waali Nahamya wileed Hakalya wa Sidkhiiya
wa Saraaya wa Azarya wa Irmiya
wa Fachhuur wa Amarya wa Malkiiya
wa Hattuuch wa Chabanya wa Malluuk
wa Hariim wa Marimuut wa Ubadya
wa Danyaal wa Ginnatuun wa Baruuk
wa Machullam wa Abiiya wa Miyaamiin
wa Ma'azya wa Bilgaay wa Chama'ya.Wa humman kulluhum rujaal al-diin.
Wa l-Laawiyiin al-sajjalo asaameehum,humman Yachuu' wileed Azanya wa Binuuwi min iyaal Hinadaad wa Khadmiyiil
wa l-naas al-ma'aahum Chabanya wa Huudiiya wa Khaliita wa Falaaya wa Hanaan
wa Miika wa Rahuub wa Hachabya
wa Zakkuur wa Charabya wa Chabanya
wa Huudiiya wa Baani wa Baniinu.
Wa kubaaraat al-cha'ab al-sajjalo asaameehum,humman Far'uuch wa Fahat Muwaab wa Ilaam wa Zattu wa Baani
wa Bunni wa Azgad wa Babaay
wa Aduniiya wa Bigwaay wa Adiin
wa Atiir wa Hizkhiiya wa Azzuur
wa Huudiiya wa Hachum wa Bisaay
wa Hariif wa Anatuut wa Niibaay
wa Magfii'ach wa Machullam wa Hiziir
wa Machizabiil wa Saduukh wa Yaduu'
wa Falatya wa Hanaan wa Anaaya
wa Huucha' wa Hananya wa Hachuub
wa Haluuhiich wa Filha wa Chubiikh
wa Rahuum wa Hachabna wa Ma'asiiya
wa Akhiiya wa Hanaan wa Anaan
wa Malluuk wa Hariim wa Ba'ana.
Wa misil da,aniina al-baagyiin min al-cha'ab,rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin wa hurraas al-biibaan hana beet Allah wa l-khannaayiin wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah wa kulla naas al-an'azalo min al-umam al-aakhariin achaan yitabbugu Tawraat Allah,be awiinhum wa awlaadhum wa banaathum wa kulla naas al-yagdaro yafhamo,
kullina ke lammeena ma'a akhwaanna wa naasna al-kubaar.Lammeena achaan nistafugu wa nahalfu kadar nitabbugu Tawraat Allah al-hu nazzalah be waasitat Muusa abdah.Nahalfu achaan nasma'o wa nisawwu hasab al-wasaaya wa l-gawaaniin wa l-churuut hana Allah Rabbina.
Wa fi chaan da,aniina chilna niiye achaan ma nijawwuzu banaatna le siyaad al-balad di wa le awlaadna kula ma nijawwuzuuhum le banaathum.
Wa kan siyaad al-balad jaabo ayyi cheyy hana bee' fi yoom al-sabt aw fi yoom aakhar hana ibaada kula,ma nachruuh minhum.Wa battaan chilna niiye achaan fi l-sana al-saab'e,nikhallu ziraa'itna ma nahartuuhum wa kan naadum addayyan minnina kula,nisaamuhu leyah deenah.
Wa aniina be nufuusna sawweena gaanuun achaan ayyi waahid yanti kulla sana tilit hana hajar fudda le khidmit beet Allah.
Al-khidme al-yisawwuuha fi beet Allah di,yigaddumu al-khubza le Allah wa yantu al-hadiiye hana dagiig al-yoomiiye wa l-dahiiye al-muharraga al-yoomiiye,wa yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-muharragiin fi kulli yoom sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa kulli iid,wa yigaddumu al-dahaaya al-mukhassasiin le Allah wa l-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib hana Bani Israa'iil,wa yisawwu ayyi khidme aakhara al-fi beet Allah.
Aniina al-cha'ab wa rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin chilna niiye wa sawweena am'iyeedaat achaan nigassumu ambeen aayilaatna al-wakit fi l-sana al-waajib niwaddu foogah al-hatab fi beet Allah Ilaahna.Misil da,niwaddu al-hatab al-yutuchchu beyah al-dahaaya fi l-madbah hana Allah Ilaahna misil maktuub fi l-Tawraat.
Wa battaan kula chilna niiye achaan ayyi sana nigaddumu fi beet Allah awwal intaaj al-nagta'ooh min ziraa'itna wa min kulla iyaal chadarna.
Wa misil maktuub fi l-Tawraat,nigaddumu awlaad al-bikir min awlaadna wa awlaad al-bikir min bahaayimna fi beet Allah Ilaahna.Nantu wald al-bikir hana bagarna wa khanamna le rujaal al-diin al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu fi beet Allah Ilaahna.
Wa battaan nantu leehum min awwal dagiigna wa min al-fawaakih hana ayyi chadar al-baakuluuh wa min al-khamar al-jadiid wa min al-dihin al-jadiid.Wa nijiibu kulla l-hadaaya dool fi l-makhaazin al-fi beet Allah Ilaahna.Wa le l-Laawiyiin kamaan,nantuuhum al-uchur min intaaj ziraa'itna wa l-Laawiyiin zaathum yamchu fi l-hillaal al-aniina nahartu fooghum wa yichiilu al-uchur da.
Wa wakit al-Laawiyiin yamchu yichiilu al-uchur da,waahid min rujaal al-diin al-min zurriiyit Haaruun yamchi ma'aahum.Wa l-Laawiyiin zaathum yichiilu uchur min al-uchur al-chaalooh da wa yukhuttuuh fi l-makhaazin al-fi beet Allah.
Wa misil da,al-cha'ab wa l-Laawiyiin yijiibu hadaaya hana gameh wa khamar wa dihin fi l-makhaazin dool.Wa fi l-makhaazin dool,bukhuttu kulla cheyy al-yakhdumu beyah khidmit Allah.Wa rujaal al-diin wa hurraas al-biibaan hana beet Allah wa l-khannaayiin kula,kulluhum bunuumu fi l-makhaazin dool fi yoom khidmithum.Misil da aniina abadan ma nikhallu beet Allah Ilaahna.
Wa kubaaraat al-cha'ab sakano fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-baagi min cha'abhum gaa'idiin fi hillaalhum.Wa sawwo am'iyeedaat achaan 10 fi l-miya min al-cha'ab yamchu yaskunu fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa 90 fi l-miya kamaan yagoodu fi hillaalhum.
Wa waahidiin min al-naas gaddamo nufuushum giddaam al-cha'ab achaan yamchu yaskunu fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-cha'ab baarakoohum.
Wa be misil da,Bani Israa'iil ma'a rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah wa zurriiyit abiid al-malik Suleymaan,kulluhum ga'ado fi hillaal balad Yahuuza,ayyi waahid fi hillitah.Wa kubaaraathum kamaan sakano fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa waahidiin min gabiilat Yahuuza wa waahidiin min gabiilat Banyaamiin kula macho fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa sakano foogha.Wa min gabiilat Yahuuza al-macho sakano hinaak,humman Ataaya wa Ma'asiiya.Wa juduud Ataaya,humman Faaris wa Mahlaliil wa Chafatya wa Amarya wa Zakariiya wa Uzziiya.Wa juduud Ma'asiiya,humman Chiilooh wa Zakariiya wa Yuyaarib wa Adaaya wa Hazaaya wa Kulhuuza wa Baruuk.
Wa min zurriiyit Faaris,468 rujaal saakniin fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa kulluhum askar.
Wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin al-macho sakano hinaak,humman Sallu wa Gabbaay wa Sallaay wa 928 rujaal.Wa juduud Sallu,humman Yacha'ya wa Itiyiil wa Ma'asiiya wa Khulaaya wa Fadaaya wa Yu'iid wa Machullam.
Wa Yuwiil wileed Zikri,hu muraakhibhum.Wa Yahuuza wileed Hasnu kamaan bigi naayib mas'uul al-madiina.
Wa rujaal al-diin al-sakano fi Madiinat al-Khudus,humman Yada'ya wileed Yuyaarib wa Yaakiin
wa Saraaya.Wa juduud Saraaya,humman Akhituub al-mas'uul fi beet Allah wa Marayuut wa Saduukh wa Machullam wa Hilkhiiya.
kulla l-Laawiyiin al-sakano fi Madiinat al-Khudus,adadhum 284 raajil.
Wa hurraas al-biibaan hana beet Allah,humman Akhuub wa Talmuun ma'a akhwaanhum wa adadhum 172 raajil.
Wa Bani Israa'iil al-aakhariin ma'a rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin,kulluhum saakniin fi hillaal balad Yahuuza,ayyi waahid fi ard warasa hana jiddah.
Wa l-khaddaamiin hana beet Allah saakniin fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi haarat Ufal.Wa l-muraakhibiin fooghum Siiha wa Gichfa.
Wa muraakhib al-Laawiyiin al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus usmah Uzzi al-juduudah Asaaf wa Miika wa Mattanya wa Hachabya wa Baani.Wa humman kulluhum min zurriiyit Asaaf wa khannaayiin fi beet Allah.
Wa l-malik Dawuud anta amur wa sawwa nizaam le l-khannaayiin fi beet Allah wa misil da,gaa'idiin yisawwu khidmithum kulla yoom.
Wa fiyah Fatahya kula,al-juduudah Yahuuza wa Zaarah wa Machizabiil.Wa Fatahya da,al-malik al-kabiir al-fi balad Faaris khattaah jambah achaan yimassil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-hillaal wa l-ziraa'a al-mujaawiriinhum,waahidiin min gabiilat Yahuuza jo sakano.Waahidiin sakano fi hillaal Kharyat Arba'a wa Diibuun wa Yakhabsiil wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum
wa fi hillaal Yachuu' wa Mulaada wa Beet Faalat
wa Hasar Chuu'al wa Biir Sab'a wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha
wa fi hillaal Sikhlaag wa Makuuna wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha
wa fi hillaal Een Rimmuun wa Saar'a wa Yarmuut
wa Zanuuh wa Adullaam wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leehum wa fi hillit Lakiich be l-ziraa'a al-mujaawiriinha wa fi hillit Aziikha wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha.Wa misil da,naas min gabiilat Yahuuza sakano fi kulla l-balad,min hillit Biir Sab'a lahaddi waadi Bani Hinnuum.
Wa naas gabiilat Banyaamiin kamaan jo sakano fi hillaal Gaba' wa Mikmaach wa Ayya wa Beet Iil wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha
wa fi hillaal Anatuut wa Nuub wa Ananya
wa Haasuur wa l-Raama wa Gitaayim
wa Hadiid wa Sabu'iim wa Naballat
wa Luud wa Uunu wa fi waadi Haddaad.
Wa waahidiin min al-Laawiyiin al-gaa'idiin fi turaab gabiilat Yahuuza gammo hawwalo fi turaab gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa daahu asaame rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin al-gabbalo ma'a Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil wa Yachuu'.Wa rujaal al-diin al-jo min al-khurba,hummanSaraaya wa Irmiya wa Azra
wa Amarya wa Malluuk wa Hattuuch
wa Chakanya wa Rahuum wa Marimuut
wa Iddu wa Gintuuy wa Abiiya
wa Miyaamiin wa Ma'adya wa Bilga
wa Chama'ya wa Yuyaarib wa Yada'ya
