wa Sallu wa Amuukh wa Hilkhiiya wa Yada'ya.Wa humman dool kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa akhwaanhum fi wakit Yachuu' kabiir rujaal al-diin.
Wa l-Laawiyiin al-gabbalo min al-khurba,hummanYachuu' wa Binuuwi wa Khadmiyiil wa Charabya wa Yahuuza wa Mattanya.Wa Mattanya ma'a akhwaanah,humman masaa'iil fi khine al-chukur fi beet Allah.
Wa Bagbugya wa Unni kamaan akhwaanhum gaa'idiin mulgaabiliin ma'a masaa'iil khine al-chukur achaan yisaa'uduuhum.
Wa Yachuu' kabiir rujaal al-diin wilid Yuyakhiimwa Yuyakhiim wilid Alyaachibwa Alyaachib wilid Yuyaadaa'
wa Yuyaadaa' wilid Yuunataanwa Yuunataan wilid Yaduu'.
Wa wakit Yuyakhiim gaa'id kabiir rujaal al-diin,al-chuyuukh hana khuchuum buyuut rujaal al-diin,hummanMaraaya cheekh khachum beet Saraayawa Hananya cheekh khachum beet Irmiya
wa Machullam cheekh khachum beet Azrawa Yuuhanaan cheekh khachum beet Amarya
wa Yuunataan cheekh khachum beet Maliikuwa Yuusuf cheekh khachum beet Chabanya
wa Adna cheekh khachum beet Hariimwa Halkhaay cheekh khachum beet Marayuut
wa Zakariiya cheekh khachum beet Idduwa Machullam cheekh khachum beet Ginnatuun
wa Zikri cheekh khachum beet Abiiyawa fi naadum aakhar cheekh khachum beet Minyaamiinwa Filtaay cheekh khachum beet Mu'adya
wa Chammuu' cheekh khachum beet Bilgawa Yuunataan cheekh khachum beet Chama'ya
wa Mattinaay cheekh khachum beet Yuyaaribwa Uzzi cheekh khachum beet Yada'ya
wa Khallaay cheekh khachum beet Sallaaywa Ibaar cheekh khachum beet Amuukh
wa Hachabya cheekh khachum beet Hilkhiiyawa Nataniil cheekh khachum beet Yada'ya.
Wa min al-wakit al-attaaba'o foogah kubaaraat rujaal al-diin Alyaachib wa Yuyaadaa' wa Yuuhanaan wa Yaduu',sajjalo asaame chuyuukh hana khuchuum buyuut al-Laawiyiin wa rujaal al-diin.Wa da lahaddi wakit hukum al-malik Daariyuus fi balad Faaris.
Wa asaame chuyuukh hana khuchuum buyuut al-Laawiyiin min wakit Alyaachib gaa'id kabiir rujaal al-diin,sajjaloohum fi kitaab taariikh muluuk Bani Israa'iil lahaddi fi wakit wileed wileedah le Alyaachib al-usmah Yuuhanaan.
Wa kubaaraat al-Laawiyiin,humman Hachabya wa Charabya wa Yachuu' wa Binuuwi wa Khadmiyiil.Wa misil al-malik Dawuud nabi Allah amaraahum,humman wa akhwaanhum yisawwu firkhateen mulgaabiliin.Kulluhum bahmudu wa bachkuru Allah,al-firkha al-waahide tachkur wa l-firkha al-aakhara kamaan tarfa' leeha.
Wa Mattanya wa Bagbugya wa Ubadya kula ma'aahum.Wa Machullam wa Talmuun wa Akhuub,humman hurraas al-makhaazin al-gaa'idiin jamb khachum biibaan beet Allah.
Wa l-naas dool gaa'idiin yakhdumu fi wakit Yuyakhiim gaa'id kabiir rujaal al-diin wa Nahamya gaa'id haakim.Wa fi l-wakit da,Azra kula gaa'id kaatib wa raajil diin.Wa Yuyakhiim da,hu wileed Yachuu' wa Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh.
Wa wakit kammalo buna durdur Madiinat al-Khudus,naado al-Laawiyiin min hillaalhum achaan yaju fi l-madiina wa yi'ayyudu.Wa wakit al-Laawiyiin jaayiin,jaabo ma'aahum nagaagiir wa jigindiiye wa amsibeybe achaan yachkuru wa yikhannu be farha kabiire hana kammiliin al-durdur.
Wa misil da,al-khannaayiin jo min al-hillaal al-jamb Madiinat al-Khudus wa min hillit Natuufa wa l-hillaal al-taab'iinha
wa min hillit Beet Gilgaal wa hillaal Gaba' wa Azmaawat wa l-ziraa'a al-mujaawiriinhum.Humman jo min hillaalhum al-banoohum wa lammo fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin tahharo nufuushum wa sawwo al-cha'ab kula taahiriin.Wa tahharo al-durdur be biibaanah kula.
Wa ana Nahamya gassamt kubaaraat al-diin wa kubaaraat cha'ab Yahuuza firkhateen wa rakkabtuhum fi l-durdur.Firkha waahide hana l-khannaayiin maache fi l-durdur be nuss al-zeene ale khachum al-baab al-binaaduuh baab al-Zibaala.
Wa waraahum maachiin Huchaa'ya wa nuss kubaaraat cha'ab Yahuuza
wa Azarya wa Azra wa Machullam
wa Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa Chama'ya wa Irmiya.
Wa battaan waraahum rujaal al-diin al-yadurbu al-burunji wa humman Zakariiya wa akhwaanah Chama'ya wa Azariil wa Milalaay wa Gilalaay wa Maa'aay wa Nataniil wa Yahuuza wa Hanaani.Wa juduud Zakariiya,humman Asaaf wa Zakkuur wa Mikaaya wa Mattanya wa Chama'ya wa Yuunataan.Zakariiya ma'a akhwaanah chaayliin aalaat al-khine misil aalaat al-amar beehum al-malik Dawuud nabi Allah.Wa l-gaa'id fi raas al-naas dool kulla ke,hu Azra al-kaatib.
Wakit wassalo fi baab Een Almi,al-derib maachi foog giddaamhum fi l-jabal hana madiinat Dawuud be atabaat.Wa humman tala'o foog fi raas al-durdur wa gaa'idiin yichiifu madiinat Dawuud min foog wa maachiin lahaddi baab al-Almi al-gaa'id be l-nuss al-sabhaani.
Wa l-firkha al-aakhara hana l-khannaayiin kamaan maache be nuss al-durdur al-aakhar wa ana waraahum wa nuss al-cha'ab kula ma'aayi.Aniina maachiin wa futna be beet al-muraakhaba al-binaaduuh al-Furun wa maachiin lahaddi fi l-bakaan al-binaaduuh al-durdur al-Wasii'.
Wa macheena futna baab Afraayim wa l-baab al-Gadiim wa baab al-Huut wa futna beet al-muraakhaba hana Hananiil wa beet al-muraakhaba al-binaaduuh Miya wa futna baab al-Khanam wa wagafna fi l-baab al-binaaduuh baab al-Sijin.
Wa ba'ad da,al-firkhateen hana l-khannaayiin wa ana ma'a nuss al-kubaaraat wagafna fi beet Allah.
Wa battaan rujaal al-diin al-asaameehum Aliyaakhim wa Ma'asiiya wa Minyaamiin wa Mikaaya wa Aliyu'naay wa Zakariiya wa Hananya,humman dool gaa'idiin yadurbu al-burunji.
Wa Ma'asiiya wa Chama'ya wa Ali'aazar wa Uzzi wa Yuuhanaan wa Malkiiya wa Ilaam wa Izaar kula gaa'idiin ma'aahum.Wa humman khannaayiin tihit muraakhabat Yizrahya.
Fi l-yoom da,dabaho dahaaya katiiriin wa firho achaan al-Rabb farrahaahum ziyaada.Wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal kula firho wa l-naas gaa'idiin yasma'o farhit Madiinat al-Khudus min ba'iid.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom da,khatto naas mas'uuliin fi l-makhaazin al-bukhuttu fooghum al-zakaat wa l-uchuur wa awwal intaaj al-gata'ooh min al-ziraa'a al-muhawwigiin kulla l-hillaal.Wa l-khumaam al-bukhuttuuh fi l-makhaazin da,hasab kalaam al-Tawraat waajib yantuuh le rujaal al-diin wa le l-Laawiyiin.Wa cha'ab Yahuuza mabsuutiin min khidmit rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin
al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu le Ilaahhum wa yisawwu khidmit al-tihaara.Al-khannaayiin wa hurraas al-biibaan kula gaa'idiin yisawwu khidmithum misil al-malik Dawuud ma'a wileedah Suleymaan amaroohum beyah.
Min zamaan,fi wakit hana l-malik Dawuud wa Asaaf,khatto mas'uuliin fi l-khannaayiin al-yachkuru al-Rabb.
Wa fi wakit Zarubaabil wa Nahamya,Bani Israa'iil yantu kulla yoom al-gisim al-waajib yantuuh le l-khannaayiin wa le hurraas al-biibaan.Wa le l-Laawiyiin kula,gaa'idiin yantuuhum al-gisim al-waajib wa kulla l-Laawiyiin kamaan gaa'idiin yantu minnah al-gisim al-mukhassas le rujaal al-diin al-humman min zurriiyit Haaruun.
Wa fi l-yoom al-garo le l-cha'ab min kitaab Muusa,ligo bakaan al-buguul Bani Ammuun wa l-Muwaabiyiin abadan ma yilkhalbato ma'a jamaa'at al-Rabb.
Achaan zamaan,wakit Bani Israa'iil dawwaro yuchuggu baladhum,humman ma laagoohum wa la antoohum almi wa la akil.Wa battaan al-Muwaabiyiin ajjaro Bal'aam al-chawwaafi achaan yal'an Bani Israa'iil laakin Ilaahna baddal al-la'ana di be baraka.
Wa wakit Bani Israa'iil sim'o al-kalaam da min al-Tawraat,gammo tarado kulla ajnabi min usuthum.
Wa gubbaal yoom al-iid da,Alyaachib bas mas'uul min al-makhaazin al-fi beet Allah.Wa l-makhaazin dool bas al-bukhuttu fooghum al-hadaaya wa l-samukh al-mu'attar wa l-mu'iddaat al-yakhdumu beehum fi beet Allah wa uchuur al-gameh wa l-khamar wa l-dihin.Wa l-khumaam da yantuuh le l-Laawiyiin wa le l-khannaayiin wa le hurraas al-biibaan wa yantu minnah le rujaal al-diin kula.Wa Alyaachib da,hu nasiibah le Tuubiiya al-min Bani Ammuun wa achaan da,hu anta izin le Tuubiiya yukhutt khumaamah fi makhazan waahid kabiir min al-makhaazin dool.
Wa fi l-wakit Alyaachib gaa'id foogah mas'uul min al-makhaazin da,ana ma fiini fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan fi l-sana al-foogha Artahachta malik Baabil indah 32 sana fi mulkah,ana gabbalt leyah hinaak.Wa ga'adt ma'aayah wa wakit nidoor nigabbil kamaan,chilt minnah izin
wa gabbalt fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit jiit,irift kadar Alyaachib sawwa cheyy fasil achaan anta le Tuubiiya makhazan min al-makhaazin al-gaa'idiin fi fadaayit beet Allah.
Al-khabar da za''alaani za'al chadiid wa anteet izin achaan yidaffugu khumaam Tuubiiya barra min al-makhazan.
Wa gult leehum yitahhuru al-makhaazin wa yigabbulu yidissu fooghum al-khumaam al-yakhdumu beyah fi beet Allah wa l-hadaaya wa l-samukh al-mu'attar.
Wa battaan simi't kadar al-naas ma anto al-waajib yantuuh le l-Laawiyiin wa achaan da,al-naas al-waajib yakhdumu,ya'ni al-Laawiyiin wa l-khannaayiin,kulluhum khallo al-khidme wa gabbalo fi ziraa'ithum.
Wa ana harajt al-mas'uuliin wa gult leehum-:-Maala khalleetu beet Allah-?-Wa battaan lammeet al-Laawiyiin wa l-khannaayiin wa gabbaltuhum ayyi waahid fi khidimtah.
Wa misil da,naas Yahuuza kulluhum jaabo battaan uchuur al-gameh wa l-khamar wa l-dihin wa khattoohum fi l-makhaazin hana beet Allah.
Wa ana kallaft be mas'uuliiyit al-makhaazin Chalamya raajil al-diin wa Saduukh al-kaatib wa Fadaaya al-min al-Laawiyiin wa Hanaan wileed Zakkuur wileed Mattanya.Wa azalt al-naas dool achaan al-naas induhum fooghum amaan.Wa misil da,humman yigassumu al-khumaam le akhwaanhum.
Ya Ilaahi,fakkir foogi-!Ma tansa al-amal al-ana sawweetah be amaan le beetak wa le khidimtah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,ana chift fi balad Yahuuza naas waahidiin ya'asuru inabhum fi yoom al-sabt.Wa aakhariin bichiddu gameh fi hamiirhum wa bijiibuuh aw bijiibu khamar hana inab aw al-inab zaatah aw tiin aw ayyi budaa'a aakhara fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi yoom al-sabt.Wa misil da,ana hazzartuhum achaan ma yibii'u khumaamhum fi yoom al-sabt.
Wa l-naas al-min balad Suur al-saakniin fi Madiinat al-Khudus,humman kula bijiibu huut wa budaa'a aakhara achaan yisaawugu fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi kulla balad Yahuuza fi yoom al-sabt.
Wa ana harajt kubaaraat Yahuuza wa gult leehum-:-Chunu al-fasaala al-gaa'idiin tisawwuuha di-?Maala ma tihtarumu yoom al-sabt-?
Juduudku kula ma sawwo nafs al-fasaala walla-?Wa achaan da Ilaahna jaab leena al-diige di,leena aniina wa le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa achaan intu ma ahtaramtu yoom al-sabt da,gaa'idiin tikhaddubu Allah foog Bani Israa'iil be ziyaada.
Wa misil da,ana gult leehum yisiddu biibaan Madiinat al-Khudus gubbaal leelit al-sabt,wakit al-wata tabga dalma.Wa ooreethum ma yaftahoohum lahaddi yoom al-sabt yikammil.Wa battaan khatteet waahidiin min naasi fi l-biibaan achaan yadharo al-naas ma yindasso be l-budaa'a.
Wa laakin be da kula,al-tujjaar jo be budaa'a nafar nafar wa ragado barra min Madiinat al-Khudus marra aw marrateen.
Wa ana hazzartuhum wa gult leehum-:-Maala tarugdu jamb al-durdur-?Wa kan battaan sawweetu misil da,ana nakrubku-! Wa min al-yoom da battaan ma gabbalo fi yoom al-sabt achaan yisaawugu.
Wa ana gult le l-Laawiyiin yabgo taahiriin wa yaju yaharsu biibaan al-madiina achaan yoom al-sabt yukuun mukhaddas.Ya Ilaahi,fakkir foogi-!Ma tansa al-amal al-ana sawweetah da wa hinn foogi be rahmatak al-kabiire.
Wa battaan fi l-wakit da,ana chift al-Yahuud akhado awiin min sukkaan Achduud wa Bani Ammuun wa l-Muwaabiyiin.
Wa nuss min iyaalhum bihajju be lukhkhat Achduud wa waahidiin bihajju be lukhkhaat hana buldaan aakhariin,laakin waahid minhum kula ma ba'arif bihajji be lukhkhat al-Yahuud.
Wa misil da,ana harajt abbahaathum wa la'antuhum wa daggeet waahidiin minhum wa mallatt suufhum.Wa hallaftuhum be usum al-Rabb wa gult leehum-:-Ma tantu banaatku le awlaadhum wa ma tichiilu banaathum le awlaadku wa la le nufuusku intu kula.
Misil intu ta'arfuuh,Suleymaan malik Israa'iil aznab be akhiidtah le l-awiin al-min al-umam dool.Wa laakin fi buldaan al-aalam,ma fi malik mislah hu achaan Ilaahah habbaah wa sawwaah malik le kulla Bani Israa'iil.Wa be da kula,al-awiin al-min al-umam dool lazzannah wa hu aznab-!
Wa intu kula,be l-fasaala al-katiire al-gaa'idiin tisawwuuha be akhiidit al-awiin min al-umam di,intu gaa'idiin tukhuunu Ilaahna.Wa fi niiyitku,tidooru naskut saakit walla-?
Wa waahid min iyaal Yuyaadaa' wileed Alyaachib kabiir rujaal al-diin,hu kula akhad bineeyit Sanbalat al-min hillit Huruun.Achaan da,ana taradtah min giddaami.
Ya Ilaahi,rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin najjaso khidmithum wa jamaa'ithum al-inta sawweet ma'aahum mu'aahada.Ma tansa fi'ilhum wa laakin aakhibhum-!
Wa ana kamaan taradt wa maragt min lubbuhum kulla ajnabi wa misil da,sawweethum taahiriin.Wa nazzamt rujaal al-diin wa l-Laawiyiin wa gabbaltuhum ayyi waahid fi khidimtah.
Misil nizaam al-nazzamtuhum min awwal,gult leehum yijiibu hatab le l-dahaaya fi beet Allah fi l-wakit al-waajib wa yigaddumu awwal intaaj al-yagta'ooh min al-ziraa'a kula.Ya Ilaahi,fakkir foogi-!Be kheerak,ma tansaani-!
Al-taariikh da bigi fi wakit al-malik Achawiruuch.Wa Achawiruuch da hakam fi 127 wulaaya min balad al-Hind lahaddi balad al-Habacha.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,al-malik Achawiruuch ga'ad fi gasir al-mamlaka wa hakam fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukmah,hu sawwa aazuuma kabiire wa lamma kulla masaa'iilah wa khaddaamiinah wa askar al-Faarisiyiin wa l-Maadiyiin wa l-hukkaam wa kubaaraat al-wulaayaat.
Wa fi muddit 180 yoom,hu wassaf leehum al-khuna al-katiir hana mamlakatah wa khiimtah al-kabiire.
Wa ba'ad al-ayyaam dool kammalo,al-malik azam fi l-aazuuma kulla l-naas al-saakniin fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye min al-khani lahaddi l-fagri.Wa humman ga'ado sab'a yoom fi l-fadaay hana jineenit gasir al-malik.
Wa l-bakaan da mujammal be sataayir hana gumaach abyad wa garadi.Wa allagoohum be hubaal buyud wa humur tchu fi khawaatim hana fudda wa rabatoohum fi raas amad hana rukhaam.Wa khatto saraayir hana dahab wa fudda fi l-ard al-jammalooha be rukhaam abyad wa azrag wa hajar sameh.
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yacharbo be mawaa'iin hana dahab nafarhum chig chig.Wa l-malik gaddam leehum khamar katiir marra waahid be juud al-mamlaka.
Wa ayyi waahid yachrab hasab niiytah achaan al-malik amar kulla khaddaamiinah yantu le ayyi naadum al-cheyy al-yidoorah.
Wa l-malika Wachti,hi kulla sawwat aazuuma le l-awiin fi gasir al-malik Achawiruuch.
Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' wakit al-malik Achawiruuch chirib al-khamar wa bigi farhaan,hu naada khaddaamiinah Mahumaan wa Bizta wa Harbuuna wa Bigta wa Abagta wa Ziitar wa Karkas,dool al-khaddaamiin al-sab'a al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu tihtah.
Wa l-malik amar yijiibu giddaamah al-malika Wachti be taajha hana l-mamlaka le yiwassif jamaalha le l-cha'ab wa le masaa'iilah achaan hi jamiile marra waahid.
Wa laakin al-malika Wachti abat ma taji hasab amur al-malik al-gaalah leeha be waasitat khaddaamiinah.Wa khalaas,al-malik khidib khadab chadiid wa l-za'al da harrag galbah.
Wa l-malik hajja ma'a l-ulama wa l-munajjimiin achaan ayyi cheyy al-bukhuss al-mamlaka,yigaddimah giddaam al-naas al-ya'arfu al-gaanuun wa l-charii'a.
Wa l-naas dool al-jamb al-malik,humman Karchana wa Chitaar wa Admaata wa Tarchiich wa Maras wa Marsana wa Mamuukaan,dool al-sab'a masaa'iil hana l-Faarisiyiin wa l-Maadiyiin.Wa humman dool gaa'idiin fi l-daraja al-awwal hana l-mamlaka wa yichiifu al-malik fi ayyi wakit.
Wa l-malik gaal leehum-:-Hasab al-gaanuun,nisawwi chunu didd al-malika Wachti-?Achaan hi ma tabbagat amri ana al-malik Achawiruuch al-gultah leeha be waasitat khaddaamiini.
Wa Mamuukaan chaal al-kalaam giddaam al-malik wa masaa'iilah wa gaal-:-Ya l-malik-!Wachti al-malika ma hagaratak inta wiheedak bas laakin hi hagarat kulla l-masaa'iil wa l-cha'ab hana kulla wulaayaat al-malik Achawiruuch.
Wa kalaam al-malika da,kulla l-awiin yasma'annah wa yahgiran rujaalhin wa yuguulan-:--Al-malik Achawiruuch zaatah gaal yijiibu al-malika Wachti giddaamah laakin hi abat ma taji.--
Wa min al-yoom al-mayaarim hana l-Faarisiyiin wa l-Maadiyiin sim'an be hugrat al-malika,hinna kula yahgiran rujaalhin masaa'iil al-malik.Wa l-hugra di tijiib al-za'al.
Ya siidi al-malik-!Kan adiil leek,khalli yamrug kharaar malaki al-yaktubuuh fi gaanuun al-Faarisiyiin wa l-Maadiyiin al-abadan ma yilkhayyar.Wa khalli yuguul-:--Abadan al-malika Wachti ma taji giddaam al-malik Achawiruuch.Wa hu yanti darajatha hint al-malika le mara aakhara akheer minha.--
Wa wakit kharaar al-malik da yanchuruuh fi kulla l-mamlaka,khalaas kulla l-awiin yikarriman rujaalhin min al-khani lahaddi l-fagri kula.
Wa l-kalaam da bigi adiil le l-malik wa le masaa'iilah wa l-malik tabbag wasiiyat Mamuukaan.
Wa l-malik rassal jawaabaat fi kulla wulaayaat al-mamlaka,le ayyi wulaaya hasab kitaabitha wa le ayyi cha'ab hasab lukhkhitah,wa kharrar kadar ayyi raajil yabga mas'uul fi beetah.Wa l-jawaabaat dool le ayyi cha'ab hasab lukhkhitah.
Wa ba'ad da,za'al al-malik Achawiruuch dalla wa fakkar fi l-malika Wachti wa fi l-cheyy al-sawwatah wa l-kharaar al-hu chaalah diddaha.
Wa l-subyaan al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu leyah gaalo-:-Khalli nifattuchu le l-malik banaat udriiyaat wa jamiilaat.
Wa khalli al-malik yukhutt mukallafiin fi kulla l-wulaayaat hana mamlakatah achaan yijiibu kulla l-banaat al-udriiyaat wa jamiilaat fi beet al-awiin fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye.Wa yagoodan tihit mas'uuliiyit Higaay khaddaam al-malik al-mukallaf be l-awiin.Wa hu yantiihin al-dihin al-waajib yiljammalan beyah.
Wa l-bineeye al-ta'ajib al-malik,hi bas tabga malika fi badal Wachti. Wa l-kalaam da ajab al-malik wa khalaas bigi misil gaalooh.
Wa fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye,fiyah raajil waahid Yahuudi usmah Mardakaay wileed Yayiir wileed Chim'i wileed Khiich.Wa hu min gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa l-raajil da,hu min naas Madiinat al-Khudus al-chaalaahum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa waddaahum fi l-khurbama'a Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa Mardakaay,hu kaliif Hadassa al-binaaduuha Astiir achaan wa la indaha amm wa la abu.Wa hi jamiile wa daggaha sameh.Wa hi bineeyit immah wa min moot ammaha wa abuuha,Mardakaay bas chaalaaha misil bineeytah wa rabbaaha.
Wa ba'ad sim'o kharaar al-malik wa gaanuunah,jaabo banaat katiiriin fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye tihit mas'uuliiyit Higaay.Wa Astiir kulla waddooha fi l-gasir tihit mas'uuliiyit Higaay al-mukallaf be l-awiin.
Wa l-bineeye di ajabatah wa ligat ridaayah.Wa tawwaali,antaaha gisimha min al-akil wa min al-dihin al-yiljammalo beyah.Wa battaan antaaha sab'a banaat khaddaamaat min al-khaddaamaat al-ahsan hana gasir al-malik.Wa ba'ad da,waddaaha hi wa l-khaddaamaat deel fi l-bakaan al-adiil fi beet al-awiin.
Wa Astiir ma oorathum wa la be ahalha wa la kadar hi Yahuudiiye achaan Mardakaay daharha ma ti'ooriihum.
Wa kulla yoom,Mardakaay yamchi giddaam fadaayit beet al-awiin achaan yalga aafiyit Astiir wa ya'arif kikkeef gaa'idiin yi'aamuluuha.
Wa le ayyi waahide min al-banaat deel,ba'ad 12 chahar,doorha yaji wa l-bineeye tamchi bakaan al-malik Achawiruuch.Wa hasab al-nizaam hana l-awiin deel,yilmassahan be dihin al-sibir le muddit 6 chahar wa be itir wa dihin al-awiin le muddit 6 chahar.
Wa daahu kikkeef al-bineeye tamchi bakaan al-malik.Yantuuha kulla cheyy al-hi tidoor tichiilah ma'aaha min beet al-awiin le gasir al-malik.
Wa be achiiye,hi tamchi.Wa be fajur,tigabbil fi beet al-awiin al-taani tihit mas'uuliiyit Cha'achgaaz khaddaam al-malik al-mukallaf be l-sirriiyaat.Wa hi battaan ma tamchi bakaan al-malik illa kan al-malik dawwarha wa naadaaha be usumha.
Wa ja doorha le Astiir bineeyit Abihaayil immah le Mardakaay,hi al-Mardakaay rabbaaha.Wa wakit ja doorha le tamchi bakaan al-malik,Astiir ma talabat cheyy ziyaada illa l-wassafah leeha Higaay khaddaam al-malik al-mukallaf be l-awiin.Wa Astiir ligat rida min kulla l-naas al-yichiifuuha.
Wa jo waddo Astiir fi gasir al-malik Achawiruuch fi l-sana al-saab'e hana hukmah,fi l-chahar al-usmah Tibit.
Wa l-malik habbaaha le Astiir ziyaada min kulla l-awiin.Wa hi ligat ridaayah wa kheerah ziyaada min kulla l-banaat al-udriiyaat.Wa hu dassa leeha fi raasha taaj al-mamlaka wa sawwaaha malika fi badal Wachti.
Wa l-malik sawwa aazuuma kabiire le kulla masaa'iilah wa khaddaamiinah wa l-aazuuma di tukhuss Astiir.Wa amar ma yichiilu miiri min sukkaan al-wulaayaat wa gassam hadaaya be juud al-mamlaka.
Wa wakit lammo al-banaat al-udriiyaat le taani marra,Mardakaay gaa'id fi khachum baab gasir al-malik.
Wa Astiir ma oorathum wa la be ahalha wa la kadar hi Yahuudiiye achaan Mardakaay daharha ma ti'ooriihum.Wa Astiir gaa'ide titabbig kalaamah misil awwal wakit hi gaa'ide tihtah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,wakit Mardakaay gaa'id fi khachum baab gasir al-malik,khaddaamiin itneen hurraas hana madkhal gasir al-malik humman Bigtaan wa Tarach zi'ilo didd al-malik Achawiruuch wa gaa'idiin yifattuchu tariiga le yaktuluuh.
Wakit Mardakaay simi' be l-khitta di,hu khabbarha le l-malika Astiir.Wa Astiir ooratah le l-malik wa gaalat kadar al-khabar da jaayi min Mardakaay.
Wa fattacho ga'ar al-kalaam da wa ligooh sahiih.Wa khalaas,chanago al-khaddaamiin al-itneen dool.Wa l-cheyy da,katabooh giddaam al-malik fi kitaab al-taariikh hana l-mamlaka.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Achawiruuch antaah le Hamaan wileed Hamdaata al-min zurriiyit Agaag charaf ziyaada min kulla l-masaa'iil al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah.
Wa kulla khaddaamiin al-malik al-gaa'idiin fi khachum baab gasir al-malik yidanguru wa yasjudu giddaam Hamaan wa da misil al-malik amar beyah.Wa laakin Mardakaay wa la yidangir wa la yasjud giddaamah.
Wa khaddaamiin al-malik al-gaa'idiin fi khachum baab gasrah gaalo le Mardakaay-:-Maala ma titabbig amur al-malik-?
Wa daayman gaa'idiin yihajju leyah wa laakin hu ma yasma' kalaamhum.Wa khalaas,humman khabbaro Hamaan achaan yichiif kan kalaam Mardakaay da sahiih achaan hu gaal hu Yahuudi.
Wa wakit Hamaan chaaf kadar Mardakaay ma dangar wa ma sajad,hu zi'il za'al chadiid.
Wa Hamaan ma dawwar yukhutt iidah foog Mardakaay wiheedah bas achaan khabbarooh kadar hu Yahuudi.Wa be misil da,Hamaan gaa'id yifattich tariiga al-yidammir beeha kulla l-Yahuud cha'ab Mardakaay al-gaa'idiin fi kulla mamlakat Achawiruuch.
Wa fi l-chahar al-awwal al-usmah Niisaan fi sanit 12 hana hukum Achawiruuch,sawwo am'iyeedaat al-usumha Fuuriim giddaam Hamaan.Wa hu yidoor yihaddid al-yoom wa l-chahar al-adiil le khittitah wa khalaas,am'iyeedaat waga'at fi chahar 12 al-usmah Adaar.
Wa khalaas,Hamaan gaal le l-malik Achawiruuch-:-Fiyah cha'ab muchattat wa mufarrag fi lubb al-chu'uub hana kulla wulaayaat mamlakatak.Wa gawaaniinhum chig min gawaaniin kulla l-chu'uub al-aakhariin wa humman ma gaa'idiin yitabbugu gaanuunak,ya l-malik.Wa da ma waajib al-malik yikhalliihum fi raaha.
Wa kan bigi leek adiil,ya l-malik,khalli tamrug kharaar le damaarhum.Wa be da,ana nanti 34-000 kiilo hana fudda le khaddaamiin al-mamlaka wa yusubbuuha fi makhaazin al-malik.
Wa khalaas,al-malik salla khaatmah al-yakhtim beyah min usba'ah wa antaah le Hamaan wileed Hamdaata al-min zurriiyit Agaag adu al-Yahuud.
Wa l-malik gaal le Hamaan-:-Al-fudda di,saamahnaaha leek wa l-cha'ab da kula,sawwi fooghum misil inta tidoorah.
Wa fi yoom 13 hana l-chahar al-awwal,naado kulla kuttaab al-malik wa katabo kulla amur Hamaan fi maktuub le muhaafiziin al-mamlaka wa le l-hukkaam hana ayyi wulaaya wa le l-masaa'iil hana ayyi cha'ab wa katabo le ayyi wulaaya hasab kitaabitha wa lukhkhitah.Wa humman katabo al-jawaabaat dool be usum al-malik Achawiruuch wa khatamoohum be khitim al-malik.
Wa l-jawaabaat dool rassaloohum be murassaliin fi kulla wulaayaat al-mamlaka achaan yidammuru wa yaktulu wa yikammulu kulla l-Yahuud,min al-subyaan lahaddi l-chiyyaab,hatta l-awiin wa l-atfaal kula.Wa yanhaboohum wa yaksabo kulla cheyy al-induhum.Wa da yabga fi yoom waahid bas ya'ni fi yoom 13 hana chahri 12 fi l-chahar al-usmah Adaar.
Wa nuskha al-jawaab da,yanchuruuha misil gaanuun fi ayyi wulaaya wa yiballukhuuha le kulla l-chu'uub achaan yukuunu jaahiziin fi l-yoom da.
Wa be amur al-malik,al-murassaliin macho be sur'a wa ballakho al-gaanuun da fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye.Al-malik wa Hamaan ga'ado le yacharbo wa laakin naas madiinat Chuucha barjalo marra waahid.
Wa wakit Mardakaay simi' be kulla l-cheyy al-kaan da,charrat khulgaanah wa libis khulgaan al-hizin wa sabba rumaad fi raasah wa macha fi lubb al-hille.Wa sarakh siraakh chadiid hana wajii'.
Wa macha lahaddi khachum baab gasir al-malik wa wagaf hinaak achaan naadum ma yagdar yadkhul fi gasir al-malik kan laabis khulgaan al-hizin.
Wa fi ayyi wulaaya al-wassal foogha kharaar al-malik wa gaanuunah,bigi hizin kabiir le l-Yahuud wa humman saamo wa bako wa naaho wa katiiriin minhum ragado fi l-chuwaalaat wa fi l-rumaad.
Wa l-banaat al-khaddaamaat al-gaa'idaat ma'a l-malika Astiir wa khaddaamiinha jo wa khabbarooha be hizin Mardakaay wa hi barjalat marra waahid.Wa hi rassalat khulgaan le Mardakaay achaan yalbashum wa yamrug minnah khulgaan al-hizin wa laakin hu aba.
Wa khalaas,Astiir naadat Hataak waahid min khaddaamiin al-malik al-jaabooh achaan yakhdim leeha.Wa hi rassalatah bakaan Mardakaay achaan yi'akkid min al-cheyy al-kaan wa bigi be sabab chunu.
Wa Hataak marag wa laagaah le Mardakaay al-gaa'id fi naga'at al-hille al-mugaabile khachum baab gasir al-malik.
Wa Mardakaay khabbarah be kulla cheyy al-hasal leyah wa akkad leyah al-wazin hana l-fudda al-Hamaan gaal yusubbuuha fi makhazan al-malik wa da le damaar al-Yahuud.
Wa antaah nuskha hana gaanuun damaar al-Yahuud al-katabooh wa ballakhooh fi madiinat Chuucha achaan yiwassifah le Astiir wa yikhabbirha.Wa talab minha tamchi tigaabil al-malik wa tachhadah achaan yihinn fi cha'abha.
Wa Hataak ja khabbaraaha le Astiir be kulla kalaam Mardakaay.
Wa Astiir amarat Hataak achaan yamchi le Mardakaay wa yuguul leyah-:
Kulla khaddaamiin al-malik wa cha'ab wulaayaat al-mamlaka ya'arfu tamaam kadar ayyi naadum kan mara walla raajil kula,kan yamchi fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye hana l-malik bala munaada,fi gaanuun waahid bas al-yahkumuuh beyah wa hu gaanuun al-moot.Wa l-naadum da yi'iich illa kan al-malik madda leyah asaatah al-dahbiiye hana l-muluk.Wa hassa',ana indi 30 yoom ke al-malik ma naadaani le namchi leyah.
Wa khabbarooh le Mardakaay be kalaam Astiir.
Wa Mardakaay rassal radd le Astiir wa gaal-:-Ma be sabab inti gaa'ide fi gasir al-malik tuguuli inti wiheedki bas tanje min kulla l-Yahuud dool.
Wa kan inti taskuti ma tuguuli cheyy fi l-wakit al-munaasib da,al-amaan wa l-naja hana l-Yahuud yaju min bakaan aakhar.Wa laakin inti wa aayilat abuuki kamaan tiddammaro.Wa yaatu ya'arif kadar fi l-haala al-misil di bas,inti bigiiti malika-?
Wa Astiir rassalat leyah al-radd da wa gaalat-:
Amchi limm kulla l-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi madiinat Chuucha wa suumu fi chaani.Ma taakulu wa la tacharbo wa la be l-nahaar wa la be l-leel le muddit talaata yoom.Wa ana kula nusuum wa banaati al-khaddaamaat kula yusuuman kula misilku.Wa ba'ad da,ana namchi nigaabil al-malik hatta kan da didd al-gaanuun kula.Wa kan waajib leyi al-moot,numuut.
Wa Mardakaay macha wa sawwa kulla cheyy al-Astiir amaratah beyah.
Wa wakit al-talaata yoom kammalo khalaas,Astiir libsat khulgaanha hana l-mamlaka wa machat wagafat fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye hana gasir al-malik al-mugaabil al-beet.Wa l-malik gaa'id fi kursiih hana l-muluk fi l-gasir mugaabil madkhal al-beet.
Wa wakit al-malik chaaf Astiir al-malika waagfe fi l-fadaay,hi ligat ridaayah.Wa hu madda le Astiir asaatah al-dahbiiye al-fi iidah wa Astiir garrabat wa limsat raas al-asa.
Wa l-malik gaal leeha-:-Maalki,ya Astiir al-malika-?Chunu munaaki-?Lahaddi kan nuss mamlakati kula,nantiih leeki.
Wa Astiir gaalat leyah-:-Kan bigi leek adiil,ya l-malik,khalli taji ma'a Hamaan fi l-aazuuma al-ana jahhaztaha leyah al-yoom.
Wa khalaas,al-malik gaal-:-Amchu ajala khabburu Hamaan kadar namchu nahdaro fi aazuumit Astiir.-Wa l-malik macha ma'a Hamaan le l-aazuuma al-sawwatha Astiir.
Wa fi l-aazuuma,al-malik gaal le Astiir-:-Chunu talabki-?Nantiih leeki.Wa chunu munaaki-?Lahaddi kan nuss mamlakati kula,nantiih leeki.
Wa Astiir raddat wa gaalat-:-Talabi wa munaayi,
ya l-malik,daahu.Kan nalga minnak al-rida wa kan bigi leek adiil,akhbal talabi wa haggig munaayi.Khalli taji ma'a Hamaan ambaakir fi l-aazuuma al-nisawwiiha leeku.Wa be da,ambaakir nisawwi hasab kalaamak,ya l-malik,wa nurudd le su'aalak.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Hamaan marag mabsuut wa farhaan.Wa laakin wakit hu chaaf fi khachum baab gasir al-malik kadar Mardakaay ma yugumm wa la yarjif giddaamah,khalaas Hamaan zi'il za'al chadiid didd Mardakaay.
Wa Hamaan sabbat nafsah wa macha beetah.Wa rassal naadaahum le rufgaanah wa martah Zarach.
Wa Hamaan hajja leehum be khunaayah al-katiir wa katarat awlaadah wa be kikkeef al-malik charrafah wa darrajah kabiir fi raas kulla masaa'iilah wa khaddaamiinah.
Wa Hamaan gaal battaan-:-Wa ziyaada min da,Astiir al-malika naadatni illa ana ma'a l-malik fi l-aazuuma al-hi jahhazatha.Wa battaan ambaakir kula,ana bas al-ma'zuum ma'a l-malik.
Wa laakin kulla l-cheyy da ma yitimm leyi wakit daayman nichiif Mardakaay al-Yahuudi gaa'id fi khachum baab gasir al-malik-!
Wa khalaas,martah Zarach wa kulla rufgaanah gaalo leyah-:-Sawwi leek uud tuulah 50 duraa' wa ambaakir fajur,atlub min al-malik khalli yi'allugu foogah Mardakaay.Wa ba'ad da,inta tamchi farhaan fi l-aazuuma ma'a l-malik. Wa l-kalaam da bigi halu le Hamaan wa gamma jahhaz leyah al-uud.
Wa fi l-leele di,al-noom aba uyuun al-malik.Wa khalaas,amar yijiibu kitaab al-taariikh hana l-mamlaka.Wa humman jaabooh wa garooh giddaam al-malik.
Wa ligo al-bakaan al-Mardakaay bayyan khittat Bigtaan wa Tarach hurraas al-itneen al-yahfado madkhal gasir al-malik.Humman al-fattacho tariiga le yaktulu al-malik Achawiruuch.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Chunu al-charaf wa l-mukaafa al-antoohum le Mardakaay fi chaan al-cheyy da-? Wa l-subyaan al-yakhdumu leyah gaalo-:-Ma charrafooh be cheyy.
Wa l-malik gaal-:-Yaatu al-gaa'id fi l-fadaay-? Wa fi nafs al-wakit da,Hamaan ja fi l-fadaay al-barraaniiye hana l-gasir achaan yihajji le l-malik yi'allugu Mardakaay fi raas al-uud al-hu jahhazah leyah.
Wa l-subyaan gaalo le l-malik-:-Hamaan bas gaa'id barra fi l-fadaay. Wa l-malik gaal-:-Khalli yadkhul.
Wa Hamaan dakhal wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Yisawwu chunu le l-naadum al-malik yidoor yicharrifah-? Wa Hamaan gaal fi nafsah-:-Le yaatu battaan al-malik yidoor yantiih charaf ziyaada minni ana-?
Wa khalaas,Hamaan radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Kan al-malik yidoor yicharrif naadum,
khalli yantuuh khalag al-libsah al-malik wa juwaad al-rikib foogah al-malik wa yukhuttu fi raas al-juwaad da taaj al-mamlaka.
Wa yantu al-khalag wa l-juwaad le waahid min masaa'iil al-malik wa yilabbusu al-naadum al-malik yidoor yicharrifah.Wa yirakkubuuh fi l-juwaad wa yiwadduuh fi l-naga'a hana l-hille wa yi'iitu giddaamah wa yuguulu-:--Daahu al-cheyy al-yisawwu le l-naadum al-malik yidoor yicharrifah.-
Wa l-malik gaal le Hamaan-:-Ajala chiil al-khalag wa l-juwaad misil inta gultah wa sawwiih le Mardakaay al-Yahuudi al-gaa'id fi khachum baab gasir al-malik.Ma tikhalli cheyy min kulla l-kalaam al-inta gultah.
Wa khalaas,Hamaan chaal al-khalag wa l-juwaad wa labbas al-khalag le Mardakaay wa rakkabah fi l-juwaad wa waddaah fi l-naga'a hana l-hille wa gaa'id yi'iit giddaamah wa yuguul-:-Daahu al-cheyy al-yisawwu le l-naadum al-malik yidoor yicharrifah.
Wa ba'ad da,Mardakaay gabbal fi khachum baab gasir al-malik.Wa Hamaan kamaan gabbal ajala le beetah haznaan wa mukhatti raasah min al-eeb.
Wa Hamaan khabbar martah Zarach wa kulla rufgaanah be l-cheyy al-hasal.Wa rufgaanah al-hakiimiin wa martah gaalo leyah-:-Kan giddaam Mardakaay al-Yahuudi da bas inta badeet ti'iib,inta ma tagdar tisawwi cheyy diddah.Wa laakin daayman tabga aayib giddaamah.
Wa wakit lissaa'hum gaa'idiin yihajju ma'aayah ke bas,khaddaamiin al-malik jo wa waddo Hamaan ajala fi l-aazuuma al-sawwatha Astiir.
Al-malik wa Hamaan macho le yacharbo wa yafraho ma'a Astiir al-malika.
Wa fi l-aazuuma,al-malik sa'alaaha le Astiir taani marra wa gaal-:-Chunu talabki,ya Astiir al-malika-?Nantiih leeki.Wa chunu munaaki-?Lahaddi kan nuss mamlakati kula,nantiih leeki.
Wa Astiir al-malika raddat wa gaalat-:-Kan nalga minnak al-rida wa kan bigi leek adiil,ya l-malik,akhbal talabi wa najji hayaati-!Wa haggig munaayi wa najji hayaat cha'abi-!
Achaan ana wa cha'abi baa'oona le yidammuruuna wa yaktuluuna wa yikammuluuna.Wa sahiih,kan awwal baa'oona misil abiid wa khadiim bas,ana naskut achaan di mudaayaga hayne leena,ma waajib nibachtin beeha al-malik.
Wa khalaas,al-malik Achawiruuch radda le Astiir wa gaal-:-Yaatu al-naadum da-?Ween al-naadum al-indah fikra misil di-?
Wa Astiir gaalat-:-Al-adu wa l-khasiim,hu Hamaan al-fasil da-!-Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,Hamaan gaa'id yarjif min al-khoof giddaam al-malik wa l-malika.
Wa fi za'alah,al-malik marag ajala min bakaan al-aazuuma wa macha fi jineenit al-gasir.Wa Hamaan kamaan ga'ad yachhad al-malika Astiir le tinajji hayaatah achaan hu irif kadar al-malik chaal niiye le yiwaddirah.
Wa wakit al-malik gabbal min jineenit al-gasir le bakaan al-aazuuma,Hamaan waga' fi raas al-sariir al-Astiir gaa'ide foogah.Wa tawwaali al-malik gaal-:-Hal al-raajil da yidoor yargud be gu ma'a l-malika giddaami ana fi lubb beeti walla-?-Wa lissaa' al-malik ma kammal kalaamah ke bas,khaddaamiinah jo khatto wijih Hamaan be git'e.
Wa Harbuuna waahid min al-khaddaamiin hajja giddaam al-malik wa gaal-:-Hamaan jahhaz uud le yi'allugu foogah Mardakaay hu al-kallam kalaam muhimm fi chaan al-malik.Wa l-uud da gaa'id fi beet Hamaan wa tuulah 50 duraa'. Wa l-malik gaal-:-Alluguuh foogah-!
Wa khalaas,allago Hamaan fi raas al-uud al-hu jahhazah le Mardakaay.Wa ba'ad da,za'al al-malik dalla.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom da,al-malik Achawiruuch antaaha le l-malika kulla khumaam Hamaan adu al-Yahuud.Wa Mardakaay ja bakaan al-malik achaan Astiir hajjat le l-malik kadar hu min ahalha.
Wa l-malik salla khaatmah al-chaalah min Hamaan wa antaah le Mardakaay.Wa Astiir darrajat Mardakaay muraakhib fi maal Hamaan.
Wa Astiir machat battaan le l-malik wa waga'at tihit rijileenah be baki wa chahadatah achaan yiwaggif al-fasaala wa l-khitta al-khattatha Hamaan al-min zurriiyit Agaag didd al-Yahuud.
Wa l-malik madda le Astiir asaatah al-dahbiiye al-fi iidah.Wa khalaas,Astiir gammat wa wagafat giddaam al-malik.
Wa gaalat-:-Kan bigi leek adiil,ya l-malik,wa kan nalga minnak rida wa kan al-cheyy da yiwaafig le l-malik wa kan ana ajabtah,khalli yaktubu jawaabaat le yibattulu jawaabaat khittat Hamaan wileed Hamdaata al-min zurriiyit Agaag.Wa l-jawaabaat dool,hu katabaahum le yidammuru al-Yahuud fi kulla wulaayaat al-mamlaka.
Wa kikkeef nagdar nahmal wa nichiif al-fasaala al-talhag cha'abi-?Wa kikkeef nagdar nahmal wa nichiif damaar ahali-?
Wa l-malik Achawiruuch radda le l-malika Astiir wa le Mardakaay al-Yahuudi wa gaal-:-Daahu ana anteet kulla maal Hamaan le Astiir wa hu kamaan,allagooh fi raas al-uud achaan hu dawwar yidammir al-Yahuud.
Hassa' da,aktubu le l-Yahuud be usum al-malik misil intu tidooruuh wa akhtumuuh be khitim al-malik achaan al-maktuub al-katabooh be usum al-malik wa khatamooh be khitim al-malik,ma yagdaro yibattuluuh.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom ya'ni fi yoom 23 hana l-chahar al-usmah Siiwaan,naado kuttaab al-malik.Wa be amur Mardakaay,humman katabo jawaabaat le l-Yahuud wa l-muhaafiziin wa l-hukkaam wa masaa'iil al-wulaayaat al-gaa'idiin fi 127 wulaaya min balad al-Hind lahaddi balad al-Habacha.Wa katabo le ayyi wulaaya hasab kitaabitha wa le ayyi cha'ab hasab lukhkhitah wa le l-Yahuud hasab kitaabithum wa lukhkhithum.
Wa khalaas,humman katabo be usum al-malik Achawiruuch wa khatamooh be khitim al-malik.Wa rassalo al-jawaabaat dool ma'a siyaad kheel al-jarraayiin al-ma'zuuliin le khidmit al-malik.
Wa daahu kalaam al-jawaab-:Al-malik anta izin le l-Yahuud fi kulla l-hillaal achaan yilimmu le yidaafu'u le nufuushum wa le yidammuru wa yaktulu wa yikammulu kulla l-duyuuch al-yaju min ayyi wulaaya wa min ayyi cha'ab wa yahjumuuhum.Wa yisawwu nafs al-cheyy fi iyaalhum wa awiinhum kula wa yagdaro yanhaboohum wa yaksabo khumaamhum.
Wa da yukuun fi yoom waahid bas fi kulla wulaayaat al-malik Achawiruuch ya'ni fi yoom 13 hana chahri 12 al-usmah Adaar.
Wa nuskha al-jawaab da,yanchuruuha misil gaanuun fi ayyi wulaaya wa yiballukhuuha le kulla l-chu'uub achaan ya'arfu kadar fi l-yoom al-muhaddad da,kulla l-Yahuud yabgo jaahiziin le yichiilu al-taar fi udwaanhum.
Wa be amur al-malik,siyaad al-kheel al-ma'zuuliin le khidmit al-malik rikbo al-kheel wa macho be sur'a wa ballakho al-gaanuun da fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye.
Wa Mardakaay marag min gasir al-malik laabis khalag hana muluuk loonah zahri wa abyad wa jallaabiiye min gumaach abyad wa garadi wa taaj kabiir hana dahab fi raasah.Wa kulla naas madiinat Chuucha gaa'idiin yi'iitu min al-farha.
Wa kan le l-Yahuud kamaan,al-yoom da bigi leehum yoom hana nuur wa farha wa suruur wa charaf.
Wa fi ayyi wulaaya wa ayyi madiina wa kulli bakaan al-wassal foogah kharaar al-malik wa gaanuunah,bigat farha wa suruur fi ust al-Yahuud wa yoom halu hana aazuuma.Wa katiiriin min naas al-balad kula sawwo nufuushum Yahuud achaan khaayfiin min al-Yahuud.
Fi yoom 13 hana chahri 12 al-usmah Adaar,fi l-yoom da bas,waajib yitabbugu kharaar al-malik wa gaanuunah wa udwaan al-Yahuud yahsubu yinnasru fooghum.Wa laakin al-cheyy da bigi be l-aks,al-Yahuud annasaro fi l-naas al-kirhoohum.
Wa l-Yahuud lammo fi hillaalhum wa fi kulla wulaayaat al-malik Achawiruuch le yugummu didd al-naas al-dawwaro yisawwu leehum al-fasil.Wa naadum ma gidir yagiif giddaamhum achaan kulla l-cha'ab khaayfiin min al-Yahuud.
Wa kulla masaa'iil al-wulaayaat wa l-muhaafiziin wa l-hukkaam wa khaddaamiin al-malik wagafo wara l-Yahuud achaan khaayfiin min Mardakaay
fi chaan Mardakaay bigi naadum muhimm fi gasir al-malik wa usmah bigi taali' fi kulla l-wulaayaat.Wa Mardakaay gaa'id daayman yabga naadum chadiid be ziyaada.
Wa l-Yahuud darabo kulla udwaanhum be l-seef wa kataloohum wa dammaroohum.Wa le l-naas al-kirhoohum,humman sawwo fooghum misil yidooruuh.
Wa fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye,al-Yahuud katalo wa dammaro 500 raajil.
Wa katalo Farchandaata wa Dalfuun wa Asfaata
wa Furaata wa Adalya wa Aridaata
wa Farmachta wa Arisaay wa Aridaay wa Wayzaata.
Dool al-awlaad al-achara hana Hamaan wileed Hamdaata adu al-Yahuud wa humman kataloohum wa laakin ma chaalo khumaamhum misil khaniime.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom da,khabbaro al-malik be adad al-naas al-maato fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye.
Wa l-malik gaal le Astiir al-malika-:-Fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye,al-Yahuud katalo wa dammaro 500 raajil wa ziyaada min da,katalo al-awlaad al-achara hana Hamaan.Wa chunu al-ma sawwooh fi l-wulaayaat al-aakhariin hana l-mamlaka-?Wa battaan chunu talabki-?Achaan yinnaffaz-!Wa battaan chunu munaaki-?Achaan yilhaggag-!
Wa Astiir raddat wa gaalat leyah-:-Kan bigi leek adiil,ya l-malik,khalli al-Yahuud al-fi Chuucha yalgo izin yisawwu ambaakir kula nafs al-cheyy hasab al-gaanuun misil sawwooh al-yoom.Wa khalli yi'allugu al-awlaad al-achara hana Hamaan fi l-iidaan.
Wa l-malik amar wa gaal-:-Khalli yisawwu misil da.-Wa marago kharaar fi Chuucha wa allagoohum le l-awlaad al-achara hana Hamaan.
Wa l-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi Chuucha lammo battaan fi yoom 14 hana l-chahar Adaar wa katalo 300 raajil fi Chuucha wa laakin ma chaalo khumaamhum misil khaniime.
Wa laakin gabul da,al-Yahuud al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin fi wulaayaat al-mamlaka lammo le yidaafu'u le nufuushum min udwaanhum le yalgo al-jumma.Wa katalo 75-000 min al-naas al-kirhoohum wa laakin ma chaalo khumaamhum misil khaniime.
Wa da bigi fi yoom 13 hana l-chahar al-usmah Adaar.Wa humman anjammo fi yoom 14 wa sawwo al-yoom da,yoom hana iid wa farha.
Wa kan le l-Yahuud al-fi Chuucha al-lammo fi yoom 13 wa 14,humman anjammo yoom 15 wa sawwo al-yoom da,yoom hana iid wa farha.
Wa fi chaan da bas,al-Yahuud al-saakniin barra fi l-hillaal yisawwu yoom 14 hana l-chahar Adaar yoom hana farha wa iid wa yoom halu wa ayyi waahid yigaddim hadiiye le jaarah.
Wa Mardakaay katab kulla l-kalaam da wa rassal jawaabaat le kulla l-Yahuud al-fi kulla wulaayaat al-malik Achawiruuch al-gaa'idiin gariib aw ba'iid
achaan yi'assusu leehum iid al-yi'ayyuduuh kulli sana fi yoom 14 wa 15 hana l-chahar al-usmah Adaar.
Achaan dool al-ayyaam al-Yahuud ligo fooghum al-jumma min udwaanhum wa da l-chahar al-foogah haalithum albaddalat,al-diige be l-farha wa l-hizin be l-iid.Wa waajib yi'ayyudu al-ayyaam dool be farha wa yigaddumu hadaaya ambeenaathum wa yantu hadaaya le l-masaakiin.
Wa l-Yahuud khassado be kalaam Mardakaay wa bado yi'ayyudu al-iid wa da bigi leehum aade.
Wa Mardakaay zakkaraahum kadar Hamaan wileed Hamdaata al-min zurriiyit Agaag al-adu hana kulla l-Yahuud khattat le yidammir al-Yahuud.Wa hu sawwa am'iyeedaat al-usumha Fuuriim le yibarjilhum wa yidammirhum.
Wa laakin wakit al-kalaam da wassal bakaan al-malik,hu katab kharaar kadar al-khitta al-fasle al-Hamaan dawwar yisawwiiha fi l-Yahuud tigabbil fi raasah wa khalli yi'alluguuh fi uud,hu wa awlaadah.
Wa be sabab da bas,al-ayyaam dool sammoohum ayyaam Fuuriim ma'anaatah am'iyeedaat.Wa be da bas,al-Yahuud irfo wa fihmo jawaab Mardakaay wa kulla cheyy al-chaafooh wa l-hasal fooghum.
Wa l-Yahuud khassado wa assaso leehum aade al-ma tilkhalla leehum humman wa le zurriiyithum wa le l-naas al-sawwo nufuushum Yahuud.Wa humman yi'ayyudu al-yoomeen dool kulli sana fi l-wakit al-muhaddad misil maktuub.
Wa l-ayyaam dool,yizzakkaroohum wa yi'ayyuduuhum min zurriiye le zurriiye fi ayyi aayila wa ayyi wulaaya wa ayyi madiina.Wa ayyaam al-Fuuriim dool ma bingachcho le l-Yahuud wa l-zikra di ma tiwaddir min zurriiyithum.
Wa l-malika Astiir bineeyit Abihaayil wa Mardakaay al-Yahuudi katabo be kulla izinhum le yihaggugu al-jawaab al-bukhuss iid al-Fuuriim.
Wa rassalo jawaabaat al-salaama wa l-amaan le kulla l-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi 127 wulaaya hana mamlakat al-malik Achawiruuch.
Wa l-jawaabaat dool yatulbu min al-Yahuud yi'ayyudu iid al-Fuuriim fi l-wakit al-muhaddad leyah hasab al-amur al-antooh Mardakaay al-Yahuudi wa l-malika Astiir le kulla l-Yahuud wa zurriiyithum.Wa da bukhuss kharaar al-siyaam wa l-hizin kula.
Wa amur Astiir haggag iid al-Fuuriim.Wa kulla l-cheyy da,katabooh fi l-kitaab.
Wa l-malik Achawiruuch khatta khidme ijbaariiye foog kulla naas mamlakatah lahaddi l-naas al-saakniin fi l-jazaayir hana l-bahar kula.
Wa kulla amal al-malik wa gudurtah wa faraasiiytah wa kikkeef hu darraj Mardakaay wa charrafah,kulla l-cheyy da maktuub fi kitaab taariikh muluuk al-Maadiyiin wa l-Faarisiyiin.
Wa Mardakaay al-Yahuudi bigi rajul al-taani le l-malik Achawiruuch.Wa hu bigi naadum muhimm le l-Yahuud wa kulla akhwaanah al-Yahuud yiriiduuh achaan hu yifattich al-kheer le cha'abah wa yihimm be salaamithum.
Fiyah raajil waahid usmah Ayyuub al-gaa'id fi balad Uus.Wa l-raajil da adiil wa saalih wa khaayif min Allah wa muba''id min al-fasaala.
Wa hu jaab sab'a awlaad wa talaata banaat.
Wa indah 7-000 khanam wa 3-000 jumaal wa 500 jooz hana bagar le l-hiraate wa 500 hamiir anaati wa khaddaamiin katiiriin.Wa l-raajil da muhimm min kulla naas al-sabaah le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa fi l-aade,awlaadah yisawwu aazuuma fi beet hana ayyi waahid minhum wa ya'azumu akhwaathum al-talaata le yaakulu wa yacharbo sawa.
Wa wakit ayyaam al-aazuuma yikammulu,Ayyuub yugumm be fajur badri wa yigaddim dahiiye muharraga le ayyi waahid min iyaalah le yisawwiihum taahiriin.Achaan hu yuguul-:-Akuun iyaali sawwo zanib wa kafaro be l-Rabb-! Wa Ayyuub yisawwi misil da fi kulli marra.
Wa yoom waahid,malaa'ikat al-Rabb macho le yigaabulu Allah wa l-Khasiim Ibliis kula macha ma'aahum.
Wa Allah gaal le Ibliis-:-Inta jaayi min ween-? Wa Ibliis radda le Allah wa gaal-:-Laffeet fi kulla l-ard wa rukht foogha.
Wa Allah sa'alah le Ibliis wa gaal leyah-:-Inta ma chift abdi Ayyuub walla-?Ma fi naadum mislah fi l-ard.Hu naadum kaamil wa adiil wa khaayif minni ana al-Rabb wa muba''id min al-fasaala.
Wa Ibliis radda le Allah wa gaal-:-Khoof Ayyuub minnak da ma saakit.
Achaan inta hawwagtah hu wa beetah wa kulla cheyy al-indah be zariibe.Wa baarakt kulla khidmit iideenah wa bahaaymah gaa'idiin yiziidu fi l-balad.
Wa laakin kan inta tarfa' iidak wa tadrub kulla cheyy al-indah,ana mu'akkid kadar hu ya'asaak giddaamak.
Wa Allah gaal le Ibliis-:-Daahu kulla cheyy al-indah fi iidak wa laakin ma tukhutt iidak foogah hu. Wa khalaas,Ibliis marag min giddaam Allah.
Wa yoom waahid,awlaad Ayyuub wa banaatah gaa'idiin yaakulu wa yacharbo khamar fi beet akhuuhum al-bikir.
Wa faj'atan,mursaal ja le Ayyuub wa gaal leyah-:-Al-bagar gaa'idiin yahartu wa l-hamiir gaa'idiin yarta'o jambuhum.
Wa tawwaali,naas min balad Saba jo waga'o fooghum wa chaaloohum wa katalo al-khaddaamiin be l-seef.Wa ana wiheedi bas nijiit wa jiit le nikhabbirak.
Wa wakit hu lissaa' gaa'id yihajji,mursaal aakhar ja wa gaal-:-Naar al-Rabb nazalat min al-sama wa haragat al-khanam wa l-khaddaamiin.Wa ana wiheedi bas nijiit wa jiit le nikhabbirak.
Wa wakit hu lissaa' gaa'id yihajji,mursaal aakhar battaan ja wa gaal-:-Talaata majmuu'aat min al-Baabiliyiin jo waga'o fi l-jumaal wa chaaloohum wa katalo al-khaddaamiin be l-seef.Wa ana wiheedi bas nijiit wa jiit le nikhabbirak.
Wa wakit hu lissaa' gaa'id yihajji,battaan mursaal aakhar ja wa gaal-:-Awlaadak wa banaatak gaa'idiin yaakulu wa yacharbo khamar fi beet akhuuhum al-bikir
wa khalaas,riih chadiide jaat min al-sahara wa darabat arkaan al-beet da be chidde wa ramatah.Wa l-beet waga' fi raas al-chabaab wa humman maato.Wa ana wiheedi bas nijiit wa jiit le nikhabbirak.
Wa khalaas min al-hizin,Ayyuub gamma charrat jallaabiiytah wa zayyan raasah.Wa waga' fi l-ard wa sajad.
Wa gaal-:-Ana maragt min batun ammi aryaanwa nigabbil fi l-khabur aryaan.Allah anta.Wa Allah chaal.Mubaarak usum Allah.
Wa be kulla l-cheyy da,Ayyuub ma aznab wa la hajja kalaam makruuh didd al-Rabb.
Wa yoom waahid,malaa'ikat al-Rabb macho le yigaabulu Allah wa Ibliis kula macha ma'aahum le mugaabalat Allah.
Wa Allah sa'alah le Ibliis wa gaal leyah-:-Inta ma chift abdi Ayyuub walla-?Ma fi naadum mislah fi l-ard.Hu naadum kaamil wa adiil wa khaayif minni ana al-Rabb wa muba''id min al-fasaala.Wa battaan munkarib gawi fi kamaalah hatta kan inta lazzeetni diddah le nidammirah bala sabab kula.
Wa Ibliis radda le Allah wa gaal-:-Aywa-!Al-nafis aziize-!Al-insaan yanti kulla cheyy al-indah le yinajji hayaatah
laakin kan inta tarfa' iidak wa tadurbah min lahamah lahaddi udaamah,ana mu'akkid kadar hu ya'asaak giddaamak.
Wa Allah gaal le Ibliis-:-Daahu-!Hu fi iidak laakin fakkir fi hayaatah.
Wa wakit Ibliis marag min giddaam Allah,darab Ayyuub be jarab min raasah lahaddi rijileenah.
Wa khalaas,Ayyuub chaal chigfe wa gaa'id yuhukk beeha wa ga'ad fi l-rumaad.
Wa martah gaalat leyah-:-Maalak lahaddi hassa' inta munkarib gawi fi kamaalak-?A'asa al-Rabb wa muut-!
Wa Ayyuub gaal leeha-:-Inti gaa'ide tihajji misil matmuusa.Kan al-kheer al-nalgooh yaji leena min al-Rabb,maala ma nakhbalo al-charr al-jaaye minnah-? Wa fi kulla l-cheyy da,Ayyuub ma aznab be kalaamah.
Wa rufgaan talaata hana Ayyuub sim'o be kulla l-bala al-ja foogah.Wa ayyi waahid ja min baladah wa humman Alifaaz min Teemaan wa Bildad min Chuuha wa Suufar min Na'ama.Wa humman alwaa'ado le yaju sawa le yikalwudu leyah wa yisabburuuh.
Wa wakit chaafooh min ba'iid,ma irfooh.Wa gammo yabku chadiid.Wa ayyi waahid charrat jallaabiiytah wa sabba rumaad fi raasah min al-hizin.
Wa humman ga'ado ma'aayah fi l-turaab sab'a nahaar wa sab'a leel.Wa naadum gaal kilme ke,ma fiih.Achaan humman chaafo ta'abah da chadiid bilheen.
Wa ba'ad da,Ayyuub fatah khachmah wa la'an al-yoom al-wildooh beyah.
Ayyuub hajja wa gaal-:
Khalli yiddammar al-yoomal-wildooni beyahwa l-leele al-gaalo foogha-:-Khilbo be wileed-!
Al-yoom da,khalli yabga dalaamwa l-Rabb min foog ma yaj'alahwa ma yinawwirah be nuurah.
Wa khalli al-dalaam wa l-sawaadyatulbu al-yoom dawa l-sahaab yagood min foog leyahwa yinbahit min chiddit al-dalaam.
Al-leele di,khalli tabga dalma marra waahidwa ma tilimm ma'a ayyaam al-sanawa ma yahsubuuha min al-chuhuur.
Aywa,khalli al-leele di tabga aagrewa ma yukuun foogha farahjayyit al-mawluud.
Wa l-naas al-yal'ano al-nahaarkhalli yal'anooha-!Aywa,humman doolal-ya'arfu yigawwumu Luyaataan khuul al-bahar.
Khalli nujuum makhribha yidallumuwa ma tukhutt achamha fi l-nuurwa ma tichiif chagaag al-sabaah.
Achaan al-leele di ma saddatbatun ammi foogi-!Wa ma labbadat al-ta'abal-ana gaa'id nichiifah.
Maala ma muttwakit ana gaa'id fi batun ammi-?Wa maala ruuhi ma maragatmin ana maarig min batunha-?
Maala rikab itneen rahhabo beyi-?Wa maala duyuud itneen radda'ooni-?
Wa kan awwal bigi misil da,ana nargud wa nirrayyahwa nunuum wa khalaas,ninjamma.
Wa nukuun ma'a muluukwa mustachaariin al-ardal-bano le nufuushum gusuural-ba'adeen yilhaddamo.
Aw nukuun ma'a masaa'iil al-induhum dahabwa buyuuthum malaaniin fudda.
Aw nabga ma fiini,misil rumaaye al-mulabbadawa misil atfaalal-ma chaafo al-harraay.
Wa hinaak,al-fasliin ma yilharrakowa l-naas al-gudrithum kammalatyinjammo fi l-bakaan da.
Al-masaajiin kula yi'iichu be l-salaamwa ma yasma'o hiss al-mudaayig.
Kabiir wa sakhiir kulluhum sawawa l-abid yalga al-hurriiye min siidah.
Maala al-Rabb yantial-nuur le l-ta'baaniinwa l-haya le l-haznaaniin-?
Humman gaa'idiin yarjo al-mootwa ma ja leehumwa yifattuchuuh ziyaada min al-kanz.
Humman yafraho wa yinbastu ziyaadawakit yaju fi l-khabur.
Wa maala yanti al-haya le l-naadumal-ma ya'arif al-derib al-yichiilah-?Wa maala leyah hual-Rabb saddaah min kulli jiihe-?
Ganiiti bigi akliwa dumuu'i yisiilu misil almi.
Achaan al-ru'ub al-barjalni lihigniwa l-nakhaaf minnah jaani.
Wa leyi ana,ma fi huduwa la raaha wa la jumma.Illa l-ta'ab bas ja leyi.
Wa khalaas,Alifaaz al-min balad Teemaan chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:
Hal kan naadum haawal yikallim leek,inta tilhammal walla-?Wa laakin yaatu yagdaryiwaggif kalaamah-?
Daahu inta addabt naas katiiriinwa gawweet iide al-di'fo
wa kalaamak lazam al-yittarta'owa gawwa rikab al-iyo.
Wa wakit al-bala da ja leekkhalaas,sabrak waddar.Wa wakit lihigak,inta barjalt.
Takhwaak ma damaan leek walla-?Wa kamaalak ma yantiik acham walla-?
Min fadlak,azzakkar.Hal simi't yoom waahid bari hilik-?Aw saalihiin addammaro-?
Ana chift al-yiteerubu al-charrwa l-yazra'o al-fasaala,humman bas yalgo natiijithum.
Be nafkha min al-Rabb,yiddammarowa be riih khadabah,yikammulu.
Al-Rabb yisakkit gargaraan al-duudwa hiss al-wuhuuch.Wa yilkassarosunuun iyaal al-duud.
Al-duud yumuut min gillit al-akilwa iyaal al-duudaay yichittu.
Wa ja leyi kalaam be achiirwa adaani sim'at al-mukhaala.
Wakit afkaar al-bikhawwufu yaju min hilim al-leelwa wakit noom chadiid karab al-naas,
al-khoof wa l-rajafaan karabooniwa udaami rajafo ziyaada.
Wa riih faatat be wijhiwa suuf jildi gamma.
Wa naadum ja wagaf giddaamiwa ana ma irift chaklah.Wa suurtah gaa'ide giddaam uyuuniwa be hudu,simi't hiss al-buguul-:
Bani Adam saalih ziyaadamin al-Rabb walla-?Wa l-naadum taahir ziyaadamin al-Khaalig walla-?
Al-Rabb ma yi'aamin khaddaamiinahaywa,yichiif malaa'ikatah khaltaaniin.
Kan misil da,kikkeef yi'aamin Bani Adamal-jisimhum misil buyuut al-tiine-?Wa kikkeef yi'aamin al-khalagaahum min turaabwa l-yinrahku ajala min al-arda-?
Min al-fajur le l-achiiye,yilkassaro.Ma fi al-yifakkir fooghumwa yiddammaro ila l-abad.
Hubaal khiyamhum yamurguuhumwa humman yumuutu bala hikma.
Ya Ayyuub,naadi-!Hal fi naadum yurudd leek walla-?Wa min al-malaa'ikainta tiwajjih ale yaatu-?
Achaan al-za'al yaktul al-munaafikhwa l-husud yikammil al-mukhaffal.
Ana chift al-munaafikh dassa uruugahlaakin tawwaali,ana la'antnaas beetah wa gult-:
Khalli iyaalah ma yalgo faza'fi khachum baab al-hille.Khalli yihaakumuuhum fi l-charii'awa ma fi naadum al-yinajjiihum-!
Khalli al-jii'aaniin yaakuluintaaj al-munaafikh da.Aywa,yichiilu intaajahal-fi lubb zaraayib al-chook kula-!Wa khalli al-tammaa'iinyichiilu khunaayah.
Sahiih,al-charr ma yamrugmin al-turaabwa l-fasaala ma tabzurmin al-ard.
Laakin al-insaan wildooh le l-ta'abmisil charaar al-naar al-yugumm wa yitiir.
Laakin kan leyi ana,nifattich al-Rabbwa leyah hu bas narfa' daliimti.
Hu yisawwi achya kubaar al-ma yinfahmuwa ajaayib bala adad.
Hu bas al-yinazzil matara fi wijh al-ardwa yazgi beeha al-ziraa'a.
Hu yarfa' al-masaakiin foog,wa l-gaa'idiin fi l-dalaam yalgo al-naja.
Hu yifachchil fikir al-najiidiinachaan ma yanjaho be khidmit iideehum.
Hu yarmi al-hakiimiin fi charak mu'aamarathumwa yifachchil choorit al-munaafikhiin.
Be nahaar,al-naas dool yiwaajuhu dalaamwa be gaayle,yiddaggacho misil be l-leel.
Laakin al-Rabb yinajji al-da'iifmin lisaanhum al-tariinaywa,yinajji al-miskiinmin iid al-chadiid.
Khalaas,al-da'iifiin yalgo achamwa l-zaalimiin khuchuumhum yinsaddo.
Mabruuk le l-insaanal-yi'addibah al-Rabb-!Wa misil da,inta kula,ma taaba hidaayat al-Gaadir-!
Achaan al-Rabb bas yajrah wa yidaawiwa yikassir wa be iideenah,yirakkib.
Wa sitte marraat,hu yinajjiikmin al-ta'abwa fi l-marra al-saab'e kula,al-fasaala ma talhagak.
Wa fi wakt al-juu',hu yafdaak min al-mootwa fi l-harib,yafdaak min darbit al-seef.
Tiddaarag min darbit al-lisaanwa ma takhaaf min al-damaar wakit yaji.
Tichchammat le l-damaar wa l-juu'wa ma takhaaf min haywaanaat al-kadaade.
Achaan indak alaakha ma'a hujaar al-kadaadewa salaam ma'a haywaanaat al-kadaade.
Be da,ta'arif kadar fi kheemtakfiyah salaamwa tiraakhib mar'aak wa cheyyma yigassir leek.
Tichiif zurriiytak tabga katiirewa iyaalak yabgo misil gechch al-ard.
Wa be gudurtak bas,tumuut wa tanzil fi l-khaburmisil jurun al-ganaadiil fi wakithum.
Daahu al-cheyy da,aniina haggagna minnahwa be misil da,inta asma'ahwa ahfadah le nafsak.
Wa Ayyuub chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:
Kan yagdaro yawzunu hizniwa yukhuttu kulla damaari fi l-miizaan,
da tagiil min ramla hana khachum al-bahar,wa fi chaan da,kalaami bigi ma indah faayde.
Achaan nachaachiib al-Gaadir ta'anooniwa nafsi riwat samm.Wa l-khoof al-rassalah al-Rabbmisil deech wagaf diddi.
Hal humaar al-kadaade yikawwikkan giddaamah fi gechch walla-?Wa l-toor yikirrkan giddaamah fi alfa walla-?
Al-maasikh bala mileh yistaakal walla-?Bayaad al-beed taa'im walla-?
La-!Galbi abaahwa gabbalahachaan al-cheyy dayitammimni fi galbi.
Yaatu yakhbal talabi-?Khalli al-Rabb yihaggig munaayi-!
Khalli al-Rabb yarhakniwa yarfa' iidah minniwa yidammirni-!
Wa fi ta'abi al-ma indah hadd,ana nunutt wa nafrahwa nalga al-saburachaan ana ma khaalaftkalaam al-Khudduus-!
Ween al-gudra al-nasbur beeha ziyaada-?Wa ween nihaayti fi tuul umri-?
Hal ana gawi misil hajar walla-?Wa jildi gawi misil nahaas walla-?
Ana ma indi cheyy al-yisaa'idniwa l-faza' ba''ad minni.
Al-ta'baan,waajib rafiigah yarhamahhatta kan al-ta'baan da ma yakhaaf min al-Gaadir kula.
Rufgaani khaanoonimisil wudyaan al-almiihum kammalwa misil majaari al-almiihum faat.
Fi aakhir al-chite,al-barad wa l-talaj yumuu'uwa l-wudyaan yinmalu.
Fi bidaayit al-seef,almiihum yikammil,wa fi l-hamu,humman yaybaso.
Al-ruhhal yigabbulu minhumwa yamchu ale l-kadaadewa yiwadduru.
Al-ruhhal min hillit Tiimayifattuchu al-wudyaanwa l-ruhhal min balad Sabayukhuttu achamhum fooghum.
Humman alhayyaroachaan atwakkalo ale almiihum.Wa wakit wassalo,achamhum angata'.
Ya rufgaani,daahu bigiitumisil al-wudyaan dool-!Intu chiftu damaari wa khuftu-!
Ana ma gult leeku-:-Antuuni cheyy-!-Wa ana ma gult leeku-:-Gaddumu leyi hadaaya min maalku
achaan tinajjuuni min iid al-khasiimwa tafdooni min iid al-mujrim.
Wassuuni wa ana naskutwa fahhumuuni min ween ana waddart.
Kalaam al-sahiih booja'wa laakin luwaamitku ma tanfa'ni.
Hal achchaawartu le tuluumuuni walla-?Wa ana al-ma indi acham,taj'alo kalaami misil riih walla-?
Intu-!Tisawwu am'iyeedaat le l-atiim-!Lahaddi rafiigku kula,tukhuttuuh le l-bee'-!
Wa hassa',fakkuru foogiwa wajjuhu aleyi-!Chiifu-!Hal giddaamkuana nakdib walla-?
Min fadulku,gabbulu ta'aalu-!Ma tazulmuuni-!Gabbulu ta'aalu-!Ana daayman saalih-!
Hal lisaani yantug be zulum walla-?Hal ana ma nafham al-damaar walla-?
Hal hayaat Bani Adam fi l-ardma misil hayaat askari walla-?Wa ayyaamah ma misil ayyaamal-mu'ajjar walla-?
Wa misil al-abd al-yinaahij yidoor al-dullwa misil al-khaddaam al-yarja ujurtah,
misil da,ana ga'adt chuhuur fi l-faadiwa da bas gismi.Wa hasabo leyilayaali hana ta'ab.
Wa wakit nargud,nuguul-:-Nugumm mata-?-Al-leel tawiil wa ana chibi'tmin gillit al-noom lahaddi fajur.
Jismi ankasa be duud wa gachcharwa farwit jildi jaffat wa algatta'at.
Wa ayyaami maachiin ajala min al-mutraarawa yikammulu be sur'aachaan achami angata'.
Ya Rabb,azzakkarkadar hayaati misil riihwa uyuuni battaan ma yichiifu al-kheer.
Wa uyuun al-yichiifuuni,ma yichiifuuni battaan.Wa wakit uyuunak yifattuchuuni,ana ma fiini.
Al-insaan al-yanzil fi l-khabur ma yigabbil battaanmisil sahaabaay al-marrat wa faatat.
Hu ma yigabbil fi maskanahwa naas beetah kula yansooh.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ma nalzam khachmi.Nihajji be diigit ruuhiwa nachki be hizin nafsi.
Ana ma bahar wa la khuul al-baharlahaddi tukhutt leyi haraasa.
Nuguul-:-Fi sariiri,nalga raahtiwa fi furaachi,nihaddi chakwiti.
Wa laakin be hilim,inta tidiss leyi al-ru'ubwa be ru'ya,tabhatni.
Ana azal al-chanagaanwa l-moot akheer leyi min bigiit udaam-!
Khalaas,tammaani-!Ma ni'iich daayman.Khalliini-!Ayyaami zaayliin.
Chunu al-insaan wa maala tikabbirah-?Maala tihimm beyah-?
Maala tiraakhibah ayyi sabaahwa tijarribah kulla wakit-?
Ya Rabb-!Mata tiwaggif nazarak minni-?Wa mata tikhalliini nazrut riigi-?
Ya muraakhib al-insaan,kan ana aznabt,da yisawwi leek chunu-?Maala khatteetni hadaf-?Ana bigiit leek tagiil walla-?
Wa maala ma tamha isyaaniwa tisaamih khataayi-?Achaan daahuuni raagid fi l-turaabmisil mayyitwa wakit tifattichni,nabga ma fiini.
Wa Bildad al-min Chuuha chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:
Lahaddi matatuguul al-kalaam da-?Wa lahaddi matakalaam khachmak yamrugmisil riih chadiide-?
Hal al-Rabb yi'awwij al-charii'a walla-?Aywa,al-Rabb al-Gaadir yi'awwij al-adaala walla-?
Achaan awlaadak aznabowa hu aakhabhum hasab isyaanhum.
Wa laakin kan tifattich al-Rabbwa kan tachhad al-Rabb al-Gaadir
wa kan inta saafi wa adiil,khalaas hu yifakkir foogakwa yisabbitak fi adaaltak.
Wa tichiif al-indak fi l-bidaayachiyya bas-!Akiid,fi mustakhbalak talgaziyaada minnah-!
As'al al-zurriiyaat al-faatowa ahfad adiil tajribat juduudhum.
Achaan aniina naas hana amis bas,ma na'arfu cheyy.Wa ayyaamna fi l-ardyufuutu ajala misil al-dull.
Laakin al-juduud dool yi'allumuukwa yikallumu leek.Wa min daakhal galibhumyamrug kalaam al-buguul-:
Hal al-birdi yugumm barramin al-rahad walla-?Al-tibin yagdar yiziidbala almi walla-?
La-!Kan akhdar kula gubbaal ma yagta'ooh,bala almi hu yaybas ajala min kulla l-gechch.
Wa yukuun misil da,le kulla l-yanso derib al-Rabb.Aywa,acham al-kaafir yingati'.
Hu khatta achamahfi cheyy ma madmuunwa amman nafsah le cheyy khafiifmisil beet abunchabach.
Hu yirrakkaz fi beetahwa l-beet da yaga'.Hu yil'allag foogahwa laakin al-beet ma yasbit.
Al-kaafir akhdar misil chadaratihit al-harraay.Hi maddat furuu'hawa khattat beehum al-jineene.
Wa uruugha yichcharbako fi koom al-hashaswa yuchuggu al-hujaar.
Wa laakin kan yimallutuuhummin bakaanhum,al-bakaan da yikhaalit wa yuguul-:-Ana ma chiftah.
Daahu farhitah fi hayaatah.Wa min al-turaab da,yugumm nabaat aakhar.
Chiif-!Al-Rabb ma yakrah al-naadum al-adiilwa ma yichajji' al-naas al-fasliin.
Gariib,hu yamla galbak be l-dihikwa halguumak be l-ragraag.
Al-yakrahook al-eeb yikhattiihum,Wa khiyam al-aasiyiin yabgo ma fiihum.
Akiid,ana na'arif kadar da sahiih.Kikkeef Bani Adam yukuun saalih giddaam al-Rabb-?
Wa kan insaan yidoor yidaafi' le nafsahgiddaam al-Rabb kula,ma yagdar yuruddfi waahid min al-alif su'aal.
Al-hikma wa l-gudra al-chadiide le l-Rabbwa yaatu yugumm diddahwa yagood be salaam-?
Al-Rabb yihawwil al-jibaal min duun yihissuwa yichaglibhum fi wakit za'alah.
Hu yirajjif al-ard min asaashawa amadha yinhazzo.
Wa yaamur al-harraay wa hi ma tatla'wa le l-nujuum yukhuttfooghum khitim le ma yidawwu.
Wa hu wiheedah bas yimidd al-samaawaatwa yifajjikh mooj al-bahar.
Hu khalag nujuum al-Dubbwa l-Sabi al-Makhmiwa l-Tureyya wa nujuum al-wati.
Wa hu sawwa achya kubaar bala haddwa ajaayib bala adad.
Wa kan adda jambi,ana ma nichiifahwa kan faat,ana ma na'arfah.
Wa kan khataf,yaatu yagdaryagla' minnah-?Wa yaatu yuguul leyah-:-Inta tisawwi chunu-?
Khadab al-Rabb ma bilgabbalwa l-yisaa'udu Rahabkhuul al-bahar kula,yidanguru leyah.
Wa ana,kikkeef nurudd leyah-?Wa chunu al-kalaam al-nagdarnuguulah giddaamah-?
Wa kan ana saalih kula,ma nagdar nurudd leyah.Nachhadah bas,hu al-yihaakimni.
Kan ana naadeetahwa hu radda leyi kula,ana ma nisaddigkadar hu yasma' hissi.
Hu yikassirni be l-riih al-chadiidewa bala janiiye,yikattir juruuhi.
Hu ma khallaani nichiil nafasilaakin chabba'ni be l-murr.
Kan nijarrib gudurtah,hu chadiid minniwa kan fi l-charii'a,yaatu yidaafi' leyi-?
Kan ana saalih kula,lisaani yuguul ana khaati.Kan ana kaamil kula,hu yuguul ana naagis.
Ana kaamil walla-?Ana zaati ma na'arfah,nakrah hayaati.
Wa da kula ma muhimm.Wa fi chaan da,ana gult-:-Al-Rabb yidammir al-kaamil wa l-aasi kula.
Wa kan al-waba yijiib al-moot be khafla,hu yichchammat le diigit al-bariyiin.
Wakit hu anta al-ard le l-aasiyiin,hu yisidd uyuun al-gudiya fi l-charii'a.Wa kan da ma hu,yaatu al-sawwaah-?
Ayyaami macho ajala ziyaadamin al-naadum al-jarraaywa jaro gabul ma yichiifu al-kheer.
Humman faato ajala misil sufun al-ageegaw misil al-sagur al-yanzil fi rimmitah.
Wa ana gult-:-Khalli nansa chakwitiwa narkhi wijhi wa nafrah.
Laakin nakhaaf min kulla ta'abiachaan ana na'arif inta ma taj'alni bari.
Ana mahsuub ma'a l-khaatiyiin-!Wa maala ni'ayyi nafsi bala faayde-?
Hatta kan nilbarrad be almi talajwa ninaddif iideeni be saabuun kula,
inta tidissini fi l-buutawa khulgaani kula yaaboonimisil ana muharram.
Achaan al-Rabb ma insaan mislile nurudd leyahwa ma nagdar nigaabilahfi l-charii'a.
Ma fi hakam ambeenaatnaal-yukhutt iidah foogna.
Kan misil da,khalli al-Rabbyiba''id asaatah minniwa khalli khawwifiinahma yabhatni.
Wa be da khalaas,nihajji leyah bala khoof.Wa laakin kan ma misil da,ana gaa'id wiheedi bas.
Al-haya bakhkhadat leyi.Ana ma nikhalli chakwitiwa nihajji be hizni al-fi galbi.
Wa nuguul le Rabbi-:-Ma taj'alni khaati-!Ooriini maala tahrijni-?
Hal adiil leek tazlumni-?Maala taabaani ana khaliigtakwa tinawwir khittat al-aasiyiin walla-?
Uyuunak misil uyuun al-makhluugiin walla-?Wa tichiif misil Bani Adam walla-?
Hal ayyaamak misil ayyaamBani Adam walla-?Wa siniinak misil siniinal-insaan walla-?
Maala tifattich fi khataayiwa tas'al min zunuubi-?
Inta ta'arif kadar ana ma khaatilaakin ma fi naadum al-yinajjiini minnak.
Inta khalagtiniwa iideenak addalooni be l-kaamillaakin hassa' tidoor tidammirni-!
Min fadlak,azzakkarinta khalagtini min al-tiine.Laakin hassa',tidoor tigabbilni fi l-turaab walla-?
Inta sabbeetni misil labanwa jammadtini misil jibna.
Inta baneetni be asab wa udaamwa kaseetni be laham wa farwa.
Wa anteetni al-haya wa l-rahmawa muraakhabatak hafadat ruuhi.
Laakin daahu al-inta labbadtah fi galbakwa ana irift al-fi fikrak.
Kan naznib,inta tichiifniwa ma taj'alni bari min khataayi.
Wa kan bigiit khaati,al-azaab leyi-!Wa kan saalih,ma nagdar narfa' raasi.Ana chab'aan min al-ihaanawa mudayyig min al-ta'ab.
Wa kan narfa' raasi,titaaridni misil duud,wa tadrubni battaan be gudurtak al-ajiibe.
Inta tijaddid hajamaatak diddiwa tiziid khadabak foogiwa duyuuch yaju yahjumuuni.
Maala khalleetnimaragt min batun ammi-?Kan awwal mutt,ma fi een tichiifni.
Wa nabga ma fiini,wa min batun ammi basyiwadduuni fi l-khabur.
Wa ayyaami katiiriin walla-?Khalli yagiifu minniwa be da,nagdar nafrah.
Wa da,gabul ma nigabbilfi balad al-dalaam,al-dalaam al-haalik.
Aywa,nigabbil fi balad zargamisil al-dalaamwa fi l-dalaam al-haalikal-indah barjaal.Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-nuur misil al-dalaam.
Wa Suufar al-min Na'ama chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:
Katarat al-kalaam dima talga radd walla-?Wa l-naadum al-ya'arif yihajjiyalga al-hagg walla-?
Wa kalaamak al-katiir dayisakkit al-naas walla-?Inta tichchammatwa ma fi al-yikhajjilak walla-?
Inta gult-:-Ilmi saafiwa ana kula saafi giddaamak.
Aywa-!Kan al-Rabb kallamwa kan hu hajja leek
wa kan khabbarak be sirr hikmatah,al-aglak ma yakhbalah.Wa khalaas be da,inta ta'arifal-Rabb khalla waahidiin min khataak.
Hal tagdar ta'arif asraar al-Rabb-?Walla tagdar ta'arif kamaal al-Gaadir-?
Humman dool aaliyiin min al-sama,inta tagdar tisawwi chunu-?Humman khariigiin min al-khabur,inta ta'arif chunu-?
Tuulhum ziyaada min al-ardwa urduhum ziyaada min al-bahar.
Wa kan al-Rabb gamma yisidd naadum fi l-sijinaw yinaadiih fi charii'tah,yaatu yagdar yamna'ah-?
Achaan hu ya'arif al-kaddaabiinwa yichiif al-fasaala,wa ma yaj'alha walla-?
Achaan al-insaan al-fihimah misil al-mukhaffal,hu misil wileed humaar al-kadaade.
Wa laakin inta,ya Ayyuub,waajib tisabbit galbakwa waajib timidd iideenak aleyah.
Wa kan fi charr fi iideenak,azgulah ba'iidwa khalli al-fasaalama taskun fi khiyamak.
Wa khalaas,inta tarfa' raasak bala eebwa tukuun saabit wa ma takhaaf.
Achaan inta tansa ta'abakwa tichiifah misil almi al-jara wa faat.
Wa hayaatak tidawwi ziyaadamin nuur al-gaaylewa l-dalaam yabga leekmisil nuur al-sabaah.
Wa inta ti'akkid kadar indak achamwa kan indak chakk kula,tunuum be amaan.
Wakit tinjamma,ma fi naadum yibachtinakwa katiiriin yifattuchu ridaak.
Wa laakin uyuun al-aasiyiin ya'ayowa ma fi ayyi malja' leehumwa ma induhum acham illa l-moot bas.
Wa khalaas,Ayyuub chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:
Akiid,intu bas timassulu juduudna-!Wa l-hikma tumuut ma'aaku wakit tumuutu.
Laakin ana kula indi agul misilku intuwa ana kula ma naagis minku-!Yaatu ma indah ma'rafa misilku-?
Ana bigiit madhaka le rufgaanihatta kan narja al-radd min al-Rabb.Aywa,bigiit madhaka,ana al-saalih wa l-tamaam-!
Al-murtaahiin yahguru al-ta'baaniinwa da misil darbe fi rijil al-yittarta'o-!
Wa khiyam al-mukharribiingaa'idiin be huduwa l-naas al-yikhaddubu al-Rabbgaa'idiin be amaan.Wa gudrithum bas ilaahhum.
Wa laakin as'al al-haywaanaatwa humman yiwassufuukwa tuyuur al-sama yi'ooruuk.
Hajji ma'a l-ard wa hi tiwassifakwa huut al-bahar yiballikhak.
Yaatu minhum kulluhum ma ya'arifkadar iid Allah sawwat al-cheyy da-?
Wa fi iidah hu,nafas kulla l-hayyiinwa ruuh kulla l-makhluugiin.
Buguulu-:-Al-adaan tifassil al-kalaammisil al-lisaan yifarrig al-ta'aam.
Fi l-cheeb,tinlagi al-hikmawa fi l-umur al-tawiil,yinlagi al-fihim.
Wa laakin al-hikma wa l-khuwwawa l-kharaar wa l-ilim,kulluhum min al-Rabb.
Al-yihaddimah al-Rabbma yinbani battaanwa l-naadum al-hu yasjinah,ma fi al-yatilgah.
Wa kan hu yiwaggif al-almi,yaji al-yabaaswa kan yikhalli al-almi yusubb,yaakul al-ard.
Al-gudra wa l-hikma hineeyah huwa l-yiwaddir wa l-muwaddir kula fi iidah hu.
Hu yiwaddi al-mustachaariin bala ni'lewa yiwaddir raas al-gudiya.
Hu yamrug kadmuul al-muluukwa yihazzimhum be firaad.
Hu yiwaddi rujaal al-diin bala ni'lewa yarmi al-gawiyiin.
Hu yibarjil kalaam al-amiiniinwa yadrub agul al-aagliin.
Hu yijiib al-hugra le l-masaa'iilwa yarkhi hizaam al-kubaaraat.
Hu yibayyin al-dalaam al-khariigwa yijiib al-dalaam al-haalik fi l-nuur.
Hu yikabbir al-umamwa yidammirhumwa yichattit al-chu'uubwa yiwaddiihum fi l-khurba.
Hu yibarjil uguul kubaaraat al-chu'uubwa yikhalliihum yichittu fi l-sahara bala derib.
Humman yiddaggachofi l-dalaam bala nuuraywa,hu yiwaddirhummisil al-sakkaara.
Daahu kulla l-chaafatah eeniwa sim'atah adaani wa ana fihimtah.
Al-intu ta'arfuuh,ana kula na'arfahwa ana kula ma naagis minku-!
Laakin nidoor nihajji le l-Rabb al-Gaadirwa nidoor nidaafi' le nafsi giddaam al-Rabb.
Kan leeku intu,tahamtuuni be kidib-!Intu misil dakaatiir al-ma naaf'iin-!
Yaatu yagdar yisakkitkule tabgo hakiimiin-?
Asma'o hujjitiwa khuttu adaanku le kalaam lisaani.
Hal tahsubu intu tidaafu'ule l-Rabb walla-?Wa leyah hu,tihajjube khachch walla-?
Hal ma'aayah hu intu tilimmu walla-?Walla le l-Rabb intu tidaafu'u-?
Wa adiil kan hu yijarribku intu walla-?Walla tukhuchchuuhmisil tukhuchchu al-naas-?
Akiid,hu yuluumkuhatta kan tilimmu ma'aayah be sirr kula-!
Wa azamatah ma tabhatku walla-?Wa l-khoof minnah ma yaga' foogku walla-?
