Achaan bala sabab,inta chilt damaan min akhwaanakwa gala't khulgaanhumwa khalleethum aryaaniin.
Inta ma anteet almi le l-atchaanwa la anteet akil le l-jii'aan.
Al-ard le siid al-unufwa l-mahbuub yaskun foogha.
Al-araamil,inta tatrudhin iideehin yaabsiinwa zalamt al-atiim al-halkaan.
Wa fi chaan da,al-churukka hawwagookwa l-ru'ub karabak be khafla.
Inta ma tichiif al-dalaamwa la l-almi al-katiiral-gaa'id yikhattiik walla-?
Al-Rabb ma foog min al-sama walla-?Wa inta-!Chiif al-nujuum humman aaliyiin-!
Wa fi chaan da,inta gult-:-Al-Rabb ya'arif chunu-?Hu yagdar yihaakimnamin al-dalaam al-haalik walla-?
Wa l-sahaab misil khita takhiinyadharah ma yichiifwakit yamchiwa yihawwig al-samaawaat.
Hal inta tidoor tahfad al-derib al-zamaan,al-chaalooh al-naas al-fasliin walla-?
Humman dool maato gabul wakithummisil beet al-almi akal asaasah.
Humman gaalo le l-Rabb-:-Ba''id minnina-!Inta al-Gaadir ma tagdartisawwi leena cheyy-!
Wa laakin hu basal-mala buyuuthum be l-kheer.Wa choorit al-aasiyiin di,hi ba'iide minni.
Al-saalihiin yichiifu kharaabhum wa yafrahowa l-bari yichchammat leehum.
Al-wagaf diddina ma addammar walla-?Wa l-naar ma akalat khumaamhum walla-?
Sawwi suluh ma'a l-Rabbwa talga al-salaam.Wa be da,al-halu yigabbilleek battaan.
Asma' ta'liim al-Rabbwa akrub kalaamah fi galbak.
Gabbil le l-Gaadir wa talga al-sabaatwa ba''id al-zulum min kheemtak.
Armi dahabak fi l-turaabwa dahab Ufiir fi ust hashas al-waadi.
Wa khalaas,al-Gaadir yabga dahabakwa yabga leek kiimaan hana fudda.
Wa be da,al-Gaadir yabga farhitakwa ale l-Rabb,tarfa' wijhak battaan.
Inta tachhadah wa hu yasma'akwa tihaggig nazrak.
Wa kan chilt kharaar kula,yilhaggag leekwa l-nuur yinawwir derbak.
Wa kan naas waahidiin yilmaskano,inta tuguul-:-Gummu foog-!-Achaan al-Rabb yinajji al-miskiin.
Aywa,hu yinajji hatta al-ma bari kulawa hu kula yanja be sabab iideenak al-saalimiin.
Al-yoom,ana mu'aarid le l-Rabbwa nitaabi' fi chakwiti.Wa iidi tagiile foogiwa laakin ma tagdar tiwaggif ganiiti.
Yaareet-!Kan na'arif bakaan nalgaahwa kan nagdar nawsal fi bakaan maskanah,
khalaas nagdar niwassif leyah kadar ana bariwa namla khachmi be l-hujaj.
Wa be da,na'arif al-kalaamal-yuruddah leyiwa nagdar nafham al-yuguulah.
Hal yihaakimni be kulla gudurtah walla-?La-!Yasma'ni.
Wa hu ya'arifkadar ana khasiimah,saalih.Wa hu al-yichaari'ni,fi l-nihaaya yibarriini.
Wa laakin kan ana macheetale l-sabaah,hu ma fiihwa fi l-kharib,ana ma nichiifah.
Kan hu machkhuul fi l-munchaakh,ma nichiifahwa wakit hu yinlafit wati,ma nichiifah.
Wa laakin le derbi ana,hu ya'arfah.Wa kan kachafni,yalgaani saafi misil al-dahab.
Rijli titaabi' khatwaatahwa ana hafadt derbah,ma talagtah.
Ana ma khalleet wasiiyaatahwa hafadt gawaaniinah ziyaadamin al-akil al-fi khachmi.
Wa kan hu bas kharrar,yaatu yagdar yifachchilah-?Aywa,al-hu yidoorah,yihaggigah.
Hu yinaffiz al-hu kharrarah leyimisil kharaaraatah al-aakhariin kula.
Fi chaan da giddaamah hu,ana ninbahitwa kan fakkart foogah,narjif.
Al-Rabb,hu al-waddar chajaa'tiwa l-Gaadir malaani be l-ru'ub.
Wa da,ma dalaam al-sakkatniwa la sawaad al-khattaani.
Maala al-Gaadir ma gata' wakitle l-ikhaab-?Wa maala al-ya'arfuuhma chaafo ayyaamah-?
Al-aasiyiin yihawwulu alaamaat al-huduudwa yasurgu al-bagarwa yasraho beehum.
Humman yichiilu humaar al-ataamawa yakurbu fi l-damaan toor al-armala.
Yaturdu al-masaakiin min al-deribwa fagraaniin al-balad yillabbado minhum.
Aywa-!Al-masaakiin yamchu le khidmithummisil hamiir al-kadaade yifattuchu akil fi l-sahara.Humman yi'akkulu iyaalhumfi ard jafaaf.
Fi l-ziraa'a,al-masaakiin yilimmu alfawa fi jineenit al-aasi,yilimmu inab.
Tuul al-leel,humman aryaaniin bala khulgaanwa ma induhum khita min al-bardaay.
Matar al-yanzil fi l-jibaal yibilluhumwa min gillit al-maskan,yittaako fi l-hajar.
Wa l-aasiyiin yagla'o al-atiimbe gu min ammahwa yakurbu damaanmin al-fagraaniin.
Al-masaakiin maachiin aryaaniinma induhum khulgaanwa be juu'hum,yangulu al-gechch.
Fi lubb al-zaraayib,ya'asuru dihinwa ya'asuru al-inabwa laakin ma induhum hagg yuduukhuuh.
Wa fi daakhal al-madiina,al-ta'baaniin yaguntuwa l-majruuhiin yikooruku le l-faza'wa laakin al-Rabb ma yasma'hum.
Wa l-aasiyiin mu'aaridiin le nuur al-nahaarwa ma ya'arfu turugahwa ma yamchu fi duruubah.
Wa l-kaatil yugumm fi wakt al-chagaagyaktul al-miskiin wa l-fagraanwa yasrig be l-leel.
Al-zaani yarja al-leel wa yuguul-:-Ma fi naadum yichiifni.-Hu yikhatti wijhahachaan ma ya'arfuuh.
Fi l-dalaam,yasrig al-buyuutwa be l-nahaar,yinsadda daakhal ma yidoor al-nuur.
Aywa,leehum humman kulluhumal-dalaam al-haalik misil al-sabaahachaan humman waalafobe ru'ub al-leel.
Wa intu tuguulu-:-Humman misil al-tibinal-chaaylah almi.Naas al-balad yal'ano turaabhumwa ma fi al-yakhdim fi jineenaat inabhum.
Wa tuguulu-:-Misil al-jafaaf wa l-hamuyimawwu'u al-talajmisil da,al-moot yichiil al-muznib.
Wa ammah al-wildatah kula tansaahwa janaaztah ti'affinwa tabga laziize le l-duud.Naas abadan ma yizzakkaroohwa zulmah yiddammarmisil chadara al-waga'at.
Laakin hu yisawwi al-fasaalale l-mara al-aagre al-ma indaha iyaalwa ma yarham al-armala.
Laakin al-Rabb be gudurtah,hu bas al-yamrug siyaad al-unuf.Wakit yugumm,humman dool ma yalgo al-haya.
Al-Rabb yikhalliihum fi l-amaanwa laakin hu yiraakhib duruubhum.
Wa l-aasiyiin bigo aaliyiinwa ba'ad chiyya,yabgo ma fiihum.Humman yidaffugu misil al-nuwwaarwa yagta'oohum misil yagta'o al-ganaadiil.
Wa kan misil da,yaatu yikaddibni-?Wa yaatu yuguul kalaami da ma sahiih-?
Al-Rabb hu al-malik al-mukhiifwa hu al-yahkim be l-salaam fi l-a'aali.
Hal khuwwaatah binhasbu walla-?Wa fi yaatu,nuurah ma yidawwi-?
Wa be da kula,kikkeef al-insaanyisawwi nafsah saalih giddaam al-Rabb-?Wa kikkeef al-jaabatah marayabga saafi giddaamah-?
Kan al-gamar kulama indah nuur giddaamahwa l-nujuum kulama waadhiin fi uyuunah,
kikkeef yukuun al-insaan al-misil rimmewa ibn al-insaan al-misil duud al-turaab-?
Chunu al-faza' al-inta jibtah leyi,ya Bildad-?Ana al-ma indi gudra-!Aywa,inta tahsib tinajjial-duraa' al-ma chadiid walla-?
Wa inta tagdar tanti wasiiyele l-ma indah hikma walla-?Wa ti'arrif be katarat ilmak walla-?
Wa laakin kalaamak da,muwajjah le yaatu-?Wa ligiit al-wahi da min yaatu-?
Al-maytiin yarjufu tihit al-almiwa tihit al-saakniin foogah.
Giddaam al-Rabb,kulla l-khubuur makchuufiinaywa,bakaan al-halaakma mukhatta minnah.
Hu yimidd al-sama al-munchaakhi fi l-faadiwa yi'allig al-ard fi l-hawa.
Hu yakhzin al-almi fi l-sahaabwa l-sahaab ma yinfajir min tagalatah.
Hu yikhatti archahwa yisiddah be sahaabah.
Al-Rabb sawwa daayira fi l-almilahaddi l-huduud al-been al-nuur wa l-dalaam.
Amad al-sama yinhazzowa yinbahtu min tahdiidah.
Be gudurtah,hu hayyaj al-baharwa be ilmah,dammar Rahab khuul al-bahar.
Be nafkhatah,al-sama bigi saafiwa iidah katal al-daabi al-mu'arrid.
Wa dool al-askhar fi amalahwa di bas al-mukhaala al-nasma'ooha.Kan misil da,yaatu yafham ra'ad gudurtah-?
Wa battaan Ayyuub kallam wa gaal-:
Nahlif be l-Ilaah al-Hayy al-daharaani huguugiwa be l-Gaadir al-ja'al leyi al-murr-!
Kan ruuh al-Rabb gaa'ide foogiwa munkhari tadrub riih,
abadan khachmi ma yuguul fasaalawa lisaani ma yantug be khachch.
Lahaddi numuut kula,ana ma nantiiku haggwa ma nuguul ana ma kaamil.
Ana munkarib fi adaalti,ma nikhalliiha-!Wa galbi ma indah chakkfi kulla ayyaam hayaati-!
Khalli aduuyi yil'aakhab misil aasiwa l-yugumm diddi yil'aakhab misil mujrim-!
Achaan intu tuguulu-:-Al-kaafir ma indah acham ba'ad yumuutwakit al-Rabb yichiil ruuhah.
Hal al-Rabb yasma' korooraakahfi wakit diigtah walla-?
Hal hu yafrah be l-Gaadir walla-?Wa yagdar yinaadi al-Rabbfi ayyi wakit walla-?
Ana ni'allimku kikkeef gudrat al-Rabbwa ma nilabbid leeku niiyit al-Gaadir.
Wa kan intu kulluku iriftuuh,maala tihajju fi l-riih saakit-?
Wa khalaas,daahu al-gisim al-jahhazahal-Rabb le l-aasiyiinwa da misil warasa al-kharrarhaal-Gaadir le l-mujrimiin.
Kan iyaalah yaktaro kula,yaktulhum al-seefwa zurriiytah ma yalgo akil.
Al-faddalo minhum yaktulhum al-wabawa araamilhum ma yabkan leehum.
Al-aasi,kan yilimm al-fudda misil al-turaabwa yilimm al-khulgaan be katara kula,
khalli yilimmuhum-!Al-saalih bas yalbashumwa l-fudda kamaan tabga gisim le l-bari.
Al-aasi bana beetah da'iifmisil beet al-ittewa ma yitawwilmisil illiiyit al-yihaahi al-teer.
Hu yunuum khani wa ma yalga kafan.Wa be khafla,yabga ma fiih.
Al-ru'ub yaji leyah be sur'a misil al-seelwa amzooba'aane taji takhtifah fi ust al-leel.
Riih al-sabaah tiwaddiih wa hu yamchiwa tichiilah min maskanah.
Bala rahma,al-Rabb yizarrigah be nachaachiibwa hu yihaawil yakhnis minhum.
Wa l-naas yisaffugu le damaarahwa yichchammato leyah min maarig min beetah.
Akiid,fiyah bakaanaat al-yamurgu minhum al-fuddawa bakaanaat al-yisaffu fooghum al-dahab.
Al-hadiid yamurguuh min al-turaabwa yagta'o al-nahaas be naarle yamurguuh min al-hajar.
Fi lubb al-ard,al-naas yiwaddu deyyal-beyah fi l-bakaanaat al-dulumyifattuchu al-hujaar al-mulabbadiinba'iid fi l-dalaam al-haalik.
Yahfuru nugra tawiileba'iid min al-bakaan al-maskuun.Wa fi bakaan al-ma yaji foogah insaan,yidallu be hubaal ba'iid min al-naas.
Wa fi dahar al-ard yugumm al-akilwa laakin daakhilha misil akalatah naar.
Wa fi hujaarha,yinlagi al-yaakhuut al-akhdarwa fi turaabha,yinlagi al-dahab.
Al-suguura ma ya'arfu al-tariig dawa een al-hideyye ma tichiifah.
Al-wuhuuch ma yamchu foogahwa l-duud ma yuchuggah.
Al-naas yikassuru al-hajarwa yichaglubu al-jibaal min ga'arhum.
Fi lubb al-jibaal,yankutu nugaar katiiriinwa kulla cheyy khaali,een al-insaan tichiifah.
Yisiddu uyuun almi al-baharwa yamurgu al-mullabbid fi l-deyy.
Laakin al-hikma,ween tinlagi-?Wa l-ma'rafa,bakaanha ween-?
Al-insaan ma ya'arif tamanhawa hi ma tinlagi fi ard al-hayyiin.
Almi al-khariig yuguul-:-Al-hikma ma gaa'ide foogi.-Wa l-bahar yuguul-:-Hi ma ma'aayi.
Al-hikma ma tilbaddal be dahab saafiwa la tinchari be wazin hana fudda.
Dahab Ufiir al-khaali ma yisaawiihawa la l-agiig wa la l-yaakhuut al-akhdar.
Al-dahab wa l-balluurma yisaawu tamanhawa hi ma tinlagibe chuwaal hana dahab saafi kula.
Wa l-marajaan wa l-maass,ma yihajju beehum jambahawa l-hikma,khiimitha ziyaada min al-lu'lu.
Wa l-yaakhuut al-asfaral-min al-Habacha ma yisaawi tamanhawa be l-dahab al-saafi kula,al-hikma ma tinchari.
Laakin al-hikma di jaaye min ween-?Wa l-ma'rafa,bakaanha ween-?
Hi ansatarat min uyuun kulli makhluug hayywa mullabbide min tuyuur al-sama.
Wa l-halaak wa l-moot yuguulu-:-Udneena sim'o beeha.
Laakin al-Rabb bas yafham deribhawa hu wiheedah ya'arif bakaanha.
Achaan hu bas al-yanzurlahaddi aakhir al-dunyawa yichiif kulla cheyyal-tihit al-sama.
Wakit wazan tugul al-riihwa haddad magaas al-almi,
wa wakit anta amur le l-matar,wa sawwa derib le l-barraaga wa l-ra'ad,
khalaas,hu chaaf al-hikma wa khaddarhawa khattaaha wa kachafha.
Wa ba'ad da,khalaas gaal le l-insaan-:-Al-khoof min al-Rabb,da bas al-hikma.Wa ba''idiin min al-charr,di bas al-ma'rafa-!
Ana nitmanna zamaani al-faat yigabbil leyiwakit al-Rabb gaa'id yahfadni.
Wa da wakit barakat al-Rabb gaa'idefoogi misil faanuuswa nuurah gaa'id yidawwi leyiderbi fi l-dalaam.
Dool ahsan ayyaam hayaatiwakit al-Rabb gaa'id yifakkir fi beeti misil rafiigi.
Fi l-wakit daak,lissaa' al-Gaadir gaa'id ma'aayiwa awlaadi muhawwigiinni.
Fi l-wakit daak,ana nilbarrad be l-labanwa assaaraati yisiilu be l-dihin be katara.
Wa da wakit namrug ale khachum baab al-hillewa nagood fi naga'at al-malamma.
Wa wakit yichiifuuni,al-subyaan yitarrufuwa l-chiyyaab yugummu leyi foog.
Wa l-masaa'iil yiwaggufu kalaamhumwa yukhuttu iideehum fi khuchuumhum.
Wa hiss al-kubaaraat ma yinsami'wa lisaanhum kula ma yantug.Wa da kulla le yiwassufu leyi ihtiraamhum.
Al-adaan al-tasma'nituguul ana mubaarakwa l-een al-tichiifnitachhad leyi.
Achaan ninajji al-miskiinal-yikoorik leyi le l-faza'wa l-atiim al-ma indahnaadum yisaa'idah.
Wa barakat al-gariib le l-moot tanzil foogiwa namla galib al-armala be l-farah.
Nalbas al-adaala wa hi taksiiniwa l-hagg misil khalag wa kadmuul leyi.
Ana misil uyuun le l-amyaanwa misil rijle le l-a'raj.
Ana misil abu le l-masaakiinwa nifakkir adiil fi huguug al-deef.
Wa naksir saalfit al-mujrimwa min khachmah,nagla' fariistah.
Wa khalaas,ana gult-:-Ba'ad ayyaam katiiriinmisil ramla hana khachum al-bahar,ana numuut fi lubb aayilti.
Nabga misil chadaraal-uruugha rawyaaniin almiwa be leel,al-talaj yanzil fi furuu'i.
Charafi yiljaddad foogiwa nubbaali yabga gawi fi iidi.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-naas yarjooniwa yaskutu le yasma'o wasiiyti.
Ba'ad kalaami,humman ma yinaakhuchuwa kalaami yanzil fooghummisil matara.
Humman yarjoonimisil yarjo al-matarwa yardo be kalaamimisil almi al-richaach.
Wa ana nadhak leehumwa humman ma yisadduguuhwa wakit chaafo wijhi daawi,khalaas yalgo acham.
Ana azalt leehum al-deribwa ga'adt fi raashum.Wa bigiit misil malik fi lubb askarahwa misil naadum al-yihannis al-ta'baaniin.
Laakin hassa',humman al-subyaan minni yadhako foogi.Wa zamaan,ana hagart abbahaathum,chiyyaab al-ma tammo kulaab le yahfado khanami.
Wa l-chiyyaab dool,gudrithum tanfa'ni be chunu-?Achaan khuwwithum kammalat.
Min al-juu' wa l-fagur,fattacho akil fi ard al-jafaafal-min zamaan hilkat wa addammarat.
Humman gata'o al-mikhkheet min chadarawa akalo min taman uruug al-ratam.
Taradoohum min ust al-naaswa aato waraahum misil wara l-saraariig.
Humman sakanofi l-wudyaan al-yaabsiinwa fi nugaar al-ardwa karaakiir al-jibaal.
Humman kawwako misil al-hamiir fi lubb al-khaabawa ragado fi l-haskaniit.
Humman iyaal al-mataamiis al-ma induhum usumwa matruudiin min al-balad.
Wa hassa',iyaalhum al-subyaan doolyisawwuuni khinneeyewa yadurbu beyi masal.
Achaan hasabooni misil muharram,yiba''udu minnilahaddi yibazzukhu leyi fi wijhiwa ma yaj'alooni.
Al-Rabb rakha habil nubbaali wa ayyabaaniwa be da,humman ma yiwaggufu fasaalithum minni.
Fi zeenaayti,chariiriin katiiriin yugummule yicharkulu leyi wa yarmuuniwa yugummu diddi le yiwadduruuni.

Humman yadkhulu leyi be khurma kabiirewa yawsalooni misil mooj al-bahar.
Al-ru'ub gabbal diddiwa charafi faat misil chaalatah riihwa najaati faatat misil sahaab.
Wa hassa',nafsi antahatwa ayyaam al-ta'ab waga'o foogi.
Be l-leel,udaami booja'ooni chadiidwa yilmaadakhooni ma yagiifu.

Hu ramaani fi l-tiinewa ana bigiit misil ajaaj wa rumaad.
Ya Rabb-!Ana koorakt leekwa inta ma raddeet leyi.Ana wagaft be tuuliwa inta ma wajjaht aleyi.
Inta ma indak leyi rahmawa iidak hajamatni be kulla gudritha.
Inta rakkabtini fi l-riih wa waddeetniwa rameetni fi amzooba'aane.
Aywa,ana irift kadar tiwaddiini le l-mootal-beyah inta waa'adt kulli makhluug hayy.
Al-yaga',ma indah hagg yimidd iidah walla-?Wa l-yidoor al-faza',ma indah hagg yikoorik walla-?
Aywa,ana bakeet le l-hayaatah fi l-ta'abwa wassaft mahannati le l-miskiin.
Ana zaati hasabt nalga al-kheerlaakin jaani al-charr.Ana narja al-nuurwa jaani al-dalaam.
Wa butuuni hirgo ayyi wakitwa ana waajaht ayyaam al-ta'ab.
Ana raayikh be ta'ab wa bigiit azragwa laakin ma min hamu al-harraay.Wa gammeet fi ust al-mujtama'wa koorakt le l-faza'.
Ana bigiit akhu al-ba'aachiimwa rafiig al-na'aam.
Farwit jildi dallamatwa udaami yibalbulu foogi min al-wirde.
Ana bigiit misil jigindiiyit khine al-hizinwa suffaarit hiss al-bakkaayiin.
Ana sawweet ahad ma'a nafsima nichiif be chahwa le bineeye.
Kan sawweetah,chunu al-gisim al-nalgaahmin al-Rabb fi l-aali-?Wa chunu al-warasa al-yantiiha leyial-Gaadir min foog-?
Al-damaar ma waajible l-naadum al-mujrim walla-?Wa l-masiibe ma taga'fi l-yisawwi al-charr walla-?
Al-Rabb ma yichiif duruubi walla-?Wa ma yahsib kulla khatwaati walla-?
Kan ana macheet be kidibaw jareet be sur'a le l-khachch,
khalli al-Rabb yawzinnifi l-miizaan al-aadilwa ya'arif kamaali.
Kan ana gabbalt min al-derib al-adiilwa chahwat galbi taaba'at uyuuniwa iideeni allattakho be l-najaasa,
khalaas,naas aakhariin yaakulu al-teerabtahwa yidammuru zurriiyti-!
Kan galbi mayyal le marawa harastaha fi khachum baab jaari,
khalaas,khalli marti kulayichiilha raajil aakharwa naas katiiriin yaznooha.
Achaan zinaayi da yabga fi'il cheen.Aywa,da khata al-yijiib ikhaab min al-gaadi.
Wa di naar al-taakul lahaddi l-aakhirawa tidammir kulla intaaji.
Ana ma rafadt huguug abdi aw khaadmiwakit yiwadduuni fi l-charii'a.
Kan awwal ana sawweetah,nisawwi chunu wakit al-Rabb yihaasibni-?Wa nuguul chunu wakit yas'alni-?
Al-khalagaani ana fi batun ammikhalagaahum humman kula.Hu nafs al-Ilaahal-khattaana fi butuun ammahaatna.
Ana ma dahart al-miskiinmin al-cheyy al-yidoorahwa ma jarreet dumuu'uyuun al-armala.
Ana ma akalt akli wiheediwa ma dahart al-atiim ma yuduukhah.
La-!Achaan min subaayi,hu kibir ma'aayi misil ma'a abuuhwa daayman ana daafa't le l-armala.
Wakit ana chift naadum fagri ma indah khalagwa miskiin ma indah khita,
hatta kan ma chakaroonibe kulla galibhum kula,ana khatteethum be khattaay daafiyemin suuf khanami.
Hatta kan ana muhimm fi khachum baab al-hille kula,ana ma rafa't iidi le nikhawwif atiim.
Kan awwal ana sawweetah,khalli iidi tingati' min kitfiwa duraa'i yingati' min kuu'i.
Achaan al-damaar al-jaayi min al-Rabbyisabbib leyi ru'ubwa fi chaan azamatah,ma indi gudra.
Ana ma khatteet amaani fi l-dahabwa ma gult leyah-:-Nitwakkal aleek-.
Wa ma firiht be katarat khunaayiwa la be khumaami al-lammatah iidi.
Wa ma chift nuur al-harraay wakit tala'twa l-gamar wakit gaa'id yazhaf be kulla jamaalah,
wa galbi ma mayyal leehum be achiirwa ana ma ja'altuhum misil ilaahaat le na'abudhum.
Kan awwal ana sawweetah,da khata waajib leyi al-ikhaab,achaan ana khunt al-Rabb fi l-aali.
Ana ma firiht be damaaral-adu al-yakrahniwa ma natteet min al-farhawakit al-charr waga' foogah.
La-!Achaan ma waajib lisaani yisawwi zanibwa la natlub mootah be la'ana.
Laakin al-naas al-gaa'idiin fi kheemti buguulu-:-Yaatu al-ma chibi' min al-laham fi beet Ayyuub-?
Abadan,ana ma raggadt al-deef barrawa baabi daayman faatih le l-musaafiriin.
Ana ma misil kulla l-naas,nilabbid isyaaniwa khataayi kula ma dasseetah tihtiwa ga'adt foogah.
Wa da achaan ana khuft min kalaam al-naaswa karaahiiyit al-gabaayil khawwafatnilahaddi ana sakattwa ma maragt min beeti.
Fi naadum al-yasma'ni walla-?Wa da kalaami al-akhiir.Khalli al-Gaadir yurudd leyi-!Kan fi chakwa min aduuyimaktuuba diddi,
khalaas ana nichiilha fi kitfiwa nalbasha misil taaj fi raasi.
Kan misil da khalaas,nigaddim le l-Rabb kulla hisaab khatwaatiwa nigarrib leyah be farah misil malik.
Kan al-ard chakat minniwa juruufha andalamo foogi
achaan ana akalt intaajhaal-ana ma chareetah,wa kan zalamt siyaadah,
khalaas,khalli ardi tigawwim haskaniitfi badal al-gameh al-ahmarwa andireesafi badal al-gameh al-abyad-!Wa da kalaam Ayyuub al-akhiir.
Wa khalaas,Alifaaz wa Bildad wa Suufar waggafo kalaamhum ma'a Ayyuub achaan hu yichiif nafsah saalih.
Wa be sabab da,Aliihu wileed Barakiil al-min hillit Buuz min khachum beet Raam zi'il za'al chadiid.Wa za'alah da didd Ayyuub achaan Ayyuub sawwa nafsah saalih ziyaada min al-Rabb.
Wa Aliihu zi'il za'al chadiid didd al-rufgaan al-talaata kula,achaan humman ma gidro yuruddu le Ayyuub.Wa be misil da,humman sawwo Ayyuub khaati.
Wa Aliihu sabar ma kallam le Ayyuub achaan humman kulluhum kubaar minnah fi l-sinn.
Wa laakin wakit Aliihu chaaf kadar al-rujaal al-talaata dool ma induhum kalaam al-yurudduuh leyah,zi'il za'al chadiid.
Wa khalaas,Aliihu wileed Barakiil al-min hillit Buuz chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:Ana sabi wa intu chiyyaabwa fi chaan da,ana khuft wa rajaftwa ma gidirt nikhabbirku be ma'rafati.
Wa fi nafsi ana gult-:-Al-chiyyaab waajib yihajju awwalwa l-induhum siniin katiiriin yi'arrufu be l-hikma.
Wa laakin fi l-sahiih,al-insaan indah ruuhwa l-nafas al-jaayi min al-Gaadir,yantiih al-fihim.
Al-siniin al-katiiriin basma yantu hikmawa ma kulla l-chiyyaabyafhamo al-adaala.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nuguul-:-Asma'ni-!Ana kula nikhabbir be ma'rafati.
Ana arrajjeet kalaamkuwa khatteet adaani le hujjitkulahaddi intu haggagtu min kalaamku.
Ana khatteet baali foogkuwa daahu waahid minku kulama gidir yuluum Ayyuubwa waahid minku ma gidiryurudd leyah.
Wa laakin ma waajib tuguulu-:-Aniina ligiina al-hikma.Al-Rabb bas yagdar foogah,ma insaan.
Wa Ayyuub ma kalaam kalaamah leyi anawa ana kula ma nurudd leyah be kalaamku intu.
Humman khaafowa ma yagdaro yuruddu battaanwa l-kalaam kula waddar leehum.
Ana arrajjeet achaan humman ma hajjoachaan humman wagafo wa sakato wa abo ma yuruddu.
Wa ja doori ana.Ana kula nuruddwa nikhabbir be ma'rafati.
Achaan ana malaan be kalaamwa ruuh fi daakhili tajburni le nikallim.
Galbi fi daakhili faarmisil khamar masduudaw misil girbe jadiide malaane al-tidoor tinfajir.
Ana nihajji le nirayyih nafsiwa naftah khachmi wa nurudd.
Ana ma nichiif naadum akheer min naadumwa ma nukhuchch insaan.
Achaan ana ma na'arif nukhuchchwa kan khachcheet kula,al-khalagaani yichiilni be sur'a.
Wa hassa' da,asma' gooli,ya Ayyuubwa khutt adaanak le kulla kalaami.
Daahu-!Ana nufukk khachmiwa lisaani yantug.
Kalaam galbi kulla adaalawa lisaani yikallim be ma'rafa sahiihe.
Be ruuhah,al-Rabb khalagaaniwa nafas al-Gaadir hayyaani.
Ya Ayyuub-!Kan tagdar,rudd leyi-!Gumm-!Agiif giddaamiwa daafi' le nafsak-!
Giddaam al-Rabb,ana zaati mislak inta.Hu khalagaani ana kulamin al-tiine bas.
Wa be misil da,ma waajib takhaaf minniachaan ana ma nidammirak.
Laakin inta hajjeet giddaami,aywa,ana simi'tak wakit inta gult-:
Ana saafi,ma indi khata.Ana nadiif,ma indi zanib.
Wa daahu al-Rabb gaa'id yihaarijniwa yaj'alni misil aduuh.
Hu dassa rijileeni fi guyuudwa yiraakhibni fi kulla duruubi.
Wa ana nuguul leek,ya Ayyuub,inta ma indak hagg fi l-kalaam daachaan al-Rabb kabiir min al-insaan.
Maala inta tachki min al-Rabbwakit hu ma radda leek fi kalaamak-?
Laakin al-Rabb yikallim be tariiga waahide aw aakharawa l-insaan ma ya'arfah.
Hu yihajji fi hilim wa fi l-ru'ya be l-leelwakit al-insaan naayim noom chadiid fi furaachah.
Wa khalaas,al-Rabb yikallimle l-naas fi udneehumwa yihazzirhumwa yikhawwifhum marra waahid.
Wa da le yiba''idhum min amalhum al-cheenwa yahfad al-insaan min al-istikbaar.
Wa da le yahfadah min al-mootwa yadhar ruuhah ma tamrug be l-seef.
Al-Rabb yihazzir al-insaan be ta'ab fi furaachahwakit udaamah yarjufu min al-waja'.
Khalaas,hu yaaba al-akil.Hatta al-akil al-halu kula,yikhalliih.
Wa laham jildah yikammil tak,yifaddil illa l-udaam.
Ruuhah tigarrib le l-khaburwa hayaatah le l-moot.
Wa laakin kan yalga leyah malak wasiit,waahid min been al-alifal-yikhabbir al-insaan be l-tariig al-adiil,
khalaas,al-Rabb yihinn foogahwa yuguul-:-Najjiih-!Achaan ma yanzil fi l-khabur,ana ligiit al-fidya al-ninajjiih beeha.
Wa be da,jismah yalga gudrat chabaabahwa yigabbil le ayyaam subaayah.
Hu yachhad al-Rabbwa l-Rabb yarda beyahwa yichiif wijh al-Rabb be farah.Wa l-Rabb yaj'al al-insaan dasaalih giddaamah battaan.
Hu yikhanni giddaam al-naaswa yuguul-:-Ana aznabt wa awwajt al-adaalawa laakin al-Rabb ma jaazaani misil waajib leyi.
Wa najja ruuhi min al-khaburwa nichiif nuur al-haya battaan.
Wa daahu kulla cheyy al-sawwaah al-Rabbmarrateen wa talaata ma'a l-insaan
le yigabbil ruuhah min al-mootwa yinawwirah be nuur al-hayyiin.
Khutt baalak,ya Ayyuub,wa asma'ni-!Askut wa ana bas nikallim.
Kan indak kalaam,rudd leyi-!Kallim achaan nidoor nibarriik.
Wa kan ma fi,askut wa asma'niwa ana ni'allimak al-hikma.
Wa battaan Aliihu chaal al-kalaam wa gaal-:
Ya l-hukama,asma'o kalaami-!Ya intu al-faahimiin,khuttu adaanku le l-nuguulah.
Achaan al-adaan tifassil al-kalaammisil al-lisaan yifarrig al-ta'aam.
Wa misil da,khalli na'azulu al-adaalawa ambeenaatna,khalli na'arfu al-sahiih.
Wa simi'na Ayyuub buguul-:-Ana saalihwa l-Rabb bas daharaani min huguugi.
Wa fi charii'ti,ma yuguul al-sahiih.Wa ana ma sawweet khatawa jarahaani jiraah hana moot.
Yaatu misil Ayyuub-?Al-sawwiyiin al-chamaate,hayyin leyah misil charaab almi-!
Hu muchtarik ma'a l-yisawwu al-charrwa yuruukh daayman ma'a l-fasliin.
Achaan hu gaal-:-Chunu faaydit al-insaankan yafrah be l-Rabb-?
Wa khalaas asma'ooni,ya l-naas al-faahimiin-!Al-Rabb yisawwi al-charr-?La-!Al-Gaadir yisawwi al-zulum-?Abadan-!
Achaan hu yijaazi al-insaan hasab amalahwa yikaafiih hasab tariigah al-yichiilah.
Al-Rabb yugumm be l-fasaala walla-?La-!Al-Gaadir yi'awwij al-charii'a walla-?Abadan-!
Ma fi naadum al-wakkal al-Rabb be l-ardwa khattaah foog kulla l-aalam.
Kan hu kharrar wa chaal ruuhahwa nafasah al-antaah le l-makhluugiin,
khalaas kulluhum yumuutuwa l-insaan yigabbil fi l-turaab.
Kan inta indak fihim,khalaas asma'-!Wa khutt adaanak le kalaami.
Kan al-Rabb yakrah al-adaala,yagdar yahkim walla-?Al-Saadikh wa l-Chadiid,tuguul hu khaati walla-?
Hal le l-malik nuguulu-:-Inta ma naafi'--?Hal le l-masaa'iil nuguulu-:-Intu aasiyiin--?
Al-Rabb ma yichiif al-masaa'iilwa ma yifarrig al-khani min al-fagriachaan kulluhum,hu bas khalagaahum.
Humman yumuutu be l-leel be khaflawa l-cha'ab yibarjulu wa yumuutuwa l-jaayir yitarrufuuh be suhuula.
Achaan al-Rabb yiraakhib fi duruub al-insaanwa yichiif kulla khatwaatah.
Wa ma fi dalaam wa la dalaam haalikal-yillabbado foogah siyaad al-fasaala.
Wa l-Rabb ma muhtaaj le yinaadi al-naasle muhaakama khaassa.
Hu yidammir al-chudaad bala ma yihaggigwa yukhutt aakhariin fi badalhum.
Achaan hu ya'arif amalhumwa yinrahku be leel wa yifajjukhuuhum.
Hu yadrubhum fi bakaan al-aasiyiinal-yi'aakhubuuhum foogah giddaam kulla l-naas.
Wa da achaan humman ba''ado minnahwa ma taabo duruubah,
wa daayago al-da'iif lahaddiyikoorik le l-Rabbaywa,al-Rabb simi'korooraak al-miskiin.
Kan al-Rabb yaskut,yaatu yisawwiih khaltaan-?Wa kan aba ma yiwajjih aleehum,yaatu yagdar yichiifah-?Wa la l-umam wa la l-naas.
Wa ma yikhalli al-kaafir yahkimwa la yabga charak le l-cha'ab.
Akuun naadum yuguul le l-Rabb-:-Ana himilt ikhaabiwa ma nisawwi battaan cheyy fasil.
Al-cheyy al-ana ma chiftah,wassifah leyiwa kan sawweet khata kula,battaan ma nisawwiih.
Hal hasab fikrak inta bas,al-Rabb yi'aakhib al-naadum da-?Hal al-Rabb yikaafiik hasab fikrak,wakit inta abeet ma tutuub-?Inta bas waajib ta'azil,ma ana-!Wa l-ta'arfah,guulah-!
Wa l-naas al-faahimiinwa l-hakiim al-gaa'id yasma'ni yuguulu-:
Ayyuub yikallim bala ma'rafawa kalaamah kula ma indah ma'aana.
Khalaas,khalli Ayyuub yagooddaayman tihit al-tajriba-!Achaan hu yuruddmisil al-naas al-fasliin.
Achaan hu yiziid al-isyaan fi zanbahwa yisaffig fi lubbina be hugrawa yihajji katiir didd al-Rabb.
Inta tahsib indak hagg wakit tuguul-:-Ana saalih ziyaada min al-Rabb.
Achaan inta gult le l-Rabb-:-Da mufiid leek walla-?Kan ma naznib da,yanfa'ni be chunu-?
Ana bas al-nurudd leek,nurudd leek intawa le rufgaanak al-ma'aak.
Anzur al-sama wa chiifah adiilwa chiif al-sahaab min foog leek-!
Kan taznib da,tudurr al-Rabb be chunu-?Wa kan isyaanak yabga katiir kula,tisawwi leyah chunu-?
Wa kan inta aadil,hu yistafiid chunu-?Wa yalga minnak chunu-?
Achaan fasaaltak di tudurr naas mislak baswa adaaltak kula tanfa' insaan bas.
Al-naas yikooruku be sababkatarat al-zaalimiinwa yikooruku le l-faza'min iid al-gawiyiin.
Laakin ma fi naadum al-yuguul-:-Ween al-Rabb al-khalagaani,hu al-ana ninaadiih be khine be l-leel-?
Ween hu al-antaana agul ziyaadamin bahaayim al-ard,wa sawwaana hakiimiinmin tuyuur al-sama-?
Khalaas,al-naas yikoorukuwa l-Rabb ma yurudd leehumachaan istikbaar al-fasliin dool.
Akiid,al-Rabb ma yasma' korooraakhum fi l-faadi,wa l-Gaadir ma yijiib khabarhum.
Ya Ayyuub,kan ke da,al-Rabb ma yasma'akwakit tuguul inta ma gaa'id tichiifahwa muchkiltak gaa'ide giddaamah wa inta tarjaah.
Wa ziyaada min da,tuguul khadab al-Rabb ma yugummwa ma indah haaje be l-isyaan.
Ya Ayyuub,tihajji saakitwa tikattir kalaamak bala faayde-!
Wa Aliihu gaal battaan-:
Asburni chiyya,nidoor nikhabbirakachaan battaan kula indi kalaamfi chaan al-Rabb.
Irfiti ligiitha min ba'iidwa niwassif kadar al-khalagaani aadil.
Achaan be l-sahiih,kalaami da ma kidibwa ana al-fikri tamaam nagood ma'aak.
Al-Rabb gaadir,ma yahgir al-insaanwa ma fi cheyy al-hu ma ya'arfah.
Le l-aasi,ma yikhalliih yi'iichwa laakin yanti al-masaakiin huguughum.
Wa nazrah ma yifaarig al-saalihwa yukhuttuhum fi kursi al-mulukwa yabgo aaliyiin daayman.
Wa kan humman masaajiinfi lubb al-janaaziirwa kan karaboohum figuyuud al-mudaayaga,
khalaas be misil da,al-Rabb yikhabbirhum be amalhumwa isyaanhum wakit humman astakbaro.
Hu yufukk adaanhum le yi'addibhumwa yaamurhum yigabbulu min al-fasaala.
Wa kan humman sim'o kalaamahwa abadooh,khalaas yi'iichu kulla hayaathum be kheerwa kulla muddit umurhum fi ni'ma.
Wa laakin kan ma sim'o kalaamah,yumuutu be l-silaahwa yiddammaro min gillit al-fihim.
Al-kuffaar guluubhum malaaniin be za'alwa ma yikooruku le l-faza' wakit yijanzirhum.
Humman yumuutu fi chabaabhumust al-charaamiit fi buyuut asnaamhum.
Wa laakin al-Rabb yikhallis al-miskiin be l-ta'abwa be l-diige,yihazzirah.
Ya Ayyuub,inta kula al-Rabb yamurgak min al-diigele yantiik hurriiye kaamilewa mawaa'iinak yinmalu be akil halu.
Wa laakin hassa',inta ligiit muhaakamamisil al-aasiwa l-muhaakama di,ma tanja minha.
Fakkir-!Ma tikhalli al-khuna yiwaddirakwa ma tikhalli al-rachwa tiba''idak.
Wa la khunaak wa la dahabak ma yitimmuukwa kulla gudrat jismak ma tisaa'idak.
Ma titmanna al-leelwakit yamurgu al-naas min bakaanaathum.
Angari' ma tiwajjih ale l-charr,ma ta'azilah fi chaan ta'abak.
Chiifu-!Al-Rabb aali be gudurtah.Yaatu mu'allim mislah-?
Yaatu yagdar yihaasibah fi amalah-?Yaatu yagdar yuguul leyah-:-Inta sawweet zulum--?
Azzakkar wa azzim amalah,amalah al-yikhannu beyah al-naas.
Ayyi insaan yichiifahwa ayyi naadum yanzurah min ba'iid.
Al-Rabb aziim wa hu faayit fihimnawa ma fi naadum yahsib siniin umrah.
Wa yilimm bukhaar almi fi l-sahaabwa yinazzilah battaan matar min jadiid.
Al-sahaab yusubb al-matar dawa almiih yisiil le naas katiiriin.
Yaatu yafhamkikkeef al-Rabb yukhutt al-sahaabwa yirassil al-ra'ad min lubb al-sama-?
Hu yirassil al-nuur hawaaleeyahwa yikhatti al-bahar al-khariig.
Wa be kulla l-cheyy da,yahkim fi l-chu'uubwa yantiihum ma'aach be katara.
Hu yichiil al-barraaga be iideenahwa yiwassif leeha hadafha.
Be l-ra'ad,yiwassif jaytahwa l-bahaayim yihissu kan hu garrab.
Wa fi chaan da,galbi rajaflahaddi misil yamrug min sadri.
Asma'o hissah al-misil al-ra'ad-!Asma'o al-dagdaag al-chadiid al-yamrug min khachmah-!
Al-Rabb yatlig barraagtah tihit kulla l-samawa yirassilha lahaddi aakhir al-ard.
Wa ba'ad da,hissah al-mukhiif yamrugwa hiss majdah yabga misil ra'ad.Wa barraagtah ma tagiifwakit hissah gaa'id yinsami'.
Hiss al-Rabb yidagdig wa yikhawwifwa yisawwi ajaayib kubaar al-aniina ma nafhamoohum.
Hu yuguul le l-talaj-:-Daffig fi l-ard-!-Wa yuguul le l-tchaktchaaka-:-Abge matar-!Aywa,subbi matar chadiid-!
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,yiwaggif khidmit kulla insaanachaan kulluhum ya'arfuda amalah hu.
Khalaas,ayyi haywaan yamchi le nugurtahwa yargud fi maskanah.
Riih al-zaggaay taji min al-junuubwa l-barid yaji min al-munchaakh.
Nafkhat al-Rabb tikawwin al-talajwa tijammid almi al-bahar.
Hu yamla al-sahaab be buruudawa yichattit al-sahaab be barraaga jaay wa jaay.
Hu bas al-yiliff al-sahaable yitabbig kulla awaamirah fi kulla wijh al-ard.
Wa yirassilhum fi l-ard le yi'aakhib al-naasaw yibayyin rahmatah.
Ya Ayyuub,khutt adaanak le l-kalaam da-!Askut wa chiif ajaayib al-Rabb-!
Inta ta'arif kikkeef al-Rabb yahkim al-sahaabwa kikkeef al-sahaab yisawwi al-barraaga walla-?
Wa inta ta'arif kikkeef al-Rabb khatta al-sahaabal-mutaharrik been al-sama wa l-ard-?Wa ta'arif ajaayib al-Rabbwa ilmah al-tamaama walla-?
Wakit al-ard saabte tihit riih al-junuub,khulgaanak yabgo haamiyiin min hamuuha.
Al-Rabb khalag al-sahaab wa gawwaahmisil amchawwaafa hint hadiid magtuu'.Wa inta tagdar tisawwi mislah-?
Khalaas,allimnaal-waajib nuguuluuh le l-Rabb.Ma na'arfu cheyywa gaa'idiin fi l-dalaam.
Wakit nikallim,waajib nikhabbir al-Rabb walla-?Misil da,naadum ma yitmannale nafsah al-halaak walla-?
Ma nagdaro nichiifu deyy al-harraayfi lubb al-sahaab al-katiir.Wa laakin ba'ad al-riih tichiil al-sahaab da,nuurha yibiin.
Min al-munchaakh yaji deyy misil al-dahabwa nuur jalaal al-Rabb yabhatna.
Hu al-Gaadir,ma nagdaro nigarrubu leyahwa khuwwatah kabiire.Wa indah al-hagg wa l-adaala be katarawa laakin ma yazlum insaan.
Fi chaan da,waajib al-naasyakhaafo minnah.Wa laakin hu ma lammaahbe l-yisawwu nufuushum hakiimiin.
Wa khalaas,Allah sa'al Ayyuub min lubb al-riih al-chadiide wa gaal-:
Yaatu al-ma yikhalli niiyti tabga waadhebe kalaam bala ma'rafa-?
Arbut sulbak misil raajil fahal-!Wa ana nas'alak wa inta turudd leyi-!
Inta gaa'id ween wakit ana assast al-ard-?Guulah leyi hasab ma'rafatak.
Yaatu khatta magaas al-ard,inta ta'arfah walla-?Wa yaatu madda foogha habil al-magaas-?
Wa amadha dool saabtiin fi chunu-?Wa yaatu khatta al-hajar al-muhimm,
wakit nujuum al-sabaah yikhannu sawawa kulla malaa'ikat al-Rabb yafraho-?
Wa yaatu khatta huduud le l-baharwakit marag min batun al-ard-?
Labbastah be sahaab misil khalagwa khatteetah be khamaam adlam.
Wa khatteet huduudahwa sawweet leyah baab wa guful.
Wa ana gult leyah-:-Taji hini bas,ma tufuut al-bakaan da-!Hini bas tagiif gudrat moojak-!
Wa inta-!Yoom waahid,amart al-sabaahle yasbih walla-?Aywa,ooreet al-fajur le yatla'
le yamsuk al-ard min tarafhawa yihitt minha al-aasiyiin walla-?
Wa be fajur,al-ard tinchaaf waadhemisil al-tiine al-khatto foogha al-khitimwa loonha yabga misil jammalooha be lubaas.
Laakin al-aasiyiin,nuurhum yiwaddirwa duraa'hum al-yarfa'ooh,yinkasir.
Wa inta wassalt lahaddi ga'ar al-bahar walla-?Wa rukht fi bakaanaat al-khariigiin hana l-bahar walla-?
Wa biibaan al-moot anfataho leek giddaamak walla-?Wa biibaan al-dalaam al-haalik,chiftuhum walla-?
Wa ta'arif urd al-ard walla-?Khalaas kan ta'arif kulla l-cheyy da,guulah-!
Al-nuur,ween maskanah-?Wa l-dalaam,ween bakaanah-?
Tagdar takrubhum fi bakaanhumwa ayyi waahid tiwaddiih le maskanah walla-?
Khalaas,akiid inta ta'arfahachaan fi l-wakit daak,inta wildook walla-?Wa akiid inta umrak tawiilziyaada walla-?
Inta wassaltlahaddi makhaazin al-talaj walla-?Wa inta chiftmakhaazin al-barad walla-?
Ana khatteethum taraf le wakt al-diige,le yoom hana harib wa duwaas.
Ween al-derib al-foogah al-barraaga tingasim-?Wa ween al-derib al-beyah riih al-sabaah tusuug fi l-ard-?
Yaatu yufukk baab al-sama wa yinazzil al-matarwa yisawwi derib le l-barraaga wa l-ra'ad-?
Yaatu yinazzil matar fi ard al-bala naaswa fi sahara al-ma indaha insaan-?
Wa da,le yarwi ard jafaaf wa kharaabachaan al-gechch yabzurwa yugumm foogha.
Al-matara indaha abu walla-?Wa yaatu wilid al-karany-?
Wa batun yaatu jaabat al-barad-?Wa yaatu wilid al-talaj al-yanzil min al-sama-?
Al-almi yabga misil hajarwa almi al-khariig yajmid.
Wa inta tagdar tarbut nujuum al-Tureyyaaw tihill hizaam al-Sabi al-Makhmi walla-?
Hal tagdar titalli' al-nujuum fi wakithum walla-?Wa inta tagdar tuguud najmat al-Zaraafa wa nujuumha walla-?
Inta ta'arif nizaam al-sama walla-?Walla inta bas tinazzim gawaaniin al-ard-?
Inta tagdar taamur al-sahaab le yinazzil matar chadiidlahaddi almiih yikhattiik walla-?
Wa inta bas tirassil al-barraaga lahaddi hadafah walla-?Wa leek inta,humman yuguulu-:-Daahu aniina.
Yaatu anta hikma le abunkhanam-?Wa yaatu anta fihim le l-diik-?
Yaatu yagdar be hikmatahyahsib al-sahaab-?Wa yaatu yagdaryidangis makhaazin almi al-sama
achaan al-turaab yilimm bakaan waahidwa daraadim al-tiine yillassago-?
Wa yaatu yagnus le yi'akkil al-duudwa yisill juu' iyaalah
wakit humman gaa'idiin fi nugrithumwa saakniin fi dungurhum-?
Wa yaatu yanti akil le l-khuraabwakit iyaalah yinaadu al-Rabb le l-faza'wa gaa'idiin wiheedhum bala akil-?
Inta ta'arif al-wakital-talda foogah al-khazaal walla-?Wa inta chift tees al-hajarwakit yalda walla-?
Wa ta'arif tahsib chuhuur waaluudithumwa l-wakit al-yaldo foogah walla-?
Humman yaburkuwa yaldo iyaalhumwa khalaas,yinjammomin waja' al-waaluuda.
Wa iyaalhum yakburuwa yabgo chudaadwa yiba''udu min ammahaathumwa battaan ma yigabbulu.
Yaatu anta al-hurriiye le humaar al-kadaade-?Wa hal fi naadum halla rubaatah-?
Hu bas al-ana sakkantah fi l-kadaadewa maskanah fi l-ard al-indaha mileh.
Wa hu yichchammat le harakat al-madiinawa ma yidoor yasma' hiss hana siid.
Wa yuruukh fi raas al-jibaal le yarta'wa yifattich al-gechch al-akhdar.
Al-jaamuus yikhassid yakhdim leekwa yaakul ma'a bahaaymak walla-?
Wa tagdar tarbut leyah harraata le yahrit leek walla-?Wa hu yukurr al-harraata waraak walla-?
Wa inta titwakkal aleyah achaan gudurtah al-chadiidewa tikhalli leyah kulla khidimtak walla-?
Hal hu yagdar yijiib leek intaajakwa yilimmah fi l-madagg walla-?
Janaahe al-na'aam yilmattato be suhuulawa laakin ma indah riich wa la suuf abunkhanam.
Al-na'aamaay talda beedhawa tikhalliih fi l-turaabwa hamu al-turaab yifaggi'ah.
Hi tansa kadar rijil insaan tikassirahaw rijil haywaan tafjakhah.
Hi jafiiye le iyaalha misil ma hineehawa ma lammaaha kan ta'abha yamchi fi l-riih saakit kula.
Achaan al-Rabb ma antaaha hikmawa hi ma ligat gisimha hana l-ma'rafa.
Wa laakin wakit hi tugumm wa tajri,tichchammat le l-juwaad wa siidah.
Ya Ayyuub,inta tagdar tanti al-gudra le l-juwaadwa tikhatti ragabatah be safiife walla-?
Tinattitah misil jaraad walla-?La-!Hanhiniinah al-chadiid bikhawwif.
Wa fi l-waadi,hu yudugg rijileenah.Hu farhaan be gudurtah,yamrug giddaam al-adu.
Yichchammat le l-khoof wa ma yinbahitwa ma yi'arrid min al-duwaas.
Foogah tinsami' harakat al-kalootawa l-harba al-tiraari wa l-tabiig.
Al-juwaad yinattitmin chiddit niiytah le l-jariwa ma yagdar yasburwakit yasma' al-buug.
Ayyi wakit al-buug yadrub,hu yihanhin wa yuguul-:-Aywa-!-Min ba'iid,hu yuchumm al-haribwa yasma' huraaj al-kubaaraat wa korooraak al-harib.
Hal be sabab irfitak inta bas,al-sagur yimidd janaaheehwa yitiir ale l-junuub walla-?
Hal be amrak inta bas,al-sagur yisawwi uchchah fi l-a'aali walla-?
Hu yaskun wa yunuum fi l-jibaal,aywa,fi bakaan gawi fi raas al-jibaal.
Min al-bakaan da,yiraakhib fariistahwa min ba'iid,uyuunah yichiifuuha.
Iyaalah yaakulu al-dammwa fi ayyi rimme,hu yinlagi.
Wa Allah hajja battaan le Ayyuub wa gaal-:
Al-yikhaasimyichaari' ma'a l-Gaadir walla-?Wa l-yachki al-Rabbyuguul leyah chunu-?
Wa Ayyuub radda le Allah wa gaal-:
Ana al-ma nisaawi cheyy,nagdar nurudd leek walla-?La-!Nisidd khachmi.
Ana hajjeet marra,battaan ma nurudd.Hajjeet marrateenwa ma niziid cheyy.
Wa Allah hajja battaan le Ayyuub min lubb al-riih al-chadiide wa gaal-:
Arbut sulbak misil raajil fahal-!Ana nas'alak wa inta,turudd leyi.
Inta tidoor tibattil charii'ti walla-?Wa tidoor tisawwiini khaati achaan tibarri nafsak walla-?
Inta indak gudra misil gudurti ana al-Rabb walla-?Wa hissak misil ra'ad yichaabih hissi walla-?
Kan misil da,jammil nafsak be majd wa kibriyawa albas al-azama wa l-charaf.
Be mooj khadabak,khatti kulla l-naaswa be nazra waahide,nazzil al-mustakbiriin-!
Chiif kulla l-mustakbiriin wa dangirhumwa fi bakaanhum da bas,dammirhum-!
Adfinhum kulluhum fi l-turaabwa asjinhum fi l-khubuur-!
Wa be da,khalaas ana zaati nafrah beekachaan iidak al-zeene najjatak-!
Daahu Bahimoot al-ana khalagtah misil khalagtak inta.Hu yaakul gechch misil toor.
Gudurtah fi sulbahwa khuwwatah fi asab batnah.
Hu yiwaggif danabah foog misil uud al-arzwa asab dawaarjah madfuur.
Udaamah misil hawaadir hana nahaaswa sufaafah misil hadiid.
Hu amal al-muhimmal-sawwaah al-Rabbwa ma fi al-yinnasir foogahilla hu al-khalagah.
Wa ma'aachah yaji leyah min al-jibaalwa da l-bakaan al-yilimmu foogahkulla haywaanaat al-kadaade.
Bahimoot da yargud tihit al-tibinwa yillabbad tihit ageeg margad almi.
Al-tibin yikhattiih be dullahwa gana al-wudyaan yihawwigah.
Kan almi jaari chadiid kula,ma yikhawwifahwa kan bahar al-Urdun yajri be chidde fi khachmah kula,hu ma lammaah.
Hal naadum yagdar yakurbahmin giddaam walla-?Aw yarmiih fi l-charakwa yigidd munkharah walla-?
Hal tagdar takrub Luyaataan be jambaatwa tarbut lisaanah be habil walla-?
Hal tagdar tidiss habil fi munkharahwa tigidd chidgah be jambaat kabiir walla-?
Hal hu yagdar yachhadakwa yihajji leek kalaam halu walla-?
Wa yisawwi ma'aak alaakha walla-?Inta tagdar ti'abbidah le muddit hayaatah walla-?
Hal tagdar tal'ab ma'aayah misil teeraaywa tarbutah le banaatak yal'aban beyah walla-?
Hal al-muchtarikiin yukhuttuuh le l-bee'wa yigassumuuh ambeenaat al-tujjaar walla-?
Hal tagdar tita''in farwitah be huraabwa raasah be kookaab walla-?
Wa laakin kan dawwart takurbah be iidak,tizzakkar fahaaliiytahwa battaan ma tilammisah.
Giddaamah,ayyi naadum achamah yingati'wa l-yichiifah,al-khoof yakurbah.
Wa ma fi naadum yagdar yujukhkhah.Wa kan misil da,yaatu yagdar yagiif giddaami ana al-Rabb-?
Yaatu dayyanaani cheyyle nigabbilah leyah-?Achaan kulla cheyy al-gaa'id tihit al-sama hanaayi ana-!
Ana ma naskut fi chaan Luyaataanwa nikallim be iideenah wa rijileenahwa gudurtah al-aziime wa chaklah al-jamiil.
Yaatu yagdar yaslakh farwitah-?Wa yaatu yadkhul ambeenaat sawaalfah-?
Wa yaatu yagdar yaftah khachmah-?Achaan sunuunah zaatah bikhawwufu.
Wa daharah mukhattabe riigaan hana daragal-mulassagiin be nizaam.
Al-waahid mulassag ma'a l-aakharlahaddi riih kula ma tufuut ambeenaathum.
Humman marbuutiin al-waahid ma'a l-aakharwa lammiin ambeenaathum ma yinfargu.
Wakit yi'attich,yamrug minnah nuurwa uyuunah yiraarumisil nuur al-sabaah.
Wa deyy yamrug min khachmahwa charaar al-naar yamrug minnah.
Wa dukhkhaan yamrug min munkharahmisil bookh al-burma al-hajjo naarha.
Wa nafasah yigabbid naarwa ambalbaala tamrug min khachmah.
Wa l-gudra gaa'ide fi ragabatahwa l-khoof yajri giddaamah.
Jildah mutabbag wa mulassag ambeenaatahwa gaa'id foogah gawi ma yilharrak.
Galbah gawi misil al-hajarwa gawi misil al-murhaaka.
Giddaam azamatah,al-kubaaraat yakrubhum al-khoofwa min chiddit al-barjaal,yi'arrudu.
Wa l-yigarrib leyah,seefah ma yanfa'ahwa haribtah wa tabiigahwa dir'ah kula ma yanfa'ooh.
Aywa-!Luyaataan yaj'al al-hadiid misil al-ageegwa l-nahaas misil uud al-musawwis.
Al-nuchchaab ma yaturdahwa hujaar al-miglaa' leyah misil ageeg.
Hu yaj'al al-asa misil ageegaaywa yichchammat le suffaarit al-harba wakit tufuut.
Farwit batnah misil musmaar tariinwa derbah fi l-tiine misil derib al-harraata.
Wa yiharrik al-almi misil gaa'id yufuurwa l-almi yilkhayyar wa yabga rikhwe.
Wa yikhalli waraayah derib waadihwa almi al-khariig yabga abyad misil suuf al-chaayib.
Khalaas fi l-ard,ma fi mislahwa hu makhluug bala khoof.
Wa yahgirkulla l-makhluugiin al-mutakabbiriinwa hu malikfoog kulla l-haywaanaat al-fasliin.
Wa khalaas,Ayyuub radda le Allah wa gaal-:
Ana na'arifinta tagdar tisawwi kulla cheyywa ma fi waahide min afkaarakal-ma tilhaggag.
Inta sa'altini wa gult-:-Yaatu al-ma yikhalli niiyti tabga waadhe bala ma'rafa-?-Sahiih,ana bala fihim gult achya ajiibiinal-yufuutuuni wa ma na'arifhum.
Inta sa'altini wa gult-:-Asma'ni,ana nikallim leekwa nas'alak wa inta turudd leyi.
Ana simi'tak be adaaniwa chiftak be eeni.
Fi chaan da,ana nidimt le kalaami wa tubtwa sabbeet fi raasi turaab wa rumaad.
Wa ba'ad Allah gaal al-kalaam da le Ayyuub,hu wajjah kalaamah le Alifaaz min balad Teemaan wa gaal-:-Khadabi bigi chadiid diddak inta wa didd rufgaanak al-itneen achaan intu ma hajjeetu beyi be kalaam sahiih misil kalaam abdi Ayyuub.
Wa be sabab da,chiilu sab'a toor wa sab'a kabich wa amchu algooh le abdi Ayyuub wa gaddumu al-bahaayim dool dahiiye muharraga.Wa abdi Ayyuub yas'al leeku.Wa fi chaanah hu bas,ana ma nisawwi foogku hasab tamaasitku.Wa intu ma hajjeetu beyi be kalaam sahiih misil kalaam abdi Ayyuub.
Wa khalaas,Alifaaz min balad Teemaan wa Bildad min Chuuha wa Suufar min Na'ama macho wa sawwo misil Allah al-Rabb amaraahum beyah.Wa Allah khibil su'aal Ayyuub.
Wa wakit Ayyuub sa'al Allah fi chaan rufgaanah,Allah gabbal leyah kulla khumaamah misil awwal da,marrateen.
Wa kulla akhwaanah wa akhwaatah wa naas ma'rafatah al-zamaan jo zaarooh.Humman akalo ma'aayah fi beetah wa hanno foogah wa kaffaro leyah min kulla l-bala al-nazzalah foogah Allah.Wa ayyi waahid minhum antaah le Ayyuub hajar fudda wa khaatim hana dahab.
Wa Allah baarak al-siniin al-akhiiriin hana Ayyuub ziyaada min siniinah al-awwal wa hu ligi 14-000 khanam wa 6-000 jumaal wa 2-000 jooz hana bagar wa 1-000 hamiir anaati.
Wa battaan wilid wa jaab sab'a awlaad wa talaata banaat.
Al-awwal sammaaha Yamiima wa l-taani sammaaha Khasii'a wa l-taalit sammaaha Garn Hafuuk.
Wa fi kulla l-balad,ma fi awiin jamiilaat misil banaat Ayyuub wa abuuhin antaahin warasa ma'a akhwaanhin.
Wa ba'ad da,Ayyuub aach 140 sana wa hu chaaf iyaalah wa iyaal iyaalah lahaddi l-zurriiye al-raab'e.
Wa wakit bigi chaayib wa chibi' min al-dunya,hu maat.
Mabruuk le l-naadum al-ma yitaabi' wasiiyat al-hawaaniinwa ma yichiil tariig al-muznibiinwa ma yagood ma'a l-chammaatiin.
Laakin be Tawraat Allah yafrahwa be l-Tawraat,leel wa nahaar yamdah.
Hu misil chadara al-gaayme fi khachum al-baharwa talda fi wakitha wa warchaalha daayman akhdar.Wa hu yanjah fi kulla cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Wa laakin al-naas al-hawaaniin ma misil da.Humman misil al-uttaab al-tichiilah al-riih.
Wa misil da,al-hawaaniin ma yuguulu cheyy giddaam al-charii'awa l-muznibiin ma yagoodu ma'a mujtama' al-saalihiin.
Achaan tariig al-saalihiin,Allah yahfadahwa laakin tariig al-hawaaniin,fi l-dalaam yiwaddirah.
Maala al-umam atmarrado-?Wa maala al-chu'uub yil'aamaro fi l-ma indah faayde-?
Maala muluuk al-ard yijahhuzu le l-harib-?Wa maala al-salaatiin yichchaawaro didd Allahwa didd al-hu masahah wa darrajah malik-?
Wa gaalo-:-Yalla-!Nihillu minnina guyuudhumwa nidaffugu minnina janaaziirhum.
Wa l-gaa'id fi l-arch fi l-samaawaat yadhak,al-Rabb yichchammat leehum.
Wa yihajji leehum be za'alwa be khadabah,yirajjifhum.
Wa yuguul-:-Ana Allah darrajt al-malik al-nidoorahfi jabali Sahyuun al-mukhaddas.
Wa niballikh kharaar Allah al-buguul-:-Inta ibni wa l-yoom,ana bigiit abuuk.
Atlub minni al-umam wa nantiihum leek warasawa tamluk fi kulla l-ard.
Wa tahkim fooghum be muluk chadiidwa tikassirhum misil jiraar al-tiine.
Wa hassa',ya l-muluuk,abgo faahimiin.Angar'u,intu hukkaam al-ard-!
Akhdumu le Allah be khoofwa afraho giddaamah wa asjudu.
Karrumu ibnah,al-malik al-hu azalahwa be da,Allah ma yaz'al foogku.Wa za'alah ma yidammirkuachaan hu gariib yaz'al foogku.Mabruuk le l-naas al-yalja'o le Allah-!
Ya Allah-!Katiiriin udwaaniwa katiiriin yugummu diddi.
Wa katiiriin yuguulu foogi-:-Ma fi naja leyah min al-Rabb-!Wagfa.
Wa laakin,ya Allah,inta daragati,inta azamati wa tarfa' raasi.
Ninaadi Allah be hiss aaliwa min jabalah al-mukhaddas,hu yurudd leyi.Wagfa.
Ana nargud wa nunuum wa nugummachaan Allah saa'adni.

Ya Allah,gumm-!Najjiini,ya Ilaahi-!Chaddig kulla udwaaniwa kassir sunuun al-aasiyiin-!
Minnak inta,ya Allah,taji al-naja.Khalli barakatak tukuun fi cha'abak.Wagfa.
Wakit ninaadi,rudd leyi,ya Ilaah al-Aadil-!Wa fi l-diige,sahhil leyiwa be rahmatak,asma' salaati.
Ya l-naas-!Le mata tibaddulu charafi be eebwa tihibbu al-ma indah faaydewa tajru wara l-kidib-?Wagfa.
A'arfu kadar Allah azal raajil amiin leyah,aywa,Allah yasma'ni wakit ninaadiih.
Az'alo laakin ma taznubuwa wakit tarugdu fi saraayirku,fakkuru adiil wa khalaas,askutu.Wagfa.
Gaddumu dahaaya al-muwaafgiinwa atwakkalo ale Allah.
Katiiriin yuguulu-:-Ma fi al-yichawwifna al-kheer.-Ya Allah,wajjih nuur wijhak aleena-!
Inta maleet galbi be l-farahziyaada min farahhumwakit induhum gameh wa khamar be katara.
Wakit nargud,nunuum be salaamachaan inta wiheedak bas,ya Allah,tisakkinni be amaan.

Ya Allah,kulli fajur asma' hissi-!Wa fi kulli fajur,ana nijahhiz wa narjaak.
Achaan inta Ilaah al-ma tarda be l-charrwa ma takhbal al-fasaala.
Al-mutakabbiriin ma yagiifu fi hadaratakwa inta takrah kulla l-yisawwu al-zulum.
Ya Allah-!Inta tidammir al-kaddaabiinwa kattaaliin al-dimam wa l-khachchaachiin,taj'alhum misil muharramiin.
Wa laakin be rahmatak al-kabiire,ana nadkhul fi fadaayit beetak.Wa be makhaafatak,nasjud ale beetak al-mukhaddas.
Ya Allah-!Guudni hasab adaaltakbe sabab udwaaniwa sahhil leyi derbak.
Achaan ma fi cheyy akiid fi kalaamhumwa guluubhum malaaniin be damaarwa kalaam khuchuumhum yiwaddi le l-khabur.Wa lisneehum malaaniin be kalaam halu khachchaach.
Ya Rabb-!Aj'alhum khaatiyiinwa khalliihum yaga'o be sabab mu'aamarathum-!Atrudhum be sabab jaraayimhum al-katiiriinachaan humman isook.

Ya Allah-!Ahdiini bala za'alwa addibni bala khadab-!
Arhamni,ya Allah,achaan ana ma indi gudra.Achfiini,ya Allah,achaan udaami maa'o.
Ana ninbahit ziyaada min daakhal galbi.Wa da le mata,ya Allah-?
Ta'aal,ya Allah-!Khallisniwa be rahmatak,najjiini-!
Achaan al-yumuutu ma yizzakkaro usmakwa fi l-khabur,yaatu yachkurak-?
Ana iyiit min chiddit al-ganitiinwa dumuu'i yuruchchu furaachiwa kulli leele,yibillu sariiri.

Achaan ana khaayif yadurbuuni misil al-diidaanwa yigattu'u jismi wa ma fi naadum al-yikhallisni.
Ya Allah Ilaahi,kan ana sawweet cheyy fasilaw sawweet jariime be iideeni
aw sawweet al-fasaala le siid zeeniaw bala sabab nahabt khasiimi,
khalaas,khalli al-adu yitaaridni wa yakrubniwa fi l-ard,yifajjikhniwa fi l-turaab,yarmi charafi.Wagfa.
Gumm,ya Allah,wa akhdab-!Gumm didd za'al al-khusmaani-!Inta al-amart be l-adil,fakkir foogi-!

Ya Allah,inta al-tichaari' al-chu'uub-!Ya Allah,chaari'ni hasab adaalti wa kamaali.
Waggif fasaalit al-aasiyiin-!Wa sabbit naas al-saalihiin-!Ya l-Ilaah al-saadikh-!Inta al-takchif al-galibwa fikir al-insaan.
Al-Rabb hu daragatiwa munajji al-saalihiin.
Allah Al-Rabb hu gaadi saadikhwa yiwassif khadabah kulla yoom.
Wa kan al-insaan ma yutuub,Allah yitarrig seefahwa yajbid nubbaalah wa yisawwibah.
Wa yijahhiz silaah al-mootwa yisawwi nachaachiib al-yiharrugu.

Ya Allah-!Ya Rabbina-!Usmak aziim fi kulla l-ard-!Inta wassaft majdak foog fi l-sama.
Al-atfaal wa l-barda'o majjadowa be majjidiinhum,inta hazamt aduukle tisakkit khusmaanak-!
Wakit ana chift khaliigit samaawaatakwa l-gamar wa katarat nujuumak,
ana gult fi nafsi chunu al-insaanwa maala tifakkir foogah-?Wa Bani Adam,hu chunuwa maala tihimm beyah-?
Laakin inta sawweetah tihit min al-malaa'ikawa anteetah azama wa charaf.

Ya Allah-!Ya Rabbina-!Usmak aziim fi kulla l-ard-!
Ya Allah,ana nachkurak be kulla galbiwa nihajji be kulla ajaaybak.
Nafrah beek wa ninbasitwa nikhanni be usmak,ya Allah al-Aali-!
Wakit udwaani yi'arrudu,humman yittarta'owa yiddammaro giddaamak.
Achaan inta chilt daliimtiwa daafa't le huguugi.Inta gaa'id fi archakwa tahkim be l-adil.
Inta haddadt al-umamwa dammart al-aasiyiin.Wa gachcheet usumhumdaayman wa ila l-abad.
Al-adu bigi ma fiihwa kharaabhum bigi daayim.Wa l-mudun al-inta dammartuhum,battaan ma yizzakkaroohum.
Laakin Allah gaa'id ila l-abadwa sabbat archah le yichaari'.

Khalaas-!Ana kula nadhakwakit taga' foogku al-masiibewa nichchammatwakit yaji foogku al-khoof.
Wa da,wakt al-khoof yaga' foogkumisil al-riih al-chadiidewa wakit al-masiibe taji foogkumisil al-zooba'aanewa wakit yaji foogkual-ta'ab wa l-diige.

Ana chilt niiye be kulla galbile nifattich wa nakchifal-hikma wa l-agulwa le na'arif al-fasaala hi al-tamaasawa tamaasa hi al-jahaala.
Wa ana ligiit cheyy waahid murr min al-mootwa di mara al-misil al-charak.Galibha misil amkajjaamawa iideenha misil janaaziir.Al-yakhaaf min al-Rabb yanja minhawa laakin al-muznib yaga' fi charakha.
Al-Mu'allim gaal-:Daahu al-cheyy al-ana ligiitah.Ana fakkart fi l-achya doolal-waahid ba'ad al-aakharle na'arif ma'anaathum.
Ana fattacht battaan wa ma ligiit.Ana ligiit raajil waahid bas fi ust al-alifal-ana nagdar nisammiih raajil.Wa laakin fi usut kulla l-awiin,ma ligiit waahide al-ana nikarrimha.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-ana ligiitah.Al-Rabb khalag kulla l-insaan adiilwa laakin humman yifattuchu machaakil be katara.
Yaatu hakiim-?Wa yaatu al-yagdar yifassir al-kalaam da-?Al-hikma tidawwi wijh al-insaanwa khalaas,yatlig wijhah al-karabah.
Kan leyi ana,nuguul-:fi chaan al-haliife al-inta sawweetha giddaam al-Rabb.
Ma tissa'jal wa taaba sultitahwa la tagiif didd kalaamahhatta kan hawaan kula.Achaan al-malik yisawwi kulla cheyyal-hu yidoorah.
Kan hu yuguul chunu kula,hu bas al-malik-!Wa kan misil da,yaatu yagdar yuguul leyah-:-Inta tisawwi chunu-?
Al-yitabbig amur al-malikma yichiif minnah ayyi fasaala.Wa l-hakiim ya'arif al-wakit al-munaasibwa kikkeef tukuun al-charii'a.
Achaan le kulla cheyy fi wakit munaasibwa fi wakit le l-charii'a.Aywa,fasaalit al-insaantabga khatiire leyah hu.
Achaan hu ma ya'arifal-cheyy al-yukuun.Wa yaatu yagdar yuguul leyahyabga misil da walla da-?
Ma fi ayyi insaan yagdar yakrub ruuhahwa la insaan al-indah gudra fi yoom mootah.Ma fi insaan indah hagg yamrug min al-haribwa l-fasaala ma yinajji siidha.
Wa kulla l-cheyy da,ana chiftahwakit fakkart fi kulla l-khidmeal-gaa'ide tukuun fi l-ard.Fi wakit al-foogah al-insaan yamluk fi l-insaanle yisawwi leyah al-fasaala.
Wa misil da,ana chiftal-fasliin dafanoohum fi l-khubuur be charaf.Wa awwal humman yamchu wa yajumin al-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Laakin fi l-madiina di,al-naas nisoohum.Wa da kula zaayil saakit.
Al-ikhaab ma yinnaffaz ajalafi l-amal al-fasil.Wa be da,galb al-insaan fi daakhilahmalaan be niiye hana sawwiyiin al-fasaala.
Al-muznib yagdar yisawwi al-amal al-fasil alif marrawa yi'iich yitawwil.Wa laakin be da kula,ana na'arifkadar al-insaan al-yakhaaf min al-Rabbyalga al-kheerachaan hu khaayif giddaamah.
Laakin al-fasil ma yalga kheerwa ayyaam hayaatahyufuutu misil al-dullachaan hu ma khaayif giddaam al-Rabb.
Fi l-ard,fiyah cheyy al-zaayil saakitwa daahu al-cheyy da.Fi naas saalihiin,yi'aamuluuhummisil yi'aamulu al-fasliin.Wa fi naas fasliin,yi'aamuluuhummisil yi'aamulu al-saalihiin.Wa ana gult battaan-:-Da kula zaayil saakit.
Khalli al-naas yi'iichu be farahachaan akheer le l-insaanyalga al-akil wa l-charaab wa l-farah.Wa da yukuun ma'aayah fi khidimtahfi kulla ayyaam hayaatah fi l-ardal-antaaha leyah al-Rabb.
Ana chilt niiye le na'arif al-hikmawa nichiif al-chakhalaal-gaa'ide tukuun fi l-ard.Achaan een al-insaan ma tunuumwa la leel wa la nahaar.
Wa ana chift kulla amal al-Rabb.Wa l-insaan ma yagdar ya'arifal-amal al-gaa'id yukuun fi l-ard.Wa kan al-insaan yifattichah be ta'ab kula,ma yalgaah.Hatta kan al-hakiim yuguul ya'arfah kula,hu ma yagdar ya'arif cheyy-!
Aywa,ana fakkart fi kulla l-achya doolwa fihimt kadar al-saalihiin wa l-hakiimiinwa khidmithum kulluhum fi iid al-Rabb.Al-insaan ma ya'arifkan yalga al-mahabbaaw al-karaahiiye.Aywa,hu ma ya'arifal-cheyy al-yarjaah-!
Kulla cheyy yukuunle kulla l-naas.Nafs al-cheyy yukuunle l-saalih wa l-fasilwa le l-adiil wa l-taahir wa l-nijiswa le l-naadum al-yigaddim al-dahiiyewa le l-naadum al-ma yigaddimha.Aywa,nafs al-cheyy yukuun le l-adiilmisil le l-muznibwa le l-yahlifmisil le l-yakhaaf min al-haliife.
Wa daahu al-fasaala al-gaa'ide tukuun fi l-ard.Nafs al-cheyy yarja kulla l-naas.Wa guluub al-naas malaaniin be l-fasaala wa l-jahal kula gaa'id fi kulla muddit hayaathum.Wa ba'ad da,al-moot gaa'id yarjaahum.
Laakin kulla l-hayyiininduhum acham.Al-masal buguul-:-Al-kalib al-hayyakheer min al-duud al-mayyit.
Achaan al-hayyiin ya'arfukadar yoom waahid yumuutu.Laakin al-maytiinma ya'arfu cheyy.Humman ma yalgo ayyi ajurwa battaan ma yizzakkaroohum.
Wa mahabbithum wa karaahiiyithum wa husudhumwaddaro khalaas.Wa battaan ma induhum gisim ila l-abadfi kulla cheyy al-yabga fi l-ard.
Wa be da,aakulwa achrab khamarak be farah.Achaan da bas al-amalal-yarda beyah al-Rabb.
Wa fi kulla wakit,albas khalag mukallafwa khalli ma yigassir leek al-dihinal-yamsahooh fi l-raas.
Afrah be hayaatak ma'a martakal-tihibbahafi kulla ayyaam hayaatakal-antaahum leek al-Rabb.Wa dool al-ayyaamal-zaayliin saakit fi l-ard.Achaan da gismak al-talgaahfi kulla muddit hayaatakwa fi khidimtak al-tisawwiiha fi l-ard.
Ayyi cheyy al-tisawwiih,sawwiih be kulla gudurtak.Achaan ma fi khibra wa la ma'rafawa la hikma fi l-khabur,al-bakaan al-inta maachi leyah.
Wa battaan ana chift fi l-ardal-sabag ma daayman le l-ajiiliinwa l-nasur ma daayman le l-furraaswa l-iiche al-haluuwe ma daayman le l-hakiimiinwa l-khuna ma daayman le l-faahimiinwa l-rahma ma daayman le l-induhum al-ma'rafa.Achaan kulla l-naasyiwaajuhu al-kheer wa l-charr.
Achaan al-insaan ma ya'arif yoomahmisil al-huut wa l-teeral-karaboohum fi l-charakwa yumuutu foogah.Wa misil da,le l-insaan kula,al-fasaala taga' foogah faj'atan.
Wa daahu ana chift fi l-ardmasal hana l-hikmaal-bigi leyi ajiib.
Fiyah hille waahide sakhayreal-indaha rujaal chiyya.Wa malik waahid gaadir gamma didd al-hille diwa hawwagha be durdur le yihaasirha.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid miskiin wa hakiimwa hu najja al-hille di be hikmatah.Laakin ba'adeen,ma fi naadum azzakkaral-miskiin da.
Wa khalaas,ana gult-:-Al-hikma akheer min al-fahaaliiye.Wa laakin hikmat al-miskiin da,al-naas hagaroohawa ma sim'o kalaamah.
Kalaam haadi hana l-hakiimiinakheer min awwit al-malik le l-mataamiis.
Al-hikma akheermin silaah al-harib.Wa laakin al-khaltaanyagdar yidammir kheer katiir.
Al-dubbaan al-mayyityihammid wa yi'affinal-dihin hana siid al-itir.Wa misil da,chiyya min al-tamaasatitallif al-hikma wa l-charaf.
Galb al-hakiimyimayyil ale l-tariig al-adiilwa galb al-matmuusyimayyil ale l-tariig al-a'waj.
Wa wakit al-matmuus yamchi fi l-derib,yin'arif kadar hu ma indah fihimwa yiwassif le l-naaskadar fikrah mahduud.
Wakit al-malik yaz'al diddak,angari',ma tikhalli bakaanak.Agood haadiwa da yinajjiik min zunuub katiir.
Fiyah fasaala ana chiftaha fi l-ardwa l-fasaala di,hi khata jaayi min al-malik.
Al-mataamiis yukhuttuuhumfi bakaan aali ziyaadawa l-khaniyiin yukhuttuuhumfi bakaan tihit.
Ana chift battaan abiid raakbiin fi kheelwa masaa'iil maachiin be rijleehum misil abiid.
Al-yankut nugra,akuun yaga' fooghawa l-yisawwi khurma,akuun daabi yi'addiih.
Al-yagta' al-hajar,akuun yinjarihwa l-yichaggig al-hatab,yadkhul fi l-khatar.
Al-faas kan kaalle wa ma tarragooha,waajib gudra ziyaada fi isti'maalha.Khalaas,faaydit al-hikmahi al-najaah.
Kan naadum ya'arif yihaddi al-daabiwa l-daabi yi'addiih,chunu al-faayde al-yalgaaha-?
Wakit al-hakiim yihajji,kalaamah ya'ajib al-naaswa laakin lisaan al-matmuusyiwaddirah.
Kalaamah fi l-bidaaya hu tamaasawa fi l-nihaaya hu jahaala wa charr.
Al-naadum al-fikrah mahduud,yikattir kalaamah.Wa l-insaan ma ya'arif al-yukuunwa yaatu al-yikhabbirahbe l-yukuun ba'ad mootah-?
Khidmit al-matmuus ti'ayyiihlahaddi ma ya'arif deribal-yiwaddiih le l-madiina-!
Al-azaab le l-balad al-malikha sabiwa kubaaraatha yaakulu tuul al-yoom-!
Mabruuk le l-balad al-malikha min iyaal al-chuyuukhwa kubaaraatha yaakulu fi wakit munaasible yalgo gudra bala sakar-!
Fi wakt al-kasal,raas al-beet yaga'wa wakt al-iide yinrakhu,al-beet yinaggit.
Al-naas yisawwu akil le yadhakowa l-khamar le yifarruhu hayaathum.Wa laakin be l-gurus,yalgo kulla cheyy.
Ma tal'an al-malikhatta fi daakhal galbak kulawa fi beetak wiheedak,ma tal'an al-khani.Achaan al-teeraay tiwaddi al-khabarwa tihajji be l-cheyy al-inta gultah.
Armi khubzitak fi l-almiachaan yoom waahid talgaaha.
Gassim maalakale sab'a aw tamaane bakaanachaan inta ma ta'arif al-fasaalaal-taji fi l-ard.
Wakit al-sahaab yichiil almi,al-matara tusubb fi l-ard.Wa kan chadara waga'atale l-wati aw ale l-munchaakh,fi bakaanha al-waga'at foogah da bas,hi tagood.
Al-harraati al-yichiif al-riihya'arif al-wakit al-ma waajib yiteerib.Wa l-harraati al-yichiif al-sahaabya'arif al-wakit al-ma waajib yagta'.
Misil inta ma ta'arif wijh al-riihwa kikkeef yilkawwano udaam al-sakhiir fi batun ammah,khalaas ma tagdar tafhamkikkeef al-Rabb yisawwi kulla cheyy.
Be fajur,teeribwa be achiiye,ma tinjamma.Achaan inta ma ta'arif weenu al-yanjah,da walla daak,walla kan al-itneen kulluhum adiiliin.
Nuur al-sabaah haluwa adiil le l-uyuun yichiifu al-harraay.
Kan naadum yi'iich siniin katiiriin,khalli yafrah be ayyi waahid minhum.Wa laakin khalli yizzakkarkadar ayyaam al-moot aktar.Wa kulla cheyy al-yaji zaayil saakit.
Ya l-sabi-!Afrah be ayyaam subaakwa khalli galbak yafrah be ayyaam chabaabak.Taabi' kalaam galbakwa l-yichiifuuh uyuunak.Laakin a'arif kadar fi kulla l-cheyy da,al-Rabb yihaasibak.
Ba''id al-hizin min galbakwa ba''id al-ta'ab min jismak.Achaan al-suba wa l-gudra zaayliin saakit.
Fi wakit chabaabak,azzakkarah,hu al-khalagaak.Azzakkarah gabul ayyaam al-diigema yajuukwa gabul ma yajuuk al-siniinal-fooghum inta tuguul-:-Hayaati ma indaha ta'am.
Azzakkarah gabul ma yidallumual-harraay wa l-nuurwa l-gamar wa l-nujuum kulawa gabul al-sahaab ma yigabbilba'ad al-matar.
Azzakkarah gabul al-haaris ma yarjif min al-khoofwa rujaal al-fahaliin ma yidanguruwa gabul awiin al-rahhaakaat al-ma katiiraat yiwaggifan al-rahiikwa l-yichiifan be chabaabiik ma yiwaddiran jamaalhin.
Azzakkarah gabul biibaan al-chawaari' abdalfiteen ma yinsaddowa harakat al-murhaaka ma tinsami'wa gabul ma tugumm wakit al-tuyuur yikhannuwa ya'ayan kulla l-khannaayaat.
Azzakkarah gabul ma takhaaf min al-aaliwa min ru'ub al-deribwa gabul chadarat al-looz ma tinawwirwa l-jaraad ma yisiir be tagalawa gabul al-chadara al-tiziid al-chahwa ma tafchulwa l-insaan ma yamchi le beetah al-abadiwa l-nawwaahaat ma yamchan fi l-chaari'.
Azzakkarah gabul al-haya ma tingati' misil habil al-fuddawa kharraaf al-dahab ma yingaddawa gabul al-jarr ma yilkassar fi l-hootwa l-jurra ma tinkasir wa taga' fi l-biir.
Azzakkarah gabul al-insaan ma yigabbilfi l-turaab al-khalagooh minnahwa gabul al-ruuh ma tigabbille l-Rabb al-khalagha.
Al-Mu'allim gaal-:-Al-haya zaayle-!Zaayle saakit-!Kulla cheyy zaayil-!
Al-Mu'allim ma hakiim bas,hu battaan allam al-ma'rafa le l-cha'ab.Hu kachaf be ma'rafa wa wazanwa nazzam adad kabiir hana amsaal.
Al-Mu'allim fattachle yalga kalaam al-ya'ajib.Wa katab kalaam da adiilwa da kalaam al-hagg.
Kalaam al-hakiimiin misil asaal-yusuugu beeha al-bahaayim.Wa mu'allifiin al-kutub gawiyiin misil masaamiiral-yutugguuhum wa yasbutu.Wa di hadiiye al-jaaye min raa'i waahid.
Wa l-faddal min al-kalaam da,khalli yabga leek daris,ya wileedi.Kitaabit al-kutub ma tikammilwa katarat al-giraay ti'ayyi al-jisim.
Wa fi l-akhiir,daahu nihaayat al-kalaam ansama'at.Akhaaf min al-Rabbwa ahfad wasiiyaatahachaan da l-waajib le ayyi insaan.
Achaan al-Rabb yihaasib kulla amal al-insaanhatta kan mulabbad kula,kan zeen walla fasil.
Al-khine al-aziim hana l-malik Suleymaan.
Hibbini-!Min fadlak,hibbini-!Achaan hubbak halu min asiir al-inab.
Itrak yinchamma haluwa usmak chattat misil riihit al-itir.Fi chaan da,al-banaat bihibbannak.
Chiilni ma'aak.Yalla najru-!Ya maliki,waddiini fi khurfitakwa hinaak,nal'abo wa nafraho sawa.Wa nizzakkaro hubbak al-halu min asiir al-inab.Al-bihibbannak indihin hagg-!
Ya banaat Madiinat al-Khudus,ana samra wa laakin jamiile,zarga misil khiyam al-sayyaarawa jamiile misil sitaarat beet Suleymaan.
Ma tichiifanni achaan ana samra.Di l-harraay bas galabat looni.Awlaad ammi zi'ilo diddiwa sawwooni haarisat jineenit inab.Wa laakin jismi al-misil jineenti,ana ma harastah.
Guul leyi,inta al-ana nihibbak,ween tisarrih khanamak-?Ween bakaan tigayyil foogah-?Wassifni achaan ma nifattich wa nuruuhwa naga' fi diiraan jiiraanak.
Ma ta'arfiih,inti al-ajmal min al-awiin-?Taab'i derib khanamahwa asrahe be inzeekijamb dara aniina al-ru'yaan.
Ya habiibti,inti misil faras arabat Fir'oon malik Masir.
Khuduudki jamiiliinambeenaat khuruuskiwa ragabatki samhafi usut ribig zaytuunki.
Nisawwu leeki khuruus hana dahabwa ziina hint fudda.
Wakit maliki gaa'id fi usut rufgaanah,riihit itri anchammat.
Habiibi misil bal'uumi hana sandal al-mu'allag fi ragabatiwa yargud fi sadri be l-leel.
Habiibi misil nuwwaar al-hinnefi jineenit inab fi Een Jidi.
Inti jamiile,ya habiibti.Aywa,inti jamiilewa uyuunki samhiinmisil al-hamaam.
Inta jamiil,ya habiibi.Inta kula halu.Wa narugdu fi goozna al-akhdar.
Narugdu tihit chadar al-arz misil chi'ab beetnawa tihit furuu' al-sarwi misil amadah.
Ana misil nuwwaar al-gechch fi sahalat Chaaruunwa misil zahra jamiile fi l-waadi.
Habiibti fi ust al-banaatmisil zahra jamiile fi lubb al-chook.
Habiibi fi ust al-subyaanmisil chadarat al-tuffaah fi lubb chadar al-khaaba.Fi dullah,niriid ninjammawa hu halu leyi misil fawaakih fi lisaani.
Hu waddaani fi beet al-aazuumawa khattaani be hubbah.
Akkuluuni be ka'ak al-inabwa azguuni be asiir al-tuffaahachaan ana miridt min katarat al-chahwa.
Iidah al-isra gaa'ide tihit raasiwa iidah al-zeene hadanatni.
Ya banaat Madiinat al-Khudus,nihallifkan be jamaal al-khuzlaanwa araayil al-kadaadekadar ma tigawwimanwa la tiwa''an al-hubb gabul waktah.
Asma'an,daahu habiibi jaayi.Yunutt min jabal le jabalwa min hajar le hajar.
Habiibi misil al-khazaalwa misil jidi al-aryal.Daahu waagif wara durdurna.Yichiifni be l-chubbaakwa yitaawigni be l-guduud.
Hu chaal al-kalaam wa gaal leyi-:-Gummi,ya habiibti al-jamiile,wa ta'aali leyi.
Achaan wakt al-seef kammalwa l-matar bada wa l-khariif ja.
Wa fi kulla l-balad,al-nuwwaar baanwa wakt al-khine ja.Wa hiss al-gimri ansama'fi kulla l-balad.
Chadar al-tiin rama iyaalahwa nuwwaar al-inab anchamma.Gummi,ya habiibti al-jamiile,wa ta'aali leyi.
Ya hamaamti,al-mullabbidefi karaakiir al-jibaalwa fi juruuf al-hujaar.Wassifi leyi wijihkiwa khalli nasma' hissikiachaan hissiki haluwa wijihki jamiil.
Aturdu leena al-ba'aachiim,aywa,al-ba'aachiim al-yitallufu al-inabachaan chadar inabna nawwar.
Habiibi,ana leyah hu wa hu leyi ana.Wa hu saarih be khanamah fi l-nuwwaar.
Wa gabul buruudit al-leelwa wakit al-dalaam yisidd,gabbil,ya habiibi,wa ta'aal leyi.Abga misil al-khazaalwa misil jidi al-aryalfi juruuf al-jibaal.
Wa be l-leel,fi sariiri,ana fattacht al-galbi biriidah,ana fattachtah wa ma ligiitah.
Ana gammeet wa hawwagt al-madiinafi l-chawaari' wa fi ayyi bakaan.Ana fattacht al-galbi biriidah,ana fattachtah wa ma ligiitah.
Wa l-hurraas al-buruukhu al-hillebe l-leel ligooniwa ana gult-:-Ma chiftu al-galbi biriidah-?
Wa min futt minhum,ana ligiit al-galbi biriidah.Hadantah wa ma khalleetahlahaddi waddeetah fi hooch ammiwa dakhkhaltah fi beet hana l-wildatnilahaddi fi l-khurfa.
Yaatu al-jaayi min al-saharawa ajaajah misil dukhkhaan al-taali'-?Yaatu al-mu'attar be sandal wa lubaanwa be kulla dukhkhaan al-tujjaar-?
Aywa,da Suleymaan al-raakibfi baasuur utfitah.Muhawwigiinah 60 rujaal furraasmin ahsan furraas Bani Israa'iil.
Kulluhum chaayliin suyuufwa humman naas muhaaribiin.Ayyi waahid seefah fi sulbahjaahiz le ayyi khatar al-yaji be l-leel.
Al-malik Suleymaan indah utfaal-sawwooha be hatab Lubnaan.
Wa amadha mujammaliin be fuddawa baasuurha be dahab.Wa furaachha loonah garadiwa banaat Madiinat al-Khudus addalan daakhilhawa jammalannah be mahabba.
Amurgan,ya banaat Sahyuun-!Ta'aalan chiifan al-malik Suleymaan-!Indah taaj al-ammah khattatah leyah fi yoom ariisahwa da yoom al-farah mala galbah.
Inti jamiile,ya habiibti,inti jamiile.Wa uyuunki misil al-hamaamkhaadi le laffaahitki.Wa cha'arki misil danab al-farasal-naazle min jabal Gil'aad.
Wa sunuunki buyudmisil laban al-khanamwa misil al-riheew al-barradah al-matar.Ayyi sinn be gabiilitha,ma fi waahide kula waga'at.
Wa chalaaliifki zurug misil al-kheet al-azragwa khachumki jamiil.Wa khuduudki misil al-rummaanaatkhaadi le laffaahitki.
Wa ragabatki tawiilemisil beet al-muraakhaba hana Dawuud.Wa ziinitha tichaabih al-alif daragal-mu'allagiin fi l-beet daroog ba'ad roog.

Inti kulliki jamiile,ya habiibti,ma indiki ayyi eeb.
Ta'aali ma'aayi min Lubnaan,ya aruusi.Dalli ma'aayi min jibaalha.Anzili min raas jabal al-Amaanawa min raas jabal Saniir wa Harmuun,bakaan dungur al-diidaanwa margad al-numuura.
Inti malakti galbi,ya akhti,ya aruusi.Inti malakti galbi be nazra waahidewa be zaytuunaay waahide min ribigki.
Hubbiki halu,ya akhti,ya aruusi.Hubbiki halu min asiir al-inab-!Wa riihitki haluuwemin kulla itir al-dunya.
Wa chalaaliifki haluwiin min al-asal,ya aruusi,wa lisaanki indah asal wa laban.Wa riihit khulgaankimisil sandal Lubnaan.
Inti jineene mazruuba,ya akhti,ya aruusi.Inti biir magfuulawa een almi makhtuuma.
Wa nabaat jineenitki rummaanal-fawaakihah haluwiin.Wa fi jineenitki fiyah nabaataat hana dukhkhaanmisil al-hinne wa l-naardiin.
Aywa,fi naardiin wa za'faraanwa dufur wa girfawa samukh lubaanwa hatab sandal wa gamaariwa kulla dukhkhaan al-riihtah haluuwe.
Wa fiyah een almi fi lubb al-jineene diwa hi biir almi al-saafial-yisiil min jibaal Lubnaan.
Gummi,inti riih al-munchaakh.Ta'aali,inti riih al-junuub.Hijji jineentiwa khalli riihitha al-haluuwe tisiil.Wa khalli habiibi yadkhul foogi ana jineentahwa yaakul min fawaakihha al-haluwiin.

Wa be sabab da,ana Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir ninazzilal-batuul fi l-askar al-sumaan hana l-malik.Wa be azamathum di kula,al-naar taakulhum wa tahrighum.
