Be l-kaamil,al-Rabb yidammir al-khaabaatwa l-jineenaat al-kubaar hana malik Achuur.Wa humman yabgomisil mardaan al-waddar gudurtah.
Wa yifaddil chiyya bas min chadar khaabaatahlahaddi sakhiir sakhayyar kula yagdar yahsibhum.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-yifaddulu min Bani Israa'iil wa l-mu'arridiin wa l-nijo min zurriiyit Yaakhuub ma yintaklu ale malik Achuur al-darabaahum.Wa laakin yintaklu be amaan ale Allah Khudduus Israa'iil.
Wa l-yifaddulu yigabbulu.Aywa,al-yifaddulu min zurriiyit Yaakhuub yigabbulu le Allah al-Gaadir.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,kan cha'abku bigo katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar kula,al-yigabbulu minku chiyya bas.Kharaar al-damaar marag wa hu kharaar malaan be l-adaala.
Wa khalaas,kharaar al-damaar da marag wa akiid Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir yitabbigah fi kulla l-balad.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ya cha'abi al-saakniin fi madiinat Sahyuun,ma takhaafo min malik balad Achuur.Hu gaa'id yadrubku be asaatah wa yarfa' asaatah didduku misil sawwooh al-Masriyiin zamaan.
Hassa' faddal wakit chiyya bas,khadabi didduku yagiif wa laakin za'ali yidammir askar balad Achuur.
Wa ana Allah al-Gaadir narfa'leyah al-soot wa nadurbahmisil darabt naas Midyaan fi hajar Uriib.Wa narfa' asaati didd al-baharmisil rafa'taha didd al-Masriyiin zamaan.
Wa fi l-yoom da,narfa'tagalatah min kataafeekuwa nichiil al-daami min rigaabkuwa l-daami yilkassarachaan tachba'o wa tabgo sumaan.
Wa askar Achuur yaju fi hillit Ayyatwa yuchuggu hillit Migruunwa fi hillit Mikmaach,yikhallu mu'iddaathum.
Wa yagta'o al-ma'add wa yuguulu-:-Fi l-leele di,nanzulu fi hillit Gaba'.-Wa be da,hillit al-Raama tarjifwa Gibee'a hillit Chaawuulsukkaanha yi'arrudu.
Asrakho,ya naas hillit Bitt Galliim-!Wa khutti baalki,ya hillit Laycha-!Wa hillit Anatuut al-Miskiine-!
Wa hillit Madmiina ti'arridwa sukkaan hillit Gabiimyifattuchu malja'.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom,askar Achuuryagiifu fi hillit Nuubwa yarfa'o iideehumdidd jabal Sahyuun al-misil bineeyewa da hajar al-foogah Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa chiifu-!Daahu Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadiryidammir askar Achuurmisil naadumyikassir al-furuu' be chidde.Wa misil yagta' al-furuu' al-marfuu'iin foog,Allah yikammil kubaaraathumwa l-aaliyiin kula,yarmiihum tihit.
Wa da misil hu yagta' chadar al-khaaba be faaswa khalaas,Lubnaan taga' giddaam al-Aziim.
Wa yaji waahid min zurriiyit Yassamisil firi' al-yabzur min dumburwa min ga'arah tugummbizre al-tisawwi iyaal.
Wa fi l-naadum da,yanzil Ruuh Allahwa da ruuh al-hikma wa l-ma'rafawa l-choora wa l-fahaaliiyewa l-ilim wa l-khoof min Allah.
Wa hu yafrah be l-khoof min Allahwa ma yahkim be l-chaafatah eenahwa ma yikharrir be l-sim'atah adaanah.
Wa yahkim le l-fagraaniin be l-adaalawa yikharrir be l-adil le masaakiin al-balad.Wa kalaamah,misil be asa yadrub al-baladwa be kilme waahide,yaktul al-aasi.
Wa l-adaala misil hizaam sulbahwa l-sahiih misil hizaam batnah.
Wa l-ba'achoom yaskun ma'a l-hamalwa l-nimir yargud jamb al-sakhal.Wa l-ijil wa farkh al-duud yaakulu sawawa wileed sakhayyar yuguudhum.
Wa l-bagara wa l-dubb yasraho sawawa iyaalhum yarugdu bakaan waahid.Wa l-duud yabga misil al-toor,yaakul al-gechch.
Al-tifil yal'ab be uchch abundaragaywa,al-sakhiir yidiss iidah fi nugrat al-daabi.
Wa ma tukuun fasaala wa la damaarfi kulla jabali al-mukhaddasachaan al-ard tinmali be ma'rafat Allahmisil al-bahar yinmali be almi.
Wa fi l-yoom da,irig Yassa yabga misil raaye le l-chu'uub.Wa l-umam yifattuchuuhwa bakaanah al-yinjamma foogah aziim.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-Rabb yimidd iidah le taani marrale yafda al-faddalo min cha'abahal-gaa'idiin fi buldaan Achuur wa Masirwa Fatruus wa l-Habacha wa Ilaamwa Chin'aar wa Hamaatwa fi jazaayir al-bahar.
Hu yarfa' raaye le l-umamwa yilimm Bani Israa'iil al-matruudiinwa yajma' Bani Yahuuza al-muchattatiinfi l-arba'a jiihaat hana l-ard.
Wa husud Afraayim yabga ma fiihwa khusmaan Yahuuza yikammulu.Wa Afraayim ma yahsid Yahuuza battaanwa Yahuuza ma yabga abadankhasiim Afraayim.
Wa humman yinsabbofi l-Filistiyiin fi l-kharibwa sawa yanhaboal-gaa'idiin fi l-sabaah.Wa fi buldaan Adoom wa Muwaab,yahkumuwa le Bani Ammuun,yamulkuuhum.
Wa Allah yiyabbis rijil bahar Masirwa yarfa' iidah le yadrub bahar al-Furaatbe chiddit nafkhatah.Wa yigassimah sab'a wudyaan dugaagal-yagdaro yagta'oohum be rijleehum.
Wa hinaak,hu yisawwi derible l-faddalo min cha'abah fi balad Achuurmisil zamaan sawwa derib le Bani Israa'iilyoom marago min balad Masir.
Wa fi l-yoom da,inta tuguul-:-Ana nachkurak,ya Allah-!Achaan inta zi'ilt diddiwa laakin khadabak inta khalleetahwa inta sabbartini.
Daahu al-Ilaah al-munajji-!Ana atwakkalt aleyahwa battaan ma nakhaaf.Achaan gudurti wa khuwwiti,hu Allahwa hu bas al-najjaani.
Wa tichiilu almi be farahmin een almi hana l-naja.
Wa fi l-yoom da,intu tuguulu-:-Achkuru Allah wa naadu usmah-!Arrufu amalah le l-chu'uubwa azzakkaro kadar usmah al-Aali.
Khannu le Allahachaan hu sawwa achya aziimiinwa arrufu beehum kulla l-ard.
Iitu be farah wa zakhrutu,ya sukkaan Sahyuun-!Achaan Khudduus Israa'iilal-gaa'id fi usutku,hu aziim.
Muhaakamat Baabil al-chaafha Icha'ya wileed Ammuus fi ru'ya.
Al-Rabb gaal-:-Khuzzu raaye fi l-jabal al-amlaswa naadu le l-askar.Wa wassufuuhum be iideekule yadkhulu al-madiinabe biibaan al-hukkaam.
Ana anteet amur le mukhassasiin hineeyiwa battaan naadeet furraasi al-yinaffuzu khadabi,al-yafraho be azamati.
Asma'o al-haraka al-katiire fi l-jibaalmisil cha'ab katiiriin-!Wa da hiss harakat al-mamaalikaywa,harakat malammat al-umam-!Allah al-Gaadir yijahhizdeechah al-yihaarib.
Humman yaju min balad ba'iidemin aakhir al-ard.Allah wa silaah khadabahyisabbubu damaar hana kulla l-balad.
Abku be hizin achaan yoom Allah garrabwa da yoom hana damaar chadiidal-jaayi min al-Gaadir.
Wa be sabab da,kulla l-iideen yinrakhuwa ayyi naadum galbah yingati'.
Humman yinbahtuwa yakrubhum waja' wa talagawa yittannomisil mara al-gaa'ide titaalig.Wa l-waahid yichiif al-aakharkulluhum munbahitiinwa yisallulu uyuunhum min al-khoof.
Daahu yoom Allah jaayi,yoom hana khadab mukhiif wa za'al chadiidal-foogah Allah yakhrib al-ardwa yuguchch minha al-muznibiin.
Wa be da,nujuum al-sama wa l-Sabi al-Makhminuurhum ma yibiin.Wa min taluu'ha,al-harraay tabga dalmawa l-gamar kula,nuurah ma yidawwi.
Wa l-Rabb gaal-:-Ana ni'aakhib al-dunya fi chaan fasaalithawa l-aasiyiin fi chaan khataahum.Wa niwaggif istikbaar al-mustakbiriinwa ninazzil fachaar siyaad al-unuf.
Wa nisawwi al-insaan khaali ma yinlagimisil al-dahab al-saafi.Aywa,Bani Adam yabga khaali ma yinlagimisil dahab balad Ufiir.
Wa be sabab da,nihizz al-samawa nirajjif al-ard min asaasha.Wa da min chiddit za'ali ana Allah al-Gaadirfi yoom khadabi al-muhrig.
Khalaas,misil al-khazaala al-matruudawa misil al-khanam al-ma induhum raa'i,ayyi waahid yigabbil le cha'abahwa ayyi waahid yi'arrid le baladah.
Wa ayyi waahid al-yalgooh,yat'anoohwa ayyi waahid al-yakurbuuh,yaktuluuh be l-seef.
Wa atfaalhum yarhakoohum giddaamhumwa yanhabo khumaam buyuuthumwa yarugdu ma'a awiinhum be gu.
Wa l-Rabb gaal-:-Daahu nigawwim al-Maadiyiin didduhumal-ma yifakkuru fi l-fuddawa l-dahab kula ma ya'ajibhum.
Wa be nuchchaabhum,yaktulu al-chabaabwa ma yarhamo al-tifilwa ma yihinnu fi l-iyaal al-dugaag.
Zamaan,madiinat Baabil jamaal al-mamaalikwa ziinat al-Baabiliyiin.Wa hassa',hi tabgamisil Saduum wa Amuuraal-dammaraahum al-Rabb.
Hi ma yaskunuuha ila l-abadwa min zurriiye le zurriiye kula,ma yaskunuuha.Al-arab al-yisiiruma yabnu khiyamhum hinaakwa l-ru'yaan ma yisawwuzaraayibhum hinaak.
Haywaanaat al-kadaade yaskunuuhawa tuyuur amguggum yamlo buyuutha.Wa l-na'aam yaskunhawa tuyuus al-hajar yal'abo foogha.
Al-maraaf'iin yabku fi buyuutha al-samhiinwa l-ba'aachiim fi gusuurha al-kubaar.Wakitha gariib yajiwa ayyaamha mahsuubiin.
Allah yihinn fi zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa ya'azil battaan Bani Israa'iilwa hu yantiihum al-raaha fi baladhum.Wa l-ajaanib yilimmu ma'aahumwa yinrabtu ma'a zurriiyit Yaakhuub.
Wa chu'uub aakhariin yichiiluuhumwa yigabbuluuhum fi baladhumfi l-ard al-antaaha leehum Allah.Wa Bani Israa'iil yakurbu al-naas doolwa yisawwuuhum abiid wa khadiim.Wa yasjunu al-naas al-sajanoohumwa yahkumu fi l-naas al-daayagoohum.
Yoom waahid,Allah yantiiku al-jummamin ta'abku wa diigitkuwa min al-ubuudiiye al-gaasiye al-faradooha foogku.
Wa khalaas fi l-yoom da,tikhannu be l-masal dawa tichchammato le malik Baabilwa tuguulu-:-Kikkeef wagaf al-mudaayig-?Wa kikkeef al-jaayir bigi ma fiih-?
Allah kassar isay al-aasiyiinwa asaat al-hukkaam.
Achaan be khadab al-mudaayig darab al-cha'abwa be daribiin mutataabi'.Wa be za'al,hu malak al-umamwa taradaahum bala rahma.
Wa hassa',kulla sukkaan al-ard anjammo wa ligo raahawa be farah zakhrato.
Hatta chadar al-sarwi wa arz Lubnaanfirho be l-bigi foogak,ya l-malik-!Wa gaalo-:--Min inta waga't,al-yagta'na abadan ma gidir yaji leena.--
Wakit inta wisilt fi bakaan al-maytiin,humman barjalo wa laagook.Wa gawwamo leek al-naas al-maato zamaanwa kulla kubaaraat al-ard.Wa gawwamo min karaasiihumkulla muluuk al-umam.
Wa kulluhum yihajju leek wa yuguulu-:--Inta kula daahu mutt misilnawa bigiit ma'aana sawa sawa.
Istikbaarak nazal fi bakaan al-maytiinma'a musiikha hana jigindiiytak.Wa hassa' inta raagid fi l-duudwa mulkhatti beyah.--
Kikkeef inta waga't min al-samaawaat,ya deyy al-sabaah al-yiraari-?Kikkeef ramook fi l-ard,ya mufachchil al-umam-?
Inta bas gult fi galbak-:--Natla' foog fi l-samaawaatwa nukhutt kursiiyimin foog le nujuum al-Ilaah.Wa nagood fi jabal al-ijtimaa' al-ilaahaatfi aakhir al-munchaakh.--
Wa battaan inta gult-:--Natla' foog fi l-sahaabwa nisawwi nafsi misil al-Aali.--
Wa laakin daahu inta nazaltma'a l-maytiin fi aakhir al-khabur.
Al-yichiifuuk yihammuruukaywa,yichiifuuk adiil wa yuguulu-:--Da ma al-raajil al-barjal al-ardwa rajjaf al-mamaalik walla-?
Da ma hu al-sawwa al-aalam saharawa haddam al-mudunwa ma talag al-masaajiin walla-?--
Kulla muluuk al-umam bala tafrikharagado be charaf,ayyi waahid fi khaburah.
Wa laakin inta,zagalook ba'iid min khaburakmisil firi' al-ja'alooh muharramwa misil rimmit al-insaanal-ta'anooh be l-seefwa zagalooh fi nugra al-fi lubbaha hajarwa misil janaazaal-fajjakhooha be l-rijileen.
Wa inta,ma dassookma'a l-muluk fi l-khaburachaan inta dammart baladakwa katalt cha'abak.Wa l-naas al-yisawwu al-fasaala,usum zurriiyithum yiwaddir ila l-abad.
Yalla-!Jahhuzu juzur le katil iyaalahbe sabab khata juduudhum-!Achaan ma waajib yugummuwa yagla'o al-ardwa yamlo al-aalam be mudunhum.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana nugumm didduhumwa nuguchch usum al-Baabiliyiinwa l-faddalo min iyaalhumwa iyaal iyaalhum.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa Baabil nisawwiiha rahadwa maskan abunchook.Wa nuguchchahabe mugchaachat al-damaar-!-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa Allah al-Gaadir halaf wa gaal-:-Akiid,al-naweetah yukuunwa l-kharrartah yitimm.
Ana nidammirnaas balad Achuur fi baladiwa nifajjikhhum fi jibaali.Wa be misil da,nidalli al-daami min kataafe cha'abiwa ninazzil tagalatah min kataafeehum.
Da l-kharaar al-chaalah Allahdidd kulla l-ardwa di hi al-iid al-marfuu'adidd kulla l-umam.
Allah al-Gaadir chaal kharaar.Yaatu yagdar yifachchilah-?Hu rafa' iidah le l-ikhaab.Yaatu yagdar yinazzilha-?
Wa fi l-sana al-maat foogha al-malik Ahaaz,al-muhaakama di bigat.
Ma tafraho,ya kulla l-Filistiyiin,wa ma tuguulu asaat al-yadrubku ankasarat.Achaan min rimmit al-daabi,yamrug abundaragwa min zurriiytah,yamrug al-daabi al-indah samm yaktul.
Wa awlaad al-bikir hana l-fagraaniinyalgo ma'aachhumwa l-masaakiin yarugdu be amaan.Wa laakin intu,ya l-Filistiyiin,naktulku be l-juu'wa l-faddalo minku,nidammirhum.
Nuuhu,ya biibaan-!Wa kooruku,ya mudun-!Kulla l-Filistiyiin barjalo.Achaan al-adu yajimisil dukhkhaan min al-munchaakhwa askari waahid kula ma yamrugmin al-saff.
Chunu al-nurudduuhle murassaliin al-umma di-?Nuguulu-:--Aywa,Allah assas Sahyuunachaan masaakiin cha'abah yalja'o leeha.-
Muhaakamat Muwaab.Fi leele waahide bas,hi addammarat-!Hillit Aar al-fi Muwaab bigat ma fiiha.Aywa fi l-leele al-hi addammarat foogha,hillit Khiir al-fi Muwaab kula bigat ma fiiha-!
Wa cha'abha gaa'idiin yabku wa tala'ofi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaadaal-fi hillit Habeet wa fi hillit Diibuun.Naas Muwaab yunuuhule hillaal Nabu wa Miidbawa kulla ruuseehum muzayyaniinwa duguunhum magtuu'iin min al-hizin.
Wa fi l-chawaari',laabsiin khulgaan al-hizinwa fi ruuse al-buyuut wa l-naga'aat,kulluhum yunuuhu wa yabku be hizin.
Wa naas Hachbuun wa Ali'aalagaa'idiin yikoorukuwa hissuhum gaa'id yinsami'lahaddi hillit Yahaas.Wa fi chaan da,askar Muwaab yi'iituwa laakin chajaa'a ma induhum.
Galbi anjarah le naas Muwaab.Al-mu'arridiin minha lihgolahaddi hillaal Suukhar wa Aglat Chaliicha.Wa gaa'idiin yatla'o fi gooz Luhiit be bakiwa yasrakho siraakh chadiid fi derib Hurunaayim.
Achaan almi rijil Nimriim chiribwa l-gechch yibis.Wa l-haya aba ma yugummwa l-khadaar bigi ma fiih.
Wa fi chaan da,humman chaalo khumaamhum al-faddalwa waddooh khaadi le waadi al-Gana.
Wa korooraakhum ansama'fi kulla ard Muwaabwa nuwaahhum machalahaddi hillit Aglaayimwa wassal lahaddi biir Iliim.
Almi Diibuun malaan dammwa Allah gaal-:-Ana ninazzil fi Diibuunmasaayib ziyaada.Al-duud yaktulal-mu'arridiin hana Muwaabwa yaakul al-faddalo fi turaabha.
Wa kubaaraat Muwaab gaalo-:-Min madiinat Saala' fi l-sahara,rassulu kharuufle haakim al-baladal-gaa'id fi jabal Sahyuun al-misil bineeye.
Wa fi ma'add waadi Arnuun,banaat Muwaab yabganmisil tuyuur al-muchattatiinal-taradoohum min uchchuhum.
Wa gaalan-:-Chaawirwa chiil leena kharaar.Be l-nahaar,khattiina be dullakmisil al-dalaam yikhatti al-leel.Wa labbid naasna al-muchattatiinwa ma tibayyin al-mu'arridiin.
Khalli al-muchattatiin min Muwaabyaskunu ma'aakwa abga leehum malja'wa labbidhum min al-yidammirhum.-Al-zulum yagiif wa l-damaar yikammilwa l-zaalim yiwaddir min al-balad.
Khalaas,kursi al-muluk yasbit be l-rahmawa yagood foogah haakim amiinmin zurriiyit Dawuud.Wa hu yichaari' be l-haggwa yahkim be l-adaala.
Wa laakin Icha'ya gaal-:-Aniina simi'nabe l-istikbaar al-chadiid hana Muwaabwa fachaarha wa istikbaarhawa khadabha al-ma indah asaaswa fachaarha al-ma indah ma'ana.
Wa fi chaan da,al-Muwaabiyiin yunuuhule baladhum Muwaabwa kulluhum yunuuhu.Aywa,intu naas Muwaab tandamole ka'ak al-inab hana hillit Khiir Haaras al-bigi ma fiihwa taguntu be hizin.
Achaan ziraa'at Hachbuun yibsatwa jineenit al-inab fi hillit Sibma jaffathi al-awwal khamarha yisakkir kubaaraat al-umam.Wa zamaan,al-inab da lihig hillit Ya'ziirwa sarah fi l-kadaadewa furuu'ah lihgokhaadi le l-bahar al-Mayyit.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nabki ma'a Ya'ziir le inab Sibmawa narwiiku be dumuu'i,ya Hachbuun wa Ali'aala.Achaan fi gati'ku wa lammiinku hana l-inab,al-khine hana l-farah bigi ma fiih.
Wa l-farha wa l-suruur bigo ma fiihumwa fi jineenaat al-inab,ma fi zakhraat wa la farha.Wa l-yagta' al-inab ma ya'asirah fi l-assaarawa khine al-farah bigi ma fiih.
Wa fi chaan da,butuuni rajafo le Muwaabmisil hubaal al-jigindiiyewa galbi khaaf le hillit Khiir Haaras.
Wa Muwaab ti'ayyi nafisha saakitfi l-madbah fi l-bakaan al-aali.Hi tamchi fi bakaanha hana l-ibaada wa tachhadwa laakin ma talga cheyy.
Wa da kalaam Allah al-gaalah fi Muwaab min zamaan.
Wa hassa',Allah gaal-:-Min hini le talaata sana sawa sawa,yahguru charaf Muwaab wa katarat askarha kula.Al-faddalo chiyya bas wa ma induhum faayde.
Muhaakamat madiinat Dimachkh.Dimachkh battaanma tukuun madiina.Hi tilhaddamwa tabga koom hana turaab.
Wa mudun Aruu'ir yakhrabowa yabgo bakaan le l-bahaayim.Al-bahaayim yarugdu fooghumwa ma fi naadum yibachtinhum.
Al-mudun al-gawiyiin fi Afraayim yiddammarowa muluk Dimachkh kula yagiif.Al-faddalo min balad Araam,charafhum yabga ma fiihmisil charaf Bani Israa'iil.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa fi l-yoom da,charaf zurriiyit Yaakhuub yangusmisil naadum al-laham jildahwa chahamah daffag.
Wa humman yabgomisil al-zere' ba'ad al-gati'wakit al-gati'iinlammo al-gameh be katara.Wa da misil wakit yikachchubu al-ganaadiilfi waadi Rafaayiin.
Al-yifaddil minhum yabga chiyyamisil al-kichcheebaw misil al-faddalba'ad hatto chadar al-zaytuun.Waahid aw tineen yifaddulu foog fi raas al-chadarawa arba'a aw khamsa fi l-furuu'.Wa da kalaam Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-insaan yitwakkal ale Ilaahah al-khalagah wa yiwajjih be amaan ale Khudduus Israa'iil.
Wa battaan ma yintakil ale l-madaabih al-sawwathum iidah wa ma yiwajjih be amaan fi l-sawwaah be asaab'ah.Wa dool al-iidaan al-khazzaahum le ibaadat Achiira wa l-makhaabir hana l-bakhuur.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-mudun al-gawiyiin yikhalluuhummisil khallo al-khaaba wa ruuse al-jibaalwakit Bani Israa'iil jo chaalo al-balad,kulla l-balad takhrab.
Achaan intu nisiitu Ilaahku al-najjaakuwa ma fakkartu foogah hu,jabal malja'ku.Wa fi chaan da,maggantu chadar laziizwa teerabtu teeraab ajnabi.
Wa yoom maggantuuhum,intu chiftuuhum kibrowa ambaakir fajur,chiftu nuwwaarhum.Wa laakin fi wakt al-gati',ma ligiitu intaajwa waja'ku ma indah ilaaj.
Al-azaab-!Daahu al-hiss al-chadiidhana chu'uub al-ma induhum adad.Harakathum chadiidemisil harakat al-baharwa hissuhum chadiidmisil hiss almi al-seel.
Wa harakat al-chu'uubmisil harakat almi al-katiir.Wakit al-Rabb yugumm didduhum,humman yi'arrudu ba'iid,matruudiin misil uttaabgiddaam riih min al-jibaalwa misil haskaniitgiddaam amzooba'aane.
Wa fi l-achiiye,ru'ub-!Wa gabul al-fajur,ma faddal cheyy-!Da bas gisim al-naas al-yanhaboonawa mukaafaat al-naas al-yaksaboona.
Al-azaab le l-balad al-fooghasufun al-induhum chiraa'fi tuul buhuur al-Habacha-!
Di l-balad al-tirassil sufara be l-baharfi maraakib hana birdial-yamchi ajala fi l-almi.Ya rusul,amchu ajala-!Amchu le l-ummaal-naasha tuwaal wa mulus,le l-cha'ab al-mukhiifiin fi ayyi bakaan.Aywa,hi umma gawiiye tarhak kulla cheyywa buhuur yuchuggu baladha.
Asma'o,intu kullukual-gaa'idiin fi l-aalam,intu al-saakniin fi l-ard-!Wakit al-raaye yarfa'oohafi ruuse al-jibaal,chiifuuha-!Wa wakit yadurbu al-buug,asma'ooh-!
Achaan daahu Allah gaal leyi-:-Min bakaani,ana nichiif wa nagood saakitmisil al-harraay al-chadiide fi l-nahaarwa misil sahaabaayit al-karany fi hamu wakit al-gati'.
Wa gabul al-gati',wakit al-inab nawwar khalaaswa wakit al-nuwwaar bigi inab najiid,al-Rabb yagta' al-furuu' be l-sakkiinwa yamrug al-khusuunwa yukhuttuhum taraf.
Wa misil da,naas al-Habachayikhalluuhum le suguura al-jibaalwa le haywaanaat al-kadaade.Al-suguura yaakuluuhum fi wakt al-seefwa haywaanaat al-kadaade fi wakt al-chite.
Wa fi l-wakit da,tijiib hadaaya le Allah al-Gaadir,al-umma al-naasha tuwaal wa muluswa cha'abha mukhiifiin fi ayyi bakaan.Wa hi umma gawiiye tarhak kulla cheyywa buhuur yuchuggu baladha.Wa hi tijiib hadaaya fi jabal Sahyuunfi l-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah usum Allah al-Gaadir.
Muhaakamat Masir.Daahu fi sahaabaay sarii'e Allahjaayi fi Masir.Wa ilaahaat Masir gaa'idiin yarjufu giddaamahwa l-Masriyiin galibhum angata'.
Ana niharrich al-Masriyiin yilhaarabo,waahidiin yugummu didd al-aakhariin.Ayyi waahid yugumm didd akhuuhwa ayyi waahid yugumm didd jaarah,madiina didd madiinawa mamlaka didd mamlaka.
Wa ana niwaddir chajaa'at al-Masriyiinwa nibarjil choorithum.Khalaas,humman yas'alo al-ilaahaatwa l-chawwaafiinwa l-yikallumu ma'a l-maytiinwa l-yihajju ma'a l-jinn.
Wa nisallim al-Masriyiin fi iid siid gawiwa hu malik jaayir yahkim fooghum.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir.
Wa almi al-bahar yikammilwa l-Niil yaybaswa almi al-bahar yachrabwa hu yabga yaabis.
Wa l-buhuur yinchammo afniinaywa,rujuul Masir yangusu wa yaybasowa l-tibin wa l-birdi yijiffu.
Wa l-gechch al-fi khachum al-Niilwa kulla nabaat al-Niil yaybasowa yichittu wa yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa l-hawwaatiin yaguntuwa l-yazgulu jambaathum fi l-Niil yahzanowa l-yazgulu charakhum fi khachum al-almi yi'ayyusu
wa l-naas al-yakhdumu fi l-kattaan yi'iibuwa l-yitirru wa l-yuduggu al-tchaaka achamhum yingati'.
Darraabiin al-tchaaka hana Masir yat'abowa kulla l-khaddaamiin al-mu'ajjariin yaz'alo.
Aywa,masaa'iil hillit Su'aan munaafikhiinwa l-hukama mustachaariin Fir'oonsawwo majlas hana mataamiis.Wa intu-!Kikkeef tagdaro tuguulu le Fir'oon-:-Ana wileed hukama.Ana wileed muluuk hana zamaan.
Ya Fir'oon,mustachaariinak ween-?Khalli yi'ooruuk wa yi'allumuukkharaar Allah al-Gaadir al-chaalah didd Masir.
Wa masaa'iil hillit Su'aan ma induhum raaswa masaa'iil hillit Mamfiis ankhachchowa kubaaraat al-gabaayil waddaro Masir.
Wa Allah nazzalfi usuthum ruuh hana barjaalwa humman waddaro Masir fi amalha al-tisawwiihmisil wadaar al-sakkaari fi lubb gadiifah.
Wa naadum ma yagdaryisawwi cheyy le Masirwa la l-raas wa la l-danabwa la l-nakhal wa l-ageeg.
Wa fi l-yoom da,naas Masir yabgo misil awiin wa yakhaafo wa yarjufu wakit yichiifu iid Allah al-Gaadir marfuu'a didduhum.
Wa balad Yahuuza tikhawwif al-Masriyiin.Achaan ayyi Masri al-yifakkir foogha yarjif fi chaan al-kharaar al-chaalah Allah al-Gaadir didd Masir.
Wa fi l-yoom da,khamsa mudun fi Masir yikallumu be lukhkhat al-Ibraaniyiin wa yahalfu kadar ya'abudu Allah al-Gaadir.Wa waahide min al-mudun dool yisammuuha Madiinat al-Harraay.
Wa fi l-yoom da,yukuun madbah le Allah fi usut balad Masir wa yukhuzzu hajar le Allah fi huduudha.
Wa l-hajar da yabga alaama wa chahaada kadar Allah al-Gaadir gaa'id fi balad Masir.Wa wakit yikooruku le Allah fi chaan al-yazulmuuhum,hu yirassil leehum munajji al-yihaami leehum wa yikhallishum.
Wa Allah yibayyin nafsah le l-Masriyiin.Wa fi l-yoom da,al-Masriyiin kula ya'arfuuh wa ya'abuduuh.Wa ya'abuduuh wa yigaddumu leyah dahaaya wa hadaaya wa yisawwu nazir le Allah wa yitimmuuh.
Wa wakit Allah yadrub al-Masriyiin be chidde,hu yachfiihum.Achaan humman yigabbulu le Allah wa hu yakhbal su'aalhum wa yachfiihum.
Wa fi l-yoom da,yukuun derib min balad Masir lahaddi balad Achuur wa l-Achuuriyiin yamchu Masir wa l-Masriyiin yamchu Achuur.Wa l-Masriyiin wa l-Achuuriyiin ya'abudu Allah sawa.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Israa'iil tabga al-taalit le Masir wa Achuur.Wa da yijiib al-baraka fi ust al-ard.
Achaan Allah al-Gaadir yibaarikhum wa yuguul-:-Mubaarakiin al-Masriyiin cha'abi wa l-Achuuriyiin al-sawwathum iidi wa Bani Israa'iil cha'abi wa warasati.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-kaan fi l-sana al-foogha Sarguun malik Achuur rassal khaayid deechah le yihaarib madiinat Achduud wa yichiilha.
Wa gabul Achduud ma taga',Allah hajja be waasitat al-nabi Icha'ya wileed Ammuus.Wa hu gaal le Icha'ya-:-Yalla amrug khulgaanak hana l-hizin wa sill ni'leek min rijileenak. Wa Icha'ya sawwa misil da wa macha aryaan wa hafyaan.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Misil abdi Icha'ya macha aryaan wa hafyaan muddit talaata sana,da yabga alaama wa cheyy ajiib le Masir wa l-Habacha.
Wa misil da,malik Achuur yichiil subyaan wa chiyyaab min Masir wa l-Habacha wa yiwaddiihum masaajiin fi l-khurba.Wa l-naas dool yiwaddiihum aryaaniin wa hafyaaniin wa ja'abaathum barra.Wa da eeb le Masir.
Wa misil da,al-naas al-khatto achamhum fi l-Habacha wa faacharo be musaa'adat Masir yinbahtu wa yi'iibu.
Wa fi l-yoom da,sukkaan khachum al-bahar yuguulu-:--Chiifu-!Khatteena achamna fooghum le yafza'oona wa yinajjuuna min malik Achuur.Wa hassa' da,kikkeef aniina ninajju nufuusna-?-
Muhaakamat al-sahara al-jamb al-bahar.Al-adu yaji min al-sahara,min balad mukhiifemisil al-zooba'aane al-jaayemin saharat al-Nagab.
Ru'ya mukhiife baanat leyi.Nichiif al-khaayin yukhuunwa l-mudammir yidammir.Wa Allah gaal-:-Yalla ahjumu al-madiina,ya naas Ilaam-!Wa haasuruuha,ya naas Maadi-!Ana niwaggif kulla l-ganitiinal-hi sabbatatah.
Wa be sabab da,sulbi gaa'id yarjif min al-ta'abwa waja' chadiid karabaanimisil waja' hana l-maraal-gaa'ide titaalig.Min chiddit al-waja',ma nasma'wa min chiddit al-khoof,ma nichiif.
Fikri waddarwa khoof chadiid karabaani.Al-leel al-gaa'id narjaahjaab leyi al-ru'ub.
Jaabo al-akil fi l-dabalaaywa farracho al-birichwa akalo wa chirbo.Laakin tawwaali,fi hiss gaal-:-Gummu,ya khuyyaad-!Zayyudu duruu'ku.
Achaan daahu al-Rabb gaal leyi-:-Amchi wa khutt haraswa khalli yihajji be l-yichiifah.
Wa kan chaaf arabaat haribal-yukurruuhum kheel itneenwa kan chaaf naas raakbiin fi hamiirwa naas aakhariin raakbiin fi jumaal,khalaas khalli yukhutt baalah wa yingari'.
Wa l-haras sarakh wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidi-!Ana waagif kulla yoomfi bakaan al-haraasa.Wa waagif kulla l-leelfi bakaan al-muraakhaba.
Wa daahu-!Naadum raakib fi arabaal-yukurruuha kheel itneenjaayi wa yuguul-:--Waga'at-!Baabil waga'at-!Wa kulla asnaam ilaahaathakassaroohum fi l-turaab-!-
Ya cha'abi-!Intu al-Allah daggaakumisil khalla fi madaggah-!Al-cheyy al-simi'tahmin Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil,da bas ana gultah leeku.
Muhaakamat balad Duuma.Aato leyi min Sa'iir wa gaalo-:-Ya l-haras-!Chunu kaan fi l-leel-?Ya l-haras-!Chunu kaan fi l-leel-?
Wa l-haras radda wa gaal-:-Al-sabaah jawa l-leel kula ma'aayah.Kan tidooru tiwajjuhu su'aal,as'alo-!Gabbulu wa ta'aalu battaan.
Muhaakama balad al-Arab.Ya naas Dadaan al-ruhhal-!Intu tunuumu fi khaabat balad al-Arab.
Ya sukkaan balad Tiima-!Antu almi le naas Dadaan al-atchaaniinwa waddu leehum akil,humman al-mu'arridiin.
Achaan humman mu'arridiin min al-suyuufaywa,min al-suyuuf al-marfuu'iinwa min al-nubbaal al-majbuudwa min chiddit al-harib.
Daahu al-Rabb gaal leyi-:-Ba'ad sana waahide sawa sawa,kulla charaf balad Khidaar yabga ma fiih.
Wa yifaddulu chiyya bas fi Khidaarmin al-rujaal al-fahaliin siyaad al-nubbaal.-Wa da kalaam Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-hu gaalah.
Muhaakama fi waadi al-Ru'ya.Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,maala kulla cha'abkitala'o fi ruuse al-buyuut-?
Maala kulla l-awwa wa l-haraka,ya inti hillit al-farah-?Maytiinki ma kataloohum be l-seefwa ma maato fi l-harib.
Kulla khuyyaadki arradowa siyaad al-nuchchaab karaboohum masaajiin.Wa kulla sukkaanki karaboohum masaajiinhatta kan humman arrado ba'iid kula.
Wa fi chaan da,ana gult-:-Ma tichiifuuni-!Khalluuni nabki be hurga.Wa ma tihaawulu tihannusuuniachaan ummati al-misil bitt ammi addammarat.
Achaan da yoom hana barjaalwa damaar wa chakk.Wa da jaayi min Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadirfi waadi al-Ru'ya.Al-durdur waga'wa l-korooraak ansama' ale l-jabal.
Naas balad Ilaam chaayliin kalootaathumwa arabaat al-harib wa siyaad al-kheel jaayiinwa naas hillit Khiir jahhazo duruu'hum.
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus-!Wudyaanki al-samhiinanmalo be arabaat al-harib.Wa siyaad al-kheel jo wagafofi khuchuum biibaanki
wa daahu balad Yahuuzama indaha difaa' battaan.Wa fi l-yoom da,intu wajjahtu ale beet al-Khaabaal-foogah silaahku.
Wa chiftu kadarkhuram madiinat Dawuud katiiriin.Wa waradtu almiwa sabbeetuuh fi l-khazzaan al-tihit.
Wa hasabtu adad buyuut Madiinat al-Khuduswa haddamtu buyuut waahidiin le tigawwu al-durdur.
Wa sawweetu khazzaanambeenaat al-daraadir al-itneenle l-almi hana l-birke al-gadiime.Wa laakin ma wajjahtu le Allahhu al-jaab al-masiibe di.Wa ma chiftuuh aleyah,hu al-jahhazaaha min zaman ba'iid.
Wa da l-yoom al-foogah Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadirnaadaaku le tabku wa tunuuhuwa le tizayyunu ruuseekuwa talbaso khulgaan al-tooba.
Wa laakin daahu be farah wa suruur,intu dabahtu bagar wa khanam.Wa akaltu lahamwa chiribtu khamar wa gultu-:-Yalla-!Naakulu wa nacharboachaan ambaakir,khalaas numuutu-!
Wa Allah al-Gaadir bayyan leyi wa gaal-:-Khataaku da,abadan ma indah kaffaaralahaddi tumuutu.-Wa da,Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir gaal-:-Amchi algaah le Chabnaal-mas'uul fi gasir al-malikwa guul leyah-:
--Indak chunu hini-?Wa indak yaatu hini-?Maala tankut leek khaburfi l-bakaan da-?Wa maala tahfir khabur fi l-aaliwa ti'addil leek khabur fi l-jabal le tinjamma foogah-?
Ya l-raajil al-chadiid,daahu Allah yarmiik ba'iidwa yakurbak be chidde wa yatwiik.
Wa yidakrimak misil kuuraaywa yazgulak fi balad wasii'e.Wa hinaak tumuut ma'a arabaat charafak,inta al-jibt al-eeb le beet siidak.
--Aywa-!Ana narmiik min bakaanakwa naturdak min mas'uuliiytak.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ninaadi abdiAliyaakhim wileed Hilkhiiya.
Ana nilabbisah khalagakwa narbut sulbah be hizaamakwa mas'uuliiytak,nantiiha leyah fi iideenah.Wa hu yabga abule sukkaan Madiinat al-Khuduswa le Bani Yahuuza.
Wa mas'uuliiyit muftaah gasir al-malik Dawuud,nukhuttaha tihit sultitah.Wa kan hu yaftah al-baab,ma fi al-yagdar yisiddahwa kan hu yisiddah,ma fi al-yagdar yaftahah.
Wa ana nimakkinahmisil witid fi bakaan gawiwa hu yijiib al-charaf le beet abuuh.
Wa kulla tagalat charaf beet abuuh,al-kubaar wa l-sukhaar kula,yukhuttuuha foogah.Wa hu yabga misil chi'beal-yi'allugu fooghakulla l-mu'iddaat al-sukhaarmin al-kharaariif lahaddi l-girab.-
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:-Fi l-yoom da,al-witid al-mumakkan fi l-bakaan al-gawiyintani wa yinkasir wa yaga'wa l-tagala al-chaayilha tiddammar.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-hu gaalah.
Muhaakamat balad Suur.Nuuhu,ya l-musaafiriin be sufun Tarchiich-!Achaan madiinat Suur addammarat-!Ma fi buyuut wa la madkhal-!Wa da khabar min jaziirat Khubrus.
Askutu min al-khoof,ya sukkaan khachum al-bahar.Ya tujjaar Seeda-!Tujjaarku chaggo al-bahar be katara.
Ma'aach waadi Masirwa darat al-Niil wa intaajahsaafaro fi l-baharwa bigo tijaara le l-umam.
Ya Seeda,akhjale-!Ya l-madiina al-gawiiye al-jamb al-bahar-!Achaan al-bahar gaal-:-Ana ma taalagt wa la wilidtwa la kabbart wulaadwa la rabbeet banaat.
Wakit sukkaan Masir yasma'obe l-khabar da,yarjufumisil rajafo wakit sim'o khabar Suur.
Ya sukkaan khachum al-bahar,nuuhuwa agta'o al-bahar lahaddi Tarchiich-!
Hal di bas madiinitku Suural-awwal farhaane walla-?Hal di bas hi al-gadiimeal-gaa'ide min zamaanwa assasat hillaal aakhariin walla-?
Yaatu al-kharrar al-cheyy da didd Suur,hi al-tidarrij muluuk-?Hi charrafat tujjaarha misil masaa'iilwa tujjaarha mucharrafiin fi kulla l-ard.
Allah al-Gaadir bas kharrarahle yidammir istikbaar al-naas al-mucharrafiinwa yahgir kulla l-naas al-induhum charafal-gaa'idiin fi l-ard.
Ya cha'ab Tarchiich-!Chittu fi ardukumisil al-Niil yamla ardahachaan ma fi cheyy al-yadharku.
Achaan Allah rafa' iidah didd al-baharwa rajjaf al-mamaalik.Wa kharrar yidammirmudun Kan'aan al-gawiyiin.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ya cha'ab madiinat Seeda-!Waggufu farahku,ya intu al-misil bineeye udriiye al-azzabooha.Gummu wa amchu jaziirat Khubrus-!Wa laakin hinaak kula,ma talgo jumma.
Chiifu naas balad Baabil,humman dool bigo ma fiihum.Achaan al-Achuuriyiin antoohumle haywaanaat al-kadaade.Al-Achuuriyiin sawwo khanaadigle yihaasuru al-hillewa haddamo gusuur madiinat Suurwa sawwoohum koom hana turaab.
Ya l-musaafiriin be sufun Tarchiich,nuuhu achaan malja'ku al-gawi khirib-!
Wa fi l-yoom da,Suur yansooha le muddit 70 sana misil adad ayyaam malik waahid.Wa fi nihaayat al-siniin dool,Suur tabga misil charmuuta al-khanno beeha.Wa gaalo-:
Ya l-charmuuta al-nisooki-!Chiili jigindiiyewa hawwigi al-madiina.Duggi al-jigindiiye adiilwa khanni katiirachaan yizzakkarooki.
Wa ba'ad 70 sana,Allah yifakkir le Suur wa hi tigabbil le ribaaha al-awwal.Wa hi tichcharmat battaan ma'a kulla mamaalik al-ard.
Laakin ribaaha wa ujritha yabgo mukhassasiin le Allah.Wa la yudummuuhum wa la yakhzunuuhum.Achaan be ribaaha yi'akkulu wa yichabbu'u wa yilabbusu adiil al-naas al-yaskunu giddaam Allah.
Daahu Allah yidammir al-ardwa yisawwiiha kharaab.Hu yitallif wijih al-ardwa yichattit sukkaanha.
Wa min chiddit al-ta'ab,raajil al-diin yabga misil waahid min al-cha'abwa l-siid yabga misil abdahwa l-sitt yabga misil khaadimhawa l-baayi' yabga misil al-muchtariwa l-yi'attil yabga misil al-yi'attuluuhwa l-yidayyin yabga misil al-yidayyunuuh.
Wa kulla l-ard tiddammar damaar kaamilwa yanhabooha marra waahidachaan da kalaam Allah al-hu gaalah.
Al-ard tijiff wa taybasaywa,al-aalam yad'af wa yaksalwa kubaaraat cha'ab al-ard yad'afo.
Wa l-ard,sukkaanha yinajjusuuhaachaan humman ma tabbago al-wasaayawa khaalafo al-gawaaniinwa gata'o al-mu'aahada al-daayme.
Wa sukkaan al-ard yil'aakhabobe sabab khataahumwa fi chaan da bas,al-la'ana talhag al-ard.Wa be da,sukkaan al-ard yahragowa yifaddulu minhum chiyya bas.
Wa l-khamar al-jadiid yabga chiyyawa chadar al-inab yamrad.Wa l-naas al-awwal guluubhum farhaaniinhassa' gaa'idiin yaguntu.
Wa hiss al-tanaabil al-halu yagiifwa aayit al-farhaaniin yikammilwa daribiin al-jigindiiye al-halu kula yagiif.
Ma yacharbo khamar be khinewa l-khamar al-bisakkir yabga murr le l-charraabiin.
Al-hille al-kharbaane tilkassarwa ayyi beet yilgaffalwa ma indah madkhal.
Wa yasrakho fi l-chawaari'achaan al-khamar yabga ma fiih.Wa kulla l-farah yabga ma fiihwa l-suruur yiwaddir min al-balad.
Wa fi l-madiina yinchaaf illa l-kharaab,al-biibaan yilkassaro wa yiddammaro.
Wa khalaas fi ust al-ardwa been al-chu'uub ma yifaddil cheyymisil al-zaytuun ba'ad al-gati'wa l-inab al-faddal kichcheeb.
Al-faddalo hayyiin yarfa'o hissuhumwa yafraho be azamat Allah.Wa wakit yaju min al-kharib,yi'iitu be farah.
Majjudu Allah fi l-sabaah-!Majjudu usum Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil fi jazaayir al-bahar-!
Wa min taraf al-ard,nasma'o khine al-buguul-:-Al-majd le Allah al-saadikh-!-Wa laakin ana nuguul-:-Ana waddart-!Ana waddart-!Al-azaab leyi ana-!Al-khaayniin khaano.Khiyaana-!Al-khaayniin khaano.
Khoof wa nugra wa charakleeku intu,ya sukkaan al-ard-!
Al-yajri min al-hiss al-yikhawwifyaga' fi l-nugrawa l-yamrug min al-nugra,al-charak yakurbah.Achaan biibaan al-sama yinfathuwa asaas al-ard yarjif.
Wa l-ard tichchaggagwa l-ard tilfatfatwa l-ard tinhazza.
Al-ard tittarta' misil al-sakkaariwa tinhazza misil illiiye fi l-riih.Isyaanha yabga leeha tagiilwa hi taga' marra waahidma tagdar tugumm.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Allah yi'aakhib khuwwaat al-sama foogwa muluuk al-ard tihit.
Wa yilimmuuhumwa yakurbuuhum masaajiin fi l-nugra.Wa yigaffuluuhum fi l-sijinwa ba'ad mudda tawiile,yi'aakhubuuhum.
Al-gamar yakhjalwa l-harraay talga al-eebachaan Allah al-Gaadir yahkim.Wa yibayyin majdahgiddaam kubaaraat cha'abahfi jabal Sahyuunwa fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Ya Allah-!Inta Rabbi,ana ni'azzimak wa nachkur usmakachaan inta sawweet ajaayibwa min zamaan,wasiiyaatak sidikh wa amaan.
Inta sawweet madiinat udwaannakoom hana turaabwa l-hille al-gawiiyesawweetha daraadir muhaddamiinwa gasir al-ajaanib ma bigi madiinawa battaan ma yinbani.
Wa fi chaan da,cha'ab gawiyiin yimajjuduukwa hillaal al-umam al-mujrimiin yakhaafo minnak.
Achaan inta malja' le l-da'iifwa malja' le l-miskiin fi l-diige.Inta misil bakaan al-yahmi min al-matara al-chadiidewa misil dull al-yahmi min al-hamu.Achaan khadab al-mujrimiinmisil matara al-chadiide al-tadrub durdur
wa misil al-hamu fi ard al-sahara.Wa inta tisakkit harakat al-ajaanibmisil sahaabaay al-tidallil fi l-hamuwa tiwaggif khine al-mujrimiin.
Allah al-Gaadir yisawwi aazuumale kulla l-chu'uub fi jabal Sahyuun.Wa yigaddim foogha laham samiinwa khamar gadiim.Aywa,yigaddim laham samiin wa mukhkhwa khamar gadiim saafi.
Wa fi l-jabal da,Allah yarfa'al-sitaar al-yidaarig kulla l-chu'uubwa l-khita al-yikhatti kulla l-umam.
Wa be da,Allah al-Rabbyidammir al-moot ila l-abadwa yuguchch dumuu' kulla l-wujuuhwa yiwaddir eeb cha'abah fi kulla l-ard.Da kalaam Allah al-hu gaalah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,yuguulu-:-Daahu Ilaahna.Aniina khatteena achamna foogahwa hu najjaana.Aywa,hu bas Allahal-khatteena achamna foogah.Yalla nafraho wa ninbastuachaan hu najjaana-!

Wa min wakit tawiil,nugrat al-naar jaahizeaywa,hi jaahize le malik Achuur-!Wa l-nugra di tawiile wa wasii'ewa daffago foogha hatab katiir.Wa be nafkhat Allahal-misil seel chadiid hana kibriit,hu yigabbidha naar.
Al-azaab le l-naas al-yanzulu fi Masir le l-faza'wa yintaklu ale l-kheelwa yitwakkalo ale arabaat al-haribachaan humman katiiriinwa yitwakkalo ale siyaad al-kheelachaan humman induhum gudra.Wa laakin al-naas dool ma induhum fikir fi Khudduus Israa'iilwa humman ma yifattuchu Allah.
Akiid,hu hakiim-!Yagdar yijiib al-charrwa ma yangud kalaamah.Wa hu yugumm didd al-yisawwu al-fasaalawa didd al-faza'o wa l-zulum.
Al-Masriyiin humman insaan,ma ilaahwa kheelhum laham,ma ruuh.Wakit Allah yarfa' iidah,al-Masriyiin al-yaju faza',yittarta'owa l-dawwaro faza'hum,yaga'owa kulluhum yiddammaro sawa.
Wa daahu Allah gaal leyi-:-Wakit al-duud aw farkh al-duud yikirr fi rimmitah,hatta kan naado ru'yaan katiiriin diddah kula,hu ma yibarjil min korooraakhumwa la yakhaaf min katarathum.Wa be misil da,Allah al-Gaadir yanzilfi jabal Sahyuun,fi hajarah le yihaarib.
Wa misil al-tuyuur yimattutu janaaheehum,Allah al-Gaadir kula yahmi Madiinat al-Khudus.Aywa,hu yahmiiha wa yinajjiihawa yafza'ha wa yikhallisha.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,gabbulu ale l-abeetuuh marra waahid-!
Wa fi l-yoom da,ayyi waahid yaaba ilaahaatah hana l-fuddawa ilaahaatah hana l-dahab.Aywa,dool al-sawwoohum leekuiideeku al-muznibiin.
Wa balad Achuur taga' tihit seef al-ma hana naadumwa da ma seef insaan al-yaktulha.Hi tajri giddaam al-seef dawa subyaanha yikhaddumuuhum misil abiid.
Wa askarha al-fahaliin yajru min al-khoofwa kubaaraatha yinbahtu giddaam al-raaye.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-indah naar fi jabal Sahyuun wa indah furun fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Aywa,yaji yoom al-foogahal-malik yamluk be l-adaalawa l-kubaaraat yahkumu be l-hagg.
Wa ayyi waahid minhum yabgamisil bakaan al-yillabbado foogah min al-riihwa misil bakaan al-yahmi min al-matara al-chadiide.Wa yabga misil majaari almi fi bakaan al-yaabiswa misil dull al-jabal fi ard jafaaf.
Wa uyuun al-naas al-yichiifuabadan ma yikhammudu.Wa udne al-naas al-yasma'oyinfathu marra waahid.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-naas al-mussa'jiliin fi l-kalaamyifakkuru wa yafhamo.Wa lisaan al-naas al-induhum tamtaamayihajji ajala be kalaam waadih.
Wa abadan ma yinaadu al-matmuus mas'uulwa l-khachchaach ma yinaaduuh hakiim.
Achaan al-matmuus yuguul kalaam cheenwa fi galbah yudumm al-charr.Hu yisawwi al-fasaala wa yakfurwa yakdib fi Allah.Wa yamna' al-akil le l-jii'aanwa l-almi le l-atchaan.
Al-khachchaach amalah fasil.Hu yikhattit al-fasaalale yidammir al-masaakiin be kalaam kidibwakit yidaafu'u le huguughum.
Wa laakin al-hakiimyikhattit amal adiilwa ale l-amal al-adiil da,hu yintakil.
Ya l-awiin al-munjammaat,gumman wa asma'an hissi.Ya l-banaat al-gaa'idaat be amaan,khuttan udneekan le kalaami.
Ba'ad sana wa ayyaam,tarjifan,ya l-gaa'idaat be amaan.Achaan gati' al-inab yabga ma fiihbattaan ma fi lammiin hana ma'aach.
Barjilan,ya l-munjammaat-!Arjifan,ya l-gaa'idaat be amaan-!Assallaban wa agoodan aryaanaatwa arbutan firaad fi salabaakan.
Akurban duyuudkan wa abkanachaan al-ziraa'a al-laziizewa jineenit al-inab al-wallaadabigo ma fiihum.
Achaan ard cha'abigamma foogha chook wa andireesa.Aywa,nuuhan le kulla buyuut al-suruurwa madiinat al-farah.
Achaan gasir al-malik khalloohwa l-madiina al-siyaadha katiiriin,abooha.Haarat Ufal wa gasir al-muraakhabayabgo misil karaakiir ila l-abad.Wa hamiir al-kadaade yinattutu fooghum min al-farahwa l-bahaayim yasraho fooghum
lahaddi yoom Allah yinazzil ruuhahfoogna min al-sama.Khalaas al-sahara tabga jineenewa l-jineene tabga misil khaaba.
Wa khalaas,al-hagg yaskun fi l-saharawa l-adaala tagood fi l-jineene.
Natiijat al-adaala tabga al-salaamwa l-adaala tijiib al-huduwa l-amin al-daayim.
Wa cha'abi yagoodu fi bakaan hana salaamfi buyuut amiiniin wa haadiyiinwa bakaan hana jumma.
Wa laakin al-khaaba tiddammar tihit al-baradwa l-madiina tilhaddam marra waahid.
Wa laakin al-farah leeku intu al-titeerubufi ayyi bakaan al-indah almiwa tatulgu bagarku wa hamiirkubala guyuud.
Al-azaab leek inta al-tikharribwa laakin ma kharrabookwa leek inta al-tukhuunwa laakin ma khaanook.Wa wakit tikammil min al-kharaab,akiid yakharbuuk.Wa wakit tikammil min al-khiyaana,akiid yukhuunuuk.
Ya Allah-!Hinn foogna-!Aniina nukhuttu achamna foogak.Abga gudritna fi kulli sabaahwa fi wakit al-diige,abga najaatna.
Min haraka chadiide hana jaytak,al-cha'ab yi'arrudu.Wa wakit inta tugumm,al-umam yichittu.
Al-khaniime yilimmuuha be kataramisil saar al-leel yaakulu al-chadar.Wa yaga'o fooghamisil wagi'iin al-jaraad.
Allah aziim achaan gaa'id foogwa mala Sahyuun be l-hagg wa l-adaala.
Ya cha'ab Allah-!Kulla ayyaam hayaatku yabgo amiiniin.Al-hikma wa l-ma'rafadool khuna al-naja.Wa l-khoof min Allahyabga leeku misil kanz.
Wa daahu al-furraas yi'iitu fi l-chawaari'wa rusul al-salaam yabku be hurga.
Wa l-chawaari' faadiyiinwa ma fi naadum maachi fi l-duruub.Al-mukharrib gata' al-mu'aahadawa le l-chuhuud,abaahumwa ma fakkar fi ayyi naadum.
Al-balad jaffat wa yibsataywa,Lubnaan yibsat wa l-eeb karabha.Sahalat Chaaruunbigat misil al-saharawa turaab Baachaan wa jabal al-Karmalwaddaro khadaarhum.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Hassa' ana nugummwa hassa' ana ninrafi'wa hassa' ana niwassif azamati.
Intu khilibtu be gechchwa wilidtu tibin-!Wa nafasku misil naar al-tahrigku.
Wa l-cha'ab al-aakhariin yahragowa yabgo rumaad.Yabgo misil al-chook al-gata'oohwa gaa'id yahrag.
Intu al-gaa'idiin ba'iid,asma'o be l-cheyy al-ana sawweetah-!Wa intu al-gaa'idiin gariib,a'arfu gudurti-!
Wa fi Sahyuun al-muznibiin rajafowa l-kuffaar anbahato wa yuguulu-:-Yaatu minnina yagdar yagoodfi l-naar al-tahrig-?Wa yaatu yagdar yagoodfi l-jamur al-daayim-?
Illa l-naadum al-yuruukh fi l-adaalawa yikallim be l-haggwa yaaba maal al-zulum.Wa yihitt iideenahwa yaaba al-rachwawa yisidd adaanahmin kalaam daffigiin al-dammwa yisidd uyuunahachaan ma yichiif al-fasaala.
Al-naadum da yaskun fi l-bakaan al-aaliwa l-jibaal al-gawiyiin yabgo malja'ah.Wa yantuuh akilwa yadmano leyah al-almi.
Wa uyuunak yichiifu al-malik fi jamaalahwa yichiifu al-balad be kulla huduudha.
Wa galbak yifakkir fi l-ru'ub al-awwalwa yuguul-:-Ween al-yahsib-?Wa ween al-yawzin-?Wa ween al-yahsib buyuut al-muraakhaba-?
Wa battaan ma tichiif al-cha'ab al-mutakabbir,al-cha'ab al-kalaamhum gawiwa lukhkhithum ma tin'arif wa la tinfahim.
Chiif Sahyuun madiinat farahna-!Wa uyuunak yichiifu Madiinat al-Khudus aamine.Hi misil kheema al-ma tilhawwalwa wutaadha abadan ma yamurguwa hubaalha abadan ma yilfartago.
Wa Allah yiwassif leena azamatahwa l-bakaan da yabga buhuur wa majaari wasii'iin.Wa maraakib harib ma yadkhulu fooghumwa sufun al-kubaar kula ma yuchugguuhum.
Achaan Allah hu gaadiinawa hu al-haakim foogna.Wa hu maliknawa hu al-yinajjiina.
Wa hubaal sufun al-adu algatta'owa battaan ma yalzamo amuud al-safiinawa ma yarfa'o raayitha.Wa khalaas nigassumu al-khaniime be katarawa l-uruj kula yalgo gisimhum.
Wa waahid min sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus ma yuguul-:-Ana mardaan-.Wa l-cha'ab al-saakniin fi l-madiina diyalgo khufraan khataahum.
Garrubu,ya umam wa asma'o-!Ya cha'ab,khuttu adaanku-!Al-ard wa kulla cheyy al-foogha,aywa,al-dunya wa kulla cheyy al-fiiha,asma'o.
Achaan khadab Allah muwajjah didd kulla l-umamwa za'alah didd kulla duyuuchhum.Hu yidammirhum damaar kaamilwa yiwaddiihum le l-juzur.
Maytiinhum mudaffigiinwa min janaazaathum tatla' afanawa l-jibaal yinballo min dammuhum.
Wa kulla khuwwaat al-sama yi'affunuwa l-sama yatwuuh misil kitaab malfuuf.Wa kulla l-khuwwaat yidaffugumisil warag al-inab al-yaabiswa misil warag al-tiin al-yibis.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Fi l-samaawaat,seefi rawyaan be l-khadabwa daahu yanzil didd balad Adoom,didd al-cha'ab al-ana khassastuhum le l-damaar.
Wa seef Allah malaan be dammwa chab'aan be chahambe damm al-khurfaan wa l-tuyuuswa be chaham kalaawe al-kubchaan.Achaan fiyah dahiiye le Allah fi madiinat Busrawa fi katil katiir fi balad Adoom.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit,yaga'o ma'aahumal-jawaamiis wa l-ajjaal wa l-tiiraan.Arduhum tarwa be l-dammwa turaabhum yiddahhan be l-chaham.
Wa da yoom taar Allahwa di sanit hisaab fi chaan Sahyuun.
Wa wudyaan Adoom yikhayyuruwa yinmalu gutraanwa turaabha yabga kibriitwa l-balad tabga misil gutraan muhrig.
Wa l-gutraan da,naarah ma tumuutwa la leel wa la nahaarwa dukhkhaanah taali' kulla yoom.Wa l-balad tagood kharaab min zurriiye le zurriiyewa naadum ma yufuut beeha battaan.
Wa l-baja' wa abungineefit yawrusuuhawa amguggum wa l-khurbaat yaskunuuha.Wa yawzinha be miizaan al-faadiwa yikiilha be mikyaal al-kharaab.
Wa ma fi kubaaraat al-yidarruju malikwa kulla masaa'iilha yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa gusuurha al-gawiyiin yugumm fooghum chookwa mudunha al-gawiyiin yinmalu be andireesa wa haskaniit.Wa hi tabga margad hana ba'aachiimwa dungur na'aam.
Wa l-gitat yillaago ma'a l-maraaf'iinwa l-tuyuus yinnaado al-waahid le l-aakhar.Wa amguggum talga bakaan tinjammaaywa,hi talga bakaan al-raaha.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-daabi yisawwi uchchahwa yalda beedah wa yiraggid foogahwa yifaggi'ah wa yahmiih.Wa akiid fi l-bakaan da,al-suguura yilimmuayyi waahid ma'a l-aakhar.
Fattuchu fi kitaab Allah wa agru.Ayyi waahid min al-haywaanaat ma gassarwa ayyi waahid yagood ma'a rafiigah.Achaan Allah kallam wa anta izinwa ruuhah bas tilimmuhum.
Hu bas sawwa leehum gisim be am'iyeedaatwa iidah gassamat leehum al-balad be magaas.Wa humman yawrusuuha daaymanwa yaskunu foogha min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Khalli al-sahara wa ard al-jafaaf yafrahowa balad al-yabaas tinawwir wa tinbasit.
Khalli tinmali be nuwwaar al-kadaadewa tinattit wa tal'abwa tizakhrit min al-farah.Allah yanti al-balad di khaaba jamiilemisil khaabat Lubnaanwa ard al-indaha intaaj katiirmisil jabal al-Karmal wa sahalat Chaaruun.Wa yichiifu majd Allahwa azamat Ilaahna.
Gawwu iideeku al-ayyaaniinwa sabbutu rikabbuku al-yarjufu.
Wa guulu le l-guluubhum angata'o-:-Abgo gawiyiin-!Ma takhaafo.Daahu Ilaahku-!Hu yaji yichiil leeku al-taarwa yilkaffa leeku fi udwaanku.Wa hu zaatah yaji yinajjiiku.
Wa khalaas,uyuun al-amyaaniin yinfathuwa udne al-tarchaaniin yasma'o.
Wa l-a'raj yinattit misil al-khazaalwa lisaan al-abkam yi'iit be l-farah.Achaan almi yisiil fi l-saharawa rujuul almi yajru fi kadaadit al-jafaaf.
Al-ard al-haamiye tabga rahadwa l-ard al-atchaane tisiil almi.Wa fi bakaan margad al-ba'aachiim,al-gechch yabga tibin wa birdi.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,yisawwu deribwa yisammuuh al-Derib al-Khaass.Al-ma taahir ma yi'addi beyahwa l-munaafikhiin ma yiwadduru foogahachaan al-derib da le cha'ab Allah bas.
Wa fi l-derib da,ma fi duudwa ayyi haywaan khatiir ma yuruukh foogahwa ma yinlagi.Illa l-naas al-najjaahum Allahyamchu foogah.
Wa l-naas al-fadaahum Allahyigabbulu wa yaju fi Sahyuunbe zakhraat wa farha.Wa farah daayim yinawwir wujuuhhumwa suruur wa farha yikhattuuhumwa l-hizin wa l-ganitiin yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa fi sanit 14 hana hukum Hizkhiiya,Sanhariib malik Achuur hajam kulla l-mudun al-gawiyiin hana mamlakat Yahuuza wa gala'aahum.
Wa min hillit Lakiich,malik Achuur rassal khaayid al-deech le l-malik Hizkhiiya fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa rassal ma'aayah deech kabiir.Wa wakit wassalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus,ga'ado jamb majra al-birke al-aali fi l-derib al-maachi ale zere' al-khassaaliin.
Wa Aliyaakhim wileed Hilkhiiya mas'uul fi gasir al-malik marag min al-madiina le yilaagiih wa macho ma'aayah Chabna al-kaatib wa Yuwaakh wileed Asaaf al-kaatib al-yizakkir al-malik.
Inta tahsib al-kalaam al-baatil yanti raay wa gudra fi l-harib walla-?Wa hassa' da,ale yaatu inta atwakkalt le titmarrad diddi-?
Wa tuguul leyi-:--Ale Allah Ilaahna bas atwakkalna.- Laakin da Hizkhiiya bas al-haddam al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin wa l-madaabih hana ibaadat Allah-!Wa hu gaal le naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus-:--Amchu asjudu giddaam al-madbah al-hini fi Madiinat al-Khudus.--
Wa hassa' be izin Allah,ana gammeet didd al-balad di le nidammirha.Aywa-!Allah bas gaal leyi-:--Gumm didd al-balad di wa dammirha-!-
Wa khalaas,Aliyaakhim wa Chabna wa Yuwaakh raddo le khaayid al-deech wa gaalo leyah-:-Min fadlak,kallim leena aniina khaddaamiinak be l-araamiiye achaan aniina nafhamo al-lukhkha di.Laakin ma tikallim leena be l-ibraaniiye wa la tisammi' al-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi raas al-durdur.
Wa khaayid al-deech gaal leehum-:-Hal kalaam siidi al-rassalaani da bukhussuku intu wa malikku bas walla-?La-!Al-kalaam da bukhuss kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi durdur al-madiina.Humman kula misilku yinjabru yaakulu huraarhum wa yacharbo boolhum-!
Wa ba'ad da,khaayid al-deech gamma be tuulah wa aat be hiss aali be kalaam ibraani wa gaal-:-Asma'o kalaam al-malik al-kabiir wa hu malik balad Achuur.
Daahu al-malik gaal-:--Khalli Hizkhiiya ma yukhuchchuku achaan hu ma yagdar yinajjiiku.
Wa khalli Hizkhiiya ma yiwaddiiku lahaddi titwakkalo ale Allah wa yuguul leeku-:"Akiid Allah yinajjiina wa l-madiina di kula ma taga' fi iideen malik Achuur-!"--
Wa da lahaddi ana nigabbil wa niwaddiiku fi balad misil baladku.Wa l-balad di indaha gameh wa khamar jadiid wa ma'aach wa inab.
Wa khalli Hizkhiiya ma yukhuchchuku wa yuguul-:"Allah yinajjiina-!"Hal ilaahaat al-umam gidro najjo buldaanhum min iid malik Achuur walla-?
Wa ween ilaahaat Hamaat wa Arfad-?Wa ween ilaahaat Safarwaayim-?Hal humman gidro najjo madiinat al-Saamira min iidi walla-?
Wa min kulla ilaahaat al-buldaan dool,yaatu gidir najja baladah minni-?Wa be da,hal Allah yagdar yinajji Madiinat al-Khudus minni walla-?-
Wa laakin al-cha'ab sakato ma raddo leyah be ayyi kilme achaan al-malik Hizkhiiya amaraahum wa gaal-:-Ma turuddu leyah.
Wa akuun Allah Ilaahak yasma' kalaam khaayid al-deech al-siidah malik balad Achuur rassalah le yi'ayyir Allah al-Hayy.Wa akuun Allah Ilaahak yasma' kalaamah wa yi'aakhibah.Hassa' da,as'al Allah fi chaan al-cha'ab al-faddalo.-
Wa khalaas,malik balad Achuur simi' khabar.Wa l-khabar da buguul-:-Tirhaakha malik balad al-Habacha gamma jaayi le yihaaribak. Wa min simi' be l-khabar da,malik Achuur rassal murassaliin le Hizkhiiya wa gaal leehum-:
Amchu le Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa guulu leyah-:--Khalli Ilaahak al-inta gaa'id titwakkal aleyah da ma yukhuchchak wa yuguul leek-:"Madiinat al-Khudus ma taga' fi iideen malik Achuur-!"
Wa Hizkhiiya sa'al Allah wa gaal-:
Ya Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil-!Inta al-gaa'id fi archak foog al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.Inta wiheedak bas Ilaah kulla mamaalik al-ard-!Wa inta bas al-khalagt al-samaawaat wa l-ard-!
Ya Allah,khutt adaanak wa asma'ni-!Ya Allah,aftah uyuunak wa chiif-!Wa asma' kulla kalaam Sanhariib malik Achuur al-rassalah le yi'ayyirak inta,al-Ilaah al-Hayy.
Ya Allah,akiid muluuk Achuur dammaro kulla l-chu'uub wa buldaanhum.
Wa hassa',ya Allah Ilaahna,najjiina min iid Sanhariib.Wa be da,kulla mamaalik al-ard ya'arfu kadar inta wiheedak bas Allah.
Le yaatu inta ayyartahwa achchammat foogah-?Wa didd yaatu inta kallamtwa chift be istikbaar-?Da diddi ana,Khudduus Israa'iil-!
Be waasitat khaddaamiinak al-rassaltuhum,inta ayyart al-Rabb wa gult-:"Be katarat arabaati,ana tala't fi ruuse al-jibaallahaddi dakhalt fi Lubnaan daakhalle nagta' chadarha hana l-arz al-tuwaalwa chadarha hana l-sarwi al-sameh.Wa namchi lahaddi nalhag al-jabal al-aali marra waahidwa fi usut khaabaatha al-dulum.
Wa ana nakat biyaarwa chiribt almiihumwa be fajkhat rijli,yabbast kulla rujuul Masir."
--Wa laakin,ya Sanhariib,inta ma fihimtkadar min wakit tawiil,ana kharrart al-cheyy da.Wa min zamaan,ana kawwantahwa hassa',nihaggigah.Wa inta kamaan,gaa'id tidammir al-mudun al-gawiyiinwa yabgo koom hana turaab.
Wa sukkaanhum ma induhum gudrawa khaafo wa khijlo.Humman yibsomisil gechch al-kadaade wa nabaat al-akhdarwa misil gechch fi ruuse al-buyuutwa misil al-ziraa'a al-yibso gubbaal ma yisawwu ageeg.
Wa laakin ana na'arif wakit inta tagoodwa wakit tamrug wa wakit tigabbilwa wakit tarjif min al-za'al diddi.
Wa l-nijo min Bani Yahuuzawa faddaloyabgo misil chadara al-tidiss uruugha min jadiid fi l-ardwa furuu'ha yinmalu be fawaakih.
Achaan min Madiinat al-Khudusyamurgu al-naas al-faddalo.Aywa,min jabal Sahyuunyamurgu humman al-nijo.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir yisawwiihhasab mahabbitah al-chadiide.
Wa khalaas,malak Allah ja darab mu'askar al-Achuuriyiin wa katal 185-000 raajil.Wa be fajur wakit gammo,al-faddalo minhum chaafo kulla l-janaazaat dool.
Wa khalaas,Sanhariib malik Achuur gabbal wa macha ga'ad fi madiinat Niinawa.
Wa yoom waahid,Sanhariib macha fi beet Nisruuk ilaahah le ya'abudah.Wa iyaalah al-itneen Adramalik wa Charaasar dakhalo darabooh wa katalooh be l-seef wa arrado macho le balad Araraat.Wa wileedah Isar Hadduun hakam fi badalah.
Wa Hizkhiiya wajjah ale l-durdur wa sa'al Allah.
Wa gaal-:-Ya Allah,fakkir foogi ana al-taaba't derbak be sidikh wa be galib mukhlis wa sawweet kulla cheyy al-inta tidoorah-! Wa Hizkhiiya baka baki chadiid.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Icha'ya wa gaal-:
Amchi guul le Hizkhiiya-:--Daahu Allah Ilaah jiddak Dawuud gaal-:"Ana simi't su'aalak wa chift dumuu'ak al-daffago.Wa daahu ana niziid leek 15 sana fi umrak.
Wa ninajjiik inta wa l-madiina di min iid malik balad Achuur.Aywa,nahmi al-madiina di.
Wa daahu nantiik alaama min Allah,al-tiwassif kadar hu yitimm al-kalaam al-gaalah leek.
Wa nikaskis al-dull be achara darajaat fi darajaat atabat Ahaaz."--Wa khalaas,al-harraay gabbalat wara be achara darajaat min al-darajaat al-awwal nazalat foogah.
Daahu al-kalaam al-katabah Hizkhiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wakit hu mardaan wa ligi al-aafe min maradah.
Ana gult-:--Be gudurti bas,namchi le l-mootwa l-baagi min umri,nagood ma'a l-maytiin.--
Wa gult-:--Battaan ma nichiif Allahfi ard al-hayyiin.Wa battaan ma nichiif wijih insaanmin sukkaan al-dunya.--
Wa hayaati maragooha wa waddooha ba'iid minnimisil kheemat al-raa'i.Wa misil tarraar al-tchaaka,hayaati kammalat wa jaat fi aakhirhawa khuyuutha algatta'o.Min yoom le aakhar,tintahi minni.
Lahaddi l-sabaah,ana fakkart fi haalti.Misil duud,al-Rabb kassarkulla udaami.Ya Rabb,min yoom le aakhar,tintahi minni.

Ya cha'abi-!Ma tarjufu wa la tinbahtu-!Ana ma khabbartuku beyah min zamaanwa ooreetku walla-?Intu chuhuudi-!Hal fi ilaah aakhar balaayi ana walla-?La-!Ana bas jabalku al-gawi.Ma na'arif aakhar-!
Al-yasna'o al-asnaam,kulluhum ma yanfa'o.Amalhum al-khaali leehumkula ma indah faayde.Chuhuudhum amyaaniinwa ma ya'arfu cheyy.Wa fi chaan da,yalgo al-eeb.
Wa yaatu sana' ilaahwa dagga sanam hana hadiidwa ligi faayde-?
Wa daahu kulla l-ya'abuduuhumyalgo al-eebwa l-yasna'oohum,humman naas bas-!Khalli kulluhum yilimmu wa yajuwa kulluhum sawa yarjufu wa yalgo al-eeb.
Le yisawwi sanam,al-haddaadi yidiss al-hadiid fi l-naarwa yuduggah be mitragawa be duraa'ah al-gawi,yisawwiih.Wa laakin kan al-haddaadi da yujuu',gudurtah tikammilwa kan al-atach yakurbah,yaksal.
Wa najjaar al-khachab yigaawisah be kheetwa yarsimah be fahamwa yanjurah be najjaarawa yarsimah be aala.Wa yisawwi suurat insaanwa yijammilah misil naadumwa yukhuttah fi beet.
Awwal hu gata' chadar al-arzwa chaal chadar al-sindiyaan wa l-balluutwa kabbaraahum ma'a chadar al-khaabawa maggan chadar al-sanoobarwa l-matar kabbarah.
Wa dool yabgo le l-insaan hatab le l-naarwa yichiilhum wa yiddaffa beehumwa yidissuhum fi l-naar le yisawwi beehum akil.Wa be l-faddal min al-hatab,yisawwi ilaahwa yarka' leyah.Aywa-!Yisawwi sanamwa yasjud giddaamah-!
Wa hu yahrig nuss hatabah fi l-naarwa yinajjid beyah lahamahwa yagliih wa yaakulah.Wa yiddaffa fi l-naar wa yuguul-:-Ha-!Ha-!Niddaffa wa nichiif hamaarha.
Wa laakin be l-faddal min al-hatab,hu yi'addil ilaah.Aywa,yisawwi sanamwa yarka' wa yasjud giddaamah-!Wa yas'alah wa yuguul leyah-:-Najjiini achaan inta bas ilaahi-!
Wa l-naas dool wa la ya'arfuwa la yafhamo.Achaan uyuunhum masduudiin,ma yichiifuwa humman mugaffaliin,ma yafhamo.
Wa ma fi insaan al-galbah yigabbilahle l-ma'rafa wa l-fihim le yuguul-:-Ana harragt nuss hatabi fi l-naarwa sawweet khubza be l-jamurwa galeet laham wa akaltah.Wa be l-faddal,sawweet cheyy muharramwa narka' giddaam gita' al-hatab-!
Hu yinrabit fi rumaadwa galbah al-makhchuuch yiwaddirah.Hu ma yinajji nafsah wa la yuguul-:-Al-fi iidi al-zeene ma khachch walla-?
Fakkir fi l-kalaam da,ya Yaakhuub-!Achaan inta abdi,ya Israa'iil-!Ana khalagtak le tabga abdi,ya Israa'iil,ana ma nansaak.
Misil al-riih tichiil al-sahaab,ana maheet zunuubak.Wa misil al-riih tichiil al-khamaam,ana gachcheet khataayaak.Gabbil leyiachaan ana fadeetak.
Ya l-samaawaat,zakhrutuachaan Allah sawwa al-cheyy da-!Afrahe,ya ard al-tihit-!Wa ya jibaalwa intu al-khaabaat wa kulla chadarku,khannu be l-farah-!Achaan Allah fada Yaakhuubwa yiwassif majdah fi Israa'iil.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-fadaak wa kawwanaak fi batun ammak.Hu gaal-:-Ana bas Allah-!Ana khalagt kulla cheyy.Ana wiheedi falleet al-samaawaatwa wakit faracht al-ard,yaatu ma'aayi-?
Ana fachchalt alaamaat al-kaddaabiin wa l-chawwaafiinachaan ma induhum ma'ana.Wa galabt kalaam al-hukamawa ilimhum,sawweetah ma indah faayde.
Ana nihaggig kalaam abdiwa nitimm khittat rusuli.Nuguul le Madiinat al-Khudus-:--Khalli yaskunuuha-!--Wa le hillaal balad Yahuuza-:--Khalli yabnuuhum min jadiid-!--Wa nigawwim daraadirhumal-daffago.
Wa nuguul le l-almi al-khariig-:--Abga yaabis wa niyabbis buhuurak-!--

Wa daahu Allah gaal le l-naadum al-hu masahah wa darrajah malik-:-Leek inta,ya Kuurach,ana karabtak min iidak al-zeenele narmi al-umam giddaamak.Ana nihill hizaam al-muluukwa nufukk giddaamak biibaan al-mudunwa battaan ma yukuunu magfuuliin.
Ana zaati namchi giddaamakwa le l-giizaan,nisaawiihum.Wa le biibaan al-nahaas,nikassirhumwa le gafala al-hadiid,nifallithum.
Ana nantiik kanz al-madfuun fi l-dalaamwa l-khuna al-mulabbada.Wa be da,inta ta'arifkadar ana Allah basnaadeetak be usmak,ana Ilaah Bani Israa'iil.

Ana kawwant al-nuurwa khalagt al-dalaam.Wa sawweet al-salaamwa khalagt al-fasaalawa ana Allah nisawwi kulla l-cheyy.
Khalli al-sama min foog tinazzil al-karanywa l-sahaab yinazzil al-adaala.Wa khalli al-ard tinfatihwa tamrug al-najawa tinawwir al-adaala.Ana Allah bas khalagtuhum.
Al-azaab le l-naadum al-yihaarij al-kawwanahhu al-misil jarr al-tiine fi ust al-jiraar.Hal al-tiine tagdar tuguul le l-yuduggaha-:-Tisawwi chunu-?-Hal al-jarr yagdar yuguul le l-daggaag-:-Inta ma indak iid walla-?
Al-azaab le l-yuguul le abuuh-:-Maala jibt iyaal-?-Al-azaab le l-yuguul le ammah-:-Maala wilidti-?
Wa daahu Allah Khudduus Israa'iil al-kawwanaahum gaal-:-As'alooni fi achya hana l-mustakhbalwa laakin kan le iyaaliwa l-achya al-sawweethum be iidi,khalluuhum leyi ana bas.
Ana bas sawweet al-ardwa khalagt al-insaan al-yaskunu foogha.Be iidi ana bas,falleet al-samaawaatwa anteet amur le kulla khuwwaatha.
Ana bas jibt Kuurach le yisawwi al-adaalawa ni'addil kulla duruubah.Hu yabni battaan madiintiwa cha'abi al-waddoohum fi l-khurbayatlighum bala taman wa la ujra.-Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Natiijat Masirwa ribih min balad al-Habachawa rujaal Saba al-tuwaal,kulla l-achya dool yawsalo leek wa yabgo hanaak.Al-naas dool yamchu waraak.Humman dool yamchu mujanzariinwa yasjudu giddaamakwa yachhadook wa yuguulu-:--Sahiih Allah ma'aakwa ma fi ilaah illa huwa ma fi ilaah aakhar.-
Akiid,inta Ilaah al-ma tinchaafwa inta Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-munajji-!
Wa l-yasna'o al-asnaam,kulluhum aaybiin wa khajlaaniinwa kulluhum sawa maachiin fi l-khajla.
Laakin kan le Bani Israa'iil,Allah yinajjiihumwa l-naja di ila l-abad.Wa battaan intu ma tabgo aaybiin wa la khajlaaniin,daayman wa ila l-abad.
Achaan daahu kalaam Allah,khaalig al-samaawaat wa hu al-Ilaah al-sawwa al-ard wa kawwanha wa sabbatha.Hu ma khalagaaha le tagood faadiye laakin kawwanha le yaskunuuha.Hu gaal-:-Ana Allah wa ma fi ilaah illa ana.
Ana ma hajjeet be sirrfi bakaan adlam fi l-ard.Wa ana ma gult le zurriiyit Yaakhuub-:--Fattuchuuni fi l-faadi-!--Ana Allah nihajji be l-adaalawa nikallim be l-hagg.
Limmu wa ta'aalu-!Garrubu sawa,intu al-faddaltu min al-umam-!Intu ma ta'arfu cheyy,intu al-chaayliin asnaamku hana hatabwa tas'alo ilaahaatku al-ma yinajjuuku.
Khabburu wa garrubuwa limmu sawa wa achchaawaro-!Yaatu hajja beyah min zamaanwa khabbar beyah min al-wakit al-faat-?Ma ana Allah walla-?Wa la ilaah illa ana-!Ana Ilaah al-saadikh wa l-munajjiwa ma fi ilaah aakhar illa ana.
Intu kulluku al-fi aakhir al-ard,wajjuhu aleyi ana wa tanjo-!Achaan ana Allahwa la ilaah illa ana.
Ana halaft be nafsi wa gultmin khachmi yamrug kalaam al-adaalawa l-kalaam da ma yinnagid.Kulla rukba tabruk giddaamiwa ayyi lisaan yachhad kadar ana Allah.
Wa yihajju beyi wa yuguulu-:--Fi Allah bas yinlagual-nasur wa l-gudra.--Kulla l-gammo be za'al diddiyaju giddaami aaybiin.
Wa beyi ana Allah,kulla zurriiyit Israa'iilyabgo saalihiin wa yahmuduuni.
Al-ilaah Biil barakwa l-ilaah Nabu dangar.Asnaamhum,chaddoohumfi l-haywaanaat wa l-bahaayim.Al-asnaam al-intu chiltuuhum dabigo himil wa tagalale l-bahaayim al-ayyaaniin.
Al-ilaahaat dool dangaro wa barako sawawa ma gidro yinajju tamaasiilhum al-tugaal.Wa humman zaathum yichiiluuhumwa yiwadduuhum fi l-khurba.
Asma'ooni,ya zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa kulluku al-faddaltu min Bani Israa'iil-!Ana chilt mas'uuliiyitkumin intu fi butuun ammahaatku.Min wildooku,ana chiltuku.
Lahaddi tichayyubu,ana nukuun ma'aakuwa lahaddi be cheebku kula,ana nilhammalku.Ana bas khalagtuku wa nichiilkuwa ana bas nilhammalku wa ninajjiiku.
Be yaatu tichabbuhuuni-?Wa ma'a yaatu tisaawuuni-?Wa ma'a yaatu tigaaduruuni achaan nukuunu sawa-?
Naas waahidiin yusubbu al-dahab min makhaaliihumwa yawzunu al-fudda fi l-miizaan.Wa yikaffu sayyaakhile yudugg leehum sanam ilaahwa le l-ilaah da,humman yarka'o wa yasjudu.
Wa l-ilaah da,yichiiluuh fi kataafeehum wa yahmuluuhwa yukhuttuuh fi bakaanah wa yagood,ma yilharrak min bakaanah da.Kan yikooruku leyah,ma yuruddwa fi l-diige kula,ma yafza'.
Azzakkaro al-cheyy da wa abgo rujaal-!Fakkuru foogah,ya l-aasiyiin-!
Fakkuru fi l-achyaal-bigo awwal min zamaan.Achaan ana Allah wa la ilaah illa anawa ma fi ilaah misli ana.
Wa min al-bidaaya,ana nikhabbir be l-yaji fi l-mustakhbalwa min zamaan,ana khabbart be l-achya al-lissaa' ma bigo.Wa gult-:--Niiyti tilhaggagwa kulla l-dawwartah,nisawwiih.--
Wa ana ninaadi min al-sabaahraajil misil sagur.Ninaadiih min balad ba'iidele yihaggig niiyti.Al-gultah,yukuunwa l-kharrartah,nihaggigah.
Asma'ooni,ya l-ruuseeku gawiyiinwa intu al-ba'iidiin min al-adaala-!
Wa ana nigarrib adaalti al-hi ma ba'iidewa ninajjiiku bala ta'khiir.Wa fi Sahyuun,nijiib al-najawa fi Israa'iil,nijiib majdi.
Anzili wa agoodi tihit fi l-rumaad,ya madiinat Baabil al-misil bineeye udriiye-!Agoodi fi l-turaab bala kursi,ya bineeyit al-Baabiliyiin-!Achaan battaan ma yinaaduukijamiile wa l-latiife.
Chiili murhaakawa arhake dagiig.Amurgi tarhitki min raaskiwa gilli khalagki.Akchifi dawaarijkiwa chuggi al-buhuur.
Wa tinkachif ooritki wa yinchaaf eebki.Ana nichiil al-taarwa ma fi naadum al-yiwaggifni.

Ya bineeyit al-Baabiliyiinagoodi saakit wa amchi fi l-dalaam.Achaan battaan ma yinaaduukimalikat al-mamaalik.
Ana khidibt didd cha'abiwa ma ahtaramt warasatiwa sallamtuhum leeki fi iidki.Laakin inti aamaltiihum bala rahmawa fi l-chaayib,khatteeti himilki al-tagiil ziyaada.

Laakin al-achya al-itneen doolyajuuki be sur'a,fi yoom waahid bas,tiwaddiri iyaalki wa tabge armala.Hatta be katarat sihirkiwa gudrat jannaaniyiinki kula,al-achya dool yaju foogki be chidde.
Inti atwakkalti fi fasaalitki wa gulti-:--Ma fi naadum yichiifni-!--Wa hikmitkiwa ma'rafatki laffo raaski.Wa gulti fi galibki-:--Ana bas gaa'ide,ma fi cheyy balaayi-!--
Laakin yajiiki balaal-inti ma ta'arfi tamurgi minnahwa taga' foogki masiibeal-ma tagdare tadhareehawa be khafla,yajiiki kharaabal-yoom waahid ma chiftiih.
Aywa,agoodi be jannaaniyiinki wa be katarat sihirkial-ayyeeti fooghum nafiski min inti sabiiye-!Akuun tagdare talge minhum faayde-!Akuun beehum tirajjifi naas aakhariin-!
Inti iyiiti min katarat al-choora.Khalaas,khalli munajjimiinki yinajjuuki-!Humman bas yigassumu al-samawa yichawwufu be l-nujuum.Wa yi'arrufuuki fi kulli chaharbe ayyi cheyy al-yaji foogki.
Wa daahu humman bigomisil al-gechch al-taakulah al-naar,ma yagdaro yinajju nufuushummin al-lahiib.Wa di ma naar hint jamural-yisawwu foogha akilwa la naar hint hatabal-yiddaffo foogha.
Wa munajjimiinki yabgo misil da,humman al-ayyeeti nafiski fooghum,humman tujjaarki min inti sabiiye.Hassa',ayyi waahid minhum yajri ale haalahwa yiwadduru,ma yinajjuuki.
Asma'o,ya zurriiyit Yaakhuub,intu al-yinaaduuku be usum Israa'iilwa maragtu min sulub Yahuuza.Asma'o,intu al-tahalfu be usum Allahwa tazkuru Ilaah Bani Israa'iillaakin bala amaan wa bala adaala.

Al-achya al-awwal bigo,ana khabbart beehum min zamaan.Wa be khachmi,ana hajjeet beehumwa ballakht beehum.Faj'atan ana sawweethumwa humman bigo.

Intu simi'tu wa chiftu kulla l-achya doolwa ma ti'tarufu beehum walla-?-Wa hassa',ana ni'ooriikube achya jadiidiin wa mahfuudiinal-intu ma ta'arfuuhum.

Aywa,intu ma simi'tu cheyy wa la iriftu cheyy,wa abadan ma khatteetu udneeku-!Achaan ana na'arifku intu khaayniinwa min fi butuun ammahaatku,yinaaduuku mutamarridiin.

Wa muluuk yirabbuuhumwa mayaarim yiraddi'anhum.Yaga'o fi l-ardwa yasjudu giddaamkiwa yalhaso ajaaj rijileenki.Wa be da,inti ta'arfi kadar ana bas Allahwa l-yukhutt achamah foogi,ma yalga eeb.
Khaniimit al-faaris tinchaal walla-?Wa l-masjuun yagdar yinbalis min iid al-jaayir walla-?
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Akiid khaniimit al-faaris tinchaalwa l-masjuun yinbalis min iid al-jaayir-!Al-yihaarujuuki,ana bas nihaarijhumwa iyaalki,ana bas ninajjiihum.
Al-yidaayuguuki,ana ni'akkilhum lahamhumwa yaskaro be dammuhum misil khamar jadiid.Wa ayyi makhluug hayy ya'arifkadar al-yinajjiiki,da ana Allahwa l-yafdaaki,da ana hu al-Jabbaar,Ilaah Yaakhuub.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Sahiih ana taradt ammuku.Ween maktuub al-talaag-?Wa le yaatu ana bi'tuku le nikaffi deeni-?A'arfu-!Be sabab khataaku bas,baa'ookuwa be sabab isyaanku,tallago ammuku.
Wakit ana jiit,maala ma fi naadum-?Wakit naadeet,maala naadum ma radda leyi-?Hal iidi gisayre lahaddi ma tafda walla-?Wa hal ma indi ayyi gudra le ninajji walla-?A'arfu-!Ana nikichch le l-bahar wa niyabbisahwa le l-wudyaan,nisawwiihum sahara.Min gillit almi al-huut yumuutaywa,min al-atach hu yumuut wa yi'affin.
Wa nilabbis al-samaawaat be l-dalaamwa nikhattiihum be khalag al-hizin.
Allah al-Rabb antaani lisaan al-talaamiizachaan be kalaaminagdar nisaa'id al-ayyaan.Kulli sabaah,hu yigawwimni min al-noomwa yufukk adaani le nasma' misil al-talaamiiz.
Allah al-Rabb fakka adaaniwa ana wa la isiit wa la gabbalt wara.
Ana anteet dahari le l-yafurchuuniwa anteet digni le l-yimallutuuhawa ma labbadt wijhi min al-mu'yaar wa l-buzaakh.
Laakin Allah al-Rabb faza'niwa be da,ana ma ligiit ihaana.Wa alhammalt wa bigiit saabit misil al-hajarachaan na'arif ma nalga al-eeb.
Al-yibarriini gariib-!Yaatu al-yachkiini-?Khalli nagiifu giddaam al-charii'a-!Yaatu al-yathamni-?Khalli yigarrib leyi-!
Daahu Allah al-Rabb jaayi leyi faza'.Yaatu al-yihaakimni-?Daahu udwaani kulluhummisil khalag gadiim al-akalatah al-itte.
Yaatu minku yakhaaf min Allahwa yasma' kalaam abdah-?Ayyi naadum al-yamchi fi l-dalaam bala deyy,khalli yitwakkal ale Allahwa yintakil ale Ilaahah.
Wa kan leeku intu kulluku al-oogadtu naarwa sawweetu machaahiib,yalla amchu fi deyy naarkuwa fi usut machaahiib al-intu oogadtuuhum-!Allah yisawwiikutumuutu fi l-ta'ab-!
Asma'ooni,intu al-tajru wara l-adaalawa titaabu'uuni ana Allah.Intu misil hajar al-gata'ooh min jabal.Azzakkaro al-jabal al-gata'ooku minnahwa l-nugra al-maragooku minha.
Azzakkaro abuuku Ibraahiimwa Saara ammuku al-wildatku.Achaan wakit ana naadeetah,hu gaa'id wiheedahwa ana baaraktahwa kattart zurriiytah.
Aywa-!Allah yisabbir Sahyuunwa hu yisabbirha fi kulla kharaabha.Hu yisawwi kadaaditha misil jineenit Adinwa saharatha misil jineenit Allah.Wa yinlagu foogha al-farah wa l-suruurwa l-chukur wa hiss al-musiikha.
Khuttu baalku leyi,ya cha'abi-!Wa khuttu adaanku leyi,ya ummati-!Achaan al-wasaaya maargiin minni anawa adaalti tabga nuur le l-chu'uubwa ninazzilha leehum be sur'a.
Adaalti gariibe wa najaati tajiwa be duraa'i,nihaakim al-chu'uub.Wa foogi ana,sukkaan al-jazaayir yukhuttu achamhumwa humman yarjo duraa'i.
Arfa'o uyuunku wa chiifu al-samawa ba'ad da,danguru wa chiifu al-ard.Achaan al-sama yabga ma fiihwa yufuut misil al-dukhkhaan.Wa l-ard tagdammisil khalag al-mucharratwa sukkaanha yumuutumisil dubbaan.Laakin najaati tagood ila l-abadwa adaalti ma tafchul.
Asma'ooni intu al-ta'arfu al-adaala,intu al-cha'ab al-wasiiyaati gaa'idiin fi guluubku-!Ma takhaafo wakit al-naas yi'ayyubuukuwa ma tinbahtu wakit yi'ayyuruuku.
Achaan al-itte taakulhum misil khalagwa l-suusa taakulhum misil suuf al-khanam.Wa laakin adaalti tagood daaymanwa najaati tagood min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Gumm-!Gumm foog-!Wa abga gawi-!Ya duraa' Allah-!Gumm misil fi l-ayyaam al-zamaanwa fi wakit al-zurriiyaat al-faato-!Ma inta bas al-chattat Masirwa ta'ant al-khuul-?
Ma inta al-yabbast al-baharwa almi al-khariig walla-?Ma inta al-sawweet derib fi ga'ar al-baharle yi'addu beyah al-naas al-inta fadeethum walla-?
Wa l-naas al-fadaahum Allah yigabbuluwa yaju fi Sahyuun be zakhraatwa farha daayme tinawwir wujuuhhum.Al-suruur wa l-farha yikhattuuhumwa l-diige wa l-ganitiin yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana-!Ana bas al-nisabbirku.Maala intu takhaafomin al-insaan al-yumuut-?Maala takhaafo min Bani Adamal-yaybas misil al-gechch-?
Intu nisiitu Allah al-khalagaakual-falla al-samaawaat wa assas al-ard.Daayman wa kulla yoom tarjufu min khadab al-yidaayigkumisil hu jaahiz le yidammirku.Wa laakin ween al-khadab al-yidaayigku-?
Gariib al-masjuun al-ta'baanyalga al-hurriiye.Hu ma yumuut fi l-sijinwa l-akil kula ma yigassir leyah.
Achaan ana Allah Ilaahku al-gawwamt al-baharlahaddi tinsami' harakat moojahwa usmi Allah al-Gaadir.
Ana khatteet kalaami fi khachmakwa labbadtak fi lubb iidi.Ana bas al-falleet al-samaawaatwa assast al-ardwa gult le naas Sahyuun-:--Intu bas cha'abi.-
Gummi-!Gummi foog,ya Madiinat al-Khudus-!Gummi,inti al-chiribtimin kaas khadab Allah al-fi iidah.Da l-kaas al-yiliff al-raaswa inti chiribtiih lahaddi kammaltiih.
Min kulla iyaal Sahyuun al-wildathum,ma fi naadum waahid al-yuguudha.Wa min kulla iyaalha al-kabbarathum,ma fi naadum waahid al-yakrub iidha.
Ya Sahyuun,al-achya dool jo foogki itneen itneen.Fi l-kharaab wa l-damaar,yaatu al-yisabbirki-?Wa fi l-juu' wa l-harib,yaatu al-yihanniski-?
Wa iyaalki ma induhum gudrawa mudaffigiin fi kulla machbak al-chawaari'misil teetal al-waga'at fi l-charak.Wa khadab Allah lihighum ziyaadaaywa,tahdiid Ilaahki.
Wa fi chaan da,asma'e al-kalaam da,inti al-ta'baane,inti al-sakraane laakin ma be mariise.
Daahu kalaam Allah Rabbiki,Ilaahki al-yidaafi' le huguug cha'abah.Hu gaal-:-Akiid ana chilt min iidki al-kaas al-yiliff al-raaswa battaan ma tacharbe min kaas khadabi.
Al-kaas da nukhuttahfi iid al-azzabooki wa daayagookiwa gaalo leeki-:--Anbathi achaan nuruukhu foogki-!--Wa inti farachti daharki misil al-ardwa misil chaari' al-naas yuruukhu foogah.
Gummi-!Gummi foog-!Wa abge gawiiye,ya madiinat Sahyuun-!Albase khulgaanki hana l-charaf,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,al-madiina al-mukhaddasa-!Achaan battaan ma yadkhul foogkial-ma mutahhar wa l-ma taahir.
Hitti al-ajaaj minkiwa gummi wa agoodi be heelki,ya Madiinat al-Khudus al-masjuuna-!Wa hilli al-jinziir min ragabatki,ya l-makruuba,ya Sahyuun al-misil bineeye-!
Achaan daahu Allah gaal-:-Baa'ooku bala tamanlaakin yafdooku bala gurus.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Awwal fi Masir,cha'abi nazalo wa ga'adowa fi l-akhiir,balad Achuur zalamathum.
Hassa' da,nisawwi chunu-?Achaan cha'abi waddoohum bala taman.Wa da kalaam Allah.Wa l-yahkumu fooghum yiragrugu min al-farahwa daayman yahguru usmi.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Fi chaan da,cha'abi ya'arfu usmifi chaan da,fi l-yoom da ya'arfukadar ana bas gaa'id nihajji leehumwa nuguul-:--Daahuuni ana.-
Marhaban be jayyit al-mursaal fi l-jibaalal-yiballikh al-bichaarawa yikhabbir be l-salaam wa l-kheer wa l-naja.Wa yuguul le Sahyuun-:-Ilaahki yahkim-!
Asma'e-!Hurraaski yarfa'o hissuhumwa yiragrugu sawa min al-farah-!Achaan be uyuunhum chaafo Allahmugabbil le madiinat Sahyuun-!
Afraho sawa wa ragrugu,ya masaakiin Madiinat al-Khudus al-kharbaane-!Achaan Allah sabbar cha'abahwa fada Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Allah bayyan iidah al-mukhaddasale kulla l-umam.Wa kulla sukkaan al-ardyichiifu al-naja al-yantiiha Ilaahna-!
Siiru-!Siiru-!Amurgu min hinaak,ya intu al-chaayliin mu'iddaat Allah.Amurgu min lubb Baabilwa tahhuru nufuuskuwa ma talmaso cheyy nijis-!
Fi l-marra di,ma tamurgu be sur'awa ma tamurgu misil al-mu'arridiin.Achaan Allah bas maachi giddaamkuaywa,Ilaah Bani Israa'iil bas maachi waraaku.
Daahu abdi yanjahwa yinrafi' wa yabga aaliwa yalga charaf marra waahid.
Awwal,naas katiiriin anbahato minnahachaan chabahah khayyar bigi cheenlahaddi ma yichaabih insaanwa chaklah ma yichaabih chakil ibn Adam.
Wa laakin hassa',umam katiiriin yil'ajjabo minnahwa muluuk yaskutu.Achaan yichiifu al-ma hajjoohum beyahwa yanzuru al-ma sim'o beyah.
Yaatu al-aaman be l-khabbaroona beyah-?Wa gudrat Allah baanat le yaatu-?
Abd Allah kibir giddaamah misil bizrewa misil irig al-marag min ard jafaaf.Hu ma indah chakilwa la azama le nichiifuuhwa la indah chabah al-ya'ajib.
Al-naas abooh wa hagaroohwa hu raajil al-waja'wa muwaalif be l-ta'ab.Hu misil naadum al-naas anlafato minnah,hu al-hagarooh wa aniina ma ja'alnaah.
Akiid,al-ta'ab al-foogna aniina,hu zaatah chaalahwa l-waja' al-foogna,hu bas himlah.Laakin aniina kamaan ja'alnaahmisil naadum al-aakhabah al-Rabbwa darabah wa ahaanah.
Wa laakin ta'anooh fi chaan isyaanna aniinawa ta''abooh fi chaan khataana al-sawweenaah.Al-azaab al-waga' foogah huyadman leena al-salaam.Wa be sabab juruuhah,aniina ligiina al-chifa.
Aniina kullina misil khanam al-muwaddiriin,ayyi waahid chaayil leyah derib.Wa Allah khatta foogah hukhataana aniina kullina.
Hu azzabooh wa ahaanoohwa ma fakka khachmah.Misil hamal al-yiwadduuh le l-dabihwa misil na'aje saakte wakit yigassusu suufha,hu kula ma fakka khachmah.
Wa be mudaayaga wa charii'a,waddooh.Wa min naas zamanah,yaatu al-hamma beyah-?Laakin fasalooh min al-hayyiinbe sabab isyaan cha'abi wa katalooh.
Khatto khaburah ma'a l-aasiyiinwa satarooh ma'a l-khaniyiin,hatta kan hu ma sawwa unuf kulawa fi khachmah,ma fi khachch.
Wa Allah ridi yarhakah be l-ta'abWa kan hayaatah bigat dahiiye le kaffaarat al-khata,khalaas hu yichiif zurriiytah.Hu yitawwil ayyaam umrahwa niiyit Allah tilhaggag beyah hu.
Wa ba'ad ta'abah,hu yichiif nuur al-hayawa yachba' minnah.Wa be ta'abah,abdi al-saalihyisawwi naas katiiriin saalihiinachaan hu himil khataahum.
Wa fi chaan da,nantiih gisim ma'a naas katiiriinwa yalga gisim al-khaniime ma'a naas chudaad.Achaan hu anta nafsah le l-mootwa hasabooh ma'a l-aasiyiin.Laakin hu himil zanib al-katiiriinwa daafa' le l-aasiyiin.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Zakhriti,ya Madiinat al-Khudus al-aagre,inti al-ma wilidti-!Iiti be farah wa zakhriti,inti al-ma dukhti waja' al-talaga-!Achaan iyaal al-mutallaga yabgo katiiriinmin iyaal al-mara al-gaa'ide ma'a raajilha.
Wassi'i bakaan kheemitkiwa filli gita' maskanki bala hisaabwa tawwili hubaalhawa sabbiti wutaadha.
Achaan inti tiziidi ale l-isra wa l-zeenewa zurriiyitki yagla'o ard al-umamwa yaskunu al-mudun al-kharaab.
Ma takhaafe achaan al-eeb ma yakrubkiwa ma takhjale achaan ma talge al-ihaana.Wa laakin tanse al-eeb hana subaakiwa ma tizzakkare ihaanitki wakit inti armala.
Achaan al-khalagaaki,hu misil raajilkiwa usmah Allah al-Gaadir.Wa l-yafdaaki,hu Khudduus Israa'iilwa yinaaduuh Ilaah kulla l-ard.
Ana Allah naadeetkimisil mara mutallaga al-galibha majruuh.Wa ana Ilaahki gult-:--Mart al-suba,ma waajib tilkhalla.--
Le mudda gisayre bas,ana khalleetkiwa laakin be rahmati al-wasii'e,nigabbilki battaan.
Wa fi khadabi al-chadiid,ana ma wajjaht aleeki le wakit gisayyirwa laakin be mahabbiti al-daaymeana narhamki.-Da kalaam Allah al-yafdaaki.
Wa da,ana nichiifahmisil almi al-ja fi ayyaam Noohwakit ana halaft wa gult-:--Battaan ma yaji almi misil da fi l-ard.--Wa hassa' da,nahlif leeki inti kulakadar battaan ma nakhdab leekiwa la nikhawwifki.
Hatta kan al-jibaal yilhawwalowa l-hujaar yinhazzo kula,mahabbiti ma tikiss minkiwa mu'aahadati hint al-salaam ma tingati'.-Da kalaam Allah al-yarhamki.
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus al-miskiine,chaalatki al-riihwa ma fi naadum al-yihanniski.Ana nabniiki be hujaar khaaliyiinwa nukhutt asaaski fi yaakhuut akhdar.
Wa nisawwi daraadirki be yaakhuut ahmarwa biibaanki be hujaar al-yiraaruwa nihawwig huduudki be hujaar mujammaliin.
Wa kulla iyaalki yabgo talaamiiz Allahwa yi'iichu fi l-salaam kaamil.
Wa be l-adaala,tabge saabtewa tiba''idi min al-mudaayaga.Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,ma takhaafe battaan-!Wa l-ru'ub kula ma yajiiki.
Wa kan udwaan gammo le yahjumuuki,da ma jaayi minni ana.Wa ayyi naadum al-yahjimkiyafchul giddaamki.
A'arfu-!Ana bas khalagt al-haddaadi al-yanfukh fi naar al-jamurwa yisawwi ayyi silaah hasab isti'maalah.Wa ana bas khalagt al-naadumal-yidammir al-silaah.
Wa kulli silaah al-yasna'ooh diddikima yanjahwa ayyi lisaan al-yathamki fi l-charii'a,inti tinnasri foogah.Wa di warasat abiidi ana Allahwa adaalithum jaaye minni ana.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya intu al-atchaaniin-!Ta'aalu ale l-almihatta intu al-ma indukugurus kula,ta'aalu-!Ta'aalu achru ma'aach wa aakulu-!Bala gurus wa bala ma tikaffu cheyy,ta'aalu acharbo khamar wa laban.
Maala tikaffu gurusku fi cheyy al-ma bin'akil-?Wa maala ti'ayyu nufuusku fi cheyy al-ma yachbi'ku-?Asma'ooni adiil-!Aakulu al-akil al-samehwa farruhu nufuusku be l-akil al-halu.
Ta'aalu leyi wa khuttu adaanku,asma'ooni wa tahyo.Wa nisawwi ma'aaku mu'aahada daayme.Akiid nantiiku rahmati al-waa'adt beeha Dawuud.
Wa daahu ana sabbattah misil chaahid fi l-umamwa khaayid al-yuguud al-cha'ab.
Wa daahu intu tinaadu umma al-ma ta'arfuuhawa l-umma al-ma ta'arifku di tajri leekufi chaani ana Allah Ilaahku Khudduus Israa'iilal-anteetku charaf.
Fattuchu Allah fi wakit hu binlagiwa naaduuh wakit hu gaa'id gariib.
Khalli al-aasi yikhalli derbahwa l-naadum al-fasil yikhalli afkaarah.Khalli yigabbil le Allah wa hu yarhamahachaan khufraan Ilaahna wasii'.

Al-matar wa l-talaj yanzulu min al-samawa ma yigabbulu gabul ma yazgu al-ardlahaddi al-nabaat yugumm wa yinawwirwa yanti teeraab le l-harraatiwa ma'aach le l-jii'aan.
Wa l-matar da misil kalaami.Wakit yamrug min khachmi,ma yigabbil leyi saakit bala natiijawa bala ma haggag hadaf al-ana nidoorahwa bala ma sawwa al-rassaltah leyah.
Aywa,be l-farah tamurguwa be l-salaam yuguuduuku.Wa l-jibaal wa l-hujaar yafraho wa yiragrugu leekuwa kulla chadar al-kadaade yisaffig.

Wa khalli al-ajnabi al-munrabit fi Allah ma yuguul-:--Akiid Allah yafsulni min cha'abah-!--Wa khalli al-khasi ma yuguul-:--Daahu ana bigiit misil chadara yaabse-!-

Humman dool,ana nantiihum fi beeti wa fi daraadirialaama hana zikra ahsan min al-wulaad wa l-banaat.Wa nantiihum usum daayimal-abadan ma yingachcha.
Fi ajaanib waahidiin anrabato fi Allahle yakhdumu leyahwa le yihibbu usum Allahwa le yabgo abiidah.Humman yahfado al-sabt wa yihtarumuwa yagoodu saabtiin fi mu'aahadati.
Al-naas dool,ana niwaddiihum fi jabali al-mukhaddaswa nifarrihhum fi beeti,beet al-sala.Wa narda be dahaayaahum al-muharragiinwa dahaayaahum al-aakhariinal-humman yigaddumuuhum fi madbahi.Achaan beeti yisammuuhbeet al-sala le kulla l-chu'uub.

Intu kulluku haywaanaat al-kadaade-!Aywa,intu kulluku haywaanaat al-khaaba-!Ta'aalu aakulu-!
Muraakhibiin Bani Israa'iil,kulluhum amyaaniinwa ma ya'arfu cheyy.Humman misil kulaab bukumma yagdaro yanbaho.Yahlamo raagdiinwa yihibbu al-noom.
Humman misil kulaab akkaaliinal-ma ya'arfu al-chaba'.Wa humman ru'yaanal-ma ya'arfu cheyy.Ayyi waahid chaayil derbahwa yifattich faayditah be kulla niiytah.

Chahwitku le asnaamku takrubkujamb chadar al-balluutwa tihit ayyi chadara khadra.Intu tadbaho leehum iyaal fi l-wudyaanwa fi chuguug al-jibaal.
Wa fi l-asnaam hana l-hujaar al-mulus fi l-waaditalge nasiibki,ya Madiinat al-Khuduswa humman dool bas gisimki-!Achaan leehum inti sabbeetihadaaya charaabwa gaddamti hadaaya hana dagiig.Hal narda be l-achya dool walla-?

Wa fi madkhal beetki,cha'agti sihirkiwa allabbadti minni ba'iid wa assallabtiwa tala'ti fi sariirki wa farrachtiih.Wa kaffeeti rujaal waahidiinle yarugdu ma'aakiwa tichiifi ireehum.
Wa inti gaddamti hadiiye hana dihin le l-sanam Muulakwa sabbeeti itir katiir fi jilidki.Rassalti samsaariyiinkiale buldaan ba'iidiinwa rassaltiihum lahaddibakaan al-maytiin.
