Yaatu khawwafki ziyaadalahaddi takdibi leyiwa ma tizzakkareeniwa ma tifakkiri foogi-?Ana sakatt mudda tawiilewa fi chaan da bas,ma takhaafe minni walla-?
Inti tahsibi nafiski adiilewa laakin ana nikhabbir be kulla a'maalkiwa be da,ma talge minhum ayyi faayde.
Wakit tasrakhe,hal asnaamki al-lammeetiihum yinajjuuki walla-?La-!Al-riih tichiilhumwa l-hawa yiwaddiihum-!Wa laakin le l-yalja' leyi ana kamaan,nantiih al-ard warasawa yawris jabali al-mukhaddas.
Wa l-Rabb yuguul-:-Addulu-!Addulu wa jahhuzu al-derib-!Amurgu al-hajar min derib cha'abi.
Achaan daahu kalaam Allah al-Aali al-gaa'id foog,hu al-gaa'id ila l-abad wa usmah al-Khudduus.Hu gaal-:-Ana gaa'id fi bakaan aali wa mukhaddaswa gaa'id battaan ma'a naas al-guluubhum ta'baaniinwa ruuhhum mutawaadi'ale nahayi ruuh al-mutawaadi'iinwa nahayi guluub al-ta'baaniin.
Achaan ana ma nahrij daaymanwa ma nakhdab ila l-abad.La-!Ma nidoor yakhmar giddaamikulli makhluug hayy al-ana khalagtah.
Wa be khataahum hana l-tama',ana khidibt wa darabt cha'abiwa ma wajjaht aleehum.Ana khidibt wa humman macho fi isyaanhumwa taaba'o chahwaat guluubhum.
Ana chift duruubhum wa nachfiihumwa nuguudhum wa nihannishum battaanhumman wa l-naas al-hizno fi chaanhum.
Wa ana nukhutt al-hamdfi khuchuumhum.Al-salaam le l-gariib-!Al-salaam le l-ba'iid-!Aywa ana nachfiihum.Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa l-aasiyiin misil al-bahar al-haayij al-ma yagdar yagood saakitwa moojah yilizz al-tiine wa l-wasakh.
Wa Ilaahi gaal-:-Le l-aasiyiin,ma fi salaam-!
Naadi be tuul hissak-!Ma taskut-!Arfa' hissak misil al-buug-!Wa khabbir cha'abi be isyaanhumaywa,khabbir zurriiyit Yaakhuub be zunuubhum-!
Laakin kulli yoomhumman yifattuchuuni anawa yidooru ya'arfu duruubimisil umma al-titabbig al-adaalawa ma khallat charii'at Ilaahhawa misil yidooru minni charii'a aadilewa yiriidu yigarrubu leyi.
Wa laakin yuguulu leyi-:--Maala kan nusuumu,inta ma tichiif siyaamna-?Wa kan nimaskunu nufuusna,inta ma tihtamma beyah-?--Achaan fi yoom siyaamku,intu tifattuchu faayditkuwa tidaayugu kulla khaddaamiinku-!
Wa daahu al-cheyyal-intu gaa'idiin tisawwuuh fi siyaamku.Intu tihaaruju wa tisawwu machaakilwa tadurbu amdarduum be zulum.Wa fi yoom hana siyaam misil da,salaatku di,ana ma nasma'ha.
Wa l-siyaam al-ana narda beyah,hu misil da walla-?Illa yoom waahid bas,al-foogahal-insaan yimaskin nafsah walla-?Wa yarkhi raasah misil ageegaay al-mardaanewa yalbas khalag al-toobawa yargud fi rumaad walla-?Da bas tinaaduuh siyaam walla-?Wa yoom siyaam misil da,ana Allah narda beyah walla-?
Wa laakin daahu al-siyaamal-ana narda beyah.Fukku al-masaajiin al-sajanoohum be zulumwa dallu al-tagala min rigaabhum.Wa khallu al-mazluumiin yamchu hurriinwa arfa'o minhum kulla l-tagala.
Wa waajib tigassim aklak ma'a l-jii'aanwa tisakkin al-miskiin al-ma indah beet.Wa l-aryaan,taksiihwa min dammak wa lahamak,ma tillabbad.
Wa be da,nuurak yibiin misil deyy al-sabaahwa chifaak yabga ajala-!Wa adaaltak tuguudakwa majd Allah yahfadak.
Wa khalaas wakit tinaadi,Allah yurudd leek.Wa wakit tikoorik le l-faza',hu yuguul leek-:--Daahuuni.--Wa kan tikhalli minnak al-mudaayagawa l-warwaraan wa l-kalaam al-fasil,
wa kan tanti aklak le l-jii'aanwa tamla batun al-ta'baan,khalaas nuurak yibiin fi l-dalaamwa l-dalaam yabga leek misil deyy al-gaayle.
Wa daayman Allah yuguudakwa yachbi'ak fi l-ard al-jafaaf wa yigawwiik.Wa inta tabga misil jineene al-mazgiiyewa misil een almi al-daayman jaariye.
Wa be sababak inta,al-naas yabnu al-muhaddam min zamaan.Wa inta tabni battaanfi l-asaas hana l-zurriiyaat al-faato.Al-naas yinaaduuk Saddaad al-Khuramwa Addaal Chawaari' al-Madiina le Yaskunuuha.
Kan inta ma takhdim fi yoom al-sabtwa ma tisawwi cheyy le maslahatak fi l-yoom al-mukhassas,wa kan tinaadi al-sabt yoom hana farahwa taj'al yoom Allah yoom mukhassas,wa kan tikarrimah wa ma tisawwi ayyi cheyy hasab niiytakwa ma tifattich maslahatak wa la tikallim kalaam fasil,
khalaas,ma'aayi ana Allah,talga al-farahwa niwaddiik be l-nasurfi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-balad.Nantiik ma'aachmin ard warasat jiddak Yaakhuub.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-gaalah.
Daahu-!Iid Allah ma gisayre le tinajjiikuwa adaanah ma tagiile le tasma'ku-!
Wa laakin da khataaku basal-faragaaku min Ilaahku.Wa be sabab zunuubku bas,hu ma wajjah aleekuwa khalaas,hu ma yasma'ku.
Achaan iideeku mulattakhiin be l-dammwa asaabi'ku be l-khata.Khuchuumku yikallumu be l-kidibwa lisneeku yikhaalu be l-khachch.
Ma fi naadum yachki be adaalawa ma fi naadum al-yahkim be l-hagg.Laakin yitwakkalo ale l-faadiwa yihajju be kidibwa yahmalo be l-fasaalawa yaldo al-charr.
Yifaggu'u beed abundaragwa yitirru hubaal abunchabach.Al-naadum al-yaakul min beedhum yumuutwa l-beedaay al-tinkasir,tawwaali tamrug minha amchideegaat.
Hubaal abunchabach dool ma yagdaro yilabbusuuhumwa khidmithum di ma tikhattiihum.Wa khidmithum di,khidmit charrwa amal al-unuf fi kafaafeehum.
Rijleehum yajru le l-charrwa yissa'jalo le daffigiin damm al-bari.Fikirhum fikir hana fasaalawa l-damaar wa l-kharaab fi deribhum.
Wa ma ya'arfu derib al-salaamwa amalhum ma adiil.Duruubhum al-sawwoohum uwujwa ayyi naadum al-yamchi fooghumma ya'arif al-salaam.
Naas Madiinat al-Khudus gaalo-:-Fi chaan da,al-hagg bigi ba'iid minninawa l-adaala ma lihgatna.Khatteena achamna fi l-nuurwa daahu ligiina al-dalaamwa gaa'idiin narjo al-nahaarwa laakin rukhna fi l-dalaam.
Niddaggacho misil amyaaniin fi l-daraadiraywa,niddaggacho misil al-ma induhum uyuun.Wa gaayle bas,nittarta'o misil fi l-leelwa fi lubb al-naas al-taybiin,bigiina misil al-maytiin.
Wa kullina nikirru misil diidaanwa nabku min al-hizin misil gimri.Khatteena achamna fi l-adaalalaakin ma fi cheyywa khatteena achamna fi l-najalaakin ba'iid minnina.
Ya Rabb,isyaanna bigi katiir giddaamakwa zunuubna chahado foogna.Nifakkuru daayman fi isyaannawa khataana kula na'arfuuh.
Kadabna wa isiina Allahwa abeena ma taaba'na Ilaahna.Hajjeena illa be zulum wa mu'aamara didd al-aakhariinwa guluubna malaaniin be kalaam kidib.
Be da,al-hagg kaskas warawa l-adaala wagafat ba'iid.Al-sahiih yittarta' fi l-chawaari'wa l-amaan ma yagdar yaji.
Al-hagg bigi ma fiihwa l-yiba''id min al-fasaala yabga khaniime-!-Allah chaaf al-adaala waddaratwa hu khidib.
Hu chaaf kadar ma fi naadumwa aasif ma fi naadum addakhkhal.Wa khalaas,hu zaatah gamma rafa' duraa'ahwa jaab al-najawa adaaltah antatah gudra.
Hu libis al-adaala misil dire'wa khatta taagiiyit al-naja fi raasah.Hu libis khalag al-taar misil ibaayawa ankasa be l-khiira misil jallaabiiye.
Khalaas,Allah yikaafi ayyi naadum hasab amalahwa yakhdab le khusmaanah wa yijaazi udwaanahwa yikaafi sukkaan al-jazaayir hasab amalhum.
Min bakaan taluu' al-harraay,yakhaafo min usum Allahwa min bakaan waguu'ha,yakhaafo min majdah.Achaan hu yaji be chidde misil seelal-tilizzah nafkhat Allah.
Khalaas,al-yafdaahum yaji le Sahyuun,le zurriiyit Yaakhuub al-yigabbulu min isyaanhum.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Kan leyi ana,di mu'aahadati ma'aahum.Ruuhi gaa'id foogak wa khatteet kalaami fi khachmak.Wa abadan ma nichiilhum min khachmak wa la min khuchuum zurriiytak wa la min khuchuum zurriiyit zurriiytak,min hassa' wa ila l-abad.
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,gummi foog wa nawwiri-!Achaan nuurki jaaywa,majd Allah baan foogki.
Daahu al-dalaam khatta al-ardwa l-khamaam al-azrag khatta al-chu'uub.Laakin foogki inti,Allah baanwa foogki majdah anchaaf.
Al-umam yaju le nuurkiwa l-muluuk yaju le l-deyy al-maarig minki.
Anzuri hawaaleeki wa chiifi-!Kulluhum lammo wa jaayiin leeki-!Awlaadki min ba'iid jaayiinwa banaatki fi l-nawaayit yichiiluuhin.
Wa wakit tichiifiihum,tiraariwa galibki yadrub min al-farah.Achaan aleeki yaji kanz al-buhuur be katarawa khuna al-umam taji leeki.
Jumaal katiiriin yamlo ardikiwa ibil turaab Midyaan wa Iifa.Kulluhum yaju min balad Sabachaayliin ma'aahum al-dahab wa l-lubaanwa yibachchuru be hamd Allah.
Wa kulla khanam turaab Khidaar yilimmu foogkiwa yijiibu kubchaan balad Nabayuut dahaaya.Wa yigaddumuuhum fi madbahiwa ana nakhbalhum.Wa beeti al-foogah majdi,ana nijammilah.
Dool yaatumman al-taayriin misil al-sahaabwa yichaabuhu al-hamaam al-mugaabil beetah-?
Sukkaan khachum al-baharyukhuttu achamhum foogi.Fi l-awwal,sufun Tarchiichyijiibu iyaalki min ba'iidbe fuddithum wa dahabhum.Wa da fi chaan yimajjudu usmi ana Allah Ilaahki,Khudduus Israa'iil al-charrafki.
Wa ajaanib yabnu daraadirkiwa muluukhum yakhdumuuki.Awwal fi khadabi,ana darabtikiwa hassa' fi ridaayi,ana narhamki.
Wa biibaanki yagoodu daayman maftuuhiin,leel wa nahaar abadan ma yigaffuluuhum.Achaan yidakhkhulu foogki khuna al-umamwa muluukhum kula yidakhkhuluuhum foogki,al-waahid ba'ad al-aakhar.
Achaan ayyi umma wa mamlakaal-ma takhdimki,tiddammarwa l-umam dool yakhrabo marra waahid.
Majd Lubnaan yaji leeki wa da hatab al-sarwiwa l-sindiyaan wa l-charbiin kulluhum sawa.Achaan yijammulu beehum beeti al-mukhaddaswa khalaas,nimajjid bakaan nukhutt rijileeni.
Zurriiyit al-zalamooki yidanguru giddaamkiwa kulla l-hagarooki yasjudu tihit rijileenki.Wa yinaaduuki madiinat Allahwa yinaadu Sahyuun madiinat Khudduus Israa'iil.
Ya Sahyuun-!Awwal,khallooki wa kirhookiwa naadum ma gidir yufuut beeki.Laakin hassa',ana nukhutt foogki farah daayimwa suruur min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Inti tarda'e laban al-umamwa taakuli khuna al-muluuk.Wa be da,ta'arfi kadar munajjiiki da ana Allahwa l-yafdaaki hu ana al-Jabbaar,Ilaah Yaakhuub.
Fi badal al-nahaas,nijiib al-dahabwa fi badal al-hadiid,nijiib al-fudda.Fi badal al-hatab,nijiib al-nahaaswa fi badal al-hujaar,nijiib al-hadiid.Fi badal al-jaayriin,nijiib al-salaamwa fi badal al-mudaayigiin,nijiib al-adaala.
Fi baladki,battaan ma yasma'o be unufwa la damaar wa la kharaab.Wa daraadirki tisammiihum al-Najawa biibaanki tisammiihum al-Hamd.
Wa battaan al-harraay ma tabga nuurki be l-nahaarwa l-gamar kula ma yabga leeki deyy be l-leel.Laakin ana Allah bas nabga nuurki al-daayimwa ana Ilaahki nabga jamaalki.
Wa battaan harraayitki ma taga'wa gamarki kula ma yiwaddir.Achaan Allah bas yabga nuurki al-daayimwa ayyaam hizinki yikammulu.
Aywa,cha'abki kulluhum yabgo saalihiinwa yawrusu al-ard ila l-abad.Humman bizirti al-ana maggantahawa khidmit iideeni al-yiwassufu majdi.
Al-sakhayyar minhum,zurriiytah tabga alifwa l-da'iif minhum yabga umma gawiiye-!Aywa-!Ana Allah nijiib al-cheyy da ajala fi waktah.
Ruuh Allah al-Rabb gaa'id foogiachaan Allah masahaani wa khassasaanile nibachchir al-masaakiin.Hu rassalaani le nidaawi al-naas al-galibhum munkasirwa na'lin be l-hurriiye le l-makruubiinwa be l-talagaan le l-masaajiin.
Ana na'lin sanit ni'mat Allahwa yoom al-taar hana Ilaahna.Wa da,le nisabbir kulla l-haznaaniin.
Hu rassalaani le naas Sahyuunal-gaa'idiin fi l-hizinachaan nantiihum kadmuul jamiilbadal al-rumaad al-fi raashumwa dihin al-suruurbadal al-hizinwa lubaas al-chukurbadal al-ruuh al-da'iife.Wa yisammuuhum Chadar al-Adaalaal-Allah Maganah le Yiwassif Majdah.
Humman yabnu al-muhaddam min zamaanwa yigawwumu al-khirib min awwalwa yijaddudu buna al-mudun al-muhaddamiinwa kharbaaniin min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Ya cha'abi,al-ajaanib yajuwa yasraho leeku be khanamkuaywa,iyaalhum yahartu ziraa'itkuwa yakhdumu leeku fi jineenaat inabku.
Wa kan leeku intu,yinaaduukurujaal al-diin hana Allahwa khaddaamiin Ilaahna.Taakulu khuna al-umamwa tifaachuru be gudrithum.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Badal al-eeb,talgo gisimku marrateenwa badal al-ihaana,al-farah yabga gisimku.Achaan da,tawrusu marrateen min baladkuwa farhitku tagood ila l-abad.
Achaan ana Allah nihibb al-adaalawa nakrah al-sirge wa l-jariime.Nantiihum mukaafaathum be sidikhwa nisawwi ma'aahum mu'aahada daayme.
Zurriiyithum tukuun ma'ruufa been al-umamwa iyaalhum ma'ruufiin ust al-chu'uub.Kulla l-yichiifuuhum ya'arfukadar humman zurriiye al-baarakaaha Allah.
Aywa,ana nafrah ziyaada be Allahwa nafsi tafrah be Ilaahi.Achaan hu labbasaani khulgaan al-najawa kasaani be jallaabiiyit al-adaala.Hu jammalaani be kadmuul misil ariisaywa,misil kadmuul raajil al-diinwa misil al-aruus al-mujammala be ziinitha.
Aywa,misil al-ard tamrug bizrithawa misil al-jineene tamrug teeraabha,misil da,Allah al-Rabb kula yibayyin adaaltahwa kulla l-umam yachkuruuh.
Fi chaan maslahat Sahyuun,ana ma naskut.Aywa,fi chaan maslahat Madiinat al-Khudus,ma nagood saakitlahaddi adaalitha tiraari misil nuur al-sabaahwa najaatha misil deyy al-muchhaab.
Khalaas,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,al-umam yichiifu adaalitkiwa kulla l-muluuk yichiifu azamatki.Wa l-naas yinaaduuki be usum jadiidal-yisammiiki beyah Allah.
Inti tabge misil taaj al-azama fi iid Allahaywa,misil kadmuul al-muluk fi iid Ilaahki.
Battaan ma yinaaduuki al-Khalloohawa ardiki ma yisammuuha al-Kharbaane.Laakin yinaaduuki al-Allah Ridi Beekiwa ardiki yisammuuha al-Mutazawwije.Achaan Allah yafrah beekiwa yabga le ardiki misil zoojha.
Misil sabi yaakhud bineeye udriiye,awlaadki yakurbuuki.Wa misil al-aruus tabga farah le raajilha,inti kula tabge farah le Ilaahki.
Wa fi daraadirki,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,ana khatteet hurraas be l-leel wa l-nahaarwa abadan ma yaskutu.Intu al-tizzakkaro Allah,khalli ma tinjammo.
Wa ma tikhallu leyah jummalahaddi yisabbit Madiinat al-Khuduswa hi tabga chukur fi l-ard.
Wa be iidah al-zeene wa be duraa'ah al-gawi,Allah sawwa al-haliife di-:-Battaan ma nanti gamehkile udwaanki yaakuluuh.Wa iyaal al-ajaanib ma yacharbo battaankhamarki al-jadiid al-ti'ibti foogah.
Wa laakin al-yilimmu al-gamehyaakuluuh wa yachkuru Allah.Wa l-yilimmu al-inab yacharbo asiirahfi fadaayit beeti al-mukhaddas.
Fuutu-!Fuutu be l-biibaanwa jahhuzu derib le cha'abi.Addulu-!Addulu al-deribwa amurgu al-hujaarwa arfa'o raaye le l-cha'ab.
Wa daahu Allah khabbar lahaddi aakhir al-ard wa gaal-:-Guulu le sukkaan Sahyuun al-misil bineeye-:--Daahu munajjiiku jaayiwa maahiiytah ma'aayahwa giddaamah mukaafaatah.-
Yisammuuhum al-Cha'ab al-Mukhassaswa l-Fadaahum Allah.Wa inti,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,ma yinaaduuki al-Madiina al-Khalloohawa laakin al-Madiina al-Mahbuuba.
Da yaatu al-jaayi min balad Adoom,min madiinat Busrabe khulgaanah induhum nugat humur-?Da yaatu al-jaayibe khulgaan al-yichiilu al-eenwa aziim be katarat gudurtah-?Allah gaal-:-Da ana-!Wa ana bas al-nihajji be adaalawa indi al-gudra le ninajji.
Maala khalagak ahmar-?Maala khulgaanakmisil khulgaan hana naadum al-yakhdim fi assaarat al-inab-?
Ana gaa'id nakhdim wiheedi fi l-assaarawa ma fi naadum min al-chu'uub ma'aayi.Ana fajjakhtuhum fi za'aliwa asartuhum fi khadabi.Wa dammuhum rachcha fi khulgaaniwa lattakh kulla lubaasi.
Achaan fi galbi,da yoom hana taarwa l-sana al-nafda fiiha,hi jaat.
Ana fattacht wa ma ligiit al-yisaa'idniwa hizint wakit ma chift al-yi'aawinni.Khalaas,duraa'i jaab nasriwa khadabi aawanni.
Fi za'ali,ana fajjakht chu'uubwa fi khadabi,sawweethum sakraaniinwa daffagt dammuhum fi l-turaab.
Ana nizzakkar rahmat Allahwa amalah al-waajib leyah al-chukurhasab kulla cheyy al-sawwaah leena Allah.Aywa,kheerah al-kabiir le Bani Israa'iil,adaaltah al-sawwaaha hasab kheerah al-ma indah hadd.
Wa hu gaal-:-Akiid,humman cha'abiwa iyaal al-ma yukhuchchuuni.-Wa khalaas,Allah bigi leehum munajji.
Allah chaaf diigithum di,hintah hu.Wa hu ma rassal mursaal wa la malaklaakin Allah hu zaatah bas najjaahum.Wa be mahabbitah wa mahannitah,hu bas fadaahum.Wa rafa'aahum wa hamalaahumfi muddit kulla l-zaman daak.
Laakin humman iso Allahwa khaddabo Ruuhah al-mukhaddas.Khalaas,gabbal wa bigi leehum aduwa hu zaatah gamma haarabaahum.
Ba'ad da,cha'abah azzakkaro al-wakit al-faat,al-wakit hana Muusa.Wa gaalo-:-Ween hu al-marag cha'abah min al-baharma'a ru'yaan khanamah-?Wa ween hu al-khatta fooghumRuuhah al-mukhaddas-?
Ween hu al-saa'ad Muusa be iidah al-majiidewa chagga al-bahar itneen giddaamhumle yi'alli usmah ila l-abad-?
Ween hu al-waddaahum fi l-bahar al-khariigwa misil juwaad fi l-sahara-?Wa humman ma attarta'o.
Wa misil bahiime al-tanzil fi l-waadi,Ruuh Allah waddaahum le l-raaha.-Misil da,ya Allah,inta gudt cha'abakle ti'alli usmak al-majiid.
Ya Allah-!Chiif min al-samaawaatwa anzur min maskanak al-mukhaddas al-aziim.Ween mahabbitak al-chadiide-?Wa ween gudurtak-?Aniina ma nihissu be mahannitakwa la be kheerak leena.
Inta bas abuunahatta kan Ibraahiim ma ya'arifnawa Israa'iil kula ma indah beena khabar.Inta bas Allah abuuna,inta bas faadiinawa da usmak min zamaan.
Wa maala,ya Allah,waddartinaba'iid min duruubakwa gawweet guluubnalahaddi ma nakhaafo minnak-?Gabbil-!Ta'aal fi chaan abiidakwa fi chaan gabaayil warasatak.
Wa cha'abak al-mukhassaschaalo al-balad di le mudda gisayre bas.Wa ba'ad da,khusmaanna jowa fajjakho beetak al-mukhaddas.
Min mudda tawiile,aniina bigiinamisil naas al-inta ma hakamt foognawa misil naas al-ma naadoona be usmak.
Ya Allah-!Aftah al-samaawaat wa anzilachaan al-jibaal yinhazzo giddaamak-!
Misil be sur'a al-naar taakul al-gechchwa tifawwir al-almi,inta kula ti'arrif usmak le khusmaanakwa tirajjif al-umam giddaamak-!
Zamaan,inta sawweet achya al-bikhawwufual-aniina ma khatteena fooghum achamna.Khalaas,inta nazaltwa l-jibaal anhazzo giddaamak.
Abadan ma fi naadum simi'wa la fakko adaanahwa la chaaf ilaah mislak inta,al-yisawwi amal ajiible l-gaa'idiin yarjooh be acham.
Inta tilaagi al-yafraho be sawwiyiin al-adaalawa l-yizzakkaro duruubak.Wa inta khidibt leenaachaan aniina aznabna.Laakin daayman be duruubak dool,aniina nalgo al-naja.
Wa kullina bigiina ma taahiriinwa kulla cheyy al-nisawwuuh adiilbigi misil khalag munajjas be damm al-heed.Wa aniina kullina yibisnamisil warag al-chadar al-daffagwa khataayaana chaaloonamisil al-riih.
Ma fi naadum al-yinaadi usmakwa ma fi naadum al-yugumm wa yinrabit ma'aak.Aywa,inta ma wajjaht aleenawa khalleetna waga'nabe tihit tagalat khataana.
Ya Allah-!Inta bas abuuna.Aniina misil al-tiinewa inta bas daggaagnawa aniina kullina,inta bas khaaligna.
Ya Allah-!Ma takhdab foogna-!Ma tizzakkar daayman fi khataana-!Chiif-!Aniina kullina cha'abak.
Mudunak al-mukhaddasiin fidowa jabal Sahyuun bigat saharawa Madiinat al-Khudus bigat bakaan kharaab.
Beetna al-mukhaddas al-jamiilal-foogah juduudna chakarook,bigi lugma al-akalatha al-naarwa kulla cheyy khaali al-indina addammar-!
Ya Allah-!Giddaam kulla l-damaar da,inta ma tisawwi cheyy walla-?Walla taskut wa tiziid ta'abna-?
Ana bayyant nafsile naas al-ma naadooniwa ana wassaft nafsile naas al-ma fattachooni.Wa ana gult-:--Daahuuni ana-!Daahuuni ana--le umma al-ma naadat usmi.
Kulla yoom maddeet iideenile cha'ab raashum gawi.Wa laakin humman chaayliin derib ma adiilhasab afkaarhum.
Humman cha'ab al-daaymanyikhaddubuuni be niiyithum.Wa yadbaho le ilaahaathum fi l-jineenaatwa yiharrugu leehum bakhuur fi diringeel-!
Al-cha'ab dool yaskunu fi l-khubuurwa yisaahuru tuul al-leel fi bakaan sirri.Humman yaakulu laham al-khinziirwa mawaa'iinhum malaaniin be akil haraam.
Wa yuguulu-:--Ma tigarrib leena-!Wa ma tilammisna-!Aniina mukhassasiin ziyaada minnak-!--Wa Allah gaal-:-Wakit nichiif amalhum da,nakhdab khadab misil al-naaral-gaa'ide tahrig kulla yoom.
Chiifu-!Daahu al-kharaaral-maktuub giddaami.Ana ma nagdar naskutlahaddi nilkaffa foogku.Aywa,nilkaffa foogku tukfa kaamile
achaan khataayaakuwa khata juduudku kulluhum.Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.Wa le l-yiharrugu al-bakhuur fi ruuse al-jibaalwa le l-yi'ayyuruuni fi l-hujaar,ana nigaawis amalhum al-awwalbe mikyaal kaamil.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Wa da misil ligo anguudal-foogah inab katiir talfaan wa yuguulu-:--Ma tazguluuh kulla keachaan waahidiin induhum baraka.--Misil da bas,ana nisawwi ma'a abiidi,ma nidammirhum kulluhum.
Min Yaakhuub namrug zurriiyeaywa,min Bani Yahuuza nijiib al-yawris jibaali.Ana azaltuhum yawrusuuhumaywa,abiidi yaskunu fooghum.
Wa le cha'abi al-yifattuchuuni,sahalat Chaaruun tabga mar'a le l-khanamwa waadi Akuur yabga bakaan raaha le l-bagar.
Wa laakin intu al-aakhariin,abeetuuni ana Allah.Wa nisiitu beeti bakaan al-ibaadafi jabali al-mukhaddas.Intu gaddamtu akil le ilaah Gaadwa kaas al-khamar le sanam Manaat.
Laakin ana niwaddiiku tumuutu fi l-haribwa tarka'o giddaam al-yadbahooku.Achaan ana naadeetkuwa intu ma raddeetu leyi.Wa ana kallamt leekuwa intu ma simi'tu kalaami.Laakin intu sawweetu al-fasil giddaamiwa azaltu al-ma nidoorah.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Abiidi yaakuluwa laakin intu tujuu'u.Abiidi yacharbowa laakin intu ta'tacho.Abiidi yafrahowa laakin intu takhjalo.
Abiidi yikooruku min farah guluubhumlaakin intu tikoorukumin waja' guluubkuwa tabku be hizinwa be ruuh muhattama.
Wa l-naas al-ana azaltuhumyista'malo usumku misil la'ana.Wa yuguulu-:--Allah al-Rabb yaktulak misil filaan-!--Wa laakin le abiidi,ninaadiihum be usum aakhar.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yibaarik nafsah fi l-ard,yibaarik nafsah be usmi ana Ilaah al-Hagg.Wa ayyi naadum al-yahlif fi l-ard,yahlif be usmi ana Ilaah al-Hagg.Achaan al-diige al-awwal tinnasiwa tillabbad ba'iid,ma nichiifha.
Daahu ana nakhlig sama jadiidwa ard jadiide.Abadan ma tizzakkaro al-achya al-awwalwa ma yaju leeku fi fikirku.
Laakin afraho wa anbastu ila l-abadfi chaan al-cheyy al-nakhalgah.Daahu nakhlig Madiinat al-Khuduswa tinmali be farahwa cha'abha yinbastu.
Wa ana nafrah be Madiinat al-Khuduswa ninbasit be cha'abi.Wa battaan ma tinsami'haraka hana baki wa la korooraak.
Wa battaan al-tifil ma yumuut ba'ad ayyaamwa l-chaayib ma yumuut kan ma tamma ayyaamah.Achaan al-yumuut fi miya sana,yaj'alooh sabi.Wa l-yumuut gabul miya sana,yaj'alooh mal'uun.
Aywa,cha'abi yabnu buyuutwa humman zaathum yaskunu fooghum.Wa yimaggunu jineenaat inabwa yaakulu min fawaakihhum.
Humman ma yabnu le naadum aakhar yaskunwa la yimaggunu le l-aakhar yaakul.Achaan ayyaam cha'abi yabgo tuwaalmisil ayyaam al-chadar al-kubaar.Wa l-naas al-ana azaltuhumyafraho be khidmit iideehum.
Humman ma ya'yo bala faaydewa la yaldo le l-moot.Achaan humman cha'ab al-baarakaahum Allah,humman wa zurriiyithum ma'aahum.
Gubbaal ma yinaaduuni,ana nurudd leehum.Wa gubbaal ma yihajju,ana nasma'hum.
Al-ba'achoom wa l-hamal yarta'o sawawa l-duud misil al-toor yaakul al-gechchlaakin al-daabi yaakul al-ajaaj.Wa fi jabali al-mukhaddas,ma fi fasaala wa la damaar.-Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Al-sama archiwa l-ard bakaan nukhutt rijileeni.Hal tagdaro tabnu beetal-yichiilni walla-?Walla tagdaro tabnu leyibakaan le l-raaha-?
Achaan kulla l-achya dool,iidi bas sawwathumwa misil da bas,humman mawjuudiin.Daahu al-naadum al-ana narda beyah,hu al-miskiin wa ruuhah muhattamawa yarjif min kalaami.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin al-yadbah toor dahiiye,hu misil al-yaktul insaan.Wa l-yigaddim khanamaay dahiiye,hu misil al-yaksir ragabat kalib.Wa l-yigaddim hadiiye hana dagiig,hu misil al-yigaddim hadiiye damm hana khinziirwa l-yiharrig bakhuur,hu misil al-ya'abud sanam.Al-naas dool azalo deribhumwa be muharramaathum dool,humman farhaaniin.
Ana kula na'azil leehum natiijat amalhumwa nijiib fooghum al-yikhawwifhum.Achaan ana naadeethumwa ma raddo leyiwa kallamt leehumwa ma sim'o kalaami.Wa laakin humman sawwo al-fasil giddaamiwa azalo al-ma nidoorah.
Asma'o kalaam Allah,intu al-tarjufu min kalaamah-:-Akhwaanku yakrahookuwa yiba''uduukufi chaan usmi ana Allah.Wa yichchammato foogkuwa yuguulu-:--Khalli Allah yiwassif majdahwa nichiifu farahku-!--Wa laakin humman basyalgo al-eeb.
Fi hiss hana aayit jaayi min al-madiinawa haraka jaaye min beet Allah.Wa da hiss Allah al-gaa'id yijaazi udwaanah.
Gabul al-talaga ma takrubha,jabal Sahyuun wildat.Wa gabul al-waja' ma yajiiha,hi wildat jaabat wileed.
Yaatu al-simi' be cheyy misil da-?Wa yaatu al-chaaf cheyy misil da-?Fiyah balad al-wildoohafi yoom waahid walla-?Fi umma yaldoohafi wakit waahid walla-?Laakin wakit gariib titaalig,Sahyuun wildat awlaadha khalaas.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana naftah batun al-ammwa ma nikhalliiha talda walla-?-Aywa,Ilaahak gaal-:-Ana al-niwallid,nadhar al-sakhiir ma yamrug walla-?
Afraho ma'a Madiinat al-Khudus wa anbastu beeha,intu kulluku al-tihibbuuha-!Afraho ma'aaha be suruur,intu kulluku al-hizintu fi chaanha.
Achaan intu tarda'o min deedha wa tarwowa talgo mahannitha.Achaan tumussu wa tafrahomin darritha al-malaane be laban.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Ana nanti al-salaam le Madiinat al-Khudusmisil almi al-bahar.Wa nijiib leeha majd al-umammisil waadi al-jaari.Wa yiraddu'uuku wa yichiiluuku fi huduunhumwa yidaaduluuku fi l-rikabbuhum.
Wa misil amm tisabbir wileedha,ana kula nisabbirku.Aywa-!Fi Madiinat al-Khudus tasburu.
Wa intu tichiifu wa guluubku yafrahowa udaamku yigawwu misil al-gechch al-yikhaddir.Wa abiid Allah ya'arfu gudurtahwa udwaanah ya'arfu la'antah.
Achaan daahu Allah jaayi fi l-naarwa arabaatah hint al-harib misil amzooba'aane.Yaji le yinazzil khadabah be za'al chadiidwa tahdiidah fi naar amlahiib.
Achaan be l-naar,Allah yi'aakhibwa be seefah yihaakim kulla l-naaswa Allah yaktulhum katiiriin.
Wa l-naas al-yikhassusu nufuushumwa yittahharo le yadkhulu fi l-jineenaatle yamchu ya'abudu al-sanam al-gaa'id usut,humman dool al-yaakulu laham al-khinziir wa l-faarwa kulla cheyy nijis marra waahid,humman dool kulluhum yiddammaro-!-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ana na'arif amalhum wa fikirhum.Wa yaji wakit al-yilimmu foogah kulla l-umam wa kulla l-lukhkhaat wa humman yaju wa yichiifu majdi.
Wa nukhutt fi lubbuhum alaama.Wa min al-faddalo,nirassil naas waahidiin le l-umam al-ya'arfu yista'malo al-nuchchaab ya'ni fi Tarchiich wa Fuul wa Luud.Wa nirassilhum battaan le naas Tuubal wa balad Yawaan wa ba'iid fi l-jazaayir fi bakaan al-foogah abadan ma sim'o beyi wa la chaafo majdi.Wa hinaak yi'arrufu majdi le l-umam dool.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Al-naas yigabbulu kulla akhwaanku min kulla l-umam be kheel wa arabaat wa kaarro mukhattayiin wa bikhaal wa jumaal lahaddi Madiinat al-Khudus fi jabali al-mukhaddas.Wa yigaddumuuhum misil hadiiye leyi ana Allah.Wa da yabga misil Bani Israa'iil yigaddumu hadaayaahum fi mawaa'iin taahiriin le beet Allah.
Wa na'azil waahidiin minhum rujaal diin wa Laawiyiin. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Misil al-sama al-jadiid wa l-ard al-jadiideal-ana sawweethum gaa'idiin gawiyiin giddaami,misil da,zurriiyitku wa usumku kulayagoodu saabtiin giddaami.
Wa awwal yoom fi kulli chaharwa fi kulli yoom al-sabt,kulla l-naas yaju yasjudu giddaami.Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa wakit yamurgu,yichiifu janaazaat al-naas al-gammo diddi.Wa l-duud al-yaakulhum ma yumuutwa l-naar al-tahrighum kula ma tumuutwa yabgo masal mukhiif le kulla l-naas.
Daahu kalaam Irmiya wileed Hilkhiiya waahid min rujaal al-diin al-saakniin fi hillit Anatuut,fi ard gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa Allah bada yihajji le Irmiya fi sanit 13 hana hukum Yuuchiiya wileed Aamuun malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa gaa'id yihajji leyah kula fi ayyaam hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa hajja leyah lahaddi l-chahar al-khaamis hana sanit 11 hana hukum Sidkhiiya wileed Yuuchiiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa da l-wakit al-waddo foogah sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus fi l-khurba.
Wa Allah hajja leyi ana Irmiya wa gaal-:
Gabul ma nikawwinakfi batun ammak,ana na'arfak.Wa gabul ma tamrug min rihim ammak,ana khassastakachaan nirassilak nabi le l-umam.
Wa ana gult-:-Ya Allah al-Rabb-!Ana sakhayyar,ma na'arif nihajji.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Ma tuguul inta sakhayyar.Amchi fi ayyi bakaan al-nirassilak foogahwa kulla cheyy al-nuguulah leek,guulah.
Ma takhaaf min naadumachaan ana gaa'id ma'aak le nahmiik.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,Allah madda iidah wa gaal leyi-:-Daahu ana nukhutt kalaamifi khachmak.
Wa a'arif kadar al-yoom nantiik sultafi l-umam wa l-mamaalik.Wa da le tamrug wa tarmiwa tidammir wa takhrib waahidiin.Wa laakin tabni wa tisabbit aakhariin.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:-Ya Irmiya,gaa'id tichiif chunu-? Wa ana gult-:-Al-gaa'id nichiifah da,firi' chadarat al-looz al-nawwar bala ta'khiir.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Inta chift adiil.Ru'yat al-looz di tiwassif kadar ana kula nihaggig kalaami bala ta'khiir.
Wa battaan Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:-Inta gaa'id tichiif chunu-? Wa ana gult-:-Al-gaa'id nichiifah da,waahid kalool gaa'id yufuur wa min munchaakh mayyal aleena.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Min munchaakh bas timayyil al-fasaala fi kulla sukkaan al-balad di.
Wa daahu ana ninaadi kulla gabaayil mamaalik al-munchaakh.Wa humman yaju wa ayyi waahid yukhutt kursiih giddaam khachum baab Madiinat al-Khudus.Yihawwugu daraadirha wa yahjumu kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa be da,ana nihaakim cha'abi fi chaan fasaalithum.Wa fasaalithum di,humman abooni ana wa harrago bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin wa sajado le l-asnaam al-sawwoohum be iideehum.
Wa laakin inta,ya Irmiya-!Arbut sulbak-!Gumm wa ballikh leehum be kulla cheyy al-naamurak beyah.Wa ma takhaaf minhum.Kan khuft,ana nikhawwifak ziyaada giddaamhum.
Wa l-yoom,ana nisawwiik gawi misil madiina gawiiye al-indaha amad hana hadiid wa daraadir hana nahaas.Wa da le tabga gawi giddaam kulla balad Yahuuza be muluukha wa kubaaraatha wa rujaal diinha wa cha'abha.
Humman yihaarubuuk wa laakin ma yisawwu leek cheyy achaan ana nukuun ma'aak wa nahmiik. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Amchi oori naas Madiinat al-Khudus wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ana nizzakkar amaankufi wakit chabaabkuwa hubbuku leyimisil al-mara al-dahaabha akhadatwa intu taaba'tuuni fi l-saharawa hi ard buura.
Wa Bani Israa'iil humman mukhassasiinleyi ana Allahwa humman misil al-intaaj al-awwalal-waajib leyi.Wa ayyi naadum al-yaakulah yabga khaatiwa l-fasaala taji foogah."--Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana Irmiya gult-:-Intu zurriiyit Yaakhuub ma'a kulla aayilat Bani Israa'iil,asma'o kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ween al-eeb al-abbahaatku ligooh foogile yiba''udu minni-?Humman taaba'o al-asnaam al-ma naaf'iinwa bigo naas ma naaf'iin.
Wa humman ma sa'alo wa gaalo-:"Ween Allah al-maragaana min balad Masirwa gaadaana fi l-sahara-?Wa hi balad al-sahale wa khatiirewa ard jafaaf wa dalaam haalik.Wa ma fi naadum al-yuchuggahawa la naadum al-saakin fiiha."--
Wa Allah gaal battaan-:--Ana jibtuku fi l-balad al-khadraachaan tuduukhu intaajhawa tafraho be jamaalha.Wa laakin wakit dakhaltu foogha,najjastu baladiwa ardi al-anteetha leeku warasa,harramtuuha.
Wa rujaal al-diin ma sa'alo wa gaalo-:"Ween Allah-?"Wa ulama churuut al-Tawraatma ya'arfuuni.Wa l-masaa'iil atmarrado diddiwa l-anbiya atnabba'o be usum ilaah Ba'alwa jaro wara l-asnaam al-ma yanfa'oohum.
Wa fi chaan da,daayman ana nachkiiku fi l-charii'awa nachki battaan iyaalku wa iyaal iyaalku.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Amchu kharib fi jaziirat Khubrus wa chiifuwa rassulu sabaah fi ard Khidaar wa as'alo adiilkan fi cheyy misil da bigi yoom waahid.
Hal fi umma baddalat ilaahha be ilaah aakhar-?Wa dool ma ilaahaat sahiih kula.Wa laakin cha'abi baddalooni ana majduhumbe cheyy ma yanfa'.
Ya l-sama,ahzane be l-sabab dawa arjifi wa anbahti ziyaada.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa cha'abi sawwo fasaala itneen.Abooni ana al-leehum misil een almi al-hayawa macho le ilaahaat aakhariin.Al-ilaahaat dool misil khazzaanaatal-nakatoohum wa achchaggago,ma yakurbu almi.-
Wa Allah gaal-:-Hal Bani Israa'iil bigo abiid walla-?Hal wildoohum fi l-ubuudiiye walla-?Wa kan la,maala nahaboohum-?
Udwaanhum misil diidaan al-yikirruwa hissuhum ansama'.Kharabo baladhumwa tachcho mudunhumwa tarado sukkaanhum.
Hatta al-Masriyiin sukkaan Mamfiis wa Tahfaniis kulajo zayyano ruuse Bani Israa'iil.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,intu bas jibtuuh fi raaskuachaan intu abeetu Allah Ilaahkuwakit hu gaa'id yuguudku fi l-derib al-adiil.
Maala macheetu balad Masirle tifattuchu musaa'adathamisil atchaaniin le almi al-Niil-?Wa maala macheetu balad Achuurle tifattuchu gudrithamisil atchaaniin le almi al-Furaat-?
Wa khalli fasaalitku tigabbil leeku fi raaskuwa kufurku yi'aakhibku.Wa a'arfu kikkeef al-cheyy da fasil wa murrkadar taabooni ana Allah Ilaahkuwa abadan ma takhaafo minni.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil-!Min wakit tawiil intu dalleetu al-tagala min ragabatkuwa gatta'tu guyuudku wa gultu-:--Abadan ma na'abuduuk.--Wa fi raas ayyi jabal aaliwa tihit ayyi chadara khadra,intu raagdiin misil al-charmuuta.
Ana maggantukumisil chadarat inab al-ma'zuula min al-noo' al-adiil.Kikkeef gidirtu alkhayyartule chadarat inab al-ma ma'ruufa-?
Wa kan tilkhassalo be atroonwa tilbarrado be saabuun kula,khataaku ma yingachchawa yagood misil bug'a giddaami.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa kikkeef tagdaro tuguulu-:--Aniina ma najjasna nufuusnawa la taaba'na ilaah Ba'al-?--Chiifu amalku al-cheen fi l-waadiwa a'arfu al-cheyy al-sawweetuuh.Intu misil naaga sabiiye al-tajri jaay wa jaay.
Wa intu misil humaarit al-kadaadeal-muwaalfe al-sahara.Hi haayil tuchumm al-riih wa tifattichwa hiyaalha abadan ma yufuut.Wa l-yifattuchuuha ma ya'ayoachaan ligooha fi wakit hiyaalha.
Angar'u,ya Bani Israa'iil-!Kan ma ke da,ni'leeku yagdamo min al-jariwa halguumku yaybas.Wa laakin intu tuguulu-:--Ma fi cheyy-!La-!Nihibbu al-ilaahaat al-ajnabiyiin baswa najru waraahum.-
Wa Allah gaal-:-Intu ya Bani Israa'iil,al-eeb yakrubku,intu wa muluukku wa kubaaraatkuwa rujaal diinku wa anbiyaaku,misil eeb al-sarraag al-karabooh gaa'id yasrig.
Wa tuguulu le sanamku hana l-hatab-:--Inta bas abuuna--wa le sanamku hana l-hajar-:--Inta bas ammina al-wildatna.--Aywa,tantuuni duhuurkuwa taabo ma tiwajjuhu aleyiwa kan al-ta'ab jaaku kamaan,tuguulu-:--Gumm,najjiina.--
Ween ilaahaatku al-sana'tuuhum-?Khalli yugummu kan yagdaro yinajjuuku fi l-diige.Achaan ilaahaatku bigo katiiriin misil mudunku,ya cha'ab Yahuuza.
Maala chakeetuuni fi l-charii'a-?Intu bas,kulluku isiituuni.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana darabt cha'ab Bani Israa'iil le ni'addibhumwa laakin ma al'addabo.Wa seefku katal anbiyaakumisil al-duud al-jaasir.
Wa intu naas al-yoom dool,asma'o kalaami ana Allah.Ya Bani Israa'iil,hal ana bigiit leekumukhiif misil al-sahara-?Walla bigiit leekumisil al-balad al-indaha dalaam azrag kurum-?Maala naas cha'abi buguulu-:--Yalla namchu-!Ma nigabbulu leek abadan-!--
Hal al-bitt tansa ziinitha walla-?Walla l-aruus tansa khalagha-?Wa laakin naas cha'abi nisoonile muddit ayyaam.
Intu ta'arfu tak derib al-charmata-!Wa tagdaro ti'allumu al-charaamiit kula.
Wa damm al-masaakiin al-bariyiinyinlagi lahaddi fi daayir khulgaanku.Kan ma kassaro biibaan buyuutku kula,intu kataltuuhum.Wa be da kula,tuguulu-:--Aniina bariyiinwa akiid khadab Allah ma yalhagna.--Wa laakin ana nihaakimku fi l-charii'aachaan intu gultu-:--Aniina ma muznibiin.--
Wa be suhuula bas tikhayyuru alaakhitku.Wa laakin Masir ti'ayyibkum misil Achuur ayyabatku zamaan.
Wa min Masir hinaak kula,tamurgu ruuseeku mudangiriin.Aywa,ana Allah rafadt al-intu titwakkalo aleehumwa be da,ma'aahum ma tanjaho.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Kan raajil tallag martahwa l-mara di machat akhadat raajil aakhar,hal raajilha al-awwal da,yagdar yigabbilha walla-?Hal hi ma annajjasat misil al-ardal-najaasitha ma indaha ilaaj-?Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,inti achcharmatti ma'a naas katiiriin.Hassa' da,tagdare tigabbilileyi ana walla-?
Arfa'e uyuunkiwa chiifi ruuse al-jibaal.Ween al-bakaan al-ma achcharmattiwara l-ilaahaat-?Wa inti tagoodi fi khuchuum al-duruubwa takursi misil rabbaat al-duruub fi l-sahara.Wa inti najjasti al-ardbe zinaaki wa fasaalitki.
Wa fi chaan da,al-matar ma nazalwa almi al-khariif kula ma ja.Laakin be da kula,inti gawweeti raaski fi charmatatkiwa abeeti ma khibilti eebki.
Wa hassa',inti tinaadiini wa tuguuli-:--Inta bas abuuyi al-habbeetni min ana sabiiye-!
Hal al-Rabb yakhdab leyi daayman-?Hal khadabah da yagood diddi ila l-abad-?--Wa misil da bas,inti gaa'ide tihajjilaakin tisawwi al-fasaala al-tagdare tisawwiiha.
Wa fi ayyaam hukum al-malik Yuuchiiya,Allah gaal leyi ana Irmiya-:-Inta ma chift al-sawwatah Israa'iil al-kaafre-?Hi machat fi raas ayyi jabal aali wa tihit ayyi chadara khadra wa achcharmatat hinaak wara l-asnaam.
Wa ana nahsib ba'ad hi sawwat kulla l-cheyy da,hi tigabbil leyi wa laakin hi ma gabbalat leyi.Wa akhutha Yahuuza al-khaayne chaafat fi'ilha.
Wa ana kula chiftaha.Aywa,be sabab zinaaha talagtaha le Israa'iil al-kaafre wa anteetha maktuub al-talaag.Wa laakin be da kula,akhutha Yahuuza al-khaayne ma hassat be ayyi khoof wa hi kula gammat achcharmatat.
Wa be sabab hi ma lammaaha be zinaaha da,najjasat al-ard.Wa hi achcharmatat wara l-asnaam al-sawwoohum be hajar wa be hatab.
Wa be da kula,Yahuuza al-khaayne akhutha le Israa'iil ma jaatni be kulla galibha laakin be khachch. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah gaal leyi battaan-:-Israa'iil al-kaafre hi saalhe ziyaada min Yahuuza al-khaayne.
Amchi,ya Irmiya,naadi be l-kalaam da fi l-munchaakh wa guul-:--Khalaas gabbili ta'aali leyi,ya Israa'iil al-kaafre.Wa da kalaam Allah.Ana ma niwassif leeki khadabiachaan ana saadikh,ma nakrub leeki fi galbi daayman.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Laakin waajib ta'arfi khataakiachaan inti isiiti Allah Ilaahki.Wa gassamti hubbiki le l-ajaanibwa achcharmatti ma'aahumtihit ayyi chadara khadrawa abeeti ma simi'ti kalaami.--Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Gabbulu ta'aalu leyi,ya iyaal al-kuffaar,achaan ana bas siidku.Nichiilku waahid min ayyi madiinawa itneen min ayyi gabiilawa nigabbilku fi Sahyuun.
Wa nukhutt foogku kubaaraatmisil ru'yaan al-ana narda beehumwa yuguuduuku be fikir adiil wa ma'rafa.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Wakit intu taldo wa tabgo katiiriin fi l-balad,fi l-wakit daak,ma yihajju battaan be sanduug mu'aahadat Allah wa naadum yifakkir foogah ma fiih wa naadum yizzakkarah kula ma fiih wa ma yagramo leyah wa la yasna'ooh battaan le taani marra.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,Madiinat al-Khudus yinaaduuha arch Allah wa kulla l-umam yilimmu fi Madiinat al-Khudus be usmi ana Allah wa battaan ma yigawwu ruuseehum fi l-fasaala.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,Bani Yahuuza yilimmu ma'a Bani Israa'iil.Wa min balad al-munchaakh humman yaju sawa fi l-balad al-ana anteetha le juduudhum misil warasa.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana dawwart intu tabgo al-ahsan min awlaadiwa nantiiku al-balad al-samhawa di ajmal warasa fi lubb al-umam.Wa ana nahsib intu tinaaduuni-:--Abuuna--wa ma taabooni.
Wa laakin intu khuntuuni,ya naas Israa'iil,misil mara khaanat raajilha.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Fiyah hiss ansama' min ruuse al-jibaalwa dool Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yabku wa yachhadoachaan humman talago al-deribwa nisooni ana Allah Ilaahhum.
Gabbulu leyi,ya iyaal al-kuffaar,wa ana nachfiiku marra waahid min kufurku.-Wa humman gaalo-:-Aywa,daahu aniina jaayiin leekachaan inta bas Allah Ilaahna.
Akiid al-ibaada fi ruuse al-hujaar,kidib saakitwa fi l-jibaal,tinsami' illa l-haraka.Wa akiid aniina nalgo al-najafi Allah Ilaahna bas.
Wa min aniina sukhaar,al-ibaada al-aaybe hint al-asnaamkhassarat juduudnawa dammarat khanamhum wa bagarhumwa awlaadhum wa banaathum.
Aniina raagdiin fi l-eebwa mulkhattiyiin be l-chamaate.Achaan aniina wa abbahaatna aznabnadiddak inta Allah Ilaahnamin aniina sukhaarlahaddi l-yoom.Wa ma simi'na kalaamak,inta Allah Ilaahna.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil-!Kan tigabbulu,gabbulu leyi ana.Wa kan tiba''udu al-muharramaat min giddaami,battaan ma ti'iiru.
Wa kan tahalfu beyi ana Allah al-Hayy,be sahiih wa hagg wa adaala,khalaas al-umam yifattuchu minni al-barakawa leyi ana,yimajjuduuni.
Wa daahu Allah hajja le naas Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa gaal-:-Intu misil zere' jadiid.Gabul ma yiteerubuuh,waajib yi'adduluuhachaan ma yiteerubu fi l-chook.
Tahhuru nufuusku leyi ana Allah,tahhuru guluubku,ya naas balad Yahuuzawa ya sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus-!Wa be sabab amalku al-fasil,khadabi yugumm didduku misil naar,yaakulku wa ma fi naadum al-yaktulha.
Yalla gummu khabburufi balad Yahuuzawa Madiinat al-Khuduswa adurbu al-buug fi kulla l-balad.Wa iitu be hiss aali wa guulu-:-Limmu wa adkhulu fi l-mudun al-gawiyiin.
Arfa'o raaye fi Sahyuunwa alja'o leehawa ma ti'akhkhuru fi l-tariig.Wa di l-fasaala al-nijiibha min munchaakhwa hi damaar kabiir.
Mudammir al-umam chaal al-derib,al-adu marag min bakaanahmisil duud marag min nugurtah.Hu yaji wa yakhrib baladkuwa mudunku yabgo faadiyiin min sukkaanhum.

Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-Rabb yuguul le cha'ab Madiinat al-Khudus-:-Fiyah riih haamiye jaayemin ruuse al-jibaal al-mulus hana l-saharawa jaaye le ummati al-misil bitt ammiwa l-riih di jaayewa la tidarri wa la tikharbil.
Hi riih chadiide bilheenwa jaaye min hinaak be amri.Wa hassa',ana kula nugumm nihaakimhum.
Wa l-cha'ab gaalo-:-Daahu al-adu jaayimisil al-sahaab al-chaayilwa arabaathum hana l-haribmisil riih amzooba'aanewa kheelhum sarii'iinziyaada min al-suguura.Ya khasaaritna-!Aniina addammarna-!
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,naddifi galibki min kulla l-fasaalawa be da,talge al-naja.Le mata tahfade fi galibkiafkaarki al-fasliin dool-?
Asma'o-!Min Daan fi l-munchaakh,yikhabburu be l-fasaala al-jaayewa min jibaal Afraayim,yanchuruuha.
Fukku adaan al-umamwa khabburu Madiinat al-Khuduswa guulu-:--Fi naas muhaasiriin jaayiin min balad ba'iidewa yikooruku le l-harib didd hillaal balad Yahuuza.
Wa misil hurraas al-zere',humman hawwago Madiinat al-Khudus min kulli jiiheachaan hi isatni ana.--Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa da taman haalki wa amalkiwa di natiijat fasaalitki.Sahiih,da murr ziyaadalahaddi galibki yingati'.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Butuuni-!Butuuni hirgo-!Ana nittanna min al-waja'wa galbi yadrub.Wa nafsi mubarjalawa ma nagdar naskut.Achaan ana simi't hiss al-buugwa korooraak al-harib.
Wa yi'iitu wa yuguulu-:--Damaar fi damaar-!--Aywa,kulla l-balad khirbat.Be khafla,khiyamna addammarowa buyuutna alhaddamo fi wakit galiil.
Lahaddi mata nichiif raayit al-haribwa nasma' hiss al-buug-?
Wa Allah gaal-:-Aywa,cha'abi munaafikhiin,humman ma ya'arfuuni.Humman misil iyaal fikirhum mahduud,ma yagdaro yafhamo cheyy.Humman nachiitiin le sawwiyiin al-fasillaakin le sawwiyiin al-kheer,ma ya'arfuuh.
Ana chift.Daahu al-ard bigat kharaab wa saharawa l-sama nuurha bigi ma fiih.
Ana chift.Daahu al-jibaal gaa'idiin yarjufuwa kulla l-hujaar yinhazzo.
Ana chift.Daahu ma fi naadumwa kulla l-tuyuur arrado.
Ana chift.Daahu al-balad al-khadra bigat saharawa kulla l-mudun alhaddamowa da min khadab Allah al-muhrig.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Kulla l-ard takhrabwa laakin be da kula,ana ma nidammirha marra waahid.
Wa be sabab da,al-ard taybaswa l-sama foog tidallim.Achaan al-kharaab da,ana bas kharrartah,ma nikhalliihwa ma nigabbil minnah.
Min harakat siyaad al-kheelwa l-yizarrugu al-nuchchaab,kulla naas al-hillaal yi'arrudu.Waahidiin yadkhulu fi l-khaabawa waahidiin yatla'o fi l-jibaal.Wa kulla hillaal Yahuuza yabgo faadiyiinwa sukkaanhum yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa laakin inti,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,ba'ad takhrabe,tisawwi chunu-?Maala talbase lubaas jamiil ahmar tchuwa tidissi ziinitki hint al-dahabwa tikahhili uyuunki-?Inti tijammili nafiski saakit bas-!Achaan sudgaanki al-jaro waraaki kula,yakrahooki wa yidooru mootki.
Ana nasma' bakimisil chakwa hana mara al-titaalig,misil siraakh ambikeeriiye al-talda.Wa di Sahyuun al-misil bineeye,tasrakh wa tinaahijwa timidd iideenha le l-faza'.Wa tuguul-:-Ya khasaarti-!Ana waga't mayte giddaam al-kattaaliin.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ruukhu fi chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus.Chiifu wa as'alo wa fattuchu fi l-naga'aat.Hal talgo naadum waahid yidaafi' le l-haggwa yifattich al-sahiih walla-?Kan ligiituuh,khalaas ana na'afa al-madiina.
Kan humman yahalfu be Allah al-Hayy kula,haliifithum di kidib saakit bas.
Ya Allah,inta ma gaa'id tiraakhib al-sahiih walla-?Inta kammaltuhumwa laakin humman ma lammaahum.Inta darabtuhumwa laakin humman yaabo al-adab.Humman yigawwu ruuseehum ziyaada min al-hajarwa yaabo ma yigabbulu leek.
Wa ana gult-:-Humman masaakiinwa ma induhum raas.Wa ma ya'arfu derib Allahwa la charii'at Ilaahhum.
Wa khalaas,ana namchi le l-kubaaraatwa nihajji ma'aahumachaan humman ya'arfu derib Allahwa charii'at Ilaahhum.-Macheet wa laakin al-kubaaraat kulamisil al-masaakiindallo tagalat charii'at Allah min ragabathumwa gata'o guyuudhum wa bigo hurriin.
Wa be sabab da,duud al-khaaba yadrubhumwa marfa'iin al-kadaade yakhribhum.Wa l-nimir yiraakhib fi mudunhumwa ayyi naadum al-yamrug,hu yicharritah.Achaan isyaanhum bigi katiirwa kufurhum bigi ziyaada.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Be l-haala di,kikkeef nakhfir leeku-?Iyaalku abooniwa yahalfu be l-asnaam al-ma Ilaah.Al-naas al-ana chabba'tuhum yisawwu zinawa yizzaahamo fi beet al-charmuuta.
Wa ayyi waahid yilaa'ib marit akhumisil al-humaar al-badiin al-haayij.
Hal ana ma ni'aakhib al-achya dool-?Hal ma nilkaffa fi l-umma al-misil di-?Wa da kalaam Allah.
Amchu le riigaan inabha wa dammuruuhwa laakin ma tidammuruuh marra waahid.Kassuru furuu'ah al-daraboachaan humman ma hineeyi ana Allah.
Aywa,Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuzakhaanooni khiyaana kabiire.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Al-naas dool kaddabo Allah wa gaalo-:-Hu ma yagdar yisawwi cheyy.Wa l-fasaala kula ma taji foogna,wa la duwaas wa la juu'.
Wa kalaam al-anbiya kulamisil riih saakitachaan kalaamhumma jaayi min Allah.Wa l-cheyy al-gaalooh dayaga' leehum fi raashum.
Wa fi chaan humman gaalo al-kalaam da,daahu Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ya Irmiya,kalaami al-fi khachmak da,nisawwiih misil naar.Wa l-cha'ab dool nisawwiihum hatabwa l-naar taakulhum.
Ya Bani Israa'iil-!Daahu ana nijiib umma min ba'iidwa hi tugumm didduku.Wa l-umma di gawiiyewa gadiime fi l-umam.Wa intu ma ta'arfu lukhkhithumwa la tafhamo kalaamhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa kalootithum misil al-khabur al-maftuuhwa humman kulluhum fahaliin.
Wa humman yanhabo buyuutku wa ma'aachkuwa yaktulu awlaadku wa banaatkuwa yadbaho khanamku wa bagarkuwa yidammuru inabku wa tiinku.Wa wakit humman yaju le l-harib,yikassuru mudunku al-gawiyiinal-intu tahsubu humman aaminiinwa tagoodu fooghum be salaam.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Hatta fi l-wakit da kula,ana ma nikammilku marra waahid.
Ya Irmiya,al-naas yas'alook wa yuguulu-:--Fi chaan chunu Allah Ilaahna yita''ibna misil da-?- Wa inta guul leehum-:--Intu abeetu Allah wa abadtu ilaahaat aakhariin fi baladku.Wa be misil da,intu kula tabgo abiid le l-ajaanib fi balad al-ma hintuku.-
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ooru zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa khabburu balad Yahuuza wa guulu-:
--Asma'o ya cha'ab,al-fikirku mahduudwa ma induku raas.Intu induku uyuun al-ma yichiifuwa induku udne al-ma yasma'o.
Wa maala ma takhaafo minni-?Wa maala ma tarjufu giddaami-?Ana bas al-khatteet turaab hadd daayim le l-bahar,hu ma yufuut huduudah.Kan hu yufuur wa moojah yugumm wa yadrub kula,hu ma yagdar yufuut al-huduud dool.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin intu cha'abi haraamiyiinwa aasiyiin min galibku daakhal.Intu abeetuuniwa gabbaltu wa macheetu.

Wa khataayaaku intu bas daharo minku al-achya doolwa zunuubku mana'o minku al-kheer.

Wa buyuuthum malaaniin be maal al-khachchmisil kurbo malaan jidaad.Wa be da,bigo kubaaraatwa khaniyiin.
Wa humman sumaan wa muluswa afsal minhum ma fiih.Humman ma yitabbugu al-adaalawa ma yihtarumu huguug al-atiim.Wa l-miskiin kula ma yantuuh huguugahwa be da,yanjaho fi hayaathum.

Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,angar'i-!Ma tigilli adabki-!Kan ma ke da,nikhalliikiwa tabge sahara wa ard ma maskuuna.

Wa hassa',ana anmaleet be khadab Allahwa iyiit ma nagdar nahmalah.-Wa Allah gaal-:-Khalli khadabi yanzil fi l-iyaal al-fi l-chawaari'wa fi kulla majmuu'at al-chabaab.Wa l-rujaal wa l-awiin yinkarbuwa l-naas al-kubaar wa l-chiyyaab kula.

Wa inta,ya Irmiya,ma tas'alni fi chaan al-cha'ab da wa ma tarfa' al-du'a wa tachhadni fi chaanhum.Ma tiddarra' leyi-!Ana ma nasma'ak.
Inta ma gaa'id tichiif al-cheyy al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuh fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus walla-?
Al-iyaal yilaggutu hatab wa l-abbahaat yigabbudu naar wa l-awiin yi'ajjinan dagiig le yisawwan ka'ak al-yigaddumuuh le sanam al-usmah malikat al-sama.Humman gaa'idiin yigaddumu hadiiyat charaab le ilaahaat aakhariin wa be da,yikhaddubuuni ana.
Hal da yikhaddibni walla-?Al-eeb yaji fooghum humman bas. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Khadabi al-muhrig yanzil fi l-bakaan da,fi l-naas wa l-haywaanaat wa chadar al-khaaba wa intaaj al-ard.Wa naar khadabi abadan ma tumuut.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Chiilu dahaayaaku al-muharragiin wa limmuuhum ma'a laham dahaayaaku al-aakhariin wa aakuluuh intu.
Wa wakit ana maragt juduudku min balad Masir,ana ma amartuhum be dahaaya muharragiin wa la be dahaaya aakhariin.
Wa laakin ana amartuhum be cheyy waahid bas wa gult-:--Asma'o kalaami-!Wa be da,ana nabga Ilaahku wa intu tabgo cha'abi.Chiilu adiil al-derib al-naamurku beyah wa be da,tafraho.--
Wa laakin humman ma khatto adaanhum le yasma'ooni wa sawwo hasab niiyithum al-fasle wa galibhum al-azrag.Wa badal yiwajjuhu aleyi,humman antooni duhuurhum.
Wa min wakit juduudku marago min balad Masir lahaddi l-yoom,ana gaa'id nirassil leeku abiidi al-anbiya daayman.
Wa laakin intu ma khatteetu adaanku wa simi'tuuni wa gawweetu ruuseeku wa bigiitu fasliin ziyaada min juduudku.
Wa inta,ya Irmiya,kan tifassir leehum kulla l-kalaam da,humman ma yasma'ook wa kan tinaadiihum kula ma yuruddu leek.
Wa khalaas guul leehum-:--Intu bas al-umma al-ma tasma' kalaam Allah Ilaahha wa ma takhbal wasiiytah.Wa l-sahiih angachcha min lisaanku wa bigi ma fiih.-
Ya naas Yahuuza,agta'o cha'arkuwa azguluuh min al-hizinwa atla'o fi ruuse al-jibaal wa nuuhuachaan Allah aba al-zurriiye al-tikhaddibah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Bani Yahuuza gaa'idiin yisawwu al-fasil giddaami wa yijiibu muharramaathum fi beeti al-foogah usmi wa yinajjusuuh.
Wa fi waadi Bani Hinnuum fi Tuufa bano madbah le yiharrugu foogah awlaadhum wa banaathum.Wa da fikir hana chunu-!Ana ma amartuhum beyah wa la fakkart foogah yoom waahid.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Wa yaji yoom waahid,battaan ma yinaaduuh Tuufa wa la waadi Bani Hinnuum.Wa laakin yinaaduuh waadi al-Janaazaat achaan yadfunuuhum fi Tuufa lahaddi tinmali be l-janaazaat.
Wa l-janaazaat dool yabgo akil le l-suguura wa l-maraaf'iin wa ma fi naadum al-yaji yatrudhum.
Wa fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus,ana niwaggif kulla l-zakhraat wa l-ragraag wa khine al-ursaan.Achaan al-balad di takhrab.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Wa fi l-wakit daak,yamurgu min al-khubuur udaam al-muluuk wa kubaaraat Yahuuza wa rujaal al-diin wa l-anbiya wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-udaam dool yukhuttuuhum barra giddaam ilaahaathum wa humman al-harraay wa l-gamar wa khuwwaat al-sama al-humman habboohum wa abadoohum wa taaba'oohum wa sa'aloohum wa sajado giddaamhum.Wa l-udaam dool ma yilimmuuhum le yadfunuuhum battaan,la-!Yikhalluuhum muchattatiin fi l-ard misil al-ba'ar.
Wa kulla l-faddalo hayyiin min al-gabiila al-fasle di,yifattuchu al-moot kula ma yalgooh.Wa l-faddalo dool yagoodu fi l-bakaanaat al-ana chattattuhum fooghum. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Ya Irmiya,guul leehum-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Al-yaga' ma yugumm walla-?Wa l-yiwaddir derbah ma yigabbil walla-?
Wa khalaas,maala cha'ab Madiinat al-Khudus waddaro deribhumwa abo ma yigabbulu leyi abadan-?Humman karabo gawi fi l-khachchwa abo ma yigabbulu leyi.
Wa ana simi't adiil kalaamhumlaakin hu ma sahiih.Wa waahid minhum kula ma nidim le fasaaltahwa gaal-:"Maala ana sawweet al-cheyy da-?"Ayyi waahid yamchi hasab niiytahmisil juwaad al-yadkhul fi l-harib be chidde.
Hatta al-kunji fi l-kadaade kula ya'arif waktahhana machiih wa jaytah.Wa l-gimri wa abunjaraari wa abunkhanamya'arfu wakithum al-yigabbulu foogah.Wa laakin cha'abi ma yifakkurufi l-tabii'a al-ana Allah anteetha leehum.
Kikkeef tagdaro tuguulu-:"Aniina hakiimiinachaan indina kitaab Tawraat Allah."Kikkeef tuguulu al-kalaam da-!Kuttaab al-gaanuun zaathum kaddaabiinwa awwajo al-Tawraat.
Al-ulama be hikmithum,yi'ayyubuuhumwa yinbahtu wa yinkarbu.Wa daahu le kalaam Allah rafadoohwa be da,ween yalgo al-hikma-?-
Wa Allah gaal-:-Wa be sabab da,nanti awiinhum le naas aakhariinwa ziraa'ithum kula le l-yichiiluuhum.Achaan min al-da'iif lahaddi l-gaadirkulluhum jaariyiin wara maal al-haraam.Wa l-anbiya wa rujaal al-diinkulluhum khachchaachiin.
Humman yikhaffufu jiraah ummati al-misil bitt ammiwa yuguulu-:--Salaam,salaam.--Wa laakin ma fi salaam.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Ana dawwart nalga fi bakaanhum intaaj al-ardwa laakin chadar al-inab ma indah iyaalwa l-tiin kula ma wilidwa l-warchaal kula yibis.Wa khalaas,ana khalleethumle naas aakhariin.
Wa l-naas gaalo-:-Maala nagoodu saakit-?Yalla gummu-!Khalli nindasso fi l-mudun al-gawiyiinwa narjo al-moot.Achaan Allah Ilaahna bas katalnawa zagaana almi musammam.Aywa,da fi chaan aniina aznabna.
Awwal indina acham fi l-salaamwa laakin ma fi kheerwa indina acham fi wakit al-ilaajwa laakin ja al-ru'ub.
Min Daan fi l-munchaakh,aniina nasma'o nafas kheelhumwa min harakat hanhiniin hisneehum,al-ard tarjif.Al-adu ja akal al-ard wa kulla cheyy al-fiihawa l-madiina wa sukkaanha.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Ana nirassil leeku abundaragwa amchideegaat al-naadum ma yagdar leehumwa humman yi'adduuku.
Galbi fi daakhili haznaanwa laakin hizni ma indah ilaaj.
Daahu gaa'id nasma' ummati al-misil bitt ammigaa'ide tikoorik le l-faza' fi kulla l-balad.Wa hi tuguul-:-Allah ma gaa'id fi Sahyuun walla-?Wa Sahyuun ma indaha malik walla-?-Wa Allah gaal-:-Humman khaddabooni be asnaamhumwa be ilaahaathum al-ajnabiyiin al-zaayliin.
Wa humman gaalo-:-Al-gati' kammal wa l-darat faatwa be da kula,ma nijiina.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Achaan anjarahat ummati al-misil bitt ammi,ana kula anjaraht.Anbahatwa hizin chadiid karabni.
Fi turaab Gil'aad,ma fi dawa al-yamsahooh walla-?Wa ma fi naadum al-yi'aalij walla-?Wa maala jiraah ummati al-misil bitt ammi ma biri-?
Khalli raasi yabga khazzaan hana dumuu'wa dumuu' uyuuni yisiilu misil uyuun almiachaan nabki leel wa nahaarle dahaaya ummati al-misil bitt ammi.
Wa kan fiyah ligdaabe fi l-sahara le l-musaafiriin,ana najri nagood fooghaba'iid min cha'abi wa nikhalliihum.Achaan kulluhum zannaayiinwa khaayniin.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Lisaanhum tariin misil al-nuchchaabwa yukhuchchuwa gudrithum fi l-balad di,ma ligooha be sahiih.Laakin humman maachiin min fasil le afsalwa ma ya'arfuuni.
Wa ayyi naadum khalli yahfad nafsah min rafiigahwa ayyi naadum ma yintakil le akhuuh.Achaan ayyi akhu khachchaach khaayinwa ayyi rafiig kaddaab naggaal kalaam.
Ayyi waahid yukhuchch akhuuhwa ma yuguul al-sahiih.Wa yi'allumu lisaanhum al-kidibwa yagoodu fi fasaalithum di.
Humman yamchu min unuf le unufwa min khachch le khachchwa yaabo ma ya'arfuuni.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ana nakchifhum misil al-dahab wa nagta'humwa da l-cheyy al-nisawwiih le ummati al-misil bitt ammi.
Wa lisaanhum tariin misil al-nuchchaab,khachumhum yuguul illa l-khachch.Yihajju le akhwaanhum be l-salaamwa laakin fi daakhil galibhum da,yukhuttu charak le yarmuuhum foogah.
Hal ana ma ni'aakhibhumbe sabab al-achya dool walla-?Aw ma nilkaffafi l-umma al-misil di walla-?-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Fi l-jibaal,ana nahzan wa nabkiwa fi maraa'i al-kadaade,ana nunuuhachaan al-ard hirgatwa ma fi naadum al-yaji foogha.Wa hiss hana bahiime kula ma yinsami'wa l-tuyuur wa l-wuhuuchkulluhum arrado minha.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana nisawwi Madiinat al-Khuduskoom hana turaabwa margad hana ba'aachiim.Wa hillaal balad Yahuuza yakhrabowa yafdo min sukkaanhum.
Wa hal fi naadum hakiimyafham al-cheyy da-?Kan Allah hajja leyah,khalli yifassirah.Maala al-balad di addammarat-?Wa maala hi khirbat wa bigat saharawa ma fi naadum al-yaji foogah-?
Wa Allah radda wa gaal-:-Humman khallo al-wasaaya al-ana anteethum leehum wa ma sim'o kalaami wa ma taaba'ooh.
Humman gawwo ruuseehum wa taaba'o ilaah Ba'al al-wallafoohum leyah juduudhum.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Daahu ana ni'akkilhum al-hamdal wa nazgiihum almi al-musammam.
Wa ana nichattithum been al-umam al-abadan ma ya'arfuuhum wa la humman wa la juduudhum.Wa nijiib al-harib fi usuthum lahaddi nikammilhum.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Alfaahamo wa naadu al-nawwaahaatwa naadu al-mutakhassisaat fi l-nuwaah yijan.
Khalli hinna yijan be sur'awa yabkan wa yunuuhan leena.Khalli uyuunna yidammu'uwa khalli dumuu'na yisiilu.
Min Sahyuun ansama' baki al-chakwa al-buguul-:-Aniina khiribna wa l-eeb katalna.Achaan taradoona min baladnawa haddamo buyuutna.
Ya l-awiin al-nawwaahaat,asma'an kalaam Allahwa dissan fi galibkan al-kalaam al-marag minnah.Wa alliman al-baki le banaatkanwa l-nuwaah le rafiigaatkan.
Wa guulan-:-Al-moot yatla' fi chabaabiiknawa yadkhul fi buyuutna al-samhiinwa yaktul al-iyaal fi l-chawaari'wa l-subyaan fi naga'aat al-madiina.
Ya Irmiya,guul leehum ke-:--Daahu kalaam Allah-:"Al-janaazaat yaga'omisil al-ba'ar fi l-kadaadewa misil al-ganaadiil wara l-gattaa'iinwa ma fi naadum yilaggithum."-
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Khalli al-hakiim ma yistakbar be hikmatahwa khalli al-gaadir ma yistakbar be gudurtahwa khalli al-khani ma yistakbar be khunaayah.
Kan naadum yistakbar,khalli yistakbar be da,yabga aagilachaan ya'arif kadar ana Allah basjibt al-kheer wa l-hagg wa l-adaala fi l-ard.Wa da bas al-ya'ajibni.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Akiid yaji yoom waahid,ana nugumm ni'aakhib kulla l-umam al-mutahhariin.
Ana nugumm didd Masir wa didd Yahuuza wa didd Adoom wa didd Bani Ammuun wa didd Muwaab wa didd al-yizayyunu cha'arhum al-yaskunu fi l-sahara.Laakin be l-sahiih,al-umam dool ma mutahhariin wa Bani Israa'iil kula guluubhum ma taahiriin.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,asma'o kalaam Allah al-gaalah leeku.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Ma tichiilu duruub al-umamwa ma tinbahtu min alaamaat al-sama.Khalli al-umam al-aakhariin basyinbahtu min kawwiriin al-harraay wa khanigiin al-gamar.
Achaan aadaat al-cha'ab dool zaayliin.Humman yamchu fi l-khaaba wa yagta'o chadarwa l-najjaar yanjurah be gadduum.
Wa yijammilah be fudda wa dahabwa be masaamiir,yuduggah le yisabbitahachaan ma yaga'.
Wa l-asnaam doolmisil khayaalaat fi l-zere'.Ma yihajju wa yanguluuhum nagalaanachaan ma yagdaro yuruukhu.Ma takhaafo-!Ma yisawwu leeku cheyy fasilwa laakin ma talgo minhum kheer kula.
Ya Allah-!Ma fi ilaah mislak-!Inta aziim wa aziim usmak al-Gaadir.
Yaatu al-ma yakhaaf minnak,ya malik al-umam-?Wa da,al-khoof al-waajib leek.Wa fi kulla ulama al-umamwa fi kulla l-mamaalik,ma fi ilaah mislak.
Humman kulluhum mukhaffaliinwa mataamiiswa ilimhum al-jaayi min al-asnaam al-zaayliin dool,ma yanfa'.
Wa be l-fuddaal-jaaybiinha min Tarchiichwa be l-dahabal-jaaybiinah min Uffaaz,al-haddaadi wa l-sayyaakhiyijammulu al-asnaam.Wa yilabbusuuhum khulgaanloonhum zahri wa garadial-sawwaahum khayyaati ma'ruuf.
Wa laakin Allah al-Rabb,hu bas al-Ilaah al-sahiih.Hu Allah al-Hayy,malik ila l-abad.Kan khidib,al-ard tarjifwa l-umam ma yahmalo za'alah.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,guulu leehum-:-Al-ilaahaat al-ma khalago al-samaawaat wa l-ard yabgo ma fiihum min tihit al-samaawaat wa yingachcho min al-ard.
Allah khalag al-ard be gudurtahwa sabbat al-aalam be hikmatahwa falla al-samaawaat be ilmah.
Wa wakit yaamur,al-almi yilimm bakaan waahid fi l-samawa l-sahaab yatla' min aakhir al-ard.Wa l-barraaga tachla' wa l-matar yanzilwa makhaazin al-riih yinfathu.
Wa ayyi naadum mukhaffalma indah ma'rafa.Wa ayyi sayyaakhi hana sanamal-eeb yakurbahachaan timsaalah da khachch,ma indah ruuh.
Al-asnaam zaayliinwa humman amal al-yijiib al-chamaate.Wa wakit al-ikhaab yaji,humman yiddammaro.
Wa Ilaah Yaakhuub ma misilhumachaan hu bas khalag kulla cheyy.Hu azal gabiilat Bani Israa'iille yabgo cha'abah al-misil warasatahwa usmah Allah al-Gaadir.
Irmiya gaal-:-Ya sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-muhaasara-!Limmu khumaamku wa arfa'ooh.
Achaan daahu Allah gaal-:--Akiid ana natrudku intu sukkaan al-balad diwa niwaddiiku ba'iid.Wa ana nidaayigkulahaddi tihissu be l-mudaayaga di.-
Wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus bako wa gaalo-:-Ya khasaaritna,aniina anjarahnawa jiraahna abadan ma yabra.Wa gulna-:--Da bas al-ta'ab al-muwajjah leenawa waajib nahmalooh.--
Wa khiyamna achchalla'owa kulla hubaalhum algatta'o.Wa iyaalna faatowa bigo ma fiihum.Wa ma fi naadum al-yisaa'idnanabnu khiyamnawa na'amuru fariigna.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Wa da achaan al-kubaaraat al-yuguudu al-naas mukhaffaliinwa ma wajjaho le Allah.Wa fi chaan da,humman ma najahowa khallo cha'abhum muchattatiinmisil al-raa'i al-khalla bahaaymah.
Asma'o-!Fiyah haraka jaayi gariibwa di haraka chadiide hana deechal-jaayi min balad al-munchaakhle yakhrib hillaal balad Yahuuza.Yisawwiihum kadaadewa margad hana ba'aachiim.
Ya Allah-!Ana na'arif kadar Bani Adamma yagdar yuguud nafsah fi derbah.Wa l-insaanma yagdar yasbit fi tariigah.
Ya Allah-!Addibna be rahma ma be khadabwa da achaan ma tisakhkhirna marra waahid.
Wa khalli khadabak yanzil fi l-umam al-ma ya'arfuukwa fi l-gabaayil al-ma yinaadu usmak.Achaan humman dammaro zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa sawwoohum ma fiihumwa kharabo masaakinhum.
Asma' kalaam al-mu'aahada wa hajji beyah le naas Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa guul leehum-:-Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Mal'uun al-naadum al-ma yasma' kalaam al-mu'aahada di.
Wa di l-mu'aahada al-ana sawweetha ma'a juduudku wakit ana maragtuhum min balad Masir al-hi misil jahannam al-tagta' al-hadiid.Wa fi l-mu'aahada di,ana gult-:"Asma'o kalaami wa tabbugu kulla awaamiri wa be da,intu tabgo cha'abi wa ana nabga Ilaahku."
Wa khalaas be da,ana tabbagt al-kalaam al-halaft beyah le juduudku wa gult nantiihum al-balad al-malaane be l-laban wa l-asal.Daahu intu aaychiin foogha al-yoom-!-- Wa ana Irmiya raddeet wa gult-:-Aamiin,ya Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah gaal leyi-:-Amchi fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa fi chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus wa guul al-kalaam da-:--Asma'o kalaam al-mu'aahada wa tabbuguuha.
Ana Allah hazzart juduudku daayman wa da min yoom maragtuhum min balad Masir lahaddi l-yoom.Wa gult leehum-:"Asma'o kalaami-!"
Wa laakin humman ma khatto adaanhum le yasma'o kalaami.Ayyi waahid yigawwi raasah fi l-fasaala wa ma tabbago kalaam al-mu'aahada di.Wa be da,ana aakhabtuhum achaan ma tabbagooha.-
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Naas Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus gammo be khiyaana diddi.
Achaan humman gabbalo fi khata juduudhum al-abo ma yasma'o kalaami wa humman jaro wara ilaahaat aakhariin le ya'abuduuhum.Wa be da,Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza gata'o al-mu'aahada al-ana sawweetha ma'a juduudhum.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Ana ninazzil fooghum al-fasaala wa ma yagdaro yamurgu minha.Humman yikooruku le nafza'hum wa laakin ana ma nasma'hum.
Naas hillaal balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus yamchu yikooruku yidooru al-faza' min al-ilaahaat al-humman yiharrugu leehum al-bakhuur.Wa laakin al-ilaahaat dool ma yagdaro yinajjuuhum min al-fasaala di.
Ya Bani Yahuuza,ilaahaatku aktar min hillaalku.Ya sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus,madaabihku aktar min chawaari'ku.Wa dool al-madaabih al-baneetuuhum le l-Eeb wa hu ilaah Ba'al al-tiharrugu leyah al-bakhuur.
Wa inta,ya Irmiya,ma tisalli fi chaan al-cha'ab da wa la tachki wa la tachhad leehum.Achaan ana ma nasma' wakit yinaaduuni fi yoom al-fasaala.
Wa cha'abi al-mahbuubiin,niiyithum faslewa yaju fi beeti da yidooru chunu-?Hal al-nazir al-waa'adooni beyahaw al-laham al-khassasooh da,yagdar yinajjiihummin al-fasaala al-jaaye leehum walla-?Wa be da,yagdaro yanjo walla-?
Wa ana Allah ja'altuhummisil chadarat zaytuun khadra samhewa mujammala be iyaalha.Wa laakin hassa',ninazzil naaral-tahrig waraghawa taakul furuu'halahaddi yisawwu haraka chadiide.
Wa ana Allah al-Gaadir bas maggantaha wa kharrart nisawwi leeha al-fasaala,be sabab al-fasaala al-sawwooha Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.Wa humman khaddabooni wakit harrago bakhuur le ilaah Ba'al.
Allah khabbaraani be l-niiye al-fasle al-gammo beeha diddi ana Irmiya.Wa khalaas be da,ana iriftaha.
Wa ana misil hamal miskiin al-yiwaddu le l-jazzaara.Wa ana ma irift kadar niiyithum al-fasle di tukhussini wa humman buguulu-:-Khalli nidammuruuh misil chadara khadra wa nuguchchuuh min ard al-hayyiin-!Wa battaan usmah kula ma yinaaduuh.
Ya Allah al-Gaadir,inta al-tahkim be l-adilwa takchif al-fi l-guluubwa ta'arif al-fi l-afkaar-!Ana nidoor inta tichiil fooghum al-taarwa fi chaan da,ana chakeet leek.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu kalaam Allah didd naas Anatuut al-yidooru yaktuluuni.Humman gaalo-:-Ma titnabba' be usum Allah-!Kan atnabba't,naktuluuk.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ana ni'aakhibhum.Subyaanhum yumuutu fi l-harib wa awlaadhum wa banaathum yumuutu be l-juu'.
Wa wakit ni'aakhibhum naas Anatuut,minhum nijiib fooghum al-fasaala.Wa minhum naadum waahid kula ma yifaddil hayy.
Ya Allah,inta aadil-!Wa laakin nidoor nachki leek.Aywa,nidoor nihajji ma'aakfi cheyy bukhuss al-charii'a.Maala al-fasliin yanjahofi khatwaathum-?Maala al-khaayniin yagoodufi l-raaha be khiyaanithum-?
Inta bas maggantuhum misil chadarawa dasso uruughum fi l-turaabwa kibro lahaddi sawwo iyaal.Khuchuumhum yinaadu usmakwa laakin guluubhum ma ma'aak.
Ya Allah-!Inta tichiifniwa takchif al-fi galbiwa ta'arifni kadar ana ma'aak.Wa laakin le l-fasliin dool,suughum misil khanam al-juzural-mukhassasiin le yoom al-dabih.
Lahaddi mata al-ard tahzanwa yaybas kulla gechch al-kadaade-?Wa l-haywaanaat wa l-tuyuuryabgo ma fiihumwa da be sabab fasaalit sukkaanha al-yuguulu-:-Hu ma ya'arif mustakhbalna.
Wa Allah gaal leyi ana Irmiya-:-Kan tajri ma'a naas be rijileenak wa ta'aya,kikkeef tagdar tisaabig ma'a l-kheel-?Wa kan waajib leek balad salaam le ti'iich be amaan,kikkeef tagdar ti'iich fi khaabat al-Urdun-?
Daahu akhwaanak iyaal abuuk zaathum yukhuunuuk.Aywa,humman yijtamu'u ma'a naas aakhariin waraak.Angari',ma ti'aaminhum hatta kan yihajju leek kalaam halu kula.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana nikhalli beetiwa naaba cha'abi al-misil warasati.Wa ummati al-mahbuuba,ana nisallimha le l-adu.
Wa cha'abi bigi leyi misil duudfi lubb al-khaaba.Hu yikirr diddiwa be da,ana ma nihibbah.
Wa cha'abi misil al-sagur al-argatal-yahjumuuh al-suguura.Yalla limmu kulla haywaanaat al-kadaadewa a'azumuuhum fi l-khada-!
Wa kubaaraat al-adu jo dammaro baladimisil ru'yaan be maalhumyidammuru jineenti hana l-inab.Wa fajjakhooha wa sawwooha sahara kharaab,hi al-awwal misil zer'i al-jamiil.
Humman sawwooha kharaabwa daahu hi giddaami yaabse wa kharbaane.Aywa,al-balad kullaha ke kharbaanewa ma fi naadum al-yihinn foogha.
Wa fi kulla ruuse al-jibaalal-mukharribiin jaayiin min al-sahara.Seef Allah yadrub al-ard min tarafha le tarafhawa ma fi salaam le ayyi insaan.
Intu teerabtu al-gamehwa ligiitu al-haskaniit baswa ayyeetu nufuusku bala faayde.Wa l-eeb karabku min natiijat khidmitkuwa da be sabab khadab Allah al-muhrig.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Kulla l-jiiraan al-fasliin al-yilammusu al-ard al-ana anteetha warasa le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil,ana nimallithum misil chadara min arduhum.Wa Bani Yahuuza kula nimallithum min usuthum.
Wa laakin ba'ad mallattuhum,battaan ana narhamhum wa nigabbilhum ayyi waahid fi ard warasatah wa ayyi waahid fi baladah.
Awwal al-umam dool allamo cha'abi yahalfu be Ba'al.Wa laakin hassa',kan humman yitaabu'u derib cha'abi wa yahalfu be usmi ana Allah al-Hayy,khalaas yaskunu be amaan fi usut cha'abi.
Wa laakin al-umma al-ma tasma' kalaami da,ana nimallitha marra waahid wa niwaddirha. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya Irmiya,amchi achri leek hizaam hana gumaach wa arbutah fi sulbak wa ma tidissah fi l-almi.
Wa khalaas,ana chareet al-hizaam hasab kalaam Allah wa rabatah fi sulbi.
Wa battaan Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Be l-hizaam al-inta chareetah wa rabatah fi sulbak da,gumm amchi ale waadi al-Faara.Wa hinaak labbid al-hizaam da fi chuguug al-hajar.
Wa khalaas,ana macheet labbadtah fi waadi al-Faara misil Allah amaraani beyah.
Wa ba'ad wakit tawiil,Allah gaal leyi-:-Gumm amchi le waadi al-Faara wa chiil al-hizaam al-gult leek tilabbidah hinaak.
Wa khalaas,ana macheet le waadi al-Faara wa fattacht wa chilt al-hizaam min al-bakaan al-ana labbadtah foogah.Wa daahu al-hizaam da bigi gadiim,ma yanfa' cheyy.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Daahu ana Allah gult-:--Misil da,ana niwaddir istikbaar Yahuuza wa istikbaar al-ziyaada hana Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa dool al-cha'ab al-fasliin wa ma yasma'o kalaami wa yigawwu ruuseehum.Wa yajru wara l-ilaahaat al-aakhariin le yasjudu giddaamhum wa ya'abuduuhum.Humman dool khalli yabgo misil al-hizaam al-ma yanfa' cheyy da.
Wa misil al-naas yarbutu al-hizaam fi l-sulub,ana kula rabatt kulla Bani Israa'iil wa kulla Bani Yahuuza achaan yabgo cha'abi wa yabgo sabab le kulla l-umam yi'allu usmi wa yahmuduuni wa yi'azzumuuni.Wa laakin humman abo ma yasma'ooni.-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya Irmiya,guul leehum al-kalaam da-:Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil buguul-:--Ayyi bukhsa yusubbu foogha khamar.- Wa akuun yuruddu leek wa yuguulu-:--Aniina na'arfu kadar ayyi bukhsa yusubbu foogha khamar.--
Khalaas inta guul leehum-:Daahu Allah gaal-:--Kulla sukkaan al-balad di,ana nisakkirhum be khadabi.Wa humman al-muluuk al-min zurriiyit Dawuud wa rujaal al-diin wa l-anbiya wa kulla sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Nadrub al-bukhsa al-waahide be l-aakhara.Wa misil da,nadrub al-abbahaat be awlaadhum.Wa fi l-yoom daak,wa la nihinn fooghum wa la narhamhum.Wa nuguchchuhum wa ma fi cheyy yadharni minhum.-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil,khuttu adaanku wa asma'o-!Ma tistakbaroachaan da kalaam Allah al-hu gaalah.
Majjudu Allah Ilaahkugabul ma yirassil leeku al-dalaamwa gabul rijleeku ma yittarta'o fi l-jibaalal-khattaahum al-dalaam.Intu tarjo al-nuur be achamwa laakin hu yibaddilah be l-dalaam al-haalikwa yisawwiiku misil gaa'idiin fi lubb sahaabaay zarga.
Wa kan ma tasma'o al-kalaam da,ana nahzan fi galbi daakhal be sabab istikbaarku.Wa nabki daayman wa dumuu'i yisiiluachaan khanam Allah al-humman Bani Israa'iilkaraboohum masaajiin.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Guul le l-malikwa le l-malika al-umm-:--Anzulu min kursi al-mulukwa agoodu fi l-ardachaan taaj al-muluk al-aziimwaga' min raasku.
Mudun al-junuub alhaasarowa ma fi naadum al-yufukk hisaarhum.Wa kulla Bani Yahuuza yiwadduuhum fi l-khurbawa da l-waddiyiin fi l-khurba be l-kaamil.-
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,arfa'e raaski wa chiifi,daahu al-adu jaayi min munchaakh.Ween sukkaanki al-ammantuhum leeki,al-misil al-khanam al-samhiin-?
Chunu tuguuli wakit ana Allah nikabbir foogkial-naas al-inti raafagtiihum zamaan-?Aywa,waja' chadiid yakrubkimisil talagat al-mara al-gaa'ide talda.
Wa tas'ale nafiski wa tuguuli-:--Maala al-cheyy da ja leyi-?--Wa be sabab khataaki al-katiir,yisillu minki farditkiwa yisawwu foogki al-unuf.
Hal al-insaan yagdar yibaddil loonah walla-?Wa l-nimir yagdar yibaddil farwitah al-dar'a di walla-?La-!Wa intu al-muwaalfiin al-fasaala,tagdaro tisawwu al-adiil walla-?
Ana nichattitku misil al-gechchal-chaayle al-riih fi l-sahara.
Wa daahu gisimkuwa hagguku al-kiltah leeku.Achaan intu nisiituuniwa khatteetu galibku fi ilaahaat al-khachch.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,inti ya Madiinat al-Khudus,ana nisill minki farditkiwa nukhuttaha leeki fi raaskiwa l-naas yichiifu ireeki.
Ana chift asnaamki al-muharramiinfi l-jibaal wa fi l-kadaade.Ana chift chahwaatki wa zinaakiwa charmatatki al-fasle ma'aahum.Ya khasaaritki,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,inti al-ma tidoori titahhiri nafiski-!Wa da le mata-?
Allah hajja le Irmiya fi wakt al-jafaaf.
Wa hu gaal-:-Balad Yahuuza yibsatwa mudunha bigo misil al-ageeg al-itichwa jaffa wa daffag.Wa sukkaanhum,al-hizin karabhum wa waga'o fi l-turaabwa korooraak naas Madiinat al-Khudus ansama'.
Wa l-kubaaraat yirassulu khaddaamiinhumle yijiibu almiwa laakin wakit yaju le l-khazzaan,ma yalgo cheyy.Wa humman yigabbulumawaa'iinhum yaabsiinwa achamhum yingati'wa yabga leehum gaasiwa yidanguru ruuseehum.
Wa l-matar ma nazal fi l-baladwa l-ard achchaggagat.Wa be da,al-harraatiin achamhum yingati'wa yidanguru ruuseehum.
Hatta al-aryal fi l-kadaade kula talda jidiihawa tikhalliih achaan ma fi gechch.
Wa hamiir al-kadaade yagiifufi ruuse al-jibaalwa yarfa'o manaakhirhumle l-riih misil al-ba'aachiim.Wa choofhum yad'afachaan ma fi gechch.
Wa l-cha'ab gaalo-:-Sahiih,kan khataana yachhad foogna kula,gumm fi chaan usmak al-aziim,ya Allah-!Achaan aniina kafarna beek wa aznabna.
Wa inta acham Bani Israa'iilwa munajjiiha fi wakt al-diige.Maala tabga misil ajnabi fi l-baladaw misil musaafir al-yunuum leele waahide bas-?
Wa maala tabga misil naadum ayyaanaw misil faaris al-ma yagdar yinajji-?Ya Allah-!Be da kula,inta gaa'id fi usutnawa usmak gaa'id foogna.Ma tikhalliina-!
Wa daahu kalaam Allah le l-cha'ab da.Hu gaal-:-Aywa,humman yihibbu yajru jaay wa jaay wa ma yichiilu al-derib al-adiil. Laakin da,Allah ma radyaan beyah.Wa hassa',hu yizzakkar khataahum wa yi'aakhibhum be sabab zunuubhum.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya Irmiya.Ma tisalli fi chaan al-cha'ab da wa la fi chaan kheerhum.
Kan humman yusuumu kula,ana abadan ma nasma' chakwaahum.Wa kan yigaddumu leyi dahaaya muharragiin wa hadaaya kula,ana ma narda beehum.Achaan ana chilt niiye nuguchchuhum be l-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba.
Wa ana Irmiya gult-:-Ya Allah Rabbi,daahu al-anbiya gaalo leehum kadar ma yichiifu al-harib wa l-juu' kula ma yaji fooghum.Wa buguulu battaan kadar inta Allah tantiihum al-raaha wa l-amaan fi baladhum.
Wa Allah radda leyi wa gaal-:-Al-tanabbu hana l-anbiya be usmi da kidib-!Ana ma rassaltuhum leeku wa la amartuhum be cheyy wa la gult leehum kalaam.Kulla ru'yithum di kidib wa ilimhum hana l-kheeb da ma yilhaggag wa da fikir khachchaach.Wa da bas tanabbu al-anbiya al-kaddaabiin.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu ana Allah gult-:--Al-anbiya dool,ana ma rassaltuhum leeku.Wa be da kula,humman gaa'idiin yitnabba'o be usmi wa yuguulu kadar al-harib wa l-juu' ma yaju fi l-balad di.Wa laakin be nafs al-harib wa l-juu' al-hajjo beyah al-anbiya dool bas yumuutu.
Wa l-naas al-humman yitnabba'o leehum yumuutu muchattatiin fi chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus be sabab al-juu' wa l-harib.Wa ma yalgo daffaan wa la humman wa la awiinhum wa la awlaadhum wa la banaathum.Wa be misil da,ana ninazzil fooghum natiijat fasaalithum.-
Wa Allah amar Irmiya yikallim le l-cha'ab.-Dumuu'i yisiilu leel wa nahaarwa ma yagiifu.Achaan damaar kabiir ja le ummatial-misil bitt ammi al-udriiyewa damaarha misil al-jiraah al-ma biddaawa.
Wa kan namchi fi l-kadaade,daahu nichiif al-maytiin be l-harib.Wa kan nadkhul fi l-madiina,daahu nichiif al-ta'baaniin be l-juu'.Al-anbiya wa rujaal al-diin yiliffu fi l-baladwa laakin ma yafhamo cheyy.
Wa l-cha'ab gaalo-:-Ya Allah-!Maala rafadt naas Yahuuza-?Wa maala kiriht sukkaan Sahyuun-?Maala darabtina be l-maradal-ma yil'aalaj-?Awwal indina acham fi l-salaamwa laakin ma fi kheer.Wa indina acham fi wakit al-ilaajwa laakin ja al-ru'ub.
Ya Allah-!Na'arfu al-fasaala al-sawweenaahawa l-khata al-sawwooh juduudna,aywa,aniina aznabna.
Ma tarfudna fi chaan usmak al-aziim,ma taaba al-madiinaal-foogha arch majdak.Wa fakkir fi mu'aahadatak ma'aana,ma tagta'ha.
Hal min al-ilaahaat al-zaayliin hana l-umam doolfi waahid al-yagdar yinazzil al-almi walla-?Hal al-sama zaathatinazzil al-matar walla-?La-!Illa beek inta Allah Ilaahna.Wa aniina narjook be achamachaan inta bas al-tisawwi kulla cheyy.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Kan al-yoom Muusa wa Samuwiil yaju yachhadooni kula,al-cha'ab dool ana ma narhamhum.Yalla atrudhum min giddaami wa khalli yamchu-!
Wa akuun yas'alook wa yuguulu-:--Ya Irmiya,namchu ween-?- Wa khalaas,inta rudd leehum wa guul-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Al-waajib leyah al-moot,yiwadduuh le l-moot.Wa l-waajib leyah al-seef,yadurbuuh be l-seef.Wa l-waajib leyah al-juu',yinazzulu foogah al-juu'.Wa l-waajib leyah al-ubuudiiye,yisawwuuh abid."-
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Ana nijiib fooghum arba'a achya al-yidammuruuhum wa humman al-seef le yaktulhum wa l-kulaab le yukurruuhum wa l-suguura le yaakuluuhum wa l-maraaf'iin le yikammuluuhum.
Wa ana nisawwiihum masal al-bikhawwif kulla mamaalik al-ard.Wa da be sabab kulla l-fasaala al-sawwaaha Manassa wileed Hizkhiiya malik Yahuuzafi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Yaatu al-yihinn foogki,inti ya Madiinat al-Khudus-?Yaatu al-yisabbirki-?Yaatu al-yinlafit leekiwa yijiib khabarki-?
Inti bas abeetiiniwa anteetiini daharkiwa fi chaan da,ana maddeet iidile nadrubki.Achaan ana ma nagdar battaan,sabart leeki katiir.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi kulla mudun al-balad,ana chattat cha'abi misil kharbaltuhum be tabag.Wa katalt iyaalhumwa dammart cha'abi.Wa be da kula,ma khallo deribhum al-hawaan.
Ana sawweet araamilhum katiiraatziyaada min ramla hana khachum al-bahar.Wa be nahaar bas,ana jibt al-mudammirfi ammahaat al-subyaanle yidammir subyaanhinwa faj'atan jibt fooghinal-khoof al-chadiid.
Wa amm al-sab'a awlaad tahzanwa nafasha yingati'.Nahaarha yabga leeha leelwa achamha yingati'wa tidangir raasha.Wa l-faddalo minhumnisallimhum le seef udwaanhum.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Ya khasaarti-!Maala ammi wildatnile nukuun raajil hana machaakilwa khilaaf fi kulla l-balad.Ana wa la dayyant fudda wa la dayyanooniwa be da kula,al-naas yal'anooni.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Akiid ana ninajjiik le l-kheer.Wa akiid ana nijiib leek udwaanakyachhadook fi wakt al-ta'ab wa l-diige.
Hal al-hadiid yinkasir walla-?Khaassatan al-hadiid al-gawi al-jaayi min munchaakhwa l-nahaas-?
Ya cha'abi-!Khunaaku wa maalku,ana nisallimhum le l-nahib.Wa di natiijat kulla zunuubkufi kulla arduku.
Ana nisawwiiku abiid le udwaankufi balad al-ma ta'arfuuha.Wa naar khadabi tigabbidwa taakulku.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Ya Allah-!Inta ta'arifni-!Fakkir foogi wa haasibhum.Wa kaffi leyi al-taarfoog al-yitaaruduuni.Ma tikhalliini nabga dahiiyat sabrak-!Wa a'arif kadar nilhammal al-mu'yaar fi chaanak inta.
Wakit kalaamak ja leyi,ana tawwaali chiltah misil al-jii'aan yichiil al-khubza.Wa kalaamak farrahniwa bigi leyi suruur fi galbi.Ya Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir-!Ya'arfuuni be usmak.
Ana ma ga'adt ma'a l-naas al-yal'abowa la firiht ma'aahum.Wa be sabab iidak kaanat foogi,ana ga'adt tarafachaan inta maleetni be hizin.
Maala ta'abi gaa'id foogi daayman-?Wa maala jiraahi ma yil'aalajwa aba ma yabra-?Akiid inta bigiit leyi misil een almi al-ma tijimm adiilwa almiiha ma mu'akkad.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Ya Irmiya-!Kan tigabbil leyi,ana nigabbilak wa tagiif giddaami.Wa kan tifannid been al-kalaamal-najiid wa l-neyy,tabga nabi leyiwa tikallim be kalaami battaan.Wa waajib humman bas yigabbulu leek,ma inta ya tigabbil leehum.
Wa giddaam al-naas dool,ana nisawwiikmisil durdur hana nahaas al-abadan ma yinkasir.Humman yihaarubuukwa laakin ma yisawwu leek cheyyachaan ana nukuun ma'aak,nahmiik wa ninajjiik.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ana ninajjiik min iid al-fasliinwa nafdaak min iid siyaad al-unuf.
Ma taakhud mara wa la tijiib iyaal fi l-bakaan da.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-bukhuss al-iyaal wa ammahaathum wa abbahaathum al-wildoohum fi l-balad di.Hu gaal-:
Humman yumuutu min al-marad wa ma yadfunuuhum wa la yabku leehum.Wa janaazaathum yichchattato misil al-ba'ar fi l-ard.Wa humman yumuutu be sabab al-harib wa l-juu' wa janaazaathum kamaan yaakuluuhum al-suguura wa l-maraaf'iin.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Ya Irmiya-!Ma tamchi bakaan al-furaach wa la tabki wa la tikalwid leehum.Achaan ana chilt min al-cha'ab da al-salaam al-anteetah leehum wa l-kheer wa l-rahma.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi l-balad di,min al-gaadir le l-da'iif yumuutu wa ma yadfunuuhum wa la yabku leehum wa la yinakhkhuchu jisimhum wa la yizayyunu ruuseehum min al-hizin.
Wa le ahal al-mayyit,ma yijiibu leehum akil le yisabburuuhum.Wa ma yijiibu leehum charaab le yisabburuuhum hatta kan al-mayyit da abuuhum walla ammuhum kula.
Ya Irmiya,ma tadkhul fi beet al-foogah aazuuma wa tagood ma'aahum le taakul wa tachrab.
Achaan ana Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gult-:--Fi l-balad di,fi l-ayyaam dool wa giddaam uyuunku,akiid ana niwaggif ayyi khine hana suruur wa farah wa ragraag al-ariis wa zakhraat al-aruus.-
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ya Irmiya,kallim le l-cha'ab dool be l-kalaam da.Wa akuun humman yas'alook wa yuguulu-:--Maala Allah kharrar diddina fasaala kabiire misil di-?Chunu khataana wa zanibna al-sawweena didd Allah Ilaahna-?--
Wa khalaas,inta rudd wa guul leehum-:--Achaan juduudku abooni ana Allah wa jaro wara ilaahaat aakhariin le ya'abuduuhum wa yasjudu giddaamhum.Wa leyi ana kamaan,abooni wa wasiiyaati kula ma karaboohum gawi.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin intu kamaan sawweetu al-fasaala ziyaada min juduudku wa ayyi waahid minku daayman yigawwi raasah fi l-fasaala wa ma yasma'ni.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nakhtifku wa nazrugku fi balad aakhara al-awwal ma ta'arfuuha wa la intu wa la juduudku.Wa hinaak,leel wa nahaar ta'abudu ilaahaat aakhariin wa battaan ma talgo rahmati.-
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Zamaan al-naas gaa'idiin yahalfu be Allah al-Hayy,hu al-marag Bani Israa'iil min Masir.Wa laakin yaji yoom waahid,
humman yibaddulu haliifithum wa yahalfu be Allah al-Hayy,hu al-marag Bani Israa'iil min balad al-munchaakh wa min kulla l-buldaan al-hu chattataahum fooghum.Wa ana Allah nigabbilhum fi l-ard al-anteetha le juduudhum.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Daahu ana nirassil le l-cha'ab hawwaatiin katiiriin yihawwutuuhum misil al-huut.Wa ba'ad da,nirassil leehum gannaasiin katiiriin yagunsu leehum misil al-seed fi l-hujaar wa fi l-jibaal lahaddi fi karaakiir al-jibaal.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa eeni gaa'ide tichiif kulla duruubhum,cheyy mulabbad leyi ma fiih.Wa khataahum kula ma mudaarag minni,ana gaa'id nichiifah.
Wa awwal cheyy,ana nilkaffa minhum marrateen taman al-khata wa l-zanib al-humman sawwooh.Achaan humman ma ahtaramo baladi wa malooha be tamaasiilhum al-makruuhiin.Wa ard warasati malooha be muharramaathum.
