Ya Allah-!Inta gudurti wa bakaani al-gawiwa inta malja'i fi yoom al-diige.Leek inta yaju al-umammin aakhir al-ard wa yuguulu-:-Juduudna warasoilla ilaahaat khachchaachiinwa humman al-zaayliinal-ma induhum faayde.
Hal al-insaan yagdar yisawwile nafsah ilaahaat walla-?La-!Humman be sahiihma yabgo Ilaah.
Khalaas Allah gaal-:-Daahu ana Allah ni'arrifhum.Aywa fi l-marra di,ni'arrifhum gudrat iidi.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Zanib Bani Yahuuza manguuch be mungaach hana hadiidal-khachmah gawi misil al-maass.Wa maktuub fi guluubhum misil fi loohwa fi guruun madaabihhum.
Wa misil yizzakkaro iyaalhum,humman yizzakkaro madaabih ilaahaathumwa l-iidaan al-khazzoohum le ibaadat Achiira.Wa dool tihit ayyi chadara khadrawa fi raas ayyi jabal aali.
Wa intu al-gaa'idiin ta'abudu al-ilaahaatfi l-jibaal fi l-kadaade,khunaaku wa maalku,ana nisallimhum le l-nahibwa di natiijat zunuubkufi kulla arduku.
Wa intu be nufuusku tikhalluard warasatku al-ana anteetha leeku.Wa nisawwiiku abiid le udwaankufi balad al-awwal ma ta'arfuuhaachaan intu gabbadtu naar khadabiwa taakulku daayman.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Mal'uun al-naadum al-yitwakkal ale l-insaanwa yintakil ale gudrat al-jisim al-yumuutwa galbah yiba''idah min Allah.
Wa l-naadum da,hu misil chideere al-gaayme fi l-naga'awa hu abadan ma yichiif al-kheer.Hu yagood fi ard jafaaf sahara,fi ard al-ma tigawwim nabaatwa ma indaha sukkaan.
Mubaarak al-insaan al-yitwakkal ale Allahwa yi'aamin beyah fi kulla cheyy.
Wa hu misil chadara al-gaayme fi khachum al-baharwa uruugha rawyaaniin almi.Hi ma takhaaf fi wakt al-seefwa warchaalha daayman akhdar.Wa kan taji sana kaamile hana jafaaf kula,hi ma lammaaha wa talda iyaalha.
Galib al-insaan khachchaach min kulla cheyywa ma indah ilaaj.Naadum ma yagdar ya'arfah.
Illa ana Allah nijarrib galib al-insaanwa nakchif daakhilah.Wa nikaffiih natiijat amalahhasab derbah al-yichiilah.
Wa l-insaan al-yifattichal-maal be najaada,hu misil teeraay al-tasrig beed al-aakhariinwa tifaggi'ah.Wa wakit hu lissaa' be gudurtah bas,maalah da yikammilwa fi aakhir ayyaamah,yabga matmuus be sahiih.
Fi arch aziim gaa'id foog min zamaanwa da bakaan beetna al-mukhaddas.
Ya Allah-!Inta acham Israa'iilwa kulla l-yaabook,al-eeb yikhattiihum.Wa l-yiba''udu minnak kamaanyil'aakhaboachaan humman abo een almi al-hayawa da inta Allah.
Achfiini,ya Allah,wa ana nalga al-chifa.Wa najjiini wa nalga al-najaachaan inta bas nahmudak.
Wa gaalo leyi-:-Ween kalaam Allah al-gaalah-?Khalli yilhaggag-!
Ana ma talabttinazzil fooghum al-fasaalawa la atmanneetyoom al-diige yanzil fooghum.Al-yamrug min khachmidaayman inta tasma'ah wa ta'arfah,ya Allah-!
Wa khalli ma nakhaaf minnakachaan inta malja'i fi yoom al-fasaala.
Wa l-yitaaruduuni,khalli al-eeb yakrubhumwa laakin ma yakrubni ana.Wa khalli humman yibarjuluwa laakin ana ma nibarjil.Wa jiib fooghum yoom al-fasaalawa dammirhum marra waahid.
Wa daahu Allah gaal leyi-:-Amchi agiif fi l-baab al-kabiir hana Madiinat al-Khudus al-beyah yadkhulu wa yamurgu muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa ba'ad da,amchi agiif fi kulla biibaanha al-aakhariin.
Wa hajji le muluuk Yahuuza wa naas Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-yufuutu be l-biibaan dool.Wa guul leehum-:--Asma'o kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah gaal-:"Fakkuru fi nufuusku.Fi yoom al-sabt ma tichiilu tagala wa ma tufuutu beeha be biibaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Fi yoom al-sabt,ma tichiilu tagala wa tamurguuha min buyuutku wa ma tisawwu ayyi khidme.Wa laakin aj'alo yoom al-sabt da yoom mukhaddas misil ana amart beyah juduudku.
Wa laakin juduudku ma khatto adaanhum wa la sim'ooni.Gawwo ruuseehum wa ma dawwaro yasma'ooni ana wa la dawwaro yasma'o wasiiyti.
--"Wa laakin intu,asma'ooni adiil-!Fi yoom al-sabt,ma tichiilu tagala wa ma tufuutu beeha be biibaan al-madiina di.Wa aj'alo yoom al-sabt da yoom mukhaddas wa ma tisawwu foogah ayyi khidme.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa be da,khalaas yadkhulu be biibaan al-madiina di muluukku al-yagoodu fi kursi al-muluk hana Dawuud al-raakbiin fi arabaat harib wa kheel.Wa yadkhulu kubaaraathum wa naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus kula.Wa l-hille di tukuun maskuuna ila l-abad.
Wa khalaas,yaju naas min hillaal balad Yahuuza wa min hawaale Madiinat al-Khudus wa min ard gabiilat Banyaamiin wa min sahalat Chafiila wa min al-jibaal wa min saharat Nagab.Wa l-naas dool yaju le yigaddumu dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya aakhariin wa hadaaya hana dagiig wa lubaan.Wa da kulla yijiibuuh le beet Allah le yachkuruuh.
--"Wa laakin kan ma tasma'o kalaami wa ma taj'alo yoom al-sabt yoom mukhaddas wa kan tichiilu al-tagala wa tufuutu beeha be biibaan Madiinat al-Khudus fi yoom al-sabt da,khalaas ana nigabbid naar fi biibaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-taakul kulla buyuutha al-samhiin wa ma tumuut abadan."-
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-gaalah leyi ana Irmiya-:
Gumm wa amchi ajala bakaan daggaag al-jiraar wa hinaak ana nuguul leek kalaami.
Wa khalaas,ana macheet bakaan daggaag al-jiraar wa daahu gaa'id yudugg jarrah.
Wa kan bakaan waahid bala raayah al-jarr al-gaa'id yuduggah bigi a'waj,hu yilimm al-tiine wa yi'ajjinha battaan wa yudugg jarr aakhar hasab al-ya'ajibah.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya naas Bani Israa'iil,ana ma nagdar nisawwi foogku misil daggaag al-jiraar gaa'id yisawwiih fi jarrah walla-?Ya naas Bani Israa'iil,intu fi iideeni misil al-tiine fi iid daggaag al-jiraar.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Bakaan waahid,ana nichiil kharaar le namrug wa narmi wa nidammir umma aw mamlaka.
Wa laakin kan al-umma di khallat amalha al-fasil al-be sababah ana chilt al-kharaar diddaha,khalaas ana nikhalli al-fasaala al-awwal kharrart nisawwiiha foogha.
Wa bakaan waahid,ana nichiil kharaar le nabni wa nisabbit umma aw mamlaka.
Wa laakin kan al-umma di tisawwi al-fasaala al-ana ma nidoorha wa ma tasma' kalaami,khalaas ana nikhalli al-kheer al-awwal gult nisawwiih leeha.
Wa hassa',gumm amchi le naas Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa guul-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Akiid ana bas jahhazt leeku fasaala wa gammeet be mu'aamara didduku.Khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil min derbah al-fasil wa yi'addil derbah wa amalah."
Wa laakin humman yuguulu-:"Ma lammaana-!Aniina nitaabu'u fikirna wa ayyi waahid yigawwi raasah fi l-fasaala bas-!"-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Fattuchu wa as'alo fi lubb al-umam.Hal yoom waahid sim'o be cheyy misil da walla-?Bani Israa'iil al-misil bineeye udriiyesawwo fadiihe.
Hal kulla talaj jibaal Lubnaan yisiilwa yanzil fi nawaayit al-jibaal walla-?Hal al-almi al-baaridal-gaa'id yisiil min ba'iidyagiif ma yajri walla-?La-!
Wa laakin cha'abi nisooniwa harrago bakhuur le ilaahaat al-ma yanfa'o,al-yitartu'uuhum fi deribhum.Wa fi chaan al-ilaahaat dool,humman abo deribhum al-adiil hana zamaanle yamchu fi dabaali al-kadaade.
Wa humman sawwo baladhum bakaan mukhiifwa l-yichiifuuha daayman yinbahtu.Wa ayyi naadum al-yufuut jambaha yil'ajjabwa yihizzu ruuseehum.
Wa ana nichattithum giddaam al-adumisil chaalathum riih al-sabaah al-chadiide.Wa fi yoom damaarhum,nantiihum dahariwa abadan wijhi ma yichiifuuh.
Wa naas waahidiin gaalo-:-Yalla khalli nugummu be mu'aamara didd Irmiya.Balaayah kula indina rujaal diin katiiriin al-yigarruuna churuut al-Tawraat wa indina hukama al-yiwassuuna wa indina anbiya al-yihajju leena kalaam Allah.Yalla namchu nahjumuuh be kalaam al-yi'ayyibah wa ma naj'alo kalaamah al-yuguulah.
Wa Irmiya chahad Allah wa gaal-:-Ya Allah-!Fakkir foogiwa asma' kalaam udwaani al-yathamooni.
Hal al-kheeryikaffuuh be l-charr walla-?Humman nakato leyi nugrale yarmuuni foogha.Ya Allah-!Azzakkar yoom ana wagaft giddaamakwa daafa' leehumle nigabbil khadabak minhum.
Wa laakin hassa' da,nazzil al-juu' fi iyaalhumwa aktulhum be l-seef.Wa khalli awiinhumyiwaddiran awlaadhinwa yafgudan rujaalhin.Wa khalli al-rujaal yumuutu be l-wabawa subyaanhum yumuutu be l-seef fi l-harib.
Khalli korooraakhum yinsami'min lubb buyuuthumwakit be khaflatijiib fooghum al-muhaajimiin.Achaan nakato nugra le yarmuuni foogha wa yakurbuuniwa kajjo leyi charak tihit rijileeni.
Ya Allah-!Inta ta'arif niiyithum al-fasleal-beeha yidooru yaktuluuni.Ma takhfir leehum khataahumwa ma tuguchch min giddaamak zanibhum.Gumm didduhum,ya Allah-!Khalli yaga'o giddaamak fi wakit khadabak.
Wa daahu Allah gaal le Irmiya-:-Amchi le daggaag al-jiraar wa achri leek ibriig hana tiine.Wa chiil ma'aak min kubaaraat al-cha'ab wa min kubaaraat rujaal al-diin.
Wa amchi ma'aahum ale waadi Bani Hinnuum fi khachum baab al-Chigaf wa hinaak ballikh be l-kalaam al-ana nuguulah leek.
Wa guul-:--Ya muluuk balad Yahuuza wa ya sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus,asma'o kalaam Allah.Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Ana nijiib fi l-bakaan da fasaala wa ayyi naadum al-yasma' beeha yinbahit.
Achaan humman abooni wa nakaro al-bakaan da wa harrago bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin al-awwal ma ya'arfuuhum wa la humman wa la juduudhum wa la muluuk Yahuuza.Wa humman daffago damm al-bariyiin wa malo beyah al-bakaan da.
Wa bano madbah le yigaddumu foogah awlaadhum dahaaya muharragiin le ilaah Ba'al.Wa da,ana ma amartuhum beyah wa la kallamtuhum beyah wa la fakkart foogah yoom waahid.
Wa fi chaan da yaji yoom waahid,battaan ma yinaadu al-bakaan da Tuufa wa la waadi Bani Hinnuum.Wa laakin yinaaduuh waadi al-Janaazaat."- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,ana nifachchil choorit naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa yumuutu fi l-harib giddaam udwaanhum wa be iideen al-naas al-yidooru moothum.Wa nanti janaazaathum le l-suguura wa l-maraaf'iin yaakuluuhum.
Wa nisawwi al-madiina di tabga kharaab wa bahiite wa ayyi naadum al-yufuut jambaha yil'ajjab wa yisaffir min al-damaar al-foogha.
Wa ana ninazzil leehum juu' chadiid lahaddi yaakulu awlaadhum wa banaathum wa ayyi waahid yaakul akhuuh tihit al-hisaar wa l-diige.Wa udwaanhum al-yidooru moothum yidaayuguuhum.
Wa inta,ya Irmiya,kassir al-ibriig al-chareetah da giddaam al-kubaaraat al-macho ma'aak.
Wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:"Ana nikassir al-cha'ab da wa l-madiina di misil kassart al-ibriig da wa hu battaan ma yil'addal.Wa yadfunu al-janaazaat fi Tuufa lahaddi tinmali wa ma tagdar tichiilhum.
Wa da bas al-cheyy al-nisawwiih fi l-madiina di wa fi sukkaanha.Wa nisawwi al-madiina di misil Tuufa.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa buyuut Madiinat al-Khudus wa gusuur muluuk Yahuuza yabgo nijsiin misil Tuufa.Achaan fi ruuse al-buyuut dool,harrago bakhuur le kulla khuwwaat al-sama wa gaddamo hadaaya charaab le ilaahaat aakhariin."-
Wa Irmiya gabbal min Tuufa wa da l-bakaan al-rassalah Allah le yitnabba' foogah.Wa ba'ad da,ja wagaf fi l-fadaay hana beet Allah wa gaal le kulla l-cha'ab-:
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Akiid ana nijiib fi l-madiina di wa fi kulla l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha al-fasaala al-gult nijiibha fooghum.Achaan sukkaanhum gawwo ruuseehum wa ma dawwaro yasma'o kalaami.-
Wa fiyah raajil waahid usmah Fachhuur wileed Immiir wa hu raajil diin wa kabiir al-haras hana beet Allah.Al-raajil da simi' Irmiya gaa'id yitnabba' be kalaam didd Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa khalaas,Fachhuur gamma karabah le l-nabi Irmiya wa farachah wa gayyadah fi l-baab al-aali al-usmah Banyaamiin fi beet Allah.
Wa ambaakir fajur wakit Fachhuur ja halla al-geed min Irmiya,Irmiya gaal-:-Allah gaal battaan ma yinaaduuk Fachhuur laakin yinaaduuk al-Mukhiif fi Kulla Bakaan.
Achaan daahu Allah gaal-:--Akiid ana nisallimak le l-Mukhiif,inta wa rufgaanak.Humman yumuutu giddaamak fi l-harib ma'a udwaanhum.Wa nisallim naas Yahuuza fi iid malik Baabil wa hu yiwaddiihum fi l-khurba fi Baabil wa yaktulhum be l-seef.
Wa ana nisallim kulla maal al-madiina wa kulla intaajha wa kulla cheyy al-khaali al-indaha.Wa nisallim kulla makhaazin muluuk Yahuuza fi iideen udwaanhum wa yanhaboohum wa yichiiluuhum wa yiwadduuhum fi Baabil.
Wa inta,ya Fachhuur,wa kulla naas beetak yakurbuuku masaajiin wa yiwadduuku fi Baabil.Wa hinaak,inta tumuut wa yadfunuuk inta wa kulla rufgaanak al-atnabba't leehum be kidib.-
Ya Allah-!Inta bas sawweetni nabi bala raayiwa ana ma na'arif cheyy wa khassadt.Inta gawi minniwa khalabtini-!Wa daahu,tuul al-nahaar,ana bigiit madhakawa kulla l-naas yichchammato foogi.
Wa kan nihajji,ni'iit wa nuguul-:-Al-unuf wa l-kharaab jaayiin-!-Wa kan nihajji be kalaamak,ya Allah,yijiib leyi al-eebwa tuul al-nahaar,yichchammato foogi.
Wa kan nuguul fi nafsima nifakkir le Allahwa la nihajji battaanbe kalaamah al-amaraani beyah,khalaas da yabga leyimisil naar tahrigni fi daakhiliwa misil jamur fi udaami.Wa da faataani,ma nagdar nahmalah.
Ana simi't mu'yaar min naas katiiriinal-yinaaduuni be usumal-Mukhiif fi Kulla Bakaan.Wa buguulu-:-Bayyunuuh-!Aywa,bayyunuuh-!-Wa kulla rufgaanigaa'idiin yarjo waga'aani.Wa buguulu-:-Mumkin bala raayah,aniina nakhalbuuhwa nichiilu foogah al-taar.
Wa laakin inta,ya Allah,gaa'id ma'aayimisil faaris al-abadan ma yinhazim.Wa be da,al-yahjumuuni yaga'owa ma yinnasru foogi.Wa l-eeb yikhattiihum marra waahidwa abadan ma yanjaho.Wa yiwadduru charafhum le l-abadwa yalgo ihaana al-abadan ma yansooha.
Ya Allah al-Gaadir-!Inta bas al-takchif al-saalihwa tichiif al-fi galib al-insaan wa l-fi daakhilah.Khalli inta tichiil leyi al-taar fooghumachaan ana khatteet chakwiti fi iideenak.
Khannu le Allahwa ahmuduuh.Achaan hu yinajji hayaat al-miskiinmin iid al-fasliin.
Mal'uunal-yoom al-wildooni foogah.Wa l-yoom al-jaabatni foogah ammi,khalli ma yalga baraka.
Mal'uun al-naadumal-bachchar abuuyi wa gaal-:-Jaabo leek wileed.Afrah ziyaada-!
Wa l-naadum da,khalli yabgamisil al-mudun al-dammaraahum Allahbala mahanna.Wa khalli yinsami' fi beet al-naadum dakorooraak al-faza' be fajurwa be gaayle,siraakh al-harib.
Wa maala Allah ma katalnifi batun ammi-?Wa maala batun ammima bigat leyi khabur-?Wa maala ma nagoodfi batunha ila l-abad-?
Wa maala maragt min batun ammile nichiif al-ta'ab wa l-diigewa ni'iich kulla ayyaami fi l-eeb-?
Allah hajja le Irmiya kalaam al-bukhuss al-malik Sidkhiiya.Wa l-malik da rassal le Irmiya naaseen wa humman Fachhuur wileed Malkiiya wa raajil al-diin Safanya wileed Ma'asiiya le yuguulu leyah-:
Min fadlak,as'al Allah fi chaanna achaan Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil gamma yihaaribna.Wa akuun Allah yirassil leena waahid min ajaaybah wa yiba''id minnina al-malik da.
Wa Irmiya gaal leehum-:-Daahu al-kalaam al-tuguuluuh le Sidkhiiya-:
--Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Nigabbil foogku silaahku al-gaa'idiin tihaarubu beyah malik Baabil wa askarah al-gaa'idiin yihaasuru madiinitku.Wa ana nijiibhum fi ust al-madiina.
Wa da ana bas gaa'id nihaaribku be iid marfuu'a wa duraa' gawi wa be khadab muhrig wa za'al chadiid.
Wa nadrub sukkaan al-madiina di,wa l-naas wa l-bahaayim kula yumuutu be waba chadiid.
Wa ba'ad da,Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa khaddaamiinah wa kulla naas al-madiina di al-faddalo min al-waba wa l-harib wa l-juu',ana nisallimhum le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Aywa,nisallimhum le udwaanhum al-yidooru moothum.Wa l-malik yaktulhum be chidde bala rahma wa la mahanna."-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa kan le l-cha'ab dool,inta ya Irmiya,guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ana nantiiku khiyaar been al-moot wa l-haya.
Wa daahu al-khiyaar.Al-naadum al-yagood fi l-madiina di yumuut be l-harib aw be l-juu' aw be l-waba.Wa laakin al-yamrug minha wa yisallim nafsah le askar Baabil al-muhaasiriinku,hu da yi'iich wa yabga farhaan achaan hu ligi al-haya.
Aywa,ana kharrart didd al-madiina di le nisawwi leeha al-charr,ma al-kheer.Wa nisallimha le malik Baabil wa hu yiharrigha."-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya aayilat muluuk Yahuuza,asma'o kalaam Allah.
Wa ya zurriiyit Dawuud,daahu Allah gaal-:-Sawwu al-adaala kulla yoomwa najju al-mazluum min iideen al-zaalim.Kan ma ke da,khadabi yanzilmisil al-naar al-tahrigwa ma fi naadum al-yagdar yaktulhaachaan da be sabab amalku al-fasil.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Akiid nugumm diddiki,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,al-gaa'ide fi raas al-jabalwa tihitki al-waadi.Inti tuguuli-:--Yaatu yagdar yahjimna-?Wa yaatu yagdar yaji yadkhul fi karaakiirna-?--
Wa laakin ana nugumm ni'aakhibkuhasab natiijat amalku.Wa nigabbid naar fi l-khaabawa l-naar di taakul kulla l-hawaaleeha.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah gaal le Irmiya-:-Gumm amchi fi gasir malik Yahuuza wa hinaak inta tuguul leehum al-kalaam da.
Inta guul-:--Asma' kalaam Allah,ya malik Yahuuza,inta al-gaa'id fi kursi al-muluk hana Dawuud,inta wa khaddaamiinak wa cha'abak al-yufuutu be l-biibaan dool.
Daahu Allah gaal-:"Sawwu al-hagg wa l-adaala wa najju al-mazluum min iideen al-zaalim.Ma tazulmu wa la tita''ubu al-ajnabi wa l-atiim wa l-armala wa ma tidaffugu damm al-bari fi l-bakaan da.
Wa kan tisawwu misil da,khalaas yadkhulu be biibaan al-gasir da muluuk al-yagoodu fi kursi al-muluk hana Dawuud al-raakbiin fi arabaat harib wa kheel.Wa yadkhulu humman wa khaddaamiinhum wa cha'abhum kula.
Wa laakin kan ma tasma'o al-kalaam da,ana Allah nahlif be nafsi kadar al-gasir da yabga koom hana turaab."-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah gaal kalaam al-bukhuss gasir muluuk Yahuuza-:-Ya l-gasir-!Kan tukuun jamiil misil khaabat Gil'aadwa aali misil jibaal Lubnaan kula,ana nisawwiik saharawa madiina bala sukkaan.
Ana jahhazt naas mukharribiinle yakharbuukwa ayyi waahid indah fi iidahaalaat hana gati'.Wa yagta'o hatabak hana l-arz al-jamiilwa yazguluuh fi l-naar.
Wa wakit naas min kulla l-umam yi'addu jamb al-madiina di,humman yissaa'alo ambeenaathum wa yuguulu-:--Maala Allah sawwa al-madiina al-kabiire di misil da-?--
Wa yuruddu leehum wa yuguulu-:--Achaan humman nagado mu'aahadat Allah Ilaahhum wa sajado giddaam ilaahaat aakhariin wa abadoohum.-
Ya naas Yahuuza,ma tabkule l-malik Yuuchiiya al-maatwa ma tahzano leyah kula.Wa laakin abku,abku ziyaadale l-malik Yahaazwileed Yuuchiiyaachaan hu battaan ma yigabbilfi l-ard al-wildooh foogha.
Aywa,Yahaaz wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza rikib fi badal abuuh.Wa ba'ad da,karabooh wa waddooh min al-bakaan da.Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Abadan hu ma yigabbil.
Hu yumuut hinaak fi l-khurba wa ma yigabbil le l-balad di battaan.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Al-azaab leek inta,ya l-malik Yahuuyakhim-!Inta tabni beetak bala haggwa gasrak bala adaala.Wa tikhaddim al-naas bala tukfawa ma tantiihum ujrithum.
Wa inta tuguul-:--Nabni le nafsi beet wasii'wa gasir aali.Wa nisawwi leyah chabaabiikwa nijammilah be hatab al-arzwa nadurbah buhya hamra tchu.--
Ya l-malik,be misil da,tiwassif mulkak walla-?Wa be hatab al-arz datisawwi beetak samehmin hana l-naas walla-?Abuuk akal wa chiribmisil al-naas al-aakhariin.Wa be da kula,hu daafa' le l-hagg wa l-adaalawa aach iiche haluuwe.
Wa hu hama huguug al-masaakiin wa l-fagraaniinwa da bigi adiil.Wa misil da bas,al-naas yiwassufukadar yakhaafo minni ana Allah.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin inta nazarakwa fikrak kulla fi l-faayde bas.Wa tidoor tidaffig damm al-bariwa tugumm be unuf wa zulum.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah hajja kalaam al-bukhuss Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza.Hu gaal-:-Wakit yumuut,ma yunuuhu leyahwa yuguulu-:--Kalawa,ya akhuuyi,kalawa,ya akhti.--Wa battaan,ma yunuuhu leyahwa yuguulu-:--Ya khasaarit siidi,ya khasaarit al-malik al-aziim.--
Wa yiwaddu janaaztahmisil rimmit al-humaar al-mayyit.Yukurruuha wa yazguluuha barramin biibaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,atla'e fi jibaal Lubnaan wa kooriki-!Wa min hujaar Baachaan,khalli yinsami' siraakhki.Wa min a'aali Abaariim,kooriki achaan sudgaanki addammaro.
Ana hajjeet leeki fi wakit raahitkiwa inti raddeetiwa gulti ma tidoori tasma'eeni.Wa da bas deribki min inti sakhayre,abadan inti ma simi'ti kalaami.
Wa hassa' khalaas,kulla ru'yaankiyuruuhu fi l-riihwa dool kubaaraatkial-yichittu fi ayyi bakaan.Wa sudgaanki yakurbuuhumwa yiwadduuhum masaajiin.Wa inti tagoodi fi l-eeb wa l-ihaanawa da be sabab fasaalitki.
Ya l-malik,inta al-saakin fi gasir Lubnaanwa fi beetak al-misil uchch al-mabni be hatab al-arz.Fi wakt al-ta'ab,inta tagnitmisil ganiit al-mara al-gaa'ide titaalig.
Ya Yuyakiin wileed Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza,ana nahlif be usmi al-Hayy-!Hatta kan inta bigiit khaatim fi iidi al-zeene kula,ana namurgak.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ana nisallimak le l-yidooru mootak,aywa fi iideen al-naas al-inta tarjif giddaamhum.Wa da fi iideen Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa askarah.
Inta wa ammak al-wildatak niwaddiiku wa nazgulku fi ard al-ma wildooku foogha.Wa hinaak tagoodu lahaddi tumuutu.
Wa arduku al-tagramo leeha,abadan ma tigabbulu leeha.
Maala al-malik da bigimisil jarr mukassar ma yanfa'-?Wa maala Yuyakiin bigimisil maa'uun al-ma yidooruuh-?Wa maala hu wa iyaalah waddoohum ba'iidwa zagaloohum fi balad al-awwal ma ya'arfuuha-?
Ya baladi,baladi-!Ya baladi,asma'e kalaam Allah-!
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Sajjulu al-raajil damisil naadum ma wilidwa ma najah fi hayaatah.Wa min iyaalah kula,ma fi waahid yanjahle yagood fi kursi al-muluk hana Dawuudwa yahkim fi Yahuuza.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Al-azaab le kubaaraat cha'abi al-misil ru'yaan hawaaniin.Yichattutu wa yidammuru cha'abi al-misil khanam.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil hajja kalaam bukhuss kubaaraat cha'abah al-yasraho beehum.Hu gaal-:-Ya l-kubaaraat-!Intu bas taradtu cha'abi wa chattattuuhum wa ma khatteetu baalku fooghum.Wa fi chaan da,ana nukhutt baali foogku wa ni'aakhibku be amalku al-fasil.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana zaati nilimm cha'abi al-faddalo wa nijiibhum min kulla l-buldaan al-ana chattattuhum fooghum.Wa misil al-khanam,nijiibhum fi mar'aahum wa humman yaldo wa yabgo katiiriin.
Wa ana nukhutt fooghum ru'yaan adiiliin al-yasraho beehum adiil.Wa humman ma yakhaafo battaan wa la yibarjulu wa waahid minhum kula ma yiwaddir. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Akiid yaji yoom waahid,ana nigawwim naadum saalih min zurriiyit Dawuudmisil bizre.Wa l-naadum da,ana bas nidarrijah malikwa hu yahkim be hikmawa yijiib al-hagg wa l-adaala fi l-balad.
Wa fi wakit hukmah,Bani Yahuuza yalgo al-najawa Bani Israa'iil yaskunu be amaan.Wa daahu al-usum al-yisammuuh beyah,Allah Hu Bas al-Yijiib leena al-Adaala.
humman yibaddulu haliifithum wa yahalfu be Allah al-Hayy,hu al-marag zurriiyit Bani Israa'iil min balad al-munchaakh wa min kulla l-buldaan al-hu chattataahum fooghum.Wa gabbalaahum fi baladhum wa humman yaskunu foogha battaan.
Wa fi l-anbiya dool,Irmiya gaal-:-Galbi angata' fi daakhiliwa kulla udaami maa'o.Wa bigiit misil al-sakraanaw misil naadum al-mariise faatat gudurtah.Wa da fi chaan Allahwa fi chaan kalaamah al-mukhaddas.
Achaan al-balad malaanebe naas al-yisawwu al-zina.Wa l-balad bigat jafaaf be sabab al-la'anawa bakaanaat al-sarha yibso.Wa niiyithum illa yisawwu al-fasaalawa induhum al-gudra le yisawwu al-zulum bas.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Al-anbiya wa rujaal al-diinkulluhum annajjasolahaddi fi beeti al-mukhaddas kulaana ligiit alaamit fasaalithum.
Wa khalaas be da,deribhum yabga amzahalootawa humman yiddaggacho fi l-dalaam wa yaga'o.Wa ana nijiib fooghum al-fasaalafi yoom ikhaabhum.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Zamaan,fi anbiya madiinat al-Saamira,ana chift cheyy makruuh.Humman atnabba'o be ilaah Ba'alwa le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil,maragoohum min al-derib al-adiil.
Wa laakin fi anbiya Madiinat al-Khudus,ana chift cheyy muharram ziyaada.Humman gaa'idiin yisawwu al-zinawa hayaathum kullaha khachch.Wa yichajju'u al-naasal-yisawwu al-fasaalaachaan waahid minhum kulama yigabbil min fasaaltah.Wa kulluhum nichiifhummisil naas Saduum al-fasliin.Wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus nichiifhummisil naas Amuura al-hawaaniin.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Gaadir hajja kalaam bukhuss al-anbiya dool.Hu gaal-:-Akiid ana ni'akkilhum al-hamdalwa nazgiihum almi musammam.Achaan be anbiya Madiinat al-Khudus dool basal-najaasa dakhalat fi l-balad di wa malatha.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ma tasma'o kalaam al-anbiyaal-yitnabba'o leeku.Humman yukhuchchuukuwa yiballukhu leeku ru'ya al-jaaye min nufuushumwa laakin ma jaaye minni ana Allah.
Be kidib,humman yuguulu le l-naas al-yankuruuni-:--Allah gaal intu talgo al-salaam.--Wa be khachch,yuguulu le ayyi waahid al-yigawwi raasah-:--Al-fasaala di ma taji leek.--
Wa l-anbiya dool,ma fi naadum minhumal-hidir fi majlasi fi l-samale yichiif wa yasma' kalaami ana Allahwa yahfad al-kalaam al-hu sim'ah.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Daahu khadab Allah gammatmisil amzooba'aane.Wa riih chadiide hajjatwa tuduur fi ruuse al-aasiyiin.
Wa khadab Allah ma yagiiflahaddi yihaggig niiytah al-hu chaalha.Wa fi l-akhiir,tafhamo al-cheyy da adiil.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Al-anbiya dool,ana ma rassaltuhumwa laakin humman jaro leeku.Wa ana ma hajjeet leehum kulawa laakin humman gaa'idiin yitnabba'o.
Wa kan awwal hidro fi majlasi,humman yagdaro yikhabburu cha'abi be kalaami.Wa yigabbuluuhummin deribhum al-hawaanwa yirajju'uuhummin amalhum al-fasil.
Ana ma al-Ilaah al-yichiif gariib baswa laakin ana al-Ilaah al-yichiif ba'iid kula.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa hal fi insaan al-yillabbad fi bakaanwa ana ma nichiifah walla-?Wa da kalaam Allah.Hal ana ma namlaal-samaawaat wa l-ard walla-?-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ana nasma' kalaam al-anbiya dool al-yitnabba'o be kidib be usmi wa yuguulu-:--Ana ri'iit-!Ana ri'iit-!--
Wa l-anbiya al-kaddaabiin dool yitnabba'o le mata-?Wa hal humman induhum niiye fasle fi guluubhum walla-?Aywa,al-kidib da jaayi min fikirhum al-khachchaach bas.
Wa be ru'yithum al-yihajju beeha ambeenaathum,humman yahsubu le cha'abi yinassuuhum usmi.Wa da,misil juduudhum al-taaba'o ilaah Ba'al wa niso usmi.
Khalli al-nabi al-indah ru'ya yihajji be ru'yitah.Wa laakin al-indah kalaami ana,khalli yihajji kalaami be amaan.Achaan al-gechch wa l-ganaadiil ma sawa. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa kalaami hu misil naarwa misil mitraga al-tikassir al-hajar.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Hassa' da,nugumm didd al-anbiya al-yasurgu al-kalaam al-waahid min al-aakhar wa yuguulu da kalaami ana Allah.
Wa nugumm didd al-anbiya al-lisaanhum yuguul kalaam kidib wa yuguulu al-kalaam da jaayi minni ana.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa nugumm didd al-anbiya al-yihajju be ru'ya kidib le yiwadduru cha'abi be khachchuhum wa kidibhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.Ana ma rassaltuhum wa la amartuhum be cheyy.Wa humman abadan ma yanfa'o al-cha'ab da. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Allah hajja le Irmiya wa gaal-:-Akuun nabi aw raajil diin aw naadum min al-cha'ab yas'alak wa yuguul-:--Chunu battaan al-tagala al-yukhuttaha foogna Allah-?- Khalaas,inta rudd leyah wa guul-:--Daahu kalaam Allah-:"Intu bas al-tagala wa ana Allah nazgulku-!"--
Wa akuun nabi aw raajil diin aw naadum min al-cha'ab yachki wa yuguul-:--Tagalat Allah foogna-!- Khalaas,ana ni'aakhib al-naadum da wa aayiltah.
Wa daahu al-kalaam al-waajib tuguuluuh ambeenaatku al-waahid le l-aakhar-:--Chunu radd Allah-?Chunu Allah kallam-?--
Wa laakin abadan ma tachku wa tuguulu-:--Tagalat Allah foogna.- Wa hal kalaam Allah tagiil le l-naas walla-?La-!Intu bas gaa'idiin tikhayyuru kalaam al-Ilaah al-Hayy,Allah al-Gaadir,Ilaahna.
Wa daahu al-kalaam al-waajib tuguulah le l-nabi-:--Chunu radd Allah-?Chunu Allah kallam-?--
Wa laakin intu gultu-:--Tagalat Allah foogna-- wa da l-kalaam al-ana dahartuku ma tuguuluuh.Wa fi chaan da,daahu ana Allah gult-:
--Intu bas al-tagala.Wa akiid ana nichiilku wa nazgulku ba'iid minni,intu wa l-madiina al-anteetha leeku intu wa le juduudku.
Wa nijiib al-eeb al-yagood foogku daayman wa gillit al-charaf al-ma tinnasi ila l-abad.-
Wa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil chaal Yuyakiin wileed Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza wa kubaaraat Yahuuza wa l-sinaa'iyiin wa l-haddaad wa waddaahum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.Wa ba'ad da,Allah chawwafaani itneen gufaf malaaniin be fawaakih al-tiin wa gaa'idiin giddaam beet Allah.
Wa l-guffa al-waahide malaane be tiin sameh min al-noo' al-adiil.Wa laakin al-guffa al-aakhara malaane be tiin mu'affan,abadan ma bin'akil.
Wa khalaas,Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya Irmiya,gaa'id tichiif chunu-? Wa ana gult-:-Gaa'id nichiif tiin.Wa l-tiin al-waahid da sameh marra waahid min al-noo' al-adiil.Wa l-tiin al-aakhar da mu'affan,abadan ma bin'akil.
Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Al-tiin al-sameh da,hu yimassil cha'ab Yahuuza al-ana maragtuhum min al-balad di wa waddeethum fi l-khurba fi Baabil wa da le kheerhum.
Wa ana niraakhibhum be rahma lahaddi nigabbilhum fi baladhum wa nabniihum misil beet wa abadan ma nakhribhum.Wa nisabbithum wa abadan ma namrughum.
Wa nantiihum fikir saabit al-beyah yagdaro ya'arfuuni kadar ana bas Allah.Wa humman yabgo cha'abi wa ana nabga Ilaahhum.Wa yigabbulu leyi be kulla guluubhum.-
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-bukhuss Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa kubaaraatah wa kulla l-faddalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa kulla l-faddalo fi l-balad di wa kulla l-saakniin fi balad Masir.Hu gaal-:-Nisawwiihum misil al-tiin al-mu'affan al-ma bin'akil.
Wa yabgo masal al-bikhawwif kulla mamaalik al-ard wa fi kulla bakaan al-nichattithum foogah,humman yabgo hijjeeye wa madhaka le l-naas wa mu'yaar wa la'ana.
Wa ana nijiib fooghum al-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba lahaddi yingachcho marra waahid min al-ard al-ana anteetha leehum wa le juduudhum.
Wa fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,Allah hajja le Irmiya kalaam bukhuss kulla cha'ab Yahuuza.Wa da fi awwal sana hana hukum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.
Wa l-kalaam da,al-nabi Irmiya hajja beyah le kulla naas Yahuuza wa kulla sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hu gaal-:
Min sanit 13 hana hukum Yuuchiiya wileed Aamuun malik Yahuuza lahaddi l-yoom da,wa da fi muddit 23 sana,Allah gaa'id yihajji leyi.Wa ana daayman gaa'id nihajji leeku wa laakin intu abeetu ma tasma'ooni-!
Wa daayman Allah rassal leeku kulla abiidah al-anbiya wa intu abeetu ma khatteetu adaanku le tasma'oohum.
Wa be waasitat al-anbiya dool Allah gaal-:--Gabbulu ayyi waahid min derbah al-hawaan wa min amalah al-fasil.Wa be da,taskunu fi l-ard al-anteetha leeku intu wa le juduudku daayman wa ila l-abad.
Angar'u-!Ma tajru wara ilaahaat aakhariin wa ta'abuduuhum wa tasjudu giddaamhum.Wa ma tikhaddubuuni be l-asnaam al-sawweetuuhum be iideeku.Wa khalaas be da,ana kula ma nisawwi leeku cheyy fasil.
Wa laakin intu ma simi'tuuni.Be l-aks,khaddabtuuni be khidmit iideeku wa jibtu foogku al-fasaala.-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Achaan intu ma simi'tu kalaami,
akiid ana ninaadi leeku kulla gabaayil al-munchaakh wa abdi Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Wa nijiibhum didd al-balad di wa didd sukkaanha wa didd kulla l-umam al-mujaawiriinha wa yidammuruuhum.Wa nijiib fooghum al-kharaab wa l-bahiite wa yabgo koom hana turaab ila l-abad.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana niwaggif kulla l-zakhraat wa l-ragraag wa khine al-aruus wa hiss al-murhaaka wa deyy al-faanuus.
Wa l-balad di kullaha nisawwiiha koom hana turaab wa ard kharaab.Wa kulla l-umam dool yabgo abiid le malik Baabil le muddit 70 sana.
Wa laakin ba'ad al-sab'iin sana dool yikammulu,ana ni'aakhib malik Baabil wa ummatah fi chaan khataahum.Wa nugumm didd balad al-Baabiliyiin wa nisawwiiha balad kharaab ila l-abad.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa nitabbig fi l-balad di kulla l-kalaam al-gultah diddaha wa l-kalaam da maktuub fi l-kitaab da.Wa da l-kalaam al-ana Allah kallamt beyah al-nabi Irmiya didd kulla l-umam dool.
Wa l-Baabiliyiin kula doorhum yaji-!Yabgo abiid le umam katiiriin wa muluuk gaadriin.Wa ana nikaffiihum natiijat fi'ilhum wa khidmit iideehum.
Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal leyi-:-Chiil kaas al-khamar hana khadabi al-ana nantiih leek wa azgiih le kulla l-umam al-ana nirassilak leehum.
Khalli yacharbo wa yaskaro wa yittarta'o lahaddi yiwadduru agulhum wa da be sabab al-harib al-nijiibah fi usuthum.
Khalaas,ana chilt kaas al-khamar al-antaah leyi Allah wa charrabtah le kulla l-umam al-hu rassalaani leehum.
Wa ana badeet be naas Madiinat al-Khudus wa naas hillaal balad Yahuuza wa muluukhum wa kubaaraathum achaan Allah sawwa mudunhum koom hana turaab wa bakaan kharaab wa bahiite wa mal'uun wa gaa'id misil da lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa ba'ad da,ja door hana l-cha'ab al-aakhariin wa hummanFir'oon malik Masir wa khaddaamiinah wa kubaaraatah wa kulla cha'abah
wa kulla l-gabaayil al-aakhariin al-fi Masirwa kulla muluuk al-Uuswa kulla muluuk balad al-Filistiyiin wa mudunhum Achgaluun wa Khazza wa Akhruun wa l-faddal min Achduud
wa naas Adoom wa Muwaab wa Bani Ammuun
wa kulla muluuk Suur wa Seedawa muluuk al-mudun al-gaa'idiin khaadi fi khachum al-bahar
wa naas Dadaan wa Tiima wa Buuzwa kulla l-yizayyunu cha'arhum
wa kulla muluuk al-Arab wa l-gabaayil al-yaskunu fi l-sahara
wa kulla muluuk Zimri wa Ilaam wa l-Maadiyiin
wa muluuk al-munchaakh al-gariibiin aw ba'iidiin.Wa be da,kulla mamaalik al-dunya al-muchattatiin fi l-ard yacharbo min kaas al-khadab da al-waahid ba'ad al-aakhar.Wa fi aakhirhum,yachrab malik Baabil.
Ya Irmiya,inta guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Acharbo wa askaro wa gaddufu.Aga'o ma tugummu-!Wa da be sabab al-harib al-nijiibah fi usutku."--
Wa kan abo ma yichiilu al-kaas da min iidak wa yacharbooh,inta guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:"Acharbooh,akiid tacharbooh.
Achaan daahu ana nijiib al-fasaala awwalan ke fi madiinti al-foogha usmi.Hal intu tahsubu naj'alku bariyiin walla-?La-!Abadan ma naj'alku bariyiin wakit gaa'id nijiib al-harib fi kulla sukkaan al-ard."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa inta,ya Irmiya-!Atnabba' be l-kalaam da wa guul leehum-:--Min hinaak foog,Allah yahrijziyaada min al-duud al-gaa'id yikirr.Wa min maskanah al-mukhaddas,hissah yinsami'wa hu yahrij didd baladah.Wa hissah didd kulla sukkaan al-ard bigi aalimin ragraag al-naas al-yifajjukhu al-inab.
Wa hissah da,yinsami'lahaddi fi aakhir al-ardachaan Allah yijiib al-umamfi l-charii'a.Yichaari' kulla l-naaswa yisallim al-aasiyiin le l-harib.--Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Akiid fi fasaala taji min umma le ummawa fi riih chadiide tugumm min aakhir al-ard.
Wa l-yaktulhum Allah fi l-yoom daak,janaazaathum yidaffugu fi l-ard min tarafha le tarafha.Wa naadum waahid kula minhum wa la yarfa'ooh wa la yadfunuuh wa la yahzano leyah.Wa janaazaathum yichchattato fi l-ard misil al-ba'ar.
Asrakho,ya ru'yaan khanami-!Kooruku wa almarmakho fi l-turaab,ya kubaaraat cha'abi-!Achaan yoom mootku garrab.Yaktuluuku wa yichattutu janaazaatkuwa taga'o wa tilkassaro misil al-suuni.
Ma fi bakaan al-yillabbado foogah ru'yaan khanamiwa ma fi malja' le kubaaraat cha'abi.
Asma'o siraakh ru'yaan khanamiwa korooraak kubaaraat cha'abiachaan Allah dammar balad mar'aahum.
Wa min khadab Allah al-muhrig,al-mar'a al-saalim khirib.
Wa Allah aba bakaanahmisil al-duud al-aba nugurtah.Achaan al-balad khirbatbe sabab al-harib al-mudammirwa be sabab khadab Allah al-muhrig.
Wa fi bidaayit hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,Allah gaal kalaam le Irmiya.
Wa daahu Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi agiif fi fadaayit beet Allah wa hajji le l-naas al-yaju min hillaal balad Yahuuza le ya'abudu fi beet Allah.Wa hajji leehum kulla l-kalaam al-ana amartak le tuguulah leehum,ma tangus minnah cheyy.
Wa akuun humman yasma'o wa ayyi waahid yikhalli minnah derbah al-fasil.Wa be da,ana kula nikhalli al-fasaala al-kharrart nisawwiiha leehum be sabab amalhum al-fasil.
Wa inta guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Asma'ooni wa amchu hasab al-wasaaya al-ana anteethum leeku.
Wa asma'o kalaam abiidi al-anbiya al-ana rassaltuhum leeku daayman wa laakin intu ma simi'tuuhum.
Wa kan ma tasma'ooni,khalaas ana nidammir al-beet da,misil dammart maskani al-awwal gaa'id fi Chiilooh.Wa nal'an Madiinat al-Khudus wa hi tabga masal le kulla umam al-ard."-
Wa rujaal al-diin wa l-anbiya wa kulla l-cha'ab sim'o kalaam Irmiya al-gaalah fi beet Allah.
Wa wakit Irmiya kammal kalaam Allah al-hu amarah le yuguulah le kulla l-cha'ab,tawwaali rujaal al-diin wa l-anbiya karabooh wa gaalo leyah-:-Inta fattacht mootak-!
Wa inta titnabba' lahaddi tuguul beet Allah yiddammar wa yabga misil maskanah al-awwal gaa'id fi Chiilooh wa l-hille di takhrab wa tabga faadiye min sukkaanha-! Wa kulla l-naas lammo wa hawwagooh le Irmiya fi beet Allah.
Wa wakit kubaaraat Yahuuza sim'o be l-khabar da,marago min gasir al-malik wa jo ga'ado fi khachum al-baab al-jadiid hana beet Allah le yichiifu al-kalaam da.
Wa rujaal al-diin wa l-anbiya gaalo le l-kubaaraat wa le kulla l-cha'ab-:-Al-raajil da,waajib yahkumu leyah be l-moot.Hu atnabba' be kalaam didd al-madiina di wa l-kalaam da,intu zaatku simi'tuuh.
Wa Irmiya gaal le l-kubaaraat wa le kulla l-cha'ab-:-Allah bas rassalaani le nitnabba' didd al-beet da wa didd al-madiina di be l-kalaam al-intu simi'tuuh.
Wa laakin hassa' da,salluhu haalku wa amalku wa asma'o kalaam Allah Ilaahku.Wa be da,Allah yikhalli al-fasaala al-kharrar yisawwiiha leeku.
Wa ana da,daahuuni fi iideeku wa sawwu foogi al-cheyy al-ya'ajibku wa l-adiil fi uyuunku.
Wa laakin a'arfu adiil kan kataltuuni da,tichiilu leeku dimmit bari fi raasku,intu wa l-madiina di wa sukkaanha kula.Wa be l-sahiih,Allah bas rassalaani le nuguul al-kalaam da le tasma'ooh.
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da,al-kubaaraat wa kulla l-cha'ab gaalo le rujaal al-diin wa le l-anbiya-:-Al-raajil da ma waajib yahkumu leyah be l-moot achaan hu hajja leena be usum Allah Ilaahna.
Wa waahidiin min chuyuukh al-balad gammo wa gaalo le kulla l-naas al-laammiin-:
Fi ayyaam hukum Hizkhiiya malik Yahuuza,Miikha al-min hillit Muurachat atnabba' wa gaal le kulla cha'ab Yahuuza-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:"Sahyuun yahartuuha misil zere' wa Madiinat al-Khudus tabga koom hana turaab wa raas jabal beet Allah yabga khaaba."-
Wa l-chuyuukh gaalo battaan-:-Hal Hizkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa cha'abah katalooh walla-?La-!Humman khaafo min Allah wa gammo chahadooh.Wa Allah khalla kharaar al-fasaala al-gaal yisawwiih leehum.Wa hassa' da,kan katalna al-naadum da,nisawwu al-fasaala le nufuusna.
Wa fi wakit al-malik Yahuuyakhim,fiyah raajil waahid usmah Uriiya wileed Chama'ya min hillit Kharyat Ya'ariim.Hu atnabba' be usum Allah didd al-madiina di wa didd al-balad di be kalaam sawa sawa misil hana Irmiya da.
Wa l-malik Yahuuyakhim wa kulla askarah wa kulla kubaaraatah sim'o be l-kalaam da wa l-malik dawwar yaktulah le Uriiya.Wa wakit khabbaro Uriiya be l-kalaam da,hu khaaf wa arrad macha Masir.
Wa l-malik Yahuuyakhim rassal naas waraayah wa humman Alnaataan wileed Akbuur wa naas waahidiin ma'aayah le yamchu Masir.
Wa humman macho Masir wa karabooh le Uriiya wa jaabooh le l-malik Yahuuyakhim.Wa l-malik katalah wa zagal janaaztah fi khubuur al-masaakiin.
Wa laakin Irmiya kamaan,Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan hamaah.Wa aba ma khalla yisallumuuh le l-cha'ab achaan yaktuluuh.
Wa fi bidaayit hukum al-malik Sidkhiiya wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,Allah gaal kalaam leyi ana Irmiya.
Wa daahu Allah gaal leyi-:-Aftul leek hubaal wa agta' leek uud hana daami wa khuttah fi kataafeek.
Wa khabbir muluuk Adoom wa Muwaab wa Bani Ammuun wa Suur wa Seeda be waasitat murassaliinhum al-jo fi Madiinat al-Khudus le Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza.
Wa inta aamurhum yigabbulu le muluukhum wa yuguulu-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:
"Ana Allah bas khalagt al-ard wa l-naas wa l-bahaayim al-gaa'idiin foogha wa da be gudurti al-kabiire wa duraa'i al-gawi.Wa ana nantiihum le l-naadum al-nidoorah.
Wa hassa' da,ana sallamt kulla l-buldaan dool le abdi Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Wa ana sallamt leyah haywaanaat al-kadaade kula le yagoodu tihit sultitah.
Wa kulla l-umam yakhdumu leyah hu wa le wileedah wa le wileed wileedah.Wa lahaddi Baabil tinhazim wa umam katiiriin wa muluuk kubaar yikhaddumuuha hi kula.
--"Wa hassa',ayyi umma aw mamlaka al-taaba ma takhdim le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa la tidangir ragabatha le tagalat daami al-malik,ana ni'aakhib al-umma di be l-harib wa be l-juu' wa be l-waba lahaddi nikammilha marra waahid be iid al-malik.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa kan leeku intu,ma tasma'o kalaam anbiyaaku wa la chawwaafiinku wa la l-yikallumu leeku be hilim wa la l-yikallumu ma'a maytiinku wa la sahhaariinku.Humman yuguulu leeku intu abadan ma takhdumu le malik Baabil.
Wa laakin yitnabba'o leeku be kidib-!Wa kan tasma'o kalaamhum,ana natrudku ba'iid min arduku wa nidammirku.
Wa laakin le l-umma al-tidangir ragabatha le tagalat daami malik Baabil wa takhdim leyah,ana nantiiha al-raaha fi ardaha achaan naasha yaskunu foogha wa yakhdumuuha."-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana Irmiya hajjeet be nafs al-kalaam le Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa gult leyah-:-Inta wa cha'abak waajib tidanguru ragabatku le tagalat daami malik Baabil wa takhdumu leyah hu wa le cha'abah.Wa be da,tinajju hayaatku.
Wa maala tumuutu,inta wa cha'abak,be l-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba-?Wa da kharaar al-ikhaab al-Allah gaal yinazzilah fi l-umma al-abat ma takhdim le malik Baabil.
Ma tasma'o kalaam al-anbiya al-buguulu leeku intu abadan ma takhdumu le malik Baabil achaan humman yitnabba'o leeku be kalaam kidib.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:--Ana ma rassaltuhum leeku.Wa kan yitnabba'o be usmi kula,yakdubu leeku bas.Kan tasma'oohum,natrudku wa nidammirku,intu wa l-anbiya al-yitnabba'o leeku.-
Wa ana Irmiya gult le rujaal al-diin wa le kulla l-cha'ab dool-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Ma tasma'o kalaam al-anbiya al-yitnabba'o wa yuguulu-:"Mu'iddaat beet Allah al-awwal nahabhum malik Baabil gariib bas yigabbuluuhum min balad Baabil."Wa kan al-anbiya dool atnabba'o leeku be l-kalaam da kula,hu kidib.
Ma tasma'oohum-!Akhdumu le malik Baabil wa tinajju hayaatku.Wa maala al-madiina di tiddammar wa tabga koom hana turaab-?--
Kan humman sahiih ke anbiya wa kalaam Allah kaan ma'aahum da,khalli yachhado Allah al-Gaadir achaan al-mu'iddaat al-faddalo fi beet Allah wa fi beet malik Yahuuza fi Madiinat al-Khudus ma yiwadduuhum fi Baabil.
Wa Allah al-Gaadir gaal kalaam bukhuss khumaam beet Allah al-lissaa' faddal fi l-madiina wa da l-amad wa l-hoot al-kabiir wa l-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin wa l-mu'iddaat al-aakhariin.
Wa dool al-khumaam al-Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ma chaalaahum wakit ja wa wadda min Madiinat al-Khudus le Baabil Yuyakiin wileed Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza wa kulla kubaaraat balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-bukhuss al-mu'iddaat al-faddalo fi beet Allah wa fi beet malik Yahuuza fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Hu gaal-:
Al-mu'iddaat dool yiwadduuhum fi Baabil wa humman yagoodu hinaak lahaddi l-yoom al-ana nugumm wa nichiilhum min hinaak wa nigabbilhum hini fi l-bakaan da. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fiyah nabi waahid usmah Hananya wileed Azzuur min hillit Gib'uun.Fi l-chahar al-khaamis fi l-sana al-raab'e fi bidaayit hukum Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza,Hananya ja wa hajja le Irmiya fi beet Allah giddaam rujaal al-diin wa kulla l-cha'ab.Wa gaal-:
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Ana nikassir daami malik Baabil le ninazzil tagalatah min kataafeeku.
Wa ba'ad santeen,ana nigabbil kulla mu'iddaat beet Allah al-chaalaahum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa waddaahum fi Baabil wa nijiibhum fi l-bakaan da.
Wa ana nigabbil Yuyakiin wileed Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza wa kulla naas Yahuuza al-waddoohum fi l-khurba fi Baabil wa nijiibhum fi l-bakaan da.Wa be da,ana nikassir daami malik Baabil le ninazzil tagalatah min kataafeeku.-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-nabi Irmiya radda le l-nabi Hananya giddaam rujaal al-diin wa kulla l-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi beet Allah.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Aamiin-!Khalli Allah yisawwi misil da-!Khalli Allah yihaggig kulla l-kalaam al-inta atnabba't beyah wa yigabbil min Baabil al-mu'iddaat hana beet Allah wa kulla l-naas al-waddoohum fi l-khurba wa yijiibhum fi l-bakaan da.
Wa laakin asma'-!Khutt adaanak le l-kalaam al-nuguulah leek inta wa le kulla l-cha'ab.
Fi anbiya al-jo gubbaali ana wa gubbaalak inta min wakit tawiil.Wa atnabba'o wa khabbaro buldaan katiiriin wa mamaalik kubaar be l-harib wa l-fasaala wa l-waba.
Wa kan nabi waahid yaji wa yitnabba' wa yikhabbir be l-salaam,illa kan al-cheyy al-hu atnabba' beyah alhaggag,khalaas al-naas ya'arfu kadar hu nabi wa akiid Allah bas rassalah.
Wa khalaas,al-nabi Hananya chaal uud al-daami min kataafe Irmiya wa kassarah.
Wa giddaam kulla l-cha'ab,Hananya gaal-:-Daahu Allah gaal-:--Be misil da ba'ad santeen,ana nikassir daami Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil le ninazzil tagalatah min kataafe kulla l-umam.-- Wa khalaas,Irmiya chaal derbah wa faat.
Wa ba'ad Hananya chaal uud al-daami min kataafe Irmiya wa kassarah,Allah hajja le Irmiya wa gaal-:
Amchi wa guul le Hananya-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Inta kassart daami hana hatab wa daahu,baddaltah be daami hana hadiid."--
Achaan Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Ana khatteet daami hana hadiid fi kataafe kulla l-umam dool le yakhdumu le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Wa sallamt leyah haywaanaat al-kadaade kula le yagoodu tihit sultitah.-
Wa Irmiya gaal le Hananya-:-Asma',ya Hananya-!Allah ma rassalak wa inta gaa'id tukhuchch al-cha'ab da le yukhuttu achamhum fi kidbak.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:--Akiid nuguchchak min wijh al-ard wa tumuut fi l-sana di achaan inta harracht al-cha'ab ya'aso Allah.-
Wa khalaas,al-nabi Hananya maat fi l-sana di bas fi l-chahar al-saabi'.
Wa l-nabi Irmiya katab jawaab min Madiinat al-Khudus le l-faddalo fi Baabil min al-kubaaraat wa rujaal al-diin wa l-anbiya wa kulla l-cha'ab al-Nabuukhadnasar chaalaahum min Madiinat al-Khudus wa waddaahum fi l-khurba.
Wa l-jawaab da rassalah ba'ad maragoohum min Madiinat al-Khudus le l-malik Yuyakiin wa l-malika al-umm wa l-masaa'iil wa l-kubaaraat hana balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-sinaa'iyiin wa l-haddaad.
Wa hu anta al-jawaab da le Al'aasa wileed Chaafaan wa Gamarya wileed Hilkhiiya al-rassalaahum Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Wa l-jawaab da buguul-:
Daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil le kulla l-naas al-fi l-khurba wa dool al-naas al-Allah waddaahum fi l-khurba min Madiinat al-Khudus le Baabil.
Hu gaal-:-Abnu leeku buyuut wa askunu fooghum wa maggunu leeku jineenaat wa aakulu min fawaakihhum.
Aakhudu wa aldo leeku awlaad wa banaat.Wa aakhudu le awlaadku awiin wa antu banaatku kula le rujaal wa hinna yaldan leehum iyaal.Aldo wa abgo katiiriin fi l-bakaan al-intu gaa'idiin foogah,ma tangusu.
Fattuchu al-salaam le l-madiina al-ana waddeetku foogha fi l-khurba.Wa as'alo Allah le l-madiina di achaan salaamha hi,salaamku intu kula.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Ma tinkhachcho be kalaam al-anbiya al-ma'aaku wa la be kalaam al-chawwaafiin wa ma titaabu'u tafsiir hilimhum kula.
Achaan al-anbiya dool yitnabba'o leeku be usmi.Wa kalaamhum da kidib,ana ma rassaltuhum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah gaal battaan-:-Mamlakat Baabil tagood 70 sana.Wa ba'ad da,ana nugumm wa nifakkir foogku wa nihaggig kalaami al-adiil wa nigabbilku hini fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Ana na'arif al-fikra al-jahhaztaha leeku wa hi ma fikra hint fasaala wa laakin fikra hint salaam al-beeha talgo mustakhbal malaan be acham.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,intu tinaaduuni wa tigarrubu leyi wa tisallu leyi wa ana nasma'ku.
Wa intu tifattuchuuni wa talgooni achaan taaba'tuuni be kulla guluubku.
Intu talgooni wa ana nigabbilku min al-khurba wa nilimmuku wa nijiibku min kulla l-umam wa min kulla l-buldaan al-ana chattattuku fooghum.Wa da kalaam Allah.Wa nijiibku hini fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa da l-bakaan al-ana waddeetku minnah fi l-khurba. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa intu gultu Allah marag anbiya fi usutku fi Baabil.
Daahu Allah hajja kalaam al-bukhuss al-malik al-gaa'id fi kursi al-muluk hana Dawuud wa fi kulla l-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi l-madiina di wa dool akhwaanku al-ma waddoohum ma'aaku fi l-khurba.
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ana nijiib fi usuthum al-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba.Wa nisawwiihum misil al-tiin al-mu'affan al-ma bin'akil min afanatah.
Wa ana nijiib fooghum daayman al-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba wa nisawwiihum masal al-bikhawwif kulla mamaalik al-ard.Wa yabgo mal'uuniin wa kharaab wa bahiite wa mu'yaar fi ust al-umam al-ana chattattuhum fi lubbuhum.
Humman ma sim'o kalaami hatta kan ana rassalt leehum daayman abiidi al-anbiya kula.Wa da kalaam Allah.Wa laakin ma sim'ooni.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin intu kulluku al-fi l-khurba,intu al-ana maragtuku min Madiinat al-Khudus wa waddeetku fi Baabil,asma'o kalaami ana Allah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal fi Akhaab wileed Khulaaya wa Sidkhiiya wileed Ma'asiiya-:-Humman atnabba'o leeku be usmi be kidib.Humman dool akiid ana nisallimhum le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa hu yaktulhum giddaamku.
Wa naas Yahuuza al-fi l-khurba fi Baabil yal'ano wa yuguulu-:--Khalli Allah yaj'alak misil Sidkhiiya wa Akhaab humman al-malik Baabil harragaahum be naar.--
Humman sawwo al-fasaala fi Israa'iil wa zano awiin akhwaanhum wa humman atnabba'o be usmi be kalaam kidib al-ana ma amart beyah.Wa da ana na'arfah wa chaahid foogah. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya Irmiya-!Guul le Chama'ya al-min hillit Nahlaam-:
--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Inta rassalt jawaab be usmak le kulla l-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa le Safanya wileed Ma'asiiya raajil al-diin wa le kulla rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin."-- Wa daahu al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-jawaab-:
Allah sawwaak raajil diin fi badal Yahuuyada' raajil al-diin achaan tiraakhib fi beet Allah.Wa ayyi naadum al-yichootin wa yitnabba',inta tigayyidah wa tidiss leyah jinziir fi ragabatah.
Wa kan misil da,maala ma karabt Irmiya al-min hillit Anatuut al-sawwa nafsah nabi fi usutku-?
Hu rassal leena fi Baabil al-jawaab al-buguul-:Wakit al-khurba yabga tawiil-!Abnu leeku buyuut wa askunu fooghum wa maggunu leeku jineenaat wa aakulu min fawaakihhum.
Wa Safanya raajil al-diin gara al-jawaab da giddaam al-nabi Irmiya.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Irmiya wa gaal-:
Aktib jawaab le kulla l-naas al-fi l-khurba wa guul leehum-:--Daahu kalaam Allah al-bukhuss Chama'ya al-min hillit Nahlaam.Hu gaal-:"Chama'ya atnabba' leeku wa laakin ana ma rassaltah.Wa hu khachchaaku le tukhuttu achamku fi kidbah."
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:"Akiid ana ni'aakhib Chama'ya wa zurriiytah.Wa naadum min zurriiytah ma yaskun fi ust al-cha'ab da wa ma yichiif al-kheer al-nisawwiih le cha'abi.Achaan hu harrach cha'abi le ya'asooni ana Allah."-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Ya Irmiya,aktib fi kitaab kulla l-kalaam al-ana gultah leek.
Wa yaji yoom waahid,ana nigabbil cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza min al-khurba.-- Wa da kalaam Allah.Wa Allah gaal battaan-:-Ana nijiib cha'abi fi l-balad al-ana anteetha le juduudhum wa yagoodu fi ard warasathum.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-bukhuss Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Korooraak al-khoof ansama'wa ma fi salaam illa l-ru'ub.
As'alo wa fakkuru-!Hal al-dukuur yaldo walla-?Wa maala ayyi raajil yukhutt iidah fi batnahmisil al-mara al-gaa'ide titaalig-?Wa maala kulla wujuuhhumbigo dulum-?
Al-azaab-!Al-yoom da,yoom ajiibwa yoom mislah kula ma fiih.Wa da wakit diigit zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa laakin yanjo minha.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:-Fi l-yoom da,ana nikassir al-daami wa ninazzilah min kataafeehum wa nigatti' guyuudhum.Wa humman battaan ma yabgo abiid le l-ajaanib
wa laakin ya'abuduuni ana Allah Ilaahhum.Wa yakhdumu le malik min zurriiyit Dawuud al-nisabbitah fooghum.
Wa intu,ya zurriiyit abdi Yaakhuub,ma takhaafowa ma tinbahtu,ya Bani Israa'iil-!Akiid ana ninajjiikumin al-balad al-ba'iidewa nijiib zurriiyitkumin balad al-khurba.Zurriiyit Yaakhuub yajuwa yagoodu be raaha wa amaanwa akiid ma fi naadum yibachtinhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ana zaati daayman nukuun ma'aakule ninajjiiku.Wa ana nidammir marra waahid kulla l-umamal-ana chattattuku fi lubbuhum.Wa laakin intu,ma nidammirku marra waahid.Akiid ma naj'alku bariyiinwa laakin ni'addibku be miiz.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,kasirki ma yirrakkabwa jiraahki ma yil'aalaj.
Ma fi naadum al-yidaafi' leeki fi l-charii'awa ma fi dawa al-yidaawi uwaarki.
Kulla sudgaanki yansooki,humman ma yihimmu beeki.Ana darabtiki darbit aduwa aakhabtiki bala rahma.Wa da,fi chaan khataaki al-katiirwa zanibki al-ma indah hadd.
Wa maalki tikooriki min waja' kasirkiwa min waja'ki al-ma yil'aalaj-?Ana bas sawweet leeki al-cheyy da.Wa da,fi chaan khataaki al-katiirwa zanibki al-ma indah hadd.
Wa be da khalaas,al-akalooki yin'akluwa kulla udwaanki yiwadduuhum abiid.Wa l-kasabooki yabgo kasiibewa l-nahabooki nisallimhum le l-nahib.
Wa naadooki Sahyuun al-mabkhuudawa ma fi naadum yihimm beeki.Wa laakin ana kamaan nachfiikiwa nidaawi leeki juruuhki.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Akiid ana Allah nigabbil zurriiyit Yaakhuub min balad al-khurbawa narham buyuuthum.Wa l-madiina tinbanifi bakaanha al-awwalwa gusuurha kula yinbanufi bakaanhum.
Wa fi usutha yinsami' al-chukurwa l-zakhraat.Wa ana nikattir zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa abadan ma yangusu.Wa ana nicharrifhumwa ma yahguruuhum battaan.
Wa cha'ab al-madiina diyabgo misil zamaanwa naasha yilimmuwa yagiifu giddaami.Akiid ana ni'aakhibkulla udwaanha al-yazulmuuha.
Wa cheekhhum yukuun minhumwa malikhum yamrug min usuthum.Wa ana nichiilah wa nigarribah leyiwa hu yukuun gariib minni.Wa yaatu al-yigarrib leyi bala izinwa yidiss nafsah fi l-khutuura-?Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,intu tabgo cha'abiwa ana nabga Ilaahku.
Wa daahu khadab Allah gammamisil amzooba'aane.Wa riih chadiide hajjatwa tuduur fi ruuse al-aasiyiin.
Wa khadab Allah al-muhrig ma yagiiflahaddi yihaggig niiytah al-hu chaalha.Wa fi l-akhiir,tafhamo al-cheyy da adiil.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Fi l-wakit da,ana nabga Ilaah le kulla khuchuum buyuut Bani Israa'iil wa humman yabgo cha'abi.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Al-cha'ab al-nijo min al-moot,ligo ridaayi fi l-sahara.Wa Bani Israa'iil mutawajjihiinale l-raaha.
Zamaan,ana Allah bint leehum wa gult-:--Ana nihibbuku hubb abadiwa be da,narhamku daayman.--
Wa ana nabniiki battaan,ya Israa'iil,misil yabnu beet.Wa inti tinbani,ya ummatial-misil bineeye udriiye.Wa tichiili tanaabilki wa tamurgiwa tal'abe wa tafrahe.
Wa battaan timaggini jineenit inabfi jibaal al-Saamira.Wa l-yimaggunu al-jineenaatyafraho be intaajhum.
Wa yaji yoom waahid al-foogahal-hurraas yinaadu fi jibaal Afraayim wa yuguulu-:--Yalla gummu namchu le madiinat Sahyuun,le Allah Ilaahna.-
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Afraho wa zakhrutu le zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa ragrugu le ahsan umma.Wa achkuru be hiss aali wa guulu-:--Allah najja cha'abah,humman al-faddalo min Bani Israa'iil.-
Wa Allah gaal-:-Akiid nijiibhummin balad al-munchaakhwa nilimmuhummin aakhir al-dunya.Wa fi usuthum fiyah amyaaniin wa l-urujwa l-awiin al-khalbaanaat wa l-yaldan.Wa humman yaju hini,majmuu'a kabiire.
Wa ana nigabbilhumwa humman yaju be bakiwa yachhadooni wa yuguulu-:--Arhamna-!Arhamna-!--Wa ana niwaddiihum ale l-wudyaanal-induhum almi katiirbe derib adiilal-abadan ma yittarta'o foogah.Aywa,ana bigiit misil abu le Bani Israa'iilwa gabiilat Afraayim bigo misil wileedi al-bikir.
Ya l-umam,asma'o kalaam Allahwa ballukhuuh fi l-buldaan al-ba'iidiinhana khachum al-bahar.Wa guulu-:-Allah al-chattat Bani Israa'iil yilimmuhumwa yahfadhum misil al-raa'i yahfad khanamah.
Allah fadaahum le zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa najjaahum min al-adu al-chadiid.
Humman yigabbulu wa yizakhrutufi jabal Sahyuun.Wa yafraho be kheer Allah,be l-gameh wa l-khamar al-jadiidwa l-dihin wa l-bagar wa l-khanam.Wa hayaathum samhe misil jineene mazgiiyewa battaan ma yat'abo.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Fi l-wakit da,al-banaat yal'aban wa yafrahanwa l-subyaan wa l-chiyyaab kula.Nibaddil bakiihum be farha wa nihannishumwa nifarrihhum min hizinhum.Wa nachbi' rujaal al-diin be l-laham al-samiinwa cha'abi yachba'o be kulla kheeri.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Ansama' hiss fi hillit al-Raama,baki chadiid wa nuwaah.Wa di Raahiil gaa'ide tabki le iyaalhawa hi abat al-sabbiriinchaan iyaalha maato khalaas.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Askuti,waggifi al-baki wa guchchi dumuu'ki.Talge ajur ta'abkiwa iyaalki yaju min balad al-adu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Aywa,mustakhbalki malaan be l-acham.Akiid iyaalki yigabbulu fi watanhum.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ana simi't adiil ganiit gabiilat Afraayim wakit gaalo-:--Awwal aniina misil ijilal-ma mu'addab.Inta addabtinawa aniina al'addabna,ya Rabb.Wa hassa',gabbilna aleekwa aniina nigabbuluachaan inta Allah Ilaahna.
Aywa,ba''adna nufuusna minnakwa laakin hassa' nidimna.Wa ba'ad irifna khataayaana,dangarna ruuseena.Wa l-eeb wa l-khijle karaboonaachaan aniina gaa'idiin nilhammalo ihaanit subaana.-
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Wa gabiilat Afraayim misil wileedi al-niriidahwa hu bas al-yijiib leyi al-farah.Wa kan kharrart diddah kula,nifakkir foogah battaan.Wa misil abu,galbi chakhkhaal beyah huwa narhamah daayman.
Khuzzi leeki ichaaraat fi l-tariigwa khutti amad misil alaamaat.Fakkiri fi deribkiwa da l-derib al-inti macheeti beyah.Ta'aali,ya bitt ammi al-udriiye Israa'iil-!Ta'aali-!Gabbili le mudunki al-halaalki.
Le mata ti'iiri,ya l-bineeye al-kaafre-?Achaan Allah yakhligcheyy jadiid fi l-ard.Wa da,inti tifattichi Allahmisil mara al-tigarrib le raajilha.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Ba'ad nigabbilhum min al-khurba wa nisabbithum fi balad Yahuuza wa mudunha,humman yihajju be l-kalaam da battaan wa yuguulu-:--Khalli Allah yibaarikak,ya Sahyuun al-jabal al-mukhaddas,ya maskan al-adaala-!--
Fi l-wakit daak,fi balad Yahuuza wa kulla mudunha,al-harraatiin wa l-sayyaara kulluhum yaskunu sawa.
Wa ana Allah narwi al-atchaaniin wa nachbi' al-jii'aaniin.
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Wa khalaas,ana wi'iit wa fakkart wa noomi da halu.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Yaji yoom waahid al-foogah ana namla ard Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza be l-naas wa l-bahaayim.
Wa misil ana gammeet didduhum,maragtuhum wa rameethum wa kharabtuhum wa dammartuhum wa sawweet leehum al-fasaala,misil da hassa' ana nugumm nabniihum wa nisabbithum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,battaan ma yuguulu-:-Kan al-abbahaat akalo inab akhdar,sunuun iyaalhum yumuutu min al-hamaad.
Laakin la-!Ayyi naadum yumuut be khataayah.Kan naadum akal inab akhdar,sunuunah hu bas yumuutu min al-hamaad.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Yaji yoom waahid,nisawwi mu'aahada jadiide ma'a Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.
Wa l-mu'aahada di ma tabga misil al-mu'aahada al-ana sawweetha ma'a juduudhum wakit gudtuhum wa maragtuhum min balad Masir.Humman gata'o al-mu'aahada di,hatta kan ana siidhum kula.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa di hi al-mu'aahada al-jadiide al-nisawwiiha ma'a Bani Israa'iil ba'ad al-yoom da.Ana nukhutt wasiiyaati fi fikirhum wa naktibhum fi guluubhum.Wa ana nabga Ilaahhum wa humman yabgo cha'abi.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa naadum ma yi'allim rafiigah wa la yuguul le akhuuh-:--A'arif Allah.- Achaan humman kulluhum kabiir wa sakhayyar ya'arfuuni khalaas.Wa ana nakhfir leehum khataayaahum wa ma nifakkir fi zunuubhum battaan. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Yaatu al-sabbat al-harraayle tidawwi be l-nahaar-?Wa yaatu al-nazzam al-gamar wa l-nujuumle yidawwu be l-leel-?Wa yaatu al-gawwam al-baharlahaddi tinsami' harakat moojah-?Da ana,al-usmi Allah al-Gaadir.
Kan al-nizaam dama angachcha min giddaami,khalaas zurriiyit Israa'iil kulama yingachcho.Yagoodu umma giddaamiila l-abad.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal battaan-:-Hal fi naadum yagdar yigaawisal-samaawaat foog walla-?Wa hal fi naadum yagdar yakchifasaas al-ard tihit walla-?La-!Kan ke da,khalaas ana kula ma nagdar narfud zurriiyit Israa'iilfi chaan kulla l-fasil al-humman sawwooh.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Yaji yoom waahid,yabnu battaan madiinat Allah min beet al-muraakhaba hana Hananiil lahaddi baab al-Rukun.
Wa min al-bakaan da,al-huduud yamchu ale jabal Gaarib wa yiwajjuhu ale Goo'a.
Wa kulla waadi al-janaazaat wa l-rumaad wa kulla ziraa'a al-ale waadi Khidruun lahaddi l-rukun hana baab al-Kheel sabaah,kulla l-bakaan da yabga mukhaddas leyi ana Allah.Wa la yamurguuh wa la yakharbuuh ila l-abad.
Wa Allah hajja le Irmiya fi l-sana al-aachir hana hukum Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa di sanit 18 hana hukum Nabuukhadnasar.
Wa fi l-wakit da,askar malik Baabil haasaro Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-nabi Irmiya gaa'id makruub fi fadaayit al-hurraas fi gasir malik Yahuuza.
Wa Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza al-karab Irmiya gaal leyah-:-Maala titnabba' wa tuguul misil ke-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ana nisallim al-madiina di le malik Baabil wa hu yichiilha.
Wa Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza kula ma yanja min deech al-Baabiliyiin wa hu zaatah akiid nisallimah le malik Baabil.Wa yigaabilah wijih be wijih wa yihajji ma'aayah khachum be khachum.
Wa malik Baabil yiwaddiih le Sidkhiiya fi Baabil wa hu yagood hinaak lahaddi ana nifakkir foogah.Wa da kalaam Allah.Wa kan tugummu tihaarubu malik Baabil kula,abadan ma tagdaro tinnasru."-
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
--Hanamiil wileed immak Challuum yaji wa yuguul leek ke-:"Achri ardi al-gaa'ide fi Anatuut achaan inta indak hagg al-warasa."-
Wa misil Allah gaalah leyi,Hanamiil wileed immi ja leyi fi fadaayit al-hurraas wa gaal-:-Min fadlak,achri ardi al-gaa'ide fi Anatuut fi ard gabiilat Banyaamiin achaan inta bas wariis wa indak hagg al-milkiiye fi l-ard di.Achriiha le nafsak. Wa khalaas fi bakaan da,ana fihimt kadar da l-kalaam al-Allah hajjaah leyi min awwal.
Wa khalaas,ana chareet al-ard min Hanamiil wileed immi wa di l-ard al-gaa'ide fi Anatuut.Wa ana wazant leyah fudda al-tisaawi 7 hajar fudda.
Wa katabt maktuub al-mubaaya'a wa khatteet foogah khitmi wa da giddaam al-chuhuud al-ana naadeethum.Wa wazant al-fudda fi l-miizaan.
Wa ana chilt nuskha waahide makhtuuma hana maktuub al-mubaaya'a wa nuskha aakhara ma makhtuuma.Wa tineenithum kula maktuub fooghum al-taman wa l-churuut.
Wa anteet al-nusakh dool le Baruuk wileed Nariiya wileed Mahsiiya wa da giddaam Hanamiil wileed immi wa giddaam al-chuhuud al-mado fi maktuub al-mubaaya'a wa giddaam kulla naas Yahuuza al-gaa'idiin fi fadaayit al-hurraas.
Wa giddaamhum,ana amart Baruuk wa gult-:
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Chiil al-nusakh al-tineen dool al-humman makaatiib al-mubaaya'a al-makhtuum wa l-ma makhtuum.Wa khuttuhum fi jarr achaan yagoodu le wakit tawiil.--
Achaan Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal battaan-:--Fi l-balad di battaan yachru buyuut wa ard wa jineenaat inab.-
Wa ba'ad ammant makaatiib al-mubaaya'a le Baruuk wileed Nariiya,ana Irmiya salleet le Allah wa gult-:
Ya Allah Rabbi-!Inta bas al-khalagt al-samaawaat wa l-ard be gudurtak al-kabiire wa be duraa'ak al-gawi.Cheyy gaasi leek inta ke ma fiih.
Wa inta bas al-tiwassif kheerak le aalaaf al-zurriiyaat.Wa laakin tagdar ti'aakhib al-iyaal be zunuub abbahaathum,inta al-Ilaah al-Kabiir wa l-Chadiid wa usmak Allah al-Gaadir.
Inta al-mustachaar al-aziim wa gaadir fi l-amal.Wa inta tiraakhib ayyi insaan wa tikaafi ayyi waahid hasab derbah wa hasab natiijat amalah.
Wa fi balad Masir,inta sawweet alaamaat wa ajaayib.Wa be da lahaddi l-yoom,usmak bigi aziim fi Israa'iil wa fi kulla l-aalam misil gaa'idiin nichiifu al-yoom.
Wa inta maragt cha'abak Bani Israa'iil min balad Masir be alaamaat wa ajaayib wa be iidak al-chadiide wa be duraa'ak al-gawi wa be ru'ub chadiid.
Wa anteethum al-balad al-inta halaft le juduudhum wa gult tantiiha wa hi al-balad al-malaane be l-laban wa l-asal.
Wa humman dakhalo foogha wa chaalooha wa laakin ma sim'o kalaamak wa la taaba'o churuutak al-fi l-Tawraat.Wa humman abo kulla l-wasaaya al-inta amart beehum.Wa fi chaan da,inta jibt leehum al-fasaala di.
Wa hassa',askar Baabil sawwo radmiiye al-yihaasuru beeha al-madiina wa yichiiluuha.Humman yihaarubuuha achaan al-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba al-inta kharrartuhum jo foogha khalaas.Wa inta gaa'id tichiif al-cheyy da.
Ya Allah Rabbi,inta bas al-gult leyi-:--Achri al-ard wa awzin al-fudda wa naadi al-chuhuud.- Wa hassa',chiif-!Al-madiina di,askar al-Baabil gaa'idiin yichiiluuha-!
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Irmiya wa gaal-:
Ana Allah Ilaah kulla makhluug hayy-!Hal fi cheyy gaasi leyi walla-?
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Akiid nisallim al-madiina di le l-Baabiliyiin wa le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa hu yichiilha.
Wa l-Baabiliyiin al-yihaasuru al-madiina di yadkhulu foogha wa yutuchchuuha.Wa yutuchchu al-buyuut al-fi raashum harrago bakhuur le ilaah Ba'al wa gaddamo hadaaya charaab le ilaahaat aakhariin wa da khaddabooni ana.
Aywa-!Min zamaan,Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza yisawwu illa l-fasaala giddaami.Wa Bani Israa'iil illa yikhaddubuuni be amalhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-madiina di gaa'ide tikhaddibni wa tiza''ilni min assasooha lahaddi l-yoom.Wa be da,nuguchchaha min giddaami.
Wa Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza khaddabooni be sabab al-amal al-fasil al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuh,humman wa muluukhum wa kubaaraathum wa rujaal diinhum wa anbiyaahum wa kulla naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Humman daayman yajuuni be duhuurhum ma be wujuuhhum.Hatta kan ana gaa'id ni'allimhum daayman kula,humman ma yasma'ooni wa la yakhbalo al-adab.
Humman jaabo asnaamhum al-muharramiin fi beeti al-foogah usmi achaan yinajjusuuh.
Wa fi waadi Bani Hinnuum bano madbah le Ba'al le yiharrugu foogah awlaadhum wa banaathum le ilaahhum Muulak.Wa da ana ma amartuhum beyah wa la fakkart foogah yoom waahid.Wa be l-muharramaat dool,lazzo Bani Yahuuza fi l-zanib.
Wa intu gultu al-madiina di taga' fi iid malik Baabil be sabab al-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba.Wa laakin daahu ana Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gult-:
--Akiid ana nilimmuhum min kulla l-buldaan al-ana chattattuhum fooghum fi wakit za'ali wa khadabi al-chadiid.Wa nigabbilhum fi arduhum wa nisabbithum foogha wa yagoodu be amaan.
Wa humman yabgo cha'abi wa ana nabga Ilaahhum.
Wa ana niwahhid galibhum wa deribhum achaan yakhaafo minni daayman.Wa be da,yagoodu fi raaha,humman wa iyaalhum min ba'adhum.
Wa ana nisawwi ma'aahum mu'aahada daayme.Ma nikhalliihum wa nisawwi leehum al-kheer.Wa namla guluubhum be khoof minni achaan ma yikhallu derbi.
Wa ana nafrah wakit nisawwi leehum al-kheer.Wa akiid ana zaati nisabbithum fi l-balad di be kulla galbi wa be kulla fikri.-
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Ana jibt fi l-cha'ab da al-fasaala al-kabiire di wa misil da,akiid ana nijiib kulla l-kheer al-gult nisawwiih leehum.
Intu gultu al-balad di takhrab min al-naas wa l-bahaayim achaan ana nisallimha le l-Baabiliyiin.Wa laakin be da kula,yachru foogha ard battaan.
Aywa,yachru ard wa yawzunu fudda wa yaktubu maktuub hana mubaaya'a wa yukhuttu foogah khitim wa yinaadu al-chuhuud.Wa da yabga fi ard gabiilat Banyaamiin wa hawaale Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa fi l-jibaal wa fi sahalat Chafiila wa fi saharat Nagab,achaan ana nigabbil sukkaanhum min al-khurba. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah hajja le Irmiya le taani marra wakit hu gaa'id makruub fi fadaayit al-hurraas.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-khalag al-ard wa kawwanha wa sabbatha wa hu bas al-usmah Allah.Hu gaal-:
Naadiini wa ana nurudd leek wa nikhabbirak be l-achya al-gaasiyiin.Wa dool al-achya al-mulabbadiin al-inta ma ta'arifhum.
Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal kalaam al-bukhuss buyuut al-madiina wa gusuur muluuk Yahuuza al-ramoohum al-hisaar wa l-harib.Hu gaal-:
Wakit yihaarubu al-Baabiliyiin,al-buyuut dool yinmalu be janaazaat al-cha'ab al-ana kataltuhum fi za'ali wa khadabi.Wa ana battaan ma niwajjih ale l-madiina di wa da be sabab kulla fasaalit cha'abha.
Wa laakin daahu ana nantiiha al-chifa wa l-aafe wa le sukkaanha nachfiihum wa nijiib leehum al-salaam wa l-amaan be katara.
Wa nigabbil naas Yahuuza wa naas Israa'iil al-waddoohum fi l-khurba.Wa nisabbithum misil zamaan.
Wa nitahhirhum min kulla khataahum al-sawwooh diddi wa nakhfir leehum kulla zunuubhum al-sawwoohum diddi wa dool zunuubhum al-beehum isooni.
Wa l-madiina di,tabga leyi farah wa tijiib leyi chukur wa charaf giddaam kulla umam al-ard al-yasma'o be l-kheer al-ana sawweetah le cha'abi.Wa l-umam dool yakhaafo wa yibarjulu be sabab kulla l-kheer wa l-salaam al-ana jibtah fi l-madiina di.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Intu gultu al-madiina di khirbat wa bigat faadiye min al-naas wa l-bahaayim.Wa battaan gultu hillaal balad Yahuuza wa chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus khirbo,ma induhum naas wa la sukkaan wa la bahaayim.Wa laakin ana nuguul battaan yinsami' fi l-madiina di
al-zakhraat wa l-ragraag wa khine al-ursaan wa khine al-chukur.Wa yigaddumu dahaaya chukur fi beet Allah wa yuguulu-:--Achkuru Allah al-Gaadir achaan hu adiil wa rahmatah daayme ila l-abad.- Achaan ana nigabbil al-naas al-waddoohum fi l-khurba wa nisabbithum fi arduhum misil zamaan. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Wa hassa',al-balad di khirbat min al-naas wa min al-bahaayim.Wa laakin ba'adeen,fi kulla hillaalha yisawwu zaraayib le ru'yaan yiraggudu fooghum khanamhum.
Wa fi hillaal al-jibaal wa fi sahalat Chafiila wa fi saharat Nagab wa fi ard gabiilat Banyaamiin wa fi hawaale Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi hillaal balad Yahuuza,kulla l-khanam yufuutu tihit iid al-raa'i le ya'arif adadhum. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Yaji yoom waahid al-foogah ana nihaggig kalaam al-kheer al-ana gultah le Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza.
Wa fi ayyaam al-wakit da,nigawwim naadum saalih min zurriiyit Dawuud misil bizre wa yijiib al-hagg wa l-adaala fi l-balad.
Wa fi l-wakit da,naas balad Yahuuza yalgo al-naja wa Madiinat al-Khudus tagood be amaan.Wa daahu al-usum al-yisammuuha beyah,Allah Hu Bas al-Yijiib leena al-Adaala.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Aywa daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiyit Dawuud al-yagood fi kursi al-muluk hana Bani Israa'iil.
Wa rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiyithum le yigaddumu leyi dahaaya muharragiin wa yiharrugu hadaaya hana dagiig wa yigaddumu dahaaya aakhariin kulla yoom.
Wa Allah hajja le Irmiya.
Daahu Allah gaal-:-Kan tagdaro tagta'o mu'aahadati ma'a l-nahaar wa l-leel wa tadharo al-leel wa l-nahaar ma yaju fi wakithum,
khalaas mu'aahadati ma'a abdi Dawuud kula tingati' wa ma yalga wariis yagood fi kursi mulkah.Wa battaan mu'aahadati tingati' ma'a rujaal al-diin al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu leyi kula.Wa laakin al-cheyy da abadan ma yabga-!
Wa akiid ma tagdaro tahsubu nujuum al-sama wa la tagdaro tahsubu ramla hana khachum al-bahar.Ana kula nikattir zurriiyit Dawuud abdi wa l-Laawiyiin al-yakhdumu leyi lahaddi ma tagdaro tahsubuuhum.
Wa Allah hajja le Irmiya wa gaal-:
Inta ma gaa'id tasma' kalaam al-naas dool walla-?Humman gaa'idiin buguulu-:--Al-gabaayil al-itneen al-humman Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil al-azalaahum Allah,hassa' da,hu abaahum.- Wa be kalaamhum da,humman gaa'idiin yahguru cha'abi wa ma yaj'aloohum misil umma.
Wa laakin daahu ana Allah gult-:--Ana bas sawweet mu'aahadati ma'a l-nahaar wa ma'a l-leel wa sabbatt nizaam al-samaawaat wa l-ard.
Wa misil da,ana ma nagdar nikhalli zurriiyit Yaakhuub wa zurriiyit Dawuud abdi.Wa min zurriiyit Dawuud bas,nichiil muluuk al-yamulku fi zurriiyit Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub.Wa narhamhum wa nigabbil naashum al-waddoohum fi l-khurba.-
Wa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil gamma le yihaarib Madiinat al-Khuduswa kulla l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha.Wa hu ja be kulla askarah wa askar mamaalik al-ard wa dool kulla l-chu'uub al-hu yahkim fooghum.Wa fi l-wakit daak,Allah hajja le Irmiya.
Wa daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal leyah-:-Amchi wa hajji le Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza.Wa guul leyah-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:Akiid ana nisallim al-madiina di le malik Baabil wa yiharrigha be naar.
Ya Sidkhiiya,inta zaatak ma tanja minnah,akiid hu yakurbak.Wa tilgaabalo ma'a malik Baabil wijih be wijih wa tihajji ma'aayah khachum be khachum wa yiwaddiik fi Baabil.
Ya Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza,kan tasma' kalaami ana Allah al-gultah leek,inta abadan ma tumuut fi l-harib.
Tumuut be salaam.Wa misil harrago al-bakhuur fi moot juduudak al-muluuk al-jo gablak,inta kula yiharruguuh leek.Wa yabku leek wa yuguulu-:"Ya khasaaritna-!Sayyidna maat-!"Wa da ana bas waa'adtak beyah.-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-nabi Irmiya gaal kulla l-kalaam da le Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,askar malik Baabil gaa'idiin yihaarubu didd Madiinat al-Khudus wa didd Lakiich wa Aziikha achaan dool bas al-mudun al-gawiyiin al-faddalo min hillaal balad Yahuuza.
Wa Allah hajja le Irmiya wa da ba'ad al-malik Sidkhiiya ma'a kulla cha'ab Madiinat al-Khudus sawwo mu'aahada le ya'lunu al-hurriiye.
Wa be da,ayyi naadum yanti al-hurriiye le abiidah wa khadiimah min akhwaanah al-Ibraaniyiin wa yikhalliihum yamchu hurriin.Wa ma waajib ayyi naadum yi'abbid naadum min akhwaanah al-Yahuud.
Wa kulla l-kubaaraat wa kulla l-cha'ab al-mado fi l-mu'aahada di khassado yantu al-hurriiye le abiidhum wa yikhalluuhum yamchu hurriin wa ma yi'abbuduuhum battaan.Wa khalaas,khalloohum macho hurriin.
Wa laakin ba'ad da,humman nidmo wa nagado mu'aahadathum al-sawwooha.Wa gabbalo abiidhum al-humman antoohum al-hurriiye wa abbadoohum battaan.
Wa Allah hajja le Irmiya wa gaal-:
Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Ana bas sawweet mu'aahada ma'a juduudku fi yoom maragtuhum min Masir balad al-ubuudiiye.
Wa gult leehum-:"Fi l-sana al-saab'e,ayyi waahid minku yanti al-hurriiye le akhuuh al-Ibraani al-baa' nafsah leyah.Hu yakhdim leyah sitte sana wa ba'ad da,yikhalli yamchi hurr."Wa laakin juduudku ma khatto adaanhum leyi wa ma sim'ooni.
Wa intu al-yoom sawweetu al-adiil giddaami.Ayyi waahid minku aalan al-hurriiye le akhuuh wa khallaah macha hurr.Wa da be mu'aahadatku al-sawweetuuha giddaami fi beeti al-foogah usmi.Wa laakin intu nidimtu-!
Aywa,nidimtu wa nagadtu mu'aahadatku wa ma ahtaramtu usmi.Gabbaltu al-abiid al-awwal khalleetuuhum macho hurriin fi nufuushum wa abbadtuuhum battaan.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Intu ma simi'tuuni wa ayyi waahid minku ma aalan al-hurriiye le akhu.Wa fi chaan da,ana ni'aalin didduku al-harib wa l-waba wa l-juu' wa humman yaktuluuku be hurriiye.Wa ana nisawwiiku masal al-bikhawwif kulla mamaalik al-ard.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-naas al-nidmo wa nagado mu'aahadati wa ma tabbago kalaam al-mu'aahada al-sawwooha giddaami,ana nisawwiihum misil al-ijil al-chaggooh itneen wa khattooh jaay wa jaaywa faato ambeenaatah wa di alaamat al-mu'aahada.
Wa kubaaraat Yahuuza wa kubaaraat Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-masaa'iil wa rujaal al-diin wa kulla cha'ab al-balad al-faato ambeenaat al-ijil da,
ana nisallimhum le udwaanhum al-yidooru moothum wa janaazaathum yabgo akil le l-suguura wa l-maraaf'iin.
Wa Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa kubaaraatah kula nisallimhum le udwaanhum al-yidooru moothum wa humman askar malik Baabil.Wa hassa',humman ba''ado minku
wa laakin daahu ana nantiihum amur wa humman yigabbulu didd al-madiina di yihaarubuuha wa yichiiluuha wa yutuchchuuha be naar.Wa kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza yabgo faadiyiin min sukkaanhum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi ayyaam hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,Allah hajja leyi ana Irmiya wa gaal-:
Amchi le Bani Rikaab wa hajji leehum.Waddiihum fi beeti ana Allah wa dissuhum fi khurfa wa antiihum khamar yacharbo.
Khalaas,ana Irmiya macheet fattacht Yaazanya wileed Irmiya wileed Habasinya wa akhwaanah wa kulla iyaalah wa kulla Bani Rikaab.
Wa ana waddeethum fi beet Allah fi khurfit talaamiiz Hanaan abd Allah wileed Yigdalya wa da jamb khurfit al-kubaaraat wa foog le khurfit Ma'asiiya wileed Challuum haaris madkhal beet Allah.
Wa ana khatteet giddaam naas Bani Rikaab mawaa'iin malaaniin be khamar wa kiisaan wa gult leehum-:-Acharbo khamar-!
Wa laakin humman raddo leyi wa gaalo-:-Aniina ma nacharbo khamar achaan jiddina Yunadaab wileed Rikaab antaana amur.Wa l-amur da buguul-:--Abadan ma tacharbo khamar wa la intu wa la zurriiyitku.
Wa ma tabnu buyuut wa la tisawwu ziraa'a wa la timaggunu jineenaat inab wa la tamulku cheyy minha.Wa laakin askunu fi khiyam fi kulla muddit hayaatku wa be da,umurku yabga tawiil fi l-ard al-intu tanzulu foogha.--
Wa aniina nikarrumu kulla amur Yunadaab wileed Rikaab jiddina.Abadan ma chiribna khamar fi kulla muddit hayaatna wa la aniina wa la awiinna wa la awlaadna wa la banaatna.
Wa ma baneena buyuut le naskunu fooghum wa ma indina wa la jineenaat inab wa la ziraa'a wa la ard mazruu'a
wa sakanna fi khiyam.Karramna amur Yunadaab jiddina wa sawweena sawa sawa misil hu amaraana beyah.
Wa illa wakit Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil gamma hajam al-balad di,aniina gulna nisiiru ni'arrudu min deech al-Baabiliyiin wa deech Araam wa naju wa nanzulu hini fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa da bas al-sabab al-jaabaana wa sakkanaana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Irmiya.
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Amchi le Bani Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa guul-:--Maala intu ma khassadtu be adabi wa la simi'tu kalaami-?Wa da kalaam Allah.
Chiifu daahu al-naas dool sim'o amur jidduhum Yunadaab wileed Rikaab.Hu amar zurriiytah ma yacharbo khamar.Wa khalaas,humman ma chirbooh lahaddi l-yoom da wa karramo amur jidduhum.Wa ana Allah kamaan hajjeet leeku daayman wa intu abadan ma simi'tuuni.
Wa daayman ana rassalt leeku abiidi al-anbiya wa da le yuguulu leeku-:"Khalli ayyi waahid yigabbil min derbah al-fasil wa yisallih amalah.Wa ma titaabu'u ilaahaat aakhariin wa ta'abuduuhum wa be da,taskunu fi l-ard al-ana anteetha le juduudku wa leeku intu."Wa laakin be da kula,intu ma khatteetu adaanku leyi ana Allah le tasma'ooni.
Ajab-!Zurriiyit Yunadaab wileed Rikaab sim'o amur jidduhum al-amaraahum beyah.Wa laakin intu al-cha'ab dool abeetu ma tasma'ooni.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Akiid ana nijiib foogku intu Bani Yahuuza wa fi kulla sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus kulla l-fasaala al-ana kharrartaha didduku.Achaan ana kallamt leeku wa intu ma simi'tuuni wa naadeetku wa ma raddeetu leyi.
Wa ba'ad da,Irmiya gaal le Bani Rikaab-:-Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Intu simi'tu amur Yunadaab jidduku wa tabbagtu kulla kalaamah sawa sawa misil hu amaraaku beyah.--
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Daayman yukuun naadum min zurriiyit Yunadaab wileed Rikaab ambeen khaddaamiini.-
Wa fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,daahu kalaam Allah al-gaalah le Irmiya-:
Chiil leek kitaab malfuuf wa aktib foogah kulla l-kalaam al-ana gultah leek fi Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza wa kulla l-umam.Wa da min awwal yoom al-ana hajjeet leek fi wakit hukum Yuuchiiya lahaddi l-yoom.
Akuun Bani Yahuuza yafhamo al-fasaala al-ana kharrartaha didduhum wa be da,ayyi waahid yigabbil min derbah al-fasil.Wa khalaas,ana kamaan nakhfir leehum khataahum wa zanibhum.
Wa Irmiya naada Baruuk wileed Nariiya.Wa Irmiya yikallim wa Baruuk yaktib fi l-kitaab al-malfuuf kulla kalaam Allah al-gaalah le Irmiya.
Wa ba'ad da,Irmiya gaal le Baruuk-:-Daahuuni ana ma nagdar namchi beet Allah.
Wa laakin inta amchi wa agri al-kitaab al-malfuuf al-inta katabtah hasab kalaami al-gaalah leyi Allah.Wa amchi agriih fi yoom hana siyaam le kulla l-cha'ab fi beet Allah wa giddaam kulla cha'ab Yahuuza al-yaju min mudunhum.
Wa be da,akuun yachhado Allah wa yutuubu wa ayyi waahid yigabbil min derbah al-fasil achaan khadab Allah wa za'alah al-kharrarah didd al-umma di chadiid.
Wa khalaas,Baruuk tabbag kulla l-kalaam al-amarah beyah al-nabi Irmiya.Hu macha beet Allah le yagri al-kitaab al-malfuuf al-foogah kalaam Allah.
Wa fi l-chahar al-taasi' fi l-sana al-khaamse hana hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,kharraro siyaam le Allah.Wa kulla cha'ab Madiinat al-Khudus wa kulla l-naas al-jo min hillaal balad Yahuuza lammo sawa fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa khalaas,Baruuk gamma wa gara fi beet Allah giddaam kulla l-cha'ab kalaam Irmiya al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-malfuuf.Wa da wakit waagif fi khurfit Gamarya wileed Chaafaan al-kaatib wa l-khurfa di fi l-fadaay al-foog fi khachum al-baab al-jadiid hana beet Allah.
Wa Miika wileed Gamarya wileed Chaafaan simi' kulla kalaam Allah al-maktuub fi l-kitaab da.
Wa khalaas,gamma macha le gasir al-malik fi khurfit al-kaatib al-yilimmu foogha kulla l-kubaaraat wa humman Alichama' al-kaatib wa Dalaaya wileed Chama'ya wa Alnaataan wileed Akbuur wa Gamarya wileed Chaafaan wa Sidkhiiya wileed Hananya wa kulla l-kubaaraat al-aakhariin.
Wa Miika hajja leehum be kulla l-kalaam al-sim'ah wakit Baruuk gaa'id yagri al-kitaab le l-cha'ab.
Wa khalaas,al-kubaaraat rassalo mursaal le Baruuk.Wa l-mursaal da,usmah Yahuudi wileed Natanya wileed Chalamya wileed Kuuchi.Wa gaal le Baruuk-:-Chiil kitaabak al-malfuuf al-inta gareetah le kulla l-cha'ab wa ta'aal beyah. Wa Baruuk chaal kitaabah wa ja giddaamhum.
Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Min fadlak,agood tihit wa agriih leena. Wa khalaas,Baruuk garaah leehum.
Wa wakit humman sim'o kulla l-kalaam da,humman khaafo khoof chadiid wa achchaawafo ambeenaathum.Wa gaalo le Baruuk-:-Khalli niwaddu kulla l-kalaam da giddaam al-malik.
Wa humman sa'alo Baruuk wa gaalo-:-Min fadlak,guul leena kikkeef inta gidirt katabt kulla l-kalaam da.Walla Irmiya bas hajjaah leek-?
Wa Baruuk radda leehum wa gaal-:-Aywa,hu bas hajja leyi kulla l-kalaam da wa ana katabtah fi l-kitaab da be dawaay.
Wa l-kubaaraat gaalo le Baruuk-:-Amchu allabbado inta wa Irmiya.Khalli naadum ma ya'arif bakaanku.
Wa ba'ad da,humman khallo al-kitaab al-malfuuf fi beet Alichama' al-kaatib wa macho bakaan al-malik wa hajjo leyah be kulla l-kalaam.
