Wa l-malik rassal Yahuudi le yijiib al-kitaab.Wa Yahuudi macha chaal al-kitaab min khurfit Alichama' al-kaatib wa ja garaah le l-malik wa le kulla l-kubaaraat al-gaa'idiin jambah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-malik gaa'id fi beetah hana l-chite.Wa da fi l-chahar al-taasi' fi wakt al-bardaay wa indah daffaay mugabbide giddaamah.
Wa kan Yahuudi gara talaata aw arba'a roog,al-malik yagta' al-katib da be muus wa yazgulah fi naar al-daffaay.Wa misil da bas,hu harrag kulla l-kitaab al-malfuuf.
Wa l-malik wa kulla kubaaraatah sim'o al-kalaam da wa laakin ma khaafo wa la charrato khulgaanhum le yiwassufu toobithum.
Wa hatta kan Alnaataan wa Dalaaya wa Gamarya chahado al-malik ma yahrig al-kitaab da kula,hu aba ma yasma'hum.
Wa l-malik amar Yarhamiil min zurriiyit al-mamlaka wa Saraaya wileed Azriyiil wa Chalamya wileed Abdiil le yakurbu Baruuk al-kaatib wa Irmiya al-nabi.Wa laakin Allah labbadaahum.
Wa ba'ad al-malik harag al-kitaab al-katabah Baruuk hasab kalaam Irmiya,Allah hajja le Irmiya wa gaal-:
Asma'-!Chiil kitaab malfuuf aakhar wa aktib foogah kulla l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-awwal al-harragah Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza.
Wa le Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza guul-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:Inta bas harragt al-kitaab da wa gult-:"Maala,ya Irmiya,inta katabt al-kalaam al-buguul kadar akiid malik Baabil yaji wa yakhrib al-balad di wa yikammil kulla naasha wa bahaayimha"-?--
Wa fi chaan da,daahu kalaami ana Allah al-bukhuss Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza.Ana gult-:--Ma fi waahid min zurriiytah yagood fi kursi al-muluk hana Dawuud.Wa wakit yumuut,yazgulu janaaztah barra wa tagood fi l-hamu tuul al-nahaar wa fi l-barid tuul al-leel.
Wa ana ni'aakhibhum fi khataahum,hu wa zurriiytah wa kubaaraatah.Wa nijiib fooghum humman wa fi sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi naas Yahuuza kulla l-fasaala al-ana kharrartaha didduhum,hatta kan humman ma saddago beeha kula.-
Wa khalaas,Irmiya chaal kitaab malfuuf aakhar wa antaah le Baruuk wileed Nariiya al-kaatib.Wa Baruuk katab foogah kulla l-kalaam al-gaalah leyah Irmiya.Wa da kulla l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-harragah Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza.Wa zaad battaan be kalaam aakhar katiir muchaabih.
Sidkhiiya wileed Yuuchiiya bigi malik fi badal Yuyakiin wileed Yahuuyakhim.Wa da Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil bas al-darrajah malik fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa la malik Sidkhiiya wa la kubaaraatah wa la cha'ab baladah ma yasma'o kalaam Allah al-hajjaah be waasitat al-nabi Irmiya.
Wa be da kula,al-malik Sidkhiiya rassal Yahuukal wileed Chalamya wa Safanya wileed Ma'asiiya raajil al-diin achaan yuguulu le l-nabi Irmiya-:-Min fadlak,as'al Allah Ilaahna fi chaanna-!
Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-nabi Irmiya lissaa' ma karabooh fi l-sijin.Hu gaa'id yamchi jaay wa jaay fi lubb al-cha'ab.
Wa wakit al-Baabiliyiin gaa'idiin yihaasuru Madiinat al-Khudus,sim'o kadar deech Fir'oon malik Masir marag min baladah wa jaayi.Wa khalaas,al-Baabiliyiin ba''ado min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le l-nabi Irmiya wa gaal-:
Hajji le l-murassaliin dool wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:Amchu le malik Yahuuza al-rassalaaku leyi le tas'alooni.Wa guulu leyah-:"Daahu deech Fir'oon al-marag le yafza'ku yigabbil fi baladah Masir.
Wa khalaas,al-Baabiliyiin yaju battaan yahjumu al-madiina di wa yichiiluuha wa yiharruguuha."
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:"Ma tukhuchchu nufuusku wa tuguulu al-Baabiliyiin macho ba'iid minku.Abadan humman ma yikhalluuku.
Hatta kan nasartu fi kulla deech al-Baabiliyiin al-gaa'idiin yihaarubuuku kula,kan faddalo minhum illa rujaal majruuhiin wa raagdiin fi khiyamhum kula,humman yugummu wa yiharrugu al-madiina di."-
Wa wakit deech al-Baabiliyiin ba''ad min Madiinat al-Khudus be sabab deech Fir'oon,
Irmiya dawwar yamrug min Madiinat al-Khudus le yamchi ard gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa hinaak yalga ard warasatah fi usut aayiltah.
Wa wakit hu ja fi baab al-madiina al-usmah Banyaamiin,hu ligi kabiir al-hurraas al-usmah Yiriya wileed Chalamya wileed Hananya gaa'id fi l-baab da.Wa Yiriya lazamah le l-nabi Irmiya wa gaal leyah-:-Tidoor tindamma le deech al-Baabiliyiin walla chunu-?
Wa Irmiya radda wa gaal-:-Misli ana namchi nindamma le deech al-Baabiliyiin-?Kalaamak da ma sahiih-! Wa laakin Yiriya ma simi' kalaamah.Karabah le Irmiya wa waddaah giddaam al-kubaaraat.
Wa l-kubaaraat zi'ilo za'al chadiid didd Irmiya wa gammo farachooh wa janzarooh fi beet Yuunataan al-kaatib achaan humman sawwo fi l-bakaan da sijin.
Wa misil da bas,le Irmiya karabooh wa dassooh fi l-suluulu wa foogah ga'ad mudda tawiile.
Wa l-malik Sidkhiiya rassal jaabooh le Irmiya fi gasrah le yas'alah be achiir.Wa sa'alah wa gaal leyah-:-Fiyah kalaam min Allah walla-? Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Aywa fi-!Wa l-kalaam da buguul,inta taga' fi iid malik Baabil.
Wa Irmiya gaal battaan le malik Sidkhiiya-:-Ana sawweet chunu leek inta wa kubaaraatak wa cha'abak achaan tidissuuni fi l-suluulu da-?
Wa ween anbiyaaku al-khachchooku wa gaalo-:--Malik Baabil ma yaji didduku walla didd al-balad di.--
Wa hassa',ya siidi al-malik,asma'-!Min fadlak,akhbal du'aayi-!Ma tigabbilni battaan fi beet Yuunataan al-kaatib.Akiid ana numuut foogah-!
Wa khalaas,al-malik Sidkhiiya anta amur yukhuttu Irmiya fi fadaayit al-hurraas wa kulla yoom yijiibu leyah khubza min chaari' al-khabbaaziin lahaddi kulla l-khubza hint al-madiina tikammil.Wa be misil da,Irmiya ga'ad fi fadaayit al-hurraas.
Wa yoom waahid,kubaaraat waahidiin sim'o al-kalaam al-gaa'id yuguulah Irmiya le kulla l-cha'ab wa humman Chafatya wileed Mattaan wa Gadaalya wileed Fachhuur wa Yahuukal wileed Chalamya wa Fachhuur wileed Malkiiya.Irmiya gaal le l-cha'ab-:
Daahu Allah gaal-:--Al-naadum al-yagood fi l-madiina di yumuut be l-harib wa be l-juu' wa be l-waba.Wa laakin al-yamrug minha wa yisallim nafsah le askar Baabil,hu da yi'iich wa yabga farhaan achaan hu ligi al-haya.--
Wa daahu Allah gaal battaan-:--Akiid al-madiina di taga' fi iid askar malik Baabil wa humman yichiiluuha.-
Wa l-kubaaraat dool gaalo le l-malik-:-Al-naadum da,waajib yumuut-!Achaan hu bas gaa'id yikhawwif al-askar al-faddalo fi l-madiina wa kulla l-cha'ab be kalaamah da.Hu ma yidoor al-kheer le l-cha'ab da wa laakin yidoor leehum al-fasaala.
Wa l-malik Sidkhiiya radda wa gaal-:-Daahu fi iidku wa sawwu foogah al-tidooruuh.Ana al-malik kula ma nagdar nadharku min cheyy.
Wa khalaas,humman chaalo Irmiya wa zagalooh fi nugra al-yakhzunu foogha almi.Wa l-nugra di hint Malkiiya min zurriiyit al-mamlaka wa gaa'ide fi fadaayit al-hurraas.Wa humman nazzalooh le Irmiya fi lubbaha be hubaal.Wa l-nugra di ma indaha almi illa l-tiine bas wa Irmiya dakhal fi lubb al-tiine di.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid Habachi usmah Abdalmalik wa hu mas'uul kabiir fi gasir al-malik.Wa simi' kadar Irmiya zagalooh fi l-nugra.Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-malik gaa'id fi baab al-madiina al-usmah Banyaamiin.
Wa Abdalmalik marag min al-gasir wa gaal le l-malik-:
Ya siidi al-malik-!Al-naas dool sawwo al-fasil le l-nabi Irmiya wakit zagalooh fi l-nugra.Wa fi l-nugra di akuun hu yumuut be l-juu' achaan hassa' fi l-madiina di kula,ma fi khubza.
Wa l-malik anta amur le Abdalmalik al-Habachi wa gaal-:-Chiil min hini 30 raajil wa amchi amrug al-nabi Irmiya min al-nugra di,gubbaal ma yumuut.
Wa Abdalmalik chaal al-rujaal dool wa macha le gasir al-malik fi khurfa tihit al-makhazan wa marag khulgaan gadiimiin wa mucharratiin.Wa nazzalaahum le Irmiya fi l-nugra be hubaal.
Wa Abdalmalik gaal le Irmiya-:-Min fadlak,chiil al-khulgaan al-gadiimiin dool wa khuttuhum fi ubutteek ambeenak wa been al-hubaal. Wa Irmiya sawwa misil Abdalmalik gaalah leyah.
Wa humman jabado Irmiya be l-hubaal wa maragooh min al-nugra.Wa be da,Irmiya ga'ad fi fadaayit al-hurraas.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Sidkhiiya rassal jaabah le l-nabi Irmiya wa khattaah jambah fi l-madkhal al-taalit fi beet Allah.Wa l-malik gaal le Irmiya-:-Ana nas'alak cheyy waahid wa ma tilabbid leyi cheyy-!
Wa Irmiya gaal leyah-:-Kan gult leek al-sahiih,inta taktulni wa kan anteetak wasiiye kula,ma tichiilha-!
Wa laakin al-malik Sidkhiiya halaf be achiir le Irmiya wa gaal-:-Ana nahlif be usum Allah al-Hayy al-khalagaana,ma naktulak wa la nisallimak le l-yidooru mootak.
Wa khalaas,Irmiya gaal le l-malik Sidkhiiya-:-Daahu Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Kan inta maragt le khuyyaad malik Baabil wa sallamt nafsak leehum,tinajji hayaatak wa l-madiina di kula ma yiharruguuha.Wa inta wa aayiltak ti'iichu be salaam.
Wa laakin kan inta ma maragt le khuyyaad malik Baabil wa sallamt nafsak leehum,khalaas al-madiina di,al-Baabiliyiin yichiiluuha wa yiharruguuha wa inta kula ma tanja minhum.-
Wa malik Sidkhiiya gaal le Irmiya-:-Ana khaayif min al-Yahuud al-andammo ma'a l-Baabiliyiin.Nakhaaf yisallumuuni leehum wa humman yi'azzubuuni.
Wa Irmiya radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-Baabiliyiin ma yisallumuuk leehum.Ya l-malik-!Asma' kulla kalaam Allah al-gaa'id nuguulah leek-!Wa be da,inta tukuun be kheer wa hayaatak kula tanja.
Wa laakin kan abeet ma tisallim nafsak le l-Baabiliyiin,daahu al-cheyy al-Allah wassafaani leyah.
Kulla l-awiin al-faddalan fi gasir malik Yahuuza yiwadduuhin le khuyyaad malik Baabil.Wa hinna yikhannan foogak wa yuguulan-:--Mustachaariinak al-aamantuhum khaanooklahaddi hazamookwa wakit rijileenak dakhalo fi l-tiine,khallook.--
Wa kulla awiinak wa iyaalak yakurbuuhum wa yiwadduuhum le l-Baabiliyiin.Wa inta zaatak ma tanja min malik Baabil.Hu yakurbak wa yiharrig al-madiina di.
Wa Sidkhiiya gaal le Irmiya-:-Kan inta ma tidoor tumuut da,khalli naadum ma yasma' al-kalaam al-gulna ma'aak.
Wa kan masaa'iili sim'o kadar ana naadeetak,akuun yaju wa yuguulu leek-:--Kallimna be l-kalaam al-gultah le l-malik wa l-kalaam al-malik gaalah leek.Ma tilabbid leena cheyy wa be da,aniina ma naktuluuk.--
Khalaas,inta guul leehum-:--Ana chahadt al-malik bas achaan ma yigabbilni battaan le beet Yuunataan achaan ana nakhaaf numuut hinaak.-
Wa ba'ad da,kulla masaa'iil Sidkhiiya jo le Irmiya wa sa'alooh wa hu radda leehum sawa sawa misil al-malik amarah beyah.Wa khalaas,humman sakato wa gabbalo achaan al-achiir da ma ligooh.
Wa Irmiya ga'ad fi fadaayit al-hurraas lahaddi yoom chaalo Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ba'ad da,Madiinat al-Khudus waga'at.
Wa fi l-chahar al-aachir fi l-sana al-taas'e hana hukum Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja be kulla askarah le Madiinat al-Khudus wa haasarha.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taasi' hana l-chahar al-raabi' fi sanit 11 hana hukum Sidkhiiya,gaddo khurma fi durdur al-madiina.
Wa khalaas,kulla khuyyaad malik Baabil jo wa ga'ado fi l-baab al-usut.Wa humman Nirgal Charaasar kabiir al-khuyyaad wa Samgar Nabu wa Sar Sakiim kabiir al-masaa'iil wa kulla masaa'iil malik Baabil al-aakhariin.
Wa min chaafo al-naas dool,Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa kulla askarah marago wa arrado min al-madiina be l-leel.Wa da be derib jineenit al-malik be l-baab al-gaa'id ambeen al-daraadir al-itneen hana l-difaa'.Wa humman marago be l-derib al-maachi ale waadi al-Urdun.
Wa laakin askar Baabil taradooh le Sidkhiiya wa lihgooh wa karabooh fi kadaadit Ariiha.Wa humman jaabooh fi hillit Ribla fi balad Hamaat giddaam Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Wa fi l-bakaan da,haakamah.
Wa malik Baabil dabah awlaad Sidkhiiya giddaamah fi Ribla wa battaan dabah kulla chuyuukh Yahuuza.
Wa ba'ad da,hu gaddad uyuun Sidkhiiya wa janzarah be jinziir hana nahaas matbuug le yiwaddiih fi Baabil.
Wa l-Baabiliyiin gammo harrago gasir al-malik wa buyuut al-cha'ab fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa ramo durdurha.
Wa l-cha'ab al-faddalo fi l-madiina wa l-naas al-andammo le malik Baabil wa l-naas al-aakhariin da,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas hana l-malik karabaahum wa waddaahum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.
Wa laakin cha'ab waahidiin masaakiin al-ma yamulku ard,Nabuuzaradaan antaahum izin achaan yifaddulu fi balad Yahuuza.Wa fi l-yoom da,hu gassam leehum jineenaat inab wa ziraa'a.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil anta amur le Nabuuzaradaan kabiir hurraasah fi chaan Irmiya wa gaal-:
Chiil Irmiya da ma'aak wa fakkir foogah adiil.Ma tisawwi leyah ayyi cheyy fasil wa sawwi leyah al-yidoorah.
Wa khalaas,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas wa Nabuuchazbaan kabiir al-masaa'iil wa Nirgal Charaasar kabiir al-khuyyaad wa kulla khuyyaad malik Baabil
rassalo jaabo Irmiya min fadaayit al-hurraas wa antooh le Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan.Wa misil da,Gadaalya khalla Irmiya macha beetah wa ga'ad fi ust al-cha'ab.
Wa wakit Irmiya lissaa' makruub fi fadaayit al-hurraas,Allah hajja leyah wa gaal-:
Gumm wa amchi le Abdalmalik al-Habachi wa guul leyah-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Akiid ana nihaggig al-kalaam al-gultah didd al-madiina di wa da le l-charr ma le l-kheer.Wa l-yoom da,inta kula tichiifah.
Wa laakin fi l-yoom da,ana ninajjiik wa inta ma yisallumuuk le l-naas al-inta takhaaf minhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa akiid ana ninajjiik.Inta ma tumuut fi l-harib wa ti'iich wa tabga farhaan achaan ligiit al-haya wa da be sabab inta atwakkalt aleyi."-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Irmiya anlaga mujanzar be janaaziir fi ust al-masaajiin hana Madiinat al-Khudus wa Yahuuza al-yidooru yiwadduuhum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.Wa laakin Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas maragah min ust al-masaajiin wa khallaah yamchi min al-Raama.Wa ba'ad da,Allah hajja le Irmiya.
Wa gabul ma yufuut min al-Raama,Nabuuzaradaan gaal leyah-:-Allah Ilaahak bas kharrar al-fasaala di didd al-bakaan da.
Wa hassa',Allah haggag kalaamah al-gaalah achaan intu Bani Israa'iil aznabtu wa gammeetu didd Allah wa ma simi'tu kalaamah.Wa fi chaan da bas,kulla l-cheyy da bigi.
Wa hassa',daahu ana fakkeet minnak al-janaaziir wa khalleetak.Kan inta tidoor tamchi ma'aayi fi Baabil,ta'aal ana nichiil mas'uuliiytak.Wa kan ma tidoor tamchi ma'aayi fi Baabil,khalaas amchi fi ayyi bakaan al-tidoorah wa l-ya'ajibak fi l-balad di.
Wa gabul Irmiya ma yurudd le Nabuuzaradaan,gaal leyah battaan-:-Gabbil amchi le Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan hu al-haakim al-khattaah malik Baabil fi hillaal balad Yahuuza.Agood fi ust al-cha'ab aw amchi fi ayyi bakaan al-ya'ajibak. Wa Nabuuzaradaan antaah zaad wa hadiiye wa khallaah macha.
Wa be misil da,Irmiya macha le Gadaalya fi Misfa wa ga'ad hinaak fi ust al-cha'ab al-faddalo fi l-balad.
Wa fiyah rujaal waahidiin musallahiin min Bani Yahuuza gaa'idiin fi l-kadaade.Wa l-rujaal dool wa kubaaraathum sim'o kadar malik Baabil khatta Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam haakim fi balad Yahuuza.Wa l-malik ammanah al-rujaal wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal wa l-masaakiin al-ma karaboohum wa waddoohum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.
Wa l-rujaal al-musallahiin wa kubaaraathum dool jo le Gadaalya fi Misfa.Wa kubaaraathum hummanIsmaa'iil wileed Natanyawa Yuuhanaan wa Yuunataan awlaad Gaarihwa Saraaya wileed Tanhuumatwa iyaal Ifaay min hillit Natuufawa Yazanya min hillit Ma'aaka.
Wa Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan hajja le l-kubaaraat dool wa naashum wa gaal-:-Ma takhaafo min sultit al-Baabiliyiin.Agoodu fi l-balad wa akhdumu tihit sultit malik Baabil wa akiid da yabga leeku adiil.
Wa ana nagood hini fi Misfa wa nimassilku giddaam al-Baabiliyiin al-yaju leena.Wa intu kamaan takhdumu wa tagta'o al-inab wa l-fawaakih wa ti'assuru dihin al-zaytuun wa tudummuuh fi l-makhaazin.Wa taskunu fi l-hillaal al-intu chiltuuhum fi wakt al-harib.
Wa kulla Bani Yahuuza al-arrado wa macho fi Muwaab wa fi usut Bani Ammuun wa fi Adoom wa fi buldaan aakhariin sim'o kadar malik Baabil khalla waahidiin min Bani Yahuuza faddalo fi l-balad.Wa khatta fooghum Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan haakim.
Wa be da,khalaas al-naas al-arrado gabbalo min al-bakaanaat al-muchattatiin fooghum.Wa jo fi balad Yahuuza fi Misfa le Gadaalya.Wa humman gata'o al-inab wa l-fawaakih be katara.
Wa yoom waahid,jo le Gadaalya fi Misfa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin al-gaa'idiin fi l-kadaade.
Wa gaalo leyah-:-Inta ma indak khabar kadar Ba'aliis malik Bani Ammuun kallaf Ismaa'iil wileed Natanya le yaktulak walla-? Wa laakin Gadaalya aba ma saddag kalaamhum.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih macha battaan be achiir le Gadaalya fi Misfa.Wa gaal leyah-:-Antiini izin namchi naktul Ismaa'iil wileed Natanya wa naadum yasma' beyah ke ma fiih.Walla inta tidoor hu yaktulak-?Wa kan katalak,kulla Bani Yahuuza al-taab'iinak yichittu wa l-faddalo minhum yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam radda le Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa gaal-:-Ma tisawwi misil da-!Al-inta gaa'id tuguulah fi Ismaa'iil,da kidib ma sahiih.
Wa laakin fi l-chahar al-saabi',Ismaa'iil wileed Natanya wileed Alichama' ja le Gadaalya fi Misfa.Wa Ismaa'iil da hu min zurriiyit al-mamlaka wa waahid min kubaaraat al-malik.Hu ja ma'a achara rujaal wa akalo ma'a Gadaalya.
Wa ba'ad da,Ismaa'iil wa l-rujaal al-achara al-ma'aayah gammo darabo Gadaalya be l-seef wa katalooh.Wa misil da,humman katalo al-naadum al-malik Baabil khattaah haakim fi l-balad.
Wa Ismaa'iil katal battaan kulla l-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin ma'a Gadaalya fi Misfa wa askar Baabil al-gaa'idiin hinaak.
Wa lahaddi l-yoom al-taani ba'ad moot Gadaalya kula,ma fi naadum simi' cheyy.
Wa fi l-wakit da,jo rujaal waahidiin adadhum 80.Wa l-naas dool,duguunhum muzayyaniin wa khulgaanhum mucharratiin wa jisimhum munakhkhach min al-hizin.Wa humman min mudun Chakiim wa Chiilooh wa l-Saamira wa chaayliin fi iideehum hadaaya hana dagiig wa bakhuur le yigaddumuuh fi beet Allah.
Wa Ismaa'iil marag min Misfa le yilaagiihum,maachi wa gaa'id yabki.Wakit wassalaahum gaal leehum-:-Alfaddalo bakaan Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam.
Wa wakit dakhalo fi l-madiina,Ismaa'iil wa l-naas al-ma'aayah gammo karaboohum wa dabahoohum wa zagaloohum fi nugra.
Wa laakin fi ust al-rujaal dool fi achara minhum gaalo le Ismaa'iil-:-Ma taktulna achaan aniina labbadna ma'aach katiir fi l-kadaade,gameh ahmar wa gameh abyad wa dihin wa asal. Wa khalaas,hu ma katalaahum ma'a akhwaanhum.
Wa l-nugra al-Ismaa'iil daffag foogah al-jisas hana l-naas al-katalaahum fi bakaan Gadaalya,hi al-nugra al-zamaan nakatha Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza wakit hu gaa'id yidaafi' le baladah didd Ba'aacha malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa l-nugra di,Ismaa'iil malaaha be jisas al-naas al-hu katalaahum.
Wa ba'ad da,Ismaa'iil karab kulla l-cha'ab al-faddalo fi Misfa masaajiin wa humman banaat al-malik wa kulla l-naas al-faddalo fi Misfa.Wa dool al-naas al-Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas ammanaahum le Gadaalya.Wa Ismaa'iil karabaahum masaajiin wa macha beehum ale balad Bani Ammuun.
Wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin al-ma'aayah sim'o be kulla l-fasaala al-sawwaaha Ismaa'iil wileed Natanya.
Humman chaalo kulla rujaalhum wa macho yahjumu Ismaa'iil wa lihgooh fi l-machiiche al-kabiire hint Gib'uun.
Wa wakit kulla l-cha'ab al-karabaahum Ismaa'iil chaafo Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin al-ma'aayah,humman firho.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-cha'ab al-Ismaa'iil karabaahum fi Misfa gabbalo wa jo lammo ma'a Yuuhanaan.
Wa laakin Ismaa'iil wa l-tamaane naas al-ma'aayah nijo min Yuuhanaan wa macho le Bani Ammuun.
Wa Yuuhanaan wa kulla kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin al-ma'aayah chaalo al-cha'ab al-faddalo al-Ismaa'iil karabaahum fi Misfa ba'ad katal Gadaalya.Wa l-cha'ab al-gabbaloohum min Gib'uun,humman askar wa awiin wa iyaal wa masaa'iil gasir al-malik.
Humman macho lahaddi beet al-diifaan al-fi Kimhaam gariib le Beet Laham.Wa min hinaak,yidooru yamchu le Masir
achaan yakhaafo min al-Baabiliyiin be sabab Ismaa'iil katal Gadaalya haakim al-balad al-khattaah malik Baabil.
Wa ba'ad da,kulla kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa Yazanya wileed Huchaa'ya wa kulla l-cha'ab min al-da'iif lahaddi l-gaadir jo
le l-nabi Irmiya.Wa gaalo-:-Min fadlak,chahadnaak wa akhbal du'aana.As'al Allah Ilaahak fi chaanna aniina al-faddalna achaan nagasna bigiina chiyya misil inta gaa'id tichiifah.
Wa khalli Allah Ilaahak yiwassif leena al-bakaan al-namchu leyah wa l-cheyy al-nisawwuuh.
Wa Irmiya gaal leehum-:-Tamaam-!Hassa' da,nas'al Allah Ilaahku hasab intu gultuuh.Wa nihajjiiku be kulla l-kalaam al-yuruddah leeku Allah Ilaahku.Wa kalaamah da ma nilabbid minnah kilme waahide kula.
Wa humman gaalo le Irmiya-:-Kulla cheyy al-gaalah Allah Ilaahak,guulah leena wa aniina nitabbuguuh.Khalli Allah yukuun leena chaahid saadikh wa amiin.
Al-kalaam da kan kheer aw charr kula aniina nitaabu'uuh achaan da kalaam Allah Ilaahna al-aniina kallafnaak tamchi tas'alah.Wa wakit nasma'o kalaam Allah Ilaahna,da yabga leena adiil.
Wa ba'ad achara yoom,Allah hajja le Irmiya.
Wa khalaas,Irmiya naada Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin al-ma'aayah wa kulla l-cha'ab min al-da'iif lahaddi l-gaadir.
Wa Irmiya gaal leehum-:-Intu kallaftuuni le namchi giddaam Allah wa nachhadah.Wa daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:
--Kan battaan taskunu fi l-balad di,ana nabniiku wa ma nakhribku wa nisabbitku foogha wa ma namrugku minha.Achaan ana hizint le l-fasaala al-sawweetha foogku.
Ma takhaafo min malik Baabil al-intu khaayfiin minnah.Ma takhaafo minnah abadan achaan ana gaa'id ma'aaku,nahmiiku wa ninajjiiku min iidah.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana ninazzil foogku al-rahma wa fi chaan rahmati di,al-malik kula yikhalliiku tagoodu fi baladku.-
Wa Irmiya gaal battaan-:-Akuun tuguulu-:--Aniina ma naskunu fi l-balad di-!- Wa misil da,intu ma gaa'idiin tasma'o kalaam Allah Ilaahku.
Wa akuun tuguulu-:--La-!Aniina namchu Masir wa hinaak wa la nichiifu harib wa la nasma'o hiss burunji wa la yigassir leena akil.Wa da bas al-bakaan al-aniina naskunu foogah.--
Ya intu al-faddaltu min Bani Yahuuza,asma'o kalaam Allah-!Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Kan wajjahtu ale Masir le tamchu taskunu foogha,
khalaas al-harib al-khuftu minnah yalhagku hinaak wa l-juu' al-hammeetu minnah yawsalku hinaak wa fi Masir bas tumuutu.
Kulla l-naas al-wajjaho ale Masir le yamchu yaskunu foogha da yumuutu be l-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba.Wa waahid minhum kula ma yifaddil hayy min al-fasaala al-ninazzilha fooghum.--
Achaan daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Misil ana nazzalt khadabi wa za'ali fi sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus,daahu ana ninazzil khadabi foogku intu kula wakit tadkhulu fi balad Masir.Wa intu tabgo mal'uuniin wa mukhiifiin wa naas yal'anooku wa yi'ayyubuuku wa battaan baladku ma tichiifuuha.-
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Ya l-faddaltu min Bani Yahuuza-!Daahu Allah gaal leeku-:--Ma tamchu balad Masir.- Wa a'arfu tamaam kadar al-yoom,ana Irmiya bas chaahid foogku.
Wa daahu intu bas waddartu nufuusku wakit kallaftuuni namchi le Allah Ilaahku wa gultu-:--As'al leena Allah Ilaahna.Wa kulla cheyy al-gaalah Allah Ilaahna,guulah leena wa aniina nitabbuguuh.--
Wa daahu al-yoom,ana gult al-kalaam al-hu raddah leeku.Wa laakin intu ma simi'tu kalaam Allah Ilaahku wa la kulla l-kalaam al-kallafaani le nuguulah leeku.
Wa be sabab da,a'arfu tamaam kadar intu tumuutu be l-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba fi l-bakaan al-intu dawwartu tamchu taskunu foogah.
Wa Irmiya kammal min kalaamah le kulla l-cha'ab wa da kulla kalaam Allah Ilaahhum al-kallafah le yuguulah leehum.
Wa Azarya wileed Huchaa'ya wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla l-rujaal al-mustakbiriin dool gaalo le Irmiya-:-Kalaamak da kidib-!Ma sahiih.Wa Allah Ilaahna kula ma kallafaak le tuguul leena ma namchu Masir le naskunu hinaak.
Wa laakin da Baruuk wileed Nariiya bas gaa'id yiharrichak le tisawwi leena al-fasaala wa tisallimna le l-Baabiliyiin.Wa humman yaktuluuna aw yiwadduuna fi l-khurba fi Baabil.
Wa khalaas,Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin wa kulla l-cha'ab ma sim'o amur Allah al-gaal yaskunu fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al-rujaal al-musallahiin chaalo kulla l-faddalo min Bani Yahuuza al-gabbalo min al-buldaan al-humman muchattatiin fooghum wa saakniin fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa chaalo battaan al-rujaal wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal wa banaat al-malik wa kulla l-naas al-Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas ammanaahum le Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan.Wa chaalo ma'aahum battaan al-nabi Irmiya wa Baruuk wileed Nariiya.
Al-naas dool macho le hillit Tahfaniis fi Masir achaan humman ma sim'o kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Irmiya fi hillit Tahfaniis wa gaal-:
Amchi chiil hujaar itneen kubaar wa adfinhum fi l-fadaay giddaam madkhal gasir Fir'oon fi Tahfaniis.Wa l-hujaar dool adfinhum giddaam Bani Yahuuza.
Wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:"Ana nirassil nijiib abdi Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa nukhutt kursiih hana l-muluk fi l-hujaar al-mulabbadiin dool.Wa hu yukhutt dallaaltah fi l-bakaan da.
Wa hu yaji yihaarib balad Masir.Wa l-waajib leyah al-moot,yaktuluuh wa l-waajib leyah al-ubuudiiye,yi'abbuduuh wa l-waajib leyah daribiin al-seef,yadurbuuh.
Wa ana nahrig buyuut al-ilaahaat fi Masir be iid Nabuukhadnasar wa hu yahrig al-asnaam aw yiwaddiihum masaajiin.Wa hu yanhab balad Masir wa yilaggit khumaamha misil al-raa'i yilaggit al-gamul min khalagah.Wa ba'ad da,yamrug minha be l-salaam.
Hu yarmi al-amad al-khazzoohum fi beet ibaadat al-harraay fi Masir wa yahrig buyuut ilaahaat Masir."-
Allah hajja le Irmiya kalaam bukhuss Bani Yahuuza al-saakniin fi Migduul wa Tahfaniis wa Mamfiis wa fi junuub Masir.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Intu chiftu kulla l-fasaala al-jibtaha fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza.Lahaddi l-yoom,al-mudun dool kharbaaniin wa ma induhum sukkaan.
Wa da be sabab al-fasaala al-humman sawwooha.Khaddabooni wakit harrago bakhuur wa abado ilaahaat aakhariin al-awwal ma ya'arfuuhum wa la humman wa la intu wa la juduudku.
Ana rassalt leehum daayman abiidi al-anbiya wa be waasitat al-anbiya dool ana gult leehum-:--Ma tisawwu al-haraam da achaan ana nakrahah.--
Wa laakin humman ma khatto adaanhum wa ma sim'ooni wa ma taabo min al-fasaala al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuha.Wa ma waggafo harrigiin al-bakhuur le l-ilaahaat al-aakhariin.
Wa be sabab da bas,khadabi wa za'ali gammo didduhum wa harrago hillaal balad Yahuuza wa chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa bigo koom hana turaab wa bakaan kharaab lahaddi l-yoom.
Daahu Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Maala tisawwu le nufuusku fasaala kabiire misil di-?Wa maala tidooru tidammuru al-rujaal wa l-awiin wa l-iyaal wa l-atfaal-?Wa be misil da,waahid kula min Bani Yahuuza ma yifaddil leeku.
Wa khaddabtuuni be khidmit iideeku wakit harragtu bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin fi balad Masir al-intu jiitu wa sakantu foogha.Wa be da,dammartu nufuusku wa bigiitu mal'uuniin wa aaybiin fi ust kulla umam al-ard.
Wa intu nisiitu al-fasaala al-sawwooha juduudku wa muluuk Yahuuza wa awiinhum-?Wa nisiitu fasaalitku intu wa awiinku al-sawweetuuha fi balad Yahuuza wa fi chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus-?
Wa lahaddi l-yoom intu ma tubtu wa la khuftu minni wa la tabbagtu churuuti al-fi l-Tawraat wa la gawaaniini al-ana anteethum leeku wa le juduudku.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Akiid ana kharrart nisawwi leeku al-fasaala wa nidammir kulla Bani Yahuuza.
Wa nichiil al-faddalo min Bani Yahuuza,humman al-wajjaho ale balad Masir wa macho le yaskunu foogha.Humman dool kulluhum ana nikammilhum fi Masir.Yumuutu be l-harib wa l-juu' wa yikammulu tak min al-da'iif lahaddi l-gaadir.Wa yabgo mal'uuniin wa mukhiifiin wa l-naas yal'anoohum wa yi'ayyubuuhum.
Ana ni'aakhib al-naas al-yaskunu fi Masir misil aakhabt sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus be l-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba.
Wa l-faddalo min Bani Yahuuza,naadum waahid kula minhum ma yifaddil hayy.Wa dool al-naas al-macho sakano fi balad Masir wa induhum niiye le yigabbulu fi balad Yahuuza.Wa laakin ma yigabbulu leeha illa waahidiin minhum al-arrado.
Wa kulla l-cha'ab al-yaskunu fi junuub Masir lammo wa fiihum awiin katiiraat wa rujaal al-ya'arfu kadar awiinhum gaa'idaat yiharrigan bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa l-naas dool gaalo le Irmiya-:
Aniina ma nidooru nasma'o al-kalaam al-inta gaa'id tuguulah leena be usum Allah.
Wa akiid aniina nitabbugu kulla l-kalaam al-marag min khachumna.Wa niharrugu bakhuur wa nigaddumu hadiiyat charaab le ilaahna malikat al-sama misil awwal aniina sawweenaah,aniina wa juduudna wa muluukna wa kubaaraatna fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa fi chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa khalaas fi l-wakit daak,aniina chibi'na wa ichna fi l-raaha wa abadan ma chifna ta'ab.
Wa laakin min waggafna harrigiin al-bakhuur wa gaddimiin hadiiyat al-charaab le malikat al-sama,khalaas kulla cheyy bigi ma fiih wa aniina mutna min al-harib wa l-juu'.
Wa l-awiin gaalan-:-Wakit aniina niharrugu bakhuur wa nigaddumu hadiiyat charaab le malikat al-sama,da ma be izin rujaalna walla-?Wa ma be izin rujaalna gaa'idiin nisawwu ka'ak fi suuritha wa nigaddumu leeha hadiiyat charaab walla-?
Wa khalaas,Irmiya hajja le kulla l-cha'ab,awiin wa rujaal,al-raddo leyah be l-kalaam da wa gaal-:
Al-bakhuur al-awwal intu harragtuuh fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa fi chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus,intu wa juduudku wa muluukku wa kubaaraatku wa cha'ab al-balad,tahsubu Allah ma chaafah wa ma fakkar foogah walla-?
Allah aba ma yahmalah battaan be sabab amalku al-fasil wa l-muharramaat al-sawweetuuhum.Wa fi chaan da,baladku bigat koom hana turaab wa kharaab wa mal'uun wa faadiye min sukkaanha lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa intu harragtu bakhuur wa aznabtu.Wa ma simi'tu kalaam Allah wa la tabbagtu churuutah al-fi l-Tawraat wa la gawaaniinah wa la wasiiyaatah.Wa fi chaan da bas,al-fasaala di jaat misil intu gaa'idiin tichiifuuha al-yoom.
Wa battaan Irmiya gaal le kulla l-cha'ab wa le kulla l-awiin-:-Intu kulluku Bani Yahuuza al-gaa'idiin fi Masir,asma'o kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:--Intu wa awiinku sawweetu be iideeku kulla l-kalaam al-gultuuh be khachumku.Wa daahu al-kalaam al-gultuuh-:"Aniina nihaggugu nazirna al-aahadna beyah wa niharrugu bakhuur wa nigaddumu hadiiyat charaab le malikat al-sama."Khalaas,timmu kalaamku wa haggugu nazirku-!-
Wa Irmiya gaal-:-Hassa' da,intu kulluku,ya Bani Yahuuza al-gaa'idiin fi balad Masir,asma'o kalaam Allah-!Allah gaal-:--Nahlif be usmi al-aziim kadar battaan fi Masir naadum min Bani Yahuuza abadan ma yahlif be usmi ana Allah al-Rabb al-Hayy.
Daahu ana niraakhibhum ma le kheerhum wa laakin le charruhum.Kulla naas Bani Yahuuza al-gaa'idiin fi Masir,ana nijiib fooghum al-harib wa l-juu' lahaddi nikammilhum.
Wa naas chiyya bas yi'arrudu min Masir fi chaan al-harib wa yamchu le balad Yahuuza.Wa laakin kulla l-faddalo min Bani Yahuuza al-jo fi Masir le yaskunu foogha yichiifu wa ya'arfu al-kalaam al-yilhaggag,da hanaayi ana walla hanaahum humman.--
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:--Ana ni'aakhibku fi l-bakaan da wa nantiiku alaama wa be da,akiid ta'arfu kadar kalaami yilhaggag foogku wa tat'abo.Wa di hi al-alaama al-nantiiha leeku.--
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:--Ana nisallim Fir'oon Hufra' malik Masir le udwaanah al-yidooru mootah misil sallamt Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil aduuh al-dawwar mootah.-
Wa fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,Baruuk wileed Nariiya katab fi l-kitaab al-malfuuf al-kalaam al-gaalah leyah al-nabi Irmiya.Wa Irmiya hajja leyah wa gaal-:
Ya Baruuk-!Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal foogak-:
--Inta gult-:"Ya khasaarti-!Allah zaad leyi hizin fi ta'abi.Iyiit min al-ganitiin wa ma ligiit raaha."--
Daahu kalaam Allah al-hajjaah leyi le nuguulah leek.Hu gaal-:--Ana nakhrib al-baneetahwa namrug al-sabbattah.Wa da nisawwiihfi kulla l-ard.
Wa inta illa tifattich le nafsak faayde kabiire bas-!Khalaas,battaan ma tifattich-!Achaan daahu ana nijiib al-fasaalafi kulla makhluug hayy.Wa laakin leek inta,nantiik hayaatakwa tafrah beehafi ayyi bakaan al-tamchi.--Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah hajja le l-nabi Irmiya kalaam bukhuss al-umam.
Wa fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,al-deech da gaa'id fi Karkamiich fi bahar al-Furaat wa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil haarabah wa annasar foogah.Wa da kalaam Allah al-bukhuss Masir wa deech Fir'oon Naku malik Masir.Hu gaal-:
Jahhuzu al-darag kubaar wa dugaagwa yalla le l-harib-!
Chiddu al-kheel-!Wa arkabo,ya l-furraas-!Wa dissu tawaagiiku hana l-haribwa jahhuzu huraabkuwa albaso duruu'ku.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Maala ana chiftuhum yarjufu-?Humman gabbalo wara wa furraashum anhazamo.Humman arrado,arrado bala gabbiliinwa l-khoof jaahum min kulla bakaan.
Al-ajiil ma yinajji nafsahwa l-faaris kula ma yanja.Wa fi l-munchaakh fi khachum bahar al-Furaat,humman yittarta'o wa yaga'o.
Wa yaatu al-yatla' misil al-Niil-?Wa yaatu al-yatra' misil al-buhuur-?
Di Masir tatla' misil al-Niilwa tatra' misil al-buhuur.Hi tuguul-:-Ana natla' wa nikhatti al-ardwa nidammir mudun be sukkaanhum.
Gummu wa ajru,ya l-kheel-!Ya siyaad arabaat al-harib,suugu misil majaaniin-!Amurgu,ya furraas al-Habacha wa Liibiya al-chaayliin al-daragwa furraas Luud al-ya'arfu al-nubbaal.
Wa laakin al-yoom,da yoom Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadirwa da yoom kaffiin al-taar,yoom yichiil al-taar fi udwaanah.Wa fi l-yoom da,al-seef yaakul wa yachba' lahamwa yachrab wa yarwa damm.Achaan da dahiiye le Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadirfi balad al-munchaakh ale bahar al-Furaat.
Ya Masir al-misil bineeye udriiye-!Yalla gummi amchi le turaab Gil'aadwa fattichi dawa al-tamsahe.Wa kan tichiili dawa misil chunu kulama fi dawa al-yidaawiiki.
Wa l-umam yasma'o be chamaatitkiwa siraakhki yamla al-ard.Achaan askarki al-waahid yittarta' fi l-aakharwa yaga'o humman al-itneen sawa.
Wa wakit Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja yihaarib balad Masir,daahu kalaam Allah al-gaalah le l-nabi Irmiya-:
Khabburu balad Masirwa khalli hillaalha yasma'owa humman Migduul wa Mamfiis wa Tahfaniis.Wa guulu leehum-:--Gummu wa jahhuzu nufuuskuachaan al-seef gaa'id yaktul hawaaleeku-!
Maala ilaahki waga',ya Masir-?Maala ilaahki hana l-toor ma gidir yasbit-?Wa da,achaan Allah ramaah.
Wa Allah tarta' katiir minhum wa waga'owa l-murtazakha gaalo ambeenaathum-:"Yalla nugummu wa nigabbulu le ahalnawa namchu le baladna al-wildoona fooghawa ni'arrudu ba'iid min seef al-adu."
Wa yinaadu Fir'oon malik Masirbe usum jadiidwa l-usum da Haraka Kabiire Saakitwa Khalla al-Fursa Faatat.-
Wa daahu kalaam al-malik wa hu Allah al-Gaadir-:-Ana nahlif be usmi al-Hayy-!Al-adu jaayi.Hu tawiil misil jabal Taabuur fi ust al-jibaalwa kabiir misil jabal al-Karmal fi khachum al-bahar.
Ya sukkaan Masir al-misil bineeye,tabbugu khumaamku le yiwadduuku fi l-khurba.Achaan hillit Mamfiis takhrabwa kharaabha yikhawwifwa tabga faadiye min sukkaanha.
Wa Masir hi misil al-ijle al-samhewa l-adu yajiiha min munchaakhmisil dubbaan amboojani.
Wa murtazakhatha gaa'idiin fi usuthamisil al-ajjaal al-sumaan.Wa laakin be sumunhum da kula,yi'arrudu ma yasbutu.Achaan yoom al-kharaab ja leehumwa wakit ikhaabhum waga' fooghum.
Wa Masir tisaffirmisil al-daabi al-mu'arridachaan al-adu jaayi diddahabe deech kabiir.Wa jaayi foogha be faasmisil gattaa'iin al-chadar.
Wa udwaanha yagta'o khaabithahatta kan hi dalma kula.Achaan humman katiiriin min saar al-leelwa abadan ma yinhasbu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Masir al-misil bineeye yi'ayyubuuhawa yisallumuuha le cha'ab al-munchaakh.
Wa Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Akiid ana ni'aakhib Ammuun ilaah Tiiba.Wa ni'aakhib Masir wa ilaahaatha wa muluukha.Wa ni'aakhib Fir'oon wa l-yitwakkalo aleyah.
Ana nisallimhum le l-yidooru moothum,le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa askarah.Wa laakin ba'adeen yaji wakit al-foogah Masir yaskunuuha misil zamaan. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa intu,ya zurriiyit abdi Yaakhuub,ma takhaafo-!Wa ya Bani Israa'iil,ma tinbahtu-!Akiid ana ninajjiiku min al-balad al-ba'iidewa nijiib zurriiyitku min balad al-khurba.Wa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yajuwa yagoodu fi baladhum be raaha wa amaanwa akiid ma fi naadum yibachtinhum.
Wa intu,ya zurriiyit abdi Yaakhuub,ma takhaafoachaan ana daayman nukuun ma'aaku.Wa ana nidammir marra waahid kulla l-umamal-ana chattattuku fi lubbuhum.Wa laakin intu,ma nidammirku marra waahid.Akiid ma naj'alku bariyiinwa laakin ni'addibku be miiz.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah hajja le l-nabi Irmiya kalaam bukhuss al-Filistiyiin wa da gabul Fir'oon ma yahjim madiinat Khazza.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Chiifu,fi almi yugumm min munchaakhwa l-almi da yabga misil waadi al-yisiil.Wa l-seel yaakul al-baladwa kulla cheyy al-fiihawa l-mudun wa sukkaanhum.Wa l-naas yikoorukuwa kulla sukkaan al-balad yasrakho.
Wa min yasma'o chiddit harakat rijle al-kheelwa harakat arabaathum hana harib wa ajalaathum,al-abbahaat yi'arrudu yikhallu iyaalhumwa da min chiddit al-khoof.
Yoom kharaab kulla l-Filistiyiin jawa da le yidammir ayyi naadumal-yafza' mudun Suur wa Seeda.Achaan ana Allah nidammir kulla l-Filistiyiin,humman al-faddalo min jaziirat Kaftuur.
Naas mudun Khazza zayyano ruuseehum min al-hizinwa sukkaan Achgaluun kula sakato.Wa intu al-faddaltu fi l-sahale,le mata tahzano wa tijarruhu jisimku-?
Intu tuguulu-:--Ya khasaaritna-!Ya seef Allah-!Lahaddi mata taktul ma tinjamma-?Adkhul fi beetakwa anjamma ma taktul-!--
Kikkeef al-seef da yinjammakan ana Allah bas amartahle yamchi didd sukkaan Achgaluunwa le yaktul sukkaan khachum al-bahar-?
Kalaam bukhuss Muwaab.Daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Ya khasaarit hillit Nabuachaan hi addammarat-!Wa hillit Khiryataayim aaybe wa makruubawa l-hille al-gawiiye kula aaybe wa mubarjala.
Wa Muwaab battaan ma tukuun balad ma'ruufawa didd madiinat Hachbuun,khattato al-fasaala.Wa gaalo-:--Yalla namchu-!Nuguchchuuha min ust al-umam.--Wa inti kula,ya hillit Madmiin,yisakkutuukiwa l-seef yajri waraaki.
Wa fi hillit Hurunaayim,hiss yasrakh wa yuguul-:--Damaarwa kharaab kabiir marra waahid-!--
Muwaab tilkassarwa iyaalha korooraakhum yinsami'.
Achaan be baki,al-iyaal yatla'owa fi taluu' Luhiit yabku.Wa wakit yanzulu le hillit Hurunaayim,humman yasrakho min al-damaarwa yuguulu-:
--Arrudu wa najju nufuuskuwa abgo misil humaar al-kadaade-!--
Ya Muwaab-!Inti atwakkaltifi a'maalki wa fi khunaakiwa fi chaan da,inti kula tinkarbi.Wa sanamki Kamuuch yiwadduuh fi l-khurbama'a rujaal al-diin hineeyah wa khaddaamiinah.
Al-mudammir yadkhul fi kulli hille,ma fi hille tanja minnah.Al-waadi yiddammar wa l-sahale takhrabachaan ana Allah bas gultah.
Antuuha le Muwaab janaahele titiir wa tiba''id.Achaan mudunha yakhrabowa yabgo faadiyiin min sukkaanhum.
Mal'uun al-yisawwi amal Allah be kasalwa mal'uun al-yamna' seefah min al-damm.
Muwaab gaa'ide fi l-raaha min subaahamisil al-khamar al-gaa'id fi rindiihwa ma sabbooh fi maa'uun aakhar.Hi ma waddooha fi l-khurba.Hi misil al-khamar al-ta'amah ma waddarwa riihtah ma albaddalat.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Misil da,yaji yoom waahid al-foogah ana nirassil naas yusubbuuh fi girab aakhariin wa yifaddu girabbah wa yicharrutuuhum.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,Muwaab takhjal min sanamha Kamuuch misil Bani Israa'iil khijlo min sanamhum al-fi Beet Iil al-awwal humman aamano beyah.
Ya naas Muwaab,kikkeef tagdaro tuguulu-:--Aniina rujaal fahaliinwa furraas hana harib-?--
Muwaab takhrab wa hillaalha yahragowa chabaabha al-adiiliin yaktuluuhum.Wa da kalaam al-malik wa hu Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa kharaab Muwaab garrab yajiwa fasaalitha jaaye be sur'a.
Wa intu kulluku al-muhawwigiin Muwaab,abku leeha.Intu kulluku al-ta'arfuuha,as'alo wa guulu-:--Da kikkeef-!Asaat gudritha anchaggatwa asaat majdaha alkassarat-?--
Ya sukkaan hillit Diibuunal-misil bineeye-!Anzulu min charafkuwa duukhu al-atach.Achaan mudammir Muwaab yahjimku intu kulawa yidammir bakaanaatku al-gawiyiin.
Wa ya sukkaan hillit Aruu'ir-!Agiifu fi l-tariig wa raakhubu.Wa as'alo al-jaariyiin wa l-mu'arridiinwa guulu-:--Chunu al-hasal-?--
Wa yuruddu wa yuguulu-:--Muwaab addammarat wa ligat al-eeb.--Asrakho wa kooruku wa khabburu waadi Arnuunkadar Muwaab khalaas addammarat.
Al-muhaakama jaat fi balad al-sahale wa jaat fi hillaal Huluun wa Yahaas wa Mifa'at
wa fi Diibuun wa Nabu wa Beet Diblataayim
wa fi Khiryataayim wa Beet Gamuul wa Beet Maa'oon
wa fi Kharyuut wa Busra wa fi kulla hillaal balad Muwaab al-gariibiin wa l-ba'iidiin.
Wa garin Muwaab waga'wa gudritha waddarat.Wa duraa'ha ankasarwa kalaamha kammal.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Sakkuru Muwaab lahaddi tilmarmakh fi gadiifha wa tabga madhaka achaan hi sawwat nafisha aaliye min Allah.
Wa inti,ya Muwaab,ma dihikti le Bani Israa'iil walla-?Hal ligiiti Bani Israa'iil ma'a l-saraariig walla-?Wa kan la-!Maala kulla wakit tihajji beehum wa tihizzi raaski-?
Ya sukkaan Muwaab-!Amurgu min al-mudunwa askunu fi l-jibaal.Abgo misil al-hamaamaal-tisawwi uchchaha fi khachum al-karkuur.
Aniina simi'na be istikbaar Muwaab,balad mustakbire misilha ke ma fi.Wa simi'na battaan hi titkabbar wa tistakbarwa hi tikoolif wa tifaachir.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Ana na'arif kadar hi tarfa' raashawa laakin hi tifaachir saakit fi l-riihwa kuluufiiyitha kula bala faayde.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nabkiwa nunuuh le Muwaab kullahawa nagnit fi chaan naas Khiir Haaras.
Ya jineenit al-inab hana Sibma,nabki leeki ziyaada min bakiiyi le Ya'ziir.Wa furuu'ki faato al-baharwa lihgo bahar Ya'ziir.Wa laakin al-mukharrib gamma yagta' inabkiwa yilaggit kichcheebki.
Wa l-farah wa l-suruur bigo ma fiihumfi balad Muwaab al-khadra.Ana waggaft al-khamar,ma yamrug min al-assaara.Battaan ma ya'asuru al-inabwa yifajjukhuuh be ragraagwa zakhraat al-farahma yinsami' battaan.
Wa korooraak al-faza' min madiinat Hachbuun yinsami' lahaddi fi Ali'aala wa lahaddi fi Yahaas.Wa yinsami' min Suukhar lahaddi Hurunaayim wa lahaddi Aglat Chaliicha.Hatta uyuun almi hana Nimriim kula yaybaso.
Ana nidammir fi Muwaab al-naas al-yigaddumu dahaaya fi l-bakaan al-aali wa yiharrugu bakhuur le ilaahaathum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa battaan galbi yahzan wa yunuuh misil al-suffaara le Muwaab wa le naas Khiir Haaras achaan al-khuna al-lammooha waddarat.
Wa be da,hizno wa zayyano ruuseehum wa gatta'o duguunhum wa jarraho iideehum wa libso khulgaan al-hizin.
Wa fi ruuse kulla buyuut Muwaab wa fi kulla chawaari'ha ma fi cheyy aakhar illa l-nuwaah.-Ana kassart Muwaab misil jarr al-ma yanfa'. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Da kikkeef Muwaab addammarat-!Iitu wa guulu-:-Chiifu-!Muwaab dangarat raasha min al-eeb.Wa hi bigat madhaka wa mukhiife le kulla l-jiiraanha al-muhawwigiinha.
Achaan daahu Allah gaal-:-Aywa-!Al-adu yinrakhi fi Muwaab misil sagural-jahhaz janaahe le yadrubha.
Hillit Kharyuut yichiiluuhawa bakaanaatha al-gawiyiin yakurbuuhum.Wa fi l-yoom da,galib askar Muwaabyabga misil galib al-mara al-gaa'ide titaalig.
Wa Muwaab takhrab,ma tabga cha'abachaan hi sawwat nafishaaaliye min Allah.
Ya sukkaan Muwaab-!Al-khoof wa l-nugra wa l-charakyukuunu fi lubbuku.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-yi'arrid min al-khoofyaga' fi l-nugrawa l-yidoor yamrug min al-nugra,al-charak yakurbah.Achaan da kulla ana bas jibtah fi Muwaab,fi sanit ikhaabha.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-yi'arrudu ma induhum gudrawa yidooru yinjammo fi dull madiinat Hachbuun.Laakin min Hachbuun tamrug naarwa min balad Siihuun,ambalbaala.Wa tahrig Muwaab balad al-unufmin tarafha lahaddi usutha.
Al-azaab leeku,ya naas Muwaab-!Ya intu cha'ab sanam Kamuuch,tiwadduru.Achaan subyaanku wa banaatkuyakurbuuhum wa yiwadduuhum fi l-khurba.
Wa laakin fi l-akhiir,nigabbil naas Muwaabal-waddoohum fi l-khurba.-Wa da kalaam Allah.Wa khalaas,hini bas kammalat muhaakamat Allah le Muwaab.
Kalaam bukhuss Bani Ammuun.Daahu Allah gaal-:-Israa'iil ma indah wileed walla-?Hu ma indah wariis walla-?Maala sanam Muulakwaras turaab Gaad-?Wa maala hu sakkan cha'abahfi mudunha-?
Fi chaan da,yaji yoom waahidal-foogah ana nijiib korooraak al-hujuumfi Rabba madiinat Bani Ammuun.Wa da kalaam Allah.Hi takhrab wa tabga koom hana turaabwa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha yahrago be naar.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Bani Israa'iil yagla'omin al-udwaan al-gala'o minhum.Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Ya naas madiinat Hachbuun,ahzano achaan hillit Aay addammarat-!Ya sukkaan hillaal Rabba,abku-!Albaso khulgaan al-hizin wa nuuhu-!Wa ajru jaay wa jaay fi lubb al-durdur.Achaan sanamku Muulak yiwadduuh fi l-khurbama'a rujaal al-diin hineeyah wa khaddaamiinah.
Ya balad Ammuun,maala tafrahe be wudyaanki,wudyaanki al-yigawwumu intaaj katiir,ya l-bineeye al-kaafre-!Inti tukhutti amaanki fi khunaakiwa tuguuli-:--Yaatu yugumm diddi-?--
Akiid nijiib foogki khoof,al-yajiiki min kulla bakaan.Wa natrud ayyi waahid beyahwa ma fi naadum al-yagdar yilimm al-mu'arridiin.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir.
Wa laakin ba'ad da,ana nigabbil Bani Ammuun min al-khurba.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Kalaam bukhuss balad Adoom.Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ma fi hikma fi Teemaan walla-?Wa wasiiyat al-faahimiin waddarat walla-?Wa hikmithum ma tanfa' battaan walla-?
Ya sukkaan hillit Dadaan,gabbulu wa arruduwa allabbado fi l-karaakiir.Achaan ana nijiib al-kharaab fi Adoom zurriiyit Isuuwakit ni'aakhibhum.
Wa kan gattaa'iin al-inab yaju leeku,ma yikhallu waraahum al-kichcheeb walla-?Wa kan saraariig yaju be leel,ma yichiilu al-yakfiihum bas walla-?
Wa laakin ana bas ni'arri zurriiyit Isuuwa nakchif sirruhumwa humman ma yagdaro yillabbado.Zurriiytah wa akhwaanah wa jiiraanah,nisallimhum le l-kharaab.Wa ma yifaddil naadum al-yuguul-:
--Khallu leyi ataamaaku nirabbiihumwa khalli araamilku yintaklan aleyi.-
Achaan daahu Allah gaal-:-Chiifu,al-naas al-ma hakamo leehum be charaab kaas al-ikhaab,humman chirbooh.Wa intu,ya naas Adoom,naj'alku bariyiin walla-?La-!Akiid intu kula tacharbo min al-kaas da.
Achaan ana nahlif be nafsi,hillit Busra tabga kharaab wa bakaan muhaddam wa yi'ayyubuuha wa yal'anooha.Wa kulla hillaalha yabgo koom hana turaab ila l-abad. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Simi't khabar jaayi min Allah.Hu rassal rasuul been al-umam al-yuguul-:-Intu kulluku limmu sawa wa ta'aalugummu haarubu balad Adoom.
Ya balad Adoom-!Daahu ana nisawwiiki umma sakhayre fi ust al-umamwa kulla l-naas yahguruuki.
Wa l-khoof al-sawweeti le l-aakhariin,khachchaakiwa istikbaarki kula,ammalki.Ya inti al-gaa'ide fi karaakiir al-hujaarwa saakne foog fi l-jibaal,kan baneeti uchchiki foog min uchch al-sagur kula,ana ninazzilki.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Adoom takhrab wa ayyi naadum al-yufuut jambaha yil'ajjab wa yisaffir min al-damaar al-foogha.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Da misil Saduum wa Amuura wa l-hillaal al-mujaawiriinhum wakit ana dammartuhum.Wa ma fi naadum yaskun hini fi balad Adoom wa la insaan yagood foogha.
Wa misil duud al-yamrug min khaabat al-Urdunle yahjim khanam fi mar'a akhdar,ana Allah kula nugumm natrud naas Adoom be khaflawa nisabbit foogha al-naadum al-ana azaltah.Yaatu al-misli ana-?Wa yaatu al-yagdar yantiini amur-?Wa yaatu al-malikal-yagdar yugumm diddi-?
Wa fi chaan da,asma'o al-kharaaral-kharrarah Allah didd Adoomwa asma'o al-niiyeal-chaalha Allah didd sukkaan Teemaan.Akiid yiwaddiihum misil iyaal al-khanamwa akiid yakhrib mar'aahum.
Wa min harakat waga'aanhum,al-ard tarjifwa siraakhhum yinsami'lahaddi fi l-bahar al-Ahmar.
Al-adu yinrakhi fi Busra misil sagur al-jahhaz janaaheeh le yadrubha.Wa fi l-yoom da,galib askar Adoom yabga misil galib al-mara al-gaa'ide titaalig.
Kalaam bukhuss madiinat Dimachkh.-Hillaal Hamaat wa Arfad hammoachaan sim'o khabar cheen.Humman barjalo wa rajafomisil al-bahar al-almiih ma haadi.
Wa sukkaan Dimachkh di'fowa gabbalo le yi'arruduwa l-bahiite karabathum.Wa l-diige wa l-waja' karaboohummisil al-mara al-gaa'ide titaalig.
Maala khallo Dimachkh,hi al-madiina al-ma'ruufaal-beeha ana nafrah-?
Wa fi l-yoom da,subyaanha yidaffugu fi l-chawaari'wa rujaalha al-muhaaribiin yumuutu.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa ninazzil naar fi durdur Dimachkhwa taakul gusuur al-malik Banhadaad.
Kalaam bukhuss Khidaar wa mantagat Haasuur al-haarabaahum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Daahu Allah gaal-:-Gummu ahjumu Khidaar.Aywa,dammuru iyaal al-sabaah-!
Chiilu khiyamhum wa khanamhumwa chiilu sataayirhumwa kulla khumaamhum wa ibilhum.Wa guulu leehum-:--Al-mukhiif fi kulla bakaan-!--
Ya naas Haasuur-!Arrudu amchu ajala,allabbado fi l-karaakiir.Achaan Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabilkharrar didduku kharaarwa khattat didduku khitta.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Gummu ahjumu al-ummaal-saakne fi raaha wa amaan.Hi ma indaha hawaadir wa la gufulwa gaa'ide wiheedha taraf.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa yanhabo ibilhumwa bahaayimhum al-katiiriin yabgo khaniime.Wa l-yizayyunu cha'arhum,nichattithum fi l-riihwa nijiib fooghum al-kharaabmin kulli jiihe.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Haasuur tabga margad ba'aachiimwa bakaan kharaab ila l-abad.Wa ma fi naadum yaskun fi l-balad diwa la insaan yagood foogha.
Fi bidaayit hukum Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza,Allah hajja le l-nabi Irmiya kalaam bukhuss balad Ilaam.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Aywa,ana nikassir nubbaal Ilaam,al-hu asaas gudurtah.
Ana nijiib fi Ilaam adual-yaji min kulli jiihe misil al-riih.Wa nichattithum be l-riih diwa ma fi balad al-ma yawsalo fooghaal-naas al-arrado min Ilaam.
Ana nibarjil naas Ilaam giddaam udwaanhumwa giddaam al-yidooru moothum.Wa nijiib fooghum al-fasaalawa khadabi al-muhrig.Wa nijiib leehum al-seef yitaaridhumlahaddi nikammilhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana nahkim fi balad Ilaamwa niwaddir malikha wa kubaaraatah.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin fi l-akhiir,ana nigabbil naas Ilaamal-waddoohum fi l-khurba.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-gaalah be waasitat al-nabi Irmiya.Wa l-kalaam da bukhuss madiinat Baabil wa kulla ardaha.
Ballukhu fi ust al-umam-!Khabburu beyahwa arfa'o al-alaama.Khabburu beyahwa ma tilabbudu cheyy.Wa guulu-:--Baabil waga'at.Wa ilaahhum Biil ayyaboohwa ilaahhum Marduuk kassarooh.Wa asnaamhum ayyaboohumwa ilaahaathum kassaroohum.--
Achaan min munchaakh,umma jaat hajamat Baabilwa kharabat al-balad.Wa naasha wa bahaayimha kulluhum arradowa l-balad di bigat faadiye min sukkaanha.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Fi ayyaam al-wakit da,Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza yigabbulu sawawa yaju be bakiyifattuchuuni ana Allah Ilaahhum.
Humman yas'alo min derib jabal Sahyuunwa yiwajjuhu aleeha.Wa yuguulu-:--Yalla-!Ninrabtu ma'a Allahbe mu'aahada daayme al-abadan ma tinnasi.-
Cha'abi misil khanam muwaddiriinal-ru'yaanhum waddaroohum fi l-jibaal.Yiliffu beehum min jabal le aakharlahaddi l-khanam dool nassoohum zariibithum.
Humman misil khanamwa ayyi naadum al-yalgaahum yaakulhum.Udwaanhum yuguulu-:--Aniina ma khaatiyiinachaan humman aznabo didd Allah.Wa Allah hu bas bakaan raahithum wa adaalithum,hu al-juduudhum khatto achamhum foogah.-
Yalla-!Arrudu min Baabil-!Amurgu min balad al-Baabiliyiin.Wa abgo misil tuyuusal-maachiin fi raas door al-khanam.
Achaan ana niharrichmajmuu'at umam katiiriin,yaju min balad al-munchaakhle yahjumu Baabil.Wa l-umam dool yihaarubuuhawa yichiiluuha.Wa nachaachiibhum hineey rujaal furraasal-nuchchaabhum tihit ke ma yaga'.
Wa balad Baabil yichiiluuha misil kasiibewa kulla nahhaabiinha yachba'o.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Aywa,intu firihtu wa anbasattu,intu al-nahabtu cha'abi al-misil warasati.Wa nattattu misil al-ijle fi l-gechch al-akhdarwa hanhantu misil al-kheel al-induhum gudra.
Wa hassa',baladku al-misil ammukutakhjal ziyaadawa l-wildatku,al-eeb yakrubha.Wa tukuun aakhir al-umamwa tabga sahara wa ard jafaaf wa kadaade.
Wa be sabab khadab Allah,baladku takhrabwa tafda min sukkaanha.Wa ayyi naadum al-yufuut jamb Baabil yil'ajjabwa yisaffir min al-damaar al-foogha.
Yalla-!Intu siyaad al-nubbaalgummu le muhaarabat Baabilwa min kulli jiihe,zarruguuha.Ma tifaddulu nuchchaab waahid kulaachaan hi aznabat didd Allah.
Hawwuguuha min kulli jiihewa kooruku korooraak al-harib diddaha.Wa khalaas,hi tisallim nafishawa gusuurha yidaffuguwa daraadirha yaga'o.Allah kaffa al-taar foogha.Intu kula kaffu al-taarwa sawwu foogha misil hi sawwat.
Wa fi Baabil,aktulu al-harraatiinwa l-yagta'o be khanaajir fi wakt al-gati'.Wa wakit seef al-mudammir yaji,khalli ayyi naadum yigabbil le cha'abahwa yajri le baladah.
Bani Israa'iil misil khanamaay al-muwaddireal-katalooha al-diidaan.Wa malik Achuur hu al-awwal akalhawa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabilfi l-akhiir kasar adumha.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Akiid ana ni'aakhib malik Baabil wa baladahmisil aakhabt malik Achuur.
Wa ana nigabbil Bani Israa'iilfi bakaan mar'aahumwa yasraho fi jabal al-Karmalwa turaab Baachaanwa yachba'o fi jibaal Afraayimwa turaab Gil'aad.
Wa fi ayyaam al-wakit da,yifattuchu khata Bani Israa'iil wa ma yalgooh.Wa zanib Bani Yahuuza kula ma yinlagi abadanachaan nakhfir le l-ana khalleethum faddalo.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ahjumu turaab Marataayimwa sukkaan Faguud.Haarubuuhum wa dammuruuhumwa sawwu fooghum misil ana amartuku.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Yinsami' korooraak al-harib fi l-baladwa yinchaaf damaar kabiir-!
Chiifu,Baabil alkassarat wa alfatfatathi al-misil al-mitraga al-darabat kulla l-ard.Ajab,Baabil khirbat fi ust al-umam.
Ya Baabil-!Ana kajjeet leeki charakwa karabtiki min duun inti ta'arfiih.Ana ligiitki wa karabtikiachaan inti bas gammeeti diddi ana Allah.
Allah fatah beet al-silaahwa marag silaah khadabah.Wa misil da bas,Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadirjahhaz khidimtah didd balad Baabil.
Ta'aalu didd Baabil min aakhir al-dunyawa aftaho dabangaatha.Wa limmu khaniimitha misil al-gechchwa dammuru sukkaanhalahaddi waahid kula ma yifaddil minhum.
Aktulu kulla furraasha al-misil al-tiiraanwa suuguuhum le l-moot-!Al-azaab leehum-!Yoomhum jawa da wakit ikhaabhum.
Asma'o korooraak al-mu'arridiinwa l-jaariyiin min balad Baabil.Fi Sahyuun yiballukhu wa yuguulu-:-Allah Ilaahna chaal al-taar,chaal al-taar le beetah al-mukhaddas al-dammarooh-!
Naadu siyaad al-nubbaal didd Baabil,kulla l-ya'arfu yista'malo al-nuchchaab.Yukhuttu mu'askarhum hawaaleehaachaan naadum minha ma yinbalis.Aakhubuuha hasab amalhawa sawwu foogha misil hi sawwat.Achaan hi astakbarat giddaam Allah,giddaam Khudduus Israa'iil.
Fi l-yoom da,subyaanha yidaffugu fi l-chawaari'wa rujaalha al-muhaaribiin yumuutu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Akiid ana nugumm diddiki,ya Baabil al-mustakbire-!Achaan yoomki jawa da l-wakit al-ni'aakhibki foogah.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir.
Al-mustakbire tittarta' wa taga'wa naadum yarfa'ha ma fiih.Wa ana nigabbid al-naar fi mudunhawa taakul kulla l-fi hawaaleeha.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuzahumman al-itneen mazluumiin.Wa l-naas al-karaboohum masaajiinabo ma yikhalluuhum.
Wa laakin al-yafdaahum hu chadiidwa usmah Allah al-Gaadir.Hu yidaafi' leehum misil muhaamiwa yirajjif sukkaan Baabilachaan yijiib al-salaam fi l-ard.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Ana nijiib al-harib didd sukkaan Baabilwa kubaaraathum wa hakiimiinhum.
Wa nijiib al-harib didd al-yihajju bala faaydewa yikallumu misil muchootiniin.Wa nijiib al-harib didd al-furraaswa yabgo mubarjaliin.
Wa nijiib al-harib didd kheelhumwa arabaathum hana l-haribwa didd kulla l-ajaanib al-fi lubb deechhumwa humman yabgo misil awiin.Wa nijiib al-harib didd makhaazinhumwa yanhaboohum.
Wa nijiib al-jafaaf le buhuur Baabilwa humman yikammulu.Achaan hi balad hint asnaam mukhiifiinal-yiwadduru raas al-naas al-ya'abuduuhum.
Wa khalaas,al-gitat wa l-maraaf'iin yaskunuuhawa l-na'aam yudugg dungurah foogha.Wa battaan,ma fi abadannaadum yaskun fi Baabilwa min zurriiye le zurriiye kula,ma talga sukkaan.
Da misil Saduum wa Amuura wa hillaalhumal-ana al-Rabb dammartuhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.Ma fi naadum al-yaskun fi balad Baabilwa la insaan yagood foogha.
Aywa,fi cha'ab jaayi min munchaakhwa umma kabiire wa muluuk chudaadyugummu min aakhir al-ard.
Wa askarhum musallahiin be nubbaal wa huraabwa humman mukhiifiin ma induhum rahma.Wa harakathum misil mooj al-baharwa humman raakbiin kheel.Wa yurussu le l-harib misil raajil waahidle yihaarubuuki,ya Baabil al-misil bineeye.
Wa wakit malik Baabil simi' al-khabar,iideenah anrakho.Wa l-khoof wa l-waja' karaboohmisil al-mara al-gaa'ide titaalig.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Misil duud al-yamrugmin khaabat al-Urdunle yahjim khanam fi mar'a akhdar,ana kula nugummnatrud naas Baabil be khaflawa nisabbit fooghaal-naadum al-ana azaltah.Yaatu al-misli ana-?Wa yaatu al-yantiini amur-?Wa yaatu al-malikal-yagdar yugumm diddi-?
Wa fi chaan da,asma'o al-kharaaral-kharrarah Allah didd Baabilwa asma'o al-niiyeal-chaalha didd al-Baabiliyiin.Akiid yiwaddiihum misil iyaal al-khanamwa akiid yakhrib mar'aahum.
Wa min harakat cheeliin Baabil,al-ard tarjifwa siraakhha yinsami'fi ust al-umam.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Chiifu,ana nigawwim adu misil riih mudammiredidd Baabil wa didd guluub udwaani.
Wa nirassil didd Baabil ajaanibyikharbuluuha.Fi yoom fasaalitha,yaju leeha min kulli jiihewa yidammuru ardaha.
Adurbu ayyi waahid min al-adual-indah nuchchaab wa laabis dir'ah.Ma tikhallu al-askar al-chabaabwa laakin dammuru kulla askar Baabil.
Khalli yaga'o muta''aniin fi l-chawaari'wa yidaffugu maytiin fi balad Baabil.
Achaan Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadirkaan ma'a Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuzahatta kan humman malo baladhum be charrdidd Khudduus Israa'iil kula.
Arrudu min balad Baabilwa khalli ayyi waahid yinajji nafsah.Ma tumuutu be sabab zanibhaachaan da wakit Allah yichiil taarahwa yijaaziiha hasab al-waajib leeha.
Baabil awwal hi misil kaas hana dahab fi iid Allah,hi sakkarat kulla l-ard.Wa l-umam chirbo min khamarhawa fi chaan da bas,ruuseehum waddaro.
Wa be khafla,Baabil waga'at wa alkassarat.Abku leeha wa fattuchu dawawa amsahooh fi uwaarha,akuun til'aalaj.
Aniina dawwarna ni'aaluju Baabilwa laakin hi ma addaawat leena.Yalla nikhalluuha-!Ayyi waahid yamchi le baladahachaan ikhaabha lihig lahaddi l-samawa anrafa' lahaddi l-sahaab.
Allah bayyan adaalitnawa khalaas,ta'aalu nigabbulu.Nikhabburu fi jabal Sahyuunbe kheer Allah Ilaahna.
Tarrugu nachaachiibkuwa amlo kalootaatku.Allah harrach muluuk Maadi didd Baabilachaan hu kharrar yidammir Baabil.Yichiil foogha al-taarwa da taar beetah al-mukhaddas al-dammarooh.
Arfa'o raayit al-hujuum didd durdur Baabilwa chaddudu al-muraakhaba.Khuttu hurraaswa khuttu naas le yarbutu kamiin.Achaan al-cheyy al-kharrarah Allah,hu yisawwiihwa da kharaarah didd sukkaan Baabil.
Inti ya Baabil al-jamb al-buhuur,khunaaki katiire.Nihaayitki jaat hasab tama'ki.
Allah al-Gaadir halaf be nafsah wa gaal-:-Ana namlaaki be rujaal katiiriin misil al-jaraadwa yikooruku fi lubbiki korooraak al-nasur.
Allah khalag al-ard be gudurtahwa sabbat al-aalam be hikmatahwa falla al-samaawaat be ilmah.
Wa wakit yaamur,al-almi yilimm bakaan waahid fi l-samawa l-sahaab yatla' min aakhir al-ardwa l-barraaga tachla' wa l-matar yanzilwa makhaazin al-riih yinfathu.
Wa ayyi naadum mukhaffalma indah ma'rafa.Wa ayyi sayyaakhi hana sanam,al-eeb yakurbahachaan timsaalah da khachch,ma indah ruuh.
Wa Ilaah Yaakhuub ma misilhumachaan hu bas khalag kulla cheyy.Hu azal gabiila waahidele yabgo cha'abah al-misil warasatahwa usmah Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Inti,ya Baabil-!Bigiiti leyi misil asaati al-nihaarib beeha.Beeki inti,ana darabt al-umamwa kharabt al-mamaalik.
Wa beeki inti,ana darabtal-kheel wa rukkaabhumwa arabaat al-harib wa siyaadhum.
Wa beeki inti,ana darabtal-rujaal wa l-awiinwa l-kubaar wa l-dugaagwa l-subyaan wa l-banaat.
Wa beeki inti,ana darabtal-ru'yaan wa khanamhumwa l-harraatiin wa tiiraanhumwa l-hukkaam wa masaa'iilhum.
Wa laakin hassa',chiifu ya Bani Israa'iil-!Ana nijaazi Baabil wa kulla sukkaanhahasab kulla l-fasaala al-sawwooha fi Sahyuun.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa akiid ana nugumm diddiki inti,ya Baabil al-misil jabal al-kharaab,inti al-kharabti kulla l-ard.Ana nimidd iidi le nadrubkiwa nidardigki min ruuse al-jibaalwa nahrigki be naar.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa battaan ma yamurgu minkiwa la hajar zaawiye wa la hajar asaasachaan tukuuni kharaab ila l-abad.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Arfa'o raayit al-hujuum fi l-baladwa adurbu al-buug fi ust al-umam.Khassusu umam didd Baabilwa harruchu diddaha mamaalik Araraat wa Minni wa Achkanaaz.Kallufu khaayid diddahawa gawwumu diddaha kheel misil al-jaraad al-saayir.
Wa khassusu al-umam didd Baabilwa rassulu diddaha muluuk Maadiwa hukkaamhum wa kulla masaa'iilhumwa kulla l-buldaan al-humman yahkumuuhum.
Al-ard anhazzat wa rajafatwakit kharaar Allah didd Baabil alhaggag.Wa balad Baabil takhrabwa tabga faadiye min sukkaanha.
Wa l-askar al-furraas hana Baabilabo ma yihaarubuwa allabbado fi bakaanaathum al-gawiyiin.Wa fahaaliiyithum kula waddaratwa humman bigo misil awiin.Wa buyuut Baabil antachchowa biibaanha alkassaro.
Wa yajri mursaal ba'ad mursaalwa rasuul wara rasuulle yikhabburu malik Baabilkadar madiintah chaalooha min tarafha le tarafha.
Wa ayyi ma'add,al-adu saddaahwa tibin al-ruhuud tachchoohwa l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin anbahato.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Baabil al-misil bineeyetabga yaabse karr misil naga'at al-madagg al-jahhazooha.Wa ba'ad chiyya,wakt al-gati' yaji.
Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil barjalaana wa akalaanawa hu sawwaana misil maa'uun faadi.Wa zarataana misil al-khuulwa mala batnah be mukhkhina wa taradaana.
Wa khalli al-unuf al-sawwooh leenayukuun fi Baabil-!-Wa da kalaam sukkaan Sahyuun.-Wa khalli dimmitna taga'fi raas sukkaan Baabil-!-Wa da kalaam naas Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Ana nidaafi' leeku misil muhaamiwa nichiil leeku al-taar.Wa niyabbis bahar Baabilwa nijaffif uyuun almiiha.
Wa Baabil tabga koom hana turaabwa margad hana ba'aachiimwa bakaan kharaab wa bahiitewa tabga faadiye min sukkaanha.
Wa naas Baabil yikirru misil al-diidaan al-subyaanwa yaharju misil iyaal al-duud.
Wa wakit jihmo,ana nijahhiz leehum aazuumawa nisakkirhum lahaddi yafraho.Wa laakin yunuumu noom ila l-abadwa battaan ma yugummu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana niwaddiihummisil al-khurfaan le l-juzurwa misil al-kubaach wa l-tuyuus.
Chiifu-!Baabilanchaalatwa l-ma'ruufa fi kulla l-ard anhazamat-!Ajab,Baabil khirbat fi ust al-umam-!
Al-bahar chaal Baabilwa be moojah al-katiir,khattaaha.
Mudunha khirbowa hi bigat ard jafaaf wa kadaade.Wa di l-balad al-ma fi naadum yaskun fooghawa la insaan yi'addi beeha.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana nugumm didd sanam Biil fi Baabilwa namrug al-lugma min khachmah.Wa battaan al-umam ma yamchu leyahwa durdur Baabil yaga'.
Ya cha'abi-!Amurgu min usut Baabilwa khalli ayyi waahid yinajji nafsah,wa yiba''id min al-khadab al-muhrig hanaayi Allah.
Wa khalli achamku ma yingati'wa ma takhaafomin al-khabaral-gaa'idiin tasma'ooh fi l-balad.Achaan al-sana di,tasma'o khabarwa fi l-sana al-ba'adha kula,tasma'o khabar aakhar.Wa yuguulu yaji unuf fi l-baladwa malik yugumm didd malik.
Wa fi chaan da,yaji yoom waahidal-foogah ana ni'aakhib asnaam Baabil.Wa kulla baladha,al-eeb yakrubhawa janaazaat maytiinha yaga'o fi lubbaha.
Al-sama wa l-ard yizakhrutuwa kulla l-fiihum yiragrig min al-farahfi chaan damaar Baabil.Achaan min munchaakhal-mukharrib yaji leeha.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya maytiin Bani Israa'iil-!Baabil kula waajib taga'.Achaan beeha hi waga'o naas maytiinfi ayyi bakaan fi l-ard.
Yalla,intu al-nijiitu min al-moot-!Arrudu-!Ma tagiifu-!Fi l-khurba,azzakkaro Allahwa khuttu Madiinat al-Khudus fi guluubku.
Wa Bani Israa'iil gaalo-:-Aniina al-eeb karabaanawakit simi'na al-mu'yaarwa l-khajla dallat ruuseena.Achaan al-ajaanib dakhalo fi l-bakaanaathana beet Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Wa fi chaan da,yaji yoom waahidal-foogah ni'aakhib asnaam Baabilwa fi kulla baladha al-majruuhiin yaguntu.
Hatta kan Baabil tabga aaliye lahaddi l-samawa tigawwi bakaanaatha al-aaliyiin kula,ana nijiib foogha mukharribiin.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa siraakh yinsami' min Baabilwa damaar kabiir yukuun fi balad al-Baabiliyiin.
Achaan Allah yakhrib Baabilwa yisakkit harakatha.Wa l-adu yajiiha misil al-mooj al-chadiidwa harakatah tinsami'.
Aywa-!Kulla l-mukharribiinjo didd Baabil.Askarha al-furraas ankarabowa nubbaalhum alkassar.Achaan Allah hu al-Ilaah al-yijaaziwa yikaafi ayyi naadum ale hasab al-waajib leyah.
Ana nisakkir masaa'iilha wa hakiimiinhawa hukkaamha wa kubaaraathawa askarha al-furraas.Wa humman yunuumu ila l-abadwa battaan ma yugummu.-Wa da kalaam al-malik wa hu Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Daraadir Baabil al-tukhaanyilhaddamo.Wa biibaanha al-tuwaal,al-naar taakulhum.Al-chu'uub yi'ayyu nufuushum saakitwa l-umam yat'abo le l-taakulah al-naar.
Al-nabi Irmiya kallam le Saraaya wileed Nariiya wileed Mahsiiya wakit hu maachi Baabil ma'a Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum Sidkhiiya.Wa Saraaya da,hu mas'uul min gasir al-malik.
Wa Irmiya katab fi kitaab malfuuf kulla l-fasaala al-taji le Baabil wa da kulla l-kalaam al-maktuub al-bukhuss Baabil.
Wa Irmiya gaal le Saraaya-:-Wakit tiwassil fi Baabil,fakkir wa agri be hiss aali kulla l-kalaam da.
Wa guul-:--Ya Allah-!Inta bas kharrart wa gult al-bakaan da yiddammar.Wa ma fi naadum yaskun foogah wa la insaan wa la bahaayim.Wa laakin hu yabga kharaab ila l-abad.--
Wakit tikammil min giraayit al-kitaab da,arbut foogah hajar wa armiih fi lubb bahar al-Furaat.
Wa ba'ad da,guul-:--Baabil kula takhrag misil da wa abadan ma tugumm ba'ad al-fasaala al-nijiibha foogha.---Al-naas yaga'o.-Wa daahu nihaayat kalaam Irmiya.
Sidkhiiya indah 21 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 11 sana fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Hamuutal bineeyit Irmiya min hillit Libna.
Wa fi chaan da,fi l-yoom al-aachir hana l-chahar al-aachir fi l-sana al-taas'e hana hukum Sidkhiiya,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja be kulla askarah le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa humman nazalo wa hawwagooha be radmiiye.
Wa l-juu' bigi chadiid fi l-madiina wa l-naas ma induhum cheyy yaakuluuh.Wa fi l-yoom al-taasi' hana l-chahar al-raabi',
gaddo khurma fi durdur al-madiina.Wa khalaas be l-leel,malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa kulla askarah marago wa arrado min al-madiina.Humman marago be l-derib al-gaa'id ambeenaat al-daraadir al-itneen hana l-difaa' al-gariib le jineenit al-malik hatta kan al-Baabiliyiin muhawwigiin al-madiina kula.Wa l-malik Sidkhiiya wa askarah chaalo al-derib al-maachi ale waadi al-Urdun.
Wa laakin askar Baabil taradooh le l-malik Sidkhiiya wa lihgooh wa karabooh fi kadaadit Ariiha.Wa kulla askarah arrado khallooh.
Wa askar Baabil karabooh le l-malik.Wa waddooh fi hillit Ribla fi balad Hamaat giddaam malik Baabil.Wa fi l-bakaan da,haakamah.
Wa hinaak fi Ribla,malik Baabil dabah awlaad Sidkhiiya giddaamah wa battaan dabah kulla kubaaraat Yahuuza.
Wa ba'ad da,malik Baabil gaddad uyuun Sidkhiiya wa janzarah be jinziir hana nahaas matbuug wa waddaah fi Baabil.Wa khattaah fi l-sijin lahaddi mootah.
Wa fi l-yoom al-aachir hana l-chahar al-khaamis fi sanit 19 hana hukum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas al-yakhdim le malik Baabil dakhal fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa kulla askar Baabil al-macho ma'a kabiir al-hurraas kassaro al-durdur al-muhawwig Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas chaal ma'aayah al-cha'ab al-faddalo fi l-madiina wa humman waahidiin min al-masaakiin wa l-naas al-sallamo nufuushum le malik Baabil wa l-sinaa'iyiin.Wa hu chaalaahum wa waddaahum fi l-khurba fi Baabil.
Wa laakin Nabuuzaradaan khalla waahidiin min masaakiin al-balad le yahartu al-inab wa l-ziraa'a.
Wa askar Baabil kassaro amad al-nahaas al-giddaam beet Allah wa l-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin wa l-hoot al-kabiir hana nahaas al-gaa'id giddaam beet Allah wa waddo kulla l-nahaas da fi Baabil.
Wa humman chaalo al-buraam wa l-feelaat wa l-sakaakiin wa l-kiisaan wa l-kharaariif wa kulla l-mawaa'iin al-sana'oohum min nahaas wa asta'maloohum le l-ibaada.
Wa kabiir al-hurraas chaal al-mawaa'iin wa khammaamaat al-naar wa l-kiisaan wa l-buraam wa l-faanuus wa l-kharaariif wa l-taasaat kulluhum min dahab wa fudda.
Wa kan le l-amad al-itneen wa l-hoot al-kabiir wa l-atnaachar tiiraan al-gaa'idiin tihtah wa l-hiitaan al-mutaharrikiin kulluhum ke al-sana'aahum al-malik Suleymaan le beet Allah,wazin nahaashum ma ma'ruuf min al-katara.
Wa ayyi waahid min al-amad dool tuulah 18 duraa' wa daayiratah 12 duraa' wa indah lubb wa tukhnah 4 asaabi'.
Wa ayyi amuud da,khatto foogah raas hana nahaas al-tuulah 5 duraa' wa muhawwag be salaasil al-murassas fooghum rummaan wa kulluhum ke min nahaas.Wa l-amuud al-taani,sun'itah sawa sawa misil al-amuud al-awwalaani be rummaanah.
Wa fi 96 rummaan al-binchaafo fi jawaanibah wa laakin fi daayir al-salaasil,kulluhum adadhum 100 rummaan.
Wa min al-madiina,karab kabiir waahid al-mukallaf be l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin wa sab'a naas min khaddaamiin al-malik al-ligoohum fi lubb al-madiina.Wa karab battaan al-kaatib hana khaayid al-deech,hu al-mukallaf be jannidiin al-cha'ab fi l-askariiye wa 60 raajil min al-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi lubb al-madiina.
Wa malik Baabil katalaahum hinaak fi Ribla fi balad Hamaat.Wa be misil da,kulla naas balad Yahuuza waddoohum fi l-khurba,ba'iid min arduhum.
Wa daahu adad al-naas al-waddaahum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil fi l-khurba.Fi l-sana al-saab'e,hu wadda 3-023 Yahuud.
Wa fi sanit 18 hana hukmah,Nabuukhadnasar wadda min Madiinat al-Khudus 832 naas.
Wa fi sanit 23 hana hukum Nabuukhadnasar,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al-hurraas wadda fi l-khurba 745 Yahuud.Wa be l-jumla adadhum 4-600 naas.
Wa fi sanit 37 min waddo Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza fi l-khurba fi Baabil,darrajo Awiil Maruudak malik fi Baabil.Wa fi yoom 25 hana chahri 12 hana l-sana di,Awiil Maruudak afa Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa talagah min al-sijin.
Wa be misil da,fi kulla muddit hayaatah lahaddi mootah,Yuyakiin ligi riise samhe min malik Baabil.
Ya l-salaam-!Al-madiina amcha'aban katiirbigat ma'zuulamisil armala ma indaha musaa'ada.Awwal,hi fi l-umam sayyidawa l-yoom,bigat khaadim mamluuka.
Hi tabki,tabki tuul al-leelbe kulla gudrithawa min sudgaanha,ma fi sadiig al-yisabbirha.Kulla rufgaanha khaanoohawa bigo udwaanha.
Tihit al-ta'ab hana l-khurba,balad Yahuuza waddooha fi l-ubuudiiye.Wa aayche fi ust al-umam bala raahawa udwaanha al-taaradoohafi l-derib al-dayyig zarrooha.
Wa chawaari' Sahyuun hiznowa ma fi naas maachiin le l-iidwa kulla biibaan al-madiina daffago.Wa rujaal al-diin hineeha yaguntuwa banaatha al-udriiyaat haznaanaatwa madiinat Sahyuun gaa'ide fi l-murr.
Wa khusmaanha bigo siyaadhawa udwaanha gaa'idiin fi l-raaha.Wa Allah jaab foogha al-hizinbe sabab kutur isyaanha.Wa karabo iyaalhawa waddoohum abiid.
Wa madiinat Sahyuun al-misil bineeyewaddarat kulla charafha.Wa daahu kubaaraatha bigo misil teetalal-ma ligo bakaan mar'aahumwa arrado bala gudragiddaam tarraadiinhum.
Wa fi ayyaamha hana l-diige wa l-ta'ab,Madiinat al-Khudus azzakkarat kulla chahwaathaal-zamaan gaa'ide tafrah beehum.Wa wakit cha'abha waga'ofi iideen khusmaanhum,ma fi naadum al-yafza'hum.Wa khusmaanha chaafoohawa firho be damaarha.
Madiinat al-Khudus aznabatwa be da,najjasat nafisha.Wa kulla l-naas al-zamaan karramooha,hassa' nakarooha achaan chaafo ireeha.Wa laakin hi gaa'ide tagnitwa tantiihum daharha.
Wa be najaasitha fi surwaalha,hi ma fakkarat fi mustakhbalha.Wa waga'aanha bigi ajiibwa ma fi naadum al-yisabbirha.Wa Madiinat al-Khudus gaalat-:-Ya Allah,chiif ta'abiachaan al-adu annasar foogi-!
Wa l-khasiim khatta iideenahfi kulla ziinat beetha al-tafrah beeha.Aywa,fi l-beet al-mukhaddasdakhalo umam al-inta Allah gultma yadkhulu fi bakaan jamaa'tak.
Wa kulla cha'abha gaa'idiin yaguntuwakit yifattuchu al-akil.Wa yibaddulu kulla ziinat buyuuthumal-yafraho beehabe akil achaan yi'iichu.Wa Sahyuun gaalat-:-Ya Allah-!Asma'wa chiif kikkeef ana mahguura.
Wa leeku intu kullukual-ti'addu be l-derib da,asma'o wa chiifu-!Fiyah ta'ab ziyaadamin ta'abi al-ana aayche beyah-?Wa da l-ta'ab al-jaabah Allahfi yoom khadabah al-muhrig.
Min al-sama,hu rassal khadabahmisil naar dakhalat fi udaami.Wa kajja leyi charakwa beyah ramaani.Wa dassaani fi l-kharaabwa nagnit tuul yoomi.
Hu zaatah chaal zunuubiwa sawwaahum misil daami.Wa rabataahum leyi fi ragabatiwa be da,waddart gudurti.Wa l-Rabb sallamaani le iid udwaaniwa ma nagdar nugumm min tihithum.
Wa l-Rabb aba kulla rujaali al-furraasal-gaa'idiin ma'aayiwa jaab diddi deechle yaktul chabaabi.Wa khatta balad Yahuuza al-misil bineeye udriiyebeen al-murhaaka wa bittaha le yarhakha.
Wa fi chaan da,ana bakeetwa dumuu'i jaro wudyaanachaan al-yisabbirniwa l-yihayyiini bigi ba'iid minni.Wa iyaali hilkoachaan al-adu annasar foogi.
Sahyuun rafa'at iideenha wa naadatwa laakin ma ligat naadum al-yisabbirha.Wa Allah anta izin le jiiraan zurriiyit Yaakhuubyabgo udwaanhum.Wa fi uyuunhum,Madiinat al-Khudusmalaane be l-najaasa.
Wa Madiinat al-Khudus gaalat-:-Allah aadilachaan ana isiit amrah.Asma'o,ya kulla l-chu'uub,wa chiifu ta'abi.Kulla subyaani wa banaati karaboohumwa waddoohum fi l-khurba.
Wa ana naadeet sudgaaniwa laakin humman khachchooni.Rujaal al-diin wa chuyuukhi maatofi l-madiinawakit humman fattacho al-akille yi'iichu beyah wa ma ligooh.
Ya Allah,chiif al-diige al-foogi-!Nafsi mubarjala wa galbi munjarihachaan ana isiitak isyaan chadiid.Kan maragt fi l-chaari',al-moot yilaagiiniwa kan ga'adt fi l-beet,al-seef yagta' ragabati.
Udwaani sim'o ganiitiwa laakin ma fi naadum al-yisabbirni.Kulluhum sim'o be hizniwa farhaaniin beyah.Wa da kulla inta bas ja'altahwa jibt yoom al-ikhaab al-inta gata'tah.Wa khalli udwaani yabgo misli ana-!
Jiibhum giddaamakbe kulla l-fasaala al-sawwooha.Wa sawwi fooghum misil sawweet foogibe sabab kulla isyaani.Achaan ganiiti bigi katiirwa nafsi bigat mardaane.
Ya l-salaam-!Fi khadabah,al-Rabb khatta be l-dalaammadiinat Sahyuun al-misil bineeye.Min al-sama,rama majd Israa'iil fi l-ardwa fi yoom khadabah,ma fakkar fi beetah al-mukhaddas.
Al-Rabb dammar bala mahannakulla gechch al-mar'a hana zurriiyit Yaakhuub.Wa fi khadabah,kassar al-buyuut al-gawiyiinhana balad Yahuuza al-misil bineeye.Wa rama al-mamlaka wa kubaaraatha fi l-turaabwa ma ja'alaahum mukhassasiin leyah.
Wa yoom khadabah al-muhrig,hu dammar kulla khuwwaat Bani Israa'iil.Wa rafa' minhum iidah al-zeenewa sallamaahum le udwaanhum.Wa gawwam hariige amlahiibakalat kulla hawaale zurriiyit Yaakhuub.
Wa misil adu,jabad nubbaalahwa misil khasiim,be iidah al-zeenegaa'id yisawwib fooghum.Hu katal kulla iyaalhumal-humman ziinat buyuuthum.Wa nazzal khadabah misil naarfi kheemat Sahyuun al-misil bineeye.
Al-Rabb bigi misil adu dammar Israa'iilwa dammar kulla daraadirhawa kharab buyuutha al-gawiyiin.Wa fi balad Yahuuza al-misil bineeye,kattar al-hizin wa l-nuwaah.
Hu kharab zariibtahmisil zariibe hana jineenewa Allah dammar bakaanahhana l-malamma.Wa fi Sahyuun,hu nassaahumyoom al-iid wa yoom al-sabt.Wa min chiddit khadabah,hu abaahum le l-muluuk wa rujaal al-diin.
Wa l-Rabb aba al-madbahwa le bakaanah al-mukhaddas,khallaah.Wa sallam daraadir buyuut al-gawiyiin hana l-madiinafi iid al-adu.Wa ansama'at haraka chadiide fi beet Allahmisil al-haraka al-chadiide hana yoom al-iid.
Wa Allah kharraryidammir daraadir madiinat Sahyuun al-misil bineeye.Hu ma waggaf iidah min al-damaarlahaddi kulla cheyy khalaas addammar.Wa hu darab al-bakaan al-gawi wa l-daraadirwa kulluhum daffago giddaamah.
Wa biibaan madiinat Sahyuun andafano fi l-turaabwa hu dammaraahumwa kassar hawaadirhum.Wa l-malik wa kubaaraatah ankarabofi iideen al-umam al-aakhariin.Wa churuut al-Tawraat waddarowa l-anbiya kula ma ligo ru'ya min Allah.
Wa madiinat Sahyuun al-misil bineeye,chuyuukhha ga'ado tihit bala kalaamwa sabbo al-turaab fi ruuseehumwa libso khulgaan al-hizin.Wa banaat Madiinat al-Khudus al-udriiyaatdangaran ruuseehin ale l-ard min al-hizin.
Wa uyuuni dumuu'hum kammalowa butuuni hirgowa gudurti bigat ma fiihabe sabab al-damaar al-lihig ummati al-misil bitt ammi.Wakit al-atfaal wa l-iyaal al-dugaaggaa'idiin yakhmaro fi chawaari' al-madiina,
humman yuguulu le ammahaathum-:-Antuuna akil wa charaab-!-Wa yidaffugu fi chawaari' al-madiinamisil almi al-yajriwa ruuhhum gaa'ide tamrugfi huduun ammahaathum.
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus al-misil bineeye,be chunu nichabbihki-?Wa chunu al-yisaawiiki wa yisabbirki,ya Sahyuun al-misil bineeye udriiye-?Damaarki bigi wasii' misil al-baharwa yaatu al-yagdar yisaa'idki-?
Be ru'ya saakit,anbiyaaki hajjookiwa ma oorooki be l-khataal-inti sawweetiihachaan tutuubiwa ma yiwadduuki fi l-khurba.Be ru'ya,hajjookiwa be kalaam kidib,khachchooki.
Wa kulla l-naas al-faaytiinbe l-derib jambikiyisaffugu le kharaabki.Aywa,yisaffuru wa yihizzu ruuseehum leeki inti,ya Madiinat al-Khudus al-misil bineeye,wa yuguulu-:-Di bas al-madiina al-binaaduuhaAmjamaalan Kaamil-?Di bas al-bisammuuhaFarah al-Dunya walla-?
Kulla udwaanki fataho khuchuumhumwa alkallamo beeki.Humman saffarowa addo chalaaliifhum wa gaalo-:-Khalaas dammarnaaha-!Da bas al-yoom al-gaa'idiin narjoohwa daahu hidirnaah wa chifnaah.
Allah sawwa hasab hu dawwarahwa haggag kalaamah al-waa'ad beyah min zamaanwa dammar kulla cheyy bala mahanna.Wa khalla udwaanki yichchammato leekiwa antaahum gudra le yagiifu diddiki.
Sukkaan al-madiina sarakho le l-Rabbmin daakhal guluubhum.Ya daraadir Sahyuun-!Ya madiinat Sahyuun al-misil bineeye-!Dumuu'ki saalo leel wa nahaarwa bigo misil al-wudyaan.Ma tanti nafiski raahawa uyuunki kula ma yinjammo.
Yalla gummi wa abkimin bidaayit al-leellahaddi aakhirah-!Wa khalli galibki yingati' misil al-almigiddaam al-Rabb.Wa arfa'e iideenki wa achhade Allahle yinajji iyaalki al-yumuutu min al-juu'fi kulla machbak al-chawaari'.
Asma' wa chiif,ya Allah-!Le yaatu inta sawweet al-masiibe di-?Maala al-awiin akalan iyaalhinal-yiriidanhum-?Wa maala kataloohum le rujaal al-diinwa l-anbiya fi beetak al-mukhaddas-?
Wa fi kulla chawaari' al-madiina,mudaffigiin iyaal wa chiyyaab.Wa l-madiina gaalat-:-Banaati wa subyaani kataloohumbe l-seef.Fi yoom za'alak,inta Allah dammartwa bala mahanna,inta katalt.
Wa misil yoom al-iid,inta naadeet kulla udwaani al-mujaawiriinni.Ya Allah,fi yoom khadabakma fi naja wa la haya.Al-iyaal al-ana rabbeethum wa kabbartuhum,al-adu dammaraahum.
Wa l-nabi gaal-:Ana al-raajil al-icht al-azaabtihit soot khadab Allah.
Hu taradaani wa waddaanifi l-dalaam al-ma indah nuur.
Aywa,kulla yoom yadrubniiddat marraatana wiheedi.
Wa hu dammar laham jildiwa rihik udaami.
Wa sajanaaniwa be l-murr wa l-ta'ab,hawwagaani.
Wa sakkanaani fi dalaam al-khaburmisil al-maato min zamaan.
Wa sadda leyi al-tariig achaan ma najriwa zaad janaaziiri.

Hu maragaani min duruubiwa gatta'aani lahamaay lahamaaywa kharabaani.

Wakit ana nizzakkar tamaam,nafsi tat'ab ziyaada.

Aywa,hi tiljaddad kulli sabaahwa amaanah yabga ziyaada.
Wa ma faddal leyi illa Allahwa ana nukhutt achami foogah.

Wa da sameh kan tarja be huduwa tukhutt achamakfi l-naja al-jaaye min Allah.

Wa waajib yagood wiheedah wa yaskutachaan Allah bas ja'alah leyah.

Yanti chidgah le l-yadurbahwa yachba' min al-mu'yaar.
Achaan al-Rabb ma yaaba al-insaanila l-abad.
Hatta kan aakhab kula,yarhamwa da hasab kheerah al-kabiir.
Achaan hu ma yihibb yita''ib al-insaanwa la yijiib leyah al-hizin.

Ya l-salaam-!Al-dahab yiwaddir loonah walla-?Wa l-dahab al-saafi yilkhayyar walla-?Wa l-hujaar al-mukhaddasiinchatto fi machbak al-chawaari'.

Hatta al-ba'aachiim yantu duyuudhumwa yiraddu'u iyaalhum.Wa laakin ummati al-misil bitt ammima induhum mahannamisil na'aamaayit al-sahara.

Al-naas al-awwal akalo akil adiilal-yoom min al-juu' daffago fi l-chawaari'wa l-awwal ragado fi l-hariir,al-yoom ragado fi l-ba'ar.
Wa khata ummati al-misil bitt ammiakbar min zunuub madiinat Saduumal-tawwaali addammaratwa ma ligat faza'.

Wa hassa' kamaan,binchaafo zurug kurum misil al-fahamwa ma bin'arfu fi chawaari' al-madiinawa farwithum laasge fi udaamhumwa yaabse karr misil al-uud.

Ya Allah,fakkir fi l-bigi foognawa asma' wa chiif eebna.

Udwaanna ragado be guma'a awiin madiinat Sahyuun.Wa fi hillaal balad Yahuuza,banno al-banaat be gu.
Wa humman allago masaa'iilna min iideehumwa ma ahtaramo al-chuyuukh.
Wa l-chabaab chaaloal-murhaaka al-tagiilewa l-subyaan attarta'omin tagalat al-hatab.
Wa l-chuyuukh ma macho le l-majlaswa l-chabaab khallo khineehum.
Wa l-farah waddar min guluubnawa li'ibna albaddal be hizin.
Wa taajna waga' min raasna.Ya khasaaritna,da achaan aznabna.
Wa fi chaan da bas,guluubna waja'oonawa uyuunna ma bichiifu adiil.
Aywa,jabal Sahyuun khiribwa ba'aachiim saakniin foogah.
Ya Allah-!Inta maalik ila l-abadwa archak kula gaa'idmin zurriiye le zurriiye.
Maala inta nisiitna daayman-?Wa maala khalleetna tuul al-wakit-?
Ya Allah,akhbalnawa aniina nigabbulu leekwa jaddid gudritnamisil fi l-zaman al-faat.
Maala khidibt leena ziyaadawa rafadtina marra waahid-?
Wa fi l-yoom al-khaamis hana l-chahar al-raabi' fi l-sana al-talaatiin min umri,ana Hizgiyaal gaa'id ambeen al-naas al-waddoohum fi l-khurba fi balad Baabil jamb bahar Khaabuur.Wa l-sama anfatahat wa ana chift ru'ya min al-Rabb.
Wa da fi l-yoom al-khaamis hana l-chahar da fi l-sana al-khaamse min waddo Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza fi l-khurba.
Wa hinaak fi balad Baabil gariib le bahar Khaabuur,Allah hajja leyi ana Hizgiyaal wileed Buuzi raajil al-diin.Wa hinaak gudrat Allah gaa'ide foogi.
Wa daahu ana chift riih amzooba'aane jaaye min munchaakh.Wa jaabat sahaabaay kabiire muhawwaga be deyy al-tamrug minha barraaga.Wa fi usutha fi cheyy yiraari misil nahaas saafi.
Wa fi lubb al-sahaabaay,chift cheyy al-yichaabih arba'a makhluugiin wa chakilhum misil chakil al-insaan.
Wa ayyi makhluug indah arba'a wijih wa arba'a janaahe.
Wa rijleehum udul wa machchaayaathum misil dalaafe al-ijil wa yiraaru misil nahaas saafi.
