Wa tihit ayyi jinh,fiyah iid misil iid insaan.Ayyi naayit min nawaaytah al-arba'a indah iid wa wijih wa jinh.
Wa ayyi makhluug,janaaheeh yilammusu ma'a janaahe al-makhluug al-aakhar.Wa wakit al-makhluugiin yamchu,ma yinlaftu wa laakin yamchu adiil giddaamhum.
Wa ayyi makhluug indah arba'a wijih.Min giddaam,indah wijih hana insaan wa be l-zeene,indah wijih hana duud wa be l-isra,indah wijih hana toor wa min wara,indah wijih hana sagur.
Wa dool wujuuhhum.Wa ayyi makhluug indah janaahe itneen mumattatiin foog wa yilammusu ma'a janaahe al-makhluug al-aakhar.Wa janaaheeh al-itneen al-aakhariin kamaan,yikhatti beehum jismah.
Wa ayyi makhluug yamchi adiil giddaamah wa yamchi ale l-jiihe al-yamchi aleeha al-ruuh.Wa ma yinlafit wakit hu maachi.
Wa l-makhluugiin dool yichaabuhu jamur hana naar al-tahrig wa yichaabuhu machaahiib al-naar.Wa l-naar di tamchi ambeen al-makhluugiin dool.Wa l-naar di tidawwi wa tamrug minha barraaga.
Wa l-makhluugiin dool yamchu wa yaju be sur'a misil al-barraaga.
Wakit ana gaa'id nichiif fi l-makhluugiin al-induhum arba'a wijih dool,daahu chift jamb ayyi makhluug fiyah ajala fi l-ard.
Wa l-ajalaat biraaru misil sana'oohum be hajar khaali wa l-ajalaat al-arba'a dool bichchaabaho.Wa masnuu'iin misil ajala waahide fi lubb ajala aakhara.
Wa wakit yamchu,yagdaro yamchu fi ayyi jiihe bala ma yinlaftu.
Wa daayir hana ayyi ajala,tuulah foog bikhawwif.Wa ayyi daayir muhawwag be uyuun.
Wa wakit al-makhluugiin yamchu,al-ajalaat kula yamchu ma'aahum.Wa wakit al-makhluugiin yinraf'u foog min al-ard,al-ajalaat kula yinraf'u.
Wa l-makhluugiin yamchu ale l-jiihe al-yamchi aleeha al-ruuh wa l-ajalaat kula yinraf'u ma'aahum.Achaan ruuh al-makhluugiin dool gaa'ide fi l-ajalaat.
Wa wakit al-makhluugiin yamchu,al-ajalaat kula yamchu wa wakit yagiifu,al-ajalaat kula yagiifu wa wakit yinraf'u min al-ard,al-ajalaat kula yinraf'u ma'aahum achaan ruuh al-makhluugiin dool gaa'ide fi l-ajalaat.
Wa min foog le ruuse al-makhluugiin dool,fi cheyy gawi mafruuch wa hu ajiib,yiraari misil gazzaaz wa gaa'id min foog le ruuse al-makhluugiin.
Wa tihit al-cheyy al-mafruuch da,ayyi makhluug indah janaahe itneen yilammusu ma'a janaahe al-makhluug al-aakhar.Wa janaaheeh al-itneen al-aakhariin kamaan,yikhatti beehum jismah.
Wa wakit al-makhluugiin maachiin,ana gaa'id nasma' harakat janaaheehum wa da misil harakat matara tagiile wa misil hiss al-Gaadir wa misil hiss naas katiiriin wa misil harakat deech kabiir.Wa wakit yagiifu,yidallu janaaheehum.
Wa hiss jaayi min foog le l-cheyy al-gawi al-mafruuch al-gaa'id min foog le ruuse al-makhluugiin.
Wa min foog le l-cheyy al-gawi al-mafruuch,fi cheyy yichaabih arch min hajar hana yaakhuut akhdar.Wa foog al-arch da,fi chakil yichaabih insaan.
Wa min sulbah lahaddi foog,ana chift kadar yiraari misil nahaas saafi wa muhawwag be naar.Wa min sulbah lahaddi tihit,ana chift deyy hana naar muhawwigah min kulli jiihe.
Wa l-deyy al-muhawwigah yichaabih hajjaaz al-matar al-yibiin fi l-sahaab fi yoom al-matar.Wa majd Allah hu misil ke.Wa wakit ana chiftah,waga't be wijhi fi l-ard wa simi't hiss gaa'id yihajji.
Wa l-hiss da gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam-!Gumm be tuulak wa ana nihajji leek.
Wa min hu hajja leyi al-kalaam da,tawwaali al-ruuh dakhal foogi wa waggafaani be tuuli wa ana gaa'id nasma' al-yihajji leyi.
Wa l-hiss gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,ana nirassilak le Bani Israa'iil humman umma aasiye al-gammat diddi.Humman wa juduudhum atmarrado diddi lahaddi l-yoom.
Aywa,ana nirassilak le naas al-wujuuhhum dulum wa guluubhum gawiyiin wa inta guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:
"Humman cha'ab aasiyiin.Kan yasma'ook walla kan ma yasma'ook kula,ya'arfu tamaam kadar fi nabi gaa'id fi usuthum."--
Asma',ya ibn Adam,ma takhaaf minhum wa la takhaaf min kalaamhum.Achaan inta gaa'id fi ust al-naas al-yangudu kalaamak wa humman misil chook wa agaarib al-inta gaa'id fooghum.Ma takhaaf min kalaamhum wa la min wujuuhhum achaan humman cha'ab aasiyiin.
Wa inta guul leehum kalaami kan yasma'ooh walla ma yasma'ooh kula achaan humman aasiyiin.
Ya ibn Adam,asma' al-nuguulah leek.Ma tabga misil al-cha'ab al-aasiyiin dool.Wa aftah khachmak wa aakul al-cheyy al-nantiih leek.
Wa daahu chift iid mamduuda aleyi wa indaha kitaab malfuuf.
Wa fallat al-kitaab da giddaami wa hu maktuub min jaay wa jaay.Wa maktuub foogah kalaam hana nuwaah wa hizin wa ta'ab.
Wa l-hiss gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,aakulah.Aakul al-kitaab al-malfuuf da wa amchi kallim le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,ana fataht khachmi wa hu akkalaani al-kitaab al-malfuuf da.
Wa gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,amla batnak wa achbi' nafsak be l-kitaab al-malfuuf al-ana gaa'id nantiih leek da. Wa ana akaltah wa da bigi leyi halu fi khachmi misil asal.
Wa gaal leyi battaan-:-Ya ibn Adam,amchi le Bani Israa'iil wa hajji leehum be kalaami.
Ana ma nirassilak le cha'ab al-lukhkhithum gawiiye wa kalaamhum ma yin'arif laakin nirassilak le Bani Israa'iil.
Ana ma nirassilak le chu'uub al-lukhkhithum gawiiye wa kalaamhum ma yin'arif hatta kan inta ma tafham kalaamhum kula.Kan ana rassaltak kula,akiid humman yasma'ook.
Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil ma yidooru yasma'ook inta achaan humman ma yidooru yasma'ooni ana.Wa kulla Bani Israa'iil ruuseehum wa guluubhum kula gawiyiin.
Wa daahu ana nantiik wijih adlam ziyaada min wujuuhhum wa nigawwi raasak ziyaada min ruuseehum.
Wa nisawwi raasak gawi misil al-maass wa l-hajar.Ma takhaaf minhum wa la tinbahit giddaamhum achaan humman cha'ab aasiyiin.
Wa l-hiss gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,aftah adaanak wa ahfad fi galbak kulla l-kalaam al-nuguulah leek.
Yalla-!Amchi le l-naas al-jaaboohum fi l-khurba al-humman iyaal cha'abak wa hajji leehum.Wa kan yasma'ook walla ma yasma'ook kula,inta guul leehum-:--Daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb.-
Wa khalaas,Ruuh Allah rafa'aani foog wa ana simi't hiss chadiid al-buguul-:-Mubaarak majd Allah fi maskanah.
Wa ana simi't harakat janaahe al-makhluugiin al-gaa'idiin yindarbu ambeenaathum wa harakat al-ajalaat al-jambuhum wa di haraka chadiide.
Wa l-ruuh rafa'aani foog wa waddaani wa ana macheet be khadab chadiid fi nafsi.Wa gudrat Allah gaa'ide foogi be chidde.
Wa be da,ana jiit le l-naas al-jaaboohum fi l-khurba al-saakniin jamb bahar Khaabuur fi hillit Tall Abiib fi Baabil.Wa hinaak,ana ga'adt sab'a yoom mutahayyir fi usuthum.
Wa ba'ad al-sab'a yoom da,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,ana nukhuttak haras fi Bani Israa'iil.Kan simi't kalaam min khachmi,tihazzirhum beyah.
Wa kan nuguul le l-aasi hu yumuut wa inta ma tihajji leyah wa la tihazzirah min derbah al-fasil le hayaatah tanja,al-aasi da kan yumuut fi khataayah,ana natlub dimmitah minnak.
Wa laakin kan inta hazzart al-aasi wa hu aba ma yikhalli isyaanah walla derbah al-fasil,khalaas hu yumuut fi khataayah wa laakin inta najjeet nafsak.
Wa kan naadum saalih gabbal min adaaltah wa gamma yisawwi zulum,ana nukhutt giddaamah hajar wa hu yintagga foogah wa yumuut.Wa kan inta ma hazzartah,khalaas hu yumuut be sabab zanbah wa ma yizzakkaro al-adaala al-hu sawwaaha awwal.Wa laakin minnak inta,ana natlub dimmitah.
Wa be l-aks,kan inta hazzart naadum saalih le ma yaznib wa l-naadum da ma aznab,khalaas hu yi'iich achaan inta hazzartah.Wa inta kula najjeet nafsak.
Wa fi l-wakit da,gudrat Allah gaa'ide foogi wa hu gaal leyi-:-Gumm-!Amchi al-waadi wa ana nihajji leek.
Wa ana gammeet wa macheet al-waadi wa daahu ana chift majd Allah waagif misil al-majd al-ana chiftah fi khachum bahar Khaabuur.Wa khalaas,ana waga't be wijhi fi l-ard.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal foogi wa gawwamaani be tuuli.Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:-Ta'aal wa sidd nafsak fi beetak.
Asma',ya ibn Adam,yijiibu hubaal wa yirabbutuuk wa battaan ma tamrug fi ust al-naas.
Ana nilassig leek lisaanak fi sug'ak.Tabga abkam wa ma tagdar tuluumhum achaan humman cha'ab aasiyiin.
Wa laakin wakit nikallim leek,ana nufukk khachmak wa inta tihajji leehum wa tuguul-:--Daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb.- Al-yidoor yasma',khalli yasma' wa l-ma yidoor yasma',khalli ma yasma' achaan humman cha'ab aasiyiin.
Wa Allah gaal leyi battaan-:-Asma',ya ibn Adam,chiil diringeelaay wa khuttaha giddaamak wa arsim foogha suurat Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi l-diringeelaay di,wassif hisaar al-madiina wa abni diddaha khanaadig wa radmiiye wa khutt mu'askar giddaamha wa hawwigha be maraadiis al-yuduggu beehum biibaan al-madiina.
Wa chiil saaja hint hadiid wa khuttaha beenak wa been al-madiina misil durdur.Wa wajjih ale l-madiina wa chiifha.Khalaas hi tilhaasar achaan inta khatteet al-hisaar giddaamha.Wa di alaama le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa argud be l-isra wa chiil foogak khata Bani Israa'iil.Wa tichiil khataahum tuul al-ayyaam al-inta raagid fooghum be nussak da.
Wa ana nagta' leek adad al-ayyaam al-muwaafig le adad al-siniin hana khataahum.Wa be da,tichiil khata Bani Israa'iil le muddit 390 yoom.
Wa ba'ad tikammil al-ayyaam dool,battaan targud be l-zeene wa tichiil foogak khata Bani Yahuuza le muddit 40 yoom.Wa be da,nagta' leek yoom waahid le ayyi sana hana khataahum.
Wa wajjih ale suurat Madiinat al-Khudus al-muhaasara wa midd duraa'ak makchuuf wa atnabba' diddaha.
Wa daahu ana nirabbitak be hubaal achaan ma tagdar tichchaglab min nussak al-waahid ale l-aakhar lahaddi tikammil ayyaam al-hisaar.
Wa chiil gameh ahmar wa gameh abyad wa lubya wa adas wa dura wa gameh hana l-kadaade wa khuttuhum fi maa'uun waahid.Wa sawwi minhum khubza al-taakulha fi muddit al-ayyaam al-inta raagid fooghum be nussak wa da le muddit 390 yoom.
Wa aklak al-taakulah da be miiz misil malyit iid itneen fi l-yoom wa da bas yabga aklak fi ayyi yoom.
Wa almi charaabak kula be miiz wa da misil rubu' kooro fi l-yoom wa da bas yabga charaabak fi ayyi yoom.
Inta tisawwi kisaar hana gameh abyad al-tisallilah giddaam kulla l-naas fi naar al-mugabbada be huraar hana naas.
Wa Allah gaal battaan-:-Aywa,misil da Bani Israa'iil yaakulu khubzithum al-munajjasa wakit ana natrudhum wa yamchu fi l-khurba fi ust al-umam.
Wa ana raddeet wa gult-:-Ya Allah al-Rabb,be huraar hana naas-!Abadan ana ma najjast nafsi min ana sakhayyar.Wa lahaddi l-yoom,ana wa la akalt rimme wa la jiife hana haywaan mayyit.Wa fi khachmi,ma dakhkhalt laham fatiis.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Kan ke da,khalaas gabbid naarak be ba'ar al-bagar fi badal huraar al-naas wa inta sawwi beyah aklak.
Wa gaal leyi battaan-:-Ya ibn Adam,ana nigallil al-ma'aach fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa humman yaakulu al-khubza be miiz wa hamm wa yacharbo almi kula be miiz wa khoof.
Wa be da,al-khubza wa l-almi yabgo ma fiihum.Wa ayyi waahid yahzan wa yabtul be sabab khataahum.
Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,chiil seef tariin wa asta'malah misil muus wa zayyin beyah raasak wa dignak.Wa ba'ad da,chiil miizaan wa awzin suufak wa gassimah ale talaata bakaan.
Wa wakit ayyaam al-hisaar yikammulu,chiil tilit al-suuf da wa harrigah fi usut suurat al-madiina di.Wa l-tilit,adurbah be seefak wa hawwig beyah suurat al-madiina.Wa l-tilit,chattitah fi l-riih achaan ana natrud cha'abi be seefi.
Wa laakin chiil chiyya min al-suuf da wa surrah fi khalagak.
Wa min al-sarreetah da,chiil suuf chiyya wa harrigah fi l-naar.Achaan tamrug naar didd kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Di bas Madiinat al-Khudus-!Ana khatteetha fi ust al-umam wa l-umam dool muhawwigiinha.
Wa sukkaanha iso gawaaniini be fasaala ziyaada min al-umam wa iso churuuti ziyaada min al-buldaan al-muhawwigiinha.Wa da achaan humman rafado gawaaniini wa ma taaba'o churuuti.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Intu gammeetu be barjaal ziyaada min al-umam al-muhawwigiinku wa ma taaba'tu churuuti wa la tabbagtu gawaaniini.Wa ma tabbagtu hatta gawaaniin al-umam al-muhawwigiinku-!
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Akiid ana kula gammeet diddiki,ya Madiinat al-Khudus wa nihaakimki giddaam kulla l-umam.
Wa be sabab kulla l-haraam al-sawweetiih,ana nisawwi foogki cheyy al-abadan ma sawweetah wa abadan ma nisawwiih battaan.
Wa be da fi lubbiki,al-abbahaat yaakulu iyaalhum wa l-iyaal yaakulu abbahaathum.Ana nihaakimki wa l-yifaddulu minki,nichattithum fi l-riih.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:-Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,akiid inti najjasti beeti al-mukhaddas be kulla muharramaatki wa asnaamki.Wa be sabab da,nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,ana kula nuguchchiki wa ma nichiifki be een al-rahma wa la nihinn foogki.
Wa tilit sukkaanki yumuutu be l-waba wa l-juu' yikammilhum fi usutki.Wa l-tilit yumuutu be l-seef fi hawaaleeki wa l-tilit nichattithum fi l-riih wa natrudhum be l-seef.
Ana ninazzil khadabi didduhum min bidaaytah lahaddi nihaaytah.Wa be da,humman ya'arfu kadar da,ana Allah bas gultah fi khiirti lahaddi nitimm khadabi al-chadiid didduhum.
Wa ana nisawwiiki kharaab wa aaybe giddaam al-umam al-muhawwigiinki wa giddaam ayyi naadum al-yufuut jambiki.
Wa ana nihaakimki be za'al wa khadab wa nuluumki luwaama chadiide.Wa l-umam al-muhawwigiinki,ya Madiinat al-Khudus,yichchammato foogki wa yi'ayyuruuki.Wa inti tabge leehum masal mukhiif.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah.
Wa nizarrig diddiki nachaachiib al-juu' al-fasil le yidammuruuki wa niziid foogki al-juu' wa nigallil ma'aachki.
Wa nirassil leeki al-juu' wa haywaanaat fasliin yaju yaakulu iyaalki.Wa l-waba wa l-unuf yi'addu beeki wa nigawwim al-harib diddiki.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah.
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale jibaal Israa'iil wa atnabba' didduhum.
Wa guul-:--Ya jibaal Israa'iil-!Asma'o kalaam Allah al-Rabb.Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb hajja le l-jibaal wa l-hujaar wa l-rujuul wa l-wudyaan wa gaal-:"Daahu ana nijiib leeku al-harib wa nihaddim bakaanaatku al-aaliyiin hana ibaadat al-asnaam.
Wa madaabihku yakhrabo wa makhaabirku yilkassaro wa ana narmi maytiinku giddaam asnaamku."--
Wa ana nukhutt janaazaat Bani Israa'iil giddaam asnaamku wa nichattit udaamku hawaale madaabihku.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan al-taskunu foogah,al-mudun yakhrabo wa l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin yilhaddamo.Wa madaabihku yakhrabo wa yiddammaro wa asnaamku yilkassaro wa yaga'o tihit wa makhaabirku yilkassaro wa khidmitku tiddammar.
Wa maytiinku yaga'o fi usutku wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa laakin ana nifaddil minku naas hayyiin ma yumuutu fi l-harib wa nichattithum fi ust al-umam.
Wa naasku al-faddalo yizzakkarooni fi ust al-umam fi l-bakaan al-waddoohum foogah fi l-khurba.Wa ana nibaddil guluubhum al-beehum ba''ado minni wa achcharmato wara l-asnaam wa uyuunhum al-beehum achcharmato wara asnaamhum.Wa l-eeb yakrubhum be sabab al-fasaala al-sawwooha wa be sabab kulla muharramaathum.
Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah wa kan gult nisawwi fooghum al-fasaala di,da ma kalaam saakit.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal leyi-:-Ya Hizgiyaal,adrub kaffeenak wa adrub be rijlak fi l-turaab wa guul-:--Ya khasaaritna-!- Wa da fi chaan kulla l-fasaala al-muharrama al-sawwooha Bani Israa'iil.Wa hassa',yumuutu be l-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba.
Wa l-yamchu ba'iid yumuutu be l-waba wa l-gariibiin yumuutu be l-harib wa l-faddalo hayyiin yumuutu be l-juu' lahaddi nitammim fooghum khadabi.
Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah wakit yichiifu maytiinhum giddaam asnaamhum wa hawaale madaabihhum wa foog ayyi hajar aali wa fi raas ayyi jabal wa tihit ayyi chadara khadra wa ayyi chadara dalma.Wa dool al-bakaanaat al-gaddamo fooghum dahaaya le asnaamhum le yardo be riihithum.
Ana nimidd iidi didduhum wa didd ayyi bakaan al-yaskunu foogah.Wa l-balad di min al-sahara lahaddi Dibla,nisawwiiha kharaab wa jafaaf.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Asma',ya ibn Adam-!Daahu Allah al-Rabb hajja le sukkaan balad Israa'iil wa gaal-:--Di hi al-nihaaya-!Al-nihaaya taji fi l-arba'a jiihaat hana l-balad.
Wa hassa',jaat nihaayitku intu.Ana nirassil khadabi didduku wa nihaakimku hasab deribku al-chiltuuh wa nihammilku natiijat amalku al-muharram.
Wa ma nichiifku be een al-rahma wa la nihinn foogku achaan nihammilku natiijat deribku al-chiltuuh wa kulla amalku al-muharram yagood fi usutku.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.-
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Masiibe,masiibe al-ma fi misilha,di hi jaaye-!
Al-nihaaya jaaye-!Aywa,al-nihaaya hi jaaye.Hi gammat didduku wa di hi jaaye-!
Wa ikhaabku jaayi,ya sukkaan al-balad-!Wakitku jaayi,al-yoom garrab wa da yoom hana barjaal wa ma hana farah fi l-jibaal.
Wa hassa',gariib ninazzil khadabi foogku min bidaaytah lahaddi nihaaytah.Wa nihaakimku hasab deribku al-chiltuuh wa nihammilku natiijat kulla amalku al-muharram.
Wa ma nichiifku be een al-rahma wa la nihinn foogku achaan nihammilku hasab deribku al-chiltuuh wa kulla amalku al-muharram yagood fi usutku.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana Allah bas darabtuku.
Wa daahu al-yoom,daahu ikhaabku jaayi-!Al-unuf zaad wa l-istikbaar kitir.
Wa l-unuf gamma wa bigi asa hint fasaala.Ma fi cheyy yifaddil minhum wa harakathum kula tingati' wa katarathum wa jamaalhum kula yabgo ma fiihum.
Wakitku jaayi,al-yoom garrab-!Khalli al-yachri ma yafrah wa l-yibii' ma yahzan achaan al-khadab al-chadiid yidammir kulla naas al-balad.
Wa l-yibii' ma yigabbil le budaa'tah hatta kan hu hayy kula.Achaan ru'yat al-muhaakama di kula ma tafchul,hi didd kulla naas al-balad.Wa ayyi naadum yi'iich fi khataayah wa abadan ma yagdar yinajji nafsah.
Kan yadurbu al-buug wa yijahhuzu silaahhum kula,naadum waahid kula ma yamchi le l-harib achaan khadabi yidammir kulla naas al-balad.
Barra fi l-kadaade,harib-!Wa daakhal fi l-madiina,waba wa juu'-!Ayyi naadum al-fi l-kadaade yumuut be l-harib wa ayyi naadum al-fi l-madiina yumuut be l-waba wa l-juu'.
Wa l-faddalo minhum yi'arrudu wa yajru yillabbado fi l-jibaal.Wa kulluhum yabku be hizin misil gimri al-waadi be sabab khataahum.
Kulla iideehum yinrakhuwa kulla rikabbuhum yumuu'u.
Wa yalbaso khulgaan al-hizinwa khoof chadiid yakrubhum.Wa l-eeb binchaaf fi wujuuhhumwa kulla ruuseehum,yizayyunuuhum.
Wa yazgulu fuddithum fi l-chawaari'wa dahabhum yabga leehum misil najaasa.Dahabhum wa fuddithum ma yinajjuuhumfi yoom khadabi ana Allah.Humman ma yagdaro yarwu nufuushumwa la yamlo butuunhum.Dahabhum wa fuddithum al-sawwoohum asnaambigo sabab khataahum.
Aywa,awwal humman astakbarobe sabab jamaal ziinithum.Wa be ziinithum,sawwo asnaamhum al-muharramiinal-yijiibu leehum al-karaahiiyewa fi chaan da,nisawwi ziinithum nijse.
Wa nisallimha le l-ajaanibwa humman yanhabooha.Wa nantiiha khaniime le aasiyiin al-ardwa ma yaj'alooha.
Wa ana ma niwajjih ale cha'abiwakit ma yihtarumu beeti al-khaali leyi.Wa saraariig yadkhulu foogahwa ma yaj'alooh mukhaddas.
Sawwi janaaziir achaan al-balad malaanebe muhaakamat kattaaliin al-dimamwa l-madiina malaane be l-unuf.
Wa nijiib afsal umamachaan yichiilu buyuuthum.Wa niwaggif istikbaar al-gawiyiinwa bakaanaathum hana l-ibaada yinnajjaso.
Wa daahu al-khoof chadiid jaayiwa humman yifattuchu al-salaam wa ma yalgooh.
Wa taji masiibe wara masiibewa khabar cheen wara khabar cheen.Kan yifattuchu ru'ya min nabi kula,ma yalgoohawa raajil al-diinma yi'allim churuut al-Tawraatwa l-chuyuukh kulama induhum choora.
Wa l-malik yahzanwa l-cheekh yibarjilwa iideen al-cha'ab yarjufu.Wa nihaakimhumhasab deribhum al-chaaloohwa nichaari'humhasab al-charii'a al-sawwooha.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi l-yoom al-khaamis hana l-chahar al-saadis fi l-sana al-saadse min waddoona fi l-khurba,ana gaa'id fi beeti.Wa fi l-yoom da,chuyuukh Bani Yahuuza kula gaa'idiin giddaami wa khalaas,gudrat Allah al-Rabb nazalat foogi.
Wa tawwaali,ana chift ru'ya wa daahu ana chift cheyy yichaabih insaan.Wa min sulbah lahaddi tihit,hu hana naar.Wa min sulbah lahaddi foog,yiraari misil al-nahaas al-saafi.
Wa hu madda misil iid wa karabaani min suuf raasi.Wa l-ruuh da rafa'aani foog ambeen al-sama wa l-ard.Wa fi l-ru'ya al-min al-Rabb di,hu waddaani fi beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hinaak,hu waddaani fi khachum al-baab al-mugaabil munchaakh hana l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye.Wa da l-bakaan al-yinlagi foogah sanam al-khiira al-yigawwim khiirat Allah.
Wa tawwaali,baan majd Ilaah Bani Israa'iil misil al-ru'ya al-awwal ana chiftaha fi l-waadi.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,arfa' raasak wa chiif munchaakh. Wa ana rafa't raasi wa chift munchaakh wa daahu chift sanam al-khiira munchaakh fi khachum al-baab al-yiwaddi le l-madbah.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,inta chift al-cheyy al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuh walla-?Wa chift al-muharramaat al-kubaar al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuhum Bani Israa'iil le yiba''uduuni min beeti al-mukhaddas walla-?Wa laakin tichiif muharramaat aakhariin kubaar ziyaada min dool-!
Wa ba'ad da,hu waddaani fi baab al-fadaay al-barraaniiye hana beet Allah wa daahu ana chift nugra fi l-durdur.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,gidd al-durdur. Wa ana gaddeet al-durdur wa khalaas,bigi derib.
Wa hu gaal leyi battaan-:-Adkhul wa chiif al-muharramaat al-fasliin al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuhum hini-!
Ana dakhalt wa daahu chift rasim hana kulla l-zawaahif wa l-haywaanaat al-nijsiin marra waahid wa kulla asnaam Bani Israa'iil marsuumiin fi ayyi bakaan fi l-durdur.
Wa 70 raajil min chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil al-fi usuthum Yazanya wileed Chaafaan waagfiin giddaam al-asnaam al-marsuumiin dool.Wa ayyi waahid indah mukhbar fi iidah wa riihit al-dukhkhaan gaa'ide tatla'.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,inta chift al-cheyy al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuh chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil fi l-dalaam,ayyi waahid giddaam sanamah walla-?Wa buguulu-:--Allah ma yagdar yichiifna-!Allah khalla baladna-!-
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Laakin tichiif muharramaat aakhariin kubaar ziyaada min dool al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuhum-!
Wa hu waddaani fi khachum al-baab al-munchaakhi hana beet Allah.Wa fi l-bakaan da,fi awiin gaa'idaat tihit yabkan le ilaahhin al-usmah Tamuuz.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,inta gaa'id tichiif walla-?Wa laakin tichiif muharramaat aakhariin kubaar ziyaada min dool-!
Wa hu waddaani daakhal fi fadaayit beet Allah al-dakhlaaniiye.Wa daahu fi khachum beet Allah ambeen khurfit al-madkhal wa l-madbah,fiyah hawaale 25 raajil.Anto duhuurhum le beet Allah wa wajjaho sabaah ale l-harraay wa sajado leeha.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,inta gaa'id tichiif walla-?Da chiyya-!Bani Yahuuza yisawwu muharramaat ziyaada min dool.Yikhaddubuuni wa yamlo al-balad be l-unuf wa yi'ayyuruuni mu'yaar khatiir-!
Wa ana kula nakhdab didduhum wa ma nichiifhum be een al-rahma wa la nihinn fooghum.Wa wakit yasrakho leyi,ana ma nasma'hum-!
Wa Allah naada be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Ta'aalu intu al-ti'aakhubu al-madiina-!Wa khalli ayyi waahid yichiil silaahah hana l-kharaab-!
Wa daahu ana chift sitte rujaal jaayiin min al-baab al-aali al-mugaabil munchaakh wa ayyi waahid indah silaahah hana l-kharaab fi iidah.Wa fi usuthum,fiyah raajil waahid laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh wa indah khalam hana kuttaab fi sulbah.Kulluhum jo wa wagafo jamb al-madbah hana l-nahaas.
Wa majd Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil al-gaa'id min foog le l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin gamma macha ale atabat al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa naada al-raajil al-laabis khalag min gumaach sameh al-indah khalam hana kuttaab fi sulbah.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Amchi fi ust Madiinat al-Khudus wa sawwi alaama fi jabhaat al-naas al-gaa'idiin yaguntu wa yachku be sabab kulla l-muharramaat al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuhum fi lubbaha.
Wa battaan simi't Allah gaal le l-rujaal al-aakhariin-:-Amchu wara l-kaatib fi l-madiina wa aktulu sukkaanha-!Wa khalli ma tichiifuuhum be een al-rahma wa la tihinnu fooghum.
Kharrubu wa aktulu al-chiyyaab wa l-subyaan wa l-banaat wa l-atfaal wa l-awiin.Wa laakin ma tilammusu ayyi naadum al-indah alaama fi jabhitah.Wa abdo min hini,min beeti al-mukhaddas. Wa khalaas,bado be l-katil hana l-chuyuukh al-gaa'idiin giddaam beet Allah.
Wa hu gaal le l-rujaal-:-Najjusu beeti wa amlo fadaayaatah be l-maytiin-!Yalla amchu-! Wa humman macho wa katalo naas fi l-madiina.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yaktulu,ana gaa'id wiheedi.Wa waga't be wijhi fi l-ard wa sarakht wa gult-:-Ya Allah Rabbi-!Wakit tinazzil khadabak fi Madiinat al-Khudus,hal tidammir kulla l-faddalo min Bani Israa'iil walla-?
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Khata Bani Israa'iil wa Bani Yahuuza da kabiir marra waahid-!Al-balad anmalat be l-damm wa l-madiina anmalat be l-zulum.Achaan humman gaalo-:--Allah khalla baladna-!Hu ma yagdar yichiifna-!--
Wa be da,ma nichiifhum be een al-rahma wa la nihinn fooghum.Wa nihammilhum kulla natiijat amalhum.
Wa ba'ad da,al-raajil al-laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh wa indah khalam hana l-kuttaab fi sulbah gabbal jaab al-natiija wa gaal-:-Ana sawweet kulla cheyy hasab amrak.
Wa daahu ana chift al-cheyy al-gawi al-mafruuch al-gaa'id min foog le ruuse al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.Wa chift cheyy yichaabih arch min hajar hana yaakhuut akhdar.
Wa min al-arch,Allah hajja wa gaal le l-raajil al-laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh-:-Adkhul fi lubb daayirat al-ajalaat al-tihit al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.Wa amla iideenak jamur min been al-makhluugiin dool.Wa chattit al-jamur da fi l-madiina. Wa ana chift al-raajil da dakhal.
Wa wakit al-raajil dakhal,al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin waagfiin wati le beet Allah.Wa sahaabaay malat al-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye.
Wa majd Allah gamma min al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin wa macha ale atabat al-beet.Wa l-beet anmala be l-sahaabaay wa l-fadaay anmalat be nuur majd Allah.
Wa harakat janaahe al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin ansama'at lahaddi fi l-fadaay al-barraaniiye wa l-haraka di misil hiss Allah al-Gaadir wakit yihajji.
Wa wakit Allah amar al-raajil al-laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh wa gaal leyah yichiil jamur min lubb al-daayira ambeen al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin,al-raajil macha wagaf jamb al-ajalaat.
Wa makhluug samaawi waahid madda iidah ale l-naar ambeen al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin wa khamma jamur wa mala beyah iideen al-raajil al-laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh.Wa l-raajil chaal al-jamur wa marag.
Wa tihit janaahe al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin,fiyah iid misil iid insaan.
Wa daahu ana chift arba'a ajalaat jamb al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin,ayyi ajala jamb makhluug samaawi waahid.Wa l-ajalaat dool biraaru misil sana'oohum be hajar khaali.
Wa l-ajalaat al-arba'a dool bichchaabaho wa masnuu'iin misil ajala waahide fi lubb al-aakhara.
Wa wakit yamchu,yagdaro yamchu fi ayyi jiihe bala ma yinlaftu.Yamchu ale l-jiihe al-yiwajjih aleeha al-raas wa ma yinlaftu.
Wa kulla l-jilid wa l-dahar wa l-iideen wa l-janaahe hana l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin wa l-ajalaat al-arba'a,kulluhum muhawwigiin be uyuun.
Wa simi't naado al-ajalaat dool al-ajalaat al-yuduuru.
Wa ayyi makhluug samaawi indah arba'a wijih.Al-wijih al-waahid hana makhluug samaawi wa l-wijih al-waahid hana insaan wa l-wijih al-waahid hana duud wa l-wijih al-waahid hana sagur.
Wa ba'ad da,al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin anrafa'o foog.Wa dool nafs al-makhluugiin al-chiftuhum jamb bahar Khaabuur.
Wa wakit al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin yamchu,al-ajalaat kula yamchu ma'aahum.Wa wakit al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin yimattutu janaaheehum le yinraf'u min al-ard,al-ajalaat kula ma yinfargu minhum laakin yinraf'u ma'aahum.
Wa wakit al-makhluugiin yagiifu,al-ajalaat kula yagiifu wa wakit yinraf'u,al-ajalaat kula yinraf'u ma'aahum achaan ruuh al-makhluugiin dool gaa'ide fi l-ajalaat.
Wa ba'ad da,majd Allah gamma min atabat al-beet wa wagaf min foog le l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.
Wa khalaas,ana chift al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin mattato janaaheehum wa anrafa'o min al-ard wa macho sawa ma'a l-ajalaat.Wa majd Allah wagaf fi khachum al-baab al-sabhaani hana beet Allah wa majd Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaa'id min foog le l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.
Wa dool al-makhluugiin al-chiftuhum tihit Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil fi bahar Khaabuur wa irift kadar dool bas al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin.
Wa l-arba'a makhluugiin samaawiyiin dool,ayyi waahid indah arba'a wijih wa arba'a janaahe wa tihit janaaheehum,fiyah iid misil iid insaan.
Wa wujuuhhum yichaabuhu wujuuh al-makhluugiin al-ana chiftuhum jamb bahar Khaabuur wa dool bas humman.Wa ayyi waahid yamchi adiil giddaamah.
Wa l-ruuh rafa'aani foog wa waddaani fi l-baab al-sabhaani hana beet Allah al-mugaabil taluu' al-harraay.Wa fi khachum al-baab da,ana chift 25 raajil wa fi usuthum,chiif kubaaraat itneen hana l-cha'ab wa humman Yaazanya wileed Azzuur wa Falatya wileed Banaaya.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,dool al-rujaal al-yikhattutu al-zulum wa yiwassu be l-fasaala fi l-madiina di.
Wa humman yuguulu-:--Yoom al-ikhaab lissaa' ba'iid-!Khalli nabnu buyuutna.Achaan al-madiina di aamine misil burma wa aniina misil al-laham al-fi lubbaha.--
Ya ibn Adam-!Fi chaan kalaamhum da,atnabba' didduhum-!Aywa,atnabba'-.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal foogi wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Hajji wa guul-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Ya Bani Israa'iil,intu hajjeetu misil da.Wa l-gaa'id fi fikirku kula,ana na'arfah.
Intu kattartu al-katil fi l-madiina di wa maleetu chawaari'ha be l-janaazaat."-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Sahiih,al-madiina di,hi misil burma wa laakin al-janaazaat al-daffagtuuhum fi lubbaha,humman bas al-laham.Wa laakin leeku intu kamaan,ana namrugku minha.
Intu khaayfiin min al-harib wa be da,ana nijiib leeku al-harib.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ana namrugku min al-madiina wa nisallimku le l-ajaanib wa ni'aakhibku.
Wa yaktuluuku be l-seef lahaddi huduud balad Israa'iil-!Ni'aakhibku wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
La,al-madiina ma tabga leeku misil burma aamine wa intu ma tabgo misil laham fi lubbaha-!Ana ni'aakhibku lahaddi huduud balad Israa'iil.
Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.Intu ma taaba'tu churuuti wa la tabbagtu gawaaniini wa laakin tabbagtu aadaat al-umam al-muhawwigiinku-!
Wa wakit gaa'id nitnabba',tawwaali Falatya wileed Banaaya maat.Wa ana waga't be wijhi fi l-ard wa sarakht be hiss aali wa gult-:-Ya Allah Rabbi,tidoor tikammil al-faddalo min Bani Israa'iil walla-?
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus gaa'idiin yihajju le akhwaanak wa ahalak wa kulla Bani Israa'iil al-fi l-khurba wa yuguulu-:--Agoodu hinaak ba'iid min Allah.Achaan hassa',al-balad di antooha leena aniina warasa.--
Wa fi chaan da,guul le l-naas al-fi l-khurba-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Hatta kan ana ba''adtuku fi l-umam wa chattattuku fi l-buldaan kula,hadarati bigat leeku misil beet mukhaddas fi ayyi balad al-intu macheetu foogha."--
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ana nilimmuku min ust al-chu'uub wa najma'ku min al-buldaan al-intu muchattatiin fooghum wa nantiiku battaan balad Israa'iil.
Wa intu taju foogha wa tiba''udu minha kulla muharramaatha wa ayyi cheyy makruuh.
Wa nantiiku galib waahid wa nukhutt foogku ruuh jadiide.Wa namrug minku galibku al-gawi misil al-hajar wa nidiss leeku galib layyin hana insaan
achaan titaabu'u churuuti wa tahfado gawaaniini wa titabbuguuhum.Wa be da,intu tabgo cha'abi wa ana nabga Ilaahku.
Wa laakin al-galibhum marbuut be l-muharramaat wa ayyi cheyy makruuh,ana nihammilhum natiijat amalhum."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa ba'ad da,al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin mattato janaaheehum wa l-ajalaat kula macho ma'aahum wa majd Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaa'id min foog leehum.
Wa majd Allah gamma min ust al-madiina wa macha ga'ad foog fi l-jabal sabaah le l-madiina.
Wa fi l-ru'ya di,Ruuh Allah rafa'aani wa gabbalaani fi Baabil bakaan al-naas al-waddoohum fi l-khurba.Wa ba'ad da,al-ru'ya al-ana chiftaha anrafa'at minni.
Wa ana kallamt le l-naas al-waddoohum fi l-khurba be kulla cheyy al-Allah wassafah leyi.
Ya ibn Adam,inta gaa'id fi usut cha'ab aasiyiin-!Humman induhum uyuun le l-choof wa laakin ma yichiifu wa induhum udne le l-sama' wa laakin ma yasma'o achaan humman cha'ab aasiyiin.
Asma',ya ibn Adam,jahhiz khumaamak wa massil nafsak misil yiwadduuk fi l-khurba wa tabga khariib.Wa sawwi al-masal da be l-nahaar giddaamhum.Wakit gaa'idiin yichiifuuk,gumm min beetak wa massil nafsak misil khariib fi bakaan aakhar.Wa misil da,mumkin ya'arfu kadar humman cha'ab aasiyiin.
Amrug khumaamak min beetak wa da misil khumaam al-yiwaddu beyah fi l-khurba.Wa sawwi al-masal da be l-nahaar giddaamhum.Wakit gaa'idiin yichiifuuk,amrug be makhrib misil tamchi fi l-khurba.
Wa giddaamhum bas,gidd durdur beetak wa amrug khumaamak be l-khurma di.
Wa giddaamhum bas,chiilah fi kitfak wa amrug fi l-dalaam.Wa khatti wijhak le ma tichiif al-balad achaan ana nidoor nisawwiik masal le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa khalaas,ana sawweet misil Allah amaraani.Be nahaar,maragt khumaami min beeti wa da misil khumaami al-yiwadduuni beyah fi l-khurba.Wa be makhrib,gaddeet al-durdur be iidi wa maragt khumaami fi l-dalaam wa chiltah fi kitfi.Wa ana sawweet kulla l-masal da giddaamhum.
Wa be fajur,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,Bani Israa'iil al-cha'ab al-aasiyiin gaalo leek-:--Inta gaa'id tisawwi chunu-?--
Khalaas,guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Al-muhaakama di jaaye min Allah didd malik Madiinat al-Khudus wa le kulla Bani Israa'iil al-gaa'idiin foogha."--
Wa guul leehum kadar inta bigiit leehum masal wa misil inta massaltah wa sawweetah,yisawwuuh fooghum wa yakurbuuhum wa yiwadduuhum fi l-khurba.
Al-malik hana Madiinat al-Khudus yichiil khumaamah fi kitfah wa yamrug fi l-dalaam be l-khurma al-yigidduuha fi l-durdur.Wa hu yikhatti wijhah le ma yichiif al-balad.
Wa ana nukujj leyah charaki wa hu yaga' foogah wa nakurbah wa niwaddiih fi balad al-Baabiliyiin wa laakin hu ma yichiifha.Wa yumuut foogha.
Wa kulla naasah al-muhawwigiinah wa l-yi'aawunuuh wa kulla askarah,nichattithum fi kulli jiihe wa natrudhum be l-seef.
Wakit nichattithum been al-umam wa nifarrighum fi ust al-buldaan,khalaas humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa nifaddil waahidiin minhum al-yanjo min al-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba achaan yihajju be kulla muharramaathum le l-umam al-yamchu ambeenaathum.Wa be da,khalaas ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Ya ibn Adam,taakul ma'aachak be rajifiin wa tachrab almiik be barjala wa hamm.
Wa tuguul le cha'ab al-balad-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb hajja le sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-gaa'idiin fi balad Israa'iil wa gaal-:"Humman yaakulu ma'aachhum be hamm wa yacharbo almiihum be khoof achaan al-ard takhrab wa tabga faadiye min kulla cheyy al-foogha be sabab al-unuf hana kulla sukkaanha.
Wa l-mudun al-maskuuniin yakhrabo wa l-balad kula tabga kharaab.Wa be da,intu ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah."-
Ya ibn Adam,maala tihajju be l-masal da al-bukhuss balad Israa'iil-?Al-masal buguul-:--Al-ayyaam yutuulu wa ru'ya waahide kula ma tilhaggag.--
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ana namna' al-masal da wa battaan ma yihajju beyah fi Israa'iil."Wa laakin antiihum masal jadiid al-buguul-:"Al-ayyaam yaju ajala wa ayyi ru'ya tilhaggag.
Achaan ma fi battaan ru'ya kidib walla chawwafaan khachch fi lubb Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana Allah kan gult chunu kula,yilhaggag bala ta'khiir.Wa fi wakitku intu,ya l-cha'ab al-aasiyiin,ana nihaggig kalaami al-ana gultah."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,daahu Bani Israa'iil yuguulu-:--Al-ru'ya al-chaafha al-raajil da ma hana ayyaam gariibiin.Hu yitnabba' le wakit ba'iid.--
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ma fi kilme waahide kula min kalaami ti'akhkhir.Kulla kalaami al-gultah yilhaggag."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,atnabba' didd anbiya Israa'iil al-yitnabba'o be kidib.Aywa humman al-yitnabba'o hasab kalaam galibhum bas,guul leehum ke-:--Asma'o kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:Al-azaab le l-anbiya al-mataamiis al-yitaabu'u afkaarhum bala ma chaafo ru'ya.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,anbiyaaku bigo misil al-ba'aachiim fi ust al-kharaab.
Humman ma saddo al-khurma wa la bano durdur le Bani Israa'iil achaan yagdaro yasbutu fi l-harib fi yoom Allah.
Humman yichiifu ru'ya saakit wa yichawwufu be kidib wa yuguulu-:"Da kalaam Allah."Wa laakin ana Allah ma rassaltuhum.Wa battaan humman yahsubu kadar ana nihaggig kalaamhum-!
Ya l-anbiya-!Al-ru'ya al-chiftuuha di saakit wa chawwafaanku da kula kidib.Achaan intu tuguulu-:"Da kalaam Allah."Wa laakin ana ma kallamt-!-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Achaan intu hajjeetu saakit wa chawwaftu be kidib,akiid ana nugumm didduku.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa ana narfa' iidi didd al-anbiya al-yichiifu ru'ya saakit wa yichawwufu be kidib.Humman dool ma yahdaro fi malammat cha'abi wa asaameehum ma yissajjalo fi kitaab Bani Israa'iil wa humman ma yigabbulu fi balad Israa'iil.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah al-Rabb.
Wa nisawwi misil da achaan humman waddaro cha'abi wakit gaalo-:--Salaam-- wa laakin ma fi salaam.Wa da misil cha'abi induhum durdur muchaggag wa humman yitallusuuh be buhya.
Guul le l-yitallusuuh be l-buhya-:--Durdurku da yaga'-!Matara chadiide taji wa barad yidaffig wa riih chadiide tichaggigah.--
Ya l-anbiya,kan al-durdur waga',al-naas yuguulu leeku-:--Ween al-buhya al-tallastuuh beeha-?-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Fi khadabi,ana nijiib riih chadiide al-tichaggig wa fi za'ali,matara chadiide taji wa barad mudammir yidaffig.
Wa ana nahdim al-durdur al-tallastuuh be buhya wa narmiih fi l-turaab wa asaasah yibiin.Wa l-durdur da yaga' wa yarhakku tihtah.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa ana nihaggig khadabi didd al-durdur wa l-naas al-tallasooh be buhya.Wa nuguul-:--Battaan ma fi durdur wa l-naas al-tallasooh kula ma fiihum-!
Wa battaan ma fi anbiya fi Israa'iil al-yitnabba'o be Madiinat al-Khudus wa yichawwufu leeha be l-salaam wa ma fi salaam-!-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Asma',ya ibn Adam.Wajjih ale awiin cha'abak al-gaa'idaat yitnabba'an hasab kalaam guluubhin bas wa atnabba' diddihin.
Wa guul leehin-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Al-azaab le l-awiin al-yikhayyitan chadar fi git'e misil waraga le yarbutannah fi iid ayyi naadum.Aywa,al-azaab leehin al-yisawwan tarhaat hana sihir le ayyi naadum hasab al-yakfi leyah wa da le yaakulan ruuh al-naas.Hal tidooran taakulan ruuh cha'abi le ti'iichan beehum walla-?
Wa intan ma ahtaramtanni giddaam cha'abi wa da le talgan malyit iid hana gameh wa lugma hint khubza.Wakit takdiban le cha'abi al-yiriidu yasma'o al-kidib,intan taktulan al-naas al-waajib leehum al-haya wa tikhallan hayyiin al-naas al-waajib leehum al-moot."-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Akiid ana nugumm didd waragaatkan hana l-chadar al-taakulan beehum ruuh al-naas.Ana nicharrithum min iideekan wa nikhalli ruuhhum al-tidooran taakulanha tanja wa tamchi.
Wa nicharrit tarhaat sihirkan wa ninajji cha'abi min iideekan wa battaan humman ma yaga'o fi charakkan.Wa be da,ta'arfan kadar ana bas Allah.
Be kidibkan,gata'tan acham guluub al-saalihiin wa laakin ana ma dawwart nibarjilhum.Wa lazzeetan al-aasiyiin achaan ma yigabbulu min deribhum al-fasil wa yalgo al-haya.
Wa fi chaan da,battaan intan ma tichiifan ru'ya saakit wa la tichawwifan.Wa ana ninajji cha'abi min iideekan.Wa be da,ta'arfan kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa waahidiin min chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil al-gaa'idiin fi l-khurba jo leyi wa ga'ado giddaami.
Ya ibn Adam,al-rujaal dool galibhum mu'allag fi asnaamhum.Humman khatto giddaamhum cheyy al-yilizzuhum fi l-khata.Hal nasma' su'aalhum walla-?
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ayyi naadum min Bani Israa'iil al-galbah mu'allag fi asnaamah wa yukhutt giddaamah cheyy al-yilizzah fi l-khata wa ba'ad da,yamchi le l-nabi le yas'alni,ana Allah bas nurudd leyah.Nurudd leyah hasab katarat asnaamah.
Aywa,nakrub guluub Bani Israa'iil achaan humman kulluhum abooni be sabab asnaamhum."--
Wa fi chaan da,guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ta'aalu gabbulu min asnaamku wa khallu kulla muharramaatku.
Kan naadum min Bani Israa'iil aw min al-ajaanib al-saakniin ambeenaathum yiba''id minni wa yi'allig galbah fi asnaamah wa yukhutt giddaamah cheyy al-yilizzah fi l-khata wa ba'ad da,yamchi le l-nabi le yas'alni,khalaas al-naadum da,ana Allah bas nurudd leyah.
Wa l-naadum da,ana nugumm diddah wa nisawwiih alaama wa masal le l-naas wa nafsulah min cha'abi.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
--"Wa kan al-nabi yukhuchch nafsah wa yurudd le l-naadum da be ayyi kalaam,ana Allah bas khachcheetah le l-nabi da.Wa ana narfa' iidi diddah wa nidammirah min usut cha'abi Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-nabi wa l-naas al-yasma'ooh yilhammalo natiijat khataahum.Wa khata al-naas al-macho sa'alo Allah yabga misil khata al-nabi.
Wa be da,Bani Israa'iil ma yiwadduru ba'iid minni wa battaan ma yinnajjaso be isyaanhum.Wa khalaas,humman yabgo cha'abi wa ana nabga Ilaahhum."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,akuun balad waahide tisawwi zanib hana khiyaana diddi wa ana nimidd iidi le nadrubha wa nigallil al-ma'aach wa nirassil leeha al-juu' le naktul al-naas wa l-bahaayim.
Hatta kan al-rujaal al-talaata dool Nooh wa Danyaal wa Ayyuub gaa'idiin fi lubb al-balad di kula,humman yinajju illa nufuushum bas be adaalithum.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa akuun nirassil haywaanaat fasliin fi l-balad di achaan yaakulu iyaalha wa l-balad tabga kharaab wa ma fi naadum yuchuggaha be sabab al-haywaanaat dool.
Hatta kan al-rujaal al-talaata dool gaa'idiin fi lubb al-balad di kula,nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,humman ma yinajju wa la bitt wa la walad.Yinajju illa nufuushum bas wa l-balad di tabga kharaab.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa akuun nijiib al-harib fi l-balad di wa nikharrir kadar al-harib yugumm foogha wa yaktul al-naas wa l-bahaayim.
Hatta kan al-rujaal al-talaata dool gaa'idiin fi lubb al-balad di kula,nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,humman ma yinajju wa la bitt wa la walad.Yinajju illa nufuushum bas.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa akuun nirassil al-waba fi l-balad di wa ninazzil foogha khadabi al-yidaffig dammuhum wa yaktul al-naas wa l-bahaayim.
Hatta kan Nooh wa Danyaal wa Ayyuub gaa'idiin fi lubb al-balad di kula,nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,humman ma yinajju wa la bitt wa la walad.Yinajju illa nufuushum bas be adaalithum. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Hatta kan rassalt didd Madiinat al-Khudus ikhaabi al-arba'a al-chadiid,wa humman al-harib wa l-juu' wa l-haywaanaat al-fasliin wa l-waba le yaktulu al-naas wa l-bahaayim,
daahu fiyah naas waahidiin yifaddulu.Rujaal wa awiin kula,yamurguuhum min al-madiina wa humman yaju leeku hini fi Baabil.Wa intu zaatku ta'arfu deribhum wa amalhum al-fasliin.Wa khalaas,tisabburu nufuusku fi chaan al-fasaala al-ana jibtaha fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa kulla l-ikhaab al-jibtah foogha.
Wa tisabburu nufuusku wakit ta'arfu deribhum wa amalhum al-fasliin.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar da ma bala sabab ana haggagt kulla l-ikhaab da fi l-madiina. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,hal hatab chadarat al-inab ahsanmin hatab al-chadara al-aakhara-?Walla furuu'ah ahsanmin furuu' chadar al-khaaba-?
Hal hi indaha hatabal-yagdaro yakhdumu beyah-?Walla yagta'o minha chi'beal-yi'allugu foogha maa'uun-?
La-!Daahu zagalo hatabha fi l-naar basle taakulah.Ba'ad al-naar akalat al-tarafeenwa l-usut kula hirig,hal hi tanfa' battaan le ayyi khidme-?
Daahu wakit hi gaa'ide be tammitha,ma khadamo beeha cheyy.Wa ba'ad al-naar akalatha,yakhdumu beeha chunu-?
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Chadarat al-inabbeen chadar al-khaaba,ana zagaltaha fi l-naarwa l-naar haragatha.Wa be misil da,nahrigsukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Ana nugumm didduhum.Humman yahsubu yamurgu min al-naarwa laakin al-naar tahrighum.Wa wakit nugumm didduhum,khalaas ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa ana nisawwi al-balad di kharaabachaan humman khaanooni.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,arrif le Madiinat al-Khudus al-muharramaat al-hi sawwathum.
Wa guul le Madiinat al-Khudus-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ga'arki wa bakaan wildooki kulla ke fi balad Kan'aan.Abuuki min gabiilat al-Amuuriyiin wa ammiki min gabiilat al-Hittiyiin.
Wa yoom wildooki,ma gata'o surritki wa la barradooki be almi le tabge nadiife wa la da''akooki be mileh wa la laffooki be farde.
Wa ma fi naadum rahamki wa la hanna foogki.Laakin fi yoom wildooki,zagalooki fi l-kadaade achaan bigiiti iife.
--"Wa laakin ana faayit jambiki wa chiftiki mulmarmikhe fi lubb dammiki.Wa be dammiki kula,ana gult leeki waajib ti'iichi.Aywa,waajib ti'iichi.
Wa ana gawwamtiki misil nabaat al-kadaade.Wa inti sabatti wa kibirti wa bigiiti jamiile marra waahid.Wa duyuudki gammo wa suuf jilidki kula gamma wa laakin inti aryaane marra waahid.
Wa ba'ad da,ana faayit jambiki battaan wa daahu chift inti tammeeti,aywa,tammeeti le l-akhiide.Wa ana matteet daayir khalagi foogki wa khatteet ireeki.Wa ana halaft leeki wa karabt raaski wa sawweet ma'aaki mu'aahada wa gult inti hinti.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
--"Wa ana barradtiki wa naddaftiki min dammiki al-foogki wa ba'ad da,massahtiki be dihin mu'attar.
Wa ana labbastiki khulgaan mukallafiin wa na'aal min farwit ijil al-bahar wa laffeetki be gumaach kattaan wa khatteetki be hariir.
Wa jammaltiki be ziina,be suure fi iideeki wa kijeel fi ragabatki
wa chinif fi munkharki wa khuruus fi udneeki wa taaj jamiil fi raaski.
Wa ziinitki min dahab wa fudda wa khulgaanki min gumaach kattaan wa hariir wa git'e mukallafa.Wa akalti dagiig wa asal wa dihin.Wa inti bigiiti jamiile marra waahid misil malika.
Wa usumki bigi aali fi ust al-umam achaan jamaalki kaamil be sabab al-ziina al-ana jammaltiki beeha."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
--"Wa laakin inti atwakkalti ale jamaalki wa ale usumki al-aali wa achcharmatti.Sawweeti charmatatki ma'a ayyi naadum al-faayit wa bigiiti hintah.
Wa chilti min khulgaanki al-mulawwaniin wa jammalti beehum bakaanaat aaliyiin hana ibaada wa achcharmatti fooghum.Wa cheyy misil da abadan ma bigi wa abadan ma yabga battaan-!
Wa inti chilti al-ziina hana l-dahab wa l-fudda al-ana anteethum leeki wa sawweeti beehum asnaam dukuura wa achcharmatti ma'aahum.
Wa chilti khulgaanki al-mukallafiin wa labbastiihum le l-asnaam dool wa gaddamti leehum dihni wa bakhuuri.
Wa khubziti al-anteetha leeki wa l-dagiig wa l-dihin wa l-asal al-ana akkaltuhum leeki,inti chiltiihum wa gaddamtiihum hadaaya le asnaamki le yardo be riihithum.Wa da bas al-sawweetiih-!Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
--"Wa chilti awlaadki wa banaatki al-wilidtiihum leyi wa gaddamtiihum dahaaya le l-asnaam dool le yaakuluuhum.Wa min al-charmata,ma chibi'ti walla-?
Inti dabahti iyaali wa harragtiihum wa gaddamtiihum le asnaamki.
Wa fi kulla muharramaatki wa charmatatki,ma fakkarti fi ayyaam chabaabki wakit al-inti aryaane marra waahid wa mulmarmikhe fi dammiki.
--"Wa ba'ad kulla fasaalitki,al-azaab leeki-!Aywa,al-azaab jaaki-!Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa inti baneeti ligdaabe wa sawweeti bakaan aali hana ibaada fi ayyi naga'a.
Fi dakhuul ayyi derib,baneeti bakaan aali wa asta'malti jamaalki fi l-amal al-muharram.Wa gaddamti nafiski le ayyi naadum al-faayit wa kattarti charmatatki.
Wa achcharmatti ma'a l-Masriyiin jiiraanki al-ajsaamhum kubaar wa kattarti charmatatki le tikhaddibiini.
Wa daahu ana rafa't iidi diddiki wa gallalt ma'aachki.Wa sallamtiki le udwaanki al-kirhooki wa l-eeb karab banaat al-Filistiyiin kula be sabab fi'ilki al-cheen.
Wa inti ma chibi'ti min al-charmata lahaddi achcharmatti ma'a naas balad Achuur.Aywa,achcharmatti ma'aahum wa be da kula,ma chibi'ti.
Wa kattarti charmatatki min balad Kan'aan lahaddi balad Baabil wa be da kula,inti ma chibi'ti abadan min al-charmata-!
--"Akiid ma gidirti fi galibki-!Sawweeti kulla l-achya dool wa humman amal hana charmuuta kabiire.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa baneeti ligdaabe fi dakhuul hana kulla l-duruub wa sawweeti bakaan aali hana ibaada fi ayyi naga'a.Wa ma chilti taman charmatatki misil al-charaamiit al-aakharaat.
La-!Inti misil mara zaaniye al-tifattich rujaal aakhariin bala raajilha-!
Fi l-aade,yantu hadaaya le l-charaamiit.Wa laakin inti anteeti hadaaya le kulla sudgaanki-!Aywa,inti kaffeetiihum le yaju leeki min ayyi bakaan wa yichcharmato ma'aaki.
Fi charmatatki,inti ma sawweeti misil al-awiin al-aakharaat.Ma fattachooki inti laakin inti bas kaffeetiihum-!Sawweeti al-aks-!"-
Wa fi chaan da,asma'e kalaam Allah,ya l-charmuuta-!
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Chahwaatki ziyaada fi ayyi wakit wa kachafti ireeki wakit gaa'ide tichcharmate ma'a sudgaanki wa ma'a kulla asnaamki al-muharramiin.Hatta damm iyaalki kula anteetiih leehum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nilimm kulla sudgaanki al-ajabtiihum wa kulla l-habbeetiihum wa kulla l-kirihtiihum.Aywa,ana nilimmuhum min ayyi jiihe diddiki.Wa giddaamhum,nakchif ireeki wa humman yichiifuuki aryaane.
Wa nihaakimki hukum al-awiin al-zannaayaat wa kattaalaat al-dimam.Wa min chiddit khadabi wa khiirti,nikhattiiki be damm.
Wa nisallimki le sudgaanki wa humman yidammuru lagaadiibki wa yahdumu bakaanaatki al-aaliyiin hana l-ibaada.Wa yisillu minki khulgaanki wa yanhabo ziinitki al-khaaliye wa yikhalluuki aryaane marra waahid.
Wa yigawwumu al-mujtama' diddiki wa yarjumuuki wa yigattu'u laham jilidki be l-seef.
Wa yiharrugu buyuutki wa yichaaru'uuki giddaam awiin katiiraat.Wa ana niwaggif charmatatki wa battaan ma tagdare tikaffi sudgaanki.
Wa nitimm khadabi foogki.Wa ba'ad da,niba''id minki khiirti wa nabga haadi wa battaan ma nakhdab.
Achaan inti ma fakkarti ayyaam chabaabki wa gammeeti diddi be kulla fi'ilki al-cheen da.Wa khalaas,daahu ana nihammilki natiijat amalki.Inti sawweeti muharramaatki wa zidti fooghum fi'ilki al-cheen-! Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Chiifi-!Yadurbu foogki masal al-buguul-:--Al-bineeye misil ammaha.--
Inti bineeyit al-mara al-kirhat raajilha wa iyaalha.Wa inti akhut al-akhwaat al-kirhan rujaalhin wa iyaalhin.Aywa,ammiki min gabiilat al-Hittiyiin wa abuuki min gabiilat al-Amuuriyiin.
Wa akhutki al-kabiire hi madiinat al-Saamira al-gaa'ide munchaakh minki ma'a banaatha.Wa tariiditki hillit Saduum al-gaa'ide junuub minki ma'a banaatha.
Inti ma chilti derib akhwaatki bas wa la sawweeti muharramaat misilhin.La,da inti chifti chiyya leeki-!Inti hilikti ziyaada minhin be kulla fi'ilki al-cheen.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:-Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy-!Saduum akhutki wa banaatha ma sawwan fi'il cheen ziyaada min al-inti wa banaatki sawweetannah.
Wa daahu khata akhutki Saduum.Hi mustakbire wa chab'aane be l-akil wa ma indaha hamm wa gaa'ide fi l-raaha,hi wa banaatha.Wa laakin hinna ma saa'adan ayyi naadum miskiin wa la da'iif.
Hinna bigan mustakbiraat wa sawwan al-cheyy al-ana ja'altah muharram.Wa ana dammartihin wakit chift al-cheyy da.
Wa l-Saamira ma sawwat nuss zunuubki kula wa inti kattarti muharramaatki ziyaada min hineeha.Wa sawweeti akhwaatki misil awiin saalhaat be kulla muharramaatki al-inti sawweetiihum-!
Wa hassa' da,alhammale eebki.Wa inti sawweeti akhwaatki misil awiin saalhaat wa da be sabab zunuubki al-muharramiin ziyaada min hineehin.Hinna bigan saalhaat ziyaada minki.Dangiri raaski wa alhammale eebki achaan akhwaatki saalhaat ziyaada minki.
Yoom waahid,ana nikhayyir leehin haalithin.Aywa,nikhayyir haalit Saduum wa banaatha wa l-Saamira wa banaatha.Wa nikhayyir haalitki inti kula ma'aahin.
Fi l-yoom da,tilhammale eebki wa takhjale fi kulla cheyy al-sawweetiih wa da yisabbirhin.
Wa akhutki Saduum wa banaatha yigabbilan fi haalithin al-zamaan.Wa akhutki al-Saamira wa banaatha yigabbilan fi haalithin al-zamaan.Wa inti wa banaatki kula tigabbilan fi haalitkan al-zamaan.
Wa fi wakit istikbaarki,inti chammatti fi akhutki Saduum.
Wa da gubbaal fasaalitki ma tibiin.Wa hassa' da,doorki ja.Banaat al-Araamiyiin wa kulla jaaraathin yi'ayyibanki wa banaat al-Filistiyiin yahgiranki min kulla jiihe.
Wa inti tilhammale natiijat fi'ilki al-cheen wa muharramaatki. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Inti gata'ti haliifitki wa nagadti mu'aahadatki ma'aayi.Wa hassa',ana nisawwi foogki misil inti sawweeti foogi.
Wa ana nifakkir fi mu'aahadati al-sawweetha ma'aaki fi ayyaam chabaabki wa nisabbit ma'aaki mu'aahadati al-daayme.
Wa tifakkiri fi amalki wa l-eeb yakrubki wakit tigaabili akhutki al-kabiire ma'a akhutki al-sakhayre.Wa ana nantiihin leeki misil banaat wa laakin ma yichaarikan fi l-mu'aahada.
Wa nisabbit mu'aahadati ma'aaki.Wa be da,ta'arfi kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa wakit tifakkiri fi l-faat,al-eeb yakrubki wa battaan ma tagdare tufukki khachumki achaan inti waddarti charafki.Wa laakin ana nakhfir leeki kulla cheyy al-sawweetiih. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,hajji hijjeeye wa adrub masal le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Fiyah sagur waahid kabiiral-janaaheeh kubaarwa riichah tuwaalwa suufah katiir wa mulawwan.Wa l-sagur da,macha jibaal Lubnaanwa chaal raas chadarat al-arz.
Aywa,hu gata' firi'wa waddaah fi balad Kan'aanwa khattaah fi madiinat al-tujjaar.
Wa chaal habba waahide min al-balad kulawa teerabha fi zere' le tugummmisil chadarat ganajamb almi al-katiir.
Wa l-habba di gammatwa bigat chadarat inab al-gaa'ide tasrah.Wa furuu'ha maddathum le l-sagur dawa uruugha gaa'idiin tihtah.Wa hi bigat chadarat inabwa sawwat furuu'wa gawwamat warag.
--"Wa laakin fiyah sagur aakhar kabiiral-janaaheeh kubaar wa riichah katiir.Wa daahu chadarat al-inab diwajjahat uruugha ale l-sagur al-aakhar dawa maddat furuu'ha aleyah.Hi dawwarat hu yazgiihabarra min al-bakaan al-magganooha foogah.
Wa da bakaan adiilwa jamb almi katiir.Magganooha le tisawwi furuu'wa talda fawaakihwa tabga chadarat inab aziime."-
Wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Hal chadarat al-inab di tanjah walla-?La-!Al-sagur al-awwalaani yamlutha be uruughawa fawaakihha kula yagta'hum.Wa hi tamrad wa taybaswa kulla bizritha tumuut.Wa da ma be iid gawiiyewa la be deech kabiirkadar yamultuuha be uruugha.
Wa kan magganooha battaan,hal hi tanjah walla-?Wa kan riih al-sabaah tihijjaha,hi taybas marra waahid,aywa,taybas fi l-bakaan al-magganooha foogah."-
Guul le l-cha'ab al-aasiyiin dool-:--Ma iriftu ma'ana al-masal da walla-?Daahu al-tafsiir.Malik Baabil ja fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa karab malikha wa kubaaraatha wa waddaahum ma'aayah fi Baabil.
Wa darraj waahid min zurriiyit al-muluuk fi mamlakat Yahuuza wa sawwa ma'aayah mu'aahada wa hallafah.Wa chaal kubaaraat al-balad wa waddaahum fi l-khurba
achaan al-mamlaka tagood sakhayre wa ma tagdar tittawwar wa tahfad mu'aahadatah le tasbit.
--Wa laakin al-malik da atmarrad didd malik Baabil.Hu rassal naasah le Masir achaan yantuuh kheel wa askar katiiriin.Hal malik misil da yanjah walla-?Hal naadum al-sawwa mu'aamara misil di yanja walla-?Hal hu al-nagad al-alaakha di yanja walla-?
Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,akiid al-malik da yumuut fi Baabil balad al-malik al-darrajah achaan hu gata' haliiftah wa nagad alaakhtah.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa kan malik Masir yantiih deech kabiir wa askar katiiriin kula,da ma yisaa'idah fi l-harib wakit askar Baabil yilimmu turaab wa yabnu radmiiye le l-hisaar le yaktulu naas katiiriin.
Al-malik da gata' haliiftah wa nagad mu'aahadatah al-hu mada foogha wa sawwa kulla l-cheyy da.Wa be da,hu ma yanja.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy-!Al-haliife al-hu sawwaaha giddaami,hu gata'ha wa mu'aahadati kula,hu nagadha.Wa ana ni'aakhibah be sabab fi'ilah.
Wa ana nukujj leyah charaki wa nakurbah.Wa niwaddiih Baabil wa hinaak nihaakimah fi chaan al-khiyaana al-hu sawwaaha diddi.
Wa l-mu'arridiin min kulla askarah yumuutu be l-seef wa l-faddalo yichittu fi l-riih.Wa be da,intu ta'arfu kadar da,ana Allah bas gultah.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana zaati nichiil firi'min raas chadarat al-arz al-tawiilewa nimagginah.Min furuu'ah foog,nagta' firi' latiifwa ana zaati nimagginahfi jabal tawiil wa aali.
Nimagginah fi jabal aali fi balad Israa'iilwa hu yisawwi furuu'wa yalda fawaakihwa yabga chadarat arz aziime.Wa ayyi nafar hana tuyuuryaskunu fooghawa yaskunu fi dull furuu'ha.
Wa be da,kulla chadar al-kadaade ya'arifkadar ana Allah.Nisakhkhir al-chadara al-aaliyewa ni'alli al-chadara al-sakhayre.Niyabbis al-chadara al-khadrawa nikhaddir al-chadara al-yaabse.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultahwa nihaggigah.
Maala tihajju be l-masal da al-bukhuss balad Israa'iil-:--Kan al-abbahaat akalo al-inab al-akhdar,sunuun iyaalhum yakhdaro---?
Ana nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,akiid intu ma tadurbu al-masal da battaan fi Israa'iil.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Aywa,hayaat al-insaan hinti ana.Wa misil da,hayaat al-abu wa hayaat al-wileed,humman al-itneen kula hineeyi ana.Wa l-yisawwi zanib,hu bas al-yumuut.
Akuun fiyah raajil saalih al-yisawwi al-hagg wa l-adaala.
Hu ma yarfa' uyuunah ale asnaam Bani Israa'iil wa la yaakul min dahaayaahum fi ruuse al-jibaal.Wa hu ma yinajjis marit jaarah wa la yigarrib le l-mara fi wakit heedha.
Wa ma yidaayig naadum wa laakin yigabbil al-damaana al-karabha fi deen le siidha wa ma yasrig.Wa yigassim aklah ma'a l-jii'aan wa yanti khalag le l-aryaan.
Wa hu ma yanti deen be riba wa la yichiil faayde.Wa yiba''id min al-zulum wa yichaari' be l-hagg been al-naas.
Hu yitaabi' churuuti wa yahfad gawaaniini wa yisawwi al-hagg.Hu da raajil saalih wa akiid yahya.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa akuun al-raajil al-saalih da yijiib wileed sarraag al-yidaffig al-damm wa yisawwi ayyi cheyy fasil misil da.
Abuuh ma sawwa amal misil da wa laakin al-wileed yaakul min dahaaya al-asnaam fi ruuse al-jibaal wa yinajjis marit jaarah.
Hu yidaayig al-miskiin wa l-da'iif wa yasrig wa ma yigabbil al-damaana al-karabha fi deen le siidha.Wa yarfa' uyuunah le l-asnaam wa yisawwi al-muharramaat.
Wa yanti deen be riba wa yichiil faayde.Hal hu da yahya walla-?La-!Hu sawwa kulla l-muharramaat dool.Akiid yumuut wa hu bas mas'uul min mootah.
Wa akuun al-wileed da yakbur wa yijiib wileed wa l-wileed da yichiif kulla l-zunuub al-abuuh sawwaahum.Hu yichiifhum wa laakin ma yisawwi misilhum.
Hu ma yarfa' uyuunah ale asnaam Bani Israa'iil wa la yaakul min dahaayaahum fi ruuse al-jibaal.Wa hu ma yinajjis marit jaarah
wa ma yidaayig naadum wa yigabbil al-damaana al-karabha fi deen le siidha wa ma yasrig.Wa yigassim aklah ma'a l-jii'aan wa yanti khalag le l-aryaan.
Wa hu yiba''id min al-zulum wa ma yanti deen be riba wa ma yichiil faayde.Hu yahfad gawaaniini wa yitaabi' churuuti.Wa akiid hu da yahya,ma yumuut be sabab al-khata al-abuuh sawwaah.
Wa laakin abuuh sawwa zulum wa sarag akhuuh wa ma sawwa adiil fi usut cha'abah wa daahu yumuut be sabab khataaya hu zaatah.
Wa intu tuguulu-:--Maala al-wileed ma yilhammal khata abuuh-?- Da fi chaan al-wileed da sawwa al-hagg wa l-adaala wa hafad gawaaniini wa tabbagaahum.Wa akiid hu da yahya.
Wa l-insaan al-yaznib,hu bas al-yumuut.Al-wileed ma yilhammal khata abuuh wa l-abu ma yilhammal khata wileedah.Wa l-aadil yalga natiijat adaaltah wa l-aasi yalga natiijat isyaanah.
Wa kan al-aasi yutuub min kulla zunuubah al-sawwaahum wa yahfad kulla churuuti wa yisawwi al-hagg wa l-adaala,akiid hu da yahya ma yumuut.
Wa ana ma nizzakkar kulla isyaanah al-sawwaah.Wa be sabab adaaltah al-sawwaaha,hu yahya.
Hal nafrah be moot al-aasi walla-?Wa kan yigabbil min derbah al-fasil da,ma yahya walla-?Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa laakin kan al-saalih yikhalli adaaltah wa yisawwi al-zulum wa yisawwi kulla l-muharramaat al-sawwaahum al-aasi,hal yahya walla-?Wa kulla l-adaala al-sawwaaha awwal,ma yizzakkarooha battaan.Hu yumuut be sabab al-khiyaana wa l-zunuub al-sawwaahum.
Wa laakin intu tuguulu-:--Al-cheyy al-Rabb gaa'id yisawwi da ma adiil-!- Asma'o,ya Bani Israa'iil.Hal al-cheyy al-ana gaa'id nisawwi da ma adiil walla-?Al-cheyy al-intu gaa'idiin tisawwuuh da bas ma adiil.
Kan al-saalih yikhalli adaaltah wa yisawwi al-zulum,hu yumuut.Be sabab al-zulum al-sawwaah bas,hu yumuut.
Wa laakin kan al-aasi yikhalli isyaanah al-gaa'id yisawwiih wa yisawwi al-hagg wa l-adaala,hu da yinajji nafsah wa yahya.
Wa kan hu irif wa taab min al-isyaan al-sawwaah,akiid hu yahya wa ma yumuut.
Wa laakin intu Bani Israa'iil tuguulu-:--Al-cheyy al-Rabb gaa'id yisawwi da ma adiil.- Ya Bani Israa'iil-!Hal al-cheyy al-ana gaa'id nisawwi da,ma adiil walla-?Al-cheyy al-intu gaa'idiin tisawwuuh da bas ma adiil.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nihaakim ayyi waahid min Bani Israa'iil hasab derbah al-chaalah.Gabbulu-!Tuubu min kulla isyaanku wa ayyi cheyy al-yilizzuku fi l-khata.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Khallu minku isyaanku wa khayyuru galibku be galib jadiid wa khayyuru ruuhku be ruuh jadiide.Maala tumuutu,ya Bani Israa'iil-?
Ana ma nafrah be moot hana ayyi naadum.Tuubu wa be da,tahyo-! Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Allah gaal leyi nikhanni nuwaah al-hizin le muluuk Bani Israa'iil.
Wa nuguul-:-Ammak ma duudaay walla-?Hi raagde fi ust al-diidaan.Wa fi lubb furuukh al-diidaan,hi tirabbi iyaalha.
Hi rabbat waahid min iyaalhawa hu kibir wa bigi malik al-diidaan.Wa hu allam kikkeef yicharrit seedtahwa yaakul al-naas.
Wa l-umam sim'o beyahwa ramooh fi nugrithum.Aywa,karaboohwa waddooh be zumaam fi balad Masir.
Wakit al-duudaay chaafatah,achamha angata'.Wa hi chaalat aakhar min iyaalhawa sawwatah malik al-diidaan.
Wa hu macha fi ust al-diidaanwa bigi malikhum.Wa allam kikkeef yicharrit seedtahwa akal al-naas.
Hu dammar gusuurhum al-gawiyiinwa kharab mudunhum.Wa l-balad ga'adat kharaab min sukkaanhabe sabab hiss gargaraanah.
Wa l-umam al-hawaaleeyahjo min wulaayaathum.Wa gammo diddahwa kajjo leyah charakwa hu waga' fi nugrithumwa karabooh.
Wa be zumaam,khattooh fi lubb gafaswa waddooh le malik Baabil.Wa dassooh fi lubb sijinachaan hissah battaan ma yinsami'fi jibaal Bani Israa'iil.
Ammak misil chadarat al-inabal-magganooha fi khachum al-almi.Hi wildat fawaakihwa indaha waragachaan al-almi katiir.
Wa furuu'ha induhum gudrale yabgo isay le l-muluuk.Hi kibrat wa bigat tawiilemin kulla l-chadar al-aakhar.Wa tinchaaf fi chaan tuulhawa katarat waragha.
Laakin hi mallatooha be khadabwa ramooha fi l-ard.Wa riih al-sabaah yabbasat fawaakihhawa humman daffago.Wa furuu'ha al-induhum gudra yibsowa l-naar akalathum.
Wa hassa',magganooha fi l-sahara,fi ard jafaaf wa atach.
Maragat naar min dumburhawa akalat al-furuu' wa l-fawaakih.Wa battaan ma fi furuu'al-induhum gudra le yabgo isay le l-muluuk.-Wa da khine yikhannuuh misil nuwaah al-hizin.
Wa fi yoom achara hana l-chahar al-khaamis hana l-sana al-saab'e min waddoona fi l-khurba,waahidiin min chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil jo leyi le yas'alo Allah.Wa wakit jo wa ga'ado giddaami,
Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,hajji le chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Jiitu le tas'alooni walla-?Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,ana ma narda intu tas'alooni."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,maala ma tihaakimhum-?Aywa,haakimhum wa arrifhum muharramaat juduudhum.
Wa guul leehum-:Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Fi yoom ana azalt Bani Israa'iil,ana halaft le zurriiyit Yaakhuub wa arraft nafsi leehum fi balad Masir.Wa halaft leehum wa gult-:"Ana Allah Ilaahku."
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana halaft leehum kadar namrughum min balad Masir wa niwaddiihum ale l-balad al-ana azaltaha leehum.Wa l-balad di malaane be l-laban wa l-asal wa jamiile min kulla l-buldaan.
Wa gult leehum-:"Khalli ayyi naadum yazgul al-asnaam al-muharramaat hana Masir al-ya'ajubuuh wa ma yinnajjas beehum achaan ana bas Allah Ilaahku."
--Wa laakin juduudku isooni wa ma dawwaro yasma'ooni.Wa ma fi naadum minhum al-zagal al-asnaam al-muharramaat hana Masir al-ya'ajubuuh wa la khallaahum.Wa ana gult-:"Ninazzil khadabi fooghum min bidaaytah lahaddi nihaaytah fi usut balad Masir."
Wa laakin fi chaan ihtiraam usmi giddaam al-umam al-humman saakniin fi usuthum,ana ma nazzalt khadabi fooghum.Wa ana arraft leehum nafsi giddaam al-umam dool wakit maragtuhum min balad Masir.
--Aywa,ana maragtuhum min balad Masir wa waddeethum fi l-sahara.
Wa anteethum churuuti wa arraftuhum gawaaniini al-beehum yalgo al-haya kan yitabbuguuhum.
Wa battaan anteethum yoomi hana l-sabt le yabga alaama beeni wa beenhum.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana Allah bas khassastuhum.
Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil isooni fi l-sahara.Wa humman ma taaba'o churuuti wa abo gawaaniini al-beehum yalgo al-haya kan yitabbuguuhum.Wa daayman ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l-sabt.Wa battaan ana gult-:"Ninazzil fooghum khadabi fi l-sahara wa nikammilhum."
Wa laakin fi chaan ihtiraam usmi giddaam al-umam,ana ma nazzalt khadabi fooghum.Wa ana maragtuhum min balad Masir giddaam al-umam dool.
Wa laakin ana halaft leehum fi l-sahara kadar ma niwaddiihum fi l-balad al-ana azaltaha leehum.Wa l-balad di malaane be l-laban wa l-asal wa jamiile min kulla l-buldaan.
Achaan humman abo gawaaniini wa ma taaba'o churuuti wa ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l-sabt achaan guluubhum taaba'o asnaamhum.
Wa be da kula,ana chiftuhum be een al-rahma wa ma halaktuhum wa la dammartuhum fi l-sahara.
--Wa fi l-sahara,ana gult le iyaalhum-:"Ma tamchu hasab wasiiyat abbahaatku wa la tahfado gawaaniinhum wa la tinajjusu nufuusku be asnaamhum.
Ana bas Allah Ilaahku-!Taabu'u churuuti wa ahfado gawaaniini wa tabbuguuhum.
Wa aj'alo yoomi hana l-sabt mukhaddas achaan hu alaama beeni wa beenku.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahku."
--Wa laakin iyaalhum isooni wa ma taaba'o churuuti wa la hafado gawaaniini al-beehum yalgo al-haya kan yitabbuguuhum.Wa humman ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l-sabt.Wa fi chaan da,ana gult-:"Ninazzil fooghum khadabi fi l-sahara wa nikammilhum."
Wa laakin fi chaan ihtiraam usmi giddaam al-umam,ana ma nazzalt khadabi fooghum.Wa ana maragtuhum min balad Masir giddaam al-umam dool.
Wa battaan ana halaft leehum fi l-sahara kadar nichattithum been al-umam wa nifarrighum fi ust al-buldaan.
Achaan humman ma tabbago gawaaniini wa abo churuuti wa ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l-sabt achaan khatto uyuunhum fi asnaam abbahaathum.
Wa be sabab da,ana zaati anteethum churuut al-ma adiiliin wa gawaaniin al-beehum al-naadum ma yalga al-haya.
Wa khalleethum annajjaso be gaddimiin dahaayaahum hana kulla awlaad al-bikir.Wa da le yinbahtu wa ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.--
Wa fi chaan da,ya ibn Adam,hajji le Bani Israa'iil wa guul leehum-:Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Daayman juduudku ayyarooni be sabab khiyaanithum leyi.
Ana waddeethum fi l-balad al-halaft wa gult nantiiha leehum.Wa wakit humman chaafo ayyi jabal aali wa ayyi chadara khadra,gaddamo fi l-bakaan da dahaayaahum.Wa khaddabooni be hadaayaahum wa be l-bakhuur al-riihtah ta'ajib wa be hadaayaahum hana l-charaab al-gaddamoohum fi l-bakaan da.
Wa ana gult leehum-:"Chunu al-bakaan al-aali al-tamchu leyah da-?"Wa sammooh al-bakaan da,al-bakaan al-aali hana l-ibaada lahaddi l-yoom.--
Wa fi chaan da,guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Intu najjastu nufuusku wakit taaba'tu derib juduudku wa achcharmattu wara muharramaathum wa isiitu.
Wa wakit intu tijiibu hadaayaaku wa wakit tiharrugu iyaalku fi l-naar,intu gaa'idiin tinajjusu nufuusku be kulla asnaamku lahaddi l-yoom.Wa be da,ana ma narda tas'alooni,ya Bani Israa'iil-!Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,ana ma narda intu tas'alooni."Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
--Intu fakkartu wa gultu-:"Aniina nidooru nabgo misil umam wa gabaayil hana buldaan aakhariin.Nidooru na'abudu leena asnaam hana hatab wa hajar misilhum."Wa laakin da ma yabga-!
Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,ana nahkimku be iid chadiide wa be duraa' gawi wa ninazzil khadabi foogku.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa be iid chadiide wa duraa' gawi wa nazziliin khadabi,ana namrugku min ust al-umam wa nilimmuku min al-buldaan al-intu muchattatiin fooghum.
Wa ana niwaddiiku fi l-sahara taraf min al-umam al-aakhariin.Wa hinaak nigaabilku wijih be wijih wa nihaakimku.
Misil ana haakamt juduudku fi saharat balad Masir,be misil da bas nihaakimku intu kula.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa ana nukhuttuku tihit asaati wa tikarrumu al-mu'aahada al-tarbutni ma'aaku.
Wa nafrug minku al-naas al-gammo diddi wa isooni.Namrughum min al-balad al-humman gaa'idiin foogha ajaanib wa laakin ma yadkhulu fi balad Israa'iil.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.--
Wa leeku intu,ya Bani Israa'iil,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Khalli ayyi naadum yamchi ya'abud asnaamah-!Wa laakin ba'ad da,khalli ayyi naadum yasma'ni.Wa tihtarumu usmi al-mukhaddas wa battaan ma tigaddumu hadaayaaku le asnaamku.
Achaan fi jabali al-mukhaddas wa da jabal Israa'iil al-aali,kulluku Bani Israa'iil wa kulla naas al-balad ta'abuduuni.Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,ana nakhbal zakaatku wa ahsan hadaayaaku wa kulla cheyy al-tikhassusuuh leyi.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa wakit namrugku min ust al-umam wa nilimmuku min al-buldaan al-intu muchattatiin fooghum,tabgo misil riihe haluuwe al-ana narda beeha.Wa beeku intu,ana niwassif khadaasti giddaam al-umam.
Wa wakit nigabbilku fi balad Israa'iil,fi l-balad al-ana halaft wa gult nantiiha le juduudku,khalaas ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa hinaak,tizzakkaro duruubku wa kulla amalku al-najjastu beehum nufuusku.Wa l-eeb yakrubku be sabab kulla l-fasaala al-sawweetuuha.
Ya Bani Israa'iil-!Ana nisawwi al-cheyy da ma fi chaan deribku wa amalku al-fasliin wa laakin fi chaan charaf usmi.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale l-wati wa kallim diddah wa atnabba' didd khaabat al-wati.
Wa guul le khaabat al-wati-:--Asma'e kalaam Allah-!Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Akiid nigabbid naar fi lubbiki al-taakul kulla l-chadar,al-akhdar wa l-yaabis kula.Wa ambalbaalitha haamiye,abadan ma tumuut.Wa taakul ayyi cheyy min al-wati lahaddi l-munchaakh.
Wa be da,kulla l-naas ya'arfu kadar ana Allah bas gabbadt al-naar di wa hi abadan ma tumuut."-
Wa ana Hizgiyaal gult-:-Ya Allah Rabbi-!Humman yihajju foogi wa yuguulu-:--Hu yihajji be amsaal bas-!-
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale Madiinat al-Khudus wa kallim didd al-bakaanaat al-mukhaddasiin wa atnabba' didd balad Israa'iil.
Wa guul le balad Israa'iil-:--Daahu Allah gaal-:"Akiid nugumm diddiki wa nisill seefi min beetah wa naktul al-saalih wa l-aasi kula.
Aywa,naktul al-saalih wa l-aasi.Wa be sabab da bas,nisill seefi min beetah wa naktul kulla l-naas min al-wati lahaddi l-munchaakh.
Wa be da,ayyi naadum ya'arif kadar ana Allah bas salleet seefi min beetah wa battaan ma nigabbilah."--
Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,agnit wa dangir.Aywa,be hizin agnit giddaamhum.
Akuun yuguulu leek-:--Maalak tagnit-?- Wa inta tuguul leehum-:--Be sabab al-khabar al-jaayi,kulla l-guluub yingat'u wa kulla l-iide yinrakhu wa kulla l-uguul yibarjulu wa kulla l-rikab yumuu'u misil almi.Wa l-khabar da jaayi wa yilhaggag.-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,atnabba' wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Al-seef-!Al-seef-!Hu mutarrag wa majli.
Mutarrag le l-katilwa majli le yiraari misil al-barraaga.Ma tafrah,ya wileedi.Ikhaab al-seef jaayiachaan inta abeet ikhaab al-asa.
Anto al-seef le l-yajliihwa le l-yakurbuuh be l-iid.Tarragooh wa jaloohwa antooh le l-yaktul.
--"Ya ibn Adam,koorik wa abki be hizinachaan al-seef da marag didd cha'abiwa didd kulla muluuk Bani Israa'iil.Ramoohum fi l-seef ma'a cha'abiwa fi chaan da,hizz raasak.
Aywa,Allah gaa'id yijarrib cha'abah.Wa kan asaat al-muluk al-hagaroohabigat ma fiiha,chunu yukuun-?Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
--"Ya ibn Adam,atnabba'wa adrub iideenakachaan al-seef yadrubmarrateen aw talaata.Wa da l-seef al-yaktul.Aywa,da l-seef al-yaktul katiirwa yaktul al-naas fi kulla bakaan.
Fi chaan al-seef da,guluubhum yingat'uwa rijleehum yittarta'o.Fi kulla biibaanhum,ana khatteet al-seef al-yakhrib.Wa hu yiraari misil al-barraagawa majli le l-harib.
Ya l-seef al-tariin,adrub ale l-zeene wa adrub ale l-israwa fi ayyi bakaan al-tiwajjih.
Ana kula nadrub iideeniwa nakhdab aakhir khadabwa da,ana Allah bas gultah."-
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Asma',ya ibn Adam,arsim duruub itneen le seef malik Baabil wakit yamrug min baladah.Wa fi ayyi derib,khutt alaama al-tiwassif al-hille al-yamchi leeha al-derib.
Wa l-derib al-waahid yiwaddi al-seef le Rabba madiinat Bani Ammuun.Wa l-derib al-aakhar yiwaddiih le Madiinat al-Khudus hi al-madiina al-gawiiye fi balad Yahuuza.
Achaan malik Baabil gaa'id fi machbak al-duruub al-itneen dool le yichawwif.Wa yihizz al-nachaachiib wa yas'al al-asnaam wa yakchif al-kibde.
Wa fi iidah al-zeene,fi uud al-yiwassif kadar am'iyeedaat waga'at fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa fi chaan da,yijiibu murdaas kabiir wa yikooruku le l-katil wa yarfa'o hissuhum le l-harba.Wa yuduggu biibaan al-madiina be l-murdaas al-kabiir da wa yilimmu turaab wa yabnu radmiiye.
Sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus yahsubu kadar am'iyeedaat di khachch achaan halafo leehum be l-amaan.Wa laakin malik Baabil yizakkirhum khataahum wa yaji yakrubhum.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Intu zakkartuuni khataaku.Wakit isyaanku anchaaf,intu wassaftu zunuubku wa kulla amalku.Wa fi chaan da,yakurbuuku be gu.
Ya inta malik Bani Israa'iil-!Ya inta kattaal al-dimam wa kaafir-!Yoomak garrab wa wakit ikhaabak ja.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Khalli yamurgu minnah al-kadmuul wa yisillu minnah al-taaj.Kulla cheyy yikhayyir,al-miskiin yarfa'ooh wa l-gawi yinazzuluuh.
Kharaab,kharaab-!Nisawwi kharaab al-abadan ma bigi mislah-!Wa da,lahaddi yaji siid al-charii'a al-ana nantiiha leyah.--
Wa inta ya ibn Adam,atnabba' wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb hajja kalaam yukhuss Bani Ammuun wa eebhum.Hu gaal-:"Al-seef-!Al-seef-!Hu masluul le l-dabih wa majli le l-harib wa yiraari misil al-barraaga.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yichiifu leeku ru'ya saakit wa yichawwufu leeku be kidib,al-seef yagta' rigaab al-fasliin humman al-yoomhum garrab wa wakit ikhaabhum ja.
Gabbulu al-seef fi beetah-!Ana ni'aakhibku fi l-bakaan al-khalagooku foogah,fi l-balad al-foogha ga'arku.
Wa ninazzil khadabi foogku wa nanfukh foogku naar khadabi wa nisallimku fi iid al-naas al-haarriin al-ya'arfu yisawwu al-kharaab.
Wa intu tabgo hagg al-naar wa dammuku yidaffig fi ust al-balad wa battaan ma yizzakkarooku."- Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah.
Ya ibn Adam,maala ma tihaakimha-?Aywa,haakim al-madiina al-malaane be l-damm wa arrifha kulla muharramaatha.
Wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ya Madiinat al-Khudus-!Inti tidaffigi al-damm fi lubbiki le tigarribi wakitki hana l-ikhaab.Wa tisawwi asnaam le tinajjisi nafiski.
Wakit daffagti al-damm da,bigiiti khaatiye.Wa wakit sawweeti al-asnaam dool,bigiiti nijse.Wa garrabti wakitki hana l-ikhaab wa jiiti fi nihaayat siniinki.Wa fi chaan da,nisawwiiki aaybe giddaam al-umam wa chimmeete giddaam kulla l-buldaan.
Al-naas al-gariibiin wa l-ba'iidiin kula yichchammato foogki achaan usumki annajjas wa barjaalki kitir.
--"Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,daahu muluuk Bani Israa'iil al-fi lubbiki,ayyi waahid yaktul dimme hasab gudurtah.
Wa fi lubbiki,yal'ano al-amm wa l-abu.Wa fiiki,yidaayugu al-ajnabi wa yazulmu al-atiim wa l-armala.
Wa inti hagarti kulla cheyy mukhaddas hanaayi wa ma ahtaramti yoomi hana l-sabt.
Wa fi lubbiki,fiyah naas al-yangulu al-kalaam le yaktulu dimme.Wa fiiki,yaakulu min dahaaya al-asnaam fi ruuse al-jibaal.Wa fi usutki,yisawwu fi'il cheen.
Wa fi lubbiki,yakchufu ire al-abu.Wa fiiki,yarugdu be gu ma'a mara al-indaha heed.
Fi lubbiki,naadum waahid yisawwi al-haraam ma'a marit jaarah wa naadum aakhar yinajjis marit wileedah be fi'il cheen wa naadum aakhar yargud be gu ma'a akhtah bitt abuuh.
Wa fi lubbiki,yichiilu ujra le yaktulu dimme wa yichiilu al-riba wa l-faayde wa yidaayugu al-naas wa ana kamaan,nisooni.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
--"Ya sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus,daahu ana rafa't iidi didduku be sabab al-maal al-haraam al-chiltuuh wa l-dimme al-kataltuuha fi lubb al-madiina di.
Wa hal guluubku yasbutu wa iideeku yalgo al-gudra fi l-yoom al-ana nugumm didduku walla-?Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah wa nihaggigah.
Wa ana nichattitku been al-umam wa nifarrigku fi ust al-buldaan wa nitahhirku min najaasitku.
Wa intu be nufuusku tiwadduru ihtiraamku giddaam al-umam.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah."-
Ya ibn Adam,Bani Israa'iil bigo misil wasakh al-fudda.Kulluhum misil al-nahaas wa l-tuuta wa l-hadiid wa l-hadiid al-azrag al-faddalo wasakh fi ust al-naar.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Achaan kulluku bigiitu wasakh,daahu ana nilimmuku fi ust Madiinat al-Khudus
misil yilimmu al-fudda wa l-nahaas wa l-hadiid wa l-hadiid al-azrag wa l-tuuta fi l-naar wa yanfukhu al-naar le yagta'oohum.Wa be misil da fi za'ali wa khadabi,ana nilimmuku wa nidissuku fi l-naar wa nagta'ku.
Wa ana nilimmuku fi lubb Madiinat al-Khudus wa nanfukh foogku naar khadabi wa nagta'ku.
Wa misil al-fudda tingati' fi lubb al-naar,be misil da intu kula tingat'u fi lubb Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa be da,intu ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah wa nazzalt khadabi foogku.
Ya ibn Adam,guul le Madiinat al-Khudus kadar hi ard al-ma taahire.Fi yoom al-khadab,ma sabba foogha matar.
Wa anbiyaaha gaa'idiin yil'aamaro fi usutha.Misil duud al-katal seedtah wa gaa'id yikirr,al-naas yaktulu dimme wa yanhabo al-khuna wa l-achya al-khaaliyiin wa yikatturu al-araamil fi ust al-madiina.
Rujaal al-diin ma tabbago churuuti al-fi l-Tawraat wa ma ahtaramo kulla cheyy mukhaddas hanaayi.Wa ma farrago been al-mukhaddas wa l-ma mukhaddas.Wa ma allamo al-naas al-faraga been al-halaal wa l-ma haraam.Wa abo ma yikarrumu yoomi hana l-sabt wa ma ja'alooni mukhaddas fi usuthum.
Wa l-hukkaam fi lubb al-madiina misil maraaf'iin al-katalo seedithum.Humman jaahiziin le yaktulu dimme wa yidammuru al-naas fi chaan faaydithum.
Wa anbiyaahum yilabbudu khataayaahum marra waahid misil tallasoohum be buhya-!Wa yichiifu ru'ya saakit wa yichawwufu be kidib wa yuguulu-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal.- Wa laakin Allah ma gaal cheyy-!
Wa cha'ab al-balad yasurgu wa yazulmu al-ta'baaniin wa l-masaakiin.Wa l-ajnabi,yazulmuuh bala hagg.
Wa ana fattacht naadum fi usuthum al-yabni leehum durdur wa yagiif fi khurmit al-durdur giddaami achaan ma nidammir al-balad.Wa laakin ma ligiitah.
Wa khalaas,ana ninazzil za'ali fooghum.Wa nidammirhum be naar khadabi wa nihammilhum kulla natiijat amalhum. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,fiyah awiin itneen banaat amm.
Hinna achcharmatan fi balad Masir.Aywa,min subaahin bas hinna achcharmatan.Wa hinaak,allammaso suduurhin wa li'ibo be duyuudhin wakit hinna banaat.
Wa usum al-kabiire Uhuula wa hi timassil madiinat al-Saamira.Wa akhutha usumha Uhuuliiba wa hi timassil Madiinat al-Khudus.Hinna hineeyi ana wa jaaban leyi awlaad wa banaat.
Wa Uhuula hi hinti wa laakin machat achcharmatat.Hi indaha chahwa le sudgaanha rujaal Achuur jiiraanha
al-laabsiin khulgaan khaaliyiin loonhum zahri.Wa humman hukkaam wa kubaaraat wa kulluhum subyaan al-ya'ajubu al-een wa siyaad kheel.
Wa hi achcharmatat ma'a kulla l-kubaaraat al-muhimmiin hana balad Achuur.Wa hi taaba'at chahwitha wa najjasat nafisha ma'a kulla asnaamhum.
Wa hi ma khallat charmatatha al-badatha fi Masir wakit li'ibo be duyuudha wakit hi bineeye wa ragado ma'aaha fi subaaha wa tammamo chahwithum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana sallamtaha le sudgaanha min balad Achuur al-leehum hi indaha chahwa.
Humman sallabooha wa khallooha aryaane.Wa chaalo awlaadha wa banaatha.Wa hi kamaan,katalooha be l-seef wa ikhaab chadiid bigi foogha.Wa hi bigat masal le l-awiin.
Wa akhutha Uhuuliiba chaafat kulla l-cheyy da.Wa laakin be da kula,chahwitha wa charmatatha bigo ziyaada min hana akhutha.
Wa hi indaha chahwa le rujaal Achuur al-humman hukkaam wa kubaaraat wa jiiraanha al-laabsiin khulgaan samhiin.Wa kulluhum siyaad kheel wa subyaan ya'ajubu al-een.
Wa ana chiftaha kadar hi annajjasat wa hinna al-itneen kullihin taaba'an nafs al-derib.
Wa battaan Uhuuliiba zaadat fi charmatatha-!Fi durdur,hi chaafat suwar hana rujaal Baabil marsuumiin be buhya hamra.
Ayyi waahid sulbah marbuut be hizaam wa raasah indah kadmuul.Wa kulluhum yichaabuhu kubaaraat al-askar min Baabil,balad al-wildoohum foogha.
Wa min chaafathum bas,chahwitha karabatha-!Wa hi rassalat leehum mursaal fi Baabil le yinaadiihum leeha.
Wa khalaas,al-Baabiliyiin jo leeha wa ragado fi furaachha hana l-hubb wa najjasooha be charmatathum.Wa hi annajjasat ma'aahum wa ba'ad da,hi ba''adat nafisha minhum.
Wa wassafat charmatatha wa kachafat ireeha giddaam kulla l-naas.Wa ana ba''adt nafsi minha misil ba''adt nafsi min akhutha.
Wa hi kattarat charmatatha le tizzakkar ayyaam subaaha wakit achcharmatat fi balad Masir.
Wa hi indaha chahwa le l-mufsidiin al-induhum dakar misil dakar al-humaar wa maniihum misil mani al-juwaad-!
Ya Uhuuliiba,inti gabbalti le fi'ilki al-cheen hana subaaki wakit al-Masriyiin allammaso suduurki wa li'ibo be duyuudki wakit inti sabiiye.
Wa fi chaan da,ya Uhuuliiba,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Akiid nigawwim sudgaanki diddiki,humman nafs al-naas al-ba''adti nafiski minhum.Wa ana nijiibhum diddiki min kulla bakaan.
Wa nijiib kulla rujaal balad Baabil min hillaal Faguud wa Chuu'a wa Khuu'a.Wa ma'aahum yaju kulla rujaal balad Achuur,humman al-subyaan al-ya'ajubu al-een wa kulluhum kubaaraat wa hukkaam wa kubaaraat askar wa ajaawiid wa siyaad kheel.
Wa yaju diddiki be arabaat al-harib wa kaarrooyaat wa askar katiiriin be darag kubaar wa dugaag wa tawaagi hana harib wa yihaasuruuki.Wa ana nantiihum izin le yihaakumuuki hasab charii'ithum.
Wa ana ninazzil khadab khiirti foogki wa fi chaan da,humman yi'aakhubuuki be za'al chadiid.Yagta'o munkharki wa udneeki wa l-yifaddulu min zurriiyitki yumuutu fi l-harib.Wa humman yichiilu awlaadki wa banaatki wa l-yifaddulu min zurriiyitki,al-naar taakulhum.
Wa humman yisallubuuki wa yichiilu ziinitki.
Wa khalaas,ana niwaggif fi'ilki al-cheen wa l-charmata al-badeetiiha fi Masir.Wa battaan ma tiwajjihi aleehum wa la tizzakkare balad Masir battaan.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana nisallimki le l-naas al-inti kirihtiihum wa le l-naas al-inti ba''adti nafiski minhum.
