Wa humman yi'aakhubuuki be karaahiiye wa yichiilu kulla khumaamki wa yisallubuuki wa yikhalluuki aryaane wa yakchufu ireeki wa fi'ilki al-cheen hana l-charmata.
Wa yi'aakhubuuki misil da achaan inti achcharmatti wakit taaba'ti al-umam wa najjasti nafiski be asnaamhum.
Wa inti taaba'ti derib akhutki wa be da,inti kula tacharbe min kaas ikhaabi misilha.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Inti tacharbe min kaas akhutkial-hu khariig wa wasii'.Wa da yijiib leeki dihik wa chamaateachaan al-kaas da malaan.
Taskare wa tahzaneachaan al-kaas da malaanbe kharaab wa damaarwa da kaas akhutkimadiinat al-Saamira.
Laakin inti tacharbeeh wa tikammiliihwa tikassiriih be sunuunki.Wa be chigaffah,tijarrihi duyuudki.Wa da,ana bas gultah.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Achaan inti nisiitiini wa anteetiini daharki,hassa' da alhammale natiijat fi'ilki al-cheen wa charmatatki.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,maala ma tihaakim Uhuula wa Uhuuliiba-?Aywa,haakimhin wa arrifhin be muharramaathin.
Achaan hinna zanan wa katalan dimme.Wa hinna sawwan zina ma'a asnaamhin wa iyaalhin al-wildanhum leyi,gaddamanhum dahiiye muharraga le l-asnaam le yaakuluuhum.
Wa ziyaada min da,fi nafs al-yoom hinna najjasan beeti al-mukhaddas wa ma ahtaraman yoomi hana l-sabt.
Wa wakit dabahan iyaalhin le asnaamhin,fi nafs al-yoom da,dakhalan fi beeti al-mukhaddas wa ma ahtaramannah.Wa da bas al-cheyy al-sawwannah fi lubb beeti.
Wa battaan rassalan yifattichan rujaal al-yaju min ba'iid.Wa min ligo al-mursaal,al-rujaal dool jo leehin.Wa hinna albarradan wa alkahhalan wa aljammalan leehum be ziinithin.
Wa machan ga'adan fi sariir jamiil wa giddaamah tarabeeza mujahhaza al-foogha bakhuuri wa dihni.
Wa min bakaanhin,ansama'at haraka hint jamaa'a al-ma induhum hamm.Wa ma'aahum rujaal katiiriin al-jaaboohum min al-sahara.Wa humman dasso suure fi iide ayyi waahide wa khatto leeha taaj jamiil fi raasha.
Wa khalaas,ana gult-:--Kikkeef al-awiin al-ajjazan fi l-zina yichcharmatan battaan-!Aywa,hinna charaamiit-!
Wa rujaal macho achcharmato ma'a Uhuula wa Uhuuliiba,al-awiin al-fi'ilhin cheen.
Wa laakin fiyah rujaal saalihiin al-yihaakumuuhin be hukum al-awiin al-zaaniyaat wa kattaalaat al-dimam achaan hinna zanan wa katalan dimme.-
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Gawwim diddihin jamaa'a katiiriin-!Khalli yisallumuuhin le l-ru'ub wa yabgan khaniime.
Wa khalli al-jamaa'a yarjumuuhin wa yigattu'uuhin lahamaay lahamaay be l-seef.Wa yaktulu awlaadhin wa banaathin wa yiharrugu buyuuthin.
Wa ana niwaggif al-fi'il al-cheen fi l-balad.Wa kulla l-awiin yalgan daris wa ma yisawwan fi'il cheen misil al-akhwaat al-itneen deel.
Wa natiijat fi'ilhin al-cheen taga' fi raashin wa yilhammalan al-zunuub al-sawwanhum ma'a l-asnaam.Wa be da,ya'arfan kadar ana bas Allah al-Rabb.
Wa fi l-yoom al-aachir hana l-chahar al-aachir fi l-sana al-taas'e min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,aktib taariikh hana l-yoom da.Da yoom muhaddad achaan al-yoom da,malik Baabil hajam Madiinat al-Khudus khalaas.
Adrub masal be l-cha'ab al-aasiyiin.Wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Jahhiz al-burma-!Jahhizha wa subb fiiha almi.
Wa amlaaha be laham,laham mugatta' adiil.Di l-gaayme al-warraaniiyewa l-gaayme al-giddaamiiyewa amlaaha be udaam adiiliin.
Chiil khanamaay samiinewa limm al-hatab tihit al-burma.Rakkib al-laham wa najjidah adiillahaddi al-udaam kula yanjado."-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Al-azaab le madiinat al-dimam-!Hi misil burma al-indaha sadaal-sadaaha abadan ma yamrug.Amrug minha al-laham gita' gita'bala ma ti'azzilah.
Al-damm al-daffagoohlissaa' gaa'id fi lubb al-madiina.Daffagooh fi hajar amlas,ma fi l-turaabbakaan al-ajaaj yagdar yilabbidah.
Fi khadabi al-chadiidwa le nilkaffa foogha al-taar,ana daffagt dammaha fi hajar amlasachaan ma yillabbad.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Al-azaab le madiinat al-dimam-!Ana zaati nikabbir al-hariige.
Limm hatab katiirwa oogid al-naar.Rakkib al-laham wa najjidah adiilwa subb foogah haraar.Khalli yanjadlahaddi al-udaam yahrago.
Khutt al-burma yaabse fi l-jamur le tahmawa khalli al-nahaas yabga ahmar.Wa l-najaasa tingati' fi lubbahawa l-sada yahrag.
Ana ti'ibt fi chaan al-sada da wa laakin al-sada ma yamrug be naar achaan sada al-burma di katiir.
Wa inti kula,ya madiinat al-Khudus,fi'ilki al-cheen najjasaaki-!Ana tahhartiki wa laakin inti ma bigiiti taahire.Wa inti ma tittahhare min najaasitki gabul ana ma nitimm khadabi al-chadiid diddiki.
Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah.Akiid da yaji wa ana nihaggigah.Ma nikhalli cheyy wa la narham wa la nihinn.Wa yihaakumuuki hasab amalki wa deribki al-chiltiih. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,daahu faj'atan nichiil hayaat martak al-hi farah galbak.Wa inta ma tahzan wa la tabki wa la dumuu'ak yidaffugu.
Wa laakin abki be bicheech bas,ma tunuuh le l-mayte.Kujj kadmuulak wa albas na'aalak wa ma tikhatti wijhak wa ma taakul akil al-yijiibuuh bakaan al-moot.
Wa khalaas,ana kallamt le l-cha'ab be fajur wa marti maatat be achiiye.Wa ambaakir,sawweet misil Allah amarni.
Wa l-cha'ab gaalo leyi-:-Maala gaa'id tisawwi al-cheyy da-?Ooriina da ma'anaatah chunu-?
Wa khalaas,ana gult leehum-:-Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
--Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Akiid ana ma naj'al beeti mukhaddas.Wa da bas al-beet al-tistakbaro beyah al-bigi farah guluubku wa achamku fi l-haya.Wa awlaadku wa banaatku al-khalleetuuhum waraaku fi Madiinat al-Khudus yumuutu fi l-harib.
Wa khalaas,intu kula tisawwu misil Hizgiyaal sawwaah.Ma tikhattu wujuuhku wa ma taakulu akil al-yijiibuuh bakaan al-moot.
Wa kujju kadaamiilku wa albaso ni'leeku wa ma tahzano wa la tabku.Wa tabtulu be sabab khataayaaku wa ayyi naadum yachki le l-aakhar.
Wa Hizgiyaal bigi leeku masal wa kulla cheyy al-hu sawwaah,intu kula sawwuuh.Wa wakit al-cheyy da yukuun,intu ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah al-Rabb."--
Asma',ya ibn Adam.Fi l-yoom da,ana nichiil minhum beeti al-mukhaddas al-hu malja'hum al-humman farhaaniin be azamatah wa hu farah guluubhum wa achamhum fi l-haya.Wa nichiil awlaadhum wa banaathum kula.
Wa fi l-yoom da,yajiik naadum al-mu'arrid min Madiinat al-Khudus wa yijiib leek al-khabar.
Wa fi l-yoom da wakit al-naadum al-mu'arrid ja khalaas,ya Hizgiyaal,khachmak yinfakka wa tihajji wa battaan ma tagood abkam.Wa inta tabga masal le l-naas dool wa be da,humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale Bani Ammuun wa atnabba' didduhum.
Wa guul leehum-:--Asma'o kalaam Allah al-Rabb.Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Intu achchammato wakit ma ahtaramo beeti al-mukhaddas wa wakit balad Israa'iil khirbat wa Bani Yahuuza waddoohum fi l-khurba.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nisallimku misil warasa le naas al-sabaah wa humman yukhuttu furgaanhum fi usutku wa yabnu buyuuthum.Wa humman bas yaakulu fawaakihku wa yacharbo labanku.
Wa madiinat Rabba nisawwiiha mar'a hana ibil wa balad Ammuun tabga bakaan sarha hana khanam.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah."-
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Wakit balad Israa'iil ligat diige,intu saffagtu wa nattattu wa firihtu min daakhal guluubku be kulla karaahiiyitku.
Wa fi chaan da,akiid ana narfa' iidi didduku wa nisallimku le l-umam yanhabooku wa nafsulku min al-chu'uub wa nidammirku min ust al-buldaan wa nuguchchuku marra waahid.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Naas balad Muwaab wa balad Sa'iir gaalo-:--Hassa',Bani Yahuuza bigo da'iifiin misil al-umam al-aakhariin.--
Wa fi chaan da,daahu ana nikhalli yahjumu al-mudun al-yahmu balad Muwaab.Wa l-adu yidammirhum al-waahide ba'ad al-aakhara hatta al-mudun al-jamiiliin misil Beet Yachiimut wa Ba'al Maa'oon wa Khiryataayim yiddammaro khalaas.
Wa le naas al-sabaah,ana nantiihum balad Muwaab warasa misil anteethum balad Ammuun achaan ma yizzakkarooha battaan fi ust al-umam.
Wa ana ni'aakhib Muwaab wa be da,humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Naas balad Adoom bigo khaatiyiin wakit chaalo al-taar fi Bani Yahuuza.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana narfa' iidi didd balad Adoom wa nidammir al-naas wa l-bahaayim.Wa nakhribha min madiinat Teemaan lahaddi hillit Dadaan wa sukkaanha yumuutu be l-harib.
Wa hassa',ana kula nichiil taari fi Adoom be iid cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa humman yugummu didd Adoom hasab khadabi wa za'ali.Wa khalaas be da,ya'arfu taari. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Al-Filistiyiin gammo le yichiilu al-taar.Wa chaalo al-taar be kulla karaahiiyithum min daakhal guluubhum le yidammuru udwaanhum al-min zamaan.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana narfa' iidi didd al-Filistiyiin.Aywa,nafsulhum humman al-min jaziirat Kiriit wa nidammir al-faddalo min sukkaan khachum al-bahar.
Wa hassa',ana kula nichiil fooghum taari al-kabiir wa ni'aakhibhum be khadabi al-chadiid.Wa wakit nichiil fooghum taari,khalaas humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi awwal chahar fi sanit 11 min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,sukkaan madiinat Suur achchammato wa gaalo le Madiinat al-Khudus-:--Biibaan al-madiina al-yadkhulu beehum al-chu'uub kassaroohum-!Wa tujjaarha yiwajjuhu aleena.Aywa,nabgo khaniyiin achaan Madiinat al-Khudus khirbat khalaas.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ya madiinat Suur-!Daahu ana nugumm diddiki wa nigawwim diddiki umam katiiriin misil al-bahar wakit yigawwim moojah.
Wa humman yikassuru daraadir Suur wa yihaddumu buyuutha al-tuwaal hana l-muraakhaba.Wa ana nuguchch ajaaj damaarha wa nikhalliiha misil hajar amlas.
Suur tifaddil fi ust al-bahar malsa misil bakaan al-yuchurru foogah al-churukka.Wa da,ana bas gultah.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.Hi tabga khaniime le l-umam.
Wa l-hillaal al-taab'iin leeha al-gaa'idiin barra min al-bahar yaktulu sukkaanhum be l-seef.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ya madiinat Suur-!Min al-munchaakh,nigawwim diddiki Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil hu malik al-muluuk.Yaji be kheel wa arabaat harib wa siyaad kheel wa deech kabiir wa askarah ma yinhasbu.
Hu yaktul be l-seef sukkaan hillaal al-barra min al-bahar al-taab'iin leeki.Wa ba'ad da,yihawwuguuki be khanaadig wa radmiiye wa deech kabiir be daraghum.
Wa be murdaas kabiir,yikassuru daraadirki wa be silaahhum,yihaddumu buyuutki al-tuwaal hana l-muraakhaba.
Wa min katarat al-kheel,al-ajaaj yikhattiiki wa min harakat siyaad al-kheel wa rijle al-arabaat,daraadirki yinhazzo.Wa yadkhulu biibaanki misil yadkhulu fi madiina al-sawwo leeha khurma.
Humman yifajjukhu kulla chawaari'ki be dalaafe kheelhum wa yaktulu cha'abki be l-seef.Wa l-amad al-yiwassufu gudritki,yarmuuhum fi l-turaab.
Wa yaksabo khunaaki wa yanhabo budaa'itki.Wa yikassuru daraadirki wa yihaddumu buyuutki al-samhiin.Wa ba'ad da,yichiilu hujaarki wa hatabki wa turaabki wa yusubbuuhum fi lubb al-bahar.
Wa ana niwaggif harakat khineeki wa hiss jigindiiyaatki kula ma yinsami' battaan.
Wa nisawwiiki hajar amlas wa tabge bakaan al-yuchurru foogah al-churukka.Wa inti battaan ma tinbani achaan da,ana Allah bas gultah. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal le madiinat Suur-:-Wakit sim'o harakat waga'aanki wa ganitiin al-majruuhiin wa min al-katil fi lubbiki,sukkaan al-jazaayir yarjufu.
Kulla muluuk hana khachum al-bahar yanzulu min karaasiihum wa yisillu lubaashum hana l-muluuk wa khulgaanhum al-mukallafiin.Al-khoof yakrubhum wa yagoodu fi l-turaab wa yarjufu fi kulla wakit wa yinbahtu be sababki.
Wa yunuuhu fi chaanki wa yuguulu-:--Ya l-salaam-!Al-madiina addammarathi al-sukkaanha jo min khachum al-baharaywa,hi al-chakarooha.Hi madiina aziime fi khachum al-bahar,wa sukkaanha kula aziimiinwa khawwafo kulla l-naas al-hawaaleehum.
Wa hassa',sukkaan al-jazaayir yibarjulufi yoom waga'aanha.Aywa,sukkaan al-jazaayir yinbahtuachaan hi waddarat.-
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Nisawwiiki madiina kharaab misil al-mudun al-ma induhum sukkaan.Wa nigawwim diddiki al-bahar al-khariig wa almi katiir yaakulki.
Wa ninazzilki fi l-haawiye ma'a l-naas al-nazalo fi l-khubuur min zamaan.Wa nisakkinki hinaak tihit al-ard wa tabge kharaab ila l-abad fi l-haawiye wa battaan ma yaskunuuki.Wa nanti jamaalki le ard al-hayyiin.
Wa nisawwiiki masal mukhiif achaan damaarki.Wa l-yifattuchuuki abadan ma yalgooki. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,khanni nuwaah al-hizin le madiinat Suur-!
Hajji le Suur al-gaa'ide fi madkhal al-bahar wa titaajir ma'a tujjaar chu'uub al-jazaayir al-katiiriin wa guul-:Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Ya madiinat Suur,inti gulti-:"Ana jamiile marra waahid."
Turaabki fi ust al-baharwa l-banooki sawwo jamaalki kaamil.
Wa be hatab al-sarwial-jaayi min Saniir,addalo kulla nawaayitkimisil safiina kabiire.Wa be hatab al-arzal-jaayi min Lubnaankhazzo amuudkial-yisabbit chiraa'ki.
Wa iidaankial-yilizzuuki beehumsawwoohum be hatab al-balluutal-jaayi min Baachaan.Wa magaa'idki addaloohum be hatab al-sarwial-jaabooh min jazaayir Khubruswa jammalooh be l-aaj.
Wa chiraa'kial-tilizzah al-riih le tuguudkisawwooh be gumaach mukallafal-jaayi min Masirwa hu misil raayitkial-ya'arfuuki beeha.Wa khitaaki min gumaach zahri wa garadial-jaayi min jaziirat Aliicha.
Wa sukkaan Seeda wa Arwaadbigo leeki khaddaamiinal-yilizzu iidaanki.Wa naaski al-induhum khibra,ya Suur,bigo leeki masaa'iil al-safiina.
Wa chiyyaab Gibaal al-induhum khibrayi'addulu chuguugki.Wa kulla l-sufunal-yuchuggu al-baharyagiifu fi bakaankiwa rukkaabhum yachru budaa'itki.
--Ya madiinat Suur,rujaal buldaan Faaris wa Luud wa Liibiyakaano muhaaribiin fi deechki.Wa tawaagiihum hana l-haribwa daraghum,allagoohum fi daraadirkiwa yantuuki charaf.
Wa rujaal min Arwaad wa askarkiraaykhiin foog fi daraadirki.Wa askar min Gammad hurraasfi buyuutki al-tuwaal hana l-muraakhaba.Humman allago daraghumfi tuul daraadirkiwa sawwo jamaalki kaamil.--
Ya madiinat Suur,tujjaar Tarchiich taajaro ma'aaki kulli nafar hana khunaaki al-katiir.Wa fi badal budaa'itki,antooki fudda wa hadiid wa tuuta wa hadiid azrag.
Wa tujjaar al-Yuunaan wa Tuubal wa Maachak kula taajaro ma'aaki.Wa fi badal budaa'itki,antooki abiid wa mu'iddaat hana nahaas.
Wa fi badal budaa'itki,tujjaar Beet Tugarma antooki kheel hana harib wa kheel al-yukurru beehum wa bikhaal.
Wa tujjaar Dadaan taajaro ma'aaki wa jazaayir katiiriin chaarako fi tijaaritki.Wa fi badal budaa'itki,kaffooki sunuun al-fiil wa hatab hana chadar al-tchaw.
Wa tujjaar Araam taajaro ma'aaki kulla cheyy al-inti sana'tiih be katara.Wa fi badal budaa'itki,antooki hujaar khaaliyiin wa gumaach garadi wa gumaach mukallaf wa gumaach kattaan wa marajaan wa yaakhuut ahmar.
Wa tujjaar Yahuuza wa balad Israa'iil kula taajaro ma'aaki.Wa fi badal budaa'itki,antooki gameh min hillit Minniit wa khalla wa asal wa dihin wa lubaan.
Wa tujjaar Dimachkh taajaro ma'aaki kulla cheyy al-inti sana'tiih be katara.Wa be sabab khunaaki al-katiir,jaabo leeki al-khamar hana Halbuun wa suuf khanam min Sahar.
Wa fi badal budaa'itki,tujjaar Daan wa l-Yuunaan min Uzaal antooki hadiid madguug wa girfa wa ageeg al-indah riihe.
Wa tujjaar Dadaan taajaro leeki khita al-yijammulu beyah al-sarij.
Wa l-Arab wa kulla chuyuukh Khidaar taajaro leeki humlaan wa kubchaan wa tuyuus.
Wa tujjaar Saba wa Ra'ma kula taajaro ma'aaki.Wa fi badal budaa'itki,antooki ahsan al-riihe wa ayyi nafar hana l-hujaar al-khaaliyiin wa l-dahab.
Wa tujjaar Haaraan wa Kinna wa Adan wa Saba wa Achuur wa Kilmad,humman kula taajaro ma'aaki.
Wa taajaro ma'aaki khumaam khaali.Wa fi badal budaa'itki,antooki khulgaan loonhum zahri wa mukallafiin wa busaataat mulawwaniin wa hubaal madfuuriin gawi.
Ya madiinat Suur,sufun kubaar hana l-tijaaranagalo budaa'itki.Wa inti malaane wa chaayle tagiilmisil safiina fi ust al-bahar.
Khaddaamiinki waddookifi almi al-khariigwa riih al-sabaah kassaratkifi ust al-bahar.
Wa kulla khunaaki wa budaa'itkiwa tijaaritki wa rukkaabkiwa l-yi'addulu chuguugkiwa l-yitaajuru budaa'itkiwa kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiin fi bakaankiwa kulla l-yilimmu foogki,humman kulluhum al-bahar yaakulhumfi yoom kharagki.
Wa min yasma'o korooraak masaa'iilki,sukkaan khachum al-bahar yarjufu.
Wa khalaas kulla khaddaamiinal-sufun al-aakhariin yanzuluwa l-rukkaab wa masaa'iil al-sufunyagoodu ba'iid fi l-ard.
Wa yabku leekiwa yasrakho be hizin.Wa yusubbu turaab fi ruuseehumwa yilmarmakho fi l-rumaad.
Wa fi chaanki,yizayyunu ruuseehumwa yalbaso khulgaan al-hizin.Wa yabku leeki be hurgawa yunuuhu min al-hizin.
Wa humman yachkuwa yunuuhu fi chaanki.Wa fi hizinhum,yunuuhu wa yuguulu-:--Yaatu bigi misil Suural-awwal madiina gawiiye fi ust al-bahar-!--
Wa wakit yiwaddu budaa'itki be l-bahar,inti chabba'ti chu'uub katiiriin.Wa be katarat khunaaki wa budaa'itki,inti khaneeti muluuk al-ard.
Wa hassa',alkassarti fi l-baharfi l-almi al-khariig.Wa budaa'itkiwa kulla l-yilimmu fi lubbiki khirgo.
Wa kulla sukkaan al-jazaayiranbahato fi chaanki.Wa muluukhum rajafo min al-khoofwa humman barjalo.
Wa l-taajaro ma'aaki min al-chu'uubsaffaro wa al'ajjaboachaan bigiiti masal mukhiifwa waddarti ila l-abad.
Ya ibn Adam,guul le malik Suur-:Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Inta astakbartwa gult-:"Ana ilaah-!Wa ana gaa'id fi kursi al-ilaahaatfi ust al-bahar-!"Laakin inta insaan bas,ma ilaahwa sawweet nafsak misil ilaah.
Tahsib nafsak hakiim ziyaada min Danyaalwa ma fi sirr al-mulabbad leek.
Wa be hikmatak wa fihimak,inta bigiit khaniwa maleet makhaaznakbe dahab wa fudda.
Wa be khibirtak al-kabiire fi l-tijaara,inta zidt khunaak.Wa be sabab khunaak,inta astakbart.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Achaan inta sawweet nafsak misil ilaah,
ana nigawwim diddak ajaanibmujrimiin min al-umam.Wa yisillu suyuufhum didd hikmatak al-aziimewa ma yihtarumu darajatak.
Humman yidissuuk fi l-khaburwa tumuut maktuul fi ust al-bahar.
Hal giddaam al-yaktuluuk,tagdar tilfachchar wa tuguul-:--Ana ilaah-- walla-?Laakin inta insaan bas,ma ilaahwa gaa'id tihit iide al-yaktuluuk.
Wa be iid al-ajaanib,tumuut moot hana eebmisil al-naas al-ma mutahhariin.Wa da,ana bas gultah.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,khanni nuwaah al-hizin le malik Suur-!Wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Zamaan,inta masal kaamilachaan inta malaan be l-hikmawa jamaalak kaamil.
Wa inta gaa'id fi Adinjineenit Allah.Wa lubaasak mujammalbe kulla nafar hana l-hujaar al-khaaliyiinmisil al-agiig al-ahmar wa l-yaakhuut al-asfarwa l-maasswa l-zabarjad wa l-agiig al-abyadwa l-kharazwa l-yaakhuut al-akhdar wa l-marajaanwa l-zumurrud.Wa be dahab,daggo leekkhawaatim wa suwaaral-jahhazoohum min yoom khalagook.
Wa inta makhluug samaawi chadiidwa khatteetak haarisfi jabali al-mukhaddashanaayi ana al-Rabbwa turuukh been al-hujaaral-fi ust al-naar.
--"Wa inta maachi tamaam fi derbakmin yoom khalagooklahaddi yoom ligo foogak al-fasaala.
Wa be sabab katarat budaa'tak,anmaleet be l-unuf wa aznabt.Fi chaan da,ma ja'altak mukhassaswa ba''adtak min jabali ana al-Rabb.Ya inta al-makhluug al-samaawi al-haaris,ana taradtak min been al-hujaaral-fi ust al-naar.
Achaan inta astakbartbe sabab jamaalakwa be sabab darajatak,tallaft hikmatak.Ana rameetak fi l-turaabwa khalleet al-muluuk yilfarrajo foogak.
Wa be katarat khataakwa zulmak fi tijaartak,inta ma ahtaramtal-bakaanaat al-mukhaddasiin.Wa ana maragt min ustak naar al-taakulakwa sawweetak rumaad fi l-ardgiddaam kulla l-yichiifuuk.
Wa kulla l-chu'uub al-ya'arfuukyinbahtu fi chaanak.Inta bigiit masal mukhiifwa waddart ila l-abad."-
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale madiinat Seeda wa atnabba' diddaha.
Wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Akiid ana gammeet diddiki,ya madiinat Seeda-!Yimajjuduuni fi usutki.Wakit ni'aakhibki,niwassif khadaastile l-naas al-fi lubbikiwa ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Ana ninazzil waba foogkiwa l-damm yidaffig fi chawaari'kiwa l-naas yumuutu fi lubbikibe sabab al-haribal-yaji leeki min kulli jiihe.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah."--
Wa battaan ma fi chook wa la andireesa al-yat'ano Bani Israa'iil min kulla l-naas al-yahguruuhum al-gaa'idiin hawaaleehum.Wa ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah al-Rabb.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Wakit nilimm Bani Israa'iil min ust al-chu'uub al-humman muchattatiin fi lubbuhum,beehum ana niwassif khadaasti giddaam al-umam.Wa Bani Israa'iil yaskunu battaan fi arduhum al-ana anteetha le jidduhum Yaakhuub.
Wa humman yaskunu be amaan wa yabnu buyuut wa yimaggunu jineenaat al-inab.Wa yaskunu be amaan wakit ninazzil ikhaabi didd kulla l-naas al-hagaroohum wa gaa'idiin hawaaleehum.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahhum.-
Wa fi yoom 12 hana l-chahar al-aachir fi l-sana al-aachir min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale Fir'oon malik Masir wa atnabba' diddah wa didd kulla l-Masriyiin.
Wa guul leehum-:Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Akiid ana nugumm diddak,ya Fir'oon malik Masir,inta al-misil tumsaah kabiiral-raagid fi ust al-Niil.Wa inta gult-:"Al-Niil da hanaayiwa ana bas khalagtah-!"
Wa laakin ana nidiss leek jambaat fi khachmakwa narbut kulla huut Niilak fi girfak.Wa namurgak min usut Niilakma'a kulla huut Niilak al-marbuut fi girfak.
Wa nikhalliik fi l-saharama'a kulla huut Niilak.Taga' fi l-kadaadewa la tinjaab wa la tinlamma.Tabga akil le haywaanaat al-kadaadewa tuyuur al-sama.
Wa be da,kulla sukkaan Masirya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.---Ya balad Masir,inti bigiiti misil ageegaay da'iifeal-yirrakkazo foogha Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit chaalooki fi iideehum,inti alkassarti wa jarahti kataafeehum.Wa wakit yirrakkazo foogki inti al-mukassara,inti kassarti kulla salabaahum.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Akiid ana nigawwim harib didd balad Masir wa naktul al-naas wa l-bahaayim.
Wa Masir takhrab wa tabga koom hana turaab.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.-Inta gult-:--Al-Niil da hanaayi wa ana bas khalagtah.--
Wa be sabab da,akiid ana nugumm diddak wa didd Niilak wa nisawwi balad Masir koom hana turaab wa kharaab min Migduul lahaddi Aswaan wa lahaddi huduud al-Habacha.
Wa le muddit 40 sana,wa la rijil insaan wa la rijil bahiime ma tuchugg al-bakaan da.
Wa balad Masir takhrab ziyaada min kharaab al-buldaan al-aakhariin.Wa le muddit 40 sana,mudunha yagoodu kharaab ziyaada min kharaab al-mudun al-aakhariin.Wa ana nichattit al-Masriyiin been al-umam wa nifarrighum fi ust al-buldaan.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ba'ad 40 sana,ana nilimm al-Masriyiin min been al-chu'uub al-humman muchattatiin fi lubbuhum.
Wa nigabbil al-Masriyiin min balad al-khurba wa nijiibhum fi ard juduudhum fi junuub Masir wa humman yikawwunu mamlaka da'iife.
Wa l-mamlaka di tabga da'iife min kulla l-mamaalik wa battaan ma tagdar tisawwi nafisha aaliye fi l-umam.Wa nisawwi naasha chiyya lahaddi ma yagdaro yamulku fi l-umam.
Wa battaan Bani Israa'iil ma yitwakkalo ale l-Masriyiin.Balad Masir tagood achaan Bani Israa'iil yizzakkaro khataahum al-sawwooh wakit wajjaho aleeha.Wa ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah al-Rabb.
Wa fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-awwal fi sanit 27 min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil kallaf askarah be khidme tagiile didd madiinat Suur lahaddi ruuseehum salla'o wa kataafeehum anjaraho.Wa laakin ma ligo faayde al-takfi le l-malik wa la le askarah be kulla l-khidme al-sawwooha didd madiinat Suur.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Daahu ana nanti balad Masir le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Wa yichiil khunaaha wa yisawwiiha kasiibe wa yanhabha nahib chadiid.Wa Masir tabga faayde le askarah.
Wa ana nantiih balad Masir misil mukaafa achaan hu wa askarah khadamo leyi.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana niziid khuwwat Bani Israa'iil.Wa leek inta,ya ibn Adam,nantiik fursa le tihajji fi usuthum.Wa be da,humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Ya ibn Adam,atnabba' wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Abku fi yoom al-hizin.
Achaan al-yoom gariib,yoom Allah gariib.Da yoom malaan be l-sahaabwa yoom ikhaab al-umam.
Al-harib yadkhul fi Masirwa l-ta'ab yaji fi l-Habacha.Fi l-wakit da,yaktulu al-Masriyiinwa yichiilu khunaahumwa yihaddumu asaashum.
Wa naas balad al-Habachawa Fuut wa Luud wa kulla l-Arabwa naas Liibiya wa sukkaan al-balad al-induhum ma'aahum alaakhakulluhum yumuutu fi l-harib."-
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Al-yisaa'udu Masir yabgo ma fiihum wa gudritha al-tistakbar beeha kula tangus.Wa min Migduul le Aswaan,naasha yumuutu be l-harib.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa balad Masir takhrab misil kharaab al-buldaan al-aakhariin wa mudunha yakhrabo misil kharaab al-mudun al-aakhariin.
Wa wakit nahrig Masir wa nahlik kulla l-yisaa'uduuha,khalaas ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,murassaliin yamurgu min giddaami be sufun wa yamchu le yirajjufu balad al-Habacha al-gaa'ide be amaan.Wa fi yoom ikhaab Masir,yaji ta'ab fi cha'ab al-Habacha.Aywa,al-yoom da yaji.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana nidammir sukkaan Masirbe iid Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.
Hu wa cha'abah mujrimiin min kulla l-umamwa ana nijiibhum le yidammuru al-balad di.Humman yihaarubu al-Masriyiinwa yamlo al-balad be janaazaat.
Ana niyabbis al-Niilwa nibii' al-balad le l-fasliin.Wa nidammir al-balad wa kulla cheyy al-fiihabe iid al-ajaanib.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana nidammir al-asnaamwa nuguchch al-ilaahaat min madiinat Mamfiis.Battaan malik fi Masir yabga ma fiihwa ninazzil al-khoof fi balad Masir.
Wa nakhrib junuub Masir wa nidiss al-naar fi hillit Su'aan wa ni'aakhib madiinat Tiiba.
Wa ninazzil khadabi fi hillit Siin wa da l-bakaan al-gawi hana Masir.Wa nuguchch sukkaan Tiiba al-katiiriin.
Wa nidiss al-naar fi Masir wa hillit Siin tittanna min al-waja'.Wa madiinat Tiiba tinchagga wa madiinat Mamfiis tiddaayag kulla yoom.
Wa subyaan mudun Uun wa Fibista yumuutu fi l-harib wa l-awiin yiwadduuhin khadiim.
Wakit ninazzil tagalat al-daami al-khattatah Masir fi l-aakhariin wa niwaggif gudrat istikbaarha,al-nahaar yabga adlam fi hillit Tahfaniis.Wa sahaabaay tikhattiiha wa banaatha yiwadduuhin khadiim.
Wa ana ni'aakhib Masir wa be da,humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi l-yoom al-saabi' hana l-chahar al-awwal fi sanit 11 min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,ana kassart iid Fir'oon malik Masir wa daahu ma fi naadum al-yidaawiih le yalga al-aafe wa la yiliff leyah iidah achaan tiddaawa wa talga gudra wa takrub al-seef.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Akiid ana nugumm didd Fir'oon malik Masir wa nikassir iideenah al-itneen,al-taybe wa l-awwal maksuura kula,wa narmi al-seef min iidah.
Wa nichattit al-Masriyiin been al-umam wa nifarrighum fi ust al-buldaan.
Wa nigawwi iid malik Baabil wa nantiih seefi fi iidah.Wa laakin nikassir iideen Fir'oon wa yagnit giddaam malik Baabil misil ganiit al-majruuh al-yidoor yumuut.
Wa nigawwi iideen malik Baabil wa laakin iideen Fir'oon yinrakhu.Wa wakit nanti seefi le malik Baabil wa yarfa'ah didd balad Masir,khalaas ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa ana nichattit al-Masriyiin been al-umam wa nifarrighum fi ust al-buldaan.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-taalit fi sanit 11 min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,guul le Fir'oon malik Masir wa askarah-:--Inta tichaabih yaatu be azamatak-?
Inta tichaabih arz Lubnaanal-indah furuu' jamiiliin.Hu chadar indah dull wa tawiilwa tuulah lihig al-sahaab.
Al-almi kabbarahwa uyuun almi al-khariig gawwamooh.Wa l-buhuur jaariyiinhawaale al-bakaanal-hu mumaggan foogah.Wa majaari al-almi yajrule kulla chadar al-kadaade.
Wa fi chaan da,tuulah bigi aaliwa faat kulla chadar al-kadaade.Furuu'ah bigo katiiriin wa tuwaalwa sawwo warag be sabab al-almi al-katiir.
Kulla tuyuur al-samasawwo uchuuchhum fi furuu'ahwa kulla haywaanaat al-kadaadewildo iyaalhum tihtahwa kulla l-umam al-katiiriinanjammo fi dullah.
Hu jamiil fi azamatah wa fi tuul furuu'ahachaan uruugah wassalo al-almi al-katiir.
Chadar al-arz fi jineenit al-Rabbma yisaawiihwa chadar al-sarwima yichaabih furuu'ahwa l-chadar al-aakhariinma yisawwu misil dullahwa ayyi chadara fi jineenit al-Rabbma jamiile minnah.
Ana jammaltahbe katarat furuu'ahwa ayyi chadara fi Adin jineenit al-Rabbgaa'ide tahsidah.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Al-chadar da kibir wa bigi tawiil wa tuulah lihig al-sahaab wa astakbar be tuulah.
Wa fi chaan da,ana sallamtah fi iid mas'uul al-umam le yisawwu foogah hasab fasaaltah achaan ana taradtah.
Wa l-ajaanib al-mujrimiin min al-umam gata'ooh wa khallooh.Wa furuu'ah waga'o fi ruuse al-jibaal wa fi kulla l-wudyaan wa waragah chatta fi kulla rujuul al-balad.Wa kulla chu'uub al-ard gammo min dullah wa khallooh.
Wa kulla tuyuur al-sama saakniin fi dumburah wa kulla haywaanaat al-kadaade yillabbado tihit furuu'ah.
Wa be da,ma fi chadar battaan al-gaa'id jamb al-almi wa bigi tawiil wa lihig al-sahaab.Wa ma fi chadar mazgi adiil al-yistakbar fi l-aakhariin.Achaan kulluhum sallamoohum le l-moot wa yanzulu tihit al-ard been al-naas al-naazliin fi l-khubuur.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Yoom chadar al-arz maat wa nazal fi l-haawiye,ana amart al-tabii'a tahzan fi chaanah wa ana saddeet almi al-khariig wa waggaft al-buhuur wa l-almi al-katiir ma yajri.Wa fi chaanah hu,ana dallamt jibaal Lubnaan wa kulla chadar al-kadaade yibis.
Wa be hiss waga'aanah,nirajjif al-umam wakit nazzaltah fi l-haawiye ma'a l-naas al-naazliin fi l-khubuur.Wa hinaak tihit al-ard,kulla chadar Adin wa kulla l-chadar al-samhiin ziyaada wa mazgiyiin adiil fi jibaal Lubnaan yafraho.
Wa humman dool kula nazalo ma'aayah fi l-haawiye ma'a l-naas al-maato fi l-harib.Wa awwal,humman dool musaa'idiin chadar al-arz da wa anjammo fi dullah fi ust al-umam.
Ya Fir'oon,inta tahsib tichaabih chadar Adin be azamatak wa charafak walla-?Wa laakin be da kula,ninazzilak ma'a chadar Adin tihit al-ard.Wa inta targud fi ust al-ma mutahhariin wa ma'a l-naas al-maato fi l-harib.Wa da l-cheyy al-yabga le Fir'oon wa kulla askarah. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Fi l-yoom al-awwal hana chahri 12 fi sanit 12 min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,khanni nuwaah al-hizin le Fir'oon malik Masir wa guul leyah-:--Inta chabbaht duud fi ust al-umamwa inta misil tumsaah fi l-bahar.Wa inta gammeet fi lubb al-bahar be chiddewa tiharrik al-almi be rijileenakwa tiwassikh al-bahar.-
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Nukujj leek charakifi wakit chu'uub katiiriin yilimmuwa humman yarmuuk fi amkajjaamti.
Ana narmiik fi l-ardwa nazgulak fi l-kadaade.Ninazzil foogak kulla tuyuur al-samawa haywaanaat al-kadaade yaakulu wa yachba'o minnak.
Ana nukhutt laham jildakfi ruuse al-jibaalwa namla al-wudyaanbe l-faddal min rimmitak.
Nazgi al-ard be dammak al-yidaffig minnakwa l-jibaal wa l-rujuul yinmalu.
Wa wakit nuurak yumuut,ana nikhatti al-samawa nidallim al-nujuum.Nikhatti al-harraay be sahaabwa l-gamar ma yidawwi battaan.
Be sababak inta,nidallim kulla anwaar al-samawa nijiib al-dalaam fi baladak.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wakit nikhabbir al-umam be damaarak,chu'uub katiiriin yibarjulu lahaddi fi buldaan al-awwal inta ma ta'arifhum.
Wa be sababak inta,chu'uub katiiriin yabgo haznaaniin wa muluukhum yarjufu min al-khoof wakit nisill seefi giddaamhum.Fi yoom inta waga't,yarjufu kulla wakit wa ayyi waahid minhum yakhaaf le nafsah.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Seef malik Baabil yajiik.
Nijiib suyuuf al-fahaliinal-humman mujrimiin min al-umamwa yaktulu kulla askarak.Aywa,humman yiwadduru istikbaar Masirwa kulla askarha yiddammaro.
Wa ana nidammir kulla bahaayimhamin jamb al-almi al-katiir.Wa la rijil insaan wa la duluf bahiimema yibarjil al-almi battaan.
Khalaas almi Masir yukuun haadiwa rujuulha yajru misil al-dihin.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wakit nakhrib balad Masirwa nuguchch kulla cheyy al-fi lubbahawa nidammir kulla l-naas al-saakniin foogha,khalaas ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Da nuwaah al-hizin al-yikhannuuh.Khalli banaat al-umam yikhannan beyah.Hinna yikhannan al-nuwaah da le Masir wa le kulla askarha. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa fi yoom 15 hana chahri 12 fi sanit 12 min waddoona fi l-khurba,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,khanni nuwaah al-hizin le cha'ab Masir,leehum humman wa umam aakhariin aziimiin.Khalli nuwaahak yinazzilhum tihit al-ard ma'a l-nazalo fi l-khubuur.
Wa guul leehum-:--Ya askar Masir,intu samhiinziyaada min yaatu-?Anzulu fi l-khubuurwa arugdu ma'a l-ma mutahhariin.--
Aywa,al-Masriyiin yumuutu fi l-harib.Wa hassa',al-seef jaahiz le l-katil.Khalli yigaddumu leyah Masir wa cha'abha-!
Wa fi bakaan al-maytiin,kubaaraat al-furraas wa mu'aawiniinhum yihajju leehum wa yuguulu-:--Hassa',al-ma mutahhariin al-maato fi l-harib nazalo wa ragado fi l-khubuur-!--
Malik Achuur gaa'id fi l-bakaan da ma'a kulla askarah.Wa hu muhawwag be khubuur askarah al-maato fi l-harib
wa khubuurhum gaa'idiin tihit fi aakhir al-ard.Wa daahu askarah wa khubuurhum muhawwigiinah.Kulluhum maato fi l-harib,humman al-awwal jaabo al-ru'ub fi ard al-hayyiin.
Wa malik Ilaam gaa'id fi l-bakaan da ma'a kulla askarah.Wa hu muhawwag be khubuur askarah al-maato fi l-harib.Humman al-ma mutahhariin al-awwal jaabo al-ru'ub fi ard al-hayyiin.Wa hassa' be ihaana,nazalo tihit al-ard ma'a kulla l-nazalo fi l-khubuur.
Aywa,malik Ilaam ragad fi usut askarah al-maato fi l-harib wa hu muhawwag be khubuurhum.Wa kulla l-ma mutahhariin dool maato fi l-harib,humman al-awwal jaabo al-ru'ub fi ard al-hayyiin.Wa hassa',aabo ma'a kulla l-nazalo fi l-khubuur.Chaalo bakaanhum ambeen al-maato fi l-harib.
Wa malik Maachak wa malik Tuubal gaa'idiin fi l-bakaan da ma'a kulla askarhum.Wa humman muhawwagiin be khubuur askarhum.Wa kulla l-ma mutahhariin dool maato fi l-harib,humman al-awwal jaabo al-ru'ub fi ard al-hayyiin.
Ma ragado ma'a l-furraas al-fahaliin al-maato zamaan,humman al-awwal jaabo al-ru'ub fi ard al-hayyiin.Wa humman dool nazalo fi bakaan al-maytiin be silaahhum hana l-harib.Khatto suyuufhum tihit ruuseehum wa daraghum min foog leehum.
Wa inta kula,ya Fir'oon,tumuut ma'a l-ma mutahhariin wa targud ma'a l-maato fi l-harib.
Wa l-Adoomiyiin wa muluukhum wa kulla chuyuukhhum gaa'idiin fi l-bakaan da.Be fahaaliiyithum kula,khattoohum ma'a l-aakhariin al-maato fi l-harib.Yarugdu ma'a l-ma mutahhariin wa ma'a l-nazalo fi l-khubuur.
Wa kulla kubaaraat al-munchaakh gaa'idiin fi l-bakaan da ma'a kulla naas balad Seeda al-nazalo ma'a l-maytiin.Humman induhum eeb achaan jaabo al-ru'ub be faraasiiyithum.Wa hassa',al-ma mutahhariin dool yarugdu ma'a l-maato fi l-harib wa chaayliin eebhum ma'a l-nazalo fi l-khubuur.
Wakit Fir'oon yichiif al-maytiin dool,yisabbir nafsah be moot askarah al-katiiriin.Aywa Fir'oon wa kulla askarah maato fi l-harib.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Aywa,ana bas khalleetah yijiib al-ru'ub fi ard al-hayyiin wa laakin hassa',Fir'oon wa kulla askarah yarugdu fi ust al-ma mutahhariin al-maato fi l-harib. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi ana Hizgiyaal wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,hajji le cha'abak wa guul leehum-:--Wakit nijiib al-harib fi ayyi balad,al-cha'ab yichiilu minhum naadum wa yukhuttuuh haras.
Kan al-naadum da yichiif al-adu jaayi,khalaas hu yadrub al-buug le yikhabbir al-cha'ab.
Wa kan naadum yasma' hiss al-buug wa laakin ma yichiil al-hazar,wakit al-harib yugumm hu yumuut wa hu bas yukuun mas'uul min mootah.
Aywa,kan naadum yasma' hiss al-buug wa ma yichiil al-hazar,hu bas yukuun mas'uul min mootah.Wa l-yichiil al-hazar kamaan,hu yinajji nafsah.
Wa laakin kan al-haras yichiif al-adu jaayi wa ma yadrub al-buug,khalaas al-cha'ab ma induhum al-hazar.Wa kan al-harib yugumm wa waahid minhum yumuut,al-khata hana l-moot da yaga' fi raas al-haras.Wa ana natlub dimmit al-mayyit da min al-haras.--
Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,ana khatteetak haras fi Bani Israa'iil.Inta tasma' kalaami wa tihazzirhum.
Akuun nuguul le l-aasi akiid yumuut.Kan inta ma tihajji le l-aasi wa tihazzirah le yikhalli derbah al-fasil wa hu yumuut fi khataayah,khalaas minnak inta bas ana natlub dimmitah.
Wa laakin kan inta hazzart al-aasi le yikhalli derbah al-fasil wa hu aba ma yikhalliih,khalaas hu yumuut fi khataayah wa inta najjeet nafsak.
Asma',ya ibn Adam.Guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Daahu intu gultu-:"Isyaanna wa zunuubna gaa'idiin foogna wa be sababhum,aniina di'ifna.Wa be da,kikkeef nagdaro nahyo-?"--
Wa guul leehum-:--Daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:"Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,ana ma nafrah be moot al-aasi.Laakin khalli yigabbil min derbah al-fasil wa yahya.Gabbulu-!Gabbulu min duruubku al-fasliin.Maala tidooru al-moot,ya Bani Israa'iil-?"--
Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,guul le cha'abak-:--Adaalit al-aadil ma tinajjiih kan yugumm be l-isyaan.Wa isyaan al-aasi ma yitarti'ah kan hu yigabbil min isyaanah.Aywa,al-aadil ma yagdar yi'iich fi adaaltah kan hu yaznib.
Wakit nuguul le l-aadil akiid yahya,hu yahya.Wa laakin akuun hu yitwakkal ale adaaltah wa yugumm be l-zulum.Wa be da,al-naas ma yizzakkaro kulla amalah al-saalih wa hu yumuut fi zulmah al-hu sawwaah.
Wa kan nuguul le l-aasi akiid yumuut,hu yumuut.Wa laakin kan hu yikhalli zanbah wa yugumm be l-hagg wa l-adaala
wa kan hu yigabbil al-damaana wa yigabbil ayyi cheyy al-sirgah wa yamchi hasab gawaaniin al-haya wa ma yisawwi al-zulum,khalaas be da,akiid hu yahya wa ma yumuut.
Ma fi zanib min zunuubah al-yizzakkarooh beyah achaan hu sawwa al-hagg wa l-adaala wa be da,akiid hu yi'iich.--
Wa cha'abak buguulu-:--Al-cheyy al-sawwaah al-Rabb da ma adiil.- Al-cheyy al-humman gaa'idiin yisawwuuh da bas ma adiil.
Wakit al-aadil yigabbil min adaaltah wa yugumm be l-zulum,hu yumuut be sababah.
Wa wakit al-aasi yigabbil min isyaanah wa yugumm be l-hagg wa l-adaala,hu yahya be sababhum.
Wa be da kula,intu tuguulu-:--Al-cheyy al-sawwaah al-Rabb da ma adiil-!- Ana nihaakimku hasab deribku al-chiltuuh,ya Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-yoom al-khaamis hana l-chahar al-aachir fi sanit 12 min waddoona fi l-khurba,ja leyi naadum waahid mu'arrid min Madiinat al-Khudus wa gaal leyi-:-Al-madiina chaalooha-!
Fi l-achiiye gubbaal al-naadum da ma yaji leyi,gudrat Allah nazzalat foogi wa khachmi anfatah.Wa be fajur wakit hu ja leyi,khachmi faatih wa ana ma abkam.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Ya ibn Adam,al-sukkaan hana l-hillaal al-muhaddamiin al-fi balad Israa'iil yuguulu-:--Ibraahiim wiheedah bas chaal al-balad di.Wa aniina katiiriin wa antooha leena warasa.--
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Intu taakulu laham fatiis wa ta'abudu al-asnaam wa taktulu al-dimam.Wa be da,tawrusu al-balad di walla-?
Wa taakulu be gudrat suyuufku wa awiinku yisawwan al-haraam.Wa ayyi raajil minku yargud ma'a marit jaarah wa yinajjisha.Wa be da,tawrusu al-balad di walla-?"--
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-tuguulah leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,humman al-gaa'idiin fi l-hillaal al-muhaddamiin yumuutu fi l-harib wa l-gaa'idiin fi l-kadaade,haywaanaat al-kadaade yaakuluuhum wa l-gaa'idiin fi l-jibaal wa l-karaakiir yumuutu be l-waba.
Wa nisawwi al-balad kharbaane wa yaabse wa gudrat istikbaarha tagiif.Wa jibaal Israa'iil yabgo kharaab wa naadum waahid kula ma yufuut beehum battaan.
Wa wakit nisawwi al-balad kharbaane wa yaabse be sabab kulla l-haraam al-sawwooh,khalaas humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah."--
Wa asma',ya ibn Adam-!Cha'abak yihajju beek fi tihit al-daraadir wa fi khuchuum al-biibaan.Al-waahid yihajji le l-aakhar wa ayyi waahid yihajji le akhuuh wa yuguul-:--Ta'aalu asma'o al-kalaam al-jaayi min Allah-!--
Wa cha'abi yaju leek be katara wa yagoodu giddaamak.Wa yasma'o kalaamak wa laakin ma yitabbuguuh.Yukhuchchu be kalaamhum wa yamchu wara maal al-haraam.
Wa daahu inta bigiit leehum misil khinneeye hana hubb al-yikhannuuha be hiss halu wa be aala hana musiikha.Humman yasma'o kalaamak wa laakin ma yitabbuguuh.
Wa wakit al-cheyy al-tihajji beyah yaji wa kan ja khalaas,ya'arfu tamaam kadar fi nabi gaa'id fi usuthum.
Ya ibn Adam,atnabba' didd ru'yaan Israa'iil.Atnabba' wa guul le l-ru'yaan dool-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Al-azaab leeku intu,ya ru'yaan Israa'iil al-tasraho be nufuusku bas-!Al-ru'yaan ma waajib yasraho be l-khanam walla-?
Intu tacharbo laban al-khanam wa talbaso suufhum wa tadbaho al-khanam al-sumaan.Wa laakin be da kula,ma sarahtu beehum.
Wa intu ma sammantu al-baatle wa ma aalajtu al-mardaane wa ma rabattu rijil al-maksuura wa ma jibtu al-muwaddire wa ma fattachtu al-raayhe.Wa laakin intu ga'adtu fi raashum be gu wa unuf.
Wa l-khanam chatto achaan ma induhum raa'i.Wa humman bigo ma'aach le kulla haywaanaat al-kadaade wa chatto.
Wa khanami chatto fi kulla l-jibaal wa fi kulla l-giizaan.Wa khanami bigo muchattatiin fi kulla l-balad wa ma fi naadum al-yifattichhum wa ma fi al-yamchi waraahum."-
Wa fi chaan da,ya l-ru'yaan,asma'o kalaam Allah-!Hu gaal-:
Ana nahlif be usmi al-Hayy.Khanami intu khalleetuuhum le l-nahib wa bigo ma'aach le kulla haywaanaat al-kadaade achaan ma induhum ru'yaan.Wa ma fattachtu khanami wa laakin gaa'idiin tasraho be nufuusku bas,ma be khanami. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa fi chaan da,ya l-ru'yaan,asma'o kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Akiid ana nugumm didd al-ru'yaan wa nifattich khanami wa nichiilhum minhum wa natrudhum min khidmithum hana l-ru'yaan.Wa l-ru'yaan dool battaan ma yagdaro yasraho hatta be nufuushum kula.Wa ninajji khanami min khuchuumhum wa battaan ma yaakuluuhum wa la yabgo leehum ma'aach.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana zaati naji nifattich khanami wa nirayyishum.
Wa misil al-raa'i al-yilimm khanamah al-muchattatiin wa yirayyishum,ana kula nirayyis khanami.Wa nilimmuhum min kulla bakaan al-humman muchattatiin foogah fi yoom al-dalaam wa l-diige.
Wa namrughum min ust al-chu'uub wa nilimmuhum min al-buldaan wa nigabbilhum fi arduhum.Wa nisarrihhum fi jibaal Israa'iil wa fi l-wudyaan wa fi kulla l-bakaanaat al-yagdaro yaskunu fooghum al-naas fi l-balad.
Wa nisarrihhum fi bakaan adiil wa da l-mar'a al-gaa'id fi l-jibaal al-aaliyiin hana balad Israa'iil.Wa fi l-mar'a al-adiil da bas,humman yarugdu wa yasraho fi mar'a adiil fi jibaal Israa'iil.
Wa ana zaati nisarrih khanami wa niraggidhum.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Al-khanamaay al-raayhe,nifattichha wa l-muwaddire,nijiibha wa l-rijilha maksuura,narbutha wa l-da'iife,nigawwiiha.Wa laakin al-tisammin nafisha aw al-tiwassif gudritha,nidammirha.Wa nasrah be khanami be adaala.
Wa Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Intu ya cha'abi al-misil khanami,daahuuni ana nahkim been khanamaay wa aakhara wa been kabich wa tees.
Wa da chiyya leeku wakit tasraho fi mar'a adiil walla-?Maala al-gechch al-faddal tifajjukhuuh be rijleeku-?Wa da chiyya leeku wakit tacharbo almi nadiif walla-?Maala al-almi al-faddal titallufuuh be rijleeku-?
Wa misil da,khanami yasraho fi l-mar'a al-intu fajjakhtuuh be rijleeku wa yacharbo al-almi al-intu tallaftuuh be rijleeku.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Daahuuni ana zaati jaayi nahkim been al-khanamaay al-samiine wa l-khanamaay al-baatle.
Intu lazzeetu kulla l-da'iifiin be nawaayitku wa kataafeeku wa darabtuuhum be guruunku lahaddi chattattuuhum barra min al-mar'a.
Wa ana naji nafza' khanami wa battaan ma yanhaboohum.Wa nahkim been khanamaay wa aakhara.
Wa nijiib le khanami raa'i waahid al-yasrah beehum.Wa hu yabga misil abdi Dawuud.Yasrah beehum wa yabga leehum raa'i.
Wa ana Allah nabga Ilaahhum wa hu yabga malik fooghum.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah.
Wa ana nisawwi mu'aahadat salaam ma'a cha'abi al-misil khanami.Wa nidammir al-haywaanaat al-fasliin min al-balad wa khanami yaskunu fi l-kadaade be amaan wa yunuumu fi l-khaaba.
Wa naj'alhum baraka,humman wa l-bakaanaat al-mujaawiriin jabali.Wa ninazzil al-matar fi waktah wa da yabga matar hana baraka.
Wa chadar al-kadaade yantu fawaakihhum wa l-ard tanti intaajha wa cha'abi yagoodu be amaan fi arduhum.Wa wakit nidalli tagalat al-daami min kataafeehum wa ninajjiihum min al-yi'abbuduuhum,khalaas ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa humman ma yabgo khaniime le l-umam battaan wa haywaanaat al-kadaade kula ma yaakuluuhum.Wa humman yaskunu be amaan wa ma fi naadum yibachtinhum.
Wa nigawwim leehum ziraa'a ma'ruufa be katarat al-intaaj.Wa l-juu' battaan ma yaktulhum fi l-balad wa ma yabgo mu'yaar fi ust al-umam.
Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahhum al-gaa'id ma'aahum wa Bani Israa'iil humman cha'abi.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa intu cha'abi al-misil khanami al-ana nasrah beeku wa ana Ilaahku. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale jabal Sa'iir wa sukkaanah wa atnabba' diddah.
Wa guul leyah-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Akiid ana nugumm diddak,ya jabal Sa'iir,wa narfa' iidi diddakwa nisawwiik kharaab wa yabaas.
Wa nisawwi mudunak koom hana turaabwa inta tabga kharaab.Wa be da,inta ta'arif kadar ana bas Allah.
--"Inta indak adaawa daayme wa rameet Bani Israa'iil fi l-harib fi wakit diigithum,wakit zunuubhum lihgo hadduhum."-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:-Ana nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,namlaak be damm wa l-damm yitaaridak.Akiid inta ma khuft min al-dimme wa hassa',al-damm yitaaridak.
Ya jabal Sa'iir,nisawwiik kharaab wa yabaas wa namna' al-naas ma yufuutu beek.
Wa namla jibaalak be l-janaazaat.Wa fi hujaarak wa wudyaanak wa kulla rujuulak,naasak yumuutu fi l-harib.
Wa ana nisawwiik kharaab ila l-abad wa mudunak ma yaskunu fooghum.Wa be da,ta'arif kadar ana bas Allah.
Inta gult-:--Al-umam al-itneen hana Israa'iil wa Yahuuza wa cha'abhum,ana nichiilhum wa yabgo hineeyi ana,hatta kan Allah gaa'id fooghum kula.--
Wa fi chaan da,daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:--Ana nahlif be usmi al-Hayy,nisawwi foogak hasab za'alak wa husdak wa karaahiiytak al-inta gammeet beehum didd al-mamaalik dool.Wa wakit ninazzil ikhaabi foogak,khalaas humman ya'arfuuni-!
Wa be da,inta kula ta'arif kadar ana bas Allah wa ana simi't kulla l-mu'yaar al-inta ayyart beyah jibaal Israa'iil wakit gult-:"jibaal Israa'iil bigo kharaab-!Khalaas,antoohum leena misil ma'aach wa aniina naakuluuhum-!"
Inta hajjeet foogi be istikbaar wa kattart kalaamak diddi wa ana simi'tah.-
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Wakit nakharbak,kulla l-buldaan yafraho.
Wakit ard warasat Bani Israa'iil khirbat,inta firiht wa fi chaan da,ana nisawwiik misilha.Ya jabal Sa'iir,inta takhrab wa kulla balad Adoom kula.Wa be da,kulla l-naas ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Ya ibn Adam,atnabba' le jibaal Israa'iil wa guul-:--Ya naas jibaal Israa'iil,asma'o kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:Al-adu gaal-:"Aywa-!Al-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin al-gaa'idiin min zamaan dool bigo warasatna."--
Be sabab da,atnabba' le jibaal Israa'iil wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Dammarooku wa daayagooku min kulli jiihe le tabgo warasa le kulla l-umam al-aakhariin wa bigiitu chimmeete fi khuchuum kulla l-chu'uub."-
Wa fi chaan da,ya jibaal Israa'iil,asma'o kalaam Allah al-Rabb.Daahu Allah al-Rabb hajja le l-jibaal wa l-hujaar wa l-rujuul wa l-wudyaan wa l-bakaanaat al-muhaddamiin wa l-mudun al-kharaab al-nahaboohum wa achchammato fooghum al-umam al-muhawwigiinhum.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Akiid be mahabbiti al-chadiide,nihajji didd kulla l-umam al-aakhariin wa didd kulla naas balad Adoom.Achaan be farha fi guluubhum wa karaahiiye fi nufuushum,humman nahabo baladi wa chaalo mar'aaha.
Wa fi chaan da,atnabba' le balad Israa'iil wa guul le l-jibaal wa l-hujaar wa l-rujuul wa l-wudyaan-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Akiid ana nihajji be kulla khiirti wa be kulla khadabi be sabab al-ihaana al-sawwooha leeku al-umam."-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ana halaft-!Akiid al-umam al-muhawwigiinku yilhammalo natiijat al-ihaana al-sawwooha leeku.
Wa intu,ya jibaal Israa'iil,tigawwumu chadar wa yisawwu furuu' wa yaldo fawaakih le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil achaan gariib yigabbulu hini.
Aywa,daahuuni ana jaayi leeku wa niwajjih aleeku wa battaan arduku titeerubuuha wa tahartuuha.
Wa nikattir naas Bani Israa'iil wa yaskunu al-mudun wa yabnu al-bakaanaat al-muhaddamiin.
Wa nikattir al-naas wa l-bahaayim wa humman yaldo wa yabgo katiiriin.Wa nisawwiihum katiiriin ziyaada min awwal wa nisawwi leehum al-kheer ziyaada min al-bidaaya.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa niwaddi naas min cha'abi Bani Israa'iil yuruukhu al-ard wa humman yichiiluuha wa hi tabga warasathum.Wa battaan hi ma taktul iyaalhum be l-juu'.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Daahu gaa'idiin buguulu kadar balad Israa'iil taakul ummitha wa taktul iyaalhum be l-juu'.
Wa be sabab da,ya balad Israa'iil,inti ma taakuli ummitki battaan wa la taktuli iyaalhum be l-juu'.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa battaan ma nisammi'ki khabar hana ihaana al-sawwooha leeki al-umam.Wa ma tilhammale mu'yaar al-chu'uub.Wa abadan ma titarti'i ummitki. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Asma',ya ibn Adam.Wakit Bani Israa'iil sakano fi arduhum,humman najjasooha be amalhum wa deribhum al-chaalooh.Wa najaasithum gaa'ide giddaami misil najaasit al-mara al-indaha heed.
Wa ana nazzalt khadabi fooghum be sabab al-damm al-daffagooh wa asnaamhum al-najjaso beehum al-balad.
Wa ana chattattuhum been al-umam wa farragtuhum fi ust al-buldaan wa haakamtuhum hasab amalhum wa deribhum al-chaalooh.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan al-chatto foogah cha'abi been al-umam,humman ma ahtaramo usmi al-mukhaddas.Wa l-naas gaalo fooghum-:--Sahiih,humman cha'ab Allah wa laakin hu taradaahum min baladah-!--
Wa hassa',ana fakkart fi usmi al-mukhaddas al-Bani Israa'iil ma ahtaramooh been al-umam al-chatto fi usuthum.
Wa fi chaan da,guul le Bani Israa'iil-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ma fi chaanku intu ana gammeet,ya Bani Israa'iil,wa laakin gammeet fi chaan usmi al-mukhaddas al-intu ma ahtaramtuuh been al-umam al-intu chattattu fi usuthum.
Wa ana niwassif khadaasat usmi al-aziim al-intu ma ahtaramtuuh been al-umam.Aywa,da usmi al-intu ma ahtaramtuuh fi usuthum.Wa wakit niwassif khadaasti beeku giddaamhum,humman ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
--"Wa ana nichiilku min been al-umam wa nilimmuku min kulla l-buldaan wa niwaddiiku fi arduku.
Wa ana nuruchchuku be almi taahir wa tabgo taahiriin wa nitahhirku min kulla najaasitku wa min kulla asnaamku.
Wa nantiiku galib jadiid wa nukhutt foogku ruuh jadiide.Wa namrug minku galibku al-gawi misil al-hajar wa nantiiku galib layyin hana insaan.
Wa nukhutt foogku ruuhi achaan tamchu hasab churuuti wa tahfado gawaaniini wa titabbuguuhum.
Wa taskunu fi l-balad al-ana anteetha le juduudku.Wa khalaas,intu tabgo cha'abi wa ana nabga Ilaahku.
Wa ana ninajjiiku min kulla najaasitku.Wa nigawwim al-ma'aach wa nikattirah leeku wa battaan ma nijiib foogku al-juu'.
Wa nikattir fawaakih al-chadar wa intaaj al-ziraa'a achaan battaan ma talgo eeb been al-umam fi chaan al-juu'.
Wa intu tizzakkaro duruubku al-fasliin wa a'maalku al-ma adiiliin wa l-eeb yakrubku be sabab khataaku wa muharramaatku.
A'arfu kadar da ma be sababku intu ana gammeet misil da.Wa khalli al-eeb yakrubku wa takhjalo be sabab duruubku,ya Bani Israa'iil."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Yoom nitahhirku min kulla khataaku,nisabbitku fi mudunku battaan wa l-bakaanaat al-muhaddamiin yinbanu.
Wa l-balad al-kharbaane,yahartuuha battaan wa ayyi naadum al-yufuut jambaha ma yizzakkar kharaabha.
Wa l-naas yuguulu-:--Al-balad di awwal kharbaane wa hassa' bigat misil jineenit Adin-!Daahu al-mudun al-mukassariin wa kharbaaniin wa muhaddamiin banoohum wa sakano fooghum.--
Wa be da,al-umam al-faddalo al-muhawwigiinku ya'arfu kadar ana Allah baneet al-muhaddam wa addalt al-kharabooh.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah wa nihaggigah.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Battaan ana nikhalli Bani Israa'iil yifattuchuuni achaan nugumm nisaa'idhum.Wa nikattir naashum misil al-khanam.
Al-mudun al-mukassariin yinmalu be naas misil al-khanam al-katiiriin hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa hana Madiinat al-Khudus fi wakit a'yaadha.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa gudrat Allah gaa'ide foogi wa hu maragaani be ruuhah wa waddaani fi ust al-waadi.Wa l-waadi da malaan be udaam hana naas.
Wa hu rawwakhaani fi usuthum fi kulli jiihe wa humman katiiriin fi l-waadi wa yaabsiin marra waahid.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,al-udaam dool yagdaro yahyo walla-? Wa ana gult-:-Ya Allah al-Rabb,inta bas ta'arfah-!
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Atnabba' le l-udaam dool wa guul leehum-:--Ya l-udaam al-yaabsiin,asma'o kalaam Allah-!
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ana nijiib foogku nafas al-haya wa tahyo.
Wa nukhutt foogku asab wa naksiiku be laham wa farwa wa nidiss foogku nafas al-haya wa tahyo.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah."-
Wa ana atnabba't misil hu amaraani.Wa wakit ana gaa'id nitnabba',ana simi't haraka.Wa di harakat al-udaam al-gaa'idiin yilgarrabo al-waahidiin le l-aakhariin.
Wa daahu ana chift al-udaam dool ligo asab wa ankaso be laham wa farwa wa laakin ma induhum nafas al-haya.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Atnabba' le nafas al-haya-!Atnabba',ya ibn Adam,wa guul le nafas al-haya-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ya nafas al-haya,ta'aal min al-jiihaat al-arba'a wa adkhul fi l-maytiin dool wa khalli humman yahyo."-
Wa ana atnabba't misil hu amaraani wa nafas al-haya dakhal fooghum wa ligo al-haya.Wa wagafo be tuulhum wa humman jamaa'a katiiriin marra waahid.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,al-udaam dool yimassulu kulla Bani Israa'iil.Humman gaalo-:--Udaamna yibso wa achamna angata' wa waddarna.--
Wa fi chaan da,atnabba' wa guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ya cha'abi,ana naftah khubuurku wa namrugku minhum wa niwaddiiku fi balad Israa'iil.
Ya cha'abi,wakit naftah khubuurku wa namrugku minhum,khalaas intu ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa nukhutt nafasi hana l-haya foogku wa tahyo wa nukhuttuku fi arduku.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar da,ana Allah bas gultah wa nihaggigah."-- Wa da kalaam Allah.
Inta ya ibn Adam,chiil uud waahid wa aktib foogah-:--Da le Yahuuza wa naas Israa'iil al-muchtarikiin ma'aayah.- Wa chiil uud aakhar wa aktib foogah-:--Da le Yuusuf aw Afraayim wa kulla naas Israa'iil al-muchtarikiin ma'aayah.--
Wa limm al-uud al-waahid le l-aakhar wa sawwiihum uud waahid wa akurbah fi iidak.
Wa akuun naas min cha'abak yuguulu leek-:--Chunu ma'ana al-cheyy da-?--
Khalaas,inta guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ana nichiil uud Yuusuf aw Afraayim wa gabaayil Israa'iil al-muchtarikiin ma'aayah.Wa nilimmah ma'a uud Yahuuza wa nisawwiihum uud waahid.Wa nakrub al-uud al-waahid da fi iidi."--
Wa l-uudeen al-katabt fooghum,akrubhum fi iidak giddaam al-cha'ab.
Wa inta guul leehum-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ana nichiil Bani Israa'iil min been al-umam al-humman muchattatiin fi usuthum.Wa nilimmuhum min kulli jiihe wa niwaddiihum fi arduhum.
Wa nisawwiihum umma waahide fi l-balad wa fi jibaal Israa'iil.Malik waahid bas yamluk fooghum kulluhum.Wa abadan ma yabgo ummateen wa battaan ma yingasmu mamlakateen.
Wa humman battaan ma yinnajjaso be asnaamhum wa la be muharramaathum wa la be kulla isyaanhum.Wa ninajjiihum min kulla kufurhum al-beyah aznabo.Wa nitahhirhum wa humman yabgo cha'abi wa ana nabga Ilaahhum.
Wa abdi al-misil al-malik Dawuud yahkim fooghum wa yabga raa'i fooghum kulluhum.Wa yamchu hasab gawaaniini wa yahfado churuuti wa yitabbuguuhum.
Wa yaskunu fi l-balad al-ana anteetha le abdi Yaakhuub wa di l-balad al-sakano foogha juduudku.Humman yaskunu foogha,humman wa iyaalhum wa iyaal iyaalhum ila l-abad.Wa abdi al-misil Dawuud yabga malik fooghum le l-abad.
Wa ana nisawwi ma'aahum mu'aahada hint salaam wa di tabga mu'aahada daayme ma'aahum.Wa nisabbithum wa nikattirhum wa nukhutt beeti al-mukhaddas fi usuthum ila l-abad.
Wa beeti yukuun ma'aahum wa ana nabga Ilaahhum wa humman yabgo cha'abi.
Wakit nukhutt beeti al-mukhaddas fi usuthum ila l-abad,al-umam ya'arfu kadar ana Allah bas nikhassis Bani Israa'iil."-
Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale Juuj al-khaayid al-kabiir hana Maachak wa Tuubal al-gaa'id fi balad Maajuuj wa atnabba' diddah.
Wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Akiid ana nugumm diddak,ya Juuj al-khaayid al-kabiir hana Maachak wa Tuubal.
Wa ana nidiss leek jambaat fi khachmak wa niwaddiik.Wa namurgak inta wa kulla askarak wa kheelak wa siyaad al-kheel al-laabsiin kulluhum khulgaan samhiin.Wa humman jamaa'aat katiiriin al-induhum darag kubaar wa darag dugaag wa kulluhum kaarbiin suyuuf.
Wa ma'aahum askar Faaris wa l-Habacha wa Liibiya wa kulluhum induhum darag wa tawaagi hana harib.
Wa naas Guumar wa kulla askarhum wa naas Beet Tugarma al-khaadi fi l-munchaakh ma'a kulla askarhum wa cha'ab katiiriin ma'aak.
--"Wa jahhiz nafsak adiil,inta wa kulla l-jamaa'a al-lammeethum ma'aak.Wa abga khaayidhum.
Wa ba'ad ayyaam wa fi aakhir al-wakit,tinazzim deechak wa tahjim balad Israa'iil.Zamaan,cha'abha nijo min al-harib wa hassa',gabbalo katiiriin min been al-chu'uub wa jo lammo fi jibaal Israa'iil al-kharbaaniin min mudda tawiile.Wa hassa' kulluhum saakniin be amaan.
Tarkab wa tamchi didduhum misil riih chadiide.Inta tabga misil al-sahaab al-yikhatti kulla l-balad,inta wa kulla askarak wa l-cha'ab al-katiiriin al-ma'aak."-
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Fi l-yoom da,kalaam katiir yaji fi galbak wa inta tichiil niiye fasle.
Wa tuguul-:--Ana nugumm didd balad al-ma indaha himaaye wa nahjim al-naas al-gaa'idiin be raaha wa amaan fi masaakinhum.Wa humman saakniin fi hillaal al-ma induhum daraadir wa la hawaadir wa la biibaan.
Wa ana namchi nichiil khaniime wa nanhab.- Wa inta tahjim bakaan awwal kharaab wa hassa' maskuun be l-cha'ab al-lammoohum min been al-umam wa induhum bahaayim wa khumaam wa saakniin fi surrit al-ard.
Wa sukkaan Saba wa Dadaan wa tujjaar Tarchiich wa kulla hillaalhum yuguulu leek-:--Le tilimm al-khaniime bas inta jiit walla-?Wa lammeet jamaa'tak le tanhab walla-?Wa jiit le tichiil al-fudda wa l-dahab wa l-bahaayim wa l-khumaam wa le tilimm khaniime kabiire walla-?--
Wa fi chaan da,ya ibn Adam,atnabba' wa guul le Juuj-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Wakit cha'abi Bani Israa'iil saakniin be amaan,inta gammeet wa jaayi.
Inta taji min baladak khaadi fi l-munchaakh,inta wa l-chu'uub al-katiiriin al-ma'aak,kulluku raakbiin fi kheel.Bigiitu jamaa'at katiiriin wa deech kabiir.
Wa tahjumu cha'abi Bani Israa'iil lahaddi tikhattu al-balad misil sahaabaay.Wa da yabga fi aakhir al-wakit.Ya Juuj,ana nijiibak didd baladi wa beek inta,niwassif khadaasti giddaam al-umam achaan ya'arfuuni."-
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Zamaan,ana hajjeet beek be waasitat abiidi anbiya Bani Israa'iil al-atnabba'o fi l-wakit daak muddit siniin.Wa inta bas al-ana nijiibak didduhum.
Ya Juuj,yoom inta taji fi balad Israa'iil,ana nakhdab chadiid diddak.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa fi khiirti wa khadabi al-chadiid,ana nahlif fi l-yoom da,al-ard tarjif chadiid fi balad Israa'iil.
Wa kulla huut al-bahar wa tuyuur al-sama wa haywaanaat al-kadaade wa zawaahif al-ard wa kulla Bani Adam al-fi wijh al-ard,kulluhum yarjufu giddaami.Wa l-jibaal yilhaddamo wa l-hujaar wa kulla l-daraadir yaga'o fi l-ard.
Wa fi kulla jibaali,ana ninaadi be l-harib didd Juuj.Wa ayyi askari hana Juuj yiwajjih seefah didd akhuuh.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa ana nugumm diddah wa nihaakimah be l-waba wa l-harib.Wa fi Juuj wa askarah wa l-chu'uub al-katiiriin al-ma'aayah,ninazzil fooghum matara chadiide hana hujaar wa barad wa kibriit wa naar.
Wa niwassif azamati wa khadaasti wa ni'arrif nafsi le umam katiiriin.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Inta ya ibn Adam,atnabba' didd Juuj wa guul-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Akiid ana nugumm diddak,ya Juuj al-khaayid al-kabiir hana Maachak wa Tuubal.
Wa ana nigawwimak wa nuguudak min baladak khaadi fi l-munchaakh wa nijiibak tahjim jibaal Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,ana nadrub nubbaalak min iidak al-isra wa nachaachiibak yidaffugu min iidak al-zeene.
Wa taga' fi jibaal Israa'iil,inta wa kulla askarak wa kulla l-chu'uub al-ma'aak.Wa nisawwiiku ma'aach le l-suguura wa kulla l-tuyuur wa haywaanaat al-kadaade.
Wa inta taga' fi l-kadaade.Wa da,ana bas gultah.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa nirassil naar taakul Maajuuj wa sukkaan al-jazaayir al-gaa'idiin be amaan.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa ni'arrif usmi al-mukhaddas fi usut cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa ma nikhalliihum yiwassufu gillit ihtiraamhum le usmi al-mukhaddas battaan.Wa be da,al-umam ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah al-Khudduus fi Israa'iil."-
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:-Al-yoom al-ana hajjeet beyah,daahu jaayi wa khalaas ja.
Wa sukkaan hillaal Israa'iil yamurgu wa yigabbudu naar wa yiharrugu silaah udwaanhum wa dool al-nubbaal wa l-nachaachiib wa l-isay wa l-huraab wa l-darag al-kubaar wa l-dugaag.Wa humman yigabbudu beehum naar le muddit sab'a sana.
Ma yifattuchu hatab fi l-kadaade battaan wa la yagta'o chadar al-khaaba achaan be l-silaah da bas,yigabbudu naar.Wa yaksabo al-kasaboohum wa yanhabo al-nahaboohum.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa khalaas fi l-yoom da,ana nanti bakaan ma'ruuf le yadfunu foogah naas Juuj fi Israa'iil fi waadi al-musaafiriin sabaah le l-bahar.Wa l-khubuur yisiddu al-derib le l-musaafiriin.Wa fi l-waadi da,yadfunu Juuj wa kulla deechah wa fi chaan da,yinaaduuh waadi Deech Juuj.
Wa waajib le Bani Israa'iil sab'a chahar le yadfunu naas Juuj wa yitahhuru al-balad.
Wa kulla cha'ab al-balad yilimmu wa yadfunuuhum wa be da,yalgo sim'e fi yoom niwassif majdi.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa ba'ad sab'a chahar,al-mukallafiin yi'azzulu rujaal khaassiin le yuruukhu al-balad wa yadfunu al-janaazaat al-faddalo muchattatiin fi l-ard le yitahhuruuha.
Wa l-rujaal dool yuruukhu al-balad wa kan chaafo adum hana insaan,yisawwu jambah alaama lahaddi l-daffaaniin yaju yadfunuuh fi waadi Deech Juuj.
Wa fiyah hille kula usumha Hamoona (ma'anaatah deech).Wa be misil da,yitahhuru al-balad.
Wa inta ya ibn Adam,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Guul le kulla l-tuyuur wa haywaanaat al-kadaade-:"Ta'aalu limmu min kulli jiihe fi chaan al-dahiiye al-ana nigaddimha leeku.Di dahiiye kabiire fi jibaal Israa'iil wa intu taakulu laham wa tacharbo damm.
Wa taakulu laham al-furraas wa tacharbo damm muluuk al-ard wa humman yabgo leeku ma'aach fi badal al-kubchaan wa l-khurfaan wa l-tuyuus wa l-tiiraan al-sumaan hana Baachaan.
Wa taakulu chaham lahaddi tachba'o wa tacharbo damm lahaddi taskaro wa di l-dahiiye al-ana nigaddimha leeku.
Wa intu tachba'o fi aazuumti min al-kheel wa siyaad al-kheel wa l-furraas wa kulla l-muhaaribiin."-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa nukhutt majdi fi ust al-umam wa kulla l-umam yichiifu al-ikhaab al-nisawwiih wa l-iid al-narfa'ha didduhum.
Wa khalaas min al-yoom da wa giddaam,Bani Israa'iil ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahhum.
Wa l-umam ya'arfu kadar Bani Israa'iil waddoohum fi l-khurba be sabab khataahum achaan humman khaanooni ana Ilaahhum.Wa fi chaan da,ana ma wajjaht aleehum wa sallamtuhum le udwaanhum le yaktuluuhum kulluhum be l-seef.
Wa ana aamaltuhum hasab najaasithum wa isyaanhum wa ma wajjaht aleehum.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Hassa',ana nigabbil zurriiyit Yaakhuub min balad al-khurba wa narham kulla Bani Israa'iil wa niwassif khiirti fi chaan usmi al-mukhaddas.
Wakit humman gaa'idiin be amaan fi arduhum,ma fi naadum yibachtinhum.Wa yanso ihaanithum wa kulla isyaanhum al-sawwooh diddi.
Wa nichiilhum min been al-chu'uub wa nilimmuhum min balad udwaanhum wa nigabbilhum.Wa beehum,niwassif khadaasti giddaam umam katiiriin.
Wa ana waddeethum fi balad al-khurba been al-umam wa nilimmuhum wa nigabbilhum fi arduhum wa hinaak,ma nikhalli waahid minhum yifaddil.Wa be da,ya'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahhum.
Wa ana niwajjih aleehum achaan ninazzil ruuhi fi Bani Israa'iil. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Fi l-yoom al-aachir fi l-chahar hana bidaayit al-sana fi sanit 25 min waddoona fi l-khurba wa da 14 sana ba'ad wagi'iin hana Madiinat al-Khudus fi nafs al-yoom da bas fi ru'ya,gudrat Allah nazalat foogi wa waddatni fi l-madiina di.
Wa fi l-ru'ya al-ilaahiiye di,Allah waddaani fi balad Israa'iil wa khattaani fi jabal aali marra waahid al-foogah mabniiye misil hille fi nussah al-junuubi.
Hu waddaani hinaak wa hinaak,ana chift raajil al-jildah yichaabih nahaas.Wa indah fi iidah habil hana kattaan wa uud hana kiyaal.Wa hu waagif fi khachum al-baab.
Wa l-raajil da gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,fukk uyuunak wa chiif wa khutt adaanak wa asma'-!Fakkir tamaam fi kulla cheyy al-niwassifah leek achaan jaabook hini le tichiif.Wa ti'oori Bani Israa'iil be kulla cheyy al-inta chiftah.
Wa daahu ana chift durdur muhawwig al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa fi iid al-raajil,fiyah uud hana kiyaal al-tuulah 6 duraa' wa ayyi duraa' zaayid be arba'a usba'.Wa hu kaal tukhun al-durdur wa ligiih uud waahid wa tuulah foog kula uud waahid.
Wa l-raajil da macha ale l-beet hana l-madkhal al-sabhaani wa rikib al-ataba.Wa kaal tukhun khachum al-baab wa ligiih uud waahid.
Wa beet al-madkhal da indah sitte khuraf hana haras.Wa ayyi khurfa,tuulha uud waahid wa urdaha uud waahid.Wa been khurfa wa aakhara,fiyah 5 duraa'.Wa l-baab giddaam al-khurfa al-mugaabile al-fadaay,hu kula urdah uud waahid.
Wa l-raajil da kaal al-khurfa al-mugaabile al-fadaay
wa ligi tuulha 8 duraa' wa amadha 2 duraa'.Wa l-khurfa al-mugaabile al-fadaay di,hi daakhal ale jiihat al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa l-khuraf hana l-haras al-fi beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani,humman mulgaabiliin,talaata be l-isra wa talaata be l-zeene.Wa kulluhum induhum nafs al-magaas.Wa l-daraadir ambeen khurfa wa aakhara,kulluhum induhum nafs al-magaas.
Wa l-raajil kaal khachum al-baab wa ligi urdah 10 duraa' wa urd al-baab kula 13 duraa'.
Wa giddaam ayyi khurfa hana haras,fiyah durdur sakhayyar tuulah duraa'.Wa ayyi khurfa hana haras urdaha 6 duraa' wa tuulha 6 duraa'.
Wa l-biibaan hana khuraf al-haras mulgaabiliin.Wa l-raajil kaal min dakhal khurfit al-haras al-waahide lahaddi daakhal khurfit al-haras al-mugaabileeha wa ligi al-tuul ambeenaathum 25 duraa'.
Wa kaal amad al-beet wa tuulhum foog 60 duraa'.Wa l-khurfa mugaabile al-fadaay wa l-fadaay muhawwigeeha be giddaam wa jaay wa jaay leeha.
Wa beet al-madkhal tuulah 50 duraa' ambeen al-baab al-barraani wa l-baab al-dakhlaani.
Wa fiyah chabaabiik al-induhum hadiid madfuur fi khuraf al-haras wa fi l-daraadir al-ambeenaathum wa fi l-khurfa al-mugaabile al-fadaay.Wa fiyah chadar nakhal marsuum fi ayyi bakaan fi l-daraadir.
Wa l-raajil da waddaani fi l-fadaay al-barraaniiye hana l-beet al-mukhaddas.Al-fadaay di indaha 30 khuraf muhawwigiinha wa hi matluusa be hujaar mulus min kulli jiihe.
Al-fadaay di matluusa lahaddi buyuut al-madaakhil.Wa hi chiyya tihit min al-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye.
Wa l-raajil kaal min beet al-madkhal hana l-fadaay al-barraaniiye lahaddi beet al-madkhal hana l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye wa ligiih indah 100 duraa' ale l-sabaah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-raajil macha ale beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi.Wa hu kaal al-tuul wa l-urd hana beet al-madkhal hana l-fadaay al-barraaniiye.
Wa khurafah hana l-haras mulgaabiliin,talaata be zeene wa talaata be isra.Wa daraadirah wa khurfitah al-mugaabile al-fadaay induhum nafs al-magaas ma'a beet al-madkhal al-awwalaani.Wa tuul al-beet da 50 duraa' wa urdah 25 duraa'.
Wa chabaabiikah wa khurfitah al-mugaabile al-fadaay wa nakhalah induhum nafs al-magaas ma'a beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani.Wa l-ataba al-yatla'o beeha indaha sab'a darajaat wa gaa'ide giddaam al-khurfa al-kabiire hana l-madkhal.
Wa fiyah beet madkhal al-yaftah fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye mugaabil beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi wa da misil beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani.Wa l-raajil kaal al-faraga min beet al-madkhal al-waahid le l-aakhar wa ligiiha 100 duraa'.
Wa l-raajil waddaani be l-nuss al-watiyaani al-gaa'id foogah beet al-madkhal al-watiyaani.Wa hu kaal daraadirah wa khurfitah al-mugaabile al-fadaay wa magaashum bigi sawa ma'a buyuut al-madaakhil al-aakhariin.
Wa l-beet da indah chabaabiik muhawwigiinah misil al-chabaabiik hana buyuut al-madaakhil al-aakhariin.Wa beet al-madkhal al-watiyaani tuulah 50 duraa' wa urdah 25 duraa'.
Wa l-ataba al-yatla'o beeha indaha sab'a darajaat wa gaa'ide giddaam al-khurfa al-kabiire hana l-madkhal.Wa fiyah chadar nakhal marsuum fi l-daraadir be jaay wa jaay.
Wa fiyah beet madkhal al-yaftah fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye mugaabil beet al-madkhal al-watiyaani.Wa l-raajil kaal al-faraga min beet al-madkhal al-waahid le l-aakhar wa ligiiha 100 duraa'.
Wa l-raajil waddaani fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye be l-derib hana beet al-madkhal al-watiyaani.Wa hu kaal beet al-madkhal da wa hu indah nafs al-magaas ma'a l-aakhariin.
Wa khurafah hana l-haras wa daraadirah wa khurfitah al-taftah fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye,kulluhum induhum nafs al-magaas ma'a l-aakhariin.Wa beet al-madkhal da be khurfitah al-kabiire,tuulhum 50 duraa' wa urduhum 25 duraa' wa muhawwagiin be chabaabiik.
Wa muhawwigiinah khuraf al-tuulhum 25 duraa' wa urduhum 5 duraa'.
Wa khurfitah al-kabiire taftah fi l-fadaay al-barraaniiye.Wa fiyah chadar nakhal marsuum fi daraadirha.Wa l-ataba indaha tamaane darajaat le yatla'o beeha.
Wa l-raajil waddaani fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye be l-derib hana beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani.Wa hu kaal beet al-madkhal da wa hu indah nafs al-magaas ma'a l-aakhariin.
Wa khurfitah al-kabiire taftah fi l-fadaay al-barraaniiye.Wa fiyah chadar nakhal marsuum fi daraadirha be jaay wa jaay.Wa l-ataba indaha tamaane darajaat le yatla'o beeha.
Wa l-raajil waddaani be beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi.Wa hu kaal beet al-madkhal da wa hu indah nafs al-magaas ma'a l-aakhariin.
Wa indah khurafah hana l-haras wa daraadirah wa khurfitah al-taftah fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye,kulluhum be chabaabiik muhawwigiinhum.Wa l-beet da tuulah 50 duraa' wa urdah 25 duraa'.
Wa fiyah khurfa aakhara al-taftah fi l-khurfa al-kabiire hint beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi.Wa da l-bakaan al-yikhassulu foogah al-bahaayim al-yigaddumuuhum dahaaya muharragiin.
Wa fi lubb al-khurfa al-kabiire hana l-madkhal,fiyah taraabiiz arba'a mulgaabiliin,tineen be l-zeene wa tineen be l-isra.Wa l-taraabiiz dool yadbaho fooghum ayyi bahiime al-yigaddumuuha dahiiye muharraga aw dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib aw dahiiye le kaffaarat al-khata.
Wa barra min beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi,fiyah taraabiiz arba'a,tineen be l-zeene wa tineen be l-isra.
Wa be da,arba'a taraabiiz gaa'idiin be l-zeene wa arba'a taraabiiz gaa'idiin be l-isra.Wa be l-jumla,fiyah tamaane taraabiiz al-yadbaho fooghum bahaayim al-yigaddumuuhum dahaaya.
Wa l-arba'a taraabiiz hana l-dahaaya al-muharragiin dool,humman hana hajar magtuu'.Wa tuulhum duraa' wa nuss wa urduhum kula duraa' wa nuss wa tuulhum foog duraa'.Wa fi l-taraabiiz dool,yukhuttu mu'iddaat al-yadbaho beehum al-bahaayim al-yigaddumuuhum dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya aakhariin.
Wa fi kulla khuchuum al-taraabiiz dool,sawwo majra al-urdah arba'a usba'.Wa yukhuttu fi l-taraabiiz dool laham al-bahaayim al-yigaddumuuhum dahaaya.
Wa fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye jamb beet al-madkhal,fiyah khuraf tineen hana khannaayiin.Khurfa waahide gaa'ide jamb beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi wa muwajjihe wati.Wa l-khurfa al-aakhara gaa'ide jamb beet al-madkhal al-watiyaani wa muwajjihe munchaakh.
Wa l-raajil gaal leyi-:-Al-khurfa al-muwajjihe wati,di hint rujaal al-diin al-yahfado khidmit al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa l-khurfa al-muwajjihe munchaakh,di hint rujaal al-diin al-yahfado khidmit al-madbah.Wa humman min zurriiyit Saduukh min gabiilat Laawi wa yigarrubu le Allah le yisawwu khidimtah.
Wa l-raajil kaal al-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye wa tuulha 100 duraa' wa urdaha 100 duraa' murabba'a.Wa l-madbah gaa'id fi l-fadaay di giddaam al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa l-raajil waddaani daakhal fi khurfit al-madkhal hana beet Allah.Wa hu kaal daraadirha jaay wa jaay wa ayyi waahid indah 5 duraa'.Wa urd al-baab 14 duraa' wa l-daraadir jaay wa jaay le l-baab,ayyi waahid indah 3 duraa'.
Wa khurfit al-madkhal urdaha 20 duraa' wa tuulha 11 duraa' wa l-ataba indaha achara darajaat al-yatla'o beehum.Wa jamb al-baab,fiyah amad itneen jaay jaay leyah,al-waahid be hini wa l-aakhar be hinaak.
Wa l-raajil waddaani daakhal fi l-beet al-kabiir hana l-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa hu kaal tukhun amad al-baab wa ligiih 6 duraa' be l-nuss al-waahid wa 6 duraa' be l-nuss al-aakhar.Wa daahu urd al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Urd baab al-madkhal 10 duraa' wa daraadirah jaay wa jaay leyah,ayyi waahid indah 5 duraa'.Wa l-raajil kaal al-beet al-kabiir hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa ligi tuulah 40 duraa' wa urdah 20 duraa'.
Wa ba'ad da,hu dakhal daakhal fi l-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa hu kaal tukhun amad al-baab wa ligiihum 2 duraa'.Wa urd al-baab 6 duraa' wa daraadirah jaay wa jaay leyah,ayyi waahid indah 7 duraa'.
Wa hu kaal al-beet al-daakhal fi l-beet al-mukhaddas wa ligi tuulah 20 duraa' wa urdah 20 duraa'.Wa gaal leyi-:-Da l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa ba'ad da,maragna barra.Wa l-raajil kaal tukhun al-durdur hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa ligiih 6 duraa'.Wa fiyah khuraf jaanibiyiin al-muhawwigiin al-beet wa ayyi khurfa urdaha 4 duraa'.
Wa l-khuraf al-jaanibiyiin le l-beet gaa'idiin fi gasir al-indah talaata darajaat wa ayyi daraja indaha 30 khurfa.Wa l-khuraf dool mabniyiin ma'a tuul al-durdur al-barraani hana l-beet wa laakin ma mulassagiin fi l-durdur hana l-beet zaatah.
Wa fi ayyi daraja hana l-gasir,al-khuraf chaalo bakaan ziyaada wa da muhawwig kulla l-beet.Wa yatla'o fi l-gasir da be ataba min al-daraja al-tihit ale l-daraja al-usut lahaddi l-daraja al-foog.
Wa ana dangart wa chift al-beet al-mukhaddas indah asaas hawaaleeyah al-yisaawi 6 duraa' kubaar.Wa da,asaas al-khuraf al-jaanibiyiin kula.
Wa l-durdur al-barraani hana l-khuraf al-jaanibiyiin,tukhnah 5 duraa'.Wa fiyah faraga been al-khuraf al-jaanibiyiin
wa khuraf al-beet.Wa urd al-faraga di 20 duraa' fi kulli jiihe min al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa biibaan al-khuraf al-jaanibiyiin muwajjihiin ale l-faraga di.Wa fiyah madkhal waahid muwajjih munchaakh wa aakhar muwajjih wati.Wa l-durdur al-yihawwig al-faraga di,tukhnah 5 duraa' fi ayyi jiihe.
Wa fiyah beet kabiir gaa'id be l-nuss al-kharbaani hana l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye.Wa tuulah 90 duraa' wa urdah 70 duraa' wa tukhun al-durdur hana l-beet da 5 duraa' fi kulli jiihe.
Wa l-raajil kaal tuul al-beet al-mukhaddas wa ligiih 100 duraa'.Wa l-beet al-kabiir al-fi l-kharib wa daraadirah wa faragatah kula urduhum 100 duraa'.
Wa sabaah le l-beet al-mukhaddas,urd al-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye indah 100 duraa'.
Wa l-raajil kaal tuul al-beet al-kabiir al-fi l-kharib wa hu wa duruubah,tuulhum 100 duraa'.Wa l-beet al-kabiir al-usut hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa khurfit al-madkhal,
daraadirhum mukhattayiin be khachab.Wa l-iidaan al-yarkabo fooghum al-biibaan wa l-chabaabiik al-induhum hadiid madfuur wa l-duruub al-yihawwugu al-gusuur hana talaata darajaat,kulluhum mukhattayiin be khachab min al-ard lahaddi l-chabaabiik.Wa kulla l-chabaabiik mukhattayiin.
Wa min khurfit al-madkhal lahaddi l-beet al-daakhal,al-beet wa kulla daraadirah mujammal fi ayyi bakaan,be barra wa daakhal kula.
Rasamo foogah suwar hana makhluugiin samaawiyiin wa chadar nakhal.Wa ambeen ayyi makhluugiin samaawiyiin itneen,fiyah nakhalaay.Wa ayyi makhluug samaawi indah wujuuh itneen.
Wijhah al-waahid hana insaan muwajjih ale l-nakhalaay be nuss waahid.Wa wijhah al-aakhar hana duud muwajjih ale l-nakhalaay be l-nuss al-aakhar.Wa be l-rasim da,hawwago kulla l-beet al-mukhaddas.
Rasamo al-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin wa l-nakhal fi l-daraadir min tihit lahaddi foog min al-biibaan.
Wa iidaan al-baab hana l-beet al-kabiir al-usut hana l-beet al-mukhaddas da,murabba'iin.Wa giddaam al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid,binchaaf cheyy misil
madbah hana hatab.Urdah 2 duraa' wa tuulah foog 3 duraa'.Wa koonyaatah wa ga'arah wa jawaanibah kula min hatab.Wa l-raajil gaal leyi-:-Di l-tarabeeza al-gaa'ide giddaam Allah.
Al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid wa l-beet al-kabiir al-usut hana l-beet al-mukhaddas,kulluhum induhum biibaan abdalfiteen.
Wa ayyi baab min al-biibaan al-itneen dool indah dalfiteen al-yiliffu.
Wa rasamo makhluugiin samaawiyiin wa nakhal fi l-biibaan dool misil rasamoohum fi l-daraadir.Wa fiyah khachaba tidallil giddaam khurfit al-madkhal barra.
Wa fi daraadir khurfit al-madkhal,fiyah chabaabiik al-induhum hadiid madfuur wa rasamo nakhal fi ayyi bakaan.Wa rasamo nakhal fi l-khuraf al-jaanibiyiin hana l-beet wa fi l-khachaba al-tidallil giddaamhum kula.
Wa ba'ad da,al-raajil maragaani be l-derib al-munchaakh ale l-fadaay al-barraaniiye.Wa waddaani ale l-khuraf al-mugaabiliin al-fadaay wa mugaabiliin al-beet al-mukhaddas be nussah al-munchaakhi.
Wa l-khuraf fi l-munchaakh dool,tuulhum 100 duraa' wa urduhum 50 duraa'.
Wa l-khuraf dool gaa'idiin ambeen al-derib al-tuulah 20 duraa' wa l-hujaar al-mulus al-tallaso beehum al-fadaay al-barraaniiye.Wa l-khuraf dool gaa'idiin jamb al-gasir al-indah talaata darajaat.
Wa jamb al-khuraf dool,fiyah derib al-tuulah 100 duraa' wa urdah 10 duraa' wa muwajjih ale daakhal.Wa biibaan al-khuraf dool faathiin munchaakh.
Wa l-khuraf fi l-daraja al-foog daygiin ziyaada min al-khuraf al-fi l-daraja hana l-usut wa l-tihit achaan al-derib chaal minhum.
Wa l-khuraf dool gaa'idiin fi gasir al-indah talaata darajaat wa laakin ma induhum amad misil al-buyuut al-aakhariin.Wa fi chaan da,l-khuraf fi l-daraja al-foog daygiin ziyaada min al-khuraf al-fi l-daraja hana l-usut wa l-tihit.
Wa fiyah durdur barra min al-khuraf fi lubb al-fadaay al-barraaniiye wa giddaam al-khuraf dool.Wa tuul al-durdur da 50 duraa'.
Al-khuraf al-muwajjihiin ale l-fadaay al-barraaniiye,tuulhum 50 duraa'.Wa l-khuraf al-muwajjihiin ale l-beet al-mukhaddas kamaan,tuulhum 100 duraa'.
Wa fi l-daraja al-awwalaaniiye,fiyah madkhal be nuss al-sabaah wa l-naas al-yaju min al-fadaay al-barraaniiye yindasso beyah.
Wa l-madkhal da gaa'id fi aakhir al-durdur al-gaa'id giddaam al-khuraf.Fi jiihat al-wati,khuraf aakhariin gaa'idiin ambeen al-fadaay al-barraaniiye wa l-beet al-kabiir al-gaa'id kharib min al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa giddaam al-khuraf dool,fiyah derib misil al-derib hana l-khuraf fi l-munchaakh.Al-khuraf fi l-wati wa l-khuraf fi l-munchaakh,tuulhum wa urduhum sawa sawa wa kulla biibaanhum hana l-marigiin wa l-dakhiliin nizaamhum waahid.
Biibaanhum yinfathu ale l-wati wa fiyah derib ambeen al-khuraf wa l-durdur al-giddaamhum.Wa fiyah madkhal al-gaa'id be sabaah fi aakhir al-durdur wa l-naas yindasso beyah.
Wa l-raajil gaal leyi-:-Al-khuraf fi l-munchaakh wa l-khuraf fi l-wati mugaabiliin al-fadaay hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa be da,humman mukhassasiin.Wa fi l-khuraf dool bas,rujaal al-diin al-yigarrubu le Allah waajib yaakulu al-hadaaya al-mukhassasiin marra waahid.Wa fi l-khuraf dool bas,waajib yudummu al-hadaaya al-mukhassasiin marra waahid wa dool al-hadaaya hana l-dagiig wa l-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib wa l-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-khata achaan al-bakaan da mukhaddas.
Wa wakit rujaal al-diin yamurgu min al-bakaan al-mukhaddas,ma yamurgu tawwaali ale l-fadaay al-barraaniiye.Waajib humman yamchu fi l-khuraf dool wa yisillu khulgaanhum hana l-khidme wa yudummuuhum hinaak achaan al-khulgaan dool mukhassasiin.Wa humman yalbaso khulgaan al-aadiyiin wa ba'ad da,yagdaro yigarrubu le l-bakaanaat al-gaa'idiin fooghum al-cha'ab.
Wakit al-raajil kammal min magaas al-beet al-mukhaddas daakhal,hu maragaani be beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani barra le yikiil kulla daayir al-hooch.
Wa kaal tuul al-hooch be nussah al-sabhaani be uud al-kiyaal wa ligiih 500 uud hasab uud al-kiyaal.
Wa kaal tuul al-hooch be nussah al-munchaakhi be uud al-kiyaal wa ligiih 500 uud.
Wa kaal tuul al-hooch be nussah al-watiyaani be uud al-kiyaal wa ligiih 500 uud.
Wa hu kammal be l-nuss al-kharbaani.Hu kaal tuul al-nuss da wa ligiih 500 uud hasab uud al-kiyaal.
Wa be da,hu kaal daayirat durdur al-hooch be l-jiihaat al-arba'a wa ligiih tuulah wa urdah kula 500 uud.Wa durdur al-hooch da yafsul ambeen al-bakaan al-mukhaddas wa l-bakaan al-ma mukhaddas.
Wa l-raajil da waddaani ale l-baab hana beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani.
Wa daahu majd Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil jaayi min al-sabaah be haraka misil harakat almi al-katiir wa l-ard nawwarat be majdah.
Wa l-ru'ya di tichaabih al-ru'ya al-ana awwal chiftaha wakit Allah jaayi le yidammir Madiinat al-Khudus wa wakit ana gaa'id jamb bahar Khaabuur.Wa tawwaali,ana waga't be wijhi fi l-ard.
Wa majd Allah dakhal fi l-beet al-mukhaddas be l-baab al-sabhaani.
Wa khalaas,Ruuh Allah rafa'aani foog wa waddaani fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye.Wa majd Allah mala al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa ana simi't hiss gaa'id yihajji leyi min lubb al-beet da wa da wakit al-raajil waagif jambi.
Wa l-hiss gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,da bakaan archi wa bakaan nukhutt rijileeni wa da bas al-bakaan al-naskun foogah fi usut Bani Israa'iil ila l-abad.Wa abadan wa la Bani Israa'iil wa la muluukhum ma yinajjusu usmi al-mukhaddas be charmatathum wara l-asnaam walla be dafin jisas muluukhum jamb beeti al-mukhaddas.
Wa muluukhum khatto madkhal gasirhum jamb madkhal gasri wa khatto baabhum jamb baabi wa khatto durdur beeni wa beenhum.Wa be da,humman najjaso usmi al-mukhaddas be l-muharramaat al-sawwoohum.Wa fi chaan da,ana dammartuhum be naar khadabi.
Wa hassa',khalli Bani Israa'iil yiba''udu minni charmatathum wara l-asnaam wa jisas muluukhum wa ana naskun fi usuthum ila l-abad.
Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,khabbir Bani Israa'iil be ru'yat al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa khalli al-eeb yakrubhum be sabab khataahum wa yifakkuru adiil fi buna al-beet da.
