Wa kan al-eeb karabhum be kulla cheyy al-sawwooh,wassifhum chakil al-beet da wa nizaamah wa biibaan al-madkhal wa biibaan al-marigiin wa kulla chaklah.Wassifhum kulla churuutah wa chaklah wa kulla gawaaniinah.Wa aktibhum giddaamhum achaan humman yabnu hasab al-chakil wa yitabbugu kulla churuutah.
Wa daahu gaanuun al-beet.Kulla raas al-jabal da wa kulla huduudah fi kulli jiihe mukhaddas marra waahid.Aywa,da gaanuun al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa daahu magaas al-madbah hasab al-duraa' al-zaayid be arba'a usba' min al-duraa' al-aadi.Daahu ga'ar al-madbah.Fi majra al-gaa'id hawaale al-madbah wa tuulah tihit duraa' wa urdah kula duraa' wa khachmah indah urd hana chibir waahid.
Min al-ga'ar al-tihit lahaddi l-mustawa al-awwal,tuulah foog 2 duraa' wa urd khachum al-mustawa da duraa'.Wa min al-mustawa al-awwal lahaddi l-mustawa al-taani,tuulah foog 4 duraa' wa urd khachum al-mustawa da kula duraa'.
Wa min al-mustawa al-taani lahaddi l-bakaan al-yigabbudu foogah al-naar,tuulah foog 4 duraa'.Wa fi raas al-madbah da,fiyah arba'a guruun.
Wa l-bakaan al-yigabbudu foogah al-naar da,tuulah 12 duraa' wa urdah 12 duraa' wa hu murabba'.
Wa l-mustawa al-taani,tuulah 14 duraa' wa urdah 14 duraa' wa hu murabba'.Wa khachmah indah majra al-urdah nuss duraa' wa tuulah tihit duraa' fi kulla daayir al-mustawa da.Wa l-madbah indah ataba al-muwajjihe sabaah.
Wa l-raajil gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:--Daahu al-churuut al-bukhussu al-madbah min yoom yabnuuh wa yigaddumu foogah dahaaya muharragiin wa yuruchchu foogah damm.
Anti toor hana kaffaarat al-zanib le rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin al-min zurriiyit Saduukh.Humman bas al-yigarrubu wa yakhdumu leyi.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa tichiil min damm al-toor da wa tamsahah fi l-arba'a guruun hana l-madbah wa fi l-arkaan al-arba'a hana l-mustawa al-taani wa fi kulla khachum daayirah.Wa be da,tamsah al-madbah be damm dahiiyat kaffaarat al-zanib wa titahhirah.
Wa tichiil al-toor hana dahiiyat kaffaarat al-zanib wa tiharrigah fi l-bakaan al-muhaddad barra min al-beet al-mukhaddas.
--Wa fi l-yoom al-taani,tigaddim tees al-ma indah ayyi eeb le l-dahiiye hana kaffaarat al-zanib wa be da,titahhir al-madbah misil sawweetuuh be l-toor.
Wa kan kammalt be l-dahiiye hana kaffaarat al-zanib,gaddim toor al-ma indah ayyi eeb min bagarak wa kabich al-ma indah ayyi eeb min khanamak.
Wakit tigaddimhum giddaam Allah,rujaal al-diin yusubbu fooghum mileh wa yigaddumuuhum dahiiye muharraga le Allah.
Wa fi muddit sab'a yoom,kulla yoom tigaddim tees dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib wa tigaddim battaan toor al-ma indah ayyi eeb min bagarak wa kabich al-ma indah ayyi eeb min khanamak.
Wa fi muddit sab'a yoom,yigaddumu dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib fi l-madbah le yitahhuruuh wa yikhassusuuh.
Wa kan al-sab'a yoom kammalo,fi l-yoom al-taamin wa l-ayyaam al-ba'adah,rujaal al-diin yigaddumu fi l-madbah dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa khalaas be da,ana narda beeku.-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa l-raajil waddaani le beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa derbah al-yaftah fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye da masduud.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Al-derib da yisidduuh wa battaan ma yufukkuuh.Wa naadum ma yi'addi beyah achaan ana Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil dakhalt be l-derib da wa hassa' hu yukuun masduud.
Wa laakin al-malik yagdar yagood foogah achaan hu malik wa yaakul giddaami ana Allah.Hu yadkhul be khurfit al-madkhal hana l-beet da wa yamrug be nafs al-derib al-hu dakhal beyah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-raajil waddaani be beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi lahaddi wisilna giddaam al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa daahu ana chift majd Allah mala beetah.Wa khalaas,ana waga't be wijhi fi l-ard.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,khutt baalak wa aftah uyuunak wa chiif-!Wa khutt adaanak wa asma' kulla l-kalaam al-nuguulah leek al-bukhuss al-churuut hana beeti ana Allah wa kulla gawaaniinah.Wa fakkir tamaam fi churuut al-dakhiliin wa l-marigiin min al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa guul le Bani Israa'iil al-aasiyiin-:--Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Ya Bani Israa'iil-!Kafaaku min kulla muharramaatku-!
Wakit gaddamtu leyi al-chaham wa l-damm hana l-dahaaya misil akil,fi l-wakit da bas,dakhkhaltu fi beeti al-mukhaddas ajaanib al-ma mutahhariin wa guluubhum kula ma taahiriin.Wa be da,ma ahtaramtu beeti wa battaan gata'tu mu'aahadati be kulla muharramaatku.
Wa intu ma hafadtu khidimti al-mukhaddasa wa laakin khatteetu ajaanib fi badalku le yahfado khidimti fi beeti al-mukhaddas."
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:"Khalli ayyi ajnabi al-ma mutahhar wa galbah kula ma taahir ma yadkhul fi beeti al-mukhaddas hatta kan hu saakin fi usut Bani Israa'iil kula."--
Wa kan le l-Laawiyiin al-ba''ado minni wakit Bani Israa'iil abooni wa gabbalo taaba'o ilaahaathum,hassa' humman yilhammalo natiijat khataahum.
Yagdaro yukuunu fi beeti al-mukhaddas wa yahfado biibaan al-beet wa yakhdumu fi lubb al-beet.Wa humman bas yadbaho al-bahaayim hana l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa l-dahaaya al-yigaddumuuhum al-cha'ab.Wa yagoodu jaahiziin le yakhdumu le l-cha'ab.
Wa laakin awwal,humman dabaho dahaaya al-cha'ab le asnaamhum wa ramo Bani Israa'iil fi l-khata.Wa be sabab da,ana narfa' iidi didduhum wa humman yilhammalo natiijat khataahum.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa humman ma yigarrubu leyi le yisawwu khidmit rujaal al-diin wa ma yigarrubu le kulla khidimti al-mukhaddasa wa la le l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.Wa humman yilhammalo natiijat ihaanithum wa l-muharramaat al-sawwoohum.
Wa ana nikallifhum be khidme sakhayre bas fi beeti al-mukhaddas wa humman yisawwu kulla khidimtah wa kulla cheyy al-waajib yakhdumuuh.
Wa kan le rujaal al-diin al-Laawiyiin al-min zurriiyit Saduukh,humman hafado khidmit beeti al-mukhaddas wakit Bani Israa'iil abooni.Wa hassa',humman dool bas yigarrubu leyi wa yakhdumu leyi.Wa yagiifu giddaami wa yigaddumu leyi chaham wa damm al-dahaaya.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa humman dool yadkhulu fi beeti al-mukhaddas wa yigarrubu le tarabeezti le yakhdumu leyi wa yahfado khidimti.
Wa khalaas wakit yadkhulu be buyuut madaakhil hana l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye,humman yalbaso khulgaan hana kattaan.Ma yalbaso khulgaan hana suuf wakit yakhdumu fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye wa fi l-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa yukujju kadaamiil hana kattaan wa yalbaso saraawiil dugaag hana kattaan wa ma yalbaso ayyi cheyy al-yijiib leehum al-wakhar.
Wa wakit yidooru yamurgu fi l-fadaay al-barraaniiye ale l-cha'ab,yisillu al-khulgaan al-khadamo beehum wa yukhuttuuhum fi l-khuraf jamb al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa yalbaso khulgaan aadiyiin achaan ma yikhassusu al-cha'ab be khulgaanhum al-mukhassasiin.
Wa ma yizayyunu ruuseehum wa la yikhallu cha'arhum yabga tuwaal laakin yugussuuh be nizaam.
Wa ayyi raajil diin ma waajib yachrab khamar wakit yadkhul fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye.
Wa ma yaakhudu mara armala wa la mutallaga.Yaakhudu illa banaat udriiyaat min gabiilat Bani Israa'iil aw mara armala al-raajilha raajil diin.
Wa rujaal al-diin yi'allumu cha'abi al-faraga been al-mukhaddas wa l-ma mukhaddas wa yi'arrufuuhum al-faraga been al-taahir wa l-nijis.
Wa kan fi muchkila,humman bas yabgo gudiya wa yichaaru'u hasab charii'ti.Wa yitabbugu churuuti al-fi l-Tawraat wa gawaaniini wa yahfado kulla a'yaadi wa yoomi hana l-sabt,yaj'alooh mukhaddas.
Wa ayyi raajil diin ma yigarrib le naadum mayyit achaan da yisawwiih nijis.Wa laakin yagdar yigarrib wa yabga nijis be janaazit abuuh aw ammah aw wileedah aw bittah aw akhuuh aw akhtah al-lissaa'ha ma akhadat.
Wa ba'ad yittahhar,yagood sab'a yoom hatta yaji.
Wa yoom hu yaji fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye hana l-beet al-mukhaddas,hu yigaddim dahiiytah le kaffaarat al-zanib gubbaal ma yisawwi khidmit al-beet.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa rujaal al-diin yakhdumu leyi ana wa ana bas warasathum.Intu ma tantuuhum ard fi balad Israa'iil achaan ana bas warasathum.
Wa humman yaakulu al-hadaaya wa l-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib wa l-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-khata.Wa kulla cheyy al-yikhassusuuh leyi Bani Israa'iil,ana nantiih leehum.
Wa kulla l-intaaj al-awwal wa kulla zakaatku yabgo le rujaal al-diin.Wa antu le rujaal al-diin awwal dagiigku wa be da,buyuutku yukuunu mubaarakiin.
Wa ma waajib rujaal al-diin yaakulu rimme wa la jiife kan tabga hint teer aw haywaan kula.
Wa wakit tigassumu al-balad warasa,antu min al-ard di hadiiye le Allah.Wa l-ard al-tichiiluuha min al-balad di tabga mukhaddasa.Wa tuulha 25-000 duraa' wa urdaha 20-000 duraa' wa l-ard di fi kulla huduudha tukuun mukhaddasa.
Wa l-beet al-mukhaddas yukuun fi lubb al-ard di,fi hooch murabba' al-tuulah 500 duraa' wa urdah kula 500 duraa'.Wa jaay jaay le l-hooch da,fiyah faraga al-tuulha 50 duraa' fi kulli jiihe.
Wa min al-ard al-anteetuuha hadiiye le Allah,agta'o nussaha al-tuulah 25-000 duraa' wa urdah 10-000 duraa'.Wa fi l-nuss da,yukuun al-beet al-mukhaddas wa l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa l-nuss al-mukhaddas al-chiltuuh min al-ard di yabga le rujaal al-diin al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu fi l-beet al-mukhaddas wa yigarrubu le Allah le yisawwu khidimtah.Min al-nuss da,humman yalgo ard al-yisawwu foogha buyuuthum wa yukuun bakaan khaass le l-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa l-nuss al-aakhar al-tuulah 25-000 duraa' wa urdah 10-000 duraa' yukuun le l-Laawiyiin al-yakhdumu fi l-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa humman yalgo foogah mudun le yaskunu fooghum.
Jamb al-ard al-anteetuuha hadiiye le l-beet al-mukhaddas,antu bakaan aakhar le yabga madiina.Wa l-bakaan da,tuulah 25-000 duraa' wa urdah 5-000 duraa' wa di tukuun madiina le kulla Bani Israa'iil.
Wa le l-malik kula,waajib leyah bakaan al-yukuun jaay wa jaay le l-ard al-anteetuuha hadiiye le l-beet al-mukhaddas wa l-madiina.Wa huduud ardah al-kharbaaniiye yamchu lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad.Wa huduud ardah al-sabhaaniiye yamchu ale l-sabaah lahaddi huduud Israa'iil fi l-sabaah.Wa tuulha muwaafig le l-ard al-yantuuha le l-gabaayil.
Wa l-ard di bas tabga le l-malik warasatah fi balad Israa'iil.Wa l-muluuk abadan ma yazulmu al-cha'ab laakin humman yikhallu al-balad le Bani Israa'iil hasab gabaayilhum.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ya muluuk Bani Israa'iil,kafaaku-!Khallu minku al-unuf wa l-nahib-!Sawwu al-hagg wa l-adaala wa arfa'o al-zulum min cha'abi.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Aamuru be miizaan aadil wa kooro aadil wa mikyaal aadil.
Wa khalli al-kooro al-binaaduuh eefa wa l-mikyaal al-binaaduuh batt yabgo sawa sawa,ayyi waahid minhum yisaawi uchur hana l-hoomar.Wa l-hoomar hu yukuun al-mikyaal al-rasmi.
Wa khalli al-hajar fudda al-binaaduuh chaakil yisaawi 20 giirah.Wa l-minn yisaawi 60 chaakil.
Wa di hi al-zaka al-tantuuha.Min intaajku hana l-gameh al-ahmar wa l-gameh al-abyad,min ayyi chuwaal wa nuss,tantu kooro waahid.
Wa daahu al-gaanuun al-bukhuss al-dihin.Tantu liitir waahid min 100 liitir.Tikiilu al-dihin be l-mikyaal al-binaaduuh batt wa l-batt hu uchur hana l-mikyaal al-kabiir al-binaaduuh hoomar aw koor.
Wa min al-mar'a al-jamiil hana balad Israa'iil,tantu kharuuf waahid min ayyi door hana 200 khanam.-Wa l-zaka di tabga hadaaya wa dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama al-yabgo kaffaara le l-cha'ab.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa kulla cha'ab al-balad yijiibu zakaathum le malik Bani Israa'iil.
Wa l-malik hu mukallaf be l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa hadaaya al-dagiig wa hadaaya al-charaab fi kulli iid wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa kulli yoom sabt wa kulla l-munaasabaat hana Bani Israa'iil.Wa hu bas yigaddim al-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib wa hadaaya al-dagiig wa l-dahaaya al-muharragiin wa dahaaya al-salaama al-yabgo kaffaara le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Wa fi l-yoom al-awwal hana l-chahar al-awwal,inta tichiil toor ma indah ayyi eeb wa tigaddimah dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib le titahhir al-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa raajil al-diin yichiil min damm al-toor da wa yamsahah fi iidaan al-baab hana l-beet al-mukhaddas wa fi l-arkaan al-arba'a hana l-mustawa al-tihit min al-madbah wa fi iidaan al-baab hana l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye.
Wa tisawwi nafs al-cheyy fi l-yoom al-saabi' hana l-chahar le ayyi naadum al-sawwa zanib bala niiytah wa bala raayah.Wa misil da,tisawwi kaffaara le l-beet al-mukhaddas.
Wa yoom 14 hana l-chahar al-awwal yabga leeku iid al-Fisha.Wa da iid hana sab'a yoom wa taakulu foogah khubza bala tawwaara.
Wa awwal yoom al-iid,al-malik yigaddim toor dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib leyah hu wa kulla l-cha'ab.
Wa fi ayyi yoom min al-ayyaam al-sab'a hana l-iid,hu yigaddim dahiiye muharraga le Allah sab'a tiiraan wa sab'a kubchaan ma induhum ayyi eeb.Wa yigaddim tees dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib fi ayyi yoom.
Wa yigaddim hadiiye 10 kooro hana dagiig wa 6 liitir hana dihin ma'a ayyi toor wa ayyi kabich.
Wa fi yoom 15 hana l-chahar al-saabi' fi wakit iid al-Lagaadiib,al-malik yisawwi nafs al-cheyy.Fi ayyi yoom min al-ayyaam al-sab'a,yigaddim nafs al-dahiiye le kaffaarat al-zanib wa nafs al-dahiiye al-muharraga wa nafs al-hadiiye hana l-dagiig wa nafs al-hadiiye hana l-dihin.
Daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Al-baab hana beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani al-yaftah fi l-fadaay al-dakhlaaniiye yagood masduud le muddit sitte yoom hana khidme fi ayyi subuu'.Wa laakin yaftahooh fi kulli yoom sabt wa battaan kula yaftahooh fi awwal yoom fi kulli chahar.
Wa min al-fadaay al-barraaniiye,al-malik yadkhul fi khurfit al-madkhal wa yagiif jamb iidaan al-baab.Wa rujaal al-diin yigaddumu leyah dahiiytah al-muharraga wa dahiiytah al-salaama wa hu yasjud fi khachum al-baab.Wa ba'ad da,yamrug wa ma yisiddu al-baab da gubbaal al-achiiye.
Wa cha'ab al-balad yasjudu le Allah fi khachum al-baab da fi kulli yoom sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar.
Wa fi kulli yoom sabt,al-malik yigaddim dahaaya muharragiin le Allah.Wa l-bahaayim al-yigaddimhum,humman sitte kharuuf wa kabich waahid al-ma induhum ayyi eeb.
Wa yigaddim hadaaya 10 kooro hana dagiig ma'a ayyi kabich wa ma'a l-khurfaan kamaan,yigaddim dagiig hasab al-tantiih iidah.Wa yiziid foogah 6 liitir hana dihin fi l-achara kooro hana l-dagiig.
Wa fi awwal yoom fi kulli chahar,al-malik yigaddim toor waahid wa sitte kharuuf wa kabich waahid al-ma induhum ayyi eeb.
Wa yigaddim hadaaya 10 kooro hana dagiig ma'a ayyi toor wa ayyi kabich.Wa ma'a l-khurfaan kamaan,yigaddim dagiig hasab al-tantiih iidah.Wa yiziid foogah 6 liitir hana dihin fi l-achara kooro hana l-dagiig.
Wa wakit al-malik yadkhul,hu yadkhul be l-baab hana khurfit al-madkhal wa yamrug be nafs al-baab da.
Wa wakit al-cha'ab yaju giddaami ana Allah fi wakit al-munaasabaat,al-naas al-yadkhulu be l-baab al-munchaakhi le yasjudu,yamurgu be l-baab al-watiyaani.Wa l-naas al-yadkhulu be l-baab al-watiyaani yamurgu be l-baab al-munchaakhi.Wa be da,ma waajib yamurgu be l-baab al-dakhalo beyah laakin yamurgu be l-baab al-mugaabilah.
Wa l-malik yadkhul ma'aahum wakit yadkhulu wa yamrug ma'aahum wakit yamurgu.
Wa fi l-a'yaad wa l-munaasabaat,yigaddim hadaaya 10 kooro hana dagiig ma'a ayyi toor wa ayyi kabich.Wa ma'a l-khurfaan kamaan,yigaddim dagiig hasab al-tantiih iidah.Wa yiziid foogah 6 liitir hana dihin fi l-achara kooro hana l-dagiig.
Wa ayyi wakit al-malik indah niiye yigaddim dahiiye muharraga aw dahiiyat al-salaama leyi ana Allah,yaftaho leyah baab beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani.Wa be da,hu yigaddim dahiiytah al-muharraga aw dahiiytah hana l-salaama misil hu yigaddimhum fi ayyi yoom al-sabt.Wa ba'ad da,hu yamrug wa yisiddu al-baab min hu marag bas.
Wa kulla yoom,tigaddumu kharuuf wald sana al-ma indah ayyi eeb dahiiye muharraga leyi ana Allah wa da tigaddumuuh kulli fajur.
Wa kulli fajur,tigaddumu leyi ana Allah hadiiye hana dagiig ma'a l-kharuuf da wa hi kooro wa nuss hana dagiig wa dihin liitreen al-yikhalbutu beyah al-dagiig.Wa da chart daayim ila l-abad.
Wa kulli fajur,tigaddumu al-kharuuf wa hadiiyat al-dagiig wa l-dihin hadiiye muharraga ila l-abad.
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Kan al-malik yanti hadiiye le waahid min awlaadah,al-hadiiye di tabga warasa le l-wileed da.Wa l-warasa di tabga hintah halaalah wa ba'adeen,yawrusuuha iyaalah.
Wa laakin kan al-malik yanti hadiiye min warasatah le waahid min abiidah,al-hadiiye di tabga hint al-abid lahaddi sanit al-Hurriiye.Wa ba'ad da,al-warasa di tigabbil le l-malik.Wa be da,hagg al-malik yagood warasa le iyaalah bas.
Wa l-malik ma yichiil cheyy min warasat al-cha'ab wa ma yazlumhum fi hagguhum.Wa cheyy al-haggah hu bas yantiih le iyaalah warasa.Achaan ma fi naadum waahid min cha'abi yadharooh min warasatah.
Wa l-raajil waddaani jamb beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi.Wa hinaak,dakhalna be l-madkhal jamb al-khuraf al-mukhassasiin le rujaal al-diin al-yaftaho munchaakh.Wa fi l-bakaan da,fiyah faraga be l-nuss al-kharbaani.
Wa l-raajil gaal leyi-:-Da l-bakaan al-foogah rujaal al-diin yirakkubu al-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-khata wa l-dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib.Wa humman yirakkubu al-dahaaya dool fi l-faraga di wa ma yamurguuhum ale l-fadaay al-barraaniiye.Wa da achaan ma yikhassusu al-cha'ab.
Wa ba'ad da,al-raajil maragaani ale l-fadaay al-barraaniiye wa waddaani ale l-arba'a rukun hana l-fadaay.Wa fi ayyi rukun,fiyah fadaay sakhayre.
Wa l-fadaayaat hana l-arba'a rukun dool dugaag wa induhum nafs al-magaas.Ayyi waahide tuulha 40 duraa' wa urdaha 30 duraa'.
Wa kulla l-fadaayaat al-arba'a dool muhawwagiin be durdur wa khatto ladaay fi ga'ar al-durdur da fi kulla daayirah.
Wa l-raajil gaal leyi-:-Dool al-ladaay al-fooghum khaddaamiin beet Allah yirakkubu al-dahaaya hana l-cha'ab.
Wa l-raajil waddaani ale madkhal al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa daahu almi maarig min tihit al-beet min nussah al-sabhaani achaan al-beet muwajjih sabaah.Wa l-almi saal ale l-wati wa jara wati al-madbah.
Wa l-raajil maragaani be beet al-madkhal al-munchaakhi wa hawwagaani fi l-fadaay al-barraaniiye lahaddi beet al-madkhal al-sabhaani.Wa daahu almi jaari wati al-baab da.
Wa l-raajil marag ale l-sabaah wa l-habil al-yigaawusu beyah fi iidah.Wa min al-baab,hu kaal 1-000 duraa' barra.Wa hinaak,gatta'aani al-almi wa l-almi lihig siigaani.
Wa battaan kaal 1-000 duraa' wa gatta'aani al-almi wa l-almi lihig rikabbi.Wa battaan kaal 1-000 duraa' wa gatta'aani al-almi wa l-almi lihig sulbi.
Wa battaan kaal 1-000 duraa' wa l-almi bigi waadi al-ma nagdar nagta'ah achaan al-almi khariig wa illa naadum yu'uum.Wa da waadi al-abadan naadum ma yagdar yagta'ah.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,inta gaa'id tichiif walla-? Wa hu waddaani wa gabbalaani fi khachum al-waadi.
Wa wakit gabbalaani,daahu ana chift chadar katiir fi khachum al-waadi jaay wa jaay.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Al-almi da yamchi ale balad al-sabaah wa yamchi le waadi al-Urdun wa yadkhul fi l-bahar al-Mayyit.Wa wakit almi min al-een di yadkhul fi l-bahar al-Mayyit,kulla almi al-bahar da yabga halu.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan al-yadkhul foogah al-almi da,al-makhluugiin al-hayyiin yabgo katiiriin wa yi'iichu.Wa l-huut yabga katiir ziyaada achaan almi al-een di yaji wa yisawwi almi al-bahar da halu.Wa l-haya tukuun fi ayyi bakaan al-yadkhul foogah al-almi da.
Wa khalaas,al-hawwaatiin yagoodu fi khachum al-almi wa min Een Jidi lahaddi Een Aglaayim yabga bakaan al-yuchurru foogah al-churukka.Wa nafar al-huut fi l-bahar al-Mayyit yabga katiir min nafar al-huut fi l-bahar al-Abyad.
Wa laakin almi ruhuudah wa birakkah ma yabga halu wa laakin yagood achaan yalgo minnah mileh.
Wa fi khachum al-waadi jaay wa jaay,yugumm nafar katiir hana chadar al-induhum iyaal.Warchaalhum abadan ma yaybas wa iyaalhum ma yikammulu.Wa humman yaldo fi ayyi chahar achaan al-almi da maarig min al-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa iyaalhum,yaakuluuhum wa warchaalhum yanti al-aafe.
Wa Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Daahu huduud al-balad al-tigassumuuha warasa ambeenaatku intu gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-atnaachar.Wa zurriiyit Yuusuf gisimhum yabga marrateen.
Wa talgo warasatku ambeenaatku sawa sawa achaan ana halaft wa gult nantiiha le juduudku.Wa l-balad di tabga leeku warasa.
Wa daahu huduud al-balad.Fi l-munchaakh,al-huduud yugummu min al-bahar al-Abyad wa yamchu lahaddi derib Hatluun wa lahaddi Sadaad
wa Hamaat wa Biruuta wa Sibraayim ambeen ard Dimachkh wa ard Hamaat wa min Hasar Tikuun ale huduud Hooraan.
Wa misil da,al-huduud yamchu min al-bahar al-Abyad lahaddi Hasar Eenaan fi ard Dimachkh wa yufuutu ard Hamaat ale jiihat al-munchaakh.
Wa fi l-sabaah,al-huduud yugummu min been Hooraan wa ard Dimachkh wa yamchu been Gil'aad wa balad Israa'iil.Waadi al-Urdun yabga huduudku lahaddi l-bahar al-Mayyit.Wa da ale jiihat al-sabaah.
Wa fi l-wati fi saharat Nagab,al-huduud yugummu min Taamaar wa yamchu lahaddi almi Mariiba hana Khaadich wa lahaddi waadi Masir wa lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad.Wa da ale jiihat al-Nagab fi l-wati.
Wa fi l-kharib,al-huduud humman al-bahar al-Abyad.Wa l-huduud yamchu min huduud al-wati lahaddi bakaan al-mugaabil Labu Hamaat fi l-munchaakh.Wa da ale jiihat al-kharib.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,gassumu al-balad di ambeenaatku hasab gabaayilku.
Wa gassumu al-balad di warasa ambeenaatku be am'iyeedaat le nufuusku wa l-ajaanib al-saakniin ma'aaku wa wildo iyaalhum fi usutku wa bigo muwaatiniin ma'aaku intu Bani Israa'iil.Wa humman yalgo gisimhum hana l-balad di be am'iyeedaat ma'aaku fi lubb gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa le ayyi ajnabi,tantuuh warasatah fi lubb al-gabiila al-hu saakin ma'aaha. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Daahu asaame al-gabaayil wa gisimhum.Gisim le gabiilat Daan yamchi min aakhir al-munchaakh fi l-derib hana Hatluun lahaddi Labu Hamaat wa Hasar Eenaan wa yamchi fi ard Dimachkh fi l-munchaakh jamb Hamaat.Gisim Daan yamchi min al-sabaah le l-kharib.
Wa wati min huduud Daan min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Achiir.
Wa wati min huduud Achiir min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Naftaali.
Wa wati min huduud Naftaali min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Manassa.
Wa wati min huduud Manassa min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim gabiilat Afraayim.
Wa wati min huduud Afraayim min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Ra'uubiin.
Wa wati min huduud Ra'uubiin min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Yahuuza.
Wa wati min huduud Yahuuza min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim al-tantuuh hadiiye leyi ana Allah.Urdah 25-000 duraa' wa tuulah misil tuul gisim al-gabaayil min al-sabaah le l-kharib.Wa l-beet al-mukhaddas yukuun fi ust al-ard di.
Wa l-gisim al-tantuuh hadiiye leyi ana Allah,tuulah 25-000 duraa' wa urdah 10-000 duraa'.
Wa da yabga gisim mukhassas le rujaal al-diin.Fi l-munchaakh,tuulah 25-000 duraa' wa fi l-kharib,urdah 10-000 duraa' wa fi l-sabaah,urdah 10-000 duraa' wa fi l-wati,tuulah 25-000 duraa'.Wa l-beet al-mukhaddas hanaayi ana Allah yukuun ust al-ard di.
Wa da yabga le rujaal al-diin al-mukhassasiin al-min zurriiyit Saduukh al-awwal sawwo khidimti wa ma ba''ado minni misil Bani Israa'iil wa l-Laawiyiin.
Wa gisimhum yukuun hadiiye al-yantuuha leehum min al-balad.Wa arduhum di mukhaddasa marra waahid wa tabga huduud ma'a gisim al-Laawiyiin.
Wa kan le l-Laawiyiin kamaan,gisimhum yabga huduud ma'a ard rujaal al-diin.Wa gisim rujaal al-diin wa gisim al-Laawiyiin kula tuulhum 25-000 duraa' wa urduhum 10-000 duraa'.
Wa l-ard di ma yibii'uuha wa la yibadduluuha wa la yantu awwal intaajha achaan al-ard di hinti ana Allah wa hi mukhaddasa.
Wa l-ard al-tifaddil min al-gisim da tabga bakaan ma mukhaddas wa yabnu foogha madiina be buyuutha wa bakaanaatha hana l-sarha.Wa l-ard di,urdaha 5-000 duraa' wa tuulha 25-000 duraa' wa l-madiina tukuun fi usutha.
Wa daahu magaas al-madiina di.Hi murabba'a wa tuulha fi ayyi jiihe 4-500 duraa'.
Wa bakaan al-sarha hana l-madiina gaa'id fi ayyi jiihe.Fi kulli jiihe min al-jiihaat al-arba'a,indah 250 duraa'.
Wa l-ard al-tifaddil jaay wa jaay min al-madiina tabga bakaan ziraa'a al-yi'iichu beyah khaddaamiin al-madiina.Wa fi l-kharib,tuulha 10-000 duraa' wa fi l-sabaah kula tuulha 10-000 duraa' wa hi tabga huduud ma'a l-ard al-mukhaddasa.
Wa khaddaamiin al-madiina al-yahartu al-bakaan da yaju min kulla gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.
Wa kulla l-gisim al-yantuuh hadiiye leyi ana Allah da murabba',tuulah wa urdah kula 25-000 duraa'.Wa yantu rubu' hana l-gisim al-mukhaddas da le l-madiina.
Wa l-ard al-tifaddil jaay wa jaay le l-gisim al-mukhaddas al-yantuuh hadiiye leyi ana Allah wa le gisim al-madiina tukuun le l-malik.Wa tuul ard al-malik,hu 25-000 duraa' jamb huduud al-ard al-mukhaddasa wa gisim al-madiina.Wa nuss ardah fi l-kharib wa nuss ardah fi l-sabaah.Wa l-gisim al-mukhaddas al-yantuuh hadiiye leyi ana Allah wa l-beet al-mukhaddas gaa'idiin usut al-gisim al-itneen hana l-malik.
Wa gisim al-Laawiyiin wa gisim al-madiina kula gaa'idiin usut ambeen al-gisim al-itneen hana l-malik.Wa gisim al-malik yukuun ambeen gisim Yahuuza fi l-munchaakh wa gisim Banyaamiin fi l-wati.
Wa daahu gisim hana l-gabaayil al-faddalo.Min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Wa wati min huduud Banyaamiin min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Chim'uun.
Wa wati min huduud Chim'uun min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Yassaakar.
Wa wati min huduud Yassaakar min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Zabuluun.
Wa wati min huduud Zabuluun min al-sabaah le l-kharib,da gisim le gabiilat Gaad.
Wa huduud Gaad yamchu fi saharat Nagab min Taamaar lahaddi almi Mariiba hana Khaadich wa lahaddi waadi Masir wa lahaddi l-bahar al-Abyad.
Wa di l-balad wa da l-gisim al-tigassumuuh warasa be am'iyeedaat le gabaayil Bani Israa'iil. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Wa daahu biibaan al-madiina.Fi l-munchaakh,tuul durdur al-madiina 4-500 duraa'.
Wa biibaan al-madiina yisammuuhum be asaame gabaayil Bani Israa'iil.Fi l-munchaakh,al-durdur indah talaata biibaan wa humman baab Ra'uubiin wa baab Yahuuza wa baab Laawi.
Wa fi l-sabaah,tuul al-durdur 4-500 duraa' wa indah talaata biibaan wa humman baab Yuusuf wa baab Banyaamiin wa baab Daan.
Wa fi l-wati,tuul al-durdur 4-500 duraa' wa indah talaata biibaan wa humman baab Chim'uun wa baab Yassaakar wa baab Zabuluun.
Wa fi l-kharib,tuul al-durdur 4-500 duraa' wa indah talaata biibaan wa humman baab Gaad wa baab Achiir wa baab Naftaali.
Wa tuul daayir al-durdur da 18-000 duraa'.Wa min al-yoom,al-madiina di yisammuuha Allah Gaa'id Hini.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukum Yahuuyakhim malik mamlakat Yahuuza,khalaas ja Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa haasar Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa l-Rabb sallam Yahuuyakhim malik Yahuuza fi iideen Nabuukhadnasar.Wa Nabuukhadnasar karab al-malik wa chaal min al-mawaa'iin al-gaa'idiin fi beet Allah wa waddaahum fi Baabil fi beet ilaahaatah.Wa khatta al-mawaa'iin dool fi l-makhazan hana beet ilaahaatah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar amar kabiir khaddaamiinah al-usmah Achfinaaz achaan yijiib leyah subyaan min Bani Israa'iil min zurriiyit al-malik aw min iyaal al-naas al-muhimmiin fi l-balad.
Wa l-subyaan dool yukuunu ma induhum ayyi eeb wa ya'ajubu al-een wa induhum hikma wa ma'rafa katiire.Wa yagdaro yafhamo wa yil'allamo wa muwaafgiin le l-khidme fi gasir al-malik.Wa yi'allumuuhum lukhkhat al-Baabiliyiin wa kutubhum.
Wa l-malik gata' leehum akil yoomi wa kulla yoom,yantuuhum akil wa khamar min tarabeezit al-malik.Wa yi'allumuuhum talaata sana wa ba'ad da,yukuunu fi khidimtah.
Wa min been al-subyaan dool,fiyah subyaan min gabiilat Yahuuza wa humman Danyaal wa Hananya wa Michayiil wa Azarya.
Wa kabiir al-khaddaamiin khatta leehum asaame aakhariin.Le Danyaal sammaah Beltachaasar wa le Hananya sammaah Chadraak wa le Michayiil sammaah Michaak wa le Azarya sammaah Abdalnagu.
Wa Danyaal chaal niiye ma yinajjis nafsah be l-akil wa l-khamar al-yantuuh leehum min tarabeezit al-malik.Wa talab min kabiir al-khaddaamiin achaan ma yajburah fi l-cheyy al-yinajjisah.
Wa l-Rabb antaah le Danyaal al-rida wa l-rahma hana kabiir al-khaddaamiin.
Wa be da kula,al-kabiir da gaal le Danyaal-:-Ana khaayif min siidi al-malik achaan hu bas al-gata' leeku al-akil wa l-charaab.Wa kan yichiifku intu baatliin ziyaada min al-subyaan al-aakhariin al-gadurku,hu yagta' raasi be sababku intu.
Wa kabiir al-khaddaamiin khatta muraakhib foog Danyaal wa Hananya wa Michayiil wa Azarya.Wa Danyaal hajja leyah wa gaal-:
Ya sayyidi,min fadlak jarrib abiidak le muddit achara yoom.Antiina naakulu min al-khudrawaat bas wa almi nacharbo.
Wa ba'ad da,chiif al-faraga ambeenna aniina wa l-subyaan al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin yaakulu akil al-malik.Wa khalaas,sawwi ma'a abiidak misil inta chiftah.
Wa l-muraakhib khassad be l-kalaam da wa jarrabaahum le muddit achara yoom.
Wa ba'ad achara yoom,Danyaal wa rufgaanah sihhithum anchaafat samha wa bigo sumaan min kulla l-subyaan al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin yaakulu akil al-malik.
Wa khalaas,al-muraakhib baddal al-akil wa l-khamar al-magtuu' leehum be khudrawaat bas.
Wa l-Rabb antaahum le l-subyaan al-arba'a dool ma'rafa wa agul fi kulla l-kutub wa l-hikma.Wa Danyaal ya'arif yifassir al-ru'ya wa l-hilim kula.
Wa wakit al-wa'ad al-yigaabulu foogah al-malik tamma khalaas,kabiir al-khaddaamiin waddaahum wa gaddamaahum le l-malik Nabuukhadnasar.
Wa l-malik kallam ma'aahum wa fi kulla l-subyaan,ma ligi naas induhum ma'rafa misil Danyaal wa Hananya wa Michayiil wa Azarya.Wa hu chaalaahum ma'aayah wa antaahum mas'uuliiye.
Wa wakit al-malik sa'alaahum min ayyi cheyy,ligaahum induhum fihim wa hikma achara marraat ziyaada min kulla l-sahhaariin wa l-chawwaafiin al-gaa'idiin fi mamlakatah.
Wa Danyaal ga'ad lahaddi l-sana al-ja foogha al-malik Kuurach wa chaal al-muluk.
Wa fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukmah,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar ri'i wa l-ru'ya di barjalatah marra waahid wa l-noom aba eenah.
Wa l-malik naada kulla l-sahhaariin wa l-chawwaafiin wa l-chaddaara wa l-munajjimiin achaan yaju wa yi'arrufu leyah al-ru'ya di.Wa kulluhum jo giddaam al-malik.
Wa l-malik gaal leehum-:-Ana ri'iit ru'ya wa l-ru'ya di barjalatni.Achaan da,nidoor na'arifha.
Wa humman gaalo le l-malik be l-lukhkha al-araamiiye-:-Ya l-malik,Allah yansurak-!Min fadlak,hajji le abiidak be l-ru'ya al-inta chiftaha wa aniina kamaan nifassuru leek ma'anaatha.
Wa l-malik radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ana ni'akkid leeku-!Kan ma arraftuuni be l-ru'ya al-ana ri'iit beeha hi zaatha wa battaan ma'anaatha,nigatti' jisimku lahamaay lahamaay wa nidammir buyuutku wa yabgo misil danaagis.
Wa laakin kan arraftuuni be l-ru'ya hi zaatha wa ma'anaatha kula,ana nantiiku hadaaya wa mukaafa wa nukhuttuku fi l-bakaan al-indah charaf.Wa hassa' da,arrufuuni be l-ru'ya hi zaatha wa ba'ad da,ooruuni ma'anaatha kula.
Wa marra taaniye,humman gaalo leyah-:-Khalli al-malik yikallim le abiidah be l-ru'ya hatta aniina nifassuru al-ma'ana.
Wa l-malik radda leehum wa gaal-:-Akiid intu tidooru ti'akhkhuru al-wakit achaan intu fihimtu kadar al-kharaar al-ana chiltah da,akiid yukuun-!
Laakin kan ma arraftuuni be l-ru'ya zaatha,al-ikhaab da gaa'id yarjaaku kulluku.Wa intu achchaawartu le taju giddaami wa tihajju leyi be kalaam kidib wa khachch achaan ana nikhayyir fikri.Wa hassa' da,arrufuuni be l-ru'ya zaatha wa be da,ana na'arif khalaas intu tagdaro tifassuruuha.
Wa laakin humman raddo le l-malik wa gaalo-:-Ma fi insaan fi l-dunya yagdar yisawwi al-cheyy al-malik talabah-!Wa ma fi malik kabiir wa chadiid al-yatlub cheyy misil da min sahhaari aw chawwaafi aw munajjim.
Wa l-cheyy al-malik talabah da gaasi bilheen-!Ma fi naadum al-yagdar yisawwiih le l-malik illa l-ilaahaat wa laakin humman ma gaa'idiin ma'a l-insaan.
Wa wakit al-malik simi' kalaamhum da,zi'il za'al chadiid wa amar yaktulu kulla l-mustachaariin hana Baabil.
Wa wakit al-kharaar hana katiliin al-mustachaariin marag,gammo yifattuchu Danyaal wa rufgaanah kula achaan yaktuluuhum.
Wa wakit Aryuuk kabiir hurraas al-malik ja achaan yaktul kulla l-mustachaariin hana Baabil,Danyaal kallam leyah be hikma wa adab.
Wa hu sa'alah le Aryuuk kabiir hurraas al-malik wa gaal-:-Maala kharaar al-malik bigi chadiid misil da-? Wa Aryuuk fassar le Danyaal kulla cheyy al-kaan.
Wa tawwaali,Danyaal macha bakaan al-malik wa chahadah achaan yantiih wakit wa ba'ad da,yaji yifassir leyah ma'ana hana l-ru'ya.
Wa khalaas,Danyaal gabbal beetah wa khabbar rufgaanah Hananya wa Michayiil wa Azarya be l-cheyy al-kaan.
Wa gaal leehum khalli yachhado ni'mat Allah Rabb al-samaawaat le yi'arrifhum al-sirr da achaan ma yaktuluuhum hu wa rufgaanah ma'a l-mustachaariin al-aakhariin hana Baabil.
Wa be l-leel,al-sirr da ankachaf le Danyaal fi ru'ya.Wa khalaas,Danyaal chakar Allah Rabb al-samaawaat
wa gaal-:-Nachkur Allah daayman wa ila l-abadachaan hu indah al-hikma wa l-gudra.
Hu yikhayyir al-wakit wa l-zamanwa yidalli muluukwa yirakkib muluuk.Wa hu yiziid hikma le l-hakiimiinwa ma'rafa le l-aarifiin.
Hu ya'arif al-sirr al-madfuunwa l-mulabbadwa ya'arif al-cheyy al-gaa'id fi l-dalaamwa ma'aayah al-nuur.
Ya Allah Ilaah juduudi,nahmudak wa nikhanni be usmak.Achaan inta anteetni al-hikmawa l-gudrawa arraftini al-cheyyal-talabnaah minnakwa arraftina al-cheyyal-bukhuss al-malik.
Wa ba'ad da,Danyaal macha bakaan Aryuuk al-naadum al-malik kallafah be katil kulla l-mustachaariin hana Baabil.Wa gaal leyah-:-Ma taktul al-mustachaariin hana Baabil laakin waddiini bakaan al-malik wa nifassir leyah ru'yitah.
Wa bala ta'khiir,Aryuuk wadda Danyaal giddaam al-malik wa gaal leyah-:-Ana ligiit raajil waahid min al-naas al-karaboohum wa jaaboohum min balad Yahuuza.Wa hu yagdar yifassir leek ru'yitak,ya l-malik.
Wa l-malik sa'alah le Danyaal al-sammooh Beltachaasar wa gaal-:-Asma',tagdar ti'arrifni be l-ru'ya wa tafsiirha walla-?
Wa Danyaal radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Ya siidi al-malik,al-sirr al-inta talabtah da wa la l-mustachaariin wa la l-chawwaafiin wa la l-sahhaariin wa la l-khattaatiin ma yagdaro ya'arfuuh wa yi'ooruuk beyah.
Laakin a'arif kadar Allah Rabb al-samaawaat yakchif al-asraar.Wa hassa',hu wassaf le l-malik Nabuukhadnasar al-cheyy al-yabga fi l-ayyaam al-jaayiin.Wa daahu al-hilim wa l-ru'ya al-inta chiftah wakit inta naayim fi furaachak.
Ya l-malik,wakit inta naayim fi furaachak,inta fakkart fi l-mustakhbal wa Allah al-yakchif al-asraar kamaan wassaf leek al-cheyy al-yabga ba'adeen.
Ana ma indi hikma ziyaada min kulla l-naas wa Allah ma kachaf leyi al-sirr da be sabab hikmati laakin achaan inta al-malik ta'arif al-tafsiir wa tafham al-cheyy al-ja leek fi fikrak.
Ya l-malik,inta ri'iit wa chift giddaamak sanam tawiil wa kabiir al-biraari ziyaada wa choofah bikhawwif.
Wa raas al-sanam da min dahab saafi wa sadrah wa iideenah min fudda wa batnah wa dawaarjah min nahaas
wa siigaanah min hadiid wa rijileenah kamaan min hadiid wa tiine mukhalbatiin.
Wa wakit inta gaa'id tichiif foogah ke bas,hajar waahid marag min al-jabal bala ma limsatah iid wa waga' fi rijle al-sanam al-min hadiid wa tiine mukhalbatiin wa rihikaahum.
Wa khalaas,al-hadiid wa l-tiine wa l-nahaas wa l-fudda wa l-dahab anrahako dagiig wa bigo misil uttaab al-riih chaalatah,ma faddal minnah cheyy.Wa l-hajar al-darab al-sanam da kamaan bigi jabal kabiir wa sadda kulla l-ard.
Wa Danyaal gaal battaan-:-Ya l-malik-!Kallamtak be l-ru'ya wa daahu ma'anaatha.
Ya l-malik,inta malik al-muluuk wa leek inta Allah Rabb al-samaawaat antaak al-mamlaka wa l-khuwwa wa l-gudra wa l-charaf.
Wa hu khatta tihit sultitak kulla l-naas wa haywaanaat al-kadaade wa tuyuur al-sama,kan gaa'idiin ween kulla,achaan inta tahkim fooghum.Wa l-raas hana l-dahab da yimassilak inta.
Wa ba'adak inta,taji mamlaka aakhara sakhayre min mamlakatak.Wa ba'ad da,taji mamlaka taalta al-yimassilha al-nahaas wa tamluk kulla l-ard.
Wa ba'ad da,taji mamlaka raab'e gawiiye misil al-hadiid.Wa l-hadiid yikassir wa yarhak kulla cheyy.Be misil da,al-mamlaka di kula tikassir wa tarhak kulla l-mamaalik.
Wa inta chift al-rijle wa l-asaabi' min hadiid wa tiine mukhalbatiin.Wa da ma'anaatah al-mamlaka di tilgaasam wa nussaha yabga gawi misil al-hadiid achaan inta chift al-hadiid mukhalbat be tiine.
Wa l-asaabi' hana l-rijle al-nussuhum hadiid wa nussuhum tiine,da yiwassif kadar al-mamlaka di nussaha yabga gawi wa nussaha yabga da'iif.
Wa inta chift al-hadiid mukhalbat ma'a l-tiine wa da ma'anaatah al-naas yisawwu alaakha ambeenaathum be derib al-akhiide.Laakin al-alaakha di ma tabga gawiiye achaan al-hadiid ma bilkhalbat ma'a l-tiine.
Wa fi wakit al-muluuk dool,Allah Rabb al-samaawaat yi'assis mamlaka al-abadan ma tiddammar wa ma fi cha'ab aakhar yista'marha.Wa hi tidammir wa tarhak kulla l-mamaalik dool wa tagood ila l-abad.
Wa inta chift hajar al-marag min al-jabal bala ma limsatah iid.Wa l-hajar da rihik al-hadiid wa l-nahaas wa l-tiine wa l-fudda wa l-dahab.Wa Allah al-Gaadir wassaf le l-malik al-cheyy al-yukuun fi l-mustakhbal.Wa l-ru'ya di akiide wa tafsiirha kula sahiih.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar dangar wa sajad giddaam Danyaal wa amar yantuuh le Danyaal hadiiye wa bakhuur.
Wa khalaas,al-malik hajja le Danyaal wa gaal-:-Be sahiih Ilaahku intu da,hu bas Ilaah al-ilaahaat wa Rabb al-muluuk wa hu yakchif al-asraar achaan inta gidirt kachaft leyi al-sirr da.
Wa khalaas,al-malik antaah le Danyaal charaf wa antaah hadaaya katiiriin wa muhimmiin.Wa darrajah haakim fi wulaayat Baabil kullaha wa khattaah muhaafiz kabiir fi kulla l-mustachaariin hana Baabil.
Wa Danyaal talab min al-malik yanti al-idaara hana wulaayat Baabil le Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu.Wa Danyaal kula bigi waahid min ajaawiid al-malik.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar sawwa sanam hana dahab tuulah 60 duraa' wa urdah 6 duraa'.Wa khattaah fi l-sahale al-usumha Duura fi wulaayat Baabil.
Wa l-malik azam kulla l-muwakkaliin wa l-muhaafiziin wa ru'asa al-wulaayaat wa l-mustachaariin wa l-muwakkaliin be hafidiin al-maal wa l-gudiya wa naas al-charii'a wa kulla l-masaa'iil hana l-manaatig achaan yaju yahdaro fi l-aazuuma hana l-malik al-tukhuss al-sanam.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-muwakkaliin wa l-muhaafiziin wa ru'asa al-wulaayaat wa l-mustachaariin wa l-muwakkaliin be hafidiin al-maal wa l-gudiya wa naas al-charii'a wa kulla l-masaa'iil hana l-manaatig jo fi l-aazuuma di wa wagafo giddaam al-sanam al-khattaah al-malik Nabuukhadnasar.
Wa l-munazzim hana l-aazuuma naada be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Ya l-naas al-laammiin min al-chu'uub wa l-umam wa l-lukhkhaat,daahu al-amur buguul ke-:
--Min simi'tu hiss al-buug wa l-suffaara wa l-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l-gitaar wa kulla nafar hana aalaat al-musiikha,waajib tidanguru wa tasjudu giddaam al-sanam hana l-dahab al-khattaah al-malik Nabuukhadnasar.
Wa ayyi naadum al-aba ma yidangir wa yasjud le l-sanam da,tawwaali yichiiluuh wa yarmuuh fi naar amlahiib al-chadiide.-
Wa fi chaan da,kulla l-naas min al-chu'uub wa l-umam wa l-lukhkhaat wakit sim'o hiss al-buug wa l-suffaara wa l-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l-gitaar wa kulla nafar hana aalaat al-musiikha,khalaas dangaro wa sajado le l-sanam hana l-dahab al-khattaah al-malik Nabuukhadnasar.
Wa fi nafs al-wakit da bas,naas waahidiin min al-Baabiliyiin jo wa gaddamo chakwa didd al-Yahuud.
Wa humman gaalo le l-malik Nabuukhadnasar-:-Allah yansurak-!
Ya l-malik,inta anteet amur le ayyi naadum al-simi' hiss al-buug wa l-suffaara wa l-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l-gitaar wa kulla nafar hana aalaat al-musiikha,waajib yidangir wa yasjud le l-sanam hana l-dahab.
Wa kan naadum aba ma yidangir wa yasjud le l-sanam,yichiiluuh wa yarmuuh fi naar amlahiib al-chadiide.
Ya l-malik,daahu fiyah naas waahidiin min al-Yahuud al-inta anteethum al-idaara hana wulaayat Baabil wa humman Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu.Wa l-rujaal dool ma karramo amrak wa ma abado ilaahaatak wa ma sajado le sanamak hana l-dahab al-inta khatteetah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar zi'il za'al chadiid wa amar yijiibu leyah Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu.Wa khalaas,jaaboohum giddaam al-malik.
Wa l-malik sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Sahiih ke intu Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu ma gaa'idiin ta'abudu ilaahaati wa ma tasjudu le l-sanam hana l-dahab al-ana khatteetah walla-?
Wa hassa' da kan intu jaahiziin,min simi'tu hiss al-buug wa l-suffaara wa l-jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l-gitaar wa kulla nafar hana aalaat al-musiikha,tawwaali danguru wa asjudu le l-sanam hana l-dahab al-ana al-malik Nabuukhadnasar khatteetah.Wa kan abeetu ma ta'abuduuh kamaan,tawwaali yichiiluuku wa yarmuuku fi l-naar amlahiib al-chadiide di.Wa nichiif al-ilaah al-yagdar yamrugku min iidi ana-!
Wa Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu raddo wa gaalo le l-malik-:-Aniina ma nagdaro nihajju leek cheyy fi l-kalaam da.
Wa laakin,ya l-malik,Ilaahna al-aniina gaa'idiin na'abuduuh yagdar yinajjiina min al-naar amlahiib al-chadiide wa min iidak inta kula.
Wa kan ma najjaana kula,a'arif ya l-malik,aniina ma na'abudu ilaahaatak wa la nasjudu le sanamak hana l-dahab al-inta khatteetah.
Wa wakit al-malik Nabuukhadnasar simi' al-kalaam da,zi'il za'al chadiid wa wijhah alkhayyar.Wa gamma didd Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu wa amar yihammu al-naar di sab'a marraat ziyaada min awwal.
Wa battaan amar waahidiin min askarah al-chudaad yirabbutu Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu wa yarmuuhum fi l-naar amlahiib al-chadiide.
Wa tawwaali,rabbatoohum le l-rujaal dool wa ramoohum fi l-naar amlahiib al-chadiide be jalaaliibhum wa saraawiilhum wa tawaagiihum wa kulla lubaashum.
Wa min chiddit amur al-malik,al-naar hammooha ziyaada lahaddi akalat al-askar al-ramoohum le Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu.
Wa kan le l-naas al-talaata al-humman Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu,ramoohum murabbatiin fi ust al-naar amlahiib al-chadiide.
Wa tawwaali,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar anbahat wa sa'al masaa'iilah wa gaal-:-Ma rameena talaata naas murabbatiin fi ust al-naar walla-? Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aywa,ya l-malik.
Wa l-malik radda leehum wa gaal-:-Daahu ana gaa'id nichiif arba'a naas mufartagiin wa raaykhiin fi ust al-naar wa cheyy waahid kula ma sawwaahum.Wa l-raabi' da bichaabih ibn al-ilaahaat-!
Wa l-malik garrab le khachum al-naar amlahiib al-chadiide wa naada wa gaal-:-Ya Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu,ya abiid Allah al-Aali-!Amurgu min al-naar wa ta'aalu-! Wa khalaas,Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu marago min ust al-naar wa jo.
Wa kulla l-muwakkaliin wa l-muhaafiziin wa ru'asa al-wulaayaat wa l-masaa'iil hana l-malik jo hawwagoohum wa chaafo kadar al-naar ma akalat jisimhum wa suufaay waahide min ruuseehum kula ma hirgat.Wa khulgaanhum kula ma khayyaro wa riihit al-naar kula fooghum ma tinchamma.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar gaal-:-Baarak Allah Ilaah Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu al-rassal malakah achaan yinajji abiidah al-humman atwakkalo aleyah.Wa khaalafo amri ana al-malik wa khassado be l-moot kula akheer leehum min ya'abudu wa yasjudu le ilaah aakhar al-ma Ilaahhum.
Asma'o,ya l-naas-!Min ba'ad al-yoom,ayyi naadum min ayyi cha'ab aw umma aw lukhkha kan gaal kalaam didd Ilaah Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu,nigatti'ah lahamaay lahamaay wa nidammir beetah wa yabga misil dungus achaan ma fi Ilaah aakhar al-yagdar yinajji be tariiga misil di.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik anta khiima le Chadraak wa Michaak wa Abdalnagu fi wulaayat Baabil.
Wa yoom waahid,al-malik Nabuukhadnasar wajjah kallam le kulla l-naas min al-chu'uub wa l-umam wa l-lukhkhaat al-gaa'idiin fi kulla l-ard wa gaal-:-Al-salaam aleekum.
Ana farhaan nikhabbirku be l-alaamaat wa l-ajaayib al-Allah al-Aali bayyanaahum leyi.
Wa alaamaatah kubaarwa ajaaybah gawiyiin.Wa mulkah yuduum ila l-abadwa sultitah tagood min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Ana Nabuukhadnasar aayich tamaam wa murtaah fi gasri.
Wa laakin yoom waahid,ana chift hilim al-khawwafaani wa barjalt min al-fikir al-jaani fi raasi wa l-ru'ya al-chiftaha wakit ana naayim fi furaachi.
Wa amart yijiibu giddaami kulla l-mustachaariin hana Baabil achaan yifassuru leyi al-ma'ana hana l-hilim da.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-sahhaariin wa l-chawwaafiin wa l-munajjimiin wa l-khattaatiin jo giddaami.Wa ana hajjeet leehum be l-hilim da wa laakin humman ma gidro yifassuru leyi ma'anaatah.
Wa fi l-akhiir,ja giddaami Danyaal al-sammooh Beltachaasar hasab usum ilaahi.Wa hu,ruuh al-ilaahaat al-khudduusiin gaa'ide foogah.Wa ana hajjeet leyah be l-hilim wa gult leyah-:
--Ya Beltachaasar kabiir al-sahhaariin,ana na'arif kadar ruuh al-ilaahaat al-khudduusiin gaa'ide foogak wa sirr gaasi leek inta ke ma fiih.Daahu hilmi al-ana hilimt beyah.Antiini tafsiirah.
--Wa di hi al-ru'ya al-ana chiftaha wakit naayim fi furaachi.Ana chift giddaami chadara tawiile bilheen gaayme fi ust al-ard.
Wa l-chadara di kibrat wa addaggagat wa tuulha lihig lahaddi l-sama wa tinchaaf min ayyi bakaan fi l-ard.
Wa waragha sameh wa iyaalha katiiriin wa indaha akil le kulla l-makhluugiin.Wa haywaanaat al-kadaade yagoodu fi dullaha wa tuyuur al-sama yaskunu fi furuu'ha wa kulla l-makhluugiin aaychiin minha.
--Wa wakit ana naayim fi furaachi,ana chift waahid min malaa'ikat Allah al-muraakhibiin naazil min al-sama.
Wa gaal be hiss aali-:"Agta'o al-chadara di wa kassuru furuu'ha wa mallutu warchaalha wa chattutu iyaalha.Wa khalli al-haywaanaat yi'arrudu min tihitha wa l-tuyuur kula yi'arrudu min furuu'ha.
Wa laakin khallu dumburha be uruugah yagood fi l-ard fi ust al-gechch wa janzuruuh be jinziir hana hadiid wa nahaas.Wa l-chadara di timassil insaan.Wa khalluuh yinballa be l-karany al-yanzil foogah min al-sama wa yaakul al-gechch ma'a l-haywaanaat.
Wa aglah yibadduluuh min agul insaan le agul haywaan wa yagood misil da lahaddi sab'a sana.
Wa l-hukum da,hu kharaar wa amur jaayi min malaa'ikat Allah al-muraakhibiin achaan kulla l-naas ya'arfu kadar Allah al-Aali,hu bas siid al-muluk.Wa yanti mulkah le l-naadum al-hu yidoorah hatta kan miskiin kula."
--Wa da l-hilim al-ana al-malik Nabuukhadnasar hilimt beyah.Wa inta Beltachaasar,ooriini al-ma'ana hana l-hilim da achaan kulla l-mustachaariin hana mamlakati ma gidro yifassuruuh leyi.Wa laakin inta bas tagdar tifassirah achaan ruuh al-ilaahaat al-khudduusiin gaa'ide foogak.-
Wa Danyaal al-bisammuuh Beltachaasar anbahat le wakit chiyya wa fikrah barjalah.Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:-Ya Beltachaasar,khalli al-hilim wa tafsiirah ma yibarjuluuk. Wa Beltachaasar radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya siidi al-malik,yaareet al-hilim da kan bigi fi udwaanak wa tafsiirah bigi fi khusmaanak-!
Al-chadara al-inta chiftaha kabiire wa muddaggige wa tuulha lihig al-sama wa tinchaaf min ayyi bakaan fi l-ard.
Wa waragha sameh wa iyaalha katiiriin wa indaha akil le kulla l-makhluugiin.Wa haywaanaat al-kadaade yagoodu tihitha wa tuyuur al-sama yaskunu fi furuu'ha.
Wa l-chadara di,hi inta ya l-malik-!Inta kibirt wa bigiit gawi misilha wa azamatak bigat kabiire lahaddi lihgat al-sama wa sultitak lihgat kulla l-ard.
Ya l-malik,battaan inta chift fi ru'yitak waahid min malaa'ikat Allah al-muraakhibiin naazil min al-sama wa gaal-:--Agta'o al-chadara di wa dammuruuha.Wa laakin khallu dumburha be uruugah yagood fi l-ard fi ust al-gechch wa janzuruuh be jinziir hana hadiid wa nahaas.Wa khalluuh yinballa be l-karany al-yanzil foogah min al-sama wa yaakul al-gechch ma'a haywaanaat al-kadaade.Wa yagood misil da lahaddi sab'a sana.--
Wa daahu tafsiir al-ru'ya,ya l-malik.Da hukum Allah al-Aali leek inta,ya siidi al-malik.
Yaturduuk min ust al-naas wa ti'iich ma'a haywaanaat al-kadaade wa taakul gechch misil toor wa tinballa be karany al-yanzil foogak min al-sama.Wa misil da,tagood sab'a sana lahaddi ta'arif kadar Allah al-Aali,hu bas siid al-muluk wa yanti mulkah le l-naadum al-hu yidoorah.
Wa laakin khallo dumbur al-chadara wa uruugah fi l-ard.Wa da yiwassif kadar mamlakatak tigabbil leek kan inta allamt kadar Allah Rabb al-samaawaat,hu bas siid al-muluk.
Fi chaan da,ya l-malik,min fadlak kan gaasi leek kula,asma' kalaami.Khalli minnak al-zanib wa sawwi al-adaala wa khalli al-khataaya wa arham al-masaakiin.Wa be da,nafsak tukuun murtaaha daayman.
Wa kulla l-kalaam al-fassarah Danyaal ba'adeen bigi fi l-malik Nabuukhadnasar.
Wa fi muddit 12 chahar ba'ad hu fassar al-hilim,yoom waahid al-malik gaa'id yuruukh foog fi raas al-gasir hana mamlakat Baabil.
Wa gaal-:-Di ma Baabil al-kabiire al-ana baneetha achaan tabga aasima le mamlakati walla-?Wa ana baneetha be gudurti wa khuwwiti wa charafi wa majdi.
Wa wakit al-malik Nabuukhadnasar gaa'id yikallim ke bas,tawwaali hiss min al-sama radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya l-malik Nabuukhadnasar,asma'-!Mulkak marag min iideenak khalaas.
Wa yaturduuk min ust al-naas wa ti'iich ma'a haywaanaat al-kadaade wa taakul gechch misil toor.Wa misil da,tagood sab'a sana lahaddi inta allamt kadar Allah al-Aali,hu bas siid al-muluk wa yanti mulkah le l-naadum al-hu yidoorah.
Wa tawwaali,al-hukum tamma fi Nabuukhadnasar.Wa khalaas,taradooh min ust al-naas wa akal gechch misil toor.Wa jismah anballa be l-karany al-nazal min al-sama lahaddi suufah bigi tuwaal misil riich al-tuyuur wa khanaafrah bigo misil khanaafir al-suguura.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar gaal-:-Ba'ad al-sab'a siniin al-muhaddadiin,ana rafa't uyuuni le l-sama wa agli ja foogi battaan.Wa khalaas,ana chakart Allah al-Aali wa khanneet be usmah wa majjadtah hu Allah al-Hayy al-Daayim.Hu yamluk daayman wa ila l-abadwa mulkah gaa'id min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Wa kulla sukkaan al-ardma yitimmu cheyy fi giddaamah.Wa hu yisawwi kulla cheyy al-yidoorahfi sukkaan al-samawa sukkaan al-ard.Wa ma fi waahid yagdar yamna'ahwa la yuguul leyah-:--Sawweet chunu-?--
Wa wakit agli ja foogi,tawwaali ligiit charaf mulki wa majdi wa khuwwiti.Wa l-masaa'iil wa l-muwazzafiin hana mamlakati dawwarooni wa ana bigiit malik battaan wa azamati zaadat marra waahid.
Hassa' da,ana Nabuukhadnasar nikhanni be usmah wa nachkurah wa nimajjid Allah malik al-samaawaat al-kulla amalah sahiih wa kulla duruubah induhum adaala.Wa hu gaadir yizill al-mustakbiriin.
Wa fi ayyaam muluk Balchaasar,hu sawwa aazuuma kabiire le alif min muwazzafiinah wa chirib ma'aahum khamar.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id yachrab al-khamar da,hu amar yijiibu al-mawaa'iin hana l-dahab wa l-fudda al-abuuh Nabuukhadnasar chaalaahum wa jaabaahum min beet Allah al-gaa'id fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa da achaan al-malik wa muwazzafiinah wa awiinah wa sirriiyaatah yacharbo beehum.
Wa khalaas,humman jaabo al-mawaa'iin hana l-dahab al-awwal chaaloohum min beet Allah al-gaa'id fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-malik wa muwazzafiinah wa awiinah wa sirriiyaatah chirbo beehum.
Humman chirbo al-khamar wa khanno le ilaahaathum al-min dahab wa fudda wa nahaas wa hadiid wa khachab wa hujaar.
Wa tawwaali,baano jamb al-faanuus asaabi' hana iid insaan wa gaa'idiin yaktubu fi bayaad al-durdur hana gasir al-malik.Wa l-malik chaaf al-iid al-gaa'ide taktib.
Khalaas al-malik wijhah alkhayyar wa khaaf wa heelah barad wa rijileenah gaa'idiin yarjufu.
Wa l-malik naada be hiss chadiid wa gaal yijiibu giddaamah kulla l-chawwaafiin wa l-munajjimiin wa l-khattaatiin al-humman mustachaariin hana Baabil.Wa gaal leehum-:-Ayyi naadum minku al-gidir gara al-kitaaba di wa fassarha leyi,nilabbisah khalag khaali al-yalbasooh al-muluuk wa nidiss leyah silsila hana dahab fi ragabatah wa nidarrijah taalit rajul fi l-mamlaka.
Wa wakit kulla l-mustachaariin jo le l-malik,ma gidro garo al-kitaaba wa la gidro fassarooha leyah.
Al-malik Balchaasar khaaf ziyaada wa wijhah alkhayyar marra waahid wa muwazzafiinah kula barjalo.
Wa wakit al-malika amm al-malik sim'at be l-cheyy al-kaan le l-malik wa muwazzafiinah,jaat wa dakhalat fi bakaan al-aazuuma wa gaalat-:-Al-malik,Allah yansurak.Ma takhaaf wa wijhak kula khalli ma yilkhayyar.
Achaan fiyah raajil fi mamlakatak al-ruuh al-ilaahaat al-khudduusiin gaa'ide foogah.Wa fi wakit abuuk,al-raajil da ma'ruuf be l-ilim wa l-fihim wa l-hikma misil hikmat al-ilaahaat.Wa abuuk al-malik Nabuukhadnasar fi zamanah khattaah kabiir al-sahhaariin wa l-chawwaafiin wa l-munajjimiin wa l-khattaatiin.
Wa l-raajil da usmah Danyaal wa l-malik sammaah Beltachaasar.Wa hu indah agul kabiir wa ma'rafa wa fihim al-beehum yifassir al-hilim wa ya'arif al-hije al-indah ma'ana gawi wa yihill al-machaakil al-gaasiyiin.Hassa' da,naadi Danyaal wa hu yifassir leek al-kitaaba di.
Wa khalaas,jaabo Danyaal giddaam al-malik wa l-malik sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta bas Danyaal walla-?Inta min al-naas al-abuuyi karabaahum wa jaabaahum min balad Yahuuza-?
Ana simi't kadar ruuh al-ilaahaat gaa'ide foogak wa inta ma'ruuf be l-ilim wa l-fihim wa l-hikma al-ziyaada.
Wa jaabo giddaami kulla l-mustachaariin wa l-chawwaafiin achaan yagru leyi al-kitaaba di wa yifassuruuha wa laakin ma gidro yifassuruuha.
Wa ana simi't kadar inta tifassir al-hilim wa tihill al-machaakil al-gaasiyiin.Wa kan gidirt gareet al-kitaaba di wa fassartaha leyi,ana nilabbisak khalag khaali al-yalbasooh al-muluuk wa nidiss leek silsila hana dahab fi ragabatak wa nidarrijak taalit rajul fi l-mamlaka.
Wa Danyaal radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Khalli hadaayaak yagoodu leek inta.Wa kan tanti,anti al-aakhariin.Wa laakin ana kamaan nagri al-kitaaba di wa nifassirha leek.
Ya l-malik,Allah al-Aali anta abuuk Nabuukhadnasar muluk wa azama wa charaf wa majd.
Wa min chiddit al-azama al-antaaha leyah,kulla l-naas min al-chu'uub wa l-umam wa l-lukhkhaat yarjufu giddaamah min al-khoof.Al-hu yidoor yaktulah,yaktulah wa l-yidoor yikhalliih,yikhalliih.Wa l-yidoor yarfa'ah,yarfa'ah wa l-yidoor yarmiih,yarmiih.
Wa laakin wakit galbah gamma wa achchaddad wa astakbar,khalaas al-mamlaka maragat minnah wa charafah kula chaalooh minnah.
Wa taradooh min ust al-naas wa aglah albaddal min agul insaan le agul haywaan.Wa aach ma'a hamiir al-kadaade wa akal gechch misil toor.Wa jismah anballa be karany al-nazal foogah min al-sama lahaddi allam kadar Allah al-Aali,hu bas siid al-muluk wa yanti mulkah le l-naadum al-hu yidoorah.
Ya Balchaasar,inta wileedah wa ta'arif kulla cheyy al-kaan le abuuk Nabuukhadnasar.Wa laakin ma maskant nafsak.
Inta gammeet didd Allah Rabb al-samaawaat wa jaabo leek mawaa'iin beetah wa chiribtu beehum al-khamar,inta wa muwazzafiinak wa awiinak wa sirriiyaatak.Wa khanneet le ilaahaatak al-min dahab wa fudda wa nahaas wa hadiid wa khachab wa hujaar.Wa humman ilaahaat al-ma yichiifu wa la yasma'o wa la ya'arfu cheyy.Wa be da kula,inta abeet ma timajjid Allah al-antaak al-haya wa gaa'id yiraakhib derbak.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah rassal al-iid al-katabat al-kalaam da.
Wa daahu al-kalaam al-maktuub.--Mana Mana Tagil wa Faarsiin--.
Wa daahu tafsiirah.--Mana-- ya'ni hasab.Ma'anaatah Allah hasab ayyaam mulkakwa khalaas,mulkak kammal.
--Tagil-- ya'ni wazin.Ma'anaatah wazanook fi l-miizaanwa waznak ma tagiil.
--Faarsiin-- ya'ni kassarooh.Ma'anaatah mulkak ankasarwa mamlakatak antoohale mamlakat al-Maadiyiin wa l-Faarisiyiin.
Wa khalaas,Balchaasar amar yilabbusu Danyaal khalag khaali al-yalbasooh al-muluuk wa yidissu leyah silsila hana dahab fi ragabatah wa yidarrujuuh taalit rajul fi l-mamlaka.
Wa laakin fi nafs al-leele di,Balchaasar malik Baabil,katalooh.
Wa khalaas,ja al-malik Daariyuus min balad al-Maadiyiin wa chaal al-mamlaka.Wa fi l-wakit daak,umrah 62 sana.
Wa l-malik chaaf akheer yukhutt 120 wakiil achaan yimassuluuh fi kulla l-mamlaka.
Wa fi raas al-muwakkaliin dool,yukhutt talaata waziir achaan al-muwakkaliin yikallumuuhum be kulla cheyy al-haasil.Wa be da,chokhol fasil ke ma yaji le l-malik.Wa l-wuzara dool,Danyaal kula waahid minhum.
Wa Danyaal faataahum le l-wuzara wa l-muwakkaliin be l-agul al-kabiir.Wa l-malik fakkar wa yidoor yukhuttah fi raas kulla l-mamlaka.
Wa khalaas,al-wuzara wa l-muwakkaliin gammo yifattuchu eeb fi khidimtah hana l-mamlaka le yi'ayyubu beyah Danyaal.Laakin ma ligo foogah ayyi eeb wa la khata achaan hu amiin wa yiraakhib adiil wa khata kula ma sawwaah.
Wa l-rujaal dool gaalo-:-Danyaal da ma ligiina foogah ayyi eeb illa fi diinah.
Khalaas al-wuzara wa l-muwakkaliin dool macho lammo ajala ke bakaan al-malik wa gaalo-:-Ya malik Daariyuus,Allah yansurak.
Aniina al-wuzara wa l-muhaafiziin wa l-muwakkaliin wa l-masaa'iil wa ru'asa al-wulaayaat astafagna ambeenaatna.Wa hassa',natulbu minnak inta al-malik achaan tamrug marsuum wa tichiil kharaar al-yamna' ayyi insaan le muddit 30 yoom ma yigaddim talab le ilaah aw le insaan illa leek inta al-malik.Wa kan naadum aba ma karram al-kharaar kamaan,yazguluuh fi nugrat al-diidaan.
Ya l-malik,hassa' da aktib al-kharaar wa amda foogah achaan ma yilkhayyar wa yittabbag hasab al-gaanuun hana l-Maadiyiin wa l-Faarisiyiin.
Wa khalaas,al-malik Daariyuus katab wa mada al-kharaar.
Wa wakit Danyaal simi' kadar al-malik mada al-kharaar da,hu macha beetah.Wa fi l-khurfa al-taaniye hana l-gasir,fiyah chabaabiik maftuuhiin ale Madiinat al-Khudus wa hinaak Danyaal yarka' talaata marraat fi l-yoom.Wa fi l-yoom da,hu salla le Allah wa hamadah misil hu gaa'id yisawwiih daayman.
Wa be khafla,khusmaan Danyaal lammo wa macho bakaanah wa ligooh gaa'id yachhad Ilaahah wa yigaddim talabah.
Wa ba'ad da,tawwaali macho le l-malik fi sabab al-kharaar al-hu maragah wa gaalo-:-Ya l-malik,inta ma madeet fi kharaar al-yamna' ayyi insaan le muddit 30 yoom ma yigaddim talab le ilaah aw le insaan illa leek inta al-malik-?Wa kan naadum aba ma yikarrim al-kharaar,ma yazguluuh fi nugrat al-diidaan walla-? Wa l-malik radda wa gaal-:-Al-kalaam da akiid hasab al-gaanuun hana l-Maadiyiin wa l-Faarisiyiin al-abadan ma yilkhayyar.
Wa humman gaalo le l-malik-:-Ya l-malik-!Danyaal al-jaabooh min balad Yahuuza ma indah haaje beek inta wa la be kharaarak al-inta madeetah.Hu yigaddim talab le ilaahah talaata marraat fi l-yoom.
Wa wakit al-malik simi' al-kalaam da,hu hizin chadiid wa chaal niiye achaan yinajji Danyaal.Wa lahaddi l-makhrib,gaa'id yihaawil le yinajjiih.
Wa laakin battaan al-rujaal dool lammo wa jo le l-malik wa gaalo leyah-:-Ya l-malik,a'arif kadar gaanuun al-Maadiyiin wa l-Faarisiyiin buguul al-kharaar wa l-marsuum al-mada foogah al-malik ma yilkhayyar abadan.
Wa khalaas,al-malik amar wa jaabo Danyaal wa ramooh fi nugrat al-diidaan.Wa l-malik gaal le Danyaal-:-Khalli ilaahak al-gaa'id ta'abudah daayman da,yinajjiik-!
Wa jaabo hajar wa saddo beyah khachum al-nugra.Wa l-malik khatta foogah khitmah wa khitim muwazzafiinah achaan ma yikhayyuru fikirhum fi chaan Danyaal.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik gabbal fi gasrah wa tuul al-leel hu ma akal cheyy wa ma naada sirriiyaatah wa l-noom kula aba eenah.
Wa be fajur badri,al-malik gamma wa macha ajala le nugrat al-diidaan.
Wa wakit garrab le l-nugra,hu haznaan bilheen wa naadaah le Danyaal wa gaal-:-Ya Danyaal,abd Allah al-Hayy-!Ilaahak al-inta gaa'id ta'abudah daayman da gidir najjaak min al-diidaan walla-?
Wa tawwaali,Danyaal radda le l-malik wa gaal-:-Ya l-malik,Allah yansurak.
Aywa,Ilaahi rassal malakah wa sadda khuchuum al-diidaan.Wa humman ma gidro sawwo leyi cheyy achaan hu ya'arif ana bari.Wa giddaamak inta al-malik kula,ana ma sawweet cheyy fasil.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-malik firih farha chadiide wa amar yamurgu Danyaal min al-nugra.Wa wakit marago Danyaal min al-nugra,ma chaafo foogah ayyi jiraah achaan hu aaman be Ilaahah.
Wa l-malik amar yijiibu al-rujaal al-chako Danyaal.Wa jaaboohum wa ramoohum fi nugrat al-diidaan,humman wa iyaalhum wa awiinhum.Wa ma lihgo ga'ar al-nugra ke bas,al-diidaan khatafoohum wa kassaro udaamhum.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malik Daariyuus katab le kulla l-naas min al-chu'uub wa l-umam wa l-lukhkhaat al-saakniin fi kulla l-ard wa gaal-:Al-salaam aleekum.
Daahu ana naamur al-naas fi kulla mamlakati.Khalli yakhaafo min Ilaah Danyaal khoof chadiid.Achaan hu bas Allah al-Hayy,al-Daayim ila l-abad.Wa mamlakatah abadan ma tiddammarwa mulkah kula ma yikammil.
Wa hu al-yafza' wa yinajjiwa hu al-yisawwi alaamaat wa ajaayibfi l-sama wa fi l-ard.Wa hu bas al-najja Danyaalmin daribiin al-diidaan.
Wa Danyaal najah fi ayyaam hukum Daariyuus wa hukum Kuurach al-Faarisi.
Wa fi awwal sana hana hukum Balchaasar malik Baabil,Danyaal chaaf ru'ya wakit hu naayim fi furaachah.Wa ba'ad da,hu katab al-ru'ya di.Wa di hi ru'yat Danyaal.
Wakit ana naayim be l-leel,ana chift fi l-ru'ya di riih badat tusuug min al-jiihaat al-arba'a wa hazzat al-bahar al-kabiir.
Wa khalaas,arba'a haywaanaat kubaar nafarhum chig chig marago min al-bahar da.
Wa l-haywaan al-awwalaani,hu misil al-duud wa indah janaahe hana sagur.Wa wakit ana gaa'id nichiif foogah,mallato janaaheeh wa gawwamooh wa waggafooh be rijileenah misil naadum wa antooh agul hana insaan.
Wa l-haywaan al-taani,hu misil marfa'iin.Gamma ga'ad be nussah.Wa chaayil fi khachmah talaata udaam hana saff ambeenaat sunuunah wa gaalo leyah-:-Gumm.Amchi aktul wa aakul laham katiir.
Wa ba'ad da,chift battaan haywaan aakhar taalit wa hu misil al-nimir wa indah janaahe arba'a fi daharah misil janaahe al-tuyuur.Wa l-haywaan da indah arba'a raas wa antooh sulta le yahkim.
Wa ba'ad da fi nafs al-ru'ya di,chift al-haywaan al-raabi'.Hu yabhat wa yikhawwif wa indah gudra chadiide.Wa indah sunuun kubaar hana hadiid wa beehum yaakul wa yicharrit wa l-fadle yifajjikhha be rijileenah.Wa l-haywaan da bigi chig min al-haywaanaat al-talaata al-awwalaaniyiin.Wa hu indah achara guruun.
Wa wakit ana gaa'id nichiif fi l-guruun dool,chift garin aakhar sakhayyar gamma ambeenaathum wa talaata guruun min al-achara al-awwalaaniyiin maragoohum le yikhallu leyah al-bakaan.Wa l-garin al-sakhayyar da indah uyuun misil uyuun al-insaan wa indah khachum al-yihajji be istikbaar.
Wa battaan ana chift karaasial-khattoohum le majlas al-gudiya.Wa chaayib waahid kabiir sinn jawa ga'ad fi archahwa khalagah abyad karrmisil al-gamarwa cha'ar raasahmisil gutun al-nadiif.Wa archah naar amlahiibwa rijle archah naar mugargire.
Wa bahar hana naar jaariwa faayit giddaamah.Wa uluuf al-aalaaf yakhdumu leyahwa malaayiin waagfiin giddaamah.Wa naas majlas al-gudiya ga'adowa fataho al-kutub.
Wa ana chift wa simi't al-garin al-sakhayyar gaa'id yihajji be istikbaar.Wa chift al-haywaan al-raabi' al-gaa'id foogah al-garin da,katalooh wa gatta'o jismah wa harragooh fi l-naar.
Wa kan le l-haywaanaat al-talaata al-aakhariin kamaan,chaalo minhum sultithum.Wa laakin zaado leehum umurhum le wakit muhaddad.
Wa be l-leel fi ru'yiti,ana chift waahid bichaabih ibn al-insaanjaayi fi lubb al-sahaab.Wa wassal bakaan al-chaayib kabiir al-sinnwa gaddamooh leyah.
Wa anto le ibn al-insaan dasulta wa majd wa mulukachaan ya'abuduuhkulla l-naas min al-chu'uubwa l-umam wa l-lukhkhaat.Wa sultitah hi sulta daaymewa mamlakatah abadan ma tiddammar.
Wa ana Danyaal hammeet ziyaada.Wa l-ru'ya al-chiftaha di barjalatni.
Wa garrabt le waahid min al-naas al-waagfiin fi l-bakaan da wa sa'altah chunu al-ma'ana al-akiid hana kulla cheyy al-ana chiftah.Wa hu antaani al-tafsiir wa gaal-:
Al-haywaanaat al-kubaar al-arba'a dool yimassulu muluuk arba'a al-yaju ba'adeen.
Wa laakin al-saalihiin naas Allah al-Aali yalgo al-mamlaka wa yichiiluuha marra waahid ila l-abad.
Wa ana Danyaal dawwart na'arif hagiigat ma'ana al-haywaan al-raabi'.Hu chig min al-haywaanaat al-aakhariin.Hu bikhawwif marra waahid wa indah sunuun hana hadiid wa khanaafir hana nahaas wa yaakul wa yicharrit wa l-fadle yifajjikhha be rijileenah.
Wa dawwart battaan na'arif ma'ana hana l-guruun al-achara al-gaa'idiin fi raasah.Wa dawwart na'arif ma'ana hana l-garin al-sakhayyar al-gamma wa l-guruun al-talaata al-maragoohum le yikhallu leyah al-bakaan.Wa da l-garin al-indah uyuun wa indah khachum al-yihajji be istikbaar wa binchaaf chadiid ziyaada min al-aakhariin.
Wa ana chift al-garin da gamma yihaarib al-saalihiin naas Allah wa annasar fooghum.
Laakin al-chaayib kabiir al-sinn ja wa hakam wa saa'ad al-saalihiin naas Allah al-Aali.Wa misil da khalaas,wakt al-saalihiin ja wa humman chaalo al-mamlaka.
Wa l-naadum da fassar leyi al-ma'ana wa gaal-:-Al-haywaan al-raabi' da,hu yimassil al-mamlaka al-raab'e fi l-ard.Wa hi chig min al-mamaalik al-aakhariin wa tichiil kulla l-ard wa tifajjikhha wa ticharritha.
Wa l-guruun al-achara kamaan,humman yimassulu achara muluuk al-yamurgu min al-mamlaka di.Wa yaji ba'adhum malik aakhar chig min al-muluuk al-jo gubbaalah wa yarmi al-muluuk al-talaata dool.
Wa hu yuguul kalaam didd Allah al-Aali wa yidaayig naasah al-saalihiin wa yidoor yikhayyir ayyaam al-a'yaad wa Tawraat Allah.Wa l-saalihiin yaga'o fi iideenah muddit talaata sana wa nuss.
Wa laakin majlas al-gudiya yilimm wa yichiilu min al-malik da sultitah wa yikassuru mamlakatah wa yidammuruuha marra waahid.
Wa l-muluk wa l-sulta wa l-azama hana kulla l-mamaalik al-gaa'idiin fi l-ard,yantuuhum le l-cha'ab al-saalihiin hana Allah al-Aali.Wa mamlakat Allah tagood ila l-abad wa kulla l-naas al-induhum sulta ya'abudu Allah wa yasma'o kalaamah.
Wa khalaas,al-ru'ya di kammalat.Wa ana Danyaal afkaari khawwafooni marra waahid wa wijhi alkhayyar wa gaa'id nifakkir fi l-ru'ya di.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukum al-malik Balchaasar,ana Danyaal ri'iit battaan wa di l-ru'ya al-taaniye.
Wa fi l-ru'ya di,ana chift nafsi gaa'id fi madiinat Chuucha al-gawiiye fi balad Ilaam wa ana waagif fi khachum bahar Ulaay.
Wa fi l-ru'ya,ana rafa't raasi wa daahu chift kabich waagif fi khachum al-bahar.Wa l-kabich da indah itneen guruun tuwaal.Wa l-guruun al-itneen dool,al-waahid bigi tawiil min al-aakhar laakin al-garin al-tawiil da,hu bas al-gamma wara.
Wa chift al-kabich darab be guruunah ale l-kharib wa l-munchaakh wa l-wati.Wa haywaan waahid kula ma gidir yagiif giddaamah wa waahid al-gidir yanja minnah kula ma fiih.Wa hu sawwa kulla cheyy al-galbah bidoorah wa gudurtah gaa'ide tiziid marra waahid.
Wa wakit ana gaa'id nifakkir foogah,tawwaali chift tees jaari jaayi min al-kharib wa chagga kulla l-buldaan wa min chiddit sur'itah misil ma gaa'id yilammis al-ard.Wa l-tees da indah garin kabiir ambeenaat uyuunah.
Wa l-tees jara le l-kabich al-indah guruun itneen al-ana chiftah waagif jamb al-bahar.Wa l-tees da jara aleyah be za'al chadiid.
Wa chift al-tees da hajam al-kabich be za'al wa darabah wa kassar guruunah al-itneen.Wa l-kabich ma gidir leyah wa l-tees da ramaah wa fajjakhah wa cheyy al-yagdar yinajji al-kabich minnah kula ma fiih.
Wa l-tees da bigi kabiir marra waahid wa laakin wakit ligi gudra be ziyaada,garnah al-kabiir da ankasar wa fi gaddah,gammo arba'a guruun kubaar muwajjihiin ale l-jiihaat al-arba'a.
Wa waahid min al-guruun dool gawwam garin waahid sakhayyar marra waahid.Wa kibir ziyaada ale l-wati wa l-sabaah wa ale l-balad al-jamiila.
Wa l-garin da zaad lahaddi lihig khuwwaat al-sama wa l-nujuum.Wa rama minhum waahidiin fi l-ard wa fajjakhaahum.
Wa ma khalla khaayidhum kula.Wa hu mana' al-dahiiye al-gaa'idiin yigaddumuuha kulla yoom le Allah wa kassar al-beet al-mukhaddas lahaddi asaasah.
Wa fi chaan isyaan al-naas le Allah,sallamoohum le l-garin wa mana'oohum al-dahiiye al-yigaddumuuha kulla yoom.Wa l-garin aba al-hagg wa najah fi kulla cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Wa ana Danyaal simi't malak waahid sa'al malak aakhar wa gaal-:-Le mata yagoodu al-achya al-kallamoohum fi l-ru'ya di-?Wa mata yagiif gaddimiin al-dahiiye al-yigaddumuuha kulla yoom-?Wa le mata yagood al-isyaan al-yijiib al-kharaab wa yisallumu al-beet al-mukhaddas wa l-khuwwaat le yifajjukhuuhum tihit al-rijle-?
Wa l-malak al-aakhar radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-cheyy da yagood lahaddi adad al-ayyaam al-yisaawi 2-300 dahiiye hana fajur wa achiiye.Wa ba'ad da,al-beet al-mukhaddas kula yi'adduluuh min jadiid.
Wa wakit ana Danyaal gaa'id nifakkir fi l-ru'ya wa nidoor nafham ma'anaatha,tawwaali chift cheyy waagif giddaami yichaabih naadum.
Wa simi't hiss insaan yinaadi min ale l-bahar Ulaay wa gaal le l-naadum al-waagif giddaami da-:-Ya Jibriil,fassir al-ru'ya di le l-raajil da.
Wa khalaas,Jibriil garrab le l-bakaan al-ana Danyaal gaa'id foogah wa wakit ja leyi,ana khuft khoof chadiid wa waga't be wijhi fi l-turaab.Wa laakin Jibriil gaal leyi-:-Ya ibn Adam,a'arif kadar al-ru'ya di hi tukhuss al-wakit al-akhiir.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id yihajji leyi,ana khimirt wa waga't be wijhi.Wa laakin karabaani wa waggafaani be rijileeni.
Wa ba'ad da,Jibriil gaal leyi-:-Daahu ni'arrifak al-cheyy al-yukuun wakit khadab Allah yanzil wa da fi l-wakit al-muhaddad al-yaji fi l-akhiir.
Wa l-kabich al-inta chiftah al-indah guruun itneen,hu yimassil muluuk al-Maadiyiin wa l-Faarisiyiin.
Wa l-tees kamaan yimassil malik al-Yuunaaniyiin.Wa l-garin al-kabiir al-gamma ambeenaat uyuunah da yimassil malikhum al-awwal.
Wa l-garin da ankasar wa arba'a guruun aakhariin gammo fi gaddah wa dool yiwassufu arba'a mamaalik al-yamurgu min al-Yuunaaniyiin.Wa laakin ma yalgo gudra misil gudrat al-malik al-awwal.
Wa wakit hukum al-muluuk dool garrab yikammil wa l-aasiyiin zunuubhum faato al-huduud,yamrug fi usuthum malik waahid mustakbir wa kaddaab.
Wa khuwwatah tiziid laakin ma be gudurtah halaalah.Wa yisabbib kharaab ajiib wa yanjah fi kulla cheyy al-yisawwiih.Wa yaktul al-naas al-induhum gudra wa cha'ab Allah al-saalihiin kula.
Wa be najaadtah,yanjah wa be kidbah,yistakbar ziyaada wa yidammir naas katiiriin al-aaychiin fi l-salaama.Wa yugumm didd sultaan al-salaatiin.Wa yiddammar bala ma limsatah iid.
Wa kan le l-ru'ya al-inta chiftaha al-tukhuss adad al-dahiiye hana fajur wa achiiye di,hi sahiiha.Laakin al-ru'ya di sirr.Ma tikallim be l-ru'ya di achaan hi tukhuss wakit lissaa' jaayi ba'iid.
Wa ana Danyaal di'ift wa miridt muddit ayyaam.Wa ba'adeen ligiit al-aafe wa gammeet nisawwi khidmit al-malik.Wa be da kula,ana hammeet ziyaada min al-ru'ya al-chiftaha wa ma fihimt ma'anaatha.
Wa ba'ad da,Daariyuus wileed Achawiruuch min gabiilat al-Maadiyiin bigi malik fi balad Baabil.
Wa fi awwal sana hana hukmah,ana Danyaal fihimt min kutub al-Anbiya kadar Allah hajja le l-nabi Irmiya wa gaal kharaab Madiinat al-Khudus yagood 70 sanalahaddi l-wakit da yitimm.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,tawwaali ana wajjaht le l-Rabb Ilaahi wa chahadtah be l-sala wa l-siyaam.Wa libist khalag al-tooba wa sabbeet rumaad fi raasi.
Wa tawwaali ana gammeet salleet salaat al-tooba wa gult le Allah Ilaahi-:-Ya Rabb,inta al-Ilaah al-aziim wa l-gaadir.Wa inta daayman amiin fi mu'aahadatak le l-naas al-yihibbuuk wa yitaabu'u wasiiyaatak.
Aniina aznabna wa khitiina wa sawweena al-charr wa isiinaak wa khalleena wasiiyaatak wa charii'tak.
Wa ma simi'na kalaam abiidak al-anbiya.Humman kallamo be usmak le muluukna wa kubaaraatna wa juduudna wa kulla cha'ab baladna.
Inta aadil,ya Rabb,wa l-yoom al-eeb foogna aniina naas balad Yahuuza wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa kulla Bani Israa'iil al-gaa'idiin wa l-muchattatiin fi kulla l-buldaan.Inta taradtuhum wa waddeethum fi l-buldaan dool be sabab isyaanhum leek.
Aywa,ya Allah,al-eeb foogna aniina wa foog muluukna wa kubaaraatna wa juduudna achaan aniina aznabna giddaamak.
Wa laakin,ya Rabbina wa Ilaahna,inta khafuur wa rahiim hatta kan aniina isiinaak kula.
Wa aniina ma simi'na kalaamak,inta Allah Ilaahna.Wa ma taaba'na churuut al-Tawraat al-kallamtina beehum be waasitat abiidak al-anbiya.
Wa aniina Bani Israa'iil kullina khaalafna churuut al-Tawraat wa abeena ma simi'na kalaamak.Wa khalaas,inta nazzalt foogna al-la'ana wa l-hukum al-maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa abdak achaan aniina aznabna giddaamak.
Wa inta haggagt kalaamak al-gultah foogna aniina wa kubaaraatna wa nazzalt foogna masiibe kabiire.Wa l-masiibe al-nazalat fi Madiinat al-Khudus di abadan ma kaanat misilha fi l-dunya.
Wa l-masiibe di nazalat foogna misil maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa.Wa be da kula,ya Allah Ilaahna,ma wajjahna aleek wa ma chahadnaak wa ma khalleena al-khataaya al-gaa'idiin nisawwuuhum wa ma simi'na kalaamak al-hagg.
Ya Allah,inta bas jahhazt al-masiibe di hasab zunuubna wa nazzaltaha foogna.Ya Allah Ilaahna,inta daayman aadil fi kulla cheyy al-tisawwiih laakin aniina ma simi'na kalaamak.
Ya Rabbina wa Ilaahna,inta maragt cha'abak min balad Masir be iidak al-chadiide wa achaan da,usmak ma'ruuf lahaddi l-yoom da fi kulla l-ard.Laakin aniina aznabna wa sawweena al-charr.
Ya Rabb,inta aadil.Wa achaan da,ma tinazzil khadabak al-chadiid fi jabalak al-mukhaddas al-foogah madiintak.Achaan be sabab zunuubna wa l-khataaya al-sawwoohum juduudna,daahu al-naas al-hawaaleena gaa'idiin yichchammato le Madiinat al-Khudus wa leena aniina cha'abak.
Wa hassa' da,ya Ilaahna,asma' al-sala wa l-du'a hana abdak.Fi chaan usmak,ya Rabb,wajjih nuur wijhak ale beetak al-mukhaddas al-khirib.
Ya Ilaahi,asma' wa chiif al-kharaab al-ja fi madiintak al-foogha usmak.Wa aniina ma chahadnaak be sabab aniina saalihiin laakin achaan rahmatak inta wasii'e.
Ya Rabb,asma'ni-!Ya Rabb,akhfir leena-!Ya Rabb,asma' du'aayi wa afza'na bala ta'khiir fi chaan usmak,ya Ilaahi-!Achaan inta khassast al-madiina di le tabga madiintak wa l-cha'ab kula le yabga cha'abak.
Wa ana gaa'id nisalli wa nutuub min zunuubi wa zunuub cha'abi Bani Israa'iil wa nachhad Allah Ilaahi fi chaan jabalah al-mukhaddas.
Wa wakit ana gaa'id nisalli,chift al-malak Jibriil wa da l-malak al-awwal ana chiftah fi l-ru'ya.Wa hu jaani taayir be sur'a fi wakit gaddimiin hadiiyat al-achiiye.
Wa hajja leyi wa gaal-:-Ya Danyaal,daahu ana jiit le ni'allimak wa nifahhimak.
Ya Danyaal,min inta badeet tachhad Allah,hu amaraani wa daahu ana jiit le nikhabbirak achaan inta da,Allah biriidak.Khutt baalak le l-kalaam da wa afham al-ru'ya di.
A'arif kadar Allah kharrar wakit muhaddad le cha'abak wa le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa l-adad da 70 fi 7 sana ya'ni 490 sana.Wa haddad leehum al-wakit da achaan yikhallu minhum al-isyaan wa l-zanib wa yalgo kaffaara le khataayaahum wa yi'iichu daayman fi l-adaala.Wa l-ru'ya wa kalaam al-anbiya yilhaggago wa l-beet al-mukhaddas kula battaan yamsahooh le yikhassusuuh.
A'arif wa afham-!Al-wakit al-muhaddad da yilgaasam misil nuguulah leek.Yamrug kharaar hana gabbiliin Bani Israa'iil wa baniyiin Madiinat al-Khudus battaan.Wa min marigiin al-kharaar da lahaddi jaayiin al-naadum al-masahooh wa darrajooh malik,yisaawi 7 fi 7 sana ya'ni 49 sana.Wa ba'ad 62 fi 7 sana ya'ni 434 sana,al-madiina di yabnuuha battaan hi wa chawaari'ha wa yigawwu daraadirha hatta kan da wakt al-diige kula.
Wa ba'ad al-urbu'miya wa talaatiin wa arba'a sana dool,al-naadum al-masahooh wa darrajooh malik da yaktuluuh wa naadum yidaafi' leyah ke ma fiih.Wa yaji malik aakhar be askarah wa yidammir al-madiina wa l-beet al-mukhaddas.Wa laakin al-malik da,nihaayat hukmah taji ajala misil al-seel.Wa fi l-akhiir,al-harib wa l-damaar al-chadiid yabgo misil mukharrar.
Wa l-malik da yajbur naas katiiriin le yisawwu ma'aayah mu'aahada le muddit 7 sana.Wa ba'ad nuss al-mudda di,al-dahaaya wa l-hadaaya al-yigaddumuuhum daayman,hu yamna'hum.Wa ajala bas,al-mukharrib da yisawwi al-haraam al-yijiib al-kharaab.Wa fi l-akhiir,hu zaatah yiddammar misil mukharrar.
Wa fi l-sana al-taalta hana hukum Kuurach malik al-Faarisiyiin,Allah bayyan le Danyaal al-binaaduuh Beltachaasar al-achya al-akiid yabgo wa minhum al-ta'ab al-chadiid al-yaji.Wa be ru'ya,Danyaal fihim ma'ana al-achya dool.
Wa fi l-wakit da,ana Danyaal hizint le muddit talaata usbuu'.
Wa ana ma akalt akil halu wa la laham wa la chiribt khamar.Wa itir kula ma sabbeetah fi jismi lahaddi l-talaata usbuu' dool kammalo.
Wa fi yoom 24 hana l-chahar al-awwal,wakit ana gaa'id fi khachum al-bahar al-kabiir al-usmah Dijla,
ana rafa't raasi wa daahu chift raajil waahid baan leyi laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh wa fi sulbah,hizaam min dahab saafi.
Wa jismah yiraari misil al-hajar al-khaali.Wa wijhah yidawwi misil al-barraaga wa uyuunah yidawwu misil machaahiib al-naar wa iideenah wa rijileenah yiraaru misil al-nahaas al-saffooh.Wa hissah misil haraka hana naas katiiriin marra waahid.
Wa ana Danyaal chift al-ru'ya di wiheedi.Al-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayi ma chaafooha laakin khaafo khoof chadiid wa jaro allabbado.
Wa ana Danyaal faddalt wiheedi gaa'id nichiif al-ru'ya al-ajiibe di.Wa ana anbahat wa wijhi alkhayyar wa gudurti bigat ma fiiha.
Wa l-raajil da gamma yikallim.Wa wakit simi't hissah,tawwaali khimirt wa waga't be wijhi.
Wa khalaas,fiyah iid karabatni wa ga''adatni amburrooko wa ana gaa'id narjif.
Wa gaal leyi-:-Ya Danyaal,inta al-Allah biriidak-!Afham al-kalaam al-nuguulah leek.Gumm wa agiif be tuulak achaan hassa' Allah rassalaani leek. Wa wakit gaal leyi al-kalaam da,wagaft be tuuli wa gaa'id narjif bas.
Wa gaal leyi-:-Ya Danyaal,ma takhaaf achaan min awwal yoom inta chilt niiye le tafham wa maskant nafsak giddaam Ilaahak,hu simi' kalaamak.Wa fi sabab kalaamak da bas ana jiit.
Wa laakin al-ruuh al-mukallaf be mamlakat al-Faarisiyiin sadda leyi al-derib wa akhkharaani le muddit 21 yoom.Wa waahid min kubaaraat al-arwaah al-usmah Mikaayiil ja wa saa'adni wa be da,ana gidirt dakhalt fi mamlakat al-Faarisiyiin.
Wa hassa',jiit nifassir leek al-cheyy al-yukuun le cha'abak ba'adeen achaan al-ru'ya di tukhuss aakhir al-wakit.
Wa wakit gaa'id yihajji leyi be l-kalaam da,ana dangart wa ma indi gudra le nihajji.
Wa laakin ja waahid bichaabih ibn al-insaan limis chalaaliifi wa khalaas,ana gidirt fataht khachmi.Wa gult le l-waagif giddaami-:-Ya sayyidi,al-ru'ya di barjalatni ziyaada wa battaan ma indi gudra.
Ya sayyidi,kikkeef ana abdak nagdar nikallim leek kan gudurti ma fiiha wa ma nagdar ninaffis adiil-?
Wa khalaas,hu al-bichaabih al-insaan limisni battaan wa antaani gudra.
Wa gaal leyi-:-Ma takhaaf,inta al-Allah biriidak.Aleek al-salaam.Chidd heelak wa abga gawi-! Wa wakit gaa'id yihajji leyi,ana ligiit gudra wa gult-:-Kallim,ya sayyidi,achaan inta anteetni gudra.
Wa gaal-:-Ta'arif maala ana jiit leek-?Jiit achaan nikhabbirak be l-cheyy al-maktuub fi kitaab al-hagg.Hassa' ana nigabbil achaan nihaarib al-ruuh al-mukallaf be l-Faarisiyiin wa ba'ad da,yaji al-ruuh al-mukallaf be l-Yuunaaniyiin.Wa ma fi al-yisaa'idni didd al-arwaah dool illa Mikaayiil al-mukallaf be cha'abak.
Ya Danyaal,ana zaati awwal wagaft ma'a Mikaayiil le nisaa'idah wa nahmiih wa da fi awwal sana hana hukum Daariyuus al-Maadi.
Wa battaan hu gaal le Danyaal-:-Hassa' da,daahu kalaam al-hagg.Fi mamlakat al-Faarisiyiin,talaata muluuk yittaaba'o wa l-raabi' al-yaji ba'adhum yabga khani ziyaada minhum.Wa be gudrat maalah,hu yugumm didd mamlakat al-Yuunaan.
Wa fi l-Yuunaan kula,yarkab malik chadiid al-yahkim be gudra wa yisawwi kulla cheyy al-galbah bidoorah.
Wa laakin wakit mamlakatah usumha tala' khalaas,tawwaali hu yumuut wa zurriiytah ma yawrusu mamlakatah.Wa hi yigassumuuha arba'a mamaalik le naas aakhariin.Wa l-mamaalik dool ma yabgo gawiyiin misil al-mamlaka al-awwalaaniiye.
Wa hu al-yabga malik fi l-junuub ya'ni fi balad Masir yabga chadiid.Wa laakin waahid min khuyyaadah yabga chadiid minnah ziyaada wa yichiil al-muluk wa yiwassi' al-mamlaka.
Wa ba'ad siniin,malik Masir wa malik al-munchaakh ya'ni balad Suuriya yisawwu alaakha ambeenaathum.Wa malik Masir yijawwiz bineeytah le malik Suuriya achaan alaakhithum tabga adiile.Wa laakin hi wa abuuha yiwadduru gudrithum wa darajathum.Wa yisallumuuhum le l-moot,hi wa raajilha wa abuuha wa kulla musaa'idiinha.
Wa waahid min aayilitha yichiil bakaan abuuha malik Masir.Wa yugumm didd malik Suuriya.Wa yahjimah hu wa deechah fi madiinithum al-gawiiye wa yinnasir fooghum.
Wa hu yichiil ilaahaathum wa tamaasiilhum hana l-hadiid wa kulla mawaa'iinhum al-khaaliyiin hana l-dahab wa l-fudda wa yiwaddiihum fi Masir misil kasiibe.Wa hu yigaati' malik Suuriya le muddit siniin.
Wa ba'ad da,malik Suuriya yamchi ard malik Masir wa yigabbil baladah.
Wa awlaad malik Suuriya yijahhuzu le l-harib wa yilimmu askar katiiriin.Wa waahid min awlaad al-malik be askarah yugumm le l-harib wa yagta' al-huduud misil al-seel.Wa wakit mugabbil,hu yahjim al-madiina al-gawiiye hana udwaanah.
Wa malik Masir yaz'al za'al chadiid wa yamrug yihaarib al-askar al-katiiriin hana malik Suuriya wa yinnasir fooghum.
Wa yakrub al-askar dool wa yaktul minhum acharaat al-uluuf wa yugumm yikoolif wa laakin gudurtah di ma titawwil.
Wa ba'ad siniin,malik Suuriya yichiil silaah katiir wa askar katiiriin min al-askar al-awwal wa yamchi.
Wa fi l-wakit da,naas katiiriin yugummu didd malik Masir.Wa l-rujaal al-mu'aaridiin min cha'abak inta,ya Danyaal,kula yugummu didd malik Masir le yihaggugu al-kalaam al-awwal hajjooh leehum fi ru'ya.Wa laakin yafchulu.
Wa wakit malik Suuriya yawsal fi Masir,yihawwig durdur al-madiina al-gawiiye be radmiiye le yadkhul fi l-madiina wa yichiilha.Wa kulla askar malik Masir hatta askarah al-furraas kula yafchulu achaan ma induhum gudra.
Wa malik Suuriya yisawwi kulla cheyy al-galbah bidoorah achaan naadum waahid yagdar leyah ke ma fiih.Hu yichiil al-balad al-jamiilawa yijiib al-damaar fiiha.
Wa malik Suuriya yichiil niiye yaji be khuwwaat mamlakatah le yichiil Masir.Wa yisawwi ma'a l-malik alaakha wa yanti bineeytah achaan yidammir Masir wa laakin khittitah di tafchul.
Wa hu yiwajjih ale l-mudun al-fi khachum al-bahar wa yichiil minhum katiiriin.Wa laakin khaayid waahid askari yugumm diddah wa yi'ayyibah.Wa malik Suuriya ma yagdar yilkaffa foogah.
Wa ba'ad fachal,yigabbil fi l-mudun al-gawiyiin al-fi baladah.Wa hu yittarta' wa yaga' wa yiwaddir marra waahid.
Wa l-malik al-yarkab ba'adah yirassil naadum le yanhab majd al-mamlaka.Wa ba'ad ayyaam,al-malik da yumuut be sirr ma fi harib.
Wa gaal battaan le Danyaal-:-Yarkab fi balad Suuriya malik aakhar makruuh wa l-naas ma yantuuh majd al-malik.Wa wakit al-balad gaa'ide fi l-salaam,hu yagla' al-muluk be najaada.
Wa ayyi deech al-yahjimah,hu yahzimah wa yidammirah.Wa yaktul waahid min kubaaraat al-cha'ab al-induhum mu'aahada ma'a Allah.
Wa l-malik da yisawwi alaakha ma'a l-naas le yukhuchchuhum.Wa gudurtah tiziid kan naas al-yitaabu'uuh ma katiiriin kula.
