Wa wakit al-balad fi l-salaam,hu yadkhul fi l-manaatig al-yugumm fooghum al-ma'aach be ziyaada wa yisawwi cheyy al-abbahaatah wa juduudah abadan ma sawwooh.Hu yanhab al-balad wa yigassim al-kasiibe le naasah.Wa indah niiye fasle didd al-mudun al-gawiyiin wa laakin fi'ilah da ma yitawwil.
Wa be deech katiir,hu yugumm be kulla gudurtah wa fahaaliiytah wa yamchi yihaarib malik Masir.Wa malik Masir kula yijahhiz deech gawi wa katiir marra waahid le yihaaribah.Wa laakin malik Masir ma yagdar yinnasir achaan fiyah mu'aamara diddah.
Wa l-mu'aamara di,ajaawiidah yugummu yukhuunuuh.Wa be da,humman yakhsaro al-harib wa katiiriin min askarah yumuutu.
Wa l-muluuk al-itneen dool yilimmu le yistafugu wa laakin ayyi waahid galbah malaan be l-fasaala wa yihajju ambeenaathum be kalaam khachch.Wa kalaamhum ma yijiib halal achaan ayyi cheyy yitimm fi l-wakit al-muhaddad.
Wa malik Suuriya yigabbil fi baladah be kasiibe katiire.Wa wakit mugabbil,yisawwi kulla cheyy fasil al-galbah yidoorah fi l-cha'ab al-induhum mu'aahada mukhaddasa ma'a Allah.Wa khalaas,yiwassil baladah.
Wa fi l-wakit al-muhaddad,malik Suuriya battaan yugumm didd malik Masir wa laakin da ma yabga leyah misil awwal.
Wa wakit naas yaju diddah min al-kharib be sufun,hu achamah yingati' wa yi'arrid.Wa wakit mugabbil,yugumm didd al-cha'ab al-induhum mu'aahada mukhaddasa ma'a Allah.Wa l-yaabo al-mu'aahada kamaan,hu yistafig ma'aahum.
Hu yirassil askarah wa humman ma yihtarumu al-beet al-mukhaddas al-gawi.Yamna'o al-dahiiye al-yigaddumuuha kulla yoom wa yisawwu al-haraam al-yijiib al-kharaab.
Wa l-malik zaatah be kalaam khachch yilizz naas waahidiin le yaabo al-mu'aahada al-induhum ma'a Allah.Wa laakin al-naas al-ya'arfu Ilaahhum yugummu be chidde wa yasbutu.
Wa l-naas al-induhum hikma yifahhumu katiiriin min naashum.Wa laakin fi muddit chuhuur,siyaad al-hikma dool yaktuluuhum be l-seef aw yiharruguuhum be naar aw yidissuuhum fi l-sijin aw yichiilu maalhum.
Wa fi wakt al-ta'ab da,ma yalgo musaa'ada adiile wa l-naas al-yindammo ma'aahum kula munaafikhiin.
Wa l-naas al-induhum hikma,katiiriin minhum yumuutu wa moothum da yitahhir al-cha'ab wa yisaffiihum wa yijahhizhum le l-wakit al-akhiir al-muhaddad.
Wa malik Suuriya yisawwi kulla cheyy al-galbah bidoorah wa yistakbar.Wa hu yichiif nafsah aali min kulla l-ilaahaat wa yuguul kalaam kufur didd Allah Ilaah al-ilaahaat.Wa hu yanjah fi kulla cheyy al-yisawwiih lahaddi khadab Allah yanzil foogah wa yitimm waktah achaan akiid Allah yihaggig kalaamah.
Wa l-malik da ma indah haaje be ilaahaat juduudah wa la be l-ilaah al-ya'abudannah al-awiin wa la be ayyi ilaah aakhar achaan hu yichiif nafsah aali min kulla cheyy.
Wa fi badalhum,hu ya'abud al-ilaah al-yahmi al-mudun al-gawiyiin wa da ilaah al-juduudah abadan ma ya'arfuuh.Wa hu yigaddim le l-ilaah da dahab wa fudda wa hujaar khaaliyiin wa achya aakhariin khaaliyiin.
Wa be musaa'adat al-ilaah da,hu yugumm didd al-mudun al-gawiyiin.Wa yanti charaf le kulla l-naas al-yikarrumu al-ilaah da wa yisawwiihum kubaaraat fi naas katiiriin.Wa yigassim leehum ziraa'a le yachkurhum.
Wa fi l-wakit al-akhiir,malik Masir yugumm le l-harib wa laakin malik Suuriya yahjimah be khuwwa kabiire,be arabaat harib wa siyaad kheel wa sufun katiiriin.Wa misil al-seel,hu yadkhul fi kulla l-buldaan.
Hu yadkhul fi l-balad al-jamiila wa yaktul naas katiiriin.Wa laakin sukkaan Adoom wa Muwaab wa kubaaraat Bani Ammuun yanjo minnah.
Wa hu yista'mar buldaan katiiriin wa balad Masir kula ma tanja minnah.
Wa hu yichiil kulla maal Masir,al-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-achya al-khaaliyiin.Wa l-Liibiyiin wa l-Habachiyiin kula yitaabu'uuh.
Wa laakin al-akhbaar al-yaju leyah min al-sabaah wa l-munchaakh yibarjuluuh wa be za'al chadiid,hu yugumm wa yakhrib wa yaktul naas katiiriin.
Wa hu yutugg kheemaatah al-malakiiye ambeen al-bahar wa l-jabal al-mukhaddas al-gaa'id fi l-balad al-jamiila.Wa ba'ad da,taji nihaaytah wa ma fi naadum al-yisaa'idah.
Wa hu gaal battaan le Danyaal-:-Fi l-wakit da,yugumm Mikaayiil al-mukallaf be cha'abak.Wa da yabga fi wakit hana ta'ab al-abadan ma bigi mislah min al-umma di gaa'ide lahaddi l-wakit da.Wa be da kula,yanja ayyi waahid min cha'abak al-usmah maktuub fi kitaab al-haya.
Wa katiiriin min al-naas al-maytiin yab'aso wa waahidiin minhum yalgo al-haya al-abadiiye wa waahidiin yalgo al-eeb wa l-ihaana ila l-abad.
Wa l-naas al-induhum hikma yidawwu misil deyy al-nahaar achaan allamo al-adaala le naas katiiriin.Wa humman yabgo misil nujuum al-sama al-yidawwu daayman.
Wa laakin inta,ya Danyaal,al-kalaam da sirr,ahfadah.Wa khutt fi l-kitaab da khitim achaan ma yaftahooh abadan lahaddi l-wakit al-akhiir yitimm.Wa achaan da,naas katiiriin yifattuchuuh jaay wa jaay le yiziidu ma'rafathum.
Wa ana Danyaal fi l-ru'ya di chift itneen aakhariin,al-waahid waagif be hini wa l-aakhar waagif be hinaak le l-bahar.
Wa waahid minhum sa'al al-raajil al-laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh al-gaa'id foog min almi al-bahar wa gaal-:-Mata yaji akhiir al-ajaayib dool-?
Wa l-naadum al-laabis al-khalag hana gumaach sameh al-gaa'id foog min almi al-bahar da rafa' iideenah al-itneen ale l-sama wa gaal-:-Nahlif be usum Allah al-Hayy al-Daayim,akhiir al-achya dool fi talaata sana wa nuss.Wa da,ba'ad tiddammar gudrat al-cha'ab al-saalihiin hana Allah.
Wa ana simi't kalaamah wa laakin ma fihimt ma'anaatah wa gult-:-Ya sayyidi,kikkeef tukuun nihaayat al-ajaayib dool-?
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Ya Danyaal,al-kalaam da khalliih achaan hu sirr wa makhtuum ma yaftahooh lahaddi l-wakit al-akhiir.
Wa naas katiiriin al-ta'ab yitahhirhum wa yisaffiihum wa yinaddifhum.Wa l-induhum hikma yafhamo.Wa laakin al-aasiyiin yisawwu al-charr wa waahid minhum kula ma yafham.
Wa min wakit mana'o al-dahiiye al-yigaddumuuha kulla yoom wa gammo sawwo al-haraam al-yijiib al-kharaab,induhum 1-290 yoom.
Wa mabruuk le l-naadum al-yasbur lahaddi 1-335 yoom.
Wa kan leek inta,ya Danyaal,asbur lahaddi tumuut.Wa fi l-akhiir,tugumm wa talga ajrak.
Daahu kalaam Allah al-gaalah le Huucha' wileed Biiri.Wa da fi ayyaam hukum Uzziiya wa Yuutaam wa Ahaaz wa Hizkhiiya muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza wa fi ayyaam hukum Yaruba'aam wileed Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil.
Daahu bidaayit kalaam Allah al-gaalah be waasitat al-nabi Huucha'.Allah gaal le Huucha'-:-Amchi aakhud leek mara charmuutawa alda minha iyaal zina.Achaan naas al-balad achcharmato ma'a l-asnaamwa abooni ana Allah.
Wa khalaas,Huucha' macha akhad Guumar bineeyit Diblaayim wa hi bigat khalbaane wa wildat leyah wileed.
Wa Allah gaal le Huucha'-:-Sammi wileedak Yazra'iilachaan ba'ad wakit chiyya,ana natlub min zurriiyit Yaahual-damm al-jidduhum Yaahudaffagah fi waadi Yazra'iil.Wa nuguchch mamlakat Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-yoom da,naksir nubbaal deech Israa'iilfi waadi Yazra'iil.
Wa marit Huucha' battaan bigat khalbaane wa wildat bineeye.Wa Allah gaal le Huucha'-:-Sammi bineeytak Ma Narhamhaachaan battaan ana ma narham Bani Israa'iilwa ma nakhfir leehum abadan.
Laakin narham Bani Yahuuzawa ana Allah Ilaahhum,ninajjiihum.Aywa,ninajjiihum bala nubbaal wa la seef wa la haribwa bala kheel wa la siyaad kheel.
Wa marit Huucha' faradat Ma Narhamha.Wa ba'ad da,battaan bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Sammi wileedak Ma Cha'abiachaan intu ma cha'abiwa ana kula ma Ilaahku.
Adad Bani Israa'iil yabga misil ramla hana khachum al-baharal-ma tinwazin wa la tinhasib.Wa fi l-bakaan al-awwal Allah gaal foogah-:-Intu ma cha'abi-,fi nafs al-bakaan,hu yuguul leehum-:-Intu iyaali ana Allah al-Hayy.
Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil yilimmu sawawa yidarruju naadum waahid kabiir fooghum.Wa yaktaro fi arduhumfi yoom kabiir al-binaaduuh Yazra'iil(ma'anaatah Allah yazra').
Guulu le akhwaanku-:-Intu cha'abi.-Wa guulu le akhwaatku-:-Narhamhin.
Achku ammuku Israa'iil.Aywa,achkuuha-!Achaan battaan hi ma martiwa ana kula ma raajilha.Khalli hi tamrug alaamaat charmatatha min wijihhawa alaamaat zinaaha min been duyuudha.
Kan ma maragathum,ana nisallibha wa tagood aryaanewa nikhalliiha misil wildooha.Nisawwiiha misil saharawa misil ard jafaafwa naktulha be l-atach.
Wa iyaalha ma narhamhumachaan humman iyaal zina.
Ammuhum achcharmatat.Aywa,hi al-wildathum alkhattat be l-eebwakit gaalat-:--Ana najri wara sudgaanial-yantuuni akil wa almiwa suuf khanam wa gumaachwa dihin wa charaab.--
Wa fi chaan da,daahu ana nukhutt chook fi deribhawa nisiddah be durdurwa ma talga derib battaan.
Hi tajri wara sudgaanhawa laakin ma talhaghum.Hi tifattichhumwa ma talgaahum.Wa hi tuguul-:--Ana nigabbil le raajli al-awwalachaan ana murtaaha ma'aayah ziyaada min hassa'.--
Wa hi ma irfat kadar da ana bas al-gaa'id nantiihaal-gameh wa l-khamar wa l-dihin.Ana kattart al-fudda wa l-dahabwa laakin hi asta'malathum le ibaadat Ba'al.
Wa fi chaan da,ana naji wa nichiilgamhi fi wakt al-gati'wa khamari fi wakt al-darat.Wa nagla' minha suuf al-khanam wa l-gumaachal-taksi beehum nafisha min al-ire.
Hassa',nakchif eebha giddaam sudgaanhawa ma fi al-yinajjiiha min iidi.
Wa niwaggif farahha hana ayyi iidwa hana awwal yoom fi kulli chaharwa hana kulli yoom sabtwa hana kulli aazuuma.
Wa nakhrib jineenaat inabhawa chadar tiinhaal-be sababhum hi gaalat-:--Dool hadaaya al-antoohum leyi sudgaani.--Ana nisawwiihum kadaadeal-yarta'o foogha al-haywaanaat.
Ana ni'aakhibha be sabab al-ayyaamal-hi harragat fooghum bakhuur le asnaam Ba'al.Hi aljammalat be chinifha wa ziinithawa jarat wara sudgaanhawa khalaas,nisatni.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa be da kula,nihajji le Israa'iil be kalaam haluwa niwaddiiha fi l-kadaadewa nikallim leeha be hubb.
Hinaak,nigabbil leehajineenaatha hana l-inabwa waadi Akuural-hu waadi al-fasaalayabga leeha baabal-yaji beyah al-acham.Hinaak,hi titaabi'nimisil fi ayyaam subaahawa misil fi wakit hi maragat min balad Masir.
Daahu kalaam Allah-:-Fi l-yoom da,inti tinaadiini raajilkiwa battaan ma tinaadiini Ba'al siidki.
Ana namrug min khachumki usum asnaam Ba'alwa battaan ma tinaadi usumhum.
Fi l-yoom da,nisawwi le cha'abi Bani Israa'iil alaakhama'a haywaanaat al-kadaadewa tuyuur al-sama wa zawaahif al-ard.Wa fi l-balad,nikassir al-nubbaal wa l-seefwa niwaggif al-haribachaan cha'abi yunuumu be amaan.
Ya Israa'iil,nakrub raaskiwa inti tabge misil marti ila l-abad.Nakrub raaski be l-adaala wa l-haggwa be l-kheer wa l-rahma.
Wa nakrub raaski be sidikhwa inti ta'arfi kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana nakhbal talab al-samawa l-sama takhbal talab al-ard.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-ard takhbal talab al-gamehwa chadar al-inab wa l-zaytuun.Wa humman yakhbalo talab waadi Yazra'iilal-bakaan al-ana Allah nazra' foogah.
Wa nazra' leyi ziraa'a fi l-ardwa narham al-umma al-naadooha Ma Narhamha.Wa nuguul leehum al-naadoohum Ma Cha'abi-:--Intu cha'abi--wa humman yuguulu leyi-:--Inta Ilaahna.-
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Amchi hibb battaan martak al-zaaniye al-tihibb raajil aakhar.Wa da misil hubbi ana Allah le Bani Israa'iil hatta kan humman macho le ilaahaat aakhariin kula wa habbo abbuud al-inab al-gaddamooh le l-ilaahaat dool.
Khalaas,ana macheet fadeet marti be 15 hajar fudda wa 4 chuwaal hana gameh abyad.
Wa gult leeha-:-Agoodi daayman leyi ana wiheedi.Ma tichcharmate wa la tamchi le raajil aakhar.Wa ana kula ma nigarrib leeki.
Wa misil da,Bani Israa'iil yagoodu mudda tawiile bala malik wa bala kabiir wa bala dahiiye wa bala hujaar al-khazzoohum le l-ibaada wa bala farmala hana raajil al-diin wa bala asnaam.
Wa ba'ad da,Bani Israa'iil yigabbulu yitaabu'u Allah Ilaahhum wa malikhum al-min zurriiyit Dawuud.Wa fi aakhir al-wakit,yakhaafo min Allah wa yalgo kheerah.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,asma'o kalaam Allah-!Hu gaal-:-Ana Allah nachki sukkaan al-balad diachaan ma fi amaan wa ma fi rahmawa ma fi ma'rafat Allah fi l-balad.
Foogha illa l-la'ana wa l-kidibwa l-katil wa l-sirge wa l-zina.Yisawwu unufwa yidaffugu damm wara damm.
Fi chaan da,al-ard taybaswa sukkaanha yi'ayyusuwa ma'aahum haywaanaat al-kadaadewa tuyuur al-samawa hatta huut al-bahar kula yabga ma fi.
Angar'u-!Khalli naadum ma yachki kulla l-naaswa ma yuluumhum.Ana nachkiiku intu bas,ya rujaal al-diin-!
Intu tittarta'o be l-nahaarwa l-nabi al-ma'aaku kula yittarta' be l-leel.Wa ana nidammir ammuku Israa'iil.
Cha'abi addammaroachaan ma induhum al-ma'rafa.Achaan intu abeetu al-ma'rafa,ana kula naabaakuwa intu ma tabgo leyi rujaal diin.Wa misil intu nisiitu churuutial-fi l-Tawraat hanaayi ana Ilaahku,ana kula nansa iyaalku.
Wa rujaal al-diin kulluhum aznabo diddiwa be da,ana nibaddil charafhum be ihaana.
Yi'iichu be laham dahaaya kaffaarat al-zanib hana cha'abiwa fi chaan da,humman garmaaniin le zunuubhum.
Al-cha'ab wa rujaal al-diin yukuunu sawa sawa.Ni'aakhibhum hasab deribhum al-chaaloohwa nikaafiihum hasab amalhum.
Humman yaakulu wa laakin ma yachba'owa yazno wa laakin ma yaldo iyaalachaan humman aboma chaalo derbi ana Allah.
Al-zina wa l-mariise wa l-khamaryiliffu ruuseehum.
Cha'abi yas'alo sanamhum hana l-hatab.Aywa,yahsubu uudhum yurudd leehum-!Achaan ruuh al-charmata waddarhumwa l-charmata ba''adathum minni ana Ilaahhum.
Fi ruuse al-jibaal,yigaddumu dahaaya le ilaahaathumwa fi l-hujaar,yiharrugu leehum bakhuur.Wa ya'abudu tihit chadar al-balluutwa l-lubna wa l-butumachaan dulluhum baarid.Ya cha'abi,be sabab da,banaatku yabgan charaamiitwa awiin awlaadku yabgan zaaniyaat.
Ana ma ni'aakhib banaatkube sabab charmatathinwa la ni'aakhib awiin awlaadkube sabab zinaahin.Achaan rujaal al-diin zaathumyinfardu be l-charaamiitwa yilgaasamo akil al-dahaayama'a l-zannaayaat al-mukhassasaat.Al-cha'ab al-ma yafhamoyiwadduru nufuushum.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,kan intu achcharmattu kula,khalli Bani Yahuuza ma yakhto-!Ma tamchu le bakaan al-ibaada fi Gilgaalwa la tatla'o ale Beet Iil al-faslewa ma tahalfu be Allah al-Hayy.
Aywa,Bani Israa'iil harraanmisil al-bagarawa be da,kikkeef Allah yagdar yisarrihhummisil khanam fi mar'a akhdar-?
Naas Afraayim anrabato ziyaada ma'a l-asnaamwa be da,khalliihum bas-!
Wakit sakarhum kammal,yugummu yichcharmatowa kubaaraathum yihibbu al-ihaana.
Khalaas,al-riih tichiilhum fi janaaheehawa dahaayaahum yijiibu leehum al-eeb.
Ya rujaal al-diin,asma'o al-kalaam da-!Ya Bani Israa'iil,khuttu baalku-!Ya naas beet al-malik,khuttu adaanku-!Al-charii'a di muwajjihe leeku intuachaan fi Misfa,kajjeetu charak le cha'abiwa fi jabal Taabuur,khatteetu leehum amkajjaama.
Aywa,intu nakattu nugra kabiire le naas Chittiimwa laakin ana ni'addibku kulluku.
Ana na'arif tamaam gabiilat Afraayim,aywa,Bani Israa'iil ma mulabbadiin leyi.Ya naas Afraayim,intu achcharmattu,aywa,Bani Israa'iil annajjaso.
Wa amalhum al-hawaanma yikhalliihum yigabbulu le Ilaahhumachaan ruuh al-charmata gaa'ide fi guluubhumwa humman ma ya'arfu Allah.
Istikbaar Bani Israa'iil yachhad fooghum.Bani Israa'iil wa naas Afraayimyittarta'o fi chaan khataahumwa Bani Yahuuza kulayittarta'o ma'aahum.
Yamchu yigaddumubagarhum wa khanamhum dahaayale yifattuchu Allahwa laakin ma yalgoohachaan hu khallaahum khalaas.
Humman khaano Allahachaan wildo iyaal zina.Wa fi wakit gisayyir bas,yiddammaro,humman wa arduhum.
Allah gaal-:-Adurbu al-buug fi Gibee'awa adurbu al-burunji fi l-Raama.Iitu le Beet Iil al-faslewa chiifu waraaku,ya naas Banyaamiin-!
Fi yoom al-ikhaab,naas Afraayim yakhrabo.Wa l-khabar al-niballikhah leeku,ya gabaayil Israa'iil,hu khabar akiid.
Kubaaraat Yahuuzamisil naas al-yihawwulu al-kalanki.Ana ninazzil khadabi fooghummisil almi al-seel.
Zalamo naas Afraayimwa awwajo charii'ithumachaan humman yiriidu yajruwara l-riih.
Wa ana nabga misil arda le naas Afraayimwa misil suusa le Bani Yahuuza.
Naas Afraayim chaafo maradhumwa Bani Yahuuza chaafo uwaarhum.Wa dawwaro musaa'ada min balad Achuurwa rassalo naas le l-malik al-kabiir.Laakin al-malik da ma yagdar yachfiihumwa ma yagdar yidaawi uwaarhum.
Achaan ana nabga misil duud didd naas Afraayimwa misil farkh al-duud didd Bani Yahuuza.Ana bas nadrubhum wa nicharrithumwa nukurruhum wa niwaddiihumwa ma fi naadum al-yinajjiihum minni.
Ana namrug wa nigabbil fi bakaanilahaddi yi'tarufu be khataahumwa yiwajjuhu aleyi.Wa fi diigithum di,yifattuchuuni.
Ta'aalu nigabbulu le Allahachaan hu bas al-jarahnawa hu bas al-yachfiina.Hu bas al-darabaanawa hu bas al-yidaawi uwaarna.
Ba'ad yoomeen,hu yantiina al-haya.Aywa,fi l-yoom al-taalit,yigawwimna wa ni'iichu giddaamah.
Khalli nitaabu'u Allah le na'arfuuh.Jaytah mu'akkada misil nuur al-sabaahwa hu yajiina misil matar,misil matar al-richaach al-yazgi al-ard.
Ya naas gabiilat Afraayim,nisawwi leeku chunu-?Ya Bani Yahuuza,nisawwi leeku chunu-?Mahabbitku misil sahaab al-fajur al-yufuutwa misil karany al-sabaah al-ma yitawwil.
Achaan da,ana darabtuku be l-anbiyawa kataltuku be kalaamiwa nuur charii'ti nawwarkumisil nuur al-sabaah.
Wa mahabbitku nidoorhaziyaada min al-dahaaya.Wa kan ta'arfuuni,da akheer leyimin al-dahaaya al-muharragiin.
Nagado al-mu'aahada fi hillit Adamachaan fi l-bakaan da,khaanooni.
Wa Gil'aad hillit al-fasliinmulattakha be l-damm.
Wa majmuu'at rujaal al-diinbigo misil rabbaatiin al-duruub.Yaktulu naas fi derib hillit Chakiim.Aywa,gaa'idiin yisawwu fi'il cheen.
Fi usut Bani Israa'iil,ana chift fadiihe.Fi lubbuhum,naas Afraayim achcharmatoaywa,Bani Israa'iil annajjaso.
Wa intu kula,ya Bani Yahuuza,talgo ikhaabi misil intaaj ziraa'itku-!--Wakit nigabbil cha'abi min al-khurba
wa wakit nidoor nachfi Bani Israa'iil,khata Afraayim wa fasaalit al-Saamira yibiinuachaan fi'ilhum kulla khachch.Al-sarraag yadkhul fi l-buyuutwa rabbaatiin al-duruub yagoodu fi l-chawaari'.
Humman ma yahsubukadar ana nizzakkar kulla fasaalithum.Hassa' a'maalhum hawwagoohumwa gaa'idiin giddaami daayman.
Be fasaalithum,yifarruhu al-malikwa be kidibhum,yifarruhu al-kubaaraat.
Humman kulluhum zannaayiinwa chahwithum misil furun mugabbad.Siid al-furun ma yiraakhibahmin ajjan dagiigahlahaddi ajiinah yugumm.
Wa fi yoom iid malikna,al-kubaaraat yamrado min sakar al-khamarwa l-malik yimidd iidah le l-chammaatiin.
Wakit yigarrubu leyah,guluubhum misil furun mugabbadfi mu'aamarathum al-yugummu beeha.Fi tuul al-leel,za'alhum yargudwa be fajur,yugumm misil naar ambalbaala.
Kulluhum haamiyiin misil al-furunwa yaakulu hukkaamhum.Kulla muluukhum yaga'owa minhum ma fi waahid al-yinaadiini.
Wa naas gabiilat Afraayim yikhalbutuma'a chu'uub aakhariin al-ma ya'arfu Allah.Aywa,naas Afraayim ma naaf'iinmisil ka'ak al-ma chaglabooh.
Al-ajaanib dool kammalo gudrithumwa humman ma ya'arfuuh.Abchiyyeeb ja leehumwa humman ma ya'arfuuh.
Istikbaar Bani Israa'iil yachhad fooghum.Laakin ma gabbalo le Allah Ilaahhumwa la fattachooh.
Naas Afraayim bigo mukhaffaliinmisil hamaam al-ma indah raas.Humman yinaadu Masir le tafza'humwa yajru wara Achuur le tidaafi' leehum.
Wakit yamchu,ana nazgul fooghum charakiwa misil teer al-sama,nakrubhum.Wa ni'aakhibhumhasab al-balaakh al-sim'ooh fi malammithum.
Al-azaab leehum achaan arrado minni-!Al-damaar leehum achaan atmarrado diddi-!Ana chilt niiye le nafdaahumwa laakin humman gaalo foogi kalaam kidib.
Humman ma yasrakho leyi min daakhal guluubhumwakit yabku be hizin fi furaachhum.Yijarruhu nufuushumwa yinaadu ilaahaathumle yantuuhum al-gameh wa l-khamarwa laakin yiba''udu minni ana.
Wa ana bas addabtuhumwa gawweet duraa'humwa laakin humman yichiilu niiyit al-fasaala diddi.
Humman yigabbuluwa laakin ma aleyi ana Allah al-Aali.Humman misil nubbaal a'wajwa kubaaraathum yumuutu be l-seefbe sabab lisaanhum al-tariin diddi.Wa daahu fi balad Masir,al-naas yichchammato fooghum.
Adurbu al-buugwa jahhuzu nufuusku-!Al-adu yanzil misil al-sagurfi cha'abi ana Allah.Achaan humman nagado mu'aahadatiwa iso churuuti hana l-Tawraat.
Humman yasrakho leyi wa yuguulu-:--Ilaahna,aniina na'arfuukachaan aniina cha'abak Bani Israa'iil-!--
Wa laakin Bani Israa'iil abo al-kheerwa hassa' aduuhum yitaaridhum.
Humman darrajo muluuk bala izniwa kubaaraat bala muwaafagati.Be fuddithum wa dahabhum,humman sana'o leehum asnaamwa da yisabbib damaarhum.
Ya naas madiinat al-Saamira,khallu sanamku al-hu ijil hana dahab-!Ana khidibt ziyaada didduku.Intu ma bariyiin-!Wa tagoodu misil ke lahaddi mata-?
Ijilku da minku intu Bani Israa'iil baswa insaan bas sana'ah.Hu ma Ilaah-!Wa fi chaan da,ijil al-Saamira yilkassar.
Intu zara'tu al-riihwa khalaas,tagta'o amzooba'aane.Al-gameh bala ganduulma yanti dagiigwa kan anta dagiig kula,al-ajaanib bas yaakuluuh.
Bani Israa'iil akaloohum.Wa hassa' gaa'idiin fi ust al-umammisil maa'uun al-ma yanfa'.
Wa wakit macho ale Achuur,bigo misil humaar al-kadaade al-aayich wiheedah.Aywa,gabiilat Afraayim gaa'ide wiheedhahatta kan kaffat ujra le sudgaanha kula.
Kan ajjarat al-umam le yidaafu'u leeha kula,ana nilimmuhum kulluhum.Wa ba'ad wakit chiyya,humman yat'abotihit zulum hana akbar malik.
Naas Afraayim kattaro al-madaabihle dahaaya hana kaffaarat al-zanib.Wa laakin al-madaabih doolsabbabo leehum al-zanib.
Wa kan naktib leehumchuruuti hana l-Tawraat alif marra kula,humman yichiifuuhum misil cheyy ajnabi.
Humman yigaddumuuhum leyi dahaayawa yaakulu al-lahamwa laakin ana Allah ma nakhbal dahaayaahum.Nizzakkar khataahumwa ni'aakhibhum be sabab zunuubhum.Khalli yigabbulu Masir-!
Bani Israa'iil niso khaalighumwa bano leehum gusuur.Wa Bani Yahuuzakattaro al-mudun al-gawiyiin.Laakin ana nirassil naar fi mudunhumwa hi taakul gusuurhum.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,ma tafraho wa tinbastumisil al-chu'uub al-aakhariin.Achaan intu ba''adtu min Ilaahku wa achcharmattuwa habbeetu ujrat al-charmataal-ligiituuha fi kulla madaggaat al-gameh.
Laakin al-madagg wa l-assaara ma yirabbuukuwa kan tukhuttu achamku fi l-khamar kula,ma talgooh.
Naas Afraayim ma yaskunu battaanfi balad Allah.Humman yigabbulu Masirwa fi balad Achuur kula,yaakulu akil nijis.
Battaan ma yigaddumu khamar hadiiyat charaab le Allahwa hu ma yakhbal dahaayaahum.Wa da yabga leehum misil akil hana hizinwa l-yaakuluuh,kulluhum yabgo nijsiin.Akilhum yamla butuunhum baswa laakin ma yagdaro yigaddumuuh fi beet Allah.
Wa yisawwu chunufi l-yoom al-muhaddad,fi yoom iid Allah-?
Hatta kan arrado min al-damaar kula,balad Masir tajma'humwa hillit Mamfiis tadfinhum.Al-chook yisidd kanzuhum hana l-fuddawa l-haskaniit yugumm fi khiyamhum.
Yoom al-ikhaab jawa yoom al-Hisaab wassal.Khalli Bani Israa'iil ya'arfuuh-!Humman gaalo-:-Al-nabi munaafikhwa l-naadum al-nazal foogah Ruuh Allah da,muchootin.-Khataayaahum bigo katiiriinwa adaawithum bigat chadiide.
Al-nabi al-gaa'id ma'a Ilaahi,hu misil muraakhib fi naas Afraayim.Wa laakin yukujju leyah charak fi kulla duruubahwa yiwajjuhuuh be l-adaawa fi beet Ilaahah.
Wa humman sawwo al-fasaadmisil zamaan naas Gibee'asawwooh.Wa Allah yizzakkar khataahumwa yi'aakhibhum be sabab zunuubhum.
Zamaan,ana ligiit Bani Israa'iilmisil inab laziiz fi l-sahara.Wa chift juduudhum haluwiinmisil fawaakih al-awwal fi chadarat al-tiin.Wa laakin wakit humman wislo fi Ba'al Fa'uur,abado al-sanam al-yijiib al-eeb.Wa bigo makruuhiinmisil al-sanam al-muharram al-abadooh.
Wa charaf Afraayimyabga misil teer wa yitiir.Ma fi battaan waaluudawa la khalaba wa la himil.
Wa kan rabbo iyaal kula,ana naktulhum gabul ma yabgo kubaar.Aywa,al-azaab leehumwakit niba''id minhum-!
Zamaan wakit chift gabiilat Afraayim,hi tichaabih nakhalaay al-magganooha fi mar'a akhdar.Wa laakin hassa',gabiilat Afraayim tamrug iyaalha le l-katil.
Ya Allah,tantiihum chunu-?Antiihum rihim al-ma yakrubwa duyuud al-ma yiraddu'u-!
Kulla fasaalithum baanat fi hillit Gilgaalwa fi l-bakaan da bas,ana kirihtuhum.Wa be sabab amalhum al-fasil,ana natrudhum min beeti.Wa battaan ma nihibbuhumachaan kulla kubaaraathum haraamiyiin.
Naas Afraayim kataloohumwa uruughum yibso khalaaswa battaan ma yijiibu iyaal.Wa kan wildo kula,ana naktul iyaalhum al-khaaliyiin leehum.
Ilaahi yarfudhumachaan humman ma sim'oohwa yi'iiru fi ust al-umam.
Bani Israa'iil wildo ziyaadamisil chadarat inab al-talda katiir.Wa laakin wakit iyaalhum kitro,humman kattaro madaabih le ilaahaathum.Wa wakit arduhum bigat jamiile,jammalo al-hujaar al-khazzoohum le l-ibaada.
Guluubhum bigo itneen itneenwa hassa' yikaffu taman khataahum.Allah zaatah yihaddim madaabihhumwa yarmi hujaarhum al-khazzoohum le l-ibaada.
Wa hassa' humman yuguulu-:-Aniina ma indina malikachaan ma khufna min Allah.Wa kan indina malik kula,yisawwi leena chunu-?
Humman yuguulu kalaam saakitwa yahalfu be kidibwa yisawwu alaakhaat ma induhum faayde.Wa yaj'alo al-adaalamisil bizre al-musammamafi l-zere' al-mahruut.
Wa sukkaan al-Saamira yarjufufi chaan sanamhum hana l-ijilfi hillit Beet Iil al-fasle.Cha'abha yahzano be sabab ijilhumwa rujaal diinhum kula yarjufuachaan yiwaddu majd sanamhum fi l-khurba.
Wa sanamhum hana l-ijil da,yiwadduuh balad Achuurhadiiye le l-malik al-kabiir.Wa gabiilat Afraayim talga al-ihaana,aywa,Bani Israa'iil yalgo al-eebfi chaan achamhum fi l-sanam da.
Madiinat al-Saamira tiddammarwa malikha yabga misil gechchaay aayme fi l-bahar.
Wa l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-fasaalaal-yaznubu fooghum Bani Israa'iil yiddammaro.Al-haskaniit wa l-chookyugummu fi madaabihhum.Wa l-naas yuguulu-:-Khalli al-jibaal yaga'o foognawa khalli al-hujaar yadfunuuna.
Wa min ayyaam Gibee'a,Bani Israa'iil aznabowa humman ma khayyaro haalhum.Fi Gibee'a,waajib al-harib yalhag al-mujrimiin
wa ana ni'aakhibhum misil nidoorah.Wa chu'uub katiiriin yugummu didduhumwa yijanzuruuhum fi chaan khataahum al-itneen.
Gabiilat Afraayim misil bagara mu'addabaal-tihibb tifajjikh al-ma'aachfi l-madagg le tuduggah.Wa wakit naji,nukhutt uud al-harraatafi ragabatha al-jamiile.Wa gabiilat Afraayim tukurr al-harraatawa Bani Yahuuza yahartuwa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yichaglubu al-ard.
Azra'o al-adaala wa agta'o al-mahabbawa addulu leeku zere' jadiid.Hassa' waajib titaabu'u Allahlahaddi hu yijiib foogku al-adaalamisil al-matara.
Laakin intu zara'tu al-charrwa gata'tu al-fasaalawa akaltu min natiijat al-kidib.Intu atwakkaltu ale gudritkuwa ale katarat askarku.
Wa khalaas,yinsami' korooraak harib fi lubb cha'abkuwa kulla mudunku al-gawiyiin yakhrabomisil yoom al-khaayid Chalmaankharab hillit Beet Arbiilwa rihik al-ammahaat wa iyaalhin.
Wa da bas al-yisawwuuh leeku intu naas Beet Iilachaan intu sawweetu al-fasaala al-ma indaha hadd.Wa yoom waahid fi wakt al-chagaag,malik Israa'iil yiddammar marra waahid.
Wakit Bani Israa'iil misil sabi,ana habbeetahwa min Masir,ana naadeet ibni.
Laakin fi kulli wakit kan ana naadeet cha'abi,humman yiba''udu minni.Yigaddumu dahaaya le ilaah Ba'alwa yiharrugu bakhuur le l-asnaam.
Wa ana kamaan karabt naas Afraayimmin iideehum wa daadeethum.Laakin humman ma irfokadar ana bas rayyastuhum.
Ana waddeethum be tariiga insaaniiyewa be alaakha hint mahabba.Ana bigiit leehum misil al-yahdin al-sakhiirwa yilimmah fi sadrah.Ana maddeet iidiwa akkaltuhum.
Humman battaan ma yigabbulu Masirwa laakin malik Achuur bas yihaakimhumachaan humman aboma yigabbulu leyi ana.
Al-harib yadkhul fi mudunhumwa yidammir biibaanhum al-gawiyiinwa yaktulhum be sabab mu'aamarathum.
Cha'abi anrabato fi kufurhum.Naadoohum le yichiifu aleyi foogwa laakin waahid minhum kula ma rafa' raasah.
Ya Afraayim,kikkeef nikhalliik-?Ya Israa'iil,kikkeef nisallimak le l-adu-?Hal nidammirakmisil dammart hillaal Adma wa Sabuuyiimwalla-?Ana alhayyartwa galbi hanna foogku marra waahid.
Ana ma ninazzil foogku khadabi al-muhrigwa ma nigabbil le nidammir Afraayimachaan ana al-Rabb,ma insaani.Ana al-Khudduus wa gaa'id fi usutkuwa ma naji leeku be khadab.
Naas al-fi l-khurba yugummu yitaabu'uuniwakit ana Allah nikirr misil al-duud.Aywa,ana nahrij wa iyaali yarjufuwa yaju min khaadi le l-bahar.
Yarjufu wa yaju min Masir misil al-tuyuurwa yigabbulu min balad Achuur misil al-hamaamwa ana nisakkinhum fi buyuuthum.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Gabiilat Afraayim hawwagatni be kidib,aywa,Bani Israa'iil hawwagatni be khachch.Wa laakin Bani Yahuuza yamchu waraayiwa induhum amaan leyi ana al-Khudduus.
Gabiilat Afraayim tarwa be riihwa tajri wara riih al-sabaah.Kulla yoom hi tikattir al-kidibwa l-damaar.Tisawwi alaakha ma'a Achuurwa tantiih dihin le Masir fi badal al-salaam.

Hatta fi batun ammah kula,Yaakhuub khachcha chig toomah.Wa wakit bigi raajil,hu saara' ma'a l-Rabb.
Aywa,Yaakhuub saara' ma'a malak al-Rabbwa gidir foogah.Wa ba'ad da,hu bakawa chahad al-malak le yihinn foogah.Aywa,fi Beet Iilhu ligi Allahwa fi l-bakaan da bas,Allah hajja leyah.

Wa ana Allah Ilaahkumin maragtuku min balad Masir.Nisakkinku battaan fi khiyammisil fi ayyaam kheemat al-ijtimaa'.

Zamaan,jiddina Yaakhuub arradle balad Araam.Aywa,jiddina Israa'iil bigi khaddaamle yalga mara.Le yalga mara,bigi raa'i hana khanam.
Wa ba'adeen be waasitat nabi,Allah marag Bani Israa'iil min Masir.Wa be waasitat nabi,hu hafadaahum.
Wa laakin naas Afraayimkhaddabo Allah khadab chadiid.Wa khalaas,Ilaahhum yarmi fi raashumal-damm al-humman daffagoohwa yigabbil fooghum kulla eebhum.
Wakit naas Afraayim hajjo,al-khoof bigi chadiid fi balad Israa'iil.Wa laakin humman bigo khaatiyiinachaan abado ilaah Ba'alwa maato be sababah.
Wa ya hassa' kula,gaa'idiin yiziidu fi zunuubhumachaan sana'o leehum sanam be fuddithum.Aywa hasab ilimhum,sawwo leehum asnaamal-daggaahum sinaa'i ma'ruuf.Wa l-naas yuguulu-:-Gaddumu leehum dahaaya-!-Chiifu-!Al-naas doolyihibbu asnaam al-ajjaal-!
Wa be sabab da,humman yabgomisil sahaab al-fajur al-yufuutwa misil karany al-sabaah al-ma yitawwil.Yabgo misil uttaab al-madagg al-tichiilah al-riihwa misil al-dukhkhaan al-yamrug min al-chubbaak.
Ana Allah Ilaahkumin maragtuku min balad Masir.Ma waajib ta'arfu ilaah aakhar balaayi anawa ma fi munajji illa ana.
Ana iriftuku fi l-sahara,fi balad al-yabaas.
Ana sarrahtuku fi mar'a adiilwa intu riwiitu wa chibi'tu.Wa min chibi'tu,al-istikbaar dakhal fi guluubkuwa be da,intu nisiituuni.

Ya Bani Israa'iil,addammartuachaan gammeetu diddi ana al-nafza'ku.
Wa hassa' da,ween malikku-?Khalli yafza'ku fi kulla hillaalku-!Wa ween hukkaamku al-be sababhum gultu-:--Antiina malik wa masaa'iil.-

Wa waja' yaji leehummisil waja' al-talaga.Wa humman misil wileedal-ma indah hikma.Fi wakit al-waaluuda,ma yamrug min batun ammah-!
Hal ninajjiihum min al-khabur-?Hal nafdaahum min al-moot-?Ya l-moot,ween wabaak-?Ya l-khabur,ween kharaabak-?Battaan ma nichiifhumbe een al-rahma.
Wa kan naas Afraayim zaadofi ust akhwaanhum,riih al-sabaah tajiwa riih min Allah tugumm min al-sahara.Hi tiyabbis wudyaanhumwa tijaffif een almiihum.Al-makhaazin,yanhaboohumwa khumaamhum al-khaali,yichiiluuh.
Naas madiinat al-Saamira khaatiyiinachaan iso Ilaahhum.Yaktuluuhum fi l-haribwa yarhako iyaalhumwa yuchuggu butuun awiinhum al-khalbaanaat.
Gabbulu le Allah Ilaahku,ya Bani Israa'iil,achaan khataaku bas ramaaku-!
Jahhuzu kalaamkuwa gabbulu le Allah guulu-:-Akhfir kulla khataanawa fi badal dahaaya al-tiiraan,akhbal kalaam khuchuumna.
Balad Achuur ma tagdar tinajjiinawa aniina ma nitwakkaloale kheel al-harib kula.Battaan ma nuguulu-:--Ya ilaahna--le l-sanam al-sana'naah be iideenna.Beek inta bas,ya Rabb,al-atiim yalga al-mahanna-!
Ana nachfiihum min marad al-kufurwa nihibbuhum be niiye waahideachaan khadabi wagaf minhum.

Ya naas Afraayim-!Hal fi chabah beeni ana wa l-asnaam-?Ana bas nakhbalkuwa niraakhib foogku.Wa ana misil chadarat al-sarwi al-khadrawa minni ana bas,talgo intaaj.

Asma'o,ya l-chuyuukh,khuttu adaanku kulluku,ya sukkaan al-balad-!Cheyy misil da awwal kaan fi zamanku walla-?Aw kaan fi wakit abbahaatku-?

Al-faddalatah ambukbuk,al-jaraad akalahwa l-faddalah al-jaraad,amkachool akalatahwa l-faddalatah amkachool,saar al-leel akalah.
Ya l-sakkaara,gummu wa abku-!Ya charraabiin al-khamar,abku be hizinachaan al-khamar angata' minku.
Hacharaat gammomisil askar didd baladiwa humman gawiyiinwa ma yinhasbu min al-katara.Wa sunuunhum misil sunuun al-duudwa fawaatirhum misil fawaatir mart al-duud.
Wa humman dammaro jineenit inabiwa kassaro chadar tiini.Wa marago girfah wa ramoohwa yabbaso furuu'ah.
Abku misil mara sabiiyeal-rabatat chuwaal misil farde min al-hizinachaan tabki le raajilha hana chabaabha.
Hadaaya al-dagiig wa hadaaya al-charaab,ma yigaddumuuhum battaan fi beet Allahwa rujaal al-diin khaddaamiin Allah hizno.
Wa l-ziraa'a addammaratwa l-ard yibsat misil mara haznaane.Achaan al-gameh addammarwa l-khamar kammalwa l-dihin bigi ma fiih.
Ahzano,ya l-harraatiin-!Wa abku,ya siyaad jineenaat al-inab-!Achaan ma tagta'o al-gameh al-ahmarwa lammiin al-gameh al-abyad bigi ma fiih.
Wa jineenaat al-inab yibsowa chadar al-tiin jaffa.Wa kulla chadar al-yanti iyaal yibisaywa,al-rummaan wa l-nakhal wa l-tuffaah.Wa l-farah waddar min guluub al-naas.
Ya rujaal al-diin,albaso khulgaan al-hizin wa nuuhuwa abku,ya intu al-khaddaamiin fi l-madbah.Ta'aalu ahzano tuul al-leel be khulgaan al-hizin,ya khaddaamiin Ilaahi.Hadaaya al-dagiig wa hadaaya al-charaabma yigaddumuuhum battaan fi beet Allah Ilaahku.

Ya l-salaam-!Kikkeef al-yoom da-!Yoom Allah garrabwa da jaayi min al-Gaadir be damaar.
Wa min giddaamna,al-ma'aach angata'wa min beet Allah,al-farha wa l-suruur angata'o.
Al-teeraab yibis fi lubb al-ardwa l-dabangaat alhaddamo.Wa l-makhaazin fidoachaan al-ma'aach yibis.
Asma'o,al-bahaayim gaa'idiin yaguntuwa l-bagar aayriin fi ayyi bakaan.Achaan ma induhum gechchwa l-khanam kula ta'baaniin.
Nasrakh leek inta,ya Allah,achaan al-naar akalat gechch al-kadaadewa l-hariige akalat kulla chadar al-khala.
Wa haywaanaat al-kadaade kulawajjaho leekachaan kulla l-ruhuud yibsowa l-naar akalat gechch al-kadaade.
Adurbu al-buug fi Sahyuunwa iitu fi jabal Allah al-mukhaddas.Wa khalli kulla sukkaan al-balad yarjufuachaan yoom Allah jaayi wa garrab.
Da yoom hana dalaam azrag kurumwa yoom hana sahaab adlam marra waahid.Daahu deech kabiir wa gawi jaayi,misil nuur al-sabaah al-tala' fi l-jibaal.Abadan ma chaafo misilhumfi l-zurriiye al-faatat wa la fi l-zurriiye al-taji.

Giddaamhum,al-cha'ab yarjufuwa kulla wujuuhhum yabgo dulum min al-khoof.
Askarhum yajru misil al-furraaswa yatla'o al-daraadir misil muhaaribiin.Ayyi waahid chaayil derbahwa abadan ma yikiss min tariigah.
Wa ma fi waahid yatruch akhuuh,ayyi waahid maachi adiil fi derbah.Wa hatta kan yizarruguuhum be nachaachiib kula,ma yichattutu.
Yanzulu fi l-madiinawa yatla'o fi l-daraadir.Yadkhulu al-buyuutwa yadkhulu be l-chabaabiik misil saraariig.
Giddaamhum,al-ard tinhazzawa l-sama tarjif.Al-harraay wa l-gamar yidallumuwa l-nujuum yiwadduru nuurhum.
Allah yarfa' hissah giddaam deechahwa askarah kubaar wa chudaad yitabbugu kalaamah.Yoom Allah aziimwa mukhiif marra waahid.Yaatu yagdar yahmalah-?
Wa hassa',gabbulu leyibe kulla guluubku,be baki wa siyaam wa nuwaah.-Wa da kalaam Allah.

Wa khalli rujaal al-diin yabkubeen khurfit al-madkhal wa l-madbah.Aywa,khaddaamiin Allah yuguulu-:-Ya Allah,hinn fi cha'abak-!Humman al-misil warasatak,ma ti'ayyibhumwa la tikhalli al-umam yichchammato fooghum.Maala fi ust al-chu'uub al-aakhariin yuguulu-:--Ween Ilaahhum-?-

Al-udwaan al-yaju min al-munchaakh,niba''idhum minkuwa niwaddiihum fi ard jafaafwa kharaab.Awwalhum narmiih fi l-bahar al-Mayyit fi l-sabaahwa aakhirhum fi l-bahar al-Abyad fi l-kharib.Afanat janaazaathum tinchammawa l-hawa yi'affinachaan ana Allah sawweet achya kubaar.

Ya naas Sahyuun,afraho wa anbastu be Allah Ilaahku.Achaan yinazzil matar awwal al-khariif al-waajib leekuwa yinazzil leeku matar al-richaachwa matar al-khariif misil zamaan.

Ana Allah nikaffiiku intaaj al-siniin al-faatowakit rassalt leeku deech kabiir hana hacharaat.Wa humman ambukbuk wa l-jaraadwa amkachool wa saar al-leel.

Aywa,akiid fi ayyaam al-wakit da,ana nigabbil naas balad Yahuuzawa Madiinat al-Khudus min al-khurba.
Wa nilimm kulla l-umamwa niwaddiihum fi l-waadi al-usmah Yahuuchafat(ma'anaatah Allah yihaakim).Wa fi l-bakaan da,nihaakimhumfi chaan kulla cheyy al-sawwoohle Bani Israa'iil,cha'abi al-misil warasati.Achaan chattatoohum fi lubb al-umamwa algaasamo baladi ambeenaathum.
Humman algaasamo cha'abibe am'iyeedaatwa baa'o al-awlaadle yikaffu al-azabaatwa baa'o al-banaatle yacharbo khamar.
Wa intu kula,ya Suur wa Seedawa kulla mudiiriiyaat al-Filistiyiin.Tidooru minni chunu-?Tidooru tilkaffo foogi al-taar walla-?Kan tilkaffo foogi al-taar,nugumm be sur'a diddukuwa nigabbil taarku fi raasku.
Intu chiltu fudditi wa dahabiwa kanzi al-khaali dammeetuuh fi gusuurku.
Wa intu bi'tu naas Yahuuzawa Madiinat al-Khudus le l-Yuunaaniyiinachaan tiba''uduuhum min baladhum.
Wa laakin daahu ana ninaadiihummin al-bakaan al-bi'tuuhum foogahwa ana nigabbil taarku fi raasku.

Ballukhu le l-umam wa guulu-:-Khassusu deech le l-haribwa gawwumu al-furraas.Khalli kulla l-rujaal al-muhaaribiinyindammo wa yamchu.

Al-harraay wa l-gamar yidallumuwa l-nujuum yiwadduru nuurhum.
Min Sahyuun,Allah yahrijwa min Madiinat al-Khudus hissah yinsami'wa l-sama wa l-ard yarjufu.Wa laakin Allah hu malja' le cha'abahwa maskan gawi le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa be da,intu ta'arfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahkual-gaa'id fi Sahyuun jabali al-mukhaddas.Madiinat al-Khudus tabga bakaan mukhaddaswa battaan ajaanib ma yadkhulu foogha.
Fi l-yoom da,asiir al-inab yinaggit min al-jibaalwa laban yisiil min al-hujaarwa almi yajri fi kulla wudyaan Yahuuza.Wa een almi tisiil min beet Allahwa tusubb fi waadi Chittiim.
Wa Masir tabga kharaabwa Adoom tabga sahara kharaabbe sabab al-unuf al-sawwooh le Bani Yahuuzawakit daffago damm al-bari fi arduhum.
Wa laakin Yahuuza yaskunuuha ila l-abadwa Madiinat al-Khudus yaskunuuha min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Aywa,ana naj'alhum bariyiinmisil awwal ja'altuhum ma bariyiin.Wa ana Allah naskun fi Sahyuun-!
Daahu al-kalaam al-bukhuss Bani Israa'iil al-ja le Amuus fi ru'ya.Wa Amuus da waahid min ru'yaan al-khanam hana hillit Takhuu'a.Wa l-ru'ya di bigat fi ayyaam hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa fi ayyaam hukum Yaruba'aam wileed Yahu'aach malik mamlakat Israa'iil.Wa da be santeen gabul al-zilzaal.
Wa Amuus gaal-:-Min Sahyuun,Allah khidib ziyaada.Wa min Madiinat al-Khudus,hissah ansama' misil gargaraan al-duud.Wa kulla mar'a al-ru'yaan jaffawa raas jabal al-Karmal yibis.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab naas madiinat Dimachkhiso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan sawwo sukkaan Gil'aad misil ganaadiilal-daggoohum be mudgaaga hana hadiid.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi gasir al-malik Hazayiilal-taakul kulla gusuur al-malik Banhadaad.
Wa nikassir haadir baab madiinat Dimachkhwa nuguchch al-haakim min waadi Awanwa l-kaarib asaat al-muluk min Beet Adin.Wa cha'ab balad Araamyiwadduuhum fi l-khurba fi Khiir.-Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab naas madiinat Khazzaiso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan waddo kulla l-cha'ab fi l-khurbawa sallamoohum le naas balad Adoom.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi daraadir Khazzaal-taakul kulla gusuurha.
Wa nuguchch al-haakim min madiinat Achduudwa l-kaarib asaat al-muluk min Achgaluun.Wa nadrub madiinat Akhruunwa nidammir al-faddalo min al-Filistiyiin.-Wa da,Allah al-Rabb bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab naas madiinat Suuriso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan sallamo kulla l-cha'abmisil abiid le naas balad Adoomwa ma fakkaro fi l-alaakha al-akhawiiyeal-ambeenaathum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi daraadir Suural-taakul kulla gusuurha.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab naas balad Adoomiso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan macho be za'al wara akhwaanhumwa kataloohum be l-seef bala mahanna.Wa achaan za'alhum didd akhwaanhumma wagafwa karabo leehum al-adaawafi galibhum le mudda tawiile.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi mantagat Teemaanal-taakul kulla gusuur hillit Busra.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab naas Bani Ammuuniso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan fi Gil'aad chaggo butuun al-awiin al-khalbaanaatle yiwassu'u arduhum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi daraadir madiinat Rabbaal-taakul kulla gusuurhabe korooraak fi yoom al-haribwa be amzooba'aanefi yoom hana riih chadiide.
Wa malikha wa kubaaraatah yakurbuuhumwa kulluhum yiwadduuhum fi l-khurba.-Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab naas balad Muwaabiso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan harrago udaam malik Adoomlahaddi bigo rumaad.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi balad Muwaabal-taakul kulla gusuur madiinat Kharyuut.Wa kulla naas balad Muwaab yumuutufi ust al-harakawa korooraak al-haribwa hiss al-buug.
Wa ana nuguchch malik Muwaab min usuthumwa kulla kubaaraatah naktulhum ma'aayah.-Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab Bani Yahuuzaiso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan abo churuut al-Tawraatwa ma yahfado gawaaniini.Wa taaba'o al-kidib wa waddarowa da l-kidib al-abbahaathum taaba'ooh.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi balad Yahuuzaal-taakul kulla gusuur Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Be sabab Bani Israa'iiliso talaata wa arba'a marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial-kharaar al-chiltah didduhum.Achaan baa'o al-saalih be sileeyaatwa l-fagraan be ni'eelaat.
Wa yidissu ruuse al-da'iifiin fi l-turaabwa yazulmu al-masaakiin fi l-charii'a.Al-walad wa abuuh yamchu le mara waahidewa be da,ma yihtarumu usmi al-mukhaddas.
Wa yarugdu jamb ayyi madbahfi l-khulgaan al-dammanoohum leehum.Wa l-khamar al-chaalooh fi l-hukum,yacharbooh fi beeti ana Ilaahhum.
Wa ana bas al-zamaan dammart al-Amuuriyiinfi chaan Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-Amuuriyiin dooltuwaal misil chadar al-arzwa chudaad misil chadar al-balluut.Wa ana dammartuhum misil al-chadarmin furuu'ah lahaddi uruugah.
Wa ana bas al-zamaan maragtuku min balad Masirwa gudtuku muddit 40 sana fi l-saharale tagla'o balad al-Amuuriyiin.
Wa ana azalt waahidiin min iyaalkule yabgo anbiyawa waahidiin min subyaankule yikhassusuuhum leyi be nazir.Wa da sahiih walla kidib,ya Bani Israa'iil-?Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin charrabtu al-khamarle l-mukhassasiin be l-nazirwa gultu le l-anbiya-:--Ma titnabba'o-!--
Wa be da,ana narhakkumisil rahiik al-kaarroal-chaayil ma'aach tagiil.
Wa be da,al-jarraay rijlah ma tinajjiihwa l-gaadir gudurtah ma tanfa'ahwa l-fahal kula ma yinajji nafsah.
Wa siid al-nubbaal ma yagdar yasbitwa l-ajiil ma yasbugwa siid al-juwaad kula ma yinajji nafsah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-fahal min al-rujaal kula yi'arrid aryaan.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,asma'o kalaam Allahal-gaalah didduku,didduku intu al-gabaayilal-maragaaku min balad Masir-:
Ana azaltuku intu wiheedkumin usut kulla gabaayil al-ard.Wa fi chaan da,ana ni'aakhibkube sabab kulla khataayaaku.
Rujaal itneen yagdaro yamchu sawakan ma astafago walla-?
Al-duud yagdar yikirr fi l-khaabakan ma katal walla-?Wald al-duud hissah yinsami' fi nugurtahkan ma ligi akil walla-?
Al-teer yagdar yaga' fi l-charakkan ma chattato leyah akil walla-?Al-charak yagdar yamrug min al-ardkan ma karab seedtah walla-?
Kan al-buug baka fi lubb al-hille,sukkaanha ma yibarjulu walla-?Kan cheyy fasil ja fi l-hille,ma Allah bas ja'alah walla-?
Wa misil da,Allah al-Rabb ma yisawwi ayyi cheyykan ma bayyan sirrah le abiidah al-anbiya.
Al-duud kan karra,yaatu al-ma yakhaaf-?Allah al-Rabb kan kallam,yaatu al-ma yiballikh kalaamah-?
Iitu fi gusuur madiinat Achduudwa fi gusuur balad Masir wa guulu-:--Limmu fi jibaal al-Saamirawa chiifu al-barjaal al-katiir al-fi lubbahawa l-zulum al-gaa'id foogha.--
Wa da kalaam Allah.Cha'abi ma ya'arfu yisawwu al-haggwa yakhzunu fi gusuurhum kulla cheyyal-chaalo be unuf wa nahib.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Ya l-Saamira,al-adu yihaasirkiwa yidammir gudritki wa yanhab gusuurki.

Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb al-Ilaah al-Gaadir.Asma'o wa hazzuruzurriiyit Yaakhuub-!
Yoom ni'aakhib Bani Israa'iil be zunuubhum,ni'aakhib madaabih Beet Iilwa nikassir guruun al-madbahwa narmiihum fi l-turaab.
Wa nidammir buyuut al-khaniyiinal-yinjammo fooghum fi l-chite wa l-seef.Wa l-buyuut al-mujammaliin be l-aaj kula,nidammirhumwa buyuut katiiriin yabgo ma fiihum.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Asma'an,ya l-awiinal-gaa'idaat fi jibaal madiinat al-Saamira-!Intan misil bagaral-yasraho fi mar'a Baachaan.Intan tazulman al-masaakiinwa tita''iban al-fagraaniin.Wa taamuran siyaad buyuutkanwa tuguulan-:-Jiib leyi nachrab-!
Wa khalaas,Allah al-Rabb halafbe usmah al-Khudduus wa gaal-:-Yaji leekan yoom waahid al-foogahyakurbuukan misil huut be jambaatwa iyaalkan yat'anoohum be kookaab.
Wa ayyi waahide tamrug be khurmit al-durdurwa yiwadduuha ale jabal Harmuun.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa kan abeetu kalaami ana Allah,khalaas amchu Beet Iilwa a'asowa amchu Gilgaal wa ziidu isyaanku.Wa kulli sabaah,gaddumu dahaayaakuwa ayyi talaata yoom,antu uchuurku.
Wa harrugu khubza bala tawwaara hadiiyat chukurwa faachuru be l-hadaayaal-tigaddumuuhum le Allah be niiyitku.Wa da bas al-cheyy al-ya'ajibku intu,ya Bani Israa'iil.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb.
Ana jibt leeku al-juu'fi kulla mudunku wa buyuutku.Ma fi cheyy al-tidissuuh fi khuchuumkuwa be da kula,ma tubtu.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa fi wakt al-iine bas,ana mana't minku al-matar.Wa nazzalt al-matara fi hille waahidewa fi hille aakhara kamaan,ana ma nazzaltaha.Wa nazzalt al-matara fi zere' waahidwa zere' aakhar yibis.
Wa naas mudun itneen aw talaatamacho le madiina waahidele yacharbo almi.Laakin ma ligo almi al-yarwiihumwa be da kula,ma tubtu.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana nazzalt waba al-yabaaswa battaan affant nabaataatku.Wa l-jaraad akal jineenaatkuwa inabku wa tiinku wa zaytuunkuwa be da kula,ma tubtu.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa nazzalt foogku al-wabamisil ana nazzaltah fi balad Masir.Wa subyaanku maato fi l-haribwa kheelku kula anchaalo.Wa chammeetu afanat al-janaazaatfi mu'askaraatkuwa be da kula,ma tubtu.-Wa da kalaam Allah.

Wa da kulla nisawwiih foogku,ya Bani Israa'iil,wa misil da bas,nisawwiih foogku.Jahhuzu nufuusku le mugaabalati ana Ilaahku,ya Bani Israa'iil-!
Chiifu Allah basal-khalag al-jibaal wa l-riih.Hu bas al-bayyan le l-insaanal-cheyy al-hu yidoor yisawwiih.Wa hu bas al-sawwa al-nuur dalaamwa hu bas al-yahkim fi kulla l-ard.Wa hu bas usmah Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadir.
Ya Bani Israa'iil,asma'o al-kalaam al-ana nabki wa nunuuh beyah.
Bani Israa'iil al-misil bineeye udriiye,hi waga'at ma tagdar tugumm abadan.Hi anbatahat fi ardahawa yaatu al-yarfa'ha-?
Wa daahu Allah al-Rabb gaal-:-Bani Israa'iil yamurgu min al-madiina le l-haribwa laakin yakhsaro.Kan marago alif,yigabbulu miya baswa kan marago miya,yigabbulu achara bas-!
Wa daahu Allah gaal le Bani Israa'iil-:-Fattuchuuniwa talgo al-haya.
Wa laakin ma tifattuchuuni fi Beet Iilwa la tamchu fi Gilgaalwa la tiwajjuhu ale Biir Sab'a.Achaan naas Gilgaal,yiwadduuhum fi l-khurbawa Beet Iil tabga kharaab.
Fattuchu Allahwa talgo al-haya.Wa kan abeetu kamaan,tiddammaro misil akalatku naar,ya zurriiyit Yuusuf.Al-naar taakul Beet Iilwa ma fi al-yagdar yaktulha.
Wa l-hagg,sawweetuuh murr misil al-hamdalwa l-adaala,zagaltuuha fi l-turaab.
Wa Allah bas al-khalagnujuum al-Tureyyawa l-Sabi al-Makhmi.Wa hu bas al-sawwa al-dalaam fajurwa l-nahaar leel.Wa hu yitalli' almi al-buhuurwa yazgi beyah al-ardwa hu bas usmah Allah.

Intu tabkhudu al-chaahidal-yuguul al-sahiih fi l-charii'awa taj'al al-naadum al-yuguul al-sahiihmisil muharram.

Ana aalim be kulla khataayaakuwa zunuubku al-katiiriin.Tazulmu al-saalih wa tichiilu al-rachwawa tadharo al-fagri min haggah fi l-charii'a.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-aagil yaskutachaan da wakt al-diige.

Akraho al-charr wa hibbu al-kheerwa ansuru al-hagg fi l-charii'a.Wa be da,akuun Allah al-Ilaah al-Gaadiryihinn fi l-faddalo min zurriiyit Yuusuf.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al-Ilaah hu al-Rabb al-Gaadir gaal-:-Fi kulla bakaan,al-naas yunuuhuwa fi kulla l-chawaari',yabku wa yuguulu-:--Ya khasaaritna,ya khasaaritna-!--Wa yinaadu al-masaakiin le l-hizinwa l-nawwaahiin le yunuuhu.

Ana Allah nakrah wa naaba kulli iidal-ti'ayyuduuh leyi.Wa ma narda beyahkan tilimmu wa ti'ayyuduuh.
