Intu tuguulu fi nufuusku-:-Le mata yikammil al-iidhana awwal yoom fi l-chaharachaan nibii'u gamehna-?Wa mata yikammil yoom al-sabtachaan nufukku dabangaatnawa nibii'u khumaamna-?Nikiilu be mikyaal sakhayyarwa niziidu tamanahwa nukhuchchu be miizaan al-ma adiil.
Wa nachru al-miskiin be sileeyaatwa l-fagraan be ni'eelaatwa nibii'u kanfuut al-gameh.
Wa Allah halaf be l-baladal-farhaaniin beeha zurriiyit Yaakhuub wa gaal-:-Ana abadan ma nansa amalku al-cheenal-gaa'idiin tisawwuuh.
Wa be sabab da,al-balad ma tarjif walla-?Wa kulla sukkaanhama yabgo haznaaniin walla-?Al-balad tatla' kullahamisil bahar hana Masirwa tatmi wa tanzilmisil seel al-Niil.
Wa da kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:-Fi l-yoom da be duhur,al-wata tabga dalmawa be nahaar bas,al-wata tabga leel fi kulla l-balad.
Wa ayyi iid al-ti'ayyuduuh,nibaddilah be hizinwa kulla khineeku yabga nuwaah.Wa kulluku talbaso khulgaan al-hizinwa tizayyunu ruuseeku.Da yabga misil hizinhana moot al-wileed al-wahiidwa fi l-akhiir,yabga yoom hana hizin chadiid.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb-:-Yaji yoom waahid al-foogahnijiib al-juu' fi kulla l-balad.Wa da ma juu' hana akilwa la atach le l-almilaakin da juu' wa atachle kalaami ana Allah.
Wa intu ti'iiru min bahar le aakharwa min munchaakh le sabaahwa tifattuchu kalaam Allahwa laakin be da kula,ma talgooh.
Fi l-yoom da,al-banaat wa l-subyaanyumuutu min al-atach.
Naas waahidiin yahalfube sanam madiinat al-Saamira wa yuguulu-:--Yi'iich ilaahki,ya hillit Daan-!Wa yi'iich ilaahki,ya hillit Biir Sab'a-!--Wa l-naas dool yahlako marra waahidwa battaan ma yugummu.
Daahu ana Amuus chift al-Rabb waagif jamb al-madbah wa hu gaal-:-Adurbu ruuse amad beet Allahwa ga'arah yarjifwa yaga' fi raas kulla l-naaswa humman yumuutu.Wa zurriiyithum kamaanyaktuluuhum be l-seefwa naadum waahidma yi'arrid wa la yifaddil.
Wa kan dakhalo fi l-khabur kula,nimarrighumwa kan tala'o fi l-sama kula,ninazzilhum.
Wa kan allabbadofi raas jabal al-Karmal kula,nifattichhum wa nakrubhum.Wa kan tamaso fi ga'ar al-baharle yillabbado minni kula,naamur daabi al-bahar yi'addiihum.
Wa kan aduuhum yiwaddiihum abiid kula,ana naamur yaktulhum kulluhum be l-seef.Wa ana gaa'id niraakhib fooghumwa da ma le l-kheerlaakin le l-charr.
Kan Allah al-Rabb al-Gaadir yalmas al-ard,hi tarjif wa sukkaanha yahzano.Wa hi tatla' kullahamisil bahar hana Masirwa tatmi wa tanzilmisil seel al-Niil.
Hu bana beetah aali fi l-samawa khatta asaasah fi l-ard.Wa hu yitalli' almi al-buhuurwa yazgi beyah al-ard.Wa hu bas usmah Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil,intu tahsubu nufuusku muhimmiin leyiziyaada min al-Habachiyiin walla-?Ma ana bas al-maragt Bani Israa'iil min balad Masirwa l-Filistiyiin min Kaftuurwa l-Araamiyiin min Khiir walla-?
Asma'o-!Ana Allah al-Rabb niraakhib foogku,intu mamlakat al-muznibiin,wa nuguchchuku min wijh al-ard.Wa laakin be da kula,ma nuguchch zurriiyit Yaakhuub marra waahid.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu ana naamurwa nikharbil Bani Israa'iilmin ambeen kulla l-umam.Wa da misil yikharbuluuhum be tabagwa habbaay waahide kula ma taga' fi l-ard.
Wa kulla l-muznibiin min cha'abiyumuutu fi l-harib.Dool humman al-yuguulu-:--Al-masiibe di ma talhagnawa abadan ma tawsalna-!-
Wa fi l-yoom da,nabni min jadiidmadiinat Dawuud al-mukassara.Wa nikaddik nugaarhawa ni'addil daraadirhawa hi tabga misil awwal.
Wa Bani Israa'iil yichiilual-faddal min ard Adoomwa min kulla l-umamal-ana naadeethum be usmi.-Wa da kalaam Allah wa hu yihaggig kalaamah.
Wa daahu yaji yoom waahid al-foogahal-harraati yaji wara l-yagta'wa l-yagta' al-inab yaji wara l-yiteeribah.Wa l-khamar yisiil be kataramisil almi al-yanzil min al-hajar.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa nigabbil cha'abi Bani Israa'iil min al-khurbawa yabnu hillaalhum al-mukassariinwa yaskunu fooghum.Wa yazra'o jineenaathum hana l-inabwa yacharbo min khamarhum.Wa yimaggunu jineenaathumwa yaakulu fawaakihhum.
Wa nisabbithum fi arduhumwa ma yaturduuhum battaanmin arduhum al-ana anteetha leehum.-Wa da,Allah Ilaahku bas gaalah.
Ru'yat Ubadya.Daahu kalaam Allah al-Rabb didd cha'ab Adoom.Simi'na khabar jaayi min Allah,hu rassal rasuul been al-umam le yuguul-:-Yalla gummu-!Gummu haarubu balad Adoom-!
Ya cha'ab Adoom,daahu ana nisawwiiku umma sakhayrewa fi ust al-umam,yahguruuku ziyaada.
Wa istikbaarku bas khachchaaku,ya intu al-gaa'idiin fi karaakiir al-hujaar.Taskunu fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiinwa tuguulu fi nufuusku-:--Yaatu yinazzilna tihit-?--
Wa hatta kan titiiru misil al-suguurawa tabnu uchchuku been al-nujuum kula,min hinaak ana ninazzilku.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa kan saraariig aw nahhaabiin yajuuku be l-leel,humman ma yichiilu al-yakfiihum bas walla-?Wa kan gattaa'iin al-inab yaju leeku,ma yikhallu waraahum al-kichcheeb walla-?
Ya zurriiyit Isuu,udwaanku yifattuchuukuwa yakchufu kanzuku.
Kulla l-rujaal al-induku ma'aahum alaakhayaturduuku khaadi le huduudku.Wa l-rujaal al-induku ma'aahum salaamyukhuchchuuku wa yahkumu foogku.Wa rufgaanku al-akalo akilkuyukujju leeku charak tihit rijleeku.Wa yuguulu-:--Humman dool ma induhum agul-!--
Fi l-yoom da bas,ana nidammir kulla l-ulama al-fi Adoomwa l-faahimiin al-fi jibaal zurriiyit Isuu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya hillit Teemaan,furraaski yinbahtuwa be da,al-adu yaktul ayyi naadumal-gaa'id fi jibaal zurriiyit Isuu.
Wa be sabab al-unuf al-sawweetuuhle akhwaanku zurriiyit Yaakhuub,al-eeb yikhattiikuwa tiddammaro ila l-abad.
Achaan fi yoom diigithum,intu wagaftu ba'iidwakit al-ajaanib nahabo khunaahumwa l-udwaan dakhalo biibaan al-madiinawa sawwo am'iyeedaat le yilgaasamo Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa fi l-yoom da,intu kula bigiitu waahidiin min udwaanhum.
Ma waajib tafrahofi yoom damaar akhwaanku,fi yoom masiibithum.Wa ma waajib tafrahobe sabab Bani Yahuuzafi yoom addammaro.Wa ma waajib tatulgu lisaankufi yoom diigithum.
Wa ma waajib tadkhulu madiinat cha'abifi yoom kharaabhumwa la tafraho be fasaalithumfi yoom kharaabhumwa la tanhabo khunaahumfi yoom kharaabhum.
Wa ma waajib tagoodufi machbak al-duruuble taktulu al-mu'arridiin minhumwa tisallumu al-faddalo hayyiinfi yoom diigithum.
Achaan al-yoom al-Allah yihaakim foogah kulla l-umamjaayi gariib.Misil sawweet,yisawwu foogak.Wa amalak al-sawweetah,yigabbil leek fi raasak.
Ya Bani Yahuuza,misil chiribtu min kaas khadabifi jabali al-mukhaddas,kulla l-umam yacharbo minnah daayman.Humman yarwo min kaas khadabimisil al-sakkaara yarwo min al-mariisewa yabgo misil abadan ma khalagoohum.
Wa laakin cha'ab Allah al-faddaloyalja'o fi jabal Sahyuunwa l-bakaan da battaan yabga mukhaddas.Wa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yagla'o arduhummin al-naas al-gala'ooha minhum.
Wa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yabgo misil naarwa zurriiyit Yuusuf yabgo misil ambalbaala.Wa laakin zurriiyit Isuu yabgo misil gechchwa l-naar tutuchchuhum wa tahrighum.Wa naadum waahid kula min zurriiyit Isuuma yifaddil hayyachaan da kalaam Allahal-hu gaalah.
Wa fi l-junuub,Bani Yahuuza yagla'o jibaal zurriiyit Isuu wa fi sahalat Chafiila,yagla'o balad al-Filistiyiin.Wa yagla'o turaab gabiilat Afraayim wa turaab madiinat al-Saamira.Wa naas gabiilat Banyaamiin yagla'o Gil'aad.
Wa Bani Israa'iil al-gabbalo min al-khurba yagla'o balad Kan'aan lahaddi Sarafa.Wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-gabbalo min al-khurba fi Safaarad yagla'o mudun al-junuub.
Wa l-munajjiyiin yatla'o jabal Sahyuun wa yahkumu jibaal zurriiyit Isuu.Wa l-muluk yukuun le Allah-!
Yoom waahid,Allah hajja le Yuunus wileed Amittaay wa gaal-:
Gumm amchi fi Niinawa,al-madiina al-kabiire di.Wa khabbir naas al-madiina kadar al-fasaala al-humman gaa'idiin yisawwuuha di,ana chiftaha.Khalli yingar'u-!
Khalaas,Yuunus gamma arrad wa aba ma yichiil derib hana Niinawa laakin chaal derib hana hillit Tarchiich achaan yidoor yajri min Allah.Wa wisil fi hillit Yaafa fi khachum al-bahar al-Abyad al-Mutawassit wa ligi safiina maache Tarchiich.Khalaas kaffa ujurtah wa rikib ma'a khaddaamiin al-safiina le yamchi Tarchiich,ba'iid min Allah.
Wa wakit maachiin fi l-bahar da,Allah rassal riih chadiide wa challaal chadiid gamma lahaddi yidoor yikassir al-safiina.
Wa khaddaamiin al-safiina khaafo bilheen wa ayyi waahid minhum gamma yasrakh le ilaahah achaan yinajjiihum.Wa daffago al-khumaam al-fi l-safiina fi l-bahar achaan tabga khafiife.Wa Yuunus kamaan dalla tihit fi lubb al-safiina ragad wa naayim noom chadiid.
Wa mas'uul al-safiina ja gaal leyah-:-Haay da-!Maalak naayim-?Gumm as'al ilaahak-!Akuun yifakkir foogna wa yinajjiina min al-moot.
Wa khaddaamiin al-safiina gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Ta'aalu nisawwu am'iyeedaat achaan na'arfu yaatu al-jaab leena al-masiibe di. Khalaas sawwo am'iyeedaat wa waga' fi Yuunus.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,humman gaalo leyah-:-Ooriina chunu al-jaab leena al-masiibe di.Inta jaayi min ween-?Wa jiit tisawwi chunu-?Wa baladak ween wa nafarak chunu-?
Wa Yuunus radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ana Ibraani wa na'abud Allah Rabb al-samaawaat,al-khalag al-ard wa l-bahar.
Wa ana mu'arrid min Allah. Wa wakit humman sim'o kalaamah da,khaafo khoof chadiid.Wa gaalo leyah-:-Maala sawweet cheyy misil da-?
Wa l-challaal gaa'id yatla' be ziyaada.Wa gaalo leyah-:-Hassa' da,nisawwu leek chunu achaan al-challaal yagiif leena-?
Wa Yuunus gaal leehum-:-Chiiluuni wa azguluuni fi l-bahar wa l-challaal yagiif leeku.Achaan ana na'arif kadar al-riih al-chadiide di jaat fi chaani ana bas.
Wa laakin khaddaamiin al-safiina haawalo yigabbulu al-safiina fi khachum al-bahar.Wa ma gidro achaan al-challaal gaa'id yatla' be ziyaada.
Wa gammo yachhado Allah wa gaalo-:-Ya Allah-!Ma tahlikna fi chaan al-raajil da wa ma tukhutt foogna dimmit bari.Ya Allah-!Inta sawweet al-cheyy al-tidoorah.
Khalaas,chaalo Yuunus wa zagalooh fi l-bahar wa tawwaali al-challaal wagaf.
Wa l-khaddaamiin khaafo khoof chadiid min Allah wa gaddamo leyah dahiiye wa aahado Allah achaan ya'abuduuh be ziyaada.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Allah rassal huutaay kabiire zaratat Yuunus.Wa khalaas,Yuunus ga'ad fi batun al-huutaay talaata yoom wa talaata leele.
Wa fi batun al-huutaay,Yuunus gamma yisalli le Allah Ilaahah.
Wa gaal-:-Ya Allah-!Fi ta'abi,ana bakeet leekwa inta najjeetni.Wa fi l-moot,ana sarakht leekwa inta simi't hissi.
Wakit inta zagaltinifi lubb al-bahar,fi l-almi al-khariig,al-challaal tammasaaniwa l-mooj zarataani.
Wa ana hasabt nafsi matruudba'iid minnak,ya Rabb,wa laakin battaan namchinichiif beetak al-mukhaddas.
Wa l-bahar zarataaniwa almi al-khariig akalaaniwa l-gechch lawlaw leyi fi raasi.
Wa ana nazalt fi ga'ar al-hajar,ansajant fi l-sijinal-baabah ansadda foogi ila l-abad.Laakin,ya Allah Ilaahi,inta maragtini min almi al-khariigwa najjeet hayaati min al-moot.
Wa wakit ruuhi tidoor tamrug,ana alfakkartak,inta Allah.Wa salaati al-wajjahtaha leekwislat leek fi beetak al-mukhaddas.
Wa laakin al-naas al-ya'abudu al-asnaamma yalgo rahma minnak.
Wa kan leyi ana,nachkurakwa nigaddim leek dahiiyewa nitimm nazri al-aahadtak beyah.Ya Allah-!Inta bas al-tinajji al-naas.
Wa khalaas,Allah amar al-huutaay achaan tigaddif Yuunus wa hi gaddafatah fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa Allah hajja le Yuunus taani marra wa gaal-:
Gumm amchi fi Niinawa,al-madiina al-kabiire.Wa khabbir naasha be l-kalaam al-nuguulah leek.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,khalaas Yuunus gamma macha Niinawa misil Allah amarah beyah.Wa Niinawa hi madiina kabiire bilheen wa naadum ma yagdar yuchuggaha illa fi talaata yoom.
Wa Yuunus wassal fi Niinawa wa indah yoom tamaam raayikh wa yuguul-:-Ba'ad arba'iin yoom,Niinawa tiddammar-!
Wa khalaas,naas Niinawa aamano be kalaam al-Rabb al-gaalah leehum Yuunus.Wa kharraro ayyaam hana siyaam wa libso khulgaan al-tooba min al-khani lahaddi l-fagri.
Wa l-malik,min simi' al-khabar da,tawwaali gamma min kursi haggah wa salla khalagah hana l-muluuk wa libis khalag al-tooba wa ga'ad fi l-rumaad.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-malik marag kharaar fi Niinawa al-buguul-:-Be izni ana al-malik wa wuzaraayi,mamnuu' le l-naas wa l-bahaayim kan bagar walla khanam kula ma yaakulu wa la yasraho wa la yacharbo cheyy.
Wa waajib al-naas yalbaso khulgaan al-tooba wa yilabbusu al-bahaayim kula.Wa ayyi waahid yachhad al-Rabb be chidde wa yikhalli minnah amalah al-fasil wa l-unuf al-gaa'id yisawwiih.
Wa be da,akuun al-Rabb yikhalli khadabah wa yarfa'ah minnina wa khalaas,ma numuutu.
Wa l-Rabb chaaf naas Niinawa gammo yisawwu misil ke wa khallo minhum amalhum al-fasil.Wa khalaas,hu kula khalla khadabah al-awwal kharrar yinazzilah fooghum.
Wa wakit Yuunus irif kadar Allah khalla khadabah da,zi'il za'al chadiid.
Wa salla le Allah wa gaal-:-Ajab,ya Allah.Da ma al-cheyy al-ana gultah wakit ana lissaa'ni fi baladi walla-?Achaan da bas ana arradt le namchi Tarchiich.Ya Allah,na'arif kadar inta al-Rahmaan al-Rahiim wa l-Sabuur wa l-Muhibb ziyaada wa tikhalli al-khadab al-awwal kharrart tinazzilah fi l-naas.
Ya Allah,hassa' da khalaas.Chiil ruuhi.Al-moot akheer leyi min al-haya.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:-Inta da-!Indak hagg taz'al walla-?
Wa Yuunus marag min Niinawa wa macha ga'ad sabaah min al-madiina.Wa sawwa leyah ligdaabe wa ga'ad foogha fi l-dull achaan yichiif al-cheyy al-yabga fi l-madiina di.
Wa Allah al-Rabb gawwam chideere achaan tisawwi dull le Yuunus wa tifarrihah min za'alah.Wa khalaas,Yuunus firih farha chadiide be l-chideere di.
Wa laakin ambaakir be fajur badri,al-Rabb rassal duudaay akalat al-chideere di wa hi yibsat.
Wa wakit al-harraay tala'at,al-Rabb rassal riih haamiye min al-sabaah.Wa l-harraay taggat Yuunus fi raasah lahaddi yidoor yakhmar.Wa dawwar yumuut wa gaal-:-Al-moot akheer leyi min al-haya.
Wa l-Rabb gaal le Yuunus-:-Inta indak hagg taz'al fi chaan al-chideere di walla-? Wa Yuunus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa,indi hagg naz'al lahaddi nidoor al-moot.
Wa laakin Allah gaal leyah-:-Asma'.Inta hanneet fi l-chideere al-ma maggantaha wa la ti'ibt foogha.Hi gammat fi yoom waahid wa maatat fi l-yoom al-taani.
Chiif naas hana Niinawa,al-madiina al-kabiire,al-indaha ziyaada min 120-000 naas al-ma ya'arfu zeen wa la fasil.Wa indaha bahaayim katiiriin kula.Kikkeef ana ma nihinn fooghum-?
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-gaalah fi ru'ya le Miikha al-min hillit Muurachat al-bukhuss mudun al-Saamira wa Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa da fi ayyaam hukum Yuutaam wa Ahaaz wa Hizkhiiya muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza.
Asma'o,ya kulla l-chu'uub-!Asma'e,ya l-ardwa kulla cheyy al-foogki.Allah al-Rabb yachhad didduku.Aywa,al-Rabb yuluumku min beetah al-mukhaddas.
Daahu Allah maarig min bakaanahwa yanzil wa yamchifi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin hana l-ard.
Wa l-jibaal yumuu'u tihtahwa hujaar khuchuum al-wudyaan yingat'umisil al-cham'e fi l-naarwa misil almi al-sabbooh fi dilleeye.
Wa da kulla fi chaan isyaan zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa fi chaan zunuub Bani Israa'iil.Wa yaatu al-lazza zurriiyit Yaakhuubfi l-isyaan-?Di ma madiinat al-Saamira walla-?Wa yaatu al-harrach Bani Yahuuzale ya'abudu ilaahaat fi l-bakaanaat al-aaliyiin-?Di ma Madiinat al-Khudus walla-?
Wa Allah gaal-:-Al-Saamira nisawwiiha koom hana turaabwa kadaade al-yazra'o foogha jineenaat al-inab.Wa l-hujaar al-banooha beehum,nidaffighum fi l-waadiwa asaasha,nikhalliih yibiin.
Wa kulla asnaamha yilkassarowa kulla maal beethum,niharrigah be naar.Wa nikharrib kulla asnaamhaachaan hi sana'athumbe maal ujrat charmatatha.Wa hassa' be hadiid al-asnaam doolyi'ajjuru charaamiit aakharaat.
Wa fi chaan da,ana Miikha nahzanwa nabki be hizinwa namchi bala ni'le wa aryaan.Wa nabki misil al-ba'achoomwa nikirr misil al-na'aam.
Marad al-Saamira ma indah ilaajwa hu lihig lahaddi balad Yahuuza.Wa lihig biibaan madiinat cha'abiaywa,lihig usut Madiinat al-Khudus.
Ma tikhabburu udwaanna fi Gaatwa ma tabku giddaamhum.Wa fi Beet Afrah,almarmakho fi l-ajaaj min al-hizin.
Wa sukkaan Chaafiir,yiwadduuhum fi l-khurbafi l-eeb wa l-ire.Wa sukkaan Sanaan yakhaafo,ma yamurgu min hillithum.Naas Beet Isaal yabku min al-hizinwa ma yafza'ooku.
Wa sukkaan Maruut yakhaafo min kheerhum yiwaddirachaan al-charr nazal min Allahwa wassal biibaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Ya sukkaan Lakiich,arbutu arabaat al-haribfi l-kheelachaan intu lazzeetu fi l-zanibSahyuun al-misil bineeyewa fiiku anlaga isyaan Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi chaan da,waajib intu tinfargumin Muurachat Gaat.Wa hillit Akziib takdib,ma tijiib faza' le muluuk Israa'iil.
Ya sukkaan Mariicha,nijiib leeku battaan naadum yichiil baladku.Wa kubaaraat Bani Israa'iil al-induhum charafyi'arrudu wa yillabbado fi Adullaam.
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus al-misil mara,agta'e cha'arki wa zayyini raaskiachaan iyaalki al-tihibbiihum.Abge muwalli'e misil al-sagurachaan yiwaddu iyaalki fi l-khurba ba'iid minki.
Al-azaab le l-yanwu al-fasaalawa yikhattutu al-charr be l-leel-!Be fajur,yugummu yisawwu khittithumachaan induhum al-gudra le yisawwuuha.
Humman yatma'o fi ziraa'at al-aakhariinwa yagla'oohumwa yitmanno al-buyuut wa yichiiluuhum.Yazulmu al-naas wa aayilaathumwa rujaal wa warasathum.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Chiifu,ana nanwi al-fasaala le gabiilitku diwa intu ma tagdaro tinajju nufuusku.Ma tagdaro turuukhu raasku marfuu'achaan da wakt al-fasaala.
Wa fi l-yoom da,yadurbu foogku masalwa yunuuhu nuwaah wa yuguulu-:-Kammaloona wa kharaboona-!Allah baddal ard warasatna be balad al-khurba.Wa gala' minnina ardinawa gassam warasatna le udwaanna.
Wa fi chaan da,kan jamaa'at Allahyigaawusu al-ard battaan,ma fi naadum minku al-yalga gisim.
Wa naas waahidiin gaalo leyi-:-Ma titnabba' misil da-!Ma tuguul kadar nalgo al-eeb.La-!Waddiriin al-charaf ma yabga.
Ya zurriiyit Yaakhuub,da bingaal walla-?Hal sabur Allah kammal walla-?Wa misil da bas,hu yugumm walla-?Wa kalaami ma yijiib al-kheerle l-naadum al-yamchi adiil walla-?
Lahaddi hassa',intu cha'abi bigiitu udwaan Allah.Al-naas al-yigabbulu min al-haribwa yahsubu induhum amaan,intu tisillu khulgaanhum.
Wa le awiin cha'abi,taturduuhinayyi waahide min beetha al-tiriidah.Wa ayyi wakit,tagla'o min iyaalhinal-charaf al-Allah antaahum.
Yalla gummu amchu-!Al-balad di battaanma indaha leeku raahaachaan be najaasitku,jibtu foogha al-damaarwa da damaar kaamil marra waahid-!
Wa kan naadum yajri wara l-riihwa yitnabba' be kidib wa yuguul-:-Ana nitnabba' leeku be khamar wa mariise-,da bas al-nabi al-waajib leeku intu al-cha'ab da-!
Wa Allah gaal-:-Akiid ana nilimmuku kulluku,ya zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa najma'ku kulluku al-faddaltumin Bani Israa'iil.Wa nijiibku sawa misil khanam fi l-zariibewa misil door fi ust al-mar'a.Wa tabgo majmuu'a kabiireal-indaha haraka.
Wa l-yufukk leeku al-khurmayamchi giddaamku.Intu tufukku al-khurmawa tufuutu be l-baabwa tamurgu beyah.Wa malikku yamchi giddaamku.Aywa,ana Allah ale raasku.
Wa ana Miikha gult-:-Asma'o,ya kubaaraat zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa hukkaam Bani Israa'iil.Ma intu basal-waajib ta'arfu al-adaala walla-?
Wa laakin intu takraho al-kheerwa tihibbu al-charr.Taslakho farwit al-naas min jisimhumwa tagta'o lahamhumwa tikhallu illa udaamhum.
Intu taakulu laham cha'abiwa taslakho farwithumwa tikassuru udaamhum.Wa tigattu'u laham cha'abimisil tusubbuuh fi burmawa tirakkubuuh fi kalool.
Wa khalaas,al-zaalimiin dool yas'alo Allahwa laakin hu ma yurudd leehum.Fi l-wakit da,hu ma yiwajjih aleehumachaan humman sawwo amal fasil.
Wa daahu Allah gaal kalaam didd al-anbiya al-yiwadduru cha'abah-:-Kan sunuunhum ligo chokhol yaakuluuh,humman yuguulu-:--Salaam,Salaam-!--Wa laakin kan naadum ma dassa leehum cheyy fi khachumhum,yinaadu diddah be l-harib-!
Wa fi chaan da,intu al-anbiya,yabga leeku leel bala ru'ya.Wa yabga leeku dalaam,ma tagdaro tichawwufu.Wa l-harraay taga' leeku,ya l-anbiya,wa l-yoom yidallim leeku.
Aywa,al-yichiifu ru'ya yalgo al-eebwa l-chawwaafiin yalgo al-chamaate.Wa humman yikhattu wujuuhhumachaan al-Rabb ma radda leehum.
Wa laakin ana malaan be gudraachaan Ruuh Allah nazal foogi.Wa indi al-adaala wa l-fahaaliiyele nikhabbir zurriiyit Yaakhuub be isyaanhumwa Bani Israa'iil be zanibhum.
Asma'o al-kalaam da,ya kubaaraat zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa ya hukkaam Bani Israa'iil.Intu tiharrumu al-adaalawa ti'awwuju ayyi cheyy al-adiil.
Baneetu Sahyuun be dammwa Madiinat al-Khudus be zulum.
Wa l-gudiya yagta'o charii'a be l-rachwawa rujaal al-diin yi'allumu kalaam Allah le yalgo faaydewa l-anbiya yitnabba'o le yalgo fudda.Humman yitwakkalo ale Allah wa yuguulu-:-Allah ma gaa'id fi usutna walla-?Al-fasaala abadan ma talhagna-!
Wa fi chaan da,be sababku intu,Sahyuun yahartuuha misil zere'wa Madiinat al-Khudus tabga koom hana turaabwa raas jabal beet Allah yabga khaaba.
Wa fi aakhir al-wakit,jabal beet Allah yasbit fi ruuse al-jibaalwa yabga aali min kulla l-hujaar.Wa l-chu'uub yaju leyah be kataramisil almi al-jaari.
Wa umam katiiriin yaju wa yuguulu-:-Ta'aalu natla'o fi jabal Allah,fi beet Ilaah Yaakhuub.Hu yi'allimna derbahwa aniina namchu foogah.-Achaan min Sahyuunyamurgu churuut al-Tawraatwa min Madiinat al-Khudusyamrug kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah yabga gaadibeen chu'uub katiiriinwa yihaakim umam gawiyiinhatta kan ba'iidiin kula.Humman yuduggu suyuufhum jaraariwa yuduggu huraabhum khanaajir.Wa umma ma tarfa' suyuufha le ummawa ma fi tadriib le l-harib battaan.
Wa ayyi naadum yagoodfi jineentah hana l-inabwa tihit chadaratah hana l-tiin.Wa ma fi naadum yibachtinahachaan Allah al-Gaadir bas kharrarah.
Kulla l-chu'uub doolyitaabu'u ilaahaathum.Wa aniina kamaannitaabu'u Allah Ilaahnadaayman wa ila l-abad.
Daahu kalaam Allah-:-Fi l-yoom da,nilimm al-ma'duuriinwa najma' al-muchattatiinwa nilimm al-ana aakhabtuhum.
Wa min al-ma'duuriin,nisawwi waahidiin yifadduluwa min al-muchattatiin,nisawwi umma gawiiye.Wa fi jabal Sahyuun,ana Allah nabga malikhummin hassa' wa ila l-abad.
Ya jabal Sahyuun al-misil bineeye,inta tiraakhib cha'abak min foogmisil gasir al-hurraas hana l-khanam.Sultitak al-awwal tigabbil leekwa battaan Madiinat al-Khudus al-misil bineeyetabga aasimat mamlaka.
Hassa',maala ti'awwi-?Achaan ma fi malik foogki walla-?Wa maala al-waja' karabkimisil al-mara al-gaa'ide titaalig-?Achaan mustachaarki waddar walla-?
Attanne min al-waja',ya Sahyuun al-misil bineeye.Aywa,attanne misil al-maraal-gaa'ide titaalig.Achaan hassa',inti tamurgi min al-madiinawa tamchi taskuni fi l-kadaadewa tisaafiri lahaddi Baabil.Wa hinaak inti tanje,hinaak Allah yafdaaki min iid udwaanki.
Wa hassa',askar hana umam katiiriinlammo wa gammo diddiki.Humman buguulu-:-Khalli tagood fi l-najaasa.Wa khalli uyuunna yichiifu damaar Sahyuun-!
Al-naas dool ma ya'arfu fikir Allahwa la yafhamo niiytah.Wa hu lammaahum sawamisil rubta hana ganaadiil fi l-madagg.
Gummi duggi al-ganaadiil,ya Sahyuun al-misil bineeye.Nisawwiiki misil toor al-guruunah hana hadiidwa dalaafeeyah hana nahaas.Wa be da,inti tarhake chu'uub katiiriinwa tikhassisi khaniimithum leyi ana Allahwa khunaahum leyi ana siid al-ard.
Wa hassa' da,ya sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus,jarruhu nufuusku min al-hizin.Haasaro madiinitkuwa be l-isay darabo wijih haakim Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Inti,ya Beet Laham Afraata,inti sakhayre le tinhasbiambeen aayilaat Yahuuza.Wa laakin naadum waahid yamrug minkial-yahkim be usmi fi Bani Israa'iil.Wa ga'arah jaayi min ba'iidmin al-zaman al-gadiim.
Wa Allah yikhalli cha'abahle wakit chiyyalahaddi l-mara al-khalbaanetalda wileedha.Wa akhwaanna al-faddalo fi l-khurbayigabbulu min hinaakwa yilimmu ma'a Bani Israa'iil.
Wa hu yugummwa yuguudhum misil raa'ibe gudrat Allahwa be azamat usum Allah Ilaahah.Wa cha'abah yaskunu be amaanachaan gudurtah tilwassa'lahaddi aakhir al-ard.
Wa hu zaatah yijiib al-salaam.Wakit askar balad Achuur yahjumu baladnawa yadkhulu fi gusuurna,aniina nigawwumu didduhumsab'a kubaaraatwa tamaane chuyuukh cha'ab.
Wa humman yahkumu balad Achuur be l-seefwa balad Nimruud be l-huraab.Wa l-haakim al-Allah yirassilahyinajjiina min iid al-Achuuriyiinwakit yahjumu baladnawa yadkhulu ardina.
Wa l-faddalo min zurriiyit Yaakhuubyukuunu fi usut chu'uub katiiriin.Yabgo misil matara al-jaaye min Allahwa misil karany fi l-gechch.Ma yarjo cheyy min naadumwa la yukhuttu achamhum fi insaan.
Wa l-faddalo min zurriiyit Yaakhuubyukuunu been al-umamfi usut chu'uub katiiriin.Yabgo misil duudambeen haywaanaat al-khaabawa misil farkh al-duudambeen door al-khanam.Wa fi ayyi bakaan al-yamchi,yaktul wa yicharritwa ma fi naadum al-yikhallis minnah.
Ya l-faddalo min zurriiyit Yaakhuub,arfa'o iideeku didd khusmaankuwa dammuru kulla udwaanku.
Daahu kalaam Allah-:-Fi l-yoom da,nidammir kheelku min usutkuwa nikassir arabaatku hana l-harib.
Wa nidammir mudun baladkuwa nihaddim kulla bakaanaatku al-gawiyiin.
Wa nidammir sihirku al-fi iidkuwa ma yukuun fi usutku al-yihajji be ilim al-kheeb.
Wa nidammir min usutku asnaamkuwa l-hujaar al-khazzeetuuhum le l-ibaadawa abadan ma tasjudu le cheyy al-sawweetuuh be iidku.
Wa nimallit min usutku al-iidaanal-khazzeetuuhum le ibaadat Achiirawa nidammir mudunku.
Wa be khadab wa za'al,nichiil al-taar fi l-umamal-abo ma yasma'ooni.
Asma'o al-kalaam al-yuguulah leyi Allah-:-Gumm sawwi charii'a giddaam al-hujaarwa khalli al-jibaal yasma'o hissak.
Ya l-jibaal-!Asma'o chakwat Allah-!Intu ya asaas al-ard al-gawi,khuttu baalku-!Allah yijiib cha'abah fi l-charii'awa yuluum Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Ana sawweet leeku chunu,ya cha'abi-?Wa kikkeef ana ayyeetku-?Ruddu leyi-!
Wa da achaan ana maragtukumin balad Masir walla-?Achaan fadeetkumin al-ubuudiiye walla-?Achaan rassalt Muusa wa Haaruun wa Mariyamle yuguuduuku walla-?
Ya cha'abi-!Azzakkaro mu'aamarat Balaakh malik Muwaab diddukuwa kikkeef Bal'aam wileed Ba'uurradda leyahwa gaal nisawwi leeku illa l-kheer.Azzakkaro kikkeef gammeetumin Chittiim sabaah bahar al-Urdunwa wassaltu fi arduku fi Gilgaal.Wa be da,ta'arfu adaalit Allah.
Be chunu nigarrib le Allah-?Be chunu nigarrib le l-Ilaah al-Aali-?Hal nigarrib leyah be ajjaal awlaad sanaal-nigaddimhum dahaaya muharragiin walla-?
Hal Allah yakhbal dahaayahana aalaaf al-kubchaan-?Walla yakhbal hadaayahana dihin katiir misil almi al-waadi-?Hal nigaddim wileedi al-bikirfi chaan isyaani-?Walla nigaddim wileed sulbifi chaan zanbi-?
Ya Bani Adam,Allah khabbarakbe l-cheyy al-adiilwa be l-cheyy al-hu yidoorah minnak.Sawwi al-adaala wa hibb al-kheerwa maskin nafsakwa amchi adiil giddaam Ilaahak.
Daahu Allah gaa'id yinaadi sukkaan al-madiinawa yinajji al-yakhaafo minnah-:-Asma'o,ya naas gabiilat Yahuuzaal-lammiin fi l-madiina.
Fi maal hawaan gaa'id fi beet al-aasi.Naas yista'malo mikyaal makhchuuch al-yikhaddibni.Hal nikhassid be l-haraam da walla-?
Hal nibarri siid al-miizaan al-ma adiil-?Walla nibarri al-naadum al-yikiilbe kooro hana khachch-?
Fi l-madiina,fiyah naas khaniyiinmalaaniin be l-unuf.Wa sukkaanha yihajju be l-kidibwa lisaanhum yikallim be l-khachch.
Wa fi chaan da,ana darabtuku be maradwa kharrabtuku be sabab zunuubku.
Intu taakulu wa ma tachba'owa l-juu' yaskun fi butuunku.Intu takhzunuwa ma tagdaro tahfadooh adiil.Wa l-hafadtuuh kula,ana nisallimah le l-harib.
Intu tazra'owa ma tagta'o.Wa tarhako al-zaytuunwa ma tilmassaho be dihnah.Wa tarhako al-inabwa ma tacharbo min khamarah.
Wa intu titaabu'u al-aade al-fasle hana l-malik Umriwa l-amal al-hawaan hana aayilat malik Akhaabwa turuukhu hasab khittithum.Wa fi chaan da,ana nisallim madiinitku le l-kharaabwa sukkaanha yabgo chimmeetewa yi'ayyubuuku misil yi'ayyubu kulla cha'abi.
Ya khasaarti-!Ana bigiit misil naadumal-yagta' al-kichcheebwa l-yilaggit al-fadle hana l-inab.Wa daahu ma faddal anguud naakulahwa la tiin al-niriidah.
Wa ma fi battaan raajil waahid saalih fi l-baladwa la raajil adiil been al-naas.Humman kulluhum yakursu le yidaffugu al-dammwa ayyi waahid yukujj charak le akhuuh.
Wa iideehum nachiitiinle yisawwu al-fasaala.Al-mas'uul yatlub hadiiyewa l-gaadi yichiil al-rachwa.Wa l-gaadir yuguul ayyi cheyy al-hu yidoorahwa kulluhum mul'aamiriin sawa.
Hatta al-adiil minhum kulamisil al-haskaniitwa l-saalih minhummisil zariibit al-chook.Wa da l-yoom al-khabbarooku beyahmuraakhibiinku al-anbiya.Aywa,ikhaabku jawa da yoom hana barjaal.
Ma tisaddugu gariibiinkuwa la ti'aamunu rufgaanku.Wa giddaam awiinku al-yarugdan fi hudunku,angar'u,fakkuru fi lisaanku.
Achaan al-wileed yahgir abuuhwa l-bineeye tugumm didd ammahawa marit al-wileed tugumm didd nasiibitha.Ayyi naadum,naas beetah al-halaalahyabgo leyah adu.
Wa laakin ana kamaan niwajjih le Allahwa narja al-Ilaah al-yinajjiiniwa hu Ilaahi al-yasma'ni.
Ma tichchammat leyi,ya aduuyi.Kan ana waga't kula,nugumm.Wa kan ana gaa'id fi l-dalaam kula,Allah hu nuuri.
Waajib nahmal khadab Allahachaan ana aznabt diddahlahaddi l-wakit al-hu yidaafi' leyi fi charii'tiwa yisabbit huguugi.Wa hu yamrugni fi l-nuurwa ana nichiif adaaltah.
Wa udwaani yichiifu najaatiwa l-eeb yikhattiihumachaan humman gaalo leyi-:-Ween Allah Ilaahak-?-Wa fi chaan da,nichiifhum be uyuuniwa yaga'o wa yifajjukhuuhummisil tiine fi l-chaari'.
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus,yaji yoom al-yabnu foogah daraadirkiwa fi l-yoom da,yiwassu'u huduudki.
Wa fi l-yoom da,yaju leeki naasmin Achuur fi l-sabaahwa min Masir fi l-junuubwa min khachum al-Niil wa bahar al-Furaatwa min khuchuum al-buhuur wa mantagat al-jibaal.
Wa l-ard tabga kharaab be sabab sukkaanhawa da be sabab natiijat amalhum al-fasil.
Ya Rabb,guud cha'abak al-misil warasatakmisil raa'i yuguud khanamah be duglah.Humman gaa'idiin wiheedhumfi l-khaaba muhawwaga be jineenaat inab.Khalliihum yasraho misil zamaan fi mar'a Baachaanwa fi bakaan hana sarha fi Gil'aad.
Misil ayyaam al-intu maragtu min balad Masir,ana battaan niwassifku ajaayib.
Wa wakit al-umam yichiifu al-cheyy da,hatta kan induhum gudra kula,al-eeb yikhattiihum.Humman yukhuttu iideehum fi khuchuumhumwa udneehum ma yasma'o battaan.
Humman yalhaso al-ajaaj misil al-dabiibwa misil kulla zawaahif al-ard.Yarjufu wakit yamurgu min malja'humwa yaju leek inta Allah Ilaahna.Yibarjulu wa yakhaafo minnak.
Yaatu ilaah mislak inta,ya Allah-?Inta al-takhfir al-khatawa tahmal isyaan al-naas al-faddalomin cha'abak al-misil warasatak.Khadabak ma yagood daaymanachaan inta tihibb al-kheer.
Wa battaan tarhamnawa tamha khataayaana.Inta tarmi kulla zunuubnafi l-bahar al-khariig.
Wa tiwassif amaanak le zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa kheerak le iyaal Ibraahiimmisil inta zamaan halaft beyah le abbahaatna.
Daahu kitaab ru'yat Naahuum al-min hillit Alikhuuch.Wa di muhaakamat madiinat Niinawa.
Allah hu khayyuur.Aywa,ma yidoor ya'abudu ilaah aakhar balaayahwa yichiil al-taar.Aywa,Allah hu al-yichiil al-taarwa siid al-khadab al-chadiid.Hu yichiil al-taar fi khusmaanahwa yakhdab le udwaanah.
Allah hu al-Sabuurwa l-Aziim wa l-Gaadir.Wa laakin le l-muznib,ma yaj'alah bari.Wa yisawwi derbah fi riih amzooba'aanewa l-sahaab da ajaajah al-hu yigawwimah.
Hu yugumm didd al-bahar wa yijaffifahwa almi al-wudyaan kula yikammilah.Wa maraa'i Baachaan wa jabal al-Karmal yaybasowa l-zuhuur fi jibaal Lubnaan yidaffugu.
Al-jibaal yarjufu giddaamahwa l-hujaar yumuu'u.Wa giddaamah,al-ard tizzalzalwa kulla sukkaanha yifatfutu.
Wa yaatu yagdar yahmal za'alah-?Wa min chiddit khadabah,yaatu yagdar yagiif giddaamah-?Khadabah yinsabba misil al-naarhatta al-jibaal yichchaggago giddaamah.
Allah hu al-Rahiimwa hu al-malja' fi yoom al-diigewa yahfad al-naas al-yalja'o leyah.
Misil seel,yijiib damaar kaamil fi bakaan udwaanahwa yitaaridhum lahaddi fi dalaam al-khubuur.
Ya sukkaan Niinawa,maala chiltu niiye fasle didd Allah-?Hu yijiib foogku damaar kaamilal-battaan ma yitanni be diige aakhara.
Intu misil al-chook al-chaabikwa misil al-sakkaara al-sikro.Al-naar taakulhum be l-kaamilmisil al-gechch al-yaabis.
Wa minku intu bas marag naadumal-khattat al-fasaala didd Allahwa mustachaar al-ma naafi'.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Ya cha'ab balad Yahuuza,kan udwaanku lammo wa kitro kula,yangusu wa yikammulu.Wa kan awwal ana daayagtuku kulabattaan ma nidaayigku.
Wa hassa' namrugku min iid udwaanku al-gawiiyewa nigatti' guyuudku.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah didduku,ya sukkaan Niinawa-:-Abadan ma talgo zurriiyetichiil usumku.Wa fi buyuutku hana l-ibaada,ana nikassir asnaamkuhana l-hatab wa l-hadiid.Wa nijahhiz khubuurkuachaan giddaami ana,intu battaan ma tanfa'o.
Ya cha'ab Yahuuza,daahu fi l-jibaalnaadum maachi be rijileenahwa yibachchir wa yiballikh al-salaam.Ayyudu wa haggugu nazirkuachaan aduuku al-ma naafi'ma yuchugg baladku battaan.Wa khalaas,kalaamah kammal-!
Ya sukkaan Niinawa,fi muhaajimiin jaayiin leeku-!Aharsu bakaanku al-gawiwa raakhubu fi l-duruub.Arbutu sulubkuwa abgo gawiyiin le l-harib.
Hatta kan al-mukharribiin kharrabo zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa dammaro chadarhum kula,Allah yigabbil leehum charafhummisil yigabbil charaf Bani Israa'iil.
Wa darag furraasah al-adumamsuuh be buhya hamrawa askarah laabsiin khulgaan humur.Wa wakit jaahiziin le l-harib,arabaatah yamurgu charaarwa l-huraab yinhazzo.
Wa arabaat al-harib yajru fi l-chawaari' be chiddewa jaariyiin fi ust al-madiinamisil deyy al-barraaga al-tachla'.
Wa malik Niinawa naada khuyyaadahwa laakin humman yittarta'o fi machiihum.Yajru le l-durdurwa yijahhuzu nufuushum le yahmuuh.
Tawwaali,al-sadd al-laazmiin beyah almi al-bahar ankasarwa gasir al-malik waga'.
Wa l-malika sallabooha wa chaaloohawa khaddaamaatha kaarbaat duyuudhinwa yunuuhan hissihin misil al-hamaam.
Wa Niinawa bigatmisil khazzaan almi al-yinaggitwa sukkaanha arradomisil almi al-jaari.Wakit yuguulu leehum-:-Agiifu-!Agiifu- kula,ma fi naadum minhum yinlafit.
Anhabo al-fuddawa anhabo al-dahab-!Khuna al-madiina abadan ma yikammilwa khumaamha al-khaali kula katiir.
Niinawa bigat naga'a faadiyewa kharaab.Wa naasha guluubhum angata'owa rijleehum barado.Wa butuunhum kula yarjufuwa wujuuhhum bigo dulum.
Wa ween marbat al-diidaanwa margad iyaalhum-?Kan al-duud wa martah marago kula,naadum ma yibachtin iyaalhum.
Al-duud yagnus le iyaalahwa yakhnig le martah.Wa yamla marbatah be l-seed al-hu katalahwa be l-rimam al-hu charrataahum.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:-Akiid nugumm diddiki,ya madiinat Niinawa.Aywa,arabaatki hana l-harib,nisawwiihum rumaad.Wa furraaski al-misil al-diidaan,al-seef yaktulhum.Wa ana niwaggif ganiiski fi l-baladwa hiss rusulki battaan ma yinsami'.
Al-azaab le madiinat al-damm.Hi kullaha ke malaane be kidib wa nahibwa daayman al-dimme waag'e foogha.
Wa fi l-madiina,yinsami' hiss al-sootwa harakat dawaraan al-ajalaatWa l-kheel yigallubuwa arabaat al-harib yinattutu.
Wa siyaad al-kheel yahjumuwa l-suyuuf yaburguwa l-huraab yiraaru.Wa l-majruuhiin katiiriinwa l-jisas ma induhum hisaabwa l-maytiin bala adadlahaddi l-naas yittarta'o fi l-janaazaat.
Madiinat Niinawa achcharmatat misil charmuutawa hi sitt al-jamaal wa sitt al-sihir.Hi abbadat al-umam be charmatathawa abbadat al-gabaayil be sihirha.
Daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:-Akiid ana nugumm diddikiwa narfa' khalagkiwa nukhuttah leeki fi wijihki.Wa niwassif ireeki le l-umamwa eebki le l-mamaalik.
Wa nukhutt leeki fi raaski kulla muharramaatkiwa ni'ayyibkiwa nisawwiiki masal le l-aakhariin.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yichiifkiyajri minki ba'iid wa yuguul-:--Niinawa khirbat.Yaatu al-yihinn foogha-?Wa min ween nalga naasal-yisabburuuha-?-
Ya Niinawa,tahsibi nafiskiakheer min madiinat Tiibaal-fi balad Masir walla-?Hi gaa'ide ambeenaat rujuul al-Niilwa almi haayigha.Wa bahar haamiiha wa bahar durdurha.Wa be da kula,hi ma nijat.
Balad al-Habacha wa balad Masir,dool khuwwitha al-abadan ma tikammil.Wa balad Fuut wa balad Liibiya kulafaza'ha.
Wa laakin madiinat Tiiba kula chaaloohawa waddo sukkaanha fi l-khurba.Wa atfaalha kataloohumfi kulla chawaari'ha.Wa le siyaad al-charaf hana l-madiina,al-udwaan gassamoohum be am'iyeedaatle yisawwuuhum abiid.Wa kubaaraat Tiiba kulajanzaroohum.
Aywa,ya Niinawa,inti taskare min al-ta'ab wa tillabbadewa tifattichi bakaan al-talja'e foogahmin udwaanki.

Wa fi chaan da,al-sama ma nazzalat matar wa l-ard ma antat intaaj.
Ana jibt al-jafaaf fi l-ard wa fi l-jibaal wa fi l-ziraa'a wa fi jineenaat al-inab wa fi chadar al-zaytuun wa fi kulla intaaj al-ard.Wa l-naas wa l-bahaayim ma ligo natiijat khidmithum.
Wa khalaas,Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil wa Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al-diin wa kulla l-faddalo min al-cha'ab,kulluhum sim'o kalaam Allah Ilaahhum wa kalaam al-nabi Haggaay al-rassalah leehum Allah Ilaahhum.Wa l-cha'ab khaafo min Allah.
Wa Haggaay rasuul Allah hajja le l-cha'ab hasab al-kalaam al-rassalah beyah Allah wa gaal-:-Daahu kalaam Allah-:--Ana ma'aaku.-
Wa Allah chajja' Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil haakim balad Yahuuza wa Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al-diin wa kulla l-faddalo min al-cha'ab.Wa humman jo wa gammo yakhdumu fi beet Allah al-Gaadir Ilaahhum
fi yoom 24 hana l-chahar al-saadis fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum al-malik Daariyuus.
Wa fi yoom 21 hana l-chahar al-saabi',Allah hajja be waasitat al-nabi Haggaay wa gaal-:
Hajji le Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil haakim balad Yahuuza wa le Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al-diin wa le l-faddalo min al-cha'ab wa guul-:
--Yaatu minku intu al-gaa'idiin hayyiin al-yoom chaaf majd al-beet da zamaan-?Wa keef chiftuuh al-yoom-?Sahiih al-beet da ma ya'ajibku-!--
Wa hassa',daahu kalaam Allah-:--Ya Zarubaabil wa ya Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al-diin wa ya kulla cha'ab al-balad,chiddu heelku.Wa da kalaam Allah.Gummu le l-khidme achaan ana ma'aaku-!Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa hasab al-wa'ad al-waa'adtuku beyah wakit maragtu min balad Masir,ruuhi gaa'ide fi usutku.Ma takhaafo min cheyy-!-
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Battaan wakit chiyya,ana nirajjif al-sama wa l-ardwa l-buhuur wa kulla l-dunya.
Ana nirajjif kulla l-umamwa l-khuna hana kulla l-umamtaji fi l-bakaan dawa ana namla kulla l-beet dabe l-majd.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Achaan kulla l-fudda hintiwa l-dahab kula hanaayi ana.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Al-majd hana l-beet da yabga ziyaadawa yufuut al-majd hana l-beet al-awwal.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,ana nisabbit al-salaam.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa fi yoom 24 hana l-chahar al-taasi' fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum Daariyuus,Allah hajja le l-nabi Haggaay.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-As'al rujaal al-diin chunu fikirhum fi l-gaanuun da.
Kan naadum chaayil laham mukhaddas fi chaarib khalagah wa allammas be chaarib khalagah da laham aw churba aw khamar aw dihin aw ayyi akil aakhar,hal al-akil da yilkhaddas walla-? Wa rujaal al-diin gaalo-:-La.Ma yilkhaddas.
Wa Haggaay gaal battaan-:-Akuun naadum annajjas be sabab janaaza.Kan al-naadum da allammas al-achya dool,humman yinnajjaso walla-? Wa rujaal al-diin gaalo-:-Aywa,yinnajjaso.
Wa Haggaay radda leehum wa gaal-:-Daahu kalaam Allah-:--Al-cha'ab da wa l-umma di,kulluhum misil da giddaami ana.Wa kulla khidmit iideehum wa ayyi cheyy al-yigaddumuuh leyi kula nijis.
Hassa' da,fakkuru adiil min al-yoom le giddaam.Gabul ma khatteetu hajar foog hajar le tabnu beet Allah,
haalitku kikkeef-?Wakit macho yikiilu 20 kooro hana khalla min al-dabanga,ligo 10 bas.Wa wakit macho yikiilu 50 liitir hana khamar min al-assaara,ligo 20 bas.
Wa ana darabt ziraa'itku be l-jafaaf wa l-barad wa l-nada al-yisoofinha.Wa be da kula,intu ma gabbaltu leyi.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Fakkuru adiil min al-yoom le giddaam.Al-yoom da yoom 24 hana l-chahar al-taasi',al-yoom al-khatto foogah asaas beet Allah.Fakkuruuh adiil.
Awwal ma faddal cheyy fi l-dabanga wa chadar al-inab wa l-tiin wa l-rummaan wa l-zaytuun kula ma jaabo cheyy.Wa laakin min al-yoom da,nibaarikku.-
Wa fi nafs al-yoom,Allah hajja battaan le Haggaay wa gaal-:
Guul le Zarubaabil haakim balad Yahuuza-:--Ana nirajjif al-sama wa l-ard.
Wa narmi karaasi al-mamaalik wa nidammir khuwwaat mamaalik al-umam.Wa narmi arabaathum hana l-harib wa l-raakbiin fooghum.Wa l-kheel wa l-raakbiin fooghum,narmiihum tihit.Ayyi waahid yumuut be seef akhuuh.
Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.Wa fi l-yoom da,ya abdi Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil,ana nichiilak wa nukhuttak misil khitim fi iidi achaan inta bas ana azaltak.-- Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Fi l-chahar al-taamin fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum Daariyuus malik balad Faaris,Allah hajja le l-nabi Zakariiya wileed Barakya wileed Iddu wa gaal leyah-:
Ana Allah khidibt khadab chadiid didd juduudku.
Hassa' da,hajji le Bani Israa'iil be kalaami ana Allah al-Gaadir wa guul leehum-:--Daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:"Gabbulu leyi wa ana kula nigabbil leeku."Wa da Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Ma tabgo misil juduudku.Zamaan,al-anbiya hajjo leehum be kalaami ana Allah al-Gaadir wa gaalo leehum yigabbulu leyi wa yikhallu deribhum al-fasil wa amalhum al-fasil.Wa laakin humman ma khatto baalhum leyi wa la sim'o kalaami.Wa da kalaam Allah.
--Ween juduudku-?Wa l-anbiya yi'iichu ila l-abad walla-?
Wa laakin kalaami wa churuuti al-ana amart beehum abiidi al-anbiya,lihgo juduudku.Wa humman gabbalo leyi wa gaalo-:"Allah al-Gaadir kharrar yi'aamilna hasab deribna wa amalna.Wa da bas al-cheyy al-hu sawwaah."-
Wa fi yoom 24 hana chahri 11 al-usmah Chabaat fi l-sana al-taaniye hana hukum Daariyuus,Allah hajja battaan leyi ana al-nabi Zakariiya wileed Barakya wileed Iddu.
Fi l-leele di,ana chift ru'ya.Ana chift raajil raakib fi juwaad ahmar wa waagif fi usut chadar al-waadi.Wa waraayah fi kheel humur wa chugur wa buyud be rukkaabhum.
Wa ana sa'alt al-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi wa gult-:-Ya siidi,humman dool yaatumman-? Wa l-malak gaal-:-Ana ni'ooriik humman dool yaatumman.
Wa l-raajil al-waagif fi lubb chadar al-waadi gaal-:-Humman dool Allah rassalaahum le yuruukhu kulla l-ard.
Wa rukkaab al-kheel hajjo le malak Allah al-waagif fi ust al-chadar wa gaalo leyah-:-Daahu aniina rukhna kulla l-ard wa ligiinaaha gaa'ide fi raaha wa jumma.
Wa malak Allah hajja wa gaal-:-Ya Allah al-Gaadir,min muddit 70 sana inta khidibt le Madiinat al-Khudus wa hillaal balad Yahuuza.Mata tarhamhum-?
Wa Allah radda le l-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi wa anta radd adiil wa muchajji'.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi gaal-:-Ballikh-!Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:--Ana indi mahabba chadiidele Madiinat al-Khudus wa jabal Sahyuun.
Wa laakin ana khidibt khadab chadiiddidd al-umam al-mustakbiriin wa murtaahiin.Achaan wakit ana khidibt chiyya didd Bani Israa'iil,al-umam dool aamaloohum be charr katiir.-
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal-:-Ana nigabbil le Madiinat al-Khudusbe mahanna.Wa Madiinat al-Khudus yigaawusuuha le l-baniwa beeti yinbani fiiha battaan.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa l-malak gaal leyi-:-Battaan ballikh-!Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:--Hillaal hanaayi yinmalu battaan be l-kheerwa nihinn battaan fi Sahyuunwa na'azil battaan Madiinat al-Khudus.-
Wa battaan rafa't raasi wa chift ru'ya.Wa daahu chift arba'a guruun.
Wa ana sa'alt al-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi wa gult-:-Humman dool chunu-? Wa hu radda leyi wa gaal-:-Dool al-guruun al-chattato sukkaan balad Yahuuza wa balad Israa'iil wa Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah chawwafaani arba'a haddaad.
Wa ana gult-:-Humman dool jo bisawwu chunu-? Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Al-guruun dool humman bas al-chattato sukkaan balad Yahuuza lahaddi naadum fiiha ma yagdar yarfa' raasah.Wa laakin al-haddaad dool jo le yirajjufu wa yikassuru guruun al-umam wa dool al-umam al-rafa'o guruunhum didd balad Yahuuza le yichattutu sukkaanha.
Wa battaan ana rafa't raasi wa chift ru'ya.Wa daahu chift sabi wa indah fi iidah habil al-yigaawusu beyah.
Wa ana sa'altah wa gult leyah-:-Inta maachi ween-? Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Maachi nigaawis Madiinat al-Khudus le na'arif urdaha wa tuulha kam.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi gamma maachi wa malak aakhar ja laagaah.
Wa l-malak al-awwal gaal le l-aakhar-:-Ajri hajji le l-sabi da wa guul leyah-:--Madiinat al-Khudus tagood maftuuha bala durdur achaan al-naas wa l-bahaayim bigo katiiriin fi usutha.--
Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:--Ana zaati nukuun leeha durdur hana naar muhawwigha.Wa fi usutha,nukuun majdaha.-
Daahu kalaam Allah-:-Yalla-!Yalla-!Intu al-ana chattattuku fi l-jiihaat al-arba'a,arrudu min balad al-munchaakh-!Wa da kalaam Allah.
Yalla-!Ya Sahyuun-!Inti al-saakne fi Baabil al-misil bineeye,arridi min hinaak-!
Majd Allah rassalaani ana Zakariiya didd al-umam al-nahabooku wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Ayyi naadum al-yilammiskuda misil limis wald eeni.
Aywa,daahu narfa' iidi didduhumhatta abiidhum kula yanhaboohum.-Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar Allah al-Gaadir,hu bas rassalaani.
Daahu kalaam Allah-:-Zakhriti wa afrahe,ya Sahyuun al-misil bineeye,achaan daahu ana jaayi naskun fi usutki.
Wa fi l-yoom da,umam katiiriinyinkarbu foogi ana Allah.Wa yabgo cha'abi halaali.Wa ana naskun fi usutku.-Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar Allah al-Gaadir,hu bas rassalaani leeku.
Wa balad Yahuuza tabga hint Allah halaalahmisil gismah fi l-ard al-mukhaddasawa hu ya'azil battaan Madiinat al-Khudus.
Khalli kulla makhluug hayyyaskut giddaam Allahachaan hu maragmin maskanah al-mukhaddas.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah chawwafaani Yachuu' kabiir rujaal al-diin waagif giddaam malak Allah.Wa Ibliis al-tahhaam waagif be nuss al-zeene hana Yachuu' le yathamah.
Wa malak Allah gaal le Ibliis-:-Khalli Allah yisakkitak,ya Ibliis-!Aywa,khalli Allah yisakkitak,hu al-azal Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa kan le l-raajil da,hu ma misil muchhaab al-chaalooh min al-naar walla-?
Wa Yachuu' waagif giddaam al-malak wa laabis khulgaan waskhaaniin.
Wa l-malak amar wa gaal le l-waagfiin jambah-:-Sillu minnah khulgaanah al-waskhaaniin. Wa ba'ad da,gaal le Yachuu'-:-Chiif,ana najjeetak min zanbak.Khalli yilabbusuuk khulgaan hana iid.
Wa gaal battaan-:-Khalli yukhuttu fi raasah kadmuul taahir. Wa khalaas,labbasooh khulgaan wa khatto kadmuul taahir fi raasah.Wa malak Allah waagif fi l-bakaan da.
Wa khalaas,malak Allah kallam le Yachuu' wa gaal-:
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:--Kan tichiil derbiwa tahfad khidimti,inta bas tahkim fi beetiwa tiraakhib fi fadaayti kula.Wa ana nantiik bakaanambeen al-aakhariin al-waagfiin hini.-
Asma',ya Yachuu' kabiir rujaal al-diin wa kulla rujaal al-diin al-tihtak.Intu zaatku alaama hana l-cheyy al-yukuun.Daahu gariib ana nirassil abdi al-binaaduuh Bizre.
Chiifu al-hajar al-khaali al-khatteetah giddaam Yachuu'.Wa fi l-hajar,fi sab'a uyuun.Wa daahu ana zaati nanguch foogah nagich.Wa fi yoom waahid bas,nuguchch khata al-balad di.Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ayyi waahid minku ya'azim jaarah le yagood be l-salaama fi lubb jineentah hana l-inab wa l-tiin. Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa l-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi gabbal ja wa gawwamaani misil yigawwumu naadum min al-noom.
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Gaa'id tichiif chunu-? Wa ana gult-:-Gaa'id nichiif faanuus kulla ke hana dahab wa l-bakaan al-yusubbu foogah al-dihin gaa'id min foog leyah wa indah sab'a tiyeesaat al-induhum sab'a niiraan.
Wa jaay wa jaay le l-bakaan al-yusubbu foogah al-dihin,nichiif chadar itneen hana zaytuun,al-waahide be l-zeene wa l-aakhara be l-isra.
Wa ana sa'alt al-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi wa gult-:-Da ma'anaatah chunu,ya siidi-?
Wa l-malak gaal-:-Al-cheyy al-gaa'id tichiifah da,ma'anaatah ma ta'arfah walla-? Wa ana gult-:-La,ya siidi.
Wa khalaas,hu gaal leyi-:-Allah hajja le Zarubaabil wa gaal-:--Al-khidme di ma be khuwwawa la be gudrawa laakin be ruuhi ana.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Inta tahsib nafsak kabiir,ya l-jabal-?Giddaam Zarubaabil taga'wa tabga sahale bas.Wa kan Zarubaabil yijiibaakhir hajar le yabnu beeti,al-naas yi'iitu wa yuguulu-:"Mabruuk-!Mabruuk le l-hajar-!"-
Wa Allah hajja leyi ana Zakariiya wa gaal-:
Iideen Zarubaabil khatto asaas al-beet dawa iideenah bas yikammuluuh.-Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar Allah al-Gaadir bas rassalaani leeku.
Ma tahguru yoom hana bidaaya sakhayre.Tafraho wakit tichiifu fi iid Zarubaabildurdumt al-hadiid al-yigaawusu beyah.-Wa l-niiraan al-sab'a hana l-faanuus dool yimassulu uyuun Allah al-gaa'idiin yiraakhubu kulla l-ard.
Wa battaan,ana sa'alt al-malak wa gult-:-Chadar al-zaytuun al-itneen al-ana chiftah jaay wa jaay le l-faanuus be l-zeene wa l-isra,ma'anaatah chunu-?
Wa sa'altah le taani marra wa gult-:-Chunu ma'ana hana l-furuu' al-itneen hana chadar al-zaytuun al-gaa'idiin jamb al-majaari al-itneen hana l-dahab al-yisiil minhum al-dihin al-dahbi-?
Wa hu radda leyi wa gaal-:-Ma ta'arif ma'anaatah walla-? Wa ana gult-:-La,ya siidi.
Wa khalaas,hu gaal leyi-:-Dool yimassulu al-rujaal al-itneen al-masahoohum be l-dihin wa khassasoohum le yagiifu giddaam Allah siid kulla l-ard.
Wa battaan ana rafa't raasi wa chift ru'ya.Wa daahu chift kitaab malfuuf taayir.
Wa l-malak gaal leyi-:-Gaa'id tichiif chunu-? Wa ana gult-:-Gaa'id nichiif kitaab taayir tuulah 20 duraa' wa urdah 10 duraa'.
Wa khalaas,hu gaal leyi-:-Fi l-kitaab da,maktuuba foogah al-la'ana al-nazalat fi kulla l-balad.Wa be nussah al-waahid,ayyi sarraag yaturduuh wa be nussah al-aakhar,ayyi naadum al-yahlif be kidib kula yaturduuh.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:--Ana nazzalt al-la'ana di achaan tadkhul wa taskun fi beet al-sarraag wa fi beet al-naadum al-yahlif be usmi be kidib.Wa tidammir al-beet lahaddi maraadiisah wa asaasah.-
Wa l-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi gaddam wa gaal leyi-:-Arfa' raasak wa chiif al-cheyy al-jaayi da.
Wa ana sa'altah wa gult-:-Da chunu-? Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Di l-guffa al-foogha zunuub hana kulla naas al-balad.
Wa tawwaali,tabag hana hadiid anrafa' min khachum al-guffa wa daahu fiyah mara gaa'ide fi lubbaha.
Wa l-malak gaal-:-Al-mara di,hi timassil al-fasaala. Hu lazzaaha daakhal fi l-guffa wa sadda khachum al-guffa be l-tabag hana l-hadiid da.
Wa ba'ad da,ana rafa't raasi wa chift ru'ya.Wa daahu chift awiin itneen jaayaat.Al-riih gaa'ide tihijj fi janaaheehin wa janaaheehin misil janaahe abunkhanam.Wa hinna chaalan al-guffa wa taaran beeha ambeen al-sama wa l-ard.
Wa ana sa'alt al-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi wa gult-:-Ween yiwaddan al-guffa di-?
Wa hu gaal leyi-:-Yiwaddanha fi balad Baabil al-fasle le yabnu leeha beet al-ibaada.Wa hinaak yisawwu leeha asaas wa yukhuttuuha foogah.
Wa battaan rafa't raasi wa chift ru'ya.Wa daahu chift arba'a arabaat hana harib marago min been jibaal itneen hana nahaas.
Al-araba al-awwalaaniiye kaarriinha kheel humur wa l-taaniye kaarriinha kheel zurug.
Wa l-taalta kaarriinha kheel buyud wa l-raab'e kaarriinha kheel rugut wa gaadriin.
Wa ana sa'alt al-malak al-gaa'id yihajji leyi wa gult-:-Humman dool yimassulu chunu,ya siidi-?
Wa l-malak radda leyi wa gaal-:-Humman dool yimassulu riih al-sama al-tusuug ale l-jiihaat al-arba'a,al-maarge min hadarat Allah siid kulla l-ard.
Wa arabat al-kheel al-zurug tamchi ale balad al-munchaakh.Wa l-kheel al-buyud yitaabu'uuhum.Wa l-kheel al-rugut kamaan yamchu ale balad al-junuub.
Wa l-kheel al-gaadriin dool marago le yamchu yuruukhu al-ard.Wa Allah gaal leehum-:--Amchu ruukhu al-ard.- Wa humman macho raakho al-ard.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah naadaani be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Chiif-!Al-yamchu fi balad al-munchaakh yihaddu khadabi fi l-balad di.
Akhbal al-hadaaya al-jaaboohum Haldaay wa Tuubiiya wa Yada'ya min al-naas al-waddoohum fi l-khurba.Al-yoom bas,inta zaatak amchi fi beet Yuuchiiya wileed Safanya achaan al-talaata rujaal dool dallo hinaak wakit jo min Baabil.
Wa akhbal minhum hadaaya al-fudda wa l-dahab wa dugg beehum taaj.Wa khuttah fi raas kabiir rujaal al-diin Yachuu' wileed Yuusaadikh.
Wa guul le Yachuu'-:--Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:"Daahu al-raajil al-binaaduuh Bizrewa tihit rijileenah yabzur kulla cheyywa hu yabni beet Allah battaan.
Aywa,hu bas yabni beet Allahwa hu bas al-yalbas khalag al-mulukwa yagood fi kursiih wa yahkim.Wa raajil al-diin kulayagood jamb kursiihwa ambeenaathum humman al-itneenfi muwaafaga kaamile."--
Wa yukhuttu al-taaj da fi beeti ana Allah wa yizzakkaro beyah Haldaay wa Tuubiiya wa Yada'ya wa l-kheer al-sawwaah wileed Safanya.
Wa naas ba'iidiin yaju yabnu battaan beet Allah.Wa be da,ta'arfu kadar Allah al-Gaadir bas rassalaani ana Zakariiya leeku.Wa da yukuun kan intu tasma'o adiil kalaam Allah Ilaahku.
Wa fi l-yoom al-raabi' hana l-chahar al-taasi' al-usmah Kislu fi l-sana al-raab'e hana hukum al-malik Daariyuus,Allah hajja le Zakariiya.
Wa Beet Iil Charaasar khaayid askar al-malik wa askarah rassalo naas le yachhado Allah.
Wa rassaloohum achaan yas'alo rujaal al-diin fi beet Allah al-Gaadir wa l-anbiya wa yuguulu-:-Awwal aniina gaa'idiin nusuumu wa nabku fi l-chahar al-khaamis achaan nizzakkaro damaar hana beet Allah.Wa hassa' da,waajib nisawwuuh walla la-?
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Guul le kulla cha'ab al-balad wa le rujaal al-diin-:--Wakit sumtu wa hizintufi l-chahar al-khaamis wa l-saabi',wa da min muddit 70 sana,siyaamku da leyi ana walla-?
Wa wakit akaltu wa chiribtu,ma le nufuusku bas walla-?-
Allah hajja misil da be waasitat al-anbiya hana zamaan.Wa da wakit sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa hillaalha al-muhawwigiinha gaa'idiin fi raaha wa saharat Nagab wa sahalat Chafiila malaaniin be sukkaan.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:--Ahkumu be l-hagg wa l-adaalawa khalli ayyi waahid yisawwi le akhuuhal-kheer wa l-rahma.
Ma tazulmu al-armala wa la l-atiimwa la l-ajnabi wa la l-miskiin.Wa khalli naadum ma yichiil niiyele yisawwi al-fasaala le akhuuh.-
Wa laakin humman abo ma yukhuttu baalhum.Gawwo ruuseehum wa saddo udneehum achaan ma yasma'o.
Wa humman gawwo galibhum misil hajar achaan ma yasma'o churuut al-Tawraat wa l-kalaam al-Allah al-Gaadir rassalah leehum be waasitat ruuhah wa be waasitat al-anbiya hana zamaan.Wa da bas sabab al-khadab al-chadiid hana Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Misil ana naadeethum wa humman ma sim'ooni,humman kula yinaaduuni wa ana ma nasma'hum.
Wa ana chattattuhum ale kulla l-umam al-abadan ma ya'arfuuhum.Wa ba'ad chattattuhum,al-balad khirbat wa ma fi al-yamchi leeha wa la l-yaji minha.Wa baladhum al-samhe di,sawwooha kharaab.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Indi khiira chadiide le jabal Sahyuunwa nihibbah be mahabba chadiide.-Wa da Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal-:-Ana nigabbil fi jabal Sahyuunwa naskun battaan fi usut Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa Madiinat al-Khudusyinaaduuha Madiinat al-Amaan.Wa jabal Allah al-Gaadiryinaaduuh al-jabal al-mukhaddas.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Al-chiyyaab wa l-ajaayiz battaan yagoodufi chawaari' Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ayyi waahid asaatah fi iidahachaan aacho umur tawiil.
Wa chawaari' al-madiinayinmalu be l-awlaad wa l-banaatal-gaa'idiin yal'abo fooghum.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Hassa' fi l-wakit da,intu al-faddaltu min cha'abi,tahsubu al-cheyy da gaasi walla-?Wa laakin ana ma nahsibah gaasi.-Wa da kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Aywa,ana ninajji cha'abimin balad al-sabaahwa min balad al-kharib.
Ana nijiibhumwa yaskunu battaanfi usut Madiinat al-Khudus.Humman yabgo cha'abiwa ana nabga Ilaahhumbe amaan wa adaala.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Chiddu heelku-!Min wakit khatteetu asaas beet Allah al-Gaadirle tabnu al-beet da battaan,gaa'idiin tasma'o kalaam al-anbiya.
Gabul ma badeetu al-khidme di,khidmit al-naas ma indaha faaydewa khidmit al-bahaayim kula ma indaha natiija.Ma fi amaan le l-yamchu wa l-yajuwa da be sabab al-adu.Wa ana khalleet kulla l-naasayyi waahid yugumm didd akhuuh.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir.-Wa laakin hassa' le l-faddalo min al-cha'ab,ana ma nabga leehum misil awwal.
Hassa' nazra' al-salaamwa jineenit al-inab taldawa l-ard tanti intaajhawa l-sama tinazzil matar.Wa nanti kulla l-cheyy da misil warasale l-faddalo min al-cha'ab.
Ya Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil,awwal intu bigiitu la'ana fi ust al-umam.Wa laakin hassa',ninajjiiku wa tabgo baraka.Ma takhaafo,chiddu heelku-!
Achaan daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Awwal,ana kharrart nita''ibkuachaan juduudku khaddabooni.Wa fi l-wakit da,ana ma khalleet kharaari.Wa da Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa hassa',ana khalleet kharaari hana l-ta'abwa kharrart nisawwi al-kheerle naas Madiinat al-Khuduswa le Bani Yahuuzawa be da,ma takhaafo.
Daahu al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwuuh.Kallumu ambeenaatku be l-sahiih.Wa fi charii'itku,ahkumu be l-haggwa be l-adaala al-tijiib al-salaam.
Ma tichiilu niiyele tisawwu al-fasaala ambeenaatkuwa ma tihibbual-haliife be kidibachaan kulla l-achya dool,ana nakrahhum.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah al-Gaadir hajja leyi wa gaal-:
Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:--Ayyaam al-siyaamhana l-chahar al-raabi'wa l-chahar al-khaamiswa l-chahar al-saabi'wa l-chahar al-aachiryabgo le Bani Yahuuza ayyaam iidal-yi'ayyuduuhum be suruur wa farha.Wa laakin hibbu al-hagg wa l-salaam.-
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Battaan yaju chu'uubwa sukkaan min hillaal katiiriin.
Wa sukkaan hille waahideyamchu le sukkaan hille aakhara.Wa yuguulu-:--Yalla namchu nachhado Allah.Khalli nifattuchu Allah al-Gaadir.--Wa yuruddu leehum wa yuguulu-:--Aywa,aniina kula namchu-!--
Wa chu'uub katiiriin wa umam gawiyiinyaju fi Madiinat al-Khudusle yifattuchu Allah al-Gaadirwa yachhadooh.
Wa daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Fi l-wakit da,yaju min al-umam achara rujaal ayyi waahid be lukhkhitah.Wa kulla l-rujaal dool yakurbu daayir khalag hana waahid min al-Yahuud wa yachhadooh wa yuguulu leyah-:--Khalluuna namchu ma'aaku achaan simi'na kadar al-Rabb gaa'id ma'aaku.-
Al-muhaakama al-kallam beeha Allahnazalat fi balad Hadraakwa wagafat fi madiinat Dimachkh.Achaan Allah yichiif kulla Bani Adam,ma gabaayil Bani Israa'iil bas.
Wa l-muhaakama di taji le madiinat Hamaatal-gariib le Dimachkh.Wa taji le mudun Suur wa Seedaal-sukkaanhum induhum hikma kabiire.
Sukkaan Suur bano leehum himaayewa lammo fudda katiire misil al-turaabwa dahab katiir misil tiinat al-chawaari'.
Wa daahu al-Rabb yagla' minhum kulla cheyywa yarmi himaayithum fi l-baharwa l-madiina zaatha,al-naar taakulha.
Madiinat Achgaluun tichiif wa takhaafwa Khazza tittanna ziyaada min al-waja'wa Akhruun achamha yingati'.Wa yaktulu malik Khazzawa Achgaluun ma yaskunuuha battaan.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Al-ajaanib yaskunu Achduudwa nidammir istikbaar al-Filistiyiin.
Namrug min khachumhum al-laham al-fatiiswa min sunuunhum al-laham al-haraam.Al-yifaddulu minhumyabgo hineeyi ana Ilaahhumwa yabgo khachum beetambeen Bani Yahuuza.Wa naas Akhruun yindammo le cha'abimisil al-Yabuusiyiin.
Wa ana nukhutt mu'askari jamb ardiwa nahrisha min al-udwaan al-maachiin wa l-jaayiin.Wa ayyi mudaayig ma yaji foogha battaanachaan hassa' eeni foogha.
Ya Sahyuun al-misil bineeye,afrahe ziyaada-!Iiti be farah,ya Madiinat al-Khudus al-misil bineeye-!Daahu malikki jaayi leeki.Hu aadil wa munnasir.Hu miskiin wa raakib fi humaar,fi dahach wileed humaara.
Ana nidammir arabaat al-harib fi turaab Afraayimwa kheel al-duwaas fi Madiinat al-Khuduswa nikassir nubbaal al-harib.Wa l-malik da yikallimbe l-salaam le l-umamwa sultitah tamchi min al-bahar al-Mayyitlahaddi l-bahar al-Abyadwa min bahar al-Furaatlahaddi aakhir al-ard.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Be sabab mu'aahadatial-sawweetha ma'aakube damm al-dahaaya,ana namrug masaajiinku min al-sijinal-bigi leehum misil nugra bala almi.
Ya l-masaajiin al-induku acham,gabbulu fi l-bakaan al-gawi.Hassa' nikhabbirkukadar nikaffiiku ta'abku marrateen.
Bani Yahuuza yabgo leyi nubbaalwa gabiilat Afraayim yabgo leyi nachaachiib.Ya Sahyuun,ana nigawwim rujaalkiwa nisawwiihum misil seef al-faarisdidd subyaan balad al-Yuunaan.
Wa Allah yibiin min foog le cha'abahwa nuchchaabah yabrug misil barraaga.Allah al-Rabb yadrub al-buugwa yaji be riih chadiide min al-junuub.
Allah al-Gaadir yahmi cha'abahwa humman yidammuruwa yakharbu al-adube hujaar al-miglaa'.Wa yacharbo wa yikoorukumisil sakkaara.Wa yinmalu be damm udwaanhummisil kaas al-yuruchchu beyah guruun al-madbah.
Wa Allah Ilaahhum yinajji cha'abah fi l-yoom da,misil raa'i yinajji khanamah.Achaan humman yiraaru fi ardahmisil hujaar khaaliyiin al-yiraaru fi taaj.
Aywa,humman yafraho ziyaadawa yabgo jamiiliin marra waahid-!Wa l-gameh yi'akkil al-subyaanwa l-khamar al-jadiid yikabbir al-banaat.
As'alo Allah achaan yinazzil leekumatar al-richaach fi waktah.Allah bas yikawwin al-sahaabwa yinazzil matar katiir.Wa le ayyi insaan kula,hu yigawwim ma'aach fi zer'ah.
Laakin kan tas'alo al-asnaam,yuruddu be l-fasaalawa l-chawwaafiinyihajju be kidib.Hilimhum kula ma sahiihwa yisabburuuku be khachch.Wa fi chaan da,al-cha'ab aayriin misil al-khanamwa ti'ibo be sabab ma induhum raa'i.
Khadabi yanzil didd ru'yaanhumwa ni'aakhib kubaaraathum al-misil tuyuus.Aywa,ana Allah al-Gaadirnidaafi' le Bani Yahuuza al-misil khanami.Wa ana nisawwiihummisil juwaad aziim fi l-harib.
Wa min Bani Yahuuza,yamurgu khuyyaadwa humman chudaad misil hajar al-asaaswa saabtiin misil witid al-kheemawa gawiyiin misil nubbaal al-harib.
Humman yihaarubu misil furraasal-yifajjukhu aduuhum misil tiinat al-chawaari'.Humman yihaarubuachaan ana Allah ma'aahumwa hatta siyaad al-kheel kula,al-eeb yikhattiihum.
Ana nigawwi Bani Yahuuzawa ninajji zurriiyit Yuusuf.Wa nigabbilhum fi baladhumachaan hanneet fooghummisil awwal abadan ma abeethum.Achaan ana Allah Ilaahhumwa nakhbal salaathum.
Naas gabiilat Afraayimyabgo misil furraaswa yinmalu be l-farahmisil al-chirbo al-khamar.Wakit yichiifuuhum,iyaalhum yinbastuwa guluubhum yafrahofi chaan Allah.
Wa ana nisaffir leehum le nilimmuhumachaan ana fadeethum.Humman yaldowa yabgo katiiriin min awwal.
Ana chattattuhum fi ust al-chu'uubwa laakin fi l-bakaan al-ba'iid kula,yizzakkarooni.Humman yi'iichu hinaak ma'a iyaalhumwa ba'adeen,yigabbulu fi arduhum.
Ana nigabbilhum min balad Masirwa min balad Achuur,nilimmuhum.Wa nisabbithum fi balad Gil'aad wa Lubnaanlahaddi al-ard ma titimmuhum.
Humman yagta'o bahar al-ta'abwa ana Allah nadrub al-mooj fi ust al-baharwa kulla almi al-Niil al-khariig yikammil.Istikbaar Achuur yiddammarwa asaat muluk Masir tilkassar.
Nichaddid cha'abi be gudurti ana Allahwa be usmi,yi'iichu wa ya'abuduuni.-Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya Lubnaan,aftahe biibaankiwa khalli al-naar tahrig chadarki hana l-arz-!
Ya chadar al-sarwi,abku be hizinachaan chadar al-arz addammarwa l-kharaab lihig al-chadar al-aziimiin dool.Ya chadar al-balluut hana Baachaan,abku be hizinachaan al-khaaba al-dalmawaga'at fi l-turaab.
Asma'o-!Al-ru'yaan yabku be hizinachaan bakaanhum al-aziim khirib.Asma'o-!Al-diidaan yikirruachaan khaabat al-Urdun khirbat.
Wa daahu Allah Ilaahi gaal-:-Sarrih khanam al-juzur.
Wa l-yachru al-khanam dool yadbahoohum wa ma yandamo leehum.Wa l-yibii'uuhum yuguulu-:--Baarak Allah-!Daahuuni khani-!- Wa l-yasraho beehum kula ma induhum leehum mahanna.
Wa ana kulla battaan ma indi ayyi mahanna le sukkaan al-balad-!Wa daahu ana nisallim ayyi naadum fi iid jaarah wa ayyi naadum fi iid malikah.Wa l-muluuk yakharbu al-balad wa laakin ana ma ninajji naadum min iidhum-! Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,ana saraht le l-tujjaar be khanamhum hana l-juzur.Wa chilt itneen dugul.Al-awwalaani sammeetah Rida wa l-taani sammeetah Wihda.Wa khalaas,saraht be l-khanam.
Wa fi chahar waahid,ana taradt ru'yaanhum al-talaata.Wa fi l-akhiir,ma gidirt nahmal tujjaar al-khanam.Wa kan leehum humman kula,bakhadooni.
Wa khalaas,ana gult leehum-:-Battaan ma nasrah leeku.Khalli al-yumuutu,yumuutu-!Wa l-yiwadduru,yiwadduru-!Wa l-faddalo kamaan,khalli yil'aakalo ambeenaathum-!
Wa ana karabt dugli Rida wa kassartah le nangud al-mu'aahada al-sawweetha ma'a kulla l-chu'uub.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana nagadtaha.Wa tujjaar al-khanam al-gaa'idiin yichiifuuni irfo kadar fi'ili da hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,ana gult leehum-:-Kan ya'ajibku,kaffuuni ujurti.Wa kan ma ya'ajibku,khalaas khalluuh. Wa humman wazano leyi ujurti wa kaffooni talaatiin hajar fudda.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Yichiifu da bas al-ujra al-adiil leyi walla-?La-!Mustahiil-!Azgulha le l-haddaadi-! Wa ana chilt al-talaatiin hajar fudda wa zagaltuhum le l-haddaadi al-fi beet Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,kassart dugli al-taani Wihda le nangud al-alaakha ambeen Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Allah gaal leyi-:-Amchi battaan wa sawwi nafsak misil raa'i mukhaffal.
Daahu ana nukhutt raa'i fi l-balad di.Al-khanamaay al-muwaddire,hu ma lammaah beeha.Wa l-tiwaddir kula,hu ma yifattichha.Wa l-tinkasir kula,hu ma yi'aalijha.Wa l-aafe kula,hu ma yisarrihha.Wa laakin hu yaakul al-khanam al-sumaan wa yigatti' dalaafeehum.
Al-azaab le l-raa'i al-ma adiilal-yikhalli al-khanam-!Khalli al-seef yadrub iidahwa yigidd eenah al-zeene-!Khalli iidah taybaswa eenah al-zeene tumuut-!
Daahu al-muhaakama al-kallam beeha Allah fi chaan Bani Israa'iil.Wa da kalaam Allah al-falla al-samaawaat wa assas al-ard wa khalag al-ruuh fi daakhal al-insaan.Wa hu gaal-:
Daahu ana nisawwi Madiinat al-Khudus misil kaas al-yisakkir kulla l-chu'uub al-mujaawiriinha.Wa naas Yahuuza kula yabga leehum misil da,wakit yihaasuru Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana nukhutt Madiinat al-Khudus giddaam kulla l-chu'uub misil hajar kabiir al-abadan ma yagdaro yarfa'ooh.Wa ayyi naadum al-yihaawil yarfa'ah,yinjarih.Wa kulla umam al-ard yilimmu wa yugummu didd al-hajar da.
Wa fi l-yoom da,kulla l-kheel niliff raashum wa nadrub agul rukkaabhum.Wa laakin le Bani Yahuuza,nukhutt eeni fooghum wa le kulla kheel al-chu'uub kamaan,nadrubhum be l-ama.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa chuyuukh Yahuuza yuguulu fi nufuushum-:--Sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus ligo gudrithum min Allah al-Gaadir Ilaahhum.--
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana nisawwi chuyuukh Yahuuza misil kaanuun malaan naar tihit koom hana hatab aw misil naar al-mugabbide fi rubta hana ganaadiil.Wa humman yaakulu zeene wa isra kulla l-chu'uub al-mujaawiriinhum.Wa laakin sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus yaskunu fi madiinithum.
Wa ana Allah ninajji fi l-awwal aayilaat Bani Yahuuza.Wa be da,charaf zurriiyit Dawuud wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus ma yabga ziyaada min charaf aayilaat Bani Yahuuza.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana Allah nahmi sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus hatta al-da'iif minhum kula yabga chadiid misil al-malik Dawuud.Wa zurriiyit Dawuud yalgo ihtiraam misli ana al-Rabb wa misil malak Allah al-maachi giddaamhum.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ana nichiil niiye achaan nidammir kulla l-umam al-yaju yahjumu Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa ninazzil fi zurriiyit Dawuud wa fi sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus ruuh hana rahma wa du'a.Wa yichiifu aleyi ana al-humman ta'anooni be amalhum al-cheen al-misil harba.Humman yahzano leyah misil hizin al-wileed al-wahiid wa yabku leyah misil baki le l-wileed al-bikir.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-hizin yabga chadiid fi Madiinat al-Khudus misil hizin Haddaad Rimmuun fi kadaadit Magiddu.
Wa l-balad tahzan,ayyi khachum beet wiheedah.Khachum beet zurriiyit Dawuud yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.Khachum beet zurriiyit Naataan yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.
Khachum beet zurriiyit Laawi yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.Khachum beet Chim'i yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.
Wa kulla khuchuum buyuut al-aakhariin yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.
Wa fi l-yoom da,tamrug een almi al-tikhassil zurriiyit Dawuud wa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus min zunuubhum wa najaasithum.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:-Fi l-yoom da,ana nuguchch min al-balad asaame al-asnaam wa battaan ma yihajju beehum abadan.Wa natrud min al-balad al-anbiya al-yihajju be khachch wa ruuh al-munajjasa.
Wa kan naadum gaa'id yitnabba' be khachch,khalaas abuuh wa ammah al-wildooh yuguulu leyah-:--Waajib tumuut achaan inta gaa'id tuguul kalaam khachch be usum Allah.- Wa khalaas,abuuh wa ammah al-wildooh,yat'anooh wakit hu gaa'id yitnabba'.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-eeb yakrub ayyi nabi be sabab ru'yitah wakit hu gaa'id yitnabba'.Wa be da,battaan ma yalbas khalag al-nabi le yukhuchch al-naas.
Wa ayyi waahid yuguul-:--Ana ma nabi,ana harraati bas.Achaan charooni misil abid wakit ana sabi.--
Wa laakin yuguulu leyah-:--Chunu juruuh al-nabi al-fi sadrak dool-?- Wa hu yurudd-:--Ana ligiit al-juruuh dool fi beet rufgaani bas.-
Daahu kalaam Allah al-Gaadir-:-Ya seef,gumm didd raa'iiyi.Aywa,gumm didd gariibi-!Adrub al-raa'i wa l-khanam yichittuwa nadrub hatta al-dugaag kula.
Wa khalaas fi kulla l-balad,al-itneen tilit min al-naasyinfaslu wa yumuutuwa laakin al-tilit al-waahidyifaddil.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-tilit al-faddal da,nukhuttah fi l-naarwa nisaffiih misil yisaffu al-fuddawa nakchifah misil yakchufu al-dahab.Wa humman yinaadu usmiwa ana nurudd leehum.Wa ana nuguul leehum-:--Intu tabgo cha'abi.--Wa humman yuguulu-:--Allah bas yabga Ilaahna.-
Daahu yoom Allah yaji fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Yanhabooha wa yilgaasamo al-khaniime fi lubbaha
Ana nilimm kulla l-umam fi Madiinat al-Khudus le yihaarubuuha.Wa yichiilu al-madiina wa yanhabo al-buyuut wa yarugdu ma'a l-awiin be gu.Wa nuss sukkaan al-madiina yiwadduuhum fi l-khurba wa laakin al-faddalo kamaan yikhalluuhum fi l-madiina.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah yugumm wa yihaarib al-umam dool misil hu haarab fi ayyaam al-harib al-faato.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Allah yagiif fi jabal al-Zaytuun sabaah le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa jabal al-Zaytuun yinchagga min usut min al-sabaah lahaddi l-kharib wa yabga waadi kabiir ziyaada.Wa nuss al-jabal yikaskis ale l-munchaakh wa nussah al-aakhar yikaskis ale l-wati.
Wa khalaas,intu ti'arrudu be l-waadi ambeenaat al-jibaal dool achaan al-waadi yiwassil lahaddi Asal.Wa ti'arrudu misil arradtu min al-zilzaal fi ayyaam hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa ba'ad da,Allah Ilaahi yaji ma'a kulla saalihiinah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ma fi nuur wa la barid wa la talaj.
Wa da yukuun yoom waahid wa Allah bas ya'arif al-yoom da.Wa foogah ma fi nahaar wa la leel.Fi l-makhrib kula,al-deyy yidawwi.
Wa fi l-yoom da,almi saafi yajri min Madiinat al-Khudus.Nussah yajri ale l-bahar al-Mayyit fi l-sabaah wa nussah yajri ale l-bahar al-Abyad fi l-kharib.Wa yajri misil da fi wakt al-khariif wa l-chite.
Wa khalaas,Allah yiwassif kadar hu malik foog kulla l-ard.Wa fi l-yoom da,al-naas ya'arfu kadar Allah hu waahid wa usmah kula waahid bas.
Wa kulla l-balad tikhayyir wa tabga mustawiye wa khadra min Gaba' fi l-munchaakh lahaddi Rimmuun junuub Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa laakin Madiinat al-Khudus tukuun fi l-aali fi bakaanha.Wa huduudha yamchu min baab Banyaamiin lahaddi l-baab al-Gadiim wa lahaddi baab al-Rukun.Wa yamchu min beet al-muraakhaba hana Hananiil lahaddi assaaraat al-inab hana l-malik.
Wa yaskunuuha wa abadan ma yikhassusuuha le l-damaar battaan.Wa Madiinat al-Khudus tagood be amaan.
Wa daahu al-waba al-Allah yadrub beyah kulla l-chu'uub al-haarabo Madiinat al-Khudus.Hu yi'affin jisimhum wakit humman waagfiin be tuulhum.Wa uyuunhum yi'affunu fi lubb nugaarhum wa lisneehum yi'affunu fi lubb khuchuumhum.
Wa fi l-yoom da,Allah yibarjil al-chu'uub dool marra waahid.Ayyi waahid yakrub akhuuh wa yiddaawaso ambeenaathum.
Wa Bani Yahuuza kula yihaarubu fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa khalaas,yilimmu be katara al-khuna hana kulla l-umam al-mujaawiriinhum misil al-dahab wa l-fudda wa l-khulgaan.
Wa nafs al-waba da yadrub hatta l-kheel wa l-bikhaal wa l-jumaal wa l-hamiir wa kulla l-bahaayim al-gaa'idiin fi mu'askar al-adu.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-naas al-faddalo hayyiin min al-umam al-gammo didd Madiinat al-Khudus yamchu ayyi sana yasjudu giddaam al-malik wa hu Allah al-Gaadir.Wa yi'ayyudu iid al-Lagaadiib.
Wa laakin gabaayil al-ard al-ma yamchu Madiinat al-Khudus le yasjudu giddaam al-malik wa hu Allah al-Gaadir,al-matar ma yanzil leehum.
Wa kan gabaayil Masir ma yamchu,khalaas Allah yadrubhum be nafs al-waba al-darab beyah al-umam al-abo ma yamchu yi'ayyudu iid al-Lagaadiib.
Wa da bas yabga al-ikhaab le Masir wa le kulla l-umam al-abo ma yamchu yi'ayyudu iid al-Lagaadiib.
Wa fi l-yoom da,jursaan al-kheel kula yaktubu fooghum-:-Khaass le Allah. Wa hatta al-buraam al-fi beet Allah kula yabgo mukhassasiin misil al-kiisaan al-yuruchchu beehum damm al-dahaaya al-yukhuttuuhum giddaam al-madbah.
Wa ayyi burma fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa balad Yahuuza tabga mukhassasa le Allah al-Gaadir.Wa l-naas al-yaju yigaddumu dahaaya,yagdaro yirakkubu dahaayaahum fi ayyi waahide min al-buraam dool.Wa fi l-yoom da,battaan ma fi tujjaar fi lubb beet Allah al-Gaadir.
Di hi al-muhaakama al-kallam beeha Allah le Bani Israa'iil be waasitat al-nabi Malaakhi.
Allah gaal-:-Ana nihibbuku.-Wa laakin intu gultu-:-Kikkeef na'arfu kadar inta tihibbina-?-Wa daahu kalaam Allah-:-Sahiih,Isuu akhu jidduku Yaakhuub.Wa laakin ana habbeet Yaakhuub
wa abeet Isuu.Ana sallamt jibaal zurriiyit Isuu le l-kharaab wa ard warasatah sawweetha kadaade le l-ba'aachiim.
Akuun zurriiytah naas Adoom yuguulu-:-Sahiih,baladna addammarat wa laakin aniina nigabbulu nabnuuha battaan.-Daahu Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Khalli humman yabnuuha-!Ana nidammirha battaan.Wa yisammuuha balad al-Fasaala wa cha'abha yisammuuhum al-Cha'ab al-Allah Yakhdab aleehum Daayman.
Wa intu tichiifu be uyuunku wa tuguulu-:--Allah kabiir wa yahkim lahaddi khaadi min huduud balad Israa'iil kula.-
Al-walad yikarrim abuuhwa l-abid yihtarim siidah.Wa kan ana abu,ween al-karam al-waajib leyi-?Wa kan ana siid,ween al-ihtiraam al-waajib leyi-?Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.Ya rujaal al-diin,intu hagartu usmi.Wa be da kula,intu gultu-:--Kikkeef hagarna usmak-?--
Wa gaddamtu akil nijis fi madbahi.Wa be da kula,intu gultu-:--Kikkeef aniina najjasnaah-?--Wa da achaan madbahi ana Allah,ja'altuuh mahguur.
Wa kan bahiime amyaanetigaddumuuha dahiiye,da ma fasil walla-?Wa kan bahiime arja aw mardaanetigaddumuuha dahiiye,da ma fasil walla-?Khalaas,gaddumuuha le haakimku-!Hal hu yarda beeku walla-?Hal hu yakhbalku walla-?Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa hassa' da,dawwartu ridaayi ana al-Rabbachaan narhamku.Wa laakin al-dahaaya al-nijsiin dool,intu bas gaddamtuuhum.Wa misil da,ana nakhbalku walla-?Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Akheer tisiddu biibaan beetiachaan ma tigabbudu naar fi madbahile tigaddumu dahaaya bala faayde-!Ana ma narda beekuwa ma nakhbal min iideeku ayyi dahiiye.-Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Min bakaan taluu' al-harraay lahaddi bakaan waguu'ha,usmi kabiir fi ust al-umam.Wa fi ayyi bakaan,yiharrugu leyi bakhuur wa yijiibu dahiiye taahire achaan usmi kabiir fi ust al-umam.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa laakin intu ma ahtaramtuuni,wakit ja'altu madbahi ana al-Rabb nijis wa l-akil al-foogah kulla mahguur.
Wa battaan intu gultu-:--Chiifu al-bachtana di-!- Wa hagartuuni ana Allah.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.Wa tijiibu bahaayim al-saragtuuhum aw uruj aw mardaaniin wa tigaddumuuhum leyi dahaaya.Humman dool nakhbalhum min iideeku walla-? Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Mal'uun al-khachchaach al-indah dakar saalim fi doorah wa le yitimm wa'adah,yadbah le l-Rabb bahiime ma'duura.Ana malik kabiir wa kulla l-umam yakhaafo minni-! Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa hassa' da,ya rujaal al-diin,ana nihazzirku.
Wa kan ma tasma'ooni wa la tizzakkarooni fi guluubku le timajjudu usmi,ana nal'anku wa naj'al barakaatku la'ana.Aywa,naj'al barakaatku la'ana achaan intu ma karramtuuni fi guluubku.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa daahu nihazzir zurriiyitku wa nadrubku be ba'ar fi wujuuhku wa da l-ba'ar hana dahaaya a'yaadku.Wa yidaffuguuku barra ma'a l-ba'ar da-!
Khalaas,a'arfu kadar ana hazzartuku le nisabbit mu'aahadati ma'a zurriiyit Laawi.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa mu'aahadati ma'a l-Laawiyiin,hi hint haya wa salaam.Wa ana anteetha leehum achaan yakhaafo minni.Aywa,humman khaafo minni wa rajafo giddaami.
Wa khuchuumhum kallamo be wasaaya al-hagg wa lisaanhum ma hajja kalaam fasil.Wa humman macho ma'aayi be l-salaam wa l-adaala wa gabbalo naas katiiriin min al-zanib.
Wa ayyi raajil diin,waajib lisaanah yahfad al-ma'rafa wa min khachmah,al-cha'ab yasma'o churuut al-Tawraat achaan hu rasuul Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa laakin intu tarraftu min derbi wa waddartu naas katiiriin be ta'liimku.Wa nagadtu mu'aahadati ma'a l-Laawiyiin.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa khalaas,ana kula nisawwiiku mahguuriin wa makruuhiin giddaam kulla l-cha'ab achaan intu ma titaabu'u derbi wa tidangusu al-charii'a.
Aniina kullina,abuuna ma waahid walla-?Wa Ilaah waahid bas ma khalagaana walla-?Wa maala al-waahid yukhuun al-aakhar wa ma nihtarumu mu'aahadat Allah ma'a abbahaatna-?
Bani Yahuuza nagado al-mu'aahada wa sawwo al-haraam fi Israa'iil wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Achaan humman ma ahtaramo al-bakaan al-mukhaddas al-Allah yiriidah wa akhado awiin al-ya'abudan ilaahaat aakhariin.
Ayyi naadum al-yisawwi misil da,Allah yafsulah wa yamurgah min mujtama' zurriiyit Yaakhuub hatta kan hu yigaddim dahaaya le Allah al-Gaadir kula.
Wa daahu al-cheyy al-taani al-gaa'idiin tisawwuuh.Be dumuu'ku tamlo madbah Allah.Tabku wa taguntu achaan hu ma gaa'id yifakkir fi dahaayaaku wa ma yakhbalhum abadan min iideeku.
Wa intu gultu-:-Maala ma yakhbal dahaayaana-?-Wa da achaan Allah chaahid beenak wa been marit chabaabak al-inta khuntaha.Hi martak al-muraafgeek wa indak ma'aaha mu'aahada gawiiye.
Ma fi naadum indah agul al-yisawwi al-cheyy da.Wa waajib naadum yisawwi chunu-?Yifattich yalda iyaal fi lubb cha'ab al-Rabb.Angar'u-!Ma tukhuunu awiin chabaabku.
Wa Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil gaal-:-Ana nakrah al-talaag.Achaan kan naadum tallag martah da misil sawwa unuf wa mala khalagah be damm.Angar'u-!Ma tisawwu al-khiyaana. Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa za''altu Allah be kalaamku al-katiir.Wa intu gultu-:-Kikkeef za''alnaah be kalaamna-?-Wa za''altuuh be kalaamku al-buguul-:-Ayyi naadum kan yisawwi fasil,da adiil giddaam Allah wa l-naas al-misil dool bas Allah yiriidhum-! Wa battaan gultu-:-Al-Ilaah al-yahkim be l-adaala da gaa'id yisawwi chunu-?
Wa Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Daahu nirassil rasuuli wa hu yi'addil al-derib giddaami.Wa tawwaali,al-Rabb al-intu gaa'idiin tifattuchu be acham yadkhul fi beetah al-mukhaddas.Daahu jaayi rasuul al-mu'aahada al-gaa'idiin tarjooh.
Yaatu yagdar yahmal yoom jaytah-?Wa yaatu yagdar yagiif be tuulah wakit yibiin-?Achaan hu misil naaral-tagta' al-hadiid le yisaffuuhwa hu misil al-saabuunal-yikhassil nadiif.
Hu misil al-sayyaakhial-yagta' wa yisaffi al-fudda.Yitahhir al-Laawiyiinmisil yisaffi al-fudda wa l-dahab.Wa humman yabgo hineey Allahwa yigaddumu leyah dahaaya be l-adaala.
Wa khalaas,Allah yarda be dahaayahana naas balad Yahuuzawa sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudusmisil fi l-ayyaam al-faatowa l-siniin al-zamaan.
Wa ana nigarrib leeku le l-charii'a.Wa tawwaali,nachhad fi l-sahhaariin wa l-zannaayiin wa l-yahalfu be kidib wa l-yazulmu al-khaddaam wa l-armala wa l-atiim wa l-yakhto fi l-ajnabi.Wa humman dool kulluhum ma yakhaafo minni. Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Ana Allah ma nikhayyir.Wa be da,intu kula ya zurriiyit Yaakhuub,ma tikammulu.
Min wakit abbahaatku,intu ba''adtu min churuuti wa ma tabbagtuuhum.Gabbulu leyi wa ana kula nigabbil leeku. Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.Wa intu gultu-:-Kikkeef nigabbulu leek-?
Wa Allah gaal-:-Hal insaani yagdar yukhuchch al-Rabb walla-?Wa laakin intu khachcheetuuni wa gultu-:--Kikkeef aniina khachcheenaak-?---Wa da achaan ma kaffeetu al-uchuur wa l-zaka.
Wa be da,intu gaa'idiin tihit al-la'ana achaan khachcheetuuni ana,intu kulla l-umma.
Wa jiibu al-uchuur tamaamiin fi makhazan beeti achaan akil katiir yinlagi fi l-beet da.Wa be da,jarrubuuni wa chiifu kikkeef naftah leeku biibaan al-sama wa ninazzil leeku al-baraka al-ma indaha hadd. Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa fi chaanku,ana nidammir al-hacharaat wa abadan ma yaakulu intaaj arduku wa jineenaat inabku kula yantu intaajhum.Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa kulla l-umam yinaaduuku al-mubaarakiin achaan intu taskunu fi balad al-farah. Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa Allah gaal-:-Kalaamku diddi bigi chadiid.-Wa laakin intu gultu-:-Chunu al-kalaam al-gulna diddak-?
Wa intu gultu battaan-:-Ibaadat al-Rabb ma indaha faayde.Chunu naksabooh kan nitabbugu wasiiyaatah wa nuruukhu be hizin giddaam Allah al-Gaadir-?
Wa hassa',aniina ninaadu al-mustakbiriin bas al-mubaarakiin.Aywa,al-yisawwu al-fasaala yanjaho.Humman jarrabo al-Rabb wa be da kula,cheyy ma ja leehum.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-naas al-yakhaafo min Allah hajjo ambeenaathum.Wa Allah simi' kalaamhum adiil.Wa giddaamah,katabo fi kitaab al-zikra asaame hana l-naas al-yakhaafo min Allah wa yikarrumu usmah.
Wa Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Fi l-yoom al-nugumm foogah,humman yabgo hineeyi ana halaali.Wa nihinn fooghum misil naadum yihinn fi wileedah al-yakhdim leyah.
Wa be misil da,tichiifu min jadiid al-faraga been al-saalih wa l-aasi wa been al-ya'abud al-Rabb wa l-ma ya'abudah.
Wa Allah al-Gaadir gaal-:-Daahu al-yoom da jaayihaami misil al-furun.Wa kulla l-mustakbiriin wa l-aasiyiinyabgo misil al-gechch.Wa l-yoom al-jaayi da yahrighumwa la yikhalli leehum irig wa la firi'.
Wa laakin leeku intu al-khaayfiin minni,adaalti tatla' leeku misil al-harraaywa deyyaha yijiib al-chifa.Wa intu tamurgu wa tinattutumisil ajjaal marago min zariibithum.
Fi l-yoom al-nugumm foogah,intu tifajjukhu al-aasiyiinwa yabgo misil rumaad tihit rijleeku.-Wa da,Allah al-Gaadir bas gaalah.
Azzakkaro kitaab al-Tawraatal-anteetah le abdi Muusa fi jabal Huuriib.Wa le kulla Bani Israa'iil,anteethum gawaaniin wa churuut.
Daahu ana nirassil leeku al-nabi Iliyaaswa da gubbaal yoom Allah ma yajiwa l-yoom da aziim wa mukhiif.
Wa hu yijiib al-salaambeen al-abbahaat wa iyaalhumwa been al-iyaal wa abbahaathum.Wa misil da,ma naji nidammir al-balad.-Allah hu al-Rahmaan wa l-Rahiim wa wassaf rahmatah le kulla l-naas be jayyit Isa al-Masiih (salaamahu aleyna).Wa Allah yihaasib kulla l-naas wa hu bas al-yagdar yantiihum al-naja.Wa l-hamdulillah,Allah rassal Isa al-Masiih fi l-dunya achaan yaftah le l-naas derib al-khufraan
