wa l-naja.Hu sawwa al-suluh been al-muznibiin wa Allah.Wa be l-Masiih,Allah yantiihum haya abadiiye.Wa fi l-haya di,al-naas yadkhulu fi alaakha jadiide ma'a Allah wa ya'arfu mahabbitah al-kabiire.Wa l-kitaab da usmah al-Ahad al-Jadiid ma'anaatah al-mu'aahada al-jadiide.Wa battaan ma'ruuf be Injiil al-Masiih.Al-kilme Injiil jaat min al-lukhkha al-yuunaaniiye wa ma'anaatha al-bichaara ya'ni al-khabar al-halu.Wa l-khabar al-halu al-fi l-kitaab da bukhuss al-rahma al-Allah rassalaaha fi l-Masiih le kulla l-naas.Wa l-Injiil da hu kalaam Allah.Fi guluub al-rusul,Allah nazzal al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan yaktubu kalaamah be iznah wa be gudurtah.Wa l-kitaab da tarjamooh be kalaam arab daariji achaan al-naas yafhamooh wa yalgo minnah faayde.Tarjamooh min al-lukhkha al-asliiye wa hi al-lukhkha al-yuunaaniiye.Kan ma fihimnaah,abadan ma nalgo minnah faayde.Wa kan fihimnaah wa ma tabbagnaah,al-kalaam da yachhad foogna fi yoom al-Hisaab.Wa Allah yidoor al-naas yitarjumu kalaamah achaan kulla l-naas yafhamooh wa yitaabu'uuh wa yalgo minnah baraka.Allah hu akbar-!Al-Ahad al-Jadiid indah arba'a juzu.Al-juzu al-awwal yihajji be taariikh al-Masiih fi l-ard wa ta'liimah wa ajaaybah wa mootah fi l-saliib wa bu'aasah al-majiid.Al-juzu da mukawwan min 4 kutub.Al-kitaab al-awwal da binaaduuh Kitaab Matta min Injiil al-Masiih.Wa naas katiiriin yinaaduuh Injiil Matta laakin be l-sahiih al-Injiil da ma hana Matta.Hu hana l-Masiih wa tilmiizah Matta katab al-kitaab bas be izin Allah wa be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa ba'ad al-kitaab da,talgo al-kutub al-kataboohum Markhus wa Luukha wa Yuuhanna.Wa l-juzu al-taani usmah kitaab A'maal al-Rusul.Wa l-rusul dool,humman al-rujaal al-Isa al-Masiih ja'alaahum rusulah wa rassalaahum achaan yiballukhu al-bichaara le kulla l-umam.Wa kitaab A'maal al-Rusul da yi'ooriina kikkeef humman bado khidmithum wa kikkeef al-Ruuh al-Khudduus gaa'id ma'aahum wa yakhdim beehum.Wa l-juzu al-taalit indah 21 jawaab.Wa l-kalaam al-gaa'id fi lubbuhum,hu al-ta'liim al-rassalooh rusul al-Masiih le l-mu'miniin.Al-rusul katabo al-jawaabaat dool be izin Allah wa be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa l-rusul dool humman Buulus wa Yaakhuub wa Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yahuuza.Wa be rahmat Allah,ayyi mu'min yalga faayde kabiire min al-jawaabaat dool.Wa l-juzu al-raabi' wa l-akhiir hana l-Ahad al-Jadiid,usmah kitaab al-Ru'ya.Wa di l-ru'ya al-Allah wassafha le l-rasuul Yuuhanna achaan yaktibha.Wa kitaab al-Ru'ya da yihajji katiir be haal al-mu'miniin wa ta'abhum fi kumaalit al-dunya.Wa naas katiiriin yas'alo wa yuguulu-:-Isa al-Masiih da,hu yaatu-?Hal al-Injiil al-Allah antaana yuguul Isa al-Masiih hu Ibn Allah-? Wa l-su'aal da muhimm.Isa al-Masiih indah asaame katiiriin wa ayyi usum indah ma'ana muhimm le l-naas wa kulla l-asaame dool ma induhum eeb.Wa l-Injiil yuguul Isa hu Ibn Ibraahiim wa Ibn Dawuud wa Ibn al-Insaan wa Ibn Allah.Wa battaan usmah Kalimat Allah wa Hamal Allah wa Raajil al-Diin al-Kabiir wa Nuur al-Aalam wa l-Munajji wa indah asaame aakhariin kula.Be kalaam ibraani lukhkhat al-Yahuud,usum Isa da Yachuu' wa ma'anaatah Allah yinajji.Wa kan naadum yidoor yafham ma'ana al-asaame dool wa ya'arif al-Masiih hu yaatu,khalli yagri al-Injiil be galib faatih.Wa Allah yarhamah wa yiwassifah al-hagg wa yiwassifah kikkeef yalga al-baraka al-Allah yantiiha be l-Masiih.Aamiin.Al-hamdulillah,al-Injiil be l-lukhkha al-asliiye mawjuud lahaddi al-yoom.Wa be da,al-naas yagdaro yagru al-kalaam al-asli wa yitarjumuuh be lukhkhaathum.Wa l-suura di tiwassif nuskha min kitaab 2 Kuruntus be l-lukhkha al-asliiye hana l-Ahad al-Jadiid ya'ni be kalaam yuunaani.Wa l-nuskha di gadiime,indaha hawaale 200 sana ba'ad waaluudit Isa al-Masiih.
Daahu gurma hana juduud Isa al-Masiih ibn Dawuud ibn Ibraahiim.
Ibraahiim wilid Ishaakhwa Ishaakh wilid Yaakhuubwa Yaakhuub wilid Yahuuza wa akhwaanah.
Wa Yahuuza wilid Faaris wa Zaarah wa ammuhum Taamaar.Wa Faaris wilid Hasruun.Wa Hasruun wilid Raam.
Wa Raam wilid Aminadaab.Wa Aminadaab wilid Nahchuun.Wa Nahchuun wilid Salmuun.
Wa Salmuun wilid Bu'aaz wa amm Bu'aaz hi Raahaab.Wa Bu'aaz wilid Ubeed wa amm Ubeed hi Ra'uus.Wa Ubeed wilid Yassa.
Wa Yassa wilid Dawuud al-malik.Wa Dawuud wilid Suleymaan wa amm Suleymaan,awwal hi marit Uriiya.
Wa Suleymaan wilid Rahab'aam.Wa Rahab'aam wilid Abiiya.Wa Abiiya wilid Asa.
Wa Asa wilid Yahuuchafat.Wa Yahuuchafat wilid Yuuraam.Wa Yuuraam wilid Uzziiya.
Wa Uzziiya wilid Yuutaam.Wa Yuutaam wilid Ahaaz.Wa Ahaaz wilid Hizkhiiya.
Wa Hizkhiiya wilid Manassa.Wa Manassa wilid Aamuun.Wa Aamuun wilid Yuuchiiya.
Wa Yuuchiiya wilid Yuyakiin wa akhwaanah wa da fi l-zaman al-foogah waddo Bani Israa'iil fi l-khurba fi balad Baabil.
Wa ba'ad waddoohum fi Baabil,Yuyakiin wilid Chaltiyiil.Wa Chaltiyiil wilid Zarubaabil.
Wa Zarubaabil wilid Abihuud.Wa Abihuud wilid Aliyaakhim.Wa Aliyaakhim wilid Azuur.
Wa Azuur wilid Saduukh.Wa Saduukh wilid Akhiim.Wa Akhiim wilid Aliyuud.
Wa Aliyuud wilid Ali'aazar.Wa Ali'aazar wilid Mattaan.Wa Mattaan wilid Yaakhuub.
Wa Yaakhuub wilid Yuusuf.Wa Yuusuf da raajil Mariyam wa Mariyam wildat Isa al-binaaduuh al-Masiih.
Wa khalaas min Ibraahiim lahaddi Dawuud,hasabo 14 juduud.Wa min Dawuud lahaddi l-wakit al-waddo foogah al-Yahuud fi Baabil,hasabo 14 juduud.Wa min wakit waddo al-Yahuud fi Baabil lahaddi waaluudit al-Masiih,hasabo 14 juduud.
Daahu taariikh waaluudit Isa al-Masiih.Wa ammah usumha Mariyam wa Mariyam di hi bineeye udriiye wa raajil waahid usmah Yuusuf karab raasha.Wa gubbaal ma yichiilha,hi bigat khalbaane be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa Yuusuf raajilha da,hu naadum saalih wa ma yidoor yi'ayyibha giddaam al-naas.Wa achaan da,hu chaal niiye yitalligha be achiir.
Wa wakit hu lissaa' gaa'id yifakkir fi l-kalaam da,waahid min malaa'ikat Allah ja leyah fi ru'ya wa gaal-:-Ya Yuusuf wileed Dawuud,ma takhaaf.Chiil Mariyam fi beetak wa khalli tabga martak achaan al-sakhiir al-fi batunha da,ja be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa hi talda wileed wa inta tisammiih Isaachaan hu bas al-naadum al-yinajji cha'abah min zunuubhum.
Wa kulla yabga misil da achaan al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah be khachum al-nabi yitimm-:
﴾‍Al-bineeye al-udriiye tabga khalbaane wa talda wileed wa yisammuuh Immaanuwiil.‍﴿Wa usum Immaanuwiil ma'anaatah Allah ma'aana.
Wa wakit Yuusuf gamma min al-noom,hu sawwa al-cheyy al-malak Allah gaalah leyah wa chaal martah fi beetah.
Wa laakin ma limisha lahaddi wildat wileed wa sammaah Isa.
Wildo Isa fi hillit Beet Laham fi daar al-Yahuudiiya fi zaman al-malik Hiruudus.Wa ba'ad wildooh,musaafiriin waahidiin jo le Madiinat al-Khudus min sabaah.Wa humman munajjimiin.
Wa sa'alo al-naas wa gaalo-:-Ween malik al-Yahuud al-dahaabah wildooh-?Chifna najmatah ale l-sabaah wa jiina achaan nasjudu leyah.
Wa l-malik Hiruudus simi' al-kalaam da wa barjal.Wa kulla naas Madiinat al-Khudus barjalo ma'aayah.
Wa l-malik naada kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama achaan yilimmu giddaamah.Wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Ween al-bakaan al-yaldo foogah al-Masiih-?
Wa humman raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Yaldooh fi Beet Laham fi daar al-Yahuudiiya achaan kalaam al-nabi al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab buguul-:
﴾‍Ya Beet Laham fi daar Bani Yahuuza,inti ma hille al-askhar le hukkaam Yahuuzaachaan naadum waahid yamrug minkiwa hu al-haakim al-yabga raa'ile ummati Bani Israa'iil.‍﴿
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Hiruudus naada al-munajjimiin be achiir wa sa'alaahum achaan ya'arif minhum al-yoom al-awwal al-baanat foogah al-najma.
Wa wakit simi' kalaamhum,rassalaahum le Beet Laham wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu wa fattuchu adiil.Wa wakit ligiitu al-sakhiir,ta'aalu ooruuni achaan ana kula namchi nasjud leyah.
Wa wakit sim'o kalaam al-malik,chaalo al-derib wa faato.Wa chaafo al-najma al-chaafooha awwal ale l-sabaah wa hi tazhaf giddaamhum lahaddi wigfat fi l-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah al-wileed.
Wa wakit chaafo al-najma,humman bigo farhaaniin marra waahid.
Wa dakhalo fi lubb al-beet wa ligo al-sakhiir ma'a ammah Mariyam wa sajado leyah.Wa jaabo hadaaya khaaliyiin wa fakkoohum wa gaddamoohum le Isa.Antooh dahab wa dukhkhaan wa lubaan wa sibir.
Wa Allah hajja leehum fi hilim wa ooraahum ma waajib yigabbulu le Hiruudus wa khalaas,gabbalo daarhum be derib aakhar.
Ba'ad al-munajjimiin faato khalaas,waahid min malaa'ikat Allah ja le Yuusuf fi hilim wa gaal leyah-:-Yalla gumm-!Chiil al-sakhiir wa ammah wa amchi beehum fi Masir.Agood hinaak wa ma tigabbil lahaddi nantiik izin.Achaan Hiruudus yifattich al-sakhiir wa yidoor yaktulah.
Wa Yuusuf gamma be leel wa chaal al-sakhiir wa ammah wa jara beehum le Masir.
Wa ga'ad hinaak lahaddi Hiruudus maat.Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah zamaan be khachum al-nabi tamma-:﴾‍Min Masir ana naadeet Ibni.‍﴿
Wakit Hiruudus irif al-munajjimiin khachchooh,hu bigi za'laan bilheen.Wa fakkar fi l-kalaam al-gaalooh leyah fi wakit al-najma baanat foogah wa rassal askarah fi Beet Laham wa l-hillaal al-jambaha.Wa amaraahum achaan yaktulu ayyi wileed al-umrah naagis min santeen.
Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah zamaan be khachum al-nabi Irmiya tamma.
Hu gaal-:﴾‍Ansama' hiss fi hillit al-Raama,baki chadiid wa nuwaah.Wa di Raahiil gaa'ide tabki le iyaalhawa abat al-sabbiriinachaan humman maato khalaas.‍﴿
Wa wakit Hiruudus maat,Yuusuf gaa'id fi Masir wa waahid min malaa'ikat Allah ja leyah fi hilim.
Wa gaal-:-Gumm-!Chiil al-sakhiir wa ammah wa gabbil beehum fi daar Israa'iil achaan al-naas al-dawwaro yaktulu al-sakhiir maato khalaas.
Wa Yuusuf gamma wa chaal al-sakhiir wa ammah wa gabbal beehum fi daar Israa'iil.
Wa laakin Arkhalaawus bigi malik fi daar al-Yahuudiiya fi badal abuuh Hiruudus.Wa min Yuusuf simi' al-khabar da,khaaf wa ma dawwar yamchi hinaak.Wa Allah kallam leyah fi hilim wa hu chaal derib hana daar al-Jaliil.
Wa wisil fi hille waahide al-usumha al-Naasira wa ga'ad hinaak.Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-anbiya gaalo tamma.Gaalo-:﴾‍Yinaaduuh al-Naasiri.‍﴿
Fi l-zaman daak,Yahya al-Mukhattis ja yibachchir al-naas fi kadaadit daar al-Yahuudiiya.
Wa yuguul-:-Yalla-!Tuubu min zunuubku-!Achaan mamlakat Allah garrabat.
Wa Yahya hu al-naadum al-hajja beyah zamaan al-nabi Icha'ya.Wa l-nabi gaal-:﴾‍Fi hiss gaa'id yi'iit fi l-khalawa yuguul-:-Jahhuzu derib al-Rabb waaddulu leyah al-turug.‍﴿
Wa Yahya laabis khalag min suuf albil wa raabit sulbah be seer wa gaa'id yaakul jaraad wa asal al-nahal.
Wa naas marago wa macho leyah min Madiinat al-Khudus wa min kulla daar al-Yahuudiiya wa min kulla l-hillaal al-jamb bahar al-Urdun.
Wa a'tarafo be zunuubhum wa Yahya khattasaahum fi bahar al-Urdun.
Wa Yahya chaaf ambeenaathum naas katiiriin min al-Fariiziyiin wa l-Sadduukhiyiin.Wa humman maachiin leyah achaan hu yikhattishum.Wa gaal leehum-:-Ya iyaal al-daabi-!Yaatu al-gaal leeku ajru min al-azaab al-jaayi-?
Sawwu al-amal al-yiwassif kadar intu tubtu be l-sahiih-!
Wa ma tukhuchchu nufuusku.Ma tuguulu-:--Ma indina eeb achaan aniina iyaal Ibraahiim.- Nuguul leeku Allah yagdar yichiil hujaar min al-turaab wa yisawwi minhum iyaal le Ibraahiim fi badalku-!
Chiifu,al-faas jaahize le tagta' al-chadara min irigha.Ayyi chadara al-ma talda iyaal adiiliin yagta'ooha wa yazguluuha fi l-naar.
Ana nikhattisku be almi achaan intu tubtu min zunuubku.Wa laakin naadum waahid jaayi waraayi gaadir minni bilheen wa ana ma tammeet leyah khaddaam kula.Wa hu yikhattisku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa be naar.
Wa indah tabag fi iideenah le yikharbilku misil al-khalla.Wa yilimm khallitah min al-madagg wa yusubbaha fi dabangitah.Wa laakin al-uttaab yutuchchah fi l-naar al-ma tumuut abadan.
Wa Isa marag min daar al-Jaliil wa macha fi bahar al-Urdun achaan Yahya yikhattisah.
Wa laakin Yahya bada yaaba wa gaal-:-Waajib ana naji leek achaan inta tikhattisni-!Wa kikkeef tidoor ana nikhattisak-?
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Ma taaba.Khalli yabga misil da achaan nitimmu kulla cheyy al-Allah bidoorah. Wa khalaas,Yahya khassad wa khattasah.
Wa wakit khattasah khalaas,Isa gamma min al-almi wa tawwaali al-samaawaat anfataho wa chaaf Ruuh Allah jaayi min al-sama wa nazal foogah misil hamaama.
Wa hiss min al-sama ansama' wa gaal-:-Da bas Ibni wa ana nihibbah.Ana farhaan beyah bilheen.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wadda Isa fi l-khala achaan Ibliis yijarribah.
Wa hu saayim leel wa nahaar 40 yoom wa ba'ad da,juu' sawwaah.
Wa Ibliis al-mujarrib ja leyah wa gaal-:-Kan sahiih inta Ibn Allah,guul le l-hujaar al-dugaag dool yabgo leek akil.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Maktuub fi Kitaab Allah-:﴾‍Al-insaan ma yi'iich be l-akil wiheedah laakin yi'iich be kulli kilme al-yuguulha Allah.‍﴿
Wa Ibliis waddaah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa khattaah fi bakaan aali fi raas beet Allah.
Wa gaal leyah-:-Kan sahiih inta Ibn Allah,nutt aga' tihit achaan fi l-Kitaab maktuub-:﴾‍Allah yaamur malaa'ikatah achaan yahfadook.Yichiiluuk fi iideehum achaan rijileenak ma yintaggo fi hajar.‍﴿
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Wa kula maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Ma tijarrib Allah Ilaahak.‍﴿
Wa Ibliis waddaah battaan wa khattaah fi raas hajar tawiil bilheen wa wassaf leyah kulla l-mamaalik al-fi l-dunya wa darajathum.
Wa gaal le Isa-:-Nantiik kulluhum ke kan inta tasjud giddaami wa ta'abudni.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Amchi minni ba'iid,ya Cheetaan,achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Le Allah Ilaahak bas tasjud wa hu wiheedah bas ta'abudah.‍﴿
Wa khalaas Ibliis khallaah wa malaa'ika jo le Isa wa saa'adooh.
Wa Yahya karabooh fi l-sijin.Wa Isa simi' al-khabar da wa gabbal fi daar al-Jaliil.
Wa khalla hillit al-Naasira wa macha sakan fi hillit Kafar Naahuum al-gaa'ide jamb al-bahar fi turaab Bani Zabuluun wa turaab Bani Naftaali.
Wa macha hinaak achaan misil da,al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah be khachum al-nabi Icha'ya yitimm.Al-nabi gaal-:
﴾‍Turaab Bani Zabuluunwa turaab Bani Naftaaligaa'id fi l-derib jamb al-baharwa khaadi le bahar al-Urdunwa hu turaab hana daar al-Jaliilwa hi daar al-ajaanib.
Hinaak al-cha'ab al-gaa'idiin fi l-dalaamchaafo nuur aziimwa l-saakniin fi balad al-dalaam al-haalik,nuur tala' leehum.‍﴿
Wa min al-wakit daak,Isa bada yiballikh kalaam Allah wa gaal-:-Tuubu min zunuubku-!Achaan mamlakat Allah garrabat.
Wa wakit Isa raayikh fi khachum bahar al-Jaliil,hu chaaf akhwaan itneen wa humman Sim'aan al-binaaduuh Butrus wa akhuuh Andareeyas.Wa humman hawwaatiin wa gaa'idiin yazgulu charakhum fi l-bahar achaan yakurbu huut.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Ta'aalu taabu'uuni.Awwal intu gaa'idiin takurbu huut wa laakin min al-yoom ana nisawwiiku takurbu al-naas le tiwassufuuhum derib Allah.
Wa tawwaali khallo charakhum wa gammo taaba'ooh.
Wa Isa macha giddaam chiyya wa chaaf akhwaan itneen aakhariin wa humman Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna awlaad Zabadi.Humman gaa'idiin fi l-markaba ma'a abuuhum wa gaa'idiin yi'addulu charakhum.Wa Isa naadaahum achaan yitaabu'uuh.
Wa tawwaali khallo al-markaba wa abuuhum wa taaba'o Isa.
Wa Isa gamma raakh fi kulla bakaan hana daar al-Jaliil wa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi buyuut al-sala wa yibachchir leehum bichaarat mamlakat Allah.Wa gaa'id yachfiihum min ayyi waja' wa ayyi marad al-fi lubb al-cha'ab.
Wa usmah tala' fi kulla balad Suuriya wa naas jaabo leyah akhwaanhum al-ma'duuriin wa l-ta'baaniin min ayyi marad.Jaabo al-muchootiniin wa l-naas al-induhum amfitfit wa l-naas al-jilidhum mayyit wa daawaahum kulluhum.
Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid taaba'ooh.Wa l-naas dool jo min daar al-Jaliil wa min al-Mudun al-Achara wa min Madiinat al-Khudus wa min daar al-Yahuudiiya wa min al-buldaan al-khaadi le bahar al-Urdun.
Wa wakit Isa chaaf naas katiiriin yidooru yasma'o kalaamah,hu tala' fi l-hajar wa ga'ad tihit wa talaamiizah jo leyah.
Wa bada yi'allimhum wa gaal-:
Mabruuk le l-naas al-ya'arfu nufuushum masaakiin giddaam Allahachaan mamlakat Allah hintuhum.
Mabruuk le l-naas al-haznaaniinachaan Allah yisabbirhum.
Mabruuk le l-naas al-daluuliinachaan humman yawrusu al-ard.
Mabruuk le l-naas al-atchaaniin wa jii'aaniin le l-adaalaachaan Allah yichabbi'hum.
Mabruuk le l-naas al-yarhamo akhwaanhumachaan humman yalgo rahma min Allah.
Mabruuk le l-naas al-galibhum taahirachaan humman yichiifu Allah.
Mabruuk le l-naas al-yijiibu al-salaamachaan Allah yaj'alhum iyaalah.
Mabruuk le l-naas al-yita''ubuuhum fi chaan al-adaalaachaan mamlakat Allah hintuhum.
Mabruuk leeku intu wakit al-naas yi'ayyuruuku wa yaturduuku wa be l-kidib yukhuttu foogku kalaam cheen achaan intu talaamiizi.
Afraho wa anbastu ziyaada achaan ajurku fi l-sama yabga katiir bilheen.Achaan awwal al-naas ta''abo al-anbiya al-jo gubbaalku.Wa khalaas intu kula tabgo misilhum.
Intu misil mileh le naas al-ard.Wa kan ta'aam al-mileh bigi ma fiih,chunu yigabbilah-?Ma indah faayde wa khalaas yidaffuguuh barra wa l-naas yifajjukhuuh.
Wa intu nuur le naas al-dunya.Kan hille kabiire gaa'ide fi raas hajar,ma mumkin yilabbuduuha.
Wa l-naas ma yi'oogudu faanuus wa yidissuuh fi tihit doozam laakin yukhuttuuh fi bakaan foog achaan yidawwi le kulla l-naas al-fi l-beet.
Wa misil da,khallu nuurku yidawwi giddaam al-naas.Wa khalluuhum yichiifu khidmitku al-samhe wa yachkuru abuuku Allah al-gaa'id fi l-samaawaat.
Ma tifakkuru ana jiit achaan nibattil al-Tawraat wa la kutub al-anbiya.Ana ma jiit achaan nibattilhum laakin achaan nitammimhum.
Nuguul leeku al-hagg,harif waahid ma yingachcha min al-Tawraat wa la nugta waahide kula lahaddi l-sama wa l-ard yabgo ma fiihum wa kulla cheyy yitimm.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yikhaalif wasiiye min al-wasaaya dool,kan hi sakhayre kula,kan yi'allim akhwaanah yisawwu nafs al-cheyy,khalaas yaj'alo al-naadum da sakhayyar fi mamlakat Allah.Wa laakin al-naadum al-yitabbig al-wasaaya dool wa yi'allimhum le akhwaanah,yaj'alooh kabiir fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa nuguul leeku kan intu ma bigiitu saalihiin ziyaada min al-ulama wa l-Fariiziyiin,abadan ma tadkhulu fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa intu simi'tu Allah kallam le naas al-zamaan wa gaal-:﴾‍Ma taktul dimme‍﴿wa﴾‍Al-naadum al-katal dimme,waajib yichaaru'uuh.‍﴿
Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku ayyi naadum al-za'laan min akhuuh,waajib yichaaru'uuh.Wa ayyi naadum al-yuguul le akhuuh-:--Inta ajami--,waajib yigaddumuuh giddaam al-majlas al-kabiir.Wa ayyi naadum al-yuguul le akhuuh-:--Inta jaahil--,waajib yazguluuh fi naar Jahannam.
Wa kan jiit tigaddim dahiiye fi l-madbah wa hinaak bas fakkart kadar akhuuk indah ma'aak muchkila,
khalli dahiiytak fi l-madbah wa amchi ajala wa assaamaho ma'a akhuuk.Wa ba'ad da bas,gabbil wa gaddim dahiiytak le Allah.
Wa kan naadum madluum foogak,yalla assaamaho ma'aayah ajala wakit intu lissaa' fi l-derib wa gubbaal ma tawsalo fi bakaan al-charii'a.Assaamaho ma'aayah gubbaal ma yiwaddiik le l-gaadi achaan al-gaadi ma yiwaddiik le l-askar wa yakurbuuk wa yidissuuk fi l-sijin.
Nuguul leek al-hagg,inta ma tamrug illa kan kaffeet kulla l-gurus al-yidooruuh minnak.
Simi'tu Allah gaal-:﴾‍Ma tazna.‍﴿
Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku ayyi raajil al-gaa'id yichiif mara be chahwa,hu zanaaha khalaas fi galbah.
Wa kan eenak al-zeene tidoor tamurgak min al-derib al-adiil,sillaha-!Azgulha ba'iid minnak-!Achaan kan waddart cheyy waahid min jismak akheer leek min yazgulu kulla jismak fi naar Jahannam.
Wa kan iidak al-zeene tidoor tamurgak min al-derib al-adiil,agta'ha-!Azgulha ba'iid minnak achaan kan waddart cheyy waahid min jismak akheer leek min yazgulu kulla jismak fi naar Jahannam.
Wa battaan gaalo leeku-:﴾‍Ayyi naadum al-tallag martah waajib yantiiha maktuub hana talaag.‍﴿
Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku ayyi naadum al-yitallig martah ma be sabab al-zina,yisawwiiha zaaniye.Wa l-naadum al-yaakhud al-mara al-mutallaga,hu zaani.
Simi'tu gaalo le naas al-zamaan-:﴾‍Ma tibattil haliiftak laakin al-nazir al-inta sawweetah le Allah,da bas waajib titimmah.‍﴿
Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku ma tahlif abadan wa la be l-sama achaan hu kursi Allah
wa la be l-ard achaan da bakaan rijileenah wa la be Madiinat al-Khudus achaan hi madiinat al-Malik al-aziim.
Wa ma tahlif be raasak achaan ma tagdar tisawwi suufaay waahide beeda walla zarga.
Kan kalaamak --Aywa--,guul --Aywa--.Wa kan kalaamak --La--,guul --La--.Wa ayyi kalaam al-ziyaada min da jaayi min charr Ibliis.
Simi'tu gaalo-:﴾‍Een be een wa sinn be sinn.‍﴿
Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku ma tigabbil al-fasil le l-naadum al-sawwa leek al-fasil.Wa kan naadum daggaak fi chidgak al-zeene,antiih al-isra kula.
Wa kan naadum yiwaddiik le l-charii'a achaan yichiil jawwaaniiytak,khalaas khalli yichiil jallaabiiytak kula.
Wa kan naadum jabaraak achaan tiwaddi khumaamah masaafa gariibe,khalaas ziid leyah masaafa aakhara.
Wa kan naadum sa'al minnak chokhol,antiih.Wa kan naadum yas'al minnak deen,ma tigabbilah yaabis.
Simi'tu gaalo-:--Hibb akhuuk wa akrah aduuk.--
Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku hibbu aduuku wa as'alo Allah be l-kheer le l-naas al-yita''ubuuku wa yaturduuku.
Wa kan tisawwu misil da,intu tabgo iyaal abuuku Allah.Achaan hu yamrug al-harraay le l-naas al-fasliin wa le l-naas al-saalihiin kula.Wa yikhalli al-matar yusubb le l-naas al-adiiliin wa le l-naas al-ma adiiliin kula.
Wa kan tihibbu al-naas al-yihibbuuku bas,ajurku chunu-?Naas al-fasliin al-yichiilu al-miiri,humman ma yihibbu al-naas al-yihibbuuhum walla-?
Wa kan intu tisallumu akhwaanku bas,intu ma tisawwu kheer ziyaada min ayyi naadum.Al-naas al-ma mu'miniin kula ma yisawwu nafs al-cheyy walla-?
Khalaas,abgo naas kaamiliin misil Allah abuuku fi l-sama kaamil.
Aw'u baalku.Kan tisawwu amal diinku giddaam al-naas achaan tidooru humman yichiifuuku bas,da ma yanfa'.Ma talgo ajur min abuuku Allah al-fi l-sama.
Wakit tanti sadakha le naadum miskiin,ma tisawwi haraka katiire misil al-munaafikhiin.Humman yantu sadakha fi buyuut al-sala wa fi l-chawaari' achaan al-naas yachkuruuhum.Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ma yalgo ajur illa l-chukur al-ligooh min al-naas.
Laakin inta wakit tanti sadakha,ma tikhalli iidak al-isra ta'arif al-cheyy al-iidak al-zeene gaa'ide tisawwiih.
Wa misil da,wakit tanti sadakha ma tikhalli naadum waahid ya'arfah wa abuuk Allah al-yichiif al-cheyy al-naas ma yichiifuuh,hu bas yantiik ajrak.
Wa wakit tisallu,ma tisallu misil al-munaafikhiin.Humman yiriidu yisallu fi buyuut al-sala wa fi l-chawaari' achaan al-naas yichiifuuhum.Nuguul leeku al-hagg,humman ma yalgo ajur illa l-chukur al-yalgooh min al-naas.
Wa laakin inta,wakit tidoor tisalli,amchi daakhal fi beetak wa sidd baabak wa salli le Allah abuuk al-ma binchaaf.Wa abuuk Allah al-bichiif al-cheyy al-naas ma bichiifuuh,hu bas yantiik ajrak.
Wa wakit tisallu ma tiraddudu kalaam al-ma indah faayde misil al-naas al-ma ya'arfu Allah.Fi fikirhum,Allah ma yasma' kalaamhum illa kan kalaamhum bigi katiir.
Ma tabgo misilhum achaan al-cheyy al-intu tidooruuh,Allah ya'arfah gubbaal ma tas'alooh.
Khalaas,sallu misil al-sala di.Ya Abuuna al-fi l-samaawaat,khalli ya'arfu kadar usmak khudduus.
Khalli mamlakatak taji.Khalli yitabbugu kalaamak fi l-ardmisil tabbagooh fi l-sama.
Antiina al-akilal-yitimmina kulla yoom.
Saamih leena khataanamisil aniina gaa'idiin nisaamuhual-naas al-khito foogna.
Ma tidissina fi l-tajribalaakin najjiina min charr Ibliis.Wa leek inta basal-muluk wa l-gudra wa l-majddaayman wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Kan intu saamahtu al-naas al-khito foogku,Allah abuuku fi l-sama yisaamihku.
Wa laakin kan intu ma saamahtu al-naas al-khito foogku,abuuku Allah ma yisaamih leeku khataayaaku.
Wa wakit tusuumu,ma tarbutu wujuuhku misil al-munaafikhiin.Humman yikarchumu wujuuhhum achaan yidooru al-naas ya'arfu humman saaymiin.Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ma yalgo ajur illa l-chukur al-ligooh min al-naas.
Wa laakin wakit inta saayim,khassil wijhak wa amsah raasak be itir
achaan naadum ma ya'arif kadar inta saayim illa abuuk Allah al-ma yinchaaf.Wa abuuk Allah,al-yichiif al-cheyy al-naas ma yichiifuuh,hu bas yantiik ajrak.
Ma tudummu al-maal fi l-ard achaan hini fi l-ard al-arda wa l-sagar bitallufuuh wa l-saraariig yadkhulu yasurguuh.
Akheer tudummu al-maal fi bakaan Allah fi l-samaawaat.Hinaak al-arda wa l-sagar ma bitallufuuh wa l-saraariig ma yadkhulu yasurguuh.
Achaan al-bakaan al-maalak gaa'id foogah,da bas al-bakaan al-galbak gaa'id foogah.
Al-een hi faanuus al-jilid.Kan eenak taybe,inta gaa'id fi l-nuur.
Wa kan eenak talfaane,inta gaa'id fi l-dalaam.Wa kan nuurak bigi adlam,inta gaa'id fi dalaam azrag marra waahid.
Ma mumkin naadum yabga abid le siyaad itneen.Achaan hu yakrah al-awwal wa yiriid al-taani walla yihibbah le l-awwal be kulla galbah wa yahgir al-taani.Wa intu kula,ma tagdaro tabgo abiid le Allah wa abiid le l-maal.
Wa fi chaan da,nuguul leeku ma tihimmu le hayaatku fi chaan al-akil wa l-charaab wa ma tihimmu le jilidku fi chaan al-khulgaan.Al-haya ma akheer min al-akil walla-?Wa l-jilid ma akheer min al-khulgaan walla-?
Chiifu al-tuyuur wa fakkuru fooghum.Humman ma yiteerubu wa la yahartu wa la yagta'o wa la yakhzunu wa laakin Allah abuuku fi l-sama yi'ayyichhum.Wa intu ma akheer ziyaada le Allah min al-tuyuur walla-?
Wa kan naadum minku yihimm katiir kula,al-hamm da ma yagdar yiziid umrah be saa'a waahide kula.
Wa maala tihimmu fi chaan al-khulgaan-?Chiifu al-nuwwaar fi l-kadaade wa fakkuru kikkeef yugumm.Ma yakhdim wa ma yisawwi kiswe.
Wa laakin nuguul leeku akiid al-malik Suleymaan zaatah fi darajatah al-kabiire abadan ma libis khalag jamiil misil jamaal al-nuwwaar da.
Wa kan Allah yilabbis gechch al-kadaade be nuwwaar jamiil wa l-gechch da gaa'id al-yoom wa ambaakir yagta'ooh wa yazguluuh fi l-naar,akiid Allah yilabbisku intu.Chiddu heelku intu al-iimaanku lissaa' da'iif.
Khalaas,ma tihimmu wa ma tas'alo nufuusku --Naakulu chunu-?Nacharbo chunu-?Nalbaso chunu-?--
Kulla l-naas al-ma mu'miniin khaattiin baalhum fi l-achya dool wa Allah abuuku fi l-sama ya'arif kulla cheyy al-intu tidooruuh.
Wa laakin intu gubbaal kulla cheyy,khuttu baalku fi mamlakat Allah wa fi l-haal al-saalhe al-Allah yidoorha wa Allah yantiiku kulla cheyy hana hayaatku.
Ma tihimmu le kalaam hana ambaakir.Ambaakir zaatah yihimm le nafsah.Ta'ab hana yoom waahid yakfi le yoom waahid.
Ma tihaakumu al-naas achaan Allah ma yihaakimku.
Achaan misil intu tihaakumu al-naas,misil da bas Allah yihaakimku.Hu yikiil leeku be nafs al-mikyaal al-intu tikiilu beyah le l-naas.
Kikkeef tichiif gechchaay fi een akhuuk wa laakin ma tichiif al-uud al-kabiir al-gaa'id fi eenak inta-?
Walla kikkeef tuguul le akhuuk-:--Khalliini nisill al-gechchaay min eenak-- wa l-uud lissaa' gaa'id fi eenak-?
Ya l-munaafikh,awwal ke sill al-uud al-fi eenak inta wa misil da tichiif adiil wa khalaas tagdar tisill al-gechchaay al-fi een akhuuk.
Ma tantu chokhol mukhaddas le kulaab wa la tidaffugu cheyy jamiil le khanaaziir.Achaan al-khanaaziir yifajjukhuuh bas wa l-kulaab yigabbulu wa yaakuluuku.
As'alo Allah wa hu yantiiku.Fattuchu wa talgo.Duggu baab Allah wa yinfatih leeku.
Achaan ayyi naadum al-yas'al,Allah yantiih.Wa ayyi naadum al-yifattich,yalga.Wa ayyi naadum al-budugg baab Allah,al-baab yinfatih leyah.
Hal fi naadum minku kan wileedah yatlub minnah eech,yantiih hajar walla-?
Wa kan wileedah yatlub minnah huutaay,yantiih daabi walla-?
Sahiih,intu muznibiin wa laakin ta'arfu kikkeef tantu chokhol sameh le iyaalku.Wa akiid abuuku Allah akheer ziyaada minku.Wa kikkeef hu ma yanti chokhol sameh le l-naas al-yas'alooh-?
Wa khalaas,al-cheyy al-tidooru al-naas yisawwuuh leeku,da bas al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwuuh le l-naas.Wa di bas zibdit kalaam al-Tawraat wa l-anbiya.
Adkhulu be l-baab al-dayyig.ِAchaan al-baab al-yiwaddi al-naas le l-halaak,hu wasii' wa cheeliinah hayyin.Wa naas katiiriin yadkhulu beyah.
Wa laakin al-derib al-yiwaddi al-naas le l-haya,hu gaasi bilheen wa baabah dayyig marra waahid.Wa naas chiyya bas yamchu aleyah.
Angar'u min al-naas al-yisawwu nufuushum anbiya.Yaju leeku daluuliin misil iyaal khanam wa laakin fi guluubhum humman misil maraaf'iin al-yidooru yaakuluuku.
Ta'arfu nafar hana chadara min iyaalha wa ta'arfu al-kaddaabiin dool min khidmithum.Al-naas yagta'o inab min chadara hana chook walla-?Wa yagta'o iyaal al-jimmeez min andireesa walla-?
Wa misil da,kulli chadara adiile talda iyaal adiiliin wa laakin al-chadara al-fasle talda iyaal fasliin.
Al-chadara al-adiile ma tagdar talda iyaal fasliin wa l-chadara al-fasle ma tagdar talda iyaal adiiliin.
Ayyi chadara al-ma talda iyaal adiiliin,yagta'ooha wa yazguluuha fi l-naar.
Wa khalaas,misil ta'arfu al-chadar min iyaalhum,ta'arfu al-naas dool min khidmithum.
Ma kulla l-naas al-yinaaduuni-:--Ya sayyidna,ya sayyidna-- yadkhulu fi mamlakat Allah,illa l-naas al-yisawwu hasab al-abuuyi Allah yidoorah yadkhulu.
Fi yoom al-Hisaab,naas katiiriin yuguulu leyi-:--Ya sayyidna,ya sayyidna.Aniina ma atnabba'na be usmak walla-?Wa be usmak ma taradna al-chawaatiin walla-?Wa be usmak ma sawweena ajaayib katiiriin walla-?--
Wa laakin ni'ooriihum be kalaam waadih wa nuguul-:--Abadan ma iriftuku-!Yalla-!Kissu minni ba'iid-!Khidmitku di charr bas.--
Ayyi naadum al-yasma' kalaami da wa yitaabi'ah,yabga misil raajil aagil al-bana beetah fi l-hajar.
Wa l-matar sabba wa l-seel ja wa l-riih saagat chadiid wa kulluhum darabo al-beet wa l-beet ma waga' achaan asaasah fi l-hajar.
Wa laakin ayyi naadum al-yasma' kalaami da wa ma yitaabi'ah,hu misil raajil matmuus al-bana beetah fi l-ramla.
Wa l-matar sabba wa l-seel ja wa l-riih saagat chadiid wa darabo al-beet.Wa khalaas,al-beet waga' wa tilif marra waahid.
Wa wakit Isa kammal kalaamah,kulla l-naas al-lammo achaan yasma'o kalaamah al'ajjabo bilheen min ta'liimah
achaan hu allamaahum be l-gudra al-Allah antaaha leyah wa ma misil kalaam ulamaahum.
Wakit Isa dalla min al-hajar,naas katiiriin marra waahid taaba'ooh.
Wa raajil waahid indah jidaamja sajad giddaam Isa wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,kan tidoor tachfiini,akiid inta tagdar wa ana nabga taahir.
Wa Isa madda iidah wa limis al-raajil al-indah jidaam wa gaal-:-Nidoor nachfiik.Abga taahir. Wa tawwaali bigi taahir min al-jidaam.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Aw'a baalak,ma ti'oori naadum waahid lahaddi tamchi tiwassif nafsak le raajil al-diin wa tigaddim dahiiye le Allah misil al-nabi Muusa amaraana beeha.Wa misil da,al-naas ya'arfu kadar inta ligiit al-aafe wa bigiit taahir.
Wakit Isa macha fi hillit Kafar Naahuum tawwaali naadum waahid ja leyah.Hu kabiir askar al-Roomaaniyiin wa chahadah le Isa.
Wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,khaddaami mardaan wa bigi mukarsah.Jildah maat.Hu raagid fi l-beet wa ta'baan chadiid.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Khalaas,namchu wa nidaawiih.
Wa kabiir al-askar radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,ana ma indi hagg le tadkhul fi beeti.Wa laakin guul kilme waahide bas wa khaddaami yalga al-aafe.
Achaan ana kula indi kabiir min foog leyi al-nitabbig amrah.Wa ana kula mas'uul fi naas al-tihit minni al-yitabbugu amri.Wa kan nuguul le waahid-:--Amchi--,hu yamchi.Wa kan nuguul le naadum aakhar-:--Ta'aal--,hu yaji.Wa kan nuguul le abdi-:--Sawwi ke--,hu yisawwiih.
Wa Isa simi' kalaamah wa al'ajjab bilheen wa hajja le l-naas al-gaa'idiin yitaabu'uuh wa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ma ligiit naadum waahid min Bani Israa'iil al-indah iimaan chadiid misil iimaan al-naadum da-!
Wa nuguul leeku,naas katiiriin yaju min sabaah wa min kharib wa yil'achcho ma'a Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa laakin al-naas al-waajib yamulku al-mamlaka di,Allah yatrudhum fi l-dalaam al-barraani.Hinaak naas yabku wa yi'addu sunuunhum min al-nadaama.
Wa Isa hajja le kabiir al-askar wa gaal-:-Khalaas amchi wa khalli yabga leek misil inta aamant beyah. Wa fi l-wakit da bas,khaddaamah ligi al-aafe.
Wa Isa macha fi beet Butrus wa ligi nasiibtah le Butrus wa hi raagde indaha wirde.
Wa Isa limis iidha wa l-wirde khallatha wa hi gammat dayyafatah.
Wa fi l-makhrib,naas katiiriin jo leyah wa jaabo muchootiniin katiiriin wa Isa gaa'id yatrud al-chawaatiin be kilme waahide bas wa l-mardaaniin kulluhum ligo al-aafe.
Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah be khachum al-nabi Icha'ya tamma.Al-nabi gaal-:﴾‍Al-marad al-foogna aniina,hu zaatah chaalah wa l-waja' al-foogna,hu bas himlah.‍﴿
Wa Isa chaaf naas katiiriin lammo foogah wa amar talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Ta'aalu nagta'o al-bahar.
Wa waahid min al-ulama ja leyah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,nitaabi'ak fi ayyi bakaan al-tamchi foogah.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-ba'achoom indah nugra wa l-teer indah uchch wa laakin ana Ibn al-Insaan ma indi bakaan nidiss raasi foogah.
Wa naadum aakhar min talaamiizah gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,antiini izin achaan namchi nadfin abuuyi.Wa ba'ad da,naji nitaabi'ak.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ta'aal taabi'ni hassa' wa khalli al-maytiin yadfunu maytiinhum.
Wa khalaas Isa rikib fi l-markaba wa talaamiizah taaba'ooh wa rikbo ma'aayah.
Wa be khafla riih chadiide marra waahid saagat fi l-bahar wa gawwamat al-challaal wa l-markaba anmalat almi.Wa Isa naayim.
Wa l-talaamiiz garrabo leyah wa gawwamooh min al-noom wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna,najjiina-!Aniina mutna-!
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Iimaanku lissaa' da'iif.Maala takhaafo-?-Wa gamma foog wa kachcha le l-riih wa l-bahar.Wa tawwaali,al-wata bigat haadiye marra waahid.
Wa l-naas al'ajjabo marra waahid wa gaalo-:-Al-naadum da,hu yaatu-?Lahaddi al-riih wa l-bahar kula yitii'uuh-!
Wa ba'ad Isa gata' al-bahar wa wassal fi balad al-Gadariyiin,rujaal itneen marago min al-khubuur wa jo laagooh.Wa humman muchootiniin wa khatiiriin bilheen wa l-naas khaafo minhum wa naadum waahid kula ma yagdar yamchi be l-derib da.
Wa l-muchootiniin gammo aato wa gaalo-:-Ya Ibn Allah,inta tidoor minnina chunu-?Inta jiit achaan ti'azzibna gubbaal yoom al-Hisaab walla-?
Wa chiyya ba'iid minhum,fi khanaaziir katiiriin gaa'idiin yasraho.
Wa l-chawaatiin chahado Isa wa gaalo-:-Kan tatrudna,khalaas rassilna fi l-khanaaziir dool-.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Yalla amchu-! Wa humman marago min al-rujaal dool wa dakhalo fi l-khanaaziir.Wa l-khanaaziir kulluhum jaro min taraf al-hajar wa waga'o fi l-bahar wa khalaas al-almi akalaahum.
Wa ru'yaan al-khanaaziir arrado wa macho khabbaro fi l-hille be kulla cheyy al-chaafooh wa kikkeef al-muchootiniin ligo al-aafe.
Wa khalaas naas al-hille marago kulluhum achaan yigaabulu Isa wa wakit laagooh,chahadooh achaan yamrug min baladhum.
Wa khalaas,Isa rikib fi l-markaba wa gata' al-bahar wa gabbal fi hillitah Kafar Naahuum.
Wa naas waahidiin jaabo leyah raajil mukarsah raagid fi furaachah.Wa Isa chaaf iimaanhum wa gaal le l-raajil al-mukarsah-:-Ya wileedi,chidd heelak-!Zunuubak ankhafaro.
Wa waahidiin min al-ulama gaalo fi guluubhum-:-Kalaam al-naadum da kalaam kufur-!
Wa Isa irif fikirhum.Wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Maala tuguulu cheyy fasil fi guluubku-?
Weenu al-hayyin nuguulah min al-kalaam al-itneen dool-?Nuguul-:--Zunuubak ankhafaro-- walla nuguul-:--Gumm wa ruukh---?
Ana nidoor intu ta'arfu kadar ana Ibn al-Insaan indi sulta fi l-ard achaan nakhfir le l-naas zunuubhum. Wa khalaas gaal le l-mukarsah-:-Gumm,chiil furaachak wa amchi beetak-!
Wa khalaas al-naadum gamma wa macha beetah.
Wakit al-naas chaafooh,khaafo bilheen wa chakaro Allah achaan hu anta sulta misil di le l-naas.
Wa fi ruwaakhtah Isa chaaf naadum waahid usmah Matta gaa'id yakhdim fi maktab al-daraayib.Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal taabi'ni. Wa khalaas gamma foog wa taaba'ah.
Wa Isa al'achcha fi beet Matta wa naas katiiriin jo min naas al-yichiilu miiri wa muznibiin aakhariin.Wa jo ga'ado ma'a Isa wa talaamiizah.
Wa waahidiin min al-Fariiziyiin chaafoohum wa sa'alo talaamiizah wa gaalo-:-Maala sayyidku yaakul ma'a naas al-daraayib wa l-muznibiin-?
Wa Isa simi' kalaamhum wa gaal-:-Al-naas al-taybiin ma hawjaaniin daktoor,illa l-mardaaniin bas.
Amchu agru wa afhamo kalaam Allah al-buguul-:﴾‍Nidoor al-rahma ziyaada min al-dahaaya.‍﴿Ana ma jiit achaan ninaadi al-saalihiin laakin jiit le ninaadi al-muznibiin le l-tooba.
Wa khalaas waahidiin min talaamiiz Yahya jo le Isa wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Aniina wa l-Fariiziyiin nusuumu daayman.Maala talaamiizak ma yusuumu-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan naas gaa'idiin fi iris wa l-ariis ma'aahum,yahzano walla-?Wa laakin yaji yoom waahid al-ariis yichiiluuh minhum wa khalaas fi l-wakit daak,yusuumu.
Ma fi naadum al-yarga' khalag gadiim be git'e jadiide achaan al-rug'a al-jadiide di ticharrit al-khalag al-gadiim wa l-gadd yabga ziyaada min awwal.
Wa l-naas ma yusubbu khamar jadiid fi girbe gadiime achaan kan sawwo misil da,al-girbe tinchagga.Wa misil da,al-khamar yidaffig wa l-girbe tatlaf.Wa laakin yusubbu al-khamar al-jadiid fi girbe jadiide wa misil da yahfado al-khamar ma'a l-girbe sawa.
Wa wakit Isa gaa'id yihajji fi l-kalaam da,naadum waahid mas'uul ja wa sajad giddaamah wa gaal-:-Bineeyti dahaabha maatat wa laakin ta'aal almasha be iidak wa hi tahya.
Wa Isa gamma wa macha ma'aayah wa talaamiizah kula macho ma'aayah sawa.
Wa mara waahide garrabat le Isa min wara wa hi ta'baane.Dammaha yidaffig min 12 sana.Wa jaat limsat taraf khalagah
wa gaalat fi galibha-:-Kan nalmas khalagah nalga al-aafe.
Wa Isa anlafat wa chaafha wa gaal-:-Ya bineeyti,chiddi heelki.Iimaanki beyi najjaaki-.Wa khalaas min al-wakit da bas,hi ligat al-aafe.
Wa Isa dakhal fi beet al-mas'uul wa chaaf darraabiin al-suffaara hana l-moot wa naas gaa'idiin yabku katiir.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Yalla amchu.Al-bineeye ma maatat.Hi naayme bas-.Wa dihko leyah be chamaate.
Wa wakit kulla l-naas marago,Isa dakhal fi lubb al-beet wa karab iid al-bineeye wa hi gammat.
Wa l-khabar da ansama' fi kulla l-balad di.
Wa Isa maachi giddaam wa amyaaniin itneen taaba'ooh.Wa gaa'idiin yasrakho wa yuguulu-:-Ya Ibn Dawuud-!Arhamna-!
Wa wakit Isa dakhal fi l-beet,humman jo leyah wa hu sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Sahiih intu ti'aamunu kadar indi gudra nidaawiiku walla-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aywa sayyidna.
Wa Isa limis uyuunhum wa gaal-:-Khalli yabga leeku misil aamantu beyah.
Wa khalaas,uyuunhum anfataho wa chaafo.Wa Isa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Angar'u-!Ma ti'ooru beyah naadum waahid.
Wa laakin macho wa chattato al-khabar da wa usmah tala' fi kulla l-balad di.
Wa wakit al-rujaal dool maargiin min al-beet,naas waahidiin jaabo naadum abkam wa muchootin.
Wa Isa tarad al-cheetaan wa l-abkam gamma yihajji.Wa l-naas al'ajjabo bilheen wa gaalo-:-Cheyy ajiib misil da abadan ma chifna fi daar Israa'iil-!
Wa laakin al-Fariiziyiin gaalo-:-Al-naadum da yatrud al-chawaatiin be gudrat kabiir al-chawaatiin.
Isa gaa'id yuruukh fi kulla l-mudun wa fi kulla l-hillaal wa yi'allim al-naas fi buyuut al-sala wa yibachchirhum be bichaarat mamlakat Allah.Wa yachfiihum min ayyi waja' wa ayyi marad.
Wa Isa chaaf naas katiiriin marra waahid jaayiin leyah wa hanna fooghum achaan humman ta'baaniin wa ayyaaniin misil khanam al-ma induhum raa'i.
Wa gaal le talaamiizah-:-Al-naas dool misil zere' kabiir wa khallitah nijdat khalaas.Wa laakin al-naas al-yakhdumu chiyya.
Achaan da,atulbu min siid al-zere' hu yirassil khaddaamiinah yilimmu khallitah.
Wa Isa naada talaamiizah al-atnaachar wa antaahum sulta achaan yaturdu al-chawaatiin wa yachfu ayyi naadum al-indah ayyi marad.
Wa asaame al-rujaal al-atnaachar al-ja'alaahum rusul.Humman awwal Sim'aan al-binaaduuh Butrus wa akhuuh Andareeyas,wa Yaakhuub wileed Zabadi wa akhuuh Yuuhanna,
wa Filibbus wa Bartulma,wa Tuuma wa Matta al-yichiil al-miiri,wa Yaakhuub wileed Halfa wa Taddaaya,
wa Sim'aan al-Sawri wa Yahuuza al-Iskhariyooti al-ba'adeen yukhuun Isa.
Dool humman al-rusul al-atnaachar.Wa Isa rassalaahum fi ust al-naas.Wa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Ma tamchu le l-naas al-ma Yahuud wa ma tadkhulu fi ayyi hille hana l-Saamiriyiin.
Amchu illa fi ust al-khanam al-muwaddiriin hana Bani Israa'iil.
Wa wakit intu maachiin fi l-derib,ballukhu al-bichaara guulu-:--Mamlakat Allah garrabat-!--
Al-mardaaniin daawuuhum wa l-maytiin gawwumuuhum wa l-induhum jidaam antuuhum al-aafe wa l-chawaatiin aturduuhum min al-naas.Intu ligiitu bala tukfa wa khalaas,antu le l-naas bala tukfa.
Ma tichiilu ma'aaku dahab wa la fudda wa la sile fi juzlaanku.
Wa ma tichiilu wa la mukhla wa la khulgaan hana khiyaar wa la na'aal wa la asa.Achaan al-khaddaam laggaam.
Wa ayyi madiina aw hille tadkhulu foogha,fattuchu fiiha naadum ijwaadi wa dallu fi beetah lahaddi tamchu min al-bakaan da.
Wa wakit intu tadkhulu fi l-beet,as'alo salaam Allah foogah.
Wa kan naas al-beet ijwaadiyiin,khalli salaamku yagood fooghum.Wa kan naas al-beet ma ijwaadiyiin,khalli salaamku yigabbil leeku.
Wa kan naas hana ayyi beet walla ayyi hille ma yakhbalooku wa yaabo kalaamku,amurgu minnah wa hittu al-ajaaj min rijleeku.
Nuguul leeku al-hagg,fi yoom al-Hisaab,al-azaab al-yanzil foog naas al-bakaan da yabga ziyaada min al-azaab al-nazal foog naas hillaal Saduum wa Amuura.
Asma'o-!Nirassilku fi ust al-naas wa tabgo misil khanam fi ust al-maraaf'iin.Achaan da,waajib tabgo hadiiriin misil al-daabi wa bariyiin misil al-hamaama.
Aw'u baalku min al-naas,achaan yiwadduuku le l-charii'a wa yajluduuku fi buyuut al-sala.
Wa yiwadduuku giddaam al-hukkaam wa l-muluuk achaan intu naasi.Wa fi l-bakaan da,tachhado leyi giddaam al-naas al-induhum diin wa giddaam al-naas al-ma induhum diin.
Wa wakit yakurbuuku wa yiwadduuku le l-charii'a,ma tihimmu le l-kalaam al-tuguuluuh walla kikkeef tihajju.Achaan fi l-wakit da,Allah yantiiku al-kalaam al-tuguuluuh.
Al-kalaam ma yaji minku intu wa laakin yaji min Ruuh abuuku Allah.Wa hu yihajji be khuchuumku.
Wa fi l-wakit al-jaayi da,naadum waahid yisallim akhuuh le l-moot wa abu iyaal yisallim wileedah le l-moot wa l-iyaal yabgo aasiyiin le waaldeenhum wa yisabbubu leehum al-moot.
Wa fi chaan usmi kulla l-naas yakrahooku.Wa laakin al-naadum al-yagood saabit lahaddi kumaalit kulla cheyy,hu yanja.
Wa wakit yita''ubuuku fi hille waahide,ajru fi hille aakhara.Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ma tagdaro tikammulu amalku fi hillaal Israa'iil gubbaal Ibn al-Insaan ma yaji-.
Wa Isa gaal battaan-:-Al-tilmiiz ma akbar min sayyidah wa l-abid ma akbar min siidah.
Wa l-tilmiiz radyaan kan yabga misil sayyidah wa l-abid radyaan kan yabga misil siidah.Wa kan yuguulu siid al-beet-:--Hu Ibliis--,akiid yuguulu nafs al-cheyy ziyaada fi naas beetah.
Ma takhaafo minhum.Achaan ma fi cheyy mukhatta al-ba'adeen ma yinkachif wa ma fi sirr al-ma yin'arif.
Ayyi cheyy al-nuguulah leeku fi l-leel,guuluuh fi l-nahaar.Wa l-kalaam al-kallamtah leeku be bicheech fi adaanku,ballukhuuh barra fi l-chawaari'.
Ma takhaafo min al-naas.Yagdaro yaktulu jisim al-naadum wa laakin ma yagdaro yaktulu ruuhah.Akhaafo min Allah achaan hu yagdar yahlik al-jisim wa l-ruuh sawa fi Jahannam.
Ta'arfu kadar yibii'u tuyuur itneen be riyaal waahid.Wa be da kula,kan waahid minhum yaga' fi l-turaab,abuuku Allah ya'arfah.
Wa laakin intu,Allah gaa'id yifakkir fiiku ziyaada lahaddi ya'arif adad al-suuf al-fi raasku-!
Khalaas,ma takhaafo.Ayyi naadum minku muhimm ziyaada le Allah min tuyuur katiiriin.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yachhad leyi giddaam al-naas,ana kula nachhad leyah giddaam abuuyi Allah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yankurni giddaam al-naas,ana kula nankurah giddaam abuuyi Allah.
Ma tahsubu ana jiit achaan nijiib al-salaam fi l-ard.Ma jibt al-salaam laakin jibt al-seef.
Ana jiit achaan nikhaalif al-wileed ma'a abuuh wa l-bineeye ma'a ammaha wa l-mara ma'a nasiibitha.
Wa be misil da,naas beetah yabgo aduuh le l-naadum.
Ayyi naadum al-yihibb abuuh walla ammah ziyaada minni,ma waajib leyah yabga tilmiizi.Wa ayyi naadum al-yihibb wileedah walla bineeytah ziyaada minni ma waajib leyah yabga tilmiizi.
Wa ayyi naadum al-aba ma yichiil ta'ab al-saliibwa ma yitaabi'ni le l-moot,ma waajib leyah yabga tilmiizi.
Ayyi naadum al-yidoor yinajji nafsah,yiwaddirha.Laakin al-naadum al-yiwaddir nafsah fi chaani ana,hu da yanja.
Wa ayyi naadum al-khibilaaku khibilaani.Wa l-naadum al-khibilaani khibil Allah al-rassalaani.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yakhbal nabi fi beetah achaan hu nabi,yalga ajur hana nabi.Wa ayyi naadum al-yakhbal raajil saalih achaan hu raajil saalih,yalga ajur hana raajil saalih.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yanti le naadum min naasi al-sukhaar dool chokhol sakhayyar misil kaas hana almi baarid achaan hu tilmiizi,nuguul leeku al-hagg,ajrah ma yiwaddir abadan.
Wa ba'ad Isa gaal kulla l-kalaam da le talaamiizah al-atnaachar,hu gamma min hinaak wa macha yi'allim al-naas wa yiballikh al-bichaara fi hillaalhum.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Yahya gaa'id fi l-sijin.Wa simi' khabar hana amal al-Masiih wa rassal waahidiin min talaamiizah le Isa
achaan yas'alooh wa yuguulu leyah-:-Inta al-naadum al-yaji walla waajib narjo naadum aakhar-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Amchu wa ooru Yahya be kulla cheyy al-chiftuuh wa l-simi'tuuh.
Al-amyaaniin gaa'idiin yichiifu wa l-uruj gaa'idiin yuruukhu wa l-induhum jidaam gaa'idiin yalgo al-aafe wa l-tarchaaniin gaa'idiin yasma'o wa l-maytiin gaa'idiin yab'aso.Wa l-masaakiin gaa'idiin yasma'o al-bichaara.
Wa mabruuk le l-naadum al-ma yichakkik foogi.
Wa wakit talaamiiz Yahya gammo maachiin,Isa bada yihajji fi Yahya le l-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah wa gaal-:-Wakit Yahya gaa'id fi l-kadaade,macheetu leyah achaan tichiifu chunu-?Ageegaay al-riih tihizzaha walla-?
Wa kan ma ke,dawwartu tichiifu chunu-?Naadum laabis khalag sameh-?La-!Achaan al-naas al-laabsiin khulgaan samhiin gaa'idiin fi buyuut al-muluuk.
Zeen,maragtu achaan tichiifu chunu-?Achaan tichiifu nabi-?Aywa-!Wa nuguul leeku chiftu naadum akbar min nabi.
Wa da bas hu al-be sababah al-Kitaab yuguul-:﴾‍Daahu nirassil rasuuli giddaamak wa hu yi'addil leek al-derib.‍﴿
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,ma fi naadum mawluud min mara akbar min Yahya al-Mukhattis.Wa laakin al-naadum al-sakhayyar fi mamlakat Allah,akbar minnah.
Wa min awwal yoom hana khidmit Yahya al-Mukhattis lahaddi al-yoom,mamlakat Allah gaa'ide tiziid be gudra wa l-yadkhulu foogha yiwajjuhu al-unuf.
Allah kallam le l-naas fi l-Tawraat wa fi kutub al-anbiya kulluhum lahaddi Yahya ja.
Wa kan induku niiye tisaddugu kalaami da,Yahya hu Iliyaas al-gaa'idiin tarjooh.
Ayyi naadum al-indah adaan khalli yasma'-!
Wa nuguul chunu fi naas wakitna-?Humman yichaabuhu chunu-?Humman misil iyaal dugaag laammiin fi door wa yinaadu rufgaanhum wa yuguulu-:
--Aniina darabna leeku al-suffaara laakin intu ma li'ibtu.Aniina khanneena khine hana moot wa intu ma bakeetu-!--
Yahya ja wa hu ma yaakul wa la yachrab wa gaalo-:--Hu muchootin--.
Wa ba'adeen ana Ibn al-Insaan jiit wa ana gaa'id naakul wa nachrab wa gaalo-:--Hu akkaal wa sakkaari wa rafiig le naas al-yichiilu miiri wa l-muznibiin.- Laakin hikmat Allah al-sahiihe tinchaaf fi amal al-naas al-yitaabu'uuha.
Wa Isa bada yahrij al-hillaal al-sawwa fooghum ajaayib katiiriin wa naashum ma taabo min zunuubhum.
Wa gaal-:-Al-azaab yarjaaki,ya hillit Kuuraziin-!Al-azaab yarjaaki,ya hillit Beet Seeda-!Kan awwal naadum sawwa al-ajaayib dool fi mudun al-kuffaar Suur wa Seeda,naas al-mudun dool yutuubu min zunuubhum min zamaan wa yalbaso khulgaan al-hizin wa yagoodu fi rumaad.
Wa nuguul leeku,fi yoom al-Hisaab,al-azaab al-yanzil foog muznibiin Suur wa Seeda ma yabga chadiid misil al-azaab al-yanzil foog naasku.
Wa inti hillit Kafar Naahuum,rafa'ti raaski lahaddi l-sama walla-?Nuguul leeki Allah yarmiiki fi l-haawiye achaan kan awwal naas Saduum chaafo al-ajaayib al-naaski chaafoohum,hillit Saduum tagood lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa laakin nuguul leeku,fi yoom al-Hisaab,al-azaab al-yanzil foog naas hillit Saduum ma yabga chadiid misil al-azaab al-yanzil foog naaski.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Isa hajja wa gaal-:-Chukran,ya abuuyi Rabb al-samaawaat wa l-ard achaan inta labbadt kalaamak da min al-hakiimiin wa min al-ulama.Wa wassaftah le l-naas al-juhhaal.
Aywa,ya abuuyi,achaan da bas al-cheyy al-inta raadi beyah-.
Abuuyi Allah wakkalaani be kulla cheyy.Ma fi naadum al-ya'arif Ibn Allah illa abuuh.Wa ma fi naadum al-ya'arif Allah,illa Ibn Allah wa l-naadum al-Ibn Allah yidoor yiwassif leyah abuuh.
Ta'aalu leyi intu kulluku al-ta'baaniin min al-tagala al-chaayliinha fi raasku wa ana nantiiku jumma.
Chiilu al-tagala al-nantiiha leeku wa abgo talaamiizi achaan ana daluul wa hanuun wa talgo jumma le nufuusku.
Achaan al-tagala al-nantiiha leeku di,ma tagiile.Aywa,al-tagala al-nukhuttaha foogku khafiife.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Isa raayikh fi ust al-ziraa'a fi yoom al-sabt.Wa talaamiizah jii'aaniin wa gammo gata'o ganaadiil al-gameh wa akaloohum.
Wa l-Fariiziyiin chaafoohum wa gaalo leyah-:-Talaamiizak gaa'idiin yisawwu al-khidme al-ma halaala fi yoom al-sabt.
Wa Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Ma gareetu al-Kitaab walla-?Nisiitu al-cheyy al-Dawuud wa jamaa'tah sawwooh wakit al-juu' sawwaahum walla-?
Hu dakhal fi beet Allah wa akal al-khubza al-gaddamooha al-naas le Allah.Wa da ma halaal le Dawuud wa la le l-naas al-ma'aayah,illa le rujaal al-diin.
Walla ma gareetu kalaam al-Tawraat-?Kulli yoom al-sabt rujaal al-diin yikhaalufu wasaaya al-sabt achaan yakhdumu fi beet Allah wa Allah ma yaj'alhum muznibiin.
Wa laakin nuguul leeku cheyy akbar min beet Allah gaa'id hini giddaamku.
Wa Allah gaal-:﴾‍Nidoor al-rahma ziyaada min al-dahaaya.‍﴿Wa kan awwal fihimtu ma'ana al-kalaam da,ma tuluumu al-naas al-ma muznibiin.
Wa khalaas,ana Ibn al-Insaan Rabb yoom al-sabt.
Wa macha giddaam wa dakhal fi beet al-sala hanaahum.
Wa naadum waahid iidah mayte gaa'id daakhal.Wa l-Fariiziyiin dawwaro fursa achaan yathamo Isa.Wa achaan da,sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Kan naadum yachfi al-mardaaniin fi yoom al-sabt da,halaal walla haraam-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan naadum minku indah kabich waga' fi nugra fi yoom al-sabt,hu ma yakurbah ajala wa yisillah walla-?
Wa insaani ma muhimm ziyaada min kabich walla-?Khalaas,halaal leena nisawwu al-kheer fi yoom al-sabt.
Wa khalaas Isa gaal le l-raajil-:-Midd iidak. Wa l-raajil maddaaha wa iidah ligat al-aafe wa bigat misil al-aakhara.
Wa laakin al-Fariiziyiin marago wa achchaawaro kikkeef yaktulu Isa.
Wa Isa irif fikirhum wa macha min hinaak.Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid taaba'ooh wa daawaahum kulluhum.
Wa amaraahum achaan ma yi'ooru al-naas hu yaatu.
Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah be khachum al-nabi Icha'ya tamma khalaas.
Wa Icha'ya gaal-:﴾‍Daahu abdi al-ana azaltah wa l-nihibbahwa ana firiht beyah.Ana nukhutt ruuhi foogahwa hu yiballikh adaalit Allah le kulla l-umam.
Wa ma yikhaasim wa ma yasrakhwa hissah ma yinsami' fi l-chawaari'.
Hu ma yaksir ageegaay mafjuukhawa la yaktul deyy al-faanuus al-gariib yumuut.Wa yuguud adaalit Allahlahaddi yansurha.
Wa kulla l-umamyukhuttu achamhum fi usmah.‍﴿
Wa ba'adeen jaabo raajil amyaan wa abkam achaan indah cheetaan wa Isa chafaah wa l-raajil gamma yichiif wa yihajji.
Wa kulla l-naas al'ajjabo bilheen wa gaalo-:-Akuun al-naadum da Ibn Dawuud al-narjooh-!
Wa laakin al-Fariiziyiin sim'o al-kalaam da wa gaalo-:-Al-naadum da ma yatrud al-chawaatiin illa be gudrat Ibliis kabiir al-chawaatiin.
Wa Isa irif fikirhum wa gaal leehum-:-Ayyi mamlaka kan naasha yiddaawaso ambeenaathum takhrab.Wa ma fi madiina wa la beet yagood saabit kan naasah yiddaawaso ambeenaathum.
Wa be misil da,kan al-Cheetaan yatrud al-chawaatiin,hu yidaawis nafsah wa kikkeef mamlakatah tagood saabte-?
Kan ana taradt al-chawaatiin be gudrat Ibliis,naasku yaturduuhum be gudrat yaatu-?Wa misil da,naasku bas al-yisabbutu foogku al-tuhma.
Wa kan ana taradt al-chawaatiin be Ruuh Allah kamaan,mamlakat Allah garrabat leeku.
Wa laakin naadum ma yadkhul fi beet raajil gawi wa ma yichiil khumaamah illa kan awwal rabat al-raajil al-gawi da.Kan rabatah,yagdar yanhab kulla khumaamah.
Ayyi naadum al-ma ma'aayi aduuyi wa ayyi naadum al-ma yilimm al-naas ma'aayi,yichattithum.
Wa be misil da,nuguul leeku Allah yakhfir le l-naas kulla zunuubhum wa kulla kalaamhum hana l-kufur.Laakin ma yakhfir leehum kalaam al-kufur fi l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa kan naadum yuguul kilme diddi ana,Ibn al-Insaan,Allah yakhfir leyah.Wa laakin al-naadum al-yuguul kilme didd al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,Allah ma yakhfir leyah wa la fi l-dunya wa la fi l-aakhira.
Al-chadara al-adiile talda iyaal adiiliin wa l-chadara al-fasle talda iyaal fasliin.Wa l-naas ya'arfu al-chadara min iyaalha.
Ya iyaal al-dabiib,intu fasliin wa misil da kikkeef tagdaro tuguulu kalaam adiil-?Achaan al-cheyy al-galib al-naadum malaan beyah,da bas al-yamrug min khachmah kan yihajji.
Al-galib hu misil makhazan.Wa l-naadum al-adiil yudumm kalaam adiil fi galbah wa l-kalaam al-yamrug minnah kula adiil.Wa l-naadum al-fasil yudumm kalaam fasil fi galbah wa l-kalaam al-yamrug minnah kula fasil.
Wa khalaas nuguul leeku,fi yoom al-Hisaab,Allah yihaasib kulla l-kalaam al-ma indah faayde al-gaalooh al-naas.
Achaan Allah yibarriik hasab kalaamak wa yihaakimak hasab kalaamak.
Wa naas waahidiin min al-ulama wa min al-Fariiziyiin hajjo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna,nidooru inta tantiina daliil achaan ni'aamunu beek.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Naas al-wakit da fasliin wa khaayniin wa yidooru daliil achaan yi'aamunu.Wa Allah ma yantiihum daliil illa l-daliil hana l-nabi Yuunus.
Wa misil Yuunus ga'ad talaata yoom wa talaata leele fi batun al-huutaay,Ibn al-Insaan kula yagood fi lubb al-ard talaata yoom wa talaata leele.
Wa fi yoom al-Hisaab,naas madiinat Niinawa yugummu foog ma'a naas hana wakitna wa yisabbit fooghum al-tuhma achaan naas Niinawa taabo min zunuubhum wakit Yuunus ballakh leehum kalaam Allah.Wa hu al-yikallim leeku hassa' akbar min Yuunus wa intu ma tubtu.
Wa fi yoom al-Hisaab,malikat al-watihi tugumm ma'a naas hana wakitna wa tisabbit foogku al-tuhma achaan hi khatarat wa jaat min aakhir al-ard achaan tasma' kalaam Suleymaan al-hakiim wa tichiif ilmah.Wa hu al-yikallim leeku hassa' muhimm min Suleymaan wa laakin intu ma tubtu.
Wa wakit al-cheetaan yamrug min naadum muchootin,al-cheetaan yamchi misil naadum muwaddir fi l-sahara wa yifattich bakaan yinjamma foogah wa ma yalgaah.
Wa yuguul-:--Khalaas,nigabbil fi l-beet al-maragt minnah.- Wa wakit yigabbil,yalga al-naadum misil beet yaabis wa nadiif wa mufarrach.
Wa yamchi yijiib ma'aayah sab'a chawaatiin fasliin minnah ziyaada.Wa kulluhum yindasso wa yaskunu fi l-naadum da wa khalaas haalit al-naadum da tabga hawaane min awwal.Wa yabga misil da le l-naas al-fasliin hana wakitna dool.
Wa Isa gaa'id yihajji le naas katiiriin wa ammah wa akhwaanah jo wa wagafo barra.Wa dawwaro yihajju ma'aayah.
Wa naadum waahid ja ooraah wa gaal-:-Ammak wa akhwaanak gaa'idiin barra wa yidooru yihajju ma'aak.
Wa Isa radda le l-naadum al-ooraah wa gaal-:-Ammi yaati-?Wa akhwaani yaatu humman-?
Wa madda iidah wa wassaf talaamiizah wa gaal leyah-:-Dool bas humman akhwaani wa ammi
achaan ayyi naadum al-yisawwi hasab abuuyi fi l-sama yidoorah,hu bas akhuuyi wa akhti wa ammi.
Fi nafs al-yoom,Isa marag min al-beet wa ga'ad tihit fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid lammo foogah.Achaan da,hu rikib fi markaba wa ga'ad tihit.Wa kulla l-naas waagfiin fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa Isa hajja leehum kalaam katiir be amsaal wa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,harraati waahid macha fi zere' achaan yiteerib.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id yichattit teeraabah,teeraab waahid waga' fi l-derib wa tuyuur jo akalooh.
Wa teeraab aakhar waga' fi bakaan indah hashas katiir wa turaab chiyya.Wa tawwaali al-bizre gammat achaan al-turaab chiyya.
Wa laakin wakit al-harraay bigat haamiye taggat al-bizre di wa l-bizre yibsat achaan ma indaha uruug.
Wa teeraab aakhar waga' fi ust al-chook wa l-bizre gammat sawa ma'a l-chook wa l-chook khanagaaha.
Wa teeraab aakhar waga' fi turaab adiil wa l-bizre gammat wa wildat wa antajat wa kulli ganduul indah 100 aw 60 aw 30 habba.
Khalaas,ayyi naadum al-indah adaan khalli yasma'-!
Wa l-talaamiiz jo leyah.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Maala tihajji le l-naas be amsaal-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Allah antaaku ma'rafat sirr mamlakat Allah laakin ma antaah le l-naas al-aakhariin.
Achaan yantu al-naadum al-indah wa yiziid leyah.Wa laakin al-naadum al-ma indah,al-chiyya al-indah kula yichiiluuh minnah.
Da l-sabab al-khallaani nihajji leehum be amsaal.Induhum uyuun wa laakin ma yichiifu cheyy wa induhum udne wa laakin ma yasma'o cheyy wa la yafhamo.
Al-naas dool misil al-naas al-hajja fooghum al-nabi Icha'ya.Hu gaal-:﴾‍Tasma'o wa laakin ma tafhamowa tichiifu wa laakin ma ta'arfu.
Guluub al-cha'ab dool bigo gawiyiinwa udneehum ma yasma'owa saddo uyuunhum.Wa kan ma misil da,uyuunhum yichiifuwa udneehum yasma'owa yafhamo adiil wa yutuubuwa ana nachfiihum.‍﴿
Wa laakin leeku intu,mabruuk leeku achaan uyuunku gaa'idiin yichiifu wa udneeku gaa'idiin yasma'o.
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,katiiriin min al-anbiya wa l-naas al-saalihiin dawwaro bilheen yichiifu al-cheyy al-intu gaa'idiin tichiifuuh wa laakin ma chaafooh.Wa dawwaro yasma'o al-kalaam al-intu gaa'idiin tasma'ooh wa ma sim'ooh.
Asma'o wa ni'ooriiku ma'ana hana masal al-harraati al-yiteerib.
Ayyi naadum al-yasma' bichaarat al-mamlaka wa ma yafhamha,Ibliis al-chariir yaji wa yichiil al-kalaam min galbah.Wa da misil al-teeraab al-waga' foog al-derib.
Wa l-teeraab al-waga' fi l-turaab al-indah hashas yimassil al-naadum al-yasma' al-kalaam wa tawwaali yakhbalah be farha.
Wa laakin al-naadum da ma yagood saabit ila le wakit chiyya bas.Wa wakit al-diige taji foogah walla l-naas yita''ubuuh be sabab kalaam Allah,al-naadum da,yamrug ajala min al-derib.
Wa l-teeraab al-waga' fi ust al-chook yimassil al-naadum al-yasma' al-kalaam laakin machaakil al-dunya wa reedtah le l-maal yaktulu al-kalaam al-fi galbah wa be da,kalaam Allah yabga leyah ma indah faayde.
Wa l-teeraab al-waga' fi l-turaab al-adiil yimassil al-naadum al-yasma' kalaam Allah wa yafhamah.Wa hu yijiib intaaj sameh misil ganduul al-indah 100 aw 60 aw 30 habba.
Wa Isa gaal leehum masal aakhar-:-Mamlakat Allah hi misil ke.Naadum waahid teerab teeraab adiil fi zere'.
Wa wakit al-naas naaymiin,adu waahid ja fi l-zere'.Wa hu jaab teeraab hana l-gechch al-yichaabih al-gameh usmah si'id.Wa hu teerabah fi ust al-gameh al-adiil wa khalaas faat.
Wa wakit al-gameh gamma wa sawwa ganaadiil,chaafo al-si'id fi ust al-gameh.
Wa l-khaddaamiin macho le sayyidhum wa gaalo-:--Ya sayyidna,ma teerabt teeraab adiil fi l-zere' walla-?Al-si'id da ja min ween-?--
Wa sayyidhum radda wa gaal-:--Da khidme hana adu.- Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:--Namchu nimallutuuh walla-?--
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:--La,achaan wakit intu gaa'idiin timallutu al-si'id,akuun timallutu al-gameh kula.
Khallu al-si'id yagood fi ust al-gameh wa yakburu sawa lahaddi al-gameh yanjad.Wa fi wakt al-gati',nihajji le l-naas al-yagta'ooh wa nuguul-:"Awwal limmu al-si'id wa tuchchuuh.Wa laakin al-gameh da,limmuuh wa subbuuh fi l-makhazan."-
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal aakhar wa gaal-:-Mamlakat Allah hi misil habba waahide hana kireeb.Wa naadum waahid chaalaaha wa teerabaaha fi zere'.
Wa teeraab al-khardal hu askhar min ayyi teeraab wa laakin wakit yabzur khalaas,hu yabga kabiir min kulla nabaataat al-jineene.Wa yabga kabiir misil chadara wa tuyuur al-sama yaju yabnu uchuuchhum fi furuu'ha.
Wa gaal leehum masal aakhar-:-Mamlakat Allah hi misil tawwaara.Wa mara waahide chaalatha wa sabbatha daakhal fi lubb talaata kooro hana dagiig wa ba'adeen al-tawwaara gawwamat al-ajiine kullaha ke.
Wa fi kulla l-kalaam da,Isa hajja le l-naas be amsaal wa ma hajja leehum cheyy bala masal.
Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-Allah gaalah be khachum al-nabi tamma.Hu gaal-:﴾‍Ana naftah khachmi be masal wa nibayyin leeku kalaam mulabbad min al-bidaaya.‍﴿
Wa Isa gamma min al-naas wa gabbal fi l-beet.Wa talaamiizah jo leyah wa gaalo-:-Fassir leena masal hana l-si'id fi l-zere'.
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-naadum al-yiteerib al-teeraab al-adiil hu ana,Ibn al-Insaan.
Wa l-zere' yimassil al-dunya.Wa l-teeraab al-adiil yimassil naas al-mamlaka wa l-si'id yimassil naas Ibliis al-chariir.
Wa l-adu al-teerab al-si'id yimassil Ibliis.Wa wakt al-gati' da,yimassil kumaalit al-dunya wa l-khaddaamiin al-yagta'o al-si'id wa l-gameh,humman al-malaa'ika.
Wa ba'adeen yilimmu al-si'id wa yitichchuuh wa da yimassil al-cheyy al-yabga fi kumaalit al-dunya.
Wa Ibn al-Insaan yirassil malaa'ikatah achaan yamurgu min mamlakatah kulla l-naas al-yilizzu akhwaanhum fi l-zanib wa kulli naadum al-yisawwi al-fasaala.
Wa yazguluuhum fi naar Jahannam.Hinaak yabku wa yi'addu sunuunhum min al-azaab.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-saalihiin yiraaru misil al-harraay fi mamlakat abuuhum.Wa khalaas,ayyi naadum al-indah adaan,khalli yasma'-!
Wa mamlakat Allah hi misil kanz katiir madfuun fi zere'.Wa naadum ligiih wa firih bilheen wa labbadah battaan fi bakaanah.Wa khalaas macha baa' kulla cheyy al-indah wa gabbal chara al-zere' da min siidah.
Wa mamlakat Allah hi misil ke.Taajir waahid siid al-maal wa gaa'id yifattich marajaan sameh.
Wa yoom waahid,ligi marajaan sameh ziyaada wa tamanah khaali bilheen wa khalaas baa' kulla cheyy al-indah wa macha chara al-marajaan da.
Wa mamlakat Allah hi misil charak al-hawwaatiin al-zagalooh fi lubb al-bahar wa karabo kulla nafar al-huut.
Wa wakit al-charak anmala,al-hawwaatiin maragooh barra fi khachum al-bahar wa ga'ado tihit wa lammo al-huut al-adiil wa sabbooh fi chabakaat.Wa l-huut al-ma yanfa' daffagooh.
Wa yabga misil da fi kumaalit al-dunya.Al-malaa'ika yaju wa yamurgu al-naas al-fasliin min ust al-naas al-saalihiin
wa yazguluuhum fi naar Jahannam.Wa hinaak yabku wa yi'addu sunuunhum min al-azaab.
Wa Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Fihimtu kulla l-kalaam da walla-? Wa talaamiizah gaalo-:-Aywa,fihimna.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Khalaas,ayyi naadum al-hu aalim be l-Tawraat wa bigi tilmiiz mamlakat Allah,hu misil naadum waahid siid beet kabiir.Wa min khumaamah al-khaali al-dammah fi beetah,hu yagdar yamrug cheyy jadiid wa cheyy gadiim al-madmuum min zamaan kula.
Wa wakit Isa kammal al-amsaal dool,khalaas gamma min al-bakaan da wa macha.
Wa Isa ja fi hillitah wa bada yi'allim al-naas fi beet al-sala wa l-naas al'ajjabo minnah bilheen.Wa assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Al-hikma wa l-ajaayib dool ligiihum min ween-?
Hu ma wileed al-usta walla-?Wa ammah,ma usumha Mariyam walla-?Wa akhwaanah,ma Yaakhuub wa Yuusuf wa Sim'aan wa Yahuuza walla-?
Kulla akhwaatah ma gaa'idaat ma'aana hini walla-?Wa kulla l-cheyy da ja leyah min ween-?
Wa khalaas zi'ilo wa ma aamano beyah.Wa laakin Isa gaal leehum-:-Kulla l-naas yikarrumu ayyi nabi,illa naas hillitah wa beetah ma yikarrumuuh.
Wa ma sawwa ajaayib katiiriin hinaak achaan ma induhum iimaan.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,Hiruudus muhaafiz daar al-Jaliil simi' khabar Isa.
Wa gaal le khaddaamiinah-:-Da Yahya al-Mukhattis-!Hu ba'as min ust al-maytiin-!Achaan da bas indah al-gudra le yisawwi al-ajaayib.
Wa gabul da,Hiruudus karab Yahya fi l-sijin wa rabatah be janaaziir fi chaan martah Hiruudiiya.Wa awwal Hiruudiiya hi marit Filibbus akhuuh le Hiruudus
wa Yahya gaal leyah-:-Hi ma halaala leek le taakhudha.
Wa Hiruudus dawwar yaktul Yahya laakin hu khaayif min za'al al-naas achaan fi fikirhum Yahya nabi.
Wa fi yoom iid mawlid Hiruudus,gaa'idiin yi'ayyudu wa bineeyit Hiruudiiya li'ibat giddaamhum wa Hiruudus farhaan bilheen minha.
Wa hu halaf yantiiha ayyi cheyy al-tatulbah minnah.
Wa l-bineeye awwal chaawarat ammaha wa ba'ad da,gaalat-:-Antiini raas Yahya al-Mukhattis hassa' hini fi sufra.
Wa l-malik nidim le haliiftah al-halafha giddaam kulla diifaanah wa laakin anta izin le askarah yijiibuuh leeha.
Wa askari waahid macha fi l-sijin wa gata' raas Yahya.
Wa jaab al-raas fi sufra wa antaah le l-bineeye wa hi waddatah le ammaha.
Wa talaamiiz Yahya jo wa chaalo janaaztah wa dafanooha wa khalaas macho ooro Isa.
Wa Isa simi' al-khabar da wa rikib fi l-markaba wa macha wiheedah fi l-khala.Wa laakin naas katiiriin sim'o hu macha hinaak wa marago min hillaalhum wa macho waraayah be rijleehum.
Wa wakit Isa dalla min al-markaba,hu chaaf naas katiiriin marra waahid gaa'idiin yarjooh wa hu hanna fooghum wa chafa al-mardaaniin al-ma'aahum.
Wa fi l-achiiye al-talaamiiz jo leyah wa gaalo-:-Al-bakaan da khala wa l-wakit akhkhar.Khalli al-naas yamchu fi l-hillaal wa yachru cheyy yaakuluuh.
Wa laakin Isa gaal le talaamiizah-:-Ma waajib leehum yamchu.Intu bas antuuhum akil.
Wa gaalo-:-Ma indina cheyy illa khamsa khubza wa huut itneen bas-!
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Jiibuuhum leyi hini.
Wa hajja le kulla l-naas wa gaal-:-Agoodu tihit fi l-gechch. Wa chaal al-khamsa khubza wa l-huut al-itneen wa rafa' raasah ale l-sama wa chakar Allah wa kassar al-khubza wa antaahum le talaamiizah wa gassamoohum le l-naas.
Wa kulla l-naas akalo lahaddi chib'o.Wa khalaas al-talaamiiz lammo al-akil al-faddal wa malo beyah 12 guffa.
Wa adad al-naas al-akalo hawaale 5-000 rujaal.Wa da bala l-awiin wa l-iyaal.
Wa tawwaali Isa amar al-talaamiiz yarkabo fi l-markaba achaan yagta'o al-bahar wa yamchu giddaamah.Wa hu yuguul le l-naas khalli yamchu.
Wa wakit al-naas macho khalaas,Isa tala' fi raas al-hajar le yisalli wiheedah.Wa ba'ad al-makhrib,hu gaa'id hinaak wiheedah.
Wa markabat al-talaamiiz lihgat ust al-bahar wa l-riih gaa'ide tusuug aleehum min giddaam wa l-challaal gaa'id yihizz al-markaba.
Wa be waradde,Isa ja leehum raayikh min foog le l-almi.
Wa wakit al-talaamiiz chaafo Isa raayikh min foog le l-almi,khaafo khoof chadiid wa gaalo-:-Da dull-! Wa sarakho min al-khoof.
Wa tawwaali Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Chiddu heelku,da ana bas.Ma takhaafo-!
Wa Butrus gaal leyah-:-Sayyidna-!Kan sahiih da inta,khalaas naadiini achaan naji leek raayikh min foog le l-almi.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal-! Wa Butrus dalla min al-markaba wa bada yamchi le Isa raayikh min foog le l-almi.
Wa laakin wakit Butrus hassa gudrat al-riih,hu khaaf bilheen wa bada yatmus.Wa sarakh wa gaal-:-Sayyidna-!Najjiini-!
Wa Isa madda iidah ajala wa karabah wa gaal-:-Iimaanak lissaa' da'iif.Maala chakkakt-?
Wa wakit rikbo fi l-markaba,khalaas al-riih wagafat.
Wa fi l-markaba al-talaamiiz jo sajado leyah wa gaalo-:-Sahiih,inta Ibn Allah-!
Wa wakit gata'o al-bahar khalaas,nazalo fi balad Ginneesarat.
Wa naas al-bakaan daak irfo Isa wa ballakho al-khabar da fi kula baladhum wa jaabo leyah kulla l-mardaaniin.
Wa chahado Isa achaan yalmaso taraf khalagah wa kulla naadum al-limsah ligi al-aafe.
Wa waahidiin min al-ulama wa l-Fariiziyiin jo le Isa min Madiinat al-Khudus wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:
Maala talaamiizak ma yitaabu'u aadaat al-juduud-?Wa maala humman ma yikhassulu iideehum le yabgo taahiriin gubbaal ma yaakulu-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Wa intu,maala taabo wasaaya Allah le titaabu'u aadaatku-?
Allah amaraana wa gaal-:﴾‍Karrim ammak wa abuuk‍﴿wa﴾‍Ayyi naadum al-yuguul kalaam fasil le ammah aw le abuuh,waajib yaktuluuh.‍﴿
Wa laakin intu tuguulu,kan naadum hajja le ammah aw le abuuh wa gaal-:--Kulli cheyy al-ana nidoor nisaa'idku beyah bigi hadiiye le Allah--,
khalaas be da,intu tuguulu al-naadum da ma waajib yisaa'id ammah aw abuuh.Wa be misil da,battaltu wasaaya Allah achaan titaabu'u aadaatku.
Intu munaafikhiin-!Kalaam Allah al-gaalah foogku al-nabi Icha'ya,sahiih-!Hu gaal-:
﴾‍Al-cha'ab dool yimajjuduuni be khuchuumhumwa laakin guluubhum ba'iid minni.
Sujuudhum leyi baatilwa kulla ta'liimhum da wasaaya al-naas bas.‍﴿
Wa Isa naada al-naas wa gaal leehum-:-Asma'o kalaami wa afhamooh-!
Al-cheyy al-yinajjis al-naadum,hu ma al-cheyy al-yadkhul fi khachmah laakin al-cheyy al-yamrug min khachmah.Da bas yinajjisah.
Wa talaamiizah jo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ma ta'arif al-Fariiziyiin zi'ilo min al-kalaam da walla-?
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ayyi khadaar al-abuuyi Allah ma teerabah yinmalit.
Khalluuhum-!Humman amyaaniin wa yuguudu amyaaniin.Kan naadum amyaan yuguud amyaan aakhar,kulluhum yaga'o fi nugra.
Wa Butrus gaal leyah-:-Fassir leena al-masal al-awwal da.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Intu kula ma iriftuuh walla-?
Ma fihimtu kadar al-akil al-yadkhul fi l-khachum,yamchi fi l-batun wa ba'adeen yamrug min al-jilid.
Wa laakin al-kalaam al-yamrug min khachum al-naadum da jaayi min galbah wa be l-kalaam da bas,yinajjis nafsah.
Achaan min daakhal galib al-insaan yamrug al-fikir al-cheen wa l-katil wa l-zina wa l-fasaala wa l-sirge wa l-chahaada be l-kidib wa kalaam al-kufur.
Wa dool bas al-yinajjusuuh al-insaan wa laakin kan naadum ma khassal iideenah wa akal,da abadan ma yinajjisah.
Wa Isa gamma min al-bakaan da wa macha fi balad Suur wa Seeda fi Lubnaan.
Wa mara waahide Kan'aaniiye jaat wa sarakhat leyah wa gaalat-:-Ya sayyidna,Ibn Dawuud,arhamni-!Bitti gaa'ide fi azaab chadiid achaan hi chootanat-.
Wa Isa ma gaal leeha cheyy wa talaamiizah jo leyah wa chahadooh wa gaalo-:-Asma' kalaamha wa rudd leeha achaan hi jaaye waraana wa tisawwi leena haraka katiire.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Allah rassalaani le Bani Israa'iil bas wa humman khanam Allah al-muwaddiriin.
Wa laakin al-mara garrabat leyah wa sajadat wa gaalat-:-Sayyidna,afza'ni-!
Wa radda leeha be masal wa gaal-:-Akil al-iyaal,kan nantuuh le l-kulaab,da ma sameh.
Wa hi gaalat-:-Kalaamak da sahiih,sayyidna.Wa laakin al-kulaab kamaan yaakulu al-yidaffig min maa'uun siyaadhum-!
Wa Isa radda leeha wa gaal-:-Ya l-mara,iimaanki chadiid marra waahid-!Khalli yabga leeki misil dawwartiih-! Wa bineeyitha ligat al-aafe min al-wakit da.
Wa min al-bakaan da,Isa macha fi khachum bahar al-Jaliil wa tala' fi hajar wa ga'ad tihit.
Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid jo leyah wa jaabo ma'aahum al-uruj wa l-mukarsahiin wa l-amyaaniin wa l-bukum wa aakhariin katiiriin wa khattoohum giddaam Isa wa hu chafaahum.
Wa l-naas al'ajjabo bilheen wakit chaafo al-naas al-bukum yihajju wa l-mukarsahiin ligo al-aafe wa l-uruj yuruukhu wa l-amyaaniin yichiifu.Wa chakaro Allah Rabb Israa'iil.
Wa laakin Isa naada talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Indi mahanna le l-naas dool achaan humman gaa'idiin ma'aayi talaata yoom wa ma induhum cheyy yaakuluuh.Wa ma nidoor nikhalliihum yufuutu jii'aaniin achaan gudrithum tikammil fi l-derib.
Wa l-talaamiiz gaalo leyah-:-Al-naas katiiriin bilheen.Ween nalgo akil fi l-khala da le yachba'o-?
Wa Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Induku kam khubza-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Sab'a.Wa indina huut dugaag chiyya.
Wa Isa amaraahum le l-naas achaan yagoodu tihit.
Wa chaal al-sab'a khubza wa l-huut wa chakar Allah wa kassaraahum wa antaahum le l-talaamiiz wa humman gassamooh le l-naas.
Wa kulla l-naas akalo lahaddi chib'o.Wa l-talaamiiz lammo al-akil al-faddal wa malo beyah sab'a guffa.
Wa adad al-naas al-akalo tamma 4-000 raajil.Wa da,bala l-awiin wa l-iyaal.
Wa ba'ad da,Isa amar al-naas yigabbulu buyuuthum.Wa khalaas hu rikib fi l-markaba wa macha le turaab Magdaan.
Wa naas min al-Fariiziyiin wa min al-Sadduukhiyiin lammo wa macho le Isa achaan yijarrubuuh.Wa talabo minnah yantiihum daliil al-yiwassif kadar gudurtah jaaye min al-sama.
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Be achiiye kan al-sama yabga ahmar,tuguulu ambaakir al-wata tabga samhe.
Wa be fajur,kan al-sama yabga ahmar wa yisawwi khamaam,tuguulu al-yoom al-matar yaji.Tichiifu al-sama wa ta'arfu kikkeef al-wata al-tabga.Wa laakin chiftu alaamaat wakitna da wa ma ta'arfuuh ma'anaathum.
Wa naas al-wakit da fasliin wa khaayniin wa yidooru daliil achaan yi'aamunu.Wa Allah ma yantiihum daliil illa l-daliil hana l-nabi Yuunus.Wa khalaas,Isa khallaahum wa macha.
Wa wakit gata'o al-bahar,talaamiizah ma induhum khubza achaan nisooha.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Khuttu baalku.Angar'u min tawwaarit al-Fariiziyiin wa l-Sadduukhiyiin.
Wa talaamiizah gammo yinaakhuchu ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Hu gaal al-kalaam da achaan ma jibna khubza.
Wa Isa irif fikirhum wa gaal-:-Intu al-iimaanku lissaa' da'iif,maala tihajju ambeenaatku be l-khubza al-ma induku-?
Lissaa' ma fihimtu walla-?Nisiitu al-khamsa khubza wa l-naas al-khamsa alif al-akalo minhum walla-?Wa nisiitu kam guffa maleetuuhum min al-khubza al-faddalat-?
Hal nisiitu al-sab'a khubza wa l-naas al-arba'a alif al-akalo minhum wa kam guffa maleetuuhum walla-?
Wa kikkeef ma fihimtu-?Ana ma hajjeet be khubza wakit gult leeku-:--Angar'u min tawwaarit al-Fariiziyiin wa l-Sadduukhiyiin.-
Wa khalaas al-talaamiiz fihmo hu ma gaa'id yuguul angar'u min tawwaara hana l-khubza laakin angar'u min ta'liim al-Fariiziyiin wa l-Sadduukhiyiin.
Wa jo fi balad Geesariiya Filibbus wa Isa sa'al talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Al-naas gaa'idiin yuguulu chunu fi Ibn al-Insaan-?Yuguulu ana yaatu-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Naas waahidiin yuguulu inta Yahya al-Mukhattis wa naas aakhariin yuguulu inta al-nabi Iliyaas wa aakhariin yuguulu inta al-nabi Irmiya aw naadum waahid min al-anbiya al-faato.
Wa Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Wa laakin intu,tuguulu chunu-?Ana yaatu-?
Wa Sim'aan Butrus gaal-:-Inta al-Masiih Ibn Allah al-Hayy.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Mabruuk leek Sim'aan wileed Yuuhanna-!Al-fikir da ma jaay min insaan-!Laakin abuuyi Allah bas antaak.
Wa nuguul leek usmak Butrus (ma'anaatah hajar).Wa ni'assis ummati fi l-hajar da wa l-moot ma yinnasir foogha.
Wa nantiik mafaatiih hana mamlakat Allah.Ayyi cheyy al-inta ja'altah haraam fi l-ard,Allah fi l-sama kula yaj'alah haraam.Wa ayyi cheyy al-inta ja'altah halaal fi l-ard,Allah fi l-sama kula yaj'alah halaal.
Wa Isa amaraahum le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Ma ti'ooru ayyi naadum kadar ana al-Masiih.
Wa min al-wakit da,Isa bada yi'allim talaamiizah wa ooraahum akiid yamchi Madiinat al-Khudus wa hinaak al-chuyuukh wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama yita''ubuuh ta'ab chadiid.Wa hinaak yaktuluuh wa Allah yab'asah fi l-yoom al-taalit.
Wa Butrus karabah le Isa wa gamma yaharjah wa gaal-:-Abadan,ya sayyidna.Da ma yabga foogak-!
Wa Isa anlafat wa gaal le Butrus-:-Ya Cheetaan-!Kiss min giddaami-!Inta tidoor ticharkil leyi.Kalaamak da ma fikir Allah.Da fikir al-naas.
Wa Isa gaal le talaamiizah-:-Ayyi naadum al-yidoor yichiil derbi,khalli yichiif nafsah rakhiise leyah wa yilhammal ta'ab al-saliib wa yitaabi'ni le l-moot.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yidoor yinajji nafsah,yiwaddirha.Wa ayyi naadum al-yiwaddir nafsah fi chaani ana,hu da yanja.
Wa kan naadum ribih kulla l-maal al-fi l-dunya wa waddar nafsah,faayditah chunu-?Aw naadum yanti chunu fi badal nafsah-?
Fakkuru fi l-kalaam da achaan Ibn al-Insaan yigabbil ma'a gudra majiide hana Allah abuuh wa ma'a malaa'ikatah.Wa ayyi naadum al-sawwa al-fasil,yi'aakhibah.Wa ayyi naadum al-sawwa amal adiil,yantiih ajur.
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg.Fi naas waahidiin al-gaa'idiin hini ma yumuutu gubbaal ma yichiifu Ibn al-Insaan jaayi fi mamlakatah.
Wa ba'ad sitte yoom,Isa chaal ma'aayah Butrus wa Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna akhuuh wa waddaahum wiheedhum fi raas hajar tawiil.
Wa Isa alkhayyar giddaamhum.Wijhah nawwar misil nuur al-harraay wa khalagah bigi abyad karr misil al-nuur.
Wa tawwaali,al-nabi Muusa wa l-nabi Iliyaas baano giddaamhum wa gaa'idiin yihajju ma'a Isa.
Wa Butrus hajja le Isa wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,bigi leena sameh kadar aniina gaa'idiin hini.Wa kan tidoorah,nisawwi lagaadiib talaata,waahide leek wa waahide le Muusa wa waahide le Iliyaas.
Wa wakit hu lissaa' gaa'id yihajji,sahaabaay al-indaha nuur jaat wa khattathum be dullaha wa hiss min lubb al-sahaabaay ansama' wa gaal-:-Da bas Ibni al-nihibbah wa ana farhaan beyah bilheen.Asma'o kalaamah.
Wa l-talaamiiz sim'o al-hiss wa khaafo marra waahid wa waga'o be wujuuhhum fi l-ard.
Wa Isa ja leehum wa khatta iidah fooghum wa gaal-:-Gummu-!Ma takhaafo-!
Wa rafa'o ruuseenhum wa ma chaafo naadum illa Isa wiheedah.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yanzulu min raas al-hajar,Isa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Ma tihajju le naadum waahid kula be l-cheyy al-chiftuuh gubbaal Ibn al-Insaan ma yab'as min ust al-maytiin.
Wa talaamiizah sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Maala al-ulama gaa'idiin yuguulu akiid Iliyaas yaji gubbaalak-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Sahiih Iliyaas yaji gubbaali achaan yi'addil kulla cheyy.
Wa ni'ooriiku Iliyaas ja khalaas wa ma irfooh wa sawwo foogah misil dawwaro.Wa ba'ad chiyya yita''ubuuni ana Ibn al-Insaan kula.
Wa khalaas al-talaamiiz fihmo hu yihajji leehum be Yahya al-Mukhattis.
Wa gabbalo fi l-bakaan al-lammo foogah al-naas wa raajil waahid ja le Isa wa sajad giddaamah.
Wa l-raajil gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,arham wileedi.Indah amfitfit wa hu ta'baan bilheen.Hu yaga' katiir.Marraat yaga' fi l-naar wa marraat yaga' fi l-almi.
Wa waddeetah le talaamiizak wa ma gidro yachfuuh.
Wa Isa radda wa gaal-:-Ya l-naas al-uwuj wa ma induku iimaan-!Lahaddi mata nagood ma'aaku-?Lahaddi mata nilhammalku-?Jiibu leyi al-wileed hini.
Wa Isa kachcha le l-cheetaan wa l-cheetaan marag min al-wileed wa fi l-wakit da bas al-wileed ligi al-aafe.
Wa ba'adeen al-talaamiiz jo wa hajjo le Isa wiheedhum.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Maala ma gidirna taradna al-cheetaan da-?
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Achaan iimaanku da'iif.Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,kan iimaanku sakhayyar misil habbat kireeb kula,tagdaro tuguulu le l-hajar da-:--Azhaf min hini wa amchi hinaak-!- Wa khalaas,al-hajar yazhaf.Wa ayyi cheyy yabga leeku mumkin.
Wa laakin al-cheetaan al-nafar da,ma yintarid illa be l-du'a wa l-siyaam.
Wa wakit Isa wa talaamiizah gaa'idiin yilimmu fi daar al-Jaliil,Isa gaal leehum-:-Ba'ad chiyya Ibn al-Insaan yisallumuuh le l-naas
wa yaktuluuh.Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,Allah yab'asah min ust al-maytiin. Wa talaamiizah bigo haznaaniin bilheen.
Wa ba'ad wislo fi hillit Kafar Naahuum,jo al-naas al-yichiilu al-miiri al-yikaffuuh kulla l-Yahuud le beet Allah.Wa jo le Butrus wa gaalo-:-Sayyidku yikaffi al-miiri walla-? Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Aywa,yikaffiih.
Wa wakit Butrus andassa fi l-beet,Isa hajja leyah wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sim'aan,fikrak chunu-?Al-muluuk al-fi l-dunya yichiilu miiri wa jamaarik min yaatu-?Yichiilu min iyaalhum walla min al-naas al-aakhariin-?
Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Yichiiluuh min al-naas al-aakhariin.-Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Khalaas,ma waajib le iyaal al-malik yikaffuuh.
Wa laakin ma nidooru nibachtunu al-naas al-sa'alook al-miiri dool.Wa achaan da,amchi fi khachum al-bahar wa azgul jambaatak fi l-almi.Wa l-huutaay al-awwal takrubha,fukk khachumha wa talga daakhal riyaal waahid khiimtah tikaffi miiri hana naaseen.Wa chiilah wa kaffi beyah al-miiri hanaayi wa hanaak.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-talaamiiz jo le Isa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Yaatu yabga al-naadum al-muhimm fi mamlakat Allah-?
Wa Isa naada wileed sakhayyar wa khattaah fi usuthum.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,kan intu ma tibaddulu fikirku wa kan ma tabgo misil iyaal dugaag,ma tadkhulu fi mamlakat Allah.
Al-naadum al-yisawwi nafsah sakhayyar wa yabga misil al-wileed da,hu bas al-muhimm fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yakhbal be usmi wileed sakhayyar misil da,yakhbalni.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yitallif iimaan hana waahid min al-iyaal al-dugaag al-mu'miniin beyi dool,al-azaab al-yarjaah chadiid lahaddi akheer le l-naadum da kan yarbutu murhaaka kabiire fi ragabatah wa yazguluuh fi lubb bahar al-khariig.
Azaab yarja naas al-dunya achaan yisawwu machaakil le l-mu'miniin.Laabudda achya waahidiin yabgo wa be sababhum naas waahidiin yamurgu min al-derib wa laakin al-azaab yarja al-naadum al-yisabbib al-achya dool.
Wa kan iidak walla rijlak tidoor tamurgak min al-derib al-adiil,agta'ha wa azgulha ba'iid minnak.Akheer leek kan bigiit ma'duur wa tadkhul fi l-haya al-abadiiye min yazguluuk fi l-naar al-abadiiye be iideenak wa rijileenak.
Wa kan eenak tidoor tamurgak min al-derib al-adiil,sillaha wa azgulha ba'iid minnak.Akheer leek tadkhul fi l-haya al-abadiiye be een waahide bas min yazguluuk fi naar Jahannam be uyuunak al-itneen.
Angar'u ma tahguru ayyi waahid min al-sukhaar dool achaan nuguul leeku malaa'ikathum fi l-sama daayman haadiriin ma'a abuuyi Allah.
Wa ana Ibn al-Insaan jiit achaan ninajji al-naas al-halkaaniin.
Fikirku chunu-?Naadum indah 100 khanam wa khanamaay waahide waddarat.Ma yikhalli al-tis'a wa tis'iin fi l-kadaade wa yamchi yifattich al-muwaddire walla-?
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,kan yalgaaha hu yabga farhaan ziyaada be l-waahide al-waddarat min be l-tis'a wa tis'iin al-ma waddaro.
Wa sawa sawa misil da,abuuku Allah kula ma yidoor waahid min al-sukhaar dool yahlak.
Wa kan akhuuk mu'min sawwa foogak khata,amchi wa hajji ma'a akhuuk da wiheedku wa wassif leyah khataayah.Wa kan yasma' kalaamak,khalaas intu akhwaan.
Wa kan akhuuk yaaba ma yasma' kalaamak,amchi leyah battaan wa chiil ma'aak waahid walla itneen min al-akhwaan achaan al-tuhma ma tasbit illa be chahaada hana naas itneen aw talaata.
Wa kan hu yaaba ma yasma' kalaamhum,jiib al-kalaam da le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.Wa kan aba ma yasma' kalaam jamaa'at al-mu'miniin kula,aj'alah misil naadum ma mu'min walla misil naadum al-yichiil al-miiri.
Achaan nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi cheyy al-ja'altuuh haraam fi l-ard,Allah fi l-sama kula yaj'alah haraam wa ayyi cheyy al-ja'altuuh halaal fi l-ard,Allah fi l-sama kula yaj'alah halaal.
Wa battaan nuguul leeku al-hagg,kan naaseen minku fi l-ard astafago fi ayyi cheyy al-yidooruuh,abuuyi Allah al-fi l-sama yisawwiih leehum.
Wa ayyi bakaan al-yilimmu foogah al-naas be usmi,kan humman itneen aw talaata kula,ana zaati gaa'id fi usuthum.
Wa Butrus ja le Isa wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,kan akhuuyi yisawwi khata foogi katiir,kam marra nisaamihah-?Nisaamihah lahaddi sab'a marraat walla-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ma tisaamihah lahaddi sab'a marraat bas.Laakin saamihah sab'iin lahaddi sab'a marraat-!
Aywa,mamlakat Allah hi misil ke.Naadum waahid malik wa dawwar yisawwi hisaab ma'a khaddaamiinah.
Wa wakit bada al-hisaab ma'aahum,jaabo leyah khaddaam waahid.Wa l-naadum da,al-malik indah foogah maal katiir marra waahid.
Wa l-khaddaam ma indah cheyy al-yikaffi beyah al-deen al-foogah.Wa siidah al-malik gaal waajib yibii'u al-khaddaam ma'a martah wa iyaalah wa kulla cheyy al-indah fi suug al-abiid achaan yikaffi deenah.
Wa laakin al-khaddaam waga' giddaamah wa gaal-:--Ya siidi,asburni wa nikaffiik al-indak foogi kulla ke.--
Wa siid al-khaddaam da hanna foogah wa afa leyah al-deen wa khallaah macha.
