Wa hu addaayag minhum lahaddi chaal nafasah foog wa khattaah wa gaal-:-Maala naas al-wakit da yidooru daliil-?Nuguul leeku al-hagg.Allah ma yanti naas al-wakit da daliil.
Wa khalaas,khallaahum wa rikib fi l-markaba wa gamma le yagta' al-bahar.
Wa talaamiizah niso ma jaabo al-akil ma'aahum.Wa induhum khubza waahide bas fi l-markaba.
Wa Isa gaa'id yihazzirhum wa yuguul-:-Khuttu baalku.Angar'u min tawwaarit al-Fariiziyiin wa tawwaarit Hiruudus.
Wa gammo yinaakhuchu ambeenaathum fi kalaamah wa gaalo-:-Hu gaal al-kalaam da achaan ma indina khubza.
Wa Isa irif fikirhum wa gaal-:-Maala tihajju be l-khubza al-ma induku-?Lissaa' ma iriftu wa fihimtu walla-?Wa ruuseeku bigo gawiyiin walla-?
Intu induku uyuun wa ma chiftu-?Induku udne wa ma simi'tu-?Nisiitu marra waahid walla-?
Fakkuru fi l-khamsa khubza al-ana kassartuhum fi chaan al-naas al-khamsa alif.Maleetu kam guffa min al-khubza al-faddalat-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Atnaachar guffa.
Wa battaan sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Fakkuru fi l-sab'a khubza al-anteethum le l-naas al-arba'a alif.Maleetu kam guffa-? Wa gaalo-:-Sab'a guffa.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Lissaa' ma fihimtu walla-?
Wa jo fi hillit Beet Seeda.Wa naas waahidiin jaabo leyah naadum amyaan.Wa chahado Isa achaan yalmasah wa yidaawiih.
Wa Isa karab iid al-amyaan wa waddaah barra min al-hille.Wa bazzakh leyah fi uyuunah wa khatta iideenah foogah wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta gaa'id tichiif walla-?
Wa l-amyaan rafa' raasah wa gaal-:-Nichiif rujaal.Wa laakin yichaabuhu misil chadar raaykhiin.
Wa battaan Isa khatta iideenah foog uyuunah.Wa l-naadum fakka uyuunah battaan wa chaaf kulla cheyy adiil wa khalaas ligi al-aafe.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Gabbil beetak.Al-hille di,ma tadkhul foogha battaan.
Wa Isa macha giddaam ma'a talaamiizah fi hillaal hana Geesariiya Filibbus.Wa wakit maachiin,hu sa'alaahum le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Al-naas gaa'idiin yuguulu ana yaatu-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Naas waahidiin yuguulu inta Yahya al-Mukhattis.Wa naas aakhariin yuguulu inta al-nabi Iliyaas.Wa aakhariin kamaan yuguulu inta naadum waahid min al-anbiya al-faato.
Wa battaan Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Wa laakin intu,tuguulu chunu-?Tuguulu ana yaatu-? Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta al-Masiih.
Wa Isa hazzaraahum be tahziir chadiid achaan ma yi'ooru beyah ayyi naadum.
Wa Isa bada yi'allim talaamiizah wa yuguul leehum-:-Ibn al-Insaan akiid yat'ab ta'ab chadiid wa l-chuyuukh wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama yaabooh.Wa hu yaktuluuh wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,yab'as min ust al-maytiin.
Wa gaal al-kalaam da be kalaam waadih.Wa Butrus karabah le Isa wa gamma yaharjah.
Wa Isa anlafat wa chaaf talaamiizah wa haraj Butrus wa gaal-:-Ya Cheetaan,kiss min giddaami-!Kalaamak da ma fikir Allah.Da fikir al-naas.
Wa Isa naada kulla l-naas achaan yilimmu ma'a talaamiizah.Wa gaal leehum-:-Ayyi naadum al-yidoor yitaabi'ni khalli yichiif nafsah rakhiise leyah wa yilhammal ta'ab al-saliib wa yitaabi'ni le l-moot.
Achaan ayyi naadum al-yidoor yinajji nafsah,yiwaddirha.Laakin ayyi naadum al-yiwaddir nafsah fi chaani ana wa fi chaan al-bichaara,yanja.
Kan naadum ribih kulla l-maal al-fi l-dunya wa waddar nafsah,faayditah chunu-?
Wa naadum yanti chunu fi badal nafsah-?
Akiid naas al-wakit al-haali muznibiin wa khaayniin.Wa ayyi naadum al-yankurni be sabab al-eeb al-yalgaah minhum,ana Ibn al-Insaan nankurah wakit nigabbil be gudrat abuuyi Allah al-majiide ma'a malaa'ikatah al-mukhaddasiin.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,fi naas waahidiin al-gaa'idiin hini ma yumuutu gubbaal ma yichiifu mamlakat Allah wakit taji be gudra.
Wa ba'ad sitte yoom,Isa chaal ma'aayah Butrus wa Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna wa waddaahum wiheedhum fi raas hajar tawiil.Wa Isa alkhayyar giddaamhum.
Wa khalagah bada yiraari wa bigi abyad karr marra waahid.Wa abadan ma fi naadum fi l-dunya al-yagdar yisawwi khalag abyad misil da.
Wa l-nabi Muusa wa l-nabi Iliyaas baano giddaamhum wa gaa'idiin yihajju ma'a Isa.
Wa Butrus hajja le Isa wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,bigi leena sameh kadar aniina gaa'idiin hini.Khalli nabnu lagaadiib talaata.Waahide leek inta wa waahide le Muusa wa waahide le Iliyaas.
Wa Butrus hajja misil da achaan hu al'ajjab wa ma irif yuguul chunu.Wa kulluhum khaafo marra waahid.
Wa sahaabaay waahide jaat wa khattathum be dullaha wa hiss min lubb al-sahaabaay ansama' wa gaal-:-Da bas Ibni al-nihibbah.Asma'o kalaamah.
Wa tawwaali anlafato wa ma chaafo ayyi naadum,illa Isa wiheedah bas ma'aahum.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yanzulu min raas al-hajar,Isa amaraahum achaan ma yi'ooru ayyi naadum be l-cheyy al-chaafooh gubbaal Ibn al-Insaan ma yab'as min ust al-maytiin.
Wa humman sim'o kalaamah.Wa assaa'alo ambeenaathum chunu ma'ana al-kalaam al-gaalah fi l-bu'aas min ust al-maytiin.
Wa sa'alo Isa wa gaalo-:-Maala al-ulama gaa'idiin yuguulu akiid Iliyaas yaji gubbaalak-?
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Sahiih,Iliyaas yaji gubbaali achaan yi'addil kulla cheyy.Laakin ma misil fi fikirku,achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab kadar Ibn al-Insaan yat'ab ta'ab chadiid wa l-naas yahguruuh.
Wa laakin nuguul leeku Iliyaasja khalaas wa sawwo foogah misil dawwarooh.Wa da misil al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab.
Wa lihgo al-talaamiiz al-aakhariin wa chaafo naas katiiriin bilheen ma'aahum wa l-ulama gaa'idiin yinaakhuchuuhum.
Wa wakit al-naas chaafo Isa jaayi,humman ajjabo bilheen wa jaro leyah wa sallamooh.
Wa Isa sa'al talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Tinaakhuchu ma'aahum fi chunu-?
Wa naadum waahid min ust al-naas radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-sayyid,ana jibt leek wileedi achaan indah cheetaan al-yisawwiih ambuuku.
Wa wakit al-cheetaan yakrub al-wileed,yarmiih fi l-turaab wa rikhwe tamrug min khachmah wa yi'addi sunuunah wa yaybas karr min al-amfitfit.Wa ana talabt min talaamiizak achaan yaturdu minnah al-cheetaan wa laakin humman ma gidro.
Wa Isa radda wa gaal-:-Ya l-naas al-ma induku iimaan-!Lahaddi mata nagood ma'aaku-?Lahaddi mata nilhammalku-?Jiibu leyi al-wileed.
Wa jaabo leyah al-wileed.Wa l-cheetaan chaaf Isa wa tawwaali al-wileed fatfat wa waga' fi turaab wa chaglab wa rikhwe maragat min khachmah.
Wa Isa sa'al abu al-wileed wa gaal-:-Min kam yoom hu ta'baan misil da-? Wa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Min hu sakhayyar.
Al-cheetaan yidoor yaktulah wa iddat marraat ramaah fi l-naar wa fi l-almi.Arhamna.Aawinna,kan ma gaasi leek.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Inta gult kan ma gaasi leyi.Wa ana nuguul kan naadum indah iimaan,ma fi cheyy gaasi leyah.
Wa tawwaali,abu al-wileed radda leyah be hiss foog wa gaal-:-Indi iimaan-!Najjiini min chukuuki-!
Wa Isa chaaf kadar al-naas al-laammiin foogah gaa'idiin yiziidu wa naas ziyaada jaariyiin aleyah wa khalaas kachcha le l-cheetaan wa gaal-:-Ya cheetaan ambuuku.Asma' kalaami-!Amrug minnah wa abadan ma tigabbil foogah-!
Wa l-cheetaan aat wa l-wileed fatfat fatfitiin chadiid wa l-cheetaan marag minnah khalaas.Wa l-wileed raagid saakit misil naadum mayyit.Wa achaan da naas katiiriin gaalo-:-Khalaas,al-wileed maat.
Wa laakin Isa karab iidah wa aawanah wa l-wileed gamma foog.
Wa ba'adeen Isa dakhal fi l-beet wa talaamiizah jo leyah wiheedhum.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Maala ma gidirna taradna al-cheetaan da-?
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-cheetaan al-nafar da ma yintarid illa be l-sala.
Wa gammo min al-bakaan da wa chaggo daar al-Jaliil.Wa Isa dawwar al-naas ma ya'arfu al-bakaan al-hu gaa'id foogah
achaan hu gaa'id yi'allim talaamiizah wiheedhum bas.Wa gaa'id yuguul leehum-:-Ba'ad chiyya Ibn al-Insaan yisallumuuh le l-naas wa yaktuluuh.Wa talaata yoom ba'ad mootah,hu yab'as.
Laakin humman ma fihmo kalaamah wa ma sa'alooh min al-kalaam da achaan humman khaayfiin.
Wa jo fi hillit Kafar Naahuum wa dakhalo fi l-beet.Wa fi l-bakaan da,Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Awwal,wakit aniina fi l-derib,intu gaa'idiin tinaakhuchu fi chunu-?
Wa khijlo wa sakato achaan fi l-derib gaa'idiin yilkhaalato ambeenaathum fi yaatu minhum al-kabiir.
Wa hu ga'ad tihit wa naada al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar.Wa gaal leehum-:-Kan naadum yidoor yabga al-awwal,hu waajib yisawwi nafsah al-akhiir wa yabga khaddaam hana kulla l-naas.
Wa Isa jaab leehum wileed sakhayyar wa waggafah fi usuthum wa hadanah.
Wa gaal-:-Ayyi naadum al-yakhbal wileed sakhayyar misil da be usmi,yakhbalni ana.Wa l-naadum al-khibilaani,ma khibilaani ana wiheedi.Hu khibil Allah al-rassalaani.
Wa Yuuhanna hajja le Isa wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,chifna naadum waahid gaa'id yatrud al-chawaatiin be usmak.Wa dawwarna nadharooh achaan hu ma gaa'id yitaabi'ak ma'aana.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ma tadharooh achaan ma fi naadum al-yisawwi ajaayib be usmi wa ajala ke yuguul foogi kalaam fasil.
Wa l-naadum al-ma yidaawisna hu gaa'id yisaa'idna.
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-yantiiku kaas hana almi achaan intu naas al-Masiih,ajrah ma yiwaddir abadan.
Wa laakin ayyi naadum al-yitallif iimaan hana waahid min al-mu'miniin al-dugaag dool,al-azaab al-yarjaah yabga chadiid lahaddi akheer leyah kan rabato fi ragabatah murhaaka kabiire wa zagalooh fi l-bahar.
Wa kan iidak tidoor tamurgak min al-derib al-adiil,agta'ha-!Akheer leek tadkhul fi l-haya al-abadiiye be iid waahide bas min tadkhul fi Jahannam be iideenak al-itneen.Wa naar Jahannam abadan ma yumuut.
Fi l-bakaan da,al-duud al-yaakulhum abadan ma yumuut wa ma fi cheyy yaktul al-naar.
Wa kan rijlak tidoor tamurgak min al-derib al-adiil,agta'ha.Akheer leek tadkhul fi l-haya al-abadiiye be rijil waahide bas min yazguluuk fi Jahannam be rijileenak al-itneen.
Fi l-bakaan da,al-duud al-yaakulhum abadan ma yumuut wa ma fi cheyy yaktul al-naar.
Wa kan eenak tidoor tamurgak min al-derib al-adiil,sillaha-!Akheer leek tadkhul fi mamlakat Allah be een waahide bas min yazguluuk fi Jahannam be uyuunak al-itneen.
Fi l-bakaan da,al-duud al-yaakulhum abadan ma yumuut wa ma fi cheyy yaktul al-naar.
Ayyi naadum yitahhuruuh be naar misil yitahhuru al-dahiiye be mileh.
Al-mileh adiil.Laakin kan ta'aamah bigi ma fiih,chunu yigabbilah-?Abgo taa'imiin misil al-mileh wa khalli al-salaam yagood ambeenaatku.
Wa Isa gamma min al-bakaan da wa macha fi daar al-Yahuudiiya wa gata' bahar al-Urdun.Wa battaan naas katiiriin lammo foogah wa hu allamaahum misil fi aadtah.
Wa naas waahidiin min al-Fariiziyiin macho leyah wa dawwaro yakurbuuh fi chaan kalaamah al-yuguulah.Wa achaan da,sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Kan al-raajil yitallig martah,da halaal walla-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Wa Muusa amaraaku be chunu-?
Wa gaalo-:-Muusa anta izin le l-raajil achaan yaktib maktuub hana talaag wa yitallig martah.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Muusa katab leeku al-wasiiye di achaan ruuseeku gawiyiin.
Wa laakin fi l-awwal,wakit Allah khalag al-ard,hu khalagaahum raajil wa mara.
Wa be sabab da,ayyi raajil yikhalli ammah wa abuuh wa yilimm ma'a martah
wa l-naaseen yabgo jisim waahid.Wa be misil da,humman ma naaseen battaan achaan bigo jisim waahid.
Allah bas rabataahum wa ma waajib al-insaan yifarrighum.
Wa ba'adeen,Isa gaa'id fi l-beet wa talaamiizah sa'alooh fi l-kalaam da.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ayyi naadum al-yitallig martah wa yaakhud mara aakhara yisawwi leeha khata wa gaa'id yazna.
Wa battaan ayyi mara al-tallagat raajilha wa akhadat raajil aakhar,hi zaaniye.
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yiwaddu iyaalhum le Isa achaan hu yalmashum le yibaarikhum.Wa talaamiizah harajoohum.
Wa Isa simi' kalaamhum wa zi'il.Wa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Khallu al-iyaal yaju leyi wa ma tadharoohum achaan mamlakat Allah hana l-naas al-misilhum.
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,naadum abadan ma yadkhul fi mamlakat Allah kan ma yakhbalha misil wileed sakhayyar.
Wa hu hadanaahum le l-iyaal wa khatta iideenah fooghum wa baarakaahum.
Wakit Isa gamma maachi fi derbah,naadum waahid jara leyah wa sajad giddaamah wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Ya l-mu'allim al-adiil-!Waajib nisawwi chunu achaan nalga al-haya al-abadiiye-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Maala tuguul ana adiil-?Waahid bas adiil wa hu Allah.
Akiid ta'arif al-wasaaya-:﴾‍Ma taktul dimme wa ma tazna wa ma tasrig wa ma tachhad be kidib wa ma tukhuchch al-naas wa karrim ammak wa abuuk.‍﴿
Wa l-naadum gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,min wakit ana sakhayyar nitaabi' kulla l-wasaaya dool.
Wa Isa chaafah adiil be mahabba wa gaal-:-Chokhol waahid lissaa' gassar leek.Bii' kulla cheyy al-indak wa anti tamanah le l-masaakiin wa misil da,talgaah giddaamak.Wa ta'aal taabi'ni.
Wa wakit al-khani simi' al-kalaam da,hu karab wijhah.Wa gamma min hinaak wa macha haznaan achaan hu indah maal katiir.
Wa Isa anlafat wa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Al-dakhuul fi mamlakat Allah yabga gaasi le l-naas al-induhum maal katiir.
Wa talaamiizah ajjabo bilheen min kalaamah da.Wa Isa hajja leehum battaan wa gaal-:-Ya iyaali,akiid al-dakhuul fi mamlakat Allah yabga gaasi.
Dakhuul al-jamal fi gadd al-ibre hayyin min dakhuul siid al-maal fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa al'ajjabo marra waahid min kalaamah.Wa assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Kan misil da,yaatu yagdar yanja-?
Wa Isa chaafaahum adiil wa gaal-:-Da gaasi marra waahid le l-naas laakin ma gaasi le Allah achaan ma fi cheyy gaasi le Allah.
Wa Butrus gamma yihajji wa gaal-:-Wa aniina khalleena kulla cheyy al-indina achaan nitaabu'uuk.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-gamma fi chaani wa fi chaan al-bichaara wa khalla beetah aw akhwaanah aw akhwaatah aw ammah aw abuuh aw iyaalah aw ziraa'tah,
hu yalga fi l-wakit al-haali 100 marra buyuut wa akhwaan wa akhwaat wa ammahaat wa iyaal wa ziraa'a wa ma'aahum diige chadiide.Wa fi l-aakhira,yalga al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa laakin naas katiiriin al-gaa'idiin wara,yabgo giddaam wa naas katiiriin al-gaa'idiin giddaam kamaan,yabgo wara.
Wa Isa wa talaamiizah maachiin fi derib hana Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa Isa raayikh giddaamhum wa talaamiizah gaa'idiin yil'ajjabo foogah.Wa l-naas al-maachiin waraahum khaayfiin.Wa Isa tarraf al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar wa hajja leehum wiheedhum.Wa bada yihajji leehum be l-ta'ab al-yaji foogah gariib.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Asma'o.Aniina maachiin le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hinaak yisallumu Ibn al-Insaan le kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa le l-ulama.Wa humman yahkumu leyah be l-moot wa yisallumuuh le l-ma mu'miniin.
Wa yichchammato leyah wa yibazzukhu foogah wa yajluduuh wa yaktuluuh.Wa laakin fi talaata yoom hu yab'as.
Wa Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna awlaad Zabadi macho le Isa wa gaalo-:-Sayyidna,nidooru inta tisawwi leena al-cheyy al-natulbuuh minnak.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Tidooru nisawwi leeku chunu-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Antiina izin achaan nahkumu ma'aak fi mamlakatak al-majiide,waahid minnina be iidak al-zeene wa waahid minnina be iidak al-isra.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Intu ma fihimtu al-cheyy al-tidooruuh.Tagdaro tacharbo min kaas al-ta'ab al-ana nachrab minnah walla-?Tahmalo al-khattisiin al-yikhattusuuni beyah walla-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aywa,nagdaro. Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Khalaas,intu tacharbo min al-kaas al-ana akkid nachrab minnah.Wa yikhattusuuku be l-khattisiin al-yikhattusuuni beyah.
Laakin ana ma nagdar na'azil al-naas al-yagoodu fi iidi al-zeene wa fi iidi al-isra.Allah jahhaz al-bakaanaat dool le l-naas al-hu bas azalaahum.
Wa l-talaamiiz al-achara sim'o al-kalaam da wa zi'ilo min Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna.
Wa Isa naada kulla talaamiizah wa gaal leehum-:-Ta'arfu kadar ambeen al-naas al-ma mu'miniin,ayyi naadum al-ja'alooh haakimhum yamluk be chidde fi cha'abah.Wa kubaaraathum kula yitmallako fi l-naas.
Wa laakin intu ma waajib tabgo misilhum.Ayyi naadum minku al-yidoor yabga kabiir khalli yabga khaddaamku.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yidoor yabga kabiirku khalli yabga abidku.
Achaan ana Ibn al-Insaan,ana zaati ma jiit achaan al-naas yakhdumu leyi laakin achaan ana nakhdim le l-naas.Wa jiit achaan nafda naas katiiriin be ruuhi.
Wa Isa wa talaamiizah wislo fi hillit Ariiha.Wakit Isa wa talaamiizah maargiin min Ariiha,naas katiiriin marra waahid jaayiin waraayah.Wa amyaan waahid gaa'id tihit jamb al-chaari' achaan yas'al sadakha min al-naas.Wa usmah Baartimaawi wileed Timaawi.
Wa hu simi' kadar Isa min al-Naasira maachi be l-chaari' da.Wa hu aat wa gaal-:-Ya Isa-!Ya Ibn Dawuud-!Arhamni-!
Wa naas katiiriin harajooh wa gaalo leyah -Askut-! Laakin al-amyaan gamma yi'iit be ziyaada wa yuguul-:-Ya Ibn Dawuud,arhamni-!
Wa Isa wagaf wa gaal-:-Naaduuh.Khalli yaji leyi. Wa naado al-amyaan wa gaalo leyah-:-Chidd heelak wa gumm foog.Hu gaa'id yinaadiik.
Wa l-amyaan rama khitaayah wa natta foog wa macha le Isa.
Wa Isa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Tidoor nisawwi leek chunu-? Wa l-amyaan gaal-:-Sayyidna,nidoor nichiif.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Khalaas,chiif-!Inta ligiit al-aafe be sabab iimaanak. Wa tawwaali uyuunah anfataho wa gamma yitaabi' Isa.
Wa Isa wa talaamiizah garrabo le Madiinat al-Khudus wa lihgo hillaal Beet Faaji wa Beet Anya al-fi jabal al-Zaytuun.Wa Isa rassal giddaamah talaamiiz itneen
wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu fi l-hille al-giddaamna di.Wa fi khachum al-hille talgo dahach waahid marbuut.Wa l-dahach da naadum lissaa' ma rikib foogah.Hilluuh wa jiibuuh leyi hini.
Wa kan naadum yas'alku wa yuguul-:--Maala intu gaa'idiin tihillu al-dahach-?- guulu leyah-:--Al-Rabb yidoorah wa yigabbilah tawwaali.-
Wa macho wa ligo al-dahach fi l-chaari' marbuut giddaam beet waahid.Wa hallooh.
Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin hinaak sa'aloohum wa gaalo-:-Gaa'idiin tisawwu chunu-?Maala halleetu al-dahach-?
Wa raddo leehum be l-kalaam al-Isa gaalah leehum wa khalaas khalloohum macho be l-dahach.
Wa jaabo al-dahach le Isa wa farracho khulgaanhum foogah wa hu rikib.
Wa naas katiiriin farracho khulgaanhum fi l-chaari' al-Isa jaayi foogah le yijammuluuh.Wa aakhariin gata'o warchaal min al-chadar wa farrachooh fi l-turaab.
Wa l-naas al-jaayiin ma'a Isa giddaamah wa waraayah kulluhum chakaro Allah be hiss aali wa gaalo-:-Al-hamdulillah-!﴾‍Mabruuk le l-naadumal-jaayi be usum Allah-!‍﴿
Mamlakat jiddina Dawuud jaayewa l-hamdulillah-!﴾‍Ahmudu Allah fi l-aali-!‍﴿
Wa Isa dakhal fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa dakhal fi beet Allah wa chaaf kulla cheyy al-gaa'id foogah.Wa l-wakit akhkhar wa achaan da,hu marag min al-madiina wa macha le hillit Beet Anya ma'a talaamiizah al-atnaachar.
Wa ambaakir,Isa wa talaamiizah jaayiin min hillit Beet Anya wa Isa jii'aan.
Wa chaaf giddaamah chiyya ba'iid chadarat tiin malaane warchaal.Wa macha leeha achaan yagta' minha iyaal.Laakin wakit lihigha ma ligi foogha tiin,illa l-warchaal bas,achaan wakitha lissaa' ma tamma.
Wa Isa hajja le l-chadara wa gaal-:-Abadan ma yaakulu minki battaan-! Wa talaamiizah sim'o kalaamah.
Wa wassalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa Isa dakhal fi beet Allah wa gamma yatrud kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin yisaawugu fi l-fadaay.Wa chaglab taraabiiz al-naas al-yibaddulu gurus wa banaabir al-naas al-yisaawugu hamaam.
Wa fi naas chaayliin khumaamhum al-yidooru yuchuggu fadaayit beet Allah wa Isa daharaahum.
Wa Isa allam al-naas wa gaal-:-Fi l-Kitaab,Allah gaal-:﴾‍Beeti yisammuuh beet al-sala le kulla l-chu'uub.‍﴿﴾‍Wa laakin intu chiftuuh misil karkuur hana saraariig-!‍﴿
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama sim'o kalaamah wa bado yichchaawaro kikkeef yaktuluuh.Wa humman khaafo minnah achaan kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yasma'o kalaamah wa ta'liimah ajabaahum marra waahid.
Wa fi l-makhrib Isa wa talaamiizah marago min al-madiina.
Wa ambaakir fajur,humman maachiin fi l-derib wa chaafo battaan chadarat tiin.Wa hi mayte wa yibsat marra waahid lahaddi uruugha.
Wa Butrus fakkar fi l-kalaam al-Isa gaalah.Wa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,chiif.Al-chadara al-inta la'antaha yibsat.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Aamunu be Allah iimaan gawi.
Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-yaamur al-jabal da wa yuguul leyah-:--Amrug min hini wa aga' fi l-bahar-- da bas yukuun,kan hu ma chakkak fi galbah wa saddag be niiye waahide kadar al-cheyy al-hu gaalah da yukuun.
Achaan da,nuguul leeku kulla cheyy al-tas'alooh min Allah,saddugu kadar ligiituuh khalaas wa talgooh.
Wa ayyi wakit tidooru tisallu,saamuhu ayyi naadum al-khiti foogku achaan abuuku Allah yisaamih leeku khataayaaku.
Wa kan intu ma saamahtu al-naas al-khito foogku,abuuku Allah ma yisaamih leeku khataayaaku.
Wa Isa wa talaamiizah wassalo battaan fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit Isa raayikh fi fadaayit beet Allah,kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama wa l-chuyuukh jo leyah.
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Taradt al-tujjaar be izin yaatu-?Wa yaatu antaak izin-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Wa ana kula indi su'aal nas'alku.Ruddu leyi wa ana kula nikhabbirku yaatu al-antaani izin achaan nisawwi al-khidme di.
Yahya khattas al-naas be izin Allah walla be izin al-naas-?Ruddu leyi-!
Wa achchaawaro ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Kan gulna Yahya indah izin min Allah,Isa yuguul leena-:--Wa maala ma aamantu beyah-?--
Laakin ma nagdaro nuguulu indah izin min al-naas. Wa hajjo misil da achaan humman khaafo min al-cha'ab wa ma dawwaro yiza''uluuhum.Achaan fi fikir kulla l-cha'ab,akiid Yahya nabi.
Wa humman raddo le Isa wa gaalo-:-Da ma na'arfuuh. Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Khalaas,ana kula ma ni'ooriiku yaatu al-antaani izin achaan nisawwi al-khidme di.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Isa gamma yihajji leehum be amsaal wa gaal-:-Naadum waahid maggan inab fi jineene.Wa zarabaaha wa sawwa foogha assaara hana inab wa bana beet hana haraasa.Wa hu ajjar harraatiin achaan yakhdumu foogha wa khalaas khatar wa macha fi balad aakhara.
Wa fi wakit lammiin al-inab,hu rassal abid waahid le l-harraatiin achaan yichiil minhum al-inab al-waajib leyah.
Wa l-harraatiin karabooh wa daggooh wa gabbalooh le siidah bala cheyy.
Wa battaan rassal leehum abid taani.Wa l-abid da,hu kula daggooh fi raasah wa ayyarooh.
Wa rassal leehum battaan abid aakhar wa l-abid da,katalooh.Wa rassal leehum abiid katiiriin wa l-harraatiin sawwo leehum nafs al-cheyy.Waahidiin daggoohum wa waahidiin kataloohum.
Wa faddal leyah naadum waahid bas al-hu yirassilah wa da wileedah al-yihibbah bilheen.Wa fi l-akhiir,siid al-jineene gaal-:--Akiid wileedi da yikarrumuuh.- Wa khalaas rassal leehum wileedah.
Laakin al-harraatiin achchaawaro ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:--Daahu yawris al-jineene.Khalli naktuluuh achaan al-warasa tabga hintina-!--
Wa khalaas karabooh wa katalooh wa zagalo janaaztah barra min al-jineene.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Wa hassa' da,nas'alku.Siid al-jineene yisawwi fooghum chunu-?Akiid hu yaji fi l-jineene wa yaktul al-harraatiin dool wa khalaas yanti al-jineene le naas aakhariin.
Akiid gareetu al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-buguul-:﴾‍Al-hajar al-bannaayiin al-beet awwal ma dawwaroohbigi al-hajar al-muhimm fi buna al-beet.
Wa l-cheyy da jaayi min Allahwa chifnaah ajiib-!‍﴿
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-kubaaraat dawwaro yakurbu Isa fi l-sijin achaan fihmo kadar be l-masal da Isa hajja fooghum laakin humman khaafo min al-naas.Wa achaan da,gammo khallooh wa faato.
Wa l-kubaaraat rassalo le Isa naas waahidiin min al-Fariiziyiin wa naas waahidiin min hizib Hiruudus achaan yarmuuh be kalaamah.
Wa l-jawaasiis dool jo leyah wa gaalo-:-Sayyidna,na'arfu kadar kalaamak hagg.Inta ma khaayif min ayyi naadum.Ma takhaaf min wijih al-naas wa ti'allim al-naas derib Allah al-sahiih.Khalaas,guul leena,hasab al-Tawraat waajib leena nikaffu al-miiri le sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin walla-?Al-tukfa waajib leena walla ma waajib-?
Wa Isa irif humman munaafikhiin.Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Maala tidooru tijarrubuuni-?Antuuni diinaar waahid wa khalli nichiifah.
Wa antooh diinaar waahid.Wa hu sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Al-suura wa l-usum al-gaa'idiin foogah dool hana yaatu-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Hana sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Khalaas.Hana l-sultaan,antuuh le l-sultaan wa hana Allah,antuuh le Allah-! Wa al'ajjabo minnah marra waahid.
Wa Sadduukhiyiin waahidiin jo le Isa be su'aal.Wa l-Sadduukhiyiin ma mu'miniin be l-bu'aas.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:
Ya l-sayyid,nidooru nihajju leek be l-kalaam al-Muusa katabah leena fi l-Tawraat.Hu yuguul kan raajil maat wa khalla mara ma indah iyaal,waajib akhu al-raajil da yaakhud al-mara.Wa be da,hu yalda minha zurriiye le akhuuh al-marhuum.
Wa awwal fi sab'a akhwaan.Wa l-kabiir minhum akhad mara wa wakit hu maat ma indah minha zurriiye.
Wa l-taani akhadha wa ba'adeen hu kula maat wa ma jaab minha zurriiye wa l-taalit sawwa nafs al-cheyy.
Wa nafs al-cheyy bigi le l-aakhariin kula.Wa l-akhwaan al-sab'a kulluhum akhado al-mara di wa maato bala zurriiye.Wa fi l-akhiir,al-mara zaatha maatat.
Wa khalaas wakit al-maytiin yab'aso da,hi tabga marit yaatu minhum-?Achaan kulluhum al-sab'a akhadooha.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Intu ma ta'arfu Kitaab Allah wa la gudrat Allah wa achaan da bas intu muwaddiriin.
Achaan wakit al-maytiin yab'aso,al-rujaal ma yaakhudu awiin wa l-awiin ma yaakhudan rujaal.Yabgo misil al-malaa'ika fi l-samaawaat.Ambeenaathum akhiide ma fi.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss bu'aas al-maytiin,hal nisiitu al-kalaam al-gareetuuh fi Kitaab Muusa walla-?Fakkuru fi l-kalaam al-bukhuss al-chideere al-gammat foogha naar.Fi l-bakaan da,Allah hajja leyah wa gaal-:﴾‍Ana Allah Rabb juduudku Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub.‍﴿
Wa hu Rabb al-hayyiin wa ma Rabb al-maytiin.Wa khalaas intu muwaddiriin marra waahid.
Wa naadum waahid min al-ulama gaa'id hinaak wa hu simi' al-munaakhacha di.Wa hu chaaf kadar Isa radda le l-Sadduukhiyiin be radd adiil.Wa achaan da,hu sa'alah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,min kulla wasaaya Allah,weeni al-wasiiye al-muhimme-?
Wa Isa radda wa gaal-:-Al-wasiiye al-muhimme hi tuguul-:﴾‍Asma'o ya Bani Israa'iil-!Allah Ilaahna hu Allah al-Waahid.
Hibbu Allah Ilaahku be kulla guluubku wa be kulla nufuusku wa be kulla fikirku wa be kulla gudritku.‍﴿
Wa l-wasiiye al-taaniye hi-:﴾‍Hibb akhuuk misil tihibb nafsak.‍﴿Wa dool bas al-wasaaya al-kubaar wa ma fi wasiiye akbar minhum.
Wa l-aalim gaal-:-Kalaamak sameh,sayyidna.Kalaamak hagg,achaan Allah waahid wa la ilaah illa hu.
Wa kan naadum yihibbah be kulla galbah wa kulla fikrah wa kulla gudurtah wa yihibb akhuuh misil yihibb nafsah,da akheer min kulla dahiiye wa hadiiye al-yagdar yigaddimhum le Allah.
Wa Isa khassad be kalaam al-aalim achaan hu radda be fikir adiil.Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Inta ma ba'iid min mamlakat Allah. Wa ba'ad da,naadum waahid kula ma dawwar yas'alah ayyi su'aal.
Wa wakit Isa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi fadaayit beet Allah,hu gaal-:-Kikkeef al-ulama yuguulu kadar al-Masiih hu Ibn Dawuud-?
Dawuud zaatah kallam be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa gaal-:--Allah hajja le siidi al-malik wa gaal-:﴾‍Agood be nussi al-zeenaay lahaddi nukhutt udwaanak tihit rijileenak.‍﴿-
Wa fi l-kalaam da,Dawuud gaal al-Masiih hu siidah.Wa be misil da,kikkeef al-Masiih yabga wileedah-? Wa naas katiiriin bilheen gaa'idiin yasma'o kalaamah be farah.
Wakit Isa gaa'id yi'allimhum hu gaal-:-Aw'u baalku min al-ulama.Humman yiriidu yuruukhu fi ust al-naas laabsiin jalaaliib tuwaal wa yiriidu salaam al-naas fi l-suug
wa l-saff al-awwal fi buyuut al-sala wa bakaan al-kubaaraat fi kulli aazuuma.
Wa laakin humman yaakulu buyuut al-araamil wa yugummu yisallu sala tawiile achaan al-naas yichiifuuhum.Wa achaan da,al-azaab al-yarjaahum yabga chadiid ziyaada.
Wa Isa ga'ad gariib le sanduug beet Allah wa chaaf al-naas al-gaa'idiin yusubbu foogah gurushum.Wa siyaad al-maal katiiriin gaa'idiin yusubbu gurus katiir.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,armala waahide jaat wa hi miskiine.Wa khattat fi l-sanduug riyaaleen khiimithum chiyya.
Wa Isa naada talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,al-armala al-miskiine di antat ziyaada min kulla l-naas al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin yusubbu gurushum fi sanduug beet Allah.
Achaan kulluhum anto le Allah al-zaayid min maalhum,laakin hi miskiine wa antat kulla cheyy al-indaha al-ti'iich beyah.
Wa wakit Isa maarig min beet Allah,naadum waahid min talaamiizah hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,beet Allah ajiib-!Chiif al-hujaar dool-!Chiif buyuutah dool-!
Wa Isa gaal-:-Inta chift kulla l-buyuut al-kubaar dool walla-?Ma yikhallu hajar yagood foog hajar.Yarmuuhum kulluhum.
Wakit Isa gaa'id wiheedah fi jabal al-Zaytuun mugaabil beet Allah,Butrus wa Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna wa Andareeyas macho leyah.Wa sa'alooh
wa gaalo-:-Ooriina da yabga mata-?Wa chunu al-alaama al-tiwassif kadar kulla l-kalaam da yitimm-?
Wa Isa gamma yihajji leehum wa gaal-:-Aw'u baalku.Ma tikhallu naadum yukhuchchuku.
Naas katiiriin yaju be usmi wa yuguulu-:--Ana bas al-Masiih.- Wa yukhuchchu naas katiiriin.
Wa wakit intu tasma'o khabar hana huruub gariib wa huruub ba'iid,ma tibarjulu.Achaan da waajib yukuun.Wa laakin da lissaa' ma kumaalit al-dunya.
Naas hana balad waahide yahjumu naas hana balad aakhara wa mamlaka tahjim mamlaka.Wa fi diyaar katiiriin yukuun zilzaal.Juu' katiir yanzil fi l-ard.Wa laakin al-ta'ab da,di al-bidaaya bas.Hu misil al-talaga al-awwalaaniiye hana l-mara al-tidoor talda.
Wa intu,aw'u baalku.Akiid yakurbuuku wa yiwadduuku le l-charii'a wa yafurchuuku fi buyuut al-sala.Wa fi chaani ana,tahdaro giddaam al-hukkaam wa l-muluuk.Wa fi l-bakaan da,tachhado leyi.
Wa awwal cheyy,laabudda al-bichaara yiballukhuuha le kulla l-umam.
Wa wakit yakurbuuku wa yiwadduuku le l-charii'a,ma tihimmu le l-kalaam al-tuguuluuh.Fi l-bakaan da,guulu al-kalaam al-yaji leeku achaan al-kalaam al-tuguuluuh yaji min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa ma min nufuusku.
Wa fi l-wakit al-jaayi da,naadum yisallim akhuuh le l-moot wa abu iyaal yisallim wileedah le l-moot wa l-iyaal yabgo aasiyiin le waaldeenhum wa yisabbubu leehum al-moot.
Wa fi chaan usmi,kulla l-naas yakrahooku.Wa laakin al-naadum al-gaa'id saabit lahaddi l-kumaale,yanja.
Wa wakit tichiifu al-haraam al-yijiib al-kharaab waagif fi l-bakaan al-abadan ma waajib leyah(khalli al-naadum al-yagri al-kalaam da yafhamah),fi l-wakit daak,khalli al-naas al-gaa'idiin fi daar al-Yahuudiiya yi'arrudu fi l-hujaar.
Wa ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yinjamma fi raas beetah,khalli ma yidalli le yadkhul fi beetah yichiil khumaamah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-gaa'id fi l-zere',khalli yajri wa ma yigabbil yichiil khalagah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,yabga gaasi marra waahid le l-awiin al-khalbaanaat wa l-yiraddi'an.
As'alo Allah achaan da ma yabga fi l-chite.
Achaan fi l-wakit daak,al-ta'ab yabga chadiid bilheen.Wa ma fi ta'ab mislah min Allah khalag al-dunya lahaddi l-yoom.Wa ta'ab chadiid misil da abadan ma yukuun battaan.
Wa kan Allah ma nagas adad ayyaam al-ta'ab da,naadum waahid ma yanja.Wa laakin Allah fakkar fi naasah al-azalaahum wa fi chaanhum hu nagas adad ayyaam al-ta'ab da.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,akuun naadum yuguul leeku-:--Daahu-!Al-Masiih hini-!- Aw yuguul-:--Chiifu-!Al-Masiih hinaak-!- Ma tisaddugu kalaamah.
Achaan naas katiiriin yaju wa yuguulu humman al-Masiih walla yuguulu be kidib humman anbiya.Wa yisawwu alaamaat wa ajaayib le yukhuchchu,kan mumkin,hatta al-naas al-Allah azalaahum.
Aywa,aw'u baalku.Ana ooreetku be kulla l-kalaam da gubbaal ma yukuun.
Wa fi l-wakit al-yaji ba'ad al-ta'ab al-chadiid da,al-harraay tabga dalma wa l-gamar ma yidawwi
wa l-nujuum yaga'o min al-sama wa khuwwaat al-samaawaat yinhazzo.
Wa fi l-wakit da,yichiifu Ibn al-Insaan jaayi fi sahaab al-samabe gudra aziime wa majiide.
Wa yirassil malaa'ikatah fi ayyi jiihe achaan yilimmu al-naas al-azalaahum min ayyi bakaan fi l-ard.
Wa fakkuru fi masal chadarat al-tiin.Kan furuu'ha yidooru yikhadduru wa warchaalha al-awwal yamrug,be da ta'arfu al-wakit al-hi talda foogah garrab.
Wa sawa sawa misil da,wakit tichiifu kulla cheyy al-ooreetku beyah gaa'id yabga,khalaas ta'arfu jayyit al-Masiih gariib.Hu garrab le biibaanku.
Wa l-cheyy al-yabga ba'adeen da,naadum waahid ma ya'arif yoomah wa la saa'tah.Al-malaa'ika fi l-samaawaat kula ma ya'arfuuh wa Ibn Allah ma ya'arfah,illa abuuh wiheedah bas ya'arfah.
Aw'u baalku.Agoodu waa'iyiin achaan intu ma ta'arfu mata waktah yitimm.
Aywa,da yabga misil naadum waahid al-yidoor yisaafir.Wa gubbaal ma yugumm min beetah hu yikallif abiidah be maalah wa ayyi waahid minhum indah mas'uuliiye.Wa siid al-beet yaamurah le haaris al-baab achaan yagood waa'i fi l-baab.
Wa achaan da,intu kula,agoodu waa'iyiin achaan ma ta'arfu al-wakit al-siid al-beet yaji foogah.Akuun yaji makhrib walla fi ust al-leel walla waradde walla fajur.
Akuun yaji faj'atan wa yalgaaku naaymiin.
Wa l-kalaam al-nuguulah leeku da,nuguulah le kulla l-naas.Nuguul agoodu waa'iyiin.
Wa iid al-Fisha wa iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara garrab.Wa be yoomeen gubbaal al-iid,kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama gaa'idiin yifakkuru kikkeef yakurbu Isa be khachch wa yaktuluuh.
Wa hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Ma nakurbuuh fi ayyaam al-iid achaan akuun fitne tabga ambeenaat al-cha'ab.
Wa Isa gaa'id fi beet Sim'aan al-Mujaddim fi hillit Beet Anya.Wa wakit hu gaa'id yaakul,mara waahide jaat leyah wa jaabat maa'uun hana hajar malaan itir asli wa khaali bilheen al-usmah naardiin.Wa hi fakkat al-maa'uun da wa sabbat al-itir kulla ke fi raas Isa.
Wa naas waahidiin zi'ilo wa hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Maala waddarat al-itir al-khaali da-?
Kan baa'o al-itir da,yalgo minnah 300 diinaarachaan yantuuh le l-masaakiin. Wa khalaas harajooha.
Laakin Isa gaal-:-Maala tibachtunu al-mara di-?Hi sawwat leyi cheyy sameh.
Al-masaakiin gaa'idiin ma'aaku daayman wa tagdaro tisawwu leehum al-kheer ayyi wakit al-tidooruuh.Laakin ana ma nagood ma'aaku daayman.
Wa hi sawwat al-cheyy al-gidratah.Gubbaal ma numuut,hi sabbat itir fi jismi achaan tijahhizni le l-khabur.
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,yihajju fi l-cheyy al-hi sawwatah da wa yizzakkarooha fi ayyi bakaan fi l-dunya al-yiballukhu foogah al-bichaara.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Yahuuza al-Iskhariyooti waahid min al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar macha le kubaaraat rujaal al-diin achaan yisallim leehum Isa.
Wa l-kubaaraat sim'o kalaamah wa firho beyah wa gaalo yantuuh gurus.Wa khalaas,Yahuuza gaa'id yifattich fursa achaan yisallim leehum Isa.
Wa awwal yoom min ayyaam iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara ja.Wa da l-yoom al-yadbaho foogah al-hamal fi chaan acha iid al-Fisha.Wa l-talaamiiz sa'alo Isa wa gaalo-:-Tidoor aniina namchu ween achaan nihassulu leek acha iid al-Fisha-?
Wa hu rassal naaseen min talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Amchu fi l-madiina wa talgo naadum waahid chaayil jarr hana almi.Taabu'uuh.
Wa amchu fi l-beet al-hu yadkhul foogah wa hajju le siid al-beet da wa guulu-:--Sayyidna al-mu'allim gaal-:"Ween beet al-diifaan al-naakul foogah acha iid al-Fisha ma'a talaamiizi-?"--
Wa hu yiwassifku khurfa wasii'e wa jaahize foog fi l-gasir.Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,hassulu leena al-acha.
Wa l-talaamiiz gammo wa macho fi l-madiina wa ligo kulla cheyy misil hu gaalah leehum.Wa hassalo acha iid al-Fisha.
Wa fi l-makhrib,Isa macha le l-beet ma'a l-talaamiiz al-atnaachar.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yaakulu sawa,Isa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,waahid minku yukhuunni.Aywa,naadum waahid al-gaa'id yaakul ma'aayi.
Wa humman bigo haznaaniin.Wa kulluhum sa'alooh,al-waahid ba'ad al-aakhar wa gaalo-:-Ana walla-?
Wa gaal leehum-:-Al-yukhuunni hu min al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar wa gaa'id yidiss iidah ma'aayi fi l-maa'uun.
Wa akiid ana Ibn al-Insaan numuut misil maktuub foogah fi l-Kitaab.Wa laakin al-azaab yarja al-raajil al-yukhuunni ana Ibn al-Insaan.Akheer le l-raajil da kan ma wildooh-!
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yil'achcho,Isa chaal khubza waahide wa chakar Allah wa kasarha wa antaaha leehum wa gaal-:-Chiiluuh.Da jismi.
Wa chaal kaas wa chakar Allah wa antaah leehum wa kulluhum chirbo minnah.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Da dammi hana l-mu'aahada al-jadiide al-yidaffig fi chaan naas katiiriin.
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,min al-yoom ana ma nachrab battaan asiir al-inab lahaddi l-yoom al-nachrab asiir al-inab al-jadiid fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa khanno khine min al-Zabuur wa marago min al-madiina wa macho jabal al-Zaytuun.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Akiid kulluku tafchulu achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Nadrub al-raa'i wa l-khanam yichittu.‍﴿
Wa laakin ba'ad ana ba'ast,namchi giddaamku fi daar al-Jaliil.
Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan kulla l-aakhariin yikhalluuk kula,ana ma nikhalliik-!
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Nuguul leek al-hagg,al-leele di gubbaal al-diik ma yi'oo'i marrateen,inta tankurni talaata marraat.
Wa Butrus zi'il wa gaal-:-Ana kan numuut ma'aak kula,abadan ma nankurak-! Wa kulla l-talaamiiz gaalo nafs al-cheyy.
Wa khalaas Isa wa talaamiizah macho fi bakaan usmah Jasiimaani.Wa gaal leehum-:-Agoodu hini wakit ana gaa'id nisalli.
Wa chaal ma'aayah Butrus wa Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna wa galbah barjal wa bada yat'ab bilheen.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Ana haznaan marra waahid lahaddi nidoor al-moot.Agoodu hini waa'iyiin.
Wa macha giddaam chiyya wa sajad fi l-ard wa sa'al Allah achaan al-ta'ab da ma yaji foogah kan da mumkin.
Wa gaal-:-Abba-!Ya abuuyi-!Ma fi cheyy gaasi leek.Ba''id minni kaas al-ta'ab da-!Laakin khalli yabga misil inta tidoorah wa ma misil ana nidoorah.
Wa gabbal le l-talaamiiz wa ligiihum naaymiin wa gaal le Butrus-:-Ya Sim'aan,inta naayim walla-?Saa'a waahide kula ma gidirt tagood waa'i-?
Agoodu waa'iyiin wa as'alo Allah achaan al-ta'ab ma yijarrib iimaanku wa yitallifah.Aywa,as'alo Allah achaan al-insaan indah niiye laakin ma indah gudra.
Wa tarraf minhum battaan wa sa'al Allah be nafs al-kalaam misil awwal.
Wa ba'adeen hu gabbal le l-talaamiiz wa battaan ligiihum naaymiin achaan al-noom chaalaahum marra waahid.Wa ma irfo al-kalaam al-yuguulu leyah.
Wa taalit marra hu ja leehum wa gaal-:-Intu lissaa'ku naaymiin walla-?Tidooru tinjammo-?Khalaas,al-wakit tamma.Ibn al-Insaan khaanooh wa yisallumuuh le l-muznibiin-!
Wa Isa lissaa' ma kammal kalaamah bas,Yahuuza al-min al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar ja.Wa jaab ma'aayah naas katiiriin induhum suyuuf wa isay.Al-rassaloohum kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama wa l-chuyuukh.
Wa l-khaayin antaahum alaama min awwal wa gaal-:-Al-naadum al-nihibbah,da bas hu.Khalli al-askar yakurbuuh wa yiwadduuh.
Wa wakit hu wassal fi l-bakaan da,hu macha ajala ke le Isa wa gaal-:-Sayyidna-! Wa habbaah.
Wa khalaas Isa karabooh.
Wa waahid min al-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'a Isa salla seefah wa darab abid hana kabiir rujaal al-diin wa gata' adaanah.
Wa Isa hajja wa gaal-:-Kikkeef intu jiitu takurbuuni be suyuuf wa isay-?Ana mujrim walla-?
Kulla yoom ana gaa'id ambeenaatku fi fadaayit beet Allah wa gaa'id ni'allim al-naas wa intu ma karabtuuni.Laakin khalli yabga misil maktuub fi l-Kitaab.
Wa khalaas kulla talaamiizah khallooh wa jaro.
Wa fi sabi waahid al-taaba' Isa fi l-bakaan da wa hu ma laabis lubaas illa khalag waahid hana gumaach khaali.Wa l-sabi da karabooh.
Wa laakin hu anbalas minhum khalla khalagah fi iideehum wa jara minhum aryaan.
Wa Isa waddooh fi beet hana kabiir rujaal al-diin.Wa kulla kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama wa l-chuyuukh laammiin fi l-beet da wa gaa'idiin yarjooh.
Wa Butrus taaba' Isa min ba'iid wa andassa fi hooch beet hana kabiir rujaal al-diin.Wa ga'ad tihit ma'a l-askar jamb al-naar.Wa Butrus gaa'id yiddaffa fi usuthum.
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa kulla naas hana l-majlas fattacho chahaada achaan yahkumu le Isa be l-moot.Wa ma ligooha.
Wa naas katiiriin gammo wa chahado foogah be kidib laakin chahaadaathum kula chig chig.
Wa waahidiin gammo wa chahado foogah be kidib wa gaalo-:
Aniina simi'naah gaal-:--Beet Allah al-banooh al-naas da,ana nikassirah.Wa fi talaata yoom nabniih aakhar wa l-yabnuuh,ma naas.-
Laakin al-chuhuud dool kula,fi l-kalaam da,chahaadithum ma waahide.
Wa kabiir rujaal al-diin gamma foog fi ust al-malamma wa sa'al Isa wa gaal-:-Ma turudd leena walla-?Ma simi't chahaadat al-naas dool foogak walla-?
Wa Isa gaa'id saakit bas wa ma radda leyah kalaam.Wa battaan kabiir rujaal al-diin sa'alah wa gaal-:-Hal inta al-Masiih,Ibn Allah al-waajib leyah kulla l-chukur-?
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ana hu.Wa tichiifu Ibn al-Insaan fi kursi jamb Allah al-Gaadir fi nussah al-zeenaaywa tichiifuuh jaayi fi sahaab al-sama.
Wa kabiir rujaal al-diin gamma charrat khalagah min al-za'al wa gaal-:-Battaan ma nidooru chaahid aakhar.
Intu zaatku simi'tuuh hu achrak.Kharaarku chunu-? Wa kulluhum gaalo waajib yahkumu leyah be l-moot.
Wa waahidiin minhum gammo yibazzukhu foogah wa rabato wijhah wa darabooh wa gaalo-:-Ooriina yaatu al-darabak-! Wa l-askar daggooh.
Wa Butrus gaa'id barra fi l-hooch wa bineeye waahide min khaddaamaat hana kabiir rujaal al-diin garrabat leyah.
Wa chaafat Butrus gaa'id yiddaffa.Wa chaafatah adiil wa akkadat wa gaalat-:-Inta kula ma'a Isa,al-min al-Naasira-!
Wa Butrus nakar wa gaal-:-Kalaamki da ma na'arfah.Kalaamki ma indah ma'ana. Wa l-diik oo'a.Wa Butrus marag wa macha ale khachum al-hooch.
Wa l-bineeye chaafatah battaan.Wa hajjat le l-naas al-gaa'idiin hinaak wa gaalat-:-Al-naadum da kula minhum.
Wa battaan hu nakar.Wa ba'ad chiyya al-naas al-waagfiin hinaak jo leyah wa gaalo-:-Akiid inta minhum achaan inta kula min daar al-Jaliil-!
Wa Butrus gamma halaf wa gaal-:-Khalli Allah yal'anni kan kalaami ma sahiih-!Abadan ana ma na'arif al-raajil al-tihajju beyah da.
Wa tawwaali al-diik oo'a battaan.Wa Butrus fakkar fi l-kalaam al-Isa gaalah leyah-:-Gubbaal al-diik ma yi'oo'i marrateen,inta tankurni talaata marraat. Wa Butrus baka baki chadiid.
Wa wakit al-wata asbahat,kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-chuyuukh wa l-ulama wa kulla naas al-majlas lammo wa achchaawaro.Wa Isa rabatooh wa waddooh wa sallamooh le Bilaatus al-waali al-Roomaani.
Wa Bilaatus sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta malik al-Yahuud walla-? Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Misil inta gultah.
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin khatto foog Isa tuham katiiriin.
Wa Bilaatus sa'alah battaan wa gaal-:-Ma tidoor turudd leehum walla-?Khatto foogak kalaam katiir.
Wa Isa ma radda leyah battaan wa Bilaatus al'ajjab bilheen.
Wa fi ayyi iid al-Fisha,al-waali fi aadtah yamrug min al-sijin masjuun waahid al-naas yatulbuuh.
Wa mujrim waahid gaa'id fi l-sijin usmah Baraabaas wa hu min al-naas al-marago sawra didd al-Roomaaniyiin wa katalo dimme.
Wa l-naas garrabo le l-waali wa bado yatulbu minnah achaan hu yisawwi leehum misil fi aadtah.
Wa Bilaatus sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Tidooru ana natlig leeku malik al-Yahuud walla-?
Wa gaal al-kalaam da achaan irif kubaaraat rujaal al-diin sallamo leyah Isa be sabab husudhum.
Wa laakin kubaaraat rujaal al-diin harracho al-naas achaan yas'alo Bilaatus yatlig Baraabaas fi badal Isa.
Wa Bilaatus hajja leehum battaan wa gaal-:-Wa Isa al-yuguulu leyah malik al-Yahuud,nisawwi leyah chunu-?
Wa aato battaan wa gaalo-:-Aktulah fi l-saliib-!
Wa Bilaatus sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Maala-?Chunu al-fasil al-sawwaah-? Wa laakin aato battaan be ziyaada wa gaalo-:-Aktulah fi l-saliib-!
Wa Bilaatus dawwar al-naas yardo beyah wa achaan da marag leehum Baraabaas wa Isa jaladooh.Wa khalaas,sallamah le l-askar achaan yaktuluuh fi l-saliib.
Wa l-askar waddo Isa daakhal fi gasir al-waali wa naado al-askar al-aakhariin yaju yilimmu foogah.
Wa labbasooh khalag loonah garadi misil khalag al-malik.Wa sawwo leyah taaj hana chook madfuur wa khattooh fi raasah.
Wa gammo yisallumuuh be chamaate wa yuguulu-:-Salaam aleek,ya malik al-Yahuud-!
Wa gaa'idiin yudugguuh be asa fi raasah wa yibazzukhu foogah wa yasjudu giddaamah.
Wa wakit kammalo chamaatithum,chaalo minnah al-khalag al-garadi wa labbasooh khulgaanah halaalah.Wa gammo yiwadduuh fi l-bakaan al-yaslubuuh foogah.
Wa l-askar asaro raajil waahid al-jaay min al-kadaade le yichiil al-saliib al-yidooru yaktulu foogah Isa.Wa hu usmah Sim'aan al-min hillit al-Khayrawaan,abu Iskandar wa Ruufus.
Wa waddo Isa le l-bakaan al-usmah Juljusa ma'anaatah bakaan al-jumjuma.
Wa gaddamo leyah khamar mukhalbat be sibir achaan yibarrid leyah al-waja'.Wa laakin Isa abaah ma chiribah.
Wa khalaas,taggo Isa fi l-saliib wa rafa'ooh foog.Wa l-askar sawwo am'iyeedaat achaan yigassumu ambeenaathum khulgaanah.
Wa khatto Isa fi l-saliib be fajur hawaale saa'a tis'a.
Wa l-maktuub al-yiwassif al-tuhma al-khattooha foogah yuguul-:-Malik al-Yahuud.
Wa taggo jambah mujrimiin itneen,al-waahid fi saliib be nussah al-zeenaay wa l-aakhar fi saliib be nussah al-israay.
Wa misil da,al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab tamma.Maktuub-:﴾‍Hasabooh ma'a l-aasiyiin.‍﴿
Wa l-naas al-maachiin fi l-derib da gaa'idiin yi'ayyuruuh wa yihizzu ruuseehum wa yuguulu-:-Haay,inta al-gult tikassir beet Allah wa tabniih battaan fi talaata yoom-!
Najji nafsak-!Dalli min al-saliib-!
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin ma'a l-ulama gaa'idiin yihajju ambeenaathum wa humman kula gaa'idiin yichchammato leyah wa yuguulu-:-Hu najja naas aakhariin laakin ma yagdar yinajji nafsah.
Khalli al-Masiih malik Bani Israa'iil yidalli hassa' min al-saliib achaan nichiifuuh wa ni'aamunu beyah-! Wa l-naaseen al-salaboohum ma'aayah,kula achchammato leyah.
Wa bigi nuss al-nahaar.Wa l-wata bigat dalma fi kulla l-balad lahaddi l-asur.
Wa gariib al-saa'a talaata,Isa aat be hiss aali be kalaam ibraani wa gaal-:-Iili Iili lama chabagtani- wa ma'anaatah﴾‍Ilaahi,Ilaahi,maala khalleetni-?‍﴿
Wa waahidiin min al-naas al-waagfiin hinaak sim'o kalaamah wa gaalo-:-Chiifu,hu gaa'id yinaadi al-nabi Iliyaas-!
Wa waahid minhum jara leyah wa chaal git'e wa ballaaha fi charaab haamud wa cha'agha fi raas ageegaay wa gaddamah le Isa achaan yachrab minnah wa gaal-:-Agiifu chiyya.Khalli nichiifu kan Iliyaas yaji yidalliih min al-saliib.
Wa Isa aat be hiss chadiid wa khalaas maat.
Wa l-sitaar al-fi beet Allah anchagga min foog lahaddi tihit.
Wa kabiir al-askar waagif mugaabilah.Wa wakit hu chaaf kikkeef Isa maat,hu gaal-:-Be l-sahiih al-raajil da Ibn Allah-!
Wa fiyah awiin gaa'idaat yichiifan min ba'iid.Wa hinna Mariyam al-Magdaliiye wa Mariyam amm Yaakhuub al-Sakhayyar wa Yuusi,hi kula gaa'ide ma'aahin.Wa battaan Saluuma kula ma'aahin.
Wa awwal al-awiin deel taaba'an Isa wa khadaman leyah wakit hu gaa'id fi daar al-Jaliil.Wa fi awiin aakharaat katiiraat kula jin ma'aayah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa khalaas bigi achiiye wa da l-yoom al-yijahhuzu foogah le yoom al-sabt.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid usmah Yuusuf.Hu min hillit al-Raama wa hu naadum mukarram min al-majlas al-kabiir wa mu'min be mamlakat Allah al-jaaye.Wa hu chadda heelah wa macha le Bilaatus wa sa'alah janaazit Isa.
Wa Bilaatus al'ajjab wa dawwar yi'akkid kadar Isa maat khalaas.Achaan da,naada kabiir al-askar wa sa'alah kan be sahiih Isa mayyit.
Wa wakit simi' kalaam kabiir al-askar,hu anta izin le Yuusuf achaan yichiil al-janaaza.
Wa Yuusuf chara kafan khaali wa dalla janaazit Isa min al-saliib wa kaffanaaha wa waddaaha dassaaha fi khabur waahid misil karkuur al-nakatooh fi l-hajar.Wa dardag hajar kabiir achaan yisidd khachum al-khabur.
Wa Mariyam al-Magdaliiye wa Mariyam amm Yuusi chaafan al-bakaan al-khatto foogah janaazit Isa.
Wakit yoom al-sabt kammal,Mariyam al-Magdaliiye wa Saluuma wa Mariyam amm Yaakhuub maragan wa charan riihe achaan yusubbanha fi janaazit Isa.
Wa awwal yoom fi l-subuu',bakkaran be fajur badri wa wassalan fi bakaan al-khabur ma'a taluu' al-harraay.
Wa gaa'idaat yihajjan ambeenaathin wa yuguulan-:-Yaatu al-yidardig leena al-hajar al-kabiir min khachum al-khabur-?
Wa rafa'an ruuseenhin wa chaafan al-hajar mudardag khalaas min khachum al-khabur.Wa l-hajar da kabiir bilheen.
Wa dakhalan fi l-khabur wa chaafan malak yichaabih sabi,laabis khalag abyad wa gaa'id tihit fi nussihin al-zeenaay.Wa hinna khaafan marra waahid.
Wa hu gaal leehin-:-Ma tibarjilan.Intan gaa'idaat tifattichan Isa al-min al-Naasira,al-katalooh fi l-saliib.Hu ba'as khalaas-!Hu ma fiih hini-!Chiifan al-bakaan al-awwal raggadooh foogah.
Wa hassa' amchan le talaamiizah wa le Butrus wa guulan leehum-:--Isa maachi giddaamku fi daar al-Jaliil wa hinaak tichiifuuh misil hu awwal gaalah leeku.-
Wa l-awiin maragan min al-khabur wa jaran.Wa hinna gaa'idaat yarjifan min al-ajab wa l-khoof.Wa ma hajjan beyah le ayyi naadum achaan hinna khaayfaat.
Wa Isa ba'as fajur badri fi yoom al-ahad.Wa hu baan awwal le Mariyam al-Magdaliiye wa di l-mara al-awwal tarad minha sab'a chawaatiin.
Wa hi gammat wa hajjat beyah le rufgaanah.Wa humman haznaaniin wa gaa'idiin yabku leyah.
Wa hi oorathum kadar Isa hayy wa hi chaafatah wa laakin humman abo ma saddago kalaamha.
Wa ba'ad da,naaseen min al-talaamiiz maachiin fi l-kadaade wa Isa baan leehum suurtah chig.
Wa humman gabbalo fi l-madiina wa ooro beyah al-talaamiiz al-aakhariin laakin al-aakhariin ma saddago be kalaamhum.
Wa ba'adeen Isa baan le l-talaamiiz al-ihdaachar wakit humman gaa'idiin yaakulu.Wa hu harajaahum achaan ma aamano wa gawwo ruuseehum wa abo ma saddago kalaam al-naas al-chaafooh ba'ad hu ba'as.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu fi kulla l-ard wa ballukhu al-bichaara le kulla l-naas fi kulla bakaan.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyi wa yikhattusuuh,yanja.Wa ayyi naadum al-ma yi'aamin beyi,Allah yi'aakhibah.
Wa l-mu'miniin yisawwu ajaayib.Be usmi yaturdu chawaatiin wa yihajju be lukhkhaat judaad.
Wa yakurbu dabiib wa kan yacharbo charaab al-indah samm,ma yisawwi leehum cheyy fasil.Wa yukhuttu iideehum fi l-mardaaniin wa l-mardaaniin yalgo al-aafe.
Wa ba'ad al-Rabb Isa kallam leehum,hu anrafa' fi l-sama wa ga'ad fi kursi jamb Allah fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Wa talaamiizah macho wa ballakho al-bichaara le l-naas fi ayyi bakaan.Wa l-Rabb aawanaahum wa antaahum ajaayib achaan yisabbit al-bichaara al-humman gaa'idiin yiballukhuuha.Aamiin.
Ya Saawufiilusal-muhtaram,sahiih naas katiiriin dawwaro yisajjulu taariikh al-achya al-bigo fi usutna.
Wa gammo yaktubu al-kalaam al-aniina ligiinaah min al-naas al-humman chuhuud min al-bidaaya le kalaam Allah wa bigo khaddaamiinah.
Wa ana kula gaa'id nukhutt baali fi kulla l-kalaam da achaan na'arif al-hagiiga hana kulla l-achya al-kaano min al-bidaaya.Wa khalaas,ya Saawufiilus al-muhtaram,ana chilt niiye achaan nisajjil taariikh al-achya al-bigo wa naktibah leek be nizaam adiil.
Wa naktibah leek achaan ta'arif kadar kulla cheyy al-oorook beyah akiid.
Fi wakit al-malik Hiruudus gaa'id yahkim fi daar al-Yahuudiiya,fiyah naadum waahid usmah Zakariiya wa hu min rujaal al-diin,min majmuu'a al-usumha Abiiya.Wa martah kula min zurriiyit Haaruun wa usumha Alisaabaat.
Wa humman saalihiin giddaam Allah wa gaa'idiin yitabbugu adiil kulla wasiiyaatah wa churuutah.
Wa laakin ma induhum iyaal achaan Alisaabaat aagre wa battaan ajjazat wa raajilha kula chayyab.
Wa yoom waahid,Zakariiya gamma yakhdim le Allah achaan ja door hana majmuu'tah.
Wa fi aadit rujaal al-diin,yisawwu am'iyeedaat achaan ya'azulu yaatu minhum al-yadkhul daakhal fi beet Allah achaan yigaddim leyah al-bakhuur.Wa khalaas am'iyeedaat waga'at fi Zakariiya achaan hu bas yadkhul.
Wa naas katiiriin laammiin barra wa kulluhum gaa'idiin yisallu fi wakit hana gaddimiin al-bakhuur.
Wa wakit Zakariiya dakhal fi beet Allah,tawwaali waahid min malaa'ikat Allah baan leyah.Wa hu chaaf al-malak waagif be nuss al-zeenaay le mukhbar al-bakhuur.
Wa wakit Zakariiya chaafah,barjal wa khaaf khoof chadiid.
Wa l-malak gaal leyah-:-Ya Zakariiya,ma takhaaf.Allah simi' du'aak.Martak Alisaabaat talda leek wileed wa sammiih Yahya.
Wa fi chaan al-wileed da,inta tabga farhaan wa mabsuut bilheen wa naas katiiriin yafraho be waaluudtah.
Wa hu yabga naadum muhimm giddaam Allah wa ma waajib yachrab khamar wa la ayyi charaab al-yisakkir al-naas.Wa hu yabga malaan be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus min hu lissaa' gaa'id fi batun ammah.
Wa naas katiiriin min Bani Israa'iil yasma'o kalaamah wa yigabbulu le Allah Rabbuhum.
Wa yaji giddaam Allah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus sawa sawa misil al-nabi Iliyaas.Wa da le yijiib al-salaam been al-abbahaat wa iyaalhum wa achaan al-aasiyiin yutuubu wa yitaabu'u fikir al-saalihiin.Wa le yijahhiz al-cha'ab le Allah.
Wa Zakariiya hajja le l-malak wa gaal-:-Kikkeef na'arif da yabga-?Ana chaayib wa marti kula ajuuz.
Wa l-malak radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana Jibriil al-waagif giddaam Allah le nisawwi al-hu yidoorah.Hu rassalaani achaan nikallim leek wa niballikh leek al-bichaara di.
Wa hassa',inta tabga abkam wa ma tihajji lahaddi kulla cheyy al-gultah leek yitimm.Achaan inta ma saddagt be kalaami al-akiid yabga fi waktah.
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yarjo Zakariiya yamrug min beet Allah wa al'ajjabo marra waahid achaan hu akhkhar.
Wa wakit hu marag khalaas,ma gidir yihajji leehum.Wa fihmo kadar hu chaaf ru'ya fi beet Allah.Wa gaa'id yihajji leehum be wasif achaan hu bigi abkam.
Wa ba'adeen door hana khidimtah kammal khalaas wa hu gabbal fi beetah.
Wa ba'ad da,martah Alisaabaat bigat khalbaane.Wa fi muddit khamsa chahar,hi ma maragat min al-beet.Wa gaalat-:
Al-cheyy da,Allah bas sawwaah leyi.Fi l-ayyaam dool hu antaani ni'ma wa l-eeb al-gaa'id foogi giddaam al-naas,hu rafa'ah minni.
Wa ba'ad sitte chahar,Allah rassal al-malak Jibriil le hille waahide fi daar al-Jaliil usumha al-Naasira.
Wa rassalah le bineeye udriiye al-karab raasha raajil waahid min zurriiyit al-malik Dawuud wa usmah Yuusuf.Wa l-bineeye di udriiye wa usumha Mariyam.
Wa l-malak Jibriil macha leeha wa gaal-:-Al-salaam aleeki,inti al-barakat Allah nazalat foogki-!Al-Rabb gaa'id ma'aaki.
Wa kalaamah barjalha marra waahid wa sa'alat nafisha chunu ma'ana al-kalaam da.
Wa l-malak Jibriil gaal leeha-:-Ya Mariyam,ma takhaafe.Allah antaaki ni'ma.
Daahu inti tabge khalbaane wa talde wileed wa tisammiih Isa.
Wa hu yabga aziim wa yinaaduuh Ibn Allah al-Aali.Wa Rabbina Allah yukhuttah fi kursi al-malik Dawuud al-hu min juduudah.
Wa yahkim fi zurriiyit Yaakhuubila l-abad wa mamlakatah abadan ma indaha nihaaya.
Wa Mariyam gaalat le l-malak Jibriil-:-Kikkeef da yabga-?Achaan ana ma chift raajil.
Wa l-malak Jibriil gaal leeha-:-Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yaji leeki wa gudrat Allah al-Aali tanzil foogki wa achaan da,al-wileed al-taldeeh yukuun khudduus wa yinaaduuh Ibn Allah.
Wa fakkiri fi akhutki Alisaabaat al-ajuuz.Indaha khalaba hana sitte chahar wa talda wileed wa di hi al-awwal gaalo foogha hi aagre.
Akiid ma fi cheyy gaasi le Allah-!
Wa Mariyam gaalat-:-Khalaas,ana khaadim Allah.Khalli yabga leyi misil inta gultah. Wa l-malak Jibriil khallaaha wa faat.
Wa ba'ad da,Mariyam gammat wa machat ajala fi hille waahide al-gaa'ide fi hujaar daar al-Yahuudiiya
wa dakhalat fi beet Zakariiya wa sallamat martah Alisaabaat.
Wa wakit Alisaabaat sim'at salaam Mariyam,al-sakhiir al-fi batunha alharrak wa Alisaabaat anmalat be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa Alisaabaat aatat be hiss aali wa gaalat-:-Min kulla l-awiin,inti bas barakat Allah nazalat foogki ziyaada wa l-sakhiir al-gaa'id fi batunki kula mubaarak-!
Wa kikkeef Allah antaani ni'ma kabiire misil di lahaddi inti amm Rabbi taji tisallimiini-?
Achaan al-sakhiir al-fi batni alharrak min al-farah wakit ana simi't salaamki.
Mabruuk leeki achaan kalaam Allah ja leeki wa inti saddagti kadar akiid yitimm-!
Wa Mariyam gaalat-:-Nimajjid Allah be kulla galbi
wa nafrah bilheen be Allah al-yinajjiini.
Nafrah achaan hu fakkar foogiana khaadmah al-miskiine.Akiid min al-yoom wa giddaamkulla l-naas yinaaduuni al-mubaaraka-!
Allah al-Gaadir sawwa leyi cheyy aziimwa Allah bas al-Khudduus.
Rahmatah daayman kabiirele kulla l-naas al-khaayfiin minnahmin zurriiye le zurriiye.
Hu bayyan gudurtahwa chattat al-mustakbiriin ma'a kulla afkaarhum.
Hu dalla muluuk gawiyiin min karaasiihumwa rafa' al-masaakiin.
Al-jii'aaniin mala batunhum be akil samehwa l-khaniyiin taradaahum iideehum yaabsiin.
Hu saa'ad abiidah Bani Israa'iilwa ma nisi al-rahma al-gaal yantiiha leehum.
Wa di l-rahma al-hajja beeha le juduudnaal-tabga le Ibraahiim wa iyaalah ila l-abad.
Wa Mariyam ga'adat ma'a Alisaabaat gariib talaata chahar wa ba'ad da,gabbalat fi beetha.
Wa wakit Alisaabaat chaharha hana l-waaluuda tamma,hi wildat wileed.
Wa jiiraanha wa akhwaanha sim'o kadar Allah rahamaaha be rahma kabiire wa firho ma'aaha.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taamin lammo achaan yitahhuru al-wileed.Wa dawwaro yisammuuh Zakariiya misil abuuh.
Wa ammah gaalat-:-La,la.Ma ke.Usmah yabga Yahya.
Wa gaalo leeha-:-Da ma usum hana ayyi naadum min akhwaanki.
Wa hajjo le abuuh be wasif achaan yas'alooh al-usum al-yidoorah le l-wileed.
Wa hu talab minhum looh wa katab foogah-:-Usmah Yahya. Wa kulluhum al'ajjabo.
Wa ajala ke khachmah anfakka wa lisaanah anhalla wa bada yihajji wa yachkur Allah.
Wa kulla jiiraanhum khaafo bilheen.Wa kulla l-naas fi l-hujaar hana daar al-Yahuudiiya gammo yihajju be l-cheyy al-bigi da.
Wa kulla l-naas al-sim'o be l-kalaam da fakkaro foogah wa gaalo fi guluubhum-:-Al-wileed da,ba'adeen yabga chunu-? Achaan Allah ma'aayah wa gaa'id yisaa'idah.
Wa Zakariiya abu Yahya anmala be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa atnabba' wa gaal-:
Baarak Allah Rabb Bani Israa'iilachaan hu anta ni'ma le cha'abah wa fadaahum-!
Hu rassal leena naadum gaadirmin zurriiyit abdah Dawuud achaan yinajjiina.
Wa da bas al-cheyy al-kallam beyah min zamaanbe khachum al-anbiya al-saalihiin al-rassalaahum.
Hu yinajjiina min udwaannawa min gudrat kulla l-naas al-yakrahoona.
Misil da,hu raham juduudnawa fakkar fi mu'aahadatah al-mukhaddasa.
Hu sawwa leena hasab al-haliifeal-sawwaaha le abuuna Ibraahiim.
Hu gaal hu yafza'na min gudrat udwaanahachaan na'abuduuh bala khoof
wa nitaabu'u derbahbe haal taybe wa saalhe fi kulla ayyaam hayaatna.
Wa inta,ya wileedi,tabga nabi Allah al-Aaliachaan taji giddaam Allahwa tijahhiz leyah al-derib.
Wa ti'allim cha'abahle ya'arfu kikkeef Allah yinajjiihumbe khufraan zunuubhum.
Wa Rabbina Allah hanuunwa yirayyisna be rahmatah.Achaan da,nuur Allah yugummyidawwi foogna min al-sama.
Wa yinawwir le l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi l-dalaamwa l-khaayfiin min al-mootwa khalaas yuguudna fi derib al-salaam.
Wa l-wileed kibir wa bigi gawwi be l-ruuh.Wa gaa'id yi'iich fi l-kadaade lahaddi yoom baan le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Akhustus sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin chaal kharaar achaan kulla l-naas al-fi mamlakatah yisajjulu asaameehum.
Wa da awwal marra sajjalo al-naas wa bigi wakit Kiriniyuus waali hana Suuriya.
Wa ayyi naadum macha fi hillitah achaan yisajjuluuh.
Wa Yuusuf zaatah gamma min hillit al-Naasira al-gaa'ide fi daar al-Jaliil wa macha fi daar al-Yahuudiiya fi hillit Beet Laham.Wa di madiinat Dawuud.Wa Yuusuf hu min zurriiyit al-malik Dawuud wa min aayiltah wa achaan da bas waajib yamchi fi l-hille di achaan yisajjulu usmah.
Wa macha ma'a Mariyam al-karab raasha achaan yisajjuluuhum sawa.Wa hi khalbaane.
Wa wakit humman gaa'idiin fi Beet Laham,wakitha al-talda foogah tamma.
Wa wildat wileedha al-bikir.Wa laffatah be git'e wa raggadatah fi l-chaaye wa da l-bakaan al-yaakulu foogah al-bahaayim achaan ma ligo bakaan fi beet al-diifaan.
Wa fi kadaadit al-hille di,fi ru'yaan.Humman gaa'idiin yahfado khanamhum be l-leel.
Wa waahid min malaa'ikat Allah baan leehum wa nuur majd Allah dawwa fooghum wa khoof chadiid karabhum.
Wa l-malak hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ma takhaafo.Asma'o,nantiiku khabar halu hana farha kabiire al-tabga le kulla l-naas.
Al-yoom wildo leeku sakhiir fi madiinat Dawuud wa hu al-yinajji al-naas wa hu al-Masiih wa l-Rabb.
Wa di hi al-alaama al-ta'arfuuh beeha.Talgo sakhiir malfuuf be git'e wa raagid fi l-chaaye.
Wa tawwaali,baano ma'a l-malak da malaa'ika katiiriin bilheen min junuud Allah.Wa humman gaa'idiin yachkuru Allah wa yuguulu-:
Majjudu Allah fi l-a'aali-!Wa l-salaam fi l-ard le kulla l-naas,achaan Allah raadi beehum-!
Wa wakit al-malaa'ika khallo al-ru'yaan wa gabbalo fi l-sama khalaas,al-ru'yaan hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Khalli namchu fi Beet Laham nichiifu al-cheyy al-bigi,al-Allah ooraana beyah.
Wa tawwaali macho wa ligo Mariyam wa Yuusuf wa l-sakhiir raagid fi l-chaaye.
Wa wakit chaafooh,humman gammo yihajju le l-naas be l-kalaam al-Allah gaalah fi l-wileed da be khachum al-malak.
Wa kulla l-naas al-sim'o kalaam al-ru'yaan al'ajjabo minnah.
Wa laakin Mariyam karabat kulla l-kalaam da fi galibha wa gaa'ide tifakkir foogah.
Wa l-ru'yaan gabbalo fi l-kadaade.Wa gaa'idiin yachkuru Allah be khine fi chaan kulla cheyy al-chaafooh wa sim'ooh wa bigi misil al-malak ooraahum beyah.
Wa l-sakhiir tahharooh wakit umrah tamma tamaane yoom.Wa sammooh Isa achaan da bas al-usum al-malak antaah le ammah gubbaal ma takhlab beyah.
Wa ba'adeen al-wakit al-waajib yigaddumu foogah al-dahiiye hana l-tihaara ja wa da misil maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa.Wa waddo Isa le Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yigaddumuuh le Allah.
Al-kalaam al-maktuub fi Tawraat Allah yuguul-:﴾‍Kulli wald bikir al-wildooh,hu yabga khaass le Allah.‍﴿
Wa gaddamo le Allah dahiiye misil maktuub fi Tawraat Allah.Maktuub-:﴾‍Gaddim gimri itneen aw hamaam itneen.‍﴿
Wa fiyah raajil waahid fi Madiinat al-Khudus usmah Sam'aan wa hu naadum saalih wa takhi.Wa hu gaa'id yarja be acham al-salaam al-yirassilah Allah le Bani Israa'iil.Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus gaa'id foogah.
Wa awwal al-Ruuh al-Khudduus kallam leyah kadar ma yumuut gubbaal ma yichiif al-Masiih al-yirassilah Allah.
Wa fi l-yoom da,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wadda Sam'aan fi fadaayit beet Allah.Wa Mariyam wa Yuusuf jo be sakhiirhum Isa achaan yisawwu leyah al-cheyy al-waajib hasab churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa Sam'aan chaalah minhum wa chakar Allah wa gaal-:
Ya Rabb,khalliini ana abdak numuut be l-salaammisil inta awwal ooreetni beyah.
Achaan chift be eenial-naadum al-tinajji beyah al-naas.
Wa di bas al-naja al-jahhaztahaachaan kulla l-umam ya'arfuuha.
Aywa,hu al-nuural-yiwassif derib Allah le l-umamwa yijiib chukur katiirle cha'abak Bani Israa'iil.
Wa abuuh wa ammah al'ajjabo bilheen min al-kalaam al-gaalah fi Isa.
Wa Sam'aan baarakaahum wa kallam le Mariyam amm Isa wa gaal-:-Akiid mukhaddar le l-wileed da,hu yabga sabab halaak le naas katiiriin min Bani Israa'iil wa le katiiriin minhum yabga sabab naja.Wa hu yabga leehum alaama wa katiiriin yaabooha.
Wa be sababah hu,al-afkaar al-fi guluub naas katiiriin yinkachfu.Wa inti zaatki hizin chadiid yaji foogki misil ta'anooki fi galibki be seef.
Wa fi mara waahide wa hi nabiiye.Usumha Hanna bitt Fanuwiil min gabiilat Achiir.Wa hi mara kabiire bilheen fi l-sinn.Min akhadooha,hi ga'adat 7 sana ma'a raajilha.Wa ba'ad da,hu maat.
Wa battaan ma akhadat raajil wa indaha 84 sana wa gaa'ide daayman fi fadaayit beet Allah.Wa gaa'ide ta'abud Allah leel wa nahaar be l-sala wa l-siyaam.
Wa wakit Sim'aan gaa'id yihajji ma'aahum,fi nafs al-wakit,hi kula garrabat leehum wa gammat tachkur Allah.Wa tihajji be l-sakhiir le kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin yarjo al-yoom al-Allah yafda foogah naas Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa wakit Yuusuf wa Mariyam sawwo kulla cheyy al-waajib leehum hasab Tawraat Allah,humman gabbalo fi daar al-Jaliil wa macho hillithum al-Naasira.
Wa l-wileed kibir.Wa hu bigi chadiid wa malaan be hikma wa ligi rida Allah.
Wa kulli sana,ahal Isa yamchu fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha.
Wa wakit Isa umrah tamma 12 sana,macho hasab aadithum wa waddooh ma'aahum.
Wa wakit al-iid kammal wa humman mugabbiliin,al-wileed Isa ga'ad fi l-madiina laakin ahalah ma ya'arfu kadar hu ma ma'aahum.
Fi fikirhum Isa gaa'id fi lubb al-musaafiriin.Wa ba'ad sawwo yoom waahid hana safar,fagadooh wa fattachooh ambeenaat akhwaanhum wa rufgaanhum.
Wa wakit irfo hu ma fiih,gabbalo fi l-madiina achaan yifattuchuuh.
Wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,ligooh fi fadaayit beet Allah.Wa hu gaa'id tihit fi ust al-ulama wa gaa'id yasma' kalaamhum wa yas'alhum.
Wa ayyi naadum al-simi' kalaamah al'ajjab bilheen min fihimah wa raddah.
Wa wakit chaafooh hinaak,al'ajjabo marra waahid.Wa ammah hajjat leyah wa gaalat-:-Ya wileedi-!Maala ta''abtina misil da-!Ana wa abuuk hammeena bilheen wakit fagadnaak.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Maala tifattuchuuni-?Ma ta'arfu kadar waajib nagood fi beet abuuyi walla-?
Wa ma fihmo al-kalaam al-gaalah da.
Wa Isa gabbal ma'aahum wa wisil fi l-Naasira.Wa taaba' kalaamhum fi kulla cheyy.Wa ammah karabat kulla l-kalaam da fi galibha.
Wa Isa gaa'id yakbur wa hikmatah gaa'ide tiziid.Wa ligi rida min Allah wa min al-naas.
Tibaari sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin hakam muddit 15 sana khalaas.Wa Bilaatus al-Bunti bigi waali hana daar al-Yahuudiiya.Wa Hiruudus bigi muhaafiz fi daar al-Jaliil wa akhuuh Filibbus bigi muhaafiz fi buldaan Ituuriya wa Tarakhuuniitus.Wa Lisaniyuus bigi muhaafiz fi Ibiiliina.
Wa Hanaan wa Gayaafa bigo kubaaraat rujaal al-diin.Wa fi wakithum da bas,kalaam Allah nazal le Yahya wileed Zakariiya al-gaa'id fi l-kadaade.
Wa hu gamma yuruukh fi kulla l-kadaade al-jamb bahar al-Urdun.Hu gaa'id yinaadi al-naas achaan yutuubu.Wa yikhattishum fi l-almi wa Allah yakhfir leehum zunuubhum.
Wa da misil al-kalaam al-maktuub fi kitaab al-nabi Icha'ya.Kalaamah yuguul-:﴾‍Fi hiss gaa'id yi'iit fi l-khalawa yuguul-:-Jahhuzu derib al-Rabbwa addulu leyah al-turug-!
Khalli ayyi waadi yindafinwa kulli jabal wa hajar yabga gisayyir.Wa l-bakaan al-a'waj yabga adiilwa l-derib al-cheen yistawi.
Wa kulla l-naas yichiifual-naja al-Allah yijiibha.‍﴿
Wa naas katiiriin maargiin min hillaalhum wa maachiin leyah achaan hu yikhattishum.Wa gaal leehum-:-Ya iyaal al-daabi-!Yaatu al-gaal leeku ajru min al-azaab al-jaayi-?
Sawwu al-amal al-yiwassif kadar intu tubtu be l-sahiih.Wa ma tukhuchchu nufuusku.Ma tuguulu-:--Ma indina eeb achaan aniina iyaal Ibraahiim.- Nuguul leeku Allah yagdar yichiil hujaar min al-turaab wa yisawwi minhum iyaal le Ibraahiim fi badalku-!
Chiifu,al-faas jaahize le tagta' al-chadara min irigha.Ayyi chadara al-ma talda iyaal adiiliin yagta'ooha wa yazguluuha fi l-naar-!
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yas'alo Yahya wa yuguulu-:-Waajib nisawwu chunu-?
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-naadum al-indah khulgaan itneen,khalli yanti waahid le l-ma indah.Wa l-naadum al-indah akil,khalli yisawwi nafs al-cheyy.
Wa waahidiin min al-naas al-yichiilu al-miiri kula jo leyah achaan hu yikhattishum.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Sayyidna,aniina waajib nisawwu chunu-?
Wa Yahya gaal leehum-:-Ma tichiilu ziyaada min al-amarooku beyah.
Wa askar waahidiin kula sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Wa aniina,waajib nisawwu chunu-? Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ma tichiilu gurus min naas be gu wa la be tuhma baatle.Wa abgo radyaaniin be gurus chaharku.
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yarjo jayyit al-Masiih.Wa ayyi waahid gaa'id yas'al fi nafsah wa fi fikirhum akuun Yahya zaatah bas al-Masiih.
Wa Yahya radda leehum kulluhum wa gaal-:-Ana nikhattisku fi l-almi wa laakin fi naadum gaadir minni bilheen jaayi waraayi wa ana ma tammeet leyah khaddaam kula.Wa hu yikhattisku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa be naar.
Wa indah tabag fi iideenah le yikharbilku misil al-khalla.Wa yilimm khallitah min al-madagg wa yusubbaha fi dabangitah wa laakin al-uttaab yutuchchah fi l-naar al-ma tumuut abadan.
Wa be kalaam katiir misil da,Yahya wassaahum le l-naas wa ballakh leehum al-bichaara.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Hiruudus al-muhaafiz akhad Hiruudiiya al-hi awwal marit akhuuh.Wa Yahya harajah le Hiruudus fi chaan al-akhiide di wa fi chaan kulla l-fasaala al-hu sawwaaha.
Wa Hiruudus karab Yahya fi l-sijin wa misil da,hu zaad fi zunuubah ziyaada.
Wa wakit Yahya lissaa' gaa'id yikhattis al-naas,Isa ja wa Yahya khattasah.Wa wakit Isa gaa'id yisalli,al-samaawaat anfataho.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus ja leyah fi suurat hamaama wa nazal foogah.Wa hiss min al-sama ansama' wa gaal-:-Inta bas Ibni wa ana nihibbak wa ana farhaan beek bilheen.
Wa Isa bada khidimtah wakit umrah misil 30 sana.Wa fi fikir al-naas,hu wileed Yuusuf wileed Ali.
Wa Ali wileed Mattaat wileed Laawi wileed Malki wileed Yanna wileed Yuusuf.
Wa Yuusuf wileed Mattataaya wileed Amuus wileed Naahuum wileed Hasli wileed Naggaay.
Wa Naggaay wileed Ma'aat wileed Mattataaya wileed Sim'iin wileed Yuusikh wileed Yahuuza.
Wa Yahuuza wileed Yuuhanna wileed Riisa wileed Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil wileed Niiri.
Wa Niiri wileed Malki wileed Addi wileed Khuusam wileed Almuudaam wileed Iir.
Wa Iir wileed Yachuu' wileed Ali'aazar wileed Yuuriim wileed Mattaat wileed Laawi.
Wa Laawi wileed Chim'uun wileed Yahuuza wileed Yuusuf wileed Yuunaan wileed Aliyaakhim.
Wa Aliyaakhim wileed Malaya wileed Manna wileed Mattaata wileed Naataan wileed Dawuud.
Wa Dawuud wileed Yassa wileed Ubeed wileed Bu'aaz wileed Salmuun wileed Nahchuun.
Wa Nahchuun wileed Aminadaab wileed Admi wileed Arni wileed Hasruun wileed Faaris wileed Yahuuza.
Wa Yahuuza wileed Yaakhuub wileed Ishaakh wileed Ibraahiim wileed Taarah wileed Naahuur.
Wa Naahuur wileed Saruug wileed Ra'u wileed Faalag wileed Ibaar wileed Chaalah.
Wa Chaalah wileed Khinaan wileed Arfakchaad wileed Saam wileed Nooh wileed Laamak.
Wa Laamak wileed Matuuchalah wileed Akhnuukh wileed Yaarad wileed Mahlaliil wileed Khinaan.
Wa Khinaan wileed Anuuch wileed Chiit wileed Adam al-hu min Allah.
Wa Isa gabbal min bahar al-Urdun malaan be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus gaa'id yuguudah wa waddaah fi l-khala.
Wa fi muddit 40 yoom,Ibliis gaa'id yijarribah.Wa fi kulla l-mudda di,Isa ma akal cheyy.Wa fi l-akhiir hu bigi jii'aan.
Wa Ibliis hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Kan sahiih inta Ibn Allah,chiil hajar min al-hujaar dool wa guul leyah yabga leek akil.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Maktuub fi Kitaab Allah-:﴾‍Al-insaan ma yi'iich be l-akil wiheedah.‍﴿
Wa Ibliis waddaah fi bakaan aali wa fi wakit gisayyir bas wassaf leyah kulla mamaalik al-dunya.
Wa gaal leyah-:-Naj'alak haakim fooghum kulluhum wa nantiik kulla l-sulta wa l-daraja hana l-mamaalik dool.Achaan indi sulta fooghum wa nagdar nantiiha le ayyi naadum al-nidoorah.
Kan tasjud leyi bas,da kulla ke yabga hanaak.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Le Allah Ilaahak bas tasjud wa leyah hu wiheedah bas ta'abudah.‍﴿
Wa Ibliis waddaah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa khattaah foog fi raas beet Allah.Wa gaal leyah-:-Kan sahiih inta Ibn Allah,nutt min hini wa aga' tihit
achaan fi l-Kitaab maktuub-:﴾‍Allah yaamur malaa'ikatahachaan yahfadook.
Yichiiluuk fi iideehumachaan rijileenak ma yintaggo fi hajar.‍﴿
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Wa l-Kitaab yuguul-:﴾‍Ma tijarrib Allah Ilaahak.‍﴿
Wa Ibliis kammal min jarribiin Isa,hu faat khallaah achaan lahaddi yalga fursa aakhara.
Wa Isa gabbal fi daar al-Jaliil malaan be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa khabarah ansama' fi kulla l-balad.
Wa Isa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi buyuut al-sala wa kulluhum chakarooh.
Wa Isa ja fi hillitah al-Naasira al-rabbooh foogha.Wa macha fi beet al-sala yoom al-sabt misil fi aadtah.Wa gamma foog achaan yagri le l-naas.
Wa antooh kitaab al-nabi Icha'ya.Wa hu fatah al-kitaab wa ligi al-bakaan al-maktuub foogah al-kalaam al-buguul-:
﴾‍Ruuh Allah gaa'id foogiachaan Allah masahaani wa khassasaanile nibachchir al-masaakiin.Hu rassalaani achaan na'lin be l-hurriiye le l-masaajiinwa nifattih uyuun al-amyaaniinwa niharrir al-mazluumiin
wa na'lin sanit ni'mat Allah.‍﴿
Wa sadda al-kitaab wa gabbalah le l-khaddaam wa ga'ad tihit giddaamhum.Wa kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi beet al-sala khaattiin baalhum leyah.
Wa bada yi'allimhum wa gaal-:-Al-yoom bas,al-kalaam al-maktuub da tamma wakit intu gaa'idiin tasma'ooh.
Wa kulluhum chakarooh wa al'ajjabo min kalaamah al-halu.Wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Ha,da ma wileed Yuusuf walla-?
Wa battaan hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Akiid tuguulu leyi al-masal al-ma'ruuf al-buguul-:--Ya daktoor,daawi nafsak.- Simi'na be kulla l-khidme al-sawweetha fi hillit Kafar Naahuum.Sawwi nafs al-cheyy hini fi hillitak-!
Wa gaal leehum-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ma fi nabi al-yakhbalooh fi hillitah halaalah.
Laakin be l-sahiih nuguul leeku,ta'arfu kadar fi zaman al-nabi Iliyaas,Allah dahar al-matar ma yusubb talaata sana wa sitte chahar wa bigi juu' chadiid fi kulla l-balad.Wa fi Israa'iil fiyah awiin katiiraat araamil
wa laakin Allah ma rassal Iliyaas le ayyi waahide min al-awiin deel.Allah rassalah fi hillit Sarafa fi balad Seeda le mara aakhara armala.
Wa fi zaman al-nabi Alyasa',fi naas katiiriin fi balad Israa'iil al-induhum jidaam wa naadum waahid minhum ma ligi al-aafe,illa Na'amaan al-Suuribas ligi al-aafe.
Wa wakit sim'o al-kalaam da,kulla l-naas al-fi beet al-sala zi'ilo za'al chadiid.
Wa gammo saagooh min al-hille wa waddooh fi taraf al-hajar al-hillithum mabniiye foogah achaan yarmuuh wa yaktuluuh.
Wa laakin hu chaggaahum min usuthum wa faat.
Wa Isa macha fi Kafar Naahuum wa hi hille waahide fi daar al-Jaliil.Wa yoom al-sabt,hu gaa'id yi'allim al-naas.
Wa l-naas al'ajjabo bilheen min ta'liimah achaan hu gaa'id yihajji be l-gudra al-Allah antaaha leyah.
Wa fi beet al-sala,naadum waahid gaa'id wa hu muchootin.Indah cheetaan fasil.Wa hu aat be hiss aali wa gaal-:
Haay-!Ya Isa min al-Naasira,tidoor minnina chunu-?Jiit hini achaan tahlikna walla-?Ana na'arfak.Inta bas al-Khudduus al-Allah rassalah.
Laakin Isa kachcha leyah wa gaal-:-Askut wa amrug minnah-! Wa l-cheetaan rama al-naadum fi ust al-naas.Wa khalaas marag minnah.Wa l-naadum da,ma ligi ayyi waja'.
Wa kulla l-naas al'ajjabo bilheen wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Al-mu'allim da kalaamah da kikkeef-?Indah sulta wa gudra lahaddi yaamur al-chawaatiin wa yamurgu min al-muchootiniin-!
Wa khabarah chattat fi kulla l-daar di.
Wa Isa marag min beet al-sala wa macha fi beet Sim'aan.Wa nasiibtah le Sim'aan indaha wirde chadiide.Wa sa'alo Isa le yachfiiha.
Wa hu macha wagaf fi jamb al-bakaan al-hi raagde foogah wa kachcha le l-wirde wa l-wirde khallatha.Wa tawwaali hi gammat wa dayyafathum.
Wa fi l-makhrib,kulla l-naas al-induhum naadum mardaan kan indah ayyi marad,jaabooh le Isa.Wa hu khatta iidah foog ayyi mardaan wa chafaah.
Wa chawaatiin marago min naas katiiriin wa aato wa gaalo-:-Inta Ibn Allah. Laakin hu kachcha leehum wa daharaahum ma yihajju achaan humman ya'arfu kadar hu al-Masiih.
Wa wakit al-wata asbahat,hu marag wa macha fi bakaan ma indah naas.Wa l-naas fattachooh wa jo leyah wa dawwaro yadharooh ma yamchi yikhalliihum.
Laakin hu gaal leehum-:-Waajib niballikh bichaarat mamlakat Allah fi hillaal aakhariin kula.Fi chaan da bas Allah rassalaani.
Wa hu raayikh fi daar al-Yahuudiiya wa gaa'id yibachchir al-naas fi buyuut al-sala.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaa'id jamb bahar al-Jaliil.Wa l-naas al-yidooru yasma'o kalaam Allah bigo katiiriin marra waahid lahaddi gaa'idiin ya'asuruuh.
Wa chaaf maraakib itneen gaa'idiin fi khachum al-bahar.Al-hawwaatiin nazalo minhum le yikhassulu churukkaahum.
Wa Isa rikib fi markaba waahide wa hi hana Sim'aan.Wa talab min Sim'aan yilizzaha chiyya min khachum al-bahar.Wa ga'ad tihit fi l-markaba wa bada yi'allim al-naas al-gaa'idiin fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa wakit Isa kammal kalaamah,hu hajja le Sim'aan wa gaal-:-Waddi al-markaba fi ust al-bahar wa oori naasak yazgulu al-charak fi l-almi le yakurbu huut.
Wa Sim'aan radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Sayyidna,ti'ibna tuul al-leel wa ma karabna cheyy.Laakin nazgul al-charak kan inta tidoorah.
Wa wakit zagalo charakhum,karabo huut katiir bilheen lahaddi l-charak yidoor yingati' min al-tagala.
Wa sawwo ichaara le rufgaanhum al-fi l-markaba al-aakhara achaan yi'aawunuuhum.Wa jo malo al-maraakib al-itneen lahaddi l-maraakib yidooru yakhtusu.
Wa wakit Sim'aan Butrus chaaf al-cheyy al-bigi da,hu sajad giddaam rijileen Isa wa gaal-:-Ya Rabb,kiss minni ba'iid-!Achaan ana naadum muznib.
Wa hajja misil da achaan hu wa kulla jamaa'tah fi l-markaba al'ajjabo bilheen min al-huut al-katiir al-karabooh.
Wa rufgaanah le Sim'aan,Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna awlaad Zabadi,kula al'ajjabo ma'aayah.Wa Isa gaal le Sim'aan-:-Ma takhaaf.Awwal inta gaa'id takrub al-huut wa laakin min al-yoom takrub al-naas le tijiibhum leyi.
Wa min gabbalo maraakibhum fi khachum al-bahar,humman khallo kulla cheyy wa gammo taaba'o Isa.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaa'id fi hille waahide wa raajil waahid indah jidaam ja leyah.Wa l-raajil da indah jidaamcheen.Wa wakit chaaf Isa,hu sajad giddaamah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,kan tidoor tachfiini akiid inta tagdar wa ana nabga taahir.
Wa Isa madda iidah wa limis al-raajil al-indah jidaam wa gaal-:-Nidoor nachfiik.Abga taahir. Wa tawwaali bigi taahir min al-jidaam.
Wa Isa amarah wa gaal leyah-:-Ma ti'oori naadum.Amchi wassif nafsak le raajil al-diin wa gaddim dahiiye le Allah misil al-nabi Muusa amaraana beeha.Wa misil da,al-naas ya'arfu kadar inta ligiit al-aafe wa bigiit taahir.
Laakin be da,khabarah chattat be ziyaada fi l-naas.Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid laammiin foogah achaan yidooru yasma'o kalaamah wa hu yachfi amraadhum.
Laakin Isa gamma wiheedah misil fi aadtah wa macha fi l-khala achaan yisalli.
Wa yoom aakhar,Isa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas.Wa fi l-bakaan da,fi naas katiiriin gaa'idiin ma'aayah min tariigat al-Fariiziiya wa min al-mu'allimiin fi l-Tawraat.Wa humman jo min ayyi hille al-fi daar al-Jaliil wa l-Yahuudiiya wa min Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa gudrat Allah gaa'ide foogah achaan yachfi al-mardaaniin.
Wa rujaal waahidiin jo wa humman chaayliin naadum mukarsah fi furaachah.Wa dawwaro yadkhulu beyah daakhal wa yukhuttuuh giddaam Isa.
Laakin ma irfo kikkeef yidakhkhulu al-naadum da le Isa,be sabab al-naas al-katiiriin al-saddo leehum al-derib.Wa achaan da,rikbo fi raas al-beet wa gaddooh be foog.Wa dallo al-mukarsah be furaachah fi ust al-naas wa khattooh giddaam Isa.
Wakit Isa chaaf iimaanhum,hajja le l-raajil al-mukarsah wa gaal-:-Ya akhuuyi,zunuubak ankhafaro.
Wa l-ulama wa l-Fariiziyiin bado yihajju fi guluubhum wa yuguulu-:-Haay-!Da yaatu al-gaa'id yihajji be kalaam kufur da-?Al-insaan ma yagdar yakhfir zunuub al-insaan,illa Allah-!
Wa Isa irif al-kalaam al-fi guluubhum.Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Maala tifakkuru fi guluubku-?
Weenu al-hayyin nuguulah-?Nuguul-:--Zunuubak ankhafaro--,walla nuguul-:--Gumm wa ruukh---?
Wa laakin nidoor intu ta'arfu kadar ana,Ibn al-Insaan,indi sulta fi l-ard achaan nakhfir le l-naas zunuubhum.-Wa gaal le l-mukarsah-:-Nuguul leek,gumm-!Chiil furaachak wa amchi beetak-!
Wa tawwaali al-mukarsah gamma giddaamhum wa chaal furaachah al-raagid foogah wa macha beetah.Wa fi l-derib,hu gaa'id yachkur Allah.
Wa kulluhum al'ajjabo marra waahid wa gammo yachkuru Allah.Wa l-khoof karabaahum wa gaalo-:-Al-yoom chifna cheyy ajiib-!
Wa ba'ad da,Isa marag.Wa chaaf naadum waahid usmah Laawi al-yilimm al-daraayib.Wa gaa'id yakhdim fi maktab al-daraayib.Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal taabi'ni.
Wa khalaas Laawi khalla kulla cheyy wa gamma taaba'ah.
Wa Laawi sawwa leyah aazuuma kabiire fi beetah.Wa fi naas katiiriin al-yilimmu al-daraayib wa naas aakhariin jo wa gaa'idiin yaakulu ma'aayah.
Wa l-Fariiziyiin wa ulamaahum harajo talaamiiz Isa wa gaalo-:-Maala taakulu wa tacharbo ma'a naas al-daraayib wa l-muznibiin-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-naas al-taybiin ma hawjaaniin daktoor,illa l-mardaaniin bas.
Ana ma jiit achaan ninaadi al-saalihiin,laakin jiit le ninaadi al-muznibiin le l-tooba.
Wa gaalo leyah-:-Talaamiiz Yahya wa talaamiiz al-Fariiziyiin yusuumu wa yisallu katiir.Laakin talaamiizak inta gaa'idiin yaakulu wa yacharbo.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan naas gaa'idiin fi iris wa l-ariis ma'aahum,tidooru humman yusuumu walla-?
Wa laakin yoom waahid yaji,al-ariis yichiiluuh minhum wa khalaas fi l-wakit daak,yusuumu.
Wa battaan hu hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:-Ma fi naadum al-yachrut git'e min khalag jadiid achaan yarga' beeha khalag gadiim.Achaan kan yisawwi misil da,hu yitallif al-khalag al-jadiid wa l-git'e al-chaalaaha min al-jadiid ma tiwaafig ma'a l-gadiim.
Wa ma fi naadum yusubb khamar jadiid fi girbe gadiime.Kan yisawwi misil da,al-khamar al-jadiid yuchugg al-girbe wa l-khamar yidaffig wa l-girbe tatlaf.
Laakin waajib yusubbu khamar jadiid fi girbe jadiide.
Wa ba'ad naadum chirib al-khamar al-gadiim hu ma yidoor yachrab al-jadiid,achaan hu yuguul al-khamar al-gadiim bas adiil.
Yoom waahid,Isa raayikh fi ust al-ziraa'a wa da yoom al-sabt.Wa talaamiizah gammo yagta'o ganaadiil al-gameh wa yafurkuuhum fi iideehum wa yaakuluuh.
Laakin Fariiziyiin waahidiin gaalo-:-Maala intu tisawwu al-khidme al-ma halaala fi yoom al-sabt-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ma gareetu al-Kitaab walla-?Nisiitu al-cheyy al-Dawuud wa jamaa'tah sawwooh wakit al-juu' sawwaahum walla-?
Hu dakhal fi beet Allah wa akal al-khubza al-gaddamooha al-naas le Allah.Wa da ma halaal le ayyi naadum illa le rujaal al-diin.Wa Dawuud zaatah akal wa anta minha le jamaa'tah kula.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ibn al-Insaan hu Rabb yoom al-sabt wa ana bas hu.
Wa fi yoom sabt aakhar,Isa dakhal fi beet al-sala wa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas.Wa fiyah naadum waahid iidah al-zeene mayte gaa'id daakhal.
Wa l-Fariiziyiin wa l-ulama khatto baalhum le Isa.Yidooru ya'arfu kan hu yachfiih fi yoom al-sabt walla la,achaan yalgo fursa le yukhuttu foogah tuhma.
Laakin hu irif fikirhum.Wa hajja le l-raajil al-iidah mayte wa gaal-:-Gumm foog giddaam al-naas. Wa l-raajil gamma wagaf giddaamhum.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Nas'alku cheyy waahid.Chunu al-halaal fi yoom al-sabt-?Al-kheer walla l-charr-?Halaal leena ninajju al-naas walla nahalkuuhum-?
Wa Isa allaffat achaan yichiifhum kulluhum fi uyuunhum.Wa hajja le l-raajil wa gaal-:-Midd iidak. Wa l-raajil maddaaha wa khalaas iidah achchaafat.
Laakin al-Fariiziyiin wa l-ulama zi'ilo za'al chadiid.Wa gammo yichchaawaro ambeenaathum fi l-cheyy al-yagdaro yisawwuuh le Isa.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Isa marag wa tala' fi hajar achaan yisalli.Wa tuul al-leel hu gaa'id yisalli le Allah.
Wa wakit al-wata asbahat,hu naada talaamiizah wa azal minhum 12 wa sammaahum rusul.
Wa humman Sim'aan al-Isa sammaah Butrus wa Andareeyas akhuuh le Sim'aan wa Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna wa Filibbus wa Bartulma
wa Matta wa Tuuma wa Yaakhuub wileed Halfa wa Sim'aan al-binaaduuh al-Sawri
wa Yahuuza wileed Yaakhuub wa Yahuuza al-Iskhariyooti al-ba'adeen yukhuun Isa.
Wa hu nazal ma'aahum min al-hajar wa wagaf fi bakaan wasii'.Wa talaamiiz katiiriin gaa'idiin ma'aayah.Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid jo min kulla daar al-Yahuudiiya wa min madiinat al-Khudus wa min al-hillaal al-jamb al-bahar gariib le Suur wa Seeda.
Wa l-naas dool jo achaan yasma'o kalaamah wa hu yachfi amraadhum.Wa l-naas al-induhum chawaatiin kula,hu daawaahum.
