Wa kulla l-naas dawwaro yalmasooh achaan al-gudra al-tamrug minnah tachfiihum kulluhum.
Wa Isa rafa' raasah chaaf talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Mabruuk leeku intu al-masaakiinachaan mamlakat Allah hintuku.
Mabruuk leeku intu al-hassa' jii'aaniinachaan ba'adeen tachba'o.Mabruuk leeku intu al-tabku min al-nadaamaachaan ba'adeen tadhako min al-farah.
Mabruuk leeku intukan al-naas yakrahookuwa yaabooku wa yi'ayyuruukuwa yitallufu usumku be sababi ana,Ibn al-Insaan.
Fi l-yoom daak,anbastu wa nattutu min al-farhaachaan nuguul leeku ajurku fi l-sama kabiir bilheen.Ma tanso kadar zamaan juduudhumsawwo nafs al-cheyy le l-anbiya al-faato.
Laakin al-azaab yarjaaku intu siyaad al-maalachaan kulla l-raaha al-talgooha ligiituuha khalaas.
Wa l-azaab yarjaaku intu al-chab'aaniinachaan ba'adeen tabgo jii'aaniin.Wa l-azaab yarjaaku intu al-gaa'idiin tadhakoachaan ba'adeen tabku wa tahzano min al-nadaama.
Wa l-azaab yarjaaku intukan kulla l-naas yachkuruuku.Ma tanso kadar zamaan al-naaschakaroohum le l-kaddaabiin al-sawwo nufuushum anbiya.
Wa Isa gaal battaan-:-Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku intu al-tasma'o kalaami,hibbu aduuku wa sawwu al-kheer le l-naas al-yakrahooku.
Wa baaruku al-naas al-yal'anooku wa as'alo Allah be l-kheer fi chaan al-naas al-yita''ubuuku.
Kan naadum daggaak fi chidgak al-waahide,antiih al-aakhara kula.Wa kan naadum yidoor yichiil jallaabiiytak,khalaas khalli yichiil jawwaaniiytak kula.
Anti le ayyi naadum al-yas'al minnak cheyy wa l-naadum al-chaal minnak khumaamak ma tas'alah minnah.
Wa sawwu le l-naas al-cheyy al-intu zaatku tidooru al-naas yisawwuuh leeku.
Wa kan tihibbu al-naas al-yihibbuuku bas,ween al-kheer al-sawweetuuh-?Al-muznibiin zaathum yihibbu al-yihibbuuhum.
Wa kan intu tisawwu al-kheer le l-naas al-yisawwu leeku al-kheer,ween al-baraka-?Al-muznibiin yisawwu nafs al-cheyy.
Wa kan tidayyunu al-naas al-induku fooghum achaan le yigabbulu leeku gurusku,ween al-kheer al-sawweetuuh-?Al-muznibiin zaathum yidayyunu akhwaanhum al-muznibiin al-yagdaro yikaffuuhum.
Laakin hibbu udwaanku wa sawwu leehum al-kheer wa dayyunuuhum wa ma tarjo minhum cheyy wa khalaas talgo ajur kabiir.Wa misil da,tabgo iyaal Allah al-Aali.Hu yisawwi zeen le l-naas al-fasliin al-ma yachkuruuh.
Arhamo al-naas misil abuuku Allah rahiim le l-naas.
Ma tihaakumu al-naas achaan Allah ma yihaakimku intu.Ma taj'alo al-naas khaatiyiin achaan Allah ma yaj'alku intu khaatiyiin.Saamuhu al-naas wa Allah yisaamihku.
Antu le l-naas wa Allah yantiiku.Yantiiku be iid wasii'e fi iideeku wa yukuun wazin adiil wa kiyaala lahaddi yidaffig.Allah yikiil leeku be nafs al-mikyaal al-intu tikiilu beyah le l-naas.
Wa Isa hajja leehum battaan be masal wa gaal-:-Naadum amyaan yagdar yuguud naadum amyaan walla-?Kulluhum ma yaga'o fi nugra walla-?
Al-tilmiiz ma akbar min sayyidah laakin wakit allamah kulla cheyy,al-tilmiiz yabga misil sayyidah.
Walla kikkeef tuguul le akhuuk --Khalliini nisill al-gechchaay min eenak-- wa inta zaatak ma chift al-uud al-gaa'id fi eenak-?Ya munaafikh-!Awwal ke sill al-uud al-fi eenak wa misil da tichiif adiil wa khalaas tagdar tisill al-gechchaay al-fi een akhuuk.
Ma fi chadara adiile al-talda iyaal fasliin.Wa battaan ma fi chadara fasle al-talda iyaal adiiliin.
Achaan al-naas ya'arfu ayyi chadara min iyaalha.Ma yalgo iyaal jimmeez fi l-chadara al-indaha chook.Wa ma yilaggutu inab min andireesa.
Al-galib hu misil makhazan.Wa l-naadum al-adiil yudumm kalaam adiil fi galbah wa l-kalaam al-yamrug minnah adiil.Wa l-naadum al-fasil yudumm kalaam fasil fi galbah wa l-kalaam al-yamrug minnah fasil.Achaan al-cheyy al-galib al-naadum malaan beyah,da bas al-yamrug min khachmah wakit yihajji.
Kikkeef tinaaduuni-:--Ya sayyidna,Ya sayyidna-- kan ma tisawwu al-cheyy al-nuguulah leeku-?
Ayyi naadum al-yaji leyi wa yasma' kalaami wa yitaabi'ah,ana ni'ooriiku be l-cheyy al-hu yichaabihah.
Hu misil naadum waahid al-bana beet.Awwal nakat fi l-turaab achaan yukhutt asaas al-beet fi l-hajar al-gaa'id tihit.Wa almi al-waadi saal wa darab al-beet wa l-beet ma anhazza achaan hu mabni adiil.
Wa laakin al-naadum al-yasma' kalaami wa ma yitabbigah,hu yabga misil al-naadum al-bana beetah fi l-turaab bala asaas.Wa almi al-waadi darabah wa ajala ke al-beet waga' wa tilif marra waahid.
Wa ba'ad Isa gaal kulla l-kalaam da le l-naas,hu macha fi hillit Kafar Naahuum.
Wa fi naadum ajnabi hinaak wa hu kabiir askar al-Roomaaniyiin wa hu indah abid waahid mardaan gariib yumuut.Wa kabiir al-askar yiriidah le abdah bilheen.
Wa wakit simi' khabar hana Isa,hu rassal leyah naas min chuyuukh al-Yahuud achaan yatulbu minnah yaji yachfi abdah.
Wa macho le Isa wa chahadooh bilheen wa gaalo-:-Al-ajnabi da,indah hagg tisawwi leyah al-cheyy al-talabah minnak.
Achaan hu yihibb cha'abna wa bana leena beet al-sala.
Wa Isa macha ma'aahum.Wa wakit hu garrab le l-beet,al-askari rassal leyah rufgaanah achaan yihajju leyah.Wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna,anjamma ma tita''ib nafsak.Ana ma indi hagg le tadkhul fi beeti.
Achaan da bas,ana zaati khijilt wa ma macheet leek.Wa laakin guul kilme waahide bas wa khaddaami yalga al-aafe.
Achaan ana kula indi kabiir min foog leyi al-nitabbig amrah.Wa ana kula mas'uul fi naas al-tihit minni al-yitabbugu amri.Wa kan nuguul le waahid --Amchi--,hu yamchi.Wa kan nuguul le naadum aakhar --Ta'aal--,hu yaji.Wa kan nuguul le abdi --Sawwi ke--,hu yisawwiih.
Wa wakit Isa simi' kalaamah,hu al'ajjab bilheen wa anlafat le l-naas al-jaayiin waraayah wa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku ma ligiit naadum waahid min Bani Israa'iil al-indah iimaan chadiid misil iimaan al-naadum da-!
Wa khalaas wakit al-murassaliin gabbalo fi l-beet,chaafo al-abid ligi al-aafe.
Wa ba'adeen Isa macha le hille waahide usumha Naayin.Wa talaamiizah ma'aayah wa naas katiiriin maachiin waraayah.
Wa wakit garrab le baab al-hille,hu chaaf naadum mayyit wa l-naas maachiin yadfunuuh.Wa l-mayyit hu wileed waahid fi ammah wa hi mara armala.Wa naas katiiriin min al-hille maachiin ma'aaha.
Wa wakit al-Rabb Isa chaafaaha,galbah hanna leeha wa gaal-:-Ma tabki.
Wa macha le l-mayyit wa limis al-barangaal wa l-naas al-chaayliinah wagafo.Wa Isa gaal-:-Ya wileedi,nuguul leek gumm-!
Wa l-mayyit gamma wa hajja.Wa Isa antaah le ammah.
Wa l-khoof dakhal le kulla l-naas wa humman majjado Allah wa gaalo-:-Nabi kabiir ja fi usutna-!Allah bayyan gudurtah le cha'abah-!
Wa fi kulla daar al-Yahuudiiya wa fi kulla l-buldaan al-mujaawiriin,al-naas sim'o khabar hana l-cheyy al-Isa sawwaah.
Wa talaamiiz Yahya macho le sayyidhum wa oorooh be kulla cheyy al-Isa gaa'id yisawwiih.
Wa Yahya naada talaamiiz itneen wa rassalaahum le l-Rabb Isa achaan yuguulu leyah-:-Inta bas al-naadum al-yaji walla waajib narjo naadum aakhar battaan-?
Wa macho le Isa wa gaalo-:-Yahya al-Mukhattis rassalaana achaan nas'alook --Inta bas al-naadum al-yaji walla waajib narjo naadum aakhar battaan-?-
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,Isa chafa naas katiiriin min al-mardaaniin wa l-ta'baaniin wa l-muchootiniin.Wa fattah uyuun amyaaniin katiiriin.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Amchu wa ooru Yahya be kulla cheyy al-chiftuuh wa simi'tuuh.Al-amyaaniin gaa'idiin yichiifu wa l-uruj yuruukhu wa l-induhum jidaam yalgo al-aafe wa l-tarchaaniin yasma'o wa l-maytiin yab'aso wa l-masaakiin gaa'idiin yasma'o al-bichaara.
Wa mabruuk le l-naadum al-ma yikhalli iimaanah beyi.
Wa wakit murassaliin Yahya maachiin,Isa bada yihajji fi Yahya le l-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah wa gaal-:-Wakit Yahya gaa'id fi l-kadaade,intu maragtu leyah.Wa dawwartu tichiifu chunu-?Dawwartu tichiifu ageegaay bas al-riih tihizzaha walla-?
Kan ma ke,dawwartu tichiifu chunu-?Naadum laabis khulgaan samhiin walla-?La.Achaan al-naas al-laabsiin khulgaan samhiin wa l-aaychiin fi bakaan halu gaa'idiin fi gusuur al-muluuk.
Zeen.Maragtu achaan tichiifu chunu-?Achaan tichiifu nabi-?Aywa,wa nuguul leeku chiftu naadum akbar min nabi.
Da bas hu al-be sababah al-Kitaab yuguul-:﴾‍Daahu nirassil rasuuli giddaamak wa hu yi'addil leek al-derib.‍﴿
Wa nuguul leeku ma fi naadum mawluud min mara akbar min Yahya al-Mukhattis.Wa laakin al-naadum al-sakhayyar fi mamlakat Allah akbar minnah.
Wa kulla l-naas sim'o kalaam Yahya wa ma'aahum naas al-jamaarik kula.Wa taabo min zunuubhum wa khallo Yahya yikhattishum wa misil da,akkado kadar fikir Allah adiil.
Wa laakin al-Fariiziyiin wa ulama al-Tawraat abo ma khallo Yahya yikhattishum.Wa be misil da,ma khiblo al-niiye al-Allah indah leehum.
Wa nuguul chunu fi l-naas hana l-wakit al-haali da-?Bichaabuhu chunu-?Humman misil iyaal dugaag laammiin fi l-door wa yinaadu rufgaanhum wa yuguulu-:
--Aniina darabna leeku al-suffaara laakin intu ma li'ibtu.Aniina khanneena khine hana l-moot laakin intu ma bakeetu.--
Achaan Yahya al-Mukhattis ja leeku wa hu ma yaakul akil wa ma bachrab khamar wa gultu hu muchootin.
Wa ba'adeen ana,Ibn al-Insaan,jiit leeku wa ana naakul wa nachrab wa tuguulu-:--Hu akkaal wa sakkaari wa bigi rafiig le naas al-jamaarik wa l-muznibiin.--
Laakin hikmat Allah al-sahiihe tinchaaf fi amal kulla l-naas al-yitaabu'uuha.
Wa naadum waahid min al-Fariiziyiin azam Isa yaakul ma'aayah.Wa Isa dakhal fi beet al-Fariizi wa antaka.
Wa fi mara waahide muznibe ma'ruufa fi l-hille.Wa wakit hi sim'at kadar Isa azamooh fi beet al-Fariizi,hi gammat chaalat maa'uun hana hajar malaan itir wa machat leyah.
Wa wagafat wara Isa jamb rijileenah.Wa hi gaa'ide tabki wa badat tibill rijileenah be dumuu'ha wa tuguchchuhum be cha'arha.Wa gaa'ide tihibb rijileenah wa tamsah fooghum al-itir.
Wa l-Fariizi al-azamah fi beetah chaaf al-cheyy al-hi gaa'ide tisawwiih wa fi galbah gaal-:Kan sahiih al-naadum da nabi,akiid hu ya'arif al-mara al-gaa'ide tilammisah di yaati wa ya'arif haalha al-cheene achaan hi muznibe.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Sim'aan.Nidoor nuguul leek kalaam waahid. Wa l-Fariizi radda leyah wa gaal-:-Na'am,ya mu'allim.Alfaddal.Hajji-!
Wa Isa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naadum waahid al-yidayyin al-naas wa indah deen foog naaseen.Wa l-waahid deenah 500 diinaar wa l-taani deenah 50 diinaar.
Ma gidro yikaffuuh leyah.Wa khalaas hu saamahaahum marra waahid.Wa nas'alak yaatu min al-naaseen dool yihibbah be ziyaada-?
Wa Sim'aan radda leyah wa gaal-:-Fi fikri ana,nuguul al-naadum al-saamaho leyah al-deen al-katiir yihibbah be ziyaada. Wa Isa gaal-:-Fikrak sahiih.
Wa Isa anlafat le l-mara wa hajja le Sim'aan wa gaal-:-Al-mara di chiftaha walla-?Ana dakhalt fi beetak wa inta ma anteetni almi achaan nikhassil rijileeni laakin hi ballat rijileeni be dumuu'ha wa gachchathum be cha'arha.
Wa inta ma sallamtini be hubb wa laakin min ana dakhalt fi beetak hi gaa'ide tihibb rijileeni.
Wa inta ma anteetni dihin achaan namsah beyah raasi laakin hi masahat itir fi rijileeni.
Wa nuguul leek,da yiwassif kadar zunuubha al-katiiriin saamahoohum leeha.Wa achaan da,hi tihibb katiir.Laakin al-naadum al-saamaho leyah chiyya,yihibb chiyya.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Akiid zunuubki ankhafaro.
Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin yaakulu ma'aayah gammo yuguulu ambeenaathum-:-Haay-!Da yaatu al-yisaamih al-muznibiin--?
Wa Isa hajja le l-mara battaan wa gaal-:-Be sabab iimaanki nijiiti.Amchi be salaam.
Wa ba'ad da,Isa gamma yuruukh fi l-mudun wa l-hillaal.Wa gaa'id yiballikh le l-naas be bichaarat mamlakat Allah.Wa l-rusul al-atnaachar maachiin ma'aayah.
Wa ma'aayah fi awiin al-Isa chafaahin.Waahidaat awwal mardaanaat wa waahidaat awwal muchootinaat misil Mariyam al-Magdaliiye al-tarad minha sab'a chawaatiin
wa Jaana marit Khuuza wakiil hana Hiruudus al-muhaafiz wa Suuzaana wa awiin aakharaat katiiraat.Wa l-awiin deel gaa'idaat yisaa'idan jamaa'at Isa be maalhin halaalhin.
Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid jaayiin leyah min ayyi hille wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:
Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi harraati waahid marag macha fi l-zere' achaan yiteerib.Wa wakit hu gaa'id yichattit teeraabah,teeraab waahid waga' fi l-derib.Wa l-naas fajjakhooh wa tuyuur al-sama jo akalooh.
Wa teeraab aakhar waga' fi bakaan hajar wa l-bizre yibsat achaan ma ligat almi.
Wa teeraab aakhar waga' fi ust al-chook wa l-bizre gammat sawa ma'a l-chook wa l-chook khanagaaha.
Wa teeraab aakhar waga' fi turaab adiil wa l-bizre gammat wa wildat iyaal katiir.Wa kulli ganduul indah 100 habba. Wa wakit gaal al-kalaam da khalaas,hu naada al-jamaa'a wa gaal-:-Ayyi naadum al-indah adaan le l-sama',khalli yasma'-!
Wa talaamiizah sa'alooh min ma'ana hana l-masal da.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Allah antaaku ma'rafat sirr mamlakat Allah laakin nihajji le l-naas al-aakhariin be amsaal.Wa be misil da,induhum uyuun wa laakin ma yichiifu wa yasma'o al-kalaam wa laakin ma yafhamooh.
Wa nifassir leeku al-masal.Al-teeraab yimassil kalaam Allah.
Wa l-teeraab al-waga' fi l-derib yimassil al-naas al-yasma'o kalaam Allah laakin Ibliis yaji yichiilah min guluubhum achaan ma yi'aamunu wa yanjo.
Wa l-teeraab al-waga' fi bakaan hajar yimassil al-naas al-yasma'o al-kalaam wa yakhbalooh be farha laakin yi'aamunu le wakit chiyya bas.Wa humman misil bizrit al-gameh al-ma indaha uruug.Wa fi wakit al-tajriba,yikhallu derib Allah.
Wa l-teeraab al-waga' fi ust al-chook yimassil al-naas al-yasma'o kalaam Allah wa laakin machaakil al-dunya wa reedithum le l-maal wa chahwaat al-haya yaktulu kalaam Allah al-fi guluubhum.Wa be da,kalaam Allah ma yijiib natiija.
Wa l-teeraab al-waga' fi l-turaab al-adiil yimassil al-naas al-yasma'o kalaam Allah wa yakurbuuh be hagg wa galib adiil.Wa yasburu wa yijiibu natiija adiile.
Wa ma fi naadum yi'oogid faanuus wa yikhattiih be maa'uun wa la yukhuttah tihit al-sariir.Wa laakin yukhuttah fi bakaan foog achaan al-naas al-yadkhulu fi l-beet yichiifu al-deyy.
Achaan ma fi cheyy mulabbad al-ba'adeen ma yinchaaf.Wa ma fi ayyi sirr al-ma yin'arif wa ba'adeen yinkachif.
Achaan da,khuttu baalku wa asma'o adiil.Achaan yantu al-naadum al-indah.Wa laakin al-naadum al-ma indah,al-chiyya al-hu indah kula,yichiiluuh minnah.
Wa amm Isa wa akhwaanah jo leyah.Dawwaro yichiifuuh laakin ma gidro yigarrubu leyah achaan katarat al-naas saddat leehum al-derib.
Wa l-naas oorooh wa gaalo-:-Ammak wa akhwaanak gaa'idiin barra wa yidooru yichiifuuk.
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-naas al-yasma'o kalaam Allah wa yitabbuguuh,humman bas ammi wa akhwaani.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Ta'aalu nagta'o al-bahar. Wa rikib fi markaba ma'a talaamiizah wa macho.
Wa wakit maachiin,Isa naam fi l-markaba.Wa be khafla,riih chadiide marra waahid saagat fi l-bahar wa gawwamat al-challaal.Wa l-markaba gaa'ide tinmali almi wa humman fi khatar.
Wa l-talaamiiz macho le Isa wa gawwamooh min al-noom wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna-!Ya sayyidna-!Aniina mutna-! Wa Isa gamma wa kachcha le l-riih wa l-challaal al-chadiid.Wa khalaas,al-riih wa l-challaal wagafo.Wa l-wata bigat haadiye.
Wa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ween iimaanku-? Wa humman khaafo khoof chadiid wa al'ajjabo marra waahid wa gaalo ambeenaathum-:-Al-naadum da yaatu-?Hu amar al-riih wa l-almi wa humman sim'o kalaamah-!
Wa khalaas,gata'o al-bahar wa wassalo fi balad al-Garaasiyiin al-gaa'ide mugaabile daar al-Jaliil.
Wa wakit Isa nazal min al-markaba,naadum waahid muchootin min al-hille ja laagaah.Wa min mudda tawiile hu ma laabis khalag wa la saakin fi beet.Hu saakin fi l-khubuur.
Wa hu chaaf Isa wa aat wa sajad giddaamah.Wa be hiss aali hu gaal-:-Ya Isa Ibn Allah al-Aali-!Inta tidoor minni chunu-?Nachhadak ma ti'azzibni.
Wa gaal al-kalaam da achaan awwal Isa amar al-cheetaan al-gaa'id foogah le yamrug minnah.Wa l-naadum da,marra katiir al-cheetaan yugumm leyah.Wa awwal rabatooh wa janzarooh laakin hu gata' ayyi rubaat.Wa l-cheetaan saagah fi l-khala.
Wa Isa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Usmak yaatu-? Wa hu gaal-:-Ana usmi Deech-.Wa hu gaal deech achaan chawaatiin katiiriin dakhalo foogah.
Wa l-chawaatiin chahado Isa achaan ma yirassilhum fi bakaan al-azaab.
Wa fi taraf al-hajar,khanaaziir katiiriin gaa'idiin yasraho.Wa l-chawaatiin chahado Isa achaan yikhalliihum yadkhulu fi l-khanaaziir dool.Wa hu antaahum izin.
Wa l-chawaatiin marago min al-naadum da wa dakhalo fi l-khanaaziir.Wa l-khanaaziir kulluhum jaro min taraf al-hajar wa waga'o fi l-bahar wa khalaas,almi akalaahum.
Wa wakit ru'yaan al-khanaaziir chaafo al-cheyy al-bigi da,gammo arrado wa macho khabbaro beyah kulla l-naas al-fi l-hille wa fi l-furgaan.
Wa be l-khabar da,al-naas marago min al-hille achaan yichiifu al-cheyy al-bigi.Wa jo le Isa wa chaafo al-naadum al-marago minnah al-chawaatiin.Wa hu gaa'id tihit yasma' kalaam Isa,laabis khulgaan wa aglah foogah.Wa khaafo marra waahid.
Wa l-naas al-chaafo al-cheyy da khabbaro al-naas al-aakhariin be kikkeef al-naadum al-awwal muchootin ligi al-aafe.
Wa kulla l-naas hana balad al-Garaasiyiin chahado Isa le yiba''id minhum achaan humman khaayfiin khoof chadiid.Wa khalaas,hu rikib fi l-markaba le yigabbil daar al-Jaliil.
Wa gubbaal Isa ma yamchi,al-naadum al-marago minnah al-chawaatiin chahad Isa achaan yamchi ma'aayah.Laakin Isa rassalah fi hillitah wa gaal-:
Gabbil beetak wa oori naasak be kulla cheyy al-Allah sawwaah leek. Wa khalaas,gamma macha wa ballakh kulla naas hillitah be kulla cheyy al-Isa sawwaah leyah.
Wa Isa gabbal fi daar al-Jaliil wa kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yarjooh wa laagooh be farah.
Wa naadum waahid usmah Jaayrus ja wa hu mas'uul fi beet al-sala.Wa hu sajad giddaam Isa wa chahadah le yaji fi beetah
achaan indah bineeye waahide bas wa umurha misil 12 sana wa hi gariib tumuut.Wa Isa gamma wa macha ma'aayah.Wa fi naas katiiriin fi l-derib lahaddi gaa'idiin ya'asuruuh.
Wa fi ust al-naas fi mara ta'baane.Wa min 12 sana,dammaha gaa'id yidaffig minha.Wa dafa'at kulla maalha le l-dakaatiir wa laakin ma fi naadum gidir yidaawiiha.
Wa hi garrabat le Isa min wara wa maddat iidha wa limsat taraf khalagah.Wa tawwaali dammaha wagaf.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Yaatu limisni-? Wa kulla l-naas nakaro.Wa Butrus gaal-:-Sayyidna,fi naas katiiriin muhawwigiinak wa gaa'idiin ya'asuruuk.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Naadum waahid limisni.Hasseet fi gudra maragat minni.
Wa khalaas,al-mara irfat kadar hi ma tagdar tilabbid nafisha wa jaat le Isa wa gaa'ide tarjif min al-khoof.Wa sajadat giddaamah wa oorat Isa giddaam kulla l-naas be sabab lammisiinha.Wa ooratah be kikkeef hi ligat al-aafe tawwaali.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Ya bineeyti,iimaanki beyi najjaaki.Amchi be salaam.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id yihajji leeha,naadum waahid ja min beet al-mas'uul hana beet al-sala wa gaal-:-Bineeytak maatat khalaas.Khalli al-mu'allim yinjamma.
Wa laakin wakit Isa simi' al-kalaam da,hajja le l-mas'uul wa gaal-:-Ma takhaaf.Aamin beyi bas wa hi tanja.
Wa wakit Isa wisil fi beet al-mas'uul,hu ma khalla ayyi naadum yadkhul ma'aayah daakhal illa Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yaakhuub wa abu al-bineeye wa ammaha.
Wa fi l-beet,kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yabku haznaaniin leeha.Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Ma tabku-!Hi ma maatat.Hi naayme bas.
Wa dihko leyah be chamaate achaan irfo hi mayte.
Laakin hu karab iidha wa hajja leeha be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Ya bitti,gummi-!
Wa ruuhha gabbalat leeha wa ajala ke hi gammat.Wa Isa amaraahum achaan yantuuha akil.
Wa waaldeenha al'ajjabo.Wa Isa amaraahum achaan ma yi'ooru naadum be l-cheyy al-bigi.
Wa Isa naada talaamiizah al-atnaachar wa antaahum sulta wa gudra achaan yaturdu ayyi cheetaan wa yachfu al-mardaaniin.
Wa rassalaahum le yibachchuru al-naas be mamlakat Allah wa yachfu al-mardaaniin.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Ma tichiilu ma'aaku cheyy le l-safar wa la asa wa la mukhla wa la akil wa la gurus.Wa ma tichiilu ma'aaku khulgaan hana khiyaar.
Wa ayyi beet al-tidallu foogah,agoodu foogah lahaddi tamurgu min al-hille.
Wa ayyi bakaan al-ma yakhbalooku foogah,amurgu minnah wa hittu al-ajaaj min rijleeku wa da yabga leeku chahaada.
Wa khalaas,humman gammo yuruukhu fi kulla l-hillaal wa yiballukhu al-bichaara fi ayyi bakaan wa yachfu al-mardaaniin.
Wa Hiruudus muhaafiz daar al-Jaliil simi' khabar hana kulla cheyy al-Isa gaa'id yisawwiih wa hu al'ajjab bilheen.Achaan naas waahidiin gaa'idiin yuguulu Yahya ba'as min ust al-maytiin.
Wa aakhariin gaa'idiin yuguulu al-nabi Iliyaas baan wa aakhariin battaan yuguulu naadum min anbiya al-zamaan ba'as.
Wa Hiruudus gaal-:-Yahya da,ana gata't raasah.Wa laakin da yaatu al-ana nasma' minnah khabar misil da-? Wa hu dawwar yichiif Isa.
Wa l-rusul gabbalo le Isa wa khabbarooh be kulla cheyy al-sawwooh.Wa hu chaalaahum ma'aayah.Wa Isa wa talaamiizah gammo macho wiheedhum fi hillit Beet Seeda.
Wa naas katiiriin sim'o al-khabar wa macho waraayah.Wa hu laagaahum adiil wa hajja leehum be mamlakat Allah wa chafa ayyi naadum al-yidoor hu yachfiih.
Wa l-makhrib garrabat wa l-rusul al-atnaachar jo leyah wa gaalo-:-Khalli al-naas yamchu fi l-hillaal wa l-furgaan al-mujaawiriin le yalgo bakaan yarugdu foogah wa yalgo akil.Achaan al-bakaan al-aniina gaa'idiin foogah da khala.
Laakin Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-La.Intu bas antuuhum akil. Wa humman gaalo leyah-:-Indina khamsa khubza wa huut itneen bas.Battaan inta tidoor aniina namchu nachru akil le kulla l-naas dool walla-?
Wa fi ma'aahum gariib 5-000 rujaal.Wa Isa gaal le talaamiizah-:-Ga''uduuhum khamsiin khamsiin.
Wa humman ga''ado al-naas misil hu gaalah leehum.
Wa Isa chaal al-khubza al-khamsa wa l-huut al-itneen.Wa rafa' raasah ale l-sama wa chakar Allah.Wa kassar al-khubza wa l-huut wa antaahum le talaamiizah achaan yigassumuuhum le l-naas.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaa'id yisalli wiheedah.Wa talaamiizah ma'aayah.Wa Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Al-naas gaa'idiin yuguulu ana yaatu-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Naas waahidiin yuguulu inta Yahya al-Mukhattis.Wa naas aakhariin yuguulu inta al-nabi Iliyaas wa naas aakhariin battaan yuguulu kadar inta naadum waahid min al-anbiya al-faato wa ba'ast min ust al-maytiin.
Wa battaan sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Wa laakin intu,tuguulu chunu-?Tuguulu ana yaatu-? Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta al-Masiih al-Allah rassalah.
Laakin Isa amaraahum wa hazzaraahum be tahziir chadiid achaan ma yi'ooru beyah ayyi naadum.
Wa gaal-:-Akiid,Ibn al-Insaan yat'ab ta'ab chadiid.Al-chuyuukh wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama yaabooh.Wa Ibn al-Insaan yaktuluuh wa Allah yab'asah min ust al-maytiin fi l-yoom al-taalit.
Wa Isa gaal leehum kulluhum-:-Kan ayyi naadum yidoor yitaabi'ni,khalli yichiif nafsah rakhiise leyah wa yilhammal ta'ab al-saliib kulla yoom wa yitaabi'ni le l-moot.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yidoor yinajji nafsah,yiwaddirha.Laakin ayyi naadum al-yiwaddir nafsah fi chaani ana,hu da yanja.
Chunu al-faayde kan naadum ribih kulla l-maal al-fi l-dunya wa laakin waddar nafsah aw hilik-?
Wa ayyi naadum al-yankurni be sabab al-eeb al-yalga min al-naas,ana Ibn al-Insaan nankurah wakit nigabbil be gudurti al-majiide wa be gudra al-majiide hana abuuyi Allah wa malaa'ikatah al-mukhaddasiin.
Wa nuguul leeku al-hagg,fi naas waahidiin al-gaa'idiin hini ma yumuutu gubbaal ma yichiifu mamlakat Allah.
Wa ba'ad gariib tamaane yoom min Isa gaal al-kalaam da,hu tala' fi raas hajar achaan yisalli.Wa chaal ma'aayah Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yaakhuub.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id yisalli,wijhah alkhayyar giddaamhum wa khalagah bigi abyad karr misil nuur chadiid.
Wa daahu-!Naaseen baano wa bado yihajju ma'aayah wa humman al-nabi Muusa wa l-nabi Iliyaas.
Wa baano fi nuur majiid wa gaa'idiin yihajju leyah be marigiinah min al-dunya al-yitimm fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa awwal Butrus wa rufgaanah,al-noom chaalaahum laakin gammo min al-noom wa chaafo Isa fi nuur majiid wa l-rujaal al-itneen al-waagfiin ma'aayah.
Wa wakit al-rujaal al-itneen dool dawwaro yinfargu min Isa,Butrus hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,bigi leena sameh kadar aniina gaa'idiin hini.Khalliina nisawwu lagaadiib talaata,waahide leek wa waahide le Muusa wa waahide le Iliyaas. Wa hajja wa ma fakkar fi kalaamah.
Wa wakit gaa'id yihajji al-kalaam da,sahaabaay waahide jaat khattathum.Wa humman khaafo bilheen.
Wa hiss min lubb al-sahaabaay ansama' wa gaal-:-Da bas Ibni wa ana azaltah.Asma'o kalaamah.
Wa wakit al-hiss da kammal khalaas,chaafo Isa gaa'id wiheedah.Wa talaamiizah ga'ado saakit.Wa fi l-wakit daak,ma ooro naadum be l-cheyy al-chaafooh.
Wa ambaakir,dallo min al-hajar wa naas katiiriin laagoohum.
Wa naadum waahid fi ust al-naas aat le Isa wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna-!Nachhadak achaan taji tichiif wileedi.Hu wileedi al-wahiid.Aakhar ma indi.
Wa fi cheetaan waahid al-daayman yakurbah.Ajala ke yaji foogah wa l-wileed yasrakh wa amfitfit tarmiih lahaddi rikhwe tamrug min khachmah.Al-cheetaan ma yikhalliih,illa yita''ibah chadiid wa gaa'id yi'azzibah bilheen.
Wa ana chahadt talaamiizak achaan yaturdu minnah al-cheetaan wa laakin humman ma gidro.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ya l-naas al-uwuj wa ma induku iimaan-!Lahaddi mata nagood ma'aaku wa nilhammalku-?Jiib wileedak hini-!
Wa wakit al-wileed gaa'id yigarrib le Isa,al-cheetaan ramaah tihit wa sawwa leyah amfitfit.Laakin Isa kachcha le l-cheetaan wa chafa al-wileed wa gabbalah le abuuh.
Wa kulla l-naas al'ajjabo bilheen le gudrat Allah al-majiide.Wa laakin wakit kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yihajju be kulla l-ajaayib al-Isa gaa'id yisawwiihum,hu hajja le talaamiizah
wa gaal-:-Asma'o kalaami wa akurbuuh fi guluubku.Ba'ad chiyya,Allah yisallim Ibn al-Insaan le l-naas.
Laakin ma fihmo kalaamah.Ma'ana kalaamah mulabbad leehum lahaddi ma irfooh.Wa ma sa'alooh minnah achaan humman khaayfiin.
Wa talaamiiz Isa bado yilkhaalato ambeenaathum fi yaatu minhum al-yabga kabiir.
Wa Isa irif fikir guluubhum wa jaab leehum wileed sakhayyar wa waggafah fi jambah.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Al-naadum al-yakhbal al-wileed da be usmi,hu yakhbalni ana.Wa l-yakhbalni yakhbal al-rassalaani.Achaan al-naadum al-sakhayyar minku kulluku,hu bas al-kabiir.
Wa Yuuhanna radda leyah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,chifna naadum waahid al-gaa'id yatrud al-chawaatiin be usmak.Wa dawwarna nadharooh achaan hu ma gaa'id yitaabi'ak ma'aana.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ma tadharooh.Achaan al-naadum al-ma yidaawisku hu yisaa'idku.
Wa l-wakit al-yinrafi' foogah Isa fi l-sama garrab.Wa achaan da,hu kharrar wa chaal niiye le yiwajjih ale Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa rassal murassaliin giddaamah achaan yijahhuzu leyah kulla cheyy.Wa dakhalo fi hille waahide wa hi hille hana Saamiriyiin.
Laakin naasha abooh le Isa achaan hu muwajjih ale Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wakit talaamiizah Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna chaafo kadar al-naas dool abooh le Isa,humman gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna,ninaadu naar tanzil min al-sama taakulhum walla-?
Laakin Isa anlafat leehum wa harajaahum.
Wa macho fi hille aakhara.
Wa wakit Isa wa jamaa'tah maachiin fi l-derib,naadum waahid ja hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Nitaabi'ak fi ayyi bakaan al-tamchi foogah.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-ba'achoom indah nugra wa l-teer indah uchch wa laakin Ibn al-Insaan ma indah bakaan yargud foogah.
Wa Isa naada naadum aakhar wa gaal-:-Ta'aal taabi'ni. Laakin al-naadum radda leyah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,antiini izin achaan nadfin abuuyi gubbaal ma nitaabi'ak.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Khalli al-maytiin yadfunu maytiinhum.Laakin inta da,amchi ballikh bichaarat mamlakat Allah.
Wa battaan naadum aakhar gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid,ana nidoor nitaabi'ak.Laakin awwal ke antiini izin achaan nigabbil fi beeti nisallim ahali.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Kan naadum bada yakhdim be l-harraata wa yichiif waraayah,hu ma jaahiz le mamlakat Allah.
Wa ba'adeen al-Rabb Isa azal min talaamiizah sab'iin wa tineen naadum wa rassalaahum itneen itneen giddaamah fi ayyi bakaan al-hu yidoor yamchi leyah.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Al-naas misil zere' kabiir wa khallitah nijdat khalaas wa laakin al-yakhdumu foogah chiyya.Achaan da,as'alo siid al-zere' achaan yirassil khaddaamiinah yilimmu khallitah.
Wa khalaas amchu.Nirassilku fi usuthum wa tabgo misil sukhlaan fi ust al-maraaf'iin.
Wa fi l-derib,ma tichiilu juzlaan wa la mukhla wa la na'aal.Ma tagiifu le tisallumu ayyi naadum fi l-derib.
Wa gubbaal ma tadkhulu fi ayyi beet,guulu-:--Khalli al-salaam yaji fi l-beet da.--
Wa kan naadum al-yiriid al-salaam gaa'id foogah,salaamku yagood foogah.Laakin kan ma fi naadum al-yiriid al-salaam,khallu salaamku yigabbil leeku.
Wa agoodu fi beet waahid wa ma tamchu beet aakhar.Aakulu wa acharbo ayyi cheyy al-yidayyufuuku beyah achaan ujrat al-naadum al-yakhdim waajbe leyah.Ma tihawwulu min beet le beet fi hille waahide.
Wa kan tadkhulu fi ayyi hille wa naasha yakhbalooku,aakulu al-akil al-yidayyufuuku beyah
wa achfu al-mardaaniin al-gaa'idiin foogha.Wa guulu leehum-:--Mamlakat Allah garrabat leeku.--
Wa laakin kan tadkhulu fi hille wa naasha ma yakhbalooku,amchu fi chawaari'ha wa guulu-:
--Ajaaj hillitku al-mulassag fi rijleena kula,nihittuuh minnina wa di chahaaditna foogku.Laakin a'arfu adiil kadar mamlakat Allah garrabat.--
Nuguul leeku al-azaab al-yaji foog naas al-hille di fi yoom al-Hisaab yabga ziyaada min al-azaab al-yaji foog naas hillit Saduum.
Al-azaab yarjaaki,ya hillit Kuuraziin.Al-azaab yarjaaki,ya hillit Beet Seeda.Kan awwal naadum sawwa al-ajaayib dool fi mudun al-kuffaar Suur wa Seeda,naashum yutuubu min zunuubhum min zamaan wa yalbaso khulgaan al-hizin wa yagoodu fi rumaad wa yutuubu.
Aywa,al-azaab al-yaji foog naasku fi yoom al-Hisaab yabga ziyaada min al-azaab al-yaji foog naas Suur wa Seeda.
Wa inti hillit Kafar Naahuum,fi fikirki tarfa'e raaski lahaddi l-sama walla-?Be l-aks,tinrami fi l-haawiye-!
Wa Isa gaal le l-talaamiiz-:-Ayyi naadum al-simi' kalaamku,simi' kalaami.Wa l-abaaku,abaani.Wa l-abaani,aba Allah al-rassalaani.
Wa l-talaamiiz al-sab'iin wa tineen al-Isa rassalaahum gabbalo leyah farhaaniin bilheen.Wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna-!Al-chawaatiin zaathum yasma'o kalaamna kan amarnaahum be usmak inta.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Aywa,wakit intu gaa'idiin fi l-khidme di,ana chift Ibliis waga' ajala misil soot yaga' min al-sama.
Ana anteetku gudra achaan tifajjukhu al-dabiib wa l-agaarib.Wa anteetku gudra lahaddi tinnasru fi kulla gudrat Ibliis al-adu.Ma fi cheyy al-yita''ibku.
Sahiih,al-chawaatiin sim'o kalaamku laakin ma tafraho be l-kalaam da.Akheer tafraho kadar Allah sajjal asaameeku fi kitaabah fi l-sama.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Isa malaan be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa farhaan bilheen wa gaal-:-Chukran,ya abuuyi Rabb al-samaawaat wa l-ard,achaan inta labbadt kalaamak da min al-hakiimiin wa min al-ulama wa wassaftah le l-naas al-juhhaal marra waahid.Aywa,ya abuuyi,achaan da bas al-cheyy al-inta raadi beyah.
Abuuyi Allah wakkalaani be kulla cheyy.Ma fi naadum al-ya'arif Ibn Allah.Illa abuuh ya'arfah.Wa ma fi naadum al-ya'arif Allah illa Ibn Allah wa l-naadum al-Ibn Allah yidoor yiwassif leyah abuuh.
Wa anlafat le talaamiizah wa hajja leehum wiheedhum wa gaal-:-Mabruuk leeku fi chaan al-cheyy al-intu tichiifuuh.
Achaan nuguul leeku naas katiiriin min al-anbiya wa l-muluuk dawwaro bilheen yichiifu al-cheyy al-intu gaa'idiin tichiifuuh,laakin ma chaafooh.Wa dawwaro yasma'o al-kalaam al-intu gaa'idiin tasma'ooh wa ma sim'ooh.
Wa naadum waahid aalim fi l-Tawraat gamma achaan yijarrib Isa wa gaal-:-Ya l-mu'allim,chunu al-cheyy al-waajib nisawwiih le nawris al-haya al-abadiiye-?
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Chunu al-maktuub fi l-Tawraat-?Gareet foogah chunu-?
Wa l-aalim radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-Kitaab yuguul-:﴾‍Waajib tihibb Allah Rabbak be kulla galbak wa be kulla nafsak wa be kulla gudurtak wa be kulla fikrak‍﴿wa battaan-:﴾‍Hibb akhuuk misil tihibb nafsak.‍﴿
Wa Isa gaal-:-Kalaamak sahiih.Sawwi misil gultah wa talga al-haya.
Wa laakin al-aalim dawwar yiwassif kadar hu indah hagg wa gaal leyah-:-Yaatu min al-naas akhuuyi-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naadum waahid maachi min Madiinat al-Khudus le hillit Ariiha.Wa tawwaali,rabbaatiin al-duruub gammo hajamooh.Daggooh wa sallabooh wa faato.Wa khallooh majruuh ambeen al-haya wa l-moot.
Wa ba'adeen fi naadum waahid maachi fi l-derib da wa hu raajil diin.Wa wakit hu chaaf al-naadum al-ta'baan,hu baaraah wa faat giddaam.
Wa naadum aakhar ja wa hu min al-Laawiyiin al-yakhdumu fi beet Allah.Hu ja fi l-bakaan da wa chaaf al-ta'baan wa hu kula baaraah wa faat giddaam.
Laakin musaafir waahid ja fi l-bakaan al-naadum gaa'id foogah da wa hu min al-Saamiriyiin.Wa l-ajnabi da chaafah wa hanna foogah.
Wa macha leyah wa sabba dihin wa khamar fi awaawiirah wa rabataahum wa rakkabah fi humaarah.Wa waddaah fi beet hana diifaan wa rayyasah.
Wa ambaakir,hu marag gurus min juzlaanah wa antaah le siid al-beet wa gaal leyah-:--Rayyisah wa kan khisirt ziyaada,nantiik wakit nigabbil leek.-
Wa Isa sa'al al-aalim wa gaal-:-Min al-naas al-talaata dool,yaatu al-sawwa nafsah akhu le l-naadum al-hajamooh rabbaatiin al-duruub-?
Wa l-aalim radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-naadum al-sawwa leyah al-rahma. Wa khalaas Isa gaal leyah-:-Gumm sawwi nafs al-cheyy mislah.
Wa Isa wa jamaa'tah maachiin giddaam wa dakhalo fi hille waahide.Wa fi mara usumha Marsa wa hi faddalathum fi beetha.
Wa indaha akhut usumha Mariyam.Wa Mariyam ga'adat gariib le l-Rabb Isa achaan tasma' ta'liimah.
Laakin Marsa gaa'ide takhdim leehum wa hi machkhuula bilheen wa ma tagdar tasma' kalaamah.Wa machat le Isa wa gaalat-:-Ya sayyidna,akhti di khallatni nisawwi kulla l-khidme di wiheedi.Da adiil walla-?Khalaas,guul leeha khalli ti'aawinni-!
Laakin al-Rabb Isa radda leeha wa gaal-:-Marsa,ya Marsa.Inti di,galibki mu'allag wa inti tihimmi le chakhala katiire.
Cheyy waahid bas waajib wa Mariyam azalat al-cheyy al-adiil.Wa ma yinrafi' minha.
Wa Isa gaa'id yisalli fi bakaan waahid.Wa wakit hu kammal salaatah,waahid min talaamiizah hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,allimna nisallu misil Yahya allam talaamiizah yisallu.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Wakit tisallu,guulu-:--Ya Abuuna,khalli ya'arfu kadar usmak khudduus.Khalli mamlakatak taji.
Antiina al-akilal-yitimmina kulla yoom.
Saamih leena zunuubnamisil aniina gaa'idiin nisaamuhukulla l-naas al-khito foogna.Ma tidissina fi l-tajriba.-
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:-Nas'alku cheyy waahid.Kan naadum minku indah rafiig wa hu yamchi leyah fi ust al-leel,yinaadiih wa yuguul-:--Ya akhuuyi,antiini talaata khubza.
Nidoorhum achaan rafiig waahid musaafir jaani wa ma indi cheyy nidayyifah beyah.--
Hal akhuuk al-sa'altah da yurudd leek min daakhal wa yuguul-:--Khalliini nunuum-!Al-baab masduud wa iyaali ma'aayi naaymiin.Ma nagdar nugumm leek wa la nantiik cheyy.- Da yabga walla-?
Wa nuguul leeku kan akhuuk da ma yidoor yugumm yantiik cheyy fi chaan inta rafiigah kula,akiid hu yugumm yantiik kulla cheyy al-tidoorah fi chaan inta bachtantah.
Wa nuguul leeku as'alo Allah wa hu yantiiku.Fattuchu wa talgo.Duggu baab Allah wa yinfatih leeku.
Achaan kulla naadum al-yas'al da,Allah yantiih.Wa ayyi naadum al-yifattich,yalga.Wa ayyi naadum al-yudugg baab Allah,al-baab yinfatih leyah.
Wa kan naadum minku abu iyaal wa wileedah yatlub minnah huutaay,yantiih daabi fi badal al-huutaay walla-?
Walla kan yatlub minnah beed jidaad,yantiih agrab walla-?Abadan.
Intu al-muznibiin kula ta'arfu kikkeef tantu chokhol sameh le iyaalku.Wa laakin abuuku Allah akheer ziyaada minku.Wa hu yanti al-Ruuh al-Khudduus le l-naas al-yas'alooh.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa yidoor yatrud cheetaan min naadum waahid al-bigi abkam be sabab al-cheetaan da.Wa l-cheetaan marag wa l-abkam hajja.Wa kulla l-naas al'ajjabo bilheen.
Laakin naas waahidiin gaalo-:-Al-naadum da yatrud al-chawaatiin be gudrat Ibliis kabiir al-chawaatiin.
Wa naas aakhariin dawwaro yijarrubuuh wa talabo minnah yantiihum daliil al-yiwassif kadar gudurtah di jaaye min al-sama.
Wa hu irif fikirhum wa gaal leehum-:-Ayyi mamlaka kan naasha yiddaawaso ambeenaathum takhrab.Wa buyuutha yidaffugu al-waahid fi l-aakhar.
Wa tuguulu ana natrud al-chawaatiin be gudrat Ibliis.Wa laakin kan Ibliis yidaawis nafsah,kikkeef mamlakatah tagdar tagood saabte-?
Wa kan sahiih ana gaa'id natrud al-chawaatiin be gudrat Ibliis,naasku yaturduuhum be gudrat yaatu-?Wa misil da,naasku bas al-yisabbutu foogku al-tuhma.
Wa kan ana taradt al-chawaatiin be gudrat Allah zaatah,khalaas mamlakat Allah gaabalatku.
Kan raajil gawi gaa'id yahris gasrah be silaahah kulla ke,misil da kulla khumaamah gaa'id be l-salaam.
Laakin kan naadum gawi minnah yaji yahjimah,hu yakhlibah wa yichiil minnah silaahah al-awwal kulla achamah gaa'id foogah.Wa khalaas yigassim al-khumaam le jamaa'tah.
Ayyi naadum al-ma ma'aayi,aduuyi.Wa ayyi naadum al-ma yilimm al-naas ma'aayi,yichattithum.
Wa Isa gaal battaan-:-Wakit cheetaan yamrug min naadum muchootin,al-cheetaan da yamchi misil naadum muwaddir fi l-sahara.Wa yifattich bakaan yinjamma foogah wa ma yalgaah.Wa yuguul-:--Khalaas,nigabbil fi l-beet al-maragt minnah.--
Wa yigabbil le l-naadum da wa yalgaah misil beet nadiif wa mufarrach.
Wa l-cheetaan yamchi yijiib ma'aayah sab'a chawaatiin fasliin minnah ziyaada wa kulluhum yindasso wa yaskunu fi l-naadum da wa khalaas,haalit al-naadum da tabga hawaane min awwal.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id yihajji le l-naas,mara waahide fi usuthum naadat wa gaalat-:-Mabruuk le l-mara al-wildatak wa rabbatak.
Laakin Isa gaal-:-Akheer tuguuli mabruuk le l-naas al-yasma'o kalaam Allah wa yitaabu'uuh.
Wa adad al-naas al-yidooru yasma'o kalaam Isa gaa'id yiziid.Wa hu bada yuguul-:-Naas al-wakit da fasliin wa yatulbu minni daliil achaan yi'aamunu beyi.Wa Allah ma yantiihum daliil illa l-daliil hana l-nabi Yuunus.
Misil Yuunus bigi alaama le naas madiinat Niinawa,ana Ibn al-Insaan kula nabga alaama le l-naas al-fi wakitna da.
Wa fi yoom al-Hisaab,malikat al-watitugumm sawa ma'a l-naas al-fi wakitna da.Wa hi tisabbit fooghum al-tuhma achaan jaat min aakhir al-ard le tasma' kalaam al-malik Suleymaan al-hakiim.Wa l-yihajji leeku hassa' akbar min Suleymaan wa laakin intu ma tubtu.
Fi yoom al-Hisaab,naas Niinawa yugummu sawa ma'a l-naas al-fi wakitna da wa yisabbutu fooghum tuhma achaan naas Niinawa taabo min zunuubhum wakit Yuunus ballakh leehum kalaam Allah.Wa l-yihajji leeku hassa' akbar min Yuunus wa laakin intu ma tubtu.
Wa ma fi naadum al-yi'oogid faanuus wa yilabbidah walla yikhattiih be maa'uun.Hu yukhuttah fi bakaan foog achaan al-naas al-yadkhulu fi l-beet yichiifu al-deyy.
Wa l-een hi misil faanuus jildak.Kan eenak taybe,kulla jildak gaa'id fi l-nuur.Wa laakin kan eenak talfaane,jildak yinmali dalaam.
Achaan da,khutt baalak.Ma tikhalli al-nuur al-indak yabga adlam.
Kan kulla jildak anmala nuur wa ma indah dalaam fi ayyi bakaan,yabga leek misil faanuus yidawwi deyy tamaam.
Wa wakit Isa kammal al-kalaam da,Fariizi waahid azamah achaan yaakul fi beetah.Wa Isa macha fi beetah wa ga'ad le l-akil.
Wa Isa ma khassal iideenah le yabgo taahiriin gubbaal ma yaakul wa l-Fariizi chaafah wa al'ajjab minnah bilheen.
Wa l-Rabb Isa gaal leyah-:-Intu al-Fariiziyiin wakit tilwaddo,da yabga misil tikhassulu al-kaas wa l-sufra min barra bas.Laakin fi guluubku daakhal intu malaaniin min al-sirge wa l-fasaala.
Ya l-juhhaal,intu ma ta'arfu kadar Allah al-khalag al-nuss al-barraani khalag al-nuss al-dakhlaani kula-?
Antu al-khumaam al-gaa'id daakhal fi sufritku wa khalli yabga sadakha le l-masaakiin wa kulla cheyy yabga leeku taahir.
Ya l-Fariiziyiin,al-azaab yarjaaku achaan intu munkaribiin fi l-uchur lahaddi tantu le Allah min al-na'naa' wa l-kammuun wa ayyi nabaat hana l-haraar al-yugumm fi hoochku.Wa laakin intu nisiitu al-adaala wa mahabbat Allah-!Awwal cheyy,waajib tisawwu al-achya al-muhimmiin dool wa battaan ma tanso kalaam al-uchur.
Ya l-Fariiziyiin,al-azaab yarjaaku achaan tiriidu tagoodu fi l-saff al-awwal fi buyuut al-sala wa intu farhaaniin kan al-naas yisallumuuku be ihtiraam fi l-suug.
Al-azaab yarjaaku achaan intu misil al-khubuur al-ma induhum wasim wa l-naas raaykhiin fooghum wa ma ya'arfu kadar humman khubuur.Al-najaasa al-gaa'ide fiiku daakhal al-naas ma ya'arfuuha.
Wa waahid min ulama al-Tawraat radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid,be kalaamak da ayyartina aniina kula.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Al-azaab yarjaaku intu al-ulama kula-!Be ta'liimku tisawwu al-diin tagiil le l-naas lahaddi bufuut raashum wa abadan ma tidooru ti'aawunuuhum hatta be cheyy sakhayyar kula.
Al-azaab yarjaaku achaan intu gaa'idiin tabnu khubuur al-anbiya al-juduudku aboohum wa kataloohum.
Wa misil da,intu gaa'idiin tachhado kadar tikhassudu be l-cheyy al-juduudku sawwooh.Aywa,achaan humman bas al-kataloohum wa intu bas al-tabnu khubuurhum.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah wassaf hikmatah wakit gaal-:--Nirassil leehum anbiya wa rusul.Waahidiin minhum yaktuluuhum wa waahidiin minhum yita''ubuuhum.--
Wa khalaas kulla l-anbiya al-kataloohum fi ayyi zaman,dimmithum taji fi raas hana l-naas al-fi wakitna da.
Aywa,nuguul leeku min dimmit Haabiil wileed Adamlahaddi dimmit Zakariiyaal-katalooh been beet Allah wa l-madbah,dimmithum kulluhum taji fi raas al-naas al-fi wakitna da.
Ya intu al-ulama,al-azaab yarjaaku achaan chiltu muftaah al-ilim.Intu zaatku ma andasseetu wa battaan al-naas al-yidooru yindasso,intu dahartuuhum minnah.
Wakit Isa gamma macha min hinaak,al-ulama wa l-Fariiziyiin bado yikhaalufuuh be chidde wa yas'alooh su'aal katiir
achaan yalgo fursa le yakurbuuh be kalaamah al-yuguulah.
Wa adad al-naas al-jaayiin le Isa zaad bilheen wa bigo acharaat al-aalaaf lahaddi gaa'idiin yil'aasaro.Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah awwal wa gaal-:-Angar'u min tawwaarit al-Fariiziyiin achaan ma tabgo misilhum.Al-nifaakh gaa'id fooghum misil al-tawwaara gaa'ide fi l-khubza.
Wa ma fi cheyy mulabbad al-ba'adeen ma yinkachif wa ma fi sirr al-ba'adeen ma yin'arif.
Achaan da,ayyi kalaam al-gultuuh fi l-leel,yinsami' fi l-nahaar.Wa l-kalaam al-hajjeetuuh be achiir daakhal fi l-beet,yiballukhuuh barra fi l-chawaari'.
Ya rufgaani,ni'ooriiku ma takhaafo min al-naas al-yagdaro yaktuluuku wa laakin ma yagdaro yisawwu leeku ziyaada min da.
Ni'ooriiku yaatu al-waajib takhaafo minnah.Akhaafo min Allah.Hu yagdar yaktulku wa battaan indah gudra achaan yarmiiku fi Jahannam.Aywa,hu bas al-waajib takhaafo minnah.
Ta'arfu kadar yibii'u khamsa tuyuur dugaag be riyaaleen.Wa laakin nuguul leeku kadar Allah ma yansa ayyi waahid minhum.
Wa intu kula,Allah gaa'id yifakkir foogku wa ya'arif adad suuf raasku.Ayyi waahid minku muhimm ziyaada le Allah min tuyuur katiiriin.Wa khalaas,ma takhaafo min al-naas.
Wa ana,Ibn al-Insaan,nuguul leeku kadar ayyi naadum al-yachhad leyi giddaam al-naas,ana nachhad leyah giddaam malaa'ikat Allah.
Wa laakin ayyi naadum al-yankurni giddaam al-naas,ana kula nankurah giddaam malaa'ikat Allah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yuguul kalaam didd Ibn al-Insaan,Allah yakhfir leyah.Wa laakin Allah ma yakhfir le l-naadum al-yihajji kalaam kufur fi l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa wakit yakurbuuku wa yiwadduuku giddaam masaa'iil buyuut al-sala wa giddaam al-kubaaraat wa l-hukkaam,ma tihimmu le l-kalaam al-tuguuluuh wa la kikkeef turuddu leehum.
Achaan fi l-wakit daak,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yi'allimku al-kalaam al-waajib tuguuluuh.
Wa naadum waahid fi ust al-naas al-maachiin wara Isa naadaah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,ajburah le akhuuyi achaan yigassim ma'aayi warasatna.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya raajil-!Fi fikrak Allah ja'alaani foogku achaan nagta' leeku al-charii'a wa nifarrigku walla-?
Wa Isa hajja le l-naas wa gaal-:-Angar'u wa aw'u baalku min ayyi cheyy hana tama'.Achaan hayaat al-insaan ma tamchi hasab katarat maalah.
Wa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naadum khani wa ziraa'tah wildat leyah khalla katiire bilheen.
Wa sa'al nafsah wa gaal-:--Ha.Nisawwi chunu-?Ma faddal leyi bakaan nakhzin foogah khalliti.--
Wa gaal-:--Khalaas.Na'arif al-cheyy al-nisawwiih.Nikassir dabangaati wa nisawwi fi badalhum dabangaat kubaar minhum.Wa fooghum nusubb kulla khalliti wa kulla khumaami.
Wa nihajji le nafsi wa nuguul-:"Ya nafsi-!Indiki maal katiir madmuum al-yitawwil siniin.Ninjamma bas wa naakul wa nachrab wa nafrah."--
Wa laakin Allah naadaah wa gaal-:--Ya l-jaahil-!Fi l-leele di bas,nichiil ruuhak.Wa l-khumaam al-jahhaztah le nafsak da,yabga hana yaatu-?-
Wa Isa gaal battaan-:-Wa yabga misil da le ayyi insaan al-yudumm maal le nafsah wa laakin ma indah kanz giddaam Allah.
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Fi chaan da,nuguul leeku ma tihimmu le hayaatku fi chaan al-akil wa la le jisimku fi chaan al-khulgaan.
Achaan al-haya muhimme min al-akil wa l-jisim muhimm min al-khulgaan.
Fakkuru fi l-khuraab.Hu ma yiteerib wa la yagta' khalla wa ma indah dabanga wa la makhazan wa laakin Allah yi'ayyichah.Wa akiid intu muhimmiin le Allah ziyaada min al-tuyuur.
Wa kan naadum minku yihimm katiir,al-hamm da ma yagdar yiziid umrah be saa'a waahide kula.
Wa kan intu ma tagdaro tisawwu cheyy sakhayyar misil da,maala tihimmu le cheyy aakhar-?
Chiifu al-nuwwaar wa fakkuru kikkeef yugumm.Ma yakhdim wa ma yisawwi kiswe.Wa laakin nuguul leeku akiid al-malik Suleymaan zaatah fi darajatah al-kabiire abadan ma libis khalag jamiil misil jamaal al-nuwwaar da.
Wa kan Allah yilabbis al-gechch be l-nuwwaar misil da wa l-gechch da gaa'id al-yoom wa ambaakir yazguluuh fi naar al-furun,akiid be ziyaada hu yilabbisku intu.Chiddu heelku intu al-iimaanku lissaa' da'iif.
Wa be misil da,ma tas'alo nufuusku fi l-cheyy al-taakuluuh wa tacharbooh wa ma tihimmu leyah.
Kulla l-naas al-ma mu'miniin khaattiin baalhum fi l-achya dool wa abuuku Allah ya'arif kadar intu tidooruuhum.
Wa khalaas,khuttu baalku fi mamlakat Allah bas wa Allah yantiiku al-achya dool.
Ya khineemaati,ma takhaafo.Abuuku Allah indah niiye yantiiku al-mamlaka.
Bii'u khumaamku wa antuuh sadakha le l-masaakiin.Wa be da,tisawwu le nufuusku juzlaan al-abadan ma yatlaf.Wa khalaas,tudummu maalku fi bakaan Allah fi l-samaawaat.Al-maal da ma yafchul.Wa l-saraariig ma yigarrubu leyah wa l-arda ma taakulah.
Achaan al-bakaan al-maalak gaa'id foogah,da bas al-bakaan al-galbak gaa'id foogah.
Agoodu jaahiziin le l-khidme salabaaku marbuutiin wa fawaaniisku muwalli'iin.
Abgo misil abiid fi beet siidhum al-gaa'idiin yarjooh.Siidhum yigabbil min aazuumit al-iris.Wa humman yagoodu jaahiziin achaan yufukku leyah al-derib be sur'a wakit hu yaji yudugg al-baab.
Mabruuk le l-abiid al-siidhum yalgaahum waa'iyiin wakit hu yaji.Nuguul leeku al-hagg,siidhum zaatah yarbut sulbah wa yiga''idhum giddaam al-sufra wa yantiihum al-akil.
Mabruuk le l-abiid dool kan siidhum yaji fi lubb al-leel walla be waradde wa yalgaahum jaahiziin.
Wa be masal aakhar,a'arfu kadar kan awwal siid al-beet irif fi l-saa'a kam fi l-leel al-sarraag yaji,hu ma yikhalli al-sarraag yadkhul fi beetah.
Wa khalaas intu kula agoodu jaahiziin achaan ana Ibn al-Insaan nigabbil fi yoom waahid al-ma tarjooni foogah.
Wa Butrus sa'alah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna-!Inta gult al-masal da leena aniina bas walla le kulla l-naas-?
Wa l-Rabb Isa gaal-:-Yaatu minku al-yabga misil al-wakiil al-amiin wa l-faahim-?Siidah yikallifah fi kulla abiidah achaan yantiihum al-akil fi waktah.
Mabruuk le l-abid da kan siidah yaji min al-safar wa yalgaah yakhdim khidimtah.
Be l-sahiih,nuguul leeku hu yidarrij al-abid da mas'uul fi kulla cheyy al-indah.
Wa laakin akuun al-abid da yuguul fi galbah-:--Ha-!Siidi yitawwil wa ma yaji ajala.- Wa achaan da,hu yugumm yudugg al-abiid wa l-khadiim wa yabda yaakul wa yachrab wa yaskar.
Akiid siid al-abid da yaji fi yoom waahid al-abid ma jaahiz yilaagiih wa fi saa'a al-hu ma ya'arifha.Wa siidah yi'aakhibah wa yukhuttah ma'a l-aasiyiin.
Wa l-abid al-irif al-cheyy al-siidah yidoorah wa ma jaahiz le jaytah wa ma sawwa al-cheyy al-siidah yidoorah,al-abid da yafurchuuh farich chadiid.
Wa laakin al-abid al-ma irif al-cheyy al-siidah yidoorah,wa sawwa cheyy al-waajib yafurchuuh be sababah,al-abid da yafurchuuh chiyya bas.Wa ayyi naadum al-ligi katiir,yatulbu minnah katiir.Wa ayyi naadum al-kallafooh be cheyy ziyaada,yatulbu minnah ziyaada.
Ana jiit achaan nusubb naar fi l-ard wa nitmanna bilheen kadar al-naar di oogadooha khalaas.
Wa fi khattisiin chadiid al-waajib yikhattusuuni beyah wa galbi mu'allag bilheen lahaddi l-khattisiin da yitimm.
Wa fi fikirku ana jiit achaan nijiib al-salaam fi l-ard walla-?La,ma ke.Nuguul leeku ana jibt al-furga.
Achaan min al-yoom wa giddaam,al-beet al-indah khamsa naas,al-talaata yikhaalufu al-itneen wa l-itneen yikhaalufu al-talaata.
Yilkhaalafo ambeenaathum.Al-raajil yikhaalif wileedah wa l-wileed yikhaalif abuuh wa l-mara tikhaalif bineeyitha wa l-bineeye tikhaalif ammaha.Wa amm al-raajil tikhaalif marit wileedha wa l-mara tikhaalif amm raajilha.
Wa Isa hajja battaan le l-naas al-katiiriin al-jo leyah wa gaal-:-Kan tichiifu al-sahaab jaayi min al-kharib,ajala ke tuguulu almi yusubb wa khalaas almi yusubb.
Wa kan tichiifu al-riih tusuug min al-wati,tuguulu al-wata tabga haamiye bilheen wa khalaas al-wata tabga haamiye.
Ya munaafikhiin-!Ta'arfu kikkeef tafhamo alaamaat hana l-ard wa l-sama.Wa kikkeef ma tagdaro tafhamo alaamaat al-zaman al-haadir-?
Maala ma tagdaro timayyuzu al-cheyy al-waajib tisawwuuh-?
Kan intu maachiin fi bakaan al-gaadi,jaahid achaan tissaamaho ma'a khasiimak wakit intu lissaa' fi l-derib.Wa da kan ma tidoor hu yusuugak le l-gaadi wa l-gaadi yisallimak le l-askar wa l-askar yidissuuk fi l-sijin.
Nuguul leek inta ma tamrug illa kan kaffeet kulla l-gurus al-yidooruuh minnak.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,naas waahidiin jo le Isa wa oorooh be khabar al-naas min daar al-Jaliil.Al-naas dool,Bilaatus katalaahum fi beet Allah wa khalbat dammuhum ma'a damm dahaayaahum.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Be sabab moothum al-cheen da,fi fikirku al-Jaliiliyiin dool muznibiin ziyaada min al-naas al-aakhariin al-min daar al-Jaliil walla-?
Nuguul leeku la.Wa kan intu ma tutuubu min zunuubku,kulluku tahlako misilhum.
Wa simi'tu khabar hana l-naas al-tamaantaachar al-gasir Silwaam waga' fooghum wa katalaahum.Wa fi fikirku,humman khaatiyiin ziyaada min kulla l-naas al-aakhariin al-saakniin fi Madiinat al-Khudus walla-?
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:-Naadum waahid indah jineene hana inab wa chadarat tiinkula gaa'ide foogha.Wa macha leeha wa fattach foogha tiin wa ma ligi cheyy.
Wa hajja le l-khaddaam al-mas'uul fi l-jineene wa gaal-:--Chiif-!Min talaata sana ana gaa'id naji nifattich iyaal min al-chadara di wa ma ligiit foogha cheyy.Maala nikhalliiha tafsid al-turaab-?Agta'ha-!--
Wa l-khaddaam radda leyah wa gaal-:--Ya sayyidi-!Khalliiha tagood sana waahide battaan.Wa ana nahfir al-turaab al-jaay wa jaay leeha wa niziid leeha ba'ar.
Akuun fi l-sana al-jaaye talda iyaal.Wa kan ma wildat,khalaas agta'ha.-
Yoom al-sabt Isa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi beet al-sala.
Wa fi mara waahide ta'baane.Cheetaan waahid darabaaha wa min 18 sana,daharha mukanjar wa ma tagdar tin'adil.
Wa Isa chaafaaha wa naadaaha.Wa gaal leeha-:-Ya mara zeene.Khalaas,ligiiti al-aafe.Inti ma marbuuta battaan.
Wa khatta iideenah foogha wa ajala ke hi mattatat daharha adiil wa chakarat Allah.
Laakin mas'uul hana beet al-sala zi'il achaan Isa chafaaha fi yoom al-sabt.Wa hajja le l-naas wa gaal-:-Fi l-usbuu' induku sitte ayyaam le l-khidme.Khalli taju fi l-ayyaam dool achaan talgo al-aafe laakin ma fi yoom al-sabt.
Wa l-Rabb Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya l-munaafikhiin-!Fi yoom al-sabt,akiid ayyi naadum minku yihill toorah walla humaarah min chaaytah wa yiwaddiih le yazgiih almi.
Wa l-mara di,hi min awlaad Ibraahiim wa l-Cheetaan rabatha.Wa min 18 sana hi marbuuta.Wa kikkeef ma waajib nihillaha min rubaatha fi yoom al-sabt-?
Wa be kalaamah da,al-eeb dakhal le kulla l-naas al-dawwaro yadharooh.Wa kulla l-naas firho be kulla l-amal al-majiid al-Isa gaa'id yisawwiih.
Wa battaan Isa gaal-:-Mamlakat Allah hi kikkeef-?Hi tichaabih chunu-?
Hi sakhayre misil habbit al-khardal.Wa raajil waahid chaalha wa teerabaaha fi jineentah.Wa hi bazarat wa bigat kabiire misil chadara.Wa tuyuur al-sama jo wa bano uchuuchhum fi furuu'ha.
Wa battaan Isa gaal-:-Nuguul mamlakat Allah tichaabih misil chunu-?
Mamlakat Allah tichaabih misil al-tawwaara.Wa mara waahide chaalatha wa sabbatha daakhal fi lubb talaata kooro hana dagiig.Wa ba'adeen al-tawwaara gawwamat al-ajiine kullaha ke.
Wa wakit Isa musaafir le Madiinat al-Khudus,gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi l-mudun wa l-hillaal al-fi derbah.
Wa naadum waahid sa'alah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,al-naas al-yanjo chiyya walla-?-Wa Isa hajja le l-naas wa gaal-:
Jaahudu le tadkhulu be derib al-dayyig achaan nuguul leeku ba'adeen naas katiiriin yidooru yadkhulu wa ma yagdaro.
Kan siid al-beet gamma sadda al-derib wa intu waagfiin barra,tugummu tuduggu al-baab wa tuguulu-:--Sayyidna,aftah leena.- Wa hu yurudd leeku wa yuguul-:--Ma na'arifku.Intu ke min ween-?--
Wa fi l-bakaan da,intu tuguulu-:--Aniina akalna wa chiribna ma'aak.Wa inta allamt al-naas fi chawaari'na.--
Laakin hu yuguul-:--Nuguul leeku ma na'arif intu yaatumman.Yalla kissu minni ba'iid,intu al-fasliin-!--
Wa fi l-bakaan da,tabku wa ti'addu sunuunku min al-nadaama achaan tichiifu Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub wa kulla l-anbiya yadkhulu fi mamlakat Allah wa intu kamaan matruudiin minha.
Wa l-naas yaju min sabaah wa kharib wa min munchaakh wa wati wa yadkhulu yil'achcho fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa khalaas al-naas al-wara yabgo giddaam wa l-naas al-giddaam yabgo wara.
Wa fi l-wakit da,naas waahidiin min al-Fariiziyiin jo le Isa wa gaalo-:-Yalla,amchi min al-bakaan da.Hiruudus yidoor yaktulak tara-!
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Amchu le l-ba'achoom da wa guulu leyah-:--Asma'.Al-yoom ana natrud al-chawaatiin wa nachfi al-mardaaniin wa ambaakir nisawwi nafs al-cheyy.Fi l-yoom al-taalit hatta nikammil khidimti.--
Aywa,al-yoom wa ambaakir wa ambukra waajib namchi giddaam achaan ma waajib le ayyi nabi yumuut,illa fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Ya Madiinat al-Khudus-!Ya Madiinat al-Khudus-!Ya kattaaliin al-anbiya-!Intu al-tarjumu al-naas al-Allah yirassilhum leeku.Kam marra dawwart nilimm iyaalku misil al-jidaade tilimm iyaalha tihit janaaheeha.Laakin intu abeetu.
Chiifu yikhallu beetku yaabis.Wa khalaas nuguul leeku ma tichiifuuni battaan lahaddi tuguulu-:﴾‍Mabruuk le l-naadum al-jaayi be usum Allah.‍﴿
Wa yoom waahid,naadum min kubaaraat al-Fariiziyiin azam Isa achaan yaakul ma'aayah wa Isa macha leyah fi beetah.Wa da yoom al-sabt wa l-diifaan al-aakhariin khatto baalhum fi Isa achaan yichiifu chunu al-cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Wa hinaak giddaamah fi naadum muwarrim.
Wa Isa sa'al ulama al-Tawraat wa l-Fariiziyiin wa gaal-:-Fi yoom al-sabt,halaal leena nachfu al-mardaaniin walla-?
Wa ma gaalo leyah cheyy.Wa hu karab iid al-mardaan wa chafaah wa khallaah macha.
Wa Isa sa'alaahum battaan wa gaal-:-Kan naadum minku indah wileed walla toor al-waga' fi biir fi yoom al-sabt,yisawwi chunu-?Ma yamurgah ajala walla-?
Wa ma gidro yuruddu leyah fi l-kalaam da.
Wa Isa chaaf kadar ayyi deef dawwar yagood fi l-bakaan al-kubaaraat yagoodu foogah.Wa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:
Kan naadum ya'azimak fi aazuumit al-iris,ma tukhutt nafsak fi bakaan al-kubaaraat.Akuun azamo deef kabiir minnak.
Wa l-naadum al-azamaaku yaji leek wa yuguul-:--Khalli al-raajil da yagood fi bakaanak.- Wa khalaas al-eeb yakurbak wa tugumm tamchi fi l-bakaan al-wara.
Laakin kan ya'azumuuk,amchi agood fi l-bakaan al-wara.Wa fi l-haala di,wakit siid al-beet yaji leek,hu yuguul-:--Ya rafiigi,ta'aal giddaam.- Wa misil da hu yicharrifak giddaam kulla l-naas al-ma'aak fi l-aazuuma.
Achaan ayyi naadum al-yisawwi nafsah kabiir,Allah yisawwiih sakhayyar.Wa l-naadum al-yisawwi nafsah sakhayyar,Allah yisawwiih kabiir.
Wa Isa hajja le l-naadum al-azamah fi beetah wa gaal-:-Kan tisawwi aazuuma walla hafla,ma ta'azim rufgaanak wa la akhwaanak wa la naas gabiiltak wa la jiiraanak siyaad al-maal.Achaan kan ta'azim al-naas dool,akuun humman ya'azumuuk fi aazuumithum wa da bas yabga leek ajrak.
Laakin wakit tisawwi aazuuma,a'azim al-masaakiin wa l-ma'duuriin wa l-uruj wa l-amyaaniin achaan yaakulu ma'aak.
Wa Allah yibaarikak achaan humman ma yagdaro yigabbulu leek cheyy.Wa Allah yi'aajirak wakit bu'aas al-saalihiin.
Wa naadum waahid al-gaa'id yaakul ma'aayah simi' al-kalaam da wa hajja le Isa wa gaal-:-Mabruuk le l-naas al-yil'achcho fi aazuuma hana mamlakat Allah-!
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naadum waahid sawwa aazuuma kabiire bilheen wa azam foogha naas katiiriin.
Wa wakit al-aazuuma tamma,hu rassal abdah le l-naas al-ma'zuumiin achaan yuguul-:--Khalaas,ta'aalu-!Kulla cheyy jaahiz leeku.--
Wa laakin kulluhum talabo minnah yisaamihhum achaan ma yaju.Al-naadum al-awwal gaal-:--Hassa' bas bi't zere' wa waajib namchi nichiifah.Natlub minnak tisaamihni.Ana ma naji.--
Wa naadum aakhar gaal-:--Ana bi't achara tiiraan achaan yakhdumu be harraataati wa ana maachi nijarribhum.Achaan da,natlub minnak tisaamihni.Ana ma naji.--
Wa naadum aakhar gaal-:--Akhadt mara wa achaan da ma nagdar naji.--
Wa l-abid gabbal le siidah wa ooraah be kalaamhum.Wa siid al-beet da zi'il za'al chadiid wa gaal le abdah-:--Yalla,amchi ajala ajala fi chawaari' al-madiina wa fi kulla duruubha wa jiib fi beeti al-masaakiin wa l-ma'duuriin wa l-amyaaniin wa l-uruj.--
Wa ba'ad chiyya,al-abid gaal leyah-:--Ya siidi,ana sawweet misil inta amartini beyah wa l-bakaan lissaa' faddal.--
Wa siidah radda leyah wa gaal-:--Amchi barra min al-madiina fi duruub al-kadaade wa a'asirhum le l-naas achaan yaju fi l-aazuuma lahaddi beeti yinmali.
Wa nuguul leeku ma fi naadum waahid min al-naas al-awwal azamtuhum yaakul cheyy min aazuumti.-
Wa naas katiiriin bilheen maachiin ma'a Isa.Wa hu anlafat leehum wa gaal-:
Kan naadum yidoor yabga tilmiizi,waajib yiriidni ziyaada min abuuh wa ammah wa martah wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah wa akhwaatah.Waajib yiriidni ziyaada min nafsah kula.
Wa kan naadum aba ma yilhammal ta'ab al-saliib wa ma yitaabi'ni le l-moot,ma yagdar yabga tilmiizi.
Kan naadum minku yidoor yabni gasir,yisawwi chunu-?Awwal cheyy,hu yagood tihit wa yisawwi al-hisaab achaan ya'arif kan indah gurus al-waajib le yikammil al-buna.
Hu ma yidoor yukhutt asaas al-gasir kan ma yagdar yikammilah achaan kulla l-naas al-yichiifuuh,yichchammato leyah.
Yuguulu-:--Al-naadum da bada yabni laakin ma gidir yikammilah.--
Wa kan naadum malik wa yidoor yidaawis malik aakhar,yisawwi chunu-?Awwal cheyy,hu yifakkir adiil.Hu yidoor ya'arif kan be askarah al-achara alif hu yagdar yidaawis al-malik al-indah ichriin alif askar.
Wa kan ma yagdar,hu yirassil naadum achaan yimassilah wakit al-adu lissaa' gaa'id ba'iid achaan yisawwi ma'aayah suluh.
Wa be misil da,kan ayyi naadum minku ma yikhalli minnah kulla cheyy al-indah,hu ma yagdar yabga tilmiizi.
Ta'arfu kadar al-mileh adiil.Laakin kan ta'aamah bigi ma fiih,chunu yigabbilah-?
Al-mileh al-misil da ma indah faayde wa la le l-turaab wa la le l-ba'ar.Wa khalaas,al-naas yidaffuguuh barra.Ayyi naadum al-indah adaan le l-sama',khalli yasma'-!
Wa l-naas al-yilimmu al-miiri wa muznibiin aakhariin jaayiin le Isa achaan yasma'o kalaamah.
Wa l-Fariiziyiin wa l-ulama gammo yihajju ambeenaathum wa yachku minnah wa gaalo-:-Al-naadum da yakhbal al-muznibiin wa yaakul ma'aahum.
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:
Kan raajil minku indah miya khanam wa waddar waahide minhum,hu yisawwi chunu-?Hu yikhalli al-tis'a wa tis'iin fi l-kadaade wa yamchi yifattich al-muwaddire lahaddi yalgaaha.
Wa wakit ligiiha khalaas,hu yukhuttaha fi kataafeeh wa yichiilha be farah.
Wa wakit yaji beetah,hu yinaadi rufgaanah wa jiiraanah wa yuguul leehum-:--Afraho ma'aayi achaan ana ligiit khanamaayti al-muwaddire.--
Wa nuguul leeku yabga misil da fi l-sama kula.Malaa'ikat Allah yafraho be l-muznib al-waahid al-taab min zunuubah ziyaada min yafraho be l-saalihiin al-tis'a wa tis'iin al-ma waajib leehum al-tooba.
Wa mara waahide indaha achara hajar fudda wa kan waddarat waahid minhum,hi tisawwi chunu-?Hi tiwalli' al-faanuus wa tuguchch al-beet wa tifattichah marra waahid lahaddi talgaah.
Wa wakit ligatah khalaas,hi tinaadi rafiigaatha wa jaaraatha wa tuguul leehum-:--Afraho ma'aayi achaan ana ligiit al-hajar fudda al-awwal waddartah.--
Wa nuguul leeku malaa'ikat Allah yafraho be farha misil da kan muznib waahid yutuub min zunuubah.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Fiyah raajil waahid indah awlaad itneen.
Wa yoom waahid,al-sakhayyar gaal le abuuh-:--Ya abuuyi,antiini warasati.- Khalaas abuuh gamma gassam maalah le awlaadah al-itneen.
Wa ba'ad ayyaam,al-wileed al-sakhayyar baa' kulla cheyy al-abu antaah wa saafar ba'iid le balad aakhara.Wa fi l-balad di,bigi faasid wa tallaf kulla gursah.
Wa wakit gursah kammal khalaas,juu' chadiid dakhal fi l-balad di wa l-wileed ma indah cheyy.
Wa macha yakhdim le raajil waahid min al-balad di.Wa l-raajil da chaalah le yirayyis khanaaziirah.
Wa l-wileed ta'baan lahaddi yidoor yaakul akil al-khanaaziir.Wa naadum ma antaah cheyy.
Khalaas gamma yifakkir ke wa gaal-:--Fi beet abuuyi kulla l-khaddaamiin chab'aaniin lahaddi l-akil yifaddil.Wa hini ana mayyit min al-juu'.
Hassa' da,khalli nigabbil fi beet abuuyi wa nuguul leyah-:"Ya abuuyi,ana sawweet khata le Allah wa khata leek inta.
Wa hassa' da,ma waajib battaan taj'alni misil wileedak.Laakin aj'alni misil waahid min khaddaamiinak."--
Wa gamma maachi beet abuuh.Wa wakit al-wileed lissaa' jaayi fi l-derib,abuuh chaafah min ba'iid wa hanna foogah bilheen.Wa jara laagaah wa hadanah wa habbaah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-wileed gaal le abuuh-:--Ya abuuyi,ana sawweet khata le Allah wa khata leek inta.Wa hassa' da,ma waajib battaan taj'alni wileedak.--
Laakin abuuh naada abiidah wa gaal-:--Ajala,jiibu leyah ajmal khalag wa labbusuuh leyah.Wa dissu leyah khaatim fi iidah wa na'aal fi rijileenah.
Wa jiibu al-ijil al-samiin wa adbahooh.Khalli naakulu wa nafraho-!
Aywa,wileedi da,hu awwal ja'altah mayyit wa hassa' hu hayy.Hu waddar wa ana ligiitah.- Wa khalaas gammo yafraho.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-wileed al-kabiir gaa'id yakhdim fi l-zere'.Wakit mugabbil,ja gariib le l-beet wa simi' haraka hana nuggaara.
Wa naada khaddaam waahid wa sa'alah chunu al-kaan.
Wa l-khaddaam radda leyah wa gaal-:--Akhuuk bas gabbal.Wa abuuk dabah leyah al-ijil al-samiin achaan ligi akhuuk tayyib.--
Wa khalaas al-wileed al-kabiir zi'il,ma yidoor yadkhul fi l-beet.Wa abuuh marag leyah wa talab minnah achaan yadkhul.
Laakin hu aba wa gaal le abuuh-:--Asma'.Tawwal ana gaa'id nakhdim leek misil abid.Abadan ana ke ma khaalaft kalaamak.Wa be da kula,inta abadan ma dabaht leyi khanamaay sakhayre achaan nafrah ma'a rufgaani.
Wa laakin wileedak da tallaf kulla gursak ma'a l-charaamiit wa wakit hu ja,inta dabaht leyah al-ijil al-samiin-!--
Wa abuuh gaal leyah-:--Ya wileedi,inta gaa'id ma'aayi daayman.Wa kulla cheyy al-haggi,da hanaak inta.
Laakin waajib nafraho be l-farha di achaan akhuuk da,awwal ja'alnaah mayyit wa daahu hu hayy.Wa awwal hu waddar wa khalaas ligiinaah aafe.-
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah battaan wa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naadum siid al-maal indah wakiil.Wa simi' khabar fi wakiilah yuguulu hu yitallif maalah.
Wa naada al-wakiil wa gaal-:--Da chunu al-simi'tah foogak-?Gabbil leyi makaatiib al-hisaab.Ma nidoor inta tabga battaan wakiili.--
Wa l-wakiil hajja le nafsah wa gaal-:--Nisawwi chunu wakit sayyidi yichiil minni al-wakaala-?Ma nagdar nahrit achaan ma indi gudra.Wa ma nidoor nachhad al-naas achaan al-eeb.
Khalaas na'arif al-cheyy al-nisawwiih al-be sababah al-naas yakhbalooni fi buyuuthum wakit yamrugni min al-wakaala.--
Wa hu naada al-naas al-sayyidah indah fooghum deen wa hajja leehum waahid ba'ad waahid.Wa le l-naadum al-awwal gaal-:--Waajib tikaffi kam le sayyidi-?--
Wa radda leyah wa gaal-:--100 baakha hana dihin.- Wa l-wakiil gaal-:--Chiil al-maktuub wa agood tihit wa ajala aktib 50 baakha.--
Wa ba'ad da,hajja le naadum aakhar wa sa'alah-:--Waajib tikaffi kam-?- Wa hu gaal-:--100 chuwaal hana gameh.- Wa gaal leyah-:--Chiil al-maktuub wa aktib 80 chuwaal.--
Wa wakit siid al-maal irif al-cheyy al-wakiilah al-khaayin sawwaah,hu khassad be najaadtah.Achaan naas hana l-dunya al-dalma di faahimiin ziyaada min naas al-nuur wa ya'arfu kikkeef yalgo al-cheyy al-yidooruuh min al-naas al-misilhum.
Wa nuguul leeku,be maal al-dunya di aksabo le nufuusku rufgaan.Wa misil da wakit maal al-dunya yikammil leeku khalaas,Allah yakhbalku fi maskanah al-abadi.
Akiid,kan naadum amiin wakit hu mas'uul fi cheyy chiyya,hu yukuun amiin battaan wakit hu mas'uul fi cheyy katiir.Wa kan naadum khaayin wakit hu mas'uul fi chiyya,hu yabga khaayin battaan wakit hu mas'uul fi katiir.
Wa kan awwal intu ma amiiniin fi maal hana l-dunya di,kikkeef Allah yikallifku be chokhol indah khiima ziyaada minnah-?
Wa kan awwal intu ma amiiniin fi l-khumaam al-intu wakkalooku foogah,kikkeef Allah yantiiku cheyy al-yabga halaalku-?
Ma fi abid al-yagdar yakhdim le siyaad itneen achaan hu yakrah al-waahid wa yiriid al-taani walla yihibbah le l-awwal be kulla galbah wa yahgir al-aakhar.Wa intu kamaan ma tagdaro tabgo abiid le Allah wa abiid le l-maal.
Al-Fariiziyiin sim'o al-kalaam da wa achchammato le Isa achaan humman yihibbu al-maal.
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Intu tisawwu nufuusku saalihiin giddaam al-naas wa laakin ma tagdaro tukhuchchu Allah wa hu ya'arif guluubku.Aywa,al-cheyy al-naas yachkuruuku foogah da,Allah yaj'alah haraam.
Wa ballakho leeku kalaam Allah fi l-Tawraat wa kutub al-anbiya lahaddi Yahya ja.Wa min Yahya ja,niballukhu bichaarat mamlakat Allah wa ayyi naadum yijaahid achaan yadkhul fiiha be chidde.
Wa waga'aan al-sama wa l-ard yabga hayyin min nugta waahide hana l-Tawraat tingachcha.
Wa kulli naadum al-yitallig martah achaan yaakhud mara aakhara,hu zaani.Wa l-naadum al-yaakhud al-mara al-mutallaga,hu kula zaani.
Wa battaan,Isa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naadum khani marra waahid.Wa hu laabis khulgaan khaaliyiin bilheen wa kulla yoom hu yafrah wa yaakul akil halu marra waahid.
Wa naas khatto naadum miskiin usmah La'aazar fi khachum beetah wa jildah kula awaawiir.
Wa hu garmaan yaakul min al-akil al-yidaffig min sufrat al-khani.Wa l-kulaab yaju wa yalhaso awaawiirah.
Wa l-miskiin da maat wa l-malaa'ika chaalooh wa ga''adooh jamb al-nabi Ibraahiim.Wa l-khani kula maat wa dafanooh.
Wa fi l-haawiye,hu gaa'id fi azaab chadiid.Wa rafa' raasah wa chaaf Ibraahiim fi bakaan ba'iid minnah wa La'aazar ma'aayah.
Wa sarakh leyah wa gaal-:--Abuuna Ibraahiim,arhamni-!Rassil leyi La'aazar.Khalli yibill raas usba'ah fi almi baarid wa yibarrid beyah lisaani.Achaan ana fi azaab chadiid fi amlahiib di.--
Wa Ibraahiim gaal-:--La,ya wileedi.Fakkir fi kikkeef icht fi l-dunya.Awwal inta icht fi l-halu wa La'aazar aach fi l-ta'ab.Wa laakin hassa' hu indah raaha hini wa inta indak azaab.
Wa battaan fi haawiye kabiire bilheen beenna wa beenku.Wa achaan da,al-naas al-yidooru yugummu min hini yamchu leeku ma yagdaro.Wa ma fi naadum al-yagdar yugumm min hinaak wa yaji leena hini.--
Wa l-khani gaal-:--Abba,natlub minnak tirassil La'aazar le beet abuuyi.
Hinaak indi khamsa akhwaan.Khalli yihazzirhum achaan ma yaju fi bakaan al-azaab da,misli ana.--
Wa Ibraahiim radda leyah wa gaal-:--Induhum kalaam Muusa wa kalaam al-anbiya.Khalli yasma'ooh.--
Wa l-khani radda leyah wa gaal-:--La,ya abba Ibraahiim-!Ma tuguul ke.Kan naadum yab'as min ust al-maytiin wa yamchi leehum,akiid yutuubu min zunuubhum.--
Wa Ibraahiim gaal-:--Kan ma yidooru yasma'o kalaam Muusa wa l-anbiya,akiid naadum al-ba'as min ust al-maytiin kula ma yagdar yijiibhum fi l-derib al-adiil.-
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Laabudda achya waahidiin yabgo wa be sababhum naas waahidiin yamurgu min al-derib.Wa laakin al-azaab yarja al-naadum al-yisabbib al-achya dool.
Aywa,kan naadum yitallif iimaan hana waahid min al-mu'miniin al-dugaag dool,al-azaab al-yarjaah yabga chadiid lahaddi akheer leyah kan rabato murhaaka fi ragabatah wa zagalooh fi lubb al-bahar.
Achaan da,khuttu baalku fi nufuusku.-Kan akhuuk khiti,aharjah.Wa kan hu nidim fi l-cheyy al-sawwaah,saamihah.
Kan fi l-yoom al-waahid hu yakhta foogak sab'a marraat wa yigabbil leek sab'a marraat wa yuguul-:--Ana tubt min al-khata da--,waajib tisaamihah.
Wa l-rusul hajjo le l-Rabb Isa wa gaalo-:-Ziid leena al-iimaan.
Wa l-Rabb Isa gaal-:-Kan iimaanku sakhayyar misil habbat al-kireeb kula,tagdaro taamuru al-chadara al-kabiire di wa tuguulu-:--Gummi min hini wa maggini nafiski fi l-bahar-- wa hi tasma' kalaamku.
Ayyi naadum minku yisawwi chunu kan indah abid al-gaa'id yahrit leyah walla yasrah-?Wakit abdah yigabbil min al-kadaade,hal siidah yuguul-:--Ta'aal aakul ma'aayi---?
La,ma ke.Yuguul-:--Khayyir khalagak wa jahhiz leyi al-acha.Wa akhdim leyi lahaddi naakul wa nachrab.Wa ba'ad da bas,inta kula taakul wa tachrab.--
Hal hu yachkur abdah fi chaan hu sawwa al-khidme al-amarah beeha walla-?La.
Wa nafs al-cheyy intu kula.Wakit sawweetu kulla cheyy al-Allah amaraaku beyah,waajib tuguulu-:--Aniina abiid bas wa ma sawweena ziyaada min al-khidme al-waajib nisawwuuha.-
Wa wakit Isa musaafir le Madiinat al-Khudus,hu faat be l-huduud al-been daar al-Saamira wa daar al-Jaliil.
Wa dakhal fi hille waahide wa achara rujaal al-induhum jidaam gaabalooh.Wa humman wagafo ba'iid minnah chiyya.
Wa sarakho leyah wa gaalo-:-Ya Isa-!Ya sayyidna-!Arhamna.
Wa Isa chaafaahum wa gaal-:-Amchu wassufu nufuusku le raajil al-diin.-Wa macho.Wa wakit humman fi l-derib,ligo al-aafe wa bigo taahiriin.
Wa wakit waahid minhum irif kadar hu ligi al-aafe,gabbal le Isa wa gamma yachkur Allah be hiss aali.
Wa sajad giddaam Isa wa chakarah.Wa l-naadum al-gabbal da,hu Saamiri.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Al-naas al-ligo al-aafe ma achara walla-?Ween al-tis'a-?
Ma fi naadum aakhar al-yidoor yachkur Allah,illa l-ajnabi da walla-?
Wa gaal le l-Saamiri-:-Gumm foog wa amchi fi derbak.Ligiit al-aafe be sabab iimaanak.
Wa yoom waahid,al-Fariiziyiin sa'alo Isa fi jayyit mamlakat Allah.Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Mamlakat Allah ma taji be alaamaat al-tichiifuuhum.
Wa l-naas ma yuguulu-:--Chiifu,hi gammat hini-- walla --Hi hinaak--.Nuguul leeku mamlakat Allah gaa'ide ambeenaatku khalaas.
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Yaji wakit tabgo garmaaniin le tichiifu yoom waahid min ayyaam Ibn al-Insaan wa laakin ma tichiifuuh.
Wa yuguulu leeku-:--Chiifu hu hini-- walla --Chiifu hu hinaak-- laakin ma tamchu ma'aahum.Ma titaabu'uuhum.
Akiid al-barraaga tabrug fi l-sama min al-nuss al-waahid wa tinchaaf lahaddi fi l-nuss al-aakhar wa jayyit Ibn al-Insaan kula tabga misil da wakit yigabbil.
Laakin awwal mukhaddar le Ibn al-Insaan yat'ab ta'ab chadiid wa l-naas al-fi wakitna da yaabooh.
Wa haalat al-naas fi yoom jayyit Ibn al-Insaan tabga sawa sawa misil haalat al-naas fi zaman Nooh.
Humman gaa'idiin yaakulu wa yacharbo wa l-rujaal yaakhudu awiin wa l-awiin yaakhudan rujaal lahaddi l-yoom al-Nooh dakhal fi l-safiina.Wa khalaas al-almi ja wa akal kulla l-naas.
Wa bigi misil da fi zaman Luut kula.Al-naas gaa'idiin yaakulu wa yacharbo wa yibii'u wa yachru wa yimaggunu chadar wa yabnu buyuut.
Laakin yoom al-Luut marag min hillit Saduum,Allah nazzal fooghum naar wa kibriit wa dammaraahum marra waahid.
Wa yabga misil da wakit Allah yibayyin Ibn al-Insaan.
Fi l-yoom da,ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yinjamma fi raas beetah wa khumaamah daakhal fi l-beet,khalli yajri,ma yidalli yichiilah.Wa battaan ayyi naadum al-yakhdim fi l-zere',khalli yajri,ma yigabbil beetah.
Fakkuru fi marit Luut.
Ayyi naadum al-yifattich yinajji nafsah,yiwaddirha.Laakin al-naadum al-ma yifakkir fi nafsah,yanja.
Nuguul leeku kadar fi l-leele diik,fi naaseen fi sariir waahid,al-waahid yinrafi' wa l-aakhar ma yinrafi'.
Wa fi awiin itneen gaa'idaat sawa yarhakan khalla,al-waahide tinrafi' wa l-aakhara ma tinrafi'.
Wa fi rujaal itneen gaa'idiin yakhdumu fi nafs al-zere',al-waahid yinrafi' wa l-aakhar ma yinrafi'.
Wa talaamiizah sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna,da yabga ween-? Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-rimme tinaadi al-suguura.
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal achaan yiwassifhum waajib daayman yisallu wa ma yaksalo.
Wa gaal-:-Fi hille waahide,fiiha haakim waahid wa hu ma khaayif min Allah wa ma lammaah be rida al-naas.
Wa fi l-hille di,fi ajuuz armala.Wa kulli yoom hi tamchi le l-haakim wa tuguul-:--Ansurni be l-hagg fi l-naadum al-zalamni.--
Wa awwal hu aba ma sawwa leeha cheyy laakin fi l-akhiir hu gaal fi nafsah-:--Sahiih,ana ma khaayif min Allah wa ma lammaani be rida al-naas.
Laakin al-ajuuz di gaa'ide tibachtinni bilheen.Khalli nansurha achaan hi ma ti'ayyiini marra waahid be jayyitha al-katiire.-
Wa l-Rabb Isa gaal-:-Al-haakim da naadum zaalim laakin fakkuru fi kalaamah.
Wa fi fikirku,Allah ma yansurhum le naasah al-azalaahum al-yasrakho leyah leel wa nahaar walla-?Yi'akhkhir leehum walla-?
Nuguul leeku hu yansurhum ajala.Wa laakin wakit Ibn al-Insaan yigabbil fi l-ard,hu yalga naas mu'miniin walla-?
Wa Isa hajja be masal le naas waahidiin al-yisawwu nufuushum saalihiin wa yahguru al-aakhariin.
Wa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naaseen dakhalo fi beet Allah achaan yisallu.Al-waahid min al-Fariiziyiin wa l-aakhar min naas al-jamaarik.
Wa l-Fariizi wagaf be tuulah wa salla wiheedah wa gaal-:--Ya Allah,nuguul leek chukran achaan ana ma bigiit misil al-naas al-aakhariin.Humman saraariig wa fasliin wa zannaayiin.Aywa,ana ma misil naadum al-jamaarik da.
Ana nusuum yoomeen fi l-usbuu' wa nantiik uchur hana kulla cheyy al-narbahah.--
Laakin naadum al-jamaarik wagaf wiheedah ba'iid min al-naas.Ma rafa' raasah foog kula.Wa gaa'id yudugg sadrah min al-nadaama wa gaal-:--Ya Allah,arhamni.Ana muznib.--
Wa nuguul leeku min al-naaseen dool,al-raajil al-taani bas gabbal fi beetah wa Allah ja'alah saalih.Achaan ayyi naadum al-yisawwi nafsah kabiir,Allah yisawwiih sakhayyar wa l-naadum al-yisawwi nafsah sakhayyar,Allah yisawwiih kabiir.
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yiwaddu iyaalhum al-sukhaar le Isa achaan hu yalmashum le yibaarikhum.Wa talaamiizah chaafoohum wa harajoohum.
Laakin Isa naada al-iyaal wa gaal le talaamiizah-:-Khallu al-iyaal yaju leyi wa ma tadharoohum achaan mamlakat Allah hana l-naas al-misilhum.
Wa naadum waahid min al-kubaaraat sa'al Isa wa gaal-:-Ya l-mu'allim al-adiil,waajib nisawwi chunu achaan nalga al-haya al-abadiiye-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Maala tuguul ana adiil-?Waahid bas adiil wa hu Allah.
Akiid,ta'arif al-wasaaya al-buguulu-:﴾‍Ma tazna wa ma taktul dimme wa ma tasrig wa ma tachhad be kidib wa karrim ammak wa abuuk.‍﴿
Wa l-raajil gaal-:-Min ana sakhayyar,nitaabi' kulla l-wasaaya dool.
Wa wakit Isa simi' kalaamah da,hu gaal-:-Chokhol waahid lissaa' gassar leek.Bii' kulla cheyy al-indak wa anti tamanah le l-masaakiin wa misil da,talgaah giddaamak.Wa ta'aal taabi'ni.
Wa wakit simi' kalaam Isa da,hu bigi haznaan achaan hu khani bilheen.
Wa Isa chaaf wijhah wa gaal-:-Al-dakhuul fi mamlakat Allah gaasi le l-naas al-induhum maal katiir.
Battaan nuguul leeku,dakhuul al-jamal fi gadd al-ibre hayyin min dakhuul siid al-maal fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa l-naas al-sim'o al-kalaam da gaalo-:-Kan misil da,yaatu yagdar yanja-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-cheyy al-gaasi le l-naas,ma gaasi le Allah.
Wa Butrus gaal-:-Wa aniina khalleena kulla khumaamna achaan nitaabu'uuk.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-khalla beetah aw martah aw akhwaanah aw waaldeenah aw iyaalah fi chaan mamlakat Allah,
yalga katiir minhum ziyaada fi l-zaman al-haadir.Wa fi l-aakhira,yalga al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa Isa tarraf al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar wa hajja leehum wiheedhum wa gaal-:-Chiifu.Aniina maachiin le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hinaak kulla cheyy al-anbiya katabooh fi Ibn al-Insaan yitimm.
Yisallumuuh le l-ma mu'miniin wa yichchammato leyah wa yi'ayyuruuh wa yibazzukhu foogah.
Wa yajluduuh wa yaktuluuh.Wa laakin fi l-yoom al-taalit hu yab'as.
Wa laakin talaamiizah ma fihmo cheyy min al-kalaam da.Kalaamah da mulabbad minhum wa ma irfo ma'ana kalaamah.
Wa wakit Isa garrab le hillit Ariiha,amyaan waahid gaa'id tihit jamb al-chaari' wa hu gaa'id yachhad sadakha min al-naas.
Wa l-amyaan simi' hiss hana l-naas al-katiiriin al-maachiin fi l-derib wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Chunu al-haraka di-?
Wa gaalo leyah-:-Isa al-min al-Naasira maachi fi l-derib da.
Wa hu bada yi'iit wa yuguul-:-Ya Isa-!Ya Ibn Dawuud-!Arhamni-!
Wa l-naas al-maachiin giddaam Isa harajooh wa gaalo leyah-:-Askut-! Laakin al-amyaan gamma yi'iit be ziyaada wa yuguul-:-Ya Ibn Dawuud,arhamni-!
Wa Isa wagaf wa amaraahum le l-naas achaan yijiibu leyah al-amyaan.Wa wakit al-amyaan ja gariib,Isa sa'alah wa gaal-:
Tidoor ana nisawwi leek chunu-? Wa l-amyaan gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,nidoor nichiif-!
Wa Isa gaal-:-Khalaas,chiif-!Inta ligiit al-aafe be sabab iimaanak.
Wa tawwaali uyuunah anfataho wa gamma yitaabi' Isa wa gaa'id yachkur Allah.Wa wakit kulla l-naas chaafooh,chakaro Allah katiir.
Wa Isa dakhal fi hillit Ariiha wa gaa'id yuchuggaha.
Wa fi naadum waahid usmah Zakka.Wa hu kabiir hana naas al-jamaarik wa hu khani bilheen.
Wa hu dawwar yichiif Isa laakin ma gidir achaan Isa gaa'id fi usut naas katiiriin wa Zakka naadum gisayyir.
Wa achaan da,hu jara giddaam fi l-derib al-Isa maachi foogah wa rikib foog fi jimmeezaay achaan yichiif Isa wakit hu yalhag al-bakaan da.
Wa Isa ja fi l-bakaan da wa rafa' raasah wa hajja le Zakka wa gaal-:-Ya Zakka,yalla ajala dalli tihit.Al-yoom waajib niddayyaf fi beetak.
Wa ajala ke hu dalla wa faddalah le Isa fi beetah be farah.
Wa kulla l-naas al-chaafo al-cheyy al-bigi da,bigo za'laaniin wa hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Haay-!Hu macha bigi deef hana naadum muznib.
Wa Zakka gamma foog wa gaal le l-Rabb Isa-:-Ya Sayyidna,nanti nuss maali le l-masaakiin.Wa kan chilt cheyy min ayyi naadum be zulum,nigabbilah leyah arba'a marraat.
Wa Isa radda wa gaal-:-Khalaas,al-yoom al-naja jaat fi l-beet da achaan Zakka kula min iyaal Ibraahiim.
Wa ana Ibn al-Insaan jiit achaan nifattich al-muwaddiriin wa ninajjiihum.
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yasma'o kalaam Isa.Wa fi fikirhum,mamlakat Allah tidoor tibiin ajala achaan hu gariib yalhag Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa achaan da,hu hajja leehum be masal.
Wa gaal-:-Yoom min al-ayyaam,fi naadum waahid min iyaal al-muluuk saafar fi bakaan ba'iid achaan hinaak yidarrujuuh malik wa yigabbil yahkim baladah.
Wa gubbaal ma yisaafir,hu naada achara min abiidah wa anta le ayyi waahid jineeh hana dahab.Wa gaal leehum-:--Taajuru beyah lahaddi nigabbil.--
Wa cha'ab baladah kirhooh wa rassalo waraayah mumassiliin achaan yuguulu-:--Ma nidooru al-naadum da yabga foogna malik.--
Wa ba'ad darrajooh malik,gabbal baladah wa naada abiidah al-antaahum al-gurus achaan yaju leyah.Wa dawwar ya'arif kam ribho leyah fi l-tijaara.
Wa l-awwal ja giddaamah wa gaal-:--Ya l-malik,al-jineeh al-anteetah leyi,ana kisibt beyah 10 jineeh.--
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:--Da sameh.Inta abid adiil.Awwal ana anteetak mas'uuliiye chiyya wa inta bigiit amiin.Wa achaan da,nantiik mas'uuliiye fi 10 hille.--
Wa l-abid al-taani ja leyah wa gaal-:--Ya l-malik,al-jineeh al-anteetah leyi,ana kisibt beyah 5 jineeh.--
Wa l-malik gaal-:--Nukhuttak fi 5 hille.--
Wa abid aakhar ja wa gaal-:--Ya l-malik,daahu jineeh hanaak.Ana hafadtah wa labbadtah fi mindiil.
Ana khuft minnak achaan inta naadum gawi.Inta tichiil al-khumaam al-naadum aakhar khattaah wa tagta' al-khalla al-ma teerabtaha.--
Wa l-malik gaal leyah-:--Nihaasibak hasab al-kalaam al-inta gultah.Inta abid fasil.Irift kadar ana naadum gawi wa nichiil al-khumaam al-naadum aakhar khattaah wa nagta' al-khalla al-ma teerabtaha.
Wa kan ana misil da,maala ma khatteet gursi fi l-banki-?Wa misil da,wakit nigabbil fi l-balad nichiilah be faayditah.--
Wa gaal le l-naas al-ma'aayah-:--Chiilu minnah al-jineeh wa antuuh le l-abid al-indah 10.--
Wa gaalo leyah-:--Ya l-malik,hu indah 10 khalaas-!--
Wa l-malik gaal-:--Nuguul leeku yantu le l-naadum al-indah.Wa laakin al-naadum al-ma indah,al-chiyya al-indah kula yichiiluuh minnah.
Wa khalaas,ween udwaani dool al-ma dawwaro ana nabga fooghum malik-?Jiibuuhum hini wa aktuluuhum giddaami-!-
Wa wakit Isa kammal al-kalaam da,hu macha giddaam fi derib Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Isa garrab le hillaal Beet Faaji wa Beet Anya fi l-bakaan al-usmah jabal al-Zaytuun.Wa Isa rassal giddaamah talaamiiz itneen.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Amchu fi l-hille al-giddaamna di.Wa fi khachum al-hille talgo dahach marbuut.Wa naadum lissaa' ma rikib foogah.Hilluuh wa jiibuuh leyi hini.
Wa kan naadum yas'alku wa yuguul-:--Maala tihillu al-dahach-?- guulu leyah-:--Al-Rabb yidoorah.-
Wa l-talaamiiz al-rassaloohum macho ligo al-dahach misil hu ooraahum beyah.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yihilluuh,siyaadah sa'aloohum wa gaalo-:-Maala tihillu al-dahach-?
Wa raddo leehum wa gaalo-:-Al-Rabb yidoorah.
Wa jaabooh le Isa.Wa farracho khulgaanhum fi l-dahach wa rakkabo Isa foogah.
Wa khalaas hu gamma maachi raakib fi l-dahach wa l-naas farracho khulgaanhum fi l-derib giddaamah.
Wa garrab le l-madiina be l-derib al-naazil min jabal al-Zaytuun wa kulla talaamiizah bado yafraho wa yachkuru Allah be hiss aali fi chaan kulla l-ajaayib al-kubaar al-chaafoohum.
Wa gaalo-:﴾‍Mabruuk le l-malikal-jaayi be usum Allah-!‍﴿Salaam fi l-samawa majjudu Allah fi l-aali-!
Wa Fariiziyiin waahidiin fi ust al-naas hajjo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ya l-sayyid,sakkit talaamiizak-!
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku kan al-naas dool sakato kula,al-hujaar yi'iitu be nafs al-kalaam.
Wa Isa garrab le l-madiina wa chaafaaha wa baka fi chaanha.
Wa gaal-:-Ana nitmanna al-yoom inti ta'arfi al-cheyy al-yijiib leeki al-salaam laakin lahaddi hassa',ma fihimtiih.
Wakit waahid yaji leeki wa askar aduuki yaju wa yankutu khanaadighum wa yihawwuguuki wa yisiddu kulla duruubki.
Wa yidammuruuki ma'a naaski al-fi lubbiki.Wa ma yikhallu hajar yagood foog hajar.Wa da yabga achaan inti ma irifti al-wakit al-Allah ja foogah le yinajjiiki.
