Wa Isa dakhal fi fadaayit beet Allah wa gamma yatrud minha al-tujjaar al-yisaawugu foogha.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Allah gaal fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Beeti yisammuuh beet al-sala.‍﴿Wa laakin intu﴾‍sawweetuuh beet al-saraariig-!‍﴿
Wa kulla yoom Isa yi'allim al-naas fi fadaayit beet Allah.Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama wa kubaaraat al-naas dawwaro fursa achaan yaktuluuh.
Laakin fursa ma ligooha achaan kulla l-cha'ab gaa'idiin ma'aayah wa yasma'o kalaamah be niiye waahide.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi fadaayit beet Allah wa yiballikh leehum al-bichaara.Wa fi l-bakaan da,kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama wa l-chuyuukh jo leyah.
Wa gaalo-:-Guul leena min ween ligiit izin achaan tisawwi al-khidme di.Walla yaatu al-antaak al-izin da-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ana kula indi su'aal nidoor nas'alku.Ooruuni,
Yahya khattas al-naas be izin Allah walla be izin al-naas-?
Wa achchaawaro ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Kan gulna Yahya indah izin min Allah,Isa yuguul leena-:--Maala ma aamantu beyah-?--
Wa kan gulna Yahya indah izin min al-naas bas,al-naas yarjumuuna.Achaan fi fikirhum,akiid Yahya nabi.
Wa raddo le Isa wa gaalo-:-Aniina ma na'arfu yaatu al-antaah izin.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Khalaas,ana kula ma ni'ooriiku be izin yaatu nisawwi al-cheyy da.
Wa Isa gamma hajja le l-naas be masal wa gaal-:-Naadum waahid maggan inab fi jineene.Wa hu ajjar harraatiin achaan yakhdumu foogha.Wa hu zaatah khatar wa macha fi balad aakhara.Wa tawwal ma gabbal.
Wa fi wakit hana lammiin al-inab,hu rassal abid waahid le l-harraatiin achaan yichiil al-inab al-waajib leyah.Laakin al-harraatiin daggooh wa gabbalooh le siidah iideenah yaabsiin.
Wa rassal leehum abid taani.Wa hu kula daggooh wa ayyarooh wa gabbalooh iideenah yaabsiin.
Wa rassal leehum battaan abid taalit wa l-abid da jarahooh wa zagalooh barra min al-jineene.
Wa siid al-jineene gaal-:--Nisawwi chunu-?Khalaas,nirassil wileedi al-nihibbah.Akuun leyah hu da,yikarrumuuh.--
Wa l-harraatiin chaafo wileed siid al-jineene wa hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:--Daahu al-yawris al-jineene.Khalli naktuluuh achaan al-warasa tabga hintina.--
Wa maragooh barra min al-jineene wa katalooh.-Wa Isa gaal-:-Hassa' nas'alku.Siid al-jineene yisawwi fooghum chunu-?
Akiid,hu yaji wa yikattilhum le l-harraatiin dool wa khalaas yanti al-jineene le naas aakhariin. Wa wakit al-naas sim'o al-kalaam da gaalo-:-Khalli Allah yadharah-!
Wa Isa chaafaahum adiil wa gaal-:-Wa kan da ma yabga,chunu ma'ana hana l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-yuguul-:﴾‍Al-hajar al-bannaayiin al-beet awwal ma dawwaroohbigi al-hajar al-muhimm fi buna al-beet.‍﴿
Wa kulla naadum al-yaga' foog al-hajar da,yinkasir marra waahid wa kan al-hajar da yaga' foog naadum,yarhakah misil al-dagiig.
Wa fi l-yoom da zaatah,al-ulama wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin dawwaro yakurbuuh achaan fihmo kadar be l-masal da Isa hajja fooghum laakin humman khaayfiin min al-naas.
Wa achaan da,gammo yukhuttu baalhum foogah.Wa bado yirassulu leyah jawaasiis al-sawwo nufuushum misil naas saalihiin achaan yalgo fursa yarmuuh be kalaamah.Wa dawwaro yiwadduuh fi mahkamat al-waali al-Roomaani.
Wa l-jawaasiis gaalo-:-Sayyidna,na'arfu kalaamak wa ta'liimak sahiih.Wa inta ma takhaaf min een al-naas.Wa ti'allim al-naas derib Allah al-sahiih.
Khalaas guul leena,hasab al-Tawraat,waajib leena nikaffu al-miiri le sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin walla ma waajib-?
Wa Isa irif najaadithum.Wa gaal leehum-:
Wassufuuni diinaar waahid.Al-suura wa l-usum al-gaa'idiin foogah hana yaatu-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Hana sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Khalaas,hana l-sultaan,antuuh le l-sultaan wa hana Allah,antuuh le Allah.
Wa ma gidro yarmuuh be kalaamah giddaam al-naas.Wa al'ajjabo marra waahid fi l-radd al-raddaah leehum wa khalaas sakato.
Wa Sadduukhiyiin waahidiin jo le Isa.Wa l-Sadduukhiyiin ma mu'miniin be l-bu'aas.
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ya l-sayyid,nidooru nihajju leek be l-kalaam al-Muusa katabah leena fi l-Tawraat.Hu gaal kan raajil waahid maat wa indah mara wa laakin ma indah iyaal,akhu al-raajil da waajib yaakhud al-mara wa yalda minha zurriiye le akhuuh al-marhuum.
Zeen.Awwal fi sab'a akhwaan.Wa l-kabiir minhum akhad mara wa ba'ad wakit,hu maat.Wa ma jaab minha iyaal.
Wa l-taani akhadha wa nafs al-cheyy bigi leyah.
Wa l-taalit akhadha wa l-akhwaan al-sab'a kulluhum akhadooha wa ma jaabo minha iyaal wa maato.
Wa fi l-akhiir al-mara zaatha maatat.
Wa khalaas,wakit al-maytiin yab'aso,hi tabga marit yaatu minhum-?Achaan kulluhum al-sab'a akhadooha.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Sahiih,fi l-zaman al-haadir,al-rujaal yaakhudu awiin wa l-awiin yantuuhin le l-rujaal.
Laakin al-naas al-induhum hagg fi l-zaman al-jaayi wa yab'aso min ust al-maytiin,humman battaan ma yaakhudu awiin wa l-awiin ma yaakhudan rujaal.
Humman ma yumuutu battaan,yabgo misil al-malaa'ika.Wa yabgo iyaal Allah achaan ba'asaahum min al-moot.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-bu'aas,Muusa zaatah wassafaaku kadar al-maytiin yab'aso.Fakkuru fi kalaam Muusa al-bukhuss al-chideere al-gammat foogha naar wakit hu gaal kadar Allah hu Rabb juduudku Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub.
Wa hu Rabb al-hayyiin wa ma Rabb al-maytiin achaan leyah hu kulla l-naas aaychiin.
Wa ulama waahidiin gaalo-:-Mabruuk,sayyidna.Kalaamak adiil.
Wa ma dawwaro battaan yas'alooh ayyi su'aal.
Laakin Isa sa'alaahum le l-ulama wa gaal-:-Kikkeef yuguulu kadar al-Masiih hu Ibn Dawuud-?
Nas'alku achaan fi kitaab al-Zabuur,Dawuud zaatah gaal-:--Allah hajja le siidi al-malik wa gaal-:﴾‍Agood be nussi al-zeenaay
lahaddi nukhutt udwaanak tihit rijileenak.‍﴿-
Wa misil da,Dawuud gaal al-Masiih hu siidah.Wa be misil da,kikkeef al-Masiih yabga wileedah-?
Wa kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yasma'o kalaamah.Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:
Aw'u baalku min al-ulama.Humman yiriidu yalbaso jalaaliib tuwaal wa yuruukhu fi ust al-naas wa yiriidu salaam al-naas fi l-suug wa l-saff al-awwal fi beet al-sala wa bakaan al-kubaaraat fi kulli aazuuma.
Wa laakin humman yaakulu buyuut al-araamil wa yugummu yisallu sala tawiile achaan al-naas yichiifuuhum.Wa khalaas al-azaab al-yarjaahum yabga chadiid ziyaada.
Wa Isa rafa' raasah wa chaaf siyaad al-maal al-gaa'idiin yusubbu gurus fi sanduug beet Allah.
Wa chaaf armala waahide miskiine.Wa hi khattat fi l-sanduug riyaaleen bas.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Nuguul leeku al-hagg,al-armala al-miskiine di khattat fi l-sanduug ziyaada min kulla l-naas al-aakhariin dool.
Achaan kulluhum anto le Allah al-zaayid min maalhum laakin hi miskiine wa antat kulla cheyy al-ti'iich beyah.
Wa naas waahidiin gaa'idiin yihajju be samaah hana beet Allah wa hujaarah al-samhiin wa kulla cheyy al-naas antooh le l-buna.Wa Isa gaal-:
Kulla l-buyuut al-tichiifuuhum dool,yaji wakit waahid ma yikhallu hajar yagood foog hajar.Yarmuuhum kulluhum.
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna,da yabga mata-?Wa chunu al-alaama al-tiwassifna kadar da gariib-?
Wa gaal leehum-:-Khuttu baalku wa ma tikhallu naadum yukhuchchuku.Achaan naas katiiriin yaju be usmi wa yihajju be nufuushum wa yuguulu-:--Ana bas al-Masiih-!- Walla buguulu-:--Al-wakit tamma-!- Al-naas dool,ma titaabu'uuhum.
Wa wakit tasma'o khabar hana huruub wa tamarrud,ma takhaafo achaan da waajib yukuun gubbaal.Laakin al-kumaale ma taji ajala.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Naas hana balad waahide yahjumu naas hana balad aakhara wa mamlaka tahjim mamlaka aakhara.
Wa fi diyaar katiiriin yukuun zilzaal wa fi aakhariin juu' chadiid wa waba.Wa alaamaat kubaar yinchaafo fi l-sama al-yikhawwufu al-naas marra waahid.
Wa laakin gubbaal al-achya dool ma yabgo,intu yakurbuuku wa yi'azzubuuku.Wa yisallumuuku le masaa'iil buyuut al-sala wa yazguluuku fi l-sijin.Yiwadduuku bakaan al-muluuk wa l-hukkaam fi chaan intu naasi.
Wa be da talgo fursa le tachhado leyi.
Achaan da,sabbutu afkaarku achaan ma tihimmu fi kikkeef turuddu leehum.
Achaan ana nantiiku al-kalaam wa l-fikir al-waajib.Wa l-naas al-yi'aazuuku ma yagdaro yahmalo kalaamku walla yuruddu leeku.
Wa l-yisallumuuku le l-kubaaraat humman waaldeenku wa akhwaanku wa min gabiilitku wa rufgaanku.Wa waahidiin minku yaktuluuhum.
Wa fi chaan usmi,kulla l-naas yakrahooku.
Laakin suufaay waahide min raasku ma tiwaddir.
Agoodu saabtiin fi l-ta'ab da wa misil da tinajju nufuusku.
Wa yoom waahid,askar katiiriin yaju yihawwugu Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit tichiifuuhum,ta'arfu kadar kharaabha gariib.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,khalli al-naas al-gaa'idiin fi daar al-Yahuudiiya yi'arrudu fi l-hujaar.Wa khalli al-naas al-fi l-madiina yamurgu minha wa khalli al-naas al-fi l-kadaade ma yadkhulu fi l-madiina.
Achaan fi l-wakit da,Allah yi'aakhib cha'abah wa kulla l-kalaam al-awwal al-anbiya katabooh fooghum yitimm.
Wa yabga gaasi bilheen le l-awiin al-khalbaanaat wa l-yiraddi'an.Wa l-diige tabga chadiide fi kulla l-balad di achaan khadab Allah yanzil fi l-cha'ab da.
Yumuutu be l-seef wa yiwadduuhum masaajiin fi ust kulla l-umam.Wa naas al-umam yamulku Madiinat al-Khudus wa yifajjukhuuha lahaddi wakithum yikammil.
Wa l-naas yichiifu alaamaat fi l-harraay wa l-gamar wa l-nujuum.Wa fi l-ard,al-umam yibarjulu wa yakhaafo min hiss al-bahar wa harakatah.
Wa l-naas yaga'o min al-khoof wa yakhaafo min al-cheyy al-jaayi fi l-dunya achaan khuwwaat al-samaawaat zaathum yinhazzo.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,yichiifu Ibn al-Insaan jaayi fi sahaab al-sama be gudra aziime wa majiide.
Wa wakit al-achya dool yabdo,chiddu heelku wa arfa'o ruuseeku foog achaan yoom najaatku garrab.
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal-:-Fakkuru fi chadar al-tiin wa fi kulla l-chadar.
Wakit al-chadar yisawwi warag,tichiifuuh wa ta'arfu al-wakit al-yalda foogah garrab khalaas.
Wa sawa sawa misil da,a'arfu kadar mamlakat Allah garrabat wakit tichiifu al-alaamaat al-ooreetku beehum dool.
Khuttu baalku fi nufuusku.Achaan kan tikhallu guluubku yinchakhlu be l-safaaha wa l-sakar wa kan tinchakhlu be humuum al-dunya,al-yoom da yaji faj'atan
wa yabga leeku misil charak.Akiid,al-yoom da yaji fi kulla l-naas al-fi kulla l-ard.
Abgo daayman waa'iyiin wa as'alo gudra min Allah achaan tanjo min kulla l-achya al-yabgo dool wa fi l-akhiir tagiifu giddaam Ibn al-Insaan.
Wa kulla yoom,Isa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi beet Allah.Wa fi l-makhrib,hu marag min al-madiina wa ragad fi l-bakaan al-usmah jabal al-Zaytuun.
Wa kulla yoom,al-naas yibakkuru wa yamchu fi beet Allah achaan yasma'o kalaamah.
Wa iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara al-ma'ruuf be iid al-Fisha garrab.
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama khaayfiin min za'al al-naas wa achaan da,gammo yifattuchu tariiga al-yaktulu beeha Isa be achiir.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-Cheetaan dakhal fi galib Yahuuza al-usmah al-Iskhariyooti.Wa hu min al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar.
Wa Yahuuza gamma wa macha hajja ma'a kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa kubaaraat al-askar hurraas beet Allah.Wa chaawaraahum be kikkeef yagdar yisallim leehum Isa.
Wa humman firho wa gaalo yantuuh gurus.
Wa khalaas,Yahuuza khassad wa min al-wakit da,hu gaa'id yifattich fursa achaan yisallim leehum Isa wakit hu ma gaa'id fi ust al-naas.
Wa iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara ja.Wa da l-yoom al-yadbaho foogah al-hamal fi chaan acha hana iid al-Fisha.
Wa Isa rassal Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa amaraahum wa gaal-:-Amchu hassulu leena acha iid al-Fisha.
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Wa nihassuluuh ween-?
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Wakit tadkhulu fi l-madiina,talgo raajil waahid chaayil jarr hana almi.Taabu'uuh fi l-beet al-yadkhul foogah
wa hajju le siid al-beet da wa guulu leyah-:--Sayyidna al-mu'allim yuguul leek-:"Ween beet al-diifaan al-naakul foogah acha iid al-Fisha ma'a talaamiizi-?"--
Wa hu yiwassifku khurfa wasii'e wa jaahize foog fi l-gasir.Wa fi l-bakaan da bas,hassulu leena al-acha.
Wa macho wa ligo kulla cheyy misil hu gaalah leehum.Wa hassalo acha iid al-Fisha.
Wakt al-acha tamma wa Isa ga'ad le l-akil ma'a l-rusul al-atnaachar.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Ana atmanneet naakul ma'aaku acha iid al-Fisha da gubbaal ma nat'ab.
Wa nuguul leeku ma naakulah battaan lahaddi kulla cheyy al-bukhuss iid al-Fisha yitimm fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa chaal kaas hana asiir al-inab wa chakar Allah.Wa gaal leehum-:-Chiiluuh.Khalli kula waahid yachrab minnah.
Wa nuguul leeku min al-yoom ana ma nachrab battaan asiir al-inab lahaddi mamlakat Allah taji.
Wa chaal khubza waahide wa chakar Allah.Wa kasarha wa antaaha leehum wa gaal-:-Da jismi al-nantiih fi chaanku.Sawwu misil da le tizzakkarooni beyah.
Wa ba'ad al-acha,hu sawwa nafs al-cheyy be l-kaas.Hu chaalah wa gaal-:-Al-kaas da yiwassif al-mu'aahada al-jadiide al-nisawwiiha ma'aaku be dammi al-yidaffig fi chaanku.
Wa nuguul leeku al-naadum al-yukhuunni gaa'id yaakul ma'aayi-!
Achaan Ibn al-Insaan yumuut misil Allah khaddarah.Laakin al-azaab yarja al-naadum al-yukhuunni.
Wa bado yissaa'alo ambeenaathum fi yaatu al-minhum yabga al-khaayin.
Wa talaamiizah gammo yilkhaalato ambeenaathum fi yaatu al-yabga al-akbar minhum.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Ayyi malik al-umam yamluk be chidde fi naasah wa l-indah gudra foog al-naas kula yahkim fooghum misil hu siid al-kheer.
Laakin ma yabga misil da ambeenaatku.Khalli al-kabiir minku yabga misil al-sakhayyar wa l-yuguudku misil al-yakhdim leeku.
Masalan,kan naadum waahid gaa'id yaakul wa naadum aakhar yijiib leyah al-akil,yaatu minhum al-kabiir-?Akiid,yuguulu al-gaa'id yaakul hu al-kabiir.Wa laakin ana zaati gaa'id fi usutku misil al-khaddaam al-yakhdim.
Wa intu ga'adtu ma'aayi saabtiin fi kulla su'uubaati.
Wa misil abuuyi Allah antaani mamlaka,ana kula nantiiku mamlaka.
Wa taakulu wa tacharbo fi nafs al-dabalaay ma'aayi fi mamlakati wa tagoodu fi karaasi wa tahkumu gabaayil Bani Israa'iil al-atnaachar.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ya Sim'aan,ya Sim'aan.Asma'.Ibliis sa'al izin achaan yijarrib iimaanku wa yikharbilku misil khalla.
Laakin ana sa'alt leek Allah achaan iimaanak ma yangus.Wa wakit inta bigiit battaan gawi fi l-iimaan,sabbit akhwaanak.
Wa Butrus gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,ana jaahiz namchi ma'aak fi l-sijin wa numuut kula.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Butrus nuguul leek,fi l-leele di gubbaal al-diik ma yi'oo'i,inta tankurni talaata marraat wa tuguul ma ta'arifni.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Chunu gassar leeku wakit rassaltuku fi ust al-naas bala juzlaan wa la mukhla wa la na'aal-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Cheyy ma gassar leena.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Laakin hassa' nuguul leeku khalli al-naadum al-indah juzlaan walla mukhla yakurbah.Wa khalli ayyi naadum al-ma indah seef yibii' khulgaanah achaan yachri seef.
Achaan nuguul leeku al-kalaam al-yukhussini fi l-Kitaab waajib yitimm.Maktuub-:﴾‍Hasabooh ma'a l-aasiyiin.‍﴿Wa akiid al-kalaam al-ankatab fi chaani gaa'id yitimm.
Wa achaan da,gaalo-:-Sayyidna,chiif.Indina suyuuf itneen. Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Khalaas,kafaaku.
Wa Isa marag min al-beet wa macha misil fi aadtah fi jabal al-Zaytuun.Wa talaamiizah macho waraayah.
Wa wakit lihig al-bakaan da,hu gaal leehum-:-As'alo Allah achaan al-ta'ab ma yijarrib iimaanku wa yitallifah.
Wa khallaahum wa macha minhum chiyya misil zargit hajar.Wa sajad wa bada yas'al Allah
wa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi,kan di niiytak,ba''id minni kaas al-ta'ab da.Laakin khalli yabga misil inta tidoorah wa ma misil ana nidoorah.
Wa waahid min malaa'ikat Allah baan leyah wa sabbat galbah.
Wa Isa gaa'id fi ta'ab chadiid wa sa'al Allah be chidde ziyaada.Wa wakharah yinaggit fi l-turaab misil damm.
Wa gamma min al-du'a wa macha le talaamiizah.Wa ligiihum naaymiin.Wa naamo achaan al-hizin kassalaahum.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Maalku naaymiin-?Gummu foog.As'alo Allah achaan al-ta'ab ma yijarrib iimaanku wa yitallifah.
Wa Isa lissaa' ma kammal al-kalaam da wa naas jo wa l-naadum al-usmah Yahuuza gaa'id yuguudhum.Wa hu min al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar.Wa garrab le Isa achaan yisallimah be hubb.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Yahuuza,tidoor tukhuun Ibn al-Insaan be hubb walla-?
Wa wakit talaamiiz Isa irfo al-cheyy al-yidoor yabga,humman sa'alo Isa wa gaalo-:-Sayyidna,nidaawusuuhum be suyuufna walla-?
Wa waahid minhum gamma darab abid hana kabiir rujaal al-diin be l-seef wa gata' adaanah al-zeene.
Laakin Isa gaal-:-Khalaas-!Agiifu-! Wa limis adaanah wa chafaah.
Wa Isa hajja le kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-chuyuukh wa kubaaraat al-askar hurraas beet Allah al-jo yakurbuuh.Wa gaal leehum-:-Da kikkeef-?Jiitu takurbuuni be seef wa asa da.Ana mujrim walla-?
Kulla yoom ana gaa'id ambeenaatku fi fadaayit beet Allah wa ma karabtuuni.Laakin al-leel bas wakitku intu achaan intu gaa'idiin titaabu'u muluk al-dalaam.
Wa khalaas,karabo Isa wa saagooh wa waddooh fi beet kabiir rujaal al-diin.Wa Butrus macha waraahum min ba'iid.
Wa l-jamaa'a al-karabo Isa oogado naar fi lubb al-hooch wa ga'ado tihit.Wa Butrus ga'ad ma'aahum.
Wa khaddaama waahide chaafatah fi deyy al-naar wa irfatah.Wa gaalat-:-Al-naadum da,hu kula ma'a Isa.
Wa Butrus nakar wa gaal-:-Mara zeene,ana ma na'arfah.
Wa ba'ad chiyya naadum aakhar chaafah wa gaal-:-Inta kula minhum. Wa Butrus gaal-:-Ya raajil,la.Da ma sahiih.
Wa ba'ad saa'a waahide,naadum aakhar hajja wa gaal-:-Akiid al-naadum da hu ma'a Isa,achaan hu kula min daar al-Jaliil.
Wa Butrus gaal-:-Ya raajil,ma na'arfah marra waahid.Kalaamak da chunu-?-Wa gubbaal ma yikammil kalaamah,al-diik oo'a.
Wa l-Rabb Isa anlafat wa chaaf Butrus.Wa Butrus fakkar fi kalaam al-Rabb Isa al-awwal gaalah leyah-:-Al-leele di gubbaal al-diik ma yi'oo'i,tankurni talaata marraat.
Wa Butrus marag min al-hooch wa baka baki chadiid.
Wa l-rujaal al-gaa'idiin yaharsu Isa gaa'idiin yichchammato leyah wa yudugguuh.
Wa rabato uyuunah wa gaalo-:-Ooriina yaatu al-darabak-!
Wa hajjo leyah kalaam katiir be kalaam murr wa ayyarooh.
Wa wakit al-wata asbahat,kulla chuyuukh al-cha'ab lammo ma'a kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama.Wa humman saago Isa wa waddooh giddaam al-majlas.
Wa gaalo leyah-:-Kan inta al-Masiih,ooriina-! Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan nuguulah leeku kula,abadan ma ti'aamunu beyi.
Wa kan nas'alku su'aal,abadan ma turuddu leyi.
Laakin nuguul leeku min al-yoom Ibn al-Insaan yagood fi kursi jamb Allah al-Gaadir fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Wa kulluhum gaalo-:-Wa be l-kalaam da tuguul inta Ibn Allah walla-? Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Aywa,misil intu gultuuh.
Wa hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Simi'na al-kalaam da min khachmah hu zaatah-!Ma nidooru chahaada aakhara.
Wa kulla naas al-majlas gammo wa waddo Isa le Bilaatus al-waali al-Roomaani.
Wa gammo yukhuttu foogah tuhma.Wa gaalo-:-Karabna al-naadum da achaan hu gaa'id yitallif cha'abna wa yadharhum ma yikaffu al-miiri le sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.Wa hu sawwa nafsah al-Masiih,al-malik.
Wa Bilaatus sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta malik al-Yahuud walla-? Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Misil inta gultah.
Wa Bilaatus hajja le kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa le l-naas al-katiiriin al-lammo wa gaal-:-Ana ma ligiit fi l-naadum da ayyi jariime.
Wa laakin humman gammo yihajju be chidde wa gaalo-:-Hu yiharrich al-naas be ta'liimah fi daar al-Yahuudiiya kullaha.Hu bada fi daar al-Jaliil wa hassa' ja hini fi Madiinat al-Khudus kula.
Wa wakit Bilaatus simi' kalaamhum da,hu sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Al-naadum da min daar al-Jaliil walla-?
Wa wakit hu irif kadar Isa min mudiiriiye al-tihit hukum Hiruudus,hu rassalah le Hiruudus.Wa fi l-wakit da,Hiruudus ja ziyaara fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa wakit Hiruudus chaaf Isa,hu firih bilheen achaan min wakit tawiil hu simi' khabarah wa yidoor yichiif Isa yisawwi leyah ajab.
Wa achaan da,sa'alah su'aal katiir laakin Isa ma radda leyah kalaam.
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-ulama waagfiin jambah wa gaa'idiin yathamooh be chidde.
Wa Hiruudus wa askarah hagaro Isa wa achchammato leyah.Wa fi chamaatithum di,labbasooh khalag sameh bilheen min khulgaan al-malik.Wa khalaas,gabbalooh le Bilaatus.
Wa min al-yoom da bas,Hiruudus wa Bilaatus bigo rufgaan.Wa awwal humman mukhaasimiin.
Wa Bilaatus naada kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-chuyuukh wa naas al-madiina.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Intu jibtu leyi al-naadum da wa gultu hu gaa'id yitallif al-cha'ab.Wa ana sa'altah adiil giddaamku wa ma ligiit foogah ayyi jariime.
Wa Hiruudus kula ma ligi foogah cheyy wa achaan da,gabbalah leena.Wa nuguul leeku hu ma sawwa cheyy fasil al-waajib leyah al-moot.
Wa khalaas,yajluduuh wa ba'ad da,natilgah.
Wa fi l-iid da,al-waali waajib yatlig leehum naadum waahid min al-makruubiin.
Wa kulla l-naas aato be hiss waahid wa gaalo-:-Aktul Isa da wa atlig leena Baraabaas-!
Wa Baraabaas hu al-naadum al-karabooh fi l-sijin achaan sawwa fitne fi l-madiina wa katal dimme.
Wa Bilaatus kallam leehum battaan achaan yidoor yatlig Isa.
Wa laakin kulla l-naas aato wa gaalo-:-Aktulah fi l-saliib-!Aktulah fi l-saliib-!
Wa battaan taalit marra,Bilaatus hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Maala-?Chunu al-fasil al-sawwaah-?Ana ma ligiit foogah ayyi jariime al-waajib leyah al-moot.Achaan da,yajluduuh wa khalaas natilgah.
Wa laakin chaddado fi kalaamhum wa be hiss foog gaalo-:-Aktuluuh fi l-saliib-! Wa khalaas,aayit al-naas jabarah.
Wa Bilaatus kharrar yantiihum al-cheyy al-talabooh minnah.
Wa khalaas,hu talag al-naadum al-gaa'id fi l-sijin achaan al-fitne wa l-dimme.Wa laakin sallam leehum Isa misil al-naas dawwarooh.
Wa wakit al-askar maachiin yiwaddu Isa,ligo naadum waahid usmah Sim'aan al-min hillit Khayrawaan al-jaayi min al-kadaade.Wa chayyalooh al-saliib wa jabarooh le yitaabi' Isa min wara.
Wa naas katiiriin maachiin wara Isa.Wa fi usuthum,fi awiin al-gaa'idaat yabkan leyah be hiss aali.
Wa Isa anlafat leehin wa gaal-:-Ya awiin Madiinat al-Khudus,ma tabkan leyi ana.Abkan le nufuuskan wa le iyaalkan.
Abkan achaan wakit waahid yaji wa fi l-wakit da,yuguulu-:--Mabruuk le awiin al-aagiraat wa l-ma wildan iyaal wa abadan ma radda'an sakhiir.--
Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-naas yasrakho min khoof chadiid wa yuguulu-:--Khalli al-jibaal yaga'o foogna wa khalli al-hujaar yadfunuuna.--
Fakkiran fi l-cheyy al-yisawwuuh leyi.Kan yisawwu misil da le l-hatab al-layyin,chunu al-yabga le l-hatab al-yaabis-?
Wa fi naaseen al-waddoohum min al-madiina achaan yaktuluuhum fi nafs al-bakaan ma'a Isa.Wa humman mujrimiin.
Wa wakit lihgo al-bakaan al-usmah al-Jumjuma,taggo Isa fi l-saliib wa rafa'ooh foog.Wa sawwo nafs al-cheyy le l-mujrimiin,al-waahid taggooh fi saliib jamb Isa be nussah al-zeenaay wa l-taani fi saliib aakhar be nussah al-israay.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi,saamihhum achaan ma fihmo al-cheyy al-humman gaa'idiin yisawwuuh. Wa l-askar sawwo am'iyeedaat achaan yigassumu ambeenaathum khulgaanah.
Wa l-naas wagafo gaa'idiin yichiifu.Wa l-kubaaraat gaa'idiin yichchammato leyah wa yuguulu-:-Hu najja naas aakhariin wa khalli yinajji nafsah kan sahiih hu al-Masiih wa l-naadum al-Allah azalah-!
Wa l-askar kula achchammato leyah.Jo wa gaddamo leyah charaab haamud
wa gaalo-:-Kan inta malik al-Yahuud,najji nafsak-!
Wa foog min raasah fi kalaam maktuub al-yuguul-:-Da malik al-Yahuud.
Wa waahid min al-mujrimiin al-mu'allagiin jambah ayyarah be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Haay-!Inta ma al-Masiih walla-?Najji nafsak wa najjiina aniina kula ma'aak-!
Laakin al-mujrim al-taani harajah wa gaal-:-Haay-!Inta ma khaayif min Allah walla-?Inta ligiit nafs al-azaab mislah.
Wa aniina,hakamoona be l-hagg achaan al-azaab al-yisawwuuh foogna waajib leena be sabab amalna.Laakin al-naadum da ma sawwa cheyy fasil.
Wa hajja battaan wa gaal-:-Ya Isa,fakkir foogi wakit tabga malik.
Wa Isa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Nuguul leek al-hagg,al-yoom tadkhul ma'aayi fi l-Janna.
Wa bigi nuss al-nahaar.Laakin al-wata bigat dalma fi kulla l-balad lahaddi l-asur.
Al-harraay ma gaa'ide tidawwi.Wa l-sitaar al-fi beet Allah anchagga min usut.
Wa Isa aat be hiss chadiid wa gaal-:-Ya abuuyi,ruuhi nantiiha leek fi iidak.Wa ba'ad gaal al-kalaam da,khalaas maat.
Wa kabiir al-askar chaaf al-cheyy al-bigi wa majjad Allah wa gaal-:-Akiid,al-raajil da saalih-!
Wa kulla l-naas al-katiiriin al-lammo le yichiifu,chaafo al-cheyy al-bigi wa bigo haznaaniin.Wa wakit mugabbiliin fi buyuuthum,gaa'idiin yuduggu sadurhum min al-nadaama.
Wa kulla l-naas al-ya'arfu Isa wa l-awiin al-machan waraayah min daar al-Jaliil waagfiin ba'iid minnah chiyya wa gaa'idiin yichiifu kulla cheyy al-gaa'id yabga.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid usmah Yuusuf.Wa hu min al-majlas al-kabiir wa hu naadum zeen wa saalih.
Hu ma khassad be kharaar al-majlas wa la be l-fi'il al-kubaaraat sawwooh.Wa hu min hille waahide hana l-Yahuud al-usumha al-Raama wa mu'min be mamlakat Allah al-jaaye.
Wa Yuusuf da,hu macha le Bilaatus wa sa'alah janaazit Isa.
Wa dalla al-janaaza min al-saliib wa kaffanaaha be kafan khaali.Wa waddaaha fi khabur waahid al-nakatooh fi hajar misil karkuur wa lissaa' ma dasso foogah ayyi janaaza.Wa raggad foogah janaazit Isa.
Wa da bigi fi l-yoom al-Yahuud yijahhuzu foogah le yoom al-sabt wa l-sabt yidoor yabda.
Wa l-awiin al-machan wara Isa min daar al-Jaliil machan ma'a Yuusuf wa chaafan al-khabur wa kikkeef khatto foogah janaazit Isa.
Wa gabbalan fi buyuuthin wa jahhazan dawa wa riihe le l-janaaza.Wa yoom al-sabt,hinna anjamman marra waahid hasab wasiiyat Allah.
Wa awwal yoom fi subuu' be fajur badri,al-awiin maragan le l-khabur wa chaalan ma'aahin al-riihe al-jahhazanha.
Wa chaafan al-hajar al-kabiir al-saddo beyah al-khabur,mudardag min bakaanah.
Wa l-awiin dakhalan fi l-khabur wa laakin janaazit al-Rabb Isa ma liganha.
Wa hinna barjalan bilheen.Wa ajala ke rujaal itneen baano jambihin wa khulgaanhum yidawwu deyy chadiid.
Wa l-khoof karab al-awiin wa dangaran wujuuhhin ale l-ard.Wa l-rujaal hajjo leehin wa gaalo-:-Maala tifattichan naadum hayy fi ust al-maytiin-?
Hu ma fiih hini.Hu ba'as khalaas.Fakkiran fi l-kalaam al-hu gaalah leekan wakit hu lissaa' gaa'id fi daar al-Jaliil.
Hu gaal-:--Ibn al-Insaan laabudda yisallumuuh le l-muznibiin wa yaktuluuh fi l-saliib wa fi l-yoom al-taalit,yab'as.-
Wa khalaas fi l-bakaan da bas,zakkaran fi l-kalaam al-Isa awwal gaalah da.
Wa gabbalan min al-khabur wa machan le l-rusul al-ihdaachar wa l-talaamiiz al-aakhariin wa ooranhum be kulla l-kalaam da.
Wa l-awiin deel hinna Mariyam al-Magdaliiye wa Jaana wa Mariyam amm Yaakhuub wa l-awiin al-ma'aahin wa hinna bas al-ooran al-rusul be l-kalaam da.
Wa l-rusul ma saddago be kalaamhin.Fi fikirhum,kalaamhin kalaam saakit bas.
Wa laakin Butrus gamma jara le l-khabur.Wa hu dangar wa taawag fi l-karkuur wa chaaf al-kafan wiheedah wa ma chaaf cheyy aakhar.Wa gabbal le l-beet wa l-cheyy da bigi leyah ajiib bilheen.
Wa nafs al-yoom,naaseen min al-talaamiiz maachiin le hille waahide usumha Imwaas wa hi gaa'ide misil achara kiilomitir min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa humman gaa'idiin yihajju ambeenaathum be kulla cheyy al-bigi da.
Wa wakit humman gaa'idiin yihajju wa yinaakhuchu ambeenaathum,Isa zaatah garrab leehum wa lihigaahum wa bada yuruukh ma'aahum.
Wa humman chaafooh laakin ma irfooh.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Da chunu al-kalaam al-gaa'idiin tihajju beyah fi l-derib da-?-Wa wagafo haznaaniin.

Wa fatah leehum uguulhum achaan yafhamo al-kutub.

Wa intu chuhuud fi kulla l-kalaam da.
Wa ana ninazzil foogku al-baraka al-abuuyi Allah gaal waa'adaaku beeha.Wa hassa' da,waajib tagoodu hini fi l-madiina lahaddi gudrat Allah tanzil foogku min al-sama.

Fi l-bidaaya al-Kalima gaa'ide.Wa l-Kalima gaa'ide ma'a Allah wa l-Kalima hi Allah.
Fi l-bidaaya hi gaa'ide ma'a Allah.
Wa kulla cheyy kaan be l-Kalima wa min kulla l-achya al-kaano,ma fi cheyy al-kaan balaaha.
Hi indaha al-haya wa l-haya hi nuur le l-naas.
Al-nuur gaa'id yidawwi fi l-dalaam wa laakin al-dalaam ma gidir yaktulah.
Wa Allah rassal naadum waahid usmah Yahya.
Hu ja achaan yachhad.Wa chahad le l-nuur achaan kulla l-naas yi'aamunu be l-nuur be sabab chahaadtah.
Yahya zaatah hu ma al-nuur laakin hu ja achaan yachhad le l-nuur.
Wa l-nuur al-sahiih ja fi l-dunya le yinawwir kulla l-naas.
Al-dunya kawwanat beyah wa laakin wakit hu ja fi l-dunya,naas al-dunya ma irfooh.
Hu ja le naasah wa laakin naasah ma khiblooh.
Laakin le kulla l-naas al-khiblooh wa aamano be usmah,hu antaahum al-hagg achaan yabgo iyaal Allah.
Wa yabgo iyaal Allah ma be waaluuda wa la be chahwat al-naas wa la be niiye hana ayyi raajil,laakin humman bigo iyaal Allah be gudrat Allah.
Wa l-Kalima bigat insaan wa hu sakan fi usutna.Wa chifna gudurtah al-majiide.Wa gudurtah hi majiide bilheen wa muwaafge le l-Ibn al-waahid al-jaayi min Allah abuuh.Wa hu malaan be l-rahma wa l-hagg.
Wa Yahya chaahid leyah wa naada al-naas wa gaal-:-Da bas al-naadum al-ooreetku beyah wa gult hu al-jaayi waraayi aali minni bilheen achaan hu mawjuud gubbaali.
Wa rahmatah kaamile wa kullina ligiina minha baraka fi baraka.
Allah nazzal churuut al-Tawraat be waasitat Muusa wa laakin Allah nazzal al-rahma wa l-hagg be waasitat Isa al-Masiih.
Abadan ma fi naadum chaaf Allah laakin Ibn Allah al-Waahid al-gaa'id jamb abuuh,hu bas al-bayyan Allah le l-naas.
Wa di hi chahaadat Yahya wakit kubaaraat al-Yahuud rassalo leyah rujaal diin wa Laawiyiin min Madiinat al-Khudus le yas'alooh hu yaatu.
Yahya ma nakar cheyy wa laakin chahad be kalaam waadih wa gaal-:-Ana ma al-Masiih.

Wa khalaas gaalo leyah-:-Inta yaatu-?Ooriina achaan nigabbulu le l-naas al-rassaloona wa ni'ooruuhum.Chunu al-kalaam al-tuguulah fi nafsak-?
Wa hu radda leehum be kalaam al-nabi Icha'ya wa gaal-:﴾‍Ana hiss al-gaa'id yi'iit fi l-khala wa yuguul-:-Addulu derib al-Rabb-!‍﴿
Wa fiyah Fariiziyiin been al-naas al-rassaloohum.
Wa humman sa'alo Yahya wa gaalo-:-Kan inta ma al-Masiih wa la Iliyaas wa la l-nabi al-yaji,maala inta gaa'id tikhattis al-naas fi l-almi-?
Wa Yahya radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ana nikhattis al-naas fi l-almi wa laakin naadum waahid gaa'id ma'aaku wa intu ma ta'arfuuh.
Hu bas al-naadum al-yaji waraayi.Wa ana ma tammeet leyah khaddaam kula.
Wa l-bakaan al-sa'alo Yahya foogah,hu fi hillit Beet Anya al-gaa'ide khaadi le bahar al-Urdun.Wa da l-bakaan al-Yahya gaa'id yikhattis foogah al-naas.
Wa ambaakir,Yahya chaaf Isa jaayi leyah wa gaal-:-Da bas al-hamal al-Allah rassalah achaan yuguchch zanib naas al-dunya.
Da bas al-naadum al-ooreetku beyah wa gult naadum waahid jaayi waraayi wa hu aali minni bilheen achaan hu mawjuud gubbaali.
Awwal ana ma iriftah.Laakin ana jiit nikhattis al-naas achaan niwassifah le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa Yahya chahad leyah wa gaal-:-Ana chift al-Ruuh al-Khudduus jaayi min al-sama wa nazal foogah misil hamaama wa ga'ad foogah.
Awwal ana ma iriftah laakin al-rassalaani le nikhattis al-naas fi l-almi,hajja leyi min awwal wa gaal-:--Al-naadum al-tichiif al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yanzil foogah wa yagood foogah,da bas al-naadum al-yikhattis al-naas be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.--
Wa khalaas,ana chiftah wa ana chaahid leyah hu Ibn Allah-.
Wa ambaakir,Yahya gaa'id fi nafs al-bakaan wa naaseen min talaamiizah gaa'idiin ma'aayah.
Wa Yahya chaaf Isa raayikh fi l-derib wa gaal leehum-:-Daahu hamal Allah.
Wa l-talaamiiz al-itneen sim'o kalaamah wa gammo taaba'o Isa.
Wa Isa anlafat wa chaafaahum jaayiin waraayah.Wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Tifattuchu chunu-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ya rabbaai,inta saakin ween-? Wa rabbaai ma'anaatah sayyid be l-lukhkha al-araamiiye.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ta'aalu chiifu al-bakaan. Wa da bigi fi l-asur.Wa macho ma'aayah wa chaafo al-beet al-hu gaa'id foogah wa fi l-yoom da,ga'ado ma'aayah.
Wa naadum waahid min al-naaseen al-sim'o kalaam Yahya wa gammo taaba'o Isa,usmah Andareeyas wa hu akhu Sim'aan Butrus.
Awwal cheyy,Andareeyas macha ligi akhuuh Sim'aan wa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Ligiina Massiiya. Wa Massiiya ma'anaatah al-Masiih be l-lukhkha al-araamiiye.
Wa Andareeyas wadda Sim'aan le Isa.Wa Isa chaaf Sim'aan fi uyuunah wa gaal-:-Inta Sim'aan wileed Yuuhanna.Yisammuuk Safa. Wa Safa ma'anaatah hajar wa be l-lukhkha al-yuunaaniiye da Butrus.
Wa ambaakir,Isa dawwar yamchi fi daar al-Jaliil.Wa ligi Filibbus wa gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal taabi'ni.
Wa Filibbus hu min hillit Beet Seeda wa di hille hana Andareeyas wa Butrus.
Wa Filibbus macha ligi Natanaayil wa gaal leyah-:-Ligiina al-naadum al-Muusa katab be sababah fi l-Tawraat wa l-anbiya katabo foogah fi kutubhum.Wa hu Isa wileed Yuusuf min hillit al-Naasira.
Wa Natanaayil radda leyah wa gaal-:-Haay-!Mata ke yoom waahid cheyy adiil ja min al-Naasira-? Wa Filibbus gaal leyah-:-Ta'aal ma'aayi wa chiifah-!
Wa Isa chaaf Natanaayil jaayi leyah wa gaal-:-Daahu Israa'iili sahiih.Hu ma yukhuchch ayyi naadum.
Wa Natanaayil sa'alah wa gaal-:-Kikkeef iriftini-? Wa Isa gaal-:-Chiftak wakit inta gaa'id tihit chadarat al-tiin gubbaal Filibbus ma yinaadiik.

Wa azamo Isa kula wa talaamiizah.

Wa ammah hajjat le l-khaddaamiin wa gaalat-:-Sawwu ayyi cheyy al-hu yuguulah leeku.
Wa fi sitte dawaayin kubaar gaa'idiin fi l-bakaan da.Wa dool dawaayin hana hajar wa yusubbu fooghum almi hana wadu al-Yahuud wa ayyi waahide minhum tichiil hawaale 100 liitir.
Wa Isa hajja le l-khaddaamiin wa gaal-:-Amlo al-dawaayin almi. Wa khalaas maloohum tak.
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Hassa' chiilu almi chiyya wa wadduuh le siid al-aazuuma. Wa khalaas waddooh leyah.
Wa siid al-aazuuma daakh al-almi wa ligiih bigi khamar.Wa hu ma irif al-khamar ja min ween wa laakin al-khaddaamiin al-kharafo al-almi irfooh.Wa siid al-aazuuma naada al-ariis
wa gaal leyah-:-Naas aakhariin yantu diifaanhum al-khamar al-halu awwal.Wa ba'ad al-diifaan chirbo katiir,yantuuhum al-khamar al-ma halu.Wa laakin inta akhkhart al-khamar al-halu wa hassa' bas anteetah leena.
Wa l-ajab al-Isa sawwaah fi hillit Kaana fi daar al-Jaliil,di awwal alaama al-Isa wassafaaha.Wa be misil da,hu wassaf gudurtah al-majiide le talaamiizah wa humman aamano beyah.
Wa ba'ad da,hu macha ma'a ammah wa akhwaanah wa talaamiizah fi hillit Kafar Naahuum wa ga'ado ayyaam.
Wa wakit iid al-Fisha hana l-Yahuud garrab,Isa macha fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa macha fi fadaayit beet Allah wa chaaf al-naas al-gaa'idiin yibii'u bagar wa khanam wa hamaam wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin yibaddulu gurus.
Wa chaal hubaal waahidiin wa sawwa beehum soot.Wa tarad beyah kulla l-naas min fadaayit beet Allah ma'a l-bagar wa l-khanam.Wa rama taraabiiz hana l-naas al-gaa'idiin yibaddulu gurus wa chattat gurushum.
Wa hajja be hiss chadiid le l-naas al-gaa'idiin yibii'u hamaam wa gaal-:-Amurgu khumaamku min hini-!Khallu minku al-tijaara fi beet abuuyi-!
Wa talaamiizah fakkaro fi l-kalaam al-maktuub al-buguul-:﴾‍Hubbi le beetak bigi leyi misil naar haragatni.‍﴿
Wa kubaaraat al-Yahuud sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Antiina daliil al-yiwassif al-amal al-gaa'id tisawwi-!
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Dammuru al-beet da wa ana nigawwimah fi talaata yoom.
Wa kubaaraat al-Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Al-beet da gaa'idiin yabnuuh min 46 sana wa inta tidoor tabniih marra taaniye fi talaata yoom-?
Wa laakin wakit Isa gaal al-beet da,hu ma hajja be l-beet al-banooh al-naas.Hu hajja be jismah.
Wa wakit Allah ba'as Isa min ust al-maytiin khalaas,talaamiizah fakkaro fi l-kalaam al-gaalah da wa aamano be l-kutub wa be kalaam Isa.
Wa wakit Isa gaa'id fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi iid al-Fisha,naas katiiriin aamano beyah achaan chaafo al-ajaayib al-Isa gaa'id yisawwiihum.
Wa laakin Isa ma aamanaahum achaan hu ya'arifhum adiil.
Wa ma dawwar yi'arrufu leyah al-naas achaan hu irif kulla cheyy al-gaa'id fi guluubhum.
Wa fi naadum waahid min kubaaraat al-Yahuud usmah Nigudiimus wa hu Fariizi.
Wa hu ja le Isa fi l-leel wa gaal leyah-:-Sayyidna,na'arfu kadar inta mu'allim al-jaayi min Allah.Naadum ma yagdar yisawwi al-ajaayib al-inta tisawwiihum illa kan Allah gaa'id ma'aayah-.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Asma' nuguul leek al-hagg,naadum ma yagdar yichiif mamlakat Allah illa kan hu mawluud min jadiid.
Wa Nigudiimus sa'alah wa gaal-:-Kan naadum bigi kabiir khalaas kikkeef yaldooh min jadiid-?Hal yagdar yigabbil fi batun ammah achaan hi taldaah marra taaniye walla-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Asma' nuguul leek al-hagg,naadum ma yagdar yadkhul fi mamlakat Allah illa be l-waaluuda al-jaaye be almi wa be Ruuh Allah.
Al-mawluud min insaan,hu insaan wa laakin al-mawluud min al-Ruuh,hu ruuh.
Ma ti'ajjib min kalaami kan gult leek waajib tabga mawluud min jadiid.
Al-riih tusuug fi ayyi bakaan al-hi tidoorah.Wa l-naas yasma'o hissaha laakin ma ya'arfu al-bakaan al-jaaye minnah wa la l-maache aleyah.Wa yukuun misil da le ayyi naadum al-mawluud min al-Ruuh.
Wa Nigudiimus gaal-:-Kikkeef da yabga-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta gaa'id ti'allim Bani Israa'iil.Kikkeef ma fihimt al-kalaam da-?
Asma' nuguul leek al-hagg,nihajju be l-cheyy al-na'arfuuh wa nachhado fi l-cheyy al-chifnaah laakin intu ma takhbalo chahaaditna.
Hajjeet leeku fi l-cheyy al-yabga fi l-ard wa ma aamantu.Wa kikkeef ti'aamunu kan nihajji leeku fi l-cheyy al-yabga fi l-sama-?
Ma fi naadum waahid tala' fi l-sama illa Ibn al-Insaan al-nazal min al-sama.
Fi l-sahara,Muusa rafa' al-daabifoog wa laabudda Ibn al-Insaan kula yarfa'ooh misil da
achaan kulla l-naas al-yi'aamunu beyah yalgo al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa Allah habba naas al-dunya bilheen wa achaan da,hu antaahum Ibnah al-Waahid achaan ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyah ma yahlak laakin yalga al-haya al-abadiiye.
Allah rassal Ibnah fi l-dunya ma le yihaakim naas al-dunya laakin le yinajjiihum beyah.
Al-naadum al-mu'min be Isa al-Masiih,Allah ma yihaakimah.Wa laakin al-naadum al-ma mu'min beyah,haakamah khalaas achaan al-naadum da aba ma aaman be Ibn Allah al-Waahid.
Wa daahu al-hukum,nuur Allah dakhal fi l-dunya wa l-naas habbo al-dalaam wa ma dawwaro al-nuur achaan amalhum cheen.
Ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yisawwi amal fasil yakrah al-nuur wa ma yaji fi l-nuur achaan ma yidoor amalah al-fasil yinchaaf.
Ayyi naadum al-yisawwi al-hagg yaji fi l-nuur achaan yabga waadih kadar al-amal al-hu sawwaah da,sawwaah hasab al-yidoorah Allah.
Wa ba'adeen,Isa chaal talaamiizah wa macha daar al-Yahuudiiya wa ga'ad ma'aahum ayyaam.Wa fi l-bakaan da,gamma yikhattis al-naas.
Wa Yahya kula gaa'id yikhattis al-naas.Hu gaa'id fi bakaan usmah Een Nuun gariib le hillit Saaliim achaan fi l-bakaan da,fi almi katiir.Wa l-naas jaayiin leyah achaan hu yikhattishum.
Wa da wakit lissaa' ma karabo Yahya fi l-sijin.
Wa talaamiiz waahidiin hana Yahya gammo yikhaalutu ma'a Yahuudi waahid fi wadu al-Yahuud.
Wa l-talaamiiz jo le Yahya wa hajjo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ya sayyidna,al-naadum al-kaan ma'aak wakit inta gaa'id khaadi le bahar al-Urdun,hu al-inta chahadt leyah,hu kula gaa'id yikhattis al-naas.Wa kulla l-naas maachiin leyah.
Wa Yahya radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-naadum ma yalga cheyy min Allah illa kan Allah antaah.
Intu zaatku simi'tu kalaami wa tagdaro tachhado leyi.Ana gult ana ma al-Masiih laakin Allah rassalaani achaan namchi giddaamah.
Al-naadum al-indah al-aruus,hu bas al-ariis.Wa rafiig al-ariis hu yagiif jambah wa yasma' kalaamah.Wa kan yasma' hiss al-ariis,hu farhaan be farha kabiire.Wa l-farha di,hi farha hinti wa hassa' ana farhaan marra waahid.
Waajib Isa yabga aali wa ana nabga tihit.
Al-jaayi min foog hu akbar min kulla l-naas.Wa l-naadum al-min al-ard hu hana l-ard bas wa yihajji fi cheyy hana l-ard.Al-jaayi min al-sama hu akbar min kulla l-naas.
Hu chaahid fi l-cheyy al-chaafah wa l-sim'ah wa laakin al-naas ma yidooru chahaadtah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-khibil chahaadtah akkad kadar kalaam Allah sahiih.
Al-naadum al-Allah rassalah yihajji al-kalaam al-jaayi min Allah achaan Allah yinazzil foogah Ruuhah bala hadd.
Allah yihibb Ibnah wa antaah kulla cheyy fi iideenah.
Ayyi naadum al-aaman be Ibn Allah ligi al-haya al-abadiiye.Laakin ayyi naadum al-yaaba ma yitaabi' kalaam Ibn Allah,hu ma yalga al-haya al-abadiiye achaan khadab Allah gaa'id foogah.
Al-Fariiziyiin sim'o kadar naas gaa'idiin yabgo talaamiiz le Isa wa Isa gaa'id yikhattis naas ziyaada min Yahya.Wa Isa irif humman sim'o al-khabar da.
Wa laakin be sahiih,Isa zaatah ma yikhattis al-naas,illa talaamiizah yikhattusu be iznah.
Wa achaan da,hu gamma min daar al-Yahuudiiya wa chaal derib hana daar al-Jaliil.
Wa waajib yuchugg daar al-Saamira.
Wa ja le hille Saamiriiye usumha Suukhaar wa hi gariib le l-zere' al-Yaakhuub antaah le wileedah Yuusuf.
Wa da bakaan al-foogah biir Yaakhuub.Wa Isa iyi min al-safar wa ga'ad tihit jamb al-biir yinjamma.Wa l-harraay bigat gaayle khalaas.
Wa mara Saamiriiye jaat achaan tichiil almi min al-biir.Wa Isa hajja leeha wa gaal-:-Antiini almi nachrab.
Wa talaamiizah ma fiihum.Humman faato fi l-hille achaan yachru leehum akil.
Wa l-Saamiriiye raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Haay-?Inta Yahuudi wa ana Saamiriiye.Kikkeef tas'al minni almi tachrab-? Wa gaalat al-kalaam da achaan al-Yahuud abadan ma yisallumu al-Saamiriyiin wa la yaakulu ma'aahum.
Wa Isa radda leeha wa gaal-:-Kan awwal irifti atiiyit Allah wa yaatu al-naadum al-gaa'id yas'alki almi,inti tas'aleeh wa hu yantiiki almi al-haya.
Wa hi gaalat-:-Ya l-sayyid,ma indak dalu wa l-biir tawiile.Almi al-haya tamurgah min ween-?
Jiddina Yaakhuub antaana al-biir di wa hu zaatah chirib minha almi ma'a awlaadah wa maalhum.Fi fikrak,inta akbar min Sayyidna Yaakhuub walla-?
Wa Isa radda leeha wa gaal-:-Ayyi naadum al-yachrab min almi hana l-biir di battaan al-atach yisawwiih.
Laakin ayyi naadum al-yachrab min al-almi al-ana nantiih abadan ke al-atach ma yakurbah.Al-almi al-ana nantiih yabga fi galbah misil een hana almi jaari wa yantiih al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa l-mara gaalat leyah-:-Ya l-sayyid,antiini min almiik da achaan al-atach ma yakrubni wa khalaas ma naji hini battaan nichiil almi.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Amchi naadi abu iyaalki wa ta'aali hini ma'aayah.
Wa l-mara gaalat-:-Ma indi raajil. Wa Isa radda leeha gaal-:-Kalaamki sahiih,ma indiki raajil.
Akhadti khamsa rujaal wa hassa' al-raajil al-inti gaa'ide ma'aayah ma raajilki.Gulti leyi kalaam sahiih.
Wa l-mara gaalat-:-Ya l-sayyid,hassa' bas ana irift inta nabi.
Juduudna abado Allah fi l-jabal da.Wa laakin intu al-Yahuud tuguulu Madiinat al-Khudus wiheedha al-bakaan al-foogah al-naas waajib ya'abudu Allah.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Mara zeene,saddigi kalaami.Fi l-wakit al-yaji gariib,intu ta'abudu Allah ma fi l-hajar da wa la fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Intu gaa'idiin ta'abudu Allah wa laakin ma ta'arfuuh.Aniina na'abudu Allah wa na'arfuuh achaan al-naja jaaye be waasitat al-Yahuud.
Wa laakin wakit jadiid yaji wa l-wakit da khalaas bada.Wa fi l-wakit da,al-naas al-ya'abudu Allah be ibaada sahiihe,ya'abudu Allah al-Abu be l-ruuh wa be l-hagg.Achaan di bas al-ibaada al-Allah abuuhum yidoorha.
Allah siid al-haya wa l-ruuh.Wa ibaadat al-naas ma sahiihe illa kan Ruuh Allah yuguudhum fi l-hagg.
Wa l-mara gaalat leyah-:-Ana na'arif kadar naadum waahid yaji al-yinaaduuh al-Masiih.Wa wakit hu yaji,hu yifassir leena kulla cheyy.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Ana al-nihajji leeki,ana bas hu.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,talaamiizah gabbalo.Wa chaafo Isa gaa'id yihajji ma'a mara wa al'ajjabo bilheen.Wa laakin ma fi naadum sa'alah wa gaal-:-Tidoor chunu-?Wa maala tihajji ma'aaha-?
Wa l-mara gammat wa khallat jarraha fi khachum al-biir wa machat fi l-hille daakhal.Wa hajjat le l-naas wa gaalat-:
Ta'aalu,chiifu al-naadum al-ooraani be ayyi cheyy al-ana sawweetah.Da bas al-Masiih walla-?
Wa naas al-hille gammo achaan yamurgu yilaaguuh.
Wa wakit al-mara gaa'ide tihajji le l-naas fi l-hille,talaamiiz Isa gaa'idiin ya'asuruuh wa yuguulu-:-Sayyidna,aakul.
Wa laakin Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ana indi akil intu ma ta'arfuuh.
Wa l-talaamiiz assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Naadum aakhar antaah akil walla-?
Wa Isa gaal-:-Al-rassalaani kallafaani be khidme wa waajib nikammilha.Wa da yabga leyi misil akli.
Ma ta'arfu al-masal al-buguul-:--Arba'a chahar wa ba'ad da,al-gati'---?Ana nuguul leeku,fukku uyuunku wa chiifu al-ziraa'a.Al-khalla nijdat khalaas wa wakit al-gati' ja.
Hassa' bas al-khaddaam al-yagta' al-khalla yalga ujurtah wa yilimm al-khalla wa yakhzinha le l-aakhira.Wa be misil da,al-naadum al-yiteerib wa l-naadum al-yagta',yafraho sawa.
Fiyah masal waahid yuguul-:--Naadum waahid yiteerib wa naadum aakhar yagta'.- Wa l-kalaam da sahiih.
Ana rassaltuku fi ust al-naas misil khaddaamiin al-yagta'o zere' wa intu tagta'o fi bakaan ma harattu foogah.Naas aakhariin harato wa intu talgo faayde min khidmithum.
Wa fi l-hille di,Saamiriyiin katiiriin aamano be Isa achaan sim'o kalaam al-mara wakit hi chahadat leyah wa gaalat-:-Hu ooraani be ayyi cheyy al-ana sawweetah.
Achaan da,al-Saamiriyiin jo talabo minnah hu yagood fi hillithum.Wa hu ga'ad ma'aahum yoomeen.
Wa naas ziyaada aamano beyah achaan sim'o kalaamah.
Wa hajjo le l-mara wa gaalo-:-Aniina ni'aamunu.Ma achaan simi'na kalaamki bas.Laakin aniina zaatna simi'na kalaamah wa na'arfu akiid hu bas al-naadum al-yinajji kulla l-naas.
Wa ba'ad al-yoomeen dool,Isa gamma macha le daar al-Jaliil.
Wa Isa awwal oora talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Kulla l-naas yikarrumu ayyi nabi illa naas hillitah ma yikarrumuuh.
Wa ja fi daar al-Jaliil wa naas al-Jaliil firho be jaytah achaan chaafo kulla cheyy al-sawwaah fi Madiinat al-Khudus fi ayyaam al-iid.Naas al-Jaliil kula macho ayyado fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Isa macha battaan fi hillit Kaana fi daar al-Jaliil.Da l-bakaan al-chaglab foogah al-almi wa bigi khamar.Wa naadum waahid gaa'id fi hillit Kafar Naahuum wa hu wakiil hana l-malik wa wileedah mardaan.
Wa wakit simi' kadar Isa gabbal fi daar al-Jaliil min daar al-Yahuudiiya,hu gamma macha leyah wa chahadah achaan yamchi ma'aayah wa yidaawi leyah wileedah al-gariib yumuut.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Intu ma ti'aamunu illa kan tichiifu ajaayib wa alaamaat min Allah.
Wa wakiil al-malik radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,ta'aal.Kan ma taji ajala,wileedi yumuut.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Amchi beetak.Wileedak yahya.-Wa l-naadum aaman be kalaam Isa wa chaal derbah wa gabbal beetah.
Wa wakit hu lissaa' maachi fi l-derib,khaddaamiinah gammo laagooh wa gaalo leyah-:-Wileedak hayy-!
Wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Min saa'a kam bigi leyah akheer-? Wa gaalo-:-Min amis al-saa'a waahid,al-wirde khallatah.
Wa abu al-wileed fakkar wa irif di bas al-saa'a al-Isa hajja leyah foogha wa gaal-:-Wileedak yahya. Wa hu aaman be Isa wa kulla naas beetah aamano ma'aayah.
Wa di l-alaama al-taaniye al-Isa wassafaaha wakit ja fi daar al-Jaliil min daar al-Yahuudiiya.
Wa ba'ad da,iid aakhar hana l-Yahuud garrab wa Isa macha fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi birke waahide gaa'ide fi Madiinat al-Khudus gariib le baab al-Khanam wa usumha be kalaam ibraani Beet Hisda.Wa fi khamsa rawaakiib jamb al-birke di.
Wa fi l-rawaakiib dool raagdiin ma'duuriin katiiriin,minhum al-amyaaniin wa l-uruj wa l-mukarsahiin.
Wa fi l-bakaan da fi naadum waahid ma'duur min 38 sana.
Wa Isa chaafah raagid fi l-bakaan da wa irif kadar hu tawwal ta'baan.Wa Isa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Tidoor talga al-aafe walla-?
Al-ma'duur radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-sayyid,ma indi naadum ma'aayi achaan yidissini fi l-birke wakit al-almi gaa'id yiharrik.Wakit nidoor nindassa fi l-almi naadum aakhar yindassa giddaami.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Gumm-!Chiil birchak wa amchi-!
Wa tawwaali,al-naadum ligi al-aafe.Wa chaal birchah wa gamma raakh.Wa laakin al-yoom da yoom al-sabt.
Wa kubaaraat al-Yahuud hajjo le l-naadum al-ligi al-aafe wa gaalo-:-Al-yoom da yoom al-sabt.Wa inta chaayil birchak wa da mamnuu'.
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-naadum al-chafaani gaal leyi-:--Chiil birchak wa amchi.-
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Yaatu al-naadum al-gaal leek chiil birchak wa amchi-?
Wa laakin al-naadum ma irif yaatu al-chafaah achaan Isa ba'ad minnah fi ust al-naas al-katiiriin al-gaa'idiin fi l-bakaan.
Wa ba'adeen,Isa ligiih fi fadaayit beet Allah.Wa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Khalaas,inta ligiit al-aafe.Khalli minnak zunuubak achaan cheyy gaasi min da ma yaji foogak.
Wa l-naadum macha le kubaaraat al-Yahuud wa ooraahum kadar al-naadum al-chafaah,hu Isa.
Wa min al-yoom da,al-Yahuud gammo yisawwu muchkila le Isa achaan hu gaa'id yisawwi amal misil da fi yoom al-sabt.
Wa Isa hajja le l-Yahuud wa gaal-:-Lahaddi l-yoom,abuuyi Allah gaa'id yakhdim wa ana kula gaa'id nakhdim.
Wa l-Yahuud zi'ilo minnah wa dawwaro yaktuluuh achaan hu yikhaalif churuut yoom al-sabt wa bigo za'laaniin minnah ziyaada achaan hu gaal Allah abuuh wa be da,hu sawwa nafsah misil Allah.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,Ibn Allah ma yagdar yisawwi cheyy be nafsah.Hu ma yisawwi cheyy illa l-cheyy al-yichiif abuuh gaa'id yisawwiih.Wa be misil da,ayyi cheyy al-Allah gaa'id yisawwiih,Ibnah kula yisawwiih.
Wa Allah yihibbah le Ibnah wa gaa'id yiwassif leyah kulla cheyy al-hu gaa'id yisawwiih.Wa yiwassif leyah a'maal kubaar ziyaada min dool achaan intu til'ajjabo minhum.
Wa Allah al-Abu yab'as al-maytiin wa yantiihum al-haya.Wa be misil da,Ibnah kula yanti al-haya le ayyi naadum al-yidoor yantiiha leyah.
Wa Allah al-Abu ma yihaasib ayyi naadum laakin hu kallaf Ibnah be kulla l-hisaab
achaan kulla l-naas yikarrumuuni ana Ibn Allah misil yikarrumu Allah.Wa l-naadum al-ma yikarrimni ana Ibn Allah,ma yikarrim Allah al-rassalaani.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yasma' kalaami wa yi'aamin be Allah al-rassalaani,al-naadum da indah al-haya al-abadiiye.Hu ma yadkhul fi l-ikhaab laakin hu marag min al-moot wa dakhal fi l-haya khalaas.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,wakit waahid yaji wa ja khalaas.Wa fi l-wakit da,al-maytiin yasma'o hiss Ibn Allah wa kan sim'ooh yahyo.
Wa misil Allah hu zaatah bas yanti al-haya,hu anta izin le Ibnah kula yanti al-haya mislah.
Wa Allah antaah izin le yihaasib al-naas achaan hu Ibn al-Insaan.
Ma til'ajjabo fi l-kalaam da.Yoom waahid yaji wa fi l-yoom da,kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi khubuurhum yasma'o hiss Ibn Allah
wa yamurgu.Wa l-naas al-sawwo al-kheer yab'aso le l-haya wa laakin al-naas al-sawwo al-charr yab'aso le l-hisaab.
Ana wiheedi ma nagdar nisawwi cheyy.Ana nasma' kalaam abuuyi wa ale hasab kalaamah bas,nihaasib al-naas.Wa nihaasibhum be adaala achaan ma nisawwi cheyy hasab fikri ana bas.Laakin nidoor nisawwi daayman al-cheyy al-yidoorah Allah al-rassalaani.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Kan ana wiheedi bas chaahid le nafsi,chahaadti di ma tanfa'.
Fi chaahid aakhar wa hu yachhad leyi wa ana irift chahaadtah leyi sahiihe.
Intu rassaltu naas achaan yas'alo Yahya wa hu radda leeku be chahaada sahiihe.
Ana ma nidoor chahaada insaaniiye laakin hajjeet be chahaadat Yahya achaan nidoor kadar intu tanjo.
Yahya hu bigi leeku misil faanuus muwalli' wa yanti nuur.Wa intu firihtu be nuurah le muddit wakit.
Laakin fi chaahid aakhar yachhad leyi wa chahaadtah akbar min chahaadat Yahya.Al-a'maal al-abuuyi Allah antaahum leyi wa ana gaa'id nisawwiihum lahaddi nikammilhum,dool bas yachhado leyi achaan ta'arfu be l-sahiih Allah rassalaani.
Wa abuuyi Allah al-rassalaani,hu zaatah chahad leyi.Hissah intu abadan ma simi'tuuh wa suurtah abadan ma chiftuuha
wa kalaamah ma gaa'id fi guluubku achaan ma aamantu be l-naadum al-Allah rassalah.
Intu gaa'idiin tagru al-Kitaab katiir achaan fi fikirku intu tuguulu talgo al-haya al-abadiiye.Al-Kitaab yachhad leyi ana
laakin intu abeetu ma taju leyi achaan talgo minni al-haya.
Ana ma nidoor chukur min al-naas.
Laakin intu,ana na'arif kadar fi guluubku ma tihibbu Allah.
Ana jiit leeku be usum Allah abuuyi wa laakin ma khibiltuuni.Kan naadum aakhar yaji be usmah halaalah,hu bas takhbalooh.
Kikkeef tabgo mu'miniin be l-sahiih kan intu tidooru chukur min akhwaanku wa ma tijaahudu achaan talgo chukur min Allah al-Waahid-?
Ma tukhuttu fi uguulku kadar ana al-naadum al-yathamku giddaam Allah.Da l-nabi Muusa bas al-yathamku wa hu al-naadum al-intu tukhuttu achamku foogah.
Wa kan be l-sahiih intu mu'miniin be Muusa,ti'aamunu beyi ana kula.Achaan Muusa katab fi chaani fi l-Kitaab.
Laakin kan awwal ma aamantu be l-kalaam al-Muusa katabah,kikkeef ti'aamunu be kalaami ana-?
Wa ba'ad da,Isa gamma faat wa macha fi nuss al-sabhaani hana bahar al-Jaliil al-ma'ruuf kula be bahar Tibiriyaas.
Wa naas katiiriin bilheen gaa'idiin yitaabu'uuh achaan chaafo al-ajaayib al-sawwaahum le l-mardaaniin.
Wa Isa tala' fi l-hajar wa ga'ad tihit ma'a talaamiizah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,iid al-Fisha garrab.Wa da iid al-Yahuud.
Wa Isa rafa' raasah wa chaaf naas katiiriin marra waahid jaayiin leyah.Wa hu sa'al Filibbus wa gaal-:-Nibii'u khubza min ween achaan kulla l-naas dool yaakulu-?
Wa Isa ya'arif tamaam al-cheyy al-yisawwiih laakin sa'al Filibbus achaan yijarrib iimaanah.
Wa Filibbus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan nachru khubza hana 200 diinaarkula,da ma yitimm leehum achaan ayyi waahid yalga lugma waahide bas-.
Wa tilmiiz waahid hajja leyah.Wa hu Andareeyas akhu Sim'aan Butrus wa gaal-:
Hini fi wileed waahid wa hu indah khamsa khubza hana gameh abyad wa huut itneen dugaag.Wa laakin da yanfa' chunu le l-naas al-katiiriin dool-?
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Ga''udu al-naas dool tihit. Wa l-bakaan da indah gechch katiir wa l-naas ga'ado foogah.Wa adad al-naas hawaale 5-000 rujaal.
Wa Isa chaal al-khubza wa chakar Allah.Wa gassamoohum le l-naas al-gaa'idiin.Wa chaal al-huut wa sawwa nafs al-cheyy.Wa kulla l-naas akalo lahaddi chib'o.
Wa ba'ad kulluhum chib'o,Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Limmu al-akil al-faddal achaan ma yiwaddir minnah cheyy-.
Wa lammooh wa malo 12 guffa min al-fadle al-faddalooha al-naas min al-khamsa khubza hana l-gameh al-abyad.
Wa l-naas chaafo al-ajab al-Isa sawwaah wa bado yihajju ambeenaathum wa yuguulu-:-Akiid,da bas al-nabi al-waajib yaji fi l-dunya-!
Wa Isa irif al-naas yidooru yakurbuuh wa yukhuttuuh fooghum malik be gu wa achaan da,khallaahum battaan wa macha wiheedah fi l-hajar.
Wa l-wata bigat makhrib wa talaamiizah dallo min al-hajar wa macho fi khachum al-bahar.
Wa rikbo fi markaba wa bado yagta'o al-bahar achaan yamchu le hillit Kafar Naahuum.Wa l-wata bigat leel wa Isa lissaa' ma ja leehum.
Wa riih chadiide gammat tusuug wa sabbabat challaal chadiid fi l-almi.
Wa wakit al-talaamiiz saago al-markaba khamsa aw sitte kiilomitir min khachum al-bahar,humman chaafo Isa.Hu raayikh min foog le l-almi wa gaa'id yigarrib le l-markaba.Wa humman khaafo khoof chadiid.
Laakin Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Da ana bas.Ma takhaafo-!
Wa khalaas khallooh rikib fi l-markaba.Wa tawwaali,wassalo fi l-bakaan al-yidooru yalhagooh.
Wa ambaakir,al-naas al-ga'ado jamb al-bahar fi nussah al-sabhaani fakkaro wa irfo kadar awwal fiyah markaba waahide bas wa Isa ma rikib foogha ma'a talaamiizah wa talaamiizah faato wiheedhum.
Wa maraakib waahidiin min hillit Tibiriyaas jo fi l-bakaan al-foogah al-Rabb Isa chakar Allah wa l-naas akalo al-khubza.
Wa wakit al-naas irfo Isa ma fiih wa talaamiizah ma fiihum,humman rikbo fi l-maraakib wa macho fi hillit Kafar Naahuum achaan yifattuchu Isa.
Wa gata'o al-bahar wa ligo Isa.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Sayyidna,jiit hini mata-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,intu ma fattachtuuni achaan chiftu al-ajaayib laakin fattachtuuni achaan akaltu al-khubza wa bigiitu chab'aaniin.
Ma tijaahudu achaan talgo al-akil al-yatlaf wa laakin jaahudu achaan talgo al-akil al-ma yatlaf wa yantiiku al-haya al-abadiiye.Da bas al-akil al-Ibn al-Insaan yantiih leeku.Hu al-naadum al-Allah abuuh chahad leyah wa akkad hu radyaan beyah khalaas.
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Waajib nisawwu chunu achaan nisawwu al-amal al-Allah yidoorah-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Daahu al-cheyy al-Allah yidoorah.Waajib ti'aamunu be l-naadum al-Allah rassalah.
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ween al-alaama min Allah al-tiwassifha leena achaan nichiifuuha wa ni'aamunu beek-?Weenu al-ajab al-tisawwiih inta-?
Zamaan,juduudna akalo al-manna fi l-sahara wa maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Hu antaahum akil min al-sama.‍﴿
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,al-antaaku al-akil min al-sama ma Muusa.Laakin abuuyi Allah bas yantiiku al-akil al-sahiih al-naazil min al-sama.
Achaan al-akil al-Allah yantiiku da,hu al-naazil min al-sama wa yanti al-haya le kulla l-naas.
Wa gaalo leyah-:-Ya sayyidna,antiina al-akil da kulla yoom.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ana bas Khubz al-Haya.Ayyi naadum al-yaji leyi ma yabga jii'aan wa ayyi naadum mu'min beyi ma yabga atchaan.
Wa ana ooreetku kadar intu chiftuuni laakin ma aamantu beyi.
Kulla l-naas al-abuuyi yikallifni beehum,yaju leyi wa ayyi naadum al-yaji leyi,ana abadan ma naturdah.
Ana nazalt leeku min al-sama achaan nisawwi hasab al-yidoorah Allah al-rassalaani wa ma achaan nisawwi hasab al-nidoorah ana.
Wa hu yidoor ana ma nikhalli naadum waahid yiwaddir min al-naas al-kallafaani beehum.Wa nigawwimhum kulluhum min al-moot fi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Da bas al-cheyy al-abuuyi yidoorah,kulla naadum al-yichiif Ibn Allah wa yi'aamin beyah yalga al-haya al-abadiiye wa ana nigawwimah fi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Wa fi chaan da,al-Yahuud gammo yihajju ambeenaathum wa yachku minnah achaan hu gaal hu al-akil al-nazal min al-sama.
Wa gaalo-:-Da ma Isa wileed Yuusuf walla-?Abuuh wa ammah na'arfuuhum.Kikkeef yuguul-:--Ana nazalt min al-sama---?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ma tachku minni ambeenaatku.
Naadum ma yagdar yaji leyi illa kan abuuyi al-rassalaani yijiibah leyi.Wa l-naadum al-yaji leyi nigawwimah min al-moot fi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Wa maktuub fi kitaab al-anbiya-:﴾‍Allah zaatah yi'allimhum kulluhum.‍﴿Wa ayyi naadum al-yasma' kalaam abuuyi wa yil'allam minnah,yaji leyi.
Ma fi naadum chaaf abuuyi Allah.Illa hu al-jaayi min Allah,hu wiheedah bas al-chaaf abuuyi.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,al-naadum al-mu'min beyi ligi al-haya al-abadiiye khalaas.
Ana Khubz al-Haya.
Juduudku akalo al-manna fi l-sahara wa laakin humman maato.
Wa daahu al-akil al-naazil min al-sama wa ayyi naadum al-yaakul minnah ma yumuut.
Ana Khubz al-Haya al-nazal min al-sama.Wa ayyi naadum al-yaakul min al-akil da,yi'iich daayman.Wa l-akil al-ana nantiih le naas al-dunya achaan yi'iichu,hu laham jismi.
Wa l-Yahuud alkhaalato wa gaalo-:-Kikkeef al-naadum da yagdar yantiina lahamah le naakuluuh-?
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,kan intu ma taakulu laham Ibn al-Insaan wa ma tacharbo dammah,ma talgo al-haya.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yaakul lahami wa yachrab dammi yalga al-haya al-abadiiye wa nigawwimah min al-moot fi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Achaan lahami hu akil sahiih wa dammi charaab sahiih.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yaakul min lahami wa yachrab min dammi yasbit foogi wa ana nasbit foogah.
Abuuyi al-rassalaani indah al-haya wa ana kula indi al-haya min abuuyi.Wa be misil da,ayyi naadum al-yaakul min lahami yahya achaan ana nantiih al-haya.
Wa khalaas,daahu al-akil al-nazal min al-sama.Hu ma misil al-manna al-juduudku akalooha.Humman maato laakin al-naadum al-yaakul al-akil al-ana nantiih yahya ila l-abad.
Wa kulla l-kalaam da Isa gaalah fi hillit Kafar Naahuum wakit hu gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi beet al-sala.
Wa talaamiiz katiiriin sim'o al-kalaam da wa gaalo-:-Al-kalaam da gaasi bilheen.Yaatu al-yagdar yahmalah-?
Laakin Isa irif fi galbah talaamiizah gaa'idiin yachku min kalaamah.Wa hu hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Tichakkuku achaan gult al-kalaam da walla-?
Tisawwu chunu kan tichiifu Ibn al-Insaan taali' fi l-bakaan al-awwal gaa'id foogah-?
Ruuh Allah yanti al-haya.Wa l-gudra al-insaaniiye ma indaha faayde.Al-kalaam al-gultah leeku jaayi min al-Ruuh wa yantiiku al-haya.
Laakin waahidiin minku ma yi'aamunu. Achaan min al-bidaaya,Isa irif yaatumman al-ma yi'aamunu wa irif yaatu al-naadum al-yukhuunah.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Achaan da bas gult leeku naadum ma yagdar yaji leyi illa kan abuuyi Allah antaah izin.
Wa min al-yoom da,talaamiiz katiiriin khallooh wa ma taaba'ooh battaan.
Wa Isa sa'al al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar wa gaal-:-Intu kula tidooru tikhalluuni walla-?
Wa Sim'aan Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,namchu ween-?Inta wiheedak indak kalaam al-haya al-abadiiye.
Aamanna beek wa na'arfu inta bas al-Khudduus al-Allah rassalah.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ya l-atnaachar.Ana zaati ma azaltuku walla-?Laakin waahid minku cheetaan-!
Wa fi l-kalaam da,Isa hajja be Yahuuza wileed Sim'aan al-Iskhariyooti al-ba'adeen yukhuunah.Wa Yahuuza da waahid min al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar.
Wa ba'ad da,Isa gamma yuruukh fi hillaal hana daar al-Jaliil.Hu ma dawwar yuruukh fi hillaal hana daar al-Yahuudiiya achaan kubaaraat al-Yahuud dawwaro yaktuluuh.
Wa iid al-Yahuud al-binaaduuh iid al-Lagaadiib garrab.
Wa akhwaan Isa gaalo leyah-:-Gumm min hini.Amchi fi daar al-Yahuudiiya wa khalli talaamiizak yichiifu al-amal al-inta tisawwiih.
Kan naadum yidoor yabga ma'ruuf,hu ma yilabbid amalah le l-naas.Kan tidoor tisawwi achya misil dool,khalaas amchi khalli kulla l-naas yichiifuuk-!
Fi l-wakit da,akhwaanah kula lissaa' ma aamano beyah.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-wakit al-Allah gata'ah leyi lissaa' ma ja.Laakin intu,tagdaro tamchu fi ayyi wakit.
Naas al-dunya ma yakrahooku wa laakin yakrahooni ana achaan ana chaahid fooghum wa nuguul amalhum fasil.
Intu gummu amchu wa ayyudu fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Fi l-iid da,ana ma nugumm.Al-wakit al-nugumm foogah lissaa' ma ja.
Wa hu gaal al-kalaam da wa ga'ad fi daar al-Jaliil.
Wa wakit akhwaanah gammo khalaas wa macho fi l-madiina le yi'ayyudu,Isa kula macha.Wa laakin ma oora naadum wa saafar be achiir.
Wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus,kubaaraat al-Yahuud gaa'idiin yifattuchu Isa fi ust al-naas al-jo le l-iid wa gaa'idiin yas'aloohum wa yuguulu-:-Hu gaa'id ween-?
Wa kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yihajju beyah ambeenaathum tihit tihit.Al-waahidiin gaa'idiin yuguulu hu naadum adiil wa waahidiin yuguulu hu gaa'id yukhuchch al-naas.
Wa kulla l-naas ma hajjo beyah be hiss aali achaan humman khaayfiin min kubaaraat al-Yahuud.
Wakit nuss ayyaam al-iidfaato khalaas,Isa dakhal fi beet Allah wa gamma yi'allim al-naas.
Wa l-Yahuud al'ajjabo bilheen wa gaalo-:-Kikkeef al-naadum da bigi aalim wa ma gara-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-kalaam al-ni'allimku beyah ma jaayi minni ana.Hu jaayi min Allah al-rassalaani.
Ayyi naadum kan indah niiye yisawwi kulla cheyy al-Allah yidoorah,hu ya'arif kan kalaami da jaayi min Allah aw jaayi minni ana bas.
Ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yi'allim al-naas be ta'liim haggah halaalah,hu yidoor chukur min al-naas.Laakin al-naadum al-yidoor al-naas yachkuru Allah al-rassalah,al-naadum da kalaamah sahiih wa hu ma yukhuchch ayyi naadum.
Muusa ma antaaku al-Tawraat walla-?Wa laakin ma fi naadum minku yitabbig churuut al-Tawraat.Maala tidooru taktuluuni-?
Wa l-naas raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ma ke-!Inta muchootin.Yaatu yidoor yaktulak-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ana sawweet ajab waahid fi yoom al-sabt wa intu kulluku ajjabtu minnah bilheen.
Tuguulu Muusa antaaku wasiiyat al-tahuura.Wa laakin be l-sahiih,juduudna al-awwalaaniyiin kula induhum al-tahuura gubbaal Muusa.Wa be sabab al-wasiiye di,intu titahhuru naadum hatta kan fi yoom al-sabt kula.
Wa kan titahhuru naadum fi yoom al-sabt achaan ma tikhaalufu Tawraat Muusa,maalku zi'iltu minni kan fi yoom al-sabt ana anteet al-chifa le kulla jisim al-naadum-?
Ma tahkumu be l-zaahir.Ahkumu be l-adil-!
Wa naas waahidiin min sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus assaa'alo wa gaalo-:-Da ma al-naadum al-yidooru yaktuluuh walla-?
Laakin daahu gaa'id yikallim fi ust al-naas wa l-kubaaraat ma yuguulu cheyy-!Akuun irfo khalaas hu al-Masiih.
Laakin al-naadum da,na'arfu al-bakaan al-jaayi minnah.Wa wakit al-Masiih yibiin,ma fi naadum ya'arif al-bakaan al-hu ja minnah.
Wa achaan da,wakit Isa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi fadaayit beet Allah,hu hajja be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Sahiih ta'arfuuni walla-?Sahiih ta'arfu al-bakaan al-ana jiit minnah walla-?Ana ma jiit be izni.Al-rassalaani hu bas saadikh wa intu ma ta'arfuuh.
Wa laakin ana na'arfah achaan ana jaayi minnah wa hu rassalaani.
Wa fi chaan da,naas waahidiin dawwaro yakurbuuh wa laakin ma fi naadum sawwa leyah cheyy achaan al-wakit al-Allah gata'ah leyah,lissaa' ma ja.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,naas katiiriin aamano beyah wa gaalo-:-Al-Masiih kan ja,yisawwi ajaayib ziyaada min al-naadum da walla-?
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yihajju tihit tihit ambeenaathum be Isa.Wa l-Fariiziyiin sim'oohum wa lammo ma'a kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa rassalo askarhum achaan yakurbu Isa.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ana nagood ma'aaku chiyya bas wa ba'ad da,namchi fi bakaanah hu al-rassalaani.
Wa intu tifattuchuuni wa ma talgooni wa l-bakaan al-ana nagood foogah ma tagdaro tamchu leyah.
Wa l-Yahuud hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Ween al-bakaan al-yidoor yamchi foogah wa aniina ma nagdaro nalgooh-?Hal hu yidoor yisaafir le l-Yahuud al-muchattatiin ajaanib fi buldaan al-Yuunaaniyiin walla-?Hu yidoor yi'allim al-Yuunaaniyiin walla-?
Wa hu gaal-:--Intu tifattuchuuni wa ma talgooni.- Wa battaan gaal-:--Al-bakaan al-ana nagood foogah ma tagdaro tamchu leyah.- Chunu ma'ana al-kalaam da-?
Wa aakhir ayyaam al-iid,hu akbar yoom fi l-iid.Wa fi l-yoom da,Isa gamma foog wa hajja le l-naas be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Kan ayyi naadum atchaan,khalli yaji leyi wa yachrab.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyi,almi al-haya yajri fi galbah misil buhuur wa da misil maktuub fi l-Kitaab.
Wa be l-kalaam da,hu hajja be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-ba'adeen yanzil fi l-naas al-mu'miniin beyah.Wa fi l-wakit da,Allah lissaa' ma nazzal al-Ruuh achaan Isa lissaa' ma tala' fi majdah.
Wakit al-naas sim'o al-kalaam da,waahidiin minhum gaalo-:-Akiid hu bas al-nabi.
Wa naas waahidiin gaalo-:-Da bas al-Masiih. Wa naas waahidiin gaalo-:-Haay-!Al-Masiih yaji min daar al-Jaliil walla-?Abadan.
Al-Masiih yaji min zurriiyit Sayyidna Dawuud wa min Beet Laham,al-hille al-rabbo foogha Dawuud.Ma maktuub fi l-Kitaab walla-?
Wa be misil da,al-naas ankhalafo ambeenaathum be sabab Isa.
Naas waahidiin dawwaro yakurbuuh wa laakin ma fi naadum sawwa leyah cheyy.
Wa l-askar gabbalo le kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-Fariiziyiin.Wa l-kubaaraat sa'alo al-askar wa gaalo-:-Maala ma jibtuuh leena-?
Wa l-askar raddo leehum wa gaalo-:-Abadan ma fi naadum hajja kalaam ajiib misil al-naadum da-!
Wa l-Fariiziyiin raddo leehum wa gaalo-:-Haay-!Hu khachchaaku intu kula-?
Fiyah naadum waahid min al-kubaaraat aw min al-Fariiziyiin al-aaman beyah walla-?
Naas al-hille dool ma ya'arfu al-Tawraat.Humman mal'uuniin-!
Wa Nigudiimus ma'aahum wa hu al-naadum al-yoom waahid macha hajja ma'a Isa be l-leel.Wa hu hajja leehum wa gaal-:
Charii'itna ma tikhalliina nahkumu le naadum gubbaal ma nasma'ooh wa ni'akkudu min al-cheyy al-hu sawwaah.
Wa l-kubaaraat raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Haay-!Inta kula min daar al-Jaliil walla-?Kan tagri al-Kitaab adiil ke wa tichiif ma fi nabi yaji min daar al-Jaliil.
Wa khalaas,kulluhum chatto wa ayyi waahid macha le beetah.
Wa laakin Isa macha fi jabal al-Zaytuun.
Wa be fajur,hu macha fi fadaayit beet Allah wa kulla l-naas jo leyah wa hu ga'ad tihit wa bada yi'allimhum.
Wa l-ulama wa l-Fariiziyiin jo leyah wa jaabo mara waahide al-karabooha gaa'ide tazna.Wa waggafooha giddaamhum.
Wa hajjo le Isa wa gaalo-:-Ya l-mu'allim,al-mara di karabooha gaa'ide tazna.
Wa fi l-Tawraat,Muusa amar wa gaal ayyi mara kan zanat waajib yarjumuuha.Wa inta,tuguul chunu-?
Humman gaalo al-kalaam da achaan yijarrubuuh.Dawwaro yalgo sabab achaan yathamooh beyah.Laakin Isa dangar wa bada yaktib be usba'ah fi l-turaab.
Wa sa'alooh su'aal katiir wa ba'adeen hu rafa' raasah wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ayyi naadum minku al-abadan ma aznab,khalli yazgul al-hajar al-awwalaani.
Wa dangar battaan wa katab be usba'ah fi l-turaab.
Wa wakit sim'o kalaamah da,khalaas kulluhum chatto minnah.Awwal al-kubaar wa waraahum al-sukhaar lahaddi faddal Isa wiheedah wa l-mara waagfe giddaamah.
Wa Isa rafa' raasah wa sa'al al-mara wa gaal-:-Mara zeene,ween humman-?Ma fi naadum yidoor yi'aakhibki walla-?
Wa hi gaalat-:-La,ya l-sayyid.Naadum ma fiih. Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Ana kula ma ni'aakhibki.Khalaas,amchi.Wa min al-yoom ma taznibi battaan.
Wa battaan Isa hajja le l-naas wa gaal-:-Ana nuur al-aalam.Ayyi naadum al-yitaabi'ni abadan ma yagood fi l-dalaam.Hu yi'iich fi l-nuur al-yantiih al-haya.
Wa l-Fariiziyiin hajjo leyah wa gaalo-:-Inta gaa'id tachhad le nafsak wa misil da,chahaadtak di ma indaha faayde.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan nachhad le nafsi kula,chahaadti indaha faayde achaan ana na'arif al-bakaan al-ana jiit minnah wa l-namchi leyah.Laakin intu ma ta'arfu al-bakaan al-ana jiit minnah wa la l-bakaan al-namchi leyah.
Intu tihaasubu al-naas be fikir insaani.Ana ma gaa'id nihaasib ayyi naadum.
Wa laakin kan ana nihaasib al-naas kula,nihaasib be adaala achaan ana ma nihaasib wiheedi.Abuuyi Allah al-rassalaani,hu ma'aayi.
Wa kitaabku al-Tawraat buguul chahaadat naaseen indaha sabaat.
Ana gaa'id nachhad le nafsi wa l-chaahid al-taani al-gaa'id yachhad leyi,hu abuuyi al-rassalaani.
Wa gammo sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Abuuk ween-? Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ma ta'arfuuni wa ma ta'arfu abuuyi.Kan awwal iriftuuni,ta'arfu abuuyi kula.
Wa Isa gaal al-kalaam da wakit hu gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi fadaayit beet Allah jamb sanduug al-maal.Wa ma karabooh achaan al-wakit al-Allah gata'ah leyah lissaa' ma ja.
Wa Isa hajja leehum battaan wa gaal-:-Ana namchi wa intu tifattuchuuni wa laakin tumuutu be zunuubku.Al-bakaan al-namchi leyah,intu ma tagdaro tamchu leyah.
Wa l-Yahuud gammo yihajju ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Hu gaal ma nagdaro namchu fi l-bakaan al-hu yamchi foogah.Hu yidoor yaktul nafsah walla-?
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Intu min naas al-ard wa ana min al-sama.Intu naas al-dunya di wa ana ma minha.
Wa gult leeku tumuutu be zunuubku.Akiid,tumuutu be zunuubku kan ma ti'aamunu kadar ana bas hu.
Wa achaan da,sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Inta yaatu-? Wa Isa gaal-:-Ana misil ooreetku beyah min al-bidaaya.
Indi kalaam katiir al-nagdar nuguulah foogku wa beyah nahkim foogku.Wa laakin al-rassalaani saadikh wa l-kalaam al-antaani,da bas al-kalaam al-nuguulah le naas al-dunya.
Wa ma fihmo kadar hu gaa'id yihajji leehum be Allah abuuh.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Wakit tarfa'o Ibn al-Insaan foog,ta'arfu kadar ana bas hu.Wa ta'arfu ana ma nisawwi cheyy wiheedi laakin al-kalaam al-abuuyi ooraani,da bas al-kalaam al-nuguulah leeku.
Wa l-rassalaani gaa'id ma'aayi.Hu ma khallaani wiheedi achaan nisawwi daayman kulla cheyy al-hu yarda beyah.
Wa wakit Isa gaa'id yuguul al-kalaam da,naas katiiriin aamano beyah.
Wa Isa hajja le l-Yahuud al-aamano beyah wa gaal-:-Kan tagoodu saabtiin fi kalaami,intu tabgo talaamiizi be l-sahiih.
Wa misil da,ta'arfu al-hagg wa l-hagg yiharrirku min al-ubuudiiye.
Wa l-Fariiziyiin raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Haay-!Aniina min zurriiyit Ibraahiim wa abadan ma fi naadum abbadaana.Kikkeef tuguul nabgo hurriin-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yaznib,hu bigi be sababah abid.
Wa l-abid ma yagood daayman fi beet siidah.Illa wileed siid al-beet yagood daayman.
Wa kan Ibn Allah yiharrirku min al-ubuudiiye,intu tabgo hurriin marra waahid.
Irift kadar intu min zurriiyit Ibraahiim laakin tidooru taktuluuni achaan fi guluubku ma tidooru kalaami.
Ana nihajji leeku fi l-cheyy al-chiftah wakit ana gaa'id ma'a abuuyi wa laakin intu gaa'idiin tisawwu al-cheyy al-abuuku ooraaku beyah.
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ibraahiim hu abuuna. Wa Isa gaal-:-Kan sahiih intu iyaal Ibraahiim,intu tisawwu al-cheyy al-Ibraahiim sawwaah.
Wa laakin intu tidooru taktuluuni wa ana jiit leeku achaan ni'ooriiku al-hagg al-Allah antaani.Da ma al-cheyy al-Ibraahiim sawwaah.
Intu gaa'idiin tisawwu al-cheyy al-abuuku yisawwiih-!-Wa gaalo-:-La.Aniina ma furuukh.Indina abu waahid bas wa hu Allah.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Kan sahiih Allah abuuku,intu tihibbuuni achaan ana jiit minnah leeku.Ana ma jiit be niiyti ana bas,laakin Allah rassalaani.
Maala ma fihimtu kalaami-?Intu ma fihimtuuh achaan intu ma tagdaro tasma'o ta'liimi.
Abuuku hu Ibliis wa intu iyaalah wa tidooru tisawwu al-cheyy al-hu yidoorah.Hu kattaal dimam min al-bidaaya wa abadan ma dawwar al-hagg achaan fi galbah,al-hagg ma fiih.Kalaam al-kidib bigi leyah lukhkhitah achaan hu kaddaab wa kulla l-kalaam al-kidib,hu abuuh.
Wa ana gaa'id ni'ooriiku al-hagg wa achaan da bas intu ma ti'aamunu beyi.
Tuguulu ana muznib laakin abadan ma tisabbutu tuhmitku.Kan ana nuguul leeku al-hagg,maalku ma ti'aamunu beyi-?
Kan naadum min Allah,hu yidoor yasma' kalaam Allah.Laakin intu ma tasma'o kalaam Allah achaan intu ma minnah.
Wa l-Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Kalaamna foogak sahiih-!Inta min daar al-Saamira wa inta muchootin-!
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-La,ana ma muchootin.Ana gaa'id nikarrim abuuyi wa laakin intu gaa'idiin ti'ayyubuuni.
Ana ma nidoor al-naas yicharrufuuni.Al-yicharrifni,gaa'id wa hu al-yihaakim.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-yitaabi' kalaami adiil,ma yumuut abadan.
Wa l-Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Khalaas-!Hassa' irifna inta muchootin-!Ibraahiim wa l-anbiya maato wa laakin inta tuguul ayyi naadum al-yitaabi' kalaamak ma yumuut abadan.
Tuguul inta akbar min abuuna Ibraahiim walla-?Hu maat.Wa l-anbiya maato.Tuguul inta yaatu-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan nicharrif nafsi,da ma yanfa'.Abuuyi hu al-yicharrifni wa intu tuguulu hu ilaahku.
Wa laakin intu abadan ma iriftuuh.Ana na'arfah.Kan nuguul ana ma na'arfah,ana nabga kaddaab misilku.Wa laakin ana na'arfah wa nitaabi' kalaamah.
Abuuku Ibraahiim farhaan achaan irif hu yichiif jayti.Wa chaafaaha wa firih.
Wa l-Yahuud gaalo leyah-:-Haay-!Lissaa' ma indak 50 sana wa tuguul chift Ibraahiim-?
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,gubbaal ma wildo Ibraahiim,ana hu al-Hayy-!
Wa battaan chaalo hujaar wa dawwaro yarjumuuh wa laakin hu allabbad minhum wa marag min beet Allah.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaa'id yuruukh wa chaaf naadum waahid mawluud amyaan.
Wa talaamiizah sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Sayyidna,al-naadum da wildooh amyaan be sabab zunuub yaatu-?Be sabab zunuubah hu walla zunuub waaldeenah-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Hu amyaan ma be sabab zunuubah wa la zunuub waaldeenah.Hu bigi misil da achaan amal Allah yibiin foogah.
Wakit al-wata lissaa' nahaar,waajib nisawwu al-amal hana Allah al-rassalaani.Al-leel yaji wa be l-leel,ma fi naadum yagdar yakhdim.
Wakit ana gaa'id fi l-aalam,ana nuur al-aalam.
Wa wakit Isa gaal al-kalaam da,hu bazzakh fi l-turaab wa ajjan tiine be buzaakhah wa masahha fi uyuun al-amyaan.
Wa gaal leyah-:-Amchi khassil wijhak fi birkit Silwaam. Wa khalaas,al-amyaan macha wa khassal wijhah wa gabbal yichiif.Wa l-usum Silwaam ma'anaatah al-mursaal.
Wa jiiraanah wa l-naas al-chaafooh wakit hu lissaa' gaa'id yas'al sadakha,assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Da ma al-naadum al-awwal gaa'id fi l-chaari' yas'al sadakha walla-?
Wa naas waahidiin gaalo-:-Aywa,da hu. Wa naas aakhariin gaalo-:-La,da ma hu.Da naadum aakhar yichaabihah bas. Wa l-naadum zaatah gaal-:-Ana bas hu-!
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Kan sahiih inta hu,kikkeef uyuunak anfataho-?
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-raajil al-usmah Isa ajjan tiine wa masahha fi uyuuni wa gaal leyi-:--Amchi le Silwaam wa khassil wijhak.- Ana macheet wa khassalt wa khalaas gaa'id nichiif-!
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ween al-naadum da-? Wa gaal leehum-:-Da ma na'arfah.
Wa waddo al-amyaan al-fatahooh le l-Fariiziyiin.
Wa l-yoom al-Isa ajjan foogah al-tiine wa fattah uyuun al-amyaan da yoom al-sabt.
Achaan da,al-Fariiziyiin kula sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Uyuunak anfataho kikkeef-? Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Hu massah uyuuni be l-tiine wa ana khassalt wijhi wa khalaas ana chift.
Wa Fariiziyiin waahidiin gammo yuguulu-:-Al-naadum al-sawwa al-cheyy da,hu ma min Allah achaan hu ma yitaabi' churuut hana yoom al-sabt. Laakin waahidiin gaalo-:-Naadum kan muznib,kikkeef yisawwi ajaayib misil da-? Wa be misil da,al-Fariiziyiin ankhalafo.
Wa battaan,sa'alo al-amyaan wa gaalo-:-Al-naadum al-fatah leek uyuunak da,inta tuguul foogah chunu-? Wa l-amyaan radda leehum wa gaal-:-Hu nabi.
Wa l-Yahuud ma saddago kadar hu awwal amyaan wa hassa' gaa'id yichiif,lahaddi naado waaldeenah.
Wa sa'alo waaldeenah wa gaalo-:-Sahiih,da wileedku-?Wa awwal mawluud amyaan walla-?Wa kan da sahiih,kikkeef hassa' yichiif-?
Wa waaldeenah raddo leehum wa gaalo-:-Na'arfu da wileedna wa na'arfu hu mawluud amyaan.
Laakin kikkeef hu yichiif wa yaatu al-fattah leyah uyuunah,da ma na'arfuuh.Hu raajil aagil.As'alooh,hu yihajji be nafsah-!
Wa waaldeenah hajjo misil da achaan humman khaayfiin min kubaaraat al-Yahuud.Wa l-kubaaraat awwal astafago ambeenaathum le yaturdu min beet al-sala ayyi naadum al-yuguul Isa hu al-Masiih.
Wa achaan da,waaldeenah gaalo-:-Hu raajil aagil.As'alooh hu.
Wa marra taaniye,naado al-amyaan al-fatahooh wa gaalo-:-Ahlif be Allah-!Aniina na'arfu kadar al-naadum da muznib.
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan hu muznib walla ma muznib,da ma na'arfah.Cheyy waahid bas na'arfah.Awwal ana amyaan wa hassa' ana gaa'id nichiif-!
Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Hu sawwa leek chunu-?Fatah uyuunak kikkeef-?
Wa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Awwal ana ooreetku,laakin intu ma dawwartu tasma'o kalaami.Maala tidooru ni'ooriiku marra taaniye-?Intu kula tidooru tabgo talaamiizah walla-?
Wa gammo ayyarooh wa gaalo-:-Inta bas tilmiizah-!Aniina talaamiiz Muusa-!
Na'arfu Allah kallam le Muusa wa laakin al-naadum da,ma na'arfu hu min ween.
Wa l-raajil radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kalaamku ajiib-!Hu fatah leyi uyuuni wa laakin intu ma ta'arfu min ween hu jaayi.
Kullina na'arfu Allah ma yasma' du'a hana l-muznibiin.Allah yasma' du'a hana l-naadum al-saalih al-gaa'id yisawwi al-cheyy al-hu yidoorah.
Min bidaayit al-dunya,abadan ma simi'na be ayyi naadum al-fatah uyuun hana naadum mawluud amyaan.
Kan al-naadum da ma jaay min Allah,hu ma yagdar yisawwi cheyy.
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Inta wildook wa rabbook fi zunuub.Ma tagdar ti'allimna cheyy-! Wa khalaas,taradooh min beet al-sala.
Wa wakit Isa simi' al-naadum al-awwal amyaan taradooh,hu macha ligiih.Wa gaal leyah-:-Inta mu'min be Ibn al-Insaan walla-?
Wa l-naadum gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid,hu yaatu-?Ooriini achaan ni'aamin beyah.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Inta chiftah wa hu al-naadum al-gaa'id yihajji leek.
Wa l-naadum gaal-:-Ya Rabb,ana mu'min beek. Wa sajad leyah.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ana jiit fi l-dunya le nijiib al-hisaab achaan al-naas al-amyaaniin yichiifu wa l-naas al-yichiifu yabgo amyaaniin.
Wa waahidiin min al-Fariiziyiin gaa'idiin ma'aayah wa sim'o al-kalaam da wa gaalo-:-Tuguul aniina amyaaniin walla-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan sahiih intu amyaaniin,intu ma khaatiyiin.Laakin gultu-:--Intu tichiifu--,wa achaan da al-khata yagood foogku.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,kan al-khanam gaa'idiin fi l-zariibe wa naadum ma yidoor yadkhul be l-derib wa laakin natta fi l-zariibe be bakaan aakhar,hu da sarraag wa mujrim.
Wa l-naadum al-yadkhul fi l-zariibe be l-derib,hu bas raa'i al-khanam.
Wa l-haras yaftah leyah al-derib tawwaali wa l-khanam ya'arfu hissah.Wa l-raa'i yinaadi khanamah al-halaalah.Hu yinaadi ayyi waahide be usumha wa humman yamurgu waraayah.
Wa wakit marag kulla l-khanam khalaas,hu yigaddim leehum.Wa l-khanam ya'arfu hissah wa achaan da yitaabu'uuh.
Al-khanam abadan ma yitaabu'u al-naadum al-ma ya'arfuuh wa yajru minnah achaan ma ya'arfu hissah.
Isa hajja leehum be l-masal da wa laakin ma fihmo kalaamah.
Wa achaan da,Isa hajja leehum battaan wa gaal-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,ana derib al-khanam.
Ayyi naadum al-ja gubbaali wa sawwa nafsah al-raa'i al-sahiih,hu sarraag wa mujrim.Wa laakin al-khanam ma sim'o hissah.
Ana al-derib.Ayyi naadum al-yadkhul beyi,yanja wa yabga misil al-khanamaay al-tadkhul wa tamrug tasrah fi l-gechch al-akhdar.
Al-sarraag ma yaji fi ust al-khanam illa le yasrighum wa yadbahhum wa yahlikhum.Wa laakin ana jiit achaan humman yalgo al-haya wa nantiihum al-haya al-afdal.
Ana al-raa'i al-adiil.Al-raa'i al-adiil hu al-naadum al-yafda khanamah be hayaatah.
Al-khaddaam al-yasrah be l-khanam achaan yalga gurus bas,hu ma al-raa'i al-sahiih wa l-khanam ma haggah halaalah.Wa kan yichiif al-marfa'iin jaayi,hu yajri minnah wa yikhalli al-khanam wiheedhum.Wa l-marfa'iin yakhtif khanamaay min usuthum wa yichattithum.
Wa l-khaddaam yakhdim achaan al-gurus bas,hu ma lammaah be l-khanam.
Ana al-raa'i al-adiil.Na'arif khanami wa humman kula ya'arfuuni
misil abuuyi ya'arifni wa ana na'arif abuuyi.Wa ana nafda al-khanam be hayaati.
Indi khanam aakhariin al-ma min al-zariibe di.Humman kula waajib niwaddiihum.Humman yasma'o hissi wa kulla l-khanam yabgo door waahid tihit raa'i waahid.
Abuuyi yihibbini achaan nanti hayaati le nichiilha ba'adeen.
Ma fi naadum yagdar yichiil ruuhi laakin ana nantiiha be niiyti.Indi gudra achaan nanti ruuhi wa indi gudra nichiilha battaan.Da bas al-cheyy al-abuuyi amaraani beyah.
Wa l-Yahuud sim'o kalaamah wa battaan ankhalafo.
Katiiriin minhum gaa'idiin yuguulu-:-Hu muchootin.Aglah laffa khalaas-!Maalku tasma'o kalaamah-?
Wa waahidiin yuguulu-:-Kalaamah ma kalaam hana naadum al-indah cheetaan.Hal cheetaan yagdar yifattih uyuun hana naadum amyaan walla-?
Wa fi l-chite,ayyado al-iid hana Tajdiid beet Allah fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Isa gaa'id yuruukh fi fadaayit beet Allah fi bakaan usmah raakuubat Suleymaan.
Wa l-Yahuud lammo katiiriin jambah.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ti'allig guluubna lahaddi mata-?Kan sahiih inta al-Masiih,khalaas ooriina be kalaam waadih.
Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Awwal ooreetku wa intu ma aamantu.Al-ajaayib al-nisawwiihum be usum abuuyi yachhado leyi.
Laakin intu ma aamantu beyi achaan intu ma khanami.
Khanami yasma'o hissi wa ana na'arifhum wa humman yitaabu'uuni.
Nantiihum al-haya al-abadiiye wa abadan ma yiwadduru.Naadum ma yagdar yakhtifhum min iideeni.
Abuuyi antaahum leyi wa hu akbar.Wa min iideen abuuyi,ma fi naadum yagdar yakhtif cheyy.
Ana wa abuuyi waahid.
Wa l-Yahuud chaalo battaan hujaar wa dawwaro yarjumuuh.
