Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ana sawweet giddaamku hasanaat katiiriin jaayiin min abuuyi.Ween hi al-hasana al-be sababha tidooru tarjumuuni-?
Wa l-Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ma nidooru narjumuuk be sabab hasana.Narjumuuk achaan inta muchrik.Inta insaani bas wa sawweet nafsak Allah-!
Wa Isa gaal-:-Akiid,ta'arfu al-kalaam al-maktuub fi kitaabku al-Tawraat kadar Allah gaal-:﴾‍Ana gult leeku intu ilaahaat.‍﴿
Wa Kitaab Allah daayman sahiih.Allah gaal-:--Intu ilaahaat-- le l-naas al-kalaam Allah ja leehum.
Wa ana bas al-Allah khaddasah wa rassalah fi l-dunya.Wa be misil da,maala tuguulu ana muchrik kan gult leeku ana Ibn Allah-?
Kan ana ma nisawwi amal Allah,khalaas ma ti'aamunu beyi.
Kan intu ma tidooru ti'aamunu beyi kula,aamunu be l-amal al-ana gaa'id nisawwiih.Be misil da,ta'arfu wa tafhamo kadar abuuyi gaa'id foogi wa ana gaa'id fi abuuyi.
Wa battaan dawwaro yakurbuuh wa laakin hu anbalas minhum.
Wa Isa gabbal fi l-nuss al-khaadi le bahar al-Urdun wa ja fi l-bakaan al-Yahya awwal khattas foogah al-naas.Wa ga'ad hinaak.
Wa naas katiiriin jo leyah wa hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Yahya ma sawwa ayyi ajab wa laakin kulla cheyy al-Yahya gaalah fi l-naadum da sahiih.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,naas katiiriin aamano beyah.
Wa fiyah naadum waahid mardaan.Usmah La'aazar wa hu saakin fi hillit Beet Anya wa di hille hana Mariyam wa akhutha Marsa.
Wa Mariyam di,hi al-mara al-masahat al-Rabb Isa be itir wa gachchat rijileenah be cha'arha.Wa akhuuha La'aazar mardaan.
Achaan da,al-akhwaat rassalan le Isa wa gaalan-:-Ya sayyidna,al-naadum al-tihibbah mardaan.
Wa Isa simi' al-kalaam da wa gaal-:-Al-marad da ma yikammil be l-moot laakin be sababah al-naas yimajjudu Allah.Wa be sababah Ibn Allah kula yimajjuduuh.
Wa Marsa wa akhutha Mariyam wa akhuuhum La'aazar humman rufgaan Isa wa hu yihibbuhum.
Wa min Isa simi' khabar hana marad La'aazar,hu ga'ad battaan yoomeen fi l-bakaan al-hu gaa'id foogah.
Wa ba'ad al-yoomeen dool,hu hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal-:-Namchu nigabbulu fi daar al-Yahuudiiya.
Wa talaamiizah raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Sayyidna,awwal al-Yahuud dawwaro yarjumuuk.Wa battaan tidoor tigabbil fi bakaanhum walla-?
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Al-nahaar ma indah 12 saa'a walla-?Kan naadum raayikh fi l-nahaar,hu ma yaga' achaan deyy hana l-dunya gaa'id wa hu yichiif beyah.
Wa laakin kan naadum raayikh fi l-leel,hu yaga' achaan ma indah deyy.
Wa hu radda leehum be l-kalaam da wa battaan hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Rafiigna La'aazar naam khalaas laakin namchi leyah nigawwimah.
Wa talaamiizah gaalo-:-Sayyidna,kan hu naayim,da sameh.Hu yalga al-aafe.
Wa fi fikir al-talaamiiz,Isa hajja leehum be l-noom bas laakin Isa hajja be l-moot.
Wa khalaas,Isa ooraahum be kalaam waadih wa gaal-:-La'aazar maat.
Ana ma kunt hinaak.Wa ana farhaan fi chaanku achaan be misil da,ti'aamunu beyi.Khalaas,gummu namchu leyah.
Wa Tuuma al-yinaaduuh Chigg al-Toom hajja le l-talaamiiz wa gaal-:-Khalaas,namchu ma'aayah wa numuutu ma'aayah.
Wa wakit Isa wisil fi hillit Beet Anya,oorooh La'aazar gaa'id fi l-khabur min muddit arba'a yoom.
Wa l-hille gaa'ide misil talaata kiilomitir bas min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Yahuud katiiriin jo min al-madiina le yikalwudu le Marsa wa Mariyam fi akhuuhin.
Wa wakit Marsa sim'at Isa jaayi,hi gammat wa maragat achaan tilaagiih.Wa Mariyam ga'adat fi l-beet.
Wa Marsa gaalat leyah-:-Sayyidna,kan awwal inta haadir,akhuuyi ma yumuut.
Laakin hassa' kula na'arif kadar ayyi cheyy al-tas'alah min Allah,hu yantiik.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Akhuuki yugumm.
Wa Marsa gaalat leyah-:-Na'arif kadar hu yab'as ma'a l-maytiin fi l-bu'aas al-yabga fi yoom al-akhiir.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Ana al-bu'aas wa l-haya.Ayyi naadum mu'min beyi,kan yumuut kula,hu yahya.
Wa ayyi naadum al-aayich mu'min beyi,abadan ma yumuut.Kalaami da,inti mu'mine beyah walla-?
Wa hi gaalat leyah-:-Aywa,sayyidna,ana mu'mine beek.Inta al-Masiih Ibn Allah.Inta hu al-laabudda yaji fi l-dunya.
Wa hi gaalat al-kalaam da wa gammat machat le akhutha Mariyam wa hajjat leeha be hiss tihit wa gaalat-:-Al-mu'allim ja wa gaa'id yinaadiiki.
Wakit Mariyam sim'at kalaamha,hi gammat ajala wa machat leyah.
Wa Isa lissaa' ma dakhal fi l-hille wa gaa'id fi l-bakaan al-Marsa laagatah foogah.
Wa wakit al-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin ma'a Mariyam fi l-beet chaafooha gammat maragat ajala,humman taaba'ooha.Fi fikirhum,hi tidoor tamchi le l-khabur achaan tabki hinaak.
Wa Mariyam jaat fi l-bakaan al-Isa gaa'id foogah wa wakit chaafatah,hi waga'at giddaamah wa gaalat-:-Sayyidna,kan awwal inta haadir,akhuuyi ma yumuut.
Wa wakit Isa chaaf dumuu'ha wa dumuu' al-Yahuud al-ma'aaha,hu hizin marra waahid wa barjal.
Wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Ween al-bakaan al-dafanooh foogah-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ta'aal sayyidna,chiif.
Wa Isa baka.
Wa achaan da,al-Yahuud al-jo fi l-maytam gaalo-:-Chiifuuh.Hu yihibbah le La'aazar bilheen.
Wa laakin naas waahidiin gaalo-:-Haay-!Da bas al-naadum al-fatah uyuun al-amyaan.Kikkeef ma gidir yadhar al-moot min al-naadum da-?
Wa Isa hizin marra waahid battaan wa ja le l-khabur.Wa l-khabur hu karkuur wa saddooh be hajar kabiir.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Lizzu al-hajar min khachum al-khabur. Laakin Marsa akhut al-marhuum gaalat-:-Sayyidna,hu mayyit min arba'a yoom wa akiid al-janaaza affanat.
Wa Isa gaal leeha-:-Ana ma ooreetki walla-?Kan ti'aamini,tichiifi gudrat Allah al-majiide.
Wa lazzo al-hajar.Wa Isa rafa' raasah wa gaal-:-Abuuyi,nachkurak achaan inta simi't hissi.
Ana irift inta daayman tasma' hissi wa laakin gult al-kalaam da achaan al-naas al-haadiriin yi'aamunu kadar inta bas rassaltini.
Wa wakit hu gaal al-kalaam da khalaas,hajja be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Ya La'aazar,amrug-!
Wa l-mayyit marag.Iideenah wa rijileenah malfuufiin be l-gabag al-kaffanooh beyah wa mindiil marbuut fi wijhah.Wa Isa amaraahum le l-naas wa gaal-:-Fartugu minnah al-kafan wa khalluuh yamchi.
Wa be misil da,naas katiiriin min al-Yahuud al-jo yikalwudu le Mariyam chaafo al-ajab al-Isa sawwaah wa aamano beyah.
Wa laakin waahidiin minhum macho le l-Fariiziyiin wa ooroohum be l-cheyy al-Isa sawwaah.
Wa achaan da,kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-Fariiziyiin naado naas hana l-majlas al-kabiir yilimmu.Wa assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Nisawwu chunu-?Al-naadum da gaa'id yisawwi ajaayib katiiriin.
Kan ma nadharooh min al-cheyy al-gaa'id yisawwiih,kulla l-naas yi'aamunu beyah wa l-Roomaaniyiin yaju wa yidammuru beetna al-mukhaddas wa yichattutu cha'abna.
Wa naadum waahid minhum usmah Gayaafa wa fi l-sana di,hu kabiir rujaal al-diin.Wa hu hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Intu ma ta'arfu cheyy.
Ma fihimtu kadar akheer leeku kan naadum waahid yumuut le l-cha'ab wa be misil da,kulla l-umma ma tiwaddir.
Wa kalaamah da ma jaay min nafsah.Hu kabiir rujaal al-diin fi l-sana di wa achaan da,hu atnabba' wa gaal Isa yumuut le l-umma.
Wa da ma le ummat al-Yahuud wiheedha.Da yabga le kulla iyaal Allah al-muchattatiin le yilimmuuhum umma waahide.
Wa min al-yoom da,bado yichchaawaro ambeenaathum achaan yaktulu Isa.
Wa achaan da,hu waggaf ruwaakhtah fi ust al-Yahuud.Wa gamma min hinaak wa macha fi hille waahide jamb al-sahara al-usumha Afraayim wa ga'ad hinaak ma'a talaamiizah.
Wa iid al-Yahuud al-binaaduuh iid al-Fisha garrab.Wa naas katiiriin gammo min hillaalhum wa macho fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yitahhuru nufuushum gubbaal al-iid.
Wa l-naas dawwaro yichiifu Isa.Wa fi fadaayit beet Allah gaa'idiin yissaa'alo ambeenaathum wa yuguulu-:-Fikirku chunu-?Hu yaji hini fi l-iid walla-?
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-Fariiziyiin amaroohum le l-naas wa gaalo leehum kan naadum ya'arif al-bakaan al-Isa gaa'id foogah,waajib yaji yi'ooriihum achaan yakurbuuh.
Wa sitte yoom gubbaal iid al-Fisha,Isa ja fi hillit Beet Anya.Wa da l-bakaan al-La'aazar saakin foogah,hu al-naadum al-Isa gawwamah min al-moot.
Wa hassalo le Isa acha.Wa La'aazar waahid min al-naas al-yaakulu ma'aayah wa Marsa faddalathum.
Wa Mariyam jaat wa jaabat nuss liitir hana itir asli wa khaali bilheen al-usmah naardiin.Wa sabbat al-itir fi rijileen Isa wa gachchathum be cha'arha.Wa riihit al-itir saddat al-beet marra waahid.
Wa laakin tilmiiz waahid gamma hajja wa hu Yahuuza al-Iskhariyooti al-ba'ad ayyaam yukhuun Isa.Wa hu gaal-:
Maala ma baa'o al-itir da-?Akuun yalgo minnah 300 diinaar achaan yantuuh le l-masaakiin.
Wa Yahuuza ma gaal al-kalaam da achaan hu hanuun le l-masaakiin laakin achaan hu sarraag.Hu mas'uul fi sanduug hana gurushum wa gaa'id yichiil min al-gurus.
Wa Isa gaal-:-Ma tahrijha.Hi sabbat al-itir fi jismi achaan tijahhizni le l-khabur.
Al-masaakiin gaa'idiin ma'aaku daayman wa laakin ana kamaan ma nagood ma'aaku daayman.
Wa l-Yahuud al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus sim'o Isa gaa'id fi hillit Beet Anya wa naas katiiriin marago leyah.Ma macho yichiifu Isa bas laakin dawwaro yichiifu La'aazar kula achaan hu al-naadum al-Isa gawwamah min al-moot.
Wa achaan da,kubaaraat rujaal al-diin chaalo niiye le yaktulu La'aazar kula.
Achaan be sabab La'aazar,Yahuud katiiriin gaa'idiin yikissu minhum wa yi'aamunu be Isa.
Wa naas katiiriin jo fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yi'ayyudu.Wa humman sim'o khabar Isa yidoor yaji fi l-madiina.
Wa gata'o firi' min nakhal wa macho beyah achaan yilaaguuh.Wa gaalo be hiss aali-:-Al-hamdulillah-!﴾‍Mabruuk le l-naadum al-jaayi be usum Allah-!‍﴿Mabruuk le malik Israa'iil-!
Wa Isa chaal humaar wa rikib foogah.Wa da bigi misil awwal maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:
﴾‍Ya Sahyuun al-misil bineeye,ma takhaafe.Daahu malikki jaayi leekiraakib fi dahach wileed humaara.‍﴿
Wa talaamiizah awwal ma fihmo al-cheyy al-bigi da.Wa laakin wakit Allah rafa' Isa fi majdah,humman fakkaro wa irfo kadar al-naas sawwo leyah al-cheyy al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab.
Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'a Isa yoom hu naada La'aazar min al-khabur wa gawwamah,humman hajjo le l-naas al-aakhariin wa chahado leyah.
Wa l-naas al-jo fi Madiinat al-Khudus sim'o khabar al-ajab da wa gammo macho laagooh.
Wa l-Fariiziyiin hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Chiifu,ma nagdaro nisawwu cheyy.Kulla l-naas gammo taaba'ooh.
Wa fiyah Yuunaaniyiin waahidiin fi ust al-naas al-jo fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan ya'abudu Allah fi wakit al-iid.
Wa l-Yuunaaniyiin jo le Filibbus al-tilmiiz al-min hillit Beet Seeda fi daar al-Jaliil wa gaddamo leyah talab.Wa gaalo-:-Ya l-sayyid,nidooru nichiifu Isa.
Wa Filibbus gamma oora Andareeyas.Wa Andareeyas wa Filibbus macho wa ooro Isa.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Khalaas,al-wakit al-Allah gata'ah le Ibn al-Insaan tamma.Wa hassa' Allah yarfa'ah fi majdah.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,kan habba hana teeraab al-gameh ma taga' fi l-turaab wa ma tumuut,hi tagood habba waahide bas.Wa laakin kan hi tumuut,talda iyaal katiir.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yihibb hayaatah yiwaddirha.Wa l-yakrah hayaatah fi l-dunya,yalga al-haya al-abadiiye.
Kan naadum yidoor yakhdim leyi,waajib yitaabi'ni.Wa fi l-bakaan al-ana nagood foogah,khaddaami kula yagood foogah.Wa ayyi naadum al-yakhdim leyi,Abuuyi yicharrifah.
Wa hassa' galbi mu'allag wa nuguul chunu-?Hal nuguul-:--Ya Abuuyi,al-wakit tamma.Najjiini minnah---?La,da ma nuguulah.Ana jiit fi chaan al-wakit da bas.
Akheer nuguul-:--Ya Abuuyi,majjid usmak-!--Wa hiss Allah ansama' min al-sama wa gaal-:-Ana majjadtah wa nimajjidah battaan.
Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi l-bakaan da sim'o al-hiss wa gaalo-:-Da dagdaag. Wa naas waahidiin gaalo-:-Waahid min al-malaa'ika hajja leyah.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-hiss da ansama' ma le faayditi ana laakin le faayditku intu.
Hassa' bas al-ikhaab yaji fi l-dunya.Wa hassa' bas yintarid Ibliis sultaan al-dunya.
Wa ana,wakit yarfa'ooni foog min al-ard,nilimm kulla l-naas aleyi.
Wa Isa gaal al-kalaam da achaan yi'ooriihum be kikkeef hu yumuut.
Wa l-naas al-haadiriin raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Allamoona min kitaab al-Tawraat kadar al-Masiih yagood ila l-abad.Wa be da,maalak gult Ibn al-Insaan laabudda yarfa'ooh-?Wa Ibn al-Insaan da,hu yaatu-?
Wa Isa gaal leehum-:-Al-nuur yagood ma'aaku wakit chiyya bas.Ruukhu fi l-nuur achaan al-dalaam ma yinnasir foogku.Al-naadum al-yuruukh fi l-dalaam ma ya'arif al-bakaan al-hu maachi leyah.
Wakit al-nuur lissaa' ma'aaku,aamunu be l-nuur.Wa be misil da,tabgo ahal al-nuur. Wa ba'ad Isa gaal al-kalaam da,hu macha wa allabbad minhum.
Isa sawwa ajaayib katiiriin fi ust al-Yahuud wa laakin be da kula,humman ma aamano beyah.
Wa be misil da,kalaam al-nabi Icha'ya tamma.Hu gaal-:﴾‍Ya Allah,yaatu al-aaman be khabarna-?Wa gudrat Allah baanat le yaatu-?‍﴿
Wa l-Yahuud ma gidro yi'aamunu beyah achaan Icha'ya kula gaal-:
﴾‍Allah ama uyuunhum wa gawwa guluubhum achaan ma yichiifu be uyuunhum wa ma yafhamo be guluubhum.Wa be da,ma yutuubu achaan nachfiihum.‍﴿
Wa Icha'ya gaal al-kalaam da achaan hu chaaf majd al-Masiih wa hajja beyah.
Wa fi l-wakit da kula,naas katiiriin min al-kubaaraat aamano be Isa.Wa laakin ma gaalo cheyy giddaam al-naas achaan humman khaayfiin min al-Fariiziyiin.Humman ma dawwaro al-Fariiziyiin yaturduuhum min buyuut al-sala
achaan dawwaro rida al-naas ziyaada min rida Allah.
Wa Isa hajja be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Ayyi naadum al-mu'min beyi,hu ma mu'min beyi ana bas laakin hu mu'min be Allah al-rassalaani kula.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yichiifni,yichiif al-rassalaani kula.
Ana jiit fi l-dunya misil nuur achaan ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyi ma yagood fi l-dalaam.
Kan naadum yasma' kalaami wa ma yitaabi'ah,ana zaati ma nihaakimah achaan ana ma jiit le nihaakim naas al-dunya laakin jiit le ninajji naas al-dunya.
Al-naadum al-yaabaani wa ma yitaabi' kalaami indah gaadi al-yihaakimah.Al-kalaam al-ana gultah yijiib foogah al-hukum fi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Wa yabga misil da,achaan ana ma kallamt hasab raayi ana bas.Abuuyi Allah rassalaani be wasiiytah wa ooraani kulla l-kalaam al-waajib nuguulah.
Wa ana na'arif kadar wasiiyat Allah tanti al-haya al-abadiiye.Wa achaan da,ana nuguul al-kalaam al-abuuyi ooraani beyah.
Wa gubbaal iid al-Fisha ma yabda,Isa irif kadar waktah tamma wa laabudda yamrug min al-dunya wa yigabbil le abuuh.Wa min al-bidaaya,hu yihibb naasah al-gaa'idiin fi l-dunya wa yihibbuhum hubb chadiid.
Wa Isa wa talaamiizah gaa'idiin fi l-acha.Wa fi l-wakit da,khalaas Ibliis dassa niiyit al-khiyaana fi galib Yahuuza wileed Sim'aan al-Iskhariyooti achaan yukhuun Isa.
Wa Isa ya'arif kadar hu ja min Allah wa yigabbil le Allah wa ya'arif kadar abuuh antaah gudra fi kulla cheyy.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yaakulu,Isa gamma foog wa salla khalagah al-barraani wa chaal al-git'e al-buguchchu beeha wa rabat beeha sulbah.
Wa sabba almi fi maa'uun wa bada yikhassil rijle talaamiizah.Wa gachchaahum be l-git'e al-rabat beeha sulbah.
Wa ja le Sim'aan Butrus.Wa Sim'aan Butrus gaal-:-Sayyidna,tidoor tikhassil rijileeni walla-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta lissaa' ma fihimt al-cheyy al-ana gaa'id nisawwiih laakin ba'adeen tafhamah.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus gaal-:-Abadan ma tikhassil rijileeni-! Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan ana ma nikhassilak,inta ma indak hagg ma'aayi.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus gaal-:-Sayyidna,kan yabga misil da,ma tikhassil rijileeni bas.Khassil iideeni wa raasi kula-!
Wa Isa gaal-:-Kan naadum albarrad khalaas,al-khasuul ma waajib leyah illa fi rijileenah.Hu nadiif marra waahid.Wa intu nudaaf laakin ma kulluku.
Wa Isa irif al-naadum al-yidoor yukhuunah wa achaan da gaal-:-Ma kulluku nudaaf.
Wa wakit Isa khassal rijleehum khalaas,hu libis khalagah wa gabbal fi bakaanah wa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ta'arfu al-cheyy al-ana sawweetah leeku walla-?
Intu tuguulu ana mu'allimku wa sayyidku wa kalaamku sahiih.
Wa kan ana sayyidku wa mu'allimku wa ana khassalt rijleeku,waajib ayyi waahid minku yikhassil rijle al-aakhariin.
Al-cheyy al-ana sawweetah da masal leeku achaan intu kula tisawwu misil ana sawweetah leeku.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,al-abid ma akbar min siidah wa l-mursaal ma akbar min al-rassalah.
Wa khalaas,ta'arfu al-kalaam da wa mabruuk leeku kan tisawwuuh.
Wa l-kalaam al-gultah da,ma leeku intu kulluku.Na'arif al-naas al-ana azaltuhum.Wa laakin al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab laabudda yitimm.Maktuub-:﴾‍Al-yaakul ma'aayi khubziti,hu angalab diddi.‍﴿
Ni'ooriiku hassa' be l-cheyy al-yidoor yabga gubbaal ma yabga.Achaan da,wakit bigi khalaas,intu ti'aamunu beyi kadar ana hu.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-yakhbal mursaali,yakhbalni ana.Wa l-naadum al-yakhbalni ana,yakhbal Allah al-rassalaani.
Wa wakit Isa gaal al-kalaam da,hu hizin marra waahid.Wa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,naadum waahid minku yukhuunni.
Wa l-talaamiiz al'ajjabo wa ma irfo al-naadum al-minhum al-Isa hajja beyah.Wa kulluhum gaa'idiin yichchaawafo ambeenaathum.
Wa naadum waahid min talaamiizah muntaki jamb Isa fi nussah al-zeenaay wa hu al-tilmiiz al-Isa yihibbah bilheen.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus sawwa leyah ichaara achaan yas'al Isa yaatu al-naadum al-hajja beyah.
Wa l-tilmiiz takka wara lahaddi lihig sadur Isa wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,hajjeet be yaatu-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Chiif,nichiil lugma wa nimallihha wa nantiiha le naadum waahid.Wa da bas hu. Wa chaal lugma wa mallahaaha wa antaaha le Yahuuza wileed Sim'aan al-Iskhariyooti.
Wa Yahuuza chaal al-lugma wa khalaas Ibliis dakhal fi galbah.Wa Isa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Al-cheyy al-tidoor tisawwiih,sawwiih ajala.
Wa kulluhum al-gaa'idiin yaakulu sim'o al-kalaam al-Isa gaalah le Yahuuza,laakin ma irfo ma'anaatah.
Yahuuza hu mas'uul hana sanduug al-gurus wa fi fikir waahidiin,Isa gaal leyah khalli yamchi yachri al-khumaam al-waajib le l-iid.Wa fi fikir waahidiin,Isa gaal leyah khalli yamchi yanti sadakha le l-masaakiin.
Wa Yahuuza chaal al-lugma wa tawwaali marag.Wa l-leel gaa'id wa l-wata dalma.
Wa wakit Yahuuza marag khalaas,Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Hassa' majd Ibn al-Insaan yibiin.Wa beyah hu,majd Allah yibiin.
Wa kan beyah hu majd Allah yibiin,akiid Allah yimajjid Ibn al-Insaan ma'aayah wa yimajjidah tawwaali.
Ya iyaali,ana nagood ma'aaku wakit chiyya bas.Intu tifattuchuuni wa laakin nuguul leeku nafs al-kalaam al-gultah le l-Yahuud.Al-bakaan al-namchi leyah intu ma tagdaro tamchu leyah.
Wa nantiiku wasiiye jadiide wa l-wasiiye hi arraayado ambeenaatku.Arraayado misil ana niriidku.
Wa misil da bas,kulla l-naas ya'arfu intu talaamiizi kan intu tirraayado ambeenaatku.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus gaal-:-Sayyidna,inta maachi ween-? Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Hassa' inta ma tagdar titaabi'ni fi l-bakaan al-ana namchi leyah.Laakin fi wakit aakhar,tagdar titaabi'ni.
Wa Butrus sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,maala ma nagdar nitaabi'ak hassa'-?Ana jaahiz nitaabi'ak lahaddi nafdaak be ruuhi-!
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Hal sahiih tidoor tafdaani be ruuhak walla-?Asma' nuguul leek al-hagg,gubbaal al-diik ma yi'oo'i,inta tankurni talaata marraat.
Wa Isa gaal battaan-:-Ma tibarjulu.Aamunu be Allah wa aamunu beyi.
Fiyah buyuut katiiriin fi beet abuuyi.Wa kan ma ke,ana ma nuguul leeku namchi nihassil leeku bakaan.
Wa wakit macheet hassalt leeku bakaan,nigabbil niwaddiiku hinaak achaan tagoodu ma'aayi.Wa be misil da,tagoodu fi l-bakaan al-ana gaa'id foogah.
Wa intu ta'arfu derib hana l-bakaan al-namchi leyah.
Wa Tuuma sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,ma na'arfu al-bakaan al-tamchi leyah.Kikkeef na'arfu derbah-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana bas al-derib wa l-hagg wa l-haya.Ma fi naadum yamchi le Allah illa beyi ana.
Kan iriftuuni,akiid ta'arfu abuuyi Allah kula.Wa min hassa' iriftuuh wa chiftuuh khalaas.
Wa Filibbus gaal-:-Sayyidna,khalliina nichiifu abuuk wa abadan ma nas'alo cheyy aakhar.
Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Filibbus,ana tawwalt ma'aaku.Kikkeef ma iriftini-?Ayyi naadum al-chaafaani,hu chaaf abuuyi khalaas.Kikkeef tuguul-:--Khalliina nichiifu abuuk-?--
Lissaa' ma aamant kadar ana fi abuuyi wa abuuyi fiyi walla-?Al-kalaam al-nuguulah leeku ma jaayi minni bas.Abuuyi mawjuud fiyi wa hu yisawwi amalah.
Aamunu kadar ana mawjuud fi abuuyi wa abuuyi mawjuud fiyi.Wa kan ma ti'aamunu be kalaami kula,fakkuru fi l-a'maal al-sawweethum wa aamunu beyi be sababhum.
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyi,hu kula yisawwi al-a'maal al-ana nisawwiihum.Aywa hu yisawwi a'maal kubaar ziyaada achaan ana nigabbil le abuuyi.
Wa ayyi cheyy al-tas'alooh be usmi,ana nisawwiih achaan majd abuuyi yibiin ziyaada foogi ana Ibnah.
Aywa,ayyi cheyy al-tas'alooh be usmi,nisawwiih.
Kan tihibbuuni,intu titaabu'u al-wasaaya al-anteethum leeku.
Wa ana nas'al abuuyi wa hu yantiiku Mu'aawin aakhar fi badali.Wa l-Mu'aawin yagood ma'aaku daayman.
Wa hu Ruuh al-Hagg.Naas al-dunya ma yagdaro yakhbalooh achaan humman ma yichiifuuh wa ma ya'arfuuh.Wa laakin intu ta'arfuuh achaan hu gaa'id ma'aaku wa ba'adeen yagood fiiku.
Ana ma nikhalliiku ataama.Ana naji leeku battaan.
Ba'ad wakit chiyya bas,naas al-dunya ma yichiifuuni battaan.Laakin intu tichiifuuni.Ana nahya wa achaan da,intu kula tahyo.
Wa fi l-yoom da,ta'arfu kadar ana gaa'id fi abuuyi wa intu gaa'idiin fiyi wa ana gaa'id fiiku.
Ayyi naadum al-simi' al-wasaaya al-ana anteethum wa gaa'id yitaabi'hum,da bas al-naadum al-yihibbini.Wa kan naadum yihibbini,abuuyi Allah yihibbah wa ana kula nihibbah wa naji leyah wa nibayyin nafsi leyah.
Wa tilmiiz waahid usmah Yahuuza wa hu ma Yahuuza al-Iskhariyooti.Wa hu sa'al Isa wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,kikkeef tibayyin nafsak leena wa ma le naas al-dunya-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan naadum yihibbini hu yitaabi' kalaami.Wa abuuyi yihibbah wa aniina naju leyah wa naskunu ma'aayah.
Wa l-naadum al-ma yihibbini,ma yitaabi' kalaami.Al-kalaam al-tasma'ooh min khachmi ma hanaayi.Al-kalaam da jaayi min abuuyi al-rassalaani.
Ana gult al-kalaam da wakit ana lissaa' gaa'id ma'aaku.
Laakin al-Mu'aawin yaji wa hu al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa abuuyi yirassilah leeku be usmi.Wa hu yi'allimku kulla cheyy wa yifakkirku kulla l-kalaam al-ana gultah leeku.
Nikhalliiku be salaam.Nantiiku salaam hanaayi.Ana nantiiku ma misil naas al-dunya yantuuku.Ma tibarjulu wa ma takhaafo.
Intu simi'tu ana gult namchi wa nigabbil leeku.Kan tihibbuuni,tafraho ma'aayi achaan abuuyi akbar minni wa ana namchi leyah.
Wa khalaas ana ooreetku be l-cheyy al-gariib yabga.Wa hajjeet beyah gubbaal ma yabga achaan wakit bigi khalaas,intu ti'aamunu beyi.
Wa nihajji ma'aaku chiyya bas achaan Ibliis sultaan al-dunya jaayi.Hu ma yagdar yisawwi leyi cheyy,
laakin ana nisawwi kulla cheyy al-abuuyi amaraani beyah.Achaan kulla naas al-dunya ya'arfu ana nihibb abuuyi.Yalla-!Gummu wa namchu.
Ana bas chadarat al-inab al-sahiihe wa abuuyi hu siid al-jineene.
Ayyi firi' al-ma gaa'id yalda,hu yamurgah minni.Wa ayyi firi' al-gaa'id yalda,hu yibarbirah achaan yabga nadiif wa yalda ziyaada.
Wa intu bigiitu nudaaf khalaas be gudrat al-kalaam al-ana gultah leeku.
Agoodu saabtiin fiyi wa ana nagood saabit fiiku.Al-firi' ma yagdar yalda wiheedah.Al-firi' yalda achaan gaa'id saabit fi l-chadara.Wa intu kula ma tagdaro tisawwu al-cheyy al-Allah yidoorah,illa kan intu tagoodu saabtiin fiyi.
Ana chadarat al-inab wa intu al-furuu'.Kan naadum gaa'id saabit fiyi,ana nagood saabit fiyah wa hu yabga misil al-firi' al-yalda katiir.Intu ma tagdaro tisawwu cheyy illa beyi.
Kan naadum ma gaa'id saabit fiyi,hu misil firi' al-yamurguuh min al-chadara wa yazguluuh wa yaybas.Wa l-furuu' dool,yilimmuuhum wa yazguluuhum fi l-naar wa yiharruguuhum.
Kan intu tagoodu saabtiin fiyi wa kalaami yagood saabit fi guluubku,as'alo min Allah ayyi cheyy al-tidooruuh wa Allah yisawwiih leeku.
Wa majd abuuyi yibiin ziyaada wakit intu tabgo misil furuu' al-yaldo iyaal katiir.Wa be da,tiwassufu nufuusku kadar intu talaamiizi.
Misil abuuyi habbaani,ana kula habbeetku.Agoodu saabtiin fi mahabbiti.
Kan intu titaabu'u al-wasaaya al-anteethum leeku,intu tabgo saabtiin fi mahabbiti misil ana saabit fi mahabbat abuuyi achaan ana taaba't wasiiyaatah.
Ana gult leeku al-kalaam da achaan farhiti talhagku wa tabgo farhaaniin marra waahid.
Wa l-wasiiye al-nantiiha leeku di hi,waajib tirraayado ambeenaatku misil ana niriidku.
Wa ma fi mahabba kabiire min mahabbat al-naadum al-yihibb rufgaanah lahaddi yafdaahum be ruuhah.
Wa intu rufgaani kan titaabu'u al-wasaaya al-anteethum leeku.
Ana ma nuguul battaan intu khaddaamiini achaan al-khaddaam ma ya'arif kulla cheyy al-sayyidah gaa'id yisawwiih.Ninaadiiku rufgaani achaan ana ooreetku be kulla cheyy al-simi'tah min abuuyi.
Intu ma azaltuuni.Ana bas azaltuku wa rassaltuku achaan tabgo misil chadara taldo fawaakih,wa fawaakihku yagoodu ila l-abad.Wa ayyi cheyy al-tas'alooh min abuuyi be usmi,hu yantiiku.
Wa di hi al-wasiiye al-nantiiha leeku.Arraayado ambeenaatku.
Kan naas al-dunya yakrahooku,a'arfu kadar kirhooni ana gubbaal.
Kan intu min al-dunya,naas al-dunya yihibbuuku achaan intu naashum.Laakin hassa' intu ma min al-dunya achaan ana azaltuku min usut naas al-dunya le tabgo naasi.Wa achaan da,naas al-dunya yakrahooku.
Fakkuru fi l-kalaam al-ana gultah leeku.Ana gult al-abid ma akbar min siidah.Wa kan ta''abooni ana,yita''ubuuku intu kula.Wa kan khiblo kalaami,yakhbalo kalaamku intu kula.
Yita''ubuuku intu be sabab usmi achaan ma irfo Allah al-rassalaani.
Awwal kan ma jiit kallamt leehum,humman ma yabgo khaatiyiin.Laakin khalaas,ana kallamt leehum wa l-khata saabit fooghum.
Ayyi naadum al-yakrahni,yakrah abuuyi kula.
Awwal kan ana ma sawweet fi usuthum amal al-naadum aakhar abadan ma sawwaah,humman ma yabgo muznibiin.Laakin hassa' chaafo al-ajaayib wa kirhooni wa kirho abuuyi.
Wa be misil da,al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Tawraat al-humman yagruuh bigi fooghum sahiih.Maktuub-:﴾‍Kirhooni bala sabab.‍﴿
Laakin al-Mu'aawin yaji.Ana nirassilah leeku min bakaan abuuyi wa hu Ruuh al-Hagg al-naazil min Allah.Wa wakit hu yaji,hu yachhad leyi
wa intu kula tachhado leyi achaan intu gaa'idiin ma'aayi min al-bidaaya.
Ana gult leeku kulla l-kalaam da achaan ma tamurgu min al-derib al-adiil.
Yaturduuku min buyuut al-sala.Wa yaji wakit waahid ayyi naadum al-yaktulku yifakkir hu gaa'id yakhdim le Allah.
Yakrahooku misil da achaan ma irfo abuuyi Allah wa ma irfooni ana kula.
Laakin gult leeku al-kalaam da achaan wakit al-ta'ab yaji foogku,tifakkuru wa ta'arfu kadar ana ooreetku beyah.Wa ana ma ooreetku min al-bidaaya be l-ta'ab al-yajiiku achaan awwal ana gaa'id ma'aaku.
Wa hassa' ana nigabbil le Allah al-rassalaani wa ma fi naadum minku yas'alni wa yuguul-:--Inta maachi ween-?--
Intu haznaaniin bilheen achaan ana hajjeet leeku be l-kalaam da.
Laakin nuguul leeku al-hagg,yabga leeku akheer kan namchi.Kan ana ma namchi,al-Mu'aawin ma yaji leeku.Laakin kan ana macheet khalaas,nirassilah leeku.
Wa wakit hu yaji,hu yi'arrif le naas al-dunya zunuubhum wa yi'arrifhum al-haal al-saalhe wa l-hisaab.
Hu yi'arrifhum al-zanib achaan ma aamano beyi.
Hu yi'arrifhum al-haal al-saalhe achaan ana namchi le abuuyi wa ma tichiifuuni.
Hu yi'arrifhum al-hisaab achaan Allah haasab Ibliis sultaan al-dunya khalaas.
Indi kalaam ziyaada nidoor nuguulah leeku laakin hassa' intu ma tagdaro tahmalooh.
Wakit Ruuh al-Hagg yajiiku,hu yuguudku fi l-hagg al-kaamil.Al-kalaam al-yuguulah ma jaayi minnah bas laakin hu yuguul kulla cheyy al-yasma'ah wa yi'ooriiku be l-cheyy al-lissaa' ma bigi.
Hu yimajjidni yichiil min kalaami wa yi'ooriiku beyah.
Kulla cheyy hana abuuyi hanaayi.Wa achaan da,gult leeku hu yichiil min kalaami wa yi'ooriiku beyah.
Ba'ad chiyya bas,ma tichiifuuni wa ba'ad chiyya battaan,tichiifuuni.
Wa waahidiin min talaamiizah hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Maala gaal-:--Ba'ad chiyya bas,ma tichiifuuni.Wa ba'ad chiyya battaan,tichiifuuni.- Wa maala gaal-:--Achaan nigabbil le abuuyi.- Chunu ma'ana al-kalaam da-?
Wa gaalo-:-Al-kalaam --ba'ad chiyya--,da ma'anaatah chunu-?Ma fihimna kalaamah.
Wa Isa irif kadar dawwaro yas'alooh.Wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Hal intu gaa'idiin tichchaawaro ambeenaatku fi kalaami walla-?Hal fihimtu kalaami-:--Ba'ad chiyya bas,ma tichiifuuni wa ba'ad chiyya battaan,tichiifuuni---?
Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,intu tabku wa tahzano wa naas al-dunya yafraho.Sahiih,intu tahzano laakin al-farha tibaddil leeku al-hizin.
Kan mara khalbaane wa wakt al-waaluuda ja,hi tat'ab ta'ab chadiid.Wa wakit wildat sakhiirha khalaas,hi farhaane wa tansa al-ta'ab achaan jaabat naadum fi l-dunya.
Wa yabga leeku misil da.Hassa' tat'abo laakin ana nigabbil battaan nichiifku wa intu tafraho farha chadiide wa ma fi naadum yichiil minku al-farha di.
Wa fi l-yoom al-yaji da,intu ma tas'alooni cheyy.Asma'o nuguul leeku al-hagg,ayyi cheyy al-tas'alooh min abuuyi be usmi,hu yantiiku.
Lahaddi al-yoom,intu ma sa'altu cheyy min Allah be usmi.As'alooh wa hu yantiiku achaan tafraho farha chadiide.
Ana hajjeet leeku be amsaal laakin fi l-wakit al-yaji,ma nihajji leeku battaan be amsaal laakin ni'ooriiku be abuuyi be kalaam waadih.
Wa fi l-wakit al-yaji,tas'alo Allah be usmi.Ana ma nuguul kadar ana nas'al abuuyi fi chaanku.
Abuuyi zaatah yihibbuku achaan intu habbeetuuni wa aamantu kadar ana jiit min Allah.
Ana jiit min abuuyi wa dakhalt fi l-dunya.Wa hassa' namrug min al-dunya wa nigabbil le abuuyi.
Wa talaamiizah gaalo-:-Khalaas hassa' da hajjeet be kalaam waadih wa ma be amsaal.
Hassa' na'arfu inta ta'arif kulla cheyy wa kan naadum ma yas'alak kula,inta ta'arif su'aalah.Wa achaan da,aniina ni'aamunu kadar inta jiit min Allah.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Hassa' tuguulu aamantu walla-?
Laakin wakit waahid yaji wa hassa' al-wakit da ja khalaas.Wa fi l-wakit da bas,yichattutuuku ayyi waahid yamchi le beetah.Intu tikhalluuni wiheedi.Laakin be l-sahiih,ana ma wiheedi achaan abuuyi gaa'id ma'aayi.
Ana gult leeku kulla l-kalaam da,achaan talgo al-salaam beyi ana.Akiid,fi l-dunya intu tat'abo.Laakin chiddu heelku achaan ana annasart fi l-dunya.
Wa wakit Isa gaal kulla l-kalaam da khalaas,hu rafa' raasah wa chaaf foog fi l-sama wa gaal-:-Ya Abuuyi,al-wakit ja.Anti majd leyi ana Ibnak achaan ana Ibnak nimajjidak.
Misil inta anteetni sulta fi kulla l-naas,ana nanti al-haya al-abadiiye le kulla l-naas al-inta anteethum leyi.
Wa l-haya al-abadiiye hi,ya'arfuuk inta Allah al-Waahid al-sahiih wa ya'arfu Isa al-Masiih al-inta rassaltah.
Ana kammalt al-amal al-inta kallaftini beyah wa be da,ana majjadtak fi l-ard.
Wa hassa',ya Abuuyi,antiini majd fi jambak wa da nafs al-majd al-indi jambak gabul bidaayit al-dunya.
Ana arraft usmak le l-naas al-inta naadeethum min usut naas al-dunya achaan tantiihum leyi.Awwal humman hineeyak wa kallaftini beehum wa humman taaba'o kalaamak.
Wa hassa' ya'arfu kadar kulla cheyy al-inta anteetni ja minnak
achaan ana anteethum al-kalaam al-inta anteetni.Wa humman khiblooh wa ya'arfu akiid ana jiit minnak wa aamano kadar inta rassaltini.
Wa ana nas'alak leehum.Ana ma nas'alak le naas al-dunya laakin le l-naas al-inta kallaftini beehum achaan humman hineeyak.
Wa kulla l-naas al-hineeyak,humman hineeyi.Wa fiihum humman,yibiin majdi.
Ana ma nagood fi l-dunya laakin humman gaa'idiin fi l-dunya wa ana namchi leek.Ya Abuuyi al-Khudduus,ahfadhum be usmak al-anteetni,achaan humman yabgo waahid misil inta wa ana waahid.
Wakit ana gaa'id ma'aahum ana hafadtuhum be usmak,al-usum al-inta anteetni.Ana harastuhum wa ma fi naadum minhum hilik,illa l-naadum al-laabudda yahlak achaan al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab yitimm.
Wa hassa' namchi leek.Wa wakit ana lissaa' fi l-dunya,nuguul al-kalaam da achaan humman yafraho farha chadiide misil ana nafrah.
Ana ooreet naasi be kalaamak wa naas al-dunya kirhoohum achaan naasi ma hana l-dunya misil ana kula ma hana l-dunya.
Ana ma nas'alak achaan tamrughum min al-dunya.Nas'alak achaan tahfadhum min Ibliis al-chariir.
Humman ma naas hana l-dunya misil ana kula ma hana l-dunya.
Khalli al-hagg yisawwiihum khaassiin leek.Kalaamak bas al-hagg.
Ana rassaltuhum fi l-dunya misil inta awwal rassaltini fi l-dunya.
Wa fi chaanhum ana nikhassis nafsi achaan humman kula yabgo khaassiin leek be l-sahiih.
Ana ma gaa'id nas'alak le talaamiizi wiheedhum.Laakin ana nas'alak le l-naas al-yasma'o kalaamhum wa yi'aamunu beyi.
Ya Abuuyi,ana gaa'id nas'alak leehum achaan kulluhum yabgo waahid misil inta fiyi wa ana fiik.Khalli humman kula yabgo waahid ma'aana achaan kulla naas al-dunya yi'aamunu kadar inta rassaltini.
Al-majd al-inta anteetah leyi,ana anteetah leehum achaan humman yabgo waahid misil inta wa ana waahid
ya'ni ana fiihum wa inta fiyi.Khalli wihdathum tukuun kaamile wa be da,kulla l-naas ya'arfu kadar inta rassaltini wa tihibbuhum misil tihibbini.
Ya Abuuyi,nidoor kadar al-naas al-anteethum leyi yagoodu ma'aayi fi l-bakaan al-ana nagood foogah.Achaan hinaak yichiifu al-majd al-inta anteetni.Wa da be sabab mahabbitak leyi min gubbaal bidaayit al-dunya.
Ya Abuuyi al-aadil,naas al-dunya ma irfook.Laakin ana iriftak wa l-naas dool ya'arfu kadar inta rassaltini.
Ana arraftuhum be usmak wa ni'arrifhum beyah ziyaada achaan mahabbitak leyi tabga fiihum humman kula wa ana zaati nukuun fiihum.
Wa wakit Isa kammal al-du'a da,hu gamma ma'a talaamiizah wa gata'o waadi Khidruun.Wa jo le jineene waahide wa dakhalo fiiha.
Wa Yahuuza al-naadum al-yukhuun Isa kula ya'arif al-bakaan da achaan Isa lamma foogah ma'a talaamiizah iddat marraat.
Wa Yahuuza ja fi l-jineene ma'a askar Roomaaniyiin wa l-hurraas al-rassaloohum kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-Fariiziyiin.Wa humman musallahiin wa chaayliin fawaaniis wa machaahiib yidawwu beehum.
Wa Isa irif kulla cheyy al-yabga foogah wa macha leehum wa gaal-:-Tifattuchu yaatu-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Nifattuchu Isa al-min hillit al-Naasira. Wa Isa gaal-:-Ana bas hu. Wa Yahuuza al-khaayin gaa'id fi usuthum.
Wa wakit Isa gaal-:-Ana bas hu-,humman kasso minnah wara wa waga'o fi l-turaab.
Wa marra taaniye,hu sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Tifattuchu yaatu-? Wa gaalo-:-Isa al-min hillit al-Naasira.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Awwal ooreetku ana bas hu.Wa khalaas kan tidooruuni,khallu al-naas al-ma'aayi yamchu.
Wa hu gaal al-kalaam da achaan al-kalaam al-gaalah min awwal yitimm.Awwal hu gaal-:-Min al-naas al-inta anteetni,ma fi naadum waddar.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus indah seef wa sallaah wa darab beyah abid kabiir rujaal al-diin wa gata' adaanah al-zeene.Wa usum al-abid da Malkhus.
Wa Isa hajja le Butrus wa gaal-:-Dakhkhil seefak fi beetah.Maala ma nachrab min kaas al-ta'ab al-abuuyi antaani-?
Wa l-askar ma'a kabiirhum wa l-hurraas al-rassaloohum kubaaraat al-Yahuud karabo Isa wa rabbatooh.
Wa awwal cheyy,waddooh le Hanaan.Wa hu abu marit Gayaafa wa Gayaafa da kabiir rujaal al-diin fi l-sana di.
Wa Gayaafa da,hu bas al-naadum al-gaal le kubaaraat al-Yahuud akheer leehum kan naadum waahid yumuut le l-cha'ab.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus wa tilmiiz aakhar macho wara Isa.Wa l-tilmiiz al-aakhar ma'ruuf le kabiir rujaal al-diin wa achaan da,gidir dakhal fi fadaayit al-beet ma'a Isa.
Wa Butrus wagaf barra fi khachum al-beet.Wa l-tilmiiz al-ma'ruuf le kabiir rujaal al-diin marag le l-khaddaama al-mas'uula fi l-baab wa hajja leeha wa wadda Butrus daakhal.
Wa l-khaddaama sa'alatah le Butrus wa gaalat-:-Inta kula tilmiiz hana l-raajil da-? Wa Butrus gaal-:-La,la.
Al-wata baarde.Wa l-khaddaamiin wa l-hurraas oogado naar fi kaanuun achaan yiddaffo.Wa Butrus gaa'id yiddaffa ma'aahum.
Wa kabiir rujaal al-diin gamma sa'al Isa min talaamiizah wa min ta'aaliimah.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana hajjeet giddaam kulla l-naas.Min al-awwal,allamt al-naas fi buyuut al-sala wa fi beet Allah wa fi l-bakaanaat al-kulla l-Yahuud yilimmu fooghum.Ma gult cheyy be achiir.
Maala tas'alni-?Al-naas al-sim'o kalaami,as'alhum min al-kalaam al-ana gultah leehum.Humman ya'arfu al-kalaam al-ana gultah.
Wa wakit gaal al-kalaam da,waahid min al-hurraas al-waagfiin jambah chaddagah wa gaal-:-Kikkeef turudd le kabiir rujaal al-diin be misil da-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan kalaami kidib,achhad fi l-kidib.Laakin kan kalaami sahiih,maala darabtini-?
Wa Hanaan wadda Isa murabbat le Gayaafa kabiir rujaal al-diin.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus waagif yiddaffa fi l-naar.Wa gaalo leyah-:-Inta kula ma waahid min talaamiizah-? Wa hu nakar wa gaal-:-La,ana ma tilmiizah.
Wa waahid min khaddaamiin kabiir rujaal al-diin hajja leyah.Wa hu akhu hana l-naadum al-Butrus gata' adaanah.Wa hu sa'al Butrus wa gaal-:-Ana ma chiftak ma'aayah fi l-jineene walla-?
Wa Butrus nakar battaan wa tawwaali al-diik oo'a.
Wa marago Isa min beet Gayaafa wa waddooh fi gasir al-waali.Al-wata bigat fajur.Al-kubaaraat zaathum ma dakhalo fi gasir al-waali al-Roomaani achaan da yoom al-iid.Wa kan dakhalo fi beet naadum ma Yahuudi,yinajjusu nufuushum wa ma yagdaro yaakulu acha iid al-Fisha.
Wa achaan da,Bilaatus al-waali marag leehum wa gaal-:-Chunu al-tuhma al-khatteetuuha fi l-naadum da-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Al-naadum da kan ma mujrim,ma nisallumuuh leek.
Wa Bilaatus gaal-:-Chiiluuh wa chaaru'uuh hasab gaanuunku. Wa l-Yahuud gaalo-:-Gaanuunak ma yasmah leena achaan nahkumu le ayyi naadum be l-moot.
Be misil da,al-kalaam al-Isa gaalah fi l-tariiga al-yumuut beehabada yilhaggag.
Wa Bilaatus gabbal fi gasrah wa naada Isa.Wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta malik al-Yahuud walla-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-su'aal da,su'aalak inta walla-?Walla su'aal hana naas aakhariin-?
Wa Bilaatus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Haay-!Ana Yahuudi walla-?Gabiiltak inta bas wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin sallamook leyi.Chunu al-cheyy al-inta sawweetah-?
Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Mamlakati ma mamlaka hana l-dunya.Kan mamlakati hana l-dunya,khaddaamiini yugummu yidaawusu achaan al-Yahuud ma yakurbuuni.Wa laakin mulki ma jaayi min al-dunya.
Wa Bilaatus gaal-:-Ha,inta malik-?-Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Misil inta gultah.Wa be l-sahiih,fi chaan da bas ana mawluud wa jiit fi l-dunya,achaan nachhad le l-hagg.Ayyi naadum al-yiriid al-hagg yasma' kalaami.
Wa Bilaatus gaal-:-Chunu al-hagg-?-Wa wakit gaal al-kalaam da,Bilaatus marag le l-Yahuud wa gaal leehum-:-Ana ma ligiit foog al-naadum da ayyi jariime.
Laakin fi aaditku waajib natlig masjuun waahid fi iid al-Fisha.Tidooru natlig leeku malik al-Yahuud walla-?
Wa aato be hiss chadiid wa gaalo-:-La,ma hu-!Atlig leena Baraabaas-! Wa Baraabaas da,hu sawri.
Wa Bilaatus wadda Isa daakhal wa amar askarah achaan yajluduuh.
Wa wakit jaladooh khalaas,al-askar sawwo leyah taaj hana chook madfuur wa khattooh fi raasah wa labbasooh khalag loonah garadi misil khalag al-malik.
Wa yaju giddaamah wa yuguulu-:-Salaam aleek,ya malik al-Yahuud-! Wa gaa'idiin yudugguuh amkufuuf.
Wa Bilaatus marag battaan.Wa hajja le l-naas wa gaal-:-Chiifuuh,namurgah leeku achaan ta'arfu ana ma ligiit foogah jariime.
Wa Isa marag laabis al-taaj al-sawwooh min al-chook wa l-khalag al-garadi.Wa Bilaatus hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Daahu al-raajil.
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa khaddaamiinhum chaafooh wa aato foogah wa gaalo-:-Aktulah fi l-saliib-!Aktulah fi l-saliib-! Wa Bilaatus gaal-:-Intu bas chiiluuh wa aktuluuh fi l-saliib.Kan leyi ana,ma ligiit foogah khata al-waajib leyah al-moot.
Wa laakin al-Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Indina gaanuun wa hasab al-gaanuun da,hu waajib yumuut achaan hu sawwa nafsah Ibn Allah.
Wa wakit Bilaatus simi' al-kalaam da,khoof chadiid karabah be ziyaada.
Wa Bilaatus gabbal fi gasrah wa sa'al Isa wa gaal-:-Inta jiit min ween-? Wa laakin Isa ma radda leyah.
Wa achaan da,Bilaatus gaal-:-Ma tidoor tihajji leyi walla-?Inta ma fihimt indi sulta foogak wa ana nagdar natilgak aw naktulak fi l-saliib walla-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta ma indak sulta foogi illa l-sulta al-Allah antaaha leek.Wa achaan da,al-naadum al-sallamaani leek hu khaati minnak ziyaada.
Wa wakit Bilaatus simi' al-kalaam da,hu dawwar yatlig Isa laakin al-Yahuud raddo leyah be hiss aali wa gaalo-:-Kan tatlig al-naadum da,inta ma tiriid sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin-!Kan naadum yisawwi nafsah malik,hu yisawwi nafsah adu le sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.
Wakit Bilaatus simi' al-kalaam da,hu marag Isa wa ga'ad fi kursi al-charii'a al-gaa'id fi l-fadaay al-mu'addala be hujaar wa be kalaam ibraani usumha Gabbaasa.
Wa l-yoom da,yoom al-yijahhuzu foogah iid al-Fisha wa l-wata gaayle.Wa Bilaatus hajja le l-Yahuud wa gaal-:-Chiifuuh,daahu malikku-!
Wa aato wa gaalo-:-Aktulah-!Aktulah-!Aktulah fi l-saliib-! Wa Bilaatus sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Tidooru ana naktul malikku fi saliib walla-? Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Ma indina malik illa sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.
Wa khalaas,Bilaatus sallam Isa le l-askar achaan yaktuluuh fi l-saliib.Wa gammo chaalooh.
Wa Isa chaayil al-saliib al-dawwaro yaktuluuh foogah.Wa waddooh fi bakaan waahid usmah Bakaan al-Jumjuma wa be kalaam ibraani usmah Juljusa.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,taggo Isa fi l-saliib wa taggo ma'aayah naaseen,waahid taggooh fi saliib be nussah al-zeenaay wa l-taani fi saliib aakhar be nussah al-israay.Wa hu fi usuthum.
Wa Bilaatus khatta maktuub waahid fi raas al-saliib.Wa l-kalaam al-maktuub foogah yuguul-:-Isa min al-Naasira,malik al-Yahuud.
Wa salabo Isa gariib le l-madiina wa achaan da,Yahuud katiiriin garo al-kalaam al-maktuub da.Wa katabooh be kalaam ibraani wa kalaam laatiini wa kalaam yuunaani.
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin hajjo le Bilaatus wa gaalo-:-Ma taktib-:--Malik al-Yahuud.- Laakin aktib-:--Al-naadum da gaal hu malik al-Yahuud.-
Wa Bilaatus radda leehum wa gaal-:-Al-kalaam al-katabtah ma nikhayyirah.
Wa wakit al-askar al-arba'a salabo Isa khalaas,humman chaalo khulgaanah wa gassamoohum ambeenaathum.Wa jawwaaniiytah bas faddalat.Wa l-jawwaaniiye hi kullaha matruura wa ma indaha khiyaate.
Wa achaan da,hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Ma nicharrutuuha.Nisawwu am'iyeedaat wa l-naadum al-waga'at fi gismah yichiilha. Wa be misil da,kalaam al-Kitaab tamma al-buguul-:﴾‍Humman gassamo khulgaani ambeenaathum wa sawwo am'iyeedaat le lubaasi.‍﴿Wa da bas al-cheyy al-sawwooh al-askar.
Wa fiyah awiin waagfaat gariib le l-saliib al-Isa gaa'id foogah.Wa hinna ammah Mariyam wa khaaltah wa Mariyam marit Kuluuba wa Mariyam al-Magdaliiye.
Wa Isa chaaf ammah wa chaaf al-tilmiiz al-hu yihibbah waagif gariib leeha.Wa hajja le ammah wa gaal-:-Mara zeene chiifiih,da wileedki.
Wa hajja le tilmiizah wa gaal-:-Chiifha,di ammak. Wa l-tilmiiz waddaaha fi beetah wa min al-yoom da,hi sakanat ma'aayah.
Wa Isa irif kulla cheyy kammal.Wa hu hajja battaan achaan al-kalaam al-maktuub fi sababah fi l-Kitaab yitimm.Wa hu gaal-:-Ana atchaan.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,fi maa'uun malaan be charaab haamud.Wa ballo git'e fi l-charaab al-haamud da wa cha'agooha fi raas ageegaay hana zuufa wa rafa'ooha foog gariib le khachum Isa.
Wa Isa chirib min al-charaab al-haamud da wa gaal-:-Kulla cheyy tamma khalaas. Wa dangar raasah wa anta al-ruuh.
Wa da l-yoom al-yijahhuzu foogah le yoom al-sabt.Wa ambaakir,yoom kabiir fi l-iid.Wa l-Yahuud ma dawwaro al-janaazaat dool yagoodu fi l-saliib fi yoom al-sabt.Wa achaan da,talabo min Bilaatus yikassuru rijileen al-masluubiin achaan yumuutu ajala wa khalaas al-janaazaat yidalluuhum.
Wa l-askar jo le awwal naadum al-salabooh ma'a Isa wa kassaro rijileenah wa sawwo nafs al-cheyy le l-taani.
Wa laakin wakit jo le Isa,chaafo hu mayyit khalaas.Wa achaan da ma kassaro rijileenah.
Laakin askari waahid ta'anah fi naaytah be harba wa tawwaali daffag minnah damm wa almi.
Al-chaafah be eenah chaahid leyah wa chahaadtah sahiihe wa hu ya'arif kalaamah sahiih wa hu yachhad achaan intu kula ti'aamunu.
Wa l-cheyy da bigi achaan kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab waajib yitimm.Wa l-kalaam da buguul-:﴾‍Waahid min udaamah kula ma yinkasir.‍﴿
Wa l-Kitaab kula buguul-:﴾‍Yichiifu al-naadum al-ta'anooh.‍﴿
Wa ba'ad da,Yuusuf al-min hillit al-Raama macha le Bilaatus wa talab minnah janaazit Isa.Hu tilmiiz Isa wa laakin gaa'id yitaabi'ah be sirr achaan hu khaayif min al-Yahuud.Wa Bilaatus antaah izin wa Yuusuf macha chaal al-janaaza.
Wa Nigudiimus al-naadum al-yoom waahid macha hajja ma'a Isa be l-leel,hu kula macha ma'aayah wa jaab 30 kiilo hana dihin al-mukhalbat be sibir wa be riihe usumha uud.
Wa chaalo janaazit Isa wa ballo gabag tawiil fi l-dihin da wa laffo beyah al-janaaza.Wa be misil da,kaffanooh hasab aadaat al-Yahuud.
Wa fiyah jineene gariib le l-bakaan al-salabo foogah Isa.Wa fi l-jineene fi khaburjadiid gaa'id wa lissaa' ma dafano foogah naadum.
Wa l-khabur da gariib.Wa l-yoom al-Yahuud yijahhuzu foogah le yoom al-sabt gariib yikammil.Wa achaan da,dafano Isa fi l-bakaan da.
Wa awwal yoom al-subuu' wakit al-wata lissaa' dalma,Mariyam al-Magdaliiye gammat machat le l-khabur wa chaafat kadar al-hajar al-kabiir al-saddo beyah al-khabur ma gaa'id fi bakaanah.
Wa hi gammat jarat le Sim'aan Butrus wa le l-tilmiiz al-aakhar,al-Isa yihibbah bilheen,wa gaalat leehum-:-Sayyidna chaalooh min al-khabur wa ma na'arfu al-bakaan al-waddooh foogah-!
Wa Butrus wa l-tilmiiz al-aakhar marago wa chaalo al-derib al-maachi le l-khabur.
Wa humman jaariyiin wa laakin al-tilmiiz al-aakhar sabagah le Butrus wa lihig al-khabur gubbaalah.
Wa dangar taawag fi l-khabur daakhal wa chaaf al-kafan laakin hu ma andassa.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus wisil waraayah wa andassa tawwaali fi l-khabur.Wa chaaf al-kafan.
Wa l-mindiil al-rabato beyah raas Isa ma gaa'id ma'a l-kafan wa laakin gaa'id fi bakaan wiheedah mutabbag adiil.
Wa l-tilmiiz al-aakhar al-lihig al-khabur gubbaal Butrus,hu kula andassa daakhal wa chaaf al-khumaam wa aaman.
Laakin humman lissaa' ma fihmo min al-Kitaab kadar Isa laabudda yab'as min ust al-maytiin.
Wa l-talaamiiz gabbalo fi buyuuthum.
Wa laakin Mariyam waagfe jamb khachum al-khabur wa gaa'ide tabki.Wa wakit gaa'ide tabki,hi dangarat wa taawagat fi l-khabur daakhal.
Wa chaafat malaa'ika itneen khulgaanhum buyud.Humman gaa'idiin tihit fi l-bakaan al-awwal janaazit Isa raagde foogah,waahid fi bakaan raasah wa waahid fi bakaan rijileenah.
Wa hajjo leeha wa gaalo-:-Mara zeene,maalki tabki-? Wa hi raddat leehum wa gaalat-:-Ana gaa'ide nabki achaan chaalo sayyidi wa ma na'arif al-bakaan al-waddooh foogah.
Wa ba'ad hi gaalat al-kalaam da,hi anlafatat wa chaafat Isa waagif waraaha wa laakin ma irfat kadar da Isa.
Wa Isa hajja leeha wa gaal-:-Mara zeene,maala tabki-?Tifattichi yaatu-? Wa fi fikirha,hu al-khaddaam al-yakhdim fi l-jineene wa raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Al-sayyid,kan inta chiltah,ooriini al-bakaan al-khatteetah foogah wa ana niwaddiih fi bakaan aakhar.
Wa Isa hajja leeha wa gaal-:-Mariyam. Wa anlafatat chaafatah adiil wa gaalat-:-Ya rabbunaay-! Wa da,ma'anaatah -ya mu'allim- be kalaam ibraani.
Wa Isa hajja leeha wa gaal-:-Ma takurbiini.Ana lissaa' ma tala't le Allah abuuyi.Amchi le akhwaani wa ooriihum ana taali' le abuuyi wa abuuku wa le Ilaahi wa Ilaahku.
Wa Mariyam al-Magdaliiye machat le talaamiizah wa gaalat-:-Ana chift sayyidna-! Wa oorathum be kulla cheyy al-hu gaalah leeha.
Wa fi nafs al-yoom,ya'ni yoom al-ahad,fi l-achiiye al-talaamiiz laammiin fi bakaan waahid wa l-biibaan mugaffaliin achaan humman khaayfiin min al-Yahuud.Wa Isa ja wa wagaf fi usuthum wa gaal-:-Al-salaam aleekum-!
Wa ba'ad hu sallamaahum,hu wassafaahum iideenah wa naaytah.Wa wakit al-talaamiiz chaafo sayyidhum,humman firho farha chadiide.
Wa Isa hajja leehum battaan wa gaal-:-Al-salaam aleekum.Misil abuuyi rassalaani,ana kula nirassilku.
Wa ba'ad hu gaal al-kalaam da,hu nafakh fooghum wa gaal-:-Akhbalo al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Al-naadum al-intu tisaamuhu leyah zunuubah,Allah yakhfir leyah.Wa l-naadum al-intu ma tisaamuhu leyah zunuubah,Allah ma yakhfir leyah.
Wa Tuuma hu waahid min al-talaamiiz al-atnaachar wa usmah al-aakhar Chigg al-Toom.Wa hu ma gaa'id ma'aahum wakit Isa ja fi usuthum.
Wa l-talaamiiz al-aakhariin oorooh beyah wa gaalo-:-Aniina chifna sayyidna-! Wa laakin hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Kan ana ma chift be eeni bakaan al-musmaar fi iideenah wa kan ma khatteet usba'i fi bakaan al-musmaar wa kan ma limistah fi naaytah be iidi,abadan ma ni'aamin-!
Wa ba'ad usbuu',talaamiiz Isa lammo battaan fi nafs al-beet wa Tuuma ma'aahum.Wa l-biibaan mugaffaliin wa laakin Isa ja wa baan fi usuthum.Wa Isa sallamaahum wa gaal-:-Al-salaam aleekum.
Wa hajja le Tuuma wa gaal-:-Khutt usba'ak hini wa chiif iideeni.Midd iidak wa almasni fi naayti.Khalli minnak al-chakak wa aamin-!
Wa Tuuma radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta Rabbi.Inta Ilaahi-!
Wa Isa gaal-:-Inta aamant achaan chiftini.Mabruuk le l-naas al-yi'aamunu beyi kan ma chaafooni kula.
Wa wakit Isa gaa'id ma'a talaamiizah,hu sawwa ajaayib katiiriin al-ma maktuubiin fi l-kitaab da.
Laakin al-kalaam al-maktuub hini ankatab achaan intu tisaddugu kadar Isa hu al-Masiih wa Ibn Allah wa ti'aamunu beyah wa talgo be usmah al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa ba'adeen Isa baan battaan le talaamiizah jamb bahar Tibiriyaas.Wa daahu kikkeef hu baan leehum.
Yoom waahid,Sim'aan Butrus wa Tuuma al-binaaduuh Chigg al-Toom wa Natanaayil al-min hillit Kaana fi daar al-Jaliil wa awlaad Zabadi wa talaamiiz itneen aakhariin gaa'idiin fi bakaan waahid.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ana namchi nihawwit. Wa gaalo leyah-:-Namchu ma'aak. Wa marago wa rikbo fi l-markaba wa laakin tuul al-leel ma karabo cheyy.
Wa fajur badri,Isa ja wagaf fi khachum al-bahar wa l-talaamiiz ma irfooh kadar da Isa.
Wa Isa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Ya l-awlaad,karabtu huut walla-? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-La,ma karabna.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Azgulu charakku fi l-nuss al-zeenaay hana l-markaba wa takurbu huut. Wa zagalo charakhum wa karabo huut katiir lahaddi ma gidro karrooh foog fi l-markaba.
Wa l-tilmiiz al-Isa yihibbah hajja le Butrus wa gaal-:-Da Rabbina-!-Wa wakit Sim'aan Butrus simi' kadar da al-Rabb,hu gamma rabat khalagah fi sulbah achaan hu awwal sallaah le l-khidme wa natta fi l-bahar.
Wa l-talaamiiz al-aakhariin jo waraayah be l-markaba wa gaa'idiin yukurru al-charak al-malaan huut.Humman ma ba'iid min khachum al-bahar illa misil 200 duraa'.
Wa wakit marago min al-markaba khalaas,chaafo kaanuun malaan jamur wa huutaay foogah wa khubza.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Jiibu waahidiin min al-huut al-dahaaba karabtuuhum.
Wa Sim'aan Butrus gamma wa karra al-charak fi khachum al-bahar wa l-charak malaan huut kubaar.Wa adadah 153.Al-huut katiir bilheen wa laakin al-charak ma angata'.
Wa Isa naada al-talaamiiz wa gaal-:-Ta'aalu afturu. Ma fi naadum minhum haawal yas'alah wa yuguul-:-Inta yaatu-? Achaan fi guluubhum,irfo da al-Rabb Isa.
Wa Isa gamma chaal al-khubza wa antaahum minha wa sawwa nafs al-cheyy be l-huut.
Wa di taalit marra Isa baan le talaamiizah min hu ba'as min ust al-maytiin.
Wa wakit fataro khalaas,Isa sa'al Sim'aan Butrus wa gaal-:-Sim'aan wileed Yuuhanna,tihibbini mahabba chadiide ziyaada min al-aakhariin walla-? Wa Sim'aan Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa sayyidna,ta'arif nihibbak. Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Asrah be humlaani.
Wa marra taaniye sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sim'aan wileed Yuuhanna,tihibbini mahabba chadiide walla-? Wa Sim'aan Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Aywa sayyidna,ta'arif nihibbak. Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Asrah be khanami.
Wa marra taalta Isa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sim'aan wileed Yuuhanna,tihibbini walla-? Wa bigi le Sim'aan Butrus gaasi bilheen achaan talaata marraat Isa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Tihibbini walla-? Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,ta'arif kulla cheyy.Wa ta'arif nihibbak. Wa Isa gaal leyah-:-Asrah be khanami.
Asma' nuguul leek al-hagg,wakit inta sakhayyar,inta rabatt sulbak wa macheet misil dawwartah.Laakin wakit tabga kabiir,timidd iideenak wa naadum aakhar yarbutak wa yiwaddiik fi bakaan al-inta ma tidoor tamchi foogah.
Wa Isa gaal al-kalaam da achaan yi'oori Butrus be tariiga al-beeha yumuut wa yimajjid Allah.Wa ba'ad da,Isa gaal-:-Taabi'ni.
Wa Butrus anlafat wa chaaf waraahum al-tilmiiz al-Isa yihibbah.Wa da bas al-tilmiiz al-takka wara lahaddi lihig sadur Isa wakit gaa'idiin yil'achcho wa gaal-:-Sayyidna,yaatu al-naadum al-yidoor yukhuunak-?
Wa Butrus chaaf Isa wa gaal-:-Ya sayyidna,tuguul chunu fi l-naadum da-?
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kan ana nidoor hu yagood lahaddi nigabbil kula,da ma lammaak.Inta taabi'ni bas-!
Wa min al-yoom da,naas gaalo al-tilmiiz da ma yumuut.Wa l-kalaam da chattat fi ust al-akhwaan.Laakin Isa ma gaal le Butrus kadar al-tilmiiz al-aakhar ma yumuut.Hu gaal-:-Kan nidoor hu yagood lahaddi nigabbil kula,da ma lammaak.
Wa da bas al-tilmiiz al-gaa'id yachhad le Isa fi l-kalaam da.Wa hu bas al-katab kulla l-kalaam fi l-Kitaab da wa na'arfu chahaadtah sahiihe.
Wa Isa sawwa achya ziyaada ma maktuubiin fi l-kitaab da.Wa fi fikri ana,kan dawwaro yaktubu kulla l-achya dool,al-dunya kullaha ke ma tagdar tichiil al-kutub al-yaktubuuhum.
Ya l-sayyid Saawufiilus,fi l-kitaab al-awwal al-ana katabtah leek,ooreetak be kulla cheyy al-Isa bada yisawwiih wa be kulla cheyy al-allamah min bidaayit khidimtah
lahaddi l-yoom al-Allah rafa'ah fi l-samaawaat.Wa gubbaal Allah ma yarfa'ah,Isa hajja le l-naas al-azalaahum le yabgo rusul wa amaraahum be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Ba'ad mootah,Isa sabbat leehum be dalaayil katiiriin kadar hu hayy.Wa gaa'id yibiin leehum fi muddit arba'iin yoom wa yikallim leehum be mamlakat Allah.
Wa wakit hu gaa'id ma'aahum hu gaal-:-Ma tamurgu min Madiinat al-Khudus.Arjo lahaddi abuuku Allah yantiiku al-baraka al-hu waa'adaaku beeha wa ana zaati ooreetku beeha.
Yahya khattas al-naas fi l-almi wa laakin ba'ad ayyaam bas,Allah yikhattisku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa wakit al-rusul gaa'idiin ma'a Isa,humman sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ya Rabbina,da bas al-wakit al-tidoor ti'assis battaan mamlakat Israa'iil walla-?
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal-:-Abuuku Allah bas nazzam al-awkaat be sultitah wa ma antaaku izin achaan ta'arfuuhum.
Wa laakin wakit al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yanzil foogku,talgo gudra achaan tachhado leyi fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi kulla daar al-Yahuudiiya wa fi daar al-Saamira wa lahaddi aakhir al-ard.
Wa ba'ad Isa gaal al-kalaam da,anrafa' fi l-sama wa humman chaayfiin Isa taali' wa sahaab daaragah minhum.
Wa wakit humman gaa'idiin yisangu'u foog fi l-sama wa Isa maachi minhum,rujaal itneen khulgaanhum buyud baano jambuhum
wa gaalo-:-Ya rujaal daar al-Jaliil,maalku intu waagfiin tisangu'u foog fi l-sama-?Chiftu Isa taali' minku wa faat fi l-sama.Wa be nafs al-tariiga di,hu yigabbil min al-sama fi l-ard-!
Wa da bigi fi hajar usmah jabal al-Zaytuun misil kiilomitir waahid min Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa ba'ad da,al-rusul dallo min al-hajar wa gabbalo fi l-madiina.
Wa l-rusul gabbalo fi l-madiina wa dakhalo fi l-beet wa tala'o fi l-gasir al-gaa'idiin foogah.Wa l-naas dool,humman Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yaakhuub wa Andareeyas wa Filibbus wa Tuuma wa Bartulma wa Matta wa Yaakhuub wileed Halfa wa Sim'aan al-Sawri wa Yahuuza wileed Yaakhuub.
Wa kulluhum gaa'idiin yilimmu daayman wa yisallu be niiye waahide wa awiin waahidaat kula gaa'idaat yilimman ma'aahum wa Mariyam amm Isa wa akhwaanah.
Wa yoom waahid,Butrus gamma fi ust al-akhwaan.Adadhum misil 120 naadum.Wa hu kallam leehum wa gaal-:
Ya l-akhwaan,al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab,waajib yitimm.Zamaan,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus kallam be waasitat al-nabi Dawuud fi Yahuuza.Hu al-wadda al-naas le Isa achaan yakurbuuh.
Wa Yahuuza da,hu waahid minnina wa sawwa ma'aana nafs al-khidme.
Wa Yahuuza chaal al-gurus al-awwal sa'alah min al-kubaaraat achaan yukhuun Isa wa chara beyah zere'.Wa fi l-zere' da,hu waga' wa batnah anchaggat wa kulla masaariinah daffago.
Wa kulla naas Madiinat al-Khudus irfo al-cheyy al-bigi lahaddi sammo al-zere' be kalaamhum Hakhil Damma,ma'anaatah zere' al-damm.
Wa Butrus gaal-:-Al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Zabuur buguul-:﴾‍Khalli beetah yakhrab wa naadum ma yaskun foogah.‍﴿Wa battaan maktuub-:﴾‍Khalli naadum aakhar yibaddilah.‍﴿
Wa achaan da,waajib leena na'azulu naadum waahid min al-rujaal al-gaa'idiin ma'aana fi kulla l-wakit al-Rabbina Isa gaa'id ma'aana,
min Yahya khattasah fi almi lahaddi l-yoom al-Allah rafa'ah minnina wa chaalah fi l-sama.Wa l-naadum al-na'azuluuh yabga chaahid ma'aana fi bu'aas Isa.
Wa gaddamo rujaal itneen.Wa l-waahid hu Yuusuf Baar Saaba al-usmah al-aakhar Yustus wa l-taani hu Mattiyaas.
Wa da'o wa gaalo-:-Ya Rabbina,inta ta'arif guluub kulla l-naas.Wassif leena yaatu min al-rujaal al-itneen dool al-inta azaltah.
Hu yabga rasuul wa yichiil khidmit Yahuuza al-khallaaha wa faat macha le l-bakaan al-waajib leyah.
Wa sawwo leehum am'iyeedaat wa waga' fi Mattiyaas.Wa Mattiyaas lamma ma'a l-rusul al-ihdaachar.
Wa fi yoom hana iid al-Khamsiin,kulla l-akhwaan gaa'idiin sawa laammiin fi bakaan waahid.
Wa faj'atan min al-sama,ansama' hiss chadiid misil riih chadiide gaa'ide tanfukh wa mala al-beet al-humman gaa'idiin foogah.
Wa chaafo cheyy yichaabih lisne al-naar chattato wa nazalo fi ayyi waahid minhum.
Wa ayyi naadum anmala be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa gamma yihajji be lukhkha aakhara be gudrat al-Ruuh da.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Madiinat al-Khudus malaane be Yahuud takhiyiin al-jo min kulla buldaan al-dunya.
Wa naas katiiriin sim'o al-haraka wa lammo fi l-bakaan al-akhwaan gaa'idiin foogah.Wa al'ajjabo marra waahid achaan ayyi naadum simi' kalaamhum be lukhkhitah.
Wa barjalo bilheen wa al'ajjabo marra waahid.Wa gammo yihajju ambeenaathum wa yuguulu-:-Al-naas al-yihajju dool ma min daar al-Jaliil walla-?
Kikkeef ayyi waahid minnina simi' humman yikallumu be lukhkhitna-?
Wa fi naas usutna min buldaan katiiriin misil al-Fartiya wa l-Maadi wa Ilaam.Wa fi sukkaan hana balad been al-Nahreen wa naas min daar al-Yahuudiiya wa min Kabbaduukiiya wa Buntus wa Aasiya
wa Firigiiya wa Bamfiiliya wa Masir wa min taraf Liibiya gariib le hillit al-Khayrawaan.Wa fi diifaan katiiriin jo min madiinat Rooma
wa fi naas Yahuud wa fi naas aakhariin dakhalo fi diin al-Yahuud.Wa fi naas waahidiin min jaziirat Kiriit wa min daar al-Arab.Wa aniina kullina gaa'idiin nasma'oohum yihajju be lukhkhitna be l-ajaayib al-kubaar al-Allah sawwaahum.
Wa kulluhum al'ajjabo wa barjalo wa gaa'idiin yissaa'alo ambeenaathum wa yuguulu-:-Al-cheyy al-gaa'id yabga da,ma'anaatah chunu-?
Wa laakin naas waahidiin yichchammato le l-mu'miniin wa yuguulu-:-Humman sakraaniin.
Butrus gamma ma'a l-rusul al-ihdaachar.Wa hu kallam le l-naas be hiss chadiid wa gaal-:-Ya akhwaani al-Yahuud wa kulla l-diifaan al-gaa'idiin fi Madiinat al-Khudus,asma'o kalaami wa nifassir leeku al-cheyy al-bigi.
Intu gultu al-naas dool sakraaniin.Wa da ma sahiih.Yaatu al-yaskar fi l-saa'a tis'a hana l-fajur-?
Wa laakin al-cheyy al-simi'tuuh da,hu al-cheyy al-nabi Yuwiil kallam beyah.
Hu gaal-:﴾‍Fi l-zaman al-akhiir,ana ninazzil Ruuhi fi kulla l-naas.Wa da bas kalaam Allah.Awlaadku wa banaatku yitnabba'owa subyaanku yichiifu ru'yawa chiyyaabku yahlamo be hilim.
Wa fi l-zaman da,abiidi wa khadiimi kulaninazzil fooghum Ruuhiwa yitnabba'o.
Wa nisawwi ajaayib foog fi l-samawa alaamaat tihit fi l-ard.Wa l-naas yichiifu dammwa naar wa dukhkhaan azrag.
Wa l-harraay tabga zargawa l-gamar yabga ahmar misil al-damm.Wa da gubbaal yoom Allah ma yajiwa hu yoom aziim wa majiid.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yad'ibe usum Allah yanja.‍﴿
Ya Bani Israa'iil,asma'o kalaami-!Allah wassaf leeku sultit Isa al-min al-Naasira.Achaan beyah hu Allah sawwa a'maal kubaar wa ajaayib wa alaamaat fi usutku.Wa intu zaatku ta'arfuuh adiil.
Wa min awwal,Allah irif al-cheyy al-yabga.Wa be niiytah al-saabte,Allah sallam leeku Isa.Wa intu astafagtu ma'a l-naas al-fasliin le taktuluuh fi l-saliib.
Wa laakin Allah ba'asah min ust al-maytiin wa dammar ta'ab al-moot achaan ma mumkin al-moot yinnasir foogah.
Wa l-nabi Dawuud hajja beyah fi l-Kitaab wa gaal-:﴾‍Chift Allah daayman giddaami.Achaan hu gaa'id be zeenaayti,ana ma nittarta'.
Wa fi chaan da,galbi yafrahwa lisaani yikhanni be farah.Wa jismi yargud be acham
achaan inta ma tikhalliini fi ust al-maytiin.La,inta ma tikhalli janaazit abdak al-Khudduustabga turaab.
Inta arraftini derib al-hayawa tantiini farah be katara fi hadaratak.‍﴿
Ya l-akhwaan,khalli ni'ooriiku be kalaam waadih kadar jiddina Dawuud maat wa dafanooh wa khaburah gaa'id fi hillitna lahaddi l-yoom.
Dawuud kaan nabi.Wa hu irif kadar Allah halaf leyah wa gaal kadar hu yukhutt waahid min zurriiytah fi kursi al-malik.
Wa Dawuud chaaf bu'aas al-Masiih min zamaan wa akkadah wa gaal kadar Allah ma yikhalli al-Masiih fi ust al-maytiin wa la yikhalli janaaztah tabga turaab.
Wa Isa da,Allah ba'asah wa aniina chifnaah wa kullina chuhuud leyah.
Wa Allah rafa' Isa wa ga''adah fi jambah fi nussah al-zeenaay.Hassa' Allah abuuh antaah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-waa'adaana beyah min zamaan wa Isa nazzalah foogna.Wa be misil da bas,al-cheyy al-intu gaa'idiin tichiifuuh wa tasma'ooh bigi.
Wa Dawuud da,hu ma anrafa' fi l-sama.Hu al-naadum al-gaal-:--Allah hajja le siidi al-malik wa gaal-:﴾‍Agood be nussi al-zeenaay
Khalaas,khalli ayyi naadum min Bani Israa'iil ya'arif bala chakak kadar Isa al-intu kataltuuh fi l-saliib,Allah ja'alah siidku al-Masiih-!
Wa wakit al-naas sim'o al-kalaam da,galibhum anjarah marra waahid wa sa'alo Butrus wa l-rusul al-aakhariin wa gaalo-:-Ya akhwaanna,waajib nisawwu chunu-?
Wa Butrus radda leehum wa gaal-:-Tuubu min zunuubku wa ayyi waahid minku yikhattusuuh be usum Isa al-Masiih.Wa Allah yakhfir leeku zunuubku wa yantiiku al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Achaan Allah gaal hu yanti al-baraka di leeku wa le iyaalku wa le kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi bakaan ba'iid,aywa le ayyi naadum al-Rabbina Allah yinaadiih.
Wa Butrus gaa'id yachhad le Isa giddaam al-naas wa hajja leehum kalaam katiir achaan yijiibhum fi l-derib.Hu gaal-:-Tuubu wa tanjo.Ma titaabu'u naas wakitna al-muwaddiriin dool.
Wa l-naas al-aamano be kalaamah khattasoohum.Wa fi l-yoom da,adad al-naas al-aamano wa l-lammo ma'a l-mu'miniin 3-000 naadum.
Wa be niiye waahide kulla l-mu'miniin gammo yinkarbu fi ta'liim al-rusul wa l-haya al-akhawiiye wa acha al-Masiih wa l-salaawaat.
Wa Allah anta ajaayib wa alaamaat katiiriin le l-rusul wa khoof dakhal fi guluub al-naas kulluhum.
Wa kulla l-mu'miniin induhum niiye waahide wa ayyi naadum yaj'al maalah misil maal al-akhwaan.
Wa gaa'idiin yibii'u arduhum wa khumaamhum le yantu gurus le ayyi naadum hasab al-hu hawjaan leyah.
Wa kulla yoom,gaa'idiin yilimmu fi beet Allah wa yil'achcho sawa fi buyuuthum be farah wa galib mukhlis.
Wa gaa'idiin yachkuru Allah wa kulla l-naas radyaaniin beehum.Wa kulla yoom,al-Rabb gaa'id yiziid adad al-mu'miniin wa yinajji naas ziyaada.
Wa yoom waahid,Butrus wa Yuuhanna maachiin fi beet Allah achaan yisallu sala hana l-saa'a talaata.
Wa naadum waahid gaa'id jamb baab hana beet Allah al-usmah al-baab al-Jamiil.Wa min wildooh,hu ma'duur.Wa kulla yoom akhwaanah yiwadduuh wa yukhuttuuh hinaak achaan yihajjir wa yalga sadakha min al-naas al-yindasso fi beet Allah.
Wa wakit hu chaaf Butrus wa Yuuhanna jaayiin yadkhulu,hu sa'al minhum sadakha.
Wa wagafo wa chaafooh adiil wa Butrus gaal leyah-:-Hammirna adiil-!
Wa hu chaafaahum wa fi fikrah,humman yidooru yantuuh sadakha.
Wa Butrus gaal-:-Ma indi fudda wa ma indi dahab laakin nantiik al-cheyy al-indi.Be usum Isa al-Masiih al-min al-Naasira,nuguul leek gumm wa ruukh-!
Wa Butrus karabah min iidah al-zeene wa saa'adah le yugumm.Wa tawwaali ke,hu ligi gudra wa rijileenah alfartago wa bigo saabtiin.
Wa natta foog wa gamma yuruukh wa dakhal ma'aahum fi beet Allah.Wa gaa'id yuruukh wa yinattit wa yachkur Allah.
Wa kulla l-naas hinaak chaafooh raayikh wa yachkur Allah.
Wa irfo da bas al-ma'duur al-yihajjir kulla yoom fi l-baab al-Jamiil hana beet Allah.Wa al'ajjabo marra waahid wa khaafo min al-cheyy al-bigi.
Wa Butrus wa Yuuhanna jo fi bakaan waahid fi fadaayit beet Allah al-usmah raakuubat Suleymaan wa l-raajil gaa'id yamsukhum wa naas katiiriin lammo fooghum wa al'ajjabo marra waahid.
Butrus chaaf kulla l-naas al-laammiin wa hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil,maalku ajjabtu fi l-cheyy da-?Wa maalku tihammuruuna-?Fi fikirku,al-raajil da gamma raakh be gudritna aniina-?Walla achaan aniina saalihiin ziyaada walla-?
Allah Rabb juduudna Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub rafa' abdah Isa wa khattaah fi majdah.Wa da bas al-naadum al-intu sallamtuuh le l-moot.Giddaam Bilaatus nakartuuh wakit hu dawwar yatilgah.
Intu abeetu ma dawwartu al-naadum al-saalih wa khudduus.Wa talabtu min al-waali yatlig leeku kattaal al-dimam fi badalah.
Wa khalaas,kataltu al-naadum al-yantiiku al-haya.Wa laakin Allah ba'asah min ust al-maytiin wa aniina chuhuud le bu'aasah.
Wa be sabab iimaanna be usum Isa,al-raajil al-tichiifuuh wa l-ta'arfuuh da ligi gudra.Wa fi chaan al-iimaan be usum Isa bas,hu ligi al-aafe marra waahid wa kulluku chiftuuh be uyuunku.
Ya akhwaani,ana na'arif intu wa kubaaraatku abeetu al-Masiih achaan ma iriftuuh.
Min zamaan,Allah kallam be waasitat kulla l-anbiya wa gaal kadar al-Masiih yat'ab wa khalaas da bas al-cheyy al-bigi.
Wa hassa' tuubu wa gabbulu le Allah achaan hu yamha zunuubku-!
Wa Allah yantiiku salaam fi guluubku wa yirassil leeku marra taaniye Isa al-hu azalah leeku gubbaal wa hu al-Masiih.
Waajib yagood fi l-sama lahaddi yoom al-foogah Allah yijaddid kulla cheyy.Wa da misil hu gaalah min zamaan be waasitat al-anbiya al-saalihiin al-rassalaahum.
Wa l-nabi Muusa gaal-:﴾‍Allah Ilaahku yigawwim leeku min akhwaanku nabi misli ana.Asma'o kalaamah wa sawwu kulla cheyy al-yuguulah leeku.‍﴿
﴾‍Wa ayyi naadum al-ma yasma' kalaamah,waajib yafsuluuh min cha'ab Allah wa yahlak.‍﴿
Be misil da,kulla l-anbiya hajjo be wakitna da,min al-nabi Samuwiil wa kulla l-anbiya al-jo waraayah.
Wa intu iyaal al-anbiya dool wa ahal al-mu'aahada al-Rabbuku Allah sawwaaha ma'a juduudku wakit hu gaal le Ibraahiim-:﴾‍Be zurriiytak bas nibaarik kulla l-umam fi kulla l-ard.‍﴿
Wa Allah rassal abdah Isa leeku intu awwal,gubbaal al-umam al-aakhariin,achaan yibaarikku wa yigabbil ayyi waahid min al-derib al-fasil.
Wa wakit Butrus wa Yuuhanna gaa'idiin yihajju le l-naas al-laammiin,rujaal al-diin wa naas min al-Sadduukhiyiin wa kabiir al-askar hurraas beet Allah jo leehum.
Wa humman za'laaniin achaan al-rusul gaa'idiin yi'allumu al-naas.Wa yuguulu Isa ba'as min ust al-maytiin wa be da,akiid al-naas kula yab'aso.
Wa karabo Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa dassoohum fi l-sijin lahaddi fajur achaan al-leel garrab.
Wa laakin naas katiiriin sim'o al-bichaara wa aamano be Isa.Wa adad al-mu'miniin tamma misil 5-000 raajil.
Wa ambaakir be fajur,kubaaraat al-Yahuud wa l-chuyuukh wa l-ulama lammo fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa lammo ma'a Hanaan kabiir rujaal al-diin wa Gayaafa wa Yuuhanna wa Iskandar wa akhwaan aakhariin hana kubaaraat rujaal al-diin.
Wa jaabo Butrus wa Yuuhanna min al-sijin wa sa'aloohum.Wa gaalo-:-Ligiitu al-gudra di min ween wa be usum yaatu sawweetu al-cheyy da-?
Wa Butrus anmala be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Hu radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ya kubaaraat al-cha'ab,ya chuyuukhna,
al-yoom tidooru tas'aloona min al-hasana al-sawweenaaha le naadum ma'duur wa tidooru ta'arfu kikkeef hu ligi al-aafe.
Khalaas,a'arfu kulluku wa khalli kulla Bani Israa'iil ya'arfu kadar al-naadum al-waagif giddaamku da ligi al-aafe be usum Isa al-Masiih al-min al-Naasira.Wa Isa da,hu bas al-naadum al-intu kataltuuh fi l-saliib wa Allah ba'asah min ust al-maytiin.
Al-Kitaab yuguul-:﴾‍Al-hajar al-bannaayiin al-beet awwal ma dawwarooh bigi al-hajar al-muhimm fi buna al-beet.‍﴿Wa Isa hu al-hajar wa intu al-bannaayiin al-abeetuuh.
Ma fi naja illa be Isa wiheedah.Wa fi kulla l-ard,ma fi usum aakhar al-Allah nazzalah le l-naas al-waajib aniina ni'aamunu beyah wa nanjo,illa be usum Isa-!
Wa naas al-majlas al'ajjabo achaan Butrus wa Yuuhanna humman naas hille bas wa ma ulama wa laakin kallamo le l-majlas bala khoof.Wa irfo kadar Butrus wa Yuuhanna awwal raaykhiin ma'a Isa.
Wa laakin chaafo al-ma'duur al-ligi al-aafe waagif ma'aahum wa achaan da,ma gidro yuguulu leehum kalaam fasil.
Wa khalaas,marago Butrus wa Yuuhanna min al-majlas wa achchaawaro ambeenaathum.
Gaalo-:-Nisawwu chunu le l-rujaal dool-?Humman sawwo cheyy ajiib bilheen wa kulla naas Madiinat al-Khudus chaafooh wa ma nagdaro nankuruuh.
Wa laakin ma nidooru kalaamhum yiziid been al-naas.Khalli nihadduduuhum wa nuguulu leehum kadar min al-yoom,ma waajib yihajju le ayyi naadum be usum Isa.
Wa khalaas,naadoohum daakhal wa amaroohum achaan abadan ma yikallumu wa la yi'allumu al-naas battaan be usum Isa.
Wa laakin Butrus wa Yuuhanna gaalo-:-Intu bas guulu leena weenu al-adiil giddaam Allah.Waajib nitaabu'u kalaamku walla nitaabu'u kalaam Allah-?
Wa aniina ma nagdaro nagoodu saakit.Waajib nihajju be l-cheyy al-chifnaah wa be l-kalaam al-simi'naah.
Wa naas al-majlas haddadoohum ziyaada wa khalaas talagoohum.Al-kubaaraat ma gidro yi'aakhubuuhum achaan humman khaayfiin min za'al al-cha'ab.Wa kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yachkuru Allah fi chaan al-ajab al-bigi da.
Wa l-raajil al-ligi al-aafe be l-ajab da umrah tamma ziyaada min 40 sana.
Wakit Butrus wa Yuuhanna talagoohum khalaas,gabbalo le akhwaanhum wa ooroohum be kulla cheyy al-gaalooh leehum kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa l-chuyuukh.
Wa kulluhum sa'alo Allah be niiye waahide wa gaalo-:-Ya siidna,khaalig al-samaawaat wa l-ard wa l-buhuur wa kulla cheyy al-fiihum.
Inta kallamt be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus be waasitat abdak jiddina Dawuud wa gult-:﴾‍Maala al-umam atmarrado-?Wa maala al-chu'uub yil'aamaro fi l-ma indah faayde-?
Muluuk al-ard jahhazo le l-haribwa l-salaatiin achchaawarodidd Allahwa didd al-Masiih al-Allah azalah.‍﴿
Wa khalaas,al-kalaam da alhaggag hini fi l-madiina di.Hiruudus wa Bilaatus al-Bunti wa kubaaraat al-umam wa Bani Israa'iil achchaawaro didd abdak al-Khudduus,Isa al-inta azaltah wa darrajtah achaan yabga al-Masiih.
Wa sawwo leyah kulla cheyy al-min awwal inta bas be gudurtak kharrartah laabudda yabga.
Ya Allah,hassa' chiif humman gaa'idiin yihadduduuna.Antiina aniina abiidak gudra achaan niballukhu kalaamak bala khoof.
Bayyin gudurtak wa achfi al-mardaaniin wa sawwi alaamaat wa ajaayib be usum Isa abdak al-Khudduus.
Wa ba'ad sa'alo Allah,al-bakaan al-laammiin foogah anhazza wa kulluhum anmalo be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa gammo yiballukhu kalaam Allah bala khoof.
Wa kulla l-mu'miniin induhum galib waahid wa fikir waahid.Wa ma fi naadum yuguul khumaamah haggah halaalah.Wa ayyi naadum minhum yaj'al maalah misil maal al-akhwaan.
Wa l-rusul gaa'idiin yachhado le bu'aas al-Rabb Isa be gudra kabiire bilheen wa rahmat Allah gaa'ide fi kulla l-mu'miniin be ziyaada.
Wa ayyi naadum minhum indah al-cheyy al-yakfi leyah achaan kulla l-mu'miniin al-induhum ziraa'a walla buyuut gaa'idiin yibii'uuhum wa yijiibu al-gurus
wa yisallumuuh le l-rusul fi chaan al-akhwaan.Wa l-rusul gaa'idiin yigassumuuh wa yantuuh le ayyi naadum hasab al-hu hawjaan leyah.
Wa naadum waahid min al-naas al-baa'o khumaamhum usmah Yuusuf.Wa l-rusul khatto leyah usum Barnaaba ma'anaatah al-yichajji'.Wa hu min gabiilat Laawi wa hillitah fi jaziirat Khubrus.
Hu indah zere' wa baa'ah wa sallam al-gurus le l-rusul fi chaan al-akhwaan.
Wa raajil waahid usmah Hanaaniiya indah zere'.Wa chaawar martah al-usumha Safiira wa humman astafago.Wa hu baa' al-zere'
wa chaal nuss taman al-zere' le nafsah wa sallam al-gurus al-faddal le l-rusul fi chaan al-akhwaan.Wa gaal da bas tamanah.Wa kulla cheyy al-sawwaah da,martah irfatah.
Wa Butrus sa'alah wa gaal-:-Ya Hanaaniiya,maalak khalleet al-Cheetaan yal'ab be aglak-?Maalak kadabt le l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa chilt le nafsak nuss taman al-zere'-?
Kan awwal ma bi'tah,kulla l-zere' da hanaak.Wa ba'ad bi'tah kula,kan dawwart tichiil kulla l-gurus hu hanaak halaalak.Maala chilt niiye le takdib-?Be misil da,ma kadabt le l-naas.Inta kadabt le Allah-!
Wa wakit Hanaaniiya simi' al-kalaam da,hu waga' fi turaab wa maat.Wa l-khoof dakhal le kulla l-naas al-sim'o al-khabar da.
Wa waahidiin min al-subyaan kaffano Hanaaniiya wa waddooh fi l-khubuur wa dafanooh.
Wa gariib talaata saa'aat ba'ad da,marit Hanaaniiya jaat wa hi ma irfat al-cheyy al-bigi.
Wa Butrus sa'alaaha wa gaal-:-Ooriini,da bas taman al-zere' kulla ke walla-? Wa hi raddat leyah wa gaalat-:-Aywa,da bas al-gurus.
Wa Butrus gaal leeha-:-Maala astafagti ma'a raajilki achaan tijarrubu Ruuh Allah-?Asma'e al-haraka di.Dool al-subyaan jaayiin fi khachum al-beet.Humman dafano raajilki wa yiwadduuki inti kula-!
Wa tawwaali ke,hi waga'at giddaam Butrus wa maatat.Wa l-subyaan dakhalo fi l-beet wa ligooha mayte wa gallooha wa macho dafanooha jamb raajilha.
Wa khoof chadiid dakhal le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin wa le kulla l-naas al-sim'o al-khabar da.
Wa l-rusul sawwo ajaayib wa alaamat katiiriin fi ust al-naas.Wa kulla l-mu'miniin induhum galib waahid wa gaa'idiin yilimmu fi raakuubat Suleymaan fi fadaayit beet Allah.
Wa l-naas al-ma minhum ma yilimmu ma'aahum wa laakin kulla l-naas gaa'idiin yachkuruuhum.
Wa adad al-mu'miniin be l-Rabb Isa bada yiziid be ziyaada,min al-rujaal wa min al-awiin.
Wa naas al-madiina gaa'idiin yamurgu al-mardaaniin fi buruuchhum wa fi saraayirhum wa yukhuttuuhum fi l-chawaari' al-Butrus yufuut fooghum.Wa be da,dullah yikhatti waahidiin minhum wa yalgo al-aafe.
Wa min ayyi hille al-gariibe le Madiinat al-Khudus,naas katiiriin marra waahid jaayiin wa humman jaaybiin ma'aahum akhwaanhum al-mardaaniin wa muchootiniin wa kulluhum ligo al-aafe.
Wa laakin kabiir rujaal al-diin wa kulla akhwaanah al-Sadduukhiyiin anhasado fi l-rusul husud chadiid.
Wa karabo al-rusul wa dassoohum fi l-sijin.
Wa laakin fi ust al-leel,waahid min malaa'ikat Allah ja fakka biibaan al-sijin wa maragaahum minnah.Wa gaal leehum-:
Amchu andasso fi beet Allah wa ballukhu le l-naas kulla kalaam al-bichaara al-tiwaddiihum le l-haya al-jadiide di.
Wa l-rusul sim'o kalaamah wa be fajur badri,dakhalo beet Allah wa gammo yi'allumu al-naas.Wa wakit kabiir rujaal al-diin wa kulla l-naas al-ma'aayah wislo,naado al-majlas yilimmu.Wa kulla chuyuukh Bani Israa'iil jo.Wa rassalo hurraas achaan yamurgu al-rusul min al-sijin wa yijiibuuhum le l-majlas.
Wa l-hurraas macho le l-sijin wa laakin ma ligoohum.Wa gabbalo ooro al-kubaaraat.
Wa gaalo-:-Ligiina baab al-sijin masduud adiil wa hurraasah waagfiin giddaamah wa laakin wakit fakkeena al-baab,ma ligiina ayyi naadum daakhal-!
Wa kabiir hurraas beet Allah wa kubaaraat rujaal al-diin sim'o al-kalaam da wa ma irfo yisawwu chunu.Wa assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Kikkeef al-kalaam da yikammil-?
Wa naadum waahid ja fi l-majlas wa gaal-:-Ya l-jamaa'a,al-rujaal al-intu dasseetuuhum fi l-sijin gaa'idiin fi beet Allah wa yi'allumu al-naas.
Wa kabiir al-hurraas macha ma'a hurraasah wa jaabo al-rusul wa laakin ma jaaboohum be gu achaan humman khaayfiin min al-cha'ab yarjumuuhum.
Wa wakit jaabo al-rusul giddaam al-majlas,kabiir rujaal al-diin sa'alaahum
wa gaal-:-Aniina amarnaaku be kalaam chadiid wa gulna leeku ma ti'allumu al-naas be usum Isa.Laakin intu maleetu Madiinat al-Khudus be ta'liimku wa l-naas gaa'idiin yihajju foogah.Wa intu tidooru tukhuttu fi raasna dimmit al-raajil da-!
Wa Butrus wa l-rusul raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Waajib nitaabu'u kalaam Allah wa ma kalaam al-naas.
Allah Rabb juduudna ba'as Isa al-intu allagtuuh fi hatab al-saliib wa kataltuuh.
Wa laakin Allah ga''adah be nussah al-zeenaay wa ja'alah malik wa munajji.Wa be da,anta fursa le Bani Israa'iil achaan yutuubu wa hu yakhfir leehum zunuubhum.
Wa aniina chuhuud le l-kalaam da.Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-Allah yinazzilah fi l-naas al-yitaabu'u kalaamah,hu kula chaahid ma'aana.
Wa wakit naas al-majlas sim'o al-kalaam da,zi'ilo za'al chadiid wa dawwaro yaktulu al-rusul.
Wa laakin naadum waahid min al-majlas gamma foog achaan yikallim leehum.Usmah Gamaliyiil wa hu Fariizi wa mu'allim fi l-Tawraat wa kulla l-naas yikarrumuuh.Wa amar yamurgu al-rusul min al-majlas le wakit chiyya.
Wa kallam le naas al-majlas wa gaal-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil,aw'u baalku.Fakkuru adiil gubbaal ma tisawwu cheyy fasil le l-rujaal dool.
Fakkuru,min siniin,Suudaas gamma wa sawwa nafsah naadum kabiir wa gariib 400 rujaal taaba'ooh.Laakin naadum waahid katalah wa l-naas al-ma'aayah chatto wa l-haraka wagafat.
Wa ba'ad da,Yahuuza al-min daar al-Jaliil gamma fi l-sana al-sajjalo foogha al-naas.Wa lamma naas katiiriin achaan yitaabu'uuh.Laakin hu kula maat wa l-naas al-taaba'ooh chatto.
Wa hassa' nuguul leeku khallu minku al-rujaal dool yamchu.Achaan kan fikirhum wa amalhum jaayiin min al-insaan,wiheedah bas yagiif.
Wa laakin kan kalaamhum da jaayi min Allah,abadan ma tagdaro tiwaggufuuhum.Wa tichiifu kadar intu gaa'idiin tihaarubu Allah-!-Wa naas al-majlas sim'o kalaamah.
Wa naado al-rusul daakhal wa farachoohum.Wa mana'oohum ma yi'allumu al-naas be usum Isa battaan wa khalaas talagoohum.
Wa l-rusul marago min bakaan al-majlas farhaaniin achaan Allah charrafaahum be l-ta'ab al-ti'ibooh fi chaan usum Isa.
Wa kulla yoom,humman gaa'idiin yi'allumu al-naas fi beet Allah wa fi buyuuthum wa gaa'idiin yiballukhu kadar Isa bas al-Masiih.Wa abadan ma wagafo minnah.
Wa fi l-wakit da,adad al-talaamiiz gaa'id yiziid.Wa l-naas al-yihajju kalaam yuunaani gammo yihaaruju al-naas al-yihajju kalaam ibraani.Harajoohum achaan ma gaa'idiin yantu musaa'ada al-yoomiiye le araamilhum al-miskiinaat.
Wa l-rusul al-atnaachar naado jamaa'at al-talaamiiz achaan yilimmu.Wa gaalo leehum-:-Aniina al-rusul ni'allumu kalaam Allah le l-naas wa ma waajib leena nikhallu khidmitna di achaan ninazzumu al-musaa'ada.
Achaan da ya akhwaanna,a'azulu min ambeenaatku sab'a rujaal,naas ma'ruufiin haalhum adiile wa malaaniin be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa induhum fikir adiil.Wa nikallufuuhum be l-khidme di.
Wa laakin kan leena aniina,ninkarbu fi l-sala wa fi ta'liim kalaam Allah.
Wa l-kalaam da ajabaahum kulluhum.Wa azalo Istifaan wa hu mu'min gawi malaan be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa azalo Filibbus wa Burkhuur wa Nikanuur wa Tiimuun wa Barmaan wa Niiguula al-min hillit Antaakiya,hu al-awwal dakhal fi diin al-Yahuud.
Wa gaddamo al-rujaal al-sab'a dool le l-rusul wa l-rusul sa'alo Allah leehum wa khatto iideehum fooghum achaan yantuuhum al-mas'uuliiye.
Wa naas ziyaada sim'o kalaam Allah wa adad al-talaamiiz zaad fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa katiiriin min rujaal al-diin aamano be Isa al-Masiih.
Wa Istifaan anmala be rahma wa gudra min Allah wa gaa'id yisawwi alaamaat wa ajaayib kubaar marra waahid fi ust al-naas.
Wa naas waahidiin min beet al-sala al-usmah beet al-Ma'tuugiin gammo diddah.Wa Yahuud waahidiin min al-Khayrawaan wa min al-Iskandariiya kula lammo ma'aahum wa aakhariin min balad Kilikiiya wa balad Aasiya.Wa gammo yikhaalutu Istifaan.
Wa laakin ma himlo kalaamah achaan hu gaa'id yikallim leehum be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa be ilim min Allah.
Wa achaan da,anto gurus le kaddaabiin waahidiin le yuguulu-:-Simi'na kalaam Istifaan wa hu gaal kalaam fasil fi Sayyidna Muusa wa fi Allah.
Wa be l-tuhma di,harracho al-naas wa l-chuyuukh wa l-ulama didd Istifaan.Wa karabooh wa waddooh giddaam al-majlas.
Wa jaabo kaddaabiin achaan yachhado foogah be kidib.Wa gaalo-:-Al-raajil da yikallim daayman kalaam fasil fi l-beet al-mukhaddas wa fi l-Tawraat.
Wa simi'na hu gaal Isa al-min al-Naasira yidammir beet Allah wa yikhayyir aadaatna al-Muusa antaahum leena.
Wa wakit kulla naas al-majlas hammaro Istifaan,chaafo wijhah yichaabih wijih malaa'ika.
Wa kabiir rujaal al-diin sa'al Istifaan wa gaal-:-Kalaamhum da sahiih walla-?
Wa Istifaan radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan wa l-abbahaat,asma'o kalaami.Allah al-Majiid baan le jiddina Ibraahiim wakit hu gaa'id fi balad been al-Nahreen gubbaal ma macha fi hillit Haaraan.
Wa Allah gaal leyah-:--Amrug min baladak wa min ahalak wa amchi fi l-balad al-niwassifha leek.--
Wa Ibraahiim marag min daar al-Kaldaaniyiin wa sakan fi Haaraan wa ga'ad hinaak lahaddi abuuh maat.Wa Allah jaabah fi l-balad di al-intu hassa' saakniin foogha.
Wa fi l-balad di,Allah ma antaah ard warasa wa la bakaan sakhayyar yukhutt foogah rijileenah kula.Wa laakin Allah waa'adah wa gaal yanti al-balad di warasa leyah hu wa le iyaalah.Wa fi l-wakit da,Ibraahiim ma indah wileed waahid kula.
Wa Allah kallam le Ibraahiim wa gaal leyah kadar zurriiytah yabgo ajaanib wa yaskunu fi balad al-ma hintuhum.Wa siyaad al-balad di yi'abbuduuhum wa yidaayuguuhum muddit 400 sana.
Wa Allah gaal-:﴾‍Ana ni'aakhib al-umma al-ti'abbidhum wa ba'ad da,zurriiytak yamurgu wa ya'abuduuni fi l-bakaan da.‍﴿
Wa Allah sawwa mu'aahada hana tahuura ma'a Ibraahiim.Wa be sabab da,Ibraahiim tahhar Ishaakh ba'ad tamaane yoom min waaluudtah.Wa Ishaakh tahhar wileedah Yaakhuub wa Yaakhuub tahhar awlaadah al-atnaachar al-bigo juduudna.
Wa juduudna anhasado fi akhuuhum Yuusuf wa baa'ooh wa hu bigi abid fi Masir.Wa laakin Allah gaa'id ma'aayah
wa najjaah min kulla l-ta'ab al-ja foogah.Wa Allah antaah rahma wa hikma achaan ligi rida min Fir'oon malik Masir.Wa be da,Fir'oon darraj Yuusuf haakim fi Masir wa kallafah be mas'uuliiyit kulla beetah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-juu' dakhal fi Masir wa balad Kan'aan wa juduudna ta'baaniin bilheen wa l-ma'aach bigi ma fiih.
Wa Yaakhuub simi' khabar yuguulu al-Masriyiin induhum gameh wa rassal juduudna awwal marra hinaak.
Wa wakit macho taani marra,Yuusuf ooraahum hu akhuuhum.Wa fi l-wakit da bas,Yuusuf gaddam akhwaanah le Fir'oon.
Wa ba'ad da,Yuusuf naada abuuh Yaakhuub wa akhwaanah wa iyaalhum achaan yaju fi Masir wa humman 75 naas.
Wa be misil da,Yaakhuub wa juduudna jo fi Masir wa sakano foogha lahaddi maato.
Wa khalaas,waddo udaamhum fi hillit Chakiim wa dafanoohum fi l-khabur al-Ibraahiim charaah be fudda min Bani Hamuur fi Chakiim.
Wa l-wakit al-Allah yidoor yitimm foogah al-wa'ad al-antaah le Ibraahiim garrab.Wa Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yiziidu fi Masir wa adadhum bigi katiir ziyaada.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,malik jadiid rikib fi Masir wa hu ma irif cheyy fi Yuusuf.
