Wa khachchaahum le gabiilitna wa zalamaahum le juduudna wa jabaraahum achaan yikhallu atfaalhum barra le yumuutu.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,wildo Muusa wa hu wileed jamiil marra waahid giddaam Allah.Wa ammah wa abuuh rabbooh fi beethum talaata chahar.
Wa fi l-akhiir,waajib yamurguuh min beethum wa bineeyit Fir'oon chaalatah achaan yabga wileedha wa rabbatah misil wileedha.
Wa hu allam kulla ilim al-Masriyiin lahaddi bigi naadum chadiid fi kalaamah wa fi khidimtah.
Wa wakit Muusa umrah tamma 40 sana,chaal niiye achaan yamchi yichiif akhwaanah Bani Israa'iil.
Wa chaaf Masri waahid gaa'id yita''ib waahid minhum.Wa Muusa daafa' le akhuuh al-mazluum achaan yansurah wa katal al-Masri.
Wa fi fikrah akhwaanah yafhamo kadar Allah rassalah achaan yinajjiihum be iidah.Wa laakin humman ma fihmo.
Wa ambaakir,hu ligi naaseen min akhwaanah gaa'idiin yiddaawaso.Wa hu dawwar humman yissaamaho ambeenaathum wa gaal-:--Intu akhwaan wa maalku tiddaawaso-?--
Laakin al-naadum al-yita''ib al-aakhar lazza Muusa wa gaal-:--Yaatu khattaak foogna haakim wa gaadi-?
Walla tidoor taktulni misil amis katalt al-Masri da-?--
Wa wakit Muusa simi' al-kalaam da,hu jara min Masir wa macha bigi ajnabi fi balad Midyaan.Wa wakit saakin hinaak,wilid awlaad itneen.
Wa ba'ad 40 sana,Muusa gamma macha fi sahara hana jabal Siinaa' wa waahid min al-malaa'ika baan leyah fi naar fi lubb chideere.
Wa wakit Muusa chaafah,hu ajjab bilheen wa garrab le l-chideere achaan yichiifah adiil.Wa khalaas,hiss Allah ansama'.
Wa Allah gaal-:--Ana Allah Rabb juduudku Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub.- Wa Muusa rajaf wa khaaf khoof chadiid wa ma dawwar yichiifah.
Wa Allah kallam leyah wa gaal-:--Sill ni'leek min rijileenak achaan al-bakaan al-inta waagif foogah da ard mukhaddasa.
Ana chift al-ta'ab al-chadiid hana cha'abi al-gaa'idiin fi Masir wa ana simi't siraakhhum wa nazalt achaan ninajjiihum.Wa hassa' ta'aal,nirassilak inta fi Masir.-
Wa Istifaan gaal-:-Muusa da,hu al-naadum al-akhwaanah abooh ma khiblooh wa l-gaalo leyah-:--Yaatu khattaak foogna haakim wa gaadi.- Wa laakin hu bas al-naadum al-Allah rassalah achaan yabga haakimhum wa munajjiihum min al-Masriyiin be musaa'adat al-malak al-baan leyah fi l-chideere.
Wa hu maragaahum min Masir.Wa fi muddit 40 sana,sawwa ajaayib wa alaamaat kubaar fi balad Masir wa fi l-bahar al-Ahmar wa fi l-sahara.
Wa Muusa da,hu al-kallam le Bani Israa'iil wa gaal-:﴾‍Ba'adeen Allah yigawwim leeku min akhwaanku nabi misli ana.‍﴿
Wa wakit jamaa'at Bani Israa'iil laammiin fi l-sahara,Muusa bas al-wasiit ambeen juduudna wa l-malak al-kallam ma'aayah fi jabal Siinaa'.Leyah hu bas,Allah nazzal kalaam al-haya achaan yantiih leena.
Wa laakin juduudna abo ma sim'ooh.Humman ma dawwaro yitaabu'uuh.Wa fi guluubhum dawwaro yigabbulu fi Masir.
Wa hajjo le Haaruun wa gaalo-:--Asna' leena asnaam wa khalliihum yuguuduuna fi l-derib,achaan ma na'arfu al-cheyy al-bigi le Muusa al-maragaana min balad Masir.--
Wa fi l-wakit da,sana'o al-sanam al-yichaabih ijil.Wa gaddamo leyah dahiiye wa ayyado be farha giddaam al-cheyy al-humman bas sawwooh.
Wa Allah kassa minhum wa khallaahum ya'abudu khuwwaat al-sama.Wa da maktuub fi kitaab al-anbiya al-buguul-:﴾‍Ya Bani Israa'iil,fi muddit 40 sana fi l-sahara,gaddamtu dahaaya wa hadaaya leyi ana walla-?
La,abadan-!Fi l-sahara,intu chaayliin kheemat al-ibaada hana Muulakwa chaayliin ilaahku najmat Rafaan.Dool al-asnaam al-sana'tuuhumachaan tasjudu leehum.Wa be sabab da,niwaddiiku fi l-khurbakhaadi le balad Baabil.‍﴿
Wa fi l-sahara,juduudna chaalo ma'aahum al-kheema al-foogha liihaan al-mu'aahada.Di al-kheema al-Muusa banaaha misil Allah amarah beyah.Wa hu banaaha misil al-nizaam al-Allah wassafah.
Wa ba'ad da,Yachuu' wa juduudna jaabo kheemat al-ibaada al-foogha al-sanduug fi l-balad di wakit dakhalo foogha wa malakooha.Wa Allah tarad kulla l-gabaayil al-saakniin foogha min giddaamhum.Wa l-kheema di gaa'ide lahaddi zaman Dawuud.
Wa Allah ridi be Dawuud wa Dawuud talab izin achaan yabni beet gawi le Allah Rabb Bani Yaakhuub.
Wa fi l-akhiir,wileedah Suleymaan bana beet Allah.
Wa laakin Allah al-Aali ma saakin fi buyuut al-banoohum al-naas.Achaan da,kitaab al-nabi buguul-:
﴾‍Daahu Allah gaal-:Al-sama archiwa l-ard bakaan nukhutt rijileeni.Hal tagdaro tabnu beet al-yichiilni-?Walla tagdaro tabnu leyi bakaan le l-raaha-?
Kulla cheyy al-gaa'id,ana bas al-khalagtah.‍﴿
Wa Istifaan gaal-:-Ya l-naas al-aasiyiin-!Guluubku gawiyiin wa ma tidooru tasma'o kalaam Allah-!Intu daayman ta'aso al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Intu tisawwu nafs al-cheyy misil juduudku sawwooh.
Ween al-nabi al-juduudku ma ta''abooh-?Humman katalo al-anbiya al-ballakho leehum be jayyit abdah al-saalih al-Masiih wa wakit al-Masiih ja khalaas,intu khuntuuh wa kataltuuh-!
Intu bas al-naas al-Allah nazzal leeku al-Tawraat be waasitat al-malaa'ika wa laakin ma taaba'tu kalaamah-!
Wa wakit naas al-majlas sim'o kalaam Istifaan,khidbo khadab chadiid wa addo sunuunhum min al-za'al diddah.
Wa Istifaan anmala be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa rafa' raasah wa gaa'id yichiif foog fi l-sama.Wa hu chaaf majd Allah wa Isa waagif jamb Allah fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Wa Istifaan gaal-:-Ana chaayif al-sama faatih wa chaayif Ibn al-Insaan waagif jamb Allah fi nussah al-zeenaay-!
Wa l-naas awwo be hiss chadiid wa ayyi waahid minhum sadda adaanah be iideenah wa kulluhum gammo hajamooh.
Wa maragooh barra min al-madiina wa gammo yarjumuuh.Wa l-chuhuud al-gaa'idiin yarjumuuhsallo khulgaanhum al-barraaniyiin wa khalloohum ma'a sabi usmah Chaawuul le yahrishum.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yarjumuuh,Istifaan da'a wa gaal-:-Ya Rabbina Isa,chiil ruuhi.
Wa barak wa sarakh be hiss chadiid wa gaal-:-Ya Rabb,ma tahsib khataahum da fooghum. Wa wakit gaal al-kalaam da,khalaas hu maat.
Wa Chaawuul muwaafig be katil Istifaan.Wa fi nafs al-yoom bas,al-naas gammo yita''ubu ummat al-Masiih fi Madiinat al-Khudus ta'ab chadiid.Wa kulla l-akhwaan jaro min al-madiina wa chatto fi l-kadaade hana daar al-Yahuudiiya wa daar al-Saamira.Wa illa l-rusul faddalo fi l-madiina.
Wa rujaal takhiyiin chaalo Istifaan wa dafanooh.Wa hizno leyah katiir wa faracho leyah.
Wa laakin Chaawuul dawwar yidammir ummat al-Masiih marra waahid wa gamma andassa beet le beet achaan yakrub rujaal wa awiin wa yidissuhum fi l-sijin.
Wa l-mu'miniin al-chatto fi ayyi bakaan gaa'idiin yiballukhu al-bichaara le kulla l-naas.
Wa Filibbus macha fi hille kabiire fi daar al-Saamira wa gamma yiballikh le l-naas be bichaarat al-Masiih.
Wa naas katiiriin lammo be niiye waahide le yasma'o kalaamah achaan waahidiin minhum sim'o be l-ajaayib wa waahidiin minhum chaafoohum be uyuunhum.
Wa Filibbus gaa'id yaamur al-chawaatiin achaan yamurgu min al-naas wa l-chawaatiin yasrakho be hiss chadiid wa yamurgu minhum.Wa gaa'id yidaawi naas ma'duuriin katiiriin wa minhum al-mukarsahiin wa l-uruj.
Wa kulla naas al-hille firho bilheen.
Wa fi l-hille di,fiyah naadum waahid usmah Siimuun wa hu sahhaari.Wa min wakit tawiil,naas al-Saamira gaa'idiin yil'ajjabo foogah.Wa hu gaa'id yuguul leehum hu naadum muhimm bilheen.
Wa kulla l-naas,al-sukhaar wa l-kubaar,yasma'o kalaamah wa yuguulu-:-Hu gudrat Allah al-Aziim.
Wa yasma'o kulla kalaamah achaan min zamaan humman yil'ajjabo foogah bilheen min al-sihir al-hu yisawwiih.
Wa Filibbus bachcharaahum be Isa al-Masiih wa mamlakat Allah wa l-Saamiriyiin aamano be kalaamah.Wa humman jo le Filibbus,rujaal wa awiin,achaan hu yikhattishum.
Wa Siimuun kula aaman wa Filibbus khattasah.Wa ayyi bakaan al-Filibbus yamchi foogah,Siimuun yamchi ma'aayah wa hu chaaf al-ajaayib wa l-alaamaat al-Filibbus gaa'id yisawwiihum wa hu al'ajjab marra waahid.
Wa l-rusul fi Madiinat al-Khudus sim'o kadar naas al-Saamira aamano be kalaam Allah wa rassalo leehum Butrus wa Yuuhanna.
Wa wakit wislo fi l-Saamira,sa'alo Allah achaan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yanzil fi l-mu'miniin.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus lissaa' ma nazal fooghum achaan khattasoohum be usum al-Rabb Isa bas.
Wa khalaas,wakit al-rusul khatto iideehum fi l-mu'miniin,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus nazal fooghum.
Wakit Siimuun chaaf al-rusul khatto iideehum fi l-naas wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus nazal fooghum,hu ja le l-rusul achaan yantiihum gurus.
Wa Siimuun gaal leehum-:-Leyi ana kula antuuni gudra achaan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yanzil fi ayyi naadum al-nukhutt iideeni foogah.
Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta wa gursak kula hatab al-naar achaan inta fakkart tagdar tachri be gursak barakat Allah-!
Inta ma tagdar tichaarik fi l-khidme di wa la indak hagg achaan galbak ma mukhlis giddaam Allah.
Tuub min fasaaltak di wa as'al Rabbina.Akuun yakhfir leek fikrak al-fasil da.
Na'arif kadar inta malaan be l-charr wa mugayyad fi l-zunuub.
Wa Siimuun gaal-:-As'alo leyi Rabbina achaan al-cheyy al-gultuuh ma yaji foogi.
Wa Butrus wa Yuuhanna ballakho bichaarat al-Rabb le naas al-Saamira wa chahado le l-Masiih.Wa ba'ad da,gabbalo fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa wakit humman maachiin fi deribhum,ballakho al-bichaara fi hillaal katiiriin hana daar al-Saamira.
Wa ba'ad da,waahid min malaa'ikat Allah ja le Filibbus wa gaal-:-Gumm amchi ale jiihat al-wati wa chiil al-derib al-yuchugg al-kadaade min Madiinat al-Khudus lahaddi hillit Khazza.
Wa Filibbus gamma macha wa ligi naadum waahid khasi min al-Habacha.Hu khaddaam hana Kandaake malikat al-Habacha wa hu waziir al-maal.Wa l-khaddaam da macha Madiinat al-Khudus achaan ya'abud Allah.
Wa wakit mugabbil fi baladah,hu raakib fi arabatah wa gaa'id yagri fi kitaab al-nabi Icha'ya.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus kallam le Filibbus wa gaal-:-Amchi giddaam wa ruukh jamb al-arabiiye.
Wa Filibbus macha ajala wa lihig al-arabiiye wa simi' al-kalaam al-hu yagriih al-gaa'id fi kitaab al-nabi Icha'ya.Wa Filibbus sa'alah wa gaal-:-Inta tafham al-kalaam al-gaa'id tagriih walla-?
Wa l-Habachi radda leyah wa gaal-:-Kikkeef nafham al-kalaam da kan naadum ma yifassirah leyi-? Wa hu azam Filibbus achaan yarkab fi l-arabiiye wa yagood ma'aayah.
Wa fi l-kitaab al-gaa'id yagriih,hu lihig al-aaya al-tuguul-:﴾‍Misil hamal al-yiwadduuh le l-dabihwa misil na'aje saakte wakit yigassusu suufha,hu kula ma fakka khachmah.
Naas ayyaboohwa ma antooh al-hagg fi l-charii'a.Wa yaatu yihajji be zurriiytah-?Achaan fasalooh min al-hayyiin fi l-ard.‍﴿
Wa l-khasi sa'al Filibbus wa gaal-:-Fi l-kalaam da,al-nabi yihajji be yaatu-?Yihajji be nafsah walla be naadum aakhar-?
Wa Filibbus hajja leyah wa bada be kalaam al-kitaab da wa ballakh leyah bichaarat Isa.
Wa wakit humman maachiin fi l-derib,wislo fi bakaan indah almi wa l-Habachi gaal-:-Chiif,daahu almi.Chunu al-yadharni ma tikhattisni-?
Wa Filibbus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Nikhattisak kan aamant be kulla galbak. Wa hu gaal-:-Ana mu'min be Isa al-Masiih.Hu Ibn Allah.
Wa l-Habachi waggaf al-arabiiye wa nazalo minha wa dakhalo fi l-almi wa Filibbus khattasah.
Wa wakit marago min al-almi,tawwaali Ruuh Allah khataf Filibbus wa l-khasi ma chaafah battaan.Wa gamma chaal derbah farhaan bilheen.
Wa Filibbus da,hu anchaaf fi hillit Achduud wa macha yiballikh al-bichaara fi kulla l-hillaal lahaddi wisil fi hillit Geesariiya.
Wa laakin Chaawuul lissaa'ah za'laan wa gaa'id yihaddidhum be l-katil le talaamiiz al-Rabb Isa.Wa macha le kabiir rujaal al-diin
wa talab minnah jawaabaat le buyuut al-sala fi madiinat Dimachkh.Wa fi l-jawaabaat dool,yantuuh izin achaan yakrub ayyi naadum al-yitaabi' derib Isa al-Masiih,kan raajil walla mara.Wa fi ayyi bakaan al-yalgaahum foogah,yakrubhum wa yiwaddiihum mugayyadiin fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa Chaawuul macha.Wa wakit garrab le Dimachkh,faj'atan nuur chadiid min al-sama daawa foogah.
Wa Chaawuul waga' fi l-turaab wa simi' hiss naadum gaa'id yikallim leyah wa yuguul-:-Ya Chaawuul,ya Chaawuul-!Maalak tita''ibni-?
Wa Chaawuul sa'alah wa gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid,inta yaatu-? Wa l-hiss gaal-:-Ana Isa al-inta gaa'id tita''ibah.
Gumm wa adkhul fi Dimachkh wa naadum waahid yi'ooriik be l-cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih.
Wa l-naas al-maachiin ma'a Chaawuul wagafo wa sakato min al-ajab achaan sim'o al-hiss wa laakin ma chaafo naadum.
Wa wakit Chaawuul gamma foog wa fakka uyuunah ma gidir yichiif cheyy.Wa karabooh min iideenah wa waddooh fi Dimachkh.
Wa talaata yoom ma yichiif cheyy wa la yaakul wa la yachrab.
Wa naadum waahid gaa'id fi Dimachkh usmah Hanaaniiya wa hu tilmiiz al-Masiih.Al-Rabb Isa baan leyah fi ru'ya wa gaal-:-Ya Hanaaniiya-! Wa Hanaaniiya radda leyah wa gaal-:-Na'am,ya Rabb.
Wa l-Rabb kallam leyah wa gaal-:-Amchi fi l-chaari' al-usmah al-Mustakhiim wa amchi fi beet hana Yahuuza.As'al min al-naadum al-min hillit Tarsuus al-usmah Chaawuul achaan hassa' hu gaa'id yisalli.
Wa fi salaatah,hu ri'i wa fi l-ru'ya,hu chaaf naadum usmah Hanaaniiya dakhal fi beetah wa khatta iideenah foogah achaan uyuunah yinfathu.
Wa Hanaaniiya radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Rabbina,simi't khabar min naas katiiriin yuguulu al-raajil da sawwa amal cheen fi naasak al-saalihiin fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa yuguulu hu ja hini be izin kubaaraat rujaal al-diin achaan yakrub ayyi naadum al-yad'i be usmak.
Wa l-Rabb hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Amchi bas.Al-raajil da,ana azaltah achaan yabga khaddaami wa yamchi yibachchir be usmi le l-naas al-ma Yahuud wa le muluukhum wa le Bani Israa'iil.
Wa ana bas niwassif leyah al-ta'ab al-chadiid al-hu yat'abah fi chaani ana.
Wa khalaas,Hanaaniiya gamma wa macha fi beet Yahuuza wa khatta iideenah fi Chaawuul wa gaal-:-Ya akhuuna Chaawuul,Rabbina Isa baan leek fi l-derib wakit inta jaayi hini wa hu bas rassalaani leek achaan tichiif battaan wa tinmali be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa tawwaali,chokhol misil gichir waga' min uyuunah wa battaan gamma yichiif.Wa Chaawuul gamma foog wa khattasooh.
Wa akal wa ligi gudra.Wa ga'ad ayyaam chiyya ma'a l-talaamiiz fi Dimachkh.
Wa tawwaali ke,Chaawuul macha fi buyuut al-sala wa ballakh al-naas be Isa wa gaal kadar Isa hu Ibn Allah.
Wa kulla l-naas al-sim'o kalaamah al'ajjabo marra waahid wa gaalo-:-Da bas al-naadum al-gamma fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa ta''ab al-naas al-yad'u be usum Isa.Wa daahu ja hini achaan yakrubhum wa yiwaddiihum fi bakaan kubaaraat rujaal al-diin.
Laakin Chaawuul bigi gawi ziyaada.Wa l-Yahuud al-fi Dimachkh ma gidro yikhaalufuuh achaan be kalaam waadih hu gaa'id yisabbit leehum kadar Isa hu al-Masiih.
Wa ba'ad Chaawuul ga'ad ayyaam fi Dimachkh,al-Yahuud achchaawaro ambeenaathum achaan yaktuluuh.
Wa Chaawuul simi' khabar mu'aamarathum.Wa l-Yahuud gaa'idiin yarjooh fi biibaan al-madiina leel wa nahaar achaan yaktuluuh.
Wa khalaas be l-leel,waahidiin min talaamiizah waddo Chaawuul le durdur al-madiina wa dassooh fi chabaka kabiire wa dallooh tihit be habil khaadi min al-durdur.
Wa Chaawuul macha fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa dawwar yilimm ma'a talaamiiz al-Masiih wa laakin humman ma saddago kadar hu kula tilmiiz wa humman khaayfiin minnah.
Wa Barnaaba lamma ma'a Chaawuul wa gaddamah le l-rusul.Wa Barnaaba ooraahum be kikkeef al-Rabb baan le Chaawuul fi derib Dimachkh wa kallam leyah.Wa ooraahum be kikkeef Chaawuul gamma bala khoof fi Dimachkh wa ballakh al-bichaara be usum al-Rabb Isa.
Wa khalaas,Chaawuul bada yakhdim ma'aahum fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa gaa'id yiballikh bala khoof al-bichaara be usum Isa.
Wa kallam le l-Yahuud al-yihajju be kalaam yuunaani wa khaalataahum.Wa humman al'aamaro foogah achaan yaktuluuh.
Wa l-akhwaan sim'o be l-kalaam da wa waddo Chaawuul fi khachum al-bahar fi hillit Geesariiya.Wa min hinaak,rassalooh fi Tarsuus.
Wa khalaas,ummat al-Masiih al-fi daar al-Yahuudiiya wa fi daar al-Jaliil wa fi daar al-Saamira gaa'ide be aafe wa salaam.Wa kulla l-mu'miniin khaayfiin min al-Rabb wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus chajja'aahum wa adadhum zaad.
Wa Butrus gaa'id yamchi min hille le hille wa khalaas macha le l-mu'miniin al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Ludda.
Wa ligi naadum waahid mukarsah usmah Inyaas.Min tamaane sana,hu raagid fi l-sariir.
Wa Butrus hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Inyaas,Isa al-Masiih yachfiik.Gumm foog wa tabbig sariirak. Wa tawwaali,Inyaas gamma wa ligi al-aafe.
Wa kulla sukkaan Ludda wa Chaaruun chaafooh wa aamano be l-Rabb Isa.
Wa mara waahide gaa'ide fi hillit Yaafa usumha Taabiita wa be kalaam yuunaani,da Duurkaas ma'anaatah khazaala.Wa hi kula min al-talaamiiz.Wa kulli yoom,hi gaa'ide tisaa'id al-masaakiin wa hi daayman chakhkhaala be amal al-kheer.
Wa fi l-wakit da,hi bigat mardaane wa maatat.Wa barradooha wa khatto janaazitha fi l-gasir al-taani.
Wa l-talaamiiz al-fi Yaafa sim'o khabar Butrus gaa'id fi Ludda.Wa Ludda ma ba'iide min Yaafa wa khalaas rassalo rujaal itneen achaan yinaaduuh wa yuguulu leyah-:-Ta'aal leena ajala.
Wa Butrus gamma macha ma'aahum.Wa wakit ja fi l-beet,waddooh foog fi l-bakaan al-hi raagde foogah.Wa kulla l-ajaayiz al-miskiinaat gaa'idaat yabkan wa machan le Butrus achaan yiwassifan leyah al-lubaas wa l-khulgaan al-Duurkaas khayyatathum wakit hi hayye.
Wa Butrus talab min kulla l-naas al-haadiriin yamurgu barra.Wa wakit marago,hu barak wa sa'al Allah.Wa ba'ad da,hu anlafat le l-janaaza wa gaal-:-Ya Taabiita,gummi foog-! Wa hi fakkat uyuunha.Wa wakit chaafat Butrus,hi gammat be heelha.
Wa Butrus karabha min iideenha wa aawanaaha wa hi gammat foog.Wa naada kulla l-saalihiin wa l-ajaayiz wa khalaas gaddamaaha leehum hayye.
Wa kulla naas hillit Yaafa sim'o be l-ajab da wa naas katiiriin aamano be l-Rabb Isa.
Wa Butrus ga'ad ayyaam fi Yaafa wa sakan fi beet dabbaakhi waahid usmah Sim'aan.
Wa fi hillit Geesariiya,fiyah naadum waahid usmah Karniili.Hu askari Roomaani wa kabiir fi 100 askar min al-firkha al-Itaaliiye.
Hu naadum takhi wa hu wa kulla naas beetah khaayfiin min Allah.Hu yanti sadakha katiir le l-masaakiin wa daayman gaa'id yas'al Allah.
Wa yoom waahid misil al-saa'a talaata ba'ad al-duhur,ru'ya jaat le Karniili.Wa fi l-ru'ya di,hu chaaf waahid min malaa'ikat Allah jaayi leyah fi beetah.Wa l-malak kallam leyah wa gaal-:-Ya Karniili-!
Wa wakit chaaf al-malak,hu khaaf bilheen wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Chunu,ya sayyidna-? Wa l-malak radda leyah wa gaal-:-Allah khibil salaawaatak wa l-sadakha al-anteetha.Wa hu jaahiz le yurudd leek.
Wa hassa' bas rassil rujaal fi hillit Yaafa achaan yinaadu Sim'aan al-binaaduuh Butrus achaan yaji leek.
Hu deef hana Sim'aan al-dabbaakhi al-beetah jamb al-bahar.
Wa wakit al-malak al-kallam leyah faat,Karniili naada khaddaamiin itneen wa naada naadum takhi min al-askar al-gaa'idiin daayman ma'aayah.
Wa ooraahum be l-cheyy al-bigi wa rassalaahum le Yaafa.
Wa ambaakir be duhur wakit al-rujaal al-talaata dool maachiin fi l-derib garrabo le hillit Yaafa,Butrus tala' fi raas al-beet achaan yisalli.
Wa juu' chadiid sawwaah wa dawwar yaakul.Wa wakit gaa'idiin yijahhuzu leyah akil,cheyy misil ru'ya ja leyah.
Wa fi l-ru'ya di,chaaf al-sama faatih wa cheyy misil git'e kabiire mafluula wa makruuba min jawaanibha al-arba'a naazle fi l-ard.
Wa l-git'e di malaane be kulla nafar al-haywaanaat al-fi l-ard wa l-zawaahif wa l-tuyuur.
Wa Butrus simi' hiss gaa'id yinaadiih wa yuguul-:-Ya Butrus,gumm-!Adbah wa aakul-!
Wa laakin Butrus radda leyah wa gaal-:-La,ya Rabbi-!Abadan ma akalt cheyy haraam wa la cheyy nijis.
Wa l-hiss kallam leyah battaan wa gaal-:-Al-cheyy al-Allah tahharah,ma tuguul nijis.
Wa l-cheyy da bigi talaata marraat wa tawwaali al-git'e anrafa'at fi l-sama.
Wa Butrus al'ajjab wa bada yas'al fi nafsah chunu ma'ana al-ru'ya al-chaafaaha.Wa fi l-wakit da bas,al-rujaal al-Karniili rassalaahum ligo beet Sim'aan al-dabbaakhi wa jo wagafo fi khachum al-beet.
Wa gaa'idiin yas'alo naas al-beet wa yuguulu-:-Sim'aan al-yinaaduuh Butrus da,hu deef fi bakaanku walla-?
Wakit Butrus gaa'id yifakkir fi ma'ana al-ru'ya di bas,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus kallam leyah wa gaal-:-Asma',fi talaata rujaal gaa'idiin fi khachum al-beet.Yas'alo minnak.
Dalli tihit wa laagiihum wa amchi ma'aahum wa ma tichakkik fooghum.Ana bas rassaltuhum leek.
Wa addalla tihit wa macha leehum wa gaal-:-Ana bas al-naadum al-tidooruuh.Jiitu le chunu-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Karniili rassalaana.Wa Karniili da hu kabiir askar wa raajil saalih wa khaayif min Allah.Wa kulla l-Yahuud yachhado leyah hu naadum adiil.Wa waahid min malaa'ikat Allah ja leyah wa gaal waajib Karniili yinaadiik tamchi beetah achaan yasma' kalaamak.
Wa Butrus dayyafaahum wa ragado fi l-beet.Wa be fajur,Butrus gamma wa macha ma'aahum.Wa waahidiin min al-akhwaan min Yaafa kula macho ma'a Butrus.
Wa ambaakir,wislo fi Geesariiya wa Karniili gaa'id yarjaahum ma'a akhwaanah wa rufgaanah al-marra waahid.
Wa wakit Butrus gaa'id yadkhul fi l-beet,Karniili gaabalah wa sajad leyah.
Wa Butrus rafa'ah wa gaal-:-Gumm foog-!Ana insaan mislak inta bas.
Wa Butrus dakhal fi l-beet wa gaa'id yihajji ma'aayah wa macha daakhal wa ligi naas katiiriin laammiin.
Wa gaal leehum-:-Intu ta'arfu fi diin al-Yahuud haraam le Yahuudi yilimm ma'a naadum ma Yahuudi.Wa la yisallimah fi beetah kula.Wa laakin Allah ooraani ma waajib nuguul ayyi naadum nijis walla ma taahir be sabab gabiiltah.
Wa achaan da,wakit naadeetuuni,ana ma gult kalaam wa jiit leeku.Wa hassa' ooruuni naadeetuuni le chunu-?
Wa Karniili radda leyah wa gaal-:-Indina arba'a yoom,al-saa'a misil al-wakit da,ana fi beeti wa gaa'id nisalli sala hana l-saa'a talaata.Wa faj'atan,raajil laabis khalag abyad misil al-barraaga baan giddaami.
Wa gaal leyi-:--Ya Karniili,Allah simi' salaawaatak wa fakkar fi l-sadakha al-inta anteetha.
Wa hassa' rassil rujaal fi Yaafa achaan yinaadu Sim'aan al-binaaduuh Butrus achaan yaji leek.Hu deef hana Sim'aan al-dabbaakhi al-beetah jamb al-bahar.--
Wa tawwaali,ana rassaltuhum achaan yinaaduuk wa chukran be jaytak.Wa khalaas,kullina gaa'idiin hini giddaam Allah achaan nasma'o kulla l-kalaam al-Allah amarak beyah.
Wa Butrus gamma yikallim leehum wa gaal-:-Khalaas dahaaba ana fihimt kadar sahiih ke,Allah ma yichiif gabiila waahide akheer min gabaayil aakhariin.
Wa Allah yakhbal naadum min ayyi gabiila kan yakhaaf minnah wa amalah saalih.
Wa akiid,Allah rassal le Bani Israa'iil bichaarat al-salaam al-yantiiha be Isa al-Masiih,Rabb hana kulla l-naas.
Wa intu ta'arfu kulla cheyy al-bigi fi daar al-Yahuudiiya.Al-cheyy al-bigi da bada fi daar al-Jaliil ba'ad Yahya naada al-naas achaan yikhattishum.
Wa ta'arfu kadar Allah nazzal al-Ruuh al-Khudduus fi Isa al-min al-Naasira wa darrajah Masiih wa antaah gudra.Wa Isa sawwa al-kheer fi ayyi bakaan wa chafa kulla l-naas al-Ibliis azzabaahum achaan Allah kaan ma'aayah.
Wa aniina chuhuud fi kulla cheyy al-Isa sawwaah fi daar al-Yahuud wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa khalaas,allagooh fi l-saliib wa katalooh.
Wa ba'ad talaata yoom,Allah gawwamah min al-moot wa bayyanah le l-naas.
Wa laakin ma bayyanah le kulla l-naas,illa le l-chuhuud al-hu azalaahum min awwal.Wa da leena aniina al-akalna wa chiribna ma'aayah ba'ad hu ba'as min ust al-maytiin.
Wa Isa amaraana achaan niballukhu al-bichaara le l-cha'ab wa nachhado leyah wa nuguulu Isa bas al-naadum al-Allah ja'alah le yihaasib al-naas al-hayyiin wa l-maytiin.
Wa kulla l-anbiya yachhado le Isa wa yuguulu ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyah,yalga khufraan al-zunuub be usmah.
Wa wakit Butrus lissaa' gaa'id yikallim leehum ke bas,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus nazal fi kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin yasma'o kalaamah.
Wa l-mu'miniin al-min al-Yahuud al-jo ma'a Butrus al'ajjabo marra waahid achaan chaafo Allah anta al-Ruuh al-Khudduus le l-naas al-ma Yahuud kula.
Wa sim'oohum wa humman gaa'idiin yikallumu be lukhkhaat aakhariin wa yahmudu Allah be farha.Wa Butrus gaal-:
Fi naadum yadharna min al-almi achaan ma nikhattusu al-naas dool walla-?Allah antaahum humman al-Ruuh al-Khudduus misil antaah leena.
Wa Butrus amaraahum le akhwaanah achaan yikhattusuuhum be usum Isa al-Masiih.Wa ba'ad khattasoohum khalaas,Karniili wa akhwaanah talabo min Butrus yagood ma'aahum ayyaam.
Al-rusul wa l-akhwaan al-fi daar al-Yahuudiiya sim'o kadar al-naas al-ma Yahuud kula sim'o kalaam Allah wa aamano.
Wa wakit Butrus gabbal fi Madiinat al-Khudus,al-Masiihiyiin al-min al-Yahuud gammo yaharjuuh
wa gaalo-:-Maala inta dakhalt fi beet al-naas al-ma mutahhariin wa akalt ma'aahum-?
Wa Butrus gamma ooraahum be kulla cheyy al-bigi min al-awwal lahaddi l-akhiir wa gaal-:
Awwal ana gaa'id nisalli fi hillit Yaafa wa fi ru'ya jaat leyi.Wa fi l-ru'ya di,ana chift cheyy misil git'e kabiire mafluula wa makruuba min jawaanibha al-arba'a naazle min al-sama.
Wa ana chiftaha adiil wa chift fi lubbaha kulla nafar al-haywaanaat al-fi l-ard,min haywaanaat al-kadaade wa l-zawaahif wa l-tuyuur.
Wa simi't hiss gaa'id yihajji leyi wa yuguul-:--Ya Butrus,gumm-!Adbah wa aakul.--
Wa raddeet leyah wa gult-:--La,ya Rabbi-!Abadan ma dakhkhalt fi khachmi cheyy haraam wa la cheyy nijis.--
Wa battaan al-hiss kallam leyi min al-sama wa gaal-:--Al-cheyy al-Allah tahharah,ma tuguul nijis.--
Wa l-cheyy da bigi talaata marraat.Wa ba'ad da,al-git'e gabbalat fi l-sama be kulla cheyy al-foogha.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,talaata rujaal jo fi l-beet al-ana deef foogah wa rassaloohum leyi min Geesariiya.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus amaraani achaan namchi ma'aahum bala chakak.Wa khalaas,gammeet ma'aahum wa l-akhwaan al-sitte dool macho ma'aayi.Wa wakit dakhalna fi beet al-raajil da,
hu ooraana be kikkeef hu chaaf waahid min al-malaa'ika waagif fi beetah.Wa l-malak gaal leyah-:--Rassil rujaal fi Yaafa achaan yinaadu Sim'aan al-binaaduuh Butrus yaji leek.
Wa hu bas yi'ooriik al-kalaam al-beyah tanjo,inta wa kulla naas beetak.--
Wa wakit ana gammeet achaan nikallim leehum,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus nazal fooghum misil nazal foogna fi l-awwal.
Wa fakkart fi l-kalaam al-Rabbina Isa gaalah leena.Hu gaal-:--Yahya khattas al-naas fi l-almi wa laakin Allah yikhattisku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.--
Wa Allah sawwa leehum nafs al-cheyy al-sawwaah leena wa nazzal fooghum nafs al-baraka al-nazzalaaha foogna wakit aniina aamanna be Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Wa ana yaatu le niwaggif al-cheyy al-Allah yidoor yisawwiih-?
Wa wakit al-naas al-yaharju Butrus sim'o al-kalaam da,sakato khalaas.Wa chakaro Allah wa gaalo-:-Be misil da,Allah fatah le l-naas al-ma Yahuud derib al-tooba al-yiwaddiihum le l-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa ba'ad moot Istifaan,al-mu'miniin chatto be sabab al-ta'ab al-chadiid al-ja fooghum.Wa waahidiin macho ba'iid lahaddi Lubnaan wa jaziirat Khubrus wa hillit Antaakiya.Wa ballakho al-bichaara le l-Yahuud laakin ma ballakhooha le l-naas al-aakhariin.
Wa laakin waahidiin minhum al-min Khubrus wa l-Khayrawaan macho fi Antaakiya wa ballakho bichaarat al-Rabb Isa le l-Yuunaaniyiin kula.
Wa gudrat Allah ma'aahum wa naas katiiriin aamano be l-Rabb Isa wa chaalo derbah.
Wa ummat al-Masiih al-gaa'ide fi Madiinat al-Khudus sim'at al-khabar da wa rassalo Barnaaba fi Antaakiya.
Wa Barnaaba wisil fi Antaakiya wa chaaf al-baraka al-Allah antaahum.Wa hu farhaan minhum wa chajja'aahum kulluhum achaan yagoodu saabtiin fi l-Rabb be niiye waahide.
Wa Barnaaba raajil adiil wa malaan be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa iimaanah chadiid.Wa naas katiiriin aamano be l-Rabb Isa wa lammo ma'a l-mu'miniin.
Wa Barnaaba gamma macha fi hillit Tarsuus achaan yifattich Chaawuul.
Wa ligiih wa gabbal beyah fi Antaakiya.Wa muddit sana kaamile,Barnaaba wa Chaawuul gaa'idiin yilimmu ma'a jamaa'at al-mu'miniin wa yi'allumu naas katiiriin.Wa awwal marra fi Antaakiya bas al-naas khatto le talaamiiz Isa,usum al-Masiihiyiin.
Wa fi l-wakit da,anbiya waahidiin jo fi Antaakiya min Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa waahid minhum usmah Akhaabuus gamma kallamaahum be kalaam jaayi min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa gaal juu' chadiid yanzil fi kulla l-buldaan.Wa sahiih,al-juu' da bigi wakit Kuluudi sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.
Wa l-talaamiiz al-fi Antaakiya chaalo niiye achaan ayyi naadum yanti musaa'ada ale hasab gudurtah wa yirassuluuha le l-akhwaan al-gaa'idiin fi daar al-Yahuudiiya.
Wa lammo kulla l-musaa'ada wa antooha amaana le Barnaaba wa Chaawuul achaan yiwadduuha le kubaaraat al-mu'miniin al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa fi l-wakit da,al-malik Hiruudusgamma yita''ib naas waahidiin min jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.
Wa be iznah,katalo be l-seef Yaakhuub akhu Yuuhanna.
Wa wakit hu chaaf al-Yahuud firho min al-cheyy al-sawwaah da,hu chaal niiye achaan yakrub Butrus kula.Wa karabah fi usbuu' hana iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara.
Wa karab Butrus wa dassaah fi l-sijin.Wa kallaf beyah 16 askar wa fi ayyi wakit,4 askar gaa'idiin ma'aayah le yaharsuuh.Wa l-malik dawwar yamrug Butrus wa yigaddimah le l-cha'ab ba'ad iid al-Fisha.
Butrus gaa'id fi l-sijin wa laakin jamaa'at al-mu'miniin gaa'idiin yas'alo Allah be chidde fi chaanah.
Wa fi l-leele al-gubbaal Hiruudus ma yamrug Butrus giddaam al-naas,Butrus marbuut be janaaziir itneen wa naayim been askar itneen.Wa askar aakhariin yaharsu baab al-sijin.
Wa faj'atan,waahid min malaa'ikat Allah baan wa nuur chadiid sadda al-suluulu al-Butrus gaa'id foogah.Wa l-malak darabah le Butrus fi naaytah wa gawwamah min al-noom wa gaal-:-Yalla,gumm ajala-! Wa l-janaaziir waga'o min iideenah.
Wa l-malak kallam leyah wa gaal-:-Arbut sulbak.Albas na'aalak. Wa Butrus taaba' kalaamah.Wa l-malak gaal leyah-:-Albas khalagak wa ta'aal taabi'ni.
Wa Butrus marag yitaabi' al-malak.Wa fi fikrah,hu gaa'id yahlam bas wa ma irif al-cheyy al-gaa'id yisawwiih al-malak da,sahiih.
Wa faato be derib al-askar al-awwal wa faato be derib al-askar al-taani wa jo fi baab al-hadiid fi khachum al-sijin al-yamrug fi l-hille.Wa l-baab anfakka wiheedah wa marago min al-sijin.Wa kammalo chaari' waahid wa ba'ad da,al-malak khallaah.
Wa khalaas Butrus fakkar wa gaal-:-Hassa' fihimt.Sahiih,Allah rassal malakah achaan yinajjiini min iideen Hiruudus wa min kulla cheyy al-Yahuud dawwaro yisawwu foogi.
Wakit fihim al-cheyy al-bigi,hu macha fi beet Mariyam amm Yuuhanna al-binaaduuh Markhus.Wa mu'miniin katiiriin laammiin fi beetha achaan yisallu.
Wa lihig al-beet wa dagga fi l-baab al-barraani.Wa khaddaama usumha Rawda jaat ti'akkid yaatu fi l-baab.
Wa wakit irfat hiss Butrus,firhat bilheen.Laakin ma fakkat al-baab wa gabbalat farhaane wa jarat achaan tuguul le l-naas al-laammiin kadar Butrus gaa'id barra fi l-baab.
Wa raddo leeha wa gaalo-:-Raaski laffa walla-? Wa laakin hi akkadat leehum kalaamha.Wa gaalo leeha-:-Akuun da malak hana Butrus bas.
Wa laakin Butrus gaa'id yudugg fi l-baab lahaddi jo fakkooh leyah.Wa wakit chaafooh,al'ajjabo marra waahid.
Wa Butrus sawwa leehum ichaara be iidah achaan yaskutu.Wa ooraahum be kikkeef Allah maragah min al-sijin wa gaal-:-Amchu khabburu Yaakhuubwa l-akhwaan be l-cheyy al-bigi. Wa khalaas,Butrus marag min al-beet wa macha bakaan aakhar.
Wa be fajur,al-hurraas barjalo marra waahid.Wa assaa'alo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Chunu bigi le Butrus-?
Wa wakit Hiruudus rassal askarah achaan yijiibu Butrus,ma ligooh.Wa naada al-hurraas wa sa'alaahum su'aal katiir wa amar askarah achaan yaktuluuhum.Ba'ad da,Hiruudus gamma min daar al-Yahuudiiya wa macha fi hillit Geesariiya wa sakan hinaak.
Hiruudus za'laan min naas al-hillaal Suur wa Seeda.Wa naas al-hillaal dool lammo wa astafago ambeenaathum achaan yissaamaho ma'aayah be musaa'adat Balaastus.Wa Balaastus da,hu mas'uul gasir al-malik Hiruudus.Wa humman dawwaro yissaamaho ma'a Hiruudus achaan akil baladhum jaayi min mamlakatah.
Wa fi l-yoom al-muhaddad,Hiruudus libis lubaas hana malik wa ga'ad fi l-kursi wa harajaahum giddaam kulla l-naas.
Wa kulla l-naas gammo aato wa gaalo-:-Da ma hiss naadum-!Da hiss Allah-!
Wa tawwaali,waahid min malaa'ikat Allah darab Hiruudus achaan hu ma aba chakkiriin al-naas wa ma majjad Allah.Wa duud al-batun akal musraan Hiruudus wa khalaas,hu maat.
Wa adad al-naas al-sim'o kalaam Allah zaad wa naas katiiriin aamano.
Wa fi Madiinat al-Khudus Barnaaba wa Chaawuul kammalo al-khidme al-kallafoohum beeha al-mu'miniin.Wa humman gabbalo fi Antaakiya wa waddo ma'aahum Yuuhanna al-binaaduuh Markhus.
Wa fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Antaakiya,fi anbiya wa mu'allimiin.Wa humman Barnaaba wa Sim'aan al-binaaduuh Azrag wa Luukiyus al-min hillit al-Khayrawaan wa Manaayin al-rabbooh ma'a Hiruudus muhaafiz daar al-Jaliil wa Chaawuul.
Wa yoom waahid,humman gaa'idiin ya'abudu al-Rabb wa yusuumu,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus kallam leehum wa gaal-:-Khassusu leyi Barnaaba wa Chaawuul achaan yisawwu leyi al-khidme al-naadeethum leeha.
Wa khalaas ba'ad saamo wa sallo,khatto iideehum fooghum wa rassaloohum.
Be misil da,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus rassal Barnaaba wa Chaawuul.Wa khalaas,humman macho le hillit Saluukiya fi khachum al-bahar wa rikbo fi safiina wa macho le jaziirat Khubrus.
Wa wakit lihgo Khubrus,nazalo fi hillit Salaamis wa bado yiballukhu kalaam Allah fi buyuut al-sala hana l-Yahuud.Wa Yuuhanna Markhus macha ma'aahum achaan yi'aawinhum.
Wa chaggo al-jaziira kullaha lahaddi wislo fi hillit Baafuus.Wa hinaak ligo sahhaari Yahuudi al-sawwa nafsah nabi wa usmah Baar Yachuu'.
Wa hu rafiig Sarjiyus Buulus haakim hana Khubrus.Wa l-haakim hu naadum faahim wa naada Barnaaba wa Chaawuul achaan yidoor yasma' minhum kalaam Allah.
Wa l-sahhaari da usmah Aliim be kalaam yuunaani.Wa hu khaalaf Barnaaba wa Chaawuul wa ma dawwar al-haakim yi'aamin.
Wa Chaawuul al-kula ma'ruuf be Buulus anmala be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa chaaf al-sahhaari fi eenah wa gaal-:
Ya naadum al-galbak malaan be l-khachch wa l-fasaala-!Ya wileed Ibliis-!Kulla cheyy saalih,inta adu leyah.Inta daayman tidoor titallif al-duruub al-adiiliin hana Allah.
Hassa' Allah yadurbak wa tabga amyaan wa ma tichiif al-nuur ayyaam. Wa tawwaali,uyuunah ma chaafo cheyy illa l-dalaam.Wa gamma dawwar naadum yuguudah min iideenah.
Wa wakit al-haakim chaaf al-cheyy al-bigi da,khalaas aaman wa al'ajjab bilheen min kalaam al-Rabb Isa.
Wa Buulus wa l-naas al-ma'aayah rikbo fi safiina min hillit Baafuus wa chaggo al-bahar wa wislo fi hillit Barga fi balad Bamfiiliya.Wa hinaak Yuuhanna Markhus khalla Buulus wa Barnaaba wa gabbal fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Laakin humman khataro min Barga wa macho le hillit Antaakiya Bisiidiya.Wa yoom al-sabt,dakhalo fi beet al-sala wa ga'ado tihit.
Wa ba'ad garo min al-Tawraat wa min kitaab al-anbiya,masaa'iil hana beet al-sala rassalo leehum wa gaalo-:-Ya l-akhwaan,kan induku kalaam al-tichajju'u beyah al-naas,khalaas hajjuuh.
Wa Buulus gamma foog wa sawwa ichaara be iidah wa gaal-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil wa kulla l-naas al-khaayfiin min Allah,asma'o kalaami-!
Allah Ilaah Bani Israa'iil azal juduudna wa kattar al-cha'ab wakit humman saakniin ajaanib fi balad Masir.Wa maragaahum minha be gudurtah al-aziime.
Wa Allah ayyachaahum fi l-sahara gariib 40 sana.
Wa ba'ad da,dammar al-umam al-sab'a al-awwal gaa'idiin fi balad Kan'aan.Wa anta baladhum le Bani Israa'iil achaan tabga warasathum.
Wa da le muddit 450 sana.-Wa ba'ad da,antaahum gudiya achaan yuguuduuhum wa l-gaadi al-akhiir hu al-nabi Samuwiil.
Wa Bani Israa'iil sa'alo Samuwiil achaan yukhutt leehum malik wa Allah azal Chaawuul wileed Khiich min gabiilat Banyaamiin wa bigi leehum malik muddit 40 sana.
Wa ba'ad da,Allah maragah wa khatta leehum Dawuud malik fi badalah.Wa Allah chahad le Dawuud wa gaal-:﴾‍Ana chift Dawuud wileed Yassa al-ana radyaan beyah.Hu yisawwi kulla cheyy al-nidoorah.‍﴿
Wa khalaas,min zurriiyit Dawuud,Allah rassal Isa le Bani Israa'iil achaan yinajjiihum.Wa misil da,Allah tamma al-wa'ad al-antaah le Dawuud.
Wa gubbaal Isa ma yaji,Yahya ja wa naada kulla Bani Israa'iil achaan yutuubu min zunuubhum wa hu yikhattishum fi l-almi.
Wa wakit khidmit Yahya gariib tikammil,hu hajja le l-naas wa gaal-:--Tuguulu ana yaatu-?Ana ma al-naadum al-jaayi laakin hu yaji waraayi wa ana ma tammeet leyah khaddaam kula.-
Wa Buulus gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,ya iyaal jiddina Ibraahiim wa kulla l-naas al-laammiin ma'aana wa khaayfiin min Allah,hu rassal khabar al-naja di leena kullina.
Sukkaan Madiinat al-Khudus wa kubaaraathum ma irfo kadar Isa bas al-Masiih al-yinajjiihum.Humman ma fihmo kalaam al-anbiya al-gaa'idiin yagruuh kulla yoom al-sabt wa khalaas hakamo leyah be l-moot.Wa be da,sawwo al-cheyy al-maktuub leyah fi l-Kitaab.
Ma ligo foogah ayyi cheyy fasil al-be sababah waajib leyah al-moot,laakin sa'alo Bilaatus al-waali achaan yaktulah.
Wa wakit sawwo kulla cheyy al-maktuub leyah fi l-Kitaab khalaas,nazzalooh min al-hatab wa dafanooh fi khabur.
Wa laakin Allah ba'asah min ust al-maytiin.
Wa muddit ayyaam katiiriin,Isa gaa'id yibiin le l-naas al-raakho ma'aayah min daar al-Jaliil le Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa hassa' humman gaa'idiin yachhado leyah giddaam al-naas.
Wa hassa' aniina niballukhu leeku al-bichaara.Al-cheyy al-Allah waa'ad beyah juduudna,
hassa' hu sawwaah leena aniina iyaalhum.Allah ba'as Isa min ust al-maytiin misil al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Zabuur fi l-fasul al-taani.Maktuub-:﴾‍Inta ibni wa l-yoom,ana bigiit abuuk.‍﴿
Wa akiid Allah ba'as Isa min ust al-maytiin achaan jildah abadan ma yabga turaab wa Allah awwal hajja beyah fi l-kalaam al-buguul-:﴾‍Nantiiku al-baraka al-mukhaddasa wa l-mu'akkada al-waa'adt beeha Dawuud.‍﴿
Wa fi fasul aakhar hana l-Zabuur,buguul-:﴾‍Inta ma tikhalli janaazit abdak al-Khudduus tabga turaab.‍﴿
Wa Dawuud sawwa kulla cheyy al-Allah dawwarah fi waktah wa ba'ad da,hu maat wa lihig juduudah wa janaaztah bigat turaab.
Wa laakin janaazit al-naadum al-Allah gawwamah,abadan ma bigat turaab.
Wa achaan da,ya l-akhwaan,khalli ta'arfu kadar Allah rassalaana le niballukhu leeku be khufraan al-zunuub.Tawraat Muusa ma gidir harraraaku min zunuubku,
wa laakin kulla l-naas al-yi'aamunu be Isa,Allah yiharrirhum min zunuubhum.
Angar'u achaan al-kalaam al-gaa'id fi kitaab al-anbiya ma yabga foogku.
Al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Ya l-chammaatiin,chiifu.Al'ajjabo wa ahlako marra waahid.Achaan fi wakitku da,ana nisawwi cheyywa kan hajjooku beyah,ma tisadduguuh.‍﴿
Wa wakit al-naas maargiin min beet al-sala,talabo be chidde min Buulus wa Barnaaba achaan yigabbulu yoom al-sabt al-jaayi wa yihajju leehum battaan be l-kalaam da.
Wa ba'ad al-malamma,naas katiiriin taaba'o Buulus wa Barnaaba.Wa l-naas dool min al-Yahuud wa min al-naas al-dakhalo fi diin al-Yahuud.Wa Buulus wa Barnaaba kallamoohum kalaam katiir wa chajja'oohum achaan yagoodu saabtiin fi l-bichaara hana rahmat Allah.
Wa yoom al-sabt al-taani,gariib kulla sukkaan al-hille lammo ma'aahum achaan yasma'o kalaam al-Rabb.
Wa l-Yahuud chaafo naas katiiriin jaayiin wa hasado Buulus wa Barnaaba.Wa achaan da,gammo khaalafo kalaam Buulus wa ayyarooh.
Wa Buulus wa Barnaaba hajjo le l-Yahuud bala khoof wa gaalo-:-Waajib niballukhu leeku intu kalaam Allah gubbaal ma niballukhuuh le l-naas al-aakhariin.Laakin intu abeetuuh ma dawwartuuh.Wa intu ja'altu al-haya al-abadiiye ma waajbe leeku.Wa khalaas nikhalluuku wa niballukhuuh le l-naas al-ma Yahuud.
Achaan Rabbina amaraana wa gaal-:﴾‍Ana ja'altak nuur le l-umam achaan najaati talhag lahaddi taraf al-ard.‍﴿
Wa l-naas al-ma Yahuud sim'o al-kalaam da wa firho farha chadiide wa majjado al-Rabb achaan al-bichaara.Wa kulla l-naas al-Allah azalaahum achaan yadkhulu fi l-haya al-abadiiye,aamano.
Be misil da,kulla l-naas al-fi l-balad di sim'o kalaam al-Rabb.
Wa laakin al-Yahuud harracho kubaaraat al-hille wa l-awiin al-aabidaat Allah achaan yita''ubu Buulus wa Barnaaba.Wa taradoohum min al-balad.
Wa khalaas,Buulus wa Barnaaba marago min al-hille wa hatto al-ajaaj min rijleehum.Wa chaalo derib hillit Iguuniya.
Wa laakin al-talaamiiz al-ga'ado fi l-hille,malaaniin be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa farhaaniin farha chadiide.
Wa nafs al-cheyy bigi fi Iguuniya.Buulus wa Barnaaba dakhalo fi beet al-sala hana l-Yahuud wa gammo yihajju be gudra lahaddi naas katiiriin aamano be Isa min al-Yahuud wa min al-Yuunaaniyiin.
Wa laakin al-Yahuud al-abo ma yi'aamunu harracho al-naas al-ma Yahuud wa khayyaro fikirhum achaan yaz'alo min al-mu'miniin.
Wa Buulus wa Barnaaba ma khaafo minhum wa tawwalo hinaak wa kallamo be l-Rabb Isa le naas al-hille be kalaam waadih.Wa l-Rabb antaahum alaamaat wa ajaayib achaan yisabbit bichaarat rahmatah giddaam al-naas.
Wa naas al-hille alfaarago,al-waahidiin lammo ma'a l-Yahuud wa l-waahidiin ma'a l-rusul.
Wa l-Yahuud astafago ma'a l-naas al-ma Yahuud wa kubaaraathum,wa kulluhum chaalo niiye achaan yi'azzubu al-rusul wa yarjumuuhum.
Wa wakit Buulus wa Barnaaba sim'o al-khabar da,jaro fi balad Likooniya fi hillaal Listara wa Darba wa hawaaleehum.
Wa hinaak kula,gammo ballakho le l-naas be l-bichaara.
Wa fi hillit Listara fi naadum ma'duur.Hu mukarsah min wildooh wa yoom waahid kula,ma raakh.
Wa hu gaa'id yasma' kalaam Buulus adiil wa Buulus chaafah wa irif al-ma'duur indah iimaan achaan yalga al-aafe.
Wa Buulus naadaah be hiss chadiid wa gaal-:-Gumm foog be rijileenak. Wa l-raajil natta foog wa gamma yuruukh.
Wa l-naas al-laammiin chaafo al-cheyy al-Buulus sawwaah wa aato be lukhkhithum al-likooniiye wa gaalo-:-Al-ilaahaat chaalo suurat al-naas wa nazalo fi usutna-!
Wa gaalo Barnaaba hu Ziyuus malik al-ilaahaat wa Buulus hu Harmiis khachum al-kalaam hana l-ilaahaat achaan hu bas al-gaa'id yikallim.
Wa raajil al-diin hana l-sanam Ziyuus jaab tiiraan wa nuwwaar muladdamiin fi khachum baab beet al-sanam hana Ziyuus.Wa beet al-sanam da gaa'id fi dakhuul al-hille.Hu wa kulla l-naas dawwaro yigaddumu dahiiye le l-rusul.
Wa wakit al-rusul Barnaaba wa Buulus sim'o be l-kalaam da,humman zi'ilo za'al chadiid wa charrato khulgaanhum wa jaro fi ust al-naas.
Wa gaalo-:-Ya l-naas,maalku tisawwu cheyy misil da-?Aniina naas misilku bas-!Wa jiina niballukhu leeku al-bichaara achaan tikhallu al-kalaam al-baatil da wa titaabu'u kalaam Allah al-Hayy.Hu bas khalag al-samaawaat wa l-ard wa l-buhuur wa kulla cheyy al-fiihum.
Fi l-zaman al-faat,Allah khalla kulla l-gabaayil yi'iichu misil humman yidooru.
Wa laakin fi l-wakit da kula,Allah anta chahaada achaan ya'arfuuh hu mawjuud.Hu sawwa leeku al-kheer wa razakhaaku be almi min al-sama wa khalla fi l-khariif wa chabba'aaku be akil wa antaaku farah fi guluubku.
Wa be kalaamhum da kula,ma gidro yadharo al-naas yisawwu leehum dahiiye.
Wa ba'ad da,Yahuud waahidiin jo min Antaakiya wa Iguuniya wa harracho al-naas.Wa rajamo Buulus achaan yaktuluuh.Wa khalaas,karrooh wa zagalooh barra min al-hille.Wa fi fikirhum,hu maat khalaas.
Wa laakin wakit al-talaamiiz jo wa hawwagooh,hu gamma wa gabbal ma'aahum fi l-hille.Wa ambaakir,Buulus macha ma'a Barnaaba le hillit Darba.
Wa ballakho al-bichaara le naas al-hille wa katiiriin minhum bigo talaamiizhum.Wa ba'ad da,gabbalo fi Listara wa min Listara macho fi Iguuniya wa gabbalo battaan fi Antaakiya Bisiidiya.
Wa fi kulla l-hillaal dool,chajja'o al-talaamiiz wa wassoohum achaan yagoodu saabtiin fi l-iimaan.Wa gaalo leehum-:-Akiid,ta'ab katiir yaji foogna kullina fi l-derib al-yiwaddiina fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan,azalo naas min jamaa'at al-mu'miniin achaan yabgo leehum kubaaraat.Wa saamo wa sa'alo Allah leehum wa ammanoohum le l-Rabb Isa al-humman kulluhum aamano beyah.Wa khalaas macho.
Wa ba'ad chaggo balad Bisiidiya,jo fi balad Bamfiiliya.
Wa ballakho al-bichaara le naas hillit Barga wa macho giddaam le hillit Attaaliiya.
Wa hinaak rikbo fi safiina wa chaggo al-bahar achaan yigabbulu fi hillit Antaakiya fi Suuriya.Wa fi l-hille di,awwal sa'alo leehum Allah achaan yahfadhum be rahmatah wakit humman maachiin yisawwu al-khidme al-hassa' kammalooha.
Wa wakit wislo khalaas,naado kulla jamaa'at al-mu'miniin yilimmu.Wa ooroohum be kulla cheyy al-Allah sawwaah beehum wa kikkeef Allah fatah derib al-iimaan le l-naas al-ma Yahuud.
Wa ga'ado wakit tawiil ma'a l-talaamiiz.
Fiyah naas waahidiin min daar al-Yahuudiiya jo fi hillit Antaakiya wa gammo yi'allumu al-akhwaan.Wa humman gaalo-:-Kan ma tahharooku hasab churuut Tawraat Muusa,abadan ma tanjo.
Wa Buulus wa Barnaaba khaalafoohum be chidde.Wa achaan da,chaalo niiye le yirassulu Buulus wa Barnaaba wa akhwaan waahidiin yamchu fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa yichchaawaro fi l-kalaam da ma'a l-rusul wa ma'a l-kubaaraat.
Wa khalaas,jamaa'at al-mu'miniin rassaloohum wa humman macho.Wa chaalo al-derib al-chagga Lubnaan wa daar al-Saamira.Wa fi ayyi bakaan al-dallo foogah,ooro al-mu'miniin kikkeef al-naas al-ma Yahuud aamano wa taabo le Allah.Wa kulla l-akhwaan firho be l-khabar da.
Wa wakit wislo fi Madiinat al-Khudus,kulla jamaa'at al-mu'miniin wa l-rusul wa l-kubaaraat laagoohum adiil.Wa l-akhwaan ooroohum be kulla cheyy al-Allah sawwaah beehum.
Wa laakin mu'miniin waahidiin al-gaa'idiin yitaabu'u tariigat al-Fariiziiya gammo fi l-malamma wa gaalo-:-Al-mu'miniin al-ma Yahuud dool,waajib yitahhuruuhum wa yaamuruuhum yitabbugu churuut Tawraat Muusa.
Wa l-rusul wa l-kubaaraat lammo wiheedhum achaan yichchaawaro fi l-kalaam da.
Wa wakit al-munaakhacha bigat tawiile,Butrus gamma kallam leehum wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,intu ta'arfu min mudda tawiile Allah azalaani min usutku wa rassalaani le l-naas al-ma Yahuud achaan humman yasma'o al-bichaara min khachmi wa yi'aamunu beeha.
Wa Allah al-ya'arif galib ayyi naadum,nazzal fooghum al-Ruuh al-Khudduus misil awwal nazzalah foogna.Wa be da,hu wassaf hu khibilaahum.
Allah sawwa leehum humman wa leena aniina nafs al-cheyy.Wa be sabab iimaanhum,hu tahhar guluubhum.
Wa be da,maala hassa' tikhaalufu Allah-?Maalku tidooru tukhuttu fi l-talaamiiz dool tagala misil daami faayit gudrat juduudna wa gudritna aniina kula-?
La,da ma yanfa'-!Aniina ni'aamunu kadar nanjo be ni'mat Rabbina Isa misilhum humman.
Wa khalaas,kulla l-naas al-laammiin sakato wa bado yasma'o kalaam Barnaaba wa Buulus.Wa humman ooroohum be l-alaamaat wa l-ajaayib al-Allah sawwaahum be waasitathum fi ust al-naas al-ma Yahuud.
Wa wakit kammalo kalaamhum,Yaakhuub gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,asma'o kalaami.
Sim'aan ooraaku be kikkeef Allah awwal wassaf kheerah le l-naas al-ma Yahuud wa bada ya'azil minhum achaan yabgo leyah cha'abah.
Wa l-kalaam da yiwaafig ma'a kalaam Allah al-maktuub fi kitaab al-anbiya al-buguul-:
﴾‍Ba'ad da,nigabbilwa nabni battaan beet Dawuud al-mukassar.Wa ni'addil daraadirah al-muhaddamiinwa nabniih min jadiid.
Wa kulla l-naas yifattuchuuni,aywa,kulla l-umam al-naadeethum be usmile yabgo hineeyi.Wa be da,al-umam al-naadeethumyabgo cha'abi.Wa da kalaam Allahwa hu yihaggig kalaamah
al-ma'ruuf min zamaan.‍﴿
Wa achaan da,fi raayi ana,ma waajib nisawwu cheyy gaasi le l-naas al-ma Yahuud al-yutuubu le Allah.
Laakin khalli naktubu leehum jawaab wa nuguulu leehum waajib yikhallu minhum kulla cheyy nijis be sabab ibaadat al-asnaam wa ma waajib yazno wa ma yaakulu laham al-fatiis wa ma yaakulu damm.
Achaan min zamaan,fi naas gaa'idiin yiballukhu kalaam Muusa fi kulla hille wa yagru al-Tawraat fi buyuut al-sala kulla yoom al-sabt.
Wa khalaas al-rusul wa l-kubaaraat wa jamaa'at al-mu'miniin kulluhum astafago wa azalo rujaal itneen min al-akhwaan achaan yirassuluuhum fi Antaakiya ma'a Buulus wa Barnaaba.Wa azalo Yahuuza al-binaaduuh Baar Saaba wa azalo ma'aayah Siila.Humman rujaal al-kulla l-akhwaan bikarrumuuhum.
Wa ammanoohum al-jawaab.Wa l-jawaab buguul-:Maktuub min akhwaanku al-rusul wa l-kubaaraat leeku intu al-akhwaan al-ma Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Antaakiya wa fi Suuriya wa Kilikiiya.Al-salaam aleekum.
Simi'na naas waahidiin macho leeku minnina bala izinna wa sawwo muchkila ambeenaatku wa barjalooku be kalaamhum.
Wa achaan da,aniina lammeena kullina sawa wa astafagna wa azalna rujaal itneen wa rassalnaahum leeku ma'a akhwaanna al-nihibbuuhum Buulus wa Barnaaba.
Al-rujaal dool dasso nufuushum fi l-khutuura fi chaan Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Wa rassalna leeku Yahuuza wa Siila achaan yihajju leeku wa yuguulu nafs al-kalaam al-katabnaah leeku.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa aniina zaatna fakkarna ma waajib nukhuttu foogku tagala ziyaada min al-churuut al-waajbiin dool.
Ma taakulu laham al-gaddamooh dahiiye le l-asnaam wa ma taakulu damm wa la laham al-fatiis wa ma tazno.Kan tikhallu minku al-achya dool,da sawweetu cheyy adiil.Wa ma'aaku al-salaam.
Wa khalaas,rassalo al-rujaal dool wa humman macho wislo fi Antaakiya.Wa naado kulla l-mu'miniin achaan yilimmu.Wa gaddamo leehum al-jawaab.
Wa l-mu'miniin garooh wa firho farha chadiide achaan al-kalaam da chajja'aahum.
Yahuuza wa Siila anbiya wa kallamo le l-akhwaan kalaam katiir achaan yichajju'uuhum wa yigawwuuhum fi iimaanhum.
Wa humman ga'ado ma'aahum mudda tawiile.Wa ba'ad da,al-akhwaan fi Antaakiya khalloohum yigabbulu be l-salaam le l-naas al-rassaloohum.
Wa laakin Siila dawwar yagood fi Antaakiya wa Yahuuza gabbal wiheedah.
Wa Buulus wa Barnaaba kula ga'ado fi Antaakiya.Humman gaa'idiin yiballukhu al-bichaara ma'a naas katiiriin aakhariin wa humman gaa'idiin yi'allumu le l-naas kalaam al-Rabb.
Wa ba'adeen,Buulus kallam le Barnaaba wa gaal-:-Khalli nigabbulu fi l-hillaal al-ballakhna fooghum bichaarat al-Rabb.Khalli nisallumu al-akhwaan wa nichiifu haalhum.
Wa Barnaaba dawwar Yuuhanna al-binaaduuh Markhus kula yamchi ma'aahum.
Laakin Buulus ma dawwar Markhus yamchi ma'aahum achaan fi l-makhatar al-awwal hu khallaahum fi Bamfiiliya wa ma khadam ma'aahum.
Wa alkhaalafo ambeenaathum be kalaam chadiid lahaddi alfaarago ma khadamo sawa.Wa Barnaaba gamma ma'a Markhus.Wa hu rikib fi safiina wa macha fi Khubrus.
Wa Buulus azal Siila achaan yamchi ma'aayah.Wa l-akhwaan ammanooh le rahmat al-Rabb Isa wa khalaas Buulus macha.
Wa Buulus raakh fi buldaan Suuriya wa Kilikiiya wa gawwa iimaan hana jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin.
Wa Buulus macha giddaam le hillit Darba.Wa ba'adeen ja fi hillit Listara.Wa fi Listara,tilmiiz waahid gaa'id usmah Timuutaawus.Ammah Yahuudiiya mu'mine be l-Masiih wa abuuh Yuunaani.
Wa kulla l-akhwaan fi Listara wa Iguuniya yachhado kadar hu naadum adiil.
Wa Buulus dawwar Timuutaawus yaji yakhdim ma'aayah.Kulla l-Yahuud fi l-bakaan da irfo kadar abu Timuutaawus Yuunaani wa achaan da,Buulus gamma tahharah hasab aadaat al-Yahuud.
Wa Buulus wa l-akhwaan al-ma'aayah gammo raakho min hille le hille wa ooro al-mu'miniin be kharaar hana l-rusul wa l-kubaaraat al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa wassoohum achaan yitaabu'u kalaamhum.
Wa be misil da,kulla jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin bigo gawiyiin fi l-iimaan wa kulla yoom adad naashum gaa'id yiziid.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus ma antaahum izin yiballukhu al-bichaara fi balad Aasiya.Wa khataro fi Firigiiya wa Khalaatiya.
Wa wakit lihgo huduud hana balad Misiiya,chaalo derib hana balad Bisinya wa laakin Ruuh Isa daharaahum ma yadkhulu foogha.
Wa khalaas,chaalo derib hana hillit Turuwaas wa chaggo balad Misiiya.
Wa fi l-leele di,Buulus ri'i wa fi l-ru'ya,chaaf raajil min naas Magiduuniya.Wa l-raajil gaa'id yinaadi Buulus wa yuguul-:-Ta'aal hini fi Magiduuniya wa aawinna.
Wa ba'ad Buulus chaaf al-ru'ya di,aniinafihimna kadar Allah naadaana achaan niballukhu al-bichaara le l-naas al-fi balad Magiduuniya.Wa tawwaali,gammeena chilna al-derib.
Wa gammeena min Turuwaas wa gata'na al-bahar wa lihigna jaziirat Saamutraaki.Wa ambaakir,macheena giddaam wa nazalna fi hillit Niyaabulus.
Wa min hinaak,macheena fi madiinat Filibbi.Wa hi hille al-banooha al-Roomaaniyiin fi l-mantaga al-awwalaaniiye hana Magiduuniya.Wa ga'adna hinaak ayyaam.
Wa yoom al-sabt,maragna barra min al-hille wa macheena jamb al-waadi achaan hasabna da bas al-bakaan al-yisallu foogah al-Yahuud.Wa ga'adna tihit wa kallamna le l-awiin al-lamman.
Wa been al-awiin fi mara waahide taajriiye hana gumaach khaali wa hi min hillit Siyaatiira.Hi ma min banaat al-Yahuud wa laakin gaa'ide ta'abud Allah ma'aahum wa usumha Liidiya.Wakit gaa'ide tasma' kalaam Buulus,al-Rabb fatah galibha achaan tukhutt baalha le kalaamah wa ti'aamin.
Wa ba'ad khattasooha ma'a kulla naas beetha,hi sa'alatna be chidde achaan nabgo diifaanha.Wa gaalat-:-Kan sahiih intu hasabtuuni mu'mine be Rabbina,ta'aalu agoodu fi beeti. Wa talabat minnina ziyaada lahaddi macheena ga'adna fi beetha.
Wa yoom waahid,aniina maachiin fi bakaan al-sala wa khaadim waahide jaat leena.Hi mara jannaaniiye wa tichiif le l-naas.Wa siyaadha ligo min junuunha gurus katiir.
Wa gammat titaabi' Buulus wa aniina al-raaykhiin ma'aayah wa gaa'ide tihajji be hiss aali wa tuguul-:-Al-naas dool abiid Allah al-Aali wa jo achaan yiballukhu leeku kikkeef tanjo.
Wa yoom katiir hi gaa'ide titaabi'na lahaddi Buulus zi'il wa anlafat leeha wa kachcha le l-cheetaan al-gaa'id foogha wa gaal-:-Be usum Isa al-Masiih,naamurak.Amrug minha. Wa tawwaali,al-cheetaan marag minha.
Wa wakit siyaadha chaafo al-gurus al-yalgooh minha angata',karaboohum le Buulus wa Siila wa karroohum fi ust al-hille fi bakaan al-malamma,giddaam al-kubaaraat.
Wa gaddamoohum le l-hukkaam wa gaalo-:-Al-rujaal dool Yahuud.Humman yisawwu machaakil fi hillitna.
Humman gaa'idiin yi'allumu al-naas aadaat mamnuu'a leena aniina al-Roomaaniyiin.Waajib leena naaboohum wa ma nitaabu'uuhum.
Wa kulla naas al-hille zi'ilo wa kallamo didd Buulus wa Siila.Wa l-hukkaam charrato khulgaan Buulus wa Siila wa amaro al-askar achaan yudugguuhum be asa.
Wa daggoohum dagg chadiid wa dassoohum fi l-sijin.Wa amaro haras hana l-sijin achaan yahrishum adiil.
Wa fi chaan al-amur da,al-haras waddaahum fi l-bakaan al-daakhal fi lubb al-sijin wa gayyadaahum min rijleehum fi l-hatab al-tagiil.
Wa fi ust al-leel,Buulus wa Siila gaa'idiin yisallu wa yamdaho wa yachkuru Allah wa l-masaajiin gaa'idiin yasma'oohum.
Wa tawwaali,al-ard anhazzat chadiid wa asaas al-sijin rajaf wa kulla l-biibaan anfataho wa kulla guyuud al-masaajiin anhallo.
Wa l-haras gamma min al-noom wa chaaf kulla l-biibaan faathiin wa fi fikrah,al-masaajiin jaro khalaas wa salla seefah achaan yaktul nafsah.
Wa laakin Buulus naadaah be hiss aali wa gaal leyah-:-Ma tisawwi le nafsak cheyy fasil.Aniina kullina gaa'idiin.
Wa l-haras naada achaan yijiibu leyah deyy wa dakhal ajala fi l-sijin.Wa gaa'id yarjif min al-khoof wa macha waga' giddaam Buulus wa Siila.
Wa khalaas,maragaahum barra.Wa sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Ya saadaati,waajib nisawwi chunu achaan nanja-?
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo-:-Aamin be l-Rabb Isa wa tanja,inta wa naas beetak.
Wa gammo ballakho kalaam al-Rabb le l-haras wa le kulla naas beetah.
Wa fi l-wakit da bas,fi ust al-leel hu waddaahum fi bakaan indah almi wa khassal leehum awaawiirhum.Wa tawwaali,humman khattasooh ma'a kulla naas beetah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-haras wadda Buulus wa Siila fi beetah wa faddalaahum wa gaddam leehum akil.Wa hu wa kulla naas beetah firho bilheen achaan aamano be Allah.
Wa wakit al-wata asbahat,al-hukkaam rassalo askar waahidiin achaan yuguulu le l-haras yatlig Buulus wa Siila.
Wa l-haras oora Buulus be kalaamhum wa gaal-:-Al-hukkaam rassalo kalaam achaan natligku wa khalaas,amurgu hassa' wa amchu be l-salaam.
Laakin Buulus aba wa gaal-:-Daggoona giddaam al-naas bala charii'a wa dassoona fi l-sijin-!Wa aniina indina jinsiiya roomaaniye.Wa hassa' yidooru yatulguuna be achiir-?Abadan-!Khalli humman zaathum yaju hini wa yatulguuna-!
Wa l-askar gabbalo le l-hukkaam wa ooroohum be l-kalaam al-Buulus gaalah leehum.Wa l-hukkaam khaafo wakit irfo induhum jinsiiya roomaaniye.
Wa jo saamahoohum.Wa l-hukkaam maragoohum min al-sijin wa talabo minhum achaan yamurgu min al-hille.
Wa Buulus wa Siila marago min al-sijin wa macho beet Liidiya wa lammo ma'a l-akhwaan wa chajja'oohum.Wa ba'ad da,marago min al-hille.
Wa Buulus wa Siila faato giddaam wa chaggo hillit Amfibuulis wa hillit Abuluuniya wa wislo fi madiinat Tasaluuniiki.Wa fi l-hille di,al-Yahuud induhum beet al-sala.
Wa fi muddit talaata usbuu',Buulus gaa'id yadkhul fi beet al-sala kulla yoom al-sabt misil fi aadtah.Wa gaa'id yinaakhich ma'a l-Yahuud fi kalaam al-Kitaab.
Wa gaa'id yiwaddihah wa yisabbitah leehum kadar laabudda al-Masiih yat'ab wa yab'as min ust al-maytiin.Wa gaal leehum-:-Isa al-niballikh leeku beyah da,hu bas al-Masiih al-intu gaa'idiin tarjooh.
Wa waahidiin min al-naas sim'o al-kalaam da adiil wa aamano beyah wa lammo ma'a Buulus wa Siila.Wa katiiriin min al-naas al-aamano humman min al-Yuunaaniyiin al-ya'abudu Allah ma'a l-Yahuud.Wa beenhum awiin katiiraat muhimmaat fi l-hille.
Wa be da,al-Yahuud al-ma aamano,hasadoohum le Buulus wa Siila.Wa naado al-naas al-ma naaf'iin al-raaykhiin fi l-chawaari' wa lammoohum fi bakaan waahid.Wa gammo harrachoohum lahaddi barjaal kabiir bigi fi lubb al-hille.Wa hajamo beet Yaasuun achaan yidooru yamurgu Buulus wa Siila fi giddaam al-naas.
Wa wakit ma ligoohum,karabo Yaasuun wa waahidiin min al-akhwaan.Wa l-naas karroohum min al-beet wa waddoohum giddaam hukkaam al-hille.Wa aato be hiss aali wa gaalo-:-Al-naas dool gaa'idiin yisawwu machaakil fi ayyi bakaan wa hassa' jo hini fi hillitna kula-!
Wa Yaasuun da dayyafaahum.Humman ma yitaabu'u wasiiyat sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin wa yiballukhu le l-naas be malik aakhar usmah Isa-!
Wa wakit naas al-hille wa hukkaamhum sim'o al-kalaam da,barjalo bilheen.
Wa l-hukkaam talabo min Yaasuun wa min al-akhwaan al-ma'aayah yikaffu gurus le damaanithum wa khalaas talagoohum.
Wa wakit bigi fi leel,al-akhwaan rassalo Buulus wa Siila fi hillit Biriiya.Wa wakit wislo,macho fi beet al-sala hana l-Yahuud.
Wa l-Yahuud al-fi Biriiya kariimiin min al-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi Tasaluuniiki.Humman sim'o kalaam Allah be farha wa gammo yagru fi l-Kitaab kulla yoom achaan ya'arfu kan ta'liim hana Buulus sahiih walla ma sahiih.
Wa katiiriin minhum aamano be Isa.Wa been al-naas al-aamano fi Yuunaaniyiin kula.Wa beenhum fi awiin muhimmaat fi l-hille wa rujaal katiiriin.
Wa l-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi Tasaluuniiki sim'o Buulus gaa'id yiballikh kalaam Allah fi Biriiya.Wa macho wa bado yiharruchu naas al-hille achaan yaz'alo min Buulus.
Wa tawwaali,al-akhwaan chaalo Buulus min al-hille wa waddooh le khachum al-bahar.Wa Siila wa Timuutaawus ga'ado fi l-hille.
Wa l-akhwaan raafago Buulus lahaddi wislo fi madiinat Atiina wa khalaas gabbalo hillithum.Wa Buulus wakkalaahum achaan Siila wa Timuutaawus yaju leyah ajala.
Wa wakit Buulus gaa'id yarjaahum fi madiinat Atiina,hu chaaf asnaam fi ayyi bakaan.Wa da bigi leyah gaasi bilheen.
Wa bada yadkhul fi beet al-sala wa yinaakhich ma'a l-Yahuud wa l-Yuunaaniyiin al-ya'abudu Allah.Wa kulla yoom,hu gaa'id yinaakhich fi l-suug ma'a ayyi naadum al-yalgaah hinaak.
Wa ulama waahidiin hana l-falsafa min al-Abiguuriyiin wa min al-Riwaagiyiin gammo yinaakhuchu ma'a Buulus.Wa waahidiin gaalo-:-Chunu kalaam hana l-hajjaay al-jaahil da-?Ma'anaatah chunu-? Wa waahidiin gaalo-:-Akuun yikallim be ilaahaat hana buldaan aakhariin. Humman hajjo misil da achaan sim'o Buulus yibachchir be Isa wa bu'aasah.
Wa waddo Buulus fi majlas al-hille.Wa sa'alooh wa gaalo-:-Ooriina be l-kalaam al-jadiid al-jibtah da.
Simi'na minnak kalaam ajiib wa nidooru nafhamooh adiil.
Wa kulla naas Atiina wa l-ajaanib al-saakniin ma'aahum yiriidu bilheen yinaakhuchu fi ayyi raay jadiid.
Wa Buulus gamma fi ust al-majlas wa gaal-:-Ya naas Atiina.Ana na'arif kadar fi kulla cheyy intu naas al-tiriidu al-adyaan.
Wa wakit ana gaa'id nuruukh fi hillitku,chift madaabihku.Wa ligiit madbah waahid wa gareet al-kalaam al-maktuub foogah buguul-:--Le l-ilaah al-ma ma'ruuf.- Wa khalaas,ana ni'ooriiku be Allah,al-ilaah al-ta'abuduuh wa ma ta'arfuuh.
Allah khalag al-dunya wa kulla cheyy al-gaa'id foogha.Hu Rabb al-samaawaat wa l-ard.Wa Allah ma saakin fi buyuut hana l-ibaada al-yabnuuhum al-naas.
Hu ma hawjaan khidmit al-naas achaan cheyy ma mugassir leyah.Hu bas al-yanti al-haya wa l-nafas le kulla l-naas wa hu bas al-yantiihum kulla cheyy.
Wa min naadum waahid,hu khalag kulla l-gabaayil wa gassam leehum al-buldaan al-yaskunu fooghum fi kulla l-ard.Wa min al-awwal,hu haddad leehum muddit al-wakit al-gaa'idiin foogah wa haddad huduud diyaarhum.
Wa Allah sawwa misil da achaan al-naas yifattuchuuh wa akuun yalgooh.Laakin be l-akiid,hu ma ba'iid min ayyi waahid minnina
achaan beyah hu bas,ni'iichu wa nuruukhu wa nukuunu.Wa misil waahidiin min chu'araaku kula gaalo-:--Aniina zurriiytah.--
Wa kan aniina zurriiyit Allah,ma waajib nifakkuru kadar Allah bichaabih dahab wa la fudda wa la hajar.Wa la bichaabih ayyi sanam al-naas sana'ooh be gudrithum walla be afkaarhum.
Allah ma haasab al-naas fi zaman al-jahal wa laakin hassa' Allah yinaadi kulla l-naas fi ayyi bakaan achaan yutuubu min zunuubhum.
Wa Allah gata' leena yoom achaan yihaasib foogah kulla naas al-dunya be l-adaala.Wa Allah kallaf al-hisaab da le l-raajil al-hu azalah.Wa l-raajil da,Allah ba'asah min ust al-maytiin achaan kulla l-naas ya'arfu da bas al-raajil al-hu azalah.
Wa wakit sim'o be l-bu'aas,waahidiin minhum achchammato le Buulus laakin waahidiin gaalo-:-Nidooru inta tihajji leena battaan be l-kalaam da.
Wa be da,Buulus marag min malammithum.
Wa waahidiin minhum macho ma'a Buulus wa aamano.Wa beenhum fi raajil waahid usmah Diyuuniis.Hu naadum min majlas madiinat Atiina.Wa fi mara waahide usumha Damaariis.Wa naas aakhariin kula aamano.
Wa ba'ad da,Buulus marag min madiinat Atiina wa macha fi madiinat Kuruntus.
Wa hinaak ligi naadum Yahuudi usmah Akiila min balad Buntus.Wa hu dahaabah ja fi Kuruntus ma'a martah usumha Biriskiila.Jo min madiinat Rooma al-fi Itaaliya achaan al-sultaan Kuluudi anta amur wa gaal kulla l-Yahuud yamurgu min Rooma.Wa Buulus macha sallamaahum.
Wa hu ga'ad fi beethum wa bada yakhdim ma'aahum achaan Buulus kula usta fi nafs al-khidme misilhum.Khidmithum yisawwu al-khiyam.
Wa kulla yoom al-sabt,hu yamchi fi beet al-sala wa yinaakhich ma'a l-Yahuud wa l-Yuunaaniyiin achaan yijiibhum fi l-derib.
Wa wakit Siila wa Timuutaawus jo min balad Magiduuniya,Buulus khalla khidimtah wa gamma yiballikh al-bichaara kulla yoom.Wa yihajji le l-Yahuud wa yachhad kadar Isa bas al-Masiih.
Laakin al-Yahuud abo ma dawwaro chahaadtah wa bado yi'ayyuruuh.Wa Buulus hatta khalagah minhum wa gaal-:-Intu mas'uuliin min al-yaji foogku.Ana bari minku.Min al-yoom niballikh al-bichaara le l-naas al-ma Yahuud.
Wa khalaas,Buulus khalla beet al-sala wa bada yi'allim fi beet hana naadum usmah Tiitus Yustus.Hu ya'abud Allah laakin hu ma Yahuudi.Wa beetah gaa'id jamb beet al-sala hana l-Yahuud.
Wa mas'uul hana beet al-sala da,usmah Kiriisbus.Wa hu wa kulla naas beetah aamano be l-Rabb Isa.Wa naas katiiriin fi Kuruntus sim'o kalaam Buulus wa aamano be l-bichaara wa khattasoohum.
Wa yoom waahid be l-leel,al-Rabb Isa ja le Buulus fi ru'ya wa gaal leyah-:-Ma takhaaf.Kallim wa ma taskut.
Ana gaa'id ma'aak.Wa ma fi naadum yagdar yisawwi leek cheyy fasil achaan indi naas katiiriin fi l-hille di.
Wa Buulus ga'ad fi Kuruntus sana wa nuss wa gaa'id yi'allim kalaam Allah le l-naas.
Wa wakit Khaaliyuun bigi haakim fi balad Akhaaya,al-Yahuud astafago ambeenaathum achaan yikhaalufu Buulus.Wa gammo waddo Buulus fi l-mahkama.
Wa gaalo-:-Al-raajil da gaa'id yiharrich al-naas achaan ya'abudu Allah be ibaada al-tikhaalif al-gaanuun.
Wa Buulus gamma achaan yihajji wa laakin Khaaliyuun hajja le l-Yahuud wa gaal-:-Ya l-Yahuud,kan kalaamku fi l-naadum da tuhma hana jariime walla zulum,waajib nasbur wa nasma' kalaamku.
Laakin tihajju fi tafsiir hana kalimaat wa asaame bas wa fi kalaam hana charii'itku.Wa waajib intu tihillu al-muchkila di ambeenaatku.Fi l-kalaam al-misil da,ana ma nidoor nagta' charii'a.
Wa khalaas taradaahum min al-mahkama.
Wa kulla l-naas karabo Suustaan mas'uul beet al-sala wa gammo daggooh giddaam al-mahkama wa laakin Khaaliyuun gaa'id saakit,ma hajja cheyy.
Wa Buulus ga'ad fi Kuruntus mudda tawiile.Wa ba'ad da,hu sallam al-akhwaan achaan yidoor yisaafir.Dawwar yamchi fi Suuriya be safiina.Wa Biriskiila wa Akiila kula macho ma'aayah.Wa fi hillit Kankhiriiya gubbaal ma yarkab fi l-safiina,Buulus zayyan raasah achaan sawwa nazir giddaam Allah.
Wa wakit wislo fi madiinat Afasus,Buulus khalla Biriskiila wa Akiila.Wa macha dakhal fi beet al-sala hana l-Yahuud wa naakhach ma'aahum.
Wa l-Yahuud talabo minnah achaan yagood ma'aahum chiyya.Wa laakin hu aba
wa macha khallaahum wa gaal-:-In cha Allah,nigabbil leeku yoom aakhar.-Wa marag min Afasus wa rikib fi safiina wa saafar.
Wa nazal fi khachum al-bahar hana Geesariiya wa macha fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa sallam jamaa'at al-mu'miniin wa ba'ad da,macha fi hillit Antaakiya.
Wa ga'ad hinaak ayyaam.Wa ba'ad da,gamma faat fi buldaan Khalaatiya wa Firigiiya raayikh min hille le hille.Wa Buulus gaa'id yichajji' kulla l-talaamiiz achaan yagoodu saabtiin fi l-iimaan.
Wa fi l-wakit da,Yahuudi waahid usmah Abuluus ja fi madiinat Afasus.Hu min al-Iskandariiya wa ya'arif yi'allim adiil wa hu aalim chadiid fi l-Kitaab.
Wa gubbaal ma yaji fi Afasus,Abuluus allamooh derib al-Rabb Isa.Wa gamma kallam be chidde wa gaa'id yi'allim al-naas be kalaam sahiih be l-achya al-bukhussu Isa.Wa laakin hu irif khattisiin Yahya bas.
Wa gamma yikallim fi beet al-sala bala khoof.Wa wakit Biriskiila wa Akiila sim'o kalaamah,waddooh fi beethum wa fassaro leyah derib Allah be ziyaada.
Wa Abuluus dawwar yisaafir fi balad Akhaaya wa l-akhwaan chajja'ooh wa katabo jawaab le l-talaamiiz al-gaa'idiin hinaak achaan yakurbuuh adiil.Wa wakit hu wisil hinaak,hu gamma yi'allim al-naas.Wa be misil da,aawanaahum bilheen le l-naas al-aamano be l-Masiih be rahmat Allah.
Wa Abuluus gaa'id yikhaalif al-Yahuud giddaam naas al-hille be kalaam gawi.Wa fassar leehum min al-Kitaab wa akkad kadar Isa bas al-Masiih.
Wa wakit Abuluus gaa'id fi Kuruntus,Buulus kammal ruwaakhtah fi l-hillaal al-fi l-jibaal wa khalaas,wisil fi madiinat Afasus.Wa hinaak ligi talaamiiz waahidiin.
Wa Buulus sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus nazal foogku wakit aamantu walla-? Wa gaalo-:-La.Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus ma na'arfuuh wa ma simi'na beyah.
Wa Buulus sa'alaahum wa gaal-:-Wakit khattasooku,khattisiinku da kikkeef-? Wa gaalo-:-Khattasoona ale hasab ta'liim Yahya.
Wa Buulus gaal-:-Yahya khattas al-naas al-taabo min zunuubhum.Wa gaal le l-naas kadar waajib yi'aamunu be l-naadum al-jaayi waraayah.Wa l-naadum da,hu Isa.
Wa wakit sim'o kalaam Buulus da,khattasoohum be usum al-Rabb Isa.
Wa wakit Buulus khatta iideenah fooghum,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus nazal fooghum wa hajjo be lukhkhaat jadiide wa atnabba'o.
Wa adadhum 12 raajil.
Wa Buulus dakhal fi beet al-sala wa bada yihajji le l-naas bala khoof.Wa muddit talaata chahar,hu yinaakhich ma'aahum fi mamlakat Allah achaan yijiibhum fi l-derib.
Wa laakin waahidiin minhum raashum gawi ma dawwaro yi'aamunu.Wa gammo yi'ayyuru derib Isa al-Masiih giddaam al-naas.Wa be da,Buulus gamma anfarag minhum ma'a talaamiizah wa bada yinaakhich ma'aahum kulla yoom fi madrasa hana naadum usmah Tiiraanuus.
Wa Buulus gaa'id yiballikh al-bichaara di muddit santeen.Wa be misil da,kulla l-naas al-saakniin fi balad Aasiya,min al-Yahuud wa min al-Yuunaaniyiin,sim'o kalaam al-Rabb.
Wa Allah sawwa ajaayib kubaar be waasitat Buulus,
lahaddi al-naas gaa'idiin yichiilu minnah misil al-git'e aw khalagah hana l-khidme al-limso jildah wa yukhuttuuh fi l-mardaaniin.Wa l-marad yikhalliihum wa l-chawaatiin kula yamurgu minhum.
Fi l-balad di,fi Yahuud waahidiin raaykhiin hille le hille wa khidmithum yachfu al-muchootiniin.Wa waahidiin minhum yista'malo usum al-Rabb Isa le yaturdu beyah al-chawaatiin wa yuguulu-:-Naamurak be usum Isa,al-Buulus gaa'id yibachchir beyah.
Wa min al-naas al-sawwo misil da,sab'a rujaal,awlaad Yahuudi waahid usmah Sakaawa wa kabiir rujaal al-diin.
Wa l-cheetaan al-dawwaro yaturduuh radda leehum wa gaal-:-Isa na'arfah wa usum Buulus na'arfah wa laakin intu yaatumman-?
Wa l-muchootin hajamaahum wa hu chadiid minhum wa ajala annasar fooghum.Hu jarahaahum wa charrat khulgaanhum lahaddi jaro min al-beet aryaaniin.
Wa kulla l-naas al-saakniin fi madiinat Afasus min al-Yahuud wa min al-Yuunaaniyiin sim'o al-khabar da wa khoof chadiid dakhal leehum wa karramo usum al-Rabb Isa ziyaada.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,katiiriin min al-mu'miniin gammo a'tarafo be a'maalhum al-cheeniin al-sawwoohum be achiir.
Wa naas katiiriin minhum al-awwal sawwo al-sihir,lammo kutubhum wa tachchoohum giddaam naas al-hille.Wa hasabo taman al-kutub dool wa bigi misil 50-000 hajar fudda.
Wa be misil da,naas al-sim'o kalaam al-Rabb zaado wa gudrat kalaamah zaadat fi usuthum.
Wa ba'ad da,Buulus chaal niiye achaan yamchi fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa gubbaal ma yamchi hinaak,dawwar yamchi fi Magiduuniya wa Akhaaya wa gaal-:-Namchi fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa ba'ad da,waajib namchi fi madiinat Rooma kula.
Wa Buulus azal naaseen min al-akhwaan al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu ma'aayah wa rassalaahum fi Magiduuniya achaan yamchu giddaamah.Wa humman Timuutaawus wa Rastus.Wa Buulus zaatah ga'ad battaan mudda gisayre fi balad Aasiya.
Wa fi l-wakit da,barjaal kabiir gamma fi Afasus be sabab derib Isa al-Masiih.
Fiyah sayyaakhi waahid usmah Dimitri.Khidimtah yasna' min al-fudda buyuut dugaag bichaabuhu beet al-ibaada hana l-ilaaha Artaamiis achaan yibii'hum.Hu wa l-naas al-yisawwu nafs al-sinaa'a ligo min al-tijaara di faayde katiire.
Wa hu lamma kulla l-sinaa'iyiin wa khaddaamiinhum.Wa kallam leehum wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,ta'arfu maalna jaayi min al-khidme di.
Wa chiftu wa simi'tu kikkeef Buulus da khachcha naas katiiriin.Wa ma khachcha naas hana Afasus bas laakin gariib kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi balad Aasiya.Buulus gaal leehum kadar al-ilaahaat al-naas sana'oohum ma ilaahaat be l-sahiih.Wa jaab naas katiiriin fi derbah.
Wa l-kalaam da ma yitallif tijaaritna bas laakin yijiib eeb fi beet al-ibaada hana Artaamiis kula wa hi ilaahitna al-aziime-!Akuun al-naas yuguulu beetha ma yanfa'.Wa akuun usum Artaamiis al-aziim yiwaddir-!Wa di bas al-ilaaha al-kulla naas Aasiya wa kulla naas al-dunya ya'abuduuha.
Wa wakit sim'o al-kalaam da,zi'ilo za'al chadiid.Wa gammo aato wa gaalo-:-Artaamiis hana naas Afasus,hi ilaaha aziime.
Wa bigi barjaal fi kulla l-hille.Wa naas katiiriin bilheen lammo wa karabo Khaayus wa Aristaarkus rufgaan Buulus al-itneen.Humman min Magiduuniya wa macho ma'aayah fi safarah.Wa l-naas jaro beehum fi l-naga'a al-kabiire.
Wa Buulus dawwar yadkhul yihajji le l-naas al-lammo wa laakin al-talaamiiz daharooh.
Wa waahidiin min kubaaraat balad Aasiya rufgaan Buulus rassalo leyah wa talabo minnah ma yadkhul fi l-naga'a.
Wa kalaam al-naas al-fi l-naga'a bigi mukhalbat.Waahidiin minhum gaalo cheyy waahid wa naas aakhariin gaalo cheyy aakhar lahaddi katiiriin minhum ma fihmo fi chaan chunu humman lammo.
Al-Yahuud lazzo naadum waahid usmah Iskandar giddaam al-naas.Wa naas waahidiin dawwaro hu yikallim le l-naas.Hu sawwa ichaara be iidah achaan al-naas yaskutu wa dawwar yidaafi' le akhwaanah.
Laakin wakit al-naas al-laammiin irfo hu Yahuudi,gammo aato kulluhum be hiss waahid wa gaalo-:-Artaamiis hana naas Afasus,hi ilaaha aziime. Wa gaa'idiin yi'iitu be l-kalaam da wa ma sakato lahaddi muddit saa'teen.
Wa fi l-akhiir,kaatib hana majlas al-hille gidir sakkat al-naas wa kallam leehum.Wa hu gaal-:-Ya naas Afasus,ma fi naadum al-yagdar yankur madiinat Afasus hi bas haafde beet al-ibaada hana Artaamiis.Wa hi al-ilaaha al-aziime wa sanamha al-waga' min al-sama.
Wa kan sahiih naadum waahid ma yankur al-kalaam da,khalaas agoodu saakit bas-!Angar'u ma tisawwu cheyy fasil misil ma induku agul.
Intu jibtu al-rujaal dool hini wa humman ma sirgo cheyy min beet al-ibaada wa ma ayyaro ilaahatna.
Wa kan Dimitri wa akhwaanah induhum chakwa,indina bakaan hana l-charii'a wa indina hukkaam.Khalli yigaddumu chakwithum le l-hukkaam.
Wa kan induku muchkila aakhara,nihilluuha fi l-malamma al-rasmiiye.
Wa laakin al-yoom aniina gaa'idiin nijiibu muchkila fi raasna.Wakit al-Roomaaniyiin yasma'o be l-barjaal al-bigi al-yoom da,akuun yahkumu foogna.Yuguulu sawweena barjaal fi hillitna.Ma indina sabab fi chaan al-muzaahara di tukuun.
Wa ba'ad gaal al-kalaam da,gaal le l-naas khalli yichittu.
Wa wakit al-barjaal kammal marra waahid,Buulus naada al-talaamiiz achaan yilimmu wa hajja leehum.Hu chajja'aahum wa sallamaahum wa faat le balad Magiduuniya.
Wa hinaak wakit chagga al-balad di,hu allam naas katiiriin wa chajja'aahum katiir.Wa ba'ad da,macha al-Yuunaan.
Wa ga'ad hinaak muddit talaata chahar.Wa dawwar yisaafir fi balad Suuriya.Wa wakit dawwar yarkab fi l-safiina,hu simi' al-Yahuud al'aamaro foogah achaan yaktuluuh fi safarah.Wa be da,khalla rakuub al-safiina achaan yigabbil fi Aasiya be derib hana Magiduuniya.
Wa akhwaan waahidiin saafaro ma'aayah wa humman Suubaatar wileed Birrus min hillit Biriiya wa Aristaarkus wa Sukuundus min hillit Tasaluuniiki wa Khaayus min hillit Darba wa Timuutaawus.Wa Tichiikus wa Turuufiimus min balad Aasiya.
Wa kulla l-naas dool faato achaan yarjoona fi hillit Turuwaas.
Wa ba'ad usbuu' hana iid al-Khubza bala Tawwaara,aniina rikibna fi l-safiina wa saafarna min madiinat Filibbi.Wa ba'ad khamsa yoom,wisilna fi Turuwaas wa lammeena ma'aahum.Wa ga'adna hinaak sab'a yoom.
Wa yoom al-ahad,wakit lammeena ma'a l-mu'miniin achaan naksuru sawa al-khubza hana acha al-Rabb,Buulus gamma fassar leena lahaddi ust al-leel achaan dawwar yisaafir be fajur.
Wa l-beet al-lammeena foogah gasir wa aniina gaa'idiin foogah foog.Wa fawaaniis katiiriin muwalli'iin.
Wa sabi waahid gaa'id ambeenaatna usmah Aftiikhuus wa hu ga'ad tihit fi khachum al-chubbaak.Wa wakit Buulus gaa'id yikallim mudda tawiile,al-sabi da naam marra waahid wa waga' min al-gasir al-taalit.Wa wakit rafa'ooh,ligooh mayyit.
Wa Buulus nazal min al-beet ajala wa dangar foogah wa hadanah.Wa gaal leehum-:-Khalaas ma takhaafo-!Ruuhah gabbalat.
Wa Buulus gabbal foog fi l-gasir wa kassar al-khubza wa akal ma'aahum.Wa ba'ad da,gamma yikallim battaan lahaddi l-fajur.Wa fajur gamma saafar.
Wa l-sabi da jaabooh fi beetah hayy wa guluubhum raagdiin marra waahid.
Gubbaal Buulus ma yamchi be derib hana hillit Assuus,hu ooraana achaan namchu be l-bahar wa niwassulu giddaamah fi Assuus wa narjooh lahaddi yaji leena.Wa khalaas,aniina rikibna fi l-safiina wa macheena.
Wa wakit Buulus ja leena fi Assuus,rakkabnaah ma'aana fi l-safiina wa macheena le hillit Mitiliini.
Wa minha macheena giddaam wa ambaakir jiina gariib le jaziirat Khiyuus.Wa l-yoom al-taalit,jiina gariib le jaziirat Saamuus.Wa l-yoom al-raabi',futna giddaam le madiinat Afasus wa wagafna fi hillit Miliitus.
Wa ma wagafna fi Afasus achaan Buulus ma dawwar yi'akhkhir fi balad Aasiya.Hu dawwar yamchi ajala.Wa kan mumkin,yalhag Madiinat al-Khudus gubbaal iid al-Khamsiin.
Wa min Miliitus,Buulus rassal fi Afasus le kubaaraat jamaa'at al-mu'miniin achaan yaju leyah.
Wa wakit al-kubaaraat jo,Buulus kallam leehum wa gaal-:-Intu ta'arfu haalti kikkeef kulla l-mudda al-ga'adtaha ma'aaku fi balad Aasiya min awwal yoom jiit.
Kulla yoom,ana khadamt le Rabbina misil miskiin wa dumuu'i daffago katiir fi chaanku.Wa intu ta'arfu kikkeef al-Yahuud al'aamaro foogi wa l-ta'ab da bigi leyi gaasi.
Wa ta'arfu wakit ana gaa'id ni'allimku,ana ma labbadt leeku ayyi kalaam hana faayditku wa ballakht leeku nafs al-bichaara kan barra giddaam naas al-hille walla daakhal fi buyuutku.
Wa nihazzir al-Yahuud wa l-Yuunaaniyiin be nafs al-kalaam wa nuguul kadar waajib kulluhum yutuubu le Allah wa yi'aamunu be Rabbina Isa.
Wa l-yoom bas,ana musaafir wa maachi le Madiinat al-Khudus.Ruuh Allah yusuugni wa ma na'arif al-cheyy al-yabga foogi hinaak
illa fi ayyi hille al-namchi foogha,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yihazzirni kadar hinaak yidissuuni fi l-sijin wa yita''ubuuni katiir.
Hayaati ma muhimme leyi.Laakin al-muhimm leyi nikammil khidmit Rabbina Isa al-hu antaaha leyi.Waajib nachhad le l-naas wa ni'ooriihum be l-bichaara hana ni'mat Allah.
Khalaas,ana jiit ga'adt ma'aaku wa ballakht leeku al-bichaara hana mamlakat Allah.Wa hassa' na'arif min ba'ad al-yoom naadum waahid minku ma bichiifni battaan.
Asma'o adiil.Ana nachhad kadar intu mas'uuliin min al-cheyy al-yaji foogku.Ana bari minku-!
Ana ballakht leeku hadaf Allah kulla ke wa ma labbadt minku cheyy waahid.
Fakkuru fi nufuusku wa fi kulla jamaa'at al-mu'miniin hana Allah achaan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus khattaaku fooghum ru'yaan.Aywa,asraho be jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-Allah charaahum be damm Ibnah.
Wa ana na'arif kadar ba'ad ana macheet khalaas,naas fasliin yadkhulu fi usutku misil al-maraaf'iin yindasso fi ust al-khanam wa yaakuluuhum.
Wa naas waahidiin minku kula yugummu yi'allumu kalaam ma sahiih achaan yidooru yalgo minku talaamiiz yitaabu'uuhum.
Wa achaan da,khuttu baalku.Ma tanso kikkeef ana gaa'id niwassi ayyi waahid minku leel wa nahaar muddit talaata sana wa ma tanso dumuu'i fi chaanku.
Wa hassa' ni'amminku le Allah wa le kalaam ni'matah al-kallamtuku beeha.Achaan al-kalaam da yagdar yigawwi iimaanku.Wa be l-kalaam da,talgo al-warasa al-Allah yantiiha le kulla l-naas al-khaassiin leyah.
Abadan ana ma dawwart nichiil cheyy min ayyi waahid minku wa la fudda wa la dahab wa la khalag.
Intu zaatku ta'arfu kadar ana khadamt be duraa'i le ni'iich wa le ni'ayyich al-naas al-ma'aayi.
Wa ana daayman wassaftuku be l-cheyy al-sawweetah fi usutku kadar waajib nakhdumu achaan ni'aawunu al-ta'baaniin.Wa ma waajib nanso kalaam Rabbina Isa wakit gaal-:--Farha hana l-banti akbar min farha hana l-bichiil.-
Wa wakit Buulus kallam al-kalaam da,hu barak wa salla ma'aahum.
Wa kulluhum bako wa hadano Buulus wa habbooh.
Wa humman haznaaniin bilheen achaan hu gaal leehum battaan ma yichiifuuh.Wa khalaas addooh le l-safiina.
Wa anfaragna minhum wa rikibna fi l-safiina.Wa chaggeena al-bahar adiil lahaddi jiina fi jaziirat Kuus.Wa ambaakir jiina fi jaziirat Ruudus wa min Ruudus macheena le hillit Baatara.
Wa fi Baatara ligiina safiina waahide tidoor tamchi le balad Lubnaan.Wa rikibna foogha wa macheena.
Wa wakit maachiin,chifna jaziirat Khubrus be l-isra wa macheena giddaam.Wa wajjahna ale balad Suuriya wa wisilna fi madiinat Suur.Wa wagafna hinaak achaan da bas al-bakaan al-waajib yidallu foogah chuhnat al-safiina.
Wa fattachna talaamiiz al-Masiih al-saakniin fi Suur wa ga'adna ma'aahum sab'a yoom.Wa be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,humman hazzaro Buulus kadar ma yamchi fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa laakin,al-wakit al-waajib nagoodu fi l-bakaan da kammal.Wa maragna achaan nigabbulu fi l-safiina wa nikammulu safarna.Wa kulla l-mu'miniin ma'a awiinhum wa iyaalhum addoona barra min al-hille.Wa kullina barakna fi ramla hana khachum al-bahar wa salleena.
Wa khalaas anfaragna.Aniina rikibna fi l-safiina wa humman gabbalo fi buyuuthum.
Wa macheena giddaam min Suur le hillit Butulaamaayis.Wa dakhalna fi l-hille wa sallamna al-akhwaan al-gaa'idiin foogha wa ga'adna ma'aahum yoom waahid.
Wa ambaakir,macheena fi hillit Geesariiya wa dalleena fi beet Filibbus al-mubachchir.Hu waahid min al-rujaal al-sab'a al-aawano al-rusul.
Wa hu indah arba'a banaat al-ma akhadoohin wa hinna hajjan wa atnabba'an.
Wa fi wakit al-ayyaam al-aniina gaa'idiin ma'aahum,nabi waahid ja min daar al-Yahuudiiya,usmah Akhaabuus.
Wa hu chaal hizaam hana Buulus wa rabat beyah iideenah wa rijileenah wa gaal-:-Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yuguul-:--Misil da,al-Yahuud fi Madiinat al-Khudus yarbutu siid al-hizaam da wa yisallumuuh le l-naas al-ma mu'miniin.-
Wa wakit simi'na al-kalaam da,aniina wa kulla l-naas al-min al-hille al-laammiin ma'aana,gammeena chahadna Buulus achaan ma yamchi le Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa laakin hu radda leena wa gaal-:-Maalku tabku misil da-?Tidooru tiwajju'u galbi walla-?Ana maachi le Madiinat al-Khudus.Ana ma jaahiz le yarbutuuni bas laakin fi chaan usum Rabbina Isa ana jaahiz le l-moot.
Wa wakit Buulus aba ma dawwar yasma' kalaamna,aniina sakatna khalaas wa gulna-:-Khalli yabga misil Rabbina yidoorah.
Wa ga'adna ayyaam wa ba'ad da,rabatna khumaamna achaan nisaafuru.Wa chilna derib Madiinat al-Khudus wa macheena.
Wa waahidiin min al-talaamiiz min Geesariiya macho ma'aana wa waddoona lahaddi beet Manaasuun min Khubrus.Hu tilmiiz min zamaan.Wa ga'adna fi beetah.
Wa wakit wisilna fi Madiinat al-Khudus,al-akhwaan farhaaniin be jayyitna.
Wa ambaakir,Buulus macha le Yaakhuub fi beetah achaan yisallimah wa aniina macheena ma'aayah.Wa hinaak ligiina kulla l-kubaaraat laammiin.
Wa Buulus sallamaahum wa waddah kulla l-cheyy al-Allah sawwaah be waasitat khidimtah fi ust al-naas al-ma Yahuud.
Wa wakit sim'o kalaamah,majjado Allah.Wa laakin gaalo leyah-:-Chiif,ya akhuuna.Hini aalaaf min al-naas al-aamano be Rabbina Isa humman Yahuud wa kulluhum yitaabu'u Tawraat Muusa be galib waahid.
Wa humman sim'o kalaam min al-naas al-yuguulu inta gaa'id ti'allim al-Yahuud al-gaa'idiin fi buldaan aakhariin wa tuguul leehum waajib yikhallu minhum kalaam Muusa.Wa tuguul leehum ma waajib yitahhuru awlaadhum wa ma waajib yitaabu'u aadaat juduudhum.
Wa akiid yasma'o khabar jaytak.Wa be da,aniina nisawwu chunu-?
Hassa' da,sawwi al-cheyy al-niwassuuk beyah.Aniina indina ma'aana arba'a rujaal al-sawwo nazir le Allah.
Waddiihum fi beet Allah wa tahhir jildak ma'aahum wa kaffi leehum gurus hana l-tihaara wa khalaas yizayyunu ruuseehum.Wa be misil da,kulla l-naas ya'arfu kadar al-kalaam al-gaalooh foogak ma sahiih wa inta kula titaabi' churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa laakin le l-mu'miniin al-ma Yahuud,katabna leehum jawaab khalaas wa ooreenaahum waajib yikhallu akil al-laham al-gaddamooh dahiiye le l-asnaam wa l-damm wa laham al-fatiis wa l-zina.
Wa ambaakir,Buulus macha ma'a l-rujaal al-arba'a wa tahhar nafsah ma'aahum.Wa ba'ad da,dakhal fi beet Allah wa haddad al-wakit al-yikammulu foogah usbuu' al-tihaara wa l-wakit al-yigaddumu foogah al-dahiiye le Allah,al-waajib ayyi waahid yigaddimha.
Wa wakit al-ayyaam al-sab'a gariib yikammulu,Yahuud waahidiin min balad Aasiya chaafo Buulus fi beet Allah wa harracho foogah kulla l-naas wa karabooh.
