Wa naado be hiss aali wa gaalo-:-Ya Bani Israa'iil,ta'aalu aawunuuna-!Da bas al-raajil al-gaa'id yi'allim al-naas fi kulla bakaan be kalaam didd al-Yahuud wa didd al-Tawraat wa didd al-beet da.Wa hassa',hu dakhal fi beet Allah be naas ma Yahuud-!Wa najjas al-beet al-mukhaddas-!
Wa gaalo al-kalaam da achaan awwal chaafo Turuufiimus min Afasus raayikh ma'a Buulus fi l-madiina wa fi fikirhum,Buulus jaabah fi beet Allah daakhal.
Wa kulla naas al-madiina barjalo bilheen wa jaro min ayyi jiihe.Wa karabooh le Buulus wa karrooh barra min beet Allah wa tawwaali saddo al-biibaan.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yudugguuh le yaktuluuh,naadum macha le khaayid al-askar al-Roomaaniyiin wa ooraah bigi barjaal fi kulla l-madiina.
Wa tawwaali,al-khaayid naada askar katiiriin ma'a kubaaraathum wa jara le bakaan al-naas.Wakit al-Yahuud chaafo al-khaayid wa l-askar jaayiin,khalaas khallo Buulus wa battaan ma daggooh.
Wa l-khaayid garrab le Buulus wa karabah wa amaraahum le l-askar achaan yarbutuuh be janaaziir itneen.Wa bada yas'al al-naas wa gaal-:-Yaatu al-naadum da-?Hu sawwa chunu-?
Wa gammo aato.Naas waahidiin gaalo cheyy waahid wa naas waahidiin gaalo cheyy aakhar.Wa fi kulla l-haraka di,al-khaayid ma gidir yafham sabab al-kalaam wa khalaas amar askarah achaan yiwaddu Buulus fi bakaan hana l-askar.
Wa bakaan al-askar hu gasir wa baabah gaa'id foog.Wa l-askar waddo Buulus lahaddi l-ataba wa laakin al-naas za'laaniin bilheen wa l-askar ma gidro yatla'o beyah fi l-gasir illa rafa'ooh foog min ruuse al-naas,
achaan al-naas gaa'idiin yitaabu'uuhum wa yi'iitu wa yuguulu-:-Aktuluuh-!
Wa gubbaal al-askar ma yindasso beyah fi l-gasir,Buulus hajja le l-khaayid be kalaam yuunaani wa gaal-:-Saamihni,nihajji leek chiyya. Wa l-khaayid gaal-:-Inta ta'arif kalaam yuunaani-?
Inta ma al-Masri al-bigi sawri yoom al-faat da wa marag fi l-kadaade ma'a 4-000 mujrimiin walla-?
Wa Buulus gaal leyah-:-Ana Yahuudi min Tarsuus fi balad Kilikiiya.Ana muwaatin hana hille ma'ruufa wa natlub minnak izin achaan nihajji le l-naas.
Al-khaayid antaah izin.Wa Buulus wagaf fi raas al-ataba wa sawwa leehum ichaara be iidah achaan yaskutu.Wa kulla l-naas sakato.Wa Buulus gamma hajja leehum be kalaam ibraani.
Wa gaal-:-Ya akhwaani,ya abbahaati,asma'o kalaami.Khalli nidaafi' le nafsi.
Wa wakit al-naas sim'o hu yihajji leehum be kalaam ibraani,sakato marra waahid.Wa Buulus gaal-:
Ana Yahuudi wildooni fi hillit Tarsuus fi balad Kilikiiya wa laakin rabbooni hini fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa bigiit tilmiiz hana sayyidna Gamaliyiil wa hu allamaani kikkeef nitaabi' churuut al-Tawraat hana juduudna adiil wa nitaabi' kalaam Allah be chidde misilku intu kulluku al-gaa'idiin hini al-yoom.
Wa ana azzabt naas al-yitaabu'u derib Isa al-Masiih wa dawwart naktulhum wa rabat rujaal wa awiin wa dasseethum fi l-sijin.
Wa kalaami da sahiih wa kan ma tisadduguuni,as'alo kabiir rujaal al-diin wa majlas al-kubaaraat.Humman zaathum antooni jawaabaat le akhwaanhum fi madiinat Dimachkh.Wa ana macheet achaan nakrub naas hana Isa al-gaa'idiin hinaak wa dawwart narbuthum wa nigabbil beehum fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan yi'aakhubuuhum hini.
Wa khalaas,macheet wa wakit al-saa'a bigat gariib al-duhur,garrabt le Dimachkh.Faj'atan,nuur chadiid daawa foogi min al-sama.
Wa ana waga't fi l-turaab wa simi't hiss hana naadum gaa'id yihajji leyi wa yuguul-:--Ya Chaawuul,ya Chaawuul,maalak tita''ibni-?--
Wa ana raddeet leyah wa gult-:--Ya l-sayyid,inta yaatu-?- Wa hu gaal-:--Ana Isa al-min al-Naasira al-inta gaa'id tita''ibah.--
Wa l-naas al-musaafiriin ma'aayi chaafo al-nuur wa laakin ma sim'o hiss hana l-naadum al-yihajji leyi.
Wa ana sa'altah wa gult-:--Ya l-Rabb,tidoor nisawwi chunu-?- Wa l-Rabb gaal-:--Gumm wa amchi fi Dimachkh wa talga naadum waahid al-yi'ooriik kulla cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih.--
Wa ba'ad chift al-nuur al-chadiid da,ma nagdar nichiif wa l-naas al-ma'aayi karabooni min iidi lahaddi jaabooni fi Dimachkh.
Wa naadum waahid gaa'id fi Dimachkh usmah Hanaaniiya.Hu gaa'id yitaabi' al-Tawraat adiil wa kulla l-Yahuud fi Dimachkh yachhado leyah kadar hu naadum takhi.
Wa hu ja leyi wa wagaf jambi wa gaal-:--Ya akhuuna Chaawuul,chiif-!- Wa tawwaali ke uyuuni anfataho wa chiftah.
Wa hu gaal-:--Allah Rabb juduudna azalak achaan ta'arif muraadtah wa achaan tichiif Isa,abdah al-saalih wa tasma' hissah.
Achaan inta tabga leyah chaahid wa tihajji fi chaanah le kulla l-naas wa ti'ooriihum be kulla cheyy al-chiftah wa l-simi'tah.
Wa hassa' tarja chunu battaan-?Gumm ad'i be usum al-Rabb wa nikhattusuuk wa Allah yakhfir leek zunuubak.--
Wa ba'ad da,gabbalt fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Yoom waahid ana gaa'id nisalli fi beet Allah wa cheyy misil al-noom sawwaani.
Wa chift Isa fi ru'ya wa hu hajja leyi wa gaal-:--Gumm ajala.Amrug min Madiinat al-Khudus.Al-naas hini yaabo ma yasma'o chahaadtak leyi.--
Wa gult-:--Ya Rabbi,humman ya'arfu ana gammeet macheet fi kulla buyuut al-sala wa karabt fi l-sijin al-naas al-mu'miniin beek wa jaladtuhum.
Wa wakit al-naas gaa'idiin yaktulu Istifaan al-chahad leek,ana gaa'id ma'aahum radyaan be katlah wa ana gaa'id nahris khulgaan al-naas al-gaa'idiin yaktuluuh.--
Wa laakin hu gaal leyi-:--Amchi.Ana nirassilak ba'iid min hini.Nirassilak le l-naas al-ma Yahuud.-
Wa l-naas gaa'idiin yasma'o kalaamah.Laakin wakit hu hajja be l-naas al-ma Yahuud,khalaas gammo aato foogah wa gaalo-:-Aktuluuh le l-naadum da-!Ma tikhalluuh yi'iich-!
Wa gammo aato wa rafa'o khulgaanhum foog wa hazzoohum wa chaalo turaab wa chattatooh foog fi l-hawa.
Wa l-khaayid amaraahum le askarah achaan yijiibu Buulus daakhal fi l-gasir al-askari wa yajluduuh lahaddi yi'ooriihum maala al-naas yi'iitu foogah.
Wa wakit gaa'idiin yarbutu Buulus achaan yajluduuh,askari waahid mas'uul fi 100 askari waagif jambah wa Buulus hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Fi l-gaanuun,yujuuz leeku tajludu al-naadum al-indah jinsiiya roomaaniye gubbaal ma tichaaru'uuh walla-?
Wakit al-mas'uul simi' al-kalaam da,hu macha hajja le l-khaayid wa gaal-:-Inta dawwart tisawwi chunu-?Al-naadum da indah jinsiiya roomaaniye.
Wa l-khaayid ja le Buulus wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Sahiih inta Roomaani walla-? Wa Buulus gaal leyah-:-Aywa.
Wa l-khaayid gaal-:-Ana kaffeet gurus katiir hatta ligiit al-jinsiiya al-roomaaniye. Wa Buulus gaal-:-Ana mawluud Roomaani.
Wa tawwaali ke,kulla l-asaakir al-dawwaro yajburu Buulus yihajji leehum,humman kasso minnah.Wa khalaas al-khoof karabah le l-khaayid achaan hu rabat naadum Roomaani be janaaziir.
Wa ambaakir,al-khaayid dawwar yi'akkid min al-cheyy al-Yahuud tahamo beyah Buulus.Wa hallah min al-janaaziir wa naada kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa kulla naas hana majlas al-Yahuud achaan yilimmu.Wa wadda leehum Buulus wa waggafah giddaamhum.
Wa Buulus gaa'id yichiif naas al-majlas adiil fi uyuunhum wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,kulla hayaati ana ichtaha be niiye mukhlisa giddaam Allah.
Wa Hanaaniiya kabiir rujaal al-diin amar al-naas al-waagfiin jamb Buulus achaan waahid minhum yuduggah fi khachmah.
Wa Buulus gaal leyah-:-Allah yuduggak inta-!Inta misil durdur al-tiine al-talasooh be buhya beeda-!Kikkeef tagta' leyi charii'a wa taamur naadum achaan yuduggini-?Amrak da mukhaalif le l-charii'a-?
Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin jambah gaalo-:-Haay-!Ti'ayyir al-naadum al-Allah khattaah kabiir rujaal al-diin-?
Wa Buulus radda leehum wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,ana ma irift kadar hu kabiir rujaal al-diin.Achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Ma tuguul kalaam fasil fi kabiir cha'abak.‍﴿
Wa wakit Buulus gaa'id yichiif naas al-majlas,hu irif waahidiin minhum Sadduukhiyiin wa waahidiin minhum Fariiziyiin.Wa hajja be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,ana Fariizi wileed hana Fariiziyiin-!Yidooru yichaaru'uuni achaan ana mu'min be l-cheyy al-narjooh be acham.Ana mu'min be l-bu'aas.
Wa wakit Buulus gaal al-kalaam da,naas al-majlas bado yilkhaalato ambeenaathum.Al-Fariiziyiin wa l-Sadduukhiyiin ankhalafo.
Al-Sadduukhiyiin ma mu'miniin be l-bu'aas wa la be l-malaa'ika wa la be l-junuun wa laakin al-Fariiziyiin mu'miniin beehum kulluhum.
Wa l-khilaaf bigi chadiid.Wa ulama waahidiin min al-Fariiziyiin gammo aarado be chidde wa gaalo-:-Aniina ma naj'alo al-naadum da khaati.Akuun ruuh waahid walla malak waahid kallam leyah.
Wa l-kalaam da jaab barjaal lahaddi l-khaayid al-Roomaani khaaf min al-naas yigattu'u Buulus lahamaay lahamaay.Wa fi l-akhiir,hu rassal askarah achaan yanzulu yakhtufuuh min usuthum wa yigabbulu beyah fi l-gasir.
Wa be l-leel,al-Rabb Isa baan le Buulus wa hajja leyah wa gaal-:-Chidd heelak-!Inta chahadt leyi fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa waajib tachhad leyi fi madiinat Rooma kula.
Wa wakit al-wata asbahat,Yahuud waahidiin al'aamaro fi Buulus wa halafo ma yaakulu wa la yacharbo cheyy illa kan katalooh.
Wa l-naas al-achchaawaro diddah dool adadhum ziyaada min arba'iin raajil.
Wa macho hajjo le kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa le l-chuyuukh wa gaalo-:-Halafna ma naakulu wa la nacharbo illa kan katalna Buulus.
Achaan da,rassulu le l-khaayid al-Roomaani wa guulu leyah intu wa naas al-majlas tidooru ti'akkudu min kalaam Buulus.Wa atulbu min al-khaayid hu yiwaddiih leeku.Wa aniina kamaan,jaahiziin.Naktulu Buulus gubbaal ma yaji fi bakaan al-majlas.
Wa laakin wileed hana akhut Buulus simi' choorithum wa macha fi gasir al-askar wa oora Buulus.
Wa Buulus naada mas'uul waahid hana l-askar wa gaal leyah-:-Waddi al-sabi da le l-khaayid achaan indah kalaam yidoor yi'ooriih.
Wa l-mas'uul wadda al-sabi le l-khaayid wa gaal-:-Buulus al-makruub naadaani wa talab minni achaan nijiib leek al-sabi da.Hu indah khabar yidoor yi'ooriih leek.
Wa l-khaayid karab al-sabi min iidah wa waddaah taraf wa sa'alah wa gaal-:-Chunu al-khabar al-tidoor ti'ooriini beyah-?
Wa l-sabi radda leyah wa gaal-:-Al-Yahuud al'aamaro fi Buulus wa ambaakir yatulbu minnak tigaddimah le l-majlas achaan yi'akkudu al-kalaam al-khattooh foogah.
Ma tasma' kalaamhum.Ziyaada min arba'iin raajil yidooru yakursu leyah.Humman halafo ma yaakulu wa la yacharbo cheyy illa kan katalooh.Wa hassa' humman jaahiziin wa yarjo lahaddi tikhassid be talabhum.
Wa l-khaayid gaal leyah-:-Ma tuguul le ayyi naadum inta ooreetni be l-kalaam da.-Wa khalla al-sabi gabbal beetah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-khaayid naada itneen min masaa'iil al-askar.Wa antaahum amur wa gaal-:-Limmu miiteen askar achaan yijahhuzu nufuushum le yamchu fi Geesariiya al-saa'a tis'a be l-leel.Wa chiilu ma'aaku 70 askar siyaad kheel wa 200 askar musallahiin be huraab.
Wa chiilu kheel achaan Buulus kula yarkab ma'aaku wa wadduuh be l-aafe le Fiiliks al-waali.
Wa l-khaayid katab jawaab le l-waali wa gaal-:
Jawaab min Kuluudi Liisiyaas le l-sayyid al-waali Fiiliks al-muhtaram,al-salaam aleekum.
Al-naadum da,al-Yahuud karabooh wa dawwaro yaktuluuh.Wa ana simi't hu indah jinsiiya roomaaniye wa macheet be l-askar wa najjeetah minhum.
Dawwart na'arif sabab chakwithum foogah wa waddeetah le majlas al-Yahuud.
Wa wakit simi't kalaamhum,ana fihimt tuhmithum foogah muchkila hana gawaaniin diinhum bas wa hu ma sawwa cheyy fasil achaan waajib leyah al-moot wa la l-sijin.
Wa naadum ooraani kadar naas waahidiin achchaawaro achaan yaktuluuh.Wa be da,waddeetah leek tawwaali.Wa anteet izin le l-naas al-tahamooh achaan yigaddumu chakwithum fi bakaanak.
Wa l-askar tabbago awaamir al-khaayid wa be leel waddo Buulus fi hillit Antiibaatris.
Wa be fajur,al-askar gabbalo fi bakaanhum wa khallo siyaad al-kheel wiheedhum yiwaddu Buulus lahaddi Geesariiya.
Wa wakit wislo fi Geesariiya,al-askar sallamo Buulus wa l-jawaab le l-waali.
Wa l-waali gara al-jawaab wa sa'al Buulus wa gaal-:-Baladak ween-? Wa wakit simi' kadar Buulus min Kilikiiya,
hu gaal leyah-:-Wakit al-naas al-tahamook yaju hini,nasma' chakwithum foogak. Wa amar askarah achaan yaharsu Buulus fi l-gasir al-zamaan Hiruudus banaah.
Wa ba'ad khamsa yoom,Hanaaniiya kabiir rujaal al-diin wa chuyuukh waahidiin macho fi Geesariiya wa jaabo ma'aahum muhaami waahid usmah Tartulus.Wa macho le l-waali wa gaddamo chakwithum didd Buulus.
Wa l-waali naada Buulus min al-sijin wa Tartulus bada yiwajjih leyah al-tuhma.Wa hu gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid Fiiliks al-muhtaram,min khattook waali foogna,kulla cheyy bigi leena halu wa ichna fi l-salaam mudda tawiile.Wa be sabab hukmak,haalat cha'abna bigat akheer marra waahid.
Wa khalaas aniina kullina daayman farhaaniin fi kulli bakaan al-aniina gaa'idiin foogah be kulla cheyy al-inta sawweetah wa nachkuruuk katiir.
Wa ma nidooru kalaamna yichiil leek wakit katiir.Min fadlak,natulbu minnak achaan tasmah leena wa nihajju ma'aak chiyya.
Na'arfu al-raajil da,hu fasil marra waahid.Wa hu gaa'id yisawwi fitne fi ust al-Yahuud fi kulla buldaan al-dunya.Wa hu min kubaaraat majmuu'at al-Nasaara.
Wa dawwar kamaan yinajjis beet Allah wa laakin aniina karabnaah.Dawwarna nichaaru'uuh ale hasab charii'itna.
Wa laakin Liisiyaas al-khaayid ja leena wa be gu chadiid chaalah min usutna.
Wa gaal leena kadar ayyi naadum al-yidoor yatham Buulus,waajib yaji leek.Wa inta,as'alah adiil,wa be da,tagdar ti'akkid min kulla l-kalaam al-gulnaah foogah.
Wa kulla l-Yahuud gaa'idiin yathamo Buulus wa yuguulu kalaam al-muhaami sahiih.
Wa be izin al-waali,Buulus gamma hajja wa gaal-:-Na'arif inta haakim fi cha'abna min mudda tawiile wa nidaafi' le nafsi giddaamak be farha.
Ana jiit fi Madiinat al-Khudus min 12 yoom bas,achaan na'abud Allah wa inta be suhuula tagdar ti'akkid min kalaami da.
Wa wakit humman ligooni,ana ma gaa'id nikhaalit ma'a ayyi naadum wa ma gaa'id niharrich al-naas.Wa la fi beet Allah wa la fi buyuut al-sala wa la fi ayyi bakaan fi l-madiina.
Wa humman ma yagdaro yisabbutu al-kalaam al-tahamooni beyah.
Laakin cheyy waahid bas sahiih min al-kalaam al-gaalooh giddaamak.Wa daahu.Ana aabid Allah Rabb juduudna hasab derib Isa al-Masiih al-humman yuguulu ma adiil.Wa laakin ana mu'min be kulla cheyy al-maktuub fi l-Tawraat wa kutub al-anbiya.
Ana kula mu'min be Allah.Wa misilhum narja be acham al-bu'aas.Wa na'arif Allah yab'as kulla l-naas,al-naas al-adiiliin wa l-naas al-ma adiiliin.
Wa achaan da,ana na'asir galbi achaan ni'iich daayman be niiye mukhlisa giddaam Allah wa giddaam al-naas.
Wa ana ma fiini fi Madiinat al-Khudus min muddit siniin.Wa jiit achaan nanti sadakha le masaakiin ummati wa achaan na'abud Allah be gaddimiin dahiiye.
Wa da bas al-cheyy al-gaa'id nisawwiih wakit Yahuud waahidiin min balad Aasiya ligooni fi beet Allah.Wa wakit humman ligooni,ana dahaabah kammalt tihaarti.Ana ma gaa'id niharrich al-naas wa la nisawwi kalaam.Wa dool bas al-naas al-waajib yathamooni giddaamak al-yoom kan sahiih induhum foogi chakwa.
Walla khalli al-naas al-gaa'idiin hini hassa' yuguulu leena ayyi cheyy fasil al-ligooh foogi wakit ana gaa'id giddaam al-majlas.
Cheyy ma fiih,illa wakit ana waagif fi usuthum,ana kallamt be hiss aali wa gult-:--Yidooru yichaaru'uuni al-yoom achaan ana mu'min be l-bu'aas.-
Wa Fiiliks irif kalaam katiir fi derib Isa al-Masiih wa wakit simi' kalaam Buulus,hu battal al-malamma wa gaal-:-Nilizz al-charii'a giddaam lahaddi Liisiyaas al-khaayid al-kabiir yaji.
Wa amar mas'uul al-askar achaan yaharsu Buulus wa anta izin le rufgaanah achaan yisallumuuh wa yisaa'uduuh.
Wa ba'ad ayyaam,Fiiliks ja ma'a martah.Usumha Duruusila wa hi Yahuudiiye.Wa naada Buulus achaan dawwar yasma' kalaamah fi l-iimaan be l-Masiih Isa.
Wa wakit Buulus gaa'id yifassir leyah kalaam fi l-adaala wa sabbitiin al-nafs wa yoom al-Hisaab al-jaayi,Fiiliks ankhara' wa gaal-:-Khalaas.Hassa' da,gabbil fi haraastak.Yoom aakhar bas kan indi fursa ninaadiik.
Fi fikrah,akuun Buulus yantiih gurus achaan yatilgah wa naadaah yaji leyah iddat marraat wa wannas ma'aayah.
Laakin ba'ad santeen,Fiiliks hawwalooh wa khatto Burkiyuus Fastus waali fi badalah.Wa Fiiliks ma talag Buulus min al-sijin achaan dawwar al-Yahuud yardo beyah.
Wa Fastus wisil le daar al-Yahuudiiya.Wa ba'ad talaata yoom hu gamma min hillit Geesariiya wa macha le Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa kabiir rujaal al-diin wa kubaaraat al-Yahuud macho leyah wa gaddamo leyah chakwithum didd Buulus.Wa humman hannasooh
wa talabo minnah hu yiwaddi leehum Buulus fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa dawwaro yakursu le Buulus wa yaktuluuh fi l-derib.
Wa Fastus ooraahum wa gaal-:-Buulus gaa'id fi l-sijin fi Geesariiya wa ana zaati namchi hinaak gariib.
Achaan da,khalli waahidiin min kubaaraatku yamchu ma'aayi.Wa kan al-naadum da mujrim,khalli yisabbutu foogah al-tuhma hinaak.
Wa Fastus ma ga'ad ma'aahum ziyaada min tamaane walla achara yoom wa khalaas gabbal fi Geesariiya.Wa ambaakir,hu ga'ad fi kursi al-mahkama wa anta izin achaan yinaadu Buulus.
Wa wakit Buulus ja,al-Yahuud al-jo min Madiinat al-Khudus hawwagooh wa gammo yukhuttu foogah jaraayim cheeniin wa katiiriin al-ma gidro yisabbutuuhum.
Wa Buulus daafa' le nafsah wa gaal-:-Ana ma khaalaft gawaaniin al-Yahuud wa la sawweet khata didd beet Allah wa la sawweet khata didd sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.
Wa laakin Fastus dawwar yisawwi nafsah zeen giddaam al-Yahuud achaan humman yardo beyah.Wa achaan da,hu sa'al Buulus wa gaal-:-Tidoor tamchi fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa nagta' leek al-charii'a hinaak walla-?
Wa Buulus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ana gaa'id fi mahkama hana sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin wa da bas al-bakaan al-waajib yichaaru'uuni foogah.Ana ma sawweet cheyy fasil le l-Yahuud wa inta zaatak ta'arfah.
Wa kan ana mujrim wa l-moot waajib leyi,ma nidoor najri minnah.Laakin kan kalaamhum foogi kidib,ma waajib le ayyi naadum yisallimni leehum.Ana nigaddim talab achaan sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin zaatahyichaari'ni.
Wa Fastus chaawar jamaa'tah wa radda leyah wa gaal-:-Inta gult tidoor al-sultaan yichaari'ak wa khalaas tamchi le l-sultaan.
Wa ba'ad ayyaam,al-malik Akhriibaas wa akhtah Barniis jo fi Geesariiya achaan yisallumu Fastus.
Wa ga'ado ayyaam wa Fastus fassar le l-malik muchkila hana Buulus wa gaal-:-Fi raajil waahid Fiiliks khallaah hini fi l-sijin.
Wa wakit macheet fi Madiinat al-Khudus,kubaaraat rujaal al-diin wa chuyuukh al-Yahuud gaddamo leyi chakwa didd al-naadum da wa talabo minni achaan nahkim leyah.
Wa raddeet leehum wa gult fi aadaat al-Roomaaniyiin,ma nahkumu le ayyi naadum illa kan al-mathuum wa l-naas al-tahamooh algaabalo.Wa l-mathuum indah fursa achaan yidaafi' le nafsah.
Wa khalaas,wakit humman jo leyi hini,ana ma akhkhart fi l-kalaam da.Wa ambaakir bas,macheet fi l-mahkama wa ga'adt fi l-kursi wa anteet izin achaan yijiibu leena al-mathuum.
Wa fi fikri ana,al-madluumiin dawwaro yathamooh be cheyy fasil.Wa laakin wakit humman gammo hajjo foogah,tuhmithum ma sabbatat ayyi jariime.
Dawwaro yikhaalufuuh fi kalaam hana diinhum bas wa fi naadum mayyit usmah Isa,al-Buulus buguul hu hayy.
Wa ma irift kikkeef nihill muchkila misil di.Wa achaan da,ana sa'altah kan yikhassid yamchi fi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan ana nagta' leyah charii'tah hinaak.
Wa laakin Buulus aba wa gaddam talabah achaan naharsuuh lahaddi l-sultaan zaatah yagta' leyah al-charii'a.Wa khalaas,ana amart askarna achaan yaharsuuh lahaddi nalga fursa niwaddiih le l-sultaan fi Rooma.
Wa Akhriibaas gaal-:-Ana kula nidoor nasma' kalaam al-naadum da. Wa Fastus gaal leyah-:-Ambaakir bas tasma'ah.
Wa ambaakir,Akhriibaas wa Barniis jo laabsiin khulgaan hana muluuk wa dakhalo fi bakaan al-malamma ma'a kubaaraat al-askar wa kubaaraat al-hille.Wa Fastus anta izin achaan al-askar yijiibu leehum Buulus.
Wa Buulus ja wa Fastus gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid al-malik Akhriibaas wa kulla l-haadiriin,da bas al-naadum al-kulla l-cha'ab al-Yahuudi aato foogah fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa fi Geesariiya.Wa talabo minni achaan naktulah tawwaali.
Laakin fi fikri ana,hu ma sawwa cheyy fasil wa ma waajib leyah al-moot.Wa hu zaatah gaddam leyi talab achaan Akhustus al-sultaan al-Roomaani yagta' leyah charii'tah.Wa achaan da,kharrart niwaddiih le Rooma.
Laakin kan niwaddiih le l-sultaan,ana ma na'arif al-cheyy al-naktibah foogah.Achaan da,ana gaddamtah leeku kulluku wa khaassatan leek inta,ya l-sayyid al-malik Akhriibaas.Akuun wakit simi'na kalaamah,ana na'arif al-cheyy al-waajib naktibah.
Ma nidoor niwaddi naadum mathuum fi Rooma kan al-tuhma ma waadhe.Fi fikri ana,da ma waajib.
Wa Akhriibaas gaal le Buulus-:-Indak izin achaan tidaafi' le nafsak. Wa Buulus sawwa ichaara be iidah achaan al-naas yasma'ooh wa bada kalaamah.Hu gaal-:
Ya l-malik Akhriibaas,ana farhaan bilheen achaan al-yoom giddaamak inta bas nidaafi' le nafsi min kulla tuham al-Yahuud al-wajjahoohum leyi.
Wa akiid,inta ta'arif adiil kulla aadaat al-Yahuud wa kulla munaakhachathum.Wa natlub minnak tasma' kalaami be sabur.
Kulla l-Yahuud ya'arfu haali min ana sakhayyar wa ya'arfu kikkeef ana icht,awwal ma'a naas hilliti wa ba'ad da,fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Min zamaan ya'arfuuni.Wa kan humman dawwaro yachhado leyi,yagdaro yi'ooruuk kadar ana tabbagt ta'liim al-Fariiziiya wa ma fi Yahuud kaarbiin al-diin ziyaada min al-Fariiziyiin.
Wa l-yoom,ana gaa'id fi l-mahkama achaan ana mu'min be l-bu'aas al-Allah waa'ad beyah juduudna.
Wa gabaayilna al-atnaachar gaa'idiin ya'abudu Allah be chidde leel wa nahaar achaan humman mu'miniin be l-bu'aas wa yidooru Allah yitimm leehum kalaamah.Wa hassa',be sabab kalaami fi l-bu'aas bas,al-Yahuud gaa'idiin yathamooni,ya l-sayyid al-malik.
Wa maala tuguulu mustahiil Allah ma yab'as al-maytiin-?
Sahiih,awwal ana zaati fakkart kadar waajib nakhdim be kulla gudurti achaan al-naas ma yi'aamunu be usum Isa al-min al-Naasira.
Wa khaalaftuhum fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa be izin kubaaraat rujaal al-diin,karabt katiiriin min al-saalihiin wa dasseethum fi l-sijin.Wa wakit al-majlas hakam leehum be l-moot,ana kula mukhassid.
Wa ana gaa'id nita''ibhum bilheen fi kulla buyuut al-sala wa jabartuhum achaan yakfuru be Isa.Wa ana za'laan minhum za'al chadiid lahaddi maragt min baladna kula le nita''ibhum fi hillaal al-barra min baladna.
Wa khalaas yoom waahid,ana gammeet macheet le madiinat Dimachkh be izin kubaaraat rujaal al-diin,chaayil awaamirhum fi jawaabaat.
Ya l-sayyid al-malik,fi l-duhur wakit ana maachi fi l-derib,chift nuur jaayi min al-sama,chadiid misil al-harraay wa l-nuur gamma daawa foogi wa foog al-naas al-ma'aayi.
Wa kullina waga'na fi l-turaab wa ana simi't hiss hana naadum yihajji leyi be kalaam ibraani wa gaal-:--Ya Chaawuul,ya Chaawuul-!Maalak tita''ibni-?Inta gaa'id tikhaalifni wa da gaasi leek.--
Wa gult-:--Ya l-sayyid,inta yaatu-?- Wa l-Rabb gaal-:--Ana Isa al-inta gaa'id tita''ibah.
Wa hassa' gumm foog wa ni'ooriik maala ana bayyant leek nafsi.Ana azaltak achaan tabga leyi khaddaam wa chaahid.Tihajji le l-naas be l-cheyy al-bayyantah leek wa be kulla cheyy al-nibayyinah leek ba'adeen.
Nahfadak min naasak al-Yahuud wa min al-umam al-aakhariin.Nirassilak leehum
le taftah uyuunhum achaan yamurgu min al-dalaam wa yadkhulu fi l-nuur wa yamurgu min hukum Ibliis wa yutuubu le Allah.Wa Allah yakhfir leehum zunuubhum wa humman yawrusu bakaan fi lubb al-naas al-khaassiin be sabab iimaanhum beyi.--
Wa khalaas,ya l-malik Akhriibaas,ana ma abeet kalaam al-ru'ya al-jaat min Allah.
Wa awwal cheyy,ana gammeet nikallim le l-naas al-fi Dimachkh wa ba'adeen le l-naas al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa l-fi kulla daar al-Yahuudiiya.Wa ba'ad da,gammeet nikallim le l-umam al-aakhariin.Wa gult leehum waajib yikhallu zunuubhum wa yutuubu le Allah wa yisawwu al-amal al-waajib le l-naas al-taabo be l-sahiih.
Wa fi chaan al-kalaam da bas,al-Yahuud karabooni fi beet Allah wa dawwaro yaktuluuni.
Laakin lahaddi al-yoom,Allah gaa'id yahfadni wa achaan da bas,ana waagif hini wa gaa'id nachhad giddaam kulla l-naas al-kubaar wa l-sukhaar.Wa abadan ma nuguul cheyy illa l-cheyy al-Muusa wa l-anbiya gaalo laabudda yukuun.
Wa l-kalaam da,hu laabudda al-Masiih yat'ab wa yabga awwal naadum le yab'as min ust al-maytiin.Wa be l-sabab da,hu yiballikh kalaam hana nuur Allah le cha'abah wa le kulla l-umam.
Wa wakit Buulus gaa'id yidaafi' le nafsah misil da,Fastus hajja be hiss aali wa gaal-:-Buulus-!Inta muchootin-!Gareet katiir lahaddi aglak laffa-!
Wa Buulus radda leyah wa gaal-:-Ya l-sayyid Fastus,ana ma muchootin.Kalaami sahiih wa kalaami ma'guul.
Al-kalaam da,al-malik ya'arfah adiil wa ana niwajjih leyah kalaami bala khoof.Ana mu'akkid kadar al-cheyy al-bigi da,al-malik ya'arfah achaan ma bigi be achiir.
Ya l-malik Akhriibaas,inta mu'min be kalaam al-anbiya walla-?Na'arif inta mu'min beehum.
Wa Akhriibaas radda le Buulus wa gaal-:-Fi fikrak,ajala ke tagdar tisawwiini Masiihi walla-?
Wa Buulus gaal-:-Kan ajala walla kan ba'ad wakit tawiil kula,ana nas'al Allah achaan inta wa kulla l-naas al-gaa'idiin yasma'o kalaami al-yoom,tabgo Masiihiyiin misli laakin bala l-janaaziir al-foogi dool-!
Wa khalaas,al-malik gamma achaan yamchi.Wa l-waali wa Barniis wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin ma'aayah taaba'ooh.
Wa wakit marago min al-bakaan,hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Al-naadum da ma sawwa jariime al-waajib leyah al-moot wa la sijin.
Wa Akhriibaas hajja le Fastus wa gaal-:-Awwal kan al-naadum da ma talab izin achaan yidaafi' le nafsah giddaam al-sultaan,tagdar tatilgah.
Fastus kharrar achaan namchu fi balad Itaaliya be l-bahar.Wa naada mas'uul askari waahid usmah Yuuliyus min al-gisim al-sultaani wa amarah achaan yahris Buulus wa l-masaajiin al-aakhariin fi l-safar.
Wa rikibna fi safiina hana hillit Adraamiit al-tidoor tamchi le hillaal waahidiin fi khachum al-bahar hana balad Aasiya wa khalaas macheena.Wa Aristaarkus al-Magiduuni min madiinat Tasaluuniiki kula saafar ma'aana.
Wa ambaakir,lihigna hillit Seeda wa ga'adna chiyya.Wa Yuuliyus sawwa zeen le Buulus wa antaah izin achaan yamchi fi l-hille wa yisallim rufgaanah wa yalga minhum al-cheyy al-bidoorah.
Wa rikibna battaan wa l-safiina gammat min Seeda.Wa l-riih gaa'ide tusuug min al-kharib wa wajjaho al-safiina fi l-jaanib al-sabhaani hana jaziirat Khubrus achaan al-jaziira tidaarigna min al-riih.
Wa wakit chaggeena al-bahar al-gaa'id jamb Kilikiiya wa Bamfiiliya,wisilna fi hillit Miira al-gaa'ide fi balad Leekiiya.
Wa hinaak mas'uul al-askar ligi safiina jaaye min al-Iskandariiya wa tidoor tamchi fi Itaaliya wa rakkabaana foogha.
Wa muddit ayyaam,ma gidirna namchu ajala achaan al-derib bigi gaasi le l-safiina.Garrabna le hillit Kiniidus wa laakin al-riih tusuug chadiid min al-kharib wa ma khallatna nanzulu foogha.Wa khalaas wajjaho al-safiina fi l-jaanib al-junuubi hana jaziirat Kiriit achaan al-jaziira tidaarigna min al-riih.Wa macheena jamb hajar usmah Raas Salmuuni.
Wa be ta'ab,lihigna al-bakaan al-usmah al-Muwaani al-Jamiile al-gaa'id gariib le hillit Lisaaya.
Wa min gammeena lahaddi l-bakaan da,al-safar tawwal bilheen wa bigi al-wakit al-gaasi le l-safar be l-bahar wa yoom siyaam hana l-Yahuud kula faat khalaas.Wa Buulus gamma hajja le naas al-safiina.
Wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,ana chift haalitna.Wa fi fikri ana,kan namchu giddaam,akiid al-safar yabga leena gaasi marra waahid.Ma tiwadduru al-safiina wa chuhnitha bas laakin aniina kullina numuutu.
Laakin mas'uul al-askar simi' kalaam al-sawwaag wa kalaam siid al-safiina wa ma simi' kalaam Buulus.
Wa dawwaro yalgo bakaan haadi achaan yagoodu foogah lahaddi l-chite yikammil wa l-bakaan al-safiina gaa'ide foogah ma muwaafig.Wa naas katiiriin gaalo yabga leehum akheer kan yamchu giddaam wa yijaahudu achaan yalhago hillit Fiiniks wa yagoodu foogha.Fiiniks gaa'ide fi jaziirat Kiriit wa indaha khachum bahar adiil ma faatih le l-riih,illa fi garn al-munchaakh le l-kharib wa fi garn al-wati le l-kharib.
Wa wakit riih khafiife badat tusuug min al-wati,naas al-safiina gaalo yagdaro yamchu giddaam misil dawwaro.Wa jabado foog witid hana l-safiina wa macho giddaam.Wa ma macho fi ust al-bahar laakin taaba'o taraf al-jaziira.
Laakin ba'ad chiyya bas,riih chadiide bilheen gammat ajala wa saagat foogna min al-jaziira min garn al-munchaakh le l-sabaah.
Wa l-riih chaalat al-safiina wa ma gidro yigabbuluuha.Wa khalaas khallo al-riih waddat al-safiina giddaam.
Al-riih lazzatna gariib le l-jaanib al-wati hana jaziira sakhayre usumha Kuuda al-daaragatna chiyya min al-riih.Wa fi l-bakaan da,be ta'ab chadiid gidirna nisabbutu al-markaba.
Wa jabadooha wa dassooha fi l-safiina wa ba'ad da,gammo lawlawo al-safiina be habil gawi achaan ma tinchagga.Wa humman khaayfiin kadar al-riih tidoor tilizzaha lahaddi tutugg fi l-bakaan al-aali al-gaa'id gariib le balad Liibiya wa jaahado achaan yikhaffufu jari hana l-safiina.Laakin al-riih gaa'ide tiwaddiiha giddaam ajala.
Wa ambaakir,al-riih wa l-challaal gaa'idiin yihizzu al-safiina chadiid wa khaddaamiin al-safiina gammo yidaffugu al-chuhna fi l-bahar achaan al-safiina tabga khafiife.
Wa l-yoom al-taalit,humman zaathum chaalo khumaamhum al-bakhdumu beyah fi l-safiina wa daffagooh fi l-bahar.
Wa min muddit ayyaam,ma chifna al-harraay wa la l-nujuum wa l-riih tusuug be chidde lahaddi waddarna achamna fi l-haya.
Min mudda tawiile,al-naas al-fi l-safiina ma akalo.Wa yoom waahid,Buulus gamma hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,kan awwal simi'tu kalaami wa ga'adtu fi Kiriit,ma fi cheyy yatlaf wa la yiwaddir leeku.
Laakin hassa' nuguul leeku chiddu heelku-!Naadum waahid minku ma yiwaddir illa l-safiina wiheedha tiwaddir.
Fi leele di,Allah al-ana na'abudah wa ana hanaayah hu bas,hu rassal leyi waahid min malaa'ikatah.Wa l-malak ja wagaf fi jambi
wa gaal-:--Ya Buulus,ma takhaaf.Laabudda tagiif giddaam sultaan al-Roomaaniyiin.Wa Allah antaak al-cheyy al-talabtah minnah.Ma fi naadum min al-naas al-musaafiriin ma'aak yumuut.--
Achaan da,ya l-akhwaan,chiddu heelku.Ana mu'min be Allah wa kalaamah wa kulla cheyy al-gaalah leyi yabga.
Laakin al-safiina waajib tutugg fi turaab hana jaziira waahide.
Wa usbuu'een min futna min jaziirat Kiriit,al-riih gaa'ide tilizzina giddaam fi ust al-bahar al-Abyad.Wa fi ust al-leel,khaddaamiin al-safiina irfo garrabna le l-turaab.
Wa gaawaso al-almi be habil wa ligooh 20 raajil.Wa ba'adeen battaan gaawasooh wa ligooh 15 raajil.
Wa l-khaddaamiin khaayfiin achaan fi fikirhum,al-riih tilizz al-safiina fi l-hujaar al-gaa'idiin fi taraf al-jaziira wa tikassirha marra waahid.Achaan da,nazzalo arba'a wutaad wara le ma namchu giddaam ajala.Wa guluubhum mu'allagiin wa gaa'idiin yarjo al-wata tasbih achaan yichiifu al-bakaan al-gaa'idiin foogah.
Wa l-khaddaamiin dawwaro yinbalsu min al-safiina wa dallo al-markaba fi raas al-almi.Wa gaalo leena humman yidooru yarbutu al-safiina be witid giddaam.
Laakin Buulus hajja le l-askar wa le mas'uulhum wa gaal-:-Kan al-rujaal dool ma yagoodu ma'aana fi l-safiina,intu ma tanjo.
Wa tawwaali,al-askar gata'o hubaal hana l-markaba wa khallooha faatat min al-safiina.
Wa gariib al-sabaah,Buulus talab minhum kulluhum yaakulu wa gaal-:-Min 14 yoom,intu ta'baaniin wa ma akaltu.
Wa hassa' natlub minku taakulu wa talgo gudra achaan tanjo.Kulluku tanjo wa suufaay waahide min raas waahid minku kula ma tiwaddir-!
Wa ba'ad hu gaal al-kalaam da,hu chaal khubza wa chakar Allah giddaam kulla l-naas wa kasaraaha wa gamma akal minha.
Wa guluubhum ragado wa kulluhum gammo akalo.
Wa adad al-naas al-gaa'idiin fi l-safiina 276.
Wa wakit chib'o,daffago fi l-bahar al-gameh al-gaa'id fi lubb al-safiina achaan tabga khafiife.
Wa wakit al-wata asbahat,chaafo al-bakaan al-wislo foogah laakin ma irfooh.Wa chaafo khachum al-bahar indah ramla.Wa kharraro yiwajjuhu al-safiina ale l-ramla di achaan yiwaggufuuha.
Wa gata'o hubaal al-wutaad wa l-wutaad daffago fi l-bahar.Wa fartago al-iidaan al-yiwaddu al-safiina fi deribha wa fartago al-chiraa'al-giddaami achaan al-riih tilizz al-safiina fi ramla hana khachum al-bahar.
Laakin al-safiina antaggat fi bakaan aali,tihit al-almi.Wa nussaha al-giddaami wihil marra waahid fi l-ramla.Wa l-challaal al-chadiid gaa'id yudugg al-nuss al-warraani wa bada yikassirha.
Al-askar dawwaro yaktulu al-masaajiin achaan naadum minhum ma yi'arrid fi l-almi.
Laakin mas'uul al-askar dawwar yinajji Buulus minhum wa dahar al-askar ma yaktulu naadum.Wa anta izin le ayyi naadum al-yagdar yu'uum achaan yunutt fi l-bahar wa yalhag khachum al-bahar.
Wa ba'adeen,anta izin le l-naas al-aakhariin achaan yamsuku khachab walla uud min hatab al-safiina al-gaa'ide tinkasir wa yu'uumu beyah waraahum.Wa khalaas,ayyi naadum minnina wisil fi l-jaziira be l-aafe.
Wa wakit kullina maragna min al-bahar be l-aafe,naadum waahid ooraana kadar al-jaziira di usumha Maalta.
Wa sukkaan Maalta zeeniin leena marra waahid wa faddaloona kullina.Wa oogado leena naar achaan al-wata baarde wa almi bada yusubb.
Wa Buulus khamma hatab achaan yusubbah fi l-naar.Wa faj'atan,daabi waahid marag min al-hatab jaari min hamu al-naar wa adda Buulus fi iidah wa lisig foogha.
Wa wakit naas al-bakaan chaafo al-daabi laasig fi iidah,hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo-:-Akiid,al-naadum da kattaal dimam-!Hu niji min al-bahar ma akalah.Wa laakin al-adil ma dawwar hu yi'iich.Wa hassa' katalah khalaas-!
Wa laakin Buulus hatta iidah min al-daabi wa l-daabi waga' fi l-naar wa cheyy ma bigi leyah.
Wa naas al-bakaan gaa'idiin yarjo Buulus yinnafikh walla yaga' yumuut ajala.Wa rijo mudda tawiile wa cheyy ma bigi le Buulus.Wa achaan da,khayyaro afkaarhum wa gaalo-:-Al-naadum da akiid waahid min al-ilaahaat.
Wa l-bakaan al-aniina gaa'idiin foogah gariib le ziraa'at naadum waahid usmah Bubliyuus wa hu kabiir hana naas Maalta.Wa hu faddalaana wa dayyafaana fi beetah talaata yoom.
Wa abu Bubliyuus raagid wa indah wirde wa yisabbib damm.Wa Buulus macha chaafah wa sa'al leyah Allah wa khatta iideenah foogah wa khalaas daawaah.
Wa ba'ad da,kulla l-naas al-mardaaniin al-fi Maalta jo leena wa ligo al-aafe.
Wa chakaroona katiir wa wakit dawwarna nisaafuru,antoona kulla cheyy al-waajib le l-safar.
Wa ga'adna talaata chahar fi Maalta.Wa ba'ad da,rikibna fi safiina waahide.Indaha foogha suura manjuura hana l-Tiimaan al-Samaawiyiin.Hi min al-Iskandariiya wa gaa'ide fi Maalta tuul al-chite.
Wa macheena wisilna fi hillit Siraakuusa wa ga'adna foogha talaata yoom.
Min hinaak,macheena giddaam lahaddi wisilna fi hillit Riikhiyuun.Wa ga'adna fiiha yoom waahid.Wa l-riih gammat tusuug min al-wati wa ambaakir lihigna Buutiyuuli.
Nazalna wa macheena ligiina akhwaan mu'miniin wa humman dayyafoona wa ga'adna ma'aahum sab'a yoom.Wa khalaas,wisilna fi Rooma.
Wa wakit al-akhwaan al-saakniin fi Rooma sim'o aniina jaayiin,marago achaan yilaaguuna.Waahidiin jo lahaddi suug Abiyuus wa aakhariin le l-hille al-usumha Talaata Buyuut hana l-Diyaafa.Wa wakit Buulus chaafaahum,chakar Allah wa chadda heelah.
Wa wakit dakhalna fi Rooma,mas'uul al-askar sallam al-masaajiin le l-khaayid wa anto izin le Buulus achaan yalga beet wa yaskun foogah wiheedah ma'a l-askari al-gaa'id yaharsah.
Wa ba'ad talaata yoom,Buulus naada kubaaraat al-Yahuud al-saakniin fi Rooma achaan yaju leyah.Wa humman jo leyah wa hu hajja leehum wa gaal-:-Ya l-akhwaan,ana ma sawweet cheyy didd cha'abna wa ma sawweet cheyy didd aadaat juduudna laakin karabooni fi Madiinat al-Khudus wa sallamooni le l-Roomaaniyiin.
Wa l-Roomaaniyiin sa'alooni fi l-kalaam da wa dawwaro yatulguuni.Wa gaalo al-moot ma waajib leyi.
Laakin al-Yahuud aarado achaan ma yatulguuni.Wa ma gidirt nisawwi cheyy illa natlub izin nidaafi' le nafsi giddaam al-sultaan.Wa abadan ma nidoor nigaddim chakwa didd ummati.
Wa achaan da,dawwart nihajji ma'aaku.Wa ana marbuut be l-jinziir da fi chaan al-naadum al-Bani Israa'iil gaa'idiin yarjooh be acham.
Wa l-Yahuud gaalo leyah-:-Ma ligiina foogak jawaab min daar al-Yahuudiiya.Wa l-akhwaan al-jo min hinaak kula,naadum waahid ma jaab leena khabar foogak wa ma simi'na foogak cheyy fasil.
Laakin nidooru nasma'o kalaamak wa na'arfu fikrak.Wa kan le majmuu'itku di,na'arfu kadar fi kulli bakaan al-naas gaa'idiin yachku minha.
Wa gata'o leyah yoom achaan yihajji leehum.Wa fi l-yoom da,naas katiiriin bilheen jo lammo fi beetah.Wa min al-fajur lahaddi l-makhrib,Buulus gaa'id yachhad le mamlakat Allah wa gaa'id yihajji leehum be kalaam Tawraat Muusa wa l-anbiya achaan yijiibhum fi derib Isa.
Wa waahidiin minhum sim'o kalaamah wa aamano wa waahidiin minhum abo,ma yi'aamunu.
Wa ma astafago ambeenaathum.Wa gubbaal ma yichittu fi buyuuthum,Buulus gaal cheyy waahid bas ziyaada-:-Akiid,kalaam al-Ruuh al-Khudduus sahiih wakit hajja le juduudku be khachum al-nabi Icha'ya wa gaal-:
﴾‍Amchi wa guul le l-cha'ab dool-:--Tasma'o wa laakin ma tafhamowa tichiifu wa laakin ma ta'arfu.
Guluub al-cha'ab dool bigo gawiyiinwa udneehum ma yasma'owa saddo uyuunhum.Wa kan ma misil da,uyuunhum yichiifuwa udneehum yasma'owa yafhamo adiil wa yutuubuwa ana nachfiihum.-‍﴿
Khalaas,waajib ta'arfu Allah rassal bichaarat al-naja le l-naas al-ma Yahuud wa humman yasma'ooha.
Wa ba'ad gaal al-kalaam da,al-Yahuud marago min al-beet wa gaa'idiin yikhaalutu ambeenaathum marra waahid.
Wa fi muddit santeen,Buulus saakin fi l-beet al-ajjarah.Wa gaa'id yifaddil kulla l-diifaan al-jaayiin leyah.
Wa gaa'id yiballikh bichaarat mamlakat Allah wa yi'allim kulla l-naas be l-Rabb Isa al-Masiih bala khoof.Wa naadum waahid ma daharah.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus abid Isa al-Masiih.Allah naadaani achaan nabga rasuul wa azalaani achaan niballikh bichaartah
al-waa'ad beeha min zamaan be waasitat al-anbiya al-kalaamhum maktuub fi l-kutub al-mukhaddasa.
Wa l-bichaara di tihajji be Ibnah al-bigi insaan min zurriiyit al-malik Dawuud
wa Allah ja'alah Ibnah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,wakit hu ba'asah min ust al-maytiin.Wa Ibnah da,hu Isa al-Masiih Rabbina.
Wa beyah hu wa fi chaan usmah,Allah antaani ni'ma wa sawwaani rasuul achaan ninaadi kulla l-umam le yi'aamunu beyah wa yitaabu'u kalaamah.
Wa intu kula,Allah naadaaku achaan tabgo ma'aahum cha'ab hana Isa al-Masiih.
Wa naktib leeku intu kulluku al-gaa'idiin fi madiinat Rooma,intu al-Allah yihibbuku wa naadaaku le tabgo saalihiin.Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma min Allah abuuna wa Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Awwal cheyy,nachkur Allah be usum Isa al-Masiih fi chaanku kulluku achaan iimaanku bigi ma'ruuf fi kulla l-dunya.
Wa Allah al-na'abudah be kulla ruuhi fi ballikhiin bichaarat Ibnah,hu chaahid leyi kadar ana gaa'id nifakkir foogku daayman wa nad'i leeku
fi kulla salaawaati.Wa gaa'id nas'al Allah kan di muraadtah,hu yaftah leyi al-derib achaan namchi leeku.
Nidoor bilheen nuzuurku wa nantiiku baraka be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan nichajji'ku.
Wa ziyaada min da,nidoor naji fi usutku achaan be iimaanku wa iimaani,kullina nalgo chajaa'a.
Ya akhwaani,nidoor intu ta'arfu kadar ana haawalt iddat marraat najiiku.Nidoor kadar khidimti tantiiku natiija misil antat natiija le l-naas al-aakhariin al-fi diyaar hana l-ma Yahuud.Laakin ma gidirt najiiku lahaddi l-yoom.
Waajib namchi le kulla l-naas,al-musakhkhafiin wa l-ma musakhkhafiin wa l-garo wa l-ma garo.Wa da gaa'id foogi misil deen.
Wa achaan da,indi niiye achaan nibachchirku intu al-fi Rooma kula be bichaarat al-Masiih.
Achaan wakit ana nibachchir bichaarat al-Masiih,da ma indah leyi eeb.Wa bichaarat al-Masiih,hi gudrat Allah al-beeha yinajji kulla l-naas al-yi'aamunu beyah,awwal ke al-Yahuud wa battaan al-ma Yahuud.
Achaan be bichaarat al-Masiih,Allah wassaf kikkeef hu yisawwi al-naas saalihiin wa l-derib da be l-iimaan min al-bidaaya lahaddi l-nihaaya.Achaan da,al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Be iimaanah,al-saalih yahya.‍﴿
Allah bayyan khadabah al-yinazzilah min al-sama fi kulla zanib wa fasaalit Bani Adam.Humman gaa'idiin yikhaalufu al-hagg be amalhum al-fasil.
Al-cheyy al-yagdaro ya'arfuuh fi Allah waadih leehum achaan Allah sawwaah waadih leehum.
Min Allah khalag al-dunya,al-naas yagdaro ya'arfu sifaat Allah al-ma yinchaafo misil gudurtah al-daayme wa tabii'tah al-ilaahiiye.Kan yifakkuru adiil fi l-achya al-Allah khalagaahum,sifaatah yabgo waadhiin leehum.Wa be da,ma yagdaro yidaafu'u le nufuushum giddaam Allah battaan.
Humman irfo Allah gaa'id wa laakin ma majjadooh wa ma chakarooh misil waajib leyah.Be l-aks,fikirhum waddar marra waahid wa khallo al-dalaam dakhal fi guluubhum al-ma induhum fihim.
Hasabo nufuushum hakiimiin wa laakin be l-sahiih,bigo mataamiis.
Abo ma ya'abudu Allah al-majiid al-ma yumuut abadan.Wa gammo ya'abudu fi badalah,asnaam fi suurat al-insaan al-akiid yumuut walla suurat teer walla suurat haywaanaat walla suurat zawaahif.
Wa achaan da,Allah sallamaahum le chahwaat guluubhum wa khallaahum yisawwu fi'il cheen be ajsaamhum wa yitallufu charafhum ambeenaathum.
Humman abo hagg Allah wa khiblo fi badalah al-kidib.Humman gammo ya'abudu al-makhluug wa yakhdumu leyah fi badal Allah al-khaalig,al-waajib leyah kulla l-chukur ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Wa achaan da,Allah sallamaahum le chahwaathum al-yijiibu fi ruuseehum al-eeb.Wa awiinhum kula khallan minhin al-rujaal wa dawwaran awiin.
Wa l-rujaal kula khallo minhum al-awiin wa chahwithum le l-rujaal bigat chadiide bilheen.Wa l-rujaal gammo billaawato ambeenaathum wa l-azaab al-waajib leehum be sabab fasaadhum,lihigaahum khalaas.
Al-naas abo ma ya'arfu Allah wa achaan da,Allah sallamaahum le uguulhum al-faasdiin wa gammo yisawwu al-cheyy al-ma waajib yisawwuuh.
Wa guluubhum anmalo be kulla l-zunuub wa l-fasaala wa l-tama' wa l-niiye al-faasde.Humman malaaniin be l-husud wa l-katil wa l-mukhaasama wa l-khachch wa l-charr.Humman gawwaaliin
wa gattaa'iin wa udwaan Allah.Humman chammaatiin wa mustakbiriin wa fachchaariin wa yifattuchu ayyi tariiga le yisawwu al-charr wa aaykhiin waaldeenhum.
Humman ma induhum fihim wa la induhum amaan wa la induhum mahanna wa la induhum rahma.
Humman irfo kharaar Allah al-buguul al-moot waajib le ayyi naadum al-yisawwi al-amal al-misil da.Wa laakin ma khallo minhum al-zunuub dool wa humman radyaaniin be l-naas al-yisawwuuhum kula.
Wa inta al-tuluum al-naas,kan inta tabga yaatu kula,ma indak kalaam.Fi l-cheyy al-tuluum foogah naadum aakhar,inta gaa'id tuluum nafsak achaan inta al-tuluum akhuuk,gaa'id tisawwi nafs al-cheyy mislah.
Laakin na'arfu Allah yihaasib be l-hagg kulla l-naas al-yisawwu al-zunuub dool.
Asma',ya naadum al-tuluum al-naas wa tisawwi nafs al-cheyy misilhum,fi fikrak inta tanja min hisaab Allah walla-?
Tidoor tahgir kheer Allah al-aziim wa sabrah wa tuul ruuhah walla-?Ma ta'arif kadar hu gaa'id yisawwi leek al-kheer achaan yidoor yiwaddiik le l-tooba walla-?
Laakin raasak gawi wa fi galbak ma tidoor tutuub.Wa be da,inta gaa'id tiziid al-ikhaab al-yaji foogak fi yoom khadab Allah.Wa da l-yoom al-Allah yihaasib foogah al-naas be l-hagg.
Fi l-yoom da,Allah yijaazi ayyi naadum hasab amalah al-sawwaah.
Hu yanti al-haya al-abadiiye le l-naas al-yisawwu al-kheer wa yifattuchu daayman min Allah al-majd wa l-charaf wa l-haya al-ma indaha hadd.
Laakin al-naas al-aasiyiin al-yaabo al-hagg wa yitaabu'u al-fasaala,za'al Allah wa khadabah yanzulu fooghum.
Allah yinazzil ta'ab chadiid wa azaab fi ayyi insaan al-yisawwi al-fasaala,awwal ke fi l-Yahuud wa battaan fi l-ma Yahuud kula.
Wa Allah yanti majd wa charaf wa salaam le ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yisawwi al-kheer,awwal ke le l-Yahuud wa battaan le l-ma Yahuud kula.
Achaan Allah yichiif kulla l-gabaayil sawa sawa.
Kulla l-naas al-ma induhum churuut al-Tawraat wa yaznubu,yahlako bala churuut al-Tawraat.Wa kulla l-naas al-induhum churuut al-Tawraat wa yaznubu,Allah yihaasibhum hasab churuut al-Tawraat.
Achaan al-naas al-saalihiin giddaam Allah,humman ma al-naas al-ya'arfu churuut al-Tawraat,laakin humman al-naas al-yitabbugu churuut al-Tawraat.Humman bas al-naas al-Allah yaj'alhum saalihiin.
Al-naas al-ma Yahuud ma induhum churuut al-Tawraat.Wa laakin wakit humman be nufuushum yitabbuguuhum hatta kan ma induhum churuut al-Tawraat kula,humman bigo misil induhum churuut al-Tawraat fi nufuushum.
Wa be misil da,haalhum tiwassif kadar churuut al-Tawraat maktuubiin fi guluubhum.Wa guluubhum yachhado leehum wa afkaarhum marraat yathamoohum wa marraat yidaafu'u leehum.
Wa hasab bichaarat al-Masiih al-niballikhha,da kulla ke yabga waadih fi l-yoom al-Allah yihaasib foogah al-naas be waasitat Isa al-Masiih.Wa hu yihaasib al-naas fi l-amal al-yisawwuuh be achiir.
Wa laakin asma',inta al-tuguul inta Yahuudi wa tukhutt galbak fi churuut al-Tawraat wa tistakbar achaan Allah hu Rabbak
wa tuguul ta'arif al-cheyy al-hu yidoorah wa tagdar timayyiz al-adiil min al-ma adiil achaan gareet churuut al-Tawraat.
Inta tahsib nafsak giid le l-amyaaniin wa nuur le l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi l-dalaam
wa mu'allim le l-juhhaal wa ustaaz le l-atfaal achaan indak fi l-Tawraat al-ma'rafa al-kaamile wa l-hagg.
Inta da al-ti'allim al-naas al-aakhariin,maala ma ti'allim nafsak-?Fi ta'liimak tuguul-:-Ma tasrig- wa laakin maala inta tasrig-?
Wa tuguul-:-Ma tazna- wa laakin maala inta tazna-?Inta takrah al-asnaam marra waahid wa laakin maala tasrig khumaam min buyuuthum-?
Inta tilfachchar be churuut al-Tawraat wa laakin maala inta tikhaalif churuut al-Tawraat be l-cheyy al-inta gaa'id tisawwiih-?Wa be misil da,inta titallif usum Allah.
Achaan da bas,al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Be sababku intu,al-umam yahguru usum Allah.‍﴿
Al-tahuura indaha leek faayde kan titaabi' churuut al-Tawraat.Laakin kan tikhaalif churuut al-Tawraat,khalaas inta al-mutahhar bigiit misil al-naadum al-ma mutahhar.
Wa kan naadum waahid ma mutahhar ya'ni ma Yahuudi wa gaa'id yitaabi' churuut al-Tawraat,nuguul leek Allah yaj'al al-naadum da misil mutahhar.
Wa be misil da,al-naadum al-ma tahharooh fi jildah wa laakin yitaabi' al-churuut,hu yiwassif be haalah di kadar inta al-Yahuudi khaati.Achaan indak al-Kitaab wa l-tahuura wa laakin tikhaalif al-churuut.
Be l-sahiih,al-Yahuudi ma yabga Yahuudi be l-cheyy al-yinchaaf foogah.Wa l-tahuura al-sahiihe ma gati'iin al-jilid bas.
Laakin al-Yahuudi al-sahiih,hu Yahuudi fi galbah wa tahuurtah,hi tahuurat al-galib al-jaaye min Ruuh Allah.Wa tahuurtah ma tahuura al-maktuuba fi Kitaab al-Tawraat bas.Al-Yahuudi al-misil da,kan al-naas ma yachkuruuh kula,Allah yarda beyah.
Wa misil da,chunu faaydit al-Yahuud-?Wa tahuurithum di,indaha faayde walla-?
Aywa,al-Yahuud induhum faayde kabiire bilheen-!Wa awwal cheyy,Allah ammanaahum be kalaamah.
Wa maala-?Kan waahidiin minhum ma induhum amaan,hal gillit amaanhum di tibattil amaan Allah walla-?
La,abadan.Kan kulla l-naas kaddaabiin kula,Allah yuguul daayman al-hagg.Achaan da,al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Ya Allah,inta saadikh wakit tikallim wa tinnasir wakit tihaakim.‍﴿
Kan be fasaalitna Allah yiwassif kadar hu aadil,nuguulu chunu-?Hal nuguulu Allah ma aadil wakit yinazzil khadabah foogna walla-?Be l-kalaam da,nihajji be fikir insaani bas.
La,abadan-!Kan Allah ma aadil,kikkeef yagdar yihaasib al-aalam-?
Akuun naadum waahid yuguul-:-Sahiih,ana kadabt laakin kidbi yanti fursa le Allah achaan yiwassif be ziyaada kadar kalaamah sahiih.Wa achaan da,al-naas yimajjuduuh be ziyaada.Wa kan ke da,maala Allah yihaasibni ma'a l-muznibiin-?
Wa khalaas,maala ma nuguulu-:-Khalli nisawwu cheyy fasil achaan cheyy sameh yaji minnah-? Wa da bas al-kalaam al-naas waahidiin yuguulu be kidib hu ta'liimna.Al-azaab al-yaji fooghum waajib leehum-!
Wa kikkeef-?Aniina al-Yahuud afdal min al-naas al-aakhariin walla-?La,da ma sahiih.Awwal wassaft be kalaam waadih kadar al-Yahuud wa l-ma Yahuud kulluhum gaa'idiin tihit al-zanib sawa sawa.
Wa l-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Ma fi naadum saalihwa la waahid.
Ma fi naadum waahid aagilwa ma fi naadum waahid yifattich Allah.
Kulluhum sawa ba''ado wa waddaro,ma fi naadum al-yisawwi al-kheerwa la waahid.‍﴿
﴾‍Kalaam khuchuumhum yiwaddi le l-khaburwa lisneehum malaaniin be kalaam halu khachchaach.‍﴿﴾‍Wa chalaaliifhuminduhum samm amchideegaat.‍﴿
﴾‍Wa kalaamhum illa la'anawa kalaam murr marra waahid.‍﴿
﴾‍Rijleehum yajrule daffigiin al-damm.
Al-damaar wa l-fasaala fi deribhum
wa ma ya'arfu derib al-salaam.‍﴿
﴾‍Wa fi nufuushum,ma induhum khoof min al-Rabb.‍﴿
Wa na'arfu kadar ayyi cheyy al-maktuub fi l-Tawraat yihajji le ahal churuut al-Tawraat.Wa be misil da,ma fi naadum waahid al-yagdar yidaafi' le nafsah giddaam Allah.Wa khalaas kulla naas al-dunya yagoodu tihit hisaab Allah.
Achaan ma fi insaan yabga saalih giddaam Allah be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat.Be l-aks,al-churuut gaa'idiin achaan beehum al-zanib yin'arif.
Laakin hassa' Allah bayyan al-derib al-beyah hu yisawwi al-naas saalihiin giddaamah wa da ma be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat.Wa l-derib da,al-Tawraat wa kutub al-anbiya yachhado leyah.
Allah yaj'al al-naas saalihiin giddaamah be l-iimaan be Isa al-Masiih.Wa yisawwi nafs al-cheyy le kulla l-naas al-yi'aamunu.Kulla l-naas sawa sawa
achaan kulla l-naas aznabo wa be da,ma yagdaro yalhago majd Allah.
Laakin Allah yisawwi kulla l-naas saalihiin be l-ni'ma al-yantiiha leehum bala taman,be Isa al-Masiih al-fadaahum min zunuubhum.
Allah gaddam al-Masiih misil dahiiye achaan dammah yamha zunuub al-naas al-yi'aamunu beyah.Wa be misil da,Allah wassaf kadar hu daayman aadil.Fi l-zaman al-faat,Allah ma haasab al-muznibiin be sabab sabrah al-aziim.
Wa fi l-zaman al-haali,hu wassaf be l-dahiiye di kadar hu aadil.Aywa,hu aadil wa ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin be Isa,hu yisawwiih saalih.
Wa kan bigi misil da,al-insaan indah hagg yistakbar walla-?La,ma indah hagg waahid kula.Maala ma yagdar yistakbar-?Achaan hu ma yabga saalih be amalah,illa be iimaanah.
Khalaas nuguulu be kalaam saabit kadar naadum yabga saalih giddaam Allah be sabab iimaanah bas wa ma be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa Allah,hu Rabb al-Yahuud wiheedhum walla-?Wa l-naas al-aakhariin hu ma Rabbuhum walla-?Akiid,hu Rabb kulla l-umam.
Achaan Allah waahid.Wa hu yisawwi al-Yahuud saalihiin be sabab iimaanhum.Wa yisawwi al-ma Yahuud kula saalihiin be sabab iimaanhum,sawa sawa.
Wa be misil da,hal baddalna marra waahid churuut al-Tawraat be l-iimaan walla-?La,abadan.Be l-aks,aniina sabbatna churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa be misil da,nuguulu chunu fi abuuna Ibraahiim al-aniina maragna minnah-?Chunu al-bigi leyah-?
Kan Ibraahiim bigi saalih giddaam Allah be sabab amalah,hu indah hagg yistakbar.Laakin ma fi naadum indah hagg yistakbar giddaam Allah.
Wa l-Kitaab buguul chunu-?Buguul-:﴾‍Ibraahiim aaman be kalaam Allah wa fi chaan iimaanah,Allah ja'alah naadum saalih.‍﴿
Fakkuru fi l-kalaam da.Kan naadum yakhdim,hu yalga ujra wa l-ujra di ma hadiiye.Hi al-cheyy al-waajib leyah.
Wa be l-aks,kan naadum ma yakhdim le yalga ajur laakin yi'aamin be Allah al-yisawwi al-muznib saalih,khalaas al-naadum da,Allah yichiif iimaanah wa yaj'alah saalih.
Wa l-nabi Dawuud kula hajja be barakat al-naadum al-Allah ja'alah saalih bala ma yichiif amalah.
Gaal-:﴾‍Mabruuk le l-naas al-Allah marag minhum isyaanhumwa khafar leehum zunuubhum.
Mabruuk le l-naadumal-Allah ma yaj'alah muznib.‍﴿
Wa nas'alku,al-baraka di hint al-Yahuud ahal al-tahuura wiheedhum walla-?La,hi hint al-naas al-ma mutahhariin kula.Awwal,gulna be sabab al-iimaan bas Allah ja'al Ibraahiim saalih.
Wa Allah ja'alah saalih mata-?Hal da bigi wakit hu mutahhar walla wakit hu lissaa' ma mutahhar-?Da bigi leyah wakit hu ma mutahhar,gubbaal ma tahharooh.
Wa Allah anta alaamat al-tahuura le Ibraahiim achaan yiwassif kadar gubbaal ma yitahhuruuh,hu bigi saalih be sabab iimaanah.Wa be misil da,Ibraahiim bigi abu kulla l-naas al-Allah ja'alaahum saalihiin be sabab iimaanhum hatta kan humman ma mutahhariin kula.
Wa Ibraahiim bigi abu al-naas al-mutahhariin kula,al-ma yintaklu ale l-tahuura wiheedha laakin al-induhum battaan al-iimaan misil al-iimaan al-abuuna Ibraahiim indah,wakit hu lissaa' ma mutahhar.
Wa Allah waa'ad Ibraahiim wa zurriiytah humman yawrusu al-dunya.Wa Allah waa'ad Ibraahiim ma achaan hu taaba' churuut al-Tawraat,laakin be sabab iimaanah al-bigi beyah saalih.
Achaan kan al-warasa hi hint al-naas al-yitaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat bas,khalaas al-iimaan ma indah faayde wa l-wa'ad bigi baatil.
Achaan churuut al-Tawraat yijiibu khadab Allah foog al-naas.Wa laakin kan churuut ma fi,mukhaalafat al-churuut kula ma fi.
Wa achaan da,Allah waa'ad be l-warasa fi asaas al-iimaan wa l-mu'miniin yalgooha be ni'mat Allah.Wa Allah dawwar yi'akkid kadar al-wa'ad yabga le zurriiyit Ibraahiim kullaha.Al-wa'ad ma le ahal al-Tawraat bas laakin le kulla l-naas al-iimaanhum misil iimaan Ibraahiim.Wa misil da,hu abuuna kullina.
Achaan da bas,fi l-Kitaab,Allah gaal-:﴾‍Ana nisawwiik abu hana umam katiiriin.‍﴿Wa khalaas hu abuuna giddaam Allah al-hu aaman beyah.Wa Allah hu bas al-yanti al-haya le l-maytiin wa be amrah,hu yikawwin al-cheyy al-awwal ma mawjuud.
Hatta kan acham ma fiih kula,Ibraahiim aaman be kalaam Allah wa achamah fi Allah gaa'id saabit.Wa fi l-akhiir,hu bigi abu hana umam katiiriin misil Allah awwal gaalah leyah-:﴾‍Zurriiytak tabga katiire misil al-nujuum.‍﴿
Ibraahiim irif fi nafsah kadar hu bigi chaayib wa ma indah gudra le l-waaluuda achaan umrah misil miya sana.Wa martah Saara kula ajuuz ma indaha acham fi l-waaluuda.Wa laakin iimaan Ibraahiim ma nagas.
Abadan ma chakkak fi wa'ad Allah wa ma khalla minnah al-iimaan.Laakin bigi gawi ziyaada fi iimaanah wa chakar Allah
achaan hu mu'akkid tamaam kadar Allah yagdar yitimm al-cheyy al-waa'adah beyah.
Wa fi chaan iimaanah,Allah ja'alah naadum saalih.
Al-kalimaat -Allah ja'alah naadum saalih- dool ma ankatabo le Ibraahiim wiheedah bas.
Laakin ankatabo leena aniina kula,achaan Allah yaj'alna aniina kula saalihiin kan ni'aamunu beyah hu al-ba'as Rabbina Isa min ust al-maytiin.
Allah sallamah le l-moot be sabab khataayaana wa ba'asah achaan beyah hu,nabgo saalihiin.
Wa khalaas,bigiina saalihiin be sabab al-iimaan wa achaan da be Rabbina Isa al-Masiih,aniina gaa'idiin be l-salaam ma'a Allah.
Wa be l-Masiih bas,gidirna dakhalna fi l-ni'ma di be l-iimaan al-aniina saabtiin foogha.Wa nafraho be l-acham al-indina achaan nalgo majd Allah.
Wa ziyaada min da,nafraho kula fi l-ta'ab al-yaji foogna achaan na'arfu al-ta'ab yantiina al-sabur.
Wa l-sabur yichajji' guluubna.Wa kan guluubna ligo chajaa'a,indina acham.
Wa l-acham da abadan ma yijiib leena al-eeb achaan Allah nazzal mahabbitah fi guluubna be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-hu antaah leena.
Aywa,achaan fi l-yoom al-Allah gata'ah wakit aniina ma indina gudra ninajju nufuusna,al-Masiih maat fi chaan al-khaatiyiin.
Gaasi le l-naadum yumuut fi chaan naadum aakhar hatta kan al-naadum da saalih kula.Akuun naadum yikhassid yumuut fi chaan naadum galbah abyad bilheen.
Laakin daahu kikkeef Allah wassaf leena mahabbitah al-kabiire.Wakit aniina lissaa'na muznibiin,al-Masiih maat fi chaanna.
Wa kan al-Masiih sawwaana saalihiin be daffigiin dammah,akiid hu yinajjiina min khadab Allah kula.
Wa wakit aniina lissaa'na udwaan Allah,moot Ibnah saalahaana ma'aayah.Wa be misil da,kan indina suluh ma'aayah be moot Ibnah,akiid nanjo be hayaat Ibnah.
Wa ziyaada min da,hassa' aniina gaa'idiin nafraho be l-alaakha al-indina ma'a Allah be Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Achaan be l-Masiih bas,aniina ligiina al-suluh.
Wa khalaas be sabab naadum waahid,al-zanib dakhal fi l-dunya.Wa be sabab al-zanib,al-moot kula ja.Wa misil da,al-moot lihig kulla l-naas achaan kulluhum aznabo.
Aywa,al-zanib gaa'id fi l-dunya gubbaal Allah ma yanti al-Tawraat le Muusa.Laakin al-zanib ma yinhasib fi l-bakaan al-foogah ma fi churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa laakin al-moot gaa'id yamluk fi l-naas min zaman Adam lahaddi zaman Muusa.Wa l-moot gaa'id yamluk fi l-naas kan zunuubhum ma misil khata Adam al-khaalaf amur Allah kula.Wa Adam hu masal hana l-naadum al-yaji waraayah.
Laakin al-atiiye al-Allah antaaha bala taman di,ma misil khata hana Adam.Be sabab khata hana l-naadum al-waahid da,naas katiiriin maato.Wa rahmat Allah hi akbar min al-khata.Wa hi al-rahma al-jaat be l-naadum al-waahid Isa al-Masiih wa hi sawwat kheer katiir bilheen le naas katiiriin.
Wa atiiyit Allah chig min natiijat al-zanib al-Adam sawwaah.Al-hisaab ja ba'ad al-zanib al-waahid wa wadda kulla l-naas fi l-halaak.Laakin al-atiiye al-bala taman di jaat ba'ad al-naas sawwo khata katiir wa hi sawwat al-naas saalihiin.
Akiid al-moot ja be sabab khata hana l-naadum al-waahid da.Wa be sabab al-naadum al-waahid da bas,al-moot malak fi l-naas.Wa laakin al-naas al-ligo ni'mat Allah al-kabiire bilheen wa bigo saalihiin be l-atiiye al-bala taman,humman yamulku fi l-haya al-abadiiye be l-naadum al-waahid Isa al-Masiih.
Wa be sabab khata hana naadum waahid,kulla l-naas yahlako.Wa laakin be sabab al-amal al-saalih al-naadum aakhar sawwaah,kulla l-naas yagdaro yabgo saalihiin wa yalgo al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa naadum waahid isi Allah wa sawwa naas katiiriin muznibiin.Wa misil da battaan,naadum waahid taa' Allah wa sawwa naas katiiriin saalihiin.
Wa churuut al-Tawraat jo achaan gudrat al-khata anchaafat be ziyaada.Laakin fi l-bakaan al-kitir foogah al-zanib,rahmat Allah kula kitrat be ziyaada.
Wa be da,misil al-moot malak fi l-naas be sabab al-zanib,misil da rahmat Allah kula tamluk fi l-naas wa tisawwiihum saalihiin wa tiwaddiihum fi l-haya al-abadiiye be Isa al-Masiih Rabbina.
Wa kan rahmat Allah kitrat ziyaada fi l-bakaan al-foogah al-zanib awwal kitir,aniina nisawwu chunu-?Hal waajib nagoodu battaan fi zunuubna achaan rahmat Allah tiziid foogna walla-?
La,abadan-!Aniina mutna wa maragna min muluk al-zanib.Kikkeef ni'iichu foogah battaan-?
Intu ta'arfu tamaam kadar aniina kullina khattasoona le nabgo waahid ma'a l-Masiih Isa wa be l-khattisiin da bigiina waahid ma'aayah fi mootah.
Wakit khattasoona,aniina mutna ma'a l-Masiih wa dafanoona ma'aayah.Wa misil abuuna Allah ba'as al-Masiih be gudurtah al-majiide,aniina kula nahyo ma'aayah be haya jadiide.
Achaan kan aniina bigiina waahid ma'a l-Masiih wa mutna ma'aayah fi mootah,akiid nabgo ma'aayah waahid fi bu'aasah.
Na'arfu kadar jisimna al-insaani al-gadiim maat ma'a l-Masiih fi l-saliib wa be da,al-jisim al-muznib addammar.Wa aniina ma nabgo battaan abiid le l-zanib
achaan al-naadum al-maat,hu bigi hurr min gudrat al-zanib.
Wa kan mutna ma'a l-Masiih,ni'aamunu kadar nahyo ma'aayah kula.
Wa na'arfu kadar Allah ba'as al-Masiih min ust al-maytiin wa l-Masiih abadan ma yumuut battaan achaan al-moot ma indah foogah gudra.
Wakit hu maat,hu maat fi chaan al-zanib marra waahide wa nihaa'iiye.Laakin hassa',hu gaa'id hayy wa aayich fi chaan Allah.
Wa be misil da,a'arfu kadar intu kula muttu wa anfaragtu min gudrat al-zanib wa ba'astu wa bigiitu hayyiin le Allah be Isa al-Masiih.
Ma tikhallu al-zanib yamluk fi ajsaamku al-ba'adeen yumuutu.Wa ma tikhallu al-zanib yilizzuku achaan titaabu'u chahwaat ajsaamku.
Ma tisallumu battaan ajsaamku le l-zanib misil aala al-yisawwu beeha al-charr.Laakin be l-aks,intu zaatku sallumu nufuusku le Allah misil naas al-ba'aso min ust al-maytiin.Wa sallumu ajsaamku le Allah misil aala al-yisawwu beeha al-kheer.
Khalaas,al-zanib ma indah gudra foogku battaan achaan hassa' intu ma tihit churuut al-Tawraat laakin intu tihit rahmat Allah.
Wa da kikkeef-?Hal naznubu achaan aniina aaychiin tihit rahmat Allah wa ma tihit churuut al-Tawraat walla-?La,abadan.
Ta'arfu adiil kadar kan tisallumu nufuusku le naadum achaan titaabu'u kalaamah misil abiid,khalaas intu abiid le l-naadum al-titaabu'u kalaamah da.Kan tabgo abiid le l-zanib da,al-zanib yiwaddiiku le l-moot wa laakin kan titaabu'u kalaam Allah,hu yisawwiiku saalihiin.
Wa l-hamdulillah,awwal intu bigiitu abiid le l-zanib laakin hassa' titaabu'u be kulla guluubku al-ta'liim al-Allah nazzalah leeku.
Intu hurriin min al-zanib wa bigiitu abiid Allah al-saalihiin.
Fikirku fikir insaani wa achaan da,ana gaa'id nihajji leeku be kalaam hayyin misil kalaam al-naas.Awwal sallamtu ajsaamku misil abiid le l-haal al-cheene wa le l-khataaya al-sawwooku khaatiyiin be ziyaada.Hassa' waajib tisallumu ajsaamku le l-haal al-saalhe wa tabgo naas Allah al-saalihiin.
Wa wakit intu kuntu abiid le l-zanib,ma gidirtu titaabu'u al-haal al-saalhe.
Wa ween al-natiija al-ligiituuha min al-zunuub al-awwal sawweetuuhum dool-?Hassa' al-eeb karabaaku be sababhum achaan al-zunuub dool yiwaddu al-naas le l-moot.
Laakin hassa' intu hurriin min al-zanib wa bigiitu abiid Allah.Wa l-natiija al-talgooha,hi al-haal al-saalhe wa hi tiwaddi al-naas le l-haya al-abadiiye.
Achaan ujrat al-zanib,hi al-moot wa l-atiiye al-Allah yantiiha bala taman,hi al-haya al-abadiiye be Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Ya akhwaani,intu al-nihajji leeku ta'arfu churuut al-Tawraat.Wa akiid ta'arfu kadar churuut al-Tawraat induhum gudra fi l-naadum wakit hu hayy bas.
Masalan,al-mara al-maakhde marbuuta ma'a raajilha be churuut al-Tawraat wakit hu hayy.Laakin kan raajilha maat,al-mara tabga hurra min rubaat churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa be misil da,kan machat akhadat raajil aakhar wakit raajilha lissaa' gaa'id hayy,churuut al-Tawraat tuguul hi zaaniye.Laakin kan raajilha maat,hi tabga hurra min al-churuut dool.Wa kan tamchi taakhud raajil aakhar kula,al-charii'a ma tuguul hi zaaniye.
Ya akhwaani,intu kula bigi leeku misil da.Wakit katalo al-Masiih,intu muttu ma'aayah fi jismah wa bigiitu hurriin min churuut al-Tawraat.Wa be da,tabgo hana sayyid aakhar wa hu al-naadum al-ba'as min ust al-maytiin.Wa khalaas,kullina nisawwu al-kheer al-Allah yidoorah.
Achaan wakit aniina lissaa'na aaychiin fi tabii'itna al-insaaniiye bas,churuut al-Tawraat sabbabo fi ajsaamna al-chahwaat al-yiwadduuna le l-zanib.Wa l-chahwaat dool lazzoona le nisawwu al-cheyy al-yiwaddiina le l-moot.
Laakin hassa' aniina hurriin min churuut al-Tawraat achaan mutna ma'a l-Masiih wa mutna le l-karabaana masaajiin.Wa be misil da,na'abudu Allah ma be l-ibaada al-gadiime hasab al-kalaam al-maktuub,laakin be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus fi l-haya al-jadiide.
Wa kan nuguulu churuut al-Tawraat sabbabo foogna zunuub,fi l-kalaam da nuguulu al-Tawraat wa l-zunuub humman sawa walla-?La-!Achaan awwal ana ma irift al-zanib laakin al-Tawraat bas arrafaani beyah.Awwal kan al-Tawraat ma gaal-:﴾‍Ma tatma'‍﴿,ana ma na'arif al-tama'.
Laakin al-zanib ligi fursa be l-wasiiye wa sabbab foogi kulli nafar hana l-tama'.Achaan kan al-Tawraat ma fiih,al-zanib mayyit.
Awwal ana hayy wa ma irift churuut al-Tawraat laakin al-wasiiye jaat leyi wa l-zanib hiyi foogi
wa khalaas ana mutt.Wa be misil da,al-wasiiye al-dawwarat tiwaddiini le l-haya,waddatni le l-moot.
Achaan al-zanib ligi fursa be jayyit al-wasiiye wa gamma khachchaani wa karab al-wasiiye achaan yaktulni beeha.
Wa misil da khalaas,churuut al-Tawraat mukhaddasiin wa l-wasiiye mukhaddasa wa saalhe wa adiile.
Wa be misil da,al-cheyy al-adiil katalaani walla-?La-!Laakin al-zanib karab al-cheyy al-adiil wa beyah sabbab leyi al-moot wa l-zanib yin'arif.Wa be l-wasiiye bas,charr al-zanib yin'arif marra waahid.
Na'arfu kadar churuut al-Tawraat jaayiin min Allah,laakin ana insaani bas.Ana misil abid wa l-zanib hu misil siidi.
Sahiih,ana ma nafham al-cheyy al-nisawwiih achaan al-cheyy al-ana nidoor nisawwiih,da ma nisawwiih.Laakin al-cheyy al-ma niriidah,da bas al-cheyy al-nisawwiih.
Wa kan ana gaa'id nisawwi al-cheyy al-fi nafsi ma nidoor nisawwiih,misil da ana nistafig ma'a churuut al-Tawraat wa nuguul humman adiiliin wa induhum al-sahiih.
Wa be da,ana ma al-naadum al-yisawwi al-fi'il da.Al-yisawwi al-fi'il,hu al-zanib al-gaa'id foogi.
Na'arif ma fi cheyy adiil gaa'id foogi,ya'ni fi tabii'ti al-insaaniiye.Indi niiye nisawwi al-kheer laakin ma nagdar.
Ma nisawwi al-kheer al-nidoor nisawwiih laakin al-fasaala al-ma nidoor nisawwiiha,di bas al-cheyy al-nisawwiih.
Wa kan ana gaa'id nisawwi al-cheyy al-ma nidoor nisawwiih,be misil da al-bisawwiih ma ana laakin hu al-zanib al-gaa'id foogi.
Wa khalaas,daahu al-cheyy al-daayman bigi leyi.Kan nidoor nisawwi al-kheer,al-fasaala bas taji leyi.
Fi galbi,ana niriid wasaaya Allah
laakin nihiss fi nafsi cheyy aakhar al-gaa'id fi jismi al-yidoor yamlukni wa hu yidaawis ma'a fikri.Wa khalaas,ana bigiit masjuun tihit muluk al-zanib al-gaa'id fi jismi.
Ya ana al-ta'baan-!Yaatu al-yafza'ni min jismi al-yiwaddiini le l-moot-?
Illa Allah yinajjiini be Rabbina Isa al-Masiih wa l-hamdulillah.Wa khalaas,be misil da be agli ana abd Allah wa nidoor nitaabi' wasiiyaatah.Laakin be tabii'ti al-insaaniiye,ana kula abid le l-zanib wa nitaabi' hasab al-yidoorah al-zanib achaan ana insaan bas.
Wa hassa' khalaas,ma fi abadan halaak le l-naas al-gaa'idiin fi Isa al-Masiih.
Wa gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-tanti al-haya fi Isa al-Masiih harraratni min gudrat al-churuut al-gadiimiin al-waddooni le l-zanib wa l-moot.
Churuut al-Tawraat abadan ma gidro yinajju al-naas achaan du'uf tabii'at al-insaan daharaahum.Wa Allah zaatah sawwa al-cheyy al-churuut al-Tawraat ma gidro yisawwuuh.Hu rassal Ibnah al-waahid le yabga insaan fi jisim misil jisim al-muznib.Wa wakit hu fi jismah al-insaani da,Allah haakam fi l-zanib marra waahid.
Wa Allah sawwa misil da achaan al-Masiih yitimm churuut al-Tawraat al-aadiliin fiina aniina al-aaychiin be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa ma be gudrat al-insaan.
Aywa,al-naas al-aaychiin be gudrat al-insaan yukhuttu fikirhum fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-insaan.Laakin al-aaychiin be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yukhuttu fikirhum fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Al-naadum al-aglah saabit fi fikir al-insaan,hu yalga al-moot.Wa laakin al-naadum al-aglah saabit fi fikir al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,hu yalga al-haya wa l-salaam.
Achaan al-naadum al-aglah saabit fi l-fikir al-insaan,hu da adu Allah wa ma yitabbig wasaaya Allah.Aywa,hu ma yagdar yitabbighum.
Al-naas al-aaychiin hasab tabii'at al-insaan,ma mumkin yalgo rida Allah.
Laakin intu ma aaychiin hasab tabii'at al-insaan.Intu aaychiin hasab al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan Ruuh Allah saakin fiiku.Wa kan naadum ma indah Ruuh al-Masiih,hu ma hana l-Masiih.
Laakin al-Masiih gaa'id fi guluubku.Akiid ajsaamku yumuutu be sabab al-zanib.Wa laakin al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yantiiku al-haya achaan intu bigiitu saalihiin.
Ruuh Allah al-ba'as Isa min ust al-maytiin saakin fiiku.Wa misil da,akiid Allah al-ba'as al-Masiih min ust al-maytiin kula yanti al-haya le ajsaamku al-yumuutu,be Ruuhah al-saakin fiiku.
Khalaas ya akhwaani,be sabab al-rahma al-kabiire di,fi waajib foogna wa l-waajib da ma bukhuss al-tabii'a al-insaaniiye.Ma waajib titaabu'u fikir al-insaan.
Kan ti'iichu be gudrat al-insaan,tumuutu.Laakin kan tahyo be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,taktulu al-zunuub al-fi ajsaamku.
Achaan al-naas al-yuguudhum Ruuh Allah,humman bas awlaad Allah.
Wa Allah nazzal foogku Ruuhah ma achaan yisawwiiku abiid al-aaychiin battaan be l-khoof.La.Al-Ruuh al-nazzalah foogku,hu al-Ruuh al-yisawwiiku iyaal Allah.Wa be sabab al-Ruuh da,kullina ninaaduuh be hiss aali-:-Abba,abuuna-!
Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus zaatah yachhad fi nufuusna kadar aniina iyaal Allah.
Wa kan aniina iyaalah,aniina kula misil wurraasah.Aniina wurraas Allah,aywa,wurraasah ma'a l-Masiih.Achaan kan nat'abo ma'a l-Masiih,nadkhulu ma'a l-Masiih fi majdah kula.
Ta'ab hana wakitna da,nahsibah chiyya wakit nifakkir fi l-majd al-Allah yibayyinah leena ba'adeen.
Yoom waahid,Allah yibayyin majd awlaadah.Wa kulla cheyy al-Allah khalagah gaa'id yitmanna jayyit al-yoom da bilheen.
Achaan al-khaliige zaatha fachalat,ma be niiyitha laakin be niiyit Allah al-fachchalaaha.Wa be da kula,hi gaa'ide tarja be acham.
Wa yoom waahid,al-khaliige zaatha tabga hurra min ubuudiiyit al-damaar.Wa khalaas,hi tichaarik fi l-hurriiye al-majiide hana iyaal Allah.
Na'arfu kadar lahaddi l-yoom al-khaliige kullaha gaa'ide tat'ab be ta'ab misil waja' al-talaga.
Wa l-khaliige ma tat'ab wiheedha.Aniina indina al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa da misil awwal intaaj al-Allah antaah leena.Wa aniina kula naguntu fi daakhilna achaan narjo Allah yikammil amalah foogna wa yisawwiina iyaalah wakit yafda ajsaamna.
Wa Allah antaana al-acham da,wakit najjaana.Wa kan naadum buguul hu yarja cheyy waahid wa laakin ligiih khalaas,da ma al-raja.Yaatu al-yarja al-cheyy al-ligiih khalaas-?
Laakin kan narjo cheyy waahid lissaa' ba'iid chiyya ma binchaaf,narjooh be l-sabur.
Wa misil da,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus kula yi'aawinna achaan aniina da'iifiin.Ma na'arfu kikkeef waajib nisallu laakin al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yisalli leena be ganitiin al-ma bingaal.
Wa Allah al-yichiif guluub al-naas,ya'arif niiyit al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yilwassat le l-saalihiin hasab al-yidoorah Allah.
Wa na'arfu kadar fi kulla cheyy,Allah yisawwi al-kheer le l-naas al-yihibbuuh wa humman al-naas al-Allah naadaahum fi derbah le yitabbugu khittitah.
Achaan al-naas al-Allah irifaahum min awwal,hu chaal niiye achaan yisawwiihum yichaabuhu Ibnah Isa al-Masiih wa misil da,Ibnah Isa al-Masiih yukuun al-bikir wa ma'aayah akhwaan katiiriin.
Wa l-naas al-Allah azalaahum,hu naadaahum.Wa l-naas al-naadaahum dool,hu sawwaahum saalihiin.Wa l-sawwaahum saalihiin dool,hu antaahum majdah.
Wa khalaas ba'ad kulla l-kalaam da,nuguulu chunu-?Kan Allah ma'aana,ma fi al-yugumm diddina.
Allah ma aba ma yantiina Ibnah al-waahid,laakin sallamah le l-moot fi chaanna kullina.Wa hu al-antaana Ibnah ma yantiina kulla cheyy ma'a Ibnah walla-?
Yaatu al-yatham al-naas al-Allah azalaahum-?Ma fi-!Allah ma yathamhum.Hu bas al-yibarriihum.
Yaatu al-yi'aakhibhum-?Ma fi-!Al-Masiih Isa ma yi'aakhibhum.Be l-aks,hu bas al-maat fi chaanna.Wa ziyaada min da,hu ba'as wa gaa'id jamb Allah fi nussah al-zeenaay wa bigi leena wasiit.
Chunu al-yagdar yafrugna min mahabbat al-Masiih leena-?Ma fi-!Wa la l-ta'ab wa la l-diige wa la l-azaab wa la l-juu' wa la l-ire wa la l-khutuura wa la l-moot.
Wa maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Fi chaanak inta,yaktuluuna kulla yoom wa yaj'aloona misil khanam al-juzur.‍﴿
Wa laakin kulla l-su'uubaat dool,aniina ninnasru fooghum nasur kabiir be l-Masiih al-yihibbina.
Wa nuguul leeku akiid,ma fi cheyy al-yagdar yafrugna min mahabbat Allah leena.Wa la l-moot wa la l-haya,wa la l-malaa'ika wa la kubaaraat al-chawaatiin wa la cheyy hana l-zaman al-haadir wa la cheyy hana l-zaman al-jaayi
wa la l-khuwwaat al-foog wa la l-khuwwaat al-tihit wa la ayyi makhluug,abadan ma fi cheyy yafrugna min mahabbat Allah leena al-gaa'ide fi l-Masiih Isa Rabbina.
Nuguul leeku al-hagg be usum al-Masiih wa kalaami ma kidib.Wa galbi yachhad leyi ma'a l-Ruuh al-Khudduus kadar kalaami sahiih.
Ana haznaan bilheen wa galbi daayman booja'ni.
Ana nitmanna Allah yal'anni wa yafrugni ana zaati min al-Masiih,kan be da naas gabiilti yanjo achaan humman akhwaani.
Humman Bani Israa'iil,al-cha'ab al-Allah azalaahum le yabgo iyaalah wa jahhaz leehum al-majd.Wa sawwa ma'aahum mu'aahadaat wa nazzal leehum al-Tawraat wa antaahum al-ibaada.Wa leehum humman,antaahum al-wu'uud
wa l-juduud al-awwalaaniyiin.Wa l-Masiih zaatah mawluud insaan minhum wa hu al-Rabb foog kulla cheyy wa l-chukur waajib le Allah ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Ma tukhuttu fi uguulku kadar wa'ad Allah al-antaah le Bani Israa'iil fachal.Achaan Bani Israa'iil ma kulluhum cha'ab Allah.
Wa zamaan kula,Allah ma hasab kulla iyaal Ibraahiim zurriiytah,laakin gaal-:﴾‍Min Ishaakh bas talga zurriiye al-binaaduuha be usmak.‍﴿
Wa min al-kalaam da,al-naas al-jo min sulub Ibraahiim ma yahsubuuhum kulluhum iyaal Allah.Illa l-naas al-wildoohum hasab wa'ad Allah,humman dool bas yahsubuuhum zurriiytah.
Achaan Allah waa'ad Ibraahiim be l-kalaam al-buguul-:﴾‍Fi l-sana al-jaaye fi nafs al-wakit,ana naji wa nalga martak Saara wildat leek wileed.‍﴿
Wa ziyaada min al-kalaam da,fakkuru fi Rifga kula.Hi bigat khalbaane wa iyaalha induhum abu waahid wa hu jiddina Ishaakh.
Laakin gubbaal al-tiimaan ma yaldoohum wa gubbaal humman ma yisawwu cheyy wa la zeen wa la fasil,Allah chaal niiye wa azal waahid minhum achaan niiyit Allah titimm be l-ikhtiyaar.
Hu yinaadi al-naas hasab niiytah wa ma hasab al-cheyy al-yisawwuuh.Wa khalaas gaal le Rifga-:﴾‍Al-kabiir yakhdim le l-sakhayyar.‍﴿
Wa l-Kitaab zaatah buguul-:﴾‍Ana habbeet Yaakhuub wa abeet Isuu.‍﴿
Wa fi l-kalaam da,nuguulu chunu-?Nuguulu Allah hu zaalim walla-?Abadan,ma ke-!
Achaan Allah gaal le Muusa-:﴾‍Ana nihinn ayyi naadum al-nidoor nihinnah wa narham ayyi naadum al-nidoor narhamah.‍﴿
Wa be misil da kan Allah azal naadum,da ma achaan niiyit al-naadum wa ma achaan al-cheyy al-naadum sawwaah.Allah azalah achaan hu dawwar yarhamah bas.
Wa fi l-Kitaab,Allah buguul le Fir'oon-:﴾‍Ana sawweetak naadum kabiir achaan chilt niiye le niwassif foogak gudurti wa yihajju be usmi fi kulla l-ard.‍﴿
Wa min al-kalaam da,na'arfu kadar Allah yarham al-naadum al-yidoor yarhamah wa yigawwi raas al-naadum al-yidoor yigawwi raasah.
Wa tas'alni tuguul-:-Kan Allah yisawwi misil da,maala hu yuluum ayyi naadum-?Ween al-naadum al-yadhar niiyit Allah-?
Laakin inta yaatu,ya insaan-?Fi fikrak tagdar tuluum Allah walla-?Kan usta sana' chokhol waahid,hal al-chokhol al-sana'ah da indah hagg yuguul-:-Maala sana'tini misil da-?
Al-haddaadi ma indah hagg foog al-tiine walla-?Min koom waahid hana tiine,hu yudugg maa'uun le amal khaass wa maa'uun taani le amal aadi.Wa fi l-masal da,al-haddaadi hu Allah wa l-mawaa'iin humman al-naas.
Wa tuguul chunu kan Allah dawwar yibayyin khadabah wa gudurtah fi l-mawaa'iin al-hu khadbaan fooghum al-jaahiziin le l-halaak wa laakin tawwal himilaahum be sabur-?
Wa Allah himilaahum tawwal achaan dawwar yibayyin kutur kheerah al-majiid le mawaa'iin aakhariin al-hu yidoor yarhamhum wa jahhazaahum le yadkhulu fi majdah.
Wa dool aniina al-Allah naadaana,ma min ust al-Yahuud bas laakin min kulla l-umam.
Wa da yiwaafig ma'a l-kalaam al-gaalah fi kitaab al-nabi Huucha'.Gaal-:﴾‍Al-naas al-awwal ma cha'abi,ninaadiihum cha'abi wa l-cha'ab al-awwal ma habbeethum,nuguul leehum-:-Ya l-mahbuubiin.‍﴿
Wa gaal battaan-:﴾‍Fi l-bakaan al-awwal Allah gaal foogah-:-Intu ma cha'abi-,fi nafs al-bakaan hu yuguul leehum-:-Intu iyaali ana Allah al-Hayy.‍﴿
Wa laakin fi Bani Israa'iil al-nabi Icha'ya hajja be hiss aali wa gaal-:﴾‍Kan Bani Israa'iil bigo katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar kula,chiyya minhum bas yanjo.
Achaan kharaar al-damaar marag wa Allah yitabbigah ajala fi kulla l-balad.‍﴿
Wa yabga misil Icha'ya gaal yabga.Hu gaal-:﴾‍Kan awwal Allah al-Gaadir ma khalla leena zurriiye,aniina niddammaro misil naas Saduum wa nahlako misil naas Amuura.‍﴿
Fi kulla l-kalaam da,nuguulu chunu-?Al-naas al-ma Yahuud ma jaahado le yabgo saalihiin wa laakin bigo saalihiin.Wa bigo saalihiin be derib al-iimaan.
Wa Bani Israa'iil taaba'o churuut al-Tawraat wa jaahado beehum le yabgo saalihiin laakin fachalo.
Wa da maala-?Achaan ma taaba'o derib al-iimaan.Wa fi fikirhum,humman yabgo saalihiin be sabab al-amal al-yisawwuuh.Wa khalaas,humman antaggo fi l-hajar al-yarmiihum.
Wa achaan da bas al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Asma'o,ana nukhutt hajar fi Sahyuun.Be sababah,al-naas yintaggo wa yaga'o.Laakin ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyah abadan ma yakhjal.‍﴿
Ya akhwaani fi l-Masiih,nitmanna be kulla galbi kadar akhwaani al-Yahuud yanjo wa da l-cheyy al-ana daayman natulbah min Allah.
Ana nachhad leehum kadar humman munkaribiin fi ibaadat Allah laakin fiyah cheyy waahid ma ya'arfuuh.
Humman ma ya'arfu kikkeef Allah yisawwi al-naas saalihiin wa khalaas yidooru yabgo saalihiin be juhudhum.Wa abo ma yakhbalo al-derib al-Allah fatahah le l-naas al-beyah yabgo saalihiin.
Achaan al-Masiih ja wa tamma churuut al-Tawraat wa be l-Masiih kulla l-naas yabgo saalihiin,kan yi'aamunu beyah.
Wa fi l-Kitaab,Muusa fassar leena kikkeef al-naas yabgo saalihiin be churuut al-Tawraat.Hu gaal-:﴾‍Al-naadum al-yitabbig kulla l-churuut dool yahya beehum.‍﴿
Laakin hu gaal battaan kikkeef al-naas yabgo saalihiin be l-iimaan.Maktuub-:﴾‍Ma tuguul fi galbak,yaatu al-yatla' fi l-sama-?‍﴿Ya'ni yinazzil al-Masiih.
Wa battaan maktuub-:﴾‍Ma tuguul yaatu al-yanzil fi l-haawiye-?‍﴿Ya'ni yamrug al-Masiih min ust al-maytiin.
Laakin al-cheyy al-buguulah chunu-?Buguul-:﴾‍Al-kalaam gaa'id gariib leek.Hu fi khachmak wa fi galbak.‍﴿Wa l-kalaam da,hu kalaam al-iimaan al-niballukhuuh leeku.
Kan be khachmak tachhad le Isa wa tuguul hu al-Rabb wa fi galbak ti'aamin kadar Allah ba'asah min ust al-maytiin,be misil da tanja khalaas.
Achaan be sabab al-iimaan al-gaa'id fi l-galib,Allah yaj'al al-naadum saalih wa be sabab chahaadat khachmah,Allah yinajjiih.
Al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Ayyi naadum al-yi'aamin beyah abadan ma yakhjal.‍﴿
Wa da bigi sawa sawa le l-Yahuud wa le l-ma Yahuud achaan al-Rabb al-waahid,hu Rabb kulla l-naas wa hu kariim le ayyi naadum al-yad'i be usmah.
Achaan maktuub-:﴾‍Ayyi naadum al-yad'i be usum Allah yanja.‍﴿
Wa kikkeef yad'u be l-Rabb,kan ma aamano beyah-?Wa kikkeef yi'aamunu be l-Rabb,kan ma sim'o beyah-?Wa kikkeef yasma'o beyah,kan ma fi naadum ballakh leehum al-bichaara-?
Wa kikkeef yiballukhu leehum al-bichaara,kan ma rassaloohum-?Achaan da,al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Marhaban be jayyit al-mursaal al-yiballikh al-bichaara.‍﴿
Wa laakin ma kulla l-naas khiblo al-bichaara.Achaan da,al-nabi Icha'ya gaal-:﴾‍Ya Allah,yaatu al-aaman be khabarna-?‍﴿
Khalaas,al-naas ma yabgo mu'miniin be l-Masiih illa kan yasma'o al-bichaara wa ma yasma'o al-bichaara illa kan naadum yiballikhha leehum.
Laakin nas'al cheyy waahid.Sahiih,al-Yahuud lissaa' ma sim'o al-bichaara di walla-?La,humman sim'ooha.Al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Hissuhum ansama' fi kulla l-ard,aywa kalaamhum lahaddi aakhir al-dunya.‍﴿
Wa battaan nas'al,Bani Israa'iil ma fihmo al-kalaam walla-?Awwal be khachum Muusa,Allah gaal-:﴾‍Nisawwiiku hasuudiin be l-cha'ab al-ma tammo umma wa niza''ilku be umma jaahle.‍﴿
Wa l-nabi Icha'ya gamma hajja kalaam Allah leehum bala chakak wa gaal-:﴾‍Al-naas al-ligooni,humman ma al-naas al-fattachooni.Wa bayyant nafsi le naas al-ma naadooni.‍﴿
Laakin fi Bani Israa'iil,hu gaal-:﴾‍Kulla yoom ana maddeet iideeni le cha'ab aasiyiin wa raashum gawi.‍﴿
Wa achaan da,ana nas'al su'aal.Allah aba cha'abah Bani Israa'iil marra waahid walla-?La,abadan.Ana zaati min Bani Israa'iil wa min zurriiyit Ibraahiim wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Allah ma aba cha'abah al-azalaahum min awwal.Walla nisiitu al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-bukhuss al-nabi Iliyaas-?Fi bakaan waahid,hu hajja le Allah wa chaka min Bani Israa'iil
wa gaal-:﴾‍Ya Allah,humman katalo al-anbiya al-rassaltuhum wa kassaro kulla madaabhak.Wa ana faddalt wiheedi wa humman yifattuchuuni le yaktuluuni.‍﴿
Wa laakin Allah radda leyah kikkeef-?Hu gaal-:﴾‍Ana hafadt minhum 7-000 naas al-abadan ma sajado giddaam ilaah Ba'al.‍﴿
Wa l-cheyy al-gaa'id yabga hassa',hu misil al-cheyy al-bigi fi l-wakit daak.Faddalo naas chiyya bas al-yitaabu'u Allah wa humman al-naas al-Allah azalaahum be ni'matah.
Wa kan di ni'ma,da ma bigi be sabab ayyi cheyy al-humman sawwooh.Achaan kan Allah azal al-naas be sabab al-cheyy al-sawwooh,al-ni'ma ma tabga ni'ma.
Wa da kikkeef-?Bani Israa'iil ma ligo al-cheyy al-talabooh min Allah.Illa l-naas al-Allah azalaahum bas ligooh.Wa l-aakhariin ruuseehum bigo gawiyiin.
Achaan da,maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Allah nazzal fooghum ruuh hana noom wa uyuunhum ma yichiifu wa udneehum ma yasma'o lahaddi l-yoom.‍﴿
Wa l-nabi Dawuud gaal-:﴾‍Khalli dabalaayithum tabga leehumamkajjaama wa charak giddaamhum.Khalli barakaathum yabgo leehumchokhol al-yintaggo foogah wa ikhaab.
Khalli uyuunhum yitoochuchuwa battaan ma yichiifuwa daayman aksir duhuurhum.‍﴿
Achaan da nas'al.Humman waga'o marra waahid lahaddi battaan ma yugummu walla-?La,abadan.Humman waga'o wa be khataahum da,najaat Allah lihgat al-naas al-ma Yahuud achaan yisawwi al-Yahuud yahsuduuhum.
Wa kan khata al-Yahuud sabbab baraka kabiire le naas al-dunya wa maskanat al-Yahuud sabbabat baraka kabiire le l-naas al-ma Yahuud,akiid wakit al-Yahuud yigabbulu marra waahid fi l-derib,da yabga leena baraka kabiire be ziyaada.
Ya l-naas al-ma Yahuud,ana gaa'id nihajji leeku.Ana al-rasuul al-murassal le l-naas al-ma Yahuud wa ana farhaan bilheen be khidimti
achaan akuun nisawwi akhwaani al-Yahuud yahsuduuku wa akuun be misil da,ninajji waahidiin minhum.
Wakit Allah aba al-Yahuud,naas al-dunya ligo salaam ma'a Allah.Wa kan bigi misil da,yabga kikkeef wakit Allah yakhbal al-Yahuud battaan-?Da yijiib bu'aas al-maytiin.
Kan al-intaaj al-awwal hu khaass le Allah,al-ajiin al-yisawwuuh minha kula khaass le Allah.Wa kan khassaso uruug al-chadara le Allah,furuu'ha kula khaassiin le Allah.
Wa misil da,zurriiyit Ibraahiim misil chadarat al-zaytuun wa furuu' waahidiin gata'oohum minha.Wa inta al-ma Yahuudi,inta misil firi' hana l-zaytuun al-bandar.Wa chaalook wa lassagook fi l-chadara al-fi l-jineene fi badal al-furuu' al-gata'oohum.Wa misil da,inta kula ti'iich min al-uruug al-adiiliin ma'a l-furuu' al-faddalo.
Wa be misil da,waajib inta ma tifaachir fi l-furuu' al-gata'oohum.Wa kan tidoor tifaachir kamaan,fakkir kadar inta ma gaa'id ti'ayyich al-uruug laakin al-uruug gaa'idiin yi'ayyuchuuk inta.
Akuun tuguul-:-Al-furuu' dool,gata'oohum achaan siid al-jineene dawwar yilassigni ana fi l-chadara fi badalhum.
Kalaamak da sahiih.Laakin ma tansa gata'oohum achaan humman ma aamano wa inta gaa'id fi bakaanhum be sabab iimaanak bas.Ma tistakbar.Angari'-!
Kan Allah ma afa furuu' al-chadara,hu ma ya'afaak inta kula.
Fakkir fi mahannat Allah wa fakkir fi hukmah al-gawi kula.Hukmah gawi fi l-naas al-marago min al-derib,laakin hu hanuun leek bilheen kan tagood saabit fi ihsaanah.Wa kan ma tagood saabit,inta kula yagta'ook.
Wa Bani Israa'iil kula,kan yikhallu gillit iimaanhum,Allah yigabbilhum battaan fi bakaanhum al-awwal gaa'idiin foogah achaan Allah gaadir yisawwiih.
Wa be da,inta firi' min al-bandar.Wa Allah gata'ak minnah wa lassagaak fi chadarat al-zaytuun al-magganha.Wa da ma bakaanak al-waajib leek.Achaan da,yabga hayyin le Allah yigabbil al-furuu' al-gata'aahum wa yilassighum battaan fi l-bakaan al-waajib leehum.
