Ya akhwaani,nidoor ni'ooriiku be sirr waahid al-Allah bayyanah leyi.Ni'ooriiku beyah achaan kan fihimtuuh adiil,ma tistakbaro fi afkaarku.Waahidiin min Bani Israa'iil bigo aasiyiin wa ma yi'aamunu be Isa al-Masiih.Wa isyaanhum da yuduum lahaddi adad al-mu'miniin min al-umam yalhag al-adad al-Allah yidoorah.
Wa be misil da,Bani Israa'iil kulluhum ke yanjo khalaas.Achaan da,maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Al-yafdaahum yaji min Sahyuun wa yigabbil zurriiyit Yaakhuub min isyaanhum.
Wa misil ana gult fi l-mu'aahada al-sawweetha ma'aahum,ana nuguchch zunuubhum.‍﴿
Fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss bichaarat al-Masiih,Bani Israa'iil bigo adu Allah wa min isyaanhum,intu ligiitu faayde.Laakin fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss ikhtiyaar Allah,humman mahbuubiin be sabab juduudhum.
Achaan kan Allah anta naadum atiiye,hu ma yandam leeha.Wa kan naada naadum,ma yibattil munaadaatah.
Intu al-ma Yahuud awwal aasiyiin laakin hassa' Allah rahamaaku be sabab isyaan Bani Israa'iil.
Wa hassa' Bani Israa'iil bigo aasiyiin wa be l-rahma al-Allah rahamaaku beeha,humman kula yalgo rahma.
Fi nizaam Allah kulla l-umam marbuutiin fi isyaanhum achaan fi l-akhiir,Allah yarham kulla l-umam sawa sawa.
Al-hamdulillah al-Aliim wa l-Hakiim.Hikmatah wa ilmah abadan ma induhum hadd-!Hikmat hukmah nafhamo minha illa chiyya.Wa nizaamah ajiib lahaddi ma yilfassar.
Achaan da,al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Yaatu irif afkaar Allah wa bigi leyah siid choortah-?
Yaatu dayyan Allah cheyy al-waajib yigabbilah leyah-!‍﴿
Achaan kulla cheyy jaayi min Allah wa mawjuud beyah hu wa leyah hu.Wa l-hamdulillah ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Ya akhwaani,niwassiiku be sabab rahmat Allah al-ligiituuha,ayyi waahid minku yigaddim jismah le Allah dahiiye hayye wa mukhaddasa al-Allah yarda beeha.Wa di hi ibaaditku al-waajbe.
Aabo ma titaabu'u fikir naas al-dunya laakin khalli Allah yikhayyirku wa yantiiku agul jadiid al-beyah tagdaro timayyuzu al-cheyy al-Allah yidoorah wa ta'arfu al-cheyy al-adiil wa l-cheyy al-Allah yarda beyah wa l-cheyy al-tamaam.
Wa be l-ni'ma al-Allah antaaha leyi,niwassi ayyi waahid minku ma yistakbar.Khalli ayyi waahid ma yinkhachcha laakin yichiif nafsah hasab gudrat al-iimaan al-Allah antaah leyah.
Chiifu,ayyi waahid minnina indah fi jismah a'da katiiriin wa kulla udu ma yisawwi nafs al-khidme.
Be misil da,aniina naas katiiriin laakin bigiina misil jisim waahid fi l-Masiih.Wa ayyi waahid minnina,hu udu fi l-jisim da wa bigi akhu le l-aakhariin kulluhum.
Indina ataaya chig chig hasab ni'mat Allah.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yihajji kalaam naazil min Allah,khalli yihajji hasab al-iimaan.
Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yakhdim fi ust al-akhwaan,khalli yakhdim.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yi'allim al-naas,khalli yi'allimhum.
Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yichajji' al-akhwaan,khalli yichajji'hum.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yanti,khalli yanti be juud.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yuguud akhwaanah,khalli yukhutt baalah wa yuguudhum adiil.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yihinn fi l-naas,khalli yihinn fooghum be farah.
Hibbu ayyi naadum be mahabba sahiihe.Akraho al-charr marra waahid wa akurbu al-kheer gawi.
Arraayado ambeenaatku misil akhwaan wa khalli ayyi waahid yichiil niiye achaan yihibb akhuuh be ihtiraam.
Taabu'u Rabbina be niiye waahide wa bala kasal.Ankarbu fi khidmit al-Rabb.
Afraho achaan induku acham fi Rabbina.Asburu fi l-ta'ab wa sallu daayman bala kasal.
Saa'udu al-saalihiin al-muhtaajiin wa dayyufu be farah al-diifaan al-yajuuku.
Baaruku al-naas al-yita''ubuuku.Aywa,baarukuuhum wa ma tal'anoohum.
Afraho ma'a l-farhaaniin wa ahzano ma'a l-haznaaniin.
Astafugu ambeenaatku wa khalli ayyi waahid ma yaj'al nafsah kabiir laakin khalli yaj'al nafsah sakhayyar.Ma tisawwu nufuusku induku irfe katiire.
Kan naadum sawwa foogku cheyy fasil,ma tisawwu foogah cheyy fasil.Fakkuru wa sawwu al-cheyy al-kulla l-naas yardo beyah.
Jaahudu be ayyi daliil achaan ti'iichu be salaam ma'a kulla l-naas.
Ya l-mahbuubiin,ma tichiilu al-taar.Khallu khadab Allah yichiil leeku al-taar achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Al-taar hanaayi.Ana bas al-nichiilah.‍﴿Da bas kalaam Allah.
Akheer kan titaabu'u al-kalaam al-buguul-:﴾‍Kan aduuk jii'aan,antiih yaakul.Wa kan hu atchaan,antiih yachrab.Kan tisawwi misil da,al-eeb yakurbah wa yabga misil jamur al-sabbooh fi raasah.‍﴿
Ma tikhallu al-charr yinnasir foogku laakin annasuru fi l-charr be l-kheer.
Khalli ayyi naadum yasma' kalaam al-hakuuma achaan ma fi hakuuma illa be izin Allah wa ayyi hakuuma al-gaa'ide,Allah assasaaha.
Achaan da,ayyi naadum al-yikhaalif al-hakuuma,yikhaalif al-cheyy al-Allah assasah.Wa l-naadum al-yikhaalif,hukum Allah yanzil foogah.
Achaan al-naadum al-haalah adiile ma yakhaaf min al-hukkaam illa l-naadum al-haalah fasle,hu yakhaaf minhum.Kan tidoor ma takhaaf min al-haakim,khalaas sawwi al-kheer wa l-haakim yachkurak.
Al-haakim hu khaddaam Allah le kheerak.Laakin kan inta mujrim,laabudda takhaaf minnah achaan al-haakim indah al-seef wa ma yichiilah saakit.Hu khaddaam Allah achaan yinazzil khadab Allah fi l-mujrim.
Fi chaan da,waajib tasma'o kalaam al-hakuuma.Wa da ma le takhaafo min khadab Allah bas laakin le talgo niiye mukhlisa.
Wa achaan da,waajib tikaffu al-miiri kula.Al-hukkaam humman khaddaamiin Allah wa yichtakhulu be l-khidme al-antaaha leehum di.
Antu ayyi naadum al-cheyy al-waajib leyah.Wa l-naadum al-waajib leyah tikaffu al-miiri,kaffuuh leyah.Wa l-naadum al-waajib leyah tikaffu jamaarik,kaffuuh leyah.Wa l-naadum al-waajib leyah ihtiraam,ahtarumuuh.Wa l-naadum al-waajib leyah al-ikraam,karrumuuh.
Ma tikhallu al-deen yagood foogku.Deen waahid bas gaa'id foogku wa hu al-mahabba ambeenaatku.Wa l-naadum al-yihibb akhuuh,hu tabbag churuut al-Tawraat khalaas.
Achaan al-wasaaya buguulu-:﴾‍Ma tazna wa ma taktul dimme wa ma tasrig wa ma tatma'‍﴿wa wasaaya aakhariin kula.Wa kulla l-wasaaya dool,zibdithum hi al-wasiiye al-tuguul-:﴾‍Hibb akhuuk misil tihibb nafsak.‍﴿
Al-naadum al-yihibb akhuuh abadan ma yisawwi leyah cheyy fasil.Wa be misil da,al-naadum al-yihibb al-naas yitabbig churuut al-Tawraat be sahiih.
Wa khalaas,ta'arfu al-wakit al-aniina gaa'idiin foogah.Al-wakit tamma khalaas.Wa hassa',waajib tugummu min noomku achaan yoom al-naja gariib leena min wakit aniina aamanna.
Al-leel gariib yikammil wa l-nahaar jaayi gariib.Khalaas,waajib nikhallu minnina kulla fi'il al-dalaam wa nijahhuzu nufuusna achaan ni'iichu fi l-nuur.
Khalli haalna tukuun haal hana iyaal al-nuur.Wa khalli ma namchu fi l-safaaha wa l-sakar,wa la fi l-zina wa l-fasaad,wa la fi l-duwaas wa l-husud.
Wa fi badal al-zunuub dool,arbutu sulubku wa khuttu fi uguulku intu khaddaamiin le Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Wa aabo ma tichtakhulu be chahwaat al-insaan.
Akhbalo al-mu'min al-da'iif fi iimaanah wa ma tikhaalutuuh fi fikrah.
Hasab iimaan naas waahidiin,kulla nafar hana akil halaal.Wa laakin al-naas al-iimaanhum da'iif yaakulu illa l-khadaar.
Al-naadum al-yaakul ayyi nafar hana akil,ma waajib yahgir al-mu'min al-yaakul illa l-khadaar.Wa l-yaakul illa l-khadaar,ma waajib yuluum al-naadum al-yaakul kulla cheyy.Achaan akhuuk da,Allah khibilah khalaas.
Inta yaatu al-tuluum al-khaddaam al-inta ma siidah-?Siidah bas yuguul kan yanjah aw yafchul.Wa akiid hu yanjah achaan Rabbina bas yinajjihah.
Wa fi fikir naas waahidiin,fiyah yoom waahid muhimm ziyaada min al-ayyaam al-aakhariin.Wa fi fikir naas aakhariin,kulla l-ayyaam sawa sawa.Khalli ayyi naadum yukuun mu'akkid min nafsah.
Al-naadum al-yikhassis yoom waahid yikhassisah fi chaan Allah.Wa l-naadum al-yaakul kulla nafar hana akil yaakulah fi chaan Allah wa yachkurah fi chaanah.Wa l-naadum al-yaakul illa l-khadaar yaaba ma yaakulah fi chaan Allah wa hu kula yachkurah.
Ma fi naadum minnina yi'iich fi chaan nafsah bas wa ma fi naadum minnina yumuut fi chaan nafsah bas.
Kan ni'iichu,ni'iichu fi chaan Rabbina wa kan numuutu,numuutu kula fi chaan Rabbina.Wa misil da,kan aniina hayyiin walla maytiin kula,aniina hana Rabbina.
Fi chaan da bas,al-Masiih maat wa ba'as achaan yabga Rabb al-hayyiin wa Rabb al-maytiin.
Wa inta,maala gaa'id tuluum akhuuk-?Wa inta,maala gaa'id tahgir akhuuk-?Ayyi waahid minnina yagiif giddaam kursi Allah fi yoom al-Hisaab.
Achaan da maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Allah gaal-:-Ana halaft be nafsi kadar kulla rukba tabruk giddaami wa ayyi lisaan yachhad kadar ana Allah.‍﴿
Wa be misil da fi yoom al-Hisaab,ayyi waahid minnina mas'uul giddaam Allah fi l-cheyy al-hu sawwaah.
Achaan da,khalliina ma nuluumu akhwaanna.Akheer nichiilu niiye achaan abadan ma nisawwu cheyy al-yiwaddi akhuuna le l-zanib,lahaddi yamurgah min al-derib.
Achaan al-Rabb Isa ma'aayi,ana mu'akkid kadar kulla nafar hana akil halaal fi zaatah.Laakin al-akil yabga haraam le l-naadum al-fi fikrah al-akil da haraam.
Kan al-akil al-taakulah yisabbib le akhuuk muchkila,inta ma maachi fi derib al-mahabba.Ma tikhalli aklak yisabbib halaak le akhuuk al-Isa al-Masiih maat fi chaanah.
Ya akhwaani,ma tikhallu al-cheyy al-adiil leeku yanti fursa le yuguulu foogku kalaam fasil.
Achaan al-muhimm fi mamlakat Allah ma al-akil wa l-charaab,laakin hu al-adaala wa l-salaam wa l-farha fi l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Al-naadum al-yitaabi' al-Masiih misil da,Allah yarda beyah wa l-naas kula yikarrumuuh.
Be misil da,khalli nijaahudu achaan nisawwu al-cheyy al-yisabbit al-salaam ambeenaatna wa l-yigawwiina kullina.
Ma titallif amal Allah be sabab al-akil.Sahiih,ayyi nafar hana akil halaal fi zaatah.Laakin ayyi akil al-taakulah al-yiwaddi akhuuk fi l-zanib,da haraam leek.
Kan ma taakul al-laham wa ma tachrab al-khamar wa kan taaba ayyi cheyy al-yiwaddi akhuuk fi l-zanib,khalaas misil da inta gaa'id tisawwi al-cheyy al-adiil.
Al-cheyy al-ti'aamin beyah fi l-kalaam da,khalli yabga beenak wa been Allah.Mabruuk le l-naadum al-gaa'id yisawwi al-cheyy al-nafsah tarda beyah wa ma yuluum nafsah be sababah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yichakkik fi galbah fi l-cheyy al-gaa'id yaakulah,Allah yuluumah achaan ma gaa'id yitaabi' iimaanah.Ayyi cheyy al-ma nisawwuuh be l-iimaan,hu zanib.
Laakin aniina al-gawiyiin fi l-iimaan,waajib nahmalo akhwaanna al-ma gawiyiin fi l-iimaan.Wa ma waajib nisawwu al-cheyy al-ya'ajibna aniina bas.
Khalli ayyi naadum minnina yisawwi al-cheyy al-ya'ajib akhuuh wa da,le kheerah wa le yigawwiih fi l-iimaan.
Achaan al-Masiih zaatah ma chaal al-derib al-ya'ajib nafsah,laakin maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Al-yi'ayyuruuk,mu'yaarhum waga' foogi ana kula.‍﴿
Kulla cheyy al-katabooh fi l-zaman al-faat ankatab le yi'allimna.Achaan be l-sabur wa l-chajaa'a al-allamnaahum min al-kutub,namchu giddaam be acham.
Allah yanti al-sabur wa l-chajaa'a wa khalli yantiiku kulluku fikir waahid le titaabu'u derib al-Masiih Isa
lahaddi kulluku timajjudu Allah abu Rabbina Isa al-Masiih be niiye waahide wa be hiss waahid.
Khalaas,akhbalo kulla mu'min be l-Masiih misil al-Masiih khibilaaku.Wa be misil da,timajjudu Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,nuguul leeku kadar al-Masiih bigi khaddaam le l-Yahuud achaan yiwassif kadar Allah saadikh wa yitimm al-cheyy al-waa'ad beyah juduudhum.
Wa ja achaan al-naas al-ma Yahuud kula yachkuru Allah fi chaan rahmatah.Maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Be sabab da,ya Allah,fi ust al-umam nachkurak wa be khine,namdah usmak.‍﴿
Wa battaan buguul-:﴾‍Ya l-umam,afraho ma'a cha'ab Allah.‍﴿
Wa battaan buguul-:﴾‍Ya kulla l-umam,ahmudu Allah-!Ya kulla l-chu'uub,majjuduuh-!‍﴿
Wa l-nabi Icha'ya gaal-:﴾‍Min zurriiyit Yassayaji naadum wa yabga malik fi kulla l-umam.Wa l-chu'uub al-aakhariin yukhuttu achamhum foogah.‍﴿
Wa Allah al-antaaku acham yantiiku al-farha wa l-salaam fi l-iimaan achaan achamku foogah yiziid be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Ya akhwaani,ana be nafsi mu'akkid kadar intu malaaniin be l-kheer wa be l-ilim wa gaadriin tilwaaso ambeenaatku.
Laakin fi achya waahidiin katabt leeku be kalaam gawi chiyya achaan dawwart nizakkirku beehum.Wa gidirt katabt misil da be sabab al-ni'ma al-Allah antaaha leyi
le nabga khaddaam le l-Masiih Isa.Wa khidimti hi ballikhiin bichaarat Allah le l-umam al-ma Yahuud.Ana nabga misil raajil diin wakit niballikh bichaarat Allah le l-umam al-ma Yahuud le yabgo misil dahiiye al-Allah yarda beeha.Wa l-dahiiye di tabga khaassa le Allah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa achaan da,nilfachchar be kulla l-khidme al-sawweetha le Allah be l-Masiih Isa.
Wa abadan ma nidoor nihajji be ayyi khidme illa l-khidme al-Isa al-Masiih sawwaaha beyi achaan al-umam yitii'u Allah.Hu khadam be kalaam wa be fi'il
wa be gudrat al-ajaayib wa l-alaamaat wa be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa misil da,ana ballakht bichaarat al-Masiih le l-naas fi kulli bakaan min Madiinat al-Khudus lahaddi balad Illirkuun.
Wa indi niiye daayman achaan niballikh al-bichaara fi ayyi bakaan al-lissaa' ma ballakho foogah usum al-Masiih.Ma nidoor nabni fi asaas al-khattaah naadum aakhar.
Nidoor nitaabi' al-kalaam al-maktuub al-buguul-:﴾‍Al-naas al-ma hajjoohum beyah yichiifuuh.Wa l-ma sim'o beyah yafhamooh.‍﴿
Wa iddat marraat,haawalt najiiku wa ma gidirt achaan khidimti di daharatni.
Laakin hassa' ma faddal leyi bakaan fi l-manaatig dool al-nibachchir foogah.Wa min siniin katiiriin,nidoor najiiku.
Wa khalaas,nagdar nakhchaaku wakit namchi Isbaaniya.In cha Allah,najiiku wa nagood ma'aaku ayyaam wa da yabga leyi halu.Wa ba'ad da,tisaa'uduuni achaan nisaafir giddaam.
Laakin hassa' da,ana maachi Madiinat al-Khudus achaan nisaa'id al-saalihiin.
Achaan al-mu'miniin al-fi Magiduuniya wa l-Yuunaan chaalo niiye ambeenaathum achaan yirassulu musaa'ada le l-masaakiin al-gaa'idiin ambeen al-saalihiin fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Wa chaalo al-niiye di be farah.Wa da misil deen fooghum achaan awwal al-Yahuud gassamo barakaathum al-ligoohum min Allah ma'a l-ma Yahuud.Wa hassa' al-ma Yahuud waajib leehum yisaa'udu al-Yahuud be l-barakaat al-ardiiye al-ligoohum.
Wa wakit al-khidme di tikammil wa ana anteethum kulla cheyy al-lammooh leehum,nichiil derib hana Isbaaniya wa nakhchaaku fi Rooma.
Wa na'arif kadar wakit nalhag bakaanku da,najiiku malaan be barakat al-Masiih al-khaassa leeku.
Wa hassa' ya akhwaani,natlub minku be usum Rabbina Isa al-Masiih wa be mahabbat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan intu tas'alo Allah ma'aayi be chidde.
As'alo leyi Allah achaan yafza'ni min al-Yahuud al-ma Masiihiyiin fi daar al-Yahuudiiya.Wa as'alo achaan al-saalihiin al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus yardo be l-musaa'ada al-nijiibha leehum.
Wa misil da,in cha Allah najiiku be farah wa ninjamma ma'aaku chiyya.
Allah Rabb al-salaam yukuun ma'aaku kulluku.Aamiin.
Nigaddim leeku akhutna Fiiba.Hi khaddaama fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Kankhiriiya.
Akhbalooha be usum al-Rabb wa dayyufuuha be l-diife al-waajbe le l-naas al-saalihiin.Saa'uduuha fi ayyi cheyy al-hi tidoorah minku achaan hi zaatha saa'adat naas katiiriin wa saa'adatni ana kula.
Wa sallumu Biriskiilawa Akiila al-khadamo ma'aayi sawa le l-Masiih Isa.
Wa humman dakhalo fi khutuura chadiide achaan yinajjuuni min al-moot.Wa kulla jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-gaa'idiin fi ust al-naas al-ma Yahuud gaa'idiin yachkuruuhum ma'aayi.
Wa sallumu jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-yilimmu fi beethum.Wa sallumu habiibi Abinaatus.Hu awwal naadum al-aaman be l-Masiih fi balad Aasiya.
Wa sallumu Mariyam al-khadamat leeku katiir.
Wa sallumu ahali Andaruuniki wa Yuuniya al-ga'adna sawa ma'aahum fi l-sijin.Kulla l-rusul ya'arfuuhum wa yikarrumuuhum.Humman mu'miniin be l-Masiih gubbaali ana.
Wa sallumu Amfilaawus,hu habiibi fi l-Rabb.
Wa sallumu Urbaan al-yakhdim misilna le l-Masiih wa habiibi Istakhi.
Wa sallumu Afaliis al-wassaf sabaatah fi l-Masiih.Wa sallumu al-akhwaan fi beet Aristubuul.
Wa sallumu akhuuyi Hiruudiyun.Wa sallumu naas Rabbina al-gaa'idiin fi beet Narkiis.
Wa sallumu al-akhwaat Tarfiina wa Tarfuusa al-yakhdiman katiir le l-Rabb.Wa sallumu akhti al-niriidha Farsiiya al-khadamat katiir bilheen le l-Rabb.
Wa sallumu Ruufus,hu al-azalah al-Rabb.Wa sallumu ammah.Hi bigat misil ammi.
Wa sallumu Sinkiraat wa Filikhuun wa Harmiis wa Batruub wa Harmaas wa kulla l-akhwaan al-ma'aahum.
Wa sallumu Filuluukh wa Juuliya wa Niiri wa akhtah wa Uluumba wa kulla l-saalihiin al-gaa'idiin ma'aahum.
Wa assaalamo ambeenaatku be salaam al-saalihiin.Kulla jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin be l-Masiih yisallumuuku.
Ya akhwaani,niwassiiku be cheyy waahid.Angar'u min al-naas al-yi'allumuuku be ta'liim chig min al-ta'liim al-simi'tuuh awwal.Al-naas dool yifarrugu al-mu'miniin be kalaamhum wa yitallufu iimaanhum.Kissu minhum ba'iid.
Al-naas al-misil dool ma yakhdumu le Rabbina al-Masiih laakin yakhdumu le butuunhum bas.Yihajju le l-naas be kalaam halu wa yachkuruuhum katiir achaan yukhuchchu al-naas al-induhum ilim chiyya bas.
Wa leeku intu,kulla l-naas ya'arfu intu simi'tu bichaarat al-Masiih wa taaba'tuuha.Wa fi chaanku,ana farhaan laakin nidoor intu tabgo faahimiin fi l-kheer wa bariyiin min al-charr.
Wa Allah Rabb al-salaam ma yi'akhkhir yarhak Ibliis tihit rijleeku.Aleekum rahmat Rabbina Isa.
Wa akhuuyi Timuutaawus al-yakhdim ma'aayi sawa yisallimku.Wa ahali Luukiyus wa Yaasuun wa Suubaatar kula yisallumuuku.
Wa ana Tartiiyus al-gaa'id naktib kalaam Buulus fi l-jawaab da,nisallimku be usum al-Rabb.
Wa Khaayus yisallimku.Hu siid al-beet al-ana muddayyif foogah.Wa beetah hu al-bakaan al-yilimmu foogah jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.Wa Rastus wakiil sanduug hana maal al-hille wa akhuuna Kawaartus yisallumuuku.
Aleeku kulluku ni'mat Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Aamiin.
Wa khalaas nachkuru Allah-!Achaan hu yagdar yigawwiiku fi l-iimaan be bichaarat al-Masiih al-nijiibha leeku wakit niballikh be Isa al-Masiih.Wa be l-bichaara di,Allah yi'arrif al-sirr al-mulabbad min al-zaman al-faat.
Wa laakin hassa' bayyanah khalaas be kutub al-anbiya le kulla l-umam al-ma Yahuud.Wa Allah al-Hayy ila l-abad anta al-amur da achaan kulla l-cha'ab yi'aamunu beyah wa yitaabu'u kalaamah.
Wa l-hamd waajib le Allah al-Waahid al-Hakiim,be usum Isa al-Masiih ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus al-Allah naadaani achaan nabga be iznah rasuul hana Isa al-Masiih.Wa daahu naktib leeku ma'a akhuuna Suustaan.
Wa nisallumuuku intu jamaa'at al-mu'miniin hana Allah al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Kuruntus,intu al-Allah khassasaaku be alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih Isa.Allah naadaaku fi derbah achaan tabgo khaassiin sawa ma'a kulla l-naas al-yad'u fi ayyi bakaan be usum Rabbina Isa al-Masiih wa hu Rabbuhum wa Rabbina.
Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma min Allah abuuna wa Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Nachkur Allah daayman fi chaanku wa fi chaan al-rahma al-hu antaaku be alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih Isa.
Wa be alaakhitku ma'aayah,Allah baarakaaku wa antaaku kulla cheyy wa antaaku kulla ma'rafat al-kalaam wa kulla l-ilim.
Wa misil da,Allah sabbat ambeenaatku chahaaditna al-chahadna beeha le l-Masiih.
Wa fi chaan da bas,ma fi ayyi baraka min barakaat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-gassarat leeku,intu al-gaa'idiin tarjo al-yoom al-Allah yibayyin foogah Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Al-Masiih yahfadku lahaddi fi l-aakhira.Achaan da,fi yoom jayyit Rabbina Isa al-Masiih,tukuunu bala eeb.
Allah hu saadikh fi wa'adah.Wa hu bas al-naadaaku achaan tadkhulu fi l-alaakha al-induku ma'a Ibnah Isa al-Masiih Rabbina.
Ya akhwaani,ana niwassiiku be usum Rabbina Isa al-Masiih achaan kalaamku yabga waahid lahaddi ma tingasmu.Wa khalli galibku yabga waahid wa fikirku yabga waahid.
Ya akhwaani,ana gult al-kalaam da achaan naas waahidiin min beet akhutku Khuluwa oorooni kadar intu gaa'idiin tilkhaalato ambeenaatku.
Wa ayyi naadum minku gaa'id yuguul-:-Ana naadum hana Buulus- aw -Ana hana Abuluus- aw -Ana hana Butrus- aw -Ana hana l-Masiih.
Haay-!Al-Masiih da waahid walla mugassam-?Buulus da maat fi l-saliib fi chaanku walla-?Wa khattasooku be usum Buulus walla-?Akiid,la-!
Wa ana ma khattast ayyi naadum minku illa Kiriisbus wa Khaayus.Wa achaan da,nuguul al-hamdulillah.
Wa be da,ma fi naadum al-yagdar yuguul hu khattasooh be usmi ana.
Aywa,ana khattast naas beet Istifaan kula.Laakin ma na'arif kan fi naadum aakhar ambeenaatku ana khattastah.
Wa l-Masiih rassalaani ma achaan nikhattis al-naas laakin achaan niballikh leehum bichaartah.Wa ma niballikhha misil al-ulama al-yiballukhu fikirhum be kalaam halu.Niballikh moot al-Masiih fi l-saliib achaan al-saliib kula indah gudra al-khaassa beyah.
Sahiih,al-naas al-muwaddiriin yuguulu kadar kalaamna fi l-saliib kalaam baatil.Laakin leena aniina al-Allah gaa'id yinajjiina,kalaam hana l-saliib indah gudrat Allah.
Wa fakkuru fi l-kalaam al-Allah gaalah fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Hikmat al-hukama niwaddirha wa fihim al-faahimiin yabga ma fiih.‍﴿
Wa hassa' da,ween al-hakiim-?Ween al-aalim-?Ween al-mutakallim al-yiriiduuh naas al-dunya-?Khalaas,Allah wassaf kadar hikmat naas al-dunya baatle.
Achaan Allah sawwa kulla cheyy hasab hikmatah wa laakin naas al-dunya ma a'tarafo beyah.Wa khalaas Allah chaal niiye achaan yinajji al-naas al-yi'aamunu beyah be tariig al-bichaara,hatta kan naas al-dunya yichiifuuh kalaam baatil kula.
Aywa,al-Yahuud yidooru yichiifu al-alaama al-tabga leehum daliil wa l-Yuunaaniyiin yifattuchu al-hagg be hikmat al-dunya
laakin aniina niballukhu le kulla l-naas be l-Masiih al-katalooh fi l-saliib.Wa l-kalaam da yiza''il al-Yahuud wa hu kalaam baatil le l-Yuunaaniyiin.
Laakin le kulla l-naas al-Allah naadaahum fi derbah,kan min al-Yahuud walla min al-Yuunaaniyiin kula,al-Masiih hu gudrat Allah wa hikmat Allah.
Wa l-naas yuguulu hikmat Allah baatle.Laakin hikmat Allah ziyaada marra waahid min hikmithum.Wa yuguulu gudrat Allah hi da'iife,laakin gudrat Allah ziyaada min gudrat al-naas.
Wa be kalaam aakhar,ya akhwaani,fakkuru fi haalitku hi kikkeef gubbaal Allah ma naadaaku fi derbah.Awwal da,naas chiyya minku induhum hikma wa chiyya minku induhum gudra wa chiyya minku iyaal kubaaraat.
Laakin al-naas al-juhhaal hasab naas al-dunya,humman dool bas Allah azalaahum achaan yijiib al-eeb fi l-hukama.Wa l-naas al-ma induhum gudra hasab naas al-dunya,humman dool Allah azalaahum achaan yijiib al-eeb fi l-gaadriin.
Aywa,Allah azal al-naas al-masaakiin wa l-mahguuriin wa l-ma induhum faayde hasab naas al-dunya,achaan yibattil faaydit al-naas al-yuguulu humman bas induhum faayde.
Wa khalaas,ma fi insaan indah hagg yisawwi nafsah kabiir giddaam Allah.
Wa Allah bas al-antaaku al-alaakha al-induku ma'a l-Masiih Isa.Wa be l-Masiih bas,nalgo hikmat Allah.Wa be l-Masiih bas,Allah ja'alaana saalihiin wa khassasaana wa fadaana.
Wa achaan da,khalli nitaabu'u al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Khalli naadum ma yisawwi nafsah kabiir.Akheer yuguul Allah bas kabiir.‍﴿
Ya akhwaani,wakit ana macheet leeku,ballakht leeku sirr Allah al-awwal al-naas ma irfooh.Laakin ma ballakhtah be kalaam sa'ab ziyaada wa ma hajjeet leeku misil aalim kabiir.
Wa chilt niiye achaan nikallim leeku misil ma na'arif cheyy illa Isa al-Masiih wa mootah fi l-saliib.
Wa ana faagid al-gudra wakit ana gaa'id ma'aaku wa khaayif bilheen.
Wa kallamt leeku be ta'liim hayyin wa ma jibtuku fi l-derib be kalaam al-yiraddiiku wa la be hikmat insaani wa laakin kallamt leeku be kalaam al-indah gudra al-jaayi min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa misil da,iimaanku ma yil'assas fi hikmat insaan laakin fi gudrat Allah.
Wa laakin kan aniina gaa'idiin ma'a mu'miniin kubaar fi l-iimaan,nikallumu leehum be hikma adiile.Wa l-hikma di ma tichaabih hikmat naas al-dunya wa la hikmat kubaaraat naas al-dunya al-laabudda yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa ni'arrufu al-naas be hikmat Allah al-hi sirr mulabbad al-ma irfooh.Wa gubbaal bidaayit al-dunya,Allah kharrar be l-hikma di yiwaddiina fi majdah.
Wa ma fi naadum min kubaaraat al-dunya di fihim hikmat Allah.Kan awwal fihmooha,ma yaktulu Rabbina al-majiid fi l-saliib.
Wa khalaas,da muwaafig ma'a l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Al-cheyy al-Allah jahhazah le l-naas al-yihibbuuh,ma chaafatah een wa la sim'atah adaan wa la fakkar foogah insaan.‍﴿
Laakin al-cheyy da,Allah wassafah leena be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Achaan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yichiif kulla cheyy wa ya'arif fikir Allah wa asraarah.
Akiid,al-naas ma ya'arfu afkaar naadum illa l-naadum zaatah ya'arif afkaarah.Wa misil da,ma fi naadum ya'arif afkaar Allah,illa Ruuh Allah ya'arif afkaar Allah.
Wa Allah antaana al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus da ma jaayi min al-dunya.Hu Ruuh Allah al-naazil leena achaan na'arfu al-rahma al-Allah antaaha leena.
Wa aniina nikallumu be l-barakaat dool le l-naas.Wa ma nihajju beehum be l-kalaam al-allamnaah min al-hikma al-insaaniiye.La.Nihajju be l-kalaam al-allamah leena al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa nifassuru ta'liim al-Ruuh al-Khudduus le l-naas al-induhum al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa l-insaani al-tabii'i ma yakhbal kalaam hana Ruuh Allah.Fi fikrah,kalaam al-Ruuh al-Khudduus baatil wa hu ma yafhamah.Achaan naadum ma yafhamah illa be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa l-naadum al-indah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,hu yihaasib kulla cheyy laakin ma fi naadum al-indah hagg yihaasibah.
Achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Yaatu irif afkaar Allah wa bigi leyah siid choortah-?‍﴿Wa laakin aniina fikirna wa fikir al-Masiih,waahid.
Ya akhwaani,wakit ana ma'aaku ma gidirt nihajji leeku misil intu naas al-induhum al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Laakin intu induku fikir hana naas al-dunya.Wa fi derib al-Masiih intu misil atfaal.
Achaan da bas,ana allamtuku be ta'liim hayyin misil ridaa'at al-laban wa ma be ta'liim gawi misil madikhiin al-asab achaan intu ma gidirtu takhbalo ta'liim gawi.Ya hassa',intu ma tagdaro.
Intu gaa'idiin titaabu'u fikir hana naas al-dunya wa ma fikir Allah.Intu gaa'idiin tilhaasado wa tihaaruju ambeenaatku.Wa be da,fikirku bigi fikir hana naas al-dunya wa haalku misil haal al-naas-!
Achaan naadum waahid buguul-:-Ana hana Buulus- wa naadum aakhar buguul-:-Ana hana Abuluus. Wa kan tihajju misil ke khalaas,intu misil naas al-dunya.
Wa Abuluus hu yaatu-?Wa ana Buulus kula yaatu-?Aniina khaddaamiin bas wa be sabab kalaamna intu aamantu.Ayyi waahid minnina sawwa al-khidme al-Rabbina kallafah beeha.
Intu misil jineene wa ana teerabt foogha kalaam Allah wa Abuluus zagaaha laakin Allah bas gawwam al-bizre.
Wa be da,al-yiteerib ma muhimm wa l-yazgi ma muhimm illa Allah al-yigawwim al-bizre bas muhimm.
Wa l-yiteerib wa l-yazgi humman sawa sawa wa ayyi waahid yalga ujurtah hasab khidimtah.
Wa khalaas,aniina akhwaan fi khidmit Allah wa intu bigiitu jineene hana Allah.Aw be masal aakhar,intu bigiitu al-beet al-Allah gaa'id yabniih.
Wa ana misil bannaay al-ya'arif khidimtah wa be l-rahma al-Allah antaani,ana khatteet asaas al-beet wa naadum aakhar ja bana foogah.Wa ayyi naadum al-yabni foogah waajib yukhutt baalah fi khidimtah.
Naadum ma yagdar yukhutt asaas aakhar min al-asaas al-gaa'id khalaas wa l-asaas da hu Isa al-Masiih.
Wa hassa' ayyi naadum yabni foog al-asaas da.Wa waahidiin yabnu foogah be dahab walla be fudda walla be hajar khaali wa waahidiin yabnu be hatab walla be gechch walla be ageeg.
Wa l-khidme al-ayyi naadum khadamha tin'arif achaan yoom al-Hisaab yiwassifha be naar.Wa l-naar tijarrib khidmit ayyi naadum kan adiile walla ma adiile.
Wa kan naadum bana foog al-asaas wa l-naar ma akalat khidimtah,al-naadum da yalga ajur.
Wa kan naadum bana foog al-asaas wa l-naar akalat khidimtah,khalaas khidimtah tala'at khasaara laakin hu zaatah yanja.Wa hu yanja misil naadum al-faza'ooh min ust al-naar.
Intu nisiitu walla-?Intu zaatku beet Allah.Ruuh Allah saakin foogku.
Kan naadum yidammir beet Allah,al-naadum da Allah yidammirah.Achaan beet Allah hu mukhaddas.Wa intu bas al-beet da.
Khalli naadum ma yukhuchch nafsah.Ayyi naadum minku al-yuguul hu indah hikma adiile wa hikmatah hi hikmat naas al-dunya,khalli yabga jaahil achaan yalga al-hikma al-sahiihe.
Achaan hikmat naas al-dunya baatle giddaam Allah.Wa maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Allah yarmi al-hakiimiin fi charak najaadithum.‍﴿
Wa maktuub battaan-:﴾‍Allah ya'arif kadar afkaar al-hakiimiin ma induhum faayde.‍﴿
Achaan da,ma tistakbaro fi ayyi insaan.Achaan kulla cheyy hanaaku.
Aywa,Buulus wa Abuluus wa Butrus kulluhum hineeku intu.Wa l-dunya wa l-haya wa l-moot wa l-wakit al-haali wa l-wakit al-jaayi,kulluhum hineeku.
Wa intu hana l-Masiih wa l-Masiih hu hana Allah.
Wa leyi ana wa akhwaani,waajib tahsubuuna khaddaamiin al-Masiih mas'uuliin min ballikhiin sirr Allah al-awwal al-naas ma irfooh.
Wa l-cheyy al-waajib le ayyi naadum al-mas'uul,hu al-sidikh.
Wa kan leyi ana,ma lammaani kan intu tihaasubu khidimti walla kan ayyi insaan yihaasibni.Ana kula ma nihaasib nafsi.
Galbi gaa'id yuguul ana ma indi eeb laakin da wiheedah ma yisabbit kadar ana bari.Al-gaa'id yihaasibni,hu Rabbina Isa.
Be misil da,ma tihaasubu khidmit ayyi naadum gubbaal yoom al-Hisaab.Fi l-yoom da,Rabbina yaji wa yibayyin kulla cheyy al-mulabbad fi l-dalaam wa yakchif niiyit al-naas al-gaa'ide fi guluubhum.Wa ayyi naadum yalga rida,ma min al-naas laakin min Allah.
Ya akhwaani,ana tabbagt kalaami da fi l-cheyy al-yukhussini ana wa Abuluus achaan intu talgo minnah faayde.Wa be da,nidoor intu ta'arfu ma'ana al-masal al-ma'ruuf al-buguul-:-Khalli naadum ma yamrug min derib al-Kitaab. Ma tistakbaro battaan fi l-naadum al-waahid wa tahguru al-aakhar.
Wa nuguul le ayyi waahid,yaatu al-sawwaak akheer min akhuuk-?Al-cheyy al-indak da,hu min Allah.Wa kan Allah bas antaah leek,maala tistakbar beyah misil inta ma ligiitah minnah hu-?
Wa khalaas,tifakkuru intu chab'aaniin wa bigiitu khaniyiin be l-iimaan wa khalleetuuna wara wa tifakkuru ga'adtu khalaas fi karaasiiku le tamulku.Nitmanna kadar intu tamulku be sahiih achaan nichaaruku ma'aaku fi l-muluk.
Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan fi fikri,Allah khattaana aniina rusul al-Masiih fi l-bakaan tihit marra waahid.Aniina bigiina misil masaajiin al-hakamo leehum be l-moot wa maragoohum giddaam kulla l-dunya wa kulla naasha wa kulla l-malaa'ika al-gaa'idiin yichiifu ta'abna.
Wa be sabab alaakhitna ma'a l-Masiih,al-naas hasaboona juhhaal.Wa laakin intu tuguulu intu aagliin be alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih.Intu tifakkuru kadar aniina da'iifiin wa intu gaadriin.Intu mukarramiin laakin aniina mahguuriin.
Ya hassa' aniina jii'aaniin wa atchaaniin.Ma indina khulgaan.Yudugguuna wa yaturduuna min ayyi bakaan.
Wa nakhdumu be duraa'na achaan ni'iichu.Wakit al-naas yi'ayyuruuna,aniina nibaarukuuhum.Wakit yita''ubuuna,aniina nasburu.
Wa wakit yihajju leena kalaam murr,aniina nuruddu leehum be nafas baarid.Wa aniina bigiina misil afana al-kulla naas yakrahooha wa misil wasakh al-yidaffuguuh barra.
Ana ma katabt al-kalaam da le ni'ayyibku.Laakin katabtah le nihazzirku achaan intu misil iyaali al-nihibbuku.
Akuun induku naas katiiriin al-yidooru yirabbuuku fi derib al-Masiih laakin ma induku abbahaat katiiriin.Aywa,ana wiheedi bigiit abuuku achaan ana ballakht leeku bichaarat al-Masiih wa beyi ana bas,intu dakhaltu fi alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih Isa.
Achaan da nichajji'ku.Taabu'u derbi ana.
Wa fi chaan da bas,ana rassalt leeku Timuutaawus al-bigi leyi wileedi mahbuub wa amiin fi l-Rabb.Hu yizakkirku be hayaati fi derib Isa al-Masiih wa di bas al-haya al-ni'allimha le ummat al-Masiih fi ayyi bakaan.
Waahidiin minku bigo mustakbiriin.Akuun fi fikirhum ana abadan ma namchi leeku.
Laakin kan Rabbina gaal aamiin,namchi leeku gariib.Wa fi l-yoom da,na'arif al-mustakbiriin dool.Ma nidoor nasma' kalaamhum.Nidoor nichiif gudrithum bas.
Achaan mamlakat Allah ma mabniiye be kalaam al-naas.La-!Hi mabniiye be gudrat Allah.
Wa tidooru chunu-?Tidooru najiiku be asa walla najiiku be mahabba wa nafas baarid-?
Simi't kalaam ajiib bilheen foogku.Yuguulu naadum minku gaa'id yisawwi zina al-naas al-ma mu'miniin kula ma yisawwuuh.Yuguulu naadum waahid gaa'id yazna marit abuuh.
Kikkeef bigiitu mustakbiriin-?Akheer tahzano hizin chadiid.Wa l-naadum al-sawwa al-zanib da,waajib taturduuh min usutku.
Wa kan leyi ana,sahiih ana gaa'id fi bakaan ba'iid minku laakin ana ma'aaku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa ana haakamt al-naadum da khalaas misil ana be nafsi gaa'id fi usutku.
Wa wakit intu laammiin be usum Rabbina Isa wa hasseetu kadar ana gaa'id ma'aaku be ruuhi wa gudrat Rabbina Isa ma'aaku,
waajib tisallumu al-naadum da le l-Cheetaan achaan tabii'tah al-insaaniiye tiddammar wa hu zaatah yanja fi yoom jayyit Rabbina Isa.
Sawweetu nufuusku kubaar wa da ma adiil.Hal nisiitu kadar tawwaara chiyya bas tigawwim kulla l-ajiin walla-?
Amurgu minku al-naadum al-gaa'id yaznib da,achaan tabgo battaan misil ajiin jadiid al-ma indah tawwaara.Wa aniina bigiina naas judaad achaan al-Masiih maat misil hamal al-dabahooh zamaan fi l-Fisha al-awwal.
Achaan da,khalliina nabgo misil al-naas al-yi'ayyudu iid al-Fisha al-baakulu al-khubza al-jadiide al-ma indaha tawwaara.Wa l-khubza al-gadiime al-indaha tawwaara tiwassif al-fasaala wa l-zunuub.Wa l-khubza al-jadiide al-ma indaha tawwaara tiwassif al-niiye al-mukhlisa wa l-hagg.
Wa fakkuru fi l-kalaam al-katabtah leeku fi jawaabi al-awwal.Ana gult angar'u min al-zannaayiin wa kissu minhum ba'iid.
Wa ma'ana al-kalaam da ma bukhuss al-naas al-zannaayiin al-ma mu'miniin wa la l-tammaa'iin wa la l-sarraagiin wa la aabidiin al-asnaam.Achaan ma tagdaro tikissu min al-naas dool illa kan tamurgu min al-dunya marra waahid.
La.Fi badalah,ana katabt leeku achaan tikissu min ayyi naadum al-buguul hu akhuuku mu'min wa laakin hu zannaay walla tammaa' walla aabid asnaam walla nammaam walla sakkaari walla sarraag.Aywa,al-naadum al-misil da ma taakulu ma'aayah kula.
Ana ma indi hagg nihaasib al-naas al-barra min ummat al-Masiih.Wa laakin akhwaanku al-mu'miniin al-fi usutku waajib intu tihaasubuuhum.
Al-naas al-barra dool,Allah yihaasibhum.Wa laakin kan leeku intu,maktuub-:﴾‍Aturdu al-chariir min usutku.‍﴿
Wa kan naadum minku mazluum fi akhuuh al-mu'min,maala yiwaddiih le l-muznibiin achaan yagta'o leyah al-charii'a-?Akheer kan yikhalli al-saalihiin yagta'o leyah al-charii'a wa yihaasubu al-zaalim.
Nisiitu kadar aniina al-saalihiin nihaakumu al-dunya walla-?Wa kan ba'adeen intu tihaakumu al-dunya,kikkeef ma tagdaro tihaakumu fi muchkila sakhayre kula-?
Nisiitu kadar aniina nihaakumu al-malaa'ika walla-?Wa kan misil da,akiid nagdaro nihaakumu fi machaakil akhwaanna fi l-dunya kula.
Wa kan induku machaakil ambeenaatku,maala tigaddumuuhum le l-naas al-ma muhimmiin fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin-?
Wa da eeb foogku.Ma fi naadum minku indah hikma achaan yahkim ambeenaat akhwaanah walla-?
Laakin intu gaa'idiin tikhallu al-mu'min yachki akhuuh giddaam al-hukkaam,hatta kan al-hukkaam dool ma mu'miniin kula.
Kan waddeetu akhuuku fi l-mahkama,intu fachaltu khalaas.Akheer takhbalo al-zulum wa tasburu foogah.Akheer tikhallu naadum yasrig minku.
Laakin be l-aks,intu zaatku gaa'idiin tazulmu akhwaanku wa tasurgu khumaamhum be khachch-!
Nisiitu kadar al-muznibiin ma yawrusu mamlakat Allah walla-?Ma tukhuchchu nufuusku.Kan naadum faasikh walla aabid asnaam walla zannaay walla chamrookha walla luuti
walla sarraag walla tammaa' walla sakkaari walla nammaam walla nahhaab ma indah warasa fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa naas waahidiin minku awwal gaa'idiin yisawwu al-zunuub dool.Laakin Allah khassalaaku wa sawwaaku khaassiin leyah wa ja'alaaku saalihiin be usum Rabbina Isa al-Masiih wa be gudrat Ruuh Allah Ilaahna.
Intu gultu-:-Kulla cheyy halaal leyi. Wa laakin ana nuguul ma kulla cheyy indah faayde.Aywa,intu gultu-:-Kulla cheyy halaal leyi. Wa laakin ana nuguul abadan ma nikhassid kadar ayyi cheyy yi'abbidni.

Hu fadaaku be taman khaali.Achaan da,khalli kulla cheyy al-tisawwu be jisimku yimajjid Allah.

Laakin muchkilat al-zina gaa'ide wa tidoor takrubku.Achaan da,akheer ayyi raajil indah martah halaalah wa ayyi mara indaha raajilha halaalha.
Waajib al-raajil al-maakhid yanti nafsah le martah wa l-mara al-maakhde tanti nafisha le raajilha.
Al-mara ma tagdar tisawwi misil tidoorah be jisimha achaan raajilha bas indah hagg foogah.Wa misil da,al-raajil kula ma yagdar yisawwi misil yidoorah be jismah achaan martah bas indaha hagg foogah.
Khalli al-raajil ma yaaba martah wa l-mara ma taaba raajilha.Laakin kan tidooru tiwaggufu al-alaakha al-jinsiiya ambeenaatku le mudda muhaddada,masalan wakit tinkarbu fi l-sala,awwalan ke astafugu foogah sawa.Wa wakit al-mudda di kammalat,limmu battaan.Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan kan ma tagdaro talzamo chahwaatku,akuun Ibliis yilizzuku fi l-zanib.
Al-waggafaan al-misil da,ma amartuku beyah laakin kan tidooru tisawwuuh,ma indah eeb.
Sahiih,fi fikri akheer kan kulli naadum yukuun misli ana al-ma maakhid.Laakin ayyi naadum indah al-atiiye al-Allah antaaha leyah.Wa le l-waahid,atiiye waahide wa le l-aakhar,atiiye chig.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-rujaal al-hassa' ma induhum awiin wa l-awiin al-araamil,nuguul akheer kan yagoodu bala akhiide misli ana.
Laakin kan ma yagdaro yalzamo chahwaathum,akheer yaakhudu.Kan yaakhudu,da akheer min al-chahwa taakulhum misil al-naar.
Wa kan le l-naas al-maakhdiin,nantiihum wasiiye.Wa l-wasiiye di ma minni ana laakin min Rabbina Isa.Waajib al-mara al-maakhde ma titallig raajilha.
Wa kan hi tallagatah,waajib tagood bala akhiide aw tigabbil raajilha.Wa khalli al-raajil al-maakhid ma yitallig martah.
Wa le l-aakhariin,indi wasiiye.Wa l-wasiiye di ma min Rabbina,hi minni ana.Kan ayyi mu'min indah mara ma mu'mine wa martah tikhassid tagood ma'aayah,ma waajib hu yitalligha.

Achaan al-raajil al-ma mu'min bigi khaass le Allah be sabab iimaan martah wa l-mara al-ma mu'mine bigat khaassa le Allah be sabab iimaan raajilha.Wa kan ma ke,iyaalhum yukuunu ma khaassiin le Allah.Wa laakin be l-sahiih,humman khaassiin le Allah.
Wa laakin kan al-naadum al-ma mu'min yidoor al-talaag,khalli yisawwiih.Kan sawwaah,al-mu'min kan raajil walla mara kula,ma marbuut.Laakin intu Allah naadaaku achaan ti'iichu be l-salaam.
Intu ma ta'arfu al-cheyy al-yabga.Ya l-mara,akuun raajilki yanja be sababki.Ya l-raajil,akuun martak tanja be sababak.
Daahu al-kalaam al-muhimm.Khalli ayyi mu'min yagood fi l-haala al-Rabbina ja'alaaha leyah.Wa di l-haala al-hu gaa'id foogha wakit Allah naadaah fi l-iimaan.Di bas al-wasiiye al-ni'allimha le ummat al-Masiih fi ayyi bakaan.
Masalan,kan naadum mutahhar gubbaal Allah ma naadaah fi derbah,khalli ma yisawwi cheyy le yibattil al-tahuura.Wa l-naadum al-ma mutahhar gubbaal Allah ma naadaah,khalli ma yitahhuruuh.
Kan naadum mutahhar walla ma mutahhar kula,da ma muhimm.Laakin al-muhimm,al-naadum yitaabi' wasaaya Allah.
Khalli ayyi naadum yagood fi l-haala al-hu gaa'id foogha gubbaal Allah ma naadaah.
Kan inta abid gubbaal Allah ma naadaak,ma tikhalli al-ubuudiiye tiza''ilak.Laakin kan yantuuk fursa tabga hurr,khassid tawwaali.
Wa ana gult leek ma taz'al achaan al-abid al-Allah naadaah fi derib Rabbina bigi khaddaam hurr hana Rabbina.Wa nafs al-cheyy le l-naadum al-awwal hurr gubbaal Allah ma naadaah,hu bigi abd al-Masiih.

Ya akhwaani,zibdit al-kalaam da,khalli ayyi naadum yagood fi l-haala al-gaa'id foogha wakit Allah naadaah wa khalli yagood foogha fi alaakha ma'a Allah.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-naas al-lissaa' ma akhado,ma indi wasiiye min Rabbina.Laakin Allah rahamaani wa ja'alaani naadum saadikh wa achaan da nuguul leeku fikri.
Hassa' haaliiyan intu gaa'idiin fi ta'ab chadiid.Achaan da,fi fikri akheer kan ayyi naadum ma yikhayyir haaltah.

Wa kan sabi yaakhud,da ma khata.Wa kan bineeye taakhud,da ma khata.Laakin fi l-dunya di,al-maakhdiin yat'abo ziyaada wa leeku intu nidoor ninajjiiku min al-ta'ab da.
Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan al-zaman al-aniina gaa'idiin foogah da,Allah haddadah.Wa min hassa' le giddaam,khalli al-raajil al-indah mara ma yinkarib ziyaada fi martah.

Wa gult al-kalaam da le faayditku.Ma nidoor nukhutt leeku huduud.Gult al-kalaam da achaan niwassifku kikkeef titaabu'u derib Rabbina be niiye waahide wa takhdumu leyah be galib waahid.

Wa l-mu'mine al-maakhde marbuuta ma'a raajilha lahaddi mootah.Wa kan raajilha maat,hi indaha hagg achaan taakhud ayyi naadum al-tiriidah kan hu kula yitaabi' derib Rabbina Isa.

Wa akiid,al-naas yuguulu fi ilaahaat fi l-samaawaat wa l-ard.Wa be l-sahiih,al-naas yuguulu fi ilaahaat wa arbaab katiiriin.
Wa laakin leena aniina al-mu'miniin,Allah waahid bas.Wa hu abuuna al-khalag kulla cheyy wa aniina nahyo leyah hu.Wa l-Rabb waahid bas wa hu Isa al-Masiih wa beyah hu kulla cheyy mawjuud wa beyah hu aniina hayyiin.
Laakin naas waahidiin ma karabo al-ilim da adiil.Wa akhwaan waahidiin fi aadithum gubbaal ma aamano,gaa'idiin ya'abudu al-asnaam.Wa fi fikirhum kan yaakulu al-laham da,yichaaruku battaan fi l-ibaada di.Wa kan akalo,yinnajjaso achaan iimaanhum lissaa' ma gawi.
Wa sahiih,al-akil ma yiziid leena rida Allah.Kan ma naakuluuh,ma nakhsaro cheyy giddaam Allah.Wa kan naakuluuh kamaan,ma nalgo minnah faayde giddaam Allah.

Wa be misil da,ujurti chunu-?Kan al-naas al-niballikh leehum al-bichaara ma yikaffu cheyy achaan ana abeet ma nichiil al-indi foogah hagg min ballikhiin al-bichaara,khalaas di bas ujurti.Wa ana farhaan bilheen.
Sahiih,ana hurr wa ana ma abid hana ayyi naadum.Laakin ana ja'alt nafsi misil abid hana kulla l-naas le nijiib naas ziyaada fi derib al-naja.
Kan ana gaa'id fi ust al-Yahuud,ana nitaabi' aadaat al-Yahuud le nijiibhum fi derib al-naja.Aywa,kan ana gaa'id ambeenaat al-naas al-yitaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat,ana kula nabga misil naadum yitaabi' churuut al-Tawraat.Wa be l-sahiih,ana ma tihit churuut al-Tawraat laakin nidoor nijiib al-naas al-gaa'idiin tihit churuut al-Tawraat fi derib al-naja.
Wa kan ana gaa'id ma'a l-naas al-ma Yahuud,ma'anaatah al-ma tihit churuut al-Tawraat,ana nisawwi nafsi misilhum humman al-ma gaa'idiin tihit churuut al-Tawraat le nijiibhum fi derib al-naja le l-naas al-ma tihit churuut al-Tawraat.Wa be l-sahiih,ana ma abeet churuut Allah achaan ana gaa'id nitaabi' churuut al-Masiih.
