Laakin kan naadum waahid yuguul leeku-:-Al-laham da hana l-dahiiye al-gaddamooha le l-asnaam-,fi l-bakaan da bas,ma taakuluuh.Fakkuru fi l-naadum al-ooraaku beyah wa fi l-chakak al-hu indah fi chaan al-laham da.
Ana ma nuguul intu induku chakak laakin al-naadum al-ooraaku,hu bas indah chakak.Ana ma nihaddid al-hurriiye al-indi fi chaan chakak hana naadum aakhar.
Ana chakart Allah fi chaan al-akil al-naakulah wa khalaas,ma nidoor naas yuguulu kalaam fasil foogi achaan al-akil al-chakart Allah fi chaanah.
Wa khalaas,fi kulli cheyy al-taakuluuh wa tacharbooh wa tisawwuuh,majjudu Allah.Majjuduuh fi kulli cheyy.
Ma tabgo sabab le ayyi naadum le tamurguuh min al-derib,wa la le l-Yahuud wa la le l-Yuunaaniyiin wa la le naas Allah ummat al-Masiih.
Sawwu misli ana.Ana nidoor daayman nisawwi al-cheyy al-kulla l-naas yardo beyah.Wa ma nifattich al-cheyy al-yijiib leyi ana bas faayde laakin nifattich al-cheyy al-yijiib faayde le kulla l-naas achaan nidoor humman yanjo.
Taabu'u derbi achaan ana gaa'id nitaabi' derib al-Masiih.
Wa ana farhaan minku achaan intu gaa'idiin tifakkuru foogi wa titaabu'u adiil al-aadaat al-allamtuhum leeku.
Wa laakin fi cheyy nidoor intu tafhamooh wa da hu.Ra'iis hana ayyi raajil,hu al-Masiih wa ra'iis al-mara,hu al-raajil wa ra'iis al-Masiih,hu Allah.
Wa ayyi raajil al-yikhatti raasah wakit yisalli walla yitnabba',hu yijiib eeb fi l-Masiih al-hu ra'iisah.
Wa ayyi mara al-ma tikhatti raasha wakit tisalli walla titnabba',hi tijiib eeb fi raajilha al-hu ra'iisha.Wa be da,misil zayyano suuf raasha.
Wa kan mara taaba ma tikhatti raasha,khalli tuguss cha'arha.Wa laakin kan gassiin al-cha'ar wa zayyiniin al-raas da eeb le l-mara,khalaas khalli hi tikhatti raasha.
Wa ma waajib le l-raajil yikhatti raasah achaan Allah khalagah fi suurtah le yiwassif majdah.Laakin al-mara tiwassif charaf al-raajil.
Achaan al-raajil ma maragooh min al-mara laakin al-mara maragooha min al-raajil.
Wa Allah ma khalag al-raajil fi chaan al-mara laakin khalag al-mara fi chaan al-raajil.
Wa be sabab al-malaa'ika,waajib le l-mara tukhutt cheyy fi raasha al-yiwassif kadar hi indaha al-sulta.
Wa da kulla sahiih laakin fi nizaam Rabbina.Bala l-raajil,al-mara ma fiiha.Wa bala l-mara,al-raajil ma fiih.
Achaan awwal,al-mara maragooha min al-raajil wa hassa',ayyi raajil mawluud min mara wa kulli cheyy jaayi min Allah.
Wa leeku intu,nuguul fakkuru adiil wa mayyuzu al-kalaam da.Kan mara tisalli le Allah wa raasha ma mukhatta,da muwaafig walla-?
Wa na'arfu min al-tabii'a kadar al-cha'ar al-tuwaal eeb le l-raajil.
Wa laakin kan mara indaha cha'ar tuwaal,da sameh wa da charafha.Wa Allah antaaha cha'ar tuwaal achaan yabga leeha khattaay.
Wa kan ayyi naadum yidoor yinaakhich fi l-kalaam da,khalli ya'arif aniina ma nikhassudu be l-aade al-hu yidoorha wa battaan naas Allah ummat al-Masiih ma yikhassudu beeha fi ayyi bakaan.
Wa laakin fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-kalaam al-hassa' nihajji foogah,ana ma farhaan beeku marra waahid achaan wakit tilimmu fi malammat al-mu'miniin,al-fasaala katiire min al-kheer.
Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan al-khabar al-simi'tah foogku.Awwal cheyy,yuguulu wakit tilimmu fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin,intu mungasimiin.Wa fi fikri,al-kalaam da ma kulla ke kidib.
Aywa,laabudda intu mungasimiin achaan kan al-khilaaf ambeenaatku ma fiih,kikkeef al-naas al-iimaanhum saabit yin'arfu-?
Wa wakit tilimmu sawa,al-acha al-taakuluuh da,ma acha Rabbina.
Achaan fi wakit al-acha,waahidiin yaakulu ajala gubbaal al-aakhariin.Wa be da,al-aakhariin dool jii'aaniin wa l-awwalaaniyiin akalo wa sikro khalaas.
Wa da kikkeef-?Ma taakulu wa tacharbo fi buyuutku walla-?Aw tahguru jamaa'at al-mu'miniin hana Allah wa tidooru ti'ayyubu al-naas al-ma induhum cheyy-?Wa nuguul leeku chunu-?Wa be da,nachkurku walla-?La,abadan.
Asma'o,da bas al-kalaam al-ligiitah min Rabbina wa allamtuku leyah.Fi l-leele al-yukhuunu foogha Rabbina Isa,hu chaal khubza waahide
wa chakar Allah wa kasarha wa gaal-:-Da jismi al-nantiih fi chaanku.Sawwu misil da le tizzakkarooni beyah.
Wa ba'ad al-acha,hu sawwa nafs al-cheyy be l-kaas.Hu chaalah wa gaal-:-Al-kaas da yiwassif al-mu'aahada al-jadiide al-nisawwiiha ma'aaku be dammi.Ayyi wakit al-tacharbo minnah,sawwu misil da le tizakkuruuni beyah.
Wa be da,fi ayyi wakit kan taakulu al-khubza di wa tacharbo min al-kaas da,tiballukhu moot Rabbina Isa lahaddi hu yaji battaan.
Wa achaan da battaan,ayyi naadum al-yaakul khubzat Rabbina wa yachrab min kaasah wa niiytah ma mukhlisa,hu yudurr jisim Rabbina wa dammah.
Khalli ayyi naadum yijarrib nafsah gubbaal ma yaakul al-khubza wa yachrab min al-kaas.
Achaan ayyi naadum al-yaakul wa yachrab acha al-Masiih bala fikir fi jisim al-Masiih,hu yijiib al-azaab fi nafsah.
Wa achaan da bas,katiiriin minku ayyaaniin wa mardaaniin wa waahidiin maato kula.
Wa kan awwal nifakkuru fi nufuusna adiil,khalaas al-azaab ma yanzil foogna.
Wa laakin Rabbina yihaasibna wa yi'addibna achaan al-azaab al-yanzil fi naas al-dunya ma yanzil foogna.
Achaan da,ya akhwaani,wakit tilimmu achaan taakulu acha al-Masiih,khalli ayyi naadum yarja akhwaanah.
Kan naadum jii'aan wa ma yagdar yarja al-aakhariin,akheer yaakul gubbaal fi beetah.Wa be da,malammitku ma tijiib al-azaab foogku.Wa khalaas,fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-su'aalaat al-aakhariin,nantiiku wasaaya wakit najiiku.
Ya akhwaani,fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss barakaat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,nidoor intu tafhamo adiil.
Ta'arfu kadar awwal intu ma mu'miniin,khachchooku wa waddooku lahaddi abadtu al-asnaam al-ma yuguulu cheyy.
Achaan da,nidoor intu tafhamo adiil kadar al-naadum al-yihajji be gudrat Ruuh Allah abadan ma yuguul-:-Isa mal'uun. Wa laakin illa be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus bas,naadum yagdar yuguul-:-Isa hu al-Rabb-.
Khalaas,al-ataaya al-Allah yantiihum chig chig laakin al-Ruuh al-Khudduus waahid.
Wa l-khidme al-nakhdumuuha chig chig laakin Rabbina waahid.
Wa l-amal al-nisawwuuh chig chig laakin Allah al-Waahid bas yantiina al-gudra achaan ayyi naadum yisawwi ayyi cheyy.
Wa Allah yinazzil le ayyi naadum atiiye min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan kullina nalgo minha faayde.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus yanti gudra le naadum waahid achaan yikallim be hikma wa yanti gudra le naadum aakhar achaan yikallim be ilim.Wa da be nafs al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yanti le naadum waahid iimaan gawi marra waahid wa yanti le naadum aakhar atiiye hana gudra al-yidaawi beeha al-mardaaniin.Wa da kula be nafs al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus yanti gudra le naadum waahid achaan yisawwi ajaayib wa le naadum aakhar kalaam naazil min Allah.Wa yanti gudra le naadum waahid achaan yimayyiz gudrat Ibliis min gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa le naadum aakhar yantiih lukhkhaat chig chig al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa le naadum aakhar gudra achaan yifassir al-lukhkhaat dool.
Wa nafs al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-waahid,hu bas al-yijiib kulla l-ataaya dool wa yigassimhum le ayyi naadum misil hu yidoorah.
Wa ta'arfu kadar jisim al-insaan hu waahid wa battaan al-jisim da indah a'da katiiriin.Wa a'da al-jisim katiiriin laakin humman jisim waahid bas.Wa ummat al-Masiih kula misil al-jisim da.
Achaan khattasoona kullina be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-waahid le nabgo jisim waahid wa da jisim al-Masiih.Wa sawwa nafs al-cheyy leena kullina kan aniina Yahuud aw ma Yahuud,wa kan aniina abiid aw hurriin.Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus bigi leena misil al-charaab al-waahid al-kullina ke chiribna minnah.
Achaan al-jisim abadan ma udu waahid bas.Hu a'da katiiriin.
Masalan,al-rijil udu min al-jisim.Wa kan hi tuguul-:-Ana ma iid wa achaan da,ana ma udu min al-jisim-,al-kalaam da ma yamrugha min al-jisim.
Wa kan al-adaan tuguul-:-Ana ma een wa achaan da,ana ma udu min al-jisim-,al-kalaam da ma yamrugha min al-jisim.
Wa battaan kan kulla l-jisim bigi een,kikkeef yasma'-?Wa kan kulla l-jisim bigi adaan,kikkeef yuchumm-?
Laakin Allah nazzam kulla l-a'da fi l-jisim achaan ayyi udu gaa'id fi l-bakaan al-hu dawwarah.
Kan kulla l-jisim bigi udu waahid,ween al-jisim-?
Wa khalaas,al-a'da katiiriin wa battaan humman jisim waahid.
Wa ma waajib al-een tuguul le l-iid-:-Ana ma nidoorki. Wa ma waajib al-raas yuguul le l-rijileen-:-Ana ma nidoorku.
La,da ma yabga achaan a'da waahidiin al-gaa'idiin fi lubb al-jisim,humman da'iifiin marra waahid.Wa laakin na'arfu kadar balaahum al-jisim ma yanfa'.
Wa nantu lubaas le l-a'da al-ma nikarrumuuhum wa misil da,nicharrufuuhum ziyaada min al-a'da al-aakhariin.Wa l-a'da al-ma waajib yinchaafo be sabab al-eeb,nirayyusuuhum be ikraam ziyaada.
Wa l-rayyisiin da,ma waajib le a'daa'na al-yinchaafo.Wa Allah nazzam al-jisim wa hu anta ikraam ziyaada le l-udu al-indah eeb.
Wa be da,a'da al-jisim ma yinfargu abadan wa ayyi udu waajib yirayyis kulla akhwaanah be niiye waahide.
Wa kan waahid minhum ta'baan,kulluhum ta'baaniin sawa.Wa kan waahid yalga charaf,kulluhum farhaaniin sawa.
Wa khalaas,intu kulluku jisim al-Masiih wa ayyi naadum udu minnah.
Wa Allah nazzam jamaa'at al-mu'miniin wa ja'al leehum khaddaamiin.Awwal ke al-rusul wa taani al-anbiya wa taalit al-mu'allimiin.Wa battaan hu anta atiiye hana gudra achaan naas waahidiin yisawwu ajaayib wa yidaawu al-mardaaniin wa yisaa'udu akhwaanhum wa yuguuduuhum wa yihajju lukhkhaat chig chig al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Kulla l-mu'miniin rusul walla-?Kulluhum anbiya walla-?Kulluhum mu'allimiin walla-?Kulluhum yisawwu ajaayib walla-?
Kulluhum induhum atiiye hana gudra achaan yidaawu al-mardaaniin walla-?Kulluhum yikallumu be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus walla-?Kulluhum yifassuru al-lukhkhaat dool-?Akiid la-!
Atmanno be niiye waahide achaan talgo al-ataaya al-kubaar hana l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa awwal ke,niwassifku al-derib al-adiil marra waahid.
Kan nikallim be lukhkhaat al-naas wa be lukhkhaat al-malaa'ika wa ma indi al-mahabba,kalaami ma indah faayde.Be da kalaami bigi misil daggiin al-nahaas walla baki al-jaras.
Wa kan nitnabba' be kalaam jaayi min Allah wa nafham kulla l-asraar wa kulli cheyy hana ilim wa kan indi iimaan gawi marra waahid lahaddi nihawwil al-jibaal min bakaanaathum kula wa kan ma indi al-mahabba,ana ma cheyy.
Wa kan nanti kulli cheyy al-indi le l-masaakiin lahaddi nisallim jismi achaan nistakbarwa laakin ma indi al-mahabba,ma nalga cheyy.
Al-naadum al-indah mahabba sabuur wa zeen.Al-indah mahabba ma hasuud.Al-indah mahabba ma fachchaar wa ma mustakbir.
Hu ma yisawwi cheyy hana eeb.Hu ma yifakkir fi nafsah bas.Wa ma yaz'al ajala.Hu ma yifakkir fi l-khata al-akhwaanah sawwooh.
Hu abadan ma yafrah be l-zulum laakin yafrah daayman be l-hagg.
Al-indah mahabba,hu yahmal ayyi cheyy.Hu yi'aamin fi kulli haal wa achamah saabit fi kulli haal wa hu yasbur fi ayyi cheyy.
Al-mahabba abadan ma tikammil.Al-tanabbu yikammil.Wa l-lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yabgo ma fiihum.Wa l-ilim yikammil.
Achaan al-ilim al-indina,muhaddad.Wa l-tanabbu al-nihajju beyah,muhaddad.
Laakin wakit kulli cheyy yabga tamaam,al-cheyy al-ma tamaam yikammil.
Masalan,wakit ana wileed sakhayyar ana hajjeet hije hana iyaal dugaag wa fikri kula hana iyaal dugaag wa agli kula hana iyaal dugaag.Wa laakin wakit ana kibirt khalaas wa bigiit raajil,khalleet minni al-iyaaliiye.
Achaan hassa' fi zamanna da,nichiifu al-hagg misil nichiifuuh fi amchawwaafa al-waskhaane wa fi l-aakhira,nichiifuuh adiil.Hassa' da,ana irift chiyya wa ba'adeen na'arif adiil misil Allah irifni.
Wa khalaas al-talaata al-yagoodu daayman,humman al-iimaan wa l-acham wa l-mahabba.Wa l-akbar minhum hu al-mahabba.
Achaan da,ankarbu fi l-mahabba wa battaan atmanno be niiye waahide achaan talgo barakaat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa min al-barakaat dool,atmanno ziyaada achaan titnabba'o.
Achaan kan naadum yikallim be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,hu yihajji le Allah wa ma yihajji le l-naas achaan ma fi naadum yafham kalaamah.Hu gaa'id yihajji be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus kalaam ma ma'ruuf.
Laakin kan naadum yitnabba',hu yihajji le l-naas wa yigawwi iimaanhum wa yichajji'hum wa yisabbirhum.
Al-yikallim be lukhkhaat yigawwi nafsah bas laakin al-yitnabba' yigawwi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.
Wa ana nidoor kulluku tihajju be lukhkhaat laakin nidoor ziyaada kadar titnabba'o.Al-yitnabba' le l-naas akheer min al-yikallim be lukhkhaat.Achaan al-yikallim be lukhkhaat ma yigawwi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin illa kan naadum waahid yifassir kalaamah leehum.
Ya akhwaani,kan najiiku wa nikallim leeku kalaam be lukhkhaat,ma talgo faayde min kalaami.Laakin talgo faayde muhimme kan nikallim leeku be l-ru'ya al-chiftaha aw kalaam al-ilim aw kalaam al-tanabbu aw kalaam al-ta'liim.
Chiilu masal hana aalaat al-musiikha misil al-suffaara aw al-jigindiiye.Nidooru soothum yabga waadih.Wa kan ma waadih,al-musiikha ma tin'arif.
Kan al-burunji ma yinaadi al-askar be hiss waadih,yaatu al-yijahhiz nafsah le l-harib-?
Wa leeku intu kula nafs al-cheyy.Kan lisaanku ma yihajji be kalaam waadih,kikkeef ayyi naadum yafham al-kalaam al-tuguuluuh-?Kalaamku macha fi l-riih saakit.
Fiyah lukhkhaat katiiriin fi l-dunya wa ayyi waahide tinfahim.
Laakin kan naadum yihajji leyi be lukhkha al-ma na'arifha,ana ma nafham kalaamah.Nabga misil ajnabi le l-naadum al-yihajji beeha wa hu ajnabi leyi ana.
Wa leeku intu kula nafs al-cheyy.Intu munkaribiin fi gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus ambeenaatku wa da adiil.Laakin ankarbu ziyaada fi l-barakaat al-yigawwu jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.
Achaan da,waajib ayyi naadum al-yikallim be lukhkhaat yas'al Allah yantiih gudra achaan yifassir kalaamah.
Kan nisalli be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,galbi yisalli laakin agli ma yisawwi cheyy.
Wa waajib nisawwi chunu-?Khalaas,nisalli be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh wa kula be kalaam jaayi min agli.Nachkur Allah be khine be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh wa nachkurah be khine jaayi min agli kula.
Wa kan inta tachkur Allah be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh,al-naadum al-ma yafham kalaamak da,yabga leek misil ajnabi.Hu ma yafham al-kalaam al-inta tuguulah wa achaan da,ma yagdar yuguul-:-Aamiin.
Akuun chakart Allah adiil laakin akhuuk da,inta ma gawweet iimaanah.
Wa l-hamdulillah,ana zaati nihajji be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus ziyaada minku kulluku.
Laakin fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin,kan ni'allim al-naas be 5 kalimaat min lukhkha al-tinfahim,da akheer min nikallim be lukhkhaat 10-000 kalimaat al-ma yinfahmu.
Ya akhwaani,khalli fikirku ma yabga misil fikir hana l-iyaal al-dugaag.Khalli ayyi naadum yabga bari misil al-tifil fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-charr.Laakin khalli fikirku yabga fikir hana l-naadum al-aagil.
Wa maktuub fi Kitaab Allah-:﴾‍Be kalaam ma mafhuum wa be lisaan ma ma'ruuf,nihajji le l-cha'ab da.Laakin be da kula,humman ma yidooru yasma'ooni.Wa da kalaam Allah.‍﴿
Wa be misil da,kalaam be lukhkhaat ma yabga alaama le l-mu'miniin laakin le l-ma mu'miniin.Wa l-tanabbu ma yabga alaama le l-ma mu'miniin wa laakin le l-mu'miniin.
Masalan,kan kulluku taju fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin wa gaa'idiin tihajju be lukhkhaat wakit diifaan aw naas ma mu'miniin yindasso foogku,humman yuguulu intu muchootiniin.
Laakin kan kulluku gaa'idiin titnabba'o wa naadum ma mu'min aw deef yindassa fi l-bakaan da,kalaamku yindassa foogah wa hu yilmaskan giddaam Allah.
Wa l-zunuub al-labbadaahum fi galbah yinkachfu wa achaan da,ajala ke yasjud wa ya'abud Allah.Wa yachhad wa yuguul-:-Be l-sahiih,Allah gaa'id fi usutku.
Wa be misil da,ya akhwaani,chunu al-waajib-?Wakit tilimmu,khalli ayyi naadum yijiib al-cheyy al-indah.Naadum waahid indah khine wa naadum aakhar indah ta'liim wa aakhar indah al-cheyy al-Allah wassafah leyah fi ru'ya wa aakhar indah kalaam be lukhkhaat wa l-aakhar indah tafsiir al-kalaam da.Wa khalaas,kulla cheyy al-tisawwuuh waajib yigawwi al-akhwaan.
Kan naas yikallumu be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,khalli itneen walla talaata bas yikallumu,waahid ba'ad waahid.Wa khalli naadum yifassir kalaamhum.
Wa laakin kan ma fi naadum al-yagdar yifassir kalaamhum,khalli yagoodu saakit ma yikallumu le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.Khalliihum yihajju le Allah be hiss tihit bas.
Wa khalli itneen walla talaata naas yitnabba'o wa khalli al-aakhariin yimayyuzu kalaamhum.
Wa kan naadum aakhar gaa'id yasma' wa kalaam Allah yanzil leyah,khalli al-naadum al-gaa'id yikallim yaskut.
Achaan kulluku induku fursa titnabba'o waahid ba'ad waahid.Wa misil da,kulluku til'allamo wa talgo chajaa'a.
Wa l-naadum al-yitnabba' indah gudra fi l-kalaam al-yuguulah
achaan Allah ma yarda be l-barjaal.Hu yarda be l-salaam.Wa misil gaa'id yabga fi kulla jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-saalihiin,
waajib al-awiin yaskutan.Ma indihin izin yihajjan.Misil maktuub fi l-Tawraat,waajib yabgan daluulaat.
Wa kan indihin su'aal fi l-ta'liim,khalli yas'alan rujaalhin fi buyuuthin.Kan mara tihajji fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin,da eeb marra waahid.
Wa kikkeef-?Fi fikirku ballikhiin kalaam Allah awwal bada fi usutku walla-?Aw intu wiheedku bas simi'tu kalaam Allah walla-?
Kan naadum yuguul hu nabi walla naadum hana l-Ruuh al-Khudduus,khalli ya'arif kadar al-kalaam al-gaa'id naktibah leeku da amur min Rabbina.
Wa kan ayyi naadum yaaba al-kalaam da,Rabbina kula yaabaah.
Ya akhwaani,di bas zibdit al-kalaam.Atmanno be niiye waahide achaan titnabba'o wa ma tadharo al-naas ma yikallumu be lukhkhaat al-yaju min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa sawwu kulla cheyy fi jamaa'at al-mu'miniin be adab wa nizaam.
Ya akhwaani,nidoor nizakkirku be bichaarat al-Masiih al-ballakhtaha leeku.Al-bichaara di,intu khibiltuuha wa be sababha bas,intu mu'miniin.
Wa be l-bichaara di,tanjo kan takurbu gawi al-kalaam al-ballakhtah leeku.Wa kan ma takurbuuh,iimaanku da baatil.
Wa daahu al-kalaam al-muhimm gubbaal kulla cheyy al-ana allamtah leeku wa ana kula allamooni leyah.Al-Masiih maat fi chaan zunuubna misil maktuub fi l-Kitaab.
Wa hu dafanooh wa Allah ba'asah fi l-yoom al-taalit misil maktuub fi l-Kitaab.
Wa hu baan le Butrus wa ba'ad da,baan le l-rusul al-atnaachar.
Wa yoom aakhar,hu baan fi bakaan waahid le ziyaada min 500 mu'miniin.Wa l-naas dool waahidiin minhum maato laakin katiiriin minhum lissaa'hum hayyiin.
Wa ba'ad da,baan le Yaakhuub wa le kulla l-rusul.
Wa ba'ad al-Masiih baan le kulla l-naas dool,fi l-akhiir baan leyi ana al-misil sakhiir al-wildooh fi wakit ma waktah.
Wa min kulla l-rusul,ana bas sakhayyar marra waahid lahaddi ma waajib yinaaduuni rasuul kula achaan awwal ana ta''abt naas Allah ummat al-Masiih.
Laakin hassa',ana rasuul be rahmat Allah wa rahmatah ma fachalat.Be l-aks,ana khadamt khidme ziyaada minhum kulluhum.Wa be l-sahiih,al-khadam adiil ma ana laakin rahmat Allah al-gaa'ide foogi.
Wa kan simi'tu al-bichaara minni ana aw min al-rusul al-aakhariin,ma fi farig.Kullina niballukhu nafs al-kalaam wa khalaas,be sababah intu aamantu.
Wa kan kullina niballukhu kadar Allah ba'as al-Masiih min ust al-maytiin,kikkeef waahidiin minku yuguulu al-maytiin ma yab'aso-?
Kan bu'aas al-maytiin ma yabga,al-Masiih kula ma ba'as.
Wa kan al-Masiih ma ba'as,ballakhna kalaam ma indah faayde wa iimaanku baatil.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,aniina gaa'idiin nakdubu fi Allah achaan chahadna gulna Allah ba'as al-Masiih.Wa da ma yabga sahiih kan al-maytiin ma yab'aso.
Achaan kan al-maytiin ma yab'aso,khalaas al-Masiih kula ma ba'as.
Wa kan al-Masiih ma ba'as,iimaanku baatil wa intu gaa'idiin be zunuubku.
Wa be da,al-mu'miniin be l-Masiih al-maato waddaro saakit.
Wa kan khatteena achamna fi l-Masiih fi wakit hayaatna fi l-dunya di bas,nabgo chagyaaniin marra waahid min kulla l-naas.
Laakin be l-sahiih,al-Masiih ba'as min ust al-maytiin.Wa be da,hu yadman kadar al-maytiin yab'aso.
Wa misil al-moot ja fi l-naas be sabab naadum waahid,al-bu'aas kula ja be sabab naadum waahid.
Kulla Bani Adam yumuutu wa kulla naas al-Masiih yab'aso.
Laakin ayyi naadum yab'as hasab nizaam Allah.Awwal,al-bikir ba'as wa hu al-Masiih.Wa ba'adeen fi yoom jaytah,kulla naas hana l-Masiih yab'aso.
Wa da bas al-wakit al-akhiir.Al-Masiih yidammir gudrat ayyi ra'iis wa sultaan wa haakim wa khalaas yisallim al-mamlaka le abuuh Allah.
Wa laabudda al-Masiih yamluk lahaddi Allah yukhutt kulla udwaanah tihit rijileenah.
Wa l-adu al-aakhir al-yidammirah,hu al-moot.
Achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Allah khatta kulla cheyy tihit rijileenah.‍﴿Wa na'arfu kadar Allah ma khatta nafsah tihit rijileen al-Masiih,achaan Allah bas khatta tihit al-Masiih kulla cheyy.
Wa wakit kulla cheyy yukuun tihit rijileen Ibn Allah,khalaas fi l-wakit da,Ibn Allah zaatah yukhutt nafsah tihit Allah al-khatta tihtah kulla cheyy.Wa khalaas,Allah wiheedah bas yabga foog kulla cheyy.
Wa kan bu'aas ma fiih,al-naas al-yikhattusuuhum fi chaan akhwaanhum al-maytiin,humman gaa'idiin yisawwu chunu-?Kan al-maytiin abadan ma yab'aso,maala naas waahidiin yikhattusuuhum fi chaan akhwaanhum al-maytiin-?
Wa aniina kamaan,maala gaa'idiin fi l-khutuura ayyi wakit-?
Ya akhwaani al-be sababku raasi foog giddaam al-Masiih Isa Rabbina,nachhad kadar kulla yoom ana gaa'id fi ust al-moot.
Hini fi hillit Afasus ana ti'ibt marra waahid misil naadum gaa'id yidaawis al-haywaanaat al-khatiiriin.Wa kan bu'aas ma fiih,ween al-faayde le l-insaan min al-ta'ab al-misil da-?Kan misil da,akheer nitaabu'u kalaam hana muznibiin al-zamaan al-gaalo-:﴾‍Khalli naakulu wa nacharbo achaan ambaakir,khalaas numuutu-!‍﴿
Ma tukhuchchu nufuusku.Haal al-saalihiin tatlaf fi ust al-muznibiin.
Gabbulu fi l-derib al-adiil al-ta'arfuuh wa khallu minku al-zunuub.Gult al-kalaam da achaan naas waahidiin minku ma ya'arfu Allah.Wa da eeb leeku.
Wa laakin akuun naadum yas'al wa yuguul-:-Al-maytiin yab'aso kikkeef-?Be nafar jisim al-weenu-?
Inta al-jaahil-!Al-teeraab al-titeeribah fi l-ard ma yugumm hayy illa kan awwal dafantah misil cheyy mayyit.
Wa l-teeraab al-tadfinah da,hu ma al-nabaat al-kaamil al-yugumm minnah ba'adeen.La-!Hu habba yaabse bas,kan hana gameh walla nabaat aakhar.
Laakin le ayyi teeraab,Allah yantiih al-jisim al-hu ja'alah leyah wa yanti le ayyi nafar hana teeraab al-jisim al-waajib leyah.
Achaan kulla l-makhluugiin al-hayyiin ma sawa wa lahamhum ma waahid.Laham waahid hana naas wa laham aakhar hana haywaanaat wa fi aakhar hana tuyuur wa aakhar hana huut.
Wa fiyah ajsaam samaawiyiin wa ajsaam ardiyiin.Wa l-jisim al-samaawi indah jamaal haggah wa l-jisim al-ardi indah jamaal chig.
Wa l-harraay indaha jamaal wa jamaalha chig min jamaal al-gamar wa jamaal al-nujuum.Wa ayyi najma jamaalha chig min al-nujuum al-aakhariin.
Wa bu'aas al-maytiin kula yabga misil da.Al-jisim al-yadfunuuh fi l-ard yatlaf laakin al-jisim al-ba'as abadan ma yatlaf.
Wa l-jisim al-yadfunuuh,hu misil cheyy mazguul laakin wakit yab'as,indah charaf.Wa l-jisim al-yadfunuuh ma indah gudra wa laakin wakit yab'as,indah gudra katiire.
Wa l-yadfunuuh,hu jisim tabii'i wa l-yab'as hu jisim hana l-ruuh.Wa akiid kan jisim tabii'i gaa'id,jisim hana l-ruuh kula gaa'id.
Wa achaan da,misil maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Adam al-insaan al-awwal bigi hayy.‍﴿Wa Adam al-akhiir hu al-Masiih wa hu bigi insaan hana l-ruuh al-yanti al-haya.
Wa l-insaan hana l-ruuh ma ja awwal.Al-insaan al-tabii'i hu al-ja awwal wa ba'adeen,ja al-insaan hana l-ruuh.
Wa l-insaan al-awwal,hu hana l-ard wa hana l-turaab.Wa l-insaan al-taani,hu hana l-sama.
Wa Adam hu insaan hana l-turaab wa Bani Adam humman kula naas hana l-turaab mislah hu.Wa l-Masiih hu insaan hana l-sama wa naas hana l-Masiih kula naas hana l-sama mislah hu.
Wa misil awwal suuritna tichaabih suurat al-insaan hana l-turaab,ba'adeen suuritna tichaabih suurat al-insaan hana l-sama.
Ya akhwaani,asma'o kalaami.Ayyi jisim al-indah damm wa laham ma yawris mamlakat Allah.Wa l-yatlaf abadan ma yawris al-ma yatlaf.
Asma'o wa ni'ooriiku be sirr waahid al-Allah wassafah leena.Ma kullina numuutu laakin akiid kullina nilkhayyaro.
Wa da yabga ajala,misil ramchit een.Wa yabga fi daribiin al-burunji al-akhiir.Achaan hiss al-burunji yinsami' wa l-maytiin yab'aso be l-jisim al-ma yatlaf wa kullina ke nilkhayyaro.
Achaan al-jisim al-yatlaf da waajib yalbas al-jisim al-abadan ma yatlaf.Wa l-jisim al-yumuut waajib yalbas al-ma yumuut.
Wa wakit al-yatlaf libis al-ma yatlaf wa l-yumuut libis al-ma yumuut,fi l-bakaan da bas,al-kalaam al-maktuub yitimm-:﴾‍Khalaas,al-moot addammar wa l-nasur tamma ila l-abad.‍﴿
﴾‍Ya l-moot,ween nasrak-?Ya l-moot,ween gudurtak-?‍﴿
Wa l-moot indah gudra foogna be sabab al-zunuub.Wa l-zunuub induhum gudra foogna be sabab churuut al-Tawraat.
Al-hamdulillah-!Allah antaana al-nasur be Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,fakkuru fi kulla l-kalaam da wa agoodu saabtiin wa gawiyiin.Ankarbu daayman fi khidmit Rabbina achaan ta'arfu kadar al-khidme al-takhdumuuha le Rabbina abadan ma baatle.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-musaa'ada al-tirassuluuha le l-saalihiin al-fi daar al-Yahuudiiya,waajib titaabu'u nafs al-wasiiye al-anteetha le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-fi balad Khalaatiya.
Kulli yoom al-ahad,khalli ayyi naadum minku yifakkir fi kikkeef Allah razakhah wa yamrug cheyy min maalah le l-musaa'ada.Khalli yukhuttah jaahiz lahaddi najiiku.Wa be misil da,wakit ana naji ma waajib tugummu tutchukku.
A'azulu min ambeenaatku al-akhwaan al-tidooru yiwaddu musaa'adatku.Wa wakit najiiku,nirassilhum be makaatiib hana chahaada fi Madiinat al-Khudus.Wa khalaas humman yiwaddu al-musaa'ada al-anteetuuha.
Wa fi l-bakaan da kan bigi leyi,ana kula nisaafir wa humman yiraafuguuni.
Wa wakit nuchugg balad Magiduuniya,khalaas namchi leeku ziyaara achaan awwal ke nufuut be Magiduuniya.
Wa akuun nagood ma'aaku ayyaam,akuun tuul al-chite kula.Wa fi l-akhiir,tagdaro tantuuni zaad le l-safar wakit na'arif al-bakaan al-namchi leyah.
Achaan ma nidoor nugumm hassa' wa nakhchaaku bas laakin kan Rabbina gaal aamiin,nitawwil chiyya ma'aaku.
Wa nagood hini fi hillit Afasus lahaddi iid al-Khamsiin
achaan Allah fatah leyi al-derib wa be da,indi fursa nisawwi khidme adiile bilheen.Wa l-yikhaalufuuni kula katiiriin.
Wa wakit Timuutaawus yajiiku,akurbuuh gawi wa khalli yagood ma'aaku be l-salaam achaan hu gaa'id yakhdim khidmit Allah misli ana.
Achaan da,ma tikhallu ayyi naadum yahgirah.Antuuh zaad wa khallu yaji leyi be l-salaama achaan ana gaa'id narjaah,hu wa l-akhwaan al-ma'aayah.
Wa akhuuna Abuluus al-gaa'id hini,ana chajja'tah achaan yamchi leeku ma'a l-akhwaan.Laakin haaliiyan da,ma yidoor yamchi.Akiid hu yamchi leeku wakit indah fursa.
Agoodu waa'iyiin wa saabtiin fi l-iimaan.Abgo chajii'iin wa gawiyiin.
Sawwu kulla cheyy be mahabba.
Ya akhwaani,ta'arfu naas beet Istifaan wa ta'arfu kadar fi balad Akhaaya,humman awwal naas al-aamano be l-Masiih wa munkaribiin fi l-khidme fi chaan al-saalihiin.Wa niwassiiku
achaan tasma'o adiil kalaam hana l-naas al-misilhum wa hana ayyi naadum al-yakhdim ma'aahum be niiye waahide.
Wa ana firiht bilheen be jayyit akhwaanku Istifaan wa Furtuuna wa Akhaayik achaan ana garmaan leeku wa humman jo fi gadduku.
Wa barrado galbi misil barrado guluubku intu kula.Karrumu al-naas al-misil dool.
Wa jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-fi balad Aasiya yisallumuuku.Wa Akiila wa Biriskiila wa l-mu'miniin al-yilimmu fi beethum yisallumuuku katiir fi Rabbina al-Masiih.
Wa l-akhwaan kulluhum yisallumuuku.Assaalamo ambeenaatku be salaam al-saalihiin.
Wa khalaas,ana zaati chilt al-galam wa katabt be iidi-:-Ana Buulus nisallimku.
Kan ayyi naadum ma yihibb Rabbina Isa,khalli Allah yal'anah.Ya Rabbina,ta'aal-!
Wa aleekum rahmat Rabbina Isa.
Mahabbiti leeku kulluku fi l-Masiih Isa.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus rasuul Isa al-Masiih be izin Allah.Wa daahu naktib leeku ma'a akhuuna Timuutaawus.Wa aniina nisallumuuku intu jamaa'at al-mu'miniin hana Allah al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Kuruntus wa le kulla l-saalihiin al-gaa'idiin fi ayyi bakaan fi balad Akhaaya.
Khalli nachkuru Allah abu Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Hu abuuna al-rahiim wa kulla l-chajaa'a jaaye minnah hu.
Wa Allah yichajji'na fi kulli diige achaan aniina kula be l-chajaa'a di nichajju'u al-aakhariin al-gaa'idiin fi ayyi diige.
Wa sahiih,aniina gaa'idiin nichaaruku katiir fi ta'ab al-Masiih wa laakin be alaakhitna ma'aayah,kula nalgo chajaa'a ziyaada.
Kan aniina gaa'idiin fi l-diige,da bigi achaan intu talgo al-chajaa'a wa l-naja.Wa kan Allah antaana al-chajaa'a,da bigi achaan intu kula talgo al-chajaa'a wa tagdaro tahmalo al-ta'ab be sabur misilna.
Achamna foogku gawi bilheen achaan na'arfu kadar tichaaruku fi l-chajaa'a misil awwal gaa'idiin tichaaruku ma'aana fi l-ta'ab.
Ya akhwaani,nidooru ni'arrufuuku be l-diige al-jaat foogna fi balad Aasiya.Wa l-diige di chadiide bilheen wa faatat gudritna lahaddi gulna mutna khalaas.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,bigiina misil naas al-hakamo leehum be l-moot.Wa da bigi achaan ma nintaklu ale nufuusna laakin nintaklu ale Allah al-yab'as al-maytiin.
Wa akiid Allah al-faza'na min al-moot da,hu yafza'na battaan.Khatteena achamna foogah hu bas wa akiid hu yafza'na battaan.
Wa intu kula waajib ti'aawunuuna be du'aaku.Wa Allah yakhbal du'aaku al-katiir wa be sabab du'aaku da,hu yibaarikna wa khalaas naas katiiriin yachkuru Allah fi chaanna.
Wa aniina farhaaniin achaan guluubna gaa'idiin yi'akkudu leena kadar ichna ma'a kulla naas al-dunya wa khaassatan ma'aaku intu be galib abyad wa be niiye mukhlisa al-Allah yarda beehum.Ma ichna hasab fikir naas al-dunya laakin ichna be rahmat Allah.
Wa abadan ma naktubu leeku illa l-kalaam al-waadih al-tagdaro tagruuh wa tawwaali tafhamooh.Wa ana nitmanna kadar tafhamo niiyitna tamaam.
Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan intu lissaa'ku ma fihimtu niiyitna tamaam.Wa kan fihimtu niiyitna,khalaas fi yoom jayyit Rabbina Isa,intu tifaachuru beena misil aniina nifaachuru beeku.
Wa akiid,achami foogku bigi gawi.Wa achaan da,dawwart namchi leeku tawwaali wa nuzuurku wa talgo rahma marrateen.
Wa dawwart nakhchaaku awwal marra wakit ana maachi le Magiduuniya wa battaan wakit ana mugabbil minha.Wa dawwart tisaa'uduuni fi safari le daar al-Yahuudiiya.
Wa kan dawwart namchi leeku misil da,hal tuguulu ana chilt niiye bala fikir walla-?Hal tuguulu ana nichiil niiye misil naas al-dunya al-buguulu -aywa- wa -la- fi nafs al-wakit-?
Allah saadikh-!Kalaamna leeku abadan ma yabga -aywa- wa -la- fi nafs al-wakit.
Achaan Ibn Allah Isa al-Masiih al-ana wa akhwaani Siila wa Timuutaawus ballakhnaaku beyah,abadan ma yikhalbit -aywa- wa -la-.Kalaamah daayman,aywa.
Achaan kulla cheyy al-Allah waa'ad beyah,hu tammaah fi l-Masiih.Wa be l-Masiih,Allah yuguul -aywa-.Wa be sabab da,nuguulu aamiin be usmah wa nimajjudu Allah.
Wa Allah bas sabbataana ma'aaku fi alaakha ma'a l-Masiih.Wa hu bas al-darrajaana le khidimtah.
Wa hu khatta foogna khitmah wa nazzal fi guluubna al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan yabga al-damaan al-yiwassifna kadar Allah yisawwi kulli cheyy al-waa'ad beyah.
Wa Allah chaahid leyi kadar kalaami ma kidib.Ana ma dawwart yabga leeku gaasi.Wa achaan da bas,ana ma macheet battaan fi Kuruntus.
Wa ma na'asuruuku fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss iimaanku achaan na'arfu kadar intu saabtiin fi l-iimaan.Laakin,akheer leena nakhdumu ma'aaku achaan farhitku tiziid.
Wa ana chilt niiye achaan ma nuzuurku battaan le nisabbib leeku hizin.
Achaan kan ana bigiit leeku sabab hana hizin,yaatu al-yifarrihni balaaku-?Illa intu al-ana sabbabt leeku al-hizin.
Wa l-kalaam al-katabtah yoom daak fi l-jawaab,katabtah achaan wakit najiiku,intu al-naas al-waajib yifarruhuuni ma tabgo leyi sabab hana hizin.Achaan ana mu'akkid kadar kan ana nabga farhaan,intu kula tabgo farhaaniin.
Wa katabtah leeku be galib haznaan chadiid wa mudayyig wa ana gaa'id nabki katiir.Wa ma dawwart nisabbib leeku hizin laakin dawwart niwassif kadar indi mahabba chadiide leeku.
Ana ma nidoor nikabbir al-kalaam.Wa l-naadum ma sabbab al-muchkila di leyi ana bas laakin hu sabbabha leeku intu kulluku.
Katiiriin minku harajooh wa khalaas,da yakfi leyah.
Wa hassa' da,waajib tisaamuhuuh wa tichajju'uuh achaan al-hizin ma yifachchilah marra waahid.
Achaan da,niwassiiku battaan wassufu leyah mahabbitku.
Wa awwal kula,ana katabt leeku jawaab achaan nijarribku wa achaan na'arif kan titaabu'u kalaam Allah fi kulli cheyy.
Wa ayyi naadum al-intu tisaamuhuuh,ana kula nisaamihah.Wa ayyi khata al-ana saamahtah le ayyi naadum,kan sahiih khata fi wa waajib leyah al-musaamaha,ana saamahtah fi chaanku giddaam al-Masiih.
Wa saamahtah achaan Ibliis ma yinnasir foogna.Achaan aniina na'arfu niiyit Ibliis.
Wa macheet fi hillit Turuwaas achaan niballikh bichaarat al-Masiih.Wa wakit wisilt,Rabbina fatah leyi al-baab achaan nibachchir.
Laakin galbi mu'allag bilheen achaan akhuuyi Tiitus al-waajib yaji giddaami min bakaanku,ana ma chiftah.Wa achaan da bas,gammeet min al-akhwaan al-fi Turuwaas wa macheet le Magiduuniya.
Wa l-hamdulillah-!Allah gaa'id daayman yuguudna fi majmuu'a al-tafrah be l-nasur hana l-Masiih.Wa fi ayyi bakaan,hu yiwazzi' beena irfit Allah al-misil riihe haluuwe.
Wa aniina misil al-bakhuur al-gaa'id yigaddimah al-Masiih le Allah.Wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin yanjo yuchummu riihtah wa l-naas al-gaa'idiin yahlako kula yuchummu riihtah.
Wa le l-naas al-yahlako,hi riihit al-moot al-tiwaddiihum le l-moot.Wa le l-naas al-yanjo,hi riihit al-haya al-tiwaddiihum fi l-haya.Wa ma fi insaan yagdar le l-khidme al-misil di.
Naas katiiriin gaa'idiin yikhalbutu kalaam Allah wa yitaajuru beyah wa aniina ma misilhum.Aniina nikallumu be niiye mukhlisa.Aniina naas al-Masiih wa Allah rassalaana wa giddaam Allah nikallumu le l-naas.
Akuun tuguulu aniina badeena battaan nachkuru nufuusna.La,ma ke.Akiid naas waahidiin waajib leehum jawaab al-yachhad leehum,kan jawaab leeku aw jawaab minku.Wa laakin da ma waajib leena aniina.
Intu bas jawaabna.Intu maktuubiin fi guluubna.Wa kulla l-naas ya'arfuuh wa yagruuh.
Aywa,intu bas jawaab al-Masiih wa hu rassalah be waasitatna wa da waadih le ayyi naadum.Wa l-jawaab da ma maktuub be galam laakin be Ruuh Allah al-Hayy.Wa hu ma maktuub fi looh hana hajar laakin maktuub fi guluub al-naas.
Wa gulna al-kalaam da achaan achamna fi Allah gawi be l-Masiih.
Aniina be nufuusna ma indina al-gudra al-waajbe le nisawwu al-khidme di.Nagdaro nisawwu al-khidme di illa kan Allah antaana al-gudra al-waajbe.
Aywa,hu antaana al-gudra le nabgo khaddaamiin wa nakhdumu le Allah fi l-mu'aahada al-jadiide.Wa l-mu'aahada al-jadiide di ma hana churuut maktuubiin wa laakin hana Ruuh Allah.Achaan mu'aahadat al-churuut al-maktuubiin tijiib al-moot wa laakin Ruuh Allah yijiib al-haya.
Churuut al-Tawraat kataboohum fi liihaan hana hajar wa nuur Allah al-majiid baan wakit hu nazzalaahum.Wa l-nuur al-majiid da chadiid lahaddi Bani Israa'iil ma gidro yichiifu al-nuur al-gaa'id fi wijih Muusa.Wa l-nuur da ma tawwal.Wa kan kalaam Allah al-hakam al-naas be l-moot da nazal be nuur majiid,
akiid kalaam Allah al-yanti leena al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yaji be nuur majiid ziyaada.
Na'arfu kadar khidmit al-mu'aahada al-ja'alat al-naas khaatiyiin giddaam Allah,indaha nuur majiid.Wa misil da,na'arfu kadar khidmit al-mu'aahada al-taj'al al-naas saalihiin indaha nuur majiid ziyaada marra waahid.
Wa sahiih,awwal fi nuur majiid wa haaliiyan ja nuur majiid aakhar ziyaada minnah wa waddarah.
Wa kan al-cheyy al-ma tawwal ja be nuur majiid,akiid al-yagood ila l-abad yaji be nuur chadiid ziyaada minnah.
Wa be misil da,indina acham gawi wa achaan da nakhdumu be chajaa'a chadiide.
Aniina ma nisawwu misil Muusa.Hu khatta wijhah be mindiil achaan Bani Israa'iil ma yichiifu al-nuur al-gaa'id yufuut.
Laakin humman dool fikirhum antamas.Wa lahaddi l-yoom kan yagru leehum churuut al-Tawraat al-hi al-mu'aahada al-gadiime,khalaas nafs al-mindiil gaa'id yikhatti fikirhum wa ma yikhalliihum yafhamo al-kalaam adiil.Wa l-mindiil da ma yinrafi' minhum illa kan yi'aamunu be l-Masiih.
Aywa,lahaddi l-yoom kan kalaam Muusa yagruuh leehum,al-mindiil gaa'id yikhatti guluubhum.
Laakin kan naadum yichiil derib al-Rabb,al-mindiil yinrafi' wa hu yafham adiil.
Wa fi l-kalaam da,al-Rabb hu al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa ayyi bakaan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus hana l-Rabb gaa'id foogah,al-hurriiye kula gaa'ide foogah.
Wa aniina ma indina mindiil al-yikhatti wujuuhna.Wa kullina gaa'idiin nichiifu nuur Allah al-majiid.Wa l-nuur da yibiin foogna waadih.Wa l-nuur al-majiid da yaji min Ruuh Allah al-gaa'id yikhayyirna ziyaada lahaddi suuritna tabga misil suurat Allah al-majiide.
Wa khalaas,Allah bas rahamna be l-khidme di wa achaan da,abadan ma naksalo minha.
Wa aniina abeena ma taaba'na al-haal al-tijiib al-eeb wa la l-zunuub al-yisawwuuhum al-naas be achiir.Naabo ma nisawwu cheyy be najaada wa abadan ma nibaddulu kalaam Allah.La.Laakin giddaam Allah nikallumu al-hagg be kalaam waadih wa nikhallu galib hana ayyi naadum yachhad le haalna al-adiile.
Wa kan al-bichaara al-niballukhuuha ma tinfahim,hi ma tinfahim illa le l-naas al-muwaddiriin bas.
Al-naas al-ma mu'miniin dool guluubhum amyaaniin achaan Ibliis indah sulta fi l-dunya di wa hu amaahum.Hu yidoor yadharhum ma yichiifu al-nuur al-majiid hana l-Masiih al-niballukhu beyah al-bichaara.Al-Masiih hu suurat Allah.
Wa l-kalaam al-niballukhuuh ma bukhuss nufuusna.Laakin niballukhu be Isa al-Masiih wa nuguulu hu bas al-Rabb.Wa aniina khaddaamiin bas wa nakhdumu leeku fi chaanah.
Wa zamaan Allah gaal-:-Khalli al-nuur yidawwi fi ust al-dalaam. Wa hu bas al-nawwar guluubna achaan na'arfu nuur Allah al-majiid al-gaa'id fi wijih Isa al-Masiih.
Wa l-baraka al-indina di misil dahab saafi al-gaa'id fi maa'uun hana tiine.Wa da yiwassif kadar al-gudra al-ajiibe al-nakhdumu beeha,hi min Allah bas wa ma minnina aniina.
Aniina yidaayuguuna fi ayyi bakaan laakin ma yiwaggufuuna.Wa aniina mutahayyiriin laakin ma waddarna al-acham.
Wa l-naas yita''ubuuna laakin Allah ma yikhalliina.Yarmuuna laakin ma yidammuruuna.
Al-Masiih ti'ib wa maat.Wa fi ayyi bakaan,aniina kula nat'abo mislah achaan hayaat Isa tinchaaf fi jisimna.
Aniina hayyiin wa laakin daayman yisallumuuna le l-moot fi chaan khidmitna le Isa.Wa da yabga leena achaan hayaat Isa tinchaaf fi jisimna al-yumuut.
Wa khalaas,aniina ni'iichu fi ust al-moot achaan intu talgo al-haya al-abadiiye.
Maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Ana aamant wa achaan da kallamt.‍﴿Wa aniina kula indina iimaan misil al-iimaan da.Aniina mu'miniin wa achaan da nikallumu.
Wa na'arfu kadar Allah al-ba'as Rabbina Isa min ust al-maytiin yab'asna aniina kula ma'a Isa wa yiwaddiina ma'aaku fi hadaratah.
Wa kulla khidmitna di le faayditku.Wa nakhdumu achaan rahmat Allah talhag kulla l-naas wa humman yachkuru Allah ziyaada wa kulluhum yimajjuduuh.
Achaan da abadan ma naksalo.Sahiih,jisimna gaa'id yumuut wa laakin al-haya al-jadiide gaa'ide tiziid fi guluubna kulli yoom.
Wa l-ta'ab al-indina hassa' da,hu khafiif wa ma yitawwil.Laakin al-ta'ab da yijahhizna le l-majd al-aziim al-abadan ma yikammil.
Wa ma nukhuttu baalna fi cheyy al-binchaaf.Nukhuttu baalna fi cheyy al-ma binchaaf.Achaan al-binchaaf yikammil wa laakin al-ma binchaaf yagood ila l-abad.
Wa l-jisim al-indina wakit gaa'idiin fi l-ard,hu misil kheema bas.Wa na'arfu kadar wakit jisimna da yumuut,indina jisim aakhar al-gaa'id fi l-samaawaat.Wa l-jisim da misil beet gawi al-Allah bas banaah.Wa yagood ila l-abad wa ma misil beet al-banooh al-naas.
Wa haaliiyan da,aniina gaa'idiin naguntu achaan garmaaniin bilheen le beetna al-samaawi al-Allah yantiih leena le ni'iichu foogah.
Wa misil da,kan libisna al-jisim al-jadiid da,battaan ma nabgo aryaaniin bala jisim.
Wa wakit aniina gaa'idiin fi l-kheema al-ardiiye di,naguntu min al-himil al-tagiil.Wa daahu al-cheyy al-nidooruuh wa hu,ma nabgo aryaaniin min al-jisim al-ardi laakin nidooru nalbaso al-jisim al-jadiid.Wa fi l-bakaan da,al-haya al-abadiiye di taakul marra waahid al-jisim al-yumuut.
Allah zaatah jahhazaana le l-haya di wa hu nazzal foogna al-Ruuh al-Khudduus achaan yabga al-alaama al-tiwassif kadar Allah yisawwi kulla cheyy al-jahhazah leena.
Wa achaan da,achamna daayman gawi.Sahiih na'arfu kadar wakit aniina saakniin fi l-jisim al-ardi,aniina lissaa' ma saakniin fi beetna al-sahiih al-gaa'id ma'a Rabbina al-Masiih.
Laakin ni'iichu hasab al-cheyy al-aniina mu'miniin beyah wa ma hasab al-nichiifuuh be eenna.
Aywa,achamna gawi wa akheer leena nikhallu al-jisim al-ardi da achaan naskunu ma'a Rabbina.
Wa khalaas,ziyaada min kulla cheyy aakhar,nidooru nisawwu al-cheyy al-yarda beyah Rabbina,kan aniina naskunu fi l-jisim al-ardi walla nikhalluuh.
Achaan laabudda ayyi waahid minnina yagiif giddaam kursi mahkamat al-Masiih.Wa fi l-bakaan da,ayyi naadum yalga al-cheyy al-waajib leyah hasab al-amal al-sawwaah wakit hu aayich be jismah al-ardi,kan amalah hana kheer aw hana charr.
Wa na'arfu al-khoof min Rabbina wa achaan da,nidooru nijiibu al-naas fi l-derib.Allah ya'arif haalna marra waahid wa nitmanna kadar intu kula ta'arfuuha fi guluubku.
Wa battaan ma nidooru nifaachuru.Aniina nidooru nantuuku fursa achaan tihajju beena raasku marfuu' wa turuddu le l-naas al-gaa'idiin yarfa'o ruuseehum be l-cheyy al-binchaaf bas wa ma be l-cheyy al-gaa'id fi l-galib.
Kan sahiih agulna laffa,da fi chaan Allah.Wa kan agulna aafe,da le faayditku.
Wa mahabbat al-Masiih leena tajburna achaan aniina mu'akkidiin kadar hu al-waahid al-maat fi chaan kulla l-naas wa beyah hu bas,kulluhum maato.
Wa hu maat le kulla l-naas achaan al-naas al-hayyiin ma yi'iichu battaan le nufuushum laakin yi'iichu le l-Masiih al-maat wa ba'as fi chaanhum.
Achaan da,min al-yoom le giddaam ma nifakkuru fi ayyi naadum misil al-naas yifakkuru foogah.Awwal aniina fakkarna fi l-Masiih misil al-naas.Laakin abadan ma nifakkuru foogah battaan misil da.
Wa kan ayyi naadum indah alaakha ma'a l-Masiih,hu bigi khaliige jadiide.Hayaatah al-gadiime faatat wa hayaatah al-jadiide badat khalaas.
Wa da kulla ke,jaayi min Allah.Hu bas sawwa al-suluh ma'aana be l-Masiih.Wa l-khidme al-Allah kallafaana beeha,hi ballikhiin khabar al-suluh.
Wa ma'anaatah Allah sawwa al-suluh be waasitat al-Masiih.Wa hu chaal niiye achaan ma yihaasib naas al-dunya hasab khataayaahum.Wa kallafaana be ballikhiin bichaarat al-suluh.
Wa be misil da,ana wa akhwaani bigiina sufara le l-Masiih wa Allah gaa'id yinaadiiku be lisaanna.Wa khalaas,natulbu minku be usum al-Masiih,assaalaho ma'a Allah.
Wa l-Masiih al-abadan ma aznab,Allah ja'alah dahiiye fi chaan zunuubna achaan aniina nabgo beyah cha'ab Allah al-saalihiin.
Wa khalaas,aniina nakhdumu ma'a Allah wa achaan da niwassuuku.Akiid khibiltu rahmat Allah wa hassa' da,akurbuuha gawi achaan talgo minha al-faayde al-kaamile.
Achaan fi l-Kitaab,Allah gaal-:﴾‍Fi wakit al-munaasib,ana khibilt du'aak.Aywa,fi yoom al-naja,ana faza'tak.‍﴿Asma'o,da bas al-wakit al-Allah yarda beyah.Da bas yoom al-naja.
Wa abadan ma nisiddu le ayyi naadum al-derib al-yiwaddiih le Allah achaan ma nidooru nijiibu loom fi khidmitna.
Wa be haalna wassafna fi kulli cheyy kadar aniina khaddaamiin Allah.Sabarna sabur gawi fi ta'ab chadiid wa diige wa su'uubaat.
Farachoona wa sajanoona wa ligiina nufuusna fi ust al-barjala.Khadamna be duraa'na.Fagadna al-noom wa l-akil.
Wa wassafna kadar aniina khaddaamiin Allah be haalna al-mukhlisa wa ilimna wa saburna wa galibna al-abyad wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-gaa'id foogna wa mahabbitna al-mukhlisa.
Kalaamna kalaam al-hagg wa nakhdumu be gudrat Allah.Al-haal al-saalhe bas silaahna fi iidna al-zeene wa fi iidna al-isra.
Wa nakhdumu le Allah kan yikarrumuuna walla yahguruuna wa kan yi'ayyuruuna walla yachkuruuna.Yuguulu aniina kaddaabiin wa laakin aniina amiiniin.
Yuguulu aniina naas ma ma'ruufiin wa laakin Allah chaahid leena.Yuguulu mutna wa chiifu aniina hayyiin.Aniina azzaboona chadiid laakin ma kataloona.
Indina hizin wa laakin nafraho daayman.Aniina masaakiin wa laakin nijiibu le katiir min al-naas baraka katiire.Ma indina cheyy wa laakin kulla cheyy hanaana.
Ya akhwaani fi Kuruntus,kallamna leeku be kalaam waadih.Fatahna leeku guluubna.
Aniina ma saddeena leeku al-derib wa laakin intu bas saddeetu leena deribku.
Nihajji leeku misil intu iyaali.Sawwu leena al-sawweena leeku.Aftaho leena guluubku.
Ma tadkhulu fi alaakha ma'a l-naas al-ma mu'miniin achaan intu ma sawa.Kikkeef haal al-saalihiin wa haal al-aasiyiin tabga waahid-?Kikkeef al-nuur wa l-dalaam yilimmu-?
Kikkeef al-Masiih wa Ibliis yistafugu-?Hal fi cheyy al-yarbut al-mu'min ma'a l-ma mu'min-?
Wa ween al-alaakha been beet ibaadat Allah wa beet ibaadat al-asnaam-?Wa aniina bas beet Allah al-Hayy.Wa fi l-Kitaab,Allah gaal-:﴾‍Naskun fooghumwa nuruukh ambeenaathumwa nabga Rabbuhumwa humman yabgo cha'abi.‍﴿
﴾‍Achaan da,amurgu min usuthumwa anfasulu minhum.Da bas kalaam Allah.Ma talmaso cheyy nijis‍﴿wa ana nakhbalku.
﴾‍Wa nabga leeku abuukuwa intu tabgo awlaadi wa banaati.‍﴿Ana Allah al-Gaadirwa ana bas gultah.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,khalli nifakkuru fi wa'ad Allah da.Wa khalli nitahhuru jisimna wa guluubna min ayyi cheyy al-yinajjisna.Lahaddi ni'iichu be haal saalhe wa khoof Allah.
Aftaho guluubku leena.Aniina ma sawweena cheyy fasil le naadum wa ma dammarna naadum wa ma khachcheena naadum.
Wa ma gult al-kalaam da achaan nidoor nuluumku.Misil awwal gultah,intu gaa'idiin fi guluubna wa achaan da,ni'iichu sawa wa numuutu sawa.
Nihajji beeku daayman be farha.Ana mabsuut minku bilheen.Chajja'tuuni chajaa'a chadiide bilheen.Wa khalaas,fi usut kulla su'uubaatna,indi farah ziyaada.
Wa wakit jiina fi Magiduuniya kula,ma ligiina raaha.Ti'ibna wa fi ayyi bakaan ligiina machaakil wa khoof gaa'id fi guluubna.
Laakin Allah al-yichajji' al-ta'baaniin chajja'aana be jayyit akhuuna Tiitus.
Wa chajaa'itna di ma be sabab jaytah bas.La-!Al-khabar al-jaabah minku chajja'aana ziyaada.Hu ooraana kadar intu chajja'tuuh.Wa gaal intu garmaaniin leyi wa haznaaniin le l-muchkila al-bigat wa induku hamiise leyi fi guluubku.Wa achaan da,ana farhaan farha kabiire.
Kan jawaabi jaab hizin fi guluubku kula,ana ma nadmaan leyah.Sahiih,awwal nidimt leyah.Laakin hassa' na'arif jawaabi da jaab hizin fi guluubku laakin al-hizin da ma tawwal.
Wa hassa' da,ana farhaan.Ana ma farhaan be hizinku laakin ana farhaan achaan al-hizin waddaaku le l-tooba.Al-hizin da ja min Allah wa achaan da,ma khassarnaaku cheyy.
Achaan al-hizin al-yaji min Allah yisabbib al-tooba al-tiwaddiina le l-naja wa ma yijiib al-nadaama.Laakin al-hizin al-naas al-dunya yisabbubuuh,yiwaddiihum le l-moot.
Fakkuru fi l-cheyy al-sabbab leeku al-hizin al-ja min Allah da.Intu waajahtu al-muchkila be niiye waahide.Wa ajala ke daafa'tu le nufuusku wa zi'iltu min al-khaati.Wa khuftu khoof chadiid wa bigiitu garmaaniin leyi wa induku leyi hamiise.Wa galibku gamma wa addabtu al-muznib.Wa khalaas,be ayyi daliil intu wassaftu kadar intu bariyiin min kulla l-kalaam da.
Sahiih,ana katabt leeku jawaab yoom daak laakin ma katabtah fi chaan al-naadum al-sawwa al-fasil wa la fi chaan al-fasaala.Ana katabtah achaan nidoor ta'arfu giddaam Allah kadar induku niiye ziyaada leena.
Wa da chajja'aana bilheen.Firihna be sabab al-chajaa'a al-ligiinaaha di.Wa firihna ziyaada be farhat Tiitus achaan awwal galbah mu'allag wa intu raggadtu galbah marra waahid.
Achaan awwal kula ana raasi marfuu' wakit ooreetah beeku wa khalaas kalaami da ma khajjalaani.Misil kulla l-kalaam al-gulna leeku sahiih,al-kalaam al-gultah fiiku le Tiitus,da kula bigi sahiih.
Wa hu gaa'id yifakkir fiiku wa be kikkeef intu kulluku simi'tu kalaamah.Wa karabtuuh adiil wa karramtuuh tamaam wa khalaas,hu yihibbuku katiir.
Wa ana nafrah achaan achami foogku saabit.
Ya akhwaani,nidoor ni'ooriiku be l-rahma al-Allah antaaha le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-gaa'idiin hini fi balad Magiduuniya.
Su'uuba chadiide gaa'ide tijarrib iimaanhum laakin humman farhaaniin farha chadiide.Wa hatta kan humman fagraaniin fagur chadiid kula,anto be juud.
Wa nachhad leehum kadar humman anto hasab gudrithum wa anto ziyaada min gudrithum kula be niiyithum.
Wa talabo minnina be chidde achaan nantuuhum fursa le yichaaruku fi l-musaa'ada le l-akhwaan al-saalihiin.
Wa humman sawwo ziyaada min al-dawwarnaah minhum.Chaalo niiye achaan yitaabu'u al-cheyy al-yidoorah Rabbina wa battaan chaalo niiye achaan yitaabu'u adiil kalaamna misil Allah yidoorah.
Wa awwal Tiitus bada khidmit al-rahma ambeenaatku wa achaan da,talabna minnah yikammil al-khidme di ma'aaku.
Akiid intu bigiitu chudaad fi kulli cheyy.Intu chudaad fi l-iimaan wa l-kalaam wa l-ilim wa niiyitku chadiide wa mahabbitku al-ligiituuha minnina chadiide.Wa hassa' abgo chudaad fi khidmit al-rahma di kula.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-musaa'ada,ma naamurku beyah.Ana gaa'id ni'ooriiku be khabar al-niiye al-chadiide hana l-akhwaan al-aakhariin.Nantiiku fursa achaan tiwassufu kadar mahabbitku sahiihe.
Achaan rahmat Rabbina Isa al-Masiih ta'arfuuha.Hu khani wa laakin fi chaanku intu,hu bigi fagri achaan be fagrah da,intu tabgo khaniyiin.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-kalaam da,ni'ooriiku be fikri.Akheer tikammulu hassa' al-khidme al-badeetuuha al-sana al-faatat achaan intu bas al-awwalaaniyiin fi l-khidme di.Wa ziyaada min da,intu al-awwalaaniyiin al-induku niiye achaan tisawwu al-khidme di.
Wa khalaas kammuluuha.Wa kammuluuha be nafs al-niiye al-chadiide al-badeetuuha beeha.Waajib tantu hasab gudritku.
Kan niiyitku adiile,Allah yarda be l-cheyy al-tantuuh.Al-ma fi ma binlagi.Hu yidoor intu tantu min al-maal al-induku bas.
Ma tifakkuru ana nidoor kadar yabga gaasi leeku wa hayyin le naas aakhariin.Nidoor yabga leena kullina sawa sawa.
Fi l-wakit al-haali,intu induku katiir wa humman hawjaaniin wa khalaas saa'uduuhum.Wa ba'adeen,kan humman induhum katiir wa intu hawjaaniin,humman kula yisaa'uduuku wa yabga leena kullina sawa sawa.
Wa da yifakkirna be l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-buguul-:﴾‍Al-induhum katiir ma faddal leehum.Wa l-induhum chiyya kula,ma gassar leehum.‍﴿
Wa nuguul al-hamdulillah achaan Allah anta Tiitus niiye chadiide misil niiyti ana achaan yi'aawinku.
Wa Tiitus khibil talabna wa ziyaada min da,hu be nafsah chaal niiye chadiide wa dawwar yamchi leeku.
Wa l-akhu al-nirassuluuh ma'aayah ma'ruuf.Jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin fi ayyi bakaan yachkuruuh be sabab khidimtah fi ballikhiin bichaarat al-Masiih.
Wa ziyaada min da,hu waahid min al-akhwaan al-azaloohum jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin le yisaafuru ma'aana wakit aniina mas'uuliin fi cheeliin al-atiiye di.Wa nisawwu al-khidme di achaan nimajjudu beeha Rabbina Isa wa niwassufu niiyitna al-mukhlisa.
Wa khatteena baalna achaan nikammulu adiil mas'uuliiyitna fi l-atiiye al-kabiire di,fi chaan ma nijiibu foogna chakak min ayyi naadum.
Wa chilna niiye le nisawwu al-adiil giddaam Allah wa giddaam al-naas kula.
Wa ma'a l-akhwaan al-itneen dool,nirassulu leeku akhu aakhar.Wa hu naadum jarrabnaah be khidme katiire.Na'arfu hu indah niiye le l-khidme.Wa hassa' niiytah zaadat bilheen achaan indah acham gawi foogku intu.
Wa Tiitus da,hu rafiigi wa yakhdim ma'aayi achaan yi'aawinku.Wa akhwaanna al-ma'aayah dool,humman mumassiliin hana jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin.Wa haalhum adiile tanti majd le l-Masiih.
Khalaas,wassufuuhum mahabbitku achaan jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin fi ayyi bakaan ya'arfuuha wa ya'arfu maala hajjeena beeku be raas marfuu'.
Wa be l-sahiih,ma waajib leyi naktib leeku fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-musaa'ada al-nidooru niwadduuha le l-akhwaan al-saalihiin al-fi Madiinat al-Khudus.
Ana na'arif niiyitku chadiide.Wa ana hajjeet beeha be raasi marfuu' le akhwaanna al-hini fi Magiduuniya wa gult leehum kadar intu al-fi Akhaaya jaahiziin min al-sana al-faatat.Wa khabar hana hamiisitku chajja' katiiriin minhum achaan yantu.
Wa hassa' rassalt al-akhwaan al-talaata dool be l-jawaab da achaan ni'akkid kadar al-kalaam al-gultah fi niiyitku ma yabga kidib.Nidoor intu tabgo jaahiziin misil ana awwal gultah.
Kan najiiku ma'a akhwaan waahidiin min Magiduuniya wa intu ma jaahiziin,al-eeb yisawwiina achaan achamna foogku fachal.Wa l-eeb yisawwiiku intu kula ziyaada.
Achaan da,fi fikri ana waajib niwassi al-akhwaan dool yamchu leeku giddaami wa yinazzumu ma'aaku atiiyitku al-gultu tantuuha be juud.Wa misil da wakit naju,al-atiiye tukuun jaahize wa tantuuha leena be niiyitku wa ma misil jabarnaaku jabaraan.
Wa ma tanso kadar al-naadum al-yiteerib chiyya yagta' chiyya wa l-yiteerib katiir yagta' katiir.
Khalli ayyi naadum minku yanti hasab al-niiye al-chaalaaha fi galbah.Khalli ma yanti cheyy bala niiytah wa ma misil naadum asarooh asaraan achaan Allah yihibb al-naadum al-yanti be farah.
Wa Allah yagdar yantiiku rahma be ziyaada lahaddi fi ayyi wakit induku al-yakfi leeku achaan tichaaruku ziyaada fi ayyi amal hana kheer.
Wa yabga misil al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-buguul fi l-naadum al-saalih-:﴾‍Hu yanti le l-masaakiin be juud wa adaaltah tagood daayman.‍﴿
Wa Allah al-yanti al-teeraab le l-harraati wa ma'aach le l-naas,hu yikattir leeku teeraabku achaan talgo katiir wa tantu ziyaada wa yiziidku baraka.
Wa Allah yiziid leeku kulli cheyy achaan anteetu be juud wa wakit niwaddu atiiyitku le Madiinat al-Khudus,al-naas yachkuru Allah.
Achaan al-khidme al-tisawwuuha le Allah di ma tisaa'id al-saalihiin al-hawjaaniin bas.Hi tikattir al-chukur al-yigaddumuuh al-naas le Allah kula.
Wa naas katiiriin yimajjudu Allah.Achaan al-khidme di,hi al-daliil al-yiwassif kadar intu mu'miniin be bichaarat al-Masiih wa titaabu'uuh adiil.Wa yimajjudu Allah achaan anteetuuhum wa anteetu le naas aakhariin be juud.
Wa yas'alo Allah leeku wa yiriiduuku be mahabba chadiide be sabab rahmat Allah al-aziime al-antaaha leeku.
Wa l-hamdulillah-!Al-atiiye al-hu antaaha,ma fi cheyy yigaadirha.
Ana bas Buulus al-yuguulu foogi ana nimaskin nafsi wakit ana gaa'id ma'aaku wa laakin kalaami haarr wakit ana khaayib minku.Wa ana nihannisku be kheer al-Masiih wa mahannitah.
Nachhadku achaan wakit najiiku ma tilizzuuni lahaddi nihajji leeku be kalaam haarr.Wa laakin akiid ana nagdar nihajji be kalaam haarr le l-naas al-yuguulu kadar aniina nitaabu'u haal naas al-dunya.
Sahiih,aniina aaychiin fi l-dunya laakin ma nihaarubu misil naas al-dunya.
