Be l-aks,bigi leehum waadih kadar Allah kallafaani be ballikhiin bichaarat al-Masiih le l-naas al-ma Yahuud misil hu kallaf Butrus be ballikhiin bichaarat al-Masiih le l-Yahuud.
Wa misil Allah azal Butrus wa sawwaah rasuul le l-Yahuud,hu azalaani ana kula wa sawwaani rasuul le l-ma Yahuud.
Wa l-kubaaraat al-ma'ruufiin misil amad al-mu'miniin,humman Yaakhuub wa Butrus wa Yuuhanna,bigi leehum waadih kadar Allah antaani al-ni'ma di.Wa khalaas,karaboona be l-iid al-zeene ana wa Barnaaba achaan yiwassufu kadar kullina muchtarikiin fi l-khidme.Wa astafago kadar aniina nakhdumu fi ust al-naas al-ma Yahuud wa humman yakhdumu fi ust al-Yahuud.
Talabo minnina cheyy waahid bas.Dawwaro aniina nifakkuru fi l-masaakiin al-ma'aahum.Wa da bas al-cheyy al-min awwal niriid nisawwiih.
Laakin wakit Butrus ja fi Antaakiya,ana gammeet diddah wa waajahtah achaan hu khaltaan.
Gubbaal naas waahidiin ma yaju min bakaan Yaakhuub,Butrus gaa'id yaakul ma'a l-akhwaan al-ma Yahuud.Laakin min al-naas dool jo khalaas,hu bada yikiss min al-naas al-ma Yahuud wa anfarag minhum achaan hu khaayif min naas Hizib al-Tahuura.
Wa akhwaan aakhariin min al-Yahuud taaba'ooh fi nifaakhah da lahaddi waddo ma'aahum Barnaaba zaatah fi nifaakhhum.
Laakin wakit ana chift kadar humman ma maachiin adiil wa ma yitaabu'u al-kalaam al-sahiih al-Allah antaana fi bichaarat al-Masiih,gammeet hajjeet le Butrus giddaamhum kulluhum.Wa gult-:-Inta Yahuudi wa bigiit misil naadum ma Yahuudi wa khalleet minnak aadaat al-Yahuud.Wa misil da,maala tidoor tajbur al-naas al-ma Yahuud le yabgo misil al-Yahuud-?
Aniina zaatna mawluudiin Yahuud wa ma min al-muznibiin al-ma Yahuud dool.
Wa be da kula,na'arfu kadar Allah ma yaj'al ayyi naadum saalih achaan hu yitaabi' churuut al-Tawraat.Laakin hu yaj'al al-naadum saalih kan hu mu'min be l-Masiih.Wa be misil da,aniina aamanna be Isa al-Masiih achaan Allah yaj'alna saalihiin be sabab iimaanna be l-Masiih wa ma achaan nitaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat.Achaan ma fi insaan waahid yabga saalih giddaam Allah be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat.
Chilna derib al-Masiih le nabgo saalihiin wa be da kula,irifna nufuusna muznibiin.Hal nuguulu al-Masiih hu sabab zunuubna walla-?La,abadan.
Laakin kan ana nigabbil wa nitaabi' battaan al-aadaat al-awwal khalleethum minni,misil da bas nabga khaati be l-sahiih.
Al-Tawraat sawwa foogi amalah wa khalaas,fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss churuut al-Tawraat,ana mayyit.Wa ana mutt le churuutah achaan nugumm ni'iich le Allah.Ana mutt ma'a l-Masiih fi saliibah.
Wa hassa' da,al-naadum al-hayy ma ana laakin al-Masiih hu hayy fiyi.Wa kulla cheyy al-nisawwiih fi l-dunya,nisawwiih fi l-iimaan be Ibn Allah al-habbaani lahaddi anta nafsah dahiiye fi chaani.
Abadan ana ma nankur ni'mat Allah.Kan al-naas yabgo saalihiin be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat,misil da al-Masiih maat bala sabab.
Ya naas Khalaatiya al-mataamiis-!Be kalaam waadih bilheen fassarna leeku moot Isa al-Masiih fi l-saliib.Wa hassa' naadum sawwa leeku sihir walla-?
Nidoor nas'alku cheyy waahid.Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus nazal foogku achaan intu taaba'tu churuut al-Tawraat,walla achaan simi'tu bichaarat al-Masiih wa aamantu beeha-?
Bigiitu mataamiis marra waahid walla-?Wakit badeetu fi derib Allah,khatteetu baalku fi gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Laakin hassa' tidooru tikammuluuh be gudra insaaniiye walla-?
Kulla cheyy al-ichtuuh,da bala faayde walla-?Ma mumkin da bala faayde.
Fakkuru foogah.Allah yinazzil foogku al-Ruuh al-Khudduus be gudra wa yisawwi ajaayib fi usutku maala-?Achaan titaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat walla achaan simi'tu bichaarat al-Masiih wa aamantu beeha-?
Fakkuru fi Ibraahiim.Maktuub-:﴾‍Hu aaman be kalaam Allah wa fi chaan iimaanah,Allah ja'alah naadum saalih.‍﴿
Wa min al-kalaam da,a'arfu kadar al-naas al-bigo mu'miniin,humman bas iyaal Ibraahiim.
Wa min awwal al-Kitaab buguul kadar Allah yaj'al al-naas al-ma Yahuud saalihiin be sabab iimaanhum.Wa ballakh al-bichaara di le Ibraahiim wa gaal-:﴾‍Be sababak inta,kulla l-gabaayil yalgo baraka.‍﴿
Wa be misil da,al-naas al-karabo al-iimaan,humman yalgo baraka ma'a Ibraahiim al-mu'min.
Wa kulla l-naas al-ankarabo fi tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat,al-la'ana gaa'ide fooghum.Achaan maktuub fi l-Kitaab kadar ayyi naadum al-ma yitaabi' al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Tawraat kulla ke wa ma yitabbigah tamaam,hu mal'uun.
Akiid kadar ma fi naadum yabga saalih giddaam Allah be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat.Wa achaan da,maktuub-:﴾‍Be iimaanah,al-saalih yahya.‍﴿
Laakin churuut al-Tawraat ma bukhussu al-iimaan.Be l-aks,bukhussu amal al-naas.Achaan maktuub-:﴾‍Al-naadum al-yitabbig kulla l-churuut dool yahya beehum.‍﴿
Laakin al-Masiih fadaana min al-la'ana al-jaaye min al-Tawraat.Hu zaatah bigi mal'uun fi chaanna.Achaan al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Ayyi naadum al-mu'allag foog fi l-hatab,hu mal'uun.‍﴿
Wa bigi misil da,achaan be l-Masiih Isa al-baraka al-Allah waa'ad beeha Ibraahiim taji fi l-naas al-ma Yahuud kula.Wa khalaas be sabab al-iimaan,Allah yinazzil foogna kullina al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-hu waa'ad beyah al-naas.
Ya akhwaani,nantiiku masal fi l-cheyy al-yisawwuuh al-naas.Kan naaseen induhum mu'aahada wa astafago fi cheyy waahid wa mado foogah khalaas,ma fi naadum al-yagdar yibattilah walla yiziid foogah cheyy.
Zeen.Allah waa'ad Ibraahiim wa l-yaji min zurriiytah.Wa l-Kitaab ma buguul-:-al-yaju min zurriiytak- ya'ni naas katiiriin,laakin buguul-:-al-yaji min zurriiytak- ya'ni naadum waahid.Wa hu al-Masiih.
Daahu al-cheyy al-nidoor ni'ooriiku beyah.Allah sawwa mu'aahada ma'a Ibraahiim wa ba'ad 430 sana,kitaab al-Tawraat ja laakin churuut al-Tawraat ma battalo al-wa'ad wa la nagado al-mu'aahada al-Allah zaatah sawwaaha.
Achaan kan al-naas ma ligo al-baraka al-Allah waa'ad beeha Ibraahiim illa kan yitaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat,al-baraka ma taji be sabab al-wa'ad.Laakin aniina na'arfu kadar hu antaaha le Ibraahiim be wa'ad bas.
Wa kan ke da,maala Allah nazzal al-Tawraat le Muusa-?Allah zaad le juduudna al-Tawraat be kulla churuutah be sabab zunuub al-naas.Wa dawwar al-naas yitaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat lahaddi al-naadum al-min zurriiyit Ibraahiim al-Allah waa'adah be l-baraka yaji.Wa l-Tawraat da,al-malaa'ika nazzalooh fi iid wasiit wa hu Muusa.
Laakin kan fi jaanib waahid bas,ma fi waasita.Wa Allah hu waahid.
Al-Tawraat yikhaalif wa'ad Allah walla-?La,abadan.Kan awwal al-naas yagdaro yalgo al-haya al-abadiiye be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat al-Allah antaahum,khalaas humman yabgo saalihiin be l-churuut dool.
Laakin fi l-Kitaab,Allah gaal kadar kulla l-naas gaa'idiin tihit hukum al-zanib wa ma yagdaro yamurgu minnah.Wa bigi misil da achaan Allah indah niiye yanti le l-mu'miniin bas al-baraka al-hu waa'ad beeha be sabab iimaanhum be Isa al-Masiih.
Gubbaal al-iimaan ma yaji,aniina misil masaajiin wa churuut al-Tawraat humman misil al-haras al-gaa'id foogna lahaddi Allah bayyan leena derib al-iimaan.
Be misil da,al-Tawraat gaa'id yiraakhib foogna lahaddi l-Masiih yaji achaan nabgo saalihiin be l-iimaan.
Wa hassa' zaman al-iimaan ja khalaas wa churuut al-Tawraat ma yiraakhubu foogna battaan.
Achaan intu kulluku iyaal Allah fi Isa al-Masiih be derib al-iimaan.
Kulluku achtaraktu ma'a l-Masiih wa be l-khattisiin,intu anrabattu ma'aayah.
Wa hassa' ma fi farig been al-Yahuudi wa l-ma Yahuudi,wa la been al-abid wa l-hurr,wa la been al-raajil wa l-mara,laakin kulluku waahid fi l-Masiih Isa.
Wa kan intu naas hana l-Masiih,khalaas intu kula min zurriiyit Ibraahiim wa tawrusu al-baraka al-Allah waa'adah beeha.
Walla be kalaam aakhar,kan wileed waras maal katiir wa hu lissaa' ma aagil,hu misil abid bas.
Waajib yitaabi' kalaam al-masaa'iil al-gaa'idiin yirabbuuh wa l-muwakkaliin be maalah lahaddi l-wakit al-abuuh haddadah leyah fi l-wasiiye.
Wa awwal bigi misil da leena aniina al-mu'miniin.Awwal aniina misil al-naas al-ma aagliin wa aaychiin misil al-abiid tihit churuut wa aadaat al-dunya.
Laakin al-wakit tamma khalaas wa Allah rassal Ibnah fi l-dunya.Hu mawluud min mara wa rabbooh tihit churuut al-Tawraat
achaan yafda al-naas al-gaa'idiin tihit churuut al-Tawraat.Wa khalaas,ligiina beyah al-huguug al-waajib le iyaal Allah.
Le yi'akkid kadar intu kula bigiitu iyaalah,Allah nazzal fi guluubna kullina Ruuh hana Ibnah al-yasrakh-:-Abba,abuuna-!
Wa khalaas,inta ma abid misil awwal.Bigiit wileed Allah wa kan inta wileedah,Allah ja'alaak wariisah.
Fi l-wakit al-faat,ma iriftu Allah wa intu abiid le l-ilaahaat al-ma ilaahaat be l-sahiih.
Laakin hassa' dakhaltu fi alaakha ma'a Allah,walla akheer nuguul Allah dakhkhalaaku fi alaakha ma'aayah.Wa kan ke da,maala tidooru tigabbulu titaabu'u battaan churuut wa aadaat al-dunya al-ma induhum gudra wa la faayde-?Maala tidooru tabgo battaan abiid-?
Haay-!Intu gaa'idiin tukhuttu fikirku fi ayyaam al-a'yaad wa l-chuhuur wa l-awkaat wa l-siniin-!
Haalitku di khawwafatni bilheen achaan akuun al-ta'ab al-ana ti'ibtah foogku macha fi riih saakit.
Ya akhwaani,awwal ana bigiit misilku intu al-ma Yahuud.Hassa' nachhadku,abgo misli ana.Awwal ma sawweetu leyi cheyy fasil.
Ta'arfu adiil kadar ana bigiit mardaan wa da antaani fursa le nibachchir leeku al-Injiil awwal marra.
Wa ta'abi da bigi leeku gaasi laakin be da kula,intu ma hagartuuni wa la taradtuuni.La,intu dayyaftuuni misil ana malak Allah walla misil ana al-Masiih Isa zaatah.
Ween al-farha al-awwal induku-?Nachhad leeku kadar fi l-wakit daak,kan induku gudra achaan tamurgu uyuunku,tawwaali tamurguuhum tantuuhum leyi.
Wa hassa' da,ana bigiit aduuku achaan ooreetku al-hagg walla-?
Al-naas al-yidooru yijiibuuku fi deribhum dool yakhdumu ambeenaatku be niiye waahide laakin niiyithum ma adiile.Yidooru yifaaruguuku minni.Wa yidooru intu titaabu'uuhum humman bas be niiye waahide.
Wa kan niiyitku chadiide,da sameh kan al-sabab sameh.Wa da sameh kan niiyitku chadiide daayman wa ma wakit ana ma'aaku bas.
Ya iyaali al-nihibbuku,ana bigiit misil ammuku al-gaa'ide naldaaku marra taaniye.Ana gaa'id nat'ab fi l-talaga lahaddi tabgo saabtiin fi l-Masiih.
Nitmanna kadar nagdar nukuun ma'aaku wa nihajji leeku be kalaam baarid.Laakin ana ba'iid minku wa ma na'arif al-cheyy al-nisawwi leeku.
Intu al-tidooru titaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat,ooruuni cheyy waahid.Intu ma simi'tu al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Tawraat walla-?
Al-Kitaab buguul Ibraahiim indah awlaad itneen.Al-waahid hu wileed Haajar al-khaadim wa l-aakhar hu wileed Saara al-hurra.
Wileed al-khaadim da,wildooh be l-waaluuda al-aadiiye.Wa laakin al-wileed al-aakhar,waaluudtah bigat hasab wa'ad Allah.
Wa l-kalaam da masal leena.Al-awiin al-itneen deel yiwassufuuna mu'aahadaat itneen been Allah wa l-naas.Al-awwalaaniiye hi misil al-mu'aahada al-Allah sawwaaha fi jabal Siinaa'.Wa hi talda naas fi l-ubuudiiye.Wa di misil Haajar al-khaadim.
Haajar wa jabal Siinaa' al-fi daar al-Arab yiwassufuuna Madiinat al-Khudus,aasimat al-Yahuud al-gaa'ide fi l-dunya.Achaan al-madiina wa naasha gaa'idiin fi l-ubuudiiye tihit churuut al-Tawraat.
Laakin Madiinat al-Khudus al-gaa'ide foog ma'a Allah,hi hurra wa hi bas ammina.
Wa maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Zakhriti,al-mara al-aagre,inti al-ma wilidti-!Iiti be farah wa zakhriti,inti al-ma dukhti waja' al-talaga-!Achaan iyaal al-mutallaga yabgo katiiriinmin iyaal al-mara al-gaa'ide ma'a raajilha.‍﴿
Wa khalaas ya akhwaani,intu bigiitu iyaal Allah be wa'ad Allah misil Ishaakh.
Laakin fi zaman Ibraahiim,al-wileed al-wildooh be l-waaluuda al-aadiiye gamma yita''ib al-wileed al-wildooh be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa bigi misil da fi zamanna kula.
Laakin al-Kitaab buguul chunu-?Buguul-:﴾‍Atrud al-khaadim ma'a wileedha.Achaan wileed al-khaadim di ma yawris ma'a wileed al-hurra.‍﴿
Wa be misil da,ya akhwaani,aniina ma iyaal al-khaadim.Laakin aniina iyaal al-hurra.
Al-Masiih sawwaana naas hurriin achaan ni'iichu fi l-hurriiye.Agoodu saabtiin fi l-hurriiye wa aabo ma tabgo battaan abiid.
Fukku adaanku.Ana Buulus nuguul leeku kan tikhalluuhum yitahhuruuku,barakat al-Masiih ma tanfa' leeku abadan.
Nachhad leeku battaan kadar ayyi naadum al-yikhalli nafsah yitahhuruuh be tahuurat al-Tawraat,waajib leyah yitabbig churuut al-Tawraat kulluhum ke.
Intu al-tidooru tabgo saalihiin be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat dool,anfaragtu marra waahid min al-Masiih wa khalleetu minku ni'mat Allah.
Laakin be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,aniina nukhuttu achamna fi Allah al-yisawwiina saalihiin be sabab iimaanna al-gaa'idiin nitmannooh be ziyaada.
Achaan fi derib al-Masiih Isa,kan naadum mutahhar walla ma mutahhar kula,da ma muhimm.Al-cheyy al-muhimm da,hu al-iimaan be l-Masiih wa l-mahabba al-jaaye min al-iimaan da.
Badeetu adiil fi derib al-Masiih.Kikkeef khalleetu naadum yamrugku min al-derib al-sahiih da-?
Al-kalaam da ma jaayi min Allah al-gaa'id yinaadiiku.
Angar'u-!Tawwaara chiyya bas takfi le tigawwim al-ajiine kullaha ke.
Laakin al-Rabb antaani damaan leeku wa na'arif kadar intu ma takhbalo fikir chig min fikirna.Wa l-naadum al-gaa'id yibarjilku da,al-hukum yaji foogah kan yabga yaatu kula.
Ya akhwaani,kan ana zaati gaa'id ni'allim al-naas kadar al-tahuura waajbe,maala al-Yahuud gaa'idiin yita''ubuuni-?Kan awwal ana ni'allim be l-tahuura wa ma nibachchir be l-saliib,naadum ma yalga muchkila.
Wa hassa' le l-naas al-gaa'idiin yibarjuluuku be l-tahuura dool,khalli yikhassu nufuushum marra waahid-!
Ya akhwaani,Allah naadaaku achaan yidoor intu ti'iichu fi l-hurriiye.Laakin ma tisawwu al-hurriiye di fursa le titaabu'u chahwaatku al-fasliin.Akheer takhdumu le akhwaanku be mahabba.
Achaan kulla churuut al-Tawraat,zibdithum tinlagi fi wasiiye waahide wa hi-:﴾‍Hibb akhuuk misil tihibb nafsak.‍﴿
Laakin kan tilkhaalafo ambeenaatku wa tiddaawaso misil kulaab,khalaas fi l-akhiir til'aakalo marra waahid.
Nuguul leeku taabu'u Allah be derib al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa misil da,ma titaabu'u chahwaatku al-fasliin.
Achaan al-cheyy al-yiriidah galib al-insaan chig min al-yiriidah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa l-cheyy al-yiriidah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus chig min al-yiriidah galib al-insaan.Al-itneen dool yiddaawaso ambeenaathum achaan yadharooku min al-cheyy al-tidooru tisawwuuh.
Wa kan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus gaa'id yuguudku,intu ma gaa'idiin tihit churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa khalaas,al-zunuub al-yaju min galib al-insaan ma'ruufiin.Humman al-zina wa l-khabaasa wa l-fasaad
wa ibaadat al-asnaam wa l-sihir wa l-huraaj wa l-duwaas wa l-husud wa l-khabiine wa l-khilaaf wa l-mukhaasamaat wa l-tafrikha
wa l-tama' wa l-sakar wa l-safaaha wa cheyy aakhar al-misilhum.Nuguul leeku misil awwal gultah leeku,al-naas al-yisawwu al-achya dool ma yawrusu cheyy fi mamlakat Allah.
Laakin misil al-chadar yalda iyaal,daahu iyaal al-Ruuh al-Khudduus humman al-mahabba wa l-farah wa l-salaam wa l-sabur wa l-galib al-abyad wa l-kheer wa l-amaan
wa l-nafas al-baarid wa sabbitiin al-nafs.Al-achya dool,ma fi chart waahid didduhum.
Wa l-naas al-bigo naas hana l-Masiih Isa khatto chahwaathum al-fasliin fi l-saliib wa kataloohum.
Wa kan ni'iichu be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,waajib nuruukhu be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Khalli ma nistakbaro wa la nizzaa'alo ambeenaatna wa la nilhaasado.
Ya akhwaani,kan waahid minku waga' fi khata,waajib intu al-gawiyiin be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus tikhattumu leyah be nafas baarid wa tigabbuluuh fi l-derib al-adiil.Wa fakkuru le nufuusku achaan al-zanib al-yaji be l-tajriba ma yinnasir foogku intu kula.
Wa fi wakit al-ta'ab,assaa'ado ambeenaatku.Wa misil da,titabbugu wasaaya al-Masiih.
Wa kan naadum sawwa nafsah aali min akhwaanah lahaddi ma yisaa'idhum,be l-sahiih hu ma yisaawi cheyy wa khachcha nafsah.
Khalli ayyi waahid yijarrib al-khidme al-hu zaatah yisawwiiha le l-Rabb.Wa misil da,hu yafrah be khidimtah wa ma yichiif khidme hana naadum aakhar.
Achaan ayyi waahid mas'uul min nafsah.
Kan naadum gaa'id yi'allimku kalaam Allah,waajib tantuuh min al-maal al-induku.
Ma tukhuchchu nufuusku.Allah ma yinkhachcha.Al-cheyy al-naadum yiteeribah,da bas al-yalgaah.
Kan naadum yitaabi' chahwaatah al-fasliin,hu yalga min chahwaatah al-halaak.Wa kan naadum yitaabi' al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,khalaas hu yalga min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-haya al-abadiiye.
Achaan da,khalli nisawwu al-kheer daayman wa abadan ma naksalo minnah.Ba'adeen kan ma kisilna,nalgo minnah faayde.
Wa achaan da,fi ayyi wakit indina fursa,khalli nisawwu al-kheer le kulla l-naas wa khaassatan le ahal al-iimaan.
Chiifu al-huruuf al-kubaar dool.Ana chilt al-galam wa ana zaati gaa'id naktib al-kalaam da.
Al-naas al-yidooru yisawwu al-tahuura chart leeku,humman yidooru rida min al-naas bas.Yidooru al-Yahuud ma yita''ubuuhum battaan be sabab bichaarat moot al-Masiih fi l-saliib.
Wa l-naas al-mutahhariin dool zaathum ma yitabbugu kulla churuut al-Tawraat.Laakin yidooru yitahhuruuku achaan yifaachuru le l-naas be jilidku al-mutahhar.
Wa kan leyi ana,abadan ma nidoor nifaachir le l-naas be ayyi cheyy,illa be saliib hana Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Wa l-saliib da,katal leyi chahwaati hana l-dunya wa beyah ana kula bigiit misil naadum mayyit le l-dunya.
Achaan kan naadum mutahhar walla ma mutahhar kula,da ma muhimm.Al-cheyy al-muhimm da,ayyi naadum waajib yadkhul fi l-khaliige al-jadiide.
Al-salaam wa l-rahma le kulla l-naas al-yitaabu'u al-wasiiye di.Humman bas ummat Allah.
Khalaas,khalli naadum waahid minku ma yibachtinni battaan achaan indi alam fi jildi min za'al al-naas wa di l-alaama al-tiwassif ana abd Isa be l-sahiih.
Ya akhwaani,aleekum rahmat Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Aamiin.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus rasuul Isa al-Masiih be izin Allah.Wa naktib leeku intu al-saalihiin al-fi hillit Afasus al-saabtiin fi iimaanku be l-Masiih Isa.
Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma min Allah abuuna wa Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Khalli nachkuru Allah abu Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Hu baarakaana be kulla l-barakaat al-ruuhiiye al-fi l-sama achaan alaakhitna ma'a l-Masiih.
Gubbaal bidaayit al-dunya,Allah azalaana fi l-Masiih.Be sabab mahabbitah,hu chaal niiye achaan nabgo khaassiin wa nahdaro giddaamah bala ayyi eeb.
Min awwal,hu khaddar leena wa chaal niiye achaan nabgo iyaalah be waasitat Isa al-Masiih.Wa di bas niiytah al-hu radyaan beeha.
Khalli nachkuruuh fi chaan ni'matah al-majiide al-nazzalaaha foogna be Ibnah al-yihibbah.
Ibnah fadaana be dammah wa beyah hu,Allah khafar leena khataayaana.Di bas ni'matah al-aziime
al-nazzalaaha foogna be katara.Wa Allah al-hakiim al-ya'arif kulla cheyy
bayyan leena sirr hana muraadtah al-hu radyaan beeha.Wa chaal niiye le yitammimha fi l-Masiih.
Wa daahu hadaf Allah.Fi l-wakit al-hu haddadah,hu yidoor yilimm kulla cheyy al-fi l-samaawaat wa kulla cheyy al-fi l-ard wa yukhuttuhum tihit ra'iis waahid wa hu al-Masiih.
Wa be alaakhitna ma'a l-Masiih,Allah ja'alaana cha'abah al-yalgo al-warasa.Allah azalaana min awwal hasab nizaamah.Hu yisawwi kulla cheyy hasab niiytah wa muraadtah.
Wa Allah azalaana aniina al-bigiina al-awwalaaniyiin al-khatteena achamna fi l-Masiih le nachkuruuh wa nimajjuduuh.
Wa intu kula,simi'tu kalaam al-hagg fi bichaarat al-Masiih al-beeha nijiitu wa bigiitu mu'miniin be l-Masiih.Wa be sabab alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih,Allah nazzal foogku al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-waa'adaana beyah wa hu misil al-wasim al-Allah khattaah foogku.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus yi'akkid leena kadar nalgo gisimna min al-warasa al-waa'ad beeha cha'abah.Wa hu yi'akkid leena kadar nalgo al-warasa di wakit najaatna bigat kaamile.Wa achaan da,khalli nimajjudu azamat Allah.
Wa fi chaan kulla l-achya dool,ana nachkur Allah.Aywa,min simi't kadar iimaanku be Rabbina Isa gawi wa tihibbu kulla l-saalihiin,
ana gaa'id nachkur Allah daayman fi chaanku wa nifakkir leeku fi ayyi wakit al-nisalli.
Wa nad'i Allah abuuna al-majiid al-rassal Rabbina Isa al-Masiih wa nas'alah leeku kadar hu yantiiku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus fikir adiil wa irfe achaan ta'arfu Allah be ziyaada.
Khalli nuur Allah yadkhul fi guluubku achaan tafhamo tamaam al-acham al-Allah naadaaku le talgooh wa battaan tafhamo kubur al-warasa al-majiide al-gaa'ide fi ust al-saalihiin.
Wa ta'arfu gudurtah al-ma indaha hadd al-gaa'ide takhdim leena aniina al-mu'miniin.Al-gudra di aziime wa hi al-gudra
al-Allah bayyanha fi l-Masiih wakit ba'asah min ust al-maytiin wa rafa'ah foog fi l-samaawaat wa ga''adah fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Al-Masiih gaa'id fi bakaan aali bilheen min kulla l-hukkaam wa l-kubaaraat wa min kulla cheyy al-indah gudra walla muluk.Usmah aali min kulla usum al-yatruuh al-naas,ma fi l-dunya bas laakin fi l-aakhira kula.
Wa Allah khatta kulla cheyy tihit muluk al-Masiih wa ja'alah ra'iis fi kulla cheyy le faaydit ummatah.
Wa ummatah hi misil jismah wa hi malaane be gudrat al-Masiih wa l-Masiih gudurtah tamla kulla cheyy.
Awwal,intu maytiin be sabab khataayaaku wa zunuubku.
Wa fi l-wakit al-faat daak,intu gaa'idiin titaabu'u derib al-dunya wa titaabu'u kabiir al-mamlaka al-cheetaaniiye al-gaa'ide been al-sama wa l-ard wa hu al-Cheetaan al-gaa'id yakhdim fi guluub al-naas al-yikhaalufu Allah.
Wa awwal kullina minhum wa nitaabu'u chahwaat al-insaan wa nisawwu al-cheyy al-jisimna wa afkaarna yidooruuh.Awwal aniina zaatna waajib leena khadab Allah misil al-naas al-aakhariin.
Wa laakin rahmat Allah,hi aziime wa hu yihibbina be mahabba kabiire bilheen.
Wa wakit aniina maytiin be sabab khataayaana,hu antaana al-haya al-jadiide ma'a l-Masiih.Aywa,be ni'mat Allah bas intu nijiitu.
Wa Allah ba'asaana ma'aayah wa ga''adaana ma'aayah fi l-samaawaat wa da bigi leena be l-Masiih Isa.
Wa hu sawwa leena zeen be l-Masiih Isa achaan fi kulla l-zaman al-jaayi,yibayyin rahmatah al-kabiire bilheen al-ma indaha hadd.
Aywa,be rahmat Allah bas,intu nijiitu be sabab iimaanku be l-Masiih.Intu ma najjeetu nufuusku laakin al-naja di hadiiye min Allah.
Allah ma najjaaku be sabab amalku hana l-kheer wa fi chaan da,ma fi naadum indah hagg yistakbar.
Wa khalaas aniina bigiina khaliigit Allah.Hu sawwaana khaliige jadiide fi l-Masiih Isa achaan nisawwu amal al-kheer al-min awwal hu jahhazah leena achaan nisawwuuh.
Ya akhwaani al-ma Yahuud,fakkuru fi haalitku al-gadiime.Awwal al-Yahuud yuguulu foogku intu ma mutahhariin.Wa l-naas al-yuguulu al-kalaam da yuguulu humman bas al-mutahhariin laakin tahuurithum gati'iin al-jilid al-yisawwuuh be iideen al-naas bas.
Awwal intu ma induku alaakha ma'a l-Masiih.Intu min gabaayil chig,ma min Bani Israa'iil al-cha'ab al-Allah azalaahum.Al-mu'aahadaat al-Allah sawwaahum ma'a l-Yahuud,hu ma sawwaahum ma'aaku.Wa l-wa'ad al-Allah antaah leehum,intu ma iriftuuh.Intu aaychiin fi l-dunya laakin ma iriftu Allah wa ma induku acham foogah.
Laakin hassa' induku alaakha ma'a l-Masiih Isa.Intu awwal ba'iidiin min Allah laakin hassa' damm al-Masiih daffag fi chaanku wa garrabaaku leyah.
Al-Masiih bas al-jaab leena al-salaam.Aniina al-Yahuud wa intu al-ma Yahuud,hu ja'alaana kullina nafar waahid.Be dahiiyat jismah,hu kassar al-huduud al-awwal faragooku minnina wa sabbabo ambeenaatna al-mukhaasama.
Hu battal derib gawaaniin al-Yahuud ma'a churuuthum achaan yikawwin fi l-alaakha ma'aayah nafar waahid jadiid fi badal nafareen.Wa misil da,hu sawwa ambeenaatna al-salaam.
Hu saalahaana kullina ma'a Allah,al-Yahuud wa l-ma Yahuud,le nabgo umma waahide be waasitat mootah fi l-saliib.Wa khalaas,al-mukhaasama al-awwal gaa'ide ambeenaatna bigat ma fiiha.
Al-Masiih ja wa ballakh bichaarat al-salaam leeku intu al-ma Yahuud al-awwal ba'iidiin min Allah.Wa ballakh bichaarat al-salaam leena aniina al-Yahuud al-gariibiin le Allah.
Wa khalaas be l-Masiih,aniina kullina nagdaro nigarrubu le Allah abuuna be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-waahid.
Wa khalaas hassa' intu al-ma Yahuud,intu ma ajaanib battaan wa la naas min gabiila aakhara.Bigiitu muwaatiniin hana mamlakat Allah ma'a l-saalihiin.Bigiitu ahal beet Allah.
Walla be masal aakhar,Allah ja'alaaku al-beet al-hu saakin foogah.Wa l-asaas al-Allah banaaku foogah,hu kalaam al-rusul wa l-anbiya.Wa Isa al-Masiih,hu hajar al-zaawiye al-yarbut al-asaas.
Be alaakhitna ma'a l-Masiih bas,kullina anrabatna sawa wa bigiina misil beet waahid al-gaa'id yakbur lahaddi yabga beet mukhaddas wa maskan khaass le l-Rabb.
Be alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih,Allah gaa'id yabni beetah beeku intu kula ma'a kulla l-saalihiin achaan tabgo al-bakaan al-Allah yaskun foogah be Ruuhah.
Ana Buulus gaa'id fi l-sijin achaan nitaabi' al-Masiih Isa wa niballikh bichaartah leeku intu al-ma Yahuud.Wa achaan da,ana nas'al leeku Allah.
Wa akiid,simi'tu be ni'mat Allah al-gaa'ide foogi le nisawwi al-khidme al-Allah kallafaani beeha fi chaanku.
Wa khidimti tukhuss sirr Allah al-bayyanah leyi fi ru'ya.Wa awwal katabt leeku minnah.
Wakit tagru kalaami da,tafhamo al-ilim al-ligiitah min sirr Allah al-bukhuss al-Masiih.
Fi kulla l-wakit al-faat,Allah ma bayyan al-kalaam da le Bani Adam laakin fi l-wakit al-haadir,bayyanah be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus le l-rusul wa l-anbiya al-saalihiin al-rassalaahum.
Wa daahu sirr Allah.Be bichaarat al-Masiih,al-umam yabgo wurraas sawa ma'a l-Yahuud.Yabgo umma waahide al-hi jisim al-Masiih.Wa khalaas be Isa al-Masiih,humman yichaaruku fi wa'ad Allah.
Allah nazzal foogi ni'matah wa ja'alaani khaddaamah be gudurtah achaan niballikh al-bichaara di.
Wa min kulla l-saalihiin,ana bas al-sakhayyar wa laakin Allah antaani rahma wa kallafaani ana be ballikhiin al-bichaara le l-umam wa nibachchirhum be barakat al-Masiih al-ma indaha hadd.
Wa rassalaani achaan nifassir le kulla l-naas ma'ana sirr Allah.Wa Allah al-khaalig kulla cheyy hafad al-sirr da le nafsah fi kulla l-zaman al-faat.
Wa hikmat Allah wasii'e wa ajiibe.Wa fi l-zaman al-haadir,Allah yidoor yiwassif hikmatah be amalah fi usut ummat al-Masiih achaan kulla l-hukkaam wa l-kubaaraat al-gaa'idiin fi l-samaawaat yichiifuuha wa yafhamooha.
Wa di bas niiyit Allah min al-bidaaya al-tammamaaha be l-Masiih Isa Rabbina.
Wa be sabab alaakhitna ma'a l-Masiih wa iimaanna beyah,indina chajaa'a achaan na'abudu Allah bala chakak.
Wa achaan kulla l-kalaam da,natlub minku ma tahzano leyi fi ta'abi.Ana gaa'id nat'ab misil da fi chaanku intu wa da yabga le faayditku al-majiide.
Wa achaan da,nasjud giddaam abuuna Allah.
Wa hu abu al-aayilaat al-fi l-sama wa l-ard.
Wa nas'alah achaan yantiiku baraka min al-khuna al-indah fi l-majd wa yantiiku gudra wa yisabbit guluubku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa khalli al-Masiih yaskun fi guluubku be iimaanku.Wa khalli al-mahabba tabga leeku misil ga'ar wa asaas lahaddi tisawwu kulla cheyy be l-mahabba.
Wa misil da,intu ma'a kulla l-saalihiin tagdaro tafhamo kadar mahabbat al-Masiih wasii'e bilheen wa kabiire bilheen wa ma indaha hadd.
Wa be misil da,ta'arfu mahabbitah al-faayte kulla l-irfe.Wa barakat Allah al-kaamile tamla guluubku marra waahid.
Wa l-hamdulillah-!Be gudurtah al-gaa'ide foogna,Allah yagdar yisawwi ziyaada min kulla cheyy al-nas'alooh minnah wa ziyaada bilheen min ayyi cheyy al-gaa'id fi fikirna.
Wa khalli yimajjudu Allah daayman fi usut ummatah wa be l-Masiih Isa daayman wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Achaan kulla l-kalaam da,ana al-masjuun hini fi chaan Rabbina,niwassiiku.Iichu be l-haal al-muwaafge le l-naas al-Allah naadaahum.
Sawwu kulla cheyy be nafas baarid wa abgo daluuliin wa sabuuriin wa alhammalo al-waahidiin le l-aakhariin be mahabba.
Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus ja'alaaku cha'ab waahid.Jaahudu achaan al-wihda ma tatlaf wa ahfado al-wihda di be l-salaam.
Jisim al-Masiih waahid bas wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus,hu kula waahid bas.Wa misil da,al-acham al-Allah naadaaku le talgooh kula waahid.
Wa Rabbina hu waahid wa iimaanna waahid wa khattisiinna kula waahid.
Wa Allah hu waahid wa hu abuuna kullina.Wa hu Rabb kulla cheyy wa gaa'id foogna kullina wa mawjuud ma'aana kullina.
Wa laakin ayyi waahid minnina ligi atiiye khaassa min al-Masiih al-antaaha hasab rahmatah achaan beeha nakhdumu leyah.
Wa achaan da,al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Wakit hu tala' foog fi l-aali,hu chaal ma'aayah masaajiin wa anta le l-naas ataaya.‍﴿
Wa hu tala' foog,ma'anaatah chunu-?Ma'anaatah al-Masiih awwal nazal tihit wa dakhal fi lubb al-ard.
Wa l-nazal da,hu bas al-tala' foog fi l-samaawaat achaan gudurtah tamla kulla cheyy.
Wa hu bas al-anta ataaya le l-naas.Wa naas waahidiin,hu ja'alaahum rusul wa waahidiin ja'alaahum anbiya wa waahidiin ja'alaahum mubachchiriin wa waahidiin ja'alaahum chuyuukh wa mu'allimiin.
Wa antaahum ataaya achaan humman yijahhuzu cha'abah al-saalihiin le yakhdumu leyah fi chaan ummat al-Masiih tabga gawiiye.
Wa yisawwu khidmithum lahaddi kullina sawa nalhago al-wihda fi l-iimaan wa na'arfu Ibn Allah tamaam.Wa kullina nabgo aagliin lahaddi ayyi waahid yabga tamaam misil al-Masiih hu tamaam.
Wa misil da,ma nabgo battaan misil iyaal ma induhum sabaat.Aniina ma misil maraakib dugaag fi l-bahar al-yichiilhum al-challaal wa l-tusuughum al-riih.Wa da misil ta'liim al-ma sahiih wa l-najaada al-yukhuchchu beeha al-naas wa yiwadduruuhum.
Akheer niballukhu al-hagg be mahabba wa misil da,nakburu wa nabgo aagliin fi kulla cheyy be alaakhitna ma'a l-Masiih.Hu bas raasna
wa beyah hu,al-jisim yabga waahid wa kulla l-mafaasil yinrabtu ambeenaathum.Wa wakit ayyi udu yisawwi khidimtah adiil,al-jisim al-kaamil yakbur wa yabga gawi be mahabba.
Wa daahu niwassiiku be usum al-Rabb,asma'o kalaami adiil.Ma ti'iichu battaan misil al-naas al-ma mu'miniin.Humman yitaabu'u al-fikir al-baatil.
Wa gaa'idiin fi l-dalaam wa ma faahimiin al-hagg.Wa ma ya'arfu al-haya al-Allah yidoor yantiiha leehum achaan al-jahal gaa'id fooghum wa raashum bigi gawi.
Guluubhum maytiin wa sallamo nufuushum le chahwaathum al-fasliin.Wa be niiye waahide,yitaabu'u al-haal al-cheene.
Wa laakin intu allamtu min ta'liim al-Masiih haal chig min di.
Akiid,kalaam al-Masiih simi'tuuh wa be alaakhitku ma'aayah allamtu al-hagg achaan al-hagg gaa'id fi Isa.
Fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss al-haal al-intu awwal aaychiin beeha,waajib tikhalluuha minku marra waahid wa ma titaabu'u battaan haalku al-gadiime.Awwal haalku di khachchatku wa waddaratku.
Wa simi'tu waajib talgo min Allah al-agul al-jadiid
wa waajib tichiilu minnah al-haal al-jadiide wa tabgo naas judaad al-tichaabuhu Allah fi haalku.Khalli haalku tabga adiile wa saalhe be l-sahiih.
Wa achaan da,abadan ma takdubu.Kallumu ambeenaatku be l-sahiih achaan aniina kullina waahid.
Kan zi'iltu,ma taznubu.Khallu za'alku gabul al-harraay ma taga'
achaan ma tantu fursa le Ibliis.
Kan naadum awwal sarraag,khalli ma yasrig battaan.Fi badal al-sirge,khalli yakhdim be wakharah wa duraa'ah.Wa misil da,min ujurtah yagdar yakrub nafsah wa yisaa'id al-naas al-muhtaajiin.
Abadan ma tihajju kalaam cheen.Waajib tihajju daayman kalaam sameh al-yigawwi al-naas wa l-kalaam al-muwaafig leehum achaan yabga baraka le l-naas al-yasma'ooh.
Ma tihajju be kalaam fasil achaan al-kalaam al-fasil yiza''il al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-Allah nazzalah foogku.Hu al-wasim al-Allah yi'akkid beyah kadar yafdaaku marra waahid fi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Khalli al-za'al wa l-khabiine wa l-khadab wa l-huraaj wa l-gatii'e yabgo ma fiihum ambeenaatku wa khallu minku al-hasiife.
Sawwu al-zeen le ayyi naadum wa alhaanano.Wa assaamaho ambeenaatku misil Allah saamahaaku wakit rahamaaku be l-Masiih.
Intu iyaal Allah al-yihibbuku wa achaan da,khalli haalku tabga misil haalah.
Iichu be mahabba misil mahabbat al-Masiih al-yihibbina beeha lahaddi fadaana be ruuhah.Wa gaddam nafsah hadiiye misil dahiiye al-Allah yarda' be riihitha.
Laakin al-zina wa l-haal al-cheene wa l-tama',khalli yabgo ma fiihum ambeenaatku marra waahid.Wa ma tihajju fooghum abadan.Dool ma af'aal hana naas saalihiin.
Abadan ma tihajju kalaam cheen wa la kalaam hana safaaha wa abadan ma tal'abo ambeenaatku be kalaam fasil.Kulla l-kalaam al-misil da,ma waajib.Fi badalah,hajju be chukur.
Ni'akkid leeku kan naadum zannaay walla nijis walla tammaa',hu ma yalga cheyy fi mamlakat Allah wa l-Masiih.Al-tama' hu misil ibaadat al-asnaam.
Ma tikhallu naadum yukhuchchuku be kalaam baatil.Be sabab al-zunuub al-misil dool,Allah yinazzil khadabah foog al-aasiyiin.
Achaan da,ma tichaarukuuhum fi haalhum.
Awwal,intu bas al-dalaam wa laakin hassa',bigiitu nuur be alaakhitku ma'a l-Rabb.Iichu be l-haal al-waajbe le ahal al-nuur.
Achaan nuur Allah yijiib natiija fi guluub al-naas wa l-natiija di,hi al-kheer wa l-adaala wa l-hagg.
A'arfu tamaam al-cheyy al-yiraddi al-Rabb.
Ma tichaaruku fi amal hana ahal al-dalaam al-ma yijiib natiija adiile.Akheer takchif al-cheyy al-humman gaa'idiin yisawwuuh.
Achaan al-cheyy al-humman gaa'idiin yisawwuuh be talbiid cheen bilheen lahaddi nakhjalo kan nihajju beyah.
Achaan ayyi cheyy kan ankachaf fi l-nuur,khalaas yinchaaf.
Wa ayyi cheyy al-yinchaaf yin'arif be l-sahiih.Achaan da,nuguulu-:-Ya l-naayim,gumm foog-!Gumm min ust al-maytiin wa l-Masiih yidawwi nuurah foogak.
Fakkuru tamaam fi haalku.Ma ti'iichu be haal al-mukhaffaliin laakin be haal al-faahimiin.
Sawwu al-kheer fi ayyi fursa achaan al-zaman al-gaa'idiin foogah da fasil.
Ma tabgo juhhaal laakin afhamo al-cheyy al-yidoorah al-Rabb.
Ma taskaro be l-khamar achaan al-khamar yisabbib illa l-fasaad.Laakin khalli Allah yamlaaku be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Achchaaja'o ambeenaatku be khine wa anaachiid wa chukur min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Khannu wa achkuru Rabbina be kulla guluubku.
Achkuru Allah abuuna fi kulla wakit wa fi kulla cheyy be usum Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Abgo daluuliin ambeenaatku wa khalli ayyi waahid yikarrim al-aakhar fi chaan al-Masiih.
Asma'an,ya l-awiin,khalli ayyi mara tikarrim raajilha misil hi tikarrim al-Rabb.
Achaan al-raajil hu ra'iis martah misil al-Masiih hu ra'iis ummatah.Wa ummatah hi jismah wa hu zaatah munajji jismah.
Wa misil ummat al-Masiih tikarrim al-Masiih,khalli ayyi mara tikarrim raajilha fi kulla cheyy.
Asma'o,ya l-rujaal,hibbu awiinku misil al-Masiih yihibb ummatah al-fadaaha be ruuhah
achaan hi tabga umma khaassa.Hu tahharaaha be khattisiin fi almi wa be kalaam Allah
achaan yigaddimha le nafsah umma majiide bala najaasa wa la wasakh wa la ayyi cheyy al-yitallifha lahaddi tabga khaassa leyah wa bala ayyi eeb.
Wa kulla raajil waajib yihibb martah misil yihibb jildah.Al-yihibb martah yihibb nafsah.
Abadan ma fi raajil al-yakrah laham jismah.Be l-aks,hu yi'ayyichah wa yirayyisah misil al-Masiih yirayyis ummatah.
Wa ayyi waahid minnina udu min jismah.
Wa l-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Be sabab da,ayyi raajil yikhalli ammah wa abuuh wa yilimm ma'a martah wa l-naaseen yabgo jisim waahid.‍﴿
Al-kalaam da sirr aziim.Ana nuguul leeku al-kalaam da bukhuss al-Masiih wa ummatah.
Wa bukhussuku intu kula.Ayyi raajil minku waajib yihibb martah misil yihibb nafsah wa ayyi mara waajib tikarrim raajilha.
Asma'o,ya l-iyaal,al-Rabb yidoor intu tasma'o kalaam waaldeenku.Da bas al-waajib tisawwuuh.
Maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Karrim ammak wa abuuk.‍﴿Wa min al-wasaaya,di bas al-wasiiye al-awwal al-indaha wa'ad.
Wa l-wa'ad hu-:﴾‍Achaan talga al-kheer wa umrak yabga tawiil fi l-ard.‍﴿
Asma'o,ya abbahaat al-iyaal,ma tiza''ulu iyaalku laakin rabbuuhum fi l-adab wa ta'liim al-Rabb.
Asma'o,ya l-abiid,taabu'u kalaam al-naas al-fi l-dunya di humman siyaadku.Aywa,karrumuuhum wa akhaafo minhum.Akhdumu leehum be niiye waahide misil intu gaa'idiin takhdumu le l-Masiih.
Akhdumu leehum ma fi chaan humman gaa'idiin yichiifuuku bas.Ma tukhuttu baalku fi chukur al-naas.Laakin khuttu fi fikirku intu abiid le l-Masiih wa sawwu al-yidoorah Allah be niiye mukhlisa.
Akhdumu leehum be farah misil khidmitku hi le Rabbina wa ma le l-naas bas.
Khalli ta'arfu kadar ayyi naadum minnina yalga ajur min al-Rabb ale hasab al-kheer al-hu sawwaah,kan hu abid walla hurr.
Asma'o,ya siyaad al-abiid,tabbugu nafs al-ta'liim.Wa ma tihaddudu abiidku.Ma tanso kadar intu wa abiidku kulluku abiid hana siid waahid.Wa hu al-gaa'id fi l-samaawaat wa ma yichiif naadum akheer min naadum.
Wa aakhir cheyy,abgo gawiyiin fi alaakhitku ma'a l-Rabb wa be gudurtah al-aziime.
Albaso silaah Allah al-kaamil achaan tagoodu beyah saabtiin wa najaadit Ibliis ma tinnasir foogku.
Aniina ma nihaarubu adu min al-naas.Laakin fi l-zaman al-haadir da,al-dunya gaa'ide fi l-dalaam wa fiyah chawaatiin al-gaa'idiin yamulkuuha.Wa aniina gaa'idiin nihaarubu hukkaam wa kubaaraat al-chawaatiin dool,al-humman askar Ibliis al-gaa'idiin fi l-samaawaat.
Achaan da bas,albaso silaah Allah al-kaamil achaan tagoodu saabtiin wakit Ibliis yahjimku.Wa ba'ad kulla l-duwaas yikammil,tagoodu saabtiin battaan.
Achaan da,agoodu saabtiin,sulubku marbuut be l-hagg.Khalli al-haal al-saalhe tabga leeku dire' gawi fi sadurku.
Abgo daayman chajii'iin le tiballukhu bichaarat al-salaam wa da yabga leeku misil ni'le adiiliin fi rijleeku.
Wa ziidu ale l-silaah da al-iimaan wa khalli yabga leeku daraga.Ibliis al-chariir yidoor yizarrigku be nachaachiibah al-induhum fi raashum naar wa be l-iimaan taktulu al-niiraan dool.
Wa khalli al-naja tabga leeku taagiiye hint harib.Wa akurbu gawi kalaam Allah al-hu misil seef hana l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa khallu al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yuguudku fi salaawaatku wa as'alo Allah fi kulla wakit be kulla anwaa' hana du'a wa talab.Wa misil da,agoodu waa'iyiin wa ankarbu fi salaawaatku wa as'alo Allah le kulla l-saalihiin.
Wa as'alo Allah leyi ana zaati achaan fi ayyi wakit al-nidoor nihajji be kalaam Allah,khalli hu yantiini al-kalaam al-waajib leyi.Nidoor nihajji bala khoof wa nifassir le l-naas sirr Allah al-bayyanah fi bichaarat al-Masiih.
Wa fi chaan al-bichaara,ana bigiit safiir wa be sababha karabooni fi l-sijin.Khalli Allah yantiini gudra achaan niballikhha bala khoof wa nikallim misil waajib.
Wa khalaas,akhuuna Tichiikus yi'ooriiku be kulla khabari.Hu akhuuna al-nihibbuuh wa yakhdim le Rabbina be amaan.
Wa hu yikhabbirku be haalitna wa yichajji'ku wa be sabab da bas,rassaltah leeku.
Wa khalli kulla l-akhwaan yalgo al-salaam wa l-mahabba ma'a l-iimaan min Allah abuuna wa Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Wa l-ni'ma le kulla l-naas al-yihibbu Rabbina Isa al-Masiih be l-mahabba al-ma tikammil abadan.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus wa Timuutaawus abiid Isa al-Masiih,leeku intu kulluku al-bigiitu saalihiin be Isa al-Masiih al-fi hillit Filibbi ma'a masaa'iilku wa mu'aawiniinhum.
Fi ayyi wakit kan fakkart leeku,nachkur Allah Rabbi.
Wa ayyi wakit nisalli le Allah,nas'alah leeku kulluku be farah.
Ana farhaan minku achaan intu chaaraktu ma'aayi fi ballikhiin bichaarat al-Masiih min awwal wakit ana jiit leeku lahaddi l-yoom.
Wa ana mu'akkid kadar Allah,al-bada khidimtah al-adiile foogku,hu yisawwiiha daayman lahaddi yitammimha fi yoom jayyit al-Masiih Isa.
Wa waajib leyi nihiss beeku kulluku misil da achaan galbi daayman ma'aaku.Wa nihibbuku achaan intu kulluku muchaarikiin ma'aayi fi ni'mat Allah.Wa intu daayman muchaarikiin ma'aayi wakit ana gaa'id mujanzar fi l-sijin wa wakit ana gaa'id nidaafi' le bichaarat al-Masiih wa nisabbitha le l-naas.
Wa Allah yachhad leyi,ana garmaan bilheen leeku kulluku be mahabbat al-Masiih Isa.
Wa ana gaa'id nas'al Allah achaan hu yiziid mahabbitku wa yikattirha leeku be ziyaada.Wa khalli yantiiku ma'aaha ilim wa fihim tamaam
achaan ta'arfu kikkeef timayyuzu daayman al-cheyy al-afdal.Wa khalaas ti'iichu be niiye mukhlisa wa bala eeb wa tabgo jaahiziin le l-yoom al-yaji foogah al-Masiih.
Wa tabgo saalihiin wa malaaniin be l-kheer al-jaayi min Isa al-Masiih.Wa khalaas,al-majd wa l-chukur le Allah.
Ya akhwaani,nidoor intu ta'arfu kadar al-ta'ab al-lihigaani hini saa'ad bichaarat al-Masiih wa hi alwassa'at ziyaada.
Achaan bigi waadih le kulla askar hana gasir al-waali wa le kulla l-naas al-aakhariin kadar ana masjuun fi chaan ana abd al-Masiih.
Wa fi l-sijin,ana bigiit masal le l-akhwaan al-fi l-hille di.Wa katiiriin minhum achamhum fi Rabbina bigi gawi ziyaada.Wa ligo chajaa'a lahaddi gammo yihajju be kalaam Allah bala khoof.
Sahiih,waahidiin minhum gaa'idiin yibachchuru be l-Masiih wa da,achaan yahsuduuni wa yikhaasumuuni laakin aakhariin yibachchuru be niiye adiile.
Al-akhwaan dool yibachchuru achaan yihibbuuni wa ya'arfu Allah jaabaani hini achaan nidaafi' le l-bichaara.
Wa laakin al-hasuudiin dool yiballukhu be l-Masiih be niiye ma mukhlisa.Yidooru yukhuttu nufuushum giddaam.Wa fi fikirhum,ballikhiinhum yabga leyi gaasi wakit ana mujanzar fi l-sijin.
Wa kan leyi ana,da ma yisawwi leyi cheyy.Kan niiyithum fasle walla niiyithum adiile kula,be ayyi tariiga humman gaa'idiin yiballukhu kalaam al-Masiih wa be da,ana farhaan.Aywa,battaan kula nafrah
achaan na'arif kadar Allah yinajjiini wa da be sabab intu gaa'idiin tas'alooh leyi wa Ruuh Isa al-Masiih yi'aawinni.
Wa nitmanna be niiye waahide wa be acham gawi kadar ma nafchul fi ayyi cheyy.Wa nidoor nikallim misil daayman kallamt be chajaa'a wa bala khoof wa ni'azzim al-Masiih giddaam al-naas fi kulla hayaati,kan ni'iich walla numuut kula.
Achaan leyi ana,al-haya illa ma'a l-Masiih.Wa l-moot indah leyi faayde be ziyaada.
Wa kan Allah yidoor ma nifaarig al-dunya di,khalaas ana nakhdim khidme samhe le l-Masiih.Laakin been al-haya wa l-moot,ma na'arif nichiil weenu.
Indi chahwaat itneen al-gaa'idiin yiddaawaso foogi.Nidoor nifaarig al-dunya wa nagood ma'a l-Masiih achaan da bas al-afdal.
Wa laakin waajib be ziyaada nagood hayy fi l-dunya di achaan hayaati indaha faayde leeku.
Wa da,bigi leyi waadih.Kan ma numuut yabga leeku akheer.Wa khalaas,na'arif kadar nagood hayy ma'aaku sawa achaan intu tabgo gawiyiin wa farhaaniin fi l-iimaan be ziyaada.
Wa be misil da wakit nigabbil leeku,intu tifaachuru ziyaada be Isa al-Masiih be sababi ana.
Laakin khalli ti'iichu be l-haal al-muwaafge le bichaarat al-Masiih.Wa misil da,kan naji nichiifku walla kan ana ba'iid minku kula,khalaas nasma' kalaam fiiku al-yuguul intu saabtiin be fikir waahid wa hadaf waahid wa intu gaa'idiin tihaarubu sawa fi chaan al-iimaan al-ligiituuh min bichaarat al-Masiih.
Ma tikhallu al-khoof yisawwiiku be sabab ayyi khidme al-yisawwuuha al-naas al-yikhaalufuuku.Wa da yabga leehum alaama al-tiwassif kadar humman fi derib al-halaak wa intu fi derib al-naja.Wa l-yinajjiiku,hu Allah.
Achaan Allah antaaku rahma wa be l-rahma di,intu ma ti'aamunu be l-Masiih bas laakin tat'abo fi chaanah kula.
Wa khalaas,intu gaa'idiin tichaaruku fi nafs al-harib al-ana gaa'id nihaarib foogah.Wa l-harib da,intu chiftuuh awwal wakit ana lissaa' gaa'id ma'aaku.Wa hassa' kula,simi'tu kadar ana gaa'id nihaarib misil da battaan.
Hal ligiitu chajaa'a be alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih walla-?Wa mahabbitah raggadat guluubku walla-?Wa chaaraktu sawa fi gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus walla-?Wa ligiitu min al-Masiih mahanna katiire walla-?
Khalaas,ziidu farhiti wa khalli fikirku yabga waahid.Arraayado ambeenaatku be mahabba waahide.Wa astafugu ambeenaatku marra waahid be hadaf waahid.
Wa ma tisawwu cheyy min al-husud wa l-istikbaar.Khalli ayyi waahid yimaskin nafsah wa yichiif akhwaanah akheer min nafsah.
Khalli ayyi waahid ma yifakkir fi l-cheyy al-yijiib faayde leyah hu wiheedah bas,laakin khalli yukhutt baalah fi l-cheyy al-yijiib faayde le l-aakhariin.
Al-fikir al-intu waajib titaabu'uuh,hu nafs al-fikir al-Isa al-Masiih taaba'ah.
Min awwal hu indah tabii'at Allahlaakin ma dawwar yamsuk le nafsahgudurtah al-rabbaaniiye.
Be l-aks,hu khalla minnah kulla cheyywa sawwa nafsah misil abidwa khassad yaldooh wa yabga insaan.
Wa wakit bigi naadum,hu maskan nafsahwa bigi taayi' lahaddi l-mootwa khassad yumuut moot cheen fi l-saliib.
Achaan da,Allah rafa'ah foog marra waahidwa antaah usum aali min kulla l-asaame
lahaddi ayyi waahid yicharrif usum Isafi l-sama wa fi l-ard wa tihit al-ardwa yarka' giddaamah.
Wa lahaddi ayyi waahid yachhad wa yuguulkadar Isa al-Masiih hu al-Rabbwa yimajjid Allah abuuh.
Fi chaan kulla l-kalaam da,ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,asma'o kalaami.Wakit ana ma'aaku,intu daayman titaabu'u kalaam Allah.Wa hassa' wakit ana ma ma'aaku,waajib titaabu'uuh be ziyaada.Jaahudu be khoof wa rajifiin le tisawwu kulla cheyy al-waajib le l-naas al-Allah najjaahum.
Achaan Allah hu al-gaa'id yisawwi amalah foogku wa hu yantiiku al-niiye wa l-gudra le tisawwu al-cheyy al-adiil al-yarda beyah.
Fi kulla cheyy ma tachku wa la tihaaruju ambeenaatku.
Achaan tabgo naas bala khata wa bariyiin wa ti'iichu misil iyaal Allah bala eeb fi usut al-naas al-fasliin wa uwuj hana l-dunya di.Wa tabgo fi usuthum nuur misil al-nujuum fi l-aalam al-adlam
achaan intu munkaribiin fi kalaam al-haya.Wa kan tabgo misil da,nagdar narfa' raasi foog fi yoom jayyit al-Masiih.Wa na'arif ta'abi wa khidimti al-khadamtaha leyah ma fachalat.
Wa hatta kan dammi waajib yidaffig misil hadiiyat charaab fi l-dahiiye al-tigaddumuuha le Allah fi chaan iimaanku wa khidmitku,khalaas ana nafrah wa ninbasit ma'aaku kulluku.
Wa waajib intu kula tabgo farhaaniin wa tafraho ma'aayi.
Wa ba'ad chiyya,nitmanna nirassil leeku Timuutaawus kan da al-yidoorah Rabbina Isa.Nidoor nirassilah achaan hu yichajji'ni wakit yigabbil yijiib leyi khabarku.
Ma fi naadum aakhar al-yihimm beeku misli ana,illa hu bas.Yihimm beeku be niiye mukhlisa.
Kulla l-aakhariin yukhuttu baalhum fi l-cheyy al-yijiib faayde leehum humman wa ma fi l-cheyy al-yijiib faayde le Isa al-Masiih.
Laakin akiid intu ta'arfu kikkeef Timuutaawus wassaf sabaatah.Min wakit tawiil,hu gaa'id yakhdim ma'aayi fi ballikhiin bichaarat al-Masiih misil wileed al-yakhdim ma'a abuuh.
Achaan da wakit na'arif chunu yabga leyi hini,nitmanna nirassilah leeku tawwaali.
Wa indi acham foog Rabbina kadar ba'ad wakit chiyya bas,ana zaati namchi leeku.
Wa fi fikri ana,waajib leyi nirassil leeku akhuuyi Abfariid al-gaa'id yakhdim ma'aayi wa nijaahudu sawa.Sahiih,intu bas rassaltuuh leyi achaan fi ta'abi hu yisaa'idni.
Laakin hu gaa'id yagram leeku kulluku wa bigi leyah gaasi achaan intu simi'tu khabar hana maradah.
Wa be l-sahiih,awwal hu mardaan bilheen wa gariib yumuut.Laakin Allah hanna foogah wa ma foogah hu wiheedah bas,laakin foogi ana kula achaan ma yiziid le hizni hizin aakhar battaan.
Wa chilt niiye nirassilah leeku ajala achaan be jaytah,intu tafraho battaan wa ana kamaan galbi yargud.
Wa khalaas,akurbuuh be usum al-Rabb be farha kabiire.Wa nuguul leeku waajib tikarrumu be ziyaada ayyi naadum mislah hu.
Awwal hu gariib yumuut fi chaan khidimtah le l-Masiih wa dassa nafsah fi khutuura chadiide achaan yijiib leyi musaa'ada al-intu ma tagdaro tijiibuuha leyi.
Wa khalaas,ya akhwaani,afraho be Rabbina Isa.Ma gaasi leyi naktib leeku nafs al-cheyy al-awwal ooreetku beyah wa nikarrirah battaan achaan da yabga leeku akiid.
Aw'u baalku min al-kulaab-!Humman al-yisawwu al-charr.Yafraho be gati'iin min al-jisim wa nuguul leeku battaan aw'u baalku minhum-!
Yuguulu humman al-mutahhariin.Laakin aniina bas al-naas al-mutahhariin be l-sahiih,aniina al-na'abudu Allah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa nifaachuru be l-Masiih Isa wa abadan ma nintaklu ale jilidna.
Wa hasab kalaamhum,ana indi hagg nintakil ale jildi.Ayyi naadum al-yuguul hu indah hagg yintakil ale jildah,ana indi hagg ziyaada minnah.
Ana tahharooni fi l-yoom al-taamin min yoom wildooni.Wa ana min zurriiyit Bani Israa'iil wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Ana Ibraani miya fi l-miya.Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat,ana min tariigat al-Fariiziiya.
Wa ana bigiit munkarib bilheen fi diini al-Yahuudi lahaddi haawalt nidammir ummat al-Masiih.Wa hasab kalaamhum fi churuut al-Tawraat,ana bigiit naadum saalih wa ma indi eeb.
Laakin kulla cheyy al-awwal ja'altah hu indah faayde da,ana khalleetah minni wa ja'altah misil cheyy saakit fi chaan al-Masiih.
Aywa wa ziyaada min da,irfit al-Masiih Isa Rabbi bigat leyi akheer min kulla cheyy wa naj'al kulla cheyy aakhar saakit.Fi chaan al-Masiih,ana khalleet kulla cheyy al-indi.Wa kulla cheyy al-awwal indah leyi faayde,ja'altah misil wasakh achaan nalga al-faayde al-kabiire wa hi al-alaakha ma'a l-Masiih.
Wa nidoor alaakhti ma'aayah tabga kaamile.Wa be misil da,ma naj'al nafsi saalih be tabbigiin churuut al-Tawraat laakin nabga saalih be iimaani be l-Masiih achaan al-derib al-Allah yisawwi beyah al-naas saalihiin,hu derib al-iimaan.
Wa nijaahid achaan na'arif al-Masiih tamaam wa ni'iich be gudrat bu'aasah wa nichaarik ma'aayah fi ta'abah.Wa nidoor nabga misil hu bigi fi mootah
wa khalaas be ayyi daliil,nalhag fi l-akhiir bu'aas al-maytiin.
Wa ma nuguul tammeet makhsuudi khalaas wa bigiit naadum tamaam.Laakin ana nijaahid le namulkah achaan al-Masiih Isa mallakaani le namluk al-makhsuud da.
Ya akhwaani,abadan ma nukhutt fi fikri kadar ana malakt al-makhsuud khalaas.Laakin nisawwi cheyy waahid bas,nansa al-wara wa nifakkir fi l-giddaam.
Wa nijaahid achaan nitammim al-makhsuud wa nalga al-jaa'iza wa hi al-baraka al-Allah yidoor yantiiha le l-naas al-naadaahum fi majdah be l-Masiih Isa.
Wa khalaas,khalli kullina al-bigiina gawiyiin fi l-iimaan nitaabu'u nafs al-fikir.Wa kan fikirku chig min al-fikir da,khalli da kula Allah yiwassifah leeku.
Khalli ayyi waahid yi'iich hasab ma'rafat al-Masiih al-ligiiha wa yamchi giddaam.
Ya akhwaani,khalli kulluku titaabu'u masali wa chiifu adiil al-naas al-aaychiin misilna wa fakkuru fi haalhum.
Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan fi naas katiiriin yisawwu nufuushum adu le saliib al-Masiih misil ooreetku beyah iddat marraat.Wa battaan ni'ooriiku beyah be hizin chadiid wa dumuu'.
Wa fi l-akhiir,humman yamchu fi l-halaak.Butuunhum bigo leehum rabbuhum wa achaan da,yitaabu'u chahwaathum bas.Al-cheyy al-yi'ayyibhum,da bas al-yifaachuru beyah.Wa uguulhum saabtiin fi khumaam al-dunya bas.
Laakin jinsiiyitna aniina,hi al-jinsiiya al-samaawiiye.Wa aniina narjo munajjiina al-yaji min al-sama wa khaattiin baalna fi jaytah wa hu Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Wa be gudurtah al-aziime al-yukhutt beeha kulla cheyy tihit hukmah,hu yaji yikhayyir jisimna al-da'iif wa yaj'alah misil jismah hu al-majiid.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,ana muchtaag leeku katiir wa nafrah beeku wa fi chaanku intu,narfa' raasi foog.Ya l-mahbuubiin,agoodu saabtiin fi Rabbina Isa.
Ya akhutna Afuudiiya,ya akhutna Sintikha,natlub minkan achaan tistafigan ambeenaatkan wa titaabi'an Rabbina be fikir waahid.
Wa inta,ya rafiigi al-amiin,natlub minnak inta tisaa'id al-awiin deel.Saa'idhin be sabab hinna khadaman ma'aayi fi chaan bichaarat al-Masiih.Hinna jaahadan sawa ma'a akhuuna Kileemaan wa l-aakhariin al-yakhdumu ma'aayi.Al-naas dool,asaameehum maktuubiin fi Kitaab al-Haya.
Afraho be Rabbina Isa daayman wa battaan nuguul leeku,afraho-!
Khalli ruuhku tabga tawiile giddaam ayyi naadum.Rabbina Isa gariib.
Ma tihimmu le ayyi cheyy laakin fi kulli haal,achkuru Allah wa gaddumu leyah talabku be sala wa du'a.
Wa Allah yantiiku salaamah al-faayit fikir al-naas.Wa khalli salaam Allah yahfad guluubku wa afkaarku wa tagoodu saabtiin fi l-Masiih Isa.
Ya akhwaani,di hi aakhir wasiiye al-nantiiha leeku.Fakkuru fi ayyi cheyy al-sahiih wa l-chariif wa l-aadil wa l-taahir wa l-mahbuub wa l-kariim wa l-afdal wa l-waajib leyah al-chukur.Wa kulla cheyy al-misil da,khuttu afkaarku foogah saabtiin.
Wa tabbugu daayman kulla cheyy al-allamtuuh minni wa ligiituuh minni,kan min kalaami al-simi'tuuh walla min haali al-chiftuuha.Wa Allah Rabb al-salaam yukuun ma'aaku.
Ana farhaan bilheen wa gaa'id nachkur Rabbina kadar fi l-akhiir,intu chiltu niiye achaan tisaa'uduuni battaan.Be l-sahiih,awwal kula induku niiye laakin ma induku fursa.
Wa ana ma gaa'id nachki leeku min al-maskana.Achaan ana allamt kikkeef ni'iich fi ayyi haal.
Na'arif kikkeef ni'iich fi l-maskana aw fi l-khuna.Ana allamt kikkeef nabga radyaan fi ayyi bakaan wa fi kulli haal,kan ana chab'aan walla jii'aan wa kan indi katiir walla chiyya.
Nagdar nilhammal ayyi cheyy be l-Masiih wa hu yantiini gudra.
Laakin al-cheyy al-sawweetuuh leyi sameh bilheen.Intu chaaraktu ma'aayi fi ta'abi.
Ya akhwaani naas Filibbi,intu ta'arfu kadar awwal marra jiit ballakht bichaarat al-Masiih leeku wa futt giddaam min balad Magiduuniya,intu wiheedku chaaraktu ma'aayi.Ma fi jamaa'at mu'miniin aakhara al-awwal anteethum kalaam Allah wa ba'adeen humman antooni musaa'ada.
Wakit ana lissaa' ma khalleet Magiduuniya wa gaa'id fi hillit Tasaluuniiki,intu rassaltu leyi musaa'ada aktar min marra.
Gult al-kalaam da,ma achaan nidoor minku musaa'ada battaan laakin achaan ayyi cheyy al-tantuuh fi chaan Rabbina,hu yakhbalah wa yukhuttah fi makhazan al-hasanaat.
Wa kulla cheyy al-ana nidoorah,ligiitah khalaas ziyaada min al-nidoorah.Akhuuku Abfariid jaab al-musaa'ada al-rassaltuuha leyi wa khalaas,ana mabsuut.Wa l-musaa'ada di hi misil hadiiye le Allah al-riihitha hu yarda beeha wa yakhbalha.
Wa ana na'arif kadar Allah yantiiku be katara kulla cheyy al-tihtaajo leyah.Aywa,yantiiku min khunaayah al-majiid be l-Masiih Isa.
Wa Allah abuuna,waajib leyah al-majd daayman wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Sallumu kulla l-naas al-bigo saalihiin be l-Masiih Isa.Wa l-akhwaan al-gaa'idiin ma'aayi yisallumuuku.
Kulla l-saalihiin al-gaa'idiin hini yisallumuuku wa khaassatan al-naas al-min beet al-sultaan.
Aleekum rahmat al-Rabb Isa al-Masiih.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus rasuul Isa al-Masiih be izin Allah wa daahu naktib ma'a akhuuna Timuutaawus
leeku intu akhwaanna fi l-Masiih al-saalihiin wa amiiniin al-saakniin fi hillit Kuluusi.Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma min Allah abuuna.
Nachkuru Allah abu Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Wa fi ayyi wakit,nas'alooh leeku
achaan simi'na be iimaanku fi l-Masiih Isa wa simi'na be hubbuku le kulla l-saalihiin.
Wa intu saabtiin fi iimaanku wa mahabbitku achaan intu gaa'idiin tarjo be acham al-baraka al-Allah hafadaaha leeku fi l-sama.Wa simi'tu beeha fi kalaam al-hagg wa hu bichaarat al-Masiih al-ballakhooha leeku min awwal.
Wa bichaarat al-Masiih gaa'ide tijiib natiija wa tilwazza' fi l-dunya.Wa da misil hi gaa'ide tisawwiih fi usutku min yoom intu simi'tu be ni'mat Allah wa iriftuuha be sahiih.
Wa intu simi'tu bichaarat al-Masiih min khachum habiibna Abfuraas al-hu abd al-Masiih misilna.Hu gaa'id yakhdim le l-Masiih be amaan wa yimassilna fi usutku.
Wa hu ooraana be l-mahabba al-ligiituuha min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa achaan da min yoom simi'na khabar iimaanku,aniina gaa'idiin nas'alo leeku Allah.Wa nas'alo leeku Allah achaan ta'arfu al-hu yidoorah wa talgo hikma wa fihim min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa misil da,ta'arfu kikkeef ti'iichu be haal al-waajbe le naas al-Rabb wa tisawwu daayman al-cheyy al-hu yarda beyah wa tisawwu kulla amal al-kheer wa ta'arfu Allah be ziyaada.
Wa fi kulli wakit,khalli Allah yigawwiiku be gudurtah al-majiide achaan tahmalo al-ta'ab wa tasburu foogah be farah
wa tachkuru daayman Allah abuuku al-ja'alaaku jaahiziin le tichaaruku fi warasat al-saalihiin fi mamlakat al-nuur.
Aywa,Allah faza'aana wa maragaana min muluk al-dalaam wa waddaana fi mamlakat Ibnah al-yiriidah.
Wa hu bas al-fadaana wa jaab leena khufraan al-zunuub.
Al-Masiih hu suurat Allahal-ma binchaaf.Hu Ibn Allah gaa'id gabul al-khaliigewa mukallaf be kulla cheyy al-Allah khalagah.
Achaan beyah hu,Allah khalag kulla cheyyal-fi l-samaawaat wa fi l-ard,al-binchaaf wa l-ma binchaaf,wa ayyi makhluug al-indah arch aw mulukwa kan hu haakim aw kabiir.Allah khalag kulla cheyy be waasitat Ibnahwa fi chaanah hu.
Ibn Allah hu gubbaal kulla cheyywa be gudurtah kulla cheyy gaa'id saabit.
Hu bas raas al-jisimwa l-jisim hu ummat al-Masiih.Wa hu al-bidaayawa awwal naadum al-ba'as min ust al-maytiin.Wa Allah sawwa misil daachaan Ibnah yabga al-awwal fi kulli cheyy.
Wa l-Masiih hu misil daachaan Allah radyaankadar kulla sifaatah yagoodu foogah kaamiliin.
Wa be waasitat al-Masiih,Allah dawwar yisaalih kulli cheyy ma'aayah,al-gaa'idiin fi l-ard aw fi l-samaawaat.Hu sawwa al-suluh da be damm Ibnahal-maat fi l-saliib.
Wa fi l-wakit al-faat,intu ma induku alaakha ma'a Allah wa bigiitu udwaanah be fikirku wa gaa'idiin tisawwu al-fasaala.
Wa laakin hassa',Allah sawwa suluh ma'aaku be waasitat Ibnah al-ja be jisim insaani.Wa Ibnah maat le yisawwiiku naas khaassiin wa yigaddimku le Allah bala khata wa bala eeb.
Wa da kula yabga leeku kan tagoodu saabtiin wa gawiyiin fi l-iimaan wa ma khalleetu achamku al-awwal ligiituuh wakit simi'tu bichaarat al-Masiih.Wa l-bichaara di,ballakhooha le kulla makhluug fi l-ard wa ana Buulus bigiit khaddaamah achaan niballikh al-bichaara le l-naas.
Wa ana farhaan be ta'abi achaan ana gaa'id nat'ab fi chaanku.Wa fi jismi,nahmal kulla l-ta'ab al-yigassir le l-Masiih fi chaan ummatah al-hi jismah.
Ana bigiit khaddaam le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin achaan Allah kallafaani be l-khidme di wa nakhdim fi chaanku.Wa khidimti hi niballikh kalaam Allah al-kaamil.
Wa niballikh al-sirr al-Allah abadan ma bayyanah le naas hana ayyi zaman al-faat wa laakin hassa' hu bayyanah le naasah al-saalihiin.
Wa Allah chaal niiye achaan yi'ooriihum kadar al-sirr da yijiib baraka kabiire wa majiide bilheen le kulla l-umam.Wa sirr Allah,hu al-Masiih zaatah yagood fiiku wa da yantiiku acham tadkhulu fi majdah.
Wa niballukhu al-naas be l-Masiih.Wa nikhabburu ayyi naadum wa ni'allumu ayyi naadum be kulli hikma achaan ayyi insaan yukuun kaamil fi l-Masiih.
Wa ana gaa'id nat'ab wa nijaahid fi l-khidme di be l-gudra al-hu yantiini min gudurtah al-aziime.
Wa nidoor intu ta'arfu kadar ana gaa'id nijaahid bilheen fi chaanku wa fi chaan al-akhwaan al-gaa'idiin fi hillit Laawdikiiya wa kulla l-akhwaan al-aakhariin al-yoom waahid ma chaafooni.
Wa nijaahid achaan yalgo chajaa'a fi guluubhum wa wihda be l-mahabba wa fihim tamaam malaan be baraka.Nidoor kadar ya'arfu wa yafhamo sirr Allah ya'ni al-Masiih.
Wa l-Masiih,hu makhazan hana Allah al-khazan foogah kulla barakaat al-ilim wa l-irfe.
Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan ma tikhallu ayyi naadum yukhuchchuku be kalaam halu wa yiwaddiiku fi derib aakhar.
Sahiih,ana gaa'id fi bakaan ba'iid minku laakin fikri daayman ma'aaku wa gaa'id nichiif kadar haalku adiile wa iimaanku fi l-Masiih gawi wa ana farhaan minku.
Achaan da,nuguul leeku awwal intu simi'tu kadar al-Masiih Isa hu bas al-Rabb wa aamantu beyah wa khalaas waajib titaabu'u derbah tamaam.
Khalli yabga leeku al-ga'ar wa l-asaas wa agoodu saabtiin foogah be iimaanku misil awwal allamooku leyah.Wa achkuru Allah katiir fi kulli wakit.
Khuttu baalku achaan naadum ma yukhuchchuku.Fiyah naas yi'allumu be ta'liim baatil al-yukhuchchu beyah al-naas.Fikirhum da jaayi min aadaat juduudhum bas wa min churuut aadaat al-dunya wa ma jaayi min al-Masiih.
Ma tasma'o kalaamhum achaan fi jisim al-Masiih bas Allah saakin be kulla sifaatah
wa be alaakhitku ma'a l-Masiih induku kulla barakaatah.Hu bas ra'iis fi kulla cheyy al-indah hukum walla sulta.
Wa fi l-Masiih,intu bigiitu mutahhariin be tahuura chig min al-tahuura al-yisawwuuha al-naas.Fi tahuurat al-naas,yagta'o jilde sakhayre.Wa laakin fi tahuurat al-Masiih,hu sallam nafsah le l-moot wa fi l-moot da,khalla minnah jismah kulla ke.Wa intu chaaraktu fi l-tahuura di.
Wa wakit intu khattasooku,chaaraktu ma'aayah fi mootah wa chaaraktu fi bu'aasah be iimaanku be gudrat Allah al-ba'asah min ust al-maytiin.
Awwal be sabab khataayaaku,intu maytiin wa ma min cha'ab Allah al-mutahhariin.Wa laakin Allah antaaku al-haya al-jadiide ma'a l-Masiih wa khafar leeku kulla khataayaaku.
Wa l-maktuub al-Allah sajjal foogah kulla zunuubna al-yihaasibna beehum hasab al-churuut,hu gachchaah marra waahid be moot al-Masiih fi l-saliib.
Wa be misil da,hu dammar al-gudra al-beeha hukkaam wa kubaaraat al-chawaatiin yahkumuuna.Wa hu ayyabaahum giddaam kulla l-naas.Hu annasar fooghum fi saliib al-Masiih wa sawwaahum misil masaajiin al-harb al-yusuuguuhum ba'ad anhazamo.
Wa achaan kulla l-kalaam da,ma tikhallu ayyi naadum yuluumku fi cheyy al-taakuluuh walla tacharbooh walla fi ayyi iid al-ti'ayyuduuh wa fi awwal yoom hana kulli chahar wa fi yoom al-sabt.
Kulla l-khumaam da,hu alaama hana l-cheyy al-muhimm al-yaji waraayah.Laakin al-cheyy al-muhimm,hu al-Masiih zaatah wa hu ja khalaas.
Angar'u min kulla l-naas al-yidooru yisawwuuku tabgo daluuliin bilheen fi l-ibaada wa yisawwuuku tasjudu le l-malaa'ika.Naas misil dool yadharooku ma talgo al-nasur.Humman yihajju katiir be l-cheyy al-humman buguulu chaafooh fi l-ru'ya wa yistakbaro bala sabab.Afkaarhum afkaar al-insaan bas.
Wa l-naadum da ma marbuut ma'a l-Masiih al-hu raas al-umma.Wa l-Masiih bas yi'ayyich kulla ummatah wa yisawwiiha misil jisim waahid.Wa hu bas al-yisawwi mafaasil al-jisim yinrabtu ambeenaathum.Wa jismah yabga kabiir be gudrat Allah.
Akiid intu muttu ma'a l-Masiih wa be l-moot da,bigiitu hurriin min churuut aadaat al-dunya.Wa kan misil da,maala tidooru ti'iichu battaan misil intu naas hana l-dunya-?Maala titaabu'u churuutha al-buguulu-:
Ma talmasah- wa -Ma taakulah- wa -Ma tichiilah--?
Wa dool kulluhum churuut al-bukhussu al-khumaam al-yikammil wakit nista'malooh.Humman hasab wasaaya al-insaan wa l-ta'liim al-jaayi min al-naas bas.
Sahiih,fi fikir al-naas,al-churuut dool yinchaafo misil induhum hikma.Achaan al-churuut dool yihajju be nizaam gaasi fi l-ibaada wa yatulbu min al-naas yisawwu nufuushum daluuliin wa yi'azzubu jisimhum bilheen.Laakin be l-sahiih,al-churuut dool ma induhum gudra wa ma yaktulu chahwaat al-insaan.
Akiid ligiitu haya jadiide fi bu'aas al-Masiih wa achaan da,khuttu baalku fi l-achya al-gaa'idiin fi l-sama ma'a l-Masiih al-gaa'id jamb Allah fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Khuttu afkaarku fi l-khumaam al-samaawi wa ma fi l-khumaam al-ardi
achaan intu muttu ma'a l-Masiih wa l-haya al-Allah antaaha leeku,hi lissaa' ma tinchaaf.Hi ma'a l-Masiih fi iideen Allah.
Al-Masiih bigi leeku al-haya wa wakit hu yaji battaan,intu tibiinu ma'aayah fi majdah.
Achaan da,guchchu marra waahid min afkaarku kulla cheyy al-min al-ard misil al-zina wa l-haal al-cheene wa l-chahwaat al-fasliin wa l-niiye al-fasle wa l-tama'.Wa be l-sahiih,al-tama' hu misil ibaadat al-asnaam.
Fi chaan al-zunuub dool,khadab Allah yanzil fi l-aasiyiin.
Wa awwal,intu kula haalku kaanat misil haalhum wakit intu gaa'idiin titaabu'u al-chahwaat dool.
Laakin hassa',khallu minku kulla cheyy al-ma adiil.Khallu minku al-khabiine wa l-za'al wa l-hasiife wa l-gatii'e wa l-kalaam al-cheen.
Ma takdubu le akhwaanku battaan achaan intu khalleetu al-haal al-gadiime ma'a kulla aadaatha.
Intu chiltu al-haya al-jadiide wa Allah gaa'id yijaddidku wa yiziid leeku al-irfe lahaddi tichaabuhu misil suurat Allah al-khalagaaku.
Wa fi l-haya al-jadiide di,ma muhimm battaan kan naadum Yahuudi walla ma Yahuudi,wa kan mutahhar walla ma mutahhar,wa kan ajnabi walla min al-kadaade,wa kan abid walla hurr.Laakin al-Masiih hu gaa'id fiina kullina wa hu bas al-muhimm.
Ya l-naas al-Allah azalaaku,bigiitu saalihiin wa mahbuubiin.Achaan da,albaso al-mahanna wa khalli guluubku yabgo buyud wa nafasku yabga baarid wa abgo daluuliin wa sabuuriin.
Wa alhammalo al-waahidiin le l-aakhariin be mahabba.Wa kan naadum indah daliime foog akhuuh,khalli yisaamihah.Al-Rabb saamahaaku wa achaan da,waajib leeku tissaamaho ambeenaatku.
Wa ziidu le kulla l-achya dool al-mahabba al-tarbut kulla cheyy tamaam wa tijiib al-wihda.
Khallu salaam al-Masiih yamluk fi guluubku achaan Allah naadaaku le ti'iichu fi l-salaam wa ja'alaaku jisim waahid.Wa abgo chakuuriin.
Khallu kalaam al-Masiih yaskun ambeenaatku be kulla barakaatah.Allumu beyah ayyi waahid wa achchaaja'o ambeenaatku be kulla hikma.Khannu le Allah be kulla guluubku wa khine wa anaachiid wa chukur min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa kulla cheyy al-tisawwuuh,kan be kalaam walla be fi'il,sawwuuh be usum al-Rabb Isa wa be usmah achkuru Allah abuuku.
Ya l-awiin,asma'an kalaam rujaalkan misil waajib le l-awiin al-yitaabi'an al-Rabb.
Ya l-rujaal,hibbu awiinku wa ma takurbu leehin fi guluubku.
Ya l-iyaal,asma'o kalaam waaldeenku fi kulla cheyy achaan da yiraddi Rabbina.
Ya abbahaat al-iyaal,ma tiza''ulu iyaalku.Kan tiza''uluuhum ziyaada,akuun yiwadduru achamhum.
Ya l-abiid,fi kulla cheyy taabu'u kalaam al-naas al-fi l-dunya di,humman siyaadku.Taabu'u kalaamhum daayman wa ma wakit humman gaa'idiin yichiifuuku bas wa la wakit tidooru minhum al-chukur.Laakin taabu'u kalaamhum be galib mukhlis achaan Rabbina hu siidku al-intu khaayfiin minnah.
Ayyi khidme al-yantuuku,akhdumuuha be niiye waahide.Khuttu fi afkaarku kadar takhdumu le Rabbina wa ma le l-naas bas.
A'arfu kadar talgo warasa min al-Rabb wa di bas ujritku.Intu gaa'idiin takhdumu le Rabbina al-Masiih.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yisawwi cheyy fasil,al-Rabb yi'aakhibah fi chaan fasaaltah.Rabbina ma yichiif naadum akheer min al-aakhar.
Ya siyaad al-abiid,sawwu daayman le abiidku al-adil wa l-musaawa.Ma tanso kadar intu kula abiid wa siidku hu al-gaa'id fi l-sama.
Ya akhwaani,ankarbu fi l-sala wa agoodu foogha waa'iyiin wa as'alo Allah be chukur.
Wa as'alo Allah leena kula.As'alooh achaan yaftah leena derib le l-bichaara achaan niballukhu al-naas be sirr Allah hu al-Masiih.Wa be sabab al-bichaara di,ana gaa'id fi l-sijin.
As'alo Allah leyi achaan niballikhha le l-naas be kalaam waadih misil waajib.
Iichu be hikma fi ust al-naas al-ma mu'miniin.Ayyi fursa al-ligiituuha,achhado le l-Masiih.
Chiilu niiye achaan tihajju daayman be kalaam taa'im wa indah rahma.Wa misil da,ta'arfu kikkeef waajib turuddu le ayyi naadum.
Wa khalaas,akhuuna Tichiikus yi'ooriiku be kulla khabari.Hu akhuuna al-nihibbuuh wa yakhdim ma'aana le Rabbina be amaan.
Wa hu yikhabbirku be haalitna wa yichajji'ku wa be sabab da bas rassaltah leeku.
Wa rassalt ma'aayah Alfaayidwa hu akhuuna al-amiin al-niriiduuh wa hu naadum min hillitku.Al-naaseen dool yi'ooruuku be kulla cheyy al-bigi foogna hini.
Akhuuna Aristaarkus al-gaa'id ma'aayi fi l-sijin yisallimku wa ma'aayah Markhus akhu Barnaaba.Wa Markhus da,kan ja leeku,akurbuuh gawi misil wassooku beyah awwal.
Wa Yachuu' al-ma'ruuf be Yustus yisallimku.Al-talaata dool bas min al-Yahuud been al-akhwaan al-yakhdumu ma'aayi fi chaan mamlakat Allah wa humman chajja'ooni katiir.
Wa akhuuna Abfuraas al-hu khaddaam al-Masiih Isa min hillitku,hu kula yisallimku.Hu gaa'id yas'al Allah daayman leeku be chidde achaan tagoodu be sabaat kaamil wa mu'akkidiin min niiyit Allah.
Wa ana nachhad leyah hu gaa'id yakhdim katiir fi chaanku wa fi chaan al-akhwaan al-fi hillaal Laawdikiiya wa Hiraabulus.
Wa akhuuna Luukha al-daktoor al-nihibbuuh wa akhuuna Diimaas,humman yisallumuuku.
Wa sallumu al-akhwaan al-fi Laawdikiiya wa akhutna Niimfa wa jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-yilimmu fi beetha.
Wa wakit garo leeku al-jawaab da khalaas,khalli yagruuh le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi Laawdikiiya kula.Wa l-jawaab al-rassaltah le Laawdikiiya,khalli yagruuh leeku kula.
Wa kallumu le Arkhibba wa guulu leyah-:-Khutt baalak achaan titammim al-khidme al-Rabbina antaaha leek.
Wa khalaas,ana zaati chilt al-galam wa naktib-:-Ana Buulus nisallimku. Ma tanso kadar ana gaa'id fi l-sijin wa mujanzar.Wa aleekum rahmat al-Rabb.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus wa akhwaani Siila wa Timuutaawus le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi hillit Tasaluuniiki,intu cha'ab Allah abuuna wa Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma.
Aniina nachkuru Allah daayman fi chaanku kulluku wa nas'alo leeku Allah fi kulla salaawaatna.
Wa ayyi wakit al-nas'alo leeku abuuna Allah,nifakkuru fi l-amal al-sawweetuuh be l-iimaan wa l-khidme al-sawweetuuha be l-mahabba wa achamku al-gawi fi Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Ya akhwaani al-Allah yihibbuku,na'arfu Allah azalaaku
achaan al-bichaara al-ballakhnaaha leeku ma jaat leeku be kalaam bas laakin be gudra wa be khidmit al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa be acham mu'akkad.Wa intu chiftu haalna ma'aaku wa khidmitna fi chaanku.
Wa intu chiltu masalna wa haalku bigat misil haalna wa misil haal hana Rabbina Isa.Wakit al-naas gaa'idiin yita''ubuuku bilheen kula,intu khibiltu al-kalaam be farah al-jaayi min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa be da,intu bigiitu masal adiil le kulla l-mu'miniin al-fi buldaan Magiduuniya wa Akhaaya.
Minku intu,bichaarat al-Rabb chattat wa machat ba'iid.Ma machat fi Magiduuniya wa Akhaaya bas wa laakin lihgat ayyi bakaan,lahaddi ma nagdaro nuguulu cheyy fiiku kula achaan iimaanku be Allah ma'ruuf.
Fi ayyi bakaan al-naas gaa'idiin yihajju beeku wa yuguulu kadar intu karabtuuna adiil wa tubtu le Allah.Wa yuguulu intu khalleetu minku al-asnaam achaan ta'abudu Allah al-Waahid al-Hayy
wa tarjo Ibnah al-yigabbil min al-samaawaat wa hu Isa al-Allah ba'asah min ust al-maytiin wa yafza'na min al-khadab al-jaayi.
Ya akhwaani,intu zaatku ta'arfu kadar intu faddaltuuna wa da ma saakit.
Ta'arfu kadar jiina leeku min hillit Filibbi al-ta''aboona wa ayyaroona foogha bilheen.Laakin Allah antaana chajaa'a wa gammeena niballukhu leeku bichaarat Allah,hatta kan al-naas khaalafoona be chidde kula.
Wa da yiwassif kadar ninaadu al-naas fi l-derib al-adiil.Wa da ma be kidib wa la be niiye fasle wa la be najaada.
Be l-aks,Allah chaaf guluubna wa kallafaana be l-bichaara wa achaan da bas,nibachchuru al-naas.Wa nibachchuruuhum da,ma achaan nidooru rida minhum laakin achaan nidooru rida min Allah al-yakchif guluubna.
Abadan ma hajjeena kalaam hana khachch.Wa abadan ma indina tama' achaan naakulu maal hana ayyi naadum.Allah chaahid le kalaamna.
Wa kulla cheyy al-sawweenaah ma achaan nidooru chukur min al-naas wa la minku wa la min al-naas al-aakhariin.
Aniina rusul al-Masiih wa indina hagg le natulbu minku cheyy katiir,laakin aniina ma chilna minku cheyy.Wakit aniina gaa'idiin fi usutku,hanneena foogku misil al-amm al-tihinn fi iyaalha.
Aniina gaa'idiin nihinnu foogku wa achaan da,dawwarna nantuuku bichaarat Allah.Wa ziyaada min da,dawwarna nantuuku nufuusna achaan nihibbuuku bilheen.
Ya akhwaani,fakkuru fi ta'abna wa amalna.Leel wa nahaar khadamna be duraa'na.Ma dawwarna nikallufu naadum minku beena wakit aniina gaa'idiin niballukhu leeku bichaarat Allah.
Intu zaatku tagdaro tachhado leena wa Allah kula chaahid kadar haalna ma'aaku intu al-mu'miniin,hi saalhe wa adiile wa ma indaha eeb.
Wa ta'arfu kadar aniina bigiina ma'a ayyi naadum minku misil al-abu ma'a iyaalah.
Wa aniina daayman chajja'naaku wa sabbarnaaku wa wasseenaaku be chidde achaan ti'iichu be l-haal al-waajbe le l-naas al-Allah naadaahum le yadkhulu fi mamlakatah wa majdah.
Wa fi chaan da,nachkuru Allah daayman achaan wakit simi'tu minnina kalaam Allah,intu karabtuuh gawi.Khibiltuuh ma misil kalaam insaani bas laakin khibiltuuh misil kalaam Allah.Wa be l-sahiih,hu kalaam Allah wa gaa'id yisawwi khidimtah fi guluubku intu al-mu'miniin.
Ya akhwaani,misil da,intu taaba'tu nafs al-derib misil naas Allah ummat al-Masiih akhwaanku al-yitaabu'u al-Masiih Isa fi daar al-Yahuudiiya.Wa intu bigiitu misilhum.Naas baladku ta''abooku misil al-Yahuud kula ta''abo akhwaanhum naas al-Masiih al-fi baladhum.
Al-Yahuud dool,humman bas al-katalo al-Rabb Isa wa l-anbiya al-gubbaalah.Wa leena aniina kula,ta''aboona bilheen.Humman yikhaddubu Allah wa khalaas bigo adu le kulla l-naas.
Humman yadharoona ma niballukhu al-bichaara al-tinajji al-naas,le l-naas al-ma Yahuud.Wa misil da,yitammumu adad zunuubhum marra waahid wa khadab Allah nazal fooghum khalaas.
Ya akhwaani,aniina anfaragna minku le wakit chiyya.Wa kan aniina macheena ba'iid minku kula,guluubna gaa'idiin ma'aaku.Wa aniina muchtaagiin leeku be ziyaada wa dawwarna nichiifuuku battaan.
Dawwarna nigabbulu leeku,khaassatan ana Buulus.Haawalna namchu leeku iddat marraat laakin Ibliis sadda leena al-derib.
Aywa,nidooru nichiifuuku battaan achaan intu bas achamna wa farahna.Wa fi yoom jayyit Rabbina Isa,chunu al-daliil al-yiwassif khidmitna ma fachalat-?Al-daliil hu intu wa iimaanku.
Aywa be sababku intu bas,narfa'o ruuseena foog wa nafraho bilheen.
Aywa,aniina muchtaagiin leeku.Wa wakit fagadna saburna khalaas,chilna niiye achaan nagoodu wiheedna fi madiinat Atiina.
Wa rassalna leeku akhuuna Timuutaawus al-yakhdim ma'aana sawa le Allah fi ballikhiin bichaarat al-Masiih.Wa rassalnaah le yichajji'ku wa yigawwi iimaanku
achaan naadum waahid minku ma yibarjil be sabab al-ta'ab al-gaa'id foogku.Intu zaatku ta'arfu kadar mukhaddar leena al-naas yita''ubuuna.
Wa wakit lissaa'na gaa'idiin ma'aaku,gulna leeku kadar al-ta'ab yaji foogna kullina.Wa khalaas,bigi misil gulna wa da ta'arfuuh.
Achaan da,wakit fagadt al-sabur marra waahid,rassalt leeku Timuutaawus achaan nidoor na'arif kan intu saabtiin fi iimaanku walla la.Wa fi l-wakit daak,ana gaa'id nihimm leeku.Fi fikri,akuun Ibliis al-yijarrib al-naas annasar foogku wa l-ta'ab al-ana ti'ibtah foogku macha fi l-riih saakit.
Laakin hassa' bas,Timuutaawus gabbal minku wa jaab leena khabar halu.Ooraana be iimaanku wa mahabbitku wa gaal fikirku foogna daayman fikir zeen wa intu muchtaagiin leena misil aniina muchtaagiin leeku.
Wa be misil da,ya akhwaani,intu chajja'tuuna be iimaanku wa raggadtu guluubna fi usut ta'abna wa su'uubaatna.
Awwal al-hamm katalaana laakin min simi'na intu saabtiin fi Rabbina,khalaas al-haya bigat leena haluuwe battaan.
Min chiddit al-farha,ma na'arfu kikkeef nachkuru Allah fi chaanku.Aywa fi chaanku intu,nafraho giddaam Allah be farha kabiire bilheen.
Leel wa nahaar nas'alo Allah be chidde achaan yilimmina battaan ma'aaku wa niziidu leeku kulla cheyy al-lissaa' mugassir leeku fi iimaanku.
Wa hassa',khalli Allah abuuna zaatah wa Rabbina Isa yisahhulu leena al-derib achaan najuuku.
Wa leeku intu,khalli al-Rabb yiziid mahabbitku wa yikattirha achaan tirraayado ambeenaatku be ziyaada wa tihibbu kulla l-naas misil aniina nihibbuuku.
Wa khalli al-Rabb yisabbit guluubku achaan tukuunu saalihiin wa bala eeb giddaam abuuna Allah fi l-yoom al-Rabbina Isa yaji foogah ma'a jamaa'tah al-saalihiin.
Ya akhwaani,asma'o kalaami battaan.Awwal allamtu minnina al-haal al-waajbe achaan Allah yarda beeku.Wa khalaas intu maachiin adiil.Wa achaan da,nachhadooku wa niwassuuku be usum al-Rabb Isa achaan tamchu adiil be ziyaada.
Ta'arfu al-wasaaya al-anteenaahum leeku be usum Rabbina Isa.
Al-cheyy al-Allah yidoorah leeku hu al-haal al-saalhe.Ma tigarrubu le l-zina.
Hu yidoor ayyi naadum ya'arif kikkeef yamluk nafsah be haal saalhe al-indaha ikraam.

Fi l-kalaam da,khalli naadum ma yakhta fi akhuuh wa la yukhuchchah achaan hazzarnaaku min awwal be kalaam waadih,Allah yi'aakhib al-naas al-yisawwu kulla l-zunuub al-misil dool.
Achaan Allah ma naadaana le l-fasaad.Allah naadaana le nabgo saalihiin.
Wa achaan da,ayyi naadum al-yaaba al-kalaam da,ma yaaba kalaam insaani bas laakin yaaba kalaam Allah al-nazzal foogku al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa akiid,Allah zaatah allamaaku kadar waajib tirraayado ambeenaatku.Wa achaan da,intu ma hawjaaniin aniina naktubu leeku fi l-mahabba al-akhawiiye.
Wa da bas al-intu gaa'idiin tisawwuuh achaan tihibbu kulla l-akhwaan al-fi balad Magiduuniya.Laakin ya akhwaani,niwassuuku achaan tirraayado be ziyaada battaan.
Chiilu niiye achaan ti'iichu be haal haadiye.Wa ma tadkhulu fi chu'uun al-naas.Akhdumu be duraa'ku misil aniina wasseenaaku beyah.
Kan intu gaa'idiin tisawwu misil da,al-naas al-ma mu'miniin yikarrumuuku wa intu ma tihtaajo le cheyy min ayyi naadum.
Ya akhwaani,nidooru ni'ooruuku be haalat al-mu'miniin al-atwaffo achaan ma tahzano misil al-naas al-ma induhum acham fi Rabbina.
Aamanna kadar Isa maat wa ba'as.Wa achaan da,waajib ni'aamunu kadar yoom Isa yaji,Allah yab'as al-mu'miniin al-maato wa yijiibhum ma'aayah.
Wa hasab al-kalaam al-Rabbina zaatah ooraana beyah,nuguulu leeku kadar aniina al-hayyiin fi yoom jayyit al-Rabb,abadan ma nigaddumu le akhwaanna al-maato khalaas.
Achaan al-Rabb Isa zaatah yanzil min al-sama wa yaamur be hiss aali.Wa hiss hana kabiir al-malaa'ika yinsami' wa ma'aayah hiss hana burunji Allah.Wa awwal cheyy,al-mu'miniin be l-Masiih al-maytiin yab'aso.
Wa ba'ad da,aniina al-hayyiin al-lissaa'na ma mutna,Allah yarfa'na ma'aahum sawa fi l-sahaab wa nilimmu ma'a l-Rabb foog fi l-sama.Wa khalaas,nagoodu daayman ma'a l-Rabb.

Ya akhwaani,intu ma hawjaaniin aniina naktubu leeku cheyy fi l-awkaat wa l-ayyaam al-jaayiin.

achaan intu kulluku iyaal al-nuur wa naas al-nahaar.Aywa,aniina ma naas hana l-leel wa la naas al-dalaam.

Achaan be l-leel bas,yunuumu al-nawwaamiin wa be l-leel bas,yaskaro al-sakkaara.
Wa laakin aniina naas al-nahaar wa achaan da,khalli nukhuttu baalna.Wa khalli al-iimaan wa l-mahabba yabgo leena misil khalagna hana l-harib.Wa khalli al-acham al-indina fi Rabbina al-yinajjiina,da yabga taagiiyitna.
Achaan Allah ma khaddar leena al-azaab.La.Hu khaddar leena al-naja be Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Al-Masiih maat fi chaanna wa be da,kan aniina hayyiin walla maytiin kula fi yoom jaytah,ni'iichu ma'aayah sawa.
Wa khalaas be l-kalaam da,achchaaja'o ambeenaatku wa assaa'ado fi iimaanku be ziyaada misil intu gaa'idiin tisawwuuh.
Ya akhwaani,natulbu minku tikarrumu al-naas al-gaa'idiin yakhdumu ambeenaatku al-induhum foogku mas'uuliiye wa gaa'idiin yuguuduuku fi derib al-Rabb.
Hibbuuhum be mahabba chadiide be sabab khidmithum.Wa agoodu be salaam ambeenaatku.
Ya akhwaani,asma'o wasaayaana.Hazzuru al-aatiliin wa sabbutu al-khawwaafiin wa saa'udu al-da'iifiin.Wa asburu le kulla l-naas.
Angar'u,naadum minku ma yisawwi cheyy fasil le l-naas al-sawwo leyah cheyy fasil.Chiilu niiye achaan tisawwu daayman al-kheer ambeenaatku wa le kulla l-naas.

Ya akhwaani,waajib nachkuru Allah daayman fi chaanku.Wa da waajib leena achaan gudrat iimaanku gaa'ide tiziid katiir wa l-mahabba al-kulluku tirraayado beeha gaa'ide tiziid bilheen.
Achaan da,narfa'o raasna foog wakit nihajju beeku le naas Allah ummat al-Masiih fi ayyi bakaan.Nihajju be saburku fi iimaanku al-saabit wakit al-naas yi'azzubuuku fi usut kulla l-mudaayagaat al-tahmaloohum.
Wa da kulla ke yiwassif kadar Allah yahkim be l-adil.Wa be l-ta'ab da,Allah yijahhizku achaan tadkhulu fi mamlakatah al-intu gaa'idiin tat'abo fi chaanha.
Fi adaalit Allah,akiid hu yita''ib al-naas al-yita''ubuuku.
Wa hu yanti al-raaha leeku intu al-gaa'idiin tat'abo wa yantiiha leena aniina kula ma'aaku.Hu yantiiku al-raaha wakit al-Rabb Isa yibiin naazil min al-sama ma'a malaa'ikatah al-gaadriin.
Hu yaji be naar amm lahiib haamiye.Wa hu yi'aakhib al-naas al-ma yidooru ya'arfu Allah wa ma yitaabu'u bichaarat Rabbina Isa.
Wa l-naas dool yahkim leehum be l-halaak al-abadi wa yifarrighum marra waahid min hadarat al-Rabb wa min gudurtah al-majiide.
Wa da yabga wakit hu yaji fi usut cha'abah al-saalihiin achaan yimajjuduuh.Wa fi l-yoom da,hu yaji fi ust al-naas al-aamano beyah wa kulluhum yikarrumuuh be farha.Wa intu kula tukuunu ma'aahum achaan wakit jiina leeku,aamantu be sabab chahaaditna.
Wa achaan da,nas'alo leeku Allah daayman achaan hu yaj'alku naas al-induku hagg le munaadaatah.Wa nas'alooh leeku achaan ayyi niiye al-saalhe al-chiltuuha wa ayyi khidme al-badeetuuha be sabab iimaanku,Allah yitammimha be gudurtah.
Wa misil da,usum al-Rabb Isa yabga majiid marra waahid fi usutku wa intu kula tichaaruku fi majdah be sabab al-rahma al-ligiituuha min Allah wa Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.

achaan ma tibarjulu be suhuula kan naadum yuguul yoom al-Rabb ja khalaas.Wa ma tikhallu kalaamah yibarjil fikirku.Ma tisaddugu be kalaam misil da,kan ja be ru'ya aw min khabar waahid aw be maktuub yuguulu jaayi minnina.

Nisiitu walla-?Wakit ana gaa'id ma'aaku ooreetku beyah.

Wa hu yista'mal kulla anwaa' al-charr le yukhuchch al-naas al-muwaddiriin wa humman al-abo ma yakhbalo wa la yiriidu al-hagg al-yagdar yinajjiihum.

Wa khalaas,nas'alo leeku Rabbina Isa al-Masiih zaatah wa Allah abuuna al-habbaana wa be rahmatah,antaana chajaa'a abadiiye wa acham kabiir.
