Wa achaan da,khalli ayyi naadum al-mas'uul fi l-mu'miniin yabga naadum al-ma indah ayyi eeb.Waajib yabga raajil martah waahide bas wa aagil wa multazim wa mukarram wa kariim le l-diifaan wa gaadir fi l-allimiin.
Waajib ma yabga sakkaari wa la daawaasi laakin waajib yabga naadum indah nafas baarid wa ma siid machaakil wa la tammaa'.
Waajib yabga naadum al-yichiil mas'uuliiyit beetah wa yirabbi iyaalah le yikarrumuuh fi kulli cheyy.
Achaan kan naadum ma yagdar yichiil mas'uuliiyit beetah,kikkeef yagdar yirayyis jamaa'at al-mu'miniin hana Allah-?
Wa khalli naadum ma yabga mas'uul kan dahaabah aaman be l-Masiih.Al-naadum al-misil da akuun yistakbar wa Allah yi'aakhibah misil aakhab Ibliis.
Wa ma'a kulla l-kalaam da,khalli ayyi mas'uul yabga naadum al-yikarrumuuh al-naas al-ma mu'miniin kula.Wa misil da,al-eeb ma yaji foogah wa yaga' fi charak Ibliis.
Wa nafs al-cheyy le l-mu'aawiniin.Waajib yabgo naas muhtaramiin al-induhum kalaam waahid wa ma itneen wa ma sakkaara wa ma yihibbu riba al-haraam.
Wa waajib yitaabu'u derib al-iimaan al-Allah bayyanah leena wa yakurbuuh gawi be niiye mukhlisa.
Wa gubbaal kulla cheyy,waajib yijarrubuuhum.Wa ba'adeen kan ma induhum eeb,khalli yabgo mu'aawiniin wa yakhdumu le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.
Wa nafs al-cheyy le awiinhum.Waajib marit al-mu'aawin tabga muhtarama wa ma gawwaala laakin aagle wa amiine fi kulli cheyy.
Wa khalli ayyi mu'aawin yabga raajil martah waahide bas wa yirabbi iyaalah adiil wa yichiil mas'uuliiyit beetah.
Al-naas al-yabgo mu'aawiniin wa yakhdumu adiil dool,iimaanhum be l-Masiih Isa yabga aali wa yabgo saabtiin bilheen wa yalgo charaf.
Nidoor najiik gariib laakin katabt leek al-wasaaya dool achaan
kan ni'akhkhir kula,inta ta'arif al-haal al-waajbe le ahal Allah.Humman naas Allah ummat al-Masiih.Wa ummat al-Masiih,hi amuud al-hagg wa asaasah.
Wa bala chakak,derib al-takhwa al-Allah bayyanah leena,hu aziim.Al-Masiih bigi insaan wa baan fi l-dunyawa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus chahad leyah.Al-malaa'ika chaafooh fi l-samawa naasah bachcharo beyah al-umam.Naas aamano beyah fi l-dunyawa Allah rafa'ah foog fi majdah.
Wa be kalaam waadih,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yuguul kadar fi l-zaman al-akhiir,naas waahidiin yamurgu min derib al-iimaan.Wa yitaabu'u derib al-chawaatiin al-yiwadduruuhum wa yasma'o ta'liim min al-chawaatiin.
Wa yinkhachcho be sabab al-naas al-yichattutu al-ta'liim da.Wa l-naas dool,humman munaafikhiin wa kaddaabiin wa guluubhum maytiin.
Yadharo al-naas min al-akhiide wa yiharrumu le l-naas achya waahidiin min al-akil.Wa laakin al-akil da,Allah khalagah achaan al-naas al-mu'miniin al-ya'arfu al-hagg yakhbalooh be chukur.
Aywa,kulla cheyy al-Allah khalagah sameh wa ma fi cheyy makruuh kan naakuluuh be chukur.
Achaan al-akil yabga halaal be kalaam Allah wa du'a hana l-chukur.
Kan ti'allim al-akhwaan al-wasaaya dool,inta tabga khaddaam adiil le l-Masiih Isa.Wa kalaam al-iimaan wa l-ta'liim al-adiil al-titaabi'ah,dool yabgo leek misil akil al-yantiik gudra.
Angari' marra waahid min al-gisas al-baatliin wa l-kalaam al-misil kalaam al-ajaayiz al-kharfaanaat.Darrib nafsak achaan tabga naadum takhi.
Sahiih,al-riyaada indaha faayde laakin al-takhwa faayditah ziyaada min kulli cheyy wa nalgo minha,fi l-dunya wa fi l-aakhira,al-haya al-Allah waa'adaana beeha.
Al-kalaam da hagg wa waajib kulla l-naas yisaddugu beyah.
Wa fi sabab al-wa'ad da,nat'abo wa nijaahudu.Khatteena achamna saabit fi Allah al-Hayy al-hu bas munajji hana kulla l-naas khaassatan al-mu'miniin.
Aamurhum le l-naas achaan yitaabu'u al-kalaam da wa allimhum leyah.
Ma tikhalli naadum yahgirak be sabab inta sakhayyar fi l-umur.Sawwi nafsak masal le l-mu'miniin fi kalaamak wa haalak.Khalli yichiifu foogak al-mahabba wa l-iimaan wa l-tihaara.
Lahaddi najiik,ankarib fi giraayit Kitaab Allah le l-naas wa ma tikhalli minnak al-bachchiriin wa l-allimiin.
Khutt baalak fi l-baraka al-Allah antaaha leek be l-kalaam al-atnabba'o beyah jamaa'at al-chuyuukh wakit khatto iideehum foogak.
Ankarib fi l-waajibaat dool wa jaahid fi chaanhum achaan kulla l-naas yichiifu najaahak.
Khutt baalak fi nafsak wa fi ta'liimak le l-naas.Ankarib foogah wa be misil da,tinajji nafsak wa tinajji al-naas al-yasma'o kalaamak.
Ma tikichch le ayyi chaayib laakin hajji leyah be adab misil hu abuuk.Wa hajji le l-subyaan misil humman akhwaanak.
Wa hajji le kulli ajuuz misil hi ammak.Wa hajji le kulli bineeye be kalaam waadih misil hi akhtak.
Waajib tabga kariim le l-awiin al-araamil kan sahiih ma indihin naadum al-yifakkir fooghin.
Kan ayyi mara armala indaha iyaal walla iyaal iyaalha,khalli ya'arfu kikkeef yabgo takhiyiin ma'a naas beethum wa yantu le waaldeenhum huguughum misil Allah yarda beyah.
Laakin al-mara al-armala al-ma indaha naadum yifakkir foogha,hi tukhutt achamha saabit fi Allah wa tinkarib fi du'aaha wa salaawaatha,leel wa nahaar.
Wa laakin al-mara al-armala al-tiriid halaat al-dunya bas,kan hi lissaa' hayye kula,hi mayte.
Aamurhum le jamaa'at al-mu'miniin be l-wasaaya dool achaan yabgo naas ma induhum eeb.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yaaba ma yirayyis ahalah wa khaassatan naas beetah,hu nakar al-iimaan khalaas.Naadum kaafir akheer minnah.
Ma tisajjil ayyi mara armala fi majmuu'at al-araamililla kan umurha sittiin sana walla ziyaada wa abadan ma khaanat raajilha
wa kan hi ma'ruufa be l-amal al-saalih.Waajib tabga mara al-rabbat iyaalha adiil wa kariime le l-diifaan wa sallamat nafisha achaan takhdim le l-naas al-saalihiin wa saa'adat al-ta'baaniin wa misil da hi ankarabat fi kulla amal al-kheer.
Aaba ma tisajjil fi majmuu'at al-araamil ayyi mara sabiiye al-raajilha maat achaan wakit chahwaatha yilizzuuha,hi taaba khidmit al-Masiih wa tidoor taakhud battaan.
Wa misil da,hi tabga khaatiye achaan tikhaalif al-wa'ad al-awwal sawwatah ma'aayah.
Wa awiin misil deel yabgan kamaan aatilaat wa yugumman yuruukhan min beet le beet.Wa ma yabgan aatilaat bas laakin yabgan gawwaalaat wa yindassan fi l-cheyy al-ma yukhussihin wa yihajjan be kalaam al-ma bichaabih.
Achaan da,nidoor ayyi mara sabiiye al-raajilha maat taakhud wa talda iyaal wa tirayyis naas beetha wa khalaas ma tanti fursa le naas hana Ibliis achaan yuguulu foogna kalaam cheen.
Wa gult al-kalaam da achaan awiin waahidaat maragan min al-derib wa taaba'an Ibliis.
Wa khalaas ayyi mu'mine al-indaha fi ahalha awiin araamil,khalli tisaa'idhin.Khalli ma tikallif beehin jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.Wa be misil da,al-mu'miniin yisaa'udu al-awiin al-akiid ma indihin naadum yifakkir fooghin.
Al-chuyuukh al-chaayliin adiil mas'uuliiyit jamaa'at al-mu'miniin,khalli al-akhwaan yihtarumuuhum bilheen wa yantuuhum al-musaa'ada,khaassatan al-chuyuukh al-munkaribiin fi l-bachchiriin wa l-allimiin.
Wa da yiwaafig ma'a l-masal al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-buguul-:﴾‍Wakit al-toor gaa'id yifajjikh leek al-khalla fi l-madagg,ma tarbut khachmah.Khalli yaakul.‍﴿Wa be masal taani-:-Ujrat al-naadum al-yakhdim waajbe leyah.
Wa kan al-naas yukhuttu tuhma fi ayyi cheekh,ma takhbal kalaamhum illa kan chuhuud itneen aw talaata yisabbutuuh foogah.
Wa kan naadum min al-chuyuukh yaznib,aharjah giddaam al-jamaa'a achaan al-aakhariin yakhaafo.
Asma' kalaami.Ana niwassiik giddaam Allah wa l-Masiih Isa wa l-malaa'ika al-mugarrabiin.Taabi' al-wasaaya al-anteethum leek dool wa ma tifannid al-naas wa ma tichiif ayyi naadum akheer min al-aakhariin.
Ma tissa'jal wakit tidoor tidarrij cheekh wa ma tichaarik fi zunuub hana naadum aakhar.Angari' ma titallif haalak al-taahire.
Wa min al-yoom wa giddaam,ma tachrab almi wiheedah bas.Ziid leyah khamar chiyya achaan tidaawi batnak min amraadha al-katiiriin.
Naas waahidiin zunuubhum waadhiin le kulla l-naas gubbaal ma yihaasubuuhum.Wa naas aakhariin zunuubhum ma yin'arfu illa ba'adeen.
Wa nafs al-cheyy le amal al-kheer.Hu waadih.Wa kan awwal ma waadih kula,ma yagood mulabbad wakit tawiil.
Khalli kulla l-mu'miniin al-gaa'idiin fi l-ubuudiiye yukhuttu fi fikirhum kadar waajib yihtarumu siyaadhum marra waahid.Wa misil da,naadum ma yuguul be sababhum kalaam fasil fi usum Allah wa ta'liimna.
Khalli al-abiid al-siyaadhum mu'miniin ma yuguulu-:-Humman akhwaanna.Ma waajib nitii'uuhum misil awwal. Akheer yakhdumu leehum be ziyaada achaan al-naas al-yalgo faayde min khidmithum al-samhe di,humman mu'miniin wa mahbuubiin.Allim al-akhwaan al-wasaaya dool wa chajji'hum achaan yitaabu'uuhum.
Ayyi naadum al-yugumm yi'allim kalaam chig min da wa ma yidoor al-kalaam al-adiil al-jaayi min Rabbina Isa al-Masiih wa yaaba al-ta'liim al-yiwaddi al-naas fi l-takhwa,
hu mustakbir marra waahid.Ma ya'arif cheyy.Indah marad hana l-munaakhachaat wa l-mukhaalataat fi ma'ana al-kalimaat.Kalaamah yisabbib al-husud wa l-mukhaasama wa l-gatii'e wa l-tuham al-baatliin.
Al-munaakhachaat abadan ma yikammulu le l-naas al-uguulhum talfaaniin wa l-hagg anrafa' minhum.Wa yisawwu nufuushum mu'allimiin hana l-takhwa achaan fi fikirhum yalgo minnah ribih.
Wa be l-sahiih,kan naadum bigi takhi wa radyaan be l-indah,hu rabhaan ziyaada.
Achaan jiina fi l-dunya iidna yaabse wa namurgu minha kula iidna yaabse.
Wa kan indina ma'aach wa kiswe,khalli nabgo radyaaniin khalaas.
Laakin al-naas al-yidooru yabgo khaniyiin,tama'hum yilizzuhum fi l-zunuub wa yabga leehum charak.Wa katarat chahwaathum yisabbubu leehum al-aza wa yisawwuuhum ajaama wa yiwadduuhum fi l-damaar wa l-halaak.
Achaan hubb al-maal,hu ga'ar kulla l-fasaala.Be sabab al-tama',naas waahidiin waddaro.Marago min derib al-iimaan wa jaabo fi raashum nadaama chadiide.
Laakin inta ya khaddaam Allah,ajri min kulla l-kalaam da.Ankarib be niiye waahide fi l-haal al-saalhe wa l-takhwa wa l-iimaan wa l-mahabba wa l-sabur wa l-nafas al-baarid.
Jaahid jihaad adiil fi derib al-iimaan.Akrub gawi al-haya al-abadiiye al-Allah naadaak le tadkhul foogha wa inta kula chahadt leeha be chahaadat al-hagg giddaam chuhuud katiiriin.
Wa niwassiik giddaam Allah al-yanti al-haya le kulli cheyy wa be usum al-Masiih Isa al-chahad le l-hagg giddaam al-waali Bilaatus al-Bunti.
Taabi' wasiiyat Allah bala khata wa bala eeb lahaddi yoom Rabbina Isa al-Masiih yigabbil wa kulla l-naas yichiifuuh.

Ya Timuutaawus,ahfad al-amaana al-Allah antaaha leek.Angari' min al-kalaam al-ma yanfa' wa l-kalaam al-yikhaalif al-hagg wa da l-kalaam al-yuguulu hu ilim,laakin hu da bas al-kidib.

Wa naktib leek inta,ya Timuutaawus,al-bigiit wileedi al-niriidak.Aleekum al-salaam wa l-ni'ma wa l-rahma min Allah abuuna wa Isa al-Masiih Rabbina.
Fi chaanak inta,nachkur Allah al-na'abudah misil juduudi abadooh be niiye mukhlisa wa nifakkir foogak daayman wakit nad'i leel wa nahaar.
Nifakkir fi dumuu'ak wa nagram leek.Nidoor nichiifak battaan achaan ninmali be l-farha.
Ana gaa'id nifakkir fi iimaanak al-mukhlis al-misil al-iimaan al-awwal chiftah fi jidditak Luwiisa wa ammak Yuunika wa hassa' akiid gaa'id foogak inta.
Achaan da,nidoor nizakkirak battaan.Wakit ana da'eet wa khatteet foogak iideeni,Allah antaak baraka wa hi misil jamur.Hajjijha achaan tabga battaan haamiye misil awwal.
Achaan Allah antaana al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-hu ma yisawwiina khawwaafiin.Be l-aks,al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yantiina al-gudra wa l-mahabba wa l-agul al-saabit.
Ma takhaaf wa ma takhjal.Bachchir al-naas be usum al-Rabb al-ana masjuun fi chaanah.Ma tidangir raasak be sabab sijni ana.Chaarikni fi l-ta'ab fi chaan bichaarat al-Masiih wa Allah yantiik al-gudra.
Hu najjaana wa naadaana achaan nabgo naas khaassiin leyah.Wa da ma be sabab ayyi amal saalih al-aniina sawweenaah laakin be sabab niiytah wa rahmatah.Gubbaal al-dunya ma badat,hu indah niiye achaan yantiina al-ni'ma di fi l-Masiih Isa.
Wa hassa' fi l-zaman al-haadir,hu bayyan rahmatah be jayyit al-naadum al-yinajjiina wa hu al-Masiih Isa.Al-Masiih battal gudrat al-moot wa fi bichaartah wassaf leena al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa Allah azalaani wa sawwaani mubachchir wa rasuul wa mu'allim.
Wa achaan da bas,ana gaa'id nat'ab misil da.Laakin al-eeb abadan ma sawwaani achaan hu al-ana aamant beyah na'arfah tamaam.Wa ana mu'akkid kadar hu gaadir wa yahfad al-amaana al-anteetha leyah lahaddi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Akrub gawi al-ta'liim al-adiil al-simi'tah minni wa taabi'ah tamaam.Wa ankarib fi l-iimaan wa l-mahabba misil al-waajib fi derib al-Masiih Isa.
Kalaam al-hagg,hu amaana min Allah.Ahfadah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-gaa'id fi usutna.
Akiid,inta simi't kadar kulla l-akhwaan al-min balad Aasiya gata'o ma'aayi al-alaakha wa l-akhwaan Figeel wa Harmuugiin kula minhum.

Fakkir fi Isa al-Masiih.Hu min zurriiyit Dawuud wa ba'as min ust al-maytiin.Wa di bas al-bichaara al-ana ballakhtaha le l-naas.

Al-kalaam da hagg.Kan mutna ma'aayah,nahyo ma'aayah.

Laakin al-asaas al-gawi al-Allah khattaah gaa'id saabit wa hu khatta foogah khitim wa da l-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-buguul-:﴾‍Allah ya'arif naasah‍﴿wa battaan-:﴾‍Waajib ayyi naadum al-yikarrim usum Allah yikhalli minnah al-fasaala marra waahid.‍﴿
Fi beet hana naadum khani,fi mawaa'iin khaaliyiin min al-dahab wa l-fudda wa mawaa'iin rakhiisiin min al-hatab wa l-tiine.Wa l-waahidiin yakhdumu beehum amal nadiif wa l-waahidiin yakhdumu beehum amal waskhaan.
Wa be misil da,kan naadum yisaffi nafsah min kulla l-wasaakha,hu yabga misil maa'uun hana amal nadiif wa maa'uun khaass al-indah faayde le siidah.Hu yabga jaahiz achaan yisawwi ayyi amal hana kheer.
Angari' min chahwaat hana l-suba.Khutt baalak achaan tabga naadum saalih wa tabga gawi fi l-iimaan wa l-mahabba wa l-salaam misil kulla l-naas al-yad'u al-Rabb be galib taahir.
Wa angari' marra waahid min al-munaakhachaat al-baatliin al-ma induhum faayde.Inta ta'arif kadar al-munaakhachaat al-misil dool yisabbubu al-huraaj bas.

Wa khalaas,yamurgu min charak Ibliis al-awwal karabaahum achaan yisawwu leyah al-cheyy al-hu yidoorah.

Wa fi l-zaman da,al-naas yihibbu nufuushum be ziyaada wa yihibbu al-gurus bilheen.Wa yabgo fachchaariin wa mustakbiriin wa yikallumu kalaam kufur wa yabgo aaykhiin waaldeenhum wa nassaayiin al-kheer wa faasdiin.
Wa ma induhum mahanna wa yaabo ma yisaamuhu.Wa yabgo gattaa'iin wa ma gaadriin yisabbutu nufuushum wa yabgo kachraaniin wa yakraho al-kheer.
Wa yabgo khaayniin wa muta'ammidiin wa fachchaariin.Wa yihibbu halaat al-dunya ziyaada min Allah.
Wa yinkarbu fi l-chokhol al-yiwassif al-takhwa laakin fi guluubhum yaabo ma yitaabu'u al-takhwa.Angari' min al-naas al-misil dool.
Waahidiin minhum yindasso fi buyuut al-naas be najaada.Wa yakurbu be khachch awiin al-fikirhin ma saabit al-malaanaat be zunuub wa gaa'idaat yitaabi'an kulla nafar hana chahwaat.
Al-awiin al-misil deel yasma'an ta'liim katiir wa abadan ma yagdaran yafhaman al-hagg.
Wa l-khachchaachiin dool gaa'idiin yikhaalufu al-hagg misil Yaniis wa Yambaarisal-khaalafo Muusa.Fikirhum talfaan wa iimaanhum baatil.
Laakin ma yanjaho achaan ba'ad chiyya,yabga waadih le kulla l-naas kadar kalaamhum baatil.Wa yabga leehum misil al-cheyy al-bigi le Yaniis wa Yambaaris.
Laakin inta raafagtini wa ta'arifni.Chiftini wakit ana gaa'id ni'allim al-naas wa ta'arif haali wa niiyti fi kulli cheyy.Ta'arif iimaani wa sabri wa mahabbiti wa galbi al-saabit.
Inta chiftini wakit al-naas gaa'idiin yita''ubuuni wa wakit ta'ab chadiid ja foogi.Wa chiftini fi kulli cheyy al-gaasi al-bigi foogi fi hillaal Antaakiya wa Iguuniya wa Listara.Himilt fooghum ta'ab chadiid marra waahid.Laakin Rabbina faza'ni wa najjaani min al-ta'ab da kulla ke.
Wa akiid ayyi naadum al-yidoor yinkarib fi l-takhwa fi derib al-Masiih Isa,yita''ubuuh.
Wa laakin al-naas al-fasliin wa l-kaddaabiin,fasaalithum tiziid be ziyaada wa yabgo khachchaachiin wa makhchuuchiin.
Laakin inta,agood saabit fi kulli cheyy al-allamtah wa aamant beyah be iimaan gawi.Ta'arif kadar al-naas al-allamook leyah amiiniin.
Min inta sakhayyar,irift kitaab Allah al-antaak al-ilim al-yiwaddiik le l-naja be l-iimaan be l-Masiih Isa.
Al-Kitaab kulla ke hu kalaam Allah al-nazzalah wa indah faayde achaan yi'allim al-hagg wa yiwassif al-naas khataahum wa yigabbilhum fi l-derib al-adiil wa yidarribhum fi l-haal al-saalhe.
Wa beyah khaddaam Allah yabga gaadir wa jaahiz achaan yisawwi ayyi amal hana kheer.
Niwassiik giddaam Allah wa giddaam al-Masiih Isa al-yichaari' al-hayyiin wa l-maytiin wa da fi l-yoom al-hu yibiin foogah fi mamlakatah.
Ballikh kalaam Allah.Ankarib foogah kan talga min al-naas murr walla halu kula.Jiib al-naas fi l-derib.Al-waahidiin ahrijhum wa l-waahidiin chajji'hum.Allimhum kulluhum be sabur chadiid.
Fi l-wakit al-jaayi,al-naas yaabo ma yahmalo al-ta'liim al-adiil.Yitaabu'u al-kalaam al-halu leehum wa yichiilu mu'allimiin katiiriin al-yuguulu al-kalaam al-ya'ajib al-naas bas.
Wa ma yidooru yasma'o abadan kalaam al-hagg.Fi badalah yidooru yasma'o gisas al-naas al-yiwadduruuhum.
Laakin inta,agood daayman saabit wa ahmal al-ta'ab wa bachchir al-naas be l-bichaara wa akhdim adiil al-khidme al-Allah antaaha leek.
Wa laakin ana bigiit misil hadiiyat charaab wa gariib dammi yidaffig.Wa ana mooti garrab khalaas.
Ana jaahadt jihaad chadiid fi l-hagg.Wa l-musaabaga al-tawiile kammaltaha wa l-iimaan karabtah gawi lahaddi l-nihaaya.
Wa hassa' al-jaa'iza al-yantuuha le l-khaalib tarjaani.Wa hi al-taaj al-Rabbina yukhuttah fi raas al-naadum al-saalih.Wa Rabbina al-haakim al-aadil yantiini al-taagiiye di fi l-yoom al-akhiir.Wa ma yantiiha leyi ana wiheedi laakin yantiiha le kulla l-naas al-garmaaniin le yoom jaytah.
Jaahid le tajiini ajala
achaan akhuuna Diimaas yihibb al-dunya.Hu faat khallaani macha fi hillit Tasaluuniiki.Wa l-aakhariin ma fiihum.Akhuuna Kiriiski macha fi balad Khalaatiya wa akhuuna Tiitus macha fi balad Dalmaatiya.
Wa misil da,illa akhuuna Luukha wiheedah gaa'id ma'aayi.Amchi le akhuuna Markhus wa jiibah ma'aak.Hu yisaa'idni ziyaada fi khidmit al-Rabb.
Wa ana rassalt akhuuna Tichiikus fi hillit Afasus.
Wa wakit taji,jiib ma'aak khalagi hana l-barid al-khalleetah ma'a akhuuna Kaarbus fi hillit Turuwaas.Wa jiib al-kutub kula.Wa fakkir fi l-kutub al-maktuubiin fi farwa wa ma tansaahum.
Wa Iskandar daggaag al-nahaas hu sawwa leyi fasil bilheen.Rabbina bas yijaaziih fi l-cheyy al-sawwaah leyi.
Angari' minnah achaan hu khaalaf kalaamna mukhaalafa chadiide.
Awwal marra wakit jaabooni fi l-mahkama wa ana daafa't le nafsi,ma fi naadum waahid al-wagaf ma'aayi.Kulluhum khallooni marra waahid.Nas'al Rabbina ma yihaasibhum.
Laakin Rabbina wagaf ma'aayi wa antaani gudra wa beeha ballakht al-bichaara kullaha ke wa naas min kulla l-umam sim'ooha.Wa fi l-yoom da,ana misil naadum al-duud yidoor yaakulah laakin al-Rabb najjaani min al-moot.
Wa hu yinajjiini min kulli cheyy fasil wa yiwaddiini aafe fi mamlakatah al-samaawiiye.Al-hamdulillah daayman wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Sallim Biriskiila wa Akiila wa naas beet Waani Sifirus.
Akhuuna Rastus ga'ad fi Kuruntus.Wa Turuufiimus bigi mardaan wa ana khalleetah fi hillit Miliitus.
Jaahid achaan taji leyi gubbaal al-chite ma yabda.Yuubulus wa Buudis wa Liinus wa Kuluudiya wa kulla l-akhwaan yisallumuuk.
Al-Rabb ma'aak.Aleekum al-ni'ma.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus abd Allah wa rasuul hana Isa al-Masiih,murassal achaan nijiib al-naas al-Allah azalaahum fi derib al-iimaan wa ni'arrifhum al-hagg al-yiwaddiihum le l-takhwa.
Wa be sabab al-iimaan da,yarjo be acham al-haya al-abadiiye al-hu waa'adaahum beeha min gubbaal bidaayit al-dunya.Wa Allah abadan ma yakdib.
Wa fi l-wakit al-Allah haddadah,hu nazzal kalaamah fi l-Masiih.Wa Allah munajjiina kallafaani be l-kalaam da wa amaraani achaan niballikhah.
Wa naktib leek inta,ya Tiitus,al-bigiit wileedi al-sahiih be l-iimaan al-nichaaruku foogah.Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma min Allah abuuna wa Isa al-Masiih munajjiina.
Ana khalleetak fi jaziirat Kiriit achaan ti'addil kulli cheyy al-lissaa' ma indah nizaam adiil.Waajib ta'azil min al-mu'miniin naas fi ayyi hille achaan yabgo leehum chuyuukh misil ana awwal wasseetak beyah.
Kulli cheekh waajib yabga naadum ma indah eeb.Khalli yabga raajil martah waahide bas wa iyaalah mu'miniin wa ma fi naadum waahid yuguul fooghum kadar humman faasdiin walla aasiyiin.
Mas'uul al-mu'miniin,hu wakiil Allah wa achaan da,waajib yabga naadum ma indah eeb.Ma waajib yabga naadum mustakbir wa la naadum al-yaz'al ajala wa la sakkaari wa la siid al-machaakil wa la naadum al-yiriid riba al-haraam.
Laakin waajib yabga naadum kariim le l-diifaan wa yiriid al-kheer wa aagil wa aadil wa saalih wa yisabbit nafsah.
Hu waajib yakrub gawi al-kalaam al-sahiih al-allamnaah leyah achaan yichajji' akhwaanah be ta'liim adiil wa yurudd le l-naas al-yikhaalufuuh.
Achaan fi naas katiiriin aasiyiin wa khachchaachiin wa yihajju kalaam saakit wa katiiriin minhum Yahuud.
Waajib niwaggufuuhum achaan tallafo iimaan hana kulla l-naas fi buyuut waahidiin be ta'liimhum.Gaa'idiin yi'allumu kalaam ma adiil achaan yarbaho gurus be kidibhum.
Naadum waahid min Kiriit al-bigi leehum misil nabi gaal-:-Naas hana Kiriit humman daayman kaddaabiin wa misil haywaanaat khatiiriin.Humman yihibbu al-akil wa ma yiriidu al-khidme.
Wa kalaamah da sahiih.Wa achaan da,ahrijhum be chidde achaan yagoodu saabtiin fi l-iimaan
wa ma yasma'o battaan al-gisas al-baatliin al-jaayiin min ust al-Yahuud wa la churuut al-naas al-abo al-hagg.
Le l-naas al-guluubhum taahiriin,kulli cheyy taahir.Wa laakin le l-naas al-guluubhum ma taahiriin wa le l-ma mu'miniin,ma fi cheyy waahid taahir.Afkaarhum wa guluubhum ma taahiriin marra waahid.
Yuguulu ya'arfu Allah laakin be amalhum yakfuru beyah.Naas misil dool makruuhiin wa aasiyiin wa ma yanfa'o le ayyi amal hana kheer.
Laakin inta,allim al-akhwaan al-haal al-muwaafge ma'a l-ta'liim al-adiil.
Wassi al-chiyyaab achaan yabgo aagliin wa muhtaramiin wa khalli baalhum yabga wasii'.Wa khalli yabgo saabtiin fi l-iimaan wa l-mahabba wa l-sabur.
Wa wassi al-ajaayiz kula achaan haalhin tabga takhiiye wa ma yabgan gawwaalaat wa la sakkaariiyaat.Khalli yi'alliman akhwaathin kikkeef yisawwan al-kheer.
Wa be misil da,yichajji'an al-chaabbaat achaan yiriidan rujaalhin wa iyaalhin
wa yi'iichan be haal aagle wa taahire wa yukhuttan baalhin fi buyuuthin wa guluubhin yabgo buyud wa yasma'an kalaam rujaalhin.Wa be misil da,yisiddan al-derib le l-naadum al-yidoor yuguul kalaam fasil fi kalaam Allah.
Wa wassi al-subyaan achaan yisabbutu nufuushum.
Abga leehum masal fi kulli cheyy.Wassif leehum be haalak kikkeef yisawwu al-kheer.Wa khalliihum yichiifu kadar inta naadum mukhlis fi ta'liimak wa munkarib foogah.
Wa khalli kalaamak yabga saalim bilheen hatta naadum ma yalga foogah sabab le yaharjak.Wa be misil da,ayyi naadum al-yidoor yikhaalifak,yakhjal wa ma yagdar yuguul foogna cheyy fasil.
Wa wassi al-abiid achaan yasma'o kalaam siyaadhum lahaddi siyaadhum yardo beehum fi kulli cheyy.Wa khalli al-abiid ma yikhaalufuuhum
wa la yasurgu minhum cheyy.Wa laakin waajib yabgo leehum amiiniin marra waahid achaan yiwassufu fi kulli cheyy kadar ta'liim hana Allah al-yinajjiina,hu sameh bilheen.
Akiid,ni'mat Allah baanat fi l-Masiih achaan tinajji kulla l-naas.
Wa hi tidarribna achaan nikhallu minnina al-kufur wa chahwaat al-dunya wa ni'iichu fi l-dunya be haal aagle wa saalhe wa takhiiye.
Wa narjo be acham al-yoom al-mubaarak al-yibiin foogah majd Ilaahna wa munajjiina al-aziim,Isa al-Masiih.
Hu anta nafsah dahiiye le yafdaana min kulla l-fasaala wa yitahhir guluubna achaan nabgo leyah cha'abah halaalah munkaribiin fi amal al-kheer.
Wa khalaas kulla l-kalaam da,ooriihum beyah be kalaam waadih.Indak fooghum hagg achaan tichajji'hum wa tahrijhum hasab haalhum.Ma tikhalli naadum yahgirak.
Zakkir al-akhwaan achaan yasma'o kalaam al-hakuuma wa l-kubaaraat wa yitaabu'u kalaamhum.Wa khalli yabgo jaahiziin le yisawwu al-kheer fi kulli haal.
Wa khalli ma yuguulu kalaam fasil fi ayyi naadum wa la yihaaruju.Wa khalli yihajju be nafas baarid wa be adab ma'a kulla l-naas.
Khalli ma nanso kadar awwal aniina kula misilhum,juhhaal wa aasiyiin.Awwal aniina muwaddiriin wa chahwaatna malakoona wa guluubna marbuutiin fi halaat al-dunya.Awwal aniina aaychiin be l-fasaala wa l-husud,wa gaa'idiin nakraho al-naas wa l-naas yakrahoona.
Wa laakin wakit Allah munajjiina bayyan mahannitah wa mahabbitah le l-insaan,
hu najjaana.Wa da ma be sabab ayyi amal saalih al-sawweenaah laakin be sabab rahmatah hu.Wa hu khassalaana be l-waaluuda al-taaniye wa antaana haya jadiide be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus
al-hu nazzalah foogna be kulla barakaatah be waasitat munajjiina Isa al-Masiih.
Wa misil da,bigiina saalihiin be ni'matah wa aniina achmaaniin foog Rabbina kadar nawrusu al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa l-kalaam da hagg.Wa nidoor kadar inta tifassir leehum kulla l-kalaam da achaan al-naas al-aamano be Allah yinkarbu be niiye waahide fi amal al-kheer.Kulla l-kalaam da sameh bilheen wa indah faayde le kulla l-naas.
Laakin angari' min al-munaakhachaat al-ma induhum faayde misil munaakhachaat fi l-guram wa l-mukhaasama wa l-mukhaalata fi tafsiir al-Tawraat.Kalaam misil da baatil wa ma indah faayde abadan.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yihajji kalaam chig wa yifarrig beyah al-akhwaan,hazzirah marra waahide wa hazzirah marra taaniye wa ba'ad da,agta' ma'aayah al-alaakha.
Akiid ayyi naadum al-misil da,hu muwaddir wa khaati.Hu yijiib al-ikhaab fi raasah.
Nidoor nirassil leek Artimaas walla Tichiikus.Wa wakit waahid minhum yawsalak,a'asir nafsak achaan taji leyi fi hillit Nikuubulus.Ana chilt niiye nagood foogha tuul al-chite.
Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss akhwaanna Zeenaas al-muhaami wa Abuluus,a'asir nafsak achaan tisaa'idhum fi safarhum wa khalli cheyy ma yigassir leehum fi l-derib.
Wa khalli kulla akhwaanna ya'arfu kikkeef yinkarbu fi amal al-kheer achaan yisaa'udu al-naas al-hawjaaniin be l-sahiih.Wa misil da akhwaanna ma yabgo naas al-hayaathum ma indaha faayde.
Kulla l-naas al-ma'aayi yisallumuuk.Wa sallim kulla l-mu'miniin al-yihibbuuna.Aleekum kulluku al-ni'ma.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus al-masjuun fi chaan al-Masiih Isa wa min akhuuna Timuutaawus.Wa naktib leek inta,ya habiibna wa rafiigna fi l-khidme Filimuun
wa jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-yilimmu fi beetak wa akhutna Affiiya wa akhuuna Arkhibba al-misilna yitaabi' kalaam Rabbina misil askari yitaabi' kabiirah.
Ya Filimuun,ayyi wakit al-nisalli,nifakkir foogak wa nachkur Allah Rabbi
achaan simi't khabar iimaanak be Rabbina Isa wa be mahabbitak le kulla l-saalihiin.
Wa nas'al leek Allah kadar be l-alaakha al-indak ma'a akhwaanak al-mu'miniin talga irfe be ziyaada fi kulla l-kheer al-indina fi l-Masiih.
Wa be l-sahiih,ya akhuuyi,khabar hana mahabbitak antaani farha kabiire wa chajaa'a chadiide achaan al-cheyy al-inta sawweetah farrah guluub al-saalihiin.
Wa achaan da,nidoor natlub minnak cheyy waahid.Indi hagg fi l-Masiih le naamurak tawwaali achaan tisawwi al-cheyy al-nidoorah.
Wa laakin aniina nirraayado wa achaan da,yabga leyi akheer kan nigaddim leek talab wa inta tafhamni.Wa ana al-nihajji leek,ana Buulus safiir al-Masiih Isa al-haaliiyan masjuun fi chaanah.
Wa nigaddim leek talab fi chaan wileedi Alfaayidal-ana bigiit leyah abuuh wakit ana gaa'id fi l-sijin.
Awwal hu ma indah leek faayde laakin be l-sahiih hassa' hu bigi naadum indah faayde katiire bilheen.Hu indah faayde leek inta wa leyi ana kula.
Wa ana gaa'id nigabbilah leek ma'a l-jawaab da wa da gaasi leyi achaan nagram leyah bilheen.
Be l-sahiih,dawwart hu yagood hini ma'aayi.Ana gaa'id fi l-sijin fi chaan bichaarat al-Masiih wa na'arif kadar inta tidoor tisaa'idni.Wa kan Alfaayid yagood ma'aayi,hu yagdar yisaa'idni fi badalak inta.
Laakin ma dawwart nisawwi ayyi cheyy al-bukhussah illa kan inta khassadt beyah.Wa misil da,tisawwi al-kheer ma achaan ana asartak leyah laakin achaan inta chilt niiye leyah be nafsak.
Akuun fi chaan da bas,Allah faragah minnak wakit chiyya achaan hassa' yigabbil leek wa yagood ma'aak daayman.
Wa ma yabga battaan abdak bas laakin yabga akheer min abdak.Hu bigi akhuuk al-mahbuub.Akiid ana nihibbah laakin inta waajib tihibbah be ziyaada achaan hu abdak al-khaali wa be Rabbina al-Masiih,hu bigi akhuuk.
Zeen.Na'arif kadar inta taj'alni ana muchaarik ma'aak fi l-iimaan.Wa natlub minnak takrub Alfaayid gawi misil tidoor takrubni ana gawi.
Kan hu sawwa leek cheyy fasil walla indah deen fi raasah kula,kallifni beyah ana.
Ana Buulus karabt al-galam wa naktib al-kalaam da be iidi-:-Ana bas nikaffiik. Wa inta ligiit al-haya al-jadiide be kalaami ana bas wa laakin ma nidoor nihajji leek be l-cheyy al-waajib tisawwiih leyi.
Aywa,ya akhuuyi,aniina akhwaan fi l-Rabb wa nidoor minnak faayde chiyya.Farrih galbi fi l-Masiih be ziyaada.
Ana mu'akkid kadar titaabi' kalaami.Ana gaa'id naktib leek wa fi galbi na'arif inta tisawwi ziyaada min al-gultah leek kula.
Wa ma'a l-kalaam da,nuguul leek jahhiz leyi bakaan fi beetak achaan naji nagood ma'aak.Narja Allah yasma' du'aaku fi chaani wa yatulguuni gariib.
Akhuuna Abfuraas al-gaa'id ma'aayi fi l-sijin fi chaan al-Masiih Isa,hu yisallimak.
Wa ma'aayah al-akhwaan al-yakhdumu ma'aayi Markhus wa Aristaarkus wa Diimaas wa Luukha.
Aleekum rahmat al-Rabb Isa al-Masiih.
Fi l-zaman al-faat,Allah kallam le juduudna be waasitat al-anbiya iddat marraat wa be turug chig chig.
Wa hassa' fi l-zaman al-akhiir,Allah kallam leena be waasitat Ibnah al-hu ja'alah wariis hana kulla cheyy.Wa beyah hu bas,Allah khalag kulla cheyy.
Wa Ibn Allah hu nuur Allah al-majiid wa suurat tabii'tah wa hu yahfad kulla cheyy be gudrat kalaamah.Wa wakit hu tahhar al-naas min zunuubhum khalaas,hu tala' fi l-bakaan al-aali wa gaa'id jamb Allah al-Aziim fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Wa Allah antaah daraja kabiire ziyaada min al-malaa'ika misil al-usum al-Allah antaah leyah afdal ziyaada min asaameehum.
Abadan ma fi malak al-Allah gaal leyah-:﴾‍Inta ibni wa l-yoom,ana bigiit abuuk.‍﴿Walla battaan gaal-:﴾‍Ana nabga leyah abuuh wa hu yabga leyi ibni.‍﴿
Wa laakin wakit Allah rassal Ibnah al-bikir fi l-dunya,hu gaal-:﴾‍Khalli kulla malaa'ikat Allah yasjudu leyah.‍﴿
Wa l-kalaam al-maktuub al-bukhuss al-malaa'ika buguul-:﴾‍Hu ja'al malaa'ikatah misil al-riih wa khaddaamiinah dool misil al-naar al-tahrig.‍﴿
Wa laakin fi Ibnah buguul-:﴾‍Ya Allah,archak gaa'id ila l-abadwa asaat mulkak,hi asaat adaala.
Inta tihibb al-adaalawa takrah al-zulum.Achaan da,Allah Ilaahak azalak inta bas min rufgaanakwa masahak be dihin al-suruur.‍﴿
Wa battaan buguul-:﴾‍Ya Rabb,fi l-bidaaya inta farracht al-ardwa inta bas falleet al-samaawaat.
Humman yiddammarowa laakin inta gaa'id ila l-abad.Humman kulluhum yagdamomisil khalag.
Wa misil naadum yatwi furaachah,inta kula tatwiihumwa tibaddilhum misil lubaas.Laakin inta tagood daayman,ma tilkhayyarwa waktak kulaabadan ma yikammil.‍﴿
Wa abadan ma fi malak al-Allah gaal leyah-:﴾‍Agood be nussi al-zeenaay lahaddi nukhutt udwaanak tihit rijileenak.‍﴿
Wa l-malaa'ika humman kulluhum arwaah khaddaamiin bas wa Allah yirassilhum achaan yakhdumu fi chaan al-naas al-yalgo al-naja.
Achaan da,waajib nukhuttu baalna wa nitaabu'u adiil al-kalaam al-simi'naah achaan ma nansooh wa ma namurgu min al-derib al-adiil.
Na'arfu kadar al-kalaam al-malaa'ikat Allah ballakhooh hagg wa ayyi naadum al-khaalafah aw abaah yijiib fi nafsah al-ikhaab al-waajib leyah.
Wa kikkeef aniina nanjo kan ma nitaabu'u adiil kalaam hana l-naja al-muhimme di-?Al-awwal ballakhaaha,hu Rabbina.Wa l-chuhuud al-sim'o kalaamah akkadooha leena.
Wa Allah kula chahad leeha be alaamaat wa ajaayib wa mu'jizaat chig chig wa be l-gudra al-hu antaaha le l-naas be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus hasab al-hu yidoorah.
Al-aakhira,Allah ma khattaaha tihit sultit al-malaa'ika.
Laakin fi bakaan waahid al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Chunu al-insaanwa maala tifakkir foogah-?Wa Bani Adam,hu chunuwa maala tihimm beyah-?
Laakin inta sawweetah tihit min al-malaa'ikawa anteetah azama wa charaf.
Wa khatteet kulla cheyy tihit rijileenah.‍﴿Wa kan hu khatta kulla cheyy tihit sultitah,battaan ma faddal cheyy al-ma tihit sultitah.Wa haaliiyan ma nichiifu kulla cheyy tihit sultitah.
Laakin al-nichiifuuh,hu Isa.Wa Isa da,Allah nazzalah tihit min al-malaa'ika le mudda gisayre wa ba'ad da,Allah antaah azama wa charaf be sabab ta'abah wa mootah.Achaan be rahmat Allah,Isa daakh al-moot fi chaan kulla l-naas.
Allah al-khalag kulla cheyy wa fi chaanah kulla cheyy mawjuud,hu dawwar naas katiiriin yabgo iyaalah wa yadkhulu fi majdah.Wa achaan da,Allah sawwa cheyy muwaafig leehum.Hu rassal al-naadum al-yaftah leehum derib al-naja.Wa ja'al le l-Masiih al-ta'ab wa be ta'abah da,hu bigi al-munajji al-kaamil.
Achaan hu al-yikhassis al-naas le Allah wa l-naas al-bigo khaassiin le Allah,humman kulluhum induhum abu waahid.Achaan da,bala eeb Isa akkad kadar humman akhwaanah.
Hu buguul-:﴾‍Ana niballikh be usmak le akhwaani wa nahmudak fi ust al-jamaa'a.‍﴿
Wa hu buguul le Allah-:﴾‍Ana nitwakkal aleek.‍﴿Wa buguul-:﴾‍Daahuuni ana ma'a l-naas al-Allah ja'alaahum iyaali.‍﴿
Al-iyaal dool kulluhum insaan wa achaan da,Isa kula bigi insaan misilhum.Wa bigi misilhum achaan be mootah,hu dammar gudrat Ibliis al-indah gudra fi l-moot.
Wa be da,Isa harraraahum le kulla l-naas al-khaayfiin min al-moot wa aaychiin tuul hayaathum misil abiid be sabab khoofhum.
Akiid,hu ma ja achaan yisaa'id al-malaa'ika laakin achaan yisaa'id iyaal Ibraahiim.
Wa be sabab da,laabudda yabga misil akhwaanah fi kulla cheyy wa yabga leehum kabiir rujaal al-diin,al-rahiim wa l-amiin,wa yakhdim le Allah wa yisawwi kaffaara le zunuub al-cha'ab.
Hu zaatah ti'ib wa ga'ad tihit al-tajriba.Wa achaan da,hu kula yagdar yisaa'id al-naas al-gaa'idiin tihit al-tajriba.
Achaan da,ya akhwaani al-saalihiin al-Allah naadaaku kulluku le tadkhulu fi derbah,fakkuru fi Isa.Hu rasuul Allah wa kabiir rujaal al-diin al-aniina mu'miniin beyah wa nachhado leyah.
Wa hu amiin le Allah al-kallafah be l-khidme di misil zamaan Muusa kula bigi amiin fi l-khidme al-Allah kallafah beeha fi kulla beetah.
Laakin al-charaf al-waajib le Isa ziyaada min al-charaf al-waajib le Muusa misil al-naadum al-bana al-beet mukarram ziyaada min al-beet al-hu banaah.
Wa kulli beet indah naadum al-banaah wa laakin Allah bas al-bana kulla cheyy.
Wa Muusa al-bigi amiin fi kulla beet Allah,hu gaa'id foogah achaan hu khaddaam Allah wa bigi chahaada le l-kalaam al-Allah yidoor yiballikhah fi l-mustakhbal.
Laakin al-Masiih bigi amiin achaan hu Ibn Allah wa hu bas al-mas'uul fi beet Allah.Wa aniina be nufuusna bas beetah,kan nagoodu saabtiin bala chakak wa nukhuttu achamna daayman fi l-Masiih al-aniina nilfachcharo beyah.
Achaan da,asma'o al-kalaam al-buguulah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus-:﴾‍Al-yoom,kan simi'tu hiss Allah,
ma tigawwu ruuseekumisil juduudku al-aboma taaba'o kalaamahfi yoom al-tajriba fi l-sahara.
Fi l-bakaan daak,juduudku jarrabooniwa amtahanooni hatta kan chaafo amali
fi muddit 40 sana.Wa khalaas,ana zi'ilt min al-naas doolwa gult-:-Humman cha'ab aasiyiinwa ma ya'arfu derbi.
Wa fi za'ali,ana halaft wa gultabadan ma yadkhulu fi raahti.‍﴿
Ya akhwaani,khuttu baalku achaan galib hana ayyi naadum ma yabga fasil wa yaaba al-iimaan wa yamrug min derib Allah al-Hayy.
Achchaaja'o ambeenaatku kulla yoom.Aywa,kulla l-ayyaam ninaaduuhum -al-yoom-,achaan al-zanib ma yukhuchch naadum minku wa yigawwi raasah.
Achaan kullina bigiina muchaarikiin fi l-Masiih kan sahiih nitaabu'u al-iimaan al-indina min al-bidaaya wa nagoodu saabtiin foogah lahaddi l-nihaaya.
Al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Al-yoom,kan simi'tu hiss Allah,ma tigawwu ruuseeku misil juduudku al-abo ma taaba'o kalaamah.‍﴿
Yaatumman al-naas al-sim'o kalaam Allah laakin abooh-?Humman kulla l-naas al-marago min Masir wa taaba'o Muusa.
Wa yaatumman al-naas al-Allah zi'il minhum fi muddit 40 sana-?Humman al-naas al-aznabo wa janaazaathum faddalo fi l-sahara.
Wa yaatumman al-naas al-Allah halaf leehum kadar ma yadkhulu fi raahtah-?Humman al-naas al-iso Allah.
Wa khalaas be l-kalaam da,na'arfu kadar ma gidro dakhalo fi raahtah achaan ma induhum iimaan.
Wa'ad Allah al-bukhuss al-dakhuul fi raahtah lissaa' gaa'id.Angar'u-!Khalli ayyi naadum minku yadkhul fi l-raaha di bala fachal.
Aniina simi'na al-bichaara misil awwal humman kula sim'ooha.Laakin al-kalaam al-humman sim'ooh ma jaab leehum faayde achaan al-naas al-sim'ooh ma khiblooh be iimaan.
Wa aniina al-aamanna bas nadkhulu fi l-raaha al-Allah hajja beeha di wa gaal-:﴾‍Fi za'ali,ana halaft wa gult abadan ma yadkhulu fi raahti.‍﴿Wa na'arfu raahtah gaa'ide achaan amalah kammal min hu kawwan al-dunya.
Achaan al-Kitaab kallam fi bakaan waahid be l-yoom al-saabi' wa gaal-:﴾‍Allah kammal khidimtah wa fi l-yoom al-saabi',hu wagaf min kulla khidimtah.‍﴿
Wa battaan,Allah hajja be raahtah wakit hu gaal-:﴾‍Ma yadkhulu fi raahti.‍﴿
Wa khalaas,fi niiyit Allah,fi naas yadkhulu fi raahtah.Wa laakin al-naas al-awwal sim'o bichaarat Allah ma dakhalo fi l-raaha di be sabab isyaanhum.
Wa battaan,Allah gata' le l-naas yoom waahid wa sammaah -al-yoom. Wa ba'ad siniin katiiriin,hu hajja fi kalaam Dawuud al-gaa'id fi l-Kitaab al-aniina kallamnaah khalaas wa l-kalaam da buguul-:﴾‍Al-yoom,kan simi'tu hiss Allah,ma tigawwu ruuseeku.‍﴿
Achaan kan awwal Yachuu' gidir wadda al-cha'ab fi l-raaha khalaas,Allah ma yihajji battaan be yoom aakhar.
Wa be da,na'arfu kadar raaha aakhara misil raahat yoom al-sabt tifaddil le cha'ab Allah.
Wa l-naadum al-yadkhul fi raahat Allah yagiif min khidimtah misil Allah wagaf min khidimtah.
Wa khalaas,khalli nijaahudu le nadkhulu fi l-raaha di,achaan naadum minnina ma yiwaddir be sabab al-isyaan misil juduudna.
Kalaam Allah hayy wa gaadir wa tariin ziyaada min al-seef al-mutarrag min jaay wa jaay.Hu yagta' daakhal fi l-naadum marra waahid lahaddi yalhag al-bakaan al-foogah al-nafas wa l-ruuh,wa l-udaam wa l-muchaach.Kalaam Allah yimayyiz al-afkaar wa l-niiye fi galib al-insaan.
Wa ma fi cheyy fi kulla l-khaliige al-mulabbad le Allah.Kulla cheyy makchuuf wa waadih giddaamah hu bas.Wa waajib leena aniina kullina naju be a'maalna achaan hu yihaasibna.
Ta'arfu kadar aniina indina raajil diin kabiir wa hu aziim wa tala' foog fi l-samaawaat wa hu Isa Ibn Allah.Wa achaan da,khalli nakurbu gawi iimaanna be Isa al-nachhado leyah.
Raajil al-diin hanaana da ya'arif du'ufna achaan hu kula,jarrabooh be kulla l-tajriba misilna laakin hu abadan ma sawwa zanib.
Wa khalaas,khalliina nigarrubu le Allah al-Rahiim be amaan achaan hu yarhamna.Wa nalgo minnah al-ni'ma al-tisaa'idna wakit nihtaajo leeha.
Achaan da,ayyi raajil diin kabiir ya'azuluuh min al-naas achaan yakhdim le l-naas giddaam Allah wa yigaddim leyah dahaaya chig chig le zunuubhum.
Wa hu ya'arif kikkeef yihajji be nafas baarid le l-naas al-juhhaal wa le l-naas al-muwaddiriin achaan hu kula insaan mu'arrad le l-du'uf.
Achaan da,laabudda hu yigaddim le Allah dahiiye le zunuubah hu wa le zunuub al-cha'ab kula.
Wa naadum ma yidarrij nafsah le l-khidme al-mucharrafa hint rujaal al-diin.Allah bas yinaadiih leeha misil zamaan hu naada leeha Haaruun.
Wa l-Masiih kula ma darraj nafsah achaan yisawwi nafsah raajil diin kabiir,laakin al-darrajah hu Allah al-gaal leyah-:﴾‍Inta ibni wa l-yoom,ana bigiit abuuk.‍﴿
Wa fi bakaan waahid fi l-Kitaab,hu gaal-:﴾‍Inta bigiit raajil diin daayim misil Malkisaadikh.‍﴿
Wakit Isa gaa'id fi l-dunya,hu naada Allah al-yagdar yinajjiih min al-moot wa sa'alah be hiss aali wa dumuu'.Wa Allah khibil su'aalah achaan hu takhi.
Sahiih,Isa hu Ibn Allah laakin hu allam kikkeef yitaabi' kalaam abuuh be l-ta'ab al-ti'ibah.
Wa khalaas,hu bigi al-munajji al-kaamil wa bigi derib al-naja al-abadiiye le kulla l-naas al-yitaabu'u kalaamah.
Wa Allah ja'alah raajil diin kabiir misil Malkisaadikh.
Indina kalaam katiir nidooru nuguuluuh leeku fi l-ta'liim da laakin tafsiirah leeku gaasi achaan intu bigiitu mataamiis.
Intu al-tawwaltu fi l-derib,waajib tabgo mu'allimiin hana l-iimaan laakin be l-sahiih,intu hawjaaniin le duruus awwalaaniyiin hana kalaam Allah.Intu bigiitu misil al-sakhiir al-lissaa'ah hawjaan le laban ammah achaan hu ma jaahiz le l-akil.
Ayyi naadum al-aayich be l-laban lissaa' sakhiir wa ma ya'arif derib al-saalihiin.
Wa l-ta'liim al-muhimm,hu misil al-laham wa hu waajib le l-naadum al-aagil fi l-iimaan al-darrasooh lahaddi ya'arif kikkeef yimayyiz al-kheer min al-charr.
Achaan da,nikhallu waraana al-duruus al-awwalaaniyiin fi l-Masiih wa namchu giddaam le l-ta'liim al-waajib le l-naas al-aagliin.Wa ma nigabbulu battaan fi asaas al-ta'liim da.Wa hu al-tooba min al-a'maal al-yiwaddu al-naas le l-moot wa ta'liim al-iimaan be Allah.
Ma ni'allumu battaan al-wadu wa khattiin al-iide fi l-naas wa ma ni'allumu battaan bu'aas al-maytiin wa l-hisaab al-akhiir.
Wa khalaas,namchu giddaam kan Allah gaal aamiin.
Chunu yukuun le l-naas al-yigabbulu fi haalhum al-gadiime-?Al-naas dool khiblo nuur Allah fi guluubhum wa irfo al-baraka al-Allah antaaha wa chaarako fi l-Ruuh al-Khudduus
wa daakho al-kheer hana kalaam Allah wa ajaayib hana l-zaman al-jaayi fi l-aakhira.
Humman dool kan yaabo al-iimaan,ma nagdaro nigabbuluuhum le l-tooba battaan.Achaan al-naas dool bigo misil gaa'idiin yaktulu Ibn Allah fi l-saliib marra taaniye wa yi'ayyubuuh giddaam al-naas.
Kan al-ard chirbat almi al-matar al-yusubb daayman wa gawwamat al-nabaat al-indah faayde le l-naas al-haratooha,al-ard di Allah yibaarikha.
Laakin al-naas dool misil al-ard al-tigawwim chook wa haskaniit.Hi ma indaha faayde wa la'anat Allah tigarrib leeha wa fi l-akhiir,yiharruguuha.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuuku,hatta kan nihajju leeku be l-kalaam al-misil da kula,ma indina chakak foogku.Intu gaa'idiin fi l-derib al-adiil wa akiid hu derib al-naja.
Achaan Allah ma zaalim le yansa khidmitku fi chaan usmah wa l-mahabba al-wassaftuuha leyah be musaa'adatku le akhwaanku al-saalihiin.Wa ya hassa' intu gaa'idiin tisaa'uduuhum.
Wa nidooru kadar ayyi waahid minku yiwassif daayman al-niiye al-adiile al-misil di wa achamku yabga bala chakak lahaddi l-akhiir.
Wa kan tisawwu misil da,ma tabgo kaslaaniin laakin titaabu'u derib hana l-naas al-gaa'idiin saabtiin fi l-iimaan be l-sabur wa yawrusu barakat Allah al-waa'adaahum beeha.
Achaan Allah waa'ad Ibraahiim wa halaf be nafsah achaan abadan ma fi cheyy akbar minnah le yahlif beyah.
Wa Allah gaal-:﴾‍Akiid ana nibaarikak wa nikattir zurriiytak.‍﴿
Wa khalaas,Ibraahiim sabar sabur gawi wa ligi al-cheyy al-Allah waa'adah beyah.
Akiid,al-naas fi aadithum yahalfu be cheyy akbar minhum wa kan naadum yi'akkid kalaamah be haliife,khalaas kalaamah kammal.
Wa Allah kula,wakit hu yikallim le l-naas al-yawrusu wa'adah wa yidoor yi'akkid leehum kharaarah abadan ma yikhayyir,hu sabbatah leehum be haliife.
Wa fi chaan al-kalaam da,indina chajaa'a chadiide,awwal be wa'ad Allah wa battaan be haliifit Allah.Al-achya al-itneen dool akiid ma yafchulu achaan ma mumkin Allah yikhalli kalaamah al-gaalah.Wa khalaas,aniina al-tubna le Allah achaan nanjo,nakurbu gawi al-acham al-hu gaddamah leena.
Achamna fi Isa da misil witid saabit al-yisabbit nufuusna achaan Isa macha khaadi le l-sitaar daakhal fi beet Allah.
Aywa,Isa dakhal fi beet Allah al-samaawi fi chaanna misil giid achaan hu bigi raajil diin kabiir daayim misil Malkisaadikh.
Wa Malkisaadikh da,hu malik hillit Chaaliim wa raajil diin hana Allah al-Aali.Wa hu laaga Ibraahiim wa baarakah wakit Ibraahiim mugabbil min al-bakaan al-annasar foogah fi l-muluuk.
Wa leyah hu,Ibraahiim anta al-uchur min kulla cheyy al-chaalah fi l-harib.Wa awwal cheyy,al-usum Malkisaadikh ma'anaatah al-malik al-aadil wa battaan hu malik Chaaliim,ma'anaatah malik al-salaam.
Wa fi l-Kitaab,hu ma indah abu wa la amm wa la gurma.Waktah ma indah bidaaya wa hayaatah ma indaha nihaaya laakin hu gaa'id daayman misil Ibn Allah wa hu raajil diin ila l-abad.
Fakkuru fi kubuuriiytah.Ibraahiim zaatah antaah al-uchur min kulla cheyy al-chaalah fi l-harib wa Ibraahiim hu jiddina al-kabiir.
Wa l-naas al-min zurriiyit Laawi al-Allah ja'alaahum rujaal diin induhum izin fi l-Tawraat achaan yichiilu al-uchur min al-cha'ab,ya'ni min akhwaanhum.Wa akhwaanhum dool kula min zurriiyit Ibraahiim.
Laakin Malkisaadikh da,hu ma min zurriiyit Laawi misilhum wa hu chaal al-uchur min Ibraahiim wa baarakah wa Ibraahiim hu bas al-naadum al-Allah antaah al-wu'uud.
Wa bala chakak,al-naadum al-yanti al-baraka akbar min al-naadum al-yichiilha.
Wa misil da,al-Laawiyiin al-yichiilu al-uchur,humman al-naas al-yumuutu laakin Malkisaadikh al-chaal al-uchur,hu hayy hasab kalaam al-Kitaab.
Be masal aakhar,nagdaro nuguulu kadar iyaal Laawi al-yichiilu al-uchur zaathum anto al-uchur le Malkisaadikh be waasitat Ibraahiim
achaan Laawi lissaa' gaa'id fi sulub jiddah Ibraahiim wakit Malkisaadikh laagaah.
Wa khidmit rujaal al-diin al-min zurriiyit Laawi,hi asaas al-churuut al-Allah antaahum le l-cha'ab.Laakin kan khidmit rujaal al-diin al-min zurriiyit Laawi kaamile,maala Allah jaab raajil diin aakhar misil Malkisaadikh fi badal raajil diin misil Haaruun-?
Wa akiid kan khidmit rujaal al-diin khayyarat,laabudda al-churuut kula yikhayyuru.
Wa Isa al-nihajju beyah ma min zurriiyit Laawi.Wa min gabiiltah hu,abadan ma fi naadum al-kallafooh be dahaaya al-madbah.
Achaan Rabbina Isa hu min gabiilat Yahuuza wa da ma'ruuf.Wa fi l-cheyy al-bukhuss gabiilat Yahuuza,Muusa abadan ma gaal cheyy fi rujaal al-diin.
Wa l-kalaam da yabga waadih bilheen wakit yaji raajil diin aakhar wa hu yichaabih Malkisaadikh.
Wa Isa bigi raajil diin be sabab gudrat hayaatah al-ma tikammil wa ma be sabab chart waahid min churuut al-Tawraat al-bukhuss zurriiyit al-naas.
Achaan al-Kitaab chahad le Isa wa gaal-:﴾‍Inta bigiit raajil diin daayim misil Malkisaadikh.‍﴿
Wa khalaas,al-chart al-gadiim bigi baatil achaan ma yanfa' wa ma indah gudra.
Akiid,churuut al-Tawraat ma sawwo ayyi cheyy kaamil.Wa Allah jaab fi badalhum derib akheer ziyaada,al-beyah nigarrubu le Allah be acham ziyaada min awwal.
Wa battaan,fi cheyy aakhar wa hu haliifit Allah.Al-naas al-awwal bigo rujaal diin ma bigo be haliife.
Laakin Isa bigi raajil diin be haliifit Allah.Maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Allah halaf wa hu yitimm kalaamah al-buguul-:-Inta bigiit raajil diin daayim.‍﴿
Be l-sabab da,indina mu'aahada akheer ziyaada wa Isa hu al-yadman leena al-mu'aahada di.
Wa battaan fi cheyy aakhar.Rujaal al-diin al-min zurriiyit Laawi dool katiiriin achaan humman yumuutu wa be da,ayyi waahid ma yagdar yitawwil fi khidimtah.
Laakin Isa hu raajil diin al-yagood daayman achaan hu hayy ila l-abad.
Be l-sabab da,hu daayman yagdar yinajji al-naas al-yigarrubu le Allah beyah hu achaan hu hayy daayman wa gaa'id yas'al leehum Allah daayman.
Wa be da,Isa bigi kabiir rujaal al-diin al-muwaafig leena marra waahid.Hu khudduus wa ma indah ayyi eeb wa hu daayman taahir.Hu ma'zuul ba'iid min al-muznibiin wa marfuu' foog fi l-samaawaat.
Isa hu ma misil kubaaraat rujaal al-diin al-aakhariin dool.Ma waajib leyah kulla yoom yigaddim dahiiye awwal fi chaan zunuubah hu wa ba'ad da,yigaddim dahiiye fi chaan zunuub al-cha'ab.La.Hu gaddam dahiiye waahide bas wa nihaa'iiye wa da wakit gaddam nafsah fi l-saliib.
Aywa,churuut al-Tawraat khatto naas da'iifiin le yabgo kubaaraat hana rujaal al-diin.Laakin al-haliife al-jaat ba'ad al-Tawraat khattat Ibn Allah kabiir rujaal al-diin.Wa Allah sawwaah kaamil ila l-abad.
Wa di hi zibdit al-kalaam.Aniina indina raajil diin kabiir misil al-fassarna beyah leeku.Hu ga'ad jamb arch Allah al-Aziim fi nussah al-zeenaay foog fi l-samaawaat.
Wa hinaak,hu khaddaam fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas al-sahiih wa di bas al-kheema al-ma banaaha insaan.Rabbina bas banaaha.
Wa kulli naadum al-yidarrujuuh raajil diin kabiir,waajib yigaddim le Allah dahaaya chig chig.Achaan da,waajib le raajil al-diin hanaana kula yigaddim dahiiye.
Wa kan Isa gaa'id fi l-ard,hu abadan ma yabga raajil diin achaan fi l-ard,rujaal diin aakhariin gaa'idiin al-yigaddumu al-dahaaya hasab churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa l-bakaan al-humman yakhdumu foogah da,alaama bas wa hi timassil al-bakaan al-mukhaddas al-samaawi.Wa da ma'ruuf achaan wakit Muusa yidoor yabni kheemat al-ibaada,Allah kallam leyah wa gaal-:﴾‍Khutt baalak achaan tasna' kulla cheyy hasab al-nizaam al-ana wassaftah leek fi l-jabal.‍﴿
Laakin hassa' Isa indah khidme akheer ziyaada min khidmit rujaal al-diin al-awwalaaniyiin achaan hu bigi wasiit hana l-mu'aahada al-akheer ziyaada.Wa l-mu'aahada di,Allah sabbatha fi wu'uud akheer ziyaada min al-wu'uud al-awwalaaniyiin.
Wa kan awwal al-mu'aahada al-awwal ma indaha eeb,ma waajib yibadduluuha be mu'aahada aakhara.
Wa laakin Allah hajja be eeb al-naas wakit hu haraj le l-cha'ab wa gaal-:﴾‍Yaji yoom waahid,nisawwi mu'aahada jadiidema'a Bani Israa'iil wa ma'a Bani Yahuuza.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l-mu'aahada dima tabga misil al-mu'aahadaal-ana sawweetha ma'a juduudhumwakit gudtuhum wa maragtuhummin balad Masir.Al-mu'aahada al-jadiide dima tabga misil al-awwal.Humman gata'o al-mu'aahada diwa achaan da,ana kula khalleethum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa hassa',di hi al-mu'aahada al-nisawwiihama'a Bani Israa'iil ba'ad al-yoom da.Ana nukhutt wasiiyaati fi fikirhumwa naktibhum fi guluubhum.Wa ana nabga Ilaahhumwa humman yabgo cha'abi.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa naadum ma yi'allim rafiigahwa la yuguul le akhuuh-:-A'arif Allah.-Achaan kulluhum ya'arfuuni,min al-sakhayyar lahaddi l-kabiir.
Wa ana nakhfir leehum khataayaahumwa ma nifakkir fi zunuubhum battaan.‍﴿
Wa fi l-kalaam da,hu hajja be mu'aahada jadiide.Wa be da,hu ja'al al-mu'aahada al-awwal gadiime.Wa ayyi cheyy al-yabga gadiim,waktah kammal wa gariib yabga ma fiih.
Wa ta'arfu kadar fi l-mu'aahada al-awwal,indaha churuut al-beehum al-naas waajib ya'abudu Allah wa indaha bakaan mukhaddas fi l-ard.
Wa bano kheemat ibaada wa fi nussaha al-barraani,khatto al-faanuus wa l-tarabeeza al-yigaddumu foogha khubza le Allah.Wa nussaha al-barraani da,usmah al-bakaan al-mukhaddas.
Wa nussaha al-dakhlaani al-gaa'id khaadi le l-sitaar,usmah al-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa da l-bakaan al-gaa'id foogah al-mukhbar hana dahab wa sanduug al-mu'aahada al-mamsuuh be dahab daakhal wa barra.Wa l-sanduug da,indah jarr hana dahab al-fi lubbah al-manna.Wa asaat Haaruun al-sawwat nuwwaarwa liihaan al-mu'aahada kula gaa'idiin fi lubbah.
Wa fi makhluugiin samaawiyiin masnuu'iin fi dahar sidaadit al-sanduug al-yiwassufu majd Allah wa humman mumattitiin janaaheehum giddaam wa mukhattiyiin beehum sidaadit al-sanduug wa da bakaan al-kaffaara.Wa laakin hassa' da,ma nagdaro nifassuru ma'ana hana kulla l-achya dool.
Wa wakit kulla l-achya dool jahhazoohum khalaas,rujaal al-diin yadkhulu kulla yoom fi nuss al-kheema al-barraani achaan yisawwu khidmit al-ibaada.
Laakin kabiir rujaal al-diin bas yadkhul fi nussaha al-dakhlaani.Wa hu ma yadkhul illa marra waahide bas fi l-sana.Wa hu ma yadkhul illa hu chaayil al-damm al-yigaddimah le Allah kaffaara le nafsah hu wa le khataaya al-cha'ab al-sawwoohum bala raayhum.
Wa dool churuut al-ibaada.Wa beehum al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yiwassif kadar dakhuul fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid al-gaa'id fi l-samaawaat,ma maftuuh maadaamit al-kheema al-awwal lissaa'ha gaa'ide.
Wa da masal hana l-zaman al-haali.Humman yigaddumu dahaaya laakin al-dahaaya dool ma yagdaro yisawwu al-naadum al-ya'abud Allah kaamil achaan ma yagdaro yikhayyuru galbah.
Wa nizaam al-ibaada da bukhuss al-akil wa l-charaab wa l-wadu.Al-churuut dool bukhussu jisim al-insaan bas wa humman yagoodu lahaddi wakit al-nizaam al-jadiid yaji.
Laakin al-Masiih ja wa bigi kabiir rujaal al-diin al-jaab kheer katiir al-hassa' gaa'id.Wa hu dakhal fi kheema kabiire wa kaamile min al-kheema al-awwal.Wa l-kheema di,insaan ma banaaha.Hi ma min al-achya al-khalagoohum fi l-dunya di.
Wa khalaas,hu dakhal dakhuul waahid wa nihaa'i fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Wa l-damm al-hu chaalah ma hana khanam wa la hana ijil laakin chaal dammah hu zaatah.Wa be da,hu jaab leena al-fida al-daayim.
Awwal al-naas al-ajsaamhum bigo ma taahiriin,yikhassusuuhum be rachchiin damm al-khanam wa l-tiiraan wa rumaad al-bagara al-harragooha.
Laakin damm al-Masiih indah gudra ziyaada.Al-Masiih ma indah eeb wa hu gaddam nafsah le Allah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-abadi.Wa akiid dammah yitahhir guluubna min al-a'maal al-yiwaddu al-naas le l-moot wa yijahhizna le na'abudu Allah al-Hayy.
Wa fi chaan da,al-Masiih hu wasiit hana l-mu'aahada al-jadiide al-beeha al-naas al-Allah naadaahum yalgo al-warasa al-abadiiye al-hu waa'ad beeha.Achaan al-Masiih maat le yafda al-naas min khataayaahum al-sawwoohum fi wakit al-mu'aahada al-awwal.
Wa l-mu'aahada di muhimme misil wasiiye maktuuba hana warasa wa waajib yi'akkudu min moot hana l-naadum al-khatta al-wasiiye di.
Achaan al-wasiiye al-maktuuba,ma yakhdumu beeha illa ba'ad moot siidha.Ma yitabbuguuha wakit hu lissaa' hayy.
Achaan da,al-mu'aahada al-awwal kula ma kaanat illa be daffigiin damm.
Wa ba'ad Muusa ballakh kulla l-cha'ab be kulla wasaaya al-Tawraat,hu chaal suuf ahmar wa firi' hana zuufa wa dassaahum fi almi wa damm hana ijil wa khanam.Wa rachcha beehum al-Kitaab zaatah wa kulla l-cha'ab.
Wa gaal-:﴾‍Daahu damm al-mu'aahada al-Allah sawwaaha ma'aaku.‍﴿
Wa be misil da,hu rachcha al-damm fi l-kheema wa fi kulla l-mawaa'iin al-yista'maloohum fi bakaan al-ibaada.
Aywa,hasab churuut al-Tawraat,katiir min al-achya yitahhuruuhum be damm.Wa kan damm ma daffagooh,ma fi khufraan.
Achaan da,laabudda yitahhuru be l-dahaaya dool al-kheema al-gaa'ide fi l-ard al-hi alaama hana l-kheema al-samaawiiye.Laakin al-kheema al-samaawiiye zaatha waajib yitahhuruuha be dahaaya al-afdal ziyaada.
Wa l-bakaan al-mukhaddas al-Isa al-Masiih dakhal foogah,da ma al-bakaan al-banaah al-insaan.Al-bakaan da suura bas hana l-bakaan al-sahiih.Laakin hu dakhal fi l-sama zaatah achaan yahdar giddaam Allah fi chaanna fi l-zaman al-haali.
Wa hu dakhal laakin ma achaan yigaddim nafsah iddat marraat.Hu ma misil kabiir rujaal al-diin al-yadkhul kulli sana fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas marra waahid chaayil ma'aayah damm al-bahaayim.
Kan yabga misil da,waajib yat'ab iddat marraat min bidaayit al-dunya.Laakin hu ja marra waahide bas fi aakhir al-zaman achaan yigaddim nafsah misil dahiiye al-beeha yamha al-zunuub.
Akiid,maktuub le ayyi naadum yumuut marra waahide wa ba'ad al-moot yaji al-hisaab.
Wa l-Masiih kula gaddam nafsah marra waahide achaan yamha zunuub hana naas katiiriin.Wa hu yaji battaan marra taaniye ma achaan yamha al-zunuub wa laakin achaan yinajji al-naas al-gaa'idiin yarjooh.
Churuut al-Tawraat ma yiwassufu be l-sahiih kulla l-kheer al-yaji waraahum.Humman yiwassufu alaamtah bas.Wa hasab churuut al-Tawraat,waajib yigaddumu daayman nafs al-dahaaya kulli sana.Wa l-dahaaya dool abadan ma yagdaro yitahhuru tihaara kaamile al-naas al-yidooru ya'abudu Allah.
Wa kan sahiih al-dahaaya dool yitahhuru al-naas,akiid gaddimiinhum yagiif laakin ma wagaf.Achaan kan al-naas al-ya'abudu Allah ligo al-tihaara al-kaamile khalaas,humman ma yifakkuru battaan fi zunuubhum.
Laakin sana ba'ad sana be l-dahaaya dool,al-naas yifakkuru fi zunuubhum.
Achaan damm al-tiiraan wa damm al-khanam abadan ma yagdar yamha zunuub al-naas.
Wa fi chaan da,wakit al-Masiih ja fi l-dunya,hu gaal-:﴾‍Inta ma dawwartwa la dahiiye wa la hadiiyewa laakin inta jahhazt leyijismi al-insaani.
Inta ma ridiit be dahaaya muharragiinwa la dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib.
Wa khalaas,ana gult-:-Ya Allah,ana jiithasab al-kalaam al-yukhussinial-maktuub fi l-kitaab al-malfuuf.Ana jiitachaan nisawwi al-cheyy al-inta tidoorah.‍﴿
Wa awwal hu gaal-:-Inta ma dawwart wa la dahiiye wa la hadiiye wa la dahaaya muharragiin wa la dahaaya le kaffaarat al-zanib. Wa fi l-kalaam da,hu hajja be l-dahaaya al-waajib yigaddumuuhum hasab churuut al-Tawraat.
Wa ba'ad da,hu gaal-:-Daahu ana jiit.Ana jiit achaan nisawwi al-cheyy al-inta tidoorah. Wa misil da,hu yibattil al-dahaaya al-awwal wa yisabbit dahiiyat nafsah.
Wa be l-yidoorah Allah da,Isa al-Masiih gaddam jismah marra waahide wa nihaa'iiye wa l-dahiiye di sawwatna khaassiin le Allah.
Wa ayyi raajil diin yagiif kulli yoom be tuulah fi bakaan khidimtah wa yigaddim nafs al-dahaaya al-abadan ma yagdaro yamho al-zunuub.
Laakin Isa al-Masiih gaddam dahiiye waahide bas le kulla l-zunuub wa ba'ad da,hu ga'ad jamb Allah ila l-abad fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Wa hassa',yarja lahaddi Allah yukhutt udwaanah tihit rijileenah.
Achaan al-Masiih gaddam dahiiye waahide bas wa beeha hu kammal marra waahid tihaarat al-naas al-yabgo khaassiin le Allah.
Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus kula chaahid fi l-kalaam da.Achaan awwal hu gaal-:
﴾‍Di hi al-mu'aahada al-nisawwiiha ma'aahum ba'ad al-yoom da.Ana nukhutt wasiiyaati fi fikirhum wa naktibhum fi guluubhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.‍﴿
Wa ba'ad da,hu gaal-:﴾‍Ma nifakkir fi zunuubhum battaan wa la fi isyaanhum.‍﴿
Wa wakit Allah khafar le l-naas zunuubhum,battaan ma waajib yigaddumu dahiiye le l-zunuub.
Khalaas ya akhwaani,akiid be sabab damm Isa nagdaro nadkhulu fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas be amaan.
Wa l-derib al-maftuuh leena da,jadiid wa hu Isa al-hayy ila l-abad.Wa be gaddimiin jismah,hu fatah leena al-sitaar.
Wa aniina indina raajil diin aziim wa hu mas'uul fi beet Allah.
Achaan da,khalli nigarrubu le Allah be galib mukhlis wa be iimaan kaamil,be guluubna al-mutahhariin be dammah wa ajsaamna kamaan misil naddafnaahum be l-almi al-saafi.
Khalli nachhado daayman le Rabbina al-achamna gaa'id foogah wa ma nichakkuku achaan al-antaana al-wa'ad,hu daayman saadikh.
Khalli nifakkuru fi kikkeef nichchaaja'o ambeenaatna achaan nitaabu'u derib al-mahabba wa nisawwu al-kheer.
Khalli daayman nilimmu wa ma nitaabu'u aadaat al-naas al-waahidiin al-ma yidooru yilimmu.Ta'arfu kadar yoom jayyit al-Masiih garrab wa achaan da,achchaaja'o be ziyaada.
Kan irifna kalaam al-hagg wa ba'adeen nugummu nitaabu'u al-zunuub,ma yifaddil leena dahiiye battaan al-tamha al-zunuub.
Laakin ma fi cheyy yifaddil leena illa narjo be khoof chadiid al-hisaab wa l-naar al-muhriga hana khadab Allah al-taakul kulla l-aasiyiin.
Na'arfu kadar ayyi naadum al-aba ma taaba' churuut Tawraat Muusa wa chuhuud itneen aw talaata chahado foogah,al-naadum da yaktuluuh bala mahanna.
Haay-!Fakkuru fi l-ikhaab al-waajib le l-naadum al-khalla derib al-Masiih-!Hu hagar Ibn Allah hugra chadiide.Damm al-mu'aahada al-beyah hu bigi khaass le Allah,hu ja'alah ma indah khiima.Wa ayyar al-Ruuh al-antaah al-rahma.
Na'arfu Allah bas al-gaal-:﴾‍Al-taar hanaayi,ana bas al-nichiilah.‍﴿Wa battaan maktuub-:﴾‍Allah yihaakim cha'abah.‍﴿
Fi yoom al-Hisaab,al-azaab le l-yaga' fi iid Allah al-Hayy-!
Fakkuru fi l-wakit al-faat wakit awwal marra dakhaltu fi nuur Allah.Fi l-wakit daak,intu jaahadtu wa sabartu sabur gawi fi l-diige.
Waahidiin minku ayyaroohum giddaam al-naas wa ta''aboohum wa waahidiin minku chaarako ma'a l-naas fi l-ta'ab al-ti'ibooh.
Wa intu hanneetu le l-masaajiin.Wa wakit al-naas nahabo maalku,intu farhaaniin achaan iriftu kadar induku maal akheer minnah gaa'id giddaamku wa l-maal da yagood daayman.
Wa fi kulla l-kalaam da,nuguul leeku ma tikhallu iimaanku al-gawi al-yijiib leeku ajur kabiir bilheen.
Hassa' da,waajib tasburu sabur gawi wa tisawwu al-cheyy al-Allah yidoorah achaan talgo minnah al-baraka al-hu waa'ad beeha.
Achaan fi l-Kitaab,Allah gaal-:﴾‍Al-wakit al-faddal chiyya basachaan al-jaayi yajiwa yaji bala ta'khiir.
Wa be iimaanah,al-saalih yahyawa kan yikaskis minnah,ana ma narda beyah.‍﴿
Wa laakin aniina ma min al-naas al-yikaskusu wa yamchu le l-halaak.Aniina min naas al-iimaan wa namchu le l-naja.
Al-naadum al-indah iimaan,hu mu'akkid kadar hu yalga al-cheyy al-yarjaah wa ma indah chakak fi l-cheyy al-lissaa' ma binchaaf.
Fi chaan iimaanhum,naas al-zamaan ligo rida Allah.
Be l-iimaan,na'arfu kadar Allah khalag al-dunya be kilmitah.Wa achaan da,na'arfu kulla cheyy al-binchaaf ja wa kaan be tariiga al-ma tinchaaf.
Wa be l-iimaan,Haabiilgaddam dahiiye le Allah.Wa dahiiytah bigat akheer min hadiiyat Gaabiil.Wa fi chaan iimaanah,Allah ridi beyah wa ja'alah naadum saalih.Allah khibil dahaayah wa chahad leyah.Wa Haabiil maat laakin be iimaanah,ya hassa' kula hu gaa'id yihajji.
Wa be l-iimaan,Akhnuukhrafa'ooh achaan ma yumuut.Hu ma anlaga achaan Allah bas rafa'ah.Wa l-Kitaab yachhad le Akhnuukh kadar gubbaal ma yinrafi',Allah ridi beyah.
Wa bala iimaan,naadum ma yalga rida Allah.Achaan ayyi naadum al-yidoor yigarrib le Allah,waajib yi'aamin kadar Allah mawjuud wa yanti ajur le l-naas al-yifattuchuuh.
Wa be l-iimaan,Nooh simi' kalaam Allah.Awwal Allah khabbarah be l-cheyy al-yidoor yabga wa lissaa' ma binchaaf.Wa min chiddit takhwaah,Nooh bana safiinaachaan yinajji ahal beetah.Wa be da,Nooh sabbat kadar naas al-dunya khaatiyiin.Wa hu waras al-adaala al-naadum ma yagdar yalhagha illa be l-iimaan.
Wa be l-iimaan,Ibraahiim simi' kalaam Allah wa gamma machafi l-bakaan al-ba'adeen yabga warasatah.Wa hu macha gubbaal ma ya'arif al-bakaan al-waajib yamchi leyah.
Wa be l-iimaan,hu bigi ajnabi fi l-balad al-Allah waa'adah beeha wa sakan foogha fi kheema.Wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub kula wurraas mislah fi nafs al-wa'ad.
Achaan Ibraahiim gaa'id yarja be acham al-madiina al-jaaye al-asaasha saabit al-Allah bas khattatha wa banaaha.
Wa be l-iimaan,Saara kula bigat khalbaanehatta kan hi ajuuz ma indaha gudra le l-waaluuda kula.Laakin Allah waa'adaaha be wileed wa hi gaalat Allah saadikh.
Wa be misil da,raajil waahid al-chayyab marra waahid bigi abu hana zurriiye katiire misil al-nujuum wa misil ramla hana khachum al-bahar al-ma tinhasib.
Wa kulla naas al-zamaan dool maato saabtiin fi l-iimaan.Humman ma ligo al-cheyy al-Allah waa'ad beyah laakin chaafooh min ba'iid wa firho beyah.Wa a'tarafo kadar humman saakniin fi usut naas al-ard misil ajaanib wa diifaan.
Wa l-naas al-yihajju kalaam misil da yiwassufu kadar yidooru watan aakhar yaskunu foogah.
Fikirhum ma fi l-balad al-marago minha.Kan dawwaro yigabbulu foogha,yagdaro.
Laakin be l-sahiih,humman yidooru watan akheer min al-marago minnah wa hu al-watan al-samaawi.Achaan da,Allah akkad kadar hu Rabbuhum wa humman cha'abah wa jahhaz leehum madiina.
Wa be l-iimaan,Ibraahiim gaddam Ishaakh dahiiye wakit Allah jarrabah.Al-naadum al-Allah antaah al-wa'ad chaal niiye achaan yigaddim wileedah al-wahiid dahiiye le Allah.
Wa Ishaakh da,hu al-wileed al-Allah awwal hajja beyah wa gaal-:﴾‍Min Ishaakh bas talga zurriiye al-binaaduuha be usmak.‍﴿
Wa Ibraahiim khatta fi fikrah kadar Allah indah gudra yigawwim al-maytiin kula.Wa be l-sahiih,wakit Allah gabbal Ishaakh le Ibraahiim,Ibraahiim chaaf wileedah misil maat wa gamma min al-moot.
Wa be l-iimaan,Ishaakh talab le Yaakhuub wa Isuu be l-baraka al-tukhuss al-cheyy al-yabga ba'adeen.
Wa be l-iimaan,Yaakhuub wakit hu gariib yumuut,talab baraka le ayyi waahid min awlaad Yuusuf wa arrakkaz fi asaatah le ya'abud Allah.
Wa be l-iimaan,Yuusuf wakit hu gariib yumuut,hajja be marigiin Bani Israa'iil min Masir al-yabga ba'adeen.Wa amaraahum yichiilu udaamah ma'aahum.
Wa be l-iimaan,waaldeen Muusa ba'ad wildooh,labbadooh muddit talaata chahar.Chaafo kadar wileedhum jamiil marra waahid wa humman ma khaayfiin min al-malik Fir'oon wa ma taaba'o amrah.
Wa be l-iimaan,Muusa wakit hu kibir khalaas,aba ma khalla al-naas yinaaduuh wileed bineeyit Fir'oon.
Wa hu chaal niiye achaan yat'ab ma'a cha'ab Allah wa aba ma yitaabi' al-zunuub wa chahwaat al-dunya al-ma daayme.
Hu ja'al kadar al-mu'yaar al-yaji foogah fi chaan al-Masiih indah faayde katiire min kulla dahab Masir.Wa hu khatta fikrah fi l-ajur al-giddaamah.
Wa be l-iimaan,hu marag min Masir ma khaayif min za'al al-malik.Hu taaba' Allah be sabur gawi misil naadum gaa'id yichiif Allah al-ma binchaaf.
Wa be l-iimaan,Muusa kharrar iid al-Fisha wa rachcha al-damm achaan malak al-moot al-gaa'id yaktul awlaad al-bikir,hu ma yaji foog awlaad Bani Israa'iil.
Wa be l-iimaan,al-cha'ab gata'o al-bahar al-Ahmar wa hu bigi leehum misil turaab yaabis.Laakin wakit al-Masriyiin dawwaro yisawwu nafs al-cheyy,al-almi akalaahum.
Wa be l-iimaan,daraadir hana madiinat Ariiha waga'owa da ba'ad Bani Israa'iil hawwagooha sab'a marraat.
Wa be l-iimaan,al-charmuuta Raahaabma hilkat ma'a l-aasiyiin achaan hi dayyafat al-naas al-jo raakho al-balad.
Wa nuguul chunu battaan-?Al-wakit ma yitimm leyi nihajji be Gid'uun wa Baaraakh wa Chamchuun wa Yiftaah wa Dawuud wa Samuwiil wa l-anbiya.
Be l-iimaan,humman chaalo mamaalik wa tabbago al-adaala wa ligo min Allah al-cheyy al-waa'adaahum beyah wa saddo khuchuum al-diidaan.
Wa be l-iimaan,katalo naar mugargire wa nijo min suyuuf udwaanhum wa ligo al-gudra al-awwal ma induhum wa bigo gawiyiin fi l-harib wa tarado al-duyuuch al-hajamo baladhum.
Wa fi awiin al-maytiinhin ba'aso wa gabbalo leehin.Wa laakin fi naas waahidiin,azzaboohum wa abo ma yamurgu min al-azaab achaan yidooru yab'aso fi haya afdal.
Wa mu'miniin waahidiin achchammato leehum wa jaladoohum wa waahidiin janzaroohum wa sajanoohum.
Wa mu'miniin waahidiin rajamoohum wa waahidiin chaggoohum min usut be munchaar wa waahidiin kataloohum be l-seef.Wa waahidiin daayman raaykhiin laabsiin firaaw al-khanam wa himlo fagur chadiid wa diige wa zulum.
Wa waahidiin muwaddiriin wa gaa'idiin yuruukhu fi l-sahara wa l-hujaar.Wa waahidiin saakniin fi karaakiir wa nugaar al-ard.Wa kulla l-mu'miniin dool akheer marra waahid min naas al-dunya al-taradoohum.
Wa kulla l-naas dool,Allah ridi beehum be sabab iimaanhum.Laakin humman ma ligo al-baraka al-Allah waa'adaahum beeha.
Achaan min awwal,Allah khaddar cheyy akheer leena wa khidmit Allah ma tabga kaamile fooghum illa ma'aana aniina.
Wa fi l-kalaam da,indina chuhuud katiiriin bilheen al-yachhado leena min ayyi jiihe.Achaan da,khalli nikhallu minnina kulla cheyy al-yiwaggifna wa kulla zanib al-yidoor yakrubna.Wa khalli namchu giddaam be juhud misil naas fi musaabaga wa najru lahaddi nikammulu al-musaabaga al-aniina gaa'idiin foogha.
Khalli nukhuttu uyuunna fi Isa al-fatah leena derib al-iimaan wa kammalah.Min ba'iid,hu chaaf al-farah al-gaa'id giddaamah wa himil ta'ab al-saliib wa ma fakkar fi l-eeb al-khattooh foogah.Wa hassa',hu gaa'id jamb arch Allah fi nussah al-zeenaay.
Fakkuru foogah hu,al-himil al-bukhud al-chadiid hana l-muznibiin.Fakkuru foogah achaan intu ma tabgo kaslaaniin wa la khawwaafiin.
Intu gammeetu didd al-zanib laakin ma sabartu lahaddi al-moot.
Intu nisiitu kalaam al-chajaa'a al-Allah gaalah leeku intu awlaadah-?Gaal-:﴾‍Ya wileedi,ma taaba adab Allah wa ma taksal kan yi'aakhibak
achaan Allah yi'addib al-yihibbah wa yudugg ayyi wileed al-hu khibilah.‍﴿
Al-ta'ab al-intu tasburu foogah,waajib leeku fi chaan al-adab.Allah yi'aamilku misil raajil yi'aamil iyaalah.Ween al-wileed al-abuuh ma yi'addibah-?
Kan al-adab al-yaji foog kulla l-iyaal min abbahaathum ma yaji foogku,khalaas intu ma awlaad abuuku da,intu furuukh.
Fakkuru battaan.Ayyi naadum minnina indah abu insaani al-addabah wa abbahaatna dool aniina nikarrumuuhum.Wa da yi'akkid leena be ziyaada kadar waajib nakhbalo adab Allah abuuna al-samaawi wa nalgo al-haya.
Achaan abbahaatna addaboona adab al-humman yardo beyah le mudda gisayre.Laakin Allah yi'addibna le faayditna achaan nichaaruku fi khadaastah.
Fi l-wakit al-haali,kulla l-adab gaasi leena wa ma yantiina farah.Laakin ba'adeen,al-naas al-daraboohum achaan al-adab yalgo minnah natiija wa hi al-salaam wa l-adaala.
Achaan da,khallu minku al-kasal.Gawwu iideeku wa rijleeku al-ma induhum gudra.
Addulu al-derib al-turuukhu foogah achaan al-rijil al-arja ma tamrug laakin tabra.
Sawwu juhud achaan ti'iichu be l-salaam ma'a kulla l-naas wa iichu be haal saalhe al-balaaha ma fi naadum yichiif Rabbina.
Angar'u achaan naadum minku ma yadhar nafsah min ni'mat Allah.Angar'u achaan naadum ambeenaatku ma yitallif nafsah wa la yitallif al-jamaa'a misil chadara fi usutku al-iyaalha induhum samm.
Angar'u achaan naadum ma yabga zannaay walla kaafir misil Isuu al-isi Allah.Hu baa' hagg al-bukuuriiye fi chaan akle waahide bas.
Wa ta'arfu kadar ba'adeen hu dawwar yalga al-baraka wa laakin abuuh abaah.Wa Isuu ma ligi tariiga yi'addil beeha haala hatta kan hu fattachha be baki kula.
Khuttu baalku achaan al-hajar al-intu jiitu giddaamah,da ma al-hajar al-naas yagdaro yilammusuuh misil Bani Israa'iil fi jabal Siinaa'.Hu ma al-hajar al-gaa'idiin foogah naar mugargire wa dalaam azrag wa riih chadiide.
Wa l-hajar hana l-wakit daak,ansama' foogah hiss al-buug wa l-hiss al-kalaamah khawwaf al-cha'ab lahaddi l-naas al-sim'ooh talabo achaan ma yihajji leehum battaan.
Achaan al-amur al-Allah amaraahum beyah gaasi leehum wa ma himlooh.Hu gaal kadar al-yilammis al-hajar da waajib yarjumuuh,hatta kan bahiime kula.
Aywa,al-cheyy al-chaafooh khawwafaahum marra waahid lahaddi Muusa kula gaal-:-Ana gaa'id narjif min al-khoof.
Laakin al-hajar al-intu jiitu giddaamah,hu jabal Sahyuun al-gaa'ide foogah madiinat Allah al-Hayy.Wa hi Madiinat al-Khudus al-samaawiiye.Jiitu giddaam al-malaa'ika al-ma yinhasbu min al-katara al-laammiin le l-ihtifaal.
Wa jiitu giddaam jamaa'at awlaad al-bikir al-asaameehum musajjaliin fi l-sama.Wa jiitu giddaam Allah al-yihaasib kulla l-naas.Wa jiitu giddaam arwaah al-saalihiin al-Allah sawwaahum kaamiliin.
Wa jiitu giddaam Isa wasiit hana l-mu'aahada al-jadiide wa giddaam dammah al-marchuuch al-yachhad leena be chahaada akheer min chahaadat damm Haabiil.
Angar'u-!Ma taabo al-yikallim leeku.Achaan kan naas al-zamaan ma nijo wakit abo ma taaba'o kalaam Muusa al-hazzarhum fi l-ard,kikkeef aniina nanjo kan naabo kalaam al-yihazzirna min al-sama-?
Awwal,hiss Allah rajjaf al-ard wa hassa',hu waa'adaana wa gaal-:﴾‍Marra waahide battaan,nirajjif al-ard wa nirajjif ma'aaha al-sama kula.‍﴿
Wa l-kalaam -marra waahide battaan- yiwassif be kalaam waadih al-khaliige tarjif wa tabga ma fiiha.Wa be da,al-ma yarjif bas yifaddil.
Wa khalaas,khalli nachkuru Allah achaan hu gaa'id yantiina mamlaka saabte al-ma tarjif.Wa khalli na'abudu Allah be l-ibaada al-hu yarda beeha be takhwa wa ihtiraam.
Achaan Allah al-na'abuduuh da,hu misil naar al-tahrig kulla cheyy.
Agoodu saabtiin fi l-mahabba al-akhawiiye.
Ma tikhallu minku faddiliin al-diifaan al-yajuuku.Ta'arfu kadar naas waahidiin dayyafo malaa'ika wa ma irfoohum.
Fakkuru fi akhwaanku al-gaa'idiin fi l-sijin wa aj'alo nufuusku misil gaa'idiin ma'aahum.Wa akhwaanku al-gaa'idiin yahmalo al-ta'ab,fakkuru fooghum achaan jisimhum misil jisimku.
Kulluku ahtarumu al-akhiide.Ma tikhallu al-zina yinajjis saraayirku al-zoojiiye achaan ta'arfu kadar Allah yihaasib kulla l-zannaayiin,kan maakhdiin walla ma maakhdiin kula.
Angar'u min hubb al-maal wa abgo radyaaniin be l-induku achaan Allah gaal-:﴾‍Abadan ma naabaak wa la nikhalliik.‍﴿
Achaan da,kullina nagdaro nuguulu bala chakak-:﴾‍Allah yisaa'idni,ana ma nakhaaf min cheyy.Al-naas yagdaro yisawwu leyi chunu-?‍﴿
Fakkuru adiil fi kubaaraatku al-awwal ballakho leeku kalaam Allah.Fakkuru fooghum kikkeef humman aacho wa maato.Wa khalli iimaanku yabga misil iimaanhum.
Isa al-Masiih abadan ma yilkhayyar.Hu gaa'id min awwal wa l-yoom wa ila l-abad.
Ma tikhallu al-naas al-jaayiin be ta'liim ajiib aw chig chig yiwadduuku fi derib aakhar.Akheer galib al-insaan yalga gudra min rahmat Allah bas wa ma min al-akil al-khaass.Wa l-naas al-taaba'o al-ta'liim da,ma ligo minnah faayde.
Al-dahiiye al-aniina nichaaruku foogha di,rujaal al-diin al-yakhdumu fi kheemat al-ibaada ma induhum hagg yaakulu minha.
Achaan kabiir rujaal al-diin yadbah bahaayim dahiiye le l-zunuub wa yijiib al-damm fi l-bakaan al-mukhaddas.Laakin laham al-bahaayim dool,yimarruguuh barra min al-fariig wa yiharruguuh.
Wa achaan da,Isa kula marag wa ti'ib barra min al-madiina achaan yisawwi al-cha'ab khaass le Allah be daffigiin dammah hu.
Achaan da,khalli namurgu wa namchu leyah barra min al-fariig wa nahmalo nafs al-mu'yaar al-hu himlah.
Achaan hini fi l-ard,ma indina madiina al-titawwil laakin aniina gaa'idiin nukhuttu baalna fi l-madiina al-taji ba'adeen.
Fi badal al-dahiiye hana l-bahaayim,khalli na'abudu Allah be derib Isa wa nigaddumu le Allah daayman dahiiyat chukur.Wa da ma'anaatah al-chukur al-jaayi min al-naas al-ya'arfu usum Allah.
Sawwu daayman al-kheer wa assaa'ado ambeenaatku achaan di bas al-ibaada al-Allah yarda beeha.
Asma'o kubaaraatku wa taabu'u kalaamhum adiil.Achaan humman gaa'idiin yifakkuru foogku wa ya'arfu kadar humman mas'uuliin minku giddaam Allah al-yihaasibhum.Khalli khidmithum di tabga leehum farha.Kan tabga leehum gaasiye,intu kula ma talgo minha faayde.
As'alo Allah leena.Aniina mu'akkidiin kadar niiyitna mukhlisa wa nidooru nitaabu'u haal adiile fi kulla cheyy.
Wa battaan natulbu minku be ziyaada,as'alo leyi ana achaan Allah yirassilni leeku fi wakit gariib.
Wa khalaas,Allah Rabb al-salaam ba'as min ust al-maytiin Rabbina Isa al-bigi raa'i kabiir hana khanam Allah be sabab damm al-mu'aahada al-abadiiye.
Wa khalli Allah yijahhizku be kulla cheyy al-adiil achaan tisawwu al-hu yidoorah.Wa khalli hu yisawwi foogku kulla cheyy al-hu yarda beyah be waasitat Isa al-Masiih.Aywa,le Isa al-Masiih al-majd daayman wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Ya akhwaani,nachhadku achaan tasma'o be sabur al-kalaam al-nirassilah leeku le nichajji'ku.Katabt leeku kalaam chiyya bas.
Nidoor intu ta'arfu kadar akhuuna Timuutaawus talagooh min al-sijin wa kan hu yaji leyi ajala,namchu leeku ma'aayah wa nichiifuuku.
Sallumu kulla kubaaraatku wa kulla l-saalihiin.Al-akhwaan al-min Itaaliya yisallumuuku.
Aleeku kulluku rahmat Allah.Aamiin.
Jawaab minni ana Yaakhuub abd Allah wa abd Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.Wa nirassilah leeku intu ummat Allah al-muchattatiin fi ayyi bakaan.Al-salaam aleekum.
Ya akhwaani,afraho fi ayyi ta'ab al-yajiiku
achaan ta'arfu kadar al-ta'ab yijarrib iimaanku wa kan ga'adtu saabtiin fi ust al-ta'ab,tabgo naas sabuuriin.
Wa khalli saburku yabga tamaam achaan beyah tabgo kaamiliin wa gaadriin wa ma fi cheyy yigassir leeku.
Kan naadum minku ma indah hikma,khalli yatlubha min Allah wa Allah yantiih.Achaan Allah yanti le kulla l-naas be ziyaada be juud wa bala luwaama.
Wa khalli yatlubha be iimaan saabit wa bala chakak.Naadum kan yichakkik,hu misil challaal al-bahar al-tichiilah al-riih wa tihizzah.
Naadum misil da,khalli ma yukhutt fi aglah kadar yalga cheyy min Rabbina
achaan al-naadum da galbah itneen wa hu ma saabit fi ayyi cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Al-akhu al-mu'min al-miskiin,khalli yafrah achaan Allah darrajah.
Wa l-mu'min siid al-maal kula,khalli yafrah achaan hu maskan nafsah giddaam Allah.Wa siid al-maal,hu misil gechch,ma yitawwil.
Kan al-harraay tala'at wa bigat haamiye bilheen,hi tutugg al-gechch wa l-gechch da yabga asfar wa yaybas wa yumuut.Wa misil da bas,siid al-maal kula yumuut fi usut khidimtah wa yabga ma fiih.
Mabruuk le l-naadum al-yasbur fi l-ta'ab al-yijarrib iimaanah.Achaan wakit al-tajriba di kammalat khalaas,hu yalga taaj al-haya.Wa l-taaj da,hu al-haya al-Allah waa'ad beeha al-naas al-yihibbuuh.
Kan naadum gaa'id fi l-tajriba,khalli ma yuguul-:-Allah gaa'id yilizzini fi l-zanib. Achaan abadan ma fi cheyy yilizz Allah fi l-zanib.Wa Allah hu abadan ma yilizz naadum fi l-zanib.
Laakin kan naadum yidoor yaznib,chahwatah bas gaa'ide tilizzah achaan al-zanib bigi leyah halu.
Wa l-chahwa hi misil mara al-takhlab wa talda sakhiir.Al-chahwa kula takhlab wa talda sakhiir wa sakhiirha,hu al-zanib.Wa l-zanib kan khalaas kibir yisabbib al-moot.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,ma tukhuchchu nufuusku.
Kulla cheyy al-adiil wa kulla cheyy al-tamaam jaayi min Allah bas wa yanzil min Allah khaalig al-anwaar al-fi l-sama.Wa hu ma yilkhayyar abadan wa ma yilhawwal misil al-dull.
Be waasitat kalaam al-hagg,Allah antaana al-haya al-jadiide be niiytah achaan aniina nabgo muhimmiin min kulla makhluugiinah.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,fakkuru adiil.Khalli ayyi naadum yukuun daayman jaahiz le yasma'.Khalli ma yihajji ajala wa ma yaz'al ajala
achaan kan naadum za'laan ma yisawwi al-amal al-saalih al-Allah yidoorah.
Achaan da,khallu minku kulla cheyy al-yinajjisku wa kulla cheyy al-fasil wa akhbalo be maskana al-kalaam al-Allah khattaah fi guluubku.Al-kalaam da indah gudra achaan yinajjiiku.
Tabbugu kalaam Allah wa ma tasma'ooh bas.Kan tasma'ooh wa ma titabbuguuh,tukhuchchu nufuusku.
Kan naadum simi' kalaam Allah wa ma tabbagah,hu yabga misil naadum al-yichiif wijhah fi amchawwaafa.
Wa yichiif kikkeef wijhah wa khalaas yamchi wa tawwaali yansaah.
Wa laakin kan naadum yukhutt baalah adiil fi wasaaya Allah al-kaamiliin al-yantuuna al-hurriiye wa yinkarib fooghum wa ma yasma'hum le yansaahum wa yitabbighum,khalaas al-naadum da,Allah yibaarikah fi kulli cheyy al-yisawwiih.
Al-naadum al-yifakkir hu yitaabi' al-diin adiil wa laakin ma yalzam lisaanah,hu da gaa'id yukhuchch nafsah wa diinah ma yanfa'.
Daahu al-diin al-saafi al-ma indah eeb giddaam abuuna Allah.Aawunu al-ataama wa l-awiin al-araamil al-gaa'idiin fi l-ta'ab.Wa agiifu ba'iid min al-achya al-yinajjusu naas al-dunya.
Ya akhwaani,intu mu'miniin be Rabbina al-majiid Isa al-Masiih wa fi derbah hu,ma waajib tichiifu al-waahid akheer min al-aakhar.
Masalan,fi jamaa'itku al-mu'miniin,ja naadum waahid siid maal laabis khulgaan samhiin marra waahid wa indah khaatim hana dahab.Wa ja aakhar miskiin laabis khalag waskhaan wa mucharrat.
Wa intu tikarrumu siid al-maal al-khulgaanah samhiin wa tuguulu leyah-:-Alfaddal giddaam,ya l-sayyid- wa tuguulu le l-miskiin-:-Haay inta da,yalla agood tihit hinaak-!
Wa misil da,khalaas intu chiftu al-waahid akheer min al-aakhar wa hagartu al-miskiin.Wa kan tisawwu misil da,sawweetu nufuusku misil hukkaam al-guluubhum fasliin.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,asma'o kalaami.Allah azal al-naas al-masaakiin fi l-dunya di achaan yalgo iimaan ziyaada wa yawrusu al-mamlaka al-Allah waa'ad beeha al-naas al-yihibbuuh.
Laakin intu hagartu al-miskiin da.Yaatumman al-yazulmuuku-?Yaatumman al-yakurbuuku wa yathamooku giddaam al-charii'a-?Ma siyaad al-maal walla-?
Dool humman bas al-yi'ayyuru al-usum al-kariim hana Rabbuku.
Be l-sahiih,da adiil kan intu gaa'idiin titaabu'u churuut al-Tawraat hana mamlakat Allah al-gaa'idiin fi l-Kitaab al-buguulu-:﴾‍Hibb akhuuk misil tihibb nafsak.‍﴿
Wa laakin kan intu gaa'idiin tichiifu al-waahid akheer min al-aakhar,intu gaa'idiin taznubu.Wa churuut al-Tawraat dool yahkumu foogku achaan intu khaatiyiin.
Ta'arfu kadar al-naadum al-taaba' kulla l-churuut wa laakin khaalaf chart waahid,hu misil khaalaf kulla l-churuut.
Achaan Allah gaal-:﴾‍Ma tazna‍﴿wa battaan gaal-:﴾‍Ma taktul dimme.‍﴿Wa kan inta katalt dimme wa laakin ma zaneet,khalaas hasab al-churuut dool,inta khaati.
Hajju kalaam adiil wa sawwu amal adiil wa abadan ma tanso kadar Allah yihaasibku hasab wasaaya Allah al-yantu al-hurriiye.
Kan naadum ma yarham al-naas,Allah kula ma yarhamah fi yoom al-Hisaab.Wa laakin al-naadum al-yarham al-naas,ma yakhaaf min yoom al-Hisaab.
Ya akhwaani,ween al-faayde kan naadum buguul hu mu'min laakin ma yiwassif iimaanah be amalah-?Iimaan nafar da yagdar yinajjiih walla-?
Masalan,akuun chiftu akhwaanku walla akhwaatku ma induhum lubaas wa ma induhum cheyy hana akil
wa tuguulu leehum-:-Amchu aafe,Allah yaftah leeku-.Wa chunu al-faayde kan intu ma tantuuhum al-cheyy al-humman hawjaaniin leyah-?
Wa khalaas,kan naadum buguul hu indah iimaan laakin ma yiwassifah be amal al-kheer,iimaanah da ma yanfa' marra waahid-!
Laakin akuun naadum yuguul-:-Inta indak iimaan wa laakin ana indi amal al-kheer. Ana nurudd leyah wa nuguul-:-Inta ma tagdar tiwassif leyi iimaanak kan ma indak amal al-kheer.Wa kan leyi ana,niwassif leek iimaani be l-amal al-kheer al-nisawwiih.
Inta mu'min kadar Allah waahid.Da sameh.Hatta l-chawaatiin kula mu'miniin kadar Allah waahid wa laakin yarjufu wa yakhaafo min al-azaab al-yaji fooghum.
Inta al-fikrak baatil,ana niwassif leek kadar al-iimaan bala amal ma yanfa'.
Fakkuru fi abuuna Ibraahiim.Allah ja'alah saalih be sabab al-amal al-hu sawwaah.Hu khassad yigaddim wileedah Ishaakh dahiiye fi l-madbah.
Chiifu,Ibraahiim iimaanah bigi kaamil achaan hu sawwa al-cheyy al-Allah yidoorah.
Be misil da bas,tamma al-cheyy al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-buguul-:﴾‍Ibraahiim aaman be kalaam Allah wa fi chaan iimaanah,Allah ja'alah naadum saalih.‍﴿Wa Allah ja'alah khaliilah.
Chiifu,Allah yaj'al al-naas saalihiin be amalhum wa ma be l-iimaan wiheedah.
Bigi misil da le Raahaab al-charmuuta kula.Allah ja'alaaha saalhe be sabab al-cheyy al-hi sawwatah.Wa da wakit hi labbadat al-murassaliin wa maragathum be derib aakhar.
Khalaas,ta'arfu kadar jilid bala ruuh ma yanfa'.Wa misil da,iimaan bala amal kheer kula ma yanfa'.
Ya akhwaani,khalli katiiriin minku ma yabgo mu'allimiin achaan ta'arfu kadar Allah yihaasibna aniina al-mu'allimiin chadiid min al-naas al-aakhariin.
Ayyi waahid minnina yakhta katiir.Kan naadum abadan ma yakhta fi kalaamah,hu da naadum kaamil wa yagdar fi nafsah.
Fakkuru fi l-lijaam al-nidissuuh fi khachum al-juwaad.Al-lijaam sakhayyar wa laakin be sababah,nagdaro niwaddu al-juwaad fi ayyi bakaan al-nidooruuh.
Wa fakkuru battaan fi l-safiina.Hi kabiire bilheen wa riih chadiide tilizzaha giddaam wa laakin be uud sakhayyar bas al-sawwaag yuguudha fi l-bakaan al-yidoorah.
Wa chiifu al-lisaan-!Hu kula sakhayyar wa laakin yisabbib cheyy kabiir.Wa battaan fakkuru fi l-naar.Naar sakhayre bas tiharrig kulla l-khaaba.
Wa l-lisaan,hu kula misil al-naar achaan beyah nuguulu kalaam fasil wa hu yinajjis kulla jilidna.Wa naar al-lisaan di taakul hayaatna min awwalha lahaddi akhiirha.Wa l-naar di jaaye min naar Jahannam zaatah.
