Wa l-insaan yagdar yidallilhum le kulla nafar hana l-haywaanaat,kan min al-tuyuur walla zawaahif walla huut al-bahar kula.Wa dallalaahum khalaas.
Wa laakin ma fi naadum yagdar yidallil lisaanah.Al-lisaan hu cheyy fasil al-ma yagood saakit wa malaan be l-samm al-yaktul.
Beyah hu,nachkuru Allah abuuna wa beyah hu battaan,nal'ano al-naas al-Allah khalagaahum fi suurtah.
Be khachum al-waahid bas nachkuru wa nal'ano beyah.Ya akhwaani,khalli ma yabga misil da.
Hal min biir waahide nalgo almi halu wa almi murr walla-?
Ya akhwaani,chadarat al-tiin talda zaytuun walla-?Wa chadarat al-inab talda tiin walla-?La-!Wa abadan ma nagdaro namurgu almi halu min biir almiiha murr.
Yaatu minku hakiim wa faahim-?Khalli yiwassif amalah be haalah al-samhe be nafas baarid wa hikma.
Laakin kan induku fi guluubku husud chadiid wa adaawa,ma tifaachuru beehum achaan be l-sahiih,fachaarku da kidib didd al-hagg.
Hikmitku di ma min Allah laakin hi hikmat al-dunya wa maarge min fikir al-insaan wa min Ibliis.
Fi ayyi bakaan al-gaa'idiin foogah al-husud wa l-istikbaar,al-barjaal wa kulla cheyy fasil kula gaa'idiin foogah.
Laakin al-hikma al-min Allah awwalan ke saafiye wa l-naadum al-indah al-hikma yiriid al-salaam wa kalaamah baarid wa raasah ma gawi wa hu hanuun wa yisawwi amal al-kheer wa hu ma indah tafrikha wa la nifaakh.
Wa natiijat al-adaala mazruu'a fi l-salaam le l-naas al-yisawwu amal al-salaam.
Al-duwaas wa l-huraaj ambeenaatku jaayiin min ween-?Humman jaayiin min chahwaatku al-gaa'idiin yihaarubu fi guluubku.
Tidooru chokhol waahid wa ma talgooh.Tukhuttu eenku fi cheyy waahid wa ma talgooh wa tugummu taktulu.Wa tugummu tidaawusu wa tihaarubu wa ma talgo al-cheyy al-tidooruuh,da achaan intu ma sa'altu Allah.
Wa kan tas'alo kula,ma talgo cheyy achaan niiyitku ma adiile wa intu tas'alo le chahwaatku bas.
Intu cha'ab munaafikhiin-!Ma ta'arfu kadar al-naas al-yihibbu al-dunya udwaan Allah-?Wa l-naadum al-yihibb al-dunya sawwa nafsah adu Allah.
Hal tuguulu kalaam al-Kitaab ma indah ma'ana kan buguul-:﴾‍Allah indah mahabba ziyaada le l-ruuh al-khattaah foogna.‍﴿
Al-ni'ma al-Allah yantiiha leena kabiire ziyaada.Wa achaan da,al-Kitaab buguul-:﴾‍Allah yugumm didd al-naas al-yistakbaro laakin hu yanti ni'ma le l-naas al-yimaskunu nufuushum.‍﴿
Fi chaan da,asma'o kalaam Allah wa agiifu didd Ibliis wa Ibliis yajri ba'iid minku.
Ta'aalu garrubu le Allah wa Allah yigarrib leeku.Intu al-muznibiin,naddufu iideeku min al-zanib.Intu al-galibku itneen,tahhuru nufuusku.
Abgo haznaaniin fi chaan zunuubku wa asrakho wa abku baki chadiid.Battaan ma tadhako,akheer tabku.Ma tafraho,akheer tahzano.
Maskunu nufuusku giddaam Allah wa khalaas,hu yarfa'ku.
Ya akhwaani,ma tuguulu kalaam fasil ambeenaatku.Ayyi naadum al-yatham akhuuh walla yuguul kalaam fasil foogah,hu da gaa'id yatham wasaaya Allah wa yuguul kalaam fasil fooghum.Wa kan inta tuguul kalaam fasil fi l-wasaaya dool,khalaas inta ma gaa'id titabbighum laakin sawweet nafsak haakim.
Allah anta al-wasaaya wa hu bas al-haakim.Hu wiheedah bas al-yinajji wa hu wiheedah bas al-yahlik.Wa inta al-tatham akhuuk,inta ke yaatu-?
Wa asma'o kalaami,intu al-tuguulu-:-Al-yoom walla ambaakir,aniina namchu fi hille waahide wa nagoodu hinaak sana waahide.Wa nitaajuru wa nalgo gurus katiir.
Wa laakin intu ma ta'arfu chunu al-yukuun leeku ambaakir.Hayaatku misil al-dukhkhaan al-yugumm wa tawwaali bas yabga ma fiih.
Akheer tuguulu-:-Kan Rabbina gaal aamiin wa antaana al-haya,nisawwu cheyy misil da aw misil da.
Wa laakin intu mustakbiriin wa kalaamku kalaam hana fachaar bas.Kulla l-istikbaar al-misil da,ma adiil.
Wa kan naadum ya'arif al-kheer al-waajib yisawwiih wa ma yisawwiih,hu bigi muznib.
Intu siyaad al-maal,asma'o sameh-!Abku wa arjufu min al-azaab al-gaa'id yarjaaku.
Maalku da yatlaf wa khulgaanku,al-arda taakulhum.
Dahabku wa fudditku,al-turaab yaakulhum.Wa maalku yachhad foogku wa yaakul jilidku misil al-naar.Intu laayamtu maal katiir laakin al-dunya gariib tikammil.
Wa laakin intu ma kaffeetu ujrat al-khaddaamiin al-khadamo fi ziraa'itku.Daahu gaa'idiin yachku minku-!Wa l-naas al-gata'o ziraa'itku gaa'idiin yasrakho wa Allah al-Gaadir simi' siraakhhum.
Fi l-dunya ichtu fi l-hala wa fi l-raaha.Intu simintu misil al-bagar al-yisammunuuhum le l-juzur.
Intu bas haakamtu wa kataltu abd Allah al-saalih.Wa hu ma yugumm didduku walla-?
Ya akhwaani,asburu lahaddi Rabbina Isa yaji.Fakkuru fi l-harraatiin.Humman yarjo al-khariif le yiteerubu al-khalla al-muhimme le hayaathum.Min teerabooha,yarjo almi yusubb le l-khalla tugumm wa yasburu lahaddi tanjad.
Intu kula asburu wa agoodu saabtiin achaan jayyit Rabbina garrabat.
Ya akhwaani,ma tilhaarajo ambeenaatku achaan Allah ma yihaasibku.Asma'o kalaami-!Al-yihaasibna da jaahiz giddaam al-baab.
Ya akhwaani,chiilu masal hana l-anbiya al-kallamo be usum Allah.Fakkuru fi ta'abhum wa saburhum.
Humman sabaro fi l-ta'ab wa aniina nuguulu humman naas mubaarakiin.Intu simi'tu be sabur Ayyuub wa ta'arfu kadar Allah antaah baraka fi l-akhiir achaan Allah hu al-Rahmaan al-Rahiim.
Ya akhwaani gubbaal kulla cheyy,abadan ma tahalfu wa la be l-sama wa la be l-ard wa la be ayyi cheyy aakhar.Laakin kan tidooru tuguulu-:-Aywa-,guulu-:-Aywa-.Wa kan tidooru tuguulu-:-La-,guulu-:-La- achaan al-azaab ma yaji foogku.
Kan naadum waahid minku ta'baan,khalli yas'al Allah.Wa kan naadum farhaan,khalli yachkur Allah be khine.
Wa kan naadum minku mardaan,khalli yinaadi kubaaraat jamaa'at al-mu'miniin achaan yaju yamsaho raasah be dihin be usum al-Rabb wa yas'alo leyah Allah.
Wa l-sala al-gaddamooha be l-iimaan tinajji al-mardaan.Wa Rabbina yachfiih wa kan indah zunuub kula,hu yakhfir leyah.
Fi chaan da,a'tarufu be zunuubku ambeenaatku wa as'alo Allah ambeenaatku achaan yachfiiku.Du'a hana naadum saalih indah gudra chadiide.
Fakkuru fi Iliyaas.Hu insaani misilna bas.Hu sa'al Allah be chidde achaan al-matara ma tusubb.Wa almi ma sabba lahaddi talaata sana wa nuss.
Wa ba'ad da,hu sa'al Allah battaan achaan almi yusubb.Wa khalaas,min al-sama almi sabba wa min al-ard al-ma'aach gamma.
Ya akhwaani,kan naadum minku marag min al-derib al-sahiih wa naadum aakhar gabbalah,
a'arfu kadar al-naadum al-gabbal akhuuh min al-derib al-hawaan da,hu najjaah min al-halaak.Wa fi chaan da,Allah yakhfir le l-muznib zunuubah al-katiiriin.
Jawaab minni ana Butrus rasuul Isa al-Masiih.Ana naktib leeku intu al-naas al-Allah azalaaku le tabgo cha'abah.Intu al-aaychiin ajaanib wa muchattatiin fi buldaan Buntus wa Khalaatiya wa Kabbaduukiiya wa Aasiya wa Bisinya.
Allah abuuku azalaaku hasab al-nizaam al-indah min zamaan.Wa intu bigiitu al-naas al-khaassiin leyah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.Wa da,le titaabu'u Isa al-Masiih wa tabgo taahiriin be dammah al-daffag fi chaanku.Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma be katara.
Khalli nachkuru Allah abu Rabbina Isa al-Masiih-!Hu rahamaana be rahma kabiire al-beeha bigiina mawluudiin min jadiid be sabab bu'aas Isa al-Masiih min ust al-maytiin.Wa be da,indina acham mu'akkad
wa warasatna abadan ma tiddammar wa la tatlaf wa la tiwaddir.Wa Allah dammaha leeku fi l-samaawaat.
Wa gudrat Allah tahfadku be iimaanku achaan talgo al-naja al-Allah jahhazaaha wa yibayyinha fi l-yoom al-akhiir.
Wa achaan da,tafraho farha kabiire,hatta kan intu gaa'idiin tat'abo le mudda gisayre kula wa tahzano be sabab al-su'uubaat al-chig chig.
Na'arfu kadar al-dahab al-ba'adeen yiddammar,yakchufuuh be l-naar.Wa misil da,iimaanku al-khiimtah ziyaada min al-dahab,kula yijarrubuuh achaan sabaatah yinchaaf.Wa be da,talgo chukur wa majd wa charaf fi l-yoom al-Isa al-Masiih yibiin foogah.
Wa l-Masiih da,intu tihibbuuh hatta kan ma chiftuuh kula.Wa kan intu ma gaa'idiin tichiifuuh kula,intu mu'miniin beyah wa tafraho beyah be farha majiide wa kabiire al-abadan ma tilwassaf.
Achaan intu gaa'idiin talgo natiijat iimaanku wa hi najaatku.
Wa l-anbiya al-atnabba'o be l-ni'ma al-intu talgooha,humman dawwaro yafhamo al-naja di wa fi chaanha gaddamo su'aalaat katiiriin.
Wa Ruuh al-Masiih al-gaa'id fiihum wassaf leehum min awwal ta'ab al-Masiih wa dakhuulah fi l-majd al-bigi ba'ad al-ta'ab.Wa sa'alo achaan ya'arfu al-achya dool yaju mata wa kikkeef.
Wa Allah wassaf le l-anbiya kadar humman yakhdumu leeku intu wa ma le nufuushum.Humman kallamo be l-achya al-yabgo fi wakitna.Wa intu simi'tu be khabarhum min al-naas al-ballakho leeku al-bichaara.Wa da,be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-Allah nazzalah min al-sama.Wa l-kalaam da,al-malaa'ika zaathum dawwaro yafhamooh.
Achaan da,khuttu baalku.Agoodu saabtiin.Khuttu achamku kulla ke fi l-ni'ma al-talgooha fi l-yoom al-Isa al-Masiih yibiin foogah.
A'arfu kadar intu iyaal Allah wa taabu'u daayman kalaamah.Aabo ma titaabu'u chahwaatku al-taaba'tuuhum gubbaal ma ta'arfu al-Masiih.
Laakin,misil Allah al-naadaaku hu Khudduus,intu kula abgo khaassiin fi kulla cheyy al-tisawwuuh.
Wa fi l-Kitaab maktuub-:﴾‍Abgo khaassiin achaan ana Allah khudduus.‍﴿
Intu tad'u Allah wa tinaaduuh abuuku wa hu ma yichiif naadum akheer min naadum laakin yihaasib ayyi naadum hasab amalah.Wa achaan da,taabu'u derib Allah be khoof tuul al-wakit al-intu aaychiin fi l-dunya misil ajaanib fi ust al-umam.
Ta'arfu Allah fadaaku achaan tamurgu min al-haya al-baatle al-warastuuha min juduudku.Wa hu ma fadaaku be l-achya al-ba'adeen yiddammaro misil al-fudda wa l-dahab.
Hu fadaaku be damm al-hamal al-ma indah eeb wa la khata wa hu damm al-Masiih al-indah khiima ziyaada.
Wa gubbaal bidaayit al-dunya,Allah khaddar le l-Masiih yabga dahiiye.Wa khalaas Allah bayyanah fi chaanku intu,fi l-wakit al-akhiir.
Wa be sabab al-Masiih,intu aamantu be Allah al-ba'asah min ust al-maytiin wa antaah al-majd.Wa khalaas iimaanku wa achamku saabtiin fi Allah.
Wa intu tahhartu nufuusku wakit taaba'tu kalaam al-hagg wa ligiitu mahabba akhawiiye bala nifaakh.Wa khalaas,arraayado ambeenaatku be chidde wa be galib waahid.
Bigiitu mawluudiin min jadiid wa da ma min waaldeenku al-yumuutu laakin hi min kalaam Allah wa l-kalaam da,abadan ma yumuut.
Wa maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Kulla l-naas misil al-gechchwa charafhum misil nuwwaar al-gechch.Wa l-gechch yaybas wa nuwwaarah yidaffig
laakin kalaam Allah yagood ila l-abad.‍﴿Wa l-kalaam da,hu bichaarat al-Masiih al-ballakhooha leeku.
Achaan da,khallu minku kulla l-fasaala wa kulla l-najaada wa l-nifaakh wa l-husud wa l-gatii'e.
Wa misil al-sakhiir al-yitmanna laban ammah,intu kula atmanno kalaam Allah al-misil laban saafi.Wa be l-kalaam da,takburu wa talgo al-naja.
Achaan intu dukhtu wa iriftu kadar Rabbina al-Masiih rahiim.
Garrubu leyah.Hu bas al-hajar al-hayy al-Allah azalah al-muhimm bilheen laakin al-naas ma dawwarooh.
Wa intu kula misil hujaar al-hayyiin al-Allah gaa'id yabni beeku beet hana Ruuhah.Wa intu rujaal diin khaassiin wa gaa'idiin tigaddumu le Allah dahaaya be izin al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-Allah yarda beehum be waasitat Isa al-Masiih.
Wa Allah gaal fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Asma'o.Ana nukhutt fi jabal Sahyuun hajar zaawiye.Wa hu al-hajar al-khaali al-ana azaltah.Wa l-yi'aamin beyah,abadan ma yakhjal.‍﴿
Wa leeku intu al-mu'miniin,al-Masiih hu al-hajar al-indah khiima kabiire.Wa laakin le l-naas al-ma mu'miniin,hu bigi misil al-kalaam al-maktuub fi l-Kitaab al-buguul-:﴾‍Al-hajar al-bannaayiin al-beet awwal ma dawwaroohbigi al-hajar al-muhimm fi buna al-beet.‍﴿
Wa battaan buguul-:﴾‍Asma'o,ana nukhutt hajar fi Sahyuun.Be sababah,al-naas yintaggo wa yaga'o.‍﴿Wa yintaggo foogah achaan abo ma yitaabu'u kalaam Allah wa da mukhaddar leehum.
Laakin kan leeku intu,bigiitu al-gabiila al-Allah azalaaha wa rujaal diin hana l-malik al-kabiir wa umma mukhassasa le Allah wa cha'ab Allah zaatah.Hu naadaaku achaan tamurgu min al-dalaam wa tadkhulu fi nuurah al-ajiib wa khalaas tiballukhu khabar hana a'maal Allah al-kubaar.
Wa maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Awwal intu ma cha'ab Allahlaakin hassa' intu bigiitu cha'abah.Awwal rahmat Allah ma jaat foogkulaakin hassa' rahmatah jaat foogku khalaas.‍﴿
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku al-aaychiin fi l-dunya misil ajaanib wa diifaan,nuguul leeku angar'u.Chahwaat al-insaan adu.Aabo ma titaabu'uuhum.
Khalli haalku fi ust al-naas al-ma mu'miniin tabga adiile.Wa be misil da,kan yakdubu fiiku wa yuguulu intu naas fasliin kula,yichiifu amalku al-sameh wa fi l-akhiir,yimajjudu Allah fi yoom al-faraj.
Fi chaan Rabbina,taabu'u kalaam hana ayyi naadum al-indah sulta.Taabu'u kalaam al-malik,kabiir al-balad,
wa l-hukkaam al-hu khattaahum le yahkumu al-mujrimiin wa yachkuru al-naas al-yisawwu al-kheer.
Wa da al-yidoorah Allah leeku.Be l-kheer al-tisawwuuh,tiwaggufu al-kalaam al-baatil al-yuguuluuh foogku al-naas al-juhhaal.
Iichu be hurriiye laakin ma tichiilu al-hurriiye di fursa le tisawwu beeha al-fasaala wa ma tanso kadar intu abiid Allah.
Karrumu kulla l-naas.Hibbu kulla akhwaanku al-mu'miniin.Akhaafo Allah.Karrumu al-malik.
Wa leeku intu al-abiid,asma'o kalaam siyaadku be kulla ihtiraam.Kan humman zeeniin wa kalaamhum baarid walla kan kalaamhum murr kula,asma'o kalaamhum.
Wa a'arfu ayyi naadum al-yahmal al-ta'ab be sabur fi chaan Allah wakit al-naas yazulmuuh,al-naadum da Allah yibaarikah.
Wa kan tisawwu khata wa be sababah yudugguuku wa intu tahmalooh be sabur,chunu al-faayde-?Laakin kan intu tisawwu al-kheer wa yita''ubuuku be sababah wa intu tahmalooh be sabur,khalaas Allah yibaarikku.
Da bas al-derib wa Allah naadaaku le tichiiluuh.Achaan al-Masiih kula ti'ib fi chaanku wa bigi leeku masal achaan titaabu'uuh.
﴾‍Hu ma aznabwa fi khachmah ma fi khachch.‍﴿
Wakit ayyarooh,hu ma radda leehum be mu'yaar.Wakit ta''abooh,hu ma haddadaahum.Fi badalah,hu atwakkal ale Allahal-yihaasib be l-hagg.
Wa fi l-saliib,hu be nafsahhamal zunuubna fi jismahachaan nikhallu al-zunuub marra waahidwa ni'iichu be haal saalhe.Wa be waasitat jiraahah,intu ligiitu al-chifa.
Achaan awwal intu misil khanam muwaddiriinlaakin hassa' gabbaltu le raa'iiku al-yahfadku.
Wa leekan intan al-awiin kula,khalli ayyi mara tasma' adiil kalaam raajilha.Wa kan fiyah rujaal al-ma gaa'idiin yitaabu'u kalaam Allah,akuun al-haal al-adiile hana awiinhum tijiibhum fi derib Allah.Wa da ma be kalaam
achaan yichiifu fooghin al-ihtiraam wa l-haal al-saalhe.
Ma tinkariban fi l-jamaal al-barraani misil al-muchaat wa ziina hana l-dahab wa l-lubaas al-sameh.
Fi badalah,ankarban fi l-jamaal al-dakhlaani wa hu jamaal al-nafas al-baarid wa l-hudu.Wa l-jamaal al-dakhlaani,hu misil hajar khaali al-abadan ma yatlaf wa khiimtah kabiire giddaam Allah.
Wa misil da bas,zamaan al-awiin al-saalhaat al-achamhin saabit fi Allah jammalan nufuushin wa sim'an adiil kalaam rujaalhin.
Wa misil da,Saara sim'at kalaam Ibraahiim wa naadatah sayyidha.Wa hassa' kan tisawwan al-kheer wa ma tikhallan ayyi khoof yakrubkan,intan tabgan banaatha.
Wa leeku intu al-rujaal kula,khalli ayyi raajil yagood ma'a martah be mufaahama wa ya'arif tamaam kadar hi ma gawiiye mislah.Karrumu awiinku achaan hinna kula yawrisan ma'aaku ni'mat al-haya al-Allah yantiiha leeku.Wa taabu'u kalaami da achaan cheyy ma yibarjil salaawaatku.
Wa aakhir cheyy nuguulah leeku kulluku,khalli galibku yabga waahid wa khalli ruuhku tabga tawiile.Arraayado ambeenaatku be mahabba akhawiiye wa be galib hanuun wa maskunu nufuusku.
Kan al-naas yisawwu foogku chokhol fasil,ma turuddu leehum be chokhol fasil.Wa kan yi'ayyuruuku,ma turuddu leehum be mu'yaar.Laakin baarukuuhum,achaan Allah naadaaku fi derbah le tibaaruku al-naas wa tawrusu baraka min Allah.
Wa maktuub fi l-Kitaab-:﴾‍Ayyi naadum al-yidoor yi'iich ayyaam sa'iidiinkhalli yahfad lisaanah min al-kalaam al-fasilwa khachmah min al-kalaam al-kidib
Khalli yiba''id min al-fasaalawa yisawwi al-kheer.Khalli yifattich al-salaamwa yitaabi'ah be niiye waahide.
Achaan een Allah tiraakhib al-saalihiinwa hu yasma' salaawaathum.Laakin Allah yugummdidd al-fasliin.‍﴿
Wa yaatu al-yisawwi leeku cheyy fasil,kan intu munkaribiin fi l-kheer-?
Wa kan yita''ubuuku be sabab intu saalihiin kula,intu mubaarakiin.Ma takhaafo minhum wa ma tibarjulu.
Laakin khuttu fi guluubku kadar al-Masiih,hu khudduus wa hu Rabbuku.Agoodu daayman jaahiziin achaan turuddu le ayyi naadum al-yatlub minku daliil hana l-acham al-induku.
Laakin hajju leyah be nafas baarid wa ihtiraam.Sawwu kulla cheyy be niiye mukhlisa.Wa be da,al-eeb yisawwiihum le l-naas al-yathamooku wa yi'ayyuruuku fi chaan al-kheer al-tisawwuuh fi derib al-Masiih.
Wa kan Allah yanti izin le l-naas achaan yita''ubuuku,akheer yita''ubuuku be sabab al-kheer al-intu sawweetuuh min yita''ubuuku be sabab intu sawweetu fasaala.
Wa l-Masiih kula ti'ib ta'ab waahid wa nihaa'i fi chaan zunuub al-naas.Al-saalih maat fi chaan al-muznibiin wa be da,yiwaddiiku kulluku fi hadarat Allah.Hu katalooh wa maat misil moot al-naas wa Allah hayyaah be l-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus,hu macha wa ballakh le l-arwaah al-gaa'idiin fi l-sijin.
Zamaan,al-arwaah dool abo ma taaba'o kalaam Allah wakit Allah al-Sabuur gaa'id yarja lahaddi Nooh yikammil al-safiina.Wa naas chiyya bas rikbo fi l-safiina wa adadhum tamaane wa humman dool nijo be sabab al-almi al-rafa' al-safiina.
Wa da masal hana l-khattisiin al-hassa' yinajjiiku.Wa l-muhimm fi l-khattisiin ma khasuul al-jilid min al-wasakh laakin hu al-ahad al-tisawwuuh ma'a Allah be niiye mukhlisa.Wa l-khattisiin yinajjiiku be sabab bu'aas Isa al-Masiih.
Wa l-Masiih hu al-macha foog fi l-samaawaat wa hassa' gaa'id jamb Allah fi nussah al-zeenaay.Wa tihtah al-malaa'ika wa hukkaam wa kubaaraat al-arwaah.
Wa be misil da,ta'arfu kadar al-Masiih ligi ta'ab fi jismah.Wa gawwu nufuusku be fikir misil fikrah achaan al-naadum al-khibil ta'ab al-jisim khalla minnah al-zunuub.
Wa hu ma yidoor yitaabi' chahwat al-naas battaan,laakin yidoor yitaabi' al-Allah yidoorah tuul al-wakit al-faddal leyah fi l-dunya.
Kafaaku-!Achaan min zamaan,intu ga'adtu wakit tawiil fi amal al-gaa'idiin yisawwu al-naas al-ma mu'miniin.Humman gaa'idiin yisawwu al-fasaad wa chahwaathum al-cheeniin wa l-sakar wa haflaat al-zina wa l-safaaha.Wa ya'abudu al-asnaam al-Allah harramaahum.
Wa humman yi'ajjubu minku achaan ma tilimmu ma'aahum fi fasaadhum al-ma indah hadd wa achaan da yi'ayyuruuku.
Laakin fi l-akhiir Rabbina yihaasibhum fi fi'ilhum.Hu jaahiz achaan yihaasib al-hayyiin wa l-maytiin.
Wa fi chaan da bas,al-bichaara ballakhooha hatta le l-naas al-maytiin.Wa kan hakamo leehum be l-moot misil naas al-dunya kula,humman yi'iichu giddaam Allah be gudrat al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Kumaalit kulla cheyy gariib.Achaan da,khuttu baalku wa agoodu saabtiin daayman achaan tagdaro tisallu fi ayyi wakit.
Gubbaal kulla cheyy,arraayado ambeenaatku be mahabba chadiide achaan al-indah mahabba yisaamih ziyaada le l-naas al-yakhto foogah.
Khalli ayyi naadum minku yifaddil akhwaanah al-yaju leyah wa ma yachki.
Allah anta ayyi naadum minku gudra achaan yakhdim beeha le akhwaanah.Wa khalli ayyi naadum yichiil mas'uuliiytah fi barakat Allah al-gaa'ide tisawwi ambeenaatku khidme chig chig.
Masalan,ayyi naadum al-yikallim le l-akhwaan fi l-malamma,khalli yikallim leehum be kalaam Allah.Wa ayyi naadum al-yakhdim le l-akhwaan,khalli yakhdim be l-gudra al-Allah antaaha leyah.Achaan kulla cheyy al-tisawwuuh yimajjid Allah be waasitat Isa al-Masiih.Wa leyah hu al-majd wa l-muluk daayman wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,ma ti'ajjubu min al-ta'ab al-chadiid al-yaji foogku achaan yijarribku.Ma tuguulu da cheyy ma ma'ruuf ja foogku.
Intu gaa'idiin tichaaruku fi ta'ab al-Masiih wa achaan da,afraho fi ust al-ta'ab.Wa kan chaaraktu fi ta'ab al-Masiih da,tafraho farha chadiide wakit hu yibiin fi majdah.
Kan al-naas yi'ayyuruuku achaan intu naas al-Masiih,khalaas induku baraka achaan Ruuh Allah al-majiid gaa'id foogku.
Wa khalli naadum minku abadan ma yita''ubuuh be sabab katiliin dimme walla sirge walla jariime walla dakhiliin fi chu'uun al-naas.
Wa laakin kan yita''ubuuh achaan hu Masiihi bas,khalli ma yakhjal.Fi badalah,khalli yimajjid Allah achaan al-naas ja'alooh naadum hana l-Masiih.
Achaan al-wakit tamma wa l-hisaab yabda.Wa akiid yabda be naas beet Allah.Wa kan al-hisaab yabda beena aniina al-mu'miniin,yabga kikkeef le l-naas al-abo ma taaba'o bichaarat Allah-?
﴾‍Kan yabga gaasi le l-naadum al-saalih le yalga al-naja,kikkeef yabga le l-aasi wa l-muznib-?‍﴿
Wa be misil da,khalli al-naas al-yat'abo hasab al-Allah yidoorah yisawwu daayman al-kheer wa yitwakkalo ale Khaalighum al-Saadikh.
Wa nidoor niwassi kubaaraat jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-ma'aaku.Ana kula kabiir misilhum.Wa ana chaahid le ta'ab al-Masiih wa battaan muchaarik fi gudrat al-Masiih al-majiide al-tibiin gariib.
Asraho be l-mu'miniin al-misil khanam achaan Allah kallafaaku beehum misil ru'yaan.Wa chiilu al-mas'uuliiye fooghum ma misil jabarooku laakin be niiyitku giddaam Allah wa ma achaan tidooru minhum riba al-ma waajib laakin chiilu al-mas'uuliiye di be farah.
Wa ma tamulku be chidde fi l-naas al-Allah kallafaaku beehum misil ru'yaan laakin abgo leehum masal lahaddi yitaabu'u deribku.
Wa wakit al-Masiih kabiir al-ru'yaan yibiin,hu yantiiku al-taaj al-majiid al-jamaalah abadan ma yikammil.
Wa leeku intu al-chabaab kula,asma'o adiil kalaam kubaaraatku.Wa nuguul leeku kulluku,maskunu nufuusku ambeenaatku al-waahidiin le l-aakhariin.Achaan Allah yugumm didd al-naas al-yistakbaro laakin hu yanti ni'ma le l-naas al-yimaskunu nufuushum.
Khalaas,maskunu nufuusku giddaam gudrat Allah wa fi l-wakit al-muwaafig,hu bas yarfa'ku.
Kulla cheyy al-tihimmu beyah,khalluuh le Allah achaan hu yichiil mas'uuliiyitku.
Khuttu baalku wa agoodu waa'iyiin achaan aduuku Ibliis gaa'id yihawwig foogku misil duud al-gaa'id yikirr wa yifattich naadum le yaakulah.
Agoodu saabtiin fi iimaanku wa agiifu didd Ibliis.A'arfu kadar akhwaanku fi ayyi bakaan fi l-dunya gaa'idiin yahmalo nafs al-ta'ab misilku.
Ta'abku yagood battaan wakit chiyya.Wa laakin Allah indah rahma kabiire wa hu naadaaku achaan tichaaruku fi majdah al-abadi be alaakhitku ma'a Isa al-Masiih.Wa Allah hu zaatah yisabbitku wa yigawwiiku wa yantiiku gudra wa ma taga'o battaan.
Wa l-muluk waajib leyah hu bas ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Wa ana katabt leeku al-jawaab al-gisayyir da ma'a akhuuna Siila wa nachhad leyah,hu akhu saadikh.Wa katabtah leeku achaan nichajji'ku wa nachhad leeku kadar induku ni'mat Allah al-sahiihe wa intu gaa'idiin saabtiin foogha.
Wa l-mu'miniin hini fi Baabilal-Allah azalaahum misil hu azalaaku,humman yisallumuuku.Wa wileedi Markhus yisallimku kula.
Assaalamo ambeenaatku be salaam al-mahabba.Al-salaam aleekum kulluku intu al-induku alaakha ma'a l-Masiih.
Jawaab minni ana Sim'aan Butrus abid Isa al-Masiih wa rasuulah.Wa naktib leeku intu al-naas al-ligiitu al-iimaan be sabab adaalit Isa al-Masiih Ilaahna wa munajjiina.Wa iimaanku indah nafs al-khiima misil iimaanna.
Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma be katara be sabab irfitku le Allah wa Rabbina Isa.
Wa akiid Rabbina antaana be gudurtah al-ilaahiiye kulla cheyy al-aniina hawjaaniin leyah le ni'iichu be l-takhwa.Wa da yabga be irfitna leyah hu al-naadaana fi derbah be kheerah al-majiid.
Wa be da,hu antaana barakatah al-khiimitha kabiire bilheen al-awwal waa'ad beeha.Achaan be l-baraka di,intu tichaaruku fi l-tabii'a al-ilaahiiye wa tamurgu min al-fasaad al-mawjuud fi l-dunya be sabab al-chahwa.
Wa achaan da,gummu be kulla juhudku achaan tiziidu fi l-iimaan,al-kheer.Wa tiziidu fi l-kheer,al-ma'rafa.
Wa tiziidu fi l-ma'rafa,sabbitiin al-nafs.Wa tiziidu fi sabbitiin al-nafs,al-sabur.Wa tiziidu fi l-sabur,al-takhwa.
Wa tiziidu fi l-takhwa,al-khuuwa.Wa tiziidu fi l-khuuwa,al-mahabba.
Wa kan induku al-achya dool wa gaa'idiin yiziidu foogku be katara,khalaas tabgo naaf'iin wa talgo ma'rafa ziyaada fi Rabbina Isa al-Masiih.
Wa ayyi naadum al-ma indah al-achya dool,hu misil naadum amyaan.Al-naadum da ma chaayif adiil wa hu nisi kadar Allah tahharah min zunuubah al-awwal.
Achaan da,ya akhwaani,sawwu juhud be ziyaada achaan be haalku di ti'akkudu kadar Allah azalaaku wa naadaaku fi derbah.Wa kan tisawwu misil ana gultah,abadan ma tamurgu min al-derib al-adiil da.
Wa be misil da,Allah yaftah leeku baab wasii' le tadkhulu fi l-mamlaka al-abadiiye wa hi mamlakat Rabbina Isa al-Masiih munajjiina.
Akiid ta'arfu al-kalaam da wa gaa'idiin saabtiin fi l-hagg al-ballakhooh leeku.Wa laakin nidoor daayman nizakkirku beyah.
Achaan wakit ana lissaa' gaa'id hayy,waajib nizakkirku le ma tanso.
Na'arif ana numuut gariib achaan Rabbina Isa al-Masiih ooraani be kalaam akiid.
Wa nisawwi juhud achaan ba'ad ana faaragt al-dunya,tagdaro tifakkuru fi l-kalaam da fi ayyi wakit.
Wa l-kalaam al-ballakhnaah leeku al-bukhuss gudrat Rabbina Isa al-Masiih wa jaytah,da ma hije saakit misil al-hije al-tuwaal al-yihajjuuh al-naas.Be l-aks,aniina chifna azamatah be uyuunna wa chahadna leyah.
Aniina mawjuudiin wakit Allah abuuh antaah charaf wa majd,wakit al-hiss ja leyah min al-Majiid wa l-Aziim wa gaal-:-Da bas Ibni al-nihibbah.Wa ana farhaan beyah bilheen.
Aniina zaatna simi'na al-hiss al-jaayi min al-sama da wakit aniina ma'a Isa fi l-jabal al-mukhaddas.
Wa be da,aniina mu'akkidiin ziyaada kadar kalaam al-anbiya sahiih.Wa khalaas,waajib tukhuttu baalku le kalaamhum al-misil deyy al-yidawwi fi bakaan adlam lahaddi l-wata tabga misil nahaar wa najmat al-fajur tatla' fi guluubku.
Wa gubbaal kulla cheyy,waajib ta'arfu kadar ma fi kalaam min kalaam al-anbiya al-gaa'id fi l-Kitaab da,ja min fikir nabi.
Achaan kalaam al-anbiya abadan ma ja min niiyit insaan laakin al-Ruuh al-Khudduus bas lazza al-rujaal dool wa humman hajjo kalaam naazil min Allah.
Laakin zamaan,fi anbiya kaddaabiin waahidiin gammo fi usut cha'ab Bani Israa'iil.Wa misil da,fi usutku intu kula,mu'allimiin kaddaabiin yugummu.Humman yindasso ambeenaatku be khachch wa yiwazzu'u ta'liimhum al-yiwaddi al-naas fi l-halaak lahaddi yankuru sayyidhum al-fadaahum kula.Wa be kalaamhum da,yijiibu al-halaak fi nufuushum be sur'a.
Wa naas katiiriin yitaabu'uuhum fi fasaadhum wa be sababhum,al-naas yuguulu kalaam fasil fi derib al-hagg.
Tama'hum katiir le l-maal wa yakdubu leeku wa yichiilu minku be kalaam khachch.Wa min zamaan,Allah kharrar leehum al-azaab wa akiid al-halaak al-yaji fooghum jaahiz.
Na'am,na'arfu kadar al-malaa'ika al-aznabo,Allah ma afaahum laakin rabataahum be janaaziir wa sajanaahum fi dalaam al-haawiye achaan yarjo yoom al-Hisaab.
Wa na'arfu battaan Allah ma afa naas al-zaman al-faat.Laakin hu nazzal al-kharag fi l-ard wa halak al-naas al-fasliin.Wa najja Nooh al-gaa'id yinaadi al-naas fi derib Allah wa najja ma'aayah sab'a naas.
Wa na'arfu kadar Allah hakam le hillaal Saduum wa Amuurawa harragaahum marra waahid wa ja'alaahum masal hana l-azaab al-yaji le l-naas al-fasliin.
Wa na'arfu Allah faza' Luut.Wa Luut hu naadum saalih al-ti'ib ziyaada be sabab fasaad al-aasiyiin.
Achaan al-raajil al-saalih da saakin fi usuthum wa kulla yoom fikrah al-saalih yat'ab be sabab isyaanhum al-chaafah wa sim'ah.
Wa khalaas be da kula ke,na'arfu kadar Allah yagdar yafza' al-saalihiin fi wakt al-tajriba wa yiraakhib al-naas al-fasliin lahaddi yi'aakhibhum fi yoom al-Hisaab.
Wa misil da,akiid yi'aakhib al-naas al-yitaabu'u chahwaathum al-khabiise al-tinajjishum wa yahguru sultit al-Rabb.Humman mustakbiriin wa mutamarridiin wa hayyin leehum yuguulu kalaam fasil fi sukkaan al-majd.
Wa l-malaa'ika kubaar wa gawiyiin min al-naas dool laakin abadan ma yukhuttu fooghum tuhma fasle giddaam Allah.
Wa laakin al-naas dool,humman misil haywaanaat al-kadaade al-ma induhum agul wa mukhaddar leehum min tabii'ithum yakurbuuhum wa yaktuluuhum.Humman yuguulu kalaam fasil fi ayyi cheyy al-ma fihmooh.Wa khalaas yahlako misil al-haywaanaat yahlako.
Wa yalgo zulum be sabab al-zulum al-sawwooh.Wa fi ust al-nahaar yisawwu chahwaathum.Wa fi aawaaziimku,huduurhum eeb wa wasakh.Ma yikhallu minhum safaahithum wa wakit yil'achcho ma'aaku,farhaaniin be khachchuhum.
Ayyi mara al-yichiifuuha,fi fikirhum yazno beeha.Yiriidu al-zunuub wa chahwithum abadan ma tachba'.Wa yidissu ma'aahum fi l-zunuub al-naas al-ma gawiyiin fi l-iimaan.Humman mudarrabiin fi l-tama' wa mal'uuniin.
Humman marago min al-derib al-adiil wa waddaro marra waahid.Taaba'o derib Bal'aam wileed Ba'uur al-firih be l-riba al-ligiih min al-fasaala al-sawwaaha.
Laakin Allah haraj leyah fi chaan al-khataaya al-sawwaahum.Al-humaar bahiime bakma laakin hajja leyah be hiss insaani wa dahar al-nabi ma yisawwi khidme hana naadum al-aglah laffa.
Al-naas dool,humman misil uyuun almi al-almiihum bigi ma fiih wa misil sahaab al-khafiif al-tichattitah al-riih al-chadiide.Wa Allah jahhaz leehum bakaan fi l-dalaam al-azrag kurum.
Yikallumu be kibriya al-ma indah faayde.Yista'malo al-chahwaat achaan yijiibu beeha al-naas al-dahaabhum marago min derib al-wadaar.
Al-mu'allimiin dool yiwaa'uduuhum be l-hurriiye laakin humman zaathum abiid hana l-fasaad.Achaan al-naadum yabga abid hana l-cheyy al-indah gudra foogah.
Wa kan al-naas awwal marago min najaasit al-dunya be irfit Rabbina Isa al-Masiih munajjiina wa ba'adeen najaasit al-dunya takrubhum battaan wa tinnasir fooghum,fi l-bakaan da,haalithum al-akhiire tabga hawaane min al-awwal.
Achaan kan abadan ma irfo derib al-saalihiin,da akheer leehum min irfooh wa khallo wasiiyat Allah al-allamooha leehum.
Al-bigi leehum da misil kalaam al-masal al-sahiih al-buguul-:﴾‍Al-kalib yigabbil yaakul al-gaddafah.‍﴿Wa battaan buguul-:-Al-khinziir al-khassalooh yilmarmakh fi l-tiine.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,daahu al-jawaab al-taani al-katabtah leeku.Wa fi jawaabaati nidoor nizakkirku be l-kalaam al-ta'arfuuh khalaas wa tifakkuru be fikir mukhlis.
Fakkuru fi kalaam al-anbiya al-saalihiin al-gaalooh min zamaan.Wa fakkuru fi wasiiyat Isa Rabbina wa munajjiina al-simi'tuuha be waasitat al-rusul al-macho leeku.
Wa daahu awwal cheyy al-waajib tafhamooh.Fi l-zaman al-akhiir chammaatiin yugummu wa yichchammato.Wa yitaabu'u chahwaathum bas.
Wa yuguulu-:-Waa'ado be jayyit Isa wa laakin hu ma ja.Abbahaatna maato wa min bidaayit al-dunya lahaddi al-yoom,cheyy khayyar ke ma fiih-!
Wa l-naas dool be niiyithum bas niso cheyy waahid ma'ruuf wa da hu.Zamaan Allah kallam kilme wa beeha al-samaawaat kaano wa l-ard anfasalat min al-almi wa l-almi hawwagha.
Wa be kilmit Allah di,al-almi da kharag al-dunya fi l-zaman daak wa dammaraaha.
Wa be kilmit Allah battaan al-samaawaat wa l-ard al-gaa'idiin haaliiyan madmuumiin achaan yarjo al-naar.Allah gaa'id yahfadhum lahaddi yoom al-Hisaab al-yahlako foogah al-naas al-fasliin.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,fi cheyy waahid ma'ruuf al-ma waajib tansooh wa da hu.Le Allah yoom waahid misil alif sana wa alif sana misil yoom waahid.
Wa Allah ma yi'akhkhir wa'adah.Al-naas al-yuguulu hu akhkhar,ma fihmo adiil.Akheer nuguulu Allah sabuur leeku.Hu ma yidoor ayyi naadum yahlak laakin yidoor kulla l-naas yutuubu.
Wa laabudda yoom Allah yaji be khafla misil jayyit al-sarraag.Wa ajala ke haraka chadiide tinsami' wa l-samaawaat yabgo ma fiihum wa l-nujuum yinhargu.Wa l-ard wa kulla cheyy al-yisawwuuh foogha yinkachif.
Wa kan kulla cheyy yiddammar misil da,intu waajib tisawwu chunu-?Waajib ti'iichu be takhwa wa haal saalhe.
Arjo yoom Allah wa atmanno jaytah.Wa fi l-yoom da,al-samaawaat yinhargu wa yiddammaro wa l-nujuum yumuu'u fi l-hamu.
Wa Allah antaana wa'ad wa achaan da narjo al-sama al-jadiid wa l-ard al-jadiide wa l-dunya al-taji tabga daar al-saalihiin.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,da bas al-cheyy al-tarjooh min Allah.Wa achaan da,sawwu juhud achaan ti'iichu be salaam giddaamah bala khata wa la eeb.
Fakkuru fi l-ruuh al-tawiile hana Rabbina wa a'arfu kadar hu yi'akhkhir jaytah achaan al-naas yanjo.Wa l-kalaam da misil al-kalaam al-akhuuna Buulus al-niriiduuh katabah leeku min al-hikma al-Allah antaaha leyah.
Wa hu yihajji be l-kalaam da fi kulla jawaabaatah.Wa fi kalaam gaa'id fi jawaabaatah al-tafsiirah ma hayyin.Wa naas waahidiin al-ma garo wa iimaanhum ma saabit yi'awwuju kalaamah misil yi'awwuju kalaam al-kutub al-aakhariin.Wa be da,yijiibu le nufuushum al-halaak.
Wa leeku intu ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,ta'arfu al-kalaam da min awwal.Wa achaan da,aw'u baalku wa ma tikhallu kidib al-aasiyiin yiwaddiiku fi deribhum wa yitallif iimaanku al-saabit.
Laakin abgo gawiyiin fi ni'mat Rabbina Isa al-Masiih munajjiina wa be irfitku leyah.Wa l-Masiih,khalli yimajjuduuh fi l-wakit al-haadir wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Al-kalaam al-niballukhuuh leeku gaa'id min al-bidaaya wa aniina simi'naah wa chifnaah be uyuunna lahaddi irifnaah adiil ke wa lammasnaah be iideenna wa hu kalaam al-haya.
Al-haya baanat wa chifnaaha wa chahadna leeha.Wa niballukhu leeku al-haya al-abadiiye al-awwal gaa'ide ma'a abuuna Allah wa baanat leena.
Wa l-cheyy al-chifnaah wa simi'naah aniina niballukhuuh leeku achaan nidooru intu kula tukuunu ma'aana fi l-alaakha.Wa l-alaakha al-indina di,hi alaakha ma'a abuuna Allah wa ma'a Ibnah Isa al-Masiih.
Wa naktubu leeku al-kalaam da achaan al-farah al-aniina kullina indina yabga kaamil.
Daahu al-khabar al-simi'naah minnah wa niballukhuuh leeku.Allah hu nuur wa fi Allah abadan ma fi dalaam.
Wa kan aniina maachiin fi l-dalaam wa nuguulu indina alaakha ma'a Allah,aniina kaddaabiin wa ma maachiin fi l-hagg.
Wa laakin kan aniina maachiin fi l-nuur misil hu zaatah fi l-nuur,ni'akkudu al-alaakha al-indina ambeenaatna wa damm Isa Ibnah yitahhirna min kulla l-zunuub.
Wa kan naadum minnina yuguul hu ma indah zunuub,hu khachcha nafsah wa l-hagg abadan ma gaa'id foogah.
Wa Allah hu saadikh wa aadil wa kan ni'tarufu be zunuubna,hu yakhfir leena zunuubna wa yitahhirna min kulli khata.
Wa kan nuguulu aniina ma aznabna,nikaddubu Allah wa kalaamah ma gaa'id foogna.
Ya iyaali,ana gaa'id naktib leeku al-kalaam da achaan ma taznubu.Laakin kan ayyi naadum minku yaznib,indina naadum waahid yidaafi' leena giddaam Allah abuuna wa hu Isa al-Masiih wa hu bas al-saalih.
Da hu al-gaddam nafsah dahiiye achaan yamha zunuubna.Wa dahiiytah ma le zunuubna aniina bas laakin le zunuub hana kulla naas al-dunya.
Daahu kikkeef ni'akkudu kadar aniina na'arfu Allah.Al-naadum al-yitaabi' wasaaya Allah,hu bas ya'arif Allah.
Wa l-naadum al-yuguul hu ya'arif Allah wa laakin ma yitaabi' al-wasaaya,hu kaddaab wa l-hagg ma gaa'id foogah.
Wa l-naadum al-gaa'id yitaabi' kalaam Allah,hu da sahiih ke yihibb Allah tamaam.Wa daahu kikkeef ni'akkudu kadar aniina gaa'idiin saabtiin foogah.
Al-naadum al-yuguul hu saabit foogah waajib yamchi fi l-dunya misil Isa al-Masiih macha fi l-dunya.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,ana ma gaa'id naktib leeku wasiiye jadiide.La.Ana naktib leeku al-wasiiye al-gaa'ide min zamaan wa intu iriftuuha min al-awwal.Wa l-wasiiye di,hi al-kalaam al-intu simi'tuuh minnina.
Wa laakin sahiih ana naktib leeku wasiiye jadiide wa hagiigitha gaa'ide tinchaaf fi Isa al-Masiih wa tinchaaf fiiku intu achaan al-dalaam bada yufuut wa l-nuur al-sahiih bada yidawwi.
Ayyi naadum al-yuguul hu gaa'id fi l-nuur wa yakrah akhuuh,hu lissaa' ma marag min al-dalaam.
Laakin al-naadum al-yihibb akhuuh,hu da gaa'id saabit fi l-nuur wa ma indah cheyy al-yamurgah min al-derib al-adiil.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yakrah akhuuh,hu gaa'id fi l-dalaam wa yuruukh fi l-dalaam wa ma ya'arif derbah achaan al-dalaam sadda uyuunah.
Ya l-iyaal,naktib leekuachaan Allah khafar leeku zunuubkube sabab usum Isa al-Masiih.
Ya l-abbahaat,naktib leekuachaan intu iriftu al-gaa'id min al-bidaaya.Ya l-chabaab,naktib leekuachaan intu khalabtu Ibliis al-chariir.
Ya l-iyaal,katabt leekuachaan iriftu abuuna.Ya l-abbahaat,katabt leekuachaan al-gaa'id min al-bidaaya iriftuuh.Ya l-chabaab,katabt leekuachaan intu chudaadwa kalaam Allah gaa'id saabit foogkuwa khalabtu Ibliis al-chariir.
Ma tihibbu al-dunya wa la khumaam al-dunya.Al-naadum al-yihibb al-dunya ma yihibb abuuna Allah
achaan kulli cheyy al-gaa'id fi l-dunya misil chahwaat al-jisim wa tama' al-een wa fachaar be l-maal ma min abuuna wa laakin min al-dunya.
Al-dunya wa chahwaatha yufuutu wa laakin al-naas al-yisawwu al-Allah yidoorah yi'iichu ila l-abad.
Ya iyaali,al-wakit al-akhiir bada.Awwal simi'tu kadar adu al-Masiih yaji wa khalaas udwaan al-Masiih katiiriin jo.Wa be da,na'arfu al-wakit al-akhiir bada khalaas.
Awwal humman fi usutna wa hassa' marago minnina laakin be l-sahiih,awwal kula humman ma akhwaanna.Kan awwal humman akhwaanna,humman yagoodu ma'aana.Wa min marago min usutna da,bigi waadih leena kadar ma fi naadum waahid ke minhum akhuuna be l-sahiih.
Wa laakin intu ma misilhum.Al-Khudduus antaaku baraka wa l-baraka di antatku gudra wa kulluku induku minnah ilim.
Ana naktib leeku ma achaan intu ma iriftu al-hagg.La.Ana naktib leeku achaan iriftu al-hagg wa fihimtu kadar ma fi kidib waahid jaayi min al-hagg.
Yaatu al-kaddaab-?Al-kaddaab hu al-yankur wa yuguul Isa zaatah ma al-Masiih.Ayyi naadum al-misil da,hu adu al-Masiih.Hu yankur kadar Allah hu Abu Isa wa yuguul Isa ma Ibn Allah.
Ayyi naadum al-yuguul Isa ma Ibn Allah,khalaas al-naadum da,Allah ma abuuh.Wa l-naadum al-yachhad kadar Isa al-Masiih hu Ibn Allah,khalaas Allah bigi leyah abuuh.
Khallu al-kalaam al-awwal simi'tuuh minnina yagood saabit fi guluubku.Kan al-kalaam al-awwal simi'tuuh yagood saabit fi guluubku,intu tagoodu fi alaakha saabte ma'a Ibn Allah wa ma'a Allah abuuh.
Wa l-cheyy al-Allah waa'adaana beyah,hu al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa l-kalaam da katabtah leeku be sabab al-naas al-yidooru yamurguuku min al-derib al-sahiih.
Laakin leeku intu,al-baraka nazalat foogku min Isa al-Masiih wa gaa'ide ma'aaku wa achaan da,intu ma hawjaaniin battaan naadum aakhar yi'allimku.Al-Ruuh al-Khudduus yi'allimku be kulla cheyy wa kalaamah sahiih wa hu ma yakdib.Agoodu saabtiin fi Ibn Allah be l-ta'liim al-simi'tuuh min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Ya iyaali,agoodu saabtiin fi l-Masiih achaan wakit hu yibiin,guluubna yukuunu raagdiin wa ma nalgo eeb fi yoom jaytah.
Iriftu Ibn Allah hu saalih wa achaan da,ta'arfu kadar kulla l-naas al-yitaabu'u al-haal al-saalhe mislah,humman iyaal Allah.
Chiftu kikkeef abuuna yihibbina-?Mahabbat Allah leena kabiire bilheen wa be sababha hu yinaadiina iyaalah.Wa sahiih bigiina iyaal Allah.Naas al-dunya ma irfoona achaan ma irfo Allah.
Ya l-mahbuubiin,hassa' haaliiyan aniina iyaal Allah.Wa kikkeef nukuunu ba'adeen da,Allah lissaa' ma bayyanah leena.Laakin na'arfu kadar wakit Ibn Allah yibiin battaan,nichiifuuh hu zaatah be nafsah wa aniina nabgo mislah.
Wa ayyi naadum al-indah acham misil da fi l-Masiih,yitahhir galbah tamaam misil Ibn Allah hu taahir.
Ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yaznib,hu yikhaalif wasaaya Allah.Al-zanib hu mukhaalafat wasaaya Allah.
Iriftu kadar Ibn Allah baan achaan yamha zunuubna.Wa foogah hu,zanib ma fiih abadan.
Kan naadum gaa'id saabit foogah,hu ma yisawwi zanib.Wa ayyi naadum al-yisawwi zanib,hu abadan ma chaaf Ibn Allah wa la irifah.
Ya iyaali,ma tikhallu naadum waahid yukhuchchuku.Al-naas al-yisawwu amal saalih,humman saalihiin misil Ibn Allah hu saalih.
Wa ayyi naadum al-gaa'id yisawwi zanib,hu hana Ibliis achaan Ibliis gaa'id yaznib min al-bidaaya.Wa khalaas Ibn Allah ja fi l-dunya achaan yakhrib amal Ibliis kulla ke.
Al-naas al-bigo iyaal Allah ma yaznubu achaan tabii'at Allah gaa'ide fooghum.Ma yagdaro yaznubu achaan bigo iyaal Allah.
Wa na'arfu yaatumman iyaal Allah wa yaatumman iyaal Ibliis be l-cheyy al-yisawwuuh.Kulla l-naas al-ma yitaabu'u al-haal al-saalhe,humman ma iyaal Allah misil al-naas al-ma yihibbu akhwaanhum.
Daahu al-kalaam al-simi'tuuh min al-bidaaya.Waajib nirraayado ambeenaatna.
Wa ma waajib nabgo misil Gaabiil.Hu naadum hana Ibliis al-chariir wa katal akhuuh.Wa maala katalah-?Hu katalah achaan hu zaatah gaa'id yisawwi al-fasaala wa laakin akhuuh gaa'id yisawwi al-adaala.
Ya akhwaani,ma ti'ajjubu kan naas al-dunya yakrahooku.
Kan nirraayado ambeenaatna,da bas al-daliil al-yi'akkid kadar maragna min haalat al-moot wa dakhalna fi haalat al-haya.Ayyi naadum al-ma yihibb akhwaanah yagood fi l-moot.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yakrah akhuuh,hu kattaal dimam wa ta'arfu kadar kan naadum kattaal dimam,al-haya al-abadiiye ma tasbit foogah.
Isa al-Masiih fadaana be ruuhah wa da bas wassaf leena ma'ana al-mahabba.Wa khalaas,waajib nihibbu akhwaanna lahaddi nafdoohum be ruuhna.
Kan naadum indah maal al-dunya wa yichiif akhuuh ta'baan wa yisidd eenah wa ma yisaa'idah,kikkeef nuguulu mahabbat Allah gaa'ide foogah-?
Ya iyaali,khalli ma nirraayado be kalaam khuchuumna bas laakin khalli nirraayado be l-fi'il wa be l-mahabba al-sahiihe.
Wa kan niriidu akhwaanna,be misil da na'arfu aniina naas hana l-hagg.Wa be l-fikir da,guluubna yagoodu be amaan giddaam Allah.
Kan guluubna yuluumuuna fi ayyi cheyy,Allah hu akbar min guluubna wa hu ya'arif kulli cheyy.
Ya l-mahbuubiin,kan guluubna ma yuluumuuna fi ayyi cheyy,aniina indina al-damaan giddaam Allah.
Wa nalgo min Allah ayyi cheyy al-nas'alooh minnah achaan nitaabu'u wasiiyaatah wa nisawwu al-cheyy al-yarda beyah.
Wa di hi wasiiytah,waajib ni'aamunu be usum Ibnah Isa al-Masiih wa nirraayado ambeenaatna misil hu amaraana beyah.
Kulla l-naas al-yitaabu'u wasiiyaatah gaa'idiin saabtiin foogah wa hu gaa'id saabit fooghum.Wa na'arfu akiid kadar hu gaa'id saabit foogna wa da na'arfuuh min al-Ruuh al-Khudduus al-hu nazzalah foogna.
Ya l-mahbuubiin,ma tisaddugu be kulla l-naas al-yuguulu humman yihajju be gudrat al-Ruuh.Jarrubuuhum achaan ti'akkudu kan kalaamhum min Allah.Naas katiiriin sawwo nufuushum anbiya wa gammo yuruukhu fi l-dunya.
Wa daahu kikkeef ta'arfu kalaam hana Ruuh Allah.Kan naadum yuguul hu yihajji be gudrat al-Ruuh wa yachhad kadar Isa hu al-Masiih wa bigi insaani wakit dakhal fi l-dunya,khalaas kalaamah da min Allah.
Wa laakin ayyi naadum al-yuguul hu yihajji be gudrat al-Ruuh wa ma yachhad le Isa,kalaamah ma min Allah.Da min ruuh hana adu al-Masiih al-simi'tu beyah laabudda yaji wa haaliiyan gaa'id fi l-dunya.
Ya iyaali,intu naas hana Allah wa khalabtu al-anbiya al-kaddaabiin dool khalaas,achaan hu al-gaa'id fiiku akbar min al-gaa'id fi l-dunya.
Humman naas hana l-dunya bas wa achaan da,kalaamhum min al-dunya wa naas al-dunya bas yasma'o kalaamhum.
Aniina naas hana Allah.Ayyi naadum al-ya'arif Allah yasma' kalaamna.Wa ayyi naadum al-ma hana Allah ma yasma' kalaamna.Wa be da,na'arfu al-ruuh al-jaayi be l-kalaam al-sahiih wa l-ruuh al-jaayi be l-kalaam al-kidib.
Ya l-mahbuubiin,khalli nirraayado ambeenaatna achaan al-mahabba hi min Allah.Kulla l-naas al-yihibbu akhwaanhum humman al-naas al-bigo iyaal Allah wa ya'arfu Allah.
Ayyi naadum al-ma yihibb akhwaanah ma ya'arif Allah achaan Allah hu mahabba.
Daahu kikkeef Allah bayyan leena mahabbitah.Allah rassal Ibnah al-waahid fi l-dunya achaan beyah nalgo al-haya.
Wa di hi al-mahabba al-sahiihe,hi ma al-mahabba al-aniina nihibbu beeha Allah.La.Hi al-mahabba al-Allah habbaana beeha lahaddi rassal Ibnah le yamha zunuubna.
Ya l-mahbuubiin,Allah yihibbina bilheen wa achaan da,waajib nirraayado ambeenaatna.
Abadan ma fi ayyi naadum al-chaaf Allah.Laakin kan aniina gaa'idiin nirraayado ambeenaatna,Allah gaa'id ma'aana wa mahabbitah tabga kaamile foogna.
Daahu kikkeef ni'akkudu kadar aniina saabtiin foogah wa hu saabit foogna.Hu antaana Ruuhah.
Wa aniina chifna adiil kadar Allah rassal Ibnah fi l-dunya achaan yinajji naas al-dunya wa aniina gaa'idiin nachhado leyah.
Ayyi naadum al-yachhad kadar Isa hu Ibn Allah,hu gaa'id saabit fi Allah wa Allah gaa'id saabit foogah.
Wa khalaas irifna al-mahabba al-Allah habbaana beeha wa aamanna beeha.Allah hu mahabba.Wa l-saabtiin fi l-mahabba saabtiin fi Allah wa Allah saabit fooghum.
Wa be misil da,mahabbat Allah tabga kaamile foogna wa fi yoom al-Hisaab ma nakhaafo achaan fi l-dunya aniina ichna misil Isa al-Masiih.
Kan na'arfu mahabbat Allah,ma nakhaafo.Al-mahabba al-kaamile tatrud minnina al-khoof.Al-khoof jaayi min fikir hana l-azaab.Al-naadum al-khaayif lissaa' ma kaamil fi l-mahabba.
Aniina nihibbu Allah achaan Allah habbaana aniina min awwal.
Ayyi naadum al-yuguul-:-Ana nihibb Allah- wa laakin yakrah akhuuh,hu da kaddaab achaan kan ma yihibb akhuuh al-gaa'id yichiifah,ma mumkin yihibb Allah al-ma chaafah.
Daahu al-wasiiye al-antaaha leena.Al-naas al-yihibbu Allah waajib yihibbu akhwaanhum kula.
Ayyi naadum al-aaman kadar Isa hu al-Masiih,al-naadum da Allah bigi abuuh.Wa ayyi naadum al-yihibb abu al-iyaal,yihibb iyaalah kula.
Wa daahu na'arfu kadar nihibbu iyaal Allah kan nihibbu Allah wa nitaabu'u al-wasaaya al-hu antaahum leena.
Wa daahu kikkeef nihibbu Allah,nitabbugu wasiiyaatah.Wa tabbigiin al-wasaaya dool ma yabga leena gaasi
achaan ayyi naadum al-Allah bigi abuuh yakhlib al-dunya.Wa l-gudra al-beeha nakhlubu al-dunya hi jaaye min iimaanna.
Yaatu al-yakhlib al-dunya-?Illa l-naadum al-aaman be Isa Ibn Allah.
Isa hu al-Masiih al-khattasooh fi almi wa hu al-Masiih al-katalooh wa dammah daffag.Hu ma al-khattasooh fi l-almi bas laakin hu al-katalooh kula wa dammah daffag.Wa l-Ruuh al-Khudduus gaa'id yachhad leyah achaan al-Ruuh al-Khudduus hu al-hagg.
Wa fiyah chahaadaat talaata
wa humman al-Ruuh al-Khudduus wa l-almi wa l-damm.Wa l-chahaadaat al-talaata dool kalaamhum waahid.
Kan nakhbalo chahaadat al-naas kula,na'arfu chahaadat Allah akbar.Wa chahaadat Allah,hi al-kalaam al-gaalah fi Ibnah.
Al-mu'miniin be Ibn Allah karabo al-chahaada di fi guluubhum.Al-naas al-ma mu'miniin be l-kalaam al-Allah gaalah,humman kaddabo Allah achaan abo ma yakhbalo chahaadat Allah fi Ibnah.
Wa di hi al-chahaada,Allah antaana al-haya al-abadiiye wa l-haya di tinlagi fi Ibnah.
Al-naas al-mu'miniin be Ibn Allah ligo al-haya al-abadiiye wa ayyi naadum al-ma aaman be Ibn Allah ma ligi al-haya.
Ana katabt al-kalaam da leeku intu al-mu'miniin be usum Ibn Allah achaan ta'arfu kadar ligiitu al-haya al-abadiiye.
Wa nihajju le Allah be kulla amaan achaan na'arfu kan natulbu minnah ayyi cheyy hasab al-hu yidoorah,akiid hu yasma' talabna.
Wa kan na'arfu kadar hu simi' talabna fi ayyi cheyy,na'arfu kadar hu sawwa leena al-cheyy al-talabnaah minnah.
Kan naadum minku yichiif akhu waahid yaznib wa l-zanib da ma al-zanib al-yiwaddi al-naas le l-moot,khalli yas'al Allah wa hu yanti al-haya le l-naadum da.Hu yanti al-haya le l-naas al-zunuubhum ma yiwadduuhum le l-moot.Zanib aakhar gaa'id al-yiwaddi al-naas le l-moot wa ma gult leeku tas'alo Allah le l-naas al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuh.
Ayyi khata hu zanib laakin fi zunuub ma yiwaddu al-naas le l-moot.
Na'arfu kadar al-naas al-Allah sawwaahum iyaalah ma yaznubu wa Ibn Allah yahfadhum wa Ibliis al-chariir ma yagdar yalmashum.
Wa na'arfu kadar aniina bas naas hana Allah wa kulla l-naas hana l-dunya gaa'idiin fi iideen Ibliis al-chariir.
Wa na'arfu kadar Ibn Allah ja wa fattah leena guluubna achaan na'arfu Allah hu al-Ilaah al-hagg wa khalaas aniina bigiina naas al-Ilaah al-hagg be Ibnah Isa al-Masiih.Hu bas al-Ilaah al-hagg wa l-haya al-abadiiye.
Ya iyaali,angar'u min al-asnaam.
Jawaab minni ana al-cheekh leeki inti al-sayyida al-Allah azalaaki,leeki inti wa iyaalkial-nihibbuku fi l-hagg.Wa ma ana wiheedi nihibbuku.Kulla l-naas al-ya'arfu al-hagg yihibbuuku.
Wa nihibbuku be sabab al-hagg al-gaa'id saabit foogna wa l-yagood ma'aana ila l-abad.
Akiid al-salaam wa l-ni'ma wa l-rahma al-jaayiin min abuuna Allah wa min Ibn abuuna,Isa al-Masiih,yagoodu ma'aana be l-hagg wa be l-mahabba.
Ana bigiit farhaan marra waahid wakit lammeet ma'a waahidiin min iyaalki wa chiftuhum maachiin fi l-hagg misil abuuna amaraana beyah.
Ya l-sayyida,nidoor natlub minki cheyy waahid.Ma naktib leeki wasiiye jadiide.Al-wasiiye di simi'naaha min al-bidaaya wa hi waajib nirraayado ambeenaatna.
Kan nitaabu'u wasaaya Rabbina,khalaas di bas al-mahabba.Wa hi bas al-wasiiye wa hi nafs al-kalaam al-simi'tuuh min al-awwal wa waajib titaabu'uuha.
Khachchaachiin katiiriin gammo yuruukhu fi l-dunya.Humman yaabo ma yachhado kadar Isa al-Masiih bigi insaani wakit ja fi l-dunya.Al-naadum al-yuguul kalaam misil da,hu khachchaach wa adu al-Masiih.
Angar'u achaan al-ajur al-yaji be sabab amalku ma yiwaddir.Chiddu heelku achaan talgo ajurku kaamil.
Ayyi naadum al-ma yagood saabit fi ta'liim al-Masiih wa laakin yiziid fi ta'liim al-Masiih kalaam jadiid,Allah ma ma'aayah.Al-naadum al-gaa'id saabit fi l-ta'liim,hu bas al-naadum al-abuuna Allah gaa'id ma'aayah wa Ibn Allah kula gaa'id ma'aayah.
Kan naadum buguul hu Masiihi wa yaji leeku wa kalaamah ma yiwaafig le l-ta'liim da,ma tidayyufuuh wa ma tisallumuuh kula.
Achaan al-naadum al-yisallimah bigi misil hu yi'aawinah fi amalah al-fasil.
Fi kalaam katiir nidoor ni'ooriiku beyah wa laakin ma nidoor naktibah leeku fi jawaab.Ana nitmanna namchi leeku wa nilimmu wa nihajju ambeenaatna achaan nafraho sawa wa farahna yabga tamaam.
Iyaal akhutki al-Allah azalaaha yisallumuuki.
Jawaab min al-cheekh le habiibna Khaayus al-nihibbak fi l-hagg.
Ya habiibi,nas'al Allah achaan kulla cheyy yabga leek adiil wa achaan sihhitak tukuun taybe misil na'arif galbak daayman tayyib.
Ana firiht be ziyaada wakit akhwaan waahidiin jo min bakaanak wa chahado leena kadar inta gaa'id saabit fi l-hagg wa inta daayman titaabi' al-hagg adiil.
Ma fi cheyy yifarrihni ziyaada min al-khabar al-buguul iyaali gaa'idiin yitaabu'u al-hagg.
Ya habiibi,akiid inta akhu saadikh achaan wakit al-akhwaan yaju leek,kan inta ma ta'arifhum kula,inta tisaa'idhum.
Humman chahado be mahabbitak giddaam jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.Wa kan tantiihum zaad le safarhum misil Allah yarda beyah,da yukuun sameh bilheen.
Humman gammo min hini achaan yakhdumu fi chaan usum al-Masiih wa ma yakhbalo cheyy min al-naas al-ma mu'miniin.
Waajib aniina nidayyufu naas misil dool wa be misil da,nakhdumu ma'aahum fi chaan al-hagg.
Ana rassalt jawaab le jamaa'tak al-mu'miniin laakin Ditriifi al-mustakbir sawwa nafsah kabiirhum wa hu aba ma yasma' kalaamna.
Wa wakit najiik,niwaddih le l-akhwaan al-cheyy al-hu gaa'id yuguulah foogna.Hu gaa'id yagta'na be kalaam fasil.Wa da kula ma tammaah.Hu zaatah aba ma dayyaf al-akhwaan al-rassalnaahum.Wa l-naas al-dawwaro yidayyufuuhum kula,hu daharaahum wa taradaahum min jamaa'at al-mu'miniin.
Ya habiibi,ma titaabi' masal hana l-naas al-yisawwu al-charr.Taabi' masal hana l-naas al-yisawwu al-kheer.Al-naadum al-yisawwi al-kheer,hu bas naadum hana Allah.Wa l-naadum al-yisawwi al-charr ma ya'arif Allah.
Wa kulla l-akhwaan yachhado le Dimitri kadar hu naadum adiil wa l-hagg al-binchaaf foogah kula yachhad leyah.Aniina kula nachhado leyah wa ta'arif chahaaditna sahiihe.
Fi kalaam katiir nidoor ni'ooriik beyah wa laakin ma nidoor naktibah leek fi jawaab.
Ana nitmanna namchi leek gariib wa nilimmu wa nihajju ambeenaatna.
Aleekum al-salaam.Al-rufgaan al-ma'aayi yisallumuuk.Wa sallim al-rufgaan al-ma'aak kulluhum ke waahid waahid.
Al-jawaab minni ana Yahuuza abid Isa al-Masiih wa akhu Yaakhuub.Wa naktib leeku intu al-naas al-Allah abuuna naadaaku fi mahabbitah wa gaa'id yahfadku be Isa al-Masiih.
Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma wa l-mahabba be katara.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,min awwal atmanneet naktib leeku fi l-naja al-kullina nichaaruku foogha.Wa hassa' anjabart naktib leeku be sur'a wa nichajji'ku achaan tijaahudu le tahfado al-iimaan al-Allah kallaf beyah al-saalihiin marra waahide wa nihaa'iiye.
Achaan fi naas waahidiin fasliin andasso ambeenaatku be achiir.Wa humman gaa'idiin yi'awwuju kalaam rahmat Allah le yihallulu beyah al-muharramaat.Wa be da,yankuru Isa al-Masiih al-hu bas Sayyidna wa Rabbina.Wa min zamaan,al-Kitaab hajja be l-azaab al-yarjaahum.
Wa nidoor nizakkirku be l-kalaam al-intu zaatku ta'arfuuh tamaam.Allah najja cha'abah wa maragaahum min balad Masir wa ba'adeen hu dammar minhum al-naas al-ma aamano beyah.
Wa fakkuru fi l-malaa'ika al-abo ma ga'ado saabtiin fi sufuufhum wa khallo al-bakaan al-waajib leehum.Allah rabataahum be janaaziir al-abadan ma yingat'u wa khattaahum fi l-dalaam achaan yarjo yoom al-Hisaab al-aziim.
Wa battaan,fakkuru fi hillaal Saduum wa Amuurawa l-hillaal al-jambuhum.Sukkaanhum kula bigo misil al-malaa'ika dool achaan ankarabo fi l-zina wa taaba'o chahwaat mukhaalifiin le l-tabii'a.Wa achaan da,Allah sabba fooghum al-naar al-abadiiye wa humman bigo leena masal hana azaab.
Wa l-naas al-andasso ambeenaatku dool misilhum.Humman yitaabu'u ahlaamhum wa yinajjusu jisimhum wa yaabo sultit Allah wa yuguulu kalaam fasil fi malaa'ikat al-sama al-majiidiin.
Wa fakkuru fi Mikaayiil.Hu kabiir al-malaa'ika wa laakin wakit hu gaa'id yikhaalif Ibliis wa yikhaalitah fi janaazit Muusa,hu ma dawwar yukhutt fi Ibliis tuhma hana kalaam fasil.Fi badalah,hu kallam leyah bas wa gaal-:-Allah yi'aakhibak-!
Be l-aks,al-naas dool yuguulu kalaam fasil fi ayyi cheyy al-ma fihmooh.Humman misil al-haywaanaat,ma induhum agul.Yitaabu'u ayyi cheyy al-yaji leehum fi fikirhum wa achaan da,akiid yiddammaro.
Al-azaab yarjaahum.Achaan humman chaalo derib hana Gaabiil.Humman chaalo derib al-kidib hana Bal'aam achaan yalgo beyah riba.Wa iso Allah misil Khuurah wa be da,akiid yiddammaro.
Wakit tilimmu fi aawaaziim al-acha al-akhawi hana mahabbat Allah,al-naas dool yitallufu al-khuuwa wa yaakulu ma'aaku bala khijle wa yifakkuru le nufuushum bas.Humman misil al-sahaab al-tusuugah al-riih al-chadiide laakin ma yusubb almi.Wa humman misil chadar al-ma yaldo iyaal fi wakithum wa battaan mumallat.Wa misil da,al-chadar mayyit marrateen.
Eeb al-naas dool misil al-rikhwe al-yijiibha mooj al-bahar al-chadiid.Humman misil nujuum raaykhiin wa Allah jahhaz leehum al-dalaam al-azrag kurum ila l-abad.
Wa battaan Akhnuukh al-min al-zurriiye al-saab'e min Adam atnabba' be l-naas dool wa gaal-:-Chiifu,Rabbina yaji fi usut khaddaamiinah al-saalihiin al-ma yinhasbu min al-katara
achaan yichaari' kulla l-naas wa yi'aakhib kulla l-fasliin fi ayyi fasaala al-sawwooha.Wa hu yi'aakhib al-muznibiin al-fasliin fi ayyi kalaam al-fasil al-hajjooh fi Allah.
Wa l-naas dool za'laaniin wa chakkaayiin.Humman yitaabu'u chahwaathum bas.Wa yikallumu be kibriya wa yachkuru al-naas be kidib achaan yalgo minhum faayde.
Ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,fakkuru fi kalaam al-rusul hana Rabbina Isa al-Masiih al-gaalooh min awwal.
Oorooku kadar fi l-zaman al-akhiir,fiyah chammaatiin al-yitaabu'u chahwaathum al-fasliin.
Humman bas al-yisabbubu ambeenaatku al-furga.Humman yitaabu'u fikir al-insaan bas wa ma induhum al-Ruuh al-Khudduus.
Wa laakin leeku intu,ya akhwaani al-nihibbuku,sawwu nufuusku gawiyiin fi iimaanku al-mukhaddas.Khallu al-Ruuh al-Khudduus daayman yuguud salaawaatku.
Agoodu saabtiin fi mahabbat Allah.Khuttu baalku fi l-rahma al-jaaye min Rabbina Isa al-Masiih,al-tiwaddiina fi l-haya al-abadiiye.
Hinnu fi l-naas al-induhum chakak.
Wa l-naas al-garrabo le khachum al-naar,akurbuuhum wa afza'oohum.Hinnu fi l-naas al-najjaso nufuushum be l-zina lahaddi khulgaanhum.Laakin angar'u marra waahid wa akraho ayyi cheyy al-yagdar yinajjisku intu kula.
Allah gaadir wa yagdar yahfadku achaan ma taga'o.Hu bas yiwaddiiku fi hadaratah al-majiide bala ayyi eeb,farhaaniin farha chadiide.
Wa l-hamd le Allah al-Waahid al-yinajjiina be Isa al-Masiih Rabbina.Kulla l-majd wa l-jalaal wa l-muluk wa l-sulta waajib leyah hu bas,min gabul kulla l-wakit wa fi l-wakit al-haadir wa ila l-abad-!Aamiin.
Di hi ru'ya hana Isa al-Masiih al-Allah antaaha leyah achaan yiwassif le abiidah al-cheyy al-laabudda yabga gariib.Wa hu rassal malakah achaan yi'arrif al-ru'ya di le abdah Yuuhanna.
Wa Yuuhanna chahad be kulla cheyy al-chaafah al-bukhuss kalaam Allah wa chahaadat Isa al-Masiih.Wa hu katabaahum fi l-kitaab da.
Wa mabruuk le l-naadum al-yagri be hiss aali kalaam al-tanabbu al-maktuub da.Wa mabruuk le l-naas al-yasma'ooh wa yitaabu'uuh.Achaan waktah garrab.
Wa daahu ana Yuuhanna naktib wa nirassil al-kalaam da le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-sab'a al-fi balad Aasiya.Aleekum al-salaam wa l-rahma min Allah al-gaa'id fi l-wakit al-faat wa l-wakit al-haadir wa l-wakit al-jaayi.Wa l-salaam min al-Arwaah al-sab'aal-gaa'idiin giddaam archah
wa min Isa al-Masiih al-chaahid al-saadikh wa hu awwal naadum al-ba'as min ust al-maytiin wa hu malik fi kulla muluuk al-ard.Wa daahu al-gaa'id yihibbina wa fadaana min zunuubna be dammah al-daffag fi chaanna.
Wa hu kawwanaana mamlaka wa sawwaana kullina rujaal diin achaan na'abudu Allah abuuh.Wa waajib le Isa al-Masiih al-majd wa l-muluk daayman wa ila l-abad.Aamiin.
Wa chiifu,hu jaayi raakib fi l-sahaab wa ayyi naadum yichiifah.Aywa,kulla l-naas al-ta'anooh yichiifuuh wa kulla gabaayil al-ard yabku be sababah.Aywa,misil da bas yabga.Aamiin.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah Rabbina-:-Ana al-Awwal wa l-Akhiir.Ana al-gaa'id fi l-wakit al-faat wa l-wakit al-haadir wa l-wakit al-jaayi.Ana Allah al-Gaadir.
Wa ana Yuuhanna akhuuku al-gaa'id nitaabi' Isa misilku.Ana kula muchaarik ma'aaku fi l-ta'ab wa fi mamlakat Allah wa nahmal al-ta'ab be sabur misilku.Wa karabooni achaan ballakht le l-naas kalaam Allah wa chahaadat Isa al-Masiih.Wa hassa' ana masjuun fi l-jaziira al-usumha Batmus.
Wa fi yoom al-Rabb,Ruuh Allah nazal foogi wa simi't waraayi hiss hana naadum gaa'id yikallim.Hissah chadiid misil hiss al-burunji.
Wa hu gaal-:-Aktib fi kitaab al-cheyy al-tichiifah wa rassilah le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-sab'a al-gaa'idiin fi hillaal Afasus wa Izmiir wa Barkhaamus wa Siyaatiira wa Saardis wa Filadalfiya wa Laawdikiiya.
Wa ana anlafatt achaan nichiif yaatu al-gaa'id yikallim leyi wa chift sab'a faanuus hana dahab.
Wa ambeenaat al-sab'a faanuus dool,chift naadum misil Ibn al-Insaan laabis khalag tawiil wa indah fi sadrah hizaam hana dahab.
Wa suuf raasah abyad karr misil laban aw gutun wa uyuunah misil jamur al-mugargir.
Wa rijileenah yiraaru misil al-nahaas al-mujammar wa misil al-nahaas al-nadiif marra waahid.Wa hissah chadiid misil al-matara al-tagiile.
Wa fi iidah al-zeene,hu chaayil sab'a nujuum.Wa seef mutarrag min jaay wa jaay maarig min khachmah.Wa wijhah yidawwi chadiid misil harraayit al-duhur.
Wa wakit ana chiftah,waga't giddaamah misil naadum mayyit.Wa hu khatta iidah al-zeene foogi wa gaal-:-Ma takhaaf.Ana al-Awwal wa l-Akhiir.
Ana al-Hayy.Awwal ana mutt wa hassa' ana hiyiit wa abadan ma numuut battaan.Wa indi muftaah hana l-moot wa l-khabur.
Wa khalaas,aktib al-cheyy al-tichiifah al-bukhuss al-wakit al-haadir wa l-wakit al-jaayi.
Nifassir leek al-sirr hana l-sab'a nujuum al-chiftuhum fi iidi al-zeene wa l-sab'a faanuus hana dahab.Al-sab'a nujuum dool humman yimassulu al-malaa'ika al-yahfado jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin al-sab'a.Wa l-sab'a faanuus,humman al-sab'a jamaa'aat zaathum.
Aktib kalaami le l-malak hana jamaa'at al-mu'miniinal-fi hillit Afasus.Daahu kalaami,ana al-chaayil al-sab'a nujuum fi iidi al-zeene wa raayikh ambeenaat al-sab'a faanuus hana dahab.
Ana na'arif kulla cheyy al-inta sawweetah wa juhdak fi l-khidme wa sabaatak foogha.Wa inta ma khassadt be l-naas al-yisawwu al-charr.Wa inta jarrabt al-naas al-yakdubu wa yuguulu humman rusul al-Masiih wa inta akkadt kadar humman kaddaabiin.
Ana na'arif kadar al-ta'ab ja foogak be sabab usmi wa inta gaa'id tahmalah be sabur wa na'arif inta ma kisilt.
Laakin ana ligiit foogak cheyy waahid ma adiil.Inta khalleet minnak mahabbitak al-gawiiye al-awwal indak.
Hassa' fakkir fi l-kalaam da wa a'arif kadar akiid inta maragt ba'iid min al-derib.Wa khalaas,tuub min zunuubak wa khalli haalak tabga misil awwal.Wa kan ma tutuub,ana najiik wa narfa' faanuusak min bakaanah.
Wa laakin ligiit foogak cheyy adiil kula.Inta takrah misil ana kula nakrahah al-cheyy al-gaa'idiin yisawwuuh al-talaamiiz hana Niiguula.
Ayyi naadum al-indah adaan,khalli yasma' al-kalaam al-yuguulah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin.Wa ayyi naadum al-yinnasir,ana nantiih izin achaan yaakul min chadarat al-Haya al-gaa'ide fi Jannat Allah.
Wa aktib kalaami le l-malak hana jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi hillit Izmiir.Daahu kalaami,ana al-Awwal wa l-Akhiir,ana al-mutt wa hiyiit.
Ana na'arif al-ta'ab al-ligaak wa na'arif inta bigiit miskiin wa laakin indak baraka kabiire.Wa na'arif al-kalaam al-fasil al-yuguuluuh foogak al-naas al-yisawwu nufuushum Yahuud wa laakin humman ma Yahuud.Yisallu fi beet al-sala wa laakin humman jamaa'at Ibliis.
Ma takhaaf min al-diige al-gariib tajiik.Khuttu baalku-!Ibliis yakrub waahidiin minku fi l-sijin wa iimaanku yijarrubuuh.Wa fi muddit achara yoom,tidayyugu diige chadiide.Agoodu saabtiin fi iimaanku lahaddi l-moot wa khalaas nantiiku taaj hana l-haya al-abadiiye.
Ayyi naadum al-indah adaan,khalli yasma' al-kalaam al-yuguulah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin.Wa ayyi naadum al-yinnasir,ma yakhaaf min al-moot al-taani.
Wa aktib kalaami le l-malak hana jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi hillit Barkhaamus.Daahu kalaami,ana al-indi seef al-mutarrag min jaay wa jaay.
Ana na'arif al-bakaan al-intu saakniin foogah wa hu al-bakaan al-Ibliis khatta foogah kursi haggah.Wa intu munkaribiin fi usmi.Wa intu ma nakartu iimaanku beyi wakit katalo Antibaas fi usutku wa hu chahad leyi chahaada saabte fi l-bakaan al-Ibliis saakin foogah.
Laakin ana ligiit foogak cheyy waahid ma adiil.Wa indak naas waahidiin yitaabu'u ta'liim misil ta'liim Bal'aam.Wa zamaan Bal'aam allam al-malik Balaakh kikkeef yiwaddi Bani Israa'iil fi l-zunuub lahaddi akalo al-laham al-awwal gaddamah dahiiye le asnaamah wa humman gammo zano.
Wa battaan naasak waahidiin gaa'idiin yitaabu'u ta'liim talaamiiz Niiguula.
Wa achaan da,nuguul leek tuub min zunuubak.Wa kan ma tubt,ana naji leek gariib wa nidaawis al-naas dool be l-seef al-maarig min khachmi.
Ayyi naadum al-indah adaan,khalli yasma' al-kalaam al-yuguulah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin.Wa ayyi naadum al-yinnasir,ana nantiih al-manna al-mulabbada wa battaan nantiih hajar abyadal-maktuub foogah usum jadiid wa ma fi naadum ya'arfah illa l-naadum al-yalgaah minni.
Wa aktib kalaami le l-malak hana jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi hillit Siyaatiira.Daahu kalaami,ana Ibn Allah,al-uyuuni misil jamur mugargir wa rijileeni yiraaru misil nahaas mujammar.
Ana na'arif khidimtak.Na'arif mahabbitak wa iimaanak wa sabrak fi l-ta'ab.Wa na'arif kadar khidimtak al-hassa' akheer min al-awwal.
Laakin ana ligiit foogak cheyy waahid ma adiil.Inta khalleet mara misil Izabiiltisawwi nafisha nabiiye wa ti'allim abiidi wa tukhuchchuhum lahaddi yazno wa yaakulu laham al-gaddamooh dahiiye le l-asnaam.
Ana anteetha fursa le tutuub min zunuubha laakin hi abat ma taabat min al-zina.
Khutt baalak-!Ana narmiiha wa hi tabga mardaane targud fi sariirha.Wa l-naas al-zano ma'aaha narmiihum fi diige chadiide,kan ma yutuubu wa ma yikhallu deribha.
Wa nadrub talaamiizha wa yumuutu.Wa be da,kulla jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin ya'arfu kadar ana nakchif galib hana ayyi naadum wa na'arif fikrah.Wa ya'arfu kadar ayyi waahid minku nijaaziih.
Wa akiid,naas gaa'idiin ambeenaatku fi Siyaatiira al-ma taaba'o ta'liimha wa ma allamo minha al-ilim al-buguulu hu min asraar Ibliis.Wa leeku intu,nuguul ana ma nukhutt foogku battaan wasiiye tagiile,
illa nuguul agoodu saabtiin fi l-kalaam al-induku lahaddi naji.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yinnasir wa yitaabi' hasab al-ana nidoorah lahaddi l-yoom al-akhiir,ana nukhuttah yahkim fi l-umam.
Wa hu yahkim fooghum be asa hana hadiid wa yikassirhum misil jiraar al-tiine.
Aywa,misil abuuyi Allah antaani gudra,ana kula nantiih najmat al-Sabaah.
Ayyi naadum al-indah adaan,khalli yasma' al-kalaam al-yuguulah al-Ruuh al-Khudduus le jamaa'aat al-mu'miniin.
Wa aktib kalaami le l-malak hana jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi hillit Saardis.Daahu kalaami,ana al-indi al-Arwaah al-sab'a hana Allah wa l-sab'a nujuum.Ana na'arif khidimtak.Yuguulu iimaanak hayy wa laakin be l-sahiih,iimaanak mayyit.
Yalla abga hadiir wa sabbit al-iimaan al-faddal leek al-yidoor yumuut.Achaan ana ligiit khidimtak al-sawweetha ma kaamile giddaam Allah Rabbi.
Wa achaan da,fakkir fi l-kalaam al-awwal simi'tah wa allamook leyah.Wa taabi' al-kalaam da wa tuub min zunuubak.Wa kan inta abeet ma gammeet foog,ana najiik be khafla misil jayyit al-sarraag wa nadurbak fi l-saa'a al-inta ma ta'arifha.
Laakin fi Saardis,naasak waahidiin ma najjaso nufuushum.Wa nuguul le l-naas dool,humman yuruukhu ma'aayi laabsiin khulgaan buyud al-induhum hagg yalbasoohum.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yinnasir,ana nilabbisah misilhum khalag abyad wa ma nuguchch usmah min Kitaab al-Haya.Wa ana nachhad leyah giddaam abuuyi wa giddaam malaa'ikatah.
Wa aktib kalaami le l-malak hana jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi hillit Filadalfiya.Daahu kalaami,ana al-Khudduus wa l-Sahiih.Indi muftaah hana l-malik Dawuud.Wa kan ana naftah al-baab,ma fi naadum al-yagdar yisiddah wa kan ana nisidd al-baab,ma fi naadum al-yagdar yaftahah.
Ana na'arif kulla cheyy al-sawweetah.Wa na'arif indak gudra chiyya bas wa laakin ma fachalt.Inta taaba't kalaami adiil wa ma nakart usmi.Wa chiif,ana fataht al-derib giddaamak wa ma fi naadum al-yagdar yisiddah.
Chiif,al-naas al-yuguulu be kidib humman Yahuud wa laakin humman ma Yahuud.Yisallu fi beet al-sala laakin humman jamaa'at Ibliis.Humman dool ana najburhum yaju leek wa yasjudu giddaamak wa ya'arfu kadar ana nihibbak.
Inta taaba't kalaami be sabur katiir.Achaan da,nahfadak min al-diige al-taji fi kulla naas al-dunya.Al-diige di tijarribhum le sukkaan al-ard.
Ana naji gariib.Akrub gawi al-iimaan al-indak achaan naadum ma yichiil minnak taajak hana l-naja.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yinnasir,ana naj'alah misil amuud fi beet Allah Rabbi.Wa hu yagood fi l-beet da wa abadan ma yamrug minnah wa ana naktib foogah usum Allah wa usum madiinat Allah wa hi Madiinat al-Khudus al-jadiide al-Allah Rabbi yinazzilha min al-samaawaat.Wa naktib foogah usmi al-jadiid.
Wa aktib kalaami le l-malak hana jamaa'at al-mu'miniin al-fi hillit Laawdikiiya.Daahu kalaami,ana al-usmi Aamiin.Ana al-Chaahid al-chahaadti daayman saabte wa sahiihe wa ana ra'iis fi kulla cheyy al-Allah khalagah.
Ana na'arif khidimtak.Wa na'arif inta bigiit misil almi daafi.Akheer leyi kan inta misil almi baarid walla misil almi haami.
Wa khalaas,ana nigaddifak achaan inta misil almi daafi wa la baarid wa la haami.
Wa inta gaa'id tuguul-:--Ana khani wa bigi leyi adiil wa ma nidoor battaan cheyy.- Wa inta ma ta'arif kadar be l-sahiih,inta chagyaan wa fagraan wa miskiin wa amyaan wa aryaan.
Wa achaan da,niwassiik achaan tachri minni dahab saafi wa beyah tabga khani.Wa achri minni lubaas abyad achaan talbas wa tisidd beyah ireek.Wa achri minni gatra achaan tusubbaha fi uyuunak wa be da,battaan tichiif.
Ana nahrij al-naas al-nihibbuhum wa ni'addibhum.Achaan da,ankarib fi kalaami wa tuub min zunuubak.
Chiif,ana misil naadum waagif fi l-derib wa yudugg fi l-baab.Kan ayyi naadum yasma'ni wa yaftah leyi al-baab,ana nadkhul fi beetah wa naakul ma'aayah wa hu yaakul ma'aayi.
Wa ayyi naadum al-yinnasir,ana nantiih izin achaan yagood ma'aayi fi archi.Aywa,hu yisawwi misil ana zaati annasart wa ga'adt ma'a abuuyi Allah fi archah.
Wa ba'ad da,ana chift cheyy aakhar.Chift baab maftuuh fi l-sama.Wa simi't battaan nafs al-hiss al-awwal simi'tah,al-hiss al-yichaabih misil hiss burunji.Wa hu hajja leyi wa gaal-:-Ta'aal leyi hini foog wa niwassifak al-cheyy al-laabudda yabga ba'adeen.
Wa tawwaali,Ruuh Allah nazal foogi wa chift arch fi l-samaawaat wa siidah gaa'id foogah.
Wa l-gaa'id fi l-arch da yiraari misil faaruus wa agiig ahmar.Wa l-arch muhawwag be cheyy misil hajjaaz al-matar al-yiraari misil yaakhuut akhdar.
Wa ana chift 24 karaasi muhawwigiin al-arch da wa 24 chuyuukh gaa'idiin fooghum.Wa ayyi waahid laabis khalag abyad wa indah taaj hana dahab fi raasah.
Wa chift barraaga tachla' min al-arch wa simi't haraka chadiide wa ra'ad.Wa giddaam al-arch,ana chift sab'a machaahiib al-naar wa humman al-Arwaah al-sab'a hana Allah.
Wa battaan giddaam al-arch,chift bakaan wasii' yichaabih misil bahar hana almi saafi marra waahid lahaddi ga'arah yinchaaf.Wa fi daayir al-arch,ana chift arba'a makhluugiin samaawiyiin wa jilidhum malaan be uyuun min wara wa min giddaam.
Wa l-makhluug al-awwalaani yichaabih misil duud wa l-taani misil toor wa l-taalit indah wijih misil wijih al-insaan wa l-raabi' yichaabih misil sagur gaa'id yitiir.
Wa ayyi waahid min al-arba'a makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin dool indah sitte janaahe malaaniin be uyuun min foog wa min tihit.Wa gaa'idiin yikhannu daayman leel wa nahaar wa abadan ma khallo khineehum.Wa gaa'idiin yuguulu-:-Khudduus,Khudduus,KhudduusAllah al-Rabb al-Gaadiral-gaa'id fi l-wakit al-faatwa fi l-wakit al-haadirwa fi l-wakit al-jaayi.
Wa l-makhluugiin dool gaa'idiin yimajjudu al-gaa'id fi l-arch wa hu al-Hayy ila l-abad.Wa humman gaa'idiin yahmuduuh wa yachkuruuh.Wa ayyi wakit yimajjuduuh misil da,
al-chuyuukh al-ichriin wa arba'a yasjudu giddaam al-gaa'id fi l-arch wa ya'abuduuh,hu al-Hayy ila l-abad.Wa ayyi waahid yarmi taajah giddaam al-arch wa yuguul-:
Ya Rabbina Allah,kulla cheyyhana l-majd wa l-ikraam wa l-gudrawaajib leek intaachaan inta bas khalagt kulla cheyywa be niiytak inta bas,kulla cheyy bigi wa gaa'id.
Wa ana chift maktuub malfuuf fi l-iid al-zeene hana l-gaa'id fi l-arch wa l-maktuub da indah kitaabe min daakhal wa min barra.Wa l-maktuub makhtuum be sab'a khitim.
Wa chift malak gaadir kallam be hiss chadiid wa gaal-:-Yaatu al-waajib leyah yufukk al-khitim wa yaftah al-maktuub-?
Wa fi l-samaawaat wa fi l-ard wa tihit al-ard,ma fi naadum al-gidir yichiil al-maktuub wa yaftahah wa yagri al-kalaam al-gaa'id foogah.
Wa ana bakeet baki chadiid achaan ma ligo naadum al-indah hagg yaftah al-maktuub wa yagri al-kalaam al-gaa'id foogah.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,waahid min al-chuyuukh hajja leyi wa gaal-:-Ma tabki.Chiif-!Al-naadum al-usmah Duud hana gabiilat Yahuuza,hu gaa'id.Wa hu al-malik al-min zurriiyit Dawuud wa hu bas al-annasar.Wa be da,hu yagdar yufukk al-sab'a khitim wa yaftah al-maktuub.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,ana chift Hamal waagif ust al-arch ambeen al-arba'a makhluugiin giddaam al-chuyuukh.Wa l-Hamal yichaabih misil awwal dabahooh.Wa indah sab'a guruun wa sab'a uyuun wa humman al-Arwaah al-sab'a al-Allah rassalaahum fi kulla l-ard.
Wa l-Hamal macha le l-gaa'id fi l-arch wa chaal al-maktuub min iidah al-zeene.
Wa wakit al-Hamal chaal al-maktuub,al-arba'a makhluugiin wa l-arba'a wa ichriin chuyuukh sajado giddaamah.Wa ayyi waahid indah jigindiiye wa mukhbar hana dahab al-foogah bakhuur.Wa l-bakhuur da yimassil salaawaat al-saalihiin.
Wa khanno khine jadiid wa daahu khineehum.-Inta bas al-waajib tichiil al-maktuubwa tufukk khitmahachaan inta dabahookwa be dammak,fadeet al-naaswa gaddamtuhum le Allahmin ayyi gabiila wa ayyi lukhkhawa min ayyi cha'ab wa ayyi umma.
Wa inta kawwantuhum mamlakawa sawweethum rujaal diinachaan ya'abudu Allahwa yahkumu fi l-ard.
Wa battaan ana chift wa simi't hiss hana malaa'ika katiiriin bilheen al-muhawwigiin al-arch wa l-makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin wa l-chuyuukh.Wa adadhum uluuf wa malaayiin wa ziyaada min da marra waahid.
Wa kallamo be hiss chadiid wa gaalo-:-Al-Hamal al-dabahooh waajib leyah hu basal-gudra wa l-maalwa l-ilim wa l-khuwwawa l-ikraam wa l-majd wa l-chukur.
Wa ana simi't hiss hana kulla l-makhluugiin al-aaychiin fi l-samaawaat wa fi l-ard wa tihit al-ard wa fi l-bahar.Wa kulluhum gaalo-:-Le l-gaa'id fi l-arch wa le l-Hamalyabgo al-chukur wa l-ikraamwa l-majd wa l-mulukdaayman wa ila l-abad.
Wa l-arba'a makhluugiin gaalo-:-Aamiin-! Wa l-chuyuukh sajado wa abado.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,ana chift al-Hamal fakka awwal khitim min al-sab'a.Wa simi't waahid min al-arba'a makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin naada be hiss chadiid misil al-ra'ad wa gaal-:-Ta'aal-!
Wa ana chift juwaad abyad.Wa l-raakib foogah indah nubbaal wa antooh taaj hana malik.Wa gamma misil malik al-annasar wa maachi le yinnasir battaan.
Wakit al-Hamal fakka al-khitim al-taani,ana simi't al-makhluug al-taani gaal-:-Ta'aal-!
Wa juwaad aakhar marag wa hu ahmar.Wa l-raakib foogah indah izin achaan yarfa' al-salaam min al-ard lahaddi al-naas yilkaatalo ambeenaathum.Wa antooh seef kabiir bilheen.
Wakit al-Hamal fakka al-khitim al-taalit,ana simi't al-makhluug al-taalit gaal-:-Ta'aal-! Wa ana chift juwaad azrag.Wa l-raakib foogah indah miizaan fi iidah.
Wa simi't haraka tichaabih hiss wa l-hiss da jaayi min ust al-arba'a makhluugiin al-samaawiyiin wa gaal-:-Khalli taman al-gameh al-ahmar wa taman al-gameh al-abyad yiziidu be achara marraat.Laakin ma tiziid taman al-dihin wa l-khamar.
Wakit al-Hamal fakka al-khitim al-raabi',ana simi't al-makhluug al-raabi' gaal-:-Ta'aal-!
Wa ana chift juwaad akhbach wa l-raakib foogah hu usmah al-Moot.Wa l-Khabur gaa'id yitaabi'ah gariib.Wa antoohum izin achaan yaktulu rubu' al-naas al-gaa'idiin fi l-ard.Wa kataloohum be l-harib wa l-juu' wa l-waba wa be haywaanaat al-kadaade.
Wakit al-Hamal fakka al-khitim al-khaamis,ana chift madbah wa tihtah chift al-naas al-kataloohum be sabab humman ballakho kalaam Allah wa chahado leyah.
Wa sarakho be hiss chadiid wa gaalo-:-Ya Rabbina al-Hagg wa l-Khudduus.Narjo kam yoom hatta inta ti'aakhib wa tichiil leena al-taar fi sukkaan al-ard al-daffago dammina-?
Wa fi l-bakaan da,Allah anta le ayyi waahid minhum khalag abyad wa gaal leehum-:-Anjammo battaan chiyya.Lissaa' ma ni'aakhibhum achaan akhwaanku abiid Isa al-mukhaddar leehum al-moot wa yaktuluuhum misil katalooku,lissaa' adadhum ma tamma.
Daahu al-cheyy al-chiftah wakit al-Hamal fakka al-khitim al-saadis.Ana chift zilzaal chadiid bilheen wa l-harraay bigat zarga kurum misil al-faham wa l-gamar bigi ahmar tchu misil al-damm.
Wa l-nujuum daffago fi l-ard misil iyaal chadar al-tiin al-ma nijdo yidaffugu wakit al-riih tusuug chadiid.
Wa l-sama antawa misil al-birich al-gaa'idiin yatwuuh.Wa ayyi jabal wa jaziira alhawwalo min bakaanaathum.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,muluuk al-ard wa kubaaraat al-naas wa kubaaraat al-askar wa siyaad al-maal wa siyaad al-gudra wa kulla l-naas min al-abiid wa l-hurriin,kulluhum gammo allabbado fi l-karaakiir wa fi ust al-hujaar.
Wa khaafo khoof chadiid wa sarakho wa gaalo le l-jibaal wa l-hujaar-:-Aga'o foogna wa labbuduuna min uyuun hana l-gaa'id fi l-arch wa min khadab al-Hamal.
Wa daahu yoom al-khadab ja wa l-yoom da aziim.Wa yaatu al-yagdar yahmalah-?
Wa ba'ad da,ana chift arba'a malaa'ika waagfiin fi atraaf al-ard.Wa humman gaa'idiin yadharo al-riih achaan ma tusuug min ayyi jiihe min al-jiihaat al-arba'a wa la fi l-ard wa la fi l-bahar wa la fi l-chadar.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,ana chift malak aakhar wa hu tala' min sabaah wa indah khitim hana Allah al-Hayy fi iidah.Wa hu kallam be hiss chadiid le l-arba'a malaa'ika al-induhum izin achaan yitallufu al-ard wa l-bahar
wa gaal-:-Ma titallufu al-ard wa la l-bahar wa la l-chadar lahaddi nukhuttu wasim le ayyi abid hana Rabbina Allah fi jabhitah.
Wa ba'ad da,ana simi't adad al-naas al-khatto fooghum wasim Allah.Wa l-adad da bigi 144-000 naadum.Wa humman min ayyi gabiila hana Bani Israa'iil.
Khatto wasim fi 12-000 min gabiilat Yahuuzawa 12-000 min gabiilat Ra'uubiinwa 12-000 min gabiilat Gaad
wa 12-000 min gabiilat Achiirwa 12-000 min gabiilat Naftaaliwa 12-000 min gabiilat Manassa
wa 12-000 min gabiilat Chim'uunwa 12-000 min gabiilat Laawiwa 12-000 min gabiilat Yassaakar
wa 12-000 min gabiilat Zabuluunwa 12-000 min gabiilat Yuusufwa 12-000 min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa kulla l-naas dool,khatto leehum wasim.
Wa ba'ad da,chift battaan naas katiiriin bilheen lahaddi ma fi naadum yagdar yahsibhum.Wa humman min ayyi umma wa gabiila wa cha'ab wa lukhkha.Wa kulluhum waagfiin giddaam al-arch wa giddaam al-Hamal wa ayyi waahid laabis khalag abyad wa indah firi' hana nakhal fi iidah al-yiwassif farhithum.
Wa kulluhum sarakho be hiss chadiid wa gaalo-:-Al-naja jaaye min Rabbina al-gaa'id fi l-archwa l-Hamal-!
Wa l-malaa'ika al-muhawwigiin al-arch wa l-chuyuukh wa l-arba'a makhluugiin,kulluhum sajado giddaam al-arch wa abado Allah.
Wa gaalo-:-Aamiin.Al-baraka wa l-majd wa l-hikmawa l-chukur wa l-ikraamwa l-gudra wa l-khuwwayabgo daayman wa ila l-abadle Allah Rabbina.Aamiin-!
Wa fi l-bakaan da,waahid min al-chuyuukh hajja leyi wa gaal-:-Yaatumman al-naas al-laabsiin khulgaan buyud dool-?Humman jo min ween-?
Wa raddeet leyah wa gult-:-Ya l-sayyid,inta bas ta'arfah. Wa hu gaal-:-Dool al-naas al-ga'ado saabtiin wa marago min al-diige al-kabiire.Humman al-naas al-khassalo khulgaanhum be damm al-Hamal wa misil da,sawwo khulgaanhum buyud.
Achaan da bas,humman waagfiingiddaam arch Allahwa ya'abuduuh leel wa nahaarfi beetah hana l-ibaada.Wa l-gaa'id fi l-archyichiil mas'uuliiyithum.
Wa l-juu' abadan ma yisawwiihumwa l-atach ma yakrubhum.Wa l-harraay ma tutugguhum battaanwa ma fi hamu al-yiharrighum.
Wa da yabga achaan al-Hamalal-gaa'id fi ust al-archyabga leehum raa'i.Wa hu yuguudhum fi l-deribwa yiwaddiihum le uyuun almi al-hayawa Allah yuguchch min uyuunhum kulla dumuu'hum.
Wa wakit al-Hamal fakka al-khitim al-saabi',kulla cheyy fi l-samaawaat sakat wa ga'ad saakit misil nuss saa'a.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,ana chift al-sab'a malaa'ika al-waagfiin giddaam Allah.Wa antoohum sab'a burunji.
Wa malak aakhar ja wa wagaf giddaam al-madbah wa chaayil fi iidah mukhbar hana dahab.Wa antooh bakhuur katiir achaan yigaddimah le Allah ma'a salaawaat kulla l-saalihiin wa gaddamah fi l-mukhbar al-dahbi al-gaa'id giddaam al-arch.
Wa dukhkhaan al-bakhuur gamma min iid al-malak ma'a salaawaat al-saalihiin wa tala' giddaam Allah.
Wa ba'ad da,al-malak chaal mukhbarah wa malaah be jamur min al-madbah wa daffagah fi l-ard.Wa ra'ad wa haraka chadiide ansama'o wa barraaga chala'at wa kaan zilzaal.
Wa khalaas,al-sab'a malaa'ika al-induhum al-sab'a burunji,ayyi waahid rafa' al-burunji al-indah wa ga'ad jaahiz le yadurbah.
Wa l-malak al-awwal darab al-burunji al-indah.Wa khalaas,barad wa naar mukhalbatiin be damm daffago fi l-ard.Wa tilt al-ard hirig wa tilt al-chadar hirig wa l-gechch al-akhdar kula hirig.
Wa l-malak al-taani darab al-burunji al-indah.Wa chokhol misil jabal kabiir hana naar ramooh fi l-bahar al-maalih.Wa khalaas,tilt al-bahar bigi damm.
Wa tilt al-haywaanaat al-aaychiin fi l-bahar maato wa tilt al-sufun addammaro marra waahid.
Wa l-malak al-taalit darab al-burunji al-indah.Wa najma kabiire bilheen waga'at min al-sama muwalli'e naar chadiide wa waga'at fi tilt al-almi al-gaa'id fi l-buhuur wa fi uyuun almi.
Wa usum al-najma di Amhamdal.Wa khalaas,tilt al-almi bigi murr wa naas katiiriin chirbo minnah wa maato achaan al-almi bigi murr marra waahid.
Wa l-malak al-raabi' darab al-burunji al-indah.Wa tilt al-harraay,darabooh wa tilt al-gamar wa tilt al-nujuum kula daraboohum.Wa khalaas,tilt deyyuhum bigi ma fiih.Wa nuur bigi ma fiih fi tilt al-nahaar wa tilt al-leel.
Wa chift battaan wa simi't hiss hana sagur al-gaa'id yitiir fi l-sama wa be hiss chadiid gaal-:-Azaab,azaab-!Azaab le sukkaan al-ard-!Achaan al-talaata burunji al-faddalo,gariib al-malaa'ika yadurbuuhum.
Wa l-malak al-khaamis darab al-burunji al-indah.Wa ana chift najma wa hi gaa'ide fi l-ard achaan waga'at min al-sama.Wa antooha muftaah hana khachum al-haawiye.
Wa l-najma fatahat khachum al-haawiye wa dukhkhaan azrag kurum marag minha.Wa khalaas,al-dukhkhaan sadda al-harraay wa l-hawa.
Wa fi l-bakaan da,jaraad marag min al-dukhkhaan wa nazal fi l-ard.Wa antooh gudra misil gudrat agaarib al-ard.
Wa l-jaraad ma indah izin achaan yitallif ayyi cheyy akhdar fi l-ard wala l-gechch wala l-nabaataat wala l-chadar.Wa laakin indah izin achaan yahjim kulla l-naas al-ma induhum wasim Allah fi jabhithum.
Wa ma indah izin achaan yaktul al-naas wa laakin ja le yi'azzibhum muddit khamsa chahar.Wa l-azaab al-yi'azzib beyah al-naas chadiid misil al-waja' al-yihiss beyah al-naadum al-addatah agrab.
Wa fi l-wakit daak,al-naas yidooru al-moot wa ma yalgooh wa humman yagramo le l-moot wa hu yaabaahum.
Wa l-jaraad da yichaabih misil kheel al-harib al-jaahiziin le l-duwaas.Fi raasah indah taagiiye tichaabih taaj hana dahab wa wijhah misil wijih al-insaan.
Wa suuf raasah tuwaal misil cha'ar al-awiin wa sunuunah misil fawaatir al-duud.
Wa fi sadrah indah misil dire' hana hadiid.Wa harakat janaaheeh tichaabih misil harakat arabaat al-harib al-yukurruuhum kheel wa maachiin ajala le l-duwaas.
Wa l-jaraad indah chookaay fi danabah misil chookaayit al-agrab wa danabah indah gudra yi'azzib al-naas muddit khamsa chahar.
Wa l-jaraad indah sultaan al-gaa'id yuguudah wa hu malak al-haawiye wa usmah be kalaam ibraani Abadduun wa usmah be kalaam yuunaani Abuliyuun (ma'anaatah al-mudammir).
Wa khalaas,al-azaab al-awwalaani kammal.Wa faddalo battaan itneen azaab.
Wa l-malak al-saadis darab al-burunji al-indah.Wa ana chift al-madbah al-dahbi al-gaa'id giddaam Allah wa simi't hiss jaayi min ust guruunah al-arba'a.
Wa l-hiss hajja le l-malak al-saadis al-indah burunji fi iidah wa gaal-:-Hill al-malaa'ika al-arba'a al-marbuutiin fi l-bahar al-kabiir wa hu al-Furaat.
Wa hallo al-arba'a malaa'ika dool wa humman jaahiziin le l-saa'a di wa l-yoom da wa l-chahar da wa l-sana di,wa fi l-wakit da bas yaktulu tilt naas al-ard.
Wa ana simi't adad al-askar al-raakbiin fi l-kheel wa adadhum miiteen malyuun.
Wa fi l-ru'ya di,ana chift kheel wa l-raakbiin fooghum.Wa ayyi waahid indah dire' marbuut fi sadrah wa loonah ahmar misil al-jamur wa akhdar zahri wa asfar misil al-kibriit.Wa ayyi juwaad raasah misil raas al-duud wa fi naar wa dukhkhaan wa kibriit maargiin min khachmah.
